q: How does the tamaraw's body compare to the ordinary carabao?
options: The tamaraw is darker and has a stockier body than the carabao.
The tamaraw is lighter in color and has longer legs than the carabao.
The tamaraw is bigger and heavier than the carabao.
The tamaraw has a longer horn span than the carabao.
explanation: The tamaraw has a darker color and a stockier body than the ordinary carabao.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ay may mas maitim na kulay at mas matipunong katawan kaysa sa karaniwang kalabaw.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw mas itom ug kolor ug mas baga ang lawas kay sa naandang kalabaw.

q: Which reptile lives in the Philippines, and what is one way to spot it even when its mouth is closed?
options: Crocodiles live in the Philippines, and some of their teeth still show even when their mouth is closed.
Alligators live in the Philippines, and you can see their teeth even when their mouth is closed.
Crocodiles live in the Philippines, but all their teeth are hidden when their mouth is closed.
Alligators live in the Philippines, but their teeth are always hidden when their mouth is closed.
explanation: The Philippines is home to crocodiles, not alligators, and some of a crocodile's teeth show even when its mouth is closed.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas ay buwaya (crocodile) ang nakatira, hindi alligator, at makikita ang ilang ngipin kahit nakasara ang bibig nito.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, buaya (crocodile) ang nagpuyo, dili alligator, ug makita ang pipila ka ngipon bisan sirado ang baba niini.

q: In which condition does a solute dissolve the fastest?
options: In warm water that is stirred
In cold water that is stirred
In warm water that is left still
In cold water that is left still
explanation: A solute dissolves faster in warm water and when stirred than in cold, still water.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis matunaw ang isang solute sa mainit na tubig at kung hinahalo, kaysa sa malamig at tahimik na tubig.
fact_bis: Mas paspas matunaw ang usa ka solute sa init nga tubig ug kon kutawon, kaysa sa bugnaw ug hilom nga tubig.

q: Why is binagol, the sweet delicacy made from giant taro, sticky and filling?
options: Because the giant taro root stores starchy food for the plant
Because the giant taro leaf produces a lot of sugar during photosynthesis
Because the giant taro flower releases a thick, sweet nectar
Because the giant taro stem contains a large amount of water and fiber
explanation: Giant taro is a root that stores starchy food for the plant, which is why binagol is sticky and filling.
fact_tl: Ang binagol ay matamis na kakanin na gawa sa giniling na giant taro o talyan, isang ugat-halaman na nag-iimbak ng almirol na pagkain para sa halaman, kaya ito malagkit at busog.
fact_bis: Ang binagol usa ka tam-is nga kalan-on nga hinimo sa gigaling nga giant taro o talyan, usa ka gamot nga tanom nga nagtipig sa almidon nga pagkaon para sa tanom, mao nga pilit kini ug makabusog.

q: Which group lists only observable properties of matter?
options: Color, smell, hardness, and texture
Weight in kilograms, number of atoms, and chemical formula
Boiling point, melting point, and electrical charge
Speed of movement, age, and country of origin
explanation: Observable properties of matter include color, smell, hardness, and texture, among others.
fact_tl: Ang bawat bagay ay may katangian na maaari nating obserbahan. Ang mga katangian ng matter ay kinabibilangan ng: kulay, amoy, hugis, tigas, texture (makinang o magaspang), at kung ito ay lumulutang o lumubog sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang matag materyal adunay mga katangian nga atong maobserba. Ang mga katangian sa matter naglakip sa: kolor, amoy, hugis, kagahi, texture (mahayahay o magaspang), ug kung kini mulutaw o molubog sa tubig.

q: Why do most geckos lick their own eyes?
options: Because they have no eyelids and cannot blink, so licking keeps their eyes clean and moist
Because they have very small eyelids that cannot cover their whole eye
Because licking their eyes helps them see better in the dark
Because their tears dry up quickly and licking replaces the moisture their tears would give
explanation: Most geckos have no eyelids and cannot blink, so they lick their own eyes with their tongue to keep them clean and moist.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng tuko ay walang talukap sa mata kaya hindi sila kumukurap; sa halip, dinidilaan nila ang sarili nilang mata para panatilihin itong malinis at basa.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga tuko walay tabontabon sa mata mao nga dili sila makapamilok; hinuon, ilang tilaan ang ilang kaugalingong mata aron magpabiling limpyo ug basa.

q: What are epiphytes, and which plants are common examples?
options: Plants that grow on tree branches — orchids, ferns, and some mosses are examples
Plants that grow fully underwater — seagrass and water lilies are examples
Plants that feed on other plants by stealing their nutrients — rafflesia is an example
Plants that only grow in soil with a lot of sunlight — sunflowers and corn are examples
explanation: Many orchids and ferns are epiphytes that grow on tree branches, and some mosses are epiphytes too.
fact_tl: Maraming orkidyas (orchids) at pako (ferns) ay mga epiphyte na tumutubo sa mga sanga ng puno. Kabilang din dito ang ilang lumot (moss).
fact_bis: Daghang orkidya (orchids) ug pako (ferns) ang mga epiphyte nga motubo sa mga sanga sa kahoy. Apil usab niini ang pipila ka lumot (moss).

q: Why is the air around us a uniform mixture of nitrogen, oxygen, and other gases?
options: The gases have slowly diffused together and mixed evenly over a long time
The gases were stirred together when the Earth first formed and have stayed mixed
The heavier gases sank and the lighter ones rose, creating an even blend
Strong winds continuously remix the gases every day so they never separate
explanation: Different gases mix spontaneously by diffusion, and our air has become a homogeneous mixture because these gases have diffused together over a very long time.
fact_tl: Ang iba't ibang gas ay kusang naghahalo sa pamamagitan ng diffusion. Ang ating hangin ay isang homogeneous na halo ng nitrogen, oxygen, at iba pang gas dahil ang mga gas ay nag-diffuse ng maayos sa loob ng mahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang lainlaing mga gas kusang naghahalo pinaagi sa diffusion. Ang atong hangin usa ka homogeneous nga halo sa nitrogen, oxygen, ug ubang mga gas tungod kay ang mga gas nagdiffuse nga maayo sa dugay na panahon.

q: Which Philippine bird is known as the largest kind of hornbill in the country?
options: The kalaw
The maya
The Philippine eagle
The kingfisher
explanation: The kalaw is the largest kind of hornbill in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang kalaw ang pinakamalaking uri ng hornbill sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang kalaw mao ang kinadak-ang matang sa hornbill sa Pilipinas.

q: How does a fever help the body fight an infection?
options: The heat of a fever signals the body to make and send more white blood cells to the infected area
The high temperature directly kills the germs by burning them up
A fever slows the body down so it can save energy to fight the infection
The fever causes the infected area to swell, trapping the germs so they cannot spread
explanation: The heat of a fever speeds the body up to make and send more white blood cells to fight germs.
fact_tl: Ang init ng lagnat ay parang hudyat na nagpapabilis sa katawan na gumawa at magpadala ng mas maraming puting selula ng dugo (white blood cells) sa lugar na may impeksyon, kaya mas marami ang lumalaban sa germs.
fact_bis: Ang init sa hilanat mura'g senyas nga magpapaspas sa lawas sa paghimo ug pagpadala og mas daghang puti nga selula sa dugo (white blood cells) sa lugar nga may impeksyon, busa mas daghan ang nakigbatok sa germs.

q: What happens to energy when a car's brakes press against the spinning wheels?
options: Friction changes the energy of motion into heat, so the brakes get hot
Friction stores the energy of motion in the brakes for later use
The brakes absorb the energy of motion and convert it into electrical energy
The energy of motion is destroyed completely when the brakes are applied
explanation: When brakes press against spinning wheels, friction changes the energy of motion into heat, which is why brakes get hot as the car slows.
fact_tl: Huminto ang kotse kapag ang mga preno ay dumidiin sa umiikot na gulong; ang friction ay nagbabago ng enerhiya ng paggalaw tungo sa init, kaya umiinit ang preno habang bumabagal ang kotse.
fact_bis: Mohunong ang awto kon ang mga preno modiin sa nagtuyok nga ligid; ang friction mag-usab sa enerhiya sa paglihok ngadto sa kainit, mao nga moinit ang preno samtang mohinay ang awto.

q: What role do the helpful bacteria living in the large intestine play?
options: They aid digestion and make some vitamins
They destroy all bacteria, including harmful ones, to keep the gut sterile
They absorb water and turn food into energy directly for the body
They produce digestive juices the same way the stomach does
explanation: Trillions of helpful bacteria live in the large intestine, aiding digestion and making some vitamins.
fact_tl: Sa malaking bituka nakatira ang triliyong mabubuting bakterya na tumutulong sa panunaw at gumagawa ng ilang bitamina.
fact_bis: Sa dako nga tinai nagpuyo ang triliyon nga maayong bakterya nga motabang sa paghilis ug mohimo ug pipila ka bitamina.

q: About how many bird species are found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in the world?
options: More than 200 endemic bird species
About 50 endemic bird species
More than 500 endemic bird species
Fewer than 20 endemic bird species
explanation: The Philippines has more than 200 endemic bird species, meaning they are found only there and nowhere else.
fact_tl: May mahigit 200 species ng ibon na endemiko sa Pilipinas, ibig sabihin matatagpuan lamang dito at wala sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay kapin sa 200 ka klase sa langgam nga endemiko, nga nagpasabot makit-an lamang dinhi ug wala sa ubang nasod.

q: Which of the following is a way people can help protect and restore coral reefs?
options: Creating marine sanctuaries and banning destructive fishing
Increasing the amount of fishing to reduce the number of fish that eat coral
Adding more sunscreen to the water to protect coral from UV light
Planting more mangroves on the coral reefs themselves
explanation: People can help reefs by creating sanctuaries and banning destructive fishing.
fact_tl: Maaaring tulungan ang mga bahura sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng mga santuwaryo at pagbabawal ng mapanirang pangingisda.
fact_bis: Matabangan nato ang mga bahura pinaagi sa paghimo og mga santuwaryo ug pagdili sa makadaut nga pangisda.

q: Where is a sea urchin's mouth, and what does it use it for?
options: On the underside of its body, to scrape algae off rocks using five teeth
On the top of its body, to catch floating food particles from the water
In the center of its body, hidden among its spines, to grab passing prey
At the front of its body, to bite pieces off seaweed and coral
explanation: A sea urchin has a mouth with five teeth on the underside of its body, used to scrape algae off rocks.
fact_tl: Ang sea urchin ay may bibig na may limang ngipin sa ilalim ng katawan na ginagamit upang kayurin ang lumot sa mga bato.
fact_bis: Ang tuyom adunay baba nga may lima ka ngipin sa ilawom sa lawas niini, gamiton aron kiskison ang lumot gikan sa mga bato.

q: Why is plastic waste a long-lasting problem for the environment?
options: Plastic does not rot easily, so it stays in the environment for a very long time
Plastic dissolves in rainwater and seeps into the soil, poisoning plants immediately
Plastic breaks down quickly in sunlight, releasing harmful gases into the air
Plastic is too heavy to be carried by wind or water, so it stays exactly where it is dropped
explanation: Plastic does not rot easily, so it stays in the environment for a very long time.
fact_tl: Hindi madaling nabubulok ang plastik, kaya nananatili ito sa kalikasan ng napakatagal.
fact_bis: Ang plastik dili dali madunot, mao nga magpabilin kini sa kinaiyahan og dugay kaayo.

q: Why does a water-filled balloon feel much heavier and drop faster than an air-filled balloon of the same size?
options: Water is a denser liquid, while air is a gas whose particles are spread far apart
Water absorbs heat from your hand, making it feel heavier than it really is
Air pushes down harder than water because gases have more pressure
A water balloon has a thicker rubber skin that adds most of the extra weight
explanation: Water is a denser liquid, while air is a gas whose particles are spread far apart, making the water balloon much heavier.
fact_tl: Ang lobong puno ng hangin ay magaan at madaling tumalbog, habang ang lobong puno ng tubig ay mabigat at mabilis bumagsak. Ito ay dahil ang tubig ay likido na mas siksik, samtang ang hangin ay gas na maluwag ang mga particle.
fact_bis: Ang lobo nga puno og hangin gaan ug dali molukso, samtang ang lobo nga puno og tubig bug-at ug paspas mahulog. Tungod kini kay ang tubig usa ka mas baga nga likido, samtang ang hangin usa ka gas nga halayo ang mga partikulo.

q: Why do different liquids form separate layers when poured into the same container?
options: The denser liquids sink to the bottom and the less dense ones float on top
The liquids separate because they are different colors and colors do not mix
The coldest liquid always sinks and the warmest always rises to the top
Liquids with more sugar settle to the bottom while plain water stays on top
explanation: Different liquids stack in layers because the denser ones sink to the bottom and the less dense ones float on top.
fact_tl: Nagpapatong-patong ang iba't ibang likido sa isang kolumna dahil ang mas mataas ang densidad ay lumulubog sa ilalim at ang mas mababa ay lumulutang sa itaas.
fact_bis: Magpatong-patong ang lain-laing likido sa usa ka kolumna kay ang mas dasok molugdang sa ilawom ug ang mas magaan molutaw sa ibabaw.

q: Where is the largest volcano in the entire Solar System located?
options: On Mars — it is called Olympus Mons
On Earth — it is the Mauna Loa volcano in Hawaii
On Jupiter's moon Io — it is called Pele
On Venus — it is called Maat Mons
explanation: Olympus Mons on Mars is the largest volcano in the Solar System.
fact_tl: Ang Olympus Mons sa Mars ang pinakamalaking bulkan sa Solar System.
fact_bis: Ang Olympus Mons sa Mars mao ang pinakadako nga bulkan sa Solar System.

q: Why do constellations appear to move slowly across the sky during the night?
options: Because the Earth is rotating on its axis
Because the stars themselves are orbiting around the Earth
Because the Moon's gravity pulls the stars across the sky
Because the constellations follow the path of the Sun
explanation: Constellations seem to slowly move across the sky at night because the Earth is rotating on its axis.
fact_tl: Mukhang dahan-dahang gumagalaw ang mga konstelasyon sa langit tuwing gabi dahil umiikot ang Earth sa sarili nitong axis.
fact_bis: Ang mga konstelasyon morag hinay nga muglihok sa langit panahon sa gabii tungod kay ang kalibutan nagtuyok sa iyang axis.

q: Why is it easier to slip on a wet floor than on a dry one?
options: Water reduces the friction between your shoes and the floor that normally gives you grip
Water makes the floor harder, so your shoes cannot press into it for grip
Wet shoes become heavier, making it harder to control your feet
Water makes the floor surface uneven, causing your feet to slide
explanation: A wet floor is slippery because water reduces the friction between your shoes and the floor that normally gives grip.
fact_tl: Madulas ang basang sahig dahil binabawasan ng tubig ang alitan sa pagitan ng iyong sapatos at sahig na siyang nagbibigay sa iyo ng kapit.
fact_bis: Danlog ang basa nga salog kay ang tubig magpakunhod sa kiskisanay tali sa imong sapatos ug salog nga maoy naghatag kanimo ug grip.

q: How does regular exercise affect a child's ability to stay healthy?
options: It helps strengthen the body's defenses against germs, so active kids tend to get sick a little less often
It replaces the need for vaccines because the body becomes naturally immune to all germs
It causes the body to produce antibiotics that kill bacteria before any illness starts
It raises body temperature slightly, which kills most germs before they cause disease
explanation: Regular exercise helps strengthen the body's defenses against germs, so kids who stay active tend to get sick a little less often.
fact_tl: Ang regular na ehersisyo ay tumutulong palakasin ang depensa ng katawan laban sa sakit. Kaya hindi ka basta-bastang magkakasipon o magkakasakit.
fact_bis: Ang regular nga ehersisyo makatabang sa pagpalig-on sa depensa sa lawas batok sa sakit. Mao nga dili dali magkasakit ang mga batang aktibo.

q: Besides its powerful shock, how does the electric eel sense objects around it in murky water?
options: It uses weak electric pulses to detect objects in its surroundings
It uses sensitive whiskers around its mouth to feel vibrations in the water
It produces clicks of sound that bounce off objects like a bat's echolocation
It releases a chemical into the water that sticks to nearby objects and can be smelled
explanation: Besides its strong shock, the electric eel uses weak electric pulses to sense objects around it even in murky water.
fact_tl: Bukod sa malakas na shock, gumagamit ang electric eel ng mahihinang kuryente upang maramdaman ang mga bagay sa paligid kahit malabo ang tubig.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kusog nga kuryente, naggamit ang electric eel og huyang nga mga pulso sa kuryente aron mabati ang mga butang sa palibot bisan halap ang tubig.

q: What is the correct way to make a simple electromagnet at home?
options: Wrap thin wire around an iron nail and connect both ends to a battery
Rub a steel needle on a permanent magnet and place it in water on a leaf
Pour saltwater over an iron nail and place it near a compass
Connect a copper wire directly between the two poles of a battery with no nail
explanation: You can make an electromagnet by wrapping thin wire around an iron nail and connecting the two ends to a battery.
fact_tl: Madali kang makakagawa ng electromagnet: ipulupot ang manipis na kawad sa isang bakal na pako, tapos ikabit ang dalawang dulo sa baterya. Subukan kung ilang clip ito makahila.
fact_bis: Sayon ra ka makahimo ug electromagnet: putoson ang nipis nga alambre sa usa ka puthaw nga lansang, dayon ikonektar ang duha ka tumoy sa baterya. Sulayi kung pila ka clip kini makabira.

q: Which animal is the largest that lives on land?
options: The African elephant
The white rhinoceros
The hippopotamus
The giraffe
explanation: The African elephant is the largest animal that lives on land.
fact_tl: Ang African elephant (elepanteng Aprikano) ang pinakamalaking hayop na naninirahan sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang African elephant (elepante sa Africa) maoy pinakadako nga hayop nga nagpuyo sa yuta.

q: What does a barnacle do at the beginning of its life before it becomes permanently attached to a surface?
options: It swims freely in the sea as a larva, searching for a good spot to settle
It burrows into sand on the ocean floor and stays hidden until fully grown
It attaches to a parent barnacle and grows there until it is big enough to move on its own
It floats on the surface of the water, carried by currents, until it hardens
explanation: As a larva, a barnacle swims freely in the sea searching for a good spot; once it settles, it stays there for its whole life.
fact_tl: Hindi laging nakadikit ang barnacle! Noong sanggol pa ito (larva), lumalangoy ito nang malaya sa dagat at naghahanap ng magandang lugar. Kapag nakahanap na ito ng tamang bato o balat, doon na ito mananatili habambuhay—hindi na ito muling gumagalaw.
fact_bis: Dili kanunay nadikit ang barnacle! Sa bata pa kini (larva), mulangoy kini nga gawasnon sa dagat ug mangita og maayong dapit. Kung makakita na kini sa hustong bato o panit, didto na kini mupuyo sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi—dili na kini mubalhin pag-usab.

q: What useful product can female goats provide for people?
options: Milk that people can drink or turn into cheese
Silk thread spun from their fur
Honey made in special glands near their hooves
Wax used to make candles and polish
explanation: Female goats give milk that people can drink or turn into cheese.
fact_tl: Ang babaeng kambing ay nagbibigay ng gatas na maaaring inumin o gawing keso.
fact_bis: Ang baye nga kanding naghatag og gatas nga mainom o himoon nga keso.

q: Which Philippine government agency monitors the habagat and amihan seasons and gives warnings when rains are heavy?
options: PAGASA
PHIVOLCS
DENR
DOST
explanation: PAGASA, the Philippine weather agency, monitors the habagat and amihan and gives warnings when rains are heavy.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA, ang ahensya ng panahon ng Pilipinas, ang nagbabantay sa habagat at amihan at nagbibigay ng babala kapag malakas ang ulan.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA, ang ahensya sa panahon sa Pilipinas, maoy nagbantay sa habagat ug amihan ug naghatag og pasidaan kung kusog ang ulan.

q: About how long is the International Space Station?
options: About 109 meters — roughly the length of a football field
About 50 meters — roughly the length of a swimming pool
About 300 meters — roughly the length of three football fields
About 20 meters — roughly the length of a school bus
explanation: The International Space Station is about 109 meters long, roughly the length of a football field.
fact_tl: Ang International Space Station ay halos 109 metro ang haba, kasinghaba ng isang football field.
fact_bis: Ang International Space Station mga 109 metros ang gitas-on, halos sama kataas sa usa ka football field.

q: What is special about a mantis shrimp's eyes?
options: They sit on movable stalks and can move separately in different directions
They are on the sides of its head and can only look forward together
They are on its claws and can be aimed at prey before striking
They are fixed in place but can see ultraviolet light that other animals cannot
explanation: The mantis shrimp's two eyes sit on stalks and can move separately in different directions.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang mata ng mantis shrimp ay nasa tangkay at kayang gumalaw nang hiwa-hiwalay sa magkaibang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka mata sa mantis shrimp anaa sa tangkay ug makahimo molihok nga magkalahi ang direksyon.

q: Why must a TB patient finish all their medicine even after they feel better?
options: Stopping early can let the bacteria return and grow stronger
The medicine only starts working once the full course is complete
TB bacteria can spread to others if the patient does not finish all the medicine
The last doses of medicine prevent the patient from catching TB again in the future
explanation: A patient must finish all the TB medicine even after feeling better, because stopping early can let the bacteria return and grow stronger.
fact_tl: Kailangang tapusin ang lahat ng gamot sa TB kahit gumaan na ang pakiramdam, dahil kung hihinto agad ay maaaring magbalik at lumakas ang bakterya.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan ubuson ang tanang tambal sa TB bisan og mibati na og maayo, kay kung moundang dayon mahimong mobalik ug molig-on ang bakterya.

q: Approximately how heavy can the blue whale get, making it the heaviest animal on Earth?
options: Up to about 150 tonnes
Up to about 50 tonnes
Up to about 300 tonnes
Up to about 20 tonnes
explanation: The blue whale is the heaviest animal, able to weigh up to about 150 tonnes.
fact_tl: Ang blue whale ang pinakamabigat na hayop, na maaaring tumimbang ng hanggang 150 tonelada.
fact_bis: Ang blue whale mao ang pinakabug-at nga hayop, mahimong motimbang ug hangtod 150 ka tonelada.

q: Besides filtering waste, what else do the kidneys control in the body?
options: The amount of salt and minerals in the body, removing the excess through urine
The amount of oxygen in the blood by adjusting how fast the heart beats
The level of sugar in the blood by producing insulin after every meal
The amount of water in the lungs by signaling the breathing rate to change
explanation: The kidneys control the amount of salt and minerals in the body and remove the excess through urine.
fact_tl: Kinokontrol din ng mga bato ang dami ng asin at mineral sa katawan, at inaalis ang sobra sa pamamagitan ng ihi.
fact_bis: Ang mga kidney mokontrol usab sa kadaghan sa asin ug mineral sa lawas, ug mokuha sa sobra pinaagi sa ihi.

q: How does seagrass affect the water around it?
options: It filters and calms the water, making the sea clearer
It releases chemicals that make the water slightly salty
It absorbs sunlight and warms the surrounding water
It produces oxygen bubbles that stir up sediment and cloud the water
explanation: Seagrass filters and calms the water, making the sea clearer.
fact_tl: Sinasala at pinapakalma ng damong-dagat ang tubig, kaya nagiging mas malinaw ang dagat.
fact_bis: Ang sagbot sa dagat nagsala ug nagpakalma sa tubig, mao nga mas tin-aw ang dagat.

q: What color of light does neon gas produce when electricity passes through it?
options: A bright red-orange glow
A bright blue-white glow
A soft green glow
A yellow glow similar to sunlight
explanation: Neon is a noble gas that produces a bright red-orange glow when electricity passes through it, which is why it is used in neon signs.
fact_tl: Ang neon ay isang noble gas na gumagawa ng maliwanag na pula-orange na liwanag kapag ang elektrisidad ay dumadaan dito. Ginagamit ito sa mga neon sign. Ang iba pang noble gas ay gumagawa ng iba pang mga kulay kapag pinagdaanan ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang neon usa ka noble gas nga nagbuhat og hayag nga pula-orange nga siga sa pag-agi sa kuryente niini. Gigamit kini sa mga neon sign. Ang ubang mga noble gas nagbuhat og lainlaing mga kolor sa pag-agi sa kuryente niini.

q: What is the capital of Camarines Sur?
options: Pili
Naga City
Iriga City
Daet
explanation: The capital of Camarines Sur is the town of Pili, not Naga City.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Camarines Sur ay ang bayan ng Pili, hindi ang Naga City.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa Camarines Sur mao ang lungsod sa Pili, dili ang Naga City.

q: Why do fish inside a marine sanctuary grow bigger and older than fish outside it?
options: Because they are not caught, so they have time to keep growing and produce more eggs
Because the water inside a sanctuary is cleaner and contains more food
Because the sanctuary warden feeds them regularly to keep them healthy
Because fish in a sanctuary have no natural predators and do not need to swim as fast
explanation: Because they are not caught, fish inside a sanctuary grow bigger and older, so they produce more eggs.
fact_tl: Dahil hindi sila nahuhuli, ang mga isda sa loob ng santuaryo ay nagiging mas malaki at matanda, kaya mas marami silang itlog.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dili sila madakpan, ang mga isda sulod sa santuaryo modako ug magmagulang, busa mas daghan silang mangitlog.

q: Why is it important to harvest rattan carefully and sustainably?
options: Because cutting too much from the forest can use it up, even though it is important for livelihoods
Because rattan grows only once and cannot regrow after being cut
Because rattan produces a poison that builds up in the forest if too much is removed
Because harvesting rattan damages the roots of nearby trees, which provide shade for animals
explanation: Rattan is important for livelihoods, but cutting too much from the forest can use it up, so it must be harvested carefully and sustainably.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang uway sa kabuhayan, pero kapag sobra ang pagputol nito sa gubat ay nauubos ito, kaya kailangan ng maingat at sustainableng pag-ani.
fact_bis: Importante ang uway sa panginabuhi, apan kung sobra ang pagputol niini sa lasang maubos kini, mao nga kinahanglan og mabinantayon ug malungtarong pag-ani.

q: How long is one day on Mars compared to one day on Earth?
options: A Mars day is about 24 hours and 37 minutes — a little longer than an Earth day
A Mars day is about 12 hours — roughly half as long as an Earth day
A Mars day is about 48 hours — about twice as long as an Earth day
A Mars day is exactly 24 hours — the same length as an Earth day
explanation: A day on Mars lasts about 24 hours and 37 minutes, which is a little longer than a day on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Mars ay mga 24 oras at 37 minuto — bahagyang mas mahaba kaysa sa araw sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Mars mokabat og mga 24 ka oras ug 37 ka minuto — gamay nga mas taas kaysa adlaw sa Earth.

q: Which statement best describes the density of gold?
options: Gold is a very dense metal, with a density of about 19.3 g/cm³
Gold is a light metal, with a density similar to aluminum at about 2.7 g/cm³
Gold has a moderate density, about the same as iron at around 7.9 g/cm³
Gold is the densest substance known, with a density above 50 g/cm³
explanation: Gold is a very dense metal, with a density of about 19.3 g/cm³.
fact_tl: Ang ginto (gold) ay napakasiksik na metal, na may densidad na mga 19.3 g/cm³.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan (gold) usa ka dasok kaayo nga metal, nga adunay densidad nga mga 19.3 g/cm³.

q: What does the prefix "milli" mean in units of measurement?
options: One thousandth (1/1000)
One hundredth (1/100)
One million (1,000,000)
One tenth (1/10)
explanation: The prefix "milli" means one thousandth (0.001), so 1 millimeter is 1/1000 of a meter.
fact_tl: Ang unlaping "milli" ay nangangahulugang ika-isanlibo (1/1000 o 0.001), kaya 1 milimetro ay 1/1000 ng metro.
fact_bis: Ang prefix nga "milli" nagpasabot og usa-ka-libo-ka-bahin (1/1000 o 0.001), busa ang 1 milimetro kay 1/1000 sa metro.

q: What is unusual about the length of a day on Venus compared to its year?
options: A single day on Venus is longer than its whole year because Venus spins very slowly
A day on Venus is much shorter than its year, just like on Earth
A day and a year on Venus are exactly the same length
A year on Venus is longer than a day because Venus travels its orbit very slowly
explanation: On Venus, one spin (a day) takes longer than one full trip around the Sun (a year) because Venus spins that slowly.
fact_tl: Sa Venus, mas mahaba ang isang araw (pag-ikot) kaysa sa isang taon (pag-ikot sa Araw) — napakabagal nitong umikot.
fact_bis: Sa Venus, mas taas ang usa ka adlaw (usa ka tuyok) kaysa sa usa ka tuig (usa ka libot sa Adlaw) — hinay kaayo kini motuyok.

q: How do scientists account for friction when using Newton's laws to describe motion in the real world?
options: They count friction as one more force included in the net force, so Newton's laws still hold
They ignore friction because Newton's laws only apply in situations with no friction
They use a special set of modified laws for real-world situations where friction is present
They subtract the effect of friction after calculating motion with Newton's laws, then add a correction
explanation: Even though friction complicates real-world motion, Newton's laws still hold — friction is just counted as one more force in the net force.
fact_tl: Kahit pinalubha ng friction ang paglalarawan ng galaw sa totoong mundo, gumagana pa rin ang mga batas ni Newton — itinuturing lang ang friction bilang isa pang puwersang kasama sa net force.
fact_bis: Bisan kon ang friction maglisod sa paghulagway sa lihok sa tinuod nga kalibutan, ang mga balaod ni Newton molihok gihapon — ang friction giihap lang isip usa pa ka kusog sa net force.

q: When did Sikorsky's practical helicopter, the VS-300, first fly?
explanation: Sikorsky's practical helicopter, the VS-300, first flew in 1939.
fact_tl: Unang lumipad ang praktikal na helicopter ni Sikorsky, ang VS-300, noong 1939.
fact_bis: Ang praktikal nga helicopter ni Sikorsky, ang VS-300, unang milupad niadtong 1939.

q: Why is it almost impossible to see a tardigrade with the naked eye?
options: Because tardigrades are usually less than a millimeter in size — about the size of a pen dot
Because tardigrades are transparent and blend in completely with water
Because tardigrades move too fast to be seen without special equipment
Because tardigrades live in total darkness and only come out in dim light
explanation: Tardigrades are usually less than a millimeter — about the size of a pen dot or grain of sand — so you need a microscope to see them.
fact_tl: Gaano kaliit ang tardigrade? Karaniwang mas maliit pa sa isang milimetro, mga kasinliit lang ng tuldok ng panulat o butil ng buhangin. Kaya halos imposibleng makita ng mata lang; kailangan mo ng mikroskopyo para mamasdan ang walong paa at galaw nila.
fact_bis: Unsa kagamay ang tardigrade? Kasagaran mas gamay pa sa usa ka milimetro, mga sama ra kagamay sa tuldok sa bolpen o lugas sa balas. Mao nga halos imposible makita sa mata lang; kinahanglan nimo ang mikroskopyo aron makita ang walo ka tiil ug ang ilang paglihok.

q: Why did dark-colored peppered moths become more common in industrial England?
options: They were better hidden on soot-darkened trees, so predators caught fewer of them
They were able to eat the soot on trees, giving them more food than the light moths
The pollution made light moths weaker, so dark moths survived diseases better
Dark moths preferred to live in cities, while light moths stayed in the countryside
explanation: During industrial England, dark peppered moths became common because they were better hidden on soot-darkened trees, so predators caught fewer of them.
fact_tl: Noong panahon ng industriyalisasyon sa England, dumami ang maitim na gamu-gamo dahil mas nakatago ito sa mga punong nadungisan ng uling.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa industriyalisasyon sa England, midaghan ang itom nga anunugba kay mas natago kini sa mga kahoy nga nahugawan sa abo.

q: What is the main nuclear fusion process that produces energy in the Sun's core?
options: The proton-proton chain, where four hydrogen nuclei fuse into one helium nucleus and release energy
The carbon-nitrogen cycle, where carbon atoms split apart and release energy as light
The fission of uranium atoms, which releases heat that powers the Sun's radiation
The collision of helium nuclei that split into hydrogen and release gamma rays
explanation: In the Sun's core, the proton-proton chain fuses four hydrogen nuclei into one helium-4 nucleus, and the tiny mass lost is converted into large amounts of energy.
fact_tl: Sa core ng Araw, ang pangunahing proseso ng nuclear fusion ay ang proton-proton chain: apat na hydrogen nuclei (proton) ay pinagsasama sa isang helium-4 nucleus, na nagpapalabas ng positron, neutrino, at gamma radiation. Ang maliliit na pagbaba ng mass ay na-convert sa malaking enerhiya ayon sa E=mc².
fact_bis: Sa core sa Adlaw, ang panguna nga proseso sa nuclear fusion mao ang proton-proton chain: upat ka hydrogen nuclei (proton) gipagsama sa usa ka helium-4 nucleus, nagpagawas og mga positron, neutrino, ug gamma radiation. Ang gamay nga pagkawala sa mass na-convert sa dagko nga kantidad sa enerhiya sumala sa E=mc².

q: Who made the first mass-produced toothbrush, and approximately when?
options: The Englishman William Addis, around 1780
The American Thomas Edison, around 1880
The German Karl Drais, around 1820
The French scientist Louis Pasteur, around 1860
explanation: The first mass-produced toothbrush was made by the Englishman William Addis around 1780.
fact_tl: Ang unang ginawang maramihang sipilyo (toothbrush) ay gawa ng Ingles na si William Addis noong mga 1780.
fact_bis: Ang unang gihimo nga daghang sipilyo (toothbrush) gihimo sa Ingles nga si William Addis mga 1780.

q: Why is the dugong considered harmless to people?
options: It only eats seagrass and never attacks anyone
It uses its tail to warn people to stay away
It moves so slowly that it cannot reach swimmers
It lives in deep water far from beaches
explanation: The dugong is gentle and harmless because it eats only seagrass and does not attack people.
fact_tl: Ang mabagal na dugong ay napakabanayad at hindi nakakasakit sa tao, dahil damong-dagat lang ang kinakain nito at hindi ito nanlalaban.
fact_bis: Ang hinay nga dugong malumo kaayo ug dili makasakit sa tawo, kay sagbot ra sa dagat ang gikaon niini ug dili kini mosukol.

q: In what year did Galileo discover the large moons of Jupiter?
explanation: Galileo discovered Jupiter's large moons in the year 1610.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang malalaking buwan ng Jupiter noong taong 1610.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ni Galileo ang dagkong bulan sa Jupiter sa tuig 1610.

q: What happens to your heart rate and blood pressure right after smoking even one cigarette?
options: They both slow down as the body relaxes
Only blood pressure rises, not heart rate
Both heartbeat and blood pressure increase immediately
Nothing changes after just one cigarette
explanation: Even a single cigarette immediately speeds up the heartbeat and raises blood pressure.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nagtatanong: masama ba kahit isang stick lang? Oo, kahit isang sigarilyo ay nagpapabilis na agad ng tibok ng puso at nagpapataas ng presyon, kaya mas mabuting huwag nang subukan.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang mangutana: daotan ba bisan usa ra ka stick? Oo, bisan usa ka sigarilyo magpaspas dayon sa pitik sa kasingkasing ug magpasaka sa presyon, mao nga mas maayo nga dili na sulayan.

q: How do water plants stay afloat and get oxygen to their roots in muddy water?
options: Their waxy leaves repel water and trap air bubbles underneath
They grow very long roots that reach air pockets in deep soil
Spongy tissue filled with air spaces keeps them buoyant and carries oxygen to the roots
They release gas bubbles that push them upward toward the surface
explanation: Water plants have spongy tissue full of air spaces that keep them buoyant and carry oxygen down to roots in airless mud.
fact_tl: Maraming halamang-tubig ang may parang esponghang tisyu na puno ng espasyong hangin sa loob ng dahon at tangkay. Ang hanging ito ang nagpapagaan at nagpapalutang sa kanila, at nagdadala rin ng oxygen pababa sa ugat na nasa putik na walang hangin.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom sa tubig adunay morag espongha nga tisyu nga puno sa luna sa hangin sulod sa dahon ug tangkay. Kini nga hangin maoy naghimo nilang gaan ug molutaw, ug nagdala usab og oxygen paubos sa gamot nga naa sa lapok nga walay hangin.

q: Which scientist first proposed that the Sun is at the center of the solar system?
options: Galileo Galilei
Isaac Newton
Nicolaus Copernicus
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Nicolaus Copernicus placed the Sun at the center of the solar system in the heliocentric model.
fact_tl: Si Nicolaus Copernicus ang naglagay ng Araw sa sentro ng solar system (heliocentric).
fact_bis: Si Nicolaus Copernicus ang nagbutang sa Adlaw sa sentro sa solar system (heliocentric).

q: What do the tiny glands in your skin produce to cool your body down?
options: Oil
Sweat
Blood
Mucus
explanation: The skin has tiny glands that make sweat to cool the body down.
fact_tl: May maliliit na glandula sa balat na gumagawa ng pawis para palamigin ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang panit adunay gagmayng glandula nga mohimo ug singot aron pabugnawon ang lawas.

q: An object gets a static charge when it has extra or missing what?
options: Protons
Neutrons
Electrons
Atoms
explanation: When an object has extra or missing electrons it becomes negatively or positively charged and gains a static charge.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng electric charge: positibo at negatibo. Karaniwang balanse ang charge ng isang bagay, ngunit kapag may sobra o kulang na electrons ito, nagiging negatibo o positibo at nagkakaroon ng static charge.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka klase sa electric charge: positibo ug negatibo. Kasagaran balanse ang charge sa usa ka butang, apan kung adunay sobra o kulang nga electrons kini, mahimong negatibo o positibo ug makabaton og static charge.

q: How did the roller bird get its name?
options: Because of the rolling pattern on its feathers
Because it rolls leaves into a nest
Because it rolls and tumbles like an acrobat in the air
Because it rolls food before eating it
explanation: The roller is named for the way it rolls and tumbles like an acrobat during flight.
fact_tl: Ang roller ay pinangalanan sa paggulong at pagbaligtad nitong parang akrobat sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang roller ginganlan tungod sa pagligid ug pagbalintong niini nga sama sa akrobat sa hangin.

q: What does a gas do when it is put inside a container like a balloon?
options: It sinks to the bottom of the container
It keeps a fixed shape and stays in one spot
It spreads out to fill the whole container
It turns into a liquid at the edges
explanation: A gas has no fixed shape and spreads to fill its whole container, just like air in a balloon.
fact_tl: Ang gas ay walang sariling hugis at pinupuno ang buong lalagyan, tulad ng hangin sa lobo.
fact_bis: Ang gas walay kaugalingong porma ug mokatap aron pun-on ang tibuok sudlanan, sama sa hangin sa lobo.

q: Where do most sponges live, and how simple are they compared to other animals?
options: Most live in freshwater rivers and are moderately complex animals
Most live in the sea and are among the simplest animals
Most live on land in moist soil and are highly complex animals
Most live in lakes and have a basic nervous system
explanation: Sponges are among the simplest animals and most of them live in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang espongha ay isa sa pinakasimpleng mga hayop, at karamihan dito ay nabubuhay sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang espongha usa sa pinakasimple nga mga mananap, ug kasagaran niini nagpuyo sa dagat.

q: What is the job of T cells in the immune system?
options: They produce antibodies that stick to germs
They carry oxygen through the blood to fight infection
They kill cells that are already infected by a germ
They form a physical barrier on the skin against pathogens
explanation: T cells are lymphocytes that kill cells already infected by a germ.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng lymphocyte: ang B cells na gumagawa ng antibody, at ang T cells na pumapatay sa mga selulang nahawaan ng germ.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka matang sa lymphocyte: ang B cells nga maghimo og antibody, ug ang T cells nga mopatay sa mga selula nga natakdan na sa germ.

q: Which muscle bends your elbow when you lift something?
options: Triceps
Quadriceps
Biceps
Deltoid
explanation: The biceps pulls to bend the elbow, while the triceps pulls to straighten it.
fact_tl: Hinihila ng biceps ang braso para mabaluktot ang siko, at hinihila naman ng triceps para matuwid ito.
fact_bis: Ang biceps mobira aron mobawog ang siko, ug ang triceps mobira aron motuwid kini.

q: What causes the 'hic' sound when you get hiccups?
options: Air rushing past the vocal cords too quickly during a deep breath
The stomach tightening and pushing air out of the mouth
The diaphragm suddenly twitching, making a quick gulp of air snap the throat shut
The lungs squeezing together and forcing air upward
explanation: Hiccups happen when the diaphragm suddenly twitches, making a quick gulp of air snap the throat shut and producing the 'hic' sound.
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon tayo ng sinok kapag biglang kumikitil ang diaphragm, ang kalamnan sa ilalim ng baga na ginagamit sa paghinga. Ang biglang paghigop ng hangin ay nagsasara sa lalamunan at gumagawa ng tunog na 'ik'.
fact_bis: Magsinok ta kon kalit nga mokitil ang diaphragm, ang kaunoran sa ilawom sa baga nga gamiton sa pagginhawa. Ang kalit nga pagsuyop og hangin mosira sa tutunlan ug mohimo sa tingog nga 'ik'.

q: What gas released by burning fossil fuels contributes to warming the Earth?
options: Nitrogen
Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Hydrogen
explanation: Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide, which warms the Earth.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ng mga fossil fuel ay naglalabas ng carbon dioxide na nagpapainit ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog sa fossil fuels mopagawas ug carbon dioxide nga magpainit sa Kalibotan.

q: Which agency warns Filipinos about incoming typhoons using wind signals?
options: DENR
PHIVOLCS
PAGASA
DOH
explanation: PAGASA is the agency that warns the country when a typhoon is coming, using wind signals to tell how strong the wind will be.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ang ahensya na nagbababala kapag may bagyong paparating, at gumagamit ito ng mga signal na nagsasabi kung gaano kalakas ang hangin.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA mao ang ahensya nga magpasidaan kon adunay bagyo nga moabot, ug naggamit kini og mga signal nga magsulti kon unsa ka kusog ang hangin.

q: In a string telephone made from two cans, how does your voice reach your friend?
options: The air between the cans carries the sound like a wave
The vibration of your voice travels along the tight string to the other can
The metal of the cans amplifies the sound so it jumps across
The string reflects the sound back and forth until it reaches the other can
explanation: Vibrations from your voice travel along the tight string connecting the two cans to reach your friend.
fact_tl: Kung magkakabit ka ng dalawang lata gamit ang hinatak na pisi, makakausap mo ang kaibigan mo dahil dumadaloy ang yanig ng iyong boses sa pisi papunta sa kabilang lata.
fact_bis: Kon imong idugtong ang duha ka lata pinaagi sa hugot nga pisi, makasulti ka sa imong higala kay ang pagkurog sa imong tingog molabay sa pisi paingon sa pikas lata.

q: What does the unit called the watt measure?
options: The amount of stored energy in a battery
The strength of an electric current
How fast energy is used, or power
The total electrical charge in a circuit
explanation: The watt is the unit that measures power, or how fast energy is used.
fact_tl: Ang watt ang yunit na sumusukat sa power o ang bilis ng paggamit ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang watt mao ang unit nga nagsukod sa power, o kon unsa ka paspas gamiton ang enerhiya.

q: What does adrenaline do to your body when you are scared or excited?
options: It slows down the heartbeat so you can think more clearly
It speeds up the heartbeat and breathing so the body is ready to fight or run
It makes the muscles relax so you do not get injured
It lowers blood pressure to prevent the body from overheating
explanation: Adrenaline is released when scared or excited and speeds up the heartbeat and breathing so the body is ready to fight or run.
fact_tl: Ang adrenaline ay hormone mula sa adrenal glands na naglalabas tuwing natatakot o nasasabik tayo. Pinapabilis nito ang tibok ng puso at hininga para handang lumaban o tumakbo ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang adrenaline usa ka hormone gikan sa adrenal glands nga gibuga kon mahadlok o malipay kita. Gipakusog niini ang pitik sa kasingkasing ug pagginhawa aron andam ang lawas nga makig-away o modagan.

q: How many bones does a fully grown adult human body have?
explanation: A fully grown adult human body has 206 bones.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng isang ganap na tao ay may 206 na buto.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa usa ka hingkod nga tawo adunay 206 ka bukog.

q: What is the term for a positively charged ion that forms when an atom loses electrons?
options: Anion
Isotope
Molecule
Cation
explanation: When an atom loses electrons it becomes a positively charged ion called a cation, such as the sodium ion Na+.
fact_tl: Kapag nawalan ng elektron ang isang atomo, nagiging positibong sisingilin na ion ito na tinatawag na cation, gaya ng sodium ion na Na⁺.
fact_bis: Kon mawad-an ug elektron ang usa ka atomo, mahimo kining positibo nga ion nga gitawag ug cation, sama sa sodium ion nga Na⁺.

q: How are the two daughter cells produced by mitosis related to the parent cell?
options: They each have half the DNA of the parent cell
They have random combinations of the parent's genes
They are genetically identical copies with exactly the same DNA
They have twice as much DNA as the parent cell
explanation: Mitosis produces two daughter cells that are genetically identical copies of the parent cell with the same DNA.
fact_tl: Ang mitosis ay nagbibigay ng dalawang anak na selula na magkaparehong genetic copy ng magulang na selula — ang bawat anak ay may eksaktong parehong DNA tulad ng orihinal.
fact_bis: Ang mitosis nagbuhat og duha ka anak nga selula nga pareho ang genetic copy sa magulang nga selula — ang matag anak adunay eksakto nga samang DNA sa orihinal.

q: Why don't a rodent's front teeth grow too long even though they are always chewing?
options: A rodent's teeth stop growing after it becomes an adult
The gnawing action wears the teeth down so they stay a normal length
A rodent never bites hard enough to wear its teeth down
Special chemicals in the food keep the teeth from growing
explanation: Every time a rodent gnaws, its teeth wear down so they do not get too long.
fact_tl: Sa tuwing ngumangata ang daga, naaagnas at naninipis ang kanilang ngipin upang hindi humaba nang sobra.
fact_bis: Matag higayon nga mokitkit ang ilaga, nagasap-ad ang ilang ngipon aron dili kini motaas og sobra.

q: What happens to water's freezing point when salt is added to it?
options: It rises above 0 degrees Celsius
It stays exactly at 0 degrees Celsius
It drops below 0 degrees Celsius
It becomes impossible for the water to freeze
explanation: Adding salt to water lowers its freezing point below 0 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Kapag naglagay ng asin sa tubig, bumababa ang freezing point nito sa ilalim ng 0 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Kung butangan og asin ang tubig, mokunhod ang freezing point niini ubos sa 0 ka degrees Celsius.

q: What makes a fumarole a 'solfatara' instead of a regular fumarole?
options: It releases steam that is hotter than 300 degrees Celsius
It is located inside the crater of an active volcano
It releases sulfur gas and usually has yellow sulfur deposits around it
It only appears after a major eruption has finished
explanation: Fumaroles that emit sulfur gas are called solfataras and usually have yellow sulfur deposits around them.
fact_tl: Ang fumarole ay mga butas sa lupa na lumalabas ng mainit na gas mula sa magma sa ibaba; ang mga fumarole na nagpapalabas ng sulfur gas ay tinatawag na solfatara at karaniwang may dilaw na deposito ng asupre sa paligid nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga fumarole mga buslot sa yuta nga nagpagawas sa mainit nga gas nga nagsaka gikan sa magma sa ilawom; ang mga fumarole nga nagpagawas og sulfur gas gitawag og solfataras ug kasagaran adunay dilaw nga mga deposito sa asupre sa palibot niini.

q: Which dwarf planet is found in the asteroid belt and is the largest object there?
options: Pluto
Eris
Ceres
Makemake
explanation: Ceres is the only dwarf planet in the asteroid belt and is the largest object there.
fact_tl: Ang Ceres ang tanging dwarf planet sa asteroid belt at ito ang pinakamalaking bagay doon.
fact_bis: Ang Ceres mao ang bugtong dwarf planet sa asteroid belt ug mao ang kinadak-ang butang didto.

q: How can you keep your balance even when your eyes are closed?
options: The fluid in your ears sends signals directly to your arms and legs
Your skin senses tiny changes in air pressure and adjusts your posture
Your muscles and joints constantly sense where your body parts are
Your brain memorizes your exact position from the last time you had your eyes open
explanation: Your muscles and joints sense where your body parts are, helping you balance even with your eyes closed.
fact_tl: Nakakaramdam ang iyong mga kalamnan at kasukasuan kung nasaan ang mga bahagi ng katawan mo, at tumutulong ito sa balanse kahit nakapikit ka.
fact_bis: Ang imong mga kaunuran ug kasukasuan makabati kung asa ang mga bahin sa imong lawas, ug kini motabang sa balanse bisan piyong ang imong mata.

q: What types of protected areas does the Philippines use to conserve its unique plants and animals?
options: Hunting reserves and wildlife farms
National parks and marine sanctuaries
Botanical gardens and city zoos
Research stations and animal hospitals
explanation: The Philippines has national parks and marine sanctuaries to save its endemic plants and animals.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may mga "protected area" tulad ng national parks at marine sanctuary para mailigtas ang mga halaman at hayop na endemic dito.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay mga "protected area" sama sa national parks ug marine sanctuary aron maluwas ang mga tanom ug hayop nga endemic dinhi.

q: What can a sleeping dog do that shows its ears never fully rest?
options: It wags its tail in response to familiar sounds nearby
It whimpers softly whenever it detects vibrations in the ground
It can wake up right away and bark if a sudden noise occurs
It moves its ears toward the sound but stays completely asleep
explanation: Even while asleep, a dog's ears keep listening, so a sudden noise can wake it up right away.
fact_tl: Kahit natutulog ang aso, patuloy pa ring nakikinig ang kanyang tainga. Kaya kung may biglaang ingay sa labas o sa loob ng bahay, agad itong magigising at maaaring tumayo o tumahol.
fact_bis: Bisan natulog ang iro, padayon gihapon nga namati ang iyang dalunggan. Mao nga kung adunay kalit nga saba sa gawas o sulod sa balay, dali kini mahigmata ug mahimong motindog o mag-usig.

q: What causes the colorful lights of auroras in the sky?
options: Sunlight reflecting off ice crystals high in the atmosphere
Charged particles from the Sun exciting gas atoms in Earth's atmosphere
Lightning discharges at extremely high altitudes during solar storms
Infrared radiation from the Sun bending as it enters the polar atmosphere
explanation: Auroras form when charged particles from the Sun excite gas atoms in the atmosphere, which release light as they return to their normal state.
fact_tl: Ang aurora ay nabubuo kapag ang mga charged particles mula sa araw ay pumapasok sa atmospera ng Mundo at nagpapabago ng mga atom ng hangin — ang mga atom na ito ay naglalabas ng liwanag sa iba't ibang kulay habang bumabalik sa normal na estado.
fact_bis: Ang aurora nahimo kung ang mga charged particle gikan sa Adlaw mosulod sa atmospera sa Yuta ug magpalihok sa mga atom sa hangin — kining mga atom nagahawa og suga sa lain-laing kolor habang nagbalik sa ilang normal nga estado.

q: Why do many fish and birds stay together in large groups?
options: They need body heat from each other to survive cold temperatures
They cooperate to build larger shelters than any one animal could make alone
More eyes watch for danger and a predator finds it hard to pick one target in a crowd
They share food more efficiently when traveling in a group
explanation: Animals in groups are safer because more eyes watch for danger and a predator finds it hard to single out one target in a crowd.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop gaya ng isda at ibon ang nananatiling sama-sama sa malalaking grupo. Mas ligtas sila dahil mas maraming mata ang nagbabantay sa panganib, at mahirap pumili ng tatarget ang mandaragit sa gitna ng karamihan.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sama sa isda ug langgam ang magpundok sa dagkong grupo. Mas luwas sila kay daghan og mata nga magbantay sa kuyaw, ug lisod alang sa manunukob nga mopili og usa ka target sa daghan.

q: Which ship discovered the Emden Deep in 1927?
options: The HMS Challenger
The Emden
The Trieste
The Meteor
explanation: The Emden Deep was discovered by the German ship Emden in 1927.
fact_tl: Ang Emden Deep ay natuklasan ng German na barkong Emden noong 1927.
fact_bis: Ang Emden Deep nadiskobrehan sa Aleman nga barko nga Emden niadtong 1927.

q: Who invented the computer mouse, and in what year?
options: Steve Jobs in 1984
Alan Turing in 1952
Douglas Engelbart in 1964
Bill Gates in 1975
explanation: Douglas Engelbart invented the computer mouse in 1964.
fact_tl: Si Douglas Engelbart ang umimbento ng computer mouse noong 1964.
fact_bis: Si Douglas Engelbart ang nag-imbento sa computer mouse niadtong 1964.

q: When does your brain become aware that a reflex action has taken place?
options: Before the action happens, so the brain can decide whether to allow it
At exactly the same moment the action occurs
Only after the reflex is already done
The brain is always in full control and triggers every reflex itself
explanation: Your brain only learns about the reflex after it has already happened, so you feel the pain even though the action is done.
fact_tl: Ang utak ay nalalaman ang reflex pagkatapos na itong mangyari, kaya nararamdaman mo ang sakit kahit tapos na ang kilos.
fact_bis: Ang utok mahibalo lang sa reflex human kini mahitabo, mao nga mabati nimo ang sakit bisan human na ang lihok.

q: How do elephants help create grassland habitat for other animals in the savanna?
options: They dig large waterholes that attract herds of grazing animals
They scatter seeds across the savanna through their droppings
They knock down trees, opening the land and turning it into grassland
They chase off large predators so smaller grazers can feed safely
explanation: Elephants are keystone species because they knock down trees and open the land, turning it into grassland for other animals.
fact_tl: Ang mga elepante ay keystone species sa savanna dahil tinutumba nila ang mga puno at binubuksan ang lupa, na ginagawang damuhan para sa ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga elepante keystone species sa savanna kay ila ginatumba ang mga kahoy ug giablihan ang yuta, nga mahimong kasagbutan alang sa ubang hayop.

q: What is the name of the main chemical in vinegar?
options: Citric acid
Hydrochloric acid
Acetic acid
Lactic acid
explanation: The main chemical in vinegar is acetic acid, with the formula CH3COOH.
fact_tl: Ang pangunahing kemikal sa suka ay acetic acid, na may pormula na CH3COOH.
fact_bis: Ang pangunang kemikal sa suka kay acetic acid, nga adunay pormula nga CH3COOH.

q: What is the capital city of South Korea?
options: Busan
Incheon
Daegu
Seoul
explanation: The capital of South Korea is Seoul.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng South Korea (Timog Korea) ay Seoul.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa South Korea mao ang Seoul.

q: From which kingdom of life did scientists obtain penicillin, one of the first antibiotic medicines?
options: Bacteria
Plantae
Animalia
Fungi
explanation: Penicillin came from a kind of mold that belongs to the fungi kingdom, showing how studying fungi benefits medicine.
fact_tl: May tunay na pakinabang ang pag-aaral ng mga kaharian: mula sa isang uri ng amag (fungi) nagmula ang penicillin, isa sa mga unang antibiotic na gamot na pumapatay sa nakakasakit na bacteria. Kaya ang pag-unawa sa fungi at bacteria ay tumutulong sa medisina.
fact_bis: Adunay tinuod nga kaayohan ang pagtuon sa mga gingharian: gikan sa usa ka klase sa agup-op (fungi) naggikan ang penicillin, usa sa unang antibiotic nga tambal nga mopatay sa makadaot nga bacteria. Mao nga ang pagsabot sa fungi ug bacteria motabang sa medisina.

q: Why does a rolling ball eventually slow down and stop on its own?
options: Gravity pulls it downward and reduces its sideways movement
Air pressure builds up in front of the ball and pushes it back
Friction between the ball and the ground takes away its energy
The ball's own weight makes it sink into the surface over time
explanation: A rolling ball slows down and stops because of friction with the ground.
fact_tl: Kapag tinulak ang isang bola, gumugulong ito at unti-unting bumabagal hanggang tumigil dahil sa friction o kuskos sa lupa.
fact_bis: Kung tuklon ang usa ka bola, moligid kini ug hinay-hinay nga mohinay hangtod nga mohunong tungod sa friction o kuskos sa yuta.

q: What is the name for the thin line that separates one rock layer from the next?
options: A fault line
A bedding plane
A mineral seam
A cleavage plane
explanation: The thin line that separates two rock layers is called a bedding plane, often seen as color bands on a cliff.
fact_tl: Bawat patong ng bato ay tinatawag na stratum, at ang marami sa kanila ay strata. Ang manipis na guhit na naghihiwalay sa dalawang patong ay tinatawag na bedding plane. Madalas mong makita ang mga ito bilang iba't ibang kulay na guhit sa isang bangin o gilid ng bundok.
fact_bis: Ang matag patong sa bato gitawag nga stratum, ug daghan kanila gitawag nga strata. Ang nipis nga linya nga nagbulag sa duha ka patong gitawag nga bedding plane. Kanunay nimo kining makita isip lain-laing kolor nga guhit sa pangpang o kilid sa bukid.

q: Besides carrying heat, what else does blood deliver to skin cells?
options: Hormones that control the color of the skin only
Nutrients and oxygen that skin cells need to live, grow, and repair
Digestive enzymes that break down old skin cells
Water to keep the outer surface of the skin moist
explanation: Blood delivers nutrients and oxygen that skin cells need to stay alive, grow, and repair themselves when injured.
fact_tl: Hindi lang init ang dala ng dugo sa balat — nagdadala rin ito ng sustansya at oksiheno na kailangan ng mga selula ng balat para mabuhay, lumaki, at maayos ang sarili kapag nasugatan.
fact_bis: Dili lang kainit ang dala sa dugo ngadto sa panit — nagdala usab kini og sustansya ug oksiheno nga gikinahanglan sa mga selula sa panit aron mabuhi, motubo, ug maayo ang kaugalingon kung masamad.

q: Why do stage and theater lighting designers use the soft penumbra shadow effect?
options: To make the stage look darker and more dramatic for horror scenes
To hide the edges of the stage so the audience cannot see the set boundaries
To make shadows gentle instead of sharp so the scene looks pleasant
To save electricity by using less focused, dimmer light sources
explanation: In theater, the soft penumbra is used to make shadows gentle instead of sharp so the scene looks pleasant to the eyes.
fact_tl: Sa mga palabas at dula sa entablado, ginagamit ang malabong penumbra para gawing malambot at hindi matalim ang mga anino, kaya mas maganda at hindi nakakagulat sa mata ang tanawin.
fact_bis: Sa mga pasundayag ug drama sa entablado, gigamit ang hanap nga penumbra aron mahimong humok ang mga landong imbes hait, mao nga mas nindot tan-awon ug dili makapakurat sa mata.

q: What do scientists call cocci bacteria that group together in a square arrangement of four cells?
options: Diplococcus
Streptococcus
Tetrad
Sarcina
explanation: Cocci that group in fours like a square are called a tetrad.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pares at kadena, ang mga cocci ay maaari ring mag-grupo ng tig-aapat na parang kuwadrado, tinatawag na tetrad. May ilan pang nag-gugrupo ng walo o higit pa parang maliit na kubo.
fact_bis: Gawas sa parisparis ug kadena, ang cocci mahimo usab nga magpundok og tag-upat murag kwadrado, gitawag og tetrad. Ang uban magpundok pa og tagwalo o sobra murag gamay nga kubo.

q: What arrangement of the Sun, Earth, and Moon is needed for an eclipse to happen?
options: The Moon must be on the opposite side of the Sun from Earth
All three must form a right angle with Earth at the corner
The Sun, Earth, and Moon must line up in a nearly straight row
The Moon must be twice as close to Earth as usual
explanation: An eclipse happens when the Sun, Earth, and Moon line up in a nearly straight row.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang eclipse kapag halos tuwid na magkahanay ang Araw, Lupa, at Buwan.
fact_bis: Ang eklipse mahitabo kon ang Adlaw, Yuta, ug Bulan halos tul-id nga maghan-ay.

q: How does the staghorn fern get its water and nutrients if it does not feed off the tree it clings to?
options: Its roots reach down into the soil far below the tree
It absorbs rain and nutrients from the air and debris that collects around its base
It steals sap directly from the tree's bark using tiny rootlets
It only needs sunlight and produces all its nutrients through photosynthesis
explanation: The staghorn fern is an epiphyte that only uses the tree as a perch and absorbs rain and nutrients from its surroundings, not from the tree itself.
fact_tl: Ang staghorn fern ay isang pakong tumutubo na nakakapit sa mga sanga ng puno (epiphyte) at may mga dahong hugis-sungay ng usa, ngunit hindi nito sinisipsip ang sustansya ng puno—gumagamit lang ito nito bilang lugar na matirahan.
fact_bis: Ang staghorn fern usa ka pako nga motubo nga nagkapyot sa mga sanga sa kahoy (epiphyte) ug adunay mga dahon nga morag sungay sa usa, apan dili niini suyopon ang sustansiya sa kahoy—gigamit lang kini ingong puy-anan.

q: What body part does an owl use to catch and hold its prey?
options: Its sharp beak
The sharp talons on its feet
Its stiff wing feathers
Its powerful chest muscles
explanation: An owl uses the sharp talons on its feet to catch and grip its prey.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng kuwago ang matalim na mga kuko sa paa nito upang hulihin at hawakan ang biktima.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa bukaw ang hait nga mga kuko sa iyang tiil aron dakpon ug kuptan ang biktima.

q: What is the anahaw plant honored as in the Philippines?
options: The national tree
The national flower
The national leaf
The national grass
explanation: The anahaw is honored as the national leaf of the Philippines, with large fan-shaped leaves used for fans and roofing.
fact_tl: Ang anahaw ay isang palmera na may malalaki at bilog na dahong hugis-abaniko, at ito ang itinuturing na pambansang dahon ng Pilipinas at ginagamit bilang pamaypay at pangbubong.
fact_bis: Ang anahaw usa ka palmera nga may dagko ug lingin nga dahon nga porma sa pamaypay, ug kini ang giila nga nasudnong dahon sa Pilipinas ug gigamit isip pamaypay ug atop.

q: Which two gases make up most of Earth's atmosphere, and roughly what percentage is each?
options: Oxygen (78%) and nitrogen (21%)
Nitrogen (78%) and oxygen (21%)
Carbon dioxide (78%) and oxygen (21%)
Nitrogen (50%) and oxygen (49%)
explanation: The atmosphere is mostly nitrogen (about 78%) and oxygen (about 21%).
fact_tl: Ang hangin sa atmospera ay halos puro nitrogen (mga 78%) at oxygen (mga 21%).
fact_bis: Ang hangin sa atmospera halos pulos nitrogen (mga 78%) ug oxygen (mga 21%).

q: How does a submarine rise back to the surface after diving underwater?
options: It fires its engine at full power to push upward against the water pressure
It releases weights attached to the hull so it becomes lighter
It pushes the water out of its tanks with air, making it float back up
It fills extra tanks with fuel to become less dense than the water
explanation: A submarine rises when it pushes water out of its ballast tanks with air, reducing its weight.
fact_tl: Lumulubog ang submarino kapag pinupuno ng tubig ang mga tangke nito, at lumulutang kapag pinalitan ito ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang submarino molubog kung pun-on og tubig ang mga tangke niini, ug molutaw kung pulihan kini og hangin.

q: In the Philippines, where do families bring old bottles, cans, and cardboard to earn extra money?
options: To a junk shop
To a government office
To the nearest school
To a pharmacy
explanation: Old bottles, cans, and cardboard are sold to a junk shop where they are bought by weight, giving families extra income before being sent to factories for recycling.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, marami ang nagtitipon ng lumang bote, lata, at karton para ibenta sa junk shop. Doon ay binibili ito ayon sa timbang, kaya nagiging dagdag-kita para sa mga pamilya. Pagkatapos, dinadala ang mga ito sa mga pabrika kung saan ito ire-recycle bilang bagong produkto.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghan ang nagatigom og daan nga botelya, lata, ug karton aron ibaligya sa junk shop. Didto gipalit kini base sa gibug-aton, busa nahimong dugang kita sa mga pamilya. Human niana, dad-on kini sa mga pabrika diin i-recycle isip bag-ong produkto.

q: What is the job of platelets in your blood?
options: They help stop bleeding by clumping together at a wound
They carry oxygen to all parts of the body
They fight germs and infections inside the body
They produce the red color found in blood
explanation: Platelets are small cell fragments that clump at a wound and form a clot, with fibrin creating a mesh that holds them in place to stop bleeding.
fact_tl: Ang mga platelet ay maliliit na piraso ng selula na tumutulong na tigilan ang pagdurugo sa pamamagitan ng pagpupulong sa wound at pagbubuo ng clot — ang fibrin ay isang protina na gumagawa ng mesh na nagtatago ng mga platelet sa lugar.
fact_bis: Ang mga platelet gagmay nga piraso sa selula nga nagtabang sa paghunong sa pagdugo pinaagi sa pagtipon sa samad ug pagporma og clot — ang fibrin usa ka protina nga nagbuhat og mesh nga nagbitay sa mga platelet sa lugar.

q: Why does blood constantly flow to the brain?
options: To deliver oxygen and food the brain needs to control the body
To cool the brain down when it gets too hot
To carry waste products away from the brain only
To help the brain grow bigger as you age
explanation: The brain needs a steady supply of energy, so blood constantly carries both oxygen and food to it so it can control the body.
fact_tl: Para makontrol ng utak ang katawan, kailangan nitong patuloy na enerhiya — kaya laging may dugong nagdadala ng oxygen at pagkain dito. Kapag kulang ang oxygen sa utak kahit ilang segundo lang, nahihirapan na itong gumana, kaya importante ang malalim na paghinga at masustansyang almusal.
fact_bis: Aron makontrol sa utok ang lawas, nagkinahanglan kini og kanunay nga enerhiya — mao nga kanunay adunay dugo nga magdala og oxygen ug pagkaon niini. Kon makulangan ang utok og oxygen bisan pipila ka segundo, maglisod na kini paglihok, mao nga importante ang lawom nga pagginhawa ug himsog nga pamahaw.

q: About how far away is the Moon from Earth?
options: About 384,400 kilometers
About 150 million kilometers
About 40,000 kilometers
About 1 million kilometers
explanation: The Moon is about 384,400 kilometers away from Earth.
fact_tl: Ang Buwan ay halos 384,400 kilometro ang layo mula sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Bulan mga 384,400 ka kilometro ang kalayo gikan sa Yuta.

q: How does sonar help ships and submarines find out what is under the sea?
options: It sends sound into the water and listens for the echoes that bounce back
It shines bright light beams into the water and reads shadows
It lowers a camera on a cable to take pictures of the ocean floor
It measures changes in water pressure to map the seafloor
explanation: Sonar sends sound waves into the water and uses the returning echoes to learn what is beneath the surface.
fact_tl: Ang sonar ay kagamitan sa barko o submarino na nagpapadala ng tunog sa tubig at gumagamit ng alingawngaw para malaman ang nasa ilalim ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang sonar usa ka himan sa barko o submarino nga mopadala og tingog sa tubig ug mogamit sa alingawngaw aron mahibal-an kon unsa ang naa sa ilawom sa dagat.

q: What does the sperm whale do on a single breath?
options: It dives very deep to hunt squid
It leaps high out of the water to catch fish
It migrates thousands of kilometers across the ocean
It blows a water spout to signal other whales
explanation: The sperm whale can dive very deep on a single breath in order to hunt squid.
fact_tl: Ang sperm whale ay nakakasisid nang napakalalim sa isang hininga lang para manghuli ng pusit.
fact_bis: Ang sperm whale makahimo og salom nga lalom kaayo sa usa lang ka ginhawa aron mangita og pusit.

q: Which of these does a jellyfish NOT have?
options: A brain, heart, and bones
Tentacles for catching food
A body mostly made of water
The ability to sting other animals
explanation: A jellyfish has no brain, no heart, and no bones — its body is almost entirely water, yet it has survived in the sea for millions of years.
fact_tl: Ang dikya (jellyfish) ay walang utak, walang puso, at walang buto — halos puro tubig lamang ang katawan nito. Kahit ganoon, milyun-milyong taon na itong nabubuhay sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang dikya (jellyfish) walay utok, walay kasingkasing, ug walay bukog — halos puro tubig lang ang lawas niini. Bisan pa niini, minilyon na ka tuig nga nabuhi kini sa dagat.

q: What happens when an ionic bond forms between a metal atom and a nonmetal atom?
options: The metal atom gives away an electron to the nonmetal, making both atoms charged so they attract each other
Both atoms share an electron equally so neither becomes charged
The nonmetal gives an electron to the metal, making the nonmetal positive
Both atoms lose electrons to the air around them and then bond together
explanation: An ionic bond forms when the metal gives away its electron to the nonmetal; both become charged ions that attract each other.
fact_tl: Ang ionic bond ay nabubuo kapag ang isang atomo ay IBINIBIGAY ang electron nito sa ibang atomo. Ang metal ay nagbibigay, ang nonmetal ay tumatanggap. Pagkatapos, nagiging may charge silang dalawa, kaya magkaakit sila.
fact_bis: Ang ionic bond mahimo kung ang usa ka atomo IHATAG niya ang iyang electron ngadto sa laing atomo. Ang metal mohatag, ang nonmetal modawat. Human niini, mahimong naay charge silang duha, mao nga magkadani sila.

q: How many sea turtle species can be found in the Philippines?
options: Five
Three
Seven
Two
explanation: Five sea turtle species are found in the Philippines — the green turtle, hawksbill, leatherback, olive ridley, and loggerhead — all endangered and legally protected.
fact_tl: Limang species ng pawikan ang matatagpuan sa Pilipinas: ang green turtle, hawksbill, leatherback, olive ridley, at loggerhead — lahat ay endangered at protektado sa batas.
fact_bis: Lima ka species sa pawikan ang makita sa Pilipinas: ang green turtle, hawksbill, leatherback, olive ridley, ug loggerhead — tanan endangered ug legal nga protektado.

q: How does a baby dugong get food while it is young?
options: It drinks milk from its mother
It digs for seagrass roots on the seafloor
It eats small fish caught near the surface
It feeds on algae growing on coral reefs
explanation: A baby dugong stays close to its mother and drinks her milk until it grows up.
fact_tl: Ang batang dugong ay laging malapit sa ina at sumususo ng gatas hanggang ito ay lumaki.
fact_bis: Ang nati nga dugong kanunay duol sa inahan ug mosuso og gatas hangtod modako kini.

q: What happens to a magnet if you drop or bang it over and over?
options: It slowly becomes weaker
It becomes stronger from the impact
It changes its poles from north to south
It loses its color but keeps its magnetism
explanation: Repeated dropping or banging jumbles the tiny aligned parts inside the magnet, causing it to gradually lose its magnetic strength.
fact_tl: Kapag madalas mahulog o mabagok ang isang magnet, gumugulo ang ayos ng maliliit na bahagi sa loob nito at unti-unting humihina ang magnet.
fact_bis: Kon kanunay nga mahulog o mabundak ang usa ka magnet, magkaguliyang ang gagmay nga bahin sa sulod niini ug hinay-hinay nga maluya ang magnet.

q: Why should pet owners keep small dogs away from platypuses?
options: Because platypus venom is strong enough to kill a small dog
Because platypuses carry a disease deadly only to dogs
Because dogs are allergic to the platypus's fur
Because platypuses mistake small dogs for fish prey
explanation: Platypus venom is strong enough to kill a dog or other small pet, making it genuinely dangerous to small animals.
fact_tl: Delikado ba ang kamandag sa maliliit na hayop? Oo, ang kamandag ng platypus ay sapat na malakas para makamatay ng isang aso o maliit na alagang hayop.
fact_bis: Delikado ba ang hilo sa gagmay nga mananap? Oo, ang hilo sa platypus igo nga kusog aron makapatay ug iro o gamay nga binuhi nga mananap.

q: Why is the space station called 'international'?
options: Because it was built with the help of many countries working together
Because it orbits over every country on Earth every day
Because astronauts from every country must live there
Because all its parts were made using international metals
explanation: The ISS earned the name 'international' because many countries contributed to building and operating it together.
fact_tl: Itinayo ang ISS sa tulong ng maraming bansa na nagtutulungan, kaya tinawag itong 'international' o pandaigdigan.
fact_bis: Ang ISS gitukod pinaagi sa tabang sa daghang nasod nga nagtinabangay, mao nga gitawag kining 'international' o pangkalibutanon.

q: Why do different kinds of mangroves grow in separate bands along the coast?
options: Different mangroves are adapted to different tide levels, some flooded often and others rarely
All mangroves are the same species but grow in bands due to soil color differences
Strong currents push young mangroves away from the shore into separate lines
Mangroves compete for sunlight and spread out to avoid shading each other
explanation: Some mangrove species live in lower areas frequently flooded by tides while others live higher up where water rarely reaches, creating distinct zones.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bakawan ay tumutubo sa eksaktong parehong lugar. Ang ilang uri ay nasa mas malalim na bahagi na madalas lubog sa tide, habang ang iba ay nasa mas mataas na bahagi na bihira lang abutin ng tubig. Kaya nabubuo ang magkahanay-hanay na zona ng bakawan.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga bakhaw motubo sa parehas gyud nga dapit. Ang uban nga klase naa sa mas ubos nga bahin nga kanunay nalunod sa taog, samtang ang uban naa sa mas taas nga bahin nga panagsa ra maabot sa tubig. Mao nga maporma ang nagkahan-ay nga mga zona sa bakhaw.

q: Why do meerkats and prairie dogs live together in burrows?
options: They are safer because many animals can watch for danger at once
They share food more easily when living in one place
They stay warmer underground when they crowd together
They need each other to dig the burrow in hard ground
explanation: Living together in burrows means many animals can watch for danger at the same time, making the whole group safer.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop gaya ng meerkat at prairie dog ang namumuhay nang magkakasama sa lungga dahil mas ligtas sila kapag maraming nagbabantay.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sama sa meerkat ug prairie dog nagpuyo nga magkauban sa lungib tungod kay mas luwas sila kung daghan ang nagbantay.

q: Christiaan Huygens, who invented the pendulum clock, was from which country?
options: The Netherlands (Holland)
Germany
France
England
explanation: Christiaan Huygens, the inventor of the pendulum clock, was Dutch — from the Netherlands, also called Holland.
fact_tl: Si Christiaan Huygens, ang nag-imbento ng relong may palawit, ay taga-Netherlands (Olanda).
fact_bis: Si Christiaan Huygens, ang nag-imbento sa relo nga adunay palawit, gikan sa Netherlands (Olanda).

q: Why does obsidian have no crystals inside it?
options: Lava cooled so fast that atoms had no time to form crystals
It formed deep underground where pressure stopped crystal growth
It is made of compressed ash rather than actual lava
Ocean water dissolved the crystals after the lava cooled
explanation: Obsidian is natural glass because lava cooled so quickly that atoms could not arrange themselves into crystals.
fact_tl: Ang obsidian ay parang itim na salamin na nabubuo kapag napakabilis lumamig ng lava, kaya walang panahon ang mga atomo na bumuo ng kristal.
fact_bis: Ang obsidian sama sa itom nga natural nga bildo nga maporma kon paspas kaayo mobugnaw ang lava, mao nga walay panahon ang mga atomo nga magporma og kristal.

q: Who was the Rafflesia flower named after?
options: Stamford Raffles, a British official who helped discover it
Rafael Santos, a Filipino botanist who first described it
Sir Raffles Darwin, Charles Darwin's cousin
Thomas Raffles, a Dutch explorer in Southeast Asia
explanation: The Rafflesia was named after Stamford Raffles, a British official who helped discover it in 1818.
fact_tl: Ipinangalan ang Rafflesia kay Stamford Raffles, na isang Britanikong opisyal na nakatulong tumuklas nito noong 1818.
fact_bis: Ang Rafflesia gipangalan kang Stamford Raffles, usa ka Britaniko nga opisyal nga nakatabang pagdiskobre niini niadtong 1818.

q: What kind of weather does El Niño typically bring to the Philippines?
options: Hotter and drier weather with long droughts and water shortages
Cooler and wetter weather with stronger typhoons and flooding
Cooler and drier weather with strong northerly winds
Warmer but wetter weather causing widespread flooding
explanation: In the Philippines, El Niño often brings hotter and drier weather that can cause long droughts and water shortages.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, kadalasang nagdadala ang El Niño ng mas mainit at mas tuyong panahon — maaaring magkaroon ng matagal na tagtuyot (drought) at kakulangan sa tubig sa maraming lugar.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kasagarang magdala ang El Niño og mas init ug mas uga nga panahon — mahimong adunay dugay nga hulaw (drought) ug kakulang sa tubig sa daghang dapit.
