explanation: The platypus is an unusual mammal because it lays eggs, yet it still feeds its young with milk just like other mammals.
fact_tl: Ang platypus ay pambihirang mamalya dahil nangingitlog ito ngunit pinapasuso pa rin ng gatas ang anak.
fact_bis: Ang platypus usa ka talagsaon nga mamalya kay nangitlog kini apan gipasuso gihapon ug gatas ang anak.

q: How does a woodpecker keep its balance while pecking into a tree trunk?
options: It uses its stiff tail feathers as a prop against the trunk
It grips the bark with extra-long curved claws on each foot
It wraps its wings tightly around the trunk for support
It inserts its beak into the wood to lock itself in place
explanation: A woodpecker uses its stiff tail feathers as a brace or prop against the tree trunk while it pecks, helping it stay stable.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng woodpecker ang matitigas nitong balahibo sa buntot bilang suhay sa katawan ng puno habang kumakatok.
fact_bis: Ang woodpecker mogamit sa iyang gahi nga balhibo sa ikog isip tukod batok sa lawas sa puno samtang motuktok.

q: What happens when too much current flows through a circuit that has a circuit breaker?
options: The circuit breaker automatically switches off the current to protect the circuit
The circuit breaker stores the extra current and releases it slowly later
The circuit breaker speeds the current up so devices can handle it better
The circuit breaker signals a light to warn the user and keeps the current flowing
explanation: A circuit breaker automatically switches off the current when too much flows through, and it can be switched back on once the problem is fixed.
fact_tl: Ang circuit breaker ay awtomatikong pumuputol ng kuryente kapag sobra ang dumadaloy, at maaaring i-on muli.
fact_bis: Ang circuit breaker awtomatikong magputol sa kuryente kung sobra ang moagi, ug pwede i-on balik.

q: About what percentage of Earth's atmosphere is nitrogen?
options: About 78%
About 21%
About 50%
About 1%
explanation: Earth's atmosphere is about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen, with nitrogen being by far the largest component.
fact_tl: Ang atmosphere ng Earth ay binubuo ng humigit-kumulang 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, at 1% iba pang mga gas tulad ng argon at carbon dioxide; ang oxygen ang bahagi na ginagamit natin para huminga, habang ang nitrogen ay nagpapatatag ng atmosphere.
fact_bis: Ang atmosphere sa Yuta mga 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, ug 1% ubang mga gas sama sa argon ug carbon dioxide; ang oxygen mao ang bahin nga gikinahanglan naton para makahinga, samtang ang nitrogen nagtabang sa pag-stabilize sa atmosphere.

q: What is the capital city of Italy?
options: Rome
Milan
Venice
Florence
explanation: The capital of Italy is Rome.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Italy (Italya) ay Rome (Roma).
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Italy (Italya) mao ang Rome (Roma).

q: Why is fresh fruit generally more nutritious than fruit that has been stored for a long time?
options: Some vitamins fade the longer produce is stored or exposed to heat and light
Stored fruit gains extra sugar that replaces the vitamins it originally had
Vitamins move from the fruit into the container it is stored in over time
Refrigeration destroys vitamins, so stored fruit always has fewer nutrients
explanation: Some vitamins slowly fade from fruits and vegetables the longer they are stored or exposed to heat and light, making fresh produce more nutritious.
fact_tl: Unti-unting nawawala ang ilang bitamina sa prutas at gulay habang tumatagal silang nakaimbak o nababad sa init at ilaw. Kaya mas masustansya ang sariwang gulay kaysa lumang naiwan nang matagal.
fact_bis: Hinayhinay nga mawala ang pipila ka bitamina sa prutas ug utanon samtang dugay kining matipigan o maladlad sa kainit ug kahayag. Mao nga mas masustansya ang preskong utanon kaysa daan nga gibilin og dugay.

q: How can a ray find a crab that is completely buried under sand?
options: Special sensors on its snout detect the faint electricity the crab's body produces
Its excellent eyesight can see the outline of the crab through the thin layer of sand
It smells chemicals released by the crab as it breathes underwater
It feels the vibrations made by the crab moving its legs under the sand
explanation: A ray has special electroreceptors on its snout that detect the faint electrical fields produced by animals, letting it find prey hidden in sand.
fact_tl: Ang pagi ay may natatanging pandama sa ngusò na nakakaramdam ng mahinang kuryente ng mga hayop, kaya nahahanap nito ang biktima kahit nakatago sa buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang pagi adunay pinasahing pandama sa ngusò nga makabati sa huyang nga koryente sa mga mananap, mao nga makit-an niini ang biktima bisan nagtago sa balas.

q: Why does aluminum resist corrosion better than iron?
options: Aluminum forms a thin protective layer on its surface that blocks further corrosion
Aluminum contains no iron, and only iron-based metals can corrode
Aluminum is always painted at the factory, and the paint keeps moisture out
Aluminum is a liquid at room temperature and does not react with air
explanation: Aluminum does not rust like iron because it naturally forms a thin oxide layer that blocks further corrosion.
fact_tl: Ang aluminyo ay hindi nagkakalawang na gaya ng bakal dahil bumubuo ito ng sariling manipis na patong na pumipigil sa korosyon.
fact_bis: Ang aluminum dili matayaan sama sa puthaw kay naghimo kini sa kaugalingong nipis nga sapaw nga makapugong sa dugang korosyon.

q: Why is Apo Island in Negros Oriental famous in the Philippines?
options: It is a community-managed marine sanctuary where fish populations recovered after protection began
It is the deepest fishing ground in the Philippines and exports the most tuna
It is the only island where the rare tamaraw now lives in the wild
It has the largest coral reef in Southeast Asia, protected by the national government
explanation: Apo Island is a successful community-managed marine sanctuary — after protection was established, fish populations recovered and it became a model for other communities.
fact_tl: Ang Apo Island sa Negros Oriental ay isang halimbawa ng matagumpay na community-managed marine sanctuary sa Pilipinas — pagkatapos ng pagtatayo ng sanctuary, naibalik ang mga populasyon ng isda at naging modelo ito para sa maraming iba pang komunidad.
fact_bis: Ang Apo Island sa Negros Oriental usa ka ehemplo sa matagumpay nga community-managed marine sanctuary sa Pilipinas — human sa pagtukod sa sanctuary, ang mga populasyon sa isda nakaayo ug nahimong modelo alang sa daghang ubang komunidad.

q: What happens to a satellite that is traveling too slowly as it tries to orbit Earth?
options: It falls back toward Earth because its speed is not enough to stay in orbit
It flies off into outer space because low speed reduces gravity's pull
It stays at the same height but drifts sideways out of its path
It speeds up automatically and returns to the correct orbit on its own
explanation: A satellite needs just the right sideways speed to orbit — too slow and gravity pulls it back down toward Earth.
fact_tl: Para manatili sa orbita, kailangang sapat ang pahalang na bilis ng isang satellite: kung masyadong mabagal, mahuhulog ito; kung masyadong mabilis, lilipad ito palabas ng orbita.
fact_bis: Aron magpabilin sa orbita, kinahanglan igo ang pahalang nga katulin sa satellite: kung hinay kaayo, mahulog kini; kung paspas kaayo, molupad kini pagawas sa orbita.

q: What is the role of the Philippine Supreme Court?
options: It is the highest court in the country and makes sure laws follow the 1987 Constitution
It writes new laws and sends them to the President for approval
It manages the national budget and checks government spending
It oversees elections and counts the votes for national positions
explanation: The Philippine Supreme Court is the highest court in the country and ensures that laws comply with the 1987 Constitution.
fact_tl: Ang Korte Suprema ng Pilipinas ang pinakamataas na hukuman sa bansa at ang nagpapatupad na ang mga batas ay naaayon sa Saligang Batas ng 1987.
fact_bis: Ang Korte Suprema sa Pilipinas mao ang pinakataas nga korte sa nasod ug nagmasiguro nga ang mga batas mosunod sa Konstitusyon sa 1987.

q: Why is moss useful for keeping soil from drying out quickly?
options: Moss soaks up and holds water like a sponge, keeping soil moist and slowing rain runoff.
Moss grows very deep roots that pull water up from underground into the soil.
Moss releases a waxy coating that seals moisture inside the soil.
Moss breaks down into nutrients that help soil hold water.
explanation: Moss acts like a sponge that soaks up and stores lots of water, helping keep the soil moist and slow down rain runoff.
fact_tl: Ang lumot ay parang espongha na sumisipsip at nag-iimbak ng maraming tubig, kaya nakakatulong itong panatilihing basa ang lupa at pabagalin ang pag-agos ng ulan.
fact_bis: Ang lumot morag espongha nga mosuyop ug motipig og daghang tubig, busa makatabang kini sa pagpabasa sa yuta ug pagpahinay sa pag-agos sa ulan.

q: Where did the world's first powered airplane flight take place?
options: Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, USA
Dayton, Ohio, USA
Paris, France
London, England
explanation: The first powered airplane flight took place at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, in the United States.
fact_tl: Naganap ang unang de-makinang lipad ng eroplano sa Kitty Hawk, North Carolina sa Estados Unidos.
fact_bis: Ang unang de-makinang paglupad sa eroplano nahitabo sa Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, sa Estados Unidos.

q: At what place was Jose Rizal executed by the Spanish colonial government?
options: Bagumbayan, now known as Luneta or Rizal Park
Fort Santiago in Intramuros, Manila
Paco Cemetery in Manila
Calamba, Laguna, his birthplace
explanation: Jose Rizal was executed at Bagumbayan, now called Luneta or Rizal Park.
fact_tl: Binaril si Jose Rizal sa Bagumbayan, na tinatawag ngayong Luneta o Rizal Park.
fact_bis: Gipusil si Jose Rizal sa Bagumbayan, nga gitawag karon nga Luneta o Rizal Park.

q: How does electricity travel from a power plant to homes in a distant city?
options: Through long wires called transmission lines
Through underground water pipes that carry electrical current
By being stored in large batteries and shipped by trucks
Through wireless radio towers that beam electricity through the air
explanation: Electricity from the power plant travels through long wires called transmission lines to towns and cities.
fact_tl: Ang kuryente mula sa power plant ay dumadaan sa mahahabang kable o transmission line papunta sa mga bayan at lungsod.
fact_bis: Ang kuryente gikan sa power plant moagi sa tag-as nga mga kable o transmission line padulong sa mga lungsod ug siyudad.

q: How is cassava planted?
options: A piece of its stem is buried directly in the soil
Seeds are soaked in water and then scattered on the ground
A cutting from the root is dried and then planted
Leaves are pressed into the soil to grow new plants
explanation: Cassava is planted using pieces of its stem, not seeds — a piece of stem is simply buried in soil and it grows.
fact_tl: Ang kamoteng kahoy (cassava) ay itinatanim sa pamamagitan ng mga putol ng tangkay nito, hindi buto — itinatabon lang ang putol sa lupa at tutubo.
fact_bis: Ang kamoting kahoy (cassava) itanom pinaagi sa mga putol sa iyang punoan, dili liso — itabon lang ang putol sa yuta ug motubo.

q: Which of the following everyday objects uses a screw as a simple machine?
options: A jar lid that twists open and shut
A door that swings on hinges
A ramp used to push a heavy box up
A pulley used to lift a bucket of water
explanation: Jar lids, bottle caps, and light bulb bases all use a screw.
fact_tl: Ang takip ng garapon, takip ng bote, at base ng bombilya ay gumagamit din ng screw.
fact_bis: Ang takup sa garapon, takup sa botelya, ug pundasyon sa bombilya naggamit usab og screw.

q: How do baleen whales catch their tiny food from the ocean?
options: They strain water through comb-like filters inside their mouth instead of biting with teeth.
They use their teeth to grind up small shrimp before swallowing them.
They suck in whole schools of fish and digest them slowly.
They use long tongue muscles to trap small creatures against the roof of their mouth.
explanation: Some whales have no teeth but instead have comb-like baleen filters that strain tiny food from the water.
fact_tl: May mga balyena na walang ngipin kundi may parang suklay na salaan na humuhuli ng maliliit na pagkain sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang ubang balyena walay ngipon apan adunay morag suklay nga salaan nga modakop sa gagmay nga pagkaon gikan sa tubig.

q: Why is the nautilus called a 'living fossil'?
options: It has barely changed in appearance for millions of years.
Its shell is made of the same minerals as ancient rock.
It can only survive in places where fossils are commonly found.
Scientists discovered it by studying fossil records, not the ocean.
explanation: The nautilus is called a 'living fossil' because it has barely changed for millions of years.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na 'buhay na fosil' ang nautilus dahil halos hindi ito nagbago sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Gitawag nga 'buhi nga fosil' ang nautilus tungod kay halos wala kini mausab sulod sa minilyon ka tuig.

q: How do doctors confirm that a patient has schistosomiasis?
options: They examine a stool sample under a microscope to look for blood fluke eggs.
They do a skin-prick test to check for an allergic reaction to the parasite.
They take an X-ray of the liver to look for visible damage caused by the worm.
They measure the patient's temperature over several days to track the pattern of fever.
explanation: A stool sample examined under a microscope for blood fluke eggs confirms schistosomiasis; a blood test can also be used.
fact_tl: Paano nalalaman ng doktor kung may schistosomiasis ang isang tao? Kinukuha nila ang sample ng dumi at tinitingnan ito sa mikroskopyo. Kapag may nakitang itlog ng blood fluke, kumpirmado ang sakit. Maaari ring gamitin ang pagsusuri ng dugo. Mahalaga ito para maagang magamot.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagkahibalo sa doktor kon ang tawo adunay schistosomiasis? Mokuha sila og sample sa hugaw ug tan-awon kini sa mikroskopyo. Kon makakita silag itlog sa blood fluke, kumpirmado ang sakit. Mahimo usab gamiton ang pagsusi sa dugo. Importante kini aron sayo nga matambalan.

q: Where in the eye can an uneven curve cause astigmatism?
options: Either in the cornea at the front or in the lens inside the eye
Only in the retina at the back of the eye
Only in the cornea; the lens cannot cause astigmatism
Only in the optic nerve that sends signals to the brain
explanation: Astigmatism usually starts in the cornea but can also come from the lens inside the eye, because both bend light.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nasa cornea (harap ng mata) ang astigmatism, pero minsan nasa lens sa loob ng mata. Pareho silang nagpapaliko ng liwanag, kaya pwedeng magmula sa alinman sa dalawa ang hindi pantay na focus.
fact_bis: Ang astigmatism kasagaran gikan sa cornea (atubangan sa mata), apan usahay gikan sa lente sulod sa mata. Pareho silang mobawog sa kahayag, mao nga ang dili patag nga focus mahimong magsugod sa bisan asa kanila.

q: Which statement about Rafflesia in the Philippines is correct?
options: Several Rafflesia species are endemic to the Philippines, found in places like the Visayas and Mindanao.
Only one Rafflesia species exists in the Philippines, found only in Luzon.
Rafflesia is common and easy to grow because it spreads its own seeds widely.
The Philippines has no native Rafflesia; all specimens were brought from Borneo.
explanation: Several Rafflesia species are endemic to the Philippines, including Rafflesia speciosa in the Visayas and others in Mindanao; all are rare.
fact_tl: May ilang species ng Rafflesia na katutubong sa Pilipinas—kasama na ang Rafflesia speciosa sa Visayas at iba pa sa Mindanao—lahat ay bihirang makita at nangangailangan ng espesyal na pangangalaga dahil parasitic ang kanilang pamumuhay.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka species sa Rafflesia nga katutubong sa Pilipinas—lakip ang Rafflesia speciosa sa Visayas ug uban pa sa Mindanao; tanan sila bihirang makita ug nagkinahanglan og espesyal nga pag-atiman tungod sa ilang parasitic nga pamumuhay.

q: What is the correct order of a frog's life cycle?
options: Egg → Tadpole → Frog
Tadpole → Egg → Frog
Egg → Frog → Tadpole
Frog → Frog → Egg
explanation: A frog starts as an egg, then becomes a tadpole, and finally grows into a full frog.
fact_tl: Nagsisimula ang palaka bilang itlog, pagkatapos ay nagiging tadpole, at saka lumalaki bilang ganap na palaka.
fact_bis: Ang baki magsugod isip itlog, dayon mahimong ulo-ulo, ug unya motubo isip hingkod nga baki.

q: Where does a tree store the carbon it takes in from the air?
options: Inside its trunk, branches, and roots as it grows
It releases all the carbon back into the air at night
In its leaves, which then fall and bury the carbon in the soil
In the water it absorbs through its roots
explanation: A tree stores carbon inside its trunk, branches, and roots as it grows, which is why big trees help lower carbon in the air.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sinisipsip ng puno ang carbon dioxide — itinatago nito ang carbon sa loob ng katawan, sanga, at ugat nito habang lumalaki. Kaya nakakatulong ang malalaking puno na bawasan ang carbon sa hangin.
fact_bis: Dili lang suyopon sa kahoy ang carbon dioxide — gitipigan niini ang carbon sulod sa lawas, sanga, ug gamot samtang motubo. Mao nga ang dagkong kahoy makatabang sa pagpakunhod sa carbon sa hangin.

q: How does a remora attach itself to a shark?
options: Using a flat suction disc on top of its head
By wrapping its long tail tightly around the shark's fin
By clinging on with sharp claws on its belly
By biting gently into the shark's skin with strong jaws
explanation: The remora has a flat suction disc on its head that it uses to stick onto a shark's body.
fact_tl: May parang sipsip na disko sa ulo ng remora na ginagamit nito para dumikit sa katawan ng pating.
fact_bis: Ang remora adunay sama sa suction nga disk sa iyang ulo nga gamiton niini sa pagpilit sa lawas sa iho.

q: Why do Philippine fishermen catch fewer fish when mangroves are cut down?
options: Because mangroves are a nursery and shelter for young fish, which disappear without them.
Because mangroves provide food that adult fish eat directly.
Because mangroves block sea currents that carry adult fish toward the shore.
Because the roots of mangroves clean the water and without them the sea becomes too salty.
explanation: Mangroves are a home and nursery for young fish; cut them down and the fish have no shelter, so fishermen catch less.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga bakawan (mangrove) ay tirahan at lugar-paglaki ng maliliit na isda. Kapag pinutol ang mga ito, walang matatakbuhan ang mga isda kaya bababa ang huli ng mangingisda, at wala ring sasalo sa mga alon at baha sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga bakhaw (mangrove) maoy puy-anan ug dapit nga tubuanan sa gagmayng isda. Kon putlon kini, walay kadangpan ang mga isda mao nga mokunhod ang kuha sa mananagat, ug walay usab mosalo sa balod ug baha sa baybayon.

q: Why are small fish like dilis and tuyo especially good for building strong bones?
options: You eat them bones and all, and fish bones are full of calcium.
They contain more protein than any other food, which builds bone tissue.
They are cooked in vinegar, which releases iron that strengthens bones.
Their soft scales are made of a mineral that the body turns into bone.
explanation: Fish bones are full of calcium, and since you eat tiny fish like dilis and tuyo whole — bones included — they really help make your bones strong.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, masustansya ang maliliit na isda tulad ng dilis at tuyo na kinakain pati buto. Ang buto ng isda ay puno ng calcium, kaya malaking tulong ito sa pagpapatibay ng iyong mga buto.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, masustansya ang gagmay nga isda sama sa bolinaw ug bulad nga kan-on uban ang bukog. Ang bukog sa isda puno og calcium, busa dako kini og tabang sa pagpalig-on sa imong mga bukog.

q: What are the two main advantages a colugo gets by gliding?
options: It can escape from predators and save energy when moving between trees.
It can find food faster and keep its body temperature cool.
It can communicate with other colugos and mark its territory.
It can dry its fur after rain and spot enemies from a higher position.
explanation: By gliding, the colugo can escape predators and save energy when moving from tree to tree.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng pagliglide, nakakaiwas ang kagwang sa mababangis na hayop at nakakatipid ng enerhiya sa paglipat ng puno.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pag-glide, makalikay ang kagwang sa mga manunukob ug makatipig og kusog sa pagbalhin gikan sa usa ka kahoy ngadto sa lain.

q: What did Galileo Galilei discover in 1610 that helped support the idea that Earth goes around the Sun?
options: Jupiter's four large moons, craters on the Moon, and the phases of Venus
The rings of Saturn and the distance between Earth and the Sun
The existence of comets and the shape of the Milky Way galaxy
The spin of Earth and the true size of the Moon
explanation: In 1610, Galileo discovered Jupiter's four large moons, the Moon's craters, and Venus's phases — all supporting Copernicus's heliocentric model.
fact_tl: Noong 1610, ginamit ni Galileo Galilei ang teleskopo para gawing detalyadong obserbasyon ng kalangitan; natuklasan niya ang apat na malalaking buwan ng Jupiter (Galilean moons), na ang Moon ay may crater at bundok, at na ang Venus ay may mga phase — lahat ng ito ay sumuporta sa heliocentric na modelo ni Copernicus.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1610, gigamit ni Galileo Galilei ang teleskopo aron makahimo og detalyadong astronomical nga mga obserbasyon; nadiskubre niya ang upat ka dako nga buwan sa Jupiter, nga ang Moon adunay mga crater ug bukid, ug nga ang Venus nagpakita og mga phase — tanan nagsuporta sa heliocentric model ni Copernicus.

q: What are ornithopters, and what inspired engineers to build them?
options: Machines that flap wings like a bird, inspired by studying how birds fly
Machines that spin rotors like a helicopter, inspired by dragonfly wings
Machines that glide without flapping, inspired by how albatrosses soar
Tiny underwater robots that mimic the wing motion of penguins
explanation: Ornithopters are machines that flap wings like a bird; engineers study bird flight to design better small flying machines and drones.
fact_tl: May mga inhinyero na gumagawa ng makina na pumapagaspas ng pakpak na parang ibon, tinatawag itong ornithopter. Pinag-aaralan nila kung paano lumipad ang ibon para gumawa ng mas magagaling na maliliit na lumilipad na makina o drone.
fact_bis: Adunay mga inhenyero nga naghimo og makina nga mokapay-kapay sa pako sama sa langgam, gitawag kini nga ornithopter. Gitun-an nila kon unsaon paglupad sa langgam aron makahimo og mas maayong gagmay nga naglupad nga makina o drone.

q: How do mangroves protect Philippine coastal towns during typhoons?
options: Their thick roots and branches block big waves and storm surge like a natural wall.
They release chemicals into the sea that calm the waves before they reach shore.
They grow so tall that they redirect wind upward, away from houses.
They absorb the rain so much that floodwaters never reach coastal roads.
explanation: The thick roots and branches of mangroves block big waves and storm surge during typhoons, acting like a natural wall for coastal towns.
fact_tl: Ang makakapal na ugat at sanga ng bakawan ay humaharang sa malalaking alon at storm surge tuwing may bagyo. Sa Pilipinas na madalas binabagyo, ang mga bakawan ay parang likas na pader na nagliligtas sa mga baybaying-bayan.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga mga gamot ug sanga sa bakawan magbabag sa dagkong balod ug storm surge panahon sa bagyo. Sa Pilipinas nga kanunay gibagyo, ang mga bakawan morag natural nga paril nga nagpanalipod sa mga baybayong lungsod.

q: What is the capital city of the province of Davao del Sur?
options: Digos City
Davao City
General Santos City
Tagum City
explanation: The capital of Davao del Sur is Digos City, not Davao City.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Davao del Sur ay ang Digos City, hindi ang Davao City.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa Davao del Sur mao ang Digos City, dili ang Davao City.

q: Which feature makes the needlefish easy to recognize?
options: It is long and thin with a pointed, needle-like jaw.
It is round and flat like a disc with a beak-shaped mouth.
It has a very short body but an extremely long tail fin.
It has two long spines on its back that look like needles.
explanation: The needlefish is a long, thin fish with a pointed, needle-like jaw.
fact_tl: Ang balo o needlefish ay mahaba at manipis na isda na may matulis na bibig na parang karayom.
fact_bis: Ang balo o needlefish usa ka taas ug nipis nga isda nga adunay talinis nga baba sama sa dagom.

q: Which insect holds the record for being the heaviest in the world?
options: The Goliath beetle from Africa
The Atlas moth from Southeast Asia
The titan beetle from South America
The elephant beetle from Central America
explanation: The heaviest insect is the Goliath beetle, a large beetle from Africa.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabigat na insekto ay ang Goliath beetle, isang malaking salagubang mula sa Africa.
fact_bis: Ang pinakabug-at nga insekto mao ang Goliath beetle, usa ka dako nga bakukang gikan sa Africa.

q: Why do phytoplankton live near the surface of the ocean rather than in deep water?
options: Sunlight they need for photosynthesis can only reach the upper layers of water.
The water near the surface is saltier, which phytoplankton need to survive.
Deep-water currents are too strong for phytoplankton to stay in one place.
The seafloor is too dark for phytoplankton to find the minerals they eat.
explanation: Phytoplankton live near the ocean surface because that is where the sunlight they need can reach.
fact_tl: Ang phytoplankton ay nabubuhay malapit sa ibabaw ng dagat kung saan umaabot ang liwanag ng araw na kailangan nila.
fact_bis: Ang phytoplankton nagpuyo duol sa ibabaw sa dagat diin makaabot ang kahayag sa adlaw nga ilang gikinahanglan.

q: Which is the only monkey that is native to the Philippines?
options: The long-tailed macaque
The proboscis monkey
The tarsier
The crab-eating gibbon
explanation: The long-tailed macaque is the only kind of monkey native to the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang long-tailed macaque o unggoy ang tanging uri ng unggoy na katutubo sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang long-tailed macaque o unggoy mao ra ang matang sa unggoy nga lumad sa Pilipinas.

q: How does Venus's surface gravity compare to Earth's?
options: Venus's gravity is almost as strong as Earth's, at about 8.9 m/s² versus Earth's 9.8 m/s².
Venus has much weaker gravity than Earth, about half as strong.
Venus has stronger gravity than Earth because it is closer to the Sun.
Venus has no measurable gravity because it has no moon to create a gravitational pull.
explanation: Venus's surface gravity is about 8.9 m/s², almost as strong as Earth's 9.8 m/s².
fact_tl: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw ng Venus ay halos 8.9 m/s², halos kasinglakas ng 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw sa Venus mga 8.9 m/s², halos sama kakusog sa 9.8 m/s² sa Yuta.

q: How do echinoderms like sea stars get the oxygen they need?
options: Through their tube feet and tiny skin gills that absorb oxygen from the water
Through gills on the sides of their bodies, similar to a fish
By swimming to the surface to breathe air directly like a whale
By absorbing oxygen through a special organ inside their central disk
explanation: Echinoderms breathe through their tube feet and tiny skin gills that take oxygen from the water.
fact_tl: Ang mga echinoderm ay humihinga sa pamamagitan ng kanilang tube feet at maliliit na hasang sa balat na kumukuha ng oksiheno mula sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga echinoderm moginhawa pinaagi sa ilang tube feet ug gagmay nga hasang sa panit nga mokuha sa oksiheno gikan sa tubig.

q: How do many single-celled pond micro-organisms reproduce?
options: They split their single body into two identical cells.
They lay tiny eggs that hatch into new micro-organisms.
They merge with another micro-organism to form a larger one, then separate.
They release spores into the water that later grow into new cells.
explanation: Many pond micro-organisms reproduce by splitting their single body into two, which lets them multiply very quickly.
fact_tl: Maraming mikroorganismo sa lawa ay dumarami sa pamamagitan ng paghahati ng kanilang katawan sa dalawa, kaya napakabilis nilang dumami.
fact_bis: Daghang mikroorganismo sa danaw modaghan pinaagi sa pagbahin sa ilang lawas ngadto sa duha, mao nga paspas kaayo sila modaghan.

q: What famous nickname are the Banaue Rice Terraces often given?
options: The Eighth Wonder of the World
The Crown of the Cordillera
The Stairway to Heaven
The Green Wall of Asia
explanation: The Banaue Rice Terraces are often called the 'Eighth Wonder of the World.'
fact_tl: Ang Banaue Rice Terraces ay madalas tawaging 'Ikawalong Kababalaghan ng Daigdig.'
fact_bis: Ang Banaue Rice Terraces kasagarang gitawag nga 'Ikawalong Kahibulongan sa Kalibotan.'

q: Why are electric wires made of metal?
options: Because most metals conduct electricity well.
Because metals are flexible enough to bend around corners easily.
Because metals are lighter than other materials, making wires easy to hang.
Because metals are waterproof, protecting the electricity from rain.
explanation: Most metals conduct both heat and electricity well, which is why wires are made of metal.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan sa mga metal ay mahusay na conductor ng init at kuryente — kaya ang mga metal na kutsara ay mainit kapag iniwan sa mainit na sabaw.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa mga metal maayo nga conductor sa init ug kuryente — mao nga ang metal nga kutsara mahot kon ibilin sa mainit nga sabaw, ug mao usab ngano ang mga wire gihimo sa metal.

q: What happens to a healthy cell after new viruses are fully made inside it?
options: The cell is often burst open as new viruses escape to infect more healthy cells.
The cell repairs itself and becomes immune to further virus attacks.
The cell shrinks and is absorbed safely by the immune system.
The cell stays alive and keeps producing viruses indefinitely without breaking.
explanation: New viruses leave the cell, often by bursting it open, and then go on to infect other healthy cells.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagong virus ay lumalabas sa selula, madalas sa pamamagitan ng pagkasira nito, at sumasalakay naman sa ibang malulusog na selula.
fact_bis: Ang mga bag-ong virus mogawas sa selula, kasagaran pinaagi sa pagbuto niini, ug dayon mosulong sa ubang himsog nga mga selula.

q: Why do deer and mouse-deer run away so quickly when they sense danger?
options: Because they are prey animals hunted by larger predators like pythons and eagles.
Because they protect their territory from other deer that want to take their food.
Because they are chasing after the insects and small animals they eat.
Because running exercises their legs so they can grow bigger and stronger.
explanation: Deer and mouse-deer are prey for bigger animals such as pythons and eagles, so they run away quickly.
fact_tl: Ang usa at pilandok ay mga biktima ng mas malalaking hayop tulad ng sawa at agila, kaya mabilis silang tumakas.
fact_bis: Ang usa ug pilandok mga biktima sa mas dagko nga hayop sama sa sawa ug agila, mao nga paspas sila modagan.

q: Why do baseball batters and soccer players follow through with their swing or kick instead of stopping right at the ball?
options: Keeping contact longer with the same force produces a bigger change in motion, sending the ball farther.
Following through transfers weight to the back foot, which improves balance after impact.
Stopping at the ball would break the bat or injure the foot from the sudden shock.
Following through redirects the force sideways to make the ball curve in the air.
explanation: The longer a force of the same strength acts, the bigger the change in motion — that is why a follow-through sends the ball farther.
fact_tl: Hindi lang lakas ng force ang mahalaga — pati ang TAGAL ng pagkakadampi nito. Mas matagal na nakadampi ang force sa parehong lakas, mas malaki ang pagbabago sa galaw. Kaya sa baseball o sipa, may 'follow-through': pinatatagal ang dampi ng kamay o paa sa bola para mas malayo ito lumipad.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang kusog sa force ang importante — apil usab ang GIDUGAYON sa pagdapat niini. Mas dugay nga modapat ang force sa parehas nga kusog, mas dako ang kausaban sa lihok. Mao nga sa baseball o sipa, adunay 'follow-through': padugayon ang dampi sa kamot o tiil sa bola aron mas layo kini molupad.

q: What is the purpose of molting in birds?
options: Old feathers fall out and are replaced by new ones so the bird can keep flying well.
The bird sheds feathers to make itself lighter before a long migration.
The bird loses feathers to cool itself down during hot weather.
Old feathers are eaten by the bird to recycle nutrients before winter.
explanation: From time to time a bird's old feathers fall out and are replaced by new ones so it can keep flying well.
fact_tl: Paminsan-minsan ay nalalaglag ang lumang balahibo ng ibon at napapalitan ng bago para manatiling maganda ang paglipad nito.
fact_bis: Matag karon ug unya mangahulog ang daan nga balhibo sa langgam ug ilisan og bag-o aron magpabilin nga maayo ang paglupad niini.

q: How did ancient builders move huge heavy stones to higher positions?
options: They put logs as rollers under the stones to reduce friction, then used ramps to raise them.
They tied ropes to the stones and had hundreds of workers lift straight up.
They carved the stones into spheres so they would roll by themselves.
They flooded the ground with water so the stones could float and be pushed easily.
explanation: Ancient builders used logs as rollers to reduce friction when dragging heavy stones, and used ramps to raise them to higher positions.
fact_tl: Ang mga sinaunang tagapagtayo ay gumamit ng mga log bilang roller sa ilalim ng mabibigat na bato para gawing mas madali ang paglipat at paggalaw ng mga ito sa mga ramp.
fact_bis: Ang mga karaan nga taga-tukod nagbutang sa mga log isip roller ubos sa mabug-at nga mga bato aron mabawasan ang kiskisan panahon sa pagdraggas, ug naggamit sa mga ramp aron ibangon sila sa mas taas nga mga posisyon.

q: Which mountain is the highest peak in the Visayas region of the Philippines?
options: Mount Kanlaon on Negros island
Mount Apo on Mindanao island
Mount Pulag in the Cordillera
Mount Mayon on Luzon island
explanation: The highest mountain in the Visayas is Mount Kanlaon, located on Negros island.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamataas na bundok sa Visayas ay ang Bundok Kanlaon sa Negros.
fact_bis: Ang pinakataas nga bukid sa Visayas mao ang Bukid Kanlaon sa Negros.

q: Which best describes where tardigrades can be found on Earth?
options: Almost everywhere — from the highest mountains to the deepest seas.
Only in tropical rainforests where humidity is constantly high.
Only in polar ice caps and very cold mountain streams.
Only in soil, because they cannot survive in water.
explanation: Tardigrades are found almost everywhere on Earth, from the highest mountains to the deepest seas.
fact_tl: Matatagpuan ang mga tardigrade halos saanman sa mundo, mula sa pinakamataas na bundok hanggang sa pinakamalalim na dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga tardigrade makit-an halos bisan asa sa kalibutan, gikan sa pinakahabog nga bukid hangtod sa pinakalawom nga dagat.

q: What must happen BEFORE you pour off the clear liquid in the process of decantation?
options: The heavy solid must settle to the bottom of the container first.
The mixture must be heated until the liquid turns into steam.
The liquid must be filtered through paper to remove all particles.
The solid must be scooped out using a spoon before pouring begins.
explanation: In decantation, the heavy solid is allowed to settle to the bottom first, then the clear liquid on top is gently poured off without disturbing the sediment.
fact_tl: Sa decantation, hinahayaang lumubog muna ang mabigat na solido sa ilalim, tapos dahan-dahang ibinubuhos ang malinaw na likido sa ibabaw nang hindi nagagalaw ang latak.
fact_bis: Sa decantation, pasagdan unang molubog ang bug-at nga solido sa ilawom, dayon hinay-hinayng ibubo ang tin-aw nga likido sa ibabaw nga dili matandog ang linugdang.

q: What is ozone made of?
options: Three oxygen atoms joined together (O3)
Two oxygen atoms and one nitrogen atom
One oxygen atom and two hydrogen atoms
Four oxygen atoms bonded in a ring
explanation: Ozone is a form of oxygen made of three oxygen atoms joined together, written as O3.
fact_tl: Ang ozone ay isang anyo ng oxygen na gawa sa tatlong oxygen na magkadikit (O3).
fact_bis: Ang ozone usa ka porma sa oksiheno nga hinimo sa tulo ka oksiheno nga nagdugtong (O3).

q: What is the MAIN difference in purpose between sweat and urine in the human body?
options: Urine is the body's main blood-cleaner; sweat is mainly the body's cooler.
Sweat is the body's main blood-cleaner; urine is mainly the body's cooler.
Both have the same main job: removing carbon dioxide from the blood.
Sweat removes salt only; urine removes only excess sugar from the blood.
explanation: Urine (from the kidneys) is the body's main blood-cleaner, while sweat is mainly the body's cooler; both remove some water and waste.
fact_tl: Parehong nagtatanggal ng tubig at kaunting waste ang pawis at ihi, pero magkaiba ang trabaho. Ang ihi (mula sa kidney) ang pangunahing tagalinis ng dugo; ang pawis ang pangunahing pampalamig ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang singot ug ihi parehong magkuha og tubig ug gamayng hugaw, apan lahi ang trabaho. Ang ihi (gikan sa kidney) mao ang nag-unang tiglimpyo sa dugo; ang singot mao ang nag-unang tigpabugnaw sa lawas.

q: Why are bananas curved instead of straight?
options: As they grow, they turn upward toward sunlight instead of hanging straight down.
They are squeezed into a curved shape by the tight bunch they grow in.
The heavy weight of the banana pulls one side down more than the other.
They grow along a curved vine and take on that shape permanently.
explanation: Bananas are curved because as they grow, they turn upward toward the sunlight instead of hanging straight down.
fact_tl: Hubog o baluktot ang saging dahil habang lumalaki ito, tumitingala ito paitaas patungo sa liwanag ng araw sa halip na pababa.
fact_bis: Hubog ang saging tungod kay samtang motubo kini, motalikod kini pataas paingon sa kahayag sa adlaw imbis nga moubos nga tul-id.

q: What part of Earth's structure makes up each tectonic plate?
options: The rigid outer layer called the lithosphere
The hot, flowing layer called the asthenosphere
The liquid outer core deep below the surface
The soft inner mantle just below the crust
explanation: Each tectonic plate is made of the rigid outer part of Earth called the lithosphere.
fact_tl: Ang bawat tectonic plate ay binubuo ng matigas na panlabas na bahagi ng Daigdig na tinatawag na lithosphere.
fact_bis: Ang matag tectonic plate gilangkoban sa gahi nga gawas nga bahin sa Kalibotan nga gitawag og lithosphere.

q: If an astronaut goes from Earth to the Moon, what happens to their mass?
options: Their mass stays the same; only their weight changes because the Moon has less gravity.
Their mass decreases because the Moon's weaker gravity pulls less on their body.
Both their mass and weight stay exactly the same as on Earth.
Their mass increases slightly because they are farther from Earth's gravity.
explanation: Your mass stays the same on Earth and on the Moon; only your weight changes because gravity is different.
fact_tl: Ang iyong masa ay pareho sa Daigdig at sa Buwan; ang timbang mo lang ang nagbabago dahil iba ang grabidad.
fact_bis: Ang imong masa parehas sa Yuta ug sa Bulan; ang imong gibug-aton lang ang mausab kay lahi ang grabidad.

q: What does the inside of an atom mostly consist of?
options: Empty space surrounding a tiny nucleus
Tightly packed protons and neutrons with no empty space
A solid core of electrons with a thin outer shell
Equally spaced particles that fill the entire atom uniformly
explanation: An atom is mostly empty space surrounding a tiny nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomo ay halos puro walang laman na espasyo, na napapalibutan ng maliit na nucleus.
fact_bis: Ang atomo halos puro walay sulod nga espasyo nga naglibot sa gamay nga nucleus.

q: What makes double fertilization in flowering plants unique?
options: One sperm fertilizes the egg to form the embryo, and a second sperm fertilizes another cell to form the endosperm that feeds it.
Two eggs are fertilized by the same sperm cell to produce twins inside the seed.
A single sperm cell fertilizes the egg twice in a row to create extra food reserves.
Both the male and female parts of the same flower fertilize each other at the same time.
explanation: In angiosperms, one sperm forms the embryo and another forms the endosperm that feeds it — a process called double fertilization.
fact_tl: Ang angiosperms ay may natatanging prosesong tinatawag na double fertilization: ang isang sperm ay nagbubunga ng embryo, at ang isa pa ay nagbubunga ng endosperm na nagsisilbing pagkain para sa embryo.
fact_bis: Ang angiosperms adunay natatangi nga proseso nga gitawag og double fertilization: ang usa ka sperm nagmugna og embryo, ug ang lain nagmugna og endosperm nga nagsilbing pagkaon sa embryo.

q: Which statement about Philippine animals is TRUE?
options: Most Philippine animals are harmless and are an important part of nature.
Most Philippine animals are dangerous because the country has so many different species.
The more kinds of animals a place has, the more dangerous it is to live there.
Animals in the Philippines are more dangerous than animals in other countries.
explanation: Most Philippine animals are harmless and are an important part of nature; having many species does not mean most are dangerous.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, kapag maraming uri ng hayop sa isang lugar, marami ring mapanganib. Hindi totoo iyan. Karamihan sa mga hayop sa Pilipinas ay hindi nakakasama at mahalagang bahagi ng kalikasan.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga kon daghan og matang sa hayop sa usa ka dapit, daghan usab ang delikado. Dili kana tinuod. Kadaghanan sa mga hayop sa Pilipinas dili makadaot ug importanteng bahin sa kinaiyahan.

q: What is a community or urban garden?
options: A place in the city where residents grow vegetables and plants together, providing fresh food and cleaner air.
A large private farm on the edge of the city that sells produce to supermarkets.
A park in the city that is designed only for flowers and trees, not food crops.
A greenhouse inside a school building where students grow plants for science class.
explanation: A community or urban garden is a place in the city where residents grow vegetables and plants together, providing fresh food and cleaner air.
fact_tl: Ang community o urban garden ay isang lugar sa lungsod kung saan magkakasamang nagtatanim ng gulay at halaman ang mga residente, na nagbibigay ng sariwang pagkain at mas malinis na hangin sa siyudad.
fact_bis: Ang community o urban garden usa ka lugar sa siyudad diin ang mga residente nagtanom ug utanon ug tanom nga dungan, nga naghatag ug presko nga pagkaon ug mas limpyo nga hangin sa siyudad.

q: How do small fish help control mosquito populations?
options: They eat mosquito larvae in the water, reducing the number that grow into adults.
They create ripples on the water surface that prevent mosquitoes from laying eggs.
They release a chemical into the water that kills mosquito eggs.
They compete with mosquitoes for the same food, leaving mosquitoes too weak to reproduce.
explanation: Small fish help reduce mosquitoes because they eat the larvae in the water.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na isda ay nakakatulong na mabawasan ang lamok dahil kinakain nila ang mga uod nito sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga mga isda makatabang sa pagpamenos sa lamok kay ilang kaonon ang mga ulod niini sa tubig.

q: Which statement about the structure of the liver is correct?
options: The liver is divided into lobes, with the right lobe larger than the left, and it sits in the upper belly protected by the ribs.
The liver has only one lobe and is located in the lower belly near the kidneys.
The right and left lobes of the liver are exactly the same size.
The liver is found in the chest cavity, protected by the breastbone.
explanation: The liver is divided into lobes — the right lobe is bigger than the left — and it sits in the upper belly, protected by the rib bones.
fact_tl: Ang atay ay nahahati sa mga malalaking bahagi na tinatawag na lobes—mas malaki ang kanang lobe kaysa kaliwa. Hugis tatsulok ito at makinis ang ibabaw. Nasa itaas ng tiyan ito, protektado ng mga buto ng tadyang.
fact_bis: Ang atay nabahin sa dagkong bahin nga gitawag ug lobes—mas dako ang tuo nga lobe kaysa wala. Morag triyanggulo kini ang porma ug hapsay ang ibabaw. Naa kini sa ibabaw nga tiyan, gipanalipdan sa mga bukog sa gusok.

q: Why is red cabbage juice considered a natural indicator?
options: Because it contains anthocyanin, a natural pigment that changes color in acids and bases.
Because it turns permanently red when heated and stays that color in any liquid.
Because it was the first indicator discovered by scientists before synthetic ones were made.
Because it grows naturally in the wild and does not need to be made in a laboratory.
explanation: Red cabbage is a natural indicator because of its anthocyanin pigment, which changes color depending on whether a solution is acidic or basic.
fact_tl: Ang pulang repolyo ay isang NATURAL na indikeytor dahil sa pigment nitong anthocyanin.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga repolyo usa ka NATURAL nga indicator tungod sa anthocyanin nga pigment niini.

q: Which part of a lanzones fruit tastes sweet, and which part tastes bitter?
options: The flesh is sweet; the seed is bitter
The flesh is bitter; the seed is sweet
Both the flesh and seed are sweet
Both the flesh and seed are bitter
explanation: The flesh of lanzones is sweet, but the seed inside it tastes bitter.
fact_tl: Matamis ang laman ng lanzones, pero ang buto sa loob nito ay mapait.
fact_bis: Tam-is ang unod sa lanzones, apan ang liso sa sulod niini mapait.

q: Why is the Philippines one of the world's largest producers of geothermal energy?
options: It has many fast-flowing rivers suitable for dams
It has many volcanoes that produce underground heat
It receives the most sunlight of any country in Asia
It sits above very large underground coal deposits
explanation: The Philippines is one of the world's largest producers of geothermal energy because of its many volcanoes.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa pinakamalaking gumagawa ng geothermal energy sa buong mundo dahil sa dami ng mga bulkan nito.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa pinakadako nga naghimog geothermal energy sa tibuok kalibotan tungod sa daghan niini nga mga bulkan.

q: How many times can a mother rat give birth in a single year?
options: Only once, like most large mammals
Exactly twice — once in summer and once in winter
Several times, producing many young throughout the year
Only during the rainy season, once a year
explanation: In one year a mother rat can give birth several times, producing many young.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng isang taon, ang isang inang daga ay maaaring manganak nang maraming beses.
fact_bis: Sulod sa usa ka tuig, ang inahan nga ilaga makapanganak ug makadaghan.

q: How many bones does an adult human body have?
explanation: There are 206 bones in the adult human body.
fact_tl: May 206 na buto sa katawan ng isang adultong tao.
fact_bis: Adunay 206 ka bukog sa lawas sa hamtong nga tawo.

q: What is the correct order of a flowering plant's life cycle?
options: Seeds → flower → fruit → pollination → fertilization
Flower → pollination → fertilization → seeds and fruit → new plant
Fruit → fertilization → pollination → flower → seeds
Pollination → flower → seeds → fertilization → fruit
explanation: A plant follows the cycle: flower → pollination → fertilization → seeds and fruit → new plant.
fact_tl: Sumusunod ang halaman sa siklo: bulaklak → polinasyon → fertilization → binhi at prutas → bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Ang tanom mosunod sa siklo: buwak → polinasyon → fertilization → liso ug prutas → bag-ong tanom.

q: If an earthquake strikes, where would you feel the strongest shaking?
options: Far away from the epicenter, where the waves spread out
Near the epicenter, where the intensity is highest
Deep underground, where the rock is harder
At the coast, because water carries the shaking further
explanation: A single earthquake has different intensities in different places — intensity is higher near the epicenter and weakens farther away.
fact_tl: Ang iisang lindol ay maaaring magkaroon ng iba't ibang intensity sa magkakaibang lugar: mas mataas ang intensity malapit sa epicenter at humihina ito habang lumalayo.
fact_bis: Ang usa lang ka linog mahimong adunay lainlaing intensity sa managlahing dapit: mas taas ang intensity duol sa epicenter ug nag-anam ka huyang samtang nagkalayo.

q: What can happen to your stomach when you eat too much food at one time?
options: It shrinks and stops digesting
It feels uncomfortable or achy
It immediately sends the extra food to your muscles
It produces extra acid that gives you more energy
explanation: When we eat too much, our stomach can feel uncomfortable or achy.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra-sobra ang ating kinain, nararamdaman nating sumasakit o hindi komportable ang tiyan.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang atong gikaon, mahimong mobati kita nga dili komportable o sakit ang tiyan.

q: What does the small round scar on a person's upper arm usually show?
options: That they were bitten by an insect as a baby
That they received the BCG vaccine against tuberculosis as a baby
That their arm was injured before it fully healed
That they were born with a birthmark on their skin
explanation: The small round scar on the upper arm is a normal sign that a person received the BCG vaccine against tuberculosis as a baby.
fact_tl: Maraming tao ang may maliit na bilog na peklat sa itaas ng braso mula sa BCG vaccine na ibinibigay sa mga sanggol laban sa tuberculosis. Normal lang ang peklat na ito — tanda lang na natanggap ang bakuna noong sanggol pa sila.
fact_bis: Daghang tawo ang adunay gamayng lingin nga pilat sa ibabaw nga bahin sa bukton gikan sa BCG vaccine nga ihatag sa mga masuso batok sa tuberculosis. Normal lang kini nga pilat — timaan lang nga nakadawat sila sa bakuna sa bata pa sila.

q: What does PHIVOLCS Alert Level 1 at a volcano mean?
options: The volcano is erupting violently and everyone must evacuate
There are small signs of unrest like weak earthquakes, but eruption is not certain
The volcano is completely calm with no activity at all
Lava is already flowing and the area is dangerous
explanation: Alert Level 1 means there are small changes like weak earthquakes or more steam, and people should avoid the crater because of possible sudden steam blasts.
fact_tl: Sa Alert Level 1, may maliliit na pagbabago sa bulkan tulad ng mahihinang lindol o pagdami ng singaw. Hindi ito nangangahulugang sasabog na, pero pinapayuhang iwasan ang bunganga (crater) dahil pwedeng may biglaang pagsabog ng singaw.
fact_bis: Sa Alert Level 1, adunay gagmay nga kausaban sa bulkan sama sa huyang nga linog o pagdaghan sa alisngaw. Wala kini magpasabot nga mobuto na, apan gitambagan ang mga tawo nga likayan ang bunganga (crater) tungod sa posible nga kalit nga pagbuto sa alisngaw.

q: At which special position in space is the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) located?
options: L1 Lagrange point between the Sun and Earth
L2 Lagrange point of the Sun-Earth system
The Moon's orbit around Earth
A geostationary orbit directly above the equator
explanation: The JWST is at the L2 Lagrange point of the Sun-Earth system, a stable position where gravity and centrifugal force balance out.
fact_tl: Ang mga Lagrange point ay mga espesyal na posisyon sa kalawakan kung saan ang gravitational pull ng dalawang malaking katawan (tulad ng Araw at Earth) at ang centrifugal force ay magkasamang nagbibigay ng stable na posisyon para sa isang mas maliit na katawan. Ang JWST ay nasa L2 Lagrange point ng Sun-Earth system.
fact_bis: Ang mga Lagrange point mga espesyal nga posisyon sa kalawakan diin ang gravitational pull sa duha ka dako nga lawas (sama sa Adlaw ug Yuta) ug ang centrifugal force magkasama naghatag og stable nga posisyon alang sa usa ka mas gamay nga lawas. Ang JWST anaa sa L2 Lagrange point sa Sun-Earth system.

q: Why is ozone found near the ground considered harmful, while ozone high in the stratosphere is considered good?
options: Ground-level ozone keeps us warm, but stratospheric ozone makes it too cold
Stratospheric ozone shields us from UV rays, while ground-level ozone is a pollutant that harms our lungs
Ground-level ozone produces rain, while stratospheric ozone creates wind
Stratospheric ozone creates oxygen we breathe, while ground-level ozone destroys it
explanation: Stratospheric ozone shields us from harmful UV rays, but ozone at ground level is part of smog and harms our lungs when we breathe it.
fact_tl: Ang ozone sa stratosphere ay mabuti dahil sinasalag tayo nito sa UV. Pero ang ozone na nasa lupa, kung saan tayo humihinga, ay masama at nakakasakit sa baga; bahagi ito ng usok-polusyon o smog sa mga lungsod.
fact_bis: Ang ozone sa stratosphere maayo kay manalipod kanato gikan sa UV. Apan ang ozone sa ubos, diin kita muginhawa, daotan ug makadaot sa atong baga; kabahin kini sa smog nga polusyon sa mga siyudad.

q: How does a plant cell divide differently from an animal cell?
options: Plant cells pinch inward in the middle to split apart
Plant cells form a cell plate between two new cells, which becomes the new cell wall
Plant cells split lengthwise along the outer membrane
Plant cells break apart and then fuse into new cells
explanation: When plant cells divide, they form a cell plate between the two new cells, which eventually becomes the new cell wall — unlike animal cells, which pinch inward.
fact_tl: Kapag nagpaparami ang mga selula ng halaman, gumagawa sila ng cell plate sa gitna ng dalawang bagong selula—ito ay naiiba sa mga selulang hayop na gumagamit ng pinching; ang cell plate ay nagiging bagong cell wall.
fact_bis: Kung nagpaparami ang mga selula sa tanum, nagmugna sila og cell plate tali sa duha ka bag-ong selula; nagkalahi kini sa mga selula sa hayop nga nagpinching; ang cell plate nahimong bag-ong cell wall tali sa mga daughter cells.

q: Why do many grazing animals like zebras and deer live in herds?
options: It is easier to find water when animals travel in large groups
More animals together means it is easier to spot and avoid predators
Living in herds keeps animals warmer in cold weather
Herds help animals find mates more quickly each season
explanation: Many grazers live in herds because it is easier to spot and avoid predators when there are many of them together.
fact_tl: Maraming grazer ay nabubuhay nang magkakawan dahil mas madaling makita at maiwasan ang mga mandaragit kapag marami sila.
fact_bis: Daghang grazer nagpuyo nga nagpanon kay mas sayon makita ug malikayan ang mga manunukob kung daghan sila nga magkauban.

q: How can a plant bulb produce more plants without using seeds?
options: It releases spores into the soil that grow into new bulbs
It forms small new bulbs at its side, which grow into separate plants
It sends out long underground runners that sprout at the tips
It sheds its outer layers, and each layer grows into a new plant
explanation: One bulb can form new small bulbs at its side, allowing it to multiply even without seeds.
fact_tl: Ang isang bombilya ay maaaring magbuo ng mga bagong maliliit na bombilya sa gilid nito, kaya dumarami ito kahit walang buto.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka bombilya makahimo og bag-ong gagmay nga mga bombilya sa kilid niini, mao nga modaghan kini bisan walay liso.

q: Who performed the first-ever spacewalk in history, and when did it happen?
options: Yuri Gagarin from the Soviet Union, in April 1961
Neil Armstrong from the USA, in July 1969
Alexei Leonov from the Soviet Union, in March 1965
Valentina Tereshkova from the Soviet Union, in June 1963
explanation: Soviet cosmonaut Alexei Leonov was the first person to walk in space in March 1965, and his spacesuit ballooned outward during the 12-minute spacewalk.
fact_tl: Ang Soviet cosmonaut na si Alexei Leonov ang naging unang tao na lumabas sa spacecraft sa kalawakan (spacewalk o EVA) noong Marso 1965; ang kanyang spacewalk ay tumagal ng 12 minuto at nakaranas siya ng malubhang problema dahil sa pag-laki ng kanyang spacesuit.
fact_bis: Ang Soviet cosmonaut nga si Alexei Leonov nahimong unang tawo nga milabas sa spacecraft sa kalawakan (spacewalk o EVA) niadtong Marso 1965; ang iyang spacewalk nagtapos og 12 minuto ug nakasinati siya og seryosong problema sa dihang ang iyang spacesuit nagsabog sa gawas.

q: How do baby spiders travel to a new place after they hatch?
options: They crawl along the ground until they reach a new habitat
They release a strand of silk and let the wind carry them
They are carried by their mother in a silk pouch
They jump from plant to plant using their strong back legs
explanation: Baby spiders release a strand of silk so the wind can carry them to a new place, a behavior called ballooning.
fact_tl: Ang mga batang gagamba ay naglalabas ng hiblang sutla para tangayin sila ng hangin patungo sa bagong lugar.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga lawalawa magpagawas ug hilo nga seda aron dad-on sila sa hangin ngadto sa bag-ong dapit.

q: Why does a rainbow look like a full circle from an airplane but only a half arc from the ground?
options: The airplane's speed makes light bend in a complete ring around it
From the ground, land blocks the lower half of the circular rainbow
Rainbows are only half arcs naturally; airplanes create a different type
Airplane windows focus light into a full circle that eyes cannot see from below
explanation: From the ground we see only a half arc because the land blocks the lower part; from an airplane or tall mountain, a rainbow can appear as a full circle.
fact_tl: Mula sa lupa, kalahating arko lang ang nakikita natin dahil hinaharang ng lupa ang ibaba. Pero mula sa eroplano o mataas na bundok, ang bahaghari, pati ang doble nito, ay pwedeng makitang buong bilog.
fact_bis: Gikan sa yuta, tunga ra nga arko ang atong makita kay ang yuta nagbabag sa ubos. Apan gikan sa eroplano o taas nga bukid, ang bahaghari, apil ang doble niini, mahimong makita nga tibuok lingin.

q: How long is the term of the President of the Philippines, and can they be re-elected?
options: 4 years, and they can run for a second term
6 years, and they cannot be re-elected
5 years, and they can serve two terms in a row
6 years, and they can run for one more term after resting for six years
explanation: The President of the Philippines serves a term of 6 years and cannot be re-elected.
fact_tl: Ang termino ng Pangulo ng Pilipinas ay 6 na taon, at hindi siya pwedeng muling tumakbo.
fact_bis: Ang termino sa Presidente sa Pilipinas kay 6 ka tuig, ug dili na siya mahimong modagan pag-usab.

q: In 2021, who was the Filipino scientist who dived to the bottom of the Emden Deep in the Philippine Trench?
options: Mahar Lagmay
Deo Florence Onda
Teodoro Corpuz
Joanne Yap
explanation: In 2021, Filipino scientist Deo Florence Onda became one of the first people to dive to the bottom of the Emden Deep, riding a special submersible with explorer Victor Vescovo.
fact_tl: Noong 2021, ang Pilipinong siyentipikong si Deo Florence Onda ay naging isa sa mga unang taong sumisid sa pinakailalim ng Emden Deep, kasama ang explorer na si Victor Vescovo, sakay ng espesyal na submersible.
fact_bis: Niadtong 2021, ang Pilipinong siyentipiko nga si Deo Florence Onda nahimong usa sa unang mga tawo nga nakasalom sa kinailaloman sa Emden Deep, kauban ang explorer nga si Victor Vescovo, sakay sa espesyal nga submersible.

q: What does your body do with the sugar made when you eat a 'go food' like rice or bread?
options: It stores all the sugar in the liver and only uses it during sleep
It sends the sugar into the blood, and muscles use it to make energy
It converts the sugar directly into fat before using any of it
It filters the sugar through the kidneys and removes it from the body
explanation: When you eat a go food, your body breaks it down into sugar that travels in your blood, and your muscles use this sugar to make energy.
fact_tl: Kapag kumain ka ng go food, hinihimay ito ng iyong katawan at ginagawang maliit na asukal na dumadaloy sa dugo. Ang asukal na ito ang ginagamit ng mga muscle mo para magkaroon ng lakas.
fact_bis: Kon mokaon ka og go food, gidugmok kini sa imong lawas ug gihimong gamay nga asukal nga moagi sa dugo. Kini nga asukal mao ang gamiton sa imong mga unod aron makakusog.

q: Which of the following is the most common cause of air pollution in cities?
options: Rain clouds releasing chemicals into the air
Smoke and gases from vehicles and factories
Animals breathing out carbon dioxide all day
Plants releasing too much pollen in spring
explanation: Air pollution is dirty smoke and gases in the air, often coming from vehicles and factories.
fact_tl: Ang air pollution ay ang pagkakaroon ng maruming usok at gas sa hangin na galing sa mga sasakyan at pabrika.
fact_bis: Ang air pollution mao ang hugaw nga aso ug mga gas sa hangin, kasagaran gikan sa mga sakyanan ug pabrikahan.

q: What is the temperature like in the deep sea, and how does that affect the animals there?
options: The deep sea is warm because of underwater volcanoes, so animals prefer heat
The deep sea is very cold, near freezing, so the animals must be adapted to the cold
The deep sea is moderate and comfortable, so no special adaptations are needed
The deep sea alternates between hot and cold depending on the season
explanation: The water in the deep sea is very cold, near freezing, so the animals there must be adapted to the cold.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa kailaliman ng dagat ay napakalamig, malapit sa pagyeyelo, kaya kailangan ng mga hayop doon na makibagay sa lamig.
fact_bis: Ang tubig sa kailaloman sa dagat bugnaw kaayo, hapit moyelo, mao nga ang mga mananap didto kinahanglan mobagay sa katugnaw.

q: What is special about the stag beetle's jaws?
options: They can spin silk to build a nest underground
They glow in the dark to attract prey at night
They are large pincer jaws that are very strong for its small size
They are hollow and inject venom into other insects
explanation: The stag beetle has large pincer jaws that are very strong for its small size.
fact_tl: Ang stag beetle ay may malalaking sipit na panga na napakalakas para sa laki nitong maliit.
fact_bis: Ang stag beetle adunay dagkong sipit nga apapangig nga kusgan kaayo para sa gamay nga gidak-on niini.

q: Who coined the word 'radioactivity' to describe the energy given off by elements like uranium?
options: Albert Einstein
Ernest Rutherford
Marie Curie
Niels Bohr
explanation: Marie Curie coined the word 'radioactivity' for the energy given off by elements like uranium.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang gumawa ng salitang "radioactivity" para sa enerhiyang inilalabas ng mga elementong tulad ng uranium.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie ang naghimo sa pulong "radioactivity" alang sa enerhiya nga gibuga sa mga elemento sama sa uranium.

q: What actually gets 'used up' when a light bulb glows in a circuit?
options: The electric current, which is smaller leaving the bulb than entering it
The wires, which slowly lose their ability to carry electricity
The energy, which is converted into light and heat — not the current itself
The voltage, which disappears completely after passing through the bulb
explanation: The current entering and leaving a bulb is the same amount; what gets used up is the energy, converted into light and heat.
fact_tl: Maraming akala na 'naubos' ang kuryente sa bombilya, pero hindi. Ang dami ng current na pumapasok sa bombilya ay kasing-dami ng lumalabas. Ang nauubos ay ang enerhiya, na nagiging liwanag at init — hindi ang current mismo.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga 'mahurot' ang kuryente sa bombilya, apan dili. Ang gidaghanon sa current nga mosulod sa bombilya parehas ra sa mogawas. Ang mahurot mao ang enerhiya, nga mahimong kahayag ug kainit — dili ang current mismo.

q: What is the unit used to measure electric current?
options: Volt
Watt
Ampere
Ohm
explanation: The unit of electric current is the ampere, with the symbol A.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng kuryente (current) ay ang ampere, na may simbolong A.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa kuryente (current) kay ang ampere, nga may simbolo nga A.

q: What causes earthquakes to happen?
options: Hot magma boiling inside the Earth's core pushes upward and shakes the ground
Large tectonic plates in the Earth's crust suddenly move or grind against each other
Strong ocean waves crash against the seafloor and send vibrations inland
Heavy rainfall seeps into the ground and causes the soil layers to collapse
explanation: Earthquakes happen when the Earth's large tectonic plates suddenly move or grind against each other.
fact_tl: Ang lindol ay nangyayari kapag biglang gumagalaw o nagkakabanggaan ang malalaking plato ng lupa (tectonic plates).
fact_bis: Ang linog mahitabo kon kalit nga molihok o magbangga ang dagkong mga plato sa yuta (tectonic plates).

q: Why is taking too many vitamin D tablets potentially harmful, even though sunlight cannot cause a vitamin D overdose?
options: Tablets make skin too sensitive to sunlight, causing burns
Too many tablets can put too much calcium in the blood and cause harm
Vitamin D from tablets blocks the absorption of vitamin C
Excess vitamin D from tablets turns into a toxin that weakens bones
explanation: While the body stops making vitamin D from sunlight once there's enough, taking too many vitamin D tablets can raise blood calcium to harmful levels.
fact_tl: Masama ba ang sobrang vitamin D? Hindi ka maaaring mag-sobra mula lang sa araw, dahil hinihinto ng katawan ang paggawa kapag sapat na. Pero ang sobrang inom ng tableta ay maaaring makapaglagay ng masyadong maraming calcium sa dugo at makasama — kaya may tamang dami.
fact_bis: Daotan ba ang sobra nga vitamin D? Dili ka maka-sobra gikan lang sa adlaw, kay mohunong ang lawas sa paghimo kung igo na. Apan ang sobrang inom og tableta makabutang og sobrang calcium sa dugo ug makadaot — mao nga adunay husto nga gidaghanon.

q: How many bones does an adult human body have, and how does this compare to a baby?
options: Adults have 300 bones; babies are born with only 206 that grow over time
Adults have 206 bones; babies are born with about 300 that gradually fuse together
Adults and babies both have exactly 206 bones from birth
Adults have 270 bones; about 64 extra bones appear as children grow
explanation: An adult human has 206 bones, but babies are born with about 300 bones that gradually fuse together as the body grows.
fact_tl: Ang isang nasa hustong gulang ay may 206 buto, ngunit ang mga sanggol ay ipinanganak na may humigit-kumulang 300 buto na kalaunan ay nagdudugtong habang tumatanda.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hamtong adunay 206 ka buto, apan ang mga bata matawo nga adunay mga 300 ka buto nga hinay-hinay nagkausa samtang nagdako ang lawas.

q: What can a chameleon do with its eyes that most animals cannot?
options: It can see colors that humans cannot, like ultraviolet light
It can move each eye in a different direction at the same time
It can close one eye completely while the other stays wide open all night
It can change the color of its pupils to match its surroundings
explanation: A chameleon can move its right eye one way and its left eye another way at the same time, letting it see in almost every direction without turning its head.
fact_tl: Ang chameleon ay kayang igalaw ang kanang mata pakanan at ang kaliwang mata pakaliwa nang sabay. Kaya kayang silang makakita sa halos lahat ng direksyon nang hindi gumagalaw ang ulo.
fact_bis: Ang chameleon kaya niyang ilihok ang tuong mata sa usa ka direksyon ug ang wala nga mata sa lain nga direksyon dungan. Mao nga makakita siya sa halos tanang direksyon nga dili ilihok ang ulo.

q: Which lake is the fifth largest in the Philippines?
options: Lake Sebu
Lake Mainit
Lake Buhi
Lake Naujan
explanation: The fifth largest lake in the Philippines is Lake Naujan.
fact_tl: Ang panlimang pinakamalaking lawa sa Pilipinas ay ang Lake Naujan.
fact_bis: Ang ikalimang pinakadako nga lanaw sa Pilipinas mao ang Lake Naujan.

q: What is the name of the larger of Mars's two moons?
options: Deimos
Titan
Phobos
Callisto
explanation: Phobos is the larger of Mars's two moons.
fact_tl: Ang Phobos ang mas malaki sa dalawang buwan ng Mars.
fact_bis: Ang Phobos mao ang mas dako sa duha ka bulan sa Mars.

q: What does the Calvin cycle in photosynthesis produce for the plant?
options: Oxygen, which the plant releases into the air as waste
Chlorophyll, which the plant uses to capture more sunlight
Glucose, which serves as the plant's food
Water, which the plant stores in its stem and leaves
explanation: In the Calvin cycle, plants use ATP and CO2 to build glucose, which serves as the plant's food.
fact_tl: Sa Calvin cycle ng photosynthesis, ginagamit ng halaman ang ATP at CO2 para gumawa ng glucose na siyang pagkain ng halaman.
fact_bis: Sa Calvin cycle sa photosynthesis, gigamit sa tanum ang ATP ug CO2 aron maghimo og glucose nga mao ang pagkaon sa tanum.

q: Why should a sick person stay home instead of going to school or work?
options: Resting at home makes medicines work faster
Staying home prevents them from infecting other people
Being around crowds would make them feel worse emotionally
Cold air outside would worsen their symptoms quickly
explanation: When a person is sick, they should stay home so they do not infect other people.
fact_tl: Kapag may sakit ang isang tao, dapat siyang manatili sa bahay para hindi niya mahawa ang ibang tao.
fact_bis: Kung masakiton ang usa ka tawo, kinahanglan siya magpabilin sa balay aron dili niya matakdan ang ubang tawo.

q: Which animal found in mangroves can crawl and breathe out of water?
options: The sea horse, which hides among the mangrove roots
The mudskipper, a fish that can crawl and breathe on land
The octopus, which walks on the mud between the roots
The jellyfish, which washes into mangroves during high tide
explanation: The mudskipper is a fish adapted to mangrove life that can crawl and breathe out of water.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop ang umangkop sa buhay sa bakawan: ang mudskipper ay isdang kayang gumapang at huminga sa labas ng tubig, at may mga alimangong umaakyat sa ugat ng bakawan kapag taog ang dagat.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap ang nakapahiangay sa kinabuhi sa bakhaw: ang mudskipper usa ka isda nga kaya mokamang ug makaginhawa gawas sa tubig, ug adunay mga kasag nga mosaka sa gamot sa bakhaw kon taob na ang dagat.

q: Why are small silica gel packets placed inside gadget boxes?
options: They release a gas that keeps electronic circuits running longer
They absorb moisture from the air to prevent rust and corrosion inside
They produce a mild electric charge that powers gadgets in standby mode
They contain a dye that changes color if the box has been opened
explanation: Silica gel packets absorb moisture from the air to prevent rust and corrosion of the metal components inside gadget boxes.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na supot ng silica gel na inilalagay sa loob ng mga kahon ng gadget ay sumisipsip ng halumigmig para pigilan ang pagkalawang ng metal na bahagi sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga supot sa silica gel nga gibutang sulod sa mga kahon sa gadget sumisipsip og halumigmig gikan sa hangin aron mapugngan ang kalawang sa mga metal nga parte sa sulod.

q: Why is coconut oil a popular ingredient in making natural soap in the Philippines?
options: It makes the soap completely clear and odorless
It produces a hard, creamy soap with rich lather
It allows the soap to melt slowly in hot and humid weather
It gives the soap a yellow color that is preferred by buyers
explanation: Coconut oil is used in Philippine natural soap making because it produces a hard, creamy soap with rich lather.
fact_tl: Ang langis ng niyog ay isang popular na sangkap sa paggawa ng natural na sabon sa Pilipinas dahil gumagawa ito ng matigas, creamy na sabon na may maraming bula.
fact_bis: Ang langis sa niyog usa ka popular nga sangkap sa paghimo og natural nga sabon sa Pilipinas tungod kay nagprodyus kini og matigas, creamy nga sabon nga adunay daghang bula.

q: If a child in the Philippines keeps sneezing due to allergies, what is most likely causing it?
options: A highly contagious virus that spreads quickly in warm weather
Sensitivity to triggers like dust, mold, or animal fur — not a contagious sickness
Breathing in sea salt air that irritates the nose near the coast
Eating too many spicy Filipino foods that affect the nasal passages
explanation: Many kids in the Philippines sneeze a lot because of allergies to dust, mold, or animal fur — this is not a contagious sickness but nose sensitivity.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, maraming bata ang madalas bumahing dahil sa allergy sa alikabok, amag, o balahibo ng hayop. Hindi ito sakit na nakakahawa, kundi sobrang sensitibo lang ang kanilang ilong sa mga bagay na ito.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghang bata ang kanunay mobahin tungod sa allergy sa abog, agup-op, o balhibo sa hayop. Dili kini sakit nga makatakod, kondili sensitibo ra kaayo ang ilang ilong niini nga mga butang.

q: How long does a pineapple plant usually take before it produces its first fruit?
options: About one month, since pineapples grow in warm tropical weather
About three to four months under good growing conditions
Over a year, and it usually gives only one fruit per stalk
About six months if the plant gets enough water and fertilizer
explanation: A pineapple plant takes over a year before it fruits and usually gives just one fruit per stalk.
fact_tl: Ang halaman ng pinya ay umaabot ng higit isang taon bago magbunga, at karaniwang isang prutas lang ang nakukuha sa bawat tangkay.
fact_bis: Ang tanom sa pinya mokabat ug kapin sa usa ka tuig una mamunga, ug kasagaran usa ra ka prutas ang makuha matag tangkay.

q: How are whales and dolphins able to communicate across long distances underwater?
options: They use flashes of bioluminescent light to send signals to each other
They swim to the surface and use high-pitched calls through the air
Sound travels far underwater, so their calls can be heard from a great distance
They touch each other's fins in a pattern that works like a code
explanation: Sound travels far underwater, so whales and dolphins can communicate across long distances using their calls.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay malayong naglalakbay sa ilalim ng tubig, kaya nag-uusap ang mga balyena at lumba-lumba sa malayo.
fact_bis: Ang tingog naglakaw ug layo sa ilalom sa tubig, mao nga ang mga balyena ug lumba-lumba makasinultihanay bisan layo.

q: Why do birds like herons and ducks visit ponds?
options: To cool off by swimming when the weather is very hot
To find soft mud for building their nests on nearby trees
To feed on fish and insects that live in the pond
To drink fresh water because ponds have no salt
explanation: Many birds such as herons and ducks come to the pond to feed on fish and insects.
fact_tl: Maraming ibon tulad ng tagak at pato ang lumalapit sa lawa upang kumain ng isda at insekto.
fact_bis: Daghang langgam sama sa talabong ug itik ang moduol sa lanaw aron mokaon ug isda ug insekto.

q: How far back in history was soap first made?
options: About 500 years ago during the Renaissance in Europe
About 2,000 years ago in ancient Rome
Thousands of years ago in ancient Babylon
About 200 years ago during the Industrial Revolution
explanation: Soap was made as far back as ancient Babylon, thousands of years ago.
fact_tl: Ang sabon ay gawa pa noong sinaunang Babylon, libu-libong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang sabon gihimo pa sa karaang Babylon, liboan ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: What happens to the animals and plants that live in a forest when the forest is destroyed?
options: They quickly migrate to nearby forests without any lasting harm
They lose their habitat and many become endangered or go extinct
They adapt and thrive in cities built in place of the forest
They move into the ocean, where more resources are available
explanation: When forests are destroyed, the animals and plants living there lose their habitat, and many become endangered or go extinct.
fact_tl: Kapag nawasak ang kagubatan, ang mga hayop at halaman na nakatira dito ay nawawala rin ang kanilang tirahan at marami ang nanganganib na mawala magpakailanman.
fact_bis: Kon ang kagubatan maguba, ang mga mananap ug tanom nga nagpuyo didto mawad-an sa ilang puy-anan, ug daghan ang mangangitag-an o mapugos.

q: In a series circuit with two bulbs and a battery, what is true about the voltage drops across the bulbs?
options: Each bulb receives the full battery voltage, just like in a parallel circuit
The sum of all voltage drops across the bulbs equals the battery's total voltage
The first bulb takes all the voltage and the second bulb receives none
Voltage drops only in the wires, not in the bulbs themselves
explanation: In a series circuit, voltage drops across each component, and the sum of all voltage drops equals the battery's voltage.
fact_tl: Sa isang series circuit, ang boltahe ay bumababa (voltage drop) sa bawat component — ang kabuuan ng lahat ng voltage drop ay katumbas ng boltahe ng baterya. Maaaring masukat ang voltage drop ng bawat component gamit ang voltmeter.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka series circuit, ang boltahe nagkubos (voltage drop) sa matag component — ang suma sa tanan nga voltage drop katumbas sa boltahe sa baterya. Ang voltmeter makasukat sa voltage drop sa matag component.

q: A shrew looks like a mouse, but it is actually more closely related to which animals?
options: Rats and squirrels, which are also small rodents
Bats and rabbits, which have similarly shaped ears
Moles and hedgehogs, and it belongs to a different group from mice
Lizards and salamanders, since it has a similarly pointed snout
explanation: A shrew belongs to a different animal group from mice and is more closely related to moles and hedgehogs; its pointy snout is a key clue.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang akala ay isang daga ang shrew, pero hindi ito daga. Ang shrew ay galing sa ibang grupo ng hayop at mas malapit ito sa mga mole at hedgehog. Ang matulis nitong nguso ang isa sa mga palatandaan.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga ilaga ang shrew, apan dili kini ilaga. Ang shrew gikan sa lain nga grupo sa mananap ug mas duol kini sa mga mole ug hedgehog. Ang tul-id niyang simod usa sa mga timailhan.

q: How does an owl fly so quietly when hunting at night?
options: Its wings are very large, so each flap pushes air more slowly
It holds its wings still and glides without flapping for most of its flight
Its soft feathers muffle the sound of its wings beating through the air
It flies very high above prey so the distance reduces the sound
explanation: The soft feathers on an owl's wings let it fly almost silently so it can surprise its prey.
fact_tl: Ang malambot na balahibo sa pakpak ng kuwago ay nagpapahintulot dito na lumipad nang halos walang ingay para masugod ang biktima.
fact_bis: Ang humok nga balhibo sa pako sa ngiwngiw nagtugot niini nga molupad nga halos walay saba aron makulbaan ang iyang biktima.

q: How does a crab get out of its old shell when it molts?
options: It uses a rock to crack the old shell open from the outside
The old shell dissolves in seawater and falls away on its own
The old shell splits open along the back and the crab slowly backs out of it
Its claws cut the shell into pieces so it can step out easily
