fact_bis: Ang pipila ka species sa tuna adunay partial endothermy — naggamit sila og counter-current heat exchange system aron mapabilin ang ilang mga kalamnan nga mas init kaysa sa napalibotang tubig, nagtugot kanila sa paglangoy nga mas paspas kaysa sa kadaghanan sa mga isda.

q: A big drum makes a very loud, low boom. What does the low pitch tell us about the drum's vibration?
options: The drum vibrates slowly, but can still be very loud
The drum vibrates slowly and must also be very quiet
The drum vibrates quickly, which is why the sound is low
The drum does not vibrate at all when making a low sound
explanation: A low pitch means slow vibration, but slow vibration can still be very loud — like the boom of a big drum — because pitch and loudness are different properties of sound.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang akala na ang mababang tunog ay laging mahina o tahimik. Mali ito! Ang mabagal na vibration ang nagbibigay ng mababang pitch, pero pwede pa rin itong napakalakas — tulad ng dagundong ng malaking tambol o bass speaker.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga ang mubo nga tingog kanunay hinay o hilom. Dili kana tinuod! Ang hinay nga vibration maghatag ug mubo nga pitch, apan mahimo pa kining kusog kaayo — sama sa dagundong sa dako nga tambol o bass speaker.

q: What two things are produced when an acid and a base react together?
options: A salt and water
A gas and a new acid
Carbon dioxide and a solid powder
Two new bases
explanation: When an acid meets a base in a neutralization reaction, the products are always a salt and water.
fact_tl: Kapag naghalo ang asido at base, dalawang bagay ang nabubuo: asin (salt) at tubig (water). Halimbawa, kapag pinaghalo ang muriatic acid at base, nagkakaroon ng isang uri ng asin na natutunaw sa tubig. Kaya ang basic na 'recipe' ay: asido + base = asin + tubig.
fact_bis: Kung magkita ang asido ug base, duha ka butang ang mahimo: asin (salt) ug tubig (water). Pananglitan, kung sagolon ang muriatic acid ug base, mahimo og usa ka klase nga asin nga natunaw sa tubig. Busa ang basic nga 'recipe' kay: asido + base = asin + tubig.

q: What happens to the energy a wave carries when it reaches the shallow shore and breaks?
options: It is suddenly released as noise, foam, and a push of water onto the sand
It is absorbed quietly into the sand without any sound or movement
It bounces back out to sea as a new wave of equal size
It sinks straight down to the seafloor
explanation: When a wave breaks on the shore, it suddenly releases the energy it carried as noise, foam, and a push of water onto the sand.
fact_tl: Kapag umabot sa mababaw na baybayin ang isang alon, bumabasag ito at biglang inilalabas ang dalang enerhiya bilang ingay, bula, at pagtulak ng tubig sa buhangin.
fact_bis: Kung moabot sa mabaw nga baybayon ang usa ka balod, mobuak kini ug kalit nga mopagawas sa dala niini nga enerhiya isip kasaba, bula, ug pagduso sa tubig ngadto sa balas.

q: How is civet coffee, also known as kopi luwak, made?
options: From coffee beans collected from civet droppings
From coffee beans soaked in civet milk overnight
From coffee beans that civets carry in their fur
From coffee berries that civets bury underground
explanation: Civet coffee (kopi luwak) is made from coffee beans collected from civet droppings after the animals eat and digest the coffee berries.
fact_tl: Ang kapeng alamid ay gawa sa mga butong kape na nakuha mula sa dumi ng alamid, tinatawag ding kopi luwak.
fact_bis: Ang kape sa alamid hinimo gikan sa mga liso sa kape nga nakuha sa hugaw sa alamid, gitawag usab nga kopi luwak.

q: What starts a tsunami?
options: The seafloor suddenly shifts and pushes a huge amount of water upward
Strong surface winds blow ocean water into tall waves
A sudden drop in air pressure above the ocean
Underwater volcanoes release hot steam that lifts the water
explanation: A tsunami begins when the seafloor suddenly shifts, pushing a huge amount of water upward and spreading energy outward as massive waves.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang gumalaw ang sahig ng dagat, naitutulak nito ang malaking dami ng tubig pataas, at ang enerhiya ay kumakalat palabas bilang mga alon.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga molihok ang salog sa dagat, gitukmod niini ang dakong gidaghanon sa tubig pataas, ug ang enerhiya mokatag paggawas isip mga balod.

q: What part of a ballpoint pen spreads ink onto paper?
options: A tiny metal ball that rolls across the paper
A small sponge that soaks ink onto the surface
A thin wire that scratches ink into the paper
A spring that pushes a flat tip against the page
explanation: A ballpoint pen works because a tiny metal ball at its tip rolls across the paper, picking up ink from the reservoir and spreading it onto the surface.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang ballpen sa pamamagitan ng maliit na bolang metal na umiikot at nagkakalat ng tinta sa papel.
fact_bis: Ang ballpen molihok pinaagi sa gamay nga bolang metal nga moligid ug magkatag og tinta sa papel.

q: Why is food pressed down tight and covered with brine when put in a jar to ferment?
options: To remove all air, because trapped air lets mold and rot start
To make the food softer so it ferments more quickly
To keep the food cold and slow down the fermentation
To add salt flavor throughout every layer of food
explanation: Food is packed tightly and covered with brine so no air is left in the jar, because trapped air is what allows mold and rot to begin.
fact_tl: Kapag naglalagay ng pagkain sa garapon para i-ferment, sinisiksik ito at tinatakpan ng tubig-asin para walang hanging maiwan, dahil ang hangin ang nagpapaamag at nagpapabulok.
fact_bis: Kung magbutang og pagkaon sa garapon aron i-ferment, ginasiksik kini ug ginatabonan og tubig-asin aron walay hangin nga mabilin, kay ang hangin maoy hinungdan sa agup-op ug pagkadunot.

q: At what speed do radio, Wi-Fi, and phone signals travel?
options: At the speed of light
At the speed of sound
At half the speed of sound
At a speed that depends on how far they need to travel
explanation: Radio, Wi-Fi, and phone signals travel at the speed of light — the fastest speed possible — so they arrive with almost no delay even from far away.
fact_tl: Ang hudyat ng radyo, wifi, at telepono ay naglalakbay sa bilis ng liwanag — ito ang pinakamabilis sa lahat, kaya halos walang antala ang pagdating ng alon kahit malayo ang pinanggalingan.
fact_bis: Ang signal sa radyo, wifi, ug telepono mobiyahe sa katulin sa kahayag — kini ang pinakakusog sa tanan, mao nga halos walay langan ang pag-abot sa balud bisan layo ang gigikanan.

q: What is the correct order of soil layers from top to bottom?
options: Topsoil, then subsoil, then bedrock
Bedrock, then topsoil, then subsoil
Subsoil, then topsoil, then bedrock
Topsoil, then bedrock, then subsoil
explanation: Soil is layered with dark, nutrient-rich topsoil on top, subsoil below it, and solid bedrock at the bottom.
fact_tl: Ang lupa ay may mga patong: ang madilim na ibabaw (topsoil) na mayaman sa sustansya, ang subsoil sa ilalim, at ang matibay na bedrock sa pinakailalim.
fact_bis: Ang yuta adunay mga sapaw: ang itom nga ibabaw nga yuta (topsoil) nga dato sa sustansya, ang subsoil sa ilalom, ug ang gahi nga bedrock sa kinaubsan.

q: Why are banana leaves a good choice for wrapping kakanin instead of plastic?
options: They are wide, natural, and break down easily without becoming plastic waste
They keep food cold longer than plastic bags
They add a sweet flavor that plastic cannot give
They are waterproof and never let any moisture through
explanation: Banana leaves are used to wrap kakanin because they are wide, natural, and break down easily, so they do not become plastic waste the way synthetic packaging would.
fact_tl: Ginagamit na pambalot ng kakanin ang dahon ng saging dahil malapad ito, natural, at madaling mabulok kaya hindi ito nagiging basurang plastik.
fact_bis: Gigamit nga pamutos sa kakanin ang dahon sa saging tungod kay halapad kini, natural, ug dali madunot busa dili kini mahimong basura nga plastik.

q: The image formed on the retina inside your eye is actually upside down. Why do we still see things the right way up?
options: The brain flips the image so we see things correctly
The lens in the eye flips the image before it reaches the retina
The retina automatically corrects the image as it forms
The optic nerve rotates the image on its way to the brain
explanation: The image on the retina is indeed upside down, but the brain flips it so that we perceive everything the right way up.
fact_tl: Baligtad ang larawang nabubuo sa retina, ngunit ang utak ang nagtatama nito kaya tama ang nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Balit-ad ang hulagway nga maporma sa retina, apan ang utok ang nagpatul-id niini mao nga sakto ang atong makita.

q: How does a parasitic plant like dodder get water and nutrients?
options: It attaches to a host plant and uses special root-like organs called haustoria to extract them
It grows extra-long roots deep into the soil to find underground water
It captures insects and digests them to get nutrients
It collects rainwater in its leaves and absorbs it through its surface
explanation: Dodder and similar parasitic plants attach to a host plant and use haustoria — special root-like organs — to extract water and nutrients because they cannot make enough food on their own.
fact_tl: Ang mga parasitic na halaman tulad ng dodder ay kumakapit sa host na halaman at ginagamit ang espesyal na mga ugat (haustoria) para kunin ang tubig at pagkain mula sa host—wala silang sapat na chlorophyll para gumawa ng sariling pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga parasitic nga tanum sama sa dodder nagkapit sa host nga tanum ug gigamit ang espesyal nga gamot-like nga organo nga gitawag og haustoria aron makuha ang tubig ug sustansya gikan sa host; dili sila makahimo og igo nga pagkaon sa ilang kaugalingon.

q: How do deep-sea animals survive the extreme water pressure in the deep ocean?
options: They have soft, flexible bodies that are not crushed by the pressure
They have extra-thick, rigid shells that block the pressure
They stay in air pockets trapped between underwater rocks
They produce a special fluid that pushes back against the water pressure
explanation: Deep-sea animals have soft, flexible bodies that are not crushed by the intense water pressure found at great depths.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop sa malalim na dagat ay may malalambot na katawan na hindi nadudurog ng matinding presyon ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap sa lawom nga dagat adunay humok nga lawas nga dili madugmok sa kusog nga presyon sa tubig.

q: Where can a thermometer be placed to measure your body temperature?
options: Under your tongue, in your armpit, or in your ear
Only under your tongue
Only in your ear canal
Only against the skin of your forehead
explanation: A thermometer can be placed under the tongue, in the armpit, or in the ear to measure body heat and show whether a person has a fever.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ng thermometer ang init ng katawan. Maaari itong ilagay sa ilalim ng dila, sa kilikili, o sa tainga. Ipinapakita nito ang numero ng temperatura para malaman kung may lagnat ka.
fact_bis: Ang thermometer magsukod sa kainit sa lawas. Mahimo kining ibutang ilalom sa dila, sa ilok, o sa dalunggan. Ipakita niini ang numero sa temperatura aron mahibal-an kung hilanaton ka.

q: How do mangroves help protect coral reefs?
options: By filtering out dirt and extra nutrients from coastal water before it reaches the reefs
By blocking large waves so the reefs are never exposed to the open sea
By providing shade that keeps the water cool enough for corals
By releasing oxygen that corals need to survive
explanation: Mangroves filter out dirt and excess nutrients from coastal water, helping to keep the water clean before it reaches nearby coral reefs.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang mga mangrove na linisin ang tubig sa baybayin sa pamamagitan ng pagsala sa dumi at sobrang sustansya bago ito umabot sa bahurang-coral.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakhaw motabang sa paglimpyo sa tubig sa baybayon pinaagi sa pagsala sa hugaw ug sobra nga sustansya sa dili pa kini moabot sa coral reef.

q: If an object is in free fall near Earth, how much does its speed increase every second?
options: 9.8 meters per second faster each second
1 meter per second faster each second
9.8 meters per second total, then it stops speeding up
98 meters per second faster each second
explanation: Because g = 9.8 m/s², a falling object speeds up by 9.8 meters per second with every second that passes.
fact_tl: Dahil sa g = 9.8 m/s², bumibilis ang isang bumabagsak na bagay nang 9.8 metro kada segundo bawat segundo.
fact_bis: Tungod sa g = 9.8 m/s², ang nahulog nga butang mopaspas ug 9.8 ka metro kada segundo matag segundo.

q: What is the capital city of Canada?
options: Ottawa
Toronto
Vancouver
Montreal
explanation: The capital of Canada is Ottawa, not Toronto, which is the largest city but not the capital.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Canada ay Ottawa (hindi Toronto).
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Canada mao ang Ottawa (dili Toronto).

q: What color does litmus paper turn when dipped in lemon juice?
options: Red
Blue
Green
Yellow
explanation: Litmus turns red in lemon juice because lemon juice is an acid, and acids cause litmus to turn red.
fact_tl: Ang litmus ay nagiging PULA sa katas ng limon dahil ito ay asido.
fact_bis: Ang litmus mahimong PULA sa duga sa limon kay asido kini.

q: On what date is the Pahiyas festival celebrated every year?
options: May 15
June 12
December 8
January 1
explanation: The Pahiyas festival is held every May 15, a colorful harvest celebration in Lucban, Quezon.
fact_tl: Ang Pahiyas ay ginaganap tuwing ika-15 ng Mayo.
fact_bis: Ang Pahiyas ginahimo matag ika-15 sa Mayo.

q: Which vitamin helps keep your eyes healthy and prevents night blindness?
options: Vitamin A
Vitamin C
Vitamin D
Vitamin B12
explanation: Vitamin A is essential for eye health and preventing night blindness; it is found in orange and yellow vegetables and fruits like squash and sweet potato.
fact_tl: Ang bitamina A ay mahalaga para sa kalusugan ng mga mata at maiwasan ang bulag-gabi (night blindness); makukuha ito sa mga oranhe at dilaw na gulay at prutas tulad ng kalabasa at kamote.
fact_bis: Ang bitamina A importante alang sa kahimsog sa mga mata ug paglikay sa gabi-gabi (night blindness); makita kini sa mga orange ug dilaw nga gulay ug prutas sama sa kalabasa ug kamote.

q: Is human blood acidic, neutral, or basic?
options: Slightly basic, with a pH of about 7.4
Slightly acidic, with a pH of about 6.8
Exactly neutral, with a pH of exactly 7.0
Strongly basic, with a pH of about 9.0
explanation: Human blood is slightly basic, with a pH of about 7.4, which is just above the neutral value of 7.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ng tao ay bahagyang base, na may pH na mga 7.4.
fact_bis: Ang dugo sa tawo gamay nga base, nga adunay pH nga mga 7.4.

q: In circular motion, what is the relationship between period and frequency?
options: They are inverses of each other — a longer period means a lower frequency
They are equal to each other when speed is constant
They add up to one when measured in the same units
Period measures distance while frequency measures time
explanation: The period is the time for one full revolution and the frequency is the number of revolutions per second, so the two are mathematical inverses of each other.
fact_tl: Ang period ay ang oras na inaabot para makaikot nang isang beses, samtang ang frequency ay kung ilang ikot ang nagagawa kada segundo — magkabaligtad ang dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang period mao ang panahon nga gikinahanglan aron makalibot makausa, samtang ang frequency mao kung pila ka libot ang mahimo kada segundo — magbaliktad ang duha.

q: Why does a hot air balloon rise into the sky?
options: The heated air inside becomes lighter than the cooler air outside, so it floats upward
The burner pushes the balloon up like a rocket engine
The balloon is filled with a gas lighter than air, like helium
Hot air expands and escapes through holes, pushing the balloon upward
explanation: When air inside the balloon is heated, its particles spread out and it becomes lighter than the surrounding cool air, causing the balloon to rise.
fact_tl: Kapag pinainit ang hangin sa loob ng isang malaking lobo, kumakalat ang mga particle nito at gumagaan ang hangin. Dahil mas magaan kaysa sa malamig na hangin sa paligid, umaakyat ang lobo. Ito ang prinsipyo ng hot air balloon.
fact_bis: Kung painiton ang hangin sa sulod sa dako nga lobo, mokatag ang mga partikulo niini ug mogaan ang hangin. Tungod kay mas gaan kini kaysa sa bugnaw nga hangin sa palibot, mosaka ang lobo. Mao kini ang prinsipyo sa hot air balloon.

q: Why can a glass crack when suddenly filled with boiling hot water?
options: Its parts expand unevenly because the heat reaches some parts before others
The water molecules hit the glass walls too hard and break them
Boiling water is heavier than cold water and creates too much pressure
The glass absorbs so much heat that its chemical bonds dissolve
explanation: A glass can crack when suddenly exposed to very hot or very cold liquid because different parts of the glass expand or contract unevenly, creating internal stress.
fact_tl: Maaaring mabasag ang baso kapag biglang binuhusan ng napakainit o napakalamig na tubig, dahil hindi pantay ang paglawak o pag-urong ng mga bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Mabuak ang baso kung kalit nga butangan ug init kaayo o bugnaw kaayo nga tubig, kay dili patas ang paglapad o pagkunhod sa mga bahin niini.

q: What is the chemical formula of ordinary table salt?
options: NaCl
KCl
NaOH
CaCl₂
explanation: The chemical formula of table salt is NaCl, representing one sodium (Na) atom bonded with one chlorine (Cl) atom.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng asin na pangkain (table salt) ay NaCl.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa asin nga pangkaon (table salt) kay NaCl.

q: In a circuit, conventional current flows from positive to negative. Which direction do electrons actually move?
options: From negative to positive — the opposite of conventional current
From positive to negative — the same as conventional current
In random directions depending on the material
From the middle of the circuit outward to both ends
explanation: Conventional current is treated as flowing from positive to negative, but electrons — the actual moving particles — flow from negative to positive, the opposite direction.
fact_tl: Nakakalito ito: ang 'conventional current' ay itinuturing na dumadaloy mula sa positibo papuntang negatibo ng baterya. Pero ang totoong gumagalaw — ang electron — ay dumadaloy sa kabaligtaran. Ginagamit pa rin natin ang lumang direksyon sa mga aralin dahil mas naunang itinakda.
fact_bis: Lisod ni: ang 'conventional current' giisip nga moagos gikan sa positibo paingon sa negatibo nga tumoy sa baterya. Apan ang tinuod nga molihok — ang electron — moagos sa kontra. Gigamit gihapon nato ang daang direksyon sa mga leksyon kay una kining gikasabotan.

q: How does an unglazed burnay jar keep water cool inside?
options: Water seeps through the walls and cools the inside as it evaporates outside
The thick clay walls block heat from the surrounding air
The clay absorbs heat from the water and stores it in its walls
The dark color of the clay reflects sunlight away from the jar
explanation: Many burnay jars have no shiny coating, so a little water seeps through their walls; as that water evaporates on the outside, it takes heat with it and cools the water inside.
fact_tl: Maraming burnay ay walang makintab na patong, kaya bahagyang tumatagos ang tubig sa pader nito. Pag sumisingaw ang tubig sa labas, lumalamig ang tubig na nasa loob.
fact_bis: Daghang burnay walay sinaw nga sapaw, mao nga gamay nga tubig motulo sa bungbong niini. Samtang mosingaw kanang tubiga sa gawas, mobugnaw ang tubig nga sulod.

q: What happens when you try to make soap lather in hard water?
options: It makes only a little foam because it does not lather well in hard water
It lathers just as well as in regular tap water
It lathers faster and creates more bubbles than usual
It turns the water a different color instead of forming bubbles
explanation: Soap does not lather well in hard water, producing only a little foam instead of the rich lather you would get in soft water.
fact_tl: Mahirap pabulain ang sabon sa matigas na tubig kaya kakaunti lang ang bula nito.
fact_bis: Lisod pabulahon ang sabon sa gahi nga tubig mao nga gamay ra og bula ang mahimo.

q: What wind speed range causes PAGASA to raise Typhoon Signal No. 1?
options: 39 to 61 km/h expected within 36 hours
62 to 88 km/h expected within 24 hours
89 to 117 km/h expected within 18 hours
118 km/h and above expected within 12 hours
explanation: PAGASA Signal No. 1, the lowest warning level, is raised for winds of 39 to 61 km/h expected within 36 hours.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA Signal No. 1, ang pinakamababa, ay itinataas para sa hanging 39 hanggang 61 km/h sa loob ng 36 oras.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA Signal No. 1, ang pinakaubos, gipataas alang sa hangin nga 39 hangtod 61 km/h sulod sa 36 ka oras.

q: About how long ago did the giant shark Megalodon go extinct?
options: About 3.6 million years ago
About 65 million years ago
About 10,000 years ago
About 500 million years ago
explanation: The Megalodon went extinct about 3.6 million years ago; it was a giant shark that could grow up to 17 meters long with teeth as large as a human hand.
fact_tl: Ang Megalodon ay isang napakalaking pating na naging extinct humigit kumulang 3.6 milyong taon na ang nakakaraan — ito ay pinakamataas na 17 metro ang haba at ang mga ngipin nito ay kasinlaki ng kamay ng isang tao.
fact_bis: Ang Megalodon usa ka napakalaking pating nga nahimong extinct mga 3.6 milyong tuig ang nakaagi — mahimong motubo kini og 17 metro ang gitas-on ug ang mga ngipon niini kasingdako sa kamot sa usa ka tawo.

q: What are the small brown dots found on the underside of fern leaves?
options: Spore cases called sori
Eggs of tiny leaf insects
Signs of a plant disease
Pores that release water vapor
explanation: The little brown dots on the underside of a fern leaf are spore cases called sori — they are not a disease but the fern's way of reproducing.
fact_tl: Kung makakita ka ng maliliit na kayumangging tuldok sa likod ng dahon ng pako, huwag matakot. Hindi iyon sakit kundi mga lalagyan ng spore na tinatawag na sori.
fact_bis: Kung makakita ka og gagmay nga brown nga tuldok sa likod sa dahon sa pako, ayaw kahadlok. Dili kana sakit kondili mga sudlanan sa spore nga gitawag og sori.

q: What is the chemical formula of hydrochloric acid?
options: HCl
H₂SO₄
HNO₃
H₂O₂
explanation: The chemical formula of hydrochloric acid is HCl, made of one hydrogen atom and one chlorine atom.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng hydrochloric acid ay HCl, isang hidroheno at isang klorin.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa hydrochloric acid kay HCl, usa ka hidroheno ug usa ka klorin.

q: Which signs suggest that a wound may be infected?
options: The wound becomes swollen, red, or has pus
The wound itches and forms a dry scab quickly
The wound turns pale and feels numb
The wound stops bleeding completely within a minute
explanation: Swelling, redness, or pus forming in a wound are signs that it may be infected and needs medical attention.
fact_tl: Kung ang sugat ay namamaga, pumupula, o may nana, maaaring ito ay nagkaimpeksiyon.
fact_bis: Kon ang samad mohubag, mapula, o adunay nana, mahimong kini natakdan ug impeksiyon.

q: What are the two main stages of photosynthesis?
options: The light reactions that capture energy, and the Calvin cycle that builds glucose
The dark reactions that capture sunlight, and the bright reactions that store sugar
The absorption stage in roots and the production stage in flowers
The water-splitting stage in leaves and the carbon release stage in roots
explanation: Photosynthesis has two stages: the light reactions that capture energy from sunlight, and the Calvin cycle that uses that energy to build glucose.
fact_tl: May dalawang yugto ang photosynthesis: ang light reactions na humuhuli ng enerhiya mula sa liwanag, at ang Calvin cycle na gumagamit ng enerhiyang iyon para gumawa ng glucose.
fact_bis: Ang photosynthesis adunay duha ka hugna: ang light reactions nga modakop sa enerhiya gikan sa kahayag, ug ang Calvin cycle nga mogamit niadtong enerhiya aron maghimo og glucose.

q: How does medical ultrasound create images of the inside of the body?
options: It sends high-frequency sound waves in and uses the echoes from different tissues to build images
It uses X-rays that pass through soft tissue and are blocked by hard organs
It measures the heat given off by organs to create a color map of the body
It uses radio waves that bounce off bones to produce a picture
explanation: Medical ultrasound sends high-frequency sound waves into the body and uses echoes returning from different tissues to build images of organs and unborn babies.
fact_tl: Ang medical ultrasound ay gumagamit ng mataas na frequency na sound waves na ipinapadala sa katawan — ang mga echo mula sa iba't ibang tissue ay ginagamit para gumawa ng imahe ng mga organ at sanggol sa sinapupunan.
fact_bis: Ang medical ultrasound nagapadala og taas nga frequency nga sound waves sa sulod sa lawas — ang mga echo gikan sa lain-laing tissue gigamit sa pagtukod og imahe sa mga organ ug wala pa matawo nga mga bata.

q: How does a stick insect breathe?
options: Through tiny holes along the sides of its body
Through a nose at the front of its head
Through gills on its back legs
Through its mouthparts when it eats
explanation: A stick insect has no nose or lungs; instead it breathes through tiny holes called spiracles along the sides of its body.
fact_tl: Walang ilong o baga ang stick insect tulad natin. Sa halip, humihinga ito sa pamamagitan ng maliliit na butas sa gilid ng katawan kung saan pumapasok ang hangin.
fact_bis: Ang stick insect walay ilong o baga sama kanato. Hinuon, moginhawa kini pinaagi sa gagmay nga lungag sa kilid sa lawas diin mosulod ang hangin.

q: Why does a bimetallic strip bend when it is heated?
options: Because one metal expands faster than the other, curving the strip
Because both metals shrink equally, squeezing the strip into a curve
Because the heat melts the glue holding the two metals together
Because the metals change color and one side becomes heavier
explanation: A bimetallic strip bends when heated because it is made of two metals that expand at different rates — the faster-expanding metal pushes the strip into a curve.
fact_tl: Ang bimetallic strip ay gawa sa dalawang magkaibang metal na nakadikit. Kapag uminit, ang isang metal ay nagpapalawak nang mas mabilis kaysa sa isa, kaya ang strip ay yumuko. Ito ang ginagamit sa ilang thermostat.
fact_bis: Ang bimetallic strip gawa sa duha ka lainlaing metal nga nagdugtong. Sa pag-init, ang usa ka metal nagpapalawak nga mas paspas kaysa sa usa pa, busa ang strip moliko. Kini gigamit sa pipila ka thermostat.

q: What are two typical properties of limestone?
options: It is usually white or grayish and soft enough to be cut or carved
It is usually black and extremely hard, like granite
It is usually red and crumbles into clay when wet
It is usually clear and as hard as glass
explanation: Limestone is usually white or grayish and is soft enough to be cut or carved easily, which is why it has been used as a building and carving material for thousands of years.
fact_tl: Karaniwang maputi o kulay-abuhin ang limestone at sapat itong malambot kaya madaling tabasin o ukitin.
fact_bis: Ang limestone kasagaran puti o abuhon ug humok-humok, busa sayon kining putlon o kulit-on.

q: What color are the newly sprouted leaves of a mango tree?
options: Reddish or copper-colored before turning green
Bright yellow before turning green
Pale white before turning green
Dark purple before turning green
explanation: Newly sprouted mango leaves are often reddish or copper-colored and gradually turn green as they mature.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagong sibol na dahon ng mangga ay madalas na mapula-pula o kulay-tanso bago maging berde.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong tubo nga dahon sa mangga kasagaran mapula-pula o kolor-tanso una mahimong lunhaw.

q: What do wasps and bees have in common that makes them both insects?
options: Each has three body parts, six legs, two pairs of wings, and antennae
Each has four body parts, eight legs, and no wings
Each has two body parts, four legs, and one pair of wings
Each has five body parts, ten legs, and three pairs of wings
explanation: Wasps and bees are both insects because each has three body parts, six legs, two pairs of wings, and antennae — the defining features of all insects.
fact_tl: Parehong insekto ang putakti at bubuyog: pareho silang may tatlong bahagi ng katawan, anim na paa, dalawang pares ng pakpak, at antena.
fact_bis: Pareho nga insekto ang putakti ug bubuyog: silang duha adunay tulo ka bahin sa lawas, unom ka tiil, duha ka paris nga pako, ug antena.

q: What does an inhaler do for a person with asthma?
options: It opens up the airways so breathing becomes easier
It kills the bacteria causing the infection in the lungs
It lowers body temperature to reduce fever
It absorbs extra mucus from the nose and throat
explanation: An inhaler is a medicine breathed in that opens up the airways and makes breathing easier for people with asthma.
fact_tl: Maraming taong may hika ang gumagamit ng inhaler, isang gamot na sinisinghot upang palawakin ang mga daluyan ng hangin at gawing madali ang paghinga.
fact_bis: Daghang tawo nga may asma naggamit og inhaler, usa ka tambal nga ginginhawa aron pahawanon ang mga agianan sa hangin ug pasayonon ang pagginhawa.

q: Why is a bigger magnet not always the strongest magnet?
options: Because a magnet's strength also depends on the material it is made of, not just its size
Because bigger magnets lose their magnetic pull more quickly over time
Because large magnets only attract iron while small ones attract all metals
Because the strength of a magnet depends only on its shape, not its size
explanation: A magnet's strength depends on the material it is made of, not size alone, so some small magnets can be stronger than big ones.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, mas malaki ang magnet, mas malakas. Hindi laging totoo iyon. May maliliit na magnet na mas malakas kaysa malalaki, dahil nakadepende rin ito sa klase ng materyal na ginamit, hindi lang sa laki.
fact_bis: Maghunahuna ang uban nga mas dako nga magnet mas kusog. Dili kana kanunay tinuod. Adunay gagmay nga magnet nga mas kusog kaysa dagko, kay ang kusog nagdepende usab sa klase sa materyal, dili lang sa kadako.

q: Why do we always see the same side of the Moon from Earth?
options: Because the Moon spins on its axis in the same time it takes to orbit Earth
Because the Moon does not spin on its axis at all
Because Earth's gravity has pulled the Moon flat on one side
Because the far side of the Moon is always in complete darkness
explanation: The Moon is tidally locked — it rotates once on its axis in the same time it takes to complete one orbit of Earth, so the same face always points toward us.
fact_tl: Nakikita natin ang iisang mukha ng Buwan dahil magkasing-tagal ang pag-ikot nito sa sarili at ang pag-ikot nito sa Earth (tidal locking).
fact_bis: Usa ra ka nawong sa Bulan ang atong makita kay parehas ra ang gidugayon sa pagtuyok niini sa kaugalingon ug sa paglibot sa Earth (tidal locking).

q: When corn is grilled over hot embers, how does the heat reach the corn even without the corn touching the flame?
options: Through hot air and radiation from the embers
Through conduction as the embers directly touch the corn
Through water vapor rising from the cooking surface
Through convection currents inside the corn itself
explanation: Heat from the embers travels to the corn through hot air (convection) and radiation, so the corn cooks even without touching the flame.
fact_tl: Kapag nag-iihaw ng mais sa tabing-kalsada, ang init mula sa baga ay lumilipat sa mais sa pamamagitan ng pag-init ng hangin at radiation, kaya naluluto ito kahit hindi sumasayad sa apoy.
fact_bis: Kon magsugba ug mais sa daplin sa dalan, ang init gikan sa baga mobalhin ngadto sa mais pinaagi sa init nga hangin ug radiation, mao nga maluto kini bisan dili modikit sa kalayo.

q: What happens when you touch your finger to a newborn baby's palm?
options: The baby grips your finger tightly all on its own
The baby pulls its hand away as a fear response
The baby's fingers spread wide open automatically
The baby's hand stays still because muscles are not developed yet
explanation: Babies are born with a grasping reflex — touching their palm makes them grip tightly without any conscious effort.
fact_tl: May mga reflex na taglay na ng sanggol pagkapanganak. Halimbawa, kapag idinampi mo ang daliri mo sa palad ng sanggol, kusa itong hahawak nang mahigpit.
fact_bis: Ang mga masuso adunay mga reflex nga dala na sukad pagkatawo. Pananglitan, kung ihikap nimo ang imong tudlo sa palad sa bata, kusog kini mogunit og hugot.

q: Which element makes up the greatest mass of the human body?
options: Oxygen
Carbon
Hydrogen
Nitrogen
explanation: Oxygen is the most abundant element in the human body by mass, mainly because our bodies are mostly water.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming element sa katawan ng tao (ayon sa bigat) ay oxygen, dahil ang karamihan sa atin ay tubig.
fact_bis: Ang labing daghang elemento sa lawas sa tawo (sumala sa gibug-aton) mao ang oxygen, kay halos tubig man ta.

q: How is pressure calculated?
options: Force divided by area
Force multiplied by area
Area divided by force
Force added to area
explanation: Pressure equals force divided by area and is measured in pascals (Pa).
fact_tl: Ang presyon ay ang puwersa na inilalapat sa bawat unit ng lawak — ito ay sinusukat sa pascal (Pa) at katumbas ng puwersa (N) hinati sa lawak (m²).
fact_bis: Ang presyon mao ang puwersa nga gibutang sa matag unit sa lawak — gisukat kini sa pascal (Pa) ug katumbas sa puwersa (N) gibahin sa lawak (m²).

q: What causes lightning inside a storm cloud?
options: Ice and water bits rubbing together build up charge until it suddenly jumps as a giant spark
Warm air rising rapidly heats the cloud until electricity bursts out
Two storm clouds crash into each other and release stored energy
Strong winds create friction against the ground that shoots sparks upward
explanation: Inside storm clouds, tiny ice and water bits rub together and build up charge; when there is too much charge, it discharges suddenly as lightning — just like a giant static spark.
fact_tl: Alam mo bang kapatid ng static ang kidlat? Sa loob ng malalaking ulap, naiipon ang napakaraming charge habang nagkukuskusan ang mga maliliit na yelo at tubig. Kapag sobra na, biglang tumatalon ang charge bilang kidlat, parang napakalaking spark.
fact_bis: Nahibal-an ba nimo nga paryente sa static ang kilat? Sulod sa dagkong panganod, daghang charge ang matigom samtang nagkuskos ang gagmay nga yelo ug tubig. Kung sobra na, kalit nga molukso ang charge isip kilat, sama sa dako kaayo nga spark.

q: Why can leaf-eating animals digest tough leaves even though the leaves are very hard to break down?
options: Tiny microbes living in their gut help break down the tough leaves
Their stomach acid is much stronger than that of meat-eating animals
They swallow small stones that grind the leaves inside their stomach
Their teeth are specially shaped to crush and dissolve leaf fibers completely
explanation: Tiny microbes in a leaf-eater's gut break down the tough plant material that the animal itself cannot digest on its own.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang mga maliliit na mikrobyo sa bituka ng leaf-eater para sirain ang matigas na dahon na hindi kayang tunawin mismo ng hayop.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga mga mikrobyo sa tinai sa leaf-eater motabang sa pagbungkag sa gahi nga dahon nga dili matunaw sa hayop mismo.

q: Why can invasive species cause native animals to go extinct?
options: They have no natural predators in the new place and out-compete native animals for food and habitat
They bring new diseases that only affect animals in cold climates
They eat only the plants that native animals depend on for shelter
They reproduce more slowly but live much longer than native species
explanation: Invasive species thrive because nothing hunts them in their new environment, allowing them to outcompete native animals for resources until the natives disappear.
fact_tl: Ang mga invasive species ay maaaring magtulak ng mga katutubong species patungo sa pagkamatay dahil walang natural na kaaway ang mga invasive species sa bagong lugar at maaari nilang mapigilan ang pagkain at tirahan ng mga katutubong hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga invasive species mahimong muduso sa mga katutubong species ngadto sa pagkapatay tungod kay wala silay natural nga mga kaaway sa bag-ong lugar ug mahimong mapildi ang mga katutubong hayop sa pagkaon ug tirahan.

q: What does a RORO ferry do in the Philippines?
options: It connects islands by sea, carrying people, vehicles, and cargo
It flies cargo between Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao
It is a kind of train that runs underwater through a tunnel between islands
It is a river barge that transports goods only within one island
explanation: RORO (roll-on/roll-off) ferries link Philippine islands by sea, transporting people, vehicles, and cargo from one island to another.
fact_tl: Ang RORO o roll-on/roll-off ferries ay nagkokonekta sa mga pulo ng Pilipinas sa pamamagitan ng dagat, nagdadala ng mga tao, sasakyan, at kargamento mula sa isang pulo patungo sa isa pa.
fact_bis: Ang RORO o roll-on/roll-off ferries nagkonekta sa mga pulo sa Pilipinas pinaagi sa dagat, nagdala sa mga tawo, sasakyan, ug kargamento gikan sa usa ka pulo ngadto sa isa pa.

q: What are the basic parts needed to make a simple worm bin?
options: A container with holes, damp paper bedding, worms, and food scraps
A sealed glass tank, dry sawdust, worms, and sugar
A plastic bucket, dry soil, worms, and cooked meat
An open wooden crate, wet sand, worms, and fish bones
explanation: A simple worm bin needs a container with holes for air and drainage, damp paper bedding, the worms themselves, and the food scraps they eat.
fact_tl: Ang simpleng worm bin ay may ilang bahagi: isang lalagyan na may maliliit na butas para makahinga at makaalis ang sobrang tubig, isang basa-basang higaan na gawa sa pinunit na papel, ang mga bulate, at ang mga tirang pagkain na kakainin nila.
fact_bis: Ang simpleng worm bin adunay pipila ka bahin: usa ka sudlanan nga adunay gagmayng lungag aron makasulod ang hangin ug makagawas ang sobrang tubig, basa-basa nga higdaanan gikan sa gisi nga papel, ang mga bulate, ug ang mga sobra nga pagkaon nga ilang kaonon.

q: Where was the coldest air temperature ever recorded on Earth?
options: Vostok Station in Antarctica
The summit of Mount Everest in Nepal
The North Pole in the Arctic Ocean
Oymyakon village in Siberia, Russia
explanation: The coldest recorded air temperature on Earth was -89.2°C, measured at Vostok Station in Antarctica.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamababang temperatura sa mundo na naitala ay -89.2°C, sa Vostok Station sa Antarctica.
fact_bis: Ang pinakaubos nga temperatura nga natala sa kalibutan mao ang -89.2°C, sa Vostok Station sa Antarctica.

q: Why are mud brick walls built thick or shaped into arches?
options: Because mud brick is very strong when squeezed but weak when pulled or stretched
Because mud brick expands when wet and thick walls prevent cracking
Because thick walls trap heat so the inside stays cool in any weather
Because mud brick dries slowly and thick walls give it more time to harden
explanation: Mud bricks have great compressive strength (resisting squeezing) but are weak in tension (resisting pulling), so they are shaped into arches or thick walls where they are always compressed.
fact_tl: Ang mga gusaling gawa sa putik o adobe ay gumagamit ng compressive strength ng lupa — ang mga brick ay napakalakas kapag pinipiga ngunit madali itong masira kapang hinihila.
fact_bis: Ang mga gusali nga gawa sa putik o adobe naggamit sa compressive strength sa yuta — ang mga brick napaka-lig-on kon pinindot apan mahuyang kon bawion, mao sila gilaraw ngadto sa mga arko o baga nga dingding.

q: What does the heat index measure?
options: How hot the body feels when both temperature and humidity are combined
The highest air temperature recorded in a place during a given day
The amount of rainfall expected based on wind speed and cloud cover
How quickly a body of water heats up in direct sunlight
explanation: The heat index combines temperature and humidity to show how hot the body actually feels, which can be much higher than the measured air temperature.
fact_tl: Ang heat index ay sumusukat ng temperatura na nararamdaman ng katawan kapag isinasaalang-alang ang humidity — sa tag-init ng Pilipinas, ang aktwal na temperatura ay maaaring 35°C ngunit ang heat index ay maaaring maging 42°C o mas mataas dahil sa mataas na humidity.
fact_bis: Ang heat index nagsukod sa temperatura nga kabati sa lawas kung ikonsidera ang humidity — sa tag-init sa Pilipinas, ang aktwal nga temperatura mahimong 35°C apan ang heat index mahimong moabot sa 42°C o mas taas tungod sa taas nga humidity.

q: How fast can the fastest-growing bamboo grow in a single day?
options: About 91 centimeters in one day
About 10 centimeters in one day
About 5 meters in one day
About 1 centimeter in one day
explanation: Some species of bamboo can grow up to about 91 centimeters in just one day, making bamboo among the fastest-growing plants on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang ilang uri ng kawayan ay maaaring tumubo ng hanggang mga 91 sentimetro sa loob lang ng isang araw.
fact_bis: Ang ubang klase sa kawayan makatubo ug hangtod mga 91 ka sentimetro sulod lang sa usa ka adlaw.

q: When you set 24°C on an air conditioner remote, what does that number mean?
options: It is the room temperature you want the air conditioner to stop cooling at
It is the temperature of the cold air blown out by the unit
It is the maximum safe temperature setting for the compressor
It is the outside temperature the unit will try to match indoors
explanation: The set temperature is the target room temperature — the air conditioner keeps cooling until the room reaches that level, then stops.
fact_tl: Ang numerong itinakda mo sa remote (halimbawa 24°C) ang gusto mong temperatura ng kwarto. Hindi ito ang lamig na binubuga ng aircon kundi ang antas na pag-abot, hihinto na ito. Parang sinasabi mo, 'Lamigin mo lang hanggang dito.'
fact_bis: Ang numero nga imong gi-set sa remote (pananglitan 24°C) mao ang temperatura sa kwarto nga imong gusto. Dili kini ang kabugnaw nga gibuga sa aircon kondili ang lebel nga kon maabot, mohunong na. Sama ra nga moingon ka, 'Bugnawa lang hangtod dinhi.'

q: Why does Plaster of Paris harden after you mix it with water?
options: It undergoes a chemical reaction where calcium sulfate absorbs water and recrystallizes into a hard solid
It loses water quickly to the air through evaporation, leaving dry particles behind
The water freezes inside the plaster and creates a rigid ice-like structure
Mixing stirs the particles so fast that friction heats and hardens them
explanation: Plaster of Paris hardens because calcium sulfate hemihydrate chemically absorbs water and recrystallizes into a new hard solid — a chemical change, not just drying.
fact_tl: Ang plaster ng Paris (gypsum) ay tumitigas kapag hinaluan ng tubig dahil ang calcium sulfate ay sumasansod ng tubig at nagre-recrystallize sa pamamagitan ng chemical reaction.
fact_bis: Ang plaster of Paris (gypsum) nagtigas kon itrono sa tubig tungod kay ang calcium sulfate hemihydrate nagsipsip sa tubig ug nagre-recrystallize ngadto sa matigas nga solid pinaagi sa chemical reaction.

q: How does carbon from the air enter living things?
options: Plants absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis and turn it into sugar
Animals breathe in carbon dioxide and store it in their bones
Rainwater dissolves carbon from soil and carries it into plant roots
Fungi release carbon into the air where animals can absorb it through their skin
explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide during photosynthesis and use the Sun's energy to convert it into sugar, which is how carbon first enters living organisms.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, kinukuha ng mga halaman ang carbon dioxide mula sa hangin at ginagamit ang enerhiya ng araw para gawin itong sugar (pagkain). Sa ganitong paraan pumapasok ang carbon sa mga buhay na bagay.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa photosynthesis, ang mga tanom mokuha sa carbon dioxide gikan sa hangin ug mogamit sa enerhiya sa adlaw aron himoon kining sugar (pagkaon). Niini nga paagi mosulod ang carbon sa mga buhing butang.

q: Who is called the father of the computer?
options: Charles Babbage
Alan Turing
Ada Lovelace
Nikola Tesla
explanation: Charles Babbage designed the first mechanical computer and is therefore called the father of the computer.
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang nagdisenyo ng unang mekanikal na kompyuter at tinawag na ama ng kompyuter.
fact_bis: Si Charles Babbage ang nagdesinyo sa unang mekanikal nga kompyuter ug gitawag nga amahan sa kompyuter.

q: What gas do plants take in from the air during photosynthesis?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Water vapor
explanation: During photosynthesis, plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and use it to make food.
fact_tl: Sa potosintesis, sinisipsip ng mga halaman ang carbon dioxide sa hangin upang gawing pagkain.
fact_bis: Sa potosintesis, ang mga tanom magsuyop sa carbon dioxide gikan sa hangin aron mahimong pagkaon.

q: Why do grasslands have fewer large trees than forests?
options: Grasslands receive less rain, so there is not enough water for many large trees to grow
Grassland soil is too thin to support the deep roots of large trees
Large trees are eaten by grazing animals before they can grow tall
The wind in open grasslands breaks the trunks of trees before they mature
explanation: Grasslands get less rainfall than forests, which means there is insufficient water to support the growth of many large trees.
fact_tl: Ang grassland ay tumatanggap ng mas kaunting ulan kaysa sa gubat, kaya hindi sapat ang tubig para sa maraming malalaking puno.
fact_bis: Ang grassland makadawat og mas gamay nga ulan kaysa sa lasang, mao nga dili igo ang tubig alang sa daghang dagkong kahoy nga motubo.

q: What is a chemical indicator used for?
options: To show whether a liquid is an acid or a base by changing color
To measure the exact temperature of a liquid when heated
To test whether a solid can dissolve in water
To reveal the presence of oxygen gas in a container
explanation: An indicator is a chemical that changes color in the presence of an acid or a base, allowing us to identify which type of substance a liquid is.
fact_tl: Ang isang indicator ay isang kemikal na nagbabago ng kulay para ipakita kung asido o base ang isang likido.
fact_bis: Ang indicator usa ka kemikal nga mag-usab og kolor aron ipakita kung asido o base ang usa ka likido.

q: Who was the second President of the Philippines?
options: Manuel L. Quezon
Sergio Osmeña
Emilio Aguinaldo
Jose P. Laurel
explanation: Manuel L. Quezon served as the second President of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Si Manuel L. Quezon ang pangalawang Pangulo ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Si Manuel L. Quezon ang ikaduhang Presidente sa Pilipinas.

q: Who created the Saffir-Simpson scale used to measure hurricane strength?
options: Herbert Saffir, an engineer, and Robert Simpson, a meteorologist
Robert Saffir, a meteorologist, and Herbert Simpson, a physicist
Francis Beaufort and George Fujita, both oceanographers
Theodore Saffir and William Simpson, both storm chasers
explanation: The Saffir-Simpson scale is named after Herbert Saffir (engineer) and Robert Simpson (meteorologist), who developed it together.
fact_tl: Ang Saffir-Simpson scale ay ipinangalan kina Herbert Saffir, isang inhinyero, at Robert Simpson, isang meteorologo, na gumawa nito.
fact_bis: Ang Saffir-Simpson scale ginganlan sunod kang Herbert Saffir, usa ka inhenyero, ug Robert Simpson, usa ka meteorologo, nga naghimo niini.

q: Which insect is known for having one of the shortest adult lifespans, often living only about one day?
options: The mayfly
The housefly
The monarch butterfly
The dragonfly
explanation: The adult mayfly lives for only about one day, giving it one of the shortest adult lifespans of any animal.
fact_tl: Ang adult mayfly ay may isa sa pinakamaikling buhay, na karaniwang umaabot lamang ng mga isang araw.
fact_bis: Ang adult mayfly adunay usa sa labing mubo nga kinabuhi, kasagaran mabuhi lang og mga usa ka adlaw.

q: In the deep sea where sunlight cannot reach, where does the only light come from?
options: From light produced by the animals themselves
From glowing minerals on the ocean floor
From the glow of hot underwater volcanoes
From light that filters down from the surface during storms
explanation: In the deep sea there is no sunlight, so the only light available comes from animals that produce their own light (bioluminescence).
fact_tl: Sa malalim na bahagi ng dagat ay walang sikat ng araw, kaya ang sariling ilaw ng mga hayop ang tanging liwanag doon.
fact_bis: Sa lawom nga bahin sa dagat walay silaw sa adlaw, busa ang kaugalingong kahayag sa mga mananap mao ra ang kahayag didto.

q: What is special about the inner wood of the narra tree?
options: It has a beautiful reddish color often used in furniture
It is extremely light and used to make small boats
It releases a sweet sap used as a natural medicine
It is completely white and is the hardest wood in the Philippines
explanation: The inner heartwood of the narra tree has a reddish color that is prized for its beauty in furniture making.
fact_tl: Ang loob na kahoy ng narra ay may mapula-pulang kulay na maganda sa muwebles.
fact_bis: Ang sulod nga kahoy sa narra adunay mapula-pula nga kolor nga nindot sa muwebles.

q: Where in the Philippines is Barako coffee most famous?
options: Batangas and Cavite
Benguet and Mountain Province
Davao and Cotabato
Cebu and Bohol
explanation: Barako coffee, a Liberica variety, is the coffee most famous in Batangas and Cavite in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Kapeng Barako ay isang uri ng kape (Liberica) na kilala sa Batangas at Cavite sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Kapeng Barako usa ka klase sa kape (Liberica) nga bantog sa Batangas ug Cavite sa Pilipinas.

q: What shape is a jackfruit seed?
options: Oval and slightly rounded, about the size of a large date
Long and thin like a bean pod
Flat and wide like a pumpkin seed
Round like a marble
explanation: A jackfruit seed is oval and slightly rounded, roughly the size of a large date or olive.
fact_tl: Ang buto ng langka ay hugis-itlog at bahagyang bilog, kasinglaki ng malaking date o olive.
fact_bis: Ang liso sa nangka oval ug medyo lingin, kasing dako sa usa ka dako nga date o olive.

q: What keeps the planets moving in their orbits around the Sun?
options: The Sun's very strong gravity pulls on the planets and keeps them in orbit
The planets are pushed along by solar wind blowing from the Sun
Each planet has magnetic poles that lock it onto a path around the Sun
The planets ride along a belt of dust and rocks that circles the Sun
explanation: The Sun's very strong gravitational pull holds the planets and keeps them orbiting around it.
fact_tl: Ang napakalakas na grabidad ng Araw ang humihila sa mga planeta para umikot ang mga ito sa paligid nito.
fact_bis: Ang kusog kaayo nga grabidad sa Adlaw maoy nagbira sa mga planeta aron motuyok kini libot niini.

q: How do birds prepare their bodies for a long migration trip?
options: They eat a lot beforehand to store fat that they use as energy during the trip
They drink large amounts of water to stay hydrated throughout the journey
They grow extra feathers to keep warm and reduce the energy needed to fly
They migrate only in groups so each bird uses less energy by following the one ahead
explanation: Before migrating, birds eat a lot to build up fat reserves, which they burn as energy fuel during the long journey.
fact_tl: Bago lumipat, kumakain nang marami ang mga ibon upang mag-imbak ng taba na gagamitin nilang lakas sa mahabang biyahe.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa mobalhin, mokaon ug daghan ang mga langgam aron motigom ug tambok nga gamiton nilang kusog sa taas nga biyahe.

q: Besides your genes (DNA), what else can affect a trait like your height?
options: The food you eat and how much you exercise
The color of your eyes and the shape of your ears
The country you were born in and the language you speak
The time of day you were born and the season of the year
explanation: Traits like height are shaped by both genes and environmental factors such as nutrition and exercise, which is why even identical twins can end up slightly different.
fact_tl: Hindi lang DNA ang gumagawa ng kung ano ka. Halimbawa, ang taas mo ay naiimpluwensyahan ng iyong gene, pero gayundin ng pagkain at ehersisyo. Kaya kahit pareho ang DNA ng kambal, maaari silang magkaroon ng kaunting pagkakaiba.
fact_bis: Dili lang DNA ang naghimo kung kinsa ka. Pananglitan, ang imong gitas-on naimpluwensyahan sa imong gene, apan ingon man sa pagkaon ug ehersisyo. Mao nga bisan parehas ang DNA sa kaluha, mahimo silang adunay gamayng kalainan.

q: How does canning keep food safe from spoiling?
options: The food is heated to kill microbes and then sealed tightly so new microbes cannot enter
The food is frozen inside the can to stop microbe growth completely
Salt is added to the can to dehydrate any microbes present
The metal of the can reacts with the food to create a natural preservative
explanation: Canning preserves food by heating it to kill microbes and then sealing the container so no new microbes can get in.
fact_tl: Sa de-latang pagkain, iniinit ito upang patayin ang mikrobyo, pagkatapos ay isasara nang mahigpit para walang makapasok.
fact_bis: Sa de lata nga pagkaon, kini initon aron patyon ang mikrobyo, dayon selyohan og hugot aron walay makasulod.

q: What causes the vision damage in glaucoma?
options: Increased pressure inside the eye damages the optic nerve
A virus attacking the lens of the eye makes it cloudy and opaque
Lack of vitamin A causes the retina to slowly break down
Too much exposure to bright light burns away the sensitive cells at the back of the eye
explanation: In glaucoma, increased pressure inside the eye presses on and damages the optic nerve, which can lead to blindness if not caught early.
fact_tl: Ang glaucoma ay isang sakit ng mata na kung saan ang pagtaas ng presyon sa loob ng mata ay nagpipinsala sa optic nerve at maaaring magdulot ng bulag; ang maagang pagtuklas sa pamamagitan ng regular na eye check ay mahalaga.
fact_bis: Ang glaucoma usa ka sakit sa mata diin ang pagtaas sa presyon sa sulod sa mata nagpinsala sa optic nerve ug mahimong hinungdan sa pagkabulag; ang sayo nga pag-ila pinaagi sa regular nga eye check-up importante.

q: Which tube carries urine from the kidney to the bladder?
options: The ureter
The urethra
The urinary sphincter
The renal vein
explanation: Urine travels from the kidney to the bladder through a tube called the ureter.
fact_tl: Dumadaloy ang ihi mula sa bato papunta sa pantog sa pamamagitan ng tubo na tinatawag na ureter.
fact_bis: Ang ihi modagayday gikan sa kidney paingon sa pantog pinaagi sa tubo nga gitawag og ureter.

q: What does a convex lens actually do to light?
options: It gathers and concentrates light that comes from another source — it does not create light itself
It produces new light by converting heat from the sun into visible rays
It blocks harmful rays from a light source and only passes safe light through
It spreads light out evenly so a wider area is lit up
explanation: A convex lens only bends and concentrates light from an existing source like the sun or a lamp; it makes no light of its own.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na ang convex lens mismo ang gumagawa ng liwanag o init — pero hindi. Hindi ito nagbubuga ng sariling liwanag; tinitipon lang nito ang liwanag na galing sa ibang pinagmulan tulad ng araw o ilaw, at doon nagmumukhang matindi.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang convex lens mismo ang naghimo sa kahayag o kainit — apan dili. Wala kini kaugalingong kahayag; gitigom lang niini ang kahayag nga gikan sa laing tinubdan sama sa adlaw o suga, ug gipakusog kini.

q: Why do cracks in dry ground often form blocky six-sided or four-sided shapes?
options: The soil pulls inward evenly on all sides as it dries, so it breaks into neat blocky pieces
Strong winds push the surface soil in opposite directions, tearing it into strips
Heavy rain had pressed the soil into layers that separate into blocks when they dry
Roots from dead plants left behind a grid of channels that crack along the same lines
explanation: As soil dries, it contracts evenly in all directions, causing it to break into neat polygon-shaped pieces like a mosaic.
fact_tl: Ang mga bitak sa tuyong lupa ay madalas na hugis tulad ng maraming maliliit na hugis-anim o hugis-apat na nagdidikit. Nangyari ito dahil ang lupa ay humihila pababa nang pantay-pantay sa lahat ng panig, kaya nahahati ito sa malilinis na piraso.
fact_bis: Ang mga liki sa mala nga yuta kasagaran og porma sama sa daghang gagmay nga unom-ka-kilid o upat-ka-kilid nga magtapad. Nahitabo kini kay ang yuta mobira paingon sa sulod nga patas sa tanang kilid, mao nga mabahin kini og hinlo nga mga piraso.

q: What does a crab do just before it molts (sheds its shell)?
options: It stops eating and becomes much less active while its body prepares for the molt
It eats more than usual to build up energy reserves for growing the new shell
It buries itself in sand and generates heat to loosen the old shell
It fights aggressively to defend its territory before becoming vulnerable
explanation: Before molting, a crab stops eating and becomes much less active while its body prepares to shed the old shell and form a new one.
fact_tl: Bago mag-molt, madalas tumitigil sa pagkain at hindi masyadong gumagalaw ang alimango habang naghahanda ang katawan nito na alisin ang lumang balat at gumawa ng bago.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mag-molt, ang alimango kasagaran moundang sa pagkaon ug dili kaayo molihok samtang mangandam ang lawas niini sa pagtangtang sa daan nga panit ug paghimo og bag-o sa ilalom.

q: How many laws of motion did Isaac Newton write?
options: Three
Two
Four
Five
explanation: Isaac Newton wrote exactly three laws of motion, which describe how objects move and respond to forces.
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay gumawa ng tatlong (3) batas ng galaw (laws of motion).
fact_bis: Si Isaac Newton naghimo ug tulo (3) ka balaod sa lihok (laws of motion).

q: What is the national gem of the Philippines?
options: The South Sea pearl
Gold
Agate
Topaz
explanation: The South Sea pearl is the national gem of the Philippines and a source of national pride.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may ilang natural na mahahalagang bato: ang South Sea pearl (perlas) ay ang pambansang pahiyas at ipinagmamalaki ng Pilipinas; ang ginto ay ginagamit para gumawa ng alahas, at ang mga mineral tulad ng agate at topaz ay natutuklasan sa ilang bahagi ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay pipila ka natural nga bililhon nga mga bato: ang South Sea pearl (perlas) mao ang national gem ug garbo sa Pilipinas; ang bulawan gigamit sa paghimo og alahas, ug ang mga mineral sama sa agate ug topaz nakit-an sa pipila ka bahin sa nasod.

q: Why does okoy (shrimp-and-vegetable fritter) become crispy when cooked?
options: Very hot oil dries out the outside of the fritter quickly, making it crispy
The batter contains baking soda that makes it puff up and harden
Cold water is added to the batter right before frying to create a crunch
The shrimp shells melt together with the batter to form a hard crust
explanation: Okoy is cooked in very hot oil, which rapidly removes moisture from the outside of the fritter and makes it crispy.
fact_tl: Ang okoy ay piniritong hipon at gulay na inilubog sa napakainit na mantika, na nagpapatuyo sa labas kaya ito nagiging malutong.
fact_bis: Ang okoy usa ka prito nga hipon ug utanon nga giluto sa init kaayo nga mantika, nga magpauga sa gawas mao nga mahimong kuyamis.

q: What is the name of the part of a sundial that blocks the sunlight and casts a shadow?
options: The gnomon
The dial plate
The style marker
The shadow fin
explanation: The standing piece on a sundial that blocks the sun and casts the shadow used to tell time is called the gnomon.
fact_tl: Ang patindog na bahagi ng sundial na pumipigil sa araw at gumagawa ng anino ay tinatawag na gnomon.
fact_bis: Ang nagtindog nga bahin sa sundial nga nagbabag sa adlaw ug naghimo sa anino gitawag og gnomon.

q: How does turning off lights and appliances you are not using help the environment?
options: It saves energy and reduces money spent on electricity
It prevents electrical wires from overheating and causing fires
It extends the lifespan of the appliances by reducing wear
It lowers the room temperature because appliances give off heat
explanation: Turning off unused lights and appliances saves energy, reduces electricity bills, and helps protect the environment.
fact_tl: Makakatulong tayo sa kapaligiran at makakatipid kapag pinapatay natin ang ilaw at gamit na hindi ginagamit.
fact_bis: Makatabang ta sa kalikopan ug makatipig kung patyon nato ang suga ug mga gamit nga wala gigamit.

q: Why is Mount Banahaw sometimes called the 'Holy Mountain'?
options: It is a site of faith and pilgrimage for many Filipinos
It is where the Philippine national flag was first raised
It has a church carved inside a natural cave near the summit
It is home to a famous Catholic shrine built by Spanish missionaries
explanation: Mount Banahaw on the Quezon-Laguna border is a dormant volcano revered as a sacred site and pilgrimage destination for many Filipinos.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Banahaw sa hangganan ng Quezon at Laguna ay isang dormant na bulkan na tinatawag ding 'Banal na Bundok'; ito ay lugar ng pananampalataya at romeria ng maraming Filipino.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Banahaw sa hangganan sa Quezon ug Laguna usa ka dormant nga bulkan nga gitawag usab nga 'Banal nga Bundok'; puy-anan kini sa pagtoo ug romeria sa daghang Pilipino.

q: Why do quartz crystals and snowflakes both have a six-sided (hexagonal) shape?
options: The way their atoms arrange themselves inside creates a six-sided structure
Six sides are the strongest shape in nature, so minerals naturally grow that way
They both form near water, which forces minerals to grow in even six-sided rings
Cold temperatures always cause all minerals to form six-sided crystals
explanation: Quartz and snowflakes form hexagonal crystals because of how their atoms are arranged internally — the atomic structure dictates the six-sided shape.
fact_tl: Ang quartz at mga snowflake ay bumubuo ng hexagonal (anim na gilid) na mga kristal. Ang hugis na ito ay nagmumula sa paraan ng pag-aayos ng mga atom sa loob ng mineral.
fact_bis: Ang quartz ug mga snowflake nagbuhat og hexagonal (anim ka kilid) nga mga kristal. Kining hugis gikan sa paagi sa pag-aayos sa mga atom sulod sa mineral.

q: What is kamias (bilimbi) most known for in Filipino cooking?
options: Its very sour taste, used to add sourness to dishes like sinigang
Its sweetness, used as a natural sugar substitute in desserts
Its bright red color, used to give dishes a deep reddish hue
Its thick skin, which is dried and used as a natural flavoring wrap
explanation: Kamias is a very sour green fruit that grows in clusters and is used to add a sour taste to Filipino dishes such as sinigang.
fact_tl: Ang kamias ay isang berde at napakaasim na prutas na tumutubo nang sama-sama sa sanga, at ginagamit itong pampaasim sa mga lutong gaya ng sinigang.
fact_bis: Ang kamias usa ka berde ug aslom kaayo nga prutas nga motubo nga nagpundok sa sanga, ug gigamit kini aron paaslomon ang mga pagkaon sama sa sinigang.

q: What does blinking do for your eyes?
options: It spreads tears across the eye to keep it wet and clean
It focuses light more sharply onto the back of the eye
It protects the eye by making the pupil smaller in bright light
It pumps extra blood to the eye muscles so they do not get tired
explanation: Each time we blink, tears are spread across the surface of the eye, keeping it moist and washing away dust or dirt.
fact_tl: Kapag kumukurap tayo, naghahalo ng luha sa ibabaw ng mata para manatili itong basa at malinis.
fact_bis: Kon mopilok ta, mokatag ang luha sa ibabaw sa mata aron magpabilin kining basa ug hinlo.

q: Besides the joule, which unit is commonly used to measure the energy in food?
options: Calorie
Watt
Newton
Volt
explanation: Food energy is commonly measured in calories (as well as joules in scientific contexts).
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya sa pagkain ay madalas sukatin sa calorie (kaloriya), bukod sa joule.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya sa pagkaon kasagarang sukdon sa calorie (kaloriya), gawas sa joule.

q: Why is the carabao called a herbivore?
options: Because it eats only plants such as grass
Because it lives near water and eats fish
Because it eats both plants and small animals
Because it drinks milk from other large animals
explanation: The carabao is a herbivore because it eats grass and other plants — no meat at all.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay isang hayop na kumakain ng damo, kaya ito ay tinatawag na herbivore o halamang-kumakain.
fact_bis: Ang kalabaw usa ka mananap nga mokaon ug sagbot, busa gitawag kini nga herbivore o tanom-kaon.

q: What does the 'grade' of an ore tell us?
options: How much metal is inside it
How deep underground it was found
How hard it is to cut or break
How old the rock layer is
explanation: The grade of an ore tells how much metal is inside it — high-grade ore has a lot of metal and is more worth mining.
fact_tl: Ang 'grade' ng isang ore ay tumutukoy kung gaano karaming metal ang nasa loob nito. Ang high-grade ore ay maraming metal kaya mas sulit minahan, habang ang low-grade ore ay konti lang ang metal.
fact_bis: Ang 'grade' sa usa ka ore nagpasabot kung pila ka metal ang anaa sa sulod niini. Ang high-grade nga ore adunay daghang metal busa mas takos mineron, samtang ang low-grade nga ore gamay ra ang metal.

q: Which unit is the official SI base unit for measuring temperature?
options: Kelvin (K)
Celsius (°C)
Fahrenheit (°F)
Joule (J)
explanation: The kelvin (K) is the SI base unit used to measure temperature, not Celsius or Fahrenheit.
fact_tl: Ang kelvin (K) ang SI base unit na ginagamit para sukatin ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Ang kelvin (K) mao ang SI base unit nga gigamit sa pagsukod sa temperatura.

q: Where is Mount Apo, the highest mountain in the Philippines, located?
options: Mindanao
Luzon
Visayas
Palawan
explanation: Mount Apo is found in Mindanao and is the highest mountain in the Philippines, showing that Philippine islands are not all flat.
fact_tl: Hindi patag lang ang mga pulo ng Pilipinas; marami ring matataas na bundok dito, tulad ng Mount Apo sa Mindanao na pinakamataas na bundok ng bansa. Ang mga bundok ay nabuo kasabay ng mga pulo.
fact_bis: Dili tanan patag ang mga isla sa Pilipinas; daghan usab og tag-as nga bukid diri, sama sa Mount Apo sa Mindanao nga mao ang pinakataas nga bukid sa nasod. Ang mga bukid naporma uban sa mga isla.

q: Which space probes, launched in 1977, are the farthest-traveling human-made objects?
options: Voyager 1 and Voyager 2
Apollo 11 and Apollo 13
Hubble Space Telescope
Pioneer 10 and Pioneer 11
explanation: Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 were launched in 1977 and are the farthest-traveling human-made objects, having flown close to the outer giant planets.
fact_tl: Ang Voyager 1 at Voyager 2 ay mga space probe na inilunsad noong 1977; sila ang mga gawa ng tao na umabot sa pinakamalayo, at lumipad sila malapit sa malalaking planeta sa labas ng ating Solar System.
fact_bis: Ang Voyager 1 ug Voyager 2 mga space probe nga gilunsad niadtong 1977; sila ang labing layo nga nakaabot nga mga binuhat sa tawo, ug milupad sila duol sa dagkong mga planeta sa gawas sa atong Solar System.

q: Why is vaping considered harmful to health?
options: Its vapor contains nicotine and other chemicals that harm the lungs
It uses too much electricity and wastes energy
The vapor makes the skin dry and itchy
The smell causes headaches but does not harm lungs
explanation: Vaping is not safe because its vapor contains nicotine and other chemicals that harm the lungs.
fact_tl: Ang vaping ay hindi ligtas; ang singaw nito ay may nikotina at iba pang kemikal na nakakasama sa baga.
fact_bis: Ang vaping dili luwas; ang alisngaw niini adunay nikotina ug uban pang kemikal nga makadaot sa baga.

q: Why does the Philippines often experience earthquakes and volcanic eruptions?
options: It sits on plate boundaries in the Pacific Ring of Fire
It is located near the equator where the Earth is hottest
Its islands are made mostly of loose volcanic soil
Heavy monsoon rains weaken the ground and cause tremors
explanation: The Philippines sits on plate boundaries in the Pacific Ring of Fire, which causes frequent earthquakes and volcanic activity.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nasa hangganan ng mga plaka sa Pacific Ring of Fire, kaya madalas itong magkaroon ng lindol at bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas naa sa utlanan sa mga plaka sa Pacific Ring of Fire, mao nga kanunay kini mag-antos og linog ug bulkan.

q: What do pufferfish use their hard, beak-like teeth for?
options: To crack open shells and crabs
To tear apart seaweed and kelp
To grind small sand grains for minerals
To bite predators that try to eat them
explanation: The pufferfish has hard, beak-like teeth it uses to crack open shells and crabs.
fact_tl: Ang butete ay may matigas na ngiping parang tuka na ginagamit nito para basagin ang kabibe at alimango.
fact_bis: Ang butete adunay gahi nga ngipon nga morag sungo nga gamiton niini sa pagbungkag og kabibe ug alimango.

q: Why are many sharks around the world in danger of disappearing?
options: They are caught too much, especially for their fins
Pollution has destroyed most of their coral reef homes
Their prey fish have all been eaten up by humans
Rising ocean temperatures make them too sick to reproduce
explanation: Many sharks are in danger because they are caught too much, especially for their fins.
fact_tl: Maraming pating sa mundo ang nanganganib dahil sobra silang hinuhuli, lalo na para sa kanilang mga palikpik.
fact_bis: Daghang iho sa kalibotan ang namiligro tungod kay sobra silang gipangdakop, ilabi na para sa ilang mga kapikas.

q: What does a startled shrimp do to escape danger quickly?
options: It darts backward by flicking its tail
It squirts ink to confuse the predator
It puffs up its body to look bigger
It digs into the sand to hide
explanation: When startled, a shrimp suddenly darts backward by quickly flicking its tail.
fact_tl: Ang hipon (shrimp) ay maliit na krustaseo na may mahahabang sungot (antennae) at mga paa para lumangoy. Pag natatakot, biglang lumalangoy ito paatras sa pamamagitan ng mabilis na pagpaspas ng buntot.
fact_bis: Ang hipon (shrimp) usa ka gamay nga crustacean nga adunay tag-as nga sungot (antennae) ug mga tiil para molangoy. Kung makuratan, kalit kini molangoy paatras pinaagi sa paspas nga pagpaypay sa iyang ikog.

q: Which of the following correctly describes the different growth forms lichens can have?
options: Some look like a crust, some like leaves, and some like tiny branches
Some float on water, some grow underground, and some live on animals
Some are soft and mossy, some are spiky like cactus, and some are flat discs
Some glow at night, some change color in sunlight, and some release spores visibly
explanation: Lichens come in three main forms: crust-like, leaf-like, and tiny branch-like structures.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang hugis ang lichen: ang iba ay parang patong na balat, ang iba ay parang dahon, at ang iba ay parang maliliit na sanga.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing porma ang lichen: ang uban morag nipis nga panit, ang uban morag dahon, ug ang uban morag gagmayng sanga.

q: About how long does it take from one high tide to the next?
options: About 12 hours and 25 minutes
Exactly 12 hours
About 24 hours
About 6 hours
explanation: The time from one high tide to the next is about 12 hours and 25 minutes.
fact_tl: Ang agwat mula sa isang mataas na taog patungo sa susunod ay mga 12 oras at 25 minuto.
fact_bis: Ang gilay-on gikan sa usa ka taas nga taob ngadto sa sunod mga 12 ka oras ug 25 ka minuto.

q: Why is it helpful to talk to someone you trust about how you feel?
options: It helps you feel lighter and work through your problems
It makes others feel responsible for fixing your problems
It stops your brain from thinking about problems at all
It distracts you so you forget what was bothering you
explanation: Talking to someone you trust about your feelings helps you feel lighter and work through your problems.
fact_tl: Ang pakikipag-usap sa mapagkakatiwalaang tao tungkol sa nararamdaman mo ay nakakatulong magaan ang loob at malutas ang problema.
fact_bis: Ang pakigsulti sa tawo nga imong masaligan bahin sa imong gibati makatabang nga mogaan ang imong gibati ug masulbad ang problema.

q: What do the tiny hairs called cilia inside the nose do?
options: They constantly sweep mucus and dirt out of the body
They warm the incoming air before it reaches the lungs
They sense different smells by catching odor particles
They make the mucus that traps dust and germs
explanation: Tiny hairs called cilia inside the nose constantly sweep mucus and dirt out of the body.
fact_tl: May napakaliliit na buhok na tinatawag na cilia sa loob ng ilong na patuloy na nagtutulak ng uhog at dumi palabas.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay kaayo nga balhibo nga gitawag ug cilia sulod sa ilong nga padayon nga nagtulod sa sip-on ug hugaw pagawas.

q: What is true about the idea that your eyes could pop out if you sneeze with them open?
options: It is a myth; your eyes are held safely in place and will not fall out from a sneeze
It is true; sneezing creates enough pressure to push the eyes forward
It only happens if you sneeze very forcefully more than five times in a row
It could happen, but the eyelids close automatically to prevent it
explanation: This is a myth — your eyes are held safely in place and will not fall out just from a sneeze.
fact_tl: May maling akala na pwedeng lumuwa ang mata mo kapag bumahing ka nang nakadilat. Hindi ito totoo; ligtas na nakakabit ang mga mata mo at hindi sila matatanggal dahil lang sa isang bahing.
fact_bis: Adunay sayop nga pagtuo nga mahimong moluwa ang imong mata kung mobahin ka nga abli. Dili kini tinuod; luwas nga nakakabit ang imong mga mata ug dili kini matangtang tungod ra sa usa ka bahin.

q: What happens to the spines on some pufferfish when they puff up?
options: The spines stick out from their skin
The spines fold flat against their body
The spines fall off and grow back later
The spines change color to warn predators
explanation: Some pufferfish have spines that stick out from their skin when they puff up, making them harder to swallow.
fact_tl: May mga butete na lumalabas ang mga tinik sa balat nito kapag namamaga.
fact_bis: Adunay mga butete nga mogawas ang mga tunok sa panit niini kung kini maghubag.

q: What happens to a host cell at the end of the lytic cycle?
options: It bursts open and releases new viruses
It repairs itself and fights off the virus
It divides into two new healthy cells
It shrinks and becomes inactive but stays intact
explanation: In the lytic cycle, a virus makes many copies of itself inside the host cell and then bursts it open to release new viruses.
fact_tl: Sa lytic cycle, ang isang virus ay pumapasok sa isang host cell, ginagamit ang makinarya ng selula para gumawa ng maraming kopya ng sarili nito, at pagkatapos ay sinisira ang selula upang makalabas.
fact_bis: Sa lytic cycle, ang usa ka virus mosulod sa usa ka host cell, mogamit sa makinarya sa selula aron makagama og daghang kopya sa kaugalingon, ug dayon mapabuto ang selula aron makagawas ang mga bag-ong virus.

q: What is the meaning of reforestation?
options: Planting trees again in an area that lost its forest
Protecting an existing forest from being cut down
Moving animals back into areas where they went extinct
Cleaning a forest floor of plastic and other trash
explanation: Reforestation means planting trees again in an area that used to be forest but lost its trees.
fact_tl: Ang reforestation ay ang muling pagtatanim ng mga puno sa lugar na dating gubat ngunit nawalan na ng mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang reforestation mao ang pagtanom og balik sa mga kahoy sa dapit nga kaniadto lasang apan nawad-an na og mga kahoy.

q: Where does a young dragonfly live before it can fly?
options: Underwater
Inside tree bark
In soil underground
Inside a cocoon on a plant
explanation: Before it can fly, a young dragonfly (nymph) lives underwater and grows there for many months.
fact_tl: Bago lumipad, ang batang tutubi ay nakatira sa ilalim ng tubig at lumalaki roon nang maraming buwan.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa makalupad, ang batan-ong alindahaw nagapuyo sa ilalom sa tubig ug motubo didto sulod sa daghang bulan.

q: What kind of plant is betel leaf (ikmo), and what shape are its leaves?
options: A climbing vine with smooth heart-shaped leaves
A small bush with narrow pointed leaves
A water plant with round floating leaves
A tall tree with large oval leaves
explanation: Betel leaf, or ikmo, is a climbing vine with smooth heart-shaped leaves used to wrap betel nut in the traditional chewing practice.
fact_tl: Ang ikmo o buyo ay isang gumagapang na halaman na may makinis at hugis-pusong dahon, at ito ang ibinabalot sa bunga sa tradisyong nganga.
fact_bis: Ang ikmo o buyo usa ka nagakatay nga tanom nga adunay hamis ug hugis-kasingkasing nga dahon, ug kini ang iputos sa bunga sa tradisyon nga mama.

q: In a fossil fuel power plant, what makes the turbine spin to produce electricity?
options: Steam from boiling water
Burning gas blown directly onto the blades
The weight of falling coal
Compressed air from giant fans
explanation: Fossil fuel is burned to boil water into steam, and the steam spins a turbine connected to a generator to make electricity.
fact_tl: Sa karamihan ng power plant, sinusunog ang fossil fuel para magpainit ng tubig hanggang maging singaw. Ang singaw na ito ay umiikot ng turbine na konektado sa generator, at doon nagagawa ang kuryenteng gamit natin sa bahay.
fact_bis: Sa kadaghanan sa power plant, gisunog ang fossil fuel aron painiton ang tubig hangtod mahimong alisngaw. Ang alisngaw nagpatuyok sa turbine nga konektado sa generator, ug didto namugna ang kuryente nga gamiton nato sa balay.

q: Through which tiny openings does sweat come out onto the surface of the skin?
options: Pores
Capillaries
Follicles
Valves
explanation: Sweat made by sweat glands inside the skin comes out through tiny holes called pores on the skin's surface.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng balat may maliliit na bahagi na tinatawag na sweat glands. Dito gawa ang pawis, na binubuo ng tubig at kaunting asin. Lumalabas ito sa maliliit na butas o pores sa ibabaw ng balat.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa panit adunay gagmay nga bahin nga gitawag ug sweat glands. Dinhi gihimo ang singot, nga gibuo sa tubig ug gamayng asin. Mogawas kini sa gagmay nga lungag o pores sa ibabaw sa panit.

q: Why does mixing two acids together NOT cause neutralization?
options: Both acids have extra H+ ions so nothing cancels out — you just get more acid
Acids are too strong to react with each other at room temperature
Two acids mixed always explode, which is why neutralization cannot happen
Neutralization only works if heat is applied, which acids alone cannot provide
explanation: Neutralization needs opposites — an acid with H+ and a base with OH- to cancel out; two acids both have extra H+ so nothing is neutralized.
