fact_tl: Bakit hindi mangyayari ang neutralization kapag dalawang asido ang pinaghalo? Dahil kailangan ng magkasalungat — isang asido (may H+) at isang base (may OH-) — para sila magkanselahan. Kung asido at asido lang, parehong may sobrang H+, kaya wala silang ibubunga maliban sa mas maraming asido. Kailangan ng kabaligtaran para magkaroon ng balanse.
fact_bis: Ngano nga dili mahitabo ang neutralization kung duha ka asido ang sagolon? Kay kinahanglan og magkasumpaki — usa ka asido (naa'y H+) ug usa ka base (naa'y OH-) — aron sila magwagtang sa usag-usa. Kung asido ug asido lang, parehas nga naa'y sobra nga H+, mao nga mas daghan lang ang asido. Kinahanglan ang kasumpaki aron makab-ot ang balanse.

q: Which country produces the most abaca in the world?
options: The Philippines
Indonesia
Malaysia
Thailand
explanation: The Philippines is the world's largest producer of abaca.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ang pinakamalaking taga-produksyon ng abaka sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas mao ang labing dako nga tighimo og abaka sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: Which muscle pulls your forearm up when you bend your elbow?
options: The biceps on the front of the upper arm
The triceps on the back of the upper arm
The deltoid muscle on the shoulder
The forearm flexor running along the wrist
explanation: The biceps — the muscle on the front of the upper arm — shortens and pulls your forearm up when you bend your elbow.
fact_tl: Halimbawa ng paghila: kapag binabaluktot mo ang siko mo, humihila ng iyong bisig pataas ang biceps — ang kalamnan sa harap ng braso. Umiikli ang biceps at nakakabit ito sa buto ng bisig, kaya naitataas nito ang iyong kamay papunta sa balikat.
fact_bis: Pananglitan sa pagbira: kung baluktoton nimo ang imong siko, ang biceps — ang kaunoran sa atubangan sa imong braso — mobira sa imong bukton paingon sa taas. Mokunot ang biceps ug nakadikit kini sa bukog sa bukton, busa maisa niini ang imong kamot paingon sa imong abaga.

q: In a lichen, why does the fungus depend on the alga?
options: Because the fungus cannot make its own food and the alga provides food from sunlight
Because the fungus cannot absorb water and the alga absorbs it instead
Because the alga protects the fungus from drying out in sunlight
Because the fungus cannot reproduce without the alga's spores
explanation: The fungus in a lichen cannot make its own food through photosynthesis, so it depends on the alga that provides food from sunlight.
fact_tl: Hindi makagawa ng sariling pagkain ang fungus, kaya umaasa ito sa alga na nagbibigay ng pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang fungus dili makahimo og kaugalingong pagkaon, mao nga nagsalig kini sa alga nga naghatag og pagkaon gikan sa adlaw.

q: Why do some animals like bears hibernate through the cold season?
options: To save energy when food is scarce
To avoid predators that hunt more actively in winter
To keep their body temperature from rising too high
To shed their old fur and grow a warmer coat
explanation: Hibernation is a deep sleep through the cold season that helps animals like bears save energy when food is hard to find.
fact_tl: Ang ilang hayop tulad ng oso ay natutulog nang malalim sa buong malamig na panahon, na tinatawag na hibernation, upang matipid ang enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang ubang hayop sama sa oso matulog ug lawom sa tibuok bugnaw nga panahon, gitawag nga hibernation, aron makatipig ug enerhiya.

q: How does getting enough sleep help your brain?
options: It helps the brain rest and better store what you have learned
It increases the number of brain cells so you think faster
It removes damaged brain cells and replaces them with new ones
It stops the brain from using energy so the body can grow
explanation: Enough sleep helps the brain rest and better store what we have learned.
fact_tl: Ang sapat na tulog ay tumutulong sa utak na magpahinga at mas maitago ang mga natutunan.
fact_bis: Ang igong katulog nagtabang sa utok nga makapahulay ug mas matipigan ang mga nakat-onan.

q: What is the capital city of Spain?
options: Madrid
Barcelona
Lisbon
Seville
explanation: The capital of Spain is Madrid.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Espanya (Spain) ay Madrid.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Espanya (Spain) mao ang Madrid.

q: What two things do you need to make a shadow indoors?
options: A flashlight and an object that blocks its light
A mirror and a candle placed behind it
A window and a piece of colored glass
A lamp and a magnifying lens
explanation: Indoors you can make a shadow using a flashlight and an object that blocks its light.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng bahay, maaaring gumawa ng anino gamit ang flashlight at isang bagay na haharang sa liwanag nito.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa balay, makahimo ka og landong gamit ang flashlight ug usa ka butang nga mobabag sa kahayag niini.

q: How are rock layers similar to the rings inside a tree trunk?
options: Both record the passage of time, with each layer or ring representing a period of growth
Both are made of the same minerals that build up one ring or layer at a time
Both are equally easy to count because one ring and one layer both equal one year
Both are found only in the oldest and tallest trees or the deepest rocks
explanation: Rock layers, like tree rings, record the passage of time — each layer represents a period, though one rock layer can span thousands or millions of years, unlike a tree ring which is one year.
fact_tl: Ang patong-patong na bato ay parang singsing ng isang puno. Kung puputulin ang puno, makikita mo ang mga singsing at mabibilang kung ilang taon na ito. Ganoon din sa bato: ang bawat patong ay parang pahina ng panahon. Ang pagkakaiba, ang singsing ng puno ay isang taon kada singsing, samantalang ang isang patong ng bato ay maaaring libu-libo o milyon-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Ang nagtapun-tapong bato sama sa mga singsing sa kahoy. Kung putlon nimo ang kahoy, makita nimo ang mga singsing ug maihap kung pila na kini ka tuig. Mao usab sa bato: ang matag patong sama sa panid sa panahon. Ang kalainan, ang singsing sa kahoy usa ka tuig matag usa, samtang ang usa ka patong sa bato mahimong liboan o milyon-milyong tuig.

q: Which group of animals without a backbone includes creatures as different as snails and octopuses?
options: Mollusks
Arthropods
Echinoderms
Annelids
explanation: Mollusks are one of the largest groups of animals without a backbone, ranging from snails to octopuses.
fact_tl: Ang mga molusko ay isa sa pinakamalaking grupo ng mga hayop na walang gulugod, kaya napakaraming uri nila mula suso hanggang pugita.
fact_bis: Ang mga molusko usa sa pinakadako nga grupo sa mga hayop nga walay bukog, busa daghan kaayo ang ilang klase gikan sa kuhol hangtod sa kugita.

q: What are nipa palm leaves traditionally used for?
options: Woven into thatch for roofing
Boiled to make herbal medicine
Ground into flour for cooking
Dried and burned as incense
explanation: The nipa palm grows in mangrove mud and its leaves are woven into thatch for roofing.
fact_tl: Ang nipa o sasa ay palmang tumutubo sa maalat na putikan ng bakawan, at ang mga dahon nito ay ginagawang pawid na pantakip sa bubong.
fact_bis: Ang nipa o sasa kay palma nga motubo sa parat nga lapok sa bakawan, ug ang mga dahon niini gihimong pawod nga atip sa atop.

q: How many bones are in both hands combined?
explanation: Both hands together have 54 bones because each hand has 27 bones.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang kamay ay may 54 na buto kapag pinagsama, dahil tig-27 ang bawat kamay.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka kamot adunay 54 ka bukog kung tingbon, kay tag-27 ang matag kamot.

q: Why is buko (young coconut) juice a good drink when you are tired or thirsty?
options: It has water and natural salts that help your kidneys balance fluids
It contains vitamins that give you instant energy to keep moving
It has a natural sugar that is quickly absorbed by the muscles
It is cold and thick so it cools down the body faster than plain water
explanation: Buko juice has water and natural salts that help make the kidneys' water-balancing job easier.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, mainam uminom ng buko juice kapag pagod o nauhaw dahil may tubig at natural na asin ito. Tumutulong itong mapadali ang trabaho ng bato sa pagbabalanse ng tubig.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, maayo ang pag-inom og buko juice kung gikapoy o giuhaw kay naa kini tubig ug natural nga asin. Makatabang kini aron mas sayon ang trabaho sa kidney sa pagbalanse sa tubig.

q: What will happen to the Sun when it runs out of hydrogen?
options: It will swell up into a huge red star called a red giant
It will shrink into a tiny cold rock called a white dwarf
It will explode in a massive blast called a supernova
It will break apart and form a ring of gas around the Solar System
explanation: When the Sun runs out of hydrogen, it will swell up into a huge red star called a red giant.
fact_tl: Kapag naubos na ng Araw ang hydrogen nito, lalobo ito at magiging isang malaking pulang bituin na tinatawag na red giant.
fact_bis: Kung mahurot na sa Adlaw ang hydrogen niini, mohabok kini ug mahimong dako nga pula nga bituon nga gitawag red giant.

q: Why do offspring from two parents look different from each other and from their parents?
options: Sexual reproduction creates new combinations of genes from the two parents
Each offspring randomly loses some genes before it is fully formed
The environment changes the genes of offspring after they are born
Only the mother's genes are passed on, so small differences come from mutations
explanation: Offspring vary because sexual reproduction creates new combinations of genes from the two parents.
fact_tl: Magkakaiba ang mga anak dahil sa sexual na pagpaparami ay nabubuo ang bagong kombinasyon ng genes mula sa dalawang magulang.
fact_bis: Managlahi ang mga anak tungod kay ang sekswal nga pagsanay maghimo ug bag-ong kombinasyon sa mga gene gikan sa duha ka ginikanan.

q: Which tiny ocean organisms produce a large share of the oxygen that all living things breathe?
options: Phytoplankton
Zooplankton
Jellyfish larvae
Sea sponges
explanation: Phytoplankton in the ocean produce a large share of the Earth's oxygen, making them vital for all living things.
fact_tl: Ang phytoplankton sa karagatan ang gumagawa ng malaking bahagi ng oxygen sa Mundo, kaya mahalaga sila sa hininga ng lahat ng nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Ang phytoplankton sa kadagatan naghimo og dakong bahin sa oxygen sa Kalibutan, mao nga importante sila sa pagginhawa sa tanang buhi.

q: Which animal is most commonly used to produce civet coffee?
options: The Asian palm civet
The African spotted civet
The Philippine pangolin
The Malay bearcat
explanation: Most civet coffee comes from the Asian palm civet, a kind of civet common in Southeast Asia.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng kapeng alamid ay galing sa Asian palm civet, isang uri ng alamid na laganap sa Timog-Silangang Asya.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa kape sa alamid gikan sa Asian palm civet, usa ka matang sa alamid nga komon sa Habagatan-Sidlakang Asya.

q: About what pH does the acid in our stomach have?
options: About pH 2
About pH 7
About pH 10
About pH 5
explanation: The acid in our stomach has a very low pH of about 2, which helps break down food.
fact_tl: Ang asido sa ating tiyan ay may napakababang pH na humigit-kumulang 2, na tumutulong tunawin ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang asido sa atong tiyan adunay ubos kaayo nga pH nga mga 2, nga makatabang sa pagtunaw sa pagkaon.

q: What does it mean when gold jewelry is labeled 24 karat?
options: It is pure gold
It is 24% gold mixed with other metals
It weighs exactly 24 grams
It was certified by 24 different quality tests
explanation: The purity of gold is measured in karats; 24 karat means pure gold.
fact_tl: Ang kadalisayan ng ginto ay sinusukat sa kilatis (karat); ang 24 na kilatis ay purong ginto.
fact_bis: Ang kaputli sa bulawan gisukod sa kilatis (karat); ang 24 karat nagpasabot nga lunsay nga bulawan.

q: What is a metronome, and how does it help musicians?
options: It is a small pendulum that keeps the beat of music steady and even
It is an electronic tuner that shows whether notes are in pitch
It is a small speaker that plays a recording of a correct tempo
It is a rubber mallet used to tap the beat on a percussion instrument
explanation: A metronome is a small pendulum that musicians use to keep the beat of music steady and even.
fact_tl: Ang metronome ay isang maliit na pendulum na ginagamit ng mga musikero para panatilihing pantay-pantay ang bilis ng tugtog.
fact_bis: Ang metronome usa ka gamay nga pendulum nga gamiton sa mga musikero aron magpabilin nga pantay ang katulin sa tugtog.

q: What happens to the vocal cords when you are just breathing and not speaking?
options: They stay open to let air through
They vibrate gently to warm the air
They close tightly to protect the lungs
They press together just enough to hum softly
explanation: When we just breathe, the vocal cords stay open to let air through; they only come together when we speak to make sound.
fact_tl: Kapag huminga lang tayo, bukas ang vocal cords para makadaan ang hangin; kapag magsasalita, magkalapit ito para manginig at magtunog.
fact_bis: Kon mag-ginhawa lang ta, abli ang vocal cords aron makaagi ang hangin; kon mosulti ta, magsuod kini aron mag-uyog ug motingog.

q: Why is Palawan considered one of the richest places for wildlife in the Philippines?
options: It has many animals and plants found nowhere else in the world
It has the largest area of tropical rainforest in Southeast Asia
It is surrounded by the deepest ocean trenches in the Pacific
It has no human settlements, so animals have never been disturbed
explanation: Palawan has many endemic animals and plants — species found nowhere else — making it one of the richest places for wildlife in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Palawan ay may maraming endemikong hayop at halaman kaya tinaguriang isa sa pinakamayamang lugar sa likas na buhay sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Palawan adunay daghang endemiko nga mananap ug tanom, mao nga usa kini sa pinakaadunahan nga lugar sa ihalas nga kinabuhi sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do many people say distilled water tastes flat or plain?
options: Because distillation removes the dissolved minerals and gases that give ordinary water its taste
Because distilled water is colder than tap water and cold dulls the sense of taste
Because the distillation process adds chemicals that cancel out the natural flavor
Because distilled water has too much oxygen dissolved in it, which causes a bland taste
explanation: Distilled water tastes flat because distillation removes the dissolved minerals and gases that give ordinary water its flavor.
fact_tl: Maraming tao ang nagsasabing matabang o walang lasa ang distiladong tubig, dahil ang lasa ng karaniwang tubig ay galing sa mga mineral at natunaw na gas na inalis ng distilasyon.
fact_bis: Daghang tawo ang moingon nga matabang o walay lami ang distiladong tubig, kay ang lami sa ordinaryong tubig naggikan sa mga mineral ug natunaw nga gas nga gikuha sa distillation.

q: What can happen to a carabao that goes too long without water or shade in the heat?
options: It can struggle or get sick
It will immediately lie down and refuse to move
Its skin will crack and peel from the dryness
Its hooves will soften and it cannot walk properly
explanation: If a carabao goes too long without water or shade in the heat, it can struggle or get sick, which is why it needs water and a chance to bathe.
fact_tl: Kapag matagal na walang tubig o lilim ang kalabaw sa sobrang init, maaari itong mahirapan o magkasakit. Kaya importanteng painumin at paliguan ito.
fact_bis: Kung dugay nga walay tubig o landong ang kalabaw sa grabe nga init, mahimo kining maglisod o magsakit. Mao nga importante nga paimnon ug paligoon kini.

q: What is the job of the hard shell around a chicken egg?
options: It protects the chick inside from harm and germs
It provides all the food the chick needs to grow
It keeps the egg warm without needing a mother hen
It makes the egg heavy so it does not roll away
explanation: The hard eggshell protects the chick inside from harm and germs.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na balat ng itlog ay nagpoprotekta sa sisiw mula sa pinsala at mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga panit sa itlog manalipod sa piso sa sulod gikan sa kadaot ug mga mikrobyo.

q: How many Nobel Prizes did Marie Curie win, and in which fields?
options: Two — in Physics and in Chemistry
One — in Physics only
Three — in Physics, Chemistry, and Medicine
Two — in Chemistry and in Medicine
explanation: Marie Curie was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes — one in Physics and one in Chemistry.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang unang taong nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize — sa Physics at sa Chemistry.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie ang unang tawo nga nagdaog ug duha ka Nobel Prize — sa Physics ug sa Chemistry.

q: If you played a kubing in outer space, could someone nearby hear it?
options: No, because there is no air in space to carry the sound waves.
Yes, the vibrations would still reach the listener.
No, because the kubing would stop vibrating in space.
Yes, but the sound would be much quieter than on Earth.
explanation: Sound needs air to travel; without air, as in outer space, the kubing's vibrations cannot reach anyone's ear.
fact_tl: Ang vibration ng dila ng kubing ay nagtutulak sa hangin sa paligid, at ang hanging ito ang naglilipat ng tunog patungo sa tenga mo bilang sound waves. Kung walang hangin — gaya sa kalawakan — hindi mo maririnig ang kubing kahit nayayanig pa rin ang dila nito.
fact_bis: Ang vibration sa dila sa kubing motulod sa hangin libot niini, ug kining hangin maoy mobalhin sa tunog ngadto sa imong dunggan isip sound waves. Kung walay hangin — sama sa kawanangan — dili nimo madungog ang kubing bisan nag-vibrate pa ang dila niini.

q: Why should you keep a credit card away from strong magnets?
options: Because the card's magnetic stripe stores information that can be erased by magnets.
Because the plastic of the card will melt near a strong magnet.
Because magnets cause electricity to flow through the card and damage it.
Because the card's chip will attract the magnet and break it.
explanation: The black stripe on the back of a card is a magnetic stripe that holds information, so strong magnets can damage or erase it.
fact_tl: Ang itim na guhit sa likod ng ATM o credit card ay isang magnetic stripe na nag-iingat ng impormasyon, kaya dapat itong ilayo sa malalakas na magnet.
fact_bis: Ang itom nga linya sa luyo sa ATM o credit card usa ka magnetic stripe nga nagtago ug impormasyon, mao nga ipalayo kini sa kusog nga magnet.

q: Where do many young fish grow up before moving to the coral reef as adults?
options: In seagrass meadows where they are safe.
In deep ocean trenches where predators cannot reach.
In rocky tide pools along the shore.
In the open sea away from the coast.
explanation: Many fish first grow up in the safe seagrass meadow before moving to the coral reef when they become adults.
fact_tl: Maraming isda ang lumalaki muna sa ligtas na damuhan ng damong-dagat bago lumipat sa bahura kapag malalaki na sila.
fact_bis: Daghang isda ang modako una sa luwas nga damuhan sa sagbot sa dagat sa dili pa mobalhin sa bahura kon dagko na sila.

q: About how many decibels is a whisper compared to a nearby jet plane?
options: A whisper is about 30 decibels; a jet plane can reach over 120 decibels.
A whisper is about 70 decibels; a jet plane can reach over 150 decibels.
A whisper is about 10 decibels; a jet plane can reach over 80 decibels.
A whisper is about 50 decibels; a jet plane can reach over 100 decibels.
explanation: A whisper is only about 30 decibels, while a nearby jet plane can exceed 120 decibels, which is extremely loud.
fact_tl: Halimbawa, ang bulong ay mga 30 desibel lang, ngunit ang malapit na eroplanong jet ay umaabot ng higit 120 desibel na sobrang lakas.
fact_bis: Pananglitan, ang hagawhaw mga 30 desibel ra, apan ang duol nga jet nga ayroplano makaabot og kapin 120 desibel nga sobra ka kusog.

q: How do antibodies in your body fight germs?
options: They fit a specific germ like a key fits a lock, sticking to it so it can be destroyed.
They raise your body temperature to kill all germs at once.
They surround every germ in the body with a thick membrane.
They release acid that dissolves any foreign object in the blood.
explanation: The body makes antibodies that fit one specific kind of germ like a key, sticking to it so it can be destroyed.
fact_tl: Gumagawa ang katawan ng antibodies na parang susi na bagay lang sa isang uri ng germ at kumakapit dito para madaling mawasak.
fact_bis: Ang lawas mohimo og antibodies nga mohaom sa usa ka klase sa germ sama sa yawi, ug mokapyot niini aron dali kining malaglag.

q: Why does the Philippines have only two main seasons instead of four?
options: Because the Philippines is close to the equator.
Because the Philippines is surrounded by the ocean on all sides.
Because the Philippines is a group of islands, not a continent.
Because the Philippines is in the Southern Hemisphere.
explanation: The Philippines is close to the equator, so it does not experience four seasons; instead it has only a wet season and a dry season.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay malapit sa equator kaya hindi ito nagtatamasa ng apat na season (taglamig, tagsibol, tag-araw, taglagas) tulad ng mga bansang malayo sa equator; sa halip, ang Pilipinas ay may dalawang pangunahing panahon: tag-ulan at tag-araw.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas duol sa equator busa wala kini masinati ang upat ka season (tagtugnaw, tagsibol, ting-init, ting-lagas) sama sa mga bansa nga layo sa equator; hinunoa, ang Pilipinas adunay duha ka panguna nga panahon: tag-ulan ug ting-araw.

q: What covers the body of the maya-maya and lapu-lapu to give them protection?
options: Scales
Thick skin
A hard shell
Slippery mucus only
explanation: The body of the maya-maya and lapu-lapu is covered with scales that protect them.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng maya-maya at lapu-lapu ay natatakpan ng kaliskis na nagbibigay proteksyon dito.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa maya-maya ug lapu-lapu natabonan og himbis nga naghatag og panalipod niini.

q: Why is it important to wash your hands with soap after touching dirty things?
options: Soap removes germs that can make you sick and stop illness from spreading to others.
Soap makes your skin stronger so germs cannot enter the body.
Soap smells bad to germs, making them fly away from your hands.
Soap creates a barrier on the skin that poisons any germ that touches it.
explanation: Washing hands with soap removes tiny germs and stops illness from spreading to other people.
fact_tl: Ang mga mikrobyo ay napakaliliit na nabubuhay na bagay na maaaring magpasakit sa atin. Ang paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon ay nag-aalis sa kanila at pumipigil na kumalat ang sakit.
fact_bis: Ang mga mikrobyo gagmayng buhing butang nga makapasakit kanato. Ang paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon makakuha kanila ug makapugong sa pagkatap sa sakit ngadto sa uban.

q: Which direction does a kangaroo's pouch open, and why does it matter?
options: It opens toward the front, so the joey does not fall out when the mother jumps.
It opens toward the back, so the joey can peek out while the mother runs.
It opens upward, so the joey can easily climb in and out.
It opens downward, so the joey can drop out quickly in an emergency.
explanation: A kangaroo's pouch opens toward the front, keeping the joey safely inside even during high jumps.
fact_tl: Ang supot ng kangaroo ay nakabukas paharap, kaya hindi nahuhulog ang joey kahit tumalon ang ina.
fact_bis: Ang supot sa kangguro abli paatubang, mao nga dili mahulog ang joey bisan molukso ang inahan.

q: Why do over a million wildebeest migrate together across the Serengeti every year?
options: They follow the rains to places with fresh grass.
They travel to warmer coastlines to escape the cold winter.
They move to higher ground to avoid floods in the rainy season.
They search for permanent water sources that never dry up.
explanation: Wildebeest migrate across the Serengeti every year, following the rains to find fresh grass to eat.
fact_tl: Sa Africa, mahigit isang milyong wildebeest ang sabay-sabay na lumilipat sa Serengeti bawat taon, sinusundan ang ulan papunta sa mga lugar na may sariwang damo.
fact_bis: Sa Africa, kapin sa usa ka milyon ka wildebeest ang dungan nga mobalhin tabok sa Serengeti matag tuig, ginasunod ang ulan padulong sa mga dapit nga adunay lab-as nga sagbot.

q: When does the kakawate tree usually produce its pink flowers?
options: During the dry season when its leaves have fallen.
During the rainy season when the soil is moist.
In the middle of the wet season when rain is heaviest.
At the start of the school year in June.
explanation: The kakawate produces pink flowers often during the dry season when its leaves have already fallen.
fact_tl: Ang kakawate ay namumulaklak ng kulay-rosas na mga bulaklak, kadalasan tuwing tag-init kapag nalalagas ang mga dahon nito.
fact_bis: Ang kakawate mamulak og kolor-rosas nga mga bulak, kasagaran panahon sa tinginit kon mangahulog na ang mga dahon niini.

q: How would you feel if you stood on Mars compared to standing on Earth?
options: You would weigh less and could jump higher because Mars has weaker gravity.
You would weigh more because Mars is farther from the Sun and pulls harder.
You would feel the same weight because all planets have similar gravity.
You would float off the ground because Mars has almost no gravity at all.
explanation: Gravity on Mars is weaker than on Earth, so you would weigh less and could jump higher there.
fact_tl: Mas mahina ang grabidad sa Mars kaysa Mundo, kaya mas magaan ka roon at mas mataas kang makakatalon.
fact_bis: Mas huyang ang grabidad sa Mars kaysa Yuta, mao nga mas gaan ka didto ug mas taas ka makalukso.

q: Which planet was the last major planet to be discovered?
options: Neptune, discovered in 1846.
Uranus, discovered in 1781.
Saturn, discovered with early telescopes in the 1600s.
Pluto, discovered in 1930.
explanation: Neptune is the last major planet to be discovered, found in 1846.
fact_tl: Ang Neptune ang huling pangunahing planetang natuklasan, noong 1846.
fact_bis: Ang Neptune mao ang ulahing dakong planeta nga nadiskobre, niadtong 1846.

q: Why do hydrocarbons with long carbon chains form thick products like tar rather than light fuels?
options: Because long, heavy chains need very high temperatures to boil, so they remain as thick liquids.
Because long chains dissolve in water easily, making them too heavy to burn.
Because long chains have fewer carbon atoms, giving them less energy to evaporate.
Because long chains are solid at room temperature, which is why fuels freeze in pipes.
explanation: Hydrocarbons with long carbon chains are heavy and boil only at very high temperatures, forming thick products like tar and bitumen.
fact_tl: Ang mga molekulang may mahahabang kadena ng carbon ay mabibigat at kumukulo sa napakataas na temperatura, kaya sila ang mga malalapot na produkto tulad ng alkitran sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Ang mga molekula nga adunay taas nga kadena sa carbon mga bug-at ug mobukal lang sa hataas kaayo nga temperatura, busa sila ang baga nga mga produkto sama sa alkitran sa ubos.

q: What part of the taro plant is used to make the Filipino dish laing?
options: The leaves, cooked in coconut milk.
The root only, boiled with vinegar.
The flower buds, mixed with chili.
The stem, fried in cooking oil.
explanation: Laing is a popular Bicol dish made from taro leaves cooked in coconut milk, showing that not only the root but also the leaves are used as food.
fact_tl: Ang laing ay isang sikat na ulam sa Pilipinas, lalo na sa Bicol, na gawa sa dahon ng gabi na nilutong mabuti sa gata — patunay na hindi lang ang ugat kundi pati dahon ng gabi ay pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang laing usa ka inila nga ulam sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa Bicol, hinimo sa dahon sa gabi nga giluto og maayo sa gata — pamatuod nga dili lang ang gamot kondili apil ang dahon sa gabi pagkaon.

q: What does DOST celebrate every July to show Filipinos new advances in science?
options: National Science and Technology Week
National Environment Day
National Research and Discovery Month
National Mathematics and Engineering Fair
explanation: DOST celebrates National Science and Technology Week every July to introduce Filipinos to new discoveries and advances in science.
fact_tl: Ipinagdiriwang ng DOST ang National Science and Technology Week bawat Hulyo upang ipakita sa mga Pilipino ang mga bagong natuklasan at pagbabago sa agham.
fact_bis: Nagsaulog ang DOST sa National Science and Technology Week matag Hulyo aron ipakita sa mga Pilipino ang bag-ong mga nakatuklas ug pag-uswag sa siyensiya.

q: How are oxygen molecules in the air arranged?
options: As pairs of two oxygen atoms joined together, written as O₂.
As single oxygen atoms floating freely.
As groups of three oxygen atoms, written as O₃.
As rings of six oxygen atoms bonded in a circle.
explanation: The oxygen in air exists as tiny molecules made of two oxygen atoms joined together, written as O₂.
fact_tl: Ang oxygen sa hangin ay nasa anyong maliliit na molekula na binubuo ng dalawang oxygen atom na magkadikit, na isinusulat na O₂.
fact_bis: Ang oxygen sa hangin anaa sa porma sa gagmay nga molekula nga gilangkoban og duha ka oxygen atom nga nagdikit, gisulat nga O₂.

q: Why do we always see lightning before we hear thunder?
options: Because light travels faster than sound, reaching our eyes first.
Because thunder is produced after lightning reaches the ground.
Because sound needs water droplets in clouds to form and travels slowly upward.
Because our eyes are more sensitive than our ears during a storm.
explanation: Light is the fastest thing of all, so it reaches our eyes before sound reaches our ears.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ang pinakamabilis sa lahat, kaya nakikita natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag mao ang pinakapaspas sa tanan, mao nga makita nato ang kilat una madungog ang dalugdog.

q: Even though blood contains iron, why can't a magnet pull you toward it?
options: The iron is in tiny amounts and is bound inside hemoglobin, so it does not act like solid iron.
The skin is too thick for a magnet to feel the iron inside the blood.
Iron in the blood is a different kind that is not found on Earth's surface.
The heart pumps blood too fast for a magnet to attract it.
explanation: Although blood contains iron, it is a tiny amount bound inside hemoglobin and does not behave like a solid lump of iron.
fact_tl: May iron nga sa dugo, pero hindi ito nangangahulugang magnetic ka o naaakit ka sa magnet. Napakaliit lang ng dami ng iron, at nasa anyong nakatali sa hemoglobin, kaya hindi ito kumikilos na parang isang piraso ng bakal. Hindi ka kakapit sa ref dahil dito.
fact_bis: Aduna gyoy iron sa dugo, apan dili kini magpasabot nga magnetic ka o madani ka sa magnet. Gamay ra kaayo ang gidaghanon sa iron, ug nahigot kini sa sulod sa hemoglobin, mao nga dili kini molihok sama sa usa ka bug-os nga puthaw. Dili ka mopilit sa ref tungod niini.

q: What substance is produced when remains and waste decay, releasing the nitrogen in them?
options: Ammonia
Carbon dioxide
Methane
Sulfur dioxide
explanation: When remains and waste decay, the nitrogen in them turns into ammonia, which other bacteria can then use.
fact_tl: Kapag nabubulok ang mga labi at dumi, ang nitrogen sa mga ito ay nagiging amonya, na maaaring gamitin ng iba pang bakterya.
fact_bis: Kon madunot ang mga salin ug hugaw, ang nitroheno niini mahimong amonya, nga magamit sa ubang bakterya.

q: Why does raw meat spoil so much faster than dried rice or crackers?
options: Because raw meat is moist and rich in protein, which microbes love to grow on.
Because raw meat contains natural acids that break it down from the inside.
Because raw meat is kept at room temperature while rice is always stored cold.
Because microbes only attack foods that have been cooked and then cooled.
explanation: Moist, rich foods like raw meat spoil quickly because microbes thrive and grow on them.
fact_tl: Ang basa at mayamang pagkain tulad ng hilaw na karne at isda ay mabilis masira dahil paborito ito ng mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang basa ug dato nga pagkaon sama sa hilaw nga karne ug isda dali madaot kay gusto kaayo sa mikrobyo motubo niini.

q: What is a key feature of a centipede's or millipede's body structure?
options: Their bodies are made of many similar segments lined up in a row.
Their bodies have a hard outer shell like a crab.
Their bodies are divided into only two parts: head and tail.
Their bodies are shaped like a single oval with no clear segments.
explanation: The bodies of centipedes and millipedes are made of many similar segments lined up in a row.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng alupihan at millipede ay binubuo ng maraming magkakaparehong bahagi na nakahanay.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa alupihan ug millipede gilangkoban og daghang managsama nga mga bahin nga gilaray.

q: Out of the 5 groups of vertebrates, how many are warm-blooded?
options: 2 — birds and mammals.
3 — birds, mammals, and reptiles.
1 — only mammals.
4 — all except fish.
explanation: Of the 5 vertebrate groups, only 2 are warm-blooded: birds and mammals.
fact_tl: Sa 5 grupo ng vertebrate, 2 lamang ang warm-blooded: ang mga ibon at ang mga mammal.
fact_bis: Sa 5 ka grupo sa vertebrate, 2 ra ang init og dugo (warm-blooded): ang mga langgam ug ang mga mammal.

q: Why is it important to limit the amount of salt, sugar, and fat in your diet?
options: Because eating too much of these can cause sickness later on.
Because salt, sugar, and fat have no nutritional value at all.
Because these ingredients make food go bad faster in storage.
Because children grow taller when they avoid these ingredients.
explanation: Part of balanced eating is limiting salt, sugar, and fat because too much can cause sickness later in life.
fact_tl: Bahagi ng balanseng pagkain ang paglilimita sa asin, asukal, at taba, dahil ang sobra nito ay maaaring magdulot ng sakit balang-araw.
fact_bis: Bahin sa balanseng pagkaon ang pagpugong sa asin, asukal, ug tambok, kay ang sobra niini mahimong hinungdan sa sakit unya.

q: How does the golden apple snail survive when the rice field dries up?
options: It buries itself in the mud and stays alive for many months until water returns.
It moves to the nearest river and waits there until the field floods again.
It climbs onto rice stalks and enters a deep sleep until rain comes.
It seals its shell opening with a hard cap and floats on any remaining water.
explanation: The golden apple snail can bury itself in mud and stay alive for many months while the rice field is dry.
fact_tl: Kayang maglubong ng golden kuhol sa putik at manatiling buhay nang maraming buwan habang tuyo ang palayan.
fact_bis: Makahimo ang golden kuhol sa paglubong sa lapok ug magpabiling buhi sulod sa daghang bulan samtang mala ang basakan.

q: Which teeth are the last to grow in a person's mouth, usually appearing when they are older?
options: The wisdom teeth, the last molars to come in.
The front incisors, which keep growing throughout life.
The canine teeth, which only appear in adulthood.
The first premolars, which replace the last baby teeth.
explanation: The wisdom teeth are the last molars to grow, usually appearing when a person is already older.
fact_tl: Ang wisdom teeth ang pinakahuling bagang na tumutubo, kadalasan kapag malaki na ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang wisdom teeth mao ang kataposang bag-ang nga motubo, kasagaran kon dako na ang tawo.

q: What do most scientists believe caused the extinction of the dinosaurs?
options: A giant asteroid that struck Earth.
A series of massive volcanic eruptions that lasted millions of years.
A worldwide ice age that froze their food supply.
A deadly disease that spread among all dinosaur species.
explanation: Most scientists believe a giant asteroid that struck Earth killed off the dinosaurs.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mga siyentipiko ay naniniwalang isang malaking asteroid na bumagsak sa Earth ang pumatay sa mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga siyentista nagtuo nga usa ka dako nga asteroid nga nahulog sa Yuta ang mipatay sa mga dinosaur.

q: What body part does a snail use to scrape and eat food like leaves and algae?
options: A radula — a long ribbon covered with hundreds of tiny teeth.
A beak — a hard pointed structure used to peck at food.
A proboscis — a long tube used to suck up liquid food.
A mandible — a pair of jaws that chew food side to side.
explanation: Snails have a radula, a ribbon covered with tiny teeth, that they use to scrape and eat food.
fact_tl: Ang kuhol ay may radula—isang mahabang laso na puno ng daan-daang maliliit na ngipin—na ginagamit nito para kuskusin at kumain ng pagkain tulad ng dahon at algae.
fact_bis: Ang kuhol adunay radula—usa ka taas nga laso nga puno og gatusan ka gagmay nga ngipin—nga gigamit niini para pakrusan ug kaonon ang pagkaon sama sa dahon ug algae.

q: Where can different kinds of tarictic hornbill be found in the Philippines?
options: On different islands such as Luzon, the Visayas, and Mindanao.
Only on the island of Palawan, where they are protected.
Only in Mindanao, where the largest rainforests remain.
Throughout all Philippine islands because they can fly between them.
explanation: Different kinds of tarictic hornbill live on different Philippine islands such as Luzon, the Visayas, and Mindanao.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng tariktik hornbill na naninirahan sa magkakaibang isla ng Pilipinas tulad ng Luzon, Visayas, at Mindanao.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalain-laing matang sa tarictic hornbill nga nagpuyo sa nagkalain-laing isla sa Pilipinas sama sa Luzon, Visayas, ug Mindanao.

q: Even if an animal is an apex predator, when might its young still be at risk from other animals?
options: When the young are small and weak, before they grow into true apex predators.
Never — the powerful smell of an apex predator keeps all other animals away.
Only during storms, when the mother cannot protect her young.
Only if the young leave the territory of their parents.
explanation: Even apex predators guard their young carefully because babies and eggs can be caught by other animals before the young are big and strong.
fact_tl: Kahit apex predator ang isang hayop, ang mga anak o itlog nito ay maaari pa ring mahuli ng ibang hayop. Nagiging tunay na apex predator lamang sila kapag malaki at malakas na. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit maingat na binabantayan ng ina ang kanyang mga anak.
fact_bis: Bisan ug apex predator ang usa ka hayop, ang mga anak o itlog niini mahimo gihapong madakpan sa ubang hayop. Mahimo lang silang tinuod nga apex predator kon dako ug kusgan na. Mao kana nga mabinantayon nga bantayan sa inahan ang iyang mga anak.

q: Approximately how fast is the land speed record set by the ThrustSSC car?
options: About 1,228 kilometers per hour.
About 500 kilometers per hour.
About 800 kilometers per hour.
About 2,000 kilometers per hour.
explanation: The land speed record for a car is about 1,228 kilometers per hour, set by the ThrustSSC.
fact_tl: Ang land speed record para sa kotse ay humigit-kumulang 1,228 kilometro kada oras, na itinakda ng ThrustSSC.
fact_bis: Ang land speed record para sa awto mga 1,228 ka kilometro kada oras, gitakda sa ThrustSSC.

q: Why is it important to eat calcium-rich foods regularly, even after your bones have fully grown?
options: Because bones are alive and constantly repair and rebuild themselves using calcium.
Because calcium dissolves the cartilage that protects your joints as you age.
Because bones stop absorbing calcium after age 10 unless you keep eating it daily.
Because calcium travels to your muscles and makes them stronger instead of your bones.
explanation: Bones are alive and constantly changing; they use calcium for nonstop repair work, so regular calcium intake supports this process.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na patay na bagay ang buto, pero buhay ito! Ang iyong mga buto ay patuloy na nagbabago at nag-aayos ng sarili gamit ang calcium. Kaya ang regular na pagkain ng calcium ay nakakatulong sa tuloy-tuloy na pag-aayos na ito.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga patay na butang ang bukog, apan buhi kini! Ang imong mga bukog kanunayng nag-usab ug nag-ayo sa ilang kaugalingon gamit ang calcium. Busa ang regular nga pagkaon og calcium makatabang niini nga padayon nga pag-ayo.

q: About how many teeth does an adult male horse have?
options: About 40 teeth.
About 20 teeth.
About 32 teeth.
About 56 teeth.
explanation: An adult male horse has about 40 teeth.
fact_tl: Ang isang lalaking matandang kabayo (horse) ay may humigit-kumulang 40 ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hamtong nga laki nga kabayo (horse) adunay mga 40 ka ngipon.

q: How do fish breathe underwater?
options: They use gills to take oxygen from the water.
They hold their breath and come up to the surface to breathe air.
They absorb oxygen directly through their scales.
They use small lungs located behind their gills.
explanation: Fish do not have lungs; they use gills to take oxygen from the water.
fact_tl: Ang isda ay walang baga; gumagamit ito ng hasang upang kunin ang oksiheno mula sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang isda walay baga; mogamit kini og hasang aron kuhaon ang oksiheno gikan sa tubig.

q: Why are the Chocolate Hills in Bohol called by that name?
options: Because the grass covering them turns chocolate-brown during the dry season.
Because the rock they are made of is the same brown color as chocolate.
Because the soil around them is dark brown and rich in minerals.
Because local legend says a giant spilled chocolate milk over the hills long ago.
explanation: They are called the Chocolate Hills because in the dry season the grass turns chocolate-brown, making the hills look like chocolate candies.
fact_tl: Tinawag silang Chocolate Hills dahil sa tag-init nagiging kayumangging parang tsokolate ang tuyong damo sa mga burol.
fact_bis: Gitawag silag Chocolate Hills tungod kay sa ting-init ang uga nga sagbot mahimong brown sama sa tsokolate.

q: How can some plants that have mild natural poisons become safe to eat?
options: By cooking them properly, which removes the poison.
By soaking them in saltwater overnight to dissolve the toxins.
By eating them only when they are very ripe, before poisons develop.
By removing the skin, where all plant poisons are stored.
explanation: Some plants with mild natural poisons become safe to eat once they are properly cooked.
fact_tl: May mga halamang may bahagyang lason na nagiging ligtas kainin kapag niluto nang maayos.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom nga adunay gamayng hilo nga mahimong luwas kan-on kung maayong giluto.

q: Where was silk first made, and what creature produced the thread?
options: In China, from the thread of the silkworm.
In India, from the cocoon of the monarch butterfly.
In Japan, from fibers scraped off the bark of the mulberry tree.
In Egypt, from the web of the golden orb spider.
explanation: Silk was first made in China from the thread of the silkworm.
fact_tl: Ang sutla (silk) ay unang ginawa sa Tsina mula sa hibla ng silkworm.
fact_bis: Ang sutla (silk) unang gihimo sa China gikan sa hilo sa silkworm.

q: Besides folding when touched, what else does the makahiya plant do at night?
options: Its leaves fold up as if sleeping, even without being touched.
Its flowers close tightly to protect pollen from the dark.
Its roots pull the plant slightly into the ground for safety.
Its stem bends toward the ground until morning light returns.
explanation: The makahiya's leaves fold up at night, as if sleeping, even when no one touches them.
fact_tl: Nagtitiklop din ang mga dahon ng makahiya kapag gabi, na parang natutulog ito, kahit walang humahawak.
fact_bis: Magtiklop usab ang mga dahon sa makahiya kung gabii, nga morag natulog kini, bisan walay muhikap niini.

q: What happens to the sound of a bell if you grab it tightly after striking it?
options: The sound stops immediately because you are stopping the vibration.
The sound gets louder because your hand amplifies the vibrations.
The sound continues for a few seconds before slowly fading.
The sound changes pitch but does not stop right away.
explanation: When you hold a struck bell to stop its vibration, the sound stops immediately, showing that sound is produced by vibration.
fact_tl: Kapag tinamaang ang kampana, ito ay nangingisig at gumagawa ng tunog — kapag hawakan mo ang kampana para pigilin ang vibration, natitigil din ang tunog.
fact_bis: Kung tinahasan ang kampana nagalingkod kini ug nagabuhat og tunog — kung hawakan mo ang kampana aron pugngan ang vibration, mounay dayon ang tunog.

q: Who created the Mohs hardness scale, and when?
options: Friedrich Mohs, a German scientist, in 1812.
Charles Darwin, a British naturalist, in 1859.
Antoine Lavoisier, a French chemist, in 1789.
Marie Curie, a Polish scientist, in 1898.
explanation: Friedrich Mohs, a German scientist, created the Mohs hardness scale in 1812 to rank the hardness of minerals.
fact_tl: Si Friedrich Mohs, isang German na siyentipiko, ang gumawa ng Mohs hardness scale noong 1812.
fact_bis: Si Friedrich Mohs, usa ka German nga siyentista, ang naghimo sa Mohs hardness scale niadtong 1812.

q: How do coral reefs help protect coastlines?
options: They break the force of big waves, protecting the coast from storms and erosion.
They absorb carbon dioxide from the sea, making the water calmer.
They anchor the seafloor so strong currents cannot shift the sand toward shore.
They attract fish that eat the sand and keep the seabed level.
explanation: Coral reefs break the force of big waves, protecting the coast from storms and erosion.
fact_tl: Pinipigilan ng coral reef ang lakas ng malalaking alon, kaya nagsisilbi itong proteksyon ng baybayin laban sa bagyo at pagguho.
fact_bis: Ang coral reef magpugong sa kusog sa dagkong balod, mao nga kini magsilbing panalipod sa baybayon batok sa bagyo ug pagguba.

q: How is a swiftlet's echolocation different from a bat's?
options: A swiftlet uses sounds humans can hear, while bats use very high-pitched sounds we cannot hear.
A swiftlet uses its eyes in the dark, while bats use sound to navigate.
A swiftlet clicks only once per second, while bats click thousands of times per second.
A swiftlet only navigates by smell, while bats use echolocation.
explanation: A swiftlet's echolocation uses sounds we can actually hear, unlike bats which use very high-pitched sounds humans cannot hear.
fact_tl: Ang echolocation ng swiftlet ay gumagamit ng tunog na kaya nating marinig, hindi tulad ng paniki na gumagamit ng napakataas na tunog na hindi naririnig ng tao. Kaya pag pumasok ka sa kweba, naririnig mo ang kanilang pag-click.
fact_bis: Ang echolocation sa swiftlet naggamit og tingog nga atong madungog, dili sama sa kabog nga naggamit og taas kaayo nga tingog nga dili madungog sa tawo. Busa kung mosulod ka sa ilang langob, madungog nimo ang ilang pag-click.

q: What are people likely to experience during a PEIS Intensity VI (Very Strong) earthquake?
options: Many people feel frightened and run outdoors, find it hard to stand, and heavy furniture may move.
Only sleeping people wake up, but standing people feel nothing unusual.
People feel a gentle swaying and objects on shelves rattle but nothing falls.
Buildings collapse and the ground cracks open along streets.
explanation: At PEIS Intensity VI, many people are frightened and run outdoors, find it hard to stand steadily, and heavy furniture may move.
fact_tl: Sa Intensity VI (Very Strong) ng PEIS, marami ang natatakot at tumatakbo palabas, nahihirapang tumayo nang tuwid, at gumagalaw ang mabibigat na muwebles.
fact_bis: Sa Intensity VI (Very Strong) sa PEIS, daghan ang nahadlok ug midagan pagawas, naglisod sa pagtindog nga tul-id, ug ang bug-at nga muwebles mahimong molihok.

q: Why do some people need to get a new flu vaccine every year?
options: Because the flu virus changes every year, so the body needs to be taught its new form.
Because the flu vaccine wears off in exactly 365 days for everyone.
Because the flu virus destroys the antibodies from last year's vaccine each spring.
Because doctors improve the vaccine recipe each year to make it stronger.
explanation: The flu virus changes every year, so a new vaccine is needed yearly to teach the body to recognize its new form.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bakuna ay panghabambuhay. Ang ilang germ tulad ng trangkaso ay nagbabago kada taon, kaya kailangan ng bagong bakuna taun-taon para alam ng katawan ang panibagong anyo nito.
fact_bis: Dili tanang bakuna molungtad sa tibuok kinabuhi. Ang ubang germ sama sa trangkaso mausab matag tuig, mao nga kinahanglan og bag-ong bakuna kada tuig aron mahibaw-an sa lawas ang bag-o niini nga porma.

q: Where does a pomelo (suha) grow?
options: On a large tree, with heavy fruits hanging from its branches.
On a vine that climbs along fences and walls.
Underground, like a root vegetable.
On a low bush close to the ground.
explanation: Pomelo grows on a large tree, not on a vine or on the ground; the tree produces heavy fruits that hang from its branches.
fact_tl: Ang suha ay tumutubo sa isang malaking puno, hindi sa baging o sa lupa. Namumunga ito ng mabibigat na prutas na nakasabit sa mga sanga.
fact_bis: Ang suha motubo sa dako nga kahoy, dili sa balagon o sa yuta. Mamunga kini og bug-at nga prutas nga nagbitay sa mga sanga.

q: How many sets of teeth does a human get in their entire lifetime?
options: Two sets — baby teeth and then permanent teeth.
Three sets — baby teeth, adult teeth, and wisdom teeth.
One set — permanent teeth that grow when baby teeth fall out.
Four sets — teeth keep replacing themselves throughout life.
explanation: Unlike sharks, humans get only two sets of teeth in a lifetime: baby teeth and the permanent teeth that replace them.
fact_tl: Hindi gaya ng pating, ang tao ay may dalawang set lamang ng ngipin sa buong buhay: ang gatas na ngipin at ang permanenteng ngipin na pumapalit.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa iho, ang tawo adunay duha lang ka set sa ngipon sa tibuok kinabuhi: ang gatas nga ngipon ug ang permanente nga ngipon nga mopuli niini.

q: Which planet has the shortest day in our solar system, and how long is it?
options: Jupiter, with a day of only about 10 hours.
Saturn, with a day of only about 11 hours.
Mercury, with a day of only about 12 hours.
Mars, with a day of only about 8 hours.
explanation: One day on Jupiter lasts only about 10 hours, making it the shortest day of any planet in the solar system.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Jupiter ay tumatagal lamang ng halos 10 oras, ang pinakamaikling araw sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Jupiter motagal lamang ug mga 10 ka oras, ang pinakamubo nga adlaw sa tanang planeta.

q: What is the approximate value of pi (π) used in math?
options: About 3.14
About 2.72
About 1.41
About 4.28
explanation: Pi (π) is about 3.14, a special number used in calculations involving circles.
fact_tl: Ang pi (π) ay humigit-kumulang 3.14, isang espesyal na numero sa matematika na ginagamit para sa mga bilog.
fact_bis: Ang pi (π) mga 3.14, usa ka espesyal nga numero sa matematika nga gigamit para sa mga lingin.

q: How many protons does a silicon (Si) atom have?
options: 14 protons, because silicon's atomic number is 14.
8 protons, the same as oxygen.
28 protons, which equals its atomic mass.
6 protons, the same as carbon.
explanation: The atomic number of silicon is 14, which means it has 14 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng silicon (Si) ay 14, kaya may 14 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa silicon (Si) kay 14, mao nga naa kini 14 ka proton.

q: What happens to a supersaturated solution when it cools down or water evaporates from it?
options: The excess dissolved substance deposits onto a seed crystal, making it grow
The solution becomes even more saturated and stays liquid
The dissolved substance disappears and the solution becomes clear
The water turns to ice and traps the dissolved substance inside
explanation: As a supersaturated solution cools or loses water, the excess dissolved substance deposits on a seed crystal and builds up, causing the crystal to grow.
fact_tl: Ang mga kristal ay lumalaki mula sa isang supersaturated na solusyon — isang solusyon na may mas maraming natunaw na sangkap kaysa sa normal. Kapag lumamig ang solusyon o nagsimulang masingaw ang tubig, ang labis na sangkap ay nagkakapatong sa isang seed crystal at lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang mga kristal motubo gikan sa usa ka supersaturated nga solusyon — usa ka solusyon nga adunay mas daghang natunaw nga substansya kaysa normal. Sa pagpabugnaw sa solusyon o pagsingaw sa tubig, ang sobra nga substansya nagpatong sa seed crystal ug motubo kini.

q: Where is the largest coal mine in the Philippines located?
options: Semirara Island in Antique
Dinagat Island in Surigao del Norte
Camiguin Island in Misamis Oriental
Samar Island in Eastern Samar
explanation: Semirara Island in Antique is the site of the Philippines' largest coal mine and supplies a large portion of the country's energy needs.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may deposito ng uling (coal); ang pinakamalaking minahan ng uling ay ang Semirara Island sa Antique, na nagbibigay ng malaking bahagi ng pangangailangan ng bansa sa enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay deposito sa uling (coal); ang pinakadakling minahan sa uling mao ang Semirara Island sa Antique, nga naghatag og dakong bahin sa pangangailangan sa enerhiya sa nasud.

q: When was Tagalog chosen as the basis of the Philippine national language?
options: December 30, 1937, under President Quezon
July 4, 1946, when the Philippines gained independence
June 12, 1898, during the Proclamation of Independence
November 15, 1935, when the Commonwealth was established
explanation: Tagalog was officially chosen as the basis of the national language on December 30, 1937, under President Quezon.
fact_tl: Pinili ang Tagalog bilang batayan ng wikang pambansa noong Disyembre 30, 1937, sa ilalim ni Pangulong Quezon.
fact_bis: Ang Tagalog gipili nga basihan sa nasudnong pinulongan niadtong Disyembre 30, 1937, ilalom ni Presidente Quezon.

q: What is the best way to protect your teeth from cigarette stains and harm?
options: Never start smoking in the first place
Brush your teeth twice a day even if you smoke
Use whitening toothpaste regularly after smoking
Drink lots of water while you smoke to wash away stains
explanation: The best way to avoid the stains and harm from cigarettes is to never start smoking, because it is easier to protect clean teeth than to repair damaged ones.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabuting paraan para maiwasan ang mantsa at sakit mula sa sigarilyo ay ang hindi pagsisimula nito. Mas madaling protektahan ang malinis na ngipin kaysa ayusin ang nasira na.
fact_bis: Ang labing maayong paagi aron malikayan ang mantsa ug kadaot gikan sa sigarilyo mao ang dili pagsugod niini. Mas sayon panalipdan ang limpyo nga ngipon kaysa ayohon ang nadaot na.

q: Why do people sometimes sneeze two or three times in a row?
options: One sneeze may not be enough to clear all the irritants from the nose, so the body repeats it
The nose muscles become stronger and trigger extra sneezes after the first one
Each sneeze releases a hormone that causes another sneeze to follow
Air pressure inside the nose builds up and forces more sneezes
explanation: Sometimes one sneeze cannot clear everything irritating the nose, so the body repeats the reflex until the nose is clear.
fact_tl: Minsan hindi sapat ang isang bahing para matanggal ang lahat ng nakakairita sa ilong, kaya inuulit ito ng katawan. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit kung minsan ka napapabahing nang dalawa, tatlo, o higit pang beses.
fact_bis: Usahay dili igo ang usa ka bahin aron mawala ang tanang nakahasol sa ilong, busa balikon kini sa lawas. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong usahay mobahin ka ug duha, tulo, o labaw pa ka higayon.

q: What does the Philippine Renewable Energy Act (Republic Act 9513) provide to encourage clean energy production?
options: A feed-in tariff that pays a premium price to solar, wind, and geothermal producers
Free land for wind farms in areas with strong winds
Tax exemptions for all households that install solar panels
Government subsidies for buying electric vehicles
explanation: RA 9513 includes a feed-in tariff that pays a premium price to producers of solar, wind, and geothermal electricity to encourage clean energy development.
fact_tl: Ang Republic Act 9513 o Renewable Energy Act ng Pilipinas (2008) ay nagbibigay ng mga insentibo para sa mga kumpanyang gumagawa ng malinis na enerhiya — kasama ang feed-in tariff na nagbabayad ng mas mataas na presyo sa mga producer ng solar, wind, at geothermal na kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang Republic Act 9513 o Renewable Energy Act sa Pilipinas (2008) naghatag ug mga insentibo alang sa mga kumpanya nga nagmugna ug malinis nga enerhiya — lakip ang feed-in tariff nga nagbayad ug mas taas nga presyo sa mga producer sa solar, wind, ug geothermal nga kuryente.

q: What is the name of the rigid outer layer of Earth made up of the crust and the top of the mantle?
options: The lithosphere
The asthenosphere
The mesosphere
The hydrosphere
explanation: The crust and the very top of the mantle together form the rigid layer called the lithosphere, which is broken into tectonic plates.
fact_tl: Ang crust at pinakaitaas na bahagi ng mantle ay magkasamang bumubuo ng matigas na patong na tinatawag na lithosphere. Nahahati ito sa malalaking piraso na tinatawag na tectonic plates na dahan-dahang naglulutang sa mas malambot na mantle sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang crust ug ang pinakaibabaw nga bahin sa mantle nagtingob aron maporma ang gahi nga patong nga gitawag og lithosphere. Nabahin kini sa dagkong mga piraso nga gitawag og tectonic plates nga hinay nga naglutaw sa mas humok nga mantle sa ilalom.

q: Where are the inner organs of an electric eel located in its long body?
options: Packed into the front part of the body because most of the body is electric organs
Spread evenly along the full length of the body
Located in the tail section at the back of the body
Stored in a special pouch in the middle of the body
explanation: Because most of the electric eel's long body is taken up by electric organs, its inner organs are packed into only the front part.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mahabang katawan ng electric eel ay binubuo ng mga organong gumagawa ng kuryente, kaya ang mga lamang-loob nito ay nasa harapang bahagi lamang.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa taas nga lawas sa electric eel gilangkuban sa mga organo nga naghimo og kuryente, busa ang sulod nga bahin niini anaa lamang sa unahan.

q: Why do you breathe faster during exercise?
options: Your muscles need more oxygen when they work harder, so your body brings in more air
Your lungs grow bigger during exercise and need more air to fill up
Exercise produces extra carbon dioxide that pushes more air out of the lungs
Your heart pumps air instead of blood to the muscles during hard work
explanation: Muscles need more oxygen when they work harder during exercise, which is why breathing and heart rate increase.
fact_tl: Ang iyong mga kalamnan ay nangangailangan ng mas maraming oxygen kapag mas magtrabaho sila habang nag-eehersisyo.
fact_bis: Ang imong mga unod nanginahanglan og mas daghang oxygen kon mas kusgan sila molihok samtang nag-ehersisyo.

q: How is the chewy nata de coco made?
options: Bacteria ferment coconut water and build up a thick mat of cellulose
Coconut jelly is extracted from the inside of young coconut shells
Coconut milk is heated until it thickens and sets into solid cubes
Sugar is added to coconut water and it is frozen into clear blocks
explanation: Nata de coco is produced when bacteria ferment coconut water and build up a thick, edible mat of cellulose.
fact_tl: Ang malutong na nata de coco ay gawa ng bakteryang nagbuburo ng tubig ng niyog at gumagawa ng makapal na selulosa na pwedeng kainin.
fact_bis: Ang nata de coco gihimo sa bakterya nga mag-fermento sa tubig sa lubi ug magtukod ug baga nga selulosa nga makaon.

q: What happens to atoms when something burns or rots?
options: The atoms move into other things but are not destroyed
The atoms are broken apart into smaller pieces called protons and electrons
The atoms disappear completely and become pure energy
The atoms combine permanently and can no longer be separated
explanation: Atoms are never destroyed; when something burns or rots, its atoms simply move into other substances and keep cycling through nature.
fact_tl: Hindi basta nawawala o nauubos ang mga atomo. Kapag nasunog o nabulok ang isang bagay, hindi naglalaho ang atomo kundi napupunta lang sa ibang bagay. Paikot-ikot lang ang parehong mga atomo sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Dili basta mawala o mahurot ang mga atomo. Kung masunog o madunot ang usa ka butang, dili mawala ang atomo kondili moadto lang sa ubang butang. Ang samang mga atomo magpadayon og libot sa kinaiyahan.

q: How do the anglerfish and the glowing bacteria benefit each other?
options: The bacteria get a home inside the fish and the fish gets light from the bacteria
The bacteria feed on parasites on the fish while the fish feeds on the bacteria
The bacteria make oxygen for the fish and the fish provides nutrients to the bacteria
The bacteria keep the fish warm in deep water and the fish protects the bacteria from predators
explanation: This is a mutualistic relationship: the glowing bacteria get shelter inside the anglerfish, and the anglerfish uses the bacteria's light to attract prey.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish at ang nagliliwanag na bakterya ay nagtutulungan: nakakakuha ng tahanan ang bakterya, at nagkakaroon ng ilaw ang isda.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish ug ang nagsiga nga bakterya nagtinabangay: ang bakterya makakuha og puy-anan, ug ang isda makabaton og kahayag.

q: How does the clownfish help the sea anemone breathe at night?
options: It wiggles inside the anemone to push fresh, oxygen-rich water through it
It covers the anemone with its fins to trap warm water around it
It releases bubbles of oxygen from its gills into the anemone's body
It swims in circles above the anemone to drive water downward into it
explanation: The clownfish wiggles around inside the anemone at night to push fresh water through it, delivering the oxygen the anemone needs.
fact_tl: Sa gabi, ang clownfish ay kumakaway-kaway sa loob ng anemone para magpadaloy ng sariwang tubig dito. Nagdadala ito ng oxygen na kailangan ng anemone para huminga nang mabuti. Kaya kahit habang natutulog ang dagat, may tumutulong sa anemone.
fact_bis: Sa gabii, ang clownfish mokisi-kisi sa sulod sa anemone aron magpaagi og presko nga tubig niini. Magdala kini og oxygen nga gikinahanglan sa anemone aron makaginhawa og maayo. Mao nga bisan matulog ang dagat, naay motabang sa anemone.

q: Why is the katala also called the red-vented cockatoo?
options: Because it has red feathers under its tail
Because it has a red patch on its cheeks near the beak
Because its crest turns red when it is excited
Because the tips of its wings are bright red
explanation: The katala earned the name 'red-vented cockatoo' from the distinctive red feathers found under its tail.
fact_tl: Tinatawag din ang katala na red-vented cockatoo dahil sa pulang balahibo sa ilalim ng buntot nito.
fact_bis: Ang katala gitawag usab nga red-vented cockatoo tungod sa pula nga balahibo sa ilalom sa ikog niini.

q: Which unit of electrical measurement is named after Georg Ohm?
options: The ohm, which measures electrical resistance
The volt, which measures electrical pressure
The ampere, which measures electrical current
The watt, which measures electrical power
explanation: The ohm (symbol Ω) is the unit of electrical resistance, named in honor of Georg Ohm who discovered the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng elektrikal na resistensya, ang ohm (simbolo Ω), ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa elektrikal nga resistensya, ang ohm (simbolo Ω), ginganlan kay Georg Ohm.

q: How is the pilandok usually described in Philippine folklore?
options: As a clever trickster that outwits larger animals through quick thinking
As a fierce hunter that defeats enemies through strength and speed
As a wise elder that teaches younger animals the ways of the forest
As a loyal companion that helps humans find food in the jungle
explanation: In Philippine folklore, the pilandok is portrayed as a clever trickster that uses quick thinking to outsmart larger, stronger animals.
fact_tl: Sa alamat ng Pilipinas, ang pilandok ay madalas na inilalarawan bilang matalinong nilalang na nanaig sa mas malalaking hayop sa pamamagitan ng katalinuhan.
fact_bis: Sa mga alamat sa Pilipinas, ang pilandok kasagaran gipakita isip usa ka matalinong manloloko nga nagdaog sa mas dagkong mananap pinaagi sa kusog sa isip.

q: What is a force?
options: A push or a pull that acts on an object
The weight of an object pressing down on a surface
The energy stored inside a moving object
The speed at which an object travels from one place to another
explanation: A force is defined as a push or a pull that acts on an object, which can change the object's motion or shape.
fact_tl: Ang puwersa ay isang tulak o hila na ginagawa mo sa isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang puwersa usa ka tulod o bira nga gibuhat sa usa ka butang.

q: What do most frogs do after laying their eggs in water?
options: They leave the eggs, which develop into tadpoles that can survive on their own
They guard the eggs until they hatch and then carry the tadpoles on their backs
They eat the eggs to prevent predators from finding them and then lay more eggs later
They build a nest of mud and leaves around the eggs to keep them safe
explanation: Most frogs lay their eggs in water and leave them; the eggs hatch into tadpoles that are able to survive and grow without any parental care.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa palaka ay nangingitlog sa tubig at iniiwan ang mga ito; ang mga itlog ay nagiging tadpole (ulo-ulo) na kayang mabuhay nang walang magulang.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa baki mangitlog sa tubig ug biyaan kini; ang mga itlog mahimong olang (tadpole) nga makahimo nga mabuhi nga walay ginikanan.

q: How does a cold-blooded animal's activity level change with temperature?
options: It moves faster and is more active when warm, and becomes sluggish when cold
It moves faster in the cold to generate heat and slows down when warm
Its activity stays the same regardless of the temperature around it
It is most active at night when temperatures drop, and rests during the day
explanation: Cold-blooded animals depend on their environment for body heat, so they are more active in warm conditions and sluggish in cold conditions.
fact_tl: Mas masigla at mabilis kumilos ang mga hayop na malamig ang dugo kapag mainit ang panahon, at nagiging mabagal kapag malamig.
fact_bis: Ang mga hayop nga bugnaw ug dugo mas kusog molihok kung init ang panahon, ug mahinay kung bugnaw.

q: What does the fossil record tell us about life on Earth over millions of years?
options: The kinds of living things changed over time and many ancient animals no longer exist
All living things today are exactly the same as they were millions of years ago
Only plants changed over time while animals stayed the same
Fossils show that living things have always moved to new places but never changed
explanation: The fossil record shows that living things changed over millions of years, and many ancient species that once existed are now extinct.
fact_tl: Ang talaan ng mga fossil ay nagpapakita na nagbago ang mga uri ng buhay sa paglipas ng milyon-milyong taon, at maraming hayop noon ay wala na ngayon.
fact_bis: Ang rekord sa mga fossil nagpakita nga nausab ang mga matang sa kinabuhi sulod sa minilyon ka tuig, ug daghang karaang mananap wala na karon.

q: Which Philippine province is known for its wind farms that use the amihan wind to generate electricity?
options: Ilocos Norte
Batanes
Sarangani
Aurora
explanation: Bangui and Burgos in Ilocos Norte have wind farms that harness the amihan (northeast) wind to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may malaking potensyal para sa wind energy; ang Bangui at Burgos sa Ilocos Norte ay may mga wind farm na gumagamit ng hangin ng amihan upang makagawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay dako nga potensyal alang sa wind energy; ang Bangui ug Burgos sa Ilocos Norte adunay mga wind farm nga naggamit sa hangin sa amihan aron makahimo og kuryente.

q: How does the swim bladder help a fish save energy?
options: It lets the fish stay at one depth without constantly swimming
It stores extra food so the fish does not need to eat as often
It filters oxygen from the water so the fish breathes less often
It keeps the fish warm so the body does not use energy to make heat
explanation: The swim bladder allows a fish to maintain its depth without continuously swimming, which saves a significant amount of energy.
fact_tl: Dahil sa swim bladder, kayang manatili ng isda sa isang lalim nang hindi laging lumalangoy, kaya nakakatipid ito ng lakas.
fact_bis: Tungod sa swim bladder, makapabilin ang isda sa usa ka kalawom nga dili kanunay maglangoy, mao nga makatipig kini og kusog.

q: How does the sailfin lizard escape from a predator that is chasing it?
options: It jumps into water and dives, staying underwater for several minutes until the danger passes
It runs very fast to the nearest tree and climbs high into the branches
It puffs up its sail-like fin to look bigger and scare the predator away
It buries itself under sand or mud and stays motionless until the predator leaves
explanation: When threatened, the sailfin lizard jumps into water and dives, remaining underwater for several minutes until the predator moves away.
fact_tl: Kapag may panganib, ang sailfin lizard ay tumatalon sa tubig at sumisid para magtago. Kaya niyang manatili sa ilalim ng tubig nang ilang minuto hanggang umalis na ang ibon o hayop na humahabol sa kanya.
fact_bis: Kung adunay kakuyaw, ang sailfin lizard moambak sa tubig ug mosalom aron magtago. Makapabilin kini ilalom sa tubig og pipila ka minuto hangtod mobiya ang langgam o hayop nga naggukod niini.

q: What is the purpose of contact tracing during a disease outbreak?
options: To identify and notify people who may have been exposed to an infectious disease to prevent further spread
To count how many people are sick so hospitals can prepare enough beds and medicine
To find the animal or insect that first passed the disease to humans
To test everyone in a community for the disease whether they have symptoms or not
explanation: Contact tracing is a public health method of identifying and notifying people who may have been exposed to an infectious disease, helping to prevent its further spread.
fact_tl: Ang contact tracing ay isang pamamaraan ng public health kung saan tinutukoy at inaalam ang mga taong maaaring nalantad sa isang sakit — nakatutulong ito na pigilan ang karagdagang pagkalat ng impeksyon.
fact_bis: Ang contact tracing usa ka pamamaraan sa public health diin gihibaw-an ug gipahibalo ang mga tawo nga posibleng nalantad sa usa ka infectious disease — nagtabang kini nga mapugngan ang dugang pa nga pagkaylap.

q: Where do sloths naturally live?
options: In the warm rainforests of Central and South America
In the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, including the Philippines
In the dry grasslands of Africa near the equator
In the mountain forests of East Asia near the Himalayas
explanation: Sloths are native to the warm rainforests of Central and South America and are not found in the wild in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Natural na naninirahan ang sloth sa mainit na kagubatan ng Gitna at Timog Amerika, at hindi ito likas sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang sloth natural nga nagpuyo sa init nga kalasangan sa Tunga ug Habagatang Amerika, ug dili kini lumad sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do large animals like carabao make low, deep sounds compared to small animals?
options: Large animals have big, thick vocal cords that vibrate slowly, producing low-pitched sounds
Large animals breathe more air through wider lungs, which makes the sound louder and deeper
Large animals have smaller mouths that block high-pitched sounds from escaping
Large animals live in open fields where low sounds travel farther than high sounds
explanation: Large animals have large, thick vocal cords that vibrate slowly, which produces low-pitched, deep sounds.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking hayop tulad ng kalabaw at baka ay may malalaki at makakapal na vocal cords sa lalamunan. Mabagal silang mag-vibrate kaya mababa at malalim ang kanilang boses kumpara sa maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong mananap sama sa kabaw ug baka adunay dako ug baga nga vocal cords sa ilang tutunlan. Hinay sila mag-vibrate busa mubo ug lawom ang ilang tingog kumpara sa gagmay nga mananap.

q: Why can science not yet explain what happened before the Big Bang?
options: Because time itself began at the Big Bang, so there was no 'before' that science can describe
Because all the evidence from that period was destroyed in the explosion
Because scientists have not built telescopes powerful enough to see that far back
Because the universe was completely dark before the Big Bang and left no light to study
explanation: Science cannot explain what happened before the Big Bang because even time itself began at that moment, making 'before' a concept that does not apply.
fact_tl: Hindi pa kayang ipaliwanag ng agham kung ano ang nangyari bago ang Big Bang, dahil doon nagsimula maging ang panahon mismo.
fact_bis: Wala pa masaysay sa siyensya kung unsa ang nahitabo sa wala pa ang Big Bang, kay didto nagsugod bisan ang panahon mismo.

q: Can you tell whether a bacterium is harmful or helpful just by looking at its shape?
options: No, because every shape of bacteria includes both harmful and helpful kinds
Yes, because round bacteria are always the helpful kind found in food
Yes, because rod-shaped bacteria are always the type that cause disease
No, but spiral-shaped bacteria are always the most dangerous kind
explanation: Shape does NOT determine whether a bacterium is harmful or helpful — every shape, whether round, rod, or spiral, includes both harmful and beneficial kinds.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang bilog na bakterya ay mabuti at ang pahaba ay masama (o kabaligtaran). Ang hugis ay HINDI nagsasabi kung nakakasakit o nakakatulong ang bakterya. May mabuti at masamang bakterya sa bawat hugis.
fact_bis: Sayop nga panghunahuna nga ang lingin nga bakterya maayo ug ang taas daotan (o sukwahi). Ang porma DILI magtug-an kon makasakit o makatabang ang bakterya. Matag porma adunay maayo ug daotan nga matang.

q: What is the lowest point of dry land on Earth?
options: The Dead Sea, which lies below sea level
The Mariana Trench, which is the deepest point in the ocean
Death Valley in California, which is very far below sea level
The Caspian Sea, which is lower than most bodies of water
explanation: The Dead Sea is the lowest point of dry land on Earth, lying well below sea level.
fact_tl: Ang Dead Sea (Patay na Dagat) ang pinakamababang lugar sa lupa ng Mundo, mas mababa pa sa lebel ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Dead Sea (Patay nga Dagat) mao ang labing ubos nga dapit sa yuta sa Kalibutan, mas ubos pa sa lebel sa dagat.

q: During which era did humans appear in Earth's history?
options: At the very end of the Cenozoic Era
During the middle of the Mesozoic Era alongside the dinosaurs
During the early Paleozoic Era when complex life first appeared
At the beginning of the Cenozoic Era right after the dinosaurs went extinct
explanation: Humans appeared in the very last part of the Cenozoic Era, which is a tiny fraction of Earth's total age.
fact_tl: Ang mga tao ay lumitaw sa pinakahuling bahagi ng Cenozoic Era, na napakaikli kumpara sa edad ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang mga tawo mitungha sa kinaulahiang bahin sa Cenozoic Era, mubo kaayo kung itandi sa edad sa Kalibutan.

q: What does a dot-and-cross diagram show about electrons in a chemical bond?
options: Which atom each valence electron in the bond originally came from
How fast electrons move between two bonded atoms
How many electrons are in the nucleus of each atom
Which electrons have the highest energy level in the bond
explanation: A dot-and-cross diagram uses dots and crosses to distinguish which atom each valence electron in a chemical bond originally came from.
fact_tl: Ang dot-and-cross diagram ay gumagamit ng mga tuldok at krus para ipakita kung saang atomo galing ang bawat valence electron sa isang bond.
fact_bis: Ang dot-and-cross diagram naggamit og mga tuldok ug krus aron ipakita kon asang atomo gikan ang matag valence electron sa usa ka bond.

q: Who was the first to use the word 'cell' to describe the tiny units of living things?
options: Robert Hooke, in 1665
Anton van Leeuwenhoek, in 1683
Louis Pasteur, in 1859
Charles Darwin, in 1859
explanation: Robert Hooke was the first to call the tiny units of living things 'cells' when he observed them under a microscope in 1665.
fact_tl: Si Robert Hooke ang unang tumawag na 'cell' (selula) sa maliliit na bahagi ng buhay na bagay noong 1665.
fact_bis: Si Robert Hooke ang una nga nagtawag og 'cell' (selula) sa gagmay nga bahin sa buhing butang niadtong 1665.

q: On a distance-time graph, what does a flat horizontal line mean?
options: The object is not moving
The object is moving at a very fast, constant speed
The object is slowing down and about to stop
The object is accelerating quickly
explanation: On a distance-time graph, a flat (horizontal) line means the distance is not changing, so the object is not moving.
fact_tl: Sa isang distance-time graph, ipinapakita ng mas matarik na linya ang mas mabilis na galaw, at ang patag na linya naman ay nangangahulugang nakatigil ang bagay.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka distance-time graph, ang mas tarik nga linya nagpakita sa mas paspas nga lihok, samtang ang patag nga linya nagpasabot nga ang butang wala maglihok.

q: How does recycling paper help protect forests?
options: Fewer trees need to be cut down because old paper is cleaned and turned into new paper
Trees grow faster when paper is recycled because they absorb the recycled chemicals
Recycled paper is stronger than new paper so less paper is needed overall
Recycling paper removes pollution from rivers, which helps trees near the water grow better
explanation: When paper is recycled, old paper is cleaned and made into new paper, which means fewer trees need to be cut down to produce fresh paper.
fact_tl: Kapag nire-recycle ang papel, hindi na kailangang magputol ng maraming puno para gumawa ng bagong papel. Ang lumang papel ay nililinis at ginagawang bagong papel. Nakakatipid din ito ng tubig at enerhiya na karaniwang ginagamit sa paggawa ng papel mula sa kahoy.
fact_bis: Kon i-recycle ang papel, dili na kinahanglan magputol ug daghang kahoy aron makahimo ug bag-ong papel. Ang daang papel limpyohan ug himuong bag-ong papel. Makatipig usab kini ug tubig ug enerhiya nga sagad gigamit sa paghimo ug papel gikan sa kahoy.

q: What part of the coconut palm plant is used to fill a pan de coco bun?
options: The grated seed, known as coconut meat
The coconut flower nectar called coconut syrup
The soft inner husk that surrounds the coconut shell
The tender young leaves at the top of the palm tree
explanation: Pan de coco is filled with grated coconut, which comes from the large seed of the coconut palm tree.
fact_tl: Ang pan de coco ay tinapay na may palaman na gadgad na niyog, at ang niyog ay galing sa malaking buto ng punong niyog na lumalaki sa init na klima ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang pan de coco usa ka pan nga gisudlan og kinudkod nga lubi, ug ang lubi gikan sa dako nga liso sa kahoy nga lubi nga maayong motubo sa init nga klima sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the peacock's long, colorful train actually made of?
options: Feathers that grow above the peacock's real tail, called upper tail coverts
The peacock's actual tail feathers, which are the longest of any bird
