explanation: Antibiotics can also kill the helpful bacteria in our gut, which is why people sometimes get diarrhea while taking them.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotiko ay maaari ring pumatay sa mabubuting bakterya sa ating bituka, kaya minsan nagkakaroon ng pagtatae ang umiinom nito.
fact_bis: Ang antibyotiko makapatay usab sa maayong bakterya sa atong tinai, mao nga usahay magtibi ang moinom niini.

q: What wind speed is associated with PAGASA Typhoon Signal No. 5?
options: 185 km/h or higher
120 to 149 km/h
150 to 184 km/h
100 to 119 km/h
explanation: Signal No. 5 means winds of 185 km/h or higher — the level of a super typhoon.
fact_tl: Sa Signal No. 5, ang lakas ng hangin ay 185 km/h o higit pa (super typhoon).
fact_bis: Sa Signal No. 5, ang kakusog sa hangin kay 185 km/h o labaw pa (super typhoon).

q: What is the unit used to measure momentum?
options: Kilogram-meter per second (kg·m/s)
Newton (N)
Joule (J)
Watt (W)
explanation: The unit of momentum is the kilogram-meter per second (kg·m/s).
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng momentum ay kilogramo-metro kada segundo (kg·m/s).
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa momentum mao ang kilogramo-metro kada segundo (kg·m/s).

q: What makes metals look shiny and able to bounce light back?
options: Their free electrons
Their tightly packed atoms
The smooth surface created when they are mined
The layer of air trapped between metal crystals
explanation: The free electrons in metals are why metals look shiny and bounce light back.
fact_tl: Ang malalayang elektron sa metal ang dahilan kung bakit ito makintab at nagbabalik ng ilaw.
fact_bis: Ang gawasnong elektron sa metal mao ang hinungdan nga kini masinaw ug mobalik sa kahayag.

q: Why is it important to stay home and rest when you have the flu or a cold?
options: To stop germs from spreading to classmates and family
To recover faster because the school air makes you sicker
To avoid getting medicine that might cause side effects
Because the school rules require it even for mild illness
explanation: Staying home and resting when you are sick helps because it stops germs from spreading to classmates and family.
fact_tl: Kapag may trangkaso o sipon, makakatulong manatili muna sa bahay at magpahinga dahil pinipigilan nito ang pagkalat ng mikrobyo sa mga kaklase at kapamilya.
fact_bis: Kon adunay trangkaso o sip-on, makatabang ang pagpabilin usa sa balay ug pagpahulay kay makapugong kini sa pagkatap sa mikrobyo ngadto sa mga klasmeyt ug pamilya.

q: In a Filipino dish like sinigang na hipon, which two parts of the shrimp are most often eaten?
options: The head and the tail
The legs and the eyes
The shell and the claws
The antennae and the body
explanation: In Filipino shrimp dishes like sinigang na hipon, the flavor-rich head and the meaty tail are the two parts most commonly eaten.
fact_tl: Sa lutong Pilipino tulad ng sinigang na hipon, ang ulo na puno ng lasa at ang buntot na may laman ang dalawang bahaging madalas nating makita at kainin.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinhong luto sama sa sinigang nga hipon, ang ulo nga puno sa lami ug ang unodon nga ikog mao ang duha ka bahin nga kasagaran natong makita ug kan-on.

q: A shorter guitar string produces a higher pitch than a longer one. Why?
options: It vibrates more times per second, giving it a higher frequency.
It vibrates fewer times per second, giving it a lower frequency.
It is made of thicker material that pushes air harder.
It has more tension that slows down its movement.
explanation: A shorter string moves back and forth more times each second, so it has a higher frequency and produces a higher pitch.
fact_tl: Ang frequency ay kung ilang beses gumalaw paroo't parito ang kuwerdas sa loob ng isang segundo. Mas maikli ang kuwerdas, mas maraming galaw kada segundo, kaya mas mataas ang frequency at mas mataas din ang tunog.
fact_bis: Ang frequency mao kung pila ka beses mokurog ang kuwerdas sulod sa usa ka segundo. Kung mas mubo ang kuwerdas, mas daghan ang lihok kada segundo, mao nga mas taas ang frequency ug mas taas ang tingog.

q: Marble is a metamorphic rock. What was it before it became marble?
options: Limestone changed by heat and pressure underground
Granite cooled slowly from melted rock
Sandstone compressed by the weight of other rocks
Basalt erupted from a volcano and cooled quickly
explanation: Marble forms when limestone is changed by intense heat and pressure deep underground, making it a metamorphic rock.
fact_tl: Ang marmol (marble) ay limestone na nagbago dahil sa matinding init at presyon sa loob ng lupa kaya naging metamorphic na bato.
fact_bis: Ang marmol (marble) usa ka limestone nga nausab tungod sa kusog nga init ug presyon sa ilawom sa yuta, busa nahimo nga metamorphic nga bato.

q: Which of the following best describes an endemic species like the tarsier?
options: It is found only in one specific country and nowhere else in the world.
It can survive in many different countries across Asia.
It was brought to the Philippines from another country long ago.
It lives in the ocean and visits land only to breed.
explanation: Endemic species like the tarsier are found only in the Philippines and nowhere else, making their protection very important.
fact_tl: Ang endemic na species tulad ng tarsier at tamaraw ay matatagpuan lamang sa Pilipinas at wala nang ibang bansa, kaya napakahalaga nilang protektahan.
fact_bis: Ang endemic nga species sama sa tarsier ug tamaraw makita lamang sa Pilipinas ug wala na sa laing nasod, busa importante kaayo nga panalipdan sila.

q: About how much of Earth's surface is covered by water?
options: About 71 percent
About 50 percent
About 29 percent
About 90 percent
explanation: About 71 percent of Earth's surface is covered by water, leaving only about 29 percent as land.
fact_tl: Halos 71 porsyento ng ibabaw ng Daigdig ay natatakpan ng tubig.
fact_bis: Mga 71 ka porsyento sa ibabaw sa Kalibutan natabunan sa tubig.

q: You look up and see big, puffy white clouds that look like cotton. What kind of weather do they usually mean?
options: Fair, sunny weather
Heavy rain is coming soon
A typhoon is approaching
Cold, foggy weather
explanation: Cumulus clouds are puffy and look like white cotton, and they usually mean fair, sunny weather.
fact_tl: Ang cumulus na ulap ay malalaki at parang bulak na puti, at karaniwang tanda ito ng magandang at maaraw na panahon.
fact_bis: Ang cumulus nga panganod dako ug morag puti nga gapas, ug kasagaran timaan kini sa maayo ug maadlaw nga panahon.

q: Which sense still helps you find things even when the room is completely dark?
options: The sense of touch
The sense of sight
The sense of color vision
The sense of balance only
explanation: The sense of touch works even in the dark, so we can feel for things we cannot see.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang pandamang hipo kahit sa dilim, kaya nakakapagkapkap tayo ng mga bagay na hindi natin nakikita.
fact_bis: Ang paghikap molihok bisan sa ngitngit, busa makakapkap ta sa mga butang nga dili nato makita.

q: Where does abaca fiber come from on the abaca plant?
options: From the outer layers of the leaf stalks that form its trunk-like stem
From the roots buried deep in the soil
From the seeds inside the fruit
From the broad surface of its leaves
explanation: Abaca fiber is taken from the outer layers of the leaf stalks that form the plant's trunk-like stem.
fact_tl: Ang hibla ng abaka ay kinukuha sa balat ng mga tangkay ng dahon na bumubuo sa parang-puno nitong katawan.
fact_bis: Ang hilo sa abaka gikuha gikan sa gawas nga panit sa mga tangkay sa dahon nga naghimo sa iyang murag-puno nga lawas.

q: How can a house lizard escape when an enemy grabs it?
options: It drops its own tail and runs away.
It bites the enemy with sharp teeth.
It releases a bad-smelling liquid.
It changes color to blend in with the wall.
explanation: When caught, a house lizard can drop its own tail to escape from an enemy.
fact_tl: Kapag hinuli, kayang putulin ng butiki ang sarili nitong buntot upang makatakas sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Kon madakpan, ang tiki makahimo sa pagputol sa kaugalingong ikog niini aron makaikyas sa kaaway.

q: Hormones are found in very tiny amounts in the body. What is surprising about them?
options: Even in tiny amounts, they have a very strong effect on the body.
They only work when many of them build up over time.
They are too small to do anything useful on their own.
They need to be combined with vitamins before they can work.
explanation: Even though hormones are present in very tiny amounts, they have a strong effect on the body.
fact_tl: Kahit napakaliit lang ng dami ng hormone, malakas pa rin ang epekto nito sa katawan.
fact_bis: Bisan gamay ra kaayo ang gidaghanon sa hormone, kusganon gihapon ang epekto niini sa lawas.

q: You see tiny water droplets on the grass early in the morning. How did they get there?
options: Water vapor in the air turned to liquid on cool surfaces overnight.
Underground water seeped up through the soil and grass.
It rained lightly just before sunrise.
The plants pushed water out through their roots.
explanation: Dew forms when the night cools and water vapor in the air turns to liquid on cold surfaces like leaves and grass.
fact_tl: Ang hamog ay mga patak ng tubig na nabubuo sa mga dahon at damo sa umaga kapag lumalamig ang gabi at ang singaw ng tubig sa hangin ay nagiging likido sa malamig na ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang yamog mga tinulo sa tubig nga maporma sa mga dahon ug sagbot sa buntag kon mobugnaw ang gabii ug ang alisngaw sa tubig sa hangin mahimong likido sa bugnaw nga nawong.

q: Why does fresh carabao milk spoil quickly if left out in a warm place?
options: Bacteria multiply fast when it is warm.
The fat in the milk melts and goes bad.
Warm air pushes oxygen into the milk.
The milk dries out and loses its water.
explanation: Fresh carabao milk spoils quickly because bacteria multiply when it is warm, so it must be kept cold and clean.
fact_tl: Ang sariwang gatas ng kalabaw ay mabilis mapanis dahil dumarami ang bacteria kapag mainit, kaya itinatago ito nang malamig at malinis para manatiling sariwa.
fact_bis: Ang lab-as nga gatas sa kabaw paspas mapan-os tungod kay modaghan ang bacteria kon init, mao nga ginatipigan kini nga bugnaw ug limpyo aron magpabilin nga lab-as.

q: What caused most of the deaths when Typhoon Yolanda struck the Philippines?
options: A storm surge—a wall of seawater—that flooded the land
Extremely strong winds that blew down houses
Landslides triggered by heavy rainfall
Lightning strikes during the typhoon
explanation: The storm surge, a wall of seawater, caused most of the deaths in Typhoon Yolanda.
fact_tl: Ang storm surge o daluyong ng dagat ang sanhi ng pinakamaraming pagkamatay sa Bagyong Yolanda.
fact_bis: Ang storm surge o pagbaha sa tubig-dagat mao ang hinungdan sa pinakadaghang namatay sa Bagyong Yolanda.

q: On the Mohs hardness scale, which mineral comes right after talc at number 2?
options: Gypsum
Quartz
Feldspar
Calcite
explanation: Gypsum is number 2 on the Mohs scale, just above talc, and it can still be scratched with a fingernail.
fact_tl: Ang kasunod ng talc sa Mohs scale ay ang gypsum sa numero 2. Medyo mas matigas ito kaysa talc, pero kaya pa rin itong gasgasan ng kuko mo.
fact_bis: Ang sunod sa talc sa Mohs scale mao ang gypsum sa numero 2. Gamay ra kini nga mas gahi kaysa talc, apan makalmotan gihapon nimo kini sa imong kuko.

q: Which part of the radish (labanos) plant do we eat?
options: Its swollen root that grows underground
Its large green leaves on top
Its small yellow flowers
Its thin fibrous stem above the soil
explanation: The radish's swollen root, which has a slightly spicy taste, is the part that grows underground and that we eat.
fact_tl: Ang labanos ay isang puti at mahabang gulay-ugat na lumalaki sa ilalim ng lupa, at kinakain natin ang namamagang ugat nito na may bahagyang maanghang na lasa.
fact_bis: Ang labanos usa ka puti ug taas nga gulay nga gamot nga motubo ilalom sa yuta, ug atong kan-on ang nanghubag niini nga gamot nga gamay og kaanghang.

q: Why does a carabao overheat so easily on a hot sunny day?
options: Its dark skin absorbs more heat and it produces very little sweat to cool down.
Its thick layer of fat traps too much heat inside its body.
It breathes too slowly to release enough body heat.
It cannot drink enough water because of its large body.
explanation: A carabao's dark skin soaks up more of the sun's heat, and because it makes very little sweat, it struggles to cool itself.
fact_tl: Bakit mabilis mainitan ang kalabaw sa araw? Maitim ang balat nito kaya mas sinisipsip nito ang init ng araw, at dahil kaunti ang pawis na ginagawa nito, mahirap nitong palamigin ang sarili. Kaya pag tirik ang araw, hinahanap nito ang putik o tubig.
fact_bis: Ngano paspas mainitan ang kalabaw sa adlaw? Itom ang panit niini busa mas mosuyop kini sa kainit sa adlaw, ug tungod kay gamay ra ang singot nga mahimo niini, lisod kini makapabugnaw sa kaugalingon. Busa kon taas na ang adlaw, mangita kini og lapok o tubig.

q: Who built early powerful microscopes that allowed him to observe microbes for the first time?
options: Anton van Leeuwenhoek
Galileo Galilei
Louis Pasteur
Robert Hooke
explanation: Anton van Leeuwenhoek built his own powerful single-lens microscopes, which let him see microbes.
fact_tl: Si Anton van Leeuwenhoek ang gumawa ng kanyang sariling makapangyarihang mikroskopyong may iisang lente, na nakakita ng mga mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Si Anton van Leeuwenhoek naghimo sa iyang kaugalingong gamhanan nga mikroskopyo nga usa ra ka lente, nga nakakita sa mga mikrobyo.

q: In fermentation, what do microbes do to food that changes its flavor, smell, and texture?
options: They break down proteins and sugars into smaller parts.
They add new minerals by pulling them from the air.
They freeze the food to preserve its original taste.
They coat the food with a protective layer of acids.
explanation: In fermentation, microbes break down proteins and sugars, which changes the food's flavor, smell, and texture.
fact_tl: Sa fermentation, sinisira ng mikrobyo ang malalaking sangkap ng pagkain tulad ng protina at asukal, kaya nababago ang lasa, amoy, at tibay nito.
fact_bis: Sa fermentation, gubaon sa mikrobyo ang dagkong bahin sa pagkaon sama sa protina ug asukal, mao nga mausab ang lami, baho, ug porma niini.

q: How do forest trees make their own food?
options: They use sunlight, water, and air through their green leaves.
They absorb nutrients directly from other plants nearby.
They collect insects in their bark and digest them.
They get energy from the warmth of the soil around their roots.
explanation: Forest trees make their own food using sunlight, water, and air through their green leaves.
fact_tl: Gumagawa ng sariling pagkain ang mga puno sa gubat gamit ang liwanag ng araw, tubig, at hangin sa pamamagitan ng kanilang berdeng dahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga puno sa lasang mohimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon gamit ang kahayag sa adlaw, tubig, ug hangin pinaagi sa ilang lunhaw nga dahon.

q: Where in the world are epiphytes like orchids and ferns most commonly found?
options: In warm, wet tropical rainforests
In cold, dry deserts near the equator
On the rocky cliffs of mountain peaks
At the bottom of deep ocean trenches
explanation: Epiphytes are most common in warm, wet tropical rainforests; in the Philippines, many epiphytic orchids and ferns grow in our forests.
fact_tl: Pinakamarami ang mga epiphyte sa mainit at basang tropical rainforest. Sa Pilipinas, makikita ang maraming epiphyte na orkidya at pako sa ating mga kagubatan.
fact_bis: Labing daghan ang mga epiphyte sa init ug basa nga tropical rainforest. Sa Pilipinas, makita ang daghang epiphytic nga orkidya ug pako sa atong mga lasang.

q: During a chemical reaction, what happens to the atoms that were in the original substances?
options: They are rearranged into new molecules, but the number of each type of atom stays the same.
Some atoms are destroyed to release energy for the reaction.
New atoms are created from the energy produced by the reaction.
The atoms shrink in size so the new substance weighs less.
explanation: In any chemical reaction the number of each type of atom does not change; the atoms are only regrouped and rearranged into new molecules.
fact_tl: Sa anumang reaksyong kemikal, hindi nagbabago ang bilang ng bawat uri ng atomo; ang mga atomo lamang ay nagbubukluran at nag-aayos-muli sa bagong mga molekula.
fact_bis: Sa bisan unsang reaksiyong kemikal, dili mausab ang gidaghanon sa matag matang sa atomo; ang mga atomo gibukod ug gi-usab lang ang han-ay ngadto sa bag-ong mga molekula.

q: What must an eggplant grow first before it can produce its fruit?
options: A flower
A second set of leaves
A thick woody stem
A deep taproot
explanation: Eggplant, tomato, and okra must first grow flowers before they can produce fruit.
fact_tl: Ang talong, kamatis, at okra ay namumulaklak muna bago magkaroon ng bunga.
fact_bis: Ang talong, kamatis, ug okra mamulak una sa dili pa kini mamunga.

q: What is a coral actually made of?
options: Thousands of tiny creatures called polyps
Layers of calcium rock built up over time
A colony of seaweed that hardens over time
Sand and minerals stuck together by ocean currents
explanation: A coral is an animal made of thousands of tiny creatures called polyps, not a rock or a plant.
fact_tl: Ang coral ay isang hayop, hindi bato o halaman; binubuo ito ng libo-libong maliliit na nilalang na tinatawag na polyp.
fact_bis: Ang coral usa ka hayop, dili bato o tanom; gilangkuban kini sa liboan ka gagmay nga mga binuhat nga gitawag og polyp.

q: What is a bacteriophage?
options: A virus that attacks and destroys bacteria
A medicine that kills viruses inside the body
A type of bacteria that destroys other bacteria
A white blood cell that fights infections
explanation: Bacteriophages are viruses that attack bacteria instead of people, and they destroy bacteria.
fact_tl: May mga virus na hindi tao ang inaatake kundi bakterya; tinatawag itong bacteriophage at sinisira nito ang bakterya.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bayrus nga dili tawo ang gisulong kondili bakterya; gitawag kini ug bacteriophage ug ginaguba niini ang bakterya.

q: Besides holding up the plant, what else does the stem do with food?
options: It carries food made by the leaves to the rest of the plant.
It stores extra sunlight to use at night.
It produces food on its own using water from the soil.
It releases food into the air to attract insects.
explanation: The stem carries the food made by the leaves to the rest of the plant.
fact_tl: Ang tangkay ay nagdadala rin ng pagkaing ginawa ng mga dahon papunta sa ibang bahagi ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang punoan magdala usab sa pagkaon nga gihimo sa mga dahon ngadto sa ubang bahin sa tanom.

q: During the amihan season, which parts of the Philippines receive the most rain?
options: The eastern regions like Bicol and eastern Visayas
The western regions like Ilocos and Palawan
The central mountain ranges of Luzon
The southern islands of Mindanao and the Sulu Sea
explanation: During the amihan, the eastern parts of the country like Bicol and eastern Visayas get rain because the wind hits there first.
fact_tl: Tuwing amihan, ang silanganing bahagi ng bansa tulad ng Bicol at silangang Visayas ay nakararanas ng ulan dahil dito tumama ang hangin.
fact_bis: Panahon sa amihan, ang sidlakang bahin sa nasod sama sa Bicol ug sidlakang Visayas makasinati og ulan kay didto motampo ang hangin.

q: Why is piña cloth so expensive?
options: Every step of making it is done by hand and takes a very long time.
The pineapple plants that produce the fibers are very rare.
It must be dyed with costly imported chemicals.
Machines that weave it are extremely difficult to operate.
explanation: Piña cloth is expensive because every step of its production is done by hand and takes a long time.
fact_tl: Ang telang piña ay mahal dahil ang bawat hakbang ay ginagawa nang mano-mano at matagal.
fact_bis: Ang pinya nga panapton mahal kay ang matag lakang ginahimo pinaagi sa kamot ug dugay kaayo.

q: Scientists measure huge distances in space using a unit called a light-year. What is this unit based on?
options: The distance light travels in one year at 300,000 km per second
The time it takes a rocket to travel from Earth to the Moon
The distance from Earth to the nearest star multiplied by 100
The number of kilometers in one full orbit around the Sun
explanation: Scientists use the speed of light—about 300,000 km per second—as a cosmic measuring stick, expressing star distances as light-years.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang bilis ng liwanag—mga 300,000 kilometro bawat segundo—bilang panukat sa kalawakan, kaya kayang ipahayag ang layo sa pagitan ng mga bituin sa light-year.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga siyentista ang katulin sa kahayag—mga 300,000 ka kilometro matag segundo—isip sukdanan sa kawanangan, mao nga ang gilay-on tali sa mga bituon mahimong ipahayag sa light-year.

q: Besides being spread by mosquito bites, how else can Zika virus be passed on?
options: From a pregnant mother to her unborn baby
Through sharing food or drinking water with an infected person
By touching the skin of someone who has the virus
By breathing the same air as an infected person
explanation: Besides mosquitoes, Zika can also pass from a pregnant mother to her baby.
fact_tl: Bukod sa lamok, maaari ring maipasa ang Zika mula sa buntis na ina patungo sa kanyang sanggol.
fact_bis: Gawas sa lamok, ang Zika mahimo usab nga mabalhin gikan sa mabdos nga inahan ngadto sa iyang bata.

q: What does a tamaraw do during the hottest part of the day?
options: It hides and rests inside dense thickets so it won't be seen.
It wades into rivers to cool itself down.
It climbs trees to find shade among the branches.
It burrows into the ground to escape the heat.
explanation: During the heat of the day, the lone tamaraw rests and hides inside dense thickets so that it will not be seen.
fact_tl: Sa init ng araw, ang nag-iisang tamaraw ay nagpapahinga at nagtatago sa loob ng makakapal na halaman para hindi ito makita.
fact_bis: Sa init sa adlaw, ang nag-inusarang tamaraw nagpahuway ug nagtago sa sulod sa baga nga kasukalan aron dili kini makita.

q: Coal and oil are both fossil fuels, but they formed from different living things. What did coal mostly form from?
options: Ancient swamp plants
Tiny sea creatures like plankton
Large marine reptiles like dinosaurs
Shellfish that lived on the ocean floor
explanation: Coal usually formed from ancient swamp plants, while oil and natural gas formed mostly from tiny sea creatures like plankton.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nabubuo ang uling mula sa mga sinaunang halaman sa latian (swamp), samantalang ang langis at natural gas ay galing sa maliliit na nilalang sa dagat tulad ng plankton. Kaya magkaiba ang pinanggalingan nila kahit pareho silang fossil fuels.
fact_bis: Ang uling kasagaran naggikan sa karaang mga tanom sa lamakan (swamp), samtang ang lana ug natural gas naggikan sa gagmayng mga binuhat sa dagat sama sa plankton. Lahi ang ilang gigikanan bisan pareho silang fossil fuels.

q: Why does Earth's air stay around the planet instead of floating off into space?
options: Earth's gravity holds the atmosphere in place.
The Sun's heat pushes the air back toward Earth.
The Moon's pull keeps the air pressed against Earth.
Air is too heavy to be moved by anything in space.
explanation: Earth's gravity holds the atmosphere in place so the air does not drift off into space.
fact_tl: Hinahawakan ng grabidad ng Daigdig ang atmospera upang hindi kumalat ang hangin sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa Kalibutan nagkupot sa atmospera aron dili mokatag ang hangin sa kawanangan.

q: Why does Philippine law forbid killing or capturing the tamaraw?
options: Because it is a protected species that needs to be conserved
Because it is sacred in indigenous Filipino religion
Because it is domesticated and owned by the government
Because it provides milk and meat to Filipino farmers
explanation: Philippine law forbids killing or capturing the tamaraw because it is a protected species.
fact_tl: Ipinagbabawal ng batas sa Pilipinas ang pagpatay o panghuli ng tamaraw dahil pinoprotektahan ito.
fact_bis: Gidili sa balaod sa Pilipinas ang pagpatay o pagdakop sa tamaraw kay gipanalipdan kini.

q: Why is the carabao a fitting national animal of the Philippines?
options: It can be found in almost every province, from Luzon to Mindanao.
It is the largest and strongest animal found in the country.
It has been used in Philippine festivals for thousands of years.
It is found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in the world.
explanation: The carabao is fitting as the national animal because it can be found in almost every province of the Philippines, from Luzon to Mindanao.
fact_tl: Angkop ang kalabaw bilang pambansang hayop dahil makikita ito sa halos lahat ng probinsya ng Pilipinas, mula Luzon hanggang Mindanao.
fact_bis: Angay ang kabaw isip nasodnong hayop kay makita kini sa halos tanang probinsya sa Pilipinas, gikan sa Luzon hangtod Mindanao.

q: When you peel an orange, what do you find inside it?
options: Small segments full of juice
A single large seed surrounded by pulp
Layers of dry fiber with a liquid center
Two halves separated by a hard membrane
explanation: Citrus fruits like oranges are divided inside into small segments full of juice.
fact_tl: Ang mga prutas na sitrus tulad ng kahel ay nahahati sa loob sa maliliit na hiwa o gajos na puno ng katas.
fact_bis: Ang mga prutas nga sitrus sama sa kahel nabahin sa sulod og gagmay nga mga hiwa nga puno og duga.

q: How can scientists tell one whale shark apart from another?
options: Each whale shark has a unique spot pattern, like a fingerprint.
Each whale shark has a different shaped tail fin.
Each whale shark has a different number of gill slits.
Each whale shark has a different color on its belly.
explanation: Each whale shark has a unique pattern of white and yellow spots on its back, and no two whale sharks share the same pattern.
fact_tl: May mga puti at dilaw na batik ang likod ng bawat butanding, at gaya ng fingerprint, walang dalawang butanding na magkapareho ang pattern.
fact_bis: Ang matag tuki adunay puti ug dalag nga mga puntos sa likod, ug sama sa fingerprint, walay duha ka tuki nga managsama og pattern.

q: Besides killing harmful bacteria, what unintended effect can antibiotics have?
options: They can also kill the good bacteria living in our gut.
They can destroy the white blood cells that fight infection.
They can cause the immune system to attack healthy cells.
They can prevent new bacteria from ever growing in the body.
explanation: Antibiotic medicines can kill not only disease-causing bacteria but also the good bacteria in our gut.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotic na gamot na pumapatay sa bakteryang nagdudulot ng sakit ay maaari ring makapatay sa mabubuting bakterya sa ating bituka.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotic nga tambal nga mopatay sa bakterya nga hinungdan sa sakit makapatay usab sa maayong bakterya sa atong tinai.

q: The Philippines mines a lot of gold and copper. Why are almost all diamonds in Filipino jewelry brought in from other countries?
options: The Philippines does not mine diamonds, so they must be imported.
Philippine diamonds are too small to be used in jewelry.
It is illegal to sell locally mined diamonds in the Philippines.
All diamonds found here are used only by the government.
explanation: The Philippines mines gold and copper but not diamonds, so almost all diamonds in jewelry here are imported from other countries.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, mas marami tayong minahan ng ginto at tanso kaysa diamante, kaya halos lahat ng diamante sa mga alahas dito ay galing sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, mas daghan tang minahan og bulawan ug tumbaga kaysa diamante, mao nga halos tanan diamante sa alahas dinhi gikan sa laing nasod.

q: What makes the peanut plant unusual compared to most other crops?
options: Its pods grow and ripen underground rather than above the soil.
Its roots grow above the ground and collect sunlight.
It produces fruit before it grows any flowers.
Its seeds must be planted upside down to grow properly.
explanation: The peanut is unusual because its pods grow and ripen underground, unlike most crops whose fruit develops above the soil.
fact_tl: Ang mani ay kakaiba dahil ang kanyang mga pod ay tumutubo at namumunga sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mani lahi kay ang iyang mga pod motubo ug mohinog sa ilalom sa yuta.

q: How big is the pilandok, one of the smallest hoofed animals in the world?
options: About the size of a rabbit
About the size of a small dog
About the size of a sheep
About the size of a young deer
explanation: The pilandok is one of the smallest hoofed animals in the whole world, roughly the size of a rabbit.
fact_tl: Ang pilandok ay isa sa pinakamaliit na hayop na may kuko sa buong mundo, kasinglaki lang ng isang kuneho.
fact_bis: Ang pilandok usa sa pinakagamay nga hayop nga adunay kuko sa tibuok kalibutan, sama ra kadako sa usa ka koneho.

q: Why do many birds build nests?
options: To hold their eggs and keep their chicks safe
To store food during cold or dry seasons
To attract a mate by showing off building skills
To protect themselves from rain and wind at night
explanation: Many birds build a nest to hold their eggs and keep their chicks safe.
fact_tl: Maraming ibon ang gumagawa ng pugad upang doon ilagay ang kanilang mga itlog at pangalagaan ang mga sisiw.
fact_bis: Daghang langgam ang naghimo ug salag aron didto ibutang ang ilang mga itlog ug ampingan ang mga piso.

q: What is the purpose of the Philippines' Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI)?
options: To provide free vaccines to Filipino children against diseases like TB, hepatitis B, and measles
To give free vitamins to malnourished children in public schools
To train health workers to treat tropical diseases in rural areas
To distribute free medicines to families below the poverty line
explanation: The Philippines EPI provides free vaccines to Filipino children against BCG (TB), hepatitis B, DTP, polio, measles, and other diseases.
fact_tl: Ang Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) ng Pilipinas ay nagbibigay ng mga libreng bakuna para sa mga batang Pilipino laban sa BCG (TB), hepatitis B, DTP, polio, measles, at iba pa.
fact_bis: Ang Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) sa Pilipinas naghatag og libreng mga bakuna sa mga batang Pilipino batok sa BCG (TB), hepatitis B, DTP, polio, tigdas, ug uban pang mga sakit.

q: How does venom help the Komodo dragon catch its prey?
options: It thins the blood and lowers blood pressure, making the prey slowly weaken.
It paralyzes the prey's muscles so it cannot move at all.
It causes the prey to fall asleep within seconds.
It makes the prey lose its sense of direction and get lost.
explanation: The Komodo dragon's venom thins the blood and lowers the blood pressure of its prey, causing the prey to slowly weaken.
fact_tl: Bukod sa malaki at malakas, may mga gland ng kamandag ang Komodo dragon sa baba nito; ang kamandag na ito ay nagpapanipis ng dugo at nagpapababa ng presyon ng biktima, kaya unti-unti itong nanghihina.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagkadako ug pagkakusgan, ang Komodo dragon adunay mga glandula sa hilo sa baba niini; kini nga hilo magpanipis sa dugo ug magpaubos sa presyon sa biktima, mao nga hinay-hinay kining naluya.

q: Purple sulfur bacteria perform photosynthesis differently from plants. What do they produce instead of oxygen?
options: Sulfur
Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen gas
Water vapor
explanation: Purple sulfur bacteria use hydrogen sulfide instead of water and produce sulfur instead of oxygen during their anoxygenic photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang mga purple bacteria tulad ng purple sulfur bacteria ay gumagawa ng photosynthesis nang walang oxygen (anoxygenic) — ginagamit nila ang hydrogen sulfide imbes na tubig at gumagawa ng sulfur imbes na oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang mga purple sulfur bacteria nagbuhat og photosynthesis nga walay oxygen (anoxygenic photosynthesis) — gigamit nila ang hydrogen sulfide imbes tubig ug nagbuhat og sulfur imbes oksiheno.

q: Who invented the first practical electric light bulb for everyday use?
options: Thomas Edison
Alexander Graham Bell
Nikola Tesla
Benjamin Franklin
explanation: Thomas Edison invented the first practical electric light bulb for everyday use.
fact_tl: Si Thomas Edison ang gumawa ng praktikal na bombilya (light bulb) na pang-araw-araw na gamit.
fact_bis: Si Thomas Edison ang nag-imbento sa praktikal nga bombilya (light bulb) para sa adlaw-adlaw nga gamit.

q: A woodpecker hammers its beak into hard wood thousands of times a day. What body features work together to protect its head?
options: Its thick skull, long tongue, and strong neck all work together.
Its hollow bones and lightweight feathers absorb the shock.
Its curved beak and large eyes cushion the impact.
Its soft head feathers and flexible spine reduce the force.
explanation: Many parts of a woodpecker's body—thick skull, long tongue, and strong neck—work together to keep its head from getting hurt.
fact_tl: Maraming bahagi ng katawan ng woodpecker ang sabay-sabay na gumagana, gaya ng makapal na bungo, mahabang dila, at malalakas na leeg, para hindi masaktan ang ulo nito.
fact_bis: Daghang bahin sa lawas sa woodpecker ang nagdungan paglihok, sama sa baga nga bagol, taas nga dila, ug kusgan nga liog, aron dili madaot ang ulo niini.

q: Why is the tardigrade (water bear) considered the toughest animal on Earth?
options: It can survive extreme heat, extreme cold, and even the conditions of outer space.
It has a shell harder than any known material on Earth.
It can regrow any part of its body that is cut off.
It produces a poison that kills anything that tries to eat it.
explanation: The tardigrade is considered the toughest animal because it can survive extreme heat, cold, and even outer space.
fact_tl: Ang tardigrade o water bear ang itinuturing na pinakamatibay na hayop, dahil kaya nitong mabuhay kahit sa init, lamig, at kahit sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang tardigrade o water bear giisip nga labing lig-on nga hayop kay makasugakod kini sa hilabihang kainit, katugnaw, ug bisan sa kawanangan.

q: In what year did the Philippines gain independence from the United States?
explanation: The Philippines officially gained independence from the United States on July 4, 1946.
fact_tl: Nakamit ng Pilipinas ang kalayaan mula sa Estados Unidos noong taong 1946.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas nakaangkon sa kagawasan gikan sa Estados Unidos niadtong tuig 1946.

q: What do scientists call a fault that has moved recently and is likely to move again?
options: An active fault
A dormant fault
A transform fault
A passive fault
explanation: PHIVOLCS watches active faults because they have moved recently and could cause earthquakes by moving again.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na aktibong fault ang isang fault na gumalaw kamakailan at malamang gagalaw pa muli, kaya ito ang binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS para sa posibleng lindol.
fact_bis: Ang fault nga bag-o lang nilihok ug lagmit molihok pag-usab gitawag og aktibo nga fault, mao nga gibantayan kini sa PHIVOLCS para sa posibleng linog.

q: How does a biofertilizer using Rhizobium bacteria help a plant grow?
options: It converts nitrogen from the air into a nutrient the plant can absorb
It breaks down rocks in the soil to release minerals
It produces its own food through photosynthesis in the roots
It drives off pests by releasing a natural chemical
explanation: Rhizobium bacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen, turning it into a usable nutrient for plants and reducing the need for chemical fertilizers.
fact_tl: Ang biofertilizer ay gumagamit ng buhay na bakterya gaya ng Rhizobium na kumukuha ng nitrogen mula sa hangin at ginagawa itong sustansyang magagamit ng pananim, kaya nababawasan ang pangangailangan sa kemikal na abono.
fact_bis: Ang biofertilizer mogamit og buhi nga bakterya sama sa Rhizobium nga mokuha og nitrogen gikan sa hangin ug himuon kining sustansya nga magamit sa tanom, mao nga makunhuran ang panginahanglan sa kemikal nga abono.

q: How does a tailorbird build its nest?
options: It pokes holes in a leaf and threads plant fibers through them to stitch the leaf into a nest
It weaves dry grasses into a cup shape and glues it with mud
It hollows out a tree trunk with its beak and lines it with feathers
It collects spider webs and wraps them around a branch to form a sack
explanation: The tailorbird uses its beak like a needle, stitching leaves together with plant fibers or spider silk to form its nest.
fact_tl: Ang tailorbird o ibong mananahi ay tumutusok ng butas sa dahon at iniaabot ang hibla ng sapot o damo para itahi ang dahon na maging pugad.
fact_bis: Ang tailorbird o langgam nga mananahi naglungag sa dahon ug gibira ang lugway sa sapot o sagbot aron itahi ang dahon nga mahimong salag.

q: What does the inside flesh of a guyabano look like and taste like?
options: White and juicy with a sweet-and-sour taste
Yellow and dry with a purely sweet taste
Green and crunchy with a bitter taste
Purple and watery with no strong flavor
explanation: The flesh of the guyabano is white, juicy, and has a taste that is both sweet and sour.
fact_tl: Ang laman ng guyabano ay maputi, makatas, at may halong tamis at asim.
fact_bis: Ang unod sa guyabano puti, tubigon, ug adunay sagol nga tam-is ug aslom.

q: How does washing hands with soap help protect your body?
options: It helps prevent intestinal worms from entering your body
It kills the viruses that cause colds and flu inside your stomach
It removes excess oil that causes skin rashes
It strengthens your immune system by training white blood cells
explanation: Washing hands often with soap is a simple way to prevent intestinal worms from being swallowed.
fact_tl: Ang madalas na paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon ay tumutulong na maiwasan ang bulate sa bituka.
fact_bis: Ang kanunay nga paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon makatabang sa paglikay sa bulate sa tinai.

q: What happens to speed and turning force when a small gear drives a larger gear?
options: Speed decreases but turning force increases
Speed increases and turning force also increases
Speed decreases and turning force also decreases
Speed increases but turning force decreases
explanation: When a small gear drives a big gear, you trade speed for more turning force, which is useful for doing heavy work.
fact_tl: Kapag pinaikot ng maliit na gear ang malaking gear, bumabagal ang pag-ikot pero lumalakas ang puwersang panikot. Kaya kapalit ng bilis ay mas malakas na lakas-ikot para sa mabibigat na trabaho.
fact_bis: Kung ang gamay nga gear magpatuyok sa dakong gear, mohinay ang pagtuyok apan mokusog ang puwersa sa pagtuyok. Busa imong gibaylo ang kapaspas alang sa mas kusog nga puwersa sa bug-at nga trabaho.

q: What is the purpose of the row of holes along the side of an abalone's shell?
options: They let exhaled water exit after the gills have absorbed oxygen
They are used to attach the abalone firmly to rocks
They allow the abalone to sense vibrations in the water
They are passages through which the abalone lays eggs
explanation: The holes along the abalone's shell let used water escape after the gills inside have taken in oxygen.
fact_tl: Ang abalone ay isang mollusc na may iisang flat, ear-shaped shell na may hilera ng mga butas sa tagiliran — ang mga butas na ito ay nagbibigay-daan sa tubig na lumabas matapos ang oxygen ay makuha ng mga hasang sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang abalone usa ka mollusk nga adunay usa ka patag, ear-shaped nga shell nga adunay laray sa mga butas sa usa ka kilid — kining mga butas nagtugot sa ginhawa nga tubig nga mogawas human makuha ang oxygen sa mga hasang sa sulod.

q: How does smoking affect the heart and blood vessels?
options: It harms them and raises the risk of heart disease
It strengthens them by making the heart beat faster over time
It has no direct effect on the heart but harms only the lungs
It thickens artery walls in a way that lowers blood pressure
explanation: Smoking harms the heart and blood vessels, raising the risk of heart disease.
fact_tl: Ang paninigarilyo ay nakakasama sa puso at sa mga ugat ng dugo, kaya tumataas ang panganib sa sakit sa puso.
fact_bis: Ang pagpanigarilyo makadaot sa kasingkasing ug sa mga ugat sa dugo, busa motaas ang risgo sa sakit sa kasingkasing.

q: Why is early treatment so important when someone is exposed to a rabid animal?
options: Because rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms begin
Because symptoms appear within minutes if treatment is delayed
Because the virus spreads to other people through touch
Because the only cure works only on children, not adults
explanation: Rabies is nearly always fatal once symptoms start, so treatment must begin as early as possible before symptoms appear.
fact_tl: Halos palaging nakamamatay ang rabies kapag nagsimula na ang mga sintomas, kaya napakahalaga ng maagang paggamot.
fact_bis: Halos kanunay makamatay ang rabies kon misugod na ang mga sintomas, busa hinungdanon kaayo ang sayong pagtambal.

q: What does it mean if you gently pinch the skin on the back of your hand and it returns slowly instead of snapping back?
options: It is a sign of dehydration
It means your blood pressure is too high
It shows you have enough body water
It indicates an allergic reaction
explanation: When pinched skin returns slowly and stays tented, it is a sign that the body is dehydrated and needs water.
fact_tl: May simpleng subok para malaman kung dehydrated ang isang tao: kuruti't bitiwan ang balat sa likod ng kamay. Kung mabilis itong bumalik sa dati, ayos ang tubig sa katawan; pero kung mabagal o parang naiipit, senyales ito ng dehydration.
fact_bis: Adunay simple nga sulay aron mahibaw-an kon dehydrated ang usa ka tawo: kusia ug buhii ang panit sa likod sa kamot. Kon paspas kini mobalik, maayo ang tubig sa lawas; apan kon hinay o morag mag-tukod, timailhan kini sa dehydration.

q: Why do root vegetables like carrots and sweet potatoes need to be scrubbed harder than fruits that hang on a tree?
options: They grow under the soil and hold more clinging dirt and sand
They have a harder outer skin that is more difficult to remove
They absorb more pesticides than fruits that grow above ground
They have more bacteria inside their flesh than other vegetables
explanation: Root vegetables grow right in the soil, so more dirt and sand clings to them and they need extra scrubbing.
fact_tl: Ang mga gulay na ugat gaya ng kamote, patatas, at carrot ay tumutubo mismo sa ilalim ng lupa, kaya mas maraming kapit na putik at buhangin ang mga ito. Kailangang kuskusin nang mabuti ang mga ito kaysa sa prutas na nakabitin sa puno.
fact_bis: Ang gamot nga utanon sama sa kamote, patatas, ug carrot mutubo mismo ilawom sa yuta, mao nga mas daghan silag pilit nga lapok ug balas. Kinahanglan kuskuson sila pag-ayo kaysa sa prutas nga nagbitay sa kahoy.

q: How do restored forests help communities that depend on streams?
options: They help store clean water in streams and watersheds
They prevent all flooding by absorbing rain instantly
They filter saltwater and turn it into freshwater
They cool the air enough to reduce evaporation from rivers
explanation: Restored forests help store clean water in streams and watersheds, protecting water sources for communities.
fact_tl: Ang mga gubat na ibinabalik ay tumutulong sa pag-iimbak ng malinis na tubig sa mga batis at watershed.
fact_bis: Ang mga gibalik nga lasang makatabang sa pagtipig og limpyo nga tubig sa mga sapa ug watershed.

q: What happens when you place a celery stalk in a glass of colored water?
options: The colored water climbs up through the stalk by capillary action
The stalk pushes water down because plants only absorb water at the roots
The color stays at the bottom and does not enter the stalk
The stalk dissolves and the water turns colorless
explanation: Capillary action causes the colored water to travel upward through tiny tubes inside the celery stalk.
fact_tl: Kapag inilubog ang tangkay ng kintsay sa tubig na may kulay, umaakyat ang kuláy na tubig sa loob ng tangkay sa pamamagitan ng capillary action.
fact_bis: Kon ibutang ang tangkay sa celery sa tubig nga may kolor, mosaka ang kolorado nga tubig sa sulod sa tangkay pinaagi sa capillary action.

q: A single stalk of malunggay has many small leaflets on it. What kind of leaf is this?
options: A compound leaf
A simple leaf
A parallel-veined leaf
A needle leaf
explanation: Malunggay has compound leaves — one stalk bearing many small leaflets that are all part of one leaf, not separate leaves.
fact_tl: Ang malunggay ay may compound leaves—isang tangkay na may maraming maliliit na leaflet; hindi ito mga magkahiwalay na dahon kundi iisang compound na dahon.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay adunay compound leaves—usa ka tangkay nga may daghang gamay nga leaflet—dili sila magkahiwalay kondili usa ka compound na dahon.

q: Which action is the best example of 'reuse'?
options: Turning an old can into a pencil holder instead of throwing it away
Sorting plastic bottles into a recycling bin
Buying a new bag to replace a torn one
Burning old newspapers to reduce trash
explanation: Reuse means using something again instead of discarding it, like making an old can into a pencil holder.
fact_tl: Ang 'Reuse' ay paggamit muli ng bagay sa halip na itapon. Halimbawa, pwede mong gawing lalagyan ng lapis ang lumang lata, o gawing paso ng halaman ang sirang timba. Hindi mo na kailangang bumili ng bago.
fact_bis: Ang 'Reuse' nagpasabot nga gamiton balik ang usa ka butang imbes nga ilabay kini. Pananglitan, mahimo nimong himuong lalagyanan sa lapis ang daang lata, o himuong tanuman ang naguba nga timba. Dili na ka kinahanglan mopalit ug bag-o.

q: How does a mother civet care for her newborn babies?
options: She feeds them her milk until they grow and can find their own food
She hides them inside a hollow tree and brings insects every hour
She carries them on her back until they are fully grown
She teaches them to hunt by bringing live prey to the den
explanation: A mother civet nurses her tiny, helpless babies with her milk until they grow up and learn to find food on their own.
fact_tl: Ang inahing musang ay nagsisilang ng ilang maliliit na anak na walang kakayahang magsarili sa simula. Pinapasuso sila ng gatas ng kanilang ina hanggang sa lumaki sila at matutong maghanap ng sariling pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang inahan nga musang manganak og pipila ka gagmay nga anak nga dili pa makaatiman sa ilang kaugalingon sa sinugdan. Pasus-on sila sa gatas sa ilang inahan hangtod nga modako sila ug makakat-on mangita og kaugalingong pagkaon.

q: What part of your body is responsible for giving you the feeling of hunger or thirst?
options: A small part of the brain that monitors food and water levels
The stomach, which shrinks when empty and sends pain signals
The kidneys, which release hormones when water is low
The tongue, which detects lack of saliva and tells you to drink
explanation: A small part of the brain constantly monitors your body's food and water levels and sends the signals we feel as hunger or thirst.
fact_tl: May maliit na bahagi ng utak na nagbabantay kung kulang ka na ng pagkain o tubig. Kapag napansin nitong kulang ka na, nagpapadala ito ng senyas na nagiging pakiramdam mong gutom o uhaw para hudyatan kang kumain o uminom.
fact_bis: Adunay gamay nga bahin sa utok nga nagbantay kon kulang na ka sa pagkaon o tubig. Kon mamatikdan niini nga kulang ka na, magpadala kini og senyas nga mahimong pamati nimo nga gigutom o giuhaw aron pahibaloon ka nga mokaon o moinom.

q: Why do antibiotics NOT work when you have a viral infection like the flu?
options: Antibiotics only target bacteria, not viruses
Antibiotics are too weak to reach the bloodstream where viruses live
Viruses hide inside bone marrow where antibiotics cannot go
Antibiotics destroy the white blood cells needed to fight viruses
explanation: Antibiotics are designed to attack bacteria, so they have no effect on viruses at all.
fact_tl: Hindi gumagana ang antibiotic laban sa virus dahil ang mga gamot na ito ay para lang sa bakterya, hindi sa virus.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotic walay epekto batok sa virus tungod kay kini nga mga tambal alang lang sa bakterya, dili sa virus.

q: How does a sea sponge get the oxygen it needs to survive?
options: It absorbs oxygen straight from water that flows through its body
It rises to the surface to breathe air like dolphins do
It uses photosynthesis to make oxygen from sunlight
It absorbs oxygen through a set of small, simple lungs
explanation: A sponge has no lungs and gets oxygen directly from water flowing through its body.
fact_tl: Kumukuha ang espongha ng oksiheno mula mismo sa tubig na dumadaloy sa katawan nito, sapagkat wala itong baga.
fact_bis: Ang espongha mokuha og oksiheno gikan mismo sa tubig nga moagi sa lawas niini, kay wala kini baga.

q: How does tuberculosis (TB) spread from one person to another?
options: Through the air when a sick person coughs
Through contaminated food and water only
By touching the skin of an infected person
Through mosquito bites like dengue fever
explanation: TB is a bacterial disease that usually attacks the lungs and spreads through the air when an infected person coughs.
fact_tl: Ang tuberculosis (TB) ay sakit na dulot ng bacteria na karaniwang umaatake sa baga, at kumakalat sa hangin kapag umuubo ang taong may sakit. Magagamot ito sa pamamagitan ng espesyal na gamot na iniinom nang maraming buwan, at may bakunang BCG para dito.
fact_bis: Ang tuberculosis (TB) usa ka sakit nga gikan sa bacteria nga kasagaran moatake sa baga, ug mokatap sa hangin kung mag-ubo ang tawong may sakit. Matambalan kini pinaagi sa espesyal nga tambal nga imnon sulod sa daghang bulan, ug adunay BCG nga bakuna alang niini.

q: Why are female ducks, not male ducks, raised for egg production?
options: Only female ducks lay eggs
Male ducks lay eggs but in much smaller numbers
Both sexes lay eggs, but female eggs are larger
Only male ducks lay fertilized eggs that can be eaten
explanation: Only female ducks lay eggs, which is why egg farms raise females.
fact_tl: Tanging ang babaeng itik lamang ang nangingitlog, kaya ito ang inaalagaan para sa produksyon ng itlog.
fact_bis: Ang baye lang nga itik ang mangitlog, busa sila ang gibuhi alang sa produksyon sa itlog.

q: A student says the ozone hole causes global warming. What is wrong with this statement?
options: The ozone hole and global warming are two different problems — the ozone hole is about UV rays, not trapped heat
The ozone hole is actually good because it cools the planet by letting heat escape
Global warming creates the ozone hole, so they are the same problem viewed differently
The ozone hole only affects the poles, while global warming affects only the equator
explanation: The ozone hole and global warming are separate issues: the ozone hole allows harmful UV rays in, while global warming is caused by heat being trapped by greenhouse gases.
fact_tl: Magkaibang bagay ang butas sa ozone at ang global warming—ang ozone ay tungkol sa UV rays, samantalang ang global warming ay tungkol sa naiipong init.
fact_bis: Lahi nga butang ang lungag sa ozone ug ang global warming—ang ozone bahin sa UV rays, samtang ang global warming bahin sa natipon nga init.

q: What is the smallest piece of an element that still keeps that element's identity?
options: The atom
The molecule
The cell
The compound
explanation: The atom is the smallest unit that retains an element's identity; splitting it further by chemistry means it is no longer that element.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaliit na piraso ng isang elemento na hindi pa nawawala ang pagkaelemento nito ay ang atom. Kapag hinati mo pa ito sa kemikal, hindi na ito ang elementong iyon.
fact_bis: Ang pinakagamay nga piraso sa elemento nga wala pa mawala ang pagka-elemento niini mao ang atomo. Kung bahinon pa nimo kini sa kemika, dili na kini kana nga elemento.

q: Why does a leech bite keep bleeding for a few hours after the leech is removed?
options: A substance in the leech's saliva that prevents clotting is still in the skin
The leech leaves tiny teeth behind that keep the wound open
The skin takes hours to close because leech bites are very deep
The blood becomes thinner after a leech bite due to a chemical reaction
explanation: The leech's saliva contains an anti-clotting substance that stays in the wound and keeps it bleeding even after the leech is gone.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos tanggalin ang linta, patuloy pa ring dumudugo nang kaunti ang kinagatan sa loob ng ilang oras. Normal lang ito dahil nasa balat pa rin ang sangkap mula sa laway na pumipigil sa pamumuo ng dugo.
fact_bis: Human makuha ang alimatok, padayon gihapon nga modugo og gamay ang gipaakan sulod sa pipila ka oras. Normal lang kini kay anaa pa sa panit ang sangkap gikan sa laway nga magpugong sa pagbara sa dugo.

q: Why do ecosystems with more species recover better from disasters than those with few species?
options: More species and more interconnected food webs make the ecosystem more resilient
More species means more competition, which keeps the ecosystem in perfect balance
Few species make it easier for the surviving ones to adapt quickly
More species means more food for humans, which motivates conservation efforts
explanation: Ecosystems with greater species diversity and more interconnected food webs are more resilient and better able to recover from disturbances.
fact_tl: Ang mga ekosistema na may mas maraming species at mas magkakaugnay na food web ay mas matibay at mas kayang bumawi mula sa kaguluhan kaysa sa mga ekosistema na may iilan lamang na species.
fact_bis: Ang mga ekosistema nga adunay mas daghang species ug mas magkaugnay nga food web mas resilient ug mas maayo nga nakakabawi gikan sa mga kasamok kaysa sa mga ekosistema nga adunay iilan lamang ka species.

q: How does a silkworm form its cocoon?
options: It moves its head around and around to wrap itself in a continuous thread of silk
It collects loose silk from the ground and packs it into a ball around itself
It spins silk outward from its body like a spider spins a web
It bites silk from another cocoon and weaves it into a new one
explanation: The silkworm spins its cocoon by moving its head in circles, wrapping itself in a single long silk thread.
fact_tl: Kapag gumagawa ng cocoon, iginagalaw ng silkworm ang ulo nito paikot-ikot para balutin ang sarili sa seda.
fact_bis: Kung maghimo og cocoon, ang silkworm motikang sa iyang ulo paliko-liko aron putson ang kaugalingon sa seda.

q: Which crocodile was recognized by Guinness World Records as the largest ever held in captivity?
options: Lolong, from the Philippines
Gustave, from Burundi
Rex, from Australia
Dominator, from Papua New Guinea
explanation: Lolong, a saltwater crocodile captured in the Philippines, holds the Guinness World Record for the largest crocodile ever held in captivity.
fact_tl: Si Lolong, isang buwaya mula sa Pilipinas, ang itinuturing na pinakamalaking buwayang naipiit kailanman ayon sa Guinness World Records.
fact_bis: Si Lolong, usa ka buaya gikan sa Pilipinas, giila sa Guinness World Records isip pinakadako nga buaya nga nabihag sukad.

q: How do cleaner fish and large fish benefit each other in a mutualistic relationship?
options: The cleaner fish gets food by eating parasites off the large fish, while the large fish gets cleaned
The large fish protects the cleaner fish from predators in exchange for being guided to food
The cleaner fish shares its mucus coating with the large fish to prevent disease
The large fish digests food faster because the cleaner fish removes harmful bacteria from its skin
explanation: In this mutualism, the small cleaner fish gains food while the large fish benefits from having parasites and dead skin removed.
fact_tl: May maliliit na isdang taga-linis na kumakain ng parasito at dumi sa balat at bibig ng mas malalaking isda; nakakakain ang maliit at lumilinis ang malaki.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga isda nga tiglimpyo nga mokaon sa parasito ug hugaw sa panit ug baba sa dagkong isda; makakaon ang gamay ug malimpyo ang dako.

q: Why do invasive species often grow in huge numbers in a new place?
options: There are no natural predators, diseases, or competitors to keep their numbers in check
They reproduce faster in warmer climates than in their home region
The new soil contains nutrients their bodies have never had before
They evolve new traits within one generation that help them survive anywhere
explanation: Invasive species spread quickly because their new environment lacks the natural enemies and competitors that limited their numbers at home.
fact_tl: Kumakalat nang mabilis ang invasive species dahil sa bagong lugar, kadalasan walang natural na kaaway (predator), sakit, o katunggali na pumipigil sa kanila, kaya mabilis silang dumami.
fact_bis: Mokatag og paspas ang invasive species kay sa bag-ong dapit, kasagaran walay natural nga kaaway (predator), sakit, o kakompetensya nga mopugong nila, busa paspas silang modaghan.

q: What property of metals allows them to be pulled and stretched into thin wires?
options: Ductility
Malleability
Conductivity
Brittleness
explanation: Metals are ductile, meaning they can be stretched and pulled into thin wires without breaking.
fact_tl: Ang metal ay ductile, kaya maaari itong hilahin at gawing manipis na alambre.
fact_bis: Ang metal ductile, busa mahimo kining biraon ug himoong nipis nga alambre.

q: Why do your hands feel warmer when you rub them together?
options: Friction between the hands produces heat
The blood vessels widen when hands move, releasing stored heat
The skin absorbs heat from the surrounding air more easily when moving
Static electricity builds up and warms the skin
explanation: When you rub your hands together, friction converts the motion into heat energy, warming your hands.
fact_tl: Kapag ikinukuskos natin ang ating mga kamay, ang kiskisan ay gumagawa ng init na nakakapagpainit sa kanila.
fact_bis: Kung atong kuskoson ang atong mga kamot, ang kiskisanay maghimo og kainit nga makapainit niini.

q: What type of roots does the kapok tree have that help it stand firmly?
options: Wide, wing-like buttress roots at its base
Long, deep taproots that reach the water table
Shallow, spreading prop roots around its trunk
Aerial roots that hang down from its branches
explanation: The kapok tree has wide buttress roots that spread out at its base and support it like wings.
fact_tl: Ang kapok ay may malalapad na ugat sa puno na parang pakpak na tumutulong dito na tumayo nang matatag.
fact_bis: Ang kapok-kapok adunay halapad nga gamot sa punoan nga morag pako nga motabang niini nga motindog nga lig-on.

q: Compared to a worker bee that lives only a few weeks, how long can a queen bee live?
options: About 5 years
About 6 months
About 1 year
About 2 weeks
explanation: A queen bee can live for about 5 years, far longer than a worker bee that lives only a few weeks.
fact_tl: Ang reynang bubuyog ay nabubuhay nang mga 5 taon, mas matagal kaysa sa worker bee na ilang linggo lang.
fact_bis: Ang rayna nga bubuyog makabuhi og mga 5 ka tuig, mas dugay kaysa sa worker bee nga pipila lang ka semana.

q: What do the bright colors of a nudibranch warn other animals about?
options: That the nudibranch is distasteful or toxic
That the nudibranch is ready to mate
That the nudibranch is the dominant animal in that area
That the nudibranch is closely related to poisonous corals
explanation: Nudibranchs use bright colors as a warning signal, telling predators that they are toxic or bad-tasting.
fact_tl: Ang mga nudibranch ay mga kulay-kulay na sea slug na walang shell — ang kanilang maliwanag na kulay ay nagbababala sa mga mandaragit na sila ay mapait o lason; ang ilang species ay kumukuha ng mga stinging cells mula sa mga kinakain nilang coral at ginagamit ito para sa sariling depensa.
fact_bis: Ang mga nudibranch mga makukulay nga sea slug nga walay shell — ang ilang hayag nga mga kulay nagpahimangno sa mga mandaragit nga sila mapait o hilo; ang pipila ka species nagkuha og mga stinging cell gikan sa mga coral nga ilang gikaon ug gigamit kini alang sa ilang kaugalingon nga depensa.

q: How is granite formed?
options: From magma that cooled slowly deep underground
From layers of sediment pressed together over time
From existing rocks changed by heat and pressure
From lava that cooled quickly on Earth's surface
explanation: Granite is an igneous rock that forms when magma cools slowly deep beneath the surface, allowing large crystals to develop.
fact_tl: Ang granite ay isang igneous rock na nabuo mula sa magma na dahan-dahang lumamig sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang granite usa ka igneous rock nga naporma gikan sa magma nga hinay-hinay nga mibugnaw sa ilawom sa yuta.

q: What is the purpose of a weather chart that students fill in each day?
options: To track whether each day is sunny, rainy, or cloudy so we can see weather patterns
To predict exactly when a typhoon will arrive next month
To record temperatures around the world for global scientists
To count the number of rainy days needed before planting crops
explanation: A weather chart records daily conditions — sunny, rainy, or cloudy — so students can observe patterns in the weather over time.
fact_tl: Ang weather chart ay isang talaan na nagtatala araw-araw kung maaraw, maulan, o maulap, para makita ang pattern ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang weather chart usa ka talaan nga nagrekord matag adlaw kon init, ulanon, o panganuron, aron makita ang sumbanan sa panahon.

q: What does a Storm Signal No. 4 warning mean for people in an area?
options: Very strong, destructive winds may arrive within about 12 hours and can heavily damage many houses
Light rains and gentle winds are expected throughout the day
A moderate storm will arrive within 36 hours with some flooding possible
Extreme flooding is certain and all residents must evacuate immediately
explanation: Signal No. 4 warns of very strong destructive winds expected within about 12 hours that can cause heavy damage.
fact_tl: Ang Signal No. 4 ay nangangahulugang may napakalakas at nakasisirang hanging dala ng bagyo na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 12 oras at maaaring sumira ng maraming bahay.
fact_bis: Ang Signal No. 4 nagpasabot nga adunay grabe ka kusog ug makaguba nga hangin gikan sa bagyo nga moabot sulod sa mga 12 ka oras ug makaguba sa daghang balay.

q: How can you identify a sperm whale by its blowhole spray?
options: The spray shoots out slanted to the left, not straight up
The spray is the tallest of any whale and reaches 10 meters high
The spray comes from two blowholes and forms a V shape
The spray is invisible because the water is forced back into the sea
explanation: A sperm whale's blowhole is positioned so that its spray shoots out to the left at an angle, making it easy to identify.
fact_tl: Madaling makilala ang sperm whale dahil ang 'spray' o singaw nitong palabas sa blowhole ay pahilig sa kaliwa, hindi tuwid pataas.
fact_bis: Sayon ilhon ang sperm whale tungod kay ang 'spray' o aso gikan sa blowhole niini mosabwag nga tagilid sa wala, dili tul-id pataas.

q: Where does a mango seed originally come from?
options: It forms inside the fruit of a mango tree after the flower becomes a fruit
It falls from the sky as part of the rain cycle
It grows directly out of the ground without needing a parent tree
It is carried by birds who deposit it as a fully formed seed
explanation: A mango tree flowers first, the flower becomes a fruit, and the seed forms inside that fruit — so every seed comes from a parent tree.
fact_tl: Tanong ng bata: saan galing ang buto? Galing ito sa bunga ng isang puno ng mangga. Namumulaklak muna ang puno, nagiging bunga, at sa loob ng bunga nabubuo ang buto.
fact_bis: Pangutana sa bata: asa gikan ang liso? Gikan kini sa bunga sa usa ka kahoy nga mangga. Mamulak una ang kahoy, mahimong bunga, ug sa sulod sa bunga maporma ang liso.

q: Why is solar power especially useful for remote Philippine islands?
options: They are not connected to the main power grid, so solar panels and batteries can supply electricity without long undersea cables
They have more sunlight than other parts of Asia, making solar the cheapest option everywhere
The national government requires all islands to use renewable energy by law
Islands need less power than cities, so small solar panels are enough for any community
explanation: Remote Philippine islands without grid connections can use solar panels and batteries to generate electricity independently.
fact_tl: Ang mga malalayong pulo sa Pilipinas na walang koneksyon sa pangunahing grid ay maaaring mapakinabangan ng solar power — ang mga solar panel at baterya ay nagbibigay ng kuryente nang hindi kailangan ng mahabang undersea cable.
fact_bis: Ang mga malalayong pulo sa Pilipinas nga walay koneksyon sa pangunahing grid makapakita-abni sa solar power — ang mga solar panel ug baterya naghatag ug kuryente nga wala kinahanglana ug taas nga undersea cable.

q: What happens when you push the north pole of one magnet toward the north pole of another magnet?
options: They push each other away (repel)
They pull strongly toward each other (attract)
They stick together and cannot be separated
Nothing happens because north poles are neutral
explanation: Like poles repel each other, so two north poles (or two south poles) will push away from each other.
fact_tl: Ang magkaparehong poste ay nagtutulak palayo: ang north at north ay hindi magkakadikit.
fact_bis: Ang managsama nga poste mag-abog: duha ka north pole, o duha ka south pole, magtinulakay palayo.

q: What is one key difference between chikungunya and dengue fever?
options: Chikungunya causes worse joint pain while dengue lowers blood platelets
Chikungunya lowers blood platelets while dengue causes worse joint pain
Chikungunya is spread by mosquitoes while dengue is spread by ticks
Chikungunya requires hospitalization while dengue can always be treated at home
explanation: Although dengue and chikungunya are easy to confuse, chikungunya is known for severe joint pain while dengue is known for lowering blood platelet counts.
fact_tl: Mahirap pagkaibahin ang dengue at chikungunya, ngunit ang chikungunya ay may mas matinding sakit sa kasu-kasuan habang ang dengue ay nakakababa ng platelet sa dugo.
fact_bis: Lisod ilhon ang kalainan sa dengue ug chikungunya, apan ang chikungunya adunay mas grabe nga sakit sa lutahan samtang ang dengue magpaubos sa platelet sa dugo.

q: What is hydrophobia, and which disease causes it?
options: A strong fear of water caused by painful throat spasms, which is a symptom of rabies
An extreme thirst that cannot be satisfied, caused by dehydration after a snake bite
A fear of drowning that develops after any animal scratch near the neck
An inability to swallow liquids, caused by food poisoning from raw meat
explanation: Rabies causes painful throat spasms when a person tries to swallow water, leading to a well-known fear of water called hydrophobia.
fact_tl: Isang kilalang sintomas ng rabies sa tao ay ang matinding takot sa tubig dahil sa masakit na pananikip ng lalamunan.
fact_bis: Usa ka ilado nga sintomas sa rabies sa tawo mao ang grabe nga kahadlok sa tubig tungod sa sakit nga pagkumot sa tutonlan.

q: How is a wheel and axle similar to a lever?
options: The axle acts as the fulcrum, and the wheel lets you push continuously around instead of just one stroke
They both use pulleys to multiply force along a straight line
Both machines must be used with a counterweight to work properly
They are completely different — a lever lifts while a wheel-axle only rolls
explanation: A wheel and axle is like a rotating lever: the axle is the fulcrum, and turning the wheel lets you apply force round and round instead of one stroke at a time.
fact_tl: Ang wheel and axle ay parang isang lever na patuloy na umiikot. Sa lever, may isang dulo ka lang na maitutulak; sa wheel and axle, paikot-ikot kang makakatulak nang walang hinto. Ang sentro ng ehe ang nagsisilbing fulcrum o tuturuan.
fact_bis: Ang wheel and axle sama sa usa ka lever nga padayon nga nagtuyok. Sa lever usa ra ka duso ang imong mahimo; sa wheel and axle makaduso ka libot-libot nga walay hunong. Ang tunga sa ehe mao ang nagsilbing fulcrum o tuyokanan.

q: Besides carbon dioxide, what other gas is released when fuels like wood or gas burn?
options: Water vapor
Nitrogen gas
Oxygen gas
Helium gas
explanation: Wood and gas contain hydrogen, so when they burn they release water vapor along with carbon dioxide.
fact_tl: Maraming gatong tulad ng kahoy at gas ang may hydrogen, kaya kapag nasusunog ay naglalabas din ng singaw ng tubig (water vapor) na isa pang hindi nakikitang gas.
fact_bis: Daghang sugnod sama sa kahoy ug gas adunay hydrogen, mao nga kung masunog kini mogawas usab og alisngaw sa tubig (water vapor), laing dili-makita nga gas.

q: The Philippine monsoon is part of which larger weather system?
options: The Asian monsoon system that also affects India, Bangladesh, Vietnam, and Thailand
The Pacific Ocean current system that controls rainfall across all Pacific islands
The El Niño cycle that originates near South America
The Intertropical Convergence Zone found only above the equator
explanation: The Philippine monsoon is one part of the broader Asian monsoon system shared by many countries including India, Bangladesh, Vietnam, and Thailand.
fact_tl: Ang monsoon ng Pilipinas ay bahagi ng mas malaking sistema ng Asian monsoon na nakakaapekto sa India, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Thailand, at iba pang bansang Asyano.
fact_bis: Ang monsoon sa Pilipinas usa ka bahin sa mas dako nga sistema sa Asian monsoon nga nakaapekto usab sa India, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Thailand, ug uban pang mga nasud sa Asya.

q: Why do doctors test a patient's reflexes, such as the knee-jerk test?
options: To check that the nerves and spinal cord are working well
To measure how strong the patient's leg muscles are
To test whether the patient is suffering from dehydration
To check if the patient's heart rate is within a healthy range
explanation: Reflex tests like the knee-jerk help doctors confirm that the nerves and spinal cord are functioning properly.
fact_tl: Sinusuri ng mga doktor ang reflex, tulad ng sa tuhod, upang malaman kung maayos ang ugnayan ng mga nerbiyos at gulugod.
fact_bis: Susihon sa mga doktor ang reflex, sama sa tuhod, aron mahibaloan kon maayo ba ang koneksyon sa mga nerbiyos ug dugokan sa likod.

q: What is the main difference between conductive hearing loss and sensorineural hearing loss?
options: Conductive loss is often treatable because sound is blocked in the outer/middle ear, while sensorineural loss from nerve or cochlea damage is usually permanent
Conductive loss is permanent because it involves nerve damage, while sensorineural loss is temporary and clears on its own
Both types are permanent, but conductive loss is louder while sensorineural loss affects only high-pitched sounds
Sensorineural loss is treatable with surgery while conductive loss requires a hearing aid forever
explanation: Conductive hearing loss is often treatable since it involves a blockage in the outer or middle ear, whereas sensorineural loss from cochlea or nerve damage is usually permanent.
fact_tl: Ang conductive hearing loss ay nangyayari kapag may hadlang sa pagdaan ng tunog sa outer o middle ear, at karaniwang nagagamot; ang sensorineural hearing loss ay dahil sa pinsala ng cochlea o nerve at kadalasang permanente.
fact_bis: Ang conductive hearing loss mahitabo kung ang tunog naputol sa outer o middle ear ug kasagaran ginaayo; ang sensorineural hearing loss gikan sa samad sa cochlea o nerve ug kasagaran permanente.

q: How do animals get the nitrogen they need?
options: By eating plants or other animals that already contain nitrogen
By breathing it in directly from the air like oxygen
By drinking water that contains dissolved nitrogen
By absorbing it through their skin from the soil
explanation: Animals obtain nitrogen by eating plants or other animals, passing nitrogen along through the food chain.
fact_tl: Nakukuha ng mga hayop ang nitroheno kapag kinakain nila ang mga halaman o ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap makakuha og nitrogen kung mokaon sila og mga tanom o ubang mananap.

q: What is the Sun mostly made of?
options: Hydrogen
Helium
Oxygen
Iron
explanation: The Sun is mostly made of hydrogen, with some helium making up most of the rest.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay halos puro hydrogen, kasama ang kaunting helium.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw kasagaran hydrogen, uban sa gamay nga helium.

q: How does an evaporative air cooler make the air feel cooler?
options: It evaporates water into the air, which absorbs heat
It blows air over frozen ice blocks
It compresses the air to lower its temperature
It pushes warm air out through a vent
explanation: Water evaporation absorbs a large amount of heat from the air, making it cooler.
fact_tl: Ang evaporative air cooler ay nagpapalamig ng hangin sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalabas ng tubig sa umiihip na hangin — ang evaporation ng tubig ay sumasipsip ng malaking halaga ng init mula sa hangin at pinagpapalamig ito.
fact_bis: Ang evaporative air cooler nagapalamig sa hangin pinaagi sa pagpalapaw sa tubig sa nagaihip nga hangin — ang evaporation sa tubig nagsipsip og dako nga init gikan sa hangin, nagapalamig niini.

q: When do neap tides — the weakest tides — occur?
options: When the Sun and Moon are at right angles to the Earth
When the Sun, Moon, and Earth are all in a straight line
When the Moon is closest to Earth
When the Moon is on the opposite side of Earth from the Sun
explanation: Neap tides happen at first and last quarter, when the Sun and Moon are at right angles to the Earth, so their gravitational pulls partly cancel each other.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang neap tide (pinakamahinang pagkakaiba ng taog) kapag first quarter o last quarter, dahil may right angle ang Araw at Buwan kumpara sa Earth.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang neap tide (kinahuyangang taob) sa first quarter ug last quarter, kay nag-right angle ang Adlaw ug Bulan sa Yuta.

q: Why do flies gather on garbage and rotting food?
options: They feed and lay their eggs there
They are looking for clean water nearby
They are attracted only by bright colors
They hide there to escape predators
explanation: Flies are drawn to dirty, smelly places like garbage and rotting food, where they both feed and lay their eggs.
fact_tl: Naaakit ang langaw sa marurumi at mabahong lugar tulad ng basurahan at bulok na pagkain. Doon sila kumakain at nangingitlog.
fact_bis: Madani ang langaw sa hugaw ug baho nga mga lugar sama sa basurahan ug bulok nga pagkaon. Didto sila mokaon ug mangitlog.

q: Why is it important to wash your hands with soap and water before eating?
options: It removes germs so you do not get sick
It makes food taste better
It helps your body digest food faster
It prevents the food from spoiling
explanation: Washing hands with soap and water before eating removes germs that could make you sick.
fact_tl: Ang paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at tubig bago kumain ay nag-aalis ng mga germ para hindi tayo magkasakit.
fact_bis: Ang paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon ug tubig sa dili pa mokaon mokuha sa mga germ aron dili ta magsakit.

q: Why does the false cleanerfish look like the real cleaner wrasse?
options: So it can sneak close to other fish and bite a chunk off them
So larger fish will not eat it
So it can share food with the real cleaner
So it can attract a mate more easily
explanation: The false cleanerfish mimics the real cleaner so other fish trust it and let it close enough to bite a chunk off them.
fact_tl: May isdang tinatawag na false cleanerfish na ginagaya ang anyo ng tunay na cleaner para makakagat ng laman ng ibang isda.
fact_bis: Adunay isda nga gitawag nga false cleanerfish nga mosundog sa dagway sa tinuod nga cleaner aron makapaak ug unod sa ubang isda.

q: On which country's border does Mount Everest sit?
options: Nepal and Tibet (China)
India and Pakistan
Bhutan and China
Nepal and India
explanation: Mount Everest sits on the border between Nepal and Tibet (China) in the Himalaya mountains.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Everest ay matatagpuan sa hangganan ng Nepal at Tibet (China) sa kabundukan ng Himalaya.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Everest nahimutang sa utlanan sa Nepal ug Tibet (China) sa kabukiran sa Himalaya.

q: Which chromosome combination is usually found in biological males?
options: XY
XX
YY
XO
explanation: Biological sex is determined by sex chromosomes; females are usually XX and males are usually XY.
fact_tl: May isang pares ng chromosomes (X at Y) na nagtatakda ng biyolohikal na kasarian; karaniwang XX sa babae at XY sa lalaki, at ang ama ang nagbibigay ng X o Y.
fact_bis: Adunay usa ka pares sa chromosomes (X ug Y) nga nagtino sa biyolohikal nga sekso; kasagaran XX sa babaye ug XY sa lalaki, ug ang amahan mao ang naghatag sa X o Y.

q: What is special about sounds in the 2,000–5,000 Hz range and your ear canal?
options: The ear canal's shape naturally amplifies those frequencies
The ear canal blocks those frequencies to protect the eardrum
The ear canal converts those frequencies into electrical signals faster
Those frequencies are too high for the ear canal to detect
explanation: The shape and length of the ear canal create a natural resonance that amplifies sounds in the 2,000–5,000 Hz range, which is most important for understanding speech.
fact_tl: Ang hugis at haba ng ear canal ay nagdudulot ng natural resonance na nagpapalaki ng mga tunog sa pagitan ng 2,000 at 5,000 Hz — ang hanay na pinaka-mahalaga para sa pag-unawa ng salita.
fact_bis: Ang porma ug gitas-on sa ear canal nagahatag og natural nga resonance nga nagapalaka sa mga tunog tali sa 2,000 ug 5,000 Hz — ang hanay nga pinaka-importante sa pagsabot sa sinultian.

q: About how fast does Earth travel as it orbits the Sun?
options: About 30 kilometers per second
About 3 kilometers per second
About 300 kilometers per second
About 0.3 kilometers per second
explanation: Earth orbits the Sun at a speed of about 30 kilometers per second.
fact_tl: Ang Mundo ay umiikot sa Araw sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 30 kilometro kada segundo.
fact_bis: Ang Kalibotan moliyok sa Adlaw sa tulin nga mga 30 ka kilometro kada segundo.

q: Which of the following is NOT a job of the skin?
options: Producing red blood cells
Protecting the body from germs
Releasing heat through sweat
Blocking out harmful microbes
explanation: The skin protects the body, releases heat through sweat, and blocks out germs, but red blood cells are made inside bones, not in the skin.
fact_tl: Ang balat ay binubuo ng magkakapatong na sapin na nagtatanggol sa katawan, nag-aalis ng init sa pamamagitan ng pawis, at humahadlang sa mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang panit gilangkoban og sapin-sapin nga sapaw nga magpanalipod sa lawas, magpagawas og init pinaagi sa singot, ug magbabag sa mga mikrobyo.

q: How have whole mammoths been preserved so that even their fur and flesh survived?
options: They were frozen in ice in very cold places
They were buried quickly under volcanic ash
They were covered in tree resin that hardened into amber
They sank into peat bogs and were pickled by acid
explanation: In very cold places, whole mammoths have been found frozen in ice, preserving even their fur and flesh.
fact_tl: Sa napakalamig na lugar, may mga buong mammoth na natuklasan na nakabaon sa yelo kaya napreserba pati balahibo at laman.
fact_bis: Sa bugnaw kaayo nga mga dapit, adunay tibuok mammoth nga nakit-an nga gibagtok sa yelo, napreserba bisan ang balahibo ug unod.

q: What do seeds need to start growing (germinate) after being planted in soil?
options: Water and warmth
Only sunlight and air
Salt and fertilizer
Darkness and cold temperatures
explanation: Seeds stay dormant until they are planted in soil, where water and warmth trigger them to germinate into new plants.
