fact_tl: Dahil paiba-iba ang hangin, kailangang itago ang sobrang kuryente sa baterya para magamit kapag tahimik ang hangin.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nag-usab-usab ang hangin, ang sobrang kuryente kasagarang gitipigan sa baterya alang sa panahon nga kalmado ang hangin.

q: What is the main role of the nervous system in the body?
options: To pump blood throughout the body and deliver oxygen to all cells
To break down food and absorb nutrients into the bloodstream
To receive signals from the senses, process them, and tell the body how to respond
To produce hormones that control growth and development
explanation: The nervous system — brain, spinal cord, and nerves — is the body's control center that receives sensory signals, processes them, and directs the body's responses.
fact_tl: Ang nervous system — utak (brain), spinal cord, at nerves — ang sentrong nagkokontrol ng katawan. Tumatanggap ito ng signals mula sa mga pandama (mata, tainga, balat, ilong, dila), nagpoproseso, at nag-uutos sa katawan kung paano tutugon.
fact_bis: Ang nervous system — utok (brain), spinal cord, ug nerves — mao ang sentro nga nagkontrol sa lawas. Modawat kini og signals gikan sa mga igbalati (mata, dalunggan, panit, ilong, dila), moproseso, ug mosugo sa lawas kung unsaon pagtubag.

q: How do the semicircular canals in your inner ear help you keep your balance?
options: They vibrate in response to sound waves and send signals about posture to the brain
They measure the pressure of blood flowing past the ear and adjust body position
Fluid inside them moves when you turn, and the brain detects this movement to sense direction
They sense changes in temperature that indicate your body is tilting to one side
explanation: The three semicircular canals in the inner ear are filled with fluid; movement of this fluid tells the brain which way you are turning, helping you keep your balance.
fact_tl: Ang inner ear ay naglalaman din ng tatlong semicircular canals na puno ng likido — ang galaw ng likidong ito ay nagpapasensya sa utak kung saan ka nakaharap at tumutulong sa iyong balanse.
fact_bis: Ang inner ear naglaman usab og tulo ka semicircular canals nga puno sa likido — ang paglihok niining likido nagtukoy sa utok kung asa ka nagikod, nagtabang sa imong balanse.

q: What happens at the center of a typhoon that makes the winds spin so fast?
options: Very high air pressure pushes air outward, spinning the winds around it
Cold air drops rapidly from the sky and hits warm ocean water, creating spin
Very low air pressure pulls air inward toward the center, making the winds spin faster
A pocket of warm air rises so quickly that it drags surrounding air into a spiral
explanation: The center of a typhoon has very low air pressure, which pulls air inward and causes the winds to spin faster.
fact_tl: Ang gitna ng isang bagyo ay may napakababang presyon ng hangin, kaya humihigop ito ng hangin papasok at lumalakas ang mga hangin paikot.
fact_bis: Ang sentro sa usa ka bagyo adunay ubos kaayo nga presyon sa hangin, nga mosuyop sa hangin pasulod ug mopakusog sa mga hangin nga molibot.

q: Which group of galaxies does the Milky Way belong to?
options: The Virgo Supercluster, the largest structure in the known universe
The Local Group, a small cluster of dozens of galaxies bound by gravity
The Andromeda Cluster, a region dominated by our nearest large galaxy
The Cosmic Web, a network of filaments connecting galaxy groups
explanation: The Milky Way belongs to the Local Group, a small cluster of dozens of galaxies — including the larger Andromeda galaxy — all held together by gravity.
fact_tl: Ang Milky Way ay kabilang sa isang maliit na pangkat ng dose-dosenang galaksiya na tinatawag na Local Group, na pinagbubuklod ng grabidad kasama ng mas malaking galaksiyang Andromeda.
fact_bis: Ang Milky Way sakop sa usa ka gamay nga pundok sa dosena ka galaksiya nga gitawag og Local Group, nga gihiusa sa grabidad uban sa mas dakong galaksiya nga Andromeda.

q: What do we call an atom that has gained extra electrons and become negatively charged?
options: A cation
A proton
A neutron
An anion
explanation: When an atom gains extra electrons it becomes a negatively charged ion called an anion, such as the chloride ion Cl⁻.
fact_tl: Kapag nakakuha ng dagdag na elektron ang isang atomo, nagiging negatibong sisingilin na ion ito na tinatawag na anion, gaya ng chloride ion na Cl⁻.
fact_bis: Kon makadawat ug dugang nga elektron ang usa ka atomo, mahimo kining negatibo nga ion nga gitawag ug anion, sama sa chloride ion nga Cl⁻.

q: Why does a bird line the inside of its cup nest with feathers, moss, or grass?
options: To keep the eggs warm
To make the nest stronger
To hide the nest from predators
To attract a mate to the nest
explanation: A bird lines a cup nest with soft materials like feathers, moss, or grass to keep the eggs warm.
fact_tl: Pinapalamutian ng ibon ang loob ng pugad na hugis-tasa ng malambot na bagay tulad ng balahibo, lumot, o damo upang mainit ang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Ginahaylan sa langgam ang sulod sa salag nga porma-tasa ug humok nga butang sama sa balhibo, lumot, o sagbot aron mainit ang mga itlog.

q: Which part of the body sends signals through motor neurons to make muscles contract and move?
options: The brain
The heart
The lungs
The stomach
explanation: The brain sends signals through nerves called motor neurons to muscles, telling them to contract and create movement.
fact_tl: Ang utak ay nagpapadala ng mga signal sa pamamagitan ng mga nerve patungo sa mga kalamnan, na iniuudyukan ang mga ito na kumokontrakt at gumagawa ng kilusan.
fact_bis: Ang utak nagpadala ug mga signal pinaagi sa mga nerve nga gitawag motor neurons ngadto sa mga kaunuran, nagsulti kanila sa pagkupos ug paghimo ug galaw.

q: What is usually done with unripe jackfruit because it is not sweet?
options: It is cooked as a dish, like jackfruit in coconut milk
It is dried and eaten as a snack
It is blended into a sweet juice
It is used only as animal feed
explanation: Unripe jackfruit is not sweet, so it is cooked as a dish, like jackfruit in coconut milk, rather than eaten as a fruit.
fact_tl: Ang hinog na langka ay matamis at kinakain bilang prutas. Ang hilaw naman na langka ay hindi matamis, kaya iniluluto itong ulam, gaya ng ginataang langka.
fact_bis: Ang hinog nga nangka tam-is ug ginakaon isip prutas. Ang hilaw nga nangka dili tam-is, busa ginaluto kini isip sud-an, sama sa ginataang nangka.

q: Why do some mangroves have pointed roots that stick up out of the mud?
options: To take in and store air for the roots buried in the mud
To absorb extra sunlight above the water
To anchor the tree against strong waves
To collect rainwater during dry seasons
explanation: These pencil-like roots take in and store air, sending oxygen down to the roots buried in airless mud.
fact_tl: May mga bakawan na may matutulis na ugat na tumutusok pataas mula sa putik, na parang mga lapis. Ang mga ugat na ito ay nag-iipon ng hangin at naghahatid ng oxygen pababa sa mga ugat na nakabaon sa putik na walang hangin.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bakawan nga adunay talinis nga gamot nga motusok pataas gikan sa lapok, morag mga lapis. Kini nga mga gamot magtigom ug hangin ug magpadala ug oxygen paubos sa mga gamot nga nalubong sa lapok nga walay hangin.

q: Who founded the Katipunan?
options: Andres Bonifacio
Jose Rizal
Emilio Aguinaldo
Apolinario Mabini
explanation: Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan, the secret revolutionary society that fought against Spanish rule.
fact_tl: Si Andres Bonifacio ang nagtatag ng Katipunan.
fact_bis: Si Andres Bonifacio ang nagtukod sa Katipunan.

q: Which animal is the largest land animal living on Earth today?
options: The African elephant
The white rhinoceros
The hippopotamus
The giraffe
explanation: The African elephant is the largest land animal living today, bigger than any other land animal.
fact_tl: Ang elepanteng Aprikano ang pinakamalaking hayop na naninirahan sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang African nga elepante mao ang pinakadako nga hayop nga nagpuyo sa yuta karon.

q: What was Baybayin used for before Spanish colonization of the Philippines?
options: It was the ancient writing system of Filipinos
It was a system of counting and trading
It was a set of laws carved in stone
It was a type of oral storytelling tradition
explanation: Baybayin is the ancient writing system of Filipinos before the Spanish arrived, and it is still used today as a symbol of Filipino culture.
fact_tl: Ang Baybayin ay ang sinaunang sistema ng pagsulat ng mga Pilipino bago dumating ang mga Espanyol, na ginagamit pa rin ngayon bilang simbolo ng kulturang Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang Baybayin mao ang karaan nga sistema sa pagsulat sa mga Pilipino sa wala pa moabot ang mga Espanyol, gigamit pa karon ingon simbolo sa kulturang Pilipino.

q: Why does kapok fiber work well to keep things warm?
options: Because a lot of air is trapped between the fibers, blocking the cold
Because the fibers are very thick and heavy
Because the fibers absorb heat from the sun
Because the fibers are waterproof and seal out wind
explanation: A lot of air gets trapped between kapok fibers, which blocks the cold and keeps the inside warm.
fact_tl: Dahil maraming hangin na nakukulong sa pagitan ng mga hibla ng kapok, nagiging mabisa itong pampainit. Ang nakulong na hangin ang humaharang sa lamig kaya nananatiling mainit ang loob.
fact_bis: Tungod kay daghang hangin ang nalit-ag taliwala sa mga lugas sa kapok, epektibo kini nga pampainit. Ang nalit-ag nga hangin mobabag sa katugnaw maong magpabilin nga init ang sulod.

q: How many teeth does a person have in a complete set of adult permanent teeth?
options: Thirty-two
Twenty-eight
Twenty-four
Thirty-six
explanation: A complete set of adult permanent teeth is thirty-two teeth.
fact_tl: Ang ganap na hanay ng permanenteng ngipin ng matanda ay tatlumpu't dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang kompletong set sa permanente nga ngipon sa hamtong mao ang katloan ug duha.

q: Why is the purple color inside an amethyst crystal often uneven, with some areas darker and some paler?
options: Because iron was not evenly mixed in as the crystal grew
Because the crystal was exposed to different amounts of sunlight
Because different minerals entered the crystal at different times
Because the outer layers of the crystal are older than the inner layers
explanation: The uneven purple color in amethyst occurs because iron was not evenly mixed in as the crystal grew, creating darker and paler zones.
fact_tl: Kung titingnan mong mabuti ang amethyst, madalas ay hindi pantay ang lilang kulay sa loob nito. May mga bahaging mas madilim at mas maputla. Ito ay dahil hindi pantay ang pagkakahalo ng iron habang lumalaki ang kristal.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon nimo pag-ayo ang amethyst, kasagaran dili patas ang purple nga kolor sulod niini. Adunay mga bahin nga mas lawom ug mas luspad. Kini tungod kay dili patas ang pagkasagol sa puthaw samtang nagtubo ang kristal.

q: What do baby eels look like when they first start life?
options: Tiny, thin, and clear like little leaves
Small and dark with spots like adults
Round and fat like fish eggs
Long and thick like worms
explanation: Baby eels start out tiny, thin, and clear like little leaves before growing into the eel shape adults recognize.
fact_tl: Ang mga sanggol na igat ay maliliit, manipis, at malinaw na parang dahon sa simula.
fact_bis: Ang mga gagmay nga igat nipis ug tin-aw nga morag dahon sa sinugdanan.

q: How old is the dragonfly as a type of insect?
options: Dragonflies were flying on Earth even before the dinosaurs
Dragonflies first appeared at the same time as the dinosaurs
Dragonflies appeared after the dinosaurs went extinct
Dragonflies are a recently evolved type of insect
explanation: Dragonflies are a very ancient kind of insect, flying on Earth even before the dinosaurs existed.
fact_tl: Ang mga tutubi ay napakatandang uri ng insekto—lumilipad na sila sa mundo bago pa dumating ang mga dinosauro.
fact_bis: Ang mga alindahaw usa ka karaan kaayo nga matang sa insekto, naglupad na sila sa kalibotan sa wala pa ang mga dinosauro.

q: What is the thick coat of hair that grows on a sheep called?
options: Wool
Fur
Fleece hide
Down
explanation: A sheep has a thick coat of hair called wool, which can be sheared and used to make warm clothing.
fact_tl: Ang tupa ay may makapal na balahibong tinatawag na lana o wool.
fact_bis: Ang karnero adunay baga nga balhibo nga gitawag og lana o wool.

q: What do the fossils found inside the Chocolate Hills tell us about the area?
options: That the area was once covered by the sea
That the area was once a dense tropical rainforest
That the area was formed by volcanic eruptions
That the area was once a large freshwater lake
explanation: Inside the Chocolate Hills are fossils of coral, shells, and tiny sea animals, which prove that the area was once a sea.
fact_tl: May mga fossil ng coral, kabibe, at maliliit na hayop-dagat sa loob ng mga burol ng Chocolate Hills, na patunay na dating dagat ito.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa mga bungtod sa Chocolate Hills naa'y mga fosil sa coral, kabibe, ug gagmay nga mananap-dagat, pamatuod nga kini kaniadto dagat.

q: Why can scientists use a radioactive isotope's half-life to measure the age of rocks?
options: Because the rate at which the isotope decays is constant, acting like a natural clock
Because the isotope changes color at a predictable rate
Because each rock type contains a unique amount of the isotope
Because older rocks contain more of the isotope than younger ones
explanation: A half-life is constant, so the decay rate acts as a natural clock that scientists use to measure the age of rocks through radiometric dating.
fact_tl: Ang half-life ay ang panahong kailangan para mabulok ang kalahati ng radyoaktibong isotopo; dahil palagi ang bilis nito, nagsisilbi itong natural na orasan para sukatin ang edad ng bato.
fact_bis: Ang half-life mao ang panahon nga kinahanglan aron mabulok ang katunga sa usa ka radyoaktibong isotope; tungod kay kanunay ang katulin niini, magsilbi kining natural nga orasan sa pagsukod sa edad sa bato.

q: How does a microwave oven heat food?
options: It makes the water molecules inside the food vibrate very fast, and that vibration becomes heat
It heats the plate, which then warms the food sitting on it
It produces hot air that flows around and cooks the food
It uses light energy that is absorbed by the surface of the food
explanation: A microwave oven makes the water molecules inside food vibrate very fast, and that shaking becomes heat, so the food warms up from the inside.
fact_tl: Hindi iniinit ng microwave oven ang plato kundi ang tubig na nasa loob mismo ng pagkain — pinapayanig nito nang napakabilis ang mga molekula ng tubig, at ang pagyanig na iyon ang nagiging init.
fact_bis: Ang microwave oven dili mag-init sa plato kondili sa tubig nga anaa mismo sa sulod sa pagkaon — gipakurog niini ang mga molekula sa tubig nga paspas kaayo, ug kana nga pagkurog mahimong kainit.

q: What allows an owl to fly nearly silently, so its prey cannot hear it coming?
options: Its soft feathers muffle the sound of its wings
Its large wings move very slowly through the air
It flies only at heights where sound does not carry
Its light body barely disturbs the air as it glides
explanation: An owl's soft feathers make its flight nearly silent, giving it a surprise advantage when hunting prey.
fact_tl: Ang malalambot na balahibo ng kuwago ay nagpapatahimik sa paglipad nito, kaya hindi ito naririnig ng biktima nito.
fact_bis: Ang humok nga mga balhibo sa bukaw maghimo sa paglupad niini nga halos hilom, mao nga dili kini madungog sa biktima niini.

q: How does the tabon bird (megapode) incubate its eggs?
options: It buries the eggs inside a large mound of sand, soil, and leaves
It sits on the eggs in a nest high in the treetops
It hides the eggs in a hole in the ground and covers them with bark
It carries the eggs in a pouch on its body until they hatch
explanation: The tabon bird builds a large mound of sand, soil, and leaves and buries its eggs inside it, using the heat of decomposition to incubate them.
fact_tl: Ang ibong tabon ay gumagawa ng malaking bunton ng buhangin, lupa, at dahon na siyang pinaglalagyan ng itlog.
fact_bis: Ang langgam nga tabon naghimo ug dakong tumpok sa balas, yuta, ug dahon nga maoy ginabutangan sa itlog.

q: What happened in hospitals when doctors started requiring handwashing before touching patients?
options: The number of deaths from infection suddenly dropped
Patients took longer to recover from surgery
The rate of new infections stayed the same
Doctors became sick more often than before
explanation: When a hospital doctor required handwashing before touching patients, the number of deaths from infection suddenly dropped, proving that handwashing saves lives.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, hindi alam ng mga doktor na kaylangang maghugas ng kamay, kaya maraming pasyente ang namamatay sa impeksyon. Nang simulan ng isang doktor sa ospital na ipag-utos ang paghuhugas bago humawak ng pasyente, biglang bumaba ang bilang ng namamatay — isa itong malaking patunay na totoong nakakaligtas ng buhay ang paghuhugas.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, wala mahibalo ang mga doktor nga kinahanglan silang manghugas, busa daghang pasyente ang namatay sa impeksyon. Sa dihang gisugdan sa usa ka doktor sa ospital nga ipasugo ang panghugas una mohikap og pasyente, kalit nga miubos ang gidaghanon sa namatay — usa kini ka kusganong pamatuod nga ang panghugas tinuod nga makaluwas og kinabuhi.

q: Why does a thrown dart follow a slightly curved path rather than a straight line to the board?
options: Because gravity pulls it down while it moves forward
Because the dart spins and drifts sideways through the air
Because air resistance slows the front of the dart more than the back
Because the thrower's wrist adds a downward flick at the moment of release
explanation: A thrown dart moves forward while gravity pulls it down at the same time, so it follows a slightly curved path to the board.
fact_tl: Kapag inihagis ang dart, sabay itong gumagalaw pasulong at bumababa dahil sa hila ng grabidad, kaya bahagyang kurba ang daan nito patungo sa target.
fact_bis: Kon ilabay ang dart, mopadulong kini samtang ginabira sa grabidad paubos, mao nga gamay nga kurba ang agianan niini paingon sa target.

q: Why does a plant stem bend toward the light during phototropism?
options: Auxin builds up on the shaded side, making those cells grow longer so the stem bends toward the light
Cells on the light side produce more sugar, pushing the stem away from them
The light side of the stem dries out and shrinks, pulling the stem in that direction
Water moves to the light side, making those cells swell and push the stem toward the light
explanation: In phototropism, auxin accumulates on the shaded side, causing those cells to elongate more, so the stem bends toward the light.
fact_tl: Sa phototropism, ang auxin ay nag-iipon sa madilim na bahagi ng tangkay at nagpapahaba ng mga selula roon—kaya ang tangkay ay yumuyuko patungo sa liwanag dahil ang lilim na bahagi ay mas mahaba.
fact_bis: Sa phototropism, ang auxin nag-ipon sa madulom nga bahin sa tangkay ug nagpalawig sa mga selula didto—kaya ang tangkay yumuko padulong sa kahayag tungod kay ang madulom nga bahin mas taas.

q: Where does the glucose used in cellular respiration come from?
options: From the food we eat and digest
From oxygen that enters the blood through the lungs
From water that is absorbed in the small intestine
From fat stored in muscles during rest
explanation: The glucose used in cellular respiration comes from the food we eat and digest.
fact_tl: Ang glucose na ginagamit sa respirasyon ay nagmumula sa pagkaing ating kinakain at tinunaw.
fact_bis: Ang glucose nga gigamit sa respirasyon naggikan sa pagkaon nga atong gikaon ug gitunaw.

q: Why is the Philippine freshwater crocodile considered one of the world's rarest crocodilians?
options: Only a few hundred remain in the wild
It lives only on one small island and cannot breed in captivity
It was nearly wiped out by a disease in the last century
There are fewer than ten left in the whole world
explanation: Only a few hundred Philippine freshwater crocodiles remain in the wild, making it one of the rarest crocodilians in the world.
fact_tl: Tanging ilang daan na Philippine freshwater crocodile ang natitirang bukas sa kalikasan, kaya ito ay isa sa pinaka-nanganganib na buwaya sa mundo.
fact_bis: Pipila ra ka gatos nga Philippine freshwater crocodile ang nahibiling buhi sa kinaiyahan, nga nagpaisa niini nga usa sa pinakalangitnon nga buwaya sa kalibutan.

q: In a lichen, what role does the algae play in the partnership with the fungus?
options: The algae makes food from sunlight
The algae provides water to the fungus
The algae protects the fungus from drying out
The algae breaks down rocks to release minerals for the fungus
explanation: In a lichen, the algae makes food from sunlight while the fungi gives protection and water — a mutualistic partnership.
fact_tl: Ang lichen na nakikita sa mga bato at puno ay binubuo ng algae at fungi na magkasama: gumagawa ng pagkain ang algae mula sa sikat ng araw, at nagbibigay ng proteksyon at tubig ang fungi.
fact_bis: Ang lichen nga makita sa mga bato ug kahoy gilangkoban sa algae ug fungi nga magkuyog: ang algae maghimo ug pagkaon gikan sa adlaw, ug ang fungi mohatag ug panalipod ug tubig.

q: What is a mudflat, and why is it important to wildlife?
options: It is soft muddy ground exposed when the tide goes out, and it is a rich feeding place for crabs, clams, and shorebirds
It is a shallow sandy area where fish lay their eggs during high tide
It is a rocky coastal strip that acts as a barrier against strong waves
It is a deep underwater trench where bottom-feeding animals live
explanation: A mudflat is soft, muddy ground exposed when the tide goes out, and it provides a rich feeding area for crabs, clams, and shorebirds.
fact_tl: Ang putikan o mudflat ay ang malambot na lupang nalalantad kapag kati ang tubig-dagat, at ito ay mayamang pinagkukunan ng pagkain ng mga alimango, talaba, at mga ibong-baybay.
fact_bis: Ang putikan o mudflat mao ang humok nga lapok nga yuta nga makita kung mohubas ang dagat, ug usa kini ka dato nga tinubdan sa pagkaon sa mga alimango, talaba, ug mga langgam sa baybayon.

q: When do new leaves grow back on trees that lost their leaves in winter?
options: When spring arrives and the weather warms again
When summer ends and temperatures begin to cool
When the first heavy rain of the year falls
When the tree has stored enough food in its roots
explanation: After winter, new leaves grow on the tree when spring arrives and the weather warms again.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng taglamig, tumutubo ang bagong mga dahon sa puno kapag dumating ang tagsibol at uminit na muli.
fact_bis: Human sa tingtugnaw, manubo ang bag-ong mga dahon sa kahoy kon moabot ang tingpamulak ug moinit na usab.

q: What is the main role of vitamins in the body?
options: They help other parts of the body do their jobs, not provide energy or calories
They supply most of the energy the body needs to move and think
They build and repair muscles after exercise
They store energy for use when food is not available
explanation: Vitamins do not give energy or calories; instead they help other parts of the body do their jobs properly.
fact_tl: Hindi nagbibigay ng enerhiya o kalorya ang mga bitamina; sa halip, tumutulong sila para gumana ang ibang bahagi ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga bitamina dili mohatag og enerhiya o kalorya; hinuon motabang sila aron molihok ang ubang bahin sa lawas.

q: How do legumes get nitrogen for growth?
options: They capture nitrogen from the air through their roots
They absorb nitrogen only from rainwater during storms
They get nitrogen by breaking down decaying leaves on the soil surface
They store nitrogen from the sun's energy during photosynthesis
explanation: Legumes can capture nitrogen from the air through their roots, enriching the soil with nitrogen.
fact_tl: Ang mga legume ay nakakakuha ng nitroheno mula sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng kanilang mga ugat.
fact_bis: Ang mga legume makakuha ug nitrogen gikan sa hangin pinaagi sa ilang mga gamot.

q: What causes a meteor shower like the Perseids that occurs every August?
options: Earth passes through a trail of debris left behind by a comet
A group of asteroids breaks apart near Earth's orbit
The moon's gravity pulls pieces of rock into Earth's atmosphere
A nearby star sends out a burst of particles that reach Earth
explanation: The Perseids meteor shower every August is caused by Earth passing through the debris trail of Comet Swift-Tuttle.
fact_tl: Ang mga meteor shower ay nangyayari kapag ang Earth ay dumadaan sa debris trail ng isang kometa; halimbawa, ang Perseids meteor shower tuwing Agosto ay dulot ng debris ng Komet Swift-Tuttle, at ang Leonids tuwing Nobyembre ay dulot ng Komet Tempel-Tuttle.
fact_bis: Ang mga meteor shower mahitabo sa dihang ang Yuta moagi sa debris trail sa usa ka kometa; pananglitan, ang Perseids meteor shower matag Agosto gikan sa debris sa Comet Swift-Tuttle, ug ang Leonids sa Nobyembre gikan sa Comet Tempel-Tuttle.

q: In which country was the famous scientist Marie Curie born?
options: Poland
France
Germany
Russia
explanation: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, Poland, though she later did most of her scientific work in France.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ay ipinanganak sa Warsaw, Poland.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie natawo sa Warsaw, Poland.

q: What is a plasmid, and why is it important in bacteria?
options: A small circular piece of DNA that bacteria can share with each other, often carrying genes for antibiotic resistance
A protective outer layer that shields bacteria from the immune system
A type of cell membrane that controls what enters and leaves the bacterium
A structure inside bacteria that produces energy for the cell
explanation: A plasmid is a small circular piece of DNA in bacteria that can be shared between bacteria, and it often carries genes for antibiotic resistance.
fact_tl: Ang plasmid ay isang maliit na bilog na piraso ng DNA na matatagpuan sa ilang bacteria — ang mga bacteria ay maaaring magbahagi ng plasmid sa isa't isa at kadalasang nagdadala ng mga gene para sa antibiotic resistance.
fact_bis: Ang plasmid usa ka gamay nga bilog nga piraso sa DNA nga makita sa uban nga bakterya — ang mga bakterya mahimong magpakigbahin og plasmid sa usag-usa, ug kini nga mga plasmid kasagaran nagdala sa mga gene para sa antibiotic resistance.

q: Which part of a soap molecule is called the 'head,' and what does it do?
options: The end that likes water; it holds onto water
The end that likes oil; it grabs onto grease and dirt
The middle section that connects the water-loving and oil-loving ends
The outer coating that makes soap feel slippery
explanation: The head of a soap molecule is the end that likes water (hydrophilic), and it holds onto water during cleaning.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na ulo ng sabon ang dulong mahilig sa tubig, at ito ang humahawak sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa sabon nga ganahan sa tubig gitawag nga ulo, ug kini ang mokupot sa tubig.

q: What kind of plant is the gumamela (hibiscus) commonly known as in the Philippines?
options: A big, colorful flower commonly planted in gardens
A small vine that climbs along fences and walls
A tall tree grown for its fruit in orchards
A water plant that floats on ponds and lakes
explanation: The gumamela (hibiscus) is a big, colorful flower commonly planted in gardens throughout the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang gumamela ay isang malaki at makulay na bulaklak na karaniwang itinatanim sa mga hardin sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang gumamela kay usa ka dako ug mabulokon nga bulak nga kasagarang gitanom sa mga tanaman sa Pilipinas.

q: What does a shrimp use to find its way when the water is too murky for its eyes to see?
options: Its two antennae to feel where to go
Its sense of smell through tiny pores on its body
Vibrations it picks up through its legs on the sea floor
A built-in sense of the water's current direction
explanation: When the water is murky or dark, a shrimp relies on its two antennae to feel where to go since its eyes cannot see.
fact_tl: Kapag malabo o madilim ang tubig at hindi makita ng mga mata, gabay ng hipon ang dalawang sungot para malaman kung saan papunta.
fact_bis: Kon hugaw o ngitngit ang tubig ug dili makakita ang mga mata, gisaligan sa hipon ang duha ka sungot aron mahibal-an kon asa moadto.

q: What happens to the glass eels caught at Philippine river mouths?
options: They are raised in fish farms until they grow big
They are immediately released back into the sea
They are dried and exported as a specialty food
They are kept in research tanks to study their life cycle
explanation: At Philippine river mouths, glass eels are caught and raised in farms until they grow big enough.
fact_tl: Sa mga bukana ng ilog sa Pilipinas, nahuhuli ang glass eel na inaalagaan sa palaisdaan hanggang lumaki.
fact_bis: Sa mga baba sa suba sa Pilipinas, gidakop ang glass eel nga giatiman sa palaisdaan hangtod modako.

q: How does a bubo fish trap catch fish?
options: It has a funnel-shaped opening that lets fish swim in easily but makes it hard for them to swim back out
It uses bait attached to a hook inside the bamboo tube
It closes shut when a fish touches a trigger inside it
It traps fish by tangling them in a net stretched across the opening
explanation: A bubo is a traditional bamboo fish trap with a funnel-shaped opening, so fish can swim in easily but find it hard to swim back out.
fact_tl: Ang bubo ay tradisyunal na bitag na yari sa kawayan na may parang-funnel na pasukan, kaya madaling makapasok ang isda ngunit mahirap nang makalabas, isang matalinong paraan ng panghuhuli.
fact_bis: Ang bubo usa ka tradisyonal nga lit-ag nga hinimo sa kawayan nga adunay sama-funnel nga pultahan, busa sayon mosulod ang isda apan lisod na mogawas, usa ka maalamon nga paagi sa pagpanakop.

q: What is the recognized national fruit of the Philippines?
options: Mango
Banana
Pineapple
Papaya
explanation: The Philippines' recognized national fruit is the mango.
fact_tl: Ang kinikilalang pambansang prutas ng Pilipinas ay ang mangga.
fact_bis: Ang giila nga nasudnong prutas sa Pilipinas mao ang mangga.

q: Where does a civet spend much of its time?
options: Up in the branches of trees
Burrowed under the ground
Floating along rivers and streams
Hiding in rock crevices on hillsides
explanation: The civet is a skilled tree climber and spends much of its time up in the branches.
fact_tl: Magaling umakyat ng puno ang musang at gumugugol ng maraming oras sa mga sanga.
fact_bis: Ang musang hanas mokatkat sa kahoy ug mogahin og dakong panahon sa mga sanga.

q: In which province is Apo Reef located?
options: Occidental Mindoro
Oriental Mindoro
Palawan
Cebu
explanation: Apo Reef is located in Occidental Mindoro, and it is one of the largest coral reef systems in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Apo Reef ay matatagpuan sa Occidental Mindoro.
fact_bis: Ang Apo Reef makita sa Occidental Mindoro.

q: What does the prefix 'centi' mean in the metric system?
options: One hundredth (1/100)
One thousandth (1/1,000)
One tenth (1/10)
One millionth (1/1,000,000)
explanation: The prefix 'centi' means one hundredth (0.01), so 1 centimeter equals 1/100 of a meter.
fact_tl: Ang unlaping "centi" ay nangangahulugang ika-isandaan (1/100 o 0.01), kaya 1 sentimetro ay 1/100 ng metro.
fact_bis: Ang prefix nga "centi" nagpasabot og usa-ka-gatos-ka-bahin (1/100 o 0.01), busa ang 1 sentimetro kay 1/100 sa metro.

q: What is a volcano?
options: An opening in Earth's surface where hot molten rock called magma rises from deep underground
A mountain formed when two tectonic plates slowly push against each other
A crack in the ocean floor where cold seawater meets hot rock
A dome of hardened lava that blocks an underground river of magma
explanation: A volcano is an opening in Earth's surface where hot molten rock called magma rises from deep underground.
fact_tl: Ang bulkan ay isang pagbukas sa balat ng Daigdig kung saan lumalabas ang mainit na tunaw na bato na tinatawag na magma mula sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang bolkan usa ka abli sa panit sa Kalibotan diin mogawas ang init nga tinunaw nga bato nga gitawag ug magma gikan sa ilalom sa yuta.

q: How is a mixture different from a compound like water?
options: A mixture has no fixed amount of each part, while a compound always has an exact ratio of its elements
A mixture cannot be separated, while a compound can easily be split apart
A mixture is always liquid, while a compound is always solid
A mixture contains only one type of atom, while a compound has two or more
explanation: In a mixture there is no fixed amount of each part, unlike a compound such as water that always has an exact ratio of hydrogen and oxygen.
fact_tl: Sa pinaghalo, walang takdang dami ng bawat sangkap. Puwede kang maglagay ng kaunti o maraming asukal sa kape mo, at halo pa rin ito. Iba ito sa compound tulad ng tubig na laging may eksaktong dami ng hydrogen at oxygen.
fact_bis: Sa sagol, walay piho nga gidaghanon sa matag sangkap. Mahimo kang mobutang og gamay o daghan nga asukal sa imong kape, ug sagol gihapon kini. Lahi ni sa compound sama sa tubig nga kanunay adunay eksakto nga gidaghanon sa hydrogen ug oxygen.

q: What is the key difference between a fever and dangerous overheating from the sun (heat stroke)?
options: A fever is a controlled rise in temperature made by the brain to fight germs, while heat stroke is an uncontrolled rise that is dangerous
A fever is caused by bacteria only, while heat stroke is caused by viruses
A fever makes the body temperature drop at night, while heat stroke keeps it high all the time
A fever is harmless at any temperature, while heat stroke only becomes dangerous above 40°C
explanation: A fever is a controlled rise in heat that the brain itself produces to fight germs, while heat stroke is an uncontrolled, dangerous rise in body temperature.
fact_tl: Ang lagnat ay kontroladong pagtaas ng init na ginagawa mismo ng utak para lumaban sa germs. Iba ito sa heat stroke o sobrang init mula sa araw — doon ay tumataas ang init nang hindi kontrolado at delikado. Kaya ang lagnat ay may layunin, ang overheating ay wala.
fact_bis: Ang hilanat usa ka kontrolado nga pagsaka sa init nga ang utok mismo ang naghimo aron makig-away sa germs. Lahi kini sa heat stroke o sobrang init gikan sa adlaw — didto ang init mosaka nga dili kontrolado ug peligroso. Busa ang hilanat may katuyoan, ang overheating wala.

q: What makes velocity a vector quantity while speed is a scalar quantity?
options: Velocity has both size and direction, while speed has size only and no direction
Velocity is measured in meters while speed is measured in kilometers
Velocity can only be measured in a straight line while speed can be measured on any path
Velocity is always larger than speed for the same object in motion
explanation: Velocity is a vector because it has both size and direction, while speed is a scalar because it has size only and no direction.
fact_tl: Ang ilang dami sa galaw tulad ng velocity, displacement, at puwersa ay vector dahil may laki at direksyon, samantalang ang bilis at distansya ay scalar dahil may laki lang at walang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka gidaghanon sa lihok sama sa velocity, displacement, ug kusog mga vector kay naay gidak-on ug direksyon, samtang ang katulin ug gilay-on mga scalar kay naay gidak-on lang ug walay direksyon.

q: What do the kidneys do to keep the blood clean?
options: They filter the blood, removing extra water and wastes that become urine
They store waste products until the body is ready to release them
They break down old blood cells and send the parts back into the bloodstream
They produce a fluid that neutralizes toxins before they reach the heart
explanation: The two kidneys filter the blood, removing extra water and wastes that become urine.
fact_tl: Sinasala ng dalawang bato (kidney) ang dugo, inaalis ang sobrang tubig at dumi na nagiging ihi.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka bato (kidney) mosala sa dugo, magtangtang sa sobra nga tubig ug hugaw nga mahimong ihi.

q: How does a hydropower dam produce electricity?
options: Falling water from the dam spins a turbine that generates electricity
Sunlight reflected off the water's surface powers solar panels on the dam
The pressure of stored water pushes a piston that drives a generator
Heat from deep underground warms the water, and the steam spins a turbine
explanation: In hydropower, falling water from a dam spins the turbine, which generates electricity.
fact_tl: Sa hydropower, ang bumabagsak na tubig sa dam ang umiikot sa turbina para gumawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Sa hydropower, ang nahulog nga tubig gikan sa dam maoy magtuyok sa turbina aron mohimo og kuryente.

q: How does ringworm spread from one person or animal to another?
options: By touching an infected person or animals such as dogs and cats
By breathing in tiny spores that float in the air
By drinking water that has been contaminated with the fungus
By eating food that was prepared by someone who has ringworm
explanation: Ringworm spreads by direct contact with an infected person or with animals such as dogs and cats.
fact_tl: Ang ringworm ay nahahawa sa pamamagitan ng paghipo sa taong may sakit o sa mga hayop gaya ng aso at pusa.
fact_bis: Ang ringworm matakdan pinaagi sa paghikap sa tawo nga may sakit o sa mga mananap sama sa iro ug iring.

q: Why is oxygen needed — along with nitrogen — for lightning to produce nitrogen oxides?
options: Because the heat of lightning pushes both nitrogen and oxygen together to combine and form nitrogen oxides
Because oxygen provides the energy that lightning needs to strike
Because nitrogen cannot travel through the air without oxygen to carry it
Because oxygen cools the gases after lightning strikes so they bond together
explanation: Air contains both nitrogen and oxygen, and when lightning strikes, the heat pushes these two gases to combine and form nitrogen oxides — so both gases are needed.
fact_tl: Mahalagang tandaan na hindi lang nitrogen ang kailangan; kailangan din ng oxygen. Ang hangin ay may parehong nitrogen at oxygen. Kapag tumama ang kidlat, ang init ay nagtutulak sa dalawang gas na ito na magsama at bumuo ng nitrogen oxides. Kaya parehong gas mula sa hangin ang nagtutulungan sa proseso.
fact_bis: Importante hinumdoman nga dili igo ang nitrogen lang; kinahanglan usab ang oxygen. Ang hangin adunay nitrogen ug oxygen. Kon mohampak ang kilat, ang init moduso niining duha ka gas aron magsagol ug maghimo og nitrogen oxides. Busa ang duha ka gas gikan sa hangin nagtinabangay sa proseso.

q: Why does glass last for a very long time compared to many other materials?
options: Because glass does not rust or rot
Because glass is one of the hardest materials found in nature
Because glass absorbs moisture and gets stronger over time
Because glass is made from rare minerals that do not break down
explanation: Glass does not rust or rot, which is why it lasts for a very long time.
fact_tl: Ang salamin ay hindi kinakalawang o nabubulok kaya tumatagal ito nang napakahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang salamin dili magkalawang o madunot mao nga molungtad kini og taas kaayong panahon.

q: What must a cell do before it divides, to make sure each new cell gets the right instructions?
options: It copies its entire DNA so each new cell receives a complete set
It destroys half its DNA so each new cell gets a fresh start
It transfers its DNA to a neighboring cell for safekeeping
It breaks its DNA into small pieces that are shared between the two new cells
explanation: Before a cell divides, it first copies its entire DNA so that each new cell receives a complete set of the same instructions.
fact_tl: Bago maghati ang isang selula, kinokopya muna nito ang buong DNA nito upang ang bawat bagong selula ay magkaroon ng kumpletong set ng parehong tagubilin.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mabahin ang usa ka selula, kopyahon una niini ang tibuok DNA niini aron ang matag bag-ong selula makadawat og kompleto nga set sa managsama nga mga instruksyon.

q: What happens to your body when you do not drink enough water?
options: You may feel tired, get a headache, or become very thirsty
You may feel cold, get a stomachache, or lose your appetite
You may feel dizzy, get a fever, or start sneezing
You may feel itchy, get sore muscles, or have trouble sleeping
explanation: Not drinking enough water can make you feel tired, cause a headache, or make you very thirsty.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang tayo sa tubig, maaari tayong makaramdam ng pagod, sakit ng ulo, o matinding uhaw.
fact_bis: Kung kulang kita sa tubig, mahimong mobati kita ug kakapoy, labad sa ulo, o grabe nga kauhaw.

q: Why does the cormorant spread its wings open after diving into the water?
options: To scare away other birds from its fishing spot
To stretch its wings after using them to swim underwater
To dry its feathers because they are not very waterproof
To signal to its mate that it caught a fish
explanation: The cormorant's feathers are not very waterproof, so it spreads its wings out to let them dry after diving.
fact_tl: Dahil hindi gaanong waterproof ang balahibo nito, ibinubuka ng cormorant ang mga pakpak para patuyuin ang mga ito pagkatapos sumisid.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dili kaayo waterproof ang balahibo niini, buklaron sa cormorant ang mga pako niini aron pauggon human mosalom.

q: How does a bird keep its feathers smooth and able to shed water?
options: It rubs its feathers against tree bark to remove dirt
It cleans and oils its feathers using its beak
It shakes its body rapidly to fluff and clean each feather
It dips its whole body in water every morning to rinse off
explanation: A bird uses its beak to clean and oil its feathers, which keeps them smooth and helps water run off.
fact_tl: Nililinis at pinapahiran ng ibon ng langis ang kanyang mga balahibo gamit ang tuka para manatiling makinis at hindi basain ng tubig.
fact_bis: Limpyohan ug pahiran og lana sa langgam ang iyang mga balhibo gamit ang tuka aron magpabilin nga hapsay ug dili mabasa.

q: What happens to your heartbeat when you breathe slowly and deeply while stressed?
options: Your heartbeat speeds up to pump more oxygen to your brain
Your heartbeat stays the same but your muscles relax
Your heartbeat slows down and you feel calmer
Your heartbeat becomes irregular for a short time
explanation: Slow, deep breathing helps slow your heartbeat and calm you down when you feel stressed.
fact_tl: Ang dahan-dahan at malalim na paghinga ay tumutulong pabagalin ang tibok ng puso at magpakalma kapag na-stress ka.
fact_bis: Ang hinay ug lawom nga pagginhawa makatabang sa pagpahinay sa kabog sa dughan ug pagpakalma kung ma-stress ka.

q: How are we able to see objects around us?
options: Our eyes send out beams of light that touch the objects
Light from the sun travels directly from the sun into our eyes
Light bounces off objects and then enters our eyes
Our brain creates images of objects without needing any light
explanation: We see objects when light bounces off them and enters our eyes.
fact_tl: Nakakakita tayo ng isang bagay kapag tumatalbog ang liwanag mula rito papasok sa ating mata.
fact_bis: Makakita ta sa usa ka butang kung ang kahayag mosalo gikan niini ug mosulod sa atong mata.

q: When food, water, or space is scarce in an ecosystem, what happens among animals that need the same things?
options: They share resources equally by taking turns feeding
They split into groups and move to separate areas to avoid conflict
They compete, and the stronger or faster ones are more likely to survive
They stop eating and wait until more resources become available
explanation: When resources are scarce, animals with the same needs compete, and the stronger or faster ones are more likely to survive.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang ang pagkain, tubig, o espasyo, nag-aagawan ang mga hayop na may parehong pangangailangan, at ang mas malakas o mabilis ay mas malamang na mabuhay.
fact_bis: Kung kulang ang pagkaon, tubig, o luna, mag-indigay ang mga mananap nga managsama og panginahanglan, ug ang mas kusgan o paspas mas lagmit mabuhi.

q: Who invented dynamite?
options: Thomas Edison, an American inventor
Marie Curie, a Polish-French scientist
Alfred Nobel, a Swedish chemist
Nikola Tesla, a Serbian-American engineer
explanation: Dynamite was invented by Alfred Nobel, a Swedish chemist.
fact_tl: Si Alfred Nobel, isang Swedish na chemist, ang umimbento ng dynamite.
fact_bis: Si Alfred Nobel, usa ka Swedish nga chemist, ang nag-imbento sa dynamite.

q: Who is the process of pasteurization named after?
options: Alexander Fleming, who discovered penicillin
Louis Pasteur, the scientist who created it
Robert Koch, who identified disease-causing bacteria
Joseph Lister, who promoted antiseptic surgery
explanation: Pasteurization is named after Louis Pasteur, the scientist who created it.
fact_tl: Ang pasteurization ay ipinangalan kay Louis Pasteur, ang siyentistang gumawa nito.
fact_bis: Ang pasteurization ginpangalan kang Louis Pasteur, ang siyentista nga naghimo niini.

q: How does the International Space Station (ISS) get its electricity?
options: It uses a nuclear reactor that runs on uranium fuel
It collects energy from the sun using large solar panels
It converts the movement of air particles in space into power
It draws power from Earth through a long electrical cable
explanation: The ISS uses large solar panels that collect energy from the sun to provide electricity.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang ISS ng malalaking solar panel na kumukuha ng enerhiya mula sa araw para magkaroon ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang ISS naggamit og dagkong solar panel nga nagkuha og enerhiya gikan sa adlaw aron makahatag og kuryente.

q: What is unusual about Palawan compared to most other Philippine islands in terms of its geology?
options: Palawan sits on a volcanic hotspot that keeps it growing larger
Palawan has oceanic crust like most Philippine islands
Palawan has continental crust that may once have been attached to mainland Asia
Palawan was formed entirely from coral reefs that hardened over time
explanation: Palawan has continental crust that may once have been attached to mainland Asia, while most other Philippine islands have oceanic origins.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay binubuo ng maraming 'terranes' — mga piraso ng lupa na nagmula sa iba't ibang lugar at nagkakaisa sa kasalukuyan; ang Palawan, halimbawa, ay may bahagi ng continental crust na maaaring dati ay kabit sa mainland Asia, habang ang karamihan ng iba pang pulo ay may oceanic na pinagmulan.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas gihimo sa daghang 'terranes' — mga piraso sa yuta nga gikan sa lain-laing lugar ug nagtinabang-tabang; ang Palawan, pananglitan, adunay continental crust nga mahimong kaniadto nakadugtong sa mainland Asia, samtang kadaghanan sa ubang mga pulo adunay oceanic nga gigikanan.

q: About how fast does the Shinkansen high-speed train travel?
options: About 100 kilometers per hour
About 200 kilometers per hour
About 300 kilometers per hour
About 500 kilometers per hour
explanation: High-speed trains like the Shinkansen travel at about 300 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang mga high-speed na tren tulad ng Shinkansen ay tumatakbo nang humigit-kumulang 300 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang high-speed nga mga tren sama sa Shinkansen modagan og mga 300 ka kilometro kada oras.

q: Why is the first lymph node in a body area usually the first one to swell when you get an infection?
options: It is always the largest node and can trap the most germs
It is connected directly to the heart and receives blood first
It is the first node that lymph from that area drains into, so it catches germs first
It produces the most white blood cells and fights infection the fastest
explanation: The first lymph node that lymph from a body area drains into is the first to catch germs there, so it is also usually the first to swell.
fact_tl: Ang pinakaunang kulani na dinadaanan ng limpa mula sa isang bahagi ng katawan ang unang humahuli ng germ doon — kaya ito rin madalas ang unang mamaga, na nagbibigay ng maagang babala sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang labing unang kulani nga agian-an sa limpa gikan sa usa ka bahin sa lawas mao ang una nga modakop sa germ didto — mao nga kini usab kasagaran ang unang maghubag, nga naghatag og sayo nga pasidaan sa lawas.

q: Which Philippine government agency manages healthcare for all Filipinos and operates public hospitals?
options: DSWD (Department of Social Welfare and Development)
DOH (Department of Health)
PhilHealth (Philippine Health Insurance Corporation)
DepEd (Department of Education)
explanation: The DOH or Department of Health is the Philippine government agency that manages healthcare for every Filipino and operates public hospitals.
fact_tl: Ang DOH o Department of Health ang ahensya ng pamahalaan ng Pilipinas na namamahala ng pangangalaga sa kalusugan ng bawat Pilipino at nagpapatakbo ng mga pampublikong ospital.
fact_bis: Ang DOH o Department of Health ang ahensya sa gobyerno sa Pilipinas nga nagdumala sa pag-atiman sa kalusugan sa matag Pilipino ug nagpadagan sa mga pampublikong ospital.

q: About how many years ago did the Mesozoic Era begin?
options: About 65 million years ago
About 145 million years ago
About 252 million years ago
About 540 million years ago
explanation: The Mesozoic Era began about 252 million years ago.
fact_tl: Ang Mesozoic Era ay nagsimula mga 252 milyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang Mesozoic Era misugod mga 252 ka milyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: How is a run-of-river hydroelectric plant different from a typical dam?
options: It uses underground water pipes instead of a river
It burns fuel to generate steam that spins a turbine
It uses the river's natural flow without building a large storage lake, so less land is flooded
It stores water in a huge reservoir to release during dry seasons
explanation: Run-of-river hydro plants use the river's natural flow without a large storage lake, so they flood much less land around them.
fact_tl: May mga hydro plant na tinatawag na run-of-river na gumagamit lamang ng natural na daloy ng ilog na walang malaking imbakang lawa, kaya mas maliit ang epekto sa lupa sa paligid.
fact_bis: Adunay mga hydro plant nga gitawag og run-of-river nga naggamit lamang sa natural nga dagayday sa suba nga walay dakong tinipigan nga linaw, mao nga mas gamay ang epekto sa yuta sa palibot.

q: What happens when antibiotics are misused?
options: Viruses become stronger and can no longer be killed by vaccines
Bacteria become stronger so the medicine no longer works on them
The human immune system becomes weaker and stops fighting infections
Antibiotics lose their chemical properties and turn into plain water
explanation: Misusing antibiotics makes bacteria stronger so the medicine no longer works on them.
fact_tl: Ang maling paggamit ng antibiotic ay nagpapalakas sa bakterya kaya hindi na ito tinatablan ng gamot.
fact_bis: Ang sayop nga paggamit sa antibiotic nagpalig-on sa bakterya, mao nga dili na kini matambalan sa tambal.

q: Which of the following is an example of a nonrenewable energy source?
options: Wind
Solar
Coal
Geothermal
explanation: Coal is a nonrenewable energy source — along with oil, natural gas, and nuclear (uranium) — that runs out and cannot be quickly replaced.
fact_tl: Ang mga halimbawa ng nonrenewable (hindi nababawing) enerhiya ay karbon, langis, natural gas, at nuclear (uranium) — mauubos ang mga ito at hindi mabilis na mapapalitan.
fact_bis: Mga pananglitan sa nonrenewable (dili mabag-o) nga enerhiya mao ang karbon, lana, natural gas, ug nuclear (uranium) — mahurot kini ug dili dali mapulihan.

q: At what altitude do altocumulus clouds usually appear, and what do they look like?
options: Very high up, appearing as thin wispy streaks of white
Very low, looking like a thick grey blanket covering the sky
At middle altitudes, appearing as patches or rows of white and grey clouds
At ground level, looking like fog rolling across hills
explanation: Altocumulus clouds appear at middle altitudes (two to six kilometres) and often look like patches or rows of white and grey clouds.
fact_tl: Ang altocumulus ay mga ulap na makikita sa gitnang taas ng kalangitan (dalawa hanggang anim na kilometro); madalas itong lumabas bilang mga grupo ng puting-abo na ulap.
fact_bis: Ang altocumulus makita sa gitna nga taas sa langit (duha ngadto sa unom ka kilometro); sagad kining makita isip mga grupo sa puti ug abo nga panganod.

q: How is the colour order of a secondary rainbow different from the primary rainbow?
options: The secondary rainbow has the same colour order as the primary one
The secondary rainbow only shows three colours instead of seven
The secondary rainbow has reversed colours — violet on the outside and red on the inside
The secondary rainbow has reversed colours — red on the outside and violet on the inside
explanation: The secondary rainbow has a reversed colour order — violet on the outside and red on the inside — caused by two internal reflections inside the raindrop.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang bahaghari na laging makikita sa itaas ng pangunahing isa ay may baligtad na pagkakasunod-sunod ng kulay — ang violet ay nasa labas at ang pula ay nasa loob.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang bahaghari, makita sa ibabaw sa primary, adunay baligtad nga han-ay sa kolor — violet sa gawas ug pula sa sulod — tungod sa duha ka internal nga refleksyon sa sulod sa patak sa ulan.

q: What invention did scientists create after studying how a gecko's feet stick to surfaces?
options: A waterproof paint that mimics the oil on gecko skin
Special 'gecko tape' that grips surfaces without any glue
A spray that makes any surface as smooth as a gecko's belly
Flexible gloves that let people climb glass like a gecko
explanation: Scientists studied how gecko feet stick and created special 'gecko tape' and materials that grip without any glue, used for wall-climbing robots and other inventions.
fact_tl: Pinag-aralan ng mga siyentipiko kung paano dumidikit ang paa ng butiki, at gumawa sila ng espesyal na 'gecko tape' at materyales na dumidikit nang walang pandikit. Ginagamit ito para sa mga robot na umaakyat sa pader at iba pang imbensyon.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga siyentista kung unsaon pagdikit sa tiil sa butiki, ug naghimo silag espesyal nga 'gecko tape' ug materyales nga mokupot nga walay pandikit. Gigamit kini sa mga robot nga mosaka sa bongbong ug uban pang imbensyon.

q: What is the main ingredient used to make glass?
options: Crushed limestone, which is the most abundant rock on Earth
Crushed quartz (sand), which is made of silicon dioxide
Melted clay, which is shaped and hardened in a furnace
Powdered iron ore, which is mixed with chemicals to become clear
explanation: Crushed quartz (sand), which is made of silicon dioxide, is the main ingredient used to make glass.
fact_tl: Ang quartz ay crystalline silicon dioxide (SiO2) — ang pinaka-karaniwang mineral sa ibabaw ng Lupa — at ito ang pangunahing sangkap ng buhangin na ginagamit para gumawa ng salamin.
fact_bis: Ang quartz crystalline silicon dioxide (SiO2), ang labing karaniwang mineral sa ibabaw sa yuta; ang dinurog nga quartz (buhangin) mao ang panguna nga sangkap nga gigamit sa paghimo og salamin.

q: How does a snake move from place to place?
options: It uses small hidden fins on its belly to push itself forward
It bounces along using the tip of its tail like a spring
It moves along the ground using its long body because it has no legs
It rolls sideways in a circular motion to travel across the ground
explanation: A snake has no legs, so it moves along the ground using its long body.
fact_tl: Ang ahas ay walang paa, kaya gumagapang ito sa lupa gamit ang mahaba nitong katawan.
fact_bis: Ang halas walay tiil, mao nga nagkamang kini sa yuta gamit ang taas niini nga lawas.

q: How far does the Philippines' territorial sea extend from its coast, and what does the Philippines have in that zone?
options: 3 nautical miles; the Philippines has the right to fish there
12 nautical miles; the Philippines has full sovereignty
24 nautical miles; the Philippines controls shipping routes
200 nautical miles; the Philippines can use all natural resources
explanation: The Philippines' territorial sea extends 12 nautical miles from its coast, and within this zone the Philippines has full sovereignty.
fact_tl: Ang teritoryong dagat ng Pilipinas ay umabot ng 12 nautical miles mula sa baybayin; sa loob ng sona na ito, ang Pilipinas ay may ganap na soberanya.
fact_bis: Ang teritoryong dagat sa Pilipinas nagbanat og 12 nautical miles gikan sa baybayin; sulod sa sona nga kini, ang Pilipinas adunay hingpit nga soberanya.

q: How do we see color?
options: Each color of light has a different temperature that our eyes feel
Light enters our eyes and our brain interprets the signals to give us color
Our eyes produce their own light that mixes with object colors
Color comes from chemicals in our tears that react to different objects
explanation: We see color when light enters our eyes and our brain interprets the signals.
fact_tl: Nakakakita tayo ng kulay kapag pumapasok ang liwanag sa ating mga mata at binibigyang-kahulugan ito ng ating utak.
fact_bis: Makakita kita ug kolor kung mosulod ang kahayag sa atong mga mata ug hubaron kini sa atong utok.

q: Why does metal feel much hotter than wood when both are left in the sun?
options: Metal is darker than wood, so it absorbs more sunlight by colour
Metal is denser than wood, so it stores heat inside without letting it escape
Metal is a good conductor of heat and absorbs the sun's heat quickly
Metal reflects the sun's rays back onto your hand, making it feel hot
explanation: Metal heats up quickly in the sun because it is a good conductor of heat and absorbs the sun's heat fast.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis uminit ang metal sa araw dahil mahusay itong conductor ng init at mabilis sumipsip ng init mula sa araw. Kaya mas mainit hawakan ang metal kaysa kahoy kahit pareho silang nasa labas.
fact_bis: Mas paspas moinit ang metal sa adlaw kay maayo kining conductor sa kainit ug paspas mosuyop sa kainit gikan sa adlaw. Mao nga mas init hikapon ang metal kaysa kahoy bisan parehas silang naa sa gawas.

q: How many bones make up the human skull?
options: 8 bones
14 bones
22 bones
30 bones
explanation: The human skull is made up of 22 bones.
fact_tl: May 22 na buto sa bungo (skull) ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang bungo (skull) sa tawo gilangkuban og 22 ka bukog.

q: What are tidal flats and mudflats on Philippine coasts mainly used for by wildlife?
options: Nesting sites for sea turtles to lay their eggs at night
Breeding grounds for sharks to raise their young in shallow water
Feeding and resting areas for many migratory birds and other creatures
Coral nurseries where young reefs grow in the soft mud
explanation: The tidal flats and mudflats on Philippine coasts are habitat for many migratory birds and other creatures that use the area for feeding and resting.
fact_tl: Ang mga tidal flat o mudflat sa baybayin ng Pilipinas ay tirahan ng maraming migrating birds at iba pang hayop na gumagamit ng lugar na ito para sa pagkain at pahinga.
fact_bis: Ang mga tidal flat o mudflat sa baybayin sa Pilipinas puy-anan sa daghang migrating birds ug uban pang mga mananap nga gumagamit sa lugar nga kini alang sa pagkaon ug pahinga.

q: Which statement best describes the atoms of the same element?
options: They vary in size depending on the temperature of the substance
All atoms of one element are alike, but different from atoms of other elements
Each atom of the same element has a different number of protons
Atoms of the same element can change into atoms of a different element over time
explanation: All atoms of one element are alike — every gold atom is alike, and every carbon atom is alike — but atoms of different elements are different from each other.
fact_tl: Magkakapareho ang lahat ng atom ng iisang element — magkapareho ang lahat ng atom ng gold, at magkapareho ang lahat ng atom ng carbon. Pero magkaiba ang atom ng iba't ibang element.
fact_bis: Managsama ang tanang atom sa usa ka element — managsama ang tanang atom sa gold, ug managsama ang tanang atom sa carbon. Apan managlahi ang atom sa lain-laing element.

q: Why does a scar form on the skin after a deep wound heals?
options: The wound fills with extra blood that hardens on top of the skin
The body fills the gap with collagen, which forms a scar that lacks hair and sweat glands
Dead skin cells pile up in the wound and slowly harden into scar tissue
Bacteria in the wound produce a tough protein that seals the cut permanently
explanation: When a wound is deep, the body fills the gap with collagen, forming a scar that usually has no hair or sweat glands.
fact_tl: Kapag malalim ang sugat, pinupunan ng katawan ang butas ng collagen na bumubuo ng peklat. Ang peklat ay totoong balat pero medyo naiiba — kadalasan walang buhok o glandula ng pawis dito.
fact_bis: Kung lawom ang samad, pun-on sa lawas ang lungag og collagen nga maghimo og uwat. Ang uwat tinuod nga panit apan gamayng lahi — kasagaran walay buhok o glandula sa singot.

q: How can you tell a physical change from a chemical change?
options: In a physical change, heat is always produced, while in a chemical change, the substance gets colder
In a physical change, only the shape changes and it can often be reversed; in a chemical change, a new substance forms
In a physical change, colour always changes; in a chemical change, only the size changes
Both changes form new substances, but a physical change happens faster than a chemical change
explanation: In a physical change only the shape changes and it can be reversed, while in a chemical change a new substance forms and usually cannot be undone.
fact_tl: Paano ipagkaiba ang tanda ng pisikal at kemikal na pagbabago? Sa pisikal — gaya ng natutunaw na yelo o gupit na papel — nagbabago lang ang anyo pero pareho pa rin ang sangkap at puwedeng ibalik. Sa kemikal, may bagong sangkap na nabubuo at kadalasan ay hindi na ito mababalik.
fact_bis: Unsaon pag-ila sa timailhan sa pisikal ug kemikal nga kausaban? Sa pisikal — sama sa natunaw nga yelo o giputol nga papel — ang porma ra ang mausab apan pareho gihapon ang substansiya ug mabalik. Sa kemikal, adunay bag-ong substansiya nga maporma ug kasagaran dili na mabalik.

q: Why does a bigger tuning fork make a lower sound than a smaller one?
options: A bigger tuning fork is heavier, so it blocks more air and creates a deeper tone
A bigger tuning fork vibrates slowly, and slow vibrations make a lower pitch
A bigger tuning fork has more metal, so it traps sound waves inside longer
A bigger tuning fork cools down faster, which lowers its vibration frequency
explanation: Bigger tuning forks vibrate slowly, and slow vibrations produce a lower pitch sound.
fact_tl: Ang tuning fork ay isang kagamitang bakal na nag-vibrate kapag pinitik. Ang mas malalaking tuning fork ay mabagal mag-vibrate, kaya mas mababa ang tunog nito. Ginagamit ito sa klase para ipakita kung paano nagbabago ang pitch.
fact_bis: Ang tuning fork usa ka puthaw nga gamit nga mag-vibrate kon pitikon. Ang mas dako nga tuning fork hinay mag-vibrate, busa mas mubo ang tingog niini. Gigamit kini sa klase aron ipakita kon unsaon pag-usab sa pitch.

q: How do geckos really stick to walls and ceilings?
options: They use suction like a rubber cup pressed against glass, creating a vacuum
They produce a sticky glue from glands on their feet that re-sticks after each step
They use millions of tiny hairs on their feet, which is why they can even stick without air
They grip surfaces using small sharp claws that hook into tiny holes in the material
explanation: Geckos do not use suction or glue; they hold on with millions of tiny foot hairs, which is why they can even stick in a vacuum with no air.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakalang ang gecko ay dumidikit gamit ang sipsip o suction tulad ng goma sa salamin, ngunit hindi ito totoo. Hindi nila ginagamit ang hangin o vacuum; nakakapit sila sa pamamagitan ng milyon-milyong buhok sa paa, kaya kaya nilang dumikit kahit sa vacuum na walang hangin.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang gecko modikit pinaagi sa sipsip o suction sama sa goma sa salamin, apan dili kana tinuod. Wala sila mogamit og hangin o vacuum; mokupot sila pinaagi sa minilyon nga balahibo sa tiil, mao nga makadikit sila bisan sa vacuum nga walay hangin.

q: What is the job of a transformer in an electrical system?
options: It stores electrical energy so homes can use it during power cuts
It converts electrical energy into heat for use in factories
It changes the voltage of electricity — raising it for long-distance travel and lowering it before it reaches homes
It measures how much electricity a home uses and sends the data to the power company
explanation: A transformer changes the voltage of electricity — raising it for long travel and lowering it before it reaches homes.
fact_tl: Ang transformer ang nagbabago ng boltahe ng kuryente—pinapataas ito para sa malayong biyahe at pinababa bago dumating sa bahay.
fact_bis: Ang transformer maoy nag-usab sa boltahe sa kuryente—gipataas kini para sa layong biyahe ug gipaubos sa dili pa moabot sa balay.

q: What does the term 'light-year' measure?
options: The number of years it takes for a star to complete one orbit around a galaxy
The amount of light that the sun produces in one year
The distance that light travels in one year, about 9.46 trillion kilometres
The time it takes for light from the sun to reach Earth
explanation: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year — about 9.46 trillion kilometres — used to measure vast distances in space.
fact_tl: Ang light-year ay ang distansya na nilalakbay ng ilaw sa loob ng isang taon — humigit-kumulang 9.46 trilyong kilometro; ginagamit ito para sukatin ang malalayong distansya sa kalawakan. Ang pinakamalalapit na bituin sa Araw, ang Proxima Centauri, ay 4.2 light-years ang layo.
fact_bis: Ang light-year mao ang distansya nga gilakbay sa suga sulod sa usa ka tuig — mga 9.46 trilyon ka kilometro; gigamit kini aron sukdon ang mga layo nga distansya sa kalawakan. Ang pinaka-duol nga bituin sa Adlaw, ang Proxima Centauri, 4.2 light-years ang kalayoan.

q: Why do most places on Earth experience two high tides each day?
options: The sun heats opposite sides of Earth at different times, causing two water swells
The Earth spins so fast that water is pushed outward on two sides at once
There are two water bulges at the same time — one facing the moon and one on the opposite side of Earth
The moon orbits Earth twice every day, pulling water toward it each time
explanation: There are two water bulges at the same time — one on the side facing the moon and one on the opposite side — giving most places two high tides a day.
fact_tl: May dalawang umbok ng tubig na nagaganap nang sabay sa Mundo. Isa sa panig na nakaharap sa buwan, at isa pa sa kabaligtarang panig. Kaya't ang karamihang lugar ay nakakaranas ng dalawang high tide sa isang araw.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka pagburot sa tubig nga mahitabo dungan sa Kalibutan. Usa sa kilid nga nag-atubang sa bulan, ug usa pa sa atbang nga kilid. Mao nga kadaghanan sa mga lugar makasinati og duha ka high tide sa usa ka adlaw.

q: How does a jet engine push an airplane forward?
options: It spins large propellers at the front that pull the plane through the air
It creates a magnetic field that repels against the air to move forward
It sucks in air at the front, burns it with fuel, and blasts hot gas out the back to push the plane forward
It heats the air under the wings to make the plane lighter and let it glide forward
explanation: A jet engine sucks in air at the front, mixes it with fuel and burns it, then blasts the hot gas out the back — and that backward blast pushes the plane forward.
fact_tl: Ang jet engine ay sumisipsip ng hangin sa harap, hinahalo ito sa panggatong at sinusunog, pagkatapos ay binubuga ang mainit na gas nang napakabilis sa likod — at ang pagbuga na iyon ang tumutulak sa eroplano pasulong.
fact_bis: Ang jet engine mosuyop og hangin sa atubangan, isagol kini sa gasolina ug sunogon, dayon ibuga ang init nga gas nga paspas kaayo sa likod — ug kanang pagbuga maoy motulod sa eroplano pasulong.

q: How does the queen bee make sure she is the only one laying eggs in the hive?
options: She physically stops worker bees from entering the egg-laying chamber
She lays eggs so quickly that workers have no time or space to lay their own
She releases a special pheromone that prevents worker bees from reproducing
She eats any eggs laid by worker bees before they can hatch
explanation: The queen bee releases a special pheromone that prevents worker bees from reproducing, ensuring she is the only one to lay eggs.
fact_tl: Ang reyna ng bubuyog ay naglalabas ng espesyal na pheromone na pumipigil sa mga manggagawa mula sa pag-reproduce, na tinitiyak na siya lamang ang maglalaglag ng mga itlog.
fact_bis: Ang reyna sa bubuyog naglabas og espesyal nga pheromone nga nagpugong sa mga manggagawa gikan sa pagpanamkon, nagpasiguro nga siya lamang ang nagitlog.

q: Besides making insulin, what other important job does the pancreas do?
options: It filters waste from the blood and turns it into urine
It pumps bile into the stomach to break down fats directly
It makes enzymes that help digest food in the intestines
It stores extra sugar in the form of glycogen for later use
explanation: Besides making insulin, the pancreas also makes enzymes that help digest food in the intestines, so it does double duty.
fact_tl: Bukod sa paggawa ng insulin, may pangalawang trabaho ang pancreas: gumagawa rin ito ng mga 'enzyme' na tumutulong tunawin ang pagkain sa bituka. Kaya dobleng-bahay ang ginagawa nito.
fact_bis: Gawas sa paghimo og insulin, ang pancreas adunay ikaduhang trabaho: naghimo usab kini og mga 'enzyme' nga motabang sa pagtunaw sa pagkaon sa tinai. Mao nga doble ang iyang gibuhat.

q: In which region of the Philippines is the province of Guimaras located, and what is its capital?
options: Eastern Visayas region; capital is Tacloban
Central Visayas region; capital is Cebu City
Western Visayas region; capital is Jordan
MIMAROPA region; capital is San Jose
explanation: Guimaras is a province in the Western Visayas region (VI) of the Philippines, and its capital is Jordan.
fact_tl: Ang Guimaras ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Western Visayas (VI), na bahagi ng Visayas. Ang kabisera nito ay Jordan.
fact_bis: Ang Guimaras usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Western Visayas (VI), nga bahin sa Visayas. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Jordan.

q: Where does the Philippine flat-headed frog live, and why does it need that particular environment?
options: It lives in warm, still ponds in Luzon where algae provides plenty of food
It lives in dry rocky areas of Mindanao where it can absorb heat from the sun
It lives in cold, fast-flowing streams in Palawan where there is enough dissolved oxygen for skin-breathing
It lives in mangrove swamps along the coast where it can hide from predators in the roots
explanation: The Philippine flat-headed frog lives in cold, fast-flowing streams in Palawan, where the water contains enough dissolved oxygen for skin-breathing.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine flat-headed frog ay nakatira sa malamig at mabilis na sapa ng Palawan, kung saan ang tubig ay may sapat na oxygen para sa paghingang sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine flat-headed frog nagpuyo sa malamig ug paspas nga mga sapa sa Palawan, diin ang tubig adunay igo nga natunaw nga oxygen alang sa paghinga pinaagi sa panit.

q: When you jump off the ground, which statement best describes the action-reaction pair?
options: You push up against gravity and gravity pulls you back down with equal force
Your legs push down on the ground, and the ground pushes you upward with an equal force
The air around you pushes up against your body as you rise into the air
Your muscles pull your bones upward while your weight pulls you downward
explanation: Jumping is an action-reaction pair: you push down on the ground and it sends you up with an equal and opposite force.
fact_tl: Makikita ang aksyon-reaksyon sa pang-araw-araw na buhay, gaya ng pagtalon kung saan itinutulak mo ang lupa at ikaw ay napapaitaas.
fact_bis: Makita ang aksyon-reaksyon sa adlaw-adlaw nga kinabuhi, sama sa paglukso diin imong giduso ang yuta ug ikaw mosaka.

q: What is at the North Pole?
options: A large continent covered by a thick ice sheet, similar to Antarctica
A small rocky island surrounded by permanently frozen sea ice
No land at all — only a frozen ocean called the Arctic Ocean
A vast flat tundra plain with no trees or mountains
explanation: At the North Pole there is no land, only a frozen ocean called the Arctic Ocean.
fact_tl: Sa North Pole ay walang lupa, kundi nagyeyelong karagatan (Arctic Ocean).
fact_bis: Sa North Pole walay yuta, kundili nagyelo nga kadagatan (Arctic Ocean).

q: What is the 'period' of a pendulum?
options: The maximum distance the pendulum swings away from the center
The total number of swings the pendulum completes in one minute
The time it takes for the pendulum to make one complete swing back to where it started
The speed at which the pendulum is moving at the lowest point of its swing
explanation: The period is the time a pendulum takes to make one complete swing back to where it started.
fact_tl: Ang period ay ang oras na kailangan ng pendulum para makagawa ng isang buong ugoy pabalik sa pinagsimulan.
fact_bis: Ang period mao ang panahon nga gikinahanglan sa pendulum aron makahimo og usa ka tibuok labyog balik sa gigikanan.

q: What color are emu eggs?
options: Bright blue, similar to the eggs of a robin
Pale cream with brown speckles, similar to turkey eggs
Dark green, unlike the usual white eggs of a chicken
Yellowish-orange with a rough bumpy shell
explanation: Emu eggs are dark green in color, unlike the usual white chicken eggs.
fact_tl: Ang itlog ng emu ay maitim na berde ang kulay, hindi gaya ng karaniwang puting itlog ng manok.
fact_bis: Ang itlog sa emu lunhaw nga itom ang kolor, dili sama sa kasagaran nga puti nga itlog sa manok.

q: What happens to the temperature of a substance while it is melting, even though heat keeps being added?
options: The temperature rises steadily as more heat is added to the substance
The temperature drops slightly because energy is used to break the bonds
The temperature stays constant; the heat being absorbed is called latent heat
The temperature jumps up and down rapidly as parts of the substance melt
explanation: While a substance melts, its temperature stays constant even though it keeps absorbing heat — this absorbed heat is called latent heat and is used to change the state.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang sangkap ay natutunaw, ang temperatura nito ay nananatiling pare-pareho kahit patuloy na tinatanggap ang init. Ang init na ito ay tinatawag na latent heat — ginagamit ito para baguhin ang anyo ng sangkap.
fact_bis: Samtang ang usa ka substansya natutunaw, ang temperatura niini nagpabilin nga pareho bisan padayon kining nagsipsip sa init. Kining nasipsipang init gitawag nga latent heat — gigamit kini aron mabag-o ang estado sa substansya.

q: What does chromatography show when it is used on black ink?
options: That black ink is a pure substance with one single colour component
That black ink only contains carbon particles suspended in water
That black ink is actually a mixture of different colours that separate as water moves up the paper
That black ink becomes clear when it is spread out thinly on paper
explanation: As water moves up the paper in chromatography, the different colour components in black ink travel at different speeds and separate into different colours.
fact_tl: Ang chromatography ay naghihiwalay ng pinaghalong kulay sa tinta. Habang umaakyat ang tubig sa papel, ang ibang kulay ay mas mabilis gumalaw, kaya nahahati ang itim na tinta sa iba't ibang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang chromatography nagbulag sa sinagol nga kolor sa tinta. Samtang mosaka ang tubig sa papel, ang ubang kolor mas paspas molihok, mao nga ang itom nga tinta mabahin sa lainlaing kolor.

q: What are the tiny light organs on a firefly squid called, and where are they especially found?
options: Bioluminosomes, found mainly along the squid's body sides
Luminocytes, found only on the squid's large central eye
Photophores, found especially on the tips of the squid's arms
Chromatophores, found all over the squid's mantle and head
explanation: The firefly squid has many tiny light organs called photophores, especially on the tips of its arms.
fact_tl: Ang firefly squid ay may maraming maliliit na organong nagliliwanag na tinatawag na photophores, lalo na sa dulo ng mga galamay nito.
fact_bis: Ang firefly squid daghan og gagmay nga organ nga nagdan-ag nga gitawag og photophores, ilabi na sa tumoy sa iyang mga bukton.

q: What should you do if a grease fire starts in your kitchen?
options: Pour water on it to cool it down
Cover it to cut off its oxygen supply
Blow on it to extinguish the flames
Throw flour over the pan to smother it
explanation: Oil floats on water, so pouring water on a grease fire makes it spread; covering the fire removes the oxygen it needs to burn.
fact_tl: Huwag bubuhusan ng tubig ang nagliliyab na mantika sa kusina — lumulutang ang langis sa tubig at lalo lang kumakalat ang apoy; sa halip, takpan ito para maputol ang oxygen.
fact_bis: Ayaw bubo-i og tubig ang nagsiga nga mantika sa kusina — molutaw ang lana sa tubig ug mas mokalat hinuon ang kalayo; hinuon, taboni kini aron putlon ang oxygen.

q: Why does a spinning top have a small, pointed tip instead of a wide, flat one?
options: A wide tip would make the top too heavy to spin
A pointed tip makes less contact with the ground, reducing friction
A pointed tip keeps the center of gravity very high
A wide tip would cause the top to bounce off the ground
explanation: The pointed tip creates less contact with the ground, which means less friction, so the top can spin for a longer time.
fact_tl: Matulis at maliit ang dulo ng trompo dahil mas kaunti ang sumasayad nito sa lupa. Mas maliit na contact ay nangangahulugan ng mas kaunting friction, kaya mas matagal umiikot ang trompo bago tumigil.
fact_bis: Talinis ug gamay ang tumoy sa trompo kay gamay ra ang modikit niini sa yuta. Mas gamay nga contact nagpasabot ug mas gamay nga friction, mao nga mas dugay magtuyok ang trompo usa mohunong.

q: The Surigao Strait connects which two bodies of water?
options: The Sibuyan Sea and Leyte Gulf
The Mindanao Sea and Leyte Gulf
The Visayan Sea and the Pacific Ocean
The Celebes Sea and Camotes Sea
explanation: The Surigao Strait lies between Leyte and Mindanao and connects the Mindanao Sea to Leyte Gulf.
fact_tl: Ang Kipot ng Surigao (Surigao Strait) ay nasa pagitan ng Leyte at Mindanao, na nag-uugnay sa Dagat Mindanao at Golpo ng Leyte.
fact_bis: Ang Kipot sa Surigao (Surigao Strait) anaa tunga-tunga sa Leyte ug Mindanao, nga nagsumpay sa Dagat Mindanao ngadto sa Gulpo sa Leyte.

q: What was Charles Darwin's nationality?
options: French
German
American
English
explanation: Charles Darwin was an English naturalist, famous for developing the theory of evolution by natural selection.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin ay isang Ingles (English) na naturalista.
fact_bis: Si Charles Darwin usa ka English (Ingles) nga naturalista.

q: Why are visitors told NOT to touch stalactites and stalagmites in caves?
options: The formations are sharp and can cut your hand easily
Oil and dirt from your hands can stop new minerals from sticking, halting their growth
The vibrations from touching can cause the cave ceiling to collapse
The minerals in the formations are poisonous to humans
