q: Titan is special because it is the only moon in the Solar System known to have liquid on its surface. What is that liquid?
options: Water
Methane
Liquid nitrogen
Sulfuric acid
explanation: Titan's surface liquid is methane, not water — making it the only body besides Earth with liquid on its surface.
fact_tl: Bukod sa Earth, ang Titan lang ang katawan sa Solar System na may likido sa ibabaw — pero methane ito, hindi tubig.
fact_bis: Gawas sa Earth, ang Titan ra ang lawas sa Solar System nga adunay likido sa nawong — apan methane kini, dili tubig.

q: What type of magnet do MRI machines use to take pictures of the inside of the body?
options: Permanent bar magnets arranged in a ring
Very strong electromagnets
Small refrigerator magnets placed on the patient's skin
Magnets made from a special radioactive metal
explanation: MRI machines use very strong electromagnets to produce the detailed images of the inside of the body.
fact_tl: Ang MRI na makina sa ospital ay gumagamit ng napakalakas na elektromagnet para kumuha ng larawan ng loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang MRI nga makina sa hospital naggamit ug kusog kaayo nga elektromagnet aron mokuha ug litrato sa sulod sa lawas.

q: How does a self-resetting fuse in a gadget protect the circuit — and what does it do after the danger passes?
options: It melts to break the circuit and must be replaced with a new one
It stops letting current through when it gets too hot, then returns to normal by itself once it cools down
It sends extra current to a second path to protect the main circuit, then switches back manually
It makes a loud beep to warn the user, then continues allowing current to flow normally
explanation: Self-resetting fuses stop current when they overheat, then automatically return to normal once they cool — nothing needs to be replaced.
fact_tl: May mga modernong fuse sa loob ng gadget at laruan na hindi natutunaw — sa halip, humihinto ito sa pagpapadaloy kapag uminit dahil sa sobrang kuryente, tapos kusang bumabalik sa normal kapag lumamig na. Parang breaker na nasa loob ng maliit na piraso, walang kailangang palitan.
fact_bis: Adunay modernong fuse sulod sa gadget ug dulaan nga dili matunaw — hinuon, mohunong kini sa pagpaagi sa kuryente kung mainit kini tungod sa sobra nga kuryente, dayon mobalik sa normal sa iyang kaugalingon inig bugnaw na. Sama kini sa breaker nga nahimutang sa usa ka gamay nga piraso, walay kinahanglang ilisan.

q: In 2022, NASA's DART mission showed that humans can do something important about asteroids. What did DART do?
options: It destroyed an asteroid completely by setting off an explosion on its surface
It changed the orbit of a small asteroid by crashing a spacecraft into it
It landed scientists on an asteroid to study its composition up close
It used a powerful laser beam fired from Earth to push an asteroid away
explanation: NASA's DART mission in 2022 successfully changed the orbit of a small asteroid by crashing a spacecraft into it, proving planetary defense is possible.
fact_tl: Ang mga near-Earth asteroid (NEA) ay mga asteroid na may orbit na malapit sa orbit ng Earth; sinusubaybayan sila ng NASA at iba pang mga ahensya para sa posibleng panganib ng banggaan. Noong 2022, matagumpay na binago ng DART mission ng NASA ang orbit ng isang maliit na asteroid sa pamamagitan ng pagbangga dito.
fact_bis: Ang mga near-Earth asteroid (NEA) mga asteroid nga ang mga orbit nagpaduol sa orbit sa Yuta; gina-track sila sa NASA ug ubang mga ahensya alang sa posibleng mga banta sa banggaan. Niadtong 2022, matagumpay nga gipabag-o sa DART mission sa NASA ang orbit sa usa ka gamay nga asteroid pinaagi sa pagbanggaa niini.

q: Why are there fewer flies in a clean environment?
options: Clean air makes flies fly away to other areas
Flies are afraid of soap and cleaning products
With no garbage and waste around, flies have no place to lay their eggs
Sunlight from clean open spaces kills fly eggs automatically
explanation: When surroundings are clean and garbage is properly disposed of, flies have no place to lay their eggs, so fewer flies are found there.
fact_tl: Kung malinis ang paligid at maayos ang pagtapon ng basura, kakaunti ang langaw dahil wala silang pwedeng pangitlugan. Kaya mahalaga ang malinis na kapaligiran.
fact_bis: Kon limpyo ang palibot ug husto ang paglabay sa basura, gamay ra ang langaw kay wala silay kapangitlugan. Mao nga importante ang limpyo nga palibot.

q: Which of the following is NOT a way germs can spread from person to person?
options: Through the air when someone coughs or sneezes
By touching a surface that a sick person touched
Through drinking clean bottled water
Through blood contact
explanation: Germs spread through the air, by touch, through dirty water, or through blood — clean bottled water does not spread germs.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang mga mikrobyo sa iba't ibang paraan: sa hangin, sa hawak, sa maruming tubig, o sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang mga mikrobyo mokaylap sa nagkalainlaing paagi: sa hangin, sa paghikap, sa hugaw nga tubig, o sa dugo.

q: A plant makes its own food through photosynthesis. Does it also do respiration to get energy?
options: No — plants only do photosynthesis and never need to break down sugar for energy
Yes — plants also use respiration to break down sugar and release energy for their own use
Only old leaves respire; young leaves only do photosynthesis
Plants do respiration only at night when there is no sunlight for photosynthesis
explanation: Plants both make food in photosynthesis and use sugar in respiration to get energy — they do not stop breathing.
fact_tl: Hindi tumitigil ang halaman sa paghinga: gumagawa ito ng pagkain sa photosynthesis, pero ginagamit din nito ang asukal sa respiration para kumuha ng energy.
fact_bis: Ang tanom dili moundang sa pagginhawa: naghimo kini og pagkaon sa photosynthesis, apan gigamit usab niini ang asukal sa respiration aron makakuha og kusog.

q: What is one important way to lower the risk of getting leptospirosis?
options: Boiling all drinking water and avoiding fruit juices
Taking daily vitamin C tablets during rainy season
Controlling the rat population and keeping surroundings clean
Wearing sunscreen whenever going outside after rain
explanation: Controlling rats and keeping surroundings clean lowers the risk of leptospirosis because rats are a main source of the bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang pagkontrol sa mga daga at pagpapanatiling malinis ng paligid ay nakakabawas sa panganib ng leptospirosis.
fact_bis: Ang pagpugong sa mga ilaga ug paghupot og hinlo nga palibot makapakunhod sa risgo sa leptospirosis.

q: Why are lagundi and sambong used as traditional medicine in the Philippines?
options: They grow very fast and are easy to harvest, making them cheap alternatives
They contain substances that can help the body heal or feel better
They smell pleasant, which helps sick people relax and recover
They were brought by Spanish colonizers who proved they cure diseases
explanation: Philippine medicinal plants like lagundi and sambong contain substances that can help the body, which is why they are used as traditional medicine.
fact_tl: Maraming halamang gamot sa Pilipinas, gaya ng lagundi at sambong, ang ginagamit bilang tradisyunal na gamot dahil may mga sangkap silang nakakatulong sa katawan.
fact_bis: Daghang tambal nga tanom sa Pilipinas, sama sa lagundi ug tambong, ang gigamit isip tradisyonal nga tambal kay adunay sila mga sangkap nga makatabang sa lawas.

q: What happens to coffee beans after a civet eats them?
options: They are fully broken down and absorbed as nutrients during digestion
They are stored in the civet's cheek pouches and spat out later
They pass through the digestive system undigested and come out whole in the droppings
They are crushed by the civet's strong teeth and dissolved in stomach acid
explanation: Coffee beans are hard and are not digested in the civet's stomach, so they come out whole in its droppings.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na buto ng kape ay hindi natutunaw sa tiyan ng musang at lumalabas itong buo kasama ng dumi nito.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga buto sa kape dili matunaw sa tiyan sa musang ug mogawas kini nga buo uban sa iyang hugaw.

q: Why does a drink with ice in it stay cold for a long time, even in a warm room?
options: Ice is so cold that it keeps cooling the drink steadily without needing to melt
Melting ice continuously absorbs large amounts of heat from the surroundings, keeping things cool
The drink has a special chemical that slows down the warming process
Water turns into a gas very quickly, and this gas keeps the liquid cool
explanation: To melt, ice must absorb a lot of heat from its surroundings — so the drink stays cold as long as there is ice still melting.
fact_tl: Para matunaw ang yelo, kailangan nitong sumipsip ng maraming init mula sa paligid — kaya nananatiling malamig ang inumin mong may yelo hangga't may natitirang yelo pa.
fact_bis: Aron matunaw ang yelo, kinahanglan kining mosuyop og daghang init gikan sa palibot — mao nga magpabilin nga bugnaw ang imong ilimnon nga adunay yelo samtang naa pay nahabilin nga yelo.

q: If you connect two batteries end to end in a circuit, what happens to the brightness of a bulb compared to using just one battery?
options: The bulb shines dimmer because the batteries share the load
The bulb shines the same because voltage does not affect brightness
The bulb shines brighter because the voltages add together and push current harder
The bulb flickers because two batteries create an uneven flow of electricity
explanation: Connecting batteries end to end (in series) adds their voltages together, pushing current harder and making the bulb shine brighter.
fact_tl: Kapag pinagdugtong mo ang dalawa o higit pang baterya nang magkasunod (series), nagsasama-sama ang kanilang boltahe, kaya mas malakas ang itulak sa kuryente at mas maliwanag ang bombilya kaysa sa iisang baterya.
fact_bis: Kung idugtong nimo ang duha o sobra pa nga baterya nga sunodsunod (series), magtipon ang ilang boltahe, mao nga mas kusgan ang pagtulod sa kuryente ug mas hayag ang bombilya kaysa sa usa ra ka baterya.

q: A venomous fish harms you in a specific way. How does it deliver its toxin?
options: You are harmed by eating its meat, which contains the toxin throughout
It sprays a cloud of toxin into the water around it
It delivers the toxin through a sting or prick, not by being eaten
Its skin releases toxin when touched lightly, just like a poison dart frog
explanation: A venomous fish delivers its toxin by a sting or prick, not by being eaten — that is what makes it venomous rather than poisonous.
fact_tl: Ang isdang venomous ay nagdudulot ng lason sa pamamagitan ng tusok, hindi sa pagkain nito.
fact_bis: Ang isda nga venomous mohatag sa hilo niini pinaagi sa tusok, dili pinaagi sa pagkaon niini.

q: Why do your ears pop when you are on an airplane or climbing a high mountain?
options: The noise of the airplane engine vibrates the eardrum and causes it to pop
Cold dry air at high altitudes enters the ear canal and makes a popping sound
The air pressure around you changes, causing the pressure inside and outside your ear to adjust
Your ears fill with fluid when altitude increases, which makes them pop when it drains
explanation: Your ears pop on an airplane or up a mountain because the air pressure around you changes, and your ears adjust to equalize the pressure.
fact_tl: Pumuputok ang tainga mo sa eroplano o sa bundok dahil nagbabago ang presyon ng hangin sa paligid mo.
fact_bis: Mosikit ang imong dalunggan sa eroplano o sa bukid kay nag-usab-usab ang presyon sa hangin sa imong palibot.

q: Inside a battery, what is the role of the electrolyte?
options: It stores electrical energy in the form of static charge on metal plates
It separates the two electrodes so they never touch and the battery lasts longer
It is the substance that allows the chemical reaction between the electrodes to happen
It insulates the battery casing to prevent heat from escaping during use
explanation: The electrolyte inside a battery is the substance that allows the chemical reaction between the anode and cathode to take place.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng baterya ay may dalawang elektrodo (anodo at katodo) at isang sangkap na tinatawag na elektrolayt na nagdudulot ng reaksiyong kemikal.
fact_bis: Sulod sa baterya adunay duha ka elektrodo (anodo ug katodo) ug usa ka sangkap nga gitawag nga elektrolayt nga maoy hinungdan sa reaksiyong kemikal.

q: Which everyday object behaves most like the way hot rock moves inside Earth's mantle?
options: A spinning top that slows down as its energy is used up
A lava lamp where warm material rises, cools at the top, then sinks again
A boiling pot of water that loses steam until the pot is empty
A candle flame that always points upward and never circulates
explanation: Mantle convection works like a lava lamp — heat from the core makes warm rock rise, cool, and sink in a cycle.
fact_tl: Maitutulad ang mantle convection sa isang lava lamp: pinainit ang ilalim, kaya ang mainit na wax ay umaakyat, lumalamig sa itaas, at bumababang muli. Ganito rin ang mantle — init mula sa core ang nagpapaikot sa bato.
fact_bis: Ang mantle convection sama sa lava lamp: ang ilalom giinit, mao nga ang init nga wax mosaka, mobugnaw sa ibabaw, ug mounlod balik. Mao usab ang mantle — ang init gikan sa core maoy nagpatuyok sa bato.

q: If you compare a goose and a duck, which bird is larger and has a longer neck?
options: They are the same size because they are both waterfowl
The duck is larger and has a longer neck than the goose
The goose is larger and has a longer neck than the duck
They are the same size but the goose has a longer neck
explanation: A goose is bigger than a duck and also has a noticeably longer neck.
fact_tl: Ang gansa ay mas malaki at mas mahaba ang leeg kaysa sa bibe.
fact_bis: Ang gansa mas dako ug mas taas og liog kay sa bibe.

q: A ball is rolling at a certain speed. If you double the ball's speed, what happens to its kinetic energy?
options: It doubles because speed and kinetic energy always change by the same amount
It triples because each extra unit of speed adds more energy than the one before
It quadruples because kinetic energy depends on speed squared
It stays the same because the mass of the ball has not changed
explanation: The formula KE = 1/2 mv^2 means kinetic energy depends on speed squared — doubling the speed quadruples the kinetic energy.
fact_tl: Ang kinetic energy ay sinusukat gamit ang formula KE = ½mv² — nangangahulugang kapag nag-double ang bilis, nagkapat ang kinetic energy, hindi nagdouble lamang.
fact_bis: Ang kinetic energy gisukat gamit ang KE = ½mv² — nagpasabot nga ang pagdoble sa bilis nagkapat sa kinetic energy, dili lang nagdoble.

q: How do some monkeys use their tails when moving through the trees?
options: They use their tails to sweep branches out of the way while running
They use their tails to hold on to branches while climbing
They carry food in their curled tails as they move from tree to tree
They use their tails to signal danger to other monkeys in the treetops
explanation: Some monkeys use their tails to grip and hold on while climbing trees, which helps them move safely through the branches.
fact_tl: May mga unggoy na gumagamit ng buntot nila para kumapit habang umaakyat sa mga puno.
fact_bis: Adunay mga unggoy nga mogamit sa ilang ikog aron mokapyot samtang nagsaka sa mga kahoy.

q: What does the santol fruit look and taste like?
options: It is a long yellow fruit with sweet flesh and thin skin, like a banana
It is a round fruit with thick skin and sour-sweet flesh, commonly found in Philippine forests and backyards
It is a small red berry with a very bitter taste found only in mountain forests
It is a spiky green fruit with a creamy white flesh that smells very strong
explanation: Santol is a round tree fruit with thick skin and sour-sweet flesh, commonly found in forests and backyards in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang santol ay isang bilog na prutas ng puno na may makapal na balat at malasa-asim na laman; karaniwan itong makikita sa mga gubat at bakuran sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang santol usa ka lingin nga prutas sa puno nga adunay baga nga panit ug aslom-tam-is nga unod; kasagaran kini makita sa mga lasang ug natad sa Pilipinas.

q: Why is it important to use clean jars, hands, and tools when fermenting food?
options: Dirty tools make the fermentation happen faster, which spoils the flavor
If unwanted dirty microbes get in, they can take over and spoil the food instead of fermenting it properly
The salt used in fermentation only works if the container is made of clean glass
Fermentation requires a completely germ-free environment or it will not start at all
explanation: If dirty microbes get into a fermentation jar they might take over and spoil the food, so clean tools and hands are essential for safe, successful fermentation.
fact_tl: Para ligtas at maayos ang fermentation, kailangang malinis ang garapon, kamay, at mga kasangkapan, dahil kung may pumasok na maruming mikrobyo, baka ito ang manaig at masira ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Aron luwas ug malampuson ang fermentation, kinahanglang limpyo ang garapon, kamot, ug mga gamit, kay kung makasulod ang hugaw nga mikrobyo, basin sila ang molabaw ug madaot ang pagkaon.

q: What determines whether an object placed in water floats or sinks?
options: Whether the object is made of metal — metal always sinks and wood always floats
Whether the object is dry or wet when it enters the water
Whether the object is lighter or heavier than the water it pushes aside
Whether the water is warm or cold — objects only float in warm water
explanation: Buoyancy is the upward push of water; an object floats if it is lighter than the water it displaces, and sinks if it is heavier.
fact_tl: Itinutulak pataas ng tubig ang anumang bagay na nakalubog dito; ito ang buoyancy. Lumulutang ang bagay kung mas magaan ito kaysa sa tubig na itinabi nito, at lumubog kung mas mabigat.
fact_bis: Ang tubig motukmod pataas sa bisan unsang butang nga gibutang niini; gitawag kini nga buoyancy. Molutaw ang butang kung mas gaan kini kaysa tubig nga gisalikway niini, ug molunod kung mas bug-at.

q: Where is pako (a fern eaten as a vegetable) usually obtained?
options: It is grown on large farms and sold only in supermarkets
It is imported from other countries and sold in markets
It is usually gathered wild from forests and riverbanks rather than being farmed
It grows only in home gardens and must be planted from seeds bought at stores
explanation: Pako is usually gathered wild from forests and riverbanks rather than being cultivated on farms.
fact_tl: Karaniwang pinupulot ang pako nang ligaw sa gubat at tabing-ilog, hindi ito laging itinatanim.
fact_bis: Ang pako kasagarang puniton nga ihalas gikan sa kalasangan ug daplin sa suba, dili kini kanunay tamnon.

q: What is the first step in making sugar from sugarcane?
options: The cane is dried in the sun to concentrate its natural sweetness
The cane is boiled whole in large pots of water until the sugar dissolves out
The cane is crushed to squeeze out its sweet juice
The cane's outer skin is peeled off and the inside is ground into a fine powder
explanation: The first step in making sugar is crushing the sugarcane to squeeze out its sweet juice.
fact_tl: Para makagawa ng asukal, pinipiga muna ang tubo para makuha ang matamis na katas nito.
fact_bis: Aron makahimo og asukal, ang tubó dugmokon una aron makuha ang tam-is nga duga niini.

q: When do a baby's eyes open during development inside the womb?
options: The eyes are open from the very beginning of development
The eyes open at about three months and stay open for the rest of the pregnancy
The eyes stay closed at first and only open later, closer to birth
The eyes never open inside the womb and only open for the first time at birth
explanation: Inside the womb the baby's eyes stay closed at first and only open later, before birth.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng sinapupunan, ang mga mata ng sanggol ay nakapikit muna at saka lamang nagbubukas bago ipanganak.
fact_bis: Sulod sa tagoangkan, ang mga mata sa bata magpiyong una ug magbukas lang sa ulahi una matawo.

q: Why doesn't a haircut hurt?
options: Hair has very few nerve endings so it only hurts a little when cut
The scissors are so sharp that they cut faster than pain signals can travel
The part of hair we see is already dead, so cutting it cannot cause pain
Our brains ignore the pain of haircuts because they happen so often
explanation: A haircut does not hurt because the visible part of hair is already dead — only the root beneath the skin is alive.
fact_tl: Hindi sumasakit ang paggupit ng buhok dahil ang bahaging nakikita natin ay patay na — buhay lang ang ugat sa ilalim ng balat kung saan ito tumutubo.
fact_bis: Dili sakit ang paggupit sa buhok kay ang bahin nga atong makita patay na — ang gamot lang sa ilawom sa panit, diin kini moturok, ang buhi.

q: The Puerto Princesa Underground River is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In which year was it listed?
explanation: The Puerto Princesa Underground River was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999.
fact_tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River ay UNESCO World Heritage Site mula noong 1999.
fact_bis: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River usa ka UNESCO World Heritage Site sukad 1999.

q: In which town and province is the colorful Pahiyas festival celebrated every year?
options: Vigan, Ilocos Sur
Lucban, Quezon
Dinagyang, Iloilo
Pakil, Laguna
explanation: The Pahiyas festival is held in Lucban, Quezon, where houses are decorated with colorful rice-wafer kiping.
fact_tl: Ang Pahiyas ay ipinagdiriwang sa Lucban, Quezon.
fact_bis: Ang Pahiyas gisaulog sa Lucban, Quezon.

q: Sweet foods like candy are called 'go foods' because they give us energy. Why should we eat only a small amount of them?
options: Because they contain fat that clogs blood vessels and causes heart disease immediately
Because they are so sweet that eating too much makes other food taste bland
Because too much sugar can harm our teeth and give us more sugar than our body needs
Because sweets slow digestion and make us feel sleepy right after eating them
explanation: Sweet go foods give energy from sugar, but eating too much can damage teeth and give the body more sugar than it needs.
fact_tl: Ang matatamis na pagkain gaya ng kendi ay go food din kasi puno ng asukal na nagbibigay lakas. Pero dapat konti lang ang kainin para hindi masira ang ngipin at hindi sumobra ang asukal.
fact_bis: Ang matam-is nga pagkaon sama sa kendi go food usab kay puno sa asukal nga naghatag og kusog. Apan kinahanglan gamay lang ang kan-on aron dili madaot ang ngipon ug dili sobra ang asukal.

q: Why can't a dolphin breathe while it is fully asleep?
options: Dolphins do not sleep at all because they must keep swimming to stay warm
A dolphin's blowhole closes tightly during sleep, which would cause it to drown
Unlike humans, a dolphin must think about each breath, so breathing is not automatic
Dolphins lose the ability to swim when asleep and would sink before they could surface to breathe
explanation: A dolphin must consciously think about each breath — breathing is voluntary for dolphins — so it cannot breathe while fully unconscious.
fact_tl: Hindi gaya natin, sinasadya ng lumba-lumba ang bawat paghinga nito, kaya hindi ito humihinga habang tulog na tulog.
fact_bis: Dili sama kanato, tuyoon sa lumba-lumba ang matag ginhawa niini, mao nga dili kini makaginhawa kon hingpit nga natulog.

q: Why do colorful terraced platforms form around hot springs?
options: Algae and bacteria grow in the hot water and build up layers that form the colored terraces
Volcanic ash falls into the water and slowly piles up into the terraced shapes over time
Minerals dissolved in the hot water deposit as solids when the water cools and evaporates at the surface
The ground around a hot spring sinks due to the weight of the water, forming natural terraces
explanation: Hot spring water carries dissolved minerals; when it cools and evaporates at the surface, those minerals deposit as travertine or silica, creating colorful terraced platforms.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na tubig ng mga hot spring ay naglalaman ng mga natunaw na mineral; habang ang tubig ay lumalamig at sumingaw sa ibabaw ng lupa, ang mga mineral ay nagtatayo bilang mga deposito na tinatawag na travertine (calcium carbonate) o siliceous sinter (silica); ito ang nagbibigay ng mga magandang color na platform sa mga hot spring.
fact_bis: Ang mainit na tubig sa mga hot spring naglangkob og natunaw nga mga mineral; samtang ang tubig nagbugnaw ug mosingaw sa ibabaw sa yuta, ang mga mineral nagtipil ingon nga travertine (calcium carbonate) o siliceous sinter (silica); kini naghatag sa mga matahum nga kolor nga plataporma nga makita sa mga hot spring.

q: How many eyes does a spider have, and what do its large front eyes help it do?
options: Two eyes, which work together to give sharp color vision for spotting prey at a distance
Four eyes arranged in a square pattern that give it a full 360-degree view
Six eyes like most other insects, which detect motion but cannot judge distance
Eight eyes, with the large front ones helping a jumping spider judge distance before leaping onto prey
explanation: A spider has eight eyes; the large front eyes of a jumping spider help it judge distance accurately before it leaps onto its prey.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng mandaragit ay may dalawang mata. Ang gagamba ay may walong mata — ang malalaki sa harap ay tumutulong sa jumping spider na tantyahin ang layo bago tumalon sa biktima nito.
fact_bis: Dili tanang mandaragit adunay duha lang ka mata. Ang lawalawa adunay walo ka mata — ang dagko sa atubangan motabang sa jumping spider sa pagtantya sa gilay-on una kini molukso sa biktima.

q: About how long does a human pregnancy last before a baby is born?
options: About six months
About nine months
About twelve months
About fifteen months
explanation: A human pregnancy lasts about nine months before the baby is born.
fact_tl: Ang pagbubuntis ng tao ay tumatagal ng humigit-kumulang siyam na buwan bago isilang ang sanggol.
fact_bis: Ang pagmabdos sa tawo molungtad ug mga siyam ka bulan sa dili pa matawo ang bata.

q: The plates at the Philippine Trench push together every year. How fast do they move?
options: About one meter per year, roughly as fast as a person walks in one second
Only a few centimeters per year, roughly as fast as fingernails grow
About ten centimeters per year, roughly as fast as hair grows in a week
Several kilometers per year but only during earthquake events
explanation: The plates at the Philippine Trench push together only a few centimeters each year — about as fast as fingernails grow — but over millions of years this greatly shapes the seafloor.
fact_tl: Ang mga plate sa Philippine Trench ay nagtutulakan nang dahan-dahan, mga ilang sentimetro lang kada taon, halos kasingbilis ng paglaki ng kuko natin. Pero sa milyong taon, malaki ang epekto nito sa hugis ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga plate sa Philippine Trench hinay nga nagtinukmod, pipila lang ka sentimetro matag tuig, halos sama kapaspas sa pagtubo sa atong kuko. Apan sulod sa minilyon ka tuig, dako kini og epekto sa porma sa dagat.

q: Why is General Santos City in Mindanao called the 'Tuna Capital of the Philippines'?
options: It is the only city in the Philippines where tuna can be legally caught and sold
The city is located on Tuna Island, the largest tuna habitat in Southeast Asia
So much tuna is landed and processed there that it earned the nickname
The city hosts the world's largest annual tuna-eating contest every December
explanation: General Santos City earned the title 'Tuna Capital of the Philippines' because an exceptionally large amount of tuna is landed and processed there.
fact_tl: Ang lungsod ng General Santos sa Mindanao ay tinatawag na 'Tuna Capital of the Philippines' dahil sa dami ng tuna na dumadaong doon.
fact_bis: Ang siyudad sa General Santos sa Mindanao gitawag nga 'Tuna Capital of the Philippines' tungod sa kadaghan sa tuna nga moabot didto.

q: Why do clouds look white instead of the blue color of the sky around them?
options: Cloud droplets absorb all colors of light and re-emit only white light
The white color comes from the ice crystals at the top of clouds reflecting sunlight
Clouds look white because their larger water droplets scatter all colors of light equally
Clouds are made of water vapor which is naturally colorless and looks white against the blue sky
explanation: Clouds look white because their larger water droplets scatter all colors of light equally, unlike the sky's smaller air molecules which scatter blue light most.
fact_tl: Puti ang ulap, hindi asul, dahil ang malalaking patak ng tubig dito ay nagkakalat ng lahat ng kulay nang pantay-pantay.
fact_bis: Puti ang panganod, dili asul, kay ang mas dagko nga tinulo sa tubig niini nagkatag sa tanan nga kolor nga managsama.

q: Why does a carabao need to spend many hours grazing every day?
options: Carabaos sleep most of the day and must eat quickly in a short window of time
Carabaos have a very fast metabolism and burn energy quickly when working
Grass has only a little nutrition, so the carabao must eat a large amount to meet its daily energy needs
Carabaos eat slowly and waste most of the grass, so they need more time to get enough food
explanation: A carabao must graze for many hours each day because grass has only a little nutrition, requiring large quantities to meet its energy needs.
fact_tl: Kailangang kumain ng maraming damo ang kalabaw kada araw kaya marami itong oras na ginugugol sa panginginain dahil mahina ang sustansya ng damo.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan mokaon og daghang kumpay ang kalabaw kada adlaw maong daghang oras ang gigugol niini sa pagsibsib kay gamay ra ang sustansya sa kumpay.

q: How does a rocket lift off the ground, according to the action-reaction principle?
options: The rocket's engines heat the air under it, and the hot air lifts the rocket like a balloon
The rocket spins its blades very fast to push air downward the way a helicopter does
The rocket pushes hot gas downward, and in return the gas pushes the rocket upward with an equal force
The rocket uses magnetic repulsion between the launch pad and its metal base to jump upward
explanation: A rocket lifts off by pushing hot gas downward; by Newton's action-reaction law, the gas pushes the rocket upward with an equal force.
fact_tl: Sa bawat tulak ay may katumbas na tulak pabalik (action–reaction). Ang rocket ay tumataas dahil itinutulak nito ang mainit na gas pababa, at bilang ganti, itinutulak ng gas ang rocket pataas.
fact_bis: Sa matag tukmod adunay katumbas nga tukmod balik (action–reaction). Mosaka ang rocket tungod kay gitukmod niini ang init nga gas paubos, ug isip balos, gitukmod sa gas ang rocket pataas.

q: What kind of animal is the civet, also called alamid or musang, found in the Philippines?
options: A large reptile that climbs trees and eats fruit and small birds
A small tree-climbing mammal that lives in Philippine forests
A nocturnal bird related to the owl that nests in tree hollows
A type of large insect related to beetles that resembles a small cat
explanation: The civet (alamid or musang) is a small tree-climbing mammal found in Philippine forests.
fact_tl: Ang alamid o musang ay isang maliit na mammal na umaakyat sa mga puno at karaniwang matatagpuan sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang alamid o milo usa ka gamay nga mananap nga mosaka sa kahoy ug makita sa Pilipinas.

q: How does smoking affect the skin over time?
options: Smoking increases blood flow to the skin, which keeps it looking young and healthy
Smoking has no direct effect on the skin because smoke mostly damages the lungs
Smoking reduces blood flow to the skin, causing the face to wrinkle and age faster
Smoking dries out only the lips and throat but does not affect facial skin at all
explanation: Smoking reduces blood flow to the skin, so a smoker's face wrinkles and ages faster than a non-smoker's.
fact_tl: Binabawasan ng paninigarilyo ang daloy ng dugo papunta sa balat, kaya mas mabilis kumulubot at tumanda ang mukha ng naninigarilyo.
fact_bis: Ang panigarilyo magpakunhod sa dagayday sa dugo paingon sa panit, busa mas paspas mokubol ug motigulang ang nawong sa nagpanigarilyo.

q: Why does frost on a cold window often form beautiful fern-like branching patterns?
options: The glass is curved, which forces ice crystals to grow in curved fern-like arcs
The patterns copy the fingerprints of people who touched the glass before it froze
Tiny ice crystals slowly join together, following little scratches and specks of dust on the glass as they grow
Cold air blows across the glass in swirling currents that shape the frost into leaf patterns
explanation: Frost forms fern-like patterns because tiny ice crystals slowly join together, following little scratches and dust specks on the glass as they grow.
fact_tl: Ang frost sa salamin ay madalas bumubuo ng magagandang disenyong parang dahon o sanga ng pako (fern). Nangyayari ito dahil dahan-dahang sumasanib ang mga kristal ng yelo, sumusunod sa maliliit na gasgas o alikabok sa salamin habang lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang frost sa bildo kanunay maghimo og matahum nga disenyo nga morag dahon o sanga sa pako (fern). Mahitabo kini kay hinay-hinay nga magdugtong ang gagmay nga kristal sa yelo, mosunod sa gagmay nga gasgas o abog sa bildo samtang motubo.

q: What is happening inside an object when it feels hotter?
options: Its atoms are getting bigger and pressing harder against each other
Its tiny particles are moving faster inside it
A special type of energy called heat energy is being stored in empty spaces between its particles
Its particles are slowing down to release energy as heat to the surroundings
explanation: The hotter an object is, the faster its tiny particles move inside it — temperature is a measure of this particle motion.
fact_tl: Kapag mas mainit ang isang bagay, mas mabilis gumalaw ang napakaliliit na partikulo sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Kon mas init ang usa ka butang, mas paspas molihok ang gagmay nga mga partikulo sa sulod niini.

q: You just finished eating rice for lunch and your blood sugar went up. Later, before dinner, you feel hungry again and your blood sugar is dropping. Which hormone helps at that later point?
options: Insulin, because it is always working to control blood sugar throughout the day
Glucagon, because it is released when blood sugar drops to help raise it back up
Adrenaline, because hunger is a stressful feeling that triggers the fight-or-flight response
Estrogen, because it regulates energy levels between meals
explanation: After eating rice, insulin works first to lower rising blood sugar; but when blood sugar drops again before dinner, glucagon is the hormone that helps raise it back up.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos kumain ng kanin, tumataas ang asukal mo kaya gumagana muna ang insulin; pero kapag gutom ka na ulit bago ang hapunan, glucagon naman ang tumutulong.
fact_bis: Human mokaon og kan-on, mosaka ang imong asukal mao nga ang insulin moana usa; apan kung gutomon ka na usab sa dili pa manihapon, ang glucagon na ang motabang.

q: What were the Chocolate Hills in Bohol long ago, before they became the dry land we see today?
options: A range of volcanic mountains that eroded into rounded hills over millions of years
A coral reef under the sea that was lifted up as the land rose
A large lake bed that dried out and left behind thousands of mud mounds
A dense forest whose tree stumps decayed and hardened into the cone-shaped hills
explanation: Long ago the Chocolate Hills area was a coral reef under the sea; it was lifted up over time and became the dry land we see today.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ang lugar ng Chocolate Hills ay isang coral reef sa ilalim ng dagat na umangat at naging tuyong lupa.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang dapit sa Chocolate Hills usa ka coral reef sa ilawom sa dagat nga miulbo ug nahimong mala nga yuta.

q: The ABO blood type system is an example of 'multiple alleles.' How many versions of the blood type gene exist?
options: Two — one for type A and one for type B, which combine to make AB or cancel out to make O
Three — I-A, I-B, and i — which combine in pairs to give four possible blood types
Four — one for each of the blood types A, B, AB, and O
Six — two versions for each of the three main blood groups
explanation: ABO blood type has three alleles (I-A, I-B, and i) that combine in pairs to produce four possible blood types: A, B, AB, or O.
fact_tl: Ang ABO blood type ay isang halimbawa ng multiple alleles — ang iisang gene ay may tatlong bersyon (I-A, I-B, at i) na nagbibigay ng apat na posibleng blood type (A, B, AB, o O) depende sa mga allele na natanggap mula sa magulang.
fact_bis: Ang ABO blood type usa ka halimbawa sa multiple alleles — ang usa ka gene adunay tulo ka bersyon (I-A, I-B, ug i) nga naghatag og upat ka posible nga blood type (A, B, AB, o O) depende sa kung unsa nga mga allele ang napanunod.

q: Why is oxidation classified as a chemical change rather than a physical change?
options: Because it always produces heat, which is a sign that energy is involved
Because the color or texture of the material looks different after oxidation occurs
Because it forms a new substance that cannot easily be turned back into the original material
Because it happens slowly over time rather than all at once like a physical change
explanation: Oxidation is a chemical change because it forms a new substance — and that new substance cannot easily be changed back to the original.
fact_tl: Ang oksihenasyon ay isang kemikal na pagbabago dahil bumubuo ito ng bagong sangkap na hindi na basta maibabalik.
fact_bis: Ang oksihenasyon usa ka kemikal nga kabag-uhan kay maghimo kini ug bag-ong substansiya nga dili na sayon ibalik.

q: What did Archimedes discover about buoyant force?
options: The buoyant force equals the weight of the water the object pushes aside.
The buoyant force equals the weight of the object itself.
The buoyant force equals the volume of the object.
The buoyant force equals the depth of the water above the object.
explanation: Archimedes found that the buoyant force on an object equals the weight of the water that object displaces.
fact_tl: Ayon kay Archimedes, ang lakas ng pagtaas ng tubig ay katumbas ng bigat ng tubig na naitabi ng bagay.
fact_bis: Sumala ni Archimedes, ang buoyant force patas sa gibug-aton sa tubig nga gitulod sa butang pagawas.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the three main kinds of coral reef?
options: Patch reef
Fringing reef
Barrier reef
Atoll
explanation: The three main reef types are fringing reefs (along the shore), barrier reefs (farther out), and ring-shaped atolls; patch reef is not in this classification.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing uri ng coral reef: fringing reef sa tabi ng baybayin, barrier reef na malayo nang kaunti, at atoll na hugis-singsing.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka nag-unang klase sa coral reef: fringing reef daplin sa baybayon, barrier reef nga gamay nga layo, ug atoll nga porma og singsing.

q: In a cave, where does a stalagmite usually form?
options: Directly below a stalactite on the cave floor
Directly above a stalactite on the cave ceiling
On the cave walls, away from stalactites
At the entrance of the cave where sunlight reaches
explanation: A stalagmite grows on the floor directly below a stalactite because the same dripping water builds both formations.
fact_tl: Kadalasan ay may stalagmite sa ilalim mismo ng isang stalactite dahil ang parehong tumutulong patak ay gumagawa sa kanila — bumubuo ng stalactite sa kisame habang ang nahuhulog na patak ay nagtatayo ng stalagmite sa tapat nito sa sahig.
fact_bis: Kasagaran adunay stalagmite diha mismo sa ilalom sa usa ka stalactite kay ang samang nagtulo nga tubig naghimo sa duha — naghimo og stalactite sa kisame samtang ang nahulog nga tulo nagtukod og stalagmite diha mismo sa ilalom niini sa salog.

q: About what percentage of the world's earthquakes happen along the Pacific Ring of Fire?
explanation: About 90% of the world's earthquakes occur along the Pacific Ring of Fire.
fact_tl: Humigit-kumulang 90% ng mga lindol sa mundo ay nangyayari sa Pacific Ring of Fire.
fact_bis: Mga 90% sa mga linog sa kalibutan mahitabo sa Pacific Ring of Fire.

q: How does soap help remove germs from your hands?
options: It makes germs slippery so scrubbing and rinsing can wash them away.
It kills all germs on contact without any rubbing needed.
It creates a protective layer that stops germs from entering the skin.
It dries out germs so they fall off by themselves.
explanation: Soap does not kill all germs — it makes them slippery and lifts them off, so scrubbing and rinsing are needed to wash them fully away.
fact_tl: Hindi pinapatay ng sabon ang lahat ng mikrobyo — sa halip, dinudulas at hinahatak nito ang mga ito palayo sa kamay kaya kailangan ng pagkuskos at pagbanlaw para tuluyang maalis.
fact_bis: Ang sabon dili mopatay sa tanan nga mikrobyo — hinuon padanlogon ug bira-on niini sila palayo sa kamot, busa kinahanglan ang pagkuskos ug pagbanlaw aron hingpit nga makuha.

q: How long can a whale shark grow?
options: About 12 to 18 meters, longer than a bus
About 5 to 7 meters, about the size of a car
About 20 to 25 meters, as long as two buses
About 3 to 4 meters, shorter than a classroom door is tall
explanation: A whale shark can grow about 12 to 18 meters long, which is longer than a bus.
fact_tl: Ang butanding ay maaaring umabot sa humigit-kumulang 12 hanggang 18 metro ang haba, mas mahaba pa sa isang bus.
fact_bis: Ang tuki makaabot ug mga 12 ngadto sa 18 ka metro ang gitas-on, mas taas pa sa usa ka bus.

q: Why does okra become slimy when you cut or cook it?
options: It has a sticky juice inside that comes out when cut, which also thickens soups.
Its outer skin breaks down and releases a waxy coating.
It produces a chemical reaction with air that creates a gel.
The seeds inside release a liquid that hardens when heated.
explanation: Okra has a sticky juice inside that comes out when cut or cooked, making it slimy and thickening soups or stews.
fact_tl: Bakit nagiging malagkit ang okra kapag hiniwa o niluto? May likido kasi ito sa loob na lumalabas at kumakapit — ito ang nagpapalapot ng sabaw o gisa.
fact_bis: Ngano nga mahimong malagkit ang okra kon hiwaon o lutoon? Adunay duga kini sa sulod nga mogawas ug mokapit — mao kini ang makapahimo nga lapot sa sabaw o gisa.

q: What is causing more frequent coral bleaching in Philippine reefs?
options: Climate change is raising ocean temperatures.
Overfishing is removing the fish that protect corals.
Ocean currents are slowing down and reducing nutrients.
Increased rainfall is making seawater less salty.
explanation: Climate change is raising ocean temperatures, causing more frequent and severe coral bleaching, including in Philippine reefs.
fact_tl: Ang pagbabago ng klima ay nagpapataas ng temperatura ng karagatan, na nagdudulot ng mas madalas at mas malubhang coral bleaching sa buong mundo, kasama ang mga bahura ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang pagbabago sa klima nagpataas sa temperatura sa dagat, naghinungdan og mas kanunay ug mas grabi nga coral bleaching sa tibuok kalibutan, lakip ang mga bahura sa Pilipinas.

q: In what kind of climate does a jackfruit tree grow best?
options: Warm tropical places like the Philippines
Cold mountainous regions with frequent frost
Dry desert areas with very little rainfall
Temperate zones with four distinct seasons
explanation: The jackfruit tree grows in warm tropical places like the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang puno ng langka ay tumutubo sa mainit na tropikal na lugar tulad ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy sa nangka motubo sa init nga tropikal nga dapit sama sa Pilipinas.

q: Who leads the Philippine Senate?
options: The Senate President
The Senate Majority Leader
The Senate Floor Leader
The Senate Speaker
explanation: The Senate President is the leader of the Philippine Senate.
fact_tl: Ang Senate President (Pangulo ng Senado) ang namumuno sa Senado ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Senate President (Presidente sa Senado) mao ang nangulo sa Senado sa Pilipinas.

q: Which of the following is part of a healthy daily hygiene routine?
options: Bathing, brushing teeth, wearing clean clothes, and washing hands
Bathing once a week, brushing teeth after meals only, and wearing the same clothes two days
Only washing hands before meals and brushing teeth at night
Wearing clean clothes daily but bathing only when visibly dirty
explanation: Daily personal hygiene includes bathing, brushing teeth, wearing clean clothes, and washing hands to protect health and prevent infections.
fact_tl: Ang araw-araw na personal na kalinisan ay kinabibilangan ng paligo, pagsisipilyo ng ngipin, pagsusuot ng malinis na damit, at paghugas ng kamay; ang mga ugaling ito ay nagpoprotekta sa kalusugan at nagbibigay ng kaginhawahan.
fact_bis: Ang adlaw-adlaw nga personal nga kalinisan naglakip sa paligo, pagsisipilyo sa ngipon, pagsuot ug limpyo nga bado, ug paghugas sa kamay; kining mga gawi nagpanalipud sa kahimsog ug naglikay sa amoy sa katawan ug mga impeksyon sa panit.

q: Why does heat conduction happen mainly in solids like a metal bar?
options: The particles stay in place and pass heat to neighbors without moving away.
The particles float freely and carry heat from one end to the other.
Metal particles release heat as light energy when they vibrate.
Solids absorb heat faster because they have more mass than liquids.
explanation: In conduction, particles stay in place and pass heat to their neighbors, which is why it happens mainly in solids.
fact_tl: Sa conduction, hindi gumagalaw mula sa lugar nito ang mga particle — nanatili sila sa puwesto habang ipinapasa lang nila ang init sa katabi. Kaya pangunahing nangyayari ito sa mga solidong bagay tulad ng metal na bareta.
fact_bis: Sa conduction, dili molihok gikan sa ilang dapit ang mga particle — magpabilin sila samtang ilang ipasa lang ang init sa silingan. Mao nga kini mahitabo ilabina sa mga solidong butang sama sa puthaw nga bara.

q: Why do earthquake magnitudes often include a decimal point, like 6.3?
options: Because an earthquake's strength is rarely an exact whole number, so the decimal gives a more accurate reading.
Because seismographs can only display decimal numbers, not whole numbers.
Because the decimal shows the depth of the earthquake underground.
Because scientists add a decimal to separate the main quake from its aftershocks.
explanation: Earthquake magnitudes use decimals because shaking strength is rarely an exact whole number, and the decimal gives a more accurate measurement.
fact_tl: Madalas may decimal ang magnitude, gaya ng 6.3, dahil ang lakas ng lindol ay bihirang eksaktong buong numero. Ang decimal ay nagbibigay ng mas tumpak na larawan kung gaano talaga kalakas ang yanig.
fact_bis: Sagad adunay decimal ang magnitude, sama sa 6.3, kay ang kusog sa linog talagsa ra mahimong eksaktong buong numero. Ang decimal naghatag og mas tukma nga hulagway kung unsa gyud ka kusog ang pag-uyog.

q: What should you do if you are sick and not getting better?
options: See a doctor instead of continuing to medicate yourself.
Take a higher dose of the same medicine for a few more days.
Rest at home and wait at least two weeks before seeking help.
Try a different over-the-counter medicine on your own.
explanation: If you are not getting better or get worse, you should see a doctor instead of continuing to medicate yourself.
fact_tl: Kung hindi ka gumagaling o lumalala, dapat magpatingin sa doktor sa halip na magpatuloy sa pag-inom mag-isa.
fact_bis: Kung wala ka mo-ayo o mograbe, pagpatan-aw sa doktor imbes nga magpadayon sa pag-inom nimo lang.

q: How can floodwater spread leptospirosis?
options: Floodwater mixed with rat urine can carry the bacteria that cause leptospirosis.
Floodwater carries mosquitoes that bite people and inject the bacteria.
Drinking tap water during floods directly transfers leptospirosis germs.
Floodwater evaporates and spreads bacteria through the air you breathe.
explanation: During floods, water mixed with rat urine can carry the bacteria that cause leptospirosis.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng baha, ang tubig na may halong ihi ng daga ay maaaring magdala ng bakterya ng leptospirosis.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa baha, ang tubig nga gisagolan og ihi sa ilaga makadala sa bakterya nga magpasakit og leptospirosis.

q: Which planet has the shortest year because it orbits the Sun in only about 88 days?
options: Mercury
Venus
Mars
Earth
explanation: Mercury orbits the Sun in only about 88 days, giving it the shortest year of any planet in our solar system.
fact_tl: Ang Mercury ay umiikot sa Araw sa loob lamang ng halos 88 araw, kaya ito ang may pinakamaikling taon sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang Mercury molibot sa Adlaw sulod lamang sa mga 88 ka adlaw, mao nga kini ang adunay pinakamubo nga tuig sa tanang planeta.

q: Where in the world can you find the tarictic hornbill?
options: Only in the Philippines
Only in Borneo and the Philippines
Throughout Southeast Asia
In the Philippines and Australia
explanation: The tarictic hornbill is a Philippine endemic bird found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in the world.
fact_tl: Ang tarictic hornbill ay isang uri ng kalaw na matatagpuan lamang sa Pilipinas at wala nang ibang lugar sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang tarictic hornbill usa ka matang sa kalaw nga makit-an lamang sa Pilipinas ug wala na sa laing dapit sa kalibotan.

q: How is one strong silk thread made from silkworm cocoons?
options: Thin strands from several cocoons are twisted together to form one strong thread.
A single thick strand is pulled straight from one large cocoon.
Several cocoons are melted together and poured into a thread mold.
Strands are glued side by side and flattened into a ribbon.
explanation: Thin strands from several cocoons are twisted together to make one strong silk thread.
fact_tl: Ang mga manipis na hibla mula sa ilang cocoon ay pinagsasama-sama para gumawa ng isang matibay na sinulid.
fact_bis: Ang mga nipis nga hilo gikan sa pipila ka cocoon gisagol aron mahimong usa ka lig-on nga hilo.

q: Why does a lacewing place its eggs at the tip of thin stalks?
options: So other insects cannot easily reach and eat the eggs.
So the eggs get more sunlight and hatch faster.
So the eggs stay dry and do not absorb water from leaves.
So wind can carry the eggs to a new location.
explanation: A lacewing places its eggs on thin stalks to protect them from being eaten by other insects that cannot easily reach the tips.
fact_tl: Inilalagay ng lacewing ang mga itlog nito sa dulo ng manipis na tangkay para hindi makain ng ibang kulisap.
fact_bis: Ang lacewing mobutang sa mga itlog niini sa tumoy sa nipis nga tangkay aron dili dali makaon sa ubang insekto.

q: Why is the makahiya plant called by that name?
options: Because it folds its leaves when touched, as if it is shy.
Because it only grows hidden under large trees away from sunlight.
Because its flowers bloom only at night when no one is watching.
Because it has a very quiet rustling sound compared to other plants.
explanation: Makahiya means 'shy' because the plant folds its leaves when touched, making it seem bashful.
fact_tl: Tinawag itong makahiya dahil sa salitang hiya, sapagkat parang nahihiya ito kapag hinahawakan.
fact_bis: Ginganlan kini ug makahiya gikan sa pulong nga ulaw, kay morag maulaw kini kung hikapon.

q: How many stamens does a gumamela flower actually have?
options: Many stamens joined together to look like one tube
Only one long central stamen
Five stamens, one for each petal
Three stamens hidden inside the petals
explanation: Although a gumamela looks like it has one stamen tube, many stamens are actually joined together to form that tube.
fact_tl: Maraming nagaakala na isa lang ang stamen ng gumamela dahil mukha itong iisang tubo. Pero ang totoo, maraming stamen ang pinagsama-sama para mabuo ang tubong iyon.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga usa ra ka stamen ang gumamela kay morag usa ra ka tubo. Apan ang tinuod, daghan nga stamen ang gitapok aron mahimo kanang tubo.

q: What is the MAIN purpose of a flower on a plant?
options: To make seeds so the plant can reproduce
To provide food for bees and butterflies
To attract rain by releasing a sweet smell
To protect the plant's leaves from being eaten
explanation: The main job of a flower is to make seeds so the plant can multiply; the nectar it offers bees is just a way to encourage them to help with pollination.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, ang bulaklak ay para lang pakainin ang bubuyog. Pero ang totoong trabaho ng bulaklak ay gumawa ng buto para dumami ang halaman! Ang nectar ay parang regalo lang para mahikayat ang bubuyog na tumulong.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga ang bulak para lang pakan-on ang putyukan. Apan ang tinuod nga trabaho sa bulak mao ang paghimo og liso aron modaghan ang tanom! Ang nectar murag gasa lang aron awhagon ang putyukan nga motabang.

q: How do you read the time on a sundial?
options: Look at which line the sharp edge of the shadow crosses.
Count how many lines the entire shadow covers.
Measure the length of the shadow from the base.
Read the number where the tip of the shadow points.
explanation: You read a sundial by finding which numbered line the sharp straight edge of the shadow crosses.
fact_tl: Hindi ang buong anino ang binabasa kundi ang tuwid na gilid nito. Tinitingnan mo kung aling numerong linya ang dinadaanan ng matalim na gilid ng anino para malaman ang oras.
fact_bis: Dili ang tibuok landong ang basahon kondili ang tul-id nga ngilit niini. Tan-awon nimo asa nga numerong badlis moagi ang hait nga ngilit sa landong aron mahibaloan ang oras.

q: Why is it risky to grow all your crops from cuttings or grafting?
options: All the plants are identical, so a disease that hits one can easily spread to all of them.
Cuttings grow more slowly than seeds, so yields are always lower.
Grafted plants cannot produce fruit, so they are only useful for shade.
Plants from cuttings have weaker roots that break in strong wind.
explanation: Plants from cuttings or grafting are genetically identical, so if one catches a disease the rest are equally vulnerable and can be wiped out together.
fact_tl: Dahil magkakapareho ang mga halamang galing sa cutting o grafting, kung tablan ng sakit ang isa, madaling tablan din ang lahat — wala silang pagkakaiba-iba.
fact_bis: Tungod kay pareho-pareho ang mga tanom gikan sa cutting o grafting, kung matakdan og sakit ang usa, dali ra pud matakdan ang tanan — wala silay kalainan.

q: How is a shrimp different from a person, dog, or bird when it comes to body temperature?
options: A shrimp is cold-blooded so its body temperature changes with the water around it.
A shrimp is warm-blooded so it keeps a steady body temperature like people do.
A shrimp has no body temperature because it lives underwater.
A shrimp switches between warm-blooded and cold-blooded depending on the season.
explanation: Unlike warm-blooded animals such as people, dogs, and birds, a shrimp is cold-blooded, meaning its body warmth changes with the surrounding water.
fact_tl: Ang tao, aso, at ibon ay mainit ang dugo kaya halos pareho lang ang init ng katawan nila kahit saan; ang hipon naman ay malamig ang dugo, kaya nagbabago ang init nito ayon sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tawo, iro, ug langgam init og dugo busa hapit managsama ra ang kainit sa ilang lawas bisan asa; ang hipon bugnaw og dugo, busa mausab ang kainit niini sumala sa tubig.

q: How do some tilapia protect their eggs from danger?
options: They keep the eggs inside their mouth until the baby fish hatch.
They bury the eggs deep in the river mud and guard the spot.
They attach the eggs to underwater plants with a sticky coat.
They carry the eggs in a pouch on their belly like a kangaroo.
explanation: Some tilapia are mouthbrooders — they keep their eggs inside their mouth to protect them until the baby fish hatch.
fact_tl: May mga isda tulad ng ilang tilapia na inaalagaan ang kanilang itlog sa loob ng kanilang bibig para protektahan ang mga ito hanggang mapisa ang maliliit na isda.
fact_bis: Adunay mga isda sama sa pipila ka tilapia nga nag-atiman sa ilang itlog sulod sa ilang baba aron panalipdan kini hangtod mapusa ang gagmay nga isda.

q: How do some volcanic islands form in the ocean?
options: Underwater volcanoes erupt, and lava builds up until it rises above the water's surface.
Earthquakes lift sections of the ocean floor above sea level.
Strong ocean currents pile up sand and rock until an island appears.
Coral reefs grow so thick they eventually become solid land above water.
explanation: Some islands form from volcanoes on the sea floor — lava erupts and cools, building up until the mound pokes above the water as an island.
fact_tl: May mga isla na nabuo mula sa mga bulkan sa ilalim ng dagat — habang umaapaw ang lava at lumalamig, unti-unti itong tumataas hanggang umusli ito sa ibabaw ng tubig bilang isla.
fact_bis: Adunay mga isla nga naporma gikan sa mga bulkan sa ilalom sa dagat — samtang mobuhagay ang lava ug mobugnaw, hinay-hinay kining motumpok hangtod motungha kini sa ibabaw sa tubig isip isla.

q: If you see a blue star in the night sky, what does its color tell you?
options: It is extremely hot — blue stars are the hottest kind.
It is very cool — blue means a star is losing heat quickly.
It is a young star that has not yet reached full brightness.
It is the same temperature as our yellow Sun.
explanation: Blue stars are the hottest stars; the color sequence from hottest to coolest goes blue, white, yellow, orange, and red.
fact_tl: Sa mga bituin, ang asul (blue) ang pinakamainit, sunod ang puti, tapos dilaw tulad ng Araw, tapos orange, at ang pula (red) ang pinakamalamig. Kaya kapag asul ang bituin, alam mong sobrang init niyon; kapag pula, mas malamig (pero mainit pa rin!).
fact_bis: Sa mga bituon, ang asul (blue) ang pinakainit, sunod ang puti, dayon dalag sama sa Adlaw, dayon orange, ug ang pula (red) ang pinakabugnaw. Mao nga kung asul ang bituon, init kaayo na; kung pula, mas bugnaw (apan init gihapon!).

q: Who invented the first pendulum clock, and when?
options: Christiaan Huygens made it in 1656.
Isaac Newton built it in 1687.
Galileo Galilei created it in 1602.
Benjamin Franklin designed it in 1752.
explanation: The first pendulum clock was made by Christiaan Huygens in the year 1656.
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Christiaan Huygens ang unang relong may palawit noong taong 1656.
fact_bis: Ang unang relo nga adunay palawit gihimo ni Christiaan Huygens niadtong tuig 1656.

q: What does the top of a wind turbine do to keep generating electricity efficiently?
options: It turns so the blades always face into the wind.
It adjusts the blade length depending on wind speed.
It tilts the whole tower toward the direction of the wind.
It locks in place once the strongest wind direction is detected.
explanation: The top of a wind turbine rotates so its blades always face into the wind, keeping it generating power efficiently.
fact_tl: Ang ulo ng turbina ay umiikot para laging nakaharap sa direksyon ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang ulo sa turbine moliso aron ang mga pako kanunay nag-atubang sa hangin.

q: What is tuba, and where does it come from?
options: Tuba is sweet coconut sap gathered from the unopened flower of the coconut tree, which ferments into a sour drink.
Tuba is a juice squeezed from ripe coconut meat and sweetened with sugar.
Tuba is water collected inside a mature coconut and left to ferment in sunlight.
Tuba is a cooked paste made from dried coconut and fermented rice.
explanation: Tuba is the sweet sap gathered from the unopened flower of the coconut tree; it becomes a drink when it ferments and turns sour.
fact_tl: Ang tuba ay katas na kinukuha mula sa hindi pa nabubukang bulaklak ng niyog, at kapag ito ay umasim sa pamamagitan ng fermentation ay nagiging inumin.
fact_bis: Ang tuba mao ang tam-is nga duga nga ginakuha gikan sa wala pa mabuka nga bulak sa lubi, ug mahimo kining ilimnon kung mo-aslom kini pinaagi sa fermentation.

q: What is the 'hanging habagat'?
options: When the habagat wind lingers for many days of nonstop rain, often causing flooding.
When a typhoon stalls over the Philippines and the winds become unusually still.
When the habagat suddenly reverses direction and brings dry weather.
When a cold front meets the habagat and produces heavy thunderstorms for one day.
explanation: The 'hanging habagat' is when the habagat (southwest wind) lingers for many days of nonstop rain, which often causes flooding in cities.
fact_tl: Kapag ang habagat ay tumagal nang maraming araw na walang tigil na ulan, tinatawag itong 'hanging habagat' at kadalasang nagdudulot ng baha sa mga lungsod.
fact_bis: Kung ang habagat magpadayon og daghang adlaw nga walay hunong nga ulan, gitawag kini nga 'hanging habagat,' ug kasagaran maoy hinungdan sa baha sa mga siyudad.

q: How do tropisms help a plant survive?
options: They direct leaves toward sunlight and roots toward water and soil.
They allow plants to move away from predators that try to eat them.
They help seeds travel long distances so new plants can grow far away.
They make flowers open and close to protect pollen from the rain.
explanation: Tropisms help a plant survive by directing leaves to get enough sunlight and roots to reach water and nutrients in the soil.
fact_tl: Ang mga tropism ay tumutulong sa halaman na mabuhay: dahil dito, nakukuha ng dahon ang sapat na sikat ng araw at naaabot ng ugat ang tubig at lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga tropism motabang sa tanom nga mabuhi: tungod niini, makakuha ang mga dahon og igong silaw sa adlaw ug makaabot ang gamot sa tubig ug yuta.

q: Why do many deep-sea animals move slowly, grow slowly, and live a very long time?
options: Because the deep sea is cold and food is scarce, so they conserve energy.
Because the high water pressure crushes their muscles and slows movement.
Because they spend most of their lives sleeping to save oxygen.
Because deep-sea water is thicker than surface water, making it harder to move.
explanation: The deep sea is cold and food is scarce, so many animals there move and grow slowly and can live a very long time.
fact_tl: Dahil malamig at kakaunti ang pagkain sa kailaliman, marami sa mga hayop doon ay mabagal kumilos, mabagal lumaki, at nabubuhay nang napakatagal.
fact_bis: Tungod kay bugnaw ug gamay ra ang pagkaon sa kalaliman, daghan sa mga mananap didto hinay molihok, hinay motubo, ug makabuhi og dugay kaayo.

q: What do the tamaraw and the Philippine eagle have in common?
options: Both prefer a solitary life and do not live in large groups.
Both are found only on the island of Palawan.
Both are endangered because of the same disease.
Both build nests in the same type of forest tree.
explanation: Like the Philippine eagle that keeps its own wide territory, the tamaraw also prefers a solitary life — neither lives in large groups.
fact_tl: Tulad ng Philippine eagle na may sariling malawak na teritoryo, ang tamaraw rin ay mas gusto ang mag-isang buhay — pareho silang hayop na hindi namumuhay sa malalaking grupo.
fact_bis: Sama sa Philippine eagle nga adunay kaugalingong lapad nga teritoryo, ang tamaraw usab mas gusto sa kinabuhi nga mag-inusara — silang duha mga hayop nga dili magpuyo sa dagkong grupo.

q: Which ancient civilization used hieroglyphs — a writing system made of pictures and symbols?
options: The ancient Egyptians
The ancient Greeks
The ancient Romans
The ancient Chinese
explanation: The ancient Egyptians used hieroglyphs, a writing system made of pictures and symbols.
fact_tl: Ang sinaunang mga taga-Ehipto (Egypt) ang gumamit ng hieroglyphs, isang sulat na gawa sa mga larawan at simbolo.
fact_bis: Ang karaang mga taga-Ehipto (Egypt) naggamit sa hieroglyphs, usa ka sinulat nga hinimo sa mga hulagway ug simbolo.

q: Why does a lightning rod protect a building during a thunderstorm?
options: Lightning's electricity flows through the metal rod and is guided safely into the ground.
The pointed metal tip pushes lightning clouds away from the building.
The metal reflects the lightning bolt back into the sky.
The rod absorbs the lightning bolt and stores the electricity for later use.
explanation: A metal lightning rod conducts electricity so well that lightning's electricity flows through it and is safely guided into the ground, away from the building.
fact_tl: May matulis na metal na patpat sa itaas ng ilang gusali na tinatawag na lightning rod. Dahil napakahusay ng metal magdala ng kuryente, kapag tumama ang kidlat, sa metal ito dumadaloy at ligtas na dinadala pababa sa lupa. Nililigtas nito ang gusali dahil pinipili ng kuryente ng kidlat ang madaling daanan—ang metal.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bilding adunay talinis nga metal nga olisi sa ibabaw nga gitawag og lightning rod. Tungod kay maayo kaayo ang metal modala sa kuryente, kung motama ang kilat, ang kuryente modagan sa metal ug luwas nga dad-on paubos sa yuta. Mapanalipdan niini ang bilding kay ang kuryente sa kilat mopili sa sayon nga agianan, ang metal.

q: What does the tail of a colasisi look like?
options: It is short and rounded.
It is long and pointed, like a parrot's tail.
It is split in the middle, like a fork.
It is bushy and fan-shaped, like a peacock's.
explanation: The colasisi has a short, rounded tail, not a long tail.
fact_tl: Ang kulasisi ay may maikli at bilog na buntot, hindi mahabang buntot.
fact_bis: Ang kulasisi adunay mubo ug lingin nga ikog, dili taas nga ikog.

q: Who is regarded as the first computer programmer in history?
options: Ada Lovelace
Marie Curie
Grace Hopper
Alan Turing
explanation: Ada Lovelace is regarded as the first computer programmer in history.
fact_tl: Si Ada Lovelace ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa kasaysayan.
fact_bis: Si Ada Lovelace ang giisip nga unang computer programmer sa kasaysayan.

q: Can inherited color blindness be cured?
options: No, it has no cure, but people learn to live well with it.
Yes, it can be corrected with special eye drops taken daily.
Yes, a simple laser eye surgery can fix inherited color blindness.
No, but it always gets worse over time and can lead to total blindness.
explanation: Inherited color blindness has no cure, though people learn to manage and live well with the condition.
fact_tl: Ang namanang color blindness ay walang gamot, ngunit natututo ang tao na mabuhay nang maayos kahit ganito.
fact_bis: Ang namana nga color blindness walay tambal, apan ang mga tawo makakat-on nga mabuhi og maayo bisan pa niini.

q: Why does your body shiver automatically when you feel cold?
options: Shivering helps make you warmer by generating heat.
Shivering pumps more blood to your skin to warm it up.
Shivering removes cold air from your lungs faster.
Shivering is a signal to the brain to find shelter.
explanation: When you feel cold, your body shivers automatically because the muscle movement of shivering generates heat and makes you warmer.
fact_tl: Kapag nilalamig ka, kusang nanginginig ang iyong katawan dahil ang panginig ay tumutulong magpainit sa iyo.
fact_bis: Kung tugnawon ka, kalit nga mokurog ang imong lawas kay ang pagkurog motabang sa pag-init kanimo.

q: Why do many Filipino families plant a calamansi tree in their backyard?
options: So they always have fresh calamansi fruit close at hand.
Because calamansi trees keep mosquitoes away from the house.
Because the government requires each home to grow one fruit tree.
So the tree's shade keeps the house cool during summer.
explanation: Filipino families often plant a calamansi tree in the backyard so they have fresh fruit readily available at home.
fact_tl: Madalas may itinanim na puno ng calamansi sa bakuran ang mga pamilyang Pilipino para may sariwang prutas.
fact_bis: Kanunay nagtanom og kahoy nga kalamansi sa natad ang mga pamilyang Pilipino aron naay presko nga prutas.

q: Why are children weighed before and during a school feeding program?
options: To find out who is underweight and to track whether they gain proper weight over time.
To make sure no child eats too much and gains unhealthy weight.
To calculate how much food the school cafeteria needs to prepare each day.
To compare the children's weight with national test score averages.
explanation: Children are weighed before and during feeding programs to identify who is underweight and to track whether they are gaining proper weight after months of the program.
fact_tl: Bago at habang tumatakbo ang feeding program, tinitimbang ang mga bata. Ginagawa ito para malaman kung sino ang kulang sa timbang at kailangang tumanggap ng pagkain, at para masubaybayan kung tumataba na sila nang husto pagkatapos ng ilang buwang programa.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa ug samtang nagdagan ang feeding program, gitimbang ang mga bata. Gibuhat kini aron mahibaloan kung kinsa ang kulang sa timbang ug nanginahanglan og pagkaon, ug aron masubay kung nagtambok na ba sila pag-ayo human sa pipila ka bulan nga programa.

q: What happens during budding in organisms like yeast and hydra?
options: A small copy grows out from the parent's body and eventually becomes independent.
The parent splits perfectly in half to form two equal new organisms.
The parent sheds its skin, which then grows into a new organism.
Two parents each donate a cell that joins together to form a new organism.
explanation: In budding, a small copy of the organism grows out from the parent's body and eventually breaks off to become an independent organism, as seen in yeast and hydra.
fact_tl: Sa budding, ang isang maliit na kopya ng organismo ay lumalabas mula sa katawan ng magulang at kalaunan ay nagiging sariling organismo, tulad ng yeast at hydra.
fact_bis: Sa budding, usa ka gamay nga kopya sa organismo namubo gikan sa lawas sa magulang ug sa katapusan nagiging independyenteng organismo, sama sa yeast ug hydra.

q: Why does PHIVOLCS create lahar hazard zone maps after a major volcanic eruption?
options: To show which rivers and valleys could be filled with mudflows so residents know when to evacuate during heavy rains.
To mark areas where lava is still flowing so people do not step on it.
To record the exact boundary of the ash fall so farmers know which fields are safe.
To identify hills strong enough to serve as evacuation centers for nearby towns.
explanation: After a major eruption, PHIVOLCS creates lahar hazard zone maps showing which rivers and valleys could be filled with mudflows, helping residents evacuate safely during heavy rains.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng isang malaking pagsabog ng bulkan, ang PHIVOLCS ay gumagawa ng mga lahar hazard zone map na nagpapakita ng mga ilog at lambak na maaaring lagyan ng mudflow; ang mga residente sa loob ng mga lugar na ito ay maaaring kailangan na lumipat sa panahon ng malakas na ulan nang ilang taon pagkatapos ng pagsabog.
fact_bis: Human sa usa ka dakong pagsabog sa bulkan, ang PHIVOLCS nagbuhat og mga lahar hazard zone map nga nagpakita kung asa mga suba ug lambak ang mahimong mapuno sa mudflows; ang mga residente sulod sa kini nga mga lugar mahimong kinahanglan mosibog panahon sa grabe nga ulan sulod sa daghang tuig human sa pagsabog.

q: When do wisdom teeth usually appear, and why might they need to be removed?
options: They emerge between ages 17 and 25 and may need removal if there is not enough space in the jaw.
They appear around age 7, alongside the first permanent teeth, and rarely need removal.
They grow in at age 12 to 14 and are removed because they cause cavities in nearby teeth.
They emerge before age 10 and are removed to make room for the permanent molars.
explanation: Wisdom teeth are the last teeth to appear, usually between ages 17 and 25, and sometimes need to be removed because they lack space in the jaw.
fact_tl: Ang mga wisdom teeth (ikatlong molars) ay ang huling ngipin na lumalabas, karaniwang sa pagitan ng 17 at 25 taong gulang; minsan ay wala itong sapat na espasyo sa panga at kailangan ng operasyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga wisdom teeth (ikatlong molar) mao ang katapusang ngipon nga mogawas, kasagarang tali sa 17 ug 25 ka tuig; usahay wala'y igo nga luna sa panga ug kinahanglang tangtangon.

q: What does it mean when we say metals are 'sonorous'?
options: They make a clear ringing sound when struck, like a bell.
They can carry electrical current through a circuit.
They are shiny and reflect light from their surface.
They can be stretched into thin wires without breaking.
explanation: Metals are sonorous, meaning they produce a clear ringing sound when struck, just like a bell.
fact_tl: Ang metal ay sonorous, ibig sabihin gumagawa ito ng malinaw na tunog kapag tinamaan, gaya ng kampana.
fact_bis: Ang metal sonorous, buot ipasabot motingog kini ug klaro kon bunalan, sama sa kampana.

q: What is capillary action?
options: The way water climbs up narrow spaces or tubes without anything pumping it.
The process by which water evaporates from the surface of leaves.
The force that pulls water downward into the roots of a plant.
The way water molecules cling together to form large drops.
explanation: Capillary action is the way water climbs up narrow spaces or tubes on its own, which is why water rises into paper, soil, and plants.
fact_tl: Ang capillary action ay ang pag-akyat ng tubig sa makikitid na puwang o tubo kahit walang bumubomba dito. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit umaakyat ang tubig sa papel, lupa, at mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang capillary action mao ang pagsaka sa tubig sa pig-ot nga mga lungag o tubo bisan walay nagbomba niini. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong mosaka ang tubig sa papel, yuta, ug mga tanom.

q: A tow truck uses an electric winch to pull a stuck car free. What simple machine is a winch?
options: A wheel and axle
A lever
A pulley
An inclined plane
explanation: A winch is a wheel and axle — the motor spins a drum (the axle) that winds up a cable, pulling the vehicle free.
fact_tl: Ang electric winch na ginagamit para hilahin ang mga sasakyang natigil sa putik ay isang wheel at axle: ang motor ay nagpapaikot ng drumm na nagpupulot ng cable na humihila sa sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang electric winch nga gamiton sa pag-recover sa mga sasakyan nga natigil sa putik usa ka wheel ug axle: ang motor nagpapin sa drum (axle) nga nagpundag sa cable (lubid), nagbitad sa sasakyan nga libre.

q: Why is copper wire so commonly used to carry electricity in homes?
options: It has many free electrons that move easily when electricity flows
It is the heaviest metal so it holds more charge
Its atoms are tightly packed so electricity cannot escape
It gets very hot and that pushes the current forward
explanation: Copper has many 'free electrons' that are not tightly held by their atoms, so they drift along easily when electricity flows.
fact_tl: Bakit napakahusay ng tanso sa pagdadala ng kuryente? Sa loob ng tanso, may napakaraming maliliit na 'malayang elektron' na hindi nakakabit nang mahigpit sa kanilang mga atomo. Kaya kapag may kuryente, madali silang gumagalaw at dumadaloy parang tubig sa tubo.
fact_bis: Ngano nga maayo kaayo ang tumbaga sa pagdala og kuryente? Sa sulod sa tumbaga adunay daghang gagmay nga 'gawasnon nga electron' nga dili hugot nga gigunitan sa ilang mga atomo. Busa kung adunay kuryente, sayon ra silang molihok ug modagayday.

q: Which two planets in our solar system have no moons at all?
options: Mercury and Venus
Venus and Mars
Mercury and Mars
Earth and Mercury
explanation: Mercury and Venus are the only two planets in the solar system that have no moons.
fact_tl: Ang Mercury at Venus ang dalawang planetang walang buwan.
fact_bis: Ang Mercury ug Venus mao ang duha ka planeta nga walay bulan.

q: Which small part of the brain monitors body temperature and water levels to keep the body in balance?
options: The hypothalamus
The cerebellum
The medulla oblongata
The pituitary gland
explanation: The hypothalamus monitors temperature, water, and other levels and orders the right responses to keep balance in the body.
fact_tl: Ang hypothalamus, isang maliit na bahagi ng utak, ang nagbabantay sa temperatura, tubig, at iba pang antas, at nag-uutos ng tamang tugon para mapanatili ang balanse.
fact_bis: Ang hypothalamus, usa ka gamay nga bahin sa utok, mao ang nagbantay sa temperatura, tubig, ug uban pang lebel, ug nagmando sa hustong tubag aron mahuptan ang balanse.

q: What protects the soft brain inside your head?
options: The hard skull and a thin fluid around the brain
A layer of muscle surrounding the brain
Thick skin on the scalp and the spine
Cartilage inside the head that cushions impacts
explanation: The brain is protected by the hard skull and a thin fluid around it, which is also why helmets are worn when riding a bike.
fact_tl: Sapagkat napakahalaga at malambot ng utak, pinoprotektahan ito ng matigas na bungo (skull) at ng manipis na likido sa palibot nito. Kaya rin tayo nagsusuot ng helmet kapag nagbibisikleta.
fact_bis: Tungod kay importante kaayo ug humok ang utok, gipanalipdan kini sa gahing bagol-bagol (skull) ug sa nipis nga likido sa palibot niini. Mao sab nga magsul-ob tag helmet kon magbisikleta.

q: A refrigerator moves heat from the cold inside to the warmer room outside. What does this require?
options: Energy input, because this is against the natural direction of heat flow
No energy, because cold air naturally flows outward
Gravity, which pulls the heat downward and out
Only insulation, which forces heat to move the wrong way
explanation: A heat pump moves heat from a cooler place to a warmer one — against the natural direction — which requires work (energy input).
fact_tl: Ang heat pump (tulad ng aircon at ref) ay gumagamit ng trabaho para ilipat ang init mula sa mas malamig patungo sa mas mainit na lugar — ito ay laban sa natural na direksyon ng heat flow at kailangan ng energy.
fact_bis: Ang heat pump (sama sa aircon ug ref) naggamit og trabaho sa pagbalhin sa init gikan sa mas mabugnaw ngadto sa mas mainit nga lugar — kini supak sa natural nga direksyon sa heat flow ug nagkinahanglan og input nga enerhiya.

q: A forest can support a certain number of deer. Which statement about that limit is correct?
options: The limit changes depending on food, weather, and the condition of the forest
The limit is a fixed number that never changes no matter what
The limit only changes when a new predator enters the forest
The limit stays the same as long as the deer do not leave
explanation: Carrying capacity is not a fixed number; it changes depending on food, weather, and the condition of the place.
fact_tl: Ang carrying capacity ay hindi pirmihang bilang; nagbabago ito depende sa pagkain, panahon, at kalagayan ng lugar.
fact_bis: Ang carrying capacity dili pirmi nga numero; mausab kini depende sa pagkaon, panahon, ug kahimtang sa lugar.

q: Some Philippine tree frogs protect their eggs by building what kind of nest?
options: A foam nest on branches or leaves hanging over water
A mud nest buried underground near a river
A leafy nest high up in the canopy away from water
A rock nest beside a mountain stream
explanation: Some Philippine frog species, such as tree frogs, build foam nests on branches or leaves hanging over water to protect their eggs.
fact_tl: Ang ilang uri ng palaka sa Pilipinas, tulad ng mga tree frog, ay nagtatayo ng foam nest sa mga sanga ng puno o mga dahon na nakabitin sa ibabaw ng tubig para pangalagaan ang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka klase sa palaka sa Pilipinas, sama sa tree frog, nagtukod og foam nest sa mga sanga o dahon nga nabitay sa ibabaw sa tubig aron mapanalipdan ang mga itlog.

q: The Philippines is part of an ocean area called the Coral Triangle. What makes this region special?
options: It has the most kinds of coral in the world
It has the deepest ocean trench on Earth
It is the only place where coral reefs can grow
It is surrounded by the warmest ocean currents
