It thickens the outer skin layer so UV rays cannot pass through at all.
explanation: Melanin works like tiny umbrellas inside skin cells — it absorbs the sun's harmful UV rays before they can damage the cell's inner parts.
fact_tl: Ang melanin sa balat ay parang maliliit na payong sa loob ng mga selula — sinasalo nito ang mapanganib na UV mula sa araw bago ito makasira sa loob ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang melanin sa panit sama sa gagmay nga payong sulod sa mga selula — masuyop niini ang delikado nga UV gikan sa adlaw sa dili pa kini makadaot sa sulod sa selula.

q: Who was the longest-serving President of the Philippines, serving from 1965 to 1986?
options: Ferdinand Marcos Sr., the tenth President
Manuel Quezon, the second President
Ramon Magsaysay, the seventh President
Corazon Aquino, the eleventh President
explanation: Ferdinand Marcos Sr. was the longest-serving President (1965 to 1986) and the tenth President of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Si Ferdinand Marcos Sr. ang pinakamatagal na naglingkod na Pangulo (1965–1986), ang ikasampung Pangulo.
fact_bis: Si Ferdinand Marcos Sr. mao ang labing dugay nga naglingkod nga Presidente (1965–1986), ang ikanapulo nga Presidente.

q: Among which groups in the Philippines is betel chewing an ancient tradition?
options: Especially among indigenous communities
Only among fishermen living along the coasts
Only among traders and merchants in urban centers
Especially among Catholic religious orders
explanation: Betel chewing is an ancient tradition in the Philippines, especially among indigenous communities.
fact_tl: Ang pagnganga ng bunga ay isang sinaunang tradisyon sa Pilipinas, lalo na sa mga katutubong pamayanan.
fact_bis: Ang panginganga ug bunga usa ka karaang tradisyon sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa mga lumad nga komunidad.

q: What does it usually mean when a dog wags its tail?
options: The dog is happy or excited
The dog is hungry and wants food
The dog is about to fall asleep
The dog is feeling sick
explanation: A dog often wags its tail when it is happy or excited.
fact_tl: Madalas na kinakawag ng aso ang kanyang buntot kapag ito ay masaya o nasasabik.
fact_bis: Kasagaran ipalihok sa iro ang iyang ikog kung kini malipayon o naghinamhinam.

q: Why does the center of a compost pile get hot?
options: Microbes working hard release heat as they break down material
Sunlight concentrates at the center of the pile
The rotting food releases stored sunlight
Worms generate body heat as they tunnel through the pile
explanation: As microbes work hard breaking down organic material, their activity heats up the center of a compost pile.
fact_tl: Habang masigla ang mga mikrobyo, umiinit ang gitnang bahagi ng compost pile dahil sa kanilang gawain.
fact_bis: Samtang kugihan ang mga mikrobyo, moinit ang tunga sa compost pile gumikan sa ilang buhat.

q: Why do bees store honey in the honeycomb?
options: So they have food when flowers are scarce
To keep the hive smelling sweet
To attract more bees to the colony
To make the honeycomb walls stronger
explanation: Bees store honey in the honeycomb so they have food available when flowers are scarce.
fact_tl: Iniimbak ng mga bubuyog ang pulot sa honeycomb upang may makain sila kapag kaunti na ang bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mga putyukan magtipig sa dugos sa honeycomb aron adunay makaon sila kon gamay na ang mga bulak.

q: How do decomposers help close the food web?
options: They return nutrients from dead organisms back to the soil for plants to use again
They eat the top predators, limiting the food chain
They produce seeds that grow into new producer plants
They convert sunlight into sugar that other organisms eat
explanation: Decomposers close the food web by returning to the soil the nutrients that producer plants will use again.
fact_tl: Sinasara ng mga decomposer ang food web dahil ibinabalik nila sa lupa ang sustansyang muling gagamitin ng mga producer na halaman.
fact_bis: Gisirad-an sa mga decomposer ang food web kay ilang ibalik sa yuta ang sustansya nga gamiton pag-usab sa mga producer nga tanom.

q: What is one important job that some bones in your body do?
options: They act like hard armor to protect the soft organs inside
They make the body lighter so you can move faster
They store extra food energy for later use
They send signals to the brain when you touch something
explanation: Some bones act like hard armor that protects the soft organs inside our body.
fact_tl: Ang ilang buto ay matigas na panangga na nagpoprotekta sa malalambot na bahagi ng loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bukog murag gahi nga taming nga nagpanalipod sa humok nga mga bahin sa sulod sa atong lawas.

q: What does an organism's ecological niche describe?
options: Its specific role in an ecosystem — what it eats, where it lives, and when it is active
The total area of land that it covers in an ecosystem
The number of offspring it can produce each year
Its position in the food chain based only on what eats it
explanation: An ecological niche is an organism's specific role in an ecosystem, including what it eats, where it lives, and when it is active.
fact_tl: Ang ecological niche ay ang espesipikong papel ng isang organismo sa ekosistema — kasama ang uri ng pagkain nito, kung saan ito nakatira, at kung kailan ito aktibo.
fact_bis: Ang ecological niche mao ang espesipikong papel sa usa ka organismo sa ekosistema — lakip ang iyang pagkaon, kung asa kini nagpuyo, ug kung kanus-a kini aktibo.

q: What is the difference between neutralization and dilution of an acid?
options: Dilution just adds water to weaken the acid, while neutralization adds a base that actually changes the acid into salt and water
Dilution removes the acid completely, while neutralization only weakens it
Neutralization adds more acid to balance pH, while dilution adds a base
Dilution and neutralization are two names for the same process
explanation: When you dilute an acid you only add water making it weaker but still acid; neutralization uses a base that chemically changes the acid into salt and water.
fact_tl: Madalas na napagkakamalan: hindi pareho ang neutralization at dilution. Kapag nag-dilute ka, dinadagdagan mo lang ng tubig ang asido para humina — pero asido pa rin ito. Sa neutralization, nagdadagdag ka ng base na nagpapabago talaga sa asido, kaya nagiging asin at tubig ito. Iba ang basta-pinanipis sa tunay na pinawalang-bisa.
fact_bis: Kasagaran masaypan: dili parehas ang neutralization ug dilution. Kung mag-dilute ka, magdugang lang ka og tubig aron mohuyang ang asido — pero asido gihapon. Sa neutralization, magdugang ka og base nga tinuod nga mag-usab sa asido, mao nga mahimo kining asin ug tubig. Lahi ang pagpaluya pinaagi sa tubig sa tinuod nga pagwagtang.

q: Where in the Philippines can you find the tamaraw?
options: Only on the island of Mindoro
Only on the island of Palawan
Only on the island of Cebu
Only on the island of Mindanao
explanation: The tamaraw is a small buffalo found only on the island of Mindoro in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ay isang maliit na kalabaw na matatagpuan lamang sa isla ng Mindoro sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw usa ka gamay nga kalabaw nga makit-an lang sa isla sa Mindoro sa Pilipinas.

q: Which set of signs is most closely associated with asthma?
options: Repeated coughing, tight chest, shortness of breath, and wheezing
High fever, body aches, runny nose, and sore throat
Itchy rash on the skin, watery eyes, and sneezing
Stomach pain, vomiting, and loss of appetite
explanation: Signs of asthma include repeated coughing, a tight feeling in the chest, shortness of breath, and a wheezing sound when breathing.
fact_tl: Ilang palatandaan ng hika ay paulit-ulit na ubo, masikip na pakiramdam sa dibdib, hingal, at humihinging tunog sa paghinga.
fact_bis: Pipila ka timailhan sa hubak mao ang balikbalik nga ubo, masikip nga pamati sa dughan, kapos sa ginhawa, ug nagsipol nga tunog kung magginhawa.

q: About how long can a single plastic bottle last before it fully breaks down?
options: Hundreds of years
About five to ten years
Around fifty years
Just a few months
explanation: A single plastic bottle can last hundreds of years before it fully breaks down.
fact_tl: Ang isang plastik na bote ay maaaring tumagal ng daan-daang taon bago ganap na masira.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka botelyang plastik mahimong molungtad og gatusan ka tuig una kini hingpit nga maguba.

q: Which Philippine region is described as a wide, fertile valley and one of the main rice and corn farming areas, with the country's longest river flowing through it?
options: Cagayan Valley in northern Luzon
Ilocos Region in western Luzon
Bicol Region in southern Luzon
Caraga Region in northeastern Mindanao
explanation: Cagayan Valley in northern Luzon is a wide and fertile valley that is one of the main rice and corn farming areas; the Cagayan River, the country's longest, flows through it.
fact_tl: Ang Cagayan Valley sa hilagang Luzon ay isang malawak at mayabong na lambak na isa sa mga pangunahing lugar ng pagsasaka ng palay at mais sa Pilipinas; dumadaloy dito ang pinakamahaba nitong ilog, ang Cagayan River.
fact_bis: Ang Cagayan Valley sa amihananong Luzon usa ka halapad ug mayabong nga lambak nga usa sa pangunahing lugar sa pagsasaka sa humay ug mais sa Pilipinas; ang pinakamahaba nga ilog, ang Cagayan, nagdagayday niini.

q: Why is curry powder considered a mixture rather than a pure substance?
options: It is made of many different spices that are not chemically combined
All its spices react together to form one new ingredient
It looks like a pure powder so it must be a single substance
The spices in it cannot be separated once blended
explanation: A spice blend like curry powder is a mixture because it is made of many different spices that are not chemically combined.
fact_tl: Ang halong panimpla tulad ng curry powder ay isang mixture ng maraming iba't ibang rekado.
fact_bis: Ang sagol nga panakot sama sa curry powder usa ka mixture sa daghang lain-laing rekado.

q: What makes water in an artesian well rise to the surface without a pump?
options: It is trapped under pressure between two tight rock layers, so it shoots up when drilled
The well is dug on a hillside so gravity pulls the water upward
Underground heat boils the water and pushes it to the surface
The water is connected to a deep ocean current that forces it up
explanation: Water in a confined aquifer is squeezed under pressure between two tight rock layers; when a well is drilled into it, the pressure pushes the water up on its own — this is an artesian well.
fact_tl: May groundwater na nakulong sa pagitan ng dalawang masikip na layer ng bato, tinatawag na confined aquifer. Dahil naipit ito at may presyon, kapag binutasan, kusang sumisirit pataas ang tubig nang hindi na kailangan ng pump. Ito ang tinatawag na artesian well.
fact_bis: Adunay groundwater nga nabilanggo tunga sa duha ka sikit nga layer sa bato, gitawag og confined aquifer. Tungod kay napiit kini ubos sa presyon, kung imong tusokon mogawas ang tubig nga mag-isa nga dili na magkinahanglan og pump. Gitawag ni og artesian well.

q: How is the paddle of a kayak different from the paddle of a canoe?
options: A kayak paddle has a blade on each end, while a canoe paddle has only one blade
A canoe paddle has a blade on each end, while a kayak paddle has only one blade
Both have a blade on each end but the kayak blade is much larger
Both have a single blade but the kayak blade faces sideways
explanation: A kayak uses a paddle with a blade on each end so the paddler can stroke right then left without changing grip, while a canoe uses a single-blade paddle.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa bangka ginagamit ang sagwan. Ang canoe ay sinasagwan ng sagwan na may iisang blade, habang ang kayak ay gumagamit ng sagwan na may blade sa magkabilang dulo, kaya kaya mong sumagwan sa kanan at kaliwa nang halili nang hindi pinapalitan ang hawak. Pareho silang umaandar sa parehong prinsipyo ng pagtulak sa tubig.
fact_bis: Dili lang sa bangka gamiton ang bugsay. Ang canoe gibugsay ug usa ka blade nga bugsay, samtang ang kayak naggamit ug bugsay nga adunay blade sa duha ka tumoy, busa makahatak ka sa tuo unya sa wala nga dili usbon ang kupot. Pareho silang molihok sa samang prinsipyo sa pagtulak sa tubig.

q: Why is pako (fiddlehead fern) often blanched or briefly boiled before eating?
options: To make it safer and more tender
To add a sour flavor that improves taste
To turn it from green to yellow so it looks more appetizing
To destroy the nutrients that cause allergies
explanation: Pako is often blanched or briefly cooked in boiling water before eating to make it safer and more tender.
fact_tl: Ang pako ay madalas binabanlian o niluluto muna sa kumukulong tubig bago kainin para mas ligtas at malambot.
fact_bis: Ang pako kasagarang banlian o lutoon usa sa nagbukal nga tubig una kan-on aron mas luwas ug humok.

q: Why do people sometimes touch the metal of their car before handling the fuel nozzle at a gas station?
options: To drain their static electric charge so a spark does not ignite gasoline vapor
To check whether the car's fuel cap is loose before refueling
To cool down the metal so the fuel cap is easier to open
To start a small spark that tests whether the pump is working
explanation: Gasoline vapor catches fire easily, so touching the car metal first drains the static charge and prevents a spark that could start a flame.
fact_tl: Sa gasolinahan, may babala na mag-ingat sa static spark. Ang singaw ng gasolina ay madaling masunog, kaya kahit maliit na spark ay pwedeng magdulot ng apoy. Kaya minsan hinihipo muna ng tao ang metal ng kotse para mawala ang charge bago humawak sa gasolina.
fact_bis: Sa gasolinahan, naay pahimangno nga mag-amping sa static spark. Ang aso sa gasolina dali ra masunog, busa bisan gamay nga spark mahimong magsugod ug kalayo. Mao nga usahay hikapon una sa tawo ang metal sa sakyanan aron mawala ang charge una mokuha sa gasolina.

q: What electric charge does a neutron carry?
options: No charge — it is neutral
A positive charge
A negative charge
A charge that changes depending on its energy
explanation: A neutron has no electric charge, so it is called neutral.
fact_tl: Ang neutron ay walang electric charge, kaya tinatawag itong neutral.
fact_bis: Ang neutron walay elektrik nga charge, mao nga gitawag kini nga neutral.

q: If you squeeze a gas into a smaller container (keeping temperature constant), what happens to its pressure according to Boyle's law?
options: The pressure increases because volume and pressure have an inverse relationship
The pressure decreases along with the volume
The pressure stays exactly the same regardless of volume
The pressure doubles only if the volume is cut in half at high temperatures
explanation: Boyle's law states that pressure and volume have an inverse relationship — when volume goes down, pressure goes up.
fact_tl: Ang relasyon sa Batas ni Boyle ay inverse (baliktad): kapag tumaas ang isa, bumababa ang isa.
fact_bis: Ang relasyon sa Balaod ni Boyle baliktad (inverse): kung mosaka ang usa, mokunhod ang lain.

q: Why does sound travel faster in warmer air than in cold air?
options: Warmer air particles move faster and pass vibrations along more quickly
Warmer air is thinner, giving sound less resistance to push through
Sound waves heat up as they travel, which makes them move faster
Warm air molecules are heavier, so they carry more energy per vibration
explanation: Sound travels faster in warmer air because warmer air particles move faster and pass vibrations along more quickly.
fact_tl: Kapag mas mainit ang hangin, mas mabilis ang tunog — dahil ang mas mainit na mga particle ay mas mabilis gumagalaw at mas mabilis na nagsasalin ng vibration.
fact_bis: Ang tunog mas dali sa mas mainit nga hangin tungod kay ang mas mainit nga mga particle mas dali mobalhin ug mas dali magpadala sa vibration.

q: Why do scientists and governments protect apex predators like sharks and eagles?
options: Because losing them would upset the balance of the whole ecosystem
Because they are the most beautiful animals in their habitat
Because they eat only invasive species that damage crops
Because they can only survive in protected areas and nowhere else
explanation: Sharks and eagles are protected because losing apex predators would upset the balance of the sea or forest that also provides food and livelihoods.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga siyentista at gobyerno ang kaalaman tungkol sa apex predator para alagaan ang kalikasan. Halimbawa, pinoprotektahan ang mga pating at agila dahil alam nilang kung mawawala ang mga ito, magugulo ang balanse ng dagat o gubat na pinagkukunan din ng pagkain at hanapbuhay ng tao.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa mga syentista ug gobyerno ang kahibalo bahin sa apex predator aron atimanon ang kinaiyahan. Pananglitan, gipanalipdan ang mga iho ug agila kay nahibalo sila nga kon mawala kini, magubot ang timbang sa dagat o lasang nga gigikanan usab sa pagkaon ug panginabuhi sa tawo.

q: What does a solar tracker do to improve the output of solar panels?
options: It slowly rotates the panels to keep them facing the Sun throughout the day
It cleans dust off the panels automatically after rainfall
It stores extra electricity in batteries when the Sun is too strong
It tilts the panels away from the Sun during peak hours to prevent overheating
explanation: A solar tracker rotates solar panels to keep them facing the Sun, which can increase panel output by 20–40% compared to fixed panels.
fact_tl: Ang solar tracker ay isang device na unti-unting inililipat ang mga solar panel para palaging nakaharap sa Araw — ang mga tracker na ito ay maaaring magpataas ng output ng panel ng 20–40% kumpara sa nakapirming panel.
fact_bis: Ang solar tracker usa ka device nga hinay-hinay nagpalikot sa mga solar panel aron palagi silang nakaatubang sa Adlaw — ang mga tracker makapataas sa output sa panel ug 20–40% kumpara sa naayos nga panel.

q: Why is a year on Mars longer than a year on Earth?
options: Mars is farther from the Sun and takes longer to orbit it
Mars spins more slowly on its axis, making each day longer
Mars has stronger gravity that slows down its movement through space
Mars has two moons that pull it in opposite directions, slowing its orbit
explanation: A year on Mars is longer than a year on Earth because Mars is farther from the Sun and takes longer to complete its orbit.
fact_tl: Mas mahaba ang isang taon sa Mars kaysa sa Mundo dahil mas malayo ito sa Araw at mas matagal umikot.
fact_bis: Mas taas ang usa ka tuig sa Mars kaysa sa Yuta tungod kay mas layo kini sa Adlaw ug mas dugay molibot.

q: Why does the Moon turn reddish during a total lunar eclipse?
options: Earth's atmosphere bends sunlight and only red light reaches the Moon
The Moon's surface glows red when it is completely in Earth's shadow
Red light from the Sun bounces off the ocean and lights the Moon
The Moon reflects the red color of clouds covering part of Earth
explanation: During a total lunar eclipse, the Moon turns reddish because light bending through Earth's atmosphere filters out other colors, allowing only red light to reach the Moon.
fact_tl: Sa total lunar eclipse, nagiging mapula ang Buwan dahil ang liwanag na dumadaan sa hangin ng Daigdig ay namumula, kaya tinatawag itong blood moon.
fact_bis: Sa total lunar eclipse, mapula ang Bulan kay ang kahayag nga moagi sa hangin sa Kalibutan mapula, mao nga gitawag kini og blood moon.

q: Which group of metals is strongly attracted to a magnet?
options: Iron and nickel
Gold and silver
Aluminum and copper
Silver and platinum
explanation: Only iron, nickel, and a few similar metals feel a strong magnetic force; metals like gold, silver, and aluminum are not attracted.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng metal ay nahihila ng magnet. Ang bakal, nikel, at ilang katulad nito lang ang nakakaramdam ng malakas na puwersa; ang ginto, pilak, at aluminum ay hindi nahihila.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga metal mabira sa magnet. Ang puthaw, nikel, ug pipila ka susama lang ang makabati sa kusog nga gahum; ang bulawan, plata, ug aluminum dili mabira.

q: How does rattan manage to climb up toward sunlight in a forest?
options: Its long stems covered with sharp spines and hooks grab onto other trees
Its roots grow upward and attach to the trunks of tall trees
It produces sticky sap that glues its stems to nearby branches
Its leaves are shaped like grappling hooks that latch onto bark
explanation: Rattan climbs using long whip-like stems covered with sharp spines and hooks that grab onto other trees so the plant can reach sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang uway ay umaakyat gamit ang mahahabang sanga na may matutulis na tinik at kaw-it; kumakapit ang mga ito sa ibang puno para makaakyat ito patungo sa liwanag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang uway mosaka pinaagi sa tag-as nga mga sanga nga puno sa hait nga tunok ug kaw-it; kini mokapyot sa ubang kahoy aron makasaka kini paingon sa kahayag sa adlaw.

q: What is the difference between cement and concrete?
options: Cement is just the powder ingredient, while concrete is the whole hardened mix
Cement is stronger than concrete because it is made without water
Concrete is pure powder and cement is the liquid version mixed with water
They are two names for the exact same building material
explanation: Cement and concrete are not the same: cement is just the powder ingredient, while concrete is the whole hardened mix that includes cement, water, sand, and gravel.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang semento at konkreto: ang semento ay pulbos lang na isang sangkap, samantalang ang konkreto ang buong tigas na halo.
fact_bis: Lahi ang semento ug konkreto: ang semento pulbos lang nga usa ka sangkap, samtang ang konkreto mao ang tibuok gahi nga sagol.

q: Can you catch an allergy or asthma from someone who has it?
options: No — allergies and asthma are not contagious
Yes — you can catch them by sharing food or drinks
Yes — being near someone who sneezes can spread allergies
Yes — but only if you already have a cold at the same time
explanation: Allergies and asthma are not contagious, so you cannot catch them from another person.
fact_tl: Hindi nakakahawa ang allergy at hika, kaya hindi ka mahahawa nito mula sa ibang tao.
fact_bis: Ang allergy ug asma dili makatakod, mao nga dili ka matakdan niini gikan sa ubang tawo.

q: Where do most earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur?
options: Along the edges where tectonic plates meet
In the centers of large continents far from the ocean
Directly below the deepest parts of the ocean only
At the poles where the Earth's crust is thinnest
explanation: Earthquakes and volcanic eruptions happen most often along the edges where tectonic plates meet.
fact_tl: Sa mga gilid kung saan nagtatagpo ang mga tectonic plate ay madalas mangyari ang mga lindol at pagputok ng bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang mga linog ug pagbuto sa bulkan kanunay mahitabo sa mga ngilit diin magtagbo ang mga tectonic plate.

q: In what year did Tubbataha Reefs become a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
explanation: Tubbataha Reefs was made a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1993.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha Reefs ay ginawang UNESCO World Heritage Site noong 1993.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha Reefs gihimong UNESCO World Heritage Site niadtong 1993.

q: What do gut bacteria help your body do?
options: Break down certain foods like fiber that your own body cannot digest on its own
Produce the enzymes your stomach uses to dissolve protein
Carry oxygen from the lungs to the cells in your intestines
Filter harmful chemicals out of the food before it enters the blood
explanation: Gut bacteria help us break down certain foods our own body cannot digest, such as fiber.
fact_tl: Tinutulungan tayo ng gut bacteria na matunaw ang ilang pagkaing hindi kayang tunawin ng ating katawan, gaya ng hibla.
fact_bis: Ang gut bacteria nagatabang kanato sa pagtunaw sa pipila ka pagkaon nga dili matunaw sa atong lawas, sama sa lanot.

q: Why does a secondary (second) rainbow have its colors in reverse order compared to the first?
options: Light reflects twice inside each raindrop before coming out, reversing the color order
The second rainbow forms from a different type of water droplet that bends light backward
The second rainbow is a reflection of the first rainbow in a flat body of water
Cooler air near the ground bends light the opposite way from warm air above
explanation: The second rainbow has reversed colors because light reflects twice inside each raindrop before coming out, flipping the color order.
fact_tl: Kung minsan may pangalawang mas malabong bahaghari sa labas ng una, at baligtad ang pagkakasunod ng kulay nito dahil ang liwanag ay nagsalamin nang dalawang beses sa loob ng bawat patak ng ulan bago lumabas.
fact_bis: Usahay adunay ikaduha, mas hanap nga balangaw sa gawas sa una, ug balit-ad ang pagkasunod sa kolor niini kay ang kahayag misalamin og kaduha sulod sa matag tulo sa ulan una migawas.

q: Why do parasites usually avoid killing their host quickly?
options: Because the parasite needs the host alive to keep getting food and shelter
Because parasites are too weak to cause serious harm to larger animals
Because killing the host would alert nearby animals to avoid the parasite
Because parasites only feed on dead cells so they cannot kill living tissue
explanation: A parasite usually does not kill its host quickly because it needs the host alive to keep getting food and shelter.
fact_tl: Karaniwang hindi agad pinapatay ng parasito ang host nito dahil kailangan nito ang host na buhay para magpatuloy na makakuha ng pagkain at tirahan.
fact_bis: Kasagaran dili dayon patyon sa parasito ang host niini, kay kinahanglan niini nga buhi ang host aron magpadayon sa pagkuha ug pagkaon ug puy-anan.

q: Why is commensalism sometimes difficult for scientists to confirm?
options: It is hard to prove there is truly zero effect on the host, so a tiny undetected effect may exist
Two species can never share a habitat without one eventually harming the other
Scientists cannot observe animal relationships without changing them by being present
The host always shows some benefit, making it impossible to separate from mutualism
explanation: It is hard to prove there is truly zero effect on the host, so commensalism may hide a tiny effect that scientists have not yet measured.
fact_tl: Mahirap patunayan na talagang walang epekto sa isa, kaya minsan ang commensalism ay maliit lang na epekto na hindi pa natutukoy ng mga siyentipiko—pero sa pinag-aaralan, itinuturing itong neutral.
fact_bis: Lisod pamatud-an nga wala gyud epekto sa host, mao nga usahay ang commensalism adunay gamay nga epekto nga wala pa masukod sa mga siyentista—apan sa pagtuon, giisip kini nga neutral.

q: What happens when the air resistance on a falling object grows large enough to balance gravity?
options: The object stops speeding up and falls at a constant speed called terminal velocity
The object begins to slow down and eventually stops in midair
The object speeds up even faster because the forces push it together
The object's weight increases until gravity pulls it down faster
explanation: When air resistance balances gravity on a falling object, it stops accelerating and falls at a steady speed called terminal velocity.
fact_tl: Kapag may bagay na bumabagsak sa hangin, hindi ito basta-basta bumibilis nang walang hangganan. Sa simula ay bumibilis ito, pero unti-unting tumataas ang hatak ng hangin laban dito hanggang sa magbalanse. Sa puntong iyon, hindi na ito bumibilis pa—tinatawag itong terminal velocity, kaya hindi nakakamatay ang patak ng ulan.
fact_bis: Kung adunay butang nga mahulog sa hangin, dili kini basta mopaspas nga walay kataposan. Sa sinugdan mopaspas kini, apan hinay-hinay nga motaas ang duso sa hangin batok niini hangtod nga mobalanse. Niana nga punto dili na kini mopaspas pa—gitawag kini nga terminal velocity, mao nga ang tulo sa ulan dili makasakit.

q: What traditional remedy is made from boiled guava leaves?
options: A drink used to treat diarrhea or an upset stomach
A paste applied to the skin to cure insect bites
A steam inhaled to relieve a blocked nose
A tea drunk to lower fever quickly
explanation: A drink made from boiled guava leaves is used as a traditional remedy for diarrhea or an upset stomach.
fact_tl: Iniinom ang pinakuluang dahon ng bayabas bilang tradisyonal na lunas sa pagtatae o sakit ng tiyan.
fact_bis: Ang gilat-ang dahon sa bayabas ginainom isip tradisyonal nga tambal sa kalibanga o sakit sa tiyan.

q: How can you usually recognize a base by touch and taste?
options: Bases often taste bitter and feel slippery, like soap
Bases taste sour and feel rough or grainy to the touch
Bases feel dry and powdery, like chalk dust
Bases taste sweet and leave a sticky film on the fingers
explanation: Bases often taste bitter and feel slippery, like soap.
fact_tl: Ang mga base ay kadalasang mapait at madulas sa pakiramdam, tulad ng sabon.
fact_bis: Ang mga base sagad mapait ug madanlog kon hikapon, sama sa sabon.

q: Which organ is the body's control center that gives orders to all other body parts?
options: The brain
The heart
The lungs
The liver
explanation: The brain is the body's control center that gives orders to all parts of the body.
fact_tl: Ang utak ang sentro ng kontrol ng katawan na nag-uutos sa lahat ng bahagi ng ating lawas.
fact_bis: Ang utok mao ang sentro sa pagkontrol sa lawas nga nagmando sa tanang bahin sa atong lawas.

q: What colors are found on a colasisi bird?
options: Mostly green with red on its forehead and throat
Mostly blue with yellow on its wings and tail
Mostly white with black stripes along its back
Mostly orange with a green ring around its neck
explanation: The colasisi is mostly green with red on its forehead and throat.
fact_tl: Ang kulasisi ay halos berde ang balahibo na may pula sa noo at lalamunan.
fact_bis: Ang kulasisi kasagaran berde ug balhibo nga adunay pula sa agtang ug tutunlan.

q: How does heat move through a solid object by conduction?
options: Fast-vibrating particles bump into neighboring particles and pass the energy along
Heat flows from one end to the other like water flowing through a pipe
Warm particles rise to the top and cool particles sink to the bottom
Invisible rays of heat energy travel straight through the solid without touching particles
explanation: In conduction, heat moves through a solid as fast-jiggling particles bump into their neighbors, passing energy along — like a spoon heating up in hot soup.
fact_tl: Sa kondaksyon, dumadaloy ang init sa loob ng isang solidong bagay habang ang mabibilis na umuugang maliliit na bahagi nito ay bumabangga sa mga katabi nila, tulad ng kutsarang umiinit sa mainit na sabaw.
fact_bis: Sa konduksyon, ang init mobalhin sa sulod sa usa ka solido samtang ang paspas nga nag-uyog nga gagmay nga bahin niini magbangga sa ilang silingan, sama sa kutsara nga mag-init sa init nga sabaw.

q: What is notable about the Philippines' coral reefs compared to the rest of the world?
options: The Philippines has one of the world's largest coral reef extents, covering hundreds of thousands of hectares
The Philippines has the deepest coral reefs, found only below 500 meters
Philippine coral reefs are unique because they grow only in freshwater rivers
The Philippines has very few coral reefs because its seas are too warm for them
explanation: The Philippines has one of the world's largest coral reef extents, with all reefs combined covering hundreds of thousands of hectares in the country's shallow seas.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may isa sa mga pinakamalawak na sumasaklaw ng coral reef sa mundo; ang kasamang lahat ng mga reef ay sumasaklaw ng daan-daang libong ektarya sa mga mababaw na dagat ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay usa sa pinakahalapad nga sakop sa coral reef sa kalibutan; ang tanan nga mga reef naglangkob sa gatusan ka libo ektarya sa mga mababaw nga dagat sa nasud.

q: Why do many egg-laying animals keep their eggs warm?
options: So that the eggs can hatch properly
So that predators cannot smell the eggs
So that the shell grows harder as the baby develops
So that the eggs float if they fall into water
explanation: Many egg-laying animals keep their eggs warm so they can hatch properly.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop na nangingitlog ang nagpapainit sa kanilang itlog para mapisa ito nang maayos.
fact_bis: Daghang mga hayop nga nangitlog ang nagpainit sa ilang itlog aron mopusa kini ug maayo.

q: What two elements make fossil fuels energy-rich, and what gas is released when they are burned?
options: Carbon and hydrogen make them energy-rich; burning releases carbon dioxide into the air
Oxygen and nitrogen make them energy-rich; burning releases water vapor
Iron and sulfur make them energy-rich; burning releases sulfur dioxide
Silicon and calcium make them energy-rich; burning releases carbon monoxide
explanation: Fossil fuels are rich in carbon and hydrogen from once-living things; burning them releases heat but also sends carbon dioxide into the air.
fact_tl: Ang fossil fuels ay mayaman sa carbon at hydrogen na galing sa mga dating buhay na bagay; ang mga kemikal na ito ang naglalabas ng init kapag sinunog, pero nagiging carbon dioxide rin ang carbon na lumalabas sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang fossil fuels dato sa carbon ug hydrogen nga gikan sa kanhing buhi nga mga butang; kining mga kemikal mobuga og kainit kung sunugon, apan ang carbon mogawas usab isip carbon dioxide ngadto sa hangin.

q: When do neap tides occur, and what makes them different from other tides?
options: They occur at the half-moon when the Sun and Moon are at right angles to Earth, causing a smaller difference between high and low tide
They occur at the full moon when the Sun and Moon align, causing the highest tides of the month
They occur only in summer when the Sun is closest to Earth, making tides stronger
They occur during storms when wind and rain push extra water toward the shore
explanation: Neap tides happen when the Sun and Moon are at right angles to Earth (half-moon), so their pulls partly cancel and the difference between high and low tide is smaller.
fact_tl: Kapag nasa right angle ang Araw at buwan kumpara sa Earth (tuwing kalahating buwan), nagkakasalungat ang kanilang hila kaya mas mahina ang pagkakaiba ng taog at kati — tinatawag itong neap tide.
fact_bis: Kung ang Adlaw ug bulan nag-eskina sa Earth (sa katunga nga bulan), magsumpaki ang ilang bira mao nga mas gamay ang kalainan sa taob ug hunas — ginatawag kini nga neap tide.

q: Beyond about how deep does sunlight stop reaching the ocean?
options: About 1,000 meters deep
About 100 meters deep
About 5,000 meters deep
About 50 meters deep
explanation: No sunlight reaches the ocean beyond about 1,000 meters deep, so it is always dark there.
fact_tl: Wala nang sikat ng araw na umaabot sa karagatan na lampas sa halos 1,000 metro ang lalim, kaya laging madilim doon.
fact_bis: Wala nay silaw sa adlaw nga makaabot sa dagat nga lapas sa mga 1,000 ka metro ang giladmon, busa kanunay ngitngit didto.

q: Which bird holds the record as the largest in the world, standing about 2.7 meters tall?
options: Ostrich
Emu
Penguin
Cassowary
explanation: The ostrich is the largest bird in the world, standing about 2.7 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang ostrich ang pinakamalaking ibon sa mundo, na umaabot ng halos 2.7 metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang ostrich mao ang pinakadako nga langgam sa kalibutan, moabot ug halos 2.7 metro ang gitas-on.

q: How do sea snakes breathe even though they live in the ocean?
options: They breathe air with lungs and must surface from time to time to take a breath
They breathe through gills like fish so they never need to surface
They absorb oxygen directly through their skin while swimming
They hold a bubble of air inside their mouth that lasts for several hours
explanation: Sea snakes are reptiles that breathe air with lungs, so they must surface from time to time to take a breath.
fact_tl: Ang mga ahas-dagat ay reptilya na humihinga ng hangin gamit ang baga, kaya kailangan nilang umahon paminsan-minsan sa ibabaw ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga bitin sa dagat mga reptilya nga moginhawa og hangin gamit ang baga, busa kinahanglan sila motungha matag karon ug unya sa ibabaw sa tubig.

q: A geologist rubs a colorful purple quartz crystal on a porcelain plate. What color streak does it leave?
options: White, no matter what color the quartz crystal is
Purple, matching the color of the crystal
Clear or transparent, since quartz is see-through
Black, because darker minerals always leave dark streaks
explanation: No matter what color a quartz crystal appears, its streak on a porcelain plate is always white, showing that streak is more reliable than visual color for identifying minerals.
fact_tl: Kahit gaano man kasiba ang kulay ng isang quartz crystal — dilaw, ube, pula, o itim — ang streak nito (pulbos na naiwan sa porcelain plate) ay laging puti; ito ay nagpapakita na ang streak ay mas maaasahan kaysa sa visual na kulay para sa pag-identify ng mineral.
fact_bis: Bisan unsa ka kolor ang usa ka quartz crystal — dalag, ube, pink, o itom — ang streak niini (pulbos sa porcelain plate) kanunay puti; kini nagpakita nga ang streak mas kasaligan kaysa visual nga kolor sa pag-ila sa mineral.

q: Which animal is considered the smallest mammal in the world by weight?
options: The Etruscan shrew, which can weigh less than two grams
The pygmy mouse, which can weigh less than five grams
The bumblebee bat, which can weigh less than one gram
The dwarf hamster, which can weigh less than ten grams
explanation: The Etruscan shrew is considered the smallest mammal by weight — it is so tiny it can weigh less than two grams.
fact_tl: Ang Etruscan shrew ang itinuturing na pinakamaliit na mamalya (hayop na nagpapasuso) ayon sa timbang. Napakaliit nito na kayang tumimbang ng wala pang dalawang gramo.
fact_bis: Ang Etruscan shrew giila nga pinakagamay nga sus-an (hayop nga nagpasuso) sumala sa gibug-aton. Gamay kaayo kini nga makatimbang og ubos pa sa duha ka gramo.

q: What type of energy does a battery convert into electrical energy?
options: Chemical energy from reactions inside it
Heat energy stored in its metal casing
Light energy absorbed through its outer coating
Mechanical energy from movement when the battery is shaken
explanation: A battery converts chemical energy from reactions inside it into electrical energy, which drives the current that powers devices in a circuit.
fact_tl: Ang baterya ay nagko-convert ng chemical na enerhiya mula sa mga kemikal na reaksyon sa loob nito patungong electrical na enerhiya — ito ang nagpapatakbo ng mga kuryente sa circuit.
fact_bis: Ang baterya nagconvert sa chemical nga enerhiya gikan sa mga kemikal nga reaksyon sulod niini paingon sa electrical nga enerhiya — kini ang nagpadagan sa kuryente nga nagpagana sa mga device sa circuit.

q: Why can a mangrove crab survive even when the water around it changes from very salty to almost fresh?
options: Its body can balance the amount of salt inside it no matter what the water is like
It moves to dry land whenever the water becomes too fresh or too salty
It only comes out to feed during high tide when the water is the saltiest
It builds a burrow in the mud to avoid the water whenever salinity changes
explanation: A mangrove crab's body can regulate its internal salt levels, letting it survive in water that shifts between sea-salty and nearly fresh.
fact_tl: Nagbabago ang alat ng tubig sa bakawan — minsan parang dagat, minsan halos tabang dahil sa ulan o ilog. Kayang i-balanse ng katawan ng alimango ang asin sa loob nito, kaya nakakaya nitong mabuhay sa ganitong pabago-bagong tubig.
fact_bis: Nagbag-o ang kaparat sa tubig sa bakhaw — usahay sama sa dagat, usahay halos tab-ang tungod sa ulan o suba. Mabalanse sa lawas sa alimango ang asin sa sulod niini, mao nga makaya niini mabuhi sa ingon nga nagbag-o nga tubig.

q: About how fast does sound travel through air?
options: About 343 meters per second
About 3,000 meters per second
About 34 meters per second
About 3,000,000 meters per second
explanation: Sound travels through air at about 343 meters per second, which is why you see lightning before you hear thunder.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay naglalakbay sa hangin nang mga 343 metro kada segundo (mga 1,235 km/h) — mas mabagal kaysa liwanag, kaya nauuna mong makita ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog.
fact_bis: Ang tingog mobaktas sa hangin og mga 343 ka metro kada segundo (mga 1,235 km/h) — mas hinay kaysa kahayag, mao nga makita una nimo ang kilat sa dili pa madungog ang dalugdog.

q: Why are cockroaches so commonly found in homes in the Philippines?
options: They love the warm and humid climate that the Philippines has
They are attracted by the bright electric lights found in Filipino homes
They feed only on rice, which Filipino families always have
They are brought in by flooding from rivers near most Philippine towns
explanation: Cockroaches thrive in the Philippines because the country's warm and humid climate is exactly the environment they need to live and multiply.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nakikita ang ipis sa mga bahay sa Pilipinas dahil mainit at mamasa-masa ang ating klima, na siyang gusto nito para mabuhay at dumami.
fact_bis: Kasagarang makita ang ipis sa mga balay sa Pilipinas tungod kay init ug umog ang atong klima, nga mao gyoy ganahan niini aron mabuhi ug modaghan.

q: Where on a firefly's body does its light come from?
options: The underside of the tip of its belly, near the tail
The top of its head, between its antennae
The inside of its wings, which glow when spread open
The sides of its thorax, just behind its front legs
explanation: A firefly's light comes from a special organ on the underside of the tip of its belly near the tail, which is why the glow seems to come from its rear.
fact_tl: Saan nanggagaling ang ilaw ng alitaptap? Sa ilalim ng dulo ng kanyang tiyan, malapit sa puwit. May espesyal na bahagi doon na parang maliit na parol kung saan nangyayari ang reaksyon. Kaya parang may ilaw na lumalabas sa likuran nito.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang kahayag sa aninipot? Gikan sa ilawom sa tumoy sa iyang tiyan, duol sa ikog. Naa didto espesyal nga bahagi, sama sa gamay nga parol, diin mahitabo ang reaksyon. Mao nga morag adunay kahayag nga mogawas sa iyang likod.

q: What does a concave lens do to the appearance of an object?
options: It makes the object look smaller
It makes the object look larger, like a magnifying glass
It flips the object upside down without changing its size
It splits the object's light into a rainbow of colors
explanation: Unlike a convex magnifying lens, a concave lens spreads light rays outward and makes things look smaller, not bigger.
fact_tl: May nag-aakalang lahat ng lente ay nagpapalaki gaya ng magnifying glass, pero mali ito. Ang concave lens ay talagang nagpapaliit ng bagay, hindi nagpapalaki.
fact_bis: Naay mga tawo nga maghunahuna nga tanang lente magpadako sama sa magnifying glass, apan sayop kana. Ang concave lens magpagamay gyud sa butang, dili magpadako.

q: Which side of the brain controls the right side of your body?
options: The left half of the brain
The right half of the brain
Both halves work together equally for each side
The lower brain stem, not either half
explanation: The brain's left half controls the right side of the body, and the right half controls the left side — they are crossed.
fact_tl: Hatian sa dalawang bahagi ang utak, ang kaliwa at kanan. Kakaiba ito: ang kaliwang bahagi ng utak ang kumokontrol sa kanang bahagi ng katawan, at ang kanan ang kumokontrol sa kaliwa.
fact_bis: Ang utok gibahin sa duha ka bahin, ang wala ug ang tuo. Talagsaon kini: ang walang bahin sa utok nagkontrol sa tuong bahin sa lawas, ug ang tuo nagkontrol sa wala.

q: What does a fever actually tell you about what is happening inside your body?
options: Your body is fighting an infection or illness
Your body is producing too many red blood cells
Your digestive system has stopped working properly
Your heart is beating too fast from too much exercise
explanation: A fever is a sign that the body is fighting something like an infection — it is the body's alarm, not the disease itself.
fact_tl: Maraming akala na ang lagnat mismo ang sakit, pero hindi. Ang lagnat ay isang tanda na may nilalabanan ang katawan, gaya ng impeksyon. Ito ay parang alarma, hindi ang sunog mismo.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang hilanat mismo ang sakit, apan dili. Ang hilanat usa ka timailhan nga ang lawas naay gibatok, sama sa impeksyon. Sama kini sa alarma, dili ang sunog mismo.

q: If you split a star's light into colors like a rainbow, what does more bluish light tell you?
options: The star is very hot
The star is very cool
The star is very far away
The star is very large
explanation: In a star's spectrum, more bluish light means the star is hotter, while more reddish light means the star is cooler.
fact_tl: Kapag hinati ng mga siyentipiko ang liwanag ng bituin sa mga kulay nito (tulad ng bahaghari mula sa prism), tinatawag itong spectrum. Sa spectrum, mas maraming asul-asul na liwanag ang mainit na bituin, at mas maraming pula-pulang liwanag ang malamig na bituin — kaya ito ang totoong susi sa init nila.
fact_bis: Kung bahin-bahinon sa mga siyentipiko ang kahayag sa bituon ngadto sa mga kolor niini (sama sa bangaw gikan sa prism), gitawag kini og spectrum. Sa spectrum, ang init nga bituon adunay mas daghang asul nga kahayag ug ang bugnaw nga bituon mas daghang pula — mao kini ang tinuod nga yawe sa ilang kainit.

q: How tall is the Statue of Liberty from its base to the tip of the torch?
options: About 93 meters
About 46 meters
About 150 meters
About 30 meters
explanation: The Statue of Liberty is about 93 meters tall from the base to the tip of the torch.
fact_tl: Ang Statue of Liberty ay mga 93 metro ang taas mula sa base hanggang sa dulo ng sulo (torch).
fact_bis: Ang Statue of Liberty mga 93 ka metro ang gitas-on gikan sa base hangtod sa tumoy sa sulo (torch).

q: Which Philippine government agency uses seismographs to monitor earthquakes and volcanoes?
options: PHIVOLCS
PAGASA
DENR
NAMRIA
explanation: PHIVOLCS is the agency in the Philippines responsible for monitoring earthquakes and volcanoes using seismographs.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS ang ahensyang gumagamit ng mga seismograph upang masubaybayan ang lindol at bulkan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS mao ang ahensya nga mogamit sa mga seismograph aron bantayan ang linog ug bulkan.

q: What does a wind turbine produce when its blades spin?
options: Electricity
Compressed air stored in tanks
Mechanical energy stored in a flywheel
Heat that warms nearby buildings
explanation: A wind turbine's spinning blades turn a generator inside, which produces electricity.
fact_tl: Ang wind turbine ay gumagawa ng kuryente — ang umiikot na blades ang umaandar sa generator sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang wind turbine maghimo ug koryente — ang nagtuyok nga blades mopalihok sa generator sa sulod.

q: Which star is the brightest in the constellation Orion?
options: Rigel
Betelgeuse
Sirius
Aldebaran
explanation: Rigel is the brightest star in the constellation Orion, outshining all other stars in that pattern.
fact_tl: Ang Rigel ang pinakamaliwanag na bituin sa konstelasyong Orion.
fact_bis: Ang Rigel mao ang pinakahayag nga bituon sa konstelasyon nga Orion.

q: Which of these is a warning sign that an active volcano might be about to erupt?
options: Small earthquakes and the ground swelling on the volcano's sides
Rivers near the volcano suddenly running faster than usual
Animals returning to live on the volcano's slopes
Heavy rainfall soaking into the ground around the volcano
explanation: Before an eruption, warning signs include small earthquakes, increased smoke and steam, ground heating up, and the volcano's sides swelling.
fact_tl: Bago pumutok ang isang aktibong bulkan, may mga babala: maliliit na lindol, mas maraming usok at singaw, pag-init ng lupa, at minsan ay umaalsa ang lupa sa gilid nito.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa moputok ang aktibo nga bulkan, adunay mga pasidaan: gagmay nga linog, mas daghang aso ug alisngaw, pag-init sa yuta, ug usahay mohubag ang yuta sa kilid niini.

q: About how long was a fully grown Tyrannosaurus rex from head to tail?
options: About 12 meters
About 4 meters
About 25 meters
About 7 meters
explanation: Tyrannosaurus rex reached about 12 meters in length from head to tail.
fact_tl: Ang Tyrannosaurus rex ay umaabot ng mga 12 metro ang haba mula ulo hanggang buntot.
fact_bis: Ang Tyrannosaurus rex moabot og mga 12 ka metro ang gitas-on gikan sa ulo hangtod sa ikog.

q: What can a community member do if they see someone illegally cutting down trees or poaching animals?
options: Report it to the DENR or local government
Confront the person directly and demand they stop
Collect evidence and sell it to a news station
Wait for national television to report on it first
explanation: Reporting illegal activities like logging or poaching to the DENR or local government is a concrete way community members can help protect endangered species.
fact_tl: Ang pag-uulat ng mga nakitang illegal na aktibidad tulad ng pagtotroso o pangangaso sa DENR o lokal na pamahalaan ay isa sa mga paraan na makakatulong ang mga miyembro ng komunidad sa pangangalaga ng mga nanganganib na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang pag-report sa nakita nga mga ilegal nga aktibidad sama sa pagtotroso o pagbuno sa DENR o lokal nga gobyerno usa sa mga paagi nga ang mga miyembro sa komunidad makatabang sa panalipod sa nangangitag-an nga mga mananap.

q: How do tree and plant roots help protect the land during heavy rain?
options: They hold the soil together so it does not wash away
They absorb all the rainwater before it reaches the soil
They release chemicals that harden the soil into rock
They create underground tunnels that drain the rain quickly
explanation: Roots hold soil together, which prevents it from being washed away by rainwater — this is how trees and plants reduce soil erosion.
fact_tl: Hinahawakan ng ugat ang lupa, kaya nakakatulong ang mga puno at halaman na pigilan ang pagguho ng lupa kapag umuulan.
fact_bis: Ang gamot mokapot sa yuta, busa ang mga kahoy ug tanom makatabang sa pagpugong sa pagbanlas sa yuta kung mag-ulan.

q: What are the small bones that make up the human spine called?
options: Vertebrae
Carpals
Phalanges
Patellae
explanation: The spine is made of 33 small bones called vertebrae, which allow us to bend, twist, and stand upright.
fact_tl: Ang gulugod ay binubuo ng 33 maliliit na buto na tinatawag na vertebrae na nagpapahintulot sa ating yumuko, lumiko, at manatiling tuwid.
fact_bis: Ang gulugod naglangkob sa 33 ka gamay nga mga buto nga gitawag vertebrae nga nagtugot kanato sa pagliko, pagduko, ug pagtindog.

q: Which type of mosquito is mainly responsible for spreading West Nile virus?
options: Culex mosquitoes
Aedes mosquitoes
Anopheles mosquitoes
Mansonia mosquitoes
explanation: West Nile virus is spread by Culex mosquitoes, which often pick up the virus from infected birds before passing it to people.
fact_tl: Ang West Nile virus ay dala ng lamok na Culex at madalas nagmumula sa mga ibon bago maipasa sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang West Nile virus gidala sa lamok nga Culex ug kasagaran gikan sa mga langgam una mabalhin sa tawo.

q: How does a woodpecker's skull protect its brain when it hammers into wood?
options: It has thick, spongy bone that cushions the brain like a shock absorber
It has an extra-thick beak that absorbs all the impact before it reaches the skull
Its neck muscles are so strong they stop vibrations from reaching the brain
Its brain floats in extra fluid that spreads out the force of each peck
explanation: A woodpecker's skull has thick, spongy bone that acts like a cushion, absorbing impact and protecting the brain with each peck.
fact_tl: Ang bungo ng woodpecker ay may makapal at parang espongha na buto na nagsisilbing unan para protektahan ang utak nito.
fact_bis: Ang bagol sa woodpecker adunay baga ug daw espongha nga buto nga nagsilbing unlan aron mapanalipdan ang utok niini.

q: What range of sea temperature in the Philippines is ideal for coral reef growth?
options: 27 to 30 degrees Celsius
10 to 15 degrees Celsius
35 to 40 degrees Celsius
20 to 22 degrees Celsius
explanation: Philippine seas are usually 27 to 30 degrees Celsius, which is the perfect temperature range for coral reef growth and rich marine biodiversity.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na temperatura ng mga dagat ng Pilipinas—kadalasang 27 hanggang 30 degrees Celsius—ay perpekto para sa paglaki ng mga coral reef at pagpapaunlad ng mayamang marine biodiversity.
fact_bis: Ang mainit nga temperatura sa mga dagat sa Pilipinas—kasagaran 27 hangtod 30 degrees Celsius—perpekto alang sa pagtubo sa coral reef ug pag-uswag sa dato nga marine biodiversity.

q: In a parallel circuit, how much of the battery's voltage does each branch receive?
options: Each branch receives the full battery voltage
Each branch receives an equal share of the battery voltage split among all branches
Only the first branch receives the full voltage and the rest get less
The branch with the most light bulbs receives the most voltage
explanation: In a parallel circuit each branch gets the full battery voltage, which is why lights in a parallel circuit shine brighter than those wired in series.
fact_tl: Sa isang parallel circuit, ang bawat sanga ay nakakakuha ng buong boltahe ng baterya — kaya mas maliwanag ang mga bombilya kaysa sa series circuit.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka parallel circuit, ang matag sanga makadawat sa buong boltahe sa baterya — mao kini nganong ang mga bombilya sa parallel circuit mas liwanag kay sa series circuit gamit ang mao rang baterya.

q: How does a sea cucumber sense its surroundings even though it has no true eyes?
options: Through simple senses that can detect light and touch
By releasing chemicals into the water and tasting what bounces back
By feeling vibrations through the ocean floor with its tube feet only
By relying entirely on smell through pores on its body wall
explanation: A sea cucumber has no true eyes but can still sense light and touch through simple sensory abilities.
fact_tl: Walang tunay na mata ang balat, ngunit nararamdaman pa rin nito ang liwanag at hipo sa pamamagitan ng simpleng pandama.
fact_bis: Ang balatan walay tinuod nga mata, apan makabati gihapon kini sa kahayag ug paghikap pinaagi sa yano nga pamati.

q: How does a horseshoe crab grow larger as it gets older?
options: It sheds its old hard shell and grows a new, bigger one
It stretches its shell slowly over time as its body expands
New shell material is added along the edges of the existing shell
Its soft inner body grows while its outer shell stays the same size
explanation: To grow, a horseshoe crab must molt — it sheds its old hard shell and forms a new, larger one in its place.
fact_tl: Para lumaki, kailangang iwaksi ng horseshoe crab ang lumang matigas na balat nito at magpalaki ng bagong mas malaki.
fact_bis: Aron motubo, kinahanglan ihukas sa horseshoe crab ang daan nga gahing kabhang ug magtubo og bag-o nga mas dako.

q: Which behavior shows that dolphins are among the most intelligent animals in the sea?
options: They learn new things, play, and communicate with other dolphins using sounds
They can swim faster than any other ocean animal when chasing prey
They use their tails to build underwater nests for their young
They can survive out of water for hours by storing oxygen in their blubber
explanation: Dolphins demonstrate intelligence by learning new things, playing, and communicating with other dolphins through sounds.
fact_tl: Ang lumba-lumba ay isa sa pinakamatalinong hayop sa dagat. Natututo ito ng mga bagong bagay, naglalaro, at nag-uusap sa kapwa nito gamit ang tunog.
fact_bis: Ang lumba-lumba usa sa labing utokan nga mga hayop sa dagat. Makakat-on kini og bag-ong mga butang, magdula, ug makigsulti sa ubang lumba-lumba gamit ang tingog.

q: What does the anglerfish use its glowing head lure for?
options: To attract and catch small fish in the dark deep sea
To signal to other anglerfish that it has found a territory
To frighten away larger predators that might eat it
To light the way as it searches for food along the ocean floor
explanation: The anglerfish dangles a glowing lure on its head to lure small fish close enough to catch them in the darkness of the deep ocean.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish ay may nakausli na nagliliwanag na pain sa ulo na ginagamit upang akitin at hulihin ang maliliit na isda sa dilim.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish adunay nagsiga nga paon sa iyang ulo nga gigamit aron makadani ug makadakop sa gagmay nga isda diha sa kangitngit.

q: What term describes the tendency of some deep-sea animals to grow much larger than their shallow-water relatives?
options: Deep-sea gigantism
Ocean megagrowth
Pressure expansion
Abyssal scaling
explanation: The phenomenon where animals like the giant isopod grow much larger in the deep sea than their shallow-water relatives is called deep-sea gigantism.
fact_tl: May ilang hayop tulad ng giant isopod na lumalaki nang husto sa kailaliman ng dagat kaysa sa kanilang mga kamag-anak sa mababaw — tinatawag itong deep-sea gigantism.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka mananap sama sa giant isopod nga modako pa kaayo sa kalaliman sa dagat kaysa sa ilang mga paryente sa mabaw — gitawag kini og deep-sea gigantism.

q: In which year was the first successful human-to-human blood transfusion performed?
explanation: The first successful human-to-human blood transfusion took place in the year 1818.
fact_tl: Ang unang matagumpay na transfusyon ng dugo sa pagitan ng dalawang tao ay ginawa noong taong 1818.
fact_bis: Ang unang malampuson nga blood transfusion tali sa duha ka tawo gihimo niadtong tuig 1818.

q: What happens to the carbon stored inside wood when it is burned?
options: It escapes into the air as carbon dioxide gas
It turns into ash that stays on the ground permanently
It is absorbed by the soil directly beneath the fire
It breaks down into harmless water vapor and disappears
explanation: When wood burns, the carbon stored inside it is released back into the air as carbon dioxide, adding gas to the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Kapag nasusunog ang kahoy o gasolina, lumalabas pabalik sa hangin ang karbong nakaimbak doon bilang carbon dioxide. Kaya nakakadagdag ng usok ang pagsusunog.
fact_bis: Kon masunog ang kahoy o gasolina, ang karbon nga natipig sulod niini mogawas balik sa hangin isip carbon dioxide. Mao nga ang pagsunog makadugang sa aso sa kalangitan.

q: When light hits a mirror, how does the angle at which it bounces off compare to the angle at which it arrived?
options: They are equal — the angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence
The reflected angle is always exactly half of the incoming angle
The reflected angle is always greater than the incoming angle
It depends on the color of the light hitting the mirror
explanation: On a mirror, the angle of incoming light (angle of incidence) always equals the angle of the reflected light (angle of reflection).
fact_tl: Sa salamin, ang anggulo ng papasok na liwanag ay katumbas ng anggulo ng pabalik na liwanag.
fact_bis: Sa samin, ang anggulo sa misulod nga kahayag parehas sa anggulo sa mibalik nga kahayag.

q: Why do ants walk in a single-file line one after another?
options: They follow the scent trail left by the ants ahead of them leading to food
They are following the largest ant in the colony who acts as a guide
They walk in a line to protect themselves from being stepped on
They are moving in rhythm with vibrations they feel through the ground
explanation: Ants walk in a line because they follow a scent trail left by the ants ahead of them, which leads them toward a food source.
fact_tl: Madalas nakikita ang mga langgam na naglalakad nang sunod-sunod sa isang hanay dahil sinusundan nila ang amoy na iniwan ng nauna nilang kasama papunta sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Kasagaran makita ang mga hulmigas nga naglakaw nga sunod-sunod sa usa ka linya kay gisunod nila ang baho nga gibilin sa nauna nilang kauban paingon sa pagkaon.

q: If two pendulums have strings of the same length but one has a heavier bob, which swings faster?
options: They swing at the same rate — the weight of the bob does not matter
The heavier bob swings faster because gravity pulls it down harder
The lighter bob swings faster because it has less mass to move
The heavier bob swings slower because it takes more energy to lift
explanation: The swing rate of a pendulum depends on string length, not on how heavy the bob is — a heavier bob does not swing faster.
fact_tl: Kahit gaano kabigat o kagaan ang bob, kung pareho ang haba ng tali, pareho ang bilis ng ugoy; hindi mas mabilis umugoy ang mabigat na bob.
fact_bis: Bisan unsa kabug-at o kagaan ang bob, kon parehas ang gitas-on sa pisi, parehas ang katulin sa labyog; ang mas bug-at nga bob dili mas paspas molabyog.

q: What makes Taal Volcano unusual compared to most other volcanoes?
options: It sits on an island inside a lake called Taal Lake
It is located completely underwater beneath the sea
It has never erupted in recorded Philippine history
It is the tallest active volcano in the Philippines
explanation: Taal Volcano is special because it sits on an island within Taal Lake, making it a volcano on an island in a lake.
fact_tl: Natatangi ang Bulkang Taal dahil ito ay isang isla sa loob ng isang lawa (Lawa ng Taal).
fact_bis: Talagsaon ang Bulkang Taal kay kini usa ka isla sulod sa usa ka lanaw (Lanaw sa Taal).

q: Why do scientists use a single scientific name for each animal or plant instead of its common name?
options: Common names differ from place to place and language to language, causing confusion
Common names are too long and difficult to remember compared to scientific names
Scientists invented scientific names so only experts could identify species
Common names change every year as new species are discovered nearby
explanation: An animal's common name varies by location and language, so scientists use one shared scientific name to avoid confusion.
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang pangalan ng isang hayop o halaman ay iba-iba sa bawat lugar at wika, kaya nakakalito; ang pangalang siyentipiko ang nagbibigay ng iisang pangalang malinaw sa lahat.
fact_bis: Ang ordinaryong ngalan sa usa ka mananap o tanom lainlain sa matag dapit ug pinulongan, mao nga makalibog; ang ngalang siyentipiko maoy naghatag og usa ka klaro nga ngalan para sa tanan.

q: What do bees do with honey after storing it in the cells of the honeycomb?
options: They seal the cells with wax to preserve the honey for hard times
They leave the cells open so the honey can dry out and harden
They mix the honey with pollen before giving it to the queen
They eat the honey immediately after storing it during summer
explanation: Bees store honey in cells and seal them with wax to preserve the food supply for times when flowers are scarce.
fact_tl: Iniimbak ng mga bubuyog ang pulot sa mga silid at tinatakpan ito ng pagkit bilang pagkain pagdating ng mahihirap na panahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga putyokan magtipig sa dugos sa mga selula ug taboran kini ug talo isip pagkaon panahon sa kalisod.

q: What is the difference between how yeast and bacteria carry out fermentation?
options: Yeast makes alcohol and gas while certain bacteria sour food like yogurt and buro
Only yeast can ferment food; bacteria always spoil food rather than ferment it
Bacteria make alcohol in drinks while yeast is only used to sour dairy products
Both produce exactly the same products and cannot be told apart by what they make
explanation: Yeast ferments to produce alcohol and gas, while some bacteria ferment to sour food — as seen in yogurt and buro.
fact_tl: Hindi lang lebadura ang nagpipermenta ng pagkain — may mga bakterya rin na nagpapaasim, gaya ng ginagamit sa yogurt at sa buro, samantalang ang lebadura ang gumagawa ng alkohol at gas.
fact_bis: Dili lang lebadura ang mag-ferment sa pagkaon — adunay mga bakterya usab nga moaslom, sama sa yogurt ug buro, samtang ang lebadura mao ang mohimo og alkohol ug gas.

q: How do some mosquitoes lay their eggs on the surface of water?
options: Joined together so they float like a tiny raft
One at a time, sinking to the bottom of still water
Glued to underwater plants below the water's surface
Attached individually to the edges of leaves above the water
explanation: Some mosquitoes lay eggs that are joined together and float on the water surface like a tiny raft.
fact_tl: May mga lamok na nangingitlog ng magkakadikit na itlog na lumulutang sa tubig na parang maliit na balsa.
fact_bis: Adunay mga lamok nga mangitlog og nagkadikit nga mga itlog nga maglutaw sa tubig sama sa gamay nga balsa.

q: What is guano?
options: The droppings of bats that pile up on the cave floor
The type of fungi that grow on cave walls in the dark
The name for a bat's echolocation squeaks inside a cave
The thick layer of moss that covers cave ceilings where bats roost
explanation: Guano is the droppings of bats that accumulate into a thick layer on the cave floor.
fact_tl: Ang guano ay ang dumi ng mga paniki na natitipon at nagiging makapal na patong sa sahig ng kuweba.
fact_bis: Ang guano mao ang iti sa mga kabog nga magtapok ug mahimong baga nga sapaw sa salog sa langob.

q: From which organism was the antibiotic penicillin first discovered?
options: A mold called Penicillium
A bacterium found in soil
A fungus that grows on tree bark
A yeast used in bread-making
explanation: Penicillin was discovered from a mold called Penicillium, which was found to kill nearby bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang penicillin ay nanggaling sa isang amag (mold) na tinatawag na Penicillium.
fact_bis: Ang penicillin naggikan sa usa ka agup-op (mold) nga gitawag og Penicillium.

q: Why do landslides often happen along newly built mountain roads?
options: Cutting into the slope removes the support that was holding the soil above it
Heavy trucks driving on mountain roads shake the ground loose over time
Road construction always removes all the trees that held the soil together
Rainwater collects in the flat road surface and then suddenly floods the slope
explanation: When a road is cut into a mountainside, the soil above loses its support and the slope becomes much more likely to slide.
fact_tl: Kapag pinutol ng tao ang gilid ng bundok para gumawa ng kalsada, nawawalan ng suporta ang lupang nasa itaas nito. Dahil dito, mas madaling gumuho ang dalisdis, kaya madalas magkaroon ng landslide sa tabi ng mga bagong daan sa bundok.
fact_bis: Kung putlon sa tawo ang kilid sa bukid aron maghimo og dalan, mawad-an og tukod ang yuta sa ibabaw niini. Tungod niini, mas sayon maguba ang bakilid, mao nga kanunay magkaaduna og landslide tapad sa bag-ong mga dalan sa bukid.

q: Among which Filipino cultural groups is the kubing, an indigenous jaw harp, traditionally used?
options: Groups in Mindanao like the Maguindanao and other lumad peoples
Fishing communities along the shores of Palawan
The indigenous Igorot communities of the Mountain Province
Farmers in the rice terraces of Ifugao province
explanation: The kubing is an indigenous instrument especially used by groups in Mindanao such as the Maguindanao and other lumad peoples for storytelling, courtship, and relaxation.
fact_tl: Ang kubing ay isang katutubong instrumento ng Pilipinas, lalo na sa mga grupo sa Mindanao tulad ng mga Maguindanao at iba pang lumad. Ginagamit ito sa mga kuwentuhan, panliligaw, at pahinga. Isa itong magandang halimbawa ng physics ng tunog na matagal nang ginagamit sa kulturang Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang kubing usa ka lumad nga instrumento sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa mga grupo sa Mindanao sama sa Maguindanao ug uban pang lumad. Gigamit kini sa pagsugilanon, panguliyaw, ug pagpahulay. Usa kini ka nindot nga panig-ingnan sa physics sa tunog nga dugay nang gigamit sa kultura sa Pilipinas.

q: What did Charles Darwin observe about finches in the Galapagos Islands that helped support his theory of evolution?
options: Different islands had finches with differently shaped beaks suited to the food found there
Finches on all the islands were identical, showing no change over time
Finches only existed on one island and had all evolved from a single bird
The finches had lost the ability to fly after living on islands for many years
explanation: Darwin found that Galapagos finches had different beak shapes on different islands, each suited to local food sources — evidence that species adapt over time.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin ay napansin sa Galapagos Islands na ang mga finch na naninirahan doon ay may iba't ibang hugis ng tuka na angkop sa iba't ibang pagkain sa iba't ibang isla — nagbigay ito ng importante na ebidensya para sa kanyang teorya ng ebolusyon.
fact_bis: Namatikdan ni Charles Darwin sa Galapagos Islands nga ang mga finch adunay lain-laing hugis sa tuka nga angay sa lain-laing pagkaon sa lain-laing isla — naghatag kini og importanteng ebidensya alang sa iyang teorya sa ebolusyon.

q: Which cells on a leaf open and close the tiny pores called stomata to control water loss?
options: Guard cells
Xylem cells
Mesophyll cells
Phloem cells
explanation: Guard cells open and close the stomata, regulating how much water vapor the plant loses through transpiration.
fact_tl: May mga guard cell na nagbubukas at nagsasara ng stomata para kontrolin ang pagkawala ng tubig.
fact_bis: Adunay guard cells nga mag-abli ug magsira sa stomata aron kontrolon ang pagkawala sa tubig.

q: What color does litmus paper turn when it touches an acid?
options: Red
Blue
Yellow
Green
explanation: Litmus paper turns red in an acid and blue in a base — it is a simple way to test whether a liquid is acidic or basic.
fact_tl: Ang litmus paper ay nagiging pula sa asido at asul sa base.
fact_bis: Ang litmus paper mahimong pula sa asido ug asul sa base.

q: What do the bones inside a dolphin's flipper reveal about the dolphin's evolutionary history?
options: They look like arm and finger bones of a land mammal, suggesting dolphins had ancestors that walked on land
They are completely different from any land animal bones, showing dolphins always lived in the sea
They are hollow like bird bones, showing dolphins are more closely related to birds than to mammals
They are fused into a single rigid plate with no individual bones, unlike any land animal
explanation: Inside a dolphin's flipper are bones resembling the arm and finger bones of a land mammal, which is evidence that cetacean ancestors once walked on land.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng palikpik (flippers) ng lumba-lumba at balyena ay may mga butong tulad ng braso at daliri ng mammal. Palatandaan ito na ang ninuno nila ay dating naglakad sa lupa.
fact_bis: Sulod sa kapay (flippers) sa lumba-lumba ug balyena adunay mga bukog nga sama sa braso ug tudlo sa usa ka mammal. Timaan kini nga ang ilang katigulangan kaniadto naglakaw sa yuta.

q: What makes mangrove trees unusual compared to most other plants?
options: They can live in salty seawater that would kill most other plants
They grow entirely underwater and never need air to survive
They produce seeds that need saltwater in order to germinate
They lose all their leaves during the dry season to survive drought
explanation: Mangroves are unusual because they can tolerate growing in salty seawater, an environment that would kill most other plant species.
fact_tl: Kakaiba ang mangrove dahil kaya nitong mabuhay sa maalat na tubig-dagat na ikamamatay ng karamihang ibang halaman.
fact_bis: Talagsaon ang mangrove kay makahimo kini sa pagpuyo sa parat nga tubig-dagat nga makapatay sa kadaghanan nga laing tanom.

q: How does a dolphin use echolocation to find objects in dark water?
options: It sends out clicking sounds and listens to the echoes that bounce back
It uses its large eyes to see infrared heat given off by other animals
It feels pressure waves in the water using sensors along its side
It releases a cloud of bubbles and feels how the current changes around them
explanation: A dolphin uses echolocation by sending out clicking sounds and listening to the echoes that return, allowing it to determine the shape and distance of objects in the dark.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang lumba-lumba ng echolocation: nagpapadala ito ng mabilis na tunog (clicks) at nakikinig sa alingawngaw nito para malaman ang hugis at layo ng mga bagay sa madilim na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lumba-lumba mogamit og echolocation: nagpadala kini og paspas nga tingog (clicks) ug naminaw sa balik (echo) niini aron mahibaw-an ang porma ug gilay-on sa mga butang sa mangitngit nga tubig.

q: How would you best describe a pig's body shape?
options: Heavy and stout with short legs
Tall and slender with long thin legs
Flat and wide with no visible neck
Small and lightweight with large hind legs
explanation: A pig has a heavy, stout body with short legs, giving it its distinctive stocky shape.
fact_tl: Ang baboy ay may mabigat at matabang katawan na may maiikling paa.
fact_bis: Ang baboy adunay bug-at ug barog nga lawas nga may mubo nga mga tiil.

q: How does camouflage help both predators and prey animals?
options: It hides prey from being eaten and also hides predators so they can sneak close before hunting
It only helps prey animals hide; predators do not need to hide because they are stronger
It makes both animals invisible to each other at the same time, so neither can hunt
It changes the animal's color so brightly that enemies are scared away without a fight
explanation: Camouflage works two ways: it helps prey avoid being seen and helps predators creep close to their target unnoticed.
fact_tl: Ang kamuflahe ay tumutulong sa dalawang paraan: nakakatago ang biktima para hindi makain, at nakakatago rin ang manunugis para mailapit ito nang di napapansin bago manghuli.
fact_bis: Ang kamuflahe motabang sa duha ka paagi: makatago ang biktima aron dili kaonon, ug makatago usab ang manunukob aron makaduol kini nga dili mamatikdan una mangayam.

q: A tardigrade is curled up and dry — it survives extreme conditions in this state. What happens to a tardigrade when it is active and wet?
options: It can still be killed by heat or starvation like other animals
It becomes completely immune to all dangers
It produces a special shell to protect itself from heat
It enters a deeper sleep that makes it impossible to kill
explanation: Tardigrades are tough but not immortal — when active and wet, heat or hunger can kill them just like other animals.
fact_tl: Matibay man ang tardigrade, hindi ito imortal—kapag aktibo at basa ito, kayang patayin ito ng init o gutom tulad ng ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Bisan lig-on, ang tardigrade dili imortal—kung aktibo ug basa, ang kainit o kagutom makapatay niini sama sa ubang mananap.

q: Which of the following best describes a liana?
options: A woody, strong vine commonly found in tropical rainforests
A small flowering plant that grows on the forest floor
A type of tall tree that supports other climbing plants
A soft water plant found along riverbanks in the Philippines
explanation: A liana is a woody, strong vine commonly found in tropical rainforests like those in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang liana ay isang makahoy at matibay na baging na karaniwang matatagpuan sa mga tropikal na kagubatan tulad ng sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang liana usa ka makahoy ug lig-on nga baging nga kasagarang makita sa mga tropikanhong lasang sama sa Pilipinas.

q: Which statement is true about how diffusion and osmosis happen inside a cell?
options: They happen on their own and do not need extra energy from the cell
They require the cell to use energy from food to push substances
They only occur when the cell is provided heat from outside
They need special proteins that burn energy to move substances
explanation: Diffusion and osmosis are passive processes — they happen on their own without needing extra energy from the cell.
fact_tl: Ang diffusion at osmosis ay nangyayari nang kusa at hindi nangangailangan ng dagdag na enerhiya mula sa selula.
fact_bis: Ang diffusion ug osmosis mahitabo sa ilang kaugalingon ug dili manginahanglan ug dugang kusog gikan sa selula.

q: Why is the center (eye) of a typhoon calm and clear, while the rest of the storm is very violent?
options: Air sinks around the eye, preventing clouds from forming there
The eye is too cold for rain clouds to survive in that area
The fast winds push all the rain to the outer edges of the typhoon
High pressure inside the eye forces the storm clouds outward
explanation: The typhoon eye has low pressure and sinking air around it, which suppresses cloud formation and gives it clear skies.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng bagyo ay isang tahimik na lugar sa sentro ng bagyo na may malinaw na kalangitan at mababang presyon; ang hangin sa paligid ng mata ay bumababa at pumipigil sa pagbuo ng ulap.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa bagyo usa ka tahimik nga lugar sa sentro sa bagyo nga adunay malinaw nga langit ug ubos nga presyon; ang hangin molusad palibot sa mata, nagpugong sa pagporma sa panganod.

q: Why is using an air pump faster and easier than blowing with your mouth to fill a balloon?
options: The pump pushes a lot of air with each stroke, while blowing with your mouth is tiring and slower
The pump uses special compressed gas that fills the balloon in one burst
A pump balloon is made of stronger rubber so less air is needed
The pump removes moisture from the air so the balloon fills more quickly
explanation: A pump pushes a lot of air with each stroke, while blowing by mouth is tiring and slower.
fact_tl: Maaari mong punuin ang lobo gamit ang iyong bibig o gamit ng air pump. Mas mabilis at mas madali ang pump dahil nagtutulak ito ng maraming hangin sa bawat dampi, samtang ang paghipan gamit ang bibig ay nakakapagod at mas mabagal.
fact_bis: Mahimo nimong pun-on ang lobo gamit ang imong baba o gamit ang air pump. Mas paspas ug mas sayon ang pump tungod kay nagtulod kini og daghang hangin matag duso, samtang ang paghuyop gamit ang baba makakapoy ug mas hinay.

q: Where does the colasisi search for its food?
options: In the canopy and middle layers of the forest
Along the riverbanks and mudflats near water
On the ground among fallen leaves and roots
In open fields and grasslands near farms
explanation: The colasisi searches for food in the canopy and middle layers of the forest.
fact_tl: Naghahanap ng pagkain ang kulasisi sa tuktok at gitna ng mga puno sa kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang kulasisi mangita ug pagkaon sa tuktok ug taliwala nga bahin sa mga kahoy sa lasang.

q: In what year was Sarao Motors — the famous Filipino jeepney manufacturer — founded?
explanation: Sarao Motors was founded in 1953.
fact_tl: Itinatag ang Sarao Motors noong 1953.
fact_bis: Ang Sarao Motors gitukod niadtong 1953.

q: How does a bird learn to avoid eating a bad-tasting butterfly?
options: It eats one bad-tasting butterfly, remembers that color, and then avoids all butterflies with that color
It is born knowing which colors of butterflies taste bad and avoids them from birth
Other birds warn it by making special alarm calls near bad-tasting butterflies
Its sharp eyesight allows it to smell the butterfly's poison before biting
explanation: Birds are not born afraid of colorful butterflies — they learn by eating one bad-tasting butterfly and then remembering to avoid that color.
fact_tl: Hindi ipinanganak na takot sa makukulay na paru-paro ang mga ibon. Natututo sila! Kapag minsang nakakain sila ng paru-paro na masama ang lasa, naaalala nila ang kulay nito. Pagkatapos, iniiwasan na nila ang lahat ng paru-paro na ganoon ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam wala matawo nga mahadlok sa mabulukon nga alibangbang. Makakat-on sila! Kausa nga makakaon og baho nga alibangbang, mahinumdom sila sa kolor niini. Human niana, ilang likayan ang tanang alibangbang nga adunay maong kolor.

q: How does the size of a sand grain compare to gravel and fine mud?
options: Sand grains are smaller than gravel but larger than fine mud or dust
Sand grains are larger than gravel but smaller than fine mud
Sand grains are the same size as both gravel and fine mud
