fact_bis: Usa sa mga nag-unang hinungdan sa malnutrisyon mao ang kakabos, kay dili makaya sa pipila ka pamilya ang pagpalit og igong masustansya nga pagkaon.

q: How do drought-tolerant corn varieties help farmers in dry areas?
options: They can produce a good harvest even under water-stress conditions with little rainfall
They grow taller than ordinary corn so their roots can reach deeper underground water
They require twice as much fertilizer to make up for the lack of water
They only need to be planted once and then regrow on their own every season
explanation: Drought-tolerant corn varieties developed by researchers allow farmers in low-rainfall areas to produce a good harvest even when water is scarce.
fact_tl: Ang mga drought-tolerant na uri ng mais ay nagawa ng mga mananaliksik para sa mga magsasakang nakatira sa mga lugar na may mababang ulan—ang mga ito ay nakakaani nang mabuti kahit na kulang ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga drought-tolerant nga klase sa mais gihimo sa mga mananaliksik para sa mga mag-uuma sa mga lugar nga kulang og ulan; kining mga klase makaani og maayo bisan sa kulang sa tubig.

q: Which river is the longest in the Philippines?
options: The Cagayan River in northern Luzon
The Pasig River in Metro Manila
The Agusan River in Mindanao
The Pampanga River in Central Luzon
explanation: The Cagayan River, found in the northern part of Luzon, is the longest river in the Philippines and supports a lot of farming in the area.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Cagayan ang pinakamahabang ilog sa Pilipinas. Matatagpuan ito sa hilagang bahagi ng Luzon at malaki ang naitutulong nito sa pagsasaka sa lugar na iyon.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Cagayan mao ang pinakataas nga suba sa Pilipinas. Makita kini sa amihanang bahin sa Luzon ug dako kini og tabang sa pag-uma niana nga lugar.

q: Why do some omnivores like humans have forward-facing eyes while others have side-facing eyes?
options: Forward-facing eyes help judge distance to food, while side-facing eyes help watch for danger while feeding
Forward-facing eyes help spot predators, while side-facing eyes help find ripe fruit
All omnivores have forward-facing eyes; side-facing eyes are only found in herbivores
Eye position in omnivores depends only on body size, not on how they find food
explanation: Omnivores can have different eye positions — forward-facing eyes (like humans) help judge how far food is, while side-facing eyes help watch for danger while feeding.
fact_tl: Iba't iba ang posisyon ng mata ng mga omnivore. Ang ilan tulad ng tao ay may matang nakaharap sa unahan para tantyahin ang layo ng pagkain, samantalang ang iba ay may matang nasa gilid para makakita ng kaaway habang kumakain.
fact_bis: Lainlain ang posisyon sa mata sa mga omnivore. Ang uban sama sa tawo adunay mata nga nag-atubang sa unahan aron pagbana-bana sa gilay-on sa pagkaon, samtang ang uban adunay mata sa kilid aron makakita og kaaway samtang nagkaon.

q: How long is a goat pregnant before giving birth?
options: About 5 months, or roughly 150 days
About 9 months, similar to a human pregnancy
About 2 months, which is very short for a large animal
About 12 months, the same as a full calendar year
explanation: A goat is pregnant for about 5 months, or roughly 150 days.
fact_tl: Ang kambing ay nagbubuntis nang halos 5 buwan, o mga 150 araw.
fact_bis: Ang kanding mabdos ug mga 5 ka bulan, o mga 150 ka adlaw.

q: Why does old silver jewelry turn black over time?
options: Silver slowly reacts with sulfur in the air, forming a thin black layer
Silver absorbs moisture from the air, and the water causes rust to form
Silver overheats from sunlight and the surface chars like burnt metal
Silver reacts with oxygen the same way iron does, forming black silver oxide
explanation: Old silver jewelry turns black because silver slowly reacts with sulfur in the air, forming a thin black layer that makes it lose its shine.
fact_tl: Kapag nangingitim ang lumang pilak na kwintas o medalya, tanda iyon ng mabagal na reaksyong kemikal. Ang pilak ay dahan-dahang nagreaksyon sa sulfur sa hangin at bumuo ng manipis na itim na patong — kaya nawawalan ng kintab ang alahas.
fact_bis: Kon mangitom ang daang plata nga kwintas o medalya, timailhan kana sa hinay nga reaksiyong kemikal. Ang plata hinay-hinay nga nag-react sa sulfur sa hangin ug naghimo og nipis nga itom nga patong — mao nga mawad-an og sidlak ang alahas.

q: What two products does yeast make when it ferments sugar without oxygen?
options: Alcohol and carbon dioxide
Water and oxygen
Lactic acid and nitrogen
Carbon monoxide and starch
explanation: When oxygen is absent, yeast ferments sugars and produces alcohol and carbon dioxide — the CO2 puffs up bread dough while the alcohol is retained in fermented drinks.
fact_tl: Ang yeast ay gumagawa ng fermentation kapag walang oxygen — ginagawang alcohol at carbon dioxide ang sugars, na ginagamit sa pagluluto ng tinapay (ang CO2 ay nagpapabukol ng masa) at paggawa ng alak (ang alcohol ay nanatili).
fact_bis: Ang yeast nagbuhat sa fermentation sa dihang walay oxygen — gipretso niini ang mga sugar ngadto sa alcohol ug carbon dioxide, gigamit sa pagluto og tinapay (ang CO2 nagpatubo sa masa) ug paghimo og mga inumon nga may alcohol (ang alcohol nagpabilin).

q: How does a woodpecker's skull avoid being damaged when it pecks hard wood?
options: A special tongue bone called the hyoid wraps around the skull and absorbs the shock like a seatbelt
Extra thick bone plates inside the skull cushion the brain each time the beak strikes
Strong neck muscles act like springs and absorb vibrations before they reach the skull
A layer of soft cartilage between the beak and skull spreads out the impact evenly
explanation: A woodpecker's hyoid bone wraps around the skull and acts like a seatbelt, absorbing the shock from each peck.
fact_tl: Ang espesyal na buto na may kaugnayan sa dila (hyoid) ng woodpecker ay umiikot sa bungo at parang seatbelt na sumasalo sa yanig.
fact_bis: Ang pinasahi nga buto sa dila (hyoid) sa woodpecker molibot sa bagol ug daw seatbelt nga mosalo sa pag-uyog.

q: Why do astronauts on the International Space Station need to exercise for a couple of hours every day?
options: Without gravity, their bones and muscles get weaker, so exercise keeps them strong
The spacecraft vibrates constantly, so exercise helps them keep their balance
They need to generate body heat because the station is extremely cold inside
Space food provides very little energy, so they exercise to stimulate their appetite
explanation: Without gravity, astronauts' bones and muscles get weaker, so they must exercise every day to maintain their strength.
fact_tl: Kailangang mag-ehersisyo ang mga astronaut ng ilang oras araw-araw dahil humihina ang kanilang mga buto at kalamnan kapag walang grabidad.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut kinahanglan mag-ehersisyo og pipila ka oras matag adlaw kay ang ilang mga bukog ug unod magluya kon walay grabidad.

q: Why is it especially important to protect the shorelines of the Philippine islands?
options: Because the shoreline is the first to take strong waves, storms, and rising seas, protecting the people and animals living near the coast
Because the shoreline is where all the freshwater rivers meet the sea and must stay clean for drinking
Because the shoreline is the only place where Philippine fishing boats can safely land their catch
Because the shoreline soil is the most fertile in the country and is used to grow rice and vegetables
explanation: Because the Philippines is made of islands, the shoreline faces strong waves, storms, and rising seas, so caring for mangroves, sand, and clean coasts protects communities near the sea.
fact_tl: Dahil isla-isla ang Pilipinas, ang baybayin ang unang sumasalo sa malalakas na alon, bagyo, at pagtaas ng dagat. Kapag nasira ito o napuno ng basura, walang proteksyon ang mga tao at hayop na nakatira malapit sa dagat. Kaya importanteng pangalagaan ang mga bakawan, buhangin, at malinis na baybayin sa bawat isla.
fact_bis: Tungod kay isla-isla ang Pilipinas, ang baybayon mao ang unang mosalo sa kusog nga balod, bagyo, ug pagsaka sa dagat. Kung kini madaot o mapuno og basura, mawad-an og panalipod ang mga tawo ug hayop nga nagpuyo duol sa dagat. Mao nga importante atimanon ang mga bakhaw, balas, ug limpyo nga baybayon sa matag isla.

q: Why do atoms form bonds with each other?
options: Because bonded atoms have lower energy and are more stable than atoms that are separated
Because atoms are attracted by gravity and pull together like planets and moons
Because atoms need to share electrons to avoid being destroyed by the nucleus
Because bonding increases the size of atoms, making them harder to break apart
explanation: Atoms bond because together they have lower energy and are more stable than they are when separated.
fact_tl: Nagbi-bond ang mga atomo dahil mas mababa ang enerhiya at mas matatag sila kapag magkasama kaysa kapag hiwa-hiwalay.
fact_bis: Magbugkos ang mga atomo tungod kay mas ubos ang enerhiya ug mas malig-on sila kon magkauban kaysa kon magbulag.

q: How many wheels did the very first car — the Benz Patent-Motorwagen — have?
options: Three wheels
Four wheels
Two wheels
Six wheels
explanation: The first car, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, had three wheels, not the four wheels we are used to today.
fact_tl: Ang unang kotse, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, ay may tatlong gulong.
fact_bis: Ang unang awto, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, adunay tulo ka ligid.

q: Where does a swinging pendulum eventually stop once all its energy runs out?
options: At its central rest position in the middle of its swing
At the highest point of its last swing on one side
At a random position wherever it happens to slow down
At the lowest point on the right side of its swing
explanation: A pendulum always has a central rest position, and it stops there once all its energy is gone.
fact_tl: Ang pendulum o spring ay laging may gitnang pahingahang punto, at dito ito huminto kapag nawala na ang lahat ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang pendulum o spring kanunay adunay tunga nga pahulay nga punto, ug didto kini mohunong kon mahurot na ang tanang enerhiya niini.

q: What happens at mid-ocean ridges where tectonic plates pull apart?
options: The mantle rises and partly melts to form brand-new crust on the ocean floor
The ocean floor cracks open and swallows seawater down into the mantle
Old ocean crust piles up at the ridge, making underwater mountain ranges
Hot water jets called geysers shoot up and harden into new rock on the surface
explanation: At mid-ocean ridges where plates pull apart, the mantle rises and partly melts to create brand-new crust on the ocean floor.
fact_tl: Sa mga mid-ocean ridge kung saan naghihiwalay ang mga plato, umaakyat ang mantle at bahagyang natutunaw para gumawa ng bagong crust sa sahig ng karagatan.
fact_bis: Sa mga mid-ocean ridge diin magbulag ang mga plato, ang mantle mosaka ug bahin nga matunaw aron maghimo og bag-ong crust sa salog sa dagat.

q: What do Filipinos do with marble quarried from places like Romblon in the Philippines?
options: They cut it into tiles, floors, and statues
They grind it into powder for making cement
They melt it in furnaces to produce construction steel
They dry it and use it as fuel for cooking
explanation: In the Philippines, marble is quarried from places like Romblon and made into tiles, floors, and statues.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang marmol ay kinukuha sa mga quarry tulad ng sa Romblon at ginagawang tile, sahig, at rebulto.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang marmol ginakuha sa mga quarry sama sa Romblon ug ginahimong tile, salog, ug estatuwa.

q: What causes anemia?
options: Too few red blood cells or too little hemoglobin in the blood, often due to a lack of iron
Too many white blood cells fighting an infection and crowding out red blood cells
A shortage of platelets that makes it hard for the blood to carry oxygen
An overload of iron in the diet that damages the cells that carry oxygen
explanation: Anemia occurs when the number of red blood cells or the amount of hemoglobin is too low, often caused by a lack of iron in the diet.
fact_tl: Ang anemia ay nangyayari kapag mababa ang bilang ng red blood cells o hemoglobin sa dugo, na maaaring sanhi ng kakulangan ng bakal sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang anemia mahitabo kung mubog ang bilang sa red blood cells o hemoglobin sa dugo, kasagarang sanhi sa kakulang sa iron sa pagkaon.

q: What causes ocean currents to curve to the right in the Northern Hemisphere?
options: The Coriolis effect caused by Earth's rotation
The pull of the Moon's gravity on the ocean surface
Differences in water temperature between the equator and the poles
Strong winds that always blow from west to east across the ocean
explanation: The Coriolis effect, caused by Earth's rotation, deflects ocean currents to the right in the Northern Hemisphere.
fact_tl: Ang Coriolis effect, dulot ng pag-ikot ng Daigdig, ang nagpapaliko sa mga agos ng karagatan pakanan sa Hilagang Hemispero.
fact_bis: Ang Coriolis effect, gumikan sa pagtuyok sa Yuta, maoy hinungdan nga ang mga sulog sa dagat moliko sa tuo sa Amihanang Hemispero.

q: How does fluid from body tissues enter the lymphatic system?
options: Through tiny tubes with open ends that allow extra tissue fluid to flow in
Through valves that open only when the heart pumps blood backward
Through pores in the skin that filter fluid from outside the body
Through the walls of blood capillaries that push fluid directly into lymph vessels
explanation: The lymphatic system begins with tiny tubes that have open ends, allowing extra tissue fluid to flow into them.
fact_tl: Nagsisimula ang sistemang limpatiko sa maliliit na tubo na may bukas na dulo upang makapasok ang sobrang likido mula sa tisyu.
fact_bis: Ang sistema sa limpa magsugod sa gagmay nga tubo nga may abli nga tumoy aron makasulod ang sobra nga likido gikan sa tisyu.

q: What are the vertical columns in the periodic table called, and what do they tell us?
options: Groups — elements in the same group share similar properties
Periods — elements in the same period have the same number of neutrons
Series — elements in the same series react with each other easily
Families — elements in the same family always have the same mass
explanation: The vertical columns in the periodic table are called groups, and elements in the same group share similar chemical properties.
fact_tl: Ang mga patayong hanay sa periodic table ay tinatawag na mga pangkat o groups, at ang mga elemento sa isang pangkat ay may magkatulad na katangian.
fact_bis: Ang patindog nga mga laray sa periodic table gitawag nga mga grupo, ug ang mga elemento sa samang grupo adunay susama nga mga kinaiya.

q: What shape does a liquid take?
options: The shape of whatever container holds it
Its own fixed shape that never changes
A perfectly round shape because of surface tension
A flat shape because gravity pulls it down
explanation: A liquid does not have its own fixed shape — it takes the shape of whatever container holds it, like water taking the shape of a glass or a bucket.
fact_tl: Hindi may sariling hugis ang likido — kumukuha ito ng hugis ng lalagyan nito. Ang tubig sa isang baso ay may hugis ng baso; sa isang balde ay may hugis ng balde.
fact_bis: Walay kaugalingong hugis ang likido — nagkuha kini sa hugis sa bisan unsang sudlanan niini. Ang tubig sa baso adunay hugis sa baso; sa balde adunay hugis sa balde.

q: A person sits still inside a moving bus. How can both statements be true: 'the person is at rest' and 'the person is moving'?
options: The person is at rest compared to other passengers in the bus, but moving fast compared to someone standing on the road
The person is resting their muscles, but their heart is still beating which counts as motion
One statement must be wrong — a person is either moving or at rest, never both at the same time
The person appears at rest from inside but the bus itself is not really moving, only the road moves backward
explanation: Motion is always measured relative to a chosen reference frame — the same person can be at rest compared to fellow passengers but moving fast compared to someone on the road.
fact_tl: Ang galaw ay palaging sinusukat kaugnay ng isang piniling sanggunian (reference frame): ang nakaupo sa bus ay tigil kumpara sa kapwa pasahero ngunit mabilis na gumagalaw kumpara sa taong nasa kalsada.
fact_bis: Ang lihok kanunay gisukod kalabot sa usa ka gipiling reference frame: ang naglingkod sa bus hunong kumpara sa isigka-pasahero apan paspas nga naglihok kumpara sa tawo nga naa sa dalan.

q: Why is iodine added to salt in the Philippines?
options: Because the thyroid gland needs iodine, and iodized salt helps prevent goiter
Because iodine kills bacteria in food and keeps salt from clumping together
Because iodine makes salt taste stronger, so people need to use less of it
Because iodine replaces iron that is lost when food is cooked in salt water
explanation: The thyroid gland needs iodine to work properly, so salt in the Philippines is mixed with iodine to prevent goiter.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng thyroid ng yodo, kaya sa Pilipinas ay hinahaluan ng yodo ang asin para maiwasan ang goiter.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid nagkinahanglan og yodo, mao nga sa Pilipinas gisagolan og yodo ang asin aron malikayan ang goiter.

q: Who took the famous X-ray image of DNA known as Photo 51?
options: Rosalind Franklin
Marie Curie
James Watson
Dorothy Hodgkin
explanation: Rosalind Franklin took the X-ray image of DNA known as Photo 51, which was key evidence for understanding DNA's structure.
fact_tl: Si Rosalind Franklin ang kumuha ng X-ray na larawan ng DNA na tinawag na Photo 51.
fact_bis: Si Rosalind Franklin ang nagkuha sa X-ray nga hulagway sa DNA nga gitawag og Photo 51.

q: Why is carbon called the element of life?
options: Because carbon is found in all living things
Because carbon is the lightest element that all animals breathe
Because carbon is the most common element found in air and water
Because carbon is the only element that can form crystals like diamonds
explanation: Carbon is called the element of life because it is found in all living things.
fact_tl: Ang carbon ay isang elementong bumubuo sa lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay, kaya tinatawag itong elemento ng buhay.
fact_bis: Ang carbon usa ka elemento nga makita sa tanang buhing butang, mao nga gitawag kining elemento sa kinabuhi.

q: What happens to the light bulb in a circuit when the switch is closed?
options: The light turns on because electricity can now flow
The light turns off because electricity is blocked
The light flickers because the circuit is unstable
The light stays on whether the switch is open or closed
explanation: When a switch is closed, it completes the circuit and electricity flows, turning the light on.
fact_tl: Ang switch ay pumuputol o nagbubukas ng sirkito; kapag sarado ito, dumadaloy ang kuryente at nagliliwanag ang ilaw.
fact_bis: Ang switch maoy mobungkag o motibuok sa sirkito; kung sirado kini, modagayday ang kuryente ug modan-ag ang suga.

q: How does the tamaraw's social behavior differ from the carabao's?
options: The tamaraw lives alone, while the carabao lives in herds
The tamaraw lives in large herds, while the carabao lives alone
Both the tamaraw and carabao live in herds
Both the tamaraw and carabao are solitary animals
explanation: Unlike the carabao that lives in herds, the tamaraw is usually solitary and stays alone.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng kalabaw na nasa kawan, ang tamaraw ay kadalasang nag-iisa o mag-isa lamang.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa kalabaw nga naa sa panon, ang tamaraw kasagaran nag-inusara lamang.

q: Which group lists all four main parts of a typical plant?
options: Roots, stem, leaves, and flowers
Roots, trunk, branches, and fruits
Stem, leaves, fruits, and seeds
Roots, bark, leaves, and buds
explanation: The four main parts of a typical plant are roots, stem, leaves, and flowers.
fact_tl: Ang apat na pangunahing bahagi ng karaniwang halaman ay: ugat, tangkay, dahon, at bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang upat ka panguna nga bahin sa kasagaran nga tanom mao ang: gamot, punoan, dahon, ug bulak.

q: Why do we naturally curl up our body when we feel very cold?
options: To reduce the body surface that loses heat
To speed up blood flow to the arms and legs
To make the lungs take in more oxygen
To help the stomach digest food faster
explanation: When we curl up or hug ourselves, less body surface is exposed, so less heat escapes from the body.
fact_tl: Kapag nilalamig, gusto nating magsiksik o yakapin ang sarili para mas kaunti ang init na nawawala sa katawan.
fact_bis: Kung ginawon, gusto natong mokulukos o mogakos sa atong kaugalingon aron gamay ra ang kainit nga mawala sa lawas.

q: How do the ears allow us to hear a sound?
options: Vibrations in the air cause parts inside the ear to vibrate
The ear converts light waves into nerve signals
Tiny bones in the ear produce sound on their own
The ear absorbs heat from sound waves and sends signals
explanation: We hear sound because vibrations in the air make parts inside our ear vibrate too.
fact_tl: Naririnig natin ang tunog dahil ang mga yanig sa hangin ay nagpapayanig sa loob ng ating tainga.
fact_bis: Madungog nato ang tingog tungod kay ang mga uyog sa hangin makapauyog usab sa sulod sa atong dalunggan.

q: What is significant about the Malampaya gas field near Palawan in the Philippines?
options: It supplied natural gas used to run power plants in Luzon
It is the largest coal mine in Southeast Asia
It produces crude oil exported to Japan and China
It is a geothermal field that heats homes in Mindanao
explanation: The Malampaya gas field near Palawan supplied natural gas used to run power plants in Luzon, showing the Philippines has its own fossil fuel resources.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang Malampaya gas field malapit sa Palawan ay nagbigay ng natural gas na ginamit para magpaandar ng mga power plant sa Luzon. Ipinapakita nito na may sariling fossil fuel resource din ang ating bansa.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang Malampaya gas field duol sa Palawan naghatag og natural gas nga gigamit sa pagpadagan sa mga power plant sa Luzon. Nagpakita kini nga ang atong nasud naa say kaugalingong fossil fuel.

q: How many seconds are there in one minute?
options: 60 seconds
100 seconds
24 seconds
30 seconds
explanation: There are 60 seconds in one minute.
fact_tl: May 60 segundo sa isang minuto.
fact_bis: Adunay 60 ka segundo sa usa ka minuto.

q: Where in the Philippines does the tweezer-beaked shrew rat live?
options: Only on the island of Luzon
Only on the island of Mindanao
Throughout all major islands of the Philippines
Only on the island of Palawan
explanation: The tweezer-beaked shrew rat lives only on the island of Luzon in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang tweezer-beaked shrew rat ay matatagpuan lamang sa isla ng Luzon sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang tweezer-beaked shrew rat makit-an lamang sa isla sa Luzon sa Pilipinas.

q: What is a storm surge?
options: A sudden rise in sea water pushed toward the coast by a strong typhoon
A very strong wind that causes trees to fall inland
Heavy rainfall that floods rivers and low-lying areas
A giant ocean wave caused by an underwater earthquake
explanation: A storm surge is a sudden rise in sea water pushed toward the coast by a strong typhoon.
fact_tl: Ang storm surge ay ang biglang pagtaas ng tubig-dagat na itinutulak ng malakas na bagyo papunta sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang storm surge mao ang kalit nga pagsaka sa tubig-dagat nga giduso sa kusog nga bagyo padulong sa baybayon.

q: Why is kamagong sometimes called 'iron wood'?
options: Because it is an extremely hard, dark wood
Because it contains iron minerals in its bark
Because it is used to make iron tools in the Philippines
Because it grows near iron ore deposits in Mindanao
explanation: Kamagong is called iron wood because it is an extremely hard, dark type of wood.
fact_tl: Ang kamagong ay isang sobrang tigas at maitim na kahoy na tinatawag ding iron wood.
fact_bis: Ang kamagong usa ka gahi kaayo ug itom nga kahoy nga gitawag usab og iron wood.

q: Approximately how tall is Mount Everest above sea level?
options: 8,849 meters
5,642 meters
6,194 meters
7,556 meters
explanation: Mount Everest reaches a height of 8,849 meters above sea level, making it the tallest mountain in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Everest ay umaabot sa taas na 8,849 metro mula sa lebel ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Everest moabot sa taas nga 8,849 ka metro gikan sa lebel sa dagat.

q: Why are spiders considered helpful to people?
options: They eat mosquitoes and other pest insects
They produce silk used to make clothing
They pollinate flowers just like bees do
They loosen the soil so plants can grow better
explanation: Spiders help people because they eat mosquitoes and other pest insects.
fact_tl: Nakakatulong ang gagamba sa tao dahil kumakain ito ng mga lamok at iba pang nakakaperwisyong insekto.
fact_bis: Makatabang ang lawalawa sa tawo kay mokaon kini ug mga lamok ug uban pang makadaot nga insekto.

q: Why do shellfish like oysters and mussels become dangerous to eat during a red tide?
options: They feed on toxic algae that have multiplied rapidly in the sea
They are infected by a bacteria that spreads through seawater
Their shells absorb poisonous chemicals from factory waste
They produce their own toxins when water temperature rises
explanation: Red tide occurs when toxic dinoflagellate algae multiply rapidly, and shellfish that feed on them become dangerous to eat.
fact_tl: Ang red tide ay nangyayari kapag ang mga nakakalason na dinoflagellate algae ay mabilis na nagparami sa karagatan — ang mga talaba at tahong na kumain ng mga algae na ito ay nagiging mapanganib na kainin.
fact_bis: Ang red tide mahitabo kung ang mga nakakasamok nga dinoflagellate algae paspas nga nagparami sa dagat — ang mga talaba ug tahong nga mokaon niini nga mga algae mahimong delikadong kaonon.

q: Why can radio waves be used to communicate with astronauts in space, even though there is no air there?
options: Radio waves do not need a medium and can travel through empty space
Radio waves travel faster through a vacuum than through air
Astronauts wear helmets that convert sound waves to radio signals
Radio waves bounce off the Moon and reach the astronauts
explanation: Unlike sound, which needs air to travel, radio waves can move through completely empty space, making communication with space possible.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng tunog na kailangan ng hangin para maglakbay, ang radio waves ay kayang dumaan sa ganap na walang laman na kalawakan. Kaya nakakausap natin ang mga satellite at astronaut sa space gamit ang radyo.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa tingog nga nagkinahanglan og hangin aron mobiyahe, ang radio waves makaagi sa hingpit nga walay sulod nga kawanangan. Mao nga makigsulti kita sa mga satellite ug astronaut sa space gamit ang radyo.

q: At what temperature does ice start to melt?
options: 0 degrees Celsius
10 degrees Celsius
100 degrees Celsius
32 degrees Celsius on the Celsius scale
explanation: Ice melts at 0 degrees Celsius (0 C), which is also equal to 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
fact_tl: Ang yelo ay natutunaw sa 0 degrees Celsius (0 C), o 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
fact_bis: Ang yelo matunaw sa 0 ka degrees Celsius (0 C), o 32 degrees Fahrenheit.

q: What happens to the ocean when it absorbs extra carbon dioxide from the air?
options: Its pH drops and it becomes more acidic, harming corals and shelled animals
Its temperature rises rapidly, causing fish to die
It becomes less salty, which confuses sea creatures
It releases oxygen, which makes the water cleaner
explanation: As the ocean absorbs extra carbon dioxide, its pH drops and it becomes more acidic, which harms corals and shelled animals like clams.
fact_tl: Habang sumisipsip ang dagat ng dagdag na carbon dioxide mula sa hangin, bumababa ang pH nito at nagiging mas acidic — na nakakasama sa mga coral at mga hayop na may shell tulad ng kabibe.
fact_bis: Samtang ang dagat mosuyop og dugang carbon dioxide gikan sa hangin, mokunhod ang pH niini ug mahimong mas asido — nga makadaot sa mga coral ug sa mga hayop nga adunay kabhang sama sa kabibe.

q: How does a steamer cook puto without making it soaked in water?
options: Boiling water at the bottom creates steam that rises and cooks the food
The steamer uses electricity to heat the puto directly from below
The lid traps hot air that slowly bakes the puto inside
The water splashes up and soaks the puto while cooking
explanation: Water at the bottom of the steamer boils and the rising steam cooks the food above it, so puto comes out moist but not soaked.
fact_tl: Ang puto, siopao, at siomai ay niluluto gamit ang singaw! May tubig sa ibaba ng steamer na pinapakulo, at ang umaakyat na singaw ang nagluluto sa pagkain sa itaas. Kaya malambot at basa-basa ang puto pero hindi lubog sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang puto, siopao, ug siomai giluto gamit ang singaw! Naay tubig sa ubos sa lansungan nga gipabukal, ug ang nagsaka nga singaw maoy magluto sa pagkaon sa ibabaw. Mao nga humok ug basa-basa ang puto apan dili nalubog sa tubig.

q: Where do macaques typically live in the Philippines?
options: In forests and mangrove swamps
In open grasslands and rice fields
In coral reefs and coastal waters
In caves and rocky mountain cliffs
explanation: Macaques live in forests and mangrove swamps in many parts of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang mga unggoy ay naninirahan sa mga gubat at kagubatan ng bakawan sa iba't ibang bahagi ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang mga unggoy nagpuyo sa mga lasang ug kalasangan sa bakhaw sa nagkalain-laing bahin sa Pilipinas.

q: Why can ferns grow taller than mosses?
options: Ferns have tiny tubes that carry water through their body, while mosses do not
Ferns grow in sunnier places that give them more energy
Ferns have broader leaves that catch more rainfall
Ferns produce more seeds than mosses
explanation: Ferns have tiny tubes that carry water through their body, allowing them to grow taller than mosses, which have no such tubes.
fact_tl: May mga maliliit na tubo ang pako na nagdadala ng tubig sa buong katawan nito, kaya mas matangkad itong tumubo kaysa sa lumot na walang ganoong tubo.
fact_bis: Ang pako adunay gagmayng tubo nga magdala og tubig sa tibuok niyang lawas, busa makatubo kini nga mas habog kaysa sa lumot nga walay ingon nga tubo.

q: What happens when light passes through a true solution, like salt water?
options: Light passes straight through without scattering
Light bounces off particles and creates a visible beam
Light is absorbed by the particles and the liquid warms up
Light slows down and causes the liquid to glow
explanation: In a true solution, light passes straight through without scattering, so there is no Tyndall effect.
fact_tl: Sa tunay na solusyon, dumadaan ang liwanag nang hindi ikinakalat kaya walang Tyndall effect.
fact_bis: Sa tinuod nga solusyon, moagi ang kahayag nga dili ikatag mao nga walay Tyndall effect.

q: How do sharks help keep coral reefs healthy?
options: They control populations of herbivorous fish and prevent overgrazing of algae
They clean the reef by eating dead coral and debris
They produce chemicals that help coral grow faster
They carry oxygen-rich water over the reef with their movement
explanation: Sharks act as keystone species by controlling populations of herbivorous fish, preventing overgrazing of the algae that healthy coral needs.
fact_tl: Ang mga pating ay gumaganap ng papel na keystone species sa coral reef sa pamamagitan ng pagkontrol ng populasyon ng mga herbivorous fish, na nagpapigil na maging masyadong maraming mga isda na kumakain ng mga coral-maintaining algae.
fact_bis: Ang mga pating nagdula isip keystone species sa coral reef pinaagi sa pagkontrol sa populasyon sa mga herbivorous fish, nagpugngan sa sobrang pagkaon sa algae nga gikinahanglan sa maayo nga coral.

q: How quickly can a mosquito complete its whole life cycle in warm weather?
options: In about one to two weeks
In about one to two days
In about one to two months
In about six months
explanation: In warm weather, the mosquito's whole life cycle can finish in only about one to two weeks.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na panahon, maaaring matapos ang buong siklo ng buhay ng lamok sa loob lamang ng mga isa hanggang dalawang linggo.
fact_bis: Sa init nga panahon, mahuman ang tibuok siklo sa kinabuhi sa lamok sulod lang sa mga usa ngadto sa duha ka semana.

q: What useful food product can be made from dried jackfruit seeds?
options: Flour that can be mixed into bread and snacks
Oil that can be used for cooking
Sugar syrup used as a sweetener
Vinegar used for pickling vegetables
explanation: In some places, jackfruit seeds are dried and ground into flour that can be mixed into bread and snacks.
fact_tl: Sa ibang lugar, pinapatuyo at ginigiling ang buto ng langka para gawing harina na pwedeng ihalo sa tinapay at kakanin.
fact_bis: Sa ubang dapit, ang liso sa nangka gipauga ug gigaling aron mahimong harina nga isagol sa pan ug meryenda.

q: What is a galaxy?
options: A huge group of billions of stars, gas, and dust held together by gravity
A single very large star surrounded by many planets
A cloud of gas in space that eventually forms one star
A cluster of planets orbiting around a bright center
explanation: A galaxy is a huge group of billions of stars, gas, and dust held together by gravity.
fact_tl: Ang galaksiya ay isang napakalaking grupo ng bilyon-bilyong bituin, gas, at alikabok na pinagsasama ng gravity.
fact_bis: Ang galaksiya usa ka dako kaayo nga pundok sa bilyon-bilyon nga bituin, gas, ug abog nga gihiusa sa gravity.

q: Why does dry ice create thick fog when placed in warm water?
options: It sublimates quickly and the gas forms thick fog
It melts rapidly and the cold water evaporates as fog
It reacts chemically with water to produce a white gas
It freezes the air around it, forming ice crystals that look like fog
explanation: When dry ice is put in warm water, it sublimates fast and makes thick fog used in shows and stage effects.
fact_tl: Kapag inilagay ang dry ice sa mainit na tubig, mabilis itong nag-sublimate at gumagawa ng makapal na usok na ginagamit sa mga palabas.
fact_bis: Kon ibutang ang dry ice sa init nga tubig, dali kining mag-sublimate ug mohimo ug baga nga aso nga gamiton sa mga show ug stage effects.

q: When is a mangrove crab most active, and why does it hide during the day?
options: It is most active at night; by day it hides to avoid heat and predators
It is most active at dawn; it hides at night because it fears the dark
It is active all day but hides at high tide to avoid being swept away
It is most active at noon when the tide is lowest and food is easy to find
explanation: A mangrove crab is most active at night when it comes out for food; by day it hides in a burrow or the mud to avoid heat and predators.
fact_tl: Mas aktibo ang alimango kapag gabi — saka ito lumalabas para maghanap ng pagkain. Sa araw, madalas itong nagtatago sa lungga o sa putik para makaiwas sa init at sa mga kaaway. Kaya madalas sa gabi ito hinuhuli.
fact_bis: Mas aktibo ang alimango kung gabii — niana mogawas kini aron mangita og pagkaon. Sa adlaw, kasagaran motago kini sa lungag o sa lapok aron makalikay sa init ug sa mga kaaway. Mao nga kasagaran sa gabii kini dakpon.

q: How is iron ore turned into the steel used in buildings and bridges?
options: Iron ore is processed into iron, then mixed with a little carbon to make steel
Iron ore is melted and poured directly into molds to form steel beams
Iron ore is combined with aluminum to create a stronger metal called steel
Iron ore is crushed into powder, then compressed under high pressure to form steel
explanation: Iron ore is processed into iron, and the iron is mixed with a little carbon to make steel, which is used in buildings, bridges, ships, and cars.
fact_tl: Ang iron ore ay pinoproseso para maging bakal, at ang bakal ay hinahalo sa kaunting carbon para gawing asero (steel). Ang asero ang matibay na metal na ginagamit sa mga gusali, tulay, barko, at kotse.
fact_bis: Ang iron ore giproseso aron mahimong puthaw, ug ang puthaw gisagolan og gamay nga carbon aron himuong asero. Ang asero mao ang lig-on nga metal nga gigamit sa mga building, taytayan, barko, ug awto.

q: Why does a piece of iron sink when placed in water?
options: Iron has a much higher density than water
Iron is magnetic and water pulls it downward
Iron absorbs water quickly, making it too heavy to float
Iron has no air pockets inside, unlike objects that float
explanation: Iron sinks in water because its density (7.9 g/cm3) is much higher than water's density.
fact_tl: Lumulubog ang bakal (iron) sa tubig dahil mas mataas ang densidad nito (7.9 g/cm³) kaysa tubig.
fact_bis: Molunod ang puthaw (iron) sa tubig kay mas taas kaayo ang density niini (7.9 g/cm³) kaysa tubig.

q: What kind of teeth do carnivores have, and what do they use them for?
options: Sharp, pointed teeth — especially long canine teeth — to grab and tear meat
Flat, wide teeth to crush and grind plant leaves and stems
Many small, even teeth to chew both plants and animals
No teeth at all; they swallow their prey whole
explanation: Carnivores have sharp, pointed teeth, especially long canine teeth, which they use to grab and tear the meat of their prey.
fact_tl: Ang mga carnivore ay may matatalas at matutulis na ngipin, lalo na ang pangil, na ginagamit nila para humuli at punitin ang laman ng kanilang biktima.
fact_bis: Ang mga carnivore adunay hait ug talinis nga mga ngipon, ilabi na ang taas nga pangil, nga ilang gigamit aron modakop ug mogisi sa unod sa ilang biktima.

q: Where are a ray's eyes and mouth located on its body?
options: Eyes on top, mouth underneath
Eyes on the sides, mouth at the front
Eyes and mouth both on the underside
Eyes at the front, mouth on top
explanation: A ray's eyes are on top of its body while its mouth is underneath, so it can easily pick up food from the sea floor.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng pagi ay nasa ibabaw ng katawan, samantalang ang bibig nito ay nasa ilalim, kaya madali nitong nakukuha ang pagkain sa pusod ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa pagi naa sa ibabaw sa lawas, samtang ang baba niini naa sa ilalom, mao nga sayon niini makuha ang pagkaon sa salog sa dagat.

q: What is a secondary consumer in a food chain?
options: An animal that eats herbivores, usually a carnivore like a snake or hawk
A plant that produces its own food using sunlight
An animal that eats only plants and nothing else
A decomposer that breaks down dead animals and plants
explanation: Secondary consumers are animals that eat the herbivores — usually carnivores like a snake or bird that eats mice.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na kumakain naman ng mga herbivore ay tinatawag na secondary consumers — kadalasan ay carnivore (kumakain ng karne) tulad ng ahas o ibon na kumakain ng daga.
fact_bis: Ang mga hayop nga mokaon sa mga herbivore gitawag og secondary consumers — kasagaran carnivore (mokaon og unod) sama sa bitin o langgam nga mokaon og ilaga.

q: What are the two fixed reference points of the Celsius temperature scale?
options: 0 degrees C for freezing water and 100 degrees C for boiling water
0 degrees C for freezing water and 212 degrees C for boiling water
32 degrees C for freezing water and 100 degrees C for boiling water
0 degrees C for freezing water and 373 degrees C for boiling water
explanation: The Celsius scale has two fixed points — 0 degrees C for freezing water and 100 degrees C for boiling water at standard atmospheric pressure.
fact_tl: Ang Celsius scale ay may dalawang fixed point — ang 0°C para sa nagyelong tubig at ang 100°C para sa kumukulong tubig sa normal na atmospheric pressure.
fact_bis: Ang Celsius scale adunay duha ka fixed point — ang 0°C alang sa nagyelong tubig ug ang 100°C alang sa kumukulong tubig sa normal nga atmospheric pressure.

q: Why is sugarcane often called the 'heart of the Negros economy'?
options: Many families in Negros depend on sugarcane for their livelihood through planting, harvesting, milling, and selling sugar
Negros produces more sugarcane than any other country in Southeast Asia
The sugarcane in Negros is used to power all of the island's electricity plants
Negros exports more sugarcane juice than any other province in the Philippines
explanation: Many families in Negros depend on sugarcane for their livelihood — planting, harvesting, milling, and selling sugar — which is why it is called the heart of the Negros economy.
fact_tl: Maraming pamilya sa Negros ang umaasa sa tubo para sa hanapbuhay. May nagtatanim, nag-aani, nagtatrabaho sa gilingan, at nagbebenta ng asukal. Kaya tinatawag ang tubo na puso ng ekonomiya ng Negros.
fact_bis: Daghang pamilya sa Negros ang nagsalig sa tubo para sa panginabuhi. Adunay nagtanom, nag-ani, nagtrabaho sa gilingan, ug namaligya og asukal. Mao nga gitawag ang tubo nga kasingkasing sa ekonomiya sa Negros.

q: What is the difference between glucagon and insulin in controlling blood sugar?
options: Glucagon raises blood sugar while insulin lowers it
Glucagon lowers blood sugar while insulin raises it
Both glucagon and insulin raise blood sugar together
Both glucagon and insulin lower blood sugar together
explanation: Glucagon and insulin do opposite jobs: glucagon raises blood sugar, while insulin lowers it.
fact_tl: Magkasalungat ang trabaho ng glucagon at insulin: itinataas ng glucagon ang asukal sa dugo, samantalang ibinababa naman ito ng insulin.
fact_bis: Ang glucagon ug insulin nagkaatbang og trabaho: ang glucagon mopataas sa asukal sa dugo, samtang ang insulin mopaubos niini.

q: At what temperature does water boil at sea level on the Fahrenheit scale?
options: 212 degrees F
100 degrees F
32 degrees F
180 degrees F
explanation: Water boils at 212 degrees F at sea level on the Fahrenheit scale.
fact_tl: Ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 212 °F (212 degrees Fahrenheit) sa karaniwang antas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tubig mobukal sa 212 °F (212 degrees Fahrenheit) sa lebel sa dagat.

q: What are the first signs that a person may be breathing in carbon monoxide?
options: Headache, dizziness, nausea, and great tiredness
Chest pain, shortness of breath, and turning blue
Skin rash, watery eyes, and a runny nose
Sudden high fever, vomiting, and stiff neck
explanation: When someone breathes carbon monoxide, the first feelings are headache, dizziness, nausea, and great tiredness — almost like the flu.
fact_tl: Kapag may nalanghap na carbon monoxide, ang unang nararamdaman ay sakit ng ulo, pagkahilo, pagkaduwal, at sobrang pagod — parang trangkaso. Madalas hindi ito napapansin dahil mukhang ordinaryong sakit lang. Kaya kapag biglang sumakit ulo ng buong pamilya sa loob ng bahay, isang babala iyon.
fact_bis: Kung adunay nakaginhawa og carbon monoxide, ang unang bation kay sakit sa ulo, kalipong, kasukaon, ug grabe nga kakapoy — murag trangkaso. Sagad dili kini mamatikdan kay murag ordinaryo lang nga sakit. Mao nga kung kalit nga magsakit ang ulo sa tibuok pamilya sa sulod sa balay, usa kana ka pasidaan.

q: Which statement about blood type is correct?
options: Blood type is determined by genes from parents and cannot be changed
Blood type changes as a person grows from a child to an adult
Blood type is determined by what foods a person eats regularly
Blood type is influenced by the environment where a person lives
explanation: Blood type such as A, B, AB, or O is determined by genes inherited from parents — it is an inherited trait that cannot be changed.
fact_tl: Ang uri ng dugo tulad ng A, B, AB, o O ay tinutukoy ng mga gene na tinanggap mula sa magulang — ito ay isang inherited trait na hindi mababago.
fact_bis: Ang uri sa dugo sama sa A, B, AB, o O gibuot sa mga gene nga gipanunod gikan sa mga ginikanan — kini usa ka inherited trait nga dili mabag-o.

q: Who is the Celsius temperature scale named after?
options: Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer
Gabriel Fahrenheit, a German physicist
Lord Kelvin, a British scientist
Isaac Newton, a British mathematician
explanation: The Celsius temperature scale is named after Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer.
fact_tl: Ang Celsius scale (°C) ng temperatura ay ipinangalan kay Anders Celsius, isang Swedish na astronomo.
fact_bis: Ang Celsius scale (°C) sa temperatura ginganlan kang Anders Celsius, usa ka Swedish nga astronomo.

q: Which bird is about the size of a palm, flies very fast, and is often mistaken for a swallow?
options: A swiftlet
A sparrow
A hummingbird
A kingfisher
explanation: A swiftlet is a very small bird roughly the size of your palm, but it flies extremely fast and is often mistaken for a swallow because they look alike.
fact_tl: Ang swiftlet ay napakaliit na ibon, kasinliit lang halos ng iyong palad, pero napakabilis lumipad. Madalas itong napagkakamalang langay-langayan dahil magkahawig sila.
fact_bis: Ang swiftlet usa ka gamay kaayo nga langgam, halos sama ra kadako sa imong palad, apan paspas kaayo molupad. Kasagaran kini masaypan nga sayaw tungod kay managsama sila og dagway.

q: What does a single fixed pulley do to make lifting a load easier?
options: It changes the direction of force so you pull down to make the load go up
It reduces the amount of force needed to lift heavy objects
It multiplies your speed so you can lift things more quickly
It stores energy and releases it to lift objects automatically
explanation: A single pulley changes the direction of a force: you pull down to make a load go up.
fact_tl: Ang isang pulley ay nagbabago ng direksyon ng puwersa: humihila ka pababa para may umakyat na bagay pataas.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka pulley nag-usab sa direksyon sa puwersa: mobira ka paubos aron motaas ang gibira nga butang.

q: How are kernels arranged on a single corn cob?
options: Hundreds of kernels arranged in rows
A few dozen kernels scattered randomly
One large kernel grows at the tip of the cob
Kernels are attached to leaves, not to the cob
explanation: A single corn cob can hold hundreds of kernels arranged in rows.
fact_tl: Iisang busal ng mais ay maaaring magtaglay ng daan-daang butil na nakaayos sa mga hanay.
fact_bis: Usa lamang ka busal sa mais mahimong adunay gatusan ka lugas nga nahan-ay sa mga laray.

q: What is the maximum depth of Lake Lanao in the Philippines?
options: About 112 meters
About 45 meters
About 250 meters
About 600 meters
explanation: Lake Lanao reaches a maximum depth of about 112 meters.
fact_tl: Ang Lake Lanao ay umaabot sa lalim na halos 112 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Lake Lanao moabot sa kalawom nga mga 112 ka metro.

q: What does a Rafflesia flower look like before it blooms?
options: A brown cabbage poking out of a vine
A large red berry hanging from a branch
A tightly curled green fern frond
A small white mushroom growing from soil
explanation: Before blooming, the Rafflesia bud looks like a brown cabbage poking out of the vine.
fact_tl: Bago mamukadkad, ang usbong ng Rafflesia ay parang kulay-kayumanggi na repolyo na lumalabas sa baging.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mamuklad, ang usbong sa Rafflesia mura ug kolor-kape nga repolyo nga mogawas sa baging.

q: What disease can develop when the body lacks vitamin C for a long time?
options: Scurvy, where a person becomes weak and the gums bleed
Rickets, where the bones become soft and bend easily
Anemia, where a person feels very tired and looks pale
Pellagra, where the skin becomes rough and the mind is confused
explanation: When the body lacks vitamin C for a long time, scurvy can develop, causing weakness and bleeding gums.
fact_tl: Kapag matagal na kulang sa vitamin C ang katawan, puwedeng magkasakit na tinatawag na scurvy, kung saan nanghihina ang tao at dumudugo ang gilagid. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit kailangang regular kumain ng prutas.
fact_bis: Kon dugay nga kulang sa vitamin C ang lawas, mahimong magkasakit nga gitawag og scurvy, diin maluya ang tawo ug modugo ang lagus. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong kinahanglan kanunay mokaon og prutas.

q: What is unusual about swifts compared to most other birds?
options: They spend almost their whole life flying and rarely land on the ground
They cannot fly and instead run very fast on the ground
They only fly at night and sleep in the air during the day
They fly backwards more easily than they fly forward
explanation: Swifts spend almost their whole life flying and rarely land on the ground.
fact_tl: Ang mga swift ay halos buong buhay na lumilipad at bihirang dumapo sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga balinsasayaw halos tibuok kinabuhi naglupad ug talagsa ra mutugdon sa yuta.

q: Why does a vulture have a bald head with no feathers?
options: So its head stays clean when it feeds inside a carcass
So it can absorb more heat from the sun to stay warm
So it can fit its large head into tight crevices in rocks
So other vultures can recognize it more easily from a distance
explanation: A vulture has a bald head so it stays clean when it feeds inside a carcass — feathers there would get messy and carry bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang buwitre ay may kalbong ulo upang manatiling malinis ito kapag kumakain sa loob ng bangkay.
fact_bis: Ang buwitre adunay walay balhibo nga ulo aron magpabilin kining hinlo kon mokaon sulod sa patay na mananap.

q: What material makes up a ray's skeleton, and what does this have in common with sharks?
options: Cartilage — the same bendy tissue in your nose — making rays relatives of sharks
Bone, just like most fish, which is why rays are similar to tuna
A mix of cartilage and bone, which is unique to rays but not sharks
Hard calcium plates, similar to a turtle's shell, not related to sharks
explanation: A ray's skeleton is made of cartilage — the bendy tissue in your nose — not hard bone, which is why rays are relatives of sharks.
fact_tl: Ang balangkas ng pagi ay gawa sa kartilago (cartilage) — ang malambot na tisa na nasa ilong mo — hindi sa matigas na buto, kaya magkakamag-anak sila ng pating.
fact_bis: Ang kalansay sa pagi hinimo sa kartilago (cartilage) — ang humok nga unod sa imong ilong — dili sa gahi nga bukog, mao nga paryente sila sa iho.

q: What happens to the yeast in bread dough when it is baked in a hot oven?
options: The yeast dies and the rising stops
The yeast grows faster due to the heat and bread rises more
The yeast turns into bubbles of carbon dioxide gas permanently
The yeast becomes sugar, making the bread sweeter
explanation: When bread is baked in a hot oven, the yeast dies and the rising stops.
fact_tl: Kapag iniluluto na ang tinapay sa mainit na hurno, namamatay ang lebadura at huminto na ang pag-alsa.
fact_bis: Kon lutoon na ang tinapay sa mainit nga hurno, mamatay ang lebadura ug mohunong na ang pagsaka.

q: How do most snakes move from place to place?
options: In an S-shaped curve, like a wave flowing from head to tail
By rolling their body sideways like a log
By pushing off the ground with tiny hidden legs
By puffing up and bouncing forward
explanation: Most snakes move in an S-shaped wave pattern that flows from the head down to the tail.
fact_tl: Karaniwang gumagalaw ang ahas sa hugis-S na liko-liko, na parang alon na dumadaloy mula ulo hanggang buntot.
fact_bis: Kasagaran nga molihok ang bitin sa porma nga S nga liko-liko, sama sa balod nga moagos gikan sa ulo paingon sa ikog.

q: Which habit is one of the main causes of lung cancer?
options: Eating too much salty food
Long-term smoking
Staying up too late every night
Drinking too much soft drinks
explanation: Long-term smoking is one of the main causes of lung cancer.
fact_tl: Ang matagal na paninigarilyo ang isa sa pangunahing sanhi ng kanser sa baga.
fact_bis: Ang dugay nga pagpanigarilyo usa sa nag-unang hinungdan sa kanser sa baga.

q: What do tears and saliva have in common that helps keep your body safe?
options: They both carry oxygen to body cells
They both contain substances that can kill some germs
They both help your body digest vitamins
They both control your body temperature
explanation: Tears and saliva contain germ-killing substances that help protect the eyes and mouth.
fact_tl: Ang luha at laway ay may sangkap na nakapapatay ng ilang mikrobyo para mapanatiling ligtas ang mata at bibig.
fact_bis: Ang luha ug laway adunay sangkap nga makapatay sa pipila ka mikrobyo aron mapanalipdan ang mata ug baba.

q: What is the capital of the province of Southern Leyte?
options: Tacloban
Maasin
Ormoc
Baybay
explanation: The capital of Southern Leyte, a province in Eastern Visayas, is Maasin.
fact_tl: Ang Southern Leyte ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Eastern Visayas (VIII), na bahagi ng Visayas. Ang kabisera nito ay Maasin.
fact_bis: Ang Southern Leyte usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Eastern Visayas (VIII), nga bahin sa Visayas. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Maasin.

q: During the habagat season, which side of the Philippines gets the heaviest rain?
options: The eastern side, like the Pacific coast of Samar
The western side, like Metro Manila
The southern islands near Mindanao
The northern tip near Batanes
explanation: The habagat (southwest monsoon) hits the western side of the Philippines, bringing heavy rain and flooding to places like Metro Manila.
fact_tl: Tuwing habagat, ang kanlurang bahagi ng Pilipinas tulad ng Metro Manila ay tumatanggap ng maraming ulan at minsan ay binabaha.
fact_bis: Panahon sa habagat, ang kasadpang bahin sa Pilipinas sama sa Metro Manila makadawat og daghang ulan ug usahay malunopan.

q: What does the egg white (albumen) do for a developing chick inside the egg?
options: It forms the hard shell that protects the egg from outside
It gives the chick water and protein and cushions it
It keeps the egg warm by trapping heat
It helps the yolk change into the chick's bones
explanation: The egg white, called albumen, provides water and protein and acts as a cushion to protect the developing chick.
fact_tl: Ang puti ng itlog (albumen) ay nagbibigay ng tubig at protina at nagpoprotekta sa sisiw.
fact_bis: Ang puti sa itlog nga gitawag albumen mohatag og tubig ug protina ug manalipod sa piso.

q: Why does a snake constantly flick its forked tongue in and out?
options: To taste the food it is chewing
To pick up scents in the air so it can find food or other snakes
To cool itself down like a dog pants
To warn enemies that it is dangerous
explanation: A snake flicks its forked tongue to collect scent particles from the air, helping it find food or detect other snakes.
fact_tl: Inilalabas ng ahas ang sanga-sangang dila nito para kunin ang amoy sa hangin, at sa ganitong paraan ay nakakahanap ito ng pagkain o ng amoy ng ibang ahas.
fact_bis: Ang ahas mopagawas sa sanga-sangang dila niini aron kuhaon ang baho sa hangin, ug niini nga paagi makakita kini og pagkaon o makasimhot sa baho sa ubang ahas.

q: Why do noble gases like helium and neon almost never bond with other elements?
options: Because they are too heavy to react with anything
Because their outer electron shell is already full, making them stable
Because they are liquids and do not mix with solid elements
Because they are found only inside the earth where nothing reacts
explanation: Noble gases have a completely full outer electron shell, so they are already stable and have almost no need to bond with other atoms.
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas gaya ng helium at neon ay halos hindi nagbi-bond dahil puno na ang kanilang panlabas na shell, kaya matatag na sila.
fact_bis: Ang mga noble gas sama sa helium ug neon halos dili magbugkos tungod kay puno na ang ilang gawas nga shell, mao nga malig-on na sila.

q: What is friction?
options: A force that pulls objects toward Earth's center
A force that happens when two touching surfaces rub against each other
A force that makes magnets stick together
A force that pushes objects upward in water
explanation: Friction is the force produced when two surfaces that are in contact rub against each other.
fact_tl: Ang friction ay isang puwersa na nangyayari kapag dalawang magkadikit na ibabaw ay nagkukuskusan.
fact_bis: Ang friction usa ka pwersa nga mahitabo kung duha ka nagdaiting nawong magkiskisay.

q: Why do many motorized boats still carry a paddle even though they have an engine?
options: The paddle is used to steer because the engine cannot turn the boat
The paddle is a backup in case the engine runs out of fuel or breaks down at sea
The paddle is required by law as part of fishing gear
The paddle keeps the boat balanced when it is heavily loaded
explanation: A paddle serves as a backup tool so the boatman can row back to shore if the engine fails or runs out of fuel.
fact_tl: Maraming motorisadong bangka ang nagdadala pa rin ng sagwan bilang reserba. Kapag nawalan ng gasolina o nasiraan ang makina sa gitna ng dagat, ang sagwan ang nagiging pag-asa para makabalik sa pampang. Kaya kahit may makina, mahalaga pa rin ang kaalaman sa pagsagwan para sa kaligtasan.
fact_bis: Daghang makinahon nga bangka magdala gihapon ug bugsay isip reserba. Kon mahurot ang gasolina o madaot ang makina sa tunga sa dagat, ang bugsay mao ang paagi aron makabalik sa baybayon. Busa bisan adunay makina, importante gihapon ang kahibalo sa pagbugsay para sa kaluwasan.

q: Where in the constellation Orion is the star Betelgeuse found?
options: At the belt of Orion
At the foot of Orion
At the shoulder of Orion
At the sword of Orion
explanation: Betelgeuse is the bright red star located at the shoulder of the constellation Orion.
fact_tl: Ang Betelgeuse ang bituing nasa balikat ni Orion.
fact_bis: Ang Betelgeuse mao ang bituon nga anaa sa abaga ni Orion.

q: In which province is the famous island of Boracay located?
options: Palawan
Cebu
Aklan
Bohol
explanation: Boracay is a small island in Aklan, Visayas, known for its long white beach and clear waters.
fact_tl: Ang Boracay ay isang maliit na isla sa Aklan, Visayas na kilala sa mahabang puting dalampasigan at malinaw na tubig; ito ay isa sa mga pinakasikat na lugar ng turismo sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Boracay usa ka gamay nga isla sa Aklan, Visayas, bantog sa mahaba nga puting dalampasigan ug klaro nga tubig; usa kini sa labing popular nga destinasyon sa turismo sa Pilipinas.

q: Is milk acidic, neutral, or basic, and what is its approximate pH?
options: Strongly acidic, with a pH of about 3
Slightly acidic, with a pH of about 6.5
Exactly neutral, with a pH of 7
Slightly basic, with a pH of about 8
explanation: Milk is slightly acidic, with a pH of about 6.5.
fact_tl: Ang gatas ay bahagyang asido, na may pH na mga 6.5.
fact_bis: Ang gatas gamay nga asido, nga adunay pH nga mga 6.5.

q: Who discovered in 1929 that the universe is expanding?
options: Galileo Galilei
Albert Einstein
Edwin Hubble
Isaac Newton
explanation: Edwin Hubble discovered in 1929 that the universe is expanding.
fact_tl: Si Edwin Hubble ang nakatuklas noong 1929 na ang uniberso ay patuloy na lumalawak.
fact_bis: Si Edwin Hubble ang nakadiskobre niadtong 1929 nga ang uniberso padayon nga nagkadako.

q: Which statement about giant clams is true?
options: There is only one species of giant clam, which always grows over a meter long
There are several different kinds of giant clam, ranging from quite small to over a meter
All giant clams are the same size and live only in Philippine waters
Giant clams come in only two sizes: small and giant
explanation: There are several different species of giant clam that vary in size, from relatively small ones to those exceeding a meter.
fact_tl: Hindi iisa lang ang taklobo; may iba't ibang uri nito na magkakaiba ang laki, mula sa napakaliit hanggang sa pinakamalaking umaabot ng higit isang metro.
fact_bis: Dili usa ra ka matang ang taklobo; adunay nagkalainlaing matang niini nga lahi ug gidak-on, gikan sa gagmay ngadto sa pinakadako nga kapin sa usa ka metro.

q: What health problem can children develop if they do not get enough iron in their diet?
options: Scurvy, which causes bleeding gums
Rickets, which makes bones soft and bent
Anemia, which leads to fatigue, pale skin, and trouble concentrating
Goiter, which causes a swelling in the neck
explanation: Iron deficiency can cause anemia in children, resulting in fatigue, pale skin, and difficulty concentrating at school.
fact_tl: Ang kakulangan ng bakal (iron) ay maaaring magdulot ng anemia sa mga bata, na nagdudulot ng pagkapagod, pamumutla, at kahirapan sa pag-aaral; makukuha ang bakal mula sa isda, karne, at malunggay.
fact_bis: Ang kakulang sa iron mahimong hinungdan sa anemia sa mga bata, naghatag ug kakapoy, maputlang panit, ug kalisud sa pagkonsentrar sa eskwela; ang iron makuha sa isda, karne, ug malunggay.

q: In capillary action, what does adhesion do?
options: It makes water molecules pull away from the tube walls
It makes water molecules cling to each other so they rise together
It pulls water upward by making it stick to the walls of the tube
It slows water down so it does not spill from the top
explanation: Adhesion is the force that makes water stick to the walls of a thin tube and pulls it upward; cohesion then keeps the water molecules together as they rise.
fact_tl: Umaakyat ang tubig dahil sa dalawang puwersa: adhesion, ang pagdikit ng tubig sa dingding ng tubo, at cohesion, ang pagkapit ng mga molekula ng tubig sa isa't isa. Hinihila ng adhesion ang tubig pataas, at sumusunod ang ibang molekula dahil sa cohesion.
fact_bis: Mosaka ang tubig tungod sa duha ka pwersa: adhesion, ang pagdikit sa tubig sa bungbong sa tubo, ug cohesion, ang pagkupot sa mga molekula sa tubig sa usag usa. Ang adhesion mobira sa tubig paibabaw, ug mosunod ang ubang molekula tungod sa cohesion.

q: Where is the Philippine Sea located relative to the Philippines?
options: To the west, between the Philippines and Vietnam
To the south, between the Philippines and Indonesia
To the east of the Philippines, as part of the Pacific Ocean
To the north, between the Philippines and Taiwan
explanation: The Philippine Sea is part of the Pacific Ocean lying to the east of the Philippines and is one of the deepest bodies of water in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Karagatang Pilipino ay bahagi ng Karagatang Pasipiko na matatagpuan sa silangang bahagi ng Pilipinas at isa sa mga pinakamalalim na katawan ng tubig sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Dagat Pilipino kabahin sa Kadagatang Pasipiko nga nahimutang sa sidlakang bahin sa Pilipinas ug usa sa pinakamalalum nga lawas sa tubig sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: How does crystal growth begin?
options: A liquid cools so fast that it instantly becomes a large crystal all at once
A gas is compressed until it solidifies into a perfect crystal shape
A tiny seed crystal forms first, and other atoms then attach onto it
Two different minerals collide and bond together to make one crystal
explanation: Crystal growth starts from a tiny seed crystal, which other atoms gradually attach to as the crystal grows larger.
fact_tl: Ang pagtubo ng kristal ay nag-uumpisa sa isang napakaliit na binhing kristal kung saan dumidikit ang iba pang atomo.
fact_bis: Ang pagtubo sa kristal magsugod sa usa ka gamay kaayo nga binhing kristal diin modikit ang ubang mga atomo.

q: How do the helpful bacteria and fungi living on your skin protect you?
options: They produce vitamins that your skin absorbs directly
They occupy space and keep the skin acidic, preventing harmful germs from taking over
They digest dead skin cells and remove them automatically
They produce heat to keep the skin warm in cold weather
explanation: The skin microbiome protects you by occupying space and maintaining the skin's acidic pH, which keeps harmful pathogens away.
fact_tl: Ang balat ay tinatahan ng libu-libong uri ng kapaki-pakinabang na bacteria at fungi na bumubuo ng microbiome ng balat; ang mga ito ay nagpoprotekta sa atin laban sa mapanganib na mga mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang panit puy-anan sa libo-libong klase sa maayong bacteria ug fungi nga nagporma sa skin microbiome; kini nagpanalipud batok sa makadaot nga mga pathogen pinaagi sa pagsakop sa luna ug pagpadayon sa asidikong pH sa panit.

q: What type of simple machine is a pair of scissors?
options: A single second-class lever with the load at the end
Two first-class levers joined at a single fulcrum
A wedge that pries materials apart
A wheel-and-axle that spins to cut
explanation: A pair of scissors is actually two first-class levers joined at a fulcrum, which allows it to cut paper easily.
fact_tl: Ang gunting ay binubuo ng dalawang unang-uring palanca na magkadikit sa fulcrum, kaya madali nitong nagugupit ang papel.
fact_bis: Ang gunting gilangkuban sa duha ka unang-klase nga palanca nga gisumpay sa usa ka fulcrum, busa sayon niini ang pagtupi sa papel.

q: Which two large islands does the Mindoro Strait separate?
options: Luzon and Visayas
Mindanao and Palawan
Mindoro and Palawan
Leyte and Samar
explanation: The Mindoro Strait lies between Mindoro and Palawan, connecting the South China Sea to the Sulu Sea.
fact_tl: Ang Kipot ng Mindoro (Mindoro Strait) ay nasa pagitan ng Mindoro at Palawan, na nag-uugnay sa Dagat Timog Tsina at Dagat Sulu.
fact_bis: Ang Kipot sa Mindoro (Mindoro Strait) anaa tunga-tunga sa Mindoro ug Palawan, nga nagsumpay sa Dagat South China ngadto sa Dagat Sulu.

q: What does the color of a star tell us about it?
options: Its distance from Earth — blue stars are closer and red stars are farther away
Its size — blue stars are the smallest and red stars are the largest
Its temperature — blue stars are hotter and red stars are cooler
Its age — blue stars are older and red stars are younger
explanation: A star's color reveals its surface temperature: blue-white stars like Sirius are very hot, yellow stars like our Sun are medium temperature, and red stars like Betelgeuse are cooler.
fact_tl: Ang Sirius (ang pinakamaliwanag na bituin sa gabi) ay asul-puti at napainit na humigit-kumulang 9,940°C; ang Betelgeuse sa Orion ay isang pula at malamig na red supergiant; ang ating Araw ay dilaw at katamtaman ang temperatura. Ang mas maginaw na mga bituin ay pula, ang mas mainit ay asul.
fact_bis: Ang Sirius (ang pinaka-hayag nga bituin sa gabiing langit) asul-puti ug kaayo ka init sa mga 9,940°C; ang Betelgeuse sa Orion usa ka bugnaw nga red supergiant; ang atong Adlaw dilaw ug katamtamang temperatura. Ang mas bugnaw nga mga bituin pula, ang mas init asul.

q: Why does it never snow in most parts of the Philippines?
options: The Philippines is surrounded by warm ocean water that melts all snow before it lands
The Philippines is near the equator in the tropics, so the air stays warm almost all year
Philippine clouds are too low to produce snow; snow only forms in very high clouds
The wind always blows snow away from the Philippines toward Japan
explanation: The Philippines is in the tropical zone near the equator, where the air is warm almost all year, so temperatures almost never drop low enough for snow to form.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nagtatanong kung bakit walang niyebe sa Pilipinas. Ito ay dahil nasa tropical na bahagi tayo ng mundo, malapit sa ekwador, kaya mainit ang panahon halos buong taon. Para magka-niyebe, kailangang sobrang lamig ng hangin, na bihira mangyari dito. Kahit sa Baguio na malamig, presko lang ito at hindi umaabot sa nagyeyelong lamig.
fact_bis: Daghang bata mangutana ngano walay niyebe sa Pilipinas. Tungod kay naa ta sa tropical nga bahin sa kalibutan, duol sa ekwador, busa init ang panahon halos tibuok tuig. Aron mag-niyebe, kinahanglan bugnaw kaayo ang hangin, nga panagsa ra mahitabo dinhi. Bisan sa Baguio nga bugnaw, presko ra kini ug dili moabot sa pagkayelo.

q: Approximately when did the Cenozoic Era begin?
options: About 250 million years ago, when the Permian mass extinction happened
About 66 million years ago, after the dinosaurs went extinct
About 5 million years ago, when the first humans appeared
About 540 million years ago, when complex animal life first appeared
explanation: The Cenozoic Era began about 66 million years ago, right after the mass extinction that wiped out the dinosaurs.
fact_tl: Ang Cenozoic Era ay nagsimula mga 66 milyong taon na ang nakalipas, pagkatapos malipol ang mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang Cenozoic Era misugod mga 66 ka milyon ka tuig na ang milabay, human napuo ang mga dinosaur.

q: What substance makes the long green chili ('siling haba') spicy?
options: Lactic acid found in its skin
Capsaicin found in its seeds and lining
Tannin found in its green color
Citric acid found in its juice
explanation: The spicy heat of the long green chili comes from a chemical called capsaicin, found in its seeds and inner lining.
fact_tl: Ang siling haba na ginagawang 'dynamite' ay bunga ng halamang sili, at ang anghang nito ay galing sa sangkap na capsaicin sa loob ng buto at balat.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga sili nga himoong 'dynamite' mao ang bunga sa tanom nga sili, ug ang kahalang niini gikan sa sangkap nga capsaicin nga anaa sa liso ug sulod niini.

q: What protects the inside of a dog's ear from dust and dirt?
options: A thin transparent membrane that blocks particles
Earwax and tiny hairs that trap dust and dirt before it goes deep inside
A layer of thick fur that covers the ear opening
A special liquid that washes out particles automatically
explanation: Inside a dog's ear, earwax and tiny hairs work together like a guard to trap dust and dirt, preventing them from reaching the sensitive inner ear.
fact_tl: May tutuli at maliliit na buhok sa loob ng tainga ng aso na nagsisilbing tagaharang. Hinaharang nila ang alikabok, dumi, at maliliit na bagay para hindi makapasok nang malalim at masaktan ang sensitibong bahagi sa loob.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa dalunggan sa iro adunay tutuli ug gagmay nga balahibo nga morag bantay. Sila modakop sa abog, hugaw, ug gagmay nga butang aron dili makasulod og lawom ug makasakit sa sensitibo nga bahin sa sulod.

q: How is the light produced by an anglerfish different from the light produced by a firefly?
options: The firefly uses bacteria to glow, while the anglerfish makes its own chemicals
The anglerfish relies on bacteria in its esca for its glow, while the firefly makes its own light chemicals
Both produce light the same way, just in different environments
The anglerfish uses sunlight stored in its body, while the firefly uses electricity
explanation: Both glow, but the anglerfish uses bacteria living in its esca to produce light, while the firefly makes the light-producing chemicals itself.
fact_tl: Parehong nagliliwanag ang anglerfish at ang alitaptap (firefly), pero may pagkakaiba: ang alitaptap mismo ang gumagawa ng kemikal para sa ilaw nito sa lupa, samantalang ang anglerfish ay umaasa sa mga bakteryang nakatira sa esca nito sa ilalim ng dagat.
fact_bis: Pareho nga nagsiga ang anglerfish ug ang aninipot (firefly), apan adunay kalainan: ang aninipot mismo maghimo sa kemikal alang sa iyang kahayag sa yuta, samtang ang anglerfish nagsalig sa mga bakterya nga nagpuyo sa iyang esca sa lawom nga dagat.

q: What is true about a thermos flask?
options: It completely stops all heat transfer, so the contents stay at the same temperature forever
It slows heat transfer but cannot stop it completely, so contents still slowly change temperature
It works only for cold drinks, not for hot drinks
It speeds up heat transfer so the drink reaches room temperature quickly
explanation: Even a good thermos can only slow heat transfer, not stop it entirely, so contents eventually warm up or cool down over time.
fact_tl: Kahit magaling ang thermos, hindi nito tuluyang mapipigil ang init, kaya unti-unti pa ring lalamig o iinit ang laman.
fact_bis: Bisan maayo ang thermos, dili niini mapugngan sa hingpit ang kainit, busa hinay-hinay gihapon nga mobugnaw o moinit ang sulod.

q: How long can it take for rainwater to fully recharge some underground aquifers?
options: Only a few hours, since rain soaks straight through soil quickly
A few days to a week, similar to how long a flood takes to drain
Decades or even hundreds of years, so aquifers must be managed carefully
Exactly one rainy season, which is why they recover every year
explanation: Some aquifers take decades or even hundreds of years to be recharged by rainwater, which is why they must be used carefully.
fact_tl: Ang ilang aquifer ay nababago ng tubig-ulan sa loob ng ilang dekada o daan-daang taon, kaya dapat itong pamahalaan nang maingat.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka aquifer gipuno balik sa tubig-ulan sulod sa pipila ka dekada o gatusan ka tuig, mao nga kinahanglan pangalagaan kini nga maayo.

q: What would happen to all animals if the Sun suddenly disappeared?
options: Animals could survive by eating each other indefinitely
Only cold-blooded animals like reptiles would die; warm-blooded animals would be fine
Plants could not make food and would die, causing plant-eaters and then meat-eaters to die too
Only plants would die; animals could find other sources of food underground
explanation: Without the Sun, plants cannot make food and die; the plant-eaters that depend on them also die, and so do the meat-eaters — the entire food chain collapses.
fact_tl: Kung walang araw, hindi makakagawa ng pagkain ang mga halaman, kaya mamamatay sila — at pati ang mga hayop na kumakain ng halaman at ang kumakain naman ng hayop. Lahat sa food chain ay nakasalalay sa araw.
fact_bis: Kon wala ang adlaw, dili makahimo og pagkaon ang mga tanom, busa mamatay sila — apil na ang mga mokaon og tanom ug ang mokaon og hayop. Tanan sa food chain nagsalig sa adlaw.

q: Birds have two main types of feathers — what is the job of each type?
options: Large feathers for camouflage, small feathers for attracting mates
Stiff flight feathers for flying and soft down feathers underneath for warmth
Colored feathers for display and plain feathers for waterproofing
Outer feathers for rain protection and inner feathers for detecting sound
explanation: Birds have stiff, flat flight feathers used for flying and soft down feathers that trap heat to keep them warm.
fact_tl: May mga balahibong matigas at malapad para sa paglipad, at may malalambot na down sa ilalim para sa init.
fact_bis: Ang langgam adunay gahi ug lapad nga mga balhibo para sa paglupad, ug humok nga down sa ilawom para sa kainit.

q: What does the atomic mass number on the periodic table roughly tell you?
options: The total number of electrons orbiting the atom's nucleus
The total number of protons and neutrons in the atom
The number of energy levels or shells the atom has
The number of bonds the atom can form with other atoms
explanation: The atomic mass shown on the periodic table is roughly the total number of protons and neutrons in that element's atom.
fact_tl: Bawat kahon sa periodic table ay may atomic mass, na halos katumbas ng kabuuang bilang ng proton at neutron sa atomo ng elemento.
fact_bis: Ang matag kahon sa periodic table adunay atomic mass, nga halos katumbas sa kinatibuk-ang gidaghanon sa proton ug neutron sa atomo sa elemento.

q: How do elephants communicate over long distances?
options: By trumpeting at high pitches that echo off mountains
By producing low rumbles that travel far and can even be felt through the ground by other elephants
By releasing special smells into the wind that other elephants detect
By using their trunks to tap coded signals on tree trunks
explanation: Elephants communicate with very low-frequency rumbles that travel far; other elephants can sometimes sense these vibrations through their feet on the ground.
fact_tl: Ang mga elepante ay nakikipag-usap gamit ang napakababang ugong na umaabot sa napakalayo, at minsan nararamdaman pa ito ng ibang elepante sa pamamagitan ng paa nila sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga elepante makigkomunikar gamit ang ubos kaayo nga dagunong nga moabot og layo, ug usahay mabati pa kini sa ubang elepante pinaagi sa ilang tiil sa yuta.

q: Why is knowing a mineral's hardness useful?
options: It tells you exactly where the mineral was formed underground
It helps identify the mineral and choose the right material for a job
It tells you how much the mineral weighs per cubic centimeter
It shows whether the mineral is magnetic or not
explanation: Hardness helps identify a mineral and guides material choices — for example, soft talc is used for powder while hard diamond is used for cutting.
fact_tl: Bakit mahalagang malaman ang tigas? Tinutulungan tayo nito na makilala kung anong mineral ang isang bato, at piliin ang tamang materyal. Halimbawa, malambot na talc para sa pulbo, pero matigas na diamante para sa pagputol.
fact_bis: Ngano importante mahibaw-an ang katig-a? Makatabang kini kanato nga mailhan kung unsang mineral ang usa ka bato, ug mapili ang husto nga materyal. Pananglitan, humok nga talc para sa pulbos, apan gahi nga diamante para sa pagputol.

q: Why does cutting or burning forests make climate change worse?
options: Forests reflect sunlight, so removing them lets more heat reach the ground
Trees store carbon in their bodies and soil; burning them releases that carbon as CO2 into the air
Forests produce rain clouds; without them, the air becomes hotter and drier
Trees absorb heat at night; without them, temperatures rise during the day
explanation: Trees store large amounts of carbon; when forests are cut or burned, that stored carbon is released as CO2, adding to the greenhouse gases that warm the planet.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno ay nag-iimbak ng malaking halaga ng carbon sa kanilang katawan at lupa; kapag ang mga kagubatan ay pinutol o sinunog, ang nakaimbak na carbon ay inilalabas bilang CO2 sa atmospera.
fact_bis: Ang mga puno nag-imbak og dako nga kantidad sa carbon sa ilang lawas ug sa palibot nga yuta; sa dihang ang mga kagubatan giputol o sunugon, ang naimbak nga carbon gipagawas isip CO2 sa atmospera.

q: Why does iron near a salty, moist coast rust much faster than iron in a dry place?
options: Salty water is heavier and presses harder on the iron surface
Rusting requires both water and oxygen; salty, moist coastal air provides a better electrolyte that speeds up the electrochemical process
The sun near the coast heats the iron, which speeds up the chemical reaction
Salt removes the protective oxide layer on iron, leaving bare metal exposed
explanation: Rusting is an electrochemical process that needs both water and oxygen; salty, moist coastal air acts as a better electrolyte, making the process much faster.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalawang ay isang electrochemical process — kailangan nito ng tubig (bilang electrolyte) at oxygen — kaya ang bakal sa tuyong hangin ay hindi kumakalawang nang mabilis ngunit ang bakal sa maalat at basa ay mabilis na nalalagok.
fact_bis: Ang pagkalawang usa ka electrochemical process nga nanginahanglan og tubig (isip electrolyte) ug oxygen; ang bakal sa uga nga hangin hinay mokalawang, apan ang bakal sa asin ug basa nga baybayin nga hangin mas paspas mokalawang.

q: What do radio waves, visible light, and X-rays all have in common?
options: They all need air or water to travel through and move at the same speed
They are all types of electromagnetic waves that travel at the speed of light and need no medium
They are all visible to the human eye and travel in straight lines only
They are all produced only by the Sun and travel only outward from it
explanation: Radio waves, visible light, and X-rays are all electromagnetic waves; they all travel at the speed of light (300 million m/s) and need no medium.
fact_tl: Lahat ng electromagnetic wave — mula radio wave hanggang gamma ray — ay gumagalaw sa bilis ng liwanag (300 milyong metro bawat segundo) at walang kailangan na medium para maglakbay. Ang pagkakaiba nila ay ang frequency at wavelength.
fact_bis: Tanan nga electromagnetic wave — gikan sa radio wave hangtod gamma ray — naglakaw sa bilis sa suga (300 milyong metro matag segundo) ug wala kinahanglana nga medium aron maglakaw. Ang kalainan sa ilaha mao ang frequency ug wavelength.

q: In the scientific definition of work, how much work is done against gravity when you carry a heavy bag while walking on flat ground?
options: A lot of work, because your muscles are working hard
Moderate work, equal to the weight of the bag times the distance walked
Almost no work against gravity, because the bag does not rise
