Twice the normal work, because you must also overcome friction with the ground
explanation: In physics, work against gravity requires the object to be lifted; carrying a load horizontally does not raise the load, so almost no work is done against gravity.
fact_tl: Kapag may pasan kang bigat habang naglalakad sa patag, halos walang trabahong nagagawa laban sa gravity dahil hindi tumataas ang bigat.
fact_bis: Kung magdala kag bug-at samtang naglakaw sa patag, halos walay trabahong nahimo batok sa gravity kay wala mosaka ang gibug-aton.

q: What is the SI unit used to measure both work and energy?
options: Watt (W)
Newton (N)
Joule (J)
Pascal (Pa)
explanation: The joule (J) is the SI unit for both work and energy; one joule equals one newton-metre.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng gawa (work) at enerhiya ay ang joule (J); ang 1 joule ay katumbas ng 1 newton-metro (1 J = 1 N·m).
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa trabaho (work) ug enerhiya mao ang joule (J); ang 1 joule parehas sa 1 newton-metro (1 J = 1 N·m).

q: What happens when you bring the same magnetic poles (like north and north) close together?
options: They attract each other and stick together tightly
They do nothing; identical poles have no effect on each other
They push each other away
They cancel each other out and both lose their magnetism
explanation: Like magnetic poles repel each other, while opposite poles attract — a fundamental rule of magnetism.
fact_tl: Ang magkasalungat na poste ng magneto ay naghihilahan, ngunit ang magkaparehong poste ay nagtataboy.
fact_bis: Ang magkalahi nga poste sa magnet magbirahay, apan ang magkapareha nga poste magtinulod.

q: What is the main advantage of an electromagnet over a regular permanent magnet?
options: An electromagnet is always stronger than any permanent magnet
An electromagnet can be switched on and off by controlling the electric current
An electromagnet works without any electricity or battery
An electromagnet never loses its magnetism, unlike permanent magnets
explanation: The key advantage of an electromagnet is that it can be turned on and off — cut the electricity and it instantly stops being magnetic, giving you precise control.
fact_tl: Ang isang malaking kalamangan ng electromagnet ay kaya mong patayin at buhayin ito. Pag pinutol mo ang kuryente, biglang nawawala ang pagiging magnet nito, kaya kontrolado mo kung kailan ito kakapit.
fact_bis: Usa ka dakong bentaha sa electromagnet mao nga mahimo nimo kini palungon ug sindihan. Kung putlon nimo ang kuryente, kalit nga mawala ang pagka-magnet niini, mao nga kontrolado nimo kung kanus-a kini mokupot.

q: What do coffee plant flowers look like and smell like?
options: Large yellow flowers with a bitter smell, similar to the coffee drink
Small white flowers that are fragrant, appearing before the plant produces fruit
Tiny red flowers with no smell, which bloom only after the berries ripen
Purple flowers with a sweet smell that attract hummingbirds for pollination
explanation: Before producing coffee fruit, the coffee plant blooms with small, white, fragrant flowers.
fact_tl: Bago mamunga, ang kape ay namumulaklak ng maputi at mababangong bulaklak.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mamunga, ang kape mamulak og puti ug humot nga mga bulak.

q: Why are bats classified as mammals even though they can fly?
options: They are classified as mammals because they are as large as most mammals
They are actually classified as birds, not mammals, because they have wings
They are classified as mammals because they have fur and are warm-blooded, like other mammals
They are classified as mammals only in the Philippines; elsewhere they are birds
explanation: Bats are mammals because they have fur and are warm-blooded — flying does not make an animal a bird.
fact_tl: Ang paniki ay may balahibo at mainit ang dugo tulad ng ibang mammal, hindi ito ibon kahit na nakakalipad.
fact_bis: Ang kabog adunay balhibo ug init ang dugo sama sa ubang mammal; dili kini langgam bisan makalupad.

q: What is tsaang-gubat used for in traditional Philippine medicine?
options: Its roots are ground into powder to treat headaches and fever
Its leaves are boiled into a tea to help relieve stomachache and diarrhea
Its bark is soaked in water to make a drink that strengthens the immune system
Its flowers are dried and used to treat skin rashes and insect bites
explanation: Tsaang-gubat is a Philippine medicinal plant whose boiled leaves are used as a tea to relieve stomachache and diarrhea.
fact_tl: Ang tsaang-gubat ay isang halamang-gamot na ang mga dahon ay pinapakuluan bilang tsaa upang tumulong laban sa pananakit ng tiyan at pagtatae.
fact_bis: Ang tsaang-gubat usa ka tanom nga tambal sa Pilipinas nga ang mga dahon ginapabukal isip tsaa aron makatabang batok sa kasakit sa tiyan ug kalibanga.

q: What is the Sun's true color as seen from outer space?
options: Yellow, because that is the color of nuclear fusion reactions
Orange, because the Sun is a cool type of star
White, though it looks yellow or orange from Earth because our atmosphere filters some colors
Red, because the Sun is actually a red dwarf star
explanation: The Sun's true color is white; it only appears yellow or orange from Earth because the atmosphere scatters and filters some wavelengths of its light.
fact_tl: Ang tunay na kulay ng Araw ay puti, hindi dilaw — mukhang dilaw o kahel lang ito sa atin dahil sumasalain ng hangin ng Mundo ang ilang kulay ng liwanag nito, lalo na kapag mababa ito sa paglubog o pagsikat.
fact_bis: Ang tinuod nga kolor sa Adlaw puti, dili dalag — murag dalag o kahel lang kini kanato tungod kay ang hangin sa Kalibutan mosala sa pipila ka kolor sa kahayag niini, ilabi na kung ubos kini sa pagsubang o pagsalop.

q: Where does natural latex come from?
options: From the leaves of the coconut palm when they are crushed
From the milky white sap of the rubber tree
From a chemical reaction between tree bark and rainwater
From a special soil fungus that grows near tropical rivers
explanation: Latex is the milky white sap that is tapped directly from the rubber tree.
fact_tl: Ang latex ay isang puting katas na nakukuha mula sa puno ng goma na tinatawag na rubber tree.
fact_bis: Ang latex usa ka puti nga duga nga makuha gikan sa kahoy nga gitawag og rubber tree.

q: Which of the following is a benefit of a mother's breast milk for her newborn baby?
options: It gives the baby antibodies that protect against diseases while its own defenses are developing.
It supplies iron directly to strengthen the baby's bones and teeth.
It helps the baby grow taller faster than formula-fed babies.
It prevents the baby from ever catching any infection in its first year.
explanation: A mother's milk carries antibodies that protect the baby from diseases while its own immune system is still developing.
fact_tl: May germs na naililipat ng ina sa kanyang sanggol — habang nasa tiyan pa, sa panganganak, o sa pagpapasuso. Pero may magandang panig din: sa gatas ng ina ay may mga antibodies na nagbibigay proteksyon sa sanggol laban sa mga sakit habang nabubuo pa ang sariling depensa nito.
fact_bis: Adunay germs nga mabalhin gikan sa inahan ngadto sa iyang bata — samtang anaa pa sa tiyan, sa pagpanganak, o sa pagpasuso. Apan adunay maayong bahin usab: sa gatas sa inahan adunay antibodies nga manalipod sa bata batok sa sakit samtang nagtubo pa ang kaugalingong depensa niini.

q: In the old days in the Philippines, what did fishermen and sailors use the amihan winds for?
options: To sail their boats and go fishing.
To predict when typhoons would arrive.
To dry fish laid out on the shore.
To cool the rice paddies during harvest season.
explanation: Fishermen and sailors used the amihan winds to sail their boats and go fishing.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ginagamit ng mga mangingisda at mandaragat ang hangin ng amihan para magpalayag at mangisda.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, gigamit sa mga mananagat ug marinero ang hangin sa amihan aron molayag ug mangisda.

q: What is a cesarean section?
options: An operation used to deliver a baby when a normal birth is not safe.
A medicine given to a mother to speed up a normal birth.
A special breathing exercise that helps during a difficult labor.
A type of hospital room where high-risk pregnancies are monitored.
explanation: When a normal birth is not safe, the baby is delivered through an operation called a cesarean section.
fact_tl: Kapag hindi ligtas ang normal na panganganak, isinisilang ang sanggol sa pamamagitan ng operasyong tinatawag na cesarean.
fact_bis: Kung dili luwas ang normal nga pagpanganak, ipanganak ang bata pinaagi sa operasyon nga gitawag cesarean.

q: How is a tsunami different from a regular wind wave?
options: A tsunami carries energy through the entire depth of the water, from surface to seafloor, while a wind wave only carries energy near the surface.
A tsunami forms only when the wind blows extremely fast across the ocean.
A tsunami is always much taller than a wind wave when it is out in deep ocean.
A tsunami moves slower than a wind wave because it carries more water.
explanation: Unlike a wind wave that only carries energy in the surface layer, a tsunami carries energy through the entire water depth, giving it enormous power.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakaiba ng tsunami sa karaniwang alon ng hangin ay: ang karaniwang alon ay nagdadala ng enerhiya sa ibabaw lamang ng tubig, habang ang tsunami ay nagdadala ng enerhiya sa buong lalim ng tubig — mula sa ibabaw hanggang sa ilalim ng dagat; kaya naman napakalakas ng lakas ng tsunami kahit hindi ito mataas sa malalim na dagat.
fact_bis: Ang kalainan sa tsunami ug ordinaryong balod sa hangin mao: ang balod sa hangin nagdala og enerhiya sa ibabaw nga layer lamang sa tubig, samtang ang tsunami nagdala og enerhiya pinaagi sa tibuok nga giladmon sa tubig gikan sa ibabaw hangtod sa ilawom sa dagat; mao kini kung ngano napakalig-on sa lakas sa tsunami bisan ubos kini sa lawom nga dagat.

q: What happens when a virus copies itself and a change occurs in its genetic material?
options: A new form called a variant can appear.
The virus becomes completely harmless to humans.
The virus stops being able to spread from person to person.
The virus turns into a bacterium that can be treated with antibiotics.
explanation: A virus can change or mutate as it copies itself, producing new forms called variants.
fact_tl: Maaaring magbago o mag-mutate ang virus habang dumadami, kaya minsan lumilitaw ang bagong uri na tinatawag na variant.
fact_bis: Ang bayrus mahimong mausab o mag-mutate samtang nagkopya, mao nga usahay motungha ang bag-ong matang nga gitawag ug variant.

q: What is one physical feature of the makahiya plant that you should watch out for when touching it?
options: Small thorns on its stems.
Sticky sap on its leaves that can irritate skin.
Tiny hairs on its leaves that sting like a bee.
Razor-sharp leaf edges that can cut your fingers.
explanation: The makahiya has small thorns on its stems, so you should be careful when handling it.
fact_tl: May maliliit na tinik sa tangkay ng makahiya, kaya mag-ingat kapag hinahawakan ito.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmayng tunok sa tangkay sa makahiya, busa pag-amping kon hikapon kini.

q: What is needed for a shadow to exist?
options: Light must be present to create a shadow.
A dark surface must be nearby to catch the shadow.
The object must be moving for its shadow to appear.
The air must be completely still so the shadow does not disappear.
explanation: Without light there is no shadow — light is needed for a shadow to exist.
fact_tl: Kung walang liwanag, walang anino — kailangan ng liwanag para magkaroon ng anino.
fact_bis: Kon walay kahayag, walay landong — gikinahanglan ang kahayag aron adunay landong.

q: What gas from the air is needed for burning to keep going?
options: Oxygen
Nitrogen
Carbon dioxide
Water vapor
explanation: Fire takes oxygen from the air, and without oxygen, burning cannot continue.
fact_tl: Kumukuha ang apoy ng oxygen mula sa hangin; kung walang oxygen, hindi makakapagpatuloy ang pagliyab.
fact_bis: Ang kalayo nagkuha ug oxygen gikan sa hangin; kung walay oxygen, dili makapadayon ang pagsiga.

q: Why do stars like the Sun shine and give off so much energy?
options: They fuse hydrogen into helium through nuclear fusion, releasing huge amounts of energy.
They burn large amounts of oxygen stored in their outer layers.
They reflect sunlight from nearby galaxies back toward Earth.
They generate electricity from powerful magnetic fields around their cores.
explanation: Stars shine because they fuse hydrogen into helium in a process called nuclear fusion that releases enormous amounts of energy.
fact_tl: Nagniningning ang mga bituin dahil pinagsasanib nila ang hydrogen para maging helium, isang proseso na tinatawag na nuclear fusion na naglalabas ng napakaraming enerhiya.
fact_bis: Nagsiga ang mga bituon kay ilang gihiusa ang hydrogen aron mahimong helium, usa ka proseso nga gitawag nuclear fusion nga nagbuga ug daghang enerhiya.

q: How does a mother dugong care for her calf after it is born?
options: She nurses it underwater and looks after it for up to two years or more.
She teaches it to find coral reefs within the first few weeks of birth.
She carries it on her back until it is strong enough to swim alone.
She leaves it in a group of other calves while she searches for food.
explanation: A mother dugong nurses her young calf underwater and looks after it for up to two years or more.
fact_tl: Ang dugong ay nanganak ng iisang anak (calf) bawat ilang taon; ang ina ay nagpapasuso sa batang dugong sa ilalim ng tubig at nagbabantay nito ng hanggang dalawang taon o higit pa.
fact_bis: Ang dugong nagpanganak og usa ka bata (calf) matag pipila ka tuig; ang inahan nag-suso sa bata nga dugong sa ilalim sa tubig ug nag-amping niini sulod sa hangtod sa duha ka tuig o labaw pa.

q: What produces gamma rays in nature?
options: The unstable nuclei of radioactive atoms release gamma rays as they change.
Lightning strikes release gamma rays when they heat the atmosphere.
Stars release gamma rays when their outer layers burn hydrogen.
Electrons release gamma rays when they move through a magnetic field.
explanation: Gamma rays are released by the unstable nuclei of radioactive atoms as they change, and each isotope gives off its own distinctive gamma wavelength.
fact_tl: Ang gamma rays ay inilalabas ng mga di-matatag na nucleus ng radioactive na atoms habang nagbabago ang mga ito, at bawat isotope ay may sariling natatanging gamma wavelength.
fact_bis: Ang gamma rays gibuga sa dili lig-on nga nucleus sa radioactive nga atoms samtang nagbag-o kini, ug ang matag isotope adunay kaugalingong talagsaong gamma wavelength.

q: What happens just before the visible flash of lightning appears?
options: An invisible path of ionized air called a stepped leader steps down from the cloud.
A bolt of visible light shoots upward from the ground toward the cloud.
Raindrops freeze together and create a spark between them.
A static charge builds up on the ground and jumps directly to the cloud.
explanation: Lightning begins with a stepped leader — an invisible ionized path stepping downward from a cloud — before the return stroke creates the visible flash.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay nagsisimula sa isang stepped leader — isang di-nakikitang daan ng ionized na hangin na pababa mula sa ulap — bago ang return stroke na pataas ang nagbibigay ng maliwanag na flash na nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Ang kidlat nagsugod sa stepped leader — usa ka dili makita nga agianan sa ionized nga hangin nga naghunong-hunong mokanaog gikan sa panganod — una ang return stroke moitaas ug maghimo sa makita nga kislap.

q: Why should talc powder never be eaten or breathed in?
options: Because it is crushed rock, not a food ingredient, and is not safe for the body.
Because it contains strong acids that can burn the inside of the mouth.
Because it is made from the same minerals as glass and can cut the throat.
Because it reacts with stomach acid and creates a harmful gas inside the body.
explanation: Talc is crushed rock, not a food ingredient, so it should not be eaten or breathed in.
fact_tl: May mga batang nagtatanong kung pwede bang kainin ang talc dahil pulbo ito. Hindi ito pagkain at hindi dapat kainin o langhapin, dahil bato ito na dinurog, hindi sangkap sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Naay mga bata nga mangutana kung mahimo bang kaonon ang talc kay pulbos man kini. Dili kini pagkaon ug dili angay kaonon o langhapon, kay kini bato nga gidugmok, dili sangkap sa pagkaon.

q: How does an octopus use its large, sharp eyes?
options: To see food and enemies clearly.
To detect changes in water temperature around it.
To sense electrical signals from nearby fish.
To communicate with other octopuses using light signals.
explanation: An octopus has large, sharp eyes that help it see food and enemies clearly.
fact_tl: May malalaki at matatalas na mata ang pugita na tumutulong dito para makakita ng pagkain at kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang kugita adunay dako ug hait nga mata nga makatabang niini sa pagkita sa pagkaon ug kaaway.

q: Why do the muscles around the shoulder joint need to be especially strong?
options: The shoulder's socket is shallow, so the surrounding muscles must add extra stability to keep the ball in place.
The shoulder carries the full weight of the arm, which is heavier than any other limb.
The shoulder joint moves in only one direction, so the muscles must work harder to rotate it.
The shoulder has no cartilage, so muscles must cushion the bones to prevent injury.
explanation: Because the shoulder socket is shallow, a group of muscles wraps around the ball to keep it in the socket, adding extra stability and strength.
fact_tl: Sa paligid ng ball-and-socket joint sa balikat, may grupo ng kalamnan na yumayakap sa bola para panatilihin itong nasa socket. Dahil mababaw ang socket sa balikat, ang mga kalamnang ito ang nagdadagdag ng tatag at lakas.
fact_bis: Sa palibot sa ball-and-socket joint sa abaga, adunay grupo sa kaunoran nga naggakos sa bola aron magpabilin kini sa socket. Tungod kay mabaw ang socket sa abaga, kini nga mga kaunoran ang nagdugang og kalig-on ug kusog.

q: Why do atoms give away or take electrons from other atoms?
options: To fill their outer shell with 8 electrons and reach a stable state.
To become lighter so they can bond more easily with heavier atoms.
To increase their electrical charge and attract more energy from the environment.
To split into smaller atoms that are easier to combine with other elements.
explanation: Atoms give or take electrons to reach a full outer shell of 8 electrons, which is a stable state.
fact_tl: Bakit ibinibigay ng atomo ang electron nito? Gusto kasi ng atomo na maging matatag, na karaniwang nangangahulugan ng PUNONG panlabas na shell (8 electrons). Kapag ibinigay o tinanggap ang electron, naaabot nila ang matatag na estado na ito.
fact_bis: Ngano ihatag sa atomo ang iyang electron? Gusto sa atomo nga mahimong lig-on, nga sagad nagpasabot og PUNO nga panggawas nga shell (8 electrons). Kung ihatag o dawaton ang electron, makab-ot nila kining lig-on nga kahimtang.

q: What is lightning, scientifically speaking?
options: A giant burst of static electricity leaping from clouds to the ground or to another cloud.
A stream of hot gas released when clouds rub against the upper atmosphere.
A beam of concentrated sunlight reflected off the top of storm clouds.
A powerful gust of wind that becomes visible when it heats up the air.
explanation: Lightning is a giant burst of static electricity that leaps from clouds to the ground or to another cloud.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay isang napakalaking pagbuga ng static na kuryente mula sa mga ulap patungo sa lupa o sa ibang ulap.
fact_bis: Ang kilat usa ka dako kaayo nga pagbuga sa static nga kuryente gikan sa mga panganod paingon sa yuta o sa lain nga panganod.

q: What can you learn by counting the rings seen in a cut tree trunk?
options: How many years old the tree is.
How tall the tree grew each year.
How much water the tree drank each season.
How many branches the tree had when it was young.
explanation: The rings visible in a cut tree stem show how many years old the tree is, one ring per year.
fact_tl: Kapag pinutol ang tangkay ng puno, makikita ang mga singsing na nagpapakita kung ilang taon na ito.
fact_bis: Kung putlon ang punoan sa kahoy, makita ang mga singsing nga nagpakita kung pila na ka tuig ang kahoy.

q: What effect does the Gulf Stream have on western Europe's climate?
options: It carries warm water from the Gulf of Mexico, keeping western Europe's climate milder than it would otherwise be.
It brings cold Arctic water southward, making western Europe colder in winter.
It causes heavy rainfall in western Europe by evaporating into the atmosphere.
It pushes warm air from Africa northward, creating dry summers in western Europe.
explanation: The Gulf Stream carries heat from the Gulf of Mexico to western Europe, keeping its climate milder.
fact_tl: Ang Gulf Stream ay isang mainit na agos na nagdadala ng init mula sa Golpo ng Mexico patungong kanlurang Europa, kaya mas mainit ang panahon doon.
fact_bis: Ang Gulf Stream usa ka init nga sulog nga nagadala sa kainit gikan sa Gulpo sa Mexico padulong sa kasadpang Europa, mao nga mas init ang panahon didto.

q: Why do concrete roads have small gaps or lines built into them?
options: So the concrete slabs have room to expand when they get hot without cracking.
To allow rainwater to drain quickly and prevent flooding on the road.
To make the road surface rougher so cars do not slip.
To mark lanes and guide drivers at night without using paint.
explanation: Concrete roads have gaps so slabs have room to expand when hot, preventing them from cracking.
fact_tl: May mga linyang puwang sa mga kalsadang kongkreto para may lugar itong lawakan kapag mainit at hindi mabiyak.
fact_bis: Ang mga konkreto nga dalan adunay linya nga gintang aron may luna kini molapad kung init ug dili mabuak.

q: How does a malunggay pod begin its growth?
options: It starts as a white malunggay flower that grows into a long pod after insects carry pollen between flowers.
It grows directly from the main trunk as a small bud that swells with water.
It begins as a leaf that hardens and curls into a pod shape over time.
It forms from a dried-out seed that falls to the ground and sprouts a new pod.
explanation: A malunggay pod starts as a white flower; after insects pollinate it, the flower slowly grows into a long pod filled with seeds.
fact_tl: Nagsisimula ang pod bilang puting bulaklak ng malunggay. Pagkatapos mapulot ng mga insekto ang pollen, dahan-dahang lumalaki ang bulaklak hanggang maging mahabang pod na puno ng buto.
fact_bis: Ang pod magsugod isip puti nga bulak sa malunggay. Human madala sa mga insekto ang pollen, hinay-hinay nga motubo ang bulak hangtod mahimong taas nga pod nga puno sa liso.

q: What kinds of materials does a magnet pull toward itself?
options: Things made of iron or steel, like a compass needle.
Any metal object, including copper coins and aluminum cans.
Objects that contain water, such as wet wood or damp cloth.
Plastic and rubber items that build up static electricity.
explanation: A magnet pulls things made of iron or steel, such as the compass needle.
fact_tl: Ang magneto ay humihila ng mga bagay na yari sa bakal o asero, gaya ng karayom ng kompas.
fact_bis: Ang magnet magbira sa mga butang nga hinimo sa puthaw o asero, sama sa dagom sa compass.

q: How does an amoeba move from place to place?
options: By pushing out finger-like extensions called pseudopods.
By using a long tail-like flagellum that spins like a propeller.
By contracting tiny muscles along the sides of its body.
By riding water currents while attached to a fixed surface.
explanation: An amoeba moves by pushing out finger-like extensions called pseudopods that it uses to creep along.
fact_tl: Ang amoeba ay isang mikroorganismo na walang permanenteng hugis; nagbabago ito ng hugis at gumagapang sa pamamagitan ng paglabas ng parang mga paa na tinatawag na pseudopod.
fact_bis: Ang amoeba kay usa ka mikroorganismo nga walay permanente nga porma; nagbalhin kini og porma ug naggapang pinaagi sa pagtuyok og morag mga tiil nga gitawag og pseudopod.

q: What do farmers use to water rice fields when there is not enough rain?
options: Irrigation channels that carry water from a river or reservoir into the fields.
Sprinkler systems powered by windmills placed around the farm.
Underground pipes that pull water up from deep wells automatically.
Large tanks on carts that are pulled by animals through the fields.
explanation: When rain is not enough, farmers use irrigation — channels that carry water from a river or reservoir into the rice fields.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang ang ulan, gumagamit ang mga magsasaka ng irigasyon, mga kanal na nagdadala ng tubig mula sa ilog o reservoir papunta sa palayan. Sa ganitong paraan may tubig pa rin ang palay kahit tag-init.
fact_bis: Kon kulang ang ulan, ang mga mag-uuma mogamit ug irigasyon, mga kanal nga nagdala ug tubig gikan sa suba o tipiganan ngadto sa humayan, aron may tubig gihapon ang humay bisan sa tinginit.

q: What do we call a piece of space rock that survives its fiery journey through Earth's atmosphere and lands on the ground?
options: A meteorite
A meteor
A meteoroid
An asteroid
explanation: A space rock in Earth's atmosphere that glows as it burns is a meteor, but if a piece survives and lands on the ground, it is called a meteorite.
fact_tl: May tatlong magkaibang pangalan sa iisang bagay. Ang meteoroid ay maliit na bato sa kalawakan; kapag pumasok ito sa himpapawid ng Earth at nagliwanag habang nasusunog, tinatawag itong meteor o bulalakaw; at kung may natitirang bahagi na bumagsak sa lupa, meteorite na ang tawag dito.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka lainlain nga ngalan sa usa ka butang. Ang meteoroid usa ka gamay nga bato sa kawanangan; kung mosulod kini sa atmospera sa Earth ug mosiga samtang nasunog, gitawag kini nga meteor o bulalakaw; ug kung adunay nahabilin nga bahin nga nahulog sa yuta, meteorite na ang tawag niini.

q: What pH does a solution have when acid and base are perfectly neutralized?
options: pH 7, which is neutral like pure water.
pH 0, which means the acid has completely disappeared.
pH 14, which is the highest possible reading.
pH 3, which shows a very weak acid remains.
explanation: When acid and base amounts exactly match, the mixture becomes neutral at pH 7, like pure water.
fact_tl: Kapag eksaktong nagkasundo ang dami ng asido at base, ang halo ay nagiging neutral, na pH 7 — gaya ng purong tubig. Ang pH ay sukat kung gaano ka-asido o ka-base ang isang bagay: mas mababa sa 7 ay asido, mas mataas ay base, at 7 ang neutral.
fact_bis: Kung sakto nga magkatugma ang gidaghanon sa asido ug base, ang sagol mahimong neutral, nga pH 7 — sama sa lunsay nga tubig. Ang pH maoy sukod kung unsa ka-asido o ka-base ang usa ka butang: ubos sa 7 asido, taas sa 7 base, ug 7 ang neutral.

q: What is an adaptation in biology?
options: A trait of an organism that helps it survive and reproduce in its environment.
A change an organism makes on purpose to avoid being eaten by predators.
A skill that young animals learn by watching their parents in the wild.
A process where organisms copy the behaviors of stronger animals nearby.
explanation: An adaptation is a trait of an organism that helps it survive and reproduce in its environment.
fact_tl: Ang adaptasyon ay isang katangian ng organismo na tumutulong dito upang mabuhay at magparami sa kanyang kapaligiran.
fact_bis: Ang adaptasyon usa ka kinaiya sa usa ka organismo nga makatabang niini nga mabuhi ug magpasanay sa iyang palibot.

q: What makes a ruby appear red in color?
options: A tiny amount of chromium inside the corundum mineral.
Iron particles that form during the cooling of volcanic rock.
Layers of iron oxide that build up on the surface of the stone.
Special light-bending crystals that reflect only red wavelengths.
explanation: A ruby is red because of a tiny amount of chromium found inside the corundum mineral.
fact_tl: Pula ang ruby dahil sa maliit na halo ng chromium (kromyo) sa loob ng corundum.
fact_bis: Pula ang ruby tungod sa gamay nga chromium (kromyo) sulod sa corundum.

q: What does the cochlea in the inner ear do when sound vibrations reach it?
options: Its tiny hair cells vibrate and send electrical signals to the brain, which we perceive as sound.
It amplifies the sound waves so they are loud enough for the brain to detect.
It filters out background noise and passes only the loudest sounds to the brain.
It converts electrical signals from the brain back into vibrations we can feel.
explanation: The cochlea contains tiny hair cells that vibrate and send electrical signals to the brain, which we perceive as sound.
fact_tl: Ang cochlea ay isang spiral na organ sa inner ear na naglalaman ng maliliit na hair cells — kapag nagvivibrate ito, nagpapadala sila ng electrical signals sa utak na nararamdaman nating tunog.
fact_bis: Ang cochlea usa ka spiral nga organ sa inner ear nga naglaman sa gagmayng hair cells — kung nagalingkod sila, nagapadala sila og electrical signals sa utok nga atong madungog ingon tunog.

q: Why is the air we breathe considered a homogeneous mixture?
options: Because the gases in it, like nitrogen and oxygen, are evenly mixed so the air is the same everywhere in a room.
Because it contains only one type of gas that is spread equally throughout the atmosphere.
Because you can easily separate its components by letting the air sit still for a few minutes.
Because its composition changes constantly as more oxygen is added by plants during the day.
explanation: Air is a homogeneous mixture because gases like nitrogen and oxygen are evenly mixed — you cannot separate them by eye, and the air is the same composition anywhere in a room.
fact_tl: Ang hangin na nilalanghap natin ay isa palang homogeneous na halo ng mga gas, tulad ng nitrogen at oxygen. Hindi mo sila makita o mahiwalay sa pamamagitan ng mata dahil pantay-pantay silang nagkahalo. Kaya kahit saan sa silid, pareho ang hangin na nahihinga mo.
fact_bis: Ang hangin nga atong ginaginhawa usa diay ka homogeneous nga sagol sa mga gas, sama sa nitrogen ug oxygen. Dili nimo sila makita o mabulag pinaagi sa mata kay pantay silang nagkasagol. Busa bisan asa sa kwarto, pareho ang hangin nga imong ginaginhawa.

q: Which of the following is an example of an involuntary movement?
options: Your heartbeat, which happens automatically and cannot be stopped on purpose.
Waving your hand to greet a friend across the street.
Kicking a ball during a game of football.
Writing your name on a piece of paper.
explanation: The heartbeat is an involuntary movement — it happens automatically and we cannot start or stop it on purpose.
fact_tl: May mga kilos na sinasadya natin, gaya ng paglakad o pagkaway, na inuutusan ng utak. May mga kilos namang awtomatik, gaya ng tibok ng puso, na hindi natin kayang pigilan o ipag-utos.
fact_bis: Adunay mga lihok nga atong tinuyo, sama sa paglakaw o pagwarawara, nga sugoon sa utok. Adunay mga lihok nga awtomatiko, sama sa pitik sa kasingkasing, nga dili nato mapugngan o masugo.

q: What is the main job of the thyroid gland?
options: It makes hormones that control how the body uses energy.
It filters waste from the blood and produces urine.
It stores extra food energy as fat in different parts of the body.
It sends signals to the muscles telling them when to move.
explanation: The thyroid makes hormones that control how the body uses energy.
fact_tl: Ang thyroid ay gumagawa ng mga hormon na kumokontrol kung paano gumagamit ng enerhiya ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid naghimo ug mga hormon nga nagkontrol kon unsaon paggamit sa lawas sa enerhiya.

q: Which Philippine scientist had two snake species named in his honor?
options: Angel Alcala
Eduardo Quisumbing
Dioscoro Rabor
Candelario Versoza
explanation: Two Philippine snake species — Lycodon alcalai and Opisthotropis alcalai — were named in honor of Angel Alcala.
fact_tl: Dalawang uri ng ahas sa Pilipinas ang ipinangalan kay Angel Alcala: ang Lycodon alcalai at Opisthotropis alcalai.
fact_bis: Duha ka klase sa bitin sa Pilipinas ang gipanganlan para kang Angel Alcala: ang Lycodon alcalai ug Opisthotropis alcalai.

q: Why do vegetable leaves look green?
options: Because they contain chlorophyll, which they use to make food from sunlight.
Because they absorb blue and red light and reflect only green light from the soil.
Because the water inside the leaf cells gives them a green tint.
Because the cell walls are made of a green substance called cellulose.
explanation: Vegetable leaves are green because of chlorophyll, the pigment they use to make food from sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang mga dahon ng gulay ay luntian dahil sa klorofila na ginagamit nila para gumawa ng pagkain mula sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga dahon sa utanon lunhaw tungod sa kloropil nga ilang gigamit aron maghimo og pagkaon gikan sa adlaw.

q: Why does a magnifying glass make small letters look bigger when you hold it very close to the page?
options: When the object is closer than the focal point, the convex lens produces a bigger, upright image of it.
The curved glass bends light around the letters, stretching them outward on both sides.
The thick glass slows down light so the letters appear to spread over a larger area.
The lens reflects the letters onto a wider surface, making them seem enlarged.
explanation: When an object is closer than the focal point of a convex lens, you see a larger, upright image — that is why a magnifying glass makes tiny letters look bigger.
fact_tl: Bakit nagpapalaki ang convex lens kapag inilapit mo sa isang libro? Kapag malapit lang ang bagay sa lens (mas malapit pa sa focal point), nakikita mo ang mas malaki at tuwid na larawan nito — kaya ginagamit ang magnifying glass para basahin ang maliliit na letra.
fact_bis: Ngano nga mopadako ang convex lens kung iduol nimo sa libro? Kung duol kaayo ang butang sa lente (mas duol pa sa focal point), makita nimo ang mas dako ug tul-id nga hulagway niini — mao nga gigamit ang magnifying glass aron basahon ang gagmay nga letra.

q: What happens to corals when seawater gets too warm?
options: They lose their color and can die, an event called coral bleaching.
They grow faster and spread to new areas to escape the heat.
They produce extra mucus to protect themselves and stay alive.
They sink deeper into the ocean where the water is cooler.
explanation: When seawater gets too warm, corals lose their color and can die in an event called coral bleaching.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang init ng tubig-dagat, ang mga koral ay nawawalan ng kulay at namamatay, na tinatawag na coral bleaching.
fact_bis: Kon sobra ka init ang tubig-dagat, ang mga korales mawad-an og kolor ug mahimong mamatay, nga gitawag og coral bleaching.

q: Why does a thinner or shorter kubing tongue produce a higher-pitched sound?
options: A thinner or shorter tongue vibrates faster, which creates a higher pitch.
A thinner tongue is lighter and bounces off the teeth more times per second.
A shorter tongue allows more air to pass through, creating a brighter sound.
A thin tongue is closer to the lips, so the sound travels a shorter distance.
explanation: A thinner or shorter kubing tongue vibrates faster, and faster vibration means a higher pitch.
fact_tl: Kung gaano kabilis nayayanig ang dila ang nagtatakda kung mataas o mababa ang tunog. Ang mas manipis o mas maikling dila ay mas mabilis mag-vibrate, kaya mas mataas ang tono nito. Ang mas makapal o mas mahabang dila naman ay mabagal mag-vibrate, kaya mas mababa ang tono.
fact_bis: Kung unsa ka paspas mo-vibrate ang dila maoy magtino kung taas o ubos ang tunog. Ang mas nipis o mas mubo nga dila mas paspas mo-vibrate, busa mas taas ang iyang tono. Ang mas baga o mas taas nga dila hinay mo-vibrate, busa mas ubos ang tono.

q: Why is oral rehydration solution (ORS) the first treatment given during cholera outbreaks in disaster areas?
options: It is cheap, easy to distribute, and can save many people even without a hospital nearby.
It kills the cholera bacteria directly, stopping the infection within a few hours.
It can only be prepared in hospitals, which is why doctors rush it to disaster zones.
It replaces the need for any other medicine, curing cholera completely on its own.
explanation: ORS is used during cholera outbreaks in disasters because it is cheap, easy to distribute, and can save many lives even without a nearby hospital.
fact_tl: Saan pa ginagamit ang ORS sa totoong buhay? Sa mga sakuna tulad ng baha o bagyo, madalas kumakalat ang cholera, isang sakit na nagdudulot ng matinding pagtatae. Ang ORS ang unang lunas dahil mura, madaling i-distribute, at kayang iligtas ang maraming tao kahit walang ospital sa malapit.
fact_bis: Asa pa gigamit ang ORS sa tinuod nga kinabuhi? Panahon sa kalamidad sama sa baha o bagyo, kasagaran mokaylap ang cholera, usa ka sakit nga magpahinabog grabe nga kalibang. Ang ORS mao ang unang tambal kay barato, sayon i-apod-apod, ug makaluwas og daghang tawo bisan walay ospital duol.

q: Which color of visible light has the longest wavelength?
options: Red
Violet
Green
Blue
explanation: Red light has the longest wavelength of all the visible colors.
fact_tl: Ang pulang liwanag ang may pinakamahabang wavelength sa mga nakikitang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga kahayag adunay kinatas-an o pinakataas nga wavelength sa makit-an nga mga kolor.

q: Why do people put oil or grease on machine parts that rub together?
options: Oil creates a thin slippery layer between the surfaces so they do not rub directly, reducing friction.
Oil makes metal parts harder so they do not wear down as quickly from the heat.
Oil seals the gaps between parts so air cannot enter and cool the machine down.
Oil conducts electricity between parts so the machine runs on less electrical power.
explanation: Oil acts as a thin slippery layer between surfaces so they do not rub directly, reducing friction and letting machines run smoothly.
fact_tl: Para babaan ang friction, nilalagyan ng langis o grasa ang mga bahagi ng makina na nagkikiskisan. Ang langis ay parang manipis na patong na nagpapadulas sa dalawang ibabaw para hindi sila direktang magkiskis. Kaya nilalagyan ng langis ang kadena ng bisikleta — para magaan ang takbo at hindi kalawangin.
fact_bis: Aron pamenusan ang friction, ginabutangan ug lana o grasa ang mga bahin sa makina nga nagkuskos. Ang lana morag nipis nga sapaw nga nagpadanlog sa duha ka nawong aron dili sila direktang magkuskos. Mao nga ginalanaan ang kadena sa bisikleta — aron gaan ang dagan ug dili magkalawang.

q: What kinds of sea creatures can be found at Tubbataha Reef?
options: Hundreds of coral species, thousands of fish species, sharks, whale sharks, manta rays, and sea turtles.
Only tropical fish and sea turtles, because the deep water keeps larger animals away.
Mainly dolphins and whales, since Tubbataha is too deep for coral reefs to grow.
A few types of coral and clams, which are the only animals that can survive in very salty water.
explanation: Tubbataha shelters hundreds of coral species, thousands of fish species, sharks, whale sharks, manta rays, and sea turtles, making it one of the most marine-biodiverse places in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha ay tirahan ng daan-daang uri ng coral, libu-libong uri ng isda, mga pating, butanding, sting ray, at pawikan — ginagawa itong isa sa pinakamayamang lugar sa biodiversity sa dagat sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha nagpuyo sa gatusan nga matang og coral, libo-libo nga matang sa isda, mga pating, butanding, manta ray, ug pawikan — nagpahimo niini isip usa sa pinakadato sa biodiversity sa dagat sa Pilipinas.

q: Why are pots and pans made of metal?
options: So heat can pass quickly from the flame into the food.
So they are heavy enough to stay steady on the stove.
So they can be cleaned easily without scratching.
So they reflect the heat back onto the stove burner to save energy.
explanation: Pots and pans are made of metal because metal conducts heat quickly from the flame into the food.
fact_tl: Ang mga kaldero at kawali ay gawa sa metal upang mabilis na maihatid ang init mula sa apoy patungo sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga kaldero ug kalaha hinimo sa metal aron paspas nga makahatod sa init gikan sa kalayo ngadto sa pagkaon.

q: Which gliding animal has the most complete gliding membrane, with skin that stretches even between its fingers and toes?
options: The colugo
The flying squirrel
The sugar glider
The Draco lizard
explanation: Among all gliding animals, the colugo has the most complete gliding membrane, which reaches even between its fingers and toes.
fact_tl: Sa lahat ng mga hayop na lumulutang, ang colugo ang may pinakakumpletong patagium na umaabot kahit sa pagitan ng mga daliri nito.
fact_bis: Sa tanang mga hayop nga nagdagan-dagan, ang colugo ang adunay labing kompleto nga patagium nga moabot bisan sa tunga-tunga sa iyang mga tudlo.

q: About how tall is Mount Apo, the highest mountain in the Philippines?
options: 2,954 meters
1,954 meters
3,954 meters
4,954 meters
explanation: Mount Apo stands about 2,954 meters high, making it the tallest mountain in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Apo ay mga 2,954 metro ang taas, kaya ito ang pinakamataas na bundok ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Apo mga 2,954 ka metro ang gihabogon, mao nga kini ang pinakahabog nga bukid sa Pilipinas.

q: What was the magnitude of the October 2013 earthquake that damaged old churches in Bohol?
explanation: The October 2013 Bohol earthquake had a magnitude of 7.2 and damaged many centuries-old churches.
fact_tl: Ang lindol ng Bohol noong Oktubre 2013 ay may magnitude na 7.2 at sinira ang maraming daan-taong simbahan at nagbago ang hugis ng mga Chocolate Hills; mahigit 220 katao ang napatay at libo-libo ang naligaw ng tirahan; ito ay nagbigay-linaw sa pangangailangan para sa mas matibay na mga gusali.
fact_bis: Ang lindol sa Bohol sa Oktubre 2013 adunay magnitude nga 7.2 ug nakasamad sa daghang libo-ka-tuig ang edad nga mga simbahan ug nabag-o ang hitsura sa pipila ka Chocolate Hills; labaw sa 220 ka tawo ang namatay ug linibo ang nawad-an sa ilang balay; kini nagpasabut sa panginahanglan sa mas lig-on nga mga gusali.

q: Why is biomass like wood and rice straw considered stored sunlight?
options: Because plants captured the Sun's energy through photosynthesis before we burn it
Because sunlight heats up wood and keeps the energy inside it
Because the Sun's rays shine directly into the wood fibers
Because burning wood releases heat from the soil where roots absorbed sunlight
explanation: Biomass is called stored sunlight because plants first captured the Sun's energy through photosynthesis, and that energy is released when we burn it.
fact_tl: Ang biomass tulad ng kahoy at dayami ay parang nakaimbak na sikat ng araw, dahil kinuha muna ng halaman ang enerhiya ng araw sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis bago natin ito sunugin para sa init.
fact_bis: Ang biomass sama sa kahoy ug dayami sama sa natipigan nga kahayag sa adlaw, kay ang tanom nag-una pagkuha sa enerhiya sa adlaw pinaagi sa potosintesis una nato kini sunogon alang sa init.

q: What causes myopia (nearsightedness) in the eye?
options: The eyeball is too long, so light focuses in front of the retina
The eyeball is too short, so light focuses behind the retina
The lens is too thin, so light scatters before reaching the retina
The pupil is too large, so too much light enters the eye
explanation: In myopia, the eyeball is too long, causing light to focus in front of the retina instead of on it.
fact_tl: Sa myopia, masyadong mahaba ang mata kaya ang liwanag ay nagtutok sa unahan ng retina, hindi sa retina mismo.
fact_bis: Sa myopia, sobra ka taas ang mata maong ang kahayag mapokus sa atubangan sa retina, dili gayud sa retina.

q: At what temperature does ice melt into liquid water?
options: 0 degrees Celsius
10 degrees Celsius
100 degrees Celsius
-10 degrees Celsius
explanation: Ice melts at 0 degrees Celsius, which is the melting point of water.
fact_tl: Ang yelo ay natutunaw sa 0 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Ang yelo matunaw sa 0 degrees Celsius.

q: How do helpful bacteria living in our gut support our body's defenses against germs?
options: They take up the space and food that harmful germs would otherwise use
They produce antibodies that directly kill harmful bacteria
They raise our body temperature to destroy invading germs
They filter our blood and remove harmful bacteria from it
explanation: Helpful gut bacteria support defense by occupying the space and consuming the food that harmful germs would otherwise use.
fact_tl: May mabubuting bakterya sa ating bituka na tumutulong sa depensa dahil pinupuno nila ang espasyo at sustansyang sana'y kinain ng masasamang germ.
fact_bis: Adunay maayong bakterya sa atong tinai nga motabang sa depensa kay ilang pun-on ang luna ug sustansya nga unta gamiton sa daotang germ.

q: How long does a broken bone usually take to fully heal?
options: Several weeks to a few months
One to three days
About one year
A few hours with proper rest
explanation: A broken bone usually takes several weeks to a few months to fully heal.
fact_tl: Karaniwang umaabot ng ilang linggo hanggang buwan bago lubusang maghilom ang isang baling buto.
fact_bis: Kasagaran moabot og pipila ka semana hangtod bulan ayha hingpit nga maayo ang nabali nga bukog.

q: How is the scientific name of a tiger written correctly?
options: Panthera tigris in italics, genus capitalized, species lowercase
Panthera Tigris in regular text, both words capitalized
panthera tigris in italics, both words in lowercase
PANTHERA TIGRIS in all capital letters
explanation: Scientific names are written in italics with the genus capitalized and the species name in lowercase, like Panthera tigris for the tiger.
fact_tl: May tuntunin sa pagsulat ng pangalang siyentipiko: ito ay isinusulat na nakahilig (italic), malaking titik ang simula ng genus at maliit ang species, gaya ng Panthera tigris para sa tigre.
fact_bis: Adunay lagda sa pagsulat sa ngalang siyentipiko: gisulat kini nga nakahilig (italic), dakong letra ang sinugdan sa genus ug gamay ang species, sama sa Panthera tigris para sa tigre.

q: What traps dust and germs inside the nose before they can reach the lungs?
options: Mucus and tiny hairs inside the nose
White blood cells lining the nasal passages
The hard cartilage in the nostrils
The sinuses behind the nose bones
explanation: Mucus and the tiny hairs inside the nose trap dust and germs before they can reach the lungs.
fact_tl: Ang uhog at mga balahibo sa loob ng ilong ay humuhuli ng alikabok at germ bago ito makarating sa baga.
fact_bis: Ang sip-on ug ang gagmayng balhibo sa sulod sa ilong nagdakop sa abog ug mga kagaw sa dili pa kini makaabot sa baga.

q: Why do you see lightning before you hear thunder, even though they happen at the same time?
options: Because light travels much faster than sound
Because lightning is closer to the ground than thunder
Because thunder travels underground and arrives late
Because your ears react more slowly than your eyes
explanation: Lightning and thunder happen at the same time, but you see lightning first because light travels much faster than sound.
fact_tl: Sabay nangyayari ang kidlat at kulog, pero nauuna mong makita ang kidlat dahil mas mabilis maglakbay ang liwanag kaysa tunog.
fact_bis: Dungan mahitabo ang kilat ug dalugdog, apan makita una nimo ang kilat kay mas paspas mobaktas ang kahayag kaysa tingog.

q: How do clams protect themselves from danger in the water?
options: They dig down and bury themselves in sand or mud
They swim away quickly using their powerful foot
They shoot ink at predators to confuse them
They attach themselves tightly to rocks with a strong grip
explanation: Clams dig down and bury themselves in sand or mud under the water to hide from danger.
fact_tl: Ang halaan ay naglulubong sa buhangin o putik sa ilalim ng tubig para magtago.
fact_bis: Ang halaan nagkalot ug naglubong sa iyang kaugalingon sa balas o lapok ilalom sa tubig aron motago.

q: What produces the glowing light on the dangling lure of a deep-sea anglerfish?
options: Bioluminescent bacteria called Aliivibrio fischeri living inside the fish's light organ
Chemicals the anglerfish makes in its own liver and releases through the lure
A crystal inside the lure that reflects the little sunlight that reaches the deep sea
Electric signals from the anglerfish's brain that cause the lure tissue to glow
explanation: Bioluminescent bacteria called Aliivibrio fischeri live inside the anglerfish's light organ and produce the light the fish uses to lure prey.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bacteria tulad ng Aliivibrio fischeri ay nagliliwanag sa dilim sa pamamagitan ng bioluminescence — ang mga ito ay naninirahan sa loob ng isang espesyal na organ ng deep-sea na angler fish at gumagawa ng liwanag para kumuhain ng biktima.
fact_bis: Ang uban nga bakterya sama sa Aliivibrio fischeri bioluminescent ug namuyo sa sulod sa light organ sa deep-sea nga angler fish, nagbuhat sa kahayag nga gigamit sa isda aron maakit ang biktima.

q: What happens to protons and neutrons in the nucleus during gamma decay?
options: No protons or neutrons are lost; the nucleus only releases extra energy as a gamma ray
The nucleus loses two protons and two neutrons as a gamma ray shoots out
One neutron is converted into a proton and the gamma ray carries the electron away
The nucleus splits in half and each part releases a gamma ray
explanation: In gamma decay, no protons or neutrons are lost — the nucleus just releases extra energy as a powerful gamma ray.
fact_tl: Sa gamma decay, walang nawawalang proton o neutron — naglalabas lang ang nucleus ng sobrang enerhiya bilang 'gamma ray,' isang napakalakas na uri ng liwanag na hindi nakikita. Madalas itong nangyayari pagkatapos ng alpha o beta decay.
fact_bis: Sa gamma decay, walay nawala nga proton o neutron — ang nucleus mogawas lang og sobra nga enerhiya isip 'gamma ray,' usa ka kusgan kaayo nga matang sa kahayag nga dili makita. Kasagaran kini mahitabo human sa alpha o beta decay.

q: Approximately how old is the Sun?
options: About 4.6 billion years old
About 1 billion years old
About 13.8 billion years old
About 500 million years old
explanation: The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay halos 4.6 bilyong taong gulang na.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw mga 4.6 ka bilyon ka tuig na ang panuigon.

q: About how many days does it take the Moon to complete one full orbit around Earth?
options: About 27 days
About 7 days
About 365 days
About 54 days
explanation: The Moon takes about 27 days to orbit Earth once.
fact_tl: Inaabot ng Buwan ng mga 27 araw para makaikot nang isang beses sa Lupa.
fact_bis: Ang Bulan mag-abot og mga 27 ka adlaw aron makatuyok kausa libot sa Yuta.

q: Why do most termites hide inside wood or behind walls instead of coming out in the open?
options: Their skin is thin and dries out easily, so they need damp and dark places
They are blind and cannot find food in open spaces
They are afraid of predators that only live in open areas
Their bodies overheat quickly in sunlight and they need the cold of wood
explanation: Most termites avoid light and dry air because their thin skin dries out easily, so they work inside damp, dark wood or walls.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng anay ay nagtatago at iniiwasan ang liwanag at tuyong hangin dahil manipis at madaling matuyo ang kanilang balat. Kaya ginagawa nila ang kanilang trabaho sa loob ng kahoy o sa likod ng pader kung saan basa at madilim.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa anay magtago ug maglikay sa kahayag ug uga nga hangin kay nipis ug daling mauga ang ilang panit. Mao nga gibuhat nila ang ilang trabaho sa sulod sa kahoy o sa luyo sa pader diin basa ug ngitngit.

q: Why does the Agusan River flow northward toward Butuan Bay?
options: Because gravity pulls water downhill and the land is lower to the north
Because the wind blows from the south pushing the water north
Because the ocean at Butuan Bay is warmer and attracts the river water
Because the river was dug by people to carry water toward the coast
explanation: The Agusan River flows northward because gravity pulls water downhill, and the land is lower in that direction toward Butuan Bay.
fact_tl: Ang ilog ay laging umaagos pababa, mula sa mataas na lugar patungo sa mababa, dahil hinihila ng grabidad ang tubig paibaba. Kaya nga umaagos pahilaga ang Ilog Agusan—doon mas mababa ang lupa hanggang sa marating nito ang dagat sa Look ng Butuan.
fact_bis: Ang suba kanunayng modagayday paubos, gikan sa habog nga dapit ngadto sa ubos, kay ang grabidad maoy mobira sa tubig paubos. Mao nga modagan paamihanan ang Suba sa Agusan—mas ubos ang yuta sa maong direksyon hangtod maabot niini ang dagat sa Look sa Butuan.

q: Where is the deepest part of Philippine waters located?
options: In the Philippine Trench, reaching about 10,540 meters deep
In the Sulu Sea, reaching about 5,000 meters deep
In Manila Bay, reaching about 3,000 meters deep
In the Celebes Sea, reaching about 7,200 meters deep
explanation: The deepest part of Philippine waters is in the Philippine Trench, which reaches about 10,540 meters deep.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na bahagi ng karagatan ng Pilipinas ay nasa Philippine Trench, na umabot sa mga 10,540 metro ang lalim.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga bahin sa kadagatan sa Pilipinas naa sa Philippine Trench, nga moabot mga 10,540 ka metro ang giladmon.

q: Which bird is famous for flying thousands of kilometers nonstop over the ocean without ever landing?
options: The bar-tailed godwit
The albatross
The Arctic tern
The frigate bird
explanation: The bar-tailed godwit is famous for flying thousands of kilometers nonstop over the ocean without landing.
fact_tl: Ang bar-tailed godwit ay kilala sa paglipad nang walang tigil ng libo-libong kilometro sa ibabaw ng karagatan nang hindi humihinto.
fact_bis: Ang bar-tailed godwit bantog sa paglupad nga walay hunong og liboan ka kilometro ibabaw sa kadagatan nga walay pagdunggo.

q: About how many liters of blood does an adult human body contain?
options: About 5 liters
About 1 liter
About 10 liters
About 15 liters
explanation: An adult human body has about 5 liters of blood.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng matandang tao ay may mga 5 litro ng dugo.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa hamtong nga tawo adunay mga 5 ka litro nga dugo.

q: What is the main mission of PAGASA in the Philippines?
options: To provide weather information and warnings to protect Filipino lives and property
To build dams and manage the water supply across the Philippines
To study volcanic activity and earthquake hazards in the Philippines
To track spacecraft and satellites over Philippine airspace
explanation: PAGASA was established in 1972 with the mission to provide weather information and warnings to protect Filipino lives and property.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration) ay itinatag noong 1972; ang misyon nito ay magbigay ng impormasyon at babala sa panahon upang maprotektahan ang buhay at pag-aari ng mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration) natukod niadtong 1972; ang iyang misyon mao ang paghatag sa impormasyon ug babala sa panahon aron mapanalipdan ang kinabuhi ug kabtangan sa mga Pilipino.

q: Why did the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in the United States collapse in 1940?
options: Strong winds made it vibrate so violently that it waved up and down and fell apart
Floodwaters eroded the soil under its foundations until the bridge fell
The metal bolts holding the bridge rusted through all at once in a storm
An earthquake shook the ground and cracked the bridge's concrete supports
explanation: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed in 1940 because wind made it vibrate violently, causing it to wave up and down until it fell.
fact_tl: Noong 1940, ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge sa Estados Unidos ay umalon-alon at gumuho dahil pinaalog ito nang husto ng hangin.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1940, ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge sa Estados Unidos nibalod ug naguba tungod kay gipauyog kini pag-ayo sa hangin.

q: Why is it helpful to turn or mix a compost pile regularly?
options: It lets in more air so the materials break down faster
It keeps insects away so they do not eat the compost
It adds moisture so the pile does not dry out
It mixes in extra nutrients from the soil below
explanation: Turning the compost lets in more air, which allows the materials to break down faster.
fact_tl: Kapag hinahalo o binabaliktad ang compost, mas maraming hangin ang pumapasok at mas mabilis itong nabubulok.
fact_bis: Kung ukayon o baliktaron ang compost, mas daghang hangin ang mosulod ug mas paspas kini madunot.

q: Where do nitrogen-fixing bacteria like Rhizobium live, and what do they help the plant do?
options: In legume roots like mung bean; they help the plant get nitrogen from the air
On leaf surfaces; they help the plant absorb carbon dioxide more efficiently
In the flower; they help the plant attract pollinators
In the stem; they help the plant carry water upward faster
explanation: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria like Rhizobium live in legume roots and help the plant get nitrogen from the air.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakteryang nagfi-fix ng nitrogen tulad ng Rhizobium ay nakatira sa mga ugat ng mga legume tulad ng munggo at nakatutulong sa mga halaman na makakuha ng nitrogen mula sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bacteria nga nag-fix sa nitrogen sama sa Rhizobium nagpuyo sa mga gamot sa legume sama sa munggo ug nagtabang sa tanom nga makakuha sa nitrogen gikan sa hangin.

q: When a musician presses a string on a kudyapi to make it shorter, what happens to the note?
options: The note becomes higher
The note becomes lower
The note becomes louder
The note becomes softer
explanation: In instruments like the kudyapi, pressing the string to shorten it makes a higher note.
fact_tl: Sa mga tradisyunal na instrumentong Pilipino tulad ng kudyapi o bandurya, ginagamit ang parehong prinsipyo: pinipindot ang kuwerdas para paikliin ito at makagawa ng mas mataas na tunog. Kaya nakakatugtog ng iba't ibang nota ang mga musikero.
fact_bis: Sa mga tradisyonal nga instrumento sa Pilipinas sama sa kudyapi o bandurya, parehas ra ang prinsipyo: ipisil ang kuwerdas aron mamubo kini ug mohimo ug mas taas nga tingog. Mao nga makatukar ug lain-laing nota ang mga musikero.

q: In what year did Anders Celsius propose his temperature scale?
explanation: Anders Celsius proposed his temperature scale in the year 1742.
fact_tl: Iminungkahi ni Anders Celsius ang kanyang temperature scale noong taong 1742.
fact_bis: Gisugyot ni Anders Celsius ang iyang temperature scale niadtong tuig 1742.

q: Why does a thumbtack's flat head not hurt your thumb, but its sharp point easily pokes into a wall?
options: The flat head spreads force over a large area (low pressure), while the sharp point concentrates force on a tiny area (very high pressure)
The flat head is made of soft plastic, while the sharp point is made of hard steel
The flat head absorbs the force like a cushion, while the sharp point releases stored spring energy
The flat head is pushed by your thumb, while the sharp point is pushed by gravity pulling the tack down
explanation: A thumbtack's flat head spreads pressure over a large area so it does not hurt, while the sharp point concentrates pressure on a tiny area to poke easily into the wall.
fact_tl: Ang tatsa ay may malapad na ulo na hindi sumasakit sa hinlalaki dahil mababa ang presyon doon, at matulis na dulong madaling tumusok sa pader dahil napakataas ng presyon sa maliit na tulis.
fact_bis: Ang tatsa adunay lapad nga ulo nga dili mosakit sa kumagko kay ubos ang presyur didto, ug talinis nga tumoy nga sayon motusok sa bungbong kay taas kaayo ang presyur sa gamay nga tumoy.

q: Where was the world's first website created, and in what year did it go online?
options: At CERN, in 1991
At NASA, in 1969
At MIT, in 1985
At Microsoft, in 1995
explanation: The world's first website was created by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN and went online in 1991.
fact_tl: Ang unang website sa mundo ay ginawa ni Tim Berners-Lee sa CERN at inilabas noong 1991.
fact_bis: Ang unang website sa kalibutan gihimo ni Tim Berners-Lee sa CERN ug gibutang online niadtong 1991.

q: Why is solar energy considered a renewable energy source?
options: Because as long as the sun shines, we have energy to capture with solar panels
Because solar panels can store enough energy to last for hundreds of years
Because sunlight is created by burning fuels that never run out underground
Because solar panels recycle old electricity and turn it back into new electricity
explanation: Solar energy is renewable because a solar panel turns sunlight into electricity, and the sun keeps shining.
fact_tl: Ang solar panel ay kumukuha ng liwanag ng araw at ginagawang kuryente, kaya ito ay renewable—hangga't sumisikat ang araw, may enerhiya tayo.
fact_bis: Ang solar panel mokuha sa kahayag sa adlaw ug himoon kining kuryente, mao nga renewable kini—basta mosubang ang adlaw, naa tay enerhiya.

q: How does metamorphic rock generally compare to the original rock it came from?
options: It is often harder and more compact
It is usually softer and more crumbly
It has the same hardness but a different color
It is always lighter because pressure squeezes out water
explanation: Metamorphic rock is often harder and more compact than the original rock it came from.
fact_tl: Kadalasan, mas matigas at mas siksik ang batong metamorphic kaysa sa orihinal na bato na pinagmulan nito.
fact_bis: Kasagaran, mas gahi ug mas siksik ang batong metamorphic kaysa sa orihinal nga bato nga gigikanan niini.

q: How do some snakes glide through the air from a tree?
options: They flatten their bodies like a ribbon to glide
They spread out their ribs to form wing-like flaps
They coil tightly and spring off a branch like a spring
They hold their breath to become lighter and float on air currents
explanation: Some snakes flatten their bodies like a ribbon to glide through the air from tree to tree.
fact_tl: May mga ahas na pinapatag ang kanilang katawan na parang laso upang lumutang sa hangin mula sa puno.
fact_bis: Adunay mga halas nga ilang gipatag ang lawas sama sa laso aron molutaw sa hangin gikan sa kahoy.

q: What important mineral do bones store to keep them strong?
options: Calcium
Iron
Sodium
Potassium
explanation: Bones store calcium, a mineral that keeps them strong.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ay nag-iimbak ng kaltsyum, isang mineral na nagpapatibay sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang mga bukog nagtipig ug kaltsyum, usa ka mineral nga naghimo kanila nga lig-on.

q: What color streak does hematite leave, even though it may look silvery on the outside?
options: A red to reddish-brown streak
A black streak
A white or gray streak
A golden-yellow streak
explanation: Hematite, an iron ore, leaves a red to reddish-brown streak even when it looks silvery on the outside.
fact_tl: Ang hematite, isang ore ng bakal, ay nag-iiwan ng pula hanggang kayumanggi-pulang streak kahit pilak ang kulay nito sa labas.
fact_bis: Ang hematite, usa ka ore sa puthaw, magbilin ug pula ngadto sa pula-pula nga streak bisan pag silver ang panggawas niini.

q: Why does a raptor (such as an eagle) turn its whole head to look to the side?
options: Because its eyes can barely move in their sockets
Because turning the head helps it hear sounds from the side as well
Because raptors have only one eye on each side and cannot see forward
Because their neck feathers block their side vision unless they turn
explanation: Because a raptor's eyes can barely move in their sockets, it must turn its whole head to look to the side.
fact_tl: Dahil halos hindi makagalaw sa loob ng kanilang ukit ang mga mata ng ibong mandaragit, kailangan nilang ibaling ang buong ulo para makatingin sa gilid.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dili halos makalihok ang mga mata sa langgam nga manunukob sa ilang lungag, kinahanglan nilang ilingi ang tibuok ulo aron makatan-aw sa kilid.

q: What material is amakan, the traditional wall panel, made from?
options: Thin strips of bamboo woven together
Dried coconut leaves stitched into sheets
Flattened sugarcane stalks pressed into boards
Clay mixed with rice straw and dried in the sun
explanation: Amakan is a wall panel woven from thin strips of bamboo, a plant that is strong yet light and good for building house walls.
fact_tl: Ang amakan ay isang dingding na hinabi mula sa mga manipis na pinilas na kawayan, isang halaman na malakas ngunit magaan kaya angkop sa pagpapatibay ng bahay.
fact_bis: Ang amakan usa ka bongbong nga hinabol gikan sa nipis nga pinikas nga kawayan, usa ka tanom nga lig-on apan gaan, busa angay kini sa paghimo og bongbong sa balay.

q: What type of mineral is citrine?
options: The yellow or golden variety of quartz
A rare form of feldspar with a yellowish color
A variety of calcite found in volcanic rocks
A gemstone made from compressed sulfur crystals
explanation: Citrine is the yellow or golden variety of quartz.
fact_tl: Ang citrine ay ang kulay-dilaw o gintong uri ng quartz.
fact_bis: Ang citrine mao ang dilaw o bulawan nga matang sa quartz.

q: What is the event horizon of a black hole?
options: The boundary past which nothing can escape because it would need to move faster than light
The glowing ring of hot gas that orbits just outside the black hole
The center point of the black hole where all matter is crushed together
The region where gravity begins to bend light slightly toward the black hole
explanation: The event horizon is the boundary around a black hole; once anything crosses it, it can never come back because it would need to move faster than light to escape.
fact_tl: Ang event horizon ang hangganan sa palibot ng black hole; kapag ang anuman ay lumagpas dito, hindi na ito makakabalik dahil kailangan nitong tumakbo nang mas mabilis pa kaysa liwanag para makaalpas.
fact_bis: Ang event horizon mao ang utlanan palibot sa black hole; kon adunay molabang niini, dili na kini makabalik kay kinahanglan kini molihok nga mas paspas pa kaysa kahayag aron makaikyas.

q: What happens when a string on a laud (a stringed instrument) is plucked?
options: The string vibrates and produces sound waves that travel through the air
The string stretches longer and the air inside the body of the instrument warms up
The string pushes against the instrument's body, which creates electricity that makes sound
The string spins rapidly, creating a humming noise by spinning the surrounding air
explanation: When a string on the laud is plucked, it vibrates and produces sound waves that travel through the air.
fact_tl: Ang laud ay instrumentong may kuwerdas; kapag pinipitik ang kuwerdas, ito ay nayayanig at gumagawa ng tunog na kumakalat sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang laud usa ka instrumento nga adunay kuwerdas; kung kutson ang kuwerdas, kini magkurog ug mohimo ug tingog nga moagi sa hangin.

q: Why do we add an extra day to the calendar every four years?
options: Because Earth takes about 365.25 days to orbit the Sun, and those quarter-days add up to a full extra day
Because the Sun moves slightly farther away every year, making each orbit a little longer
Because the Moon's gravity slows Earth down a little each year until an extra day is needed
Because ancient calendar-makers made a small mistake and the extra day corrects it
explanation: Earth orbits the Sun in about 365.25 days, so an extra day is added every four years to account for the leftover quarter-days.
fact_tl: Ang Mundo ay umiikot sa Araw sa loob ng halos 365.25 araw, kaya may dagdag na isang araw kada apat na taon.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta molibot sa Adlaw sulod sa mga 365.25 ka adlaw, mao nga adunay dugang nga usa ka adlaw matag upat ka tuig.

q: Approximately how many people live on Earth today?
options: Over 8 billion people
About 4 billion people
About 1 billion people
About 6 billion people
explanation: The world's population is over 8 billion people.
fact_tl: Ang populasyon ng mundo ay mahigit 8 bilyong tao.
fact_bis: Ang populasyon sa kalibutan kapin sa 8 ka bilyon nga tawo.

q: After sound enters the ear and makes the eardrum vibrate, what does the cochlea do?
options: It turns the vibration into signals sent to the brain
It sends the vibration back out as an echo
It filters out loud sounds to protect the brain
It stores the sound so the brain can replay it later
explanation: The cochlea is the snail-shaped part that turns sound vibrations into signals sent to the brain.
fact_tl: Pumapasok ang tunog sa tainga at pinapanginig nito ang eardrum (tympanic membrane). Ipinapasa ang panginig sa maliliit na buto at sa cochlea na hugis-kuhol, na nagbabago ng tunog sa mga signal na ipinapadala sa utak.
fact_bis: Mosulod ang tingog sa dalunggan ug pakurogon niini ang eardrum. Ipasa ang pagkurog sa gagmayng bukog ngadto sa cochlea nga porma og kuhol, nga mobalhin sa tingog ngadto sa mga signal nga ipadala sa utok.

q: According to the famous story, what gave Isaac Newton the idea to think about gravity?
options: Seeing a falling apple
Watching a boat float on water
Observing the Moon rising
Feeling raindrops on his face
explanation: According to the story, Newton thought of gravity after seeing a falling apple.
fact_tl: Sabi ng kwento, naisip ni Newton ang grabidad nang makakita siya ng nahulog na mansanas (apple).
fact_bis: Sumala sa sugilanon, nahunahuna ni Newton ang grabidad human siya makakita ug nahulog nga mansanas (apple).

q: In what year was the planet Neptune discovered?
explanation: Neptune was discovered in the year 1846.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Neptune noong taong 1846.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ang Neptune niadtong tuig 1846.

q: Why are fossil fuels called nonrenewable energy sources?
options: Because they take millions of years to form and we use them faster than they can be replaced
Because they come from fossils that scientists want to preserve for study
Because they can only be burned once before they turn into rock and are useless
Because governments have passed laws limiting how much fossil fuel can be made
explanation: Fossil fuels are nonrenewable because they take millions of years to form and we use them much faster than they can be replaced.
fact_tl: Ang fossil fuels ay nonrenewable, ibig sabihin mauubos sila — dahil milyon-milyong taon bago mabuo ang mga ito, hindi natin sila mapapalitan kasimbilis ng paggamit natin.
fact_bis: Ang fossil fuels nonrenewable, buot ipasabot mahurot sila — tungod kay milyon-milyon ka tuig sila maporma, dili nato sila mapulihan sama kapaspas sa atong paggamit.

q: How does the Philippine Draco lizard glide from tree to tree?
options: It extends its rib-supported skin membranes to form wings that carry it up to ten metres
It leaps using its powerful hind legs and spreads all four limbs like a parachute
It flattens its whole body like a frisbee and spins through the air between trees
It inflates air sacs in its throat to become buoyant and floats between trees
explanation: The Philippine Draco lizard glides by extending its rib-supported skin membranes to form a wing that lets it travel up to ten metres.
fact_tl: Ang Draco lizard ng Pilipinas ay kayang lumipat sa pagitan ng mga puno sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalawig ng kanyang mga tadyang na may balat upang gumawa ng isang uri ng pakpak na nagbibigay-daan sa kanya na lumipat ng hanggang sampung metro.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Draco lizard makaglide sa taliwala sa mga kahoy pinaagi sa pagpalapad sa iyang rib-supported nga skin membrane aron makaporma og usa ka pakpak nga nagtugot niini nga makabalhin hangtod sa napulo ka metro.

q: How do prairie dogs stay alert to danger even while their heads are down feeding?
options: They pop up to look around now and then and listen for neighbors' alarm calls
They take turns eating so one animal is always standing on guard while others feed
They dig their feeding holes in a circle so they can all face outward while eating
They can hear underground vibrations of approaching predators through their paws while eating
explanation: While feeding, prairie dogs pop up regularly to look around and also listen for neighbors' alarm calls to detect danger quickly.
fact_tl: Habang nakayuko at kumakain, paminsan-minsang tumatayo ang prairie dog para tumingin sa paligid. Nakikinig din sila sa mga sigaw ng kapwa nila para malaman agad kung may paparating na panganib.
fact_bis: Samtang nakaduko ug nagkaon, usahay motindog ang prairie dog aron molibod og tan-aw. Maminaw sab sila sa mga singgit sa ilang silingan aron diha-diha mahibalo kung naay nagsingabot nga katalagman.

q: Why was the technique of separating substances called 'chromatography'?
options: Because 'chroma' is Greek for color and it was first used to separate plant colors
Because 'chroma' is Latin for mixture and it describes how mixed substances separate
Because it was invented by a scientist named Chromatov who separated dyes
Because the results always show a colorful rainbow pattern on the paper
explanation: Chromatography got its name because 'chroma' is Greek for color and the technique was first used to separate plant colors.
fact_tl: Saan galing ang salitang 'chromatography'? Ang 'chroma' ay Griyego para sa kulay. Tinawag itong ganito noong una dahil ginamit ito sa paghihiwalay ng kulay ng halaman, kahit ngayon marami nang ibang gamit.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang pulong 'chromatography'? Ang 'chroma' Griyego nga pulong alang sa kolor. Ginganlan kini og ingon niini sa sinugdan kay gigamit kini sa pagbulag sa kolor sa tanom, bisan karon daghan na og lain nga gamit.

q: Where was the famous scientist Marie Curie born?
options: Poland
France
Germany
Russia
explanation: Marie Curie was Polish-born, even though she later worked in France.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ay isang Polish (taga-Poland) na siyentipiko na nagtrabaho sa France.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie usa ka Polish (gikan sa Poland) nga siyentista nga nagtrabaho sa France.

q: How do nipa plants help riverbanks and coastlines?
options: Their dense roots hold the soil and prevent erosion
Their large leaves block waves from hitting the shore
Their thick trunks act as walls against floodwater
Their fruits fall and build up the ground along the coast
explanation: The dense roots of the nipa anchor soil and prevent erosion of riverbanks and coastlines.
fact_tl: Ang siksik na mga ugat ng nipa ay tumutulong na pigilan ang pagguho ng pampang at baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga mga gamot sa nipa makatabang sa pagpugong sa pagkaguba sa pampang ug baybayon.

q: Why should you brush your teeth every morning and night?
options: To remove germs and food bits that cause tooth decay
To make your teeth grow faster and stronger
To keep your gums from bleeding during the day
To stop your mouth from producing too much saliva
explanation: Brushing removes germs and food bits, which prevents the teeth from decaying.
fact_tl: Ang pagsisipilyo ng ngipin tuwing umaga at gabi ay nag-aalis ng mga kagaw at tira ng pagkain upang hindi mabulok ang ating ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang paneripilyo sa ngipon kada buntag ug gabii magtangtang sa mga kagaw ug salin sa pagkaon aron dili madunot ang atong ngipon.

q: What protects a virus's genetic material while it searches for a cell to infect?
options: A tough protein coat wrapped around it
A layer of fat that repels water
A hard shell made of calcium carbonate
A sticky sugar coating on the outside
explanation: The virus's genetic material is wrapped in a tough protein coat that protects it while it looks for a host cell.
fact_tl: Ang genetic material ng virus ay nababalot ng matigas na protina na nagsisilbing panangga habang naghahanap ito ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang genetic material sa bayrus giputos sa gahi nga protina nga nagsilbing panalipod samtang nangita kini ug selula.

q: What is the unit used to measure electric charge?
options: Coulomb
Ampere
Volt
Watt
explanation: The unit of electric charge is the coulomb (C), named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng kargang elektrikal o electric charge ay coulomb (C), na ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa kargang elektrikal o electric charge mao ang coulomb (C), nga ginganlan sunod kang Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.

q: What happens to coral when the tiny algae living inside it leave?
options: The coral turns white in a process called coral bleaching
The coral grows faster without the algae taking up space
The coral sinks to the ocean floor because it loses buoyancy
The coral changes color from white to bright orange
explanation: Zooxanthellae algae provide over 90% of the coral's energy; when they leave, coral bleaching occurs.
fact_tl: Ang mga zooxanthellae ay maliliit na dinoflagellate algae na naninirahan sa loob ng mga coral polyp — gumagawa sila ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis at nagbibigay ng higit sa 90% ng enerhiya ng coral. Kapag naalisan sila, nangyayari ang coral bleaching.
fact_bis: Ang mga zooxanthellae gagmay nga dinoflagellate algae nga namuyo sa sulod sa mga coral polyp — nagbuhat sila og pagkain pinaagi sa photosynthesis ug naghatag og labaw sa 90% sa enerhiya sa coral. Kung mobiya sila, mahitabo ang coral bleaching.

q: Why can a camera on a telescope photograph objects that our eyes cannot see?
options: A camera can collect light for a long time, gathering more than the eye can
A camera has a built-in light source that illuminates distant objects
A camera filters out unwanted light, making faint objects appear bright
A camera is bigger than an eye so it automatically sees farther
explanation: A camera on a telescope can collect light over a long exposure time, capturing objects too faint for our eyes.
fact_tl: Sa teleskopyo, ang kamera ay maaaring mag-ipon ng liwanag nang matagal, kaya kaya nitong kunan ng litrato ang mga bagay na masyadong malabo para makita ng ating mata.
fact_bis: Sa teleskopyo, ang kamera makahimo sa pagtigom og kahayag sa dugay nga panahon, mao nga makakuha kini og hulagway sa mga butang nga hanap kaayo aron makita sa atong mata.

q: Why do some Filipino farmers add lime to their soil?
options: To neutralize excess acid so the soil becomes healthier for plants
To add more nitrogen so plants grow taller and greener
To make the soil harder so it does not wash away in rain
To kill insects that live in the soil and eat plant roots
explanation: Lime neutralizes excess acid in the soil, bringing it closer to neutral so crops can grow well.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga lupang masyadong asido kaya hindi maganda ang tubo ng pananim. Naglalagay ang mga magsasaka ng apog (lime) sa lupa para i-neutralize ang sobrang asido at gawing mas malapit sa neutral ang lupa. Sa ganitong paraan, mas masustansya ang lupa para sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, naa'y mga yuta nga sobra ka-asido mao nga dili maayo ang tubo sa tanom. Magbutang ang mga mag-uuma og apog (lime) sa yuta aron i-neutralize ang sobra nga asido ug himuong mas duol sa neutral ang yuta. Niini nga paagi, mas himsog ang yuta para sa mga tanom.

q: What is the capital city of China?
options: Beijing
Shanghai
Hong Kong
Chongqing
explanation: The capital of China is Beijing.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng China ay Beijing.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa China mao ang Beijing.

q: What tiny animals build coral reefs by making hard limestone skeletons?
options: Coral polyps
Sea urchins
Zooplankton
Barnacles
explanation: Coral reefs are built by millions of tiny animals called coral polyps that produce hard limestone skeletons.
fact_tl: Ang mga coral reef ay gawa ng milyon-milyong maliliit na hayop na tinatawag na coral polyp na bumubuo ng matigas na balangkas na apog.
fact_bis: Ang mga coral reef gibuhat sa minilyon ka gagmay nga mga hayop nga gitawag og coral polyp nga naghimo og gahi nga kalansay nga apog.

q: What is bagasse used for that makes it better for the environment than plastic?
options: It is made into eco-plates and cups that break down faster than plastic
