It has no effect on local rainfall since rain comes from the ocean, not from trees
It causes stronger storms because open land creates more wind
explanation: Cutting large forests can reduce local rainfall because trees release moisture through transpiration — removing trees reduces transpiration and lowers local rainfall.
fact_tl: Ang pagputol ng malalaking kagubatan ay maaaring bawasan ang pag-ulan sa lokal na lugar dahil ang mga puno ay nagtatakip ng napakaraming halumigmig sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng transpiration — ang pagtatanggal ng mga puno ay nagpapababa ng transpiration at maaring magbawas ng lokal na pag-ulan.
fact_bis: Ang pagputol sa mga dagkong kagubatan mahimong makabawas sa ulan sa lokal nga lugar tungod kay ang mga kahoy nagpagawas og dako kaayong halumigmig ngadto sa hangin pinaagi sa transpiration — ang pagtangtang sa mga kahoy nagpaubos sa transpiration ug mahimong makababa sa lokal nga ulan.

q: Why is emptying out containers of collected water an important way to prevent dengue?
options: Mosquito larvae need water to live, so removing standing water stops them from developing
Mosquitoes drink still water, so removing it makes them leave the area to find other sources
Standing water attracts adult mosquitoes that lay eggs in the soil nearby
Removing water lowers the humidity that mosquitoes need to survive
explanation: Because mosquito larvae need water to live, emptying collected water destroys their habitat and is the heart of the '4S' strategy against dengue.
fact_tl: Dahil kailangan ng tubig ng larva para mabuhay, ang pinakamadaling paraan para pigilan ang lamok ay ubusin o ibuhos ang naipong tubig at takpan ang mga lalagyan kada linggo. Ito ang puso ng '4S' laban sa dengue: Search and destroy ang mga pinaglalagian ng tubig.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nagkinahanglan ug tubig ang larva aron mabuhi, ang pinakasayon nga paagi sa pagpugong sa lamok mao ang pag-ula sa natipong tubig ug pagtabon sa mga sudlanan matag semana. Mao kini ang kasingkasing sa '4S' batok sa dengue: pangitaa ug gub-a ang mga gilis-an sa tubig.

q: What three simple ingredients are found inside oral rehydration solution (ORS)?
options: Clean water, a little salt, and a little sugar
Clean water, honey, and lemon juice
Clean water, vitamins, and baking soda
Clean water, vinegar, and a little salt
explanation: ORS contains just clean water, a little salt to replace lost minerals, and a little sugar to help the water get absorbed into the body.
fact_tl: Ano ang laman ng ORS? Tatlong simpleng bagay lang: malinis na tubig, kaunting asin, at kaunting asukal. Ang asin ang nagpapalit ng mineral na nawala, ang asukal ang tumutulong sumipsip ang tubig, at ang tubig ang nagpapahydrate sa katawan.
fact_bis: Unsa ang sulod sa ORS? Tulo lang ka simple nga butang: hinlo nga tubig, gamay nga asin, ug gamay nga asukar. Ang asin nag-ilis sa nawala nga mineral, ang asukar nagtabang nga masuyop ang tubig, ug ang tubig nag-rehydrate sa lawas.

q: Why do maya birds fly together in a flock?
options: To find food more easily and stay safe from danger
To keep warm by sharing each other's body heat
To practice flying in formation before long migrations
To signal to other birds that this area belongs to them
explanation: Maya birds fly together in a flock so they can find food more easily and stay safer from danger.
fact_tl: Madalas lumilipad ang mga maya nang sama-sama sa isang kawan upang mas madaling makahanap ng pagkain at makaiwas sa panganib.
fact_bis: Ang mga maya kanunay molupad nga magkauban sa usa ka panon aron sayon nga makakaplag og pagkaon ug makalikay sa katalagman.

q: What is the coldest air temperature ever recorded on Earth, and where was it measured?
options: −89.2 °C at Vostok Station, Antarctica
−70.5 °C at the North Pole in the Arctic
−95.0 °C at the top of Mount Everest in Nepal
−62.1 °C at Oymyakon Station, Russia
explanation: The coldest air temperature ever recorded on Earth was −89.2 °C at Vostok Station, Antarctica, in 1983.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalamig na temperaturang naitala sa Mundo ay −89.2 °C (−128.6 °F) sa Vostok Station, Antarctica noong 1983.
fact_bis: Ang labing bugnaw nga temperatura nga natala sa Kalibutan mao ang −89.2 °C (−128.6 °F) sa Vostok Station, Antarctica niadtong 1983.

q: What happens to an animal's body during hibernation?
options: Its heart rate, breathing, and metabolism slow down and its body temperature drops
Its body temperature rises to keep all organs working through the cold winter
It stops producing waste products but continues to breathe and move normally
Its body shuts down completely, similar to how a computer turns off
explanation: During hibernation, an animal's heart rate, breathing, and metabolism slow down and its body temperature drops in order to save energy.
fact_tl: Sa hibernation, bumabagal ang tibok ng puso, paghinga, at metabolismo ng hayop, at bumababa ang temperatura ng katawan nito para makatipid ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Panahon sa hibernation, mohinay ang pintog sa kasingkasing, ginhawa, ug metabolismo sa mananap, ug monaog ang init sa lawas niini aron makatipig og kusog.

q: Why does the Philippines have so many mountains?
options: The Philippines sits where large tectonic plates meet and constantly push the land upward
Volcanic eruptions over millions of years piled up enough lava to form mountain ranges
Strong typhoons deposit sediment that slowly builds up into mountain formations
The Philippines drifted away from a larger continent, and the collision created mountains
explanation: The Philippines sits where large tectonic plates meet, so the land is constantly pushed up, creating many mountains.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nasa pagtatagpo ng malalaking tectonic plates, kaya patuloy itong itinutulak pataas at lumilikha ng maraming bundok.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas naa sa nagtagbo nga dagkong tectonic plates, mao nga padayon kining gitulod pataas ug naghimo og daghang bukid.

q: How do tardigrades survive extreme cold temperatures?
options: They remove almost all the water from their body so ice cannot form and tear their cells
They produce extra body heat by speeding up their metabolism during cold periods
They wrap themselves in a thick layer of fat that insulates them from freezing
They move to deeper underground areas where the temperature stays stable
explanation: In tun form, tardigrades remove almost all the water from their body so there is little left to form sharp ice that could damage their cells, and they also make substances that make freezing less harmful.
fact_tl: Paano nabubuhay ang tardigrade sa sobrang lamig? Una, tinatanggal nila ang halos lahat ng tubig sa katawan sa anyong tun, kaya kakaunti na lang ang pwedeng maging matulis na yelo na makakasira ng selula. May mga sangkap din silang gumagawa para hindi gaanong makapinsala ang pagyeyelo. Pero kailangan pa rin nilang maghanda, hindi basta-basta.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagkabuhi sa tardigrade sa hilabihang katugnaw? Una, sa porma nga tun kuhaon nila ang halos tanang tubig sa lawas, mao nga gamay na lang ang mahimong hait nga yelo nga makaguba sa selula. Mohimo usab silag mga sustansya aron dili kaayo makadaot ang pagyelo. Apan kinahanglan gihapon silang mangandam, dili kini awtomatik.

q: Which best describes the cheetah's speed ability?
options: It can reach 100 kilometers per hour in just a few seconds, faster than most cars accelerate
It can run at 100 kilometers per hour for up to one hour without stopping
It is the fastest animal on Earth but takes several minutes to reach top speed
It can only reach top speed on flat ground and slows down on any slope
explanation: The cheetah can reach 100 kilometers per hour in just a few seconds, making its acceleration faster than most cars.
fact_tl: Hindi lang mabilis ang cheetah — napakabilis din nitong magsimulang tumakbo. Kaya nitong umabot sa 100 kilometro kada oras sa loob lang ng ilang segundo, mas mabilis pa kaysa karamihang sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang cheetah dili lang paspas — paspas usab kini mosugod sa pagdagan. Makaabot kini og 100 ka kilometro kada oras sulod ra sa pipila ka segundo, mas paspas pa kaysa kadaghanan sa mga sakyanan.

q: What happens to energy each time it is transformed from one form to another?
options: It spreads out more evenly, so less of it remains available for useful work
It becomes more concentrated, making each transformation more efficient
The total amount of useful energy stays exactly the same through every transformation
Some energy is destroyed, so the total amount of energy in the universe decreases
explanation: Although the total amount of energy never decreases, in each transformation it spreads out more evenly, so the amount of energy available for useful work steadily declines.
fact_tl: Bagaman hindi nababawasan ang kabuuang enerhiya, sa bawat transpormasyon ay kumakalat ito nang mas pantay-pantay, kaya unti-unting bumababa ang dami ng enerhiyang maaaring gamitin para sa kapaki-pakinabang na gawain.
fact_bis: Bisan dili mokunhod ang kinatibuk-ang enerhiya, sa matag transpormasyon mokatag kini og mas patas, mao nga hinay-hinay nga mokunhod ang gidaghanon sa enerhiya nga magamit para sa mapuslanon nga buluhaton.

q: Why does the Moon experience such extreme temperature differences between its sunny side and its dark side?
options: There is no air on the Moon to hold heat, so temperatures change dramatically
The Moon spins very slowly, giving the sunny side too much time to heat up
The Moon's dark side faces away from the Sun forever and has never received any sunlight
The Moon's rocky surface absorbs almost all sunlight and releases none back into space
explanation: Because there is no air on the Moon to hold heat, the temperature changes a lot — extremely hot where the Sun shines and freezing cold in the dark.
fact_tl: Sobrang init ng Buwan kapag nasisikatan ng Araw, at sobrang lamig naman kapag madilim. Dahil walang hanging nagtatabi ng init, mabilis magbago ang temperatura roon.
fact_bis: Init kaayo ang Bulan kung sidlakan sa Adlaw, ug bugnaw kaayo kung ngitngit. Tungod kay walay hangin nga motipig sa kainit, paspas mausab ang temperatura didto.

q: What is the wind speed range of a tropical depression according to PAGASA?
options: 39 to 61 km/h
62 to 88 km/h
89 to 117 km/h
below 30 km/h
explanation: According to PAGASA, a tropical depression has winds of 39 to 61 km/h.
fact_tl: Ang tropical depression ay may hanging 39 hanggang 61 km/h.
fact_bis: Ang tropical depression naa'y hangin nga 39 ngadto sa 61 km/h.

q: What can scientists learn from fossil dinosaur footprints?
options: How fast dinosaurs walked and whether some traveled in groups
Exactly what dinosaurs ate and how they hunted their prey
The color and texture of a dinosaur's skin when it was alive
How long a particular dinosaur lived before it died
explanation: Fossil dinosaur footprints show scientists how fast dinosaurs walked and that some of them traveled in groups.
fact_tl: Natagpuan din ng mga siyentista ang mga fossil na yapak ng dinosaur, na nagpapakita kung gaano kabilis sila lumakad at kung ang ilan ay naglalakbay nang grupo-grupo.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentista nakakaplag usab og fossil nga mga tunob sa dinosaur, nga nagpakita kung unsa kapaspas sila molakaw ug nga ang uban nagpanaw nga pundok-pundok.

q: What is left behind when wood is completely burned?
options: Ash, while smoke rises into the air
Charcoal, which can be burned again later
Water vapor and carbon dioxide only
A dark liquid that pools at the bottom
explanation: When wood is fully burned, ash is left behind and smoke rises into the air.
fact_tl: Kapag tuluyang nasunog ang kahoy, naiiwan ang abo at lumalabas ang usok.
fact_bis: Kung hingpit nga masunog ang kahoy, mabilin ang abo ug moutbo ang aso sa hangin.

q: Why do we never see a green star in the night sky, even though some stars give off lots of green light?
options: Stars mix green light with other colors, and to our eyes that mix appears white, not green
No star is hot enough to produce green light, which requires very extreme temperatures
Green light from stars is absorbed by Earth's atmosphere before it reaches our eyes
Our eyes are not sensitive enough to detect the green wavelengths coming from distant stars
explanation: Even though some stars give off lots of green light, they also mix in other colors, and to our eyes that mix turns out white — so we never see a green star.
fact_tl: Tanong ng marami: bakit walang berdeng bituin? Kahit may mga bituin na naglalabas ng maraming berdeng liwanag, halo-halo rin nila ang ibang kulay, at sa mata natin ang halong iyon ay nagiging puti. Kaya wala tayong nakikitang berdeng bituin — puti ang lumalabas sa atin.
fact_bis: Pangutana sa daghan: ngano walay berde nga bituon? Bisan adunay mga bituon nga mobuga og daghang berde nga kahayag, gisagol pud nila ang ubang kolor, ug sa atong mata kana nga sagol mahimong puti. Mao nga wala kitay makita nga berde nga bituon — puti ang mogawas sa atoa.

q: What does Republic Act 9275, the Philippine Clean Water Act, protect?
options: Rivers, lakes, and seas from waste and chemicals from factories and garbage dumps
Groundwater wells from being used too much during dry season
Drinking water pipes in cities from being damaged or polluted
Ocean fish from being over-harvested by fishing boats
explanation: Republic Act 9275, the Philippine Clean Water Act, protects rivers, lakes, and seas from waste and chemicals coming from factories and garbage dumps.
fact_tl: Ang Batas Republika 9275 o Clean Water Act ng Pilipinas ay nagpoprotekta sa mga ilog, lawa, at karagatan mula sa dumi at kemikal na nagmumula sa mga pabrika at basurahan.
fact_bis: Ang Republic Act 9275 o Clean Water Act sa Pilipinas nagprotekta sa mga suba, lanaw, ug dagat gikan sa basura ug kemikal nga gikan sa mga pabrika ug basurahan.

q: How many categories does PAGASA use to classify tropical cyclones?
options: 5 categories
3 categories
4 categories
7 categories
explanation: PAGASA sorts tropical cyclones into 5 categories: tropical depression, tropical storm, severe tropical storm, typhoon, and super typhoon.
fact_tl: Inuuri ng PAGASA ang bagyo sa 5 kategorya: tropical depression, tropical storm, severe tropical storm, typhoon, at super typhoon.
fact_bis: Gi-klasipikar sa PAGASA ang bagyo sa 5 ka kategorya: tropical depression, tropical storm, severe tropical storm, typhoon, ug super typhoon.

q: What does a jumping spider do before it leaps, and why?
options: It lets out a dragline thread so it will not fall to the ground if the jump misses
It anchors all eight legs firmly before pushing off to maximize jumping force
It inflates a small air sac in its body to help it float gently if it falls
It sends a vibration signal to nearby spiders so they will catch it if it falls
explanation: A jumping spider lets out a dragline before it leaps, so even if the jump misses it will not fall to the ground.
fact_tl: Ang jumping spider ay naglalabas ng dragline bago tumalon, kaya kahit sumablay ang talon ay hindi ito mahuhulog.
fact_bis: Ang jumping spider mogawas ug dragline una kini molukso, busa bisan masipyat ang lukso dili kini mahulog sa yuta.

q: What do oxpecker birds eat while riding on the backs of large animals?
options: Ticks on the animal's skin
Small seeds caught in the animal's fur
Dried mud and dead skin flakes
Insects disturbed from the grass as the animal walks
explanation: Oxpecker birds ride on the backs of large animals and eat the ticks on their skin, which benefits both the bird and the host animal.
fact_tl: May mga ibong tinatawag na oxpecker na sumasakay sa likod ng malalaking hayop at kumakain ng kuto sa balat nila.
fact_bis: Adunay mga langgam nga gitawag og oxpecker nga mosakay sa likod sa dagkong mananap ug mokaon sa mga garapata sa ilang panit.

q: What does the IUCN use to classify how endangered a species is?
options: It classifies species as vulnerable, endangered, critically endangered, or extinct based on how many individuals remain
It ranks species from 1 to 10 based on how quickly their numbers are declining each year
It labels species as safe, at risk, or gone based on the size of their natural habitat
It sorts species into green, yellow, and red groups based on how much humans hunt them
explanation: The IUCN classifies species as vulnerable, endangered, critically endangered, or extinct based on how many individuals remain in the population.
fact_tl: Ang IUCN, isang pandaigdigang organisasyon, ay nag-uuri ng mga species bilang vulnerable (mahina), endangered (nanganganib), critically endangered (kritikal), o extinct (wala na) batay sa bilang ng natitira.
fact_bis: Ang IUCN, usa ka internasyonal nga organisasyon, nag-ugmad sa mga species isip vulnerable, endangered, critically endangered, o extinct base sa kung pila ang nahibilin.

q: What does a battery's voltage tell you?
options: How strongly the battery can push electrons around the circuit
How many electrons are stored inside the battery in total
How long the battery will last before it runs out of charge
How quickly the battery can recharge after it has been used
explanation: A battery's voltage measures how strongly it can push electrons around the circuit.
fact_tl: Ang boltahe ng baterya ang sumusukat kung gaano kalakas nitong naitutulak ang mga elektron sa sirkito.
fact_bis: Ang boltahe sa baterya maoy nagsukod kon unsa kakusog niini makaduso sa mga elektron sa sirkito.

q: What do coral fossils found inside Philippine limestone rocks tell us about places like the Chocolate Hills of Bohol?
options: Those places were once coral reefs under the sea and were later lifted onto dry land
Those places were formed by volcanic eruptions that buried ancient coral beds
Those places were once covered by a shallow freshwater lake full of coral animals
Those places received coral fossils carried inland by ancient mega-tsunamis
explanation: Coral fossils found inside Philippine limestone confirm that places like the Chocolate Hills were once coral reefs under the sea, now uplifted onto dry land.
fact_tl: Ang mga fosil ng coral ay matatagpuan sa loob ng mga limestone bato sa buong Pilipinas; ang mga fosil na ito ay nagpapatunay na ang mga lugar tulad ng Chocolate Hills ng Bohol ay dating mga coral reef na nasa ilalim ng dagat, ngayon ay nasa lupa na.
fact_bis: Ang mga coral fossil makita sulod sa mga limestone bato sa tibuok Pilipinas; kining mga fossil nagpakita nga ang mga lugar sama sa Chocolate Hills sa Bohol kaniadto mga coral reef sa ilawom sa dagat, karon gitaas na sa yuta.

q: Why do small stars live much longer than big stars?
options: Small stars burn their fuel slowly, while big stars burn their fuel fast and die young
Small stars are protected from solar winds, while big stars lose fuel through constant eruptions
Small stars are farther from other stars so they are not disturbed, while big stars collide more often
Small stars cool down and hibernate for long periods, while big stars stay hot all the time
explanation: Small stars burn their fuel slowly and live a very long time, while big stars burn their fuel fast and die young.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na bituin ay mabagal magsunog ng panggatong kaya nabubuhay sila nang napakatagal, samantalang ang malalaking bituin ay mabilis maubusan at maagang namamatay.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga mga bituon hinay mosunog sa ilang gatong busa mabuhi sila ug dugay kaayo, samtang ang dagkong mga bituon paspas mahurot ug sayo mamatay.

q: Why is it dangerous to be stung by many bees at the same time, even if you are not allergic?
options: More and more venom builds up in the body with each sting
Bee stingers break off and cause deep wounds inside
The bees release a gas that makes it hard to breathe
Each sting opens a hole that lets germs into the body
explanation: Even without an allergy, multiple stings are dangerous because venom builds up in the body.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi ka allergic, ang sobra-sobrang kagat ng maraming pukyutan nang sabay-sabay ay maaaring delikado, dahil dumarami ang kamandag sa katawan. Kaya mahalagang lumayo agad kapag ginugulo ang isang malaking pugad.
fact_bis: Bisan dili ka allergic, ang sobra ka daghang paak sa daghang putyokan nga dungan mahimong delikado, kay magdugang ang hilo sa lawas. Mao nga importante nga molayo dayon gikan sa dako nga gisamok nga salag.

q: During a storm in the Philippines, you count three seconds between a lightning flash and the thunder. About how far away did the lightning strike?
options: About one kilometer away
About three kilometers away
About ten kilometers away
About half a kilometer away
explanation: Every three seconds between the flash and thunder means lightning struck about one kilometer away, because sound travels slowly compared to light.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas na maraming bagyo, pwede mong malaman kung gaano kalayo ang kidlat. Bilangin ang segundo mula flash hanggang kulog tatlong segundo ay halos isang kilometro ang layo. Dahil ito sa mabagal na bilis ng tunog.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas nga daghan ug bagyo, mahibaw-an nimo kung unsa ka layo ang kilat. Ihapa ang segundo gikan sa flash hangtod sa dalugdog mga tulo ka segundo mga usa ka kilometro ang gilay-on. Tungod ni sa hinay nga kapaspas sa tingog.

q: Which mineral is rated 1 on the Mohs scale, making it the softest mineral?
options: Talc
Quartz
Calcite
Gypsum
explanation: Talc is the softest mineral, rated 1 on the Mohs scale.
fact_tl: Ang talc ang pinakamalambot na mineral, na may 1 sa Mohs scale.
fact_bis: Ang talc mao ang pinakahumok nga mineral, nga adunay 1 sa Mohs scale.

q: Why is the pipefish so hard to spot in a seagrass bed?
options: Its thin, long body looks almost exactly like a seagrass blade
Its skin changes color to match the sandy seafloor beneath it
It buries itself in mud and only shows its eyes
It stays perfectly still and pretends to be a coral branch
explanation: The pipefish is thin and long like a seagrass blade, making it very hard to see among the seagrass.
fact_tl: Ang pipefish ay isang manipis at mahabang isda na halos kamukha ng dahon ng damong-dagat kaya mahirap itong makita.
fact_bis: Ang pipefish usa ka nipis ug taas nga isda nga morag dahon sa sagbot sa dagat maong lisod kini makita.

q: A Philippine flying fox bat sleeps during the day and is active at night. What word describes this behavior?
options: Nocturnal
Diurnal
Migratory
Hibernating
explanation: An animal that is active at night and sleeps during the day is called nocturnal.
fact_tl: Ang paniking ito ay aktibo sa gabi at natutulog kapag araw, kaya tinatawag itong nocturnal.
fact_bis: Kini nga kabog aktibo sa gabii ug matulog kon adlaw, busa gitawag kini nga nocturnal.

q: How does a radio choose one specific station out of many?
options: It matches the frequency of that station's signal through resonance
It filters out all other sounds using a small microphone inside
It uses a magnet to attract the strongest radio wave nearby
It connects only to the station whose antenna is closest
explanation: A radio uses resonance to pick one station by matching the frequency of that station's signal.
fact_tl: Ang resonansya ay ginagamit din sa radyo: pumipili ito ng isang estasyon sa pamamagitan ng pagtugma sa prekwensiya ng signal nito.
fact_bis: Ang resonansya gigamit usab sa radyo: mopili kini og usa ka estasyon pinaagi sa pagtakdo sa prekwensiya sa signal niini.

q: Why can a vaccine usually NOT give you the real disease?
options: The germ inside the vaccine is dead or too weakened to infect you
The vaccine travels only to muscles, not to the blood
Your nose and mouth block the vaccine before it can spread
Vaccines are made from plants, not from real germs
explanation: The germ in a vaccine is dead or so weakened that it cannot infect you — it only teaches your body to recognize it.
fact_tl: May mga taong natatakot na magkasakit dahil sa bakuna, pero karaniwang hindi ito magbibigay ng tunay na sakit. Ang germ sa loob nito ay patay o napakahina na, kaya hindi na ito makakahawa — sapat lang ito para matuto ang katawan, hindi para magkasakit ka.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga nahadlok nga magsakit tungod sa bakuna, apan kasagaran dili kini maghatag sa tinuod nga sakit. Ang germ sa sulod patay na o huyang kaayo nga dili na makatakod — igo lang kini aron makakat-on ang lawas, dili aron magsakit ka.

q: What does the ozone layer in the stratosphere protect us from?
options: Rays that could burn skin and harm plants
Meteorites that fall toward Earth every day
Strong winds that would blow away the atmosphere
The extreme heat coming from the Sun's surface
explanation: The ozone layer protects us from rays that could burn skin and harm plants.
fact_tl: Pinoprotektahan tayo ng ozone layer sa stratosphere mula sa sinag na maaaring makasunog ng balat at makasama sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang ozone layer sa stratosphere nagpanalipod kanato gikan sa silaw nga makasunog sa panit ug makadaot sa mga tanom.

q: What medicine do doctors use in the hospital to treat a venomous snake bite?
options: Antivenom that fights the venom in the body
Antibiotics that kill the bacteria from the bite
A sugar solution that dilutes the poison in the blood
A vaccine to prevent any future snake bites
explanation: Doctors treat venomous snake bites with antivenom, which fights the venom in the body.
fact_tl: Kapag nakagat ng makamandag na ahas, ang taong natuklaw ay maaaring gamutin sa ospital gamit ang antivenom na pumipigil sa kamandag.
fact_bis: Kung mapaakan sa makamandag nga bitin, ang tawo mahimong tambalan sa ospital pinaagi sa antivenom nga mosumpo sa kamandag.

q: Scientists insert the human insulin gene into bacteria so the bacteria can produce insulin for diabetic patients. What technology makes this possible?
options: Recombinant DNA technology
Cell membrane transplanting
Selective breeding over many generations
Virus-based gene removal
explanation: Recombinant DNA technology allows scientists to move genes from one organism to another, such as putting the human insulin gene into bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang recombinant DNA technology ay nagpapahintulot sa mga siyentipiko na ilipat ang mga gene mula sa isang organismo patungo sa isa pa — ang human insulin gene ay ini-insert sa bacteria upang gumawa ng insulin para sa mga diabetic na pasyente.
fact_bis: Ang recombinant DNA technology nagpatunga sa mga siyentipiko nga makapagbalhin sa mga gene gikan sa usa ka organismo ngadto sa lain — ang human insulin gene gi-insert sa bacteria aron magbuhat sila og insulin alang sa mga pasyente nga may diabetes.

q: How does a newly hatched baby fish get its first food without drinking milk?
options: It uses a tiny food sac attached to its belly from the egg
It immediately eats tiny plants floating in the water
Its father feeds it by chewing food into small pieces
It absorbs food through its skin from the surrounding water
explanation: A baby fish carries a yolk sac attached to its belly from the egg, which gives it food until it can feed on its own.
fact_tl: Tanong ng bata: paano kumakain ang sanggol na isda kung walang gatas? Ang isda ay hindi gaya ng tao o hayop na nagpapasuso. Ang sanggol na isda ay may dalang maliit na 'baon' na pagkain na nakakabit sa tiyan nila mula sa itlog, kaya't kaya na nilang mabuhay nang mag-isa.
fact_bis: Pangutana sa bata: unsaon pagkaon sa gamay nga isda kung walay gatas? Ang isda dili sama sa tawo o hayop nga magpasuso. Ang gamay nga isda nagdala ug gamay nga 'baon' nga pagkaon nga nakataput sa ilang tiyan gikan sa itlog, mao nga makabuhi na sila sa ila-ilang kaugalingon.

q: Why does your skin always stay fresh and strong even though old skin cells die?
options: New cells are constantly made underneath and push old cells upward to flake off
The skin absorbs minerals from sweat to repair any dead cells
Blood vessels bring new skin cells to the surface each morning
The body grows a completely new layer of skin every seven days
explanation: Skin constantly makes new cells underneath that push old cells upward, where they dry out and flake off, keeping the body's shield fresh and strong.
fact_tl: Palaging gumagawa ang balat ng bagong cell sa ilalim na nagtutulak sa mga lumang cell paitaas. Ang mga lumang cell ay natutuyo at nalalaglag, kaya laging sariwa ang pananggol ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang panit kanunay nagahimo og bag-ong cell sa ilalom nga moduso sa daan nga cell pataas. Ang daan nga cell mauga ug matangtang, mao nga kanunay bag-o ang taming sa lawas.

q: On an old water well, which part of the crank is the 'wheel' and which part is the 'axle'?
options: The handle is the wheel and the bar that winds the rope is the axle
The rope is the wheel and the bucket is the axle
The bar is the wheel and the handle is the axle
The pulley at the top is the wheel and the rope is the axle
explanation: In a water-well crank, the handle is the wheel and the bar it turns is the axle, which allows a heavy bucket to be lifted with an easy turning motion.
fact_tl: Sa lumang balon, may pihit na hawakan na ikinakabit sa isang baras na nagbabalumbon ng lubid. Ang hawakan ang gulong at ang baras ang ehe. Kaya kahit mabigat ang timba ng tubig, kaya mo itong iangat sa pamamagitan ng madaling pagpihit.
fact_bis: Sa karaan nga atabay, naay liko-liko nga kuptanan nga gisumpay sa usa ka bara nga naglikos sa pisi. Ang kuptanan mao ang gulong ug ang bara mao ang ehe. Maong bisan bug-at ang timba sa tubig, masakwat kini pinaagi sa sayon nga pagtuyok.

q: How is sweet cane juice taken out of the sugarcane plant?
options: The stalk is crushed and pressed by a mill machine until the juice comes out
The leaves are boiled in hot water to release the sugar
The roots are soaked in water overnight and the liquid is strained
The stalk is dried in the sun until the sugar crystals appear on the surface
explanation: Cane juice is extracted by crushing and pressing the sugarcane stalk through a mill until the sweet liquid comes out.
fact_tl: Para makuha ang tamis, dinudurog at pinipiga ang tangkay ng tubo sa makina (molino) hanggang lumabas ang matamis na katas na tinatawag na cane juice.
fact_bis: Aron makuha ang katam-is, dugmokon ug pug-on ang punoan sa tubo sa makina (galingan) hangtod mogawas ang tam-is nga duga nga gitawag og cane juice.

q: What simple machine is the sharp tip of a nail?
options: A wedge that pushes wood fibers apart
A lever that multiplies the force of the hammer
A screw that spins into the wood
A pulley that changes the direction of force
explanation: The sharp tip of a nail is a wedge — it pushes wood fibers apart so the nail can slide in when hammered.
fact_tl: Ang matulis na dulo ng pako ay isang wedge na nagtutulak palayo sa mga hibla ng kahoy upang makapasok ang pako kapag pinukpok.
fact_bis: Ang talinis nga tumoy sa lansang usa ka wedge nga motulod og palayo sa mga lanot sa kahoy aron makasulod ang lansang kon paktolon.

q: What happens when you cut a magnet in two pieces?
options: Each piece becomes a new magnet that still has two poles
One piece keeps the north pole and the other keeps the south pole
The two pieces lose their magnetism and become ordinary metal
One piece becomes stronger and the other becomes weaker
explanation: If you cut a magnet in two, each piece becomes a new magnet that still has both a north and a south pole.
fact_tl: Kapag hinati mo ang magnet, hindi mawawala ang poste—ang bawat piraso ay magiging bagong magnet na may dalawang poste.
fact_bis: Kung putlon nimo ang magnet, ang matag bahin mahimong bag-ong magnet nga may gihapon duha ka poste.

q: When fireworks explode far away, you always see the flash before you hear the bang. What does this tell you?
options: Light travels much faster than sound
Sound is blocked by the air between you and the fireworks
Light and sound leave the fireworks at different times
Sound takes longer to start than light does
explanation: You see the flash before the bang because light is millions of times faster than sound, so the light reaches you first.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ay milyon-milyong beses na mas mabilis kaysa tunog. Kaya kapag may paputok sa malayo, nauuna mong makita ang flash bago mo marinig ang putok — dumarating muna ang liwanag dahil napakabilis nito, tapos saka pa lang darating ang mas mabagal na tunog. Kaya pwede mong matantya kung gaano kalayo ang paputok.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag minilyon ka beses nga mas paspas kaysa tingog. Busa kung adunay paputok sa layo, makita una nimo ang flash sa dili pa nimo madungog ang buto — moabot una ang kahayag kay paspas kaayo kini, ug unya pa moabot ang mas hinay nga tingog. Mao nga matantya nimo kung unsa ka layo ang paputok.

q: What is a fault in Earth's crust?
options: A crack in the crust where blocks of rock can move, causing earthquakes when they slip
A weak spot in the ocean floor where hot lava slowly leaks out
A deep valley formed when a mountain range wears down over millions of years
A boundary between two different types of rock that never move
explanation: A fault is a crack in Earth's crust where blocks of rock can move, and when they suddenly slip, an earthquake occurs.
fact_tl: Ang fault ay isang bitak sa balat ng lupa kung saan naghahati at gumagalaw ang mga bloke ng bato, at kapag bigla itong dumulas, nagkakaroon ng lindol.
fact_bis: Ang fault usa ka liki sa panit sa yuta diin nagbahin ug naglihok ang mga bloke sa bato, ug kon kalit kining modahili, mahitabo ang linog.

q: Why is the tamilok — a strange-looking creature eaten in Palawan — considered nutritious?
options: It is rich in protein
It is high in sugar for quick energy
It contains large amounts of vitamin C
It has the most calcium of any seafood
explanation: The tamilok is rich in protein, making it a nutritious food for some people in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Bagama't kakaiba, ang tamilok ay mayaman sa protina kaya ito ay masustansyang pagkain para sa ilang tao sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Bisan tuod talagsaon, ang tamilok dato sa protina mao nga kini usa ka masustansyang pagkaon alang sa ubang tawo sa Pilipinas.

q: What does a butterfly do with its wings right after it comes out of its chrysalis?
options: It pumps fluid into the soft, crumpled wings and lets them dry before flying
It vibrates the wings quickly to shake off any remaining cocoon silk
It rubs the wings together to warm them up in the sunlight
It dips the wings in water to make them flexible enough to open
explanation: When a butterfly first emerges, its wings are soft and crumpled, so it pumps fluid into them and waits for them to dry before it can fly.
fact_tl: Pagkalabas sa chrysalis, malambot at nakalukot ang pakpak, kaya pinupuno ito ng likido at hinahayaang tumuyo bago lumipad.
fact_bis: Pag-gawas sa chrysalis, humok ug kunot pa ang pako, busa pun-on kini og duga ug pasagdan nga mamala una molupad.

q: What is the main job of a sneeze?
options: To push out dust or germs that have entered the nose
To help the lungs take in a larger breath of fresh air
To warn the body that the temperature is getting too cold
To clear the throat so sound can come out more clearly
explanation: Sneezing helps push out dust or germs that have entered the nose, keeping the airway clean.
fact_tl: Ang pagbahin ay tumutulong na maitulak palabas ang alikabok o mikrobyo na pumasok sa ilong.
fact_bis: Ang pagbahing makatabang sa pagpagawas sa abog o mikrobyo nga nakasulod sa ilong.

q: What is an electromagnet?
options: A magnet made by passing electricity through coiled wire
A magnet that only works at very low temperatures
A natural rock that has been magnetized by lightning
A magnet inside a compass that always points north
explanation: An electromagnet is made when electricity flows through coiled wire, creating a magnetic force.
fact_tl: Ang kuryenteng dumadaloy sa nakapulupot na alambre ay gumagawa ng magnet na tinatawag na electromagnet.
fact_bis: Ang koryente nga moagi sa giliko nga alambre maghimo og magnet nga gitawag og electromagnet.

q: What gives brown sugar its brown color compared to white sugar?
options: Brown sugar still contains some molasses that was not removed
Brown sugar is made from a different type of sugarcane than white sugar
Brown sugar is colored by adding caramel during cooking
Brown sugar is less processed so it keeps the natural green color of the cane
explanation: Brown sugar still has some molasses in it, giving it a brown color; white sugar is refined more to remove the molasses.
fact_tl: Ang kayumangging asukal (brown sugar) ay may natitirang molasses kaya kulay-kape ito; ang puting asukal naman ay mas nililinis (refined) para maalis ang molasses at maging puti.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga asukal (brown sugar) aduna pay nahabilin nga molasses mao nga kape ang kolor niini; ang puti nga asukal mas gilinis (refined) aron makuha ang molasses ug mahimong puti.

q: When your arm lifts a heavy book, which part of the arm acts as the fulcrum of the lever?
options: The elbow
The wrist
The shoulder
The upper arm muscle
explanation: In the human arm working as a lever, the elbow is the fulcrum, the muscle provides the effort, and the hand holding the load is the output end.
fact_tl: Ang braso ng tao ay gumagana na parang lever. Ang siko ang fulcrum, ang kalamnan ang nagbibigay ng effort, at ang kamay na may dalang bigat ang load.
fact_bis: Ang bukton sa tawo molihok sama sa usa ka lever. Ang siko mao ang fulcrum, ang kaunuran maghatag sa effort, ug ang kamot nga nagdala og bug-at mao ang load.

q: What is the most effective way to stop mosquitoes from breeding around your home?
options: Remove standing water from containers, old tires, and trash
Spray all windows with insect repellent spray every morning
Put mosquito nets on all drains and water pipes
Plant strong-smelling herbs around the house to drive them away
explanation: Removing standing water in containers, old tires, and trash stops mosquitoes from having places to lay their eggs and breed.
fact_tl: Para hindi makapagparami ang lamok, dapat alisin ang nakaiimbak na tubig sa mga lalagyan, lumang gulong, at tapunan.
fact_bis: Aron dili makapadaghan ang lamok, kuhaa ang natigom nga tubig sa mga sudlanan, daang ligid, ug basura.

q: Why is the katala, the Philippine cockatoo, critically endangered?
options: Widespread capture for the pet trade and loss of its forest home in Palawan
Pollution from fishing boats has destroyed its food supply near the coast
A disease spread by migratory birds wiped out most of the population
Competition with introduced parrots has pushed it out of its nesting areas
explanation: The katala is critically endangered because of widespread capture for the pet trade and forest loss in Palawan.
fact_tl: Ang katala ay kritikal na nanganganib dahil sa malawak na pag-aani para gawing alagang hayop at sa pagkawala ng kagubatan sa Palawan.
fact_bis: Ang katala kritikal nga nanganganib tungod sa lapad nga pagdakop alang sa tiyanggihan ug pagkawala sa kagubatan sa Palawan.

q: What does a joey do when it starts to get bigger inside its mother's pouch?
options: It pokes its head out of the pouch to look around
It leaves the pouch permanently and walks beside its mother
It moves to a second pouch on the mother's back
It makes loud sounds from inside the pouch to ask for food
explanation: When the joey gets bigger, it pokes its head out of the pouch to look around while still staying inside for safety.
fact_tl: Kapag lumalaki na ang joey, inilalabas nito ang ulo sa supot upang tumingin sa paligid.
fact_bis: Kung modako na ang joey, idungaw niini ang ulo gawas sa supot aron motan-aw sa palibot.

q: Why were schools and workplaces in the Philippines closed during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020?
options: To prevent too many people from getting infected all at once
To give teachers time to prepare new online lesson materials
Because the virus was known to survive only in cold buildings
To allow hospitals to be converted into temporary classrooms
explanation: Lockdowns were put in place so that too many people would not get infected all at once, which would overwhelm hospitals.
fact_tl: Noong 2020, mabilis na kumalat ang COVID-19 sa buong mundo kaya tinawag itong 'pandemya.' Sa Pilipinas, nagkaroon ng 'lockdown' o quarantine kung saan nagsara ang mga eskwela at trabaho, at lumipat sa online classes ang mga estudyante. Ginawa ito para hindi madaliang mahawa ang napakaraming tao nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Niadtong 2020, paspas nga mikatap ang COVID-19 sa tibuok kalibutan busa gitawag kining 'pandemya.' Sa Pilipinas, dunay 'lockdown' o quarantine diin nagsira ang mga eskwelahan ug trabaho, ug nibalhin sa online classes ang mga estudyante. Gihimo kini aron dili dali matakdan ang daghang tawo nga dungan.

q: What are the two main gases that make up a star like our Sun?
options: Hydrogen and helium
Oxygen and nitrogen
Carbon dioxide and methane
Neon and argon
explanation: A star is made mostly of hydrogen and helium, the two lightest gases.
fact_tl: Ang bituin ay halos puro hydrogen at helium, ang dalawang pinakamagaang gas.
fact_bis: Ang bituon kasagaran hinimo sa hydrogen ug helium, ang duha ka labing gaan nga gas.

q: How does a dog's color vision compare to a human's?
options: Dogs see fewer colors than people do
Dogs see exactly the same colors as people
Dogs see more colors than people, especially in the dark
Dogs see only in black and white with no color at all
explanation: Dogs see fewer colors than people, so they do not see all the colors the way humans do.
fact_tl: Mas kakaunti ang kulay na nakikita ng aso kaysa sa tao, kaya hindi nila nakikita ang lahat ng kulay tulad natin.
fact_bis: Mas gamay ang kolor nga makita sa iro kaysa sa tawo, mao nga dili nila makita ang tanang kolor sama nato.

q: Why do Philippine orchids grow so well in their natural environment?
options: The warm and humid tropical climate provides perfect growing conditions
The cool mountain air keeps disease-causing insects away from them
The dry season forces the roots to grow deep and become very strong
Heavy monsoon rains wash minerals down from the mountains to feed them
explanation: Philippine orchids grow well because of the warm and humid climate of the tropics.
fact_tl: Ang mga orkidya ng Pilipinas ay mabuting tumubo sa mainit at mahalumigmig na klima ng tropiko.
fact_bis: Ang mga orkid sa Pilipinas maayong motubo sa init ug humol nga klima sa tropiko.

q: What does the term 'light-year' actually measure?
options: Distance — how far light travels in one year
Time — how long a ray of light takes to cross the solar system
Speed — how fast light moves through empty space
Brightness — how much light a star sends out in one year
explanation: A light-year is the distance that light travels in one year; it is a unit of distance, not time.
fact_tl: Ang light-year ay ang layo na nalalakbay ng liwanag sa loob ng isang taon, hindi ito sukat ng oras kundi ng distansya.
fact_bis: Ang light-year mao ang gilay-on nga malakbay sa kahayag sulod sa usa ka tuig; gilay-on kini ug dili oras.

q: Why do most metals need to be put in an extremely hot furnace before they can be shaped?
options: Most metals have a very high melting point, so they need very high heat to melt
Metals are full of trapped air that must be burned away before they soften
The crystals inside metal must be broken by heat before the metal can flow
Metals absorb heat slowly, so a furnace is needed just to warm them up
explanation: Most metals have a high melting point, so they need very high heat to melt.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng metal ay may mataas na melting point, kaya kailangan ng matinding init para matunaw ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa metal taas ang melting point, mao nga nagkinahanglan ug grabe nga init aron matunaw.

q: Besides letting the sun evaporate it, how else can you get salt back from seawater?
options: Boil the seawater so it evaporates faster and the salt is left behind
Filter the seawater through sand to catch the salt particles
Freeze the seawater so the salt separates and sinks to the bottom
Shake the seawater in a closed container until the salt settles out
explanation: Seawater can be boiled so the water evaporates faster, leaving the salt behind.
fact_tl: Bukod sa init ng araw, maaari ring pakuluan ang tubig-dagat para mas mabilis sumingaw ang tubig at maiwan ang asin.
fact_bis: Gawas sa init sa adlaw, mahimo usab pabukalon ang tubig-dagat aron mas paspas mosingaw ang tubig ug mahibilin ang asin.

q: You dissolve a spoonful of salt in a glass of water and the salt disappears. What happens to the total weight of the mixture?
options: It stays the same — the salty water weighs as much as the water and salt added together
It becomes lighter because the salt breaks into tiny pieces that weigh less
It becomes heavier because water fills the spaces where the salt grains used to be
It changes slightly because some salt turns into a gas when it dissolves
explanation: When salt dissolves in water it disappears from sight but not from the weight — the salty water weighs the same as the water and salt combined.
fact_tl: Kapag natunaw ang asin sa tubig, nawawala ito sa paningin pero hindi sa timbang — ang timbang ng tubig na may asin ay katumbas ng tubig at asin na pinagsama.
fact_bis: Kung matunaw ang asin sa tubig, mawala kini sa panan-aw apan dili sa gibug-aton — ang gibug-aton sa tubig nga may asin parehas sa tubig ug asin nga gidugtong.

q: At a palengke (Philippine market), there is a huge catch of fish today, and the stalls are overflowing. What will most likely happen to the price of fish?
options: Prices will fall because there is plenty of fish available
Prices will rise because the fishermen worked harder to catch so much
Prices will stay the same because the government sets all food prices
Prices will rise because more people will want to buy the extra fish
explanation: When there is a large supply of fish, prices fall according to the principle of supply and demand.
fact_tl: Sa palengke ng Pilipinas, ang presyo ng mga produkto ay naaapektuhan ng supply at demand — kapag maraming isda, bumababa ang presyo; kapag kaunti, tumaas ang presyo.
fact_bis: Sa palengke sa Pilipinas, ang presyo sa mga produkto naimpluwensyahan sa supply ug demand — kon daghan ang isda, moubos ang presyo; kon gamay, motaas ang presyo.

q: Why do chickens swallow small stones?
options: The stones help grind food inside their gizzard
The stones provide minerals that chickens cannot get from seeds
The stones balance the chicken's body weight while walking
The stones keep parasites away from the chicken's stomach
explanation: Chickens swallow small stones that help grind food inside their gizzard, since they have no teeth.
fact_tl: Ang manok ay lumulunok ng maliliit na bato na tumutulong durugin ang pagkain sa loob ng balun-balunan nito.
fact_bis: Ang manok motulon og gagmay nga mga bato nga makatabang sa pagdugmok sa pagkaon sulod sa balunbalunan niini.

q: Who first proposed the idea that the continents slowly move across Earth's surface?
options: Alfred Wegener
Charles Darwin
Isaac Newton
Galileo Galilei
explanation: Alfred Wegener proposed continental drift — the idea that the continents slowly move.
fact_tl: Si Alfred Wegener ang nagmungkahi ng continental drift — ang ideyang ang mga kontinente ay dahan-dahang gumagalaw.
fact_bis: Si Alfred Wegener mao ang nagsugyot sa continental drift — ang ideya nga ang mga kontinente hinay-hinayng molihok.

q: How many hours are there in one full day?
options: 24 hours
12 hours
48 hours
36 hours
explanation: There are 24 hours in one day, the time it takes Earth to complete one full rotation.
fact_tl: May 24 oras sa isang araw.
fact_bis: Adunay 24 ka oras sa usa ka adlaw.

q: About how hot is the core of the Sun, where energy is produced by fusion?
options: About 15 million degrees Celsius
About 5,500 degrees Celsius
About 1 million degrees Celsius
About 100,000 degrees Celsius
explanation: The Sun's core reaches about 15 million degrees Celsius, where nuclear fusion takes place and produces the Sun's energy.
fact_tl: Ang kaibuturan (core) ng Araw ay umaabot sa halos 15 milyong degree Celsius — milyon-milyong beses na mas mainit kaysa sa pinakamainit na oven sa lupa — at doon nagaganap ang pagsasanib na nagpapaningning sa Araw.
fact_bis: Ang kinahiladman (core) sa Adlaw moabot sa mga 15 ka milyon ka degree Celsius — labi pa ka init kaysa pinakainit nga hudno sa yuta — ug didto mahitabo ang fusion nga maoy hinungdan sa kahayag sa Adlaw.

q: What is the SI unit used to measure both energy and work?
options: Joule (J)
Watt (W)
Newton (N)
Ampere (A)
explanation: The SI unit of energy and work is the joule, with the symbol J.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng enerhiya at trabaho (work) sa SI ay joule, na ang simbolo ay J.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa enerhiya ug trabaho (work) sa SI mao ang joule, nga ang simbolo kay J.

q: What makes a material 'transparent'?
options: It lets light pass through it clearly
It reflects all light hitting its surface
It absorbs light and converts it to heat
It bends light so objects behind it look blurry
explanation: A transparent material, such as clear glass, lets light pass through it clearly.
fact_tl: Ang transparent na bagay tulad ng malinaw na salamin ay pinadadaanan ng liwanag nang malinaw.
fact_bis: Ang transparent nga butang sama sa tin-aw nga bildo magpaagi sa kahayag nga tin-aw.

q: An MRI machine takes clear pictures of the inside of the body. What does it use instead of X-rays?
options: A very powerful magnet
A beam of high-energy sound waves
A radioactive dye injected into the blood
A set of spinning mirrors and laser beams
explanation: An MRI machine uses a very powerful magnet to take clear pictures of the inside of the body without using X-rays.
fact_tl: Ang MRI machine sa ospital ay gumagamit ng napakalakas na magnet para kumuha ng malinaw na larawan ng loob ng katawan nang hindi gumagamit ng x-ray.
fact_bis: Ang MRI machine sa ospital mogamit ug kusog kaayo nga magnet aron makakuha ug klaro nga hulagway sa sulod sa lawas nga walay gamit nga x-ray.

q: Drinking far too much water can also be harmful to the body. Why?
options: It dilutes the salt in your blood too much, upsetting the balance
It stretches the stomach so badly that digestion stops working
It flushes out all the vitamins before your body can use them
It makes blood too thin, so the heart has to pump much faster
explanation: Drinking far too much water is harmful because it dilutes the salt in your blood too much; the key is balance.
fact_tl: Ang kabaligtaran ng dehydration ay ang sobrang pag-inom ng tubig, na pwede ring makasama dahil masyadong nadidiluwian ang asin sa dugo. Kaya ang importante ay balanse: uminom kapag uhaw, pero hindi rin sobra-sobra.
fact_bis: Ang kaatbang sa dehydration kay ang sobra nga pag-inom ug tubig, nga makadaot usab kay sobra nga matunaw ang asin sa dugo. Ang importante kay balanse: moinom kon uhaw, apan dili usab sobra.

q: How do bats in Philippine caves avoid bumping into walls and each other while flying in total darkness?
options: They use echolocation — sending out sounds and listening for echoes
They follow air currents created by other bats flying ahead of them
Their eyes can see a special type of light invisible to humans
They memorize the exact layout of the cave from their first flight
explanation: Many bats in Philippine caves use echolocation to navigate inside dark caves without bumping into anything.
fact_tl: Maraming paniki sa mga kuweba ng Pilipinas ang gumagamit ng echolocation para makalipad sa loob ng madilim na kuweba nang hindi bumabangga.
fact_bis: Daghang kabog sa mga langob sa Pilipinas mogamit og echolocation aron makalupad sulod sa ngitngit nga langob nga dili mabangga.

q: What is the SI unit for measuring electric current?
options: Ampere (A)
Volt (V)
Watt (W)
Ohm (Ω)
explanation: The SI unit of electric current is the ampere, with the symbol A.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng agos ng kuryente (electric current) sa SI ay ampere, na ang simbolo ay A.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa agos sa koryente (electric current) sa SI mao ang ampere, nga ang simbolo kay A.

q: Why is farm fruit usually bigger and sweeter than wild fruit found in the forest?
options: Farmers selected and cared for plants over many generations to produce bigger and sweeter fruit
Farm soil has more rainwater so the fruit grows larger and fills with more sugar
Wild fruit uses its sweetness as a defense against insects that eat it
Sunlight reaches farm trees more easily in open fields, adding more sugar
explanation: Farm fruit was chosen and cared for by people to be bigger, sweeter, and more plentiful, unlike wild forest fruit that grows on its own.
fact_tl: Ang prutas sa gubat ay tumutubo nang mag-isa at kadalasang mas maliit at hindi kasing-tamis ng prutas sa taniman. Ang prutas sa sakahan ay pinili at inalagaan ng tao para mas malaki, mas matamis, at mas marami.
fact_bis: Ang bunga sa lasang motubo sa iyaha ra ug kasagaran mas gamay ug dili kaayo tam-is kompara sa prutas sa uma. Ang prutas sa uma gipili ug giatiman sa tawo aron mas dako, mas tam-is, ug mas daghan.

q: What makes the body of a queen ant look different from worker ants?
options: The queen is bigger, especially her egg-filled belly, and her chest is larger where wings used to attach
The queen has a bright red head that shows other ants she is in charge
The queen has six legs while the workers have only four legs
The queen has much longer antennae so she can sense danger from far away
explanation: A queen ant is usually bigger than workers, especially her gaster which is full of eggs, and her chest is larger because that is where her wings used to be attached.
fact_tl: Karaniwang mas malaki ang reyna kaysa sa mga manggagawa, lalo na ang kanyang tiyan o gaster na puno ng itlog. Mas malaki rin ang kanyang dibdib dahil dito dati nakakabit ang mga pakpak niya.
fact_bis: Ang reyna kasagaran mas dako kaysa mga trabahante, ilabi na ang iyang tiyan o gaster nga puno sa itlog. Mas dako sab ang iyang dughan kay didto kaniadto nakakabit ang iyang mga pako.

q: Which farm animal is known for being one of the most intelligent and able to learn simple things?
options: Pig
Cow
Goat
Horse
explanation: Pigs are among the most intelligent farm animals and can learn simple things.
fact_tl: Ang baboy ay isa sa mga pinakamatalinong hayop sa sakahan at kaya nitong matuto ng mga simpleng bagay.
fact_bis: Ang baboy usa sa labing utokan nga mananap sa uma ug makakat-on kini ug yano nga mga butang.

q: About how long does sunlight take to travel from the Sun to Earth?
options: 8 minutes
3 minutes
24 hours
1 hour
explanation: The Sun is about 150 million kilometers away, and its light takes about 8 minutes to reach us.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay nasa mga 150 milyong kilometro mula sa Earth. Ang liwanag nito ay umaabot sa atin sa loob ng mga 8 minuto.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw mga 150 ka milyon ka kilometro gikan sa Earth. Ang kahayag niini moabot kanato sulod sa mga 8 ka minuto.

q: What acts like a natural pacemaker in the heart, making sure the chambers beat in the right order?
options: A small part near the top of the heart that sends electrical signals
The aorta, which pumps blood to the body
The ventricles, which receive blood first
Nerve endings in the heart muscle walls
explanation: A small part near the top of the heart acts like a natural pacemaker, sending signals so the atria beat first, then the ventricles — in the correct order.
fact_tl: Para tumibok nang maayos at sunod-sunod ang apat na silid, may sariling 'kuryente' ang puso. May maliit na bahagi sa itaas na parang natural na pacemaker na nagpapadala ng senyas. Una itong nagpapatibok sa mga atria, saka sa mga ventricles, kaya hindi nagkakagulo ang pagtibok.
fact_bis: Aron mopitik og maayo ug sunod-sunod ang upat ka lawak, ang kasingkasing adunay kaugalingong 'kuryente.' Adunay gamay nga bahin duol sa ibabaw nga sama sa natural nga pacemaker nga nagpadala og senyas. Pasagdan una niini ang atria mopitik, dayon ang ventricles, mao nga dili magubot ang pagpitik.

q: How does food and oxygen reach a baby growing inside its mother's body?
options: Through the umbilical cord
Through the mother's bloodstream directly into the baby's lungs
Through the placenta only, with no cord connection
Through swallowing amniotic fluid
explanation: Food and oxygen pass from the mother's body to the baby through the umbilical cord.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng pusod, naipapasa sa sanggol ang pagkain at oxygen mula sa katawan ng ina.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pusod, ang pagkaon ug oxygen mosulod sa bata gikan sa lawas sa inahan.

q: In what type of environment does rattan grow, and where are many kinds found?
options: Warm, moist tropical rainforests, especially in the Philippines and Southeast Asia
Cold, dry mountain forests in East Asia
Sandy coastal beaches around the Pacific
Grasslands and open plains in South America
explanation: Rattan grows in warm, moist tropical rainforests, and many kinds are found in the forests of the Philippines and Southeast Asia.
fact_tl: Ang uway ay tumutubo sa mainit at mahalumigmig na kagubatan, at marami nito sa mga gubat ng Pilipinas at Timog-Silangang Asya.
fact_bis: Ang uway motubo sa init ug umog nga kalasangan, ug daghan niini sa mga lasang sa Pilipinas ug Habagatan-Sidlakang Asya.

q: How is the sailfin lizard different from the water monitor lizard?
options: The sailfin lizard is smaller, has a sail on its back, and eats plants too, while the water monitor is larger and a hunter
The sailfin lizard is larger and eats only meat, while the water monitor is smaller and eats plants
Both are the same size but differ only in their diet
The sailfin lizard lives only in water, while the water monitor lives on land
explanation: The sailfin lizard is smaller, has its special sail on the back, and eats plants too, while the water monitor is larger and a hunter.
fact_tl: Madalas ipagkamali ang sailfin lizard sa bayawak na water monitor, pero magkaiba sila. Mas maliit ang sailfin lizard, may natatanging layag sa likod, at kumakain din ng halaman, samantalang ang water monitor ay mas malaki at mandaragit.
fact_bis: Kanunay masaypan ang sailfin lizard sa bayawak nga water monitor, apan lahi sila. Mas gamay ang sailfin lizard, adunay pinasahi nga layag sa likod, ug mokaon usab og tanom, samtang ang water monitor mas dako ug mangangayam.

q: What property makes red cabbage juice useful in a science experiment with acids and bases?
options: It changes color when mixed with an acid or base
It produces a gas that you can smell
It heats up quickly when mixed with any liquid
It dissolves completely and disappears in water
explanation: Red cabbage juice is a natural indicator that changes color in acids and bases.
fact_tl: Ang katas ng pulang repolyo ay natural na indicator na nagbabago ng kulay sa asido at base.
fact_bis: Ang duga sa pulang repolyo usa ka natural nga indicator nga mag-usab og kolor sa asido ug base.

q: Why do some animals have bright colors like yellow, red, or orange?
options: To warn predators that they are poisonous or dangerous
To attract sunlight and keep themselves warm
To blend in with colorful flowers so they can hide
To signal other animals that food is nearby
explanation: Bright colors like yellow, red, or orange warn predators that the animal is poisonous or dangerous — a kind of silent communication.
fact_tl: May mga hayop na may matingkad na kulay tulad ng dilaw, pula, o kahel para magbabala sa mga manunukob na sila ay nakakalason o delikado—isang uri ito ng tahimik na komunikasyon.
fact_bis: Adunay mga hayop nga hayag og kolor sama sa dalag, pula, o kahel aron pasidan-an ang mga manunukob nga sila makahilo o delikado—usa kini ka matang sa hilom nga komunikasyon.

q: Why does the Philippines have many active volcanoes?
options: It sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, a zone with many volcanoes and earthquakes
It is the largest island country in Southeast Asia
It is located near the equator, which creates more heat underground
Its mountains are made of very soft rock that melts easily
explanation: The Philippines sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, a zone with many volcanoes and earthquakes, which is why it has many active volcanoes like Taal, Pinatubo, Kanlaon, and Bulusan.
fact_tl: Maraming aktibong bulkan ang Pilipinas tulad ng Taal, Pinatubo, Kanlaon, at Bulusan. Nasa Pacific Ring of Fire ang bansa, isang lugar na maraming bulkan at lindol.
fact_bis: Daghan ang aktibo nga bulkan sa Pilipinas sama sa Taal, Pinatubo, Kanlaon, ug Bulusan. Ang nasod naa sa Pacific Ring of Fire, usa ka dapit nga daghag bulkan ug linog.

q: What happens when a falling object reaches terminal velocity?
options: It falls at a steady speed because air resistance equals gravity
It falls faster and faster until it hits the ground
It slows down and eventually stops in mid-air
It bounces upward because air resistance becomes stronger than gravity
explanation: When air resistance grows until it equals gravity, the object stops speeding up and falls at a steady speed called terminal velocity.
fact_tl: Kapag nahuhulog ang isang bagay, dumarating ang sandali na ang air resistance ay kasing lakas na ng grabidad — kaya hindi na ito bumibilis pa at pantay na ang bilis nito (terminal velocity).
fact_bis: Kung mahulog ang usa ka butang og dugay, moabot ang takna nga ang air resistance pareho na kakusog sa grabidad, busa dili na kini modugang ang katulin ug kanunay na ang gilay-on nga kapaspas (terminal velocity).

q: How does the janitor fish survive in water with very little oxygen?
options: It gulps air from the surface
It burrows into the mud until oxygen returns
It slows down its heartbeat and hibernates
It absorbs oxygen through its skin instead of its gills
explanation: The janitor fish can gulp air from the surface when there is little oxygen in the water, allowing it to survive even in dirty water.
fact_tl: Kaya ng janitor fish na humigop ng hangin sa ibabaw kapag kulang ang oxygen sa tubig. Dahil dito, nabubuhay pa rin ito kahit sa maruming tubig na ikamamatay ng ibang isda.
fact_bis: Makahimo ang janitor fish sa pagsuyop og hangin sa ibabaw kung kulang ang oxygen sa tubig. Tungod niini, buhi gihapon kini bisan sa hugaw nga tubig nga makapatay sa laing isda.

q: What role do roots play when there is a strong storm?
options: They hold the plant firmly so it does not fall over or get blown away
They absorb extra rainwater to feed the plant during the storm
They spread out to make the plant's trunk thicker
They release chemicals that calm the wind around the plant
explanation: Sturdy roots hold the plant in place during strong wind so it does not fall over or get blown away.
fact_tl: Kapag malakas ang hangin, ang matibay na ugat ang humahawak sa halaman para hindi ito matumba o matangay. Kaya nga mahalaga ang ugat tuwing bagyo.
fact_bis: Kung kusog ang hangin, ang lig-on nga gamot ang mokupot sa tanom aron dili kini matumba o mapalid. Mao nga importante ang gamot panahon sa bagyo.

q: How do worms grind their food if they have no teeth?
options: They swallow tiny sand grains that grind food inside their gizzard
They use strong stomach acid to dissolve everything they eat
They chew with hard ridges inside their throat
They only eat food that is already fully broken down by bacteria
explanation: Worms swallow soft food along with tiny grains of sand; inside their gizzard, the sand grinds the food so it can be digested.
fact_tl: Walang ngipin ang bulate, kaya nilalamon nito ang malambot na pagkain at maliliit na butil ng buhangin. Sa loob ng kanilang gizzard (balun-balunan), ginigiling ng buhangin ang pagkain para madaling matunaw — parang ngipin na nasa loob ng tiyan.
fact_bis: Walay ngipon ang ulod, mao nga molamoy kini og humok nga pagkaon ug gagmay nga lugas sa balas. Sulod sa ilang gizzard (balun-balunan), galingon sa balas ang pagkaon aron matunaw dali — sama sa ngipon nga naa sa sulod sa tiyan.

q: What do red ruby and blue sapphire have in common?
options: They are both made of the same mineral, corundum, and differ only because of tiny traces of different metals
They are both forms of quartz and get their color from iron
They are both found only in tropical rainforests and shaped by heat
They form from the same volcanic rock but harden at different temperatures
explanation: Red ruby and blue sapphire are made of the very same mineral, corundum — they differ in color only because of tiny traces of different metals mixed in.
fact_tl: Ang pulang rubi at ang asul na sapphire ay parehong gawa sa iisang mineral na corundum — magkaiba lang ang kulay dahil sa kaunting ibang metal na nahalo.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga ruby ug ang asul nga sapphire parehong hinimo sa usa lang ka mineral nga corundum — managlahi lang ang kolor tungod sa gamay nga lain nga metal nga nasagol.

q: What caused the tall cliffs and wrinkle-like ridges on the surface of Mercury?
options: Mercury's inside slowly cooling and shrinking, causing the surface to wrinkle
Strong meteor impacts that pushed up rock into ridges over time
The heat from the Sun melting and reshaping the surface
Liquid lava flowing and hardening into cliff shapes
explanation: As Mercury's inside slowly cools and shrinks, tall cliffs and wrinkle-like ridges formed on its surface, like skin that wrinkles.
fact_tl: Habang dahan-dahang lumalamig at lumiliit ang loob ng Mercury, nagkaroon ng mga mataas na bangin o parang kunot sa ibabaw nito, na parang balat na nangungulubot.
fact_bis: Samtang hinay-hinayng mobugnaw ug mogamay ang sulod sa Mercury, mitungha ang taas nga mga pangpang o morag kunot sa nawong niini, sama sa panit nga mokunot.

q: What does a sea turtle do with its eggs after laying them on the beach?
options: Covers them with sand and leaves them to be warmed by the heat of the sand
Carries them into the ocean to keep them cool and safe
Guards them in a nest made of leaves and sticks
Buries them underwater near coral reefs
explanation: After laying, the sea turtle covers the eggs with sand and leaves them to be warmed by the heat of the sand.
fact_tl: Matapos mangitlog, tinatabunan ng pawikan ang mga itlog ng buhangin at iniiwan ang mga ito para mainitan ng init ng buhangin.
fact_bis: Human mangitlog, tabonan sa pawikan ang mga itlog og balas ug biyaan kini aron painiton sa kainit sa balas.

q: Why are there two high tides each day instead of just one?
options: Water bulges on both the side facing the Moon and the far side of Earth
The Moon pulls water twice as it completes one full orbit each day
The Sun and Moon work together to create a tide every 12 hours
Strong winds push ocean water back and forth twice a day
explanation: Water bulges on the side facing the Moon and also on the far side of Earth, giving two high tides a day.
fact_tl: May dalawang kataasan ng tubig kada araw. Umaalsa ang tubig sa panig na nakaharap sa Buwan, at umaalsa rin sa kabilang panig ng Mundo, kaya dalawang taog kada araw.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka pagtaas sa tubig kada adlaw. Mosaka ang tubig sa kilid nga nag-atubang sa Bulan, ug mosaka usab sa pikas kilid sa Yuta, mao nga duha ka taob kada adlaw.

q: What is the correct order of colors in a rainbow from top to bottom?
options: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet
Violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, red
Red, yellow, orange, green, violet, blue, indigo
Blue, green, yellow, orange, red, indigo, violet
explanation: The order of rainbow colors is red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakasunod ng kulay ng bahaghari ay pula, kahel, dilaw, berde, asul, indigo, at violet.
fact_bis: Ang han-ay sa kolor sa balangaw mao ang pula, kahel, dalag, berde, asul, indigo, ug violet.

q: Why does kalamay-hati thicken as it is cooked for a long time?
options: Because water evaporates from the mixture as it boils
Because the sugar breaks down into a solid block when heated
Because the sticky rice absorbs all the coconut milk and expands
Because the mixture cools and hardens inside the pan
explanation: Kalamay-hati is boiled a long time until the water evaporates and the mixture thickens.
fact_tl: Ang kalamay-hati ay gawa sa gata, asukal, at malagkit na bigas na pinakuluan nang matagal hanggang sumingaw ang tubig at lumapot ito.
fact_bis: Ang kalamay-hati hinimo sa gata, asukar, ug pilit nga bugas nga gipabukal og dugay hangtod nga moalisngaw ang tubig ug molapot kini.

q: In gold panning, how does gold separate from sand?
options: The heavy gold sinks to the bottom while the lighter sand washes away
The gold dissolves in water and is collected when the water evaporates
The gold floats on top while the heavier sand sinks
The gold changes color in water, making it easy to pick out by hand
explanation: In gold panning, the heavy gold sinks to the bottom while the lighter sand washes away because of their different weight.
fact_tl: Sa pagdulang ng ginto, iniuuga ang buhangin at tubig sa lalagyan — lumulubog ang mabigat na ginto sa ilalim habang naaanod ang magaang buhangin. Naghihiwalay sila dahil magkaiba ang bigat.
fact_bis: Sa pagdulang og bulawan, uyogon ang balas ug tubig sa sudlanan — molubog ang bug-at nga bulawan sa ilawom samtang maanod ang gaan nga balas. Magkabulag sila tungod sa lahi nilang gibug-aton.

q: What stage of a cyclone is called a tropical storm, and who gives it a name in the Philippines?
options: The stage between a tropical depression and a typhoon, named by PAGASA
The stage after a typhoon when winds are slowing down, named by the Red Cross
The same as a typhoon but with a different name used in other countries
The weakest stage of a cyclone, named by the National Weather Bureau
explanation: A tropical storm is the stage between a tropical depression and a typhoon, with winds of 62–88 km/h, and it receives a local name from PAGASA.
fact_tl: Ang tropical storm ay ang yugto ng cyclone sa pagitan ng tropical depression at typhoon; ang bilis ng hangin nito ay 62–88 km/h at tumatanggap na ito ng pangalan mula sa PAGASA.
fact_bis: Ang tropical storm mao ang yugto sa cyclone tali sa tropical depression ug typhoon; ang iyang hangin 62–88 km/h ug nakakatanggap na kini og lokal nga ngalan gikan sa PAGASA.

q: What did the centipede's first pair of legs become, and what are they used for?
options: Sharp claws with venom for catching prey
Flat paddles for swimming in water
Sticky pads for climbing smooth surfaces
Long antennae for sensing movement
explanation: A centipede's first pair of legs became sharp claws with venom for catching prey.
fact_tl: Ang unang pares ng paa ng alupihan ay naging matalas na kuko na may kamandag para manghuli ng biktima.
fact_bis: Ang unang paris sa tiil sa alupihan nahimong hait nga kuko nga adunay hilo aron makadakop og tukbonon.

q: How can you tell a sea snake apart from an eel?
options: A sea snake has scales and lungs, while an eel has gills and smooth skin
A sea snake is longer and thinner, while an eel is short and wide
A sea snake glows in the dark, while an eel is dark brown
A sea snake has fins on its back, while an eel has none
explanation: A sea snake has scales and lungs, while an eel has gills and smooth skin.
fact_tl: Madaling mapagkamalang palos ang ahas-dagat, pero ang ahas ay may kaliskis at baga samantalang ang palos ay may hasang at makinis na balat.
fact_bis: Ang bitin sa dagat sayon masaypan nga igat, apan ang bitin adunay himbis ug baga samtang ang igat adunay hasang ug humok nga panit.

q: Which body system is responsible for breaking down the food you eat?
options: Digestive system
Respiratory system
Circulatory system
Nervous system
explanation: The digestive system breaks down food; the human body has many connected systems — digestive, respiratory, circulatory, skeletal, muscular, and nervous — that all work together.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng tao ay may magkakaugnay na body systems na may tungkulin: digestive (pagtunaw ng pagkain), respiratory (paghinga), circulatory (pagdaloy ng dugo), skeletal (buto), muscular (kalamnan), at nervous (pagkontrol at pakiramdam). Magkakatulong silang lahat para manatiling buhay ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa tawo adunay magkadugtong nga body systems nga may tahas: digestive (paghilis sa pagkaon), respiratory (pagginhawa), circulatory (pag-agos sa dugo), skeletal (bukog), muscular (kaunoran), ug nervous (pagkontrol ug pagbati). Nagtinabangay silang tanan aron mabuhi ang tawo.

q: Why does each kind of firefly have its own unique flashing pattern?
options: So the right mate can recognize that they are the same species
To warn predators that they are poisonous and should not be eaten
To light the way when flying through dark forest undergrowth
To communicate the location of food sources to other fireflies
explanation: Each kind of firefly has its own flashing pattern — number and length of flashes — so the right mate can recognize that they are the same species.
fact_tl: Bawat uri ng alitaptap ay may sariling padron ng pagkislap—ilang kislap at gaano katagal—para makilala ng tamang kapareha kung kapwa sila iisang uri.
fact_bis: Ang matag matang sa aninipot adunay kaugalingong padron sa pagkidlap—pila ka kidlap ug unsa kadugay—aron mailhan sa hustong kapares nga managsama silag matang.

q: What is the main job of the ozone layer high in Earth's atmosphere?
options: It absorbs most of the harmful ultraviolet light from the Sun
It traps heat close to Earth's surface to keep the planet warm
It reflects visible sunlight back into space to cool the planet
It produces oxygen that living things breathe
explanation: The ozone layer high in the atmosphere absorbs most of the harmful ultraviolet light from the Sun.
fact_tl: Ang ozone layer sa itaas ng atmospera ay sumisipsip ng karamihan sa nakakapinsalang ultraviolet mula sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang ozone layer sa taas sa atmospera nagasuyop sa kadaghanan sa makadaot nga ultraviolet gikan sa adlaw.

q: Which type of honeybee cannot sting?
options: Drones
Worker bees
The queen bee
Guard bees
explanation: Drones have no stinger, so they cannot sting.
fact_tl: Walang tibo ang mga drone kaya hindi sila makakatusok o makakapaso ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang mga drone walay tusok mao nga dili sila makapaak.

q: What is special about Mount Hamiguitan in Davao Oriental?
options: It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, listed in 2014
It is the highest mountain in the Philippines
It is the location of the country's largest active volcano
It is home to the only remaining lowland rainforest in the Philippines
explanation: Mount Hamiguitan in Davao Oriental is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, listed in 2014.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Hamiguitan sa Davao Oriental ay UNESCO World Heritage Site mula noong 2014.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Hamiguitan sa Davao Oriental usa ka UNESCO World Heritage Site sukad 2014.

q: What is the fastest-growing plant in the world?
options: Bamboo
Water hyacinth
Giant sequoia
Sugarcane
explanation: The fastest-growing plant in the world is bamboo.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis tumubong halaman sa mundo ay ang kawayan (bamboo).
fact_bis: Ang pinakapaspas motubo nga tanom sa kalibotan mao ang kawayan (bamboo).

q: Why does light bend when it moves from air into water or glass?
options: Because it slows down when entering a denser material, and this change in speed turns its path
Because water and glass are magnetic and pull the light sideways
Because light always follows the curve of round objects like lenses
Because the colors in light separate and each color bends at a different angle
explanation: Light bends because it slows down when it enters a denser material like water or glass, and this change in speed is what turns its path.
fact_tl: Nagbabaluktot ang liwanag dahil bumabagal ito kapag pumapasok sa mas siksik na bagay tulad ng tubig o salamin, at ang pagbabago ng bilis na ito ang nagpapaliko sa landas nito.
fact_bis: Mobawog ang kahayag kay mohinay kini kon mosulod sa mas baga nga butang sama sa tubig o salamin, ug kini nga pagbag-o sa katulin maoy moliko sa agianan niini.

q: Why can kapok float on water?
options: Each kapok fiber is a tiny hollow tube filled with air
Kapok fibers are coated with a waxy oil that repels water
Kapok is lighter than any other plant material in the world
Kapok fibers tangle together and trap a bubble of water underneath
explanation: Each kapok fiber is like a tiny hollow tube filled with air inside, so it can float on water.
fact_tl: Ang bawat hibla ng kapok ay parang napakaliit na tubo na may laman na hangin sa loob. Dahil puno ito ng hangin at hindi tubig, kaya nakakalutang ang kapok kahit sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang matag lugas sa kapok sama sa gamay nga tubo nga puno og hangin sa sulod. Tungod kay puno kini og hangin ug dili tubig, makalutaw ang kapok sa tubig.

q: What does yeast feed on to stay alive in bread dough?
options: Sugar found in flour or added to the dough
Starch granules inside the wheat grains
Water added to the dough
Salt mixed into the bread recipe
explanation: Yeast stays alive by eating the sugar found in flour or added to the dough, turning it into energy.
fact_tl: Ang lebadura ay nabubuhay sa pamamagitan ng pagkain ng asukal na nasa harina o idinagdag sa masa, at ginagawa nitong enerhiya ang asukal na ito.
fact_bis: Ang lebadura mabuhi pinaagi sa pagkaon sa asukal nga anaa sa harina o gidugang sa minasa, ug ginahimo niini nga kusog kining asukara.

q: Why are dishes like sinigang and tinola considered mixtures?
options: Because they are made of water, vegetables, meat, and seasonings combined — but you can still see and pick out each part
Because all their ingredients melt together completely so none can be separated
Because they are cooked at very high heat, which bonds all the ingredients chemically
Because they are made from a single ingredient that is cut into many pieces
explanation: Sinigang and tinola are mixtures because you can still see each part — water, vegetables, meat, and seasonings — and pick out the pieces you want.
fact_tl: Tuwing nagluluto tayo, gumagawa tayo ng pinaghalo. Ang sinigang at tinola ay halo ng tubig, gulay, karne, at rekado—lahat ay nasa isang kaldero pero nakikita mo pa ang bawat sangkap. Kaya nga puwede mong piliin ang gusto mong kainin mula sa sabaw.
fact_bis: Matag higayon nga magluto ta, naghimo ta og sagol. Ang sinigang ug tinola mga sagol sa tubig, utanon, karne, ug panakot—tanan naa sa usa ka kaldero, apan makita pa nimo ang matag sangkap. Mao nga mahimo nimong pilion ang gusto nimong kan-on gikan sa sabaw.

q: Which of the following correctly describes a parrot?
options: It has feathers and wings and lays eggs to reproduce
It has scales, breathes underwater, and gives birth to live young
It has fur, is warm-blooded, and feeds its young with milk
It has a hard shell, lives in water, and lays eggs on the seafloor
explanation: A parrot is a bird that has feathers and wings and lays eggs to reproduce.
fact_tl: Ang loro ay isang ibon na may balahibo at pakpak at nangingitlog kapag nagpaparami.
fact_bis: Ang loro usa ka langgam nga adunay balahibo ug pako ug mangitlog aron magsanay.

q: What is one of the biggest causes of death among children worldwide, linked to dirty water?
options: Diarrhea diseases
Respiratory infections from air pollution
Malaria from mosquito bites
Skin diseases from lack of sunlight
explanation: Diarrhea diseases from dirty water are one of the biggest causes of death among children worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang mga sakit na may pagtatae mula sa maruming tubig ay isa sa pinakamalaking sanhi ng pagkamatay ng mga bata sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang mga sakit nga adunay kalibanga gikan sa hugaw nga tubig usa sa labing dako nga hinungdan sa kamatayon sa mga bata sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: In 1854, how did John Snow discover the source of a cholera outbreak in London?
options: He traced it to a single contaminated water pump
He found that sick people had all eaten the same infected food
He identified rats carrying the disease through the sewers
He noticed the outbreak started near a hospital and spread outward
explanation: In 1854 in London, John Snow traced a cholera outbreak to a single contaminated water pump.
