options: Scissors have two blades that support each other, giving more control and a neater cut
Scissors are always sharper than a knife because they are made of harder metal
A knife is heavier, so it gets tired and wobbles, while scissors stay steady
Scissors make a safer cut because they can only close, not stab
explanation: Unlike a knife that must be pressed down on a surface, scissors have two blades that support each other, giving more control and a neater cut.
fact_tl: Bakit minsan mas mainam ang gunting kaysa kutsilyo? Ang kutsilyo ay isang talim na kailangan mong idiin sa ibabaw ng bagay, pero ang gunting ay may dalawang talim na sumusuporta sa isa't isa, kaya mas kontrolado at mas tumpak ang hiwa sa papel o tela.
fact_bis: Ngano usahay mas maayo ang gunting kay sa kutsilyo? Ang kutsilyo usa ka sulab nga kinahanglan nimong idis-og sa ibabaw sa butang, apan ang gunting adunay duha ka sulab nga nagsuportahay, mao nga mas kontrolado ug mas hapsay ang putol sa papel o panapton.

q: What happens to a baby when its mother smokes or drinks alcohol during pregnancy?
options: The baby in the womb is harmed too
The baby is protected because the placenta blocks all harmful substances
The baby is only affected after birth, not while inside the womb
Only the mother's health is affected; the baby is not harmed
explanation: When a pregnant woman smokes or drinks alcohol, the baby in her womb is harmed too.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang buntis ay naninigarilyo o umiinom ng alak, naaapektuhan din ang sanggol sa kanyang sinapupunan.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka mabdos manigarilyo o moinom ug alak, maapektuhan usab ang bata sa iyang tiyan.

q: Of the three fruits — guyabano, guava, and avocado — which one is the largest and can weigh several kilograms?
options: Guava
Guyabano
Avocado
Papaya
explanation: The guyabano is the largest of the three fruits and can weigh several kilograms.
fact_tl: Sa tatlong prutas, ang guyabano ang pinakamalaki at maaaring tumimbang nang ilang kilo.
fact_bis: Sa tulo ka prutas, ang guyabano ang pinakadako ug mahimong motimbang og pipila ka kilo.

q: How is PHIVOLCS earthquake intensity written differently from earthquake magnitude?
options: Intensity uses decimal numbers; magnitude uses Roman numerals
Intensity uses Roman numerals; magnitude uses decimal numbers
Both use decimal numbers, but intensity is always higher
Both use Roman numerals, but magnitude has more digits
explanation: PHIVOLCS intensity is written in Roman numerals (e.g. Intensity VII), while magnitude is written as an ordinary decimal number (e.g. 7.2).
fact_tl: Ang magnitude ay isinusulat sa karaniwang numero na may desimal (hal. 7.2), samantalang ang PHIVOLCS intensity ay sa Roman numerals (hal. Intensity VII).
fact_bis: Ang magnitude gisulat sa ordinaryong numero nga adunay desimal (pananglitan 7.2), samtang ang PHIVOLCS intensity gisulat sa Roman numerals (pananglitan Intensity VII).

q: Why do farmers carefully choose which plants or animals will become parents?
options: To make sure the offspring look exactly like the parents in color only
To pass useful traits like bigger harvests or healthier cattle to the next generation
To prevent any mutations from occurring in the next generation
To reduce the total number of offspring produced each season
explanation: Farmers select parents with desirable traits so those traits — like a bigger harvest or healthier cattle — are passed to the next generation through selective breeding.
fact_tl: Pinipili ng mga magsasaka at mag-aalaga ng hayop ang mga halaman o hayop na may magagandang katangian para gawing magulang. Sa ganitong paraan, ipinapasa ang mga kanais-nais na katangian — tulad ng mas malaking ani o mas malusog na baka — sa susunod na henerasyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga mag-uuma ug tig-atiman og hayop magpili sa mga tanom o hayop nga adunay maayong kinaiya aron himuong ginikanan. Niini nga paagi, ang mapuslanon nga mga kinaiya — sama sa mas dako nga ani o mas himsog nga baka — gipasa sa sunod nga henerasyon.

q: What makes a spider's dragline stronger than a single thread?
options: It is made of a sticky material that traps insects
It is made of two thin threads laid side by side and joined together
It is made of a thick single strand of metal-like silk
It is coated with a special glue produced by the spider's feet
explanation: A dragline is often made of two thin threads laid side by side and joined, which makes it stronger than a single thread.
fact_tl: Madalas, ang isang dragline ay binubuo ng dalawang manipis na hiblang magkadikit na pinagsama para mas tumibay ito.
fact_bis: Kasagaran, ang usa ka dragline gilangkuban ug duha ka nipis nga hilo nga gitapad ug gihiusa aron mas molig-on.

q: What happens when mutations build up in the genes that control cell division?
options: The cell stops dividing completely and shrinks
The cell starts dividing out of control, which is called cancer
The cell repairs itself by producing extra proteins
The cell becomes immune to all future mutations
explanation: When mutations build up in genes that control dividing, it is like the brakes break and the cell starts dividing out of control — this unstoppable growth is called cancer.
fact_tl: Karaniwang sumusunod ang mga cell sa panuto kung kailan dapat maghati at kailan dapat huminto. Kung mag-ipon ang ilang mutation sa mga gene na nagkokontrol ng paghahati, parang nasira ang preno, at nag-uumpisang maghati nang wala sa kontrol ang cell. Ang ganitong walang-tigil na paglaki ay tinatawag na cancer.
fact_bis: Kasagaran mosunod ang mga cell sa mando kung kanus-a mobahin ug kanus-a mohunong. Kung magtapok ang pipila ka mutation sa mga gene nga nagkontrol sa pagbahin, murag naguba ang preno, ug magsugod og bahin nga dili matugkad ang cell. Kining walay-hunong nga pagtubo mao ang gitawag nato nga kanser.

q: Which set of lifestyle choices best helps reduce the risk of cancer?
options: Eating only cooked food, sleeping more than 10 hours, and avoiding cold drinks
Not smoking, protecting skin from the sun, and eating plenty of fruits and vegetables
Drinking lots of sugary juice, exercising indoors only, and avoiding spicy food
Taking vitamins every day, avoiding all sunlight, and eating red meat regularly
explanation: Many cancers can be prevented by avoiding things that cause DNA mutations — not smoking, protecting skin from the sun, and eating fruits and vegetables all help reduce the risk.
fact_tl: Maraming klase ng kanser ay maiiwasan sa pamamagitan ng pag-iwas sa mga bagay na nagdudulot ng DNA mutations — ang hindi paninigarilyo, pagprotekta sa balat mula sa araw, at pagkain ng maraming prutas at gulay ay nakakatulong na bawasan ang panganib.
fact_bis: Daghang klase sa kanser mapigilan pinaagi sa paglikay sa mga butang nagpangusog sa DNA mutations — ang dili paninigarilyo, pagpanalipod sa panit gikan sa adlaw, ug pagkaon og daghang mga prutas ug gulay nagtabang sa pagbawas sa risgo.

q: Where is the Manila Trench located compared to the Philippine Trench?
options: The Manila Trench is also on the east side, just north of the Philippine Trench
The Manila Trench is on the west side of the Philippines, near the South China Sea
The Manila Trench is directly beneath the Philippine Trench at greater depth
The Manila Trench is in the middle of the Philippine archipelago under Mindanao
explanation: The Philippine Trench is on the east side of the country, while the Manila Trench is on the west side, near the South China Sea, and they connect to different plates.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay nasa silangan ng bansa, pero may ibang kanal sa kanluran na tinatawag na Manila Trench, malapit sa South China Sea. Magkaiba sila ng lokasyon at kung saang plate naka-ugnay.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench naa sa sidlakan sa nasod, apan adunay laing kanal sa kasadpan nga gitawag og Manila Trench, duol sa South China Sea. Lahi silag nahimutangan ug lahi ang plate nga ilang gisumpay.

q: Why does a person with blood type AB have no anti-A or anti-B antibodies?
options: Their immune system destroys all antibodies before they can form
Their body already has both A and B antigens and does not make antibodies against its own antigens
They produce extra red blood cells that neutralize any antibodies
Type AB blood is too thick for antibodies to travel through
explanation: Type AB individuals already have both A and B antigens, so the immune system sees them as 'self' and does not produce antibodies against them.
fact_tl: Bakit walang anti-A o anti-B ang type AB? Dahil may A at B antigen na mismo ang katawan niya, kinikilala ito ng immune system bilang 'sarili.' Hindi gumagawa ng antibody laban sa sariling antigen, kaya wala itong panlaban sa A o B.
fact_bis: Ngano walay anti-A o anti-B ang type AB? Tungod kay ang lawas niini aduna nay A ug B antigen, giila kini sa immune system isip 'kaugalingon.' Ang lawas dili maghimo ug antibody batok sa kaugalingong antigen, mao nga wala kini igong panlaban sa A o B.

q: How do scientists figure out whether an asteroid coming near Earth is a danger?
options: They send a spacecraft to land on it and measure its surface temperature
They calculate the routes of these objects ahead of time using telescopes
They wait for the asteroid to enter the atmosphere and then measure its size
They compare old photographs of the sky taken decades apart
explanation: Scientists use telescopes to watch near-Earth asteroids and calculate their routes ahead of time to know whether Earth is safe.
fact_tl: Binabantayan ng mga siyentista sa pamamagitan ng mga teleskopyo ang mga asteroid na lumalapit sa landas ng Earth. Kinakalkula nila ang ruta ng mga ito nang maaga para malaman kung ligtas ang ating planeta at kung kailangan ng aksyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentista naggamit og mga teleskopyo aron bantayan ang mga asteroid nga moduol sa agianan sa Earth. Ilang gikalkula ang ruta niini nga sayo aron mahibaloan kung luwas ang atong planeta ug kung kinahanglan ba og aksyon.

q: Why are bones considered living tissue rather than dead objects?
options: Because bones can move on their own without any muscles attached
Because the body constantly removes old parts and replaces them using fresh calcium
Because bones contain blood vessels that carry oxygen to the brain
Because bones grow from the outside in, just like tree rings
explanation: Bones are alive and constantly changing — the body removes old parts and replaces them using fresh calcium.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba ay patay na bagay ang buto, pero ito ay buhay at palaging nagbabago. Tinatanggal at pinapalitan ng katawan ang lumang bahagi gamit ang bagong kaltsyum.
fact_bis: Ang uban naghunahuna nga patay nga butang ang bukog, apan kini buhi ug kanunay nga nagabag-o. Tangtangon ug ilisan sa lawas ang daan nga bahin gamit ang bag-ong kalsyum.

q: How can algae growing on a water turtle's shell be helpful to the turtle?
options: The algae provide extra calcium that strengthens the shell over time
The green algae can help the turtle blend in and be harder to spot in the water
The algae keep the shell warm during cold nights in deep water
The algae release oxygen directly into the turtle's bloodstream
explanation: Green algae growing on a water turtle's shell can help it blend in and be harder to spot in the water, providing camouflage.
fact_tl: Sa mga pagong na nakatira sa tubig, minsan tumutubo ang lumot sa kanilang talukab. Bukod sa nagiging tirahan ito ng maliliit na nilalang, nakakatulong din ang berdeng lumot para mas mahirap silang makita sa tubig.
fact_bis: Sa mga bao nga nagpuyo sa tubig, usahay motubo ang lumot sa ilang talukab. Gawas nga mahimong puy-anan kini sa gagmayng binuhat, ang berdeng lumot makatabang usab aron lisod sila makita sa tubig.

q: A carabao loves to stay in the water — does that make it a fish?
options: Yes, because it spends most of its time in the water just like a fish
No, it is still a land animal that breathes air through its nose, not underwater
Yes, because its thick skin allows it to breathe through water like a fish
No, but only because it has four legs instead of fins
explanation: Even though a carabao loves water, it is not a fish — it is a land animal that breathes air through its nose, not underwater.
fact_tl: Kahit mahilig sa tubig ang kalabaw, hindi ito isda. Hayop pa rin itong nakatira sa lupa at humihinga ng hangin gamit ang ilong, hindi sa tubig.
fact_bis: Bisan mahiligon sa tubig ang kalabaw, dili kini isda. Mananap gihapon kini nga nagpuyo sa yuta ug nagaginhawa ug hangin pinaagi sa ilong, dili sa ilalom sa tubig.

q: Which example best shows that the same substance can exist in three different states?
options: Sand can be dry, wet, or mixed with clay depending on how much rain falls
Water can be ice (solid), liquid water, or steam (gas)
Air can be cold, warm, or hot depending on the season
A rock can be small, medium, or large depending on how it breaks
explanation: Water is the clearest example — the same substance can be ice (solid), liquid water, or steam (gas).
fact_tl: Ang iisang sangkap ay maaaring maging solido, likido, o gas. Ang tubig ay maaaring maging yelo (solido), tubig (likido), o singaw (gas).
fact_bis: Ang iyang substansya makahimong solido, likido, o gas. Ang tubig mahimong yelo (solido), likidong tubig, o singaw (gas).

q: How can a new gumamela plant be grown without using seeds?
options: By pouring extra fertilizer around an existing gumamela plant
By planting a cut piece of its stem in the soil
By grafting its flowers onto a different type of plant
By soaking its fallen leaves in water until roots appear
explanation: A new gumamela can be grown by planting a cut piece of its stem in the soil — this is called propagation by cuttings.
fact_tl: Maaaring palaguin ang bagong gumamela sa pamamagitan ng pagtatanim ng putol na sanga nito sa lupa.
fact_bis: Mahimong patubuon ang bag-ong gumamela pinaagi sa pagtanom sa giputol nga sanga niini sa yuta.

q: What did Eduardo San Juan achieve that made him an example of Filipino excellence internationally?
options: He became the first Filipino astronaut to travel to the Moon
He worked as an engineer at NASA, showing Filipino scientists can excel on the international stage
He discovered a new planet in the solar system while working at a Philippine observatory
He designed the first satellite launched by a Southeast Asian country
explanation: Eduardo San Juan worked as an engineer at NASA and became an example of excellence by Filipino scientists on the international stage.
fact_tl: Nagtrabaho si Eduardo San Juan bilang inhinyero sa NASA at naging halimbawa ng kahusayan ng mga Pilipinong siyentipiko sa internasyonal na entablado.
fact_bis: Nagtrabaho si Eduardo San Juan ingon inhinyero sa NASA ug naging sulondan sa kahusayan sa mga Pilipinong siyentipiko sa internasyonal nga entablado.

q: How many rocky planets are closest to the Sun, and which ones are they?
options: Three rocky planets: Mercury, Venus, and Earth
Five rocky planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, and Pluto
Four rocky planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars
Four rocky planets: Venus, Earth, Mars, and Jupiter
explanation: There are four rocky planets closest to the Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.
fact_tl: May apat (4) na batong (rocky) planeta na malapit sa Araw: Mercury, Venus, Earth, at Mars.
fact_bis: Adunay upat (4) ka batoon (rocky) nga planeta nga duol sa Adlaw: Mercury, Venus, Earth, ug Mars.

q: Why do engineers place two cameras side by side on robots and self-driving cars?
options: To capture a wider view by pointing each camera in a different direction
To let the machine see depth and measure distance, copying how predator eyes work
To take photos in color and in black-and-white at the same time
To reduce the cost of sensors by using smaller, cheaper cameras in pairs
explanation: Engineers copy the forward-facing eyes of predators by placing two cameras side by side so the machine can see depth and measure distance — just like predator eyes do.
fact_tl: Ginagaya ng mga inhinyero ang harapang mata ng mandaragit. Naglalagay sila ng dalawang kamera nang magkatabi sa mga robot at self-driving na kotse para makita ang lalim at masukat ang layo ng mga bagay — gaya ng ginagawa ng mata.
fact_bis: Gisundog sa mga inhenyero ang nag-atubang nga mata sa mandaragit. Magbutang sila og duha ka kamera nga magtapad sa mga robot ug self-driving nga awto aron makakita og giladmon ug masukod ang gilay-on sa mga butang — sama sa gibuhat sa mata.

q: When you touch a makahiya plant and its leaves fold, what type of movement is this?
options: Phototropism — the plant moving toward the direction of light
Thigmonasty — a nastic movement triggered by touch, not by the direction of the stimulus
Gravitropism — the plant responding to the pull of gravity on its stems
Hydrotropism — the plant's roots moving toward a water source underground
explanation: Makahiya shows thigmonasty — a nastic movement caused by touch — where the direction of the stimulus does not matter; the response is triggered by a rapid drop in turgor pressure in specialized leaf cells.
fact_tl: Ang nastic movements ay paggalaw ng halaman na hindi depende sa direksyon ng stimulus—ang makahiya ay gumaganap ng thigmonasty (pagtugon sa haplos) na sanhi ng pagbaba ng turgor pressure sa mga espesyal na selula sa dahon.
fact_bis: Ang nastic movements paggalaw sa tanum nga dili depende sa direksyon sa stimulus; ang makahiya nagpakita og thigmonasty (pagtubag sa haplos) tungod sa kalit nga pagbaba sa turgor pressure sa espesyal nga mga selula sa dahon.

q: In an ecosystem, what is the key difference between how matter and energy are handled?
options: Both matter and energy are recycled endlessly without any loss
Matter like carbon can be reused over and over, but energy cannot be recycled and must keep coming from the sun
Energy is recycled through decomposers, but matter is lost as heat at each level
Neither matter nor energy can be recycled; both must come from outside the ecosystem
explanation: Matter such as carbon and nitrogen can be reused over and over in an ecosystem, but energy cannot be recycled and must keep coming from the sun.
fact_tl: Ang materya tulad ng karbon at nitrogen ay maaaring gamitin nang paulit-ulit sa isang ekosistema, ngunit ang enerhiya ay hindi maibabalik, kaya kailangang patuloy na magmula sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang materya sama sa carbon ug nitrogen mahimong gamiton balik-balik sa usa ka ekosistema, apan ang kusog dili mabalik, busa kinahanglan kanunayng maggikan sa adlaw.

q: What are intestinal worms?
options: Tiny bacteria that live on the surface of the skin and cause itching
Small animals that live inside a person's intestines
A type of fungus that grows in the stomach when food is spoiled
Viruses that attack the digestive system and cause fever
explanation: Intestinal worms are small animals that live inside a person's intestines.
fact_tl: Ang bulate sa tiyan ay maliliit na hayop na nabubuhay sa loob ng bituka ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang bulate sa tiyan kay gagmay nga mananap nga nagpuyo sulod sa tinai sa tawo.

q: What is the main difference between a school feeding program and a food bank?
options: A feeding program gives raw food to take home; a food bank cooks and serves food at school
In a feeding program, cooked food is served directly to children at school; in a food bank, raw or packaged food is given to families to take home
Both programs serve the same purpose, but a food bank only helps adults while a feeding program helps children
A food bank is run by the government; a feeding program is only run by private groups
explanation: In a feeding program, food is cooked and fed directly to children at school; in a food bank, raw or packaged food is given to families to take home and cook themselves.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang feeding program at food bank. Sa feeding program, ang pagkain ay niluluto at direktang ipinapakain sa mga bata sa paaralan. Sa food bank naman, ang mga hilaw o nakaimpaketeng pagkain ay ibinibigay sa mga pamilya para dalhin sa bahay at lutuin nila mismo.
fact_bis: Lahi ang feeding program ug ang food bank. Sa feeding program, ang pagkaon giluto ug direkta nga gipakaon sa mga bata sa eskwelahan. Sa food bank, ang hilaw o nakaempake nga pagkaon ihatag sa mga pamilya aron dad-on sa balay ug ila mismong lutoon.

q: How many stages does incomplete metamorphosis have, and which stage is missing compared to complete metamorphosis?
options: Four stages — egg, larva, pupa, and adult — the same as complete metamorphosis
Three stages — egg, nymph, and adult — there is no pupa stage
Two stages — nymph and adult — there is no egg or pupa stage
Three stages — egg, larva, and adult — there is no nymph stage
explanation: Incomplete metamorphosis has only three stages — egg, nymph, and adult — with no pupa stage.
fact_tl: Ang di-ganap na metamorphosis ay may tatlong yugto lamang: itlog, nymph, at hingkod na insekto—walang pupa.
fact_bis: Ang dili kompleto nga metamorphosis adunay tulo lang ka hugna: itlog, nymph, ug hamtong nga insekto—walay pupa.

q: Why is garden soil a good example of a heterogeneous mixture?
options: Because all its parts are dissolved evenly and look the same throughout
Because it contains sand, rocks, rotting leaves, and clay that are different in look and size and not evenly mixed
Because it always has the same color and texture no matter where you dig
Because its particles are too small to see, just like salt dissolved in water
explanation: Garden soil is heterogeneous because it contains sand, tiny rocks, rotting leaves, and clay that differ in look and size and are not evenly mixed.
fact_tl: Ang lupa sa hardin ay magandang halimbawa ng heterogeneous na halo. Kung titingnan mong mabuti, may buhangin, maliliit na bato, bulok na dahon, at putik na magkakaiba ang itsura at laki. Hindi sila pantay na naghalo, kaya kita mo pa rin ang bawat sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang yuta sa hardin maayong pananglitan sa heterogeneous nga sagol. Kung tan-awon nimo pag-ayo, naay balas, gagmay nga bato, gabok nga dahon, ug lapok nga lainlain ang hitsura ug gidak-on. Wala sila magkasagol nga pantay, mao nga makita pa nimo ang matag sangkap.

q: What weather effect does El Niño typically bring to the Philippines?
options: More rain and flooding, especially in Mindanao and the Visayas
Hotter and drier conditions with less rain, so PAGASA watches for drought
Stronger typhoons that make landfall more frequently along the eastern coast
Cooler temperatures and thick fog that last for several months
explanation: During an El Niño, the Philippines becomes hotter and drier because there is less rain, so PAGASA watches closely for drought.
fact_tl: Tuwing may El Niño, ang panahon sa Pilipinas ay nagiging mas mainit at mas tuyo dahil bumababa ang ulan, kaya nagbabantay ang PAGASA para sa tagtuyot.
fact_bis: Panahon sa El Niño, ang panahon sa Pilipinas mas mo-init ug mo-uga kay mokunhod ang ulan, busa nagbantay ang PAGASA para sa hulaw.

q: How are rock layers underground different from the soil on top?
options: Rock layers are just very old soil that became slightly darker over time
Rock layers are real hard rock formed from bits cemented and hardened over a very long time, not soft soil
Rock layers are made of melted rock that cooled underwater near the seabed
Rock layers are loose piles of sand and gravel compressed by the weight above them
explanation: Rock layers underground are real hard rock formed from bits that got cemented and hardened over a very long time; soil is only on the very top.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nag-iisip na ang mga patong ng bato ay basta lupa lang na nakatambak. Pero hindi ito malambot na lupa, kundi tunay na matigas na bato na nabuo mula sa mga tipak na dinikit-dikit at tinigas sa napakahabang panahon. Ang lupa ay nasa pinakaibabaw lang, samantalang ang mga patong sa ilalim ay matigas na talaga.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga ang mga patong sa bato yano ra nga natapok nga yuta. Apan dili kini humok nga yuta; tinuod kini nga gahi nga bato nga naporma gikan sa mga tipik nga nagdikit ug migahi sulod sa taas kaayo nga panahon. Ang yuta naa ra sa kinatas-an, samtang ang mga patong sa ilalom tinuod gyud nga gahi nga bato.

q: Why is the Philippines considered important for marine biodiversity?
options: It has the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia, which shelters rare fish species
It is part of the Coral Triangle, the area in the Pacific with the highest coral and fish biodiversity in the world
It has the longest coastline of any country and the most species of sea turtles
It is the only country where whale sharks breed naturally in protected marine reserves
explanation: The Philippines is part of the Coral Triangle, the area in the Pacific with the highest coral and fish biodiversity in the world.
fact_tl: Bahagi ang Pilipinas ng Coral Triangle, ang lugar sa Pasipiko na may pinakamataas na biodibersidad ng mga korales at mga isda sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Bahin ang Pilipinas sa Coral Triangle, ang lugar sa Pasipiko nga adunay pinakataas nga biodiversity sa mga korales ug mga isda sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: What was the original title of the Philippine national anthem?
options: Lupang Hinirang, composed as a poem before it had music
Marcha Nacional Filipina, at first a march with no words
Himno Nacional Filipino, written during the Spanish colonial period
Bayan Ko, adopted as the anthem during the American period
explanation: The original title of the national anthem was 'Marcha Nacional Filipina,' at first a march with no words.
fact_tl: Ang orihinal na pamagat ng pambansang awit ay "Marcha Nacional Filipina," isang martsa na walang titik noong una.
fact_bis: Ang orihinal nga ngalan sa nasudnong awit mao ang "Marcha Nacional Filipina," usa ka martsa nga walay liriko sa sinugdan.

q: Why does a candle wick glow red and produce white smoke just after you blow it out?
options: The wick absorbs oxygen from the air, which makes it briefly burn brighter before fading
The wick is still very hot and slowly cooling down, and the white smoke is wax vapor that was not burned
The red glow is caused by leftover wax melting on the surface of the wick
The white smoke is water vapor from the flame mixing with cooler air above the candle
explanation: After blowing out a candle, the wick is still very hot and slowly cooling; the white smoke is wax vapor that did not get burned.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos mong hipan ang kandila, makikita mong namumula pa nang bahagya ang dulo ng mitsa, parang maliit na baga, bago tuluyang lumabo. Ito ay dahil sobrang init pa ng mitsa at unti-unti itong lumalamig hanggang mawala ang init. Mula rito rin lumalabas ang puting usok na singaw ng wax na hindi na nasunog.
fact_bis: Human nimo huypa ang kandila, makita nimo nga nagpula pa gamay ang tumoy sa pabilo, daw gamay nga baga, una kini hingpit nga mawala. Kini tungod kay init pa kaayo ang pabilo ug hinay-hinay nga nagbugnaw. Gikan usab dinhi mogawas ang puti nga aso, ang alisngaw sa wax nga wala masunog.

q: How does an insect breathe?
options: Through gills on the sides of its head, similar to how fish breathe underwater
Through tiny holes along the sides of its body, not through a nose
Through a small tube on the tip of its tail that opens and closes as it moves
Through pores on the bottom of its legs, which absorb oxygen from the air
explanation: An insect breathes through tiny holes along the sides of its body, not through a nose.
fact_tl: Ang insekto ay humihinga sa pamamagitan ng maliliit na butas sa gilid ng katawan nito, hindi sa ilong.
fact_bis: Ang insekto moginhawa pinaagi sa gagmay nga lungga sa kilid sa lawas niini, dili sa ilong.

q: Which animal holds the record as the largest lizard in the world?
options: The monitor lizard of the Philippine rainforest
The Komodo dragon
The Nile crocodile of Africa
The green iguana of South America
explanation: The largest lizard in the world is the Komodo dragon.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking butiki (bayawak) sa mundo ay ang Komodo dragon.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga tiki (lizard) sa kalibotan mao ang Komodo dragon.

q: What happens to a blood vessel immediately after it is injured, even before clotting starts?
options: It widens to allow more blood to rush to the injured area and fight infection
It quickly squeezes to narrow the passage, reducing how much blood leaks out
It releases platelets directly into the tissue to form a clot at once
It sends a signal to the heart to pump blood faster to compensate for the loss
explanation: Even before clotting starts, the injured blood vessel quickly squeezes to narrow the passage for blood, reducing how much blood leaks out while platelets get ready.
fact_tl: Bago pa magsimula ang pamumuo, agad na sumisikip ang ugat na nasugatan para paliitin ang daanan ng dugo. Nababawasan nito ang dugong lumalabas habang naghahanda ang platelets.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa magsugod ang pagmuo, ang nasamdan nga ugat dali nga mosikip aron pakitidon ang agianan sa dugo. Makapakunhod kini sa dugo nga mogawas samtang nangandam ang platelets.

q: Who discovered Pluto, and in what year?
options: Galileo Galilei, in 1610, using an early refracting telescope
Clyde Tombaugh, in 1930, at the Lowell Observatory
Edwin Hubble, in 1929, at the Mount Wilson Observatory
Percival Lowell, in 1905, based on mathematical predictions alone
explanation: Pluto was discovered in 1930 by Clyde Tombaugh at the Lowell Observatory.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Pluto noong 1930 ni Clyde Tombaugh sa Lowell Observatory.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan ang Pluto niadtong 1930 ni Clyde Tombaugh sa Lowell Observatory.

q: What happens to a habitat when a keystone species disappears from it?
options: The habitat quickly returns to an earlier, simpler state with fewer plant species
The whole habitat can change a lot and many other species can be affected
Only the species that directly depended on it for food will be affected
The habitat stays mostly the same because other species quickly fill the gap
explanation: When a keystone species disappears, the whole habitat can change a lot and many other species can be affected.
fact_tl: Kapag nawala ang isang keystone species, malaki ang maaaring magbago sa buong habitat at maraming ibang species ang maaaring maapektuhan.
fact_bis: Kung mawala ang usa ka keystone species, mahimong dako ang kausaban sa tibuok puy-anan ug daghang ubang espesye ang maapektuhan.

q: Why does a solid keep its shape while a gas spreads out to fill the whole room?
options: Because a solid is always heavier than a gas, so it sinks and stays in one place
Because the particles of a gas are far apart and move fast, giving it no fixed shape, unlike a solid
Because a solid absorbs all available heat, leaving no energy for the gas to move
Because gas particles are larger than solid particles and need more space
explanation: A solid stays in one place with a fixed shape, but a gas spreads out because its particles are far apart and move fast, giving it no shape or size of its own.
fact_tl: Ang solid ay nananatili sa isang lugar at may fixed na hugis, pero ang gas ay kumakalat at pumupuno sa buong silid. Dahil malayo at mabilis gumalaw ang mga particle ng gas, wala itong sariling hugis ni laki, hindi tulad ng solid.
fact_bis: Ang solid magpabilin sa usa ka lugar nga adunay pirme nga porma, apan ang gas mokatag ug mopuno sa tibuok kuwarto. Kay layo ug paspas molihok ang mga tipik sa gas, wala kini kaugalingong porma o gidak-on, lahi sa solid.

q: Why can no machine use energy with zero waste?
options: Because machines need to store some energy inside their moving parts to keep running
Because every time energy changes form, some of it escapes as heat
Because the laws of physics require all energy to be converted back to electricity eventually
Because friction only happens in machines that have not been oiled properly
explanation: Every time energy changes form, some of it escapes as heat, so no machine can use energy with no waste at all.
fact_tl: Tuwing nagbabago ang enerhiya ng anyo, may bahaging tumatakas bilang init, kaya't walang makinang gumagamit ng enerhiya nang 100 porsiyentong walang sayang.
fact_bis: Matag higayon nga mausab ang porma sa enerhiya, adunay bahin nga moikyas isip kainit, busa walay makina nga makagamit sa enerhiya nga walay gisayang.

q: Where does the Sun get its enormous energy?
options: From burning hydrogen gas, the same way a campfire burns wood
From nuclear fusion, where hydrogen atoms join to form helium, releasing huge amounts of heat and light
From nuclear fission, where uranium atoms are split apart deep inside the Sun's core
From the gravitational pull of Jupiter, which constantly squeezes the Sun and heats it up
explanation: The Sun's energy comes from nuclear fusion — hydrogen atoms join to form helium, releasing huge amounts of heat and light.
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya ng Araw ay galing sa nuclear fusion — pinagsasama ang mga atomo ng hydrogen para maging helium, na naglalabas ng napakaraming init at liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya sa Adlaw gikan sa nuclear fusion — ang mga atomo sa hydrogen magtipon aron mahimong helium, nga nagpagawas ug daghang init ug kahayag.

q: How do eels find their way from rivers back to the sea to lay eggs?
options: They follow ocean currents and use the positions of stars at night to navigate
They are guided by the smell of the water and Earth's magnetic field on the long journey
They follow the path of other fish species that migrate at the same time of year
They use their electrical organs to detect underwater landmarks along the route
explanation: Eels are guided by the smell of the water and Earth's magnetic field as they travel from rivers back to the sea to lay eggs.
fact_tl: Ang igat (eel) ay nabubuhay sa ilog ngunit naglalakbay pabalik sa dagat para mangitlog; ginagabayan ito ng amoy ng tubig at ng magnetic field ng Earth sa mahabang biyaheng ito.
fact_bis: Ang kasili (eel) mabuhi sa suba apan mopanaw balik sa dagat aron mangitlog; gigiyahan kini sa baho sa tubig ug sa magnetic field sa Yuta niining taas nga panaw.

q: What is a climax community?
options: The first group of plants and animals to colonize bare rock after a volcanic eruption
The most stable grouping of species reached after a long succession process, like a mature tropical rainforest
A community that changes rapidly every few years due to seasonal flooding
A group of species that thrives only in disturbed areas such as burnt forests
explanation: A climax community is the most stable grouping of species reached after a long succession process, like a mature tropical rainforest that changes only slowly.
fact_tl: Ang climax community ay ang pinaka-stable na kalipunan ng mga species na naabot pagkatapos ng matagal na proseso ng succession, tulad ng isang mature na tropical rainforest na patuloy na nagbabago nang dahan-dahan.
fact_bis: Ang climax community mao ang labing stable nga grupo sa mga species nga naabot human sa dugay nga proseso sa succession, sama sa usa ka hamtong nga tropical rainforest nga nagbag-o lamang og hinay.

q: What do penguins use their wings for, since they cannot fly?
options: To fan themselves and stay cool on hot rocky shores
To swim through the water
To carry their eggs from one nesting site to another
To signal danger to other penguins in the colony
explanation: A penguin uses its wings to swim, showing that wings are not always used for flying.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng ibong may pakpak ay nakakalipad. May mga ibon tulad ng penguin at ostrich na may pakpak pero hindi makalipad. Ginagamit ng penguin ang pakpak para lumangoy, at ang ostrich naman para magbalanse habang tumatakbo. Ipinapakita nito na hindi laging pang-lipad ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Dili tanang langgam nga adunay pako makalupad. Adunay mga langgam sama sa penguin ug ostrich nga adunay pako apan dili makalupad. Ang penguin mogamit sa pako aron molangoy, ug ang ostrich mogamit sa pako aron magbalanse samtang nagdagan. Gipakita niini nga dili kanunay pangglupad ang pako.

q: How do wetlands help clean water?
options: By absorbing all the water into underground rocks, leaving behind only clean minerals
By letting water flow slowly so that dirt and pollutants are filtered out
By releasing chemicals that kill harmful bacteria in nearby rivers and lakes
By trapping water vapor in thick mats of floating plants above the surface
explanation: Wetlands let water flow slowly, so dirt and pollutants are filtered out and the water gets cleaner.
fact_tl: Pinapadaloy ng latian ang tubig nang dahan-dahan kaya nasasala at naaalis ang dumi.
fact_bis: Ang lamakan magpaagi sa tubig og hinay-hinay, mao nga masala ug makuha ang hugaw.

q: What does the DENR do in the Philippines?
options: It manages the country's roads, bridges, and public infrastructure projects
It manages and protects the nature and natural resources of the Philippines
It oversees the country's agriculture and farming programs for rice and corn
It is in charge of monitoring weather and issuing storm warnings across the country
explanation: The DENR or Department of Environment and Natural Resources is the government agency that manages and protects the nature and natural resources of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang DENR o Department of Environment and Natural Resources ang ahensya ng gobyerno na namamahala at nagpoprotekta sa kalikasan at likas na yaman ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang DENR o Department of Environment and Natural Resources ang ahensya sa gobyerno nga nagdumala ug nagprotekta sa kalikasan ug natural nga kayamanan sa Pilipinas.

q: What makes a weevil easy to recognize, and what kind of damage does it cause?
options: It has large colorful wings and damages fruit trees by eating their leaves
It has a long snout-like part on its head and often damages stored grains such as rice and corn
It has a very hard shell and damages wooden furniture by burrowing inside
It has extra-long antennae and damages crops by sucking juice from plant stems
explanation: The weevil is a kind of beetle with a long snout-like part on its head, and it often damages stored grains such as rice and corn.
fact_tl: Ang weevil o bukbok ay isang uri ng salagubang na may mahaba at parang ngusong bahagi sa ulo, at madalas itong sumisira sa mga nakaimbak na butil tulad ng bigas at mais.
fact_bis: Ang weevil o bukbok usa ka matang sa salagubang nga may taas ug morag nguso nga bahin sa ulo, ug kasagaran kini makadaot sa gitipig nga mga lugas sama sa bugas ug mais.

q: How large is the Sahara Desert?
options: About 3 million square kilometers, roughly the size of India
About 9 million square kilometers, nearly the size of the whole United States
About 15 million square kilometers, larger than all of South America
About 5 million square kilometers, about the size of the European Union
explanation: The Sahara covers about 9 million square kilometers, nearly the size of the whole United States.
fact_tl: Ang Sahara ay halos 9 milyong square kilometers ang lawak, halos kasinlaki ng buong Estados Unidos.
fact_bis: Ang Sahara mokabat sa mga 9 ka milyon nga square kilometers, hapit sama kadako sa tibuok Estados Unidos.

q: Why does a can with a little water get crushed when it is heated then quickly cooled?
options: The heat melts the metal slightly, making it too soft to hold its shape when it cools
The air pressure outside becomes stronger than the pressure inside, crushing the can
The water inside expands so fast when cooling that it pushes inward on the walls
The steam inside the can reacts with the metal and weakens the walls
explanation: When the can is quickly cooled, the air pressure outside is stronger than the pressure inside, crushing the can.
fact_tl: Kapag pinainit ang lata na may kaunting tubig at biglang pinalamig, dumudurog ito dahil mas malakas ang presyon ng hangin sa labas kaysa sa loob.
fact_bis: Kung initon ang lata nga may gamayng tubig dayon paspas pabugnawon, madugmok kini kay mas kusog ang presyon sa hangin sa gawas kay sa sulod.

q: Is there a maximum number on the earthquake magnitude scale?
options: Yes, the scale goes from 1 to 10, and no earthquake has ever exceeded magnitude 10
No, the scale has no fixed upper limit, though earthquakes above magnitude 9 are extremely rare
Yes, the scale stops at magnitude 8 because stronger earthquakes are physically impossible
No, but scientists use a different scale for any earthquake above magnitude 7
explanation: The magnitude scale has no fixed upper limit, but earthquakes above magnitude 9 are extremely rare.
fact_tl: Walang itaas na hangganan ang magnitude scale, ngunit napakabihira ng mga lindol na lampas sa magnitude 9.
fact_bis: Ang magnitude scale walay tinakdang kinutuban sa taas, apan talagsa ra kaayo ang mga linog nga molapas sa magnitude 9.

q: Why is a star stable for most of its life?
options: Because it burns fuel very slowly, producing only a tiny amount of heat per year
Because the inward pull of gravity is balanced by the outward push of heat from fusion
Because it is surrounded by a cold gas cloud that keeps its temperature from rising too high
Because gravity is very weak in space, so there is nothing to compress the star
explanation: For most of its life, a star is stable because the inward pull of gravity is balanced by the outward push of heat from fusion.
fact_tl: Sa karamihan ng buhay nito, matatag ang isang bituin dahil ang lakas ng grabidad na humihila papasok ay balanse sa presyon ng init ng fusion na nagtutulak palabas.
fact_bis: Sa kadaghanan sa kinabuhi niini, lig-on ang usa ka bituon tungod kay ang pagbira sa grabidad paingon sa sulod gibalanse sa pagduso pagawas sa init gikan sa fusion.

q: Why can thick fog cause flight delays at airports like NAIA?
options: Because fog contains ice crystals that can freeze the aircraft's engines during takeoff
Because fog reduces visibility, making it unsafe for aircraft to take off or land
Because fog causes strong downdrafts that push aircraft off their flight path
Because fog traps warm air near the ground, creating dangerous turbulence on runways
explanation: Thick fog reduces visibility, which can cause flight delays or cancellations; Philippine airports like NAIA sometimes experience delays due to fog, especially on cold amihan mornings.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na hamog ay maaaring magdulot ng pagpapaliban o pagkansela ng mga flight; ang mga airport sa Pilipinas tulad ng NAIA ay minsan nakakaranas ng mga delay dahil sa hamog, lalo na sa malamig na umaga sa panahon ng amihan.
fact_bis: Ang makapal nga hamog mahimong magdulot sa pagpalangan o pagkansela sa mga flight; ang mga airport sa Pilipinas sama sa NAIA usahay nakasinati sa mga delay tungod sa hamog, ilabi na sa mabugnaw nga umaga sa panahon sa amihan.

q: Which leaf is popularly called the national leaf of the Philippines?
options: The narra leaf, because narra is the national tree of the Philippines
The anahaw (footstool palm) leaf, though no law officially declares it
The bamboo leaf, because bamboo is the most widely used plant in the country
The banana leaf, because it is used in many traditional Filipino celebrations
explanation: The anahaw (footstool palm) leaf is popularly called the national leaf of the Philippines, though no law officially declares it.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng anahaw ang malawakang tinatawag na pambansang dahon ng Pilipinas, kahit walang batas na nagpapatibay nito.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa anahaw mao ang kasagarang gitawag nga nasodnong dahon sa Pilipinas, bisan walay balaod nga nagpamatuod niini.

q: What makes kwek-kwek different from other battered fried foods like tempura?
options: It has a quail egg inside and an orange color
It uses a thicker flour batter than other foods
It is the only battered food that becomes crispy outside
It is always made with chicken instead of vegetables
explanation: While coating food in batter before frying is used in many foods like tempura, kwek-kwek is unique because it contains a quail egg inside and has its distinctive orange color.
fact_tl: Ang ideya ng pagbabalot sa harina bago iprito ay ginagamit din sa ibang pagkain tulad ng pritong gulay o tempura. Pareho silang nagkakaroon ng malutong na balot sa labas. Ang kaibahan ng kwek-kwek ay itlog ng pugo ang nasa loob at orange ang kulay nito.
fact_bis: Ang ideya sa pagputos sa harina sa dili pa iprito gigamit pud sa ubang pagkaon sama sa pritong utanon o tempura. Tanan sila makabaton og crispy nga balot sa gawas. Ang kalainan sa kwek-kwek mao ang itlog sa pugo sa sulod ug ang orange nga kolor niini.

q: Which group of animals includes creatures as different as insects, spiders, snails, sea stars, and jellyfish?
options: Invertebrates
Vertebrates
Mammals
Reptiles
explanation: Invertebrates include a huge variety of very different body forms, from insects and spiders to snails, sea stars, and jellyfish.
fact_tl: Ang mga invertebrate ay hindi iisang grupo lamang — kasama dito ang napakaraming magkakaibang anyo ng katawan tulad ng insekto, gagamba, kuhol, bituing-dagat, at dikya.
fact_bis: Ang mga invertebrate dili usa lang ka grupo — apil dinhi ang daghan kaayong lainlaing dagway sa lawas sama sa insekto, lawalawa, kuhol, bituon sa dagat, ug bukya.

q: In a vertical farm, how are plants grown differently from a regular outdoor farm?
options: In stacked shelves inside a building under artificial light
In wide open fields exposed to natural sunlight
Floating on the surface of large ponds
Buried deep underground in tunnels
explanation: Vertical farms grow plants on stacked shelves inside a building under artificial light, making it possible to raise vegetables even where city land is scarce.
fact_tl: Sa vertical farm, itinatanim ang mga halaman nang patong-patong sa mga istante sa loob ng gusali, gamit ang artipisyal na ilaw, upang makapagtanim ng maraming gulay kahit kakaunti lang ang lupa sa lungsod.
fact_bis: Sa vertical farm, ang mga tanom ginatanom nga patong-patong sa mga estante sulod sa usa ka building ubos sa artipisyal nga suga, aron makatanom og daghang utanon bisan gamay ra ang yuta sa siyudad.

q: Why is dengue fever sometimes called 'breakbone fever'?
options: Because the joints and bones hurt so much it feels like they are breaking
Because it causes the bones to become brittle and crack easily
Because patients must lie very still or their bones will break
Because it was first discovered when someone broke a bone
explanation: Dengue causes such severe aching in the joints and bones that it is nicknamed 'breakbone fever,' even though bones do not actually break.
fact_tl: Kapag may dengue ang isang tao, kadalasang nararamdaman niya ang mataas na lagnat, matinding sakit ng ulo, sakit sa likod ng mga mata, sakit ng kasu-kasuan at buto, at minsan may pantal sa balat. Dahil sa sobrang sakit ng buto, tinatawag minsan itong 'breakbone fever'.
fact_bis: Kon adunay dengue ang usa ka taw, kasagaran iyang mabati ang taas nga hilanat, grabe nga labad sa ulo, sakit sa likod sa mga mata, sakit sa kasukasuan ug bukog, ug usahay adunay panuhot sa panit. Tungod sa grabe nga sakit sa bukog, gitawag usahay kini nga 'breakbone fever'.

q: Why is venom especially useful as a defense weapon for small animals?
options: It lets a small animal defend itself against much larger enemies
It makes the small animal run faster to escape
It hardens the skin so bigger animals cannot bite through it
It causes the small animal to look bigger than it really is
explanation: For small animals, venom is a powerful weapon because it allows them to defend themselves against much larger enemies that they could not overpower physically.
fact_tl: Para sa maliliit na hayop, ang kamandag ay mabisang sandata upang ipagtanggol ang sarili laban sa mas malalaking kaaway.
fact_bis: Para sa gagmayng mga hayop, ang kamandag usa ka gamhanan nga hinagiban aron manalipod batok sa mas dagkong kaaway.

q: How does a jellyfish sting something that touches its tentacles?
options: Tiny stinging cells fire out like harpoons and inject venom
The tentacles squeeze tightly and crush what they touch
The jellyfish releases an acid cloud into the water around it
Sharp spines on the tentacles pierce the skin directly
explanation: A jellyfish's tentacles hold thousands of tiny stinging cells that work like coiled harpoons — when touched, they fire out and inject venom.
fact_tl: Sa galamay ng dikya ay may libu-libong maliliit na selula na parang maliliit na pana o palaso. Kapag may nadikit, biglang pumuputok ang mga ito at nagtutusok ng kamandag.
fact_bis: Sa galamay sa dikya naa'y liboan ka gagmayng selula nga sama sa gagmayng pana. Kon may makahikap niini, kalit kining mobuto ug motusok og hilo.

q: How do plants actually benefit from lightning?
options: Lightning changes nitrogen in the air into nitrates that roots can absorb
Plants absorb the electricity from lightning directly through their leaves
Lightning heats the soil so plants can grow faster
Plants eat the bright flash of light produced by lightning
explanation: Lightning does not feed plants directly — instead it converts nitrogen in the air into nitrates that plant roots can absorb, so the benefit is from what lightning creates, not the lightning itself.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nagtatanong: kinakain ba ng halaman ang kidlat? Hindi naman. Ang halaman ay hindi kumakain ng kuryente o liwanag ng kidlat. Sa halip, ang kidlat ay nagbabago lang sa nitrogen sa hangin para ito ay maging nitrates na kayang sipsipin ng ugat. Kaya hindi ang kidlat mismo ang pagkain, kundi ang produktong gawa nito.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang mangutana: gikaon ba sa tanom ang kilat? Dili gyud. Ang tanom dili mokaon og kuryente o kidlap sa kilat. Hinuon, ang kilat mausab lang ang nitrogen sa hangin ngadto sa nitrates nga masuyop sa gamot. Busa dili ang kilat mismo ang pagkaon, kondili ang produkto nga gihimo niini.

q: What happens to the makahiya plant if you touch it over and over again in a short time?
options: It may stop folding because it seems to get used to it
It folds up permanently and never opens again
It grows faster to escape the repeated touching
It releases a chemical smell to warn it is being disturbed
explanation: If the makahiya is touched repeatedly in a short time, it may stop folding its leaves because it appears to get used to the repeated contact.
fact_tl: Kung paulit-ulit na hinahawakan ang makahiya sa maikling oras, maaari itong huminto sa pagtiklop dahil parang nasasanay na ito.
fact_bis: Kung balik-balik nga hikapon ang makahiya sa mubo nga panahon, mahimo kining muhunong sa pagtiklop kay morag naanad na kini.

q: What is one important difference between pythons and anacondas?
options: Pythons lay eggs, while anacondas give birth to live young
Pythons squeeze their prey, but anacondas use venom instead
Anacondas live in Asia, while pythons live in South America
Pythons live in rivers, while anacondas prefer dry deserts
explanation: Although both pythons and anacondas squeeze their prey, pythons lay eggs and live mainly in Asia and Africa, while anacondas give birth to live young and live in South American rivers.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang sawa at anaconda kahit pareho silang pumipiga: ang sawa ay nangingitlog at karaniwang nasa Asya at Aprika, habang ang anaconda ay nanganganak ng buhay at nakatira sa mga ilog ng South America.
fact_bis: Lahi ang sawa ug anaconda bisan parehas silang mopiga: ang sawa mangitlog ug kasagaran sa Asya ug Aprika, samtang ang anaconda manganak ug buhi ug nagpuyo sa mga suba sa South America.

q: What is the first thing inside your ear that moves when sound reaches it?
options: A thin part called the eardrum that vibrates
A fluid that swirls around in a tiny tube
Small hairs that stand up when sound passes by
A bone that taps against the side of the ear canal
explanation: When sound reaches your ear, it hits the eardrum — a thin part that vibrates like a tiny drum — and that vibration is passed deeper into your ear until your brain receives it as sound.
fact_tl: Pagdating ng tunog sa tainga mo, tinatamaan nito ang isang manipis na bahagi na parang maliit na tambol na tinatawag na eardrum. Nagvi-vibrate ang eardrum, at ang vibration na ito ay ipinapasa sa loob ng tainga hanggang sa makarating ang mensahe sa utak mo bilang tunog.
fact_bis: Pag-abot sa tingog sa imong dalunggan, maigo niini ang nipis nga bahin nga sama sa gamay nga tambol nga gitawag og eardrum. Mo-vibrate ang eardrum, ug kini nga vibration ipasa sa sulod sa dalunggan hangtod nga moabot ang mensahe sa imong utok isip tingog.

q: In a parallel circuit like home lighting, what happens when one light bulb burns out?
options: The other lights stay on because each has its own path
All the lights go out because they share one path
The remaining lights become brighter to make up for it
The electricity stops flowing until the bulb is replaced
explanation: In a parallel circuit, each component has its own path, so if one light fails the others stay on — unlike a series circuit where one failure stops everything.
fact_tl: Ang series at parallel circuit ay may mahalagang pagkakaiba: sa series, kapag naputol ang isa, lahat ay mamatay; sa parallel (tulad ng pagkakawire ng mga ilaw sa bahay), ang isa pang ilaw ay mananatiling naka-on kahit may naputol.
fact_bis: Ang series ug parallel circuit adunay importante nga pagkalahi: sa series, inig-hubag sa usa, tanan mamatay; sa parallel (sama sa pagkakawire sa mga suga sa balay), ang ubang mga suga nagpabilin nga naka-on bisan adunay nahubag.

q: Why do most snakes use their tongue so much, even though they have eyes?
options: Because they have weak eyesight and use their tongue to detect smells
Because their eyes are closed during daylight and only open at night
Because tasting the air helps them find water to drink
Because the tongue is used to feel if the ground is safe to slither on
explanation: Most snakes have poor eyesight and cannot see very clearly, so they depend heavily on their tongue to 'see' the world through smell rather than using their eyes.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng ahas ay mahina ang paningin at hindi gaanong nakakakita ng malinaw. Kaya umaasa sila nang husto sa kanilang dila para 'makita' ang mundo sa pamamagitan ng amoy sa halip na sa mga mata.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga ahas huyang ug panan-aw ug dili kaayo makakita ug klaro. Busa nagsalig sila pag-ayo sa ilang dila aron 'makakita' sa kalibotan pinaagi sa baho imbes sa ilang mga mata.

q: What determines how high a tropical cyclone wind signal number is raised?
options: The wind speed expected in the area
The amount of rainfall the storm will bring
How far the center of the storm is from the coast
The size of the storm measured from cloud to cloud
explanation: A tropical cyclone wind signal number is based on the expected wind speed in an area — the faster the wind, the higher the signal number.
fact_tl: Ang tropical cyclone wind signal ay batay sa inaasahang bilis ng hangin sa isang lugar — kapag mas mabilis ang hangin, mas mataas ang itinataas na signal.
fact_bis: Ang tropical cyclone wind signal gibase sa gilauman nga kapaspas sa hangin sa usa ka lugar — kung mas paspas ang hangin, mas taas ang signal nga ibutang.

q: What are head lice and what do they cause?
options: Tiny insects that live in hair and scalp causing an itchy head
Small worms that burrow under the skin and cause a rash
Microscopic germs that make the scalp oily and flaky
Tiny mites that make the hair fall out in patches
explanation: Head lice are tiny insects that live in the hair and scalp, and their presence causes an itchy head.
fact_tl: Ang kuto ay maliliit na insektong naninirahan sa buhok at anit, at nagdudulot ng kati sa ulo.
fact_bis: Ang kuto gagmayng insekto nga nagpuyo sa buhok ug anit, ug maghimo og katol sa ulo.

q: In the relationship between the fig tree and the fig wasp, what does the fig tree depend on the wasp for?
options: To pollinate it
To protect it from animals that eat figs
To carry its seeds to new places
To provide nutrients through the wasp's body
explanation: The fig tree and fig wasp have an obligate mutualism — the tree depends entirely on the wasp to pollinate it, and the wasp depends entirely on the tree to raise its young.
fact_tl: Ang fig tree at ang fig wasp ay may obligate na mutualism — ang puno ay dumadepende sa wasp bilang tanging tagapalabas ng pollen, at ang wasp ay dumadepende sa puno para mag-alaga ng kanyang mga anak.
fact_bis: Ang fig tree ug ang fig wasp adunay obligate mutualism — ang kahoy hingpit nga nagsalig sa wasp aron mapollinate kini, ug ang wasp hingpit nga nagsalig sa kahoy aron mapataas ang iyang mga anak.

q: Who is the head of both the Philippine Judiciary and the Supreme Court?
options: The Chief Justice
The Secretary of Justice
The Senate President
The Solicitor General
explanation: The head of the Judiciary and of the Supreme Court is the Chief Justice.
fact_tl: Ang pinuno ng Hudikatura at ng Korte Suprema ay ang Punong Mahistrado (Chief Justice).
fact_bis: Ang puno sa Hudikatura ug sa Korte Suprema mao ang Punong Mahistrado (Chief Justice).

q: What kind of plants mostly cover a grassland?
options: Grasses, with few or no trees
Tall trees that form a thick canopy
A mix of shrubs, ferns, and mosses
Cactus and other water-storing plants
explanation: A grassland is a wide area of land where grasses are the main plants, with few or no trees growing.
fact_tl: Ang grassland ay isang malawak na lupain na halos pawang damo ang tumutubo, na may kaunti o walang punong sumisibol.
fact_bis: Ang grassland usa ka lapad nga yuta diin halos puro damo ang nagtubo, nga gamay ra o wala gyoy mga kahoy.

q: Why do people boil water before drinking it?
options: Boiling kills germs and makes the water safe to drink
Boiling adds minerals that the body needs to stay healthy
Boiling removes the smell and bad taste from tap water
Boiling makes water heavier so it is easier to swallow
explanation: Boiling water kills germs, making it safe to drink.
fact_tl: Ang pagpapakulo ng tubig ay pumapatay sa mga mikrobyo at ginagawa itong ligtas inumin.
fact_bis: Ang pagpabukal sa tubig mopatay sa mga mikrobyo ug maghimo niini nga luwas imnon.

q: In which Philippine area are manta rays known to be seen?
options: Tubbataha Reef
Manila Bay
Laguna de Bay
Bataan Nuclear Power Plant area
explanation: Manta rays can be seen in Philippine seas such as Tubbataha Reef.
fact_tl: Makikita ang mga manta ray sa mga karagatan ng Pilipinas tulad ng Tubbataha Reef.
fact_bis: Ang mga manta ray makita sa kadagatan sa Pilipinas sama sa Tubbataha Reef.

q: Why does cooking rice take longer in Baguio than in Manila?
options: Water boils at a lower temperature in Baguio because air pressure is lower at higher altitude
Baguio's cold weather cools the stove so the flame is weaker
The water in Baguio contains more minerals that slow down boiling
Rice grains grown in the highlands are harder and need more time to soften
explanation: At high altitudes like Baguio, lower air pressure causes water to boil below 100 degrees Celsius, meaning the water is not as hot when it boils, so cooking rice takes longer.
fact_tl: Sa mas mataas na lugar tulad ng Benguet, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa mas mababang temperatura kaysa 100 degrees Celsius dahil mas mababa ang presyon ng hangin doon. Kaya ang pagluluto ng kanin sa Baguio ay mas matagal.
fact_bis: Sa mas taas nga lugar sama sa Benguet, ang tubig kumukulo sa mas ubos nga temperatura kaysa 100 degrees Celsius tungod kay ang presyon sa hangin mas ubos didto. Mao kana nga ang pagluto og kanon sa Baguio mas dugay.

q: Why is kape alamid one of the most expensive coffees in the world?
options: Because it is rare and hard to collect
Because it grows only at the very top of the highest mountains
Because it must be imported from other countries to the Philippines
Because it takes more than ten years for the coffee plant to produce beans
explanation: Kape alamid is one of the most expensive coffees in the world because it is rare and hard to collect.
fact_tl: Ang kape alamid ay isa sa pinakamahal na kape sa mundo dahil bihira at mahirap itipon.
fact_bis: Ang kape alamid usa sa labing mahal nga kape sa kalibutan tungod kay talagsaon ug lisod tapokon.

q: What does a fixed pulley do to help you lift a heavy object?
options: It changes the direction of the force you apply
It reduces the amount of force you need to use
It multiplies your force so you can lift heavier loads
It stores energy and releases it when you need to pull
explanation: A fixed pulley does not reduce the amount of force needed, but it changes the direction of the force applied, making it easier to lift things by pulling down instead of up.
fact_tl: Ang nakatali na pulley ay hindi nagbabago ng dami ng puwersa na kailangan, ngunit binabago nito ang direksyon ng puwersa.
fact_bis: Ang nakatali nga pulley wala magbago sa gidaghanon sa paningkamot nga kinahanglan, apan nagbago kini sa direksyon sa gipaningkamutan.

q: What makes some kinds of bamboo unusual among plants?
options: They can grow several centimeters in just one day
They never need water because their hollow stems store rain
Their roots grow faster than any other plant on Earth
They only grow in one country in the world
explanation: Some kinds of bamboo are among the fastest-growing plants on Earth and can grow several centimeters in just one day.
fact_tl: Ang ilang uri ng kawayan ay isa sa pinakamabilis tumubong halaman sa mundo at maaaring tumubo nang ilang sentimetro sa loob lamang ng isang araw.
fact_bis: Ang ubang matang sa kawayan usa sa labing paspas motubo nga tanom sa kalibotan ug makatubo og pipila ka sentimetro sulod lamang sa usa ka adlaw.

q: When you dip the tip of a metal spoon into hot soup, why does the whole spoon eventually get hot?
options: Heat spreads through the metal by conduction, moving through direct contact
The steam rising from the soup heats the air around the spoon
Metal attracts heat from nearby objects like a magnet attracts iron
Hot water evaporates and the vapor travels up inside the handle
explanation: In conduction, heat spreads through direct contact between materials — so heat travels from the hot tip of the metal spoon through its length until the whole spoon is hot.
fact_tl: Sa conduction, kumakalat ang init sa pamamagitan ng tuwirang pagdikit ng mga bagay, lalo na sa mga solid. Halimbawa, umiinit ang buong metal na kutsara kapag inilubog ang dulo nito sa mainit na sabaw.
fact_bis: Sa conduction, mokaylap ang init pinaagi sa direktang pagdikit sa mga butang, ilabi na sa mga solid. Pananglitan, moinit ang tibuok metal nga kutsara kung ituslob ang tumoy niini sa init nga sabaw.

q: Which part of the brain controls balance and smooth movement?
options: The cerebellum
The cerebrum
The brain stem
The hippocampus
explanation: The brain has three main parts: the cerebrum handles thinking and the senses, the cerebellum controls balance and smooth movement, and the brain stem controls breathing and heartbeat.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing bahagi ang utak: ang cerebrum para sa pag-iisip at pandama, ang cerebellum para sa balanse at maayos na galaw, at ang brain stem na kumokontrol sa paghinga at tibok ng puso.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka nag-unang bahin ang utok: ang cerebrum para sa panghunahuna ug igbalati, ang cerebellum para sa balanse ug hapsay nga lihok, ug ang brain stem nga nagkontrol sa pagginhawa ug pitik sa kasingkasing.

q: How did petroleum form over millions of years?
options: From ancient marine organisms buried under the sea and subjected to heat and pressure
From rainwater that seeped into rocks and chemically changed over time
From volcanic lava that cooled underground and turned into liquid fuel
From dinosaur bones that were compressed deep underground
explanation: Petroleum formed from ancient marine organisms buried under the sea and subjected to heat and pressure over millions of years; the Malampaya natural gas field in Palawan is a major Philippine example.
fact_tl: Ang petrolyo ay nabuo mula sa mga sinaunang marine organism na nalubog sa ilalim ng dagat at napalantad sa init at presyon nang milyun-milyong taon — ang Malampaya gas field sa Palawan ay isa sa mga pangunahing rekurso ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang petrolyo nabuo gikan sa mga karaan nga marine organism nga nakalubong sa ilalim sa dagat ug napalabak sa init ug presyon sulod sa milyun-milyon ka tuig; ang Malampaya natural gas field sa Palawan usa sa panguna nga rekurso sa Pilipinas.

q: What does fever medicine do that rest alone cannot, and what can it NOT do?
options: Medicine lowers the heat and eases headaches, but it does not kill the germs
Medicine kills the germs, so rest becomes unnecessary once you take it
Medicine boosts the immune system so the body heals twice as fast
Medicine opens the pores so the fever sweats out faster
explanation: Fever medicine lowers body heat and eases headaches, but it doesn't kill the germs — the body still needs rest to actually heal.
fact_tl: Pinapababa ng gamot sa lagnat ang init at nababawasan ang sakit ng ulo, pero hindi nito pinapatay ang mikrobyo. Ang katawan mo pa rin ang gumagaling, at kailangan nito ng pahinga. Kaya kahit uminom ka ng gamot, magpahinga ka pa rin.
fact_bis: Ang tambal sa hilanat magpaubos sa init ug magpagaan sa sakit sa ulo, apan dili niini patyon ang mikrobyo. Ang imong lawas gihapon ang mag-ayo, ug nagkinahanglan kini ug pahulay. Busa bisan moinom ka ug tambal, kinahanglan gihapon nga magpahulay.

q: What happens to the facial warts of male Visayan warty pigs during mating season?
options: They grow larger and are used in fights between competing males
They shrink so the males look smaller and less threatening
They change color to attract females of the species
They fall off after mating is complete
explanation: During mating season, the facial warts of male Visayan warty pigs grow larger and are used in fights between competing males.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng pag-aasawa, ang mga tagok sa mukha ng lalaking Visayan warty pig ay lalo pang lumalaki, na ginagamit sa pakikipaglaban sa ibang lalaki.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa pagpaanakon, ang mga tagok sa nawong sa lalaking Visayan warty pig motubo pa og dako ug gigamit sa mga away tali sa nagakompetensyang mga lalaki.

q: Why is it important to protect wetlands for migratory birds?
options: Because if wetlands disappear, migratory birds lose the resting places they depend on
Because wetlands produce the insects that migratory birds eat during flight
Because wetlands reflect sunlight that helps birds navigate their long journeys
Because migratory birds lay their eggs only inside wetland plants
explanation: Wetlands must be protected because migratory birds depend on them as resting places, and if they disappear those birds lose the stops they need during their long journeys.
fact_tl: Kailangang pangalagaan ang mga latian dahil kung mawawala ang mga ito, mawawalan ng pahingahan ang mga lumilipat na ibon.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan panalipdan ang mga kalatian kay kon mawala kini, mawad-an og pahulayanan ang mga balhinong langgam.

q: Why does an air conditioner sometimes turn off and then turn back on while the room is still being cooled?
options: The thermostat shuts off the compressor when the set temperature is reached, then turns it on again when the room warms up
The air conditioner overheats and needs to rest before it can keep blowing cold air
The electricity supply to the unit automatically cuts when the room is cold enough
The fan motor slows down to save energy and stops the cold air from flowing
explanation: An aircon's thermostat shuts off the compressor when the set temperature is reached and switches it back on when the room warms up, which is why you hear it cycling on and off.
fact_tl: Hindi tuloy-tuloy na bumubuga ng lamig ang aircon. Kapag naabot na ang itinakdang temperatura, papatayin ng thermostat ang compressor (ang bahaging gumagawa ng lamig). Kapag uminit muli ang kwarto, bubuksan nito ulit. Kaya naririnig mong nag-o-on at off ang aircon.
fact_bis: Dili padayon nga magbuga og bugnaw ang aircon. Kon maabot na ang gi-set nga temperatura, palungon sa thermostat ang compressor (ang bahin nga maghimo og bugnaw). Kon mo-init na usab ang kwarto, on-on niini balik. Mao nga madunggan nimo nga nag-on ug off ang aircon.

q: How can a red tide bloom spread from one bay to nearby coastal areas?
options: Currents and wind push the drifting plankton into other bays or coasts
Fish eat the toxic plankton in one bay and carry it to other bays
The toxins dissolve in rain and fall onto nearby coastlines
Boats sailing through the bloom accidentally carry it to new locations
explanation: Because plankton drift in the water, currents and wind can push them into other bays or coasts, causing red tide advisories to appear in several provinces at the same time.
fact_tl: Dahil lumulutang lang sa tubig ang plankton, kaya itong itulak ng agos at hangin papunta sa ibang look o baybayin. Kaya minsan, kumakalat ang red tide mula sa isang lugar patungo sa karatig na lugar. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit maaaring magkaroon ng abiso sa ilang lalawigan nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Tungod kay molutaw lang sa tubig ang plankton, mahimong itukmod kini sa sulog ug hangin paingon sa ubang look o baybayon. Mao nga usahay, mokaylap ang red tide gikan sa usa ka lugar paingon sa silingang lugar. Mao kini ang hinungdan nga mahimong adunay abiso sa pipila ka lalawigan nga dungan.

q: Which element is found in the greatest amount in the Earth's crust?
options: Oxygen
Silicon
Iron
Aluminum
explanation: Oxygen is the most abundant element in the Earth's crust, found mostly locked in rocks and minerals.
fact_tl: Ang oxygen ang pinakamaraming elemento sa balat ng lupa (Earth's crust).
fact_bis: Ang oxygen maoy kinadaghanang elemento sa panit sa Yuta (Earth's crust).

q: How is the problem of microplastics in soil different from microplastics in water?
options: In soil, microplastics stay buried for a long time where crops grow, unlike flowing water where they move away
In soil, microplastics dissolve quickly, but in water they last for hundreds of years
Soil microplastics are visible to the naked eye, while water microplastics are invisible
Microplastics in soil are harmless to plants, but in water they are dangerous to fish
explanation: Unlike in flowing water where microplastics move around, in soil they stay buried for a long time in the very ground where crops grow.
fact_tl: Madalas naririnig natin ang microplastics sa dagat, pero marami rin pala sa lupa. Kaiba sa tubig na umaagos, sa lupa ay nananatili itong nakabaon nang matagal kung saan tumutubo ang ating mga pananim.
fact_bis: Kasagaran madunggan nato ang microplastics sa dagat, apan daghan usab diay sa yuta. Lahi sa tubig nga moagas, sa yuta magpabilin kini nga nalubong sa dugay nga panahon diin motubo ang atong mga tanom.

q: If you lined up Earth-sized balls across the face of the Sun, how many would fit?
options: About 109
About 50
About 1,000
About 12
explanation: The Sun is about 109 Earths wide across its face, showing how enormous the Sun is compared to our planet.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay halos 109 Earth ang lapad kung pagtatabi-tabihin sa isang linya.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw mga 109 ka Yuta ang gilapad kung itandi sa usa ka linya.

q: Why does a charged balloon stick to a wall even though it has no glue?
options: An invisible force from electric charge makes it cling to the wall
A thin layer of static glue forms on the surface of the balloon
Tiny hooks on the rubber surface grab onto the bumps in the wall
Moisture between the balloon and wall acts like a natural glue
explanation: There is no glue involved — a charged balloon sticks because of an invisible electric force from charge, which is why it pulls off cleanly without leaving any residue.
fact_tl: May nag-aakalang dumidikit ang lobo o damit dahil malagkit ito o may pandikit. Mali ito! Walang anumang pandikit. Ito ay isang puwersa na hindi nakikita na galing sa charge. Kaya pwede itong tanggalin agad nang walang naiiwang dumi.
fact_bis: Naay mga bata nga nagtuo nga modikit ang balloon o sinina kay malagkit o naay pandikit. Sayop kana! Walay bisan unsang pandikit. Usa kini ka dili makita nga puwersa nga gikan sa charge. Mao nga mahimo nimo kining kuhaon dayon nga walay mabilin nga hugaw.

q: What is the main job of DNA in a cell?
options: It carries the instructions for how every cell lives and grows
It surrounds the cell to protect it from harmful chemicals
It produces the energy a cell needs to do its work
It filters out waste products from inside the cell
explanation: DNA is a molecule that carries the instructions for how every cell lives and grows.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay isang molekula na nagdadala ng mga instruksiyon kung paano mabuhay at lumaki ang bawat selula.
fact_bis: Ang DNA usa ka molekula nga nagdala sa mga panudlo kung unsaon pagkinabuhi ug pagtubo sa matag selula.

q: How is loess soil formed?
options: Fine dust carried by the wind is dropped in layers over a long time
Sand at the bottom of rivers is slowly pressed into solid ground
Volcanic ash from eruptions cools and hardens into a rich soil layer
Leaves and dead plants pile up over centuries and rot into dark soil
explanation: Loess is thick, fertile soil formed from fine dust that the wind carried and deposited over a long time.
fact_tl: Ang loess ay makapal na lupa na nabuo mula sa pinong alikabok na dinala at inihulog ng hangin sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang loess kay baga nga yuta nga naporma gikan sa pino nga abog nga gidala ug gihulog sa hangin sa taas nga panahon.

q: Which continent has the most countries in the world?
options: Africa with 54 countries
Asia with 54 countries
Europe with 54 countries
North America with 54 countries
explanation: Africa is the continent with the most countries, with 54 member nations.
fact_tl: Ang Africa ang kontinenteng may pinakamaraming bansa, 54 na bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Africa mao ang kontinente nga adunay pinakadaghang nasud, 54 ka nasud.

q: In a tug-of-war game, when does the rope start moving toward one team?
options: When one team pulls harder and the forces become unbalanced
When both teams pull with exactly the same force
When the rope is held perfectly still in the middle
When one team lets go and the other team falls down
explanation: In a tug-of-war, if one team is stronger, the forces become unbalanced and the rope moves toward them.
fact_tl: Sa tug-of-war, kung mas malakas ang isang grupo, di-balanse na ang pwersa at gumagalaw ang lubid patungo sa kanila.
fact_bis: Sa tug-of-war, kung mas kusgan ang usa ka grupo, mahimong dili balanse ang pwersa ug molihok ang pisi paingon kanila.

q: How dramatically did the Philippines' forest cover change over the past century?
options: It dropped from about 70% of the land to below 20%
It dropped from about 50% of the land to about 30%
It increased from 20% to 70% due to reforestation programs
It remained stable at around 40% throughout the century
explanation: The Philippines' forest cover dropped dramatically over the past century from about 70% of the land to below 20%, one of the most dramatic deforestation records worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang saklaw ng kagubatan ng Pilipinas ay lubos na bumaba sa nakalipas na isang siglo mula sa halos pitumpu porsyento ng lupain patungo sa mas mababa sa dalawampu porsyento, na isang isa sa pinaka-dramatikong pagbaba ng kagubatan sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang forest cover sa Pilipinas grabe nga nahulog sa miaging siglo gikan sa mga pitumenta porsyento sa yuta ngadto sa ubos sa kawhaan porsyento, usa sa labing dramatiko nga rekord sa deforestation sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: What causes an aurora, the colorful glow seen in the sky near Earth's poles?
options: Particles from the Sun striking the upper air near the poles
Sunlight reflecting off ice crystals floating high above the poles
Volcanoes under the Arctic releasing glowing gases into the sky
Moonlight bending through thick clouds over the polar regions
explanation: An aurora is a colorful glow in the sky created when particles from the Sun strike the upper air near Earth's poles.
fact_tl: Ang aurora ay makukulay na liwanag sa langit na nabubuo kapag ang mga particle mula sa Araw ay tumama sa hangin sa itaas malapit sa mga polo ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang aurora mao ang kolorido nga kahayag sa langit nga maporma kon ang mga partikulo gikan sa Adlaw mohampak sa hangin sa taas duol sa mga polo sa Kalibotan.

q: Which of these is a sign that someone may be having an asthma attack?
options: A whistling or wheezing sound when breathing along with a tight chest
A high fever combined with a skin rash all over the body
Sudden sharp pain in one side of the stomach when running
Swollen glands in the neck and sore throat when swallowing
explanation: Signs of asthma include wheezing or a whistling sound when breathing, coughing, and a tight feeling in the chest.
fact_tl: Kabilang sa mga palatandaan ng hika ang paghinga na may parang hagok na tunog, ubo, at masikip na pakiramdam sa dibdib.
fact_bis: Lakip sa mga timailhan sa asma ang pagginhawa nga may sipol nga tingog, ubo, ug gahi nga pamati sa dughan.

q: What happens to the soft, jelly-like meat of a young coconut (buko) as the coconut gets older?
options: It hardens into firm copra
It dissolves into the coconut water inside
It stays soft but changes from white to brown
It falls off the shell and is replaced by new meat
explanation: Buko is a young coconut with soft, jelly-like meat, which hardens into firm copra as the coconut matures.
fact_tl: Ang buko ay batang niyog na may malambot at malasang laman at malinaw na tubig, na nagiging matigas na kopra kapag tumanda ang niyog.
fact_bis: Ang buko mao ang batan-on nga lubi nga adunay humok ug malasa nga unod ug tin-aw nga tubig, nga mahimong gahi nga kopras kon motigulang na ang lubi.

q: How many regions does the Philippines have?
options: 18 regions
12 regions
17 regions
20 regions
explanation: The Philippines has 18 regions.
fact_tl: May 18 rehiyon sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay 18 ka rehiyon.

q: What did Charles Darwin notice about the finches on the Galápagos Islands that helped him develop his theory?
options: They had different beak shapes suited to different foods on each island
They all had identical beaks because they shared the same ancestor
They survived longer than mainland birds because the islands had no predators
They changed their feather colors to blend in with each island's environment
explanation: Darwin observed that related finches on different Galápagos islands had differently shaped beaks suited to the food available there, which became a key example of natural selection shaping his theory.
fact_tl: Sa Galápagos Islands, napansin ni Charles Darwin na ang magkakaugnay na finch ay may iba-ibang hugis ng tuka na akma sa iba-ibang pagkain sa bawat isla — isang halimbawa ng natural selection na humubog sa kaniyang teorya.
fact_bis: Sa Galápagos Islands, namatikdan ni Charles Darwin nga ang managsoon nga mga finch adunay lainlaing porma sa tuka nga haom sa lainlaing pagkaon sa matag isla — usa ka pananglitan sa natural selection nga naghulma sa iyang teoriya.

q: Why does regular exercise help a person keep a healthy weight?
options: Exercise burns up food energy (calories), so eating about as much as you burn helps maintain weight
Exercise speeds up digestion so the body absorbs fewer calories from food
Exercise stretches muscles and makes them lighter, reducing overall body mass
Exercise removes extra sugar from the blood through sweat
explanation: Exercise uses up food energy (calories), so when a person eats roughly as much as they burn through activity, it is easier to stay at a healthy weight.
fact_tl: Ang ehersisyo ay gumagamit ng enerhiya (calories) mula sa pagkain; kapag kasing-dami lang ang kinakain natin ng nagagasta natin, mas madaling mapanatili ang malusog na timbang.
