options: It has a backbone made of soft cartilage instead of hard bone
It has no backbone at all, just like every other invertebrate
It has a small backbone hidden inside its head
It has a backbone only when it is fully grown
explanation: Even the biggest invertebrates like the giant squid have no backbone — big or small, an invertebrate always lacks a bone in its back.
fact_tl: Kahit ang pinakamalalaking invertebrate tulad ng higanteng pusit ay walang gulugod — laki man o liit, ang isang invertebrate ay laging walang buto sa likod.
fact_bis: Bisan ang pinakadako nga invertebrate sama sa higante nga nukos walay gulugod — dako man o gamay, ang usa ka invertebrate kanunay walay bukog sa likod.

q: Which of the following is a property shared by most metals in the periodic table?
options: They are usually soft, dull, and do not conduct electricity
They are usually shiny and conduct heat and electricity
They usually float on water because they are less dense
They usually break apart when bent because they are brittle
explanation: Metals like iron and copper are usually shiny, strong, and conduct heat and electricity, unlike nonmetals.
fact_tl: Nakaayos ang mga element sa periodic table. Ang metals (tulad ng bakal at tanso) ay kadalasang makintab, matibay, at nagpapadaloy ng init at kuryente; ang nonmetals (tulad ng oxygen at carbon) ay kadalasang hindi nagpapadaloy ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Gihan-ay ang mga element sa periodic table. Ang metals (sama sa puthaw ug tumbaga) kasagaran sinaw, lig-on, ug nagpadala og init ug kuryente; ang nonmetals (sama sa oxygen ug carbon) kasagaran dili magpadala og kuryente.

q: How does yeast make new yeast cells?
options: It splits exactly in half to form two equal cells
A small bump grows on the side of a cell until it breaks off as a new yeast
It releases spores that drift in the air until they land and grow
It lays tiny eggs that hatch into new yeast cells
explanation: Yeast multiplies by budding: a small bump grows on the side of a cell until it breaks off as a new yeast cell.
fact_tl: Dumarami ang lebadura sa pamamagitan ng pagsibol (budding): tumutubo ang isang maliit na usbong sa gilid ng selula hanggang ito ay humiwalay bilang bagong lebadura.
fact_bis: Modaghan ang lebadura pinaagi sa pagturok (budding): motubo ang gamayng usbong sa kilid sa selula hangtod kini mobulag isip bag-ong lebadura.

q: Why do many mangrove trees have arch-shaped prop roots that spread out from the trunk?
options: To absorb sunlight from multiple directions in the shaded swamp
To store extra freshwater away from the salty sea
To spread into soft mud and keep the tree from toppling over
To trap fish and small crabs for extra nutrients
explanation: Mangrove prop roots spread from the trunk down into soft mud, providing stability and keeping the tree from toppling in soft soil.
fact_tl: Maraming bakawan ang may mga arch-shaped prop roots na lumalawig mula sa puno pababa sa malambot na putikan — ang pag-spread ng mga ugat na ito ay nagbibigay ng katatagan at nagpipigil sa puno na gumuho sa malambot na lupa.
fact_bis: Daghang bakawan adunay arch-shaped prop roots nga nagpahanap gikan sa kahoy pababa sa humok nga lapok — ang pagpalapad niining mga ugat naghatag og katatagan ug nagpugong sa kahoy gikan sa pagsipatay sa humok nga yuta.

q: In which weightlifting category did Hidilyn Diaz win her Olympic gold medal?
options: Women's 49-kilogram category
Women's 59-kilogram category
Women's 55-kilogram category
Women's 64-kilogram category
explanation: Hidilyn Diaz won in the women's 55-kilogram weightlifting category at the Olympics.
fact_tl: Nanalo si Hidilyn Diaz sa 55-kilo na kategorya ng weightlifting ng kababaihan.
fact_bis: Nakadaog si Hidilyn Diaz sa 55-kilo nga kategorya sa weightlifting sa kababayen-an.

q: How many sense organs does a human body have?
options: Three — the eyes, ears, and nose
Four — the eyes, ears, nose, and tongue
Five — the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin
Six — the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, skin, and brain
explanation: There are five sense organs: the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin.
fact_tl: May limang (5) sangkap ng pandama: mata, tainga, ilong, dila, at balat.
fact_bis: Adunay lima (5) ka organ sa igbalati: ang mata, dalunggan, ilong, dila, ug panit.

q: After steam is removed from geothermal water in the Philippines, what do plants like those in Leyte do with the leftover brine?
options: They release it into the ocean to cool nearby coastal areas
They evaporate it in open ponds to let minerals dry out and be sold
They inject it back underground to keep reservoir pressure and prevent pollution
They pipe it to farms as fertilizer because it is rich in minerals
explanation: Philippine geothermal plants inject the mineral-rich brine back underground to maintain reservoir pressure and prevent pollution.
fact_tl: Ang mga geothermal plant sa Pilipinas tulad ng sa Leyte ay maingat na namamahala ng mga brine — ang mineral-rich na tubig na nananatili pagkatapos ng steam separation — sa pamamagitan ng pag-inject nito pabalik sa lupa para mapanatili ang pressure ng reservoir at maiwasan ang polusyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga geothermal plant sa Pilipinas sama niadtong sa Leyte maingat nagdumala sa mga brine — mineral-rich nga tubig nga nahabilin pagkahuman sa steam separation — pinaagi sa pag-inject niini balik sa ilalim sa yuta aron mapadayon ang presyon sa reservoir ug mapugngan ang polusyon.

q: How does a paramecium move through pond water?
options: It pushes itself forward using a long whip-like tail called a flagellum
It wriggles its whole body like a worm to swim
It waves tiny hairs called cilia to move
It shoots a jet of water out the back to propel itself forward
explanation: The paramecium is a slipper-shaped pond micro-organism that moves by waving tiny hairs called cilia.
fact_tl: Ang paramecium ay isang mikroorganismo sa tubig-lawa na hugis-sapatos at gumagalaw sa pamamagitan ng maliliit na buhok-buhok na tinatawag na cilia.
fact_bis: Ang paramecium kay usa ka mikroorganismo sa tubig-danaw nga porma og sapatos ug naglihok pinaagi sa gagmay nga balahibo nga gitawag og cilia.

q: How can large birds like eagles stay in the air for a long time without flapping their wings?
options: They glide on cold air that sinks from high altitudes
They ride rising columns of warm air called thermals
They catch strong horizontal winds called jet streams near the ground
They inflate air sacs that make them lighter than the surrounding air
explanation: Large birds like eagles soar on rising columns of warm air called thermals, which carry them upward with hardly any wing movement.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking ibon tulad ng agila ay nakakapailanlang sa mainit na hanging pumapaitaas (thermals) nang halos hindi gumagalaw ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong langgam sama sa agila makahimo og pagpailanlang sa mainit nga hangin nga nagsaka (thermals) nga halos walay paglihok ang pako.

q: Why is it helpful for a person to know their own blood type?
options: So they can choose which sports are safe for their body type
So doctors can match a blood type quickly if they need blood in an emergency
So they know which foods to avoid to keep their blood clean
So teachers can plan physical activities that suit each student
explanation: Knowing your blood type means you can be helped quickly in an emergency because doctors can find a matching blood type right away.
fact_tl: Mabuting malaman ng bawat tao ang sariling uri ng dugo upang mabilis itong matulungan kung may emerhensya.
fact_bis: Maayo nga mahibal-an sa matag tawo ang iyang kaugalingong klase sa dugo aron dali siyang matabangan kung adunay emerhensya.

q: Which part of a plant cell uses sunlight to make food?
options: The cell wall, which captures light and turns it into sugar
The vacuole, which stores sunlight energy as starch
The chloroplast, which makes food using sunlight
The nucleus, which converts light signals into chemical instructions
explanation: Plant cells have chloroplasts that make food using sunlight through the process of photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang mga selula ng halaman ay may chloroplast na gumagawa ng pagkain gamit ang liwanag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga selula sa tanom adunay chloroplast nga maghimo og pagkaon gamit ang kahayag sa adlaw.

q: Where are electrons found inside an atom?
options: At the very center of the atom, forming the nucleus
Packed tightly together with protons inside the nucleus
Moving around the outside of the nucleus
Spread evenly throughout the entire atom like a cloud of mist
explanation: Electrons move around the outside of the nucleus in an atom.
fact_tl: Ang mga electron ay gumagalaw sa labas ng nucleus, sa palibot nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga electron naglihok sa gawas sa nucleus, sa palibot niini.

q: Which part of the lagundi plant is most commonly used as herbal medicine?
options: The bark, which is scraped off and dried into powder
The roots, which are dried and ground into capsules
The leaves, which are boiled or made into an extract
The flowers, which are pressed into oil for skin treatment
explanation: The part of lagundi usually used as medicine is the leaves, which are boiled or made into an extract.
fact_tl: Ang bahagi ng lagundi na karaniwang ginagamit bilang gamot ay ang mga dahon, na pinapakulo o kinukunan ng katas.
fact_bis: Ang bahin sa lagundi nga kasagaran gigamit isip tambal mao ang mga dahon, nga lat-an o kuhaan ug katas.

q: What is unusual about a crocodile's jaw strength?
options: It can open and close its jaws with equal force in both directions
Its bite is weak because its jaw muscles are used mostly for swimming
It has one of the strongest bites of any animal but can only open its jaws weakly
Its jaws are strongest when opening, which is why it can flip prey into the air
explanation: The crocodile has one of the strongest bites of any animal, but its muscles for opening the jaw are surprisingly weak.
fact_tl: Ang buwaya ay may isa sa pinakamalakas na kagat sa lahat ng hayop, ngunit mahina ang lakas na ibinubukas nito ng panga.
fact_bis: Ang buwaya adunay usa sa pinakakusog nga paak sa tanang mananap, apan huyang ra ang kusog niini sa pag-abli sa apapangig.

q: When fishballs are fried in hot oil, how does the cooking actually happen?
options: The pan vibrates rapidly, shaking heat into the fishballs
Heat from the hot oil moves into the food and cooks it
The fishballs absorb light from the flame and convert it to heat inside
Steam trapped under the fishballs heats them from below
explanation: When fishballs are fried, heat from the hot oil moves into the food and cooks it through heat transfer.
fact_tl: Kapag pinipirito ang fishball, ang init mula sa mainit na mantika ay lumilipat sa pagkain at siyang nagluluto nito.
fact_bis: Kon iprito ang fishball, ang kainit gikan sa init nga mantika mobalhin ngadto sa pagkaon ug maoy moluto niini.

q: What do shrimp use their long antennae for?
options: To paddle through the water like oars
To inject venom into predators that come close
To sense and smell their surroundings in the water
To anchor themselves to rocks so the current does not sweep them away
explanation: A shrimp uses its long feelers, called antennae, to sense and smell its surroundings in the water.
fact_tl: Ang mahahabang sungot o antenna ng hipon ay ginagamit nito para maramdaman at maamoy ang paligid sa loob ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga sungot o antenna sa hipon gamiton niini aron mobati ug makasimhot sa palibot sulod sa tubig.

q: Earth is actually closest to the Sun in January, yet the northern hemisphere has winter then. What does this tell us about what causes seasons?
options: Seasons are caused by the Sun changing its heat output each year
Seasons are caused by Earth spinning faster in winter than in summer
Seasons are not caused by Earth's distance from the Sun but by Earth's axial tilt
Seasons are caused by clouds blocking sunlight more in some months than others
explanation: Because Earth is closest to the Sun in January (northern winter) and farthest in July, this confirms that seasons are caused by Earth's axial tilt, not its distance from the Sun.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay pinaka-malapit sa Araw (perihelion) sa Enero — sa panahon ng northern hemisphere winter — at pinaka-malayo (aphelion) sa Hulyo. Ito ay nagpapatunay na ang mga season ay hindi sanhi ng distansya mula sa Araw kundi ng axial tilt ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta pinaka-duol sa Adlaw (perihelion) sa Enero — panahon sa northern hemisphere winter — ug pinaka-layo (aphelion) sa Hulyo. Nagpamatuod kini nga ang mga season dili sanhi sa distansya sa Yuta gikan sa Adlaw kondili sa axial tilt sa Yuta.

q: What happens when a carabao mango seed is planted in soil and given water?
options: It dissolves into the soil and provides nutrients for nearby plants
It dries out and cannot sprout unless it is first soaked in juice
It can sprout and slowly grow into a new mango tree
It produces fruit within a week but does not grow into a full tree
explanation: When a carabao mango seed is planted in soil and watered, it can sprout and slowly grow into a new mango tree.
fact_tl: Kapag itinanim sa lupa ang buto ng carabao mango at nadiligan, maaari itong sumibol at unti-unting tumubo bilang isang bagong punong mangga.
fact_bis: Kon itanom sa yuta ang liso sa carabao mango ug bisbisan, makasalingsing kini ug hinay-hinay nga motubo isip bag-ong punoan sa mangga.

q: What is the key difference between glass and ordinary ceramic when it comes to light?
options: Glass and ceramic both let light through, but glass bends it more
Glass is clear and lets light through, while ordinary ceramic is solid and not transparent
Ceramic lets more light through than glass because it has tiny holes
Both are opaque, but glass looks clear because it is polished smooth
explanation: Glass is clear and lets light through, but ordinary ceramic is solid and not transparent.
fact_tl: Ang salamin ay aninag at nakakadaan ang liwanag, ngunit ang karaniwang seramika ay makapal at hindi aninag.
fact_bis: Ang salamin aninag ug makaagi ang kahayag, apan ang ordinaryong seramika baga ug dili aninag.

q: How big is a blue whale's heart compared to everyday objects?
options: About the size of a basketball
About the size of a school desk
About the size of a small car
About the size of a refrigerator
explanation: The blue whale has the largest heart of any animal — about the size of a small car.
fact_tl: Ang blue whale ang may pinakamalaking puso sa lahat ng hayop — kasinglaki ng isang maliit na kotse.
fact_bis: Ang blue whale adunay pinakadako nga kasingkasing sa tanang hayop — sama kadako sa usa ka gamay nga awto.

q: Why can introducing a new organism into an ecosystem cause problems?
options: New organisms always bring diseases that wipe out the native species instantly
The new organism may have no natural enemies and may eat the food of native species, upsetting the balance
Native species are too weak to compete with any newcomer, so they always go extinct
New organisms produce chemicals that poison the water and soil for all other living things
explanation: A new organism introduced into an ecosystem can upset the balance because it has no natural enemies and may eat the food that native species depend on.
fact_tl: Kapag may bagong uri ng organismo na ipinapasok sa isang ekosistema, maaari nitong sirain ang balanse dahil wala itong likas na kaaway at maaaring lamunin ang pagkain ng mga katutubong species.
fact_bis: Kung adunay bag-ong matang sa organismo nga gipasulod sa usa ka ekosistema, mahimo niining guboon ang balanse kay wala kini natural nga kaaway ug mahimong kan-on ang pagkaon sa lumad nga mga espisye.

q: What are fossils, and why are they valuable to scientists?
options: Fossils are living organisms found in deep caves that reveal how species survive today
Fossils are crystals that form when minerals drip into underground pools over centuries
Fossils are remains or traces of ancient plants and animals preserved in rock that help scientists learn what lived on Earth millions of years ago
Fossils are artificial casts made by scientists to recreate the look of animals that no longer exist
explanation: Fossils are the remains or traces of ancient plants and animals preserved in rock, helping scientists learn what lived on Earth millions of years ago.
fact_tl: Ang fossils ay mga labi o bakas ng mga halaman at hayop noong unang panahon na napreserba sa bato. Tumutulong ang mga ito sa mga siyentista na malaman kung anong nabuhay sa Earth milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang fossils mao ang salin o timaan sa karaang tanom ug hayop nga napreserbar sa bato. Motabang kini sa mga siyentista nga mahibaloan kung unsa ang nabuhi sa Earth milyon-milyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: Why does thick water hyacinth growth in rivers and canals make flooding worse?
options: Water hyacinth absorbs so much water that the riverbed dries and cracks, causing sudden water rushes
Water hyacinth poisons the water, killing fish that normally help keep water levels stable
Thick water hyacinth blocks the flow of water, so rivers overflow more easily
Water hyacinth releases gases that heat the water and make it expand, raising water levels
explanation: When water hyacinth grows thick, it blocks the flow of water in rivers and canals, making floods happen more easily.
fact_tl: Kapag dumami ang water hyacinth, nakakabara ito sa daloy ng tubig sa ilog at kanal. Dahil dito, mas mabilis bumaha at nahihirapang dumaan ang mga bangka.
fact_bis: Kung modaghan ang water hyacinth, mobabag kini sa agos sa tubig sa suba ug kanal. Tungod niini, mas paspas mobaha ug maglisod molabay ang mga bangka.

q: Which plants, besides onion and garlic, also produce bulbs?
options: Mango and papaya
Cactus and aloe vera
Lily and tulip
Tomato and eggplant
explanation: Besides onion and garlic, plants such as lily and tulip also make bulbs.
fact_tl: Bukod sa sibuyas at bawang, may iba pang halamang gumagawa ng bombilya gaya ng liryo at tulip.
fact_bis: Gawas sa sibuyas ug ahos, naa pa'y ubang tanom nga naghimo og bombilya sama sa liryo ug tulip.

q: Why is it important to warm up before exercising?
options: To make your heart beat slower so you save energy during the workout
So our muscles do not get hurt easily
To make sure you sweat enough to cool down during exercise
To stretch your bones so they do not break when you run
explanation: It is important to warm up before exercising so our muscles do not get hurt easily.
fact_tl: Mahalagang mag-warm-up o mag-init muna bago mag-ehersisyo para hindi madaling masaktan ang kalamnan.
fact_bis: Importante nga mag-warm-up o mag-init-init una sa ehersisyo aron dili dali masakitan ang kaunoran.

q: What is dangerous about a tsunami that people often do not realize?
options: A tsunami is always a single, massive wave that strikes only once
A tsunami is a series of multiple waves, and the second or third wave can be larger than the first
A tsunami only affects underwater life and does not reach land unless there is an earthquake nearby
A tsunami travels so slowly that people always have days to evacuate before it arrives
explanation: A tsunami is a wave train of multiple waves; the second or third wave is often larger than the first, so people must stay in safety until it is confirmed safe to return.
fact_tl: Ang tsunami ay hindi isang alon lamang kundi isang 'wave train' ng maraming alon na maaaring dumating sa loob ng 10-60 minuto; ang pangalawa o ikatlong alon ay madalas na mas malaki kaysa sa una; ang mga tao ay dapat manatili sa lugar na ligtas hanggang alam nilang ligtas nang bumalik.
fact_bis: Ang tsunami dili usa ka balod lamang kondili usa ka 'wave train' sa daghang balod nga mahimong moabot sulod sa 10-60 minuto sa usag usa; ang ikaduha o ikatulo nga balod kanunay mas dako kaysa una; ang mga tawo kinahanglan magpabilin sa ligtas nga lugar hangtod nahibaloan nila nga luwas na ang pagbalik.

q: What do a plant's first leaves do once they appear?
options: They store water underground to feed the growing roots
They fall off after a week and are replaced by stronger adult leaves
They turn green and begin making food from sunlight
They release seeds so that new plants can grow nearby
explanation: Once the first leaves appear, they turn green and begin making food from sunlight through photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Kapag lumitaw na ang mga unang dahon, nagiging berde ang mga ito at nagsisimulang gumawa ng pagkain mula sa araw.
fact_bis: Kon mogula na ang unang mga dahon, kini molunhaw ug magsugod sa paghimo og pagkaon gikan sa adlaw.

q: Why can fish survive under ice in a frozen lake?
options: Fish produce body heat that melts a thin tunnel through the ice
Ice sinks to the bottom, pushing warmer water upward where the fish live
Because ice floats, it covers the lake surface while fish stay alive in the liquid water below
Fish hibernate inside the ice, frozen solid until the ice melts in spring
explanation: Because ice floats, it covers the lake's surface in cold weather while fish stay alive in the liquid water below.
fact_tl: Dahil lumulutang ang yelo, natatakpan nito ang ibabaw ng lawa sa malamig na panahon at nananatiling buhay ang mga isda sa tubig sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Tungod kay molutaw ang yelo, matabonan niini ang ibabaw sa linaw sa tugnaw nga panahon samtang ang mga isda mabuhi sa tubig sa ilawom.

q: Where did the carbon, nitrogen, and iron atoms in your body originally come from?
options: They formed inside Earth's core and were brought to the surface by volcanic eruptions
They arrived on Earth aboard comets from the outer solar system
They were forged inside stars through nuclear fusion and scattered into space by supernova explosions
They have existed since the Big Bang without ever changing or being created inside stars
explanation: The atoms in our bodies were forged inside stars through nuclear fusion and scattered into space by supernova explosions — the saying that we are 'made of star stuff' is literally true.
fact_tl: Ang mga atom sa ating katawan — ang carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, iron, at iba pa — ay ginawa sa mga panloob ng mga bituin sa pamamagitan ng nuclear fusion at ibinulalas sa kalawakan ng mga supernova explosion; ang pagkasabi na tayo ay 'gawa sa star dust' ay isang literal na katotohanan.
fact_bis: Ang mga atom sa atong lawas — carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, iron, ug uban pa — gihimo sulod sa mga bituin pinaagi sa nuclear fusion ug gibulagak sa kalawakan sa mga supernova explosion; ang pagkasulti nga kita 'gihimo sa star dust' usa ka literal nga katotohanan.

q: How do a bird's hollow bones help it breathe?
options: Hollow bones store extra oxygen like a tank so the bird does not need to breathe as often
Hollow bones make the bird lighter, reducing the effort needed to pump air through the lungs
Some hollow bones connect to air sacs that help the bird breathe
Hollow bones vibrate to pump air in and out without the bird needing a diaphragm
explanation: Some of a bird's hollow bones connect to air sacs that help the bird breathe.
fact_tl: Ang ilang guwang na buto ng ibon ay konektado sa mga supot ng hangin na tumutulong sa paghinga nito.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka guwang nga bukog sa langgam konektado sa mga sudlanan sa hangin nga motabang sa pagginhawa niini.

q: How do farmers keep soil from cracking quickly during a drought?
options: They spray chemicals that seal the surface of the soil
They cover the soil with straw or dry leaves to block the sun's heat and slow evaporation
They dig deep holes to allow heat to escape from deep underground
They water the soil with saltwater, which holds moisture longer than freshwater
explanation: Farmers cover soil with straw, dry leaves, or other covers to block the sun's heat and slow evaporation, which helps the soil take longer to dry and crack.
fact_tl: Para hindi agad mabitak ang lupa, tinatakpan ito ng mga magsasaka ng dayami, tuyong dahon, o iba pang panakip. Ang takip na ito ay humaharang sa init ng araw at binabagalan ang pagsingaw ng tubig, kaya mas matagal bago matuyo at mabitak ang lupa.
fact_bis: Aron dili dali nga moliki ang yuta, tabonan kini sa mga mag-uuma og dagami, mala nga dahon, o ubang tabon. Kini nga tabon mobabag sa init sa adlaw ug mohinay sa pag-alisngaw sa tubig, mao nga mas dugay mamala ug moliki ang yuta.

q: How does the ipil-ipil tree help protect hillsides from erosion?
options: Its wide flat leaves catch rainfall and spread it gently over the ground
Its deep roots hold the soil and prevent it from being washed away
Its trunk acts as a barrier that stops flowing water and mud
It releases chemicals that harden the soil around it
explanation: The deep roots of ipil-ipil hold the soil, helping prevent erosion on hillsides.
fact_tl: Ang malalim na ugat ng ipil-ipil ay humahawak sa lupa kaya nakakatulong itong pigilan ang pagguho ng lupa sa mga gilid ng bundok.
fact_bis: Ang lawom nga gamot sa ipil-ipil naggunit sa yuta mao nga makatabang kini sa pagpugong sa pagkahugno sa yuta sa mga dalisdis.

q: What must be true about your position relative to the sun and rain in order to see a rainbow?
options: The sun must be directly in front of you and the rain must be behind you
The sun must be above you and the rain must be falling straight down onto you
You must have the sun behind you and raindrops in front of you
You must stand inside the rain with sunlight shining down from directly overhead
explanation: To see a rainbow, the observer must have the sun behind them and raindrops in front — which is why rainbows are commonly seen in the afternoon after rain in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Para makita ang isang bahaghari, kailangan ng manonood na nasa likod ang araw at ang mga patak ng ulan ay nasa harapan — kaya karaniwan itong nakikita pagkatapos ng ulan sa hapon sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Aron makakita og bahaghari, ang nagtan-aw kinahanglan nga likod ang adlaw ug mga patak sa ulan sa atubangan — mao nang kasagaran makita ang bahaghari sa hapon human sa ulan sa Pilipinas.

q: How long does the rock cycle take to complete?
options: A few hundred years, which is why we can observe it within a human lifetime
A few thousand years, similar to how long some mountains have existed
Millions of years, making it far too slow for humans to watch directly
A few decades, which is why rock formations change noticeably after earthquakes
explanation: The rock cycle is very slow and can take millions of years to complete.
fact_tl: Ang siklo ng bato ay napakabagal at maaaring tumagal ng milyon-milyong taon para makompleto.
fact_bis: Ang siklo sa bato hinay kaayo ug mahimong molungtad og milyon-milyon ka tuig aron mahuman.

q: Paper comes from heavy wood, yet each sheet is very light and thin. Why?
options: Wood becomes lighter when mixed with water because some parts dissolve away
Paper is not really from wood — it is made from cotton fibers woven together
The wood is crushed and spread out thin, so each sheet contains only a little material
Chemicals are added to wood that break it down into a gas, which is then cooled into thin sheets
explanation: The wood used to make paper is crushed and spread out thin, so each sheet has only a little material, making it very light.
fact_tl: Kahit galing sa mabigat na kahoy, ang papel ay napakagaan at manipis. Nangyari ito dahil dinurog ang kahoy at kinalat nang manipis kaya kakaunti na lang ang laman ng bawat papel.
fact_bis: Bisan og gikan sa bug-at nga kahoy, ang papel gaan kaayo ug nipis. Nahitabo kini kay gidurog ang kahoy ug gibukhad og nipis mao nga gamay ra ang sulod sa matag papel.

q: What does the inside of a santol fruit taste like compared to its outer rind?
options: Both the rind and the pulp are sour, but the pulp is juicier
The rind is sweet but the pulp inside is sour and yellow
The rind is sour, but the soft pulp inside is sweet and white
Both the rind and the pulp are sweet, but the rind has a bitter aftertaste
explanation: The santol's rind is sour, but the soft pulp inside is sweet and white.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng santol ay maasim, ngunit ang malambot na laman sa loob ay matamis at maputi.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa santol aslom, apan ang humok nga unod sa sulod tam-is ug puti.

q: Why should visitors never break a stalactite inside a cave?
options: Breaking it releases poisonous gas trapped inside the mineral layers
Stalactites are hollow and filled with water that floods the cave if broken
A stalactite represents thousands of years of very slow growth and breaking it destroys all of that time
Broken stalactites are sharp enough to collapse the cave ceiling above
explanation: Stalactites and stalagmites grow only a few millimeters to centimeters per thousand years, so breaking one destroys thousands of years of growth.
fact_tl: Ang mga stalactite at stalagmite ay lumalaki nang napakabagal — karaniwan ay ilang millimeter hanggang ilang centimeter bawat 1,000 taon depende sa dami ng patak ng tubig at konsentrasyon ng calcite; ang pagpuputol o pagbasag ng isang stalactite ay nagsisira ng libo-libong taon ng paglaki.
fact_bis: Ang mga stalactite ug stalagmite nagtubo og kaayo ka hinay — kasagaran pipila ka millimeter hangtod pipila ka centimeter matag 1,000 ka tuig depende sa rate sa pagtuslob ug konsentrasyon sa calcite; ang pagbasag sa usa ka stalactite nagguba sa libu-libong tuig nga pagtubo.

q: What is the typical temperature range in the Philippines due to its warm tropical climate?
options: Around 5 to 15 degrees Celsius
Around 15 to 22 degrees Celsius
Around 25 to 33 degrees Celsius
Around 35 to 45 degrees Celsius
explanation: The Philippines has a warm tropical climate, so temperatures are often around 25 to 33 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Mainit ang panahon sa Pilipinas, kaya madalas mga 25 hanggang 33 degrees Celsius ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Init ang panahon sa Pilipinas, mao nga kasagaran mga 25 hangtod 33 degrees Celsius ang temperatura.

q: Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. How do they use their wings?
options: They fold their wings tightly to reduce drag and run faster on ice
They spread their wings wide to glide downhill on snowy slopes
They use their wings like paddles to swim underwater
They use their wings to dig burrows in snow for shelter
explanation: Penguins are birds that cannot fly, but they use their wings like paddles to swim underwater.
fact_tl: Ang mga penguin ay ibong hindi nakakalipad, ngunit ginagamit nila ang kanilang mga pakpak na parang sagwan upang lumangoy sa ilalim ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga penguin mga langgam nga dili makalupad, apan gamiton nila ang ilang mga pako sama sa bugsay aron molangoy ilalom sa tubig.

q: What does the nautilus eat on the seafloor?
options: Shrimp, crabs, and dead animals it finds
Seaweed and underwater plants
Small fish it hunts by chasing them
Plankton it filters through its gills
explanation: The nautilus is a scavenger that eats shrimp, crabs, and molted shells or dead animals it finds on the seafloor.
fact_tl: Kumakain ang nautilus ng mga hipon, alimango, at mga natuklap na balat o patay na hayop sa dagat.
fact_bis: Mokaon ang nautilus og pasayan, alimango, ug mga nangahulog nga panit o patay nga mananap sa salog sa dagat.

q: In what year did Marconi first send a radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean?
explanation: Marconi sent the first transatlantic radio signal in 1901, a landmark achievement in communication history.
fact_tl: Ipinadala ni Marconi ang unang radyo signal tumawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko noong 1901.
fact_bis: Gipadala ni Marconi ang unang radyo signal tabok sa Dagat Atlantiko niadtong 1901.

q: For most of its life, where does Rafflesia hide before its flower appears?
options: As threads inside a vine
Underground as a bulb in the soil
As dormant seeds attached to tree bark
As a small leafy plant beneath the forest floor
explanation: Rafflesia spends most of its life hidden as threads inside the vine, only becoming visible when a flower bud finally pushes out and blooms.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng buhay ng Rafflesia ay ginugugol nitong nakatago bilang mga sinulid sa loob ng baging. Walang makikitang halaman sa labas hanggang sa biglang lumabas at mamukadkad ang bulaklak nito.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa kinabuhi sa Rafflesia gigugol niini nga tago isip mga tanod sulod sa baging. Walay makita nga tanom sa gawas hangtod nga kalit nga mogawas ug mamulak ang bulak niini.

q: Why does a jeweler cut and polish a freshly dug diamond?
options: To give it many flat faces that catch the light
To remove the carbon from inside it
To make it harder so it does not scratch easily
To change its color from gray to clear
explanation: A freshly dug diamond looks rough and dull, so an expert cuts and polishes it to create many flat faces that catch the light and make it sparkle.
fact_tl: Ang bagong hukay na diamante ay magaspang at mapurol, kaya hinihiwa at pinakikintab ito ng eksperto para magkaroon ng maraming mukhang sumasalamin sa liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong kalot nga diamante magaspang ug pulpol, mao nga ginahiwa ug ginapasinaw kini sa eksperto aron magbaton og daghang nawong nga mosalamin sa kahayag.

q: What happens to a mango fruit as it ripens on the tree?
options: The green fruit turns sweet and yellow
The yellow fruit turns hard and sour
The fruit falls off while still green
The fruit changes from red to orange
explanation: The unripe mango is green, but as it ripens it turns sweet and yellow.
fact_tl: Ang mangga ay isang prutas na tumutubo sa matataas na puno, at ang hilaw na berdeng bunga ay nagiging matamis at dilaw kapag hinog na.
fact_bis: Ang mangga usa ka prutas nga motubo sa tag-as nga kahoy, ug ang hilaw nga berde nga bunga mahimong tam-is ug dalag kung mahinog na.

q: When measuring ocean waves at a shore, what does frequency mean?
options: How many waves hit the shore each second
How tall each wave is when it arrives
How fast the water moves toward the beach
How far apart the waves are from each other
explanation: For water waves, frequency is how many waves hit the shore each second — the same concept as frequency in sound waves.
fact_tl: Ang konsepto ng frequency ay pareho para sa alon ng tubig at alon ng tunog. Sa dagat, ang frequency ay kung ilang alon ang humampas sa baybayin kada segundo. Sa tunog, ang frequency ay kung ilang vibration ng hangin ang umabot sa tainga mo kada segundo. Magkaiba ng anyo pero iisa ang ideya.
fact_bis: Ang konsepto sa frequency parehas alang sa balod sa tubig ug balod sa tingog. Sa dagat, ang frequency mao kung pila ka balod ang mohampak sa baybayon matag segundo. Sa tingog, ang frequency mao kung pila ka pagkurog sa hangin ang moabot sa imong dalunggan matag segundo. Lahi og porma apan parehas og ideya.

q: Why are expansion gaps built into roads, rails, and bridges in the Philippines?
options: So they are not damaged when they expand in the heat
To allow rainwater to drain off the surface quickly
To make them strong enough to handle heavy vehicles
To reduce the cost of construction materials
explanation: Because the Philippines has a hot climate, materials expand in the heat, so expansion gaps prevent damage to roads, rails, and bridges.
fact_tl: Dahil mainit ang klima sa Pilipinas, mahalaga ang mga puwang sa kalsada, riles, at tulay para hindi sila masira kapag lumalawak sa init.
fact_bis: Tungod kay init ang klima sa Pilipinas, importante ang mga gintang sa dalan, riles, ug taytayan aron dili madaot kung molapad sila sa kainit.

q: How do engineers make sure a geothermal plant near a volcano operates safely?
options: They study the area carefully, pick safe spots, and monitor it
They move the volcano away from the power plant
They build a concrete wall between the plant and the volcano
They wait until the volcano stops erupting permanently
explanation: Engineers study the area carefully, pick safe spots, and continuously monitor a geothermal plant near a volcano so it can operate safely.
fact_tl: Iniisip ng iba na delikadong magtayo ng planta malapit sa bulkan. Pero maingat itong pinag-aaralan ng mga inhinyero, pinipili ang ligtas na lugar at binabantayan, kaya ligtas itong gumana.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga delikado magtukod og planta duol sa bulkan. Apan gitun-an kini pag-ayo sa mga inhenyero, mopili sila og luwas nga lugar ug bantayan kini, busa luwas kining modagan.

q: What is a risk of using activated charcoal toothpaste that is too rough?
options: It can scratch the enamel or protective layer of the teeth
It makes teeth turn black permanently
It weakens the gums and makes them bleed
It removes fluoride from the teeth
explanation: While activated charcoal absorbs stains, toothpaste that is too rough can scratch the enamel or protective layer of the teeth, which is why dentist advice is important.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakalang ang activated charcoal toothpaste ay laging mas magaling magpaputi ng ngipin—pero kailangan ng ingat dito. Totoo na nakakasipsip ng dumi ang activated charcoal, pero kapag masyadong magaspang ito, maaari nitong gasgasin ang enamel o pananggalang na balat ng ngipin. Kaya hindi laging mas mabuti ang 'active', at mahalagang magtanong muna sa dentista.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang activated charcoal toothpaste kanunayng mas maayo mopaputi sa ngipon—apan nanginahanglan kini og pag-amping. Tinuod nga ang activated charcoal mosuyop sa mansa, apan kung sobra ka gaspang kini, mahimo niining makagit ang enamel o ang panalipod nga panit sa ngipon. Busa dili kanunayng mas maayo ang 'active', ug importante mangutana sa una sa dentista.

q: How do foreign animals or plants brought into the Philippines harm native species?
options: By taking their food and homes
By mixing with them and creating new hybrids
By spreading diseases that only affect humans
By eating the soil and reducing farmland
explanation: Invasive foreign animals or plants threaten native Philippine species by competing for and taking their food and homes.
fact_tl: Ang mga dayuhang hayop o halaman na dinala sa Pilipinas ay maaaring makasakit sa mga katutubong species sa pamamagitan ng pagkuha sa kanilang pagkain at tirahan.
fact_bis: Ang mga langyaw nga hayop o tanom nga gidala sa Pilipinas mahimong makadaot sa lumad nga species pinaagi sa pagkuha sa ilang pagkaon ug puy-anan.

q: Why is it important to keep your fingernails short and clean?
options: Dirt and germs easily hide under long nails
Long nails break off and cause bleeding
Painted nails attract more insects
Nails grow faster when they are dirty
explanation: Dirt and germs easily hide under long fingernails, so keeping nails short and scrubbing under them when washing helps prevent illness.
fact_tl: Madaling matago ang dumi at mikrobyo sa ilalim ng mahabang kuko, kaya mahalagang panatilihing maikli at malinis ang mga kuko at kuskusin din ang ilalim nito kapag naghuhugas.
fact_bis: Sayon nga matago ang hugaw ug mikrobyo sa ilawom sa taas nga kuko, mao nga importante nga himoong mubo ug limpyo ang mga kuko ug kuskoson usab ang ilawom niini kon manghugas.

q: Why do crabs, shrimp, and lobsters need to shed their old shell as they grow?
options: Their hard outer shell does not grow with them
Their shell becomes too colorful and attracts predators
Their shell absorbs water and gets too heavy
Their inner bones push the shell off
explanation: Crustaceans have a hard exoskeleton instead of bones inside, and since it cannot grow with them, they must shed it through a process called molting.
fact_tl: Ang mga krustaseo (crustaceans) gaya ng alimango, hipon, at ulang ay may matigas na balat sa labas (exoskeleton) sa halip na buto sa loob. Para lumaki, kailangan nilang magpalit ng lumang balat (molting).
fact_bis: Ang mga crustacean sama sa alimango, hipon, ug ulang adunay gahi nga panit sa gawas (exoskeleton) imbis bukog sa sulod. Aron motubo, kinahanglan silang mag-ilis sa daan nga panit (molting).

q: Which part of the brain sends signals that make you feel hungry?
options: The hypothalamus
The cerebellum
The brainstem
The cerebrum
explanation: The hypothalamus, a part of the brain, sends the signals that make you feel hungry.
fact_tl: Ang iyong utak, lalo na ang bahaging tinatawag na hypothalamus, ang nagpapadala ng senyales na nararamdaman mong gutom.
fact_bis: Ang imong utok, ilabi na ang bahin nga gitawag og hypothalamus, maoy nagapadala sa senyales nga gibati nimong gutom.

q: Why do some deep-sea fish and shrimp have bright red color?
options: Red appears invisible in the dark deep sea where red light cannot reach
Red attracts mates in the cold deep water
Red color absorbs heat to keep them warm
Red makes them look larger to scare predators
explanation: Deep down there is almost no red light, so red-colored animals appear to vanish and stay hidden — making bright red a useful camouflage color in the deep sea.
fact_tl: Sa kailaliman ay halos walang pulang liwanag, kaya ang mga hayop na pula ang kulay ay parang naglalaho at hindi nakikita — kaya pulang-pula ang ilang mga deep-sea na isda at hipon.
fact_bis: Sa kalaliman halos walay pula nga kahayag, busa ang mga mananap nga pula ang kolor morag mawala ug magpabiling tago — mao nga pula kaayo ang ubang deep-sea nga isda ug pasayan.

q: Why is the Coriolis effect described as an 'apparent' force rather than a real one?
options: Nothing is actually pushing the object; the path just looks curved because the Earth is spinning beneath it
The force only works on objects in water, not in air
It is caused by the Moon's gravity pulling on moving air
It only appears during storms and disappears in calm weather
explanation: The Coriolis effect is only an apparent force — nothing is really pushing; the path looks curved because the spinning Earth moves beneath the object.
fact_tl: Ang Coriolis ay isang apparent force lamang, ibig sabihin walang tunay na nagtutulak; mukha lang itong lumiliko dahil umiikot ang Mundo sa ilalim ng gumagalaw na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang Coriolis maoy usa lang ka apparent force, buot ipasabot walay tinuod nga nagtulod; daw mokurba lang kini kay nagtuyok ang Kalibutan ilalom sa naglihok nga butang.

q: How much force is one newton (1 N)?
options: The force that gives a 1-kilogram mass an acceleration of 1 m/s²
The force that gives a 10-kilogram mass a speed of 1 m/s
The force needed to lift one liter of water one meter high
The force that stops a 1-kilogram object from moving
explanation: One newton is defined as the force that gives a 1-kilogram mass an acceleration of 1 m/s².
fact_tl: Ang isang newton (1 N) ay ang puwersang nagbibigay ng 1 m/s² na asintada sa isang masa na 1 kilogramo.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka newton (1 N) mao ang puwersa nga naghatag og 1 m/s² nga acceleration sa usa ka kilo nga masa.

q: What happens when a wave changes speed as it passes from one medium into another?
options: It can bend or refract
It stops and bounces back completely
It splits into two separate waves
It becomes louder or brighter
explanation: When a wave passes from one medium into another and changes speed, it can bend or refract — just like light bending as it enters water.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang alon ay dumaan mula sa isang medium patungo sa iba at nagbago ang bilis nito, maaari itong lumiko o mag-refract, tulad ng liwanag na lumiliko kapag pumapasok sa tubig.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka balod moagi gikan sa usa ka medium ngadto sa lain ug mausab ang katulin niini, mahimo kining moliko o mo-refract, sama sa kahayag nga moliko kung mosulod sa tubig.

q: When is an organism described as homozygous for a trait?
options: When its two alleles for that trait are the same
When it inherits the trait from only one parent
When neither allele produces a visible effect
When one allele is dominant and one is recessive
explanation: An organism is homozygous when its two alleles for a trait are the same — for example, both coding for the same eye color.
fact_tl: Ang organismo ay homozygous kapag pareho ang dalawang alelo nito para sa isang katangian.
fact_bis: Ang organismo homozygous kon managsama ang duha niini ka alelo para sa usa ka kinaiya.

q: What makes stainless steel resist rusting?
options: The chromium it contains forms a thin invisible protective layer
The carbon inside it absorbs all moisture from the air
It is coated in a thin layer of zinc during manufacturing
The iron in it has been replaced by a rust-proof metal
explanation: Stainless steel resists rust because it contains chromium, which forms a thin invisible protective layer on the surface that blocks rusting.
fact_tl: Ang stainless steel ay hindi madaling kalawangin dahil may halong metal na chromium ito, na gumagawa ng manipis at hindi nakikitang panangga sa ibabaw na pumipigil sa kalawang.
fact_bis: Ang stainless steel dili dali magtaya kay adunay sagol nga metal nga chromium, nga maghimo og nipis ug dili makita nga panagang sa ibabaw nga mopugong sa taya.

q: How long can it take to form even a thin layer of rich topsoil?
options: Hundreds of years
Just a few weeks after rain
About ten years of plant growth
One growing season
explanation: Soil forms very slowly — it can take hundreds of years just to build a thin layer of rich topsoil.
fact_tl: Napakatagal bago mabuo ang lupa—maaaring umabot ng daan-daang taon para makagawa lang ng manipis na patong ng mayamang topsoil.
fact_bis: Hinay kaayo ang pagporma sa yuta—mahimong moabot og gatusan ka tuig aron makahimo lang og nipis nga sapaw sa dato nga topsoil.

q: What happens to the energy stored in a stretched rubber band when you let it go?
options: It is released as the rubber band snaps back to its original shape
It disappears because the rubber band stops moving
It turns into heat and warms the rubber band
It stays stored inside the rubber band
explanation: When a rubber band is stretched it stores elastic potential energy, and when released it snaps back to its original length and releases that stored energy.
fact_tl: Kapag inunat ang goma, nag-iingat ito ng elastic potential energy; kapag binitawan, nagbabalik ito sa dating haba at nilalabas ang naingat na enerhiya.
fact_bis: Kon inunat ang goma, nagtipig kini og elastic potential energy; kon buhian, nagpabalik sa orihinal nga gitas-on ug nagpalaya sa gitipgang enerhiya.

q: What are two main threats that are damaging coral reefs today?
options: Warming seas and pollution
Strong ocean currents and deep water
Overfishing and shark attacks
Sand and mudslides from the seafloor
explanation: Coral reefs are threatened by warming seas and pollution that damage them.
fact_tl: Nanganganib ang mga coral reef dahil sa pag-init ng dagat at polusyon na nakakasira sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang mga coral reef namiligro tungod sa pag-init sa dagat ug polusyon nga makadaot kanila.

q: Why does oil float on top of water instead of mixing in?
options: Oil is less dense than water
Oil contains no hydrogen atoms
Oil is a solid at room temperature
Oil is repelled by the salt in water
explanation: Oil floats on top of water because it is lighter, or less dense, than water.
fact_tl: Ang langis ay lumulutang sa ibabaw ng tubig dahil mas magaan o mas mababa ang densidad nito kaysa sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lana magalutaw sa ibabaw sa tubig kay mas gaan o mas ubos ang densidad niini kaysa tubig.

q: How do fungi digest their food if they have no mouth or stomach?
options: Their whole body works like a stomach on the outside
They absorb sunlight and turn it into food instead
They swallow food in tiny pieces through their roots
They drink liquid food through straw-like tubes
explanation: Fungi have no mouth or stomach, so instead their whole body works like a stomach on the outside to digest food.
fact_tl: Walang bibig o tiyan ang mga fungi, kaya hindi sila nginunguya o lumululon gaya natin. Sa halip, ang buong katawan nila ang gumagana parang tiyan na nasa labas.
fact_bis: Ang mga fungi walay baba ug walay tiyan, mao nga dili sila makausap o makatulon sama kanato. Hinuon, ang ilang tibuok lawas molihok sama sa tiyan nga naa sa gawas.

q: Which part of the brain controls your balance, coordination, and smooth body movements?
options: The cerebellum
The hypothalamus
The cerebrum
The medulla
explanation: The cerebellum, located at the back of the brain, controls balance, coordination, and smooth body movements.
fact_tl: Ang cerebellum ay matatagpuan sa likod ng utak at kontrolado ang ating balanse, koordinasyon, at makinis na galaw ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang cerebellum nahimutang sa likod sa utak ug nagkontrol sa atong balanse, koordinasyon, ug hapsay nga mga galaw sa lawas.

q: Is baking soda an acid or a base?
options: A base, with a pH of about 9
An acid, with a pH of about 4
Neutral, with a pH of exactly 7
An acid, with a pH of about 2
explanation: Baking soda is basic, with a pH of about 9, which is above the neutral value of 7.
fact_tl: Ang baking soda ay base (basic), na may pH na mga 9.
fact_bis: Ang baking soda base (basic), nga adunay pH nga mga 9.

q: Who is the unit of force called the 'newton' named after?
options: Isaac Newton, the English scientist who studied force and motion
James Watt, who invented the steam engine
Albert Einstein, who developed the theory of relativity
Galileo Galilei, who studied falling objects
explanation: The newton is named after Isaac Newton, the English scientist famous for studying force and motion.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na newton ay ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton, ang Ingles na siyentistang nag-aral ng puwersa at galaw.
fact_bis: Ang yunit nga newton ginganlan kang Isaac Newton, ang Ingles nga siyentista nga nagtuon sa kusog ug lihok.

q: Besides spreading seeds, how else does the giant golden-crowned flying fox help plants?
options: It helps pollinate plants when it feeds on flower nectar
It digs burrows that loosen the soil around plant roots
It eats insects that damage plant leaves
It carries water in its fur to dry forest areas
explanation: The giant golden-crowned flying fox also helps pollinate plants when it feeds on nectar from flowers, in addition to spreading seeds.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pagpapakalat ng mga binhi, ang giant golden-crowned flying fox ay tumutulong din sa pagpapalakad ng mga halaman sa pamamagitan ng pagdaloy ng pollen habang kumakain ng nectar.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagpakaylap sa mga binhi, ang giant golden-crowned flying fox nagtabang usab sa pagpabunga sa mga tanom pinaagi sa pagdala sa pollen samtang mokaon og nectar sa mga bulak.

q: Why does wet iron rust more easily than dry iron?
options: Oxygen dissolved in the water helps the rusting reaction along
Water fills tiny cracks and makes the iron expand
The weight of water presses on iron and breaks it down
Water washes away the iron's protective coating
explanation: Wet iron rusts easily because oxygen dissolved in the water helps the rusting reaction along.
fact_tl: Ang basang bakal ay madaling kumalawang dahil may natunaw na oksiheno sa tubig na tumutulong sa reaksyon.
fact_bis: Ang basa nga puthaw dali mokalawang kay adunay natunaw nga oksiheno sa tubig nga motabang sa reaksiyon.

q: What kind of weather does high, thin cirrus cloud usually indicate?
options: Fair weather
Heavy rain or a typhoon
Thunderstorms
Snow or hail
explanation: High, thin cirrus clouds often mean fair weather, while low gray stratus clouds are more likely to bring drizzle or rain.
fact_tl: Ang taas at hugis ng ulap ay nagbibigay ng pahiwatig sa panahon: ang mataas at manipis na cirrus ay tanda ng magandang panahon, samantalang ang mababa at kulay-abong stratus ay maaaring magdala ng ambon o ulan.
fact_bis: Ang kataas ug porma sa panganod maghatag og timailhan sa panahon: ang taas ug nipis nga cirrus kasagaran nagpasabot og maayong panahon, samtang ang ubos ug abuhon nga stratus mahimong modala og talithi o ulan.

q: Why do some flowers smell like rotting meat?
options: To attract flies that will carry their pollen
To keep large animals from eating them
To trap insects inside and digest them
To warn birds that they are poisonous
explanation: Some flowers smell like rotting meat to attract flies, which then carry the flowers' pollen to other plants.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bulaklak ay umaamoy ng bulok na karne para akitin ang mga langaw na siyang nagdadala ng pollen nito.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bulak baho og dunot nga unod aron danihon ang mga langaw nga maoy magdala sa ilang polen.

q: How did a trilobite protect itself when it sensed danger?
options: It curled up into a ball to protect the soft underside of its body
It buried itself quickly in the seafloor mud
It released ink to confuse predators
It used sharp spines on its back to sting attackers
explanation: When in danger, a trilobite could curl up into a ball to protect the soft underside of its body.
fact_tl: Kapag may nanganganib, kayang pumulupot ng trilobite na parang bola para protektahan ang malambot na ilalim ng katawan nito.
fact_bis: Kung adunay kakuyaw, ang trilobite makahimo sa pagbilot nga morag bola aron mapanalipdan ang humok nga ilawom sa lawas niini.

q: How do fungi reach new dead matter far away from where they are growing?
options: They release tiny spores that drift on the wind
They grow long roots that extend underground to find food
They send out animal helpers to carry them to new spots
They wait for water to wash them to new locations
explanation: Fungi release huge numbers of tiny spores that drift on the wind, and when a spore lands on something wet and rotting, it grows there into a new decomposer.
fact_tl: Paano nakakarating ang fungi sa bagong patay na bagay? Naglalabas sila ng napakaraming spore — parang napakaliliit na buto na hindi nakikita ng mata — na naliliparan ng hangin. Kapag dumapo ang spore sa basa at nabubulok na bagay, doon ito tutubo at magiging bagong decomposer.
fact_bis: Giunsa pag-abot sa fungi sa bag-ong patay nga butang? Mogawas silag daghan kaayong spore — morag gagmay nga liso nga dili makita sa mata — nga gianod sa hangin. Kung motugpa ang spore sa basa ug nadunot nga butang, motubo kini didto isip bag-ong decomposer.

q: How many regions is the Philippines divided into?
explanation: The Philippines is divided into 18 regions in all, covering the whole country from the far north of Luzon down to the far south of Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nahahati sa 18 na rehiyon sa kabuuan. Magkakasama silang sumasaklaw sa buong bansa — mula sa pinakahilaga ng Luzon hanggang sa pinakatimog ng Mindanao. Kapag pinagsama-sama ang lahat ng 18 rehiyon, nabubuo ang buong Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas gibahin sa 18 ka rehiyon sa kinatibuk-an. Hiniusa silang naglangkob sa tibuok nasod — gikan sa amihanan sa Luzon hangtod sa habagatan sa Mindanao. Kon imong tapuson ang tanang 18 ka rehiyon, mamugna ang tibuok Pilipinas.

q: What is pewter mainly made of, and what is it used for?
options: Mainly tin, used for tableware and decorations
Mainly copper, used for electrical wiring
Mainly iron, used for building structures
Mainly aluminum, used for aircraft parts
explanation: Pewter is a soft alloy mainly made of tin and is used for tableware and decorations because it is easy to shape.
fact_tl: Ang pewter ay isang malambot na alloy na pangunahing gawa sa lata at ginagamit sa mga kubyertos at dekorasyon dahil madaling hubugin.
fact_bis: Ang pewter usa ka malambot nga alloy nga panguna gihimo sa lata ug gigamit sa mga kubyertos ug dekorasyong dali mahubog.

q: Where was Philippine independence declared?
options: At the house of General Emilio Aguinaldo in Kawit, Cavite
In the halls of the Malolos Congress in Bulacan
At the Intramuros walls in Manila
On the fields of Calamba, Laguna
explanation: Philippine independence was declared at the house of General Emilio Aguinaldo in Kawit, Cavite.
fact_tl: Idineklara ang kalayaan ng Pilipinas sa bahay ni Heneral Emilio Aguinaldo sa Kawit, Cavite.
fact_bis: Ang kalayaan sa Pilipinas gideklara sa balay ni Heneral Emilio Aguinaldo sa Kawit, Cavite.

q: According to Newton's laws, what happens to an object's acceleration when the net force on it is zero?
options: The acceleration is also zero, so the object stays still or keeps a constant speed
The acceleration doubles because the object has no resistance
The object immediately stops no matter how fast it was moving
The object speeds up slightly due to gravity always acting on it
explanation: Newton's first law is a special case of the second: when force equals zero, acceleration is zero, so the object stays still or keeps a constant speed.
fact_tl: Ang unang batas ni Newton ay isang espesyal na kaso ng ikalawa: kapag zero ang puwersa (F = 0), zero rin ang aselerasyon, kaya nananatiling tigil o pare-pareho ang bilis ng bagay.
fact_bis: Ang unang balaod ni Newton usa ka espesyal nga kaso sa ikaduha: kon zero ang kusog (F = 0), zero usab ang aselerasyon, mao nga magpabilin nga hunong o managsama ang katulin sa butang.

q: Which two fish are most commonly raised in Philippine fish ponds?
options: Bangus and tilapia
Tuna and lapu-lapu
Dilis and galunggong
Maya-maya and tanigue
explanation: Bangus and tilapia are the two most common fish raised in Philippine fish ponds (aquaculture), with Laguna de Bay as one of the largest aquaculture areas.
fact_tl: Ang bangus at tilapia ay ang dalawang pinakasikat na isda na pinalaki sa mga fish pond (aquaculture) sa Pilipinas; ang Laguna de Bay ay isa sa pinakamalaking lugar ng aquaculture sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang bangus ug tilapia mao ang duha ka labing komon nga isda nga gipalaki sa mga fish pond (aquaculture) sa Pilipinas; ang Laguna de Bay usa sa labing dakling lugar sa aquaculture sa nasud.

q: Which type of electromagnetic wave has the longest wavelength?
options: Radio waves
Microwaves
Infrared
X-rays
explanation: From longest to shortest wavelength, the order of the electromagnetic spectrum is: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma — making radio waves the longest.
fact_tl: Mula pinakamahaba hanggang pinakamaikling wavelength, ang ayos ay: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.
fact_bis: Gikan sa pinakataas hangtod pinakamubo nga wavelength, ang han-ay mao: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.

q: Where on the periodic table are metalloids like silicon found?
options: Along the border between metals and nonmetals
In the top row with the lightest elements
In the far right column with the noble gases
In the bottom rows with the heaviest elements
explanation: Metalloids such as silicon lie along the border between metals and nonmetals and have a mix of both kinds of properties.
fact_tl: Ang mga metalloid gaya ng silikon ay matatagpuan sa hangganan ng metal at di-metal at may pinaghalong katangian ng dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang mga metalloid sama sa silicon nahimutang sa utlanan sa metal ug dili-metal ug adunay sinagol nga kabtangan sa duha.

q: Why are endemic animals — those found only in the Philippines — especially important to protect?
options: If they vanish here, there is no other population anywhere on Earth to replace them
They produce medicines that cannot be found in any other country
They are the largest animals in Asia and hard to replace
They help filter the air and water better than any other species
explanation: Endemic animals found only in the Philippines are especially vulnerable because if they disappear here, there is no other population anywhere on Earth to replace them.
fact_tl: Ang mga endemikong hayop — yaong matatagpuan lamang sa Pilipinas at wala nang ibang lugar — ay mas madaling mawala nang tuluyan, dahil kung maubos sila rito, wala nang ibang populasyon sa mundo na makakapalit. Kaya napakahalagang ingatan ang katutubo nating hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga endemikong hayop — kadtong makit-an lamang sa Pilipinas ug wala nay laing dapit — mas dali nga mawala hangtod, kay kung mahurot sila dinhi, wala nay laing populasyon sa kalibotan nga mopuli. Mao nga importante kaayo nga ampingan ang atong kinaiyanhong mga hayop.

q: What happens to the tonsils as a person grows from childhood into adulthood?
options: They slowly shrink as the person grows older
They grow larger to protect against more diseases
They harden and become part of the throat bone
They move deeper inside the throat and disappear
explanation: The tonsils are more active in young children and slowly shrink as a person grows older.
fact_tl: Mas aktibo ang tonsils sa mga bata at unti-unting lumiliit habang tumatanda.
fact_bis: Mas aktibo ang tonsils sa mga bata ug hinay-hinay nga mokunhod samtang motigulang.

q: If an earthquake increases by one step in magnitude, how much more energy is released?
options: About 32 times more
About 2 times more
About 10 times more
About 100 times more
explanation: For each step up of one in magnitude on the Richter scale, about 32 times more energy is released by the earthquake.
fact_tl: Sa bawat dagdag na isang numero sa magnitude, mga 32 na beses na mas malaki ang enerhiyang inilalabas ng lindol.
fact_bis: Sa matag dugang nga usa ka numero sa magnitude, mga 32 ka pilo nga mas dako ang enerhiya nga gibuga sa linog.

q: What do a ladybug's bright red and black spots tell birds?
options: That the ladybug does not taste good to eat
That the ladybug is friendly and safe to touch
That the ladybug can fly very fast and escape
That the ladybug is the same color as poisonous berries
explanation: A ladybug's bright red and black spots warn birds that it does not taste good to eat, protecting it from being eaten.
fact_tl: Ang maliwanag na pula at itim na batik ng ladybug ay babala sa ibon na hindi ito masarap kainin.
fact_bis: Ang hayag nga pula ug itom nga puntik sa ladybug usa ka pasidaan sa langgam nga dili kini lami kan-on.

q: Who made the first vaccine, and what disease did it protect against?
options: Edward Jenner, who made a vaccine against smallpox in 1796
Louis Pasteur, who made a vaccine against rabies in 1796
Alexander Fleming, who made a vaccine against polio in 1796
Marie Curie, who made a vaccine against cholera in 1796
explanation: In 1796, Edward Jenner made the first vaccine against smallpox using cowpox, a milder disease from cows.
fact_tl: Noong 1796, ginawa ng doktor na si Edward Jenner ang unang bakuna laban sa smallpox gamit ang sakit na cowpox mula sa baka.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1796, ang doktor nga si Edward Jenner naghimo sa unang bakuna batok sa smallpox gamit ang cowpox, sakit gikan sa baka.

q: What do sloths mostly eat, even though it gives them very little nourishment?
options: Leaves
Fruit
Insects
Bark
explanation: Most of what a sloth eats is leaves, which have very little nourishment, forcing the sloth to move very slowly to save energy.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa kinakain ng sloth ay mga dahon na kakaunti lang ang sustansya.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa gikaon sa sloth mga dahon nga gamay ra kaayog sustansya.

q: What holds a fish's fins in shape and gives them strength?
options: Thin bones or rays
A layer of scales
Cartilage discs
Muscle fibers only
explanation: A fish's fins are held up by thin bones or rays that give them their shape and strength.
fact_tl: Ang mga palikpik ng isda ay hawak ng maninipis na buto o tinik na nagbibigay-hugis at lakas sa mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga kapay sa isda gisuportahan sa nipis nga bukog o tunok nga naghatag og porma ug kusog niini.

q: Why are buildings given wide foundations?
options: To spread the weight over more soil and lower the pressure so they do not sink
To make the building look bigger from the outside
To allow rainwater to drain away from the walls
To anchor the building against strong winds
explanation: Wide foundations spread a building's great weight over more soil, which lowers the pressure so the building does not sink into the ground.
fact_tl: Ginagawang malapad ang pundasyon ng gusali para ikalat ang malaking bigat nito sa mas malaking lupa, kaya bumababa ang presyon at hindi madaling lumubog sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ginama nga lapad ang patukoranan sa bilding aron ikatag ang dako niini nga gibug-aton sa mas dako nga yuta, mao nga mokunhod ang presyur ug dili dali molubong sa yuta.

q: What is a weather balloon used for?
options: Carrying instruments high into the sky to measure heat, moisture, and wind in the upper air
Dropping rain over dry areas during a drought
Lifting scientists into the stratosphere for research
Reflecting sunlight to warm cold regions
explanation: A weather balloon is a big balloon sent high into the sky carrying small instruments that measure heat, moisture, and wind in the upper air.
fact_tl: Ang weather balloon ay isang malaking lobong pinapalipad pataas sa himpapawid, dala ang maliliit na instrumento na sumusukat sa init, halumigmig, at hangin sa mataas na bahagi ng atmospera.
fact_bis: Ang weather balloon usa ka dakong globo nga ipalupad pataas sa kalangitan, nagdala og gagmayng himan nga magsukod sa kainit, kaumog, ug hangin sa taas nga bahin sa atmospera.

q: What should you do when you sweat a lot to avoid feeling dizzy or weak?
options: Drink water to replace the water your body lost
Eat more salty food to stop sweating
Rest until your skin cools down completely
Breathe faster to bring more oxygen in
explanation: When you sweat a lot your body loses water, so you need to drink water to replace it — otherwise you can feel dizzy or weak from dehydration.
fact_tl: Kapag pumawis ka nang marami, nawawalan ang katawan mo ng tubig. Kaya kailangan mong uminom ng tubig para mapalitan ito — kung hindi, maaari kang mahilo o manghina (dehydration).
fact_bis: Kon daghan kang masingot, mawad-an ang imong lawas og tubig. Mao nga kinahanglan ka moinom og tubig aron mailisan kini — kon dili, mahimo kang malipong o maluya (dehydration).

q: What is the frequency of the lowest note on a piano (A0)?
options: 44 Hz
110 Hz
55 Hz
explanation: The lowest note on a piano, called A0, has a frequency of 27.5 Hz.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamababang nota sa piano (A0) ay may dalas na 27.5 Hz.
fact_bis: Ang pinakaubos nga nota sa piano (A0) adunay frequency nga 27.5 Hz.

q: What do lactic acid bacteria like Lactobacillus produce that gives yogurt its sour taste?
options: Lactic acid
Acetic acid
Carbon dioxide
Alcohol
explanation: Lactic acid bacteria such as Lactobacillus convert sugars into lactic acid, which gives yogurt, sourdough bread, and other fermented foods their sour taste.
fact_tl: Ang lactic acid bacteria tulad ng Lactobacillus ay nagko-convert ng asukal sa lactic acid — ito ang nagbibigay ng maasim na lasa sa yogurt, sourdough bread, at iba pang fermented na pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang lactic acid bacteria sama sa Lactobacillus nagbag-o sa asukal ngadto sa lactic acid — mao kini ang naghatag sa maasim nga lasa sa yogurt, sourdough bread, ug uban pang fermented foods.

q: Why does a hand warmer produce heat when opened?
options: Fine iron inside slowly reacts with oxygen from the air, releasing heat
Water crystals inside absorb cold air and release heat
A chemical battery inside powers a tiny heater
Compressed gas inside expands and warms the surrounding material
explanation: A hand warmer works because fine iron inside slowly reacts with oxygen in an exothermic reaction — like a faster version of rusting — that gives off heat.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang hand warmer dahil ang pinong iron sa loob ay dahan-dahang nag-ru-react sa oxygen ng hangin, isang exothermic na reaksyon na naglalabas ng init. Ito ay parang mabilis na bersyon ng pagkalawang.
fact_bis: Molihok ang hand warmer kay ang pino nga iron sa sulod hinay-hinay nga mo-react sa oxygen sa hangin, usa ka exothermic nga reaksyon nga magpagawas og kainit. Sama kini sa mas paspas nga bersyon sa pagkataya.

q: Which color of the rainbow has the longest wavelength?
options: Red
Violet
Blue
Green
explanation: Among the rainbow colors, red has the longest wavelength.
fact_tl: Sa mga kulay ng bahaghari, ang pula ang may pinakamahabang wavelength.
fact_bis: Sa mga kolor sa balangaw, ang pula ang adunay pinakataas nga wavelength.

q: How does sound travel from a source to our ears?
options: As a vibration through the air that enters the ear
As a beam of light that the ear converts into sound
As a chemical signal released into the air
As heat waves that make the eardrum warm up
explanation: Sound is a vibration that travels through the air and enters the ear so we can hear it.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay isang bibrasyon na naglalakbay sa hangin at pumapasok sa tainga upang marinig natin.
fact_bis: Ang tunog usa ka bibrasyon nga mobiyahe sa hangin ug mosulod sa dalunggan aron atong madungog.

q: How do many plants spread their seeds to grow in new places?
options: Pollen is moved by wind or insects to form seeds that are often protected inside a fruit
The plant releases spores that float directly through the soil
Roots grow outward and produce new plants underground
Leaves fall off and sprout roots when they touch the ground
explanation: In pollination, wind or insects move pollen on a flower, a seed forms — sometimes inside a fruit — and the fruit protects and spreads the seed so a new plant can grow.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng mga buto (seeds). Sa pollination, inililipat ng hangin o insekto (tulad ng bubuyog) ang pollen sa bulaklak. Pagkatapos nito, nabubuo ang buto at minsan ay prutas na nagtatago at nagpapakalat sa buto para tumubo ang bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang mosanay pinaagi sa mga liso (seeds). Sa pollination, ibalhin sa hangin o insekto (sama sa putyokan) ang pollen sa bulak. Human niini, maporma ang liso ug usahay prutas nga manalipod ug mokatag sa liso aron motubo ang bag-ong tanom.

q: What is the national language of the Philippines, and which regional language is it based on?
options: Filipino, based on Tagalog
Tagalog, based on Ilocano
English, based on Spanish
Filipino, based on Cebuano
explanation: The national language of the Philippines is Filipino, which is based on Tagalog.
fact_tl: Ang pambansang wika ng Pilipinas ay ang Filipino, na nakabatay sa Tagalog.
fact_bis: Ang nasudnong pinulongan sa Pilipinas mao ang Filipino, nga gibase sa Tagalog.

q: How do water plants help keep a pond healthy?
options: They provide shade that limits algae growth and add oxygen to the water
They filter out fish waste by trapping it in their roots
They heat the water so harmful bacteria cannot survive
They attract insects that eat the algae directly
explanation: Water plants help a pond by giving shade that keeps too much algae from growing and by adding oxygen to the water.
fact_tl: Ang mga halaman sa tubig ay nakakatulong sa lawa dahil nagbibigay sila ng lilim na pumipigil sa labis na lumot at nagdaragdag ng oxygen sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom sa tubig makatabang sa lawa kay naghatag silag landong nga makapugong sa sobrang lumot ug nagdugang og oxygen sa tubig.

q: How does a lizard warm up when the weather is cold?
options: It lies in the sun because it is cold-blooded and cannot make its own body heat
It shivers rapidly to generate heat from its muscles
It burrows underground where the soil stays warm
It eats more food so digestion warms its body
explanation: Lizards are cold-blooded, so they cannot make their own body heat — instead they warm up by lying in the sun.
fact_tl: Hindi nanginginig ang mga butiki kapag malamig—malamig ang kanilang dugo, kaya nagpapainit sila sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga tiki dili mokurog kung tugnaw—bugnaw silag dugo, mao nga magpapainit sila sa adlaw.

q: How can the ocean be used to make electricity?
options: The rising and falling of tides and the force of big waves can spin a turbine
Seawater is burned in a boiler to produce steam that turns a generator
The salt in seawater conducts electricity directly into power lines
Floating solar panels on the ocean surface collect sunlight
explanation: The rising and falling of tides and the force of big waves can spin a turbine to make electricity, making ocean energy a renewable source.
fact_tl: Puwede ring gawing renewable energy ang lakas ng dagat — ang pagtaas at pagbaba ng tubig (tides) at ang malalaking alon ay may lakas na puwedeng paikutin ng turbine para gumawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang kusog sa dagat mahimo usab nga renewable energy — ang pagsaka ug pagkanaog sa tubig (tides) ug ang dagkong mga balod adunay kusog nga makapatuyok sa turbine aron maghimo ug kuryente.

q: Why is extreme cold dangerous to your skin?
options: Blood vessels narrow so much that blood stops flowing, cutting off oxygen to skin cells and damaging them
Cold temperatures cause skin cells to freeze solid and shatter instantly
The skin's sweat glands overproduce fluid, which damages surrounding tissue
Low temperatures cause a chemical reaction in the skin that destroys nerve endings
explanation: In extreme cold, blood vessels in the skin can narrow so much that almost no blood flows, depriving skin cells of oxygen and causing damage.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang lamig, maaaring sobrang kipot ng mga ugat sa balat kaya halos walang dugong dumadaloy. Kung matagal ito, maaaring mawalan ng oksiheno at masira ang mga selula ng balat — kaya delikado ang sobrang lamig.
fact_bis: Sa sobra nga tugnaw, mahimong mokipot pag-ayo ang mga ugat sa panit maong halos walay dugo nga modagayday. Kung dugay kini, mahimong mahutdan og oksiheno ug madaot ang mga selula sa panit — mao nga delikado ang sobra nga tugnaw.

q: How do feathers keep a bird warm?
options: They trap tiny pockets of air next to the skin that hold in body heat
They reflect sunlight to warm the skin underneath
They produce a special oil that blocks cold air from reaching the skin
They tighten against the skin to form a solid barrier against the wind
explanation: Feathers trap tiny pockets of air next to the skin, and that trapped air keeps heat from escaping.
fact_tl: Ang mga balahibo ay humuhuli ng maliliit na bulsa ng hangin sa tabi ng balat, at ang hanging ito ang pumipigil sa init na makatakas.
fact_bis: Ang mga balhibo modakop og gagmay nga bulsa sa hangin tupad sa panit, ug kini nga hangin maoy mopugong sa kainit nga mogawas.

q: Why do sinkholes and caves often form in limestone areas like Bohol?
options: Water slowly dissolves the limestone rock beneath the ground
Earthquakes crack the rock and the pieces fall into underground gaps
Lava from old volcanoes hollows out the rock from below
Heavy rainfall washes loose soil downward, leaving empty spaces
explanation: Many sinkholes and caves form in limestone areas like Bohol because water slowly dissolves the rock beneath the ground.
fact_tl: Maraming sinkhole at kweba sa mga lugar na batong-apog (limestone) gaya ng Bohol, dahil unti-unting tinutunaw ng tubig ang bato sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Daghang sinkhole ug langub ang maporma sa mga dapit nga apog nga bato (limestone) sama sa Bohol, tungod kay hinay-hinay nga gitunaw sa tubig ang bato sa ilalom sa yuta.

q: What color does sodium (Na) produce in a flame test?
options: Bright yellow
Vivid red
Blue-green
Violet
explanation: In a flame test, sodium gives a bright yellow flame color.
fact_tl: Sa flame test, ang sodium (Na) ay nagbibigay ng maliwanag na DILAW (yellow) na kulay sa apoy.
fact_bis: Sa flame test, ang sodium (Na) mohatag ug hayag nga DALAG (yellow) nga kolor sa kalayo.

q: Which type of DNA mutation involves swapping one letter of the genetic code for a different one?
options: Substitution
Insertion
Deletion
Replication
explanation: A substitution mutation is one where one letter of the DNA code is swapped for another, changing the genetic instruction.
fact_tl: May tatlong simpleng uri ng mutation: ang substitution kung saan napapalitan ang isang letra ng iba, ang insertion kung saan may nadagdag na letra, at ang deletion kung saan may nawalang letra. Iba-iba ang epekto nila, pero pareho silang pagbabago sa code ng DNA.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka yano nga matang sa mutation: ang substitution diin mapulihan ang usa ka letra sa lain, ang insertion diin may madugang nga letra, ug ang deletion diin may mawala nga letra. Lahi-lahi ang ilang epekto, apan parehong kausaban kini sa code sa DNA.

q: Why is it important to remove standing water inside and around your home to prevent dengue?
options: The Aedes mosquito that carries dengue stays close to where it breeds, so most bites happen inside or near your own home
Dengue spreads through tap water, so removing containers stops the disease from reaching drinking supplies
Standing water attracts birds that carry the dengue virus from one neighborhood to another
The dengue virus survives in water and enters the skin directly when people touch it
explanation: The Aedes mosquito does not fly far from where it breeds, so most dengue bites happen right inside or around your own home — which is why removing standing water is so important.
fact_tl: Ang lamok na Aedes na nagdadala ng dengue ay hindi lumilipad nang malayo; nananatili lang ito malapit sa pinanggalingan nito, madalas sa loob o paligid ng bahay. Ibig sabihin, kadalasan ay nakakagat ka mismo sa loob ng inyong tahanan o paaralan. Kaya napakahalaga na panatilihing malinis at walang naipong tubig ang ating mga bahay.
fact_bis: Ang lamok nga Aedes nga magdala ug dengue dili molupad ug layo; magpabilin lang kini duol sa gigikanan niini, kasagaran sa sulod o palibot sa balay. Kini nagpasabot nga kasagaran gipaak ka mismo sa sulod sa inyong balay o eskwelahan. Mao nga importante kaayo nga magpabilin nga hinlo ug walay natipon nga tubig ang atong mga balay.

q: What does the Pinggang Pinoy guide show Filipino families?
options: How to divide one plate into portions for rice, vegetables and fruits, and protein
Which foods have the most vitamins and should be eaten every day
How many glasses of water a person should drink depending on their age
Which traditional Filipino dishes are the healthiest to cook
explanation: Pinggang Pinoy is a DOH-FNRI guide that shows how to divide one plate into a part for rice, a part for vegetables and fruits, and a part for protein.
fact_tl: Ang Pinggang Pinoy ay isang gabay mula sa DOH-FNRI na nagpapakita kung paano hatiin ang isang plato: bahagi para sa kanin, bahagi para sa gulay at prutas, at bahagi para sa protina.
fact_bis: Ang Pinggang Pinoy usa ka giya gikan sa DOH-FNRI nga nagpakita unsaon pagbahin sa usa ka plato: bahin para sa kan-on, bahin para sa utanon ug prutas, ug bahin para sa protina.

q: What happens to silver when it is left exposed to air for a long time?
options: It slowly turns dark and must be polished to bring back its shine
It becomes whiter and more reflective over time
It breaks apart into fine powder and loses its metallic luster
It reacts with water vapor and turns light green like copper
explanation: Silver slowly turns dark when exposed to air, so it must be polished to bring back its shine.
fact_tl: Ang pilak ay unti-unting nangingitim kapag nakalantad sa hangin, kaya kailangan itong linisin para bumalik ang kintab.
fact_bis: Ang plata hinay-hinay nga muitom kon mabutang sa hangin, mao nga kinahanglan kining limpyohan aron mubalik ang kintab.

q: What body part powers the flapping of a bird's wings?
options: Large, strong chest muscles
The spine, which flexes up and down with each stroke
Shoulder blades that lock and spring like levers
Air sacs in the wings that inflate and push down against the air
explanation: Birds have large, strong chest muscles that power the flapping of their wings during flight.
fact_tl: May malalaki at malalakas na kalamnan sa dibdib ang ibon na siyang nagpapakilos sa mga pakpak nito.
fact_bis: Ang langgam adunay dagko ug kusgan nga mga kaunoran sa dughan nga maoy nagpalihok sa iyang mga pako.

q: Why will putting a blind cave fish in the light NOT make its eyes grow back?
options: Losing eyes happened over many generations of evolution, so one fish cannot regrow them just from seeing light
Cave fish have eyes that are covered by skin, so light will peel the skin away and reveal them
Eyes only regrow in young cave fish but not in adults
The fish would need a special vitamin found in sunlight for several weeks before regrowth begins
explanation: Losing eyes in cave fish happened over many, many generations, so a single fish will not regrow eyes just because it is placed in light.
