q: Where are tilapia raised when they are farmed in floating net cages?
options: In a lake
In the open ocean
In a rice paddy
In a river dam
explanation: Some tilapia are raised in floating net cages set in a lake.
fact_tl: Ang ibang tilapia ay inaalagaan sa mga kulungang lambat na nakalutang sa lawa.
fact_bis: Ang uban nga tilapia gialiman sa naglutaw nga mga kulungan nga pukot sa lanaw.

q: How does the cone snail catch prey as fast as a fish?
options: It shoots a harpoon-like tooth that injects venom into its prey
It releases a paralyzing chemical into the water around it
It clamps its shell shut and traps small fish inside
It spins a silk-like sticky thread to entangle passing fish
explanation: The cone snail shoots a harpoon-like tooth at its prey to inject venom and can even catch fast fish this way.
fact_tl: Ang cone snail ay may parang harpon na ngipin na ipinapana nito sa biktima para magturok ng kamandag at hulihin kahit ang mabilis na isda.
fact_bis: Ang cone snail adunay morag harpon nga ngipon nga ipana niini sa biktima aron mag-indyik ug kamandag ug makadakop bisan sa paspas nga isda.

q: In a grassland food chain, what eats the grazers after they have eaten the grass?
options: Predators such as lions
Decomposers such as fungi and bacteria
Other grazers competing for the same food
The grass itself, growing back to reclaim nutrients
explanation: In a grassland, grass is eaten by grazers, and those grazers are then eaten by predators such as lions.
fact_tl: Sa grassland, ang damo ay kinakain ng mga grazer, at ang mga grazer naman ay kinakain ng mga mandaragit tulad ng leon.
fact_bis: Sa grassland, ang damo gikaon sa mga grazer, ug ang mga grazer gikaon usab sa mga manunukob sama sa leon.

q: Why is the banana plant called a giant herb rather than a true tree?
options: Its trunk is made of tightly packed leaves with no hard wood inside
Its stem grows underground, so it is classified as a root vegetable
It dies after producing fruit just once, like an annual herb
It is too short to be called a tree under botanical rules
explanation: The banana is a giant herb because its 'trunk' is made of tightly packed leaves and has no hard wood, unlike a true tree.
fact_tl: Kahit tinatawag nating "puno ng saging," hindi ito tunay na puno — walang matigas na kahoy ang tangkay nito. Ang saging ay isang napakalaking damo, at ang "tangkay" ay mga dahong magkakapatong.
fact_bis: Bisan og tawgon natong "punoan sa saging," dili kini tinuod nga kahoy — walay gahi nga kahoy ang punoan niini. Ang saging usa ka dako kaayo nga sagbot, ug ang "punoan" hinimo sa nag-uban-uban nga mga dahon.

q: How can malunggay leaves be prepared to add their nutrients to bread and soup?
options: They can be dried and ground into a powder
They can be boiled until they dissolve into a clear broth
They can be pressed to extract an oil that is mixed into dough
They can be frozen and then crumbled directly into food
explanation: Malunggay leaves can be dried and ground into a powder that is added to foods like bread and soup.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng malunggay ay maaaring patuyuin at gawing pulbos na idinadagdag sa pagkain tulad ng tinapay at sopas.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa kamunggay mahimong pauga ug himoong pulbos nga idugang sa pagkaon sama sa pan ug sabaw.

q: What is the main sign that a person might have pinworms?
options: An itchy feeling around the bottom, especially at night
A swollen stomach that is painful after eating
Yellowing of the skin and eyes due to liver irritation
Frequent headaches and blurry vision
explanation: The pinworm is a small white worm that makes the bottom itchy, especially at night.
fact_tl: Ang pinworm ay maliit na puting bulate na nagdudulot ng makating puwet, lalo na sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang pinworm kay gamay nga puti nga bulate nga maoy hinungdan sa katol sa lubot, ilabi na sa gabii.

q: What is one reason natural rubber from the rubber tree is still used even though synthetic rubber exists?
options: Natural rubber is softer and bouncier than synthetic rubber
Natural rubber is cheaper to produce than factory-made rubber
Natural rubber does not melt in heat while synthetic rubber does
Natural rubber can be recycled endlessly unlike synthetic rubber
explanation: Natural rubber is softer and bouncier than synthetic rubber, which is why it is still used even though a man-made version exists.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng goma: natural na galing sa rubber tree, at synthetic na gawa sa pabrika mula sa petrolyo. Mas malambot at nakaka-bounce ang natural na goma, kaya ginagamit pa rin ito kahit may artipisyal na.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka klase sa goma: natural gikan sa rubber tree, ug synthetic nga hinimo sa pabrika gikan sa petrolyo. Mas humok ug mabouncing ang natural nga goma, mao nga gigamit gihapon kini bisan adunay artipisyal.

q: Which element was discovered on the Sun before it was ever found on Earth?
options: Helium
Hydrogen
Oxygen
Carbon
explanation: Helium was the first element discovered on the Sun (in 1868) before it was found on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang helium ang unang elementong natuklasan sa Araw bago pa ito nakita sa Earth, noong 1868.
fact_bis: Ang helium mao ang unang elemento nga nadiskobrehan sa Adlaw una pa kini makita sa Yuta, niadtong 1868.

q: Why do stars appear to twinkle when we look at them from Earth?
options: Their light passes through Earth's moving air, which bends the light slightly
Stars actually pulse and dim repeatedly as part of their natural cycle
The spinning of the Earth causes their light to flicker as they move
Water vapor in the atmosphere reflects star light back into space unevenly
explanation: Stars appear to twinkle because their light passes through Earth's moving air, which bends and shifts the light.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin ay parang kumikislap dahil ang kanilang liwanag ay dumadaan sa gumagalaw na hangin ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon morag nagpangidlap tungod kay ang ilang kahayag moagi sa naglihok nga hangin sa Yuta.

q: After someone gets a burn, why should rings or tight clothing near the burned area be removed right away?
options: To remove them before the area starts to swell and makes removal difficult
To prevent the metal in jewelry from conducting heat deeper into the skin
To allow the burn to be cooled with water without getting the items wet
To let a doctor see the full size of the burn wound clearly
explanation: After a burn, rings or tight clothing near the area should be gently removed before it starts to swell.
fact_tl: Pagkapaso, alisin agad ang singsing o masikip na damit malapit sa sugat bago pa ito mamaga.
fact_bis: Human mapaso, kuhaa dayon ang singsing o hugot nga sinina duol sa samad sa dili pa kini mohubag.

q: What kind of kiln is used to fire burnay jars?
options: A long, sloped kiln heated by wood
A round, flat kiln heated by charcoal
A small, upright kiln heated by gas
A covered pit kiln heated by coal
explanation: Burnay jars are fired in a long, sloped kiln heated by wood, and many jars are cooked together inside until they all become hard.
fact_tl: Ang burnay ay hinuhurno sa isang mahaba at nakatagilid na hurno na pinaiinit ng kahoy. Maraming banga ang sabay-sabay na naluluto rito hanggang tumigas ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang burnay giluto sa usa ka taas ug nahiling nga hudno nga gipainit sa kahoy. Daghang banga ang dungan nga maluto sa sulod niini hangtod motig-a silang tanan.

q: Why does COVID-19 have its own vaccine separate from the flu vaccine?
options: Because COVID-19 and the flu are caused by different viruses
Because COVID-19 only affects children, not adults
Because the flu vaccine makes COVID-19 symptoms worse
Because both diseases are caused by the same virus but in different seasons
explanation: COVID-19 and the flu are caused by different viruses, so each needs its own separate vaccine.
fact_tl: Parehong sanhi ng virus ang COVID-19 at trangkaso (flu), at parehong may lagnat at ubo. Pero magkaibang virus ang sanhi ng dalawa, at ang COVID-19 ay mas mabilis kumalat at maaaring mas malala lalo na sa matatanda. Kaya may sariling bakuna ang COVID-19 na iba sa bakuna sa trangkaso.
fact_bis: Parehong gumikan sa virus ang COVID-19 ug trangkaso (flu), ug parehong adunay hilanat ug ubo. Apan lahi nga virus ang hinungdan sa duha, ug ang COVID-19 mas paspas mokatap ug mahimong mas grabe ilabina sa mga tigulang. Mao nga adunay kaugalingong bakuna ang COVID-19 nga lahi sa bakuna sa trangkaso.

q: What does the trachea divide into when air enters the lungs?
options: Two bronchi, one for each lung
Two alveoli, one for each lung
Four bronchioles, two for each lung
Two air sacs connected to the heart
explanation: The trachea divides into two bronchi, one for each lung, which then branch into smaller bronchioles that carry air to the alveoli.
fact_tl: Ang trachea ay nahati sa dalawang bronchi na pumupunta sa bawat baga, at ang mga ito ay nagba-branch pa sa mga bronchioles na nagdadala ng hangin sa alveoli.
fact_bis: Ang trachea nabahin sa duha ka bronchi, usa alang sa matag baga, nga nagbranch pa ngadto sa mga bronchioles nga nagdala sa hangin sa mga alveoli.

q: How does a marine protected area (MPA) help fishermen even though fishing is banned inside it?
options: Fish increase around its edges and tourists come, boosting fishermen's income
It provides free fishing equipment to nearby communities
It removes harmful algae so fish become bigger and easier to catch
It blocks foreign fishing boats from entering Philippine waters
explanation: Even though fishing is banned inside, a marine protected area helps fishermen because fish increase around it and it brings in tourists.
fact_tl: Sa kabila ng bawal mangisda sa loob, nakatutulong ang marine protected area sa mga mangingisda dahil dumarami ang isda sa paligid at nagdadala ito ng turista.
fact_bis: Bisan og gidili ang pangisda sa sulod, ang marine protected area makatabang sa mga mananagat kay modaghan ang isda sa palibot ug magdala kini og mga turista.

q: Which aircraft was the first jet-powered plane to fly?
options: The German Heinkel He 178
The American Boeing B-17
The British Spitfire Mk I
The Japanese Mitsubishi Zero
explanation: The German Heinkel He 178 was the first jet aircraft to fly.
fact_tl: Ang Heinkel He 178 ng Alemanya ang unang jet aircraft na lumipad.
fact_bis: Ang German nga Heinkel He 178 mao ang unang jet aircraft nga milupad.

q: Why do plant roots grow downward into the soil?
options: Because water and nutrients the plant needs are found there
Because sunlight is stronger deeper in the ground
Because the soil is cooler underground and slows root growth
Because roots need to anchor the plant to the surface only
explanation: Roots grow downward into the soil where the water and nutrients the plant needs are found.
fact_tl: Ang ugat ay lumalaki pababa patungo sa lupa kung saan naroon ang tubig at sustansya na kailangan ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang gamot motubo paubos ngadto sa yuta diin makit-an ang tubig ug sustansya nga gikinahanglan sa tanom.

q: Why is it unsafe to casually touch certain kinds of pufferfish?
options: Because the poison can also be found on their skin
Because they have sharp spines that inject venom when touched
Because their skin releases an ink that stings eyes
Because they bite with powerful jaws when picked up
explanation: In some kinds of pufferfish, the poison is also on the skin, not just inside the body, making casual touch unsafe.
fact_tl: Sa ilang uri ng butete, may lason din sa balat nito, hindi lang sa loob ng katawan. Kaya hindi rin ligtas na basta-basta hawakan ang ganitong isda.
fact_bis: Sa ubang klase sa butete, adunay hilo usab sa panit niini, dili lang sa sulod sa lawas. Mao nga dili usab luwas nga basta-basta hikapon kini nga isda.

q: Why are pot handles usually made of wood or plastic instead of metal?
options: Wood and plastic are heat insulators that keep your hand from getting hot
Wood and plastic conduct heat faster so the pot heats up more evenly
Metal handles are too heavy, so lighter materials are used instead
Wood and plastic expand with heat so they grip the pot more tightly
explanation: Wood and plastic are heat insulators that let heat flow slowly, so they keep your hand from getting hot when you hold the pot.
fact_tl: Ang heat conductors (tulad ng metal) ay mabilis magpadaloy ng init; ang heat insulators (tulad ng kahoy, plastik, at tela) ay mabagal. Kaya kahoy o plastik ang hawakan ng kaserola — para hindi mainit ang kamay.
fact_bis: Ang heat conductors (sama sa metal) paspas magpadala og kainit; ang heat insulators (sama sa kahoy, plastik, ug panapton) hinay. Mao nga kahoy o plastik ang kuptanan sa kaldero — aron dili mainit ang kamot.

q: What is the main role of the termite queen in the colony?
options: She lays huge numbers of eggs to grow the colony
She leads worker termites to find food sources
She builds the mound walls with her strong mandibles
She protects the colony by fighting off predators
explanation: The termite queen lays huge numbers of eggs, which is how the colony grows.
fact_tl: Ang reyna ng anay ay nangingitlog ng napakaraming itlog para palakihin ang kolonya.
fact_bis: Ang reyna sa anay mangitlog ug daghan kaayo nga itlog aron padaghanon ang kolonya.

q: How does a viper typically hunt its prey?
options: It stays coiled and waits quietly, then strikes suddenly with long fangs to inject venom
It chases prey at high speed across open ground
It constricts its prey by wrapping its body tightly around it
It spits venom from a distance to blind and stun its prey
explanation: The viper is a venomous snake that often stays coiled and waits quietly, then strikes suddenly with long fangs to inject its venom.
fact_tl: Ang viper ay isang ahas na may kamandag na kadalasang nakapulupot at tahimik na naghihintay, pagkatapos ay biglang sumusugod gamit ang mahahabang pangil para tumusok.
fact_bis: Ang viper usa ka halas nga may hilo nga kasagaran nagliko-liko ug hilom nga naghulat, dayon kalit nga moigo gamit ang taas nga mga tango aron motusok og hilo.

q: How does a cricket make its chirping sound?
options: By rubbing one wing against the other
By vibrating a special membrane on its abdomen
By clicking its back legs together rapidly
By pushing air through tiny holes in its thorax
explanation: A cricket makes its chirp by rubbing one wing against the other, like running a fingernail over the teeth of a comb.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig ay gumagawa ng huni hindi sa pamamagitan ng bibig kundi sa paghagod ng isang pakpak sa kabila, na parang paghagod sa ngipin ng suklay.
fact_bis: Ang kagiw mohimo sa iyang huni dili pinaagi sa baba kondili pinaagi sa paghagod sa usa ka pako sa pikas, sama sa paghagod sa ngipon sa sudlay.

q: What actually vibrates to make sound in a flute or trumpet?
options: The air column inside the tube
The metal or wood walls of the instrument
The player's lips directly against the mouthpiece
The valves or keys that open and close the holes
explanation: In a flute or trumpet, it is the air inside the tube that vibrates; a longer air path gives a lower pitch.
fact_tl: Sa plawta at trumpeta, ang nayayanig ay ang hanging nasa loob ng tubo; mas mahaba ang haba ng dinaraanan ng hangin, mas mababa ang tono kaya kung tatakpan ang mga butas, nababago ang nota.
fact_bis: Sa plawta ug trumpeta, ang nagkurog mao ang hangin sa sulod sa tubo; mas taas ang agianan sa hangin, mas ubos ang tono, mao nga ang pagtabon sa mga lungag mag-usab sa nota.

q: What two things does yeast produce when it eats sugar during fermentation?
options: Carbon-dioxide gas and a little alcohol
Oxygen gas and water
Nitrogen gas and sugar crystals
Hydrogen gas and a little acid
explanation: When yeast eats sugar, it breaks it apart inside its cell and produces carbon-dioxide gas plus a little alcohol — a process called fermentation.
fact_tl: Ito ang paraan kung paano gumagana ang yeast: kapag kumakain ito ng asukal, hinahati nito ang asukal sa loob ng selula nito at nililikha ang carbon-dioxide na gas at kaunting alcohol. Tinatawag itong fermentation.
fact_bis: Mao kini ang pamaagi sa pagtrabaho sa yeast: kung mokaon kini og asukal, bahinon niini ang asukal sulod sa selula niini ug maghimo og carbon-dioxide nga gas ug gamayng alkohol. Kini gitawag og fermentation.

q: According to Newton's third law, why does a swimmer move forward?
options: The swimmer pushes the water backward, and the water pushes the swimmer forward
The swimmer reduces water resistance by keeping their body flat
The swimmer pulls their arms through the water to drag themselves forward
The swimmer's legs push down on the water to lift the body upward
explanation: While swimming, you push the water backward with your hands, and the water pushes you forward — an action-reaction pair.
fact_tl: Habang lumalangoy, itinutulak mo ang tubig pabalik gamit ang iyong mga kamay, at itinutulak ka ng tubig pasulong.
fact_bis: Samtang molangoy, giduso nimo ang tubig pabalik gamit ang imong mga kamot, ug giduso ka sa tubig paabante.

q: Even though air is invisible, what physical properties do its gases have?
options: Mass and weight, so air is real matter that presses on us
Only volume, because gases have no measurable mass
Color and texture that become visible under a microscope
Temperature only, because cold air sinks and warm air rises
explanation: Even though they are invisible, the gases in air have mass and weight, so air is real matter that presses on us.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi nakikita, ang mga gas sa hangin ay may mass at bigat, kaya ang hangin ay isang totoong sangkap (matter) na nakadidiin sa atin.
fact_bis: Bisan dili makita, ang mga gas sa hangin adunay mass ug gibug-aton, busa ang hangin tinuod nga butang (matter) nga nagduot kanato.

q: Which part of a typhoon contains the calmest weather?
options: The eye at the center
The eyewall surrounding the center
The spiral rainbands on the outer edge
The storm surge at sea level
explanation: A typhoon is made of three main parts: the calm eye at the center, the eyewall with the strongest winds, and the spiral rainbands that carry rain around the outside.
fact_tl: Binubuo ang isang bagyo ng tatlong pangunahing bahagi: ang tahimik na mata sa gitna, ang eyewall na may pinakamalakas na hangin, at ang mga spiral rainband na nagdadala ng ulan sa palibot.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka bagyo gilangkoban sa tulo ka nag-unang bahin: ang malinawon nga mata sa tunga, ang eyewall nga adunay labing kusog nga hangin, ug ang mga spiral rainband nga nagdala sa ulan sa palibot.

q: How long does it take the Sun to complete one full orbit around the center of the Milky Way?
options: About 230 million years
About 365 days
About 26,000 years
About 1 billion years
explanation: The Sun orbits the center of the Milky Way, and one complete orbit takes about 230 million years — called a galactic year or cosmic year.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay nag-o-orbit sa sentro ng Milky Way; ang isang buong orbit ay tumatagal ng humigit-kumulang 230 milyong taon — tinatawag na isang galactic year o cosmic year.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw nag-orbit sa sentro sa Milky Way; ang usa ka kompleto nga orbit mokabat og mga 230 milyong tuig — ginganlan og galactic year o cosmic year.

q: What happens when you cover a candle flame with a jar?
options: The fire goes out because the oxygen is cut off
The fire burns brighter because heat builds up inside the jar
The fire changes color because it uses up the fuel faster
The fire spreads along the jar's surface toward more air
explanation: Combustion needs fuel, oxygen, and heat; covering the flame cuts off oxygen, so the fire goes out.
fact_tl: Ang combustion (pagsusunog) ay isang chemical reaction na nangangailangan ng tatlong bagay (fire triangle): gatong (fuel), oxygen, at init. Alisin ang isa — halimbawa, takpan ang apoy para mawala ang oxygen — at mamamatay ang apoy.
fact_bis: Ang combustion (pagsunog) usa ka chemical reaction nga nagkinahanglan og tulo ka butang (fire triangle): sugnod (fuel), oxygen, ug kainit. Kuhaa ang usa — pananglitan, taboni ang kalayo aron mawala ang oxygen — ug mapalong ang kalayo.

q: What material makes up the rigid cell wall of plant cells?
options: Cellulose
Chitin
Keratin
Collagen
explanation: Plant cells have a rigid cell wall made of cellulose, which provides structure and prevents the cell from bursting when it swells with water.
fact_tl: Ang mga selula ng halaman ay may matibay na cell wall na gawa sa cellulose—ito ang nagbibigay sa halaman ng istraktura at nagpipigil sa selula na pumutok kahit nagswell ito ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga selula sa tanum adunay matibay nga cell wall nga gawa sa cellulose; kini naghatag sa istruktura ug nagpigil sa selula nga mopahak bisan kung mopadako kini sa tubig tungod sa turgor pressure.

q: What is a grasshopper's newly exposed skin like right after it molts?
options: Soft and pale, and weak for a few hours until it hardens
Hard and brightly colored immediately after molting
Sticky and rough so the grasshopper can cling to plants
Dry and brittle, and it must be shed again within minutes
explanation: Right after molting, a grasshopper's new skin is soft and pale, and it is weak for a few hours until the new skin hardens and gets its proper color.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos magpalit ng balat, malambot at maputla muna ang bagong balat ng tipaklong. Mahina ito sa ilang oras hanggang tumigas at kumulay nang husto ang bago nitong balat.
fact_bis: Human mag-molt, ang bag-ong panit sa apan humok ug luspad. Maluya kini sulod sa pipila ka oras hangtod mogahi ug makuha ang husto nga kolor sa bag-ong panit.

q: Which body part do we use to sense smells?
options: The nose
The tongue
The skin
The ears
explanation: The nose is the body part we use to smell things.
fact_tl: Ang ilong ang bahagi ng katawan na ginagamit natin para umamoy.
fact_bis: Ang ilong mao ang bahin sa lawas nga gamiton nato sa pagpanimaho.

q: What do Adopt-a-Reef programmes allow communities and students to do?
options: Take responsibility for caring for and monitoring a section of coral reef
Harvest coral to sell for souvenirs and aquariums
Build artificial reefs using concrete blocks in the open ocean
Catch and relocate fish away from damaged reef areas
explanation: Adopt-a-Reef programmes allow communities, companies, and students to take responsibility for caring for and monitoring a section of coral reef.
fact_tl: Ang mga programang 'Adopt-a-Reef' ay nagpapahintulot sa mga komunidad, kumpanya, at estudyante na maging responsable sa pag-alagaan at pag-monitor ng isang bahagi ng coral reef.
fact_bis: Ang mga programang 'Adopt-a-Reef' nagtugot sa mga komunidad, kumpanya, ug estudyante sa pagtanggap sa responsibilidad sa pag-atiman ug pag-monitor sa usa ka bahin sa coral reef.

q: How long ago did jellyfish first appear on Earth?
options: More than five hundred million years ago
About sixty-five million years ago
About two hundred million years ago
About one billion years ago
explanation: The jellyfish is one of the oldest animals on Earth — it lived in the sea even before the dinosaurs, more than five hundred million years ago.
fact_tl: Ang dikya ay isa sa pinakamatandang hayop sa Mundo — nabubuhay na ito sa dagat bago pa man dumating ang mga dinosaur, mahigit limang daang milyong taon na ang nakalilipas.
fact_bis: Ang dikya usa sa labing karaang mananap sa Kalibutan — nabuhi na kini sa dagat sa wala pa moabot ang mga dinosaur, kapin sa lima ka gatos ka milyon ka tuig ang milabay.

q: Which of the following is one of the four cardinal directions?
options: South
Northeast
Southwest
Southeast
explanation: The four cardinal directions are North, South, East, and West; diagonal directions like Northeast are not cardinal directions.
fact_tl: Ang apat na pangunahing direksyon (cardinal directions) ay Hilaga (North), Timog (South), Silangan (East), at Kanluran (West).
fact_bis: Ang upat ka nag-unang direksyon mao ang Amihanan (North), Habagatan (South), Sidlakan (East), ug Kasadpan (West).

q: Why does every sip of samalamig taste equally sweet?
options: Because the sugar dissolves and spreads evenly through the water
Because sugar sinks to the bottom so later sips are sweeter
Because the fruit flavoring makes all the sugar float to the top
Because stirring the drink breaks sugar molecules into smaller pieces
explanation: In samalamig, the sugar dissolves and spreads evenly through the water, so every sip is equally sweet.
fact_tl: Sa samalamig, ang asukal ay natutunaw at kumakalat sa buong tubig, kaya pantay-pantay ang tamis ng bawat lagok.
fact_bis: Sa samalamig, ang asukal matunaw ug mokatag sa tibuok tubig, mao nga managsama ang katam-is sa matag higop.

q: When are cockroaches most active, and what do they do when a light is turned on?
options: They are most active at night and quickly run to their hiding place when a light is turned on
They are most active at midday and freeze in place when a light is turned on
They are equally active day and night but avoid brightly colored surfaces
They are most active in the morning and emit a chemical warning when a light is turned on
explanation: A cockroach is most active at night coming out to look for food; when you turn on a light, it quickly runs back to its hiding place.
fact_tl: Mas aktibo ang ipis kapag gabi at gumagala ito para maghanap ng pagkain; kapag binuksan mo ang ilaw, mabilis itong tumatakbo pabalik sa tago nito.
fact_bis: Mas aktibo ang ipis kon gabii ug mogawas kini aron mangita og pagkaon; kon dagkutan nimo ang suga, paspas kini modagan balik sa iyang gitagoan.

q: Why can an octopus arm move and react partly on its own?
options: Because each arm has many nerves of its own
Because the arms share one large brain located in the mantle
Because suckers on the arms sense light and react to it
Because the arms are controlled by a nerve ring in each sucker
explanation: Each octopus arm has many nerves, so an arm can move and act partly on its own.
fact_tl: Marami ang nerbiyo sa bawat braso ng pugita, kaya kayang kumilos ng braso kahit hindi pa ito inuutusan ng utak.
fact_bis: Ang matag bukton sa kugita adunay daghang ugat, mao nga makalihok ang bukton bisan walay sugo sa utok.

q: How diluted can blood be in water and still be detected by a shark?
options: One part per million
One part per hundred
One part per thousand
One part per billion
explanation: Sharks can detect blood diluted to one part per million in water, meaning they can smell trace amounts of blood from considerable distances.
fact_tl: Ang mga pating ay may napakahusay na pang-amoy — kayang makilala nila ang dugo sa tubig kahit isang parte lamang sa milyong parte ng tubig — malayo ito sa katotohaan na 'matutukoy ito sa isang basong tubig', ngunit lubhang sensitibo pa rin.
fact_bis: Ang mga pating adunay napaka-sensitibong pandamgo ug makakita sa dugo nga diluted hangtod sa usa ka parte sa usa ka milyon sa tubig — nagpasabot nga makaamgo sila og gamay nga dugo gikan sa daghang distansya.

q: Why do people often shiver after getting out of the water, even when it is not very cold?
options: Wet skin loses heat quickly as water evaporates, so the body shivers to warm up
The water pressure on the body reduces blood flow and triggers shivering
Shivering is a reflex that helps dry the skin by vibrating water droplets off
Cold water temporarily lowers blood pressure, causing muscle spasms
explanation: After swimming, wet skin loses heat quickly as water evaporates, so the body warms you up by shivering.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos lumangoy o maligo, madalas kang nanginginig kahit hindi naman ganoon kalamig. Dahil ito sa basang balat na mabilis nawawalan ng init habang sumisingaw ang tubig, kaya pinapainit ka ng katawan sa pamamagitan ng nginig.
fact_bis: Human maglangoy o maligo, sagad mokurog ka bisan dili kaayo bugnaw. Tungod kini sa basa nga panit nga paspas mawad-an og kainit samtang mosingaw ang tubig, mao nga painiton ka sa lawas pinaagi sa kurog.

q: Which tuna species are the main ones found in Philippine waters?
options: Yellowfin, bigeye, and skipjack tuna
Bluefin, albacore, and bonito tuna
Bigeye, albacore, and Atlantic bluefin tuna
Skipjack, Pacific bluefin, and frigate tuna
explanation: The main tuna species in Philippine waters are yellowfin, bigeye, and skipjack tuna, which are important to the Philippine fishing industry and diet.
fact_tl: Ang mga pangunahing species ng tuna sa mga karagatan ng Pilipinas ay ang yellowfin tuna, bigeye tuna, at skipjack tuna — ang mga ito ay mahahalagang bahagi ng industriya ng pangingisda ng Pilipinas at karne ng isda.
fact_bis: Ang mga nag-unang species sa tuna sa mga tubig sa Pilipinas mao ang yellowfin, bigeye, ug skipjack tuna — kini mga mahinungdanon nga bahin sa industriya sa pangisda sa Pilipinas ug pagkaon.

q: What happens when antibiotics are misused, such as not finishing the full course?
options: Surviving bacteria multiply and become resistant through natural selection
All bacteria are killed immediately, but new bacteria arrive from the environment
The antibiotics become toxic and harm the patient instead of the bacteria
The bacteria become viruses that can no longer be treated with any medicine
explanation: When antibiotics are misused, the surviving bacteria multiply and become resistant — an example of natural selection happening now.
fact_tl: Kapag iniinom nang mali ang antibiotiko, ang mga bakteryang nakaligtas ay nagpaparami at nagiging resistant, isang halimbawa ng natural na seleksyon.
fact_bis: Kung sayop ang paggamit sa antibiotiko, ang mga bakterya nga nabuhi mosanay ug mahimong resistant, usa ka pananglitan sa kinaiyanhong pagpili.

q: What is the main job of your skin?
options: To act as a barrier that protects the inside of the body from germs and injury
To produce the blood cells that fight disease inside the body
To absorb oxygen from the air so the lungs do not have to work as hard
To regulate body temperature by controlling how fast the heart beats
explanation: The skin acts like a barrier that protects the inside of the body from germs and injury.
fact_tl: Ang balat ay parang harang na nagpoprotekta sa loob ng katawan laban sa mikrobyo at pinsala.
fact_bis: Ang panit sama sa usa ka harang nga manalipod sa sulod sa lawas batok sa mikrobyo ug kadaot.

q: What happens to palay at the rice mill?
options: The husk is removed to turn it into white bigas
The palay is soaked in water to soften it before cooking
The grains are polished with oil to give them a shiny appearance
The stalks are crushed to separate the rice grains from the soil
explanation: At the rice mill, palay is milled to remove the husk and turn it into white bigas.
fact_tl: Sa kiskisan, ang palay ay ginigiling upang matanggal ang ipa at maging puting bigas.
fact_bis: Sa galingan, ang humay galingon aron makuha ang upa ug mahimong puti nga bugas.

q: Why is fermented food kept cool after fermentation is complete?
options: Keeping it cool slows the changes caused by microbes so the food lasts longer
Keeping it cool reactivates the yeast so the flavor improves over time
Keeping it cool prevents ice crystals from destroying the fermentation products
Keeping it cool is required for the fermentation process to start properly
explanation: Once fermented food is done, keeping it cool slows microbial activity so the food lasts even longer.
fact_tl: Ang init ng paligid ay nakakaapekto sa fermentation: sa maligamgam na init mas mabilis kumilos ang mikrobyo, at kapag malamig na itinago ang natapos na pagkain, bumabagal ang pagbabago kaya mas tumatagal ito.
fact_bis: Ang kainit sa palibot makaapekto sa fermentation: sa init-init nga kahimtang mas paspas molihok ang mikrobyo, ug kung tipigan og bugnaw ang nahuman nga pagkaon, mohinay ang pagbag-o busa mas molungtad kini.

q: What is true about astigmatism and wearing glasses?
options: Glasses help vision feel more comfortable and clear, and wearing them does not make astigmatism worse
Wearing glasses too early causes the eyes to depend on them and worsens astigmatism
Astigmatism always leads to blindness if it is not treated with surgery
Glasses weaken the eye muscles over time, making natural vision permanently blurry
explanation: Astigmatism does not get worse from wearing glasses — in fact, glasses help your vision feel more comfortable and clear.
fact_tl: Hindi ka nabubulag sa astigmatism. Hindi rin ito lumalala dahil sa pagsusuot ng salamin — sa katunayan, tumutulong ang salamin para mas komportable at malinaw ang paningin mo.
fact_bis: Dili ka mabuta tungod sa astigmatism. Dili usab kini mosamot tungod sa pagsul-ob og antiyohos — sa pagkatinuod, ang antiyohos motabang aron mas komportable ug klaro ang imong panan-aw.

q: How long is one year on Mercury compared to Earth?
options: Only 88 Earth days
About 365 Earth days
About 687 Earth days
About 29 Earth days
explanation: Mercury races around the Sun faster than any other planet, finishing a whole year in just 88 Earth days.
fact_tl: Ang Mercury ay umiikot sa Araw nang mas mabilis kaysa ibang planeta, tinatapos ang isang buong taon sa loob lamang ng 88 araw sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Mercury molibot sa Adlaw nga mas paspas kaysa ubang planeta, nahuman ang usa ka tuig sa 88 lang ka adlaw sa Yuta.

q: Why does a plant wilt when it does not get enough water?
options: Water loss causes turgor pressure inside the cells to drop, making the cells go limp
The roots stop absorbing nutrients, causing the leaves to turn yellow and fold
The stem loses its cellulose structure and can no longer hold the leaves upright
Lack of water slows photosynthesis so the plant does not produce enough sugar to stay rigid
explanation: Turgor pressure is the pressure of water inside plant cells pushing against the cell wall; when water is lost, turgor pressure drops and the plant wilts.
fact_tl: Ang turgor pressure ay ang presyon ng tubig sa loob ng selula ng halaman laban sa cell wall—kapag sapat ang tubig, ang selula ay nananatiling matigas; kapag kulang, bumababa ang pressure at nalalanta ang halaman.
fact_bis: Ang turgor pressure mao ang presyon sa tubig sa sulod sa selula sa tanum batok sa cell wall; kung igo ang tubig, matig-a ang mga selula; kung mawala ang tubig, mobaba ang presyon ug malanta ang tanum.

q: Where is Taal Volcano located?
options: Inside Taal Lake in Batangas
Inside Laguna de Bay in Laguna
On the coast of Cavite near Manila Bay
On top of Mount Mayon in Albay
explanation: Taal Volcano sits inside a large lake called Taal Lake in Batangas.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Taal ay nasa loob ng isang malaking lawa na tinatawag na Lawa ng Taal sa Batangas.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkang Taal naa sa sulod sa usa ka dako nga lanaw nga gitawag og Lanaw sa Taal sa Batangas.

q: Where do Philippine frogs usually lay their eggs?
options: In ponds and rice paddies
On dry land under fallen leaves
Inside hollow tree trunks
In underground burrows near rivers
explanation: In the Philippines, frogs often lay their eggs in ponds and rice paddies, where the eggs become tadpoles and grow into frogs.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas mangitlog ang palaka sa mga lawa at palayan, at doon din nagiging tadpole at lumalaki bilang palaka.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kasagaran mangitlog ang baki sa mga linaw ug basakan, ug didto usab kini mahimong tadpole ug modako nga baki.

q: How does the giant flying fox find fruiting trees at night, unlike small insect-eating bats?
options: It uses its eyes rather than echolocation
It uses echolocation at a frequency too low for humans to hear
It follows the scent trails left by other bats to fruiting trees
It uses the Earth's magnetic field to navigate toward fruit
explanation: Unlike small insect-eating bats, the giant flying fox uses its eyes to locate fruiting trees at night, not echolocation.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng maliliit na insektibore na paniki, ang giant flying fox ay gumagamit ng mga mata para mahanap ang mga puno ng prutas sa gabi, hindi echolocation.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa gagmayng insektibore nga paniki, ang giant flying fox mogamit sa iyang mga mata sa pagpangita sa mga prutas nga kahoy sa gabii, dili echolocation.

q: Why is it important to see a doctor early when a child shows signs of pneumonia?
options: Early treatment keeps pneumonia from getting worse and helps the child recover faster
Waiting a few days lets the immune system fight it naturally without side effects
Early treatment is only important for adults; children usually recover on their own
Seeing a doctor early prevents the pneumonia from spreading to other organs permanently
explanation: Seeing a doctor early helps keep pneumonia from getting worse and helps the child recover faster.
fact_tl: Ang maagang pagpapatingin sa doktor ay nakakatulong para hindi lumala ang pulmonya at mas madaling gumaling ang bata.
fact_bis: Ang sayo nga pagpakonsulta sa doktor makatabang aron dili mograbe ang pulmonya ug mas dali maulian ang bata.

q: What kind of plant does the carabao mango grow on?
options: A large, tall mango tree that can live for many years and bear fruit year after year
A short, bushy shrub that needs to be replanted every two to three years
A climbing vine that attaches to other trees for support
A small potted tree that only bears fruit in its first two years
explanation: The carabao mango grows on a large, tall mango tree that can live for many years and bear fruit year after year.
fact_tl: Ang carabao mango ay tumutubo sa malaki at mataas na punong mangga na maaaring mabuhay nang maraming taon at magbunga taun-taon.
fact_bis: Ang carabao mango motubo sa dako ug taas nga punoan sa mangga nga makabuhi og daghang tuig ug mamunga matag tuig.

q: What part inside a retractable ballpoint pen pushes the nib out when you press the button?
options: A compressed spring that releases when the button is pressed
A small electric motor powered by the pen's ink cartridge
A lever attached to the clip that toggles the nib in and out
A rubber band stretched around the ink tube
explanation: A retractable ballpoint pen uses a small spring inside — pressing the button releases the compressed spring that pushes the pen nib out.
fact_tl: Ang click pen na may retractable na dulo ay gumagamit ng maliit na spring sa loob — ang pagpindot ng button ay nagpapalabas ng naka-compress na spring na nagtutulak ng dulo papalabas.
fact_bis: Ang retractable nga ballpoint pen naggamit og gamay nga spring sa sulod — ang pagpindot sa button nagpalaya sa compressed nga spring nga nagtulod sa pen nib palabas, ug ang pagpindot pag-usab nagbalik niini.

q: Where does sedimentary rock usually form compared to metamorphic and igneous rock?
options: Near the surface, while metamorphic and most igneous rock form deeper and hotter underground
Deep underground, while metamorphic rock forms only at the surface
In the ocean only, while igneous rock forms exclusively on land
At the same depth as metamorphic rock but at much lower temperatures
explanation: Sedimentary rock usually forms near the surface, while metamorphic and most igneous rock form deeper and hotter underground.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nabubuo ang sedimentary na bato malapit sa ibabaw, habang ang metamorphic at karamihan ng igneous na bato ay nabubuo sa mas malalim at mas mainit na bahagi sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang sedimentary nga bato kasagaran maporma duol sa ibabaw, samtang ang metamorphic ug kadaghanan sa igneous nga bato maporma sa mas lawom ug mas init nga bahin sa ilawom sa yuta.

q: What happens to your mass and your weight when you travel to the Moon?
options: Your mass stays the same but your weight is lighter because the Moon's gravity is weaker
Both your mass and your weight stay exactly the same as on Earth
Your mass decreases because there is less gravity pulling on it
Your weight stays the same but your mass increases due to lower pressure
explanation: Your mass stays the same everywhere, but your weight is lighter on the Moon because gravity there is weaker.
fact_tl: Hindi nagbabago ang masa mo kahit saan, pero mas magaan ang timbang mo sa buwan dahil mas mahina ang grabidad doon.
fact_bis: Ang imong masa parehas bisan asa, apan mas gaan ang imong gibug-aton sa buwan tungod kay mas huyang ang grabidad didto.

q: Why must the material used to make a convex lens be clear and clean?
options: So that light can pass through neatly and the image stays sharp
So that the lens can bend light without any heat building up inside
So that the lens does not crack when exposed to direct sunlight
So that the edges of the lens remain thin enough to focus light properly
explanation: A convex lens must be made of clear glass or plastic so light can pass through neatly and the image stays sharp.
fact_tl: Ang convex lens ay madalas gawa sa malinaw na salamin o plastik na hinubog na makapal sa gitna at makinis ang ibabaw. Mahalaga na malinaw at walang dumi ang materyal para makadaan nang maayos ang liwanag at hindi mag-blur ang larawan.
fact_bis: Ang convex lens kasagaran hinimo sa tin-aw nga bildo o plastik nga gihulma nga baga sa tunga ug hamis ang ibabaw. Importante nga tin-aw ug limpyo ang materyal aron moagi og maayo ang kahayag ug dili molabo ang hulagway.

q: Which relationship is an example of commensalism?
options: An orchid growing on a tree without harming the tree
A tick feeding on a dog's blood while the dog weakens
A clownfish protecting an anemone while the anemone shelters the clownfish
A fungus killing a tree while living off its nutrients
explanation: In commensalism, one species benefits while the other is unaffected, like an orchid epiphyte growing on a tree without harming it.
fact_tl: Sa commensalism, ang isang species ay nakikinabang habang ang kabilang species ay hindi naapektuhan, tulad ng orchid na epiphyte na lumalaki sa puno ngunit hindi nakakasama sa puno.
fact_bis: Sa commensalism, ang usa ka species makiginabaw samtang ang laing species wala maapektuhan, sama sa orchid epiphyte nga nagtubo sa kahoy nga wala makaadot sa kahoy.

q: What is air mainly made of?
options: A mixture of nitrogen and oxygen gases
A single pure gas called oxygen
Mostly carbon dioxide with a little water vapor
An equal mixture of all known gases
explanation: Air is a mixture of gases, mostly nitrogen and oxygen, not a single pure substance.
fact_tl: Ang hangin ay isang mixture ng mga gas, karamihan ay nitrogen at oxygen, hindi isang purong sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang hangin usa ka mixture sa mga gas, kasagaran nitrogen ug oxygen, dili usa ka purong sangkap.

q: Why can't you always identify a mineral just by looking at its color?
options: Because one mineral can come in many different colors
Because minerals are always too small to see clearly
Because color changes when a mineral gets wet
Because all minerals look the same color underground
explanation: Color alone is unreliable for identifying minerals because a single mineral can appear in many different colors.
fact_tl: Hindi laging maaasahan ang kulay sa pagkilala ng mineral dahil ang isang mineral ay maaaring magkaroon ng iba't ibang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang kolor lang dili kanunay kasaligan sa pag-ila sa mineral kay ang usa ka mineral mahimong adunay lainlaing kolor.

q: A child has a cold caused by a virus. Should the doctor give antibiotics to cure it?
options: No, because antibiotics only work against bacteria, not viruses
Yes, because antibiotics kill all kinds of germs
Yes, because antibiotics reduce fever from any illness
No, because antibiotics are only for adults
explanation: Antibiotics kill bacteria or stop them from multiplying, but they do not work against viruses like the common cold.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotic ay gamot na pumapatay o pumipigil sa pagdami ng bakterya, ngunit hindi ito gumagana laban sa mga virus tulad ng sipon.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotic usa ka tambal nga mopatay o mopugong sa pagdaghan sa bakterya, apan dili kini molihok batok sa mga virus sama sa sip-on.

q: Why is the wind usually slower near the ground than high up in the sky?
options: Because friction from trees and buildings slows the wind near the surface
Because gravity pulls the wind downward and stops it
Because the Sun heats the ground and pushes wind upward
Because clouds block the wind from reaching the ground
explanation: Friction from trees, buildings, and other surfaces slows wind near the ground; at higher altitudes there is less friction so wind moves faster.
fact_tl: Ang hangin ay mas mabagal malapit sa lupa dahil sa friction na dulot ng mga puno, gusali, at iba pang bagay; mas mabilis ang hangin sa mataas na lugar dahil mas kaunti ang friction.
fact_bis: Ang hangin mas hinay duol sa yuta tungod sa friction gikan sa mga puno, mga bilding, ug uban pang mga ibabaw; ang hangin mas paspas sa mas taas nga lugar tungod kay gamay lang ang friction.

q: Which aircraft was the first to fly faster than the speed of sound?
options: The Bell X-1
The Wright Flyer
The Concorde
The Spitfire
explanation: The Bell X-1 was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound.
fact_tl: Ang Bell X-1 ang unang eroplanong lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog.
fact_bis: Ang Bell X-1 mao ang unang ayroplano nga milupad nga mas tulin pa sa tingog.

q: Which part of the body does tuberculosis (TB) most often attack?
options: The lungs
The liver
The kidneys
The heart
explanation: TB most often attacks the lungs, causing breathing trouble and a lot of coughing.
fact_tl: Madalas na inaatake ng TB ang mga baga, kaya nahihirapan ang tao sa paghinga at madalas umubo.
fact_bis: Ang TB kasagaran moataki sa mga baga, mao nga ang tawo maglisod sa pagginhawa ug kanunay maubo.

q: Before 2006, what number planet from the Sun was Pluto considered to be?
options: The ninth and farthest planet
The eighth planet
The seventh planet
The tenth and farthest planet
explanation: Before 2006, Pluto was counted as the ninth and farthest planet from the Sun.
fact_tl: Bago ang 2006, itinuturing ang Pluto bilang ika-siyam at pinakamalayong planeta mula sa Araw.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa ang 2006, giisip ang Pluto isip ikasiyam ug kinalayong planeta gikan sa Adlaw.

q: What record does Filipino billiards player Efren Reyes hold in world competition?
options: He is the first person to win World Championships in two different billiards disciplines
He is the youngest player ever to win a billiards world title
He is the only player to win ten world titles in the same discipline
He invented the modern rules of billiards used in world championships
explanation: Efren Reyes is the first person in history to win World Championships in two different billiards disciplines.
fact_tl: Si Efren Reyes ang unang taong nanalo ng world championship sa dalawang magkaibang disiplina ng bilyar.
fact_bis: Si Efren Reyes ang unang tawo nga nakadaog ug World Championship sa duha ka lain-laing disiplina sa bilyar.

q: Why do engineers copy the centipede's body design when building robots that walk on rough ground?
options: Because many legs help the robot stay balanced and avoid tipping over
Because centipede legs are made of a very strong material
Because having many legs makes the robot move faster on flat surfaces
Because few legs means less energy is needed to walk
explanation: Engineers copy the centipede's many legs to build robots that stay stable and are less likely to tip over or get stuck on uneven ground.
fact_tl: Ginagaya ng mga inhinyero ang maraming paa ng alupihan para gumawa ng mga robot na kayang maglakad sa magaspang at hindi pantay na lupa. Dahil maraming paa, hindi agad natutumba o naiipit ang ganitong klase ng robot.
fact_bis: Gisundog sa mga inhinyero ang daghang tiil sa alupihan aron makahimo og mga robot nga makalakaw sa gansangon ug dili patag nga yuta. Tungod kay daghan ang tiil, dili dayon matumba o maipit kini nga matang sa robot.

q: How does the Komodo dragon's venom compare to the venom of some snakes like the cobra?
options: The Komodo's venom works slowly, while cobras have faster and more lethal venom
The Komodo's venom is stronger and faster-acting than any snake's venom
Both have equally deadly venom but the cobra's works more slowly
The Komodo dragon has no venom and relies only on its bite
explanation: Though dangerous, the Komodo dragon's venom is not the deadliest — snakes like the cobra have faster and more lethal venom; the Komodo's venom works slowly to weaken prey.
fact_tl: Bagama't delikado, hindi ang kamandag ng Komodo dragon ang pinakamakamandag sa mundo; ang ilang ahas gaya ng cobra ay may mas mabilis at mas nakamamatay na kamandag — ang sa Komodo ay mabagal magpahina.
fact_bis: Bisan delikado, ang hilo sa Komodo dragon dili mao ang labing makahilo sa kalibotan; ang ubang bitin sama sa cobra adunay mas paspas ug mas makamatay nga hilo — ang sa Komodo hinay nga magpaluya.

q: How does a female praying mantis protect her eggs after laying them?
options: She lays them in a soft case that hardens around them
She buries them deep in the soil one by one
She guards them by sitting on top of them like a bird
She hides them inside a rolled-up leaf sealed with silk
explanation: The female praying mantis lays her eggs in a soft case that hardens to protect them.
fact_tl: Nangingitlog ang inahing sasamba sa isang malambot na balot na tumitigas para protektahan ang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Mangitlog ang inahan nga sasamba sa usa ka humok nga sapaw nga mogahi aron mapanalipdan ang mga itlog.

q: Why do the smallest young fish hide in mangroves before moving out to coral reefs?
options: Because mangroves are shallower and closer to shore, giving tiny fish better shelter
Because coral reefs have no food for very small fish
Because mangroves have warmer water that speeds up fish growth
Because coral reefs produce chemicals that are harmful to newborn fish
explanation: Mangroves are shallower and sit along the shore, so the very smallest fish hide there first; as they grow they move out to the reef.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan at ang bahura ay parehong silid-pampalaki ng isda, pero magkaiba sila. Ang bakawan ay nasa baybayin at mas mababaw, kaya dito unang nagtatago ang napakaliliit na isda. Paglaki, lumilipat sila sa bahura. Magkatulong ang dalawa sa pag-aalaga ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang bakawan ug ang bahura parehong nursery sa isda, apan lahi sila. Ang bakawan naa sa baybayon ug mas mabaw, mao nga dinhi una magtago ang pinakagagmay nga isda. Inigdako, mobalhin sila sa bahura. Nagtinabangay ang duha sa pag-atiman sa kinabuhi sa dagat.

q: What does the redshift of light from distant galaxies tell astronomers about the universe?
options: That the universe is expanding
That distant galaxies are cooling down rapidly
That the universe is slowly shrinking toward a center
That stars in distant galaxies are younger than our Sun
explanation: Because light from almost all distant galaxies shows a longer wavelength (redshift), astronomers believe the whole universe is expanding.
fact_tl: Dahil ang liwanag mula sa halos lahat ng malalayong galaksi ay may mas mahabang wavelength (redshift) kaysa sa inaasahan, naniniwala ang mga astronomo na lumalawak ang buong uniberso.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang kahayag gikan sa halos tanan nga layo nga galaksiya adunay mas taas nga wavelength (redshift) kaysa gilauman, nagtuo ang mga astronomo nga nagkalapad ang tibuok uniberso.

q: What is unusual about a scallop's eyes compared to most other shellfish?
options: A scallop has dozens of tiny eyes along the edge of its shell that sense movement
A scallop has two large compound eyes on long stalks
A scallop is completely blind and uses touch to detect danger
A scallop has one large eye in the center of its body
explanation: A scallop has dozens of tiny blue eyes along the edge of its shell that sense movement, which is unusual for a shellfish.
fact_tl: Ang scallop, isang uri ng kabibe, ay may dose-dosenang maliliit na asul na mata sa gilid ng kabibe nito na nakakaramdam ng galaw.
fact_bis: Ang scallop, usa ka matang kabibe, adunay dosena-dosena ka gagmay nga asul nga mata sa daplin sa kabibe niini nga makabati sa lihok.

q: What is the largest island found inside Laguna de Bay?
options: Talim Island
Corregidor Island
Turtle Island
Hundred Islands
explanation: Talim Island is the largest island within Laguna de Bay, located in the Rizal portion of the lake.
fact_tl: Ang Talim Island ay ang pinakamalaking isla sa loob ng Laguna de Bay; ito ay matatagpuan sa bahagi ng lalawigan ng Rizal at tahanan ng mga mangingisda.
fact_bis: Ang Talim Island mao ang pinakadakling isla sulod sa Laguna de Bay; nahimutang kini sa bahin sa Rizal sa danaw ug puy-anan sa mga komunidad sa pangisda.

q: What is the special type of forest found near the top of Mount Apo, the highest mountain in the Philippines?
options: A mossy forest where trees are covered in moss due to cold, moist air
A rainforest where the trees grow very tall due to heavy rainfall
A mangrove forest at the edge of a mountain lake
A pine forest that grows only above 2,000 meters elevation
explanation: Mount Apo has an alpine zone called mossy forest, where trees are covered in moss because of the cold, moist air at that height.
fact_tl: Ang Bundok Apo, ang pinakamataas na bundok sa Pilipinas, ay may espesyal na alpine zone na tinatawag na mossy forest kung saan ang mga puno ay natatakpan ng lumot dahil sa malamig at mahalumigmig na hangin.
fact_bis: Ang Bukid Apo, ang pinakataas nga bukid sa Pilipinas, adunay espesyal nga alpine zone nga gitawag og mossy forest diin ang mga kahoy gitabonan og lumot tungod sa bugnaw, basa nga hangin.

q: What do the blue whale and bacteria have in common, even though one is enormous and the other is microscopic?
options: Both are living things
Both need sunlight to survive
Both have a backbone inside their bodies
Both live in ocean water
explanation: Despite the huge difference in size, both the blue whale and bacteria are living things, showing how wide the range of sizes on Earth is.
fact_tl: Kabaligtaran ng pinakamalaking hayop na blue whale ang pinakamaliliit na buhay na bagay tulad ng bakterya, na hindi mo makita nang walang mikroskopyo. Parehong buhay sila, pero napakalaki ng pagkakaiba ng sukat. Ito ang nagpapakita kung gaano kalawak ang sukat ng mga buhay na bagay sa Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang kaatbang sa pinakadako nga hayop nga blue whale mao ang pinakagagmay nga buhi nga butang sama sa bakterya, nga dili nimo makita kung walay mikroskopyo. Pareho silang buhi, apan dako kaayo ang kalainan sa gidak-on. Kini nagpakita kung unsa kalapad ang han-ay sa gidak-on sa mga buhi nga butang sa Kalibutan.

q: Which animals are examples of species that can live in brackish water where saltiness keeps changing?
options: Mud crabs and milkfish
Clownfish and sea turtles
Freshwater tilapia and carp
Dolphins and sea lions
explanation: Only special animals like mud crabs and milkfish can live in brackish water, where saltiness keeps changing with the tides.
fact_tl: Iilang hayop lang gaya ng alimango at bangus ang kayang mabuhay sa brackish na tubig na nagbabago-bago ang alat sa pagtaog at paghupa.
fact_bis: Pipila lang ka mananap sama sa alimango ug bangus ang makahimo og puyo sa brackish nga tubig, diin nagbag-o ang kaparat samtang motaob ug mohunas.

q: Paper and plastic bags look similar, but what are they each made from?
options: Paper is made from wood; plastic is made from oil
Paper is made from cotton; plastic is made from sand
Both paper and plastic are made from oil but in different ways
Paper is made from oil; plastic is made from wood pulp
explanation: Even though both are thin, paper is made from wood while plastic is made from oil, which is why paper rots but plastic lasts a long time.
fact_tl: Kahit parehong manipis ang papel at plastik, magkaiba sila: ang papel ay gawa sa kahoy, samantalang ang plastik ay gawa sa langis. Kaya naaagnas ang papel pero ang plastik ay matagal mawala.
fact_bis: Bisan og parehong nipis ang papel ug plastik, lahi sila: ang papel hinimo sa kahoy, samtang ang plastik hinimo sa lana. Mao nga madunot ang papel apan ang plastik dugay mawala.

q: What is formed when two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom join together?
options: A water molecule
A hydrogen gas molecule
An oxygen molecule
A salt crystal
explanation: Because atoms are so tiny they join together to form molecules; two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom combine to make water.
fact_tl: Dahil napakaliit ng atomo, kadalasang nagsasama-sama sila para bumuo ng molekula. Halimbawa, dalawang atomo ng hydrogen at isang atomo ng oxygen ang nagsasama para maging tubig.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gamay kaayo ang atomo, kasagaran magkahiusa sila aron maghimo og molekula. Pananglitan, duha ka atomo sa hydrogen ug usa ka atomo sa oxygen ang magsagol aron mahimong tubig.

q: About how much can a large male polar bear weigh?
options: Up to about 800 kilograms
Up to about 200 kilograms
Up to about 1,500 kilograms
Up to about 400 kilograms
explanation: A large male polar bear can weigh up to about 800 kilograms.
fact_tl: Ang isang malaking lalaking polar bear ay maaaring tumimbang ng hanggang mga 800 kilo.
fact_bis: Ang dako nga laki nga polar bear mahimong motimbang hangtod sa mga 800 ka kilo.

q: What does a catalytic converter in a car's exhaust system do to reduce pollution?
options: It turns poisonous carbon monoxide into the safer carbon dioxide
It filters out dust particles before smoke leaves the exhaust pipe
It converts carbon dioxide back into oxygen gas
It stores harmful gases inside the car so they cannot escape
explanation: A catalytic converter turns poisonous carbon monoxide into the safer carbon dioxide before smoke leaves into the air.
fact_tl: Maraming modernong kotse ang may bahaging tinatawag na catalytic converter sa tambutso. Ginagawa nito ang nakakalasong carbon monoxide tungo sa mas ligtas na carbon dioxide bago pa lumabas ang usok sa hangin. Ito ay isang halimbawa ng teknolohiyang ginagamit para mabawasan ang polusyon.
fact_bis: Daghang modernong awto ang adunay bahin nga gitawag og catalytic converter sa tambutso. Gihimo niini ang makahilo nga carbon monoxide ngadto sa mas luwas nga carbon dioxide sa dili pa mogawas ang aso sa hangin. Usa kini ka pananglitan sa teknolohiya nga gigamit aron makunhuran ang polusyon.

q: How does covering stored water containers help prevent dengue fever?
options: It stops mosquitoes from laying their eggs in the water
It keeps the water cold so mosquitoes cannot survive in it
It removes the chemicals in the water that attract mosquitoes
It blocks sunlight, which dengue mosquitoes need to breed
explanation: Covering containers of stored water prevents dengue because mosquitoes cannot lay their eggs in water that is kept covered and clean.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatakip ng mga lalagyan ng nakaimbak na tubig ay nakakatulong na maiwasan ang dengue, dahil hindi makakapangitlog ang mga lamok sa nakatakip at malinis na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagtabon sa mga sudlanan sa gitipigan nga tubig makatabang sa paglikay sa dengue, kay dili makapangitlog ang mga lamok sa tubig nga natabonan ug limpyo.

q: Which object has more gravitational potential energy?
options: A heavy rock held high up on a cliff
A heavy rock resting on the ground
A light feather held high up in the air
A light feather lying flat on the floor
explanation: Gravitational potential energy depends on both height and weight — the higher and heavier the object, the more of this stored energy it has.
fact_tl: Ang gravitational potential energy ay ang nakaimbak na enerhiya ng isang bagay dahil sa taas nito; mas mataas at mas mabigat ang bagay, mas malaki ang enerhiyang ito.
fact_bis: Ang gravitational potential energy mao ang natipig nga enerhiya sa usa ka butang tungod sa kahabog niini; mas habog ug mas bug-at ang butang, mas dako kini nga enerhiya.

q: How does a pitcher plant trap insects — does it snap shut like a Venus flytrap?
options: No, the pitcher stays still and just waits for insects to fall inside
Yes, the pitcher snaps shut as soon as an insect lands on the rim
Yes, the pitcher rolls closed slowly after an insect enters
No, the pitcher shoots out a sticky tongue to catch flying insects
explanation: The pitcher plant does not move or snap shut; it simply waits passively for an insect to fall in.
fact_tl: Hindi gumagalaw o pumipitik ang tabo; naghihintay lang itong mahulog ang insekto sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang tabo dili molihok o motak-op; naghulat lang kini nga mahulog ang insekto sa sulod.

q: Why is gliding, like the kind done by the Draco lizard, different from true powered flight?
options: Gliding uses gravity and always moves downward, with no power of its own
Gliding is faster than powered flight because air resistance is removed
Gliding uses flapping wings to push air backward and move forward
Gliding can only be done upward since air currents lift the animal
explanation: Gliding is unpowered flight that uses gravity, so the path is always downward — unlike true flight which uses its own power.
fact_tl: Ang paglutang ay isang paglipad na walang sariling lakas; gumagamit ito ng grabidad kaya laging pababa ang tunguhin.
fact_bis: Ang paglutaw usa ka paglupad nga walay kaugalingong kusog; mogamit kini og grabidad maong kanunay paubos ang dagan.

q: Why does a bird fluff up its feathers when the weather is cold?
options: To trap more air between the feathers and stay warmer
To scare away other animals that might steal its food
To make itself look bigger so predators will leave it alone
To dry the feathers faster after getting wet in the rain
explanation: When cold, a bird fluffs up its feathers to trap more air, which keeps the bird warmer.
fact_tl: Kapag malamig, ibinubuka at pinapataas ng ibon ang mga balahibo nito para makaipon ng mas maraming hangin at lalo itong uminit.
fact_bis: Kung bugnaw, ibukhad ug ipataas sa langgam ang mga balhibo niini aron makadakop og daghang hangin ug mas mainit kini.

q: Why does the tamaraw's habit of living alone make it harder for the species to recover?
options: Because tamaraws have difficulty meeting each other to breed, so the population grows very slowly
Because living alone means each tamaraw needs a larger territory with more food
Because solitary animals cannot defend themselves from hunters without the group
Because tamaraws forget how to raise young when they do not live in herds
explanation: Because tamaraws live alone and have trouble meeting to breed, their population grows even more slowly, making conservation of each individual critical.
fact_tl: Dahil nag-iisa ang tamaraw at mahirap silang magkasalubong para magpaanak, mas mabagal pang dumami ang kanilang lahi — kaya importante ang pag-iingat sa bawat isa.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nag-inusara ang tamaraw ug lisod silang magkita aron magpasanay, mas hinay pa modaghan ang ilang kaliwat — busa importante ang pag-amping sa matag usa.

q: What causes an algae bloom in a pond, and why is it harmful to fish?
options: Too many nutrients from fertilizer or waste cause algae to multiply rapidly, using up oxygen so fish die
Too little sunlight causes algae to rot and release poison that kills fish
Cold water temperatures make algae grow in thick mats that trap fish
A sudden drop in water level concentrates salt, which algae needs to bloom
explanation: When too many nutrients wash into a pond, algae multiply suddenly in a bloom that uses up oxygen, causing fish to die.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang sustansya sa tubig — halimbawa mula sa abono o dumi na naaanod sa pond — biglang dumadami ang algae at nagiging berdeng-berde ang ibabaw ng tubig. Tinatawag itong algae bloom, at pwedeng makaubos ng oxygen kaya namamatay ang mga isda.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang sustansya sa tubig — pananglitan gikan sa abono o hugaw nga maanod sa pond — kalit nga modaghan ang algae ug mahimong berde kaayo ang ibabaw sa tubig. Gitawag kini og algae bloom, ug mahimong maubos ang oxygen maong mamatay ang mga isda.

q: Which instrument does PHIVOLCS use to detect ground swelling caused by rising magma inside a volcano?
options: A tiltmeter
A seismograph
An SO2 sensor
A rain gauge
explanation: PHIVOLCS uses tiltmeters to measure ground swelling as magma rises, along with seismographs and SO2 sensors to monitor active Philippine volcanoes.
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS ay gumagamit ng maraming uri ng instrumento para obserbahan ang mga aktibong bulkan ng Pilipinas: tiltmeters (sumusukat ng pag-angat ng lupa kapag ang magma ay umaangat), seismographs (nakikinig sa mga lindol), at SO2 sensors (nagsusukat ng gas na inilalabas ng magma).
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS naggamit sa daghang klase sa instrumento sa pag-monitor sa aktibong mga bulkan sa Pilipinas: tiltmeters (nagsukat sa pag-umol sa yuta samtang nagsaka ang magma), seismographs (nagpaminaw sa mga lindol), ug SO2 sensors (nagsukat sa gas nga gibuhian sa magma).

q: Which of these correctly describes a jellyfish's body?
options: It has no bones, no brain, and no heart, and its body is almost all water
It has a simple brain but no bones, and its body is about half water
It has soft bones, a small heart, and its body is about half water
It has no bones but has a brain and heart to control its movements
explanation: A jellyfish has no bones, no brain, and no heart, and its body is almost entirely water — it simply drifts with the current.
fact_tl: Ang dikya (jellyfish) ay walang buto, walang utak, at walang puso, at halos puro tubig ang katawan nito. Naglulutang lang ito sa dagat at sumusunod sa agos.
fact_bis: Ang dikya (jellyfish) walay bukog, walay utok, ug walay kasingkasing, ug halos puro tubig ang iyang lawas. Molutaw lang kini sa dagat ug mosunod sa sulog.

q: When wood burns completely, what two substances are produced?
options: Carbon dioxide and water vapor
Oxygen gas and ash
Smoke and nitrogen gas
Carbon monoxide and steam only
explanation: When wood or gas burns completely, it produces carbon dioxide and water vapor.
fact_tl: Kapag kumpleto ang pagkasunog ng kahoy o gas, nakabubuo ito ng carbon dioxide at singaw ng tubig.
fact_bis: Kung hingpit nga masunog ang kahoy o gas, makahimo kini ug carbon dioxide ug alisngaw sa tubig.

q: Deep-sea animals glow in the dark for several reasons. Which of these is NOT one of them?
options: To keep their body temperature warm in cold deep water
To catch prey in the darkness
To scare off enemies
To find a mate in the dark
explanation: Deep-sea animals glow to catch prey, scare enemies, or find a mate — not to warm themselves; bioluminescence is not used for heat.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa kailaliman ang nagniningning para sa iba't ibang dahilan — para manghuli, para takutin ang kaaway, o para makahanap ng kapareha sa dilim.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sa kalaliman ang nagdan-ag tungod sa nagkalainlain nga rason — aron manghuli, aron hadlokon ang kaaway, o aron makakita og kapikas sa kangitngit.

q: Where do rats usually build their nests?
options: In hidden places like holes, drains, and broken walls
In open grassy fields where they can watch for danger
In tall trees where predators cannot reach them
Under water in riverbeds or flooded areas
explanation: Rats build nests in hidden places like holes, drains, and broken walls to stay safe and out of sight.
fact_tl: Ang daga ay gumagawa ng pugad sa mga tagong lugar tulad ng butas, alkantarilya, at sira na pader.
fact_bis: Ang ilaga magbuhat og salag sa tinago nga mga dapit sama sa lungag, kanal, ug guba nga bungbong.

q: If someone is bitten by a dog that might have rabies, what is the only thing that can prevent the disease?
options: A vaccine given by a doctor
A herbal remedy applied to the wound right away
Washing the bite with salt water and honey
Resting for several days and drinking plenty of fluids
explanation: No home remedy or herbal cure can stop rabies — only a vaccine from a doctor works.
fact_tl: Walang gamot sa bahay o herbal na lunas ang makakapigil sa rabies — tanging bakuna mula sa doktor ang epektibo.
fact_bis: Walay tambal sa balay o herbal nga makapugong sa rabies — ang bakuna lang gikan sa doktor ang epektibo.

q: What is a cloud actually made of?
options: Millions of tiny water droplets or ice crystals floating in the air
Pockets of warm air that rise and glow in sunlight
Layers of water vapor that have not yet become liquid
Clumps of dust mixed with gases released by plants
explanation: A cloud is made of millions of tiny water droplets or ice crystals that form when water vapor rises, cools, and turns into tiny droplets.
fact_tl: Ang ulap ay gawa sa milyon-milyong napakaliliit na patak ng tubig o kristal ng yelo na lumulutang sa himpapawid. Nabubuo ito kapag tumataas at lumalamig ang singaw ng tubig at nagiging maliliit na patak.
fact_bis: Ang panganod hinimo sa minilyon ka gagmay kaayo nga tulo sa tubig o kristal sa yelo nga naglutaw sa hangin. Maporma kini kung mosaka ug mobugnaw ang alisngaw sa tubig ug mahimong gagmay nga tulo.

q: How do scientists use carbon-14 to figure out the age of an ancient bone or piece of wood?
options: They measure how much carbon-14 remains, since it decays at a known rate, to calculate how long ago the organism died
They count the number of carbon-14 atoms added each year the organism was alive
They compare carbon-14 levels in the sample to those in nearby rocks of known age
They heat the sample until carbon-14 glows and then read the color to find its age
explanation: Carbon-14 decays at a known rate, so by measuring how much remains in an ancient organic sample, scientists can determine how long ago the organism died.
fact_tl: Ang carbon-14 ay isang radioactive na isotope na unti-unting nagkasira sa isang kilalang rate — sa pamamagitan ng pagsukat ng kung gaano na karaming carbon-14 ang natitira sa isang lumang organic na sample, maaaring malaman ng mga siyentipiko kung gaano katagal nang patay ang organismo.
fact_bis: Ang carbon-14 usa ka radioactive nga isotope nga hinay-hinay nagkasira sa usa ka nahibal-an nga rate — pinaagi sa pagsukod kung pila na ka carbon-14 ang nahabilin sa usa ka karaan nga organic nga sample, makita sa mga siyentipiko kung kanus-a namatay ang organismo.

q: Why does one full day last exactly 24 hours?
options: Because that is how long Earth takes to spin once on its own axis
Because that is how long Earth takes to travel halfway around the Sun
Because the Moon's gravity causes Earth to slow its spin to 24 hours
Because ancient scientists decided to divide daylight into 24 equal parts
explanation: A day is 24 hours because that is how long Earth takes to spin once on its own axis.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw ay 24 oras dahil ganoon katagal umiikot ang Earth nang isang beses sa sarili nitong axis.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw kay 24 ka oras kay mao kana kadugay ang pagtuyok sa Earth kausa sa iyang kaugalingong axis.

q: In which group of the periodic table will you find the alkaline earth metals?
options: Group 2
Group 1
Group 7
Group 18
explanation: The alkaline earth metals are located in Group 2 of the periodic table.
fact_tl: Ang mga alkaline earth metal ay nasa Group 2 ng periodic table.
fact_bis: Ang mga alkaline earth metal naa sa Group 2 sa periodic table.

q: Who built the famous steam locomotive called the 'Rocket'?
options: George Stephenson and his son Robert
James Watt and his partner Matthew Boulton
Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla
Richard Trevithick and Isambard Kingdom Brunel
explanation: George Stephenson, together with his son Robert, built the famous steam locomotive called the 'Rocket'.
fact_tl: Si George Stephenson (kasama ang anak niyang si Robert) ang gumawa ng tanyag na steam locomotive na 'Rocket'.
fact_bis: Si George Stephenson (kauban ang iyang anak nga si Robert) mao ang naghimo sa bantogang steam locomotive nga ginganlag 'Rocket'.

q: How did dinosaurs have babies?
options: They laid eggs, just like birds and reptiles do today
They gave birth to live young, similar to most mammals
They carried eggs inside a pouch on their belly until they hatched
They planted eggs in the ground and never returned to care for them
explanation: Dinosaurs laid eggs, just like birds and reptiles do today.
fact_tl: Ang mga dinosaur ay nangingitlog, tulad ng mga ibon at reptilya ngayon.
fact_bis: Ang mga dinosaur nangitlog, sama sa mga langgam ug reptilya karon.

q: When can you see a full Moon in the sky?
options: It rises in the east at sunset and is visible all night long
It is only visible for a few hours just after midnight
It rises at noon and sets at sunset on the same day
It is visible just before sunrise in the western sky
explanation: A full Moon rises in the east when the Sun sets in the west and remains visible throughout the entire night.
fact_tl: Ang full Moon ay sumisilang sa kanluran kapag ang Araw ay lumulubog sa silangan at nakikita sa buong gabi; ang new Moon naman ay hindi makikita dahil ito ay kasabay ng Araw sa kalangitan. Ang crescent Moon pagkatapos ng new Moon ay makikita sa gabi malapit sa lumululong na Araw.
fact_bis: Ang full Moon mosidlak sa sidlakan sa dihang ang Adlaw mosalop sa kasadpan ug makita sa tibuok gabii; ang new Moon dili makita tungod kay mosidlak ug mosalop uban sa Adlaw. Ang crescent Moon pagkahuman sa new Moon makita sa gabii duol sa nagsalop nga Adlaw.

q: Why does a swinging pendulum eventually slow down and stop?
options: Because air resistance and friction gradually take away its energy
Because gravity increases over time and pulls the pendulum down faster
Because the string stretches longer with each swing, wasting energy
Because the mass of the pendulum ball decreases as it swings
explanation: A pendulum cannot swing forever because air resistance and friction slowly remove its energy until it stops, unless something keeps adding energy.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na ang pendulum ay puwedeng umugoy nang walang hinto, pero hindi ito totoo; dahil sa hangin at kuskos, unti-unti itong humihina hanggang tumigil kung walang nagdadagdag ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang pendulum makalabyog nga walay hunong, apan dili kana tinuod; tungod sa hangin ug kuskos, hinay-hinay kining mohuyang hangtod mohunong kon walay magdugang og kusog.

q: What happens to homeostasis when the body is exposed to an extremely high or extremely low temperature?
options: The body can no longer maintain balance and life is endangered
The body automatically speeds up homeostasis to correct the temperature faster
Homeostasis switches off safely and restarts when temperature returns to normal
The body produces extra hormones that replace the need for homeostasis
explanation: Homeostasis works only within a limited temperature range; at extreme temperatures the body can no longer balance itself and life is endangered.
fact_tl: Gumagana lamang ang homeostasis sa loob ng limitadong saklaw; sa sobrang init o sobrang lamig, hindi na ito kayang ibalanse ng katawan at nanganganib ang buhay.
fact_bis: Ang homeostasis molihok lamang sulod sa limitado nga han-ay; sa hilabihang kainit o katugnaw dili na kini mabalanse sa lawas ug makuyaw ang kinabuhi.

q: How does a shrimp use its two front legs to eat?
options: It uses the small pincers on its front legs to grab food and bring it to its mouth
It uses its front legs to filter tiny particles of food from the water
It uses its front legs only to dig in the sand and uncover buried food
It uses its front legs to inject venom into prey before eating it
explanation: A shrimp uses its two front legs, which have small pincers, to grab food and bring it to its mouth.
fact_tl: Gamit ng hipon ang dalawang unang paa na may maliit na sipit para humawak at magdala ng pagkain sa bibig nito.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa hipon ang duha ka unahang tiil nga adunay gagmay nga sipit aron mokupot ug modala sa pagkaon ngadto sa baba niini.

q: Why does water drain away quickly in sandy soil?
options: Because sandy soil has larger particles that create big gaps for water to flow through
Because sandy soil contains salt that repels water and pushes it away
Because sandy soil is always found on slopes where water runs downhill
Because sandy soil has fewer minerals, leaving no material to hold water
explanation: Sandy soil has larger particles, so water drains through quickly and the soil dries fast.
fact_tl: Ang mabuhanging lupa ay may malalaking tipik kaya mabilis dumaloy ang tubig at madaling matuyo.
fact_bis: Ang yutang balason adunay dagko nga tipik, mao nga paspas moagi ang tubig ug dali kining mauga.

q: What makes the Philippine eagle special as a national symbol?
options: It is the national bird of the Philippines and is endangered, with only a few left in our forests
It is the largest bird in the world and the only eagle that can swim
It is the fastest bird in the Philippines and never endangered
It is the national bird because it is found in every region of the Philippines
explanation: The Philippine eagle is the national bird of the Philippines and is endangered, with only a few individuals remaining in our forests.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine eagle (haribon) ay isang endangered na ibon at ito ang pambansang ibon ng Pilipinas. Kakaunti na lamang ang natitira sa ating mga kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine eagle (agila) usa ka endangered nga langgam ug kini ang pambansang langgam sa Pilipinas. Diyutay na lang ang nahabilin sa atong kalasangan.

q: How do a crab's eyes help it survive both during the day and at night?
options: Its eyes can adjust to bright daylight and also work in dim moonlight at night
Its eyes only work well in daylight and the crab hides during the night
Its eyes glow in the dark so the crab can signal to other crabs
Its eyes can see colors in the day but only black and white at night
explanation: A crab's eyes can adjust to a bright morning and a dark night; some crabs are even more active at night and can use just a little moonlight to see.
fact_tl: Ang mga mata ng alimango ay kayang umangkop sa maliwanag na umaga at sa madilim na gabi. May mga alimango pa ngang mas aktibo kung gabi, at kayang gamitin ang kahit kakaunting liwanag ng buwan para makakita habang naghahanap ng pagkain sa dalampasigan.
fact_bis: Ang mga mata sa alimango makahimo sa pag-angay sa hayag nga buntag ug sa ngitngit nga gabii. Adunay mga alimango nga mas aktibo kon gabii, ug makagamit sa gamay nga kahayag sa bulan aron makakita samtang mangita silag pagkaon sa baybayon.

q: What is the correct chemical symbol for oxygen gas?
options: O2
O
Ox
O3
explanation: The chemical symbol for oxygen gas is O2, representing two oxygen atoms bonded together.
fact_tl: Ang chemical symbol ng oxygen gas ay O2.
fact_bis: Ang chemical symbol sa oxygen gas mao ang O2.

q: Why does your body shiver when you are very cold?
options: Because the rapid movement of muscles produces heat to warm the body
Because shivering pumps more blood to the skin to release heat
Because shivering signals the brain to increase breathing and take in more oxygen
Because shivering compresses fat cells, which release stored warmth
explanation: When cold, the body shivers because the fast movement of muscles generates heat.
fact_tl: Kapag malamig, ang katawan ay nanginginig dahil ang mabilis na paggalaw ng mga kalamnan ay gumagawa ng init.
fact_bis: Kung tugnaw, ang lawas mokurog tungod kay ang paspas nga paglihok sa mga kaunoran maghimo og init.

q: Which of the following best describes why the body has different kinds of cells?
options: Each kind of cell has its own special job to do
All cells look the same but act differently
Only muscle and bone cells have specific jobs
The body uses the same type of cell for every task
explanation: The body has different kinds of cells—like muscle cells, bone cells, and skin cells—and each kind has its own job.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng selula sa katawan—gaya ng selula ng kalamnan, ng buto, at ng balat—at ang bawat isa ay may sariling tungkulin.
fact_bis: Ang lawas adunay lainlaing matang sa selula—sama sa selula sa kaunoran, sa bukog, ug sa panit—ug ang matag matang adunay kaugalingong buluhaton.

q: Why is it important to chew your food thoroughly before swallowing?
options: Chewing increases the food's surface area so digestive enzymes can break it down more easily
Chewing adds digestive juices directly into the food
