fact_tl: Hindi pa kayang butasin ng tao hanggang core, kaya ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang seismic waves mula sa lindol. Kapag dumadaan ang mga alon sa iba't ibang patong, nagbabago ang bilis at direksyon nito — kaya natutukoy ang hugis at laki ng bawat layer.
fact_bis: Dili pa makahimo ang tawo og buho hangtod sa core, mao nga gigamit sa mga siyentipiko ang seismic waves gikan sa linog. Samtang moagi kini nga mga alon sa lainlaing patong, mausab ang ilang katulin ug direksyon — mao nga matukib ang porma ug gidak-on sa matag patong.

q: Why is it NOT safe to assume a small open window makes it okay to run a vehicle engine indoors?
options: One small window is not enough to clear out all the carbon monoxide, which can still build up to dangerous levels.
Carbon monoxide is heavier than air and sinks to the floor where windows cannot reach it.
Windows only let out water vapor, not invisible gases like carbon monoxide.
A running engine produces so much heat that a window would need to be fully open to help.
explanation: A cracked window provides insufficient ventilation; carbon monoxide can still reach deadly concentrations indoors even with some airflow.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na basta may kaunting bukas na bintana, ligtas na kahit may apoy o makina sa loob. Pero hindi sapat ang isang maliit na bintana para mailabas lahat ng carbon monoxide — pwede pa rin itong umipon hanggang sa makasama. Ang pinakaligtas ay huwag talagang magpaapoy o magpatakbo ng makina sa loob.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga basta gamay nga abli ang bintana, luwas na bisan adunay kalayo o makina sa sulod. Apan dili igo ang usa ka gamay nga bintana aron mahawa ang tanang carbon monoxide — mahimo pa kining magtigom hangtod nga makadaot. Ang pinakaluwas kay dili gyud magpakalayo o magpatuyok og makina sa sulod.

q: What is the main difference between a decomposer and a scavenger?
options: A scavenger is a visible animal that eats chunks of dead matter, while a decomposer like bacteria is tiny and fully breaks down what remains into the soil.
A scavenger lives underground and eats roots, while a decomposer lives above ground and eats dead leaves.
A scavenger only eats plants, while a decomposer only breaks down dead animals.
A scavenger produces compost, while a decomposer produces seeds for new plants.
explanation: Scavengers are visible animals eating large pieces of dead matter, while decomposers are microscopic organisms that completely break down what is left.
fact_tl: Ano ang pagkaiba ng decomposer sa scavenger? Ang scavenger tulad ng uwak o aso ay nakikitang hayop na kumakain ng malalaking piraso ng patay na bagay. Ang decomposer naman tulad ng bacteria at fungi ay maliit at madalas hindi nakikita, at sila ang ganap na naglalansag sa natitira pabalik sa lupa.
fact_bis: Unsa ang kalainan sa decomposer ug scavenger? Ang scavenger sama sa uwak o iro usa ka makita nga hayop nga mokaon og dagkong tipik sa patay nga butang. Ang decomposer sama sa bacteria ug fungi gamay ug sagad dili makita, ug sila ang bug-os nga moguba sa nahibilin balik sa yuta.

q: According to Pinggang Pinoy, what should take up half of your plate at each meal?
options: Vegetables and fruit together
Rice and vegetables together
Protein-rich food and rice together
Fruit juice and protein-rich food together
explanation: Pinggang Pinoy guidelines say half the plate should be vegetables and fruit, with the remaining half split between rice and protein.
fact_tl: Sa Pinggang Pinoy, kalahati ng plato ay dapat gulay at prutas, at ang kalahati pa ay hinahati sa kanin at ulam na may protina.
fact_bis: Sa Pinggang Pinoy, katunga sa plato kinahanglan utanon ug prutas, ug ang laing katunga gibahin sa kan-on ug sud-an nga adunay protina.

q: Whose X-ray image was important in helping Watson and Crick discover the shape of DNA in 1953?
options: Rosalind Franklin
Marie Curie
Barbara McClintock
Dorothy Hodgkin
explanation: Watson and Crick used an X-ray image of DNA taken by Rosalind Franklin as crucial evidence when working out the structure of DNA.
fact_tl: Natuklasan nina James Watson at Francis Crick ang hugis ng DNA noong 1953, gamit ang mahalagang larawang x-ray ni Rosalind Franklin.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan nila James Watson ug Francis Crick ang porma sa DNA niadtong 1953, gamit ang importanteng x-ray nga litrato ni Rosalind Franklin.

q: Who invented the World Wide Web (WWW)?
options: Tim Berners-Lee
Bill Gates
Steve Jobs
Alan Turing
explanation: The World Wide Web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee, not the internet itself but the system of web pages and links we use today.
fact_tl: Ang World Wide Web (WWW) ay inimbento ni Tim Berners-Lee.
fact_bis: Ang World Wide Web (WWW) gimugna ni Tim Berners-Lee.

q: Where does the Brahminy kite build its nest?
options: High in trees near water, using sticks and leaves.
On rocky cliff ledges above the sea using mud and grass.
On the ground near rivers, hidden under dense bushes.
In hollow tree trunks near water, lined with soft feathers.
explanation: The Brahminy kite builds its stick-and-leaf nest high in trees close to water, where it hunts for food.
fact_tl: Ang lawin ay gumagawa ng pugad mula sa mga sanga at dahon sa itaas ng mga puno malapit sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lawin maghimo og salag gikan sa mga sanga ug dahon sa taas sa mga kahoy duol sa tubig.

q: What happens to sea cucumbers (balatan) after they are harvested in the Philippines?
options: They are dried and sold to Chinese markets as a valuable seafood called trepang.
They are ground into medicine and used in local herbal clinics.
They are released into fish ponds to clean algae from the water.
They are preserved in vinegar and sold as a local condiment called bagoong.
explanation: Philippine sea cucumbers are harvested, dried, and exported to Chinese markets as trepang, which has driven population declines on many reefs.
fact_tl: Ang sea cucumber (balatan) ay kinukuha at pinapa-ting sa Pilipinas at ibinebenta sa mga pamilihan ng Tsina bilang trepang — isang mahal na seafood; ang labis na pagkuha ay nagdulot ng pagbaba ng kanilang bilang sa maraming Philippine reef.
fact_bis: Ang sea cucumber (balatan) gikuhaan ug ginapa-ting sa Pilipinas ug gibaligya sa mga merkado sa Tsina isip trepang — usa ka bililhon nga seafood; ang sobra nga pagkuha nagpahinabo sa pagbagsak sa populasyon sa daghang Philippine reef.

q: What is the difference between how objects behave in elastic versus inelastic collisions?
options: In some collisions objects bounce apart, while in others they stick together and move as one.
In elastic collisions both objects stop moving, while in inelastic collisions they continue moving.
In elastic collisions one object absorbs all the energy, while in inelastic collisions energy is shared equally.
In elastic collisions objects slow down gradually, while in inelastic collisions they stop all at once.
explanation: Elastic collisions result in objects bouncing apart, while inelastic collisions result in objects sticking together and moving as a single combined mass.
fact_tl: Sa ilang banggaan, ang mga bagay ay tumatalbog palayo, samantalang sa iba ay nagkakadikit sila at magkasamang gumagalaw.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka banggaan, ang mga butang motalbog palayo, samtang sa uban magdikit sila ug maglihok nga usa.

q: Why are small lumps you can feel in your neck not always a sign of something dangerous?
options: They are likely lymph nodes, which are always in your body and only swell when they are fighting an illness.
They are fat deposits that build up during childhood and disappear in adulthood.
They are muscle knots caused by carrying heavy school bags every day.
They are glands that swell after eating salty food and shrink once you drink water.
explanation: Small neck lumps are usually lymph nodes — a normal part of the immune system — that become noticeable only when enlarged while fighting infection.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang bawat bukol sa leeg ay nakakatakot — ang maliliit na kulani ay normal at nasa katawan natin lagi; nagpapaalala lang sila kapag namamaga na sila habang lumalaban sa sakit.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga ang matag bukol sa liog makahadlok — ang gagmay nga kulani normal ug naa kanunay sa atong lawas; mamatikdan lang sila kung maghubag samtang nakig-away sa sakit.

q: What is the purpose of the three soft 'eyes' or holes found on one end of a coconut?
options: The new sprout pushes out through one of these holes when the coconut germinates.
They allow the coconut to absorb water from the soil while it is still on the tree.
They release a sweet gas that attracts animals to eat and spread the coconut.
They are air holes that keep the coconut from bursting in hot weather.
explanation: One of the three germination pores (eyes) is softer than the others, and the seedling sprout pushes through it when the coconut begins to grow.
fact_tl: Ang bawat niyog ay may tatlong malambot na butas o 'mata' sa isang dulo na parang mukha; sa isa sa mga butas na ito lumalabas ang usbong kapag tumubo na ang niyog.
fact_bis: Ang matag lubi adunay tulo ka humok nga lungag o 'mata' sa usa ka tumoy nga morag nawong; pinaagi sa usa niini nga lungag mogawas ang turok kon motubo na ang lubi.

q: What does a higher coefficient of friction tell you about two surfaces?
options: The surfaces are rougher and there is more friction between them.
The surfaces are smoother and objects slide more easily over them.
The surfaces have more mass and are therefore harder to lift.
The surfaces conduct electricity better than surfaces with lower coefficients.
explanation: The coefficient of friction is higher for rougher surfaces, meaning there is more resistance to sliding between them.
fact_tl: Ang coefficient of friction ay isang numero na nagpapakita kung gaano kadali ang isang bagay ay mag-slide sa ibabaw ng isa pang bagay — mas mataas ang numero para sa mas magaspang na ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang coefficient of friction usa ka numero nga nagpakita kung unsa ka dali ang usa ka butang mag-slide sa ibabaw sa laing butang — mas taas ang numero para sa mas magaspang nga mga ibabaw.

q: What is a common misconception about mangrove trees and saltwater?
options: People wrongly think mangroves love salt, but they actually just tolerate it and can grow fine in fresh water.
People wrongly think mangroves die in salt water, but they actually need salt to survive and grow.
People wrongly think mangroves absorb salt from seawater to use as fertilizer.
People wrongly think mangroves only grow in fresh water and cannot survive any salt at all.
explanation: Mangroves do not prefer salt — they simply tolerate it better than other plants and can actually grow well in fresh water.
fact_tl: Maling akala na 'mahilig sa asin' ang bakawan. Ang totoo, kaya lang nitong tiisin ang asin na ikamamatay ng ibang halaman. Marami ngang bakawan ang lumalago kahit sa tabang na tubig kung walang ibang halamang kakompetensya.
fact_bis: Sayop ang pagtuo nga 'ganahan sa asin' ang bakhaw. Ang tinuod, kaya ra niini antuson ang asin nga makapatay sa ubang tanom. Daghang bakhaw ang motubo bisan sa tab-ang nga tubig kon walay laing tanom nga makigkompetensya.

q: Why are ceramic (porcelain) materials used on high-voltage power line insulators?
options: Because ceramics are good electrical insulators and do not conduct electricity.
Because ceramics are lightweight and make it easier to hang cables from poles.
Because ceramics reflect lightning away from the wires during storms.
Because ceramics are magnetic and keep the electrical current flowing along the wire.
explanation: Ceramics do not conduct electricity, making them ideal insulators to prevent electricity from escaping into the poles or towers.
fact_tl: Ang mga ceramic ay mahusay na electrical insulator — hindi ito nagpapadaan ng kuryente — kaya ginagamit ang mga porsylanang ceramic sa mga high-voltage power line.
fact_bis: Ang mga ceramic maayo nga electrical insulator — dili kini nagpasa sa kuryente — mao nga ang porselana nga ceramic gigamit sa mga high-voltage power line insulator.

q: How does a snail build its shell?
options: A thin layer of its body called the mantle releases calcium that hardens into shell.
It collects small pebbles and sticks them together with a sticky liquid from its foot.
It sheds an outer layer of skin that dries and hardens in the sun over time.
It absorbs minerals from the soil through its foot and pushes them outward.
explanation: The mantle, a thin layer of the snail's body, secretes calcium that gradually hardens into the spiral shell.
fact_tl: Paano gumagawa ng bahay ang kuhol? May manipis na balat sa katawan nito na tinatawag na mantle. Naglalabas ito ng kalsiyum na tumitigas at nagiging shell. Galing ang kalsiyum sa kinakain at iniinom ng kuhol.
fact_bis: Unsaon paghimo sa kuhol sa iyang balay? Naa siyay nipis nga panit sa lawas nga gitawag og mantle. Mogawas niini ang calcium nga motig-a ug mahimong kabhang. Ang calcium gikan sa iyang gikaon.

q: Why are flowers that bloom at night often white or pale instead of brightly colored?
options: Because color cannot be seen in the dark, so they rely on strong scent to attract bats and moths.
Because pale flowers absorb more moonlight, which they need for extra energy at night.
Because bright colors would scare away the insects that pollinate them at night.
Because night temperatures are too cold for plants to produce colorful pigments.
explanation: At night, color is invisible, so night-blooming flowers skip bright colors and instead use scent to attract nocturnal pollinators like bats and moths.
fact_tl: Bakit may mga bulaklak na puti at hindi makulay? Ang mga bulaklak na namumukadkad sa gabi ay kadalasang puti o maputla. Dahil madilim, hindi makikita ang kulay, kaya umaasa sila sa malakas na amoy para akitin ang paniki at gamu-gamo.
fact_bis: Nganong adunay mga bulak nga puti ug dili mabulukon? Ang mga bulak nga mamukhad sa gabii kasagaran puti o luspad. Tungod kay ngitngit, dili makita ang kolor, busa nagsalig sila sa kusog nga baho aron makadani og kabog ug aliboot.

q: What makes the cassowary stand out as a bird?
options: It is a large flightless bird from New Guinea and Australia with sharp claws.
It is a large flying bird from South America known for its colorful feathers.
It is a small water bird from Australia that runs across the surface of ponds.
It is a flightless bird from Africa that is the tallest bird in the world.
explanation: The cassowary is a large, flightless bird found in New Guinea and Australia, recognized for its powerful legs and sharp claws.
fact_tl: Ang cassowary ay isang malaking ibong hindi makalipad mula sa New Guinea at Australia, at may matatalas itong kuko.
fact_bis: Ang cassowary usa ka dako nga langgam nga dili makalupad gikan sa New Guinea ug Australia, ug adunay hait nga mga kuko.

q: What is the main job of the lymphatic system?
options: It carries lymph fluid through vessels and nodes, filtering out germs before the fluid returns to the blood.
It pumps oxygenated blood from the heart to all the organs of the body.
It produces the hormones that control growth and body temperature.
It absorbs digested food from the intestines and delivers it to the liver.
explanation: The lymphatic system filters germs from lymph fluid in nodes throughout the body before returning the clean fluid to the bloodstream.
fact_tl: Ang sistemang limpatiko ay isang network ng mga daluyan at kulani na nagdadala ng likidong tinatawag na linfa at sinasala nito ang mga germ bago bumalik sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang sistemang limpatiko usa ka network sa mga agianan ug kulani nga magdala og likido nga gitawag og linfa ug mosala sa mga germ una mobalik ang likido sa dugo.

q: What is a sloth's typical resting position in a tree?
options: It hangs upside down with its head pointing down.
It sits upright on a branch gripping it with both feet.
It curls into a ball on a wide branch to sleep.
It hangs sideways with its body parallel to the branch.
explanation: Sloths are famous for hanging upside down from branches, spending most of their lives in this head-down position.
fact_tl: Madalas na nakabaligtad o patiwarik ang sloth habang nakabitin sa puno, na nakatungo ang ulo.
fact_bis: Kasagaran nga ang sloth nagbitay nga balintwad sa kahoy, nga ang ulo paubos.

q: According to Newton's law of cooling, when does a hot object cool the fastest?
options: When the temperature difference between the object and its surroundings is greatest.
When the object is placed in a vacuum where no air can carry heat away.
When the object is the same temperature as the room it is placed in.
When the object is wrapped in a material that prevents heat from escaping quickly.
explanation: Newton's law of cooling states that the greater the temperature difference between an object and its surroundings, the faster heat is lost.
fact_tl: Ayon sa batas ng paglamig ni Newton, ang rate ng paglamig ng isang bagay ay nakasalalay sa pagkakaiba ng temperatura nito at ng kapaligiran — mas mainit ang bagay kumpara sa paligid, mas mabilis itong lumamig.
fact_bis: Sumala sa batas ni Newton sa pagpalamig, ang rate sa pagpalamig nagdepende sa kalainan sa temperatura tali sa butang ug sa iyang palibot — ang mas mainit nga butang, mas dali kini magpalamig.

q: Why do some animals produce venom?
options: Either to hunt for food or to defend themselves against enemies.
Only to mark their territory and warn off competing animals.
Only to paralyze prey; they never use it for self-defense.
To digest food externally before swallowing it whole.
explanation: Animals use venom for two main reasons: to capture and kill prey, or to protect themselves from predators.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga hayop ng kamandag para mangaso ng pagkain o para ipagtanggol ang sarili laban sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang mga hayop mogamit ug kamandag aron mangayam ug pagkaon o aron manalipod sa ilang kaugalingon batok sa kaaway.

q: How did the Emden Deep get its name?
options: It was named after the German ship Emden, which discovered it in 1927.
It was named after a Filipino fisherman named Emden who first reported it.
It was named for the German word for 'deep,' which is 'emden.'
It was named after a German scientist who studied deep-sea trenches.
explanation: The Emden Deep was discovered in 1927 by the German ship Emden and was named after that vessel.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Emden Deep noong 1927 ng barkong Aleman na Emden, kaya ipinangalan ito rito.
fact_bis: Nadiskubre ang Emden Deep niadtong 1927 sa Alemang barko nga Emden, mao nga ginganlan kini sumala niini.

q: How does sweating prevent your body from overheating?
options: As sweat dries on your skin, it carries heat away from your body.
Sweat creates a cool liquid layer that blocks more heat from reaching your skin.
Sweating speeds up your heartbeat so blood reaches your skin faster.
Sweat absorbs oxygen from the air, which cools the surface of the skin.
explanation: When sweat evaporates from the skin, it takes heat along with it, lowering your body temperature.
fact_tl: Kapag mainit, lumalabas ang pawis sa balat mo. Habang natutuyo ang pawis, kinukuha nito ang init sa katawan mo, kaya lumalamig ka. Ito ang paraan ng balat para huwag kang sobrang mainit.
fact_bis: Kung init, mogawas ang singot sa imong panit. Samtang momala ang singot, gikuha niini ang kainit gikan sa imong lawas, mao nga mobugnaw ka. Mao ni ang paagi sa panit aron dili ka sobra kainit.

q: Why was molave wood used to build historic churches in the Philippines?
options: It is one of the most durable Philippine hardwoods and resists decay even without chemical treatment.
It is the lightest Philippine wood, making it easy to transport to build sites.
It absorbs water easily, which makes it ideal for structures near the sea.
It produces a natural resin that hardens into a protective coating on buildings.
explanation: Molave is prized because its natural durability allows it to resist rot and insects for centuries without chemical preservatives.
fact_tl: Ang molave (Vitex parviflora) ay isa sa pinakamatibay na kahoy ng Pilipinas—ginagamit ito sa pagtatayo ng mga lumang simbahan at gusali dahil hindi ito agad nabubulok kahit na walang pagtrato.
fact_bis: Ang molave (Vitex parviflora) usa sa pinaka-matibay nga hardwood sa Pilipinas; gigamit kini sa pagtukod sa mga daan nga simbahan ug istruktura tungod kay nagresist kini sa pagkabulok bisan walay chemical treatment.

q: What is the key difference between a homogeneous and a heterogeneous mixture?
options: A homogeneous mixture looks uniform throughout, while a heterogeneous mixture has clearly visible different parts.
A homogeneous mixture can be separated easily, while a heterogeneous mixture cannot be separated at all.
A homogeneous mixture contains only solids, while a heterogeneous mixture contains liquids and solids.
A homogeneous mixture is always a liquid, while a heterogeneous mixture is always a solid.
explanation: Homogeneous mixtures (like sugar water) look the same throughout, while heterogeneous mixtures (like salad) show clearly distinct ingredients.
fact_tl: Sa homogeneous mixture, pantay ang pagkakahalo at iisang hitsura lang ito (gaya ng tubig na may asukal, isang solution); sa heterogeneous mixture, kitang-kita ang magkakaibang bahagi (gaya ng ensalada o sopas na may sangkap).
fact_bis: Sa homogeneous mixture, patas ang pagkasagol ug usa ra ka hitsura (sama sa tubig nga may asukal, usa ka solution); sa heterogeneous mixture, klarong makita ang lainlaing bahin (sama sa salad o sabaw nga may sagol).

q: What makes Philippine shrews like the Mindanao shrew and Palawan moss shrew special?
options: They are found nowhere else in the world — they are endemic to the Philippines.
They are the smallest mammals in Southeast Asia and can fit in a teaspoon.
They are the only mammals in the Philippines that can breathe underwater.
They were brought to the Philippines by Spanish colonizers in the 1500s.
explanation: Several Philippine shrews are endemic species, meaning they exist only in the Philippines and are found on specific islands.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng shrew ang katutubo sa Pilipinas, gaya ng Mindanao shrew at Palawan moss shrew na wala sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa shrew ang lumad sa Pilipinas, sama sa Mindanao shrew ug Palawan moss shrew nga wala sa ubang nasod.

q: When is the Ati-Atihan festival held every year?
options: On the third Sunday of January
On the first Saturday of February
On the last Sunday of December
On the second Friday of March
explanation: The Ati-Atihan festival is celebrated on the third Sunday of January each year in Kalibo, Aklan.
fact_tl: Ang Ati-Atihan ay ginagawa tuwing ikatlong Linggo ng Enero.
fact_bis: Ang Ati-Atihan gihimo matag ikatulong Domingo sa Enero.

q: Who is credited with coining the word 'radioactivity'?
options: Marie Curie
Albert Einstein
Isaac Newton
Louis Pasteur
explanation: The word 'radioactivity' was coined by Marie Curie.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang lumikha ng salitang 'radyaktibidad' (radioactivity).
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie ang naghimo sa pulong nga 'radyaktibidad' (radioactivity).

q: What made it possible for living things to begin surviving on land millions of years ago?
options: The ozone layer formed as oxygen built up in the atmosphere
Large amounts of carbon dioxide dissolved into the oceans
The continents spread apart creating more land area
Volcanic eruptions cooled the planet enough for life
explanation: Millions of years ago the ozone layer formed as oxygen built up, helping make it safe for living things to survive on land.
fact_tl: Mga milyong taon na ang nakalipas, nabuo ang ozone layer nang dumami ang oksiheno, at nakatulong ito upang mabuhay ang mga nilalang sa lupa.
fact_bis: Milyon ka tuig na ang milabay, naporma ang ozone layer samtang midaghan ang oksiheno, nga nakatabang aron mabuhi ang mga binuhat sa yuta.

q: Even though carbon monoxide is poisonous, it has a useful role in industry. What is one example of that use?
options: Removing oxygen from iron ore to make iron and steel
Adding color to plastics in a factory
Cooling machines that get too hot during manufacturing
Purifying drinking water at treatment plants
explanation: Carbon monoxide is used in making iron and steel to remove oxygen from iron ore, showing that even a dangerous gas can be useful when handled carefully.
fact_tl: Kahit nakakalason ang carbon monoxide, may silbi rin ito sa industriya kapag ligtas na pinangangasiwaan. Halimbawa, ginagamit ito sa pagawaan ng bakal at asero (steel) para alisin ang oxygen sa iron ore, at sa paggawa ng ilang kemikal. Ipinapakita nito na ang isang mapanganib na gas ay may gamit kapag maingat na ginagamit.
fact_bis: Bisan makahilo ang carbon monoxide, adunay pulos usab kini sa industriya kung luwas nga gidumala. Pananglitan, gigamit kini sa paghimo og puthaw ug asero (steel) aron tangtangon ang oxygen sa iron ore, ug sa paghimo og pipila ka kemikal. Gipakita niini nga bisan ang delikado nga gas mahimong magamit kung amping nga gamiton.

q: How does a stick insect protect itself from birds and other predators?
options: Its body looks almost exactly like a twig, hiding it from view
It sprays a foul-smelling liquid when attacked
It makes a loud buzzing sound to scare enemies away
Its bright colors warn predators that it is poisonous
explanation: A stick insect has a body that looks almost exactly like a twig, and this camouflage hides it from birds and other predators.
fact_tl: Ang stick insect ay isang insektong ang katawan ay kahawig na kahawig ng sanga ng kahoy, at ito ang kanyang kamuflahe para hindi siya makita ng mga ibong gustong kumain sa kanya.
fact_bis: Ang stick insect usa ka insekto nga ang lawas susama kaayo sa sanga sa kahoy, ug kini ang iyang takuban aron dili siya makita sa mga langgam nga gustong mokaon kaniya.

q: Besides producing rubber, how does the rubber tree help the environment?
options: It takes in carbon dioxide and releases oxygen, helping clean the air
It filters harmful chemicals out of the soil with its deep roots
It produces a sap that repels insects and keeps pests away
It absorbs salt from the ground, making farmland more fertile
explanation: Like other trees, the rubber tree takes in carbon dioxide and releases oxygen, which helps clean the air.
fact_tl: Bukod sa goma, nakakatulong din ang rubber tree sa kalikasan. Tulad ng ibang puno, sumisipsip ito ng carbon dioxide at naglalabas ng oxygen na nakakatulong linisin ang hangin at magbigay ng lilim.
fact_bis: Gawas sa paghatag og goma, ang rubber tree makatabang usab sa kinaiyahan. Sama sa ubang kahoy, mosuyop kini og carbon dioxide ug mobuga og oxygen, nga makatabang sa paglimpyo sa hangin ug paghatag og landong.

q: In a termite colony, which group is responsible for finding food and building the nest?
options: The workers
The soldiers
The queen
The drones
explanation: In a termite colony the workers find food and build the nest, while the queen lays eggs and the soldiers defend the colony.
fact_tl: Sa kolonya ng anay, may iba't ibang uri na may sariling tungkulin: ang reyna ang nangingitlog; ang mga manggagawa ang naghahanap ng pagkain at nagpapagawa ng pugad; at ang mga sundalo ang nagdedepensa sa kolonya.
fact_bis: Sa kolonya sa anay, adunay nagkalainlaing matang nga may kaugalingong tahas: ang reyna ang mangitlog; ang mga trabahante ang mangita og pagkaon ug magtukod sa pugad; ug ang mga sundalo ang magdepensa sa kolonya.

q: What is the highest value that longitude can reach on Earth?
options: 180 degrees
360 degrees
90 degrees
270 degrees
explanation: Longitude ranges from 0 degrees at the prime meridian to 180 degrees.
fact_tl: Ang longhitud ay umaabot mula 0 degrees sa prime meridian hanggang 180 degrees.
fact_bis: Ang longitude gikan 0 degrees sa prime meridian hangtod 180 degrees.

q: What is the Benham Plateau (Philippine Rise)?
options: A large underwater plateau in the Pacific Ocean within the Philippines' Exclusive Economic Zone
A mountain range in the northern Philippines rich in gold and copper
A deep ocean trench along the eastern coast of Mindanao
A coral reef system located inside the Sulu Sea
explanation: The Benham Plateau (Philippine Rise) is a large submarine plateau in the Pacific Ocean within the Philippines' Exclusive Economic Zone, recognized as a potential source of minerals.
fact_tl: Ang Benham Plateau (Philippine Rise) ay isang malaking submarine plateau sa Pacific Ocean na nakatuklas sa Exclusive Economic Zone ng Pilipinas; ito ay kilala bilang isang potensyal na pinagkukunan ng mga mineral at isang mahalagang bahagi ng karagatang pag-aari ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Benham Plateau (Philippine Rise) usa ka dako nga submarine plateau sa Pacific Ocean sulod sa Exclusive Economic Zone sa Pilipinas; kini kilala ingon nga potensyal nga gigikanan sa mga mineral ug usa ka importante nga bahin sa dagat nga teritoryo sa nasod.

q: What is the job of the tonsils in your body?
options: They help trap germs that enter through the mouth and nose
They produce digestive juices that break down food
They filter waste products out of the blood
They send electrical signals from the brain to the muscles
explanation: The tonsils help trap germs that enter through the mouth and nose.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang tonsils na harangin ang mga mikrobyong pumapasok sa bibig at ilong.
fact_bis: Ang tonsils makatabang sa pagsalo sa mga mikrobyo nga mosulod sa baba ug ilong.

q: What is nectar, and why do pollinators visit flowers to get it?
options: A sweet liquid inside a flower that pollinators use as food
A sticky powder that clings to insects and helps them fly
A scent released by flowers to attract butterflies at night
A colorful pigment in petals that signals the flower is ripe
explanation: Nectar is a sweet liquid inside a flower that pollinators use as food.
fact_tl: Ang nektar ay matamis na likido sa loob ng bulaklak na ginagawang pagkain ng mga pollinator.
fact_bis: Ang nektar usa ka tam-is nga likido sulod sa bulak nga gigamit nga pagkaon sa mga pollinator.

q: What energy transformation happens inside a generator?
options: Kinetic (motion) energy becomes electrical energy
Chemical energy becomes light energy
Heat energy becomes sound energy
Electrical energy becomes mechanical energy
explanation: In a generator, kinetic or motion energy becomes electrical energy.
fact_tl: Sa generator, ang enerhiya ng paggalaw o kinetiko ay nagiging enerhiyang elektrikal.
fact_bis: Sa generator, ang enerhiya sa paglihok o kinetiko mahimong elektrikal nga enerhiya.

q: How can lightning actually help plants grow?
options: Its intense heat combines nitrogen in the air into a form plants can absorb through rain
It heats the soil so roots grow deeper toward moisture
It breaks apart rock, releasing minerals that wash into the soil
It produces ozone that protects leaves from harmful ultraviolet rays
explanation: Lightning's intense heat can combine nitrogen in the air into a form plants can use, and rain carries it into the soil.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang init ng kidlat ay nakakapagpagsama ng nitrogen sa hangin upang maging anyong magagamit ng halaman. Dinadala ito ng ulan sa lupa, kaya nakakatulong pala ang kidlat sa pagtubo ng mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang grabe nga kainit sa kilat makahiusa sa nitrogen sa hangin ngadto sa porma nga magamit sa mga tanom. Dad-on kini sa ulan ngadto sa yuta, mao nga ang kilat makatabang diay sa pagtubo sa mga tanom.

q: Who became President of the Philippines after Manuel Roxas died in 1948?
options: Elpidio Quirino
Ramon Magsaysay
Carlos P. Garcia
Diosdado Macapagal
explanation: Elpidio Quirino became President after Roxas died in 1948, and he was the sixth President of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Si Elpidio Quirino ang naging Pangulo matapos mamatay si Roxas noong 1948, at siya ang ikaanim na Pangulo.
fact_bis: Si Elpidio Quirino ang nahimong Presidente human mamatay si Roxas niadtong 1948, ug siya ang ikaunom nga Presidente.

q: Why does a convex lens sometimes produce an upside-down image?
options: When the object is far away, light rays cross after the focal point, flipping the image
The glass curves inward, bending all light beams downward
The coating on the lens reflects some light back, reversing the image
Light travels slower through thick glass, causing the image to rotate
explanation: When the object is far from the lens, the light rays cross after the focal point, so the image flips upside down — this is how projectors and cameras work.
fact_tl: Bakit minsan baligtad ang larawang nabubuo ng convex lens? Kapag malayo ang bagay sa lens, nagsasalubong ang mga sinag ng liwanag pagkatapos ng focal point, kaya nababaligtad ang larawan — ganito gumagana ang proyektor at kamera.
fact_bis: Ngano nga usahay baliktad ang hulagway nga buhaton sa convex lens? Kung layo ang butang sa lente, magtagbo ang mga silaw sa kahayag human sa focal point, mao nga mobaliktad ang hulagway — ingon niini molihok ang projector ug kamera.

q: How do elephants help plants spread to new areas?
options: They carry plant seeds in their droppings and deposit them far away
They dig up roots with their tusks and plant them elsewhere
They spray water from their trunks onto dry seeds to help them sprout
They knock down old trees so sunlight reaches new seedlings
explanation: Elephants help nature by spreading plant seeds through their droppings.
fact_tl: Nakakatulong ang elepante sa kalikasan dahil ikinakalat nito ang mga buto ng halaman sa pamamagitan ng dumi nito.
fact_bis: Makatabang ang elepante sa kinaiyahan tungod kay ipakatag niini ang mga liso sa tanom pinaagi sa hugaw niini.

q: What happens to the weather in the Philippines when the habagat arrives?
options: It rains frequently, so children carry umbrellas more often on the way to school
Strong dry winds blow dust across the streets every afternoon
The temperature drops sharply and mornings become very cold and foggy
Typhoons stop forming and the skies stay clear for weeks
explanation: When the habagat arrives, it rains frequently, so children carry umbrellas more often on the way to school.
fact_tl: Pagdating ng habagat, mas madalas magdala ng payong ang mga bata dahil malimit umulan sa daan papasok ng eskwela.
fact_bis: Pag-abot sa habagat, mas masagad magdala og payong ang mga bata kay kanunay mag-ulan sa dalan paingon sa eskwelahan.

q: What is special about many of the freshwater fish found in the rivers and lakes of the Philippines?
options: They are endemic, meaning they are found only in specific parts of the Philippines
They can survive equally well in both fresh water and salt water
They migrate every year to rivers in other Asian countries to breed
They are the largest freshwater fish species found anywhere in Southeast Asia
explanation: The rivers and lakes of the Philippines are home to hundreds of freshwater fish species that are endemic, or found only in specific parts of the country.
fact_tl: Ang mga ilog at lawa ng Pilipinas ay tahanan ng daan-daang uri ng isda sa tabang na tubig na endemiko o makikita lamang sa ilang lugar sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang mga ilog ug danaw sa Pilipinas puy-anan sa gatusan ka species sa isda sa tabang nga tubig nga endemiko o makita lamang sa piho nga mga lugar sa nasud.

q: In which region of the Philippines is the province of Pampanga located?
options: Central Luzon (Region III)
Ilocos Region (Region I)
Calabarzon (Region IV-A)
Cagayan Valley (Region II)
explanation: Pampanga is a province in the Central Luzon region (Region III) of the Philippines, and its capital is San Fernando.
fact_tl: Ang Pampanga ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Central Luzon (III), na bahagi ng Luzon. Ang kabisera nito ay San Fernando.
fact_bis: Ang Pampanga usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Central Luzon (III), nga bahin sa Luzon. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang San Fernando.

q: How do large Philippine fruit bats like flying foxes find their food?
options: They use their vision to locate fruit
They use echolocation like smaller insect-eating bats
They follow scent trails left by other animals
They use sensitive hearing to detect fruit falling from trees
explanation: Large Philippine fruit bats like flying foxes are megabats that use vision to find food, not echolocation like the smaller insect-eating microbats.
fact_tl: Ang mga malaking fruit bat ng Pilipinas tulad ng flying fox ay megabat na gumagamit ng paningin para mahanap ang pagkain, hindi echolocation tulad ng maliliit na insektibore na bat.
fact_bis: Ang mga dako nga fruit bat sa Pilipinas sama sa flying fox mga megabat nga mogamit sa panan-aw sa pagpangita og pagkaon, dili echolocation sama sa gagmayng insektibore nga bat.

q: What are the three main layers of the Earth, from outermost to innermost?
options: Crust, mantle, and core
Crust, magma, and inner core
Atmosphere, lithosphere, and asthenosphere
Outer shell, middle ring, and lava center
explanation: The Earth has three main layers: the crust (the outer skin), the mantle (the thick middle layer), and the core (the center).
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay may tatlong pangunahing patong (layer): ang crust (balat sa labas), ang mantle (makapal na patong sa gitna), at ang core (kaibuturan). Tulad ito ng itlog: ang balat ay crust, ang puti ay mantle, at ang dilaw ay core.
fact_bis: Ang Earth adunay tulo ka nag-unang patong (layer): ang crust (panit sa gawas), ang mantle (baga nga patong sa tunga), ug ang core (kinauyokan). Sama kini sa itlog: ang panit mao ang crust, ang puti mao ang mantle, ug ang pula mao ang core.

q: Why does adrenaline make you breathe faster when you are scared or in danger?
options: So more oxygen enters your lungs to power your muscles to move quickly
So your body temperature drops to keep your brain cool under stress
So carbon dioxide builds up in your blood and makes you more alert
So your heart slows down and your body conserves energy for later
explanation: Adrenaline makes you breathe faster so more oxygen can enter your lungs, giving your muscles the oxygen they need to move quickly and strongly.
fact_tl: Pinapabilis din ng adrenaline ang iyong paghinga para mas maraming oxygen ang makapasok sa baga. Itong dagdag na oxygen ay kailangan ng kalamnan para makakilos nang mabilis at malakas.
fact_bis: Gipakusog usab sa adrenaline ang imong pagginhawa aron mas daghang oxygen ang makasulod sa imong baga. Kini nga dugang oxygen mao ang gikinahanglan sa kaunoran aron molihok og paspas ug kusgan.

q: What are the names of the two moons of Mars?
options: Phobos and Deimos
Titan and Ganymede
Europa and Callisto
Triton and Charon
explanation: Mars has two small moons called Phobos and Deimos; they are shaped like potatoes and are probably captured asteroids.
fact_tl: Ang Mars ay may dalawang maliit na buwan na tinatawag na Phobos at Deimos; hindi sila bilog tulad ng Moon ng Earth kundi may hugis na katulad ng patatas, at malamang na mga captured asteroid ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang Mars adunay duha ka gamay nga buwan nga ginganlan og Phobos ug Deimos; dili sila bilog sama sa Moon sa Yuta kondili adunay porma nga sama sa patatas, ug lagmit mga captured asteroid kini.

q: Why can corn be planted in most parts of the Philippines?
options: Corn grows well in the warm climate that the Philippines has
Corn needs very little water, and the Philippines has very dry soil
Corn thrives in cold highlands, which cover most of the Philippines
Corn grows best in salty coastal soil found throughout the country
explanation: Corn grows well in the warm climate of the Philippines, so it can be planted in most parts of the country.
fact_tl: Mahusay tumubo ang mais sa mainit na klima ng Pilipinas, kaya kaya itong itanim sa karamihan ng bahagi ng bansa.
fact_bis: Maayo motubo ang mais sa init nga klima sa Pilipinas, mao nga mahimo kining itanom sa kadaghanan nga bahin sa nasud.

q: Why is boiling a safe way to make unsafe water fit to drink?
options: Boiling kills the germs that can cause diarrhea and other illnesses
Boiling removes salt and minerals that are bad for the body
Boiling adds oxygen to the water, making it taste fresher
Boiling causes dirt particles to sink to the bottom of the container
explanation: Boiling water kills germs that can cause diarrhea and other illnesses, making dirty water safe to drink.
fact_tl: Ang pagpapakulo ng tubig ay pumapatay sa mikrobyong maaaring magdulot ng pagtatae at iba pang sakit, kaya ito ay isang ligtas na paraan para gawing maiinom ang maruming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagpabukal sa tubig makapatay sa mikrobyo nga makahatag og kalibanga ug uban pang sakit, mao nga kini usa ka luwas nga paagi aron mahimong mainom ang hugaw nga tubig.

q: Which is the largest muscle in the human body, and what does it help you do?
options: The muscle in the buttocks; it helps us stand up and climb
The muscle in the thigh; it helps us run fast and jump high
The muscle in the upper arm; it helps us lift and carry heavy things
The muscle in the back; it helps us bend forward and straighten up
explanation: The largest muscle in the body is in the buttocks, and it helps us stand up and climb.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking kalamnan sa katawan ay nasa puwit, at tumutulong ito sa pagtayo at pag-akyat.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga kaunuran sa lawas anaa sa lubot, ug motabang kini sa pagtindog ug pagsaka.

q: What does finding lots of earthworms in the ground tell you about the soil?
options: The soil is healthy and rich
The soil is too dry and needs water
The soil contains harmful chemicals from pollution
The soil is too sandy and cannot support plant roots
explanation: Lots of earthworms in the ground is a sign that the soil is healthy and rich.
fact_tl: Kapag maraming bulate sa lupa, palatandaan ito na malusog at matabang lupa.
fact_bis: Kon daghan og bulate ang yuta, timailhan kini nga himsog ug tambok ang yuta.

q: Why do most children end up with DNA that is almost identical to their parents'?
options: Mutations in any one gene are very rare because the body guards and repairs DNA so well
Genes are locked inside bones, which protect them from any changes
Children copy their parents' genes exactly through a process that never makes any errors
Only one parent passes genes to the child, so only half the DNA can change
explanation: Mutations are rare for any one particular gene because the body guards and repairs DNA so well, which is why most of us have DNA almost identical to our parents'.
fact_tl: Madalang mangyari ang mutation sa isang partikular na gene. Bagaman bilyon-bilyon ang letra sa DNA at maraming cell na naghahati araw-araw, napakaganda ng pag-iingat at pag-aayos ng katawan kaya bihirang magbago ang isang tiyak na gene. Kaya naman karamihan sa atin ay halos kapareho ng DNA ng ating mga magulang.
fact_bis: Panagsa ra mahitabo ang mutation sa usa ka partikular nga gene. Bisan og binilyon ang letra sa DNA ug daghang cell ang mabahin matag adlaw, maayo kaayo ang pagbantay ug pag-ayo sa lawas mao nga panagsa ra mausab ang usa ka piho nga gene. Mao nga kadaghanan kanato adunay DNA nga halos pareho sa atong mga ginikanan.

q: What happens if a young stick insect loses one of its legs?
options: It can grow a new leg back when it sheds its skin
The leg is permanently lost and the insect learns to walk with five legs
The wound heals over and leaves a hard stump that protects the insect
Other insects in the group carry the injured stick insect until it recovers
explanation: If a young stick insect loses a leg, it can grow a new one back when it sheds its skin.
fact_tl: Kung mawalan ng paa ang batang stick insect, maaari itong muling tumubo kapag nagpalit ito ng balat.
fact_bis: Kon mawad-an ug tiil ang batan-ong stick insect, makatubo kini ug bag-o kon mag-ilis kini sa iyang panit.

q: What can a strong habagat cause in parts of the Philippines?
options: Many days of rain that lead to flooding
A long dry spell that dries up rivers and farms
Powerful earthquakes along coastal areas
Extremely cold temperatures that freeze mountain lakes
explanation: A strong habagat can bring many days of rain that cause flooding in parts of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang malakas na habagat ay maaaring magdala ng maraming araw na pag-ulan na nagdudulot ng baha sa ilang bahagi ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang kusog nga habagat mahimong magdala og daghang adlaw nga pag-ulan nga maoy hinungdan sa baha sa pipila ka bahin sa Pilipinas.

q: What comes out when you cut a jackfruit, and how do people protect themselves from it?
options: Sticky sap; people rub oil on their hands and knife so it does not stick
Sweet juice; people wear gloves so the juice does not stain their skin
Tiny seeds; people cover the fruit with cloth to catch the seeds
A strong smell; people hold their breath and cut quickly to avoid it
explanation: When you cut a jackfruit, sticky sap comes out, so people rub oil on their hands and knife so the sap does not stick.
fact_tl: Kapag hinihiwa ang langka, may malagkit itong dagta na lumalabas. Madalas pinapahiran ng mantika ang kamay at kutsilyo para hindi dumikit ang dagta.
fact_bis: Kon putlon ang nangka, naa kini pilit nga duga nga mogawas. Kasagaran ginahiran og lana ang kamot ug kutsilyo aron dili modikit ang duga.

q: How does the lifespan of a queen ant compare to that of a worker ant?
options: The queen can live for many years, while workers live only a few months
The worker and the queen live the same length of time, about one year
Worker ants outlive the queen because they stay safe underground
The queen lives only a few weeks because laying eggs wears her out quickly
explanation: A queen ant can live for many years, while worker ants live only a few months.
fact_tl: Ang reyna ng langgam ay maaaring mabuhay nang maraming taon, samantalang ang mga manggagawang langgam ay ilang buwan lang.
fact_bis: Ang rayna sa hulmigas mabuhi og daghang tuig, samtang ang trabahante nga mga hulmigas pila lang ka bulan.

q: Where did Emilio Aguinaldo first officially wave the Philippine flag?
options: At Kawit, Cavite on June 12, 1898
At Malolos, Bulacan on July 4, 1896
At Intramuros, Manila on June 12, 1896
At Batangas City on August 23, 1896
explanation: Emilio Aguinaldo first officially waved the flag at Kawit, Cavite on June 12, 1898 during the declaration of independence.
fact_tl: Unang opisyal na iwinagayway ni Emilio Aguinaldo ang bandila sa Kawit, Cavite noong Hunyo 12, 1898 sa pagpapahayag ng kalayaan.
fact_bis: Si Emilio Aguinaldo ang unang opisyal nga nagwagayway sa bandila sa Kawit, Cavite niadtong Hunyo 12, 1898 sa pagpahayag sa kagawasan.

q: Where in the Philippines is the Puerto Princesa Underground River located?
options: Palawan
Cebu
Mindanao
Batangas
explanation: The Puerto Princesa Underground River is in Palawan, Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River ay nasa Palawan, Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River anaa sa Palawan, Pilipinas.

q: What happens when two particles that have the same type of electric charge are placed near each other?
options: They push each other away
They attract and stick together
They cancel each other out and become neutral
They spin around each other like tiny planets
explanation: Particles with the same charge, like two protons, push each other away.
fact_tl: Ang mga particle na magkaparehong charge, tulad ng dalawang proton, ay nagtataboyan sa isa't isa.
fact_bis: Ang mga particle nga managsama og charge, sama sa duha ka proton, mag-abog sa usag usa.

q: What device is officially used to define the exact length of one second worldwide?
options: An atomic clock
A pendulum clock
A digital stopwatch
A quartz wristwatch
explanation: The atomic clock is officially used to define the exact length of one second worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang atomic clock ang opisyal na ginagamit upang tukuyin ang eksaktong haba ng isang segundo sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang atomic clock mao ang opisyal nga gigamit aron mahubit ang tukmang gitas-on sa usa ka segundo sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: Why won't an ordinary electric fan turn itself off when the room becomes cool?
options: A fan has no thermostat, so it cannot measure the room's temperature and must be switched off by hand
A fan's motor breaks down when the air is too cold, so it stops on its own
A fan always runs at the same speed regardless of what button you press
A fan is connected to the same switch as the lights, so turning off the lights stops it
explanation: An ordinary electric fan has no thermostat — it doesn't measure the room's heat, so it won't stop by itself when it's cool; you must switch it off by hand.
fact_tl: Ang ordinaryong electric fan ay walang thermostat. Hindi ito sumusukat ng init ng kwarto basta umiihip lang ito sa speed na pinili mo. Kaya hindi ito kusang humihinto kapag malamig na, kailangan mong patayin nang mano-mano. Ang aircon ang gumagamit ng thermostat para sukatin ang init.
fact_bis: Ang ordinaryong electric fan walay thermostat. Dili kini magsukod sa init sa kwarto mohuyop lang kini sa speed nga imong gipili. Mao nga dili kini mohunong sa kaugalingon kon bugnaw na; kinahanglan nimo kining palungon pinaagi sa kamot. Ang aircon ang naggamit og thermostat aron sukdon ang init.

q: Which statement best shows how ecologically significant termites are on Earth?
options: The combined weight of all termites on Earth exceeds the combined weight of all humans
Termites are found on every continent, including Antarctica
A single termite queen can lay more than one million eggs per day
Termites build mounds that are taller than any building made by humans
explanation: The combined weight (biomass) of all termites on Earth exceeds the combined weight of all humans, showing how ecologically significant these insects are.
fact_tl: Ang kabuuang timbang (biomass) ng lahat ng anay sa mundo ay mas mabigat kaysa sa kabuuang timbang ng lahat ng tao—nagpapakita ito kung gaano kahalagang bahagi ang mga anay sa ecosystem ng mundo.
fact_bis: Ang tibuok timbang (biomass) sa tanan nga anay sa kalibutan labaw pa sa tibuok timbang sa tanan nga tawo—nagpakita niini kung unsa ka importante ang mga anay ingon bahin sa ecosystem sa kalibutan.

q: What was the nationality of the astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus?
options: Polish
German
Italian
Czech
explanation: Nicolaus Copernicus was a Polish astronomer from Poland.
fact_tl: Si Nicolaus Copernicus ay isang astronomong Polako (taga-Poland).
fact_bis: Si Nicolaus Copernicus usa ka astronomong Polako gikan sa Poland.

q: What does the climbing perch eat?
options: Small animals like insects, worms, shrimp, and tiny fish, as well as water plants
Only algae and underwater plants attached to rocks
Mainly large fish and frogs that live near the riverbank
Exclusively insects that land on the surface of the water
explanation: The climbing perch eats small animals like insects, worms, shrimp, and tiny fish, and also eats water plants, so it is not picky about food.
fact_tl: Ang climbing perch ay kumakain ng maliliit na hayop tulad ng insekto, uod, hipon, at maliliit na isda. Kumakain din ito ng mga halaman sa tubig, kaya hindi ito mapili sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang climbing perch mokaon og gagmay nga mananap sama sa insekto, ulod, pasayan, ug gagmay nga isda. Mokaon usab kini og mga tanom sa tubig, mao nga dili kini mapilion sa pagkaon.

q: Which element appears first in the periodic table with atomic number 1?
options: Hydrogen
Helium
Carbon
Oxygen
explanation: Hydrogen is the first element in the periodic table, with atomic number 1.
fact_tl: Ang hydrogen ang unang elemento sa periodic table, na may atomic number na 1.
fact_bis: Ang hydrogen mao ang unang elemento sa periodic table, nga adunay atomic number nga 1.

q: Which layer of Earth's atmosphere is the outermost, where the air slowly fades into space?
options: The exosphere
The thermosphere
The mesosphere
The stratosphere
explanation: The exosphere is the outermost layer of the atmosphere, where the air slowly fades away into space.
fact_tl: Ang exosphere ang pinakalabas na patong ng atmospera, kung saan unti-unting kumakaunti ang hangin papunta sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang exosphere mao ang pinakagawas nga sapaw sa atmospera, diin hinay-hinay nga mawala ang hangin paingon sa kawanangan.

q: In a pot of boiling water, what is the circular movement called where hot water rises and cooler water sinks?
options: Convection
Conduction
Radiation
Evaporation
explanation: In a pot of boiling water, hot water at the bottom rises while cooler water at the top sinks — this circular motion is called convection, and it heats all the water.
fact_tl: Sa kumukulong tubig sa kaldero, umaakyat ang mainit na tubig sa ilalim malapit sa apoy, at bumababa naman ang mas malamig na tubig sa itaas. Ang paikot na galaw na ito ay convection na nagpapainit sa buong tubig.
fact_bis: Sa nagbubukal nga tubig sa kaldero, mosaka ang init nga tubig sa ilawom duol sa kalayo, samtang mokunsad ang mas bugnaw nga tubig sa ibabaw. Kini nga paliyok nga paglihok mao ang convection nga nag-init sa tibuok tubig.

q: Why do planets that are closer to the Sun orbit faster than planets farther away?
options: Closer planets feel stronger gravity from the Sun, which pulls them along faster
Closer planets are smaller and lighter, so they naturally move more quickly
Closer planets have thinner atmospheres, which create less drag to slow them down
Closer planets formed more recently and still have leftover speed from their formation
explanation: Planets closer to the Sun feel stronger gravity, so they orbit faster than the planets farther away.
fact_tl: Ang mga planetang mas malapit sa Araw ay nakakaramdam ng mas malakas na grabidad, kaya mas mabilis silang umiikot kaysa sa malalayong planeta.
fact_bis: Ang mga planeta nga mas duol sa Adlaw mas kusog ang gibug-aton nga ilang gibati, mao nga mas paspas sila motuyok kaysa sa mga halayo nga planeta.

q: Why can't you scoop up or hold steam in your hand?
options: Steam is a gas, so it slips through your fingers and spreads into the air
Steam is too hot and immediately turns into ice when it touches cool skin
Steam is a liquid, so it pours off your hands like water
Steam is very heavy, so it sinks to the floor before you can grab it
explanation: Steam is a gas, so it just slips through your fingers and spreads into the air — you can't catch it.
fact_tl: Pwede mo bang sahurin o hawakan ang singaw? Hindi! Ang singaw ay gas, kaya dumadaan lang ito sa mga daliri mo at kumakalat sa hangin — hindi mo ito mahuhuli. At hindi mo dapat subukan dahil mainit ito at nakaka-paso. Tingnan na lang, huwag hawakan.
fact_bis: Mahimo ba nimong sakpon o kuptan ang singaw? Dili! Ang singaw kay gas, mao nga moagi lang kini sa imong mga tudlo ug mokatag sa hangin — dili nimo kini madakpan. Ug dili nimo angay sulayan kay init kini ug makapaso. Tan-awa lang, ayaw hikapa.

q: Why does sound or light get weaker the farther you are from its source?
options: As a wave travels farther, its energy spreads over a wider area, making it weaker
Waves slow down over distance and lose energy through friction with the air
The air absorbs the wave completely after it travels a certain distance
Waves reflect off the ground repeatedly, and each bounce removes some energy
explanation: As a wave travels farther from its source, its energy spreads over a wider area, so sound or light grows weaker the farther away you are.
fact_tl: Habang lumalayo ang isang alon mula sa pinagmulan nito, kumakalat ang enerhiya sa mas malawak na lugar, kaya't humihina ang tunog o liwanag kapag mas malayo ka na.
fact_bis: Samtang molayo ang balod gikan sa gigikanan niini, mokatag ang enerhiya sa mas lapad nga dapit, mao nga mokahuyang ang tingog o kahayag kung mas layo ka na.

q: Why is washing your hands important for people other than just yourself?
options: It stops germs from spreading to other people, especially babies and the elderly who have weaker defenses
It removes vitamins from your skin that could make others allergic if they touch you
It prevents your own fingerprints from leaving marks that carry viruses on surfaces
It keeps your hands warm, which makes you less likely to sneeze on others
explanation: Handwashing stops germs from spreading to other people, especially babies and the elderly who have weaker defenses, so the whole family is better protected.
fact_tl: Ang paghuhugas ng kamay ay hindi lang para sa sarili — pinipigilan din nito ang pagkalat ng germ sa ibang tao, lalo na sa mga sanggol at matatanda na mas mahina ang resistensya. Kapag malinis ang kamay mo, mas protektado ang buong pamilya.
fact_bis: Ang paghugas sa kamot dili lang para sa kaugalingon — mapugngan usab niini ang pagkatap sa germ ngadto sa uban, ilabi na sa mga masuso ug tigulang nga mas huyang ang resistensya. Kung limpyo ang imong kamot, mas protektado ang tibuok pamilya.

q: What does a sailfin lizard do when it feels threatened by a predator?
options: It dives into water and can swim and hide underwater for several minutes
It puffs up its body to look bigger and hisses loudly at the attacker
It drops its tail, which wriggles on the ground to distract the predator
It changes color to match the ground and stays completely still
explanation: When threatened, the sailfin lizard dives into water and can swim and hide underwater for several minutes.
fact_tl: Kapag nanganganib, ang sailfin lizard ay sumasagpang sa tubig at kaya nitong lumangoy at magtago sa ilalim ng tubig nang ilang minuto.
fact_bis: Kung may peligro, ang sailfin lizard mosunod sa tubig ug makalangoy ug magtago sa ilawom sa tubig sulod sa pipila ka minuto.

q: How does the coloring of a shark's body help it hide in the ocean?
options: Its dark back and pale belly (countershading) make it hard to spot from above or below
Its silver stripes reflect sunlight and blend in with the sparkling surface of the water
Its bright blue color matches the deep ocean where most sharks live
Its spotted pattern looks like the sandy ocean floor where it rests
explanation: A shark's dark back and pale belly is a trick called countershading that makes the shark hard to spot from above or below in the water.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pagiging magaspang, ang kulay ng balat ng pating ay tumutulong rin sa pagtatago. Karaniwang madilim ang likod nito at maputi ang tiyan — isang trick na tinatawag na countershading na nagpapahirap makita ang pating mula sa itaas o sa ibaba sa tubig.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagkagaspang, ang kolor sa panit sa iho makatabang usab sa pagtago. Kasagaran itom ang likod niini ug puti ang tiyan — usa ka paagi nga gitawag countershading nga maghimo nga lisod makita ang iho gikan sa taas o ubos sa tubig.

q: What is the most important job of fuses and circuit breakers in a home?
options: To cut the power before overheated wires can start a fire
To store extra electricity when the main supply is turned off
To increase the voltage so appliances run more efficiently
To measure how much electricity each appliance uses every month
explanation: The most important job of fuses and breakers is to prevent fires by cutting the power before overheated wires can burn the insulation and start a flame.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamahalagang trabaho ng fuse at breaker ay pigilan ang sunog. Kapag sobra ang kuryente, umiinit nang husto ang mga wire — puwedeng masunog ang insulation at magkaroon ng apoy. Pinuputol ng fuse o breaker ang kuryente bago mangyari iyon, kaya ligtas ang bahay.
fact_bis: Ang pinakaimportante nga trabaho sa fuse ug breaker mao ang pagpugong sa sunog. Kung sobra ang kuryente, mainit kaayo ang mga wire — mahimong masunog ang insulation ug mosiga. Putlon sa fuse o breaker ang kuryente sa dili pa kana mahitabo, busa luwas ang balay.

q: How is resting for a fever different from resting a sprained ankle?
options: With a fever the whole body rests to fight germs, while with a sprain only the injured part rests to repair
With a fever you keep moving to sweat out the germs, while a sprain means complete bed rest
Both require the same kind of rest: stay in bed and do not move any part of the body
A fever requires exercise to raise your temperature, while a sprain requires keeping the limb elevated
explanation: Resting for a fever means the whole body rests to gather strength to fight germs, while with a sprain or broken bone just one part rests so it can repair.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang pahinga sa lagnat at pahinga sa nasugatang bahagi. Sa lagnat, ang buong katawan ang nagpapahinga para makaipon ng lakas sa paglaban sa mikrobyo. Sa pilay o nabaling buto, isang bahagi lang ang pinapahinga para makapag-ayos ito.
fact_bis: Lahi ang pahulay sa hilanat ug ang pahulay sa nasamdan nga bahin. Sa hilanat, ang tibuok lawas magpahulay aron makatigom ug kusog sa pakig-away sa mikrobyo. Sa pilay o nabali nga bukog, usa lang ka bahin ang pahulayan aron makaayo kini.

q: What keeps a cuttlebone both strong and very light?
options: Tiny pillars between its many thin stacked layers
A solid hard shell with no air spaces inside
A spongy foam material soaked in seawater
Long thick ribs running through its center
explanation: A cuttlebone is made of many thin layers with tiny pillars between them that keep it strong while staying very light.
fact_tl: Kapag tinignan mo ng malapitan ang cuttlebone, makikita mo na gawa ito sa maraming manipis na patong na nakasalansan na parang mga papel. Ang mga maliliit na haligi sa pagitan ng patong ang nagpapatibay nito habang nananatiling magaan.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon nimo og duol ang cuttlebone, makita nimo nga hinimo kini sa daghang nipis nga mga sapaw nga gipatong sama sa papel. Ang gagmay nga mga haligi tali sa mga sapaw maoy naghimo niini nga lig-on apan gaan gihapon.

q: Which island group is Palawan usually counted as part of?
options: Luzon
Visayas
Mindanao
Palawan is its own separate island group
explanation: Palawan, found in the western part of the Philippines, is usually counted as part of the Luzon island group.
fact_tl: Ang Palawan, na nasa kanlurang bahagi, ay karaniwang ibinibilang sa pangkat ng mga isla ng Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Palawan, nga naa sa kasadpang bahin, kasagarang giapil sa grupo sa mga pulo sa Luzon.

q: What happens when overfishing occurs?
options: Fish are caught faster than they can reproduce, so their numbers keep falling
Fish populations grow too large and overflow into shallow waters
Fishermen use nets that accidentally catch too many different species
Fish reproduce faster than they can be caught, causing overpopulation
explanation: Overfishing means catching fish faster than they can reproduce, which causes their numbers in the sea to keep falling.
fact_tl: Ang overfishing ay ang sobra-sobrang panghuhuli ng isda, kaya hindi na nakakahabol dumami ang mga isda sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang overfishing mao ang sobra nga pagpangisda, mao nga dili na makasunod og daghan ang mga isda sa dagat.

q: Which of these useful products can be made from tree bark?
options: Rope and paper
Glass and plastic
Metal wire and cloth
Rubber and concrete
explanation: Bark can be used to make rope, paper, and other useful things.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng puno ay ginagawa ring lubid, papel, at iba pang kapaki-pakinabang na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa kahoy gihimo usab nga pisi, papel, ug uban pang mapuslanon nga butang.

q: How small a gap can an octopus squeeze through?
options: A gap as small as its eye
A gap as small as its head
A gap as small as its arm
A gap as small as its whole body length
explanation: Because an octopus has no bones, it can squeeze through a gap as small as its eye.
fact_tl: Dahil walang buto, ang pugita ay makakalusot sa napakaliit na siwang na kasinglaki lang ng mata nito.
fact_bis: Tungod kay walay bukog, ang pugita makalusot sa gamay kaayo nga lungag nga sama lang kadako sa iyang mata.

q: How does a solar still clean dirty water?
options: The sun's heat evaporates the dirty water and clean drops collect under a plastic cover
Sunlight kills the bacteria in the water by shining directly on it
A plastic cover filters out dirt particles as water passes through it
The sun heats a special chemical that reacts with the dirt and removes it
explanation: A solar still uses the sun's heat to evaporate dirty water, and the clean drops collect under a plastic cover.
fact_tl: Ang init ng araw ay maaaring gamitin sa isang solar still upang pasingawin ang maruming tubig at kolektahin ang malinis na patak sa ilalim ng plastik na takip.
fact_bis: Ang kainit sa adlaw mahimong gamiton sa solar still aron pasingawon ang hugaw nga tubig ug tigumon ang limpyo nga tulo ilalom sa plastik nga taklob.

q: Why is it better for Philippine island communities to protect reef sharks instead of catching them?
options: Tourists pay to dive and see reef sharks alive, bringing income and jobs to the community
Reef sharks eat other fish that would otherwise destroy coral reefs
Catching reef sharks is against Philippine law and carries heavy fines
Reef shark meat is poisonous, so catching them puts fishermen in danger
explanation: Many tourists come to the Philippines to dive and see reef sharks alive, bringing income and jobs to island communities.
fact_tl: Maraming turista ang pumupunta sa Pilipinas para sumisid at makita ang mga reef shark nang buhay. Nagdudulot ito ng kita at trabaho sa mga taga-isla, kaya mas mabuting protektahan ang mga pating kaysa hulihin.
fact_bis: Daghang turista ang moadto sa Pilipinas aron mosalom ug makita ang mga reef shark nga buhi. Naghatag kini ug kita ug trabaho sa mga lumulupyo sa isla, busa mas maayong panalipdan ang mga iho kaysa dakpon.

q: What happens to your muscles when you move and exercise often?
options: They grow stronger
They grow longer and thinner
They become more flexible but weaker
They store more fat to give you energy
explanation: When we move and exercise often, our muscles grow stronger.
fact_tl: Kapag madalas tayong gumagalaw at nag-eehersisyo, lumalakas ang ating mga kalamnan.
fact_bis: Kung kanunay tang molihok ug mag-ehersisyo, mokusog ang atong mga unod o kaunoran.

q: How do a bird's feathers help keep it warm?
options: They trap the bird's body heat close to its skin
They reflect sunlight so the bird does not overheat
They absorb heat from the sun and store it inside
They block cold wind by lying flat against the body
explanation: A bird's thick feathers trap its body heat, keeping the bird warm.
fact_tl: Pinipigil ng makakapal na balahibo ng ibon ang init ng katawan nito kaya hindi ito nilalamig.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga balhibo sa langgam mopugong sa kainit sa lawas niini aron dili kini bugnawan.

q: If you push a wall with a force of 10 newtons, how large is the wall's reaction force on you?
options: 10 newtons, pointing back at you
More than 10 newtons, because the wall is heavier
Less than 10 newtons, because the wall does not move
0 newtons, because the wall is not alive and cannot push
explanation: The reaction force is always the same size as the action force, but points in the opposite direction.
fact_tl: Ang puwersa ng reaksyon ay laging kasinglaki ng puwersa ng aksyon, pero patungo sa kabilang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang kusog sa reaksyon kanunay nga sama kadako sa kusog sa aksyon, apan padulong sa atbang nga direksyon.

q: How does a heron usually catch a fish?
options: It grabs and clamps the fish with its beak
It skewers the fish like a barbecue stick, piercing all the way through
It scoops the fish up in a pouch under its beak
It stuns the fish by slapping the water with its wing
explanation: Despite the common belief that herons skewer fish, they usually just grab and clamp the fish with their beak rather than piercing through it.
fact_tl: Akala ng marami, lagi raw tinutuhog ng tagak ang isda na parang barbecue stick. Kadalasan, hinahawakan lang at sinisipit ito ng tuka, hindi talaga binabaon.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga kanunay gitusok sa tulabong ang isda nga morag barbecue stick. Kasagaran, gikuptan ug gikimpit lang kini sa sungo, dili gyud gibuslot.

q: In which liquid would an object feel a stronger buoyant force?
options: A denser liquid, like salt water
A less dense liquid, like fresh water
The buoyant force is the same in all liquids
A warmer liquid, because heat increases the push
explanation: A liquid pushes up with a buoyant force, and this force is stronger in a denser liquid.
fact_tl: Ang likido ay may puwersang pampalutang na itinutulak pataas, at mas malakas ito sa mas siksik na likido.
fact_bis: Ang likido adunay puwersa nga molutaw nga motukmod paibabaw, ug mas kusog kini sa mas siksik nga likido.

q: What does PAGASA's Signal No. 1 mean?
options: Light winds are coming and it is time to start preparing early
Very strong winds are expected within 12 hours
The typhoon is currently passing over the area
All schools and offices must close immediately
explanation: Signal No. 1 is PAGASA's lowest warning, meaning light winds are coming and it is time to start preparing early.
fact_tl: Ang Signal No.1 ang pinakamababang babala ng PAGASA: nangangahulugan itong may darating na mahinang hangin, kaya panahon na para maghanda nang maaga.
fact_bis: Ang Signal No.1 mao ang pinakaubos nga pasidaan sa PAGASA: nagpasabot kini nga naay moabot nga hinay nga hangin, busa panahon na sa pag-andam og sayo.

q: What makes Coron Bay in northern Palawan famous among divers?
options: Sunken Japanese ships from World War II beneath its waters
The world's largest living coral reef system
Underground rivers that flow into the sea
Schools of whale sharks that gather there every year
explanation: Coron Bay in northern Palawan is famous for sunken Japanese ships from World War II beneath its waters, popular among snorkelers and scuba divers.
fact_tl: Ang Coron Bay sa hilaga ng Palawan ay kilala sa ilalim ng dagat na mga lumubog na barko ng Hapon mula sa Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig; sikat ito sa mga manlalangoy at scuba diver.
fact_bis: Ang Coron Bay sa amihanan sa Palawan bantog sa mga nalunod nga barko sa Hapon gikan sa Ikaduha nga Gubat sa Kalibutan sa ilalim sa iyang tubig; popular kini sa mga snorkeler ug scuba diver.

q: Why do many stingrays have a sharp, venomous spine on their tail?
options: To defend themselves against threats, not to hunt
To steer while swimming through strong currents
To dig into the sand when resting on the seafloor
To attract prey by waving the tail like a lure
explanation: Many stingrays have a sharp, venomous spine on the tail that they use to defend themselves against threats, not to hunt.
fact_tl: Maraming pagi ang may matalas na tinik na may lason sa buntot, na ginagamit nila bilang panangga laban sa mga mananakot — hindi para manghuli.
fact_bis: Daghang pagi adunay talinis nga tunok nga adunay hilo sa ikog, nga gamiton nila isip panalipod batok sa mga makahadlok — dili para mangayam.

q: Why don't we get badly burned the moment we step outside on a sunny day?
options: The ozone layer blocks most of the most dangerous UV rays from the sun
Our skin produces a natural sunscreen when exposed to sunlight
Clouds always reflect enough sunlight to keep UV levels safe
The atmosphere is too thick for UV rays to pass through at all
explanation: The ozone layer blocks most of the most dangerous UV rays, preventing us from burning right away when we go outside.
fact_tl: Kahit malakas ang sikat ng araw, hindi tayo agad napapaso dahil hinahadlangan ng ozone layer ang karamihan ng pinakamapanganib na UV. Kung wala ito, kahit sandaling pagtayo sa labas ay maaari nang makapaso sa ating balat.
fact_bis: Bisan kusog ang sidlak sa adlaw, dili dayon kita mapaso kay gibabagan sa ozone layer ang kadaghanan sa pinakapeligrosong UV. Kon wala kini, bisan mubo nga pagtindog sa gawas makapaso na sa atong panit.

q: What happens to a solution when you add more water to it?
options: It becomes more dilute
It becomes more concentrated
It turns from a liquid into a solid
The solute stops dissolving and sinks to the bottom
explanation: Adding water to a solution means there is less solute in more water, making the solution more dilute.
fact_tl: Ang isang solution ay concentrated kapag maraming natunaw na solute sa kaunting solvent (gaya ng matapang na kape), at dilute kapag kaunti lang ang solute sa maraming tubig — nadaragdagan ng tubig ang pagiging dilute nito.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka solution concentrated kung daghang natunaw nga solute sa gamayng solvent (sama sa lig-on nga kape), ug dilute kung gamay ra ang solute sa daghang tubig — ang pagdugang og tubig mopadilute niini.

q: What is the standard household voltage in the Philippines?
options: 220 volts AC at 60 Hz
110 volts AC at 60 Hz
220 volts AC at 50 Hz
110 volts DC at 60 Hz
explanation: Standard household electricity in the Philippines is 220 volts AC at 60 Hz, which is higher than the 110 volts used in the United States.
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang kuryente sa mga bahay at gusali sa Pilipinas ay 220 volts na alternating current (AC) sa 60 Hz — ito ay mas mataas kaysa sa 110 volts na ginagamit sa Amerika, kaya mas maingat ang kailangan ng kaligtasan.
fact_bis: Ang naandan nga kuryente sa mga balay ug gusali sa Pilipinas 220 bolts AC sa 60 Hz — mas taas kini kaysa sa 110 bolts nga gigamit sa Amerika, busa mas importante ang pag-amping.

q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
options: Au
Go
Gd
Ag
explanation: The chemical symbol for gold is Au, from the Latin word 'aurum'.
fact_tl: Ang kemikal na simbolo ng ginto (gold) ay Au, mula sa salitang Latin na 'aurum'.
fact_bis: Ang chemical symbol sa bulawan (gold) mao ang Au, gikan sa Latin nga pulong 'aurum'.

q: When does a growing baby's heart start to beat?
options: Only a few weeks after life begins
At about six months, when the baby can be felt moving
Right at birth, when the baby takes its first breath
After the brain and nervous system fully form
explanation: The growing baby's heart starts to beat only a few weeks after life begins.
fact_tl: Ang puso ng lumalaking sanggol ay nagsisimulang tumibok ilang linggo lamang pagkatapos magsimula ang buhay.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing sa nagtubo nga bata magsugod og pitik pipila lang ka semana human magsugod ang kinabuhi.

q: What does a stick insect do when it senses danger?
options: It stays perfectly still so it will not be noticed
It sprays a foul-smelling liquid at the threat
It drops to the ground and plays dead
It quickly flies away using its hidden wings
explanation: When there is danger, a stick insect stays perfectly still so that it will not be noticed.
fact_tl: Kapag may panganib, ang stick insect ay nananatiling hindi gumagalaw para hindi ito mapansin.
fact_bis: Kon adunay kuyaw, ang stick insect magpabilin nga dili molihok aron dili kini mamatikdan.

q: Why is geothermal power considered cleaner than coal power?
options: Geothermal burns nothing and uses the Earth's heat, so it does not produce smoke or run out
Geothermal produces less electricity, so there is less waste energy released
Geothermal plants are built underground, so their emissions stay below the surface
Geothermal uses water to cool the steam, which washes away the pollutants
explanation: Unlike coal plants that burn fuel and produce lots of smoke, geothermal just uses the Earth's heat, so it is cleaner and does not run out.
fact_tl: Ang planta ng karbon ay nagsusunog ng fuel na nauubos at maraming usok. Ang geothermal ay hindi nagsusunog ng anuman, gumagamit lang ng init ng lupa, kaya mas malinis at hindi nauubos.
fact_bis: Ang planta sa karbon magsunog og fuel nga mahurot ug daghang aso. Ang geothermal walay sunogon, gamiton lang ang init sa yuta, busa mas hinlo ug dili mahurot.

q: What is the minimum wind speed for a Category 5 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale?
options: 252 km/h (157 mph)
185 km/h (115 mph)
220 km/h (137 mph)
300 km/h (186 mph)
explanation: A Category 5 hurricane, the strongest on the Saffir-Simpson scale, has winds of 252 km/h (157 mph) or higher.
fact_tl: Ang Category 5 na bagyo, ang pinakamalakas sa Saffir-Simpson scale, ay may hanging 252 km/h (157 mph) o higit pa.
fact_bis: Ang Category 5 nga bagyo, ang pinakakusog sa Saffir-Simpson scale, adunay hangin nga 252 km/h (157 mph) o labaw pa.

q: How far away can you hear a lion's roar?
options: Up to 8 kilometers away
Up to 1 kilometer away
Up to 3 kilometers away
Up to 15 kilometers away
explanation: A lion's roar is very loud and can be heard from as far as 8 kilometers away.
fact_tl: Ang atunggal o ungol (roar) ng leon ay napakalakas — naririnig ito sa layong hanggang 8 kilometro. Ginagamit ito ng leon para tawagin ang pangkat nito at balaan ang ibang leon.
fact_bis: Ang ungal (roar) sa leon kusog kaayo — madungog kini hangtod sa 8 ka kilometro ang gilay-on. Gigamit kini sa leon aron tawgon ang grupo niini ug pasidan-an ang ubang leon.

q: Who proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection?
options: Charles Darwin
Gregor Mendel
Louis Pasteur
Isaac Newton
explanation: Charles Darwin, an English naturalist, proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin, isang Ingles na naturalista, ang naglahad ng teorya ng ebolusyon sa pamamagitan ng natural na seleksyon.
fact_bis: Si Charles Darwin, usa ka Ingles nga naturalista, ang nagpasiugda sa teorya sa ebolusyon pinaagi sa natural nga seleksyon.

q: What do you find inside a guava fruit?
options: Soft flesh and many tiny seeds
A hard pit surrounded by thin juice
One large seed with no flesh
Thick dry pulp with no seeds at all
explanation: Inside a guava is soft flesh and many tiny seeds.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng bayabas ay may malambot na laman at maraming maliliit na buto.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa bayabas adunay humok nga unod ug daghang gagmay nga liso.

q: What does the tabon bird eat?
options: Seeds, fruit, worms, and small insects it finds on the ground
Only fish it catches by diving into the sea
Small mammals and lizards it hunts in the forest
Nectar from flowers and small flying insects it catches in the air
explanation: The tabon eats seeds, fruit, worms, and small insects it finds on the ground.
fact_tl: Kumakain ang tabon ng mga buto, prutas, uod, at maliliit na insekto na nakukuha nito sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang tabon mokaon og mga binhi, prutas, ulod, ug gagmay nga insekto nga makit-an niini sa yuta.

q: What gives kutsinta its chewy, jelly-like texture?
options: A little lye mixed into the rice-flour batter before steaming
Sugar syrup poured over the cake after it is cooked
Coconut milk stirred into the batter to make it thick
Extra water added to the rice flour to soften the dough
explanation: Kutsinta is a rice-flour cake mixed with a little lye, which makes the batter set into a chewy, jelly-like texture when steamed.
fact_tl: Ang kutsinta ay kakaning gawa sa harina ng bigas na hinahaluan ng lihiya, kaya nagiging makunat at parang jelly kapag niluto sa singaw.
fact_bis: Ang kutsinta usa ka kakanin nga hinimo sa harina sa bugas nga gisagulan ug gamay nga lihiya, mao nga mahimo kining humok ug morag jelly kung lutoon sa alisngaw.

q: Who was the first person to break the sound barrier by flying faster than sound?
options: Chuck Yeager
Neil Armstrong
Yuri Gagarin
Amelia Earhart
explanation: Chuck Yeager was the first person to break the sound barrier, flying faster than sound.
fact_tl: Si Chuck Yeager ang unang taong nakalampas sa sound barrier (mas mabilis pa sa tunog).
fact_bis: Si Chuck Yeager mao ang unang tawo nga nakalapas sa sound barrier, naglupad nga mas paspas pa sa tingog.

q: What does the hormone insulin do in the body?
options: It helps glucose enter cells, which lowers the sugar level in the blood
It stores extra sugar as fat in the liver and muscles
It signals the stomach to stop producing acid after a meal
It carries oxygen from the lungs to all parts of the body
explanation: Insulin is a hormone from the pancreas that helps glucose enter the cells, which lowers the sugar level in the blood.
fact_tl: Ang insulin ay isang hormona mula sa pancreas na tumutulong sa glucose na pumasok sa mga selula, kaya bumababa ang asukal sa dugo.
