The water becomes murkier because the clams stir up the seafloor
The coral bleaches faster because the clams compete for the same nutrients
explanation: When giant clams become plentiful again, the reef grows healthier and more fish live there too.
fact_tl: Kapag dumami muli ang taklobo, nagiging mas malusog ang bahura at dumadami rin ang mga isda doon.
fact_bis: Kon modaghan na usab ang taklobo, mahimong mas himsog ang bahura ug modaghan usab ang isda didto.

q: When do winged termites fly out to start new colonies?
options: During the rainy season
During the hottest days of the dry season
Only at the start of the cold season in December
Only at night during the summer solstice each year
explanation: During the rainy season, winged termites swarm and fly out to start new colonies.
fact_tl: Tuwing tag-ulan, lumilitaw ang mga anay na may pakpak na lumilipad para magsimula ng bagong kolonya.
fact_bis: Panahon sa ting-ulan, mogawas ang mga anay nga adunay pako nga molupad aron magsugod ug bag-ong kolonya.

q: What happens to the diaphragm muscle when you breathe in?
options: It tightens and moves down so the chest gets bigger and air is pulled in
It relaxes and moves up so the chest squeezes air out of the lungs
It pushes against the lungs to force them to expand outward to the sides
It vibrates rapidly to create a pumping action that draws air through the nose
explanation: When you breathe in, the diaphragm tightens and moves down, making the chest bigger so air is pulled into the lungs.
fact_tl: May malaking kalamnan sa ilalim ng baga na tinatawag na diaphragm. Kapag humihinga ka, sumisikip at bumababa ito para lumaki ang dibdib at mahatak ang hangin papasok sa baga. Kapag nag-relax ito, lumalabas ang hangin.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa baga adunay dako nga unod nga gitawag og diaphragm. Kon mohinga ka, mokontra ug monaog kini aron modako ang dughan ug masuyop ang hangin pasulod sa baga. Kon mo-relax kini, mogawas ang hangin.

q: Why do goosebumps not keep humans warm the way they do in furry animals?
options: Human hair is too thin, so goosebumps no longer trap enough warmth — they are a leftover from furrier ancestors
Human skin is too thick and tough for goosebumps to reach the surface and create insulation
Humans do not have enough muscles attached to their hair to make effective goosebumps
Human body temperature is already so high that goosebumps are not needed for warmth
explanation: Because human hair is thin, our goosebumps no longer warm us much and are a leftover from our furrier ancestors.
fact_tl: Dahil manipis na ang balahibo ng tao, hindi na gaanong nakakapagpainit ang ating "goosebumps"—isa itong tira mula sa mga makakapal-balahibong ninuno.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nipis na ang balhibo sa tawo, dili na kaayo makapainit ang atong "goosebumps"—usa kini ka salin gikan sa mas balhibo nga mga katigulangan.

q: Why is bamboo a popular material for building the bahay-kubo?
options: It is strong, light, and easy to get
It is fireproof and does not burn even in very hot weather
It floats on water, making houses safe during floods
It is heavy and dense, so it keeps the inside cool in hot weather
explanation: Bamboo is used to build the bahay-kubo because it is strong, light, and easy to get, and it can be made into walls, floors, and roofs.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang kawayan sa paggawa ng mga bahay tulad ng bahay-kubo dahil matibay, magaan, at madaling makuha ito. Ginagawa rin itong dingding, sahig, at bubong.
fact_bis: Gigamit ang kawayan sa paghimo og mga balay sama sa bahay-kubo kay lig-on, gaan, ug sayon makuha. Ginahimo usab kini nga bungbong, salog, ug atop.

q: Who first discovered oxygen and in what year?
options: Joseph Priestley in 1774
Antoine Lavoisier in 1783
John Dalton in 1808
Robert Boyle in 1661
explanation: Oxygen was first discovered by the scientist Joseph Priestley in 1774.
fact_tl: Ang oxygen ay unang natuklas ng siyentistang si Joseph Priestley noong 1774.
fact_bis: Ang oksiheno unang nadiskobrehan sa siyentista nga si Joseph Priestley niadtong 1774.

q: At approximately what decibel level can sounds start to harm your hearing if you listen for a long time?
options: About 85 decibels
About 30 decibels
About 120 decibels
About 50 decibels
explanation: Sounds louder than about 85 decibels can harm your hearing if you are exposed to them for a long time.
fact_tl: Ang mga tunog na mas malakas sa humigit-kumulang 85 desibel ay maaaring makapinsala sa pandinig kung matagal mong naririnig.
fact_bis: Ang mga tunog nga mas kusog sa mga 85 desibel makadaot sa pandungog kon dugay nimo kining madunggan.

q: How is water stored in cold mountainous places, and what happens when it eventually melts?
options: It is stored as snow and ice on mountains, and when it melts it flows into rivers as fresh water
It is stored underground in frozen rocks, and when it melts it rises as steam into the atmosphere
It is stored in thick clouds above the mountains, and when it melts it falls directly into the ocean
It is stored inside glaciers that never melt and therefore permanently remove water from the cycle
explanation: In cold places, water is stored as snow and ice on mountains, and when it melts it flows into rivers as fresh water.
fact_tl: Sa malalamig na lugar, ang tubig ay naiimbak bilang niyebe at yelo sa bundok, at kapag natutunaw ito, dumadaloy ito sa ilog bilang tubig-tabang.
fact_bis: Sa bugnaw nga mga dapit, ang tubig matipig isip niyebe ug yelo sa bukid, ug kung kini matunaw, modagayday kini sa suba isip tubig-tab-ang.

q: Why does the colugo avoid spending time on the ground?
options: Its body is built for tree life, so it moves slowly and awkwardly on the ground
It fears water puddles that collect on the ground after rain in the rainforest
The ground is too hot for its sensitive feet, so it stays in the cool tree canopy
Its eyes only work well in bright treetop light and it goes blind near the dark ground
explanation: The colugo is built for gliding and climbing trees, making it slow and awkward on the ground, so it avoids being there.
fact_tl: Mahusay ang colugo sa paglutang at pag-akyat sa puno, pero mahina ito sa lupa. Dahil naka-disenyo ang katawan nito para sa pamumuhay sa itaas ng puno, mahirap at mabagal itong gumalaw kapag nasa lupa, kaya iniiwasan nito ito.
fact_bis: Maayo ang colugo sa paglupad-lupad ug pagsaka sa kahoy, apan luya kini sa yuta. Tungod kay ang lawas niini gimugna alang sa kinabuhi sa ibabaw sa kahoy, hinay ug lisod kini molihok kon anaa sa yuta, busa likayan niini kini.

q: Which rock pair correctly shows a metamorphic rock and the rock it came from?
options: Marble comes from limestone, and slate comes from shale
Granite comes from sandstone, and basalt comes from marble
Pumice comes from limestone, and obsidian comes from shale
Coal comes from granite, and quartzite comes from volcanic ash
explanation: Marble is a metamorphic rock formed from limestone, and slate is a metamorphic rock formed from shale.
fact_tl: Ang marble ay isang batong metamorphic na nagmula sa limestone, at ang slate naman ay galing sa shale.
fact_bis: Ang marble usa ka batong metamorphic nga naggikan sa limestone, ug ang slate naggikan sa shale.

q: Besides the kidneys, which two other organs help remove wastes from the body?
options: The skin (through sweat) and the lungs (through exhaled carbon dioxide)
The stomach (through digestion) and the heart (through pumping blood)
The liver (through bile) and the tongue (through saliva)
The eyes (through tears) and the ears (through earwax)
explanation: The skin releases water and salt through sweat, and the lungs breathe out carbon dioxide — both help remove wastes alongside the kidneys.
fact_tl: Hindi lang bato ang nag-aalis ng dumi — nagpapalabas din ng tubig at asin ang balat sa pamamagitan ng pawis, at ang baga ay naglalabas ng carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang bato ang mokuha sa hugaw — ang panit mogawas og tubig ug asin pinaagi sa singot, ug ang baga moginhawa pagawas sa carbon dioxide.

q: What are the two main features that define the kingdom Animalia?
options: Animals eat other organisms and can usually move on their own
Animals make their own food from sunlight and stay rooted in one place
Animals have a hard outer shell and reproduce by releasing spores
Animals live only in water and breathe through gills their entire lives
explanation: The kingdom Animalia is made of organisms that eat other organisms and can usually move.
fact_tl: Ang kahariang Animalia ay binubuo ng mga hayop na kumakain ng ibang organismo at karaniwang nakakagalaw.
fact_bis: Ang gingharian nga Animalia gilangkob sa mga mananap nga mokaon og ubang organismo ug kasagaran makalihok.

q: How long does one year last on Mercury?
options: About 88 Earth days
About 365 Earth days
About 687 Earth days
About 29 Earth days
explanation: One year on Mercury lasts only about 88 Earth days, giving it the shortest year of all the planets.
fact_tl: Ang isang taon sa Mercury ay tumatagal lamang ng halos 88 araw ng Earth—ito ang pinakamaikling taon sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka tuig sa Mercury molungtad lang ug mga 88 ka adlaw sa Yuta—kini ang pinakamubo nga tuig sa tanang planeta.

q: What is the density of gold?
options: About 19.3 grams per cubic centimeter
About 1.0 gram per cubic centimeter
About 8.9 grams per cubic centimeter
About 11.3 grams per cubic centimeter
explanation: The density of gold is about 19.3 grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm³).
fact_tl: Ang densidad ng ginto (gold) ay mga 19.3 gramo bawat sentimetrong kubiko (19.3 g/cm³).
fact_bis: Ang density sa bulawan (gold) kay mga 19.3 gramo matag kubikong sentimetro (19.3 g/cm³).

q: How does an adaptation develop in a species over time?
options: Natural selection favors helpful traits, and these build up gradually over many generations
One generation of animals decides to change a body part and passes the choice to its children
A single animal learns a new skill and that skill is immediately inherited by all its young
Adaptations appear suddenly in one individual through a large change during its own lifetime
explanation: An adaptation is a heritable trait that builds up gradually over many generations because natural selection favors traits that help survival.
fact_tl: Ang adaptasyon ay ang namamanang katangiang nagpapadali sa pagkabuhay sa isang partikular na kapaligiran; nabubuo ito nang unti-unti sa maraming henerasyon dahil pinili ng natural selection ang mga katangiang nakakatulong sa pananatiling buhay.
fact_bis: Ang adaptasyon mao ang napanunod nga kinaiya nga nagpasayon sa pagkabuhi sa usa ka partikular nga palibot; mabuo kini hinay-hinay sa daghang henerasyon tungod kay gipili sa natural selection ang mga kinaiya nga makatabang sa pagkabuhi.

q: How does complete metamorphosis help young insects and adult insects survive together?
options: Because young and adults look different and eat different foods, so they do not compete with each other
Because young and adults live in separate countries, so they never meet during their lives
Because young insects eat the adults, giving the adults a reason to grow and change form quickly
Because both young and adults eat the same food, making it easier to find enough for everyone
explanation: In complete metamorphosis the young (e.g., caterpillar) and the adult (e.g., butterfly) eat different foods, so they do not compete and more can survive.
fact_tl: May malaking benepisyo ang kumpletong metamorphosis: dahil magkaiba ang hitsura ng bata at magulang, magkaiba rin ang kanilang pagkain. Ang higad ay kumakain ng dahon, ngunit ang paru-paro ay umiinom ng nektar. Kaya hindi sila nag-aagawan ng pagkain, at mas marami ang nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Adunay dako nga bintaha ang kompleto nga metamorphosis: tungod kay lahi ang hitsura sa bata ug hamtong, lahi usab ang ilang pagkaon. Ang ulod mokaon og dahon, apan ang alibangbang moinom og nektar. Mao nga dili sila mag-ilog og pagkaon, ug mas daghan ang mabuhi.

q: What is the biggest object in our solar system?
options: The Sun
Jupiter
Saturn
Earth
explanation: The biggest object in our solar system is the Sun.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking bagay sa ating solar system ay ang Araw.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga butang sa atong solar system mao ang Adlaw.

q: How was vitamin D first discovered by scientists?
options: Children with weak bent bones (rickets) got better when given cod liver oil or sunlight, leading scientists to identify vitamin D
Scientists noticed that adults who ate more fish grew taller, so they tested fish oil on children with bone problems
A doctor accidentally spilled fish oil on a plant and saw it grow stronger, which suggested it helped bones too
Children who drank more milk got healthier bones, and scientists found vitamin D was added to the milk
explanation: Scientists found that city children with rickets (weak, bent bones) got better with cod liver oil or sunlight — that is how vitamin D was discovered.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, maraming bata sa siyudad na palaging nasa loob ang nagkaroon ng rickets (mahinang baluktot na buto). Natuklasan ng mga siyentipiko na gumagaling sila kapag binigyan ng cod liver oil (langis mula sa atay ng isda) o pinaaraw — ganito nadiskobre ang vitamin D.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, daghang bata sa siyudad nga kanunay sa sulod ang nakaangkon og rickets (luya, baliko nga bukog). Nakit-an sa mga siyentista nga maayo sila kung hatagan og cod liver oil (lana gikan sa atay sa isda) o pa-adlawon — mao kini ang pagkadiskobre sa vitamin D.

q: What is the job of the valves inside the heart?
options: They open and close like doors to keep blood from flowing backward
They pump blood by squeezing and releasing with each heartbeat
They filter out waste products from the blood as it passes through
They measure the pressure of blood and signal the brain to speed up or slow down
explanation: Valves in the heart act like doors that open and close so blood cannot flow backward.
fact_tl: Ang mga balbula sa puso ay parang mga pinto na nagbubukas at nagsasara para hindi umatras ang dugo.
fact_bis: Ang mga balbula sa kasingkasing sama sa mga pultahan nga moabli ug mosira aron dili mobalik ang dugo.

q: How do monitor lizards (bayawak) have their young?
options: They lay eggs in nests made of leaves, grass, or soil, and females may stay nearby to guard them
They give birth to live young and carry them on their backs for the first few weeks
They lay eggs inside hollow trees where the warmth of the wood helps them hatch
They release their eggs into rivers and the current carries them to a safe hatching site
explanation: Monitor lizards lay eggs in nests made of leaves, grass, or soil, and females may remain nearby to guard them.
fact_tl: Ang mga bayawak ay naglalagay ng mga itlog sa mga pugad na gawa sa dahon, damo, o lupa, at ang babae ay maaaring mag-bantay sa malapit.
fact_bis: Ang mga bayawak nagpangitlog sa mga salag nga gihimo sa dahon, damo, o yuta, ug ang babaye mahimong magpabilin duol aron bantayan.

q: What is true about the shark species found in Philippine reef waters?
options: Many small shark species like bamboo sharks and catsharks live in deeper reef areas and are rarely seen by snorkelers
All sharks in Philippine waters are large and dangerous and can be seen easily by snorkelers near the surface
Philippine reefs have no native shark species because the water is too warm for sharks to survive
Only one species of shark lives in Philippine waters and it is found only near Tubbataha Reef
explanation: Not all sharks are large — many small species such as bamboo sharks and catsharks live in deeper Philippine reefs and are rarely seen by snorkelers.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng pating ay malalaki — maraming maliliit na uri ng pating (tulad ng bamboo at catshark) ang namumuhay sa mas malalim na parte ng mga Philippine reef at bihira itong makita ng mga manlalangoy.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga pating dagko — daghang gagmay nga species sa pating (sama sa bamboo sharks ug catsharks) nagpuyo sa mas lawom nga bahin sa Philippine reefs ug bihirang makita sa mga manlalangoy.

q: What makes Tubbataha Reef's location especially important for marine life?
options: It sits at the core of the Coral Triangle, the world's center of marine biodiversity
It is surrounded by the deepest ocean trench in the world, keeping it isolated and pristine
It lies directly on the equator, giving it the warmest water temperature of any reef on Earth
It is the only reef in Southeast Asia that is entirely protected from fishing by international law
explanation: Tubbataha Reef sits at the core of the Coral Triangle, which is the world's center of marine biodiversity.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha Reef ay nasa pinakapuso ng Coral Triangle, ang sentro ng marine biodiversity sa daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha Reef anaa sa kasingkasing sa Coral Triangle, ang sentro sa marine biodiversity sa kalibutan.

q: Where are chromosomes found in a cell, and what do they carry?
options: In the nucleus, and each chromosome carries many genes
In the cell membrane, and each chromosome carries proteins for digestion
In the mitochondria, and each chromosome carries instructions for making energy
In the cytoplasm, and each chromosome carries one single trait only
explanation: DNA is packaged into chromosomes found in the nucleus of a cell, and each chromosome carries many genes.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay nababalot sa loob ng mga istrukturang tinatawag na chromosomes na matatagpuan sa nucleus ng selula, at ang bawat chromosome ay may dala-dalang maraming gene.
fact_bis: Ang DNA giputos sulod sa mga estruktura nga gitawag og chromosomes nga makita sa nucleus sa selula, ug ang matag chromosome nagdala og daghang gene.

q: Why does food sealed in an airtight can last much longer than food left in the open air?
options: Without oxygen, the microbes that break down food cannot work as well
Without sunlight, the microbes that break down food cannot see
Without moisture, the microbes that break down food dry up and die
Without heat, the microbes that break down food stay frozen
explanation: Oxygen helps the microbes that spoil food, so sealing food away from air slows the spoiling process.
fact_tl: Maraming pagkain ang mas mabilis mabulok kapag nadidikit sa hangin, dahil tumutulong ang oxygen sa mga mikrobyong sumisira nito. Kaya inilalagay ang ilang pagkain sa selyadong lata o supot na walang hangin — kapag walang oxygen, mas matagal bago mapanis ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Daghang pagkaon ang mas dali madunot kung maladlad sa hangin, kay ang oxygen motabang sa mga mikrobyo nga moguba niini. Mao nga ang ubang pagkaon gisilyo sa lata o suput nga walay hangin — kung walay oxygen, mas dugay madaot ang pagkaon.

q: What does DNA do inside a cell?
options: It acts like an instruction book that tells how to build and run a living thing
It acts like a battery that gives the cell energy to move
It acts like a filter that removes waste materials from the cell
It acts like a wall that keeps harmful substances from entering the cell
explanation: DNA carries the instructions for life, telling the cell how to build and run a living organism.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay parang aklat ng panuto sa loob ng selula na nagsasabi kung paano buuin at patakbuhin ang isang nabubuhay na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang DNA sama sa libro sa panudlo sulod sa selula nga nagsulti kung unsaon paghimo ug pagpadagan sa usa ka buhing butang.

q: What is Anilao in Batangas famous for?
options: Extraordinary underwater biodiversity and beautiful coral gardens
Vast rice terraces carved into steep mountain slopes
White sandy beaches and strong surfing waves
Ancient underground river systems and limestone caves
explanation: Anilao in Batangas is one of the most famous diving locations in the Philippines and Asia, known for its extraordinary underwater biodiversity and coral gardens.
fact_tl: Ang Anilao sa Batangas ay isa sa mga pinakasikat na lugar ng diving sa buong Pilipinas at Asya; kilala ito sa napakayamang underwater biodiversity at magagandang coral garden.
fact_bis: Ang Anilao sa Batangas usa sa pinaka-bantog nga lugar sa diving sa tibuok Pilipinas ug Asya; bantog kini sa labaw ka dato nga underwater biodiversity ug matahum nga coral garden.

q: How do scientists define the speed of an object?
options: The distance it travels in a certain amount of time
The force it needs to start moving from a stopped position
The weight it pushes down on the surface below it
The direction it is heading at any given moment
explanation: Speed is how fast an object moves — the distance it travels in a certain amount of time.
fact_tl: Ang speed ay kung gaano kabilis gumalaw ang isang bagay — ang layong (distance) nalakbay sa loob ng isang takdang oras (time). Mas mabilis ang isang bagay kung mas malayo ang nalalakbay nito sa parehong dami ng oras.
fact_bis: Ang speed mao kung unsa ka paspas molihok ang usa ka butang — ang gilay-on (distance) nga nabaktas sulod sa usa ka takna nga oras (time). Mas paspas ang butang kung mas layo ang iyang nabaktas sa parehas nga gidaghanon sa oras.

q: Why is the herbal plant sambong called a diuretic?
options: It makes the body produce more urine, helping clean out the kidneys
It makes the body sweat more, flushing out heat and toxins through the skin
It makes the body absorb more water from food in the intestines
It makes the body digest food faster by increasing stomach acid
explanation: Sambong is a diuretic because it makes the body produce more urine, which helps clean out the kidneys.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na diuretic ang sambong dahil pinaparami nito ang ihi, na nakakatulong upang malinis ang mga bato o kidney.
fact_bis: Gitawag nga diuretic ang sambong kay gipadaghan niini ang ihi, nga makatabang sa paghinlo sa mga kidney.

q: Which best describes how sleep is organized?
options: Sleep has different stages, from light sleep to deep sleep
Sleep is a single steady state with no changes throughout the night
Sleep only has one stage — the deep dreamless stage — each night
Sleep cycles only happen in young children, not in adults
explanation: Sleep has different stages, ranging from light sleep to deep sleep, throughout the night.
fact_tl: Ang tulog ay may iba't ibang yugto, mula sa mababaw na tulog hanggang sa mahimbing na tulog.
fact_bis: Ang tulog adunay lain-laing bahin, gikan sa mabaw nga tulog ngadto sa lawom nga tulog.

q: When was Filipino hero Andres Bonifacio born?
options: November 30, 1863
March 22, 1869
November 30, 1872
explanation: Andres Bonifacio was born on November 30, 1863.
fact_tl: Si Andres Bonifacio ay ipinanganak noong Nobyembre 30, 1863.
fact_bis: Si Andres Bonifacio natawo niadtong Nobyembre 30, 1863.

q: Which set of habits can often help prevent type 2 diabetes?
options: Eating healthy food with vegetables and fruit, exercising regularly, and keeping a healthy weight
Taking vitamin supplements every day and drinking eight glasses of water
Avoiding all sweet foods completely and sleeping more than ten hours each night
Eating small meals every hour and resting instead of doing physical activity
explanation: Type 2 diabetes can often be prevented by eating healthy food including vegetables and fruit, exercising regularly, and keeping a healthy weight.
fact_tl: Ang type 2 diabetes ay madalas na maiiwasan sa pamamagitan ng malusog na pagkain, pagkain ng gulay at prutas, regular na ehersisyo, at pagpapanatili ng tamang timbang.
fact_bis: Ang type 2 diabetes kasagaran malikayan pinaagi sa himsog nga pagkaon, pagkaon og utanon ug prutas, regular nga ehersisyo, ug pagtipig sa saktong timbang.

q: What did Copernicus and Galileo help prove about Earth and the Sun?
options: Earth orbits the Sun, not the other way around
The Sun orbits Earth once every 365 days
Both Earth and the Sun orbit the Moon
Earth stays perfectly still while all other planets move around it
explanation: Long ago people thought Earth was the center, but Copernicus and Galileo showed that Earth orbits the Sun.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, akala ng mga tao na ang Earth ang sentro at ang Araw ang umiikot dito; ngayon alam na natin na ang Earth ang umiikot sa Araw, isang ideyang ipinaliwanag nina Copernicus at Galileo.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, gituohan sa mga tawo nga ang Earth maoy sentro ug ang Adlaw molibot niini; karon nahibalo na ta nga ang Earth maoy molibot sa Adlaw, usa ka ideya nga gipasabot nila Copernicus ug Galileo.

q: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
options: Neil Armstrong
Buzz Aldrin
Yuri Gagarin
Alan Shepard
explanation: The first person to walk on the Moon was Neil Armstrong.
fact_tl: Ang unang taong nakatungtong sa buwan ay si Neil Armstrong.
fact_bis: Ang unang tawo nga nakatunob sa bulan mao si Neil Armstrong.

q: The unit of electrical resistance called the ohm is named after which scientist?
options: Georg Ohm, a German scientist
André-Marie Ampère, a French scientist
Alessandro Volta, an Italian scientist
James Watt, a Scottish scientist
explanation: The ohm, the unit of electrical resistance, is named after Georg Ohm, a German scientist.
fact_tl: Ang ohm, ang yunit ng resistensya ng kuryente, ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm, isang Aleman na siyentista.
fact_bis: Ang ohm, ang yunit sa resistensya sa kuryente, ginganlan kang Georg Ohm, usa ka Aleman nga siyentista.

q: Which nonmetal is the only one that exists as a liquid at room temperature?
options: Bromine
Sulfur
Phosphorus
Carbon
explanation: Bromine is the only nonmetal that is liquid at room temperature.
fact_tl: Ang bromine ang tanging di-metal na likido sa temperatura ng silid.
fact_bis: Ang bromine mao ra ang dili-metal nga likido sa temperatura sa kwarto.

q: A tertiary consumer is at which trophic level in a food chain?
options: The fourth trophic level
The second trophic level
The third trophic level
The first trophic level
explanation: A tertiary consumer is at the fourth trophic level and eats secondary consumers.
fact_tl: Ang tertiary consumer ay nasa ikaapat na antas ng food chain at kumakain ng secondary consumer — halimbawa, ang agila ay kumakain ng ahas na kumakain ng palaka na kumakain ng balang.
fact_bis: Ang tertiary consumer anaa sa ikaupat nga lebel sa food chain ug mangaon sa mga secondary consumer — pananglitan, ang agila mangaon sa bitin nga mangaon sa baki nga mangaon sa balang.

q: What do interferons do when a cell is infected by a virus?
options: They warn nearby cells to prepare for a viral attack
They digest the virus and remove it from the bloodstream
They grow into new white blood cells to fight the infection
They seal the cell membrane so the virus cannot spread
explanation: When a cell is infected by a virus, it releases interferons that warn nearby cells to prepare for attack as a first-line defense.
fact_tl: Kapag nahawahan ng virus ang isang cell, naglalabas ito ng mga protina na tinatawag na interferon na nagbababala sa mga kalapit na cell na maghanda para sa atake — ito ay isang mahalagang unang linya ng depensa ng innate immune system.
fact_bis: Kung mahawahan sa virus ang usa ka cell, nagpagawas kini og mga protina nga gitawag og interferon nga nagpahibalo sa mga lapit nga cell aron moandam para sa pag-atake — usa ka importante nga unang linya sa depensa sa innate immune system.

q: Why do ice and metal need very different amounts of heat to melt?
options: Different materials melt at different temperatures depending on what they are made of
All materials melt at the same temperature but metals take longer to heat up
Metals melt at a lower temperature because they are denser than ice
Ice melts at a high temperature because it is frozen harder than metal
explanation: Different materials melt at different temperatures — low for ice, but very high for metal.
fact_tl: Iba-iba ang temperaturang kailangan para matunaw ang iba't ibang bagay — mababa lang para sa yelo, pero napakataas para sa bakal.
fact_bis: Lahi-lahi ang temperatura nga gikinahanglan aron matunaw ang lainlaing butang — ubos ra para sa yelo, apan taas kaayo para sa puthaw.

q: How does soap remove grease and dirt from your hands?
options: One end of the soap molecule wraps around grease while the other end clings to water, so rinsing carries the dirt away
Soap dissolves grease by turning it into water, which then washes away on its own
Soap kills dirt-causing bacteria with heat produced by scrubbing friction
Soap increases the surface tension of water so it grabs onto grease more strongly
explanation: Soap cleans because its oil-loving end wraps around grease and dirt while its water-loving end faces the water, so rinsing carries the dirt away.
fact_tl: Naglilinis ang sabon dahil binabalot ng oil-loving na dulo nito ang mantika at dumi, habang nakaharap sa tubig ang water-loving na dulo. Kaya kapag binanlawan mo, naaanod palayo ang dumi kasama ng sabon.
fact_bis: Ang sabon nakalimpyo kay ang oil-loving nga tumoy niini magputos sa lana ug hugaw, samtang ang water-loving nga tumoy mag-atubang sa tubig. Busa kung hugasan nimo, ang hugaw madala palayo uban sa sabon.

q: What health benefit does the banaba tree's leaves provide?
options: They contain an acid that may help control blood sugar levels
They produce a sap that soothes inflamed throat and tonsils
They release a scent that repels mosquitoes and other insects
They contain a fiber that speeds up digestion in the stomach
explanation: Banaba leaves contain corosolic acid that may help control blood sugar levels.
fact_tl: Ang banaba (Lagerstroemia speciosa) ay isang ornamental na puno sa Pilipinas na ginagamit din bilang halamang gamot—ang mga dahon nito ay naglalaman ng corosolic acid na makakatulong sa pagkontrol ng blood sugar.
fact_bis: Ang banaba (Lagerstroemia speciosa) usa ka ornamental nga kahoy sa Pilipinas nga gigamit usab ingong halamang gamot; ang mga dahon niini adunay corosolic acid nga mahimong makatabang sa pagkontrol sa blood sugar.

q: Why does water dissolve sugar and salt but not sand?
options: Water dissolves substances it is attracted to, like sugar and salt, but cannot pull apart substances like sand
Water is too cold to break apart sand, but heat from dissolving sugar warms it up
Sand is too heavy to dissolve, while sugar and salt are lighter than water
Water dissolves only white or clear substances and leaves colored ones like sand alone
explanation: Water dissolves the substances it is attracted to, like sugar and salt, but leaves whole the substances it cannot pull apart, like sand.
fact_tl: Natutunaw ng tubig ang mga sangkap na nahihila nito tulad ng asukal at asin, ngunit iniiwan nitong buo ang mga sangkap na hindi nito kayang hilahin tulad ng buhangin.
fact_bis: Matunaw sa tubig ang mga sangkap nga mabira niini sama sa asukal ug asin, apan ibilin niini nga buo ang mga sangkap nga dili niini mabira sama sa balas.

q: What is the key difference between complete and incomplete metamorphosis in insects?
options: Complete metamorphosis has a pupa stage, but incomplete metamorphosis does not
Incomplete metamorphosis has a pupa stage, but complete metamorphosis does not
Complete metamorphosis skips the larva stage, while incomplete metamorphosis includes it
Both types have the same stages, but incomplete metamorphosis finishes much faster
explanation: The key difference is the pupa stage: it is present in complete metamorphosis but absent in incomplete metamorphosis.
fact_tl: Ang pangunahing pagkakaiba ay ang yugto ng pupa: ito ay nasa buong metamorphosis pero wala sa di-buo.
fact_bis: Ang nag-unang kalainan mao ang hugna sa pupa: anaa kini sa kompletong metamorphosis apan wala sa dili kompleto.

q: What is dysentery, and what causes it?
options: A disease with bloody diarrhea caused by bacteria or amoeba from dirty water
A disease that makes bones weak and brittle caused by a lack of calcium
A skin disease with red blisters caused by a virus spread through touch
A disease that causes breathing problems caused by inhaling polluted air
explanation: Dysentery is a disease with diarrhea that contains blood, caused by bacteria or amoeba from dirty water.
fact_tl: Ang disenterya ay sakit na may pagtatae na may halong dugo, na dulot ng bakterya o amoeba mula sa maruming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang dysentery usa ka sakit nga adunay kalibanga nga may dugo, gikan sa bakterya o amoeba sa hugaw nga tubig.

q: Why are reflexes so much faster than normal body movements?
options: They protect the body by acting before the brain can send a slower order to move
They are powered by extra muscles that are stronger than regular muscles
They only happen during sleep when the brain is resting and the body moves on its own
They are practiced movements that the body has memorized and can do without thinking
explanation: Reflexes are fast to protect you — if the body waited for an order from the brain, you might already be hurt before you could move away.
fact_tl: Ang dahilan kung bakit napakabilis ng reflex ay para protektahan ka. Kung maghihintay pa ang katawan mo ng utos mula sa utak, baka napaso o nasugatan ka na bago ka pa makaalis.
fact_bis: Ang hinungdan nganong paspas kaayo ang reflex aron panalipdan ka. Kon maghulat pa ang imong lawas og mando gikan sa utok, basin napaso o nasamdan ka na sa dili pa ka makalihok.

q: How do lichens contribute to the breaking down of rocks?
options: They release weak acids that slowly break down the rock surface
They absorb water and freeze inside cracks to split the rock apart
They produce heat that causes the rock to expand and crack over time
They dig roots deep into the rock and pull it apart as the roots grow
explanation: Lichens growing on a rock's surface release weak acids that slowly break down the rock.
fact_tl: Ang lichens na tumutubo sa ibabaw ng bato ay naglalabas ng mahinang asido na unti-unting dumudunot sa bato.
fact_bis: Ang lichens nga motubo sa ibabaw sa bato mogawas og huyang nga asido nga hinay-hinayng modunot sa bato.

q: Why do many ground-nesting birds have speckled, brownish eggs?
options: The speckled pattern matches the soil and stones so enemies cannot easily spot the eggs
The speckled pattern absorbs more sunlight to keep the eggs warm in cold soil
The brownish color comes from the soil minerals that the mother bird eats while nesting
The speckled pattern signals to other birds that the nest already has an owner
explanation: Birds that nest on the ground often have speckled brownish eggs that match the soil, sand, or stones so enemies cannot easily spot them.
fact_tl: Ang mga ibong namumugad sa lupa ay kadalasang may itlog na may batik at kulay-kayumanggi na tumutugma sa lupa, buhangin, o bato, kaya hindi madaling makita ng kaaway ang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga magsalag sa yuta kasagaran adunay itlog nga batikan ug kapehon nga motakdo sa yuta, balas, o bato, mao nga dili sayon makita sa kaaway ang mga itlog.

q: What cleaning job does dental floss do that a toothbrush cannot?
options: It cleans between teeth where a toothbrush cannot reach
It removes old fillings and loose crowns from damaged teeth
It whitens the outer surface of teeth by scrubbing off stains
It kills bacteria in the throat and tonsils after brushing
explanation: Dental floss cleans between teeth where a toothbrush cannot reach.
fact_tl: Ang dental floss ay naglilinis sa pagitan ng mga ngipin kung saan hindi kayang umabot ng sipilyo.
fact_bis: Ang dental floss naglimpyo sa tunga-tunga sa mga ngipon diin dili maabot sa sepilyo.

q: Which rock is changed by heat and pressure to become slate?
options: Shale
Granite
Sandstone
Limestone
explanation: Slate forms when shale is changed by heat and pressure.
fact_tl: Ang slate ay nabubuo kapag ang shale ay nabago dahil sa init at presyon.
fact_bis: Ang slate maporma kung ang shale mabag-o tungod sa kainit ug presyon.

q: How does the fluoride in toothpaste protect your teeth?
options: It makes teeth stronger so they can better resist the acid produced by plaque
It kills all bacteria in the mouth so plaque cannot form in the first place
It washes plaque off the gums by making saliva flow faster after brushing
It coats the teeth with a soft layer that plaque cannot stick to
explanation: The fluoride in toothpaste makes teeth stronger so they can better resist the acid from plaque.
fact_tl: Ang fluoride na nasa toothpaste ay nagpapatibay sa ngipin para mas makalaban sa asido na galing sa plaque. Kaya pumili ng toothpaste na may fluoride.
fact_bis: Ang fluoride sa toothpaste mopalig-on sa ngipon aron mas makasukol sa asido gikan sa plaque. Busa pagpili og toothpaste nga adunay fluoride.

q: Where do lenticular clouds usually form, and what makes them look unusual?
options: Near mountains, and their lens shape makes them look like UFOs
Over oceans, and their flat shape makes them look like giant pancakes
In deserts, and their dark color makes them look like smoke from fires
High in the atmosphere, and their wispy shape makes them look like feathers
explanation: Lenticular clouds are lens-shaped clouds that form near mountains, and they are sometimes compared to UFOs because of their unusual shape.
fact_tl: Ang lenticular clouds ay mga ulap na hugis-lens na nabubuo sa mataas na lugar sa tabi ng mga bundok; minsang kinukumpara sa UFO dahil sa katangi-tanging hugis nito.
fact_bis: Ang lenticular clouds hugis-lens nga panganod nga naporma duol sa mga bundok; usahay itandi sa UFO tungod sa dili kasagaran nga porma niini.

q: Why does a mudskipper need to keep its skin wet even when it is out of the water?
options: It breathes through its wet skin on land, so it must stay moist to keep breathing
It needs wet skin to reflect sunlight and prevent overheating in the mud
Its scales only stay attached when moist, so drying out causes them to fall off
It needs wet skin to help it slide quickly across mud when escaping predators
explanation: The mudskipper's skin must stay wet so it can keep breathing while on land, so it rolls in mud or water.
fact_tl: Kailangang manatiling basa ng balat ng mudskipper, kaya gumugulong ito sa putik o tubig para makahinga pa rin sa labas.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan magpabiling basa ang panit sa mudskipper, mao nga moligid kini sa lapok o tubig aron makaginhawa gihapon sa yuta.

q: What three things combine to make iron rust?
options: Iron, oxygen, and water
Iron, carbon dioxide, and heat
Iron, salt, and sunlight
Iron, nitrogen, and pressure
explanation: Rusting of iron is a slow chemical reaction between iron, oxygen, and water that forms a new substance.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalawang ng bakal ay isang mabagal na chemical reaction sa pagitan ng iron, oxygen, at tubig. Hindi ito bumubula gaya ng suka't baking soda, ngunit chemical reaction pa rin ito na bumubuo ng bagong sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang pagkataya sa puthaw usa ka hinay nga chemical reaction tali sa iron, oxygen, ug tubig. Dili kini mobula sama sa suka ug baking soda, apan chemical reaction gihapon nga maghimo og bag-ong sustansya.

q: Why does hard water leave white spots on glasses and dishes?
options: When the water dries, minerals left behind form white spots on the surface
Hard water contains soap that dries into a white foam on glassware
The high temperature of hard water burns a white film onto dish surfaces
Hard water freezes faster than normal water and leaves ice crystals behind
explanation: Hard water leaves white spots on glasses and dishes when the water dries and the minerals are left behind.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na tubig ay nag-iiwan ng puting mantsa sa mga baso at pinggan kapag natuyo ang tubig at naiwan ang mineral.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga tubig magbilin og puti nga mantsa sa mga baso ug plato kung mauga ang tubig ug mabilin ang mineral.

q: What does insulin do in your body after you eat a meal?
options: It helps move sugar from the blood into your cells to be used as energy
It breaks down the food in your stomach so nutrients enter the blood faster
It signals the liver to release stored fat to give you energy between meals
It carries oxygen from the lungs to the muscles that need energy to digest food
explanation: After eating, the pancreas releases insulin that helps move sugar from the blood into your cells, bringing blood sugar back to normal.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos kumain, tumataas ang asukal sa dugo. Ang pancreas ay nagbubuga ng hormone na tinatawag na insulin na tumutulong ipasok ang asukal sa mga cell para magamit bilang enerhiya—kaya bumababa ang asukal pabalik sa normal.
fact_bis: Human ka mokaon, mosaka ang asukal sa dugo. Ang pancreas magbuhi og hormone nga gitawag og insulin nga motabang sa pagpasulod sa asukal ngadto sa mga selula aron magamit isip enerhiya—busa mokunhod ang asukal balik sa normal.

q: How do mountains form from the movement of Earth's tectonic plates?
options: When two tectonic plates collide, the land is pushed upward and mountains form
When two tectonic plates pull apart, the gap fills with rock that piles up into mountains
When a single tectonic plate spins in place, the edges crumple up into mountains
When a tectonic plate floats on magma, the magma bubbles up and hardens into mountains
explanation: When two large pieces of Earth's crust (tectonic plates) collide, the land is pushed up and mountains form.
fact_tl: Kapag dalawang malalaking tipak ng balat ng Lupa (tectonic plates) ay nagbangga, natutulak ang lupa pataas at nabubuo ang mga bundok.
fact_bis: Kung magbangga ang duha ka dagkong piraso sa panit sa Yuta nga gitawag og tectonic plates, ang yuta matulod pataas ug mahimo ang mga bukid.

q: What do a duck's webbed feet help it do?
options: Swim in water by acting like paddles
Grip tree branches tightly without slipping
Dig burrows in soft muddy ground
Walk across slippery ice without falling
explanation: A duck has webbed feet that act like paddles so it can swim in water.
fact_tl: Ang itik ay may magkakabit na daliri sa paa na parang sagwan para makalangoy sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang itik adunay nagdikit nga mga tudlo sa tiil nga sama sa bugsay aron makalangoy sa tubig.

q: What does Storm Signal Number 1 tell people about an approaching storm?
options: Light winds from a storm may arrive within about 36 hours
Destructive winds are already hitting the area and evacuation should begin immediately
Heavy rain will fall for the next 12 hours with no strong winds expected
A storm is more than 5 days away and there is no immediate danger
explanation: Signal No. 1 is the lowest warning and means light winds from a storm may arrive within about 36 hours.
fact_tl: Ang Signal No. 1 ay ang pinakamababang babala at nangangahulugang may mahinang hanging dala ng bagyo na maaaring dumating sa loob ng 36 na oras.
fact_bis: Ang Signal No. 1 mao ang pinakaubos nga pasidaan ug nagpasabot nga adunay hinay nga hangin gikan sa bagyo nga moabot sulod sa mga 36 ka oras.

q: What kind of chemical substance is baking soda?
options: A chemical salt called sodium bicarbonate
A type of acid that makes bubbles when mixed with vinegar
A natural mineral scraped from the bottom of the ocean
A type of sugar compound made from fermented grains
explanation: Baking soda is sodium bicarbonate, a kind of chemical salt.
fact_tl: Ang baking soda ay sodium bicarbonate, isang uri ng asin sa kemika.
fact_bis: Ang baking soda kay sodium bicarbonate, usa ka matang sa kemikal nga asin.

q: Why is the center of a typhoon such a powerful part of the storm?
options: The air pressure is very low there, so surrounding air rushes in and spirals toward it, making the storm strong
The temperature is extremely hot at the center, and the heat pushes winds outward at great speed
The center spins the fastest because it is closest to the eye of the storm where rain is heaviest
Water evaporates at the center and rises so fast that it pulls ocean water up into the clouds above
explanation: At the center of a typhoon the air pressure is very low, and surrounding air rushes in and spirals toward it, which makes the storm strong.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng bagyo ay napakababa ng presyon ng hangin, at ang hangin mula sa paligid ay pumapasok at umiikot patungo dito, kaya lumalakas ang bagyo.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa bagyo ubos kaayo ang presyon sa hangin, ug ang hangin gikan sa palibot mosulod ug mosaka og tuyok paingon niini, mao nga mokusog ang bagyo.

q: What was special about the tail of the dinosaur Diplodocus?
options: It was very long and shaped like a whip
It was covered in sharp spines to defend against predators
It was wide and flat like a beaver's tail for swimming
It had a bony club at the end for striking enemies
explanation: Diplodocus had a very long tail shaped like a whip.
fact_tl: Ang Diplodocus ay may napakahabang buntot na parang latigo.
fact_bis: Ang Diplodocus adunay taas kaayo nga ikog nga sama sa latigo.

q: Why does a sealed soda bottle keep its carbon dioxide bubbles better than an open bottle?
options: The higher pressure inside the sealed bottle keeps more gas dissolved in the liquid
The cold temperature inside a sealed bottle turns the gas into a liquid automatically
The cap blocks oxygen from entering and reacting with the carbon dioxide inside
The sugar in the soda chemically binds to the gas and stops it from escaping
explanation: More gas dissolves in a liquid when the pressure is higher, so a sealed soda bottle is kept under pressure to keep the carbon dioxide dissolved.
fact_tl: Mas maraming gas ang natutunaw sa likido kapag mataas ang presyon; kaya naka-pressure ang selyadong bote ng softdrink para manatiling natunaw ang carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Mas daghang gas ang matunaw sa likido kon taas ang presyon; mao nga ang naselyado nga botelya sa softdrink gibutang ubos sa presyon aron magpabilin nga natunaw ang carbon dioxide.

q: What is one of the biggest threats to the narra tree in the Philippines?
options: Illegal logging, where trees are cut without permission to sell their valuable wood
Acid rain from nearby factories that dissolves the narra's roots over time
Invasive insect species that eat narra leaves faster than the tree can regrow them
Flooding from typhoons that washes away the soil narra trees need to grow
explanation: One of the biggest threats to narra is illegal logging, where trees are cut down without permission to sell their valuable wood.
fact_tl: Isa sa pinakamalaking banta sa narra ay ang ilegal na pagtotroso, kung saan pinuputol ang mga puno nang walang pahintulot para ibenta ang mahal na kahoy nito. Lumalaban ang gobyerno dito para hindi tuluyang maubos ang narra.
fact_bis: Usa sa labing dako nga hulga sa narra mao ang iligal nga pagputol, diin ginaputol ang mga kahoy nga walay pagtugot aron ibaligya ang mahal nga kahoy niini. Nakigbatok ang gobyerno niini aron dili mahurot ang narra.

q: What is the main purpose of a circuit breaker?
options: To automatically cut power when things get dangerous, protecting the circuit as a safety device
To turn lights and appliances on or off as an everyday convenience switch
To measure how much electricity a house uses each month and send data to the provider
To store electricity during the day so appliances can run at night without power
explanation: A breaker's real job is to automatically cut the power when things get dangerous — it is a safety device, not just an everyday switch.
fact_tl: Mali ang akala ng iba na ang breaker ay basta switch lang para buksan at isara ang ilaw. Totoo, puwede mo itong i-off nang manu-mano, pero ang totoong trabaho nito ay awtomatikong pumutol ng kuryente kapag delikado na — proteksyon ito, hindi pang-araw-araw na switch.
fact_bis: Sayop ang hunahuna sa uban nga ang breaker switch ra para ablihan ug sirad-an ang suga. Tinuod, mahimo nimo kining i-off pinaagi sa kamot, apan ang tinuod nga trabaho niini mao ang awtomatik nga pagputol sa kuryente kung delikado na — proteksyon kini, dili adlaw-adlaw nga switch.

q: What makes the monsoon winds called habagat and amihan different from each other?
options: They blow from opposite directions — habagat from the southwest and amihan from the northeast
They blow at different speeds — habagat is faster while amihan is slow and gentle
They carry different amounts of rain — habagat is dry and amihan brings all the rainfall
They occur at the same time each year but affect only different parts of the Philippines
explanation: Monsoons are winds that reverse direction with the seasons: from the southwest during the habagat, and from the northeast during the amihan.
fact_tl: Ang mga monsoon ay hangin na nagbabago ng direksyon ayon sa panahon: mula sa timog-kanluran tuwing habagat, at mula sa hilagang-silangan tuwing amihan.
fact_bis: Ang mga monsoon mao ang hangin nga mabalhin ang direksyon sumala sa panahon: gikan sa habagatan-kasadpan panahon sa habagat, ug gikan sa amihanan-sidlakan panahon sa amihan.

q: Why can sunlight reach Earth even though space is nearly empty?
options: Unlike sound, light can travel through empty space
Light travels along invisible air currents that stretch from the Sun to Earth
The Sun is hot enough to push light through space using thermal pressure
Light bounces from planet to planet until it finally reaches Earth
explanation: Unlike sound, light can travel through empty space, which is why sunlight is able to reach us.
fact_tl: Hindi gaya ng tunog, makakalakbay ang liwanag sa kawalan (space), kaya umaabot sa atin ang sinag ng Araw.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa tingog, ang kahayag makalakaw sa kawanangan, mao nga moabot kanato ang kahayag sa Adlaw.

q: Why is it dangerous when the lungs become sick with a disease like pneumonia?
options: The lungs take oxygen from the air and pass it to the blood, so sick lungs cannot do this important job
The lungs produce the hormones the body needs, and disease stops this chemical supply
The lungs control body temperature, and illness causes the body to overheat rapidly
The lungs filter germs out of the blood, and sick lungs let harmful bacteria circulate freely
explanation: The lungs' job is to take oxygen from the air and pass it to the blood, so it is dangerous when they are sick.
fact_tl: Ang trabaho ng baga ay kunin ang oxygen mula sa hangin at ibigay ito sa dugo, kaya delikado kapag may sakit ito.
fact_bis: Ang trabaho sa baga mao ang pagkuha sa oksiheno gikan sa hangin ug paghatag niini sa dugo, busa delikado kung masakit kini.

q: How do coral reefs help young fish survive?
options: Young fish hide and grow up in the reef's crevices before heading into the open sea
Young fish eat the coral itself until they are big enough to hunt other prey
Young fish use the bright colors of coral to attract mates at an early age
Young fish school around reefs to confuse large predators with their numbers
explanation: Many young fish hide and grow up in the crevices of a reef before heading out into the open sea.
fact_tl: Maraming batang isda ang nagtatago at lumalaki sa mga siwang ng bahura bago sila lumabas sa malawak na dagat.
fact_bis: Daghang gagmayng isda magtago ug modako sa mga liki sa bahura sa dili pa sila mogawas sa lawak nga dagat.

q: Why can you smell perfume spreading across a room even though you cannot see it moving?
options: The scent molecules are far too small to see, but they spread through the air and reach your nose
The perfume turns into a gas that is clear and invisible but heavy enough to flow along the floor
The smell travels along invisible electric charges in the air that carry it toward people
The scent dissolves into water vapor in the air, which is colorless and hard to detect
explanation: We cannot see scent molecules diffusing through the air because they are far too small, but we can smell the result.
fact_tl: Hindi natin nakikita ang mga molekula ng amoy na kumakalat sa hangin dahil napakaliit ng mga ito, pero naaamoy natin ang resulta ng diffusion.
fact_bis: Dili nato makita ang mga molekula sa humot nga mikatag sa hangin tungod kay gagmay kaayo kini, apan masimhutan nato ang resulta sa diffusion.

q: Why do geese and other large birds fly in a V shape during long journeys?
options: Each bird can ride the air pushed up by the bird ahead, saving energy on the trip
The V shape helps each bird see farther ahead so the flock avoids obstacles
Flying in a V keeps the birds warmer by trapping shared body heat in the center
The V shape makes the flock look like one giant bird to scare away predators
explanation: Big birds like geese fly in a V shape so each one can ride the air pushed up by the bird ahead, saving energy on long journeys.
fact_tl: Maraming malalaking ibon na tulad ng gansa ang lumilipad nang hugis-V upang makasakay sa hanging itinutulak ng pakpak ng nauuna, kaya nakakatipid sila ng lakas sa mahabang biyahe.
fact_bis: Daghang dagkong langgam sama sa gansa molupad nga porma sa V aron makasakay sa hangin nga gitulod sa pako sa nag-una, mao nga makatipig sila ug kusog sa taas nga panaw.

q: How do transparent animals like jellyfish hide from predators in open water?
options: Light passes through their nearly see-through bodies, making them seem to vanish
They sink to the very bottom where it is too dark for predators to spot them
They release ink clouds that confuse predators so the animals can escape unseen
They match the blue color of the ocean by reflecting the water around them
explanation: In open water where there is nowhere to hide, animals like jellyfish are nearly transparent so they seem to vanish as light passes through their bodies.
fact_tl: Sa bukas na tubig kung saan walang matataguan, ang ilang hayop tulad ng dikya at maliliit na hipon ay halos aninag, kaya parang naglalaho sila dahil dumadaan ang liwanag sa kanilang katawan.
fact_bis: Sa luag nga tubig diin walay katagoan, ang pipila ka mananap sama sa dikya ug gagmayng pasayan kay halos tin-aw, mao nga morag mawala sila kay molabay ang kahayag sa ilang lawas.

q: What do a chipmunk's cheek pouches help it do?
options: Stuff and carry seeds back to its food store
Puff up to scare away predators in the forest
Store water during dry seasons when streams dry up
Make loud sounds to communicate with other chipmunks
explanation: A chipmunk has stretchy cheek pouches that it stuffs full of seeds to carry back to its food store.
fact_tl: Ang chipmunk ay may malalaking bulsa sa pisngi na pinupuno nito ng mga buto para madala sa kanyang tagong pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang chipmunk naa'y dagkong supot sa iyang aping nga iyang pun-on og mga liso aron madala sa iyang tagoanan og pagkaon.

q: What kind of flavor is umami, and where can you find it?
options: A savory taste found in broth, meat, and cheese
A sour taste found in vinegar, lemons, and pickles
A bitter taste found in dark chocolate and coffee
A sweet taste found in honey, ripe fruit, and sugar cane
explanation: Umami is one of the five basic tastes — the savory taste found in broth, meat, and cheese.
fact_tl: Ang umami ay isa sa limang batayang lasa, ang malinamnam na lasa gaya ng sabaw, karne, at keso.
fact_bis: Ang umami usa sa lima ka sukaranang lami, ang lamiang lasa nga makita sa sabaw, karne, ug keso.

q: Black bread mold has special hyphae that absorb food from the bread. What are these root-like hyphae called?
options: Rhizoids
Stolons
Sporangiophores
Mycelium
explanation: Rhizopus stolonifer has three types of hyphae: rhizoids absorb food, stolons spread across the surface, and sporangiophores make spores.
fact_tl: Ang Rhizopus stolonifer ay ang karaniwang itim na amag na lumulaki sa tinapay — may tatlong uri itong sinulid: ang rhizoid (na nagkukuha ng pagkain), ang stolon (na kumakalat), at ang sporangiophore (na gumagawa ng spore).
fact_bis: Ang Rhizopus stolonifer mao ang naandan nga itom nga amag sa tinapay — adunay tulo ka klase niini nga hyphae: rhizoids nga nagkuha og pagkain, stolons nga nagpalawig niini sa ibabaw, ug sporangiophores nga nagbuhat og mga spore.

q: Where in the Philippines can pawikan (sea turtles) nest safely because the area is protected?
options: Turtle Islands in Tawi-Tawi
Palawan's Puerto Princesa Bay
Batanes Province
Lake Lanao in Mindanao
explanation: The Turtle Islands in Tawi-Tawi is one of the Philippines' protected sites where pawikan can nest safely.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga protektadong lugar tulad ng Turtle Islands sa Tawi-Tawi kung saan ligtas na nangingitlog ang pawikan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas adunay protektadong mga dapit sama sa Turtle Islands sa Tawi-Tawi diin luwas nga mangitlog ang pawikan.

q: What must you do to malunggay leaves before cooking them?
options: Pick them off the tough stalk
Soak them in salt water overnight
Dry them in the sun first
Boil the whole stalk with leaves on
explanation: Before cooking, the small malunggay leaves are picked off from the tough stalk.
fact_tl: Bago lutuin, tinatanggal muna ang maliliit na dahon ng malunggay mula sa matigas na tangkay.
fact_bis: Una iluto, tangtangon una ang gagmay nga dahon sa malunggay gikan sa gahi nga tangkay.

q: Why does a meteor glow and appear as a shooting star when it enters Earth's atmosphere?
options: Friction with the air creates intense heat that makes it glow
The Sun's rays hit it at a stronger angle in the atmosphere
It catches fire from the oxygen in the upper atmosphere
Gravity squeezes it and releases stored light energy
explanation: When a meteor enters the air, friction makes intense heat that causes it to glow as a shooting star.
fact_tl: Kapag pumapasok sa hangin ang bulalakaw, ang friction ay gumagawa ng matinding init na nagpapaningas dito.
fact_bis: Kung mosulod sa hangin ang bulalakaw, ang friction maghimo ug grabe nga init nga maoy hinungdan nga mosiga kini.

q: What international agreement controls or bans global trade in animals and plants that are in danger of going extinct?
options: CITES
IUCN
WWF
CBD
explanation: CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) is the international agreement that bans or controls trade in species facing extinction.
fact_tl: Ang CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) ay isang internasyonal na kasunduan na nagbabawal o nagkokontrol ng pandaigdigang kalakalan ng mga hayop at halaman na nanganganib na mawala.
fact_bis: Ang CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) usa ka internasyonal nga kasabutan nga nagdili o nagkontrol sa global nga kalakal sa mga mananap ug tanom nga nanganganib sa pagkapugos.

q: Once a virus gets inside a body cell, what does it use to make more copies of itself?
options: The cell's own machinery
Its own enzymes it brings with it
Nutrients from the blood
Oxygen from the cell's mitochondria
explanation: Once inside a cell, a virus uses the cell's own machinery to build many new copies of the virus.
fact_tl: Kapag nasa loob na ng selula, ginagamit ng virus ang makinarya ng selula para gumawa ng maraming bagong kopya ng virus.
fact_bis: Kon naa na sa sulod sa selula, gamiton sa virus ang makinarya sa selula aron maghimo og daghang bag-ong kopya sa virus.

q: How is an ammeter connected in a circuit to measure current correctly?
options: In series with the component
In parallel with the component
Between the battery terminals only
Outside the main circuit loop
explanation: An ammeter is connected in series so that the current flowing through the circuit passes directly through it.
fact_tl: Ang ammeter ay ikinakabit nang series upang sukatin ang current na dumadaan, samantalang ang voltmeter ay ikinakabit nang parallel upang sukatin ang boltahe sa dalawang dulo ng isang bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang ammeter gikonektar sa series aron sukdon ang current nga moagi, samtang ang voltmeter gikonektar sa parallel aron sukdon ang boltahe tabok sa usa ka bahin.

q: Which plane was used to break the sound barrier for the first time?
options: Bell X-1
SR-71 Blackbird
Concorde
Lockheed F-104
explanation: The Bell X-1 was the plane used to break the sound barrier.
fact_tl: Ang eroplanong ginamit upang malampasan ang sound barrier ay ang Bell X-1.
fact_bis: Ang eroplano nga gigamit aron malapasan ang sound barrier mao ang Bell X-1.

q: About how many times per minute does a resting human heart beat?
options: 70 times
200 times
30 times
120 times
explanation: A resting human heart beats about 70 times per minute, far slower than the shrew's thousands of beats.
fact_tl: Ang puso ng tao ay tumitibok ng mga 70 beses kada minuto kapag nakapahinga, na napakabagal kumpara sa libu-libong tibok ng shrew.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing sa tawo nga nagpahulay mopitik ug mga 70 ka beses kada minuto, hinay kaayo kay sa liboan nga pitik sa shrew.

q: Why should you wash your hands after handling garbage or throwing out trash?
options: Because garbage is full of germs and bacteria that can make you sick
Because your hands get chemically stained by plastic bags
Because the smell of garbage is toxic if it stays on skin
Because garbage bags often contain sharp objects
explanation: Garbage is full of germs and bacteria from rotting food and waste, so washing hands prevents illness from spreading.
fact_tl: Ang basura ay puno ng mga germ at bacteria mula sa nabubulok na pagkain at dumi. Pagkatapos magtapon o humawak ng basura, dapat kang maghugas ng kamay para hindi kumapit ang sakit sa iyo.
fact_bis: Ang basura puno sa germ ug bacteria gikan sa nadunot nga pagkaon ug hugaw. Human maglabay o magkupot og basura, kinahanglan ka maghugas sa kamot aron dili motapot ang sakit kanimo.

q: Why are power cables hung a little loose rather than pulled tight between poles?
options: So they don't snap when they shorten in the cold
To save copper wire during construction
To reduce the electrical resistance along the line
Because they are too heavy to hang straight
explanation: Power cables are hung loose on purpose so they don't snap when they contract (shorten) on cold nights due to thermal contraction.
fact_tl: Sinasadyang ipakabit nang medyo maluwag ang mga kableng pangkuryente para hindi ito maputol kapag umiikli sa malamig na gabi.
fact_bis: Ang mga kable sa kuryente tinuyo nga ipataod nga medyo luag aron dili kini mabugto kon moikli sa bugnaw nga gabii.

q: Which type of swiftlet nest is the most expensive?
options: Clean, white nests made almost entirely of saliva
Nests mixed with small feathers for added warmth
Dark-coloured nests from the deepest caves
Large nests built in clusters of three or more
explanation: The cleaner, whiter nests that are almost pure saliva are the most expensive, while those mixed with feathers or dirt are cheaper.
fact_tl: Hindi pare-pareho ang halaga ng pugad. Ang mas malinis at maputing pugad na halos puro-laway ang pinakamahal, habang mas mura ang may halong balahibo o dumi.
fact_bis: Dili managsama ang bili sa mga salag. Ang mas hinlo ug puti nga salag nga halos puro-laway maoy pinakamahal, samtang mas barato ang adunay sagol nga balhibo o hugaw.

q: At about what speed does an average person walk?
options: 5 kilometers per hour
15 kilometers per hour
1 kilometer per hour
10 kilometers per hour
explanation: An average person walks at about 5 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang tao ay naglalakad nang humigit-kumulang 5 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang kasagaran nga tawo molakaw sa mga 5 kilometro kada oras.

q: What happened to the town of Cagsawa during Mayon's 1814 eruption?
options: It was buried, leaving only the church belfry above the ground
It was completely destroyed by lava flows that reached the sea
It was flooded by a mudflow that washed it into Albay Gulf
It was covered by ash but rebuilt on the same site
explanation: In 1814, Mayon erupted and buried the town of Cagsawa, leaving only the church belfry above the ground.
fact_tl: Noong 1814, pumutok ang Mayon at tinabunan ang bayan ng Cagsawa, kaya ang kampanaryo ng simbahan na lang ang natira sa ibabaw ng lupa.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1814, mibuto ang Mayon ug gilubong ang lungsod sa Cagsawa, mao nga ang kampanaryo sa simbahan na lang ang nahibilin sa ibabaw sa yuta.

q: What is plasma in the blood?
options: The liquid part of blood, mostly water, in which blood cells float
The red cells that carry oxygen around the body
The white cells that fight germs and infection
The platelets that help blood clot after a cut
explanation: Plasma is the liquid part of blood, mostly water, in which the blood cells float.
fact_tl: Ang plasma ang likidong bahagi ng dugo na karamihan ay tubig at dito lumulutang ang mga selula.
fact_bis: Ang plasma mao ang likido nga bahin sa dugo nga kasagaran tubig, ug dinhi naglutaw ang mga selula sa dugo.

q: What finding from the Rosetta mission complicated the theory that comets delivered water to early Earth?
options: Comet 67P's water has a different chemical signature than Earth's water
Comet 67P contained no water ice at all
Comet 67P was moving away from Earth, not toward it
Comet 67P was too small to have delivered enough water
explanation: The Rosetta mission found that comet 67P's water has a different chemical signature than Earth's water, complicating the delivery theory.
fact_tl: Isang pangunahing teorya ay nagmumungkahi na ang bahagi ng tubig ng Earth ay dinala ng mga kometa at asteroid na bumagsak noong maagang panahon ng solar system (Late Heavy Bombardment); gayunpaman, ang Rosetta mission ay natuklasan na ang tubig ng kometa 67P ay may iba't ibang chemical signature kaysa sa tubig ng Earth, na nagpapakumplikado ng teoryang ito.
fact_bis: Usa ka nanguna nga teorya nagsugyot nga ang bahin sa tubig sa Yuta gihatod sa mga kometa ug asteroid nga mihangad sa sayo pang solar system (Late Heavy Bombardment); bisan pa niana, ang Rosetta mission nakakaplag nga ang tubig sa kometa 67P adunay lain nga chemical signature kaysa sa tubig sa Yuta, nagpakomplikado niining teorya.

q: Which is the longest river in the world and on which continent is it found?
options: The Nile River in Africa
The Amazon River in South America
The Yangtze River in Asia
The Mississippi River in North America
explanation: The Nile River in Africa is the longest river in the world, about 6,650 kilometers long.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamahabang ilog sa mundo ay ang Ilog Nile sa Africa, na may haba na mga 6,650 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang pinakataas nga suba sa kalibotan mao ang Suba sa Nile sa Africa, nga mga 6,650 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Why is soap better than water alone for removing germs from your hands?
options: Soap loosens and breaks apart the oils that germs cling to
Soap kills germs with its high temperature
Soap releases a chemical that destroys germ DNA
Soap makes your skin too dry for germs to survive
explanation: Soap helps loosen and break apart the oils that germs cling to, so they wash away with water.
fact_tl: Ang paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon ang isa sa pinakamabisang paraan para hindi kumalat ang sakit. Ang sabon ay tumutulong na alisin at lusawin ang taba na kinakapitan ng mga germ, kaya naaanod sila sa tubig. Mahalagang hugasan nang mabuti ang buong kamay nang ilang segundo.
fact_bis: Ang paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon usa sa pinakaepektibo nga paagi aron dili mokalat ang sakit. Ang sabon motabang sa pagtangtang ug pagbungkag sa lana nga gikuptan sa mga germ, busa maanod sila sa tubig. Importante nga hugasan og maayo ang tibuok kamot sulod sa pipila ka segundo.

q: Whose face appeared on the old 2-peso banknote that is no longer in use?
options: Jose Rizal
Andres Bonifacio
Emilio Aguinaldo
Manuel Quezon
explanation: Jose Rizal appeared on the old 2-peso banknote, which is no longer in use today.
fact_tl: Si Jose Rizal ang nasa lumang dalawang-pisong (2-peso) papel na pera, na hindi na ginagamit ngayon.
fact_bis: Si Jose Rizal mao ang anaa sa daan nga duha-ka-piso (2-peso) nga papel nga kwarta, nga dili na gamiton karon.

q: How does a coral polyp catch its food?
options: With tiny tentacles that have stinging cells to catch plankton
By filtering seawater through its body like a sponge
By absorbing nutrients directly through its hard skeleton
By waiting for dead fish to sink to the reef floor
explanation: A polyp has tiny tentacles with stinging cells to catch tiny plankton for food.
fact_tl: Ang polyp ay may maliliit na galamay na may makating selula para manghuli ng plankton na pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang polyp adunay gagmay nga galamay nga adunay makapaak nga selula aron manghuli og plankton nga pagkaon.

q: What is the name of the deepest part of the Philippine Trench, reaching about 10,540 meters down?
options: Emden Deep
Mariana Pit
Mindanao Abyss
Galathea Depth
explanation: The deepest part of the Philippine Trench is called the Emden Deep, named after the German ship that found it in 1927.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na bahagi ng Philippine Trench ay tinatawag na Emden Deep, na umaabot ng halos 10,540 metro ang lalim. Pinangalanan ito sa barkong Aleman na Emden na nakatuklas nito noong 1927.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga bahin sa Philippine Trench gitawag og Emden Deep, nga moabot og mga 10,540 ka metro ang giladmon. Ginganlan kini sa barkong Aleman nga Emden nga nakakaplag niini niadtong 1927.

q: Which crickets and grasshoppers make chirping or singing sounds — males, females, or both?
options: Usually only the males
Usually only the females
Both males and females equally
Neither; the sound comes from their wings rubbing on leaves
explanation: Usually only the male crickets and grasshoppers sing, not the females.
fact_tl: Karaniwang ang mga lalaking kuliglig at tipaklong lang ang umaawit, hindi ang mga babae.
fact_bis: Kasagaran ang lalaki nga kagang ug apan lamang ang mag-awit, dili ang baye.

q: What was the name of the first quartz wristwatch, and which company made it?
options: Seiko Astron, made by Seiko of Japan
Timex Quartz, made by Timex of the USA
Omega Electroquartz, made by Omega of Switzerland
Citizen Crystron, made by Citizen of Japan
explanation: The Seiko Astron was the first quartz wristwatch, released by Seiko of Japan in 1969.
fact_tl: Ang Seiko Astron ang unang quartz na relo sa pulso, na inilabas ng Seiko ng Japan noong 1969.
fact_bis: Ang Seiko Astron mao ang unang quartz nga relo sa pulso, gipagawas sa Seiko sa Japan niadtong 1969.

q: On Earth, about how much does a 1-kilogram object weigh in newtons?
options: About 10 newtons
About 1 newton
About 100 newtons
About 9 newtons
explanation: On Earth, a 1-kilogram object weighs about 9.8 newtons, which is often rounded to about 10 N.
fact_tl: Sa Earth, ang isang 1-kilogramong bagay ay tumitimbang ng halos 9.8 newton (madalas binibilog na mga 10 N).
fact_bis: Sa Earth, ang usa ka 1-kilogramo nga butang adunay gibug-aton nga mga 9.8 newton (kasagaran giliboot ngadto sa mga 10 N).

q: Why are mines often found in mountain ranges like the Cordillera?
options: Heat and pressure deep in the earth gather minerals like gold and copper in mountain rocks
Mountain air keeps the minerals from rusting before they can be mined
Rivers wash minerals up the mountains and deposit them in the peaks
Mountains are easier to dig through because the rock is softer at high altitude
explanation: Many useful minerals lie inside mountain ranges because heat and pressure deep in the earth gather them in the rock.
fact_tl: Maraming mahahalagang mineral ang nasa loob ng mga mountain range, tulad ng ginto at tanso, dahil ang init at presyon sa loob ng lupa ay nag-iipon ng mga ito sa bato. Kaya may mga minahan sa Cordillera. Pero kailangang maingat ang pagmimina para hindi masira ang gubat at maagusan ng putik ang mga ilog.
fact_bis: Daghang mahinungdanong mineral ang naa sulod sa mga mountain range, sama sa bulawan ug tumbaga, kay ang init ug presyur sa sulod sa yuta magtigom niini sa bato. Mao nga adunay mga minahan sa Cordillera. Apan kinahanglan mag-amping ang pagmina aron dili maguba ang lasang ug dili matabonan og lapok ang mga suba.

q: How does pollen get carried from one flower to another during pollination?
options: Pollen sticks to a pollinator's body while it drinks nectar and is carried to other flowers
The flower shoots pollen into the air where the wind blows it onto pollinators
Pollinators bite off pollen and carry it in their mouths to the next flower
Rain washes pollen off the flower onto nearby visiting insects
explanation: While drinking nectar, pollen sticks to the pollinator's body and gets carried to other flowers.
fact_tl: Habang umiinom ng nektar, dumidikit ang pollen sa katawan ng pollinator at nadadala nito sa ibang bulaklak.
fact_bis: Samtang nag-inom ug nektar, ang polen mopilit sa lawas sa pollinator ug madala niini ngadto sa ubang bulak.

q: Why does nata de coco look almost see-through like glass?
options: It is mostly water held by tiny, neatly arranged fibers that let light pass through
It is cooked at very high heat that melts the coconut fibers into a clear gel
The coconut water bleaches the fibers white and then clear during fermentation
Sugar dissolves all the solid parts, leaving only a transparent jelly behind
explanation: Nata de coco looks clear because it is mostly water held by extremely thin, neatly arranged fibers that allow light to pass through.
fact_tl: Malinaw ang nata de coco dahil halos tubig lang ang laman nito na hawak ng napakanipis na mga hibla. Dahil maliliit at maayos ang pagkakaayos ng mga hibla, dumadaan ang liwanag dito at nagiging halos transparent ito.
fact_bis: Tin-aw ang nata de coco kay halos tubig ra ang sulod niini nga gigunitan sa nipis kaayo nga mga hilo. Tungod kay gagmay ug han-ay ang mga hilo, moagi ang kahayag niini, mao nga halos lutaw kini tan-awon.

q: Why does using antibiotics too often or wrongly lead to antibiotic resistance?
options: A few tough bacteria survive and multiply, producing strains the medicine can no longer kill
Antibiotics change into a weaker form inside the body the more times they are used
Our immune system starts blocking the antibiotic so it cannot reach the bacteria
Bacteria hide inside body cells where antibiotics cannot reach them after repeated doses
explanation: When antibiotics are misused, naturally tough bacteria survive and multiply, creating strains the medicine can no longer kill.
fact_tl: Kapag madalas o maling ginagamit ang antibiotics, ang ilang bakteryang likas na matibay ay nakakaligtas at dumarami, kaya nabubuo ang mga bakteryang hindi na tinatablan ng gamot.
fact_bis: Kon kanunay o sayop nga gamiton ang antibiotics, ang pipila ka natural nga lig-on nga bakterya makalahutay ug modaghan, mao nga motumaw ang mga bakterya nga dili na matablan sa tambal.

q: How do glaciers change the shape of the land as they move?
options: They slowly drag rock along and carve out wide valleys
They melt and deposit sand to form flat plains
They push mountains higher by piling ice on top
They dissolve the rock beneath them with meltwater acid
explanation: A glacier is a huge mass of ice that slowly moves and carves out wide valleys as it drags rock along.
fact_tl: Ang glacier ay malaking masa ng yelo na dahan-dahang gumagalaw at umuukit ng malalawak na lambak habang dinadala nito ang bato.
fact_bis: Ang glacier usa ka dako nga tipun-tipon nga yelo nga hinay-hinay nga molihok ug mokalot og lapad nga walog samtang gidala niini ang bato.

q: What is PhilSys, and what is its main purpose?
options: A government program giving every Filipino one official ID to make accessing services easier
A government scholarship program for public school students in the Philippines
A national health insurance system covering all Filipino citizens at low cost
A digital payment system linking all Filipino bank accounts to one app
explanation: The Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) is a government program that gives every Filipino one official ID to make accessing services easier.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Identification System o PhilSys ay isang programa ng pamahalaan na nagbibigay ng isang opisyal na ID sa bawat Pilipino upang mas madaling makakuha ng mga serbisyo.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Identification System o PhilSys usa ka programa sa gobyerno nga naghatag sa matag Pilipino og usa ka opisyal nga ID aron mas sayon nga makakuha sa mga serbisyo.

q: In Ohm's law, what unit is used to measure electrical resistance, and what is its symbol?
options: Ohm, symbolized by the Greek letter omega (Ω)
Watt, symbolized by the letter W
Ampere, symbolized by the letter A
Joule, symbolized by the letter J
explanation: In Ohm's law, resistance is measured in ohms, and the symbol for the ohm is the Greek letter omega (Ω).
fact_tl: Sa batas ni Ohm, ang boltahe ay sinusukat sa volt, ang kuryente sa ampere (o amp), at ang resistensya sa ohm. Ang simbolo ng ohm ay ang letrang Griyego na omega (Ω).
fact_bis: Sa balaod ni Ohm, ang boltahe gisukod sa volt, ang kuryente sa ampere (o amp), ug ang resistensya sa ohm. Ang simbolo sa ohm kay ang Griyegong letra nga omega (Ω).

q: Where must the Sun be for you to see a rainbow?
options: Behind you, with rain in front of you
In front of you, with rain behind you
Directly overhead, with rain all around
On your left side, with rain on your right
explanation: To see a rainbow, the sun must be behind you and the rain must be in front of you.
fact_tl: Para makita ang bahaghari, kailangan nasa likod mo ang araw at nasa harap mo ang ulan. Kaya madalas nakikita ang bahaghari sa umaga o hapon kapag mababa ang araw.
fact_bis: Aron makita ang balangaw, kinahanglan anaa sa imong luyo ang adlaw ug anaa sa imong atubangan ang ulan. Mao nga sagad makita ang balangaw sa buntag o hapon kung ubos ang adlaw.

q: How many bonds can a single carbon atom form with other atoms?
options: Four bonds
Two bonds
One bond
Six bonds
explanation: A carbon atom can form four bonds with other atoms, letting it build a huge variety of molecules, including those in all living things.
fact_tl: Ang carbon ay nakakabuo ng apat na bond sa ibang atom, kaya kayang-kaya nitong gumawa ng napakaraming iba't ibang molekula—kabilang ang mga molekulang bumubuo sa lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang carbon makahimo og upat ka bond sa ubang mga atomo, mao nga kaya niini maghimo og daghan kaayong nagkalain-laing molekula—lakip na ang mga molekula nga naglangkob sa tanang buhing butang.

q: What should you do to protect your hearing when there is a sudden loud noise?
options: Cover your ears with your hands or move away from the sound
Open your mouth wide to equalize the air pressure in your ears
Press your fingers against your eardrums gently
Hum loudly to cancel out the noise with your own sound
explanation: When there is a sudden loud noise, you should cover your ears with your hands or move away to protect your hearing.
fact_tl: Kapag may biglang malakas na ingay, takpan ang iyong tainga ng mga kamay o lumayo upang maprotektahan ang pandinig.
fact_bis: Kon adunay kalit nga kusog nga saba, tabuni ang imong dalunggan sa imong kamot o palayo aron mapanalipdan ang imong pandungog.

q: Why do the positive and negative charges in an ionic compound need to be equal?
options: So the compound is electrically neutral overall
So the compound can conduct electricity when dissolved
So the ions can dissolve in water more easily
So the compound does not react with oxygen in the air
explanation: In an ionic compound, the total positive and negative charges must be equal so the compound is electrically neutral.
fact_tl: Sa ionic compound, kailangan PANTAY ang kabuuang positive at negative charge. Kung +1 ang sodium at -1 ang chlorine, nag-cancel sila kaya neutral ang compound. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit ganoon ang formula.
fact_bis: Sa ionic compound, kinahanglan PAREHO ang kinatibuk-ang positive ug negative charge. Kung +1 ang sodium ug -1 ang chlorine, magkanselar sila mao nga neutral ang compound. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong ingon niana ang formula.

q: Which combination of symptoms is most closely associated with tuberculosis (TB)?
options: Cough lasting more than two weeks, fever, night sweats, and weight loss
Sudden high fever, rash on the skin, and swollen glands in the neck
Runny nose, sore throat, and sneezing for about one week
Stomach cramps, vomiting, and diarrhea for two to three days
explanation: Common signs of TB are a cough lasting more than two weeks, fever, night sweats, and losing weight.
fact_tl: Ang mga karaniwang sintomas ng TB ay matagal na ubo na lampas dalawang linggo, lagnat, pagpapawis sa gabi, at pagpapayat.
