fact_bis: Ang kasagarang sintomas sa TB mao ang dugay nga ubo nga kapin sa duha ka semana, hilanat, pansingot sa gabii, ug pagniwang.

q: How do seismic isolators protect a building during an earthquake?
options: Rubber and spring bearings at the foundation absorb seismic vibrations before they reach the structure
Steel cables tie the roof to the ground so the building cannot sway
Extra thick concrete walls spread the shaking evenly through the whole building
The building is raised on stilts so earthquake waves pass underneath it
explanation: Seismic isolators use rubber and spring bearings at the foundation to absorb seismic vibrations and protect the structure above.
fact_tl: Ang ilang mga gusali sa mga lugar na madaling matamaan ng lindol ay ginagamit ng seismic isolators — mga rubber at metal na spring sa pundasyon na sumasipsip ng vibration ng lindol at nagpoprotekta sa gusali.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka mga gusali sa mga lugar nga madaling matamaan sa lindol naggamit sa seismic isolators — rubber ug spring bearings sa pundasyon nga nagsipsip sa seismic vibrations ug nagpanalipod sa istruktura sa ibabaw.

q: On a standard map, which direction is found on the right side?
options: East
West
North
South
explanation: On a standard map, East is on the right side.
fact_tl: Sa karaniwang mapa, ang Silangan (East) ay nasa kanang bahagi.
fact_bis: Sa naandang mapa, ang Sidlakan (East) anaa sa tuong bahin.

q: Where in your body is sound produced when you speak or sing?
options: In the larynx (voice box) inside the neck
In the lungs where air is stored
In the nasal cavity behind the nose
In the trachea (windpipe) in the chest
explanation: The larynx, or voice box, sits inside the neck and is where the sound of our voice is made.
fact_tl: Ang larynx o kahon ng boses ay nasa loob ng leeg natin at dito gawa ang tunog ng ating boses.
fact_bis: Ang larynx o kahon sa tingog naa sa sulod sa atong liog ug diri gihimo ang tunog sa atong boses.

q: About how tall is the San Roque Dam, the tallest dam in the Philippines?
options: About 200 meters
About 50 meters
About 500 meters
About 100 meters
explanation: The San Roque Dam is about 200 meters tall, making it the tallest dam in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang San Roque Dam ay halos 200 metro ang taas, na ginagawa itong pinakamataas na dam sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang San Roque Dam mga 200 metros ang gihabogon, mao nga kini ang pinakahabog nga dam sa Pilipinas.

q: What sea conditions make it easier for plankton blooms (like red tide) to form?
options: Warm and calm seawater
Cold and rough seawater
Deep and dark seawater
Salty and acidic seawater
explanation: Plankton blooms form more easily when seawater is warm and calm, so red tide can become more common under such conditions.
fact_tl: Mas madaling magkaroon ng plankton bloom kapag mainit at kalmado ang tubig dagat, kaya minsan mas madalas ang red tide sa mga panahong ito.
fact_bis: Mas sayon ang pagtungha sa plankton bloom kung init ug kalmado ang tubig dagat, mao nga ang red tide mahimong mas kanunay niini nga panahon.

q: Why are dry sugarcane leaves sometimes burned before harvest?
options: To make cutting the stalks easier
To kill insects that eat the sugarcane roots
To add ash as fertilizer to the soil for next season
To dry the juice inside the stalks and make sugar sweeter
explanation: Before harvest, the dry sugarcane leaves are sometimes burned to make cutting the stalks easier.
fact_tl: Bago anihin, minsan sinusunog ang mga tuyong dahon ng tubo upang mas madaling putulin ang tangkay.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa anihon, usahay sunogon ang ugang dahon sa tubo aron mas sayon putlon ang punoan.

q: Why do farmers sometimes add lime to their soil?
options: To reduce the soil's acidity so plants can absorb nutrients more easily
To add nitrogen that plants need to grow green leaves
To kill harmful worms and insects living in the topsoil
To make the soil heavier so it does not wash away in rain
explanation: Soil pH affects plant growth by controlling how easily roots take up nutrients, and farmers add lime to reduce a soil's acidity.
fact_tl: Ang pH ng lupa ay nakakaapekto sa paglaki ng mga tanim dahil kinokontrol nito kung gaano kadaling makuha ng ugat ang mga sustansya; minsan naglalagay ang mga magsasaka ng apog upang bawasan ang asido ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang pH sa yuta makaapekto sa pagtubo sa mga tanom kay gikontrol niini kung unsa kasayon makuha sa gamot ang mga sustansya; usahay magbutang ang mga mag-uuma og apog aron kunhoran ang kaaslom sa yuta.

q: Who was Pythagoras?
options: An ancient Greek mathematician famous for his theorem about right triangles
A Roman emperor who funded the first geometry school
An Egyptian pharaoh who used math to design the pyramids
A Persian astronomer who discovered the planets' circular orbits
explanation: Pythagoras was an ancient Greek mathematician and philosopher famous for his theorem about right triangles.
fact_tl: Si Pythagoras ay isang sinaunang Griyegong matematiko at pilosopo na sikat sa kanyang teorema tungkol sa right triangle.
fact_bis: Si Pythagoras usa ka karaang Griyegong matematiko ug pilosopo nga inila sa iyang teorema bahin sa right triangle.

q: How are intestinal worms different from an ordinary germ stomach bug?
options: A germ stomach bug clears up in a few days, but worms can stay inside you until treated with the right medicine
Worms cause vomiting and fever while a germ bug only causes stomach pain
Worms are destroyed by the immune system, but a germ bug needs antibiotics
A germ bug lasts longer because it reproduces inside the gut faster than worms do
explanation: A germ stomach bug usually clears up in a few days, but worms can stay inside you for a long time until the right medicine treats them.
fact_tl: Iba ang bulati sa karaniwang sakit sa tiyan na dulot ng mikrobyo. Ang sakit sa tiyan mula sa mikrobyo ay madalas mabilis gumaling sa loob ng ilang araw, pero ang bulati ay puwedeng manatili sa loob mo nang matagal hanggang gamutin ng tamang gamot.
fact_bis: Lahi ang bulati sa ordinaryong sakit sa tiyan nga gikan sa mikrobyo. Ang sakit sa tiyan gikan sa mikrobyo kasagaran maayo dayon sa pipila ka adlaw, apan ang bulati mahimong magpabilin sa sulod nimo og dugay hangtod matambalan sa husto nga tambal.

q: How does breast milk help protect a newborn baby from infections?
options: It contains antibodies (especially IgA) that give the baby temporary protection against infections
It raises the baby's body temperature to kill germs before they can spread
It contains white blood cells that live permanently in the baby's blood
It coats the baby's stomach lining so germs cannot enter the bloodstream
explanation: Breast milk contains antibodies, especially IgA, that give the baby temporary protection against infections.
fact_tl: Ang gatas ng ina ay naglalaman ng mga antibody (lalo na ang IgA) na nagbibigay sa sanggol ng pansamantalang proteksyon laban sa mga impeksyon — ito ang isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit ang breastfeeding ay mahalaga sa kalusugan ng sanggol.
fact_bis: Ang gatas sa ina naglangkob sa mga antibody (labi na ang IgA) nga naghatag sa sanggol og pansamantalang proteksyon batok sa mga impeksyon — usa sa mga hinungdan kung ngano ang breastfeeding importante para sa kalusugan sa bata.

q: What kind of plant is a guava (bayabas)?
options: A small tree that bears a fruit also called guava
A tall vine that climbs walls and bears sweet fruit
A root vegetable that grows underground like a potato
A grass plant whose seeds are used to make juice
explanation: The guava is a small tree that bears a fruit also called guava.
fact_tl: Ang bayabas ay isang maliit na puno na namumunga ng prutas na tinatawag ding bayabas.
fact_bis: Ang bayabas usa ka gamay nga kahoy nga mamunga ug prutas nga ginatawag usab ug bayabas.

q: Why is it harmful when a housefly lands on your food?
options: The fly lands on poop and garbage, so germs cling to its body and get left on your food
The fly sprays a chemical from its wings that spoils food instantly
The fly lays invisible eggs on food that hatch into worms when you eat them
The fly's legs are coated with acid that breaks down vitamins in the food
explanation: A housefly lands on poop and garbage, so germs cling to its body, and when it lands on food it leaves those germs behind.
fact_tl: Dumadapo ang langaw sa dumi at basura, kaya may mga germ (mikrobyo) sa kanyang katawan. Kapag dumapo ito sa pagkain mo, naiiwan ang mga germ na ito.
fact_bis: Ang langaw motugdon sa hugaw ug basura, mao nga adunay mga germ (mikrobyo) sa iyang lawas. Kon motugdon kini sa imong pagkaon, mabilin ang mga germ.

q: In a pair of scissors, where is the fulcrum (pivot point) located?
options: In the middle, where the screw holds the two blades together
At the handle end, where you put your fingers
At the blade tips, where the cutting happens
At the very bottom of one of the handles
explanation: Scissors are a first-class lever, which means the fulcrum (the screw) sits in the middle, with effort at one end and cutting at the other.
fact_tl: Ang gunting ay isang first-class lever o unang-uri na palanca. Ibig sabihin, ang fulcrum (turnilyo) ay nasa gitna, ang puwersa mo ay nasa isang dulo, at ang gupit ay nasa kabilang dulo.
fact_bis: Ang gunting usa ka first-class lever o unang-klase nga palanca. Buot pasabot, ang fulcrum (turnilyo) anaa sa tunga, ang imong kusog anaa sa usa ka tumoy, ug ang putol anaa sa pikas tumoy.

q: If you dropped a heavy bowling ball and a light tennis ball at the same time in a vacuum (no air), what would happen?
options: They would hit the ground at exactly the same time
The bowling ball would hit the ground first because it is heavier
The tennis ball would hit the ground first because it is lighter
The bowling ball would fall faster but the tennis ball would bounce higher
explanation: With no air resistance, heavy and light objects fall at the same rate — Galileo showed this.
fact_tl: Kapag walang hangin (vacuum), ang mabigat at magaan na bagay ay sabay na bumabagsak — pinatunayan ito ni Galileo.
fact_bis: Kon walay hangin (vacuum), ang bug-at ug gaan nga butang dungan nga mahulog — gipakita kini ni Galileo.

q: In a food chain, which type of animal is called a primary consumer?
options: Plant-eating animals like the carabao and deer
Meat-eating animals like lions and crocodiles
Animals that eat both plants and meat, like pigs
Tiny animals that break down dead matter, like worms
explanation: Plant-eating animals (herbivores) are called primary consumers — they are the second link in the food chain, right after the plant.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na kumakain ng halaman (herbivore) ang tinatawag na primary consumers — sila ang pangalawang kawing sa food chain, kasunod agad ng halaman. Halimbawa nito ang kalabaw at usa.
fact_bis: Ang mga hayop nga mokaon og tanom (herbivore) gitawag og primary consumers — sila ang ikaduhang link sa food chain, sunod dayon sa tanom. Pananglitan ang kabaw ug usa.

q: Inside a wind turbine, what kind of energy does moving wind get changed into?
options: Electrical energy
Heat energy
Chemical energy
Sound energy
explanation: Inside a turbine, the kinetic energy of moving wind is changed into electrical energy.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng turbina, ang enerhiya ng gumagalaw na hangin ay nagiging enerhiyang elektrikal.
fact_bis: Sulod sa turbine, ang enerhiya sa naglihok nga hangin mahimong enerhiyang elektrikal.

q: When salt dissolves in water, what kind of change is it, and how do you know?
options: A physical change, because you can get the salt back by evaporating the water
A chemical change, because the salt disappears and cannot be recovered
A physical change, because the water changes color when the salt is added
A chemical change, because mixing salt and water releases heat
explanation: Dissolving salt is a physical change because you can recover the salt by evaporating the water — no new substance is formed.
fact_tl: Kapag natunaw ang asin sa tubig, mababawi ito kapag pinasingaw ang tubig, kaya pisikal na pagbabago ito.
fact_bis: Kung matunaw ang asin sa tubig, makuha kini balik pinaagi sa pagpasingaw sa tubig, busa pisikal kini nga kausaban.

q: What is a sprain?
options: When the ligaments around a joint are stretched or torn too far
When a bone breaks into two pieces inside the body
When a muscle gets too tired and stops working
When cartilage between two bones slowly wears away
explanation: A sprain happens when the ligaments around a joint are stretched or torn too far, causing swelling and pain.
fact_tl: Kapag napilay, ang mga ligamento sa paligid ng kasukasuan ay nabanat o napunit nang sobra, kaya namamaga at sumasakit ito.
fact_bis: Ang piang mahitabo kon ang mga ligamento palibot sa lutahan mabanat o magisi sa sobra, mao nga mohubag ug mosakit kini.

q: Which scientist first proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection?
options: Charles Darwin
Gregor Mendel
Louis Pasteur
Carl Linnaeus
explanation: Charles Darwin proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin ang nagmungkahi ng teorya ng ebolusyon sa pamamagitan ng natural na pagpili (natural selection).
fact_bis: Si Charles Darwin mao ang nagsugyot sa teorya sa ebolusyon pinaagi sa natural nga pagpili (natural selection).

q: Why do cold ocean currents help sea creatures like plankton thrive?
options: They bring up nutrients from the deep water through upwelling
They raise the water temperature so plankton grow faster
They push warm, sunlit surface water into deeper zones
They carry more oxygen from the air down to the seafloor
explanation: Cold currents often have upwelling, where cold water from the deep rises and brings up nutrients that plankton feed on.
fact_tl: Ang malamig na agos ay madalas na may upwelling, kung saan ang malamig na tubig mula sa kailaliman ay umaakyat at nagdadala ng sustansya na kinakain ng plankton.
fact_bis: Ang bugnaw nga sulog kasagaran adunay upwelling, diin ang bugnaw nga tubig gikan sa kahiladman mosaka ug magdala og sustansya nga gikaon sa plankton.

q: What happens when a shark loses one of its front teeth?
options: A tooth from the row behind moves forward to replace it
The tooth slowly grows back from the same root
The shark must survive with fewer teeth for the rest of its life
A new tooth grows in from the side, not from behind
explanation: Sharks have multiple rows of teeth; when a front tooth falls out, the next row moves forward to replace it, and a shark may replace thousands of teeth over its lifetime.
fact_tl: Ang mga pating ay may maraming hanay ng ngipon sa likod ng pangunahing hanay; kapag nahulog ang isang ngipon, pasulong ang susunod na hanay upang palitan ito — maaaring mapalitan ng pating ang libu-libong ngipon sa buong buhay nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga pating adunay daghang laray sa ngipon sa luyo sa unahan nga laray; sa dihang mahulog ang usa ka ngipon, ang sunod nga laray mosulod aron palitan — ang usa ka pating mahimong magpalit og libu-libong ngipon sa tibuok kinabuhi niini.

q: What does an unconformity in a rock record tell scientists?
options: That some layers are missing because of erosion or periods when no sediment was deposited
That two different types of rock were pressed together by an earthquake
That the rocks in that area are much younger than the rocks around them
That a river once ran across that spot and left behind sediment
explanation: An unconformity is a gap in the rock record where some layers are missing due to erosion or non-deposition, so spans of time are absent from the record.
fact_tl: Ang unconformity ay isang puwang sa rock record kung saan nawawala ang ilang layer dahil sa erosion o dahil walang nadeposito, kaya may mga nawawalang yugto ng panahon sa talaan ng bato.
fact_bis: Ang unconformity usa ka gintang sa rock record diin nawala ang pipila ka layer tungod sa erosion o tungod kay walay sediment nga nasalog, busa adunay nawala nga mga yugto sa panahon sa rekord sa bato.

q: Why are fruit ripening and rotting considered chemical changes?
options: Because the color, taste, and smell of the fruit change permanently
Because the fruit gets softer and loses water, which can be reversed
Because the fruit changes size but its inside stays exactly the same
Because you can make a rotten banana go back to being fresh by cooling it
explanation: Fruit ripening and rotting are chemical changes because the color, taste, and smell change — new substances form that cannot easily be reversed.
fact_tl: Ang paghinog at pagkabulok ng prutas tulad ng saging ay kemikal na pagbabago dahil nagbabago ang kulay, lasa, at amoy nito.
fact_bis: Ang paghinog ug pagkadunot sa prutas sama sa saging kay kemikal nga kabag-ohan kay mausab ang kolor, lami, ug baho niini.

q: A substance has a pH of 9. What does this tell you about it?
options: It is basic (alkaline) and may feel slippery or taste bitter
It is acidic and will likely taste sour like vinegar
It is neutral, just like pure water
It is a strong acid that can burn your skin
explanation: Things with a pH above 7 are basic (alkaline) and often feel slippery and taste bitter, like soap and baking soda.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagay na may pH na mas mataas sa 7 ay basic (o alkaline) at kadalasang madulas at mapakla — tulad ng sabon at baking soda.
fact_bis: Ang mga butang nga adunay pH nga taas sa 7 kay base (o alkaline) ug sagad madanlog ug mapait — sama sa sabon ug baking soda.

q: What does a bougainvillea plant do when there is very little water during a very dry spell?
options: It drops its leaves to save water
It grows extra-thick leaves to hold water inside
It sends its roots deeper to find underground water immediately
It stops making food but keeps all its leaves to catch more sunlight
explanation: When the weather is very dry, bougainvillea may drop its leaves as a way of saving water, then grows new ones when it rains.
fact_tl: Kapag napakatuyo ng panahon at kulang sa tubig, maaaring malagas o mahulog ang mga dahon ng bougainvillea. Ito ay paraan nito para makatipid ng tubig. Pagdating ng ulan o madiligan ito, muli itong tutubo ng bagong dahon.
fact_bis: Kung uga kaayo ang panahon ug kulang sa tubig, mahimong mangahulog ang mga dahon sa bougainvillea. Kini ang paagi niini aron makatipig og tubig. Kung moabot ang ulan o mabisbisan kini, motubo na usab kini og bag-ong dahon.

q: What makes a frog an amphibian?
options: It lives both in water and on land
It breathes only through gills like a fish
It is covered in scales and lays eggs in dry soil
It is a cold-blooded reptile that never goes in water
explanation: A frog is an amphibian, which means it lives both in water and on land.
fact_tl: Ang palaka ay isang amphibian, ibig sabihin nakatira ito sa tubig at sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang baki kay usa ka amphibian, nagpasabot nga nagpuyo ni sa tubig ug sa yuta.

q: How does the parasite that causes schistosomiasis actually spread from person to person?
options: It must first pass through a snail and water before it can enter another person
You catch it by holding hands or living in the same house as a sick person
It spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes
It is passed directly through a mosquito bite like malaria
explanation: Schistosomiasis does not spread by touching a sick person — the parasite must first pass through a snail and water before it can enter another person.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakalang nakakahawa ang schistosomiasis kapag nahawakan mo ang may sakit, pero mali ito. Hindi ka tatablan kahit magkasama kayo sa bahay o magkahawak ng kamay. Kailangan munang dumaan ang parasito sa suso at sa tubig bago ito makapasok sa ibang tao.
fact_bis: Daghan ang nagtuo nga ang schistosomiasis makatakod kon mahikap nimo ang masakiton, apan sayop kini. Dili ka matakdan bisan magpuyo mo sa usa ka balay o maggunitay sa kamot. Ang parasito kinahanglan unang moagi sa kuhol ug tubig una kini makasulod sa lain nga tawo.

q: Which mosquito spreads malaria, and what causes the disease?
options: The Anopheles mosquito spreads it, and it is caused by a parasite
The Aedes mosquito spreads it, and it is caused by a virus
The Culex mosquito spreads it, and it is caused by bacteria
The Anopheles mosquito spreads it, and it is caused by a virus
explanation: Malaria is spread by the Anopheles mosquito and caused by a parasite, not a virus, and is still common in places like Palawan.
fact_tl: Ang malaria ay dala ng lamok na Anopheles at sanhi ng isang parasito, hindi virus, na karaniwan pa rin sa ilang lugar tulad ng Palawan.
fact_bis: Ang malaria gidala sa lamok nga Anopheles ug gikan sa usa ka parasito, dili virus, ug kasagaran gihapon sa mga lugar sama sa Palawan.

q: What is the smallest unit of life that makes up all living things?
options: The cell
The atom
The molecule
The tissue
explanation: The cell is the smallest unit of life, and all living things are made of one or many cells.
fact_tl: Ang selula ang pinakamaliit na yunit ng buhay, at lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay ay gawa sa isa o maraming selula.
fact_bis: Ang sélula mao ang pinakagamay nga bahin sa kinabuhi, ug ang tanang buhing butang gihimo gikan sa usa o daghang sélula.

q: To what family of trees does the Philippine balete tree belong?
options: The fig family (Ficus)
The palm family (Arecaceae)
The bamboo family (Poaceae)
The pine family (Pinaceae)
explanation: The balete is a kind of fig tree (Ficus), so it is related to trees that bear small figs.
fact_tl: Ang balete ay isang uri ng puno ng igos (Ficus), kaya kamag-anak ito ng mga punong namumunga ng maliliit na igos.
fact_bis: Ang balete usa ka matang sa kahoy nga igos (Ficus), busa paryente kini sa mga kahoy nga namunga ug gagmayng igos.

q: In the game tumbang-preso, how does a thrown slipper knock the can over?
options: The force of the moving slipper pushes the can when it strikes it
The air pushed by the flying slipper blows the can sideways
The sound of the slipper hitting the ground vibrates the can until it falls
Gravity pulls the can down harder when the slipper lands nearby
explanation: In tumbang-preso, the force of the moving slipper pushes the can over when the slipper strikes it.
fact_tl: Sa tumbang-preso, kapag inihagis mo ang tsinelas at tumama ito sa lata, ang puwersa ng gumagalaw na tsinelas ang nagtutulak at nagpapatumba sa lata.
fact_bis: Sa tumba-tumba, kon ilabay nimo ang tsinelas ug moigo kini sa lata, ang kusog sa nagalihok nga tsinelas maoy motulod ug motumba sa lata.

q: Long ago, how did the deadly disease called the plague spread among people?
options: Fleas living on rats bit people and passed on the disease
Rats bit people directly and gave them the disease through their teeth
People drank water that rats had swum in, spreading the illness
The plague spread through the air near places where many rats lived
explanation: Long ago, fleas living on rats spread a deadly disease called the plague.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ang mga pulgas na nasa daga ay nagkalat ng nakamamatay na sakit na peste.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang mga pulgas nga anaa sa ilaga nagsabwag sa makamatay nga sakit nga peste.

q: How do ferns and mosses get their food even though they have no flowers?
options: They make their own food from sunlight using photosynthesis
They absorb food from the soil through their roots like mushrooms do
They get nutrients by breaking down dead leaves on the forest floor
They depend on insects to bring them food in exchange for shelter
explanation: Even without flowers, ferns and mosses are green and make their own food from sunlight, just like other plants.
fact_tl: Kahit walang bulaklak, ang pako at lumot ay berde at gumagawa ng sariling pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw, tulad ng ibang halaman.
fact_bis: Bisan walay bulak, ang pako ug lumot lunhaw ug maghimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw, sama sa ubang tanom.

q: What often causes a sinkhole to form suddenly in the ground?
options: The roof of a hidden underground cave gives way and collapses
Heavy rain washes away soil from the surface layer by layer
A small earthquake cracks the ground and the pieces fall inward
Tree roots grow so big underground that they push the soil up and away
explanation: Many sinkholes form when the roof of a hidden underground cave gives way and the surface collapses into the space below.
fact_tl: Maraming sinkhole ang nabubuo kapag gumuho ang atop ng isang nakatagong kuweba sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Daghang sinkhole ang maporma kon mahugno ang atop sa usa ka tinago nga langob sa ilawom sa yuta.

q: How does getting enough sleep help you do better at school?
options: It organizes and stores the things you learned during the day
It gives your eyes a rest so you can read more the next day
It speeds up your heart so more blood reaches your brain in the morning
It removes all the old memories so your brain has space for new ones
explanation: Sleep helps learning because it organizes and keeps the things we learned during the day.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang tulog sa pag-aaral dahil inaayos at iniingatan nito ang mga natutunan natin sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang tulog motabang sa pagkat-on tungod kay giorganisa ug gitipigan niini ang mga nakat-unan nato sa adlaw.

q: How can you find the center of gravity of a ruler using just your finger?
options: Rest the ruler on your finger and find the spot where it balances without falling
Slide your finger from one end and stop when the ruler feels heaviest
Hold the ruler at one end and find the midpoint by measuring
Press down on both ends and find where the ruler bends the most
explanation: You can find a ruler's center of gravity by resting it on your finger and finding the spot where it does not fall — that is its balance point.
fact_tl: Mahahanap mo ang center of gravity ng isang ruler kapag pinatong mo ito sa iyong daliri at hinanap ang puntong hindi ito mahuhulog. Iyon ang balance point nito.
fact_bis: Mapangita nimo ang center of gravity sa usa ka ruler kung ipatong nimo kini sa imong tudlo ug pangitaon ang punto diin dili kini mahulog. Kana ang balance point niini.

q: Why do different kinds of bacteria have different shapes?
options: The shape helps them survive — for example, spiral bacteria swim easily and round ones resist drying out
All bacteria have the same shape; what looks different is just the way they clump together
The shape only matters for telling them apart under a microscope, not for survival
Bacteria choose their shape based on the type of food they eat
explanation: Bacteria have different shapes because the shape helps them survive — spiral spirilla swim easily through liquid, while round cocci resist drying out better.
fact_tl: Bakit magkakaiba ang hugis ng bakterya? Tumutulong ito sa kanilang mabuhay. Halimbawa, ang mga pilipit na spirilla ay madaling lumangoy sa likido, habang ang mga bilog na cocci ay matatag laban sa pagkatuyo.
fact_bis: Ngano lainlain man ang porma sa bakterya? Ang porma motabang nila nga mabuhi. Pananglitan, ang pilipit nga spirilla sayon molangoy sa likido, samtang ang lingin nga cocci mas lig-on batok sa pagkauga.

q: In which province and island of the Philippines is the Agusan Marsh found?
options: Agusan del Sur, on the island of Mindanao
Agusan del Norte, on the island of Luzon
Surigao del Sur, on the island of Samar
Bukidnon, on the island of Visayas
explanation: The Agusan Marsh is found in the province of Agusan del Sur on the island of Mindanao in the southern Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Agusan Marsh ay matatagpuan sa lalawigan ng Agusan del Sur, sa isla ng Mindanao sa katimugang bahagi ng Pilipinas. Nasa gitna ito ng malaking lambak kung saan dumadaloy ang tubig mula sa mga paligid na bundok.
fact_bis: Ang Agusan Marsh nahimutang sa probinsya sa Agusan del Sur, sa isla sa Mindanao sa habagatang bahin sa Pilipinas. Naa kini sa tunga sa dakong walog diin nagaagas ang tubig gikan sa palibot nga kabukiran.

q: What is a safe way to stop snails from eating crops WITHOUT using poison?
options: Handpick the snails at night when they come out to feed
Spray the plants with salt water to keep snails away
Cover the whole field with plastic during the day when snails are active
Plant a ring of spicy peppers around the crops to repel the snails
explanation: To stop snails from eating crops without poison, many people simply handpick the snails at night when they come out to feed.
fact_tl: Para mapigilan ang kuhol na ubusin ang pananim nang hindi gumagamit ng lason, marami ang namumulot na lang ng kuhol sa gabi kung kailan sila lumalabas para kumain.
fact_bis: Aron mapugngan ang kuhol nga maghurot sa tanom nga walay hilo, daghan ang mamupo na lang og kuhol panahon sa gabii kon mogula sila aron mokaon.

q: Who is the unit of electrical resistance, the ohm, named after?
options: Georg Simon Ohm, the scientist who developed the law of resistance
Alessandro Volta, the inventor of the electric battery
André-Marie Ampère, who studied electric current
James Watt, who measured electrical power
explanation: The ohm is named after Georg Simon Ohm, the scientist behind Ohm's Law of resistance.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ohm ay ipinangalan kay Georg Simon Ohm, ang siyentistang gumawa ng batas ng resistensya (Ohm's Law).
fact_bis: Ang yunit nga ohm gipangalan kang Georg Simon Ohm, ang siyentista sa luyo sa Ohm's Law sa resistensya.

q: Why does a heavy, fast-moving truck need a much longer distance to stop than a small, slow car?
options: Because it has greater inertia and momentum, it needs more force and more distance to stop
Because trucks have weaker brakes that produce less friction than car brakes
Because the truck's tires are larger and create more rolling resistance, making stopping harder
Because air resistance on the big truck body pushes it forward and fights the brakes
explanation: A heavier or faster vehicle needs a larger force and a longer distance to stop because it has greater inertia and momentum.
fact_tl: Mas mabigat o mas mabilis na sasakyan ay nangangailangan ng mas malaking puwersa at mas mahabang layo bago tumigil, dahil mas malaki ang inertia at momentum nito.
fact_bis: Ang mas bug-at o mas paspas nga sakyanan nanginahanglan og mas dako nga kusog ug mas taas nga gilay-on una mohunong, kay mas dako ang inertia ug momentum niini.

q: Why do ionic compounds like salt have very high melting points?
options: Because the pull between their opposite ions is very strong
Because they contain carbon atoms that are hard to break apart
Because they are made of long chains of molecules that tangle together
Because they dissolve in water and absorbing water makes them harder to melt
explanation: Ionic compounds like salt are hard solids with very high melting points because the pull between their opposite ions is very strong.
fact_tl: Ang mga ionic compound gaya ng asin ay matigas na solido at may napakataas na melting point dahil napakalakas ng hila ng kanilang magkasalungat na ion.
fact_bis: Ang mga ionic compound sama sa asin gahi nga solido ug adunay taas kaayo nga melting point tungod kay lig-on kaayo ang bira tali sa ilang magkasumpaki nga ion.

q: Why is Maria Cristina Falls in the Philippines called the 'twin falls'?
options: A rock at the top splits the water into two streams
The waterfall drops into two separate rivers that flow in different directions
Two rivers from different mountains join together and fall off the same cliff
The water falls in two separate stages, each going over a different ledge
explanation: Maria Cristina Falls is called the 'twin falls' because a rock at the top splits the water into two streams.
fact_tl: Tinatawag ang Maria Cristina Falls na 'twin falls' o kambal na talon dahil may bato sa taas na naghahati sa tubig sa dalawang agos.
fact_bis: Ang Maria Cristina Falls gitawag nga 'twin falls' o kaluha nga busay tungod kay adunay bato sa taas nga nagbahin sa tubig sa duha ka agos.

q: How does a sundial show the time of day?
options: The shadow cast by a stick moves as the Earth rotates, pointing to different times
The stick glows brighter when the sun is at noon and dimmer in the morning
The heat from sunlight moves a small wheel inside the sundial like a clock
The shadow stays still but the numbers on the sundial move with the sun
explanation: A sundial uses the shadow cast by a stick in sunlight, and the shadow moves as the Earth rotates, which shows the time of day.
fact_tl: Ang sundial ay isang lumang orasan na gumagamit ng anino na inihahagis ng isang patpat sa ilalim ng araw, at gumagalaw ang anino habang umiikot ang mundo kaya napapakita nito ang oras.
fact_bis: Ang sundial usa ka karaan nga orasan nga naggamit sa landong nga ginahimo sa usa ka sungkod ubos sa silaw sa adlaw, ug ang landong molihok samtang nagatuyok ang kalibutan, busa makita ang takna.

q: What happens to electric current in a circuit when a switch is turned off (open)?
options: Current stops because there is no complete path for it to flow through
Current slows down but keeps flowing at a reduced rate
Current reverses direction and flows back through the wires
Current keeps flowing but the light gets dimmer instead of turning off
explanation: A switch opens a gap in the circuit, and when the gap is open the current stops because there is no complete path.
fact_tl: Ang isang switch ay gumagawa o nagsasara ng puwang sa sirkito, at kapag may puwang ay tumitigil ang current dahil walang kumpletong daanan.
fact_bis: Ang switch mohimo o magsira ug usa ka luna sa sirkito, ug kung abli ang luna mohunong ang current tungod kay walay kompleto nga agianan.

q: Where does most of the water in hot springs and geothermal fields originally come from?
options: From rainwater that seeped into the ground and was heated below the surface
From water that formed deep inside the Earth's core millions of years ago
From underground rivers that flow from the ocean floor through cracks in the rock
From melted glaciers that seeped down and got trapped in deep rock chambers
explanation: Most of the water in hot springs and geothermal fields comes from rain that seeped into the ground, was heated below, and rose back up.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa tubig sa hot springs at geothermal fields ay nagmula sa ulan na tumagos sa lupa, uminit sa ilalim, at bumalik pataas. Sa power plants, madalas ibinabalik ang ginamit na tubig sa lupa para muling uminit.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa tubig sa hot springs ug geothermal fields gikan sa ulan nga misulod sa yuta, giinit sa ilalom, ug mibalik pataas. Sa mga power plant, kasagaran ibalik ang nagamit nga tubig sa yuta aron mainit pag-usab.

q: A big pot of warm water and a small cup of very hot water — which one holds MORE total heat?
options: The big pot of warm water holds more total heat
The small cup of hot water holds more total heat because it has a higher temperature
They hold exactly the same total heat because heat and temperature are the same thing
The cup holds more heat because the water in it is boiling and has more energy per drop
explanation: A big pot of warm water can hold more total heat than a small cup of hot water, even though the cup has the higher temperature.
fact_tl: Ang isang malaking palayok ng maligamgam na tubig ay maaaring may mas maraming init kaysa sa isang maliit na tasa ng mainit na tubig, kahit mas mataas ang temperatura ng tasa.
fact_bis: Ang dakong kaldero sa init-init nga tubig mahimong adunay mas daghang init kaysa gamay nga tasa sa init nga tubig, bisan pa ug mas taas ang temperatura sa tasa.

q: What do you find surrounding the sweet pods inside a jackfruit?
options: Many thin, stringy fibers
A thick layer of smooth, waxy skin
A hard shell like a coconut that you must crack open
A soft, spongy material filled with liquid
explanation: Inside a jackfruit, the sweet pods are surrounded by many thin, stringy fibers.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng langka, ang mga matatamis na laman ay napapalibutan ng maraming manipis na hibla.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa nangka, ang tam-is nga mga unod gilibutan sa daghang nipis nga hibla.

q: What does a concave mirror do to light rays that hit it?
options: It bends them inward so they meet at a single focal point
It spreads them outward in all directions like a flashlight
It reflects them straight back in exactly the same direction they came from
It absorbs most of the light and only reflects a dim glow
explanation: A concave mirror converges light rays to a focal point — this is used in solar cookers and reflecting telescopes.
fact_tl: Ang concave mirror ay nagtitipon ng mga sinag ng liwanag sa isang punto na tinatawag focal point — ginagamit ito sa solar cooker at telescope.
fact_bis: Ang concave mirror nagatipon sa mga sinag sa suga ngadto sa usa ka punto nga gitawag focal point — gigamit kini sa solar cooker ug reflecting telescope.

q: How does the makahiya plant scatter its seeds?
options: Its small pods dry out and split open to release the seeds
A strong wind carries each seed away on a tiny wing or hair
Animals eat the makahiya fruit and spread the seeds in their droppings
The pods fall into streams and the water carries the seeds to new places
explanation: The makahiya has small pods that dry and split open to scatter its seeds.
fact_tl: Ang makahiya na karaniwan sa Pilipinas ay may maliliit na pod na natutuyo at pumuputok para ikalat ang mga binhi nito.
fact_bis: Ang makahiya nga kasagaran sa Pilipinas adunay gagmayng pod nga momala ug mobuslot aron isabwag ang mga liso niini.

q: Why do children's neck lymph nodes often swell during dengue season in the Philippines?
options: They are busy fighting the virus that entered the body
They are damaged by the dengue mosquito's bite and fill with blood
They swell because children eat less during a fever and become dehydrated
They enlarge to release more red blood cells to replace those lost during fever
explanation: In the rainy season when dengue is common, children's neck lymph nodes often swell because they are busy fighting the virus that entered the body.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, lalo na tuwing tag-ulan kung saan dumarami ang lagnat at dengue, madalas mamaga ang kulani ng mga bata sa leeg dahil masigla silang lumalaban sa virus na pumasok sa katawan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa ting-ulan kung diin modaghan ang hilanat ug dengue, kasagaran maghubag ang kulani sa liog sa mga bata kay kusog silang nakig-away sa virus nga misulod sa lawas.

q: Why can planting foreign tree species in the wrong place be harmful?
options: They can harm native plants and animals that are not used to them
They always grow too tall and block sunlight from reaching farm crops
They use up all the underground water and cause nearby rivers to dry up
They attract insects from other countries that eat the local fruits
explanation: Planting the wrong kind of tree, especially foreign species, can harm native plants and animals that depend on the local ecosystem.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatanim ng maling uri ng puno, lalo na dayuhang species, ay maaaring makasama sa katutubong halaman at hayop.
fact_bis: Ang pagtanom og sayop nga matang sa kahoy, ilabi na ang langyaw nga species, makadaot sa lumad nga tanom ug mananap.

q: Why does electricity flow more easily through a thick wire than through a thin wire?
options: A thick wire has a wider path, so more electrons can pass through at once
A thick wire is heavier and gravity helps pull the electrons through faster
A thick wire gets hotter, and heat makes electrons move more quickly
A thick wire is made of a different metal that conducts electricity better than thin wires
explanation: Electricity flows more easily through a thick wire because it is like a wide road — more free electrons can pass through at once, unlike the narrow path in a thin wire.
fact_tl: Mas madaling dumaloy ang kuryente sa makapal na kable kaysa sa manipis. Parang malawak na kalsada ang makapal na kable: mas maraming malayang electron ang sabay na nakakadaan. Sa manipis na kable, masikip ang daanan kaya mas nahihirapan dumaan ang kuryente at mas mabilis itong umiinit.
fact_bis: Mas sayon modagan ang kuryente sa baga nga kable kay sa nipis. Ang baga nga kable sama sa luag nga kalsada: mas daghang gawasnon nga electron ang makaagi dungan. Sa nipis nga kable, sigpit ang agianan, mao nga maglisod ang kuryente sa pag-agi ug mas paspas mainit ang kable.

q: When are most frogs active, and why?
options: At night, when it is cool and they can hide from predators during the day
During the day, when it is warm and they can sunbathe on rocks
Only during rain, because frogs need to stay wet at all times
Early in the morning, right after sunrise, before it gets too hot
explanation: Many frogs are more active at night and hide during the day where it is cool.
fact_tl: Maraming palaka ang mas aktibo sa gabi at nagtatago lang sa araw kung saan malamig.
fact_bis: Daghang baki ang mas aktibo sa gabii ug magtago lang panahon sa adlaw diin bugnaw.

q: If you drop a rock in free fall, how fast will it be moving after exactly one second?
options: About 9.8 meters per second
About 9.8 meters per second per second faster than it started
About 1 meter per second, since it just started falling
About 98 meters per second, because gravity is very strong
explanation: In free fall, an object speeds up by about 9.8 m/s each second, so after one second it is moving at about 9.8 meters per second.
fact_tl: Sa free fall, ang isang bagay ay bumibilis nang halos 9.8 m/s kada segundo — kaya pagkatapos ng isang segundo, mga 9.8 metro kada segundo na ang bilis nito.
fact_bis: Sa free fall, ang butang modugang ang katulin og mga 9.8 m/s kada segundo — busa human sa usa ka segundo, mga 9.8 ka metro kada segundo na ang tulin niini.

q: What is cellulose, and why can humans not digest it?
options: It is the material that makes up plant cell walls; humans lack the enzymes to break its strong glucose links
It is the sugar stored in plant roots; humans can digest it but it passes through too quickly
It is a protein found in plant seeds; the human stomach acid is not strong enough to dissolve it
It is a fatty substance in plant leaves; humans cannot absorb it because it does not mix with water
explanation: Cellulose is the most abundant organic polymer on Earth, made of strongly linked glucose units that form plant cell walls; humans cannot digest it, but it provides dietary fiber.
fact_tl: Ang cellulose ay ang pinakamaraming organic polymer sa Lupa — binubuo ito ng mga yunit ng glucose na nakadikit nang matigas at bumubuo ng dingding ng selula ng lahat ng halaman. Hindi ito matutunaw ng mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang cellulose mao ang labing daghan nga organic polymer sa Yuta, gihimo sa mga yunit sa glucose nga hugot nga nagsumpay aron makahimo sa mga dingding sa selula sa tanom; dili kini matunaw sa mga tawo, apan naghatag kini og dietary fiber.

q: What should you avoid if you want to keep your amethyst gemstone's purple color from fading?
options: Leaving it in heat and direct sunlight for too long
Rinsing it with cool water and wiping it with a soft cloth
Storing it inside a box away from other gemstones
Wearing it on your hand where it touches the air
explanation: To care for amethyst, you should avoid leaving it in heat and sunlight for too long so its purple color does not fade.
fact_tl: Para alagaan ang amethyst, pwede itong linisin gamit ang malamig na tubig at malambot na tela. Iwasang ilantad nang matagal sa init at sikat ng araw para hindi kumupas ang magandang lilang kulay nito.
fact_bis: Aron atimanon ang amethyst, mahimo kining limpyohan gamit ang bugnaw nga tubig ug humok nga panapton. Likayi ang pagbutang niini sa kainit ug adlaw og dugay aron dili mokupas ang nindot niini nga purple nga kolor.

q: How are baby bats (pups) born, and how do they learn echolocation?
options: They are born blind and hairless, and gradually learn echolocation as they grow with their mother's care
They are born with full fur and can already use echolocation on their very first night
They are born in eggs like birds, and echolocation develops before they hatch
They are born fully developed but must practice flying for weeks before echolocation kicks in
explanation: Baby bats (pups) are born blind and hairless and need their mother's care for many weeks — they gradually learn echolocation as they grow.
fact_tl: Ang mga batang paniki (pup) ay ipinanganak na bulag at walang balahibo at nangangailangan ng pag-aalaga ng ina sa loob ng maraming linggo — natututo sila ng echolocation nang unti-unti habang lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang mga batang paniki (pup) ipanganak nga buta ug walay balhibo ug nagkinahanglan sa pag-atiman sa ilang inahan sulod sa daghang semana — unti-unti nila nakat-onan ang echolocation sa dihang motubo sila.

q: Why will an LED not light up if you connect it the wrong way in a circuit?
options: An LED only lights up when current flows through it in the correct direction from positive to negative
An LED needs alternating current, so direct current in any direction will not work
An LED has a built-in switch that turns it off when the voltage is too low
An LED works only with very high voltages, and connecting it backwards reduces the voltage
explanation: An LED is a type of diode — it only lights up when current flows through it in the correct direction from the positive to the negative terminal inside the component.
fact_tl: Ang LED ay isang espesyal na uri ng diyodo — nagliliwanag lamang ito kapag ang kuryente ay dumadaan sa tamang direksyon mula positibo patungong negatibo sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang LED usa ka klase sa diode — moliwanag lang kini inig-agos sa kuryente sa tama nga direksyon gikan sa positibo paingon sa negatibo sulod sa parte.

q: How does a single pangolin help keep nature in balance?
options: It can eat millions of insects in one year, helping control insect populations
It builds underground tunnels that let rainwater reach plant roots more easily
It spreads seeds from dozens of different plants as it moves through the forest
It produces a chemical from its scales that protects nearby plants from disease
explanation: A single pangolin can eat millions of insects in one year, helping keep nature in balance.
fact_tl: Ang isang balintong ay maaaring kumain ng milyun-milyong insekto sa loob ng isang taon kaya tumutulong itong panatilihing balanse ang kalikasan.
fact_bis: Usa ka balintong makakaon og minilyon ka insekto sulod sa usa ka tuig, busa makatabang kini sa pagtimbang sa kinaiyahan.

q: How do eels swim differently from most other fish?
options: They wiggle their whole body like a snake because they lack belly (pelvic) fins
They flap two large fins on their back to push themselves forward through water
They use powerful tail fins to leap forward in short bursts and then glide
They spin rapidly in a spiral pattern using fins along their sides
explanation: Eels lack the belly fins most fish have, so they swim by wiggling their bodies like a snake.
fact_tl: Ang igat ay walang palikpik sa tiyan kaya lumalangoy ito sa pamamagitan ng pagkiwal ng katawan na parang ahas.
fact_bis: Ang igat walay kapay sa tiyan mao nga molangoy kini pinaagi sa pagkiwal sa lawas nga morag bitin.

q: What makes dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) more serious than ordinary dengue?
options: It involves plasma leakage and a dropping platelet count
It causes higher fever and more rashes on the skin
It spreads much faster from person to person
It affects only the lungs and makes breathing harder
explanation: DHF is severe because it involves plasma leakage and a dropping platelet count, requiring immediate medical attention.
fact_tl: Ang dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) ay mas malubhang porma ng dengue na kinabibilangan ng pagtagas ng plasma at pagbaba ng platelet count—nangangailangan ito ng agarang medical attention.
fact_bis: Ang dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) mas grabe nga porma sa dengue nga may plasma leakage ug pagbaba sa platelet count—kinahanglan kini og dayon nga medikal nga atensyon.

q: Birds and bats both have wings, yet they are not closely related. What does this illustrate?
options: Convergent evolution, where unrelated species develop similar traits due to similar environments
Common ancestry, because all flying animals share the same ancient relative
Selective breeding, where humans chose animals with wings over many generations
Mimicry, where one species copies another to gain protection from predators
explanation: Convergent evolution occurs when unrelated species independently develop similar traits because they face similar environments, as seen in birds and bats both evolving wings.
fact_tl: Ang convergent evolution ay nangyayari kapag ang mga hindi magkakaugnay na species ay nagpapalaki ng katulad na katangian dahil sa katulad na kapaligiran — tulad ng pakpak ng parehong ibon at kabog na nagpapalaki nang hiwalay.
fact_bis: Ang convergent evolution mahitabo sa dihang ang mga dili magkaugnay nga mga species nagpalambo og susamang mga katangian tungod sa susamang kalikopan — sama sa mga ibon ug kabog nga pareho naglambo og mga pakpak nga nagsalagway.

q: The pH scale goes from 0 to 14. What does it measure?
options: How acidic or basic a liquid is
How hot or cold a liquid is
How dense or light a liquid is
How fast or slow a liquid flows
explanation: The pH scale measures how acidic or basic a liquid is on a range from 0 to 14.
fact_tl: Ang pH scale ay isang sukatan mula 0 hanggang 14 na nagsasabi kung gaano kaasido o kabase ang isang likido.
fact_bis: Ang pH scale usa ka sukdanan gikan 0 hangtod 14 nga nagasulti kung unsa kaasido o kabase ang usa ka likido.

q: What is the main difference between the ozone hole problem and the global warming problem?
options: The ozone hole is about thinning of the layer that blocks UV rays, while global warming is about gases trapping heat and raising Earth's temperature
The ozone hole causes Earth to heat up, while global warming causes more harmful radiation to reach us
They are actually the same problem, just described using different scientific terms
The ozone hole only affects the poles, while global warming only affects the tropics
explanation: The ozone hole is about thinning of the ozone layer that blocks UV radiation, whereas global warming is caused by gases trapping heat — they are two different problems.
fact_tl: Iba ang ozone hole sa global warming, kahit madalas pinagsasama. Ang ozone hole ay tungkol sa pagnipis ng ozone na humaharang sa UV. Ang global warming naman ay tungkol sa pag-init ng Mundo dahil sa mga gas na nakukulong ang init. Dalawang magkaibang problema ito.
fact_bis: Lahi ang ozone hole sa global warming, bisan kanunay gisagol. Ang ozone hole mahitungod sa pagnipis sa ozone nga nagbabag sa UV. Ang global warming mahitungod sa pag-init sa Kalibutan tungod sa mga gas nga makadakop sa init. Duha kini ka lahi nga problema.

q: Why does mantle convection keep happening inside the Earth?
options: Because the bottom of the mantle near the core stays much hotter than the top, keeping rock cycling continuously
Because the oceans pour cold water into cracks that constantly cool and heat the mantle
Because Earth's rotation stirs the mantle the way a spoon stirs soup in a bowl
Because meteorite impacts every million years reheat the mantle just before it cools down
explanation: Mantle convection continues as long as the bottom of the mantle stays hotter than the top; it will only stop when Earth fully cools, which takes many millions of years.
fact_tl: Bakit hindi tumitigil ang mantle convection? Hangga't mas mainit ang ilalim ng mantle (malapit sa core) kaysa sa itaas (malapit sa crust), patuloy ang pag-ikot ng bato. Titigil lang ito kapag ganap nang lumamig ang Earth — pero milyong-milyong taon pa ang kailangan.
fact_bis: Ngano dili mohunong ang mantle convection? Basta mas init ang ilalom sa mantle (duol sa core) kaysa sa ibabaw (duol sa crust), ang bato magpadayon sa pagtuyok. Mohunong lang kini kon hingpit nang mobugnaw ang Earth — apan minilyon pa ka tuig ang gikinahanglan.

q: What do the flowers of the makahiya plant look like?
options: Small round pink balls that look fluffy
Large yellow petals like a sunflower
Long white tubes like a trumpet
Tiny blue stars arranged in a cluster
explanation: The makahiya has small round pink flowers that look like fluffy little balls.
fact_tl: May maliliit na bilog at kulay-rosas na bulaklak ang makahiya na parang malambot na bola.
fact_bis: Ang makahiya adunay gagmay, lingin ug rosas nga bulak nga morag humok nga bola.

q: Muddy water left to stand eventually has particles settle to the bottom, but milk does not. Why?
options: Muddy water is a suspension with particles large enough to settle, while milk is a colloid with particles too small to settle
Muddy water is a pure substance, while milk is a compound that resists gravity
Muddy water has particles that absorb light, while milk particles reflect light and stay afloat
Muddy water is denser than milk, so its particles fall while milk particles float
explanation: Muddy water is a suspension whose large particles settle over time, while milk is a colloid whose tiny particles stay spread out and do not settle.
fact_tl: Ang suspension ay mixture na may mga particle na sapat ang laki para makita at tumira sa ilalim kapag iniwan (gaya ng maputik na tubig); ang colloid naman ay may particle na napakaliit para tumira at nananatiling lutang (gaya ng gatas o fog).
fact_bis: Ang suspension usa ka mixture nga adunay mga particle nga igong dako aron makita ug motining sa ilawom kung pasagdan (sama sa lapok nga tubig); ang colloid adunay particle nga gagmay kaayo aron motining, mao nga magpabilin nga nagkatag (sama sa gatas o gabon).

q: Why is coal called a non-renewable energy source?
options: Because it took millions of years to form and cannot be replaced quickly once used up
Because it cannot be burned more than once in the same power plant
Because scientists have not yet figured out how to mine it efficiently
Because it only produces a small amount of electricity compared to other fuels
explanation: Coal is a fossil fuel — a non-renewable energy source burned to make electricity that cannot be replaced on a human timescale once used.
fact_tl: Ang coal (karbon) ay isang fossil fuel — isang hindi nababagong (non-renewable) pinagkukunan ng enerhiya na sinusunog para magkuryente.
fact_bis: Ang coal (karbon) usa ka fossil fuel — usa ka dili mabag-o (non-renewable) nga tinubdan sa enerhiya nga ginasunog aron makahimo ug kuryente.

q: What must happen for a coconut palm to produce fruit?
options: Pollen must move from the male flowers to the female flowers on the same cluster
The tree must be at least 50 years old before the flowers can produce fruit
A second coconut tree nearby must shed its leaves onto the flowers
The female flowers must fall off and re-grow before fruit can form
explanation: A single coconut flower cluster has both male and female flowers, and pollen must move from male to female flowers for the palm to set fruit.
fact_tl: Sa iisang kumpol ng bulaklak ng niyog ay may magkasamang lalaki at babaeng bulaklak; kailangan maglipat ng polen mula sa lalaki patungo sa babaeng bulaklak upang mamunga ito ng niyog.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka pungpong sa bulak sa lubi adunay dungan nga lalaki ug babaye nga bulak; kinahanglan mabalhin ang polen gikan sa lalaki ngadto sa babaye nga bulak aron mamunga kini og lubi.

q: What makes the Twin Lagoons in Coron, Palawan special?
options: Warm freshwater floats above cold saltwater in one lagoon, creating a unique halocline layer
The two lagoons are connected by an underground river only visible at low tide
One lagoon is completely frozen in winter while the other stays warm all year
Both lagoons change color from blue to green depending on the season
explanation: The Twin Lagoons in Coron, Palawan are famous for a halocline where warm freshwater floats above cold saltwater in one lagoon.
fact_tl: Ang Twin Lagoons sa Coron, Palawan ay kilala sa natatanging karanasan ng paglangoy: sa isang lagoon ay may halocline kung saan ang mainit na tabang na tubig ay nag-aapaw sa malamig na tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Twin Lagoons sa Coron, Palawan bantog sa natatanging kasinatian sa paglangoy: sa usa ka lagoon adunay halocline diin ang mainit nga tabang na tubig nagpalutaw sa ibabaw sa bugnaw nga tubig-dagat.

q: What happens to blood pressure each time a person smokes?
options: Blood pressure temporarily rises, and repeated rises can damage the heart over time
Blood pressure drops sharply, causing the heart to pump much faster to compensate
Blood pressure stays the same but the lungs work harder to supply oxygen
Blood pressure only changes if the person already has a heart condition
explanation: Each time a person smokes, blood pressure temporarily rises, and when this happens repeatedly the heart struggles more and gets damaged.
fact_tl: Tuwing manigarilyo ang tao, pansamantalang tumataas ang kanyang blood pressure o presyon ng dugo. Kapag palagi itong mataas, mas nahihirapan at napipinsala ang puso.
fact_bis: Matag higayon nga manigarilyo ang tawo, temporaryong mosaka ang iyang blood pressure o presyon sa dugo. Kung kanunay kining taas, mas malisdan ug madaot ang kasingkasing.

q: About how fast could Stephenson's Rocket locomotive travel?
options: About 47 km/h (29 mph)
About 120 km/h (75 mph)
About 15 km/h (9 mph)
About 200 km/h (124 mph)
explanation: Stephenson's Rocket could travel at about 29 miles per hour, which is roughly 47 km/h.
fact_tl: Ang lokomotibong Rocket ni Stephenson ay nakakatakbo nang humigit-kumulang 29 milya kada oras (mga 47 km/h).
fact_bis: Ang lokomotibo nga Rocket ni Stephenson makadagan og mga 29 ka milya kada oras (mga 47 km/h).

q: In Filipino, the word 'bunga' is used for the areca palm seed. What else does 'bunga' mean in Filipino?
options: Fruit
Flower
Leaf
Root
explanation: The word 'bunga' refers to the areca palm seed, even though it also means fruit in Filipino languages.
fact_tl: Ang salitang 'bunga' ay tumutukoy sa buto ng areca palm, kahit ang ibig sabihin din nito ay prutas sa Filipino.
fact_bis: Ang pulong nga 'bunga' nagtumong sa liso sa areca palm, bisan kini nagkahulogan usab nga prutas sa Pinilipinhon.

q: What happens to a seismic wave when it crosses from one layer of the Earth into another?
options: It changes speed and bends, allowing scientists to find the depth of each boundary
It disappears completely and a new wave starts on the other side of the boundary
It speeds up and travels in a straight line regardless of the layer it enters
It splits into two identical waves that travel in opposite directions
explanation: When a seismic wave crosses a layer boundary it changes speed and bends, and by studying this bending scientists can determine the depth of each boundary.
fact_tl: Kapag tumatawid ang seismic wave mula sa isang sapaw papunta sa ibang sapaw, nagbabago ang bilis nito at lumiliko, at sa pamamagitan ng pagsusuri nito nalalaman ang lalim ng bawat hangganan.
fact_bis: Kung ang seismic wave motabok gikan sa usa ka sapaw paingon sa lain, mausab ang katulin niini ug moliko, ug pinaagi sa pagtuon niini mahibal-an ang giladmon sa matag utlanan.

q: Why is Taal Volcano considered both notable and dangerous?
options: It is one of the world's smallest active volcanoes yet sits near heavily populated areas
It is the tallest volcano in the Philippines and erupts more often than any other
It is located underwater, making it impossible to evacuate people before eruptions
It has not erupted for over 500 years, making scientists unsure what it will do
explanation: Taal Volcano is recognized as one of the world's smallest active volcanoes but is dangerous because of its location near populated areas.
fact_tl: Ang Taal Volcano ay kinikilala bilang isa sa mga pinakamaliit na aktibong bulkan sa buong mundo ngunit maaari rin itong maging mapanganib dahil sa malapit nitong lokasyon sa mataong lugar.
fact_bis: Ang Taal Volcano giila isip usa sa pinakagamay nga aktibong bulkan sa tibuok kalibutan apan mahimong mapanganib usab tungod sa iyang lokasyon duol sa mga tinawong lugar.

q: What is special about the rice seed that farmers plant?
options: It is the same grain that we could otherwise cook and eat as food
It must be dried for three years before it can sprout into a new plant
It looks completely different from the cooked rice we see on our plate
It can only grow if it is mixed with fertilizer before being placed in the soil
explanation: The rice seed planted by farmers is itself a grain that could otherwise have been cooked as food.
fact_tl: Ang itinatanim na binhi ng palay ay mismong butil na maaari rin sanang ginawang kanin.
fact_bis: Ang binhi sa humay nga itanom mao gyud ang lugas nga puwede untang lutuon nga kan-on.

q: What feature do insects, worms, and shrimp all share that makes them invertebrates?
options: They all have no backbone
They all live in water for at least part of their lives
They all have exactly six legs
They all have an outer shell made of the same material
explanation: An animal is called an invertebrate if it has no backbone; insects, worms, and shrimp are all examples.
fact_tl: Ang isang hayop ay tinatawag na invertebrate kung ito ay walang gulugod, gaya ng mga insekto, bulate, at hipon.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka mananap gitawag nga invertebrate kung kini walay bukog sa likod, sama sa mga insekto, ulod, ug pasayan.

q: Why do children often get higher fevers than adults when they are sick?
options: Their immune system is still new and very active, so it reacts quickly when fighting new germs
Their bodies have less water, so body temperature rises more easily from the same amount of heat
They eat more sugar, which raises body temperature faster than in adults
They have thinner skin that lets more heat escape inward and raises core temperature
explanation: Children often get higher fevers because their immune system is still new and very active, learning to fight many new germs, so it reacts quickly — this does not always mean the illness is worse.
fact_tl: Mas madalas at minsan mas mataas ang lagnat ng mga bata kaysa matanda. Ito ay dahil bago pa lang at masigla ang kanilang immune system na natututong lumaban sa maraming bagong germ, kaya mas mabilis itong tumugon. Hindi ito laging nangangahulugang mas malala ang sakit.
fact_bis: Mas kanunay ug usahay mas taas ang hilanat sa mga bata kay sa hamtong. Tungod kini kay bag-o pa ug aktibo kaayo ang ilang immune system nga nagtuon pa sa pagpakig-away sa daghang bag-ong germ, busa paspas kini motubag. Dili kini kanunay nagpasabot nga mas grabe ang sakit.

q: What is dehydration, and why is it dangerous?
options: Too much loss of body water from sweat, urine, or diarrhea that upsets the body's balance
A sudden drop in blood sugar that makes a person feel dizzy and too weak to stand
A condition where the body absorbs too much salt and cannot release enough water
An allergy reaction where the body loses vitamins along with fluids very quickly
explanation: Dehydration is too much loss of body water from sweat, urine, or diarrhea, which upsets the body's balance and is dangerous if not corrected.
fact_tl: Ang dehydration ay sobrang pagkawala ng tubig sa katawan mula sa pawis, ihi, o pagtatae, na nakakasira sa balanse at delikado kung hindi maagapan.
fact_bis: Ang dehydration mao ang sobra nga pagkawala sa tubig sa lawas gikan sa singot, ihi, o kalibanga, nga makaguba sa balanse ug makuyaw kung dili matubag.

q: About what percentage of all water on Earth is salty ocean water?
options: About 97 percent
About 50 percent
About 75 percent
About 30 percent
explanation: About 97% of Earth's water is salty ocean water; only about 3% is fresh water.
fact_tl: Halos 97 porsyento (97%) ng tubig sa Daigdig ay maalat na tubig-dagat; tatlong porsyento lang ang tabang.
fact_bis: Mga 97 porsiyento (97%) sa tubig sa Kalibutan parat nga tubig-dagat; tulo lang ka porsiyento ang tab-ang.

q: How does a hamster carry food back to store it?
options: It stuffs food into its big cheek pouches and carries it that way
It holds food between its front paws and hops quickly to its corner
It wraps food in leaves using its tail and drags the bundle home
It pushes food along the ground with its nose until it reaches its corner
explanation: A hamster carries food in its big cheek pouches and stores it in a corner of its home.
fact_tl: Ang hamster ay nagdadala ng pagkain sa kanyang malalaking pisngi at iniimbak ito sa sulok ng kanyang tirahan.
fact_bis: Ang hamster nagadala og pagkaon sa iyang dagkong aping ug gitago kini sa eskina sa iyang puy-anan.

q: How does organic matter (humus) in soil help plants in both sandy and clay soils?
options: It helps sandy soil hold more water and improves drainage in clay soil so roots don't get waterlogged
It makes sandy soil harder so roots do not sink too deep and pulls extra water out of clay soil
It only helps sandy soil by adding nutrients; it has no effect on clay soil drainage
It turns both sandy and clay soils into a thick mud that keeps moisture locked at the surface
explanation: Organic matter (humus) helps sandy soil hold more water and improves drainage in clay soil so roots do not become waterlogged.
fact_tl: Ang organikong bagay (humus) sa lupa ay nagpapabuti ng water holding capacity—tumutulong ito sa sandy na lupa na mag-imbak ng higit na tubig at nagpapabilis ng drainage sa clay soil para hindi mababad ang ugat.
fact_bis: Ang organiko nga bagay (humus) sa yuta nagpaayo sa water holding capacity; nakatubang kini sa sandy nga yuta aron magtago og mas daghang tubig ug nagpaayo sa drainage sa clay soil aron ang gamot dili malunod.

q: Why is warm water better than cold water for extracting color from red cabbage leaves?
options: Heat releases the anthocyanin pigment faster and in greater amounts, producing a stronger color
Warm water dissolves the leaf cells completely, releasing all nutrients along with the color
Cold water absorbs the color too quickly and turns it brown before you can use it
Warm water prevents the cabbage from reacting with air, which would bleach the color away
explanation: Heat helps release the anthocyanin pigment from red cabbage leaves faster and in greater amount, giving the indicator a stronger color.
fact_tl: Tanong ng marami: bakit kailangan ng mainit na tubig kapag kumukuha ng katas? Tumutulong ang init na ilabas nang mas mabilis at mas marami ang anthocyanin mula sa dahon, kaya mas matingkad ang kulay ng iyong indicator.
fact_bis: Daghan mangutana: ngano kinahanglan og init nga tubig kung mokuha sa duga? Ang kainit motabang sa pagpagawas sa anthocyanin gikan sa mga dahon nga mas paspas ug mas daghan, busa mas tingkad ang kolor sa imong indicator.

q: How do mangrove roots help build and protect coastlines?
options: Their tangled roots trap mud carried by water, slowly building up and stabilizing coastal land
Their roots release chemicals that harden the seafloor into solid rock over time
Their roots pump seawater inland, raising the level of the coast higher than the sea
Their roots cool the water around them, causing sediment to freeze and sink to the bottom
explanation: The tangled roots of mangroves trap mud carried by water, slowly building up and stabilizing coastal land.
fact_tl: Hinuhuli ng siksik na ugat ng mangrove ang putik na dala ng tubig, kaya unti-unting nadaragdagan at napapatatag ang lupa sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang gusot nga mga gamot sa bakhaw mobitag sa lapok nga dala sa tubig, busa hinay-hinay nga modugang ug molig-on ang yuta sa baybayon.

q: What is vermicompost, and how is it made?
options: Compost made by worms that eat food scraps and leave behind rich castings
Compost made by mixing dried leaves with rainwater and leaving it in the sun
Compost made by burning food waste and collecting the ash for garden use
Compost made by grinding old newspapers into fine powder and adding it to soil
explanation: Vermicompost is compost made by worms that eat food scraps and leave behind rich castings.
fact_tl: Ang vermicompost ay compost na ginawa ng mga bulate na kumakain ng tira ng pagkain at nagdudumi ng mayamang abono.
fact_bis: Ang vermicompost maoy compost nga gibuhat sa mga bulate nga mokaon sa salin nga pagkaon ug mobiya og dato nga abono.

q: What kind of animal is the carabao?
options: A type of domestic water buffalo raised by people
A type of wild deer found only in the Philippine mountains
A large reptile used for carrying heavy loads in rice fields
A domesticated cousin of the rhinoceros native to Southeast Asia
explanation: The carabao is a type of domestic water buffalo raised by people.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay isang uri ng kalabaw-tubig (water buffalo) na inaalagaan ng mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang kalabaw usa ka klase sa water buffalo nga gialagaan sa mga tawo.

q: How tall can a coconut palm grow, and how long can it live?
options: Nearly 30 meters tall, living for several decades and bearing fruit for many years
About 5 meters tall, living for only around 10 years before it stops producing
Nearly 60 meters tall, living for more than 300 years without any care needed
About 15 meters tall, living for exactly 25 years and then dying after one last harvest
explanation: A coconut palm can grow nearly 30 meters tall and live for several decades, bearing fruit for many years.
fact_tl: Ang puno ng niyog ay maaaring tumaas ng halos 30 metro at mabuhay ng ilang dekada, na patuloy na namumunga sa loob ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Ang puno sa lubi mahimong motaas og hapit 30 metros ug mabuhi sulod sa pipila ka dekada, nga padayong mamunga sulod sa daghang tuig.

q: Why does red cabbage juice change color when mixed with an acid?
options: Acid changes the shape of the anthocyanin molecule, which causes it to absorb different colors of light
Acid burns away the outer layer of the pigment and reveals a different colored layer underneath
Acid adds extra hydrogen atoms that paint the liquid a new color like a dye would
Acid causes the pigment molecules to clump together, and bigger clusters look different in color
explanation: The pigment anthocyanin shifts its molecular shape in the presence of acid, causing it to absorb different colors of light and making us see a different color.
fact_tl: Ang dahilan kung bakit nagbabago ang kulay ng pulang repolyo ay ang pigment na anthocyanin: kapag mas maraming acid sa paligid, bahagyang nagbabago ang hugis ng molekula nito, at ang ibang hugis ay sumisipsip ng ibang kulay ng liwanag kaya iba ang nakikita nating kulay.
fact_bis: Ang hinungdan nganong mabag-o ang kolor sa pula nga repolyo mao ang pigment nga anthocyanin: kon mas daghan ang acid sa palibot, gamay nga mabag-o ang porma sa molekula niini, ug ang lahi nga porma magsuyop og lahi nga kolor sa kahayag, busa lahi ang atong makita nga kolor.

q: During Moon missions, which part of the spacecraft actually landed on the Moon's surface?
options: A small section called the lunar module that separated from the main spacecraft
The entire spacecraft landed together as one unit on the Moon
Only the command module at the front of the rocket touched down on the Moon
A robotic arm extended from the spacecraft and touched the surface instead
explanation: The whole spacecraft did not land; a small part called the lunar module separated and descended to the Moon's surface.
fact_tl: Hindi buo ang sasakyan na lumapag sa Buwan; isang maliit na bahagi na tinatawag na lunar module ang naghiwalay at bumaba sa ibabaw nito.
fact_bis: Dili tibuok ang sakyanan nga mitugpa sa Bulan; usa ka gamay nga bahin nga gitawag ug lunar module ang nagbulag ug nanaog sa ibabaw niini.

q: Why does a bee sting cause pain, redness, and swelling?
options: Bee venom contains chemicals that irritate the nerves and skin
Bee stingers inject acid that burns a hole through the top layer of skin
Bee saliva mixed with the sting causes an instant bacterial infection
Bee stingers break off and keep releasing heat inside the skin for hours
explanation: A bee sting hurts because its venom is a mix of chemicals that irritate the nerves and skin, causing pain, redness, and swelling.
fact_tl: Ang sakit ng kagat ng bubuyog ay dahil sa kamandag (venom) nito, na may halong mga kemikal na nakakairita sa nerbiyo at balat. Kaya naman tumutusok ang sakit, namumula, at namamaga ang tinusok na bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang sakit sa paak sa buyog tungod sa hilo (venom) niini, nga sinagol nga mga kemikal nga makapasakit sa nerbiyo ug panit. Mao nga mosakit, mopula, ug manghupong ang gipaak nga bahin.

q: Which set of signs might suggest a person lacks enough vitamin D?
options: Often feeling tired, having weak muscles, and having aching bones
Frequent nosebleeds, cracked lips, and sores around the mouth
Blurry vision at night, dry skin, and hair that falls out easily
Swollen gums, bruising easily, and slow wound healing
explanation: A lack of vitamin D can cause tiredness, weak muscles, and aching bones, though a blood test is needed to confirm since these signs are vague.
fact_tl: Paano malalaman kung kulang sa vitamin D? Maaaring makaramdam ang tao ng madalas na pagod, mahinang kalamnan, o masakit na buto. Dahil malabo ang mga palatandaang ito, kadalasan ay sinusuri muna ng doktor ang dugo bago matiyak.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagkahibalo kung kulang sa vitamin D? Mahimong bation sa tawo ang kanunay nga kapoy, luya nga kaunoran, o sakit nga bukog. Tungod kay dili klaro kini nga mga timailhan, kasagaran sulayan una sa doktor ang dugo aron masiguro.

q: Why do some prey animals have bright colors like red, yellow, or orange?
options: To warn predators that they are poisonous or taste bad so predators will avoid them
To blend into colorful tropical flowers so they are harder for predators to spot
To attract mates from far away so they can reproduce before being eaten
To reflect sunlight and confuse predators that hunt using their sense of sight
explanation: Some prey use bright warning colors to signal that they are poisonous or taste bad, causing predators to avoid them.
fact_tl: Ilang biktima ay may matitingkad na kulay bilang babala na sila ay makahilo o masama ang lasa kaya iniiwasan sila ng mananakop.
fact_bis: Ang ubang biktima adunay tin-aw nga kolor isip pasidaan nga sila makahilo o dili lami, mao nga likayan sila sa manghuhuli.

q: Which renewable energy source is currently the largest in the Philippines?
options: Geothermal energy
Solar energy
Wind energy
Hydroelectric energy
explanation: The Philippines is working to strengthen renewables including geothermal, which is the largest renewable source, along with solar and wind, to reduce dependence on imported coal.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nagtatrabaho para palakasin ang kanyang renewable energy, kasama ang geothermal (pinakamalaking renewable), solar, at wind; ang layunin ay bawasan ang pag-asa sa uling na nagmumula sa ibang bansa at mapababa ang carbon emissions.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas nagtrabaho sa pagpalig-on sa iyang renewable energy, lakip ang geothermal (ang labing dagko nga renewable), solar, ug wind; ang tumong mao ang pagpababa sa pagdepende sa imported na uling ug pagpababa sa carbon emissions.

q: On which continent are armadillos naturally found?
options: The Americas, especially Central and South America
Africa, living in the grasslands south of the Sahara Desert
Australia, sharing the land with kangaroos and wallabies
Asia, particularly in the tropical forests of Southeast Asia
explanation: Armadillos are found only in the Americas, especially in Central and South America.
fact_tl: Ang mga armadillo ay matatagpuan lamang sa Amerika, lalo na sa Gitna at Timog Amerika.
fact_bis: Ang mga armadillo makit-an lamang sa Amerika, ilabi na sa Tunga ug Habagatang Amerika.

q: How does a seismograph detect ground shaking?
options: A heavy hanging mass stays nearly still while the frame moves with the ground, and the difference is recorded
The machine fills with water during shaking and measures how many ripples form inside the tank
Electronic sensors in the base heat up when the ground moves and send a signal to a printer
The device counts the number of times per minute the ground vibrates and converts that to a reading
explanation: A seismograph works because a heavy hanging mass tends to stay still when the ground shakes while the frame moves, and the relative difference between them is recorded.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang seismograph dahil may mabigat na bagay na nakabitin na ayaw kumilos kapag yumanig ang lupa; ang frame at lupa ang gumagalaw, pero ang mabigat na bagay ay parang nananatiling nakatigil, kaya naitatala ang pagkakaiba.
fact_bis: Mogana ang seismograph kay adunay bug-at nga butang nga gibitay nga dili gusto molihok kung mauyog ang yuta; ang frame ug yuta molihok apan ang bug-at nga butang magpabilin nga hapit dili molihok, mao nga marekord ang kalainan.

q: Why is the housefly called a disease vector?
options: Because it carries germs from filth and transfers them onto our food
Because it bites people and injects bacteria directly into the blood
Because it lays eggs inside food that hatch and release poison when eaten
Because its loud buzzing scares animals that spread diseases away from people
explanation: The housefly is called a vector because it carries germs of diseases like typhoid and cholera from filth onto our food.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na vector ang langaw dahil dinadala nito ang germ ng mga sakit tulad ng typhoid at cholera mula sa marumi papunta sa pagkain natin.
fact_bis: Gitawag nga vector ang langaw kay nagdala kini sa germ sa mga sakit sama sa typhoid ug cholera gikan sa hugaw ngadto sa atong pagkaon.

q: What happens to the total voltage when several batteries are connected end to end in a series?
options: Their voltages add together, giving a stronger push
Their voltages cancel each other out, giving zero power
The strongest battery takes over and the others become inactive
Their voltages are averaged, giving a medium amount of power
explanation: When batteries are connected in series (end to end), their voltages add together to give a stronger overall push.
fact_tl: Kapag pinagsunod-sunod ang ilang baterya nang dulo sa dulo (serye), nagsasama ang kanilang boltahe upang magbigay ng mas malakas na tulak.
fact_bis: Kon ang pipila ka baterya isumpay-sumpay tumoy sa tumoy (series), magdugang ang ilang boltahe aron makahatag ug mas kusog nga duso.

q: If a strong magnet pulls a weaker magnet toward it, how hard does the weaker magnet pull the strong one?
options: With exactly equal strength, because Newton's third law applies to magnetic forces too
With less force, because the weaker magnet has less magnetic power to pull back
With no force at all, because only the stronger magnet does the pulling
With greater force, because the weaker magnet must work harder to resist being pulled
explanation: Newton's third law applies to magnets: when one magnet pulls another (action), the second pulls the first with equal strength (reaction), even without touching and even if one is stronger.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa magkadikit na bagay nangyayari ang ikatlong batas — pati sa magnet! Kapag hinihila ng isang magnet ang pangalawa (aksyon), hinihila rin ng pangalawa ang una nang PANTAY na lakas (reaksyon), kahit hindi sila magkadikit. Totoo ito kahit magkaiba ang lakas ng dalawang magnet.
fact_bis: Dili lang sa nagdikit nga mga butang mahitabo ang ikatulong balaod — bisan sa magnet! Kung ang usa ka magnet mobira sa ikaduha (aksyon), ang ikaduha mobira usab sa una nga PAREHAS og kusog (reaksyon), bisan dili sila magdikit. Tinuod kini bisan lahi ang kusog sa duha ka magnet.

q: How do the water needs of a rice plant and a cactus differ?
options: Rice needs lots of water and soggy soil, while a cactus survives in a dry desert with very little water
Both plants need the same amount of water but absorb it from the soil in different ways
A cactus needs more water than rice because it must store extra water in its thick trunk
Rice can survive a drought better than a cactus because its roots go much deeper into the ground
