explanation: Rice wants lots of water and soggy soil while a cactus survives in a dry desert with only a little water, showing that not all plants need the same things.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng halaman pareho ng pangangailangan. Ang palay ay gusto ng maraming tubig at basa-basang lupa, samantalang ang kaktus naman ay nabubuhay sa tuyong disyerto na may kaunting tubig lang.
fact_bis: Dili tanang tanom managsama ug panginahanglan, ang humay gusto ug daghang tubig ug basa nga yuta, samtang ang cactus mabuhi sa uga nga disyerto nga gamay ra ug tubig.

q: Why can no real machine ever be 100% efficient?
options: Because friction always converts some input energy into heat that cannot do useful work
Because machines can only work for a limited number of hours before they need to be replaced
Because the materials machines are made of absorb some of the energy permanently inside them
Because gravity pulls down on moving parts and removes energy from the system each time
explanation: All real machines have efficiency less than 100% because friction always converts some input energy into heat that cannot do useful work.
fact_tl: Ang lahat ng tunay na makina ay may kahusayan (efficiency) na mas mababa sa 100% dahil ang kiskisan ay laging nagpapalit ng ilang input energy tungo sa init na hindi nagagamit.
fact_bis: Ang tanan nga tinuod nga mga makina adunay efficiency nga mas ubos sa 100% tungod kay ang kiskisan kanunay nagbalhin sa pila ka input energy ngadto sa init nga dili makapahimo og kapaki-panahon nga trabaho.

q: Why can several lymph nodes in the same area swell at the same time during an infection?
options: Because lymph from the same infected area passes through neighboring nodes in a row, so all of them react
Because the infection sends signals through the bloodstream that cause every node in the body to swell at once
Because lymph nodes are connected by bones, and swelling in one forces fluid into the others
Because the body mistakes the swelling medicine for an infection and triggers extra nodes to respond
explanation: Several neighboring lymph nodes can swell at once because lymph from the same infected area passes through them in a row.
fact_tl: Minsan, hindi lang isa kundi ilang magkakatabing kulani ang sabay na namamaga dahil dumadaan sa kanila nang sunud-sunod ang limpa mula sa parehong lugar na may impeksyon.
fact_bis: Usahay, dili lang usa kundi pipila ka magsikbit nga kulani ang dungan nga maghubag kay moagi kanila sunod-sunod ang limpa gikan sa samang dapit nga naa'y impeksyon.

q: What is one joule of work equal to?
options: A force of one newton moving an object one meter in the direction of the force
A force of one kilogram lifting an object one centimeter straight up
A force of ten newtons moving an object one millimeter to the side
A force of one newton pushing an object for one second regardless of distance
explanation: One joule is done when a force of one newton moves an object one meter in the direction of the force; work and energy are both measured in joules.
fact_tl: Ang work at enerhiya ay parehong sinusukat sa yunit na joule (J), at isang joule ang nagagawa kapag isang newton na force ang nagpagalaw ng bagay ng isang metro sa direksyon ng force.
fact_bis: Ang work ug enerhiya parehas nga gisukod sa yunit nga joule (J), ug usa ka joule ang mabuhat kung usa ka newton nga force makapalihok sa butang og usa ka metro sa direksyon sa force.

q: How does a generator inside a hydroelectric plant produce electricity?
options: The spinning turbine turns a magnet near coils of wire, and the moving magnetism makes electric current flow
The flowing water is heated by friction and the steam that forms pushes electrons through wires
Water pressure squeezes the coils of wire directly, forcing electrons out into the circuit
Chemical reactions between the water and metal coils release stored electrons as electricity
explanation: Inside the generator, the spinning turbine turns a magnet near coils of wire, and the moving magnetism makes electric current flow in the wire.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng generator, ang umiikot na turbina ay nagpapaikot ng magnet malapit sa mga pulupot na kawad, at ang gumagalaw na magnetismo ay lumilikha ng daloy ng kuryente sa kawad.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa generator, ang naglibot nga turbina nagpalibot sa usa ka magnet duol sa mga linukot nga alambre, ug ang naggalaw nga magnetismo naghimo og dagan sa kuryente sa alambre.

q: Why does a callus form on a part of the skin that is rubbed or pressed repeatedly?
options: The skin thickens to protect itself from the repeated pressure or rubbing it experiences
The skin becomes infected and swells up in that area from bacteria on rough surfaces
Extra blood rushes to the spot and hardens after clotting just beneath the surface
Nerve endings in that spot die and are replaced by a tougher type of muscle tissue
explanation: When a spot of skin is rubbed or pressed often, it thickens into a callus as the skin's way of protecting itself from the repeated work.
fact_tl: Kapag madalas kuskusin o diinan ang isang bahagi ng balat — tulad ng kamay ng magsasaka o daliri ng naglalaro ng gitara — kumakapal ito at nagiging kalyo. Ito ay paraan ng balat para protektahan ang sarili sa lagi nitong ginagawa.
fact_bis: Kon kanunay kuskuson o dat-olan ang usa ka bahin sa panit — sama sa kamot sa mag-uuma o tudlo sa nagtukar og gitara — mokapal kini ug mahimong kubal. Paagi kini sa panit aron panalipdan ang kaugalingon sa kanunay niini nga buhat.

q: Who was removed from power by the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution?
options: President Ferdinand Marcos
President Corazon Aquino
President Joseph Estrada
President Elpidio Quirino
explanation: The 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution removed President Ferdinand Marcos from power.
fact_tl: Pinatalsik ng EDSA People Power Revolution noong 1986 si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos.
fact_bis: Ang EDSA People Power Revolution niadtong 1986 nagpalagpot kang Presidente Ferdinand Marcos.

q: What does the thyroid gland control in the body?
options: How fast the body uses energy (metabolism)
How quickly the lungs take in oxygen
How much blood the heart pumps per minute
How deeply the brain sleeps at night
explanation: The thyroid gland in the neck controls how fast the body uses energy, which is called metabolism.
fact_tl: Ang thyroid gland sa leeg ay kumokontrol kung gaano kabilis gumamit ng enerhiya ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid gland sa liog nagkontrol kung unsa ka paspas mogamit og enerhiya ang lawas.

q: Where is the ozone layer located, and what does it do?
options: It is in the stratosphere and blocks harmful UV rays from the sun
It is in the troposphere and traps heat to keep the Earth warm at night
It is in the mesosphere and reflects radio waves back to the Earth's surface
It is in the thermosphere and absorbs lightning energy from thunderstorms below
explanation: The ozone layer is in the stratosphere and blocks harmful UV rays from the sun.
fact_tl: Ang ozone layer ay nasa stratosphere at humaharang sa nakakapinsalang UV rays ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang ozone layer anaa sa stratosphere ug nagsalipod sa makadaot nga UV rays sa adlaw.

q: The 'First 1,000 Days' of a child's life is counted starting from when?
options: From the start of pregnancy, including about 270 days in the womb plus the first two years after birth
From the moment of birth, counting every day until the child's third birthday
From the child's first birthday, covering the second and third years of life only
From the mother's first doctor visit, no matter how far along the pregnancy already is
explanation: The 1,000 days includes about 270 days inside the womb (nine months of pregnancy) plus the two years after birth (about 365 + 365 days), ending at the child's second birthday.
fact_tl: Paano nakukuha ang 1,000 araw? Mga 270 araw habang nasa tiyan (siyam na buwan na pagbubuntis), tapos dalawang taon pagkatapos ipanganak—mga 365 + 365 araw—kaya umaabot sa halos 1,000 araw hanggang sa ikalawang kaarawan.
fact_bis: Giunsa nato pagkuha ang 1,000 ka adlaw? Mga 270 ka adlaw sulod sa tiyan (siyam ka bulan nga pagmabdos), dayon duha ka tuig human matawo—mga 365 + 365 ka adlaw—busa moabot sa halos 1,000 ka adlaw hangtod sa ikaduhang adlawng natawhan.

q: What feeling does singing Lupang Hinirang bring out in Filipinos?
options: Love and pride for our country
Sadness and longing for the past
Excitement about future victories
Respect for foreign nations
explanation: Lupang Hinirang is the Philippine national anthem, and singing it reminds us that we are all Filipinos and fills us with love and pride for our country.
fact_tl: Kapag kinakanta natin ang Lupang Hinirang, nararamdaman natin ang pagmamahal at pagmamalaki sa ating bansa. Pinapaalala nito sa atin na tayong lahat ay mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Kung kantahon nato ang Lupang Hinirang, atong mabati ang gugma ug garbo alang sa atong nasud. Gipahinumdom niini nga kitang tanan mga Pilipino.

q: Diamond is extremely hard and graphite (the dark material in a pencil) is soft, yet they are both made of the same element. What element is that?
options: Carbon
Silicon
Iron
Nitrogen
explanation: Both diamond and graphite are made entirely of carbon atoms; the difference in hardness comes only from how those atoms are arranged.
fact_tl: Ang diamante at ang itim na laman ng lapis (graphite) ay parehong gawa lamang sa carbon — magkaiba lang sila dahil sa kung paano nakaayos ang mga atom: matigas ang diamante, malambot ang graphite.
fact_bis: Ang diamante ug ang itom nga sulod sa lapis (graphite) parehong hinimo lang sa carbon — lahi lang sila tungod sa kung giunsa pagkahan-ay ang mga atom: gahi ang diamante, humok ang graphite.

q: Why does mold suddenly appear on food that was left out, even though no one put mold there?
options: Tiny mold spores are always floating in the air and land on warm, damp food
Bacteria in the food slowly transform into mold over time
Mold grows from the water inside the food itself
The food produces mold when it gets too cold
explanation: Mold spores float invisibly in the air all around us and settle on warm, damp surfaces like leftover food, where they quickly begin to grow.
fact_tl: Ang dahilan kung bakit biglang tumutubo ang amag sa naiwang pagkain ay dahil palaging may maliliit na spore ng amag na lumulutang sa hangin sa paligid natin, naghihintay lamang ng basa at mainit na lugar.
fact_bis: Ang hinungdan nganong kalit motubo ang agup-op sa nahabilin nga pagkaon mao nga kanunay adunay gagmayng spore sa agup-op nga naglutaw sa hangin libot nato, nga naghulat lang og init ug mamasa nga dapit.

q: What process, invented by Charles Goodyear, makes rubber stronger, more elastic, and resistant to heat?
options: Vulcanization
Pasteurization
Fermentation
Hydrogenation
explanation: Vulcanization heats rubber with sulfur to make it tougher, stretchier, and able to withstand heat without melting or cracking.
fact_tl: Ang vulcanization ay prosesong iniimbento ni Charles Goodyear kung saan pinainit ang goma kasama ang asupre para gawing mas matibay, elastic, at hindi madaling matunaw sa init.
fact_bis: Ang vulcanization, nga giimbento ni Charles Goodyear, usa ka proseso sa pagpainit sa goma uban ang asupre aron mas lig-on, mas elastic, ug dili madaling matunaw sa init.

q: What is something important to know about antibiotics when you are sick with the flu?
options: Antibiotics will not help because the flu is caused by a virus, not bacteria
Antibiotics cure the flu by killing the flu virus directly
You should take antibiotics before seeing a doctor to recover faster
Antibiotics work against all types of microorganisms including viruses
explanation: Antibiotics fight bacteria but do not work against viruses, and the flu is caused by a virus, so antibiotics are useless against it.
fact_tl: Ang microorganisms ay napakaliliit na buhay na bagay na hindi nakikita ng mata kundi sa pamamagitan lang ng microscope, tulad ng bacteria at fungi. May nakakatulong sa kanila (halimbawa, paggawa ng yogurt o pagdurog ng patay na bagay) at may nakakasakit. Ang virus ay mas maliit pa at nagdudulot ng sakit tulad ng trangkaso.
fact_bis: Ang microorganisms mao ang gagmay kaayo nga buhi nga butang nga dili makita sa mata kondili pinaagi lang sa microscope, sama sa bacteria ug fungi. Adunay makatabang kanila (pananglitan, paghimo og yogurt o pagguba sa patay nga butang) ug adunay makapasakit. Ang virus mas gamay pa ug maoy hinungdan sa sakit sama sa trangkaso.

q: What does a crab do with its eyes when it senses danger?
options: Folds them down into protective grooves in its shell
Closes them tightly and stays completely still
Extends them higher on their stalks to see better
Sheds them and grows new ones after the danger passes
explanation: A crab's stalked eyes can fold down into small grooves in its shell, protecting them from harm the way you might tuck something fragile safely away.
fact_tl: Kapag may panganib, kayang itiklop ng alimango ang kanyang mga matang nasa tangkay pababa sa maliliit na ukit o butas sa kanyang shell para protektado ang mga ito. Para itong pagkurap o pagtago ng mata para hindi masaktan.
fact_bis: Kung adunay kuyaw, kaya sa alimango nga ipilo ang iyang mga mata nga naa sa tangkay paubos sa gagmay nga lugot o lungag sa iyang kabhang aron maprotektahan kini. Sama kini sa pagtago sa mata aron dili masakitan.

q: An object moves around a circle at a steady speed without speeding up or slowing down. What keeps changing even though the speed stays the same?
options: Its direction of movement
Its mass
Its distance from the center
Its weight
explanation: In uniform circular motion the speed is constant, but the direction of movement changes at every point along the circle.
fact_tl: Sa uniform circular motion, gumagalaw ang isang bagay sa bilog na may pareho ang bilis, pero patuloy na nagbabago ang direksyon nito sa bawat sandali.
fact_bis: Sa uniform circular motion, ang butang molihok libot sa lingin sa parehong katulin, apan kanunay nga mausab ang direksyon niini matag gutlo.

q: Why should you never eat raw gabi (taro)?
options: It contains tiny crystals that make the mouth itch
It is extremely bitter and poisonous to the stomach
It hardens inside the throat and is hard to swallow
It releases a strong acid that burns the tongue
explanation: Raw gabi has microscopic crystals that irritate the mouth and cause itching, so it must be cooked thoroughly to be safe to eat.
fact_tl: Hindi dapat kaining hilaw ang gabi dahil may maliliit na kristal ito na nakakakati sa bibig; kailangan munang lutuing mabuti.
fact_bis: Dili angay kan-on og hilaw ang gabi kay aduna kini gagmay nga kristal nga makakatol sa baba; kinahanglan lutoon una og maayo.

q: Where does roughly half of all the oxygen in Earth's atmosphere come from?
options: Marine phytoplankton in the ocean
The rainforests of South America
Mosses and ferns on forest floors
Freshwater plants in rivers and lakes
explanation: Marine phytoplankton produce about half of all Earth's oxygen — more than all land plants combined — through photosynthesis in the ocean.
fact_tl: Ang mga phytoplankton (maliliit na algae sa dagat) ay gumagawa ng halos kalahati ng lahat ng oxygen sa atmospera ng Daigdig — mas marami pa sila kaysa sa lahat ng mga halaman sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga phytoplankton (gagmay nga algae sa dagat) nagbuhat og halos katunga sa tanan nga oksiheno sa atmospera sa Yuta — labaw pa sila kaysa sa tanan nga tanom sa yuta.

q: After a goat grazes on grass, what does it do to help digest the tough plant material?
options: Brings the grass back up to its mouth and chews it again
Drinks large amounts of water to soften the grass in its stomach
Rubs its belly on the ground to mix the grass with stomach acid
Stands still for several hours until the grass dissolves on its own
explanation: Goats chew the cud by bringing partially digested grass back up from their stomach to chew it again, which helps break down tough plant fibers.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos manginain ng damo, nagpapahinga ang kambing at ibinabalik sa bibig ang halamang nakain para ngumuyang muli — tinatawag itong pagngangata ng cud, na tumutulong para mas matunaw ang matigas na damo.
fact_bis: Human mosibsib ug sagbot, mopahulay ang kanding ug ibalik sa baba ang nakaon nga tanom aron ngisngison pag-usab — gitawag kini og pagngisngis sa cud, nga motabang aron mas matunaw ang gahi nga sagbot.

q: Why can getting dengue a second time be more dangerous than getting it the first time?
options: A second infection with a different dengue serotype is often more severe
The body becomes weakened from the first infection and cannot fight at all
The dengue virus mutates into a stronger form inside the body
Mosquitoes inject more virus during a second bite
explanation: The dengue virus has four serotypes, and catching a different serotype the second time often leads to more severe illness, including dengue hemorrhagic fever.
fact_tl: Ang dengue virus ay may apat na uri (serotype) — ang pangalawang impeksyon ng ibang uri ay maaaring mas mapanganib at magdulot ng malubhang dengue.
fact_bis: Ang dengue virus adunay upat ka lainlaing serotype — ang ikaduha nga impeksyon sa lain nga serotype mas delikado ug mahimong mosangput sa grabe nga dengue hemorrhagic fever.

q: A doctor prescribes an antibiotic for a bacterial infection. What do antibiotics do inside the body?
options: They kill bacteria or stop them from multiplying
They destroy viruses and prevent them from spreading
They boost the immune system to fight any type of germ
They reduce fever by lowering body temperature directly
explanation: Antibiotics are medicines designed to kill bacteria or stop them from multiplying inside the body, but they are not effective against viruses.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotics ay gamot na ginagawa para labanan ang masasamang bacteria na nagdudulot ng sakit. Pinapatay nito o pinapahinto ang pagdami ng bacteria sa loob ng katawan. Pero tandaan, hindi ito gumagana laban sa virus, kaya dapat ireseta lang ito ng doktor.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotics tambal nga gihimo aron makontra ang daotang bacteria nga maghatag og sakit. Gipatay niini o gipahunong ang pagdaghan sa bacteria sulod sa lawas. Apan hinumdomi, dili kini molihok batok sa virus, mao nga ang doktor lang ang angay magreseta niini.

q: During a frog's metamorphosis, which of the following changes actually happens to its internal organs?
options: Gills are replaced by lungs as the frog moves from water to land
The frog grows a second heart to pump blood to its new legs
Its stomach shrinks because it switches from eating plants to insects
Its skin thickens to protect it from the cold air on land
explanation: During frog metamorphosis, gills are replaced by lungs, the tail is absorbed, legs grow, and the eyes reposition — it is a complete organ-level transformation.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng metamorphosis ng palaka, hindi lamang nagbabago ang hugis — ang mga hasang ay napapalitan ng mga baga, ang buntot ay nasisipsip ng katawan, at lumalabas ang mga paa habang muling pino-posisyon ang mga mata.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa metamorphosis sa palaka, dili lamang ang porma ang nagbag-o — ang mga hasang gipulihan sa mga baga, ang ikog gi-absorb sa lawas, namubo ang mga tiil, ug ang mga mata gi-reposition aron makakita sa ibabaw sa tubig.

q: What does a guava plant grow before it produces fruit?
options: White flowers
Green leaves only
Small red buds
Yellow pollen cones
explanation: Before bearing fruit, the guava plant first grows white flowers, which then develop into the fruit we eat.
fact_tl: Bago mamunga, namumulaklak muna ang bayabas ng puting bulaklak.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa mamunga, ang bayabas mamulak una ug puti nga bulak.

q: What fruit is widely regarded as the national fruit of the Philippines?
options: Mango
Banana
Coconut
Pineapple
explanation: The mango is widely regarded as the national fruit of the Philippines, celebrated for its sweetness and abundance in the country.
fact_tl: Ang mangga ay malawakang kinikilala bilang pambansang prutas ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang mangga kasagarang giila nga nasodnong prutas sa Pilipinas.

q: Approximately when did the Industrial Revolution begin?
options: Around the 1760s in the late 1700s
Around the 1850s in the mid-1800s
Around the 1900s at the turn of the 20th century
Around the 1600s in the early 1600s
explanation: The Industrial Revolution began around the 1760s in the late 1700s, when machines started replacing hand tools in factories.
fact_tl: Ang Rebolusyong Industriyal ay nagsimula noong mga 1760s, sa huling bahagi ng 1700s.
fact_bis: Ang Industrial Revolution nagsugod niadtong mga 1760s, sa ulahing bahin sa 1700s.

q: What is remarkable about the coconut crab found on some Philippine islands?
options: It is the world's largest land-living arthropod and can climb coconut trees
It is the fastest-running crustacean and can outrun most land animals
It can breathe underwater for hours and lives in both sea and land
It is the only crab in the world that can change color like a chameleon
explanation: The coconut crab (Birgus latro), found on islands including Tawi-Tawi in the Philippines, is the world's largest terrestrial arthropod and is capable of climbing coconut trees to collect fruit.
fact_tl: Ang coconut crab (Birgus latro) — na matatagpuan sa ilang isla ng Pilipinas tulad ng Tawi-Tawi — ang pinakamalaking terrestrial arthropod sa mundo; kayang umakyat ito ng mga puno ng niyog upang kumuha ng prutas.
fact_bis: Ang coconut crab (Birgus latro) — makita sa pipila ka pulo sa Pilipinas lakip ang Tawi-Tawi — ang pinakadako nga terrestrial arthropod sa kalibutan; makahimo kini og pag-akat sa mga kahoy sa niyog aron makuha ang prutas.

q: What role do decomposers like fungi, bacteria, and earthworms play in the soil?
options: They break down dead plants and animals, returning nutrients to the soil
They carry water from deep underground up to plant roots
They protect plant roots from insects by producing chemicals
They pack the soil tightly so that plant roots can grip it
explanation: Decomposers break down dead organisms and return their nutrients to the soil, making those nutrients available for plants to use again.
fact_tl: Ang mga decomposer tulad ng fungi, bakterya, at bulati sa lupa ay sumisira sa mga patay na halaman at hayop, na nagbabalik ng sustansya sa lupa para magamit muli ng mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang mga decomposer sama sa fungi, bakterya, ug ulod sa yuta nagaguba sa mga patay nga tanom ug hayop, nga nagpabalik sa sustansiya sa yuta aron magamit pag-usab sa mga tanom.

q: How do stick insects and leaf insects in the Philippines protect themselves from predators?
options: Their bodies look exactly like twigs or leaves, making them hard to spot
They release a foul-smelling liquid that drives predators away
They move extremely fast so predators cannot catch them
They have very hard shells that predators cannot bite through
explanation: Philippine stick and leaf insects have evolved remarkable camouflage — their bodies mimic twigs or leaves so closely that predators overlook them.
fact_tl: Ang stick insects at leaf insects ng Pilipinas ay napakahusay na adaptation ng camouflage — ang kanilang katawan ay mukhang talagang sanga o dahon na nagpapanatili sa kanila na ligtas mula sa mga manlangis.
fact_bis: Ang mga stick insect ug leaf insect sa Pilipinas adunay kahangol kaayo nga nag-evolve nga camouflage — ang ilang mga lawas nagpakita nga tunay nga mga sanga o dahon, nagpabilin kanila nga luwas gikan sa mga manunuha.

q: Why is a pomelo (suha) such a refreshing fruit to eat on a hot day?
options: Most of its flesh is water, which helps quench your thirst
It contains extra sugar that gives you energy quickly in the heat
It releases a cooling chemical that lowers your body temperature
Its thick skin keeps the inside cold even without refrigeration
explanation: A pomelo's flesh is mostly water, making it very juicy and great for quenching thirst on a hot day.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng laman ng suha ay tubig, kaya napakakatas nito. Mabuti itong kainin kapag mainit ang panahon dahil nakakatulong itong mawala ang uhaw.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa unod sa suha kay tubig, mao nga tubigon kaayo kini. Maayo kini kan-on kung init ang panahon kay makatabang kini sa pagtangtang sa uhaw.

q: What shape are the paths that planets follow as they orbit the Sun?
options: Slightly oval ellipses
Perfect circles
Irregular zigzag paths
Straight lines that curve near the Sun
explanation: Planet orbits are not perfect circles but slightly oval shapes called ellipses, as described by Kepler's first law of planetary motion.
fact_tl: Ang mga orbita ng planeta ay hindi ganap na bilog kundi bahagyang hugis-itlog na tinatawag na elipse.
fact_bis: Ang mga orbita sa planeta dili hingpit nga lingin kondili gamayng tabunon ang porma nga gitawag og elipse.

q: What is the difference between static electricity and current electricity?
options: Static electricity is charge that stays in place, while current electricity flows steadily around a loop
Static electricity flows in a circuit, while current electricity builds up in one spot
Current electricity comes from lightning, while static electricity comes from batteries
Static electricity is stronger than current electricity and powers most appliances
explanation: Static electricity is charge that stays put (like a spark from a balloon), while current electricity is a steady flow around a loop, such as from a battery through a circuit.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang static at current electricity. Ang static ay singil na nakatigil — gaya ng kuryenteng pumapasok pag kinuskos mo ang balloon sa buhok. Ang current naman ay tuloy-tuloy na daloy sa loop, gaya sa baterya. Ang kidlat ay biglaang labas ng static.
fact_bis: Lahi ang static ug current electricity. Ang static kay charge nga nagpabilin — sama sa spark kung kuskoson nimo ang balloon sa imong buhok. Ang current kay padayon nga agos sa loop, sama sa baterya. Ang kilat usa ka kalit nga pagbuhi sa static.

q: How does a vaccine protect you from getting sick when the real germ arrives?
options: It teaches your body what the germ looks like so your body is ready to fight it quickly
It kills all germs in your bloodstream before they can multiply
It makes your body too cold for germs to survive inside
It creates a protective coating on your skin that blocks germs from entering
explanation: A vaccine introduces your body to what a germ looks like without making you sick, so when the real germ arrives, your immune system already knows how to fight it.
fact_tl: Ang bakuna ay nagtuturo sa katawan kung ano ang itsura ng isang germ, nang hindi ka nagkakasakit. Kaya pag dumating ang totoong germ, handa na ang katawan na labanan ito nang mabilis.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna magtudlo sa lawas kung unsa ang hitsura sa usa ka germ, nga dili ka magsakit. Mao nga kung moabot ang tinuod nga germ, andam na ang lawas sa pag-away niini dayon.

q: Why is it much better to pick up plastic from a beach before it breaks into tiny pieces?
options: Whole plastic is easier to remove; once it crumbles into microplastics it is almost impossible to collect
Whole plastic is lighter than microplastics, so it is cheaper to transport to recycling centers
Plastic releases its harmful chemicals only after it breaks into small pieces
Microplastics float up into the sky and are no longer a problem for the ocean
explanation: Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down; collecting it whole is far easier than waiting for it to crumble into microplastics that are nearly impossible to remove.
fact_tl: Dahil daan-daang taon bago masira ang plastik, mahalaga ang coastal cleanup o paglilinis ng baybayin. Kapag kinuha natin ang plastik bago ito madurog sa microplastics, mas madaling maalis ito kaysa hintaying mawala mag-isa.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gatusan ka tuig usa madunot ang plastik, importante ang coastal cleanup o paglimpyo sa baybayon. Kung kuhaon nato ang plastik usa kini madugmok nga microplastics, mas sayon kining tangtangon kaysa hulaton nga mawala kini sa kaugalingon.

q: A seagull is floating on the open ocean as waves pass by. How does the bird actually move?
options: It bobs up and down in place without moving forward with the wave
It is carried forward in the same direction the wave is traveling
It spins in circles as each wave passes underneath it
It is pushed backward because waves always push objects back toward shore
explanation: In deep-water waves, water particles (and anything floating on them) move up and down in place — they do not travel along with the wave.
fact_tl: Sa alon sa malalim na tubig, ang tubig ay tumataas at bumababa lamang sa kinalalagyan nito at hindi sumasama sa direksyon ng alon, kaya't ang lumulutang na ibon o korotso ay umuugoy-ugoy lang sa lugar nito.
fact_bis: Sa balod sa lawom nga tubig, ang tubig mokayab ug mokanaog lang sa iyang dapit ug dili mouban sa direksyon sa balod, mao nga ang naglutaw nga langgam o tapon mag-uyog-uyog lang sa iyang dapit.

q: What substance in tobacco makes it so difficult to stop smoking?
options: Nicotine, an addictive chemical
Tar, which coats the lungs and causes cravings
Carbon monoxide, which the brain becomes dependent on
Ammonia, which triggers the reward centers in the brain
explanation: Tobacco contains nicotine, an addictive chemical that creates strong cravings and makes it very hard for smokers to quit.
fact_tl: Ang tabako ay naglalaman ng nikotina, isang kemikal na nakakaadik kaya mahirap nang itigil ang paninigarilyo.
fact_bis: Ang tabako adunay nikotina, usa ka kemikal nga makahubog mao nga lisod nang hunongon ang pagpanigarilyo.

q: What unit is commonly used to measure air pressure, and what is normal sea-level air pressure in that unit?
options: Hectopascal (hPa); about 1013 hPa
Kilogram (kg); about 101 kg
Newton (N); about 100 N
Joule (J); about 1013 J
explanation: Air pressure is measured in hectopascals (hPa), and normal sea-level pressure is about 1013 hPa.
fact_tl: Madalas sukatin ang air pressure sa yunit na hectopascal (hPa); ang karaniwang presyon ng hangin sa tabing-dagat ay nasa palibot ng 1013 hPa.
fact_bis: Ang air pressure kasagarang sukdon sa yunit nga hectopascal (hPa); ang naandang presyon sa hangin sa daplin sa dagat mga 1013 hPa.

q: What does Philippine law say about cloud rats?
options: They are protected animals that cannot legally be hunted or harmed
They are considered pests and may be removed from farms without penalty
They are classified as an invasive species that must be controlled
They are allowed to be caught and sold as pets under a special permit
explanation: The cloud rat is a protected animal under the wildlife laws of the Philippines, meaning it is illegal to hunt or harm one.
fact_tl: Itinuturing na protektadong hayop ang cloud rat sa ilalim ng batas pangkalikasan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang cloud rat giila nga protektado nga hayop ilalom sa balaod sa kinaiyahan sa Pilipinas.

q: Which group of sea animals is the nautilus most closely related to?
options: Octopus and squid
Crabs and lobsters
Starfish and sea urchins
Jellyfish and sea anemones
explanation: The nautilus is a mollusk — a relative of the octopus and squid — living inside a hard shell in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang nautilus ay isang hayop sa dagat na may matigas na kabibi, kamag-anak ng pugita at pusit.
fact_bis: Ang nautilus usa ka mananap sa dagat nga adunay gahi nga kabibi, paryente sa kugita ug nukos.

q: What is the white crusty deposit that builds up inside kettles and water pipes in areas with hard water?
options: Limescale
Rust
Soap scum
Salt crystals
explanation: Hard water leaves behind a white crusty deposit called limescale when it evaporates or is heated inside kettles and pipes.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na tubig ay nag-iiwan ng puting latak na tinatawag na limescale sa loob ng takure at mga tubo.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga tubig magbilin og puti nga latak nga gitawag og limescale sulod sa takure ug mga tubo.

q: How many strands does RNA have compared to DNA?
options: RNA has one strand while DNA has two strands
RNA has two strands while DNA has one strand
Both RNA and DNA have two strands each
Both RNA and DNA have one strand each
explanation: DNA is a double-stranded molecule, but RNA usually has just one strand and acts as a messenger to carry DNA's instructions for making proteins.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay may dalawang strand, pero ang malapit nitong kapatid na RNA ay karaniwang iisa lang ang strand. Tumutulong ang RNA na dalhin ang mensahe ng DNA para makagawa ng mga bagay sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang DNA adunay duha ka strand, apan ang duol niini nga igsoon nga RNA kasagaran usa lang ka strand. Ang RNA motabang sa pagdala sa mensahe sa DNA aron makahimo ang lawas sa mga butang nga gikinahanglan.

q: Which of the following is a correct list of igneous rocks?
options: Granite, basalt, and obsidian
Limestone, marble, and quartzite
Shale, sandstone, and coal
Slate, gneiss, and schist
explanation: Granite, basalt, and obsidian are all igneous rocks — they formed from cooled magma or lava.
fact_tl: Tatlong halimbawa ng igneous rock ang granite, basalt, at obsidian.
fact_bis: Tulo ka pananglitan sa igneous rock mao ang granite, basalt, ug obsidian.

q: A student dips a strip soaked in purple cabbage juice into a liquid and it changes color. What does this experiment show?
options: The liquid is either an acid or a base, and cabbage juice is a natural pH indicator
The cabbage juice reacted with oxygen in the air and changed color spontaneously
Purple cabbage juice always changes color when it gets wet
The liquid is poisonous, because it reacted with the plant juice
explanation: The juice of purple cabbage (and some other plants) acts as a natural pH indicator — it changes color in the presence of acids or bases.
fact_tl: May mga halaman na puwedeng gawing natural na indicator — halimbawa, ang katas ng purple cabbage o talong ay nagbabago ng kulay kapag inilagay sa acid o base.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom nga mahimong natural nga indicator — pananglitan, ang duga sa purple cabbage o talong mousab og kolor kung ibutang sa asido o base.

q: What can happen to a baby if its mother catches the Zika virus during pregnancy?
options: The baby's brain can be affected and its head may be unusually small
The baby may be born with an extra finger or toe on each hand and foot
The baby can develop a severe rash all over its skin at birth
The baby's eyes may not open properly for the first few months of life
explanation: If a pregnant woman is infected with the Zika virus, the developing baby's brain can be harmed, resulting in a condition where the baby's head is unusually small.
fact_tl: Kung ang isang buntis ay mahawa ng Zika, maaaring maapektuhan ang utak ng sanggol at maging mas maliit ang ulo nito.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka mabdos mataptan sa Zika, mahimong maapektohan ang utok sa bata ug mahimong gamay kaayo ang ulo niini.

q: Why is the dugong considered a keystone species in Philippine coastal waters?
options: Its grazing on seagrass keeps the meadows healthy and supports many fish
It protects coral reefs by eating the crown-of-thorns starfish that destroy coral
It stirs up the ocean floor, releasing nutrients that feed phytoplankton
Its body heat warms the shallow waters, helping coral and seagrass grow faster
explanation: Dugongs are keystone species in the Philippines because grazing on seagrass keeps the meadows healthy; those meadows in turn shelter many young fish.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang dugong ay keystone species dahil sa pagkain nito ng damong-dagat, nakakatulong itong panatilihing malusog at sariwa ang mga seagrass na tirahan ng maraming isda.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang dugong usa ka keystone species kay tungod sa pagkaon niini sa sagbot sa dagat, makatabang kini sa pagpadayon nga himsog ug presko ang seagrass nga puy-anan sa daghang isda.

q: What makes mineral water different from plain water?
options: It contains dissolved minerals like calcium and magnesium
It has been purified so all minerals and bacteria have been removed
It is collected from clouds before it touches the ground
It has bubbles of carbon dioxide added to it
explanation: Mineral water contains dissolved minerals including calcium and magnesium, which give it a distinctive taste and provide some health benefits.
fact_tl: Ang mineral water ay tubig na naglalaman ng mga mineral na natunaw sa loob nito — kabilang ang calcium, magnesium, at iba pang mineral. Ang mga mineral na ito ay nagbibigay ng natatanging lasa sa mineral water at may benepisyo sa kalusugan.
fact_bis: Ang mineral water mao ang tubig nga naglakip sa mga natunaw nga mineral — lakip ang calcium, magnesium, ug ubang mga mineral. Kining mga mineral naghatag sa mineral water sa iyang natatanging lasa ug naghatag og pipila ka benepisyo sa kalusugan.

q: James Joule, the scientist whose name is used as the unit of energy, was from which country?
options: England
France
Germany
Scotland
explanation: James Joule was English, and the joule (J) — the standard unit of energy — was named in his honor.
fact_tl: Si James Joule ay taga-England (Inglatera).
fact_bis: Si James Joule taga-England (Inglatera).

q: In a compound microscope, what are the two lenses and what does each one do?
options: The objective lens near the specimen creates an enlarged image; the eyepiece magnifies that image further
The objective lens focuses light onto the slide; the eyepiece projects the image onto a screen
The objective lens shrinks the image so it fits in the eyepiece; the eyepiece then enlarges it
The two lenses are identical and each provides the same level of magnification independently
explanation: A compound microscope has an objective lens that forms an enlarged image of the specimen, and an eyepiece that magnifies that image even further, giving very high total magnification.
fact_tl: Ang compound microscope ay gumagamit ng dalawang convex lens — ang objective lens na malapit sa specimen para gumawa ng enlarged na imahe, at ang eyepiece para palakiin pa ito.
fact_bis: Ang compound microscope naggamit og duha ka convex lens — ang objective lens duol sa specimen nagabuhat og palakong hulagway, ug ang eyepiece nagapalaki niini pa.

q: What special ability lets the dalag (snakehead fish) survive in water that has very little oxygen?
options: It can gulp air from the surface to breathe
It slows its heartbeat to almost zero and waits for better conditions
It burrows into the mud and absorbs oxygen directly through its skin
It switches to eating plants instead of fish when oxygen levels are low
explanation: The dalag can gulp air from above the water's surface, allowing it to survive in oxygen-poor water such as rice paddies and muddy swamps.
fact_tl: Ang dalag o snakehead ay isang isda sa tubig-tabang sa Pilipinas na naninirahan sa mga palayan at putikang lawa, at kayang huminga ng hangin upang mabuhay sa tubig na kulang sa oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang haloan o snakehead usa ka tab-ang nga isda sa Pilipinas nga nagpuyo sa kahumayan ug lapokon nga lanaw, ug makaginhawa kini og hangin aron mabuhi sa tubig nga kulang sa oxygen.

q: Which of the following is a source of methane, a powerful greenhouse gas?
options: Cattle, rice fields, and landfills
Cars, airplanes, and factories burning gasoline
Coal power plants and oil refineries
Deforestation and burning of forests
explanation: Methane is produced by cattle digestion, flooded rice fields, and decomposing waste in landfills, making it a significant greenhouse gas from agriculture and waste.
fact_tl: Ang methane ay nagmumula sa mga baka, palayan, at basurahan, at ito ay malakas na greenhouse gas.
fact_bis: Ang methane gikan sa mga baka, humayan, ug tambakan sa basura, ug kini usa ka kusgan nga greenhouse gas.

q: How do the sizes of black holes in the universe compare to one another?
options: They vary enormously — some weigh a few times a star's mass while others weigh billions of times the Sun's mass
They are all roughly the same size because they form from stars of similar mass
The biggest black holes are only about ten times larger than the smallest ones
Black holes grow to one standard size and then stop absorbing matter
explanation: Black holes vary enormously in size: stellar black holes weigh a few times a star's mass, while supermassive black holes at galaxy centers can weigh millions or billions of times the Sun's mass.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang laki ang mga black hole: ang ilan ay kasimbigat lang ng ilang bituin, samantalang ang iba na nasa sentro ng mga galaksiya ay kasimbigat ng milyon-milyon o bilyon-bilyong Araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga black hole adunay lainlaing gidak-on: ang uban sama ra og gibug-aton sa pipila ka bituon, samtang ang uban sa sentro sa mga galaksiya sama og gibug-aton sa minilyon o binilyon nga Adlaw.

q: Which part of a plant acts like a kitchen, making the plant's food through photosynthesis?
options: The leaf
The root
The stem
The flower
explanation: The leaf is where photosynthesis takes place, converting sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into food for the plant.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ang parang kusina ng halaman kung saan ginagawa ang pagkain nito sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis.
fact_bis: Ang dahon mao ang sama sa kusina sa tanom, diin ginahimo ang pagkaon niini pinaagi sa potosintesis.

q: A scientist adds a few drops of phenolphthalein indicator to two liquids — one is an acid and one is a base. What happens?
options: The acid stays colorless and the base turns pink
Both liquids turn pink because phenolphthalein is always pink
The acid turns pink and the base stays colorless
Both liquids stay colorless because phenolphthalein only reacts with metals
explanation: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acid but turns pink in a base, making it a useful indicator to distinguish between the two.
fact_tl: Ang phenolphthalein ay walang kulay sa asido ngunit nagiging rosas sa base.
fact_bis: Ang phenolphthalein walay kolor sa asido apan mahimong rosas sa base.

q: Why do the kidneys make sure amino acids are not lost in urine?
options: Because the body uses amino acids to make protein and repair itself, so they are too important to waste
Because amino acids make urine smell strongly and could cause infections
Because amino acids would solidify in the bladder and cause painful kidney stones
Because losing amino acids in urine would lower body temperature dangerously
explanation: Amino acids are the building blocks the body uses to make protein and repair tissue, so the kidneys reabsorb them rather than letting them pass out in urine.
fact_tl: Isa pang halimbawa ng itinatago ng bato ay ang amino acids—ang maliliit na sangkap na ginagamit ng katawan para gumawa ng protina at ayusin ang sarili. Dahil mahalaga ang mga ito sa paglaki at pagkumpuni ng katawan, hindi pinapayagan ng bato na maaksaya sa ihi.
fact_bis: Lain pang pananglitan sa gitipigan sa kidney mao ang amino acids—ang gagmayng sangkap nga gamiton sa lawas aron maghimo og protina ug ayohon ang kaugalingon. Tungod kay importante kini sa pagtubo ug pag-ayo sa lawas, dili tugotan sa kidney nga mausik kini sa ihi.

q: Why do gears have teeth along their edges?
options: The teeth prevent slipping so motion passes exactly from one gear to the next
The teeth make the gears spin faster by reducing friction between them
The teeth allow the gears to be stacked on top of each other to save space
The teeth make it easier to pull the gears apart when a machine needs repair
explanation: A gear's teeth interlock with the teeth of the next gear, preventing slipping so that motion and force are transferred precisely between gears.
fact_tl: Ang mga ngipin ng gear ay nagsisiguro na hindi ito nadudulas, kaya tumpak ang paglipat ng galaw.
fact_bis: Ang mga ngipon sa gear maghimo nga dili kini modalin-as, busa eksakto ang pagbalhin sa lihok.

q: Chickens, birds, and many other animals reproduce by doing what?
options: Laying eggs
Giving birth to live young
Splitting into two new animals
Growing new offspring from their skin
explanation: Chickens, birds, and many other animals are egg-layers — they make babies by laying eggs that hatch outside the mother's body.
fact_tl: Ang ilang hayop tulad ng manok at ibon ay nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng pangingitlog.
fact_bis: Ang ubang mga hayop sama sa manok ug langgam nagpasanay pinaagi sa pangitlog.

q: What is special about a goat's pupils that helps it stay safe from predators?
options: They are wide and rectangular, giving the goat a broad field of view
They are perfectly round like a human's, allowing sharp central vision
They are vertical slits that help the goat focus on objects far away
They can rotate inside the eye so the goat can look behind itself
explanation: Goats have wide rectangular pupils that allow them to see a very broad area around them, helping them spot predators approaching from the sides.
fact_tl: Ang kambing ay may pahabang parihabang balintataw (pupil) na tumutulong dito na makakita ng malawak na paligid para sa kaligtasan.
fact_bis: Ang kanding adunay halapad nga rektanggulo nga kalimutaw (pupil) nga makatabang niini nga makakita sa lapad nga palibot alang sa kaluwasan.

q: When a snail pulls back into its shell for safety, which body part goes in first?
options: Its head and tentacles go in first, then the foot follows
Its foot goes in first to act as a plug, then the head follows
Its whole body goes in at once in a single smooth motion
Its tentacles go in last because they are the least important part
explanation: A snail protects its most important parts first — the sensitive head and tentacles go in before the foot does, ensuring the vital organs are shielded quickly.
fact_tl: Kapag nagtatago ang kuhol, unang pumapasok ang sensitibong ulo at sungay nito, tapos sumusunod ang malambot na paa. Ginagawa nito ito para maprotektahan ang pinakamahalagang bahagi.
fact_bis: Kon mutago ang kuhol, ang sensitibo nga ulo ug sungay-sungay ang unang musulod, dayon mosunod ang humok nga tiil. Gibuhat niini aron mapanalipdan ang labing importante nga bahin.

q: What happens to fish populations in an area where mangroves are replanted after being cut down?
options: Young fish gradually increase as the growing trees provide shelter and food again
Fish populations instantly recover because fish return the moment new trees are planted
Fish populations decrease further because replanting disturbs the ocean floor
Fish move permanently to deeper water and never return to the mangrove area
explanation: When mangroves are replanted, the shelter and food they provide slowly return, and as the trees grow the area becomes a nursery again, causing young fish to increase over time.
fact_tl: Kapag muling nagtanim ng bakawan sa mga lugar na naputol, unti-unting bumabalik ang taguan at pagkain ng isda. Pagkalaki ng mga bagong puno, nagiging nursery ulit ito at dumarami muli ang batang isda. Maraming komunidad sa Pilipinas ang gumagawa ng ganitong proyekto.
fact_bis: Kung magtanom og balik og bakawan sa mga dapit nga naputol, hinay-hinay nga mobalik ang katagoan ug pagkaon sa isda. Inigdako sa bag-ong mga kahoy, mahimo na usab kining nursery ug modaghan ang batan-ong isda. Daghang komunidad sa Pilipinas ang naghimo niini nga proyekto.

q: What is the siphuncle in a nautilus shell?
options: A thin tube that connects all the chambers and controls the gas and water inside
A sharp beak-like structure the nautilus uses to crack open prey
A row of suckers along the nautilus's arms used for gripping food
A layer of smooth material lining the shell that makes it waterproof
explanation: The siphuncle is a thin tube running through all the chambers of a nautilus shell; it controls the mixture of gas and water in each chamber to regulate the animal's buoyancy.
fact_tl: May manipis na tubo na tinatawag na siphuncle na nag-uugnay sa lahat ng silid at kumokontrol sa gas at tubig.
fact_bis: Adunay nipis nga tubo nga gitawag og siphuncle nga nagkonektar sa tanang lawak ug nagkontrol sa gas ug tubig.

q: What was the universe like at the very beginning?
options: Extremely hot and dense, then it gradually cooled as it expanded
Very cold and empty, then it slowly heated up as it shrank
Exactly the same size and temperature as it is today
Full of planets and stars from the very start
explanation: At the very start, the universe was extremely hot and dense, and it gradually cooled as it expanded.
fact_tl: Sa simula, ang uniberso ay napakainit at napakasiksik, at unti-unti itong lumamig habang lumalawak.
fact_bis: Sa sinugdanan, ang uniberso init kaayo ug bagaon kaayo, ug anam-anam kini nga nibugnaw samtang naglapad.

q: Besides changing color, what other amazing thing can an octopus do with its skin?
options: Change its skin texture to appear smooth or bumpy like a rock or plant
Shed its entire skin like a snake to reveal a new layer underneath
Make its skin glow in the dark to confuse predators
Produce a slippery slime coating that repels other animals
explanation: Octopuses can change both color and skin texture to look smooth or bumpy, helping them mimic rocks or plants.
fact_tl: Bukod sa kulay, kaya ring baguhin ng pugita ang tekstura ng balat para maging makinis o kulubot katulad ng bato o halaman.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kolor, ang pugita makausab usab sa tekstura sa panit aron mahimong hamis o kulubot sama sa bato o tanom.

q: On which river was the Three Gorges Dam built?
options: The Yangtze River in China
The Yellow River in China
The Mekong River in Southeast Asia
The Ganges River in India
explanation: The Three Gorges Dam was built on the Yangtze River in China.
fact_tl: Ang Three Gorges Dam ay itinayo sa Yangtze River sa China.
fact_bis: Ang Three Gorges Dam gitukod sa Yangtze River (Suba sa Yangtze) sa China.

q: Which mosquito carries the dengue virus, and how can you recognize it?
options: The Aedes aegypti mosquito, which has a black body and white stripes on its legs
The Anopheles mosquito, which has spotted brown wings and rests at an angle
The Culex mosquito, which is plain brown and bites mainly at night
The house mosquito, which has a striped abdomen and bites indoors
explanation: Dengue is carried by the Aedes aegypti mosquito, which is identified by its black body with white stripes on its legs.
fact_tl: Ang dengue ay dala ng lamok na Aedes aegypti, na may itim na katawan at puting guhit sa paa.
fact_bis: Ang dengue gidala sa lamok nga Aedes aegypti, nga adunay itom nga lawas ug puti nga guhit sa tiil.

q: Why can distillation separate ethanol from water?
options: Ethanol boils at 78°C while water boils at 100°C, so they turn to gas at different temperatures
Ethanol is heavier than water and sinks to the bottom when heated
Water evaporates before ethanol because water molecules are smaller
They are different colors, so distillation uses a filter to separate them
explanation: Ethanol boils first at 78°C before water at 100°C, so heating the mixture turns the ethanol to vapor first, allowing distillation to separate them.
fact_tl: Sa init, ang ethanol (78°C) ay kumukulo bago ang tubig (100°C), kaya ito ang dahilan kung bakit gumagana ang distillation.
fact_bis: Kon initon, ang ethanol (78°C) mubukal una sa wala pa ang tubig (100°C), mao nga molihok ang distillation.

q: After our Sun, which star is the closest to Earth?
options: Proxima Centauri, about 4.2 light-years away
Sirius, about 8.6 light-years away
Betelgeuse, about 700 light-years away
Alpha Centauri A, about 100 light-years away
explanation: Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to our Sun at about 4.2 light-years away; it is part of the Alpha Centauri triple star system.
fact_tl: Ang Proxima Centauri ang pinaka-malapit na bituin sa aming Araw sa distansya na humigit-kumulang 4.2 light-years; ito ay isang maliit na red dwarf na bahagi ng triple star system na Alpha Centauri at mayroon itong isang exoplanet (Proxima b) na nasa habitable zone nito.
fact_bis: Ang Proxima Centauri mao ang pinaka-duol nga bituin sa atong Adlaw sa distansya nga mga 4.2 light-years; kini usa ka gamay nga red dwarf nga parte sa triple star system sa Alpha Centauri ug adunay exoplanet (Proxima b) sa iyang habitable zone.

q: What is the name of the area between the highest and lowest tide lines along the shore?
options: The intertidal zone
The continental shelf
The sublittoral zone
The abyssal plain
explanation: The area between the highest and lowest water is called the intertidal zone — it dries at low tide and is covered at high tide.
fact_tl: Ang lugar sa pagitan ng pinakamataas at pinakamababang tubig ay tinatawag na intertidal zone. Natutuyo ito kapag hunas at nalulubog kapag taog. Dito nakatira ang mga bituin-dagat, kabibe, at iba pang hayop na sanay sa pagbabagong ito.
fact_bis: Ang lugar tunga sa pinakataas ug pinakaubos nga tubig gitawag og intertidal zone. Momala kini kung hunas ug malubog kung taob. Dinhi nagpuyo ang mga bituon sa dagat, kinhason, ug uban pang mananap nga anad niini nga kausaban.

q: How does a monitor lizard (bayawak) defend itself when it is frightened?
options: It whips its strong tail at the threat
It sprays a cloud of poison from its skin
It changes color to blend into the background
It puffs up its body to look much larger
explanation: When frightened, the monitor lizard can use its strong tail to whip and defend itself.
fact_tl: Kapag natatakot, maaaring gamitin ng bayawak ang malakas nitong buntot para humampas at ipagtanggol ang sarili.
fact_bis: Kon mahadlok, mahimong gamiton sa bayawak ang kusgan niini nga ikog aron molatos ug manalipod sa kaugalingon.

q: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan, Mindanao is famous for two things — how tall is it, and what is it used for?
options: About 98 meters tall, and it is used to generate electricity
About 198 meters tall, and it is used as a drinking water source
About 48 meters tall, and it is used for tourist swimming
About 298 meters tall, and it is used for irrigating rice fields
explanation: Maria Cristina Falls is about 98 meters tall and its water power is used to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan, Mindanao ay mga 98 metro ang taas at ginagamit sa paggawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan, Mindanao mga 98 ka metro ang gihabogon ug gigamit sa paghimo og kuryente.

q: Why are many wetlands disappearing and in need of protection?
options: They are being filled in and their mangroves are being cut down
They are drying up because global rainfall has completely stopped
Animals are eating all the plants, leaving the wetlands empty
Salt water is flooding them and turning them into open ocean
explanation: Many wetlands are being lost as they are filled in or their mangroves are cut down, so they need to be protected.
fact_tl: Maraming wetland ang nawawala dahil tinatabunan o pinuputol ang bakawan, kaya kailangan itong pangalagaan.
fact_bis: Daghang wetland ang nawawala kay gitabunan o giputol ang ilang bakawan, busa kinahanglan kini ampingan.

q: What is a tsunami?
options: A series of very large sea waves usually caused by a strong undersea earthquake
A powerful spinning ocean current that pulls boats underwater
An extremely heavy tropical storm that forms over warm ocean water
A sudden rise in sea level caused only by very strong ocean winds
explanation: A tsunami is a series of very large sea waves usually caused by a strong undersea earthquake.
fact_tl: Ang tsunami ay napakalaking alon sa dagat na kadalasang dulot ng malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng karagatan.
fact_bis: Ang tsunami usa ka dagkong balod sa dagat nga kasagaran tungod sa kusog nga linog sa ilawom sa dagat.

q: How do some poisons and venoms stop muscles from working?
options: They block the synapse so nerve messages cannot cross, preventing the brain from sending commands to muscles
They destroy the muscles themselves by breaking down muscle fibers directly
They travel to the brain and put the whole nervous system to sleep permanently
They thicken the blood so oxygen cannot reach the muscles at all
explanation: Some poisons attack the synapse and block the nerve message from crossing, so the brain can no longer send commands to breathe or move muscles.
fact_tl: May mga lason at kamandag na umaatake mismo sa synapse. Hinaharang nila ang pagdaan ng mensahe, kaya hindi na maipasa ng utak ang utos na huminga o gumalaw ang kalamnan.
fact_bis: Naay mga hilo ug lala nga moataki mismo sa synapse. Ilang babagan ang pag-agi sa mensahe, busa dili na mapadala sa utok ang mando nga moginhawa o molihok ang unod.

q: Long ago, what did sailors eat to prevent the disease called scurvy?
options: Limes and citrus fruits
Salted fish and dried meat
Hardtack biscuits and oats
Seaweed and shellfish
explanation: Long ago, sailors ate limes and citrus fruits to avoid getting scurvy, because these fruits are rich in vitamin C.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ang mga mandaragat ay kumakain ng dayap (lime) at citrus para hindi magka-scurvy.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang mga mandaragat mokaon og dayap (lime) ug citrus aron dili maka-scurvy.

q: Where do your muscles get the energy they need to pull?
options: From the food you eat and the oxygen from your breathing
From the calcium stored in your bones
From electrical signals sent directly by your brain
From the water you drink, which powers muscle movement
explanation: A muscle needs energy to pull, and that energy comes from the food you eat and the oxygen from your breathing.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng enerhiya ng kalamnan para makahila. Galing ang enerhiyang ito sa pagkaing kinakain mo at sa oxygen mula sa paghinga. Kaya napapagod ka at nanghihina kapag gutom — wala nang sapat na enerhiya ang mga muscle mo para patuloy na humila.
fact_bis: Nagkinahanglan og kusog ang kaunoran aron makabira. Kini nga kusog gikan sa pagkaon nga imong gikaon ug sa oxygen gikan sa imong pagginhawa. Mao nga gikapoy ka ug maluya kung gutom — wala nay igong kusog ang imong mga kaunoran aron magpadayon sa pagbira.

q: A person with myopia has trouble seeing things far away. What kind of lens is used in glasses to correct this?
options: A concave lens
A convex lens
A flat lens
A prism lens
explanation: Myopia (nearsightedness) causes blurry distant vision and is corrected with concave lenses in glasses or contact lenses.
fact_tl: Ang myopia (nearsightedness) ay isang kondisyon ng mata na kung saan ang mga bagay na malayo ay malabo; maaaring itama ng mga salamin na may concave lens.
fact_bis: Ang myopia (nearsightedness) usa ka kondisyon sa mata diin ang mga layo nga mga butang nagpakita nga malabo; mahimong ma-correct gamit ang mga salamin o contact lenses nga adunay concave lenses.

q: Why does a raisin swell up when you soak it in water?
options: Water moves into the raisin by osmosis
The raisin absorbs water through tiny holes in its skin by suction
The raisin's sugar dissolves into the water and pulls liquid inside
Heat from the room makes the raisin expand like a balloon
explanation: When you soak a raisin in water, it swells because water moves into it by osmosis — the movement of water from a less concentrated area to a more concentrated one.
fact_tl: Kapag ibinabad mo ang pasas sa tubig, namamaga ito dahil pumapasok ang tubig sa loob nito sa pamamagitan ng osmosis.
fact_bis: Kon ituslob nimo ang pasas sa tubig, mohubag kini tungod kay mosulod ang tubig niini pinaagi sa osmosis.

q: What is diffusion?
options: The spreading of tiny particles from a crowded area to a less crowded area until evenly spread
The mixing of two liquids when you stir them together with a spoon
The sinking of heavy particles to the bottom of a liquid over time
The evaporation of water from the surface of a liquid into the air
explanation: Diffusion is the spreading of tiny particles from where they are crowded to where they are fewer, until they are evenly spread out.
fact_tl: Ang diffusion ay ang pagkalat ng mga maliliit na piraso ng bagay mula sa lugar na maraming sila patungo sa lugar na kakaunti sila, hanggang sa pantay na ang pagkakalat.
fact_bis: Ang diffusion mao ang pagkatag sa gagmay nga mga tipik gikan sa dapit nga daghan sila ngadto sa dapit nga gamay ra sila, hangtod managsama na ang ilang pagkatag.

q: Which teeth do you use mainly to grind rice, corn, and tough food until it is soft?
options: Molars at the back of your mouth
Incisors at the very front of your mouth
Canines near the corners of your mouth
Baby teeth that fall out before age 7
explanation: Your molars are the grinding teeth at the back of your mouth, used to grind rice, corn, and other food until soft.
fact_tl: Kapag kumakain ka ng kanin, mais, o nilagang gulay, ang bagang mo ang gumigiling nito hanggang sa lumambot. Kaya kahit medyo matigas, kayang-kaya nilang durugin.
fact_bis: Kung mokaon ka og kan-on, mais, o nilat-an nga utan, ang imong bag-ang maoy mogaling niini hangtod molumo. Bisan medyo gahi, kaya ra nila dugmokon.

q: What useful building material can be made from the trunk of an old coconut palm?
options: Coco lumber for posts, planks, and buildings
Coconut charcoal burned as cooking fuel
Coconut rope woven from the inner trunk fibers
Coconut glass melted and shaped into windows
explanation: The trunk of an old coconut palm can be sawn into coco lumber — sturdy wood used for posts, planks, and buildings.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng matandang puno ng niyog ay puwedeng gawing coco lumber — matibay na kahoy na ginagamit sa mga poste, tabla, at gusali.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa tigulang nga puno sa lubi mahimong himuong coco lumber — lig-on nga kahoy nga gamiton sa mga poste, tabla, ug mga gambalay.

q: How does synthetic fabric (like nylon or polyester) compare to natural cotton when you wear it?
options: Synthetic fabric dries faster but can feel hotter to wear than cotton
Synthetic fabric absorbs more sweat and keeps you cooler than cotton
Cotton dries faster than synthetic fabric in hot weather
Cotton is stronger and longer-lasting than any synthetic fabric
explanation: Synthetic fabrics like nylon and polyester dry faster than cotton, but they can feel hotter to wear.
fact_tl: Ang ilang tela ay natural (tulad ng bulak na galing sa halaman); ang iba ay synthetic (tulad ng nylon at polyester na gawa ng tao). Mas mabilis matuyo ang synthetic na tela pero mas mainit isuot kaysa bulak.
fact_bis: Ang ubang panapton natural (sama sa gapas gikan sa tanom); ang uban synthetic (sama sa nylon ug polyester nga hinimo sa tawo). Mas paspas mamala ang synthetic nga panapton apan mas init isul-ob kaysa gapas.

q: Many people think carbon is always black coal — which of these is also made of carbon?
options: A clear diamond
Table salt
Iron nails
Oxygen gas
explanation: Carbon is an element found in thousands of forms — even a clear diamond is made of carbon, not just black coal.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nag-aakalang ang carbon ay laging itim na uling. Pero ang carbon ay isang element na nasa libu-libong anyo — ang sugar sa prutas, ang protina sa katawan mo, at maging ang malinaw na diamond ay carbon din. Hindi ito laging itim.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga ang carbon kanunay itom nga uling. Apan ang carbon usa ka element nga makita sa liboan ka porma — ang sugar sa prutas, ang protina sa imong lawas, ug bisan ang tin-aw nga diamond kay carbon usab. Dili kini kanunay itom.

q: Why does tikoy become chewy and sticky when cooked?
options: It is made from glutinous rice that is rich in starch, which becomes sticky when cooked
It contains a lot of sugar syrup that caramelizes and hardens around the outside
It is deep-fried in oil, which seals the surface and traps moisture inside
It is steamed for a very long time, which breaks down the protein into a glue-like paste
explanation: Tikoy is made from glutinous rice rich in starch, and starch becomes chewy and sticky when cooked.
fact_tl: Ang tikoy ay gawa sa malagkit na bigas na maraming almirol, kaya kapag niluto ay nagiging makunat at malagkit ito.
fact_bis: Ang tikoy hinimo gikan sa pilit nga bugas nga daghan og almirol, mao nga kon lutoon mahimo kining unat ug pilit.

q: The pancreas makes a hormone called glucagon. What does the name "glucagon" tell you about its job?
options: It raises blood sugar — the name comes from the word glucose, meaning sugar
It breaks down fat — the name comes from gluco meaning oil and agon meaning breaker
It fights infection — the name comes from gluco meaning white and agon meaning warrior
It controls sleep — the name comes from gluco meaning calm and agon meaning rest
explanation: The name glucagon comes from the word glucose (sugar), because its job is to raise blood sugar levels.
fact_tl: Ang pangalang glucagon ay nagmula sa salitang glucose (asukal), dahil ang trabaho nito ay pataasin ang asukal sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang ngalan nga glucagon naggikan sa pulong nga glucose (asukal), tungod kay ang trabaho niini mao ang pagpataas sa asukal sa dugo.

q: Why do mangrove trees have special roots that stick up above the mud?
options: The mud below has too little oxygen, so these roots absorb oxygen from the air
The roots need sunlight to photosynthesize just like leaves do
The roots collect rainwater to store it inside the tree trunk
The roots act as legs that help the tree walk to deeper water
explanation: Mangroves have roots called pneumatophores that stick up above the mud to absorb oxygen from the air, because the mud below is too low in oxygen.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakawan ay may natatanging mga ugat na tinatawag na pneumatophores na lumalabas sa ibabaw ng putik upang humiga ng oxygen mula sa hangin, dahil ang putik sa ilalim ay walang sapat na oxygen para sa mga ugat.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakawan adunay espesyal nga mga gamot nga gitawag pneumatophores nga nagsulibay sa ibabaw sa lapok aron mosuyop sa oxygen gikan sa hangin, tungod kay ang lapok sa ilawom naglangkob og gamay ra kaayo nga oxygen alang sa mga gamot.

q: How long can weathering and erosion take to fully change the shape of a mountain or valley?
options: Thousands of years
A few weeks
Several months
Only a few days after heavy rain
explanation: Weathering and erosion are usually very slow — it can take thousands of years to fully change the shape of a mountain or valley.
fact_tl: Ang weathering at erosion ay karaniwang napakabagal—maaaring umabot ng libu-libong taon bago lubusang mabago ang anyo ng bundok o lambak.
fact_bis: Ang weathering ug erosion kasagaran hinay kaayo—mahimong moabot og liboan ka tuig una gyud mabag-o ang porma sa bukid o walog.

q: How do mango flowers get pollinated?
options: Insects like bees and flies are attracted by sweet nectar and carry pollen from flower to flower
The wind blows pollen grains from one mango tree to the next
Rain splashes pollen from one flower to another on the same tree
The mango tree can pollinate itself without any outside help
explanation: Mango flowers have sweet nectar that attracts insects like bees and flies, which carry pollen from one flower to another.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulaklak ng mangga ay may matamis na nectar na umaakit sa mga insekto tulad ng bubuyog at langaw na nagdadala ng pollen mula sa isang bulaklak patungo sa isa pa.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulaklak sa mangga adunay tam-is nga nectar nga nagpaduol sa mga insekto sama sa putyukan ug langaw nga nagdala sa pollen gikan sa usa ka bulaklak ngadto sa lain.

q: How does eating too much salt affect your body?
options: It raises blood pressure by causing the body to retain more water
It thickens the blood so the heart has to pump harder to move it
It weakens the bones over time by replacing calcium in the skeleton
It slows down digestion and causes the stomach to produce less acid
explanation: Excess salt (sodium) raises blood pressure by increasing water retention in the body; reducing salt intake helps protect the heart and kidneys.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang asin (sodium) sa pagkain ay nagpapataas ng presyon ng dugo sapagkat nagpapahaba ng dami ng tubig sa katawan; ang pag-iwas sa napakaraming asin ay nakatutulong sa pagpapanatili ng malusog na presyon ng dugo.
fact_bis: Ang sobrang asin (sodium) sa pagkaon nagpataas sa presyon sa dugo pinaagi sa pagdugang sa pagpugngan sa tubig sa lawas; ang pagpababa sa pag-inom ug asin nagtabang sa pagpadayon sa maayong presyon sa dugo ug nagpanalipud sa puso ug mga kidney.

q: What is the male koel bird especially known for?
options: Its loud, repeated "ko-el" call heard especially in the morning
Its brightly colored feathers that attract females from far away
Its habit of building the largest nests of any bird in Asia
Its ability to mimic the calls of other birds perfectly
explanation: The male koel is known for its loud, repeated "ko-el" call, especially in the morning.
fact_tl: Kilala ang lalaking koel sa malakas at paulit-ulit nitong tawag na "ko-el" lalo na sa umaga.
fact_bis: Ang lalaking koel inila sa kusog ug balik-balik niini nga tawag nga "ko-el" ilabi na sa buntag.

q: Fog and smoke are examples of which type of mixture?
options: Aerosol colloids — tiny droplets or particles suspended in air
Solutions — substances dissolved completely and evenly in air
Suspensions — large heavy particles that quickly settle to the ground
Emulsions — two liquids that do not mix, one spread through the other
explanation: Fog and smoke are aerosol colloids: tiny water droplets or solid particles suspended in air that do not settle quickly.
fact_tl: Ang usok at ulap ay aerosol na colloid: maliliit na patak ng tubig o mga particle ng dumi na nakalutang sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang ambon ug aso mga aerosol colloid: gagmay nga patak sa tubig o solidong particle nga naglutaw sa hangin nga dili dali mahulog.

q: How is the Philippine sampaguita garland similar to a flower lei from other countries?
options: Both are necklaces made of flowers strung together
Both are made from the same type of tropical flower
Both are worn only by royalty at important ceremonies
Both are hung on walls as decorations, not worn on the body
explanation: The sampaguita garland is like a flower lei in that both are necklaces of flowers; the Philippine version uses small white sampaguita blooms.
fact_tl: Ang kwintas na sampaguita ay parang lei na ginagawa sa ibang bansa, na kwintas din ng bulaklak. Ang pagkakaiba, gumagamit ng maliliit na puting sampaguita ang Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang kwintas nga sampaguita sama sa lei nga gihimo sa ubang nasud, nga kwintas usab sa bulak. Ang kalainan, mogamit ang Pilipinas og gagmay nga puti nga sampaguita.

q: Why are root crops like kamote, gabi, ube, and cassava good sources of energy for your body?
options: They are rich in carbohydrates that give us energy
They are high in protein that builds and repairs muscles
They are packed with fats that keep organs warm and protected
They contain iron that helps red blood cells carry oxygen
explanation: Root crops like kamote, gabi, ube, and cassava are rich in carbohydrates, which are the body's main source of energy.
fact_tl: Ang mga halamang-ugat tulad ng kamote, gabi, ube, at cassava ay mayaman sa carbohydrates na nagbibigay sa atin ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nga ugat sama sa kamote, gabi, ube, ug cassava dato sa carbohydrates nga naghatag kanato og kusog.

q: If a parent gets a scar or a tattoo during their lifetime, will their child inherit it? Why or why not?
options: No — only the DNA in the egg and sperm passes to children, and a scar or tattoo does not change that DNA
Yes — any mark on the parent's body is recorded in their blood and passed on during pregnancy
No — children only inherit the parent's hair and eye color, never any skin changes
Yes — skin changes are always passed on because the skin cells divide and carry the change to offspring
explanation: Only the DNA in the egg and sperm passes to the next generation; scars and tattoos do not change that DNA, so children do not inherit them.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng nangyayari sa iyong katawan ay naipapasa sa anak. Ang DNA lang sa egg at sperm ang naipapasa sa susunod na henerasyon. Kaya kung magka-peklat o magpa-tattoo ka, hindi ito mamana ng anak mo—hindi nababago ang DNA sa egg o sperm.
fact_bis: Dili tanang mahitabo sa imong lawas mapasa sa imong anak. Ang DNA lang sa itlog ug sperm ang mapasa sa sunod nga henerasyon. Mao nga kon makaangkon kag peklat o magpa-tattoo, dili kini mapanunod sa imong anak—ang DNA sa itlog o sperm wala mausab niini.

q: About how long does a typical dog live?
options: 10 to 13 years
20 to 25 years
3 to 5 years
30 to 35 years
explanation: A dog typically lives about 10 to 13 years.
fact_tl: Ang isang aso ay karaniwang nabubuhay nang humigit-kumulang 10 hanggang 13 taon.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka iro kasagaran mabuhi og mga 10 ngadto 13 ka tuig.

q: Why is the Philippine eagle's population easy to threaten?
options: A pair usually raises only one chick every few years, so they reproduce very slowly
Eagles lay too many eggs but most crack before hatching due to thin shells
The chicks grow so slowly that they take 30 years to become adults
Pairs only mate once in their lifetime and never produce more than two chicks total
explanation: A Philippine eagle pair usually raises only one chick every few years, so their numbers are easily threatened because reproduction is very slow.
fact_tl: Ang mag-asawang Philippine eagle ay karaniwang nagpapalaki ng isang sisiw lamang kada ilang taon, kaya napakabagal nilang dumami at madaling manganib ang kanilang bilang.
fact_bis: Ang magtiayon nga Philippine eagle kasagaran nag-atiman lang og usa ka piso matag pipila ka tuig, mao nga hinay kaayo silang modaghan ug dali rang mameligro ang ilang gidaghanon.

q: Who proposed the modern atomic theory, which says that all matter is made of tiny atoms?
options: John Dalton
Isaac Newton
Antoine Lavoisier
Dmitri Mendeleev
explanation: John Dalton proposed the modern atomic theory, stating that all matter is made of tiny atoms.
fact_tl: Si John Dalton ang nagpasimuno ng modernong teoryang atomiko, na nagsabing ang lahat ng bagay ay gawa sa maliliit na atomo.
fact_bis: Si John Dalton ang nagsugod sa modernong teoriya sa atomo, nga nag-ingon nga ang tanang butang gilangkuban sa gagmay nga mga atomo.

q: What are the names of Jupiter's four biggest moons?
options: Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto
Titan, Enceladus, Rhea, and Dione
Phobos, Deimos, Triton, and Charon
Oberon, Titania, Umbriel, and Ariel
explanation: Jupiter's four biggest moons are Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto, known as the Galilean moons.
fact_tl: Ang apat na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter ay sina Io, Europa, Ganymede, at Callisto.
fact_bis: Ang upat ka pinakadako nga bulan sa Jupiter mao sila Io, Europa, Ganymede, ug Callisto.

q: Besides carbon dioxide, what else is released when fossil fuels are burned, and how does it affect people?
options: Smoke and tiny particles that dirty the air, causing smog and lung problems
Harmless steam and water vapor that cool the surrounding environment
Large amounts of pure oxygen that make air too rich for people to breathe
Nitrogen gas that builds up in cities and causes people to feel dizzy
explanation: Burning fossil fuels releases smoke and tiny particles that dirty the air, causing smog in cities and leading to lung and breathing problems.
fact_tl: Bukod sa carbon dioxide, ang pagsunog ng fossil fuel ay naglalabas ng usok at maliliit na particles na nakakasama sa hangin. Ito ang dahilan ng smog sa mga siyudad at maaaring magdulot ng problema sa baga at paghinga.
fact_bis: Gawas sa carbon dioxide, ang pagsunog sa fossil fuel nagbuga og aso ug gagmayng mga partikulo nga makahugaw sa hangin. Mao kini ang hinungdan sa smog sa mga siyudad ug mahimong hinungdan sa problema sa baga ug pagginhawa.

q: Why is unripe jackfruit sometimes used as a meat substitute in cooking?
options: Its flesh is chewy and fibrous, making it feel like meat when cooked
Its flesh turns bright red when heated, looking exactly like beef
Its juice contains protein that thickens and hardens just like cooked meat
Its seeds taste and smell identical to chicken when boiled
explanation: Jackfruit flesh is chewy and fibrous, so when unripe jackfruit is cooked it feels like meat and is used as a meat substitute.
fact_tl: Ang laman ng langka ay medyo makunat at may himaymay. Dahil dito, kapag iniluto ang hilaw nito, parang karne ang pakiramdam kaya ginagamit pangsubstitute sa karne.
fact_bis: Ang unod sa nangka medyo makunat ug adunay himaymay. Tungod niini, kung lutoon ang hilaw niini, mura og karne ang bati, busa ginagamit isip puli sa karne.

q: How does panting help cool an animal down?
options: Air flows over the wet tongue and mouth and evaporates moisture there, carrying heat out of the body
The rapid breathing pumps cool blood from the lungs to the rest of the body
Panting makes the heart beat faster and pumps heat out through the paws
The sound of panting sends a signal to the brain to stop producing heat
explanation: When an animal pants, air flows over the wet tongue and mouth and evaporates moisture there, carrying heat out of the body.
fact_tl: Kapag naghahangos ang hayop, dumadaloy ang hangin sa basang dila't bibig at sumisingaw ang tubig doon, na nag-aalis ng init sa katawan.
fact_bis: Kung manghol ang hayop, moagi ang hangin sa basa nga dila ug baba ug mosingaw ang tubig didto, nga magkuha sa kainit sa lawas.

q: Why are some mountains still getting taller today?
options: The tectonic plates beneath them are still moving and pushing them upward
Volcanic eruptions keep adding new rock layers on top of the mountains
Glaciers at the peak keep adding weight that stretches the mountain upward
Strong winds pile up soil and rock on mountain slopes each year
explanation: Some mountains are still rising a tiny bit each year because the tectonic plates beneath them are still moving.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bundok ay patuloy pa ring tumataas nang kaunti bawat taon dahil gumagalaw pa rin ang mga plato.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bukid padayon pa nga nagtaas og gamay matag tuig kay nagalihok pa ang mga plato.

q: How is the tamaraw different from a common water buffalo?
options: The tamaraw is smaller and has straighter horns, and it is found only on Mindoro
The tamaraw is larger and has curved horns, and it is found all over the Philippines
The tamaraw is the same size but has no horns at all, and lives only on Luzon
The tamaraw is a water animal that can breathe underwater, unlike the water buffalo
explanation: The tamaraw is smaller than the common water buffalo, has distinctively straighter horns, and is endemic only to the island of Mindoro.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ng Mindoro ay mas maliit kaysa karaniwang kalabaw at may mas matuwid na sungay na kakaiba nito; ito ay endemiko sa Mindoro.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw sa Mindoro mas gamay kaysa ordinaryong kalabaw ug adunay mas tuwid nga sungay nga espesyal niini; endemiko kini sa Mindoro.

q: Although the Philippines is tropical, when have frost and near-freezing conditions been recorded there?
options: At the highest peaks like Mount Pulag during strong amihan (northeast monsoon) season
At sea level in Metro Manila during December typhoons
Only in air-conditioned buildings, never naturally outdoors
At any mountain above 500 meters elevation every winter without exception
explanation: Although snow is not normal in the Philippines, frost and near-freezing conditions have been recorded at the highest peaks such as Mount Pulag during strong amihan.
fact_tl: Bagaman hindi karaniwan sa Pilipinas, may mga ulat ng icing at napaka-malamig na kondisyon sa pinakamataas na bahagi ng Mount Pulag at iba pang mataas na bundok sa panahon ng malakas na amihan.
fact_bis: Bisan kung ang niyebe dili normal sa Pilipinas, adunay mga rekord sa frost ug hapit-mamubo nga kondisyon sa pinakataas nga mga tumoy sa Mount Pulag ug ubang mga bundok sa panahon sa kusog nga amihan.

q: What do some bats do with their wings while hanging and sleeping?
options: They wrap their wings around their body like a cloak to stay warm and protected
They spread their wings wide open to catch any breeze and keep cool
