explanation: Charles Darwin was the British scientist who, after sailing the world and studying Galapagos animals, explained natural selection as the way living things change over time.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin ay isang siyentipikong British na, pagkatapos maglakbay sa buong mundo at mag-aral ng mga hayop sa Galapagos Islands, ang nagpaliwanag sa natural selection bilang paraan kung paano nagbabago ang mga buhay na bagay sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Si Charles Darwin usa ka British nga siyentista nga, human makapanaw sa tibuok kalibotan ug makatuon sa mga hayop sa Galapagos Islands, mipasabot sa natural selection isip paagi kung giunsa pag-usab sa mga buhi nga butang sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: Medicine factories use chromatography to check their products. What would it mean if an unexpected substance appeared in the chromatography result?
options: The medicine is extra strong and more effective than expected.
The medicine was mixed with a good preservative to keep it fresh.
Something is wrong — a substance is present that should not be there.
The medicine has been properly purified and is ready to be sold.
explanation: In medicine factories, if an extra substance shows up in chromatography, scientists know something is wrong with the medicine.
fact_tl: Sa mga pabrika ng gamot, ginagamit ang chromatography para suriin kung puro at ligtas ang gamot. Kung may makitang dagdag na sangkap na hindi dapat naroon, malalaman ng mga siyentipiko na may mali sa gamot.
fact_bis: Sa mga pabrika sa tambal, gigamit ang chromatography aron susihon kung putli ug luwas ang tambal. Kung naay makita nga dugang sangkap nga dili angay naa didto, mahibaw-an sa mga siyentista nga naay sayop sa tambal.

q: Why are tiny pieces of diamond placed on saws and drills used to cut through rock, metal, and glass?
options: Diamond conducts electricity very well, which powers the cutting blade.
Diamond reflects light strongly, which helps guide the cut in a straight line.
Diamond is the hardest known natural material, so it cuts through tough substances.
Diamond is very light in weight, so it does not slow down the spinning blade.
explanation: Because diamond is so hard, tiny diamond pieces are put on saws, drills, and grinders to cut through rock, metal, and glass.
fact_tl: Dahil napakatigas ng diamante, ginagamit ang maliliit na piraso nito sa mga saw, drill, at gilingan para maghiwa ng bato, metal, at salamin.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gahi kaayo ang diamante, ang gagmay nga piraso niini gibutang sa lagari, drill, ug galingan aron moputol sa bato, metal, ug salamin.

q: How do wings develop in insects that go through incomplete metamorphosis?
options: Wings grow fully formed inside a pupa before the adult emerges.
Wings appear suddenly in the adult stage after the last molt.
Wings grow little by little on the outside of the nymph's body with each molt.
Wings are carried folded inside the nymph's abdomen and unfurl at the last stage.
explanation: In incomplete metamorphosis, the nymph's wings grow little by little on the outside of its body with each molt.
fact_tl: Sa di-buong metamorphosis, ang pakpak ng nimpa ay unti-unting lumalaki sa labas ng katawan tuwing nagpapalit ito ng balat.
fact_bis: Sa dili kompletong metamorphosis, ang pako sa nympha hinay-hinay nga motubo sa gawas sa lawas niini matag ilis sa panit.

q: Why did the ancient Egyptians consider the dung beetle (scarab) to be sacred?
options: Because it ate harmful pests that destroyed their crops.
Because its rolling of a dung ball reminded them of the sun moving across the sky.
Because it was only found near the Nile River, which gave them life.
Because its hard shell was used to make jewelry for their pharaohs.
explanation: The ancient Egyptians called the dung beetle the 'scarab' and considered it sacred because its rolling of a ball reminded them of the sun moving across the sky.
fact_tl: Itinuturing na sagrado ng mga sinaunang taga-Ehipto ang dung beetle, na tinatawag nilang 'scarab', dahil ang paggulong nito ng bola ay inihalintulad nila sa paggalaw ng araw sa langit.
fact_bis: Giila nga balaan sa karaang mga taga-Ehipto ang dung beetle, nga ilang gitawag og 'scarab', tungod kay ang pagligid niini sa bola gipakasama nila sa paglihok sa adlaw sa langit.

q: What is happening to most galaxies relative to us right now?
options: Most galaxies are moving closer to us as gravity pulls them in.
Most galaxies are staying in fixed positions in space.
Most galaxies are orbiting around a central point in the universe.
Most galaxies are moving farther and farther away from us as the universe expands.
explanation: The universe is still expanding today, so most galaxies are moving farther and farther away from us.
fact_tl: Patuloy pa ring lumalawak ang uniberso ngayon, kaya ang karamihan sa mga galaksi ay palayo nang palayo sa atin.
fact_bis: Padayon gihapon nga naglapad ang uniberso karon, mao nga ang kadaghanan sa mga galaksi nagkalayo na gikan kanato.

q: Why do plumbers wrap hot water pipes with insulating material called lagging?
options: To prevent the pipes from vibrating and making noise when water flows.
To stop the pipes from expanding and bursting in hot weather.
To prevent heat from escaping the pipes, so hot water stays hot and energy is saved.
To protect the pipes from rust caused by moisture in the air.
explanation: Lagging or insulating hot water pipes prevents heat loss to the surroundings, saving energy and keeping water hot as it travels to the tap.
fact_tl: Ang lagging o insulation ng mga tubo ng mainit na tubig ay pumipigil sa pagkawala ng init sa kapaligiran — makatipid ito ng enerhiya at tumitiyak na makakarating ang mainit na tubig sa tap.
fact_bis: Ang lagging o insulation sa mga tubo sa mainit nga tubig nagpugong sa pagkawala sa init sa palibot — nakatipig og enerhiya ug nagasiguro nga ang mainit nga tubig nagpabilin nga mainit habang mobalhin sa gripo.

q: The Beaufort scale is used to measure wind strength. What are the lowest and highest numbers on the scale?
options: 0 (calm) to 10 (storm)
0 (calm) to 12 (hurricane force)
1 (light breeze) to 10 (violent storm)
1 (light breeze) to 15 (super typhoon)
explanation: The Beaufort scale runs from 0 (calm) to 12 (hurricane force).
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort scale ay mula 0 (kalmado) hanggang 12 (bagyo o hurricane).
fact_bis: Ang Beaufort scale gikan sa 0 (kalma) hangtod 12 (kusog sa bagyo).

q: Pufferfish can inflate their bodies to scare away predators. When does a pufferfish actually puff up?
options: Whenever it sees another fish nearby.
Only when it is truly in danger, because puffing up is tiring.
Every morning to warm up its body for the day.
Only at night when it is resting on the ocean floor.
explanation: Puffing up is tiring for the pufferfish, so it only does it when it is truly in danger.
fact_tl: Ang pamamaga ay nakakapagod sa butete kaya ginagawa lang nito ito kapag tunay na nasa panganib.
fact_bis: Ang paghubag makapagod sa butete maong buhaton lang niini kini kon tinuod nga anaa sa peligro.

q: When wood burns, it seems to almost disappear. According to the law of conservation of mass, what is true about the total mass of the products (ash, gases, smoke)?
options: The total mass of the products is less than the wood because some matter was destroyed.
The total mass of the products is more than the wood because heat adds mass.
The total mass of the products equals the original mass of the wood because no atoms are created or destroyed.
The total mass of the products cannot be measured because gases escape into the air.
explanation: By the law of conservation of mass, the total mass of reactants equals the total mass of products because no atoms are created or destroyed in a reaction.
fact_tl: Ayon sa batas ng konserbasyon ng masa, ang kabuuang masa ng mga reactant ay katumbas ng kabuuang masa ng mga product dahil walang atomong nalilikha o nawawala sa reaksyon.
fact_bis: Sumala sa balaod sa konserbasyon sa masa, ang kinatibuk-ang masa sa mga reactant managsama sa kinatibuk-ang masa sa mga product kay walay atomo nga nahimo o nawala sa reaksiyon.

q: Fossils of which ancient animals have been found in the Cagayan Valley in the Philippines?
options: Ancient dinosaurs and giant turtles
Ancient sharks and giant crocodiles
Ancient elephants and rhinoceroses
Ancient horses and giant sloths
explanation: In the Cagayan Valley in the Philippines, fossils of ancient elephants and rhinoceroses that lived there thousands of years ago have been found.
fact_tl: Sa Lambak ng Cagayan sa Pilipinas, may natagpuang mga fossil ng sinaunang elepante at rinoseronte na nabuhay dito libu-libong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Sa Cagayan Valley sa Pilipinas, may nakaplagan nga mga fossil sa karaang elepante ug rinoseronte nga nabuhi dinhi liboan ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: Venus is usually the brightest object in the night sky after the Moon. Why does Venus appear so bright?
options: Venus has its own light source — a glowing inner core — that shines through its thin atmosphere.
Venus is the planet closest to Earth, so its surface features reflect a lot of sunlight directly to us.
Thick clouds of sulphuric acid cover Venus and reflect so much sunlight that it appears very bright.
Venus has large flat oceans of liquid water that act as mirrors and bounce sunlight toward Earth.
explanation: Venus is covered by thick clouds of sulphuric acid that reflect so much sunlight that Venus is usually the brightest 'star' in the night sky after the Moon.
fact_tl: Ang Venus ay natatakpan ng makapal na mga ulap ng sulfuric acid na nasa taas na 45 hanggang 70 kilometro; ang mga ulap na ito ay nagpapasalamin ng maraming sikat ng Araw, kaya ang Venus ay karaniwang pinakamaliwanag na 'bituin' sa kalangitan ng gabi pagkatapos ng Buwan.
fact_bis: Ang Venus natakpan sa baga nga mga panganod sa sulfuric acid sa 45 hangtod 70 kilometro ang gitas-on; kining mga panganod nagpasalamin og daghang silaw sa adlaw busa ang Venus kasagaran ang pinaka-hayag nga 'bituin' sa gabiing langit pagkahuman sa Moon.

q: When water freezes into ice, the molecules arrange into a six-sided (hexagonal) pattern. What does this arrangement cause?
options: The molecules are packed closer together, so ice is denser and sinks in water.
The molecules are pushed far apart, so ice is lighter than liquid water and floats.
The molecules spin faster, which produces the coldness we feel when we touch ice.
The molecules bond so tightly that ice becomes impossible to break without heat.
explanation: When water freezes, molecules lock into an open hexagonal pattern that holds them farther apart, which is why ice is lighter than liquid water and floats.
fact_tl: Kapag nagyeyelo, magkakaayos ang mga molekula ng tubig sa isang bukas na hugis na may anim na panig (hexagonal), kaya mas magkakalayo sila at mas maluwag — ito ang dahilan kung bakit mas magaan ang yelo.
fact_bis: Kung mo-yelo, ang mga molekula sa tubig magpahimutang sa usa ka luag nga porma nga unom ang kilid (hexagonal) nga maghimo nila nga magkalayo — mao kini ang hinungdan nga mas gaan ang yelo.

q: The Sun heats Earth even though there is no air between them. Which method of heat transfer allows heat to travel without any medium?
options: Conduction
Convection
Radiation
Insulation
explanation: In radiation, heat travels as invisible rays even with no air to pass through, just like the Sun's heat reaches Earth across empty space.
fact_tl: Sa radiation, naglalakbay ang init bilang sinag kahit walang hanging dadaanan, gaya ng init ng araw na umaabot sa Lupa.
fact_bis: Sa radiation, ang kainit nagbiyahe isip silaw bisan walay hangin nga agianan, sama sa kainit sa adlaw nga moabot sa Yuta.

q: Bridges have special gaps called expansion joints built into them. What is the purpose of these joints?
options: To let workers access the inside of the bridge for repairs.
To allow water to drain off the bridge surface during heavy rain.
To let the metal expand and contract with temperature changes without cracking.
To absorb the vibrations caused by vehicles driving over the bridge.
explanation: Bridges have expansion joints that let the metal expand and contract without cracking as temperature changes.
fact_tl: Ang mga tulay ay may mga espesyal na hugpong (expansion joints) na nagbibigay-daan sa metal na lumawak o umurong nang hindi nababasag.
fact_bis: Ang mga taytayan adunay espesyal nga sumpay (expansion joints) nga magtugot sa metal molapad ug mokunhod nga dili mabuak.

q: Even though Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun, where can ice still exist on Mercury?
options: Near the equator, where tall mountains block the sun.
Deep inside craters at Mercury's poles where sunlight never reaches.
In underground caves protected by the rocky surface.
On Mercury's night side, which never rotates to face the Sun.
explanation: Even though Mercury is closest to the Sun, ice can hide deep inside craters at its poles where sunlight never reaches.
fact_tl: Kahit pinakamalapit ang Mercury sa Araw, may mga yelo pa ring natatago sa loob ng malalalim na crater sa mga polo nito kung saan hindi kailanman umaabot ang sikat ng Araw.
fact_bis: Bisan ang Mercury pinakaduol sa Adlaw, aduna gihapoy yelo nga natago sa sulod sa lawom nga mga crater sa mga polo niini diin dili gyud moabot ang silaw sa Adlaw.

q: During a thunderstorm you see the lightning before you hear the thunder. Why does this happen?
options: Thunder is formed after lightning strikes the ground, so it takes more time to start.
Light reaches us almost instantly while sound travels at only about 340 meters per second.
Lightning happens closer to you while thunder is produced far away in the clouds.
Sound is absorbed by raindrops and must wait until the rain stops to travel.
explanation: The flash of lightning reaches us almost instantly because light travels so fast, but the sound of thunder travels only about 340 meters each second.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng kidlat ay umaabot sa atin halos kaagad, ngunit ang tunog ng kulog ay naglalakbay lamang ng mga 340 metro bawat segundo.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag sa kilat moabot kanato halos diha-diha, apan ang tingog sa dalugdog mobiyahe lang og mga 340 metros matag segundo.

q: Why is iodine especially important for pregnant mothers?
options: Iodine strengthens the mother's bones so they do not break during childbirth.
The baby inside needs iodine to grow a healthy brain and body.
Iodine helps the mother produce enough milk after the baby is born.
Iodine protects the mother from infections during pregnancy.
explanation: Pregnant mothers really need iodine because the baby inside uses it to grow a healthy brain and body.
fact_tl: Kailangang-kailangan ng iodine ng mga buntis na nanay dahil ginagamit ito ng sanggol sa loob ng tiyan para lumaki nang maayos ang utak at katawan nito.
fact_bis: Gikinahanglan kaayo sa mga mabdos nga inahan ang iodine kay gamiton kini sa bata sa sulod sa tiyan aron motubo og himsog nga utok ug lawas.

q: The stapes is the smallest bone in the human body. Where is it located?
options: In the inner ear
In the middle part of the ear
In the outer ear canal
Behind the ear, connected to the skull
explanation: The stapes, the smallest bone in the body, is found in the middle part of the ear.
fact_tl: Ang stapes, ang pinakamaliit na buto, ay matatagpuan sa loob ng tainga sa gitnang bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang stapes, ang pinakagamay nga bukog, makita sa tunga nga bahin sa dalunggan.

q: Why are many kinds of Rafflesia in danger of disappearing?
options: They are over-collected by scientists who study their smell.
They are threatened by forest loss, so they are now protected.
They cannot survive because insects no longer pollinate them.
They are eaten by animals that are attracted to their large flowers.
explanation: Many kinds of Rafflesia are in danger of disappearing because of forest loss, so they are protected.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng Rafflesia ay nanganganib nang maubos dahil sa pagkawala ng kagubatan, kaya ito ay protektado.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa Rafflesia nameligro nga mahanaw tungod sa pagkawala sa lasang, busa kini gipanalipdan.

q: Where do many of the world's biggest rivers begin?
options: In large lakes in the middle of plains, where rainwater collects.
In the ocean, where saltwater turns into freshwater through evaporation.
In mountain ranges, where rain and melted ice flow downhill and join together.
Underground, in huge water reserves that slowly seep up through the soil.
explanation: Many big rivers begin in mountain ranges, where rain and melted ice flow downhill and join together, carrying fresh water to the lowlands.
fact_tl: Maraming malalaking ilog ang nagmumula sa mga mountain range. Ang ulan at natunaw na yelo sa matataas na bahagi ay umaagos pababa, nagsasama-sama, at nagiging mga ilog na nagdadala ng tubig sa mga patag at lungsod. Kaya tinatawag na watershed ang ganitong lugar — parang malaking imbakan ng tubig-tabang.
fact_bis: Daghang dagkong suba magsugod sa mountain range. Ang ulan ug natunaw nga yelo sa habog nga bahin moagas paubos, mag-usa, ug mahimong suba nga magdala og tubig ngadto sa kapatagan ug siyudad. Mao nga tawgon kini nga watershed — sama sa dakong tipiganan sa tab-ang nga tubig.

q: What happened when microscope lenses improved in the 1600s?
options: Scientists were able to map the night sky and discover new planets.
Scientists discovered a hidden world of tiny living things like bacteria and yeasts.
Scientists learned how the human heart pumps blood around the body.
Scientists were able to see atoms for the first time and study the elements.
explanation: When microscope lenses improved in the 1600s, scientists discovered a whole new world of tiny living things such as bacteria and yeasts.
fact_tl: Nang mapabuti ang mga lente ng mikroskopyo noong 1600s, natuklasan ng mga siyentipiko ang isang bagong mundo ng maliliit na nabubuhay tulad ng bakterya at lebadura.
fact_bis: Sa dihang napaayo ang mga lente sa mikroskopyo niadtong 1600s, nadiskobrehan sa mga siyentista ang usa ka bag-ong kalibutan sa gagmay nga buhi sama sa bakterya ug lebadura.

q: The word 'escalator' was originally a brand name first shown to the public in 1900. What is an escalator?
options: A type of elevator that moves people between floors in a vertical shaft.
A set of moving stairs that carries people up or down continuously.
A moving walkway that transports people horizontally in airports.
A mechanical crane used to lift heavy loads in construction.
explanation: An escalator is a set of moving stairs, and the word 'escalator' was originally a brand name first shown to the public in 1900.
fact_tl: Ang escalator ay hagdang gumagalaw; ang salitang 'escalator' ay orihinal na isang brand name na unang ipinakita sa publiko noong 1900.
fact_bis: Ang escalator usa ka hagdanan nga molihok; ang pulong 'escalator' orihinal nga usa ka brand name nga unang gipakita sa publiko niadtong 1900.

q: What is the first thing you should do when you get a fresh wound?
options: Apply cotton with alcohol directly to kill all germs immediately.
Cover the wound with a bandage right away so dirt cannot enter.
Rinse the wound with clean water and mild soap to remove dirt and germs.
Leave the wound open to air so it dries out and heals faster.
explanation: The first thing to do with a fresh wound is to rinse it with clean water and mild soap to remove dirt and germs so it does not get infected.
fact_tl: Ang unang gawin sa sariwang sugat ay hugasan ito ng malinis na tubig at banayad na sabon. Inaalis nito ang dumi at germs para hindi mahawa at mas mabilis gumaling.
fact_bis: Ang unang buhaton sa bag-ong samad mao ang paghugas niini og limpyo nga tubig ug malumo nga sabon. Makuha niini ang hugaw ug germs aron dili mataptan ug mas paspas mo-ayo.

q: Why do older people, like grandparents, need to be extra careful about falls?
options: Their eyesight improves with age, so they misjudge distances.
Their balance can weaken as they grow older, increasing the risk of falling.
Their bones become softer with age, so they fall more often than young people.
Their muscles grow stronger with age, which makes them move too fast and lose control.
explanation: As people grow older, their balance can weaken, so grandparents need to be careful not to fall.
fact_tl: Habang tumatanda ang tao, maaaring humina ang kanilang balanse, kaya dapat mag-ingat ang mga lolo at lola para hindi madapa.
fact_bis: Samtang motigulang ang tawo, mahimong moluya ang ilang balanse, mao nga kinahanglan mag-amping ang mga lolo ug lola aron dili matumba.

q: Transpiration is a process that happens in plants. How is it similar to sweating in humans?
options: Like sweating, it produces heat that helps the plant stay warm.
Like sweating, it releases water — in the plant's case, through its leaves.
Like sweating, it removes waste products that build up inside the plant.
Like sweating, it helps the plant absorb salt from the soil.
explanation: Transpiration is like a plant sweating because it releases water through its leaves.
fact_tl: Ang transpirasyon ay parang pagpawis ng halaman, dahil naglalabas ito ng tubig sa mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang transpiration sama sa paghingot sa tanom, kay nagpagawas kini og tubig pinaagi sa mga dahon.

q: What is the danger of plugging too many appliances into one outlet or extension cord?
options: The electricity in the outlet becomes too weak and all appliances stop working.
The wire overheats and can start a fire.
The appliances start working too fast and break down sooner.
The outlet sends too little current, which can damage the plugged-in devices.
explanation: When too many appliances are plugged into one outlet, the wire overheats and can start a fire.
fact_tl: Kapag napakaraming gamit ang nakasaksak sa iisang outlet o extension (parang octopus na sangang-sanga), nag-iinit ang wire at pwedeng magdulot ng sunog. Hatiin ang mga gamit sa iba't ibang saksakan.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ka daghan nga gamit ang nakaplug sa usa ka outlet o extension (sama sa octopus nga sanga-sanga), mag-init ang wire ug mahimong hinungdan sa sunog. Bahina ang imong mga gamit sa lain-laing saksakan.

q: How does a volcanic mountain grow bigger over time?
options: Wind and rain deposit rocks around the volcano's base, building it up slowly.
Lava from each eruption hardens in a new layer, adding to the mountain layer by layer.
The ground below pushes upward during earthquakes, raising the mountain each time.
Ash from nearby volcanoes settles on the slopes and hardens into new rock layers.
explanation: A volcanic mountain grows layer by layer each time magma rises and erupts as lava that then hardens.
fact_tl: Ang bulkang bundok ay lumalaki nang patong-patong tuwing umaakyat ang magma at sumasabog bilang lava na pagkatapos ay tumitigas.
fact_bis: Ang bulkang bukid motubo og patong-patong matag higayon nga ang magma mosaka ug mobuto isip lava nga unya motig-a.

q: Why is a small amount of chlorine added to drinking water?
options: It makes the water taste better and removes its smell.
It kills bacteria in the water, making it safe to drink.
It hardens the water so that pipes do not corrode.
It removes heavy metals like lead that can poison the water.
explanation: Adding a small amount of chlorine to water kills bacteria, so it is used to make drinking water safe.
fact_tl: Ang paglagay ng kaunting chlorine sa tubig ay pumapatay sa mga bakterya, kaya ginagamit ito para gawing ligtas ang inuming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagbutang ug gamay nga chlorine sa tubig makapatay sa mga bakterya, busa gigamit kini aron mahimong luwas ang imnonon nga tubig.

q: What is the main advantage of a circuit breaker over a fuse when protecting an electrical circuit?
options: A circuit breaker allows more current to flow without any danger.
A circuit breaker can be reset after it trips, while a fuse must be replaced.
A circuit breaker is much cheaper and easier to install than a fuse.
A circuit breaker trips only when sparks are detected, unlike a fuse.
explanation: A circuit breaker can be reset after it automatically opens due to too much current, while a fuse must be replaced once it burns out.
fact_tl: Ang circuit breaker ay parang switch na kusang bumubukas kapag sobra ang current, at maaari itong ibalik o i-reset pagkatapos, hindi tulad ng fuse na kailangang palitan.
fact_bis: Ang circuit breaker sama sa switch nga awtomatikong moabli kung sobra ang current, ug mahimo kining i-reset human, dili sama sa fuse nga kinahanglang ilisan.

q: What do the wings of a lacewing look like?
options: Thick, brightly colored wings with bold patterns to scare away predators.
Thin, net-like wings that are green in color.
Long, narrow wings covered in tiny scales like a butterfly.
Tough, shield-like wings that fold flat over the insect's back.
explanation: A lacewing has thin, net-like wings that are green in color.
fact_tl: Ang lacewing ay may manipis at parang lambat na pakpak na berde ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang lacewing adunay nipis ug daw pukot nga mga pako nga lunhaw og kolor.

q: The gallbladder is a small sac found near the liver. What does it store?
options: Digestive enzymes that break down proteins in the stomach
Bile produced by the liver
Insulin produced by the pancreas
Acid needed to help dissolve food in the stomach
explanation: The gallbladder is a small sac that stores bile made by the liver.
fact_tl: Ang apdo (gallbladder) ay maliit na sisidlan na nag-iimbak ng bile na galing sa atay.
fact_bis: Ang gallbladder usa ka gamay nga sudlanan nga nagtipig sa apdo nga gihimo sa atay.

q: Both oil and ice float on water. What is the reason that ICE floats on water?
options: Ice is a solid, and all solids are lighter than water.
Ice expanded when it froze, making it less dense and lighter than liquid water.
Ice traps air bubbles inside that make it rise to the surface.
Ice is naturally slippery, so it slides up through water instead of sinking.
explanation: Ice floats because frozen water expanded into an open hexagonal pattern, making it lighter (less dense) than liquid water.
fact_tl: Parehong lumulutang ang langis at yelo sa tubig dahil parehong mas magaan sila kaysa tubig. Pero iba ang dahilan: ang yelo ay tubig na nagyelo at lumuwag, samantalang ang langis ay isa nang magaang sangkap mula pa sa simula.
fact_bis: Parehong naglutaw ang lana ug yelo sa tubig kay parehong mas gaan sila kaysa tubig. Apan lahi ang rason: ang yelo kay tubig nga nagyelo ug miluag, samtang ang lana usa na ka gaan nga sustansya gikan pa sa sinugdan.

q: Scientists spend a lot of money and effort exploring space. Which of these is a reason people explore space?
options: To mine gold from asteroids and bring it back to sell on Earth.
To learn about other planets, how stars formed, and look for life beyond Earth.
To escape pollution on Earth and build cities on other planets right now.
To test how fast rockets can travel before building passenger spacecraft.
explanation: People explore space to learn about other planets, find out how stars began, and look for places where there might be life beyond Earth.
fact_tl: Ginagalugad ng mga tao ang kalawakan para matuto tungkol sa ibang planeta, para malaman kung paano nagsimula ang mga bituin, at para tingnan kung may iba pang lugar na maaaring magkaroon ng buhay.
fact_bis: Ang mga tawo nagsusi sa kawanangan aron magkat-on bahin sa ubang planeta, aron mahibaw-an kon giunsa pagsugod sa mga bituon, ug aron pangitaon kon aduna pay ubang dapit nga adunay kinabuhi.

q: You can hold a rock in your hand and it takes up space in your palm. A plastic bag also takes up space. What do all materials — natural or human-made — have in common?
options: They are all made of living cells that can grow and change.
They are all made of matter, meaning they have weight and take up space.
They all come from plants or animals found in nature.
They all conduct electricity when connected to a power source.
explanation: All materials, whether natural or synthetic, are made of matter — meaning they have weight and take up space.
fact_tl: Lahat ng materyales, natural man o synthetic, ay gawa sa matter — ibig sabihin, may bigat ang mga ito at sumasakop ng espasyo.
fact_bis: Ang tanan nga materyales, natural man o synthetic, hinimo sa matter — buot ipasabot, adunay timbang kini ug nagsakop og espasyo.

q: Saliva begins breaking down starch in your mouth. What stops saliva's digestive enzyme (amylase) from continuing to work when food reaches the stomach?
options: The food mixes with water in the stomach, which dilutes and deactivates amylase.
The strong stomach acid stops the amylase from working.
The stomach squeezes the food so hard that amylase molecules are crushed.
Amylase finishes its job completely in the mouth and is no longer needed.
explanation: Once food reaches the stomach, the strong stomach acid stops saliva's amylase from working, and other enzymes continue the digestion there.
fact_tl: Nagsisimula ang laway na hatiin ang starch sa bibig, pero kapag nakarating na ang pagkain sa tiyan, pinapatigil ng malakas na asido sa tiyan ang trabaho ng amylase. Ibang enzyme naman ang tumutuloy doon.
fact_bis: Ang laway magsugod pagbungkag sa starch sa baba, apan kung makaabot na ang pagkaon sa tiyan, ang kusog nga asido sa tiyan magpahunong sa amylase. Lahi nga enzyme na ang mopadayon didto.

q: The dead leaf butterfly has an amazing way to hide from birds. What does it look like when it folds its wings?
options: It looks like a brightly colored flower petal to attract helpful insects.
It looks like tree bark, blending into the trunk where it rests.
It looks just like a dry, brown leaf complete with what seem like leaf veins.
It looks like a small stone on the forest floor, perfectly round and gray.
explanation: When the dead leaf butterfly folds its wings, it looks just like a dry leaf — brown with what seem like leaf veins — so birds cannot spot it.
fact_tl: Kapag nakatupi ang pakpak ng dead leaf butterfly, kamukha ito ng isang tuyong dahon — may kulay-kayumanggi at parang ugat ng dahon — kaya hindi ito mapansin ng mga ibon.
fact_bis: Kung pilo na ang pako sa dead leaf butterfly, mura kini og uga nga dahon — kolor-kapehon ug daw adunay ugat sa dahon — mao nga dili kini makita sa mga langgam.

q: Rubber trees produce a sticky white liquid called latex. Why does the tree actually make latex?
options: The tree makes latex as a food source stored inside its trunk for dry seasons.
The tree makes latex as its own defense — it oozes out to seal wounds and drive away pests.
The tree makes latex to attract pollinators, since its flowers have no scent.
The tree makes latex to absorb water from the air during dry weather.
explanation: Latex is the tree's own defense against insects and disease — when the tree is wounded, sticky latex oozes out to seal the cut and drive away pests.
fact_tl: Hindi talaga ginawa ng puno ang latex para sa atin. Ito ay panangga nito laban sa mga insekto at sakit. Kapag nasugatan ang puno, lumalabas ang malagkit na latex para takpan ang sugat at takutin ang mga peste.
fact_bis: Wala gyud gihimo sa kahoy ang latex para kanato. Kini iyang panalipod batok sa mga insekto ug sakit. Kung masamdan ang kahoy, mogawas ang pilit nga latex aron tabunan ang samad ug papahawaon ang mga peste.

q: Cork is used in wine bottles and floats in water. What is the approximate density of cork?
options: About 0.02 g/cm³
About 0.24 g/cm³
About 0.75 g/cm³
About 1.5 g/cm³
explanation: The density of cork is about 0.24 grams per cubic centimeter (0.24 g/cm³), which is why it floats easily on water.
fact_tl: Ang densidad ng kotso (cork) ay mga 0.24 gramo bawat sentimetrong kubiko (0.24 g/cm³).
fact_bis: Ang density sa cork (tapon) kay mga 0.24 gramo matag kubikong sentimetro (0.24 g/cm³).

q: A dragonfly (tutubi) is a skilled hunter. What is special about how it sometimes eats its prey?
options: It carries prey to a leaf and waits for it to stop moving before eating.
It eats the insect it caught while still flying in the air.
It stores prey in a pouch near its mouth and eats later when it lands.
It chews prey underwater, where it is safe from other predators.
explanation: Sometimes a dragonfly eats the insect it caught while it is still flying in the air.
fact_tl: Minsan ay kinakain ng tutubi ang nahuli nitong insekto habang lumilipad pa ito sa hangin.
fact_bis: Usahay ang alindahaw mokaon sa nadakpan niini nga insekto samtang nagalupad pa kini sa hangin.

q: If you drop a flat sheet of paper and a sheet crumpled into a ball from the same height, which falls faster and why?
options: The flat sheet falls faster because it is lighter and catches less air.
The crumpled ball falls faster because it has less surface area facing the air, so drag is smaller.
Both fall at exactly the same speed because they weigh the same.
The crumpled ball falls slower because its rough surface creates more friction with the air.
explanation: Air resistance (drag) is greater when an object has a wider front facing the air, so the crumpled ball — with a smaller frontal area — falls faster than the flat sheet.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang air resistance kapag mas malapad ang harapan ng bagay na gumagalaw. Kaya mas mabagal mahulog ang nakabukang papel kaysa sa pinilipit na bola ng papel.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang air resistance kung mas lapad ang atubangan sa butang nga molihok. Mao nga mas hinay mahulog ang nakabukhad nga papel kaysa sa kinumos nga bola sa papel.

q: What problem can untreated grey water from laundry and bathing cause to rivers?
options: It can change the river's pH and harm the creatures living in it
It makes the water freeze faster in cold weather
It adds too much oxygen and causes fish to grow bigger
It makes river water evaporate more quickly in sunlight
explanation: Grey water contains soap, detergent, and dirt that can alter a river's pH and harm aquatic organisms, especially near densely populated areas.
fact_tl: Ang grey water mula sa paglalaba at paliligo ay naglalaman ng soap, detergent, at dumi — ang untreated na grey water ay maaaring magpabago ng pH ng mga ilog at makasama sa mga organismo sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang grey water gikan sa paglabanda ug paligo nagdala og sabon, detergent, ug dumi; ang untreated na grey water mahimong magbag-o sa pH sa mga ilog ug makapasakit sa mga organismo sa tubig, labi na sa mga densong gipuy-an nga mga lugar.

q: Why does a tuna's body shape help it swim so fast?
options: Its smooth, torpedo-shaped body lets it slice easily through the water
Its flat, wide body creates more push against the water
Its round, puffer-shaped body traps air to float quickly
Its rough, scale-covered body grips the water like a paddle
explanation: A tuna's smooth, torpedo-shaped body is built to slice through water, allowing it to swim at high speed.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng tuna ay hugis-torpedo o makinis upang madali itong makahati sa tubig habang lumalangoy.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa tuna porma og torpedo ug hamis aron dali nga makalusot sa tubig samtang naglanguy.

q: How many hydrogen atoms are in one molecule of ammonia (NH₃)?
options: Three
One
Four
Two
explanation: The chemical formula NH₃ shows that one molecule of ammonia contains three hydrogen atoms.
fact_tl: Sa isang molekula ng ammonia (NH3), may tatlong (3) atomo ng hydrogen.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka molekula sa ammonia (NH3), adunay tulo (3) ka atomo sa hydrogen.

q: What makes the cone inside a speaker vibrate and produce sound?
options: Electric current and a magnet push and pull the cone back and forth
Compressed air forces the cone to move in and out
A spinning motor directly hits the cone to create vibrations
Heat from the wire causes the cone to expand and contract
explanation: Inside a speaker, electric current interacts with a magnet to push and pull a cone, making it vibrate and produce sound.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng speaker, ang dumadaloy na kuryente at magnet ay nagtutulak-hila sa isang cone para manginig ito at lumikha ng tunog.
fact_bis: Sulod sa speaker, ang nagdagayday nga kuryente ug ang magnet moduso-bira sa usa ka cone aron mokurog kini ug mohimo og tingog.

q: Which disease was the first to be completely wiped out worldwide by vaccines?
options: Smallpox
Polio
Measles
Malaria
explanation: Smallpox was declared completely eradicated in 1980, making it the first disease ever wiped out worldwide through vaccination.
fact_tl: Ang smallpox (bulutong) ang unang sakit na ganap na naubos sa mundo dahil sa bakuna, idineklara noong 1980.
fact_bis: Ang smallpox (bulutong) maoy unang sakit nga hingpit nga nawala sa kalibotan tungod sa bakuna, gideklara niadtong 1980.

q: What fuel do many Filipino families traditionally use for cooking?
options: Wood or charcoal in a stove
Natural gas piped into the home
Electricity in a microwave oven
Kerosene in a pressure cooker
explanation: Many Filipino families cook using wood or charcoal in a stove, a common traditional practice across the country.
fact_tl: Maraming pamilyang Pilipino ang nagluluto gamit ang kahoy o uling sa kalan.
fact_bis: Daghang pamilyang Pilipino ang nagluto sa ilang pagkaon gamit ang kahoy o uling sa abohan.

q: Why does stirring mix a dye in water much faster than just leaving it alone?
options: Diffusion alone is very slow, so stirring speeds up the mixing process
Stirring heats the water so the dye melts into it instantly
Stirring breaks the dye into smaller molecules that spread better
Diffusion pushes dye upward while stirring spreads it sideways
explanation: Diffusion by itself is slow, so stirring physically moves the dye through the water much faster than diffusion alone can.
fact_tl: Ang diffusion lamang ay mabagal, kaya kapag hinalo natin ang tubig, mas mabilis na kumakalat ang tina kaysa sa diffusion lang.
fact_bis: Ang diffusion lang hinay, mao nga kon kutawon nato ang tubig, mas paspas mosagol ang tina kaysa sa diffusion lamang.

q: What does the sun on the Philippine flag represent?
options: Freedom and the unity of the Filipino people
The eight hours of sunlight each day in the Philippines
The burning spirit of Filipino soldiers in battle
The heat that powers the country's farms and fisheries
explanation: The sun on the Philippine flag is a symbol of freedom and the unity of the Filipino people.
fact_tl: Ang araw sa bandila ay simbolo ng kalayaan at pagkakaisa ng mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang adlaw sa bandera maoy simbolo sa kagawasan ug panaghiusa sa mga Pilipino.

q: Why is plastic floating in the ocean dangerous for sea turtles?
options: A sea turtle may mistake floating plastic for a jellyfish and eat it
Plastic blocks sunlight so turtles cannot see where they are swimming
Plastic releases chemicals that make the water too cold for turtles
Sea turtles get tangled in plastic only when it sinks to the ocean floor
explanation: Sea turtles can mistake floating plastic bags for jellyfish — one of their foods — and eat the plastic, which can seriously harm or kill them.
fact_tl: Mapanganib ang plastik sa dagat dahil minsang naaakalang dikya ng pawikan ang lumulutang na plastik at nakakain ito.
fact_bis: Delikado ang plastik sa dagat kay usahay masaypan sa pawikan nga dikya ang naglutaw nga plastik ug makaon kini.

q: What is tension in a rope during a tug-of-war?
options: A pulling force that runs along the rope when it is stretched tight at both ends
A pushing force that squeezes the rope from both sides
A twisting force that causes the rope to spin in the middle
A bending force that makes the rope curve when pulled hard
explanation: Tension is the pulling force that travels along a rope or cable when both ends are being pulled in opposite directions, as in tug-of-war.
fact_tl: Ang tension ay ang humihilang puwersang dumadaloy sa isang lubid o kable kapag ito ay binabanat sa magkabilang dulo, gaya sa laro ng tug-of-war.
fact_bis: Ang tension mao ang nagbira nga kusog nga moagi sa usa ka pisi o kable kon kini hugton sa duha ka tumoy, sama sa dula nga tug-of-war.

q: What is the small white half-moon shape you can see near the bottom of your fingernail called?
options: The lunula
The cuticle
The nail plate
The nail bed
explanation: The small white half-moon shape near the bottom of a fingernail is called the lunula, and it is one of the visible parts of a healthy nail.
fact_tl: Ang kuko ay may iba't ibang bahagi: ang matigas na plato na nakikita mo, ang balat sa gilid na tinatawag na cuticle na nagpoprotekta dito, at ang maliit na puting hugis-buwan sa ibaba na tinatawag na lunula. Lahat ng ito ay bahagi ng isang malusog na kuko.
fact_bis: Ang kuko adunay lain-laing bahin: ang gahi nga plato nga imong makita, ang panit sa kilid nga gitawag og cuticle nga manalipod niini, ug ang gamay nga puti nga porma-bulan sa ubos nga gitawag og lunula. Tanan kini bahin sa usa ka himsog nga kuko.

q: Approximately how tall is Mayon Volcano in the Philippines?
options: About 2,462 meters
About 1,200 meters
About 3,800 meters
About 800 meters
explanation: Mayon Volcano stands about 2,462 meters tall, making it the Philippines' most famous active volcano.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon ay may taas na humigit-kumulang 2,462 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkan Mayon mga 2,462 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: What were the very first words ever recorded on Thomas Edison's phonograph in 1877?
options: 'Mary had a little lamb'
'Hello, world, can you hear me?'
'Four score and seven years ago'
'To be or not to be'
explanation: The very first words ever recorded on Edison's phonograph in 1877 were the nursery rhyme 'Mary had a little lamb.'
fact_tl: Ang kauna-unahang naitalang salita sa phonograph ni Edison ay 'Mary had a little lamb' noong 1877.
fact_bis: Ang pinakaunang mga pulong nga narekord sa phonograph ni Edison mao ang 'Mary had a little lamb' niadtong 1877.

q: What unit is used to measure the electricity produced by a hydroelectric power plant?
options: Kilowatt-hours
Newtons
Degrees Celsius
Liters per second
explanation: Electricity from a hydroelectric plant — like all electrical energy — is measured in kilowatt-hours, the same unit shown on a home electric meter.
fact_tl: Ang kuryenteng nagagawa ng isang hydro plant ay sinusukat sa kilowatt-hour, na siya ring yunit na lumalabas sa metro ng kuryente sa inyong bahay.
fact_bis: Ang kuryente nga mahimo sa usa ka hydro plant gisukod sa kilowatt-hour, ang samang yunit nga makita sa metro sa kuryente sa inyong balay.

q: Why does a stalactite slowly grow in a cave?
options: When a water drop reaches cave air, its carbon dioxide escapes and the mineral is left behind as calcite
When water freezes on the cave ceiling, it pulls minerals out of the rock above it
When underground rivers dry up, their mineral-rich mud hardens into stalactites
When sunlight enters the cave, it causes dissolved minerals to crystallize on the ceiling
explanation: As a water drop reaches the cave air, its carbon dioxide escapes, preventing the water from holding dissolved minerals, so calcite is deposited layer by layer to form a stalactite.
fact_tl: Pagdating ng patak sa hangin ng kweba, kumakalat palabas ang carbon dioxide nito, kaya hindi na kayang hawakan ng tubig ang mineral at naiiwan ito bilang manipis na calcite — ganito unti-unting lumalaki ang stalactite.
fact_bis: Pag-abot sa tulo sa hangin sa langob, mokalagiw ang carbon dioxide niini, mao nga dili na kaya sa tubig nga huptan ang mineral ug mabilin kini isip nipis nga calcite — mao kini ang hinay nga pagtubo sa stalactite.

q: Why do we feel thirsty faster on a hot day or after playing hard?
options: Our body loses water through sweat, so we feel thirsty sooner
Our stomach shrinks in the heat, so it holds less water than usual
Playing makes our heart beat faster, which uses up water directly
Hot weather causes our kidneys to remove extra water from the blood
explanation: On hot days or during physical activity, we sweat more and lose body water faster, which triggers thirst sooner.
fact_tl: Mas madali tayong mauhaw kapag nawalan ng tubig ang katawan dahil sa pawis tuwing mainit o naglalaro.
fact_bis: Mas paspas kita mauhaw kung nawad-an ug tubig ang lawas pinaagi sa singot kung init o nagdula.

q: Why should you never look straight at the sun, even for just a moment?
options: The sun is so bright it can damage your eyes even before it hurts
The sun's heat will immediately cause a fever if you look at it
Ordinary sunglasses fully protect your eyes so you can look safely
Looking at the sun only harms your eyes during a solar eclipse
explanation: The sun is so intensely bright that it can damage your eyes almost instantly, even before you feel any pain, and ordinary sunglasses do not provide enough protection.
fact_tl: Hindi dapat tinitsignan nang diretso ang araw kahit sandali lang, dahil napakaliwanag nito at puwedeng makasira ng iyong mga mata kahit hindi ka masaktan agad. Walang ordinaryong salamin sa mata ang sapat na proteksyon. Kapag may eclipse, kailangan ng espesyal na proteksyon para tumingin.
fact_bis: Dili gyud nimo angay tan-awon ang adlaw nga diretso bisan kadiyot lang, kay hayag kaayo kini ug makadaot sa imong mga mata bisan dili dayon kini sakit. Ang ordinaryong salamin sa mata dili igo nga panalipod. Panahon sa eclipse, kinahanglan nimo og espesyal nga panalipod aron makatan-aw.

q: How many stomach chambers does a goat have to help it digest tough grass?
options: Four chambers
Two chambers
One chamber
Three chambers
explanation: A goat has four stomach chambers that work together to break down tough plant material like grass.
fact_tl: Ang sikmura ng kambing ay may apat na bahagi na tumutulong itunaw ang matitigas na damo.
fact_bis: Ang sikmura sa kanding adunay upat ka bahin nga makatabang sa pagtunaw sa gahi nga sagbot.

q: How do some small desert animals survive without drinking much water?
options: They get water from the seeds and plants they eat
They store water in a special pouch under their skin
They absorb morning dew through tiny pores in their feet
They dig underground to find hidden rivers below the sand
explanation: Some small desert animals can survive with very little water by getting the moisture they need from the seeds and plants in their diet.
fact_tl: Ilang maliliit na hayop sa disyerto ay halos hindi umiinom dahil nakukuha nila ang tubig sa kinakain nilang buto at halaman.
fact_bis: Pipila ka gagmay nga mananap sa desyerto halos dili muinom kay makakuha sila ug tubig gikan sa liso ug tanom nga ilang gikaon.

q: How does coating iron with zinc help protect it, as seen in galvanized roofing?
options: The zinc coating keeps the iron from coming into contact with air and water so it does not rust
The zinc makes the iron stronger so it does not crack in heavy rain
The zinc reflects sunlight away from the roof so the iron stays cool
The zinc makes the iron surface slippery so rainwater slides off quickly
explanation: Galvanizing iron by coating it with zinc prevents rusting by shielding the iron surface from air and moisture.
fact_tl: Ang pagbalot ng bakal ng zinc, gaya sa yerong galvanized, ay pumipigil sa kalawang.
fact_bis: Ang paghaklap ug zinc sa puthaw, sama sa galbanisadong yero, makapugong sa kalawang.

q: Where does cotton fabric come from?
options: It is a natural fiber that comes from a plant
It is a synthetic fiber made from melted plastic pellets
It is an animal fiber spun from silkworm cocoons
It is a mineral fiber dug out of the ground and woven into cloth
explanation: Cotton is a natural fiber harvested from a cotton plant; it is then woven into soft cloth that absorbs sweat.
fact_tl: Ang bulak (cotton) ay natural na hibla na galing sa halaman. Hinahabi ito para gawing tela at damit na malambot at nakakasipsip ng pawis.
fact_bis: Ang gapas (cotton) usa ka natural nga hibla nga gikan sa tanom. Gihabi kini aron mahimong panapton ug sinina nga humok ug mosuyop sa singot.

q: What is special about when moths are active?
options: They are nocturnal, meaning they are most active at night and are often attracted to light
They are active only at dawn and rest for the rest of the day
They sleep at night and search for flowers during daylight hours
They are active only during the rainy season and hide in dry weather
explanation: Moths are nocturnal insects that are most active at night and are well known for flying toward sources of light.
fact_tl: Ang mga gamu-gamo ay nokturnal na insekto na madalas na naaakit sa ilaw kapag gabi.
fact_bis: Ang mga anunugba mao ang nokturnal nga insekto nga sagad madani sa kahayag kon gabii.

q: What happens to a sound as it travels farther away from where it was made?
options: It gets weaker and quieter the farther it travels from its source
It gets louder and louder as it bounces off the air around it
It stays exactly the same volume until it hits a solid wall
It gets higher in pitch but stays the same volume as it travels
explanation: Sound spreads out as it travels, so the farther it gets from its source, the weaker and quieter it becomes.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay humihina habang lumalayo ito sa pinagmulan nito.
fact_bis: Ang tingog magkahinay samtang magkalayo kini gikan sa gigikanan niini.

q: Why does hot air rise?
options: Heating causes air to expand and become lighter, so it floats upward
Hot air contains more water vapor which is heavier and pushes cooler air up
Heated air molecules stick together and form a bubble that floats like a balloon
Hot air is attracted to cold air above, so it moves upward to mix with it
explanation: When air is heated it expands, becomes less dense (lighter) than the surrounding cooler air, and therefore rises.
fact_tl: Kapag uminit ang hangin, lumalawak ito at gumagaan, kaya tumataas o pumapaitaas ang mainit na hangin.
fact_bis: Kung moinit ang hangin, kini molapad ug mogaan, mao nga ang init nga hangin mosaka.

q: Why is aluminum a popular material for making cooking pans and cans?
options: It is a lightweight metal that conducts heat very well
It is a heavy metal that keeps heat inside the pan for a long time
It is a non-metal that is completely safe at very high temperatures
It is an insulator that prevents the handle from getting hot
explanation: Aluminum is prized for cookware and cans because it is both lightweight and an excellent heat conductor.
fact_tl: Ang aluminyo ay magaan na metal na mahusay magpadaloy ng init, kaya ginagamit sa mga kawali at lata.
fact_bis: Ang aluminyo usa ka gaan nga metal nga maayo modala sa init, mao nga gigamit sa mga kalaha ug lata.

q: What does the Philippine pangolin, or balintong, use to catch its food?
options: Its long tongue to eat ants and termites
Its sharp claws to tear open tree bark and eat beetles
Its powerful beak to break into ant mounds
Its sticky tail to pull insects out of tight spaces
explanation: The Philippine pangolin uses its long tongue to eat ants and termites, while its body is protected by hard scales.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine pangolin o balintong ay tinatakpan ng matigas na kaliskis at kumakain ito ng langgam at anay gamit ang mahaba nitong dila.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine pangolin o balintong gitabonan sa gahi nga mga himbis ug mokaon kini ug hulmigas ug anay pinaagi sa iyang taas nga dila.

q: Why can more people see a total lunar eclipse than a total solar eclipse?
options: A total lunar eclipse is visible from anywhere on Earth's night side, while a total solar eclipse is only visible along a narrow path
A total lunar eclipse lasts for many days, giving more people time to watch it
A total solar eclipse only happens once every 100 years, so very few people ever see one
A total lunar eclipse is brighter than a solar eclipse and can be seen even through clouds
explanation: During a total lunar eclipse, the entire night side of Earth can see it at the same time, whereas a total solar eclipse is visible only along a narrow strip called the path of totality.
fact_tl: Ang lunar eclipse ay mas madalas na makita kaysa sa solar eclipse; ang isang total lunar eclipse ay makikita mula sa kahit saan sa night side ng Earth kapag ito ay nangyayari, habang ang total solar eclipse ay makikita lamang mula sa isang makitid na path of totality. Ang mga total lunar eclipse ay nangyayari humigit-kumulang dalawa hanggang tatlong beses sa isang taon sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang lunar eclipse mas kanunay makita kaysa sa solar eclipse; ang usa ka total lunar eclipse makita gikan sa bisan asa sa night side sa Yuta sa dihang mahitabo kini, samtang ang total solar eclipse makita lamang gikan sa makipot nga path of totality. Ang mga total lunar eclipse mahitabo mga duha hangtod tulo ka beses matag tuig sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: Which of the following is an example of renewable energy?
options: Geothermal energy from Earth's heat
Coal burned in a power plant
Natural gas piped from underground fields
Oil refined from petroleum
explanation: Geothermal energy, which comes from Earth's internal heat, is one of the key examples of renewable energy alongside solar, wind, hydro, and biomass.
fact_tl: Ang mga halimbawa ng renewable (nababawing) enerhiya ay solar (araw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init ng lupa), at biomass.
fact_bis: Mga pananglitan sa renewable (mabag-o) nga enerhiya mao ang solar (adlaw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init sa yuta), ug biomass.

q: How does a geothermal power plant produce electricity?
options: Hot steam from the ground spins turbine blades, which turn a generator that makes electricity
Cold water pumped underground is heated by lava and then used to cool a nuclear reactor
Volcanic ash is burned to boil water, and the steam runs through pipes to homes
Earth's magnetic field is captured by large coils buried in the ground
explanation: In a geothermal plant, steam from underground wells spins turbine blades connected to a generator that produces electricity.
fact_tl: Sa isang geothermal power plant, ang mainit na singaw mula sa lupa ay pumipiglas papaalis ng tubig sa mga drill hole; ang singaw ay hinahayaang lumabas at ipinaiikot ang mga turbine blades; ang mga paikot na blades ay nagpapaikot ng generator na gumagawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka geothermal power plant, ang mainit nga singaw gikan sa yuta mosulod paibabaw pinaagi sa mga kinalbang na buslot; ang singaw gidala sa pagpaligid sa turbine blades; ang nagaligid nga mga blades nagpaligid sa generator nga nagbuhat og kuryente.

q: When was the last time a human walked on the Moon?
options: 1972, when the Apollo 17 crew returned home
1986, after the Space Shuttle Challenger mission
2001, during the first International Space Station mission
1969, right after the first Moon landing by Apollo 11
explanation: The Apollo 17 mission ended in 1972, and no human has walked on the Moon since then.
fact_tl: Mula nang umuwi ang Apollo 17 noong 1972, wala pang ibang tao ang muling nakalakad sa Buwan hanggang ngayon.
fact_bis: Sukad miuli ang Apollo 17 niadtong 1972, wala pay laing tawo nga nakalakaw pag-usab sa Bulan hangtod karon.

q: Where was the element helium first discovered?
options: In the light of the Sun in 1868, before it was found on Earth
In a volcanic gas sample collected in Hawaii in 1895
Inside a meteorite that crashed in Russia in 1801
In the atmosphere of the Moon during the Apollo missions
explanation: Helium was first detected by studying sunlight in 1868, making it the first element discovered in space before being found on Earth.
fact_tl: Unang natuklasan ang helium sa liwanag ng araw noong 1868, bago ito nahanap dito sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang helium una nga nadiskobrehan sa kahayag sa adlaw niadtong 1868, sa wala pa kini makit-i sa Earth.

q: When you use a wheel and axle and apply less force, what trade-off must you accept?
options: The wheel must turn a longer distance than the axle moves
The axle must turn faster than the wheel, which can break the machine
You can only lift objects straight up, not sideways
The object you move will weigh more after it is lifted
explanation: With a wheel and axle, you gain a force advantage by using less effort, but in exchange the wheel travels a greater distance than the axle.
fact_tl: Sa gulong at ehe, kapalit ng mas kaunting puwersa, mas malayo ang dapat ikutin ang gulong kaysa sa kinakailangang pag-ikot ng ehe.
fact_bis: Sa ligid ug aksis, baylo sa paggamit og gamay nga puwersa, ang ligid kinahanglan motuyok og mas layo kaysa lihok sa aksis.

q: What makes the dragonfly one of the hardest insects to catch in the air?
options: It is one of the fastest-flying insects
It can camouflage itself to look like a leaf while in flight
It releases a foul smell that confuses predators chasing it
It flies only at night when it is too dark for predators to see it
explanation: The dragonfly is one of the fastest-flying insects, which makes it extremely difficult to catch while it is in the air.
fact_tl: Ang tutubi ay isa sa pinakamabilis na lumilipad na insekto, kaya mahirap itong hulihin sa ere.
fact_bis: Ang tutubi usa sa labing paspas nga molupad nga insekto, mao nga lisod kini dakpon sa hangin.

q: Why does your face turn red and feel warm when you run or play?
options: Blood vessels in your skin widen and bring warm blood near the surface to release body heat
Your heart pumps extra oxygen to your face so your brain can think faster
Sweat glands in your cheeks fill with water and push it against the skin
Your body temperature drops quickly and sends a flush of cold blood to your face
explanation: When you exercise, your muscles generate heat; to release it, skin blood vessels widen so warm blood reaches the surface, turning your face red and warm as you sweat.
fact_tl: Kapag tumatakbo o naglalaro ka, gumagawa ng maraming init ang kalamnan mo. Para palabasin ito, lumalawak ang ugat sa balat at lumalapit ang dugo sa ibabaw, kaya namumula at umiinit ang mukha mo habang pinagpapawisan ka.
fact_bis: Kung modagan o magdula ka, daghang kainit ang gihimo sa imong kaunoran. Aron ipagawas kini, mosangkad ang ugat sa panit ug moduol ang dugo sa ibabaw, mao nga mamula ug moinit ang imong nawong samtang singoton ka.

q: Why is it important to wash your hands after touching shared public surfaces like doorknobs or railings?
options: Many people touch those surfaces, so lots of germs collect there and can spread to your face or food
Doorknobs and railings are coated with a chemical that is harmful if it enters your mouth
Public surfaces are always wet and the moisture carries bacteria directly into your skin
Germs only live on public surfaces for a few minutes, so you must wash immediately to catch them
explanation: Shared public surfaces are touched by many people, allowing germs to build up; washing your hands afterward prevents you from transferring those germs to your face or food.
fact_tl: Maraming taong humahawak sa mga pampublikong bagay tulad ng hawakan ng pinto, barandilya, at pera, kaya marami doong germ. Pagkatapos mong hawakan ang mga ito, mabuting maghugas ng kamay bago hawakan ang iyong mukha o pagkain.
fact_bis: Daghang tawo ang naggunit sa pampublikong butang sama sa hawiranan sa pultahan, barandilya, ug kwarta, busa daghan og germ didto. Human nimo kini hikapa, maayong maghugas sa kamot sa dili pa hikapon ang imong nawong o pagkaon.

q: Besides being touched by a person, what else can make the makahiya plant fold its leaves?
options: Strong raindrops or strong wind hitting the leaves
Bright sunlight shining on the leaves during midday
Cold temperature at night making the leaves stiffen
The smell of nearby flowers triggering a reaction
explanation: Strong raindrops or strong wind can also cause the makahiya to fold its leaves, which may help protect the leaves from storm damage.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas umuulan. Kapag tumama ang malalakas na patak ng ulan o malakas na hangin sa makahiya, magtitiklop din ito na parang may humipo. Iniisip ng iba na ito ay tumutulong upang hindi masira ang dahon sa unos.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kanunay mag-ulan. Kon ang kusog nga tulo sa ulan o kusog nga hangin muigo sa makahiya, mutiklop usab kini nga morag adunay mihikap. Naghunahuna ang uban nga makatabang kini aron dili madaot ang dahon sa bagyo.

q: Which Philippine place is most famous for its sea caves and limestone formations shaped by waves?
options: El Nido, Palawan
Mayon Volcano, Albay
Chocolate Hills, Bohol
Mount Apo, Davao
explanation: Philippine coastlines have many sea caves and limestone formations, and El Nido in Palawan is the most famous location for these wave-carved features.
fact_tl: Ang mga karagatan ng Pilipinas ay may maraming sea caves at limestone formations na hinubog ng mga alon sa loob ng libu-libong taon; pinakakilala ang mga ito sa El Nido, Palawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga karagatan sa Pilipinas adunay daghang sea cave ug limestone formations nga gihulma sa mga balod sulod sa libu-libong taon; labing bantog kini sa El Nido, Palawan.

q: What is the range of the original Fujita scale used to rate tornado strength?
options: F0 (weakest) to F5 (strongest)
F1 (weakest) to F10 (strongest)
F0 (weakest) to F3 (strongest)
F1 (weakest) to F5 (strongest)
explanation: The original Fujita scale runs from F0 for the weakest tornadoes to F5 for the most destructive ones.
fact_tl: Ang orihinal na Fujita scale ay mula F0 (mahina) hanggang F5 (pinakamalakas).
fact_bis: Ang orihinal nga Fujita scale gikan sa F0 (huyang) ngadto sa F5 (labing kusog).

q: How do insect-eating bats help farmers?
options: They eat mosquitoes and crop pests, reducing the insects that damage plants
They dig burrows in the soil that loosen it and help crop roots grow deeper
They pollinate night-blooming plants that are important food crops
They scare away larger animals like rats that would otherwise eat the crops
explanation: Many small bats eat insects such as mosquitoes and crop pests, which naturally reduces the number of insects that damage farm plants.
fact_tl: Maraming maliliit na paniki ang kumakain ng insekto tulad ng lamok at mga peste sa pananim. Tumutulong sila sa mga magsasaka dahil binabawasan nila ang mga insektong nakakasira ng halaman.
fact_bis: Daghang gagmay nga kabog ang mokaon og insekto sama sa lamuk ug mga peste sa tanom. Motabang sila sa mga mag-uuma kay ilang gikunhuran ang mga insekto nga modaot sa tanom.

q: What keeps the heart beating on its own without you thinking about it?
options: A tiny electrical signal made by the heart's own pacemaker
A special muscle that squeezes automatically when blood pressure drops
The lungs send a burst of oxygen to the heart every second to trigger a beat
Nerve signals from the brain order the heart to beat once per second
explanation: The heart has its own natural pacemaker that generates a tiny electrical signal, telling the heart to beat without any conscious effort.
fact_tl: May sariling parang 'kuryente' ang puso na ginagawa sa maliit na bahagi nito na tinatawag na pacemaker. Ito ang nagbibigay ng senyas para pumintig ang puso kahit hindi mo iniisip o inuutusan.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing adunay kaugalingon nga gamay nga 'kuryente' nga gihimo sa bahin niini nga gitawag og pacemaker. Kini ang naghatag og senyas aron mopitik ang kasingkasing bisan dili nimo huna-hunaon.

q: In what unusual position does a barnacle spend its life inside its shell?
options: On its back, with its legs pointing upward to kick food toward its mouth
Upright like a crab, gripping the rock with its claws
Sideways, filtering water that flows past from left to right
Curled in a ball with its head tucked under its body
explanation: A barnacle lies on its back inside its shell so that its legs point upward and can sweep food down toward its mouth.
fact_tl: Nakakatuwa, ang barnacle ay parang nakatihaya o nakatayo sa ulo sa loob ng kabibi nito. Kaya pataas ang mga binti niya, na para bang sinisipa ang pagkain papunta sa bibig.
fact_bis: Katawa, ang barnacle nagbuy-od sa likod niya, murag nagtindog sa ulo sulod sa iyang kabhang. Mao nga ang iyang mga tiil patuyok pataas, murag gisipa ang pagkaon padulong sa baba.

q: How does the wild pig search for food in the ground?
options: It uses its strong snout to dig in the soil
It uses its sharp front hooves to scrape away the surface layer
It listens for underground insects with its large ears before digging
It uses its long tail to probe between roots and pull out grubs
explanation: The wild pig uses its powerful, muscular snout to root in the soil and uncover food.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang baboy-ramo ng matibay nitong nguso para humukay sa lupa at maghanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa baboy ihalas ang lig-on niyang nguso aron mokalot sa yuta ug mangita ug pagkaon.

q: In the game luksong tinik, what two forces act on a child when they jump?
options: The push of their feet against the ground lifts them up, and gravity pulls them back down to land
The wind pushes them forward while friction with the ground slows them down
Magnetic force pulls them up while air resistance pushes them back down
The weight of their body helps them jump while tension in their legs brings them back
explanation: In luksong tinik, a child's feet push against the ground to jump upward, and gravity then pulls the child back down to land.
fact_tl: Sa luksong tinik, tumatalon ang bata sa pamamagitan ng pagtulak ng kanyang mga paa sa lupa, at hinihila siya pababa ng grabidad para bumalik sa lupa.
fact_bis: Sa luksong tinik, molukso ang bata pinaagi sa pagtulod sa iyang tiil batok sa yuta, ug ang grabidad nagabira kaniya paubos aron mobalik sa yuta.

q: How was the woolly mammoth similar to an elephant, and how was it different?
options: It was a close relative of the elephant but had thick fur and very long curved tusks for living in snowy lands
It was the same species as the elephant but lived only in Africa and Asia, not in cold regions
It was larger than any elephant and had no tusks, relying on its thick fur alone for warmth
It looked like an elephant but was actually more closely related to the rhinoceros
explanation: The woolly mammoth was closely related to today's elephants but had thick fur and long curved tusks that helped it survive in cold, snowy environments.
fact_tl: Ang woolly mammoth ay malapit na kamag-anak ng elepante ngunit may makapal na balahibo at napakahabang baluktot na pangil para mabuhay sa lupaing puno ng niyebe.
fact_bis: Ang woolly mammoth duol nga paryente sa elepante apan adunay baga nga balhibo ug taas kaayo nga liko-liko nga bangkil aron mabuhi sa yutang puno sa niyebe.

q: What happens inside the body when a person is drowning?
options: Water fills the airway and lungs so the person cannot breathe
The heart stops beating because cold water shocks it suddenly
The stomach fills with water and pushes against the lungs from below
The ears fill with water and send wrong signals to the brain, causing unconsciousness
explanation: Drowning occurs when water enters the airway and lungs, preventing the person from breathing.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalunod ay nangyayari kapag napupuno ng tubig ang daanan ng hangin at baga, kaya hindi makahinga ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang pagkalunod mahitabo kung mapuno sa tubig ang agianan sa hangin ug baga, busa dili na makaginhawa ang tawo.

q: What is a key difference between a magnetic field and gravity?
options: Gravity pulls everything downward, while a magnetic field only pulls on iron and a few other metals
Gravity only works underground while a magnetic field works in the air above Earth's surface
A magnetic field pulls objects upward while gravity pulls them toward the center of Earth
Gravity is stronger than a magnetic field at the North Pole but weaker at the equator
explanation: While gravity acts on all objects and pulls them downward, a magnetic field only attracts iron and a few other metals.
fact_tl: Madalas pinagkakamalan na pareho ang magnetic field at gravity, pero magkaiba sila. Ang gravity ay humihila sa LAHAT ng bagay pababa, samantalang ang magnetic field ay humihila lamang ng bakal at ilang metal.
fact_bis: Sagad masaypan nga pareho ang magnetic field ug gravity, apan lahi sila. Ang gravity mobira sa TANANG butang paubos, samtang ang magnetic field mobira lang sa puthaw ug pipila ka metal.

q: What keeps the Agusan Marsh supplied with fresh water?
options: Many small rivers and creeks from the surrounding mountains flow into it
A single large underground spring fills it from below
Rainfall alone collects in the low-lying land to form the marsh
Seawater mixes with rainwater during typhoons to fill it
explanation: The Agusan Marsh is fed by many small rivers and creeks flowing down from surrounding mountains, ensuring a continuous supply of fresh water.
fact_tl: Hindi lang iisang ilog ang nagbibigay ng tubig sa Agusan Marsh. Maraming maliliit na ilog at sapa mula sa mga paligid na bundok ang dumadaloy papasok dito, kaya laging may sariwang tubig ang marsh.
fact_bis: Dili lang usa ka suba ang naghatag og tubig sa Agusan Marsh. Daghang gagmayng suba ug sapa gikan sa palibot nga kabukiran ang nagaagas pasulod niini, busa kanunay adunay bag-ong tubig ang marsh.

q: How many provinces does the Philippines have?
options: 82 provinces
72 provinces
106 provinces
54 provinces
explanation: The Philippines is divided into 82 provinces spread across its three main island groups.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may 82 na lalawigan o probinsya.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay 82 ka probinsya.

q: What is an echo?
options: A sound that bounces off a faraway surface like a cliff or wall and comes back to us
A sound that gets louder as it travels through a tunnel or narrow valley
A second sound wave created when the first sound wave splits in open air
A sound made by two identical noises played at exactly the same moment
explanation: An echo is what we hear when a sound wave travels to a distant surface, bounces off it, and returns to our ears.
fact_tl: Ang alingawngaw ay tunog na bumabalik sa atin matapos tumama at tumalbog sa isang malayong ibabaw gaya ng bangin o pader.
fact_bis: Ang alingawngaw mao ang tingog nga mobalik kanato human mobangga ug mosalpok sa layo nga bahin sama sa pangpang o bongbong.

q: Where does firewood used as fuel come from?
options: The branches and trunks of trees
Underground coal deposits mined from the earth
Dried grass and bamboo compressed into bricks
Animal fat collected and dried in the sun
explanation: Firewood is fuel made from the branches and trunks of trees, which release energy when burned.
fact_tl: Ang kahoy na ginagamit panggatong ay galing sa mga sanga at katawan ng puno.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy nga gigamit nga sugnod naggikan sa mga sanga ug lawas sa kahoy.

q: Which of the following is an example of a rate, just like speed?
options: Water dripping at 2 liters per minute
The color of a moving car
The direction a ball rolls
The weight of a moving object
explanation: Speed is a rate (distance per time), and water dripping at liters per minute is the same kind of measurement — how much something changes per unit of time.
fact_tl: Ang speed ay isang uri lang ng rate — ibig sabihin, kung gaano kadami ang nagbabago bawat yunit ng oras. Kung paanong ang speed ay layo bawat oras, ang ibang rate naman ay tulad ng tubig na tumutulo na litro bawat minuto o pera na naiipon piso bawat araw. Lahat sila ay sumusukat ng bilis ng pagbabago.
fact_bis: Ang speed usa lang ka matang sa rate — buot ipasabot, kung unsa kadaghan ang nagbag-o matag yunit sa oras. Sama nga ang speed mao ang gilay-on matag oras, ang ubang rate sama sa tubig nga nagtulo og litro matag minuto o kwarta nga natigom og piso matag adlaw. Tanan sila nagsukod sa katulin sa pagbag-o.

q: Why do coral reefs grow well in the shallow seas between the Philippine islands?
options: The water there is warm and shallow
The water there is cold and deep
The islands block all ocean currents
The seabed there is made of white sand
explanation: The shallow, warm water between the Philippine islands provides ideal conditions for coral reefs to grow and become home to many fish.
fact_tl: Ang mababaw at mainit na tubig sa pagitan ng mga pulo ay magandang lugar para tumubo ang mga bahura o coral reef na tirahan ng maraming isda.
fact_bis: Ang mabaw ug init nga tubig taliwala sa mga pulo maayong dapit alang sa pagtubo sa mga bahura o coral reef nga puy-anan sa daghang isda.

q: What would most likely happen if a fish that lives in fresh water were moved to the ocean?
options: It would not survive
It would quickly adapt and thrive
It would grow larger than before
It would migrate back on its own
explanation: Most fish can only survive in either fresh water or salt water — moving them to the other type of water would be fatal for most species.
fact_tl: May mga isdang nabubuhay lang sa tubig-tabang at iba namang nabubuhay lang sa tubig-alat; hindi karaniwang kayang magpalit ang isa.
fact_bis: Naay mga isda nga mabuhi lang sa tubig-tab-ang ug uban nga mabuhi lang sa tubig-parat; kasagaran dili sila mabalhin sa pikas.

q: Which branch of the Philippine government is responsible for making laws?
options: The Legislative Branch (Congress)
The Executive Branch (President)
The Judicial Branch (Supreme Court)
The Local Government Units
explanation: The Legislative Branch, which is Congress, is the branch that makes the laws in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Sangay na Lehislatibo (Kongreso) ang gumagawa ng mga batas.
fact_bis: Ang Sanga nga Lehislatibo (Kongreso) mao ang naghimo sa mga balaod.

q: Which statement correctly describes the two main kinds of plankton?
options: Phytoplankton are plant-like and zooplankton are tiny animal-like creatures
Phytoplankton swim fast and zooplankton drift slowly
Phytoplankton live in fresh water and zooplankton live in the sea
Phytoplankton are larger and zooplankton are microscopic algae
explanation: There are two main kinds of plankton: phytoplankton that are plant-like and zooplankton that are tiny animal-like creatures.
fact_tl: May dalawang pangunahing uri ng plankton: ang phytoplankton na parang halaman at ang zooplankton na parang maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka nag-unang matang sa plankton: ang phytoplankton nga sama sa tanom ug ang zooplankton nga sama sa gagmay nga mananap.

q: How does the ionosphere help radio signals travel very long distances?
options: Its charged particles bounce radio waves back toward Earth
Its high temperature speeds up the radio waves
Its thick air blocks interference from space
Its water vapor absorbs and re-emits the signals
explanation: The ionosphere has charged particles that bounce radio waves back, allowing signals to reach far away.
fact_tl: Ang ionosphere ay may mga sisingilin na particle na nagpapabalik ng mga alon ng radyo, kaya nakakaabot ang signal sa malayo.
fact_bis: Ang ionosphere adunay mga charged nga partikulo nga nagpabalik sa mga balod sa radyo, maong moabot ang signal sa layo.

q: What is a stress fracture?
options: A tiny crack in a bone caused by too much repeated activity
A complete break of a bone from a single hard fall
Swelling around a joint from an infection
Stretched ligaments around a bone from overuse
explanation: A stress fracture is a tiny crack in a bone caused by repeated overuse, such as too much running.
fact_tl: Ang stress fracture ay maliit na lamat sa buto na dulot ng paulit-ulit na paggamit, tulad ng sobrang pagtakbo.
fact_bis: Ang stress fracture mao ang gamay nga liki sa bukog tungod sa balik-balik nga paggamit, sama sa sobra nga pagdagan.

q: What is the recommended treatment for a person sick with chikungunya?
options: Rest, plenty of fluids, and medicine to lower fever
A special antiviral medicine taken for two weeks
An antibiotic injection given at the hospital
A vaccine taken within 48 hours of getting the disease
explanation: There is no special cure for chikungunya, so treatment focuses on rest, fluids, and medicine for fever.
fact_tl: Walang espesyal na gamot para sa chikungunya, kaya ang lunas ay pahinga, maraming tubig, at gamot para sa lagnat.
fact_bis: Walay espesyal nga tambal para sa chikungunya, mao nga ang lunas mao ang pagpahuway, daghang tubig, ug tambal para sa hilanat.

q: In what year was the Philippine Eagle officially declared the national bird?
explanation: The Philippine Eagle was made the national bird in 1995 through Proclamation No. 615.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Eagle ay ginawang pambansang ibon noong 1995 sa pamamagitan ng Proclamation No. 615.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Eagle gihimong nasodnong langgam niadtong 1995 pinaagi sa Proclamation No. 615.

q: What is vermicompost and why is it useful?
options: Compost made by worms whose droppings are a rich fertilizer for plants
Compost made by mixing dried leaves with chemical fertilizers
Soil dug from river banks used to enrich garden beds
Decayed wood chips that slowly release nutrients into the ground
explanation: Vermicompost is compost made by worms — their castings (droppings) are one of the richest natural fertilizers for plants.
fact_tl: Ang vermicompost ay compost na gawa ng mga bulate. Kinakain nila ang nabubulok na basura at ang lumalabas na dumi nila ay isa sa pinakamayamang natural na pataba para sa halaman — kaya may mga taong nag-aalaga ng bulate sa kahon para gumawa nito.
fact_bis: Ang vermicompost kay compost nga hinimo sa mga bulate. Kaonon nila ang nadunot nga basura, ug ang ilang tae (gitawag og castings) usa sa pinakadato nga natural nga abono para sa tanom — busa naay mga tawo nga moalima og bulate sa kahon aron mohimo niini.

q: Approximately how long can a giant tortoise live?
options: More than 100 years, sometimes nearly 150
About 50 to 60 years at most
Around 75 years, similar to humans
Up to 200 years in the wild
explanation: Giant tortoises can live more than 100 years, and some reach nearly 150 years.
fact_tl: Ang mga higanteng pagong (giant tortoise) ay maaaring mabuhay nang mahigit 100 taon, at ang ilan ay umaabot ng halos 150 taon.
fact_bis: Ang mga higante nga baw-baw (giant tortoise) makabuhi ug kapin 100 ka tuig, ug ang uban moabot ug halos 150 ka tuig.

q: What enters a leaf through the tiny pores called stomata?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Water vapor
Nitrogen
explanation: Leaves have tiny pores called stomata where carbon dioxide enters and oxygen and water vapor leave.
fact_tl: May maliliit na butas sa dahon na tinatawag na stomata kung saan pumapasok ang carbon dioxide at lumalabas ang oxygen at singaw ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga dahon adunay gagmay nga mga lungag nga gitawag og stomata diin mosulod ang carbon dioxide ug mogawas ang oxygen ug alisngaw sa tubig.

q: What happened to measles cases in many countries after the measles vaccine became widespread?
options: The number of cases dropped greatly
The number of cases stayed about the same
The disease disappeared completely worldwide
The cases increased because the vaccine had side effects
explanation: After the measles vaccine spread, the number of cases dropped greatly in many countries, making it one of the most successful uses of a vaccine in history.
fact_tl: Bago naimbento ang bakuna, napakaraming bata ang nagkakatigdas bawat taon at marami ang nagkakasakit nang malubha. Pagkatapos lumaganap ang bakuna, bumaba nang husto ang bilang ng mga nagkakatigdas sa maraming bansa. Ito ang isa sa pinakamatagumpay na paggamit ng bakuna sa kasaysayan.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa naimbento ang bakuna, daghan kaayong bata ang magtigdas matag tuig ug daghan ang grabe nga nagsakit. Human mikatap ang bakuna, mikunhod pag-ayo ang gidaghanon sa nagtigdas sa daghang nasod. Usa kini sa pinakamalampuson nga paggamit sa bakuna sa kasaysayan.

q: How is a sea breeze similar to boiling water in a pot?
options: Hot fluid rises, cooler fluid sinks at the sides, and it circulates — both are convection
Both are driven by the moon's gravity pulling water toward the shore
Both require a large difference in pressure between two air masses
Both move in only one direction without cycling back
explanation: A sea breeze and boiling water both work by convection — hot material rises, cooler material sinks to the sides, and the flow circulates.
