fact_bis: Kung naay hilanat ka ug magpabilin sa balay aron magpahulay, dili lang ikaw ang imong gitabangan. Dili nimo matakdan ang imong mga klasmeyt kay daghang sakit makatakod. Busa ang pahulay sa balay maayo para nimo ug sa uban.

q: Who won the Philippines' very first Olympic gold medal in 2021?
options: Carlos Yulo
Hidilyn Diaz
Nesthy Petecio
EJ Obiena
explanation: The Philippines won its first Olympic gold medal in 2021 through Hidilyn Diaz.
fact_tl: Nanalo ang Pilipinas ng kauna-unahang gintong medalya sa Olympics noong 2021, sa pamamagitan ni Hidilyn Diaz.
fact_bis: Nakadaog ang Pilipinas sa unang-unang bulawang medalya sa Olympics niadtong 2021, pinaagi ni Hidilyn Diaz.

q: What important cleaning process happens in the brain during sleep?
options: The brain stores new memories and deletes old ones permanently
The brain washes out waste that built up while you were awake
The brain stops working completely to save energy
The brain produces extra blood to grow larger overnight
explanation: During sleep the brain cleans itself better, washing out waste that built up while you were awake.
fact_tl: Sa tulog, mas mahusay na nililinis ng utak ang sarili nito — inaanod palabas ang mga waste na naipon habang ikaw ay gising.
fact_bis: Sa pagkatulog, mas maayong manglimpyo ang utak sa kaugalingon niini, gianod pagawas ang hugaw nga natipon samtang ikaw nagmata.

q: What element is graphite made of?
options: Iron
Silicon
Sulfur
Carbon
explanation: Graphite is a form of pure carbon that is soft and dark.
fact_tl: Ang graphite ay isang anyo ng purong karbon (carbon) na malambot at maitim.
fact_bis: Ang graphite usa ka porma sa lunsay nga carbon nga humok ug itom.

q: What is it called when people eat insects as food, such as giant water bugs in Southeast Asia?
options: Herbivory
Entomophagy
Omnivory
Apiculture
explanation: Eating insects is called entomophagy — a tradition found in some parts of Asia, including eating giant water bugs as a nutritious delicacy.
fact_tl: Sa ilang bahagi ng Southeast Asia, ang giant water bugs ay kinakain bilang masustansyang pagkain; ito ay isang halimbawa ng entomophagy—ang pagkain ng mga insekto—na kaugalian ng ilan sa Pilipinas at sa buong Asya.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka bahin sa Southeast Asia, ang giant water bugs gikaon ingon masustansyang delicacy; kini usa ka pananglitan sa entomophagy—pagkaon og insekto—usa ka tradisyon nga makita sa pipila ka bahin sa Asya.

q: Why should you never touch a poison dart frog?
options: Its loud croaking can permanently damage your hearing
It carries poison on its skin that can harm you
Its sticky feet can grip your hand and not let go
It sprays venom from its eyes when threatened
explanation: The poison dart frog carries poison on its skin, so it should not be touched — its bright colors also warn predators to stay away.
fact_tl: Ang poison dart frog ay may lason sa balat nito, kaya hindi ito dapat hawakan, at ang matitingkad na kulay nito ay babala sa mga mandaragit.
fact_bis: Ang poison dart frog adunay hilo sa panit niini, mao nga dili kini angay hikapon, ug ang hayag nga kolor niini pasidaan sa mga manunukob.

q: What causes your eyes to water when you cut an onion?
options: The cold temperature from inside the onion chills your eyes
A gas released from the cut onion irritates your eyes and makes you cry
The strong smell of onion makes your nose run and eyes water together
Juice from the onion splashes directly into your eyes
explanation: When an onion is cut, it releases a gas that irritates the eyes, which makes us cry.
fact_tl: Kapag hiniwa ang sibuyas, naglalabas ito ng gas na nakakairita sa mata kaya tayo umiiyak.
fact_bis: Kung tadtaron ang sibuyas, mogawas ang gas nga makapasakit sa mata mao nga maghilak ta.

q: How can you save electricity when boiling water?
options: Always boil a full kettle so the water stays hot longer
Heat only as much water as you actually need
Use the highest heat setting to finish faster and save time
Boil water twice to make sure it is really clean
explanation: When boiling water, heating only as much as you need avoids wasting electricity.
fact_tl: Kapag nagpapakulo ng tubig, ang dami lang na kailangan mo ang painitin para hindi masayang ang kuryente.
fact_bis: Kung magpabukal og tubig, ang gidaghanon lang nga imong gikinahanglan ang painiton aron dili mausik ang koryente.

q: What is spider silk like BEFORE it leaves the spider's body?
options: A dry powder that the spider mixes with air
A liquid inside the spider that hardens into thread as it is pulled out
A solid thread already formed inside special silk pouches
A thick paste that dries slowly over several hours
explanation: Silk starts as a liquid inside the spider and hardens into a thread as it is pulled out.
fact_tl: Ang sutla ay likido sa loob ng gagamba at tumitigas na hibla kapag ito ay hinila palabas.
fact_bis: Ang seda likido sulod sa lawalawa ug motig-a nga hilo kon kini birahon pagawas.

q: When does a chick's heart begin to beat inside the egg?
options: Only on the day the egg hatches
About halfway through the incubation period
Just a few days after incubation starts
Not until a week before hatching
explanation: The chick's heart begins to beat early, just a few days after incubation starts.
fact_tl: Maagang nagsisimulang tumibok ang puso ng sisiw, ilang araw lamang pagkatapos masimulan ang pagpisa.
fact_bis: Sayo nga magsugod og kibot ang kasingkasing sa piso, pipila lang ka adlaw human magsugod ang pagpusa.

q: Why do some orb-web spiders eat their old web before spinning a new one?
options: Old webs are poisonous to insects so the spider removes the danger
They recycle the silk proteins so the nutrients are not wasted
Eating the web gives the spider energy to catch prey during the day
They destroy old webs to confuse predators about where they live
explanation: Some orb-web spiders eat their old web each night to recycle the silk proteins so the nutrients are not wasted.
fact_tl: Ang ilang orb-web spiders ay inuubos ang lumang tela nila sa gabi bago gumawa ng bago—nire-recycle nila ang mga protina ng sutla para hindi nasasayang ang sustansya.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka orb-web spiders gikaon ang ilang daan nga tela sa gabii sa wala pa magpiko og bag-ong—nire-recycle nila ang mga protina sa sutla aron ang mga sustansya dili masayang.

q: Who gave the name 'spectrum' to the band of seven colors of light?
options: Galileo Galilei
Isaac Newton
Albert Einstein
Michael Faraday
explanation: Isaac Newton gave the name 'spectrum' to the band of seven colors of light.
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ang nagbigay ng terminong "spectrum" sa hanay ng pitong kulay ng liwanag.
fact_bis: Si Isaac Newton ang naghatag sa pulong nga "spectrum" sa han-ay sa pito ka kolor sa kahayag.

q: What are the two main things that combine during combustion to release energy?
options: Water and carbon dioxide
Salt and water
Fuel and oxygen
Heat and pressure
explanation: Combustion is a chemical reaction in which fuel combines with oxygen and releases energy.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ay isang reaksyong kemikal kung saan nakikipagsanib ang panggatong sa oxygen at naglalabas ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog usa ka reaksiyong kemikal diin ang sugnod makigsumpay sa oxygen ug magpagawas ug enerhiya.

q: What do calamansi and dalandan trees produce BEFORE they bear fruit?
options: Small green fruits that slowly turn orange
Large leaves that drop to the ground first
Flowers that bloom before the fruit appears
Underground roots that store sugar first
explanation: Calamansi and dalandan grow on small trees that first bloom with flowers before they bear fruit.
fact_tl: Ang calamansi at dalandan ay tumutubo sa maliliit na puno na unang namumulaklak bago magbunga ng prutas.
fact_bis: Ang kalamansi ug dalandan motubo sa gagmayng kahoy nga mamulak una mamunga og prutas.

q: How do club mosses reproduce, and what makes them unusual among plants?
options: They produce flowers and fruits like most modern plants
They grow from seeds carried by the wind like grasses
They reproduce by spores and are among the oldest kinds of plants on Earth
They reproduce by budding new plants from their stems underground
explanation: Club mosses are small seedless plants that reproduce by spores and are among the oldest kinds of plants on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang club moss ay maliit na halamang walang buto na nagpaparami sa spore, at isa rin ito sa mga pinakalumang uri ng halaman sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang club moss gamayng tanom nga walay liso nga nagsanay pinaagi sa spore, ug usa usab kini sa pinakakaraan nga matang sa tanom sa kalibotan.

q: Why are young children most at risk of dehydration when they have diarrhea?
options: Children refuse to drink water when they are sick
Young children eat more salty food that dries out their bodies faster
Their bodies are small, so they lose water more quickly and become dehydrated faster
Children's stomachs do not absorb water as well as adults'
explanation: Young children are most at risk of dehydration because their bodies are small, so fluid loss affects them more quickly.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na bata ang pinakadelikadong magka-dehydration dahil maliit ang kanilang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga mga bata ang labing delikado nga ma-dehydration kay gamay ang ilang lawas.

q: Why does a cacao pod take several months to ripen on the tree?
options: The cacao tree only absorbs sunlight two hours a day so growth is slow
The seeds inside need time to grow and the pulp needs time to sweeten
Cacao pods must wait for the rainy season before they can start growing
Farmers keep cacao pods on the tree longer to make them easier to harvest
explanation: A cacao pod takes several months to ripen because the seeds inside need time to grow and the pulp needs time to sweeten.
fact_tl: Tinatanong ng mga bata kung bakit matagal bago hinog ang cacao pod. Ito ay umaabot ng ilang buwan dahil kailangan ng oras para lumaki ang mga buto sa loob at maging matamis ang laman.
fact_bis: Kanunay mangutana ang mga bata ngano dugay mahinog ang cacao pod. Nagkinahanglan kini og pipila ka bulan kay ang mga liso sa sulod kinahanglan og panahon motubo ug ang unod motam-is.

q: In which parts of the body are many lymph nodes found, where they can sometimes be felt when swollen?
options: Inside the lungs, stomach, and liver
On the surface of the skin on the back and chest
In the neck, armpits, and groin
Along the spine and inside the skull
explanation: Many lymph nodes are found in the neck, armpits, and groin — you can often feel them there when they swell.
fact_tl: Marami ang mga kulani sa leeg, kilikili, at singit, kaya doon mo sila madalas maramdaman kapag namamaga.
fact_bis: Daghang lymph nodes ang makita sa liog, ilok, ug singit, mao nga didto nimo kini mabati kung maghubag.

q: What is pus made of, and what does it tell you about your body?
options: Extra blood plasma that leaks out when skin is damaged
Dead white blood cells and germs, showing the body has been fighting an infection
A liquid the body makes to keep a wound moist and soft
Skin oil that collects around a wound to protect it from air
explanation: Pus is made of dead white blood cells and germs — it is a sign the body has been fighting the infection.
fact_tl: Ang nanang lumalabas sa sugat ay binubuo ng mga patay na white blood cells at germ; tanda ito na nakipaglaban ang katawan sa impeksyon.
fact_bis: Ang nana nga mogawas sa samad gilangkoban sa mga patay nga white blood cells ug germ; timaan kini nga nakig-away ang lawas sa impeksyon.

q: What happens when you stack two magnets with their poles lined up the same way?
options: The magnets cancel each other out and have no pull at all
The pull stays exactly the same as one magnet alone
The pull becomes stronger than one magnet, like adding both strengths together
One magnet loses its power and the other becomes twice as strong
explanation: Stacking two magnets with poles lined up the right way makes the pull stronger than one magnet alone — like adding both strengths together.
fact_tl: Kung pagpapatungin mo ang dalawang magnet na magkatugma ang poste, mas lumalakas ang hila kaysa sa iisang magnet lang. Parang pinagsama mo ang lakas ng dalawa.
fact_bis: Kung patongon nimo ang duha ka magnet nga husto ang pagkahan-ay sa polo, mas mokusog ang pagbira kaysa usa ra ka magnet. Murag gidugang nimo ang kusog sa duha.

q: What is anaphylaxis, and how is it treated in an emergency?
options: A mild skin rash from touching plants, treated with cold water
A severe allergic reaction that makes breathing hard, treated with epinephrine
A type of stomach flu that causes vomiting, treated with rest and fluids
A broken bone complication that causes swelling, treated with a cast
explanation: Anaphylaxis is a severe allergic reaction that makes breathing hard and is a medical emergency treated with epinephrine.
fact_tl: Ang anaphylaxis ay matinding allergic na reaksyon na nakakapaghirap ng paghinga at isang emerhensiyang medikal na ginagamot ng epinephrine.
fact_bis: Ang anaphylaxis usa ka grabe nga allergic nga reaksyon nga maglisod sa pagginhawa ug usa ka medikal nga emerhensya nga tambalan og epinephrine.

q: What happens to a snake's eyes just before it sheds its skin?
options: The eyes grow larger to help the snake see during shedding
The eyes turn bright red as blood flows to help loosen the skin
The eyes turn cloudy or milky-blue for a short while
The eyes close shut and stay closed until the old skin is gone
explanation: Before shedding, a snake's eyes turn cloudy or milky-blue for a short while.
fact_tl: Bago maghubad ng balat, nagiging malabo o parang maputlang kulay-asul ang mata ng ahas saglit.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa molubad sa panit, mahimong hanap o morag puti-asul ang mata sa halas sa makadiyot.

q: What is the correct way to read a thermometer accurately?
options: Hold the thermometer above your head and read it from below
Look at the thermometer at the same level as your eye
Stand as far away as possible so the thermometer is not affected by your body heat
Shake the thermometer quickly before reading the scale
explanation: For an accurate reading, you should look at the thermometer at the same level as your eye.
fact_tl: Para sa tamang pagbasa, tingnan ang termometro nang kalebel ng iyong mata.
fact_bis: Para sa tukmang pagbasa, tan-awa ang termometro nga parehas og lebel sa imong mata.

q: Why can a crocodile see and breathe even when most of its body is underwater?
options: Crocodiles hold their breath for hours and do not need to breathe
Crocodiles breathe through gills on their sides like fish
Their eyes and nostrils sit on top of the head, staying above the water surface
They swim so fast that they reach the surface before needing air
explanation: A crocodile's eyes and nostrils sit on top of its head, so even when its body is underwater it can still see and breathe.
fact_tl: Ang mga mata at butas ng ilong ng buwaya ay nasa itaas ng ulo nito, kaya kahit lumubog ang katawan nito sa tubig, makakakita at makakahinga pa rin ito habang nag-aabang.
fact_bis: Ang mga mata ug buho sa ilong sa buaya naa sa ibabaw sa ulo niini, busa bisan unlod ang lawas niini sa tubig makakita ug makaginhawa pa kini samtang nag-atang.

q: What happens to red litmus paper when you dip it into a base?
options: It turns blue.
It turns green.
It stays red.
It turns yellow.
explanation: Red litmus paper turns blue when dipped in a base, which is how we know something is basic rather than acidic.
fact_tl: Ang PULANG litmus paper ay nagiging ASUL kapag inilagay sa base.
fact_bis: Ang PULA nga litmus paper mahimong ASUL kung ituslob sa base.

q: What is the chemical formula for the oxygen gas that we breathe?
options: O3
O2
CO2
H2O
explanation: The oxygen gas we breathe has the chemical formula O2, meaning each molecule is made of two oxygen atoms bonded together.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng oxygen gas na nilalanghap natin ay O2.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa oxygen gas nga atong ginaginhawa kay O2.

q: Why does your body make you cough?
options: To push air into your lungs faster
To push out things that irritate your airways
To cool down your throat when it is hot
To send extra blood to your chest
explanation: A cough is the body's way of pushing out irritants from the airways to keep them clear.
fact_tl: Ang ubo ay paraan ng katawan para itulak palabas ang mga bagay na nakakairita sa iyong daanan ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang ubo mao ang paagi sa lawas aron iduso pagawas ang mga butang nga nakapasamok sa imong agianan sa hangin.

q: When is the best time to drink water during the day?
options: Only when you feel very thirsty
Only after eating a full meal
Regularly throughout the day, before strong thirst hits
Only in the morning when you wake up
explanation: Thirst is already a sign you are a little low on water, so it is better to drink regularly through the day rather than wait for strong thirst.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakala na kailangan munang mauhaw bago uminom ng tubig, pero ang totoo, ang pagkauhaw ay senyales na medyo kulang ka na. Mas mabuti kung regular kang umiinom buong araw kaysa hintayin ang sobrang uhaw. Hindi mo kailangang mauhaw nang husto para malaman na oras na para uminom.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga kinahanglan una giuhaw ka una moinom og tubig, apan ang tinuod, ang kauhaw usa ka senyales nga gamay na ka og kulang. Mas maayo kung regular ka moinom sa tibuok adlaw kaysa maghulat sa grabe nga kauhaw. Dili nimo kinahanglan grabe ka og kauhaw aron mahibalo nga panahon na sa pag-inom.

q: Both the burnay and palayok are made of clay, but what is a palayok mainly used for?
options: Storing food and drinks
Cooking food over fire
Carrying water from rivers
Decorating the home
explanation: A palayok is a clay pot designed for cooking over fire, while a burnay is used for storing food and drinks.
fact_tl: Parehong gawa sa putik ang burnay at ang palayok, pero magkaiba ang gamit. Ang palayok ay pangluto sa apoy, samantalang ang burnay ay pang-imbak ng pagkain at inumin.
fact_bis: Ang burnay ug ang kulon parehong hinimo sa lapok, apan lahi ang gamit. Ang kulon para sa pagluto sa kalayo, samtang ang burnay para sa pagtipig sa pagkaon ug ilimnon.

q: Which element is the most abundant in the entire universe?
options: Oxygen
Carbon
Helium
Hydrogen
explanation: Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe, making up the bulk of stars and interstellar gas.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming element sa buong uniberso ay hydrogen.
fact_bis: Ang labing daghang elemento sa tibuok uniberso mao ang hydrogen.

q: Why can't a barnacle chase its food the way a fish can?
options: It has no mouth to eat with
It is permanently cemented to a rock head-down by its own glue
Its eyes are too weak to spot food moving past
It only eats food that sinks to the bottom
explanation: A barnacle is glued head-down to a rock by its own natural cement, so it must wait for food to drift to it rather than chasing it.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng isda, hindi makakahabol ng pagkain ang barnacle dahil nakadikit ito sa bato gamit ang sarili nitong natural na pandikit, at ulo pa ang nakatapat sa ibaba. Kaya kailangan nitong maghintay na lumapit ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa isda, ang barnacle dili makagukod sa pagkaon kay nakapilit kini sa bato gamit ang iyang kaugalingong natural nga pandikit, ulo pa ang naa sa ubos. Busa kinahanglan niyang maghulat nga moduol ang pagkaon.

q: What electrical charge does a proton carry?
options: Negative
Neutral (no charge)
Positive
It varies depending on the element
explanation: A proton carries a positive (+) charge, which is one of the basic properties that defines it.
fact_tl: Ang proton ay may positibong (+) charge.
fact_bis: Ang proton adunay positibo nga (+) charge.

q: How does the sea cucumber help the ocean environment?
options: It produces oxygen that fish breathe
It recycles nutrients in the sea, keeping water and sand healthy
It filters salt out of seawater for other animals
It builds reefs that small fish can hide in
explanation: Sea cucumbers help recycle nutrients in the sea, which keeps the water and sand healthy for other marine life.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang balat na i-recycle ang sustansya sa dagat, kaya napapanatili nitong malusog ang tubig at buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang balatan motabang sa pag-recycle sa sustansya sa dagat, busa nagpabilin niini nga himsog ang tubig ug balas.

q: What happens to a vehicle's fuel consumption when its tires are underinflated?
options: Fuel consumption stays the same because engine power does not change
Fuel consumption decreases because soft tires grip the road better
Fuel consumption increases because underinflated tires have higher rolling resistance
Fuel consumption decreases because the vehicle moves more slowly
explanation: Underinflated tires have higher rolling resistance — more friction between tire and road — which causes the engine to use more fuel.
fact_tl: Ang rolling resistance ay ang puwersa ng kiskisan ng gulong laban sa daan — ang mga gulong na kulang ang hangin ay may mas malaking rolling resistance at nagkukulang ng gasolina nang mas mabilis.
fact_bis: Ang rolling resistance mao ang puwersa sa kiskisan tali sa gulong ug sa daan — ang mga gulong nga kulang sa hangin adunay mas taas nga rolling resistance, nagpahinabo sa mas dako nga paggamit sa gasolina.

q: What do we call it when many connected food chains are joined together to show how animals really eat in nature?
options: A food pyramid
A food web
An energy chain
A nutrient cycle
explanation: Many connected food chains form a food web, which better reflects that real animals eat many kinds of food, not just one.
fact_tl: Ang food chain ay isang tuwid na daan ng pagkain, pero sa totoong kalikasan, ang mga hayop ay kumakain ng maraming uri ng pagkain. Kaya ang maraming food chain na magkakaugnay ay tinatawag na food web.
fact_bis: Ang food chain usa ka prangka nga dalan sa pagkaon, apan sa tinuod nga kinaiyahan, ang mga hayop mokaon og daghang klase sa pagkaon. Mao nga ang daghang food chain nga magkadugtong gitawag og food web.

q: A shark is dark on top and pale on its belly. What type of camouflage is this, and what does it hide?
options: Background matching — it hides the shark's color from prey
Countershading — it hides the body's shadow so the shark does not look three-dimensional
Warning coloration — it tells predators the shark is dangerous
Mimicry — it makes the shark look like a harmless fish
explanation: Countershading (dark on top, pale below) hides the body's shadow, making the animal look flat rather than three-dimensional and harder to spot.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang dalawang uri ng camouflage: ang background matching ay tumutugma lang sa kulay ng paligid, habang ang countershading (madilim sa itaas, maputi sa ilalim) ay nagtatago ng anino para hindi mukhang tatlong-dimensyon ang katawan. Ang una ay tungkol sa kulay, ang pangalawa ay tungkol sa hugis.
fact_bis: Magkalahi ang duha ka matang sa camouflage: ang background matching motakdo lang sa kolor sa palibot, samtang ang countershading (ngitngit sa ibabaw, maputi sa ilawom) motago sa anino aron dili makita nga tulo-ka-dimensyon ang lawas. Ang una bahin sa kolor, ang ikaduha bahin sa porma.

q: Which part of a rice grain is the outermost layer, also known as the ipa?
options: Bran
Endosperm
Germ
Husk
explanation: The husk (ipa) is the outermost layer of a rice grain, covering the bran, endosperm, and germ inside.
fact_tl: Ang butil ng palay ay binubuo ng: husk (ipa)—ang pinakalalim na patong; bran—ang susunod na patong na mayaman sa nutrients; endosperm—puting starch; at germ—ang embryo ng binhi.
fact_bis: Ang butil sa palay naglangkob sa: husk (ipa)—ang pinakagawas nga layer; bran—ang sunod nga layer nga dato sa sustansya; endosperm—ang puting starchy sulod; ug germ—ang embryo sa binhi.

q: Which fish holds the record for living the deepest in the ocean, found at over 8,000 meters down?
options: Anglerfish
Viperfish
Snailfish
Gulper eel
explanation: The snailfish is the deepest-living fish ever found, recorded at depths of over 8,000 meters.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na isda na natagpuan ay ang snailfish, na nakikita sa mahigit 8,000 metro ang lalim.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga isda nga nakit-an mao ang snailfish, makita sa kapin sa 8,000 ka metro ang giladmon.

q: What is the original source of nearly all the energy found on Earth, including the energy in food and fossil fuels?
options: The Earth's hot core
The Moon's gravity
The sun
Chemical reactions in the ocean
explanation: The sun is the original source of nearly all energy on Earth — energy in food, wind, and even fossil fuels all trace back to sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang araw ang pangunahing pinagmulan ng halos lahat ng enerhiya sa Daigdig — mula sa pagkain, hangin, hanggang sa fossil fuel — na nagbabago lamang ng anyo.
fact_bis: Ang adlaw mao ang nag-unang gigikanan sa halos tanan nga enerhiya sa Yuta — sa pagkaon, hangin, ug bisan fossil fuel — nga mousab lang og porma human.

q: Willis Carrier is remembered for inventing the first modern air conditioner. What nickname did he earn for this?
options: The King of Cool
The Father of Air Conditioning
The Master of Cold
The Prince of Refrigeration
explanation: Willis Carrier is called the Father of Air Conditioning because he built the first modern air conditioner.
fact_tl: Si Willis Carrier ay tinaguriang "Ama ng Air Conditioning" dahil siya ang gumawa ng unang makabagong aircon.
fact_bis: Si Willis Carrier gitawag nga "Amahan sa Air Conditioning" tungod kay siya ang naghimo sa unang modernong aircon.

q: In a nerve cell (neuron), which part receives incoming signals from other neurons?
options: Axon
Cell membrane
Nucleus
Dendrites
explanation: Dendrites are the branching parts of a neuron that receive signals from other neurons and pass them to the cell body.
fact_tl: Ang neuron ay isang nerve cell na may mga dendrites na tumatanggap ng mga signal, isang cell body, at isang axon na nagpapadala ng mga signal patungo sa iba pang neuron o kalamnan.
fact_bis: Ang neuron usa ka nerve cell nga adunay mga dendrite nga nagdawat sa mga signal, usa ka cell body, ug usa ka axon nga nagpadala sa mga signal ngadto sa uban pang neuron o kaunuran.

q: After cleaning a wound, what should you do to help keep germs out?
options: Pour hot water on it every hour
Leave it open so it can dry in the air
Cover it with a bandage
Rub dirt on it to toughen the skin
explanation: After cleaning a wound, covering it with a bandage keeps germs out and protects the wound while it heals.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos linisin, takpan ang sugat ng benda para hindi mahawahan ng mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Human malimpyohi, tabuni ang samad ug bendahe aron dili masudlan sa mikrobyo.

q: According to the story, what inspired Galileo to study the pendulum?
options: A rock rolling down a hill
A swinging lamp he watched inside a church
A clock he saw in a market
A ball tied to a tree branch by children
explanation: Galileo is said to have been inspired to study the pendulum after observing a swinging lamp inside a church.
fact_tl: Sinasabing napansin ni Galileo ang pendulum nang mapagmasdan niya ang isang umuugoy na lampara sa simbahan.
fact_bis: Giingon nga gitun-an ni Galileo ang pendulum human niya makita ang naglabyog nga suga sa simbahan.

q: Why did the sea otter population fall from hundreds of thousands to only a few thousand in the past?
options: Their food supply ran out because humans overfished the ocean
They were killed in large numbers for their incredibly soft fur
Rising ocean temperatures destroyed their habitat
Disease spread by ships wiped most of them out
explanation: Sea otters were nearly wiped out because they were hunted for their very soft fur, used for clothing and blankets, leaving only a few thousand alive.
fact_tl: Dati, halos maubos ang sea otter dahil pinapatay sila para sa napakalambot nilang balahibo na ginagawang damit at kumot. Mula sa daan-daang libo, naiwan na lang ang ilang libo. Ngayon, protektado na sila ng batas at unti-unting dumarami ulit—isang halimbawa kung paano makatutulong ang tao para mabawi ang isang naglalahong hayop.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, halos mahurot ang sea otter kay gipamatay sila tungod sa ilang humok kaayo nga balahibo nga gihimong sanina ug habol. Gikan sa gatosan ka libo, pipila na lang ka libo ang nahibilin. Karon gipanalipdan na sila sa balaod ug hinay-hinay nga modaghan pag-usab—usa ka panig-ingnan unsaon pagtabang sa tawo aron mabawi ang nawala nga mananap.

q: During a typhoon, the wind suddenly becomes calm and the sky clears. What should you do?
options: Go outside quickly to check for damage before the storm returns
Head to the beach since the typhoon has passed
Stay indoors because the strong winds from the other side of the eyewall will return
Open all windows to let the fresh air in
explanation: The calm is only the eye passing over — the other side of the eyewall brings strong winds again, so people must stay indoors.
fact_tl: Kapag dumaan ang mata ng bagyo sa isang lugar, biglang tatahimik ang panahon, pero ito ay panandalian lang. Babalik ang malakas na hangin mula sa kabilang bahagi ng eyewall, kaya hindi dapat lumabas agad kahit mukhang tapos na ang bagyo.
fact_bis: Kung moagi ang mata sa bagyo sa usa ka lugar, kalit nga mokalma ang panahon, apan kini temporaryo lang. Mobalik ang kusog nga hangin gikan sa pikas bahin sa eyewall, mao nga dili angay mogawas bisan murag human na ang bagyo.

q: What does the inside of a durian fruit feel like?
options: Crunchy and dry like a biscuit
Watery and clear like a melon
Soft and creamy like custard or ice cream
Hard and fibrous like a coconut
explanation: When you open a durian, you find soft yellow flesh that feels like custard or ice cream, with a large seed inside each piece.
fact_tl: Kapag binuksan mo ang durian, makikita mo ang malambot at madilaw na laman na parang custard o ice cream. Sa loob ng bawat piraso ng laman ay may malaking buto.
fact_bis: Kung ablihan nimo ang durian, makita nimo ang humok ug dalag nga unod nga morag custard o ice cream. Sulod sa matag piraso sa unod adunay dako nga liso.

q: Which of the following minerals does the Philippines export to other countries from its mines?
options: Diamonds, rubies, and sapphires
Uranium, coal, and iron ore
Nickel, copper, and gold
Tin, mercury, and tungsten
explanation: The Philippines exports nickel, copper, gold, and other minerals from its mines, which contribute significantly to the country's economy.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nag-eeksport ng iba't-ibang mineral sa iba pang mga bansa; ang nikel, tanso, ginto, at iba pang mineral mula sa mga minahan ay nagbibigay ng malaking kita para sa ekonomiya ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas nag-eksport sa lain-laing mineral sa ubang mga nasud; ang nikel, tanso, ginto, ug uban pang mineral gikan sa mga minahan naghatag og dakong kita alang sa ekonomiya sa nasud.

q: When you blink your eyes one at a time while looking at two objects — one close and one far — which object seems to shift more?
options: Both shift by the same amount
The far object shifts more
Neither shifts at all
The near object shifts more
explanation: Near objects appear to shift more than far objects when you blink each eye alternately, because of the difference in angle (parallax) from each eye.
fact_tl: Kapag pinipikit mo ang mga mata nang salitan, ang malalapit na bagay ay tila lumilipat nang mas malaki kaysa sa malalayong bagay.
fact_bis: Kung pisukon nimo ang imong mga mata nga magsalit-salit, ang duol nga mga butang morag mobalhin og mas dako kaysa sa layo nga mga butang.

q: Besides having two ears, what helps you tell whether a sound is coming from above or below you?
options: The eardrum, which vibrates differently at different heights
The shape and folds of the outer ear (pinna), which slightly change the sound
The fluid in the inner ear, which tilts toward the sound source
The nerve endings inside the ear canal, which sense direction
explanation: The bumps and folds of the pinna slightly change a sound depending on whether it comes from above or below, giving a clue about the sound's height.
fact_tl: Hindi lang basta dalawang tainga ang gumagana, kundi pati yung mga kulubot at hubog ng pinna. Binabago ng mga ito ang tunog depende kung galing ito sa taas o sa baba, kaya kahit isang tainga lang, may pahiwatig kung nasa itaas o ibaba ang pinagmulan.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang duha ka dalunggan ang importante, apil pod ang mga kulubot ug pilo sa pinna. Gibag-o nila gamay ang tingog depende kung gikan ba kini sa taas o sa ubos, mao nga naa kay timailhan kung asa nga gihabogon ang gigikanan.

q: Why does a rechargeable battery hold less energy after being charged hundreds of times?
options: The battery slowly loses chemical ingredients through its outer casing
Each charge and use cycle slightly damages the materials inside the battery
The electricity stored inside gradually leaks out even when the battery is not used
The battery's wires corrode and slow down the flow of electricity
explanation: Every charge-and-use cycle slightly damages the materials inside a rechargeable battery, so after hundreds of cycles it can no longer hold as much energy as when it was new.
fact_tl: Humihina ang rechargeable na baterya habang tumatagal dahil sa bawat pag-charge at paggamit ay unti-unting nasisira ang mga sangkap sa loob nito, kaya pagkatapos ng daan-daang beses na pag-charge ay hindi na ito kayang humawak ng dating dami ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Maluya ang rechargeable nga baterya samtang molabay ang panahon tungod kay ang matag pag-charge ug paggamit hinay-hinay nga makadaot sa mga materyales sa sulod niini, busa human sa gatusan ka beses nga pag-charge dili na kini makakupot sa daghan nga enerhiya sama sa bag-o pa.

q: Why might someone put baking soda on an acidic bee sting to get relief?
options: Baking soda is a base that can neutralize the acid in the sting
Baking soda is an acid that matches the sting and cancels it out
Baking soda draws out the stinger buried under the skin
Baking soda cools the skin faster than water can
explanation: Because some stings are acidic, a mild base like baking soda can neutralize the acid and bring relief through a neutralization reaction.
fact_tl: May nagtatanong: bakit kapag nakagat ng langgam o bubuyog, minsan nilalagyan ng baking soda o suka? Ang ilang kagat ay maasim (acidic), kaya ang banayad na base gaya ng baking soda ay pwedeng mag-neutralize at makapagpaginhawa. Ngunit mag-ingat — hindi lahat ng kagat ay pareho, at mas mabuti pa ring magtanong sa nars o doktor.
fact_bis: Naa'y mangutana: ngano kung paakon sa langgam o buyog, usahay butangan og baking soda o suka? Ang uban nga paak kay asido, busa ang hinay nga base sama sa baking soda makahimo og neutralize ug makahatag og kahupayan. Apan pag-amping — dili tanan nga paak parehas, ug mas maayo gihapon nga mangutana sa nars o doktor.

q: Which organism is usually the first to grow on bare rock and begin turning it into soil?
options: Moss
Fern
Grass
Lichen
explanation: Lichen is typically the first organism (pioneer species) to grow on bare rock; it acidifies the surface and slowly breaks it down, creating soil for other plants.
fact_tl: Ang lichen ay ang karaniwang unang organismo na lumalaki sa hubad na bato — ina-acidify nito ang ibabaw ng bato, na nagpapabilis ng pagkagasgas nito at unti-unting gumagawa ng lupa kung saan maaari nang lumaki ang ibang halaman.
fact_bis: Ang lichen kasagaran ang unang organismo nga nagtubo sa hubad nga bato — kini nagpa-asido sa ibabaw sa bato, hinay-hinay nga nagpaagas niini ug nagmugna sa yuta diin ang ubang mga tanom makatubo.

q: How is light from the Sun able to reach Earth even though space has no air or water to travel through?
options: It travels inside the solar wind, which carries it across space
Light is an electromagnetic wave and needs no medium to travel
Tiny particles called photons use gravity as a path through space
It bounces off invisible gas molecules that fill the solar system
explanation: Unlike sound, electromagnetic waves need no medium, so light can travel through the vacuum of space to reach Earth from the Sun.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng tunog, ang electromagnetic wave ay hindi nangangailangan ng medium kaya nakakadaan ito sa vacuum ng kalawakan—kaya naaabot tayo ng liwanag ng araw at mga bituin.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa tingog, ang electromagnetic wave dili magkinahanglan ug medium, busa makaagi kini sa vacuum sa kawanangan—mao nga ang kahayag sa adlaw ug mga bituon makaabot kanato.

q: A jeepney travels 60 kilometers in exactly one hour. What is its speed?
options: 60 kilometers
60 kilometers per hour
1 hour per kilometer
120 kilometers per hour
explanation: If a jeepney covers 60 kilometers in one hour, its speed is 60 kilometers per hour — distance divided by time.
fact_tl: Kung ang isang dyip ay nakaabot ng 60 kilometro sa loob ng isang oras, ang bilis nito ay 60 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka dyip makaabot og 60 kilometro sulod sa usa ka oras, ang katulin niini 60 kilometro kada oras.

q: Instead of bees, what carries the pollen of rice flowers in Philippine farms?
options: Water flowing through the paddies
Butterflies attracted to the rice's scent
The wind
Ants that climb the rice stalks
explanation: Rice flowers are tiny with almost no colorful petals, and they rely on the wind to carry their pollen rather than bees.
fact_tl: Alam mo bang may bulaklak ang palay? Maliit lang ito at halos walang makulay na petals. Sa halip na bubuyog, ang hangin ang naglilipat ng pollen sa palay. Kaya nga maraming bukid sa Pilipinas ang nagkakaroon ng bigas!
fact_bis: Nahibal-an ba nimo nga ang humay adunay bulak? Gamay ra kini ug halos walay mabulukon nga petals. Imbis nga putyukan, ang hangin ang nagdala sa pollen sa humay. Mao nga daghang uma sa Pilipinas ang nakaani og bugas!

q: About how long was the dinosaur Argentinosaurus?
options: About 10 meters — roughly the length of one bus
About 35 meters — longer than three buses lined up
About 5 meters — roughly the size of a large car
About 60 meters — about as long as six buses lined up
explanation: Argentinosaurus reached about 35 meters in length, which is longer than three buses lined up end to end.
fact_tl: Ang Argentinosaurus ay umabot ng halos 35 metro ang haba, mas mahaba pa sa tatlong bus.
fact_bis: Ang Argentinosaurus mokabat og mga 35 ka metro ang gitas-on, mas taas pa sa tulo ka bus.

q: Can a person's blood type change as they grow older or after an illness?
options: Yes, it changes slowly as a person ages
Yes, certain diseases can permanently alter your blood type
No, a person's blood type stays the same for their whole life
No, but medicine can temporarily switch it during a transfusion
explanation: A person's blood type does not change — it stays the same from birth throughout their entire life.
fact_tl: Ang uri ng dugo ng isang tao ay hindi nagbabago at nananatiling pareho habambuhay.
fact_bis: Ang klase sa dugo sa usa ka tawo dili mausab ug magpabilin nga pareho sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi.

q: Why does a signal sent from Earth to a rover on Mars take several minutes to arrive?
options: Space is so cold that radio waves slow down before reaching Mars
The signal must first bounce off the Moon on its way to Mars
Even light travels at a fixed speed, so crossing a large distance takes time
The rover's antenna is small and can only receive weak signals slowly
explanation: Even light (and radio signals) travel at a fixed speed, so crossing the large distance between Earth and Mars takes several minutes.
fact_tl: Ang senyales mula sa Earth papunta sa isang rover sa Mars ay umaabot ng ilang minuto, dahil kahit ang liwanag ay may takdang bilis.
fact_bis: Ang signal gikan sa Earth paingon sa usa ka rover sa Mars moabot og pipila ka minuto, kay bisan ang kahayag adunay piho nga katulin.

q: On a distance-time graph, what is always true about the direction of the time axis?
options: Time can go forward or backward depending on the motion shown
Time always moves forward and the line never goes back to the left
Time resets to zero whenever an object stops moving
Time can move backward if the object reverses direction
explanation: On a distance-time graph, time always moves forward on the horizontal axis and never goes back — you cannot have a line moving left because time always flows forward.
fact_tl: Sa distance-time graph, ang oras (nasa pahigang axis) ay palaging gumagalaw pasulong lang at hindi kailanman bumabalik, kaya hindi puwedeng magkaroon ng linya na pabalik sa kaliwa — laging papunta sa kanan ang daloy ng panahon.
fact_bis: Sa distance-time graph, ang oras (anaa sa pahigda nga axis) kanunay molihok pasulong lang ug dili gyud mobalik, mao nga dili pwede nga adunay linya nga mobalik sa wala — kanunay padulong sa tuo ang dagan sa panahon.

q: Which cells in your eye help you see colors in bright light?
options: Rod cells
Lens cells
Pupil cells
Cone cells
explanation: The retina contains cone cells that allow you to see colors in bright light, while rod cells help you see in dim light.
fact_tl: Ang retina ng mata ay may dalawang uri ng mga photoreceptor: ang mga rod cells para sa pananaw sa mabababang liwanag, at ang mga cone cells para sa kulay.
fact_bis: Ang retina sa mata adunay duha ka klase sa photoreceptor: rod cells alang sa panan-aw sa bagunang kahayag, ug cone cells alang sa pagkita ug kolor sa hayag nga kahayag.

q: Who first drew a design for a parachute, more than 300 years before one was actually used?
options: Isaac Newton
Galileo Galilei
Leonardo da Vinci
Benjamin Franklin
explanation: Leonardo da Vinci drew a parachute design over 300 years before a parachute was actually used in practice.
fact_tl: Si Leonardo da Vinci ang unang gumuhit ng disenyo ng parachute mahigit 300 taon bago ito unang nagamit.
fact_bis: Si Leonardo da Vinci ang unang nagdrowing sa disenyo sa parachute kapin 300 ka tuig sa wala pa kini magamit.

q: How does an eagle's eyesight compare to a human's?
options: It is about the same sharpness as a human's
It is much weaker — eagles rely more on hearing to hunt
It is much sharper — it can spot a small animal from very high up in flight
It can only see clearly in darkness, not in daylight
explanation: An eagle's eyesight is much sharper than a human's, allowing it to spot small prey from a great height while in flight.
fact_tl: Ang paningin ng agila ay mas matalas kaysa sa tao — kaya nitong makita ang maliit na hayop mula sa napakataas at malayong lipad. Tumutulong ito sa pangangaso.
fact_bis: Ang panan-aw sa agila mas talinis kay sa tawo — makita niini ang gamayng hayop gikan sa taas ug layo kaayo nga paglupad. Motabang kini sa pagpangayam.

q: What can you easily see running through the center of a gumamela (hibiscus) flower?
options: A bright yellow pollen bag hanging from the petals
A short wide tube where the roots begin
A long central tube where the stamens and pistil are attached
A hollow seed pod at the base of each petal
explanation: The gumamela has a long central tube that is easy to notice, and both the stamens and the pistil are attached along it.
fact_tl: Sa gumamela na karaniwan sa Pilipinas, madaling makita ang mahabang tubo sa gitna kung saan nakadikit ang stamen at pistil.
fact_bis: Sa gumamela nga kasagaran sa Pilipinas, sayon makita ang taas nga tubo sa tunga diin nakadikit ang stamen ug pistil.

q: About how often are your taste buds replaced with new ones?
options: Every few hours
Every one to two weeks
Every six months
Once a year
explanation: Taste buds are replaced with new ones about every one to two weeks, which is why a burned tongue heals and taste returns after just a few days.
fact_tl: Ang mga taste buds ay napapalitan ng bago tuwing isa hanggang dalawang linggo. Kaya kapag napaso ng mainit na pagkain ang dila mo, gumagaling ito at bumabalik ang lasa pagkalipas ng ilang araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga taste buds mapulihan og bag-o matag usa hangtod duha ka semana. Mao nga kung mapaso sa init nga pagkaon ang imong dila, moayo kini ug mobalik ang lami human sa pipila ka adlaw.

q: Why are bacteria like E. coli used as workhorses in biotechnology?
options: They are the largest microorganisms and can carry the most DNA
They naturally produce all medicines on their own without being modified
They grow rapidly and can be engineered to produce important proteins and medicines
They destroy harmful chemicals in the lab, keeping scientists safe
explanation: Bacteria like E. coli are used in biotechnology because they grow rapidly and can be engineered to produce important proteins, medicines, and enzymes.
fact_tl: Ang mga bacteria tulad ng E. coli ay ginagamit bilang 'mga manggagawa' sa biotechnology — madali silang palakihin at maaaring ma-engineer upang gumawa ng mahahalagang protina, gamot, at enzymes.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakterya sama sa E. coli gigamit ingon 'mga trabahante' sa biotechnology — dali silang ilalaki ug mahimong i-engineer aron makahimo og importante nga mga protina, gamot, ug enzymes.

q: Why do the lymph nodes in your neck sometimes swell when you have an infection?
options: Blood rushes to the neck to keep the brain warm during a fever
Fluid from your throat drains into the lymph nodes and fills them up
The cells that fight the infection multiply inside the lymph nodes, making them swell
Germs hide inside the lymph nodes to avoid being attacked by the immune system
explanation: When you have an infection, the immune cells that fight the sickness multiply inside the lymph nodes, which causes the nodes to swell.
fact_tl: Kapag may impeksyon, namamaga ang mga kulani sa leeg dahil dumarami ang mga selula na lumalaban sa sakit.
fact_bis: Kung naa kay impeksyon, maghubag ang mga lymph nodes sa imong liog kay nagdaghan ang mga selula nga nakig-away sa sakit.

q: Why do nectar-sipping birds like sunbirds have long, thin beaks?
options: To crack open hard seeds that other birds cannot eat
To scoop fish out of shallow streams quickly
To reach deep inside flowers to sip nectar
To pry open the bark of trees to find insects
explanation: Sunbirds and similar nectar-feeding birds have long, thin beaks perfectly shaped for reaching deep inside flowers to drink the nectar.
fact_tl: Ang mga ibong sumisipsip ng nektar gaya ng tamsi ay may mahaba at manipis na tuka para makaabot sa loob ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga mosuyop ug nektar sama sa tamsi adunay taas ug nipis nga sungo aron makaabot sa sulod sa bulak.

q: Why is it easier to clean up an oil spill in the ocean compared to a spill that mixes completely with water?
options: Oil evaporates quickly in sunlight before it can spread very far
Oil sinks to the bottom where it can be vacuumed up easily
Oil floats on the surface, so workers can use barriers to gather and remove it
Oil breaks apart into harmless drops on its own within hours
explanation: Because oil floats on the surface of water, workers can use floating barriers to corral the oil and then scoop it up more easily.
fact_tl: Dahil lumulutang ang langis sa ibabaw, mas madaling tipunin at alisin ito kapag may natapong langis sa tubig. Gumagamit ang mga manggagawa ng harang na lumulutang para ipunin ang langis sa isang lugar bago sandukin.
fact_bis: Tungod kay naglutaw ang lana sa ibabaw, mas dali kining tigumon ug kuhaon kung adunay nayabo nga lana sa tubig. Mogamit ang mga trabahante og naglutaw nga babag aron tipunon ang lana sa usa ka dapit una kini sandukon.

q: What kind of food do goats prefer when they graze?
options: Old, dried grass that has been stored for a long time
Any grass they can find, whether dirty or clean
Fresh, clean grass — they often refuse grass that has been stepped on or is dirty
Grass mixed with mud near rivers and ponds
explanation: Goats are actually picky eaters — they prefer fresh, clean grass and often refuse to eat grass that has been stepped on or is dirty.
fact_tl: Mas mapili ang kambing kaysa sa karaniwang akala — gusto nito ng sariwa at malinis na damo, at madalas itong tumatanggi sa damong natapakan na o marumi.
fact_bis: Mas mapili ang kanding kaysa sa kasagarang gihunahuna — ganahan kini og lab-as ug limpyo nga sagbot, ug kasagaran mobalibad sa sagbot nga natumban na o hugaw.

q: When a big gear drives a small gear, which gear spins faster and why?
options: The big gear spins faster because it has more teeth pushing the small one
Both gears spin at the same speed because they are connected
The small gear spins faster because it has fewer teeth that need to pass by
The small gear spins slower because it has less mass to resist turning
explanation: When a big gear drives a small gear, the small gear spins faster because it has fewer teeth that need to pass by for each rotation of the big gear.
fact_tl: Kapag nagpaikot ang malaking gear sa maliit na gear, mas mabilis umikot ang maliit na gear. Mas kaunti kasi ang ngipin nito na kailangang dumaan.
fact_bis: Kung ang dakong gear magpatuyok sa gamay nga gear, mas paspas motuyok ang gamay nga gear. Tungod kay gamay ra ang ngipin niini nga kinahanglang molabay.

q: Unlike nutrients, energy is NOT recycled through a food pyramid. What does this mean for life on Earth?
options: Animals must eat rocks and minerals to get the energy they cannot recycle
New energy must keep arriving from the sun to power living things
Plants store used energy underground so animals can dig it up later
Energy stays inside dead animals and is passed back to plants through roots
explanation: Energy is not recycled back through the pyramid, so living things depend on the sun to keep supplying fresh energy.
fact_tl: Hindi naiuulit o nabalik ang enerhiya sa pyramid, kaya kailangang laging dumating ang bagong enerhiya mula sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya dili mabalik-balik sa pyramid, mao nga kinahanglan kanunayng moabot ang bag-ong enerhiya gikan sa adlaw.

q: What do an insect's two feelers (antennae) help it do?
options: Fly by spinning them like helicopter blades
Produce light to attract other insects at night
Smell things and sense its surroundings
Sting enemies when the insect feels threatened
explanation: An insect's antennae are used to smell and sense things in its environment, helping it find food and detect danger.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng insekto ay may dalawang sungot (antennae) sa ulo na ginagamit para makaamoy at makaramdam, at may matigas na panlabas na balat (exoskeleton) na nagsisilbing baluti sa katawan nila.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa mga insekto adunay duha ka sungot (antennae) sa ulo nga gigamit aron makasimhot ug makabati, ug adunay gahi nga gawas nga panit (exoskeleton) nga sama sa taming sa ilang lawas.

q: Who created the Mohs scale used to measure how hard a mineral is?
options: Charles Darwin in 1859
Isaac Newton in 1687
Friedrich Mohs in 1812
Marie Curie in 1903
explanation: The Mohs scale of mineral hardness was created by the German scientist Friedrich Mohs in 1812.
fact_tl: Ang Mohs scale ng tigas ng mineral ay ginawa ng German na si Friedrich Mohs noong 1812.
fact_bis: Ang Mohs scale sa katigasan sa mineral gihimo sa German nga si Friedrich Mohs niadtong 1812.

q: Why is it not a good idea to drink only distilled water every day?
options: It contains too many minerals that can harm your kidneys
It has no minerals, which the body also needs
It tastes too salty for daily use
It turns into a gas too quickly inside the body
explanation: Distilled water is safe but has no minerals, which the body needs, so we should get minerals from nutritious food instead.
fact_tl: Ligtas inumin ang distiladong tubig, pero hindi ito ang pinakamabuting palaging inumin dahil wala itong mineral na kailangan din ng katawan—kaya kumukuha tayo ng mineral mula sa masustansyang pagkain.
fact_bis: Luwas imnon ang distiladong tubig, apan dili kini ang labing maayo nga kanunay imnon kay wala kini'y mineral nga gikinahanglan usab sa lawas—busa magkuha kita og mineral gikan sa masustansyang pagkaon.

q: Which planet is an example of a very large planet in our solar system?
options: Mercury
Mars
Venus
Jupiter
explanation: Planets come in different sizes — Jupiter is one of the very large ones, while Mercury is one of the smallest.
fact_tl: Ang mga planeta ay may iba't ibang sukat; ang iba ay napakalaki tulad ng Jupiter at ang iba ay maliit tulad ng Mercury.
fact_bis: Ang mga planeta lainlain og gidak-on; ang uban dako kaayo sama sa Jupiter ug ang uban gamay sama sa Mercury.

q: About how tall does a Philippine eagle stand?
options: About 30 centimeters tall
About 1 meter tall
About 2 meters tall
About 50 centimeters tall
explanation: The Philippine eagle stands about 1 meter tall, making it one of the largest eagles in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine eagle ay tumataas nang mga 1 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine eagle motaas ug mga 1 ka metro.

q: Why do most trees in the Philippines stay green all year long?
options: They have extra thick leaves that do not fall off
The Philippines is a tropical country with no cold winter
Philippine trees absorb extra sunlight during the rainy season
The soil in the Philippines has special nutrients that keep leaves green
explanation: Most Philippine trees stay green all year because the country is warm and tropical with no cold winter season.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng punong Pilipino ay laging berde dahil mainit at walang malamig na taglamig sa tropikong bansa natin buong taon.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga kahoy sa Pilipinas kanunayng berde tungod kay init ug walay bugnaw nga tingtugnaw ang atong tropikanhong nasod sa tibuok tuig.

q: What is the capital city of India?
options: Mumbai
Kolkata
New Delhi
Bangalore
explanation: The capital of India is New Delhi, which serves as the country's center of government.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng India ay New Delhi.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa India mao ang New Delhi.

q: What is the main cause of tsunamis?
options: The pull of the moon on ocean water
Sudden ocean movements like underwater earthquakes or volcanoes
Strong storms pushing huge waves to shore
Very high ocean tides during a full moon
explanation: Tsunamis come from sudden ocean movements like quakes or volcanoes, not from tides caused by the moon.
fact_tl: Minsan tinatawag ang tsunami na "tidal wave" pero mali ito. Ang taog (tides) ay galing sa hila ng buwan at araw, samantalang ang tsunami ay galing sa biglang galaw ng dagat tulad ng lindol o bulkan, hindi sa buwan.
fact_bis: Usahay gitawag ang tsunami nga "tidal wave" apan sayop kini. Ang taob gikan sa pagbira sa bulan ug adlaw, samtang ang tsunami gikan sa kalit nga paglihok sa dagat sama sa linog o bulkan, dili sa bulan.

q: How does the sayote (chayote) plant grow?
options: It grows as a small bush close to the ground
It grows on a climbing vine
It grows as a tall tree with branches
It grows underground like a root crop
explanation: Sayote (chayote) is a vegetable that grows on a climbing vine and has a green, wrinkled skin.
fact_tl: Ang sayote ay isang gulay na tumutubo sa gumagapang na baging at may berde, kulubot na balat na maganda lutuing nilaga o ginisa.
fact_bis: Ang sayote kay usa ka utanon nga motubo sa nagakatay nga baging ug adunay berde, kunot nga panit nga maayo lutoon og linat-an o gisa.

q: What nutrient do the mung beans in ginisang monggo mainly provide?
options: Calcium for strong bones
Vitamin C to fight colds
Protein for body growth and repair
Carbohydrates for quick energy
explanation: The mung beans in ginisang monggo provide an affordable source of protein for the body.
fact_tl: Ang ginisang monggo ay sabaw ng pinakuluang monggo na may gulay tulad ng malunggay, at ang monggo ay nagbibigay ng murang pinagkukunan ng protina.
fact_bis: Ang ginisang monggo usa ka sabaw sa linuto nga monggo nga may utanon sama sa malunggay, ug ang monggo naghatag ug barato nga tinubdan sa protina.

q: Why is it better to eat many different kinds of food rather than only rice every day?
options: Because rice has too much sugar and will make you sick quickly
Because different foods give different nutrients that the body needs
Because eating only rice will make you gain too much weight
Because rice does not give your body any energy at all
explanation: Different foods give different nutrients, so eating a variety is better than eating only one type of food like rice.
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng iba't ibang uri ng pagkain ay mas mabuti kaysa sa kanin lamang, dahil iba't ibang pagkain ang nagbibigay ng iba't ibang sustansya.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon og lain-laing klase sa pagkaon mas maayo kay sa kan-on lang, kay lain-laing pagkaon naghatag og lain-laing sustansya.

q: What does the crown-of-thorns starfish eat, and why is this a problem?
options: It eats small fish eggs, reducing the fish population in the ocean
It eats coral, which can damage coral reefs
It eats seaweed, which causes coral to grow too fast
It eats sea urchins, which upsets the balance of the reef
explanation: The crown-of-thorns starfish eats coral and can damage coral reefs when its numbers grow too large.
fact_tl: Ang crown-of-thorns starfish ay isang malaking starfish na may maraming tinik na kumakain ng coral at maaaring makasira ng bahura.
fact_bis: Ang crown-of-thorns starfish usa ka dako ug daghan og tunok nga bituin sa dagat nga mokaon sa korales ug makadaot sa bahura.

q: What happens to the airways during an asthma attack?
options: The airways stretch open wider to let in more air
The muscles around the airways tighten and the lining swells, narrowing the passage
The lungs fill with fluid, blocking air from entering
The airway walls become thin and break, causing breathing to stop
explanation: During an asthma attack, the muscles around the airways tighten and the lining swells, making the path for air narrow.
fact_tl: Sa atake ng hika, humihigpit ang mga kalamnan sa palibot ng daluyan ng hangin at namamaga ang loob nito, kaya kumikitid ang daanan ng hangin.
fact_bis: Sa atake sa asma, mohugot ang mga kaunoran palibot sa agianan sa hangin ug maghubag ang sulod niini, mao nga mokitid ang agianan sa hangin.

q: What determines how bright a star looks from Earth?
options: Only the color of the star — brighter colors mean brighter stars
The size and heat of the star and how far away it is from Earth
Only how far away the star is — closer stars always look brighter
Only the age of the star — younger stars always look brighter
explanation: How bright a star looks depends on its size, heat, and distance from us, so a nearby star can look dim and a far one can look very bright.
fact_tl: Kung gaano kaliwanag ang tingin natin sa isang bituin ay nakadepende sa laki at init nito at kung gaano ito kalayo, kaya may malalapit na malabong bituin at malalayong napakaliwanag.
fact_bis: Kung unsa kahayag ang pagtan-aw nato sa usa ka bituon nagdepende sa gidak-on ug init niini ug kung unsa kini kalayo, busa adunay duol nga hanap ug halayo nga hayag kaayo.

q: Why is the gumamela (hibiscus) a good flower to study the parts of a flower?
options: Because it has no petals, making the inside easy to see
Because its stamen and pistil are large and easy to see
Because it only blooms at night when students can observe it
Because it has exactly four petals, one for each flower part
explanation: The gumamela (hibiscus) is large enough that the stamen and pistil are easy to see and study.
fact_tl: Ang gumamela ay isang malaking bulaklak sa Pilipinas kung saan madaling makita ang stamen at pistil.
fact_bis: Ang gumamela usa ka dako nga bulak sa Pilipinas diin sayon makita ang stamen ug pistil.

q: How do you calculate the momentum of a moving object?
options: Multiply its weight by its speed
Multiply its mass by its velocity
Add its mass and its velocity together
Divide its force by its speed
explanation: Momentum equals mass multiplied by velocity, which is a measure of an object's motion.
fact_tl: Ang momentum ay sukat ng galaw ng isang bagay, at ito ay katumbas ng masa nito na pinarami sa bilis nito.
fact_bis: Ang momentum mao ang sukod sa paglihok sa usa ka butang, ug kini parehas sa masa niini nga gipadaghan sa katulin niini.

q: Osmium is known for being the densest natural element. What is its density?
options: About 10.5 grams per cubic centimeter
About 22.6 grams per cubic centimeter
About 7.9 grams per cubic centimeter
About 19.3 grams per cubic centimeter
explanation: Osmium has a density of about 22.6 grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm³), making it the densest naturally occurring element.
fact_tl: Ang osmium ay may densidad na mga 22.6 gramo sa bawat cubic sentimetro (g/cm³).
fact_bis: Ang osmium adunay densidad nga mga 22.6 gramo kada cubic sentimetro (g/cm³).

q: How do towns along the Cagayan River use the river?
options: They use it only for irrigation of rice fields
They use it for fishing and for transport by boat
They use it mainly as a source of drinking water
They use it to generate electricity for nearby cities
explanation: Towns along the Cagayan River use it for fishing and for transport by boat.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga bayan sa tabi ng Ilog Cagayan ang ilog para sa pangisda at transportasyon gamit ang mga bangka.
fact_bis: Ang mga lungsod daplin sa Suba sa Cagayan naggamit niini alang sa pagpangisda ug transportasyon pinaagi sa bangka.

q: How can a person develop pneumonia even if they did not catch it directly?
options: By swimming in cold water immediately after recovering from a cold
By eating food that was not cooked properly during a fever
By developing it after another illness like flu or measles when the body is weak
By breathing smoke-filled air during an asthma attack
explanation: Sometimes pneumonia develops after another illness such as the flu or measles when the body has become weak.
fact_tl: Minsan, sumusunod ang pulmonya pagkatapos ng ibang sakit gaya ng trangkaso o tigdas kapag humina na ang katawan.
fact_bis: Usahay, mosunod ang pulmonya human sa lain nga sakit sama sa trangkaso o tigdas kung naluya na ang lawas.

q: What is one major downside of building a large hydroelectric dam?
options: It produces large amounts of carbon dioxide that pollute the air
Building the reservoir floods land and can force people living there to move away
The electricity it produces is very expensive compared to coal power
It kills fish in the river by making the water too cold
explanation: Although hydro power is clean, building a big reservoir floods land and sometimes forces people who live there to move away.
fact_tl: Bagaman malinis ang kuryenteng hydro, ang paggawa ng malaking imbakang lawa ay nagbabaha ng lupa at minsan ay napipilitang lumipat ang mga taong nakatira doon.
fact_bis: Bisan limpyo ang hydro nga kuryente, ang paghimo og dakong tinipigan nga linaw makabaha sa yuta ug usahay mapugos sa pagbalhin ang mga tawong nagpuyo didto.

q: What powers the Curiosity rover on Mars?
options: Large solar panels that collect sunlight on Mars
Wind turbines that spin in the Martian atmosphere
A nuclear (radioactive) energy source
Rechargeable batteries charged from an orbiting satellite
explanation: The Curiosity rover is powered by a nuclear (radioactive) energy source, not solar panels.
fact_tl: Ang Curiosity rover ay pinapaandar ng nuclear (radioactive) na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya, hindi solar panel.
fact_bis: Ang Curiosity rover gipadagan sa nuclear (radioactive) nga tinubdan sa enerhiya, dili solar panel.

q: What acceleration does Earth's gravity give to a falling object?
options: About 3.7 m/s²
About 9.8 m/s²
About 1.6 m/s²
About 25 m/s²
explanation: Earth's gravity gives a falling object an acceleration of about 9.8 meters per second squared.
fact_tl: Ang lakas ng grabidad sa lupa (acceleration) ay halos 9.8 m/s² (metro kada segundo kuwadrado).
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa yuta naghatag ug acceleration nga mga 9.8 m/s² (metro kada segundo kwadrado).

q: Which galaxy contains our Sun and solar system?
options: The Andromeda Galaxy
The Triangulum Galaxy
The Milky Way
The Whirlpool Galaxy
explanation: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Sun and the whole solar system.
fact_tl: Ang Milky Way ay ang galaksiyang kinabibilangan ng ating Araw at ng buong solar system.
fact_bis: Ang Milky Way mao ang galaksiya nga gilangkuban sa atong Adlaw ug sa tibuok solar system.

q: What was Eduardo Quisumbing known for in Philippine science?
options: He was the first Filipino to reach the summit of a high mountain
He researched Philippine medicinal plants and wrote an important book on native Philippine plants
He discovered a new species of coral reef fish found only in Philippine waters
He developed the first locally made fertilizer for Philippine rice farms
explanation: Eduardo Quisumbing was a prominent Filipino botanist who researched Philippine medicinal plants and wrote an important book on native Philippine plants.
fact_tl: Si Eduardo Quisumbing ay isang kilalang Pilipinong botanist na nagsaliksik ng mga halamang gamot ng Pilipinas at nagsulat ng mahalagang aklat tungkol sa mga katutubong halaman.
fact_bis: Si Eduardo Quisumbing usa ka bantog nga Pilipinong botanist nga nananaliksik sa mga halamang gamot sa Pilipinas ug nagsulat og importanteng libro bahin sa mga katutubo nga halaman sa Pilipinas.

q: Which layer of the skin contains blood vessels, nerves, sweat glands, and hair roots?
options: The epidermis, the outermost layer we can see
The dermis, the layer just beneath the outer skin
The subcutaneous layer, the deepest fatty layer
The keratin layer, the tough waterproof top layer
explanation: The dermis, found beneath the skin we see, holds the blood vessels, nerves, sweat glands, and hair roots.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng nakikita nating balat ay ang dermis — dito naroon ang ugat ng dugo, nerbiyos na nakakaramdam, glandula ng pawis, at ugat ng buhok, kaya ito ang pinakaabalang bahagi ng balat.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa panit nga atong makita anaa ang dermis — dinhi nagpuyo ang ugat sa dugo, ang nerbiyos nga mobati, ang glandula sa singot, ug ang gamot sa buhok, busa kini ang pinakaaktibo nga sapaw sa panit.

q: Astronauts float in space and feel weightless. What is still true about them?
options: They have no mass because gravity no longer acts on them
They still have mass even though they float
Their mass increases because of the lack of gravity
Their mass decreases by half compared to on Earth
explanation: Astronauts in space seem weightless and float, but they still have mass.
fact_tl: Ang mga astronaut sa kalawakan ay parang walang timbang at lumulutang, ngunit mayroon pa rin silang masa.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut sa kawanangan murag walay gibug-aton ug naglutaw, apan aduna gihapon silay masa.

q: Why do many flowers produce a sweet smell?
options: To warn animals that they are poisonous and should not be eaten
To attract insects like bees that help pollinate them
To absorb water from the air through their petals
To protect themselves from the cold at night
explanation: Many flowers smell sweet to attract insects like bees, which help pollinate the flower while visiting.
fact_tl: Maraming bulaklak ang mabango hindi para lang sa atin, kundi para makaakit ng mga insekto. Sinusundan ng bubuyog at iba pang insekto ang amoy papunta sa bulaklak, at habang naroon sila ay natutulungan nilang mapollinate ito.
fact_bis: Daghang bulak ang humot dili lang alang kanato, kondili aron makadani og mga insekto. Sundon sa buyog ug ubang insekto ang humot paingon sa bulak, ug samtang naa sila magtabang sila sa pagpollinate niini.

q: What is ratoon cropping in sugarcane farming?
options: Cutting sugarcane down to ground level so it dries up faster
Allowing new shoots to regrow from the roots after harvest, so replanting is not needed right away
Planting a new batch of seeds immediately after the old crop is removed
Soaking the harvested sugarcane in water to grow more sweetness
explanation: After sugarcane is harvested, new shoots can regrow from the remaining roots — this is called ratoon cropping, so the field does not need to be replanted immediately.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng pag-ani ng tubo, maaaring tumubo muli ang mga bagong shoot mula sa natirang ugat—tinatawag itong ratoon cropping—kaya hindi na kailangang magtanim muli agad.
fact_bis: Human moanhi ang tubo, motubo pag-usab ang bag-ong shoots gikan sa nahibilin nga gamot—gitawag og ratoon cropping—kaya dili na kinahanglan magtanom dayon.

q: Which planet is called Earth's twin because it is almost the same size as Earth?
options: Mars
Neptune
Saturn
Venus
explanation: Venus is almost the same size as Earth, which is why it is called Earth's twin.
fact_tl: Ang Venus ang halos kasinglaki ng Earth, kaya tinatawag itong kambal ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Venus halos parehas og gidak-on sa Earth, mao nga gitawag kini nga kambal sa Yuta.

q: What does the body of an earthworm look like?
options: It has six short legs and a hard outer shell
It has no legs and a soft, long body divided into many little rings
It has four stubby legs and a smooth, round body
It has many tiny legs and a stiff body covered in spines
explanation: An earthworm has no legs and a soft, long body divided into many little rings.
fact_tl: Ang bulate ay walang paa at may malambot, mahabang katawan na hatihati sa maliliit na bilog.
fact_bis: Ang bulate walay tiil ug adunay humok, taas nga lawas nga nabahinbahin sa daghang gagmay nga liningin.

q: What does the term 'sea level' mean?
options: The deepest point found at the bottom of the ocean
The average height of the ocean surface, used as a measuring point
The height at which ocean waves are at their highest during a storm
The line where the ocean water meets the sand on a beach
explanation: Sea level is the average height of the ocean surface, used as a measuring point for elevations on land.
fact_tl: Ang antas ng dagat ay ang karaniwang taas ng tubig-dagat na ginagamit bilang sukatan.
fact_bis: Ang lebel sa dagat mao ang kasarangang gitas-on sa tubig sa dagat nga gigamit nga sukdanan.

q: Where does tilapia naturally live?
options: In saltwater oceans and coral reefs
In freshwater such as rivers, lakes, and fishponds
In very deep ocean trenches where it is dark
In both saltwater and freshwater equally
explanation: Tilapia lives in freshwater such as rivers, lakes, and fishponds.
fact_tl: Ang tilapia ay nabubuhay sa tubig-tabang gaya ng mga ilog, lawa, at palaisdaan.
fact_bis: Ang tilapia nagpuyo sa tubig-tabang sama sa mga suba, lanaw, ug palaisdaan.

q: How does an MRI machine help doctors in a hospital?
options: It uses X-rays to find broken bones inside the body
It uses a very strong magnetic field to take clear pictures of the inside of the body without cutting the patient
It uses sound waves to create images of a baby inside the mother
It uses electricity to measure how fast the heart beats
explanation: An MRI machine uses a very strong magnetic field to take clear pictures of the inside of the body without cutting the patient open.
fact_tl: Sa ospital, may makinang tinatawag na MRI na gumagamit ng napakalakas na magnetic field para kumuha ng malinaw na larawan ng loob ng katawan, nang hindi kinakailangang operahan ang pasyente.
fact_bis: Sa ospital, adunay makina nga gitawag ug MRI nga naggamit ug kusog kaayo nga magnetic field aron makakuha ug tin-aw nga hulagway sa sulod sa lawas, nga dili na kinahanglan operahan ang pasyente.

q: What did Filipino Pedro Flores become famous for in America in the 1920s?
options: He invented the first wooden top toy that became popular in American schools
He popularized the yo-yo in America by setting up yo-yo factories
He introduced the game of sipa to American children as a new sport
He created a spinning wooden doll toy that was sold across the United States
explanation: Pedro Flores was the Filipino who popularized the yo-yo in America in the 1920s, setting up factories and introducing the toy worldwide.
fact_tl: Si Pedro Flores ang Pilipinong nag-popularize ng yo-yo sa Amerika noong dekada 1920, na nagtatag ng mga pabrika ng yo-yo at nagpakilala ng laruan sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Si Pedro Flores mao ang Pilipino nga nagpopular sa yo-yo sa Amerika niadtong 1920s, nagtukod og mga pabrika sa yo-yo ug nagpaila sa laruan sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: What part of a seesaw acts as the fulcrum?
options: The long flat board you sit on
The middle part that the board rests and balances on
The ends where you place your feet
The bolts that hold the board in place
explanation: The middle part a seesaw rests on is the fulcrum — it is what makes the seesaw a real lever.
fact_tl: Ang seesaw sa palaruan ay isang totoong lever! Ang gitna na sinasandalan ay ang fulcrum, at ang dalawang dulo ay kung saan kayo nakaupo. Kapag bumaba ang isang dulo, umakyat ang kabila.
fact_bis: Ang seesaw sa lingawan usa ka tinuod nga lever! Ang tunga nga gisandigan mao ang fulcrum, ug ang duha ka tumoy mao ang lingkoranan. Kon mokanaog ang usa ka tumoy, mosaka ang pikas.

q: Why does the sky look red or orange at sunset?
options: The sun itself changes color and turns red as it cools down in the evening
Sunlight travels through more atmosphere at sunset so most blue light scatters away, leaving red and orange
Red light from city lights mixes with moonlight to create a red glow
The ozone layer absorbs blue light in the evening and reflects red light back
explanation: At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, so most blue light scatters away and only red and orange light reach our eyes.
fact_tl: Sa pagsalubong ng araw, ang liwanag nito ay dumadaan sa mas makapal na bahagi ng atmospera — ang karamihan ng asul na liwanag ay nakakalat na at ang pula at orange lang ang nakakarating sa ating mga mata.
fact_bis: Sa pagsalop sa adlaw, ang suga niini moagi sa mas baga nga bahin sa atmospera — ang kadaghanan sa asul nga suga nakawagtang na ug pula ug orange ra ang makaabot sa atong mga mata.

q: What do armadillos use their strong claws for?
options: Climbing trees to find fruit and escape from predators
Digging burrows and finding food underground
Swimming in rivers by paddling through the water
Cracking open hard-shelled nuts for food
explanation: The armadillo has strong claws that it uses to dig burrows in the ground and to find food.
fact_tl: Ang armadillo ay may matitibay na kuko na ginagamit nito sa paghuhukay ng lungga sa lupa at paghahanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang armadillo adunay lig-on nga mga kuko nga gamiton niini sa pagkalot og lungag sa yuta ug sa pagpangita og pagkaon.

q: What was the first antibiotic ever discovered?
options: Aspirin
Penicillin
Amoxicillin
Ibuprofen
explanation: Penicillin was the first antibiotic, a medicine that kills bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang penicillin ang unang antibiotic, gamot na pumapatay ng mga bacteria.
fact_bis: Ang penicillin ang unang antibiotic, tambal nga mopatay sa mga bakterya.

q: Why are stick insects often kept in classrooms as pets?
options: They produce a harmless sticky substance that children enjoy touching
They are quiet, do not bite, and only need leaves to eat
They glow in the dark, making them easy to observe at night
They spin colorful webs that children can use for art projects
explanation: Stick insects are great classroom pets because they are quiet, do not bite, and only need leaves to eat, letting children observe camouflage and insect growth.
fact_tl: Madalas alagaan ang stick insect sa paaralan dahil tahimik, hindi nangangagat, at dahon lang ang kailangang pagkain. Magandang panuod para matutunan ng mga bata ang kamuflahe at paglaki ng insekto.
fact_bis: Sagad alagaan ang stick insect sa eskwelahan kay hilom, dili mopaak, ug dahon lang ang gikinahanglan nga pagkaon. Maayo kining tan-awon aron makakat-on ang mga bata bahin sa kamuflahe ug pagtubo sa insekto.

q: How does exercise help your body get more oxygen to your cells?
options: Exercise causes the blood to produce more red blood cells within minutes of activity
Your heart beats faster and your lungs breathe deeper, so blood carries more oxygen to every part of your body
Exercise opens tiny holes in the skin so oxygen can enter the body directly
Your stomach digests food faster during exercise, releasing oxygen stored in food
explanation: During exercise your heart beats faster and your lungs breathe deeper, so blood carries more oxygen to every part of your body.
fact_tl: Pag nag-eehersisyo ka, mas mabilis tumibok ang puso at humihinga ang baga, kaya mas maraming oksiheno ang nadadala ng dugo sa bawat bahagi ng katawan mo.
fact_bis: Kung mag-ehersisyo ka, mas paspas motibok ang kasingkasing ug moginhawa ang baga, mao nga mas daghang oksiheno ang madala sa dugo ngadto sa tibuok lawas.

q: What is the difference between weather and climate?
options: Weather is measured in degrees, while climate is measured in millimeters of rain
Weather changes from day to day, but climate is the usual pattern of weather in a place over many years
Weather only happens in cities, while climate describes weather in the countryside
Weather is caused by the sun, while climate is caused by the ocean
explanation: Weather changes from day to day, but climate is the usual pattern of weather in a place over many years.
fact_tl: Ang panahon ay nagbabago araw-araw, ngunit ang klima ay ang karaniwang panahon ng isang lugar sa loob ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Ang panahon mausab matag adlaw, apan ang klima mao ang naandang sumbanan sa panahon sa usa ka lugar sulod sa daghang tuig.

q: Where do meerkats sleep and hide from danger?
options: In nests built high up in trees to avoid ground predators
In burrows they dig underground
In hollow logs found on the desert floor
In shallow pools of water during the hottest part of the day
explanation: Meerkats dig burrows underground where they sleep and hide from danger.
fact_tl: Ang mga meerkat ay humuhukay ng mga lungga sa ilalim ng lupa kung saan sila natutulog at nagtatago.
fact_bis: Ang mga meerkat nagakalot og mga lungib ilalom sa yuta diin sila matulog ug magtago.

q: Why do your teeth chatter when you are very cold?
options: Your mouth opens and closes automatically as your body tries to drink warm air
Your jaw muscles shiver as part of the same body reflex that warms you up
Your teeth expand slightly from the cold, causing them to knock together
The cold makes your tongue stiffen and push against your teeth
explanation: When it is very cold, shivering includes the jaw muscles, causing teeth to chatter — this is part of the reflex that warms the body.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang lamig, kasama sa nginig ang mga kalamnan ng panga, kaya nagngangalit o kumakalampag ang iyong ngipin. Ito ay parte rin ng parehong reflex na nagpapainit ng katawan.
fact_bis: Kon grabe ang bugnaw, apil sa kurog ang mga kaunoran sa apapangig, mao nga mag-kalagatak ang imong ngipon. Bahin kini sa samang reflex nga magpainit sa lawas.

q: What is the Filipino name for the prayer 'Glory Be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit'?
options: Ama Namin
Luwalhati sa Ama
Mga Kabanalan
Hesus Ko
explanation: 'Luwalhati sa Ama' is the Filipino name for the Glory Be prayer, honoring the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
fact_tl: Luwalhati sa Ama, at sa Anak, at sa Espiritu Santo. Kapara noong unang-una, ngayon at magpakailanman, at magpasawalang-hanggan. Amen.
fact_bis: Himaya sa Amahan, ug sa Anak, ug sa Espiritu Santo. Maingon sa sinugdan, karon ug sa gihapon, hangtod sa kahangtoran. Amen.

q: What happens to light when it hits a calm, still lake?
options: It is absorbed by the water and converted into heat
It reflects off the surface like a mirror, showing an image of the sky
It bends downward and lights up the bottom of the lake
It scatters in all directions, making the water glow softly
explanation: Calm, still water reflects light like a mirror and shows an image of the sky above it.
fact_tl: Ang tahimik at kalmadong tubig ng lawa ay tumatalbog ng liwanag tulad ng salamin at nagpapakita ng larawan ng langit.
fact_bis: Ang hilom ug kalmado nga tubig sa lanaw mobalik sa kahayag sama sa salamin ug magpakita sa hulagway sa langit.
