explanation: Neptune has the longest year (about 165 Earth years) because it is the farthest planet from the Sun.
fact_tl: Ang Neptune ang may pinakamahabang taon (mga 165 taon ng Earth) dahil ito ang pinakamalayong planeta sa Araw.
fact_bis: Ang Neptune mao ang may labing taas nga tuig (mga 165 ka tuig sa Earth) kay kini ang labing layo nga planeta sa Adlaw.

q: What happens to aerodynamic drag as a vehicle moves faster?
options: The drag force gets greater, so the engine must work harder to overcome it
The drag force gets smaller because the air moves out of the way more quickly
The drag force stays the same no matter how fast the vehicle goes
The drag force reverses direction and begins to push the vehicle forward
explanation: Aerodynamic drag is the air resistance force opposing a vehicle's motion — the faster the vehicle, the greater the drag force the engine must overcome.
fact_tl: Ang aerodynamic drag ay ang puwersa ng hangin na sumasalungat sa paggalaw ng sasakyan — mas mabilis ang sasakyan, mas malaki ang drag na kailangang labanan ng makina.
fact_bis: Ang aerodynamic drag mao ang puwersa sa hangin nga nagsukol sa lihok sa sasakyan — mas paspas ang sasakyan, mas dako ang drag nga kinahanglan labanan sa makina.

q: What gas is released when coal and oil containing sulfur are burned?
options: Sulfur dioxide
Carbon monoxide
Nitrogen oxide
Methane
explanation: Burning coal and oil that contain sulfur releases sulfur dioxide, a gas that can cause acid rain.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ng karbon at langis na may asupre (sulfur) ay naglalabas ng sulfur dioxide, isang gas na maaaring magdulot ng acid rain.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog sa karbon ug lana nga adunay sulfur mogawas og sulfur dioxide, usa ka gas nga makahimo og acid rain.

q: Why can a nautilus only see blurry images?
options: Its eyes are simple pinhole eyes with no lens
Its eyes are covered by a thick layer of skin
Its eyes are pointed backward instead of forward
Its eyes can only detect light and dark, not shapes
explanation: The nautilus has simple pinhole eyes with no lens, so it can only see blurry images.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng nautilus ay parang simpleng butas lamang na walang lente, kaya malabo ang nakikita nito.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa nautilus sama ra sa yano nga lungag nga walay lente, mao nga hanap ra ang makita niini.

q: Which type of radiation has the shortest wavelength and highest energy in the electromagnetic spectrum?
options: Gamma rays
X-rays
Ultraviolet rays
Microwaves
explanation: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and highest energy in the spectrum; they come from nuclear changes and are used to treat cancer and sterilize hospital equipment.
fact_tl: Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaikling wavelength at pinakamataas na enerhiya sa spectrum; nagmumula ito sa mga nuclear na pagbabago at ginagamit sa paggamot ng cancer at pag-sterilize ng kagamitan sa ospital.
fact_bis: Ang gamma rays adunay kinamub-ang wavelength ug kinatas-ang kusog sa spectrum; gikan kini sa mga nuclear nga pagbag-o ug gigamit sa pagtambal sa kanser ug pag-sterilize sa kagamitan sa ospital.

q: What plant part is black pepper made from?
options: Small berries from a climbing vine that are picked and dried
Seeds scraped from the inside of a large tree bark
The dried roots of a pepper bush dug up after harvest
Dried flower petals ground into a fine powder
explanation: Black pepper is made from the small berries of a climbing vine that are picked and dried until they wrinkle and turn black, then ground into a spice.
fact_tl: Ang itim na paminta ay gawa sa maliliit na bunga ng isang gumagapang na halaman na pinitas at pinatuyo hanggang sa magkulubot at maging itim. Ito ay ginigiling para gawing pampalasa.
fact_bis: Ang itom nga paminta hinimo gikan sa gagmay nga bunga sa usa ka nagkatay nga tanom nga gipupo ug gipauga hangtod kini mokulot ug maitom. Giliton kini aron himuong panakot.

q: Why does a shrimp struggle to breathe when the water gets very warm?
options: Warm water holds less oxygen, making it harder to breathe through its gills
Warm water makes its gills swell shut so no water can pass through
Warm water causes the shrimp to move faster, using up all its energy
Warm water is denser and too heavy for the shrimp's gills to filter
explanation: Warm water holds less oxygen, so when it gets too hot a shrimp struggles to breathe through its gills.
fact_tl: Mas kaunti ang oxygen sa mainit na tubig, kaya kapag sobrang init, nahihirapang huminga ang hipon sa pamamagitan ng hasang nito at minsan umaakyat ito sa ibabaw kung saan may hangin.
fact_bis: Mas gamay ang oxygen sa init nga tubig, busa kung init kaayo, maglisod og ginhawa ang hipon pinaagi sa hasang niini ug usahay mosaka kini sa ibabaw diin naay hangin.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the element polonium?
options: Po
Pm
Pl
Pn
explanation: The chemical symbol for polonium is Po.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng elementong polonium ay Po.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga simbolo sa elemento nga polonium kay Po.

q: Who discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter in 1610?
options: Galileo Galilei
Isaac Newton
Nicolaus Copernicus
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Galileo Galilei discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter in 1610.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo Galilei ang apat na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter noong 1610.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan ni Galileo Galilei ang upat ka pinakadako nga bulan sa Jupiter niadtong 1610.

q: What is a fish pen used for in aquaculture?
options: Raising fish like milkfish and tilapia inside a large net enclosure until they are big enough to harvest
Catching wild fish at sea using a large floating cage that traps them
Storing freshly caught fish in cold water to keep them fresh before selling
Breeding rare fish for scientific study in a controlled laboratory
explanation: A fish pen is a large net enclosure in a lake or sea where fish such as milkfish and tilapia are raised and fed until they are big enough to harvest.
fact_tl: Ang fish pen ay isang malaking kulungan na lambat sa lawa o dagat kung saan inaalagaan at pinapakain ang mga isda tulad ng bangus at tilapia hanggang sa lumaki para anihin.
fact_bis: Ang fish pen usa ka dako nga kulungan nga pukot sa lanaw o dagat diin gialagaan ug gipakaon ang mga isda sama sa bangus ug tilapia hangtod nga modako kini aron anihon.

q: What does an energy pyramid measure at each level of a food chain?
options: The amount of energy stored at each level, showing the top is always smallest
The number of animals living at each level, showing the top has the most
The weight of all organisms at each level, showing the bottom is lightest
The speed at which organisms move energy through the ecosystem
explanation: An energy pyramid is measured by the amount of energy stored at each level, which shows the top is always smaller.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ang pyramid ng enerhiya ayon sa dami ng enerhiyang naipon sa bawat antas, kaya nakikita na laging mas maliit ang itaas.
fact_bis: Ang pyramid sa enerhiya gisukod sumala sa gidaghanon sa enerhiya nga natipon sa matag lebel, busa makita nga ang taas kanunay mas gamay.

q: Where do hornbill chicks hatch and grow until they are nearly ready to fly?
options: Inside the sealed nest
In a shallow nest in the treetops
On the ground beneath the tree
Inside a cave near the nesting tree
explanation: Inside the sealed nest the eggs hatch, and the chicks grow there until they are nearly ready to fly.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng saradong pugad napipisa ang mga itlog at doon lumalaki ang mga inakay hanggang sila ay halos handa nang lumipad.
fact_bis: Sulod sa sirado nga salag mapusa ang mga itlog, ug didto motubo ang mga piso hangtod hapit na sila andam molupad.

q: What remarkable thing did tardigrades do in 2007 when sent into space?
options: They survived the vacuum and radiation outside the spacecraft
They reproduced and laid eggs in zero gravity
They grew much larger due to the lack of gravity
They changed color to protect themselves from solar radiation
explanation: In 2007, some tardigrades were sent into space and survived the vacuum and radiation outside the spacecraft.
fact_tl: Noong 2007, ang ilang tardigrade ay ipinadala sa kalawakan at nakaligtas sa vacuum at radiation sa labas ng spacecraft.
fact_bis: Niadtong 2007, ang ubang tardigrade gipadala sa kalawakan ug nakalahutay sa vacuum ug radiation sa gawas sa spacecraft.

q: Where is Davao Gulf located in the Philippines?
options: In the southeastern part of Mindanao, near Davao City
In the northeastern part of Luzon, near Cagayan Valley
In the central part of the Visayas, near Cebu City
In the southwestern part of Palawan, near Puerto Princesa
explanation: Davao Gulf is in the southeastern part of Mindanao, near Davao City.
fact_tl: Ang Golpo ng Davao (Davao Gulf) ay nasa timog-silangang bahagi ng Mindanao, malapit sa Lungsod ng Davao.
fact_bis: Ang Gulpo sa Davao (Davao Gulf) anaa sa habagatang-sidlakang bahin sa Mindanao, duol sa Dakbayan sa Davao.

q: How do school gardens help students in the school feeding program?
options: The vegetables grown on campus are harvested and used to feed the children fresher and cheaper food
The gardens teach students to sell vegetables and earn money for school supplies
The school gardens attract butterflies and insects that students study in science class
The harvested vegetables are sold to nearby markets to fund school field trips
explanation: Some schools grow vegetables on campus in school gardens; the harvested vegetables are used in the feeding program so children are fed fresher and cheaper food.
fact_tl: May mga paaralang nagtatanim ng sariling gulay sa loob ng kampus, tinatawag itong Gulayan sa Paaralan. Ang mga aning gulay tulad ng kangkong, talong, o malunggay ay ginagamit sa feeding program, kaya mas sariwa at mas mura ang ipinapakain sa mga bata.
fact_bis: Adunay mga eskwelahan nga nagtanom og kaugalingong utanon sulod sa kampus, gitawag kini nga Gulayan sa Eskwelahan. Ang naani nga utanon sama sa kangkong, talong, o malunggay gamiton sa feeding program, mao nga mas presko ug mas barato ang ipakaon sa mga bata.

q: How do plant roots absorb water from the soil?
options: By osmosis, where water flows from the wet soil into the root cells
By suction, where the leaves pull water upward and the roots follow
By capillary action alone, where thin tubes draw water sideways into the stem
By photosynthesis, which creates a chemical that attracts water into the roots
explanation: Roots absorb water by osmosis, where water flows from the wet soil into the root cells.
fact_tl: Sumisipsip ang ugat ng tubig sa pamamagitan ng osmosis, kung saan dumadaloy ang tubig mula sa basang lupa patungo sa mga selula ng ugat.
fact_bis: Ang gamot mosuyop og tubig pinaagi sa osmosis, diin ang tubig moagos gikan sa basa nga yuta paingon sa mga selula sa gamot.

q: Why do things rot much faster in the Philippines than in cold countries?
options: Decomposers release nutrients faster when it is warm and moist, so tropical warmth speeds up the process
The Philippines has more rain, which washes nutrients directly into the soil without decomposers
Bacteria in tropical countries are larger and more numerous than those in cold places
Sunlight in tropical areas bleaches organic matter, making it dissolve more quickly
explanation: Decomposers release nutrients faster when it is warm and moist — in a tropical country like the Philippines, things rot quickly, while cold places slow the process.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis maglabas ng sustansya ang mga decomposers kapag mainit at basa ang paligid — kaya sa tropikal na bansa tulad ng Pilipinas, mabilis mabulok ang mga bagay. Sa malalamig na lugar, mas mabagal sila, kaya mas matagal bago mabalik ang sustansya sa lupa.
fact_bis: Mas paspas mogawas og sustansya ang mga decomposers kon init ug basa ang palibot — mao nga sa tropikal nga nasod sama sa Pilipinas, paspas madunot ang mga butang. Sa bugnaw nga dapit, mas hinay sila, mao nga mas dugay mabalik ang sustansya sa yuta.

q: Why is steel used to make strong permanent magnets?
options: Because steel keeps its magnetism once it has been magnetized
Because steel is the lightest metal, making magnets easy to carry
Because steel has no magnetic properties of its own so it can be fully reprogrammed
Because steel melts at a low temperature, making it easy to shape into magnets
explanation: Steel can be made into a strong permanent magnet because it keeps its magnetism.
fact_tl: Ang asero (steel) ay maaaring gawing malakas at permanenteng magnet dahil pinapanatili nito ang pagka-magnet.
fact_bis: Ang asero (steel) mahimong himoon nga kusgan ug permanente nga magnet kay magpabilin niini ang pagka-magnet.

q: How does the vacuum in a thermos flask keep your drink hot or cold?
options: It stops heat from moving by conduction and convection, and shiny surfaces reduce radiation
It absorbs the heat from inside the flask and releases it slowly through the walls
It freezes the air around the liquid so that no heat can pass in either direction
It creates a partial vacuum that thickens the liquid and slows down heat loss
explanation: A thermos flask has a vacuum between two walls that stops conduction and convection, while shiny surfaces reduce radiation, preventing heat transfer.
fact_tl: Ang thermos flask ay gumagamit ng vacuum sa pagitan ng dalawang dingding para pigilan ang heat transfer — ang vacuum ay pumipigil sa conduction at convection, at ang shiny na ibabaw ay pumipigil sa radiation.
fact_bis: Ang thermos flask adunay vacuum tali sa duha ka dingding aron mapugngan ang heat transfer — ang vacuum nagpugong sa conduction ug convection, ug shiny nga mga ibabaw nagpababa sa radiation.

q: When you rub a balloon on your hair and it sticks to the wall, what caused that attraction?
options: Rubbing moved electrons from one object to the other, giving them opposite charges that attract
Rubbing created a tiny magnet inside the balloon that was pulled toward metal in the wall
Rubbing heated the balloon surface so it melted slightly and stuck like glue
Rubbing removed air from between the balloon and wall, creating a suction force
explanation: Rubbing transfers electrons between objects; the object that loses electrons becomes positive and the one that gains them becomes negative, and opposite charges attract.
fact_tl: Ang static na puwersa ay nagmumula sa maliliit na bagay na tinatawag na electron. Kapag kinuskos mo ang dalawang bagay, lumilipat ang ilang electron mula sa isa papunta sa isa. Ang nawalan ng electron ay nagiging positibo, at ang nadagdagan ay nagiging negatibo. Dahil magkasalungat na sila ng charge, naa-attract sila sa isa't isa.
fact_bis: Ang static nga puwersa naggikan sa gagmay nga mga butang nga gitawag og electron. Kung imong kuskuson ang duha ka butang, molukso ang pipila ka electron gikan sa usa ngadto sa lain. Ang nawad-an og electron mahimong positibo, ug ang nadugangan mahimong negatibo. Tungod kay magkasumpaki na silang charge, magdani sila sa usag usa.

q: How much iodine does the body need each day?
options: Only a very tiny amount, but it is still very important
At least one full gram to support normal growth
About the same amount as calcium, which the body needs a lot of
A large amount that must come from eating seafood every single day
explanation: The body needs only a tiny amount of iodine each day, but that tiny amount is very important.
fact_tl: Napakaliit na halaga lang ng iodine ang kailangan ng katawan araw-araw, pero mahalaga ito.
fact_bis: Gamay ra kaayo nga iodine ang gikinahanglan sa lawas kada adlaw, apan importante kini.

q: Which gases are responsible for the green and red colors seen in auroras?
options: Oxygen produces green and red, while nitrogen produces purple and blue
Nitrogen produces green and red, while oxygen produces purple and blue
Hydrogen produces green and red, while helium produces purple and blue
Carbon dioxide produces green and red, while argon produces purple and blue
explanation: Auroras glow in different colors because green and red come from oxygen while purple and blue come from nitrogen high in the air.
fact_tl: Iba-iba ang kulay ng aurora dahil ang berde at pula ay nanggagaling sa oxygen samantalang ang lila at asul ay galing sa nitrogen sa mataas na hangin.
fact_bis: Lahi-lahi ang kolor sa aurora kay ang berde ug pula gikan sa oxygen samtang ang purple ug asul gikan sa nitrogen sa taas nga hangin.

q: If you are caught outside in an open area during a lightning storm, what should you do?
options: Crouch low with feet together and head down between your knees
Lie flat on the ground so you are as low as possible
Stand still with arms raised to signal for help
Run to the nearest tall tree for shelter
explanation: If caught outside during lightning, you should crouch low with feet together and head down — crouching makes you a smaller target while minimizing ground current risk.
fact_tl: Kung nahuli ka sa labas sa panahon ng kidlat, lumukbo nang mababa, ipikit ang mga paa, itago ang ulo sa pagitan ng mga tuhod, at huwag humiga sa lupa — ang pagsuntok nang mababa ay nagpapaliit ng target para sa kidlat.
fact_bis: Inig maabtan ka sa gawas sa panahon sa kidlat, lumukbo nga ubos nga magkasabay ang tiil, ulo ubos sa taliwala sa mga tuhod, ug ayaw pagkahimutang nga flat sa yuta — ang paglubo nagpagamay sa target samtang nagpaminus sa risgo sa ground current.

q: How does a sinkhole form in areas with a lot of limestone underground?
options: Water dissolves the limestone underground, leaving a hollow that suddenly collapses into a hole
Heat from the Earth's core melts the limestone, causing the ground above to sink slowly
Earthquakes break the limestone into small pieces that wash away and leave a pit
Wind erosion gradually wears away the limestone from the surface downward
explanation: When limestone dissolves underground, it can leave a hollow that suddenly collapses into a hole called a sinkhole.
fact_tl: Kapag natunaw ang limestone sa ilalim ng lupa, maaaring magkaroon ng butas na biglang gumuho na tinatawag na sinkhole.
fact_bis: Kung matunaw ang limestone sa ilawom sa yuta, mahimong adunay lungag nga kalit nga mahugno, gitawag og sinkhole.

q: What does a carabao eat when it wades into shallow water or rice paddies?
options: Grasses and plants growing in the water
Small fish and frogs that live in the mud
Insects found floating on the water surface
Algae and mud scooped from the bottom
explanation: A carabao often wades into shallow water or rice paddies and grazes on the grasses and plants growing there.
fact_tl: Madalas pumunta ang kalabaw sa mababaw na tubig o palayan at kumakain ng mga damo at halaman na tumutubo doon.
fact_bis: Kasagaran moadto ang kalabaw sa mabaw nga tubig o basakan ug mokaon sa mga kumpay ug tanom nga motubo didto.

q: Why is jackfruit considered nutritious for children?
options: It contains vitamins that help keep children's bodies healthy and strong
It has a tough skin that builds strong teeth when chewed
It produces a sweet juice that replaces the need to drink water
It is the heaviest fruit, so eating it gives children the most energy
explanation: Jackfruit is tasty and nutritious because it has vitamins that help keep children's bodies healthy and strong.
fact_tl: Masarap at masustansya ang langka dahil may taglay itong bitamina. Nakakatulong ito para maging malusog at malakas ang katawan ng mga bata.
fact_bis: Lami ug masustansya ang nangka kay naa kini bitamina. Makatabang kini aron mahimong himsog ug kusgan ang lawas sa mga bata.

q: Who is the unit of electrical resistance, the ohm, named after?
options: Georg Ohm
Andre-Marie Ampere
Alessandro Volta
James Watt
explanation: The ohm (Ω), the unit of electrical resistance, is named after Georg Ohm.
fact_tl: Ang ohm (Ω), ang yunit ng resistensya sa kuryente, ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm.
fact_bis: Ang ohm (Ω), ang yunit sa resistensya sa kuryente, ginganlan kay Georg Ohm.

q: In what year did the first successful airplane flight take place?
explanation: The first successful airplane flight was in 1903.
fact_tl: Ang unang matagumpay na paglipad ng eroplano ay noong 1903.
fact_bis: Ang unang malampuson nga paglupad sa eroplano kadto niadtong 1903.

q: Which insect holds the record as the smallest in the world?
options: The fairyfly (Dicopomorpha echmepterygis)
The flea
The fruit fly
The dust mite
explanation: The smallest insect is the fairyfly (Dicopomorpha echmepterygis), which is only about 0.139 mm long.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaliit na insekto ay ang fairyfly (Dicopomorpha echmepterygis), na mga 0.139 mm lamang ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang pinakagamay nga insekto mao ang fairyfly (Dicopomorpha echmepterygis), nga mga 0.139 mm lang ang gitas-on.

q: What is it called when a living animal makes its own light?
options: Bioluminescence
Photosynthesis
Fluorescence
Phosphorescence
explanation: When a living animal makes its own light, it is called bioluminescence.
fact_tl: Ang paggawa ng sariling liwanag ng isang nabubuhay na hayop ay tinatawag na bioluminescence.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka buhi nga hayop maghimo og kaugalingong kahayag, gitawag kini nga bioluminescence.

q: What is the difference between magma and lava?
options: Magma is molten rock still underground, while lava is molten rock that has reached the surface
Magma is cooled and hardened rock underground, while lava is still molten inside the volcano
Magma is a gas that escapes from volcanoes, while lava is the liquid rock that follows
Magma only forms during eruptions, while lava exists deep underground all the time
explanation: Molten rock is called magma while it is still underground, but it is called lava once it reaches the surface.
fact_tl: Ang tunaw na bato ay tinatawag na magma habang ito ay nasa ilalim ng lupa, ngunit nagiging lava ang tawag kapag lumabas na ito sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang tinunaw nga bato gitawag ug magma samtang anaa pa kini sa ilalom sa yuta, apan mahimo na kining lava kung mogawas na sa ibabaw.

q: What did Isaac Newton discover when he shone white light through a prism?
options: White light is made of all the colors of the rainbow
White light travels faster than colored light through glass
A prism turns white light into heat energy
White light contains only red and blue wavelengths mixed together
explanation: Isaac Newton used a prism to show that white light is made of all the colors of the rainbow.
fact_tl: Ipinakita ni Isaac Newton gamit ang prisma na ang puting liwanag ay binubuo ng lahat ng kulay ng bahaghari.
fact_bis: Gigamit ni Isaac Newton ang prisma aron ipakita nga ang puti nga kahayag gilangkuban sa tanang kolor sa bangaw.

q: How many moons does Mars have?
options: One moon called Phobos
Two moons called Phobos and Deimos
Three moons called Phobos, Deimos, and Ares
No moons at all
explanation: Mars has exactly two moons named Phobos and Deimos.
fact_tl: Ang Mars ay may dalawang (2) buwan: Phobos at Deimos.
fact_bis: Ang Mars adunay duha (2) ka bulan: Phobos ug Deimos.

q: What happens inside a fuse when too much electricity flows through it?
options: It stores the extra electricity for later use
A thin metal strip inside melts and cuts the current
It sends the extra electricity to the ground
It beeps to warn the household
explanation: A fuse contains a thin metal strip that melts when too much current flows, cutting the circuit to prevent fires.
fact_tl: Ang fuse ay may manipis na bakal sa loob na natutunaw kapag sobra ang kuryente, kaya naputol ang daloy at hindi nasusunog ang bahay. Katulad ito ng breaker, pero kailangang palitan ang fuse kapag natunaw na.
fact_bis: Ang fuse naay nipis nga metal sa sulod nga matunaw kung sobra ang koryente, busa maputol ang agos ug dili masunog ang balay. Sama kini sa breaker, apan kinahanglan ilisan ang fuse kung matunaw na kini.

q: When you test objects in a basin of water, what mainly determines whether an object floats or sinks?
options: The color of the object
How smooth the surface of the object is
How heavy the material is compared with water
How warm or cold the water is
explanation: Whether an object floats or sinks depends on how heavy the material is compared with water.
fact_tl: Kapag sinubukan natin sa palanggana ng tubig, may mga bagay na lumulutang at may lumulubog, depende sa kung gaano kabigat ang materyales kumpara sa tubig.
fact_bis: Kon sulayan nato sa planggana nga tubig, naay mga butang nga magalutaw ug naay magalunod, depende kon unsa kabug-at ang materyales kumparado sa tubig.

q: Why is iodine added to table salt?
options: To make the salt look whiter
To stop the salt from clumping together
To help prevent the disease called goiter
To add a salty flavor to food
explanation: The halogen iodine is added to salt to help prevent goiter.
fact_tl: Ang halogen na iodine (I) o yodo ay idinadagdag sa asin para maiwasan ang sakit na goiter.
fact_bis: Ang halogen nga iodine (I) o yodo gidugang sa asin aron malikayan ang sakit nga goiter.

q: On Venus, a single day is longer than a full year. Why does this happen?
options: Venus is very far from the Sun, so its orbit takes a long time
Venus spins so slowly that one rotation takes 243 Earth days, longer than its 225-day orbit
Venus has no atmosphere to speed up its rotation
Venus rotates backwards, making its days shorter than on Earth
explanation: Venus rotates so slowly that one Venus day (243 Earth days) is longer than one Venus year (225 Earth days).
fact_tl: Ang Venus ay umiikot nang napakabagal — isang Venus day (243 Earth days) ay mas matagal pa kaysa sa isang Venus year (225 Earth days). Kaya sa Venus, ang isang taon ay maaaring magtapos bago matapos ang isang araw!
fact_bis: Ang Venus mikilit kaayo ka hinay — usa ka Venus day (243 Earth days) mas dugay pa kaysa usa ka Venus year (225 Earth days). Busa sa Venus, ang usa ka tuig mahimong matapos sa wala pa matapos ang usa ka adlaw!

q: Why is it dangerous to hold a long metal object or stand as the tallest point during a lightning storm?
options: Lightning is attracted to bright colors and shiny surfaces
Lightning is a flow of electricity seeking the ground, so easy paths like tall objects or metal are hit first
Metal becomes magnetized during storms and pulls lightning toward it
Lightning is cold plasma and searches for cold surfaces to land on
explanation: Lightning is a powerful flow of electricity from cloud to ground, so you avoid being an easy path by not being the tallest object or holding metal that reaches the ground.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay isang napakalakas na daloy ng kuryente mula sa ulap pababa sa lupa, kaya iniiwasan natin ang pagiging madaling daanan nito—huwag maging pinakamataas o huwag hawak ng metal na umaabot sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang kilat usa ka kusog kaayo nga agos sa kuryente gikan sa panganod paubos sa yuta, busa likayan nato nga mahimong sayon nga agianan niini—ayaw pagka labing taas, ug ayaw paghawid og metal nga moabot sa yuta.

q: Why can a single germ become thousands in just a few hours?
options: Germs absorb heat from the body and duplicate by heat energy
Germs are living things that eat, grow, and split to make more germs
Germs are carried by air and new ones keep arriving
Germs combine with water inside the body to multiply
explanation: Many germs are tiny living things that eat, grow, and split to make more germs, allowing one germ to become thousands quickly.
fact_tl: Maraming germs ay maliliit na nabubuhay na bagay. Kumakain sila, lumalaki, at dumarami para gumawa ng mas marami pang germs. Kaya kahit isa lang sa simula, pwedeng maging libo-libo sa loob ng ilang oras.
fact_bis: Daghang germs kay gagmay nga buhi nga mga butang. Mokaon sila, motubo, ug modaghan aron mohimo og mas daghang germs. Mao nga bisan usa ra sa sinugdan, mahimong liboan sulod sa pipila ka oras.

q: How do you make a natural pH indicator from red cabbage?
options: Dry the cabbage in the sun, grind it to powder, then mix with vinegar
Chop and boil or blend the cabbage in water until the water turns purple, then strain out the leaves
Freeze the cabbage overnight and squeeze out the juice the next day
Soak the cabbage leaves in salt water for a week until the water changes color
explanation: Chopping red cabbage and boiling or blending it in water until the water turns purple, then straining the leaves, gives a natural indicator liquid.
fact_tl: Para makagawa ng indicator, hiwain ang red cabbage at pakuluan o blenderin sa tubig hanggang maging lila ang tubig. Salain ang dahon at ang naiwang malilang likido na ito ang iyong natural indicator.
fact_bis: Aron makahimo og indicator, tadtara ang red cabbage ug pakuhi o i-blender sa tubig hangtod molila ang tubig. Salaa ang mga dahon, ug ang nabilin nga lila nga likido mao ang imong natural nga indicator.

q: How does a true water lily stay in place while its leaves float on the water's surface?
options: It wraps its stems around underwater rocks for support
Its roots are anchored in the bottom of the water while its leaves float on top
It fills its hollow stems with air to keep itself upright in the water
It links its leaves together to form a wide raft that balances on the surface
explanation: A true water lily is rooted in the bottom of the water while only its leaves float on the surface.
fact_tl: Ang tunay na water lily ay nakaugat sa ilalim ng tubig habang lumulutang lamang ang mga dahon nito.
fact_bis: Ang tinuod nga water lily nakagamot sa ilawom sa tubig samtang ang iyang mga dahon lang ang naglutaw.

q: Why do two forward-facing eyes help us judge how far away objects are?
options: They let us see in total darkness by combining their night-vision signals
The brain compares the slightly different images from each eye to judge distance
Two eyes double the number of colors we can detect
Forward-facing eyes increase the total field of view to nearly 360 degrees
explanation: Having two forward-facing eyes gives depth perception because the brain compares slightly different images from each eye to judge distance.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakaroon ng dalawang mata na nakaharap ay nagbibigay sa atin ng depth perception — ang utak ay inihahambing ang bahagyang magkaibang imahe mula sa bawat mata para malaman ang distansya.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon og duha ka mata nga nag-atubang nagahatag sa ato og depth perception — ang utok nagatandi sa bahay-bahay nga lain-laing hulagway gikan sa matag mata aron mahibaw-an ang gilay-on.

q: How tall did the Great Pyramid of Giza originally stand?
options: About 90 meters tall
About 120 meters tall
About 146 meters tall
About 200 meters tall
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza originally stood about 146 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang Great Pyramid of Giza ay orihinal na may taas na humigit-kumulang 146 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Great Pyramid of Giza orihinal nga mga 146 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: Why is an electric shock more dangerous when a person is wet?
options: Water absorbs more of the electric charge, causing it to spread throughout the body
Wet skin has lower resistance, so a larger current can flow through the body
Wet skin acts as an insulator, trapping the shock inside the body longer
Water changes the direction of the current, sending it directly to the heart
explanation: Wet skin has lower resistance than dry skin, so a larger current can flow, making an electric shock more dangerous.
fact_tl: Ang basang balat ay may mas mababang resistance kaysa tuyong balat, kaya mas malaking current ang dumadaloy at mas malala ang pagkakuryente kapag basa ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang basa nga panit adunay mas ubos nga resistance kaysa uga nga panit, mao nga mas dako nga current ang moagi ug mas peligroso ang shock kung basa ang tawo.

q: What does a hygrometer measure?
options: The speed of the wind
The amount of rainfall
The humidity of the air
The temperature of the air
explanation: A hygrometer is an instrument that measures the humidity of the air.
fact_tl: Ang hygrometer ay isang instrumento na sumusukat ng humidity (kahalumigmigan) ng hangin; ang iba't ibang uri nito ay gumagamit ng buhok, kemikal, o electronic sensor.
fact_bis: Ang hygrometer usa ka instrumento nga nagsukod sa humidity (kahalumigmigan) sa hangin; ang lain-laing matang niini naggamit sa buhok, kemikal, o electronic sensor.

q: What is the metal element found in table salt (NaCl)?
options: Potassium
Calcium
Magnesium
Sodium
explanation: The metal part of table salt (NaCl) is sodium, with the chemical symbol Na.
fact_tl: Ang metal na bahagi ng asin (NaCl) ay sodium, na may simbolo na Na.
fact_bis: Ang metal nga bahin sa asin (NaCl) kay sodium, nga adunay simbolo nga Na.

q: Why do stars seem to move across the night sky throughout the night?
options: Stars orbit the Earth slowly, completing one full circle every night
Stars are caught in the solar wind and drift through space at night
It is Earth that is rotating, changing our view of space rather than the stars actually moving
The Moon's gravity pulls the stars into new positions each night
explanation: Stars seem to move across the sky because Earth is rotating, constantly changing our view of space.
fact_tl: Sa gabi, parang umiikot ang lahat ng bituin sa langit, pero hindi talaga sila ang gumagalaw — ang Earth ang umiikot, kaya nagbabago ang tanawin natin sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Sa gabii, morag molibot ang tanang bituon sa langit, apan dili sila ang tinuod nga naglihok — ang Earth maoy molibot, mao nga mausab ang atong panan-aw sa kawanangan.

q: What does Republic Act 9003 require Filipino households to do with their garbage?
options: Burn all waste once a week to reduce the volume sent to landfills
Separate waste into biodegradable, recyclable, and other categories
Send all waste to the local government collection point without sorting
Compost all food waste and donate recyclables to the barangay
explanation: RA 9003, the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act, requires waste to be separated into biodegradable, recyclable, and other categories in every home and community.
fact_tl: Ang Batas Republika 9003 o Ecological Solid Waste Management Act ay nag-aatas na hiwalay ang basura sa bawat tahanan at komunidad — biodegradable, recyclable, at iba pa.
fact_bis: Ang Republic Act 9003 o Ecological Solid Waste Management Act nagsugo nga ibulag ang basura sa matag balay ug komunidad — biodegradable, recyclable, ug uban pa.

q: Which crocodile species found in the Philippines is critically endangered and lives only in freshwater?
options: The saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus)
The Philippine crocodile (Crocodylus mindorensis)
The Nile crocodile (Crocodylus niloticus)
The mugger crocodile (Crocodylus palustris)
explanation: The Philippine crocodile (Crocodylus mindorensis) is critically endangered and lives in freshwater environments.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang species ng buwaya ay matatagpuan sa Pilipinas — ang Philippine crocodile (Crocodylus mindorensis) na critically endangered at nagtatago sa freshwater, at ang saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus) na mas malaki at matatagpuan din sa mga dagat-estero at baybayin.
fact_bis: Duha ka species sa buwaya ang makita sa Pilipinas — ang critically endangered nga Philippine crocodile (Crocodylus mindorensis) nga nagpuyo sa freshwater, ug ang saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus) nga mas dako ug makita usab sa coastal estuary ug dagat.

q: Why is the malunggay tree commonly found in backyards all over the Philippines?
options: It produces very colorful flowers that people like to use for decorations
It grows fast and easily, producing many pods in a short time
Its roots go very deep, so it can survive even long dry seasons
It requires very little sunlight and thrives even inside homes
explanation: The malunggay tree grows fast and easily, producing many pods quickly, which is why it is commonly found in backyards across the Philippines.
fact_tl: Mabilis at madaling tumubo ang punong malunggay, kaya't marami itong namumungang pod sa loob ng maikling panahon. Dahil dito, madalas itong matagpuan sa mga bakuran sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Paspas ug sayon motubo ang kahoy nga malunggay, maong daghan kini og pod nga mamunga sa mubo nga panahon. Tungod niini, kasagaran kini makita sa mga nataran sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the unit used to measure force, and who is it named after?
options: The joule, named after James Joule
The watt, named after James Watt
The newton, named after Isaac Newton
The pascal, named after Blaise Pascal
explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N), named after Isaac Newton.
fact_tl: Ang puwersa (force) ay sinusukat sa yunit na Newton (N), na ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton.
fact_bis: Ang puwersa (force) gisukod sa yunit nga Newton (N), nga ginganlan sunod kang Isaac Newton.

q: What happens to your body if you shiver for a long time?
options: Your body temperature rises so high that you feel warm and stop shivering
You become tired and hungry because shivering uses a lot of energy
Your muscles become stronger because they keep contracting during shivering
Your blood pressure drops and you feel dizzy from the vibrations
explanation: Shivering for a long time uses a lot of energy, which makes you tired and hungry.
fact_tl: Ang matagal na panginginig ay gumagamit ng maraming enerhiya, kaya nakakapagod at nakakagutom ito.
fact_bis: Ang dugay nga pagkurog mogamit og daghang kusog, mao nga makapakapoy ug makapagutom kini.

q: Why must cocoa beans be fermented for several days before chocolate can be made?
options: Fermentation removes the bitter caffeine so the chocolate tastes sweet
Yeast and bacteria break down the pulp and develop the complex flavor of chocolate
Fermentation dries the beans so they can be roasted without burning
The heat from fermentation kills fungi that would otherwise spoil the chocolate
explanation: Cocoa beans must be fermented so yeast and bacteria break down the pulp and develop the complex flavor of chocolate.
fact_tl: Ang mga butil ng cacao ay kailangang ferment ng ilang araw pagkatapos ng pag-aani — ang yeast at bakterya ay nagbabago ng pulp sa paligid ng butil at nagbibigay sa tsokolate ng kumplikadong lasa nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga butil sa cacao kinahanglang palalaon sulod sa pipila ka adlaw human sa pag-aani — ang yeast ug bakterya nagbungkag sa pulp sa palibot sa mga butil ug nagpalambo sa komplikadong lasa sa tsokolate.

q: A fire needs three things to keep burning. Which group correctly names all three?
options: Fuel, water, and heat
Fuel, heat, and oxygen
Oxygen, smoke, and carbon dioxide
Heat, light, and ash
explanation: A fire needs fuel, heat, and oxygen; removing any one of these — such as cutting off oxygen by smothering — puts the fire out.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng sunog ng tatlong bagay: gatong, init, at oxygen. Alisin ang isa sa mga ito — gaya ng pagtakip sa apoy — at mamamatay ang sunog.
fact_bis: Ang kalayo nagkinahanglan og tulo ka butang: sugnod, init, ug oxygen. Kuhaa ang usa niini — sama sa pagtabon sa apoy — ug mapalong ang kalayo.

q: Why does stainless steel resist rust compared to ordinary steel?
options: Stainless steel is coated with a layer of plastic during manufacturing
Stainless steel contains chromium, which forms a thin protective layer on the surface
Stainless steel is melted at a higher temperature, making it denser and harder to oxidize
Stainless steel is kept shiny by polishing, which prevents oxygen from reaching it
explanation: Stainless steel resists rust because it contains chromium that forms a thin protective layer on its surface.
fact_tl: Ang stainless steel ay hindi madaling magkalawang dahil may halong chromium na bumubuo ng manipis na proteksiyon.
fact_bis: Ang stainless steel dili dali matayaan tungod kay adunay sagol nga chromium nga naghimo og nipis nga panalipod.

q: In science class, you compare solutions, colloids, and suspensions. Which has the LARGEST particles?
options: A solution, because the particles are fully dissolved
A colloid, because the particles scatter light
A suspension, because its particles are the largest
They all have particles of the same size
explanation: Suspension particles are the largest, colloid particles are medium-sized, and solution particles are the smallest.
fact_tl: Pinakamaliit ang particle ng solusyon, mas malaki ang sa kolloid, at pinakamalaki ang sa suspensyon.
fact_bis: Ang partikulo sa solusyon pinakagamay, ang sa kolloid mas dako, ug ang sa suspensyon pinakadako.

q: The flying lizard (Draco) warms itself in sunlight. What does this tell you about its body temperature?
options: It is warm-blooded and uses sunlight to cool down after exercise
It is cold-blooded and depends on outside heat sources like sunlight to warm its body
It is warm-blooded and sunbathes to help digest its food faster
It is cold-blooded and uses sunlight to produce Vitamin D only
explanation: The flying lizard is a cold-blooded reptile that warms itself in sunlight because it cannot generate its own body heat.
fact_tl: Ang butiking lumilipad ay isang reptilya na malamig ang dugo at umiinit sa sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang naglupad nga tiki usa ka reptilya nga bugnaw og dugo nga magpainit sa silaw sa adlaw.

q: In what year did Filipino scientist Abelardo Aguilar discover the soil sample that led to erythromycin?
explanation: Abelardo Aguilar found the soil containing erythromycin in 1949.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Abelardo Aguilar ang lupa na may erythromycin noong 1949.
fact_bis: Nakaplagan ni Abelardo Aguilar ang yuta nga adunay erythromycin niadtong 1949.

q: Babies have more than 300 bones, but adults have only 206. What happens to the extra bones?
options: The extra bones dissolve into the bloodstream as children grow
The bones slowly fuse together at the joints as a child grows up
Bones break into smaller pieces during growth spurts, then rejoin
Some bones are absorbed by muscles as the body gets stronger
explanation: A baby's 300+ bones slowly fuse together at the joints as they grow, leaving an adult with only 206 bones.
fact_tl: Ang isang sanggol ay may mahigit 300 buto na unti-unting nagdurugtong sa mga kasukasuan, kaya may 206 na lang buto ang isang matanda.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka masuso adunay kapin 300 ka bukog nga hinay-hinayng magdugtong sa mga lutahan, mao nga ang hamtong adunay 206 na lang ka bukog.

q: How does a common smoke detector use radioactive material to sense smoke?
options: The radioactive material glows brighter when smoke enters, triggering a light sensor
Alpha particles from the radioactive material create a small electric current; smoke blocks the particles, changing the current and sounding the alarm
The radioactive material heats up when smoke enters, triggering a heat sensor
Radiation from the material reacts chemically with smoke particles, producing a loud sound
explanation: Many smoke detectors contain a tiny radioactive source that emits alpha particles to maintain a small current; when smoke blocks the particles the current changes and the alarm sounds.
fact_tl: Maraming smoke detector sa bahay ay gumagamit ng kaunting radioactive material na naglalabas ng alpha particle. Ang particle na ito ay tumutulong gumawa ng maliit na daloy ng kuryente; kapag may usok na humarang, nagbabago ang daloy at tumutunog ang alarma. Ligtas ito dahil sobrang konti lang.
fact_bis: Daghang smoke detector sa balay naggamit og gamay nga radioactive material nga mogawas og alpha particle. Kini nga mga particle motabang sa paghimo og gamay nga elektrik nga dagan; kung adunay aso nga moali, mausab ang dagan ug motingog ang alarma. Luwas kini tungod kay gamay ra kaayo.

q: On a phase diagram, what is the 'triple point' of a substance?
options: The highest temperature at which the substance can exist as a liquid
The exact temperature at which the substance melts from solid to liquid
The point where all three states — solid, liquid, and gas — exist at the same time
The pressure at which the substance changes directly from solid to gas
explanation: The triple point on a phase diagram is where all three states of matter (solid, liquid, gas) coexist simultaneously.
fact_tl: Ang isang phase diagram ay isang grap na nagpapakita kung aling estado ng matter (solid, liquid, gas) ang matatag para sa isang sangkap sa iba't ibang temperatura at presyon. Ang triple point ay kung saan ang tatlong estado ay umiiral nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka phase diagram usa ka grap nga nagpakita kung aling estado sa matter (solid, liquid, gas) ang matatag alang sa usa ka substansya sa lainlaing mga temperatura ug presyon. Ang triple point mao ang diin ang tulo ka estado magkauban sa samang panahon.

q: How does the Draco lizard start a glide from a tree?
options: It runs along the branch and leaps upward, using its tail as a rudder
It jumps from a branch and then spreads its ribs to open its wing-like flaps
It inflates a pouch under its throat to become lighter before dropping off
It climbs to the very top of the tree and lets the wind carry it off the branch
explanation: To glide, the Draco jumps from a branch and spreads its elongated ribs to open its wings.
fact_tl: Upang makalutang, tumatalon ang Draco mula sa sanga at saka ibinubuka ang mga tadyang nito para buksan ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Aron makalutaw, molukso ang Draco gikan sa sanga ug dayon ibukhad ang iyang gusok aron ablihan ang pako.

q: Where does the Agus River flow from and to, and how long is it?
options: From Mount Apo to Davao Gulf, about 75 kilometers long
From Lake Lanao to Iligan Bay, about 36 kilometers long
From Lake Sebu to Moro Gulf, about 50 kilometers long
From Lake Mainit to Butuan Bay, about 60 kilometers long
explanation: The Agus River flows from Lake Lanao to Iligan Bay, about 36 kilometers long.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Agus ay umaagos mula sa Lake Lanao patungong Iligan Bay, mga 36 kilometro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Agus nagdagayday gikan sa Lake Lanao paingon sa Iligan Bay, mga 36 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Why do natural dyes work better on cotton or silk than on plastic fibers?
options: Natural fibers are smoother, so dye spreads more evenly across their surface
Natural fibers have a stronger electric charge that attracts dye molecules
Color soaks into natural fibers more easily, so it holds better than on plastic fibers
Natural fibers are thicker, so they absorb more dye and appear brighter
explanation: Natural dyes hold better on natural fibers like cotton or silk because the color soaks into them more easily than it does into plastic fibers.
fact_tl: Mas mahusay na kumakapit ang natural dye sa mga likas na hibla tulad ng bulak (cotton), abaka, o sutla kaysa sa plastik na hibla, dahil mas madaling sumipsip ang kulay sa mga ito.
fact_bis: Mas maayong modikit ang natural dye sa natural nga hibla sama sa bulak (cotton), abaka, o seda kaysa sa plastik nga hibla, kay mas dali nga mosuyop ang kolor niini.

q: Why are soldiers ordered to break their marching step when crossing a bridge?
options: To reduce the weight load on the bridge by spreading it across irregular intervals
So the rhythm of their marching does not match the bridge's natural frequency, which could cause dangerous vibrations
To prevent their boots from wearing down the bridge surface over time
Because marching in step produces static electricity that could damage the bridge's metal supports
explanation: Soldiers break step on bridges so their marching rhythm does not match the bridge's natural frequency, which could cause resonance and dangerous vibrations.
fact_tl: Pinapahinto ang sabay-sabay na martsa ng mga sundalo sa tulay para ang ritmo ng kanilang hakbang ay hindi tumugma sa natural na prekwensiya ng tulay.
fact_bis: Gipahunong ang dungan nga martsa sa mga sundalo sa taytayan aron ang ritmo sa ilang lakang dili motakdo sa kinaiyanhon nga prekwensiya sa taytayan.

q: What is La Niña's typical effect on the Philippines?
options: It brings the Philippines drier weather, less rain, and stronger drought conditions
It causes the Philippines to have more rainfall, stronger westward winds, and a higher risk of flooding
It raises sea temperatures around the Philippines, killing coral reefs and reducing fish stocks
It creates frequent hot and dry El Niño-like conditions across the Philippine archipelago
explanation: La Niña usually brings the Philippines more rainfall, stronger westward winds, and a higher risk of flooding.
fact_tl: Ang La Niña ay ang malamig na yugto ng ENSO na kadalasang nagdadala sa Pilipinas ng mas maraming ulan, mas malakas na hanging humampas sa kanluran, at mas mataas na panganib ng pagbaha.
fact_bis: Ang La Niña mao ang bugnaw nga bahin sa ENSO nga kasagaran nagadala sa Pilipinas og daghang ulan, mas kusog nga hangin paadto sa kasadpan, ug mas dako nga peligro sa baha.

q: Inside a leaf cell, where exactly does photosynthesis take place?
options: In the mitochondria, which are the cell's power generators
In the cell nucleus, which controls all chemical reactions
In tiny parts called chloroplasts, which hold the chlorophyll
In the cell membrane, which lets sunlight pass into the cell
explanation: Photosynthesis takes place inside tiny parts called chloroplasts, which hold the chlorophyll in leaf cells.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng mga selula ng dahon, ang photosynthesis ay nangyayari sa maliliit na bahaging tinatawag na chloroplasts, kung saan naroon ang chlorophyll.
fact_bis: Sulod sa mga selula sa dahon, ang photosynthesis mahitabo sa gagmay nga mga bahin nga gitawag og chloroplasts, diin nahimutang ang chlorophyll.

q: Why does meat turn brown when it is cooked?
options: The heat burns the surface of the meat, creating a layer of black ash that looks brown
Cooking adds oxygen to the meat, turning the red blood brown
The protein myoglobin in the meat changes when heated, causing the color to change — this is a chemical change
The fat in the meat melts and coats the surface, changing its color to brown
explanation: Raw meat is red because of myoglobin; cooking changes the protein, turning the meat brown in a chemical change.
fact_tl: Ang hilaw na karne ay pula dahil sa myoglobin protein; kapag niluto, ang protina ay nagbabago at ang karne ay nagiging kayumanggi — ito ay isang chemical change.
fact_bis: Ang hilaw nga karne pula tungod sa protein nga myoglobin; kon luto-on, ang protein nagbag-o ug ang karne nahimong kayumanggi — kining pagbag-o sa kolor usa ka chemical change.

q: Why are humans affected when the balance of nature breaks down?
options: Humans stand outside the food web, so they are only affected by pollution, not food loss
Humans are part of the food web — we eat fish, vegetables, and animals — so when the web breaks, our food supply is also affected
Humans are at the top of every food chain, so they are the last to feel any change in nature
Humans only eat plants, so animal population changes do not affect the human food supply
explanation: Humans are part of the food web — we eat fish, vegetables, and animals — so when nature's balance breaks, our food supply suffers too.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang tao ay nakatayo sa labas ng food web. Kasali tayo dito: kumakain tayo ng isda, gulay, at hayop. Kaya kapag nawasak ang balanse ng kalikasan, kulang ang ating pagkain at apektado rin ang ating buhay, hindi lang ang ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Sayop nga panghunahuna nga ang tawo naa sa gawas sa food web. Apil kita niini: mokaon kita og isda, utanon, ug hayop. Busa kon maguba ang balanse sa kinaiyahan, makulangan ang atong pagkaon ug maapektohan usab ang atong kinabuhi, dili lang ang ubang hayop.

q: Besides dengue, what are two other diseases that some mosquitoes can carry?
options: Typhoid and cholera
Malaria and chikungunya
Influenza and hepatitis
Rabies and tetanus
explanation: Besides dengue, some mosquitoes also carry malaria and chikungunya.
fact_tl: Bukod sa dengue, may mga lamok din na nagdadala ng ibang sakit gaya ng malaria at chikungunya.
fact_bis: Gawas sa dengue, adunay mga lamok nga nagdala usab og ubang sakit sama sa malaria ug chikungunya.

q: How long can it take for a young orchid plant to bloom for the first time?
options: Just a few days, if it gets enough sunlight and water
One to two weeks under good growing conditions
Several months or even years before it blooms for the first time
Orchids bloom every month as long as they are watered regularly
explanation: An orchid can take several months or even years before it blooms for the first time.
fact_tl: Ang isang orkidya ay maaaring tumagal ng ilang buwan o taon bago ito unang mamulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka orkid mahimong mokabat ug pipila ka bulan o tuig sa dili pa kini unang mamulak.

q: Why do we feel sick with symptoms like fever when we have a viral infection?
options: The virus releases a toxin that directly makes the body heat up
Viruses consume all our nutrients, leaving the body too weak to maintain normal temperature
The virus damages our cells and our body fights back, causing symptoms like fever
Viruses block blood flow, which raises body temperature and causes pain
explanation: We feel sick with symptoms like fever because the virus damages our cells and our body fights back.
fact_tl: Nararamdaman natin ang sakit tulad ng lagnat dahil sinisira ng virus ang ating mga selula at lumalaban ang ating katawan.
fact_bis: Mobati ta ug sakit sama sa hilanat tungod kay ang bayrus modaot sa atong mga selula ug mosukol ang atong lawas.

q: When two substances are mixed and the mixture suddenly changes color, what does this likely tell you?
options: The mixture has absorbed water from the air, causing a physical change
One substance has dissolved into the other, creating a solution
A chemical reaction may be happening and a new substance is forming
The temperature of the mixture has dropped, causing its color to shift
explanation: A sudden color change when substances are mixed is a sign that a chemical reaction may be happening and a new substance is forming.
fact_tl: Ang biglaang pagbabago ng kulay kapag may pinaghalong sangkap ay isang tanda na maaaring nangyayari ang chemical reaction at may bagong sangkap na nabubuo.
fact_bis: Ang kalit nga pagbag-o sa kolor kon adunay gisagol nga sustansya usa ka timaan nga tingali nagakahitabo ang chemical reaction ug adunay bag-ong sustansya nga maporma.

q: Besides letters, what else can the Braille writing system represent?
options: Only punctuation marks like periods and question marks
Numbers, math symbols, and even music
Colors and simple drawings using raised dot patterns
Only capital letters and spaces between words
explanation: Besides letters, Braille can also represent numbers, math symbols, and even music.
fact_tl: Bukod sa mga letra, kayang ipakita ng Braille ang mga numero, simbolo sa matematika, at maging musika.
fact_bis: Gawas sa mga letra, ang Braille makahimo usab pagpakita sa mga numero, simbolo sa matematika, ug bisan musika.

q: Why is high blood pressure sometimes called a 'silent' condition?
options: It only develops in people who never speak about their health problems
A person with high blood pressure often feels no symptoms at all
It is too quiet for doctors to detect without special equipment
The condition causes gradual hearing loss, making patients quieter over time
explanation: High blood pressure is called 'silent' because a person who has it often feels no symptoms.
fact_tl: Madalas na walang nararamdamang sintomas ang taong may altapresyon, kaya tinatawag itong 'tahimik na sakit.'
fact_bis: Ang tawo nga adunay altapresyon kasagaran walay bation nga simtomas, mao nga gitawag kini nga 'hilom' nga sakit.

q: How does chromatography reveal that a black pen ink is actually a mixture of colors?
options: You burn the ink and the different colors in the flame show its components
Water climbs up paper with a dot of ink, and each color travels at a different speed, separating them
You add bleach to the ink and each color disappears at a different rate, revealing its components
You shine white light through the ink and a prism splits it into its different color components
explanation: In chromatography, water climbs up paper through a dot of ink, and the colors separate because each one travels at a different speed.
fact_tl: Maraming itim o berdeng tinta ay talagang mixture ng iba't ibang kulay. Sa chromatography, hinahayaang umakyat ang tubig sa papel na may patak ng tinta, at naghihiwalay ang mga kulay dahil iba-iba ang bilis ng pag-akyat nila.
fact_bis: Daghang itom o lunhaw nga tinta usa gyud ka mixture sa nagkalainlaing kolor. Sa chromatography, tugotan ang tubig nga mosaka sa papel nga adunay tulo sa tinta, ug mabulag ang mga kolor kay lainlain ang kapaspas sa ilang pagsaka.

q: What is a barrier reef, and what does it create between itself and the island?
options: A reef that forms a complete circle around an island, creating a lake of saltwater inside
A long coral reef lying offshore that shelters a calm, shallow lagoon between it and the island
A reef built by people to protect beaches from erosion during typhoons
A reef that only forms in very deep water far from any coastline
explanation: A barrier reef is a long coral reef lying offshore that shelters a calm, shallow lagoon between it and the island from strong waves.
fact_tl: Ang isang barrier reef ay mahabang bahura ng korales na nasa malayo sa baybayin, na nagpoprotekta sa mababaw na lagoon sa pagitan nito at ng isla mula sa malalakas na alon.
fact_bis: Ang barrier reef usa ka taas nga bahura sa korales nga naa sa layo sa baybayon, nga nagpanalipod sa mabaw nga lim-aw tali niini ug sa isla gikan sa kusog nga balod.

q: Cellular respiration is the reverse of photosynthesis. What does it produce from glucose and oxygen?
options: Glucose and carbon dioxide only
Oxygen and water only
Carbon dioxide, water, and energy
Light energy and oxygen
explanation: Cellular respiration converts glucose and oxygen into carbon dioxide, water, and energy that organisms use from food.
fact_tl: Ang cellular respiration ay ang kabaligtaran ng photosynthesis: glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + tubig + enerhiya — ito ang paraan ng paggamit ng lahat ng nabubuhay na organismo ng pagkain para makakuha ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang cellular respiration ang kabaliktaran sa photosynthesis: glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + tubig + enerhiya — kini ang paagi kung giunsa sa tanan nga buhing organismo ang paggamit sa pagkaon aron mapagawas ang enerhiya.

q: At what temperature does water boil on the Fahrenheit scale?
options: 100 degrees Fahrenheit
180 degrees Fahrenheit
212 degrees Fahrenheit
273 degrees Fahrenheit
explanation: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit, which equals 100 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Sa Fahrenheit, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 212 degrees — ito ang katumbas ng 100 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Sa Fahrenheit, ang tubig magbukal sa 212 ka degrees — mao ni ang sama sa 100 ka degrees Celsius.

q: How can fertilizer washing off farm fields lead to red tide in the sea?
options: Fertilizer poisons small fish, and their dead bodies feed the plankton that cause red tide
Extra nutrients from fertilizer washed into the sea can fuel large plankton blooms, including red tide
Fertilizer changes the saltiness of the water, allowing red-colored algae to survive
Fertilizer blocks sunlight from reaching the sea floor, forcing toxic plankton to float to the surface
explanation: Extra nutrients from fertilizer and waste washed into the sea can fuel large plankton blooms, including red tide.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang sustansya mula sa abono at dumi na inaanod sa dagat ay maaaring magpalaki ng plankton bloom kabilang ang red tide.
fact_bis: Ang sobrang sustansya gikan sa abono ug hugaw nga maanod ngadto sa dagat makapadako sa plankton bloom lakip na ang red tide.

q: What is the chemical formula of glucose, the simple sugar your body uses for energy?
options: C6H12O6
C6H6O6
C2H5OH
explanation: The chemical formula of glucose is C6H12O6, meaning each molecule has 6 carbon, 12 hydrogen, and 6 oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Ang kemikal na pormula ng glucose (isang uri ng asukal) ay C6H12O6.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa glucose (usa ka klase sa asukal) kay C6H12O6.

q: What are the tiny parts on your tongue that let you taste the flavor of food?
options: Taste buds
Nerve endings
Papillae pores
Saliva glands
explanation: The tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds on its surface that allow us to sense the flavor of food.
fact_tl: Ang ating dila ay may libu-libong napakaliliit na taste buds na nasa ibabaw nito. Ang maliliit na bahaging ito ang nagpaparamdam sa atin ng lasa ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang atong dila adunay liboan ka gagmay kaayong taste buds sa ibabaw niini. Kining gagmayng bahin maoy makapabati nato sa lami sa pagkaon.

q: Why do the poles experience about six months of continuous daylight followed by six months of near-darkness each year?
options: Because Earth is tilted on its axis as it orbits the Sun
Because the poles are closest to the Sun for half the year
Because the Sun moves around Earth in a slow orbit
Because the poles have no atmosphere to scatter sunlight
explanation: The six-month polar day and night are caused by Earth's axial tilt as it travels around the Sun, which keeps one pole pointed toward the Sun for half the year.
fact_tl: Sa pinakadulo ng mga polo, may panahong umaabot ng anim na buwan na araw na walang gabi, at anim na buwan na gabi na halos walang araw — bunga ito ng pagkakiling ng Earth sa kanyang paggalaw.
fact_bis: Sa kinatumyan sa mga polo, adunay panahon nga moabot og unom ka bulan nga adlaw nga walay gabii, ug unom ka bulan nga gabii nga halos walay adlaw — bunga kini sa pagkiling sa Yuta samtang naglibot sa adlaw.

q: What happens to a star when it eventually runs out of hydrogen fuel?
options: It begins to change and no longer shines the same way
It explodes immediately and disappears
It shrinks into a planet
It starts burning oxygen instead and shines brighter
explanation: Stars do not shine forever; when they run out of hydrogen fuel they begin to change, even though some last billions of years.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin ay hindi nagliliwanag magpakailanman. Sa kalaunan, mauubos ang kanilang sugnod na hydrogen at magbabago sila. Ang ilan ay tatagal ng bilyong taon, kaya tila walang hanggan sa atin, pero may katapusan din sila.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon dili magsiga hangtod sa kahangtoran. Sa kadugayan, mahurot ang ilang sugnod nga hydrogen ug magbag-o sila. Ang uban molungtad og binilyon ka tuig, maong murag walay katapusan alang kanato, apan adunay gihapon silang kataposan.

q: Besides folding its leaves when touched, how else does the makahiya plant protect itself?
options: It has small thorns on its stem that prick you
It releases a bad smell to drive away animals
It has sticky sap that traps insects
It turns bright red to warn animals away
explanation: The makahiya has two defenses: the fast leaf-folding and small thorns on its stem that prick when grabbed.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pagtiklop dahil sa tubig, may iba pang panangga ang makahiya. May maliliit na tinik sa tangkay nito na tumutusok kapag hinawakan. Kaya dalawa ang depensa nito: ang mabilis na pagtiklop at ang matutulis na tinik.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagtiklop tungod sa tubig, naa pay laing panalipod ang makahiya. Naay gagmay nga tunok sa lawas niini nga mutusok kon kuptan. Busa duha ang depensa niini: ang paspas nga pagtiklop ug ang hait nga mga tunok.

q: Whose equation E=mc² explains how a tiny amount of mass can release a huge amount of energy in nuclear reactions?
options: Albert Einstein
Isaac Newton
Marie Curie
Niels Bohr
explanation: Nuclear energy is explained by Albert Einstein's famous equation E=mc², showing that a tiny mass can become a huge amount of energy.
fact_tl: Ang enerhiyang nuklear ay ipinaliliwanag ng ekwasyon ni Albert Einstein na E=mc², kung saan ang kaunting masa ay nagiging napakalaking enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang nuclear energy gipasabot sa ekwasyon ni Albert Einstein nga E=mc², diin ang gamay nga masa mahimong dakong enerhiya.

q: Why does a heavy steel ship float on water even though steel is denser than water?
options: Its hollow shape traps air, making its overall density lower than water
Steel becomes lighter when shaped into thin sheets
The salty ocean water is much denser and pushes the steel up
The ship's engine creates enough thrust to keep it on the surface
explanation: A steel ship floats because its hollow shape is filled with air, which makes the ship's overall density lower than water's.
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang mabibigat na barkong bakal dahil hugis-lukong ito at puno ng hangin sa loob, kaya mas mababa ang kabuuang density nito kaysa sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang bug-at nga barkong puthaw molutaw kay lungagon ug puno sa hangin sa sulod, mao nga mas ubos ang kinatibuk-ang density niini kaysa tubig.

q: What happens to the connections in your brain when you practice a new skill over and over?
options: They grow stronger
They disappear to make room for new ones
They move to a different part of the brain
They stay exactly the same
explanation: Brain connections change and grow stronger each time we learn and practice a new skill repeatedly.
fact_tl: Nagbabago at lumalakas ang mga koneksyon sa utak kapag tayo ay nag-aaral at paulit-ulit na nagsasanay ng bagong kasanayan.
fact_bis: Ang mga koneksyon sa utok mausab ug molig-on kung kita magtuon ug balik-balik nga mobansay og bag-ong kahanas.

q: Approximately how fast does light travel?
options: 186,000 miles per second
186,000 miles per hour
18,600 miles per second
1,860,000 miles per second
explanation: The speed of light is about 186,000 miles per second, which is extremely fast compared to anything we encounter daily.
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng liwanag ay humigit-kumulang 186,000 milya kada segundo.
fact_bis: Ang tulin sa kahayag mga 186,000 ka milya kada segundo.

q: What happens to a jeepney's center of gravity when heavy cargo is loaded on its roof?
options: It rises, making the jeepney easier to tip over on sharp turns
It drops, making the jeepney more stable on sharp turns
It stays the same because the weight is spread evenly
It shifts to the front, making braking more difficult
explanation: When heavy cargo is loaded on a jeepney's roof, its center of gravity rises, making it easier to tip over on a sharp turn.
fact_tl: Kapag nakakarga ng mabigat na gamit sa bubong ng dyip, tumataas ang sentro ng bigat nito kaya nagiging mas madaling matumba sa matarik na liko.
fact_bis: Kon adunay bug-at nga karga sa atop sa dyip, mosaka ang sentro sa kabug-at niini busa mas dali kining matumba sa hait nga liko.

q: What is basi, the traditional drink from Ilocos in the Philippines?
options: A fermented sugarcane wine made with herbs and bark
A sweet coconut juice drink served cold
A rice wine brewed from glutinous rice
A sugarcane tea flavored with pandan leaves
explanation: Basi is a traditional fermented sugarcane wine from Ilocos, made by fermenting sugarcane juice with various herbs and bark.
fact_tl: Ang basi ay isang tradisyonal na inuming may alkohol mula sa Ilocos, Pilipinas, na ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalala ng katas ng tubo (sugarcane) at mga herbal na sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang basi usa ka tradisyonal nga fermented sugarcane wine gikan sa Ilocos, Pilipinas, gihimo pinaagi sa pagpalala sa katas sa tubo (sugarcane) ug lainlaing mga herbal nga sangkap.

q: Where are the transition metals found on the periodic table?
options: In the middle, from Group 3 to Group 12
On the far left in Groups 1 and 2
On the far right in Groups 13 to 18
Along the bottom in the lanthanide and actinide rows
explanation: The transition metals occupy the middle section of the periodic table, specifically from Group 3 to Group 12.
fact_tl: Ang mga transition metal ay nasa gitnang bahagi ng periodic table, mula Group 3 hanggang Group 12.
fact_bis: Ang mga transition metal naa sa tunga sa periodic table, gikan sa Group 3 ngadto sa Group 12.

q: Why does a moving jeepney need strong brakes to stop quickly?
options: Because it is heavy and fast, giving it a lot of kinetic energy
Because its tires grip the road too loosely
Because its engine keeps pushing it forward even when off
Because kinetic energy turns into potential energy during braking
explanation: A moving jeepney carries a lot of kinetic energy because it is both heavy and fast, making it hard to stop suddenly without strong brakes.
fact_tl: Magandang halimbawa ng kinetic energy ang tumatakbong jeepney. Mabigat ito at mabilis, kaya napakalaki ng kinetic energy nito. Iyon ang dahilan kung bakit mahirap itong pigilang biglaan at kailangan ng malakas na preno para huminto.
fact_bis: Maayong panig-ingnan sa kinetic energy ang nagdagan nga jeepney. Bug-at kini ug paspas, mao nga dako kaayo ang iyang kinetic energy. Mao nay hinungdan nga lisod kini hunongon dayon ug nagkinahanglan ug kusgan nga preno.

q: At what body temperature is a person considered to have a fever?
options: 38°C or higher
37°C or higher
39°C or higher
36.5°C or higher
explanation: A person is considered to have a fever when their body temperature reaches about 38 degrees Celsius or higher.
fact_tl: Ang isang tao ay itinuturing na may lagnat kapag umabot ang temperatura nito sa mga 38 degrees Celsius pataas.
fact_bis: Ang tawo giisip nga adunay hilanat kung ang temperatura niini moabot og mga 38 degrees Celsius pataas.

q: Which plant roots are well-known examples of roots that store food and grow large?
options: Sweet potato and cassava
Tomato and pepper
Rice and corn
Mango and banana
explanation: Some plants store food in their roots, causing them to grow large — sweet potato and cassava are classic examples.
fact_tl: Ang ilang halaman ay nag-iimbak ng pagkain sa kanilang ugat, kaya lumalaki ito tulad ng kamote at kamoteng kahoy (cassava).
fact_bis: Ang ubang tanom motipig og pagkaon sa ilang gamot, mao nga modako kini sama sa kamote ug balanghoy (cassava).

q: About how long does it take sunlight to travel from the Sun to Earth?
options: 8 minutes
8 seconds
8 hours
80 minutes
explanation: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth, even at the incredible speed of light.
fact_tl: Umaabot ng halos 8 minuto bago marating ng liwanag ng Araw ang Earth.
fact_bis: Mokabat ug mga 8 ka minuto ang kahayag sa Adlaw aron makaabot sa Earth.

q: How long can the Philippine sailfin lizard grow?
options: Up to one meter
Up to half a meter
Up to two meters
Up to 30 centimeters
explanation: The Philippine sailfin lizard can grow up to one meter in length, making it one of the largest lizards commonly seen in Philippine forests.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine sailfin lizard ay maaaring lumaki ng hanggang isang metro ang haba, na ginagawa itong isa sa pinakamalaking aligator na karaniwang tinaawag na ibid sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine sailfin lizard makatubo og hangtud usa ka metro ang gitas-on, nga nagpaisa niini nga usa sa pinakadako nga butiki nga nakita sa mga kagubatan sa Pilipinas.

q: What process causes a child's soft cartilage to gradually harden into true bone as they grow?
options: Ossification
Calcification
Mineralization
Fossilization
explanation: Children's bones begin as cartilage and gradually harden into true bone through a process called ossification as the child grows.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ng bata ay nagsisimula bilang kartilago at unti-unting nagiging matibay na buto sa pamamagitan ng prosesong tinatawag na ossification habang lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang mga buto sa bata nagsugod ingon kartilago ug hinay-hinay nagpatig-a ngadto sa tinuod nga buto pinaagi sa proseso nga gitawag ossification samtang nagdako ang bata.

q: Although many sea snakes have very strong venom, why are they usually not considered dangerous to people?
options: They are shy and rarely bite people
Their venom is too weak to affect humans
They live too deep in the ocean to encounter swimmers
Their fangs are too small to pierce human skin
explanation: Many sea snakes have very strong venom, but they are usually not dangerous because they are shy and rarely bite people.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng ahas-dagat ang may napakalakas na lason, pero karaniwan silang hindi mapanganib dahil mahihiyain sila at bihirang tumuklaw sa tao.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa bitin sa dagat ang adunay kusog kaayo nga lala, apan kasagaran dili sila peligroso kay maulawon ug talagsa ra mopaak sa tawo.

q: Where do lava, ash, and smoke escape from an active volcano?
options: Through the crater at the top
Through the magma chamber below ground
Through the vent deep underground
Through cracks in the volcano's side called calderas
explanation: An active volcano has a crater at the top where lava, ash, and smoke escape to the surface.
fact_tl: May mga pangunahing bahagi ang aktibong bulkan: ang silid ng magma sa ilalim, ang daanan o vent na umaakyat, at ang bunganga o crater sa tuktok kung saan lumalabas ang lava, abo, at usok.
fact_bis: Ang aktibong bulkan adunay mga nag-unang bahin: ang lawak sa magma sa ilawom, ang agianan o vent nga mosaka, ug ang baba o crater sa tumoy diin mogawas ang lava, abo, ug aso.

q: What is the key difference between mangroves and seagrass at the coast?
options: Seagrass stays underwater even at low tide, while mangroves rise into the air when the tide goes down
Mangroves stay underwater at all times, while seagrass grows above the water
Seagrass grows only in fresh water, while mangroves grow only in salt water
Mangroves are grasses and seagrass is a type of tree
explanation: Both grow at the coast, but seagrass stays underwater even at low tide while the mangrove is a tree that rises above water when the tide drops.
fact_tl: Parehong tumutubo sa baybayin ang bakawan at ang damong-dagat (seagrass), pero magkaiba sila. Ang damong-dagat ay laging nasa ilalim ng tubig kahit low tide, samtang ang bakawan ay isang puno na lumilitaw sa hangin tuwing bumababa ang tide.
fact_bis: Parehong motubo sa baybayon ang bakhaw ug ang sagbot-dagat (seagrass), apan magkalahi sila. Ang seagrass kanunay naa sa ilawom sa tubig bisan hunas, samtang ang bakhaw usa ka kahoy nga motungha sa hangin matag mohubas ang taog.

q: Where is urine stored in the body after the kidneys make it?
options: In the bladder
In the liver
In the large intestine
In the ureter
explanation: The urine made by the kidneys is stored in the bladder until it fills up and needs to be passed out.
fact_tl: Ang ihing ginawa ng mga bato ay iniimbak muna sa pantog hanggang sa mapuno ito at kailangan na nating umihi.
fact_bis: Ang ihi nga gihimo sa mga kidni tipigan una sa tunggo hangtod kini mapuno ug kinahanglan na natong moihi.

q: Who composed the music of the Philippine national anthem "Lupang Hinirang" in 1898?
options: Julian Felipe
Jose Palma
Andres Bonifacio
Emilio Aguinaldo
explanation: The music of "Lupang Hinirang" was composed by Julian Felipe in 1898; the words came from a Spanish poem by Jose Palma.
fact_tl: Ang musika ng "Lupang Hinirang" ay binuo ni Julian Felipe noong 1898. Ang titik ay mula sa tulang Espanyol na "Filipinas" ni Jose Palma, na isinalin sa Filipino. Dapat itong awitin nang may paggalang habang nakatayo.
fact_bis: Ang musika sa "Lupang Hinirang" gihimo ni Julian Felipe niadtong 1898. Ang titik gikan sa Espanyol nga balak nga "Filipinas" ni Jose Palma, nga gihubad sa Filipino. Kinahanglan kining awiton nga may pagtahod samtang nagtindog.

q: What is it called when an astronaut goes outside a space station to make repairs while wearing a spacesuit?
options: A spacewalk
An orbital drift
A vacuum excursion
A station inspection
explanation: When astronauts go outside the station to make repairs wearing a spacesuit, it is called a spacewalk.
fact_tl: Kapag lumalabas ng istasyon ang mga astronaut para mag-ayos, nagsusuot sila ng spacesuit at gumagawa ng tinatawag na spacewalk.
fact_bis: Kon mogawas sa himpilan ang mga astronaut aron mag-ayo, magsul-ob sila og spacesuit ug maghimo og gitawag nga spacewalk.

q: What is special about the leaf of the alibangbang tree?
options: It is split at the tip like a butterfly's wings
It is shaped like a heart with a pointed base
It is round with a hole in the center
It grows in pairs that look like clasped hands
explanation: The alibangbang leaf is split at the tip like a butterfly's wings, and its sour leaves are used to add a tangy taste to dishes like sinigang.
fact_tl: Ang alibangbang ay isang puno na ang dahon ay hati sa dulo kaya parang pakpak ng paruparo, at ang maasim nitong dahon ay ginagamit na pampaasim sa sinigang.
fact_bis: Ang alibangbang usa ka kahoy nga ang dahon gibahin sa tumoy mura'g pako sa alibangbang, ug ang aslom niini nga dahon gigamit nga pampaaslom sa sinigang.

q: How are Philippine senators elected?
options: Nationwide by the whole country, not by district
By the voters in their home province only
By the members of the House of Representatives
By regional groups representing Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao
explanation: Philippine senators are elected at large, meaning the whole country votes for them, not just voters in one district.
fact_tl: Ang mga senador ng Pilipinas ay hinahalal ng buong bansa (at large), hindi sa bawat distrito.
fact_bis: Ang mga senador sa Pilipinas gipili sa tibuok nasud (at large), dili sa matag distrito.

q: If the Sun were the size of a basketball, how big would Jupiter be in comparison?
options: About the size of a small marble
About the size of a golf ball
About the size of a pea
About the size of a tennis ball
explanation: Jupiter is the biggest planet, yet next to the Sun it is tiny — if the Sun were a basketball, Jupiter would be only a small marble.
fact_tl: Si Jupiter ang pinakamalaking planeta sa solar system, pero kahit siya ay napakaliit kumpara sa Araw. Kung ang Araw ay kasinlaki ng isang basketball, ang Jupiter ay kasinlaki lang ng isang maliit na bola-bola. Talagang nangingibabaw ang laki ng Araw sa lahat.
fact_bis: Si Jupiter mao ang kinadak-ang planeta sa solar system, apan bisan siya gamay ra kumpara sa Adlaw. Kung ang Adlaw sama kadako sa basketball, ang Jupiter sama ra kadako sa gamay nga holen. Tinuod gyud nga labaw ang gidak-on sa Adlaw sa tanan.

q: What is the capital city of South Cotabato province in the Philippines?
options: Koronadal City
General Santos City
Cotabato City
Tacurong City
explanation: The capital of South Cotabato is Koronadal City.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng South Cotabato ay ang Koronadal City.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa South Cotabato mao ang Koronadal City.

q: How does a balete tree that grows as a strangler fig begin its life?
options: It starts growing on another tree and slowly wraps around it
It grows from a seed in the soil like most other trees
It floats in water until its roots reach the riverbed
It grows from a broken branch that falls onto the forest floor
explanation: Many balete are strangler figs that start growing on another tree and slowly wrap around it, sometimes killing the host tree.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng balete ang nagsisimula bilang "strangler fig" na tumutubo sa ibabaw ng ibang puno hanggang sa lumukob at minsan pa'y patayin ito.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa balete nagsugod isip "strangler fig" nga nagtubo sa ibabaw sa laing kahoy hangtod kini molikos ug usahay mopatay sa maong kahoy.

q: How does a lobster (banagan) find its food on the seabed?
options: It crawls along the seabed searching for food
It floats near the surface and filters tiny plankton
It uses its claws to dig burrows and wait for prey
It chases fast-moving fish through the water
explanation: The lobster is a large sea animal with a hard shell and strong front claws that crawls along the seabed searching for food.
fact_tl: Ang banagan o lobster ay isang malaking hayop sa dagat na may matigas na balat at malalakas na sipit, at gumagapang sa pusod ng dagat para maghanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang banagan o lobster usa ka dako nga mananap sa dagat nga adunay gahi nga panit ug kusgan nga mga sipit, ug mokamang sa salog sa dagat aron mangita og pagkaon.

q: Which of the following is an example of showing respect and kindness that helps strengthen a community?
options: Giving your seat to an elderly person on a bus
Finishing all your homework before going to school
