fact_tl: Ang mga bituin ay ipinanganak sa loob ng malaking ulap ng gas at alikabok na tinatawag na nebula; ang gravity ay nagtitipon ng materyal na ito hanggang sa ito ay maging mainit at siksik para magsimulang mag-nuclear fusion, na lumilikha ng bagong bituin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituin natawo sulod sa dagkong mga panganod sa gas ug abug nga ginganlan og nebula; ang gravity nagtabok niining materyal hangtod mahimong init ug siksik aron magsugod ang nuclear fusion, nagmugna og bag-ong bituin.

q: What happens to the silk inside a silkworm's body when it comes out into the air?
options: It quickly hardens from a soft, liquid-like substance into a strong thread.
It dissolves in the air and must be collected very quickly before it disappears.
It remains soft and liquid until the silkworm wraps it around its body many times.
It turns into a solid powder that sticks together when the silkworm wets it with saliva.
explanation: Inside the silkworm the silk is soft and liquid-like, but once it comes out into the air it quickly hardens into a strong thread.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng katawan ng silkworm, ang sutla ay malambot pa at parang likido. Pagkalabas sa hangin, ito ay agad na tumitigas at nagiging matibay na sinulid.
fact_bis: Sulod sa lawas sa silkworm, ang sutla humok pa ug murag likido. Pagkagawas sa hangin, mogahi dayon kini ug mahimong lig-on nga sinulid.

q: What was the magnitude of the 2013 earthquake in Bohol, and what did it damage?
options: It measured 7.2 and damaged many churches, bridges, and part of the Chocolate Hills.
It measured 6.5 and caused a tsunami that flooded the coastal towns of Bohol.
It measured 8.0 and completely destroyed the Chocolate Hills and all historic churches.
It measured 5.9 and mainly cracked roads, with no damage to historic landmarks.
explanation: The 2013 Bohol earthquake measured 7.2 and damaged many churches, bridges, and part of the Chocolate Hills, showing the importance of evacuation planning.
fact_tl: Ang lindol na lumindol sa Bohol noong 2013 ay may lakas na 7.2 at nagpinsala ng maraming simbahan, tulay, at ang bahagi ng Chocolate Hills, na nagpapakita kung gaano kahalaga ang paglikas.
fact_bis: Ang lindol sa Bohol niadtong 2013 adunay kusog nga 7.2 ug nagdaot sa daghang mga simbahan, tulay, ug bahin sa Chocolate Hills, nagpakita sa kahinungdanon sa paglikas.

q: When is the best time to pick okra for eating, and why?
options: While it is still young and tender, because if it grows old it turns hard and is no longer good to eat.
After it is fully grown and large, because that is when it has the most seeds and flavor inside.
Only at night, because okra toughens in sunlight and becomes hard if picked during the day.
When the pod turns yellow, because that color means the okra has reached peak flavor.
explanation: Okra is a pod full of tiny seeds and should be picked while still young and tender; if it grows old, it turns hard and is no longer good to eat.
fact_tl: Ang okra ay isang supot na puno ng maliliit na buto sa loob. Pinipitas natin ito habang bata pa at malambot — kapag tumanda na, tumitigas ito at hindi na masarap.
fact_bis: Ang okra usa ka supot nga puno sa gagmayng liso sa sulod. Among kuhaon kini samtang bata pa ug humok — kon motigulang na, mogahi kini ug dili na lami.

q: How does a cricket make its chirping sound?
options: By rubbing its wings together.
By vibrating a special membrane in its throat.
By clicking its back legs against its body.
By pushing air through holes along its abdomen.
explanation: A cricket makes its chirping sound by rubbing its wings together, not with its mouth or legs.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig ay gumagawa ng huni sa gabi sa pamamagitan ng pagkiskis ng kanyang mga pakpak, hindi sa pamamagitan ng bibig.
fact_bis: Ang kuliglig magbuhat sa iyang huni panahon sa gabii pinaagi sa pagkuskos sa iyang mga pako, dili pinaagi sa baba.

q: What is a key feature that describes mollusks as a group?
options: They have soft bodies, and many of them have a hard protective shell.
They have hard, jointed bodies covered by an exoskeleton made of chitin.
They have no body at all — they are made only of jelly-like material.
They have scaly bodies like fish and breathe through gills their whole lives.
explanation: Mollusks are soft-bodied animals, and many of them have a hard protective shell — snails, clams, and squid are all mollusks.
fact_tl: Ang mga molusko ay mga hayop na may malambot na katawan, at marami sa kanila ay may matigas na kabibe na pananggalang.
fact_bis: Ang mga molusko mga hayop nga humok ug lawas, ug daghan kanila adunay gahi nga kabhang nga pangpanalipod.

q: Why do many farmers choose to live near active volcanoes despite the danger?
options: The ash and minerals from eruptions enrich the soil, so crops grow very well nearby.
Volcanoes create warm underground water that farmers use to irrigate their fields year-round.
The lava cools into flat land that is easier to farm than hilly areas far from volcanoes.
Volcanic smoke keeps away insects and pests that would otherwise destroy the crops.
explanation: Even though they are dangerous, active volcanoes enrich the surrounding soil with ash and minerals from eruptions, which helps crops grow well.
fact_tl: Kahit delikado, may pakinabang ang aktibong bulkan: ang abo at mineral mula sa pagputok ay nagpapataba ng lupa. Kaya maraming magsasaka ang nakatira malapit dito dahil masagana ang ani.
fact_bis: Bisan delikado, adunay kaayohan ang aktibo nga bulkan: ang abo ug mineral gikan sa pagputok mopatabunok sa yuta. Mao nga daghang mag-uuma ang nagpuyo duol niini kay maayo ang ani.

q: Why is a carabao mango usually peeled before eating?
options: Because its skin is a bit bitter and tough, and the sweet flesh inside is what we eat.
Because the skin contains seeds that are poisonous and must be removed before eating.
Because mango skin is so sweet that eating it causes an upset stomach.
Because peeling makes the mango easier to slice, but the skin is perfectly fine to eat.
explanation: A carabao mango is usually peeled because its skin is a bit bitter and tough; the sweet, delicious flesh inside is what we eat.
fact_tl: Karaniwang binabalatan ang carabao mango bago kainin dahil ang balat nito ay medyo mapait at makapal; ang matamis na laman sa loob ang sinusubo.
fact_bis: Kasagaran panitan ang carabao mango una kan-on tungod kay ang panit niini medyo pait ug gahi; ang tam-is nga unod sa sulod ang atong kan-on.

q: What kind of food does an omnivore eat?
options: Both plants and animals.
Only plants like leaves, fruits, and grass.
Only other animals and never plants.
Only insects and small invertebrates.
explanation: An omnivore eats both plants and animals — humans, pigs, and chickens are examples of omnivores.
fact_tl: Ang omnivore ay hayop na kumakain ng halaman at hayop pareho. Halimbawa nito ang tao, baboy, at manok.
fact_bis: Ang omnivore usa ka hayop nga mokaon og tanom ug hayop pareho. Pananglitan niini ang tawo, baboy, ug manok.

q: Where does a mangrove tree grow?
options: Along the coast where the land meets the sea.
Deep in the rainforest far from any body of water.
On mountain slopes where there is lots of rain.
At the bottom of rivers, fully underwater.
explanation: A mangrove is a tree that grows along the coast where the land meets the sea, often in salty or brackish water.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan ay isang puno na tumutubo sa baybayin kung saan nagtatagpo ang lupa at dagat.
fact_bis: Ang bakhaw kay usa ka kahoy nga motubo sa baybayon diin maghiusa ang yuta ug dagat.

q: Why does bread dough rise and become full of holes when it is baked?
options: Yeast ferments and releases carbon dioxide gas, which is trapped by the stretchy gluten in the flour.
The flour absorbs water and expands in size when it is heated in the oven.
Baking soda reacts with the flour to produce tiny air pockets throughout the dough.
Steam from the water in the dough pushes the gluten apart and creates air pockets.
explanation: As yeast ferments in the dough, the carbon dioxide it releases is trapped by the flour's stretchy gluten, making the bread rise and become full of holes.
fact_tl: Habang nagfe-ferment ang lebadura sa masa, ang carbon dioxide na nalalabas ay nakukulong ng nababanat na gluten ng harina, kaya umaalsa at nagiging mabuko ang tinapay.
fact_bis: Samtang mo-ferment ang lebadura sa masa, ang carbon dioxide nga gibuga niini makulong sa nabanat nga gluten sa harina, mao nga moalsa ug magbuho-buho ang tinapay.

q: What happens in the body when a person has diabetes?
options: There is too little insulin or the insulin does not work well, so sugar stays high in the blood instead of entering the cells.
The body makes too much insulin, which forces too much sugar into the cells and starves the blood.
The pancreas makes no digestive enzymes, so food cannot be broken down into sugar at all.
The liver stores too much sugar and releases it all at once, causing sudden spikes in blood sugar.
explanation: Diabetes happens when there is too little insulin or the insulin does not work well, so sugar cannot enter the cells and stays high in the blood.
fact_tl: Ang diabetes ay nangyayari kapag kulang ang insulin o hindi ito gumagana nang maayos. Dahil dito, hindi maipasok ang asukal sa mga cell at nananatiling mataas ito sa dugo. Ito ay halimbawa ng sakit kapag may problema sa endocrine system.
fact_bis: Ang diabetes mahitabo kon kulang ang insulin o dili kini molihok og maayo. Tungod niini, dili makasulod ang asukal ngadto sa mga selula ug magpabilin kining taas sa dugo. Pananglitan kini sa sakit kon adunay problema sa endocrine system.

q: How are weaver ants and their eggs used as food in some parts of Asia?
options: They are eaten as food or a delicacy in some Asian countries.
They are only used to flavor soups but are never eaten whole by people.
They are fed to farm animals as a protein supplement but are not eaten by humans.
They are dried and ground into powder that is used as a spice in cooking.
explanation: In some parts of Asia, weaver ants and their eggs are eaten as food or considered a delicacy.
fact_tl: Sa ilang bahagi ng Asya, ang mga hantik at ang kanilang mga itlog ay kinakain bilang pagkain o delikadesa.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka bahin sa Asya, ang mga hantik ug ang ilang mga itlog kaonon isip pagkaon o delikadesa.

q: In sickle cell anemia, what causes red blood cells to curve into a sickle shape instead of staying round?
options: Just one wrong letter in the DNA instructions changes the shape of the red blood cells.
A virus attacks the red blood cells and reshapes them into a curved form.
A lack of iron in the diet prevents red blood cells from keeping their normal round shape.
The bone marrow produces too many red blood cells, causing them to crowd and bend.
explanation: Sickle cell anemia is caused by just one wrong letter in the DNA, which makes red blood cells curve into a sickle shape and carry oxygen less well.
fact_tl: Magandang halimbawa ang sickle cell anemia: isang maling letra lang sa DNA ang nagiging dahilan para maging hugis-karit ang mga pulang selula ng dugo sa halip na bilog. Dahil dito, mahirap silang dumaloy at nahihirapang magdala ng oxygen. Ipinapakita nito kung gaano kalaki ang epekto ng kahit napakaliit na pagbabago.
fact_bis: Maayong panig-ingnan ang sickle cell anemia: usa ra ka sayop nga letra sa DNA ang hinungdan nga ang pula nga selula sa dugo mahimong hugis-garab imbis nga lingin. Tungod niini lisod silang modagayday ug maglisod sa pagdala og oxygen. Gipakita niini nga bisan gamay kaayo nga kausaban makaadunay dako nga epekto.

q: Who was the pilot of the very first airplane flight in 1903?
options: Orville Wright.
Wilbur Wright.
Charles Lindbergh.
Louis Blériot.
explanation: Orville Wright was the pilot of the very first airplane flight in 1903, while his brother Wilbur watched from the ground.
fact_tl: Si Orville Wright ang piloto sa kauna-unahang lipad ng eroplano noong 1903.
fact_bis: Si Orville Wright mao ang piloto sa kinaunahang paglupad sa eroplano niadtong 1903.

q: What does the cell theory state about all living things?
options: All living things are made of one or more cells.
All living things share the same type of cell with the same structure.
All living things can only survive if their cells contain a nucleus.
All living things are made of cells that are visible to the naked eye.
explanation: According to the cell theory, all living things are made of one or more cells — the cell is the basic unit of life.
fact_tl: Ayon sa cell theory (teorya ng selula), lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay ay binubuo ng isa o higit pang selula.
fact_bis: Sumala sa cell theory (teoriya sa selula), ang tanang buhing butang gilangkuban sa usa o daghang selula.

q: What was the nationality of Alfred Nobel, who invented dynamite and founded the Nobel Prize?
options: Swedish, from Sweden.
Norwegian, from Norway.
German, from Germany.
Danish, from Denmark.
explanation: Alfred Nobel, who invented dynamite and founded the Nobel Prize, was Swedish — he was born in Stockholm, Sweden.
fact_tl: Si Alfred Nobel, ang gumawa ng dinamita at nagtatag ng Nobel Prize, ay isang Suweko (mula sa Sweden).
fact_bis: Si Alfred Nobel, ang naghimo sa dinamita ug nagtukod sa Nobel Prize, usa ka Suweko (gikan sa Sweden).

q: Why is the coconut important to the Philippines?
options: The Philippines is one of the world's leading coconut producers, and coconut products are important to the livelihood of many Filipinos.
Coconuts are the only fruit that grows in the Philippines and is exported around the world.
The Philippines uses coconut shells to build houses because wood is scarce on the islands.
Coconut water is the main drinking water source for Filipinos who live far from rivers.
explanation: The Philippines is one of the world's leading coconut producers, and coconut products like coconut oil are important to the livelihood of many Filipinos.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang tagagawa ng niyog sa mundo; ang niyog at mga produkto nito tulad ng langis ay mahalaga sa kabuhayan ng maraming Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa nanguna nga nagprodyus og niyog sa kalibutan; ang niyog ug iyang mga produkto sama sa lana sa niyog importante sa kabuhayan sa daghang Pilipino.

q: Who discovered that a pendulum swings at a steady rate, and what did this discovery lead to?
options: Galileo Galilei discovered it, and it became the basis of the pendulum clock.
Isaac Newton discovered it, and it became the basis for understanding gravity.
Leonardo da Vinci discovered it, and he used it to design early flying machines.
Nicolaus Copernicus discovered it, and it helped him measure the movement of planets.
explanation: Galileo Galilei discovered that a pendulum swings at a steady rate, which became the basis of the pendulum clock.
fact_tl: Si Galileo Galilei ang nakatuklas na ang palawit ay umuugoy sa pare-parehong takbo, na naging batayan ng pendulum clock.
fact_bis: Si Galileo Galilei ang nakadiskobre nga ang palawit moindayog sa parehas nga gidaghanon, nga nahimong basehan sa pendulum clock.

q: How can too many epiphytes growing on one tree cause harm?
options: Their combined weight can break branches, and they can also block light from the tree's own leaves.
They release a chemical that poisons the tree's roots and stops it from absorbing water.
They steal all the nutrients from the tree's bark, leaving the tree with nothing to grow on.
They attract insects that bore holes into the tree's trunk and weaken its structure.
explanation: If too many epiphytes grow on one tree, their weight can break branches and they can block sunlight from reaching the tree's own leaves.
fact_tl: Kung sobra-sobra ang dami ng epiphyte sa isang puno, maaaring bumigat ito at makapagpabali ng sanga. Maaari rin nilang harangan ang liwanag para sa mga dahon ng puno.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ka daghan ang epiphyte sa usa ka kahoy, mahimong mabug-at kini ug makabali sa sanga. Mahimo usab nilang babagan ang kahayag para sa mga dahon sa kahoy.

q: What is humus, and how does adding compost help a garden?
options: Humus is the dark part of soil made from decayed organic matter; compost adds it to soil and helps plants grow bigger.
Humus is a chemical fertilizer made in a factory that is mixed into soil to add nutrients.
Humus is the hard rocky layer under topsoil; compost softens it so plant roots can reach water.
Humus is a type of fungus that lives in soil and makes the soil smell dark and earthy.
explanation: Humus is the dark part of soil made from decayed leaves and organic matter, and adding compost (home-made humus) improves soil and helps plants grow bigger.
fact_tl: Ang humus ay ang itim na bahagi ng lupa na gawa sa mga nabulok na dahon, sanga, at iba pang organikong bagay; ang pagdadagdag ng compost (ginawang humus) sa lupa ay nagpapaganda nito at nagpapalaki ng mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang humus mao ang ngitngit nga bahin sa yuta nga gihimo gikan sa nadunot nga mga dahon, sanga, ug ubang organikong butang; ang pagdugang sa compost (gawa sa balay nga humus) sa yuta nagpahimog niini ug nagtabang sa mga halaman nga motubo og mas dako.

q: What does water vapor need in order to form the tiny droplets that make up a cloud?
options: Tiny particles like dust or salt for the water vapor to stick to.
A cold surface like a mountain peak to freeze the vapor into droplets.
Sunlight to break apart the water vapor so it can recombine as liquid droplets.
Wind to compress the water vapor until it turns into liquid droplets.
explanation: For a cloud to form, water vapor needs tiny particles like dust or salt to stick to, which become the core of the little droplets that make up the cloud.
fact_tl: Para mabuo ang ulap, kailangan ng napakaliliit na particle tulad ng alikabok o asin sa hangin; kumakapit dito ang singaw ng tubig at nagiging maliliit na patak na bumubuo ng ulap.
fact_bis: Aron maporma ang panganod, kinahanglan ang gagmay kaayo nga partikulo sama sa abog o asin sa hangin; mokapyot dinhi ang singaw sa tubig ug mahimong gagmay nga tulo nga maghimo sa panganod.

q: What happens to the observed wavelength of a sound or light wave when the source moves toward you?
options: The observed wavelength becomes shorter.
The observed wavelength becomes longer.
The observed wavelength stays the same but gets louder.
The observed wavelength doubles because the waves arrive faster.
explanation: According to the Doppler effect, the observed wavelength becomes shorter when the source or observer moves toward the other, and longer when they move apart.
fact_tl: Ang naoobserbahang wavelength ng isang alon ay nagiging mas maikli kapag papalapit ang pinagmumulan o tagamasid sa isa't isa, at mas mahaba kapag papalayo sila.
fact_bis: Ang nakit-an nga wavelength sa usa ka balod mahimong mas mubo kung ang tinubdan o tagpaniid magpaduol sa usag usa, ug mas taas kung sila magpalayo.

q: Which mission was the first to carry humans around the Moon?
options: Apollo 8 in 1968.
Apollo 11 in 1969.
Apollo 13 in 1970.
Apollo 1 in 1967.
explanation: Apollo 8 in 1968 was the first mission to carry humans around the Moon, though it did not land on the surface.
fact_tl: Ang unang misyon na nagdala ng mga tao paikot sa buwan ay ang Apollo 8 noong 1968.
fact_bis: Ang unang misyon nga nagdala ug mga tawo libot sa bulan mao ang Apollo 8 niadtong 1968.

q: Why do scientists prioritize protecting keystone species?
options: Because saving one keystone species helps the whole habitat and many other animals that depend on it.
Because keystone species are the largest animals in a habitat and keep smaller animals under control.
Because keystone species are the rarest animals and scientists want to prevent all extinctions equally.
Because keystone species produce the most offspring and their protection is easiest to achieve.
explanation: Scientists protect keystone species because saving one helps the entire habitat and the many other animals that depend on it to survive.
fact_tl: Pinoprotektahan ng mga siyentipiko ang mga keystone species dahil ang pag-iingat sa isang ito ay nakatutulong sa buong habitat at maraming ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Ginapanalipdan sa mga siyentista ang mga keystone species kay ang pag-amping niini makatabang sa tibuok puy-anan ug sa daghang ubang hayop.

q: Where is the Malampaya gas field located?
options: Offshore in the waters northwest of Palawan.
Offshore in the waters east of Leyte in the Philippine Sea.
Underground beneath the Cagayan Valley in northern Luzon.
Beneath the Laguna de Bay lake in Metro Manila.
explanation: The Malampaya gas field is located offshore in the waters northwest of Palawan and is one of the Philippines' most important energy sources.
fact_tl: Ang Malampaya gas field ay matatagpuan sa karagatan sa hilaga-kanluran ng Palawan.
fact_bis: Ang Malampaya gas field nahimutang sa dagat sa amihanan-kasadpan sa Palawan.

q: Why can water pipes burst in very cold weather?
options: Because water expands as it turns to ice, creating pressure that breaks the pipe.
Because cold temperatures make metal pipes shrink and crack along their seams.
Because frozen air outside the pipe pushes inward and crushes the pipe walls.
Because water contracts when it freezes, pulling the pipe walls inward until they tear.
explanation: Water pipes can burst in very cold places because water expands as it turns to ice, building up pressure that breaks the pipe.
fact_tl: Pumuputok ang mga tubo ng tubig sa sobrang lamig dahil lumalawak ang tubig habang nagiging yelo.
fact_bis: Ang mga tubo sa tubig mabuto sa hilabihang katugnaw kay ang tubig molapad samtang mahimong yelo.

q: What makes the lipa tree in the Philippines dangerous to touch?
options: Its leaves have stinging hairs that are very painful to touch.
Its sap contains a strong acid that burns the skin on contact.
Its thorns are hollow and inject a mild venom when they pierce the skin.
Its bark releases a toxic powder that causes a rash when touched.
explanation: The lipa tree in the Philippines has leaves covered with stinging hairs that are very painful to touch.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang punong lipa ay may dahong may nakakapasong balahibo na napakasakit kapag nahawakan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang kahoy nga lipa adunay dahon nga may makapaso nga balhibo nga sakit kaayo kung mahikap.

q: What services do Philippine telecommunications companies like PLDT and Globe provide?
options: Cellphone and internet services to millions of Filipinos nationwide.
Electricity and water supply to homes and businesses across the country.
Television broadcasting and radio services to rural and urban communities.
Postal services and package delivery to all regions of the Philippines.
explanation: Philippine telecommunications companies like PLDT and Globe provide cellphone and internet services to millions of Filipinos across the country.
fact_tl: Ang mga kumpanya ng telekomunikasyon sa Pilipinas tulad ng PLDT at Globe ay nagbibigay ng serbisyo ng cellphone at internet sa milyun-milyong Pilipino sa buong bansa.
fact_bis: Ang mga kumpanya sa telekomunikasyon sa Pilipinas sama sa PLDT ug Globe naghatag og serbisyo sa cellphone ug internet sa milyun-milyon nga Pilipino sa tibuok nasod.

q: How does a vaccine protect the body from getting sick?
options: It teaches the immune system to recognize and fight a specific virus before it can make us sick.
It kills all viruses in the body immediately after it is injected into the bloodstream.
It builds a barrier around body cells so that viruses cannot enter and infect them.
It increases body temperature to a level that destroys viruses before they can multiply.
explanation: A vaccine teaches our immune system to recognize and fight a specific virus before it can make us sick, giving us protection without the illness.
fact_tl: Ang bakuna ay nagtuturo sa ating immune system na kilalanin at labanan ang isang virus bago pa tayo magkasakit dito.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna magtudlo sa atong immune system nga mailhan ug labanan ang usa ka virus sa dili pa kita masakit niini.

q: How big can a roundworm, or Ascaris, grow inside a person's intestines?
options: As long as a pencil.
As long as a finger.
As long as a person's arm.
As long as a grain of rice.
explanation: The roundworm, or Ascaris, is one of the most common intestinal worms and can grow as long as a pencil inside the intestines.
fact_tl: Ang roundworm o Ascaris ay isa sa pinakakaraniwang bulate, at pwede itong tumubo nang kasinghaba ng lapis sa loob ng bituka.
fact_bis: Ang roundworm o Ascaris kay usa sa labing kasagaran nga bulate, ug makatubo kini sama kataas sa lapis sulod sa tinai.

q: How long can a dugong live if it stays safe?
options: More than 70 years.
About 20 to 30 years.
About 40 to 50 years.
Around 10 years, similar to most large sea animals.
explanation: Dugongs are long-lived animals and can reach more than 70 years of age if they are protected from danger.
fact_tl: Mahaba ang buhay ng dugong, na maaaring umabot ng mahigit 70 taon kung ligtas ito.
fact_bis: Ang dugong tag-as og kinabuhi ug mahimong mosobra sa 70 ka tuig kon luwas kini.

q: What is quartz made of?
options: Silicon dioxide (SiO2).
Calcium carbonate (CaCO3).
Iron oxide (Fe2O3).
Aluminum silicate (Al2SiO5).
explanation: Quartz is made of silicon dioxide (SiO2) and is one of the most common minerals found on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang quartz ay gawa sa silicon dioxide (SiO2) at isa ito sa pinakakaraniwang mineral sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang quartz hinimo sa silicon dioxide (SiO2) ug usa kini sa pinakakomon nga mineral sa Yuta.

q: What happens in a synthesis or combination reaction?
options: Two or more substances join together to form a single new compound.
A single compound breaks apart into two or more simpler substances.
One substance replaces another in a compound to form a different compound.
Two compounds exchange parts with each other to form two new compounds.
explanation: In a synthesis or combination reaction, two or more substances join together to form a single new compound — for example, hydrogen and oxygen combining to form water.
fact_tl: Sa isang synthesis o combination reaction, dalawa o higit pang sangkap ang nagsasama upang bumuo ng iisang bagong compound, gaya ng hydrogen at oxygen na nagiging tubig.
fact_bis: Sa synthesis o combination reaction, duha o labaw pa ka sangkap ang magtipon aron maghimo og usa ka bag-ong compound, sama sa hydrogen ug oxygen nga mahimong tubig.

q: How do scientists keep track of asteroids that pass close to Earth?
options: They use telescopes to watch asteroids and learn where they are headed.
They send spacecraft to push asteroids off course before they get too close.
They use radar signals bounced off the Moon to detect approaching asteroids.
They rely on reports from astronauts on the International Space Station.
explanation: Scientists use telescopes to watch near-Earth asteroids and learn where they are headed, so they can track any potential threat.
fact_tl: Binabantayan ng mga siyentista ang mga asteroid na malapit dumaan sa Mundo gamit ang teleskopyo upang malaman kung saan sila pupunta.
fact_bis: Gibantayan sa mga siyentista ang mga asteroid nga duol moagi sa Kalibutan gamit ang teleskopyo aron mahibaloan kung asa sila padulong.

q: What is the FIRST thing you should do if someone has been poisoned by carbon monoxide?
options: Give them water to drink right away
Move them into fresh air immediately and call for help
Cover them with a blanket to keep them warm
Have them breathe slowly into a paper bag
explanation: Fresh air is the immediate first step because outside oxygen slowly replaces the CO in the blood while help is on the way.
fact_tl: Kapag may nalason sa carbon monoxide, ang unang dapat gawin ay ilabas siya agad sa sariwang hangin at tumawag ng tulong. Sa labas, unti-unting napapalitan ng oxygen ang CO sa dugo. Sa ospital, binibigyan sila ng dalisay na oxygen para mas mabilis itong mawala.
fact_bis: Kung adunay nahiloan sa carbon monoxide, ang unang buhaton kay ipagawas siya dayon sa presko nga hangin ug motawag og tabang. Sa gawas, hinay-hinay nga mapulihan og oxygen ang CO sa dugo. Sa ospital, hatagan sila og putli nga oxygen aron mas paspas kining mawala.

q: How many body parts does a spider have?
options: Three — head, thorax, and abdomen
Four — head, neck, chest, and abdomen
Two — the cephalothorax and the abdomen
Six — one for each pair of legs
explanation: A spider's body is divided into only two parts: the cephalothorax (fused head and chest) and the abdomen.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng gagamba ay may dalawang (2) bahagi lang: ang cephalothorax (pinagsamang ulo at dibdib) at ang abdomen.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa lawalawa adunay duha (2) lang ka bahin: ang cephalothorax (gihiusang ulo ug dughan) ug ang abdomen.

q: What is the name for a magnet that is made by running electricity through a coil of wire?
options: Permanent magnet
Bar magnet
Electromagnet
Neodymium magnet
explanation: A magnet created by electricity flowing through a wire coil is called an electromagnet.
fact_tl: Ang magnet na ginagawa gamit ang kuryenteng dumadaloy sa nakapulupot na alambre ay tinatawag na electromagnet.
fact_bis: Ang magnet nga gihimo gamit ang koryente nga nag-agas sa giliki nga alambre gitawag nga electromagnet.

q: Why can adult mayflies survive only one or two days?
options: They freeze to death after the first night
They are eaten by fish almost immediately after hatching
They have no working mouthparts and cannot eat, so they live just long enough to mate and lay eggs
They breathe through gills that dry out in open air
explanation: Adult mayflies have no functional mouthparts, so they cannot eat; their only purpose is to mate and lay eggs before they die.
fact_tl: Ang adult na mayfly ay nabubuhay ng isang araw o dalawa lang—ang buong layunin ng buhay ng adult ay makipagtipan at maglaglag ng itlog; walang bibig ang adult mayfly para kumain.
fact_bis: Ang hamtong nga mayfly nabuhi lamang og usa o duha ka adlaw—ang tibuok katuyoan sa hamtong nga mayfly magtatipan ug magitlog; ang hamtong nga mayfly walay functional nga baba para mokaon.

q: Where exactly are your taste buds found?
options: On the roof of your mouth
Along the inside of your cheeks
Inside the tiny bumps on the surface of your tongue
On the back of your throat
explanation: Taste buds sit inside the small bumps visible on the tongue's surface.
fact_tl: Ang mga taste buds ay nasa loob ng maliliit na bukol na makikita sa ibabaw ng dila.
fact_bis: Ang mga taste buds anaa sulod sa gagmay nga mga bukol nga makita sa ibabaw sa dila.

q: What happens to your body when you yawn?
options: Your heart beats faster to wake you up
You exhale a large amount of stale air through your nose
You pull a big amount of air into your lungs while opening your mouth wide
Your stomach tightens to push air into your lungs
explanation: A yawn is a deep breath in which a large amount of air is drawn into the lungs while the mouth opens wide.
fact_tl: Ang paghikab ay isang malalim na paghinga kung saan malaki ang ipinapasok mong hangin sa baga sabay ng pagbuka ng bibig.
fact_bis: Ang paghuy-ab usa ka lalom nga pagginhawa diin daghan ang imong gipasulod nga hangin sa baga samtang gibuka ang baba.

q: Decomposers recycle matter in an ecosystem. What happens to energy in that same ecosystem?
options: Energy is also recycled by decomposers and returned to plants
Energy builds up in the soil over time
Energy is gradually lost as heat and cannot be recycled, so sunlight is always needed
Energy is stored in rocks until the next growing season
explanation: While atoms and nutrients cycle through decomposers, energy flows one way and is gradually lost as heat, which is why ecosystems depend on a constant input of sunlight.
fact_tl: Pinararami ng mga decomposers ang siklo ng materya: paulit-ulit na ginagamit ang mga atomo at sustansya. Pero ang enerhiya ay hindi umiikot — unti-unti itong nawawala bilang init, kaya patuloy na kailangan ang sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga decomposers nagpadayon sa siklo sa materya: balik-balik nga gamiton ang mga atomo ug sustansya. Apan ang enerhiya dili molibot — anam-anam kining mawala isip kainit, mao nga kanunay gikinahanglan ang kahayag sa adlaw.

q: What kind of bird do most Filipinos call a maya?
options: A brightly colored parrot found in rainforests
A large black crow common in cities
A small brown bird called the Eurasian tree sparrow, often seen near houses
A tiny hummingbird that feeds on flower nectar
explanation: The bird Filipinos commonly call maya is the Eurasian tree sparrow, a small brown bird often found around houses and gardens.
fact_tl: Ang ibong tinatawag na maya sa Pilipinas ay kadalasang ang Eurasian tree sparrow, isang maliit na kayumangging ibon na madalas makita sa mga bahay at hardin.
fact_bis: Ang langgam nga gitawag og maya sa Pilipinas kasagaran mao ang Eurasian tree sparrow, gamay nga kapehong langgam nga makita sa mga balay ug tanaman.

q: Why are wild greens like saluyot and talinum easier to find during the rainy season?
options: Fewer animals eat them when it rains
Rainwater washes seeds from distant farms into local gardens
Rain gives plants the water they need to grow faster and in greater numbers
The soil becomes too hard to dig during the dry season, burying the plants
explanation: Rain provides the water plants need to grow, so wild greens grow faster and in greater amounts during the rainy season.
fact_tl: Mas marami at mas mabilis tumubo ang gulay-ligaw kapag tag-ulan. Ang ulan ay nagbibigay ng tubig na kailangan ng mga halaman para lumago. Kaya sa panahong ito, mas madali makakita ng saluyot, talinum, at iba pang ligaw na gulay.
fact_bis: Mas daghan ug mas paspas motubo ang gulay-ligaw kung tag-ulan. Ang ulan maghatag og tubig nga gikinahanglan sa mga tanom aron motubo. Mao nga niini nga panahon, mas sayon makakita og saluyot, talinum, ug uban pang ihalas nga utanon.

q: Besides grass, what else does a goat need every day to stay healthy?
options: Salt licks only — grass provides all the moisture it needs
Fruit and vegetables to get enough vitamins
Clean water to drink, because grass alone does not quench its thirst
Grains like corn or rice every morning
explanation: Even when grazing, a goat needs clean drinking water because the moisture in grass alone is not enough to satisfy its thirst.
fact_tl: Bukod sa damo, kailangan din ng kambing ng malinis na tubig na maiinom, dahil hindi sapat ang basa ng damo para mapawi ang uhaw nito.
fact_bis: Gawas sa sagbot, kinahanglan usab sa kanding ang limpyo nga tubig nga mainom, kay ang kabasa sa sagbot dili igo aron mapawong ang iyang kauhaw.

q: Approximately how long is the coastline of Manila Bay?
options: About 50 kilometers long
About 190 kilometers long
About 450 kilometers long
About 800 kilometers long
explanation: The coastline of Manila Bay stretches about 190 kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang baybayin ng Look ng Maynila (Manila Bay) ay may habang halos 190 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang baybayon sa Luok sa Manila (Manila Bay) adunay gitas-on nga mga 190 ka kilometro.

q: Which Philippine law protects endemic animals from hunting, capture, and trade?
options: Republic Act 8550 (Philippine Fisheries Code)
Republic Act 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act)
Republic Act 9147 (Philippine Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act)
Republic Act 7586 (National Integrated Protected Areas System Act)
explanation: Republic Act 9147, the Philippine Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act, protects all endemic Philippine animals from hunting, capture, and trade.
fact_tl: Ang Republic Act 9147 o Philippine Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act ay nagpoprotekta sa lahat ng endemikong hayop ng Pilipinas mula sa pangangaso, pagdakip, at pagbebenta.
fact_bis: Ang Republic Act 9147 o Philippine Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act nagprotekta sa tanan nga endemikong hayop sa Pilipinas gikan sa pagpangayam, pagdakop, ug kalakalan.

q: How many teeth does a fully grown adult human have?
options: 20 teeth
28 teeth
32 teeth
36 teeth
explanation: A complete set of adult teeth totals 32.
fact_tl: Ang isang nasa hustong gulang na tao ay may 32 na ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hamtong nga tawo adunay 32 ka ngipon.

q: About what percentage of air is made up of nitrogen and oxygen together?
options: About 50%
About 78%
About 99%
About 100%
explanation: Nitrogen and oxygen combined make up about 99% of the air we breathe.
fact_tl: Magkasama, ang nitrogen at oxygen ay halos 99% ng hangin.
fact_bis: Kombinado, ang nitrogen ug oxygen mga 99% sa tibuok hangin.

q: What makes balut a nutritious food?
options: It is very low in calories and easy to digest
It contains high amounts of vitamin C
It is rich in protein and nutrients
It provides mostly carbohydrates for quick energy
explanation: Balut is rich in protein and nutrients, making it a nutritious food.
fact_tl: Ang balut ay mayaman sa protina at sustansya, kaya isa itong masustansyang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang balut dato sa protina ug sustansya, busa usa kini ka masustansyang pagkaon.

q: How do mRNA vaccines like some COVID-19 vaccines work?
options: They inject a weakened live virus that trains the immune system
They inject antibodies directly into the blood to fight the disease
They give the body instructions to make one piece of a germ so the immune system learns to fight it
They block the germ from entering cells using a chemical barrier
explanation: mRNA vaccines give the body genetic instructions to produce one harmless piece of a germ, which the immune system then learns to recognize and fight.
fact_tl: Ang mga mRNA vaccine, gaya ng ilang COVID-19 vaccine, ay nagbibigay sa katawan ng instruksiyon para gumawa ng isang bahagi ng mikrobyo na malalabanan ng immune system.
fact_bis: Ang mRNA vaccines, sama sa ubang COVID-19 vaccine, naghatag sa lawas ug mga instruksiyon aron maghimo ug usa ka bahin sa mikrobyo nga makat-onan sa immune system nga sukolon.

q: Besides raising body temperature, how else does a fever help fight bacterial infections?
options: It slows blood flow so bacteria cannot travel through the body
It causes the body to produce extra white blood cells instantly
The body hides iron away from the blood, starving bacteria that need iron to multiply
It flushes bacteria out of the body through sweat
explanation: During a fever, the body withdraws iron from the blood, depriving many bacteria of the iron they need to multiply.
fact_tl: Bukod sa init, kapag may lagnat ay itinatago ng katawan ang iron (bakal) sa dugo. Kailangan ng maraming bakterya ang iron para dumami, kaya kapag nawalan sila nito ay parang ginugutom — isa pang paraan ng katawan para labanan ang sakit.
fact_bis: Gawas sa init, kon adunay hilanat ang lawas magtago sa iron (puthaw) gikan sa dugo. Daghang bakterya nagkinahanglan og iron aron modaghan, busa kon mawala kini mura silag gigutom — laing paagi sa lawas sa pagpakigbatok sa sakit.

q: What is the highest court in the Philippines?
options: The Court of Appeals
The Sandiganbayan
The Supreme Court
The Regional Trial Court
explanation: The Supreme Court is the highest court in the Philippine judicial system.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamataas na hukuman sa Pilipinas ay ang Korte Suprema (Supreme Court).
fact_bis: Ang kinatas-ang hukuman sa Pilipinas mao ang Korte Suprema (Supreme Court).

q: Why can scientists figure out which elements are inside a faraway star?
options: They collect small pieces of the star and test them in a laboratory
Every element has its own unique frequencies of light that it emits and absorbs, which can be detected from far away
Telescopes can photograph the star's surface and identify colored bands by eye
All stars emit the same light, so scientists compare brightness instead
explanation: Each element emits and absorbs its own distinctive frequencies of light, allowing scientists to identify elements even in distant stars.
fact_tl: Bawat elemento ay naglalabas at sumisipsip ng sarili nitong natatanging mga frequency ng liwanag, kaya kayang tukuyin ng mga siyentipiko kung anong elemento ang nasa isang bagay—pati sa malalayong bituin.
fact_bis: Ang matag elemento mobuga ug mosuhop sa kaugalingong talagsaong mga frequency sa kahayag, mao nga matino sa mga siyentista kung unsang elemento ang anaa sa usa ka butang—bisan sa layong mga bituon.

q: Why are plants called producers in a food chain?
options: They produce seeds that animals eat to get energy
They capture energy from the sun through photosynthesis and form the base of the food chain
They produce oxygen that every other living thing needs to survive
They produce soil nutrients by breaking down dead matter
explanation: Plants are called producers because they capture sunlight through photosynthesis and form the first energy level of the food pyramid.
fact_tl: Ang mga halaman na producer ang humuhuli ng enerhiya mula sa araw sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis at sila ang unang antas ng pyramid.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nga gitawag producer maoy mokuha sa enerhiya gikan sa adlaw pinaagi sa potosintesis ug sila ang unang lebel sa pyramid.

q: What is camouflage as an animal adaptation?
options: A behavior where animals move in large groups to confuse predators
A special poison an animal releases when threatened
A color or body shape that blends with surroundings to hide the animal from predators
A loud warning sound an animal makes to scare enemies away
explanation: Camouflage is an adaptation where an animal's color or shape blends with its surroundings so predators cannot easily spot it.
fact_tl: Ang kamuplahe ay isang adaptasyon kung saan ang kulay o anyo ng hayop ay nakakahalo sa kapaligiran upang itago ito sa mananakmal.
fact_bis: Ang kamuplahe usa ka adaptasyon diin ang kolor o porma sa hayop nagsagol sa palibot aron itago kini sa mga manunukob.

q: Why does a flat sheet of paper fall more slowly than a stone dropped from the same height?
options: Paper is lighter, so gravity pulls it down with less force than it pulls the stone
Paper contains trapped air inside its fibers that keeps it floating
More air pushes against the flat paper than against the stone, slowing it down
The stone's smooth shape lets it cut through air while paper bounces off air molecules
explanation: Air resistance pushes back against falling objects, and a flat sheet of paper has more surface area for air to push against than a stone, so it falls more slowly.
fact_tl: Ang hangin ay humaharang sa mga bagay na nahuhulog — tinatawag itong air resistance. Kaya mas mabagal mahulog ang isang bukas na papel o dahon kaysa sa bato: mas malaki ang sumasalubong na hangin sa kanila. Ito rin ang dahilan kung bakit nakakatulong ang parachute.
fact_bis: Ang hangin moali sa mga butang nga nahulog — gitawag kini og air resistance. Mao nga mas hinay mahulog ang bukas nga papel o dahon kaysa bato: mas daghan ang hangin nga mosugat kanila. Mao usab ni ang hinungdan nga molihok ang parachute.

q: How many years does a Philippine senator serve in one term?
options: Three years
Four years
Six years
Nine years
explanation: A Philippine senator serves a term of six years.
fact_tl: Ang isang senador ng Pilipinas ay naglilingkod sa loob ng anim (6) na taon kada termino.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka senador sa Pilipinas nagaserbisyo sulod sa unom (6) ka tuig matag termino.

q: What can happen to the ground when too much groundwater is pumped out during a drought?
options: The ground expands upward as water pressure is released
Rivers and lakes overflow because the water moves above ground
The land can sink and saltwater can push into the freshwater underground
Underground caves collapse and fill with soil instantly
explanation: Over-pumping groundwater lowers the water table, which can cause the land above to sink (subsidence) and allow saltwater to intrude into freshwater aquifers.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang paggamit ng groundwater sa panahon ng tagtuyot ay nagpapababa ng water table; maaaring humantong ito sa subsidence ng lupa at pagpasok ng maalat na tubig ng dagat sa mga freshwater aquifer.
fact_bis: Ang sobrang paggamit sa groundwater sa panahon sa hulaw nagpababa sa water table; mahimong magdala kini sa paglusad sa yuta ug pagsulod sa maalat nga tubig sa dagat sa mga freshwater aquifer.

q: Why does a large light source like the Sun create a penumbra (partial shadow) around an object's shadow?
options: The object is too small to block all the Sun's light, so a full shadow never forms
The Sun's light bends around objects in space, creating a fuzzy edge
Because the Sun is wide, light from one edge can sneak past even when the other edge is blocked, making a zone of partial shadow
The penumbra forms only when two light sources shine on the same object
explanation: A penumbra appears because the Sun is a large source — light from one side can reach around an obstacle even when the opposite side is blocked, creating a partly lit zone.
fact_tl: Lumilitaw ang penumbra kapag malaki ang pinagmulan ng ilaw, tulad ng araw. Dahil malaki ito, may sinag na galing sa isang gilid na nakakalusot kahit naharang ang kabila.
fact_bis: Motumaw ang penumbra kon dako ang tinubdan sa kahayag, sama sa adlaw. Tungod kay lapad kini, ang suga gikan sa usa ka ngilit makalusot bisan nasangga ang pikas.

q: Where does a giant clam spend the rest of its life after it finishes growing up?
options: It slowly migrates along the sea floor looking for food
It floats near the ocean surface to absorb more sunlight
It stays anchored in one spot on the reef for the rest of its life
It digs deep into the sand and only comes out to mate
explanation: Once a giant clam reaches adulthood, it anchors itself to the reef and never moves again.
fact_tl: Kapag lumaki na ang taklobo, nananatili ito sa iisang lugar at nakakapit sa bahura habambuhay.
fact_bis: Kon modako na ang taklobo, magpabilin kini sa usa ka dapit, nakapilit sa bahura sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi.

q: What is the main advantage of an electromagnet over a regular permanent magnet?
options: An electromagnet is always stronger than a permanent magnet of the same size
An electromagnet never loses its magnetism over time
An electromagnet can be switched on to grab iron and switched off to release it
An electromagnet works without any electricity or batteries
explanation: Because an electromagnet is powered by electricity, its magnetic pull can be turned on to grab iron and turned off to drop it when the power is switched off.
fact_tl: Ang elektromagnet ay magneto na gawa sa kuryente, kaya kaya nitong humila ng bakal at bitiwan ito kapag pinatay ang kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang elektromagneto usa ka magneto nga hinimo sa kuryente, busa makakabig kini sa puthaw ug mobitaw kung patyon ang kuryente.

q: Why is it important to count how many children will eat BEFORE cooking in a feeding program?
options: To make sure the food is divided equally by weight
To decide what ingredients to use for the best nutrition
To prepare just enough food and avoid waste, since other children elsewhere may still be hungry
To speed up cooking time by using the right size pot
explanation: Carefully counting participants before cooking ensures just enough food is prepared so none is thrown away, especially when other hungry children exist elsewhere.
fact_tl: Mahalaga sa feeding program na huwag masayang ang pagkain. Kaya maingat na sinusukat kung ilang bata ang kakain bago magluto, para sapat lang ang naihahanda at walang natatapong pagkain, lalo na't may mga batang nagugutom pa rin sa ibang lugar.
fact_bis: Importante sa feeding program nga dili masayang ang pagkaon. Mao nga maampingong giihap kung pila ka bata ang mokaon una magluto, aron igo lang ang maandam ug walay malabay nga pagkaon, ilabina kay adunay mga bata sa ubang dapit nga gigutom pa gihapon.

q: Why does a mountaintop stay cold even at noon when the Sun is directly overhead?
options: Mountains are always in the shadow of clouds that block sunlight
The Sun's rays hit mountain slopes at an angle that reduces their heating power
Thin air at high altitude cannot hold as much heat as the air at lower elevations
Snow on mountain peaks reflects all the sunlight back into space
explanation: Mountain cold is caused by thin high-altitude air that holds little heat, so it stays cold at noon unlike nighttime cold, which is simply because the Sun has set.
fact_tl: Iba ang lamig ng bundok sa lamig ng gabi. Sa gabi malamig dahil wala nang araw na nagpapainit; pero sa bundok malamig kahit tanghali dahil sa manipis na hangin sa mataas na lugar.
fact_bis: Lahi ang kabugnaw sa bukid sa kabugnaw sa gabii. Sa gabii bugnaw kay wala nay adlaw nga mopainit; apan sa bukid bugnaw bisan udto tungod sa nipis nga hangin sa habog nga dapit.

q: How do giraffes usually sleep?
options: They lie flat on the ground for many hours each night
They sleep hanging from tree branches with their long necks draped over a limb
They often sleep standing up, usually at night and only for short periods
They sleep underwater in shallow rivers to stay cool
explanation: Giraffes often sleep standing up and only in short periods, typically at night.
fact_tl: Madalas nakatayo lang at sandali lang matulog ang dyirap, kadalasan sa gabi.
fact_bis: Kasagaran nagtindog ra ug mubo ra ang katulog sa giraffe, kasagaran sa gabii.

q: When do we see a full moon?
options: When the Moon moves between Earth and the Sun, blocking sunlight
When the Moon is at its farthest point from Earth in its orbit
When Earth is between the Sun and the Moon, so the whole face of the Moon is lit by sunlight
When the Sun and Moon are on the same side of Earth
explanation: A full moon occurs when Earth lies between the Sun and the Moon, allowing sunlight to illuminate the entire face of the Moon that we can see.
fact_tl: Nagiging full moon o kabilugan ng buwan kapag nasa magkabilang panig ang Earth at Buwan mula sa Araw, kaya buong mukha ng Buwan na nakaharap sa atin ang naliliwanagan.
fact_bis: Makita nato ang takdol o bug-os nga bulan kon ang Yuta anaa sa tunga sa Adlaw ug sa Bulan, mao nga ang tibuok nawong sa Bulan nga nag-atubang kanato masidlakan sa silaw sa adlaw.

q: Why is iron rusting considered a chemical change and not a physical change?
options: Because the iron becomes lighter after rusting
Because rusting changes the color of the iron but not its structure
Because the iron reacts with oxygen and water to form a completely new substance called rust
Because rust can be melted back into iron very easily
explanation: Rusting is a chemical change because the iron reacts with oxygen and water to form a new substance, rust, which has different properties from the original iron.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalawa ng bakal ay kemikal na pagbabago dahil nagrereaksyon ito sa oksiheno at tubig at nabubuo ang bagong sangkap na kalawang.
fact_bis: Ang pagtaya sa puthaw kay kemikal nga kabag-ohan kay mo-reaksyon kini sa oksiheno ug tubig, ug naporma ang bag-ong substansiya nga taya.

q: Which animal is the largest on land, and about how much can it weigh?
options: The white rhinoceros, weighing up to about 3 tons
The hippopotamus, weighing up to about 4 tons
The African elephant, weighing up to about 6 tons
The giraffe, weighing up to about 2 tons
explanation: The African elephant is the largest land animal, capable of weighing up to about 6 tons.
fact_tl: Ang African elephant ang pinakamalaking hayop sa lupa, na umaabot ng mga 6 tonelada ang bigat.
fact_bis: Ang African elephant mao ang labing dako nga hayop sa yuta, nga makaabot og mga 6 ka tonelada ang gibug-aton.

q: What is the role of the cell membrane?
options: It makes energy for the cell by absorbing sunlight
It contains the cell's genetic information and controls cell activities
It is a thin layer around the cell that controls what goes in and out
It produces proteins the cell needs to grow and repair itself
explanation: The cell membrane is a thin layer surrounding each cell that controls what substances enter and exit.
fact_tl: Ang lamad ng selula (cell membrane) ang nakapalibot sa selula at kumokontrol kung ano ang pumapasok at lumalabas dito.
fact_bis: Ang cell membrane mao ang nipis nga panit nga naglibot sa selula ug nagkontrol kung unsa ang mosulod ug mogawas niini.

q: How do the habitats of octopuses and squids generally differ?
options: Octopuses swim in open water while squids hide under sand on the sea floor
Both octopuses and squids live in deep-sea trenches far from the coast
Octopuses crawl along the sea floor while squids swim in open water, often in groups
Squids live near the shore in shallow reefs while octopuses migrate in deep open water
explanation: Octopuses typically crawl on the sea floor, while squids swim in open water, often traveling in groups.
fact_tl: Ang pugita ay madalas gumagapang sa ilalim ng dagat, habang ang pusit ay lumalangoy sa malawak na tubig kadalasang pangkat-pangkat.
fact_bis: Ang pugita kasagarang nagakamang sa salog sa dagat, samtang ang pusit nagalangoy sa lapad nga tubig kanunay nga panon-panon.

q: Which of the following foods helps build strong bones because it is rich in calcium?
options: Sweet potato and banana
Rice and corn
Milk, small fish, and malunggay
Cooking oil and coconut cream
explanation: Foods like milk, small fish, and malunggay are rich in calcium, which helps build strong bones.
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng mayaman sa kaltsyum tulad ng gatas, maliliit na isda, at malunggay ay nagpapatibay ng buto.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon sa pagkaon nga daghan ug kaltsyum sama sa gatas, gagmay nga isda, ug malunggay makapalig-on sa bukog.

q: If a pufferfish is cooked, fried, or boiled, what happens to its poison?
options: The heat breaks down the poison and makes the fish safe to eat
Boiling removes most of the poison, leaving only a small safe amount
The poison does not go away even after cooking, so the fish is still dangerous
Frying seals the poison inside the flesh where it cannot harm you
explanation: Pufferfish poison is not destroyed by cooking, frying, or boiling, so the fish remains dangerous to eat.
fact_tl: Hindi nawawala ang lason ng butete kahit ito ay lutuin, iprito, o pakuluan — kaya delikado pa rin itong kainin.
fact_bis: Ang hilo sa butete dili mawala bisan ug lutoon, iprito, o lat-an kini — busa delikado gihapon kini kan-on.

q: How does a python move even though it has no legs?
options: It rolls its body sideways like a wheel across the ground
It jumps forward using its tail as a spring
It slithers using strong muscles and wide belly scales
It inflates its body with air and glides forward
explanation: A python has no legs and moves by slithering, using powerful muscles working together with its wide belly scales.
fact_tl: Walang paa ang sawa; gumagapang ito gamit ang malalakas na kalamnan at malalapad na kaliskis sa ilalim ng tiyan.
fact_bis: Ang sawa walay tiil; nagkamang kini gamit ang kusgan nga kaunoran ug halapad nga himbis sa ilalom sa tiyan.

q: How do maglev trains move without touching the track?
options: They use high-speed fans underneath that push them above the track
Strong magnetic fields make them float above the track, and magnets guide and push them forward
They ride on a thin cushion of compressed air pumped under the train
Rubber wheels spin so fast that friction lifts the train slightly off the rail
explanation: Maglev trains use strong magnetic fields to float just above the track, with magnets also guiding and propelling them so they run very fast and quietly.
fact_tl: May mga modernong tren na tinatawag na maglev na lumulutang sa ibabaw ng riles gamit ang malalakas na magnetic field. Itinutulak at ginagabayan sila ng mga magnet kaya napakabilis at tahimik nilang tumakbo.
fact_bis: Adunay modernong mga tren nga gitawag ug maglev nga naglutaw ibabaw sa riles gamit ang kusog nga magnetic fields. Ang mga magnet motukmod ug mogiya kanila, mao nga kusog kaayo ug hilom sila modagan.

q: What important role does the pancreas play in digestion?
options: It stores bile that breaks down fats in the stomach
It absorbs water from digested food and sends it to the blood
It makes digestive enzymes that help break down food in the small intestine
It grinds food into smaller pieces before it reaches the stomach
explanation: The pancreas produces digestive enzymes that help break down food in the small intestine.
fact_tl: Ang pancreas ay gumagawa ng mga enzyme na nakakatulong tunawin ang pagkain sa maliit na bituka.
fact_bis: Ang pancreas naghimo og mga enzyme nga makatabang sa paghilis sa pagkaon sa gamay nga tinai.

q: What happens to a moving object if absolutely NO force acts on it?
options: It gradually slows down because objects naturally lose energy over time
It immediately stops because there is nothing pushing it forward
It keeps moving at the same speed and direction without changing
It speeds up slightly because there is no resistance to slow it down
explanation: With no force acting on it, an object's motion does not change — something moving keeps moving at the same speed and direction; on Earth, friction and gravity are forces that stop things, not the absence of a push.
fact_tl: Kung WALANG force na dumadapo, hindi nagbabago ang galaw ng isang bagay nang kusa. Ang nakatigil ay mananatiling nakatigil, at ang gumagalaw ay patuloy na gagalaw sa parehong bilis at direksyon. Sa Earth, mukhang humihinto ang mga bagay dahil may friction at gravity — pero ang totoo, force pa rin ang nagpapatigil.
fact_bis: Kung WALAY force nga modapat, ang lihok sa usa ka butang dili mausab sa iyang kaugalingon. Ang nagpahulay magpabilin nga nagpahulay, ug ang naglihok magpadayon sa paglihok sa parehas nga katulin ug direksyon. Sa Earth, morag mohunong ang mga butang tungod sa friction ug gravity — apan force gihapon ang mopahunong niini.

q: What does one newton (1 N) of force mean?
options: The force needed to lift an object weighing exactly 1 kilogram
The force needed to move 1 kilogram a distance of 1 metre
The force needed to accelerate a 1-kilogram mass by 1 metre per second squared
The force needed to stop a 1-kilogram object moving at 1 metre per second
explanation: One newton is defined as the force required to accelerate a mass of 1 kilogram at a rate of 1 metre per second squared.
fact_tl: Ang isang newton (1 N) ay ang puwersang kailangan para pabilisin ang 1 kilogramong masa nang 1 metro kada segundo kuwadrado (1 N = 1 kg·m/s²).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka newton (1 N) mao ang kusog nga gikinahanglan aron pakusgon ang 1 kilogramo nga masa og 1 metro kada segundo kuwadrado (1 N = 1 kg·m/s²).

q: What do Philippine fishers call the flying fish, and why is it important to them?
options: They call it tilapia and raise it in fish ponds for easy harvesting
They call it bangsi and catch it from the sea for food
They call it lapu-lapu and protect it in marine sanctuaries
They call it tawilis and find it only in Taal Lake
explanation: In the Philippines the flying fish is called bangsi and is caught by fishers for food.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang isdang lumilipad ay tinatawag ding bangsi at hinuhuli ng mga mangingisda para kainin.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang isdang naglupad gitawag usab nga bangsi ug gidakop sa mga mangingisda aron kan-on.

q: Why do scientists classify living things into groups from large to small, down to the species?
options: To rank organisms by size from the biggest animal to the smallest microorganism
To decide which organisms are most important to protect from extinction
To study and name the millions of kinds of life by organizing them according to shared characteristics
To show which organisms evolved first and which appeared most recently
explanation: Classification organizes living things by shared characteristics into increasingly specific groups down to the species, helping scientists study and name the millions of kinds of life.
fact_tl: Iniuuri (classified) ang mga buhay na bagay ayon sa kanilang magkakatulad na katangian, mula sa malalaking grupo (tulad ng hayop, halaman, fungi, at microorganism) hanggang sa pinakatiyak na grupo na species. Tumutulong ito sa mga siyentipiko na pag-aralan at pangalanan ang milyon-milyong klase ng buhay.
fact_bis: Giklasipikar ang mga buhi nga butang sumala sa ilang managsama nga kinaiya, gikan sa dagkong grupo (sama sa hayop, tanom, fungi, ug microorganism) hangtod sa kinatukmaang grupo nga species. Motabang kini sa mga siyentista sa pagtuon ug paghingalan sa milyon-milyon ka klase sa kinabuhi.

q: How does a scallop escape from predators?
options: It releases an ink cloud to confuse the attacker and swims away slowly
It buries itself rapidly in the sand using its soft foot
It rapidly claps its two shells together, jetting itself away through the water
It clings tightly to a rock and seals its shell until the predator leaves
explanation: Scallops escape predators by rapidly clapping their two shells together, which jets them away; they also have dozens of tiny blue eyes around the edge of their shell.
fact_tl: Ang scallop ay nagtatago sa mga mandaragit sa pamamagitan ng mabilis na pagpipalakpak ng kanyang dalawang shell — ang pagkilos na ito ay nagpapaalog sa kanya nang palayo; mayroon din itong maraming maliliit na asul na mata sa paligid ng bukas nitong shell.
fact_bis: Ang scallop nakalikay sa mga mandaragit pinaagi sa paspas nga pagpalakpak sa iyang duha ka shell — kining aksyon nagpaiwang niini; aduna usab kini og dose-dosena nga gagmay nga asul nga mga mata sa palibot sa bukas niyang shell.

q: Why do pigs roll in mud?
options: Mud contains minerals that keep their skin healthy and shiny
Pigs roll in mud to find insects and worms to eat
Pigs barely sweat, so they use mud to cool their bodies and avoid overheating
Mud hardens into a shell that protects pigs from biting insects
explanation: Because pigs have very few sweat glands and can barely sweat, they rely on mud to cool themselves and prevent overheating.
fact_tl: Halos hindi pumapawis ang baboy, kaya umaasa ito sa putik para hindi mainitan.
fact_bis: Ang baboy halos dili mosingot, mao nga mosalig kini sa lapok aron dili mainitan.

q: Why does a smartphone touchscreen respond to your finger but NOT to most other objects like a pencil eraser?
options: Fingers are warm, and the screen detects heat from skin to find the touch location
Fingers are softer than other objects, so they press the screen surface more evenly
The screen detects our body's small electric charge, which changes its weak electric field when a fingertip touches it
Finger oils coat the screen in a way that reflects light to hidden sensors
explanation: A capacitive touchscreen generates a weak electric field, and a fingertip's small electric charge changes that field so sensors can detect exactly where the touch happened.
fact_tl: Ang capacitive touchscreen ng smartphone ay gumagawa ng weak electric field — kapag hinalikan ng daliri, ang maliit na kuryente ng ating katawan ay nagbabago ng field, at ang sensor ay nagde-detect ng eksaktong lokasyon ng touch.
fact_bis: Ang capacitive touchscreen sa smartphone nagmugna ug huyang nga electric field — inig-hikap sa tudlo, ang gamay nga kuryente sa atong lawas nagbag-o sa field, ug ang mga sensor nagdetect sa eksaktong lokasyon sa touch.

q: Where does a mother crab carry her eggs until they hatch?
options: She buries them in a nest dug into the sand on the beach
She attaches them to a plant or rock on the sea floor and guards them from nearby
She carries thousands of eggs under her belly until they hatch
She releases all her eggs into the open water at once and leaves them
explanation: A mother crab carries thousands of eggs under her belly, keeping them safe until they hatch.
fact_tl: Dinadala ng inahing alimango ang libu-libong itlog sa ilalim ng tiyan nito hanggang mapisa ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang inahan nga alimango magdala og liboan ka itlog ilalom sa iyang tiyan hangtod kini mapusa.

q: How does a movable pulley make lifting easier?
options: It doubles the distance you pull the rope, which doubles your speed
It locks the load in place so you do not need to hold it continuously
Two parts of the rope share the weight of the load, so you need only about half the force to lift it
It changes the direction of your pull from down to up, making it feel effortless
explanation: In a movable pulley, the load is supported by two rope sections, so each section carries only about half the weight, meaning you need only about half the force to lift the load.
fact_tl: Ang gumagalaw na pulley (movable pulley) ay umaakyat kasama ng bagay na binubuhat. Dalawang bahagi ng lubid ang humahawak sa bigat, kaya kalahati na lang ng lakas ang kailangan mo.
fact_bis: Ang molihok nga pulley (movable pulley) mosaka uban sa butang nga gibuhat. Duha ka bahin sa pisi ang nagdala sa gibug-aton, busa katunga na lang sa kusog ang imong gikinahanglan.

q: What are the three main nutrients the body needs in large amounts?
options: Vitamins, minerals, and water
Fiber, calcium, and iron
Protein, carbohydrates, and fats
Sugar, salt, and starch
explanation: The three macronutrients the body needs in large amounts are protein, carbohydrates, and fats.
fact_tl: Ang tatlong pangunahing sustansyang kailangan ng katawan sa malaking dami ay protina, karbohaydrat, at taba.
fact_bis: Ang tulo ka nag-unang sustansya nga gikinahanglan sa lawas sa daghang gidaghanon mao ang protina, karbohaydrat, ug tambok.

q: What happens when you pour cooking oil into water?
options: The oil sinks to the bottom of the water
The oil floats on top and does not mix with the water
The oil and water mix together completely
The oil turns into a solid when it touches water
explanation: Cooking oil floats on top of water and does not mix in because oil is lighter than water.
fact_tl: Kapag naglagay ka ng mantika sa tubig, lumulutang ito sa ibabaw at hindi naghahalo. Ito ay dahil mas magaan ang mantika kaysa sa tubig, kaya nasa itaas ito. Kaya nakikita mo itong lumulutang sa sabaw.
fact_bis: Kung magbutang ka ug mantika sa tubig, molutaw kini sa ibabaw ug dili magsagol. Tungod kini kay mas gaan ang mantika kaysa tubig, mao nga anaa kini sa taas. Mao nga makita nimo kini nga naglutaw sa sabaw.

q: Who sewed the first Philippine flag?
options: Gabriela Silang and two of her daughters
Josepha Llanes Escoda with her sisters
Marcela Agoncillo with her daughter Lorenza and Delfina Herbosa de Natividad
Melchora Aquino with her granddaughters
explanation: The first Philippine flag was sewn by Marcela Agoncillo, together with her daughter Lorenza and Delfina Herbosa de Natividad, in Hong Kong.
fact_tl: Ang unang watawat ng Pilipinas ay tinahi nina Marcela Agoncillo, kasama ang kanyang anak na si Lorenza at si Delfina Herbosa de Natividad, sa Hong Kong. Unang iwinagayway ito noong ipinahayag ang kalayaan sa Kawit, Cavite noong Hunyo 12, 1898.
fact_bis: Ang unang bandila sa Pilipinas gitahi nila Marcela Agoncillo, kauban ang iyang anak nga si Lorenza ug si Delfina Herbosa de Natividad, sa Hong Kong. Una kining giwarawara sa pagmantala sa kagawasan sa Kawit, Cavite niadtong Hunyo 12, 1898.

q: Which lake is the second-largest in the Philippines?
options: Lake Sebu
Lake Buhi
Lake Taal
Lake Lanao
explanation: Lake Lanao is the second-largest lake in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Lawa ng Lanao ang pangalawang pinakamalaking lawa sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Lanaw sa Lanao mao ang ikaduhang pinakadako nga lanaw sa Pilipinas.

q: Why is it important to always prepare for an earthquake in advance?
options: Earthquakes always strike at the same time every year
Earthquakes can be predicted a week before they happen
No scientist can yet predict the exact day and time of an earthquake
Earthquakes only strike without warning once every decade
explanation: Because no scientist can yet predict the exact day and time of an earthquake, preparing in advance is the safest strategy.
fact_tl: Hindi pa kayang hulaan ng kahit sinong siyentipiko ang eksaktong araw at oras ng isang lindol, kaya ang pinakaligtas na gawin ay laging maghanda nang maaga.
fact_bis: Wala pay siyentista nga makatagna sa eksaktong adlaw ug oras sa usa ka linog, mao nga ang pinakaluwas nga buhaton mao ang kanunay nga pagpangandam og sayo.

q: Why does oil end up lighter than water for the same amount?
options: Oil molecules are packed more tightly together than water molecules
Oil molecules are exactly the same size as water molecules
Oil molecules are spread out more loosely than water molecules
Oil molecules are heavier than water molecules
explanation: Oil molecules do not pack as tightly together as water molecules do, so for the same amount, oil ends up lighter than water.
fact_tl: Ang mga maliliit na parte ng langis na tinatawag na molekula ay hindi gaanong magkadikit-dikit kumpara sa molekula ng tubig. Dahil mas maluwag ang pagkakaayos nila, mas magaan ang langis sa parehong dami.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga bahin sa lana nga gitawag og molekula dili kaayo hugot magdikit kompara sa molekula sa tubig. Tungod kay luag ang ilang pagkahan-ay, mas gaan ang lana sa parehas nga gidaghanon.

q: How many magnitude values does a single earthquake have?
options: One magnitude, and it is the same everywhere it is felt
One magnitude, but many different intensity values depending on location
Two magnitudes: one near the epicenter and one farther away
As many magnitudes as there are towns that feel the shaking
explanation: An earthquake has only one magnitude, but it can have many different intensity values because shaking is felt with different strength in each affected place.
fact_tl: May iisang magnitude lang ang isang lindol, pero maaari itong magkaroon ng maraming intensity values dahil iba-iba ang lakas ng pagyanig sa bawat lugar na naapektuhan.
fact_bis: Usa ra ka magnitude ang usa ka linog, apan mahimo kining adunay daghang intensity values kay lainlain ang kakusog sa pag-uyog sa matag dapit nga naapektuhan.

q: How is most electricity made in a power plant?
options: By heating water until it glows and releases electricity
By letting chemicals react inside large batteries
By a spinning turbine moving magnets inside a generator
By sunlight hitting copper wires and releasing electrons
explanation: Most electricity is made when a spinning turbine moves magnets inside a generator.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng kuryente ay nagagawa kapag may umiikot na turbine na nagpapagalaw ng magnet sa loob ng generator.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa koryente mahimo kon adunay nagtuyok nga turbine nga magpalihok sa mga magnet sulod sa generator.

q: Why does your body shiver when you are very cold?
options: You choose to shiver so your muscles can warm up quickly
Shivering is a habit your body learned from experience
The body does it automatically to produce heat without you deciding to
Your brain sends a signal and you shiver on purpose
explanation: Shivering is an automatic response — the body does it on its own when it needs to generate heat.
fact_tl: Hindi natin sinasadya ang panginginig—awtomatiko itong ginagawa ng katawan kapag kailangan ng init.
fact_bis: Dili nato tinuyo ang pagkurog—automatiko kining buhaton sa lawas kung kinahanglan og kainit.

q: What actually causes ringworm and athlete's foot?
options: A small worm that burrows into the skin
A type of bacteria found in soil
A fungus that infects the skin
A virus spread through the air
explanation: Ringworm and athlete's foot are skin diseases caused by a fungus, not a worm, despite the misleading name.
fact_tl: Ang buni (ringworm) at alipunga ay sakit sa balat na dulot ng fungus, hindi ng uod. Nagbibigay ito ng makati at minsan bilog na pantal, at kumakalat sa pamamagitan ng paghawak o paggamit ng damit ng may sakit. Tumutulong ang pananatiling malinis at tuyo ng balat.
fact_bis: Ang buni (ringworm) ug alipunga mga sakit sa panit nga gikan sa fungus, dili sa ulod. Maghatag kini og makatol, usahay lingin nga pantal, ug mokatap pinaagi sa paghikap o paggamit sa sinina sa may sakit. Makatabang ang pagpabilin nga limpyo ug uga sa panit.

q: What happens when mangroves that were cut down are replanted?
options: The mangroves immediately store twice as much carbon as before
Carbon storage returns, fish get shelter again, and the coast is protected
Only the coastal protection benefit returns; the fish do not come back right away
The mangroves release stored carbon into the ocean when they grow back
explanation: Replanting mangroves restores their ability to store carbon, provides homes for fish again, and protects the coast.
fact_tl: Sa maraming lugar sa Pilipinas, muling nagtatanim ang mga tao ng bakawan na dating pinutol. Sa pagbabalik ng bakawan, nababawi ang kakayahang mag-imbak ng carbon, mabigyan muli ng tirahan ang mga isda, at maprotektahan ang baybayin.
fact_bis: Sa daghang lugar sa Pilipinas, ang mga tawo nagtanom pag-usab ug bakawan nga kaniadto giputol. Pinaagi sa pagpabalik sa bakawan, mabawi ang abilidad sa pagtipig ug carbon, makabalik ang puy-anan sa mga isda, ug mapanalipdan ang baybayon.

q: What makes the asteroid Vesta unusual compared to most other asteroids?
options: It is made entirely of ice and orbits beyond Neptune
It has an iron core, mantle, and crust like a proper planet
It is the largest body in the asteroid belt by far
It was discovered in 2011 by the Dawn spacecraft
explanation: Vesta is unusual because it has a differentiated interior — an iron core, mantle, and crust — much like a proper planet.
fact_tl: Ang Vesta ang pangalawang pinakamalaking katawan sa asteroid belt at isa sa iilang asteroid na may differentiated interior — ibig sabihin ay ito ay may iron core, mantle, at crust tulad ng isang planeta. Ang Dawn spacecraft ng NASA ay nag-orbit nito noong 2011 at 2012.
fact_bis: Ang Vesta mao ang ikaduha ka pinakadako nga lawas sa asteroid belt ug usa sa pipila ka asteroid nga adunay differentiated nga interior — nagkahulogan nga adunay iron core, mantle, ug crust sama sa usa ka tinuod nga planeta. Ang Dawn spacecraft sa NASA nag-orbit niini niadtong 2011 ug 2012.

q: How do ginger and galangal plants spread and multiply?
options: By producing berries that animals eat and scatter
Through wind-blown seeds that land in new soil
Through horizontal underground stems called rhizomes
By dropping leaves that root in the ground nearby
explanation: Ginger and galangal spread through rhizomes — horizontal underground stems that produce new shoots from their nodes.
fact_tl: Ang luya (ginger) at lagkaw (galangal) ay nagkakalat sa pamamagitan ng rhizome—isang horizontal na tangkay na lumalago sa ilalim ng lupa at nagbubunga ng bagong shoots mula sa mga node nito.
fact_bis: Ang luya (ginger) ug lagkaw (galangal) nagkatag pinaagi sa rhizome—usa ka horizontal nga tangkay sa ilalim sa yuta nga nagmugna og bag-ong shoots gikan sa mga node niini.

q: Which hormone raises blood sugar FASTER than glucagon?
options: Insulin, which is released by the pancreas
Cortisol, which is released slowly over hours
Adrenaline, which is released when you are scared or startled
Melatonin, which is released when it gets dark
explanation: Adrenaline, released when you are scared or startled, also raises blood sugar — and it acts faster than glucagon.
fact_tl: Hindi lang glucagon ang nagtataas ng asukal sa dugo; pati adrenaline na lumalabas kapag takot o nagugulat ka ay nagtataas din nito, pero mas mabilis ang adrenaline.
fact_bis: Dili lang glucagon ang mopataas sa asukal sa dugo; ang adrenaline usab, nga mogawas kung mahadlok o makalitan ka, mopataas niini, apan mas paspas ang adrenaline.

q: What does a pufferfish do after the danger has passed?
options: It keeps its puffed-up shape to scare more enemies
It swims to the surface and floats there for safety
It releases the water and returns to its normal size
It buries itself in sand until the next day
explanation: When the danger is gone, the pufferfish lets the water out and returns to its normal size.
fact_tl: Kapag wala nang panganib, inilalabas ng butete ang tubig at bumabalik ito sa dati nitong laki.
fact_bis: Kung wala nay kakuyaw, ipagawas sa butete ang tubig ug mobalik kini sa naandan nga gidak-on.

q: Which of these foods is known for its bitter taste?
options: Kamote (sweet potato)
Ampalaya (bitter gourd)
Saging (banana)
Mangga (mango)
explanation: Ampalaya (bitter gourd) is a classic example of a bitter-tasting food, along with coffee and some medicines.
fact_tl: Mapait ang lasa ng mga bagay tulad ng ampalaya, kape, at ilang gamot.
fact_bis: Pait ang lami sa mga butang sama sa paliya, kape, ug pipila ka tambal.

q: Why do swallows and swifts look so similar to each other?
options: They are the same species but live in different countries
They share the same nest sites so they evolved identical looks
Both fly to catch insects in the air, giving them a similar body shape
They eat the same seeds and berries, so they evolved together
explanation: Swallows and swifts look alike because both fly to catch insects, even though they belong to different bird groups.
fact_tl: Magkatulad ang itsura ng layang-layang at swift dahil parehong lumilipad sila para humuli ng insekto, ngunit magkaibang grupo sila ng ibon.
fact_bis: Ang sayaw ug balinsasayaw managsama ug hitsura kay pareho silang naglupad aron mudakop ug insekto, apan lahi silang grupo sa langgam.

q: How does a lake form?
options: A lake forms only when a volcano erupts and creates a crater
A lake forms when wind piles sand into a rim that traps rainfall
A lake forms when a hollow left by ice, a volcano, or shifting land fills with water
A lake forms when a river delta grows wide enough to hold still water
explanation: A lake forms when a hollow in the ground — left by ice, a volcano, or shifting land — fills up with rain, streams, or groundwater.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang lawa kapag napupuno ng tubig-ulan, sapa, o groundwater ang isang lubak sa lupa na maaaring iniwan ng yelo, bulkan, o paggalaw ng lupa.
fact_bis: Maporma ang lanaw kung mapuno og tubig-ulan, sapa, o groundwater ang usa ka lungag sa yuta nga gibilin sa yelo, bulkan, o paglihok sa yuta.

q: Why can you never walk to the end of a rainbow?
options: Rainbows end exactly where the rain stops falling
Rainbows end at the horizon and you cannot cross it
The rainbow moves with you because it depends on exactly where you stand
Rainbows form in the clouds and are always too high to reach
explanation: Your rainbow depends on your exact position, so it moves with you as you walk — meaning you can never actually reach it.
fact_tl: Ang bahaghari na nakikita mo ay nakadepende sa kung saan ka nakatayo, kaya may sariling bahaghari ang bawat tao. Kung lalapitan mo ito, gagalaw rin ito kasama mo, kaya hindi mo ito kailanman maaabot.
fact_bis: Ang bahaghari nga imong makita nagsalig kung asa ka nagtindog, mao nga ang matag tawo adunay kaugalingong bahaghari. Kung duolon nimo, mokuyog kini nimo, mao nga dili gyud nimo kini maabtan.

q: When you lift a heavy bag upward, what scientific 'work' are you doing?
options: Work against friction between your hands and the bag
Work against air resistance pushing the bag down
Work against the pull of gravity on the bag
Work against the bag's magnetic attraction to the floor
explanation: Lifting a bag upward means you are doing work against the pull of gravity.
fact_tl: Kapag binubuhat mo ang isang bag pataas, gumagawa ka ng trabaho laban sa puwersa ng gravity.
fact_bis: Kung imong ibayaw ang usa ka bag pataas, naghimo ka og trabaho batok sa kusog sa gravity.

q: In some kinds of fireflies, which stage of life can already give off a faint glow?
options: Only the adult male can glow
Only the adult female can glow
Both adults and larvae can glow, but not the eggs
Even the eggs can give off a faint glow
explanation: In some species of fireflies, even the eggs glow faintly, showing the ability to produce light is present from the very start.
fact_tl: May mga uri ng alitaptap na kahit ang mga itlog nila ay may mahinang liwanag. Ipinapakita nito na ang kakayahang magliwanag ay nasa kanila bago pa sila lumaki.
