fact_tl: Ang prutas ng areca palm ay nagiging kahel o dilaw-pula kapag hinog na.
fact_bis: Ang prutas sa areca palm mahimong kahel o dalag-pula kon hinog na.

q: What happens to the resistance of most metal wires when they heat up?
options: The resistance goes down because the metal becomes more fluid
The resistance stays exactly the same no matter the temperature
The resistance goes up, which is why Ohm's law is most exact at steady temperature
The resistance disappears entirely once the wire reaches a high enough temperature
explanation: In most metals, when a wire heats up its resistance goes up, which is why Ohm's law is most exact when the temperature stays the same.
fact_tl: Tanong ng marami: nagbabago ba ang resistensya? Oo, sa karamihan ng metal, kapag umiinit ang kawad, tumataas ang resistensya nito. Kaya ang batas ni Ohm ay pinakatumpak kapag pare-pareho ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Pangutana sa daghan: mausab ba ang resistensya? Oo, sa kadaghanan sa metal, kung moinit ang kawad, mosaka ang resistensya niini. Mao nga ang balaod ni Ohm pinakatukma kung parehas ang temperatura.

q: Why are insects more active on warm days than on cold days?
options: Insects eat more food in summer, giving them extra energy to move
Insects are warm-blooded and generate more heat when the air is warm
Insects are cold-blooded, so their body temperature depends on the surrounding temperature
Insects grow larger wings in warm weather, making flying easier
explanation: Insects are cold-blooded, so their body temperature depends on their surroundings — they are more active when it is warm and sluggish when it is cold.
fact_tl: Ang mga insekto ay cold-blooded, kaya nakadepende ang init ng kanilang katawan sa paligid—mas aktibo sila kapag mainit at mabagal kumilos kapag malamig.
fact_bis: Ang mga insekto cold-blooded, mao nga ang kainit sa ilang lawas nagsalig sa palibot—mas aktibo sila kon init ug hinay molihok kon bugnaw.

q: Which senses help the tamaraw detect danger even though its eyesight is poor?
options: Taste and touch, which let it feel vibrations in the ground
Sharp hearing and smell, which warn it when a person or predator approaches
Electroreception and echolocation, like a bat or electric eel
Color vision and night vision, which help it see danger in darkness
explanation: The tamaraw has sharp hearing and smell, even though its eyesight is not very clear, helping it sense approaching danger quickly.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ay may matalas na pandinig at pang-amoy, kahit hindi gaanong malinaw ang paningin nito. Tinutulungan siya nito na maramdaman agad ang papalapit na tao o panganib, kaya mabilis siyang makatakas.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw adunay hait nga pandungog ug panimaho, bisan tuod dili kaayo klaro ang panan-aw niini. Makatabang kini aron mabati dayon ang nagpaduol nga tawo o katalagman, busa paspas kini nga makaikyas.

q: How does the saltwater crocodile get rid of extra salt from its body?
options: It drinks large amounts of fresh water every day to flush the salt out
It has special salt-excreting glands on its tongue that remove the excess salt
Its skin absorbs fresh water from the air to balance the salt in its blood
Its kidneys filter out all salt before it can enter the bloodstream
explanation: The saltwater crocodile has special salt-excreting glands on its tongue that remove excess salt, allowing it to live in seawater.
fact_tl: Ang saltwater crocodile ay may espesyal na glandula sa dila na naglalabas ng labis na asin mula sa katawan, kaya kaya nitong mabuhay sa maalat na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang saltwater crocodile adunay espesyal nga glandula sa dila nga nagtangtang sa sobrang asin sa lawas, kaya makabuhi kini sa tubig-dagat.

q: What does being listed under CITES Appendix I mean for the Philippine cockatoo?
options: The species may be traded internationally only with a special permit from one country
International commercial trade in this species is completely banned worldwide
The species is no longer endangered and may be kept as a pet freely
Countries are encouraged to breed this species on farms for the pet trade
explanation: The Philippine cockatoo is listed under CITES Appendix I, meaning international commercial trade in this species is banned worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine cockatoo ay kabilang sa CITES Appendix I, na nangangahulugang ang internasyonal na kalakalan nito ay ipinagbabawal sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine cockatoo nalista sa ilawom sa CITES Appendix I, nga nagpasabot nga ang internasyonal nga komersyal nga kalakalan sa kining klase gibawal sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: Compared to other types of electromagnetic waves, radio waves have which property?
options: The highest frequency and shortest wavelength in the spectrum
A medium frequency and wavelength, similar to visible light
The lowest frequency and longest wavelength in the spectrum
A very high frequency that allows them to pass through walls easily
explanation: Radio waves have the lowest frequency and longest wavelength of the whole electromagnetic spectrum, which is why they can bend around obstacles and travel far.
fact_tl: Ang radio wave ay may pinakamababang frequency at pinakamahabang wavelength sa buong electromagnetic spectrum — ang ilan ay mas mahaba pa sa isang bahay o gusali — kaya kaya nilang umikot sa mga hadlang at maglakbay nang malayo.
fact_bis: Ang radio wave adunay pinakaubos nga frequency ug pinakataas nga wavelength sa tibuok electromagnetic spectrum — ang uban mas taas pa sa usa ka balay o bilding — mao nga makaliko sila sa mga babag ug makabiyahe og layo.

q: What is the key difference between a primary battery and a secondary battery?
options: Primary batteries are larger, while secondary batteries are smaller and more portable
Primary batteries are single-use and cannot be recharged, while secondary batteries can be recharged many times
Primary batteries use chemicals, while secondary batteries use solar energy to store power
Primary batteries last longer than secondary batteries on a single charge
explanation: Primary batteries such as AA alkaline are single-use and cannot be recharged, while secondary batteries such as cellphone lithium-ion can be recharged hundreds of times.
fact_tl: Ang primary na baterya (tulad ng AA alkaline) ay para sa isang gamit lamang at hindi maaaring i-charge muli, habang ang secondary na baterya (tulad ng lithium-ion ng cellphone) ay maaaring i-charge muli nang maraming beses.
fact_bis: Ang primary nga baterya (sama sa AA alkaline) alang sa usa ka gamit lamang ug dili maarang i-charge pag-usab, samtang ang secondary nga baterya (sama sa lithium-ion sa cellphone) maarang i-charge pag-usab ug gatusan ka beses.

q: Why is it difficult for Rafflesia plants to produce seeds?
options: Rafflesia flowers bloom underground where no insects can reach them
Rafflesia usually has separate male and female flowers, making fertilization hard
Rafflesia releases a gas that repels all pollinating insects and animals
Rafflesia seeds are so tiny they blow away before they can take root
explanation: A Rafflesia plant usually has separate male and female flowers, which makes it hard for them to produce seeds.
fact_tl: Karaniwang hiwalay ang lalaki at babaeng bulaklak ng Rafflesia, kaya mahirap silang makapag-bunga.
fact_bis: Kasagaran lahi ang laki ug baye nga bulak sa Rafflesia, mao nga lisod sila makapamunga.

q: How do polarized sunglasses reduce glare?
options: They darken all incoming light equally, making everything appear dimmer
They allow only light vibrating in one direction to pass through, blocking glare
They use a special coating that absorbs ultraviolet rays that cause glare
They reflect all light away from the lens before it reaches the eye
explanation: Polarized sunglasses allow only light vibrating in one direction to pass through, reducing glare from smooth surfaces.
fact_tl: Ang normal na liwanag ay nagvivibrate sa lahat ng direksyon — ang polarized na sunglasses ay pinapayagan lamang ang liwanag na nagvivibrate sa isang direksyon na lumipas, binabawasan ang glare mula sa makinis na ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang normal nga suga nagalingkod sa tanang direksyon — ang polarized nga sunglasses nagahatag og tagi lamang sa suga nga nagalingkod sa usa ka direksyon nga moagi, nagpababa sa glare gikan sa makinis nga mga ibabaw.

q: What makes leaves tough and difficult to tear apart?
options: Leaves are tough because of a waxy coating called cuticle on their surface
Leaves are tough because of cellulose, a strong fiber in plant cell walls
Leaves are tough because of chlorophyll, which hardens the leaf tissue
Leaves are tough because of starch stored inside each leaf cell
explanation: Leaves are tough because of cellulose, a strong fiber in the cell walls of plants.
fact_tl: Matigas ang mga dahon dahil sa cellulose, isang matibay na hibla sa mga dingding ng selula ng halaman.
fact_bis: Gahi ang mga dahon tungod sa cellulose, usa ka lig-on nga hibla sa mga bongbong sa selula sa tanom.

q: Why is a double rainbow's outer (second) bow fainter and higher than the inner rainbow?
options: The second bow forms from smaller raindrops that are higher in the sky
Light bounces twice inside each raindrop to form the second bow, losing brightness with each bounce
The second bow only appears when the sun is lower on the horizon at sunset
The second bow is made of reflected light from the ground, not from raindrops
explanation: The second rainbow forms when light bounces twice inside each raindrop instead of just once, which is why the second bow is fainter and sits higher in the sky.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang bahaghari ay nagkakaroon kapag ang liwanag ay bumalik nang DALAWANG beses sa loob ng patak ng ulan, hindi isang beses lang gaya ng unang bahaghari. Dahil dito, mas mahina ang kulay nito at mas mataas ang puwesto sa langit.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang bahaghari mahimo kung ang kahayag mobalik og DUHA ka higayon sulod sa tinulo sa ulan, dili kausa ra sama sa nauna. Mao na nga mas luya ang kolor niini ug mas taas ang pwesto sa langit.

q: Which chemical did Joseph Lister use as an antiseptic to kill germs during surgery?
options: Hydrogen peroxide, a clear liquid that bubbles on contact with wounds
Carbolic acid (phenol), which he applied to kill germs during operations
Alcohol solution, commonly used to clean hands before and after surgery
Chlorine bleach, diluted with water to sterilize surgical instruments
explanation: Joseph Lister used carbolic acid (phenol) as the antiseptic to kill germs during surgery.
fact_tl: Gumamit si Joseph Lister ng carbolic acid (phenol) bilang antiseptic para patayin ang mga mikrobyo sa operasyon.
fact_bis: Si Joseph Lister migamit og carbolic acid (phenol) isip antiseptic aron patyon ang mga germ atol sa operasyon.

q: What sound do hornbill wings make when the bird flies?
options: A high-pitched whistle, like a flute or piccolo instrument
A loud whooshing sound like the wind
A soft flapping sound, almost silent like an owl in flight
A rattling noise from the hollow bones rubbing together
explanation: When the hornbill flies, its large wings make a loud whooshing sound like wind.
fact_tl: Kapag lumilipad ang kalaw, ang malalaki nitong pakpak ay gumagawa ng malakas na tunog na parang hangin.
fact_bis: Kon molupad ang kalaw, ang dagko niini nga mga pako mohimo og kusog nga tingog nga morag hangin.

q: What is the unit used to measure force, and who is it named after?
options: The joule, named after James Joule who studied energy and heat
The newton, named after Isaac Newton who studied motion and gravity
The watt, named after James Watt who invented the steam engine
The pascal, named after Blaise Pascal who studied pressure
explanation: The unit of force is the newton, named after Isaac Newton.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng puwersa (force) ay ang newton, na ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa puwersa (force) mao ang newton, ginganlan kang Isaac Newton.

q: How does a baby grow from a single fertilized cell into a full organism?
options: The one cell absorbs nutrients and stretches until it becomes large enough
The cell divides over and over by mitosis, producing all the cells of the body
The cell splits once into two cells, which then combine to form different organs
Stem cells are produced in the bone marrow and travel to where they are needed
explanation: A baby begins as one cell that divides over and over by mitosis.
fact_tl: Ang isang sanggol ay nagsisimula sa isang selula na paulit-ulit na naghahati sa pamamagitan ng mitosis.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka masuso magsugod isip usa ka selula nga balik-balik nga mabahin pinaagi sa mitosis.

q: Which animal is the fastest runner on land?
options: The lion, which can sprint in short bursts to catch prey on the savanna
The cheetah, which is the fastest land animal
The greyhound dog, which was bred specifically for its speed
The pronghorn antelope, which can run longer distances than any other animal
explanation: The fastest land animal is the cheetah, which is the fastest runner.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa lupa ay ang cheetah, na siyang pinakamabilis tumakbo.
fact_bis: Ang pinakapaspas nga hayop sa yuta mao ang cheetah, ang pinakapaspas modagan.

q: Besides its valuable wood, what is another reason the narra tree is important to protect?
options: Its flowers are used to make perfumes that are exported around the world
Some people use parts like its bark or sap as traditional medicine
Its seeds provide edible oil that is used in cooking traditional Filipino dishes
Its large root system prevents flooding in lowland areas near rivers
explanation: Besides its wood, some people also use other parts of the narra such as bark or sap as traditional medicine, making it even more valuable to protect.
fact_tl: Bukod sa kahoy nito, ginagamit din ng ilang tao ang ibang bahagi ng narra bilang tradisyonal na gamot mula sa balat o dagta nito. Isa pa itong dahilan kung bakit mahalaga ang punong ito at dapat pangalagaan.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kahoy niini, ginagamit usab sa pipila ka tawo ang ubang bahin sa narra isip tradisyonal nga tambal gikan sa panit o dagta niini. Usa pa kini ka rason ngano importante kini nga kahoy ug angay panalipdan.

q: Why is each fossil considered very precious?
options: Fossils are made of rare minerals that are hard to find in the ground
Not every dead animal becomes a fossil — fossilization happens only rarely
Fossils can only form in very deep ocean trenches far from land
Most fossils are destroyed before scientists can dig them up safely
explanation: Not every dead animal becomes a fossil — it happens only rarely, which makes each fossil very precious.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng patay na hayop ay nagiging fossil — bihira lang itong mangyari kaya napakahalaga ng bawat fossil.
fact_bis: Dili tanang patay nga hayop mahimong fossil — talagsaon ra kini mahitabo, mao nga bililhon kaayo ang matag fossil.

q: Why is the UV index especially high in the Philippines even when the ozone layer is healthy?
options: The Philippines has little cloud cover, so no clouds block the UV rays
The Philippines is near the equator, so sunlight hits more directly giving a high UV index
The Philippines has thin air at high elevation, letting more UV rays through
The Philippines faces the sun longer each day than countries farther north
explanation: Because the Philippines is near the equator, sunlight hits more directly, so the UV index is high here even when the ozone layer is normal.
fact_tl: Dahil malapit ang Pilipinas sa ekwador, mas direkta ang sinag ng araw kaya mataas ang UV index dito kahit normal ang ozone layer. Kaya mahalagang gumamit ng sunblock, payong, o sumbrero lalo na tanghaling-tapat.
fact_bis: Tungod kay duol ang Pilipinas sa ekwador, mas direkta ang sidlak sa adlaw, busa taas ang UV index dinhi bisan normal ang ozone layer. Mao nga importante ang sunblock, payong, o kalo, ilabi na sa udto.

q: Why does vinegar taste sour?
options: Vinegar is a base that reacts with saliva to create a sour sensation
Vinegar is an acid because it contains acetic acid, which gives it its sour taste
Vinegar contains salt crystals that dissolve on the tongue to create sourness
Vinegar is a neutral liquid whose sourness comes from added flavoring
explanation: Vinegar is an acid because it contains acetic acid, which gives it a sour taste.
fact_tl: Ang suka ay isang asido dahil naglalaman ito ng acetic acid, kaya maasim ang lasa nito.
fact_bis: Ang suka usa ka asido kay naa kini acetic acid, mao nga aslom ang lasa niini.

q: Which bird holds the record for being the fastest runner, and about how fast can it go?
options: The emu, reaching about 50 kilometers per hour across the Australian plains
The ostrich, reaching about 70 kilometers per hour
The roadrunner, which can reach 60 kilometers per hour in short bursts
The cassowary, which can reach 80 kilometers per hour through dense forest
explanation: The ostrich is the fastest running bird, reaching about 70 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang ostrich ang pinakamabilis tumakbong ibon, umaabot ng halos 70 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang ostrich mao ang pinakapaspas modagan nga langgam, moabot ug mga 70 ka kilometro kada oras.

q: What global effect did Mount Pinatubo's 1991 eruption have on Earth's temperature?
options: It warmed global temperatures because of the intense heat released from lava flows
It lowered average global temperature by about 0.5°C for about two years
It had no measurable effect on global temperature outside the Philippines
It caused a permanent rise in average temperatures in Southeast Asia
explanation: Mount Pinatubo's 1991 eruption released massive volcanic aerosols into the stratosphere that lowered average global temperature by about 0.5°C for the following two years.
fact_tl: Ang pagsabog ng Mount Pinatubo noong Hunyo 1991 ay isa sa pinakamalaking pagsabog ng bulkan sa ika-20 siglo; naglabas ito ng napakaraming volcanic aerosols sa stratosphere na nagpababa ng average na temperatura ng mundo ng halos 0.5°C sa susunod na dalawang taon.
fact_bis: Ang pagsabog sa Mount Pinatubo niadtong Hunyo 1991 usa sa pinakadakling volcanic eruption sa ika-20 siglo; nagpagawas kini og dako kaayong volcanic aerosols sa stratosphere nga nagpakunhod sa average nga global temperatura og mga 0.5°C sulod sa sunod nga duha ka tuig.

q: What is special about many micro-organisms found in pond water?
options: They are made of exactly two cells that work together to form a tiny organism
They are complete living things made of just a single cell that can eat, move, and reproduce
They cannot reproduce on their own and must attach to larger organisms
They are the smallest stage of insects before they grow into larvae
explanation: Many pond-water micro-organisms are made of just a single cell, yet they are still complete living things that eat, move, and reproduce.
fact_tl: Marami sa mga mikroorganismo sa tubig-lawa ay binubuo lamang ng iisang selula (single cell), ngunit kompleto pa rin silang nabubuhay—kumakain, gumagalaw, at dumarami.
fact_bis: Daghan sa mga mikroorganismo sa tubig-danaw kay gilangkoban lamang sa usa ka selula, apan kompleto gihapon sila nga buhi—mokaon, molihok, ug modaghan.

q: Why does your heart beat faster when you are very dehydrated?
options: Your muscles send signals to the heart to pump more oxygen during dehydration
Blood gets thicker when you are dehydrated, making the heart work harder to pump it
Your brain reduces blood flow to less important organs to save water
Dehydration raises body temperature, which directly speeds up the heartbeat
explanation: Blood is mostly water, so when you are dehydrated the blood gets thicker and your heart has a harder time pumping it, causing your heart rate to go up.
fact_tl: Ang dugo natin ay karamihan tubig, kaya kapag nagka-dehydration, lumalapot ang dugo at nahihirapan ang pusong i-pump ito sa buong katawan. Ito ang dahilan kaya mas mabilis tumibok ang puso kapag uhaw na uhaw ka.
fact_bis: Ang atong dugo kasagaran tubig, mao nga kon ma-dehydrate ka, molapot ang dugo ug maglisod ang kasingkasing sa pag-pump niini sa tibuok lawas. Mao kana nga mas paspas motibok ang kasingkasing kon uhaw kaayo ka.

q: Where does the journey of food begin in your body?
options: In the stomach, where strong acids start breaking down food first
In the mouth, where food is chewed and mixed with saliva before going to the stomach
In the small intestine, where most of the digestion and nutrient absorption happens
In the esophagus, where food is ground into smaller pieces by muscular walls
explanation: Food's journey begins in the mouth where it is chewed and mixed with saliva, before flowing into the stomach and intestines to be fully broken down.
fact_tl: Ang paglalakbay ng pagkain ay nagsisimula sa bibig kung saan nginunguya at hinahaluan ng laway, bago ito dumaloy sa sikmura at bituka upang lubusang matunaw.
fact_bis: Ang panaw sa pagkaon magsugod sa baba diin kini usapon ug sagolan og laway, sa dili pa kini moagos paingon sa tiyan ug tinai aron hingpit nga matunaw.

q: What can some white blood cells do that most other blood cells cannot?
options: They can carry oxygen to cells more efficiently than red blood cells can
They can squeeze out of blood vessels to chase germs inside body tissues
They can change color to signal that an infection is happening nearby
They can reproduce inside the bloodstream without the help of bone marrow
explanation: Some white blood cells can squeeze out of the blood vessels to chase germs inside the tissues.
fact_tl: Ang ilang puting selula ay kayang lumabas sa ugat ng dugo upang habulin ang mikrobyo sa loob ng mga tisyu.
fact_bis: Ang ubang puti nga selula makahimo og gawas sa ugat sa dugo aron gukdon ang mikrobyo sulod sa mga tisyu.

q: What is the hardest natural material found on Earth?
options: Steel, because it is an alloy that is stronger than any pure natural element
Diamond, which is so hard that only another diamond can scratch it
Quartz, a common mineral used to make glass and electronics
Granite, a dense rock that is harder than most other common minerals
explanation: Diamond is the hardest natural material on Earth, and nothing can scratch a diamond except another diamond.
fact_tl: Ang diamante ang pinakamatigas na natural na materyales sa Earth. Wala itong ibang bato na makakagasgas dito kundi isa pang diamante!
fact_bis: Ang diamante mao ang pinakagahi nga natural nga materyales sa Yuta. Walay ubang bato nga makagasgas niini gawas sa laing diamante!

q: What simple machine is used in tall buildings to lift and lower elevators?
options: A wedge system that pushes the elevator car up through a narrow shaft
Pulleys and cables that work together to lift and lower the elevator car
Gears and levers connected to a motor that push the floor upward
Hydraulic pistons that use water pressure to raise and lower the car
explanation: Elevators in tall buildings use strong pulleys and cables to lift and lower people.
fact_tl: Ang mga elevator sa matataas na gusali ay gumagamit ng malalakas na kalo at cable para iangat at ibaba ang mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang mga elevator sa tag-as nga building naggamit ug kusgang polea ug cable aron ipataas ug ipaubos ang mga tawo.

q: In which part of the Philippines is the Philippine tarsier naturally found?
options: Only in the northern Philippines, specifically in Luzon and Batanes
In the southern Philippines such as Bohol, Samar, Leyte, and Mindanao
Across all the major islands, from Luzon to Mindanao equally
Only on Palawan Island, where it is strictly protected in forest reserves
explanation: The Philippine tarsier is endemic to the southern Philippines such as Bohol, Samar, Leyte, and Mindanao, and is found in no other country.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine tarsier ay endemiko sa katimugang Pilipinas tulad ng Bohol, Samar, Leyte, at Mindanao, at wala sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine tarsier endemiko sa habagatang Pilipinas sama sa Bohol, Samar, Leyte, ug Mindanao, ug wala sa laing nasod.

q: Why did communities try to 'slow the spread' of COVID-19 through distancing and lockdowns?
options: To give scientists more time to study the virus before anyone caught it
To prevent hospitals from filling up all at once so that patients could still receive care
To stop the virus from mutating into a more dangerous form over time
To allow people to build up natural immunity without any medical treatment
explanation: When COVID-19 spreads too fast, too many people get sick at once and hospitals fill up; slowing the spread kept hospitals from being overwhelmed so patients could still be cared for.
fact_tl: Kapag napakabilis kumalat ng COVID-19, sabay-sabay na nagkakasakit ang napakaraming tao at hindi sapat ang kama at doktor sa ospital. Kaya ginawa ang 'pagpapabagal ng pagkalat' — sa pamamagitan ng distansya at lockdown — para hindi mapuno agad ang ospital at maagapan ang mga pasyente.
fact_bis: Kung paspas kaayo mokatap ang COVID-19, dungan nga magsakit ang daghan kaayo nga tawo ug dili igo ang higdaanan ug doktor sa ospital. Busa gihimo ang 'pagpahinay sa pagkatap' — pinaagi sa distansya ug lockdown — aron dili mapuno dayon ang ospital ug maatiman pa ang mga pasyente.

q: How are particles arranged differently in a solid, a liquid, and a gas?
options: Solids have spread-out particles; liquids have tightly packed particles; gases have orderly particles
Solids have packed, orderly particles; liquids have close but moving particles; gases have far-apart, spreading particles
All three states have the same particle spacing but differ only in how fast particles vibrate
Solids and liquids have identical particle spacing; only gases have a noticeably different arrangement
explanation: In a solid the particles are packed and orderly; in a liquid they are close but can move; in a gas they are far apart and spread quickly.
fact_tl: Sa solido, magkadikit at nakaayos ang mga partikulo; sa likido, malapit pero nakakagalaw; sa gas, malayo at mabilis kumalat ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Sa solido, magkadikit ug han-ay ang mga partikulo; sa likido, duol apan makalihok; sa gas, magkalayo ug paspas mokatag.

q: How many eyes does a human have?
explanation: A human has 2 eyes.
fact_tl: May 2 (dalawa) na mata ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang tawo adunay 2 (duha) ka mata.

q: How does a mangrove crab grow bigger if its hard shell cannot stretch?
options: Its shell slowly expands as the crab eats more food over several months
It sheds its old shell through molting, grows quickly while the new shell is soft, then the shell hardens
Its shell cracks open along special seams and is repaired from inside with new material
It absorbs minerals from seawater that make its shell grow outward layer by layer
explanation: To grow, a mangrove crab must shed its old hard shell through molting; the new shell is soft at first, letting the crab grow quickly before it hardens again.
fact_tl: Para lumaki, kailangang hubarin ng alimango ang lumang matigas nitong balat — tinatawag itong molting. Pagkatapos, malambot muna ang bagong balat at mabilis itong tumutubo bago tumigas ulit. Kaya hindi tuloy-tuloy ang paglaki nito kundi pa-yugto.
fact_bis: Aron modako, kinahanglan hukason sa alimango ang daan nga gahi nga balat — gitawag kini nga molting. Human niini, humok una ang bag-ong balat ug paspas kini motubo una mogahi pag-usab. Mao nga dili kanunay ang pagtubo niini kondili pina-ang-ang.

q: What are the 'wings' of the Draco lizard actually made of?
options: Thin layers of muscle that the lizard flaps rapidly to glide between trees
Skin stretched over long ribs that it opens out and folds back in
Flaps of loose neck skin supported by cartilage rings around the throat
Feather-like scales that grow from its sides and unfold when needed
explanation: The Draco's 'wings' are skin stretched over long ribs that it can open out and fold back in.
fact_tl: Ang "pakpak" ng Draco ay balat na nakaunat sa mahahabang tadyang na maaaring ibuka at itupi.
fact_bis: Ang "pako" sa Draco maoy panit nga gibukhad sa tag-as nga gusok nga mahimo niyang ablihan ug pilo-on.

q: How do scientists predict how Earth's temperature will change in the future?
options: They observe animal migration patterns, which are known to shift with changing temperatures
They use computer climate models tested against past climate data to predict future warming
They measure changes in ocean salinity, which directly reflects global temperature trends
They study ancient tree rings, which can predict future climate up to 100 years ahead
explanation: Scientists use computer climate models that are tested against past climate to predict the future, showing that temperatures will keep rising depending on how much greenhouse gas humans add.
fact_tl: Ang mga siyentipiko ay gumagamit ng climate models sa kompyuter na sumusubok sa nakaraang klima upang hulaan ang hinaharap, at ipinapakita ng mga ito na patuloy na tataas ang temperatura depende sa dami ng greenhouse gas na idaragdag ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentista naggamit og climate models sa kompyuter nga gisulayan batok sa kanhing klima aron matagna ang umaabot, ug kini nagpakita nga magpadayon sa pagsaka ang temperatura depende sa kadaghan sa greenhouse gas nga idugang sa tawo.

q: How does your skin detect whether something is hot or cold?
options: One type of nerve ending detects all temperatures and sends a stronger signal for extremes
The skin has separate receptors for heat and for cold, so we can feel each one distinctly
Sweat glands measure temperature by releasing sweat when it is hot and stopping when cold
The skin's color-sensing cells also detect heat and cold as part of the same system
explanation: The skin has separate receptors for heat and for cold, so we can feel whether something is hot or cold.
fact_tl: May hiwalay na receptor sa balat para sa init at para sa lamig, kaya nararamdaman natin kung mainit o malamig ang isang bagay.
fact_bis: Adunay bulag nga receptor sa panit alang sa kainit ug alang sa katugnaw, busa mabati nato kung init o bugnaw ang usa ka butang.

q: How does a kudyapi make its sound?
options: Air is blown through two holes at each end, vibrating a reed inside the wooden body
Two strings are plucked, and the vibration echoes inside the hollow carved wooden body
A bow is drawn across the strings, making them vibrate against a flat soundboard
The player taps the wooden body like a drum while the strings hum in resonance
explanation: The kudyapi is a native boat-shaped lute with two strings that make sound when plucked, vibrating and echoing inside its hollow carved wooden body.
fact_tl: Ang kudyapi ay isang katutubong instrumentong hugis-bangka na may dalawang kuwerdas, at gumagawa ng tunog kapag pinitik ng daliri ang kuwerdas na umuugong sa loob ng inukit na kahoy.
fact_bis: Ang kudyapi usa ka lumad nga instrumento nga porma og sakayan nga adunay duha ka kwerdas nga motingog kon kutkuton, nga mokurog ug molanog sulod sa kinulit nga kahoy nga guwang.

q: If you launch a ball at 30 degrees and another at 60 degrees with the same speed, what do they share?
options: They reach the exact same maximum height above the ground
They stay in the air for the same amount of time before landing
They travel the same horizontal distance (range) before hitting the ground
They follow identical curved paths that overlap completely
explanation: Two launch angles that add up to 90 degrees (such as 30 and 60) give the same range, but the steeper angle makes the object go higher and stay in the air longer.
fact_tl: Dalawang anggulo na nagsusuma ng 90 degrees (gaya ng 30 at 60) ay nagbibigay ng parehong range, pero mas mataas at mas matagal ang paglipad ng inihagis sa mas matarik na anggulo.
fact_bis: Duha ka anggulo nga magsuma og 90 degrees (sama sa 30 ug 60) maghatag og parehong range, apan ang mas tul-id nga anggulo maghimo sa butang nga mosaka og mas taas ug magdugay sa hangin.

q: What surprising thing do some small sea creatures like crabs and barnacles do with floating ocean plastic?
options: They eat the plastic to extract the nutrients trapped inside the material
They ride and live on floating plastic, which can carry them to new areas where they do not belong
They wrap themselves in plastic pieces to protect their soft bodies from predators
They use plastic as a shelter from which to hunt fish passing underneath
explanation: Small sea creatures like crabs and barnacles ride and live on the floating plastic in garbage patches, which can carry them to new places where they are not supposed to live.
fact_tl: Nakakapagtaka, may maliliit na hayop sa dagat tulad ng alimango at barnacle na sumasakay at namumuhay sa nakalutang na plastik sa garbage patch — pero ito rin ay nakakatulong dalhin sila sa mga bagong lugar kung saan hindi sila dapat manirahan.
fact_bis: Katingad-an, adunay gagmay nga mananap sa dagat sama sa alimango ug barnacle nga magsakay ug magpuyo sa naglutaw nga plastik sa garbage patch — apan kini usab magdala kanila ngadto sa bag-ong mga dapit diin dili sila angay magpuyo.

q: What does the chico (sapodilla) fruit look and taste like?
options: It is a yellow fruit with a crunchy texture and a very sour tangy flavor
It is a sweet fruit with brown skin and soft flesh that grows in warm places like the Philippines
It is a red fruit with a hard seed inside and a bitter taste when unripe
It is a green fruit with thick skin and white watery flesh similar to coconut
explanation: The chico, or sapodilla, is a sweet fruit with brown skin and soft flesh that grows in warm places like the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang tsiko ay isang matamis na prutas na may kayumangging balat at malambot na laman, at tumutubo sa mainit na lugar tulad ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang tsiko o sapodilla usa ka tam-is nga prutas nga may tabunon nga panit ug humok nga unod, ug motubo sa init nga dapit sama sa Pilipinas.

q: What did Charles Darwin explain in his famous scientific work?
options: How the Earth's continents slowly drifted apart over millions of years
How living things slowly change over very long periods of time
How planets formed from clouds of gas and dust in space
How fossils are created when animals are buried in mud
explanation: Charles Darwin explained evolution — the slow change of living things over very long periods of time.
fact_tl: Si Charles Darwin ay isang siyentista na nagpaliwanag ng ebolusyon, ang dahan-dahang pagbabago ng mga uri ng buhay sa paglipas ng napakaraming taon.
fact_bis: Si Charles Darwin usa ka siyentista nga nagpasabot sa ebolusyon, ang hinay-hinay nga pagbag-o sa mga buhing butang sulod sa daghan kaayo nga katuigan.

q: Who composed the music of the Philippine national anthem, 'Lupang Hinirang'?
options: José Palma
Julián Felipe
Juan Luna
Emilio Jacinto
explanation: Julián Felipe composed the music of 'Lupang Hinirang,' the Philippine national anthem.
fact_tl: Si Julián Felipe ang gumawa ng musika ng "Lupang Hinirang."
fact_bis: Si Julián Felipe ang naghimo sa musika sa "Lupang Hinirang."

q: What do burning fuel and cellular respiration have in common?
options: Both produce nitrogen gas and water vapor as their only products
Both are reactions with oxygen that release stored energy and form carbon dioxide
Both require sunlight to start and can only happen during the day
Both are reversible reactions that can be undone by adding water
explanation: Both burning fuel and cellular respiration react with oxygen, releasing stored energy from carbon-containing molecules and forming carbon dioxide.
fact_tl: Parehong reaksyon sa oxygen ang pagsunog ng gatong at ang respirasyon sa selula, kung saan ang mga molekulang may carbon ay naglalabas ng nakaimbak na enerhiya at bumubuo ng carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Pareho nga reaksiyon sa oxygen ang pagsunog sa gatong ug ang respirasyon sa selula, diin ang mga molekula nga adunay carbon mogawas sa natipig nga enerhiya ug maghimo og carbon dioxide.

q: Why do Philippine volcanoes form at a specific distance away from the deep ocean trench?
options: Because the wind patterns push volcanic ash inland rather than over the trench
Because the subducted plate must sink about 100 km deep before it melts to form magma
Because the ocean is too deep near the trench for volcanic islands to build up
Because earthquakes near the trench destroy any volcanoes that try to form there
explanation: The subducted plate must reach about 100 km depth to melt and generate magma, so volcanoes form at a set distance from the trench called the arc-trench gap.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulkan ng Philippine island arc ay nabubuo sa tiyak na distansya mula sa subduction trench dahil ang subducted na plato ay kailangan pang maabot ang sapat na lalim (halos 100 km) para matunaw at makapagbuhos ng magma; ang distansyang ito ay tinatawag na 'arc-trench gap'.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulkan sa Philippine island arc naporma sa tiyak nga gilay-on gikan sa subduction trench tungod kay ang subducted nga plato kinahanglan pa maabot ang igo nga giladmon (mga 100 km) aron matunaw ug makagawa og magma; kini nga gilay-on gitawag og 'arc-trench gap'.

q: A person with color blindness would most likely have trouble telling apart which two colors?
options: Blue and yellow
Red and green
Black and white
Orange and purple
explanation: Color blindness is a condition that makes it difficult to tell red from green, and it is more common in males because the gene is on the X chromosome.
fact_tl: Ang color blindness (daltonismo) ay isang kondisyon na karaniwang nauugnay sa kasarian, na nagdudulot ng kahirapan sa pagtukoy ng pula at berde; mas karaniwan ito sa mga lalaki.
fact_bis: Ang color blindness usa ka kasagarang na-inherit nga kondisyon nga nagpalisud sa pagpilit sa pula ug berde; mas kasagaran kini sa mga lalaki tungod kay ang gene naa sa X chromosome.

q: What happens to the Sun during its 'active' period?
options: The Sun becomes cooler and gives off less light than usual
There are more sunspots and the Sun releases stronger solar flares more often
The Sun spins faster and all the planets move slightly farther away
There are fewer sunspots and the Sun produces more heat for Earth
explanation: During active periods, the Sun has more dark sunspots on its surface and releases stronger solar flares more often; this cycle repeats about every eleven years.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay dumadaan sa mga panahong 'active' at 'quiet'. Tuwing 'active' ito, mas maraming sunspots o madidilim na mantsa sa mukha nito, at mas madalas itong magpalabas ng malalakas na solar flare. Tuwing 'quiet' naman, mas kaunti ang sunspots at mas kalmado ito. Umiikot ang siklong ito nang humigit-kumulang labing-isang taon.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw moagi sa mga panahong 'active' ug 'quiet'. Kung 'active' kini, mas daghan ang sunspots o itom nga mantsa sa nawong niini, ug mas kanunay kini mogawas og kusog nga solar flare. Kung 'quiet' kini, mas diyutay ang sunspots ug mas kalmado kini. Kining siklo mobalik-balik matag mga onse ka tuig.

q: The Philippines is part of what important marine region recognized as the global center of ocean biodiversity?
options: The Great Barrier Region
The Coral Triangle
The Pacific Ring of Life
The Blue Biodiversity Zone
explanation: The Philippines is part of the Coral Triangle, the Southeast Asian region recognized as the global center of marine biodiversity, which also includes Indonesia and Malaysia.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay bahagi ng Coral Triangle, ang rehiyon sa Timog-Silangang Asya na kilala bilang sentro ng biodiversity sa dagat sa buong mundo; kasama rin dito ang Indonesia, Malaysia, at iba pang bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas kabahin sa Coral Triangle, ang rehiyon sa Habagatang-Silangang Asya nga giila isip sentro sa biodiversity sa dagat sa kalibutan; naglangkob usab kini sa Indonesia, Malaysia, ug uban pang mga nasud.

q: What is the range of sound frequencies that people can normally hear?
options: From 200 hertz up to 2,000 hertz
From 20 hertz up to 20,000 hertz
From 2 hertz up to 200 hertz
From 2,000 hertz up to 200,000 hertz
explanation: People can usually hear sounds from a low 20 hertz up to a very high 20,000 hertz.
fact_tl: Karaniwang naririnig ng tao ang mga tunog mula sa mababang 20 hertz hanggang sa napakataas na 20,000 hertz.
fact_bis: Kasagaran madungog sa tawo ang mga tingog gikan sa ubos nga 20 hertz hangtod sa taas kaayo nga 20,000 hertz.

q: Bronze is a mixture of two metals. Which metals are combined to make bronze?
options: Copper and zinc
Copper and tin
Iron and copper
Iron and tin
explanation: Bronze is an alloy made by mixing copper with tin.
fact_tl: Ang bronse ay isang aleasyon na gawa sa tanso na hinaluan ng tin.
fact_bis: Ang bronse usa ka aleasyon nga gihimo gikan sa tumbaga nga gisagolan og tin.

q: Normal human body temperature is 37°C. What is that in Fahrenheit?
explanation: Using the formula °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32, normal body temperature of 37°C equals 98.6°F.
fact_tl: Para i-convert ang Celsius sa Fahrenheit, gumamit ng formula: °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32 — halimbawa, ang 37°C na temperatura ng katawan ay katumbas ng 98.6°F.
fact_bis: Aron i-convert ang Celsius ngadto sa Fahrenheit gamit ang formula: °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32 — pananglitan, ang 37°C nga temperatura sa lawas katumbas sa 98.6°F.

q: What are the small holes called that form in rocks like scoria when gas bubbles get trapped in fast-cooling lava?
options: Crystals
Vesicles
Fossils
Pores
explanation: When lava cools rapidly, trapped gas bubbles form small holes called vesicles, which are visible in scoria and some basalt rocks.
fact_tl: Kapag mabilis na lumamig ang lava, nahaharang ang gas bubbles sa loob ng bato at bumubuo ng maliliit na butas na tinatawag na vesicles — makikita ito sa scoria at basalt.
fact_bis: Kung dali malamig ang lava, ang mga gas bubble masud-ong sulod, nagporma og mga gagmay nga buho nga gitawag vesicles—kini makita sa scoria ug pila ka basalt nga mga bato.

q: What does PHIVOLCS Alert Level 0 mean for a volcano?
options: The volcano is about to erupt and people must evacuate immediately
The volcano is normal and quiet with no signs of eruption
The volcano is showing small signs of unrest but is not dangerous yet
The volcano just finished erupting and is cooling down
explanation: Alert Level 0 means the volcano is normal and quiet with no signs of eruption, so people nearby are safe.
fact_tl: Ang Alert Level 0 ay nangangahulugang normal at tahimik ang bulkan. Walang senyales ng pagputok, kaya ligtas ang mga tao sa paligid — pero patuloy pa rin itong binabantayan.
fact_bis: Ang Alert Level 0 nagpasabot nga normal ug hilom ang bulkan. Walay timailhan sa pagbuto, busa luwas ang mga tawo sa palibot — apan padayon gihapon kining bantayan.

q: What type of battery is used in most cars, and what makes it special?
options: Lithium-ion batteries, which are very light and used only once
Lead-acid batteries with lead plates and acid, which can be recharged
Alkaline batteries that contain zinc and manganese and last very long
Nickel-cadmium batteries that are charged by solar panels on the hood
explanation: Car batteries are lead-acid batteries containing lead plates and sulfuric acid electrolyte; the alternator recharges them by converting engine energy into stored chemical energy.
fact_tl: Ang mga baterya ng sasakyan ay lead-acid batteries na naglalaman ng tingga at sulfuric acid — ang mga ito ay maaaring muling i-charge gamit ang alternator ng sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang mga baterya sa sasakyan mga lead-acid battery nga nagdala og mga plato sa tingga ug sulfuric acid electrolyte; mahimong i-recharge kini, nagpasabot nga ang alternator nagconvert sa enerhiya sa makina balik ngadto sa naimbak nga chemical energy.

q: An electric eel has thousands of tiny cells in its electric organ. How do they produce such a powerful shock?
options: Each cell stores energy for months and releases it all at once in an emergency
Each cell makes a tiny amount of electricity, but all firing together adds up to one strong shock
Only one special large cell actually produces the electricity while the others are just fillers
The cells absorb electricity from the water and then redirect it at the target
explanation: Each tiny cell produces only a small amount of electricity, but when thousands fire at the same time the amounts add up into one strong shock, like many batteries in a row.
fact_tl: Bawat maliit na cell sa electric organ ay gumagawa lang ng napakaliit na kuryente. Pero kapag libu-libo na sila at sabay-sabay na gumana, nagsasama-sama ang maliliit na ito para maging isang malakas na kuryente, gaya ng maraming bateryang pinagdugtong.
fact_bis: Ang matag gagmayng cell sa electric organ naghimo lang og gamay kaayo nga kuryente. Apan kung liboan na sila ug dungan nga mogana, ang gagmay nga kuryente magtapok aron mahimong usa ka kusog nga kuryente, sama sa daghang baterya nga gidugtong.

q: Some animals store food for winter without being taught. What do we call this kind of inborn behavior?
options: A learned habit
An instinct
A trained skill
A memory
explanation: Storing food is an inborn instinct in these animals — they know how to do it even though no one taught them.
fact_tl: Ang pag-iimbak ng pagkain ay likas na ugali ng mga hayop, kaya alam na nila itong gawin kahit walang nagturo.
fact_bis: Ang pagtipig og pagkaon kay kinaiyahan na sa mga mananap, busa kabalo na sila niini bisan walay nagtudlo.

q: Why did so many different languages develop across the Philippines?
options: The Spanish colonizers taught a different language to each island group
The islands are separated from each other, so languages grew apart independently
A law was passed requiring each island to invent its own language
Different groups of traders brought different languages from faraway countries
explanation: Because the islands are separated, many different languages grew across the Philippines independently.
fact_tl: Dahil hiwa-hiwalay ang mga pulo, umusbong ang maraming iba't ibang wika sa buong Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Tungod kay bulag-bulag ang mga isla, daghang nagkalainlaing pinulongan ang mitubo sa tibuok Pilipinas.

q: Why is the Philippine flying fox now endangered?
options: It is endangered because it has trouble finding mates and reproduces very slowly
Forests are cut down and people hunt it for food, causing its numbers to drop
It was deliberately released into the wild after escaping from zoos nationwide
Climate change raised temperatures so high that the bats can no longer fly properly
explanation: The Philippine flying fox is endangered because its forest habitat is cut down and people sometimes hunt it for food, which is why it is now protected by law.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine flying fox ay nanganganib nang maubos (endangered). Nababawasan sila dahil pinuputol ang mga gubat na tinitirhan nila, at minsan hinuhuli sila ng tao para kainin. Kaya protektado na sila ng batas.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine flying fox namiligro nga mahurot (endangered). Mokunhod sila kay giputol ang mga kagubatan nga ilang gipuy-an, ug usahay panguhaon sila sa tawo aron kaonon. Mao nga gipanalipdan na sila sa balaod.

q: How does adrenaline work when it reaches a cell in your body?
options: It dissolves into the cell wall and spreads inside the cell like water soaking into a sponge
It attaches to special receptors on the cell, like a key fitting the right lock, to send its message
It sends electrical signals through the nervous system that reach the cell before the hormone does
It travels directly to the brain, which then tells each cell how to respond to the danger
explanation: Adrenaline must attach to special receptors on cells — like a key fitting the right lock — for the body to respond to it.
fact_tl: Para maramdaman ng katawan ang adrenaline, kailangan nitong dumikit sa espesyal na bahagi ng selula na tinatawag na receptor. Parang susi ito na bumabagay sa tamang kandado—doon lang gumagana ang mensahe nito.
fact_bis: Aron mobati ang lawas sa adrenaline, kinahanglan kini motapot sa espesyal nga bahin sa selula nga gitawag og receptor. Sama kini sa yawi nga mohaom sa husto nga kandado—didto lang molihok ang mensahe niini.

q: What is the sampaguita flower well known for?
options: Its very spicy and strong scent that keeps insects away
Its sweet, fragrant smell
Its bright red color that attracts birds and butterflies
Its large size that can cover an entire garden wall
explanation: The sampaguita is known for its sweet, fragrant smell.
fact_tl: Ang sampaguita ay may matamis at mabangong amoy.
fact_bis: Ang sampaguita adunay tam-is ug humot nga baho.

q: What does the inside of a jackfruit seed look like when you peel it?
options: It is dark brown, dry, and hard like a pebble with no moisture
It is white and starchy inside and full of energy
It is bright orange and juicy, similar to the flesh of a mango
It is hollow in the middle with a thin layer of sweet jelly
explanation: When you peel a jackfruit seed, you find a white, starchy inside that is full of energy.
fact_tl: Kapag binalatan ang buto ng langka, makikita mo ang puti at malasebong laman na puno ng almirol o starch na nagbibigay-lakas.
fact_bis: Kung panitan nimo ang liso sa nangka, makita nimo ang puti ug starchy nga sulod nga naghatag ug kusog.

q: What is the relationship between bacteria in bean roots and the bean plant?
options: The bacteria harm the plant by stealing water and nutrients from the roots
The bacteria take nitrogen from the air to fertilize the plant, and the plant feeds the bacteria in return
The bacteria protect the roots from insects by releasing a bitter chemical taste
The bacteria break down dead leaves and return the nutrients to the soil for the plant
explanation: Bacteria in the roots of legumes like beans take nitrogen from the air to fertilize the plant, and the plant feeds the bacteria — a mutual relationship where both benefit.
fact_tl: Sa ugat ng mga halamang munggo nakatira ang bakterya na kumukuha ng nitroheno mula sa hangin; nagbibigay ito ng sustansiya sa halaman at ang halaman ay nagbibigay ng pagkain sa bakterya.
fact_bis: Sa gamot sa mga tanom nga munggo nagpuyo ang bakterya nga mokuha ug nitroheno gikan sa hangin; gihatagan niini ug sustansya ang tanom, ug ang tanom mohatag ug pagkaon sa bakterya.

q: Which type of exercise is BEST for strengthening your heart?
options: Lifting heavy weights
Running or swimming
Stretching and yoga
Balancing on one foot
explanation: Running and swimming are aerobic exercises that strengthen your heart, while lifting builds muscles and stretching makes your body flexible.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang klase ng ehersisyo: ang pagtakbo at paglangoy ay nagpapalakas ng puso, ang pagbubuhat ay nagpapalakas ng kalamnan, at ang pag-stretch ay nagpapaliksi sa katawan.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing matang sa ehersisyo: ang pagdagan ug paglangoy magpalig-on sa kasingkasing, ang pag-alsa magpakusog sa unod, ug ang pag-stretch magpaliksi sa lawas.

q: Why are gasoline, coal, and oil sometimes called 'canned sunlight'?
options: Because they were formed near the surface where sunlight could heat and compress them
Because the energy in them is sunlight captured long ago by photosynthesis and stored for millions of years
Because burning them releases the same wavelengths of light that the Sun originally sent to Earth
Because solar panels on oil rigs use sunlight to speed up the formation of fossil fuels
explanation: Fossil fuels come from plants and organisms that lived millions of years ago, and the energy in them is sunlight captured long ago by photosynthesis and stored ever since.
fact_tl: Ang gasolina, langis, at uling ay galing sa mga halaman at organismo na nabuhay milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas. Ang enerhiya sa mga ito ay sikat ng araw na nakuha noon sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, na nakaimbak nang napakatagal. Kaya sinasabing 'nakalatang na sikat ng araw' ang gasolina.
fact_bis: Ang gasolina, lana, ug uling gikan sa mga tanom ug organismo nga nabuhi milyon-milyon ka tuig na ang milabay. Ang enerhiya niini mao ang kahayag sa adlaw nga nadakop kaniadto pinaagi sa photosynthesis ug gitipigan og dugay kaayo. Mao nga gitawag ang gasolina nga 'de-lata nga kahayag sa adlaw.'

q: Rolling your tongue into a tube shape is a classic example of what kind of trait?
options: An acquired trait learned through practice and exercise
An inherited trait passed from parents to children
A random trait that appears without any pattern
A developmental trait that only appears after age ten
explanation: The ability to roll the tongue is often used as a classic example of an inherited trait.
fact_tl: Ang kakayahang irolyo ang dila ay madalas gamiting halimbawa ng namamanang katangian.
fact_bis: Ang katakus sa paglukot sa dila kasagaran gigamit nga pananglitan sa napanulondon nga kinaiya.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the element silver?
options: Si
Ag
Sl
Au
explanation: Silver is a chemical element whose symbol is Ag.
fact_tl: Ang pilak (plata) ay isang elemento na ang kemikal na simbolo ay Ag.
fact_bis: Ang plata (silver) usa ka elemento nga ang kemikal nga simbolo mao ang Ag.

q: About what percentage of the total mass of the solar system is in the Sun?
options: About 50%
About 99%
About 75%
About 25%
explanation: The Sun holds about 99% of all the mass in the solar system, which is why its gravitational pull on everything else is so strong.
fact_tl: Hindi lang malaki ang Araw — ito rin ang pinakamabigat sa buong solar system. Halos lahat ng materyales sa solar system (mga 99%) ay nasa Araw, at kakaunti lang ang natitira para sa lahat ng planeta. Kaya napakalakas ng hila ng Araw sa lahat.
fact_bis: Dili lang dako ang Adlaw — kini usab ang labing bug-at sa tibuok solar system. Halos tanan nga materyales sa solar system (mga 99%) anaa sa Adlaw, ug gamay ra ang nahibilin alang sa tanang planeta. Mao nga kusog kaayo ang birik sa Adlaw sa tanan.

q: How does the leaf-tailed gecko avoid being seen by predators?
options: It changes its skin color rapidly to match any surface it touches within seconds
It has a leaf-shaped tail and skin flaps that hide its outline so it looks like tree bark
It burrows quickly into loose soil and covers itself with dirt when threatened
It produces a foul-smelling liquid that drives away predators before they can see it
explanation: The leaf-tailed gecko has a leaf-shaped tail and flaps of skin that hide its shadow and outline, making it look almost the same as the bark of the tree it clings to.
fact_tl: Ang leaf-tailed gecko ay may buntot na hugis-dahon at maliliit na laylayan ng balat sa gilid ng katawan na nagtatago sa anino at balangkas nito, kaya halos kapareho na ito ng balat ng punong kinakapitan nito.
fact_bis: Ang leaf-tailed gecko adunay ikog nga porma-dahon ug gagmay nga laylay sa panit sa kilid sa lawas nga magtago sa landong ug balangkas niini, mao nga halos pareho na kini sa panit sa kahoy nga gikuptan niini.

q: How does your skin help protect you from extreme temperatures?
options: It produces sweat that cools you down but cannot detect cold at all
It has tiny sensors that feel hot and cold and send the information to your brain as a warning
It changes color when you are too hot or too cold so others can see you need help
It grows thicker in winter to trap heat and thinner in summer to release it
explanation: Your skin has tiny sensors that detect whether surroundings are hot or cold and send that information to your brain, acting like an alarm to protect you.
fact_tl: May maliliit na sensors ang balat na nakakaramdam kung mainit o malamig ang paligid. Pinapadala nito ang impormasyon sa utak, kaya alam mo kung dapat kang maghanap ng lilim o magdamit. Kaya parang alarm ang balat mo.
fact_bis: Ang panit adunay gagmay nga sensors nga makabati kung init o tugnaw ang palibot. Ipadala niini ang impormasyon sa utok, mao nga mahibaw-an nimo kung kanus-a mangita ug landong o magsul-ob ug sinina. Sama sa alarm ang imong panit.

q: Why are steel bars (rebar) placed inside concrete when building structures?
options: To make the concrete lighter so buildings do not press down too hard on the ground
Because concrete alone is weak when pulled or bent, and steel bars stop it from cracking
To keep the concrete warm while it dries so it sets more quickly and evenly
Because steel conducts heat away from the building during fires, protecting the structure
explanation: Concrete is weak when pulled or bent, so steel bars (rebar) are placed inside it so it does not crack or break easily.
fact_tl: Mahina ang konkreto kapag hinahatak o binabaluktot, kaya nilalagyan ito ng mga baras na bakal (rebar) sa loob para hindi madaling mabitak o mabali.
fact_bis: Luya ang konkreto kon biraon o baw-ogon, busa butangan kini og mga puthaw nga bara (rebar) sa sulod aron dili dali mabuak o mabali.

q: Which bird holds the record for the fastest speed in level flight?
options: The peregrine falcon
The common swift
The golden eagle
The albatross
explanation: The common swift is the fastest bird in level flight, reaching about 111 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na ibon sa tuwid na paglipad ay ang common swift, mga 111 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang pinakatulin nga langgam sa tul-id nga paglupad mao ang common swift, mga 111 ka kilometro kada oras.

q: Which part of a plant cell carries out photosynthesis to make food?
options: The nucleus
The chloroplast
The cell wall
The vacuole
explanation: Chloroplasts are the parts of plant cells that carry out photosynthesis to make food.
fact_tl: Ang kloroplast ang bahagi ng selula ng halaman na gumagawa ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis.
fact_bis: Ang kloroplast mao ang bahin sa sélula sa tanom nga naghimo ug pagkaon pinaagi sa potosintesis.

q: Why do students use a breadboard when building electronic circuits?
options: It keeps all wires at the same voltage so none of the components can burn out
It lets them insert components and wires without soldering so they can test and change the circuit easily
It automatically corrects wiring mistakes by rerouting electricity to the right path
It generates a small current of its own so students do not need an external battery
explanation: A breadboard lets students insert components and jumper wires without soldering, making it easy to test circuits before making permanent soldered connections.
fact_tl: Ang breadboard ay isang plastic na board na may mga butas kung saan maaaring isingit ang mga electronic component at jumper wire nang walang solder — ginagamit ito ng mga estudyante para subukan ang mga circuit bago i-solder ang permanent na koneksyon.
fact_bis: Ang breadboard usa ka plastic nga board nga adunay mga butas kung diin ang mga electronic component ug jumper wire mahimong isingit nga walay solder — ang mga estudyante naggamit niini aron i-test ang mga circuit sa wala pa buhaton ang permanent nga soldered nga koneksyon.

q: What happens to coconut milk when you boil it in a ginataang dish?
options: It turns bright white and stays watery throughout the whole cooking process
It thickens as heat draws the oil out of the coconut milk
It completely evaporates and leaves only a dry coconut crust in the pot
It separates into plain water and solid coconut chunks that float to the top
explanation: Coconut milk (gata) is squeezed from grated coconut, and when boiled it thickens as heat draws out the oil.
fact_tl: Ang gata ay nakukuha sa pagpiga ng kinudkod na niyog, at kapag pinakuluan ito sa ginataang putahe ay lumalapot habang lumalabas ang langis dahil sa init.
fact_bis: Ang gata makuha pinaagi sa pagpuga sa kinudkod nga lubi, ug kon pabukalon kini sa ginataang sud-an molulot kini samtang mogawas ang lana tungod sa kainit.

q: If you count the rows of kernels on a corn cob, what pattern will you usually find?
options: The rows are always an odd number because each side grows a different amount
The number of rows is usually even because of the way kernels grow from the silk
The kernels grow in a spiral pattern with no clear rows at all
Each corn cob has exactly eight rows, never more and never less
explanation: The kernels on a corn cob are arranged in neat rows and the number of rows is usually even because of the way they grow from the silk.
fact_tl: Kapag titignan mo ang mais, nakaayos ang mga butil sa maayos na mga hanay sa paligid ng cob. Karaniwang pares ang bilang ng hanay dahil sa paraan ng paglaki ng butil mula sa silk.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon nimo ang mais, ang mga lugas hapsay nga gilinya palibot sa busal. Kasagaran parehas (even) ang gidaghanon sa linya tungod sa paagi sa pagtubo sa lugas gikan sa silk.

q: According to the famous story, what word did Archimedes shout when he made his great discovery in the bath?
options: "Eureka!"
"Aha!"
"Miracle!"
"Archimedes!"
explanation: According to the story, Archimedes shouted 'Eureka!' meaning 'I have found it!' when he discovered the principle of buoyancy while in his bath.
fact_tl: Sabi ng kwento, sumigaw si Archimedes ng "Eureka!" (ibig sabihin: "Natuklasan ko na!") sa paliguan.
fact_bis: Sumala sa sugilanon, misinggit si Archimedes ug "Eureka!" (kahulogan: "Nakaplagan na nako!") sa iyang kaligoanan.

q: When you fry food in a pan of hot oil, how does heat get into the food?
options: The heat rises through the air above the pan and enters the food from the top
Heat passes directly from the hot oil into the food because they are in contact — this is called conduction
Microwaves from the stove burner pass through the oil and vibrate the food's molecules
The food produces its own heat once it touches the pan through a chemical reaction
explanation: When frying, the food and hot oil are in direct contact, so heat passes quickly from the oil into the food by conduction.
fact_tl: Kapag nagpriprito, ang mainit na langis ay nagsasalid ng init sa pagkain sa pamamagitan ng conduction — ang pagkain at mainit na langis ay nakahipo kaya mabilis ang paglipas ng init.
fact_bis: Kung nagaprito, ang mainit nga langis nagadala sa init ngadto sa pagkain pinaagi sa conduction — ang pagkain ug mainit nga langis nagahikap aron dali moagi ang init ngadto sa pagkain.

q: What happens to a person's lungs after they quit smoking?
options: The damage to the lungs is permanent and cannot improve no matter what
The lungs slowly heal and the person's health improves over time
The lungs heal within 24 hours and return completely to their original state
The lungs only heal if the person also takes special medicine prescribed by a doctor
explanation: When a person quits smoking, the lungs slowly heal and health improves over time.
fact_tl: Kapag tumigil sa paninigarilyo, unti-unting gumagaling ang baga at bumubuti ang kalusugan.
fact_bis: Kung mohunong sa pagpanigarilyo, hinay-hinay nga maayo ang baga ug mouswag ang panglawas.

q: Why does light from the stars take many years to reach Earth?
options: Because starlight travels slower than sunlight due to the cold temperature of space
Because the stars are so far away that even light, traveling very fast, needs years to cross that distance
Because Earth's atmosphere blocks most of the starlight and only a little gets through each year
Because stars only release light for a few seconds at a time before resting and releasing more later
explanation: Light from stars takes many years to reach Earth because the stars are so incredibly far away.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng mga bituin ay umaabot ng maraming taon bago marating ang Daigdig dahil napakalayo nila.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag sa mga bituon mokabat ug daghang tuig sa dili pa makaabot sa Yuta tungod kay layo kaayo sila.

q: During photosynthesis, where does the oxygen that plants release into the air actually come from?
options: From carbon dioxide molecules that the plant breaks apart to release oxygen
From water molecules that the plant splits apart using the sun's energy
From the soil, where oxygen is stored between the soil particles underground
From the air itself — the plant collects oxygen and then releases it again purified
explanation: The oxygen a plant releases comes from water, not carbon dioxide — the plant uses the sun's energy to split water molecules (H2O) and releases that oxygen into the air.
fact_tl: Marami ang akalang galing sa carbon dioxide ang oxygen na nililikha ng halaman, pero galing pala ito sa TUBIG. Ginagamit ng halaman ang lakas ng araw para hatiin ang molekula ng tubig (H₂O), at ang oxygen na ito ang ipinapalabas nito sa hangin.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang oxygen nga buhian sa tanom gikan sa carbon dioxide, apan gikan diay kini sa TUBIG. Gigamit sa tanom ang kusog sa adlaw aron bahinon ang molekula sa tubig (H₂O), ug kanang oxygen mao ang ibuga niini sa hangin.

q: What is 'blue carbon' and where does it come from?
options: Carbon stored in the atmosphere by high-altitude clouds over the ocean
Carbon stored quickly in the mud beneath underwater seagrass meadows
Carbon captured by blue-green algae that floats on the ocean's surface
Carbon that sinks to the ocean floor after being released by deep-sea volcanoes
explanation: Blue carbon is carbon stored quickly in the mud beneath underwater seagrass meadows, and it is called 'blue' because it comes from the sea.
fact_tl: Ang mga damong-dagat (seagrass) sa ilalim ng tubig ay mabilis mag-imbak ng karbon sa putik sa ilalim nila. Ito ang tinatawag na 'blue carbon' dahil galing sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga sagbot-dagat (seagrass) ilalom sa tubig paspas mosuyop ug karbon sa lapok ubos nila. Gitawag kini nga 'blue carbon' kay gikan sa dagat.

q: In many fish like the guppy, why is the male more colorful than the female?
options: Males are more colorful to warn predators that they are poisonous and dangerous
Males use bright colors to attract the attention of females and be chosen as a mate
Males are colorful because they eat more food and the pigments build up in their scales
Males need bright colors to camouflage themselves among coral reefs and sea plants
explanation: In many fish, the male is more colorful to attract females; for example, the male guppy has bright colors on its tail that it uses to be noticed and chosen.
fact_tl: Sa maraming isda, mas makulay at mas magaganda ang lalaki kaysa babae. Halimbawa, ang lalaking guppy ay may matitingkad na kulay sa buntot. Ginagamit nila ang gandang ito para mapansin at mahalin sila ng babae.
fact_bis: Sa daghang isda, mas mabulukon ug mas nindot tan-awon ang laki kaysa baye. Pananglitan, ang laki nga guppy naa'y hayag nga kolor sa ikog. Gamiton nila kini nga katahom aron mamatikdan ug pilion sila sa baye.

q: Why is Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) considered one of the most important medical discoveries?
options: It is a new high-tech treatment that requires hospitals and trained doctors to give correctly
It is simple, cheap, and has saved millions of children who would have died from diarrhea
It was the first medicine to be produced without any chemicals or laboratory equipment
It replaced surgery as the main way to treat serious stomach infections around the world
explanation: ORS has been called one of the most important medical discoveries because it is simple and cheap yet has saved millions of children around the world from dying of diarrhea.
fact_tl: Bakit napakahalaga ng ORS? Tinawag itong isa sa pinakamahalagang medikal na natuklasan dahil simple lang pero milyon-milyong bata ang nailigtas nito sa buong mundo. Dati, maraming batang namamatay sa pagtatae; ngayon, kayang iligtas ng murang ORS.
fact_bis: Ngano importante kaayo ang ORS? Gitawag kini nga usa sa labing importante nga medikal nga nadiskobrehan kay simple ra apan minilyon nga bata ang naluwas niini sa tibuok kalibutan. Kaniadto, daghang bata ang namatay sa kalibang; karon, maluwas sila sa barato nga ORS.

q: Which of these metals will NOT stick to a magnet?
options: Iron
Copper
Steel
Nickel
explanation: Not all metals are magnetic — copper does not stick to a magnet even though it is a solid metal, unlike iron, steel, and nickel which do stick.
fact_tl: Maraming solid na metal gaya ng bakal ang kumakapit sa magnet, kaya naididikit mo ang clip sa bato-balani. Pero hindi lahat ng metal ay ganito—ang ginto at tanso ay hindi kumakapit sa magnet kahit solid din sila.
fact_bis: Daghang solid nga metal sama sa puthaw ang motapot sa magnet, mao nga maipapilit nimo ang clip sa bato-balani. Apan dili tanan nga metal ingon niini; ang bulawan ug tumbaga dili motapot sa magnet bisan solid sad sila.

q: Which two parts of the eye work together to bend light and help you see clearly?
options: The retina and the pupil
The cornea and the lens
The iris and the eyelid
The optic nerve and the pupil
explanation: Two parts bend light in the eye — the clear cornea at the front and the lens inside — together they focus the light so you can see clearly.
fact_tl: Dalawang bahagi ang nagliliko ng liwanag sa mata: ang malinaw na cornea sa harap at ang lente sa loob.
fact_bis: Duha ka bahin ang nagaliko sa kahayag sa mata: ang tin-aw nga cornea sa atubangan ug ang lente sa sulod.

q: How long does a horse carry its baby before giving birth?
options: About 3 months
About 11 months
About 6 months
About 18 months
explanation: A horse is pregnant for about 11 months before giving birth.
fact_tl: Ang kabayo ay nagbubuntis nang halos 11 buwan bago manganak.
fact_bis: Ang kabayo mabdos ug mga 11 ka bulan una manganak.

q: Why is gold considered a perfect material for jewelry and rings?
options: Because it is very common and easy to find, so it is affordable for everyone
Because it is rare, shiny, and does not rust, making it durable and beautiful
Because it is extremely hard and cannot be scratched or dented by anything
Because it is lightweight and floats in water, making it easy to wear all day
explanation: Gold is valuable for jewelry because it is rare, shiny, and does not rust, which makes it perfect for rings and decorative items.
fact_tl: Ang ginto ay transition metal at mahalaga sa Pilipinas — may mga minahan ng ginto sa Benguet at Mindanao. Mahal ito dahil bihira, makintab, at hindi kumakalawang, kaya perpekto para sa alahas at singsing.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan usa ka transition metal ug importante sa Pilipinas, naa'y minahan sa Benguet ug Mindanao. Mahal kini kay talagsaon, masinaw, ug dili motaya, maong perpekto sa alahas ug singsing.

q: What was Usain Bolt's top speed during his world-record run?
options: 37.5 kilometers per hour
44.72 kilometers per hour
52.0 kilometers per hour
29.8 kilometers per hour
explanation: Usain Bolt reached a top speed of 44.72 kilometers per hour during his world-record run.
fact_tl: Naabot ni Usain Bolt ang pinakamataas na bilis na 44.72 kilometro kada oras sa kanyang record na takbo.
fact_bis: Si Usain Bolt nakaabot sa kinatas-ang katulin nga 44.72 ka kilometro kada oras sa iyang rekord nga dagan.

q: What does a fever do for your body when you are sick?
options: It helps fight the germs that are making you ill
It tells the doctor what medicine you need
It cools the body down to slow your heart rate
It stops you from feeling hungry so you rest
explanation: A fever is a temporary rise in body temperature that helps your body fight the germs causing illness.
fact_tl: Ang lagnat ay pansamantalang pagtaas ng temperatura ng katawan na tumutulong labanan ang mga mikrobyong nagdudulot ng sakit.
fact_bis: Ang hilanat usa ka temporaryo nga pagsaka sa temperatura sa lawas nga makatabang pagpakig-away sa mga mikrobyo nga hinungdan sa sakit.

q: Which mineral helps your blood carry oxygen around your body?
options: Calcium
Magnesium
Zinc
Iron
explanation: Iron helps your blood carry oxygen around the body, while calcium is the mineral that makes bones strong.
fact_tl: Parehong mineral ang calcium at iron, pero magkaiba ang trabaho nila. Ang calcium ang nagpapatibay sa buto, habang ang iron naman ay tumutulong sa dugo na magdala ng oxygen sa buong katawan. Kailangan mo silang dalawa.
fact_bis: Parehong mineral ang calcium ug iron, apan lahi ang ilang trabaho. Ang calcium maoy makapalig-on sa bukog, samtang ang iron motabang sa dugo nga magdala og oxygen sa tibuok lawas. Kinahanglan nimo silang duha.

q: What is the local name of Pagsanjan Falls in Laguna?
options: Tinago Falls
Aliwagwag Falls
Magdapio Falls
Catarata Falls
explanation: Pagsanjan Falls in Laguna is also known by its local name, Magdapio Falls.
fact_tl: Ang Pagsanjan Falls sa Laguna ay tinatawag din sa lokal na pangalan na Magdapio Falls.
fact_bis: Ang Pagsanjan Falls sa Laguna nailhan usab sa lokal nga ngalan niini nga Magdapio Falls.

q: Which statement best describes a compound like salt?
options: It always has the same fixed amount of each element joined together
Its elements can vary depending on how hot or cold it is
It can be separated easily by stirring it in water
It is made of only one type of element
explanation: A compound like salt always has a fixed, exact amount of the elements joined together.
fact_tl: Ang compound tulad ng asin ay may tiyak at laging-parehong dami ng mga elemento na pinagsama.
fact_bis: Ang compound sama sa asin kanunay adunay piho ug parehas nga gidaghanon sa mga elemento nga gihiusa.

q: How does heat move through a solid object by conduction?
options: Heat jumps across empty spaces between particles
Hot, vibrating particles bump into the cooler particles next to them
Particles travel in circles carrying heat from one end to the other
The solid melts and liquid carries the heat through
explanation: In conduction, heat passes along as hot, vibrating particles bump into the cooler particles next to them.
fact_tl: Sa kondaksyon, naipapasa ang init habang ang mga mainit na partikulo ay nayayanig at nababangga ang mga katabi nito.
fact_bis: Sa kondaksyon, mapasa ang init samtang ang init nga mga partikulo molihok ug mobangga sa mga katupad niini.

q: Why do you get better at a skill the more you practice it?
options: Your muscles memorize the movement so your brain no longer has to work
The connections between brain cells grow stronger with repeated practice
Extra blood flows to your fingers and makes them faster
Your body grows new brain cells each time you repeat an action
explanation: When you do something over and over, the connections between brain cells grow stronger, which is why practice improves your skills.
fact_tl: Kapag paulit-ulit mong ginagawa ang isang bagay — gaya ng pagbasa o pagtugtog — lumalakas ang mga koneksyon sa pagitan ng mga selula ng utak. Kaya nga mas gumagaling ka habang nagpapraktis: hinuhubog mo ang paraan ng pagkontrol ng utak sa iyong katawan.
fact_bis: Kon balik-balikon nimo ang usa ka butang — sama sa pagbasa o pagtugtog — molig-on ang mga koneksyon tali sa mga selula sa utok. Mao nga mas mohusay ka samtang nagpraktis: gihulma nimo ang paagi sa pagkontrol sa utok sa imong lawas.

q: Why can the biomass pyramid be inverted in some ocean ecosystems?
options: Large sharks eat so much that they outweigh all smaller animals
Fast-reproducing phytoplankton support a heavier total mass of zooplankton above them
The ocean floor holds more mass than the open water
Zooplankton reproduce slower than phytoplankton so there are fewer of them
explanation: In some ocean ecosystems, fast-reproducing phytoplankton support a heavier total mass of zooplankton, creating an inverted biomass pyramid.
fact_tl: Sa ilang ekosistema sa karagatan, ang piramide ng biomass ay maaaring maging nakabaliktad dahil ang mabilis na nagpaparaming phytoplankton ay sinusuportahan ang mas mabigat na zooplankton.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka ecosystem sa dagat, ang biomass pyramid mahimong nabaliktad tungod kay ang paspas nga nagpadaghan nga phytoplankton nagsuporta sa mas bug-at nga ukab-ukab nga zooplankton.

q: What type of energy does a battery use to produce a steady electric current?
options: Solar energy
Nuclear energy
Chemical energy
Mechanical energy
explanation: A battery uses chemical energy to provide a steady voltage that drives a steady direct current around a circuit.
fact_tl: Ang baterya ay gumagamit ng kemikal na enerhiya upang magbigay ng tuluy-tuloy na boltahe na nagtutulak ng tuluy-tuloy na current sa isang sirkito.
fact_bis: Ang baterya naggamit ug kemikal nga enerhiya aron mohatag ug padayon nga boltahe nga nagtulod ug padayon nga current sa usa ka sirkito.

q: What is the best way to prevent mosquito-borne diseases like dengue?
options: Wear long sleeves only when sleeping at night
Remove stagnant water where mosquitoes lay their eggs
Spray plants with water each morning to keep mosquitoes away
Keep windows open so fresh air drives mosquitoes out
explanation: Mosquitoes that carry diseases like dengue lay their eggs in stagnant water, so removing it reduces the risk of disease.
fact_tl: Ang ilang lamok ay maaaring magdala ng sakit tulad ng dengue, kaya mahalagang alisin ang nakatigil na tubig kung saan sila nangingitlog.
fact_bis: Ang ubang lamok makadala og sakit sama sa dengue, mao nga importante nga kuhaon ang nagtigom nga tubig diin sila mangitlog.

q: What causes a rainbow to appear in the sky?
options: Sunlight bounces off the surface of clouds and changes color
Sunlight splits into seven colors as it passes through raindrops
The moon reflects colored light back toward Earth after a storm
Hot air above the ground bends sunlight into an arc of colors
explanation: A rainbow forms when sunlight splits into its seven colors as it passes through raindrops.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag ang liwanag ng Araw ay humahati sa pitong kulay habang dumadaan sa mga patak ng ulan.
fact_bis: Mahimo ang balangaw kung ang kahayag sa Adlaw mabahin sa pito ka kolor samtang moagi sa mga tulo sa ulan.

q: About how long ago did the K-Pg mass extinction wipe out the non-avian dinosaurs?
options: 250 million years ago
100 million years ago
66 million years ago
10 million years ago
explanation: The K-Pg extinction occurred about 66 million years ago and killed the non-avian dinosaurs.
fact_tl: Ang Mundo ay nakaranas ng limang malaking mass extinction sa kasaysayan nito — ang pinaka-kilala ay ang K-Pg extinction na nangyari humigit kumulang 66 milyong taon na ang nakakaraan at nagpatay sa mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta nakasinati og lima ka dagko nga mass extinction sa kasaysayan niini — ang pinaka-bantog mao ang K-Pg extinction mga 66 milyong tuig ang nakaagi nga nagpatay sa mga non-avian nga dinosaur.

q: How do Filipino farmers usually plant sweet potato (kamote)?
options: By planting seeds directly in rows in the soil
By grafting branches onto another root vegetable plant
By pressing whole tubers deep into the ground
By placing stem cuttings (vine pieces) into the soil
explanation: Sweet potato (kamote) is often planted using stem cuttings — a piece of vine is simply placed in the soil rather than using seeds.
fact_tl: Ang kamote ay madalas na itinatanim ng mga magsasakang Pilipino gamit ang mga tangkay (talbos) at hindi buto — putol lang ng baging ang itinatanim sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang kamote kasagarang itanom sa mga mag-uumang Pilipino gamit ang mga punoan (talbos) ug dili liso — putol lang sa baging ang itanom sa yuta.

q: Which simple machine is a screw based on?
options: A lever
A pulley
An inclined plane
A wedge
explanation: A screw is really an inclined plane that has been wound around a rod, which is why it has a spiral thread.
fact_tl: Ang screw (tornilyo) ay talagang isang inclined plane na pinaikot at binalot sa isang baras (kaya may spiral na guhit).
fact_bis: Ang screw (tornilyo) tinuod nga usa ka inclined plane nga gilikos sa usa ka baras (mao nga adunay spiral nga linya).

q: What does the thick bark on some trees protect them from?
options: Insects that eat leaves and block sunlight
Animals that dig around their roots for water
Fire and extreme heat or cold
Fungi that grow on the trunk during rainy season
explanation: Thick bark on some trees protects them from fire and from extreme heat or cold.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na balat ng ilang puno ay nagbibigay proteksyon laban sa sunog at matinding init o lamig.
