Any two minerals can scratch each other if enough force is applied
The softest mineral, talc, can scratch all other minerals by rubbing fast
Minerals of the same hardness cannot scratch each other under any conditions
explanation: The rule of the Mohs scale is that a harder mineral can scratch a softer one, but the softer one cannot scratch the harder, so almost any mineral can scratch talc.
fact_tl: Ang panuntunan ng Mohs scale ay simple: ang mas matigas na mineral ay kayang gasgasan ang mas malambot, pero hindi kayang gawin ng malambot sa matigas. Kaya kayang gasgasan ng kahit anong mineral ang talc.
fact_bis: Ang lagda sa Mohs scale yano ra: ang mas gahi nga mineral makakalmot sa mas humok, apan ang mas humok dili makakalmot sa mas gahi. Mao nga halos bisan unsang mineral makakalmot sa talc.

q: Why does the carabao enjoy wallowing in water and mud?
options: It is a kind of water buffalo suited to hot, wet places, and wallowing is its natural way to deal with the heat
It needs to soak its hooves daily to prevent them from cracking in dry soil
It uses mud as camouflage to hide from predators in the rice fields
It absorbs water through its skin to stay hydrated instead of drinking
explanation: The carabao is a kind of water buffalo naturally suited to hot, wet places, so wallowing in water is its natural way to deal with the heat.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay isang uri ng water buffalo, kaya likas na mahilig ito sa tubig at putikan. Ang katawan nito ay sanay sa mainit at basang lugar, kaya ang paglublob sa tubig ang natural na paraan nito para harapin ang init.
fact_bis: Ang kalabaw usa ka matang sa water buffalo, busa kinaiyanhon nga mahiligon kini sa tubig ug lapok. Ang lawas niini hapsay sa init ug basa nga dapit, busa ang paglunang sa tubig mao ang natural niini nga paagi sa pag-atubang sa kainit.

q: Why does the Sun's gravity keep all the planets in orbit?
options: The Sun holds more than 99% of all the mass in the solar system, giving it very strong gravity
The Sun's intense heat pushes planets away while gravity pulls them in, creating a balance
The Sun spins so fast that it creates a magnetic field that locks planets in their paths
The Sun is the largest object in the universe, making its gravitational pull the strongest
explanation: The Sun holds more than 99% of all the mass in the solar system, so its gravity is strong enough to keep every planet in orbit around it.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ang may hawak ng higit sa 99% ng kabuuang masa ng solar system, kaya napakalakas ng grabidad nito at dito umiikot ang lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw maoy naghupot sa kapin sa 99% sa tanang masa sa solar system, mao nga kusgan kaayo ang grabidad niini ug niini molibot ang tanang planeta.

q: How can you tell a wasp apart from a bee by looking at its body?
options: A wasp has a slimmer, smoother body with less hair
A wasp has stripes while a bee has no markings at all
A wasp has six legs while a bee has only four legs
A wasp has longer wings that extend past the tip of its body
explanation: Although wasps and bees look alike, a wasp has a slimmer, smoother body with less hair than a bee.
fact_tl: Ang putakti ay hindi bubuyog; bagama't magkamukha, mas makinis at mas kaunti ang balahibo ng katawan ng putakti.
fact_bis: Ang putakti dili putyokan; bisan managsama silag hitsura, ang putakti hamis ug nipis ang lawas ug gamay rag balhibo.

q: What is the key difference between pure water and saltwater, even though both look uniform?
options: Pure water is a single substance, while saltwater is a mix of two different substances dissolved together
Pure water contains minerals while saltwater has had all minerals removed
Pure water is denser than saltwater because it has no dissolved particles
Pure water is a mixture while saltwater is a pure substance because salt strengthens it
explanation: Both look uniform, but pure water is just one substance while saltwater is a homogeneous mixture of two different substances — water and salt — dissolved together.
fact_tl: Madalas mapagkamalan na pare-pareho ang purong sangkap at homogeneous na halo dahil parehong pantay ang itsura. Pero ang purong tubig ay iisang sangkap lang, samantalang ang tubig-asin ay halo ng dalawang magkaibang sangkap na natunaw. Pareho silang pantay tingnan, pero magkaiba ang laman.
fact_bis: Sagad masaypan nga pareho ang lunsay nga sangkap ug homogeneous nga sagol kay pareho silang pantay tan-awon. Apan ang lunsay nga tubig usa ra ka sangkap, samtang ang tubig-asin sagol sa duha ka lainlaing sangkap nga natunaw. Pareho silang pantay tan-awon, apan lahi ang sulod.

q: Besides building strong bones, what else does calcium do in your body?
options: It helps muscles move and contract, including the heartbeat
It helps the lungs expand and take in more oxygen
It helps the stomach break down proteins in food
It helps the eyes focus light onto the retina
explanation: Calcium helps your muscles move and squeeze, and even your heartbeat needs calcium to work properly.
fact_tl: Hindi lang para sa buto ang calcium! Tinutulungan din nito ang iyong mga kalamnan na kumilos at humigpit. Kahit ang tibok ng iyong puso ay nangangailangan ng calcium para gumana nang maayos.
fact_bis: Dili lang para sa bukog ang calcium! Motabang sab kini sa imong mga kaunoran nga molihok ug mokus-og. Bisan ang pitik sa imong kasingkasing nagkinahanglan og calcium aron molihok og maayo.

q: What does a tarsier use its sharp teeth for?
options: To bite and crunch the hard shell of an insect before swallowing it
To gnaw on tree bark to reach the sap underneath
To scrape algae and lichen off of rocks and branches
To tear apart small fruits and peel away tough skin
explanation: The tarsier has sharp teeth that it uses to bite and crunch the hard shell of an insect before swallowing it.
fact_tl: May matatalim na ngipin ang tarsier na ginagamit nito para kagatin at ngatngatin ang matigas na balat ng insekto bago ito lunukin.
fact_bis: Adunay hait nga mga ngipon ang tarsier nga gamiton niini aron paak-on ug usapon ang gahi nga panit sa insekto una kini tulonon.

q: What do fruit bats eat?
options: Fruit and sweet nectar from flowers
Small insects and moths caught in flight
Fish and frogs near rivers and ponds
Seeds and grain found on the ground
explanation: Fruit bats eat fruit and also sip sweet nectar from flowers.
fact_tl: Ang mga paniki na kumakain ng prutas ay sumisipsip din ng matamis na nektar mula sa mga bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mga kabog nga mokaon ug prutas mosuyop usab ug tam-is nga nektar gikan sa mga bulak.

q: How do some leaf insects make themselves look like a real damaged leaf?
options: They have brown edges and fake holes so they look like a leaf that has been nibbled by bugs
They can change their color from green to brown depending on the season
They flatten their bodies completely and cling tightly to bark to disappear
They release a smell that tricks predators into thinking they are a rotting leaf
explanation: Some leaf insects have brown edges and fake holes so they look like a leaf that has been nibbled by bugs, helping them hide from predators.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng ilang leaf insect ay may kayumangging gilid at parang butas para magmukhang dahong kinagat na ng insekto.
fact_bis: Ang ubang leaf insect adunay kayumanggi nga ngilit ug morag lungag aron mahisama sa dahon nga gikaon na sa mga insekto.

q: How long does it take for an animal to regrow a lost body part?
options: Weeks or months of slow growth
Just a few hours after the part is lost
Exactly one full year in most animals
Only a few days if the animal is young
explanation: Regrowing a body part does not happen all at once; it takes weeks or months of slow growth.
fact_tl: Ang pagtubo muli ng bahagi ng katawan ay hindi biglaan kundi unti-unting nangyayari sa loob ng linggo o buwan.
fact_bis: Ang pagtubo pag-usab sa bahin sa lawas dili kalit nga mahitabo kondili hinay-hinay sulod sa mga semana o bulan.

q: Who is especially harmed by secondhand smoke that they breathe in?
options: Children are especially harmed
Only elderly people with existing lung disease
Adults who exercise regularly are most affected
People who already smoke are the only ones harmed
explanation: Secondhand smoke is harmful to health, and it is especially dangerous for children who breathe it in.
fact_tl: Ang usok na nalalanghap ng ibang tao (secondhand smoke) ay nakakasama rin sa kalusugan, lalo na sa mga bata.
fact_bis: Ang aso nga maginhawa sa ubang tawo (secondhand smoke) makadaot usab sa panglawas, ilabi na sa mga bata.

q: What is the job of nervous tissue in the body?
options: To send signals throughout the body from the brain and spinal cord
To carry oxygen and nutrients to every cell in the body
To protect the body by fighting off infections and diseases
To hold organs and other tissues firmly in place
explanation: Nervous tissue is made of neurons and helps send signals throughout the body from the brain and spinal cord.
fact_tl: Ang nervous tissue ay binubuo ng mga neuron at tumutulong na magpadala ng mga signal sa buong katawan mula sa utak at spinal cord.
fact_bis: Ang nervous tissue hinimo sa mga neuron ug nagtabang sa pagpadala sa mga signal sa tibuuk lawas gikan sa utok ug spinal cord.

q: Why do water plants float their leaves on top of the water?
options: To catch sunlight and make their own food through photosynthesis
To stay safe from fish that live deeper in the water
To help them absorb minerals that dissolve only at the surface
To release seeds that can be carried away by the wind
explanation: Water plants float their leaves on top so they can catch sunlight and make their own food from sunlight, water, and air through photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Lumulutang sa ibabaw ang dahon ng halamang-tubig para masinagan ng araw. Tulad ng ibang halaman, gumagawa sila ng sariling pagkain mula sa liwanag ng araw, tubig, at hangin (photosynthesis).
fact_bis: Naglutaw sa ibabaw ang dahon sa tanom sa tubig aron masidlakan sa adlaw. Sama sa ubang tanom, naghimo silag kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw, tubig, ug hangin (photosynthesis).

q: How do rivers help shape the islands of the Philippines over time?
options: They carry mud, sand, and small stones down from mountains and build up flat land and beaches at river mouths
They carve deep valleys into mountains and eventually split islands into two smaller islands
They wash away all the sand and soil from coasts, making the islands slowly shrink
They push volcanic rock outward from the center of the island to create new cliffs
explanation: Rivers carry mud, sand, and small stones down from the mountains toward the sea, and this builds up along banks and river mouths to form the flat land and beaches where people live and farm.
fact_tl: Hindi lang bulkan at plaka ang humuhubog sa isla. Ang mga ilog ay nagdadala ng putik, buhangin, at maliliit na bato mula sa bundok pababa sa dagat. Unti-unti itong naiipon sa mga pampang at bukana ng ilog, kaya nabubuo ang patag na lupa at buhanginan kung saan maraming tao ang nakatira at nagsasaka.
fact_bis: Dili lang bulkan ug plaka ang naghulma sa isla. Ang mga suba magdala og lapok, balas, ug gagmayng bato gikan sa bukid paubos sa dagat. Hinay-hinay kini matipon sa mga daplin ug baba sa suba, busa matukod ang patag nga yuta ug baybayon diin daghang tawo ang nagpuyo ug nagdaro.

q: What country was the scientist Isaac Newton from?
options: England
France
Germany
Italy
explanation: Isaac Newton was an English scientist from England.
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay isang siyentipikong Ingles (taga-England).
fact_bis: Si Isaac Newton usa ka siyentipikong Iningles gikan sa England.

q: Why is white lime added to the betel nut quid when people chew it?
options: It helps release the stimulating substance from the betel nut so the body can absorb it more easily
It whitens the teeth and prevents staining from the dark juice
It makes the mixture taste sweeter and easier to chew
It hardens the betel nut leaf wrapper so it holds its shape
explanation: The white lime in the quid helps release the stimulating substance from the betel nut so the body can absorb it more easily.
fact_tl: Ang puting apog sa nganga ay tumutulong na pakawalan ang sangkap na pampagising mula sa betel nut, para mas madaling masipsip ng katawan. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit kasama ang apog.
fact_bis: Ang puti nga apog sa nganga makatabang sa pagpagawas sa sangkap nga pampukaw gikan sa betel nut, aron mas sayon masuyop sa lawas. Mao kana ang hinungdan nga gidugang ang apog.

q: Why can you sometimes hear a distant train by pressing your ear to the rail or the ground?
options: Solids carry vibrations very well, so sound travels through them easily
Sound echoes off the ground surface much farther than through air
The ground reflects sound waves upward so they are louder at ear level
Your ear is naturally shaped to amplify sounds coming from below
explanation: You can hear distant footsteps or a train by pressing your ear to the ground or a rail because solids carry vibrations well.
fact_tl: Maririnig mo ang tunog ng malayong yapak o tren kung idikit mo ang tainga sa lupa o riles dahil mahusay magpasa ng yanig ang solido.
fact_bis: Madungog nimo ang layo nga yatak o tren kung idikit nimo ang dalunggan sa yuta o riles tungod kay maayo mopasa sa pag-uyog ang gahi.

q: What was Agila-2, launched in 1997?
options: The first Philippine satellite launched into orbit
The first Philippine rocket sent to the Moon
A telescope built by Filipino scientists
A space station used for weather research
explanation: Agila-2 was the first Philippine satellite launched into orbit, in 1997, and was used for communications.
fact_tl: Ang Agila-2 ang unang satelayt ng Pilipinas na inilunsad sa orbit, noong 1997, na ginamit sa komunikasyon.
fact_bis: Ang Agila-2 mao ang unang satelayt sa Pilipinas nga gilusad ngadto sa orbita, niadtong 1997, nga gigamit sa komunikasyon.

q: Why is a singkaban arch light yet strong?
options: Because bamboo is a tall grass with hollow, sturdy stems
Because bamboo is a type of hard tropical wood
Because the arch is made from thin metal wires coated in bamboo
Because bamboo stores water inside solid, dense cores
explanation: Bamboo is a tall grass with hollow, sturdy stems, which makes a singkaban arch both light and strong.
fact_tl: Ang singkaban ay arko na gawa sa kawayan na inuukit upang gumawa ng kulot na hibla; magaan ito ngunit matibay dahil ang kawayan ay malakas na damo na may guwang na tangkay.
fact_bis: Ang singkaban usa ka arko nga hinimo sa kawayan nga gikulit aron makahimo og kulot nga himbis; gaan kini apan lig-on tungod kay ang kawayan usa ka taas nga sagbot nga adunay bakante ug malig-on nga punoan.

q: Where does the carbon in coal and oil originally come from?
options: Plants and animals that died millions of years ago
Minerals dissolved from underground rocks over time
Carbon gas trapped underground from ancient volcanoes
Seawater that slowly hardened under pressure
explanation: Fossil fuels like coal and oil are carbon from plants and animals that died millions of years ago and were buried over time.
fact_tl: Ang mga fossil fuel tulad ng uling at langis ay karbon mula sa mga halaman at hayop na namatay milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang mga fossil fuel sama sa uling ug langis maoy karbon gikan sa mga tanom ug hayop nga namatay milyon-milyon ka tuig kanhi.

q: What flavor does calamansi add when squeezed onto food?
options: A sour, tasty flavor
A sweet, fruity flavor
A spicy, bitter flavor
A salty, savory flavor
explanation: Filipinos squeeze calamansi onto food and dipping sauces to add a sour, tasty flavor.
fact_tl: Pinipiga ang calamansi sa pagkain at sawsawan ng mga Pilipino para magbigay ng maasim at masarap na lasa.
fact_bis: Pugaon sa mga Pilipino ang kalamansi sa pagkaon ug sa sawsawan aron mahatagan og maaslom ug lami nga lasa.

q: How does a swiftlet build its cup-shaped nest without using hands?
options: It uses its mouth to smear saliva layer by layer onto the wall
It weaves dry grass together using only its beak and feet
It mixes mud with feathers and presses them into a cup shape
It glues leaves together using sticky plant resin from trees
explanation: Swiftlets use their mouth to smear saliva layer by layer onto the wall until the cup-shaped nest is formed.
fact_tl: Paano nila nahuhubog ang pugad kung wala silang kamay? Ginagamit ng swiftlet ang bibig nila para ipahid ang laway nang patong-patong sa pader hanggang mabuo ang hugis-tasang pugad.
fact_bis: Unsaon nila paghulma ang salag kung walay kamot? Ang swiftlet maggamit sa ilang baba aron ipahid ang laway sa nagpatong-patong sa bongbong hangtod mahuman ang porma-tasa nga salag.

q: How does PAGASA decide the name for the very first typhoon of the year?
options: It starts with the letter A, since typhoons are named in alphabetical order
It uses the name of the month when the typhoon enters the country
It is named after the most recent major typhoon that struck the Philippines
It is chosen by a public vote held at the start of each year
explanation: PAGASA names typhoons in alphabetical order within the year, so the first typhoon of the year always starts with A.
fact_tl: Pinangangalanan ng PAGASA ang mga bagyo ayon sa alpabeto sa loob ng taon, kaya ang unang bagyo ay nagsisimula sa A.
fact_bis: Ginganlan sa PAGASA ang mga bagyo subay sa alpabeto sulod sa tuig, mao nga ang unang bagyo magsugod sa A.

q: Why is the tip of the shadow on a sundial blurry and hard to read exactly?
options: Because of the penumbra, which is the soft, partly-lit edge of a shadow
Because sunlight is too bright and overexposes the surface of the sundial
Because the rod on a sundial is always slightly bent out of position
Because shadows are always moving and never stay still long enough
explanation: Because of the penumbra (the partially lit, blurry outer edge of a shadow), the tip of the sundial's shadow is not sharp, making the exact time a little hard to read.
fact_tl: Sa orasan ng araw o sundial, ang anino ng patpat ang nagtuturo ng oras. Dahil sa penumbra, malabo ang dulo ng anino, kaya minsan mahirap basahin nang eksakto ang oras.
fact_bis: Sa orasan sa adlaw o sundial, ang landong sa patpat maoy nagtudlo sa oras. Tungod sa penumbra, hanap ang tumoy sa landong, mao nga usahay lisod basahon ang eksaktong oras.

q: What do ants receive from aphids in exchange for guarding them?
options: Sweet honeydew that the aphids produce
Tiny eggs that the ants hatch and raise
Wax the aphids make from plant sap
Silk threads for building the ant colony
explanation: Ants guard and protect aphids, and in return the ants collect the sweet honeydew the aphids produce — a mutualistic relationship.
fact_tl: May mga langgam na binabantayan at pinoprotektahan ang maliliit na aphid sa halaman; bilang kapalit, kumukuha ang langgam ng matamis na katas na inilalabas ng aphid.
fact_bis: Adunay mga hulmigas nga magbantay ug manalipod sa gagmay nga aphid sa tanom; baylo niini, mokuha ang hulmigas sa tam-is nga katas nga gibuga sa aphid.

q: Where does a kangaroo's tiny newborn baby continue to grow after birth?
options: Inside its mother's pouch
In a nest made of grass and leaves
Attached to the mother's back fur
In a burrow dug underground
explanation: A kangaroo gives birth to a very tiny baby that keeps growing inside its mother's pouch.
fact_tl: Ang kangaroo ay nanganganak ng napakaliit na anak na lumalaki pa sa bulsa ng ina nito.
fact_bis: Ang kangaroo manganak ug gamay kaayo nga anak nga motubo pa sa puyo sa iyang inahan.

q: Where in the Philippines is the Asian koel commonly heard?
options: In trees in villages and towns
Deep inside rainforest caves
On open beaches near the sea
Underground in rice paddies
explanation: The Asian koel is found in the Philippines and is often heard in trees in villages and towns.
fact_tl: Matatagpuan ang Asian koel sa Pilipinas at madalas itong naririnig sa mga puno sa baryo at lungsod.
fact_bis: Ang Asian koel makit-an sa Pilipinas ug sagad madungog sa mga kahoy sa baryo ug lungsod.

q: What is the capital city of Greece?
options: Athens
Sparta
Thessaloniki
Corinth
explanation: The capital of Greece is Athens.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Greece (Gresya) ay Athens.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Greece (Gresya) mao ang Athens.

q: Who is credited with pioneering the radio?
options: Guglielmo Marconi
Thomas Edison
Nikola Tesla
Alexander Graham Bell
explanation: The radio was pioneered by Guglielmo Marconi.
fact_tl: Ang radyo ay binuo ni Guglielmo Marconi.
fact_bis: Ang radyo gimugna ni Guglielmo Marconi.

q: About how often can people on Earth see Halley's Comet pass by?
options: Every 76 years
Every 12 years
Every 365 days
Every 1,000 years
explanation: Halley's Comet can be seen from Earth about every 76 years.
fact_tl: Ang Halley's Comet ay nakikita mula sa Earth tuwing humigit-kumulang 76 na taon.
fact_bis: Ang Halley's Comet makita gikan sa Yuta matag mga 76 ka tuig.

q: How do sponges compete with corals for space on a reef?
options: Sponges may release chemicals to slow coral growth nearby
Sponges grow faster and physically push corals off the reef wall
Sponges block sunlight from reaching corals underneath them
Sponges eat the tiny polyps that form the coral structure
explanation: Sponges may use chemicals to slow coral growth nearby, while corals defend space by extending tentacles at night to attack competitors.
fact_tl: Sa coral reef, ang mga coral at espongha ay nagkukumpitensya para sa espasyo — ang mga espongha ay maaaring gumamit ng kemikal upang pabagalin ang paglaki ng coral sa kalapit, at ang mga coral naman ay nagtatago ng espasyo sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalaki ng mga tentakulo sa gabi upang atakuhin ang mga kakumpitensya.
fact_bis: Sa coral reef, ang mga coral ug espongha nagkumpitensya sa espasyo — ang mga espongha mahimong gamiton ang mga kemikal aron mapabagal ang pagtubo sa coral sa duol, samtang ang mga coral nagpanalipod sa espasyo pinaagi sa pagpalapad og mga tentakulo sa gabii aron makatake sa mga kakumpitensya.

q: What is the body of water found to the west of the Philippines?
options: The South China Sea, also called the West Philippine Sea
The Pacific Ocean
The Sulu Sea
The Celebes Sea
explanation: To the west of the Philippines is the South China Sea, which is also called the West Philippine Sea.
fact_tl: Sa kanluran ng Pilipinas ay ang South China Sea, na tinatawag ding West Philippine Sea.
fact_bis: Sa kasadpan sa Pilipinas mao ang South China Sea, nga gitawag usab nga West Philippine Sea.

q: How many protons does an atom of iron (Fe) have?
explanation: The atomic number of iron (Fe) is 26, meaning each iron atom has 26 protons.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng iron (bakal, Fe) ay 26, kaya may 26 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa iron (puthaw, Fe) kay 26, mao nga naa kini 26 ka proton.

q: How many floors does the Burj Khalifa have?
explanation: The Burj Khalifa has 163 floors, making it one of the tallest buildings in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Burj Khalifa ay may 163 na palapag.
fact_bis: Ang Burj Khalifa adunay 163 ka andana (floors).

q: How do most jellyfish sense their surroundings even though they have no real eyes?
options: They have simple light-sensing spots on their body
They use vibrations in the water to find their way
They detect chemicals dissolved in the seawater
They feel changes in water pressure with their tentacles
explanation: Most jellyfish have no real eyes, but they have simple spots that can sense light.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng dikya ay walang tunay na mata, ngunit may simpleng bahagi na nakakaramdam ng liwanag.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa dikya walay tinuod nga mata, apan naa'y yano nga bahin nga makabati sa kahayag.

q: What does a seismograph specifically measure?
options: The shaking of the ground
The temperature of the earth's crust
The weight of rocks in an area
The amount of rainfall during a storm
explanation: A seismograph is a measuring tool made just for detecting the shaking of the ground, just as a thermometer measures heat.
fact_tl: Tulad ng thermometer na sumusukat sa init at timbangan na sumusukat sa bigat, ang seismograph naman ay isang panukat na para lang sa pagyanig ng lupa; bawat instrumento ay may sariling tanging sinusukat.
fact_bis: Sama sa thermometer nga magsukod sa kainit ug timbangan nga magsukod sa gibug-aton, ang seismograph usa ka sukoranan nga alang lang sa pag-uyog sa yuta; matag instrumento adunay kaugalingong butang nga gisukod.

q: What are two main uses of the kakawate (madre de cacao) tree?
options: Firewood and feeding animals
Building houses and making medicine
Cooking oil and making rope
Shade for rice fields and cleaning water
explanation: The kakawate or madre de cacao is a fast-growing tree used for firewood and feeding animals.
fact_tl: Ang kakawate o madre de cacao ay isa pang mabilis tumubong puno na ginagamit sa panggatong at pagpapakain ng hayop.
fact_bis: Ang kakawate o madre de cacao usa pa ka paspas motubo nga kahoy nga gigamit sa sugnod ug pagpakaon sa hayop.

q: What makes swifts remarkable compared to other birds?
options: They are among the fastest birds when flying straight ahead
They can hover in one spot longer than any other bird
They migrate farther than any other bird species
They have the largest wingspan relative to their body size
explanation: Swifts are among the fastest birds when flying straight ahead in the sky.
fact_tl: Ang mga swift ay kabilang sa pinakamabilis na ibon kapag tuwid silang lumilipad sa langit.
fact_bis: Ang mga balinsasayaw kauban sa pinakapaspas nga langgam kon tul-id silang naglupad sa langit.

q: What happens in a group of clownfish when the female dies?
options: The largest male changes and becomes female
The group disperses and each fish finds a new group
A younger fish instantly grows larger to become the new leader
The remaining males compete until one drives the others away
explanation: In a group of clownfish, if the female dies, the largest male changes and becomes female — a rare ability in animals.
fact_tl: Sa isang pangkat ng clownfish, ang pinakamalaking isda ay laging babae. Kapag namatay ang babae, ang pinakamalaking lalaki ay nagbabago at nagiging babae — kakaibang kakayahan na bihira sa hayop.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka grupo sa clownfish, ang pinakadako nga isda kanunay baye. Kon mamatay ang baye, ang pinakadako nga laki mausab ug mahimong baye — talagsaon nga abilidad nga panagsa ra sa mga hayop.

q: What is a pyroclastic flow?
options: A very hot cloud of ash and gas that rushes rapidly down a volcano
A slow-moving river of liquid lava that hardens on the slopes
A massive wave of water caused by an underwater eruption
A loud explosion of rock fragments blasted upward from a crater
explanation: A pyroclastic flow is a very hot cloud of ash and gas that rushes down a volcano very fast and is extremely dangerous.
fact_tl: Ang pyroclastic flow ay isang napakainit na ulap ng abo at gas na mabilis na dumadaloy pababa ng bulkan at napakapanganib.
fact_bis: Ang pyroclastic flow usa ka init kaayo nga panganod sa abo ug gas nga paspas nga modagayday paubos sa bulkan ug delikado kaayo.

q: Which cells in the blood help fight off germs that cause sickness?
options: White blood cells
Red blood cells
Platelets
Plasma cells
explanation: White blood cells help fight off germs that cause sickness.
fact_tl: Ang mga puting selula ng dugo ay tumutulong na labanan ang mga mikrobyo na nagdadala ng sakit.
fact_bis: Ang puti nga mga selula sa dugo motabang sa pagpakig-away sa mga mikrobyo nga maoy hinungdan sa sakit.

q: When you use a ramp to move something heavy, what is the trade-off?
options: You use less force, but you must move the load over a longer distance
You use more force, but the load travels a shorter distance
You use the same force, but the load moves much faster
You use less force, and the load also travels a shorter distance
explanation: A ramp (inclined plane) lets you use less force, but you must move the load over a longer distance.
fact_tl: Mas magaan ang itinutulak sa dahilig, pero kailangan mong itulak ito sa mas mahabang distansya.
fact_bis: Ang banghilig nagahatag og mas gamay nga kusog, apan kinahanglan nimong itulod kini sa mas layo nga gilay-on.

q: What is deceleration also called in science?
options: Negative acceleration
Zero velocity
Kinetic friction
Terminal force
explanation: When an object slows down, the force acts opposite to its motion, so this is called deceleration or negative acceleration.
fact_tl: Kapag bumabagal ang isang bagay, may aselerasyon pa rin ito ngunit nakaturo ang puwersa pabaligtad sa galaw, kaya tinatawag itong deceleration o negatibong aselerasyon.
fact_bis: Kung mohinay ang usa ka butang naa pa gihapon kini aselerasyon apan ang kusog nagtumong batok sa lihok niini, busa gitawag kini nga deceleration o negatibong aselerasyon.

q: Which element is the heaviest natural element found on Earth?
options: Uranium (element 92)
Gold (element 79)
Lead (element 82)
Plutonium (element 94)
explanation: Uranium (U), element number 92, is the heaviest natural element.
fact_tl: Ang uranium (U), elemento numero 92, ang pinakamabigat na likas na elemento.
fact_bis: Ang uranium (U), elemento numero 92, maoy kinabug-atang natural nga elemento.

q: Which recycling code is found on HDPE plastic items like shampoo bottles and milk jugs?
options: Code 2
Code 1
Code 5
Code 7
explanation: HDPE (high-density polyethylene) has recycling code 2 and is commonly recycled; it is used for thick containers like shampoo bottles, milk jugs, and pipes.
fact_tl: Ang HDPE (high-density polyethylene) ay ginagamit para sa makapal na plastic containers tulad ng bote ng shampoo at PVC pipes; ito ay may recycling code 2.
fact_bis: Ang HDPE (high-density polyethylene) gigamit alang sa baga nga plastic containers sama sa bote sa shampoo, ug mga tubo; adunay recycling code 2 ug kasagaran na-recycle.

q: Which type of earthquake is usually felt more strongly at the surface, even with the same magnitude?
options: A shallow earthquake (less than 70 km deep)
A deep earthquake (more than 300 km deep)
A mid-depth earthquake (about 200 km deep)
All earthquakes are felt equally regardless of depth
explanation: Shallow earthquakes (less than 70 km deep) are usually felt more strongly at the surface than deep ones because they are closer to where people live.
fact_tl: Ang focus (hypocenter) ng lindol ay ang aktwal na lugar sa loob ng Earth kung saan nagsimula ang pagyanig; ang mga mababaw na lindol (mas mababa sa 70 km) ay karaniwang mas nakararamdaman sa ibabaw kaysa mga malalim (hanggang 700 km) kahit may parehong magnitude.
fact_bis: Ang focus (hypocenter) sa lindol mao ang aktuwal nga punto sulod sa Yuta diin nagsugod ang pagyanig; ang mga mababaw nga lindol (ubos sa 70 km) kasagaran mas maramdam sa ibabaw kaysa mga lawom (hangtod 700 km) bisan sama ang magnitude.

q: How can a citizen help fix a broken street light or a clogged drain in their community?
options: Report it to the barangay so it gets fixed
Wait for a government worker to notice the problem
Post about it on social media and hope officials see it
File a formal complaint with the national government
explanation: Reporting community problems to the barangay is one practical way a citizen's voice can help get things fixed.
fact_tl: Isang paraan ng pagtulong ay ang pagsasalita: kung may sirang ilaw sa kalye o baradong kanal, maaari mong iulat ito sa barangay para maaksyunan—boses din ng mamamayan ang tumutulong.
fact_bis: Usa ka paagi sa pagtabang mao ang pagsulti: kung adunay guba nga suga sa dalan o bara nga kanal, mahimo nimo kining i-report sa barangay aron maaksyunan—ang tingog sa lungsuranon makatabang usab.

q: Which of these is NOT listed as a way bats help nature?
options: Building dams to control water flow
Spreading seeds
Controlling pests
Pollination
explanation: Bats help with pollination, spreading seeds, and controlling pests — they do not build dams.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang mga paniki sa kalikasan dahil tumutulong sila sa polinasyon, pagkalat ng buto, at pagkontrol ng peste.
fact_bis: Importante ang mga kabog sa kinaiyahan kay makatabang sila sa polinasyon, pagsabwag sa liso, ug pagpugong sa peste.

q: Why could a person not breathe on the planet Mercury?
options: Mercury's atmosphere is so thin there is almost no air
Mercury's air is made of pure carbon dioxide, which is poisonous
Mercury is too hot for any gases to exist near its surface
Mercury is too far from the Sun to hold any atmosphere
explanation: Mercury has almost no air — its atmosphere is so thin that a person could not breathe there.
fact_tl: Halos walang hangin ang Mercury — napakanipis nito kaya hindi makahinga ang tao roon.
fact_bis: Halos walay hangin ang Mercury — nipis kaayo kini maong dili makaginhawa ang tawo didto.

q: What happens to a star like the Sun when it grows very old?
options: It swells up and turns reddish as its surface cools, becoming a red giant
It shrinks and turns blue as its core heats up rapidly
It explodes immediately and disappears from view
It stays the same size but gradually fades to white
explanation: When a star like the Sun grows very old, it swells up and its surface cools, turning reddish — this stage is called a red giant.
fact_tl: Maaaring magbago ang kulay ng bituin habang tumatanda ito. Halimbawa, kapag matandang-matanda na ang isang bituin tulad ng Araw, lalaki ito at lalamig ang ibabaw, kaya magiging mapula ('red giant'). Kaya ang kulay ay maaari ding magpahiwatig ng yugto ng buhay ng isang bituin.
fact_bis: Mahimong mausab ang kolor sa bituon samtang motigulang kini. Pananglitan, kung tigulang na kaayo ang bituon sama sa Adlaw, mohubag kini ug mobugnaw ang nawong, mao nga mahimong mapula ('red giant'). Mao nga ang kolor mahimo pud magpasabot sa yugto sa kinabuhi sa bituon.

q: Where in the solar system is the asteroid belt located?
options: Between Mars and Jupiter
Between Earth and Mars
Between Jupiter and Saturn
Between Saturn and Uranus
explanation: The asteroid belt is located between Mars and Jupiter.
fact_tl: Ang asteroid belt ay matatagpuan sa pagitan ng Mars at Jupiter.
fact_bis: Ang asteroid belt makit-an sa tunga-tunga sa Mars ug Jupiter.

q: In the 3 R's (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle), which step is considered the strongest or most important?
options: Reduce, because it is better not to create extra waste in the first place
Recycle, because turning waste into new products removes it entirely
Reuse, because using things again is easier than buying new items
All three steps are equally important and cannot be ranked
explanation: "Reduce" comes first in the 3 R's because it's better not to create extra waste in the first place — recycling helps, but using less is the strongest step.
fact_tl: Sa 3 R's, ang "Reduce" ang nauuna bago ang "Recycle" dahil mas mabuti kung hindi na tayo gumawa ng sobrang basura mula sa simula — ang recycling ay tumutulong, pero ang pinakamabisang paraan ay ang bawasan muna ang paggamit.
fact_bis: Sa 3 R's, ang "Reduce" mag-una sa "Recycle" kay mas maayo nga dili na maghimo og sobra nga basura sukad sa sinugdan — ang recycling makatabang, apan ang pinakaepektibo nga paagi mao ang paggamit og gamay sa sinugdan.

q: How is travelling between islands in the Philippines different from moving between regions in a large country like China?
options: You need a boat or plane to cross between Philippine islands, unlike in China where you can walk across land
You must have a passport to travel between Philippine islands, just like crossing international borders
Philippine islands are larger than Chinese provinces, making travel take longer
Island travel in the Philippines is faster because ferries are faster than trains
explanation: The Philippines is surrounded by water and made of many separate islands, so you need a boat or plane to cross between them, unlike a connected landmass like China.
fact_tl: Ang isang bansang isla tulad ng Pilipinas ay napapaligiran ng tubig at binubuo ng maraming hiwalay na lupa. Kaiba ito sa isang bansang nasa kontinente, tulad ng Tsina, na isang malaking magkakadikit na lupain na maaari mong lakarin papunta sa kalapit na bansa. Sa Pilipinas, kailangan ng bangka o eroplano para tumawid sa pagitan ng mga isla.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka nasod nga isla sama sa Pilipinas gilibotan sa tubig ug gilangkuban sa daghang bulag nga yuta. Lahi kini sa usa ka nasod nga naa sa kontinente, sama sa Tsina, nga usa ka dakong nagdikit nga yuta nga malakaw nimo padulong sa silingang nasod. Sa Pilipinas, kinahanglan og sakayan o eroplano aron motabok tali sa mga isla.

q: Which type of earthquake wave cannot pass through the liquid outer core of the Earth?
options: S-waves (secondary waves)
P-waves (primary waves)
Surface waves
Compression waves
explanation: S-waves (secondary waves) are shear waves that cannot pass through Earth's liquid outer core, unlike P-waves which travel through any material.
fact_tl: Ang P-waves (primary waves) ay compression waves na mas mabilis at dumadaan sa lahat ng materyales; ang S-waves (secondary waves) ay shear waves na mas mabagal at hindi tumatawid sa likidong outer core ng Earth; ang pagkakaiba ng oras ng pagtakas ng dalawang wave ay nagpapahintulot sa mga siyentipiko na kalkulahin ang distansya ng lindol.
fact_bis: Ang P-waves (primary waves) mga compression wave nga mas paspas ug moagi sa bisan unsa nga materyales; ang S-waves (secondary waves) mga shear wave nga mas hinay ug dili makaabot sa liquid outer core sa Yuta; ang pagkalain sa oras sa pag-abot sa duha ka wave nagtugot sa mga siyentipiko sa pagkalkula sa gilay-on sa lindol.

q: Why does even the closest galaxy look like just a dim, fuzzy spot to the naked eye?
options: Because other galaxies are so far away that we cannot see them clearly without a telescope
Because galaxies do not produce their own light and only reflect starlight
Because the atmosphere bends and scatters galactic light before it reaches us
Because our eyes can only detect light from objects inside our own solar system
explanation: Other galaxies are so far away that even the closest one looks like a dim, fuzzy spot to the naked eye, and a telescope is needed to see it more clearly.
fact_tl: Napakalayo ng ibang galaxy kaya kahit ang pinakamalapit sa kanila ay mukhang isang malabong batik lamang sa mata, at kailangan ng teleskopyo para makita nang mas malinaw.
fact_bis: Layo kaayo ang ubang galaxy mao nga bisan ang labing duol kanila morag hanap nga tulbok lang sa mata, ug kinahanglan og teleskopyo aron makita kini nga mas tin-aw.

q: How can you tell a resting butterfly apart from a resting moth just by looking at its wings?
options: A butterfly holds its wings up together, while a moth lays its wings flat
A butterfly spreads its wings flat, while a moth folds them up tightly
A butterfly closes its wings under its body, while a moth raises them high
Both butterflies and moths always hold their wings in the exact same position
explanation: When resting, a butterfly holds its wings up together, while a moth lays its wings flat over its back.
fact_tl: Kapag nagpapahinga, itinataas ng paru-paro ang pakpak nito nang magkadikit, samantalang ibinababa ng gamu-gamo ang pakpak nang lapat sa likod.
fact_bis: Kung magpahulay, ang alibangbang mopataas sa pako niini nga magdikit, samtang ang anunugba mopahaluna sa pako nga patag sa likod.

q: Why is the continental shelf the most productive fishing zone in the ocean?
options: Sunlight and nutrients can reach all of it because it is shallow
Deep cold water rises to the shelf and brings rich mineral deposits
The shelf is close to human settlements, so more fish swim there
Fish prefer flat surfaces, and the shelf is the flattest part of the ocean
explanation: The continental shelf is shallow (usually less than 200 metres deep), so sunlight and nutrients can reach all of it, making it the most productive fishing zone.
fact_tl: Ang continental shelf ay isang mababaw na bahagi ng ocean floor (karaniwang hindi hihigit sa 200 metro ang lalim) sa paligid ng mga kontinente at pulo; ang mga salmón (light) at sustansya ay maaaring makarating sa lahat ng dako ng shelf, kaya ito ang pinaka-produktibong lugar ng mangingisda; ang Pilipinas ay may malawak na continental shelf na nagbibigay ng mahalagang lugar ng pangingisda.
fact_bis: Ang continental shelf mao ang mabaw nga bahin sa ocean floor (kasagaran ubos sa 200 metro ang giladmon) sa palibot sa mga kontinente ug pulo; ang adlaw ug mga sustansya makaabot sa tanan niini, naghimo niini ingon nga pinaka-produktibong lugar sa pangisda; ang Pilipinas adunay halapad nga continental shelf nga naghatag og importante nga mga lugar sa pangisda.

q: What is the capital city of the Philippines, and on which island is it located?
options: Manila, on the island of Luzon
Cebu City, on the island of Cebu
Davao City, on the island of Mindanao
Quezon City, on the island of Palawan
explanation: The capital of the Philippines is Manila, found on the island of Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera (kapital) ng Pilipinas ay ang Maynila, na nasa isla ng Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang kaulohan (kapital) sa Pilipinas mao ang Manila, nga naa sa pulo sa Luzon.

q: How old is the horseshoe crab's family compared to the dinosaurs?
options: Horseshoe crab ancestors lived in the oceans even before the dinosaurs appeared
Horseshoe crabs and dinosaurs evolved at exactly the same time
Horseshoe crabs appeared long after the dinosaurs went extinct
Horseshoe crabs are a modern species with no ancient fossil relatives
explanation: Ancestors of horseshoe crabs were living in the oceans even before the dinosaurs appeared, making them an ancient lineage.
fact_tl: Mga ninuno ng horseshoe crab ay nabuhay na sa karagatan bago pa lumitaw ang mga dinosauryo.
fact_bis: Ang mga katigulangan sa horseshoe crab nabuhi na sa kadagatan bisan sa wala pa motungha ang mga dinosauryo.

q: Why is an insulator unable to conduct electricity?
options: Its electrons are tightly held and cannot move freely
It has too many electrons crowded together to form a current
It repels electric current with a built-in magnetic field
It absorbs electricity and converts it into heat immediately
explanation: An insulator does not conduct electricity because its electrons are tightly held and cannot move freely.
fact_tl: Hindi nagpapadaloy ng kuryente ang insulador dahil mahigpit na nakakabit ang mga elektron nito at hindi makagalaw.
fact_bis: Ang insulador dili magpaagi sa kuryente kay ang mga elektron niini hugot nga nakagakos ug dili makalihok.

q: What is the capital city of Laos?
options: Vientiane
Luang Prabang
Phnom Penh
Yangon
explanation: The capital of Laos is Vientiane.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Laos ay Vientiane.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Laos mao ang Vientiane.

q: What happens during the process of pasteurization?
options: Milk or juice is heated just enough to kill harmful bacteria without ruining the flavor
Milk is frozen solid to stop all bacteria from reproducing in it
Juice is filtered through a fine screen to remove bacteria physically
Milk is mixed with a small amount of chemicals that kill germs on contact
explanation: In pasteurization, milk or juice is heated just enough to kill harmful bacteria without ruining the flavor, making it safer and longer-lasting.
fact_tl: Sa pasteurization, ipinipinit nang sapat ang gatas o juice para patayin ang mga nakakasamang bakterya nang hindi nasisira ang lasa, kaya nagiging mas ligtas at mas tumatagal ito.
fact_bis: Sa pasteurization, init-initan ang gatas o juice og igo aron patyon ang makadaot nga bakterya nga dili madaot ang lami, mao nga mahimo kining mas luwas ug mas dugay.

q: Who developed the first effective vaccine against polio?
options: Jonas Salk
Louis Pasteur
Edward Jenner
Albert Sabin
explanation: Jonas Salk developed the first effective vaccine against polio.
fact_tl: Si Jonas Salk ang gumawa ng unang epektibong bakuna laban sa polio (polyo).
fact_bis: Si Jonas Salk ang naghimo sa unang epektibo nga bakuna batok sa polio (polyo).

q: Which famous Philippine variety of durian is known for having thick flesh?
options: Puyat
Sultan
Arancillo
explanation: In the Philippines, one famous kind of durian is the Puyat, which is known for having thick flesh — not all durians are the same.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng durian, at magkakaiba ang lasa, kulay ng laman, at laki nito. Sa Pilipinas, ang isang sikat na uri ay ang Puyat na may makapal na laman. Kaya hindi lahat ng durian ay pareho.
fact_bis: Adunay lainlaing klase sa durian, ug magkalahi ang lami, kolor sa unod, ug gidak-on niini. Sa Pilipinas, usa ka bantog nga klase mao ang Puyat nga adunay baga nga unod. Busa dili tanang durian managsama.

q: How do the surface temperatures of red stars and blue stars compare?
options: Red stars are around 3,000 °C, while blue stars can be hotter than 25,000 °C
Red stars are hotter than blue stars because red light carries more energy
Both red and blue stars have the same surface temperature of about 10,000 °C
Blue stars are cooler because their energy is released more slowly over time
explanation: Red stars are around 3,000 °C, while blue stars can be hotter than 25,000 °C at the surface — color tells us about temperature.
fact_tl: Ang mga pulang bituin ay umaabot sa mga 3,000 °C, samantalang ang mga asul na bituin ay maaaring lumampas sa 25,000 °C sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga mga bituon kay mga 3,000 °C, samtang ang asul nga mga bituon mahimong sobra sa 25,000 °C sa ibabaw.

q: What does the ozone layer in the stratosphere protect life on Earth from?
options: The Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation
Meteorites falling from outer space
Radio waves sent by satellites
Extreme cold temperatures from space
explanation: The ozone layer, found in the stratosphere about 15 to 35 kilometres up, protects living things on Earth's surface by absorbing most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
fact_tl: Ang ozone layer ay matatagpuan sa stratosphere ng Earth (humigit-kumulang 15 hanggang 35 kilometro ang taas); nagtatanggol ito ng mga nabubuhay na bagay sa ibabaw ng Earth mula sa nakakapinsalang ultraviolet (UV) radiation ng Araw sa pamamagitan ng pagsagap ng karamihan ng UV light.
fact_bis: Ang ozone layer makita sa stratosphere sa Yuta (mga 15 hangtod 35 kilometro ang gitas-on); nagpanalipod kini sa mga buhi nga mga butang sa nawong sa Yuta gikan sa makadaot nga ultraviolet (UV) radiation sa Adlaw pinaagi sa pagsuyop sa kadaghanan sa UV light sa wala pa kini makaabut sa yuta.

q: What do decomposers do with the nitrogen found in dead plants and animals?
options: They break down the remains and return the nitrogen to the soil
They trap the nitrogen in their own bodies and keep it out of the soil
They release the nitrogen as a gas that floats up into the atmosphere
They convert the nitrogen into oxygen that plants and animals can breathe
explanation: When plants and animals die, decomposers break down their remains and return the nitrogen to the soil, making it available again.
fact_tl: Kapag namatay ang mga halaman at hayop, binubulok ng mga decomposer ang kanilang mga labi at ibinabalik ang nitrogen sa lupa.
fact_bis: Kon mamatay ang mga tanom ug hayop, gibungkag sa mga decomposer ang ilang mga salin ug giuli ang nitroheno sa yuta.

q: What do people do in selective breeding to pass desired traits to the next generation?
options: They choose parents that have the traits they want and breed them together
They inject vitamins into newborn animals to strengthen the traits
They remove animals with unwanted traits from the wild so they cannot reproduce
They wait for random mutations to create new traits on their own
explanation: In selective breeding, people choose parents with desired traits so those traits are inherited by the next generation.
fact_tl: Sa selective breeding, pinipili ng tao ang mga magulang na may ninanais na katangian upang maipasa ang mga ito sa susunod na henerasyon.
fact_bis: Sa selective breeding, ang mga tawo magpili sa mga ginikanan nga adunay gusto nga kinaiya aron kini ipasa sa sunod nga henerasyon.

q: Why do the planets keep moving around the Sun instead of flying off into space?
options: The Sun's magnetic field locks the planets in place
The planets are too heavy to move in a straight line
The Sun's gravity pulls the planets inward, acting as the centripetal force that keeps them in orbit
The other planets' gravity prevents them from escaping
explanation: The Sun's gravity acts as the centripetal force that pulls planets inward, keeping them in their orbits instead of flying away.
fact_tl: Ang gravity ng Araw ang humihila sa mga planeta papasentro at nagsisilbing centripetal force, kaya nananatili silang umiikot sa kanilang orbita sa halip na lumipad palayo.
fact_bis: Ang gravity sa Adlaw nagbira sa mga planeta ngadto sa tunga ug nagsilbing centripetal force, mao nga magpadayon sila sa paglibot sa ilang orbita imbes molupad palayo.

q: Will a magnet still stick to an iron gate that is covered with paint?
options: No, because paint blocks the magnetic force completely
No, because paint mixed with rust permanently changes the iron
Yes, because a thin layer of paint does not stop the magnet from attracting the iron beneath it
Yes, but only if the paint is a dark color
explanation: A thin layer of paint does not stop magnetic attraction because the iron underneath is still iron.
fact_tl: Kahit may kalawang (rust) o may pintura ang bakal na bakod o gate, dumidikit pa rin dito ang magnet dahil bakal pa rin ang nasa loob. Ang manipis na pintura o kalawang ay hindi nakakapigil sa paghila ng magnet sa iron.
fact_bis: Bisan adunay taya (rust) o pintura ang puthaw nga koral o gate, modikit gihapon niini ang magnet kay puthaw gihapon ang sulod. Ang nipis nga pintura o taya dili makapugong sa magnet sa pagbira sa iron.

q: Which feature of Philippine sea straits like the Sibutu Passage makes them useful for tidal energy?
options: They have very warm water that heats underwater turbines
Their fast sea currents could drive underwater turbines to produce electricity
They are shallow enough for workers to install solar panels on the seabed
Their salt content is high enough to conduct electricity directly
explanation: Fast sea currents in narrow Philippine straits like the Sibutu Passage could drive underwater turbines to generate tidal energy.
fact_tl: Ang mga makitid na daanan ng tubig-dagat (strait) sa Pilipinas tulad ng Sibutu Passage at San Bernardino Strait ay may potensyal para sa tidal energy — ang mabilis na agos ng dagat dito ay maaaring magpatakbo ng mga underwater turbine.
fact_bis: Ang mga makitid nga daanan sa tubig-dagat (strait) sa Pilipinas sama sa Sibutu Passage ug San Bernardino Strait adunay potensyal alang sa tidal energy — ang paspas nga agos sa dagat didto makapadagan sa mga underwater turbine.

q: What can scientists learn by studying the shape of an animal's fossil teeth?
options: How long ago the animal lived based on its tooth size
Whether the animal ate meat or plants
How fast the animal could run based on the number of teeth
Whether the animal lived alone or in groups
explanation: The shape of fossil teeth tells scientists whether an ancient animal was a meat-eater or a plant-eater.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng hugis ng fossil na ngipin, malalaman ng mga siyentista kung ang isang hayop ay kumakain ng karne o halaman.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa porma sa fossil nga ngipon, mahibal-an sa mga siyentista kon ang usa ka mananap nagkaon og karne o tanom.

q: What is the main food of the binturong?
options: Small mammals and fish
Insects and tree sap
Fruit, especially figs
Leaves and bamboo shoots
explanation: The binturong eats many kinds of fruit, especially figs.
fact_tl: Ang binturong ay kumakain ng iba't ibang prutas, lalo na ang bunga ng igos o balete.
fact_bis: Ang binturong mokaon ug nagkalain-laing prutas, ilabina ang bunga sa igos o balete.

q: What can you say about the leaves of the sampaguita plant throughout the year?
options: The leaves fall off every dry season and grow back in the rainy season
The leaves change from green to yellow in cooler months
The sampaguita has glossy green leaves all year round
The leaves only appear while the plant is flowering
explanation: The sampaguita keeps its glossy green leaves all year round, making it an evergreen plant.
fact_tl: Ang sampaguita ay may makintab na berdeng mga dahon sa buong taon.
fact_bis: Ang sampaguita adunay masinaw nga lunhaw nga mga dahon sa tibuok tuig.

q: Why can a heron judge exactly where a fish is below the water surface before it strikes?
options: Its long beak lets it feel vibrations in the water
Its feet sense movement on the riverbed
Its eyes are positioned to look down into the water so it can see fish below the surface
It uses sound echoes to locate fish underwater
explanation: A heron's eyes are positioned to look downward, allowing it to judge exactly where a fish is below the surface before striking.
fact_tl: Nakaposisyon ang mga mata ng tagak para makatingin pababa sa tubig. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit kaya nitong tantyahin nang tama kung saan eksaktong nasa ilalim ng tubig ang isda bago ito sumalakay.
fact_bis: Ang mga mata sa tagak gibutang aron makatan-aw paubos sa tubig. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong matantsa niini sa husto kung asa gyud sa ilawom sa tubig ang isda sa dili pa kini motira.

q: Which part of the brain acts like a thermostat that controls how warm the body should be?
options: The cerebellum
The hypothalamus
The brain stem
The cerebrum
explanation: The hypothalamus acts like a thermostat, setting and regulating the body's temperature.
fact_tl: May bahagi ng utak na tinatawag na hypothalamus na parang termostat na nagtatakda kung gaano kainit dapat ang katawan.
fact_bis: Adunay bahin sa utok nga gitawag og hypothalamus nga sama sa termostat nga nagbutang kung unsa ka init angay ang lawas.

q: How do people usually catch leptospirosis?
options: By eating food that rats have touched with their paws
By breathing air near rat droppings
By wading in floodwater or water that contains rat urine
By being bitten directly by an infected rat
explanation: People can catch leptospirosis from floodwater or water that contains rat urine.
fact_tl: Ang sakit na leptospirosis ay nakukuha kapag nahahawakan ang baha o tubig na may ihi ng daga.
fact_bis: Ang sakit nga leptospirosis makuha gikan sa baha o tubig nga adunay ihi sa ilaga.

q: Which government agency is responsible for protecting and managing Laguna de Bay?
options: The National Water Resources Board (NWRB)
The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
The Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA)
The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR)
explanation: The Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) is the government agency that protects and manages Laguna de Bay.
fact_tl: May isang ahensya ng pamahalaan na tinatawag na Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) na nangangalaga at namamahala sa Laguna de Bay. Sila ang nagtatakda ng mga patakaran para malinis at mapanatili ang lawa.
fact_bis: Naay ahensya sa gobyerno nga gitawag og Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) nga nag-atiman ug nagdumala sa Laguna de Bay. Sila ang nagbutang sa mga lagda aron limpyo ug himsog ang lanaw.

q: In which layer of Earth's atmosphere does the International Space Station orbit?
options: Stratosphere
Mesosphere
Exosphere
Thermosphere
explanation: The International Space Station orbits Earth within the thermosphere, about 400 kilometers above the surface.
fact_tl: Ang International Space Station ay umiikot sa Daigdig sa loob ng thermosphere, mga 400 kilometro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang International Space Station nagtuyok sa Kalibutan sulod sa thermosphere, mga 400 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Why can we eventually see in a dark room after the lights go out, even though we could not see at first?
options: The pupils get smaller to let in more light after a few minutes
The lens of the eye stretches to focus on objects in low light
The rods in the retina become more sensitive after several minutes in the dark
The cones in the eye take over from rods and become stronger
explanation: The rods in the retina gradually become more sensitive in the dark, allowing us to see after several minutes.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang napatay ang ilaw, hindi tayo agad nakakakita, pero pagkalipas ng ilang minuto ay unti-unting napupukaw ang rods sa retina kaya nakakakita na tayo sa dilim.
fact_bis: Kung kalit nga mapalong ang suga, dili dayon ta makakita, apan paglabay sa pila ka minuto mahimong mas sensitibo ang rods sa retina mao nga makakita na ta sa ngitngit.

q: Why is geothermal energy considered renewable and cleaner than burning coal?
options: Because it converts sunlight into heat that can be reused endlessly
Because the Earth's heat will not run out for a very long time and it produces less pollution
Because underground water is easily replaced by rainfall every year
Because geothermal plants release steam that cools the planet
explanation: Geothermal energy is renewable because the Earth's heat does not run out for a very long time, and it makes less pollution than burning coal or oil.
fact_tl: Ang geothermal energy ay isang renewable energy dahil ang init ng Earth ay hindi nauubos sa loob ng mahabang panahon. Mas malinis ito kaysa sa pagsunog ng uling o langis dahil mas kaunti ang polusyong nililikha nito.
fact_bis: Ang geothermal energy usa ka renewable energy tungod kay ang kainit sa Earth dili mahurot sulod sa taas nga panahon. Mas limpyo kini kaysa sa pagsunog og uling o lana tungod kay mas gamay ang polusyon nga mahimo niini.

q: Which of the following correctly describes the age of ferns compared to other plants?
options: Ferns appeared around the same time as the first flowering plants
Ferns are a very ancient kind of plant that existed even before flowering plants and dinosaurs
Ferns evolved after the dinosaurs died out
Ferns first appeared only a few thousand years ago
explanation: Ferns are among the most ancient plants on Earth, existing millions of years ago before flowering plants and dinosaurs.
fact_tl: Ang pako ay napakaluma nang uri ng halaman — umiral na ito milyun-milyong taon na ang nakalipas, bago pa man dumating ang mga halamang may bulaklak at maging ang mga dinosauro.
fact_bis: Ang pako karaan kaayo nga matang sa tanom — naglungtad na kini milyon-milyon ka tuig na ang milabay, sa wala pa ang mga tanom nga adunay bulak ug bisan ang mga dinosauro.

q: How does a streak test help identify a mineral?
options: It measures how hard the mineral is by scratching a steel plate
It shows the mineral's true color by melting a tiny piece of it
It reveals the color of the mineral's powder when scraped across rough tile, which may differ from the stone's surface color
It measures how much light the mineral reflects when held in sunlight
explanation: Scraping a mineral across rough tile leaves a colored powder (streak) that can differ from the stone's surface color, helping identify the mineral.
fact_tl: Kapag iginuhit ang isang mineral sa magaspang na tile, ang kulay ng naiiwang pulbos (streak) ay minsan iba sa kulay ng mismong bato — at nakakatulong ito para makilala ang mineral.
fact_bis: Kon igasgas ang usa ka mineral sa gaspang nga tisa, ang kolor sa pulbos nga mabilin (streak) usahay lahi sa kolor sa mismong bato — ug makatabang kini aron mailhan ang mineral.

q: How can you tell that a liquid is a pure substance and not a mixture?
options: It changes color when heated to a high temperature
It boils at one fixed temperature instead of over a range of temperatures
It takes longer to boil than a mixture of the same volume
It produces bubbles only at the very bottom of the container
explanation: A pure substance boils at one fixed temperature (e.g., pure water at 100°C), while a mixture boils over a range of temperatures.
fact_tl: Isang palatandaan ng purong sangkap: tiyak at palagi ang temperatura kung saan ito kumukulo o natutunaw (halimbawa, kumukulo ang purong tubig sa 100°C). Ang mixture naman ay kumukulo o natutunaw sa nag-iibang temperatura, hindi sa iisang tiyak na punto.
fact_bis: Usa ka timailhan sa putli nga sustansya: tino ug kanunay ang temperatura kon asa kini mobukal o matunaw (pananglitan, mobukal ang putli nga tubig sa 100°C). Ang mixture mobukal o matunaw sa nagkalainlain nga temperatura, dili sa usa ka tino nga punto.

q: Why do vegetables like eggplant, tomato, and okra grow better in loose soil?
options: Loose soil holds more water on the surface, reducing the need for watering
Roots can spread more easily in soft soil and reach the nutrients they need
Loose soil keeps pests away from the roots
Loose soil makes the vegetables grow faster by warming up more quickly
explanation: Loose, healthy soil allows roots to spread easily and reach the nutrients needed for eggplant, tomato, and okra to grow well.
fact_tl: Para lumaki nang maayos ang talong, kamatis, at okra, kailangan ng malambot at masustansyang lupa. Mas madaling humukay ang ugat sa malambot na lupa at makakakuha ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Aron motubo og maayo ang talong, kamatis, ug okra, kinahanglan og humok ug masustansyang yuta. Ang gamot mas dali nga mokatag sa humok nga yuta ug makakuha sa kinahanglang sustansya.

q: Why does a doctor gently press the sides of your neck during a checkup?
options: To measure your pulse in the neck artery
To check if your throat muscles are strong enough
To feel for swollen or hardened lymph nodes that may signal an infection
To check if your spine is properly aligned
explanation: Doctors feel the neck for swollen or hardened lymph nodes, which is an easy, painless way to tell if the body is fighting an infection.
fact_tl: Kapag hinihipo ng doktor ang gilid ng iyong leeg sa checkup, hinahanap niya kung may namamaga o tumigas na kulani — isang madali at painless na paraan para malaman kung may nilalabanang impeksyon.
fact_bis: Kung hikapon sa doktor ang kilid sa imong liog sa checkup, gipangita niya kung naa'y naghubag o nagahi nga kulani — usa ka sayon ug walay-sakit nga paagi aron mahibaloan kung nakig-away ka sa impeksyon.

q: K2 is 8,611 meters tall. What is its rank among the world's mountains?
options: It is the tallest mountain in the world
It is the third highest mountain in the world
It is the second highest mountain in the world
It is the fourth highest mountain in the world
explanation: K2, at 8,611 meters, is the second highest mountain in the world.
fact_tl: Ang K2 ang pangalawang pinakamataas na bundok sa mundo, 8,611 metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang K2 mao ang ikaduha nga pinakataas nga bukid sa kalibutan, 8,611 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: How little water does a mosquito need in order to breed?
options: At least a full bucket of still water
A puddle at least 10 centimeters deep
As little as a bottle cap or water collected on a plant leaf
At least a glass of water left standing for a week
explanation: Mosquitoes can breed in very small amounts of water, such as the tiny amount found in a bottle cap or on a plant leaf.
fact_tl: Kayang mamugad ng lamok kahit sa kakaunting tubig lang, gaya ng sa talukap ng bote o sa dahon ng halaman.
fact_bis: Makasanay ang lamok bisan sa gamay ra kaayong tubig, sama sa takup sa botelya o sa dahon sa tanom.

q: How does a ship's echo sounder measure the depth of the water below it?
options: It drops a weighted cable and measures how long it takes to hit the bottom
It sends a sound pulse down and measures the time for the echo to return, then calculates the depth
It measures water pressure at the hull to calculate depth
It uses radio waves that bounce off the seafloor and return to a receiver
explanation: An echo sounder sends a sound pulse into the sea and calculates depth using the time the echo takes to return: depth = (speed of sound × time) ÷ 2.
fact_tl: Ang echo sounder sa mga barko ay nagpapadala ng sound pulse pababa sa dagat at nagsusukat ng oras na kinukuha ng echo na bumalik — ang kalkulasyon ng distansya ay distance = (bilis ng tunog × oras) ÷ 2.
fact_bis: Ang echo sounder sa mga barko nagapadala og sound pulse pababa sa dagat ug nagasukod sa oras nga mokuhit ang echo sa pagbalik — ang distansya = (tulin sa tunog × oras) ÷ 2 nagahatag sa lalim sa tubig.

q: What happens to the size of crystals when melted rock cools very slowly?
options: The crystals stay the same size regardless of cooling speed
Slow cooling produces smaller crystals because the minerals have less energy
Slow cooling produces larger crystals because the minerals have more time to arrange themselves
Slow cooling prevents crystal formation entirely
explanation: When melted material cools slowly, larger crystals form; fast cooling produces smaller crystals.
fact_tl: Kapag mabagal ang paglamig, mas malalaki ang nabubuong kristal; kapag mabilis ang paglamig, maliliit ang kristal.
fact_bis: Kon hinay ang pagbugnaw, mas dagko ang kristal nga maporma; kon paspas ang pagbugnaw, gagmay ang kristal.

q: What is the name of the deepest point of the Philippine Trench?
options: The Mindanao Deep
The Galathea Depth, also called the Emden Deep
The Pacific Abyss
The Manila Trench Floor
explanation: The deepest point of the Philippine Trench is called the Emden Deep, also known as the Galathea Depth.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na punto ng Philippine Trench ay tinatawag na Emden Deep, na kilala rin bilang Galathea Depth.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga punto sa Philippine Trench gitawag og Emden Deep, nailhan usab nga Galathea Depth.

q: What is a subspecies?
options: A completely separate species that looks almost identical to another
A group within a species that differs slightly by region, sometimes given a third name word
An animal that is a hybrid of two different species
A species that has gone extinct but left fossils
explanation: Subspecies are smaller groups within a species that differ slightly by region, and their scientific name sometimes includes a third word.
fact_tl: Ang ilang species ay nahahati sa mas maliliit na grupong tinatawag na subspecies, na may bahagyang pagkakaiba ayon sa rehiyon, at minsang dinaragdagan ng ikatlong salita ang pangalan.
fact_bis: Ang ubang species nabahin ngadto sa mas gagmay nga grupo nga gitawag og subspecies, nga gamayng magkalahi sumala sa rehiyon, ug usahay gidugangan og ikatulong pulong ang ngalan.

q: Why can a new animal brought into an area be dangerous to the animals already living there?
options: It brings new diseases from its original country that the native plants cannot survive
It eats or competes with native animals for food, putting them in danger
It prevents native animals from finding mates by confusing their mating calls
It takes up the space native animals need to lay their eggs
explanation: When a new animal is introduced to an area, it can eat or take food away from native animals, threatening their survival.
fact_tl: Kapag may bagong hayop na dinala sa isang lugar, maaari nitong kainin o agawan ng pagkain ang mga katutubong hayop, kaya sila nanganganib.
fact_bis: Kon adunay bag-ong hayop nga gidala sa usa ka dapit, mahimo niini kan-on o agawan og pagkaon ang mga lumad nga hayop, busa namiligro sila.

q: What usually happens BEFORE the blisters of chickenpox appear?
options: The child gets a rash immediately with no other warning signs
The child usually has a fever and body aches before the blisters show up
The child's temperature drops suddenly, making them feel cold
The child develops an itchy rash on the hands and feet first
explanation: Before chickenpox blisters appear, a child usually experiences fever and body aches first.
fact_tl: Bago lumabas ang paltos ng bulutong-tubig, kadalasan ay may lagnat at pananakit ng katawan ang bata.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa motungha ang butlig sa bulutong-tubig, ang bata kasagaran adunay hilanat ug labad sa lawas.

q: What is metamorphosis in insects?
options: The process of an insect building a protective shell around itself
The big change in an insect's body shape and form as it grows from egg to adult
The way an insect reproduces by laying many eggs at one time
The seasonal migration of insects to warmer regions
explanation: Metamorphosis is the dramatic change in an insect's body shape and form as it develops from egg to adult.
fact_tl: Ang metamorphosis ay ang malaking pagbabago ng hugis at anyo ng isang insekto habang ito ay lumalaki mula sa itlog hanggang sa pagtanda.
fact_bis: Ang metamorphosis mao ang dako nga kausaban sa porma ug lawas sa insekto samtang nagdako kini gikan sa itlog ngadto sa pagkahamtong.

q: When lightning hits the ground, why can animals nearby be hurt even if the bolt did not strike them directly?
options: The sound of the thunder causes shock waves strong enough to injure nearby animals
Lightning heats the air so quickly that it creates a burst of steam that burns nearby animals
The electricity spreads outward through the ground from the strike point, called ground current
The bright flash of lightning temporarily blinds and disorients animals, causing them to run into obstacles
explanation: When lightning hits the ground, electricity spreads outward through the ground around it — this is called ground current — and can hurt animals standing nearby.
fact_tl: Kapag tumama ang kidlat sa lupa, hindi lang sa tinamaang puntong delikado kumakalat ang kuryente palabas sa lupa sa paligid nito. Ito ang tinatawag na 'ground current.' Kaya minsan ang mga hayop na nakatayo malapit sa tinamaan ay naaano, kahit hindi sila direktang tinamaan ng kidlat.
fact_bis: Kon motama ang kilat sa yuta, dili lang sa eksaktong natamaan nga lugar ang delikado mokatag ang kuryente pagawas sa yuta sa palibot niini. Kini gitawag nga 'ground current.' Mao nga usahay ang mga mananap nga nagtindog duol sa natamaan maapektuhan, bisan wala sila direktang tamai sa kilat.

q: Approximately how wide (diameter) is Earth's Moon?
options: About 1,200 kilometers across
About 3,474 kilometers across
About 6,371 kilometers across
About 12,742 kilometers across
explanation: Earth's Moon is about 3,474 kilometers across (its diameter).
fact_tl: Ang Buwan ng Mundo ay may diyametro na humigit-kumulang 3,474 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang Bulan sa Yuta mga 3,474 ka kilometro ang gilapdon (diyametro).

q: Why is aluminum often mixed with other metals to make it into an alloy before being used in airplanes?
options: To make aluminum able to conduct electricity for the plane's systems
To change aluminum's color so it is easier to see and inspect
To make it strong while keeping it lightweight
To lower its melting point so it can be shaped more easily in factories
explanation: Aluminum is alloyed with other metals to make it strong while staying lightweight, which is why it is used in airplanes.
fact_tl: Ang aluminyo ay hinahaluan ng ibang metal upang maging malakas habang nananatiling magaan, kaya ginagamit ito sa mga eroplano.
fact_bis: Ang aluminyo gisagolan og ubang metal aron mahimong kusgan apan magpabilin nga gaan, mao nga gamiton kini sa mga eroplano.

q: Why is the blind snake given that name?
options: It attacks by sensing heat and cannot see its prey even in daylight
It is a tiny, worm-like snake that lives underground and can barely see
It hides in dark caves and its eyes have adapted to see only in complete darkness
It closes its eyes when it senses danger, making it appear blind
explanation: The blind snake is named for its tiny, worm-like body and underground lifestyle — it can barely see, which is why it is called blind.
fact_tl: Ang blind snake ay isang maliit na ahas na parang bulate, na nakatira sa ilalim ng lupa at halos hindi nakakakita kaya tinawag itong bulag.
fact_bis: Ang blind snake usa ka gamay nga halas nga morag wati, nga nagpuyo ilalom sa yuta ug halos dili makakita maong gitawag nga buta.

q: How do cone cells in the eye allow us to see many different colors?
options: Each cone cell can detect all wavelengths of light and sends combined color signals to the brain
Three kinds of cones pick up red, green, and blue light, and the brain mixes these signals to produce many colors
Cone cells amplify dim light so the brain can interpret it as color
Cone cells filter out harmful ultraviolet light, leaving only visible colors for the brain to process
explanation: Three types of cone cells pick up red, green, and blue light, allowing the brain to mix these signals and see many colors.
fact_tl: Karaniwang may tatlong uri ng cones na sumasagap ng pula, berde, at asul na liwanag para makakita tayo ng maraming kulay.
fact_bis: Naa kasagaran tulo ka klase sa cones nga nagdawat sa pula, berde, ug asul nga kahayag aron makakita ta og daghang kolor.

q: How do some mangrove trees get rid of extra salt from their bodies?
options: They release salt through tiny pores on their bark during heavy rain
They push excess salt into their oldest leaves, which then fall off, taking the salt with them
They send salt down to their roots, where it is flushed away by tidal water
They store salt in their seeds and release it when the seeds fall into the sea
explanation: Some mangroves move excess salt into their oldest leaves; when those leaves fall off, the tree discards the salt along with them.
fact_tl: May mga bakawan na ipinupon ang sobrang asin sa kanilang matatanda nang dahon. Kapag puno na ng asin ang dahon, nahuhulog ito — kaya parang itinatapon ng puno ang asin kasama ng lumang dahon.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bakhaw nga itipon ang sobrang asin sa ilang tigulang nga dahon. Kon puno na sa asin ang dahon, mahulog kini — busa daw gilabay sa kahoy ang asin uban sa daan nga dahon.

q: In which direction does the North Equatorial Current flow across the Pacific Ocean?
options: Eastward, away from the Philippines
Northward, toward Japan
Westward, toward the eastern coast of the Philippines
Southward, along the coast of South America
explanation: The North Equatorial Current flows westward across the Pacific and reaches the eastern coast of the Philippines before splitting.
fact_tl: Ang North Equatorial Current ay dumadaloy pakanluran sa Pasipiko at umaabot sa silangang baybayin ng Pilipinas bago humati.
fact_bis: Ang North Equatorial Current nagaagos pakasadpan sa Pasipiko ug moabot sa sidlakang baybayon sa Pilipinas una kini mabahin.

q: Where does the tamaraw live?
options: In the coral reefs and coastal waters of Palawan
In the rainforests and rivers of Mindanao
In the grasslands, forests, and mountains of Mindoro
In the mangrove swamps along the Luzon coastline
explanation: The tamaraw lives in the grasslands, forests, and mountains of Mindoro.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ay nakatira sa mga damuhan, kagubatan, at kabukiran ng Mindoro.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw nagpuyo sa kasagbutan, kalasangan, ug kabukiran sa Mindoro.

q: What happens to a newly hatched chick in the first few hours after it hatches?
options: It immediately starts searching for food and water on its own
It stays wet and unable to move for several days
It is wet and weak at first, but dries into a soft fluffy chick within a few hours
It hatches already dry and fluffy, ready to follow its mother
explanation: A newly hatched chick is wet and weak, but dries into a soft, fluffy chick within a few hours.
fact_tl: Basa at malata ang bagong pisang sisiw, ngunit makalipas ang ilang oras ito ay natutuyo at nagiging malambot.
fact_bis: Basa ug luya ang bag-ong napusa nga piso, apan human sa pipila ka oras kini mamala ug mahimong humok ug balhiboon.

q: What happens when iron-containing rocks are exposed to air and water over time?
options: The iron in the rock reacts with air and water, causing it to rust and turn reddish and weaker
The rock absorbs water and expands, causing it to split cleanly into layers
The iron crystallizes into metal nuggets that can be collected from the surface
The rock dissolves completely in rainwater and leaves behind only sand
explanation: Iron in rocks reacts with air and water, causing the rock to rust, turn reddish, and become weaker — a form of chemical weathering.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bato ay may bakal, at kapag nahalo ito sa hangin at tubig, nangangalawang ito tulad ng lumang bakal. Pumupula ang bato at humihina.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka bato adunay puthaw, ug kung masagol kini sa hangin ug tubig mokalawang kini sama sa daan nga puthaw. Mahimong pula-pula ang bato ug mohuyang.

q: Why did John Walker, the inventor of the match, NOT get a patent for his invention?
options: He was not allowed to patent it because he was not a professional scientist
He forgot to file the paperwork before another inventor copied his design
He chose not to patent it because he wanted everyone to be free to use it
He believed his match was too simple to qualify for a patent
explanation: John Walker did not patent the match because he wanted everyone to be free to use it.
fact_tl: Hindi pinatentehan ni John Walker ang posporo dahil gusto niyang malayang magamit ito ng lahat.
fact_bis: Wala gipatente ni John Walker ang posporo kay gusto niya nga gawasnon kining magamit sa tanan.

q: Why are solar panels especially useful in Philippine areas not yet connected to the power grid?
options: Because those areas receive more rainfall, which improves panel efficiency
Because solar panels can also store water for communities without pipelines
Because solar panels convert sunlight into clean, renewable electricity that does not require grid connections
Because solar panels are cheaper to install than any other energy source in the Philippines
explanation: Solar panels convert sunlight into clean, renewable electricity, making them especially useful in areas of the Philippines not yet connected to the power grid.
fact_tl: Maaaring gamitin ng mga Pilipino ang mga solar panel upang gawing kuryente ang liwanag ng araw, isang malinis at mapanibagong mapagkukunan ng enerhiya lalo na sa mga lugar na hindi pa nakakonekta sa power grid.
fact_bis: Maggamit ang mga Pilipino og mga solar panel aron himoong kuryente ang kahayag sa adlaw, usa ka malinis ug renewable nga tinubdan sa enerhiya labi na sa mga lugar nga wala pa makonekta sa power grid.

q: How many lungs does a person have, and where are they located?
options: One large lung in the center of the chest
Two lungs inside the chest, one on the left and one on the right
Three lung sections: two in the chest and one near the stomach
Two lungs located behind the stomach, on either side of the spine
explanation: A person has two lungs inside the chest — one on the left and one on the right — and they are soft and spongy, full of air.
fact_tl: May dalawang baga (lungs) ka sa loob ng iyong dibdib, isa sa kaliwa at isa sa kanan. Malambot at parang esponghang puno ng hangin ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Aduna kay duha ka baga (lungs) sa sulod sa imong dughan, usa sa wala ug usa sa tuo. Humok kini ug morag espongha nga puno sa hangin.

q: What is the main cause of ocean tides on Earth?
options: The spinning of Earth on its axis creates waves that rise and fall daily
The Sun's heat warms the ocean, making the water rise and fall twice a day
The Moon's gravity pulls on the ocean water, causing the daily rise and fall of the tides
Strong winds that blow in a regular pattern push ocean water toward the shore
explanation: The Moon's gravity is the main cause of tides — the daily rising and falling of ocean water.
fact_tl: Ang hila ng gravity ng buwan ang pangunahing dahilan ng taog — ang pagtaas at pagbaba ng tubig sa dagat sa araw-araw.
fact_bis: Ang hila sa gravity sa bulan mao ang nag-unang hinungdan sa taob — ang pagtaas ug paghunas sa tubig sa dagat matag adlaw.

q: What is the best way to prevent an allergic reaction?
options: Take antihistamine medicine every day to stop reactions before they start
Eat small amounts of the allergen regularly to build up tolerance over time
Avoid the allergen that triggers your allergy
See a doctor for an allergy shot once a month
explanation: The best way to prevent an allergic reaction is to avoid the allergen that triggers it.
