fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga bansang may pinakamaraming plastik na umaagos sa dagat dahil sa basurang hindi maayos na natatapon.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa mga nasod nga adunay pinakadaghang plastik nga moagos sa dagat tungod sa basura nga dili maayong gidumala.

q: What makes a single-celled organism like an amoeba special?
options: It can join with other cells to form organs when the environment changes.
One cell alone does all the jobs of life: feeding, moving, reproducing, and responding.
It has a simple nucleus that controls hundreds of helper cells around it.
It can survive without any source of energy by staying completely still.
explanation: A single-celled organism must carry out all life functions — feeding, moving, reproducing, and responding — with just one cell.
fact_tl: Ang isang single-celled na organismo tulad ng amoeba ay kailangang gawin ng isang selula lamang ang lahat ng gawain ng buhay — kumain, gumalaw, magparami, at tumugon sa kapaligiran.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka single-celled nga organismo sama sa amoeba kinahanglan nga buhaton sa usa lang ka cell ang tanan nga gawain sa kinabuhi — pagkaon, paglihok, pagparami, ug pagtubag sa kalikasan.

q: How can trees in a forest share carbon and nutrients with each other?
options: Through their above-ground branches that touch and exchange sap
Through rain water that carries nutrients from one tree's roots to another
Through an underground network of mycorrhizal fungi that connects their roots
Through chemical signals released into the air that trigger other trees to absorb more nutrients
explanation: Forest trees are connected by underground mycorrhizal fungal networks that allow carbon and nutrients to transfer between trees.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno ng kagubatan ay maaaring konektado sa pamamagitan ng underground na network ng mycorrhizal fungi — ang carbon at mga sustansya ay maaaring ilipat mula sa isang puno patungo sa isa pa sa pamamagitan ng network na ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy sa kagubatan mahimong konektado pinaagi sa underground nga network sa mycorrhizal fungi — ang carbon ug mga sustansya mahimong mabalhin gikan sa usa ka kahoy ngadto sa lain pinaagi sa kini nga network.

q: Whether an animal hatches from an egg or is born live, what do the young usually look like?
options: A completely different color until they grow into adults
A mixture of features from many unrelated animals in the area
Similar to their parents in shape and appearance
Identical copies of one parent and nothing like the other
explanation: Whether from eggs or live birth, young animals usually look like their parents, showing inherited traits.
fact_tl: Iisa man ang itlog o buhay na anak, ang mga supling ay kadalasang kahawig ng kanilang mga magulang.
fact_bis: Itlog man o buhi nga anak, ang mga anak kasagaran kaamgid sa ilang mga ginikanan.

q: What happens over time as hosts develop new defenses against parasites?
options: The parasites simply die out because they can no longer survive in any host.
The parasites switch to attacking plants instead of animals.
The parasites evolve new ways to overcome the host's defenses, creating an ongoing arms race.
The host's immune system gets permanently stronger and can fight all future parasites.
explanation: Hosts and parasites undergo coevolution — as hosts develop defenses, parasites evolve to overcome them — creating a continuous evolutionary arms race.
fact_tl: Ang host at parasito ay nagkakaroon ng coevolution — habang nagde-develop ang host ng mga bagong paraan ng pagtatanggol, ang parasito naman ay nagde-develop ng bagong paraan ng pag-atake — isang patuloy na 'arms race' ng ebolusyon.
fact_bis: Ang host ug parasito nagkakaroon og coevolution — habang nagugmad ang host og bag-o nga mga depensa, ang parasito nagugmad usab og bag-o nga mga paagi sa pag-atake — usa ka padayong evolutionary arms race.

q: When you are very cold, why does your body start shivering?
options: Shivering pumps blood faster so it reaches the skin and warms it.
The fast movement of muscles during shivering produces heat that raises body temperature.
Shivering signals the brain to send more oxygen to the cold parts of the body.
It tightens the skin so less cold air can touch the blood vessels underneath.
explanation: The fast movement of muscles during shivering generates heat, which helps raise body temperature when you are cold.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang lamig, nanginginig ang katawan mo. Ang mabilis na paggalaw ng kalamnan ay gumagawa ng init para tumaas ulit ang temperatura mo. Ito ay tulong-tulong ng katawan at balat para manatiling mainit.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ka tugnaw, mokurog ang imong lawas. Ang paspas nga paglihok sa kaunoran maghimo ug kainit aron motaas balik ang imong temperatura. Magtinabangay ang lawas ug panit aron magpabilin nga init.

q: What type of rock is marble?
options: An igneous rock formed when magma cools slowly underground
A sedimentary rock formed from layers of crushed shells and minerals
A metamorphic rock created under heat and pressure, used for floors and statues
A volcanic rock formed when lava hardens on the surface
explanation: Marble is a metamorphic rock — formed when limestone is changed by heat and pressure — and is valued for fine floors and statues.
fact_tl: Ang marble ay isang metamorphic rock na ginagamit sa magagandang sahig at rebulto.
fact_bis: Ang marble usa ka metamorphic rock nga gigamit sa nindot nga salog ug estatwa.

q: What is the difference between weather and climate?
options: Weather refers to temperature only, while climate includes wind and rain.
Weather is what happens in one place, while climate is the average for the whole world.
Weather is the condition on a particular day, while climate is the usual weather of a place over many years.
Weather can be predicted, while climate can never be measured or tracked.
explanation: Weather is the day-to-day condition of the atmosphere, while climate is the usual weather pattern of a place built up over many years of collected records.
fact_tl: Bukod sa araw-araw na panahon, tumutulong din ang weather station na pag-aralan ang KLIMA. Ang panahon ay ang kondisyon ngayon o bukas, pero ang klima ay ang karaniwang panahon sa isang lugar sa loob ng maraming taon. Ang tipon ng mga lumang datos ang nagsasabi nito.
fact_bis: Gawas sa adlaw-adlaw nga panahon, ang weather station motabang usab sa pagtuon sa KLIMA. Ang panahon mao ang kahimtang karon o ugma, apan ang klima mao ang naandang panahon sa usa ka dapit sulod sa daghang tuig. Ang tipon sa karaang datos maoy magbutyag niini.

q: What was the result of the People Power Revolution at EDSA in 1986?
options: The Philippines gained independence from the United States for the first time.
A new constitution was written that turned the Philippines into a federal republic.
A peaceful movement by Filipinos toppled authoritarian rule and restored democracy.
The military took control of the government to prevent a civil war.
explanation: The 1986 People Power Revolution at EDSA was a peaceful movement that ended authoritarian rule and restored democracy in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang People Power Revolution noong 1986 sa EDSA ay isang mapayapang kilusan ng mga Pilipino na nagbabagsak sa diktaturyang pamumuno at nagpanumbalik ng demokrasya sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang People Power Revolution niadtong 1986 sa EDSA usa ka malinawon nga kilusan sa mga Pilipino nga nagbagsak sa diktadurya ug nagpabuhag sa demokrasya sa nasod.

q: Why do many deep-sea animals produce their own light?
options: To keep warm because the deep ocean is extremely cold
To find food, find mates, or scare off enemies in the pitch-dark deep sea
To attract sunlight downward so they can photosynthesize food
To signal ocean currents that carry nutrients from the surface
explanation: In the deep sea where sunlight never reaches, many animals make their own light (bioluminescence) to find food, find mates, or scare away enemies.
fact_tl: Sa madilim na kalaliman ng dagat na hindi naaabot ng sikat ng araw, maraming hayop ang gumagawa ng sarili nilang ilaw — tinatawag itong bioluminescence — para humanap ng pagkain, kasama, o takutin ang kalaban.
fact_bis: Sa ngitngit nga kahiladman sa dagat diin dili maabot ang silaw sa adlaw, daghang mananap ang naghimo sa ilang kaugalingong kahayag — gitawag kini og bioluminescence — aron mangita og pagkaon, magpares, o mahadlok ang kaaway.

q: Where does a female crab keep her eggs safe until they hatch?
options: She buries them in sand and returns to check on them every day.
She keeps them in a special pouch inside her body like a kangaroo.
She sticks them under the folded flap of her belly called the apron.
She attaches them to the underside of a rock close to the surface.
explanation: A female crab carries thousands of tiny eggs stuck under the folded flap of her belly (the apron) and keeps them safe until they hatch.
fact_tl: Ang babaeng alimango ay nagdadala ng libo-libong maliliit na itlog na nakakapit sa ilalim ng nakatuping bahagi ng tiyan nito (apron). Inaalagaan niya ito hanggang sa mapisa, at lumalabas sa tubig-dagat ang napakaliliit na sanggol na alimango.
fact_bis: Ang babaye nga alimango magdala og liboan ka gagmay nga itlog nga nagkapyot ilalom sa pinilo nga bahin sa iyang tiyan (apron). Bantayan niya kini hangtod mapusa, ug mogawas sa tubig-dagat ang gagmay kaayo nga bata nga alimango.

q: Why is estivation more common than hibernation in hot countries like the Philippines?
options: Tropical animals have thicker fur that makes it too hot to sleep in winter.
The danger being escaped is heat and drought, not cold, so animals rest in the dry season instead of winter.
Rain falls all year in the tropics so animals never need to save energy.
Tropical animals are cold-blooded so they stay active no matter how hot it gets.
explanation: In hot countries like the Philippines, estivation is more common because the threat is heat and drought rather than cold, so animals rest during the dry season.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na bansa gaya ng Pilipinas, mas karaniwan ang estivation kaysa hibernation dahil ang dapat iwasan ay ang init at tuyot, hindi ang lamig.
fact_bis: Sa init nga nasud sama sa Pilipinas, mas komon ang estivation kay sa hibernation kay ang likayan mao ang init ug hulaw, dili ang bugnaw.

q: What does the unit called the ampere (A) measure?
options: The electrical resistance of a wire or component
The electrical voltage pushing current through a circuit
The electrical power used by a device in one second
The amount of electric current flowing through a circuit
explanation: The ampere (A) is the unit that measures electric current — the flow of electric charge through a conductor.
fact_tl: Ang ampere (A) ang yunit na sumusukat sa agos ng kuryente o electric current.
fact_bis: Ang ampere (A) mao ang unit nga nagsukod sa agos sa kuryente o electric current.

q: What do ants live in, and how do they work together?
options: Ants live alone in tiny holes and only meet other ants to fight for food.
Ants live in pairs and take turns guarding their eggs and finding food.
Ants live in large groups called colonies where thousands of workers find food and care for the nest together.
Ants live in trees and follow a single leader ant that gives them instructions.
explanation: Ants live in large groups called colonies, where thousands of worker ants cooperate to find food and care for the nest.
fact_tl: Ang mga langgam ay nakatira sa malalaking grupo na tinatawag na kolonya, kung saan nagtutulungan ang libu-libong manggagawang langgam para maghanap ng pagkain at mag-alaga sa pugad.
fact_bis: Ang mga hulmigas nagpuyo sa dagkong grupo nga gitawag og kolonya, diin liboan ka trabahante nga hulmigas magtinabangay aron mangita og pagkaon ug moatiman sa pugad.

q: What is one possible job the appendix may do inside your body?
options: It produces extra stomach acid to help digest tough foods.
It stores bile that the liver makes to break down fats.
It acts as a safe storehouse for helpful bacteria that aid the gut.
It filters waste from the blood before the kidneys take over.
explanation: The appendix may act as a safe storehouse for helpful gut bacteria, protecting them so they can help the digestive system recover after illness.
fact_tl: Ang apendiks ay maaaring magsilbing imbakan ng mabubuting bakterya na tumutulong sa bituka.
fact_bis: Ang apendiks mahimong tindahanan sa maayong bakterya nga makatabang sa tinai.

q: Which anglerfish have the glowing lure on their head?
options: Only the young anglerfish have it; adults lose it as they grow.
Only the male anglerfish — they use it to attract females in the dark.
Only the female anglerfish have the lighted lure; males are tiny and have no rod.
Both males and females have it, but the female's light is much brighter.
explanation: Only female anglerfish have the glowing esca (lure); males are tiny and have no rod at all, so any picture of an anglerfish with a light is a female.
fact_tl: Mahalagang malaman: hindi lahat ng anglerfish ay may nagliliwanag na pamingwit. Ang mga babaeng anglerfish lang ang may esca na ilaw. Ang mga lalaki ay napakaliit at walang pamingwit — kaya kapag may larawan ng anglerfish na may ilaw, babae 'yan.
fact_bis: Importante mahibal-an: dili tanan nga anglerfish adunay nagsiga nga pamingwit. Ang baye lang nga anglerfish ang adunay esca nga kahayag. Ang laki gagmay kaayo ug walay pamingwit — busa kung adunay litrato sa anglerfish nga may kahayag, baye kana.

q: Why do some flowers change color after they have been pollinated?
options: To attract more bees so they can be pollinated a second time
To warn animals that the flower's fruit is not yet ready to eat
To signal to pollinators that they have already been pollinated and should visit other flowers instead
To protect their petals from the sun after the delicate pollen is gone
explanation: Some flowers change color after pollination to tell pollinators to skip them and move on to flowers that still need pollinating.
fact_tl: May mga bulaklak na nagbabago ng kulay matapos mapollinate para sabihin sa pollinator na laktawan na ito.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bulak mag-ilis ug kolor human mapollinate aron sultihan ang pollinator nga laktawan na kini.

q: Why are icebergs so dangerous to ships at sea?
options: They melt quickly and suddenly surround ships with chunks of floating ice.
Their biggest part is hidden underwater where it cannot easily be seen.
They produce a thick fog that makes it impossible to see the ship's path.
They are magnetic and pull ships off course in the open ocean.
explanation: Icebergs are dangerous because most of their mass is underwater and invisible, so ships may strike the submerged part without seeing it in time.
fact_tl: Mapanganib ang mga iceberg sa mga barko dahil ang pinakamalaking bahagi nito ay nakatago sa ilalim ng tubig kung saan hindi ito agad nakikita.
fact_bis: Ang mga iceberg peligroso sa mga barko tungod kay ang labing dako nga bahin niini natago sa ilawom sa tubig diin dili kini dali makita.

q: How do a shrimp's two wide-seeing eyes help it survive?
options: They let the shrimp see colors on the ocean floor to find the right food.
They help the shrimp aim its claws precisely when catching prey.
They allow the shrimp to quickly notice approaching danger and flick backward to escape.
They glow in the dark so other shrimp can find each other in deep water.
explanation: A shrimp's two eyes see very widely, allowing it to quickly spot approaching danger and suddenly flick backward to escape.
fact_tl: Dahil malapad ang nakikita ng dalawang mata nito, mabilis mapapansin ng hipon ang papalapit na panganib at biglang umiigkas paatras palayo.
fact_bis: Tungod kay halapad ang makita sa duha ka mata niini, dali makamatngon ang hipon sa nagsingabot nga kapeligrohan ug kalit nga mokisdat paatras aron makaikyas.

q: If you crush an aluminium can flat, what happens to its total mass?
options: The mass decreases because some material is squeezed out when it is crushed.
The mass increases because crushing makes the metal more dense and heavier.
The mass stays exactly the same because crushing only changes the shape.
The mass increases at first and then returns to normal after a few minutes.
explanation: When we crush or melt an object, its total mass does not change — mass is conserved when matter changes shape.
fact_tl: Kapag dinurog o tinunaw natin ang isang bagay, hindi nagbabago ang kabuuang masa nito.
fact_bis: Kung dugmokon o tunawon nato ang usa ka butang, ang tibuok masa niini dili mausab.

q: What is the difference between the two kinds of memory in a phone or computer?
options: One memory is for apps and the other is only for the operating system.
One memory only works while the device is on and forgets everything when turned off, while the other keeps files even with no power.
One memory is fast and the other is slow, but both keep your files forever.
One memory is built into the chip and the other can be removed like a card.
explanation: A device has two memory types: one that forgets everything when turned off (RAM) and one that keeps your files and pictures even without power (storage).
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng memorya ang telepono o computer: ang isa ay tumutulong lang habang nakabukas at nakakalimutan ang laman kapag pinatay, at ang isa naman ay nagtatago ng iyong mga larawan at file kahit wala nang kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang telepono o computer adunay duha ka matang sa memorya: ang usa motabang lamang samtang naka-on ug makalimot sa sulod kung patyon, samtang ang lain motipig sa imong mga litrato ug file bisan wala nay kuryente.

q: What kinds of creatures can be found at the very bottom of the Philippine Trench?
options: No creatures at all — the pressure and darkness make life impossible there.
Only microscopic bacteria that cannot be seen without a microscope.
Strange animals like tiny shrimp-like creatures and fish adapted to crushing pressure and total darkness.
Only large predatory fish that generate their own heat to survive the cold.
explanation: Even in the pitch-dark, cold, high-pressure depths of the Philippine Trench, strange animals like tiny shrimp-like creatures and specially adapted fish still live there.
fact_tl: Kahit napakadilim, malamig, at sobrang bigat ng tubig sa ibaba ng trench, may mga kakaibang hayop pa rin doon tulad ng maliliit na hipon-hipon at isda na sanay sa matinding presyon.
fact_bis: Bisan ngitngit kaayo, bugnaw, ug bug-at kaayo ang tubig sa ilawom sa trench, naa gihapoy lahi nga mga hayop didto, sama sa gagmay nga sama-sa-pasayan ug isda nga anad sa kusog nga presyur.

q: Why do termites build mud tubes along walls when they travel to reach wood?
options: To carry the chewed wood back to their nest more easily
To trap the moisture from the wood so it stays soft enough to eat
So they do not dry out and stay safe from enemies while traveling
To confuse predators by hiding their trail in the mud
explanation: Termites travel inside mud tubes so they do not dry out and are protected from enemies on the way to their food source.
fact_tl: Para makarating sa kahoy nang ligtas, gumagawa ang anay ng maliliit na tubong putik sa pader o haligi. Sa loob ng tubong ito sila dumadaan para hindi sila matuyot at maligtas sa mga kaaway.
fact_bis: Aron makaabot sa kahoy nga luwas, ang anay maghimo ug gagmayng tubo nga lapok sa bongbong o haligi. Sa sulod niini sila moagi aron dili sila mauga ug maluwas sa kaaway.

q: How does the turkey vulture find dead animals to eat?
options: It soars very high and uses its extremely sharp eyesight to spot carcasses from kilometers away.
It listens for the sound of flies buzzing around decaying animals from far above.
It uses its sharp sense of smell to detect gases released by dead animals.
It follows other animals that are fleeing from a dead body nearby.
explanation: Unlike most birds, the turkey vulture finds dead animals using its well-developed sense of smell, detecting gases from decaying matter.
fact_tl: May mga buwitre, gaya ng turkey vulture, na nakakahanap ng patay na hayop gamit ang kanilang matalas na pang-amoy.
fact_bis: Adunay mga buwitre, sama sa turkey vulture, nga makakaplag og patay na mananap gamit ang ilang talinis nga panimaho.

q: How does a lymph node filter out germs from the fluid passing through it?
options: It heats the fluid to a temperature that kills all bacteria and viruses.
It releases white blood cells that swim upstream and destroy germs in the blood.
The flow slows down and passes through a thick mesh of fibers where germs get trapped.
It uses tiny pores that are too small for germs to squeeze through.
explanation: Inside a lymph node, fluid slows and passes through a thick mesh of fibers so that germs are left behind and trapped there.
fact_tl: Paano nagsasala ang kulani? Sa loob nito, bumabagal ang daloy ng limpa at dumadaan ito sa makapal na lambat ng hibla, kaya naiiwan at nahuhuli doon ang mga germ.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagsala sa kulani? Sulod niini, mohinay ang agos sa limpa ug moagi kini sa baga nga lambat sa hibla, mao nga mabilin ug madakpan didto ang mga germ.

q: When did the very first life appear on Earth, and what form did it take?
options: About 540 million years ago, as small soft-bodied ocean creatures
About 1 billion years ago, as simple green algae in shallow seas
About 3.5 billion years ago, as simple bacteria in the Precambrian
About 66 million years ago, right after the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs
explanation: The first life — simple bacteria — appeared in the Precambrian about 3.5 billion years ago.
fact_tl: Ang unang buhay, mga simpleng bakterya, ay lumitaw noong Precambrian, mga 3.5 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang unang kinabuhi, yano nga bakterya, mitungha sa Precambrian mga 3.5 ka bilyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: What does a printed circuit board (PCB) do inside an electronic device?
options: It stores electrical energy like a battery so the device can run without a power cable.
It uses printed copper tracks to connect electronic components without needing many loose wires.
It protects the device from overheating by spreading heat across its flat surface.
It converts alternating current (AC) from the wall into the direct current (DC) the device needs.
explanation: A PCB has printed copper tracks that connect components like resistors, capacitors, and transistors neatly without many loose wires.
fact_tl: Ang printed circuit board (PCB) ay isang plato na may naka-print na linya ng tanso (tracks) na nagkokonekta sa mga electronic component tulad ng resistor, capacitor, at transistor nang hindi kailangan ng maraming hawak na kawad.
fact_bis: Ang printed circuit board (PCB) usa ka board nga adunay naka-print nga copper tracks nga nagkonekta sa mga electronic component sama sa resistor, capacitor, ug transistor nga wala kinahanglana ug daghang duwagan nga kawad.

q: What is a comet made of, and what nickname does this give it?
options: Hot gas and plasma, which is why it is called a "fireball."
Solid iron and nickel, which is why it is called a "metal ball."
Ice, dust, and rock, which is why it is called a "dirty snowball."
Pure ice crystals with no dust, which is why it is called a "clean snowball."
explanation: A comet is made of ice, dust, and rock, earning it the nickname "dirty snowball."
fact_tl: Ang isang kometa ay gawa sa yelo, alikabok, at bato — kaya tinatawag itong parang "maruming bola ng niyebe."
fact_bis: Ang usa ka kometa hinimo sa yelo, abog, ug bato — mao nga gitawag kini nga sama sa "hugaw nga bola sa niyebe."

q: Which type of wave has the lowest frequency in the whole electromagnetic spectrum?
options: X-rays, which pass through soft materials easily
Microwaves, which are used to heat food in microwave ovens
Infrared waves, which carry heat from warm objects
Radio waves, which have the lowest frequency of all
explanation: Radio waves have the lowest frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum, sitting at the opposite end from gamma rays.
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamababang frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_bis: Ang radio waves mao ang adunay pinakaubos nga frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum.

q: What is the name of the deepest point on Earth, and how deep is it?
options: The Java Trench, about 7,500 meters deep
The Puerto Rico Trench, about 8,400 meters deep
The Tonga Trench, about 10,800 meters deep
The Mariana Trench, about 11,000 meters deep
explanation: The deepest point on Earth is the Mariana Trench, which reaches about 11,000 meters below the ocean surface.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na lugar sa Mundo ay ang Mariana Trench, na halos 11,000 metro ang lalim.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga dapit sa Kalibutan mao ang Mariana Trench, nga mga 11,000 ka metro ang giladmon.

q: What did NASA's New Horizons spacecraft discover when it flew past Pluto in 2015?
options: That Pluto has a thick oxygen atmosphere and running liquid water on its surface
That Pluto is actually a large comet with a glowing tail of gas and dust
A heart-shaped nitrogen ice plain and mountains of water ice on Pluto's surface
That Pluto has three large moons, all bigger than Earth's own Moon
explanation: When New Horizons flew past Pluto on 14 July 2015, it revealed a heart-shaped nitrogen ice plain and tall mountains of water ice on the surface.
fact_tl: Ang New Horizons spacecraft ng NASA ay unang lumipad malapit sa Pluto noong Hulyo 14, 2015; ito ang nagbigay sa atin ng unang malinaw na mga larawan ng Pluto, na nagpapakita ng heart-shaped na nitrogen ice plain at mga bundok ng yelo.
fact_bis: Ang New Horizons spacecraft sa NASA unang milupad hapit sa Pluto niadtong Hulyo 14, 2015; naghatag kini kanato og unang tin-aw nga mga larawan sa Pluto, nagpadayag sa puso-hugis nga nitrogen ice plain ug mga bukid sa water ice.

q: Why does bleached coral look white?
options: Its colorful algae have left, so only the white skeleton shows through the clear tissue.
It is covered in white sand that sticks to its surface.
It produces white pigment to protect itself from sunlight.
Its outer skin peels off, revealing a white layer underneath.
explanation: Once the colorful algae are gone, only the coral's white skeleton shows through the clear tissue, making it look white.
fact_tl: Namumuti ang coral dahil kapag wala na ang makukulay na algae, nakikita na lang ang puting kalansay nito sa ilalim ng malinaw na tisyu.
fact_bis: Moputi ang coral tungod kay kung wala na ang mabulukon nga algae, ang puti nga kalansay na lang niini ang makita pinaagi sa tin-aw nga unod.

q: Which bird is the only one that can fly backward?
options: The hummingbird, because its whole wing can swivel at the shoulder like a propeller.
The kingfisher, because it can hover in place before diving.
The swallow, because its narrow wings give it great speed and control.
The parrot, because it uses its tail feathers to steer in reverse.
explanation: The hummingbird is the only bird able to fly backward because its entire wing swivels at the shoulder like a propeller.
fact_tl: Ang hummingbird ang tanging ibong kayang lumipad nang paatras, dahil umiikot ang buong pakpak nito sa balikat na parang propeler.
fact_bis: Ang hummingbird mao ra ang langgam nga makalupad paatras, kay ang tibuok pako niini makatuyok sa abaga sama sa propeler.

q: How does Hepatitis A spread from person to person?
options: Through dirty water and food contaminated with an infected person's stool.
Through mosquito bites that carry the virus in their saliva.
Through breathing air in the same room as an infected person.
Through touching the skin of an infected person directly.
explanation: Hepatitis A spreads through dirty water and food that has been contaminated with an infected person's stool.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang hepatitis A sa maruming tubig at pagkaing nahawaan ng dumi ng taong may sakit.
fact_bis: Ang hepatitis A mokaylap pinaagi sa hugaw nga tubig ug pagkaon nga nahugawan sa tae sa tawo nga adunay sakit.

q: What type of banana is used to make turon, and how is it prepared?
options: Saba banana wrapped in a lumpia sheet and fried.
Lakatan banana mashed and baked inside dough.
Cavendish banana sliced and stir-fried with sugar.
Señorita banana boiled and rolled in shredded coconut.
explanation: Turon is made from saba banana — a starchy cooking banana — wrapped in a thin lumpia sheet and fried.
fact_tl: Ang turon ay saging na saba na binalot sa manipis na balat ng lumpia at iprinito, at ang saba ay isang uri ng saging na panluto.
fact_bis: Ang turon kay saging nga saba nga giputos sa nipis nga lumpia ug gipritos, ug ang saba usa ka matang sa saging nga lutoon.

q: A plane flies straight and level at the same speed without changing direction. What do we know about the forces acting on it?
options: The forces are balanced, which can mean steady motion, not just being at rest.
The forces must be unbalanced, because only unbalanced forces keep things moving.
There are no forces at all acting on the plane while it cruises.
The plane must be slowing down because balanced forces always cause rest.
explanation: Balanced forces do not always mean rest — an object can also be moving in a straight line at constant speed, like a cruising plane.
fact_tl: Ang balanseng puwersa ay hindi laging nangangahulugang nakatigil ang bagay — maaari rin itong gumagalaw nang tuwid sa pare-parehong bilis, tulad ng eroplanong patag na lumilipad.
fact_bis: Ang balanse nga mga kusog dili kanunay nagpasabot nga hunong ang butang — mahimo usab kining naglihok nga tul-id sa managsamang katulin, sama sa eroplano nga patag nga naglupad.

q: What was the name of the Wright brothers' first airplane?
options: The Wright Flyer
The Wright Eagle
The Kitty Hawk Express
The Sky Pioneer
explanation: The Wright brothers named their first airplane the "Wright Flyer."
fact_tl: Ang unang eroplano ng magkapatid na Wright ay tinawag na "Wright Flyer."
fact_bis: Ang unang eroplano sa managsoon nga Wright gitawag nga "Wright Flyer."

q: What record does Typhoon Yolanda hold?
options: It is considered one of the strongest typhoons ever to make landfall in the world.
It was the slowest-moving typhoon ever recorded in the Philippines.
It produced the most rainfall in a single day in Philippine history.
It was the first typhoon to be officially named in the western Pacific.
explanation: Typhoon Yolanda is considered one of the strongest typhoons ever to make landfall anywhere in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Bagyong Yolanda ay itinuturing na isa sa pinakamalakas na bagyong tumama sa lupa sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Bagyong Yolanda giisip nga usa sa pinakakusog nga bagyo nga miigo sa yuta sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: How does a monitor lizard typically behave when it sees a person?
options: It runs or swims away because it is shy and avoids people.
It stands very still and puffs up its body to look bigger.
It hisses loudly and bites to defend its territory.
It slowly walks toward the person out of curiosity.
explanation: The monitor lizard is shy and usually runs or swims away when it sees a person.
fact_tl: Ang bayawak ay mahiyain at karaniwang tumatakbo o lumalangoy palayo kapag nakakita ito ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang bayawak maulaw ug kasagaran modagan o molangoy palayo kon makakita kini ug tawo.

q: What colors identify an adult Brahminy kite?
options: White head and chest with a reddish-brown body and wings.
All-black body with a bright orange beak and yellow eyes.
Brown head and chest with white wings and a red tail.
Gray body with a white head and blue wing tips.
explanation: The adult Brahminy kite has a white head and chest that contrasts with its reddish-brown body and wings.
fact_tl: Ang adultong Brahminy kite ay may puting ulo at dibdib na kaibahan sa pulang-kayumanggi nitong katawan at pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang hamtong nga Brahminy kite adunay puti nga ulo ug dughan nga lahi sa mapula-pula nga lawas ug pako niini.

q: Which type of mutation can be passed on to a person's children?
options: A mutation in the sex cells (sperm or egg) can be passed to offspring.
A mutation in any ordinary body cell can be passed to offspring.
Only mutations caused by radiation can be inherited by children.
Any mutation formed after birth can be inherited by the next generation.
explanation: Only mutations in the sex cells (sperm or egg) can be passed on to the next generation; mutations in ordinary body cells are not inherited.
fact_tl: Ang mutation na nangyayari sa karaniwang selula ng katawan ay hindi naipapasa sa anak; tanging ang mga mutation sa sex cells (tamod o itlog) ang maaaring maipasa sa susunod na henerasyon.
fact_bis: Ang mutation nga mahitabo sa ordinaryong selula sa lawas dili maipasa sa anak; ang mga mutation lamang sa sex cells (tamod o itlog) ang mahimong ipasa sa sunod nga henerasyon.

q: Why must we not eat shellfish during a red tide?
options: Too much plankton turns the water reddish and creates a poison that shellfish absorb.
The shellfish get swept away by fast currents during red tide events.
The water temperature rises so much that shellfish spoil instantly.
Red tide causes shellfish to produce a bright dye that makes them taste bitter.
explanation: Red tide happens when too much of a certain plankton fills the sea, making a poison — which is why eating shellfish during red tide is dangerous.
fact_tl: Ang red tide ay nangyayari kapag sobrang dami ng isang uri ng plankton sa dagat na nagpapapula sa tubig at gumagawa ng lason, kaya bawal munang kumain ng talaba at tahong tuwing may red tide.
fact_bis: Ang red tide mahitabo kung sobra kadaghan ang usa ka matang sa plankton sa dagat nga makapapula sa tubig ug makahimo og hilo, mao nga dili una mokaon og talaba ug tahong panahon sa red tide.

q: How many hours of sleep do school-age children (ages 6–12) need each night?
options: 9 to 11 hours
6 to 8 hours
5 to 7 hours
12 to 14 hours
explanation: School-age children need 9 to 11 hours of sleep each night for healthy brain development, body growth, and a strong immune system.
fact_tl: Ang mga batang pang-eskwela (edad 6-12) ay kailangan ng 9 hanggang 11 oras na tulog bawat gabi para sa maayos na pag-unlad ng utak, paglago ng katawan, at malusog na immune system.
fact_bis: Ang mga batang pang-eskwela (edad 6-12) nanginahanglan ug 9 hangtud 11 ka oras sa pagtulog matag gabii alang sa maayong pag-uswag sa utak, pagtubo sa lawas, ug lig-on nga immune system.

q: Why was silver used as money and coins in many countries in the past?
options: Because it was valuable and easy to carry.
Because it was the lightest metal and would not bend.
Because it could be melted and poured into any mold without tools.
Because it was the most common metal found on the Earth's surface.
explanation: Silver was used as money in the past because it was valuable and easy to carry.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ginagamit ang pilak bilang pera at barya sa maraming bansa dahil mahalaga at madaling dalhin.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang plata gigamit nga kwarta ug sinsilyo sa daghang nasod kay bililhon kini ug sayon dad-on.

q: What is ylang-ylang best known for, and how is it used?
options: Its very fragrant yellow flowers, whose oil is used to make expensive perfumes.
Its hard wood, which is carved into traditional Philippine furniture.
Its large edible fruit, which is used in desserts across Southeast Asia.
Its broad leaves, which are woven into baskets and mats.
explanation: Ylang-ylang is a tree with very fragrant yellow flowers, and oil from them is used to make expensive perfumes.
fact_tl: Ang ilang-ilang ay isang punong-kahoy na may mabangong dilaw na bulaklak, at ang langis na kinukuha mula rito ay ginagamit sa paggawa ng mamahaling pabango.
fact_bis: Ang ilang-ilang usa ka kahoy nga adunay humot nga dilaw nga bulak, ug ang lana nga gikuha gikan niini gigamit sa paghimo ug mahal nga pahumot.

q: How do root hairs help a plant?
options: They cling to bits of soil so the plant can hold on more tightly.
They absorb sunlight to help the plant make food underground.
They push out harmful chemicals to keep insects away from the roots.
They store extra water for the plant to use during dry weather.
explanation: Root hairs cling to little bits of soil so the plant can hold on more tightly to the ground.
fact_tl: Ang ugat ay may napakaliliit na buhok na tinatawag na root hairs. Dumidikit ang mga ito sa maliliit na butil ng lupa para mas mahigpit na makakapit ang halaman.
fact_bis: Ang gamot adunay gagmay kaayong balhibo nga gitawag og root hairs. Mokapyot kini sa gagmayng tipik sa yuta aron mas hugot nga makakupot ang tanom.

q: What causes anemia, and how does it make a person feel?
options: Too few red blood cells or too little iron, making a person feel tired and weak.
Too many white blood cells fighting an infection, making a person feel dizzy.
A buildup of carbon dioxide in the blood, causing shortness of breath and fever.
Damaged platelets that prevent blood from clotting, causing constant bruising.
explanation: When the body has too few red cells or too little iron, it gets anemia, which makes a person feel tired and weak.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang sa pulang selula o bakal ang katawan, nagkakaroon ng anemia na nagpaparamdam ng pagod at panghihina.
fact_bis: Kung kulang ang pula nga selula o puthaw sa lawas, motungha ang anemia nga makapakapoy ug makapaluya sa tawo.

q: Why are mushrooms and molds NOT grouped with plants?
options: Because fungi absorb nutrients from dead matter instead of making their own food like plants do.
Because fungi are too small to be seen without a microscope, unlike most plants.
Because fungi reproduce using seeds, just like flowering plants.
Because fungi live only in water, while plants mainly live on land.
explanation: Fungi don't make their own food like plants; they absorb nutrients from dead matter, which is why they have their own separate kingdom.
fact_tl: Hindi kumakain ang fungi gaya ng hayop at hindi rin gumagawa ng sariling pagkain gaya ng halaman; sa halip, sinisipsip nila ang sustansya mula sa patay na bagay na kinakapitan nila. Kaya ang kabute at amag ay nasa sariling kingdom, hindi kasama ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang fungi dili mokaon sama sa hayop ug dili usab maghimo og kaugalingong pagkaon sama sa tanom; hinuon mosuyop sila og sustansya gikan sa patay nga butang nga ilang gituboan. Mao nga ang uhong ug agup-op naa sa kaugalingong kingdom, dili kauban sa tanom.

q: What should you do when singing Lupang Hinirang if the Philippine flag is visible?
options: Face the Philippine flag while singing.
Close your eyes and place your hand over your heart.
Bow your head and remain silent until the song ends.
Stand at ease with your hands clasped behind your back.
explanation: When singing Lupang Hinirang, we should face the Philippine flag; if no flag is visible, we face the direction of the music or the band.
fact_tl: Kapag kinakanta ang Lupang Hinirang, dapat tayong humarap sa watawat ng Pilipinas. Kung walang nakikitang watawat, humarap tayo sa direksyon ng tugtog o ng banda.
fact_bis: Kung kantahon ang Lupang Hinirang, kinahanglan kita moatubang sa bandila sa Pilipinas. Kung walay makita nga bandila, moatubang kita sa direksyon sa tugtog o sa banda.

q: What is the main job of tamaraw rangers in the forest?
options: They walk the forest daily to guard tamaraw, stop hunters, and keep the animals safe inside the protected park.
They capture injured tamaraw, treat them in a clinic, and release them back into the wild.
They count the tamaraw population each year to publish reports for the government.
They build fences around the tamaraw's territory to keep predators out.
explanation: Rangers walk the forest every day to guard the tamaraw, stop hunters, and make sure the animals are safe inside the protected park.
fact_tl: May mga taong tinatawag na ranger na naglalakad sa kagubatan araw-araw para bantayan ang tamaraw. Hinaharang nila ang mga mangangaso at sinisigurong ligtas ang mga hayop sa loob ng protektadong parke.
fact_bis: Naay mga tawo nga gitawag og ranger nga maglakaw sa kalasangan adlaw-adlaw aron bantayan ang tamaraw. Pugngan nila ang mga mangangayam ug siguroon nga luwas ang mga hayop sulod sa giprotektahang parke.

q: A student sees bubbles in boiling water and says it is a chemical reaction. Is the student correct?
options: No — the bubbles are just water vapor escaping, which is a physical change, not a chemical reaction.
Yes — all bubbling is a sign that new substances are being made.
Yes — heat always causes chemical reactions that produce gas bubbles.
No — boiling water produces no bubbles at all, so there is nothing to explain.
explanation: Bubbles in boiling water are just gas (water vapor) escaping — a physical change, not a chemical reaction; a chemical reaction only occurs when the gas itself is a new substance.
fact_tl: Maling akala na lahat ng bula ay reaksyong kemikal. Ang mga bula sa kumukulong tubig o sa soda ay gas na lumalabas lang — pisikal na pagbabago, hindi bagong sangkap. Reaksyong kemikal lang kung ang gas mismo ay BAGONG sangkap na nabuo, gaya ng pagbubula ng baking soda at suka.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga ang tanang bula kay reaksiyong kemikal. Ang bula sa nagbukal nga tubig o sa soda kay gas lang nga mogawas — pisikal nga kausaban, dili bag-ong substansiya. Kemikal lang kon ang gas mismo kay BAG-ONG substansiya nga naporma, sama sa pagbula sa baking soda ug suka.

q: What habits can often prevent type 2 diabetes?
options: Eating healthy food, exercising regularly, and keeping a healthy weight.
Taking vitamin supplements every day and drinking at least 3 liters of water.
Avoiding all sugary fruits and eating only protein-rich foods.
Getting a vaccine each year and avoiding contact with infected people.
explanation: Type 2 diabetes can often be prevented by eating healthy food, exercising regularly, and keeping a healthy weight.
fact_tl: Ang type 2 diabetes ay madalas na maiiwasan sa pamamagitan ng malusog na pagkain, regular na ehersisyo, at pagpapanatili ng tamang timbang.
fact_bis: Ang type 2 diabetes kasagaran malikayan pinaagi sa himsog nga pagkaon, regular nga ehersisyo, ug pagpabilin sa husto nga timbang.

q: Why is a single day on Mercury very long even though a year there is very short?
options: Mercury spins very slowly on its own axis compared with Earth.
Mercury is so close to the Sun that its days are stretched by gravity.
Mercury has no moon to speed up its rotation.
Mercury's thick atmosphere slows down sunlight, making each day last longer.
explanation: Although Mercury's year is very short, a single day there is very long because it spins very slowly on its own axis.
fact_tl: Bagama't ang isang taon sa Mercury ay napakaikli, ang isang araw doon ay napakahaba dahil napakabagal nitong umikot sa sarili nitong axis kumpara sa Earth.
fact_bis: Bisan mubo kaayo ang usa ka tuig sa Mercury, ang usa ka adlaw didto taas kaayo kay hinay kaayo kini motuyok sa kaugalingong axis niini kumpara sa Yuta.

q: Why can hardened concrete NOT be turned back into cement powder?
options: Because the chemical reaction that hardened it is permanent and cannot be reversed.
Because concrete is mixed with water which evaporates and can never be added back.
Because concrete is compressed under heavy machines until it becomes rock-hard.
Because the cement powder burns up completely when concrete dries in sunlight.
explanation: Once concrete hardens, the chemical reaction is permanent, so it cannot be turned back into cement powder.
fact_tl: Kapag tumigas na ang konkreto, hindi na ito maibabalik sa pulbos na semento dahil permanente ang reaksyong kemikal na nangyari.
fact_bis: Kon mogahi na ang konkreto, dili na kini mabalik sa pulbos nga semento tungod kay permanente ang reaksyong kemikal nga nahitabo.

q: What unit is used to measure the electricity a home uses on its electric bill?
options: Kilowatt-hours
Volts
Amperes
Watts
explanation: The electricity a home uses is measured in kilowatt-hours, which is what the electric bill is based on.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ang kuryenteng ginagamit sa bahay sa yunit na kilowatt-hour, at ito ang batayan ng iyong bayarin.
fact_bis: Ang koryente nga gigamit sa balay sukdon sa yunit nga kilowatt-hour, ug kini ang basihan sa imong bayranan.

q: What is the genome of an organism?
options: Its complete set of DNA — the full collection of all its genes and instructions.
The part of the cell nucleus that controls cell division.
The layer of proteins that surround and protect the DNA in each cell.
The number of chromosomes found only in reproductive cells.
explanation: The genome is an organism's complete set of DNA — the full collection of all its genes and instructions.
fact_tl: Ang genome ay ang buong set ng DNA ng isang organismo — ang kumpletong koleksyon ng lahat ng gene at tagubilin nito.
fact_bis: Ang genome mao ang tibuok set sa DNA sa usa ka organismo — ang kompleto nga koleksyon sa tanan niyang gene ug panudlo.

q: The Verde Island Passage is located between which two Philippine islands?
options: Mindoro and Luzon, near Batangas.
Leyte and Samar, near Tacloban.
Cebu and Bohol, near Tagbilaran.
Palawan and Mindanao, near Puerto Princesa.
explanation: The Verde Island Passage lies between the islands of Mindoro and Luzon, near Batangas.
fact_tl: Ang Verde Island Passage ay nasa pagitan ng mga isla ng Mindoro at Luzon, malapit sa Batangas.
fact_bis: Ang Verde Island Passage anaa sa taliwala sa mga isla sa Mindoro ug Luzon, duol sa Batangas.

q: What are rainbands in a typhoon?
options: Spiraling lines of thick rain clouds that wrap around the eye of the typhoon.
The calm ring of clear sky found directly around the typhoon's eye.
Strong straight winds that blow outward from the center of the typhoon.
The flat cloud layer that forms above the eye wall of the typhoon.
explanation: Rainbands are spiraling lines of thick rain clouds that wrap around the eye of the typhoon.
fact_tl: Ang mga banda ng ulan ay mga paikot na hanay ng makakapal na ulap na umuulan na nakapalibot sa mata ng bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang mga banda sa ulan mao ang nagliko-liko nga laray sa baga nga panganod nga nag-alirong sa mata sa bagyo.

q: Why is it a problem to put an air conditioner's thermostat sensor near a sunny window?
options: It will think the whole room is hotter than it really is, so the aircon will cool more than needed.
The sunlight will damage the sensor's wiring, causing the aircon to switch off completely.
The sensor will reflect the sunlight and overheat the wall behind it.
The sensor will detect only the room's humidity and ignore the actual temperature.
explanation: If the thermostat sensor is near a sunny window, it thinks the whole room is hotter than it is, so the aircon cools more than needed.
fact_tl: Mahalaga kung saan nakalagay ang sensor ng thermostat. Kung malapit ito sa bintanang tinatamaan ng araw o sa init ng kalan, aakalain nitong mas mainit ang buong kwarto kaysa totoo, kaya sosobra ang lamig na ibubuga ng aircon.
fact_bis: Importante asa nahimutang ang sensor sa thermostat. Kon duol kini sa bintana nga gisidlakan sa adlaw o sa init sa kalan, maghunahuna kini nga mas init ang tibuok kwarto kaysa tinuod, mao nga sobra ang bugnaw nga ibuga sa aircon.

q: What happens to the pressure of a gas if you heat it while keeping the container the same size?
options: The pressure rises because, at constant volume, pressure is directly proportional to temperature.
The pressure drops because the gas molecules slow down when heated.
The pressure stays the same because the container holds the volume fixed.
The pressure first rises and then falls once the gas reaches a certain temperature.
explanation: Gay-Lussac's law states that at constant volume, the pressure of a gas is directly proportional to its temperature — heat it up and the pressure rises.
fact_tl: Ayon sa Batas ni Gay-Lussac, kapag pare-pareho ang volume, ang presyon ng gas ay tuwirang proporsyonal sa temperatura nito (kapag uminit, tumataas ang presyon).
fact_bis: Sumala sa Balaod ni Gay-Lussac, kung kanunay ang volume, ang presyon sa gas tuwiran nga proporsyonal sa temperatura niini (kung moinit, mosaka ang presyon).

q: What is true about the large centipedes (Scolopendra) found in the Philippines?
options: They can reach 20 centimeters long and their bite is painful and venomous, but not usually life-threatening.
They are harmless to humans because their fangs cannot break human skin.
Their venom is strong enough to be deadly to any healthy adult in minutes.
They only bite when stepped on and release no venom, just a mild irritant.
explanation: Philippine Scolopendra centipedes can reach 20 cm; their bite is painful and venomous but generally not life-threatening to healthy people.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may malalaking species ng alupihan (Scolopendra) na maaaring umabot ng 20 sentimetro ang haba; ang kagat nito ay masakit at may hilo, ngunit karaniwang hindi delikado para sa malusog na tao.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay dagkong species sa alupihan (Scolopendra) nga makabot og 20 sentimetro ang gitas-on; ang ilang kagat masakit ug adunay hilo, apan kasagaran dili mapanganib sa kinabuhi sa himsog nga tawo.

q: About how long is the Philippine Trench?
options: About 1,320 kilometers long
About 500 kilometers long
About 3,000 kilometers long
About 200 kilometers long
explanation: The Philippine Trench is about 1,320 kilometers long, located off the eastern Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay halos 1,320 kilometro ang haba sa silangan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench mga 1,320 ka kilometro ang gitas-on, sa sidlakan sa Pilipinas.

q: How does a goat grab leaves and grass before biting them off?
options: It uses its nimble lips and tongue to grab and pull plants into its mouth.
It scoops plants up with its curved horns and flicks them into its mouth.
It uses its front hooves to hold plants down before biting.
It shakes its head rapidly to knock plants loose before eating them.
explanation: A goat uses its nimble lips and tongue to grab and pull leaves and grass into its mouth before cutting them with its teeth.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng kambing ang mahuhusay nitong labi at dila para hawakan at hilahin ang mga dahon at damo papasok sa bibig bago ito putulin gamit ang ngipin.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa kanding ang iyang hanas nga ngabil ug dila aron kuptan ug bira-on ang mga dahon ug sagbot ngadto sa baba una putlon kini sa iyang ngipon.

q: What special feature of a clinical thermometer keeps it showing the correct reading after it is removed from the patient?
options: A constriction near the bulb that stops the liquid from falling back down.
A digital memory chip that freezes the last temperature on its screen.
A sealed glass tip that locks the liquid column in place when shaken.
A rubber stopper at the top that holds the liquid at its highest point.
explanation: A clinical thermometer has a constriction near the bulb that prevents the liquid from falling back, ensuring an accurate reading after removal.
fact_tl: Ang clinical thermometer ay espesyal na dinisenyo para sukatin ang temperatura ng katawan — mayroon itong kink malapit sa bulb na pumipigil sa balik ng likido kapag inalis mula sa katawan para masiguro ang tamang pagbabasa.
fact_bis: Ang clinical thermometer espesyal nga gidisenyohan sa pagsukod sa temperatura sa lawas — adunay kini kink duol sa bulb nga nagpugong sa likido sa pagbalik kung gikuha, nagasiguro og husto nga pagbasa.

q: How have deep-sea organisms adapted to survive extreme pressure?
options: Their proteins have special structures that resist pressure changes, and many lack a swim bladder.
They have very thick bones that protect their organs from being crushed.
They inflate an air-filled sac to match the outside water pressure exactly.
They coat their bodies with a thick layer of fat that blocks pressure from reaching their organs.
explanation: Deep-sea organisms evolved special proteins that resist pressure changes, and many lack a swim bladder, helping them survive extreme deep-sea pressure.
fact_tl: Ang mga organismo sa malalim na karagatan ay nag-evolve ng mga espesyal na adaptasyon para sa sobrang taas na pressure — ang kanilang mga protina ay may espesyal na istraktura na hindi nababago ng pressure at marami ay wala na sa swim bladder.
fact_bis: Ang mga organismo sa dagat nga lawom nag-evolve og espesyal nga mga adaptasyon alang sa sobrang taas nga pressure — ang ilang mga protina adunay espesyal nga istruktura nga lumalaban sa mga pagbag-o sa pressure ug daghang wala na sa swim bladder.

q: What type of volcano is Mayon, and what is it famous for?
options: It is a stratovolcano, famous for its nearly perfect cone shape.
It is a shield volcano, famous for being the tallest mountain in the Philippines.
It is a cinder cone volcano, famous for its very frequent small eruptions.
It is a caldera volcano, famous for the large lake that fills its crater.
explanation: Mayon Volcano is a stratovolcano (composite volcano), famous for its nearly perfect cone shape.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon ay isang stratovolcano (composite volcano), kilala sa halos perpektong tulis-konong hugis nito.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkang Mayon usa ka stratovolcano (composite volcano), bantog sa hapit perpekto nga porma sa kono.

q: Why can a hovercraft glide easily over both water and land?
options: It floats on a thin cushion of air beneath it, so there is almost no friction.
Its flat bottom is coated with a special material that repels both water and mud.
It uses powerful magnets to push against the Earth's surface and stay lifted.
Its engines point downward and push the vehicle up, eliminating all contact with surfaces.
explanation: A hovercraft floats on a thin cushion of air, so there is almost no friction and it can glide easily over water or land.
fact_tl: Ang hovercraft ay lumulutang sa manipis na kolchon ng hangin sa ilalim nito, kaya halos walang friction at madaling gumalaw sa tubig o lupa.
fact_bis: Ang hovercraft naglutaw sa nipis nga unlan sa hangin sa ilawom niini, busa halos walay friction ug sayon kining molihok sa tubig o yuta.

q: What are tsunami waves like when they are in the middle of the deep ocean?
options: They are only low, so ships may not even notice them.
They are already very tall, reaching several meters high.
They travel very slowly, less than 10 kilometers per hour.
They are invisible because they move entirely underwater.
explanation: In the middle of the ocean, tsunami waves are only low, so ships may not even notice them.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng karagatan, ang alon ng tsunami ay mababa lang kaya maaaring hindi ito mapansin ng mga barko.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa kadagatan, ang mga balod sa tsunami ubos ra mao nga basin dili kini mamatikdan sa mga barko.

q: Why is coral considered an animal even though it feels hard like a rock?
options: Each tiny part called a polyp has a mouth and tentacles to catch food, and the hard part is like a shell the animals build around themselves.
Coral is actually a type of rock that has small bacteria living inside it.
Coral is a plant that uses hard minerals to stay anchored to the seafloor.
Coral looks hard because it is a colony of fungi that produce calcium shells.
explanation: Coral is a living animal — each tiny polyp has a mouth and tentacles to catch food, and the hard part is like a house the polyps build around themselves.
fact_tl: Madaling akalain na bato lang ang coral dahil matigas ito, pero ang coral ay buhay na hayop! Ang bawat maliit na bahagi nito ay isang polyp na may bibig at maliliit na galamay para humuli ng pagkain. Ang matigas na bahagi ay parang bahay na ginawa nila sa kanilang sarili.
fact_bis: Sayon hunahunaon nga bato lang ang coral kay gahi kini, apan ang coral usa ka buhing mananap! Ang matag gamay nga bahin usa ka polyp nga adunay baba ug gagmay nga galamay aron modakop og pagkaon. Ang gahi nga bahin sama sa balay nga ilang gitukod palibot sa ilang kaugalingon.

q: Why do light bulbs in a parallel circuit stay bright even when more bulbs are added?
options: Because each branch in a parallel circuit receives the full battery voltage.
Because parallel circuits share the total current equally among all bulbs.
Because adding more bulbs increases the total power supplied by the battery.
Because parallel circuits use thicker wires that reduce resistance as bulbs are added.
explanation: In a parallel circuit, each branch receives the full battery voltage, so bulbs stay bright even when more are added.
fact_tl: Sa isang parallel circuit, bawat sanga ay tumatanggap ng buong boltahe ng baterya, kaya ang mga bumbilya ay nananatiling maliwanag kahit dumami pa sila.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka parallel circuit, ang matag sanga makadawat sa tibuok boltahe sa baterya, mao nga magpabilin nga hayag ang mga bombilya bisan modaghan pa sila.

q: Does gold sink or float in water, and why?
options: It sinks because its density (19.3 g/cm³) is much higher than water's.
It floats because gold is a noble metal that repels water molecules.
It sinks because gold is magnetic and is pulled downward by Earth's core.
It floats because gold is processed into thin sheets that spread across the surface.
explanation: Gold sinks in water because its density (19.3 g/cm³) is very high compared to water.
fact_tl: Lumulubog ang ginto (gold) sa tubig dahil napakataas ng densidad nito (19.3 g/cm³) kaysa tubig.
fact_bis: Molunod ang bulawan (gold) sa tubig kay taas kaayo ang density niini (19.3 g/cm³) kaysa tubig.

q: When a jeepney stops suddenly, why do passengers lurch forward?
options: Because of inertia — a moving body's tendency to keep moving in the same direction.
Because the brakes push the floor backward, flinging passengers forward.
Because the jeepney's seats are tilted so passengers slide toward the front.
Because gravity pulls passengers forward whenever a vehicle decelerates.
explanation: When a jeepney stops suddenly, passengers lurch forward because of inertia — a moving body's tendency to keep moving.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang huminto ang dyipni, ang mga pasahero ay tila sumusulong pa dahil sa inertia—ang ugali ng katawang gumagalaw na magpatuloy sa paggalaw.
fact_bis: Kon kalit moundang ang dyip, ang mga pasahero morag mopadayon sa unahan tungod sa inertia—ang kinaiya sa naglihok nga lawas nga magpadayon sa paglihok.

q: How can AM radio signals be received very far from the broadcasting tower?
options: Radio waves travel at the speed of light and can bounce off the ionosphere to travel around the world.
Radio waves are amplified by satellites in orbit that relay the signal across continents.
Radio waves travel through the ground and emerge at receiving antennas far away.
Radio waves slow down in the atmosphere, which bends them back toward distant listeners.
explanation: Radio waves travel at the speed of light and can bounce off the ionosphere, allowing AM radio to be received far away.
fact_tl: Ang mga radio waves ay bahagi ng electromagnetic spectrum at gumagalaw sa bilis ng liwanag — maaari silang makalapit sa ilalim ng ionosphere at maglakbay sa buong mundo, na siyang nagpapahintulot sa AM radio na marinig sa malayo.
fact_bis: Ang mga radio wave bahin sa electromagnetic spectrum ug nagabiyahe sa tulin sa suga — mahimo silang mabounce sa ionosphere ug maglakbay sa tibuok kalibutan, nagahatag og AM radio nga madungog sa layo.

q: How does the speed of a planet's rotation affect its Coriolis effect?
options: A faster spin produces a stronger Coriolis effect, which is why it is stronger on Jupiter than on Earth.
A faster spin weakens the Coriolis effect because wind patterns are blown apart by speed.
The Coriolis effect is the same on all planets regardless of how fast they spin.
A faster spin only affects the Coriolis effect at the poles, not near the equator.
explanation: If a planet spins faster, its Coriolis effect is stronger; it is stronger on fast-spinning Jupiter than on Earth.
fact_tl: Kung mas mabilis umikot ang isang planeta, mas malakas ang Coriolis effect nito; mas malakas ito sa Jupiter na napakabilis umikot kaysa sa Mundo.
fact_bis: Kon mas paspas motuyok ang usa ka planeta, mas kusog ang iyang Coriolis effect; mas kusog kini sa paspas-motuyok nga Jupiter kaysa sa Kalibutan.

q: How many natural satellites does Earth have?
options: One — the Moon
Two — the Moon and a small captured asteroid
Three — the Moon, Phobos, and Deimos
Zero — the Moon is actually a dwarf planet
explanation: Earth has one natural satellite: the Moon.
fact_tl: Ang Mundo ay may isang (1) likas na satellite, ang Buwan (Moon).
fact_bis: Ang Kalibutan adunay usa (1) ka natural nga satellite, ang Bulan (Moon).

q: Why is clear plastic easier to recycle than colored or black plastic?
options: Clear plastic can be turned into any color afterward, while dark plastic is hard for sorting machines to detect.
Clear plastic is thinner and melts at a lower temperature, saving energy during recycling.
Clear plastic has fewer chemical additives, so it produces less pollution when melted.
Clear plastic is always made from a single type of material, while colored plastic mixes several types.
explanation: Clear plastic is easier to recycle because it can be turned into any color afterward, while dark or black plastic is hardest because sorting machines have trouble seeing it.
fact_tl: Mas madaling i-recycle ang malinaw na plastik kaysa sa makulay, dahil ang malinaw ay puwedeng gawing kahit anong kulay pagkatapos. Ang madilim o itim na plastik ang pinakamahirap dahil mahirap itong makita ng mga sorting machine.
fact_bis: Mas sayon i-recycle ang tin-aw nga plastik kaysa kolorado, kay ang tin-aw mahimong bisan unsang kolor human. Ang itom nga plastik ang labing lisod kay maglisod ang sorting machine sa pagkita niini.

q: What happens to the clear, runny part of an egg when it is heated?
options: It turns white and becomes firm.
It stays clear but bubbles and expands.
It turns yellow and becomes liquid.
It dries up and disappears completely.
explanation: When an egg is heated, its clear runny white turns white and firm — a sign of a chemical change.
fact_tl: Kapag iniinit ang itlog, ang malinaw at malabnaw na puti nito ay nagiging puti at matigas.
fact_bis: Kon initon ang itlog, ang tin-aw ug lasaw nga puti niini mahimong puti ug gahi.

q: What is the role of the cell wall in a plant cell?
options: It is a stiff outer layer that gives the cell shape and support.
It is a flexible membrane that controls what enters and leaves the cell.
It is a jelly-like filling that holds the cell's organelles in place.
It is a layer of pigment that gives the plant its green color.
explanation: The cell wall is a stiff outer layer around plant cells that gives them shape and support.
fact_tl: Ang dingding ng selula ay matigas na balot sa labas ng selula ng halaman na nagbibigay ng hugis at suporta.
fact_bis: Ang pader sa sélula maoy gahi nga bahin sa gawas sa sélula sa tanom nga naghatag ug porma ug suporta.

q: What shape do salt crystals look like when you look at them very closely?
options: Tiny cubes or little boxes
Round balls like marbles
Long thin needles
Flat hexagonal snowflakes
explanation: Salt crystals are shaped like tiny cubes or little boxes when viewed up close.
fact_tl: Ang mga kristal ng asin ay parang maliliit na kubo o kahon kapag tiningnan nang malapitan.
fact_bis: Ang mga kristal sa asin morag gagmay nga mga kubo o gagmay nga kahon kon imong tan-awon og duol.

q: What color does turmeric (luyang dilaw) turn when it touches a base?
options: Reddish-brown
Bright blue
Dark green
Deep purple
explanation: Turmeric is normally yellow but turns reddish-brown when it comes into contact with a base, making it a natural indicator.
fact_tl: Ang luyang dilaw (turmeric) ay isa pang likas na indicator: dilaw ito sa karaniwan, ngunit nagiging mapula-pula o kayumanggi kapag inilagay sa base. Madalas itong makita sa kusina kaya madaling subukan.
fact_bis: Ang luyang dilaw (turmeric) usa pa ka natural nga indicator: dalag kini sa naandan, apan mahimong pula-pula o kape kon ibutang sa base. Kasagaran kini makita sa kusina busa sayon sulayan.

q: Why are rats considered a danger to people's health?
options: They carry and spread diseases that can make people sick
They eat all the crops and leave people hungry
They bite through electrical wires causing fires
They chase away animals that protect farms
explanation: Rats carry and spread diseases that can make people sick.
fact_tl: Ang daga ay nagdadala at nagkakalat ng mga sakit sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang ilaga nagdala ug nagsabwag ug mga sakit nga makasakit sa tao.

q: Why does a woodpecker's beak keep growing throughout its life?
options: To replace the part that wears down from constant pecking on wood
To attract a mate with a longer, more colorful beak
To help it sing louder songs in the forest
To break open seeds that get harder each season
explanation: A woodpecker's beak keeps growing to replace the part worn down by constant pecking on wood.
fact_tl: Patuloy na tumutubo ang tuka ng woodpecker para mapalitan ang bahaging naninipis dahil sa palagiang pagkatok sa kahoy.
fact_bis: Ang tuka sa woodpecker padayon nga motubo aron ilisan ang bahin nga naut tungod sa kanunay nga pagtuktok sa kahoy.

q: How does sunscreen protect your skin when you go outside on a sunny day?
options: It blocks the sun's UV rays so the skin does not get burned
It cools the skin by releasing a water mist when it gets warm
It reflects all sunlight away so you stay in the shade
It makes the outer layer of skin thicker and tougher
explanation: Sunscreen is a cream that blocks the sun's UV rays so the skin does not get burned.
fact_tl: Ang sunscreen ay pamahid na humaharang sa UV na sinag ng araw para hindi masunog ang balat.
fact_bis: Ang sunscreen usa ka pahid nga nagsumpo sa UV nga silaw sa adlaw aron dili masunog ang panit.

q: What makes the Baboy Bisaya a good pig to raise in a backyard farm?
options: It is small and hardy, so it can thrive and eat leftover scraps
It grows very large quickly, so it produces more meat in less time
It can survive without any water for several weeks at a time
It naturally stays clean and does not need a pen or fence
explanation: The Baboy Bisaya is a small and hardy native black pig that thrives in backyard raising and eats leftover scraps.
fact_tl: Ang baboy Bisaya ay isang katutubong itim na baboy na maliit at matibay, kaya nabubuhay ito sa pag-aalaga sa likod-bahay at pagkain ng mga tira-tirang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang baboy Bisaya usa ka lumad nga itom nga baboy nga gamay ug kusgan, mao nga mabuhi kini sa pag-atiman sa likod sa balay ug mokaon sa mga sobra nga pagkaon.

q: What makes the pufferfish's poison especially dangerous for humans?
options: There is no known cure or antidote for it
It spreads through the air and can reach people far away
It causes immediate blindness before any other symptom
It destroys all the vitamins in the body within an hour
explanation: There is no known cure or antidote for the pufferfish's poison, making it extremely dangerous.
fact_tl: Wala pang tiyak na gamot o lunas para sa lason ng butete.
fact_bis: Wala pay nahibaloan nga tambal o lunas alang sa hilo sa butete.

q: About how tall is Mayon Volcano in the Philippines?
options: About 2,462 meters tall
About 4,800 meters tall
About 1,200 meters tall
About 8,000 meters tall
explanation: Mayon Volcano stands about 2,462 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon ay may taas na humigit-kumulang 2,462 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkang Mayon adunay gihabugon nga mga 2,462 ka metro.

q: Which scientist is famous for studying how energy turns into heat?
options: James Joule
Michael Faraday
Henry Cavendish
Robert Brown
explanation: James Joule studied how energy turns into heat, and the unit of energy is named after him.
fact_tl: Si James Joule ang nag-aral kung paano nagiging init ang enerhiya (energy at heat).
fact_bis: Si James Joule ang nagtuon kon unsaon pagkahimong kainit ang enerhiya (energy ug heat).

q: Which of the following is true about moons of giant planets like Jupiter and Saturn?
options: Some of their moons are even larger than the planet Mercury
All of their moons are smaller than Earth's Moon
Giant planets have no more than five moons each
Their moons are made only of ice and have no rocky parts
explanation: Giant planets like Jupiter and Saturn have dozens of moons, and some—like Ganymede and Titan—are even larger than Mercury.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking planeta tulad ng Jupiter at Saturn ay may dose-dosenang buwan, at ang ilan tulad ng Ganymede (buwan ng Jupiter) at Titan (buwan ng Saturn) ay mas malaki pa sa planetang Mercury.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong planeta sama sa Jupiter ug Saturn adunay dosena-dosenang bulan, ug ang uban sama sa Ganymede (bulan sa Jupiter) ug Titan (bulan sa Saturn) mas dako pa kay sa planeta nga Mercury.

q: How big is a typical mantis shrimp?
options: About ten centimeters long, roughly the size of a hand
About one meter long, about the length of a desk
About one centimeter long, smaller than a fingernail
About half a meter long, about the length of an arm
explanation: Most mantis shrimp are small, only about ten centimeters long, roughly the size of a hand.
fact_tl: Karaniwang maliit lang ang mantis shrimp, mga sampung sentimetro ang haba, kasinglaki ng palad ng kamay.
fact_bis: Kasagaran gamay ra ang mantis shrimp, mga napulo ka sentimetro ang gitas-on, sama kadako sa palad sa kamot.

q: Why is it harmful to disturb giant flying fox bat colonies, especially during breeding season?
options: It causes serious harm to the bat population
It makes the bats move to cities and become pests
It stops the bats from eating insects, causing pest outbreaks
It damages the trees where the bats sleep permanently
explanation: Disturbing giant flying fox roost colonies during breeding season causes serious harm to the bat population.
fact_tl: Ang pagabala sa mga roost ng giant flying fox, lalo na sa panahon ng pag-aanak, ay nagdudulot ng malaking pinsala sa populasyon ng paniki.
fact_bis: Ang pagperturba sa mga roost sa giant flying fox, labi na sa panahon sa pagpaanakon, nagduhat og dakong kadaut sa populasyon sa paniki.

q: What material does a mussel use from seawater to build its hard shell?
options: Calcium
Iron
Salt
Sand
explanation: A mussel's hard shell is made of calcium it takes from the seawater.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na kabibe ng tahong ay gawa sa kalsyum na kinukuha nito mula sa tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga kabhang sa tahong hinimo sa kalsyum nga gikuha niini gikan sa tubig dagat.

q: Why is farmland near volcanoes often very good for growing crops?
options: Ash from volcanic eruptions enriches the soil and makes it fertile
Heat from the volcano keeps the soil warm all year round
Lava rocks break down quickly into water that plants drink
Volcanic gas acts like fertilizer when plants absorb it through leaves
explanation: Ash from volcanic eruptions enriches the soil, so farmland around volcanoes is often very fertile.
fact_tl: Ang abo mula sa pagputok ng bulkan ay nagpapataba sa lupa, kaya mabunga ang sakahan sa paligid ng mga bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang abo gikan sa pagbuto sa bulkan makapatambok sa yuta, mao nga tabunok ang kaumahan palibot sa mga bulkan.

q: How can you tell when an atis fruit is ripe and ready to eat?
options: Its green, bumpy skin pulls apart easily
Its skin turns bright orange and becomes smooth
It falls off the tree and bursts open on the ground
Its bumps disappear and the skin becomes flat and shiny
explanation: The atis has a green, bumpy skin that pulls apart easily when the fruit is ripe.
fact_tl: Ang atis ay may berde at bukul-bukol na balat na madaling humiwalay kapag hinog na ito.
fact_bis: Ang atis adunay berde ug kuluton nga panit nga sayon mabungkag kung hinog na.

q: Which Philippine plant's leaves are commonly made into cough medicine?
options: Lagundi
Malunggay
Ampalaya
Pandan
explanation: Lagundi leaves are often made into cough medicine and are a well-known example of medicinal leaves in the Philippines.
fact_tl: May mga dahon na ginagamit bilang gamot sa Pilipinas. Halimbawa, ang dahon ng lagundi ay madalas gawing gamot sa ubo. Maraming halaman ang may dahong nakakatulong magpagaling, pero dapat laging may gabay ng nakatatanda o doktor.
fact_bis: Adunay mga dahon nga gigamit isip tambal sa Pilipinas. Pananglitan, ang dahon sa lagundi kasagarang himoon nga tambal sa ubo. Daghang tanom ang adunay dahon nga makatabang og ayo, apan kinahanglan kanunay nga adunay giya sa hamtong o doktor.

q: Where in the body does food get absorbed into the blood as nutrients?
options: In the small intestine
In the large intestine
In the stomach
In the esophagus
explanation: In the small intestine, the body absorbs the nutrients from food into the blood.
fact_tl: Sa maliit na bituka sinisipsip ng katawan ang sustansya ng pagkaon papunta sa dugo.
fact_bis: Sa gamay nga tinai, ang lawas mosuyop sa sustansya gikan sa pagkaon ngadto sa dugo.

q: In which town and province is the colorful Pahiyas festival held every year?
options: Lucban, Quezon
Vigan, Ilocos Sur
Kalibo, Aklan
Cebu City, Cebu
explanation: The Pahiyas festival is held in Lucban in the province of Quezon.
fact_tl: Ang Pahiyas ay ipinagdiriwang sa Lucban, sa lalawigan ng Quezon.
fact_bis: Ang Pahiyas gisaulog sa Lucban, sa lalawigan sa Quezon.

q: Robert Brown looked at pollen in water under a microscope and saw the pollen moving randomly. What was causing that movement?
options: Invisible water particles constantly bumping into the pollen
The pollen was alive and swimming on its own
Light from the microscope was pushing the pollen around
Currents created by the microscope's heat stirred the water
explanation: The random movement Brown observed—called Brownian motion—was caused by invisible water particles constantly bombarding the pollen, providing evidence for the particle model of matter.
fact_tl: Ang isa sa pinakamahalagang patunay para sa particle model ng matter ay ang Brownian motion. Nang si Robert Brown ay nanonood ng mga particle ng pollen sa tubig sa ilalim ng mikroskopyo, napansin niya na ang mga ito ay gumagalaw nang random — ito ay dahil sa mga hindi nakikitang particle ng tubig na bumabagsak sa kanila.
fact_bis: Usa sa mga susi nga patunay alang sa particle model sa matter mao ang Brownian motion. Sa pag-obserba ni Robert Brown sa mga particle sa pollen sa tubig ilalum sa mikroskopyo, nakita niya nga nagbalhin sila nga random — tungod kay ang mga dili-makita nga particle sa tubig padayon nga nagbabanga kanila.

q: What important discovery did Michael Faraday make in 1831?
options: A moving magnet can make electricity
Heating water produces steam that spins a wheel
Electricity travels at the speed of light through wires
Two magnets always push each other apart
explanation: Michael Faraday discovered in 1831 that a moving magnet can make electricity, which became the basis of the generator.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Michael Faraday noong 1831 na ang gumagalaw na magnet ay maaaring gumawa ng kuryente, na naging batayan ng generator.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan ni Michael Faraday niadtong 1831 nga ang naglihok nga magnet makahimo ug kuryente, nga nahimong sukaranan sa generator.

q: Why do coastal areas tend to have milder temperatures than inland areas far from the sea?
options: The ocean absorbs and slowly releases large amounts of heat, moderating the climate nearby
Ocean breezes carry rain clouds that keep coastal areas cool all year
Salt in the ocean water reflects sunlight and prevents overheating
The ocean is flat, so wind blows heat away before it reaches the coast
explanation: Water's high specific heat lets the ocean absorb large amounts of heat during the day and release it slowly, moderating the climate of coastal lands.
fact_tl: Ang mataas na specific heat ng tubig ay ginagawa ang karagatan bilang isang malaking buffer ng temperatura para sa Mundo. Ang mga karagatan ay sumisipsip ng malaking halaga ng init sa araw at inilalabas ito nang dahan-dahan sa gabi at taglamig — ito ay nagpapabago ng klima ng mga lupain sa dalampasigan.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga specific heat sa tubig nagbuhat sa kadagatan isip usa ka dakong temperature buffer alang sa Yuta. Ang mga karagatan nagsipsip sa daghang kantidad sa init sa adlaw ug hinay-hinay kini naglabas sa gabii ug sa taglamig — nagpabag-o kini sa klima sa mga yuta sa dalampasigan.

q: Where does the Philippines rank among the world's top geothermal energy producers?
options: Third, behind the United States and Indonesia
First, ahead of all other countries
Second, behind only the United States
Fifth, behind four other Asian countries
explanation: The Philippines is now ranked 3rd in geothermal energy production, behind the United States and Indonesia.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang gumagawa ng geothermal energy sa mundo — dating pang-2 at ngayon ay pang-3 (sumunod sa Estados Unidos at Indonesia).
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa nag-unang naghimo ug geothermal energy sa kalibutan — kanhi ika-2 ug karon ika-3 (sunod sa Estados Unidos ug Indonesia).

q: What actually happens to your heart when you sneeze?
options: Its rhythm may change for a moment, but it does not stop beating
It stops completely for about one second, then restarts
It beats twice as fast right after the sneeze
It pauses only when you sneeze and hold your breath at the same time
explanation: The idea that your heart stops when you sneeze is a myth; its rhythm may change momentarily, but it does not actually stop beating.
fact_tl: May sabi-sabi na huminto raw ang puso kapag bumahing ka, pero hindi ito totoo. Maaaring bahagyang magbago ang ritmo nito sandali, pero hindi talaga ito tumitigil sa pagtibok.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga nag-ingon nga mohunong ang kasingkasing kung mobahing ka, apan dili kini tinuod. Mahimong mausab gamay ang ritmo niini kadiyot, apan dili gyud kini mohunong sa pagtibok.

q: What does blood pressure measure, and how is it checked?
options: How hard the heart pushes blood through vessels, measured with a cuff around the arm
How much blood is in the body, measured by counting heartbeats for one minute
How fast red blood cells travel, measured with a finger clip device
How wide the blood vessels are, measured with a special chest X-ray
explanation: Blood pressure measures how hard the heart pushes blood through the vessels and is measured with a cuff wrapped around the arm.
fact_tl: Ang blood pressure ay sukat kung gaano kalakas itinutulak ng puso ang dugo sa mga ugat, at sinusukat ito gamit ang isang cuff na ibinabalot sa braso.
fact_bis: Ang blood pressure mao ang sukod kung unsa kakusog ang pagtulod sa kasingkasing sa dugo agi sa mga ugat, ug gisukod kini gamit ang cuff nga giputos sa bukton.

q: Why do dolphins often leap high out of the water?
options: To play, find food, or swim fast
To catch birds flying low over the sea
To cool themselves down when the water gets too warm
To warn other sea animals about nearby sharks
explanation: Dolphins leap out of the water while playing, finding food, or swimming fast.
fact_tl: Madalas lumukso ang lumba-lumba paitaas sa hangin mula sa tubig. Ginagawa nila ito habang naglalaro, naghahanap ng pagkain, o tumatakbo nang mabilis.
fact_bis: Kasagaran molukso ang lumba-lumba paibabaw sa hangin gikan sa tubig. Buhaton nila kini samtang nagdula, mangita og pagkaon, o molangoy og paspas.

q: How do some starfish eat shellfish that are bigger than their mouths?
options: They push their stomach outside their body to digest the shellfish's soft flesh
They use their arms to crack the shell open and then eat the pieces
They inject venom to dissolve the shell before swallowing it whole
They wait for the shellfish to open its shell, then quickly bite the flesh
explanation: Some starfish eat by pushing their stomach out of their body to digest the soft flesh of shellfish.
fact_tl: Ang ilang starfish ay kumakain sa pamamagitan ng paglabas ng kanilang tiyan sa labas ng katawan upang lusawin ang laman ng kabibe.
