The palm family
The grass family
The vine family
explanation: Cogon and talahib belong to the grass family, along with rice, corn, and sugarcane — they all have long leaves and hollow stems.
fact_tl: Ang cogon at talahib ay parehong kabilang sa pamilya ng mga damo, kasama ang palay, mais, at tubo. Kaya pareho silang may mahahabang dahon at hungkag na tangkay.
fact_bis: Ang kugon ug talahib parehong sakop sa pamilya sa mga balili o sagbot, lakip ang humay, mais, ug tubo. Mao nga silang tanan adunay tag-as nga dahon ug bakante nga punoan.

q: What do bears do during winter to survive when food is scarce?
options: They migrate south to warmer forests
They rest in a den and live off stored body fat
They eat only snow and bark to stay alive
They slow down but keep hunting every few days
explanation: Bears rest inside a den or cave all winter and live off the fat they stored in their bodies.
fact_tl: Ang mga oso ay nagpapahinga sa loob ng lungga o kweba sa buong taglamig at nabubuhay sa naimbak nilang taba.
fact_bis: Ang mga oso mopahuway sulod sa langub o kweba sa tibuok tingtugnaw ug mabuhi sa tambok nga ilang natigom.

q: What is the name of the first set of teeth a person grows?
options: Permanent teeth
Wisdom teeth
Milk teeth or baby teeth
Molars
explanation: A person's first set of teeth is called milk teeth or baby teeth, and they grow in when we are babies.
fact_tl: Ang unang set ng ngipin ng tao ay tinatawag na gatas na ngipin, at ito ang lumalabas noong sanggol pa tayo.
fact_bis: Ang unang set sa ngipon sa tawo gitawag og gatas nga ngipon, ug kini mitubo samtang gamay pa kita.

q: Which lake is the deepest in the world?
options: Lake Victoria in Africa
Lake Baikal in Russia
Lake Superior in North America
Lake Titicaca in South America
explanation: The deepest lake in the world is Lake Baikal, located in Russia.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na lawa sa mundo ay ang Lake Baikal sa Russia.
fact_bis: Ang labing lawom nga lanaw sa kalibutan mao ang Lake Baikal sa Russia.

q: Salty water is a mixture. What is one way to tell it apart from a pure substance?
options: A mixture always looks darker than a pure substance
A mixture can have different amounts of each part, while a pure substance is always the same one thing
A mixture must always be a liquid, but a pure substance is a solid
A pure substance has more than one kind of particle, but a mixture has only one
explanation: A mixture like salty water is made of two or more things that can be in different amounts, while a pure substance is always just one kind and is exactly the same in every sample.
fact_tl: Ang isang paraan para malaman kung mixture o purong sangkap ang isang bagay: ang mixture ay gawa sa dalawa o higit pang bagay na puwedeng nasa iba't ibang dami (gaya ng tubig na may asin), samantalang ang purong sangkap ay laging iisang uri lang at parehong-pareho saan ka man kumuha.
fact_bis: Usa ka paagi aron mahibaw-an kon mixture o putli nga sustansya ang usa ka butang: ang mixture hinimo sa duha o sobra pa nga butang nga mahimong lainlain ang gidaghanon (sama sa tubig nga parat), samtang ang putli nga sustansya kanunay usa ra ka klase ug parehas gyud bisan asa ka mokuha.

q: Unlike most fish, what makes the mudskipper's eyes special?
options: They glow in the dark to attract prey
They are shaped to see clearly in air, not just in water
They can see colors that other fish cannot
They can close completely like human eyelids
explanation: The mudskipper's eyes are specially shaped to see clearly in air because it spends a lot of time out of the water on the mud.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng isda ay malabo ang paningin sa labas ng tubig, pero naiba ang mata ng mudskipper para makakita nang malinaw sa hangin. Ito ay dahil maraming oras itong gumugugol sa labas ng tubig, sa ibabaw ng putik.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa isda hanap ang panan-aw kon gawas sa tubig, apan ang mata sa mudskipper espesyal nga porma aron makakita nga klaro sa hangin. Kay daghan kini og oras nga gawas sa tubig, sa ibabaw sa lapok.

q: Whose faces appear on the front of the Philippine 500-peso banknote?
options: Jose Rizal and Andres Bonifacio
Manuel Quezon and Sergio Osmeña
Corazon Aquino and Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr.
Emilio Aguinaldo and Apolinario Mabini
explanation: Corazon Aquino and Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. appear on the front of the 500-peso banknote.
fact_tl: Sina Corazon Aquino at Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. ang nasa harap ng 500-piso na papel na pera.
fact_bis: Sila si Corazon Aquino ug Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. ang naa sa atubangan sa 500-piso nga papel nga kwarta.

q: When juice inside a plastic tube is placed in the freezer to make ice candy, what change happens to the juice?
options: It evaporates and disappears
It freezes and hardens into a solid
It turns into a gas inside the tube
It becomes a thicker liquid but stays liquid
explanation: When the liquid juice loses its heat to the cold freezer, it freezes and hardens — that is how ice candy is made.
fact_tl: Ang ice candy ay gawa sa juice o gatas na inilalagay sa manipis na plastik at iniyeyelo sa freezer. Kapag nawala na ang init ng likido papunta sa malamig na freezer, nag-freeze ito at tumitigas. Kapag inalis sa freezer, nagsisimula na itong matunaw muli.
fact_bis: Ang ice candy hinimo gikan sa juice o gatas nga gibutang sa nipis nga plastik ug gi-yelo sa freezer. Kon mawala na ang init sa likido ngadto sa bugnaw nga freezer, mo-yelo kini ug mogahi. Kon kuhaon sa freezer, magsugod na usab kini pagkatunaw.

q: Why is iron deficiency especially common in growing children?
options: Children eat mostly sweet foods that block iron
Children sleep more, so they use less iron
Growing children quickly need more blood, so they need more iron
Children's stomachs cannot absorb iron from food
explanation: Iron deficiency is common in growing children because they quickly need more blood as they grow.
fact_tl: Karaniwan ang kakulangan sa bakal sa mga lumalaking bata dahil mabilis silang nangangailangan ng mas maraming dugo.
fact_bis: Komon ang kakulang sa puthaw sa nagtubo nga mga bata kay paspas silang nanginahanglan ug mas daghang dugo.

q: Who led the first European expedition to reach the Philippines, arriving in 1521?
options: Vasco da Gama
Christopher Columbus
Juan de Salcedo
Ferdinand Magellan
explanation: Ferdinand Magellan led the first European expedition to reach the Philippines in 1521.
fact_tl: Si Ferdinand Magellan ang nanguna sa unang pangkat ng Europeo na nakarating sa Pilipinas noong 1521.
fact_bis: Si Ferdinand Magellan ang nanguna sa unang grupo sa mga Europeo nga miabot sa Pilipinas niadtong 1521.

q: Why can a single drop of water magnify small things like a lens?
options: Water absorbs light and slows it down completely
Its curved surface bends light toward your eye through refraction
Water has special chemicals that enlarge the image
It reflects light off its flat surface to make things look bigger
explanation: A water drop's curved surface bends light through refraction, directing it toward your eye so small objects appear magnified.
fact_tl: Ang isang patak ng tubig ay maaaring magpalaki ng tingin sa maliliit na bagay tulad ng lens, dahil ang kurbadong ibabaw nito ay nagbabaluktot ng liwanag (refraction) papunta sa mata mo.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka tulo sa tubig makapadako sa pagtan-aw sa gagmay nga mga butang sama sa lens, tungod kay ang kurbado niini nga ibabaw mobawog sa kahayag (refraction) paingon sa imong mata.

q: In which type of rock are fossils most commonly found?
options: Igneous rock
Metamorphic rock
Sedimentary rock
Volcanic rock
explanation: Fossils are most commonly found in sedimentary rock because it forms slowly in layers, trapping and preserving remains.
fact_tl: Karaniwang matatagpuan ang mga fosil sa sedimentary na bato dahil dahan-dahan itong nabubuo sa mga patong.
fact_bis: Ang mga fosil kasagarang makit-an sa sedimentary nga bato tungod kay hinay kini nga mabuo sa mga patong.

q: Why did Robert Hooke call the tiny units he saw under his microscope 'cells'?
options: They were shaped like small batteries called cells
They reminded him of the small rooms where monks lived
They looked like the cells of a honeycomb he was also studying
He named them after the Latin word for 'tiny bag'
explanation: Hooke called them 'cells' because they looked like the small rooms (cells) where monks lived.
fact_tl: Tinawag ni Robert Hooke na 'cell' ang mga ito dahil parang maliliit na kwarto (cells) ng mga monghe ang itsura.
fact_bis: Gitawag ni Robert Hooke kini og 'cell' tungod kay morag gagmay nga kwarto (cells) sa mga monghe ang ilang dagway.

q: What gas is released back into the air as a result of cellular respiration?
options: Oxygen
Nitrogen
Carbon monoxide
Carbon dioxide
explanation: In cellular respiration, sugar reacts with oxygen to release energy, and carbon dioxide is given off back into the air.
fact_tl: Sa selular na paghinga, nakikipagreaksyon ang asukal sa oxygen upang maglabas ng enerhiya para sa katawan, at nagbubuga ng carbon dioxide pabalik sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sa cellular respiration, ang asukal mareaksyon sa oxygen aron mahatag ang kusog alang sa lawas, ug magbuga ug carbon dioxide balik sa hangin.

q: What can happen to rivers and lakes when too much nitrogen fertilizer washes into them?
options: The water becomes too cold for fish to survive
Algae grows too much and harms the water
The water evaporates faster than normal
Rocks on the riverbed dissolve and disappear
explanation: Excess nitrogen fertilizer washed into rivers and lakes causes algae to grow too much, which harms the water.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang abonong nitrogen, naaanod ito sa mga ilog at lawa at nagdudulot ng labis na paglago ng lumot na nakakasama sa tubig.
fact_bis: Kon sobra ang abonong nitroheno, maanod kini ngadto sa mga suba ug lanaw ug maoy hinungdan sa sobrang pagtubo sa lumot nga makadaot sa tubig.

q: Which gland produces the growth hormone that helps your bones and muscles grow during childhood?
options: The thyroid gland
The pituitary gland
The adrenal gland
The pancreas
explanation: Growth hormone comes from the pituitary gland and helps bones and muscles grow taller and bigger during childhood.
fact_tl: Ang growth hormone na galing sa pituitary ang tumutulong sa pagtangkad at paglaki ng mga buto at kalamnan habang bata pa. Kaya mahalaga ito sa paglaki ng isang tao.
fact_bis: Ang growth hormone gikan sa pituitary motabang sa pagtaas ug pagtubo sa mga bukog ug kaunoran samtang bata pa. Mao nga importante kini sa pagtubo sa usa ka tawo.

q: What materials do birds collect from their surroundings to build their nests?
options: Only mud and clay from riverbanks
Only spider silk and soft cotton
Grass, twigs, leaves, feathers, and mud
Plastic, stones, and sand only
explanation: Birds collect nest materials from their surroundings, including grass, twigs, leaves, feathers, and mud.
fact_tl: Kinukuha ng ibon ang materyales para sa pugad mula sa paligid—damo, sanga, dahon, balahibo, at putik.
fact_bis: Ginakuha sa langgam ang materyales para sa salag gikan sa palibot—sagbot, sanga, dahon, balhibo, ug lapok.

q: What is the largest animal ever to have lived on Earth?
options: The African elephant
The great white shark
The blue whale
The giant squid
explanation: The largest animal ever to live is the blue whale, reaching up to about 30 meters long.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking hayop na nabuhay ay ang blue whale (balyena), na umaabot ng hanggang mga 30 metro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga hayop nga nabuhi mao ang blue whale (balyena), nga moabot hangtod mga 30 ka metros ang gitas-on.

q: About how long is one year on Neptune?
options: About 12 Earth years
About 29 Earth years
About 84 Earth years
About 165 Earth years
explanation: One year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years — it has the longest year of all the planets.
fact_tl: Ang isang taon sa Neptune ay tumatagal ng halos 165 taon ng Earth—ito ang pinakamahabang taon sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka tuig sa Neptune molungtad ug mga 165 ka tuig sa Yuta—kini ang pinakataas nga tuig sa tanang planeta.

q: In what year was the electron discovered?
explanation: The electron was discovered in the year 1897.
fact_tl: Natuklas ang electron noong taong 1897.
fact_bis: Ang electron nadiskubre niadtong tuig 1897.

q: What ability does a chameleon use to blend into its surroundings or show how it feels?
options: It puffs up its body to look like a rock
It changes the color of its skin
It releases a cloud of ink like a squid
It mimics the sounds of other animals nearby
explanation: The chameleon is a reptile that can change the color of its skin to blend in with its surroundings or to show its feelings.
fact_tl: Ang bunglon o chameleon ay isang reptilyang kayang baguhin ang kulay ng balat nito upang magtago o ipahayag ang kanyang kalagayan.
fact_bis: Ang chameleon usa ka reptilya nga makahimo sa pag-usab sa kolor sa iyang panit aron motago o mopakita sa iyang gibati.

q: In which U.S. state is Death Valley located?
options: Nevada
Arizona
Texas
California
explanation: Death Valley is located in California, United States.
fact_tl: Ang Death Valley ay matatagpuan sa California, Estados Unidos.
fact_bis: Ang Death Valley nahimutang sa California, Estados Unidos.

q: Why is the Philippines a good place for using solar panels?
options: It has many strong rivers that power the panels
It gets plenty of sunlight all year long
Its soil has minerals that make solar panels work better
It is close to the equator where electricity is cheaper
explanation: The Philippines gets plenty of sunlight all year, making it well suited for using solar panels to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay tumatanggap ng maraming sikat ng araw buong taon, kaya angkop ito sa paggamit ng solar panel.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas makadawat ug daghang sidlak sa adlaw tibuok tuig, mao nga angay kini sa paggamit ug solar panel.

q: How does COVID-19 mainly spread from a sick person to others?
options: Through touching doorknobs only
Through tiny droplets that come out when a sick person coughs, sneezes, or talks
Through drinking water from the same glass
Through mosquito bites
explanation: COVID-19 spreads through tiny droplets of spit or mist released when a sick person coughs, sneezes, or talks, which can be breathed in or land on another person's face.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang COVID-19 sa pamamagitan ng napakaliliit na patak ng laway o usok na lumalabas kapag umuubo, bumabahin, o nag-uusap ang isang taong may sakit. Kapag nalanghap o napunta ito sa mata, ilong, o bibig ng iba, maaari silang mahawa. Kaya nakakatulong ang pananatili sa malayo at pagsuot ng mask.
fact_bis: Mokatap ang COVID-19 pinaagi sa gagmay kaayo nga tulo sa laway o aso nga mogawas kung mo-ubo, mobahin, o mag-istorya ang tawo nga adunay sakit. Kung masuyop kini o motugpa sa mata, ilong, o baba sa uban, mahimo silang matakdan. Mao nga makatabang ang pagpalayo ug pagsul-ob og mask.

q: Why can a refinery separate crude oil into gasoline, kerosene, and diesel?
options: Because crude oil is a pure substance with one boiling point
Because crude oil is a mixture of many different liquid hydrocarbons
Because crude oil contains dissolved minerals that separate easily
Because heat turns all crude oil into diesel first, then into gasoline
explanation: Crude oil is a mixture of many different liquids called hydrocarbons, so a refinery can separate it into products like gasoline, kerosene, and diesel.
fact_tl: Ang krudo ay hindi iisang sangkap kundi isang halo ng maraming magkakaibang likido na tinatawag na hydrocarbons. Dahil dito, kayang ihiwalay ang krudo sa refinery para gawing gasolina, gaas, diesel, at iba pa, bawat isa may sariling gamit.
fact_bis: Ang krudo dili usa lang ka sangkap kondili usa ka sagol sa daghang lahi nga likido nga gitawag og hydrocarbons. Tungod niini, mabahin sa refinery ang krudo aron mahimong gasolina, gaas, diesel, ug uban pa, ang matag usa adunay kaugalingong gamit.

q: Why do clouds form high up in the sky?
options: Cold air sinks and pushes water vapor upward into clouds
Warm air rises, cools as it goes up, and the cooling causes clouds to form
Wind blows flat ground water straight up until it becomes cloud
The sun heats the top of the sky more than the bottom, making clouds form up there
explanation: As warm air carrying water vapor rises, it cools, and this cooling causes clouds to form high up.
fact_tl: Habang pumapaitaas ang mainit na hangin na may singaw, lumalamig ito, at ang paglamig na ito ang dahilan kung bakit nabubuo ang ulap sa itaas.
fact_bis: Samtang mosaka ang init nga hangin nga nagdala og alisngaw, mobugnaw kini, ug kining pagbugnaw mao ang hinungdan nganong maporma ang panganod sa taas.

q: Why is carbon monoxide called a 'silent killer'?
options: It kills plants silently without harming people at first
It is invisible and has no smell, so you cannot detect it without a special alarm
It moves silently through walls and floors into sleeping areas
It only appears at night when people cannot see it
explanation: Carbon monoxide is colorless, odorless, and tasteless, so you cannot see or smell it even when it is in the air — that is why it is dangerously hard to detect.
fact_tl: Ang carbon monoxide ay walang kulay, walang amoy, at walang lasa, kaya hindi mo ito maaamoy o makikita kahit nasa hangin na. Dahil dito tinatawag itong 'silent killer' — hindi mo alam na nakalanghap ka na hangga't masama na ang pakiramdam mo.
fact_bis: Ang carbon monoxide walay kolor, walay baho, ug walay lami, busa dili nimo kini masimhot o makita bisan naa na sa hangin. Mao nga gitawag kini og 'silent killer' — wala ka kahibalo nga nakaginhawa ka na hangtod nga grabe na ang imong gibati.

q: When gold is purified, what actually happens?
options: The gold atoms are split into smaller particles
Other substances mixed with the gold are removed, but the gold itself stays whole
The gold melts and fuses with new atoms to become purer
The gold is burned and then re-formed as a purer element
explanation: Purifying gold only removes other mixed-in substances — the element gold cannot be broken down and stays whole.
fact_tl: Kapag dinadalisay ang ginto, inaalis lang ang ibang sangkap na nakahalo dito—hindi hinahati ang ginto. Ang gintong elemento ay nananatiling buo at hindi mabubungkag.
fact_bis: Kung lunsayon ang bulawan, ang ubang sagol nga substansiya lang ang gikuha—dili gibahin ang bulawan. Ang elemento nga bulawan magpabilin nga tibuok ug dili mabungkag.

q: Why does the water in a bucket not spill when you spin the bucket fast in a circle?
options: Gravity is too weak at the top of the circle to pull the water out
The constant circular motion keeps pressing the water against the bottom of the bucket
Air pressure seals the top of the bucket when it spins
The water freezes briefly each time the bucket is upside down
explanation: When you spin a bucket fast in a circle, the constant circular motion keeps pressing the water against the bucket's bottom so it does not spill.
fact_tl: Kapag mabilis mong iniikot ang timba na may tubig nang pabilog, hindi natatapon ang tubig dahil ang patuloy na pag-ikot ay itinutulak ito laban sa ilalim ng timba.
fact_bis: Kon imong tuyokon paspas ang timba nga may tubig sa lingin, dili mayabo ang tubig tungod kay ang padayon nga pagtuyok mag-ipit niini batok sa ilawom sa timba.

q: How long can the gestation period of some sharks, like the spiny dogfish, last?
options: About one month
About three to four months
About nine months, the same as humans
Up to 24 months
explanation: Some sharks, such as the spiny dogfish, have extremely long gestation periods of up to 24 months — among the longest of any vertebrate.
fact_tl: Ang ilang pating (tulad ng spiny dogfish shark) ay may napakahaba na gestasyon — hanggang 24 na buwan — isa sa pinakamatagal sa lahat ng vertebrate.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka pating (sama sa spiny dogfish shark) adunay labing haba nga panahon sa pagmabdos — hangtod sa 24 ka bulan — usa sa pinaka-haba sa tanan nga vertebrate.

q: Why is gold used inside cellphones and computers?
options: It is very light and makes devices weigh less
It stays shiny so screens look better
It conducts electricity very well
It is magnetic so it helps signals travel faster
explanation: Gold is used in electronics because it conducts electricity very well, making it reliable for connections inside devices.
fact_tl: Ginagamit din ang ginto sa mga cellphone at kompyuter dahil mahusay itong magdaloy ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan gigamit usab sa mga cellphone ug kompyuter tungod kay maayo kini modala og kuryente.

q: About how many typhoons enter the Philippines in a typical year?
options: About 5
About 10
About 20
About 40
explanation: About 20 typhoons enter the Philippines each year, making it one of the most typhoon-hit countries on Earth.
fact_tl: Mga 20 na bagyo ang pumapasok sa Pilipinas bawat taon, kaya ito ang isa sa pinakamadalas tamaan ng bagyo sa mundo.
fact_bis: Mga 20 ka bagyo ang mosulod sa Pilipinas matag tuig, mao nga usa kini sa kanunay maigo sa bagyo sa kalibotan.

q: How do vaccines help protect even people who cannot receive them, like very young babies?
options: Vaccinated people release healing chemicals into the air
When most people are vaccinated, the disease can barely spread, protecting those who cannot get the vaccine
Vaccines travel through food and water to reach unvaccinated people
Babies absorb protection from vaccinated adults through touch
explanation: When most people in a community are vaccinated, the disease has a hard time spreading, so even babies or sick people who cannot get vaccinated are protected.
fact_tl: Kapag karamihan sa isang komunidad ay bakunado, mahihirapang kumalat ang sakit. Sa ganitong paraan, naprotektahan din ang mga sanggol o maysakit na hindi pa pwedeng mabakunahan.
fact_bis: Kung kadaghanan sa usa ka komunidad nabakunahan, lisod mokaylap ang sakit. Niini nga paagi, bisan ang mga masuso o masakiton nga dili pa makabakuna mapanalipdan usab.

q: In some kinds of starfish, what amazing thing can a single broken arm do if it has a piece of the center attached?
options: It can swim on its own but cannot feed
It can grow into a completely new starfish
It attaches to the nearest rock and turns into coral
It hardens into a shell to protect itself
explanation: In some kinds of starfish, a single broken arm with a piece of the center can grow into a whole new animal.
fact_tl: Sa ilang uri ng bituin sa dagat, ang isang putol na braso na may kapiraso ng gitna ay maaaring tumubong buong bagong hayop.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka matang sa bituon sa dagat, ang usa ka naputol nga bukton nga adunay bahin sa tunga makatubo nga usa ka tibuok bag-ong hayop.

q: Where does ultraviolet light sit on the spectrum compared to visible light?
options: Just beyond the red end, with a longer wavelength than red light
In the middle of visible light, between green and blue
Just beyond the violet end, with a shorter wavelength than violet
It overlaps with visible light so it can be seen by humans
explanation: Ultraviolet lies just beyond the violet end of visible light, meaning its wavelength is shorter than violet.
fact_tl: Ang ultraviolet ay nasa labas ng violet na dulo ng visible light, kaya mas maikli ang wavelength nito kaysa violet.
fact_bis: Ang ultraviolet naa unahan sa violet nga tumoy sa visible light, mao nga mas mubo ang wavelength niini kaysa violet.

q: How do microplastic fibers get into the water when you do laundry?
options: Detergent reacts with plastic bags left in pockets
Washing machines grind up plastic beads added to detergent
Clothes made of polyester or nylon release thousands of tiny plastic fibers that flow out with the wash water
Plastic buttons dissolve in hot water and turn into microfibers
explanation: Washing clothes made of polyester or nylon releases thousands of tiny plastic microfibers that flow out with the water from the washing machine.
fact_tl: Alam mo bang ang paglalaba ng damit na yari sa polyester o nylon ay naglalabas ng libo-libong maliliit na hibla ng plastik? Dumadaloy ang mga microfiber na ito sa tubig na umaagos palabas ng washing machine.
fact_bis: Nahibalo ka ba nga ang paglaba sa sinina nga hinimo sa polyester o nylon mopagawas og linibo ka gagmay nga hibla sa plastik? Kini nga mga microfiber moagas uban sa tubig nga mogawas sa washing machine.

q: What makes Laguna de Bay a lake and not a river?
options: It is saltwater, while a river is always fresh water
It is a large body of water surrounded by land that does not flow quickly in one direction, unlike a river
It is underground, while rivers flow on the surface
It is too shallow to be called a river
explanation: Laguna de Bay is a large body of water surrounded by land that does not flow quickly, which is what makes it a lake rather than a river like the Pasig River.
fact_tl: Ang Laguna de Bay ay isang lawa, hindi ilog—ibig sabihin, ito ay malaking tubig na napapaligiran ng lupa at hindi mabilis umaagos. Ang ilog naman, gaya ng Pasig River, ay patuloy na umaagos papunta sa ibang lugar.
fact_bis: Ang Laguna de Bay usa ka lanaw, dili suba—buot ipasabot, dako kini nga tubig nga gilibutan sa yuta nga dili paspas moagos. Ang suba pod, sama sa Pasig River, padayon nga moagos paingon sa laing dapit.

q: Why did the official count of Philippine islands grow from 7,107 to about 7,641?
options: New islands were formed by volcanic eruptions
The government reclaimed land from the sea to add new islands
Modern satellites and maps found more islands that were not counted before
Islands from other countries were added to the Philippines
explanation: When modern satellites and maps were used, more islands were discovered, so the official count grew from 7,107 to about 7,641.
fact_tl: Noong una ay 7,107 isla ang bilang, pero nang gumamit ng modernong satellite at mapa, mas marami palang pulo ang nakita kaya naging humigit-kumulang 7,641 ang opisyal na bilang.
fact_bis: Sa sinugdan 7,107 ka isla ang giihap, apan dihang migamit og modernong satellite ug mapa, mas daghang pulo ang nakita, mao nga ang opisyal nga ihap nahimong mga 7,641.

q: Why does a silver spoon turn dark over time?
options: Silver slowly absorbs water from the air and swells
Silver rusts the same way iron does when exposed to oxygen
Silver reacts with sulfur in the air to form a thin black layer of silver sulfide
Silver changes color when it gets too cold or too hot
explanation: A silver spoon darkens because silver reacts with sulfur in the air, forming a thin black layer of silver sulfide — a chemical change.
fact_tl: Nangingitim ang pilak na kutsara kapag ang pilak ay nakikipagreaksyon sa sulfur sa hangin, na bumubuo ng manipis na itim na silver sulfide—isang pagbabagong kemikal.
fact_bis: Mongitngit ang plata nga kutsara tungod kay ang plata mo-react sa sulfur sa hangin, nga maghimo og nipis nga itom nga silver sulfide—usa ka kemikal nga pagbag-o.

q: What is the regional center (capital) of Caraga (Region XIII) in Mindanao?
options: Cagayan de Oro
Davao City
General Santos
Butuan
explanation: Caraga (Region XIII) is located in Mindanao and its regional center is Butuan City.
fact_tl: Ang Caraga (XIII) ay isa sa 18 rehiyon ng Pilipinas, matatagpuan sa Mindanao. Binubuo ito ng 5 na lalawigan: Agusan del Norte, Agusan del Sur, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur. Ang sentrong rehiyonal nito ay Butuan.
fact_bis: Ang Caraga (XIII) usa sa 18 ka rehiyon sa Pilipinas, nahimutang sa Mindanao. Gilangkoban kini sa 5 ka probinsya: Agusan del Norte, Agusan del Sur, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur. Ang sentro nga rehiyonal niini mao ang Butuan.

q: Where do many Filipino families grow jackfruit?
options: Only in large plantations far from cities
In backyards, since it is a common fruit in the Philippines
Only along riverbanks where the soil is wet
In greenhouses because it needs special care
explanation: Jackfruit is a common fruit in the Philippines and is often planted in backyards.
fact_tl: Ang langka ay karaniwang prutas sa Pilipinas at madalas itong itanim sa mga bakuran.
fact_bis: Ang nangka usa ka kasagarang prutas sa Pilipinas ug kanunay kining itanom sa mga nataran.

q: What does the rounded shape of the pebbles in conglomerate rock tell us about how they got there?
options: The pebbles were rounded by volcanic heat that melted their sharp edges
The pebbles were shaped by wind carving away the corners slowly
The pebbles were carried and smoothed by fast-moving river water before being cemented together
The pebbles are naturally round because that is how minerals grow underground
explanation: The rounded shape of the pebbles in conglomerate shows they were transported and worn smooth by fast-moving river water before being cemented together by minerals.
fact_tl: Ang conglomerate ay isang sedimentary rock na binubuo ng mga bilog na bato-bato (pebbles) na pinagsamang-sama ng simento na mineral; ang pag-ikid ng mga bato ay nagpapakita na dinala sila ng mabilis na tubig ng ilog.
fact_bis: Ang conglomerate usa ka sedimentary rock nga gihimo sa lingin nga mga bato-bato (pebbles) nga gisemento sa mga mineral; ang lingin nga hitsura sa mga bato nagpakita nga gidala sila sa paspas nga tubig sa suba.

q: What happens to electrons when you rub two objects together?
options: Electrons are created between the two objects
Electrons are destroyed and turn into heat
Electrons move from one object to the other
Electrons double in number inside both objects
explanation: When two objects are rubbed together, tiny particles called electrons move from one object to the other, creating static electricity.
fact_tl: Kapag kinuskos mo ang dalawang bagay, lumilipat ang maliliit na particle na tinatawag na electron mula sa isa patungo sa isa.
fact_bis: Kon kuskuson nimo ang duha ka butang, ang gagmayng partikulo nga gitawag og electron mobalhin gikan sa usa paingon sa lain.

q: How do Filipino farmers mainly use the carabao?
options: They use it to pull fishing boats to the shore
They use it to plow fields, and it cools itself by wallowing in mud
They train it to carry heavy loads on mountain trails
They keep it mainly for its milk, which is used to make butter
explanation: The carabao is a large animal Filipino farmers use to plow fields, and it likes to wallow in mud to cool down.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay malaking hayop na ginagamit ng mga magsasaka sa Pilipinas para mag-araro ng bukid, at gusto nitong maglublob sa putik para lumamig.
fact_bis: Ang kabaw usa ka dakong hayop nga gigamit sa mga mag-uuma sa Pilipinas aron mag-daro sa uma, ug ganahan kini molubog sa lapok aron mabugnaw.

q: What do we call an animal that hunts and eats other animals?
options: A scavenger
A predator
A herbivore
A parasite
explanation: A predator is an animal that hunts and eats other animals, while the animal that gets hunted is called the prey.
fact_tl: Ang mananakop ay hayop na humuhuli at kumakain ng ibang hayop, at ang hinuhuling hayop ay tinatawag na biktima o prey.
fact_bis: Ang manghuhuli (predator) usa ka hayop nga mangita ug mokaon sa ubang hayop, ug ang gipangita nga hayop gitawag nga biktima o prey.

q: Roughly how many Earths could fit inside the Sun?
options: About 1.3 million
About 13,000
About 130,000
About 13 million
explanation: The Sun is so enormous that about 1.3 million Earths could fit inside it.
fact_tl: Halos 1.3 milyong Earth ang kasya sa loob ng Araw.
fact_bis: Mga 1.3 ka milyon ka Yuta ang mahaom sulod sa Adlaw.

q: What is kundiman best known for?
options: A traditional Philippine song with a sweet melody that expresses love for the country
A lively folk dance performed at harvest festivals in the Visayas
A military march played during national holiday parades
A chant sung by fishermen to call for calm seas
explanation: Kundiman is a traditional Philippine song known for its sweet and gentle melody that expresses love and affection for the country.
fact_tl: Ang kundiman ay isang uri ng tradisyonal na awit ng Pilipinas na nagpapahayag ng pag-ibig at pagmamahal sa bansa, kilala sa matamis at malambot na melodiya nito.
fact_bis: Ang kundiman usa ka klase sa tradisyonal nga awit sa Pilipinas nga nagpahayag sa gugma ug pagmahal sa nasod, bantog sa matam-is ug humok niining melodiya.

q: Why do migratory birds visit Philippine mudflats during their long journeys?
options: To rest and feed before continuing their journey
To lay their eggs in the warm mud
To escape typhoons that form over open water
To find freshwater streams flowing into the sea
explanation: Migratory birds use Philippine mudflats as resting and feeding stops during their long journeys between their breeding and wintering grounds.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga ibong dayo (migratory) ang mga putikan ng Pilipinas bilang pahingahan at pakainan tuwing sila ay naglalakbay.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga molalin (migratory) mogamit sa mga lapokon sa Pilipinas isip pahulayan ug kan-anan panahon sa ilang taas nga panaw.

q: What is inside a kwek-kwek besides the orange batter on the outside?
options: A real whole quail egg with egg white and a yolk
A ball of fish paste shaped to look like an egg
A hard-boiled chicken egg cut into quarters
A mixture of tofu and food coloring
explanation: Despite what some people think, the inside of kwek-kwek is a real whole quail egg that still has egg white and a yellow yolk — only the batter is added on the outside.
fact_tl: May iniisip na peke o gawa-gawa lang ang loob ng kwek-kwek, pero ang totoo ay tunay na buong itlog ng pugo ang nasa loob. May puti at dilaw na yolk pa rin ito tulad ng ordinaryong itlog. Ang masa lang ang idinagdag sa labas.
fact_bis: Naay naghunahuna nga peke o himo-himo ra ang sulod sa kwek-kwek, pero ang tinuod usa ka tinuod nga tibuok itlog sa pugo ang naa sa sulod. Naa gihapon ni puti ug dilaw nga yolk sama sa ordinaryong itlog. Ang batter ra ang gidugang sa gawas.

q: What raw material is used to make most modern synthetic rubber?
options: Petroleum-derived chemicals
Latex sap tapped from rubber trees
Recycled plastic bottles
Coal ash mixed with plant oil
explanation: Most modern rubber is synthetic, made from chemicals like styrene and butadiene that come from petroleum.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan sa modernong goma ay synthetic — gawa mula sa mga kemikal na kinuha sa petrolyo — at ginagamit sa mga gulong, guwantes, at tsinelas.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa modernong goma synthetic — gihimo gikan sa mga kemikal nga kinuha sa petrolyo sama sa styrene ug butadiene — ug gigamit sa mga gulong, gwantes, ug tsinelas.

q: Which two elements does the Big Bang theory explain are present in just the right amounts in the universe?
options: Hydrogen and helium
Oxygen and carbon
Nitrogen and neon
Iron and silicon
explanation: The Big Bang explains why the universe contains hydrogen and helium in just the right proportions, which serves as supporting evidence for the theory.
fact_tl: Maipapaliwanag ng Big Bang kung bakit puno ang uniberso ng hydrogen at helium sa tamang dami—isa pang patunay ng teorya.
fact_bis: Masaysay sa Big Bang nganong puno ang uniberso sa hydrogen ug helium sa husto nga gidaghanon—lain pang pamatuod sa teorya.

q: What do the small structures lining an octopus's arms help it do?
options: Grip and hold on to things
Sense light and color changes
Inject venom into prey
Absorb oxygen from the water
explanation: An octopus's arms are lined with many small suckers that allow it to grip and hold on to objects.
fact_tl: Ang mga braso ng pugita ay may maraming maliliit na sipsip (suckers) na nakakadikit sa mga bagay.
fact_bis: Ang mga bukton sa pugita adunay daghang gagmay nga suckers nga makakapyot sa mga butang.

q: How does a barnacle attach itself permanently to a surface?
options: It releases a soft liquid glue that then hardens like cement
It uses tiny hooked claws that dig into the rock
It spins sticky silk threads like a spider
It melts the rock surface with acid and sinks in
explanation: A barnacle secretes a glue that starts out as a soft liquid and then hardens into a tough cement-like substance, locking it in place.
fact_tl: Lumalabas muna bilang malambot na likido ang pandikit ng barnacle, tapos tumitigas ito at nagiging matibay na parang semento.
fact_bis: Ang pandikit sa barnacle mogawas una nga humok nga likido, dayon mogahi kini ug mahimong lig-on nga murag semento.

q: When are lymph nodes present in your body?
options: All the time, even when you are perfectly healthy
Only when you have a cold or infection
Only during childhood, then they disappear
Only after you have been vaccinated
explanation: Lymph nodes are always present in the body even when you are healthy; they only become enlarged and easier to feel when they are actively fighting an illness.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na lumilitaw lang ang lymph node kapag may sakit. Hindi totoo iyon: laging nandiyan ang mga ito kahit malusog ka, pero mas maliit at hindi mo sila madaling maramdaman. Lumalaki lang sila kapag nilalabanan ang sakit.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga motungha lang ang lymph node kon magsakit. Dili tinuod kana: kanunay sila naa bisan himsog ka, gamay lang ug lisod bation. Modako lang sila kon makig-away sa sakit.

q: How far does the Moon move away from Earth every year?
options: About 3.8 centimetres
About 38 centimetres
About 3.8 metres
About 38 metres
explanation: Tidal friction transfers Earth's rotational energy into the Moon's orbital energy, causing the Moon to drift about 3.8 centimetres farther from Earth each year.
fact_tl: Ang Moon ay dahan-dahang lumalayo sa Earth sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 3.8 sentimetro bawat taon; ito ay dulot ng tidal friction na nag-iilipat ng rotational energy ng Earth patungo sa orbital energy ng Moon. Ito ay nasusukat gamit ang mga laser reflector na iniwan ng Apollo astronaut sa Moon.
fact_bis: Ang Moon hinay-hinay nga nagpalayo sa Yuta sa bilis nga mga 3.8 sentimetro matag tuig; kini tungod sa tidal friction nga nag-transfer sa rotational energy sa Yuta ngadto sa orbital energy sa Moon. Kini gisukat gamit ang mga laser reflector nga gibiyaan sa Moon sa mga Apollo astronaut.

q: How hot does the surface of Venus get?
options: About 465°C, hot enough to melt lead
About 120°C, roughly like a very hot oven
About 1,000°C, close to volcanic lava
About 60°C, like a very hot desert day
explanation: The surface of Venus reaches about 465°C due to its thick atmosphere and runaway greenhouse effect — hot enough to melt lead.
fact_tl: Umaabot sa mga 465°C ang init ng ibabaw ng Venus — sapat para matunaw ang tingga.
fact_bis: Ang ibabaw sa Venus moabot ug mga 465°C nga kainit — igo na nga matunaw ang tingga.

q: Where is Philippine money produced?
options: At the Security Plant Complex of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
At the Bureau of the Treasury printing facility in Intramuros
At a private mint contracted by the Department of Finance
At the Philippine Mint under the Department of Trade and Industry
explanation: Philippine banknotes and coins are produced at the Security Plant Complex of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
fact_tl: Ginagawa ang pera ng Pilipinas sa Security Plant Complex ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang kwarta sa Pilipinas gihimo sa Security Plant Complex sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.

q: About how old is the Sun, and how much longer will it shine?
options: About 4.6 billion years old, with about 5 billion more years to go
About 1 billion years old, with about 1 billion more years to go
About 10 billion years old, with only a few million years left
About 4.6 million years old, still very young compared to other stars
explanation: The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old and is roughly halfway through its life, with enough hydrogen to keep shining for about 5 billion more years.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay halos 4.6 bilyong taon na ang edad at nasa kalagitnaan pa lang ng buhay nito — may sapat pa itong haydroheno para magningning ng mga 5 bilyong taon pa, kaya hindi tayo dapat mag-alala na mawawala ito sa loob ng mahabang-mahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw mga 4.6 ka bilyon na ka tuig ang edad ug tunga pa lang sa kinabuhi niini — aduna pa kini igong hydrogen aron modan-ag og mga 5 ka bilyon pa ka tuig, busa dili kita kinahanglan mabalaka nga mahurot kini sulod sa taas kaayo nga panahon.

q: Why does a colugo glide using its patagium instead of climbing down and walking to another tree?
options: Gliding saves energy and is safer than going down to the ground and climbing back up
Colugos cannot grip bark tightly, so climbing trees is impossible for them
The patagium cools the colugo's body during the hot daytime hours
Gliding helps the colugo spot predators from above before landing
explanation: Gliding with its patagium lets a colugo reach another tree quickly using almost no energy, avoiding the dangerous effort of climbing down, walking on the ground, and scaling a new tree.
fact_tl: Bakit dumudulas ang colugo sa halip na bumaba at umakyat ulit? Dahil mas nakakatipid ito ng lakas. Kung bababa sa lupa, maglalakad, at aakyat muli sa mataas na puno, napakahirap at mapanganib. Sa isang glide lang gamit ang patagium, mabilis itong nakakarating sa ibang puno nang halos hindi gumagastos ng lakas.
fact_bis: Ngano nga modahili ang colugo imbis nga manaog ug mosaka pag-usab? Kay makatipig ni og kusog. Kung manaog sa yuta, molakaw, ug mosaka pag-usab sa taas nga kahoy, lisod kaayo ug delikado. Sa usa ka glide lang gamit ang patagium, paspas ni nga makaabot sa laing kahoy nga halos walay gasto nga kusog.

q: In what year did Samuel Morse send the first official telegraph message?
explanation: Samuel Morse sent the first official telegraph message in 1844, marking a milestone in long-distance communication.
fact_tl: Ang unang opisyal na mensahe sa telegraph ay ipinadala ni Samuel Morse noong taong 1844.
fact_bis: Ang unang opisyal nga mensahe sa telegraph gipadala ni Samuel Morse niadtong tuig 1844.

q: Where do many short-period comets come from?
options: The Kuiper belt, when gravity nudges icy objects toward the inner solar system
The asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter
The Sun's outer corona, where solar wind launches debris
The Oort cloud at the very edge of the solar system
explanation: Many short-period comets originate in the Kuiper belt, where gravitational nudges send icy objects falling inward toward the inner solar system.
fact_tl: Maraming kometang mabilis bumalik (short-period comet) ang nagmumula sa Kuiper belt, kapag may grabidad na humila sa isang yelong bagay papasok patungong loob na bahagi ng solar system.
fact_bis: Daghang kometa nga paspas mobalik (short-period comet) gikan sa Kuiper belt, kon adunay grabidad nga mobira sa usa ka bugnaw nga butang paingon sa sulod nga bahin sa solar system.

q: What makes a species a 'keystone' species?
options: It has a very large effect on its ecosystem even though it may not be the most numerous animal
It is the largest predator living at the top of the food chain
It produces the most offspring and spreads across the widest area
It has been on Earth longer than any other species in its habitat
explanation: A keystone species has a disproportionately large effect on its ecosystem relative to how abundant it is — removing it can trigger dramatic changes throughout the ecosystem.
fact_tl: Ang keystone species ay isang species na may malaking epekto sa ekosistema higit sa inaasahan batay sa dami nito — ang pag-alis ng isang keystone species ay maaaring magdulot ng malaking pagbabago sa buong ekosistema.
fact_bis: Ang keystone species usa ka species nga adunay dili proporsyonal nga dako nga epekto sa iyang ekosistema kumpara sa iyang kadaghan — ang pagtangtang sa usa ka keystone species mahimong magpagana og dramatikong pagbag-o sa ekosistema.

q: According to Ohm's law, how do you calculate the current in a circuit?
options: Divide the voltage by the resistance
Multiply the voltage by the resistance
Divide the resistance by the voltage
Add the voltage and the resistance together
explanation: Ohm's law states that current (I) equals voltage (V) divided by resistance (R), written as I = V/R.
fact_tl: Ayon sa Batas ni Ohm, ang dami ng kuryenteng dumadaloy sa isang sirkito ay katumbas ng boltahe na hinati sa resistensya (I = V/R).
fact_bis: Sumala sa Balaod ni Ohm, ang gidaghanon sa koryente nga moagi sa usa ka sirkito katumbas sa boltahe nga gibahin sa resistensya (I = V/R).

q: How do female aphids reproduce so quickly?
options: They give birth to live young directly, even without a male
They lay hundreds of eggs at once in a single clutch
They split their body in two, and each half becomes a new aphid
They attach their eggs to ants, which carry and protect them
explanation: Aphids multiply very rapidly because females can give birth to live young directly, even without mating with a male.
fact_tl: Mabilis dumami ang aphid dahil ang mga babae ay maaaring direktang manganak ng buhay na anak nang walang lalaki.
fact_bis: Paspas modaghan ang aphid kay ang mga baye makahimugso direkta ug buhing anak bisan walay laki.

q: How do mangrove forests help the climate?
options: They store a large amount of carbon in their soil
They reflect sunlight back into space, cooling the ocean
They release oxygen in greater amounts than any other forest
They filter carbon dioxide out of seawater before it reaches the air
explanation: Mangroves store a lot of carbon in their soil, which helps slow climate change by keeping that carbon out of the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan ay nag-iimbak ng maraming carbon sa lupa nito kaya nakakatulong ito sa klima.
fact_bis: Ang bakhaw magtipig og daghang carbon sa iyang yuta, busa makatabang kini sa klima.

q: What can rice straw and rice husk be used for after the grains are harvested?
options: The straw can feed animals and the husk can become fuel or compost
The straw is burned in fields and the husk is buried as garbage
The straw is woven into baskets and the husk is ground into flour
Both straw and husk are soaked in water and turned into rice paper
explanation: Almost nothing from rice is wasted because the straw can feed animals and the husk can be turned into fuel or compost.
fact_tl: Halos walang nasasayang sa palay dahil ang dayami ay pwedeng pakain sa hayop at ang ipa ay gawing panggatong o abono.
fact_bis: Halos walay mausik sa humay kay ang uhot mahimong ipakaon sa mga hayop ug ang upa mahimong sugnod o abono.

q: When is the Coriolis effect strongest?
options: When air moves faster and travels over longer distances
When air is cold and moves in short, local bursts
When the wind blows directly along the equator
When air rises quickly in thunderstorm clouds
explanation: The Coriolis effect is larger when air moves faster and covers greater distances, which is why it shapes huge storms but is unnoticeable for small puffs of wind.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang Coriolis effect kapag mas mabilis ang hangin at mas malayo ang nilalakbay nito, kaya ramdam ito sa malalaking bagyo pero hindi sa maliliit na hangin.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang Coriolis effect kon mas paspas ang hangin ug mas layo ang giagian niini, mao nga importante kini sa dagkong bagyo apan dili sa gagmay nga hangin.

q: What kind of food helps keep your blood healthy?
options: Iron-rich foods as part of a balanced diet
Only citrus fruits high in vitamin C
Dairy products like milk and cheese
Foods high in sugar for quick energy
explanation: Eating a balanced diet with enough iron-rich foods provides the iron that the blood needs to stay healthy.
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng balanse at sapat na pagkaing mayaman sa bakal ay tumutulong na panatilihing malusog ang dugo.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon ug balanse ug igong pagkaon nga dato sa puthaw makatabang nga himsog ang dugo.

q: Why does white light split into different colors when it passes through a prism or raindrop?
options: Each color bends by a slightly different amount, so they separate
White light is actually made of only three colors that mix together
The glass absorbs some colors and lets others through
The colors were always separate but too close together to see
explanation: When white light enters a prism or raindrop, each color bends (refracts) by a slightly different amount, causing them to spread apart and form a rainbow.
fact_tl: Kapag dumaan ang puting liwanag sa isang prism o sa patak ng ulan, nahahati ito sa iba't ibang kulay tulad ng bahaghari. Nangyayari ito dahil bawat kulay ay yumuyuko nang bahagyang magkaiba, kaya nahihiwalay sila.
fact_bis: Kung mutadlas ang puti nga kahayag sa usa ka prism o sa tulo sa ulan, mabahin kini sa nagkalainlaing kolor sama sa balangaw. Mahitabo kini tungod kay ang matag kolor mubawog og gamay nga lahi, maong magbulag sila.

q: What is oral rehydration solution (ORS) made of, and what is it used for?
options: A mix of water, salt, and sugar used to restore fluids in a person with diarrhea
A syrup of vitamins and minerals given to prevent colds
A liquid medicine made from herbs that lowers fever quickly
A blend of fruit juice and electrolytes that boosts athletic performance
explanation: Oral rehydration solution is a simple mix of water, salt, and sugar that helps restore lost fluids in a person suffering from diarrhea.
fact_tl: Ang oresol, isang halo ng tubig, asin, at asukal, ay tumutulong na maibalik ang tubig sa katawan ng taong may pagtatae.
fact_bis: Ang oresol, usa ka sagol nga tubig, asin, ug asukar, makatabang sa pagbalik sa tubig sa lawas sa tawong nagkalibang.

q: Where does the word 'ozone' come from?
options: A Greek word meaning 'to smell', because ozone has a sharp, noticeable scent
A Latin word for 'blue sky', because it makes the sky appear blue
A scientist's name, after the man who first discovered the gas
A Japanese word for 'lightning bolt', where it was first studied
explanation: The word ozone comes from a Greek word meaning 'to smell', reflecting the sharp odor that ozone produces, sometimes noticed near lightning or electrical machines.
fact_tl: Ang salitang ozone ay galing sa Griyegong salita na ang ibig sabihin ay 'amoy'. May matarik na amoy ang ozone na minsang naaamoy malapit sa kidlat o sa mga makinang gumagamit ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang pulong ozone gikan sa Griyegong pulong nga nagkahulogan og 'baho' o 'simhot'. Ang ozone adunay hait nga baho nga usahay masimhotan duol sa kilat o sa mga makina nga mugamit og koryente.

q: How is sea-level rise in parts of the Philippines different from the global average?
options: Sea level in parts of the Philippines has been rising faster than the global average
Sea level in the Philippines has been rising more slowly because of its many islands
Sea level around the Philippines has stayed the same while the rest of the world rises
The Philippines experiences falling sea levels because of volcanic activity lifting the seafloor
explanation: In parts of the Philippines, sea level has been rising faster than the global average, making the country especially vulnerable to the effects of climate change.
fact_tl: Sa ilang bahagi ng Pilipinas, mas mabilis tumaas ang dagat kaysa sa pandaigdigang pamantayan.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka bahin sa Pilipinas, mas paspas mosaka ang dagat kaysa sa kasarangan sa kalibutan.

q: What happens to soil when trees and plants are removed from a hillside?
options: Rain washes away the rich topsoil more easily, making it hard for crops to grow
The bare soil absorbs more sunlight and becomes more fertile over time
Worms multiply quickly in bare soil, replacing the lost nutrients
Underground roots from neighboring plants quickly spread in and hold the soil
explanation: When trees and plants are removed, there are no roots to hold the soil in place, so rain washes away the rich topsoil, leaving ground that is poor for growing crops.
fact_tl: Kapag nawawala ang mga puno at halaman, mas madaling tangayin ng ulan ang mayamang topsoil, kaya nahihirapang tumubo ang mga pananim.
fact_bis: Kung mawala ang mga kahoy ug tanom, mas sayon nga banlasan sa ulan ang dato nga topsoil, mao nga maglisod og tubo ang mga tanom.

q: How many of the elements in the periodic table are man-made?
options: About 24 elements are man-made, created in laboratories
All elements are natural; none have been made by scientists
Only 2 elements are man-made: plutonium and einsteinium
More than 60 elements were created in laboratories
explanation: About 24 of the elements on the periodic table are synthetic, meaning scientists created them in laboratories rather than finding them in nature.
fact_tl: Mga 24 na elemento ang gawa ng tao (synthetic) sa laboratoryo.
fact_bis: Mga 24 ka elemento ang hinimo sa tawo (synthetic) sa laboratoryo.

q: What do you need to make a simple homemade compass?
options: A magnetized needle floating on water
A battery connected to a metal rod placed in soil
A glass lens focused on sunlight to point north
A coil of copper wire attached to a plastic arrow
explanation: You can build a simple compass by magnetizing a needle and placing it on water so it can rotate freely and align with Earth's magnetic field.
fact_tl: Makakagawa ka ng simpleng kompas sa pamamagitan ng paghihimagneto sa karayom at pagpapalutang nito sa tubig.
fact_bis: Makahimo ka ug yano nga compass pinaagi sa pag-magnetize sa dagom ug pagpalutaw niini sa tubig.

q: What are the two parts that make up secondhand smoke?
options: Smoke from the burning tip of the cigarette and smoke the smoker breathes back out
Smoke from the cigarette paper and smoke from the tobacco filter
Indoor smoke trapped by walls and outdoor smoke carried by wind
Chemical vapor from the lighter and tar released by the cigarette
explanation: Secondhand smoke is a mixture of smoke from the burning tip of the cigarette and the smoke the smoker exhales back into the air — both combine into what bystanders breathe.
fact_tl: May dalawang bahagi ang secondhand smoke. Una, ang usok na galing sa nagliliyab na dulo ng sigarilyo. Pangalawa, ang usok na ibinuga ng naninigarilyo pabalik sa hangin. Pinagsasama ang dalawa kaya nilalanghap ng mga tao sa paligid.
fact_bis: Ang secondhand smoke gihimo sa duha ka bahin. Una, ang aso gikan sa nagdilaab nga tumoy sa sigarilyo. Ikaduha, ang aso nga gibuga balik sa hangin sa nanigarilyo. Ang duha magsagol, ug mao kana ang ginaginhawa sa mga tawo nga duol.

q: How did most of the Philippines' mountain ranges, such as the Sierra Madre and Cordillera, form?
options: Tectonic plates converged and pushed the land upward through a process called tectonic uplift
Ancient volcanoes erupted repeatedly and piled up lava until they formed mountain ridges
Erosion carved valleys between flat areas, leaving tall sections that became mountains
Undersea ridges rose above sea level after massive earthquakes drained the surrounding ocean
explanation: Most Philippine mountain ranges formed by tectonic uplift — when plates converge, the land is pushed upward, and these mountains continue to rise a few millimetres each year.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan ng mga kabundukan ng Pilipinas (tulad ng Sierra Madre at Cordillera) ay nabubuo ng tectonic uplift: kapag ang mga plato ay nagtatagpo, ang lupa ay itinataas; ang mga kabundukang ito ay patuloy na tumatangkad nang ilang millimeter sa bawat taon habang nagtatagpo ang mga plato.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga bundok sa Pilipinas (sama sa Sierra Madre ug Cordillera) naporma sa tectonic uplift: kon ang mga plato magkomberhensiya, ang yuta giitsa sa ibabaw; kining mga bukid nagpadayon nga motaas og pipila ka millimeter matag tuig samtang nagbanggaan ang mga plato.

q: What unusual feature does a platypus have, even though it is a mammal?
options: A soft, duck-like bill
A hard shell like a turtle
Scales covering its entire body
Gills for breathing underwater
explanation: The platypus is a mammal but has a soft, duck-like bill, which is one of the features that makes it one of the most unusual animals in the world.
fact_tl: Ang platypus ay may malambot na tuka na parang sa pato kahit ito ay isang mammal.
fact_bis: Ang platypus adunay humok nga sungo nga sama sa pato bisan kini usa ka mammal.

q: What gas is released when coal, oil, and gasoline are burned in factories and vehicles?
options: Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen
Oxygen
Methane
explanation: Burning fossil fuels such as coal, oil, and gasoline releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, which traps heat and warms the Earth.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ng karbon, langis, at gasolina sa mga pabrika at sasakyan ay naglalabas ng carbon dioxide na nagpapainit sa Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog sa uling, lana, ug gasolina sa mga pabrika ug sakyanan nagpagawas og carbon dioxide nga mopainit sa Kalibutan.

q: Roughly when did the Milky Way begin forming?
options: About 13 billion years ago, not long after the universe began
About 4.6 billion years ago, around the same time as Earth
About 1 billion years ago, relatively recently in cosmic time
About 500 million years ago, when the first stars in our galaxy were born
explanation: The Milky Way is extremely old — it began forming about 13 billion years ago, shortly after the universe itself started with the Big Bang.
fact_tl: Ang Milky Way ay napakatanda — nagsimula itong mabuo mga 13 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas, hindi pa katagalan matapos magsimula ang buong sansinukob.
fact_bis: Ang Milky Way tigulang kaayo — nagsugod kini pagporma mga 13 ka bilyon ka tuig na ang milabay, dili dugay human magsugod ang tibuok uniberso.

q: Which Philippine waterfall is known as the 'little Niagara' because of its wide curtain of water?
options: Tinuy-an Falls in Bislig, Surigao del Sur
Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan City, Lanao del Norte
Pagsanjan Falls in Laguna
Asik-Asik Falls in Alamada, North Cotabato
explanation: Tinuy-an Falls in Bislig, Surigao del Sur is called the 'little Niagara' of the Philippines because of its impressive wide curtain of falling water.
fact_tl: Ang Tinuy-an Falls sa Bislig, Surigao del Sur ang tinatawag na 'little Niagara' ng Pilipinas dahil sa malapad nitong kurtinang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Tinuy-an Falls sa Bislig, Surigao del Sur mao ang gitawag nga 'little Niagara' sa Pilipinas tungod sa lapad niini nga kurtina sa tubig.

q: What is the glowing cloud of gas and dust that forms around a comet's solid center called?
options: The coma
The nucleus
The tail
The corona
explanation: As a comet nears the Sun, a large glowing cloud called the coma forms around its solid center, becoming the bright 'head' of the comet that we can see.
fact_tl: Kapag lumalapit ang kometa sa Araw, nabubuo ang isang malaking nagliliwanag na ulap ng gas at alikabok sa palibot ng matigas na ubod nito. Ang ulap na ito ay tinatawag na coma, at ito ang nagiging maliwanag na 'ulo' ng kometa na nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Kung moduol ang kometa sa Adlaw, maporma ang usa ka dako nga nagasiga nga panganod sa gas ug abog palibot sa gahi niini nga ubod. Kini nga panganod gitawag nga coma, ug kini ang mahimong masanag nga 'ulo' sa kometa nga atong makita.

q: What is the unit used to measure work and energy?
options: Joule
Newton
Watt
Pascal
explanation: Work and energy are both measured in joules, where one joule equals a force of one newton applied over a distance of one metre.
fact_tl: Ang trabaho at enerhiya ay sinusukat sa yunit na joule, na katumbas ng isang newton na puwersa sa isang metrong layo.
fact_bis: Ang trabaho ug enerhiya gisukod sa yunit nga joule, nga katumbas sa usa ka newton nga kusog sa usa ka metro nga gilay-on.

q: How is convection in Earth's mantle different from convection in the air?
options: Air convection is fast and makes weather, while mantle convection is extremely slow and moves over millions of years
Mantle convection moves upward while air convection always moves downward
Air convection only happens at the poles, while mantle convection happens everywhere
Mantle convection is driven by the Sun's heat, while air convection is driven by Earth's core
explanation: Both mantle and air convection share the same basic idea — warm material rises and cool material sinks — but air convection is fast and creates weather, while mantle convection is extremely slow, occurring over millions of years.
fact_tl: Ang convection sa mantle at sa hangin ay magkaparehong ideya — umaakyat ang mainit, bumababa ang malamig. Pero ang convection ng hangin ay mabilis at gumagawa ng panahon at ulap, habang ang mantle ay umaagos nang napakabagal sa loob ng milyong taon.
fact_bis: Ang convection sa mantle ug sa hangin pareho og ideya — ang init mosaka, ang bugnaw mounlod. Apan ang convection sa hangin paspas ug naghimo og panahon ug panganod, samtang ang mantle moagos hinay kaayo sulod sa minilyon ka tuig.

q: Why are some pufferfish brightly colored?
options: To warn predators that they are poisonous and should not be eaten
To attract smaller fish that they use as food
To blend in with colorful coral reefs and hide from danger
To signal to other pufferfish that they are ready to mate
explanation: Some pufferfish display bright colors as a warning to predators that they are poisonous and dangerous to eat.
fact_tl: May mga buteteng makulay para babalaan ang mga kaaway na sila ay may lason at hindi dapat kainin.
fact_bis: Adunay mga butete nga mabulukon aron pasidan-an ang mga kaaway nga sila adunay hilo ug dili angay kan-on.

q: What is a light-year?
options: The distance light travels in one year, about 9.5 trillion kilometres
The time it takes light to travel from the Sun to Earth
The amount of light the Sun produces in a single year
The distance from Earth to the nearest star divided by the speed of light
explanation: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year — about 9.5 trillion kilometres — and is used to describe the vast distances between stars.
fact_tl: Ang light-year ay ang layong nilalakbay ng liwanag sa loob ng isang taon — humigit-kumulang 9.5 trilyong kilometro. Ginagamit ito para sukatin ang napakalalayong distansya sa pagitan ng mga bituin.
fact_bis: Ang light-year mao ang gilay-on nga gibiyahe sa kahayag sulod sa usa ka tuig — mga 9.5 ka trilyong kilometro. Gigamit kini aron sukoron ang dagkong gilay-on tali sa mga bituon.

q: Besides humans, which other creatures can be harmed by red tide?
options: Dolphins, sea turtles, and seabirds that eat fish or plankton carrying the toxin
Only microscopic plankton, because larger animals are not affected
Crabs and lobsters, but only those living on the ocean floor
Sharks and other large predators that feed at the top of the food chain
explanation: Red tide toxins can sicken or kill not just people, but also sea animals such as dolphins, sea turtles, and seabirds that eat contaminated fish or plankton.
fact_tl: Hindi lang tao ang naaapektuhan ng red tide — ang mga hayop sa dagat tulad ng dolphin, pawikan, at ibong-dagat ay maaari ring magkasakit o mamatay kapag nakakain sila ng isda o plankton na may lason.
fact_bis: Dili lang tawo ang maapektuhan sa red tide — ang mga mananap sa dagat sama sa dolphin, pawikan, ug langgam sa dagat mahimo usab masakit o mamatay kon makakaon silag isda o plankton nga adunay hilo.

q: Why is a dog's nose often a little wet?
options: The wetness helps the dog smell better
The wetness cools the dog down when it is too warm
Dogs lick their noses to keep germs away
The wetness protects the nose from sunburn
explanation: A dog's nose is often slightly wet because the moisture helps it pick up scent particles from the air, making its sense of smell even sharper.
fact_tl: Ang ilong ng aso ay madalas na basa-basa, na tumutulong dito na makaamoy nang mas mabuti.
fact_bis: Ang ilong sa iro kasagaran basa-basa, nga makatabang niini sa mas maayong pagpanimaho.

q: How deep can geothermal wells go to reach underground heat sources?
options: From 1 to 4 kilometres into the ground
From 10 to 40 kilometres, near the base of the crust
Only about 100 metres, similar to a regular water well
From 5 to 10 kilometres, deeper than any oil well
explanation: Geothermal wells can reach from 1 to 4 kilometres into the ground, and engineers use directional drilling to access hot reservoirs that may not be directly below the drill site.
fact_tl: Ang mga geothermal well ay maaaring magmalaim ng 1 hanggang 4 kilometro sa lupa; ginagamit ng mga inhinyero ang directional drilling para maabot ang mga mainit na reservoir na hindi diretso sa ilalim ng drilling rig; ang teknolohiyang ito ay katulad ng ginagamit sa oil and gas exploration.
fact_bis: Ang mga geothermal well mahimong magkagilawod og 1 hangtod 4 kilometro sa ilawom sa yuta; naggamit ang mga inhinyero og directional drilling aron maabot ang mga mainit nga reservoir nga dili direkta ilalom sa drilling rig; kini nga teknolohiya pareha sa gigamit sa oil ug gas exploration.

q: What does compost do for the soil?
options: Returns nutrients to the soil so plants can grow stronger and healthier
Kills harmful bacteria and makes soil completely sterile
Hardens the soil so that it holds water for a longer time
Releases gases that warm the soil and speed up seed germination
explanation: Compost is decomposed organic matter that returns valuable nutrients to the soil, helping plants grow stronger and healthier.
fact_tl: Ibinabalik ng compost ang mga sustansya sa lupa para mas malusog na tumubo ang mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang compost mobalik sa mga sustansya ngadto sa yuta aron molambo og maayo ang mga tanom.

q: Which types of living things can become endangered?
options: Any living thing — animals, plants, insects, and frogs — whose numbers fall dangerously low
Only large animals like tigers, elephants, and whales
Only animals with a backbone, such as birds, fish, and mammals
Only animals that live in rainforests or coral reefs
explanation: It is a mistake to think only big animals become endangered — plants, insects, frogs, and many other kinds of living things can also be at risk, such as the wild waling-waling orchid in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Maling akala na hayop lamang ang nagiging endangered — pati halaman, insekto, at palaka ay maaari ring manganib. Halimbawa, ang ilang ligaw na orkidyas tulad ng waling-waling ay nanganganib na rin. Anumang uri ng buhay na bumababa ang bilang ay maaaring maging endangered.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga mga hayop ra ang mahimong endangered — bisan ang mga tanom, insekto, ug baki mahimong mameligro. Pananglitan, ang pipila ka ihalas nga orkidyas sama sa waling-waling namiligro na usab. Bisan unsang matang sa buhi nga mokunhod ang gidaghanon mahimong endangered.

q: How do sea snakes keep water out of their nose when they dive underwater?
options: They have valve-like flaps on their nostrils that close when they dive
They hold their nostrils shut using special muscles around their snout
They breathe through their skin so they do not need to use their nostrils
They plug their nostrils with mucus before entering the water
explanation: Sea snakes have valve-like flaps on their nostrils that close when they dive, preventing water from getting in.
fact_tl: Ang mga ahas-dagat ay may parang takip sa butas ng ilong na sumasara kapag sumisisid para hindi pumasok ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga bitin sa dagat adunay morag takup sa lungag sa ilong nga mosira kon mosalom aron dili makasulod ang tubig.

q: Your classmate is being shocked and is still stuck to a wire. What should you do first?
options: Grab your classmate and pull them away from the wire quickly
Switch off the power at the breaker if you can and call an adult for help
Pour water on the wire to make the electricity stop
Yell loudly to scare the electricity away from your classmate
explanation: You must not touch a shocked person still stuck to a wire or you could be shocked too — instead, cut the power at the breaker and call an adult right away.
fact_tl: Kapag may nakuryente at dikit pa sa wire, huwag mo siyang hahawakan dahil baka ikaw rin ay makuryente. Sa halip, patayin agad ang switch o breaker kung kaya, at humingi kaagad ng tulong sa matanda.
fact_bis: Kung naay na-kuryente ug nakadikit pa sa wire, ayaw siya hikapa kay basin ikaw pod ma-kuryente. Hinuon, palonga dayon ang switch o breaker kung mahimo, ug pangayo dayon ug tabang sa hamtong.

q: Why does the carabao cool itself by wallowing in water and mud instead of sweating like humans?
options: It prefers water because mud protects its skin from insect bites only
It has very few sweat glands so it cannot release much heat through sweat
Its sweat is too salty and would sting its eyes in the heat
It cools faster by sleeping in the shade than by any other method
explanation: The carabao has very few sweat glands, so it relies on water and mud to cool its body instead.
fact_tl: Kakaunti ang glandula ng pawis ng kalabaw, kaya gumagamit ito ng tubig at putik para magpalamig ng katawan.
fact_bis: Gamay ra ang glandula sa singot sa kalabaw, mao nga mogamit kini ug tubig ug lapok aron magpabugnaw.

q: You touch something very hot and your hand pulls away before you even feel pain. Why do you feel the pain only a moment later?
options: The pain signal travels to the spinal cord first and the brain receives it slightly after the reflex happens
The skin takes time to warm up so the pain builds slowly after the burn starts
Your brain ignores pain signals while your muscles are still moving
The nerve endings only start working again once your hand is safely away
explanation: A reflex bypasses the brain to act fast, but the pain signal still reaches the brain a moment later — so the feeling of pain comes after the hand has already pulled away.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi dumadaan sa utak ang reflex, nakakaabot pa rin doon ang signal kaunting sandali pagkatapos — kaya nararamdaman mo ang sakit ilang sandali matapos kang umurong. Una ang aksyon, saka ang pakiramdam.
fact_bis: Bisan og laktawan sa reflex ang utok, makaabot gihapon didto ang signal paglabay og gamayng higayon — mao nga mabati nimo ang sakit human ka na makaiwas. Una ang aksyon, sunod ang pagbati.

q: A pangolin and an armadillo both have hard armor on their bodies, but scientists say they are not related. What explains why two unrelated animals look so similar?
options: They are distant cousins that share an ancient common ancestor with armor
Convergent evolution caused both animals to independently develop armor for defense
One animal copied the other's armor through sharing the same habitat
Both animals got their armor from the same type of environmental poison
explanation: The pangolin and armadillo look alike because of convergent evolution — both independently developed armor for defense even though they are not related.
fact_tl: Ang pangolin at armadillo ay magkahawig ang hitsura — parehong may baluti — ngunit hindi sila magkamag-anak; ang pagkakahawig ay nagmula sa iba't ibang ebolusyon para sa parehong depensa.
fact_bis: Ang pangolin ug armadillo magkahawig og hitsura — pareho adunay baluti — apan dili sila kadugo; ang pagkakahawig gikan sa convergent evolution samtang pareho nagpalambo og baluti alang sa depensa.

q: Which scientist created the special theory of relativity, and in what year was it published?
options: Isaac Newton published it in 1687
Albert Einstein created it in 1905
Marie Curie developed it in 1898
Nikola Tesla proposed it in 1910
explanation: Albert Einstein created the special theory of relativity in 1905.
fact_tl: Si Albert Einstein ang gumawa ng special theory of relativity noong 1905.
fact_bis: Si Albert Einstein ang naghimo sa special theory of relativity niadtong 1905.

q: An astronaut has a mass of 70 kg on Earth. What is her mass when she travels to the Moon?
options: About 12 kg because the Moon's gravity is much weaker than Earth's
70 kg because mass stays the same wherever you go
Zero kg because there is no gravity in space
140 kg because the trip through space adds extra matter to her body
explanation: Mass is the amount of matter in an object and does not change wherever you go, so the astronaut's mass stays 70 kg on the Moon.
fact_tl: Ang mass ay ang dami ng matter sa isang bagay — ito ay hindi nagbabago kahit saan ka pumunta. Ang weight ay ang lakas ng gravity na kumukuha sa mass — ito ay maaaring magbago depende sa lakas ng gravity ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang mass mao ang kantidad sa matter sa usa ka butang — kini dili nagbabago bisan asa ka moadto. Ang weight mao ang gravitational force nga nagkuha sa maong mass — mahimong mabag-o kini depende sa kusog sa gravity sa planeta.

q: What do the tiny spark you feel touching a metal doorknob and a bolt of lightning have in common?
options: Both are caused by heat building up inside clouds and metal objects
Both are forms of static electricity where built-up charge jumps across a gap
Both happen only when there is water or moisture in the air nearby
Both come from magnetic fields that attract electrons to metal surfaces
explanation: Both the small doorknob spark and lightning happen when built-up electric charge suddenly jumps across a gap — they are both forms of static electricity, just vastly different in size.
fact_tl: Ang maliit na kislap na nararamdaman mo kapag nahawakan ang metal pagkatapos magkuskos sa karpet ay static electricity. Ang kidlat ay halos kapareho lang nito ngunit higanteng bersyon. Pareho silang nabubuo dahil sa naipong singil na biglang lumulukso, kaya parehong static lang silang kuryente.
fact_bis: Kanang gamay nga kidlap nga imong mabati kon mohikap ka ug metal human magkuskos sa karpet mao ang static electricity. Ang kilat halos pareho lang niini higante lang nga bersyon. Parehong mahitabo tungod sa natipon nga charge nga kalit nga molukso, busa pareho silang static nga kuryente.

q: How does a vulture avoid getting sick even though it eats rotten meat full of dangerous germs?
options: It picks only the freshest parts of a carcass and avoids the moldiest sections
Its stomach acid is so strong that it kills the germs in rotten meat
It has a special coating in its throat that blocks germs before they reach the stomach
It eats large amounts of grass after feeding to wash the germs out of its body
explanation: A vulture's stomach acid is so strong that it destroys the dangerous germs found in rotten meat.
fact_tl: Napakalakas ng asido sa tiyan ng buwitre kaya napapatay nito ang mga mikrobyo sa bulok na karne.
fact_bis: Ang asido sa tiyan sa buwitre kusgan kaayo maong mapatay niini ang mga mikrobyo sa dunot na karne.

q: A medicine label says 'take on an empty stomach.' Why would a doctor give this instruction?
options: Taking medicine without food stops it from tasting bad in your mouth
Some medicines are absorbed better into the body when you have not eaten yet
Food makes the medicine work twice as fast and could overdose you
An empty stomach means the medicine reaches the blood faster because the heart pumps harder when hungry
explanation: Some medicines are absorbed better when there is no food in the stomach, which is why labels sometimes say to take them on an empty stomach.
fact_tl: May label na nagsasabing 'inumin kasabay ng pagkain' o 'kapag walang laman ang tiyan.' Ginagawa ito dahil ang ibang gamot ay nakakairita ng sikmura kaya kailangan ng pagkain, habang ang iba naman ay mas mabuting masipsip kapag walang kinain pa.
fact_bis: Naa'y label nga nagsulti og 'imna kuyog sa pagkaon' o 'kung walay sulod ang tiyan.' Gibuhat ni kay ang ubang tambal makahasol sa tiyan maong kinahanglan og pagkaon, samtang ang uban mas maayong masuyop kung wala pa makakaon.

q: Inside an atom, where are the electrons found?
options: Packed tightly inside the nucleus alongside the protons and neutrons
Outside the nucleus, moving around it
Floating freely between different atoms and not attached to any single one
Resting on the surface of the nucleus like a shell
explanation: Electrons are found outside the nucleus, moving around it.
fact_tl: Ang mga electron ay matatagpuan sa labas ng nucleus, umiikot sa paligid nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga electron makit-an sa gawas sa nucleus, nagtuyok palibot niini.

q: When you look through frosted glass you can see light but everything looks blurry. What causes the blurry image?
options: The glass absorbs most of the light so only a dim outline passes through
Light scatters in many different directions as it passes through the translucent material
The glass is so thick that the image shrinks before it reaches your eyes
Color pigments in the glass mix the light beams together into a blur
explanation: In a translucent material like frosted glass, light scatters in different directions rather than passing straight through, which makes the image appear blurry.
fact_tl: Sa translucent na bagay, kumakalat ang liwanag sa iba't ibang direksyon kaya nagiging malabo ang imahe.
fact_bis: Sa translucent nga butang, ang kahayag mokatag sa lain-laing direksyon mao nga mahimong hanap ang hulagway.

q: Why are sharks described as 'keystone' animals on Philippine reefs?
options: They build coral structures that other fish use as homes and shelter
They eat weak and sick fish, keeping reef fish populations healthy and balanced
They produce nutrients that feed the coral polyps and keep reefs growing
They protect smaller fish from being eaten by larger ocean predators like whales
explanation: Sharks are keystone animals on Philippine reefs because they eat weak and sick fish, keeping the fish populations healthy and balanced.
fact_tl: Sa mga bahura ng Pilipinas, ang pating ay keystone dahil kinakain nito ang mga mahihina at maysakit na isda, kaya nananatiling malusog at balanse ang populasyon ng isda sa reef.
fact_bis: Sa mga bahura sa Pilipinas, ang iho keystone kay ginakaon niini ang mga luya ug masakiton nga isda, busa magpabiling himsog ug balanse ang populasyon sa isda sa reef.

q: When your body raises your temperature during an infection, what helpful purpose can this fever serve?
options: A fever burns away the germ's outer shell so medicines can enter more easily
A fever can slow some germs while the immune system works to fight the infection
A fever tells the brain to send more blood to the skin so you cool down faster
A fever stops you from feeling pain so you can rest more comfortably
explanation: Fever can slow down some germs while the immune system fights the infection — it is the body's natural defense response.
fact_tl: Kapag may impeksyon, minsan iniinit ng katawan ang sarili bilang lagnat, na nakakatulong na pabagalin ang ilang germ habang lumalaban ang immune system.
fact_bis: Kon adunay impeksyon, usahay ang lawas mopainit sa kaugalingon isip hilanat, nga makapahinay sa pipila ka germ samtang nagaaway ang immune system.

q: Approximately how large is the surface area of Lake Lanao?
options: About 100 square kilometers
About 340 square kilometers
About 800 square kilometers
About 1,200 square kilometers
explanation: Lake Lanao has a surface area of about 340 square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang Lake Lanao ay may lawak na humigit-kumulang 340 kilometro kuwadrado.
fact_bis: Ang Lake Lanao adunay gidak-on nga mga 340 ka kuwadradong kilometro.

q: Why do cities near the ocean have milder temperatures than cities far inland?
options: The ocean reflects sunlight back into the sky which cools the nearby land
Water warms up slowly and cools down slowly, steadying the temperature of nearby coasts
Ocean breezes carry cold air from the poles directly to coastal towns
The ocean absorbs storms before they can heat up the land near the shore
explanation: Water needs a lot of heat to warm up and cools down slowly, so the sea steadies the climate and keeps coastal areas milder than inland regions.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng maraming init para tumaas ang temperatura ng tubig, at mabagal din itong lumamig — kaya pinapakalma ng dagat ang klima at mas malamig ang baybayin kaysa lupang malayo sa tubig.
fact_bis: Daghan og init ang gikinahanglan aron mosaka ang temperatura sa tubig, ug hinay usab kini molamig — mao nga ang dagat magpakalma sa klima ug ang baybayon mas bugnaw kaysa yuta nga layo sa tubig.
