fact_bis: Matulog ta aron makapahulay ug makabawi ang lawas ug utok. Samtang natulog, mareparar ang mga cell, molig-on ang immune system, ug tipigan sa utok ang atong nakat-unan.

q: Why does a hoverfly have yellow-and-black stripes even though it has no sting?
options: Its bee-like appearance fools predators into thinking it can sting, keeping them away
The stripes help it blend in with yellow flowers where it collects nectar
The bright colors warm its body faster in cool morning air
Predators are attracted to the stripes, which actually help the hoverfly attract mates
explanation: The hoverfly mimics a bee's stripes to trick predators into avoiding it, even though it is harmless and has no sting.
fact_tl: Ang hoverfly ay isang langaw na may dilaw at itim na guhit na parang bubuyog, ngunit wala itong tibo o tusok; ang kanyang anyong-bubuyog ang nagpapaiwas sa mga kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang hoverfly usa ka langaw nga adunay dilaw ug itom nga guhit sama sa buyog, apan wala kini'y tusok; ang iyang dagway nga sama sa buyog maoy makapalikay sa mga kaaway.

q: How much space does one mole of any ideal gas take up at standard temperature and pressure (STP)?
options: About 22.4 liters
About 11.2 liters
About 44.8 liters
About 6.02 liters
explanation: At STP, one mole of any ideal gas occupies approximately 22.4 liters, which is called the molar volume.
fact_tl: Ang isang mole ng anumang ideal na gas ay sumasakop sa humigit-kumulang 22.4 litro sa STP (standard temperature and pressure).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka mole sa bisan unsang ideal nga gas mosakop sa mga 22.4 ka litro sa STP (standard temperature and pressure).

q: What is the pathway sound travels inside each ear before the brain can detect it?
options: Sound travels down the ear canal and makes the eardrum vibrate
Sound enters the inner ear directly through the skull bone by vibration
Sound passes through tiny hairs on the outer ear and enters the cochlea immediately
Sound travels through the ear canal, skips the eardrum, and goes straight to the brain
explanation: In each ear, sound moves down the ear canal and causes the eardrum to vibrate; the brain then compares signals from both ears to locate the source of sound.
fact_tl: Sa bawat tainga, dumadaan ang tunog sa makitid na butas na tinatawag na ear canal hanggang umabot ito sa eardrum, isang manipis na balat na nayayanig. Dahil may ganitong daanan ang dalawang tainga, kayang ihambing ng utak ang dumating sa kaliwa at sa kanan.
fact_bis: Sa matag dalunggan, moagi ang tingog sa pig-ot nga agianan nga gitawag og ear canal hangtod nga moabot kini sa eardrum, usa ka nipis nga panit nga mokurog. Tungod kay parehas kini'g agianan ang duha ka dalunggan, matandi sa utok ang miabot sa wala ug sa tuo.

q: How do predators affect the number of prey animals in an ecosystem?
options: They help keep the prey population close to the carrying capacity of the environment
They always drive prey populations to extinction if there are too many predators
They have no lasting effect because prey animals reproduce faster than predators hunt
They increase the prey population by driving weaker individuals away from food sources
explanation: Predators regulate prey numbers by hunting, which helps keep the prey population near the level the environment can sustainably support — the carrying capacity.
fact_tl: Ang mga mandaragit ay tumutulong na panatilihin ang bilang ng kanilang biktima malapit sa carrying capacity.
fact_bis: Ang mga mandadagit motabang sa pagpabilin sa gidaghanon sa ilang tukbonon duol sa carrying capacity.

q: Which 'sixth sense' allows you to know where your arms and legs are without looking at them?
options: Proprioception, which uses sensors in muscles and joints to detect body position
Echolocation, which uses sound waves to map the body's position in space
Kinesthesia, which uses signals from skin pressure receptors to track movement
Thermoception, which detects heat given off by the body to measure limb position
explanation: Proprioception relies on sensors in muscles and joints to give the brain a constant sense of where each body part is, providing coordination without the need for sight.
fact_tl: Ang proprioception ay ang kakayahan ng ating katawan na malaman ang posisyon ng ating mga bahagi nang hindi gumagamit ng paningin; ito ang 'sixth sense' na nagbibigay ng koordinasyon ng galaw.
fact_bis: Ang proprioception mao ang kakayahan sa atong lawas sa pag-alam sa posisyon sa iyang mga bahin nga wala mogamit ug panan-aw; kining 'ikaunom nga pandama' nagdepende sa mga sensor sa mga kaunuran ug kasukasuan.

q: Why is agriculture considered one of the most vital sectors in the Philippines?
options: It provides livelihood to millions of farmers and ensures food security for the whole nation
It produces the most exports in value, earning more foreign currency than any other industry
It requires the least investment from the government while creating the most jobs
It supplies all the raw materials needed by Philippine factories and manufacturing plants
explanation: Agriculture is vital to the Philippines because it supports the livelihoods of millions of farmers and is essential for the nation's food security.
fact_tl: Ang agrikultura ay isa sa pinakamahalagang sektor ng ekonomiya ng Pilipinas—nagbibigay ito ng kabuhayan sa milyun-milyong magsasaka at nagbibigay ng pagkain para sa buong bansa.
fact_bis: Ang agrikultura usa sa pinaka-importante nga sektor sa ekonomiya sa Pilipinas—naghatag kini og kabuhayan sa milyun-milyong mag-uuma ug naghatag og pagkaon para sa tibuok nasod.

q: What do most chameleons eat in the wild?
options: Insects like grasshoppers, crickets, and worms
Leaves and fruits that they find on tree branches
Small mammals and frogs that wander near their perch
Nectar from flowers, which they lick with their long tongue
explanation: Most chameleons feed on insects such as grasshoppers, crickets, and worms, though some large species can also eat small birds or lizards.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng chameleon ay kumakain ng mga insekto gaya ng tipaklong, ipis, at uod. May ilang malalaking chameleon na kayang kumain ng maliliit na ibon o ibang butiki.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa chameleon mokaon og mga insekto sama sa apan-apan, kuliglig, ug ulod. Adunay pipila ka dagkong chameleon nga makakaon pa og gagmayng langgam o ubang tiki.

q: Who was the first person to observe the planet Neptune through a telescope?
options: Johann Galle
Galileo Galilei
Edmond Halley
Giovanni Cassini
explanation: Johann Galle was the first astronomer to observe Neptune through a telescope, confirming its existence.
fact_tl: Si Johann Galle ang unang nakakita ng planetang Neptune sa teleskopyo.
fact_bis: Si Johann Galle ang unang nakakita sa planetang Neptune pinaagi sa teleskopyo.

q: In the Philippines, who should do home electrical work like installing new outlets or replacing circuit breakers?
options: A licensed electrician, because improper wiring can cause fires or fatal shocks
Any adult family member who has watched someone do it before
A barangay official who has been trained in basic safety procedures
The homeowner, as long as they turn off the main switch before starting
explanation: Philippine regulations require a licensed electrician to handle home wiring tasks because improper electrical work can lead to electrical fires or deadly shocks.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga gawaing kuryente sa bahay tulad ng pagkakawire ng bagong outlet o pagpapalit ng circuit breaker ay dapat isagawa ng lisensyadong elektrisyan — ang hindi tamang trabaho ay maaaring magdulot ng sunog o electric shock.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga trabaho sa kuryente sa balay sama sa pagkawire ug bag-ong outlet o pagpalit sa circuit breaker kinahanglan buhaton sa lisensyadong electrician — ang dili husto nga trabaho mahimong magsanhi ug electrical fire o patay nga electric shock.

q: How does studying the flying lemur benefit engineers and designers?
options: It gives ideas for designing better gliders and motorless aircraft based on how it glides with its skin membrane
It shows how to build faster motorboats by mimicking the way it moves through the air
It helps engineers design stronger bridges by copying the shape of its wing-like skin
It inspires the design of underwater submarines because its gliding path resembles swimming
explanation: Scientists study the flying lemur's smooth skin-membrane gliding to get ideas for designing better human gliders and motorless aircraft.
fact_tl: Pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko kung paano nakakaglide ang kagwang nang napakahusay gamit lang ang balat nito. Mula sa mga hayop na nag-glide na tulad nito, nakakakuha ng ideya ang mga tao kung paano gumawa ng mga eroplanong walang motor at iba pang glider.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga siyentista kung giunsa pag-glide sa kagwang nga hapsay kaayo gamit lang ang iyang panit. Gikan sa mga hayop nga mag-glide sama niini, makakuha og ideya ang mga tawo kung unsaon paghimo og mas maayong glider ug eroplano nga walay makina.

q: What does it mean when someone is color blind?
options: They cannot see any colors at all and everything looks black and white
They have trouble telling certain colors apart, like red and green
Their eyes are more sensitive to bright light than normal eyes
They can only see colors when they are in sunlight
explanation: Color blindness means having trouble telling certain colors apart, such as red and green.
fact_tl: May mga taong color blind, ibig sabihin nahihirapan silang ipagkaiba ang ilang kulay tulad ng pula at berde.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga color blind, nagpasabot nga maglisod sila pag-ila sa pipila ka kolor sama sa pula ug berde.

q: What would happen to almost all ocean life if plankton disappeared?
options: Ocean animals would simply eat seaweed and algae instead
Ocean animals would migrate to freshwater rivers to survive
Almost all ocean life would starve because plankton start the food chain
Only small fish would die but large predators would survive just fine
explanation: Plankton are the start of all ocean food, so without them almost all ocean life would starve.
fact_tl: Kung mawawala ang plankton, halos lahat ng buhay sa dagat ay magugutom dahil sila ang simula ng lahat ng pagkain doon.
fact_bis: Kung mawala ang plankton, halos tanang kinabuhi sa dagat magutom kay sila ang sinugdanan sa tanang pagkaon didto.

q: Which provinces in the Philippines are known to have schistosomiasis, especially in rice-field areas?
options: Batangas, Cavite, and Laguna
Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, and Pangasinan
Leyte, Samar, and parts of Mindanao
Cebu, Bohol, and Negros Occidental
explanation: Schistosomiasis has long been present in provinces such as Leyte, Samar, and parts of Mindanao, particularly in rice-field and watery areas.
fact_tl: Totoo bang nandito sa Pilipinas ang schistosomiasis? Oo. Ito ay matagal nang sakit sa ilang lalawigan tulad ng Leyte, Samar, at mga bahagi ng Mindanao, lalo na sa mga lugar na may palayan at tubig. Ang uri rito ay tinatawag na Schistosoma japonicum.
fact_bis: Tinuod ba nga ania sa Pilipinas ang schistosomiasis? Oo. Dugay na kining sakit sa pipila ka lalawigan sama sa Leyte, Samar, ug mga bahin sa Mindanao, ilabi na sa mga dapit nga adunay basakan ug tubig. Ang matang dinhi gitawag og Schistosoma japonicum.

q: What two main materials are heated together in a kiln to make cement?
options: Sand and iron ore
Limestone and clay
Granite and quartz
Salt and chalk
explanation: Cement is made by heating limestone and clay in a kiln at about 1450°C to produce clinker, which is then ground into the fine gray powder used as a binder.
fact_tl: Ang semento ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng pagpainit ng apog at luwad sa isang pugon sa napakataas na temperatura (mga 1450°C) para gumawa ng clinker na dinurog pagkatapos sa pulbos na semento.
fact_bis: Ang semento gihimo pinaagi sa pagpainit sa apog ug luwad sa usa ka pugon sa mga 1450°C aron makahimo og clinker, nga dayon gidurog ngadto sa maayong abuhong pulbos nga gigamit isip binder sa semento.

q: Why do CFCs from old refrigerators and spray cans damage the ozone layer?
options: They release carbon dioxide that traps heat and burns through ozone
They release chlorine atoms that react with and break down ozone molecules
They absorb ultraviolet light and convert ozone into oxygen directly
They block sunlight from reaching the ozone layer, weakening it over time
explanation: Chlorine atoms released from CFCs react with and break down ozone molecules, destroying the ozone layer.
fact_tl: Ang mga CFC (chlorofluorocarbon) na ginamit sa mga refrigerator at aerosol spray ay sumisira ng ozone layer — ang mga chlorine atom na inilalabas nito ay nagre-react sa ozone at nagpapalala nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga CFC (chlorofluorocarbon) nga gigamit sa mga karaan nga refrigerator ug aerosol spray nagsira sa ozone layer; ang mga chlorine atom nga gipagawas sa CFCs nagtubag sa ug nagbasag sa mga molekula sa ozone.

q: Why is the beaver called a keystone species?
options: It has very strong teeth that can chew through almost any wood
It builds dams that create ponds and wetlands where many other animals live
It stores so much food that other animals can share it in winter
It is the only animal that can build structures on rivers
explanation: The beaver is a keystone species because its dams create ponds and wetlands that provide habitats for many other animals.
fact_tl: Ang beaver ay isang keystone species dahil gumagawa ito ng mga dam na lumilikha ng pond at basa-basang lupa na tirahan ng maraming ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang beaver usa ka keystone species kay maghimo kini og mga saplad nga makamugna og danaw ug basa nga yuta nga puy-anan sa daghang ubang hayop.

q: How does a sea snake sometimes remove tiny creatures stuck on its body?
options: It rubs against sharp coral reefs to scrape the creatures off
It dives very deep where water pressure pushes the creatures off
It ties its body in a knot to scrape off the tiny creatures stuck on it
It rolls in sand on the beach to dislodge the creatures
explanation: Sea snakes sometimes tie their body in a knot to scrape off the tiny creatures stuck on them after shedding their skin.
fact_tl: Madalas magpalit ng balat ang ahas-dagat at minsan ay nagbubuhol-buhol ang katawan para matanggal ang maliliit na hayop na dumikit dito.
fact_bis: Ang mga bitin sa dagat kanunay mag-ilis og panit ug usahay magbuhol-buhol sa lawas aron makuha ang gagmay nga mananap nga nanapot niini.

q: Why can you NOT separate a pure substance by filtering or evaporating it into two different things?
options: Pure substances dissolve too quickly for filters to catch them
A pure substance contains only one kind of material, so there is nothing to separate
Pure substances are too heavy to move through filter paper
The heat needed for evaporation destroys pure substances completely
explanation: A pure substance is only one kind of material, so it cannot be separated into two different things by physical means like filtering or evaporating.
fact_tl: Hindi mo mapaghihiwalay ang isang purong sangkap sa pisikal na paraan dahil iisang uri lang ito — hindi mo masasala o mapapasingaw ang purong asukal para maging dalawang magkaibang bagay. Ang mixture lang ang puwedeng paghiwalayin nang ganoon.
fact_bis: Dili nimo mabulag ang usa ka putli nga sustansya sa pisikal nga paagi kay usa ra kini ka klase — dili nimo maayag o mapasingaw ang putli nga asukal aron mahimong duha ka lahi nga butang. Ang mixture lang ang mabulag sa ingon.

q: What do all butterflies and moths in the order Lepidoptera have on their wings?
options: Bright patterns painted directly on the wing membrane
Tiny scales that create their colors and patterns
A waxy coating that makes the wings waterproof
Fine hairs that help them sense the wind direction
explanation: All members of order Lepidoptera — butterflies and moths — have tiny scales covering their wings, which create their colors and patterns.
fact_tl: Ang order Lepidoptera ay kinabibilangan ng mga paru-paro at moth—lahat ng miyembro ng order na ito ay may mga kaliskis sa pakpak, na siyang nagbibigay ng kulay at pattern sa mga pakpak nila.
fact_bis: Ang order Lepidoptera naglangkob sa mga mariposa ug moth—ang tanan nga miyembro sa order nga kini adunay gagmay nga kaliskis sa pakpak, nga nagmugna sa ilang mga kolor ug pattern.

q: Why does your eye blink automatically when something comes near it?
options: To clean the eye surface by spreading tears evenly
To reduce the amount of light entering when it is too bright
To protect the eye from objects or dust coming close to it
To help the eye focus on objects that move quickly
explanation: The eye blinks automatically when an object or dust comes near, to protect it.
fact_tl: Awtomatikong pumipikit ang mata kapag may paparating na bagay o alikabok upang maprotektahan ito.
fact_bis: Awtomatik nga mopisok ang mata kon adunay nagsingabot nga butang o abog aron mapanalipdan kini.

q: Why did cave fish lose their eyes over many generations?
options: Cave water contains chemicals that dissolve eye tissue slowly
Predators inside caves specifically targeted and ate fish with eyes
Eyes were useless in total darkness, so fish that built them wasted energy and were at a disadvantage
The cold temperature inside caves froze and damaged eye development
explanation: Inside completely dark caves, eyes are useless, so fish that spent energy building them were at a disadvantage — over many generations their eyes slowly disappeared.
fact_tl: Bakit nawala ang mata ng cave fish? Sa loob ng kweba, sobrang dilim kaya walang silbi ang mata. Sa napakahabang panahon, ang mga isdang gumagastos ng enerhiya para sa matang hindi naman magagamit ay mas mahina, kaya unti-unting nawala ang mata ng lahi nila.
fact_bis: Ngano nawala ang mata sa cave fish? Sa sulod sa langob, ngitngit kaayo busa walay pulos ang mata. Sa taas kaayo nga panahon, ang mga isda nga naggasto og enerhiya para sa mata nga dili man magamit, mas luya, mao nga hinay-hinay nga nawala ang mata sa ilang kaliwat.

q: How does melting ice make climate change get even worse through a feedback loop?
options: Melting ice releases methane gas that blocks sunlight from leaving Earth
When ice melts, the exposed land or sea absorbs more sunlight, raising the temperature further
Melted ice water evaporates and forms clouds that trap more heat below them
Melting ice raises sea levels which flood forests that used to absorb carbon
explanation: When ice melts, the exposed dark land or sea absorbs more sunlight instead of reflecting it, so temperatures rise further — a positive feedback loop.
fact_tl: Ang mga positive feedback loop ay nagpapalaki ng climate change: halimbawa, kapag ang yelo ay natunaw, ang lupa o dagat ay mas maraming araw ang nasisipsip kaya lalong tumataalas ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Ang mga positive feedback loop nagpapalaki sa climate change: pananglitan, sa dihang ang yelo matunaw, ang nabutyag nga yuta o dagat nagsupsop og mas daghang sikat sa adlaw ug ang temperatura mosaka pa.

q: What is a micro-hydro plant used for in remote mountain villages?
options: Filtering and purifying drinking water from mountain streams
Pumping water up to farms on steep hillsides for irrigation
Generating electricity for villages that big power lines have not yet reached
Storing rainwater during the dry season to prevent water shortage
explanation: Tiny micro-hydro plants use small streams to bring electricity to remote mountain villages that the big power lines have not yet reached.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na micro-hydro plant ay gumagamit ng maliliit na sapa upang magbigay ng kuryente sa mga liblib na nayon sa bundok na hindi pa naaabot ng malaking linya ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga micro-hydro plant naggamit sa gagmay nga sapa aron mohatag og kuryente sa mga lagyo nga baryo sa bukid nga wala pa maabti sa dagkong linya sa kuryente.

q: What does a bee's 'round dance' tell the other bees in the hive?
options: The exact direction and distance to a faraway food source
That danger is near and the hive should be defended immediately
That food is located close by, without giving a specific direction
That the queen bee has left and a new queen must be chosen
explanation: When food is close by, a bee does a simple circling round dance to signal that food is near, unlike the waggle dance that gives direction and distance to far food.
fact_tl: Kapag malapit lang ang pagkain, ang bubuyog ay gumagawa ng simpleng 'round dance' na paikot-ikot para sabihing 'may pagkain malapit dito,' kaiba sa waggle dance na nagsasabi ng direksyon at malayong layo.
fact_bis: Kon duol ra ang pagkaon, ang putyukan mohimo og yano nga 'round dance' nga paglibot-libot aron isulti nga 'aduna'y pagkaon duol dinhi,' lahi sa waggle dance nga nagsulti sa direksyon ug layong gilay-on.

q: What makes the James Webb Space Telescope better than Hubble at studying very old, very distant galaxies?
options: It orbits much closer to Earth, giving sharper images with less distortion
It is larger than a football field and uses visible light more efficiently
It sees infrared light, allowing it to detect very far and very old galaxies Hubble cannot see
It can spin around to face any direction in space within seconds
explanation: The James Webb Space Telescope sees infrared light, which lets it observe very distant and very old galaxies that Hubble cannot see.
fact_tl: Ang James Webb Space Telescope, na inilunsad noong 2021, ay nakikita ang infrared na liwanag, kaya kaya nitong tingnan ang napakalayo at napakaluma nang galaxy na hindi makita ng Hubble.
fact_bis: Ang James Webb Space Telescope, nga gilunsad niadtong 2021, makakita og infrared nga kahayag, mao nga makahimo kini sa pagtan-aw sa layo kaayo ug daan kaayo nga galaksiya nga dili makita sa Hubble.

q: How does a typhoon's eyewall form?
options: Cold air sinks from the upper atmosphere and freezes moisture around the center
Ocean water is pulled upward directly into the clouds by the spinning winds
Warm, moist air from the ocean spirals upward fast, cools, and turns into thick clouds and rain around the storm's center
Two separate storm systems collide and their edges merge into a ring of clouds
explanation: The eyewall forms when warm, moist air from the ocean spirals upward fast around the storm's center, cools, and turns into thick clouds and heavy rain.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang eyewall kapag ang mainit at basang hangin mula sa dagat ay mabilis na umaakyat paikot sa gitna ng bagyo. Habang umaakyat, lumalamig ito at nagiging makakapal na ulap at ulan, kaya nabubuo ang singsing na puno ng kidlat at malakas na ulan.
fact_bis: Mamugna ang eyewall kung ang init ug basa nga hangin gikan sa dagat moliki paibabaw nga paspas libot sa sentro sa bagyo. Samtang mosaka, mobugnaw kini ug mahimong baga nga panganod ug ulan, mao nga matawo ang singsing nga puno sa kilat ug kusog nga ulan.

q: Why do farmers sometimes use bat droppings, called guano, on their plants?
options: Guano keeps insects away because of its strong smell
Guano cools the soil and helps it retain moisture longer
Guano is rich in nutrients, so it works as a natural fertilizer
Guano makes the soil softer so plant roots can grow more easily
explanation: Bat droppings (guano) are rich in nutrients and are used as a natural fertilizer for plants.
fact_tl: Ang ipot ng paniki ay tinatawag na guano. Mayaman ito sa sustansya, kaya ginagamit ng mga tao bilang natural na pataba (fertilizer) sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang iti sa kabog gitawag og guano. Dato kini sa sustansya, mao nga gigamit kini sa mga tawo isip natural nga abono (fertilizer) sa mga tanom.

q: What is absolute zero, the lowest temperature that can ever exist, equal to in degrees Celsius?
options: About 0°C, the freezing point of water
About -100°C, far colder than the coldest winter day
About -273°C, the lowest possible temperature
About -459°C, the point where all atoms stop vibrating
explanation: Absolute zero is about -273°C (exactly -273.15°C), the lowest possible temperature.
fact_tl: Ang absolute zero, ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura, ay humigit-kumulang -273°C (eksaktong -273.15°C).
fact_bis: Ang absolute zero, ang pinakaubos nga posible nga temperatura, mga -273°C (eksakto nga -273.15°C).

q: For about how long after life first appeared on Earth did only single-celled microorganisms exist?
options: About 100 million years
About 500 million years
About 3 billion years
About 10 billion years
explanation: For about 3 billion years after life first appeared, all life on Earth consisted only of single-celled microorganisms; multicellular organisms appeared only about 600–700 million years ago.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng halos 3 bilyong taon mula nang lumabas ang unang buhay, ang lahat ng buhay sa Daigdig ay single-celled na microorganism lamang — ang mga multicellular na organismo ay lumabas lamang mga 600-700 milyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Sulod sa mga 3 bilyong tuig human sa unang paglungtad sa kinabuhi, ang tanan nga buhi sa Yuta single-celled lang nga microorganism — ang mga multicellular nga organismo mipakita lamang mga 600-700 milyong tuig ang milabay.

q: What are the large dark patches that we can see on the surface of the Moon?
options: Deep craters filled with shadow that never receive sunlight
Thick dust storms that blow across the Moon's surface
Areas covered by a layer of dark ice mixed with rock
Wide flat plains of old hardened lava
explanation: The dark patches we see on the Moon are wide flat plains of old hardened lava.
fact_tl: Ang maitim na mga bahagi na nakikita natin sa buwan ay malalawak na patag na dating umaapaw na lava na tumigas na.
fact_bis: Ang itom nga mga bahin nga atong makita sa bulan mao ang halapad nga patag nga karaang lava nga migahi na.

q: What special feature of the talahib stem helps it stand up without breaking in the wind?
options: The stem is filled with a thick sticky sap that makes it flexible
The stem is covered with tough bark three layers thick
The stem is hollow inside and has joints like bamboo that make it strong
The stem grows in a spiral shape that absorbs wind from all directions
explanation: The stem of talahib is hollow inside and has joints like bamboo, which make the stem strong so it does not break easily in the wind.
fact_tl: Ang tangkay ng talahib ay hungkag sa loob at may mga buko na parang sa kawayan. Ang mga bukong ito ang nagpapatibay ng tangkay para hindi ito madaling mabali sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang punoan sa talahib bakante sa sulod ug adunay mga buko nga murag sa kawayan. Kining mga buko maoy naglig-on sa punoan aron dili kini dali mabali sa hangin.

q: How do swiftlet droppings (guano) benefit the cave ecosystem?
options: They harden into rock formations that give the cave its shape
They attract bats that keep the cave temperature warm
They become food for tiny animals and insects and can be used as plant fertilizer
They absorb moisture and prevent the cave walls from getting too wet
explanation: Swiftlet guano piles up on the cave floor, becoming food for tiny animals and insects, and people also use it as fertilizer for plants.
fact_tl: Ang dumi ng swiftlet, tinatawag na guano, ay natitipon sa sahig ng kweba. Nagiging pagkain ito ng maliliit na hayop at insekto, at ginagamit pa nga ng tao bilang abono sa halaman.
fact_bis: Ang tae sa swiftlet, gitawag og guano, magtapok sa salog sa langob. Mahimo kining pagkaon sa gagmay nga mga hayop ug insekto, ug gamiton pa gani sa tawo isip abono sa mga tanom.

q: Which planet in our solar system is most famous for its bright rings?
options: Jupiter
Uranus
Neptune
Saturn
explanation: Saturn is the most famous planet for its bright rings.
fact_tl: Ang Saturn ang pinakatanyag na planeta dahil sa magaganda nitong singsing.
fact_bis: Ang Saturn mao ang pinakabantog nga planeta tungod sa nindot niini nga mga singsing.

q: What gives each musical instrument its unique tone color (timbre)?
options: The size and weight of the instrument's body
The material the instrument is made from, such as wood or metal
The pattern of overtones or harmonics produced along with the main note
The speed at which the musician plays the notes
explanation: A vibrating string produces overtones or harmonics at higher frequencies, and their unique pattern gives each instrument its distinctive timbre or tone color.
fact_tl: Ang isang vibrating string ay nagbibigay ng hindi lamang isang frequency — nagbibigay rin ito ng overtones o harmonics na mas mataas na frequencies — ang pattern ng mga ito ang nagbibigay ng natatanging timbre ng bawat instrumento.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka nagalingkod nga kuwerdas nagahatag dili lamang og usa ka frequency apan usab og mga overtone o harmonic sa mas taas nga frequency — ang ilang pattern nagahatag sa matag instrumento sa iyang natatanging timbre.

q: Which part of the brain controls automatic actions like breathing and heartbeat?
options: The cerebrum, which is the large wrinkled outer part of the brain
The cerebellum, which coordinates balance and movement
The brain stem, which controls vital automatic functions
The hippocampus, which handles memory and learning
explanation: The brain stem controls automatic actions such as breathing and heartbeat.
fact_tl: Ang brain stem ang kumokontrol sa mga awtomatikong gawain tulad ng paghinga at tibok ng puso.
fact_bis: Ang brain stem mao ang nagkontrol sa awtomatikong mga lihok sama sa pagginhawa ug pitik sa kasingkasing.

q: Why is it dangerous to plug too many appliances into one electrical outlet?
options: Too many plugs can block the socket, making it impossible to remove them safely
Using many appliances at once drains the battery in the wall quickly
It increases the total current, which can overheat the wires and start a fire
Extra appliances cause the voltage to rise and damage the devices
explanation: Plugging too many appliances into one outlet increases the total current, which can overheat the wires and start a fire.
fact_tl: Ang pagsaksak ng masyadong maraming kagamitan sa iisang saksakan ay nagpapalaki ng kabuuang current, na maaaring magpainit sa mga wire at magdulot ng sunog.
fact_bis: Ang pagsaksak ug sobra ka daghang galamiton sa usa lang ka outlet mopadako sa kinatibuk-ang current, nga makapainit sa mga wire ug makahimo ug sunog.

q: How many eyes do many spiders have, and what sense do they rely on more than sight?
options: Six eyes, and they rely more on smell than sight
Two eyes, and they rely more on hearing than sight
Eight eyes, and they rely more on touch than sight
Four eyes, and they rely more on taste than sight
explanation: Many spiders have eight tiny eyes, but most rely more on touch than on sight.
fact_tl: Maraming gagamba ay may walong maliliit na mata, pero karamihan ay mas umaasa sa pakiramdam kaysa paningin.
fact_bis: Daghang lawalawa adunay walo ka gagmay nga mata, apan kadaghanan mas mosalig sa hikap kaysa panan-aw.

q: Why is it hard to dry fish when the weather is rainy or cool?
options: Rain washes away the salt used to preserve the fish during drying
Clouds block the sunlight that fish need to make them taste better
Fish dries faster on sunny days, so drying is slow in rainy or cool weather
Rain causes bacteria to grow faster, so the fish must be eaten right away
explanation: Fish dries faster on sunny days, so it is hard to dry food when the weather is rainy or cool.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis matuyo ang isda kapag maaraw, kaya mahirap magpatuyo kapag maulan o malamig ang panahon.
fact_bis: Mas paspas mauga ang isda kung init ang adlaw, mao nga lisod magpauga kung ting-ulan o bugnaw ang panahon.

q: Why are dogs often treated as members of the family?
options: Dogs can understand and speak simple human words after training
Dogs can do household chores and help take care of small children
Dogs form strong bonds with the family that cares for them
Dogs protect the family by memorizing the face of every stranger
explanation: Dogs form strong bonds with the family that cares for them, which is why they are treated as part of the family.
fact_tl: Nakakabuo ng matibay na ugnayan ang aso sa pamilyang nag-aalaga sa kanila, kaya tinuturing silang bahagi ng pamilya.
fact_bis: Ang iro makahimo og lig-on nga relasyon sa pamilya nga nag-atiman kanila, mao nga giisip sila nga bahin sa pamilya.

q: Why does adrenaline make your pupils get wider when you are scared or in danger?
options: Wider pupils reduce glare so you can see in very bright conditions
Wider pupils allow more light in, helping you see danger around you more clearly
Wider pupils signal to other animals that you are ready to fight
Wider pupils help your eyes focus faster on objects that are far away
explanation: Adrenaline widens the pupils so more light can come in, helping you see danger around you more clearly.
fact_tl: Pinapalaki ng adrenaline ang balintataw (pupils) ng iyong mga mata para mas maraming liwanag ang pumasok. Nakakatulong ito para mas malinaw mong makita ang panganib sa paligid.
fact_bis: Gipadako sa adrenaline ang pupil o balintataw sa imong mga mata aron mas daghang kahayag ang makasulod. Makatabang kini aron mas klaro nimong makita ang katalagman sa imong palibot.

q: Why do coral reefs recover faster inside marine protected areas where fishing is banned?
options: Protected areas are kept cleaner of plastic waste which smothers coral
The ban on fishing allows more fish and less human disturbance, helping coral heal faster
Scientists regularly plant new coral fragments inside protected areas
Protected areas have warmer water temperatures that help coral grow
explanation: Inside marine protected areas where fishing is banned, coral reefs recover faster from damage compared with areas open to fishing.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng mga marine protected area o sanctuary kung saan ipinagbabawal ang pangingisda, ang mga coral reef ay mas mabilis na nakakabawi mula sa pinsala kumpara sa mga lugar na bukas sa pangingisda.
fact_bis: Sulod sa mga marine protected area o sanctuary diin ang pangisda gidili, ang mga coral reef mas paspas nga nagkaayo gikan sa kadaot kumpara sa mga lugar nga bukas sa pangisda.

q: What tiny tubes in a plant carry water upward from the roots to the leaves through capillary action?
options: Phloem tubes that transport sugars made in the leaves
Stomata openings that pull water up from the soil
Xylem tubes through which capillary action moves water upward
Cambium layers that produce new water-carrying cells each year
explanation: Capillary action helps water rise from the roots up through tiny tubes called xylem to reach the stem and leaves.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang capillary action na umakyat ang tubig mula sa ugat papunta sa tangkay at dahon ng halaman sa loob ng maliliit na tubo na tinatawag na xylem.
fact_bis: Ang capillary action makatabang nga mosaka ang tubig gikan sa gamot paingon sa lawas ug dahon sa tanom pinaagi sa gagmay nga mga tubo nga gitawag og xylem.

q: Who is called the father of electrodynamics, the study of how electric current produces magnetism?
options: Michael Faraday
Alessandro Volta
Andre-Marie Ampere
James Clerk Maxwell
explanation: Andre-Marie Ampere is called the father of electrodynamics, the study of how electric current produces magnetism.
fact_tl: Si Andre-Marie Ampere ay tinatawag na ama ng electrodynamics, na nag-aaral kung paano gumagawa ng magnetismo ang agos ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Si Andre-Marie Ampere gitawag nga amahan sa electrodynamics, ang pagtuon kon giunsa paghimo og magnetismo sa agos sa kuryente.

q: Why is it more convincing to see heat, a color change, AND bubbling together rather than just heat alone?
options: Having three signs means the reaction is also releasing a gas that can be captured
A single sign like heat can come from a physical change, but multiple signs together make a chemical reaction much more certain
Three signs happening at once means the reaction is going faster and is more complete
Seeing more signs allows you to identify the exact chemicals that reacted
explanation: A single sign like heat can also come from a physical change, but when you see heat, a color change, and bubbling all together, you can be much more sure a chemical reaction really happened.
fact_tl: Bakit mas mabuti kung dalawa o higit pang tanda ang makita? Dahil ang isang tanda lang — gaya ng init — ay puwede ring dahil sa pisikal na pagbabago. Pero kapag sabay-sabay na nakita mo ang init, pagbabago ng kulay, at bula, mas sigurado kang naganap ang reaksyong kemikal.
fact_bis: Ngano mas maayo kon duha o labaw pa ka timailhan ang makita? Kay ang usa ra ka timailhan — sama sa init — mahimong gikan ra sa pisikal nga kausaban. Apan kon dungan nimong makita ang init, pagbag-o sa kolor, ug bula, mas sigurado ka nga tinuod nga nahitabo ang reaksiyong kemikal.

q: Why is ocean plastic especially dangerous to sea turtles that eat jellyfish?
options: Plastic cuts the inside of a turtle's throat, making it hard to swallow real food
Plastic releases chemicals that poison the jellyfish that turtles try to eat
Turtles mistake floating plastic for jellyfish and eat it, which can harm or kill them
Plastic bags trap turtles underwater and prevent them from surfacing to breathe
explanation: Sea turtles mistake floating plastic for jellyfish and eat it, which is why keeping the ocean clean is so important for their survival.
fact_tl: Ang ilang pawikan ay kumakain ng dikya (jellyfish). Dahil dito, mapanganib ang plastik sa dagat — napagkakamalan nilang dikya ang lumulutang na plastik at kinakain ito, kaya dapat nating panatilihing malinis ang dagat.
fact_bis: Ang ubang pawikan mokaon og dikya (jellyfish). Tungod niini, delikado ang plastik sa dagat — masaypan nila nga dikya ang naglutaw nga plastik ug kan-on kini, busa kinahanglan natong limpyohan ang dagat.

q: What did Benjamin Franklin prove through his famous experiment?
options: That electricity can travel through water as fast as through metal wire
That lightning rods must be made of copper to work effectively
That lightning is a form of electricity
That thunderclouds are formed by the collision of warm and cold air
explanation: Benjamin Franklin showed through an experiment that lightning is a form of electricity.
fact_tl: Ipinakita ni Benjamin Franklin sa pamamagitan ng eksperimento na ang kidlat ay isang uri ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Gipakita ni Benjamin Franklin pinaagi sa eksperimento nga ang kilat usa ka matang sa kuryente.

q: In a hemoglobin molecule, where exactly does oxygen attach?
options: Along the outer protein chain that wraps around the iron rings
At the junction between two globin protein halves
Onto the central iron atom inside a small ring-shaped structure called a heme
On the surface of the red blood cell, not inside hemoglobin itself
explanation: Inside hemoglobin, iron sits at the center of a ring-shaped structure called a heme, and oxygen attaches right onto that central iron.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng hemoglobin, ang iron ay nasa gitna ng isang maliit na istrukturang parang singsing na tinatawag na heme. Dito mismo sa iron sa gitna ng heme dumidikit ang oxygen. Apat na heme ang nasa isang hemoglobin, kaya apat na oxygen ang kaya nitong dalhin.
fact_bis: Sulod sa hemoglobin, ang iron anaa sa tunga sa usa ka gamay nga estruktura nga sama sa singsing nga gitawag og heme. Dinhi mismo sa iron sa tunga sa heme motapot ang oxygen. Upat ka heme ang naa sa usa ka hemoglobin, mao nga upat ka oxygen ang madala niini.

q: How do rough, sharp rocks become smooth, round pebbles in a river?
options: River water slowly dissolves the sharp edges through a chemical reaction with the rock
Pressure from the deep water above them squeezes the rocks into rounded shapes
They rub against one another over and over as flowing water carries them, wearing down the edges
Tiny microorganisms in river water eat away at the sharp corners of the rocks
explanation: Pebbles in a river become smooth and round because they rub against one another repeatedly as flowing water carries them — a process called abrasion.
fact_tl: Ang mga bato sa ilog ay nagiging makinis at bilog dahil sila ay paulit-ulit na nagkukuskusan habang dinadala ng umaagos na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga bato sa suba mahimong hamis ug lingin tungod kay sila balikbalik nga magkuskosanay samtang gidala sa nagdagayday nga tubig.

q: What is 'deep-sea gigantism,' and which animal is a well-known example of it?
options: The tendency for deep-sea fish to glow brightly; an example is the anglerfish
The growth of very large eyes in deep-sea animals; an example is the giant squid
When deep-sea invertebrates grow far larger than their shallow-water relatives; an example is the giant isopod reaching 50 cm
When deep-sea mammals grow bigger than surface relatives; an example is the sperm whale
explanation: Deep-sea gigantism is the tendency for some deep-sea invertebrates to grow much larger than their shallow-water relatives; the giant isopod can reach 50 centimeters while land relatives are only a few centimeters.
fact_tl: Sa malalim na dagat, ang ilang mga invertebrate ay lumalaki nang malayo sa karaniwang laki ng kanilang mga kamag-anak sa mababaw na tubig — tinatawag itong 'deep-sea gigantism'; ang halimbawa ay ang giant isopod na maaaring lumaki ng hanggang 50 sentimetro, habang ang kanilang mga kamag-anak sa lupa ay ilang sentimetro lamang.
fact_bis: Sa lawom nga dagat, ang pipila ka mga invertebrate nagdako nga mas dako kay sa ilang mga paryenti sa mababaw nga tubig — gitawag og 'deep-sea gigantism'; usa ka ehemplo mao ang giant isopod nga makaabot og 50 sentimetro, samtang ang ilang mga paryenti sa yuta pipila ka sentimetro lamang.

q: During exercise, what do muscles use oxygen for?
options: To cool down the muscle fibers and prevent them from overheating
To carry away the lactic acid that builds up and causes soreness
To produce energy through aerobic respiration, releasing carbon dioxide as a waste product
To repair tiny tears in the muscle fibers that happen during hard exercise
explanation: During exercise, muscles use oxygen to produce energy through aerobic respiration, and carbon dioxide is released as a waste product.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng ehersisyo, ang mga kalamnan ay gumagamit ng oxygen upang makagawa ng energy; ito ang tinatawag na aerobic respiration at ginagawa ang carbon dioxide bilang basura.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa ehersisyo, ang mga kaunuran naggamit ug oxygen aron makahimo ug energy sa proseso nga gitawag aerobic respiration, nagpatubas ug carbon dioxide ingon basura.

q: In what way are Philippine sunbirds similar to hummingbirds?
options: Both hover in place by flapping their wings faster than any other bird
Both have the same bright red and orange feathers found nowhere else in birds
Both drink nectar from flowers as a main part of their diet
Both build identical cup-shaped nests attached to the underside of leaves
explanation: Philippine sunbirds are similar to hummingbirds because both drink nectar from flowers.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga sunbird o pituhol ang kahawig ng hummingbird dahil umiinom din sila ng nektar sa bulaklak.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga sunbird o tamsi susama sa hummingbird kay sila usab moinom og nektar sa bulak.

q: Why might a child show a trait that neither parent has, but a grandparent does?
options: The child developed a brand-new mutation that happened to look like the grandparent's trait
Traits can be copied from grandparents directly through a special type of cell memory
A recessive gene can be carried by a parent without showing, then appear in the child
The environment the child grows up in can re-activate old family traits that were dormant
explanation: A recessive gene can be carried by a parent without showing and then appear in the child, which is why a trait sometimes seems to skip a generation.
fact_tl: Minsan ang isang bata ay may katangiang wala sa kanyang mga magulang pero nasa lolo o lola. Nangyayari ito kapag ang isang recessive gene ay dinala ng magulang nang hindi ito lumalabas, tapos lumitaw sa anak.
fact_bis: Usahay ang bata adunay kinaiya nga wala sa iyang mga ginikanan apan anaa sa iyang apohan. Mahitabo kini kung ang recessive nga gene gidala sa ginikanan nga wala mogawas, dayon mogawas sa anak.

q: What did Darwin observe about the finches on the Galapagos Islands that helped him understand how animals adapt?
options: All the finches had the same beak shape but different body sizes depending on the island
The finches on each island had brighter feathers than finches found anywhere else on Earth
Related finches had differently shaped beaks depending on what they ate — thin for insects, thick for hard seeds
The finches could not fly from island to island, so each island had a completely different species
explanation: Darwin noticed that related finch birds had differently shaped beaks depending on what they ate — thin for insects, thick for hard seeds — showing how animals fit to their environment.
fact_tl: Sa Galapagos Islands, napansin ni Darwin na ang magkakaugnay na ibong finch ay may magkakaibang hugis ng tuka depende sa kanilang kinakain — manipis para sa insekto, makapal para sa matitigas na buto — isang halimbawa ng pag-aangkop sa kapaligiran.
fact_bis: Sa Galapagos Islands, namatikdan ni Darwin nga ang nagkadugtong nga mga langgam nga finch adunay lainlaing porma sa sungo depende sa ilang gikaon — nipis para sa insekto, baga para sa gahi nga liso — usa ka pananglitan sa pagpahiangay sa palibot.

q: Why does sound travel faster in water than in air, and how does this help dolphins?
options: Water molecules vibrate at higher temperatures, speeding up all sounds equally
Sound waves in water are bigger and longer, so they cover more distance per second
Sound travels faster in water because water molecules are closer together, which makes echolocation work well for dolphins
Water filters out background noise, so dolphins hear only the echoes they need
explanation: Sound travels faster in water than in air because water molecules are closer together, which makes echolocation work well for dolphins in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay naglalakbay nang mas mabilis sa tubig kaysa sa hangin, kaya mabuti ang echolocation para sa mga lumba-lumba sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tingog mobiyahe nga mas paspas sa tubig kaysa sa hangin, mao nga maayo ang echolocation alang sa mga lumba-lumba sa dagat.

q: What happens when two objects with the same type of charge (both positive or both negative) are near each other?
options: They spin around each other in circles because the charges are balanced
They attract each other and stick together tightly
They push each other away
They have no effect on each other because equal charges cancel out
explanation: Like charges push each other away (repel), while opposite charges attract and cling together.
fact_tl: Ang magkaparehong charge (parehong positibo o parehong negatibo) ay nagtataboy sa isa't isa, habang ang magkaibang charge (positibo at negatibo) ay naaakit at nagkakadikit. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit may bagay na dumidikit at may bagay na tumataboy.
fact_bis: Ang managsama nga charge (parehong positibo o parehong negatibo) magtinul-iray sa usag usa, samtang ang magkalahi nga charge (positibo ug negatibo) magdinanihay ug magdikit. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong adunay butang nga modikit ug adunay motul-id palayo.

q: What type of star is Betelgeuse, and in which constellation can it be found?
options: A yellow dwarf star in the constellation Scorpius
A white dwarf star in the constellation Taurus
A blue supergiant star in the constellation Cassiopeia
A red supergiant star in the constellation Orion
explanation: Betelgeuse is a red supergiant star found in the constellation Orion.
fact_tl: Ang Betelgeuse ay isang pulang higanteng bituin (red supergiant) sa konstelasyong Orion.
fact_bis: Ang Betelgeuse usa ka pula nga higante nga bituon (red supergiant) sa konstelasyon nga Orion.

q: How do bananas grow on the plant?
options: They grow joined together in large bunches holding many bananas
They grow one by one along a single stem
They hang separately from the roots of the plant
They grow in pairs, always two bananas together
explanation: Bananas do not grow one by one — they grow joined together in large bunches that hold many bananas.
fact_tl: Hindi tumutubo nang isa-isa ang saging — nagtutubo ito nang magkakadikit sa malalaking buwig na may maraming saging.
fact_bis: Dili magtinagsa og tubo ang saging — motubo kini nga nagdugtong sa dagkong buwig nga adunay daghang saging.

q: What does aerobic respiration need in order to release a lot of energy?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Glucose only, with no gas needed
explanation: Aerobic respiration needs oxygen and gives a lot of energy.
fact_tl: Ang aerobic respiration ay nangangailangan ng oxygen at nagbibigay ng maraming enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang aerobic respiration nanginahanglan og oksiheno ug naghatag og daghang kusog.

q: Why does ice float on top of liquid water?
options: Ice is colder, so it rises above warmer water
Ice is lighter than the same amount of liquid water because water expands when it freezes
Ice contains trapped air bubbles that push it upward
Frozen water is denser, so it naturally rises to the surface
explanation: Water expands as it freezes, so each part of the ice weighs less than the same volume of liquid water, causing it to float.
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang yelo sa tubig dahil mas magaan ito kaysa sa likidong tubig na kapareho nitong dami. Dahil lumalaki ang tubig kapag nagyeyelo, nagiging mas magaan ang bawat bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Molutaw ang yelo sa tubig kay mas gaan kini kaysa sa parehas nga gidaghanon sa likidong tubig. Tungod kay modako ang tubig kung mag-yelo, mas gaan ang matag bahin niini, mao nga molutaw.

q: How does a python kill its prey?
options: It spits venom at its prey from a distance
It bites with hollow fangs that inject poison
It squeezes its prey tightly with coils of its body
It crushes prey under its heavy body weight
explanation: A python has no venom; it kills its prey by squeezing it tightly with coils of its body.
fact_tl: Ang sawa ay walang lason; pinapatay nito ang biktima sa pamamagitan ng mahigpit na pagpisil gamit ang katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang sawa walay hilo; ginapatay niini ang tukbonon pinaagi sa hugot nga pagpiga sa lawas niini.

q: How does dried bagasse help power a sugar factory?
options: It is mixed with water to create a chemical reaction that powers generators
It is burned in a boiler to heat water into steam that runs the machines
It is compressed into blocks that store electricity for later use
It is fermented to release gas that turns the factory turbines
explanation: Dried bagasse is burned in a boiler to heat water and make steam, and that steam runs the machines and gives electricity to the whole sugar factory.
fact_tl: Ang tuyong bagasse ay sinusunog sa isang boiler para magpainit ng tubig at gumawa ng singaw. Ang singaw na ito ang nagpapaandar sa makina at nagbibigay ng kuryente sa buong asukarera.
fact_bis: Ang uga nga bagasse sunogon sa boiler aron painiton ang tubig ug mohimo og alisngaw. Kining alisngaw maoy modagan sa makina ug mohatag og kuryente sa tibuok asukarera.

q: What does stunting mean when we talk about a child's health?
options: A child is too heavy for their age because of eating too much
A child is too short for their age because of not getting enough nutrition over a long time
A child is underweight due to a recent illness or infection
A child has delayed speech and language development from birth
explanation: Stunting means a child is too short for their age because of not getting enough nutrition over a long time, and it is a sign of malnutrition that has built up over many months or years.
fact_tl: Ang stunting ay nangangahulugang masyadong pandak ang isang bata para sa kanyang edad dahil sa matagal na kakulangan sa sustansya. Ito ay tanda ng malnutrisyon na nangyari sa loob ng maraming buwan o taon.
fact_bis: Ang stunting nagpasabot nga sobra ka mubo ang usa ka bata alang sa iyang edad tungod sa dugay nga kakulang sa sustansya. Timaan kini sa malnutrisyon nga natipon sulod sa daghang bulan o tuig.

q: About how long is an elephant pregnant before giving birth?
options: About 6 months, similar to a lion
About 12 months, the same as a horse
About 22 months, the longest pregnancy of any land animal
About 36 months, nearly 3 years
explanation: An elephant is pregnant for about 22 months — nearly 2 years — the longest pregnancy of any land animal.
fact_tl: Ang elepante ay buntis nang halos 22 buwan (mga 2 taon), ang pinakamahabang pagbubuntis sa lahat ng hayop sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang elepante mabdos sulod sa mga 22 ka bulan (halos 2 ka tuig), ang pinakataas nga pagmabdos sa tanang hayop sa yuta.

q: How are ferns able to grow taller than mosses?
options: Ferns grow in sunnier spots which gives them more energy to grow tall
Ferns have tiny tubes inside that carry water from the roots up to the leaves
Ferns have thicker cell walls that support their height
Ferns store extra water in their leaves to stay rigid and upright
explanation: Ferns have tiny tubes (vascular tissue) inside that carry water from the roots up to the leaves, which lets them grow taller than mosses.
fact_tl: Ang pako ay may maliliit na tubo (vascular tubes) sa loob na nagdadala ng tubig mula sa ugat patungo sa dahon, kaya ito ay kayang tumubo nang mas mataas kaysa lumot.
fact_bis: Ang pako adunay gagmayng tubo (vascular tubes) sa sulod nga nagdala sa tubig gikan sa gamot ngadto sa dahon, mao nga makatubo kini nga mas tag-as kaysa lumot.

q: Where does a tortoise live?
options: In rivers and lakes, swimming most of the time
Equally on land and in water, like a frog
Only on land and usually cannot swim
In the ocean, coming ashore only to lay eggs
explanation: A tortoise lives only on land and usually cannot swim.
fact_tl: Ang tortoise ay nakatira sa lupa lamang at karaniwang hindi marunong lumangoy.
fact_bis: Ang tortoise nagpuyo lang sa yuta ug kasagaran dili kabalo molangoy.

q: Why is the soft, fleshy rim around a remora's suction disc so important?
options: It makes the disc colorful so the host fish does not try to remove the remora
It hardens like glue to permanently bond the remora to the host's skin
It presses snugly against the host's skin to seal out water and keep the suction strong
It releases a numbing chemical so the host fish does not feel the remora attached
explanation: The soft, thick fleshy rim presses snugly against the skin and seals out water from getting under the disc; without that closed edge the suction would weaken instantly.
fact_tl: Sa gilid ng disc ay may malambot at makapal na laman na parang goma. Ito ang dumidikit nang husto sa balat at humaharang para walang tubig na makapasok sa ilalim ng disc. Kung hindi sarado ang gilid na ito, hihina agad ang suction — kaya napakahalaga ng malambot na rim na ito.
fact_bis: Sa ngilit sa disc adunay humok ug baga nga unod nga morag goma. Kini ang moduot pag-ayo sa panit ug mosanta aron walay tubig nga makasulod ilawom sa disc. Kung dili sirado kini nga ngilit, dali nga mohuyang ang suction — busa importante kaayo kini nga humok nga rim.

q: Why do farmers tap rubber trees early in the morning?
options: The tree produces the most latex only at sunrise, then stops
Cool morning temperatures make the latex flow better and longer, so more is collected
Insects that damage the cut are only active in the afternoon
The latex dries faster in the morning air and is easier to collect
explanation: In cool weather, the latex flows better and longer than when the sun gets hot, so tapping early in the morning lets the farmer collect more.
fact_tl: Karaniwang ginagawa ang tapping nang maaga sa umaga habang malamig pa. Sa malamig na panahon, mas mabuti at mas matagal dumaloy ang latex kaysa kapag mainit na ang araw, kaya mas marami ang nakukuha.
fact_bis: Kasagaran himuon ang tapping og sayo sa buntag samtang bugnaw pa. Sa bugnaw nga panahon, mas maayo ug mas dugay modagayday ang latex kaysa kung init na ang adlaw, mao nga mas daghan ang makuha.

q: Why do many birds migrate together in a flock instead of flying alone?
options: Flying in a flock lets birds take turns navigating so none get lost
Migrating together as a flock makes the journey safer and easier
Birds share body heat in a flock so they stay warm during cold migration routes
Flocking allows birds to eat while flying by catching insects disturbed by others
explanation: Many birds migrate together in a flock so their journey is safer and easier.
fact_tl: Maraming ibon ang lumilipat nang sama-sama bilang isang kawan upang mas ligtas at mas madali ang kanilang paglalakbay.
fact_bis: Daghang langgam ang mobalhin nga managsama isip usa ka panon aron mas luwas ug mas sayon ang ilang panaw.

q: Which statement about how we should treat ourselves is true?
options: You should never make mistakes, because mistakes mean you are not trying hard enough
Being kind to yourself means avoiding all difficult tasks so you do not fail
It is important to be kind to yourself — it is okay to make mistakes, and you do not need to be perfect to matter
You only deserve kindness after you have helped other people first
explanation: It is important to be kind to yourself — it is okay to make mistakes, and you do not need to be perfect to matter.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang maging mabait sa sarili — okay lang magkamali, at hindi kailangang maging perpekto upang maging mahalaga ka.
fact_bis: Importante nga magmaayo sa kaugalingon — okay ra nga masayop, ug dili kinahanglan nga hingpit ka aron mahimong importante.

q: What is the source of energy for hydropower?
options: Heat from underground rocks that warms river water
Chemical energy stored in water molecules
Moving water that spins a turbine to make electricity
The pressure of deep ocean water pushing through pipes
explanation: Hydropower is energy from moving water — flowing water spins a turbine to make electricity.
fact_tl: Ang hydropower ay enerhiyang galing sa gumagalaw na tubig — pinapagalaw ng umaagos na tubig ang turbine para gumawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang hydropower kay enerhiya gikan sa naglihok nga tubig — ang nag-agos nga tubig motuyok sa turbine aron makahimo ug koryente.

q: How does a cuttlefish use its cuttlebone to rise or sink in water?
options: It pumps seawater in and out of the cuttlebone's chambers to change weight
It changes how much gas versus water is inside the cuttlebone's chambers
It expands the cuttlebone to increase its body size and displace more water
It uses muscles to bend the cuttlebone and steer up or down
explanation: The cuttlebone has tiny chambers filled with gas and water; the cuttlefish changes how much gas versus water is inside to rise or sink, working like a built-in flotation device.
fact_tl: Ang cuttlebone ay may maliliit na siwang na puno ng gas at tubig. Para lumutang o lumubog, pinapalitan ng cuttlefish ang dami ng gas at tubig sa loob nito, parang isang likas na 'flotation device' sa katawan niya.
fact_bis: Ang cuttlebone naay gagmay nga mga lawak nga puno sa gas ug tubig. Aron molutaw o molubog, baylohan sa cuttlefish ang gidaghanon sa gas ug tubig sa sulod, sama sa usa ka natural nga flotation device.

q: Is the maya (Eurasian tree sparrow) found only in the Philippines?
options: Yes, it is found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in Asia
No, it is found in many countries across Asia and Europe, not only in the Philippines
No, it originally came from Australia and was brought to the Philippines
Yes, but it has recently spread to nearby countries like Malaysia
explanation: The Eurasian tree sparrow we call maya is found in many countries across Asia and Europe, not only in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Eurasian tree sparrow na tinatawag nating maya ay matatagpuan sa maraming bansa sa Asya at Europa, hindi lamang sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Eurasian tree sparrow nga atong gitawag og maya makita sa daghang nasod sa Asya ug Uropa, dili lamang sa Pilipinas.

q: What causes a rockfall on a steep mountainside?
options: Wind erosion slowly pushes rocks sideways until they tip over the edge
Gravity pulls loose rocks down, often triggered by heavy rain or an earthquake
Underground rivers dissolve the rock base until pieces collapse
Plant roots push rocks out of the slope as they grow larger
explanation: A rockfall happens when rocks break loose from a steep mountainside and tumble down because gravity pulls them, often triggered by heavy rain or an earthquake.
fact_tl: Ang rockfall ay nangyayari kapag ang mga bato sa gilid ng bundok ay kumakalas at bumabagsak dahil sa hila ng grabidad, na kadalasang pinalalala ng matinding ulan o lindol.
fact_bis: Ang rockfall mahitabo kung ang mga bato sa kilid sa bukid mobuhi ug mahulog tungod sa grabidad, nga kasagaran mograbe sa kusog nga ulan o linog.

q: Why should you never take antibiotics without a doctor's prescription?
options: Antibiotics taste very bitter and can upset your stomach without food
Taking the wrong antibiotic or dose helps resistance grow, making bacteria harder to treat
Antibiotics are only needed for viral infections like the flu and colds
Antibiotics can only be given as injections, never as pills, without a doctor present
explanation: Taking antibiotics without a prescription is dangerous because the wrong medicine or dose helps antibiotic resistance grow.
fact_tl: Huwag uminom ng antibiotiko nang walang reseta ng doktor, dahil ang maling gamot o dosis ay nakakatulong sa pag-usbong ng resistensya.
fact_bis: Ayaw pag-inom ug antibyotiko nga walay reseta sa doktor, kay ang sayop nga tambal o dosis makatabang sa pagtubo sa resistensya.

q: Who built the very first steam locomotive to run on rails?
options: James Watt, who also invented the steam engine
George Stephenson, the famous railway engineer
Richard Trevithick, in 1804
Robert Fulton, who pioneered steam-powered transportation
explanation: Richard Trevithick built the very first steam locomotive to run on rails, in 1804.
fact_tl: Si Richard Trevithick ang gumawa ng pinakaunang steam locomotive na tumakbo sa riles, noong 1804.
fact_bis: Si Richard Trevithick ang naghimo sa pinakaunang steam locomotive nga midagan sa riles, niadtong 1804.

q: Why do farmers move goats from one part of the pasture to another?
options: To prevent goats from fighting over the same territory
So the land can rest and the grass can grow back, giving goats a constant food supply
To expose the goats to sunlight evenly across all parts of the farm
Because goats refuse to eat the same grass more than once
explanation: Farmers move goats from one part of the pasture to another so the land can rest and the grass can grow back, so the goats never run out of food.
fact_tl: Inililipat-lipat ng mga magsasaka ang kambing sa iba't ibang bahagi ng pastulan para makapagpahinga ang lupa at muling tumubo ang damo, kaya hindi ito naubusan ng makakain.
fact_bis: Ginabalhin sa mga mag-uuma ang kanding ngadto sa lainlaing bahin sa sabsabanan aron makapahulay ang yuta ug motubo pag-usab ang sagbot, mao nga dili mahurot ang ilang makaon.

q: How long can a large jackfruit grow?
options: About 10 centimeters, roughly the size of a mango
About 30 centimeters, similar to a large pineapple
Almost one meter long
About 2 meters long, as tall as a grown person
explanation: A large jackfruit can grow to be almost one meter long.
fact_tl: Ang isang malaking langka ay maaaring umabot sa halos isang metro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang dako nga nangka mahimong motaas og halos usa ka metro.

q: Which other animals, besides crabs, have eyes on stalks?
options: Octopuses and squids, which are also found in the sea
Shrimp, prawns, and lobsters, which are all crustaceans like crabs
Sea urchins and starfish, which live on the ocean floor
Jellyfish and sea anemones, which are soft-bodied sea animals
explanation: Crabs, shrimp, prawns, and lobsters all have stalked eyes and all belong to the same family called crustaceans.
fact_tl: Hindi lang alimango ang may matang nakatangkay—pati ang hipon, ulang, at lobster ay ganoon din. Magkakapamilya sila lahat na tinatawag na crustaceans. Kaya kung titingnan mong mabuti ang hipon sa palengke, makikita mong nakausli din ang maliliit nitong mata sa dulo ng tangkay.
fact_bis: Dili lang alimango ang adunay mata nga naa sa tangkay; ang pasayan, ulang, ug lobster aduna usab. Managsoon silang tanan nga gitawag og crustaceans. Mao nga kon tan-awon nimo pag-ayo ang pasayan sa merkado, makita nimo nga nagtoybo usab ang gagmay niini nga mata sa tumoy sa tangkay.

q: Which snake holds the record for being the longest in the world?
options: The king cobra, known for its deadly venom and great length
The anaconda, a heavy water snake found in South America
The reticulated python, found in the Philippines, reaching over six to seven meters
The black mamba, the fastest and longest African snake
explanation: The reticulated python, found in the Philippines, is the longest snake in the world, reaching more than six to seven meters.
fact_tl: Ang reticulated python na matatagpuan sa Pilipinas ang pinakamahabang ahas sa mundo, na umaabot ng mahigit anim hanggang pitong metro.
fact_bis: Ang reticulated python nga makit-an sa Pilipinas mao ang pinakataas nga halas sa kalibotan, nga moabot ug kapin sa unom ngadto pito ka metro.

q: What is pollen and why is it important to a flower?
options: A sweet liquid produced by petals to attract insects for shade
A fine powder made by the stamen that is needed to make seeds
A sticky substance on petals that traps insects to help the plant eat
A colored pigment inside petals that helps the flower absorb sunlight
explanation: Pollen is like a fine yellow powder made by the stamen, and it is needed to make seeds.
fact_tl: Ang pollen ay parang manipis na dilaw na pulbos na gawa ng stamen; ito ang kailangan para makagawa ng binhi.
fact_bis: Ang pollen sama sa nipis nga dalag nga pulbos nga gibuhat sa stamen, ug gikinahanglan kini aron makahimo og liso.

q: On the Saffir-Simpson scale, which categories are called 'major hurricanes'?
options: Categories 1 and 2, which are the most common storms
Categories 3, 4, and 5, with winds of at least 178 km/h
Only Category 5, the most destructive storm level
Categories 2, 3, and 4, the middle range of the scale
explanation: On the Saffir-Simpson scale, Categories 3, 4, and 5 are called 'major hurricanes' — those with winds of 178 km/h or more.
fact_tl: Sa Saffir-Simpson scale, tinatawag na 'major hurricane' ang Category 3, 4, at 5 — yaong may hanging 178 km/h (111 mph) pataas.
fact_bis: Sa Saffir-Simpson scale, ang Category 3, 4, ug 5 gitawag nga 'major hurricane' — kadtong adunay hangin nga 178 km/h (111 mph) pataas.

q: What would happen to the planets if the Sun's gravity suddenly disappeared?
options: The planets would slowly drift toward the center of the solar system
The planets would crash into each other without gravity to keep them apart
The planets would fly off in a straight line into space
The planets would stop moving and float still in place
explanation: If the Sun's gravity suddenly disappeared, the planets would fly off in a straight line into space instead of following their curved orbits.
fact_tl: Kung biglang mawawala ang grabidad ng Araw, ang mga planeta ay lilipad nang tuwid na linya papuntang kalawakan.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga mawala ang gibug-aton sa Adlaw, ang mga planeta molupad sa tul-id nga linya padulong sa kawanangan.

q: Which description best fits a liverwort plant?
options: A tall leafy plant with deep roots that grows in dry, sunny meadows
A plant with colorful flowers that reproduces by making seeds
A small, simple plant with no true roots or flowers that grows as a flat mat on damp, shaded surfaces
A climbing vine with woody stems that clings to tree trunks in rainforests
explanation: A liverwort is a small, simple plant with no true roots or flowers that grows as a flat, leafy mat on damp, shaded soil and rocks.
fact_tl: Ang liverwort ay maliit at simpleng halamang walang tunay na ugat o bulaklak na tumutubo bilang lapad na kapal sa basa at malilim na lupa o bato.
fact_bis: Ang liverwort usa ka gamay ug simple nga tanom nga walay tinuod nga gamot o bulak, nga motubo isip lapad nga sapaw sa basa ug landong nga yuta o bato.

q: Where does silk really come from?
options: From the fluffy seed pods of a plant, similar to cotton
From the resin of a special tropical tree, like rubber
From an animal called the silkworm
From a type of sea animal that spins fine threads underwater
explanation: Silk does not come from a plant — it comes from an animal, the tiny silkworm.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba ay galing sa halaman ang sutla tulad ng koton, pero mali ito. Ang sutla ay galing sa hayop, sa maliit na uod na silkworm.
fact_bis: Naghuna-huna ang uban nga gikan sa tanom ang sutla sama sa gapas, apan sayop kini. Ang sutla gikan sa hayop, sa gamay nga ulod nga silkworm.

q: Why does a star like the Sun stay steady and not explode or collapse?
options: The star's magnetic field creates a rigid shell that holds its shape
Gravity pulls inward while the heat from nuclear fusion pushes outward, and these two forces balance
The star is made of a gas that is too light to be pulled together by gravity
Dark matter surrounding the star pushes equally from all sides to keep it stable
explanation: A star stays steady because gravity pulling inward is balanced by the heat from fusion pushing outward.
fact_tl: Ang bituin ay hindi sumasabog o gumuguho dahil may balanse sa loob nito. Hinihila ng gravity ang lahat papasok, pero ang init ng fusion ay nagtutulak palabas. Magkapatas ang dalawang puwersa kaya panatag ang bituin sa mahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang bituon dili mobuto o mahugno tungod kay adunay balanse sa sulod niini. Ang grabidad mobira sa tanan paingon sa sulod, samtang ang kainit gikan sa fusion motulod paingon sa gawas. Managsama ang duha maong lig-on ang bituon sulod sa taas nga panahon.

q: How does knowing an insect's life cycle help people?
options: It helps farmers choose the best crops to plant each season
It tells scientists how to create new medicines from insect venom
It helps control pests, such as removing stagnant water to stop mosquitoes from breeding
It allows engineers to design machines that mimic insect wings for flight
explanation: Knowing an insect's life cycle helps us control pests, such as removing stagnant water to stop mosquitoes from laying eggs.
fact_tl: Ang pag-alam sa siklo ng buhay ng insekto ay tumutulong sa atin na kontrolin ang mga peste, gaya ng pag-aalis ng nakatigil na tubig para sa lamok.
fact_bis: Ang pagkahibalo sa siklo sa kinabuhi sa insekto motabang kanato sa pagpugong sa mga peste, sama sa pagkuha sa nagtigib nga tubig batok sa lamok.

q: How does a frog's smooth, wet skin help it move?
options: It reflects sunlight to keep the frog from overheating during long jumps
The wet surface makes its body slippery so it can slide and move more easily after jumping into water
It absorbs heat from the ground to fuel the muscles used for jumping
The moisture traps air bubbles that cushion the frog's legs when landing
explanation: A frog's slimy skin coating makes its body slippery so it can slide and move more easily after jumping into water.
fact_tl: Makinis at basa ang balat ng palaka dahil sa parang malabnaw na sustansya na bumabalot dito. Bukod sa tumutulong itong huminga, nagiging madulas ang katawan kaya mas madali silang nakakadausdos at nakakagalaw pagkatapos lumukso sa tubig.
fact_bis: Hamis ug basa ang panit sa baki tungod sa danlog nga sustansiya nga nagtabon niini. Gawas sa pagtabang niini nga makaginhawa, nahimong danlog ang lawas mao nga mas sayon sila makadausdos ug makalihok human molukso sa tubig.

q: How do many crystals form?
options: Crystals form when two liquid chemicals are mixed together and react instantly
Crystals form when water evaporates from a solution, leaving the dissolved material behind
Crystals form only under very high pressure deep inside the Earth
Crystals form when a gas cools and turns directly into a solid without becoming liquid
explanation: Many crystals grow when water evaporates from a solution, leaving the dissolved material behind as a crystal.
fact_tl: Maraming kristal ang tumutubo kapag sumisingaw ang tubig sa isang solusyon, kaya naiiwan ang natunaw na sangkap bilang kristal.
fact_bis: Daghang kristal motubo kon mawala ang tubig sa solusyon, mao nga ang natunaw nga sangkap mahimong kristal.

q: Why do you feel a small 'tick' when you touch a friend after walking on carpet?
options: The carpet warms your feet and the extra heat releases as a spark when you touch someone
You have built up electric charge on your body, and that charge jumps to your friend to return to balance
Your shoes create friction that generates a magnetic pulse felt when two people touch
The static electricity stored in the carpet's fibers is released when two people make contact
explanation: After building up charge on your body, touching a friend lets the charge jump between your fingers, returning to balance — both people feel a small 'tick'.
fact_tl: Kung nag-ipon ka ng charge sa katawan mo at hinawakan mo ang kamay ng kaibigan, pwedeng tumalon ang charge sa pagitan ng inyong mga daliri at parehas kayong makaramdam ng maliit na 'tik'. Hindi ito masama—nagbabalik lang sa balanse ang charge sa pagitan ninyong dalawa.
fact_bis: Kon nakatigom ka ug charge sa imong lawas ug hikapon nimo ang kamot sa imong higala, mahimong molukso ang charge tali sa inyong mga tudlo ug pareho kamong mobati ug gamay nga 'tik'. Dili kini daotan—mibalik ra ang charge sa balanse tali ninyong duha.

q: Where do diamonds form in nature?
options: At the bottom of the ocean under the weight of miles of seawater
In desert regions where extreme daytime heat bakes carbon-rich sand
Deep inside the Earth, where heat and pressure are extremely high
In meteorites that fall from space and cool very slowly over millions of years
explanation: Diamonds form deep inside the Earth, where heat and pressure are extremely high.
fact_tl: Ang diamante ay nabubuo sa napakalalim na bahagi ng Lupa, kung saan napakataas ng init at presyon.
fact_bis: Ang diyamante mabuhat sa lalom kaayo nga bahin sa Yuta, diin grabe ka taas ang init ug presyon.

q: Which is a real limitation of solar power?
options: Solar panels produce the most electricity at night when temperatures are coolest
Solar energy works well everywhere on Earth, including polar regions with long winters
Solar power needs large land areas and produces no electricity at night or on very cloudy days
Storing solar energy is cheap and easy, but the panels themselves are very expensive to make
explanation: Solar power has limitations — it needs large land areas, produces no electricity at night or on very cloudy days, and storing excess solar energy is still expensive.
fact_tl: Ang solar power ay may mga kakulangan — kailangan nito ng malaking lawak ng lupa, hindi ito nagpo-produce ng kuryente sa gabi o sa masyadong maulap na araw, at ang storage ng sobrang solar energy ay mahal pa.
fact_bis: Ang solar power adunay mga kakulangan — nagkinahanglan kini ug dako nga lugar sa yuta, dili kini nagmugna ug kuryente sa gabii o sa labihan ka maulap nga adlaw, ug ang pagtiging sa sobrang solar energy mahal pa.

q: Why do babies overheat more easily than older children and adults?
options: Babies have thinner skin that lets heat pass through from the outside much more easily
Not all of a baby's sweat glands are working fully yet, so babies cannot sweat as well
Babies produce more body heat because their organs are growing very rapidly
Babies have less body fat, so they cannot trap and release heat properly
explanation: Babies do not sweat as well yet because not all of their sweat glands are working fully, so they overheat more easily and must be watched in very hot weather.
fact_tl: Ang mga sanggol ay hindi pa gaanong marunong magpawis dahil hindi pa lubusang gumagana ang lahat ng kanilang sweat glands. Kaya mas madali silang mainitan at kailangang bantayan sa sobrang init.
fact_bis: Ang mga masuso dili pa kaayo kahibalo mosingot tungod kay wala pa molihok og hingpit ang tanan nilang sweat glands. Mao nga mas dali sila mainitan ug kinahanglang bantayan sa hilabihang init.

q: What happens to distilled water when it is left open to the air?
options: It slowly evaporates and leaves behind mineral salts on the container
It absorbs oxygen from the air and becomes slightly basic
It slowly absorbs carbon dioxide from the air and becomes slightly acidic
It reacts with nitrogen in the air to form a neutral solution of ammonia
explanation: When left open to the air, distilled water slowly absorbs carbon dioxide, which makes it slightly acidic and no longer perfectly neutral.
fact_tl: Kapag naiwang bukas sa hangin, dahan-dahang sumisipsip ang distiladong tubig ng carbon dioxide, kaya nagiging bahagyang asim ito at hindi na ganap na neutral.
fact_bis: Kon ibilin nga bukas sa hangin, hinay-hinay nga mosuyop ang distiladong tubig og carbon dioxide, mao nga mahimo kining gamay nga aslom ug dili na hingpit nga neutral.

q: How do rambutans grow on the tree?
options: They grow one at a time, each on its own long separate stem
They grow individually but hang together in clusters along the branches
They grow in pairs, always two fruits side by side on one stalk
They grow at the base of the tree trunk, attached to the roots
explanation: Rambutan grow individually but hang together in clusters along the branches.
fact_tl: Ang rambutan ay tumutubo nang tig-iisa pero nagsasama-sama sa mga kumpol sa sanga.
fact_bis: Ang rambutan motubo nga tag-usa apan magtapok sa mga pungpong subay sa sanga.

q: What sequence of energy changes happens inside a geothermal power plant?
options: Chemical energy → heat → light → electricity
Heat turns water to steam, steam spins a turbine, and that motion becomes electricity
Sound energy from underground vibrations is captured and converted into electricity
Pressure energy pushes water through pipes and is directly converted into an electric current
explanation: In a geothermal plant, heat (thermal energy) turns water into steam, the steam spins the turbine (motion), and that motion becomes electricity.
fact_tl: Sa planta, ang init (thermal energy) ay nagpapainit ng tubig na nagiging singaw. Ang singaw ay nagpapaikot sa turbine (galaw o motion), at ang galaw na iyon ay ginagawang kuryente. Init papuntang galaw papuntang kuryente.
fact_bis: Sa planta, ang init (thermal energy) maghimo sa tubig nga singaw. Ang singaw motuyok sa turbine (lihok), ug kanang lihok mahimong kuryente. Init ngadto sa lihok ngadto sa kuryente.

q: Of all the bands of the electromagnetic spectrum, which one can the human eye actually see?
options: Infrared light, which we feel as warmth on our skin
Ultraviolet light, which causes sunburn on our skin
Visible light, the only band the human eye can detect
Radio waves, which travel the farthest through space
explanation: Of the seven bands in the electromagnetic spectrum, only visible light can be seen by the human eye.
fact_tl: Sa pitong banda, ang visible light lang ang nakikita ng mata ng tao.
fact_bis: Sa pito ka banda, ang visible light ra ang makita sa mata sa tawo.

q: Who invented the first hot air balloon?
options: The Wright Brothers, who also built the first powered airplane
Leonardo da Vinci, who drew flying machines hundreds of years ago
The Montgolfier brothers
Isaac Newton, inspired by watching objects rise when heated
explanation: The Montgolfier brothers invented the first hot air balloon.
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Montgolfier ang gumawa ng unang hot air balloon.
fact_bis: Ang managsoong Montgolfier mao ang naghimo sa unang hot air balloon.

q: How do scientists tell individual whale sharks apart?
options: They measure the exact length and weight of each shark when they are tagged
