They look at the color of the gills, which is unique to each individual whale shark
They use pattern recognition software to identify each whale shark's unique white spot pattern, like fingerprints
They track the shape of the tail fin, which grows differently in each whale shark
explanation: Each whale shark has a unique pattern of white spots, and scientists use pattern recognition software to identify individuals from photographs, like using human fingerprints.
fact_tl: Ang bawat whale shark ay may natatanging disenyo ng mga puting spot sa itaas ng katawan — ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang pattern recognition software upang matukoy ang bawat indibidwal na butanding mula sa mga larawan, tulad ng paggamit ng fingerprint ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang matag whale shark adunay natatanging disenyo sa puting mga spot sa ibabaw sa iyang lawas — ang mga siyentipiko naggamit sa pattern recognition software sa pag-ila sa matag indibidwal nga butanding gikan sa mga litrato, sama sa paggamit sa fingerprint sa tawo.

q: How does sunscreen protect your skin outdoors?
options: It reflects all light away so the skin stays completely cool and in shadow
It produces vitamin D that strengthens the skin against radiation damage
It helps block ultraviolet light so the skin does not get burned
It seals the skin's surface so sweat keeps it moist and resistant to heat
explanation: Sunscreen helps block ultraviolet light so our skin does not get burned.
fact_tl: Ang sunscreen ay tumutulong na harangin ang ultraviolet para hindi masunog ang ating balat.
fact_bis: Ang sunscreen makatabang sa pagbabag sa ultraviolet aron dili masunog ang atong panit.

q: What other names is the Philippine Trench known by?
options: The Manila Deep and the Luzon Trench
The Visayas Trench and the Philippine Abyss
The Mindanao Trench and the Philippine Deep
The Sulu Trench and the Cebu Deep
explanation: The Philippine Trench is also called the Mindanao Trench or the Philippine Deep.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay tinatawag ding Mindanao Trench o Philippine Deep.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench gitawag usab nga Mindanao Trench o Philippine Deep.

q: What minimum wind speed must a storm reach before it is called a typhoon or hurricane?
options: At least 63 km/h, the threshold for a tropical storm
At least 89 km/h, the threshold for a severe tropical storm
At least 119 km/h, the minimum wind speed for a typhoon or hurricane
At least 150 km/h, the threshold for a super typhoon
explanation: A storm is called a typhoon or hurricane once its winds reach at least 119 km/h.
fact_tl: Ang isang bagyo ay tinatawag nang typhoon o hurricane kapag umabot ang hangin sa hindi bababa sa 119 km/h.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka bagyo gitawag nga typhoon o hurricane kung ang hangin moabot og dili moubos sa 119 km/h.

q: In a parallel circuit, what happens when one bulb burns out?
options: All the bulbs go out because the circuit is broken
The remaining bulbs become dimmer because they share the current from that one path
The other bulbs stay lit because each bulb has its own separate branch
Only the next bulb in line goes out; the rest keep working
explanation: In a parallel circuit each bulb has its own branch, so if one bulb goes out, the others stay lit because they do not depend on a single shared path.
fact_tl: Sa parallel circuit, may sariling sanga o daanan ang bawat bombilya. Kaya kung mamatay ang isa, tuloy pa rin ang ilaw sa iba dahil hindi sila nakasalalay sa iisang daanan.
fact_bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang matag bombilya adunay kaugalingong sanga o agianan. Mao nga kung mapalong ang usa, padayon gihapon ang suga sa uban kay wala sila magsalig sa usa ra ka agianan.

q: What does the Clean Air Act require of all vehicles in the Philippines?
options: Vehicles must switch to electric engines within five years of the law being passed
Vehicles must carry a certificate showing they were built in the last ten years
All vehicles must pass an emission test to ensure they are not releasing excessive smoke
Vehicles over ten years old must be replaced with newer, cleaner models immediately
explanation: Under the Clean Air Act, all vehicles in the Philippines must pass an emission test to ensure they are not releasing excessive smoke into the air.
fact_tl: Ayon sa Clean Air Act, kinakailangan ang lahat ng sasakyan sa Pilipinas na pumasa sa emission test upang masiguro na hindi sila naglalagay ng labis na usok sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sumala sa Clean Air Act, kinahanglan ang tanan nga sasakyan sa Pilipinas nga molapas sa emission test aron masiguro nga dili sila nagpagawas og labis nga aso sa hangin.

q: A blood clot forms inside a healthy blood vessel where there is no wound. Why is this dangerous?
options: It can block blood flow to the heart or brain.
It makes the blood move faster than normal.
It causes the vessel walls to grow thicker.
It turns the blood a darker color.
explanation: A clot inside an uninjured vessel can block blood flow to vital organs like the heart or brain, which is life-threatening.
fact_tl: Mabuti ang pamumuo ng dugo sa sugat, pero delikado kung mamuo ito sa loob ng ugat na walang sugat. Pwede nitong barahan ang daloy ng dugo papunta sa puso o utak, kaya mahalaga ang malusog na katawan.
fact_bis: Maayo ang pagmuo sa dugo sa samad, apan delikado kung mamuo kini sulod sa ugat nga walay samad. Mahimo niining babagan ang dagayday sa dugo padulong sa kasingkasing o utok, busa importante ang himsog nga lawas.

q: What city serves as the regional center of Region XIII (Caraga)?
options: Butuan City
Cagayan de Oro City
Surigao City
Davao City
explanation: Butuan City is the regional center of Region XIII, also known as the Caraga region.
fact_tl: Ang sentrong lungsod ng Region XIII (Caraga) ay ang Lungsod ng Butuan.
fact_bis: Ang sentro nga siyudad sa Region XIII (Caraga) mao ang Butuan City.

q: Which of the following is an example of a behavioral adaptation?
options: Birds migrating to another place in winter to find food.
A polar bear's thick white fur keeping it warm in the cold.
A cactus having thick stems to store water.
A turtle's hard shell protecting it from predators.
explanation: A behavioral adaptation is an action an animal takes — like migrating — to survive, as opposed to a physical body feature.
fact_tl: Ang pang-ugaling adaptasyon ay isang kilos tulad ng paglipat ng ibon sa ibang lugar tuwing taglamig upang makahanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang pang-batasan nga adaptasyon usa ka lihok sama sa paglalin sa langgam ngadto sa laing dapit panahon sa tugnaw aron makakaplag og pagkaon.

q: Who are the scientists credited with describing the structure of DNA as a double helix?
options: James Watson and Francis Crick
Charles Darwin and Gregor Mendel
Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch
Marie Curie and Albert Einstein
explanation: James Watson and Francis Crick described the structure of DNA as a double helix.
fact_tl: Sina James Watson at Francis Crick ang naglarawan sa estruktura ng DNA na hugis double helix.
fact_bis: Sila James Watson ug Francis Crick ang naghulagway sa estruktura sa DNA isip double helix.

q: Why is the top side of a ray usually sandy or gray in color?
options: To blend in with the sea floor and hide from predators or prey.
To reflect sunlight and keep the ray cool in warm water.
To warn other animals that it is poisonous.
To help it absorb more oxygen through its skin.
explanation: A ray's sandy or gray top side helps it camouflage against the sea floor, making it hard to spot from above.
fact_tl: Ang ibabaw ng pagi ay madalas kulay-buhangin o abuhin para magkahalintulad sa pusod ng dagat, habang ang ilalim nito ay maputi.
fact_bis: Ang ibabaw sa pagi kasagaran kolor-balas o abuhon aron mahaom sa salog sa dagat, samtang ang ilalom niini maputi.

q: What is the main purpose of reproduction in living things?
options: To make new living things similar to themselves.
To help organisms get more food and energy.
To allow organisms to grow larger over time.
To help organisms survive cold or dry seasons.
explanation: Reproduction is the way living things make new life similar to themselves, ensuring their kind continues.
fact_tl: Ang reproduksiyon ang paraan kung paano gumagawa ang mga buhay na bagay ng bagong buhay na katulad nila.
fact_bis: Ang reproduksiyon mao ang paagi kung giunsa paghimo sa mga buhing butang ug bag-ong kinabuhi nga sama nila.

q: Why can the continents slowly move over time?
options: Because the crust is lighter than the mantle and floats on top of it.
Because the crust is made of water that flows easily underground.
Because the Sun's gravity pulls the crust sideways each day.
Because earthquakes constantly push the continents apart.
explanation: The crust is lighter than the mantle, so it floats on top — this allows the continents to drift slowly over millions of years.
fact_tl: Ang crust ay mas magaan kaysa mantle, kaya parang nakalutang ito sa ibabaw ng mas mabigat na mantle. Kaya nakakagalaw ang mga continent nang napakabagal sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang crust mas gaan kaysa mantle, mao nga morag naglutaw kini sa ibabaw sa mas bug-at nga mantle. Mao nga ang mga kontinente makahimo og hinay kaayo nga paglihok sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: Pseudoscorpions hitch rides on larger insects to travel to new places. What is this behavior called?
options: Phoresy
Migration
Parasitism
Hibernation
explanation: When pseudoscorpions cling to larger insects for transport without harming them, this behavior is called phoresy.
fact_tl: Ang mga pseudoscorpion ay maliliit na arachnid na walang nakakulot na buntot; sila ay sumakay sa mas malalaking insekto para maglakbay—ang ugaling ito ay tinatawag na phoresy.
fact_bis: Ang mga pseudoscorpion gamay nga arachnid nga walay pinikod nga ikog; nagsakay sila sa mas dagkong insekto para molakaw ngadto sa bag-ong lugar—kining gawi gitawag og phoresy.

q: What major event in 1986 led to Cory Aquino becoming President of the Philippines?
options: The People Power (EDSA) Revolution
The declaration of Martial Law
The signing of the 1987 Constitution
The Bataan Death March
explanation: Cory Aquino became President because of the People Power (EDSA) Revolution in 1986, which peacefully ousted the Marcos government.
fact_tl: Naging Pangulo si Cory Aquino dahil sa People Power (EDSA) Rebolusyon noong 1986.
fact_bis: Nahimong Presidente si Cory Aquino tungod sa People Power (EDSA) Rebolusyon niadtong 1986.

q: How deep does the Emden Deep reach?
options: 10,540 meters
8,848 meters
6,200 meters
12,000 meters
explanation: The Emden Deep reaches a depth of 10,540 meters, making it one of the deepest points in the ocean.
fact_tl: Ang Emden Deep ay umaabot sa lalim na 10,540 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Emden Deep moabot sa kalawom nga 10,540 ka metro.

q: Why does a bathroom mirror get foggy during a hot shower?
options: Steam hits the cool mirror, cools down, and turns into tiny water droplets.
The hot air melts a thin layer of glass on the mirror's surface.
Soap particles from the shower float up and stick to the mirror.
The mirror heats up and releases water stored inside the glass.
explanation: Steam from the hot shower hits the cooler mirror surface, loses heat, and condenses into tiny water droplets that form the foggy layer.
fact_tl: Bakit naglalabo ang salamin sa banyo kapag naliligo ka ng mainit na tubig? Ang singaw mula sa mainit na tubig ay tumatama sa malamig na salamin, lumalamig, at nagiging napakaliliit na patak ng tubig. Iyon ang ulap sa salamin!
fact_bis: Ngano molabo ang salamin sa kasilyas kung maligo ka og init nga tubig? Ang singaw gikan sa init nga tubig moigo sa bugnaw nga salamin, mobugnaw, ug mahimong gagmay kaayo nga tulo sa tubig. Kana nga hanap kay mao kadto nga mga tulo!

q: How are moons different from stars?
options: Moons are cold, have no light of their own, and orbit planets.
Moons produce their own light but are smaller than stars.
Moons are made of burning gas just like the Sun.
Moons travel freely through space without orbiting anything.
explanation: Unlike stars, moons are cold, produce no light of their own, and only orbit planets.
fact_tl: Ang mga buwan ay hindi bituin — malamig ang mga ito, walang sariling liwanag, at umiikot lamang sa mga planeta.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulan dili bitoon — bugnaw kini, walay kaugalingong kahayag, ug molibot lang sa mga planeta.

q: Why do hospital workers wear lead aprons when using X-ray machines?
options: X-rays carry high energy that can damage living cells, so shielding is needed.
Lead aprons keep X-rays focused on the correct part of the patient's body.
The aprons stop X-rays from reflecting off walls and blinding staff.
Lead makes X-ray images clearer by blocking unwanted light.
explanation: X-rays can ionize atoms and damage living cells, so lead aprons shield hospital workers from unnecessary exposure.
fact_tl: Ang X-ray ay may mataas na enerhiya na kayang mag-ionize ng atoms at makasira ng mga buhay na cells, kaya kontrolado ang dami nito at gumagamit ng panangga gaya ng lead apron sa ospital.
fact_bis: Ang X-ray adunay taas nga kusog nga makahimo ug ionize sa atoms ug makaguba sa buhi nga mga selula, mao nga kontrolado ang gidaghanon niini ug gigamit ang panagang sama sa lead apron sa ospital.

q: Why do an owl's eyes face forward instead of to the sides?
options: So the owl can judge exactly how far away its prey is.
So the owl can see in two different directions at once.
So the owl can protect its eyes from wind while flying.
So the owl can detect colors better in low light.
explanation: Forward-facing eyes give an owl overlapping fields of view, which lets it accurately judge the distance to its prey.
fact_tl: Magkatabi at nakaharap sa unahan ang mga mata ng kuwago kaya nasusukat nito nang tama ang layo ng biktima.
fact_bis: Ang mga mata sa kuwago nag-atubang sa unahan mao nga masukod niini sa husto ang gilay-on sa iyang tukbonon.

q: What is the purpose of a bulb like garlic or onion for a plant?
options: It stores food underground for the plant.
It absorbs sunlight from below the soil surface.
It collects rainwater to keep the plant hydrated.
It anchors the plant so strong winds cannot pull it out.
explanation: A bulb is an underground plant part that stores food, allowing plants like garlic and onion to survive and grow.
fact_tl: Ang bombilya gaya ng bawang at sibuyas ay bahagi ng halaman na nasa ilalim ng lupa at nag-iimbak ng pagkain para sa halaman.
fact_bis: Ang bombilya sama sa ahos ug sibuyas usa ka bahin sa tanom nga naa sa ilalom sa yuta nga nagtipig og pagkaon para sa tanom.

q: Why do lotus and water lily plants prefer ponds over fast-moving rivers?
options: Strong currents are hard on their floating leaves, so they need calm water.
Fast rivers are too cold for tropical water plants to survive.
Rivers carry too much salt, which poisons floating-leaf plants.
Ponds have more sunlight than rivers because they are not shaded by trees.
explanation: The lotus and water lily prefer calm or slow-moving water because strong currents can damage their floating leaves.
fact_tl: Mas gusto ng lotus at water lily ang tahimik o bahagyang umaagos na tubig gaya ng lawa, dahil mahirap para sa floating na dahon ang malakas na agos.
fact_bis: Mas gusto sa lotus ug water lily ang kalma o hinay nga tubig sama sa lawa, kay lisod alang sa naglutaw nga dahon ang kusog nga sulog.

q: Which scientist first discovered the patterns of heredity in the 1860s?
options: Gregor Mendel
Charles Darwin
Louis Pasteur
James Watson
explanation: Gregor Mendel discovered the patterns of heredity in the 1860s by carefully studying how traits were passed on in pea plants.
fact_tl: Si Gregor Mendel, isang siyentipiko, ang unang nakatuklas ng mga padron ng pagmamana noong dekada 1860 sa pamamagitan ng pag-aaral ng mga halaman ng gisantes.
fact_bis: Si Gregor Mendel, usa ka siyentipiko, mao ang unang nakadiskobre sa mga padron sa panulundon niadtong dekada 1860 pinaagi sa pagtuon sa mga tanom nga gisantes.

q: What kind of rock is tuff, and why was it used to build old Philippine structures?
options: A rock made of compacted volcanic ash, used because it is lightweight and easy to cut.
A rock made of cooled lava, used because it is the hardest rock found in the Philippines.
A rock made of pressed seashells, used because it is found near the ocean.
A rock made of compressed soil, used because it absorbs heat well in hot weather.
explanation: Tuff forms from compacted volcanic ash and pyroclastic material; its light weight and softness made it ideal for constructing old Philippine buildings.
fact_tl: Ang tuff ay isang bato na nabubuo mula sa pinagsama-samang volcanic ash at pyroclastic material; maraming gusali sa Pilipinas ay itinayo gamit ang tuff dahil ito ay magaan at madaling putulin.
fact_bis: Ang tuff usa ka bato nga naporma gikan sa nagsamok nga volcanic ash ug pyroclastic material; daghang karaan nga mga bilding sa Pilipinas gitukod gamit ang tuff tungod kay gaan kini ug sayon putlon.

q: Which groups of animals can be infected by rabies?
options: Mammals such as dogs, cats, and bats.
Birds, reptiles, and amphibians.
Fish and sea creatures.
All animals including insects and worms.
explanation: Rabies affects mammals like dogs, cats, and bats, but does not infect birds, fish, or reptiles.
fact_tl: Ang rabies ay tumatama sa mga mamalya tulad ng aso, pusa, at paniki, ngunit hindi sa mga ibon, isda, o reptilya.
fact_bis: Ang rabies moapekto sa mga mamalya sama sa iro, iring, ug kabog, apan dili sa mga langgam, isda, o reptilya.

q: Why does everyone have a "blind spot" in their vision, yet they don't notice it?
options: There are no sensors at one spot on the eye, but the brain fills in the gap.
The pupil closes slightly to block distracting light from that area.
Both eyes blink at different times to cover any missing vision.
The lens becomes thicker in that area to bend light away from it.
explanation: A small area at the back of the eye has no light sensors, creating a blind spot, but the brain automatically fills it in so we never notice.
fact_tl: Maling akala na nakikita ng mata ang lahat nang sakto. May maliit na bahagi sa likod ng mata na walang sensor, kaya may "blind spot" tayo. Pinupunan ito ng utak para hindi natin mapansin ang butas.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga ang mata makakita sa tanan nga hingpit. Adunay gamay nga bahin sa luyo sa mata nga walay sensor, mao nga aduna tay "blind spot." Pun-an kini sa utok aron dili nato mamatikdan ang bangag.

q: Compared to a thin wire, what can a thicker wire do when carrying electricity?
options: Carry more electricity without getting as hot.
Carry electricity faster because electrons move quicker.
Store electricity inside the wire for later use.
Only carry electricity in one direction without reversing.
explanation: A thicker wire has more space for electrons to flow, so it can carry more current without overheating the way a thin wire would.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na kable ay kayang magdala ng mas maraming kuryente nang hindi gaanong umiinit kaysa sa manipis na kable.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga kable makahimo sa pagdala ug mas daghang elektrisidad nga dili kaayo moinit kompara sa nipis nga kable.

q: If you crumple a piece of paper into a ball, what happens to its mass?
options: Its mass stays the same because changing shape does not change the amount of matter.
Its mass decreases because some matter is squished out of the paper.
Its mass increases because the paper becomes denser when crushed.
Its mass changes slightly depending on how tightly it is crumpled.
explanation: Changing the shape of an object does not change the amount of matter it contains, so the crumpled paper has the same mass as the flat sheet.
fact_tl: Kapag dinurog o tiniklop mo ang isang papel, ang mass nito ay hindi nagbabago. Ang pagbabago ng hugis ay hindi nagbabago ng dami ng matter — ang lahat ng maliliit na piraso ay may kabuuang parehong mass tulad ng orihinal na papel.
fact_bis: Sa pagdurog o pagtiklop nimo sa usa ka papel, ang mass niini dili nagbabago. Ang pagbabago sa hugis dili nagbabago sa kantidad sa matter — tanan nga gagmayng piraso magkaupay adunay samang total nga mass sama sa orihinal nga papel.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the element potassium?
options: K
P
Po
Ka
explanation: Potassium's symbol is K, taken from its Latin name "kalium."
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng potassium (potasyum) ay K, mula sa salitang Latin na kalium.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa potassium mao ang K, gikan sa Latin nga pulong nga kalium.

q: How do scientists know that dinosaurs laid eggs?
options: Fossil dinosaur eggs and nests have been found.
Dinosaur bones show marks from sitting on nests.
Ancient cave paintings show dinosaurs hatching eggs.
DNA from living reptiles proves all their ancestors laid eggs.
explanation: Scientists have discovered fossil dinosaur eggs and nests, which is direct evidence that dinosaurs laid eggs like birds and reptiles do today.
fact_tl: Ang mga dinosaur ay nangingitlog tulad ng mga ibon at reptilya, at may natagpuan nang mga fossil ng itlog at pugad ng dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang mga dinosaur nangitlog sama sa mga langgam ug reptilya, ug ang mga siyentista nakakaplag og fossil nga mga itlog ug salag sa dinosaur.

q: About what percentage of all animal species on Earth are invertebrates (animals without a backbone)?
options: About 95 to 97 percent.
About 50 percent.
About 25 percent.
About 75 percent.
explanation: Invertebrates make up about 95 to 97 percent of all animal species, making them by far the most common type of animal on Earth.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ng mga hayop sa mundo ay invertebrate (walang gulugod) — humigit-kumulang 95 hanggang 97 porsyento ng lahat ng uri ng hayop.
fact_bis: Halos tanang mananap sa kalibotan invertebrate (walay bukog sa likod) — mga 95 hangtod 97 porsyento sa tanang matang sa mananap.

q: Can the youngest rock layer always be found on top in a stack of rock layers?
options: No, tectonic forces like folding and faulting can flip or rearrange rock layers.
Yes, because sediments always settle on top of older layers and never move.
Yes, because gravity prevents heavier older rocks from rising above younger ones.
No, but only in underwater rocks — land rocks always stay in the original order.
explanation: Tectonic forces such as folding, faulting, and uplift can invert or rearrange rock layers, so the youngest layer is not always on top.
fact_tl: Ang mga layer ng bato ay maaaring maibaligtad o magambala ng puwersang tektoniko (folding, faulting, uplift), kaya hindi laging nasa itaas ang pinakabatang layer.
fact_bis: Ang mga layer sa bato mahimong mabaliktad o matandog sa puwersang tektoniko (folding, faulting, uplift), busa dili kanunay naa sa ibabaw ang labing bag-o nga layer.

q: How does an amoeba reproduce?
options: By cell division, splitting itself into two new cells.
By laying eggs that hatch into smaller amoebas.
By releasing spores that drift through the water.
By joining with another amoeba to form a new organism.
explanation: The amoeba is a single-celled organism that reproduces by cell division, splitting into two new cells.
fact_tl: Ang ilang nilalang na may isang selula lamang, gaya ng ameba, ay dumarami sa pamamagitan ng paghahati ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang ubang buhing binuhat nga adunay usa ra ka selula, sama sa ameba, modaghan pinaagi sa pagbahin sa selula.

q: What are common signs that a person may have tuberculosis (TB)?
options: A long-lasting cough, fever, and weight loss.
Sudden high fever, rash, and swollen joints.
Runny nose, sneezing, and itchy eyes.
Stomach pain, vomiting, and yellowing of the skin.
explanation: Common signs of TB are a long-lasting cough, fever, and weight loss, which develop as the bacteria affect the lungs.
fact_tl: Ang mga karaniwang sintomas ng TB ay matagal na ubo, lagnat, at pagpayat.
fact_bis: Ang kasagarang ilhanan sa TB mao ang taas nga ubo, hilanat, ug pagniwang.

q: How many SI base units are there in the International System of Units?
options: Seven
Five
Ten
Three
explanation: There are exactly seven SI base units: meter, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela.
fact_tl: May pito (7) ang SI base units: metro, kilogramo, segundo, ampere, kelvin, mole, at candela.
fact_bis: Adunay pito (7) ka SI base units: metro, kilogramo, segundo, ampere, kelvin, mole, ug candela.

q: How many days are there in one week?
explanation: One week has 7 days, which is the standard unit of time used around the world.
fact_tl: May 7 araw sa isang linggo.
fact_bis: Adunay 7 ka adlaw sa usa ka semana.

q: When are rats usually active, and why do they hide during the day?
options: Rats are active at night and hide during the day to stay safe.
Rats are active during the day and sleep at night like most animals.
Rats are active only in the early morning and rest the remainder of the day.
Rats are active at night only when looking for a mate, otherwise staying hidden.
explanation: Rats are nocturnal — they come out at night and hide during the day to avoid predators and stay safe.
fact_tl: Karaniwang aktibo ang daga sa gabi at nagtatago sa araw upang hindi mahuli.
fact_bis: Kasagaran aktibo ang ilaga sa gabii ug magtago sa adlaw aron dili madakpan.

q: What does the sampaguita flower look like?
options: It is small and white.
It is large and yellow.
It is medium-sized and purple.
It is small and pink.
explanation: The sampaguita is known for its small, white flowers and sweet fragrance, and it is the national flower of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang bulaklak ng sampaguita ay maliit at maputi.
fact_bis: Ang bulak sa sampaguita gamay ug puti.

q: If you push sideways on a box that is moving forward, how much work does your sideways push do on the box?
options: No work, because the force is at right angles to the direction of motion.
A little work, because any push adds some energy to a moving object.
The same amount of work as a forward push of the same strength.
It depends on how hard you push — a stronger sideways push does more work.
explanation: Work is only done when force is applied in the same direction as motion; a force perpendicular to the motion does no work on the object.
fact_tl: Kung ang puwersa ay patayo sa direksyon ng paggalaw, walang trabahong nagagawa sa bagay.
fact_bis: Kon ang puwersa patadlong sa direksyon sa paglihok, wala kini'y trabaho nga mahimo sa butang.

q: What do female sea turtles do when they come to the beach at night?
options: They dig nest holes in the sand and lay around 100 eggs before returning to the sea.
They hunt for small fish and crabs that come close to shore at night.
They rest on the warm sand to raise their body temperature before diving again.
They call to their young in the water to teach them how to find the beach.
explanation: Female sea turtles crawl up beaches at night, dig holes with their flippers, lay around 100 eggs, cover the nest, and return to the sea.
fact_tl: Ang mga babaeng pawikan ay umaangat sa beach sa gabi upang humukay ng pugad sa buhangin gamit ang kanilang mga flipper; nagtatago sila ng mga 100 itlog bawat pugad bago balunan ang mga ito at bumalik sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga babaye nga pawikan nagakyat sa baybayon sa gabii aron mohukay og mga buho sa pugad sa balas gamit ang ilang mga flipper; nagbutang sila og mga 100 itlog matag pugad sa wala pa kini takloban ug mobalik sa dagat.

q: What makes porcupine quills so hard to remove once they stick into skin?
options: Tiny backward barbs on the tips that grip the skin from inside.
A sticky glue-like coating that hardens when it touches skin.
Hollow tips that expand like an umbrella once they pierce the skin.
Sharp double points that hook around muscle fibers below the skin.
explanation: Porcupine quill tips have tiny backward-facing barbs, which dig in deeper and resist being pulled out once they penetrate the skin.
fact_tl: May maliliit na kawit ang dulo ng tinik ng porcupine kaya mahirap itong tanggalin kapag tumirik na sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa tunok sa porcupine adunay gagmay nga sima maong lisod kini tangtangon kon nakatusok na sa panit.

q: How does the pangolin find ants and termites to eat if it has poor eyesight?
options: It uses its sharp sense of smell to locate them.
It listens for the sounds that ants make inside tunnels.
It taps the ground with its claws and feels vibrations from moving insects.
It follows other animals that dig up ant hills for it.
explanation: The pangolin has weak eyesight but compensates with a sharp sense of smell that guides it to ant and termite colonies.
fact_tl: Mahina ang paningin ng balintong, kaya gumagamit ito ng matalas nitong pang-amoy para hanapin ang mga langgam at anay.
fact_bis: Ang balintong huyang og panan-aw, busa mogamit kini sa hait niini nga panimaho aron mangita og mga hulmigas ug anay.

q: How are fungi and bacteria similar in the way they get nutrients?
options: Both digest food outside their bodies before absorbing it.
Both use sunlight to make their own food through photosynthesis.
Both swallow food whole and digest it inside a stomach.
Both catch and paralyze prey before slowly dissolving it.
explanation: Both fungi and bacteria release enzymes to digest food outside their bodies and then absorb the nutrients — though they differ in size and structure.
fact_tl: Gaya ng fungi, ang mga bacteria ay tumutunaw din ng pagkain sa labas ng kanilang katawan. Pero mas malalaki at may sinulid na hyphae ang fungi, habang ang bacteria ay napakaliliit at iisang selula lang.
fact_bis: Sama sa fungi, ang bacteria motunaw usab og pagkaon sa gawas sa ilang lawas. Apan mas dako ang fungi ug adunay sinulid nga hyphae, samtang ang bacteria gagmay kaayo ug usa ra ka selula.

q: Why does a blender turn fruit into a smooth shake so quickly?
options: Its blade spins very fast, hitting the food thousands of times in just a few seconds.
It uses high heat to melt the fruit before mixing it with liquid.
It uses suction to compress the fruit into a liquid form.
Its heavy steel bowl shakes so hard that the fruit breaks apart on its own.
explanation: A blender's blade spins fast enough to hit food thousands of times per second, which quickly breaks it down into a smooth drink.
fact_tl: Ang blender ay may talim na umiikot nang napakabilis para durugin ang prutas o yelo. Dahil sa sobrang bilis ng pag-ikot, paulit-ulit na tinatama ng talim ang pagkain nang libu-libong beses sa loob lang ng ilang segundo, kaya ito nagiging makinis na shake.
fact_bis: Ang blender adunay sulab nga motuyok og paspas kaayo aron dugmokon ang prutas o yelo. Tungod sa kapaspas sa pagtuyok, ang sulab moigo sa pagkaon og liboan ka beses sulod lang sa pipila ka segundo, busa mahimo kining hamis nga shake.

q: What happens to the image formed on the back of your eye by the eye lens?
options: The image is upside down on the retina, but the brain flips it so we see things the right way up.
The image is the right way up on the retina, and the brain displays it exactly as received.
The image is upside down and we actually see everything inverted without realizing it.
The image is sideways on the retina, and the brain rotates it 90 degrees.
explanation: The eye lens forms an inverted image on the retina, but the brain processes this signal and flips it so we perceive the world the right way up.
fact_tl: Ang lens ng mata ay gumagawa ng baligtad na imahe sa retina ngunit ang utak ay nagbabalik-balik nito upang mukhang tuwid — hindi natin ito napapansin.
fact_bis: Ang lente sa mata nagahimo og nabaliktad nga hulagway sa retina apan ang utok nagbalik-balik niini aron makita nato kini nga tuwid — dili nato mapansin kining proseso.

q: How tall can a durian tree grow?
options: More than twenty meters.
About five meters.
Around ten meters.
Up to fifteen meters.
explanation: Durian grows on a tall tree that can reach more than twenty meters in height.
fact_tl: Ang durian ay tumutubo sa isang mataas na puno na maaaring umabot nang mahigit beinte metro.
fact_bis: Ang durian motubo sa taas nga kahoy nga makaabot ug labaw sa baynte metros ang gitas-on.

q: Which of Earth's two motions is responsible for creating day and night?
options: Earth spinning on its axis.
Earth orbiting around the Sun.
Earth tilting toward and away from the Moon.
Earth slowing down and speeding up in its orbit.
explanation: Earth spinning on its axis causes day and night, while its orbit around the Sun creates the year and the seasons.
fact_tl: Dalawang magkaibang galaw: ang pag-ikot ng Mundo sa sariling ehe ang gumagawa ng araw at gabi, samantalang ang pag-inog nito paikot sa Araw ang gumagawa ng taon at panahon.
fact_bis: Duha ka lahi nga lihok: ang pagtuyok sa Kalibotan sa kaugalingong aksis maoy nagbuhat sa adlaw ug gabii, samtang ang paglibot niini sa Adlaw maoy nagbuhat sa tuig ug sa panahon.

q: What two ingredients are combined to make soap through a process called saponification?
options: Fat or oil and a strong base like lye.
Acid and water mixed at high temperature.
Sugar and salt dissolved in heated water.
Alcohol and a weak acid like vinegar.
explanation: Soap is made by reacting fat or oil with a strong base like lye — a chemical process called saponification.
fact_tl: Ginagawa ang sabon sa pamamagitan ng pagpapareact ng taba o langis sa isang malakas na base tulad ng lye, isang prosesong tinatawag na saponification.
fact_bis: Ang sabon gihimo pinaagi sa pagpareact sa tambok o lana ngadto sa kusganon nga base sama sa lihiya, usa ka proseso nga gitawag og saponification.

q: Where do most of the remaining tamaraw live, and how are they protected?
options: In Mounts Iglit-Baco Natural Park in Mindoro, where rangers guard them from hunters.
In Batanes Province, where the remote islands keep hunters away naturally.
In Palawan's forests, where they are protected by strict national laws.
In Davao Region, where zoos are helping to breed them safely.
explanation: Most remaining tamaraw live in Mounts Iglit-Baco Natural Park in Mindoro, where rangers protect them from illegal hunting.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga natitirang tamaraw ay nakatira sa Mounts Iglit-Baco Natural Park sa Mindoro. Doon sila binabantayan ng mga ranger para hindi mahuli ng mangangaso.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa nahibiling tamaraw nagpuyo sa Mounts Iglit-Baco Natural Park sa Mindoro. Didto gibantayan sila sa mga ranger aron dili madakpan sa mangangayam.

q: How does a civet help new trees grow in the forest?
options: Seeds from fruit it ate pass through and come out in new places when it poops, where they can grow.
It digs holes in the ground that collect rainwater, helping seeds sprout nearby.
It carries fruit in its mouth and buries it to save for later, sometimes forgetting where it hid them.
It clears away dead leaves with its claws, giving seeds on the ground more sunlight.
explanation: When a civet eats fruit and defecates, the undigested seeds are deposited in new locations where new plants can sprout and grow.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang musang sa kalikasan dahil kapag dumumi ito, lumalabas ang buto ng prutas na kinain nito sa ibang lugar. Doon ay puwedeng tumubo ang bagong halaman, kaya nakakatulong itong magkaroon ng bagong puno.
fact_bis: Motabang ang musang sa kinaiyahan kay kung motae kini, mogawas ang liso sa prutas nga gikaon niini sa laing dapit. Didto, mahimong motubo ang bag-ong tanom, mao nga motabang kini nga aduna'y bag-ong kahoy sa lasang.

q: What does it mean to practice self-medication?
options: Taking medicine on your own without asking a doctor.
Following a doctor's prescription to treat yourself at home.
Using exercise and diet instead of medicine to stay healthy.
Asking a pharmacist to recommend a medicine for your symptoms.
explanation: Self-medication means taking medicine on your own without consulting a doctor, which can be risky because the wrong medicine or dose may cause harm.
fact_tl: Ang self-medication ay ang pag-inom ng gamot nang hindi muna nagtatanong sa doktor.
fact_bis: Ang self-medication mao ang pag-inom og tambal nga wala mangutana sa doktor.

q: What is the difference between sensory neurons and motor neurons?
options: Sensory neurons carry messages to the brain, while motor neurons give orders to the muscles.
Sensory neurons control movement, while motor neurons detect pain and temperature.
Sensory neurons are found only in the eyes, while motor neurons are found only in the legs.
Sensory neurons carry signals away from the brain, while motor neurons bring signals toward it.
explanation: Sensory neurons send information from the body to the brain, while motor neurons send commands from the brain to the muscles to produce movement.
fact_tl: Ang sensory neuron ay nagdadala ng mensahe papunta sa utak, habang ang motor neuron ay nag-uutos sa mga kalamnan.
fact_bis: Ang sensory neuron nagdala ug mensahe ngadto sa utok, samtang ang motor neuron nagmando sa mga kaunuran.

q: A clownfish normally lives safely among a sea anemone's stinging tentacles. When can the anemone still sting and hurt the clownfish?
options: If the clownfish loses its protective mucus coating, the anemone can sting it.
If the clownfish swims too deep, the anemone's tentacles become more powerful.
If the clownfish eats too much food, the anemone attacks to defend its territory.
If the clownfish is very young and small, it is always stung until it grows bigger.
explanation: A clownfish is protected by a thick mucus coat; if that coating is washed off or lost, the anemone's stinging cells can harm the clownfish.
fact_tl: May nag-iisip na hindi na kailanman natutusok ang clownfish ng anemone. Pero kung mahugasan o mawala ang mucus nito, pwede pa rin itong matusok at masaktan. Kaya kailangan niyang panatilihin ang kanyang makapal na mucus para manatiling ligtas.
fact_bis: Naay mga bata nga naghunahuna nga dili na gyud matusok ang clownfish sa anemone. Apan kung mahugasan o mawala ang iyang mucus, mahimo pa gihapon kini matusok ug masakitan. Mao nga kinahanglan niyang ampingan ang iyang baga nga mucus aron magpabiling luwas.

q: How do young Palawan peacock-pheasant (tandikan) chicks learn to find food?
options: They follow their parents on the forest floor and learn to find food on their own.
Their parents bring food directly to them inside the nest until they can fly.
They hatch already knowing where food is because of instinct alone.
Older chicks from previous broods teach the younger ones where to search.
explanation: Tandikan chicks follow their parents on the forest floor, gradually learning to find food by themselves through this close contact.
fact_tl: Ang mga sisiw ng tandikan ay sumusunod sa kanilang magulang sa lupa ng gubat, kung saan natututo silang humanap ng sariling pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga piso sa tandikan mosunod sa ilang ginikanan sa yuta sa lasang, diin makakat-on sila mangita og kaugalingong pagkaon.

q: What is corrosion?
options: The slow damage of metal from reacting with its surroundings
The rapid melting of metal when heated to high temperatures
The process of bending metal into a new shape
The coating applied to metal to make it shiny
explanation: Corrosion is the slow damage of metal caused by reactions with its surroundings, and rust is one well-known type of corrosion.
fact_tl: Ang korosyon ay ang unti-unting pagkasira ng metal dahil sa reaksiyon nito sa paligid; ang kalawang ay isang uri ng korosyon.
fact_bis: Ang korosyon mao ang hinay-hinay nga pagkadaot sa metal gikan sa reaksiyon niini sa palibot; ang taya usa ka matang sa korosyon.

q: What can happen to your arms and legs if your body is very low on vitamin D?
options: They can feel weak or tire easily
They can become swollen and painful
They can develop rashes and blisters
They can stop growing in length
explanation: Besides helping bones, vitamin D is also needed for muscles to work well — a severe deficiency can make the arms and legs feel weak or tire easily.
fact_tl: Bukod sa buto, kailangan din ng kalamnan (muscles) ang vitamin D para gumana nang maayos. Kapag masyadong kulang, maaaring maramdaman ng tao na mahina o madaling mapagod ang kanyang mga binti at braso.
fact_bis: Gawas sa bukog, ang imong mga kaunoran (muscles) nanginahanglan usab og vitamin D aron molihok og maayo. Kung kulang kaayo, mahimong bation sa tawo nga luya o dali makapuyo ang iyang mga bitiis ug bukton.

q: What is the largest lake in the world?
options: The Caspian Sea
Lake Superior
Lake Baikal
The Aral Sea
explanation: The Caspian Sea is the largest lake in the world, even though its name makes it sound like an ocean.
fact_tl: Ang Caspian Sea ang pinakamalaking lawa sa mundo, kahit ang tawag dito ay dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Caspian Sea mao ang pinakadako nga lanaw sa kalibutan, bisan pa nga gitawag kining dagat.

q: How many neck bones does a giraffe have?
options: Seven, the same as a human
Fourteen, because its neck is twice as long
Twenty-one, one for each segment of its neck
Three, but each bone is very large
explanation: Despite its extremely long neck, a giraffe has only seven neck bones — the same number as a human.
fact_tl: Kahit napakahaba ng leeg ng dyirap, may pitong buto lang ito sa leeg gaya ng tao.
fact_bis: Bisan taas kaayo ang liog sa giraffe, pito ra ka bukog ang naa sa liog niini sama sa tawo.

q: About how long did the Wright brothers' very first airplane flight last?
options: About 12 seconds
About 12 minutes
About 2 minutes
About 30 seconds
explanation: The Wright brothers' historic first powered flight lasted only about 12 seconds.
fact_tl: Ang unang paglipad ng Wright brothers ay tumagal lamang ng mga 12 segundo.
fact_bis: Ang unang paglupad sa Wright brothers milungtad lamang og mga 12 segundo.

q: What usually happens if you cut a worm in half?
options: The whole worm often dies, or only the head end might survive
Both halves grow into two complete worms
The tail end grows a new head and survives
Both halves die immediately no matter what
explanation: It is a myth that cutting a worm makes two worms — usually the whole worm dies, and at best only the head end might survive a small cut.
fact_tl: Hindi totoo na kapag pinutol mo ang bulate ay magiging dalawang buhay na bulate ito. Kadalasan, ang bahaging may ulo lang ang maaaring mabuhay kung maliit ang sugat, at madalas mamatay ang buong bulate. Kaya hindi tama na sinasadyang putulin ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Dili tinuod nga kung putlon nimo ang ulod mahimo kining duha ka buhi nga ulod. Kasagaran, ang bahin nga adunay ulo lang ang mabuhi kung gamay ang samad, ug sagad mamatay ang tibuok ulod. Mao nga dili husto nga tuyoon pagputol kini.

q: Why is the very first stroke of a paddle the hardest when starting a banca at rest?
options: Because the banca resists starting to move due to inertia
Because the water is always moving against the banca at first
Because the paddle blade is at the wrong angle during the first stroke
Because the banca is heaviest at the front when stationary
explanation: A banca at rest resists starting to move because of inertia — the tendency of objects to stay still unless a force acts on them.
fact_tl: Ang unang sagwan ang pinakamabigat dahil ang nakatigil na banca ay ayaw gumalaw — ito ang inertia. Kapag gumagalaw na ito, mas magaan ang susunod na mga sagwan dahil tinutulungan ka na ng momentum ng bangka.
fact_bis: Ang unang bugsay maoy pinakabug-at kay ang nagpahulay nga banca dili gusto molihok — kini ang inertia. Kung naglihok na kini, mas gaan ang sunod nga mga bugsay kay ang momentum sa sakayan motabang na nimo.

q: Compared to the air above it, how much carbon does the soil hold?
options: More carbon than the air
The same amount as the air
Less carbon than the air
No carbon at all
explanation: Soil stores carbon from rotting plants and animals, and there is actually more carbon stored in the soil than in the air.
fact_tl: Ang lupa ay nag-iimbak ng maraming carbon mula sa mga nabubulok na halaman at hayop. Mas marami pa ang carbon sa lupa kaysa sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang yuta magtipig og daghang carbon gikan sa nabulok nga mga tanom ug hayop. Mas daghan pa gani ang carbon sa yuta kaysa sa hangin.

q: When you place paper over a leaf and rub it with a crayon, what appears on the paper?
options: The pattern of the leaf's veins and shape
The color of the leaf's inside cells
A copy of the leaf's smell
The exact number of cells in the leaf
explanation: Rubbing a crayon over paper placed on a leaf reveals the pattern of its veins and shape, helping us observe the leaf's texture.
fact_tl: Kapag inilagay mo ang papel sa ibabaw ng dahon at kinuskos ng krayola, lumalabas ang patron ng mga ugat at hugis nito, na tumutulong sa atin na obserbahan ang tekstura ng bawat dahon.
fact_bis: Kon ibutang nimo ang papel ibabaw sa dahon ug kuskoson og krayola, mogawas ang sumbanan sa mga ugat ug porma niini, nga motabang kanato sa pag-obserbar sa tekstura sa matag dahon.

q: Who is called the Father of the Computer?
options: Charles Babbage
Alan Turing
Thomas Edison
Nikola Tesla
explanation: Charles Babbage earned the title Father of the Computer for designing the Analytical Engine, an early mechanical computing device.
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang tinaguriang Ama ng Kompyuter dahil sa kanyang Analytical Engine.
fact_bis: Si Charles Babbage ang gitawag nga Amahan sa Computer tungod sa iyang Analytical Engine.

q: Why is the hummingbird given its name?
options: Its fast-moving wings make a humming or buzzing sound
It hums a musical tune to attract a mate
Its feathers vibrate and make a humming noise in the wind
It makes a humming call with its beak while feeding
explanation: The hummingbird gets its name because its wings beat so fast that they produce a humming or buzzing sound.
fact_tl: Tinawag itong hummingbird dahil ang mabilis na pakpak nito ay gumagawa ng tunog na parang humihuni o umuugong.
fact_bis: Gitawag kini nga hummingbird kay ang paspas niyang pako naghimo og tunog nga murag naghuni o nag-ugong.

q: When the body runs out of stored sugar (glycogen), what does the hormone glucagon help the liver do?
options: Make brand new sugar from other materials such as those from protein
Store the remaining sugar more tightly so none is wasted
Send a signal to the stomach to digest food faster
Release stored fat directly into the blood as sugar
explanation: When glycogen stores are depleted, glucagon signals the liver to make brand new sugar from other materials, including those from protein.
fact_tl: Kapag naubos na ang nakaimbak na glycogen, tumutulong ang glucagon na gumawa ng bagong asukal ang atay mula sa ibang sangkap gaya ng galing sa protina.
fact_bis: Kung mahurot na ang gitipig nga glycogen, motabang ang glucagon nga maghimo ang atay og bag-ong asukal gikan sa ubang materyal, sama niadtong gikan sa protina.

q: How many times must the trigger hairs inside a Venus flytrap be touched before its trap snaps shut?
options: Twice within a few seconds
Once, very hard
Three times in a row
Five times quickly
explanation: The Venus flytrap requires two touches within a few seconds so it does not waste energy snapping shut on a raindrop.
fact_tl: May maliliit na buhok-sensitibo (trigger hairs) sa loob ng Venus flytrap, at kailangang mahawakan ang mga ito ng dalawang beses sa loob ng ilang segundo bago magsara — kaya hindi ito nasasayang sa basta patak ng ulan.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga mga buhok nga sensitibo (trigger hairs) sa sulod sa Venus flytrap, ug kinahanglan kining mahikap og duha ka higayon sulod sa pipila ka segundo una kini mosira — busa dili kini masayang sa usa lang ka tulo sa ulan.

q: Why do antibiotics work against bacteria but not against viruses?
options: Bacteria are whole living cells that can be killed directly, while viruses must enter another cell to multiply and are not cells themselves
Viruses are larger than bacteria and harder to destroy with medicine
Antibiotics destroy the outer shell of viruses, but viruses have no shell
Bacteria and viruses are the same size, but antibiotics only target round-shaped germs
explanation: Antibiotics can kill bacteria because they are living cells, but viruses are not cells and must hijack another cell to multiply, so antibiotics have no effect on them.
fact_tl: Ang bacteria ay mas malaki kaysa virus at isang buong buhay na cell na kayang dumami nang mag-isa. Ang virus ay mas maliit, hindi isang cell, at kailangan nitong pumasok sa cell ng iba para makadami — kaya gamot na antibiotic ang ginagamit sa bacteria, hindi sa virus.
fact_bis: Ang bacteria mas dako kaysa virus ug usa ka tibuok buhi nga cell nga makahimo og pagdaghan nga mag-inusara. Ang virus mas gamay, dili usa ka cell, ug kinahanglan kini mosulod sa cell sa lain aron modaghan — mao nga ang tambal nga antibiotic mogana sa bacteria, dili sa virus.

q: Why does honey flow more slowly than water?
options: Because honey is thicker than water
Because honey is colder than water
Because honey contains tiny solid sugar crystals that block flow
Because honey is less dense than water and floats instead of flowing
explanation: Honey flows more slowly than water because it is thicker, meaning it has higher viscosity.
fact_tl: Ang pulot ay mas malapot kaysa tubig, kaya mas mabagal itong dumaloy.
fact_bis: Ang dugos mas baga kay sa tubig, mao nga mas hinay kini modagayday.

q: At approximately what temperature does iron melt?
options: About 1,538 degrees Celsius
About 100 degrees Celsius
About 660 degrees Celsius
About 3,000 degrees Celsius
explanation: Iron melts at approximately 1,538 degrees Celsius, which is why extremely high heat is needed to work with it.
fact_tl: Ang bakal ay natutunaw sa mga 1,538 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Ang puthaw matunaw sa mga 1,538 degrees Celsius.

q: How many babies does a kagwang usually have at one time, and what are they like at birth?
options: One baby that is small and underdeveloped
Two babies that are already fully formed
Three to five babies that can cling to branches immediately
One baby that is fully developed and independent right away
explanation: The kagwang usually gives birth to just one baby, which is small and underdeveloped and needs a long period of care from its mother.
fact_tl: Karaniwang isang anak lamang ang ipinanganganak ng kagwang, at mahina at maliit pa ito kaya kailangan ng matagal na pag-aalaga ng ina.
fact_bis: Kasagaran usa ra ka anak ang ipanganak sa kagwang, ug gamay ug luya pa kini mao nga kinahanglan og taas nga pag-atiman sa inahan.

q: How does high-viscosity (very thick) lava move compared to thin lava?
options: It flows more slowly
It flows more quickly
It shoots higher into the air
It cools instantly and stops moving
explanation: Thick, high-viscosity lava flows slowly, which is why PHIVOLCS studies lava viscosity in Philippine volcanoes like Mayon.
fact_tl: Ang malapot na lava ay mabagal dumaloy, kaya pinag-aaralan ng PHIVOLCS ang viscosity ng lava sa mga bulkan tulad ng Mayon.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga lava hinay modagayday, mao nga gitun-an sa PHIVOLCS ang viscosity sa lava sa mga bulkan sama sa Mayon.

q: Why do elements in the same group of the periodic table behave alike?
options: They have the same number of electrons in their outer shell
They have the same total number of protons
They have the same atomic mass
They were all discovered in the same year
explanation: Elements in the same group share the same number of outer-shell electrons, which determines how they react with other substances.
fact_tl: Ang mga elemento sa iisang pangkat ay kumikilos nang magkatulad dahil pareho ang bilang ng electron sa labas nilang shell.
fact_bis: Ang mga elemento sa samang grupo managsama og pamatasan tungod kay parehas ang gidaghanon sa electron sa ilang gawas nga shell.

q: Who gave the first public demonstration of using ether as anesthesia for surgery?
options: William Morton, an American dentist
Louis Pasteur, a French chemist
Joseph Lister, a British surgeon
Ignaz Semmelweis, a Hungarian doctor
explanation: The American dentist William Morton was the first to publicly demonstrate that ether could be used to put a patient to sleep for surgery.
fact_tl: Ang Amerikanong dentista na si William Morton ang unang nagpakita sa publiko ng paggamit ng ether bilang anesthesia para sa operasyon.
fact_bis: Ang Amerikanong dentista nga si William Morton ang unang nagpakita sa publiko sa paggamit sa ether isip anesthesia para sa operasyon.

q: A child has a cold caused by a virus. Why would taking antibiotics NOT help?
options: Antibiotics kill bacteria, not viruses
Antibiotics only work inside the stomach, not the nose or throat
Antibiotics make viruses stronger if taken too early
Antibiotics must be injected to work against any germ
explanation: Antibiotics are designed to kill bacteria, and they have no effect on viruses like the one that causes the common cold.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotics ay gamot na pumapatay sa bacteria, pero hindi ito gumagana sa virus tulad ng sanhi ng karaniwang sipon. Kaya hindi dapat uminom ng antibiotics nang walang reseta ng doktor.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotics kay tambal nga mopatay sa bacteria, apan dili kini molihok batok sa virus sama sa hinungdan sa ordinaryong sip-on. Mao nga dili angay moinom og antibiotics nga walay reseta sa doktor.

q: How do trees help form clouds and rain?
options: They release large amounts of water through transpiration
They absorb sunlight that heats the ocean and causes evaporation
They produce oxygen that helps water rise into the sky
They store rainwater in their roots and then spray it upward
explanation: Trees release large amounts of water through transpiration, which helps form clouds and rain, making forests an important part of the water cycle.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno ay nagpapalabas ng malaking dami ng tubig sa pamamagitan ng transpiration — ang prosesong ito ay nakakatulong sa pagbuo ng mga ulap at ulan at ginagawa ng mga kagubatan ang mahalagang bahagi ng water cycle.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy nagpagawas sa dako nga dami sa tubig pinaagi sa transpiration — kining proseso nagtabang sa pagporma sa mga panganod ug ulan, nagpahimo sa mga kagubatan isip mahinungdanon nga bahin sa water cycle.

q: What do we call the large system that links power plants, transmission lines, and homes together?
options: The power grid
The circuit board
The main switch
The energy network
explanation: All power plants, transmission lines, and homes are connected in one big system called the power grid.
fact_tl: Ang lahat ng power plant, transmission line, at bahay ay magkakaugnay sa isang malaking sistema na tinatawag na power grid.
fact_bis: Ang tanang power plant, transmission line, ug mga balay konektado sa usa ka dakong sistema nga gitawag og power grid.

q: Even though diamond is the hardest mineral, what can still happen to it?
options: A hard blow can shatter it
It can dissolve in salt water over time
It can melt at normal room temperature
It can be scratched by other common rocks
explanation: Diamond is the hardest mineral and cannot be scratched, but hardness does not mean unbreakable — a hard blow can still shatter a diamond.
fact_tl: Kahit pinakamatigas ang diyamante at walang ibang mineral na makagasgas dito, hindi ibig sabihin na hindi ito mababasag — kaya pa rin itong durugin ng malakas na hampas.
fact_bis: Bisan pa nga ang diamante mao ang pinakagahi nga mineral ug walay laing mineral nga makagasgas niini, dili kini magpasabot nga dili kini mabuak — ang kusog nga hampak makabungkag gihapon niini.

q: In what year did Galileo discover Jupiter's moons?
explanation: Galileo Galilei discovered Jupiter's four largest moons in the year 1610, an important milestone in astronomy.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang mga buwan ng Jupiter noong taong 1610.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ni Galileo ang mga bulan sa Jupiter niadtong tuig 1610.

q: Who first discovered that uranium gave off mysterious radiation on its own?
options: Henri Becquerel
Marie Curie
Pierre Curie
Albert Einstein
explanation: In 1896, Henri Becquerel noticed that uranium produced radiation on its own even in the dark, which led to the discovery of radioactivity.
fact_tl: Sino ang nakatuklas ng radioactivity? Noong 1896, napansin ni Henri Becquerel na ang uranium ay kusang naglalabas ng misteryosong radiation kahit nasa dilim. Pinag-aralan pa ito nina Marie at Pierre Curie, at si Marie Curie ang nag-imbento ng salitang 'radioactivity.'
fact_bis: Kinsa ang nakadiskobre sa radioactivity? Niadtong 1896, namatikdan ni Henri Becquerel nga ang uranium nag-gawas og misteryoso nga radiation sa kaugalingon, bisan sa kangitngit. Gitun-an pa kini ni Marie ug Pierre Curie, ug si Marie Curie ang nag-imbento sa pulong nga 'radioactivity.'

q: What can a seed do if the right conditions for sprouting are not yet present?
options: It can rest in the soil and wait for the right conditions
It sprouts immediately no matter what the conditions are
It floats to the surface to find better sunlight
It breaks open and releases its nutrients into the soil
explanation: A seed can stay dormant — resting and waiting in the soil — until the right conditions arrive for it to sprout.
fact_tl: Maaaring matagal munang maghintay ang isang binhi sa lupa hanggang dumating ang tamang panahon para tumubo.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka liso mahimong mopahulay ug maghulat sa yuta og dugay hangtod moabot ang husto nga panahon aron motubo.

q: Why does leche flan come out shaped like an oval when it is cooked in a llanera?
options: Because any liquid takes the shape of its container before it sets
Because the heat of the llanera pushes the mixture into an oval
Because leche flan is always oval before it is cooked
Because the llanera has a special lining that molds the shape after cooking
explanation: Like any liquid, the leche flan mixture takes the shape of the llanera mold before it sets, so it comes out oval.
fact_tl: Ang leche flan ay iniluluto sa llanera, isang oval na metal na hulmahan; tulad ng kahit anong liquid, ang timpla ay humuhugis sa lalagyan bago tumigas, kaya nakukuha nito ang hugis ng llanera.
fact_bis: Ang leche flan lutoon sa llanera, usa ka oval nga metal nga hulmahan; sama sa bisan unsang liquid, ang sagol mosunod sa porma sa sudlanan una kini mogahi, maong makuha niini ang porma sa llanera.

q: What do we call a space rock that burns up in Earth's atmosphere and appears as a streak of light in the sky?
options: A meteor
A meteoroid
A meteorite
A comet
explanation: When a meteoroid enters Earth's atmosphere and burns as a streak of light, we call it a meteor, or shooting star; only if it survives and lands does it become a meteorite.
fact_tl: Ang meteoroid ay maliit na bato sa kalawakan; kung sumunog ito sa himpapawid at maging guhit ng liwanag, ito ay meteor (bulalakaw); at kung may matira na bumagsak sa lupa, ito ay meteorite.
fact_bis: Ang meteoroid usa ka gamayng bato sa kawanangan; kon kini masunog sa atmospera ug mahimong linya sa kahayag, kini meteor (bulalakaw); ug kon adunay mabilin nga matagak sa yuta, kini meteorite.

q: Which element is the most abundant in the entire universe?
options: Hydrogen
Oxygen
Carbon
Nitrogen
explanation: Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe, while oxygen holds that title specifically in Earth's crust.
fact_tl: Ang hydrogen ang pinakamarami sa buong uniberso, ngunit ang oxygen ang pinakamaraming elemento sa balat ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang hydrogen mao ang labing daghan sa tibuok uniberso, apan ang oxygen mao ang labing daghang elemento sa balat sa Kalibotan.

q: What is a hormone?
options: A chemical messenger made by glands that travels in the blood to give instructions to other parts of the body
A type of white blood cell that fights infections in the body
A special nutrient absorbed from food to help organs grow
An electrical signal sent by the brain to control movement
explanation: A hormone is a chemical messenger produced by glands and released into the blood to carry instructions to other parts of the body.
fact_tl: Ang hormone ay isang kemikal na mensahero na ginagawa ng mga glandula sa katawan. Inilalabas ito sa dugo para magdala ng tagubilin sa ibang bahagi ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang hormone usa ka kemikal nga mensahero nga gihimo sa mga glandula sa lawas. Ibutang kini sa dugo aron magdala og tagubilin ngadto sa ubang bahin sa lawas.

q: How does climate change threaten Philippine coral reefs?
options: Rising ocean temperatures and acidification cause more frequent and severe coral bleaching
Stronger typhoon winds physically break the coral apart
Rising sea levels bury the coral under too much deep water
Warmer air temperatures dry out the coral during low tide
explanation: Climate change causes rising ocean temperatures and acidification, which trigger coral bleaching events that are becoming more frequent and severe in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang mga coral reef ng Pilipinas ay nanganganib dahil sa pagtaas ng temperatura ng dagat at pag-asim nito dulot ng climate change; ang coral bleaching ay nagiging mas madalas at mas malala.
fact_bis: Ang mga coral reef sa Pilipinas naay peligro tungod sa pagtaas sa temperatura sa dagat ug pag-asim niini tungod sa climate change; ang mga coral bleaching event nagkasayon ug nagkagrabe.

q: Besides delivering oxygen, what waste gas does blood carry away from the body's cells?
options: Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen
Water vapor
Carbon monoxide
explanation: Blood carries away carbon dioxide, a waste gas produced by cells, and brings it to the lungs where it is breathed out.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ay nag-aalis din ng carbon dioxide, isang basurang gas, at dinadala ito sa baga para mailabas.
fact_bis: Ang dugo magkuha usab sa carbon dioxide, usa ka hugaw nga gas, ug magdala niini ngadto sa baga aron ipagawas.

q: Which activities help make your bones stronger?
options: Running and jumping
Reading and studying
Sleeping and resting
Eating and drinking water
explanation: Weight-bearing activities like running and jumping put stress on bones, which helps make them stronger over time.
fact_tl: Ang mga aktibidad gaya ng pagtakbo at paglundag ay nakakatulong na lumakas ang ating mga buto.
fact_bis: Ang mga kalihokan sama sa pagdagan ug paglukso makatabang nga mokusog ang atong mga bukog.

q: In a landslide, what is the name given to the bottom area where fallen soil and rock pile up?
options: The toe
The scarp
The crown
The flank
explanation: The toe of a landslide is the bottom area where all the fallen soil and rock accumulate, while the scarp is the torn upper edge.
fact_tl: May mga bahagi ang landslide: ang itaas na bahagi na parang putol na pader ay tinatawag na scarp, at ang ibaba kung saan natitipon ang lahat ng nahulog na lupa at bato ay tinatawag na toe o paa ng pagguho.
fact_bis: Ang landslide adunay mga bahin: ang ibabaw nga bahin nga morag napunit nga pader gitawag og scarp, ug ang ubos diin matipon ang tanang nahulog nga yuta ug bato gitawag og toe o tiil sa pagguba.

q: What is the unit used to measure electrical resistance?
options: Ohm (Ω)
Volt (V)
Ampere (A)
Watt (W)
explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms (Ω), a unit named after the scientist Georg Ohm.
fact_tl: Ang elektrikong resistensya ay sinusukat sa ohm (Ω), na ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm.
fact_bis: Ang elektrikong resistensya gisukod sa ohm (Ω), nga ginganlan kang Georg Ohm.

q: Why does a straw in a glass of water appear to be bent even though it is straight?
options: Water bends the light passing through it
The water pressure pushes the straw sideways
The weight of the water makes the straw lean to one side
The straw absorbs water and actually curves slightly
explanation: The straw looks bent because water bends (refracts) the light passing through it, making objects appear to be in a different position.
fact_tl: Ang straw sa baso ng tubig ay mukhang baluktot dahil binabaluktot ng tubig ang liwanag na dumadaan dito.
fact_bis: Ang straw sa baso nga may tubig murag baliko kay ang tubig nagliko sa kahayag nga moagi niini.

q: What helps a carabao get nutrients from the tough grass it eats?
options: Tiny microbes living in its stomach that break down the grass
Special teeth that grind grass into liquid before swallowing
A very long small intestine that slowly dissolves the grass
A strong acid in its stomach much more powerful than human acid
explanation: Tiny microbes living in the carabao's stomach break down tough grass so the carabao can absorb nutrients from it.
fact_tl: May napakaliliit na buhay na bagay (microbes) sa tiyan ng kalabaw na tumutulong magtunaw ng damo, kaya nakakakuha ito ng sustansya mula sa halaman.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay kaayo nga buhing mga butang (microbes) sa tiyan sa kalabaw nga motabang paghunaw sa kumpay, mao nga makakuha kini og sustansya gikan sa tanom.

q: What can a strong electric current passing through the body do?
options: Harm the heart and muscles
Only cause a small burn on the skin
Make a person temporarily blind
Cause the bones to break
explanation: A strong electric current passing through the body can seriously harm a person's heart and muscles, making electric shocks very dangerous.
fact_tl: Ang malakas na kuryente na dumaan sa katawan ay maaaring makapinsala sa puso at mga kalamnan ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang kusog nga kuryente nga moagi sa lawas mahimong makadaot sa kasingkasing ug sa mga kaunoran sa tao.

q: What keeps the ozone layer from running out, even though ozone is constantly split apart by UV light?
options: Ozone keeps reforming as split oxygen atoms use the sun's energy to join back together
New ozone is created from carbon dioxide in the upper atmosphere
Clouds constantly produce new ozone and push it upward
Plants release ozone that rises and replaces what is lost
explanation: When ozone splits from absorbing UV, the oxygen atoms reunite using the sun's energy to form new ozone, so the cycle repeats and the ozone layer is maintained.
fact_tl: Kapag nasipsip ng ozone ang UV at nahati ito, hindi ba nauubos ang ozone? Hindi, dahil paulit-ulit itong nabubuo. Ang nahating oxygen ay muling nagsasama gamit ang enerhiya ng araw para gumawa ulit ng bagong ozone. Tuloy-tuloy ang siklong ito kaya laging may ozone na humaharang sa UV.
fact_bis: Kung suyupon sa ozone ang UV ug mabuak kini, dili ba mahurot ang ozone? Dili, kay balik-balik kining maporma. Ang nabuak nga oxygen mag-usa pag-usab gamit ang enerhiya sa adlaw aron mohimo og bag-ong ozone. Magbalik-balik kini nga siklo mao nga kanunay adunay ozone nga nagbabag sa UV.

q: Why is DNA fingerprinting useful for identifying people?
options: Because every person has unique DNA patterns that can be compared from blood, hair, or saliva
Because DNA fingerprints show a person's face and body shape
Because DNA can only be found on actual fingerprints left at a scene
Because all members of the same family share identical DNA patterns
explanation: Every individual has unique DNA patterns, so DNA fingerprinting — using blood, hair, or saliva — allows investigators to identify people reliably.
fact_tl: Ang DNA fingerprinting ay ginagamit ng mga imbestigador upang matukoy ang mga tao dahil ang bawat isa ay may natatanging bahagi ng DNA na maaaring ihambing mula sa dugo, buhok, o laway.
fact_bis: Ang DNA fingerprinting gigamit sa mga imbestigador aron mahibal-an ang mga tawo tungod kay ang matag indibidwal adunay talagsaon nga mga pattern sa DNA nga mahimong ikumpara gikan sa dugo, buhok, o laway.

q: Why do barn swallows visit the Philippines?
options: They come from colder places to stay here during the northern winter
They migrate here in summer to breed and raise their chicks
They travel here every year to feed on Philippine sea fish
They visit the Philippines as a stop on their way to Australia
explanation: Barn swallows migrate to the Philippines from colder regions to stay during the northern winter, making them seasonal visitors.
fact_tl: Ang barn swallow ay dumadayo sa Pilipinas mula sa malalamig na lugar upang dito manirahan habang taglamig sa hilaga.
fact_bis: Ang barn swallow mubisita sa Pilipinas gikan sa bugnaw nga mga dapit aron magpuyo dinhi panahon sa tingtugnaw sa amihanan.

q: How does the sailfin lizard help new plants grow in the forest?
options: It swallows fruit seeds that pass out in its droppings elsewhere, spreading them
It digs burrows in the soil that help seeds fall deeper and sprout
It carries seeds stuck to its scaly skin to new locations
It drinks water and sprays it on the ground to moisten seeds
explanation: When the sailfin lizard eats fruit, it swallows seeds that are later released in its droppings somewhere else, helping spread plants through the forest.
fact_tl: Dahil kumakain ng prutas ang sailfin lizard, nakakain din nito ang mga buto na lumalabas sa kanyang dumi sa ibang lugar. Sa ganitong paraan, nakakatulong siyang magkalat ng buto para tumubo ang mga bagong halaman sa gubat.
fact_bis: Tungod kay mokaon og prutas ang sailfin lizard, makalamoy usab kini og mga liso nga mogawas sa iyang hugaw sa laing dapit. Niini nga paagi, makatabang kini sa pagsabwag og liso aron motubo ang bag-ong mga tanom sa kalasangan.

q: What is bird migration?
options: The regular movement of birds from one place to another at certain times of the year
The process by which birds learn to fly for the first time
The way birds communicate using songs and calls during the breeding season
The yearly change in a bird's feather color to match the seasons
explanation: Bird migration is the regular, seasonal movement of birds from one place to another, often driven by changes in weather and food availability.
fact_tl: Ang migration ay ang regular na paglipat ng mga ibon mula sa isang lugar patungo sa iba't ibang panahon ng taon.
fact_bis: Ang migration mao ang regular nga pagbalhin sa mga langgam gikan sa usa ka lugar ngadto sa lain sa pipila ka panahon sa tuig.

q: What is the unit used to measure force?
options: Newton (N)
Joule (J)
Watt (W)
Pascal (Pa)
explanation: The newton (N) is the standard unit of force, named after the scientist Isaac Newton.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng puwersa ay ang newton (simbolo: N).
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa puwersa mao ang newton (simbolo: N).

q: About how fast were the winds of Typhoon Yolanda when it made landfall?
options: About 315 km/h
About 150 km/h
About 200 km/h
About 400 km/h
explanation: Typhoon Yolanda's winds reached approximately 315 km/h at landfall, making it one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded.
fact_tl: Umabot sa humigit-kumulang 315 km/h ang lakas ng hangin ng Bagyong Yolanda nang tumama ito, kabilang sa pinakamalakas na naitala.
fact_bis: Ang kusog sa hangin sa Bagyong Yolanda miabot ug mga 315 km/h dihang miigo, usa sa pinakakusog nga natala.

q: Which statement best describes the sizes of dinosaurs?
options: Some were as small as a chicken, while others were taller than a house
All dinosaurs were about the size of a large elephant
Most dinosaurs were smaller than a dog
All dinosaurs were taller than three-story buildings
explanation: Dinosaurs came in an enormous range of sizes — from chicken-sized species to giants taller than a house.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang laki ang mga dinosaur—ang iba ay kasinglaki ng manok lamang, habang ang iba ay mas mataas pa sa bahay.
fact_bis: Lainlain ang gidak-on sa mga dinosaur—ang uban kasing-gamay ra sa manok, samtang ang uban mas taas pa kaysa balay.

q: What is the main sequence stage in the life of a star?
options: The long stage where a star burns hydrogen through nuclear fusion in its core
The brief early stage when a star is first forming from a gas cloud
The final stage when a star collapses and becomes very small
The middle stage when a star expands into a red giant
explanation: The main sequence is the longest stage in a star's life, during which it steadily burns hydrogen through nuclear fusion — our Sun is currently midway through this phase.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan sa buhay ng isang bituin ay ginagugol nito sa main sequence — ang yugto kung saan ito ay nagsusunog ng hydrogen sa pamamagitan ng nuclear fusion sa core nito. Ang aming Araw ay nasa gitna ng main sequence phase nito.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa kinabuhi sa usa ka bituin gigugol niini sa main sequence — ang yugto diin kini nagsunug og hydrogen pinaagi sa nuclear fusion sa iyang core. Ang atong Adlaw naa sa katagatnga sa iyang main sequence phase.

q: What is the largest lake in the Philippines?
options: Laguna de Bay
Lake Sebu
Taal Lake
Lake Lanao
explanation: Laguna de Bay, located in Luzon near Manila, is the largest lake in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking lawa sa Pilipinas ay ang Laguna de Bay, na nasa Luzon malapit sa Maynila.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga lanaw sa Pilipinas mao ang Laguna de Bay, nga naa sa Luzon duol sa Manila.

q: Where can eels be found living?
options: Both in rivers and in the sea
Only in the deep ocean
Only in freshwater rivers
Only in tropical coral reefs
explanation: Some eels live in fresh water like rivers while others live in the sea, so they can be found in both environments.
fact_tl: May mga igat na nakatira sa tubig-tabang tulad ng ilog at may nasa dagat din.
fact_bis: Adunay mga igat nga nagpuyo sa tubig-tabang sama sa suba ug adunay anaa sa dagat.

q: What is the value of absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature, in degrees Celsius?
explanation: Absolute zero is -273.15 degrees Celsius, the coldest temperature that can theoretically exist.
fact_tl: Ang absolute zero, ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura, ay -273.15 degrees Celsius (-273.15°C).
fact_bis: Ang absolute zero, ang kinabababaan nga posibleng temperatura, kay -273.15 degrees Celsius (-273.15°C).

q: Which part of the kamote plant, besides the root, can be eaten as a nutritious vegetable?
options: The young leaves or tops
The flowers
The stem bark
The seeds
explanation: The young leaves or tops of the kamote plant are also nutritious and eaten as a vegetable, not just the root.
fact_tl: Hindi lang ugat ng kamote ang kinakain; ang mga dahon o talbos nito ay masustansyang gulay din.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang gamot sa kamote ang gikaon; ang mga dahon o talbos niini usa usab ka masustansyang utanon.

q: Why do your ears 'pop' when an airplane climbs or descends?
options: Your body equalizes the pressure on both sides of your eardrum
Tiny bones in your ear shift due to the vibration of the engine
Cold air at high altitude contracts the ear canal
Gravity pulls your eardrums downward as the plane rises
explanation: When outside air pressure changes during a climb or descent, your body works to equalize the pressure on both sides of your eardrum, causing the popping sensation.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang eroplano ay umaahon o bumababa, nagbabago ang presyon ng hangin sa labas ng iyong tainga. Ang iyong katawan ay nag-aayos upang pantay-pantay ang presyon sa loob at labas ng tainga — ito ang dahilan ng mararamdamang 'pop' sa iyong tainga.
fact_bis: Sa pag-angat o paglusong sa eroplano, ang presyon sa hangin sa gawas sa imong tainga nagbabago. Ang imong lawas nag-aayos aron pantay ang presyon sa sulod ug gawas sa eardrum — kini ang hinungdan sa 'pop' nga imong mabati sa mga tainga.

q: What happens to the kelp forest when sea otters disappear from an area?
options: Sea urchins multiply and eat all the kelp, leaving the seafloor bare
Sea urchins die out because they lose their main predator
Kelp grows even faster without otters disturbing the seafloor
Crabs take over and eat the sea urchins instead
explanation: Without sea otters to control them, sea urchins multiply and eat all the kelp until the seafloor becomes bare and lifeless.
fact_tl: Kapag nawala ang mga sea otter, dumarami ang mga sea urchin at kinakain nila ang lahat ng kelp hanggang maging tigang at walang-buhay ang dagat.
fact_bis: Kung mawala ang mga sea otter, modaghan ang mga tuyom ug kaonon nila ang tanang kelp hangtod nga maawaaw ug walay kinabuhi ang salog sa dagat.

q: What do meerkats dig out of the ground to eat?
options: Insects, worms, and scorpions
Seeds, nuts, and roots
Small lizards and frogs
Berries and desert plants
explanation: Meerkats eat insects, worms, and even scorpions that they dig out of the ground.
fact_tl: Ang mga meerkat ay kumakain ng mga insekto, uod, at maging mga alakdan na hinuhukay nila sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga meerkat nagakaon og mga insekto, ulod, ug bisan mga tanga nga ilang kaloton gikan sa yuta.

q: Which set of features correctly describes a fish?
options: Breathes with gills, has scales and fins, and is cold-blooded
Breathes with lungs, has scales and fins, and is warm-blooded
Breathes with gills, has smooth wet skin, and is cold-blooded
Breathes with gills, has feathers, and is warm-blooded
explanation: A fish is defined as a vertebrate that breathes with gills, has scales and fins, and is cold-blooded.
fact_tl: Ang isda (fish) ay vertebrate na humihinga gamit ang hasang (gills), may kaliskis (scales) at palikpik (fins), at malamig ang dugo (cold-blooded).
fact_bis: Ang isda (fish) usa ka vertebrate nga moginhawa pinaagi sa hasang (gills), adunay himbis (scales) ug palikpik (fins), ug bugnaw og dugo (cold-blooded).

q: Why do manta rays visit certain spots on coral reefs?
options: Small fish at those spots clean parasites off their skin
They gather there to find mates during breeding season
They go there to feed on large schools of plankton
They rest on the reef bottom to conserve energy
explanation: Manta rays visit reefs where small fish clean their skin, removing parasites and dead tissue.
fact_tl: Pumupunta ang manta ray sa mga bahura kung saan nililinis ng maliliit na isda ang balat nito.
fact_bis: Ang manta ray moadto sa mga bahura diin ang gagmay nga isda molimpyo sa panit niini.

q: What usually happens to the Philippines during a La Niña period?
options: More rain and flooding occur
Less rain and severe drought occur
Stronger typhoons form east of the country
Temperatures rise sharply and rivers dry up
explanation: La Niña is when the central Pacific Ocean surface cools, which often brings more rain and flooding to the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang La Niña ay panahon na lumalamig ang ibabaw ng gitnang Karagatang Pasipiko, kaya madalas itong nagdadala ng mas maraming ulan at baha sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang La Niña maoy panahon nga mobugnaw ang ibabaw sa sentro nga Kadagatang Pasipiko, mao nga sagad kini magdala og mas daghang ulan ug baha sa Pilipinas.

q: Which part of the brain acts like a thermostat and raises your body temperature when you are sick?
options: The hypothalamus
The cerebellum
The brain stem
The cerebral cortex
explanation: The hypothalamus works like a thermostat; when you are sick it raises your body's temperature setting, causing a fever on purpose.
fact_tl: May parang thermostat ang utak mo na tinatawag na hypothalamus. Kapag may sakit ka, itinataas nito ang 'setting' ng temperatura ng katawan, kaya nilalagnat ka. Hindi ito sira ng katawan kundi sinadya niya.
fact_bis: Ang imong utak naay sama sa thermostat nga gitawag og hypothalamus. Kung magsakit ka, gipataas niini ang 'setting' sa temperatura sa lawas, mao nga hilanaton ka. Tinuyo kini sa lawas, dili kay nadaot.

q: About how long did the Wright brothers' very first airplane flight last?
options: About 12 seconds
About 5 minutes
About 2 minutes
About 30 seconds
explanation: The Wright brothers' first flight lasted only about 12 seconds and covered about 36 meters.
fact_tl: Ang unang lipad ng magkapatid na Wright ay tumagal lamang ng mga 12 segundo at umabot ng mga 36 metro (120 talampakan).
fact_bis: Ang unang lupad sa managsoong Wright milungtad lang og mga 12 segundo ug milukop og mga 36 metros (120 ka tiil).

q: Unlike camouflage which hides an animal, what do bright warning colors on an animal signal?
options: That the animal is poisonous and should not be eaten
That the animal is ready to find a mate
That the animal is the fastest in its habitat
That the animal is the dominant predator nearby
explanation: Bright warning colors signal to predators that the animal is poisonous and should not be eaten, which is the opposite strategy from camouflage.
