fact_tl: Ang kamuflahe ay nagtatago sa hayop, ngunit ang ilang hayop ay kabaliktaran ang ginagawa — gumagamit sila ng makikinang na kulay bilang babala na sila ay may lason at hindi dapat kainin.
fact_bis: Ang kamuflahe magtago sa mananap, apan ang pipila ka mananap kasukwahi ang gibuhat — mogamit sila og hayag nga kolor isip pasidaan nga sila adunay hilo ug dili angay kaonon.

q: Who shared the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with Marie Curie and Pierre Curie?
options: Henri Becquerel
Albert Einstein
Ernest Rutherford
Max Planck
explanation: Henri Becquerel shared the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with Marie and Pierre Curie for the discovery of radioactivity.
fact_tl: Hinati nina Henri Becquerel, Marie Curie, at Pierre Curie ang Nobel Prize in Physics noong 1903 para sa radioactivity.
fact_bis: Gibahin nila Henri Becquerel, Marie Curie, ug Pierre Curie ang Nobel Prize in Physics niadtong 1903 alang sa radioactivity.

q: Which two scientists proposed the cell theory in 1838–1839?
options: Matthias Schleiden and Theodor Schwann
Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch
Charles Darwin and Alfred Wallace
Gregor Mendel and Hugo de Vries
explanation: Matthias Schleiden and Theodor Schwann proposed the cell theory in 1838–1839, stating that all living things are made of cells.
fact_tl: Sina Matthias Schleiden at Theodor Schwann ang nagpanukala ng cell theory noong 1838–1839.
fact_bis: Sila si Matthias Schleiden ug Theodor Schwann mao ang nagsugyot sa cell theory niadtong 1838–1839.

q: What is dysbiosis, and what problems has it been linked to?
options: An imbalance of gut bacteria linked to irritable bowel syndrome, obesity, and inflammatory diseases
A complete lack of bacteria in the gut that causes malnutrition
An overgrowth of only beneficial bacteria that improves digestion
A viral infection of the gut lining that causes temporary diarrhea
explanation: Dysbiosis is an imbalance of the gut microbiome and has been linked to conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome, obesity, and inflammatory diseases.
fact_tl: Ang dysbiosis ay ang kawalan ng balanse ng mga microbe sa bituka — ito ay iniugnay sa iba't ibang sakit tulad ng irritable bowel syndrome, obesity, at mga sakit na nauugnay sa pamamaga.
fact_bis: Ang dysbiosis mao ang kawad-on sa balanse sa mga microbe sa tinai — kini gikonektar sa lainlaing mga kondisyon sama sa irritable bowel syndrome, obesity, ug mga sakit nga may kalabotan sa pamamaga.

q: Why is biodiversity important for nature?
options: Each plant and animal has a role in keeping nature in balance
Having more species makes it easier for humans to find medicine
More animals in an area means more food is available for people
Biodiversity helps the water cycle produce more rainfall
explanation: Biodiversity is important because each plant and animal has a role in keeping nature in balance.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang biodiversity dahil ang bawat halaman at hayop ay may papel para manatiling balanse ang kalikasan.
fact_bis: Importante ang biodiversity tungod kay ang matag tanom ug hayop adunay papel aron magpabiling balanse ang kinaiyahan.

q: About how old was Harriet the Galapagos giant tortoise when she died in 2006?
options: About 175 years old
About 75 years old
About 50 years old
About 100 years old
explanation: Harriet, a Galapagos giant tortoise, reached about 175 years old before she died in 2006.
fact_tl: Si Harriet, isang Galapagos giant tortoise, ay umabot sa mga 175 taong gulang bago namatay noong 2006.
fact_bis: Si Harriet, usa ka Galapagos giant tortoise, nakaabot og mga 175 ka tuig sa wala pa siya mamatay niadtong 2006.

q: What does a crescent moon look like?
options: Only a thin sliver — less than half — of the Moon's face is lit
Exactly half of the Moon's face is lit on one side
More than half but not all of the Moon's face is lit
The entire Moon's face is lit up brightly
explanation: During a crescent moon phase, only a thin sliver — less than half — of the Moon's face is lit.
fact_tl: Sa crescent moon, kakaunti lang (mas kaunti sa kalahati) ng mukha ng Buwan ang naliliwanagan, na parang manipis na hibla.
fact_bis: Sa crescent moon, gamay ra (ubos sa katunga) sa nawong sa Bulan ang nahayagan, sama sa nipis nga bahin.

q: How many cells does a single bacterium have?
options: Just one cell
About one thousand cells
Millions of cells
Hundreds of cells
explanation: A bacterium is made of just ONE cell, yet it can eat, grow, and multiply all by itself.
fact_tl: Ang bacteria ay isang napakaliit na nabubuhay na nilalang na gawa lang sa ISANG cell. Kahit isang cell lang siya, kaya niyang kumain, lumaki, at dumami nang mag-isa. Tayong tao ay gawa sa trilyon-trilyong cell, pero ang bacteria ay kumpleto na sa isa lang.
fact_bis: Ang bacteria usa ka gamay kaayo nga buhing butang nga hinimo lang sa USA ka cell. Bisan usa ra ka cell, makakaon, makatubo, ug makadaghan kini mag-isa. Kita nga tawo hinimo sa trilyon nga cell, pero ang bacteria kompleto na sa usa lang.

q: Why is there no permafrost in the Philippines?
options: The soil stays warm all year and never freezes underground
The Philippines gets too much rain which prevents freezing
The rock beneath the soil is volcanic and keeps it warm
The Philippines is too flat for cold temperatures to develop
explanation: There is no permafrost in the Philippines because the soil stays warm all year, unlike cold countries where the ground underneath stays permanently frozen.
fact_tl: Walang permafrost (lupang laging nagyeyelo) sa Pilipinas dahil mainit ang lupa buong taon — iba sa malalamig na bansa kung saan nananatiling nagyeyelo ang lupa sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Walay permafrost (yuta nga kanunay nagyelo) sa Pilipinas tungod kay init ang yuta tibuok tuig — lahi sa bugnaw nga mga nasod diin magpabilin nga nagyelo ang yuta sa ilalom.

q: When is the house gecko most active?
options: At night, when it comes out to hunt insects
In the early morning, just after sunrise
During midday, when it is warmest
At dusk, just before the sun sets
explanation: The house gecko is nocturnal — it comes out at night to hunt insects and hides or sleeps during the day.
fact_tl: Ang butiki sa bahay ay aktibo sa gabi (nocturnal); lumalabas ito kapag dilim para manghuli ng insekto, at madalas natutulog o nagtatago sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang tabili sa balay aktibo sa gabii (nocturnal); mogawas kini kung ngitngit aron mangita og insekto, ug kasagaran matulog o motago sa adlaw.

q: Approximately how long is the Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge, the world's longest bridge?
options: About 165 kilometers
About 50 kilometers
About 500 kilometers
About 15 kilometers
explanation: The Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge is about 165 kilometers long.
fact_tl: Ang Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge ay halos 165 kilometro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge mga 165 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Why can't you make goosebumps appear just by wanting them?
options: Your brain sends the signal automatically through nerves — you cannot control it on purpose
Goosebumps only appear when the temperature drops below a certain level
The muscles that cause goosebumps only respond to hormones, not thoughts
Goosebumps are caused by the heart pumping faster, not the brain
explanation: Goosebumps happen automatically when your brain sends a fast nerve signal to tiny skin muscles — you cannot force them to appear by wanting them.
fact_tl: Hindi mo kayang pilitin ang goosebumps na lumabas kapag gusto mo. Kusang nagpapadala ang utak mo ng mabilis na senyales sa pamamagitan ng mga nerbiyo papunta sa mga maliliit na kalamnan ng balat kapag giniginaw o natatakot ka, kaya bigla itong lumilitaw.
fact_bis: Dili nimo mapugos ang goosebumps nga mogawas kung gusto nimo. Awtomatik nga magpadala ang imong utak og paspas nga senyales pinaagi sa mga nerbiyo ngadto sa gagmay nga kaunuran sa panit kung ginawon o mahadlok ka, mao nga kalit kini motungha.

q: Why does a fish in water appear to be in a slightly different position than where it actually is?
options: Water bends the light coming from the fish, making it look shifted
The fish's body reflects light and creates a mirror image
Water magnifies objects, making them look closer to the surface
Your eyes cannot focus properly through the flat surface of water
explanation: Water bends light through refraction, so a fish appears to be in a different place than it actually is — spear fishers must aim a bit off from where they see it.
fact_tl: Kapag tumitingin ka sa isdang nasa tubig, wala ito sa eksaktong kinaroroonan na nakikita mo dahil binabaluktot ng tubig ang liwanag — kaya kailangang mag-adjust ng mga mangingisdang gumagamit ng sibat.
fact_bis: Kon motan-aw ka sa isda nga anaa sa tubig, wala kini sa eksaktong dapit nga imong makita tungod kay gibawog sa tubig ang kahayag — mao nga ang mga mananaksok kinahanglang mo-adjust gikan sa ilang nakita.

q: How does a fixed pulley at the top of a traditional well help someone draw water?
options: It changes the direction of force so pulling down raises the bucket up
It reduces the weight of the water bucket by half
It stores energy so the rope moves on its own
It multiplies the force so less effort is needed to lift the bucket
explanation: A fixed pulley changes the direction of force — pulling the rope down on one side raises the water bucket on the other side, letting you use your weight to help.
fact_tl: Sa tradisyonal na balon na may pulley, ang pagbaba ng lubid sa isang gilid ay nag-aahon ng balde ng tubig sa kabilang gilid — ang pulley ay nagbabago ng direksyon ng puwersa.
fact_bis: Sa tradisyonal nga balon nga adunay fixed pulley, ang pagbitad sa lubid pababa sa usa ka kilid nagpaakyat sa balde sa tubig sa pikas kilid — ang pulley nagbago sa direksyon sa puwersa aron mahimo nimo gamiton ang imong timbang.

q: Where are nonmetals located on the periodic table?
options: On the upper right side
On the lower left side
In the middle rows
Along the bottom row
explanation: Nonmetals are found on the upper right side of the periodic table.
fact_tl: Ang mga nonmetal (di-metal) ay matatagpuan sa kanang bahagi sa itaas ng periodic table.
fact_bis: Ang mga nonmetal (dili metal) makit-an sa tuo nga bahin sa ibabaw sa periodic table.

q: How do baby sea turtles (pawikan) find their way to the ocean after hatching?
options: They head toward the brightest part of the sky
They follow the sound of waves using their hearing
They use their sense of smell to detect salt in the air
They follow the tracks left by their mother on the sand
explanation: Baby turtles find the sea by heading toward the brightest part of the sky, which is naturally over the open ocean.
fact_tl: Hinahanap ng mga sanggol na pawikan ang dagat sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa pinakamaliwanag na bahagi ng kalangitan.
fact_bis: Ginapangita sa gagmayng pawikan ang dagat pinaagi sa pagsunod sa labing hayag nga bahin sa langit.

q: What happens to wavelength as the frequency of electromagnetic waves increases from radio waves to gamma rays?
options: The wavelength gets shorter
The wavelength gets longer
The wavelength stays the same
The wavelength first increases and then decreases
explanation: As frequency increases across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio waves to gamma rays, the wavelength gets shorter.
fact_tl: Habang tumataas ang frequency mula radio hanggang gamma, lumiliit ang wavelength.
fact_bis: Samtang motaas ang frequency gikan sa radio hangtod sa gamma, momubo ang wavelength.

q: What happens to the frequency of a musical note when you go up exactly one octave?
options: The frequency doubles
The frequency triples
The frequency increases by half
The frequency stays the same but the pitch sounds higher
explanation: Going up one octave doubles the frequency — for example, A4 at 440 Hz becomes A5 at 880 Hz.
fact_tl: Sa tuwing aakyat ng isang oktaba sa musika, nagdodoble ang dalas — halimbawa, ang A4 (440 Hz) ay nagiging A5 (880 Hz).
fact_bis: Kada saka og usa ka oktaba sa musika, modoble ang frequency — pananglitan, ang A4 (440 Hz) mahimong A5 (880 Hz).

q: Which animal is the tallest in the world?
options: The giraffe
The African elephant
The polar bear
The ostrich
explanation: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world, reaching about 5.5 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang giraffe ang pinakamatangkad na hayop sa mundo, na umaabot ng halos 5.5 metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang giraffe mao ang pinakataas nga hayop sa kalibutan, moabot ug halos 5.5 metro ang gitas-on.

q: What does a bee's 'waggle dance' tell other bees in the hive?
options: The direction and distance to a food source
The location of a safe place to build a new hive
That there is danger and they should stay inside
Which flowers have the sweetest nectar nearby
explanation: When a bee finds food, it performs a waggle dance inside the hive to communicate the direction and distance to the food source.
fact_tl: Kapag nakahanap ang bubuyog ng pagkain, gumagawa ito ng 'waggle dance' sa loob ng puwod para ipaalam sa ibang bubuyog ang direksyon at distansya ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Kung makakita ang bubuyog og pagkaon, nagbuhat kini og 'waggle dance' sa sulod sa puod aron sultihi ang ubang bubuyog sa direksyon ug gilay-on sa pagkanan.

q: How do antihistamine medicines help people with allergies?
options: They block the effect of histamine, reducing itching and runny nose
They destroy the allergen before it enters the bloodstream
They strengthen the immune system so it ignores allergens
They dilate blood vessels to help the body remove allergens faster
explanation: Antihistamines block the effect of histamine, easing allergy symptoms like itching and a runny nose.
fact_tl: Ang antihistamine ay gamot na humaharang sa epekto ng histamine, kaya nababawasan nito ang pangangati at sipon dulot ng allergy.
fact_bis: Ang antihistamine mao ang tambal nga magbabag sa epekto sa histamine, mao nga mokunhod ang katol ug sip-on tungod sa allergy.

q: How many seasons does the Philippines have?
options: 2 seasons: dry and wet (rainy)
4 seasons: summer, autumn, winter, spring
3 seasons: dry, rainy, and cool
2 seasons: summer and winter
explanation: The Philippines has 2 seasons: the dry season and the wet (rainy) season.
fact_tl: May 2 na panahon sa Pilipinas: tag-init (tuyong panahon) at tag-ulan (basang panahon).
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay 2 ka panahon: ting-init (uga nga panahon) ug ting-ulan (basa nga panahon).

q: Where is the Manila Trench located?
options: West of Luzon and Mindoro, under the South China Sea
East of Mindanao, under the Philippine Sea
North of Batanes, under the Luzon Strait
Between Visayas islands, under the Sibuyan Sea
explanation: The Manila Trench is found west of Luzon and Mindoro, under the South China Sea.
fact_tl: Ang Manila Trench ay matatagpuan sa kanluran ng Luzon at Mindoro, sa ilalim ng South China Sea.
fact_bis: Ang Manila Trench makit-an sa kasadpan sa Luzon ug Mindoro, ilalom sa South China Sea.

q: Why does a smoker get out of breath faster when running or playing sports?
options: Smoking weakens the lungs, so they cannot supply enough oxygen during exercise
Smoking speeds up the heart so it burns energy too quickly
Smoking reduces the number of red blood cells in the body
Smoking makes muscles tire faster by blocking protein absorption
explanation: A smoker gets out of breath and tired faster because smoking weakens the lungs, reducing their ability to supply oxygen during physical activity.
fact_tl: Ang naninigarilyo ay mas madaling hingalin at napapagod sa pagtakbo o paglalaro dahil mahina na ang baga.
fact_bis: Ang nagpanigarilyo dali rang hangakon ug kapuyon sa pagdagan o pagdula tungod kay luya na ang baga.

q: What is a growing baby called in the womb after its body parts have formed?
options: A fetus
An embryo
A zygote
A neonate
explanation: In the first weeks the growing baby is called an embryo, and once the body parts have formed it is called a fetus.
fact_tl: Sa unang mga linggo ay tinatawag na embryo ang lumalaking sanggol, at kapag nabuo na ang mga bahagi ng katawan ito ay tinatawag nang fetus.
fact_bis: Sa unang mga semana gitawag nga embryo ang nagtubo nga bata, ug kung naporma na ang mga bahin sa lawas gitawag na kini nga fetus.

q: How do seashells on the shore eventually turn into sand?
options: Waves repeatedly break them down into tiny grains
The sun bleaches and crumbles them over many years
Sea salt dissolves them slowly into fine powder
Crabs and fish crush them while looking for food inside
explanation: Seashells on the shore are broken down by waves until they become tiny grains of sand.
fact_tl: Ang mga kabibe sa dalampasigan ay nadudurog ng mga alon hanggang maging maliliit na butil ng buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga kabhang sa baybayon gidugmok sa mga balud hangtod mahimo silang gagmayng lugas sa balas.

q: Why does a horseshoe crab often bury itself in the sand or mud?
options: To hide from predators and rest safely
To lay its eggs deep underground
To filter food particles from the sand
To cool down during the hot daytime hours
explanation: A horseshoe crab buries itself in sand or mud with only the edge of its shell showing to hide from predators and rest safely.
fact_tl: Kadalasang inililibing ng horseshoe crab ang sarili sa buhangin o putik, na ang gilid lang ng shell ang nakikita. Tumutulong ito para magtago ito sa mga isda o ibong gustong kumain dito, at para makapagpahinga ito nang ligtas.
fact_bis: Kasagaran ilubong sa horseshoe crab ang kaugalingon sa balas o lapok, nga ang kilid lang sa shell ang makita. Kini motabang niini nga motago gikan sa mga isda o langgam nga gustong mokaon niini, ug makapahuway kini nga luwas.

q: Who is the unit of pressure called the 'pascal' named after?
options: Blaise Pascal, a French scientist and mathematician
Isaac Pascal, a British physicist
Louis Pascal, a French engineer
Claude Pascal, a Swiss chemist
explanation: The pascal, the unit of pressure, is named after Blaise Pascal, a French scientist and mathematician.
fact_tl: Ang pascal, ang yunit ng presyon, ay ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal, isang Pranses na siyentista at matematiko.
fact_bis: Ang pascal, ang yunit sa presyon, ginganlan kang Blaise Pascal, usa ka Pranses nga siyentista ug matematiko.

q: How does a fiddler crab get its food from the mud?
options: It scoops up mud with its small claw, sifts out tiny bits of food, and leaves behind balls of mud
It digs deep burrows and waits for prey to fall in
It uses its large claw to crack open mollusks buried in the mud
It filters water through its gills to catch microscopic food particles
explanation: Fiddler crabs scoop up mud with their small claw, sift out tiny bits of food, and leave behind little balls of mud.
fact_tl: Kinakalkal ng fiddler crab ang putik gamit ang maliit na sipit, sinisala ang pagkain, at iniiwan ang maliliit na bola ng putik.
fact_bis: Ginakaykay sa fiddler crab ang lapok gamit ang gamayng kuyamoy, ginasala ang pagkaon, ug ginabilin ang gagmayng bola sa lapok.

q: What mineral found in bananas and sweet potato helps muscles and nerves work properly?
options: Potassium
Calcium
Magnesium
Iron
explanation: Potassium, found in bananas and sweet potato, helps muscles and nerves work properly.
fact_tl: Ang potasyum, na makukuha sa saging at kamote, ay tumutulong sa tamang paggana ng mga kalamnan at nerbiyo.
fact_bis: Ang potasyum, makuha sa saging ug kamote, motabang sa hustong paglihok sa mga kaunuran ug nerbiyo.

q: Why do stars appear to slowly move across the sky during the night?
options: Earth is spinning, making the sky above us seem to shift
The stars are orbiting around Earth and actually move
The Moon's gravity pulls the stars slowly across the sky
Solar winds push the stars in a westward direction at night
explanation: Stars seem to move across the sky because Earth is spinning — as Earth turns, the sky above us shifts, so stars rise in the east and set in the west.
fact_tl: Mukhang dahan-dahang gumagalaw ang mga bituin sa langit buong gabi, pero hindi naman talaga sila ang gumagalaw — ang Earth ang umiikot! Habang umiikot ang Earth, parang gumagalaw ang langit sa itaas natin, kaya sumisikat ang mga bituin sa silangan at lumulubog sa kanluran, tulad ng Araw.
fact_bis: Murag hinay-hinay nga naglihok ang mga bituon sa langit tibuok gabii, apan dili sila ang tinuod nga naglihok — ang Earth ang nagtuyok! Samtang nagtuyok ang Earth, murag naglihok ang langit sa ibabaw nato, mao nga ang mga bituon mosubang sa sidlakan ug mosalop sa kasadpan, sama sa Adlaw.

q: What famous cave in Cagayan, Philippines, is known for its seven large chambers filled with stalactites and stalagmites?
options: Callao Cave
Hinagdanan Cave
Crystal Cave
Sohoton Cave
explanation: Callao Cave in Cagayan has seven large chambers full of stalactites and stalagmites, with one chamber used as a chapel because a natural hole in the ceiling lets in light.
fact_tl: Isang tunay na halimbawa sa Pilipinas ay ang Callao Cave sa Cagayan, na may pitong malalaking silid na puno ng stalactite at stalagmite — ang isang silid ay ginawang maliit na kapilya dahil sa natural na butas sa kisame na pinapasukan ng liwanag.
fact_bis: Usa ka tinuod nga pananglitan sa Pilipinas mao ang Callao Cave sa Cagayan, nga adunay pito ka dagko nga lawak nga puno sa stalactite ug stalagmite — ang usa ka lawak gigamit isip gamay nga kapilya kay adunay natural nga buho sa kisame nga gisudlan sa kahayag.

q: Which continent is the smallest in the world?
options: Australia
Europe
Antarctica
South America
explanation: Australia is the smallest continent in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Australia ang pinakamaliit na kontinente sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Australia mao ang pinakagamay nga kontinente sa kalibutan.

q: How does a weather station help protect people before a typhoon arrives?
options: It detects dropping air pressure and stronger winds so scientists can warn people to prepare and evacuate
It sends radio signals that weaken the typhoon before it reaches land
It releases chemicals into the clouds to reduce rainfall from the storm
It tracks the typhoon's speed and redirects it away from populated areas
explanation: When a weather station detects dropping air pressure and stronger winds, scientists know a storm is coming and can warn people to prepare and evacuate early.
fact_tl: Isang importanteng gamit ng weather station ay ang pagbabala bago dumating ang bagyo. Kapag bumababa ang presyon ng hangin at lumalakas ang hangin, alam na ng mga siyentista na may paparating na bagyo, kaya nakakapaghanda at nakakalikas ang mga tao nang maaga.
fact_bis: Usa ka importante nga gamit sa weather station mao ang pagpasidaan sa dili pa moabot ang bagyo. Kung mokunhod ang presyon sa hangin ug mokusog ang hangin, nasayod na ang mga siyentista nga adunay paingon nga unos, mao nga makaandam ug makabakwit ang mga tao og sayo.

q: What happens when a farmer uses the technique called grafting?
options: Parts of two plants are joined so they grow together as one plant
Seeds from two different plants are mixed and planted in the same soil
A plant is split in half so each half can grow into a new plant
Two plants are grown in the same pot so their roots share nutrients
explanation: In grafting, parts of two plants are joined together — such as attaching a shoot of one tree onto the trunk of another — so they grow as a single plant.
fact_tl: Sa grafting, pinagdudugtong ang bahagi ng dalawang halaman para magkasamang lumaki bilang isa, gaya ng pagdugtong ng sanga ng isang puno sa katawan ng iba.
fact_bis: Sa grafting, gisumpay ang bahin sa duha ka tanom aron mutubo sila ingon usa, sama sa pagsumpay sa sanga sa usa ka kahoy ngadto sa lawas sa lain.

q: During a fire, which is often more dangerous to people than the flames?
options: The poisonous smoke that fills the air
The extreme heat coming from the burning walls
The falling debris from the collapsing ceiling
The sparks flying from the burning materials
explanation: In a fire, the poisonous smoke is often more dangerous than the flames themselves.
fact_tl: Sa sunog, ang nakakalason na usok kadalasang mas mapanganib kaysa sa mismong apoy.
fact_bis: Sa sunog, ang makahilo nga aso kasagaran mas peligroso kaysa sa kalayo mismo.

q: A student says that a filter with bigger holes is better because water flows through it faster. What is wrong with this thinking?
options: Bigger holes let more dirt pass through, so the water is less clean
Bigger holes actually slow the water down more than small holes do
Filters with bigger holes always break apart when water flows through them
Water cannot pass through holes that are too big, so no filtering happens
explanation: Although bigger holes let water flow faster, they also let more dirt slip through — fine holes filter more slowly but give cleaner water, so there is a trade-off between speed and cleanliness.
fact_tl: Maling isipin na mas mabuti ang filter kung mas malaki ang mga butas para mabilis dumaloy ang tubig. Totoo na mas mabilis ang malalaking butas, pero mas maraming dumi ang nakakalusot. Ang pinong butas ay mabagal mag-filter pero mas malinis ang resulta, kaya may palitan ang bilis at linis.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahunaon nga mas maayo ang filter kung mas dako ang mga lungag aron paspas mo-agas ang tubig. Tinuod nga mas paspas ang dagkong lungag, pero mas daghang hugaw ang makalusot. Ang pino nga lungag mas hinay mosala pero mas limpyo ang resulta, mao nga adunay baylohanay sa katulin ug kalimpyo.

q: How can you tell a planet apart from a star when looking at the night sky?
options: Planets usually shine with a steady light and twinkle less than stars
Planets are always much brighter than stars in the night sky
Stars move across the sky each night while planets stay perfectly still
Stars are visible only during the day while planets appear only at night
explanation: Unlike stars that make their own light and twinkle, planets only reflect the Sun's light and usually shine with a steadier, less-twinkling glow.
fact_tl: Madaling malito ang isang planeta sa bituin sa langit, pero magkaiba sila. Ang bituin ay gumagawa ng sarili nitong liwanag, samantalang ang planeta ay nagsasalamin lang ng liwanag ng Araw. Kadalasan, ang mga planeta ay hindi gaanong kumikislap at tuloy-tuloy ang liwanag, samantalang ang bituin ay kumikislap.
fact_bis: Sayon masaypan ang usa ka planeta isip bituon sa langit, apan lahi sila. Ang bituon mohimo sa iyang kaugalingong kahayag, samtang ang planeta mosalamin lang sa kahayag sa Adlaw. Kasagaran, ang mga planeta dili kaayo magkidlap ug hapsay ang ilang kahayag, samtang ang bituon magkidlap.

q: Why do some caterpillars look like shiny white and black bird droppings?
options: So birds think they are waste and will not eat them
So they can hide from the sun and stay cool during the day
So other caterpillars can recognize and stay close to them
So they can attract butterflies to mate with them
explanation: Some caterpillars mimic bird droppings in appearance so that birds do not eat them, since they appear to be waste rather than food.
fact_tl: May mga higad na ang anyo ay parang tae ng ibon — makintab, puti at itim — kaya hindi ito kinakain ng mga ibon dahil mukhang dumi lamang ito at hindi pagkain.
fact_bis: Adunay mga ulod nga ang panagway sama sa iti sa langgam — masinaw, puti ug itom — mao nga dili kini kan-on sa mga langgam kay morag hugaw lamang kini, dili pagkaon.

q: In a bee colony, what is the special job of the drones?
options: To mate with the queen bee
To build the honeycomb and store honey
To guard the hive entrance from enemies
To gather pollen and nectar from flowers
explanation: Drones in a bee colony exist specifically to mate with the queen; the worker bees gather food and care for the hive, while the queen lays the eggs.
fact_tl: Sa isang kolonya ng pukyutan, may iisang queen na nangingitlog, libu-libong worker bee na naghahanap ng pagkain at nag-aalaga, at mga drone na ang gawain ay pakasalan ang queen.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka kolonya sa putyukan, adunay usa ka queen nga mangitlog, liboan ka worker nga mangita og pagkaon ug moatiman sa pugad, ug mga drone nga ang buluhaton mao ang pagminyo sa queen.

q: Why might your body make you crave salty food after you have been playing hard in the heat?
options: Your body may be signaling that it lost salt through sweat
Your body is telling you that it needs more energy from fat
Your stomach is empty and salt helps trigger hunger feelings
Your muscles need salt to produce the energy used during exercise
explanation: After sweating heavily, the body signals that it may be low on salt lost in sweat, which is why you sometimes crave salty food.
fact_tl: Minsan napapansin mong gusto mong kumain ng maalat, lalo na pagkatapos maglaro o sa sobrang init. Ito ay isang paraan ng katawan para sabihing baka kulang ito sa asin na nawala sa pawis. Pero dahil madali nang makakuha ng asin sa pagkain, kadalasan kakaunti lang ang talagang kailangan.
fact_bis: Usahay mamatikdan nimo nga gusto kang mokaon ug parat, ilabi na human magdula o sa hilabihang kainit. Usa ni ka paagi sa lawas sa pagsulti nga basin kulang kini sa asin nga nawala sa singot. Apan tungod kay sayon na makakuha ug asin gikan sa pagkaon, kasagaran gamay ra ang tinuod nga gikinahanglan.

q: How do plants like corn and grasses spread their pollen to other plants?
options: They rely on the wind to carry their pollen
They use bees and butterflies to carry pollen between flowers
They drop pollen into nearby water streams
They release pollen only at night when moths are active
explanation: Unlike plants that rely on insects, corn and grasses send their pollen on the wind to reach other plants.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng halaman ay umaasa sa insekto; ang ilan tulad ng mais at damo ay nagpapadala ng pollen sa pamamagitan ng hangin.
fact_bis: Dili tanang tanom nagasalig sa insekto; ang uban sama sa mais ug mga sagbot nagapadala sa ilang polen pinaagi sa hangin.

q: Even after someone has stopped smoking in a room, why might children still be harmed?
options: Smoke chemicals cling to clothes, walls, and furniture and can still be touched
The carbon dioxide from the cigarette keeps building up in the closed room
The heat from the cigarette stays trapped in the air for many hours
Nicotine floats freely in the air for days even after all smoke is gone
explanation: Thirdhand smoke — the chemicals left on clothes, walls, curtains, and sofas long after smoking has stopped — can still be harmful, especially to children who touch these surfaces.
fact_tl: May tinatawag na thirdhand smoke—ito ang mga kemikal na natitira sa damit, dingding, kurtina, at sofa matagal nang tapos ang paninigarilyo. Kahit wala nang usok na nakikita, naroon pa rin ang residue na pwedeng makasama, lalo na sa mga bata na humahawak sa mga ito.
fact_bis: Naay gitawag nga thirdhand smoke—ang mga chemicals nga mabilin sa sinina, dingding, kurtina, ug sofa dugay na human ang panigarilyo. Bisan walay aso nga makita, anaa gihapon ang residue nga makadaot, labi na sa mga bata nga mokupot niini.

q: In what year did the Ingenuity helicopter make its first flight on Mars?
explanation: The Ingenuity helicopter made its historic first flight on Mars in the year 2021.
fact_tl: Unang lumipad ang Ingenuity helicopter sa Mars noong taong 2021.
fact_bis: Ang Ingenuity helicopter unang milupad sa Mars sa tuig 2021.

q: Why can't you use water to clean brushes used for oil-based paint?
options: Oil and water do not mix, so water cannot dissolve oil-based paint
Water makes oil-based paint harden faster and ruins the brush permanently
Oil-based paint reacts with water and produces a harmful chemical
Water dissolves too much of the paint and ruins the color
explanation: Turpentine and other paint thinners are organic solvents that dissolve oil-based paints; water cannot substitute because oil and water do not mix.
fact_tl: Ang turpentine at iba pang paint thinner ay mga organic solvent na maaaring matunaw ang mga oil-based na pintura — hindi ito maaaring palitan ng tubig dahil ang pintura at tubig ay hindi naghahalo.
fact_bis: Ang turpentine ug uban pang paint thinner mga organic solvent nga makatunaw sa mga oil-based na pintura; ang tubig dili makasunod niini tungod kay ang mantika ug tubig dili naghialo.

q: What happens to the number of sunspots during a solar minimum?
options: The sunspot count is very low and the Sun is relatively calm
The sunspot count reaches its highest peak and the Sun is most active
Sunspots disappear completely and no solar flares occur at all
Sunspots cover more than half the Sun's surface causing strong storms
explanation: At solar minimum, the sunspot count is very low and the Sun is relatively calm, with fewer solar flares and quieter space weather.
fact_tl: Sa solar minimum, ang bilang ng sunspot ay napakakaunti at ang Sun ay mas kalmado; sa panahon na ito, mas kaunti ang solar flare at CME, at ang space weather ay mas maayos para sa mga satellite at astronaut. Gayunpaman, ang galactic cosmic rays ay mas malakas kapag ang solar shield (heliosphere) ay mas mahina.
fact_bis: Sa solar minimum, ang sunspot count kaayo ka ubos ug ang Adlaw medyo kalmado; sa panahon niini mas kaunti ang solar flare ug CME, ug ang space weather mas mahinay alang sa mga satellite ug astronaut. Bisan pa niana, ang galactic cosmic rays mas kusog sa dihang ang solar shield (heliosphere) pinaka-mahina.

q: Why can moths and other night insects see in the dark even when there is very little light?
options: Their eyes are built to gather and use the small amount of light available at night
Their eyes produce their own light like a flashlight to see in the dark
They have extra layers of eyes that work only when all light is gone
They sense heat from other animals instead of using light to see
explanation: Some night insects like moths have eyes specially built to gather the little light available in the dark, allowing them to see at night.
fact_tl: Ang ilang insekto na lumalabas sa gabi, tulad ng gamu-gamo, ay may mga matang husay mangalap ng kakaunting liwanag sa dilim.
fact_bis: Ang ubang insekto nga mogawas sa gabii, sama sa gamugamo, adunay mga mata nga maayong manguha sa gamay nga kahayag sa kangitngit.

q: Cassava is a common root crop eaten in the Philippines. What is one nutritional weakness of cassava?
options: It is low in protein even though it is high in energy-giving carbohydrates
It is low in carbohydrates and provides very little energy for the body
It contains almost no vitamins or minerals needed for good health
It has high fat content that can cause weight gain if eaten often
explanation: Cassava is high in carbohydrates that give energy, but it is low in protein.
fact_tl: Ang kamoteng kahoy ay mataas sa karbohidrato na nagbibigay ng enerhiya, ngunit mababa ito sa protina.
fact_bis: Ang balanghoy taas sa karbohidrato nga naghatag ug enerhiya, apan ubos kini sa protina.

q: How does a female sea turtle find the beach where she will lay her eggs?
options: She uses the Earth's magnetic field as a guide back to the beach where she was born
She follows the smell of salt water to the nearest sandy shore
She is led to the beach by older turtles who remember the location
She swims toward the brightest lights near the shore at night
explanation: Female sea turtles use the Earth's magnetic field to navigate back to the exact beach where they were born to lay their eggs.
fact_tl: Ang mga babaeng pawikan ay bumabalik sa parehong dalampasigan kung saan sila ipinanganak upang mangitlog — ginagamit nila ang magnetic field ng Lupa bilang gabay sa napakahabang paglalakbay.
fact_bis: Ang mga babaye nga pawikan mobalik sa mao rang baybayon diin sila natawo aron magitlog — naggamit sila sa magnetic field sa Yuta isip giya sa ilang haba kaayong biyahe.

q: Why do climbers of Mount Pulag need to bring thick jackets and gloves even though the Philippines is a tropical country?
options: The temperature near the summit can drop close to zero degrees Celsius
Strong winds at the top carry rain that makes climbers wet and cold
The forests on the mountain block sunlight and keep everything in shade
Clouds block the sun for most of the year making the mountain very dark
explanation: Even in tropical Philippines, the summit of Mount Pulag can drop near zero degrees Celsius, so climbers need thick jackets, gloves, and bonnets.
fact_tl: Kahit napakainit sa Pilipinas, kailangang magdala ng makapal na jacket, guwantes, at bonnet pag aakyat ng Mount Pulag. Sa tuktok kasi, pwedeng bumaba sa malapit-zero ang temperatura. Maraming nagugulat na manginginig sila sa lamig sa sariling bansa!
fact_bis: Bisan init kaayo sa Pilipinas, kinahanglan magdala ug baga nga jacket, guwantes, ug bonnet kon mosaka sa Mount Pulag. Sa tumoy man gud, mahimong mokunhod duol sa zero ang temperatura. Daghan ang natingala nga magkurog sila sa katugnaw sa ilang kaugalingong nasod!

q: In a metal factory, workers use a piece of talc or soapstone like a pencil. Why does talc leave a clear white mark on metal so easily?
options: Talc is one of the softest minerals, so it rubs off easily onto metal surfaces
Talc contains a white dye that is released only when it touches metal
Metal surfaces are rough enough to scrape off pieces of any hard mineral
Talc reacts chemically with metal to leave behind a white powdery residue
explanation: Talc is a very soft mineral, so it rubs off easily and leaves a clear white mark on metal, making it useful for marking in welding work.
fact_tl: Sa mga pabrika, ginagamit ang talc o soapstone na hinubog na parang lapis para gumuhit ng marka sa bakal, lalo na sa welding. Naiiwan ang malinaw na puting marka dahil madaling mag-rub off ang malambot na talc.
fact_bis: Sa mga pabrika, ang talc o soapstone nga gihulma sama sa lapis gigamit aron magmarka sa puthaw, ilabi na sa welding. Mabilin ang tin-aw nga puti nga marka kay sayon ra mag-rub off ang humok nga talc.

q: Why does the Sun pull on the planets more strongly than any other object in our solar system?
options: The Sun has enormous mass and all the planets are relatively close to it
The Sun is the only object in space that produces its own gravitational field
The Sun spins so fast that its rotation creates a very strong pulling force
Planets are made of metal which is naturally attracted to the Sun's surface
explanation: Gravity is stronger when objects have more mass and are closer together, so the Sun's enormous mass allows it to pull the hardest on nearby planets.
fact_tl: Mas malakas ang grabidad kapag mas malaki ang masa at mas malapit ang dalawang bagay, kaya pinakamalakas ang hatak ng napakalaking Araw.
fact_bis: Mas kusog ang gibug-aton kon mas dako ang masa ug mas duol ang duha ka butang, mao nga ang dako kaayong Adlaw ang pinakakusog mobira.

q: An astronaut pushes a ball in outer space. What will happen to the ball after the push?
options: It will keep moving almost forever because there is no friction or air to slow it down
It will slow down and stop because gravity pulls it back toward the astronaut
It will float in circles because the lack of gravity makes it spin endlessly
It will speed up on its own as it moves farther away from the spacecraft
explanation: In space, where there is no air or friction, an object that is pushed keeps moving almost forever because of inertia — nothing is there to slow it down.
fact_tl: Sa kalawakan na walang hangin o friction, ang isang bagay na naitulak ay tuloy-tuloy na gagalaw halos magpakailanman dahil sa inertia. Walang puwersang pumipigil dito, kaya hindi ito humihinto kusa.
fact_bis: Sa kawanangan, diin walay hangin o friction, ang usa ka butang nga giduso magpadayon sa paglihok hapit sa kahangtoran tungod sa inertia. Walay mopahinay niini, mao nga dili kini mohunong sa kaugalingon.

q: After gliding through the air, how does a colugo keep itself from falling when it lands on a tree?
options: It uses its sharp, curved claws to hook into the tree's bark
It wraps its long tail tightly around a branch to hold on
It spreads its gliding membrane flat against the trunk like a suction cup
It lands on soft leaves and grabs them quickly with its front feet
explanation: After gliding, the colugo grips the tree using its sharp, curved claws that hook into the bark so it does not fall when it lands.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng glide, kailangan ng colugo na kumapit nang mahigpit sa puno. Mayroon itong matutulis na kuko na nakakapako sa balat ng puno para hindi ito mahulog matapos lumapag mula sa hangin.
fact_bis: Human sa glide, kinahanglan sa colugo nga mokupot ug hugot sa kahoy. Aduna kini hait nga mga kuko nga makasab-it sa panit sa kahoy aron dili kini mahulog human modapo gikan sa hangin.

q: What do your kidneys do when there is too much salt in your body?
options: They filter out the extra salt and send it out of the body through urine
They store the extra salt in special pouches until the body needs it later
They send signals to the brain to make you sweat out all the extra salt
They break the salt down into smaller chemicals that become body fat
explanation: The kidneys act like filters for the blood — when there is too much salt, they remove the extra and send it out with urine to keep the right balance.
fact_tl: Ang mga bato mo ay parang salaan na naglilinis ng dugo. Kapag sobra ang asin sa katawan, inaalis ng mga bato ang labis at inilalabas ito kasama ng ihi. Ganito pinapanatili ng katawan ang tamang dami ng asin kahit minsang sumosobra ka sa maalat.
fact_bis: Ang imong mga kidney murag salaan nga naglimpyo sa imong dugo. Kung sobra ang asin sa lawas, kuhaon sa kidney ang sobra ug ipagawas kini uban sa imong ihi. Ingon niini gipabilin sa lawas ang husto nga asin bisan usahay mokaon kag sobra ka parat.

q: In some parts of the Philippines, how is geothermal energy used aside from generating electricity?
options: Hot water from the ground is used directly to dry fish and vegetables
Steam from volcanoes is piped into homes to heat water for bathing
Hot geothermal rocks are placed in ovens to cook food without electricity
Geothermal water is mixed with seawater to make salt for cooking
explanation: In some parts of the Philippines, geothermal hot water from the ground is used directly for drying fish and vegetables, saving fuel and electricity.
fact_tl: Ang geothermal heat ay hindi lamang para sa kuryente — sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas, ang mainit na tubig mula sa lupa ay direktang ginagamit para sa pagpapatuyo ng isda at gulay, na nagtatipid ng gasolina at kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang geothermal heat dili lang alang sa kuryente — sa pipila ka bahin sa Pilipinas, ang mainit nga tubig gikan sa yuta direkta gigamit alang sa pagpatuyo sa isda ug utan, nakatipid sa gasolina ug kuryente.

q: Which aircraft holds the record as the fastest jet-powered plane ever flown?
options: NASA X-43A, which flew at about Mach 9.6
SR-71 Blackbird, which flew at about Mach 3.3
Space Shuttle, which flew at about Mach 8.0
F-22 Raptor, which flew at about Mach 2.0
explanation: The NASA X-43A is the fastest jet-powered aircraft, reaching about Mach 9.6 — roughly 11,000 km/h.
fact_tl: Ang NASA X-43A ang pinakamabilis na eroplanong de-jet, lumipad sa halos Mach 9.6 (mga 11,000 km/h).
fact_bis: Ang NASA X-43A mao ang pinakakusog nga eroplano nga de-jet, milupad sa mga Mach 9.6 (mga 11,000 km/h).

q: On which side of the Philippines is the Philippine Trench located?
options: The eastern side, in the Pacific Ocean
The western side, in the South China Sea
The southern side, near the Celebes Sea
The northern side, near the Luzon Strait
explanation: The Philippine Trench lies on the eastern side of the country, deep in the Pacific Ocean.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay nasa silangang bahagi ng bansa, sa Karagatang Pasipiko.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench anaa sa sidlakang bahin sa nasod, sa Dagat Pasipiko.

q: A 1,000-watt air conditioner is used for 8 hours a day. How many kilowatt-hours (kWh) of electricity does it use?
options: 8 kWh
0.8 kWh
80 kWh
800 kWh
explanation: To find kWh: divide watts by 1,000 (giving 1 kW) then multiply by hours (1 kW x 8 h = 8 kWh).
fact_tl: Para makalkula ang gastos ng isang appliance sa kuryente: i-convert ang wattage sa kilowatts (hatiin sa 1000), paramihin sa bilang ng oras na ginamit, at paramihin sa presyo bawat kWh. Halimbawa: isang 1000-watt aircon na gumagana nang 8 oras = 8 kWh.
fact_bis: Para makalkula ang gastos sa kuryente sa usa ka appliance: i-convert ang wattage sa kilowatts (bahinon sa 1000), paramihin sa ihap sa oras nga gigamit, dayon paramihin sa presyo matag kWh. Pananglitan: usa ka 1000-watt aircon nga nagdagan ug 8 oras naggamit ug 8 kWh.

q: How long should you scrub your hands with soap when washing them properly?
options: At least 20 seconds
At least 5 seconds
At least 1 minute
At least 2 minutes
explanation: Proper handwashing means scrubbing with soap and water for at least 20 seconds to remove germs that cause sickness.
fact_tl: Ang tamang paghuhugas ng kamay ay paggamit ng sabon at tubig, pagkuskos nang hindi bababa sa 20 segundo, at pagbabanlaw upang maalis ang mga mikrobyong nagdadala ng sakit.
fact_bis: Ang husto nga paghugas sa kamot mao ang paggamit og sabon ug tubig, pagkuskos sa dili moubos sa 20 ka segundo, ug paghugas aron mawala ang mga mikrobyo nga maoy hinungdan sa sakit.

q: Why should you turn off and unplug appliances like an iron when you are done using them?
options: To prevent overheating and save electricity which reduces fire risk
To stop the appliance from using electricity even when it is cool
So the appliance will last longer because parts wear out only when plugged in
To protect the appliance from power surges that happen when it is idle
explanation: Turning off and unplugging appliances when not in use prevents overheating and saves electricity, both of which help prevent fires.
fact_tl: Patayin at tanggalin sa saksakan ang mga gamit gaya ng plantsa o charger kapag tapos nang gamitin. Bukod sa nakakatipid ng kuryente, iniiwasan din nito ang pag-init at posibleng sunog.
fact_bis: Palonga ug tangtanga sa saksakan ang mga gamit sama sa plantsa o charger kung human na gamita. Gawas nga makatipid sa koryente, malikayan usab niini ang pag-init ug posible nga sunog.

q: Why is it dangerous to look directly at the Sun?
options: Its intense light and radiation can permanently damage your retina and cause blindness
The Sun's heat travels through your eyes and burns the inside of your head
Looking at the Sun sends too much electricity into your brain
The Sun's rays can freeze the liquid inside your eyes and damage them
explanation: The Sun's intense light and radiation can permanently damage the retina, the light-sensing part at the back of the eye, causing blindness.
fact_tl: Huwag kailanman tumingin nang direkta sa araw — ang napakalakas na liwanag at radiation nito ay maaaring permanenteng makapinsala sa iyong retina at maging sanhi ng pagkabulag.
fact_bis: Ayaw kailanman motan-aw direkta sa adlaw — ang iyang kusog nga suga ug radiation mahimong permanenteng makasamad sa imong retina ug makagama og pagkabuta.

q: What are the three main stages that rice (palay) goes through as it grows?
options: Vegetative, reproductive, and ripening
Germination, flowering, and drying
Sprouting, pollination, and harvesting
Seedling, tillering, and decomposing
explanation: Rice goes through three main stages: vegetative (growing leaves and roots), reproductive (forming the panicle), and ripening (grains filling and maturing).
fact_tl: Ang palay ay dumadaan sa tatlong pangunahing yugto: vegetative (paglaki ng dahon at ugat), reproductive (pagbuo ng uhay), at ripening (paghinog ng butil).
fact_bis: Ang palay moagi sa tulo ka pangunahing yugto: vegetative (pagtubo sa dahon ug gamot), reproductive (pagporma sa uhay), ug ripening (pagpuno ug paghinog sa butil).

q: What important change happens to a tadpole's breathing organs as it grows into a frog?
options: Its gills gradually disappear and lungs develop so it can breathe air
Its lungs grow larger so it can hold its breath longer underwater
It develops extra gills to help it breathe both in water and on land
Its mouth grows wider so it can gulp air directly through the mouth
explanation: As a tadpole grows, its gills gradually disappear and lungs develop, allowing the future frog to breathe air instead of water.
fact_tl: Sa paglago ng tadpole, unti-unting nawawala ang mga hasang at lumalabas ang mga baga upang ang maging palaka ay makahanap ng hangin sa halip na sa tubig.
fact_bis: Sa dihang ang tadpole motubo, unti-unti nga mawala ang mga hasang ug mosulod ang mga baga aron ang manglantaw nga palaka makaganghaan og hangin kaysa tubig.

q: Even though stars differ from each other in size, temperature, and age, what do scientists find is the same about all of them?
options: They are all made of the same elements found on Earth and follow the same laws of physics
They all have the same surface temperature just expressed in different units of measurement
They all produce the same amount of light energy regardless of how big they are
They all orbit a central black hole and travel at the same speed through space
explanation: Stars differ in size, temperature, and age, yet they appear to be made of the same elements found on Earth and to follow the same laws of physics.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin ay nag-iiba sa laki, temperatura, at edad, ngunit halos pareho silang gawa sa mga elementong matatagpuan din sa Earth at sumusunod sa parehong batas ng pisika.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon nagkalain-lain sa gidak-on, temperatura, ug panuigon, apan halos parehas silang hinimo sa mga elemento nga makita usab sa Earth ug nagsunod sa samang mga balaod sa pisika.

q: Besides drinking water, how else can your body get the water it needs to stay hydrated?
options: By eating water-rich fruits and vegetables like watermelon and cucumber
By breathing humid air slowly through the nose during hot weather
By resting in the shade so the body reabsorbs sweat through the skin
By drinking milk or juice which replace water completely in the body
explanation: Fruits and vegetables like watermelon, melon, and cucumber are full of water, so eating them also helps keep you from getting dehydrated.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa pag-inom ng tubig nakakakuha ng tubig ang katawan; marami ring tubig ang prutas at gulay tulad ng pakwan, melon, at pipino. Ang pagkain ng mga ito ay tumutulong para hindi ka ma-dehydrate.
fact_bis: Dili lang sa pag-inom ug tubig makakuha ang lawas ug tubig; daghan usab tubig ang prutas ug utanon sama sa pakwan, melon, ug pipino. Ang pagkaon niini motabang aron dili ka ma-dehydrate.

q: What do Filipino shrews have in common with the Etruscan shrew?
options: They are both small, eat insects, and live in forest environments
They are both capable of swimming in rivers to hunt for small fish
They both hibernate during the coldest months of the year
They are both found only on islands and cannot survive on the mainland
explanation: Like the Etruscan shrew, Filipino shrews are small, eat insects, and live in forests.
fact_tl: May mga sariling shrew din ang Pilipinas! Tulad ng Etruscan shrew, maliliit at kumakain ng insekto ang mga Pilipinong shrew na matatagpuan sa kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay kaugalingong mga shrew usab! Sama sa Etruscan shrew, gagmay ug mokaon ug insekto ang mga Pilipinhong shrew nga makita sa atong kalasangan.

q: What is sambong traditionally used for as a medicinal herb in the Philippines?
options: As a diuretic to help with urination and kidney problems
As a pain reliever to reduce fever and headache
As an antibiotic to treat infected wounds and cuts
As a digestive aid to relieve stomach pain and bloating
explanation: Sambong is a Philippine medicinal herb used as a diuretic to help with urination and kidney problems.
fact_tl: Ang sambong ay isang halamang gamot sa Pilipinas na ginagamit bilang diuretic upang tumulong sa pag-ihi at sa mga problema sa bato.
fact_bis: Ang sambong kay usa ka tanom nga tambal sa Pilipinas nga gamiton isip diuretic aron motabang sa pagpangihi ug sa mga problema sa kidney.

q: How do some big fish signal that they want to be cleaned by cleaner fish?
options: They slightly change their color or pose to invite the cleaner
They make a sound that only cleaner fish can hear underwater
They stop swimming and sink slowly to the ocean floor as a signal
They open their mouths wide and swim backward toward the cleaner
explanation: Some big fish slightly change their color or pose to invite cleaner fish to clean parasites off them.
fact_tl: May mga malaking isda na bahagyang nagbabago ng kulay o pwesto para anyayahan ang cleaner na linisin sila.
fact_bis: Adunay dagkong isda nga gamay nga mag-usab sa kolor o postura aron dapiton ang cleaner nga molinis kanila.

q: For what work was Dr. Fe del Mundo awarded the title of National Scientist of the Philippines?
options: Her contributions to children's health and medicine
Her discoveries in the field of plant biology and botany
Her research on Filipino earthquakes and volcanic activity
Her engineering of water systems for rural Filipino communities
explanation: Dr. Fe del Mundo was awarded the title National Scientist of the Philippines for her outstanding work in children's health.
fact_tl: Si Dr. Fe del Mundo ay ginawaran ng titulong National Scientist of the Philippines dahil sa kanyang gawain para sa kalusugan ng mga bata.
fact_bis: Si Dr. Fe del Mundo gihatagan sa titulo nga National Scientist of the Philippines tungod sa iyang buhat alang sa panglawas sa mga bata.

q: Which Philippine government agency monitors and warns the public about La Nina?
options: PAGASA
PHIVOLCS
DENR
DOH
explanation: In the Philippines, PAGASA is the agency that uses satellites, ocean buoys, and temperature data to watch for and warn about La Nina.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA ang ahensya na nagbabantay at nagbibigay ng babala tungkol sa La Nina. Ginagamit nila ang satellite, buoy sa dagat, at datos ng temperatura upang malaman kung darating ang La Nina, para makapaghanda ang mga tao.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA ang ahensya nga nagbantay ug naghatag og pasidaan bahin sa La Nina. Mogamit sila og satellite, buoy sa dagat, ug datos sa temperatura aron mahibaw-an kung moabot na ang La Nina, aron makaandam ang mga tao.

q: What are the round eye-like spots found on a peacock's tail feathers called?
options: Eyespots
Tail rings
Feather eyes
Color patches
explanation: The round eye-like markings on a peacock's tail are called eyespots, and they catch the peahen's attention during courtship.
fact_tl: Ang buntot ng paboreal ay may mga guhit na parang mga mata na tinatawag na eyespots na pumupukaw sa babaeng pabo.
fact_bis: Ang ikog sa paboreal adunay lingin nga mga marka nga sama sa mata nga gitawag eyespots nga makadani sa baye nga pabo.

q: What is special about the eggs of most reptiles?
options: They have a tough, leathery shell that keeps them from drying out on land
They have a hard calcium shell exactly like the eggs of birds
They must stay underwater or the embryo inside will die
They are soft with no shell at all and depend on mud to hold their shape
explanation: Most reptiles lay their eggs on land, and their eggs have a tough, leathery shell that does not dry out easily.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mga reptilya ay nangingitlog sa lupa, at ang kanilang itlog ay may matibay, parang-katad na balat na hindi madaling matuyo.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa mga reptilya mangitlog sa yuta, ug ang ilang mga itlog adunay gahi, sama-sa-panit nga bagol nga dili dali mauga.

q: How does a coral polyp eat its food?
options: It catches tiny prey using tentacles around a single opening that is both mouth and gut
It filters water through tiny pores all over its body to trap food particles
It absorbs dissolved nutrients directly through its outer skin from seawater
It uses a long tube to suck food from the seafloor below it
explanation: A coral polyp has a single opening that acts as both mouth and gut, surrounded by tentacles used to catch tiny prey.
fact_tl: Ang isang coral polyp ay may iisang bukas na bibig na napapalibutan ng mga tentakulo na ginagamit nito upang hulihin ang maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka coral polyp adunay usa ka bukas nga agianan nga nagsilbing baba ug tiyan, giliyokan sa mga tentakulo aron makuha ang gagmay nga buhi.

q: Approximately how wide (diameter) is the Earth?
options: About 12,742 kilometers
About 6,371 kilometers
About 40,075 kilometers
About 1,392 kilometers
explanation: The Earth's diameter — the distance from one side to the other through the center — is about 12,742 kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang diametro ng Daigdig ay humigit-kumulang 12,742 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang diyametro sa Kalibutan mga 12,742 ka kilometro.

q: What was the main idea of Louis Pasteur's germ theory of disease?
options: Illnesses are caused by tiny microorganisms, not by 'bad air'
Illnesses spread because of bad smells coming from rotting waste
Diseases are inherited from parents and cannot be prevented
Sickness is caused by imbalances in four fluids inside the body
explanation: Louis Pasteur established through careful experiments in the 1860s that illnesses are caused by microorganisms, overturning the old idea of 'bad air' as the cause.
fact_tl: Pinagtibay ni Louis Pasteur ang germ theory of disease — ang ideya na ang mga sakit ay dulot ng mga microorganism, hindi ng 'masamang hangin' — sa pamamagitan ng mga maingat na eksperimento noong 1860s.
fact_bis: Gi-establish ni Louis Pasteur ang germ theory of disease — ang ideya nga ang mga sakit gikagikan sa mga microorganism, dili sa 'masamang hangin' — pinaagi sa maayong mga eksperimento sa 1860s.

q: What are the two steps needed to turn short fibers into a piece of cloth?
options: Twisting fibers into thread, then weaving the thread over and under to form fabric
Pressing fibers flat with heat, then cutting them into the shape of cloth
Soaking fibers in water until they stick together, then drying them flat
Gluing fibers side by side into a sheet, then drying them in the sun
explanation: To make cloth, short fibers are first twisted into long thread, and then the thread is woven over and under to form a piece of fabric.
fact_tl: Upang gumawa ng tela, ang maiikling hibla ay pinipihit muna upang maging mahabang sinulid, pagkatapos ang sinulid ay hinahabi nang pasalit-salit upang maging tela.
fact_bis: Aron makahimo ug panapton, ang mugbo nga mga hibla unahon ug lubid aron mahimong taas nga tanod, dayon ang tanod ginahabol nga magsalisi aron mahimong panapton.

q: How do predator insects help farmers in their fields?
options: They eat pest insects and keep pest numbers from growing too large
They pollinate crops more efficiently than bees or butterflies
They dig tunnels in the soil that allow plant roots to grow deeper
They produce chemicals that protect plants from fungal diseases
explanation: Predator insects help keep the number of pests in a field in balance by eating them.
fact_tl: Pinapanatiling balanse ng mga mandaragit na kulisap ang dami ng peste sa bukid.
fact_bis: Ang mandadagit nga mga insekto motabang sa pagpabilin nga balanse ang gidaghanon sa peste sa uma.

q: At approximately what temperature does copper metal melt?
options: About 1,085 degrees Celsius
About 327 degrees Celsius
About 660 degrees Celsius
About 1,538 degrees Celsius
explanation: Copper melts at about 1,085 degrees Celsius, which is much hotter than boiling water.
fact_tl: Ang tanso ay natutunaw sa mga 1,085 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Ang tumbaga matunaw sa mga 1,085 degrees Celsius.

q: How can scientists estimate the age of a giant clam?
options: By counting the growth lines or bands on its shell, similar to tree rings
By measuring the total weight of the shell and dividing by its growth rate
By testing the color of the shell which changes each year as it grows
By observing how deep the clam lives, since older clams always go deeper
explanation: As a giant clam grows, its shell lays down lines or bands like tree rings, allowing scientists to estimate its age from them.
fact_tl: Habang lumalaki ang taklobo, nag-iiwan ng mga linya o banda ang kabibe nito tulad ng singsing ng puno, kaya pwedeng matantya ng siyentipiko ang edad nito mula rito.
fact_bis: Samtang motubo ang taklobo, magbilin ang kabhang niini ug mga linya o banda sama sa singsing sa kahoy, busa matantya sa siyentista ang edad niini gikan niini.

q: Why is the shark not harmed when a remora fish attaches to it?
options: The remora uses suction only and does not bite or dig into the skin, leaving no wound
The shark's skin is too thick for the remora's teeth to penetrate even slightly
The remora releases a numbing chemical that prevents the shark from feeling it
The shark's immune system heals any injury from the remora almost instantly
explanation: The remora attaches using suction only — it doesn't bite or dig into the skin — so no wound is left and the shark is unharmed.
fact_tl: Hindi nasasaktan ang pating kapag dumidikit ang remora dahil suction lang ang gamit nito — hindi ito kumakagat o humuhukay sa balat. Walang sugat na naiiwan, kaya tahimik lang na sumasakay ang remora nang hindi nakakasama sa host nito.
fact_bis: Wala masakiti ang iho kung motapot ang remora kay suction ra ang gamit niini — dili kini mopaak o mokalot sa panit. Walay samad nga mabilin, busa hilom ra nga mosakay ang remora nga walay kadaot sa host niini.

q: What major change did the K-12 curriculum bring to education in the Philippines?
options: It added Senior High School to prepare students for college, work, or business
It replaced college entrance exams with a national skills assessment test
It made English the only official medium of instruction in all schools
It reduced the school year from 10 months to 8 months to match global standards
explanation: The Philippines implemented the K-12 curriculum that added Senior High School to prepare young Filipinos for college, work, or business.
fact_tl: Ipinatupad ng Pilipinas ang K-12 curriculum na nagdagdag ng Senior High School upang ihanda ang mga kabataang Pilipino para sa kolehiyo, trabaho, o negosyo.
fact_bis: Gipatuman sa Pilipinas ang K-12 curriculum nga nagdugang sa Senior High School aron ihanda ang mga batan-ong Pilipino para sa kolehiyo, trabaho, o negosyo.

q: What is a photobioreactor used for in the production of biofuel?
options: To cultivate large amounts of microalgae using light and CO2 as inputs
To burn algae at high temperatures to extract oil for fuel directly
To filter seawater and separate algae from plankton for processing
To mix algae with chemicals under pressure to produce ethanol fuel
explanation: A photobioreactor is a transparent tank used to cultivate microalgae at large scale using light and CO2, and it is the technology being studied for producing algal biofuel in large quantities.
fact_tl: Ang isang photobioreactor ay isang transparent na tangke na ginagamit upang malakihang palakihin ang mga microalgae gamit ang liwanag at CO2 — ito ang teknolohiya na pinag-aaralan para sa paglikha ng algal biofuel sa malalaking dami.
fact_bis: Ang photobioreactor usa ka transparent nga tangke nga gigamit aron ilalaki ang mga microalgae sa dako nga sukod gamit ang kahayag ug CO2 — mao kini ang teknolohiya nga gistudy para sa paghimo sa algal biofuel sa dagkong gidaghanon.

q: Why does a bolo cut through things easily?
options: Its thin edge concentrates your pushing force onto a narrow line, like a wedge.
It spins very fast, which creates extra energy to cut.
Its handle absorbs the impact so the blade does all the work.
It is made of very heavy metal that adds weight to every chop.
explanation: A bolo works as a wedge—its thin edge focuses the pushing force onto a very small area so it can cut or chop easily.
fact_tl: Ang bolo ay matalim na itak na isang uri ng wedge, kung saan ipinipook ng manipis na talim ang puwersa sa isang makitid na guhit para madaling makahiwa o makaputol.
fact_bis: Ang bolo usa ka hait nga sundang nga usa ka matang sa wedge, diin ang nipis nga sulab mopundok sa imong kusog ngadto sa pig-ot nga linya aron sayon mohiwa o moputol.

q: When is World Rabies Day observed every year?
options: September 28
October 15
August 1
November 30
explanation: World Rabies Day is observed every September 28 to raise awareness about rabies and promote dog vaccination drives.
fact_tl: Tuwing Setyembre 28 ipinagdiriwang ang World Rabies Day para palakasin ang kamalayan tungkol sa rabies. Sa araw na ito, maraming komunidad ang nagsasagawa ng libreng pagbabakuna ng mga aso at pagtuturo kung paano iwasan ang sakit.
fact_bis: Matag Septembre 28 gisaulog ang World Rabies Day aron palig-onon ang kahibalo bahin sa rabies. Niining adlawa daghang komunidad ang naghimo og libreng pagbakuna sa mga iro ug pagtudlo unsaon paglikay sa sakit.

q: How does a sponge get its food?
options: It filters tiny bits of food from water that flows through its body.
It uses long tentacles to catch small fish nearby.
It absorbs nutrients directly through its outer skin from the seafloor.
It traps plankton in a sticky mucus layer on its surface.
explanation: A sponge is a filter feeder—it eats by pulling water through its body and trapping tiny food particles inside.
fact_tl: Kumakain ang espongha sa pamamagitan ng pagsala ng maliliit na pagkain mula sa tubig na dumadaloy sa katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang espongha mokaon pinaagi sa pagsala sa gagmay nga pagkaon gikan sa tubig nga moagi sa lawas niini.

q: What is Newton's third law also known as?
options: The action-reaction law
The law of inertia
The law of acceleration
The law of universal gravitation
explanation: Newton's third law is called the action-reaction law because every action force has an equal and opposite reaction force.
fact_tl: Ang ikatlong batas ni Newton ay tinatawag ding batas ng aksyon-reaksyon (action-reaction law).
fact_bis: Ang ikatulong balaod ni Newton gitawag usab nga action-reaction law (balaod sa aksyon-reaksyon).

q: Why do some animals migrate to a different place at certain times of year?
options: To find food or to reproduce in a better location
To escape from animals that are stronger than them permanently
To follow ocean currents that carry them automatically
To shed their old skin or feathers in a warmer climate
explanation: Migration is a behavioral adaptation where animals move seasonally—usually to find food or to reproduce.
fact_tl: Ang paglalakbay o migration ay isang behavioral adaptation kung saan ang mga hayop ay gumagalaw mula sa isang lugar patungo sa isa pa sa mga tiyak na panahon ng taon — kadalasang para hanapin ang pagkain o magparami.
fact_bis: Ang paglalin o migration usa ka behavioral adaptation diin ang mga mananap mobalhin gikan sa usa ka lugar ngadto sa lain sa tiyak nga mga panahon sa tuig — kasagaran aron mangita og pagkaon o magpapadaghan.

q: How does the Ebola virus spread from one person to another?
options: Through direct contact with blood or body fluids from an infected person
Through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes
Through contaminated drinking water or food
Through mosquito bites carrying infected blood
explanation: Ebola is a dangerous virus that spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids of an infected person.
fact_tl: Ang Ebola ay isang mapanganib na filovirus na nagdudulot ng hemorrhagic fever, kumakalat sa pamamagitan ng direktang pakikipag-ugnayan sa dugo o katas ng katawan ng may sakit.
fact_bis: Ang Ebola usa ka delikadong filovirus nga nagpahinabog hemorrhagic fever ug mikaylap pinaagi sa direkta nga kontak sa dugo o body fluids sa usa ka tawo nga may sakit.

q: Which feature is true of ALL mammals?
options: They feed their young with milk and have hair or fur.
They lay eggs and breathe through gills when young.
They are warm-blooded and always give birth to live young.
They have four legs and live on land.
explanation: All mammals share two key traits: they feed their young with milk and they have hair or fur on their bodies.
fact_tl: Ang mga mamalya (mammals) ay mga hayop na nagpapasuso ng gatas sa kanilang anak at may buhok o balahibo.
fact_bis: Ang mga mammal mao ang mga hayop nga nagpasuso ug gatas sa ilang mga anak ug adunay buhok o balhibo.

q: How do GPS and delivery apps use the idea of distance over time?
options: They track how far the rider has traveled over time to show if your order is getting close.
They measure the weight of the package to predict when it will arrive.
They count the number of traffic lights passed to estimate arrival time.
They use the rider's phone battery level to calculate remaining distance.
explanation: GPS and delivery apps measure how far a rider has gone over time—the same idea as a distance-time graph—so you can see your order getting closer.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang ideya ng distance-time graph sa mga GPS at delivery app gaya ng pagsubaybay sa padala — sinusukat nito kung gaano kalayo na ang motor ng rider sa paglipas ng oras, kaya makikita mo sa phone kung malapit na ba ang iyong order.
fact_bis: Ang ideya luyo sa distance-time graph gigamit sa GPS ug delivery apps nga nagsubay sa padala — gisukod niini kon unsa na ka layo ang motor sa rider samtang nagpadayon ang oras, mao nga makita nimo sa phone kon duol na ba ang imong order.

q: Which type of sunlight causes sunburn on your skin?
options: Ultraviolet (UV) light
Infrared light
Visible blue light
X-rays from the sun
explanation: Ultraviolet (UV) is the specific band of sunlight responsible for causing sunburn on the skin.
fact_tl: Ang ultraviolet (UV) ang banda ng sikat ng araw na nagdudulot ng sunburn sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang ultraviolet (UV) maoy banda sa silaw sa adlaw nga maoy hinungdan sa sunburn sa panit.

q: Which satellite does PAGASA use to monitor typhoons and cloud cover over the Philippines?
options: Japan's Himawari satellite
NASA's Hubble space telescope
China's Fengyun satellite
The Philippines' own weather satellite
explanation: PAGASA uses images from Japan's Himawari satellite to monitor typhoons and cloud patterns over the Philippines and the Pacific Ocean.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ay gumagamit ng mga larawan mula sa weather satellite (tulad ng Himawari ng Japan) upang subaybayan ang mga bagyo at ulap sa ibabaw ng Pilipinas at Pacific Ocean.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA naggamit sa mga larawan gikan sa mga weather satellite (sama sa Himawari sa Japan) aron masubaybayan ang mga bagyo ug panganod sa ibabaw sa Pilipinas ug Pacific Ocean.

q: What is the cloudy, fuzzy head that forms around a comet as it heats up called?
options: The coma
The nucleus
The corona
The halo
explanation: As a comet gets closer to the Sun and heats up, gas and dust escape from its icy core and form a cloudy head called the coma.
fact_tl: Kapag umiinit ang kometa, lumalabas ang gas at alikabok mula sa malamig na ubod nito at bumubuo ng maulap na ulo na tinatawag na coma.
fact_bis: Samtang nag-init ang kometa, mogawas ang gas ug abog gikan sa bugnaw nga ubod niini ug maghimo og malabog nga ulo nga gitawag og coma.

q: At normal Earth air pressure, what happens to carbon dioxide instead of melting into a liquid?
options: It goes straight from solid to gas without becoming liquid.
It stays as a liquid for several minutes before becoming gas.
It dissolves into the surrounding water vapor in the air.
It remains as a solid indefinitely at room temperature.
explanation: At normal Earth air pressure, carbon dioxide cannot stay liquid, so it skips the liquid stage and goes straight to gas—this is called sublimation.
fact_tl: Sa normal na presyon ng hangin sa Earth, hindi maaaring maging likido ang carbon dioxide kaya ito dumidiretso sa gas.
fact_bis: Sa normal nga presyon sa hangin sa kalibutan, dili mahimong likido ang carbon dioxide mao nga diretso kini ngadto sa gas.

q: Why do shorebirds often fly together in large flocks?
options: To stay safer from predators
To keep warm by sharing body heat while flying
To navigate better because one bird alone can get lost
To eat more efficiently by chasing fish together
explanation: Shorebirds fly in large flocks so that there are more eyes to spot predators, making each bird safer.
fact_tl: Madalas na lumilipad ang mga ibong dagat nang sama-sama sa malalaking kawan para mas ligtas mula sa mga maninila.
fact_bis: Kasagaran molupad ang mga langgam sa baybayon nga magkuyog sa dagkong mga panon aron mas luwas gikan sa mga manunukob.

q: In a food chain like Sun → grass → grasshopper → frog → snake → eagle, what generally happens as new links are added on top?
options: The predator at the top gets bigger with each new link.
The total amount of energy in the chain increases each step.
The animals lower in the chain become more numerous.
The chain becomes less stable and the animals compete more.
explanation: Each new link added to a food chain usually adds a bigger predator on top, as in the example chain ending with a snake eaten by an eagle.
fact_tl: May food chain na mas mahaba: araw → damo → tipaklong → palaka → ahas → agila. Sa tuwing may bagong kumakain, nadadagdagan ng isa pang kawing ang kadena, at kadalasan mas malaki ang mandaragit sa tuktok.
fact_bis: Adunay food chain nga mas taas: adlaw → sagbot → apan → baki → bitin → agila. Matag adunay bag-ong mokaon, modugang og usa pa ka link ang kadena, ug kasagaran mas dako ang manunukob sa tumoy.

q: Which planet has the shortest year in our solar system?
options: Mercury
Mars
Venus
Earth
explanation: Mercury has the shortest year of all planets—it completes one orbit around the Sun in only about 88 Earth days.
fact_tl: Ang Mercury ang planetang may pinakamaikling taon—iniikot nito ang Araw sa halos 88 araw lamang ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Mercury mao ang planeta nga adunay pinakamubo nga tuig—molibot kini sa Adlaw sulod lang sa mga 88 ka adlaw sa Yuta.

q: What happens to land when too many goats graze the same spot repeatedly?
options: The grass is eaten down to nothing, leaving bare soil that erodes more easily.
The goats' hooves press seeds into the ground, helping new grass grow faster.
The land becomes more fertile because of the waste the goats leave behind.
The soil becomes wetter because bare ground absorbs more rain.
explanation: Overgrazing by too many goats strips the grass away completely, leaving bare soil that is vulnerable to erosion.
fact_tl: Kapag masyadong maraming kambing ang nanginginain sa iisang lugar, nauubos ang damo hanggang sa walang natitira at nagiging hubad ang lupa, na nagpapadali sa pagkasira o pagguho nito.
fact_bis: Kung sobra kadaghan nga kanding ang mosibsib sa usa ka dapit, mahurot ang sagbot hangtod nga walay mabilin ug mahimong hubad ang yuta, nga makapasayon sa pagkadaot o pagkahugno niini.

q: What is the purpose of a sneeze?
options: To push out air fast and clear something irritating from the nose
To send extra oxygen to the brain when you feel tired
To warm the air in your throat before it reaches the lungs
To signal to your body that you need to drink more water
explanation: A sneeze is an automatic reflex that blasts air out quickly to remove something irritating from the nose.
fact_tl: Ang pagbahing ay isang reflex na nagpapalabas nang mabilis ng hangin upang linisin ang ilong sa nakakairitang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang pagbahing usa ka reflex nga mopagawas ug paspas sa hangin aron limpyohan ang ilong sa makahasol nga butang.

q: What does the formula 'NaCl' actually tell you about table salt?
options: The ratio of sodium to chlorine ions in the giant network—one sodium for every one chlorine.
The exact number of atoms in a single tiny particle of salt.
The mass of one molecule of sodium chloride in grams.
The number of bonds holding one pair of sodium and chlorine atoms together.
explanation: NaCl shows the ratio of ions—one sodium for every one chlorine—in a huge network of millions of ions, not a single tiny particle.
fact_tl: Mali ang akala na ang 'NaCl' ay isang maliit na bagay na nag-iisa. Sa totoo, ang ionic compound ay isang MALAKING network ng milyon-milyong ion. Ang 'NaCl' ay nagpapakita lang ng RATIO: isang sodium bawat isang chlorine.
fact_bis: Sayop ang pagtuo nga ang 'NaCl' usa ka gamay nga butang nga nag-inusara. Sa tinuod, ang ionic compound usa ka DAKO nga network sa minilyon nga ion. Ang 'NaCl' nagpakita lang sa RATIO: usa ka sodium matag usa ka chlorine.

q: Aside from defense, what else does a skink use its tail for?
options: Storing fat as a reserve food supply when food is scarce
Sensing temperature changes in the environment
Balancing itself while climbing slippery surfaces
Attracting mates during the breeding season
explanation: A skink stores fat in its tail—like a packed lunch—so it has energy reserves when food is hard to find, which is why losing the tail is a real cost.
fact_tl: Bukod sa depensa, ginagamit ng skink ang buntot para mag-imbak ng taba. Parang baon o reserbang pagkain na nakatago sa buntot, na pwedeng gamitin kapag kulang ang makain. Kaya nga sayang kapag naihulog ito.
fact_bis: Gawas sa depensa, gigamit sa skink ang ikog aron magtipig og tambok. Sama kini sa baon o reserbang pagkaon nga gitago sa ikog, magamit kung nihit ang makaon. Maoy hinungdan nga sayang kung mahulog kini.

q: What happens to deer populations when their forests are destroyed?
options: Deer numbers fall.
Deer adapt and move into cities instead.
Deer populations stay the same because they eat grass, not trees.
Deer numbers increase because they no longer compete with forest animals.
explanation: Deer depend on forests for shelter and food, so when forests are destroyed, deer populations decline.
fact_tl: Bumababa ang bilang ng usa kapag nasisira ang mga gubat na kanilang tinitirhan.
fact_bis: Ang gidaghanon sa usa mokunhod kung maguba ang kalasangan nga ilang gipuy-an.

q: How does a firefly control whether its light is on or off?
options: By controlling how much oxygen reaches its light organ
By squeezing a special gland that releases glowing chemicals
By adjusting the thickness of its wing covers to block the glow
By changing its body temperature to start or stop the chemical reaction
explanation: A firefly switches its light on and off by controlling the amount of oxygen delivered to its light organ—oxygen makes it glow, less oxygen turns it off.
fact_tl: Kaya ba ng alitaptap na buksan at patayin ang kanyang ilaw? Oo! Kinokontrol nila kung magkano ang oxygen na papasok sa light organ nila. Kapag may oxygen, kumikinang; kapag wala, nawawala ang ilaw. Parang may switch silang sariling lighthouse.
fact_bis: Mahimo ba sa aninipot nga ablihan ug palongon ang iyang kahayag? Oo! Ilang kontrolon kung pila ka oxygen ang mosulod sa ilang light organ. Kon adunay oxygen, mosiga; kon wala, mapalong ang kahayag. Morag adunay switch sila para sa ilang kaugalingong lighthouse.

q: Where in the Philippines is the Sulu bleeding-heart dove found?
options: Only on the islands of Sulu and Tawi-Tawi
Only in the highland forests of Luzon
Throughout the Visayas region, especially Cebu and Bohol
In mangrove areas along the coast of Palawan
explanation: The Sulu bleeding-heart dove is one of the rarest Philippine birds and is found only on the islands of Sulu and Tawi-Tawi.
fact_tl: Ang Sulu bleeding-heart dove (Gallicolumba menagei) ay isa sa pinakararest na ibon sa Pilipinas, makikita lamang sa mga pulo ng Sulu at Tawi-Tawi.
fact_bis: Ang Sulu bleeding-heart dove (Gallicolumba menagei) usa sa pinakalangitnon nga langgam sa Pilipinas, makita lamang sa mga pulo sa Sulu ug Tawi-Tawi.

q: Which best describes a calamansi fruit?
options: A small, sour fruit with usually green skin, commonly grown around homes in the Philippines
A large, sweet orange fruit that turns fully orange when ripe
A seedless fruit with thick yellow skin used mainly in desserts
A medium-sized purple fruit that grows on tall palm-like trees
explanation: The calamansi is a small, sour fruit with usually green skin that is commonly grown in home gardens across the Philippines.
