fact_tl: Ang taklobo ay kinuha ng sobra para sa pagkain at shell trade at noong nakaraan ay halos nawala sa maraming Philippine reef — ang mga programa ng SEAFDEC at BFAR ay nag-breed ng libu-libong taklobo sa mga laboratoryo at nagtanim ng mga ito pabalik sa mga reef.
fact_bis: Ang taklobo labis nga ani-on alang sa pagkaon ug kalakalan sa shell ug kaniadto halos nawala na gikan sa daghang Philippine reef — ang mga programa sa SEAFDEC ug BFAR nag-breed og liboan ka taklobo sa mga laboratoryo ug nagtanim niini pagbalik sa mga reef.

q: What gas makes up about 95% of Mars's thin atmosphere?
options: Oxygen, the same gas that makes up most of Earth's air
Carbon dioxide (CO2)
Nitrogen, which is the most common gas in Earth's air
Water vapor, which forms the clouds we see on Mars
explanation: Mars's thin atmosphere is made up of about 95% carbon dioxide (CO2), unlike Earth's air which is mostly nitrogen.
fact_tl: Ang manipis na hangin ng Mars ay halos puro carbon dioxide (CO2) — humigit-kumulang 95%.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga hangin sa Mars halos tibuok carbon dioxide (CO2) — mga 95%.

q: When you make coffee with a paper filter, how does the filter separate the grounds from the liquid?
options: The filter absorbs only the coffee flavor and lets dirty water pass through
The filter has tiny holes that trap the coffee grounds but let the liquid coffee flow through
The filter is heated to burn away the grounds and purify the coffee
The filter uses a magnetic force to attract the coffee grounds and hold them back
explanation: Coffee filter paper has very tiny holes that are small enough to trap coffee grounds but large enough to let the liquid coffee flow through.
fact_tl: Ang papel na pansala sa kape ay may napakaliliit na butas na pumipigil sa durog na kape ngunit pinadadaan ang likidong kape.
fact_bis: Ang salang papel sa kape adunay gagmay kaayo nga lungag nga makapugong sa durog nga kape apan magpaagi sa likidong kape.

q: Why do we see lightning as a bright flash of light?
options: Lightning reflects off water droplets in the clouds, creating a glowing effect
The air in lightning's path is superheated into glowing plasma, which shines brightly
Lightning carries so much electricity that it lights up the entire cloud from inside
The bright flash is caused by lightning hitting the ground and igniting dust particles
explanation: When air in lightning's path is superheated, it turns into plasma — a glowing gas so hot it shines, which is why we see lightning as a bright flash.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang init na ng hangin sa daanan ng kidlat, nagiging plasma ito—isang nagliliwanag na gas na napakainit kaya kumikinang. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit nakikita nating maliwanag ang kidlat.
fact_bis: Kung sobra na kainit ang hangin sa agianan sa kilat, mahimo kining plasma—usa ka nagsiga nga gas nga init kaayo maong mosidlak. Mao ni ang hinungdan nga makita nato nga hayag ang kilat.

q: How does a coconut float so it can travel across the sea?
options: The coconut's hard shell repels water, so it sits on top
The thick fibrous husk is full of tiny air pockets that keep it from sinking
The coconut is filled with coconut water, which is lighter than seawater
A coconut tree always grows near the shore, so seeds do not need to travel far
explanation: A coconut floats because its thick fibrous husk contains tiny pockets of trapped air that prevent it from sinking, allowing it to travel across the sea.
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang niyog dahil ang makapal na bunot nito ay puno ng maliliit na bulsa ng hangin. Ang hanging ito ang pumipigil dito na lumubog kaya kaya nitong maglakbay sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang lubi molutaw tungod kay ang baga niini nga bunot puno sa gagmay nga puyo sa hangin. Kini nga hangin ang mopugong niini sa pagkalunod aron makabiyahe kini sa dagat.

q: A diamond is one of the most beautiful and expensive gemstones. What element is it made of?
options: Silicon, a hard material also used in computer chips
Carbon, and nothing else
Calcium, the same element found in bones and shells
A mixture of carbon and oxygen bonded tightly together
explanation: A diamond is made of just one single element — carbon — with no other elements mixed in.
fact_tl: Kahit napakaganda at mamahalin, ang diamante ay gawa lang sa iisang sangkap na tinatawag na carbon, walang ibang halo.
fact_bis: Bisan nindot kaayo ug mahal, ang diamante hinimo ra sa usa ka sangkap nga gitawag og carbon, walay laing sagol.

q: Besides keeping your eyes moist, what else do tears do to protect the eye?
options: They cool the eye down to stop it from overheating under bright lights
They contain a special substance that kills some bacteria
They form a hard coating on the eye surface to block dust from entering
They send pain signals to the brain faster than any other body fluid
explanation: Tears contain a special substance that kills some bacteria, helping to protect the eye from infection.
fact_tl: May natatanging sangkap sa luha na nakakapatay ng ilang bakterya upang ingatan ang mata.
fact_bis: Adunay espesyal nga sangkap sa luha nga makapatay sa pipila ka bakterya aron panalipdan ang mata.

q: What is the purpose of a potential divider circuit?
options: It doubles the input voltage so that devices get more power
It uses two resistors in series to produce an output voltage that is a fraction of the input voltage
It stores electrical energy and releases it later, like a battery
It prevents current from flowing in one direction so electricity only goes forward
explanation: A potential divider uses two resistors in series, and the output voltage taken between them is a fraction of the input voltage determined by the ratio of the two resistors.
fact_tl: Ang potential divider ay isang simpleng circuit na may dalawang resistor na nakakonekta sa series — ang output voltage sa pagitan ng dalawang resistor ay bahagi ng input voltage, na nakadepende sa ratio ng dalawang resistor.
fact_bis: Ang potential divider usa ka simpleng circuit nga adunay duha ka resistor nga nakakonekta sa series — ang output voltage sa taliwala sa duha ka resistor bahin sa input voltage, nagdepende sa ratio sa duha ka resistor.

q: How do roots help a plant stay in the ground?
options: Roots pull sunlight down into the soil to feed the plant
They spread out wide underground in different directions, holding the plant firmly so it does not fall over
Roots push the plant upward so that its leaves can reach the sunlight
They store water above the ground to weigh the plant down
explanation: Roots spread out wide underground in many directions — like arms — anchoring the plant firmly so it does not easily fall over.
fact_tl: Kumakalat nang malawak ang mga ugat sa ilalim ng lupa. Parang mga braso na nakahawak sa magkakaibang direksyon, kaya hindi basta natutumba ang halaman.
fact_bis: Mikatag og lapad ang mga gamot ilalom sa yuta. Sama sila sa mga bukton nga mokupot sa lain-laing direksyon, mao nga dili dali matumba ang tanom.

q: How is tuberculosis (TB) different from a common cold when it comes to getting better?
options: TB goes away faster than a cold because the body fights it more aggressively
TB requires the right antibiotic medicine to be cured, whereas a cold goes away on its own
A cold needs medicine too, but TB can disappear without any treatment
Both TB and a cold go away naturally if you rest and drink enough water
explanation: Unlike a cold that clears up on its own, TB does not simply disappear — it requires the right antibiotic medicine to be cured.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng sipon na gumagaling mag-isa, ang TB ay hindi basta nawawala—kailangan ng tamang antibiotic gamot para magamot ito.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa sip-on nga maayo ra sa kaugalingon, ang TB dili basta mawala—nagkinahanglan kini ug husto nga antibiotic nga tambal aron maayo.

q: What is one of the kidneys' main jobs in the body?
options: They pump blood around the body to deliver oxygen to all your cells
They regulate the amount of water and minerals in the blood to keep the right balance of fluids and salts
They filter air coming into the body to remove dust before it reaches the lungs
They produce digestive juices that break down food in the stomach
explanation: The kidneys regulate the amount of water and minerals (electrolytes) in the blood, ensuring the body has the right balance of fluids and salts.
fact_tl: Ang mga kidney ay nagbabalanse ng dami ng tubig at mga mineral (electrolytes) sa dugo, na tinitiyak na hindi masyadong marami o masyadong kaunti ang tubig sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga kidney nagbalanse sa dami sa tubig ug mga mineral (electrolytes) sa dugo, nagsiguro nga ang lawas adunay tama nga balanse sa mga likido ug asin.

q: Why do we blink our eyes?
options: Blinking signals to others that we are awake and paying attention
Blinking spreads tears to clean and moisten our eyes, and protects them from dust and bright light
Blinking pumps blood into the eye so that our vision stays sharp
We blink to rest the muscles in our eyes for a split second
explanation: We blink to spread tears that clean and moisten our eyes, and to shield them from dust and bright light.
fact_tl: Kumukurap tayo para ikalat ang luha na naglilinis at nagpapabasa sa ating mga mata, at para protektahan ang mga ito mula sa alikabok at sobrang liwanag.
fact_bis: Mokurap ta aron ikatag ang luha nga maglimpyo ug magpabasa sa atong mga mata, ug aron panalipdan kini gikan sa abog ug sobra nga kahayag.

q: The Magat River is one of the main tributaries of which large river?
options: The Pampanga River
The Cagayan River
The Agusan River
The Pasig River
explanation: The Magat River is one of the main tributaries that flows into the Cagayan River, the longest river in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Magat ay isa sa mga pangunahing sanga ng ilog na umaagos papunta sa Ilog Cagayan.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Magat usa sa mga nag-unang sanga nga nagaagos paingon sa Suba sa Cagayan.

q: Some people think using leeches in medicine is only an old-fashioned practice. What is the truth?
options: Leeches were used in ancient times but banned from medicine many centuries ago
Leeches have been used since ancient times and are still used in modern medicine today because they work
Leeches were never really used as medicine — it was just a myth
Leeches are now only used in veterinary medicine, not for humans
explanation: Leeches have been used as medicine since ancient times and are still used in modern medicine today because they are effective.
fact_tl: Ginagamit na ang linta bilang gamot mula pa noong unang panahon, libong taon na ang nakalipas. Akala ng marami ay luma na itong paraan, pero ginagamit pa rin ito ngayon sa makabagong gamutan dahil epektibo ito.
fact_bis: Gigamit na ang alimatok ingon nga tambal sukad pa sa karaang panahon, libo na ka tuig ang milabay. Daghan ang naghunahuna nga karaan na kini nga pamaagi, apan gigamit gihapon kini karon sa modernong pagtambal kay epektibo.

q: What makes biomass a renewable source of energy?
options: Biomass is stored deep underground like oil and never runs out
It comes from plants, wood, and rotting waste, which can always be regrown or replaced
Biomass energy is captured from sunlight directly without burning anything
It is called renewable because it produces no greenhouse gases when burned
explanation: Biomass is renewable because it comes from plants, wood, and rotting waste — materials that can be regrown or replaced — and releasing their energy produces heat or electricity.
fact_tl: Ang biomass ay renewable energy na galing sa mga halaman, kahoy, at basurang nabubulok. Kapag sinunog o pinabulok ito, lumalabas ang enerhiya na puwedeng gawing init o kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang biomass mao ang renewable energy gikan sa mga tanom, kahoy, ug nadunot nga basura. Kung sunogon o padunoton kini, mogawas ang enerhiya nga mahimong init o kuryente.

q: What does your body do with extra carbohydrates or fat that you eat but do not use for energy?
options: The body breaks them down and releases them as heat to warm the body
It stores the excess as body fat to use as energy later
The liver immediately destroys extra nutrients so they cannot cause harm
The kidneys filter the extra nutrients out and remove them in urine
explanation: When we eat more carbohydrates or fat than the body needs, the excess is stored as body fat to be used for energy later.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang nakakain na karbohaydrat o taba, iniimbak ito ng katawan bilang taba para gamitin sa darating na araw.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang nakaon nga karbohaydrat o tambok, gitipigan kini sa lawas isip tambok aron gamiton unya.

q: What special ability do stick insects have that most other insects do not?
options: They can regrow a lost leg at their next molt
They can fly without wings by gliding on wind
They can change color to match any background
They can survive underwater for several hours
explanation: Stick insects are among the few insects that can regenerate a complete lost limb, growing it back at their next molt.
fact_tl: Ang stick insects ay may kakayahang muling palaguin ang naputol na binti sa susunod na paghuhuklap—isa sa mga kakaunting insekto na kayang mag-regenerate ng buong limb.
fact_bis: Ang stick insects makahimo sa pagpatubo pag-usab sa napurol nga tiil sa sunod nga paghuklad—usa sila sa pipila ka insekto nga makahimo sa pagpatubo pag-usab sa kompleto nga tiil.

q: Why does using solar panels, windmills, and hydropower reduce carbon dioxide in the air?
options: They produce electricity without burning fossil fuels
They absorb carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere
They cool the Earth's surface and slow evaporation
They replace the ozone layer that blocks harmful gases
explanation: Clean energy sources like solar, wind, and hydropower generate electricity without burning fossil fuels, so almost no carbon dioxide is released.
fact_tl: Paano natin mababawasan ang greenhouse gas? Isang paraan ay ang paggamit ng malinis na enerhiya tulad ng solar panel (mula sa araw), windmill (mula sa hangin), at hydropower (mula sa tubig). Hindi sila nagsusunog ng fossil fuel, kaya halos walang carbon dioxide na lumalabas habang gumagawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Unsaon nato pagkunhod sa greenhouse gas? Usa ka paagi mao ang paggamit og limpyo nga enerhiya sama sa solar panel (gikan sa adlaw), windmill (gikan sa hangin), ug hydropower (gikan sa tubig). Dili sila mosunog og fossil fuel, busa hapit walay carbon dioxide nga mogawas samtang naghimo og kuryente.

q: A wave has a frequency of 4 Hz. What is its period?
options: 0.25 seconds
4 seconds
2 seconds
0.5 seconds
explanation: Period is the inverse of frequency, so at 4 Hz the period is 1 divided by 4, which equals 0.25 seconds per wave.
fact_tl: Ang period ay ang oras na kailangan para makumpleto ang isang buong alon. Ito ang kabaligtaran ng frequency: kung mataas ang frequency, maikli ang period. Kung ang frequency ay 4 Hz, ang period ay 1/4 o 0.25 segundo bawat alon.
fact_bis: Ang period mao ang oras nga gikinahanglan aron makompleto ang usa ka tibuok balod. Kini ang kabaliktaran sa frequency: kung taas ang frequency, mubo ang period. Kung ang frequency 4 Hz, ang period 1/4 o 0.25 segundo matag balod.

q: How wide is the path of totality during a total solar eclipse?
options: About 100 kilometres wide
About 1,000 kilometres wide
About 10 kilometres wide
About 500 kilometres wide
explanation: The path of totality is usually only about 100 kilometres wide; people outside this narrow track only see a partial eclipse.
fact_tl: Ang path of totality ng isang total solar eclipse ay karaniwang humigit-kumulang 100 kilometro lamang ang lapad; sa labas ng makitid na landas na ito, makikita lamang ang partial eclipse.
fact_bis: Ang path of totality sa usa ka total solar eclipse kasagaran mga 100 kilometro lamang ang gilapdon; sa gawas sa makipot nga agianan, partial eclipse lamang ang makita.

q: What type of rock forms when lava cools and hardens?
options: Igneous rock
Sedimentary rock
Metamorphic rock
Limestone rock
explanation: When lava cools and hardens it becomes volcanic or igneous rock.
fact_tl: Kapag ang lava ay lumamig, ito ay tumitigas at nagiging bagong bato na tinatawag na bulkanikong bato.
fact_bis: Kung ang lava mobugnaw, kini mogahi ug mahimong bag-ong bato nga gitawag ug bulkaniko nga bato.

q: In which country are the Pyramids of Giza located?
options: Egypt
Iraq
Libya
Sudan
explanation: The Pyramids of Giza are located in Egypt.
fact_tl: Ang mga Piramide ng Giza ay matatagpuan sa bansang Ehipto (Egypt).
fact_bis: Ang mga Piramide sa Giza nahimutang sa nasod nga Ehipto (Egypt).

q: How do people use forest fruits to help bring forests back to bare areas?
options: They collect seeds from ripe fruits, sprout them in nurseries, then plant the seedlings
They grind up the fruits and mix them into soil to add nutrients
They leave the whole fruits on the ground so birds carry seeds away
They boil the fruits to make a liquid fertilizer for young trees
explanation: People collect ripe forest fruits, germinate the seeds in nurseries, and then plant the seedlings to restore the forest in bare areas.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga tao ang buto mula sa prutas sa gubat para magtanim ng bagong puno sa mga kalbong lugar. Tinitipon nila ang mga hinog na bunga, pinapatubo ang buto sa nursery, at saka itinatanim ang punla para maibalik ang kagubatan.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga tawo ang liso gikan sa bunga sa lasang aron magtanom ug bag-ong kahoy sa hawan nga mga dapit. Maghipos sila sa mga hinog nga bunga, patubuon ang liso sa nursery, ug dayon itanom ang punla aron mabalik ang kalasangan.

q: Why does a carabao wallow in mud?
options: To cool its body and protect its skin from heat and biting insects
To soften its hooves so it can walk on hard ground more easily
To hide from predators by covering its strong smell with mud
To absorb water through its skin when it is very thirsty
explanation: The carabao wallows in mud to cool its body and protect its skin from heat and biting insects.
fact_tl: Lumulublob ang kalabaw sa putik upang palamigin ang katawan nito at maprotektahan ang balat mula sa init at mga insekto.
fact_bis: Naglunang ang kabaw sa lapok aron pabugnawon ang lawas niini ug panalipdan ang panit gikan sa kainit ug mga insekto.

q: What happens to the weather during the months when the monsoon is switching over, like May or October?
options: The wind becomes weaker and it is often very hot
Heavy rains fall every day as two monsoons meet
Strong storms and typhoons form more frequently
Cool dry air blows in from the north
explanation: During monsoon transition months the wind weakens and it often becomes very hot before the next season arrives.
fact_tl: May mga buwan tulad ng Mayo o Oktubre na nagpapalit ang monsoon — sa panahong ito ay mas mahina ang hangin at madalas ay napakainit bago dumating ang susunod na season.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bulan sama sa Mayo o Oktubre kung mag-usab ang monsoon — niini nga panahon mas huyang ang hangin ug kasagaran init kaayo una moabot ang sunod nga panahon.

q: Why is it dangerous to plug multiple extension cords into each other (daisy chaining)?
options: The combined load can exceed the cords' rating, causing overheating and fire
The combined cord becomes too long for electricity to travel through it
Chaining cords reverses the direction of the current and damages appliances
The extra cords use more electricity even when nothing is plugged into them
explanation: Daisy chaining extension cords can make the total electrical load exceed what the cords can safely handle, leading to overheating and fire danger.
fact_tl: Huwag magsalansan ng maraming extension cord sa isa't isa (daisy chaining) — ang magkasamang limitasyon ng mga extension cord ay hindi sapat para sa malaking karga, na nagdudulot ng overheating at panganib ng sunog.
fact_bis: Ayaw mag-daisy chain ug daghang extension cord — ang kinabuok nga load mahimong lapason ang gidak-on sa mga cord, nagpahinabo sa sobrang init ug panganib sa sunog.

q: Why is it so hard to remove barnacles from the bottom of a ship?
options: Because barnacles attach with a glue so strong that workers must scrape hard or use special paint
Because barnacles burrow deep holes into the metal that cannot be filled
Because barnacles are protected by sharp spines that cut cleaning tools
Because barnacles multiply faster than they can be removed by hand
explanation: Barnacle glue is extremely strong, so workers must scrape hard or apply special paint to remove barnacles from a ship's hull.
fact_tl: Dahil napakatibay ng pandikit ng barnacle, kailangang kiskisan nang husto o gamitan ng espesyal na pintura ang ilalim ng barko para matanggal ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Tungod kay lig-on kaayo ang pandikit sa barnacle, kinahanglan kiskisan pag-ayo o gamitan og espesyal nga pintura ang ilawom sa barko aron makuha kini.

q: What is another name for the fire tree, and why does it have that name?
options: Caballero, because its bright red-orange summer flowers make the whole tree look like it is on fire
Caballero, because its wood burns much longer than other trees when used as firewood
Sampaguita, because its flowers glow orange like embers in the dark
Narra, because loggers once burned it to clear land in summer
explanation: The fire tree is also called caballero; it blooms with bright red-orange flowers in summer, making the whole tree look like it is on fire.
fact_tl: Ang fire tree o caballero ay isang punong namumukadkad ng makukulay na pula-kahel na bulaklak tuwing tag-init, kaya parang naglalagablab ang buong puno.
fact_bis: Ang fire tree o caballero usa ka kahoy nga mamulak og bidlisiw nga pula-kahel nga mga bulak panahon sa ting-init, busa morag nagdilaab ang tibuok kahoy.

q: What does a camera lens do to light from a scene?
options: It converges the light and focuses it onto a sensor or film to form a clear image
It filters out unwanted colors so the image looks natural and bright
It slows light down so the sensor has more time to record the scene
It splits light into three beams for the red, green, and blue pixels
explanation: A camera lens converges light from a scene and focuses it onto a sensor or film to produce a clear image.
fact_tl: Ang lens ng camera ay nagtitipon ng liwanag mula sa isang bagay at nagtutuon nito sa sensor o film upang makagawa ng malinaw na larawan.
fact_bis: Ang lente sa camera nagatipon sa suga gikan sa talan-awon ug nagtutok niini sa sensor o film aron makabuhat og klaro nga larawan.

q: How is scabies treated?
options: With a special medicine or cream prescribed by a doctor
By soaking in hot water twice a day for a week
By keeping the skin very dry and avoiding all water
By applying cooking oil to kill the tiny organisms on the skin
explanation: Scabies can be treated with a special medicine or cream that a doctor prescribes.
fact_tl: Maaaring gamutin ang galis gamit ang espesyal na gamot o cream na ibinibigay ng doktor.
fact_bis: Ang galis matambalan gamit ang espesyal nga tambal o cream nga ihatag sa doktor.

q: Which of the following is one of the four conditions needed for natural selection to work?
options: Traits must be heritable so they can be passed to offspring
All individuals in a population must look exactly the same
Animals must choose mates from a different species
The environment must stay the same from generation to generation
explanation: One of the four conditions for natural selection is that traits must be heritable — passed from parents to offspring — so better traits can spread in the population.
fact_tl: Ang natural selection ay nangangailangan ng apat na kondisyon: (1) pagkakaiba sa katangian, (2) ang ilang katangian ay nakakatulong sa survival, (3) ang mga katangian ay namamana, at (4) ang mga may mas magandang katangian ay nagpaparami ng mas marami.
fact_bis: Ang natural selection nagkinahanglan og upat ka kondisyon: (1) pagkalahi sa mga katangian, (2) ang uban nga mga katangian nagtabang sa survival, (3) ang mga katangian namamana, ug (4) ang mga adunay maayong katangian nagpanamkon og daghang.

q: Why is erosion harmful to farmers?
options: It carries away the fertile topsoil that contains the nutrients crops need
It pushes rocks and sand into rivers, making them overflow onto fields
It dries out the ground by removing the water stored near the surface
It buries seeds too deeply underground so they cannot sprout
explanation: The most fertile soil is on top, and when erosion washes it away, the nutrients that crops need are lost.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamatabang lupa ay nasa ibabaw, kaya kapag tinatangay ito ng erosion, nawawala ang sustansyang kailangan ng mga pananim.
fact_bis: Ang labing tabunok nga yuta naa sa ibabaw, mao nga kon banlasan kini sa erosion, mawala ang sustansya nga gikinahanglan sa mga tanom.

q: Which of the following is a color that gumamela flowers can be?
options: Red, yellow, white, and pink
Only red and white
Only purple and blue
Green and brown
explanation: Gumamela flowers come in many colors including red, yellow, white, and pink.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulaklak ng gumamela ay may iba't ibang kulay tulad ng pula, dilaw, puti, at rosas.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulak sa gumamela kay nagkalain-laing kolor sama sa pula, dalag, puti, ug rosas.

q: What can red cabbage juice tell you that regular litmus paper cannot?
options: How strong an acid or base is, not just whether it is acid or base
Whether a liquid is safe to drink or poisonous
The exact pH number without any calculation
Whether a substance is a solid, liquid, or gas
explanation: Unlike litmus paper which only shows red for acid or blue for base, red cabbage juice produces many different colors that also reveal how strong the acid or base is.
fact_tl: Tulad ng litmus paper, indicator din ang red cabbage—pero may pagkakaiba. Ang litmus ay nagpapakita lang ng pula (asido) o asul (base), samantalang ang red cabbage ay nagbibigay ng maraming kulay na nagsasabi pa kung gaano kalakas ang asido o base.
fact_bis: Sama sa litmus paper, indicator usab ang red cabbage, apan adunay kalainan. Ang litmus magpakita lang og pula (asido) o asul (base), samtang ang red cabbage naghatag og daghang kolor nga nagsulti usab kung unsa kakusog ang asido o base.

q: What helps you stand up straight without straining?
options: Strong muscles in your back and tummy that hold your body upright
Long leg bones that act as pillars to support your weight
A thick layer of fat around your spine that cushions your posture
Flexible joints in your hips that tilt your body into the right angle
explanation: Good posture comes from strong back and core muscles that hold the body upright, making standing tall feel easy.
fact_tl: Ang magandang postura ay nanggagaling sa malalakas na kalamnan sa likod at tiyan. Hinahawakan nila ang iyong katawan nang tuwid para hindi ka kailangang magpilit. Kaya kapag malakas ang iyong mga kalamnan, mas madaling tumayong tuwid.
fact_bis: Ang maayong postura naggikan sa kusog nga kaunoran sa likod ug tiyan. Sila ang nagkupot sa imong lawas nga tul-id aron dili ka maglisod. Busa kung kusgan ang imong kaunoran, sayon ra ang pagtindog nga tul-id.

q: How do scientists use the transit method to find planets outside our solar system?
options: They detect a slight dimming of a star's light when a planet passes in front of it
They photograph the planet directly using a very powerful telescope
They measure the heat given off by the planet as it orbits its star
They listen for radio signals that bounce off the planet's surface
explanation: In the transit method, when a planet passes in front of its star, the star's light dims slightly and telescopes can detect this to confirm the planet's existence.
fact_tl: Madalas natutuklasan ang mga exoplanet sa pamamagitan ng transit method: kapag dumaan ang planeta sa harap ng bituin nito, bahagyang humihina ang liwanag ng bituin na nakikita ng mga teleskopyo.
fact_bis: Ang mga exoplanet kasagarang madiskobre pinaagi sa transit method: kon ang planeta moagi sa atubangan sa bituon niini, ang kahayag sa bituon gamayng miluya, nga mamatikdan sa mga teleskopyo.

q: What is the golden-crowned flying fox known for?
options: It is a Philippine endemic bat and one of the largest bats in the world
It is the fastest-flying bat and can reach speeds of 100 km/h
It is the only bat that hunts fish instead of insects or fruit
It is the only bat found living inside active volcanoes in the Philippines
explanation: The golden-crowned flying fox is a bat found only in the Philippines and is one of the largest bats in the world.
fact_tl: Ang golden-crowned flying fox ay isang endemikong paniki sa Pilipinas at isa sa pinakamalalaking paniki sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang golden-crowned flying fox usa ka endemiko nga kabog sa Pilipinas ug usa sa pinakadako nga kabog sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: Which animals help move pollen from one gumamela flower to another?
options: Bees and birds that drink nectar
Ants and butterflies that eat the petals
Worms and beetles that live in the soil
Lizards and frogs that rest on the leaves
explanation: Bees and birds that visit gumamela flowers to drink nectar pick up pollen and carry it to the next flower.
fact_tl: Ang mga bubuyog at ibon na umiinom ng nektar ay tumutulong magdala ng pollen mula sa isang gumamela patungo sa iba.
fact_bis: Ang mga buyog ug langgam nga moinom og nektar makatabang sa pagdala sa pollen gikan sa usa ka gumamela ngadto sa lain.

q: How is a thermostat different from a timer on an air conditioner?
options: A thermostat stops the unit when it is cool enough, while a timer stops it after a set amount of time
A thermostat counts down minutes, while a timer reads the room temperature
A thermostat only works at night, while a timer only works during the day
A thermostat uses more electricity, while a timer saves electricity automatically
explanation: A thermostat responds to temperature and stops the unit once it is cool enough, while a timer responds to the clock and switches off after the set number of minutes or hours.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang thermostat at timer. Ang thermostat ay nakabatay sa init kapag tama na ang lamig, hihinto. Ang timer naman ay nakabatay sa oras patay ito kapag tapos na ang itinakdang minuto o oras, kahit anong temperatura pa. Maaari mong gamitin pareho sa gabi.
fact_bis: Lahi ang thermostat ug ang timer. Ang thermostat nagsalig sa init kon bugnaw na, mohunong. Ang timer nagsalig sa oras mopalong kini human sa gi-set nga minuto o oras, bisan unsa pa ang temperatura. Pwede nimo gamiton ang duha sa gabii.

q: A classmate says La Nina is a strong storm that hits in a single day. What is wrong with that idea?
options: La Nina is an ocean and climate condition that lasts many months, not a single storm
La Nina is actually warmer and drier than normal, not wetter
La Nina only affects the Atlantic Ocean and never reaches the Philippines
La Nina is too weak to affect weather and only matters to scientists
explanation: La Nina is not one storm but an ocean and climate pattern that can last many months or more than a year, unlike a typhoon that strikes in a single day.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na ang La Nina ay isang malakas na bagyo, pero hindi. Ito ay isang kondisyon ng karagatan at klima na tumatagal ng maraming buwan, minsan higit sa isang taon. Hindi ito tumatama sa isang araw lang gaya ng bagyo.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang La Nina usa ka kusog nga bagyo, apan dili. Kini usa ka kondisyon sa dagat ug klima nga molungtad og daghang bulan, usahay sobra sa usa ka tuig. Dili kini moigo sa usa lang ka adlaw sama sa bagyo.

q: Which river's hydroelectric plants supply a large share of Mindanao's electricity?
options: Agus River, which flows out of Lake Lanao
Cagayan River, which flows through the Cagayan Valley
Pasig River, which connects Laguna de Bay to Manila Bay
Cotabato River, which drains the Liguasan Marsh
explanation: The hydroelectric plants along the Agus River, which flows out of Lake Lanao, have long supplied a large share of Mindanao's electricity.
fact_tl: Ang mga hydroelectric plant sa Agus River, na umaagos mula sa Lake Lanao, ay matagal na nagbibigay ng malaking bahagi ng kuryente para sa Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang mga hydroelectric plant sa Agus River, nga modagan gikan sa Lake Lanao, dugay na nga naghatag og dakong bahin sa kuryente sa Mindanao.

q: After whom is the kelvin (K), the unit of temperature, named?
options: Lord Kelvin (William Thomson)
Kelvin Fahrenheit
James Kelvin Maxwell
Lord Kelvin Darwin
explanation: The kelvin unit of temperature is named after Lord Kelvin, whose real name was William Thomson.
fact_tl: Ang kelvin (K), ang yunit ng temperatura, ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson).
fact_bis: Ang kelvin (K), ang yunit sa temperatura, ginganlan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson).

q: Who discovered that an electric current produces magnetism?
options: Hans Christian Oersted, who noticed a compass needle moved near a wire
James Watt, who saw a magnet spin when touched to a battery
Michael Faraday, who built the first electric lamp using magnets
Isaac Newton, who found that electricity and gravity are the same force
explanation: Hans Christian Oersted discovered that electric current makes magnetism when he observed a compass needle deflecting near a current-carrying wire.
fact_tl: Si Hans Christian Oersted ang nakakita na ang dumadaloy na kuryente ay gumagawa ng magnetismo, dahil gumalaw ang karayom ng kompas.
fact_bis: Si Hans Christian Oersted ang nakakita nga ang nagdagayday nga kuryente makahimo ug magnetismo, kay milihok ang karayom sa kompas.

q: What does PAGASA do with information about ENSO?
options: It issues seasonal climate outlooks to tell farmers and fishermen whether to expect drought or extra rain
It uses ENSO data to predict exactly when and where typhoons will land
It turns off weather satellites when ENSO is active to protect them from storms
It sends ships to the Pacific Ocean to change ocean temperatures and stop ENSO
explanation: PAGASA monitors ENSO and issues seasonal climate outlooks so farmers and fishermen know whether to expect drought or above-normal rainfall.
fact_tl: Binabantayan ng PAGASA ang ENSO at nag-iisyu ng seasonal climate outlook na nagbibigay ng impormasyon sa mga magsasaka at mangingisda kung aasahan ang tagtuyot o mas maraming ulan.
fact_bis: Ginimonitor sa PAGASA ang ENSO ug nagpagawas sa seasonal climate outlook nga nagpahibalo sa mga mag-uuma ug mananagat kung magpaabot ba og hulaw o labaw-normal nga ulan.

q: How long can an electric eel grow?
options: More than two meters long
About 30 centimeters long
Up to half a meter long
About one meter long
explanation: An electric eel can grow more than two meters long, making it one of the largest electric fish in rivers.
fact_tl: Ang electric eel ay maaaring umabot ng higit sa dalawang metrong haba, kaya isa ito sa pinakamalalaking isda sa ilog na may kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang electric eel makaabot og kapin sa duha ka metro ang gitas-on, busa usa kini sa kinadak-ang isda nga adunay kuryente sa suba.

q: What gas do aquatic plants like seagrass release into the water that fish need?
options: Dissolved oxygen
Dissolved carbon dioxide
Dissolved nitrogen
Dissolved hydrogen
explanation: Aquatic plants use dissolved carbon dioxide for photosynthesis and release dissolved oxygen into the water, which fish and other aquatic animals need to breathe.
fact_tl: Ang mga halamang-tubig tulad ng seagrass ay gumagamit ng carbon dioxide na natunaw sa tubig para sa photosynthesis. Nagpapalabas din sila ng oxygen na natunaw sa tubig na kinakailangan ng mga isda at iba pang hayop sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga halamang-tubig sama sa seagrass naggamit sa carbon dioxide nga natunaw sa tubig alang sa photosynthesis. Nagpalabas usab sila og dissolved oxygen ngadto sa tubig nga kinahanglan sa mga isda ug ubang mga hayop sa tubig.

q: What happens to the atoms in matter when living things die and decay?
options: They are reused over and over again by nature because Earth's matter is almost never lost
They float into space and are replaced by new matter from asteroids
They turn into a different kind of atom that plants and animals cannot use
They all sink to the ocean floor and are locked away permanently
explanation: In nature the same atoms are recycled over and over — Earth's total amount of matter stays almost constant because none of it is lost.
fact_tl: Sa kalikasan, ginagamit muli ang parehong mga atomo nang paulit-ulit — ang masa ng mundo ay halos hindi nagbabago dahil hindi ito nawawala.
fact_bis: Sa kinaiyahan, ang samang mga atomo gigamit balik-balik — ang masa sa kalibutan halos dili mausab kay walay mawala niini.

q: Which scientist explained the law of gravity?
options: Isaac Newton
Albert Einstein
Galileo Galilei
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Isaac Newton explained the law of gravitation, describing how objects attract each other with a gravitational force.
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ang nagpaliwanag ng batas ng grabidad (gravitation).
fact_bis: Si Isaac Newton ang nagpasabot sa balaod sa grabidad (gravitation).

q: In which city is the Panagbenga festival held?
options: Baguio City
Cebu City
Davao City
Zamboanga City
explanation: The Panagbenga festival is held in Baguio City.
fact_tl: Ang Panagbenga ay ipinagdiriwang sa Baguio City.
fact_bis: Ang Panagbenga gisaulog sa Baguio City.

q: Why can tides be predicted ahead of time?
options: Because the Moon's motion is regular and predictable, so PAGASA can make tide tables
Because the ocean level only depends on rainfall, which weather computers can forecast
Because underwater sensors measure the tide and radio the data to shore each hour
Because the Earth's spin is perfectly constant and that alone controls tides
explanation: Tides can be predicted because the Moon's motion follows a regular pattern, which allows PAGASA to publish tide tables showing when the sea will rise or fall.
fact_tl: Mahuhulaan ang tides nang maaga dahil regular ang galaw ng buwan, kaya gumagawa ang PAGASA ng tide table na nagsasabi kung anong oras tataas o bababa ang dagat — malaking tulong ito sa mga mangingisda at barko.
fact_bis: Matagna ang tides daan tungod kay regular ang lihok sa bulan, mao nga ang PAGASA mohimo og tide table nga nagsulti kung unsang orasa mosaka o mokunhod ang dagat — dako kini'g tabang sa mga mananagat ug barko.

q: Why are shellfish an important link in the ocean food chain?
options: They filter tiny plankton and turn it into bigger food that fish, birds, and people can eat
They produce the oxygen that all other sea creatures need to breathe underwater
They build coral reefs that shelter thousands of species of fish
They clean the water by absorbing pollution so other animals stay healthy
explanation: Shellfish filter extremely tiny plankton and convert it into food that larger animals such as fish, birds, and people can eat, making them a vital link in the food chain.
fact_tl: Ang kabibe ay mahalagang kawing sa kadena ng pagkain: kinukuha nito ang napakaliit na plankton at ginagawa itong mas malaking pagkain para sa mga isda, ibon, at tao na kumakain ng kabibe.
fact_bis: Ang kabibe usa ka importanteng kawing sa kadena sa pagkaon: mokuha kini sa gagmay kaayong plankton ug himoon kining mas dakong pagkaon alang sa mga isda, langgam, ug tawo nga mokaon og kabibe.

q: Why does your house have a circuit breaker or fuse?
options: To cut off the flow of electricity if too much current passes through the wires and causes overheating
To store extra electricity during the night so you save money during the day
To prevent lightning from entering the house through the power lines
To measure how much electricity your family uses every month
explanation: Too much current overheats wires and can start a fire, so homes have breakers or fuses that cut off the electrical flow when current gets too high.
fact_tl: Bakit delikado ang sobrang current? Kapag masyadong maraming current ang dumaan sa wire, sobra itong umiinit at pwedeng magdulot ng sunog. Kaya may breaker o fuse sa bahay — pinuputol nito ang daloy kapag sumosobra para hindi mapahamak.
fact_bis: Ngano delikado ang sobrang current? Kung sobra ka daghan ang current nga moagi sa wire, mosobra kini og init ug mahimong hinungdan sa sunog. Mao nga adunay breaker o fuse sa balay — giputol niini ang agos kung mosobra aron luwas ang tanan.

q: What would happen to Saturn if you could place it in a giant container of water?
options: It would float, because Saturn's average density is less than water
It would sink immediately because it is much heavier than water
It would dissolve because Saturn is made mostly of gases that mix with water
It would explode because its gases would react with the water
explanation: Saturn is the only planet in the solar system with an average density less than water, so it would actually float in a large enough body of water.
fact_tl: Ang Saturn ang tanging planeta sa solar system na may average density na mas mababa kaysa sa tubig; kung may sapat na malaking lalagyan ng tubig, ang Saturn ay lulutang doon.
fact_bis: Ang Saturn mao lamang ang planeta sa solar system nga adunay average density nga mas ubos kaysa sa tubig; kung adunay igo nga dakong sudlanan sa tubig, ang Saturn molutaw didto.

q: What does a kingfisher do with fish bones that it cannot digest?
options: It coughs them up as a small pellet after eating
It stores them in its nest to use as a skeleton for the nest structure
It pushes them out through its feathers like tiny needles
It grinds them into powder using a special part of its stomach
explanation: After eating, a kingfisher coughs up the undigested fish bones as a small compact pellet.
fact_tl: Matapos kumain, iniluluwa ng kingfisher ang hindi natunaw na mga tinik at buto ng isda bilang maliit na bukol.
fact_bis: Human mokaon, ang kingfisher mosuka sa wala matunaw nga tinik ug bukog sa isda isip gamay nga buol.

q: Why do leaves look green to us?
options: Because chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light for energy but reflects green light back to our eyes
Because the water inside leaf cells filters out all colors except green
Because sunlight is mostly green and leaves simply show the color of sunlight
Because the green pigment is the strongest pigment and it covers all other colors
explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light to power photosynthesis but reflects green light, which is why leaves appear green.
fact_tl: Ang chlorophyll ang molekulang nanghuhuli ng liwanag sa photosynthesis. Sinisipsip nito ang pulang at asul na liwanag para gamitin ang enerhiya, pero ibinabalik (reflects) nito ang berdeng liwanag — kaya berde ang dahon na nakikita mo.
fact_bis: Ang chlorophyll mao ang molekula nga nagdakop og kahayag sa photosynthesis. Gisipsip niini ang pula ug asul nga kahayag aron gamiton ang enerhiya, apan gibalik (reflects) niini ang berde nga kahayag — mao nga berde ang dahon nga imong makita.

q: How does a rainbow form?
options: Sunlight refracts and splits into colors inside raindrops
Sunlight bounces off flat clouds and breaks apart into colors
The sun's heat makes water vapor glow in different colors
Colorful gases rise from the ground after rain and form an arc
explanation: A rainbow forms when sunlight enters raindrops, refracts, and splits into its different colors before reaching our eyes.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag ang liwanag ng araw ay lumiliko at nahahati sa loob ng mga patak ng ulan.
fact_bis: Maporma ang balangaw kon ang kahayag sa adlaw mobawog ug mabahin sa sulod sa mga tulo sa ulan.

q: What is Tubbataha?
options: A marine park that protects coral reefs and thousands of fish
A mountain range in Palawan known for its ancient cave paintings
A river system in Mindanao that floods during the rainy season
A volcanic island near Batangas that is a popular diving site
explanation: Tubbataha is a marine park in the Philippines that protects coral reefs and the thousands of fish species that live there.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha ay isang marine park na pinoprotektahan ang mga bahura ng korales at libo-libong isda.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha usa ka marine park nga nagpanalipod sa mga bahura sa korales ug libo-libong isda.

q: Why is nitrogen never used up in nature?
options: Because it is recycled again and again through the nitrogen cycle
Because plants lock nitrogen inside their roots and never release it
Because nitrogen comes from the sun in unlimited amounts every day
Because animals breathe out nitrogen which turns back into fertilizer instantly
explanation: Nitrogen is never used up because it moves through the nitrogen cycle repeatedly, being recycled again and again among the air, soil, plants, and animals.
fact_tl: Hindi nauubos ang nitroheno sa kalikasan dahil paulit-ulit itong ginagamit sa pamamagitan ng siklo nito.
fact_bis: Dili gyud mahurot ang nitrogen sa kinaiyahan kay balik-balik kini gamiton pinaagi sa iyang siklo.

q: Why can't the tandikan (Palawan peacock-pheasant) simply move to a different island if its forest is destroyed?
options: Because it is adapted to Palawan's special forest and has nowhere else to go
Because its wings are too small for it to fly over the ocean to another island
Because other islands already have too many birds that compete for the same food
Because it is afraid of the ocean and will not cross open water
explanation: The tandikan is specifically adapted to Palawan's unique forest environment, so if that forest is destroyed it has no suitable habitat on any other island.
fact_tl: Hindi basta-basta makakalipat sa ibang isla ang tandikan dahil nasanay na ito sa natatanging gubat ng Palawan — kaya kapag nasira ang gubat na iyon, wala na itong ibang matatakbuhan.
fact_bis: Dili basta makabalhin sa laing isla ang tandikan kay naanad na kini sa talagsaon nga lasang sa Palawan — maong kung maguba kana nga lasang, wala na kini laing kadangpan.

q: What is the hardest natural material, and what element is it made of?
options: Diamond, made of pure carbon
Gold, made of compressed metallic ore
Granite, made of compressed quartz and feldspar
Steel, made of purified iron and carbon alloy
explanation: Diamond is the hardest natural material and is made entirely of pure carbon atoms arranged in a very strong crystal structure.
fact_tl: Ang diyamante ang pinakamatigas na likas na materyal, at ito ay gawa sa purong karbon.
fact_bis: Ang diyamante mao ang pinakagahi nga natural nga materyal, ug kini hinimo gikan sa lunsay nga carbon.

q: How many seeds does a mango fruit have?
options: One big seed inside
Many small seeds scattered throughout
Two seeds side by side in the center
No seeds — it grows from a cutting
explanation: A mango has one large seed inside it.
fact_tl: Ang mangga ay may iisang malaking buto sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang mangga adunay usa ka dako nga liso sa sulod niini.

q: Which special ability do sugarcane and corn share that helps them grow well in the hot, bright climate of the Philippines?
options: They use a more efficient C4 photosynthesis pathway
They store extra water in thick underground roots
They grow only at night to avoid the strong sun
They absorb nutrients directly from rainwater through their leaves
explanation: Sugarcane and corn are C4 plants with a special photosynthesis pathway that works more efficiently in hot, bright conditions like the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang tubo at mais ay C4 plants na may espesyal na paraan ng photosynthesis na mas epektibo sa mainit at maliwanag na klima ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang tubo ug mais mga C4 plants nga adunay espesyal nga photosynthesis nga mas epektibo sa init ug maliwanag nga klima sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the OL trap designed to do to the dengue mosquito?
options: Lure the female mosquito to lay eggs, then kill those eggs
Attract male mosquitoes with sound and trap them in sticky glue
Release a chemical that stops mosquitoes from biting people
Block mosquito entry into homes using a special filter
explanation: The OL trap lures the female dengue-carrying mosquito to lay eggs, then kills those eggs before they can hatch.
fact_tl: Inaakit ng OL trap ang babaeng lamok na nagdadala ng dengue para mangitlog at mamatay ang mga itlog nito.
fact_bis: Gidani sa OL trap ang bayeng lamok nga nagdala og dengue aron mangitlog, dayon patyon ang maong mga itlog.

q: Inside a thundercloud, where does the negative electric charge collect?
options: At the bottom of the cloud because heavier negative charges sink down
At the top of the cloud because warm air carries it upward
Evenly spread throughout the whole cloud
Along the edges of the cloud where wind is strongest
explanation: Inside a thundercloud, rubbing between ice and water particles causes heavier negative charges to sink to the bottom while lighter positive charges rise to the top.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng makapal na ulap-kulog, nagtutunggalian ang maliliit na piraso ng yelo at tubig. Ang mga ito'y nagkukuskusan kaya naghihiwalay ang positibo at negatibong singil: ang magaan na positibo ay paitaas, ang mabigat na negatibo ay pababa. Kapag napakalakas na ng pagkakaiba ng singil, sumasabog ito bilang kidlat.
fact_bis: Sulod sa baga nga panganod sa dalugdog, magbangga ug magkuskos ang gagmay nga tipik sa yelo ug tubig. Kini nga pagkuskos magbulag sa positibo ug negatibo nga charge: ang gaan nga positibo motungas, ang bug-at nga negatibo molugsong. Kon kusog na kaayo ang kalainan, mobuto kini isip kilat.

q: How is a crab's eye different from a human eye?
options: A crab's eye is made of many tiny lenses joined together, not a single lens
A crab's eye has only one tiny lens that spins in a circle
A crab's eye can see in total darkness but not in bright light
A crab's eye is flat and can only look straight ahead
explanation: A crab has compound eyes made of very many tiny lenses joined together, so they see a mosaic-like picture made of many small pieces.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng alimango ay tinatawag na compound eye. Ibig sabihin, hindi ito iisang lente lang gaya ng mata natin, kundi binubuo ito ng napakaraming maliliit na lente na pinagsama-sama. Kaya parang mosaic o pinagdikit-dikit na maliliit na larawan ang nakikita nila.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa alimango gitawag og compound eye. Dili kini usa ka lente lang sama sa atong mata, kondili gilangkoban kini sa daghan kaayong gagmay nga lente nga gitapok. Mao nga sama sa mosaic o gisumpay-sumpay nga gagmay nga hulagway ang ilang makita.

q: Where does the Philippine Eagle build its nest?
options: High up in tall forest trees using big sticks
In burrows it digs into cliffs along the coast
In low bushes near rivers where fish are plentiful
On the ground among large boulders in open grasslands
explanation: The Philippine Eagle builds a very large nest of big sticks high up in tall forest trees.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Eagle ay gumagawa ng napakalaking pugad mula sa malalaking sanga sa itaas ng matataas na puno sa gubat.
fact_bis: Ang agila sa Pilipinas naghimo ug dako kaayong salag gikan sa dagkong sanga sa taas sa habog nga mga kahoy sa lasang.

q: How tall can talahib, the wild grass, grow?
options: Taller than a person
About as tall as a knee
Only a few centimeters high
About as tall as a small bush
explanation: Talahib is a very tall wild grass that can grow even higher than a person.
fact_tl: Ang talahib ay isang napakatangkad na ligaw na damo na maaaring lumampas pa sa tao ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang talahib usa ka taas kaayo nga ihalas nga sagbot nga mahimong molabaw pa sa tawo ang gitas-on.

q: On which Philippine islands can the wild Visayan warty pig still be found today?
options: Negros and Panay
Palawan and Cebu
Leyte and Samar
Mindoro and Bohol
explanation: Today the wild Visayan warty pig is found only on the islands of Negros and Panay.
fact_tl: Ngayon, ang ligaw na Visayan warty pig ay matatagpuan na lamang sa mga isla ng Negros at Panay.
fact_bis: Karon, ang ihalas nga Visayan warty pig makita na lamang sa mga isla sa Negros ug Panay.

q: How do lichens get the water they need, since they have no roots?
options: They soak up water from the air, rain, and dew
They send thin threads deep into rock cracks to find groundwater
They collect water by trapping fog with tiny hairs on their surface
They absorb moisture directly through their green color-making cells
explanation: Lichens have no roots, so they soak up water from the air, rain, and dew.
fact_tl: Ang mga lichen ay walang ugat, kaya sumisipsip sila ng tubig mula sa hangin, ulan, at hamog.
fact_bis: Ang mga lichen walay gamot, busa mosuyop sila og tubig gikan sa hangin, ulan, ug yamog.

q: What is a keystone species?
options: A species so important that its disappearance dramatically changes the whole ecosystem
A species that lives only at the very top of the food chain and eats everything
A species that produces the most oxygen in an ecosystem
A species that can survive in any ecosystem, no matter how it changes
explanation: A keystone species is one so important that if it disappears the whole ecosystem changes dramatically, like sharks in the ocean.
fact_tl: Ang keystone species ay isang species na napakahalaga kaya kung mawala ito, malaki ang magbabago sa buong ecosystem, tulad ng pating sa karagatan.
fact_bis: Ang keystone species mao ang usa ka species nga importante kaayo mao nga kung mawala kini, dako ang mabag-o sa tibuok ecosystem, sama sa iho sa dagat.

q: Why do some comets appear to have two different tails when near the Sun?
options: Gas and dust are pushed in different ways, making a straight blue gas tail and a curved bright dust tail
The comet splits apart near the Sun, with each piece making its own tail
One tail is from the comet itself and the other is its shadow cast by sunlight
The two tails appear at different times of day depending on where the comet is
explanation: Some comets show two tails because gas and dust are pushed differently by the Sun, creating a straighter pale-blue gas tail and a slightly curved, brighter dust tail.
fact_tl: Ang ilang kometa ay nagpapakita ng dalawang buntot kapag malapit sa Araw: isang buntot ng gas na karaniwang mas tuwid at maputlang asul, at isang buntot ng alikabok na bahagyang nakakurba at mas maliwanag. Iba ang anyo nila dahil iba ang itinutulak sa gas at sa alikabok.
fact_bis: Ang ubang kometa magpakita og duha ka ikog kung duol sa Adlaw: usa ka ikog sa gas nga sagad mas tul-id ug maluspad nga asul, ug usa ka ikog sa abog nga gamay nga kurbado ug mas masanag. Lahi ang ilang hitsura kay lahi ang pagtulod sa gas ug sa abog.

q: How many provinces make up the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM)?
options: 5 provinces
3 provinces
7 provinces
9 provinces
explanation: BARMM is made up of 5 provinces: Basilan, Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao del Norte, Maguindanao del Sur, and Tawi-Tawi.
fact_tl: Ang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) ay isa sa 18 rehiyon ng Pilipinas, matatagpuan sa Mindanao. Binubuo ito ng 5 na lalawigan: Basilan, Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao del Norte, Maguindanao del Sur, Tawi-Tawi. Ang sentrong rehiyonal nito ay Cotabato City.
fact_bis: Ang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) usa sa 18 ka rehiyon sa Pilipinas, nahimutang sa Mindanao. Gilangkoban kini sa 5 ka probinsya: Basilan, Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao del Norte, Maguindanao del Sur, Tawi-Tawi. Ang sentro nga rehiyonal niini mao ang Cotabato City.

q: Why are asthma and allergies often connected in children?
options: In many children, asthma is triggered when the body overreacts to harmless things like pollen or dust
Asthma causes allergies by weakening the skin barrier so dust enters the body
Allergies are just a milder form of asthma and always develop into it
Children with asthma produce too many red blood cells, which react to allergens
explanation: In many children asthma is linked to allergies, where the body's defense system overreacts to harmless things like pollen or dust.
fact_tl: Sa maraming bata, ang hika ay konektado sa alerdyi, kung saan ang sistemang panlaban ng katawan ay sobrang reaksiyon sa hindi naman nakakapinsalang bagay tulad ng pollen o alikabok.
fact_bis: Sa daghang bata, ang hubak konektado sa alerdyi, diin ang sistema sa depensa sa lawas sobra og reaksiyon sa dili makadaot nga mga butang sama sa pollen o abog.

q: How can a small, light object have as much momentum as a large, heavy object?
options: If the small object moves very fast, its speed makes up for its low mass
If the small object is made of a denser material than the large object
If the small object is pushed by a stronger force at the same time
If the small object travels a longer distance before stopping
explanation: A light but very fast object can have just as much momentum as a heavy but slow object — a small bullet has large momentum because it is extremely fast.
fact_tl: Ang isang magaan pero napakabilis na bagay ay pwedeng magkaroon ng kasing-laki ng momentum ng isang mabigat pero mabagal na bagay. Halimbawa, ang maliit na bala ay may malaking momentum dahil sobrang bilis nito kahit magaan lang.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka gaan apan paspas kaayo nga butang mahimong adunay sama kadako nga momentum sa usa ka bug-at apan hinay nga butang. Pananglitan, ang gamay nga bala adunay dakong momentum tungod kay paspas kaayo kini bisan gaan lang.

q: What is the correct order of levels in a food pyramid, from bottom to top?
options: Producers, then primary consumers that eat plants, then predators that eat animals
Predators at the bottom, then plant-eaters, then producers at the top
Primary consumers at the bottom, then producers, then top predators
Decomposers at the bottom, then producers, then all animals together at the top
explanation: The pyramid levels go in order: producers at the base, then primary consumers that eat plants, then predators that eat animals at the top.
fact_tl: Ang mga antas ng pyramid ay sunod-sunod: producer, primary consumer na kumakain ng halaman, at saka mga mandaragit na kumakain ng hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga lebel sa pyramid nagsunod: producer, primary consumer nga mokaon og tanom, ug dayon manunukob nga mokaon og hayop.

q: Why does water roll right off a lotus leaf without wetting it?
options: The leaf has special microscopic structures that make water bead up and roll away instantly
The leaf is covered in a thick oily wax layer that people can see with the naked eye
The leaf surface is so smooth that water cannot grip it at all
The leaf releases a chemical that repels water before drops can land
explanation: Lotus leaves have special microscopic structures that make water bead and roll off instantly — a property called superhydrophobicity or the lotus effect.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng lotus ay may espesyal na microscopic na istraktura na nagpapadulas ng tubig—tinatawag itong lotus effect o superhydrophobicity; ginaya ng mga siyentipiko ang katangiang ito para gumawa ng self-cleaning surfaces.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa lotus adunay espesyal nga microscopic nga istraktura nga nagpapadulas sa tubig—gitawag kini og lotus effect o superhydrophobicity; giimitahan kini sa mga siyentipiko aron makahimo og self-cleaning surfaces.

q: What pattern does the shell of a sea urchin show when its spines are removed?
options: A pattern divided into five parts, like a flower or a star
A spiral pattern that winds from the top to the bottom
A pattern of six equal sections like a honeycomb
A completely smooth and round surface with no visible pattern
explanation: When a sea urchin's spines are removed, its round shell reveals a pattern divided into five parts, like a flower or a star.
fact_tl: Kapag tinanggal ang mga tinik ng tihik, makikita sa bilog nitong balat-bato ang disenyong nahahati sa limang bahagi, na tulad ng bulaklak o bituin.
fact_bis: Kung tangtangon ang mga tunok sa tihik, makita sa lingin niini nga bagol ang disenyo nga gibahin sa lima ka bahin, sama sa bulak o bituon.

q: Which tree produces most of the world's natural rubber?
options: The Hevea brasiliensis, also called the Para rubber tree
The Ficus elastica, also called the India rubber tree
The Parthenium argentatum, also called the guayule plant
The Manihot glaziovii, also called the Ceará rubber tree
explanation: Most of the world's natural rubber comes from the Hevea brasiliensis, or Para rubber tree.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng natural na goma sa mundo ay galing sa punong Hevea brasiliensis o Para rubber tree.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa natural nga goma sa kalibutan gikan sa kahoy nga Hevea brasiliensis o Para rubber tree.

q: What is unusual about how a mangrove seed begins its life?
options: It starts sprouting while still attached to the parent tree, so it is ready to root as soon as it drops
It is released into the water as a tiny seedling with no seed coat left around it
It must dry out completely on the shore before it can absorb water and begin to grow
It floats in the ocean for years before it is mature enough to sprout
explanation: Unlike most plants, a mangrove seed begins sprouting while still attached to the parent tree, so when it finally drops it is ready to root quickly in the salty mud.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng karaniwang halaman, ang binhi ng bakawan ay nagsisimulang tumubo habang nakakabit pa sa puno, kaya kapag bumagsak na ito ay handa nang mag-ugat agad sa maalat na putik.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa kasagarang tanom, ang liso sa bakhaw magsugod na og tubo samtang nakabitay pa sa kahoy, busa kon mahulog na kini andam na kining mogamot dayon sa parat nga lapok.

q: What does a woodpecker do before it drills into wood to find insects?
options: It taps lightly and listens to the sound to tell if insects are hiding inside
It smells the bark to detect the chemicals insects leave behind
It pecks a small test hole and waits to see if insects come out
It watches for movement under the bark before starting to drill
explanation: A woodpecker first taps lightly and listens to the sound to tell if insects are hidden inside the wood.
fact_tl: Kumakatok muna nang mahina ang woodpecker para makinig sa tunog at malaman kung may insekto sa loob ng kahoy.
fact_bis: Ang woodpecker motuktok una ug hinay ug mamati sa tingog aron mahibal-an kung adunay insekto sulod sa kahoy.

q: What is the main cause of coral bleaching?
options: Sea water that becomes too warm
Pollution from plastic and oil spills
Too little sunlight reaching the reef
Strong ocean currents that break off coral branches
explanation: The main cause of coral bleaching is sea water that becomes too warm, stressing the coral and causing it to expel its colorful algae.
fact_tl: Ang pangunahing sanhi ng coral bleaching ay ang sobrang init ng tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang nag-unang hinungdan sa coral bleaching mao ang sobra ka init nga tubig-dagat.

q: Why is the pangolin sometimes called the 'scaly anteater'?
options: Because it eats ants and termites
Because its scales look like ant wings
Because it lives inside termite mounds
Because its tongue is shaped like an ant
explanation: The pangolin eats ants and termites, which is why it is called the scaly anteater.
fact_tl: Ang balintong ay kumakain ng mga langgam at anay, kaya tinatawag itong scaly anteater o kaliskis na kumakain ng langgam.
fact_bis: Ang balintong mokaon ug mga hulmigas ug anay, mao nga gitawag kini nga scaly anteater o himbis nga mokaon ug hulmigas.

q: What effect does chewing betel have on the body?
options: It acts as a mild stimulant, making a person feel slightly more awake and warm
It causes a person to feel very sleepy and relaxed, like a sedative
It numbs the mouth and tongue completely for several hours
It lowers the heart rate and makes the body feel cooler
explanation: Betel is a mild stimulant, so chewing it makes people feel slightly more awake and a bit of warmth, somewhat like coffee's effect on adults.
fact_tl: Kapag ngumunguya ng nganga, nararamdaman ng tao ang bahagyang pagkagising at init sa katawan dahil ito ay isang mahinang stimulant, parang epekto ng kape sa matatanda.
fact_bis: Kon magnganga ang tawo, mobati siyag gamayng pagmata ug kainit sa lawas tungod kay kini usa ka huyang nga stimulant, susama sa epekto sa kape sa mga hamtong.

q: Which color of visible light has the shortest wavelength?
options: Violet
Blue
Red
Green
explanation: Among the colors of visible light, violet has the shortest wavelength.
fact_tl: Sa mga kulay ng visible light, ang lila ang may pinakamaikling wavelength.
fact_bis: Sa mga kolor sa visible light, ang violet ang adunay pinakamubo nga wavelength.

q: Why does a thick blanket keep you warm even though it does not produce any heat?
options: It traps air, which is a poor heat conductor that slows the escape of your body's heat
It reflects your body heat back toward you using its fluffy fibers
It absorbs cold air from outside so none of it reaches your body
It produces a small amount of heat through the friction of its fibers rubbing together
explanation: Trapped air is a good insulator because it conducts heat very slowly, so a thick blanket keeps us warm by slowing the escape of our own body heat.
fact_tl: Mahusay na insulator ang nakukulong na hangin dahil mabagal itong magpadaloy ng init. Kaya pinapainit tayo ng makapal na kumot — hindi ito nagbibigay ng init kundi pinipigilan lang ang pagtakas ng init ng katawan natin.
fact_bis: Ang nakubkob nga hangin maayong insulator kay hinay kaayo kining magpadala og init. Mao nga mopainit kanato ang baga nga habol — dili kini mohatag og init, gibabagan lang niini ang pag-ikyas sa init sa atong lawas.

q: Why does warm air rise upward?
options: Heating makes air expand and become lighter, so it floats up
Warm air is pulled upward by the sun's gravity during the day
Warm air contains more oxygen molecules that push it higher
Heating speeds up air molecules so they collide into the ceiling and rise
explanation: When air is heated it expands and becomes lighter (less dense), so warm air rises upward.
fact_tl: Kapag uminit ang hangin, lumalawak ito at gumagaan, kaya umaakyat ang mainit na hangin paitaas.
fact_bis: Kon moinit ang hangin, molapad kini ug mogaan, mao nga mosaka ang init nga hangin paingon sa taas.

q: What do you do to a shopping cart to make it start moving?
options: Push it
Heat it up
Tilt it sideways
Spin its wheels by hand
explanation: We push a cart or a swing to make it start moving — a push is the force that starts the motion.
fact_tl: Tinutulak natin ang kariton o duyan para magsimula itong gumalaw.
fact_bis: Atong giduso ang karwahe o duyan aron magsugod kini og lihok.

q: Where does the energy in your body's movement originally come from, if you trace it all the way back?
options: The sun, because food plants get their energy from sunlight
The center of the Earth, which sends heat energy upward through the soil
The oxygen you breathe, which releases energy when it enters your lungs
The water you drink, which carries electrical energy from rivers
explanation: Every energy chain leads back to its source — the energy in your movement comes from food, which in turn came from the sun's energy through photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Maaaring tunton ang bawat anyo ng enerhiya pabalik sa pinagmulan nito sa pamamagitan ng serye ng mga transpormasyon — halimbawa, ang enerhiya sa iyong pagkilos ay galing sa pagkain, na galing naman sa enerhiya ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang matag porma sa enerhiya matultolan balik sa gigikanan niini pinaagi sa sunod-sunod nga mga transpormasyon — pananglitan, ang enerhiya sa imong paglihok gikan sa pagkaon, nga gikan usab sa enerhiya sa adlaw.

q: How does scabies spread from person to person?
options: Through long skin-to-skin contact with an infected person
Through sharing food or drinks with an infected person
Through breathing the same air as an infected person
Through touching surfaces that an infected person has touched briefly
explanation: Scabies spreads through long skin-to-skin contact, so people living together can easily catch it from each other.
fact_tl: Ang scabies ay kumakalat sa pamamagitan ng matagal na dikit ng balat sa balat, kaya madaling mahawa ang magkakasama sa bahay.
fact_bis: Ang scabies mokatap pinaagi sa dugay nga dikit sa panit ngadto sa panit, mao nga sayon matakdan ang nagpuyo sa usa ka balay.

q: What kind of beak does an insect-eating bird usually have?
options: A thin, pointed beak for picking up tiny animals
A wide, flat beak for scooping insects out of water
A thick, strong beak for cracking open insect shells
A curved, hooked beak for tearing insects apart
explanation: Insect-eating birds often have thin, pointed beaks that work like tweezers for picking up tiny animals.
fact_tl: Ang mga ibong kumakain ng insekto ay kadalasang may manipis at matulis na tuka para dampot ang maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga mokaon ug insekto kasagaran adunay nipis ug talinis nga sungo aron pagkuha sa gagmay nga mananap.

q: How many baby teeth (milk teeth) do young children have in total?
explanation: Young children have 20 first teeth called baby teeth or milk teeth.
fact_tl: Ang mga bata ay may 20 unang ngipin na tinatawag na gatas na ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bata adunay 20 ka unang ngipon nga gitawag og gatas nga ngipon.

q: How does the pitch of a screw's thread affect its mechanical advantage?
options: A finer (closer) thread pitch gives a greater mechanical advantage
A coarser (wider) thread pitch gives a greater mechanical advantage
Thread pitch has no effect — only the size of the screw head matters
A finer pitch makes the screw weaker, reducing its mechanical advantage
explanation: The mechanical advantage of a screw equals the circumference of its head divided by the pitch of the thread, so a finer thread pitch gives a greater mechanical advantage.
fact_tl: Ang mechanical advantage ng tornilyo ay katumbas ng circumference ng ulo nito na hinati sa pitch ng thread. Mas maikli ang pitch, mas malaki ang MA.
fact_bis: Ang mechanical advantage sa tornilyo mao ang circumference sa ulo gipangbahin sa pitch sa thread — mas pino ang pitch, mas dako ang MA.

q: Which of the following is an example of a colloid?
options: Milk, where tiny particles are spread evenly and do not settle out
Salt water, where salt completely dissolves and cannot be seen
Sand in a jar, where the particles settle to the bottom over time
Oil and water in a bottle, where the two liquids separate into layers
explanation: A colloid like milk has very tiny particles spread evenly that do not settle — bigger than in a solution but too small to see individually.
fact_tl: Ang colloid ay timpla kung saan ang napakaliliit na piraso ay nakakalat nang pantay at hindi lumulubog — gaya ng gatas, gulaman, usok, at fog. Mas malaki ang piraso kaysa solusyon pero hindi nakikita nang isa-isa.
fact_bis: Ang colloid usa ka sagol diin ang gagmay kaayong piraso nagkatag nga patas ug dili molubog — sama sa gatas, gulaman, aso, ug gabon. Mas dako ang piraso kaysa solusyon apan dili gihapon makita tag-usa.

q: Why is it unsafe to take expired medicine?
options: It may lose its strength or even become harmful to the body
It always becomes poisonous and will definitely make you sick
Its color and smell change, making it impossible to swallow
The body cannot absorb it at all, so it has no effect whatsoever
explanation: Expired medicine may lose its strength or even become harmful to the body, so it should not be taken.
fact_tl: Ang gamot na paso na ay maaaring humina ang bisa o maging nakakasama sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang tambal nga expired na mahimong mahuyang ang bisa o makadaot pa sa lawas.

q: What happens to a mangrove seed after it falls from the tree in the Philippines?
options: It floats on water until it finds mud where it can take root
It sinks to the sea floor and stays there until a current moves it
It is carried by birds to drier land where it can grow
It dries out on the beach for several weeks before sprouting
explanation: Mangrove seeds in the Philippines start growing while still on the tree, then drop and float on water until they take root in mud.
fact_tl: Ang mga binhi ng bakawan sa Pilipinas ay tumutubo na habang nakakabit pa sa puno, pagkatapos ay bumabagsak at lumulutang sa tubig hanggang makakapit sa putik.
fact_bis: Ang mga liso sa bakhaw sa Pilipinas mosugod na pagtubo samtang nagsumpay pa sa kahoy, dayon mahulog ug molutaw sa tubig hangtod makagamot sa lapok.

q: What health problem can eating too much salt cause?
options: It can raise blood pressure and affect the heart
It can make your bones become brittle and break easily
It can cause your eyesight to weaken over time
It can reduce your body's ability to fight infections
explanation: Too much salt in food can raise blood pressure and affect the heart, so we should not over-salt our food.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang asin sa pagkain ay maaaring magtaas ng presyon ng dugo at makaapekto sa puso, kaya dapat hindi sobra ang inaasin.
fact_bis: Ang sobrang asin sa pagkaon makapataas sa presyon sa dugo ug makaapekto sa kasingkasing, mao nga dili angay sobra ang pag-asin.

q: When there is no soap available, what can still help remove germs from your hands?
options: Scrubbing with clean water, or using alcohol or hand sanitizer
Standing in the rain for several minutes to let water wash germs away
Wiping your hands firmly on a clean dry cloth or tissue
Blowing on your hands repeatedly to dry any germs off them
explanation: When there is no soap, water plus scrubbing still removes some germs, and alcohol or hand sanitizer can be used instead.
fact_tl: Kapag walang sabon, ang tubig at pagkuskos pa rin ay nakakatanggal ng ilang germ, at maaari ring gamitin ang alcohol o hand sanitizer. Sa ilang lugar na walang sabon, ginagamit ang malinis na abo at tubig para maalis ang langis at dumi.
fact_bis: Kung walay sabon, ang tubig ug pagkuskos makakuha gihapon og pipila ka germ, ug mahimo usab gamiton ang alcohol o hand sanitizer. Sa pipila ka lugar nga walay sabon, gigamit ang limpyo nga abo ug tubig aron matangtang ang lana ug hugaw.

q: How do narra seeds and dandelion seeds travel through the air to new places?
options: The narra seed has a wing to glide and the dandelion seed has feathery fluff to float down like a parachute
Both seeds dry out until they are so light they blow away with any breeze
Both seeds produce a gas bubble that makes them rise and drift on the wind
The narra seed spins like a helicopter blade while the dandelion seed rolls along the ground
explanation: Some seeds have special shapes to float on wind — the narra seed has a wing like an airplane and dandelion seeds have feathery fluff to parachute down.
fact_tl: Ang ilang mga buto ay may espesyal na hugis para makalutay sa hangin — ang buto ng narra ay may pakpak na katulad ng eroplano, habang ang buto ng dandelion ay may mahinhing balahibo para makapag-parachute.
fact_bis: Ang uban nga mga buto adunay espesyal nga porma aron makalangoy sa hangin — ang buto sa narra adunay pakpak sama sa eroplano samtang ang mga buto sa dandelion adunay malambuton nga balahibo aron makaparachute.

q: Why does cold air sink downward?
options: Cold air is denser because its particles move slower and pack closer together, making it heavier
Cold air is pulled down by a stronger gravitational force than warm air
Cold air contains more water vapor, which adds weight and pulls it down
Cold air loses its electric charge and is attracted toward the negatively charged ground
explanation: Cold air sinks because it is heavier (denser) — when cooled, particles move slower and contract so there are more particles in the same space.
fact_tl: Bumababa ang malamig na hangin dahil mas mabigat (denser) ito — kapag lumalamig, mas mabagal gumalaw ang mga particle at umuurong ang hangin, kaya mas marami ang particle sa parehong espasyo.
fact_bis: Mokunsad ang bugnaw nga hangin tungod kay mas bug-at (denser) kini — kung mobugnaw, mas hinay molihok ang mga particle ug mokunhod ang hangin, mao nga mas daghan ang particle sa parehong espasyo.

q: How do many cave fish survive where there is very little food?
options: They move slowly, save energy, store body fat, and can go long stretches without eating
They eat the minerals in cave rocks to get the nutrients they need
They hibernate for months at a time and only wake up when food appears
They grow a special organ that converts cave water directly into energy
explanation: Inside caves, food is very scarce, so many cave fish save energy, move slowly, store body fat, and can survive long stretches without eating.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng kweba, kakaunti lang ang pagkain. Kaya marami sa mga cave fish ay matipid sa enerhiya, mabagal kumilos, at kayang magtagal kahit matagal na walang makain. Iniimbak nila ang taba para may panustos sa gutom na panahon.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa langob, gamay ra kaayo ang pagkaon. Mao nga daghan sa mga cave fish matipid sa enerhiya, hinay molihok, ug makalahutay bisan dugay walay makaon. Magtipig sila og tambok sa lawas para naa silay magamit sa gutom nga panahon.

q: Which type of magnet can be switched on and off, and is used in scrapyard cranes and doorbells?
options: An electromagnet
A permanent magnet
A lodestone
A ferrite magnet
explanation: An electromagnet can be switched on and off — it is used in scrapyard cranes and doorbells, unlike a permanent magnet which is always magnetic.
fact_tl: Ang permanenteng magneto ay palaging may magnetismo at hindi maaaring i-off — ginagamit ito sa mga refrigerator door seal at earphone. Ang elektromagneto ay maaaring i-on at i-off — ginagamit ito sa mga scrapyard crane at doorbell.
fact_bis: Ang permanenteng magneto palagi adunay magnetismo ug dili mausab — gigamit sa mga refrigerator door seal ug earphone. Ang electromagneto mahimong i-on ug i-off — gigamit sa mga scrapyard crane ug doorbell.

q: What happens when you put a drop of dye in a glass of still water without stirring?
options: The color slowly spreads through all the water by diffusion
The dye sinks straight to the bottom and stays there
The dye forms a colored layer on top because it is lighter than water
The dye only spreads to the edges of the glass near the sides
explanation: When a drop of dye is placed in still water without stirring, the color slowly spreads through all the water by diffusion.
fact_tl: Kapag naglagay ka ng isang patak ng tina sa baso ng tubig at hindi mo ito hinalo, dahan-dahang kumakalat ang kulay sa buong tubig sa pamamagitan ng diffusion.
fact_bis: Kon magbutang ka og usa ka tulo nga tina sa baso nga tubig nga dili imong kutawon, hinay-hinay nga mikatag ang kolor sa tibuok tubig pinaagi sa diffusion.

q: How does a star produce the light and heat we see from Earth?
options: Hydrogen atoms in its extremely hot center fuse together to form helium, releasing a huge amount of energy
It burns like a giant fire, with oxygen from space feeding the flames continuously
Its surface is so hot from being compressed that it glows like a piece of metal in a forge
Gravity crushes the star so hard that the pressure itself shoots out light in all directions
explanation: A star makes its own light because in its extremely hot center, hydrogen atoms fuse to form helium, releasing a huge amount of energy as light and heat.
fact_tl: Ang bituin ay gumagawa ng sarili nitong liwanag sa loob nito. Sa napakainit na gitna ng bituin, ang maliliit na piraso ng hydrogen ay nagsasama-sama (fusion) at nagiging helium, at naglalabas ito ng napakaraming enerhiya. Ang enerhiyang iyon ang lumalabas bilang liwanag at init na nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Ang bituon mohimo sa iyang kaugalingong kahayag sulod niini. Sa init kaayo nga tunga sa bituon, ang gagmay nga piraso sa hydrogen maghiusa (fusion) ug mahimong helium, ug mopagawas kini og daghan kaayo nga enerhiya. Kana nga enerhiya mogawas isip kahayag ug kainit nga atong makita.

q: Where do wasps usually build their nests?
options: Under roofs, on tree branches, or in quiet corners
Deep underground where it is cool and dark
Inside hollow tree trunks submerged in water
At the very tops of tall trees where wind keeps predators away
