fact_tl: Binubuo ang Kongreso ng Pilipinas ng dalawang bahagi: ang Senado na may 24 na miyembro at ang Kapulungan ng mga Kinatawan na kumakatawan sa iba't ibang distrito.
fact_bis: Ang Kongreso sa Pilipinas binuhatan og duha ka bahin: ang Senado nga may 24 ka miyembro ug ang Kapulungan sa mga Kinatawan nga nagrepresenta sa lain-laing distrito.

q: What makes Type 2 diabetes different from other types?
options: The body still makes insulin but the cells stop responding to it well
The pancreas makes no insulin at all and stops working completely
The body makes too much insulin causing blood sugar to drop dangerously low
The immune system destroys all the insulin in the bloodstream
explanation: In Type 2 diabetes the body still produces insulin, but the body's cells no longer respond to it properly, making it the more common type.
fact_tl: Sa Type 2 diabetes, gumagawa pa ng insulin ang katawan pero hindi na ito gaanong tumutugon ang mga selula; ito ang mas karaniwang uri.
fact_bis: Sa Type 2 nga diabetes, naghimo pa og insulin ang lawas apan ang mga selula dili na motubag og maayo niini; kini ang mas komon nga klase.

q: Out of the 7,641 Philippine islands, how many still have no official name?
options: More than 5,000
Fewer than 500
About 2,000
About 3,500
explanation: Of the 7,641 Philippine islands, more than 5,000 still have no official name.
fact_tl: Sa 7,641 na isla ng Pilipinas, mahigit 5,000 ang wala pang opisyal na pangalan.
fact_bis: Sa 7,641 ka pulo sa Pilipinas, kapin sa 5,000 ang wala pa'y opisyal nga ngalan.

q: Why has burning fossil fuels and cutting forests upset the carbon cycle?
options: They release carbon faster than plants and oceans can absorb it
They remove carbon from the air faster than volcanoes can replace it
They destroy the oxygen needed for the carbon cycle to work
They block sunlight so plants cannot absorb carbon through photosynthesis
explanation: Burning fossil fuels and cutting forests releases carbon into the air faster than natural systems like plants and oceans can absorb it, disrupting the long-balanced carbon cycle.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng milyong taon, balanse ang carbon cycle. Ngunit ang pagsunog ng tao ng fossil fuels at pagputol ng gubat ay naglalabas ng carbon nang mas mabilis kaysa kayang sipsipin ng mga halaman at dagat.
fact_bis: Sulod sa milyon ka tuig, balanse ang carbon cycle. Apan ang pagsunog sa tawo og fossil fuels ug pagpang-utol sa kalasangan mobuhi og carbon nga mas paspas kaysa masuyop sa mga tanom ug kadagatan.

q: In what year did the Philippine Revolution against Spain begin?
explanation: The Philippine Revolution against Spain began in 1896.
fact_tl: Nagsimula ang Himagsikang Pilipino laban sa Espanya noong 1896.
fact_bis: Ang Rebolusyong Pilipino batok sa Espanya nagsugod niadtong 1896.

q: What is the purpose of the tall, arching stilt roots of a mangrove tree?
options: They hold the tree upright in the soft mud and resist the push of waves
They absorb sunlight to help the tree make more food
They filter salt out of the seawater before it reaches the leaves
They store fresh water for the tree to use during dry season
explanation: Mangroves have tall arching stilt roots that anchor the tree in soft, waterlogged mud and withstand the constant push of waves.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan ay may matataas na ugat na parang saha na humahawak sa puno para hindi ito matumba sa malambot na putik at sa palagiang hampas ng alon.
fact_bis: Ang bakhaw adunay tag-as nga gamot nga morag saha nga magkupot sa kahoy aron dili kini matumba sa humok nga lapok ug sa kanunay nga hampak sa balod.

q: What role do decomposers play in a compost pit?
options: They break down vegetable scraps and leaves into rich fertilizer
They add nutrients by producing their own food through photosynthesis
They keep harmful pests away from the organic material
They speed up the process by adding heat from sunlight
explanation: In a compost pit, decomposers break down vegetable scraps and leaves, turning them into rich fertilizer that plants can use.
fact_tl: Sa compost pit, binubulok ng mga decomposer ang mga tira ng gulay at dahon para gawing mayamang abono para sa halaman.
fact_bis: Sa compost pit, gibungkag sa mga decomposer ang mga tira sa utan ug mga dahon aron mahimong tabunok nga abono para sa tanom.

q: What causes a whistle to make its sharp sound when you blow it?
options: The air inside swirls and vibrates very fast
The metal or plastic of the whistle rattles loudly
The hard pea inside the whistle bounces back and forth
The force of the breath directly creates a sound wave
explanation: When you blow a whistle, the air inside swirls and vibrates very fast, and those vibrations produce the sharp sound.
fact_tl: Kapag hinihipan ang pito, mabilis na umiikot at nayayanig ang hanging nasa loob nito, at ang pag-yanig na ito ang gumagawa ng matinis na tunog.
fact_bis: Kon huypan ang pito, ang hangin sa sulod molibot ug mokurog ug paspas, ug kini nga pagkurog mao ang naghimo sa hait nga tingog.

q: How do indigenous Filipinos traditionally predict weather to plan their farming activities?
options: By observing animal behavior and changes in sky color
By measuring the temperature of the soil and river water
By counting the number of stars visible on clear nights
By tracking the direction and speed of ocean currents
explanation: Indigenous Filipinos read natural signs such as animal behavior and sky color changes to predict weather and decide when to plant or harvest.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga katutubong Pilipino ang mga tanda sa kalikasan — tulad ng kilos ng mga hayop at pagbabago ng kulay ng langit — upang hulaan ang panahon at planuhin ang pagtatanim.
fact_bis: Naggamit ang mga katutubo nga Pilipino og mga tanda sa kalikasan — sama sa kinaiya sa mga hayop ug pagbag-o sa kulay sa langit — aron panaghunahuna sa panahon ug planuhin ang pagtanim.

q: How is a tsunami different from an ordinary ocean wave?
options: Tsunami water can flood far inland onto the land
A tsunami wave is much shorter but hits the shore more frequently
Tsunamis only form in deep water and stop at the shoreline
A tsunami creates strong currents underwater but causes little flooding on land
explanation: Unlike ordinary waves that break at the shore, tsunami water can rush far inland, flooding large areas of land.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng karaniwang alon, ang tubig ng tsunami ay maaaring umapaw nang malayo papasok sa lupa.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa ordinaryong balod, ang tubig sa tsunami makabaha ug layo ngadto sa yuta.

q: How does the tetanus vaccine protect you from getting sick?
options: It teaches your body to fight the bacteria's poison before it can hurt you
It kills the tetanus bacteria living in rusty metal surfaces
It creates a hard coating on your skin that blocks bacteria from entering
It removes the poison from a wound immediately after you are injured
explanation: The tetanus vaccine teaches your immune system to recognize and fight the bacteria's toxin before it can cause harm.
fact_tl: May bakuna laban sa tetanus na nagtuturo sa katawan mo kung paano labanan ang lason ng bakterya bago pa ito makapanakit. Karamihan sa mga bata ay nabakunahan na noong sanggol pa sila, pero kailangan itong i-update paminsan-minsan.
fact_bis: Adunay bakuna batok sa tetanus nga nagtudlo sa imong lawas kung unsaon pagpakig-away sa hilo sa bakterya sa dili pa kini makasakit. Kadaghanan sa mga bata nabakunahan na sa pagkamasuso pa, apan kinahanglan kini i-update matag karon ug unsa.

q: What does a sea cucumber do to defend itself when it senses danger?
options: It can stiffen or shrink its body
It shoots ink into the water to confuse predators
It buries itself quickly in the sand
It releases a cloud of poison into the surrounding water
explanation: A sea cucumber can stiffen or shrink its body as a defense response when threatened.
fact_tl: Kaya ng balat na patigasin o paliitin ang katawan nito bilang depensa kapag may panganib.
fact_bis: Ang balatan makahimo sa pagpatig-a o pagpakunhod sa iyang lawas isip depensa kon adunay kakuyaw.

q: What are hydrocarbons, and why are gasoline and natural gas examples of them?
options: They are compounds made only of carbon and hydrogen atoms, used as fuels
They are compounds made of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen that store energy in plants
They are pure carbon materials that burn cleanly without producing gases
They are hydrogen-only compounds that produce electricity when heated
explanation: Hydrocarbons are compounds made exclusively of carbon and hydrogen atoms, and fuels like gasoline and natural gas are classic examples.
fact_tl: Ang mga hydrocarbon ay mga compound na gawa lamang sa carbon at hydrogen, at marami sa kanila tulad ng gasolina at natural gas ay ginagamit bilang panggatong.
fact_bis: Ang mga hydrocarbon mga compound nga hinimo lamang sa carbon ug hydrogen nga mga atomo, ug daghan kanila sama sa gasolina ug natural gas gigamit ingon nga sugnod.

q: Where does the ultraviolet light that bees see on flowers actually come from?
options: From the sun — the flower reflects sunlight in UV patterns the bee's eyes can read
From special glowing cells inside the flower petals
From chemicals inside the flower that produce their own light at night
From the soil, which absorbs UV from sunlight and passes it into the plant
explanation: Flowers do not produce their own UV light; they simply reflect ultraviolet rays from the sun in patterns that bees can detect with their eyes.
fact_tl: Hindi totoo na ang mga bulaklak mismo ang gumagawa ng sariling ilaw para makita ng bubuyog. Ang ultraviolet ay galing sa araw, at ang ginagawa lang ng bulaklak ay i-reflect o ibalik ito sa iba't ibang pattern na nababasa ng mata ng bubuyog.
fact_bis: Dili tinuod nga ang mga bulak mismo ang nagbuhat sa ilang kaugalingong kahayag aron makita sa putyokan. Ang ultraviolet gikan sa adlaw, ug ang gibuhat lang sa bulak mao ang pag-reflect o pagbalik niini sa lain-laing pattern nga mabasa sa mata sa putyokan.

q: Why is a newly made bar of soap left to sit for several weeks before it is sold or used?
options: It needs time to harden and dry — a process called curing — so it lasts longer and becomes milder
It must absorb fragrance oils that are added to the soap after it hardens
The chemicals inside are still dangerous and need time to become safe
It must be kept cool so the oils and fats do not separate from the bar
explanation: After soap is made, curing allows it to harden and dry for several weeks, making it last longer and gentler on the skin.
fact_tl: Pagkagawa ng bareta ng sabon, kailangan muna itong patigasin at patuyuin nang ilang linggo bago gamitin. Tinatawag itong curing, at nakakatulong ito para mas matagal at mas ligtas ang sabon.
fact_bis: Human mahimo ang bareta sa sabon, kinahanglan una kining pagahion ug paugahon sulod sa pipila ka semana sa dili pa gamiton. Gitawag kini nga curing, ug makatabang kini aron mas dugay ug mas hinay ang sabon.

q: In type 1 diabetes, why does the person need insulin injections every day?
options: Because the pancreas makes almost no insulin on its own
Because the body makes too much insulin and needs extra to balance it
Because the cells ignore insulin and extra injections force them to respond
Because insulin is broken down too quickly and must be replaced each hour
explanation: In type 1 diabetes the pancreas produces almost no insulin, so daily injections are needed to replace what the body cannot make.
fact_tl: Sa type 1 diabetes, halos hindi na nakakagawa ng insulin ang pancreas, kaya kailangan ng tao na turukan ng insulin araw-araw; madalas itong nagsisimula sa mga bata.
fact_bis: Sa type 1 diabetes, halos dili na makahimo og insulin ang pancreas, mao nga kinahanglan iniksyonan ang tawo og insulin matag adlaw; sagad magsugod kini sa mga bata.

q: How does bamboo help protect land along riverbanks?
options: Its dense roots hold the soil together and prevent erosion
Its hollow stems act as drainage pipes that redirect floodwater
Its leaves form a thick mat that blocks rainfall from hitting the ground
Its rapid height growth shades the river and slows the current
explanation: Bamboo's dense root system binds the soil together, which is especially useful for preventing erosion along riverbanks.
fact_tl: Ang masinsing ugat ng kawayan ay humahawak sa lupa, kaya nakakatulong itong pigilan ang pagguho ng lupa (erosion) lalo na sa tabi ng ilog.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga gamot sa kawayan naghawid sa yuta, mao nga makatabang kini pagpugong sa pagguho sa yuta (erosion) ilabi na sa daplin sa suba.

q: Which processes move carbon through the carbon cycle between living things, the air, oceans, and the ground?
options: Photosynthesis, respiration, and decay
Evaporation, condensation, and precipitation
Erosion, deposition, and compaction
Digestion, circulation, and excretion
explanation: In the carbon cycle, carbon moves between the air, living things, oceans, and ground through photosynthesis, respiration, and decay.
fact_tl: Sa siklo ng karbon, ang elementong karbon ay paikot-ikot na inililipat sa pagitan ng hangin, mga halaman at hayop, karagatan, at lupa sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, paghinga, at pagkabulok.
fact_bis: Sa siklo sa carbon, ang elemento nga carbon naglibot-libot tali sa hangin, mga buhing butang, kadagatan, ug yuta pinaagi sa photosynthesis, pagginhawa, ug pagkadunot.

q: Where does the edible part of a cassava (kamoteng kahoy) plant grow?
options: Underground, as a root
On the stem, as a thick bark
At the tips of the branches, as a large fruit
In pods that hang from the leaves
explanation: Cassava, also called kamoteng kahoy, is a root crop — its edible starchy part grows underground.
fact_tl: Ang kamoteng kahoy o kasava ay isa pang ugat na tumutubo sa ilalim ng lupa at ginagawang harina o kakanin.
fact_bis: Ang balanghoy o kasava usa pa ka gamot nga motubo ilalom sa yuta ug himoong harina o kalan-on.

q: What happens to your ability to judge the distance of objects when you close one eye?
options: It becomes harder to judge the exact distance of objects
Your remaining eye automatically adjusts and judges distance just as well
You can only see objects that are within arm's reach
Colors look brighter because the open eye gets more light
explanation: Using both eyes together gives depth perception; closing one eye makes it much harder to judge how far away objects are.
fact_tl: Kapag ipinikit mo ang isang mata, mas nahihirapan kang tantiyahin ang tamang distansya ng mga bagay.
fact_bis: Kung piyongon nimo ang usa ka mata, mas maglisod ka sa pagtantiya sa husto nga gilay-on sa mga butang.

q: What can the simple cup eyes of a flatworm (planarian) actually do?
options: Sense which direction light comes from, but not form a real image
See clear images of objects up to a few centimeters away
Detect both color and movement just like human eyes
Only work in darkness — the eyes are blinded by bright light
explanation: A planarian's two cup-shaped eyes can sense the direction of light but cannot form a proper image like more complex eyes can.
fact_tl: Ang flatworm o planaria ay may dalawang simpleng mata na nakakaramdam ng direksyon ng liwanag ngunit hindi makakagawa ng tunay na larawan.
fact_bis: Ang flatworm o planaria adunay duha ka simple nga mata nga makabati asa gikan ang kahayag apan dili makahimo ug tinuod nga hulagway.

q: Why can insects not escape once they touch certain threads of a spider's web?
options: Some threads are coated with a sticky substance that traps them
The threads tighten automatically when anything touches them
The web produces a weak electric charge that holds insects in place
The threads are so thin they wrap around the insect's legs and knot
explanation: Some threads in a spider's web are sticky, so insects that land on them become trapped and cannot escape.
fact_tl: May mga hibla sa sapot na malagkit kaya dumidikit at hindi makatakas ang mga insekto.
fact_bis: Adunay mga hilo sa sapot nga pilit, mao nga mopilit ang mga insekto ug dili makaikyas.

q: In a polar bond between two atoms, how are the electrons shared?
options: Unequally, so one end becomes slightly negative and the other slightly positive
Equally, so both atoms carry the same small positive charge
One atom keeps all the electrons and the other gives them all up
The electrons switch back and forth so both atoms take turns being negative
explanation: In a polar bond the electrons are shared unequally, giving one end a slight negative charge and the other end a slight positive charge.
fact_tl: Sa polar bond, hindi pantay ang hatian ng elektron kaya ang isang dulo ng bond ay bahagyang negatibo at ang kabila ay bahagyang positibo.
fact_bis: Sa polar bond, dili patas ang pagbahin sa elektron mao nga ang usa ka tumoy sa bond medyo negatibo ug ang pikas medyo positibo.

q: What happens to an ozone molecule when it absorbs ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun?
options: It briefly breaks apart, turns the UV energy into heat, then re-forms to absorb more UV
It permanently breaks down into oxygen and releases the UV energy back into space
It joins with nearby oxygen molecules to form a thicker protective layer
It reflects the UV rays back toward the sun without absorbing any energy
explanation: When UV hits ozone, the molecule briefly breaks apart and converts the UV energy into heat; it then re-forms and can absorb UV again.
fact_tl: Sinisipsip ng ozone ang enerhiya ng UV na sinag. Kapag tinamaan ng UV, panandaliang nabubuwag ang molekula ng ozone, at ang enerhiya ay nagiging init sa halip na makarating sa lupa. Pagkatapos, muling nabubuo ang ozone para ulitin ang proseso.
fact_bis: Suyupon sa ozone ang enerhiya sa UV nga sidlak. Kon maigo sa UV, kadiyot nga mabuak ang molekula sa ozone, ug ang enerhiya mahimong kainit imbis nga muabot sa yuta. Unya mabalik usab ang ozone aron mausab pag-usab.

q: What role do gravel and sand (called aggregate) play in concrete?
options: They make up most of the concrete and give it bulk and strength
They act as a glue that holds the cement powder together
They speed up the hardening process by reacting with water
They keep the concrete flexible so it does not crack when it dries
explanation: Aggregate — gravel and sand — makes up the bulk of concrete and gives it its strength.
fact_tl: Ang graba at buhangin (tinatawag na agregado) ang pumupuno sa karamihan ng konkreto at nagbibigay ng tigas at lakas dito.
fact_bis: Ang graba ug balas (gitawag nga agregado) maoy nagpuno sa kadaghanan sa konkreto ug naghatag ug katig-a ug kusog niini.

q: Why do a child's first (baby) teeth fall out?
options: They are replaced by larger permanent teeth as the child grows
They break down from too much sugar and cannot be repaired
The jaw pushes them out because it runs out of space
They are lost because the roots dissolve due to chewing hard food
explanation: A child's milk (baby) teeth fall out naturally to make room for the larger permanent teeth that grow in afterward.
fact_tl: Ang mga unang ngipin ng bata, na tinatawag na gatas na ngipin, ay natatanggal para mapalitan ng mas malalaking permanenteng ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang unang mga ngipon sa bata, nga gitawag ug gatas nga ngipon, matangtang aron pulihan sa mas dagko nga permanenteng ngipon.

q: What do a cat's claws help it do?
options: Grip surfaces and climb trees and other high places
Swim quickly through water to catch fish
Dig burrows underground to find food
Sense nearby movement through vibrations in the ground
explanation: A cat uses its sharp, curved claws to grip surfaces so it can climb trees and reach high places.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng pusa ang mga kuko nito para kumapit at umakyat sa mga puno at iba pang mataas na lugar.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa iring ang iyang mga kuko aron mokapyot ug mosaka sa mga kahoy ug uban pang habog nga dapit.

q: Why is open burning of trash — especially plastic — banned in the Philippines?
options: It releases toxic smoke that is harmful to people and the environment
It wastes materials that could be recycled into useful products
It produces so much heat that it can start wildfires in dry areas
It creates too much carbon dioxide that directly causes acid rain
explanation: Burning plastic releases toxic smoke, which is why the Philippine Clean Air Act prohibits open trash burning.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ng basura lalo na ng plastik ay naglalabas ng nakakalasong usok, kaya bawal ang open burning sa Pilipinas sa ilalim ng Clean Air Act.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog sa basura ilabi na ang plastik mogawas og makahilo nga aso, mao nga gidili ang open burning sa Pilipinas ubos sa Clean Air Act.

q: When does a rainbow usually appear in the sky?
options: After rain while the sun is still shining
Only at sunrise or sunset when the sky is the darkest orange
During heavy rain when the sky is completely overcast
At night when moonlight passes through water droplets
explanation: A rainbow is an arc of colors that usually appears after rain when sunlight is still shining and passes through water droplets in the air.
fact_tl: Ang bahaghari ay isang arko ng mga kulay sa kalangitan na karaniwang lumilitaw pagkatapos ng ulan kapag sumisikat pa rin ang Araw.
fact_bis: Ang balangaw usa ka arko sa mga kolor sa langit nga kasagaran motungha human sa ulan samtang nagsidlak pa ang Adlaw.

q: Which mineral is ranked as the softest on the Mohs hardness scale?
options: Talc, with a hardness of 1
Gypsum, with a hardness of 2
Quartz, with a hardness of 7
Calcite, with a hardness of 3
explanation: Talc is the softest of all minerals, earning a rating of just 1 on the Mohs hardness scale.
fact_tl: Ang talc (talko) ang pinakamalambot na mineral, na may tigas na 1 lang sa Mohs scale.
fact_bis: Ang talc (talko) mao ang pinakahumok nga mineral, nga adunay katigasan nga 1 ra sa Mohs scale.

q: In a lichen, how do the alga and fungus help each other?
options: The alga makes food while the fungus provides water and protection
The fungus makes food while the alga stores water for both of them
The alga breaks down dead material and the fungus absorbs the nutrients
The fungus fixes nitrogen from the air while the alga absorbs sunlight only
explanation: In a lichen, the alga produces food through photosynthesis while the fungus supplies water and protection — a true mutualistic partnership.
fact_tl: Ang lichen ay binubuo ng algae at fungus na nabubuhay nang magkasama: gumagawa ng pagkain ang algae habang nagbibigay ng tubig at proteksyon ang fungus.
fact_bis: Ang lichen gilangkoban sa alga ug fungus nga nagpuyo nga magkauban: ang alga maghimo og pagkaon samtang ang fungus maghatag og tubig ug panalipod.

q: Why are offshore wind farms in Philippine seas considered better than onshore wind farms?
options: Sea winds are stronger and more reliable than winds on land
Ocean waters cool the turbines so they can spin much faster
Offshore turbines are cheaper to build because no land needs to be cleared
Philippine seas have no typhoons so the turbines face less storm damage
explanation: Sea winds are stronger and more reliable than onshore winds, giving the Philippines enormous potential for offshore wind energy.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may napakalaking potensyal para sa offshore wind farm sa mga karagatan nito — ang mga hangin sa dagat ay mas malakas at mas maaasahan kaysa sa lupa, at ang mga teknikal na pagsulong ay nagpapadali na ng pag-develop ng offshore wind.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay napakalaking potensyal alang sa offshore wind farm sa palibot niini nga mga dagat — ang mga hangin sa dagat mas kusog ug mas masaligan kaysa sa yuta, ug ang mga pagsulong sa teknolohiya nagpadali sa pag-develop sa offshore wind.

q: What does food security mean?
options: All people have access to sufficient, safe, and nutritious food at all times
A country produces more food than it needs and can export the surplus
Food is kept free from bacteria by storing it in refrigerators or freezers
Farmers are protected by laws that make sure they receive fair pay
explanation: Food security means that all people always have access to enough safe and nutritious food — the goal of Philippine agricultural programs.
fact_tl: Ang food security ay ang kalagayan kung saan lahat ng tao ay may sapat at malusog na pagkain sa lahat ng oras—ito ang layunin ng agrikulturang programa ng Pilipinas na pinamumunuan ng Department of Agriculture.
fact_bis: Ang food security mao ang kahimtang diin ang tanan nga tawo adunay access sa igo, luwas, ug malusog nga pagkaon sa tanan nga oras; mao kini ang tumong sa mga agricultural program sa Pilipinas nga gidumalaan sa Department of Agriculture.

q: Besides wings, what body part does a bird use to turn, keep balance, and brake before landing?
options: Its tail
Its beak
Its feet
Its neck
explanation: A bird's tail works together with its wings to help it turn, maintain balance, and slow down before landing.
fact_tl: Hindi lang pakpak ang ginagamit ng ibon para lumipad — tumutulong din ang buntot (tail). Ginagamit nito ang buntot para lumiko, panatilihing balanse, at magpreno bago dumapo. Kasama ng pakpak, ang buntot ang parang manibela ng ibon sa ere.
fact_bis: Dili lang pako ang gamiton sa langgam aron makalupad — motabang sab ang ikog (tail). Gigamit niini ang ikog aron moliko, magpabiling balanse, ug mopreno una motugpa. Uban sa pako, ang ikog mao ang sama sa manibela sa langgam sa hangin.

q: What is the job of a seed's tough outer coat?
options: To protect the inside of the seed from harm and from drying out
To attract birds and animals so the seed gets carried to new places
To absorb water from the soil so the seedling can start to grow
To store food energy that the new plant will use when it sprouts
explanation: The tough seed coat shields the embryo inside from physical damage and prevents it from drying out.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na balat ng binhi ay nagtatanggol sa loob nito laban sa pinsala at pagkatuyo.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga panit sa liso nanalipod sa sulod niini batok sa kadaot ug pagkauga.

q: Why has the scientific model of the atom changed many times over history?
options: Scientists gathered new evidence that showed earlier ideas needed to be corrected
Each generation of scientists simply preferred a different visual picture of the atom
Political decisions forced scientists to change their official descriptions
New technology made atoms visible, so scientists could draw them exactly
explanation: The atomic model improved over time as scientists gathered new evidence, demonstrating that scientific knowledge grows by correcting earlier ideas.
fact_tl: Nagbago ang modelo ng atom sa paglipas ng panahon habang nagkakaroon ng bagong ebidensya ang mga siyentista — patunay na umuunlad ang kaalaman sa agham sa pamamagitan ng pagwawasto ng dating mga ideya.
fact_bis: Nausab ang modelo sa atom sa paglabay sa panahon samtang nakakuha og bag-ong ebidensya ang mga siyentista — pamatuod nga ang kahibalo sa siyensya nagtubo pinaagi sa pagtul-id sa daan nga mga ideya.

q: How does your body know which way is 'down' even when your eyes are closed?
options: Tiny grain-like crystals in the ear are pulled by gravity, sensing direction
Special nerve endings in the soles of your feet detect the ground's pressure
The fluid in your lungs shifts toward the floor due to gravity
Tiny hairs inside your nose feel the pull of air moving downward
explanation: Tiny crystal-like particles inside your ear are pulled by gravity, letting your brain sense which direction is down.
fact_tl: May maliliit na butil na parang buhangin sa loob ng tainga na tumutulong maramdaman kung saan ang ibaba dahil hinihila sila ng grabidad.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga butil nga morag balas sa sulod sa dalunggan nga motabang sa pagbati kung asa ang ubos kay birahon sila sa grabidad.

q: In what year was the Christ the Redeemer statue completed and opened?
explanation: The Christ the Redeemer statue in Brazil was completed and officially opened in 1931.
fact_tl: Natapos at binuksan ang estatwang Christ the Redeemer noong 1931.
fact_bis: Ang estatwa nga Christ the Redeemer nahuman ug giablihan niadtong 1931.

q: How is tuyo made, and why does it last for many days without spoiling?
options: Fish is salted and dried in the sun, which removes moisture and stops spoiling
Fish is smoked over a fire for several days until it becomes firm and dry
Fish is soaked in vinegar and spices that kill bacteria inside the flesh
Fish is frozen immediately after the catch, then slowly thawed before eating
explanation: Tuyo is made by salting fish and drying it in the sun; removing moisture this way prevents spoiling and makes it last much longer.
fact_tl: Ang tuyo ay isdang inasnan at ibinilad sa araw, kaya tumatagal ito nang maraming araw na hindi nasisira.
fact_bis: Ang bulad (tuyo) kay isda nga giasinan ug gibulad sa adlaw, mao nga modugay kini og daghang adlaw nga dili madunot.

q: How does the sun look when you view it through altostratus clouds?
options: Blurred or hazy, as if seen through frosted glass
Completely hidden so the sky looks totally dark and grey
Bright and sharp with a visible ring of light around it
Invisible because altostratus clouds let no light pass through at all
explanation: Altostratus are grey sheet clouds at middle altitude; the sun can be seen through them but appears blurred, like looking through frosted glass.
fact_tl: Ang altostratus ay patong na abo-abong ulap sa gitnang antas ng kalangitan; maaaring makita ang araw sa pamamagitan nito ngunit parang sa pamamagitan ng salamin.
fact_bis: Ang altostratus abo nga patong nga panganod sa gitna nga antas sa langit; ang adlaw makita pa niini apan morag pinaagi sa frosted glass.

q: What happens to the particles in matter when it is heated?
options: The particles move faster and the matter usually expands
The particles stop moving and the matter shrinks
The particles move slower and the matter usually expands
The particles break apart and turn into a new substance
explanation: Particles move faster when matter is hotter, which is why heated objects usually expand.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis gumalaw ang mga particle ng matter kapag mas mainit ito, at mas mabagal kapag malamig. Kaya kadalasang lumalaki (expansion) ang mga bagay kapag iniinit at umuurong kapag pinapalamig.
fact_bis: Mas paspas molihok ang mga particle sa matter kung mas init kini, ug mas hinay kung bugnaw. Mao nga kasagaran modako (expansion) ang mga butang kung initan ug mokunhod kung bugnawon.

q: An adult cicada spends many years underground before emerging. How long does it actually live above the ground as an adult?
options: A few years
A few months
A few weeks
A few days
explanation: After many years underground, an adult cicada lives only a few weeks above the ground.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng maraming taon sa ilalim ng lupa, ang matandang kuliglig ay nabubuhay lamang nang ilang linggo.
fact_bis: Human sa daghang tuig sa ilalom sa yuta, ang hamtong nga kuliglig mabuhi lamang ug pipila ka semana.

q: Swiftlets sleep and nest inside caves. Where do they go to find food during the day?
options: They dive underwater to catch small fish
They fly out of the cave to catch tiny flying insects in the air
They gather fruits and seeds from nearby trees
They eat small insects found on the cave walls
explanation: Swiftlets fly out during the day to catch tiny flying insects in the air, which are their food.
fact_tl: Bagama't natutulog at namumugad sila sa kweba, lumalabas ang swiftlet sa araw para manghuli ng maliliit na lumilipad na insekto sa himpapawid, na siyang kanilang pagkain.
fact_bis: Bisan og natulog ug namugad sila sa langob, mogawas ang swiftlet sa adlaw aron manguha og gagmay nga naglupad nga insekto sa kahanginan, nga maoy ilang pagkaon.

q: What can the seed inside a fruit like rambutan grow into?
options: A brand-new tree
A colorful flower
A large mushroom
A long vine
explanation: The seed inside a fruit like rambutan can grow into a brand-new tree.
fact_tl: Ang buto sa loob ng prutas tulad ng rambutan ay maaaring tumubo at maging bagong puno.
fact_bis: Ang liso sa sulod sa prutas sama sa rambutan mahimong motubo ug mahimong bag-ong kahoy.

q: Why do sperm and egg cells each carry only half the usual number of chromosomes?
options: Because sex cells are too small to hold all chromosomes
So that when they join during fertilization, the offspring has the complete chromosome number
Because the other half is stored in the parents' skin cells
So that the baby has fewer chromosomes than its parents
explanation: Sex cells carry half the chromosomes so that when sperm and egg join, the offspring ends up with the complete number from both parents.
fact_tl: Ang mga sex cell tulad ng tamod at itlog ay may kalahati lamang ng karaniwang bilang ng chromosomes, kaya kapag nagsanib ang dalawa sa fertilization, nabubuo ang anak na may kumpletong bilang ng chromosomes mula sa dalawang magulang.
fact_bis: Ang mga sex cell sama sa tamod ug itlog adunay katunga lamang sa kasagarang gidaghanon sa chromosomes, busa kon magsanib ang duha sa fertilization, mahimo ang anak nga adunay kompletong gidaghanon sa chromosomes gikan sa duha ka ginikanan.

q: Why are two people with the same genes not always the same height?
options: Because height is determined entirely by genes
Because the environment, such as food and exercise, also affects traits like height
Because height depends only on how much sleep a person gets
Because chromosomes change every year as a person grows
explanation: Genes alone do not control every trait — the environment, including food and exercise, also affects things like a person's height.
fact_tl: Hindi lang gene ang humuhubog sa isang katangian — ang kapaligiran tulad ng pagkain at ehersisyo ay nakakaapekto rin, halimbawa sa taas ng isang tao.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang gene ang naghulma sa usa ka kinaiya — ang palibot sama sa pagkaon ug ehersisyo naka-apekto usab, pananglitan sa gitas-on sa usa ka tawo.

q: Which of the following groups of animals can all be found living in mangrove forests?
options: Penguins, polar bears, seals, and walruses
Fish, crabs, birds, and snakes
Camels, lions, zebras, and giraffes
Dolphins, whales, sharks, and sea turtles
explanation: Mangroves are home to many different animals such as fish, crabs, birds, and even monkeys and snakes.
fact_tl: Ang mangrove ay tirahan ng sari-saring hayop tulad ng isda, alimango, ibon, at maging mga unggoy at ahas.
fact_bis: Ang mangrove puy-anan sa lainlaing mananap sama sa isda, alimango, langgam, ug bisan mga unggoy ug bitin.

q: What is true about the pufferfish's poison?
options: It is harmless to humans and only affects other fish
Even a small amount of its poison can kill a person
It can only make a person sick for a few hours
Its poison becomes safe to eat after cooking
explanation: The pufferfish's poison is so strong that even a small amount can kill a person.
fact_tl: Napakalakas ng lason ng butete kaya kahit kaunti lang ay maaaring makamatay ng tao.
fact_bis: Kusgan kaayo ang hilo sa butete maong bisan gamay lang mahimong makapatay og tawo.

q: Why is solar energy called a renewable energy source?
options: Because solar panels never break down or need replacing
Because the Sun keeps shining and does not run out
Because solar energy can be stored forever without any loss
Because solar panels work even when there is no sunlight
explanation: Solar energy is renewable because the Sun keeps shining and does not run out.
fact_tl: Ang solar energy ay renewable dahil patuloy na sumisikat ang Araw at hindi ito nauubos.
fact_bis: Ang solar energy kay renewable kay ang Adlaw padayon nga mosidlak ug dili kini mahurot.

q: What is the safe way to handle leftover food?
options: Leave it on the table overnight and eat it cold the next morning
Put it in the fridge while still fresh and reheat it well before eating again
Store it at room temperature for up to three days before eating
Freeze it immediately and eat it without reheating
explanation: Leftover food should be put in the fridge while still fresh and reheated well before eating again to keep it safe.
fact_tl: Dapat ilagay ang tirang pagkain sa ref habang sariwa pa, at painitin itong mabuti bago ulit kainin.
fact_bis: Ang tira nga pagkaon kinahanglan ibutang sa pridyider samtang preska pa, ug initon pag-ayo una kan-on pag-usab.

q: Who declared Philippine independence, and when?
options: Jose Rizal declared independence on June 19, 1861
Andres Bonifacio declared independence on August 23, 1896
Emilio Aguinaldo declared independence on June 12, 1898
Manuel Quezon declared independence on November 15, 1935
explanation: Emilio Aguinaldo declared Philippine independence on June 12, 1898.
fact_tl: Si Emilio Aguinaldo ang nagpahayag ng kalayaan ng Pilipinas noong Hunyo 12, 1898.
fact_bis: Si Emilio Aguinaldo ang nagpahayag sa kagawasan sa Pilipinas niadtong Hunyo 12, 1898.

q: Where does buho bamboo often grow in the Philippines?
options: On the tops of high mountains and in cold highland areas
Near rivers and hillsides
Deep in the ocean near coral reefs
In dry desert-like lowlands with very little rain
explanation: Buho is a kind of bamboo with thin walls that often grows near rivers and hillsides in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang buho ay isang uri ng kawayan na may manipis na balat at madalas tumutubo malapit sa ilog at gilid ng bundok sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang buho usa ka matang sa kawayan nga adunay nipis nga bongbong nga kasagaran motubo duol sa suba ug kilid sa bukid sa Pilipinas.

q: How do mussels and oysters help the ocean environment?
options: They produce oxygen by doing photosynthesis in shallow water
They filter tiny food from the water, which helps clean the seawater
They eat algae that would otherwise smother coral reefs
They release chemicals that attract fish and improve water temperature
explanation: Mussels and oysters filter tiny food from the water, so they help clean the seawater around them.
fact_tl: Ang mga tahong at talaba ay sumasala ng pagkain sa tubig, kaya nakatutulong silang linisin ang tubig sa karagatan.
fact_bis: Ang mga tahong ug talaba mosala sa gagmay nga pagkaon gikan sa tubig, busa makatabang sila sa paglimpyo sa tubig sa dagat.

q: What was special about Dolly the sheep?
options: She was the first sheep ever kept as a farm animal
She was the first mammal cloned from an adult cell
She was the first animal to survive a trip to outer space
She was the first animal to be genetically modified to glow in the dark
explanation: Dolly the sheep was the first mammal cloned from an adult cell, born in 1996.
fact_tl: Si Dolly na tupa ang unang mamalya na na-clone mula sa isang adultong selula, ipinanganak noong 1996.
fact_bis: Si Dolly nga karnero ang unang mamipero nga na-clone gikan sa hamtong nga selula, natawo niadtong 1996.

q: What happens to a child who does not get enough iron in their diet?
options: They develop weak bones and teeth from low calcium
They can develop anemia, which makes them feel tired and weak easily
They lose their appetite because iron controls hunger signals
They grow too quickly and become taller than normal
explanation: A lack of iron can cause anemia, which makes a child tired and weak easily.
fact_tl: Ang bakal (iron) mula sa pagkain tulad ng karne, malunggay, at gulay na madahon ay kailangan para gumawa ng malusog na dugo. Kapag kulang dito, maaaring magka-anemya ang bata at madaling mapagod o manghina.
fact_bis: Ang puthaw (iron) gikan sa pagkaon sama sa karne, malunggay, ug dahonon nga utanon gikinahanglan aron makahimo og himsog nga dugo. Kung kulang niini, mahimong ma-anemya ang bata ug daling kapuyon ug maluya.

q: Why is the universe said to be mostly empty space?
options: Because black holes have swallowed most of the matter in the universe
Because stars and galaxies are extremely far apart compared to how big they are
Because the universe stopped forming new stars long ago
Because most planets do not have any solid matter inside them
explanation: The universe is mostly empty space because stars and galaxies are extremely far apart compared to how big they are.
fact_tl: Ang sansinukob ay halos puro puwang lamang, dahil napakalayo ng mga bituin at galaxy sa isa't isa kumpara sa laki nila.
fact_bis: Ang uniberso halos puro haw-ang lang, kay layo kaayo ang mga bituon ug galaxy sa usag usa kumpara sa ilang gidak-on.

q: If your clothes catch fire, what should you do?
options: Run as fast as you can to find water
Wave your arms to fan away the flames
Stop, drop, and roll to smother the flames
Jump into the nearest body of water immediately
explanation: Stopping, dropping, and rolling smothers the flames and cuts off the oxygen that keeps the fire burning.
fact_tl: Kapag nasunog ang iyong damit, dapat kang tumigil, lumuhod, at gumulong upang takpan ang apoy at maputol ang suplay ng oksiheno na nagpapanatili nitong nagliliyab.
fact_bis: Kung masunog ang imong sinina, kinahanglan ka mohunong, moluhod, ug moligid aron matabonan ang kalayo ug maputol ang oksiheno nga nagapadayon sa pagdilaab.

q: How deep is the deepest hole people have ever drilled into the Earth?
options: About 12 kilometers, barely scratching the crust
About 50 kilometers, reaching halfway through the crust
About 100 kilometers, just entering the upper mantle
About 500 kilometers, well into the mantle
explanation: The deepest hole ever drilled reached only about 12 kilometers, which is just a thin scratch compared with the whole crust.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na butas na nabarena ng tao ay umabot lamang ng mga 12 kilometro, na napakanipis pa lamang kumpara sa kapal ng buong crust, kaya hindi pa kayang marating ang mantle.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga bangag nga nabangag sa tawo miabot lang ug mga 12 ka kilometro, nga nipis pa kaayo kumpara sa baga sa tibuok crust, mao nga wala pa gayud maabot ang mantle.

q: What does your pupil do when you walk into a very dark room?
options: It becomes smaller to let in less light
It turns from black to gray to let in more colors
It gets bigger to let in more light
It stays the same size no matter how bright or dark it is
explanation: The pupil gets bigger in the dark to let in more light so you can see better.
fact_tl: Ang itim na bilog sa gitna ng mata, ang balintataw o pupil, ay lumiliit kapag maliwanag at lumalaki kapag madilim para itama ang dami ng liwanag na papasok.
fact_bis: Ang itom nga lingin sa tunga sa mata, ang pupil, mo-gamay kung hayag ug modaku kung ngitngit aron makontrol ang gidaghanon sa kahayag nga mosulod.

q: From where does a fingernail grow?
options: From the tip of the nail, which is pushed outward
From the middle of the nail plate where new cells form
From a living part at its base, near the skin
From the skin on either side of the nail
explanation: A nail grows from a living part at its base, near the skin.
fact_tl: Ang kuko ay tumutubo mula sa isang buhay na bahagi sa puno ng kuko, malapit sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang kuko nagtubo gikan sa buhi nga bahin sa pundo niini, duol sa panit.

q: Besides hiding from enemies, why else do snails pull back into their shells?
options: To keep their bodies warm in cold temperatures
To avoid losing water from their soft, moist bodies
To lay their eggs safely inside the shell
To sleep more comfortably during the day
explanation: Snails also pull inside their shells to avoid losing water from their bodies, which is important because their bodies are soft and moist.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa kaaway nagtatago ang kuhol—pumapasok din ito sa shell para hindi mawalan ng tubig sa katawan. Mahalaga ito dahil malambot at basa ang katawan nito.
fact_bis: Dili lang sa kaaway mutago ang kuhol—musulod usab kini sa kabhang aron dili mawad-an ug tubig ang lawas. Importante kini kay humok ug basa ang iyang lawas.

q: Which planet has the longest day in our solar system?
options: Mercury, because it is closest to the Sun
Mars, because it rotates more slowly than Earth
Jupiter, because it is the largest planet
Venus, where one day lasts about 243 Earth days
explanation: One day on Venus lasts about 243 Earth days, making it the longest day of any planet.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Venus ay tumatagal ng halos 243 araw ng Mundo, ang pinakamahabang araw sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Venus motagal ug mga 243 ka adlaw sa Yuta, ang pinakatas-on nga adlaw sa tanang planeta.

q: A child has a fever above 38°C. Which of these actions is the correct way to help manage it at home?
options: Wrap the child in thick blankets and give them hot soup to sweat it out
Give the correct dose of paracetamol, sponge with lukewarm water, and let the child rest
Rub the child's body with cold ice packs to bring the temperature down quickly
Give extra vitamins and let the fever run its course without any treatment
explanation: Fever above 38°C can be managed with paracetamol at the correct dose, sponging with lukewarm water, and rest.
fact_tl: Ang lagnat sa mga bata na nasa itaas ng 38 degrees Celsius ay maaaring pamahalaan sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay ng paracetamol (sa tamang dosis), pagpupunas ng maligamgam na tubig, at pagpapahinga; kung mataas o matagal ang lagnat, kumunsulta sa doktor.
fact_bis: Ang lagnat nga labaw sa 38°C sa mga bata mahimong pamahalaan gamit ang paracetamol (tamang dosis), paglimpyo ug mainit nga tubig, ug pahinga; mangita ug doktor kung ang lagnat taas kaayo o molungtad ug labaw sa duha ka adlaw.

q: In science, if you push a wall as hard as you can but it does not move, how much work have you done?
options: A lot of work, because you used a lot of force
Some work, because you were pushing the whole time
No work at all, because the wall did not move
Work equal to the force times the time you pushed
explanation: In physics, no work is done if the object does not move, even if a large force is applied.
fact_tl: Kapag itinutulak mo ang pader pero hindi ito gumagalaw, wala kang nagagawang trabaho sa pisika kahit napapagod ka.
fact_bis: Kung itulod nimo ang dingding apan dili kini molihok, wala kay nahimong trabaho sa pisika bisan kapoy ka.

q: What happens when the number of animals in an area exceeds its carrying capacity?
options: The animals quickly adapt and find new food sources nearby
Food runs short and some animals will go hungry or die
The extra animals move away to balance the population automatically
Predators disappear so there is more food for the remaining animals
explanation: When animal numbers exceed the carrying capacity, food runs short and some will go hungry or die.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra na ang bilang ng hayop sa carrying capacity, magkukulang ang pagkain at ang ilan ay magugutom o mamamatay.
fact_bis: Kung sobra na ang gidaghanon sa hayop sa carrying capacity, mokulang ang pagkaon ug ang uban magutom o mamatay.

q: Why does a snake flick its tongue so quickly and so often?
options: To scare away predators by making a hissing sound
To collect more smell samples and constantly update information about its surroundings
To cool down its body in hot weather
To taste the air for moisture before deciding where to move
explanation: A snake flicks its tongue quickly and often to collect more smell samples and keep updating its information about what is around it.
fact_tl: Mabilis at madalas dumila ang ahas dahil mas maraming sample ng amoy ang nakukuha nito sa ganoong paraan. Parang patuloy na pag-update ng impormasyon tungkol sa kung ano ang nasa paligid nito.
fact_bis: Paspas ug kanunay motila ang ahas tungod kay mas daghang sample sa baho ang makuha niini niana nga paagi. Morag padayon nga pag-update sa impormasyon mahitungod sa unsay anaa sa palibot niini.

q: Salted egg is a traditional Filipino food. In what newer way is the salted egg flavor now also used?
options: As a natural food coloring added to rice dishes only
As a popular flavor in chips, bread, and other snack foods
As a cooking oil used only in restaurants
As a medicine used to treat stomach aches
explanation: The salted egg flavor is now also popular in chips, bread, and other foods.
fact_tl: Ang lasa ng itlog na maalat ay sikat din ngayon sa mga chips, tinapay, at iba pang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang lasa sa itlog nga parat sikat usab karon sa mga chips, pan, ug uban pang pagkaon.

q: Which of these is an example of a service that healthy ecosystems provide to people?
options: Manufacturing plastic products from natural materials
Producing clean air and water, and helping crops grow through pollination
Mining metals from the ground for building materials
Generating electricity directly from sunlight
explanation: Healthy ecosystems give people services such as clean air and water, crop pollination, and breaking down waste.
fact_tl: Ang mga malulusog na ekosistema ay nagbibigay sa tao ng mahahalagang serbisyo gaya ng malinis na hangin at tubig, pagpaparami ng pananim sa pamamagitan ng pollination, at pagbubulok ng basura.
fact_bis: Ang himsog nga mga ekosistema naghatag sa tawo ug bililhong serbisyo sama sa limpyo nga hangin ug tubig, pagpadaghan sa pananom pinaagi sa pollination, ug pagdunot sa basura.

q: Why does your body stay nearly still while you are dreaming during REM sleep?
options: Because the heart slows down so much that muscles cannot receive blood
Because the brain briefly relaxes the muscles so you do not act out your dreams
Because dreaming uses all the body's energy for the brain, leaving none for muscles
Because body temperature drops so low that muscles temporarily freeze
explanation: During REM sleep the brain briefly relaxes the muscles, which keeps us from acting out our dreams.
fact_tl: Sa REM na yugto kung kailan tayo madalas mananaginip, halos hindi gumagalaw ang katawan dahil pansamantalang nire-relax ng utak ang mga kalamnan. Ito ay para hindi natin isagawa ang ating mga panaginip.
fact_bis: Sa REM nga hugna, kanus-a kasagaran ta magdamgo, halos dili molihok ang lawas kay temporaryong gipahuway sa utak ang mga kaunoran. Kini aron dili nato buhaton ang atong mga damgo.

q: When light passes through a tiny hole, why does the image on the other side appear upside down?
options: Because the hole bends the light waves as they squeeze through
Because light travels in straight lines, so rays from the top go to the bottom and vice versa
Because the hole acts like a prism and flips the colors of light
Because light slows down as it passes through a small opening and flips direction
explanation: The image is upside down because light travels in straight lines — rays from the top of the scene cross through the hole and end up at the bottom of the image.
fact_tl: Kapag ang liwanag ay dumaan sa isang maliit na butas, nabubuo ang baliktad na larawan dahil naglalakbay ang liwanag sa tuwid na linya.
fact_bis: Kung ang kahayag molabay sa usa ka gamay nga lungag, mabuo ang balitad nga hulagway tungod kay ang kahayag mobiyahe sa tul-id nga linya.

q: What nationality was the inventor Thomas Edison?
options: British
German
American
French
explanation: Thomas Edison was an American inventor.
fact_tl: Si Thomas Edison ay isang Amerikano (American) na imbentor.
fact_bis: Si Thomas Edison usa ka Amerikano (American) nga imbentor.

q: Why can you see a clear reflection in a mirror but not in a painted wall?
options: Because mirrors are made of glass which absorbs light, while walls do not
Because a smooth mirror reflects light evenly, while a rough wall scatters light in many directions
Because mirrors produce their own light, while walls only reflect colored light
Because walls are too thick for light to bounce back from them properly
explanation: A smooth surface like a mirror reflects light evenly so a clear image forms, but a rough surface scatters light so no image appears.
fact_tl: Ang makinis na ibabaw tulad ng salamin ay nagbabalik ng liwanag nang pantay kaya nakikita natin ang malinaw na larawan, ngunit ang magaspang na ibabaw tulad ng pader ay nagkakalat ng liwanag sa iba't ibang direksyon kaya walang larawang nabubuo.
fact_bis: Ang hapsay nga nawong sama sa salamin mobalik sa kahayag nga pantay maong makita nato ang klaro nga hulagway, apan ang gasbang nga nawong sama sa pader magkatag sa kahayag sa nagkalainlaing direksyon maong walay hulagway nga maporma.

q: Bacteria come in several basic shapes. Which of the following correctly lists three of those shapes?
options: Flat, triangular, and square
Round, rod-like, and spiral
Pointed, hollow, and branching
Cube-shaped, ring-shaped, and star-shaped
explanation: Bacteria come in different shapes — round, rod-like, and spiral.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang hugis ang bakterya—bilog, parang baras, at parang spiral.
fact_bis: Lain-lain ang porma sa bakterya—lingin, sama sa baras, ug sama sa spiral.

q: How is a hummingbird able to stay in one place while drinking nectar from a flower?
options: It holds onto the flower with its feet while keeping its wings still
It glides on warm air currents that push it upward
It flaps its wings so fast that it can hover in one spot
It uses its long beak as a hook to hang from the flower
explanation: A hummingbird flaps its wings so fast that it can hover in one place while sipping nectar.
fact_tl: Pinapagaspas ng hummingbird ang mga pakpak nito nang napakabilis kaya nakakalutang ito sa isang lugar habang sumisipsip ng nektar mula sa bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ginakapay-kapay sa hummingbird ang mga pako niini og paspas kaayo mao nga makalutaw kini sa usa ka lugar samtang nagasuyop og nektar gikan sa bulak.

q: Why do Filipinos know in advance when the rainy season and the cool, dry winds will arrive each year?
options: Because scientists use satellites to predict the exact dates each month
Because the habagat and amihan winds follow a pattern that repeats every year
Because radio stations announce the monsoon schedule at the start of each year
Because the monsoon schedule is the same worldwide and never changes
explanation: The habagat and amihan happen again every year, so Filipinos know when the rain and the cool weather will come.
fact_tl: Ang habagat at amihan ay paulit-ulit na nangyayari bawat taon, kaya alam ng mga Pilipino kung kailan darating ang ulan at lamig.
fact_bis: Ang habagat ug amihan mabalik-balik kada tuig, mao nga nahibalo ang mga Pilipino kung kanus-a moabot ang ulan ug ang bugnaw nga panahon.

q: What two important jobs does the liver do in your body?
options: It pumps blood to the lungs and stores extra oxygen for the muscles
It makes bile to help break up fats and cleans harmful substances from the blood
It produces insulin to control blood sugar and stores extra water for the body
It filters waste from the blood and sends it to the lungs to be breathed out
explanation: The liver makes bile to break up fats during digestion and also cleans harmful substances out of the blood.
fact_tl: Ang atay ay tumutulong sa panunaw sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng apdo na bumabasag sa taba, at naglilinis din ito ng mga lason sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang atay motabang sa panghilis pinaagi sa paghimo og apdo nga mobungkag sa tambok, ug naghinlo usab kini sa makadaot nga mga butang sa dugo.

q: Why are most leaves wide and flat?
options: To store large amounts of water inside the leaf during dry seasons
To catch more sunlight for photosynthesis
To reduce wind resistance and keep the plant from falling over
To attract insects for pollination by displaying a large surface
explanation: Leaves are usually wide and flat so they can catch more sunlight for photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Karaniwang lapad at patag ang mga dahon upang makahuli ng mas maraming liwanag ng araw para sa photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Ang mga dahon kasagaran halapad ug patag aron makadakop og mas daghang kahayag sa adlaw alang sa photosynthesis.

q: What does the Filipino value of humility (pagkukumbaba) teach?
options: That a person should always speak loudly and confidently in public
That you should not be excessively proud and should always show respect for others
That hard work is more important than treating other people well
That keeping your achievements secret is better than sharing them
explanation: Humility is a Filipino value that teaches not to be excessively proud of oneself and to always show respect for others.
fact_tl: Ang pagkukumbaba ay isang pagpapahalaga ng mga Pilipino na nagtuturo na hindi dapat ipagmalaki ang sarili nang labis at laging may respeto sa ibang tao.
fact_bis: Ang pagkukumbaba usa ka pagpapahalaga sa mga Pilipino nga nagtudlo nga dili kinahanglan magpabugalbugal sa kaugalingon ug pirmi mag-respeto sa uban.

q: What is the difference between a real image and a virtual image?
options: A real image is always larger than the object, while a virtual image is always smaller
A real image can be projected onto a screen, but a virtual image like that in a flat mirror cannot
A real image is seen with both eyes open, while a virtual image can only be seen with one eye
A real image is formed by mirrors only, while a virtual image is formed by lenses only
explanation: A real image can be projected onto a screen, but the image in a flat mirror is virtual and cannot be caught on a screen.
fact_tl: Ang tunay na larawan (real image) ay maaaring ipakita sa screen, ngunit ang larawan sa patag na salamin ay virtual at hindi mahuhuli sa screen.
fact_bis: Ang tinuod nga hulagway (real image) mapakita sa tabing, apan ang hulagway sa patag nga salamin virtual ug dili madakop sa tabing.

q: What is charcoal made of, and what is it used for?
options: Charcoal is made of iron compounds and is used in making steel
Charcoal is almost pure carbon and is used as fuel for cooking and heating
Charcoal is made of crushed limestone and is used to purify drinking water
Charcoal is made of sulfur compounds and is used to make gunpowder
explanation: Charcoal is almost pure carbon and is used as fuel for cooking and heating.
fact_tl: Ang uling ay halos purong carbon at ginagamit na panggatong para magluto at magpainit.
fact_bis: Ang uling halos puro nga karbon ug gigamit nga sugnod sa pagluto ug pagpainit.

q: If you drop food coloring into a glass of water and do nothing else, what will happen?
options: The dye will sink to the bottom and stay there permanently
The dye will float on top because it is lighter than water
The dye will slowly spread through the water on its own through diffusion
The dye will quickly disappear and the water will return to being clear
explanation: Diffusion happens on its own from the movement of molecules, so you do not need to stir the water for the dye to spread.
fact_tl: Hindi kailangang haluin ang tubig para kumalat ang tina, dahil ang diffusion ay nangyayari nang kusa dahil sa galaw ng mga molekula.
fact_bis: Dili kinahanglan kutawon ang tubig aron mikatag ang tina, kay ang diffusion mahitabo sa kaugalingon tungod sa paglihok sa mga molekula.

q: Why is the chemical symbol for gold 'Au' instead of 'Go' or 'G'?
options: Because Au stands for 'atomic unit,' the original way gold was measured
Because Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum,' meaning gold
Because the scientist who discovered gold was named August
Because Au was chosen randomly when the periodic table was first created
explanation: Gold's symbol is Au because it comes from the Latin word 'aurum,' meaning gold.
fact_tl: Ang symbol ng gold ay Au dahil galing ito sa salitang Latin na 'aurum,' na ibig sabihin ay ginto.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa gold mao ang Au tungod kay naggikan kini sa Latin nga pulong nga 'aurum,' nga nagpasabot og bulawan.

q: What is misleading about the name 'flying lemur'?
options: It cannot actually fly — it only glides — and it is not a true lemur at all
It does not live on islands and is not related to any ocean animal
It cannot survive in forests and only lives in open grasslands
It is actually a bird, not a mammal, despite its mammal-like appearance
explanation: Despite its name, the flying lemur is not a true lemur and belongs to its own special group of mammals.
fact_tl: Sa kabila ng pangalan nito, ang flying lemur ay hindi tunay na lemur at kabilang sa sarili nitong natatanging grupo ng mga hayop.
fact_bis: Bisan pa sa ngalan niini, ang flying lemur dili tinuod nga lemur ug sakop sa kaugalingon niini nga talagsaong grupo sa mga mananap.

q: How does the sailfin lizard's color help it stay safe in the forest?
options: Its bright orange color warns predators that it is poisonous
Its greenish or wood-colored body blends in with leaves and branches, hiding it from predators
Its dark black color makes it hard to see at night when predators are active
Its shiny silver scales reflect sunlight and blind nearby birds of prey
explanation: The sailfin lizard's green or wood-like color works as camouflage, hiding it from birds and other animals that might eat it.
fact_tl: Karaniwang berde o kulay-kahoy ang sailfin lizard kaya nahahalo siya sa mga dahon at sanga. Ang kulay na ito ay parang panakip na nagtatago sa kanya mula sa mga ibon at iba pang hayop na kumakain sa kanya.
fact_bis: Kasagaran berde o kolor-kahoy ang sailfin lizard mao nga mosagol kini sa mga dahon ug sanga. Kini nga kolor murag tabon nga magtago niini gikan sa mga langgam ug ubang hayop nga mokaon niini.

q: What important role does the Philippine Eagle play in the forest?
options: It pollinates forest flowers by carrying pollen on its feathers
As the top predator, it helps keep the numbers of other animals in balance
It breaks down dead trees and returns nutrients to the soil
It digs burrows that other forest animals use as shelter
explanation: As the top predator in the forest, the eagle helps keep the numbers of other animals in balance.
fact_tl: Bilang pinakamataas na mandaragit sa gubat, tinutulungan ng agila na mapanatiling balanse ang bilang ng mga hayop dito.
fact_bis: Isip kinatas-ang manunukob sa lasang, ang agila motabang sa pagpabilin nga timbang sa gidaghanon sa ubang mananap.

q: The Philippines and India both have monsoons caused by land-sea temperature differences. What makes the Philippine monsoon different from India's?
options: The Philippine monsoon only brings dry weather, while India's monsoon always brings heavy rain
The Philippines is more influenced by typhoons than India because of its location in the Pacific
India has two monsoon seasons per year while the Philippines has only one
The Philippines receives monsoon winds from the north while India gets them from the south
explanation: The Philippines has more typhoon influence than India because of its location in the Pacific Ocean.
fact_tl: Ang monsoon ng Pilipinas at ng India ay parehong dulot ng pagkakaiba ng temperatura ng lupa at karagatan; gayunpaman, ang Pilipinas ay may mas maraming impact mula sa mga bagyo kaysa India dahil sa lokasyon nito sa Pacific.
fact_bis: Ang monsoon sa Pilipinas ug sa India pareho nga gikan sa pagkakalainlain sa temperatura sa yuta ug kadagatan; apan, ang Pilipinas adunay mas daghang impluwensya sa bagyo kaysa India tungod sa iyang lokasyon sa Pacific.

q: What are nephrons, and what do they do inside the kidneys?
options: They are the large chambers that hold urine before it leaves the body
They are tiny filters where blood is cleaned and useful substances are returned to the blood
They are blood vessels that carry waste away from the kidneys to the lungs
They are nerves that signal the brain when the kidneys need to work harder
explanation: Nephrons are tiny filters packed inside each kidney where filtering happens and useful substances are returned to the blood.
fact_tl: Ang bawat bato ay puno ng napakaliliit na pansala na tinatawag na nephron. Dito nangyayari ang pagsala at ang pagbalik ng mga kapaki-pakinabang na sangkap sa dugo. Napakarami nito sa loob ng bawat bato, kaya kahit maliit ang bato, marami itong magagawa.
fact_bis: Ang matag kidney puno sa gagmay kaayong pansala nga gitawag og nephron. Dinhi mahitabo ang pagsala ug ang pagbalik sa mapuslanong mga sangkap ngadto sa dugo. Daghan kaayo kini sa sulod sa matag kidney, mao nga bisan gamay ang kidney, daghan kini mahimo.

q: What is Usain Bolt's world record time for running 100 meters?
options: 9.12 seconds
9.34 seconds
9.58 seconds
9.74 seconds
explanation: Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record is 9.58 seconds, set in 2009.
fact_tl: Ang record ni Usain Bolt sa 100 metro ay 9.58 segundo, na itinakda noong 2009.
fact_bis: Ang rekord ni Usain Bolt sa 100 ka metro mao ang 9.58 ka segundo, gibutang niadtong 2009.

q: What do PAGASA's Doppler radars across the Philippines help scientists do?
options: They measure how deep the ocean is around each island in the Philippines
They monitor typhoons, rainfall, and dangerous weather conditions in real time
They track the movement of migratory birds across the Philippine islands
They measure air quality and pollution levels in major Philippine cities
explanation: PAGASA's network of Doppler radars helps monitor typhoons, rainfall, and dangerous weather conditions in real time.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ay may network ng mga Doppler radar sa iba't ibang bahagi ng Pilipinas; tinutulungan ng mga radar na ito na subaybayan ang mga bagyo, ulan, at mapanganib na kalagayan ng panahon sa real-time.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA adunay network sa mga Doppler radar sa lain-laing bahin sa Pilipinas; kini nga mga radar nagtabang sa pagmonitor sa mga bagyo, ulan, ug peligrosong kondisyon sa panahon sa real time.

q: How does a star produce its light?
options: Through nuclear fusion inside its core
By burning fuel like wood in a campfire
By reflecting light from nearby planets
By releasing stored chemical energy
explanation: A star's light comes from fusion, not from burning — stars cannot burn like fire because there is no oxygen or wood-like fuel in space.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na ang bituin ay parang nasusunog na apoy, pero mali ito. Ang apoy ay nangangailangan ng oxygen at kahoy, pero walang ganoon sa kalawakan. Ang liwanag ng bituin ay galing sa fusion, hindi sa pagkasunog.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang bituon murag nagdilaab nga kalayo, apan sayop kana. Ang kalayo nanginahanglan og oxygen ug sugnod sama sa kahoy, ug wala niana sa kawanangan. Ang kahayag sa bituon gikan sa fusion, dili sa pagkasunog.

q: What is all matter made of?
options: Very tiny pieces called particles
Layers of smooth, solid sheets
A mix of water and air pockets
Invisible waves of energy
explanation: All matter is made of very tiny pieces called particles, which are too small to see with the naked eye.
fact_tl: Lahat ng bagay ay binubuo ng napakaliliit na piraso na tinatawag na mga partikulo, na masyadong maliit para makita.
fact_bis: Ang tanang butang gilangkoban sa gagmay kaayong piraso nga gitawag og partikulo, nga gamay ra kaayo aron makita.

q: Who founded the Apple company in 1976?
options: Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak
Bill Gates and Paul Allen
Mark Zuckerberg and Eduardo Saverin
Elon Musk and Larry Page
explanation: Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak founded the Apple company together in 1976.
fact_tl: Sina Steve Jobs at Steve Wozniak ang nagtatag ng kompanyang Apple noong 1976.
fact_bis: Sila si Steve Jobs ug Steve Wozniak ang nagtukod sa kompanya nga Apple niadtong 1976.

q: What part of the body does hepatitis affect?
options: The liver
The kidneys
The lungs
The stomach
explanation: Hepatitis is a disease in which the liver becomes swollen or damaged.
fact_tl: Ang hepatitis ay sakit kung saan namamaga o nasisira ang atay.
fact_bis: Ang hepatitis usa ka sakit diin ang atay namaga o madaot.

q: Why is it good to eat different kinds of leafy greens every day?
options: To get balanced nutrition
To grow taller quickly
To make your teeth stronger
To avoid getting sleepy after meals
explanation: Eating a variety of leafy greens each day provides balanced nutrition for the body.
fact_tl: Mainam kumain ng sari-saring gulay na dahon araw-araw para makakuha ng balanseng sustansya.
fact_bis: Maayo nga mokaon og nagkalainlaing utanon nga dahon kada adlaw aron makakuha og balanse nga sustansya.

q: What useful fuel can be made from the sap of the nipa plant?
options: Ethanol (alcohol fuel)
Diesel oil
Kerosene
Natural gas
explanation: The sweet sap of the nipa can be turned into alcohol or ethanol that may be used as fuel.
fact_tl: Ang matamis na katas ng nipa ay maaaring gawing alkohol o ethanol na pwedeng gamitin bilang gatong.
fact_bis: Ang tam-is nga duga sa nipa mahimong himuong alkohol o ethanol nga magamit isip sugnod.

q: Why might scientists change a species' scientific name?
options: When new evidence like DNA shows its true relationship to other species
When the animal's color or size changes over time
When more than five scientists disagree with the old name
When the animal moves to a different country
explanation: Scientists may change a species' scientific name when new evidence, like DNA, shows its true relationship to other kinds of living things.
fact_tl: Maaaring baguhin ng mga siyentista ang pangalang siyentipiko ng isang species kapag may bagong ebidensiya, gaya ng DNA, na nagpapakita ng tunay nitong pagkakaugnay sa ibang uri.
fact_bis: Mahimong usbon sa mga siyentista ang ngalang siyentipiko sa usa ka species kon adunay bag-ong ebidensiya, sama sa DNA, nga nagpakita sa tinuod niini nga pagkaparyente sa ubang matang.

q: What happens to the vertical motion of a flying projectile due to gravity?
options: It slows while rising and speeds up while falling
It stays the same speed the whole time
It speeds up while rising and slows while falling
It moves sideways instead of up or down
explanation: Gravity pulls the projectile down, so the vertical part of its motion slows while rising and speeds up while falling.
fact_tl: Habang lumilipad ang projectile, hinihila ito pababa ng gravity kaya ang patayong bahagi ng galaw ay bumabagal kapag pataas at lalong bumibilis kapag pababa.
fact_bis: Samtang naglupad ang projectile, ang gravity nagbira niini paubos mao nga ang patindog nga bahin sa lihok mohinay kung pasaka ug mas mopaspas kung paubos.

q: What actually happens if you cut an earthworm in half?
options: Usually only the head end survives
Both halves grow into new worms
Neither half survives
The worm rejoins itself quickly
explanation: It is not true that cutting an earthworm makes two living worms; usually only the head end survives.
fact_tl: Hindi totoo na nagiging dalawang buhay na uod ang isang bulate kapag pinutol; karaniwang ang bahaging may ulo lang ang nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Dili tinuod nga mahimong duha ka buhi nga ulod ang usa ka bulate kung putlon; kasagaran ang bahin lang nga adunay ulo ang mabuhi.

q: What does the vampire squid actually eat?
options: Bits of dead, falling food in the deep ocean
The blood of deep-sea fish
Living shrimp and small crabs
Algae growing on the seafloor
explanation: Despite its scary name, the vampire squid does not bite for blood but only eats bits of dead, falling food in the deep.
fact_tl: Sa kabila ng nakakatakot nitong pangalan, ang vampire squid ay hindi nangangagat ng dugo kundi kumakain lamang ng mga nahuhulog na patay na piraso ng pagkain sa kailaliman.
fact_bis: Bisan pa sa makahadlok niini nga ngalan, ang vampire squid dili mopaak og dugo kondili mokaon lang sa nahulog nga patay nga tipik sa pagkaon sa kalaliman.

q: How are termites able to digest wood?
options: Special microbes in their gut break down the wood's cellulose into nutrients
Their sharp teeth grind the wood into a fine powder they absorb
They produce strong acid in their stomachs that dissolves wood
They mix wood with saliva and let it ferment outside their bodies
explanation: Termites can digest wood cellulose thanks to special microbes in their gut that break down cellulose into nutrients the termites absorb.
fact_tl: Ang mga anay ay nakakakain ng kahoy na may cellulose dahil sa mga espesyal na mikrobyo sa kanilang tiyan na tumutulong sa pagtunaw ng cellulose na hindi natin kayang tunawin.
fact_bis: Ang mga anay makakaon og kahoy nga adunay cellulose tungod sa mga espesyal nga mikrobyo sa ilang tiyan nga nagtabang sa pagtunaw sa cellulose nga dili nato matinaaw.

q: How does a nautilus control whether it floats up or sinks in the water?
options: By adjusting the amount of gas and liquid in its shell chambers
By flapping its tentacles rapidly up or down
By swallowing or spitting out seawater
By inflating a special air bladder near its head
explanation: The nautilus adjusts gas and liquid in its shell chambers to float up or sink, much like a submarine.
fact_tl: Ang nautilus ay nag-aayos ng gas at likido sa mga silid ng kabibe nito para makalutang o lumubog na parang submarino.
fact_bis: Ang nautilus mag-usab sa gas ug likido sa mga lawak sa kabhang niini aron molutang o molubog sama sa submarino.

q: What does it mean when we say a wheel is spinning faster?
options: It completes more full turns in the same amount of time
It moves in a larger circle than before
It takes longer to come to a stop
It produces more heat as it turns
explanation: Faster spin means an object completes more full turns in the same amount of time — for example, two turns per second is faster than one turn per second.
fact_tl: Ang 'mas mabilis na pag-ikot' ay ibig sabihin mas maraming buong ikot ang nagagawa ng isang bagay sa loob ng parehong oras. Halimbawa, kung ang isang gulong ay umiikot ng 2 beses kada segundo, mas mabilis ito kaysa sa umiikot ng 1 beses kada segundo.
fact_bis: Ang 'mas paspas nga pagtuyok' nagpasabot nga ang usa ka butang makahuman og mas daghang tibuok nga liko sulod sa parehas nga panahon. Pananglitan, ang ligid nga molibot og duha ka beses kada segundo mas paspas kaysa sa molibot og kausa kada segundo.

q: What is the scientific name of the sampaguita flower?
options: Jasminum sambac
Rosa philippinensis
Hibiscus rosa-sinensis
Plumeria acutifolia
explanation: The scientific name of the sampaguita is Jasminum sambac, a type of jasmine.
fact_tl: Ang siyentipikong pangalan ng sampaguita ay Jasminum sambac, isang uri ng jasmine.
fact_bis: Ang siyentipikong ngalan sa sampaguita mao ang Jasminum sambac, usa ka matang sa jasmine.

q: What special feature helps a pufferfish fill up with water when threatened?
options: A very stretchy, elastic stomach
A set of water-absorbing gills
A flexible beak that opens very wide
A hollow spine that draws in water
explanation: A pufferfish has a very stretchy, elastic stomach that lets it fill up with lots of water.
fact_tl: Ang tiyan ng butete ay nababanat na parang goma kaya kaya nitong punuin ng maraming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tiyan sa butete maunat kaayo morag goma maong kaya niini pun-on og daghang tubig.

q: What does a millipede do when it feels scared?
options: It curls into a coil
It bites with its front legs
It sprays venom from its tail
It burrows quickly underground
explanation: A millipede does not bite; instead it curls into a coil when it is scared.
fact_tl: Ang millipede ay hindi nangangagat; sa halip, namamaluktot ito na parang singsing kapag natatakot.
fact_bis: Ang millipede dili mopaak; hinuon molikit kini nga daw singsing kon mahadlok.

q: After whom is the unit of frequency, the hertz (Hz), named?
options: Heinrich Hertz
James Watt
Isaac Newton
Michael Faraday
explanation: The hertz (Hz), the unit of frequency, is named after Heinrich Hertz.
fact_tl: Ang hertz (Hz), ang yunit ng prekwensya, ay ipinangalan kay Heinrich Hertz.
fact_bis: Ang hertz (Hz), ang yunit sa prekwensya, ginganlan kay Heinrich Hertz.

q: What do maya bird eggs look like?
options: They are small and spotted
They are large and solid blue
They are plain white without any markings
They are dark brown with black stripes
explanation: The maya lays small spotted eggs, and after a few days the chicks hatch from them.
fact_tl: Nangingitlog ang maya ng maliliit na itlog na may batik, at pagkalipas ng ilang araw ay napipisa ang mga inakay.
fact_bis: Ang maya mangitlog og gagmayng itlog nga adunay batik, ug human sa pipila ka adlaw mamusa ang mga piso.

q: Which of these correctly lists three regions of the human spine?
options: Neck, chest, and lower-back regions
Head, shoulder, and hip regions
Upper, middle, and tailbone sections only
Front, back, and side columns
explanation: The spine has different regions: the neck part, the chest part, and the lower-back part.
fact_tl: Ang gulugod ay may iba't ibang bahagi: ang leeg, ang dibdib, at ang ibabang bahagi ng likod.
fact_bis: Ang gulugod adunay lain-laing bahin: ang liog, ang dughan, ug ang ubos nga bahin sa likod.

q: What does a newly hatched snail often eat first?
options: Its own eggshell to get calcium
A nearby leaf for energy
Soil to get minerals
Another snail's discarded shell
explanation: A newly hatched snail often first eats its own eggshell to get calcium before moving on to plants.
fact_tl: Ang bagong pisa na kuhol ay madalas unang kumakain ng balat ng sarili nitong itlog para makakuha ng calcium bago ito lumipat sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong napusa nga kuhol kasagarang mokaon una sa iyang kaugalingong balat sa itlog aron makakuha og calcium una mobalhin sa mga tanom.

q: How are soldier ants different from worker ants in some species?
options: Soldier ants have larger heads and mandibles built for defense
Soldier ants have wings so they can fly away from danger
Soldier ants are smaller and faster for chasing enemies
Soldier ants carry food while workers guard the nest
explanation: In some species, soldier ants have larger heads and mandibles than workers — they are specially sized to defend the colony.
fact_tl: Sa ilang mga species, ang mga sundalo (soldier ants) ay may mas malalaking ulo at mandibles kaysa sa mga manggagawa—espesyal silang ginawa para ipagtanggol ang koloni.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka species, ang mga sundalo (soldier ants) adunay mas dakong ulo ug mandibles kaysa sa mga manggagawa—espesyal silang gidisenyo para panalipdan ang kolonya.

q: What are an elephant's tusks?
options: Long teeth that stick out from its mouth
Hardened pieces of bone from its skull
Curved horns that grow from its forehead
Thick nails that grow from its feet
explanation: An elephant's tusks are long teeth that stick out from its mouth.
fact_tl: Ang pangil ng elepante ay mahabang ngipin na lumalabas sa bibig nito.
fact_bis: Ang tango sa elepante taas nga ngipin nga mogawas sa baba niini.

q: How does a refrigerator keep food cold inside?
options: It moves heat from inside to the air at the back
It produces cold air and pumps it in
It freezes the air inside using electricity directly
It absorbs sunlight and converts it to cold energy
explanation: A refrigerator does not make cold — instead it moves heat out from inside to the air at the back, so the inside stays cold while the coils behind it feel warm.
fact_tl: Hindi gumagawa ng lamig ang refrigerator — sa halip, inilalabas nito ang init mula sa loob papunta sa hangin sa likuran, kaya nananatiling malamig ang loob at mainit ang mga tubo sa likod.
fact_bis: Ang refrigerator dili maghimo og bugnaw — hinuon ginakuha niini ang kainit gikan sa sulod ngadto sa hangin sa likod, mao nga magpabilin nga bugnaw ang sulod ug init ang mga tubo sa luyo.

q: Why can't we see the Moon during a new moon?
options: The Moon is between Earth and the Sun so its lit side faces away from us
Earth's shadow covers the entire Moon
The Moon is on the far side of the Sun from Earth
Clouds always block the Moon during this phase
explanation: At new moon, the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun, so we cannot see its lit side.
fact_tl: Sa new moon (bagong buwan), nasa pagitan ng Earth at Araw ang Buwan kaya hindi natin nakikita ang naliliwanagang bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Sa new moon (bag-ong bulan), ang Bulan naa sa tunga sa Yuta ug Adlaw mao nga dili nato makita ang nahayagan nga bahin niini.

q: How long does it typically take for a mango seed to sprout after planting?
options: A few weeks
Only one or two days
About six months
Several years
explanation: A mango seed can take a few weeks before a shoot appears, so patience and regular watering are needed.
fact_tl: Hindi agad tumutubo ang buto ng mangga. Maaaring tumagal ng ilang linggo bago lumabas ang usbong, kaya kailangan ng pasensya at patuloy na pagdidilig.
