fact_bis: Adunay tin-aw nga kalibutanon nga sumbanan: ang mga linog, bulkan, ug kabukiran dili nagkatag lang sa walay han-ay kondili naglinya daplin sa mga ngilit sa tectonic plate, busa ang mapa niini magpakita kanato asa ang mga plate boundary.

q: Why are there almost no snakes in places that are always snowy and freezing cold?
options: Snakes cannot swim in melted snow so they cannot find water
Snake scales crack in very cold temperatures and fall off
Snakes are cold-blooded and cannot warm themselves without heat from the surroundings
Snow covers the ground, so snakes have no sand to hide in
explanation: Snakes are cold-blooded and cannot warm themselves if there is no heat in the surroundings, so they cannot survive in freezing places.
fact_tl: Sa mga lugar na palaging may niyebe o sobrang lamig, halos walang ahas. Dahil cold-blooded sila, hindi nila kayang painitin ang sarili kung walang init mula sa paligid—kaya mamamatay sila sa lamig. Kaya marami silang nakatira sa mainit na lugar tulad ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Sa mga dapit nga kanunay snowy o sobra ka bugnaw, halos walay bitin. Tungod kay cold-blooded sila, dili nila mapainit ang kaugalingon kon walay kainit gikan sa palibot—busa mamatay sila sa katugnaw. Mao nga daghan kanila nagpuyo sa init nga dapit sama sa Pilipinas.

q: How does concrete's strength change after it is poured?
options: It reaches full strength in 24 hours and then stays the same
It is strongest when first poured and gradually weakens over time
It keeps getting stronger over several weeks, typically measured after 28 days
It hardens all at once when it dries, usually overnight
explanation: Concrete does not harden all at once; it keeps getting stronger over weeks, and its strength is usually measured after 28 days.
fact_tl: Hindi biglaang tumitigas ang konkreto—patuloy itong lumalakas sa loob ng mga linggo, at karaniwang sinusukat ang lakas nito pagkatapos ng 28 araw.
fact_bis: Dili kalit nga mogahi ang konkreto—padayon kining molig-on sulod sa mga semana, ug kasagaran sukdon ang kusog niini human sa 28 ka adlaw.

q: How does a python squeeze and hold its prey?
options: It only wraps its tail tightly around the prey's neck
It uses its jaw muscles alone to grip the prey
It uses almost its whole body to coil around and tighten on the prey
It bites with venom and then waits for the prey to fall
explanation: A python uses almost its whole body to coil around and tighten on prey with its strong muscles, not just one part.
fact_tl: Hindi lang buntot o iisang bahagi ang gamit ng sawa para pumiga; ginagamit nito ang halos buong katawan upang pulupot at higpitan ang biktima gamit ang malalakas na kalamnan.
fact_bis: Ang sawa dili mopiga gamit lang ang ikog o usa ka bahin; gamiton niini ang halos tibuok lawas aron molikos ug mohugot sa biktima gamit ang kusgan nga kaunoran.

q: What are barnacles, and where do they attach themselves?
options: They are small fish that swim inside whale mouths to eat leftover food
They are tiny shelled animals that attach to and ride on the skin of whales
They are parasitic worms that burrow into whale blubber
They are tiny jellyfish that float alongside whales for protection
explanation: Barnacles are tiny shelled animals that attach themselves and ride on the skin of whales.
fact_tl: Ang mga barnacle ay maliliit na hayop na dumidikit at nakikisakay sa balat ng balyena.
fact_bis: Ang mga barnacle gagmayng mananap nga adunay kabibe nga mopilit ug mosakay sa panit sa balyena.

q: What does the prime meridian divide the Earth into?
options: The Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere
The Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn
The Eastern Hemisphere and the Western Hemisphere
The Arctic and the Antarctic regions
explanation: The prime meridian divides the Earth into the Eastern Hemisphere and the Western Hemisphere.
fact_tl: Hinahati ng prime meridian ang Mundo sa Eastern Hemisphere (silangan) at Western Hemisphere (kanluran).
fact_bis: Ang prime meridian nagbahin sa Kalibutan sa Eastern Hemisphere (sidlakan) ug Western Hemisphere (kasadpan).

q: How does studying a snake's tongue help scientists and inventors?
options: It shows how to make better venom antidotes for hospitals
It helps design new sensors or machines that can detect smells
It reveals how to make tongues longer in other reptiles
It helps doctors understand how the human tongue works
explanation: Scientists study how a snake's tongue works to help design new sensors or machines that can detect smells, showing how nature inspires technology.
fact_tl: Pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko kung paano gumagana ang dila ng ahas para makagawa ng mga bagong sensor o makina na nakakaamoy. Natutulungan tayo ng kalikasan na mag-imbento ng kapaki-pakinabang na teknolohiya.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga siyentista kung giunsa paglihok ang dila sa ahas aron makahimo ug bag-ong sensor o makina nga makapanimaho. Ang kinaiyahan motabang nato sa pag-imbento ug mapuslanong teknolohiya.

q: Long ago, why did humans get goosebumps when they felt cold?
options: The bumps acted like tiny shields to block cold wind
The skin swells to push warm blood closer to the surface
The tiny hairs standing up trapped warm air close to the skin
The bumps released heat stored inside the skin
explanation: When you feel cold, tiny hairs on your skin stand up, and long ago this helped trap warm air close to the skin to keep you warmer.
fact_tl: Kapag nilalamig ka, tumitindig ang maliliit na balahibo sa balat mo at nagkakaroon ng goosebumps. Dati, nakakatulong ito para mahuli ang mainit na hangin malapit sa balat para mainitan ka.
fact_bis: Kung tugnawon ka, motindog ang gagmay nga balahibo sa imong panit ug magka-goosebumps. Kaniadto, nakatabang ni aron malit-ag ang init nga hangin duol sa panit aron mainitan ka.

q: How do large forest trees like the narra help animals?
options: They produce fruit that is poisonous to predators only
They provide food by eating insects that harm animals
They become homes for birds and other animals
They release a gas that repels mosquitoes in the forest
explanation: Forest trees like the narra become homes for birds and other animals, providing shelter in the forest.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno sa gubat tulad ng narra ay nagiging tahanan ng mga ibon at iba pang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy sa lasang sama sa narra mahimong puy-anan sa mga langgam ug uban pang mananap.

q: What happens to an enzyme if the temperature or pH in a cell is too extreme?
options: The enzyme moves to a safer part of the cell to keep working
The enzyme produces more copies of itself to compensate
The enzyme's active site changes shape and it stops working — a process called denaturation
The enzyme speeds up to finish its job before conditions get worse
explanation: If temperature or pH is too extreme, an enzyme's active site changes shape and it stops working, a process called denaturation.
fact_tl: Ang mga enzyme ay nagtatrabaho nang pinakamahusay sa isang partikular na temperatura at pH — kapag napakaInit o napaka-acidic, ang hugis ng active site ay nagbabago at ang enzyme ay nabi-bigo, isang proseso na tinatawag na denaturation.
fact_bis: Ang mga enzyme nagtrabaho sa pinakamaayo sa usa ka partikular nga temperatura ug pH — kung hilabihang painit o sayop ang pH, ang hugis sa active site nagbag-o ug ang enzyme mohunong sa pagtrabaho, usa ka proseso nga gitawag og denaturation.

q: Where does most of the world's energy come from today?
options: Solar and wind power
Hydroelectric dams
Nuclear power plants
Fossil fuels
explanation: Today, most of the world's energy still comes from fossil fuels, which is why countries are working to shift to renewable energy.
fact_tl: Sa kasalukuyan, karamihan ng enerhiya ng mundo ay galing pa rin sa fossil fuels, kaya unti-unting lumilipat ang mga bansa sa renewable energy upang hindi maubusan.
fact_bis: Karon, kadaghanan sa enerhiya sa kalibotan gikan gihapon sa fossil fuels, mao nga hinay-hinay nga molipat ang mga nasod sa renewable energy aron dili mahutdan.

q: What happens to the tiny particles inside water as it cools down and freezes into ice?
options: They speed up and spread apart to fill more space
They stay the same speed but group into bubbles
They slow down and lock into a firm pattern to become ice
They completely stop moving and disappear into the ice crystal
explanation: As water cools, its particles slow down until they lock into a firm pattern and become ice; when melting, they speed up and spread apart again.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng tubig, mabilis gumagalaw ang maliliit na particles. Kapag lumalamig, bumabagal sila hanggang mag-ayos sila sa matibay na pattern at maging yelo. Sa pagtunaw naman, bumibilis silang muli at nagkakalat.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa tubig, paspas molihok ang gagmay nga mga particle. Kung mabugnaw, mohinay sila hangtod nga magpahimutang sa lig-on nga pattern ug mahimong yelo. Sa pagtunaw, mopaspas sila pag-usab ug magkatibulaag.

q: How do a crab's eyes help it spot danger from many directions at once?
options: Its eyes change color to attract predators away from its body
Its eyes can see underwater but not in the air
Its eyes sit on tall movable stalks, so it can see almost all around itself without turning its body
Its eyes glow in the dark so it can spot predators at night
explanation: A crab's eyes sit on tall stalks that it can turn, allowing it to see almost all around itself without moving its body, helping it spot predators quickly.
fact_tl: Dahil nasa matataas na tangkay ang mga mata ng alimango at kaya nilang ikutin ito, halos makakita sila sa buong paligid nila nang hindi inililiko ang katawan. Kaya kahit nasa likod o gilid ang kaaway, agad nila itong nakikita at nakakatakas sila.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang mga mata sa alimango anaa sa taas nga tangkay nga ila mang matuyok, halos makakita sila sa tibuok nilang palibot nga dili lingion ang lawas. Mao nga bisan sa luyo o kilid ang kaaway, dali ra nila kini makita ug makaikyas sila.

q: What does the outer bark of a tree prevent?
options: It prevents the tree from losing water into the air
It prevents insects from laying eggs inside the tree
It prevents the tree's roots from growing too deep
It prevents sunlight from reaching the inner wood
explanation: The outer bark acts like a thin raincoat that keeps the tree's water from escaping into the air.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pagtatakip, pinipigilan ng panlabas na balat na matuyo ang puno. Para itong manipis na kapote na humaharang sa tubig para hindi sumingaw palabas ang basa mula sa loob.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagtabon, ang gawas nga panit mopugong nga mauga ang kahoy. Murag nipis nga kapote kini nga mobabag aron dili mosingaw pagawas ang tubig gikan sa sulod.

q: Why do dolphins and whales have to come up to the water's surface regularly?
options: To look for food floating on the surface
To warm their skin in the sunlight
To breathe air because they have lungs, not gills
To communicate with other animals above water
explanation: Dolphins and whales breathe air with lungs, unlike fish that breathe underwater using gills, so they must surface to breathe.
fact_tl: Ang isda ay humihinga gamit ang hasang (gills) sa ilalim ng tubig, pero ang lumba-lumba at balyena ay humihinga ng hangin gamit ang baga (lungs). Kaya kailangan nilang umahon para huminga.
fact_bis: Ang isda moginhawa gamit ang hasang (gills) ilalom sa tubig, apan ang lumba-lumba ug balyena moginhawa og hangin gamit ang baga (lungs). Mao nga kinahanglan sila motungha aron makaginhawa.

q: Instead of a brain, what do echinoderms use to control their body?
options: A single large nerve cluster near their stomach
A ring of nerves that connects through their whole body
A simple spinal cord running from top to bottom
Tiny nerve cells scattered only in their arms
explanation: Echinoderms have no head and no brain; a ring of nerves connects through their entire body instead.
fact_tl: Ang mga echinoderm ay walang ulo at walang utak; sa halip, may singsing ng mga nerbiyo na umuugnay sa buong katawan nila.
fact_bis: Ang mga echinoderm walay ulo ug walay utok; hinuon, adunay singsing sa mga nerbiyo nga nagdugtong sa tibuok nilang lawas.

q: How does a clownfish avoid being stung by the sea anemone it lives in?
options: It moves too fast for the anemone's stingers to touch it
It makes its mucus coat similar to the anemone's own chemicals so the stingers don't fire
It has a hard shell that the anemone's stingers cannot pierce
It releases a liquid that paralyzes the anemone's stinging cells permanently
explanation: Clownfish gradually adapt their mucus layer to mimic the anemone's chemical signature, preventing the nematocysts from firing.
fact_tl: Ang clownfish ay nagtatamo ng immunity sa mga stinging tentakulo ng anemone sa pamamagitan ng paulit-ulit na pagdampi sa anemone — unti-unti nitong naaangkop ang kanyang sariling mucus layer upang magtulad sa chemical signature ng anemone, na nagpipigil sa nematocyst na umaksyon.
fact_bis: Ang clownfish nagkuha og imyunidad sa mga stinging tentakulo sa anemone pinaagi sa paulit-ulit nga pagdampi sa anemone — hinay-hinay nilang inaangkop ang ilang kaugalingong mucus layer aron tularon ang chemical signature sa anemone, nagpugong sa nematocyst gikan sa pag-aksiyon.

q: What type of simple machine are a barber's scissors?
options: A wheel and axle
A lever
An inclined plane
A pulley
explanation: Scissors are lever machines, and barbers and tailors in the Philippines use scissor-levers every day.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ginagamit ng mga barbero at mananahi ang gunting na palanca araw-araw. Ang manipis na gunting ng barbero ay para sa buhok, at ang malaking gunting ng modista ay para sa tela.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga barbero ug mananahi mogamit og gunting nga palanca matag adlaw. Ang nipis nga gunting sa barbero para sa buhok, ug ang dako nga gunting sa modista para sa panapton.

q: What happens to a fish ball when it is fried in hot oil?
options: It cools down and becomes harder without changing color
It cooks, turns brown, and changes in taste
It absorbs water and becomes softer and lighter
It stays the same but becomes safer to eat
explanation: In frying, hot oil carries heat into the fish ball so it cooks, turns brown, and changes in taste.
fact_tl: Sa pagprito, dinadala ng mainit na mantika ang init sa fishball kaya ito naluluto, namumula, at nagbabago ang lasa.
fact_bis: Sa pagprito, ang init nga lana magdala sa kainit ngadto sa fishball mao nga maluto kini, mamula, ug mausab ang lami.

q: Why do we see the Milky Way as a band of stars across the sky?
options: Because all the stars in the galaxy orbit the same bright center star
Because we live inside a flat disk-shaped galaxy and see it edge-on from within
Because the Milky Way's stars are arranged in a perfect ring around Earth
Because Earth's atmosphere bends starlight into a curved band
explanation: We live inside the Milky Way's flat disk, so looking along the disk we see it as a band across the sky.
fact_tl: Ang Milky Way ay hugis isang lapad at manipis na disk na may umbok na siksik na bituin sa gitna; nasa loob tayo ng disk na ito kaya nakikita natin ito bilang guhit sa langit.
fact_bis: Ang Milky Way porma og lapad ug nipis nga disk nga adunay umbok nga baga ang bituon sa tunga; naa kita sulod niini nga disk maong makita nato kini isip guhit sa langit.

q: What is special about a glass frog's belly skin?
options: It is very thick and acts like armor to protect internal organs
It is so thin and clear that you can see some internal organs through it
It changes color to match its background like a chameleon
It produces poison that oozes out when the frog is touched
explanation: A glass frog's belly skin is so thin and clear that organs like the heart can be seen right through it.
fact_tl: May mga uri ng palaka na tinatawag na glass frog na napakanipis at malinaw ng balat sa tiyan, kaya makikita mismo mula sa labas ang ilang panloob na bahagi nito tulad ng puso.
fact_bis: Adunay mga matang sa baki nga gitawag og glass frog kansang panit sa tiyan nipis ug tin-aw kaayo, mao nga makita gikan sa gawas ang pipila ka sulod niini sama sa kasingkasing.

q: In what year were the Tagalog words of the Philippine national anthem first sung?
explanation: The Tagalog words "Lupang Hinirang" were first sung in 1956.
fact_tl: Unang inawit ang Tagalog na titik na "Lupang Hinirang" noong 1956.
fact_bis: Ang Tagalog nga liriko nga "Lupang Hinirang" unang giawit niadtong 1956.

q: What caused the deadly tsunami in Indonesia in 2018 near Anak Krakatau?
options: A very strong underwater earthquake shook the ocean floor
The side of a sea volcano collapsed into the water
An unusually powerful tropical storm pushed the sea inward
Underground magma heated the seawater until it exploded upward
explanation: The side of a sea volcano collapsed and caused a tsunami even without a strong earthquake, showing that quakes are not always the cause.
fact_tl: Noong 2018 sa Indonesia, isang malapit nating kapitbahay, gumuho ang gilid ng isang bulkan sa dagat at gumawa ito ng tsunami kahit walang malakas na lindol. Ipinapakita nito na hindi laging lindol ang sanhi.
fact_bis: Niadtong 2018 sa Indonesia, usa ka duol natong silingan, natumpag ang kilid sa usa ka bulkan sa dagat ug nakahimo kini og tsunami bisan walay kusog nga linog. Nagpakita kini nga dili kanunay linog ang hinungdan.

q: What did Isaac Newton use to split white light into its colors?
options: A magnifying glass
A mirror
A prism
A telescope
explanation: Isaac Newton used a prism to split white light into its colors.
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ang gumamit ng prisma para hatiin ang puting liwanag sa mga kulay nito.
fact_bis: Si Isaac Newton ang naggamit og prisma aron bahinon ang puti nga kahayag ngadto sa mga kolor niini.

q: Where is a storm surge likely to be highest?
options: Where the coast is steep and the water is very deep
Where the sea is shallow and the coast is flat
Where large coral reefs slow the incoming water
Where strong offshore winds push water away from land
explanation: A storm surge is higher where the sea is shallow and the coast is flat because the water piles up more easily there.
fact_tl: Mas mataas ang storm surge sa mga lugar na mababaw at patag ang dagat, dahil mas madaling maipon doon ang tubig.
fact_bis: Mas taas ang storm surge sa mga dapit nga mabaw ug patag ang dagat, kay sayon ra didto mapundok ang tubig.

q: What do whiteflies do when the leaves of the plant they are on get disturbed?
options: They burrow deeper into the leaf tissue to hide
They fly up in a white cloud
They spray a sticky liquid to trap the intruder
They stay perfectly still and flatten against the leaf
explanation: Whiteflies are tiny sap-sucking insects that fly up in a cloud when the plant's leaves are disturbed.
fact_tl: Ang whitefly ay maliliit na puting insektong sumususo ng katas at lumilipad kapag nagulo ang dahon ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang whitefly gagmay nga puti nga insekto nga nagasupsop ug duga ug molupad kon masamok ang dahon sa tanom.

q: What kind of feathers do baby chicks have, and what do those feathers do?
options: Hard flight feathers that help them start flying early
Soft down feathers that keep them warm
Waterproof oil feathers that protect them from rain
Bright colored feathers that help their mother find them
explanation: Baby chicks have soft down feathers that keep them warm before stronger flight feathers grow in.
fact_tl: Ang mga sisiw ay may malalambot na balahibong down na nagpapainit sa kanila bago tumubo ang mas matitigas na balahibo para sa paglipad.
fact_bis: Ang mga piso adunay humok nga down nga balhibo nga mopainit kanila sa wala pa motubo ang mas gahi nga mga balhibo para sa paglupad.

q: What do scientists believe caused the dinosaurs to die out?
options: A worldwide drought that dried up all their water sources
A giant asteroid that struck the Earth
A deadly disease that spread among all species
Massive volcanic eruptions that covered every continent in lava
explanation: Scientists believe a giant asteroid that struck the Earth caused the dinosaurs to die out.
fact_tl: Naniniwala ang mga siyentista na isang malaking asteroid na bumagsak sa Earth ang nakapatay sa mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Nagtuo ang mga siyentista nga usa ka dako nga asteroid nga nahulog sa Yuta maoy nakapatay sa mga dinosaur.

q: Why is a firefly's light considered more efficient than an ordinary light bulb?
options: A firefly produces light only at night when energy is cheaper to use
Almost all of a firefly's energy becomes light, while a bulb wastes much energy as heat
A firefly can produce light for months without resting or eating
A firefly's light is brighter than a bulb of the same size
explanation: Almost all of a firefly's light energy becomes light, making it more efficient than an ordinary bulb that wastes energy as heat.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ng enerhiya sa ilaw ng alitaptap ay nagiging liwanag, kaya mas mahusay ito kaysa sa karaniwang bombilya na nag-aaksaya ng init.
fact_bis: Hapit tanang enerhiya sa kahayag sa aninipot mahimong kahayag, mao nga mas episyente kini kay sa ordinaryong bombilya nga mag-usik og init.

q: What is the role of the inner ear?
options: It gathers sound waves from the air around you
It passes vibrations from the eardrum deeper into the ear
It converts vibrations into nerve signals sent to the brain
It produces earwax to protect the ear canal from dust
explanation: The inner ear converts vibrations to nerve signals, while the outer ear gathers sound and the middle ear passes vibrations along.
fact_tl: Ang tainga ay may tatlong bahagi — ang outer ear na nagtitipon ng tunog, ang middle ear na nagpapadala ng vibration, at ang inner ear na nagko-convert ng vibration sa nerve signals.
fact_bis: Ang tainga adunay tulo ka bahin — ang outer ear nga nagtipon sa tunog, ang middle ear nga nagpadala sa vibration, ug ang inner ear nga nagpreserba sa vibration ngadto sa nerve signals.

q: Why can oxygen pass quickly from the water into a fish's body through its gills?
options: Gills store large amounts of oxygen inside a special chamber
Gills have thin walls with many tiny blood vessels close to the surface
Gills filter the water at high speed and push oxygen into the stomach
Gills produce a chemical that attracts and binds oxygen molecules
explanation: Gills are full of thin walls with many tiny blood vessels, so oxygen can quickly enter the fish's body.
fact_tl: Ang mga hasang ay puno ng manipis at maraming maliliit na ugat ng dugo, kaya mabilis na nakakapasok ang oksiheno sa katawan ng isda.
fact_bis: Ang mga hasang puno sa nipis ug daghang gagmay nga ugat sa dugo, mao nga paspas nga makasulod ang oksiheno sa lawas sa isda.

q: Why do the leaves of the makahiya plant fold when you touch them?
options: The plant sends a signal to its roots to pull the leaves downward
Water quickly moves out of certain cells, so the leaves lose their stiffness and droop
The leaves roll up to show bright colors that scare away insects
The stem contracts like a muscle to pull the leaves together
explanation: The makahiya's leaves fold because water quickly moves out of certain cells, causing them to lose stiffness and droop.
fact_tl: Nagtitiklop ang dahon ng makahiya dahil mabilis na lumalabas ang tubig sa loob ng mga selula nito, kaya nawawalan ito ng tigas.
fact_bis: Motiklop ang dahon sa makahiya kay paspas nga mogawas ang tubig sa sulod sa mga selula niini, mao nga mawad-an kinig katig-a.

q: Why do carnivores often swallow meat without much chewing?
options: Their saliva breaks down meat instantly so chewing is not needed
They have few flat teeth, so they are not built for grinding food
Their teeth are too large to fit inside their mouth comfortably
Chewing would reduce the nutrition stored in the meat
explanation: Carnivores have few flat teeth, so they often swallow meat without much chewing.
fact_tl: Ang mga karnivor ay may kaunting patag na ngipin kaya madalas nilang nilululunok ang karne nang hindi gaanong ngumunguya.
fact_bis: Ang mga karnivoro adunay gamay nga patag nga ngipon, busa sagad nilang tunlon ang karne nga dili kaayo mag-usap.

q: What can a certain type of gear do to the direction of rotation in a machine?
options: Make a slow rotation much faster without changing direction
Change the direction of turning, for example from sideways to upright
Reduce friction between moving metal parts
Lock two rotating shafts so they always spin at the same speed
explanation: Some gears can change the direction of turning, for example from sideways to upright.
fact_tl: May mga gear na nakakabaling sa direksyon ng ikot, halimbawa mula pahalang patungong patayo.
fact_bis: Adunay mga gear nga makausab sa direksyon sa pagtuyok, pananglitan gikan sa pikas paingon sa patindog.

q: Why is natural gas considered a nonrenewable energy source?
options: It can only be collected in very cold regions of the world
It is a fossil fuel that cannot be replaced once it is used up
It produces too little energy to power large machines
It turns into a solid at room temperature and is hard to store
explanation: Natural gas is a fossil fuel, meaning it is nonrenewable and cannot be replaced once burned.
fact_tl: Ang natural gas ay isang fossil fuel at nonrenewable — sinusunog ito para gumawa ng kuryente at magluto.
fact_bis: Ang natural gas usa ka fossil fuel ug nonrenewable — gisunog kini aron makahimo ug koryente ug magluto.

q: What is unusual about how often the titan arum blooms?
options: It blooms every single day but each flower lasts only a few hours
It blooms only once in several years
It blooms twice a year but only in tropical rainforests
It blooms continuously for several months then dies permanently
explanation: The titan arum rarely blooms — sometimes only once in several years.
fact_tl: Ang titan arum ay isa sa pinakamataas na namumulaklak na halaman, at gaya ng Rafflesia ay umaamoy ng patay na hayop; bihira itong mamulaklak — minsan, isa o ilang ulit lamang sa loob ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Ang titan arum usa sa pinakahabog nga namulak nga tanom, ug sama sa Rafflesia mobaho kini sama sa patayng hayop; talagsa kini mamulak — usahay kausa lang sulod sa daghang tuig.

q: What happens to Earth's warming when polar ice melts?
options: Warming slows because the exposed ocean water absorbs less sunlight than ice
Warming speeds up because darker water absorbs more heat than bright ice did
Warming stops because the meltwater cools the surrounding air
Warming has no change because ice and water hold the same amount of heat
explanation: When ice melts it exposes darker water that absorbs more heat, which speeds up the warming even more.
fact_tl: Ang maputing yelo ay nagsasalamin ng sinag ng araw pabalik sa kalawakan, kaya kapag natunaw ito ay nalalantad ang madilim na tubig o lupa na mas sumisipsip ng init, na nagpapabilis pa sa pag-init.
fact_bis: Ang puti nga yelo nagasalming sa kahayag sa adlaw balik sa kawanangan, busa kung kini matunaw mabutyag ang mas itom nga tubig o yuta nga mosuyop og dugang kainit, nga magpadali pa sa pag-init.

q: How do parrots usually live, and what are their calls like?
options: Alone and silent — they only make sounds when threatened
In pairs and they communicate with quiet whistles
In flocks, and their calls and screeches are very loud
In large groups but they communicate using body movements only
explanation: Parrots often live in flocks, and their calls and screeches are very loud.
fact_tl: Madalas na nabubuhay ang mga loro sa kawan at malakas ang kanilang mga tawag at sigaw.
fact_bis: Ang mga loro kasagaran magpuyo sa panon, ug saba kaayo ang ilang mga tawag ug singgit.

q: Why is siling haba (the long green finger chili) added to dishes like sinigang?
options: To make the dish extremely spicy and hot to the tongue
For its aroma and mild flavor rather than for heat
To thicken the broth and give it a richer color
To add protein and vitamins that the other ingredients lack
explanation: Siling haba is mild and is added to dishes for its aroma and flavor rather than for heat.
fact_tl: Ang siling haba (siling pansigang) ay mahaba at berde at hindi gaanong maanghang, kaya idinadagdag ito sa sinigang at iba pang ulam para sa amoy at lasa, hindi para sa init.
fact_bis: Ang siling haba (siling pansigang) taas ug berde ug dili kaayo mahalang, mao nga idugang kini sa sinigang ug uban pang sud-an alang sa baho ug lami, dili alang sa kainit.

q: What are the four stages of a butterfly's complete metamorphosis in order?
options: Egg, pupa, caterpillar, butterfly
Egg, caterpillar, pupa, butterfly
Larva, egg, pupa, butterfly
Egg, caterpillar, butterfly, pupa
explanation: A butterfly goes through egg, caterpillar (larva), pupa, and finally butterfly — the four stages of complete metamorphosis.
fact_tl: Ang paru-paro ay dumaraan sa ganap na metamorphosis: mula itlog, nagiging higad (caterpillar), pagkatapos ay pupa, at sa wakas ay paru-paro.
fact_bis: Ang alibangbang moagi sa kompleto nga metamorphosis: gikan sa itlog, mahimong ulod (caterpillar), dayon pupa, ug sa kataposan alibangbang.

q: Who was the first American to orbit the Earth, and when did this happen?
options: Neil Armstrong in 1969
Alan Shepard in 1961
John Glenn in 1962
Buzz Aldrin in 1965
explanation: The first American to orbit the Earth was John Glenn in 1962.
fact_tl: Ang unang Amerikanong umikot sa Earth ay si John Glenn noong 1962.
fact_bis: Ang unang Amerikano nga milibot sa Earth mao si John Glenn niadtong 1962.

q: Why is the stratosphere warmer than scientists might expect?
options: The stratosphere traps heat rising from the warm Earth below it
Ozone absorbs UV rays from the Sun and the energy turns into heat
Satellites and aircraft flying through the stratosphere release heat
The stratosphere contains heavy gases that compress and heat up
explanation: As ozone absorbs UV radiation, the energy turns into heat, which is why the stratosphere is warmer than expected.
fact_tl: Habang sinisipsip ng ozone ang UV, nagiging init ito, kaya mas mainit ang stratosphere kaysa inaakala.
fact_bis: Samtang gisuyop sa ozone ang UV, ang enerhiya mahimong kainit, mao nga mas init ang stratosphere kaysa gidahom.

q: How does a nerve signal cross the tiny gap between two neurons?
options: It jumps as an electric spark directly from one neuron to the next
Chemical messengers called neurotransmitters carry the signal across the gap
The gap closes temporarily so electrical current can flow
Tiny tubes connect the neurons and carry fluid that passes the signal
explanation: Signals cross the synapse using chemical messengers called neurotransmitters.
fact_tl: Ang synapse ay ang maliit na puwang sa pagitan ng mga neuron; ang mga signal ay tinatawid ito sa pamamagitan ng mga chemical na tinatawag na neurotransmitters.
fact_bis: Ang synapse usa ka gamay nga guwang tali sa mga neuron; ang mga signal nagtabok niini pinaagi sa mga chemical messengers nga gitawag neurotransmitters.

q: When a tablecloth is yanked away very quickly, why do the dishes stay in place?
options: Friction between the dishes and the air holds the dishes still
The dishes' inertia keeps them from moving when the cloth is pulled
The weight of the dishes is too great for the tablecloth to move them
Gravity pulls the dishes straight down faster than the cloth moves sideways
explanation: When a tablecloth is yanked quickly, the dishes stay in place because of their inertia.
fact_tl: Kapag mabilis na hinila ang mantel sa ilalim ng mga plato, nananatili sa lugar ang mga plato dahil sa kanilang inersya.
fact_bis: Kung paspas nga hawiron ang mantel ilalom sa mga plato, ang mga plato magpabilin sa ilang dapit tungod sa ilang inertia.

q: Which of the following best describes an amphibian?
options: A cold-blooded animal with dry scales that lays eggs on land only
An animal that lives both in water and on land, has moist smooth skin, and usually begins life in water
A warm-blooded animal that feeds its young with milk and breathes with lungs
An animal that lives only underwater and breathes through gills its whole life
explanation: An animal is an amphibian if it lives both in water and on land, has moist smooth skin, and usually begins life as a tadpole in water.
fact_tl: Ang isang hayop ay amphibian kung ito ay nabubuhay sa tubig at sa lupa, may basa o makinis na balat, at karaniwang nagsisimula bilang tadpole sa tubig, gaya ng palaka.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka mananap usa ka amphibian kung kini nagpuyo sa tubig ug sa yuta, adunay basa o hapsay nga panit, ug kasagaran magsugod isip tadpole sa tubig, sama sa baki.

q: How does a durian usually leave the tree when it is ripe?
options: A farmer must twist and pull it off the branch before it rots
It is eaten by bats who carry it away at night
It falls from the tree on its own when it becomes ripe
It is knocked down by strong winds before it fully ripens
explanation: A durian usually falls from the tree on its own when it becomes ripe.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nahuhulog mula sa puno ang durian kapag hinog na ito.
fact_bis: Ang durian kasagarang mahulog gikan sa kahoy kon kini hinog na.

q: Where does the trogon bird make its nest?
options: In grass nests hanging from thin branches over rivers
Inside holes or rotten parts of trees
On the ground hidden under large leaves
On rocky cliff ledges away from predators
explanation: The trogon makes its nest inside holes or rotten parts of trees.
fact_tl: Ang trogon ay gumagawa ng pugad sa loob ng mga butas o bulok na bahagi ng puno.
fact_bis: Ang trogon mohimo sa iyang salag sulod sa mga lungag o gabok nga bahin sa kahoy.

q: How does a monitor lizard find its prey?
options: It lies very still and waits for prey to walk into reach
It uses keen smell and eyesight to actively track and chase prey on ground, in water, or in trees
It follows the sounds of other animals using its excellent hearing
It senses the body heat of nearby animals through special pits on its face
explanation: A monitor lizard is an active hunter that uses keen smell and eyesight to find prey and chases it on the ground, in the water, or up in trees.
fact_tl: Hindi lang basta naghihintay ang bayawak — aktibo itong mangangaso na gumagamit ng matalas na pang-amoy at paningin para hanapin ang biktima. Tinutugis nito ang mga ito sa lupa, sa tubig, o sa puno.
fact_bis: Ang bayawan dili lang basta maghulat — usa kini ka aktibong mangangayam nga mogamit og hait nga panimaho ug panan-aw aron pangitaon ang biktima. Gukoron niini kini sa yuta, sa tubig, o sa kahoy.

q: What does the outside of a rattan fruit look like?
options: Smooth and shiny like a marble with a green skin
Covered with shiny overlapping scales like snake skin
Rough and spiky like a durian with hard pointed thorns
Soft and fuzzy like a peach with a thin edible covering
explanation: Rattan fruit is covered with shiny overlapping scales like snake skin, with the seed inside.
fact_tl: Ang uway ay namumunga, at ang bunga nito ay natatakpan ng makintab na kaliskis na parang balat ng ahas; sa loob nito ang binhi.
fact_bis: Ang uway mamunga, ug ang bunga niini natabunan og sinaw nga himbis nga morag panit sa bitin; sa sulod niini ang liso.

q: What are stromatolites, and why are they important to science?
options: Colorful sea corals that formed the first tropical reefs 500 million years ago
Rocks formed by ancient cyanobacteria about 3.5 billion years ago; among the oldest fossil evidence of life on Earth
Fossilized shells of giant mollusks that prove ancient oceans were much larger
Thin layers of old volcanic rock that contain the first traces of oxygen in the atmosphere
explanation: Stromatolites are rocks formed by ancient cyanobacteria about 3.5 billion years ago and are among the oldest fossil evidence of life on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang mga stromatolite ay mga bato na nabuo ng mga sinaunang cyanobacteria na mga 3.5 bilyong taon na ang nakakaraan — ang mga ito ay isa sa mga pinakamatatandang fossil na ebidensya ng buhay sa Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang mga stromatolite mga bato nga naporma sa mga sinaunang cyanobacteria mga 3.5 bilyong tuig ang milabay — kini usa sa labing daang fossil nga ebidensya sa kinabuhi sa Yuta.

q: What role does groundwater play in the water cycle?
options: It stays permanently underground and never returns to the surface
It can flow back into rivers and the sea as part of the water cycle
It only moves when pumped out by humans using wells
It evaporates directly from the ground into clouds without touching rivers
explanation: Groundwater is part of the water cycle and can flow back into rivers and the sea.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa ilalim ng lupa ay bahagi ng siklo ng tubig at maaaring umagos pabalik sa mga ilog at dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tubig ilawom sa yuta kabahin sa siklo sa tubig ug mahimong moagas balik ngadto sa mga suba ug dagat.

q: How does a bird keep water from soaking into its feathers?
options: It dries its feathers quickly in the sun after every swim
It spreads natural oil from its body onto its feathers with its beak
Its feathers are made of a wax that naturally repels water
It shakes its body so fast that water cannot settle on the feathers
explanation: A bird spreads a natural oil from its body onto its feathers with its beak so water cannot soak in.
fact_tl: Pinupunas ng ibon ang likas na langis mula sa katawan nito patungo sa balahibo gamit ang tuka para hindi ito basain ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang langgam mopahid sa kinaiyanhon nga lana gikan sa lawas niini ngadto sa mga balhibo pinaagi sa tuka aron dili kini mabasa sa tubig.

q: What is the main purpose of a cough?
options: To push extra oxygen into the lungs when the body needs more energy
To blast out dust, phlegm, or anything that does not belong in the airway
To warm the air before it reaches the lungs on cold days
To signal to the brain that the body is getting enough sleep
explanation: A cough is the body's way of blasting out dust, phlegm, or anything that does not belong in the airway.
fact_tl: Ang ubo ay paraan ng katawan para itaboy ang alikabok, plema, o mikrobyong hindi dapat nasa daan ng hangin. Mabilis at malakas na pinupwersa palabas ng baga ang hangin para linisin ang lalamunan at tubo ng paghinga.
fact_bis: Ang ubo mao ang paagi sa lawas aron itaboy ang abog, plema, o bisan unsa nga dili angay sa agianan sa hangin. Kusog ug paspas nga ipugos pagawas sa baga ang hangin aron malimpyohan ang tutonlan ug ang mga tubo sa pagginhawa.

q: What does a blood clot do when you get a wound?
options: It dilutes bacteria in the wound with extra white blood cells
It seals the wound and stops too much bleeding
It carries extra oxygen to the injured cells to help them heal faster
It numbs the area around the wound so you feel less pain
explanation: Blood clots to seal a wound and stop too much bleeding.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ay namumuo para isara ang sugat at pigilan ang labis na pagdurugo.
fact_bis: Ang dugo namuo aron sirhan ang samad ug pugngan ang sobra nga pagdugo.

q: What does melanin do in the skin?
options: It produces vitamin D when the skin absorbs water from sweat
It gives skin its color and helps protect it against the sun's UV rays
It keeps the skin moist by sealing in water from inside the body
It sends pain signals to the brain when the skin is damaged
explanation: Melanin gives skin its color and helps protect it against the sun's UV rays.
fact_tl: Ang melanin ang sangkap na nagbibigay-kulay sa balat at tumutulong itong magsanggalang laban sa UV na sinag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang melanin mao ang sangkap nga naghatag og kolor sa panit ug nagtabang kini sa pagpanalipod batok sa UV nga silaw sa adlaw.

q: What is the difference between a fish sanctuary and a marine park?
options: A fish sanctuary is larger and allows limited fishing in some zones, while a marine park bans all fishing everywhere
A fish sanctuary is a small strict no-take zone, while a marine park is a larger area that may allow limited fishing in some zones
A fish sanctuary is managed by the national government, while a marine park is managed by local fishermen
A fish sanctuary protects only coral reefs, while a marine park protects all ocean creatures including open-water fish
explanation: A fish sanctuary is usually a small, strict no-take zone, while a marine park is a larger area that may have zones allowing limited fishing.
fact_tl: Ang fish sanctuary ay kadalasang isang MALIIT at MAHIGPIT na bahagi (no-take zone) na bawal talaga ang panghuhuli. Ang marine park o marine reserve naman ay mas MALAKING lugar na maaaring may iba't ibang zone — may bahaging sanctuary, may bahaging pwedeng manghuli nang may limitasyon. Kaya madalas, ang sanctuary ay isang bahagi lamang ng mas malaking marine park.
fact_bis: Ang fish sanctuary kasagaran usa ka GAMAY ug ISTRIKTO nga bahin (no-take zone) diin bawal gyud ang pangisda. Ang marine park o marine reserve usa ka mas DAKO nga dapit nga mahimong adunay nagkalainlaing zone — adunay bahin nga sanctuary, adunay bahin nga pwede mangisda nga may limitasyon. Busa kasagaran, ang sanctuary usa lang ka bahin sa mas dako nga marine park.

q: When salt dissolves in water, what kind of change is this?
options: A chemical change because salt disappears and a new liquid is formed
A physical change because the salt is still salt and can be recovered by evaporating the water
A biological change because living organisms help break salt into smaller pieces
An irreversible change because dissolved salt can never be separated from water
explanation: Salt dissolving in water is a physical change — it is still salt, and you can get it back by evaporating the water.
fact_tl: Ang pagtunaw ng asin sa tubig ay isang physical change, hindi bagong sangkap ang nabuo. Asin pa rin ito, at mababawi mo ito kapag pinasingaw ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagtunaw sa asin sa tubig usa ka physical change, dili paghimo og bag-ong substansya. Asin gihapon kini, ug mabawi nimo kini kung paalisngawon ang tubig.

q: What are the four life stages of a mosquito?
options: Egg, larva, adult, pupa
Egg, nymph, pupa, adult
Egg, larva, pupa, adult
Larva, egg, adult, pupa
explanation: A mosquito goes through four life stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult.
fact_tl: Ang lamok ay dumaraan sa apat na yugto ng buhay: itlog, uod o larva, pupa, at matandang lamok.
fact_bis: Ang lamok moagi sa upat ka hugna sa kinabuhi: itlog, uod o larva, pupa, ug hamtong nga lamok.

q: What is the capital town of Pangasinan province?
options: Dagupan
San Carlos
Urdaneta
Lingayen
explanation: The capital of Pangasinan province is the town of Lingayen.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng lalawigan ng Pangasinan ay ang bayan ng Lingayen.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa lalawigan sa Pangasinan mao ang lungsod sa Lingayen.

q: What is the main condition needed for a typhoon to form over the ocean?
options: A very cold ocean surface that creates heavy downward air currents
A warm ocean surface where moist air rises, cools, and releases energy that powers the storm
Strong high-pressure systems pushing cold air outward in a spiral
Cold dry air masses colliding with each other over the open sea
explanation: A typhoon forms when the ocean surface is warm: warm, moist air rises, cools, and forms clouds that release energy to power the spinning storm.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang bagyo kapag mainit ang ibabaw ng dagat: pumapaitaas ang mainit na singaw ng tubig, lumalamig, at nagiging ulap na nagbibigay ng enerhiya sa umiikot na bagyo.
fact_bis: Maporma ang bagyo kung init ang ibabaw sa dagat: mosaka ang init nga alisngaw sa tubig, mobugnaw, ug mahimong panganod nga maghatag og enerhiya sa nagtuyok nga bagyo.

q: Compared to human vision, how do insects see the world?
options: Insects see sharper details but only directly in front of them
Insects have a wider field of view but see things with less detail and more blur
Insects see only in black and white with perfect sharpness at close range
Insects see far better at night than in daylight unlike most humans
explanation: Even though an insect's view is wide, insects see things blurrier and with less detail than humans do.
fact_tl: Kahit malawak ang kanilang paningin, ang mga insekto ay nakakakita ng mas malabo at kulang sa detalye kaysa sa atin.
fact_bis: Bisan og halapad ang ilang panan-aw, ang mga insekto makakita ug mas hanap ug kulang sa detalye kaysa kanato.

q: What is Earth's outer shell broken into?
options: A single solid layer that slowly spins around the liquid mantle
Large pieces called tectonic plates
Many tiny blocks of rock that drift independently in the ocean
A series of rings that slide under each other at the poles
explanation: Earth's outer shell is broken into large pieces called tectonic plates.
fact_tl: Ang panlabas na balat ng Daigdig ay nahahati sa malalaking piraso na tinatawag na tectonic plates.
fact_bis: Ang gawas nga panit sa Kalibotan nabahin sa dagkong mga tipik nga gitawag og tectonic plates.

q: What happens to a plant's grip on the soil as the plant gets older?
options: Its roots shrink to save energy as it grows taller
Its grip on the soil becomes stronger as its roots grow longer and thicker
Its roots stop growing once the plant reaches full height
Its grip weakens because older roots begin to rot underground
explanation: As a plant ages, its roots grow longer and thicker, making its hold on the soil stronger over time.
fact_tl: Habang tumatanda ang halaman, lumalago at kumakapal ang mga ugat nito. Kaya mas lalong tumitibay ang paghawak nito sa lupa sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Samtang motigulang ang tanom, motubo og taas ug mosamot kabaga ang mga gamot niini. Mao nga mas molig-on ang pagkupot niini sa yuta sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: Why do weather services issue a frost warning in cold countries?
options: To remind people to turn on their heaters and stay indoors
So people can cover plants and protect water pipes before freezing damages them
To warn drivers that roads will be slippery in the morning
To alert farmers to harvest all crops immediately before snow arrives
explanation: A frost warning lets people prepare by covering plants and protecting water pipes, which can burst when the water inside freezes.
fact_tl: Sa mga bansang malamig, naglalabas ang weather service ng 'frost warning' para alam ng mga tao na magka-frost o magyeyelo. Sa babalang ito, naihahanda nila ang sarili — tinatakpan ang tanim at pinoprotektahan ang mga tubo ng tubig na maaaring sumabog kapag nagyelo ang loob.
fact_bis: Sa bugnaw nga mga nasod, ang weather service mopagawas og 'frost warning' aron mahibalo ang mga tawo nga moabot ang frost o pagyelo. Pinaagi niini nga pasidaan, makaandam sila — gitabonan ang mga tanom ug gipanalipdan ang mga tubo sa tubig, nga mahimong mobuto kon mo-yelo ang sulod.

q: Why are fungi considered more closely related to animals than to plants?
options: Because fungi can move around to find food just like animals do
Because fungi cannot make their own food and have cell walls made of chitin, like insect shells
Because fungi grow very quickly and need oxygen to breathe, just like animals
Because fungi have roots and stems that look more like animal body parts than plant parts
explanation: Fungi cannot make their own food and their cell walls contain chitin, the same material found in insect shells, making them more closely related to animals.
fact_tl: Kahit mukhang halaman ang fungi, mas malapit sila sa mga hayop dahil hindi sila gumagawa ng sariling pagkain at ang kanilang dingding ng selula ay yari sa chitin, ang parehong sangkap na nasa balat ng mga insekto.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag tanom ang fungi, mas duol gyud sila sa mga mananap kay dili sila makahimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon ug ang ilang bongbong sa selula hinimo sa chitin, ang samang materyal nga anaa sa panit sa mga insekto.

q: What happens to a fire if you remove the fuel, heat, OR oxygen?
options: The fire burns slower but does not go out completely
The fire changes color but keeps burning
The fire goes out
The fire produces more smoke until it gradually fades
explanation: Removing any one of the three elements — fuel, heat, or oxygen — causes the fire to go out.
fact_tl: Kapag inalis mo ang isa sa tatlo—panggatong, init, o oksiheno—mamamatay ang apoy.
fact_bis: Kung kuhaon nimo ang usa sa tulo—sugnod, kainit, o oksiheno—mapalong ang kalayo.

q: How do a cat's whiskers help it move around?
options: They help the cat balance while running and jumping over obstacles
They spread about as wide as its body to help the cat measure whether it can fit through a gap
They sense vibrations in the ground to warn the cat of danger nearby
They help the cat smell food by spreading scent particles in the air
explanation: A cat's whiskers spread about as wide as its body, helping it measure whether it can fit through a gap.
fact_tl: Halos kasinglapad ng katawan ng pusa ang kabuuang luwang ng kanyang mga bigote, kaya nasusukat nito kung kasya siya sa isang puwang.
fact_bis: Ang gilapdon sa mga bigote sa iring halos pareho sa gilapdon sa lawas niini, busa masukod niini kung mahaom ba siya sa usa ka lungag.

q: When using a fishing rod as a lever, where is the fulcrum?
options: At the tip of the rod where the fishing line is attached
In the middle of the rod where the reel is mounted
At the end of the rod where one hand holds it
At the hook at the end of the fishing line in the water
explanation: In a fishing rod (a third-class lever), one hand at the end of the rod acts as the fulcrum while the other hand in the middle provides the effort.
fact_tl: Ang pamingwit ay isang ikatlong-uring palanca kung saan ang kamay sa dulo ang fulcrum at ang isa pang kamay ang nagbibigay ng effort sa gitna.
fact_bis: Ang pamasol usa ka ikatulong-klase nga palanca diin ang usa ka kamot sa tumoy mao ang fulcrum ug ang laing kamot maghatag sa effort sa tunga.

q: What does the word "hardwood" tell us about a tree like narra?
options: It means the tree grows very tall and lives in tropical rainforests
It comes from a strong, slow-growing tree
It means the tree has bark that is rough and thick to protect it from insects
It means the tree grows near water and has deep underground roots
explanation: Hardwood comes from strong, slow-growing trees like the narra.
fact_tl: Ang hardwood o matigas na kahoy ay galing sa mga punong matibay at mabagal lumaki, gaya ng narra.
fact_bis: Ang hardwood o gahi nga kahoy gikan sa lig-on ug hinay motubo nga mga kahoy sama sa narra.

q: Why must a container be sealed when you want to test conservation of mass in a reaction that produces gas?
options: Because the heat from the reaction can crack an open container and spoil the experiment
Because an open container lets air mix in, adding extra mass to the measurement
Because the gas escapes from an open container, making the weight seem to drop
Because reactions only happen properly when there is no air touching the mixture
explanation: If the container is open, gas produced by the reaction escapes, so the measured weight seems to drop — sealing the container keeps all matter inside so the total mass stays constant.
fact_tl: Para makita ang konserbasyon ng masa sa reaksyong gumagawa ng gas, dapat selyado ang sisidlan — kung bukas, tumatakas ang gas at mukhang bumababa ang timbang.
fact_bis: Aron makita ang konserbasyon sa masa sa reaksyon nga maghimog gas, kinahanglan sirado ang sudlanan — kung abli, moikyas ang gas ug murag mokunhod ang gibug-aton.

q: What tiny living things are responsible for building a coral reef?
options: Millions of tiny sea plants that attach to the ocean floor
Millions of tiny animals called coral polyps
Millions of tiny shells washed together by ocean currents
Millions of tiny algae that harden when exposed to sunlight
explanation: A reef is built by millions of tiny animals called coral polyps.
fact_tl: Ang reef ay binubuo ng milyun-milyong maliliit na hayop na tinatawag na coral polyp.
fact_bis: Ang bahura gitukod sa minilyon ka gagmayng mananap nga gitawag og coral polyp.

q: When wood burns completely, what happens to the matter that made up the wood?
options: The matter is destroyed because fire breaks down atoms permanently
The matter disappears into energy, so nothing of the wood remains
It becomes ash and gases whose total mass equals the original wood plus the air used
The matter shrinks into a smaller form because heat compresses it into ash
explanation: In any physical or chemical change, matter is not lost — when wood burns it becomes ash and gases whose total mass equals the original wood plus the air used.
fact_tl: Sa anumang physical o chemical change, hindi nawawala o nadaragdag ang matter — nananatili ang kabuuang mass. Kapag nasunog ang kahoy, hindi ito basta nawawala: nagiging abo at mga gas ito na ang kabuuang bigat ay katumbas ng dating kahoy at hangin na ginamit.
fact_bis: Sa bisan unsang physical o chemical change, dili mawala o madugang ang matter — magpabilin ang kinatibuk-ang mass. Kung masunog ang kahoy, dili kini basta mawala: mahimo kining abo ug mga gas nga ang kinatibuk-ang gibug-aton katumbas sa kanhing kahoy ug hangin nga gigamit.

q: Who piloted the first successful airplane flight in history?
options: Wilbur Wright
Louis Blériot
Orville Wright
Charles Lindbergh
explanation: Orville Wright piloted the first successful airplane flight in 1903.
fact_tl: Si Orville Wright ang nagpiloto sa unang matagumpay na paglipad ng eroplano noong 1903.
fact_bis: Si Orville Wright maoy nagpiloto sa unang malampuson nga paglupad sa eroplano niadtong 1903.

q: What is one of the earliest warning signs that a drought is approaching?
options: An unusually cold night followed by heavy fog in the morning
Falling water levels in rivers and dams
More clouds appearing in the sky with very little rain
Strong winds that dry out the soil faster than usual
explanation: Falling water levels in rivers and dams are among the earliest signs of an approaching drought, so agencies like PAGASA monitor them to plan water conservation.
fact_tl: Ang pagbaba ng antas ng tubig sa mga ilog at dam ay isa sa pinakamaagang senyales ng paparating na tagtuyot; binabantayan ng PAGASA at MWSS ang mga antas na ito upang magplano ng water conservation.
fact_bis: Ang pagbaba sa antas sa tubig sa mga suba ug dam usa sa labing sayo nga mga senyales sa paparapit nga hulaw; ginimonitor sa PAGASA ug mga water utility kini nga mga antas aron magplano sa water conservation.

q: On which continents are pangolins naturally found in the wild?
options: Africa and South America
Asia and Australia
Africa and Asia
South America and Europe
explanation: Pangolins are naturally found in Africa and Asia, but not in the Americas.
fact_tl: Ang mga pangolin ay natural na matatagpuan sa Aprika at Asya, ngunit wala sa Amerika.
fact_bis: Ang mga pangolin natural nga makit-an sa Aprika ug Asya, apan wala sa Amerika.

q: Why is it a good idea to dry fruit with a clean cloth after washing it?
options: Because drying makes the fruit sweeter and easier to peel before eating
Because a wet surface lets leftover bacteria multiply more easily, and wiping removes leftover dirt
Because water soaks into the fruit skin and makes it mushy if left wet too long
Because drying removes the natural wax coating that traps germs on the outside
explanation: A wet surface lets leftover bacteria multiply more easily, and wiping also helps remove dirt that the water did not carry off.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos hugasan, mainam patuyuin ang prutas gamit ang malinis na tela o papel. Ang basang ibabaw ay mas madaling pagdamihan ng natitirang bakterya, at nakakatulong din ang pagpunas na maalis ang mga dumi na hindi natangay ng tubig.
fact_bis: Human hugasi, maayo nga pauggon ang prutas gamit ang limpyo nga panapton o papel. Ang basa nga ibabaw mas dali pasanayon sa nahabilin nga bakterya, ug ang pagpahid makatabang usab sa pagwagtang sa hugaw nga wala madala sa tubig.

q: How is singkamas (jicama) most commonly enjoyed?
options: Boiled until soft and mashed like potatoes
Roasted over fire to bring out its natural sweetness
Eaten raw because it is watery and crunchy
Fried in oil to make it crispy like a chip
explanation: Singkamas (jicama) is a watery root that is tasty eaten raw and crunchy.
fact_tl: Ang singkamas ay isang matubig na ugat na masarap kainin nang hilaw at malutong.
fact_bis: Ang singkamas usa ka tubigon nga gamot nga lami kan-on nga hilaw ug malutong.

q: What is iron ore used to make?
options: Aluminum sheets used in aircraft and food packaging
Copper wire used in electrical cables and circuits
Steel for buildings and vehicles after the ore is melted
Glass for windows and lenses after the ore is refined
explanation: Iron ore is melted to get iron, which is then made into steel for buildings and vehicles.
fact_tl: Tinutunaw ang iron ore upang kunin ang bakal na ginagawang asero para sa mga gusali at sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang iron ore tunawon aron makuha ang puthaw nga himoon nga asero para sa mga building ug sakyanan.

q: How does a slug protect itself since it has no shell like a snail?
options: It burrows underground and covers itself with leaves when threatened
It puffs up its body to look larger and scare predators away
It relies on its color and bad-tasting mucus to protect itself
It moves very quickly away from danger unlike the slow-moving snail
explanation: Without a shell to hide in, a slug relies on color and bad-tasting mucus to protect itself from predators.
fact_tl: Ang kuhol ay may shell na mapagtataguan, pero ang slug na kamukha nito ay walang bahay kaya hindi makapasok kahit saan. Kaya umaasa ang slug sa kulay at mapait na uhog para magtago sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang kuhol naa'y kabhang nga katagoan, apan ang slug nga susama'g hitsura walay balay busa dili makasulod bisan asa. Busa, mosalig ang slug sa kolor ug pait nga uhog aron manalipod sa kaaway.

q: What three things are mixed together in traditional betel chewing?
options: Betel nut, coconut milk, and dried coconut leaves
Betel leaf, sugar cane juice, and ground pepper seeds
Sliced betel nut, betel leaf, and slaked lime
Betel nut, ginger root, and rice vinegar
explanation: In traditional betel chewing, sliced betel nut, betel leaf, and slaked lime are mixed together before chewing.
fact_tl: Sa tradisyonal na nganga, hinahalo ang hiniwang bunga, dahong buyo, at apog bago nguyain.
fact_bis: Sa tradisyonal nga panginganga, gisagol ang hiniwa nga bunga, dahon nga buyo, ug apog una nganga-on.

q: Why does a shooting star glow as it falls through the sky?
options: It carries its own light from the Sun and glows as it moves away from space
It is burning leftover fuel from when it was part of a comet
Strong friction with the air heats it up until it shines as it falls fast through the atmosphere
Electricity in the upper atmosphere ignites the rock as it passes through
explanation: A shooting star glows because of strong friction with the air as it falls fast through the atmosphere, heating it until it shines.
fact_tl: Ang bulalakaw ay nagliliyab dahil sa matinding kuskusan (friction) sa hangin habang mabilis itong bumabagsak sa atmospera, na nagpapainit dito hanggang umilaw.
fact_bis: Ang bulalakaw mosiga tungod sa kusog nga kuskos (friction) sa hangin samtang paspas kining nahulog sa atmospera, nga nagpainit niini hangtod mosidlak.

q: What is the main purpose of sneezing?
options: To push air into the lungs quickly when we need more oxygen
To cool down the brain when body temperature rises too high
To clear the nose when dust or an irritating thing gets inside it
To pump extra blood to the head when we bend forward
explanation: Sneezing is a reflex that clears the nose when dust or an irritating thing gets inside it.
fact_tl: Ang pagbahing ay isang reflex na naglilinis sa ilong kapag may alikabok o nakakairitang bagay sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang pagbahin usa ka reflex nga naghawan sa ilong kung adunay abog o makasamok nga butang sulod niini.

q: Why does the Philippines have so many unique bird species found nowhere else on Earth?
options: Because the warm tropical climate allows birds from other countries to breed here easily
Because Filipino forests have more fruit and insects than anywhere else in Asia
Because island isolation allowed unique evolutionary paths, making the Philippines part of Wallacea, a world bird-diversity hotspot
Because Philippine birds have been protected by law for hundreds of years with no hunting allowed
explanation: The Philippines is part of Wallacea, one of the world's richest areas for bird diversity, because island isolation allowed unique evolutionary paths.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay bahagi ng Wallacea, isa sa mga pinaka-mayamang lugar sa mundo para sa pagkakaiba-iba ng mga ibon, dahil sa paghiwalay ng mga pulo na nagbigay-daan sa natatanging ebolusyon.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas bahin sa Wallacea, usa sa pinaka-dato nga mga lugar sa kalibutan alang sa pagkabahin-bahin sa mga langgam, tungod kay ang paghiwalay sa pulo nagtugot sa talagsaon nga ebolusyon.

q: What simple machine is the sharp wheel of a can opener?
options: A pulley that changes the direction of the force you apply
A lever that lifts the metal lid off the can
A wedge that presses and cuts through the thin metal at the rim
A screw that twists into the metal to create an opening
explanation: The sharp wheel of a can opener is a wedge that presses and cuts through the thin metal at the rim of the can as you turn it.
fact_tl: Ang matalim na gulong ng abrelata ay isang wedge na pumipindot at pumuputol sa manipis na metal sa gilid ng lata habang iniikot mo ito.
fact_bis: Ang hait nga ligid sa abrelata usa ka wedge nga mag-ipit ug moputol sa nipis nga metal sa ngilit sa lata samtang imong ginatuyok kini.

q: Why does the Philippines have one of the longest coastlines in the world?
options: Because it is located on the equator where land meets the ocean in many places
Because it is a very large country with a huge land area compared to its neighbors
Because its thousands of islands mean there is a very long total length of shoreline
Because strong ocean currents have eroded the coasts to create long and winding shores
explanation: Because of its thousands of islands, the Philippines has one of the longest coastlines in the whole world.
fact_tl: Dahil sa libu-libong pulo, ang Pilipinas ay may isa sa pinakamahabang baybayin sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Tungod sa liboan ka isla, ang Pilipinas adunay usa sa pinakatag-as nga baybayon sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: What is the safest way to remove a leech from your skin?
options: Pour salt directly on it to make it fall off right away
Yank it off quickly with your fingers before it digs deeper
Gently slide a fingernail under its edge to detach it
Burn the end of the leech with a match to make it release
explanation: It is safer to remove a leech by gently sliding a fingernail under its edge, rather than yanking it off suddenly.
fact_tl: Mas ligtas na tanggalin ang linta sa pamamagitan ng dahan-dahang pag-usod gamit ang kuko sa gilid nito, hindi sa biglang paghila.
fact_bis: Mas luwas tangtangon ang linta pinaagi sa hinay nga pagsulod sa kuko sa kilid niini, dili sa kalit nga pagbira.

q: A classmate gets a small spark from touching a metal doorknob. Should they be worried it is dangerous?
options: Yes, because any electric spark means electricity is flowing through the body and can cause burns
Yes, because the spark shows charge is building up and could cause a bigger shock later
No, because the amount of charge is very small so it surprises you but does no harm
No, because electricity only comes from wall sockets and a doorknob cannot hold a charge
explanation: The static spark from a doorknob carries a very small amount of charge that surprises you but cannot hurt you, unlike the electricity in a wall socket.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, delikado ang static spark na nararamdaman mo sa doorknob. Pero hindi ito nakakasama—napakaliit lang ng kuryente, kaya nakakagulat pero hindi nakakapinsala. Iba ito sa kuryente sa saksakan na talagang delikado at hindi dapat hawakan.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga delikado ang static spark nga imong mabati sa doorknob. Apan dili kini makadaot—gamay ra kaayo ang kuryente, busa makakurat apan walay daot. Lahi kini sa kuryente sa saksakan nga tinuod nga delikado ug dili angay hikapon.

q: What is true about everyone's fingerprint pattern?
options: Twins always share the same fingerprint pattern because they have the same DNA
People in the same family share very similar fingerprint patterns that look almost identical
Every person's fingerprint pattern is unique — even identical twins have different fingerprints
Fingerprint patterns change as a person grows older because skin cells replace themselves
explanation: Fingerprint ridges help us grip things and feel textures, and everyone's pattern is unique — even identical twins have different fingerprints.
fact_tl: Ang mga fingerprint ay maliliit na guhit (ridges) sa ating mga daliri na tumutulong sa paghawak ng bagay at pagdama ng texture. Natatangi ang pattern ng bawat tao — magkaiba pa rin kahit kambal.
fact_bis: Ang mga fingerprint mao ang gagmayng linya (ridges) sa atong tudlo nga makatabang sa pagkupot og butang ug pagbati sa texture. Talagsaon ang pattern sa matag tawo — lahi gihapon bisan kambal.

q: How is a mosquito pupa different from a butterfly's pupa (cocoon)?
options: The mosquito pupa is underground while the butterfly's cocoon hangs from a branch
The mosquito pupa has a hard outer shell but the butterfly's cocoon is soft and silky
The mosquito pupa can move and swim in water, while a butterfly's cocoon stays still
The mosquito pupa is much larger than the butterfly's cocoon because mosquitoes are insects
explanation: The mosquito pupa is different from a butterfly's cocoon because it can move and swim, and it is not wrapped in a hard case.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-iisip na ang pupa ay laging tulog na parang cocoon ng paru-paro. Pero iba ang pupa ng lamok—gumagalaw ito at nakakalangoy, hindi nakapaloob sa matigas na balot.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang pupa kanunay matulog murag cocoon sa alibangbang. Apan lahi ang pupa sa lamok—makalihok ug makalangoy kini, dili gisuksok sa gahi nga sapaw.

q: Why does a female mosquito need to bite and drink blood?
options: Because blood gives the female the energy she needs to fly long distances
Because blood is the only liquid that quenches a mosquito's thirst in warm weather
Because she needs the protein from blood to form and lay her eggs
Because blood keeps the female mosquito's body warm enough to survive cooler nights
explanation: The female mosquito needs the nutrients or protein from blood in order to form and lay her eggs.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng babaeng lamok ang sustansya o protina mula sa dugo upang makabuo at makapangitlog ng mga itlog.
fact_bis: Gikinahanglan sa baye nga lamok ang sustansiya o protina gikan sa dugo aron makahimo ug makapangitlog.

q: What is the correct way to unplug an electrical appliance from the wall?
options: Grab the cord near the wall and pull it at an angle to loosen the plug
Hold the cord close to the appliance and pull firmly and steadily
Hold the plug itself and pull it out, never yank by the cord
Wrap the cord around your hand first for a better grip and then pull
explanation: You should hold the plug itself when unplugging — yanking the cord can break the wires inside and expose them, which is dangerous.
fact_tl: Kapag tatanggalin ang nakasaksak, hawakan ang plug mismo at hindi ang kable. Kapag kable ang hinila mo, pwedeng masira ito sa loob at malantad ang wire na delikado.
fact_bis: Kung tangtangon ang nakasaksak, kupti ang plug mismo, dili ang kable. Kung kable ang imong birahon, mahimong maguba kini sa sulod ug malantad ang wire nga delikado.

q: What is the special name for a group of crows?
options: A flock
A colony
A murder
A parliament
explanation: A group of crows is called a "murder."
fact_tl: Ang isang grupo ng mga uwak ay tinatawag na "murder."
fact_bis: Ang usa ka grupo sa mga uwak gitawag nga "murder."

q: If something is measured in micrometers, how big is one micrometer compared to a full meter?
options: One thousandth (1/1,000) of a meter
One hundred-thousandth (1/100,000) of a meter
One millionth (1/1,000,000) of a meter
One billionth (1/1,000,000,000) of a meter
explanation: The prefix "micro" means one millionth (0.000001), so a micrometer is one millionth of a meter.
fact_tl: Ang unlaping "micro" ay nangangahulugang ika-isang-milyon (1/1,000,000 o 0.000001).
fact_bis: Ang prefix nga "micro" nagpasabot og usa-ka-milyon-ka-bahin (1/1,000,000 o 0.000001).

q: Why is the front (bow) of a boat pointed rather than flat?
options: To make it easier to attach ropes and anchors at the front of the boat
To give the captain a better view of the water ahead of the vessel
The pointed bow is shaped like a wedge that splits the water so the boat moves forward with less resistance
To hold more cargo at the front of the boat and keep it balanced in the water
explanation: The pointed bow of a boat is shaped like a wedge that splits the water apart, allowing the boat to move forward with less resistance.
fact_tl: Ang matulis na proa ng bangka ay huling katulad ng wedge na nagpapahintulot sa bangka na hatiin ang tubig at bumabang mas mabilis.
fact_bis: Ang matulis nga proa sa bangka giporma sama sa wedge nga nagdivide sa tubig aron ang bangka makalihok pasulong nga adunay gamay nga pagsukol.

q: How do mangrove trees help young fish?
options: Their leaves fall into the water and give young fish nutrients to eat
They block sunlight so the water stays cool enough for young fish to survive
Their roots shelter small fish until they grow big enough to move into the open sea
They release oxygen into the water which young fish need more than adult fish
explanation: The roots of mangroves shelter small fish until they grow big enough to move into the open sea.
fact_tl: Nagsisilbing kanlungan ng maliliit na isda ang mga ugat ng bakawan bago sila lumaki at lumabas sa malawak na dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamot sa bakhaw mahimong silongan sa gagmay nga isda hangtod modako sila ug mogawas sa lapad nga dagat.

q: What is the carbon cycle?
options: The process by which plants absorb carbon dioxide and release it back at night
The way that carbon builds up in the atmosphere from burning fossil fuels
The continuous movement of carbon between the air, plants, animals, soil, oceans, and rocks
The path that carbon takes from a living animal into the soil after it dies
explanation: The carbon cycle is the continuous movement of carbon between the air, plants, animals, soil, oceans, and rocks — the same carbon is used and released over and over again.
fact_tl: Ang carbon cycle ay ang paulit-ulit na paggalaw ng carbon sa pagitan ng hangin, halaman, hayop, lupa, karagatan, at mga bato. Ginagamit at muling pinakakawalan ang parehong carbon nang paulit-ulit.
fact_bis: Ang carbon cycle mao ang balik-balik nga paglihok sa carbon tali sa hangin, tanom, hayop, yuta, kadagatan, ug mga bato. Ang samang carbon gigamit ug gibuhian pag-usab balik-balik.

q: What makes crows especially remarkable among animals when it comes to using tools?
options: They are the only birds that can pick up objects with their feet to use as tools
They memorize where tools are hidden and return to use the same tool many times
They can actually make tools themselves, bending a twig into a hook to pull out food
They teach their young how to use tools by showing them step-by-step in the nest
explanation: Some crows don't just use tools — they make them, bending a twig into a hook to pull out food, something very few animals can do.
fact_tl: May mga uwak na hindi lang gumagamit kundi gumagawa pa ng kasangkapan—binabaluktot nila ang sanga para gawing kawit na panghila ng pagkain, isang gawaing iilang hayop lang ang kaya.
fact_bis: Adunay mga uwak nga dili lang mogamit kondili maghimo pa ug galamiton—ilang balikoon ang sanga aron mahimong taga nga ibira sa pagkaon, usa ka butang nga pipila ra ka hayop ang makahimo.

q: What organs or structures make up the integumentary system?
options: The bones, cartilage, and joints that give the body its shape and support
The muscles, tendons, and ligaments that allow the body to move
The skin, hair, and nails that form the outer covering of the body
The heart, blood vessels, and blood that circulate nutrients through the body
explanation: The integumentary system is made up of the skin, hair, and nails, forming the outer covering that protects the body, keeps water in, and helps control body temperature.
fact_tl: Ang integumentary system ay binubuo ng balat, buhok, at kuko, at ito ang panlabas na takip na nagpoprotekta sa katawan, pumipigil sa pagkawala ng tubig, at tumutulong sa pagkontrol ng init ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang integumentary system gilangkoban sa panit, buhok, ug kuko, ug mao kini ang gawas nga tabon nga nanalipod sa lawas, nagpugong sa pagkawala sa tubig, ug nagtabang sa pagkontrol sa init sa lawas.

q: Why can an optical illusion make two equal-length lines look different?
options: Because the eyes have different numbers of light-detecting cells and one eye sees better
Because one line is usually placed in a brighter area of the image making it seem longer
Because the brain sometimes guesses wrong about what it sees, so our senses are not always right
Because the lines are printed slightly differently due to imperfect printing on paper
explanation: Optical illusions trick the eyes because sometimes the brain guesses wrong about what it sees, showing that our senses are not always right.
fact_tl: Hindi laging tama ang sinasabi ng ating pandama. May mga "optical illusion" na nagpapaniwala sa mata na ang dalawang pantay na guhit ay magkaiba ang haba. Nangyayari ito dahil minsan, mali ang hula ng utak sa nakikita nito.
fact_bis: Dili kanunay sakto ang gisulti sa atong igbalati. Adunay mga optical illusion nga molingla sa mata nga ang duha ka managsama nga linya lahi og gitas-on. Mahitabo kini tungod kay usahay, sayop ang banabana sa utok sa iyang nakita.

q: Which of the following is a list of five renewable energy sources?
options: Coal, oil, natural gas, nuclear, and wood
Solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, and biomass
Solar, coal, wind, oil, and biomass
Hydro, nuclear, solar, coal, and geothermal
explanation: Five renewable energy sources are solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, and biomass.
fact_tl: Limang pinagkukunan ng renewable energy ay ang solar (araw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init ng lupa), at biomass.
fact_bis: Lima ka tinubdan sa renewable energy mao ang solar (adlaw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init sa yuta), ug biomass.

q: What valuable resource is the Philippines known to be rich in?
options: Diamonds and rubies found in its mountain ranges
Oil and natural gas deep under its seas
Gold and other valuable minerals
Uranium and coal used for nuclear and thermal energy
explanation: The Philippines is one of the countries that is rich in gold and other valuable minerals.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga bansang mayaman sa ginto at iba pang mahalagang mineral.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa mga nasod nga dato sa bulawan ug uban pang mahal nga mineral.

q: How do many Philippine communities get water from underground sources?
options: By building large dams that collect rainwater and pump it underground for storage
By digging tunnels into mountainsides to reach hidden underground rivers
Through wells and boreholes that extract water from underground aquifers
By filtering seawater through layers of sand and rock found near the coast
explanation: Many communities in the Philippines rely on groundwater extracted through wells and boreholes, as underground aquifers are an important natural water resource.
fact_tl: Ang maraming komunidad sa Pilipinas ay umaasa sa tubig mula sa ilalim ng lupa (groundwater) na kinukuha sa pamamagitan ng mga balon at poso; ang mga aquifer sa ilalim ng lupa ay mahalagang likas na yaman ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang daghang komunidad sa Pilipinas nagsalig sa tubig gikan sa ilalim sa yuta (groundwater) nga gikuha pinaagi sa mga balon ug poso; ang mga aquifer sa ilalim sa yuta importante nga natural na tubig-kahinguhaan.

q: What is the job of guard cells in a leaf?
options: To make food for the plant by absorbing sunlight on the surface of the leaf
To transport water from the roots up through the stem to the leaves
To open and close tiny pores called stomata to control the gases and water moving in and out
To protect the leaf from insects by producing a bitter chemical on the leaf surface
explanation: Guard cells are paired cells that open and close tiny pores called stomata to let carbon dioxide in and water and oxygen out.
fact_tl: Ang guard cells ay magkapares na selula sa dahon na bumubukas at sumasara ng maliliit na butas na tinatawag na stomata upang makapasok ang carbon dioxide at makalabas ang tubig at oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang guard cells mao ang parisan nga mga selula sa dahon nga magbukas ug magsira sa gagmayng lungag nga gitawag og stomata aron makasulod ang carbon dioxide ug makagawas ang tubig ug oxygen.

q: How does activated carbon clean water in a home filter?
options: It kills bacteria by releasing a small amount of chlorine into the water
It boils the water inside tiny pores to destroy harmful chemicals through heat
Its enormous number of tiny pores trap unwanted chemicals through adsorption, removing taste and odor
It adds healthy minerals to the water while blocking dirt with its hard surface
explanation: Activated carbon has an enormous number of tiny pores that trap unwanted chemicals from water through adsorption, removing taste and odor.
fact_tl: Ang activated carbon ay may napakadaming maliliit na pores na kumukuha ng mga di-gustong kemikal mula sa tubig sa pamamagitan ng adsorption — ito ang ginagamit sa mga water filter sa bahay.
fact_bis: Ang activated carbon adunay hilabihang daghang gagmay nga pores nga nagbitad sa mga dili gusto nga kemikal gikan sa tubig pinaagi sa adsorption; gigamit kini sa mga water filter sa balay aron tangtangon ang lasa ug baho.

q: Who was one of the first scientists to observe dark patches on the Sun using a telescope?
options: Isaac Newton
Nicolaus Copernicus
Galileo
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Galileo was one of the first to observe sunspots (dark patches on the Sun) with a telescope.
fact_tl: Si Galileo ay isa sa mga unang nag-obserba ng mga sunspots (madidilim na mantsa sa Araw) gamit ang teleskopyo.
fact_bis: Si Galileo usa sa unang nag-obserbar sa mga sunspots (mangitngit nga mga lama sa Adlaw) gamit ang teleskopyo.

q: What do a bonded pair of seahorses do together each morning?
options: They hunt for food together and share what they catch with each other
They change their color to match each other as a sign of being a pair
They do a kind of dance, swimming together and sometimes linking tails, to strengthen their bond
They build a nest together from seaweed collected from the ocean floor
explanation: Each morning a seahorse pair does a kind of dance, swimming together and sometimes linking tails, which strengthens their bond.
fact_tl: Tuwing umaga, ang magkapares na seahorse ay parang nagsasayaw, magkasabay na lumalangoy at minsan nagkakapit ng buntot, para palakasin ang kanilang samahan.
fact_bis: Matag buntag, ang magtiayon nga seahorse morag mosayaw, dungan nga molangoy ug usahay maggunitay og ikog, aron molig-on ang ilang relasyon.

q: Why is a blue ball blue — and is the reason the same as why the sky is blue?
options: Yes, both are blue for the same reason: they both scatter blue light in all directions toward your eyes
No, the sky is blue because it absorbs other colors, while a blue ball scatters blue light everywhere
Yes, both reflect blue light back to your eyes after absorbing the other colors of the spectrum
No, the sky is blue because air scatters blue light everywhere, but a blue ball absorbs other colors and reflects only blue back to you
