By wrapping its scaly body around the trunk and inching upward
By hooking its armored plates onto the bark for support
explanation: Pangolins are capable tree climbers, using their strong claws and prehensile tail to grip branches.
fact_tl: Ang pangolin ay isang mahusay na manukakyat ng puno, ginagamit ang matalas na kuko at prehensilyang buntot para kumapit sa mga sanga.
fact_bis: Ang pangolin usa ka maayong mangatkat sa kahoy, mogamit sa kusog nga kuko ug prehensil nga ikog sa pagkupot sa mga sanga.

q: What happens to an object's motion when opposite forces on it cancel out, making the net force zero?
options: The motion does not change
The object immediately stops moving
The object speeds up because the forces add together
The object moves in the direction of the larger force
explanation: When opposite forces cancel out so the net force is zero, the object's motion does not change.
fact_tl: Ang net force ay ang pinagsama-samang puwersa na isinasaalang-alang ang lakas at direksyon ng bawat isa; kapag nagkakansela ang magkasalungat na puwersa, zero ang net force at hindi nagbabago ang galaw.
fact_bis: Ang net force mao ang gitiponong tanang kusog nga giila ang kakusgon ug direksyon sa matag usa; kon magkanselar ang atbang nga mga kusog, zero ang net force ug dili mausab ang lihok.

q: Why was Golden Rice created?
options: To help children who lack vitamin A by adding genes that let the rice produce beta-carotene
To make rice grow faster so farmers can harvest more times per year
To make rice resistant to insects so fewer pesticides are needed
To give rice a golden color so consumers could tell it apart from regular rice
explanation: Golden Rice is a GMO rice engineered with genes that allow it to produce beta-carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A, to help children who lack it.
fact_tl: Ang Golden Rice ay isang GMO na bigas na may dagdag na gene para makagawa ng beta-carotene, na ginagawang vitamin A ng katawan, upang tulungan ang mga batang kulang dito.
fact_bis: Ang Golden Rice usa ka GMO nga bugas nga adunay dugang nga gene aron makahimo og beta-carotene, nga himuon sa lawas nga vitamin A, aron motabang sa mga bata nga kulang niini.

q: What happens if you do not eat enough go foods each day?
options: You get tired and weak easily because your body lacks enough energy
You gain too much weight because your body stores extra fat
You get sick more often because your immune system breaks down
You grow too slowly because go foods control how tall you become
explanation: If you eat too few go foods, your body does not have enough energy, so you get tired and weak easily.
fact_tl: Kung kulang ka sa go food, madali kang mapapagod at manghihina kasi walang sapat na lakas ang katawan mo. Kaya mahalaga ang tamang dami ng go food araw-araw.
fact_bis: Kon kulang ka sa go food, dali ka kapuyon ug maluya kay walay igong kusog ang imong lawas. Mao nga importante ang husto nga gidaghanon sa go food kada adlaw.

q: How do you calculate the speed of a moving object?
options: Divide the distance traveled by the time taken
Multiply the distance by the time taken
Subtract the time from the distance
Divide the time by the distance traveled
explanation: Speed is how far something travels in a given time, calculated by dividing the distance by the time.
fact_tl: Ang bilis ay kung gaano kalayo ang nilakbay ng isang bagay sa loob ng isang panahon, kaya kinakalkula ito sa pamamagitan ng paghahati ng layo sa oras (halimbawa, kilometro kada oras).
fact_bis: Ang katulin mao kung unsa ka layo ang gilakwan sa usa ka butang sa sulod sa usa ka panahon, busa makwenta kini pinaagi sa pagbahin sa gilay-on sa oras (pananglitan, kilometro matag oras).

q: Why can bright lights from roads or houses near a beach be dangerous for baby sea turtles?
options: Baby turtles head toward the brightest area, so the lights can lead them away from the sea
The bright lights blind baby turtles so they cannot see predators at night
Artificial lights heat the sand too much and stop the eggs from hatching
Baby turtles mistake the lights for the moon and swim upward instead of forward
explanation: Baby turtles instinctively head toward the brightest area, so artificial lights can lead them away from the sea, and even fewer survive.
fact_tl: Sumusunod ang batang pawikan sa pinakamaliwanag na bahagi, kaya kapag may maliwanag na ilaw sa kalsada o bahay, naliligaw sila palayo sa dagat at mas kakaunti ang nakakaligtas.
fact_bis: Mosunod ang gagmayng pawikan sa labing hayag nga bahin, busa kung naay hayag nga suga sa dalan o balay, masaag sila palayo sa dagat ug mas pipila ang makaluwas.

q: Why is the sun considered the starting point for most renewable energy sources?
options: The sun heats air to create wind and evaporates water that refills rivers used for hydropower
The sun's gravity pulls rivers downhill, creating the force needed for hydropower
Solar panels capture sunlight and directly power the wind turbines
The sun produces electricity that travels through the atmosphere to power plants
explanation: Most renewable energy begins with the sun — it heats air to create wind and evaporates water that returns as rain to fill rivers used for hydropower.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa renewable energy ay nagsisimula sa araw. Pinapainit ng araw ang hangin para lumikha ng wind, at pinapasingaw nito ang tubig na bumabalik bilang ulan na pumupuno sa mga ilog para sa hydropower.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa renewable energy magsugod sa adlaw. Ang adlaw mopainit sa hangin aron mohimo ug hangin, ug mopaalisngaw kini sa tubig nga mobalik isip ulan nga mopuno sa mga suba para sa hydropower.

q: Why are roofing sheets coated with zinc through a process called galvanizing?
options: The zinc reacts with water and air first, protecting the iron underneath from rusting
Zinc makes the sheets shinier so they reflect heat and keep buildings cooler
The zinc layer makes the sheets heavier so strong winds cannot blow them off
Zinc seals tiny holes in the iron so water cannot reach the surface at all
explanation: The zinc coating (galvanizing) reacts with water and air first, so the iron underneath is protected from rusting even in humid weather.
fact_tl: Ang mga yero sa bubong ng bahay ay binabalutan ng manipis na zinc, tinatawag na galvanized. Ang zinc na ito ang unang nakikipaglaban sa tubig at hangin, kaya hindi agad kumakalawang ang bakal sa ilalim kahit mahalumigmig.
fact_bis: Ang mga sin sa atop sa balay gibutangan og nipis nga zinc, gitawag og galvanized. Kini nga zinc ang mag-una og atubang sa tubig ug hangin, mao nga dili dayon motaya ang puthaw sa ilalom bisan umog.

q: How is density calculated?
options: By dividing the mass of an object by its volume
By multiplying the mass of an object by its volume
By subtracting the volume from the mass
By dividing the volume of an object by its weight
explanation: Density is the amount of mass in a given space, found by dividing mass by volume.
fact_tl: Ang densidad ay ang dami ng masa sa isang dami ng espasyo, na kinukuha sa masa hinati sa volume.
fact_bis: Ang densidad mao ang gidaghanon sa masa sa usa ka espasyo, makuha pinaagi sa pagbahin sa masa sa volume.

q: What is the bump on top of the kalaw's large curved beak called?
options: A casque
A crest
A wattle
A knob
explanation: The kalaw has a large curved beak with a bump on top called a casque, which looks like a horn.
fact_tl: May malaki at kurbadong tuka ang kalaw, at may bukol o 'casque' sa ibabaw nito na parang sungay.
fact_bis: Ang kalaw adunay dako ug kurbadong sungo nga adunay bukol o 'casque' sa ibabaw niini nga sama sa sungay.

q: What does chickenpox cause on the skin?
options: Itchy little blisters filled with fluid
Dry red patches that flake and peel
Hard bumps that do not itch but turn dark
Large painful sores that bleed easily
explanation: Chickenpox causes itchy little blisters filled with fluid on the skin.
fact_tl: Ang bulutong-tubig ay nagdudulot ng makati at maliliit na paltos na may tubig sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang bulutong-tubig magpagawas ug makatol nga gagmay nga butlig nga puno sa tubig sa panit.

q: How do cloud rats help the forest grow?
options: By eating fruits and seeds and spreading them around the forest
By digging burrows that loosen the soil for plant roots to grow
By eating insects that would otherwise destroy young tree seedlings
By building nests in tree trunks that let water reach plant roots
explanation: By eating fruits and seeds, cloud rats spread seeds around the forest, helping plants grow in new areas.
fact_tl: Sa pagkain ng prutas at buto, nakakatulong ang cloud rat na maikalat ang mga binhi sa kagubatan.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pagkaon ug prutas ug liso, ang cloud rat makatabang sa pagsabwag sa mga binhi sa kalasangan.

q: Where can plankton be found in the ocean?
options: Almost everywhere in the ocean, with billions in even a single drop of seawater
Only near the surface in shallow tropical waters
Only in deep cold ocean zones where sunlight cannot reach
Mainly around coral reefs where they use the coral for shelter
explanation: Plankton are found almost everywhere in the ocean, with billions drifting in even a single drop of seawater.
fact_tl: May plankton halos saanman sa karagatan, at bilyon-bilyon ang lumulutang sa isang patak lang ng tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Adunay plankton halos bisan asa sa dagat, ug binilyon ang naglutaw bisan sa usa ka tulo lang sa tubig-dagat.

q: What causes the Coriolis effect, which makes moving air and water appear to curve?
options: The Earth spinning on its axis
The gravitational pull of the Moon on the atmosphere
Differences in air temperature between the poles and the equator
The uneven surface of the continents deflecting wind patterns
explanation: The Coriolis effect happens because the Earth spins on its axis, which makes moving air and water appear to curve.
fact_tl: Ang Coriolis effect ay nangyayari dahil umiikot ang Mundo sa sarili nitong axis, kaya parang lumiliko ang mga gumagalaw na hangin at tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Coriolis effect mahitabo tungod kay nagtuyok ang Kalibutan sa iyang axis, mao nga morag mokurba ang naglihok nga hangin ug tubig.

q: The kagwang is nicknamed 'flying lemur,' but what is it NOT?
options: It is not a true lemur and not a monkey
It is not able to glide and not a mammal
It is not found in the Philippines and not a reptile
It is not nocturnal and not related to bats
explanation: Despite its nickname, the kagwang is not a true lemur and is not a monkey.
fact_tl: Ang kagwang ay tinatawag na 'flying lemur' pero hindi ito tunay na lemur at hindi rin ito unggoy.
fact_bis: Ang kagwang gitawag nga 'flying lemur,' apan dili kini tinuod nga lemur ug dili pud kini unggoy.

q: Why does the body sneeze?
options: To blow out dust or irritating things that got into the nose
To warm up cold air before it reaches the lungs
To send more oxygen to the brain when you feel dizzy
To clear out the throat when it is blocked by mucus
explanation: Sneezing is the body's way of cleaning the nose — a strong sneeze quickly blows out dust or anything irritating inside.
fact_tl: Ang pagbahing ay isang paraan ng katawan para linisin ang ilong. Kapag may alikabok o nakakakati sa loob ng ilong, mabilis itong pinalalabas ng malakas na pagbahing.
fact_bis: Ang pagbahing usa ka paagi sa lawas aron limpyohan ang ilong. Kung adunay abog o makakatol sa sulod sa ilong, paspas kining ipagawas sa kusog nga pagbahing.

q: What dangerous liquid is dynamite made from?
options: Nitroglycerin
Gunpowder
Hydrogen peroxide
Sulfuric acid
explanation: Dynamite is made from the dangerous liquid nitroglycerin, which Nobel found a way to make safe to handle.
fact_tl: Ginawa ang dynamite mula sa mapanganib na likido na nitroglycerin na ginawang ligtas hawakan ni Nobel.
fact_bis: Ang dynamite gihimo gikan sa peligrosong likido nga nitroglycerin nga gihimong luwas kuptan ni Nobel.

q: How do trees and forests help lower carbon dioxide in the air?
options: They store a lot of carbon in their wood and roots
They release special gases that break down carbon dioxide into harmless oxygen
They block carbon dioxide from drifting in from the ocean
They convert carbon dioxide directly into water through their root systems
explanation: Trees and forests store a lot of carbon in their wood and roots, which is why planting trees like mangroves in the Philippines helps lower carbon dioxide in the air.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno at gubat ay nag-iimbak ng maraming carbon sa kanilang kahoy at ugat. Ang pagtatanim ng puno gaya ng bakawan (mangrove) sa Pilipinas ay tumutulong mabawasan ang carbon dioxide sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy ug kalasangan magtipig og daghang carbon sa ilang kahoy ug gamot. Ang pagtanom og kahoy sama sa bakhaw sa Pilipinas makatabang sa pagpaubos sa carbon dioxide sa hangin.

q: What is hilot?
options: A traditional Filipino healing practice that uses massage and herbal oils to relieve body pain
A Filipino herbal tea brewed from coconut leaves to treat fever
A traditional Filipino exercise routine passed down from indigenous tribes
A Filipino ritual dance performed to ask for healing from the spirits
explanation: Hilot is a traditional Filipino healing practice that uses massage and herbal oils to relieve body pain and discomfort.
fact_tl: Ang hilot ay isang katutubong paraan ng pagpapagaling ng katawan sa Pilipinas na gumagamit ng haplos at mga halamang langis upang maibsan ang sakit at pighati ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang hilot usa ka katutubo nga paagi sa pagpagpas-an sa katawan sa Pilipinas nga naggamit og haplos ug herbal nga lana aron mawala ang kasakit ug kaguol sa lawas.

q: What is the main job of PHIVOLCS?
options: To monitor active volcanoes and earthquakes in the Philippines and provide safety warnings
To track typhoons and issue storm warnings for Filipino communities
To map out Philippine territory including islands and underwater reefs
To manage the clean-up and rebuilding after natural disasters in the Philippines
explanation: PHIVOLCS is the government agency that monitors active volcanoes and earthquakes in the Philippines and provides safety warnings.
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS (Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology) ay ang ahensya ng gobyerno na nagmamasid sa mga aktibong bulkan at lindol sa Pilipinas at nagbibigay ng mga babala para sa kaligtasan.
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS (Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology) mao ang ahensya sa gobyerno nga nagbantay sa mga aktibong bulkan ug lindol sa Pilipinas ug naghatag og mga pahimangno sa kaligtasan.

q: In a sound wave, what does frequency determine?
options: The pitch of the sound
The loudness of the sound
The speed at which the sound travels
The distance the sound can travel
explanation: Frequency is how many waves pass per second; in sound, frequency determines the pitch, while amplitude determines the loudness.
fact_tl: Madaling malito ang frequency at amplitude pero magkaiba sila. Ang frequency ay kung ilang alon ang dumadaan kada segundo, samantalang ang amplitude ay kung gaano kataas o kalakas ang alon. Sa tunog, ang frequency ang nagdidikta ng pitch, at ang amplitude ang nagdidikta ng lakas o loudness.
fact_bis: Sayon malibog ang frequency ug amplitude apan lahi sila. Ang frequency mao kung pila ka balod ang molabay matag segundo, samtang ang amplitude mao kung unsa ka taas o kakusog ang balod. Sa tingog, ang frequency mao ang magdesisyon sa pitch, ug ang amplitude mao ang kakusog o loudness.

q: How is a savanna different from a forest?
options: A savanna is a grassland with trees scattered far apart, not close together like in a forest
A savanna has no trees at all, only tall grasses that cover the ground
A savanna gets more rainfall than a forest, which is why the trees are bigger
A savanna is found only near rivers, while forests grow on mountains and hills
explanation: A savanna is a grassland that has trees scattered here and there, but they are not close together like in a forest.
fact_tl: Ang savanna ay isang grassland na may mga punong nakakalat dito at doon, ngunit hindi sila magkakadikit tulad sa gubat.
fact_bis: Ang savanna usa ka grassland nga adunay mga kahoy nga nagkatag dinhi ug didto, apan dili sila magkaduol sama sa lasang.

q: Which planet has the second most moons in our solar system?
options: Jupiter, with more than 90 moons
Mars, with more than 90 moons
Uranus, with more than 90 moons
Neptune, with more than 90 moons
explanation: Jupiter has the second most moons with more than 90, just behind Saturn.
fact_tl: Ang Jupiter ang pangalawa sa pinakamaraming buwan, na may mahigit 90 — sumunod sa Saturn.
fact_bis: Ang Jupiter mao ang ikaduha sa labing daghang bulan, nga adunay kapin sa 90 — sunod sa Saturn.

q: Why do comets return to the inner solar system even after traveling very far away?
options: The Sun's gravity still holds them and makes them follow long stretched-out orbits
Comets produce their own thrust from melting ice that pushes them back toward the Sun
The gravitational pull of Jupiter catches comets and flings them back toward the Sun
Comets bounce off the edge of the solar system and are reflected back inward
explanation: Even comets follow very long, stretched-out orbits, but the Sun's gravity still holds them so they return now and then.
fact_tl: Kahit ang mga kometa ay sumusunod sa napakahaba at pahabang orbita, hawak pa rin sila ng grabidad ng Araw kaya bumabalik sila paminsan-minsan.
fact_bis: Bisan ang mga kometa nagsunod sa taas kaayo ug binira nga orbita, ang gibug-aton sa Adlaw nagkupot gihapon kanila mao nga mobalik sila usahay.

q: How does the kakawate tree contribute to the nitrogen cycle?
options: It takes nitrogen from the air and returns it to the soil when its parts decompose
It stores nitrogen in its trunk and releases it slowly through its bark
It releases nitrogen gas into the air through its leaves during photosynthesis
It absorbs nitrogen from the soil and prevents it from escaping into the air
explanation: The kakawate is part of the nitrogen cycle: it takes nitrogen from the air and returns it to the soil when its parts decompose.
fact_tl: Bahagi ang kakawate ng siklo ng nitrogen: kinukuha nito ang nitrogen mula sa hangin at ibinabalik ito sa lupa kapag nabubulok ang mga bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Bahin ang kakawate sa siklo sa nitrogen: gikuha niini ang nitrogen gikan sa hangin ug giuli kini sa yuta kon madunot ang mga bahin niini.

q: What is the range in size of algae?
options: From tiny single cells too small to see up to large seaweeds visible in the water
From tiny floating spores to tree-sized kelp forests up to 30 meters tall
All algae are microscopic and can only be seen with a powerful microscope
Algae are all roughly the same size as the seagrasses found in shallow bays
explanation: Algae range from tiny single cells too small to see up to the large seaweeds we can spot in the water.
fact_tl: Ang algae ay mula sa napakaliliit na isahang selula hanggang sa malalaking seaweed o damong-dagat na nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Ang algae naglakip sa gagmay kaayo nga usa ka selula hangtod sa dagkong seaweed o lumot sa dagat nga atong makita.

q: Why can you NOT catch a mutation from sitting next to someone who has one?
options: A mutation happens inside a person's own DNA and cannot spread from one person to another like a cold
Mutations only travel through blood contact, not through the air or touch
Most mutations are hidden inside cells and cannot leave the body at all
The immune system destroys any mutation before it can leave the skin
explanation: Mutations happen inside a person's own DNA and are not contagious — you cannot catch a mutation from a friend or seatmate.
fact_tl: Maling akala na nakakahawa ang mutation gaya ng sipon. Hindi puwedeng mahawa ka ng mutation sa katabi mo, dahil ang mutation ay nagaganap sa loob mismo ng iyong sariling DNA. Puwede mo lang maipasa ang ilang mutation sa magiging anak mo, hindi sa kaibigan o katabi.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga ang mutation makatakod sama sa sip-on. Dili ka matakdan og mutation gikan sa imong tapad, kay ang mutation mahitabo sulod sa imong kaugalingong DNA. Mahimo ra nimong ikapasa ang ubang mutation sa imong umaabot nga anak, dili sa higala o tapad.

q: Who discovered Pluto, and in what year?
options: Clyde Tombaugh in 1930
Galileo Galilei in 1610
Edwin Hubble in 1924
Carl Sagan in 1971
explanation: The American astronomer Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto in 1930.
fact_tl: Ang Amerikanong astronomo na si Clyde Tombaugh ang nakatuklas ng Pluto noong 1930.
fact_bis: Ang Amerikanong astronomo nga si Clyde Tombaugh ang nakadiskobre sa Pluto niadtong 1930.

q: How is a frog's skin different from a toad's skin?
options: Frogs usually have smooth, wet skin, while toads have drier and bumpier skin
Frogs have thick leathery skin, while toads have thin and easily-torn skin
Frogs have brightly colored skin for warning, while toads are always camouflaged
Frogs shed their skin every day, while toads keep the same skin their whole life
explanation: Frogs usually have smooth, wet skin, while toads have drier and bumpier skin.
fact_tl: Karaniwang makinis at basa ang balat ng palaka, samantalang ang palakang-bukid (toad) ay may mas tuyo at magaspang na balat.
fact_bis: Ang baki kasagaran hamis ug basa og panit, samtang ang kabkab (toad) naay mas uga ug magaspang nga panit.

q: Why is it more dangerous when many wasps sting you at the same time compared to just one?
options: More wasps means more venom enters the body at once, making it more dangerous
Each additional wasp sting causes an allergic reaction that the first sting does not
Wasp stingers break off inside the skin when many sting together, causing infection
When many wasps attack, they release a gas that stops the heart from beating normally
explanation: When many wasps sting at the same time, more venom enters the body, making the situation more dangerous and requiring immediate help.
fact_tl: Ang isang saksak ng putakti ay masakit pero kadalasang gumagaling lang. Ngunit kapag maraming putakti ang sabay-sabay na nanaksak, mas dumadami ang kamandag sa katawan kaya mas delikado ito at kailangan ng tulong agad.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka tusok sa putyukan sakit apan kasagaran maayo ra. Apan kung daghang putyukan ang manukol dungan, mas daghang hilo ang mosulod sa lawas mao nga mas delikado kini ug nagkinahanglan ug tabang dayon.

q: What does seeing many dragonflies near a pond or stream tell you?
options: The water is likely healthy and clean
The water is polluted and needs to be cleaned
The water level is dropping and the pond may dry out soon
Dangerous bacteria are present and the water is unsafe to touch
explanation: Many dragonflies live near clean water, so plenty of dragonflies is a sign that a pond or stream is healthy.
fact_tl: Maraming tutubi ang nakatira malapit sa malinis na tubig, kaya ang pagdami ng tutubi ay tanda na malusog ang lawa o sapa.
fact_bis: Daghang tutubi ang nagpuyo duol sa limpyo nga tubig, mao nga ang kadaghan sa tutubi timailhan nga himsog ang lanaw o sapa.

q: What are the four stages of a mosquito's life cycle in order?
options: Egg, larva, pupa, adult
Egg, nymph, pupa, adult
Larva, egg, pupa, adult
Egg, larva, adult, pupa
explanation: A mosquito goes through four stages: egg, larva (wriggler) in water, pupa, and then adult mosquito.
fact_tl: Ang lamok ay dumadaan sa apat na yugto: itlog, larva (kiti-kiti) sa tubig, pupa, at saka ganap na lamok.
fact_bis: Ang lamok moagi sa upat ka hugna: itlog, larva (kiti-kiti) sa tubig, pupa, ug unya hingkod nga lamok.

q: What causes cancer in the body?
options: A cell divides without control because of damage or mutation in its genes
A cell grows too large and takes up space from other organs
A cell stops making energy and begins to poison nearby cells
A cell absorbs too many nutrients and swells up
explanation: Cancer happens when a cell divides without control because of damage or mutation in its genes.
fact_tl: Ang kanser ay nangyayari kapag ang isang selula ay naghahati nang walang kontrol dahil sa pinsala o mutasyon sa mga genes nito.
fact_bis: Ang kanser mahitabo kon ang usa ka selula mobahin nga walay kontrol tungod sa kadaot o mutasyon sa iyang mga gene.

q: Why does water hyacinth keep coming back even after people remove it from a river?
options: Even a tiny leftover piece with a root can grow into a whole new plant, and seeds can rest in mud for years
Its flowers release chemicals that attract birds, which carry seeds back to the water
The plant stores energy underground in large bulbs that are impossible to remove
Strong water currents carry the plant back from the ocean every season
explanation: Water hyacinth regrows from even a small root piece left behind, and its seeds can wait in the mud for years before sprouting.
fact_tl: Common na tanong: bakit bumabalik ang water hyacinth kahit nililinis? Dahil kahit isang maliit na piraso na may ugat ay puwedeng tumubo at maging bagong halaman. Bukod pa, ang mga buto nito ay puwedeng mahimbing sa putik nang mga ilang taon bago muling sumibol.
fact_bis: Komon nga pangutana: ngano mobalik ang water hyacinth bisan gilimpyohan? Kay bisan gamay nga nahabilin nga piraso nga naa'y gamot mahimong motubo ug mahimong bag-ong tanom. Dugang pa, ang mga liso niini mahimong matulog sa lapok sulod sa pipila ka tuig una mosalingsing pag-usab.

q: What is the chemical symbol for hydrogen?
options: H
Hy
Hd
Hg
explanation: The symbol for hydrogen is H.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng hydrogen ay H.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa hydrogen mao ang H.

q: How does the tuna industry help many Filipinos?
options: It gives jobs and a living to many Filipino fishers and families
It provides free fish to all schools across the country
It supplies fresh water to coastal communities through fish ponds
It funds the construction of bridges in fishing villages
explanation: The tuna industry gives jobs and a living to many Filipino fishers and families.
fact_tl: Ang industriya ng tuna ay nagbibigay ng hanapbuhay sa maraming mangingisda at pamilyang Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang industriya sa tuna naghatag og panginabuhi sa daghang mananagat ug pamilyang Pilipino.

q: Why is iodine important for the body even though we only need a very tiny amount of it?
options: The thyroid needs it to work correctly
The liver uses it to filter out toxins from food
The heart requires it to keep a steady beat
The lungs use it to transfer oxygen into the blood
explanation: Even a very tiny daily amount of iodine is critical because the thyroid needs it to function properly.
fact_tl: Napakaliit lang ng iodine na kailangan ng katawan araw-araw, parang kakapiraso lang, pero kahit gaano kaliit, napakahalaga nito para gumana nang tama ang thyroid.
fact_bis: Gamay ra kaayo ang iodine nga gikinahanglan sa lawas matag adlaw, sama ra sa usa ka gamayng tipik, apan bisan gamay kaayo, importante kaayo kini aron molihok og husto ang thyroid.

q: What happens when a house gecko loses its tail?
options: It slowly grows a new tail over several weeks or months, though the new tail is usually shorter and looks a bit different
It immediately grows back an identical tail the very next day
The tail never grows back, and the gecko learns to live without it
The gecko grows two new tails to replace the one it lost
explanation: A house gecko regrows its tail over several weeks or months, but the new tail is usually shorter and looks a little different from the original.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos maputol ang buntot ng butiki, unti-unti itong tumutubo ulit sa loob ng ilang linggo o buwan. Pero ang bagong buntot ay kadalasang mas maikli at iba ang hitsura kaysa sa orihinal.
fact_bis: Human maputol ang ikog sa butiki, hinay-hinay kining motubo balik sulod sa pipila ka semana o bulan. Apan ang bag-ong ikog kasagaran mas mubo ug lahi og dagway kay sa orihinal.

q: Which of these correctly describes how fast a papaya tree grows?
options: It can reach the height of a person in about a year because it grows very fast and has a soft trunk
It takes about ten years to grow as tall as a person because its trunk is very hard
It grows quickly but only in cold weather and needs many years to reach full height
It grows only a few centimeters each year because its fruit is heavy and slows it down
explanation: The papaya grows very fast and has a soft trunk, allowing it to reach a person's height in about one year.
fact_tl: Ang papaya ay lumalaki nang napakabilis at may malambot na katawan, kaya kaya nitong umabot ng taas ng tao sa loob lamang ng isang taon.
fact_bis: Ang kapayas paspas kaayo motubo ug adunay humok nga lawas, mao nga makaabot kini sa katas-on sa tawo sulod lang sa usa ka tuig.

q: Why does water stored in a clay jar stay cool?
options: A little water evaporates through the porous clay and carries heat away
The clay absorbs sunlight and reflects heat away from the water inside
Clay is naturally cold and keeps the temperature of the water low
The water inside shrinks in the clay jar, and smaller water stays colder
explanation: Water in a clay jar stays cool because a little water evaporates through the porous clay and carries heat away.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa banga ay lumalamig dahil ang kaunting tubig na sumisingaw sa butas-butas na luwad ay nagdadala ng init palabas.
fact_bis: Ang tubig sa banga magpabilin nga bugnaw kay ang gamay nga tubig nga moalisngaw sa lungag-lungag nga luwad magdala sa kainit pagawas.

q: Besides clownfish, which other animals are also known to live with and help sea anemones?
options: Some small shrimp and crabs
Small squid and jellyfish
Certain sea turtles and dolphins
Electric eels and moray eels
explanation: Some small shrimp and crabs also live with and help anemones, just like clownfish do.
fact_tl: Hindi lang clownfish ang tumutulong sa anemone. May mga maliliit na hipon at crab din na nakikitira at nagtutulungan sa anemone. Ipinapakita nito na maraming klase ng hayop sa dagat ang marunong magtulungan para mabuhay.
fact_bis: Dili lang clownfish ang motabang sa anemone. Adunay gagmay nga pasayan ug alimango nga nagpuyo ug nagtinabangay usab sa anemone. Gipakita niini nga daghang klase sa mananap sa dagat ang kahibalo motinabangay aron mabuhi.

q: Why does soap make a lot of foam when used with soft water?
options: Soap lathers easily in soft water because soft water does not block the soap from foaming
Soft water is very cold, and cold water makes soap foam more quickly
Soap releases extra chemicals when it touches soft water that create bubbles
Soft water already contains soap-like minerals that add to the foam
explanation: Soap lathers easily in soft water, so it makes lots of foam.
fact_tl: Madaling pabulain ang sabon sa malambot na tubig kaya marami itong bula.
fact_bis: Sayon pabulahon ang sabon sa humok nga tubig mao nga daghan kini og bula.

q: What is lime (apog) mainly made of?
options: Calcium, usually as calcium oxide or calcium hydroxide
Sodium, usually as sodium chloride or sodium carbonate
Magnesium, usually as magnesium oxide or magnesium sulfate
Potassium, usually as potassium oxide or potassium nitrate
explanation: Lime (apog) is made of calcium, usually in the form of calcium oxide or calcium hydroxide.
fact_tl: Ang apog (lime) ay gawa sa calcium, karaniwang bilang calcium oxide o calcium hydroxide.
fact_bis: Ang apog (lime) hinimo gikan sa calcium, kasagaran isip calcium oxide o calcium hydroxide.

q: How does food leave the stomach and enter the small intestine?
options: A ring of muscle opens a little at a time to release food slowly into the small intestine
The stomach contracts all at once and pushes all the food out at the same time
Food floats up out of the stomach because it is lighter than stomach acid
The stomach dissolves food completely into liquid before releasing it all at once
explanation: A ring of muscle (a valve) opens a little at a time to release food slowly from the stomach into the small intestine.
fact_tl: Hindi sabay-sabay na lumalabas ang pagkain sa tiyan. May singsing na kalamnan (balbula) na nagbubukas nang unti-unti para dahan-dahang maipasa ang pagkain sa maliit na bituka.
fact_bis: Dili dungan nga mogawas ang pagkaon sa tiyan. Adunay singsing nga kaunoran (valve) nga moabli og hinay-hinay aron inanay nga ipasa ang pagkaon ngadto sa gamayng tinai.

q: How does Jupiter's surface gravity compare to Earth's?
options: Jupiter's gravity is about 24.8 m/s², which is more than double Earth's 9.8 m/s²
Jupiter's gravity is about 9.8 m/s², which is exactly the same as Earth's
Jupiter's gravity is about 12.5 m/s², which is slightly stronger than Earth's
Jupiter's gravity is about 4.9 m/s², which is about half of Earth's
explanation: Jupiter's surface gravity is about 24.8 m/s², more than double Earth's 9.8 m/s².
fact_tl: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw ng Jupiter ay halos 24.8 m/s², mahigit dalawang beses ng 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw sa Jupiter mga 24.8 m/s², kapin sa doble sa 9.8 m/s² sa Yuta.

q: Why is the blood in the right side of the heart often shown as blue in diagrams, even though it is not really blue?
options: It is colored blue in diagrams so the difference between oxygen-poor and oxygen-rich blood is easy to see
Blue dye is mixed into the blood by the right side of the heart to mark old blood
The right side of the heart is colder than the left, turning the blood blue like ice water
Blue light inside the chest makes the blood appear blue in X-ray diagrams
explanation: Blood low in oxygen looks dark red or maroon, not blue — it is only colored blue in diagrams to make the difference easy to see.
fact_tl: Sa mga larawan, kadalasang asul ang ipinapakitang dugo sa kanang bahagi ng puso, pero hindi naman talaga ito asul. Ang dugong walang masyadong oxygen ay maitim na pula o kulay-ube ang itsura, hindi asul. Asul lang ito ipinapakita para madaling makita ang pagkakaiba.
fact_bis: Sa mga litrato, kasagaran asul ang gipakita nga dugo sa tuong bahin sa kasingkasing, apan dili kini tinuod nga asul. Ang dugo nga gamay og oxygen itom nga pula o morag ube ang dagway, dili asul. Gipa-asul lang kini sa mga drawing aron sayon makita ang kalainan.

q: Why does a bimetal strip bend when it is heated?
options: One metal in the strip expands faster than the other when heated, causing the strip to curve
Both metals melt slightly on one side, making the strip droop downward
The strip bends because heat always pushes objects to the left or right
One metal becomes magnetic when hot and is pulled toward the other metal
explanation: A bimetal strip bends when heated because it is made of two metals with different rates of thermal expansion — one metal expands faster than the other.
fact_tl: Ang bimetal strip ay gawa sa dalawang metal na may magkaibang rate ng thermal expansion — kapag nainit, ang strip ay yumuyuko dahil ang isang metal ay lumalawak nang mas mabilis kaysa sa isa.
fact_bis: Ang bimetal strip gilangkuban sa duha ka metal nga adunay lain-laing rate sa thermal expansion — kung nainit, ang strip mobuko tungod kay ang usa ka metal mopalawak nga mas dali kaysa sa usa.

q: What is the correct source of heat energy released by radioactive material?
options: Energy comes from inside the atom's nucleus when it decays — no flame or oxygen is needed
Energy comes from a slow chemical burning reaction inside the material that needs oxygen
Energy comes from the friction between atoms as they rub together and create heat
Energy comes from sunlight absorbed by the radioactive material and released slowly as heat
explanation: The heat from radioactive material comes from inside the atom's nucleus when it decays — no flame or oxygen is needed, unlike burning.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakala na ang init mula sa radioactive material ay galing sa 'pagkasunog' tulad ng kahoy o gasolina. Mali ito — walang apoy o oxygen na kailangan. Ang enerhiya ay galing mismo sa loob ng nucleus ng atomo kapag ito ay nagde-decay, isang ganap na ibang proseso sa pagkasunog.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang kainit gikan sa radioactive material naggikan sa 'pagkasunog' sama sa kahoy o gasolina. Sayop kini — walay kalayo o oxygen nga gikinahanglan. Ang enerhiya naggikan mismo sa sulod sa nucleus sa atomo kung kini mo-decay, usa ka hingpit nga lahi nga proseso kaysa pagkasunog.

q: What is notebook paper made from?
options: Tiny wood fibers from trees that are mashed into pulp, pressed flat, and dried
Thin sheets of rock mineral that are sliced and bleached white
Fibers from cotton plants that are woven together and flattened
Recycled plastic that is melted, stretched into thin sheets, and dried
explanation: The paper in a notebook is made from tiny wood fibers from trees, which are mashed into pulp, pressed flat, and dried.
fact_tl: Ang papel sa kwaderno ay gawa sa pinong himaymay ng kahoy mula sa mga puno, na dinurog at pinipis bago patuyuin.
fact_bis: Ang papel sa kwaderno hinimo gikan sa gagmay nga himaymay sa kahoy gikan sa mga kahoy, nga giduktok ngadto sa pulp, gipig-ot, ug gipauga.

q: What is the job of phloem in a plant?
options: It carries sugar (glucose) from the leaves down to all parts of the plant
It carries water and minerals from the roots up to the leaves
It carries oxygen from the air down into the roots
It carries waste products from the leaves into the soil
explanation: Phloem carries sugar (glucose) from leaves down to all parts of the plant, while xylem carries water and minerals upward from the roots.
fact_tl: Ang xylem ay nagdadala ng tubig at mineral mula sa ugat paakyat hanggang sa mga dahon, habang ang phloem ay nagdadala ng asukal (glucose) mula sa mga dahon pababa patungo sa lahat ng bahagi ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang xylem nagdala sa tubig ug mineral gikan sa mga gamot pataas ngadto sa mga dahon, samtang ang phloem nagdala sa asukar (glucose) gikan sa mga dahon paubos ngadto sa tanan nga bahin sa tanom.

q: Who decides the names of craters on the Moon?
options: The International Astronomical Union (IAU) names them after famous scientists, mathematicians, and explorers
The astronauts who first visit each crater get to choose its name
The country that builds the most powerful telescope gets to name new craters
Each country names one crater, chosen by a vote from its citizens
explanation: Most craters on the Moon are named by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) after famous scientists, mathematicians, and explorers, such as Copernicus.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan sa mga crater sa Moon ay pinangalanan ng International Astronomical Union (IAU) ayon sa mga sikat na siyentipiko, mathematicians, at explorer; halimbawa, ang crater na Copernicus ay pinangalanan kay Nicolaus Copernicus na nagmungkahi na ang Araw ang gitna ng solar system.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa mga crater sa Moon gipahinganlan sa International Astronomical Union (IAU) ayon sa mga sikat nga mga syentipiko, matematiko, ug manlalayag; pananglitan, ang crater nga Copernicus gipahinganlan kang Nicolaus Copernicus nga nagmugna og ideya nga ang Adlaw mao ang sentro sa solar system.

q: Why are decomposer bacteria considered helpful rather than harmful?
options: Without them, the world would be buried in dead plants and animals because they break down dead matter
They protect people from disease by killing all other bacteria in the soil
They produce oxygen for us to breathe by digesting dead organic material
They are helpful because they make the soil darker so plants can find sunlight more easily
explanation: Decomposer bacteria are among the most helpful living things on Earth — without them, the world would be buried in dead plants and animals.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang akala na lahat ng bacteria ay 'germs' na nagdudulot ng sakit. Mali iyon — ang mga decomposer na bacteria ay kabilang sa pinakakapaki-pakinabang na nilalang sa Earth. Kung wala sila, babahain ang mundo ng patay na halaman at hayop.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga tanang bacteria kay 'germs' nga magpasakit. Sayop kana — ang decomposer nga bacteria usa sa pinakatabang nga buhing butang sa Yuta. Kung wala sila, malubong ang kalibotan sa patay nga tanom ug hayop.

q: How many chromosomes does a normal human cell contain?
options: 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs
23 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs
48 chromosomes arranged in 24 pairs
44 chromosomes arranged in 22 pairs
explanation: Each human cell normally has 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs — half from the mother and half from the father.
fact_tl: Ang bawat human cell ay karaniwang may 46 na chromosomes na nakaayos sa 23 pares — kalahati mula sa ina at kalahati mula sa ama.
fact_bis: Ang matag human cell kasagaran adunay 46 ka chromosomes nga gihan-ay sa 23 ka pares — katunga gikan sa inahan ug katunga gikan sa amahan.

q: On which side of the leaf are most stomata found, and why?
options: On the underside of the leaf to reduce excess water loss
On the top surface of the leaf to absorb the most sunlight
Along the edges of the leaf to allow air to flow freely
Inside the veins of the leaf to protect them from drying out
explanation: Most stomata are on the underside of the leaf to reduce excess water loss.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng stomata ay nasa ilalim ng dahon para mabawasan ang sobrang pagkawala ng tubig.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa stomata anaa sa ilalom sa dahon aron makunhoran ang sobra nga pagkawala sa tubig.

q: How is a cnidarian's body shaped, and what advantage does this give it?
options: Its body is round like a wheel with tentacles in a circle, letting it sense food coming from any direction
Its body is flat like a ribbon so it can hide under rocks and ambush prey from one side
Its body is long and thin like a tube so it can move quickly in a straight line through the water
Its body has two identical halves so it can split in two and become two separate animals
explanation: A cnidarian's body has radial symmetry — round like a wheel with tentacles arranged in a circle — allowing it to sense food coming from any direction.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng cnidarian ay bilog at parang gulong (radial symmetry), na ang mga galamay ay nakapaikot sa gitnang bibig. Kaya kaya nitong makaramdam ng pagkain mula sa kahit anong direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa cnidarian lingin sama sa ligid (radial symmetry), nga ang mga galamay nagpalibot sa tunga nga baba. Busa makabati kini og pagkaon gikan sa bisan asa nga direksyon.

q: Why does each firefly species have its own unique flash pattern?
options: So males and females of the same species can recognize each other for mating
So fireflies can warn predators that they are poisonous and should not be eaten
So fireflies can light up their surroundings to find food at night
So fireflies can signal other animals about the location of water
explanation: Each firefly species has a unique flash pattern so males and females can recognize each other for mating.
fact_tl: Ang bawat species ng alitaptap ay may natatanging pattern ng pagkislap para makila ng lalaki at babae ang isa't isa para sa pagtatipan.
fact_bis: Ang matag species sa alitaptap adunay talagsaong flash pattern aron makilala sa usag-usa ang lalaki ug babae para sa pagtatipan.

q: How does a sea cucumber move from place to place?
options: It uses tiny tube feet powered by water inside its body
It uses jet propulsion by squirting water out of its mouth
It rolls along the seafloor using its rounded body like a wheel
It digs into the sand with its front end and pulls the rest of its body along
explanation: Like other echinoderms, the sea cucumber moves using tiny tube feet powered by water inside its body.
fact_tl: Tulad ng ibang echinoderm, gumagamit ang balat ng maliliit na paa-tubo na pinapagana ng tubig sa loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Sama sa ubang echinoderm, ang balatan mogamit og gagmayng tube feet nga gipalihok sa tubig sulod sa lawas niini.

q: How does a crocodile's overlapping field of vision help it when hunting?
options: It helps the crocodile judge exactly how far away its prey is before it strikes
It lets the crocodile see in complete darkness underwater without any light
It allows the crocodile to see in two different directions at the same time to watch for enemies
It helps the crocodile detect the smell of blood in the water from a great distance
explanation: The area in front where both of a crocodile's eyes see the same thing at once helps it judge exactly how far away its prey is before striking.
fact_tl: May bahagi sa harapan kung saan magkasabay na nakikita ng dalawang mata ng buwaya ang parehong bagay. Tumutulong ito para masukat nito nang tama kung gaano kalayo ang biktima bago ito sumalakay.
fact_bis: Adunay bahin sa atubangan diin dungan nga makita sa duha ka mata sa buaya ang samang butang. Makatabang kini aron masukod niini sa husto kung unsa kalayo ang tukbonon una kini mosulong.

q: Why is an alloy classified as a mixture rather than a compound?
options: The metals are melted and mixed together but remain separate substances, so it is still a mixture, not a chemically bonded compound
The metals in an alloy share electrons equally, forming a new substance with completely different properties
Alloys are compounds because two or more elements combine and can never be separated again
An alloy is a compound because each metal loses its original identity when melted together
explanation: An alloy is a solid mixture of metals — the metals are melted and mixed while hot, then set solid, but they remain a mixture, not a compound.
fact_tl: Ang alloy ay solidong timpla ng metal — gaya ng asero (bakal + carbon) at bronse (tanso + lata). Tinutunaw at pinaghahalo ang mga metal habang mainit, tapos pinatitigas — kaya timpla pa rin ito, hindi compound.
fact_bis: Ang alloy usa ka solidong sagol sa metal — sama sa asero (puthaw + carbon) ug bronse (tumbaga + lata). Tunawon ug isagol ang mga metal samtang init, dayon patig-ahon — busa sagol gihapon kini, dili compound.

q: How do Philippine mangroves help address climate change?
options: They absorb carbon from the air, making them among nature's most effective carbon stores
They release large amounts of oxygen that cool the atmosphere and lower temperatures
They block ocean currents, stopping warm water from reaching the coast and raising temperatures
They grow so thickly that they stop typhoons from bringing rain, reducing flooding
explanation: Philippine mangroves are among nature's most effective carbon stores, helping address climate change by absorbing carbon from the air.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakawan (mangrove) sa Pilipinas ay isa sa mga pinaka-epektibong tagapag-imbak ng karbon sa kalikasan; nakatutulong ang mga ito sa pagbabago ng klima sa pamamagitan ng pag-iimbak ng karbon mula sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakawan (mangrove) sa Pilipinas usa sa labing epektibong tagailwas sa karbon sa kalikasan; nagtabang kini sa pagbabago sa klima pinaagi sa pagsuyop sa karbon gikan sa hangin.

q: Where exactly does light bend when it passes from air into water?
options: At the boundary or surface between the air and the water
Deep inside the water, far from the surface
Halfway through the water, in the middle of the glass or pool
Only at the bottom where the light hits a solid surface
explanation: The bending of light (refraction) happens at the boundary or surface where two materials meet, such as between air and water.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang pagbaluktot ng liwanag sa hangganan o ibabaw kung saan nagtatagpo ang dalawang bagay, tulad ng pagitan ng hangin at tubig — hindi habang nasa loob lamang ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagbawog sa kahayag mahitabo sa utlanan o ibabaw diin magtagbo ang duha ka butang, sama sa tunga sa hangin ug tubig — dili samtang ang kahayag anaa pa sa sulod sa tubig.

q: What does the closing of the heart's valves produce?
options: The 'lub-dub' sound of the heartbeat
The pumping force that pushes blood through the body
The electrical signal that tells the heart when to beat
The warmth that keeps the blood at body temperature
explanation: The valves between heart chambers open and close to keep blood flowing one way, and their closing makes the 'lub-dub' sound of the heartbeat.
fact_tl: Sa pagitan ng mga silid ay may mga balbula na parang pinto na bumubukas at sumasara. Pinapayagan nilang dumaloy ang dugo sa isang direksyon lamang at pinipigilang bumalik ito. Ang pagsara ng mga balbula ang gumagawa ng 'lub-dub' na tunog ng tibok ng puso.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa mga lawak adunay mga balbula nga sama sa pultahan nga moabli ug mosira. Gitugotan nila ang dugo nga modagayday sa usa lang ka direksyon ug gipugngan kini sa pagbalik. Ang pagsira sa mga balbula maoy nagahimo sa 'lub-dub' nga tingog sa pitik sa kasingkasing.

q: How does the body defend itself when a virus enters?
options: The body makes antibodies — tiny defenders that fight that particular virus
The body raises its temperature high enough to boil and destroy the virus
The body sends extra red blood cells to surround and trap the virus
The body produces extra mucus to push the virus out through the nose
explanation: When a virus enters the body, the immune system makes antibodies — tiny defenders that fight that particular virus.
fact_tl: Kapag pumasok ang virus, gumagawa ang ating katawan ng antibodies, mga maliit na panangga na lumalaban sa virus na iyon.
fact_bis: Kon mosulod ang bayrus, ang atong lawas mohimo ug antibodies, gagmay nga tigpanalipod nga makig-away nianang bayrusa.

q: How does the brain cause your muscles to move?
options: The brain sends signals through nerves to tell the muscles when to pull
The brain pumps extra blood to the muscles to give them energy to move
The brain releases a hormone into the blood that reaches the muscles and makes them contract
The brain heats up the muscles slightly so they become flexible and can bend
explanation: The brain sends signals through nerves to tell the muscles when to pull.
fact_tl: Nagpapadala ang utak ng mga senyas sa pamamagitan ng mga nerbiyo para sabihan ang kalamnan kung kailan hihila.
fact_bis: Ang utok mopadala ug mga signos pinaagi sa mga nerbiyo aron sultihan ang kaunuran kung kanus-a mobira.

q: What color is blood that is carrying a full load of oxygen?
options: Bright red
Dark maroon
Purple
Blue
explanation: Blood that is full of oxygen is bright red.
fact_tl: Ang dugong puno ng oxygen ay maliwanag na pula (bright red).
fact_bis: Ang dugo nga puno sa oxygen hayag nga pula (bright red).

q: What did Pasteur's swan-neck flask experiment prove?
options: Living organisms do not arise from non-living matter — airborne microorganisms cause decay, not spontaneous generation
Living things can form from non-living chemicals if the chemicals are heated for long enough
Decay is caused by invisible air currents, not by any living organism
Bacteria grow only in curved glass containers, not in straight ones
explanation: Pasteur's swan-neck flask experiment proved that airborne microorganisms — not spontaneous generation — cause decay, showing life does not arise from non-living matter.
fact_tl: Pinatunayan ni Pasteur na ang mga organismo ay hindi lumalabas sa wala — ang kaniyang swan-neck flask experiment ay nagpakita na ang mga microorganism sa hangin ang nagdudulot ng pagkabulok, hindi ang spontaneous generation.
fact_bis: Gipatunayan ni Pasteur nga ang mga buhing organismo dili moluwa sa wala — ang iyang swan-neck flask experiment nagpakita nga ang mga microorganism sa hangin ang nagpahinabog pagkadunot, dili spontaneous generation.

q: At what wind speed does PAGASA raise Signal No. 5 for a typhoon?
options: 185 km/h or higher
120 km/h or higher
150 km/h or higher
220 km/h or higher
explanation: PAGASA raises Signal No. 5 when a storm's winds reach 185 km/h or higher.
fact_tl: Itinataas ng PAGASA ang Signal No. 5 kapag ang hangin ng bagyo ay 185 km/h o mas mataas pa.
fact_bis: Ipataas sa PAGASA ang Signal No. 5 kung ang hangin sa bagyo moabot og 185 km/h o mas taas pa.

q: Why is the top of a room usually warmer than the floor?
options: Warm air rises because it is lighter than cold air, so it collects near the ceiling
Heat always sinks downward from lights in the ceiling, warming the air near the top
Cold air rises and pushes warm air down, but the floor stays cold
Warm air spreads evenly in all directions, but ceilings trap the heat
explanation: Warm air rises because it is lighter than cold air, so the top of a room is warmer than the floor.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na hangin ay umaakyat dahil ito ay mas magaan kaysa malamig na hangin, kaya mas mainit sa itaas na bahagi ng isang silid kaysa sa sahig.
fact_bis: Ang init nga hangin mosaka kay mas gaan kini kaysa bugnaw nga hangin, mao nga mas init ang ibabaw nga bahin sa kwarto kaysa salog.

q: Why is a cast put on a broken bone?
options: To keep the bone straight while it heals
To make the bone grow faster by keeping it warm
To prevent blood from reaching the bone so it does not swell
To absorb the pain from the break while the patient rests
explanation: When a bone breaks it can heal, and a cast is used to keep it straight so it mends properly.
fact_tl: Kapag nabali ang isang buto, ito ay maaaring gumaling, at madalas itong nilalagyan ng cast para manatiling tuwid.
fact_bis: Kung mabali ang usa ka bukog, makaayo kini, ug sagad butangan kini ug cast aron magpabiling tul-id.

q: What happens to the herpes simplex type 1 virus after a person's first infection?
options: The virus hides in nerve cells and can reactivate later during stress or illness
The immune system destroys the virus completely, so it never comes back
The virus travels to the lungs and stays there permanently without causing any symptoms
The virus becomes part of the person's genes and is passed on to their children
explanation: After the first infection, herpes simplex type 1 hides in nerve cells and can reactivate during stress or illness, causing cold sores again.
fact_tl: Ang herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) ay nagdudulot ng singaw (cold sore) — pagkatapos ng unang impeksyon, ang virus ay nagtataago sa mga nerve cell at maaaring mag-activate ulit sa panahon ng stress o sakit.
fact_bis: Ang herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) nagpahinabog singaw — human sa unang impeksyon, ang virus nagtago sa mga nerve cell ug mahimong mag-activate pag-usab sa panahon sa stress o sakit.

q: In the rock cycle, what does limestone become when it is heated and squeezed?
options: Marble
Granite
Sandstone
Obsidian
explanation: In the rock cycle, if limestone is heated and squeezed deep underground, it becomes marble.
fact_tl: Sa siklo ng bato, ang kabibe ay nagiging limestone, at kung iinitan at didiinan ito, nagiging marmol.
fact_bis: Sa siklo sa bato, ang kabibe mahimong limestone, ug kung init-on ug ipit-on kini, mahimo kining marmol.

q: What happens to the thyroid gland when a person's food does not contain enough iodine?
options: The thyroid can swell into a goiter because it cannot make its hormone without iodine
The thyroid shrinks and stops working completely, and the person loses all energy
The thyroid starts producing extra hormones to make up for the missing iodine
The thyroid stores extra calcium to replace the missing iodine and keeps working normally
explanation: When food lacks iodine, the thyroid — which needs iodine to make its hormone — can swell into a goiter, which is why Philippine salt is iodized.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng thyroid ang iodine para gumawa ng hormone nito. Kapag kulang sa iodine ang pagkain, maaaring mamaga ang thyroid at maging goiter, kaya nilalagyan ng iodine ang asin sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid nanginahanglan og iodine aron makahimo sa hormone niini. Kon kulang sa iodine ang pagkaon, mahimong mohubag ang thyroid ug mahimong goiter, mao nga ang asin sa Pilipinas gibutangan og iodine.

q: What happens to a moving object when you push it from the side?
options: It turns or changes direction
It speeds up in the direction it was already going
It slows down and eventually stops
It moves backward in the opposite direction
explanation: Pushing an object from the side causes it to turn; the direction of a force shapes how the motion changes.
fact_tl: Hindi lang lakas — mahalaga rin ang DIREKSYON ng force sa kung paano magbabago ang galaw. Kung itutulak mo ang bagay sa direksyon ng galaw nito, bumibilis ito; kung kontra sa galaw, bumabagal; kung sa gilid, lumiliko. Iisang force, iba-ibang resulta depende sa direksyon.
fact_bis: Dili lang kusog — importante usab ang DIREKSYON sa force sa kung unsaon pag-usab sa lihok. Kung iduso nimo ang butang sa direksyon sa iyang lihok, mopaspas kini; kung supak, mohinay; kung gikan sa kilid, moliko. Parehas nga force, lainlain nga resulta depende sa direksyon.

q: Why do scientists study the dangerous toxin produced during red tide?
options: It helps them understand how the body's nerves work because it is a natural poison that affects nerves
It can be used as a fertilizer for ocean plants if diluted with enough water
It can power small batteries because it releases a large amount of chemical energy
It helps scientists track ocean currents since the toxin glows bright red in satellite images
explanation: Scientists study the red tide toxin because this kind of natural poison helps them understand how the body's nerves work.
fact_tl: Bagaman delikado ang lason ng red tide, pinag-aaralan ito ng mga siyentista dahil ang ganitong likas na lason ay tumutulong sa kanila na maunawaan kung paano gumagana ang mga ugat at nerbiyo ng katawan.
fact_bis: Bisan delikado ang hilo sa red tide, gitun-an kini sa mga siyentista kay kini nga matang sa natural nga hilo motabang kanila pagsabot kon unsaon paglihok sa mga nerbiyo sa lawas.

q: Why does a short vibrating string produce a higher pitch than a long one?
options: On a short string, only a smaller wave fits, so it repeats faster and produces a higher pitch
A short string is thinner, and thinner strings always vibrate more slowly and sound higher
A short string is held tighter, and tight strings vibrate at a lower rate producing high sound
A short string has less air around it, so the sound waves travel faster and sound higher
explanation: On a short string, only a smaller wave fits, so it repeats faster and produces a higher pitch.
fact_tl: Kapag nag-vibrate ang kuwerdas, bumubuo ito ng mga alon. Sa maikling kuwerdas, mas maliit ang alon na kasya, kaya mas mabilis itong umuulit at mas mataas ang tunog na nagagawa.
fact_bis: Kung mokurog ang kuwerdas, mohimo kini ug mga balod. Sa mubo nga kuwerdas, mas gamay nga balod ang mohaom, mao nga mas paspas kini mosubli ug mas taas ang tingog nga mahimo.

q: The lionfish is native to the Indo-Pacific but is now a harmful invasive species in which ocean region?
options: The Atlantic and Caribbean
The Arctic Ocean
The Indian Ocean
The Southern Ocean near Antarctica
explanation: The lionfish is native to the Indo-Pacific but has become a harmful invasive species in the Atlantic and Caribbean.
fact_tl: Ang lionfish ay katutubo sa Indo-Pacific, ngunit naging mapanirang dayuhang species ito sa Atlantic at Caribbean.
fact_bis: Ang lionfish lumad sa Indo-Pacific, apan nahimo kining makadaot nga langyaw nga species sa Atlantic ug Caribbean.

q: Why does the Moon look red during a lunar eclipse?
options: Earth's atmosphere bends red light and lets it reach the Moon
The Moon's surface heats up and glows red when Earth blocks the Sun's light
Dust from Earth's volcanoes travels to the Moon and gives it a red color
Red light from the Sun bounces off the ocean and is reflected onto the Moon
explanation: The Moon looks red during an eclipse because Earth's atmosphere bends red light and lets it reach the Moon.
fact_tl: Pula ang Buwan sa eclipse dahil ang atmospera ng Lupa ang nagbabaluktot at nagpapadaan ng pulang liwanag tungo rito.
fact_bis: Mapula ang Bulan sa eklipse kay ang atmospera sa Yuta nagbawog ug nagpaagi sa pula nga kahayag ngadto niini.

q: How long should you scrub your hands with soap to wash away germs properly?
options: About 20 seconds — as long as singing 'Happy Birthday' twice
About 5 seconds — just a quick rub to remove visible dirt
About 2 minutes — long enough for the soap to soak into the skin
About 1 minute — long enough for the soap to kill all bacteria on contact
explanation: A good handwashing lasts about 20 seconds of scrubbing — as long as singing 'Happy Birthday' twice — so the soap has time to remove the germs.
fact_tl: Maraming batang nagtatanong kung gaano katagal dapat maghugas. Ang mabuting tagal ay mga 20 segundo ng pagkuskos — kasinghaba ng dalawang ulit na kanta ng 'Happy Birthday' — para magkaroon ng panahon ang sabon na alisin ang germ.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang nangutana kon unsa kadugay sila maghugas. Ang maayong gidugayon mga 20 ka segundo nga pagkuskos — sama kataas sa kaduha nga pag-awit sa 'Happy Birthday' — aron adunay panahon ang sabon sa pagtangtang sa germ.

q: During the power phase of a paddle stroke, what does the paddler do?
options: Pulls the blade back through the water to push the boat forward
Dips the blade in ahead to catch the water before pulling
Lifts the blade out and swings it forward to prepare for the next stroke
Holds the blade still underwater so water pressure slows the boat
explanation: The power phase is when the paddler pulls the blade back through the water, which pushes the boat forward.
fact_tl: Ang isang hatak ng sagwan ay may mga yugto: una, ilubog mo ang blade sa unahan (catch); pangalawa, hilahin mo ito paatras habang nasa tubig para tumulak (power); at pangatlo, iangat mo ito palabas at ibalik sa unahan (recovery). Inuulit-ulit ang siklong ito para magpatuloy ang bangka.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hatak sa bugsay adunay mga yugto: una, ituslob ang blade sa unahan (catch); ikaduha, birahon kini paatras samtang anaa sa tubig aron motulak (power); ug ikatulo, ialsa kini pagawas ug ibalik sa unahan (recovery). Balik-balikon kini nga siklo aron magpadayon ang bangka.

q: Which part of a rainforest has the most humid or moist air?
options: The forest floor, because humidity increases lower down through the layers
The canopy at the top, because the most rain falls there first
The middle layer, because it is sheltered from wind above and below
The emergent layer at the very top, where clouds touch the tallest trees
explanation: Lower in the layers the air gets more humid, so the forest floor is the wettest and most moist part of the rainforest.
fact_tl: Pababa sa mga patong, mas tumataas ang halumigmig kaya pinakabasa at pinaka-umido ang sahig ng gubat.
fact_bis: Paubos sa mga patong, mas modako ang umog sa hangin, busa ang salog sa lasang mao ang labing basa ug umido.

q: Halo-halo is described as a heterogeneous mixture. What does this mean?
options: All the ingredients blend together so you cannot tell them apart
You can still see all its different parts like ice, sago, and gulaman
The ingredients change into a brand-new substance when mixed
The mixture must be heated before you can eat it
explanation: In halo-halo each ingredient keeps its own identity, so you can still see and separate them — the definition of a heterogeneous mixture.
fact_tl: Ang halo-halo ay magandang halimbawa ng pinaghalo dahil makikita mo pa ang lahat ng sangkap nito—yelo, sago, gulaman, saging, at leche flan. Bawat sangkap ay nananatiling sarili nitong sarap, at puwede mo pa silang pag-isa-isahin. Ito ay heterogeneous na pinaghalo.
fact_bis: Ang halo-halo maayong pananglitan sa sagol kay makita pa nimo ang tanan niini nga sangkap—yelo, sago, gulaman, saging, ug leche flan. Ang matag sangkap nagpabilin sa kaugalingong lami niini, ug mahimo pa nimo silang puniton tagsa-tagsa. Heterogeneous kini nga sagol.

q: What happens to plastic over time instead of disappearing?
options: It dissolves completely into water
It turns into a harmless gas
It breaks into very tiny pieces called microplastics
It changes back into oil underground
explanation: Plastic does not disappear; it breaks into very tiny pieces called microplastics that remain in the environment.
fact_tl: Sa halip na tuluyang mawala, nadudurog ang plastik sa napakaliliit na piraso na tinatawag na microplastics.
fact_bis: Imbis nga mawala, ang plastik mabuak ngadto sa gagmay kaayo nga piraso nga gitawag og microplastics.

q: About how wide is a sampaguita (Jasminum sambac) flower?
options: About 8 to 10 centimeters wide
About 2 to 3 centimeters wide
About 15 to 20 centimeters wide
About 5 to 6 centimeters wide
explanation: The white sampaguita flower is only about 2 to 3 centimeters wide, making it a small but fragrant bloom.
fact_tl: Ang puting bulaklak ng sampaguita (Jasminum sambac) ay mga 2 hanggang 3 sentimetro lamang ang lapad.
fact_bis: Ang puti nga bulak sa sampaguita (Jasminum sambac) mga 2 ngadto sa 3 sentimetro lang ang gilapdon.

q: Why does the habagat bring so much rain to the Philippines?
options: It is a very cold wind that freezes water vapor in the sky
It blows in from the sea, carrying moisture that forms thick rain clouds
It comes from dry deserts and picks up dust that later becomes rain
It pushes warm air up from the ground to create thunderstorms
explanation: The habagat blows in from the sea, carrying lots of moisture that becomes thick clouds and rain over the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang habagat ay umiihip mula sa dagat kaya dala-dala nito ang maraming halumigmig na nagiging makakapal na ulap at ulan.
fact_bis: Ang habagat mohuyop gikan sa dagat mao nga nagdala kini og daghang umog nga mahimong baga nga panganod ug ulan.

q: What is the main job of the endoplasmic reticulum inside a cell?
options: It controls all cell activities by storing the cell's DNA
It produces energy by breaking down sugar molecules
It helps make and transport proteins and lipids through the cell
It surrounds and destroys harmful bacteria that enter the cell
explanation: The endoplasmic reticulum is a network of thin tubes that helps make and transport proteins and lipids within the cell.
fact_tl: Ang endoplasmic reticulum ay isang sistema ng mga manipis na tubo sa loob ng selula na tumutulong gumawa at maghatid ng mga protina at taba.
fact_bis: Ang endoplasmic reticulum usa ka sistema sa nipis nga mga tubo sa sulod sa selula nga motabang sa paghimo ug paghatud sa mga protina ug tambok.

q: Why should you scrub the outside of a melon with a brush even if you do not eat the skin?
options: Scrubbing removes natural wax that makes the fruit taste bitter
The knife used to cut the melon can carry microbes from the rind into the flesh
Melons have seeds inside that are harmful if they touch the knife
The skin of a melon is where most of the vitamins are stored
explanation: Even if you skip eating the skin, the knife you use to cut the melon can carry microbes from the rind into the flesh you do eat.
fact_tl: Ang mga prutas na may makapal o magaspang na balat gaya ng melon at pakwan ay dapat kuskusin gamit ang malinis na brush. Kahit hindi mo kakainin ang balat, ang kutsilyong gagamitin sa paghiwa ay maaaring magdala ng mikrobyo mula sa balat papasok sa laman.
fact_bis: Ang mga prutas nga baga o gansang ang panit sama sa melon ug pakwan kinahanglan kuskuson gamit ang limpyo nga brush. Bisan dili nimo kan-on ang panit, ang kutsilyo nga gamiton sa paghiwa mahimong mudala og mikrobyo gikan sa panit ngadto sa unod.

q: How does a young giant clam stay in place on a reef without being swept away by waves?
options: It uses a hard shell that is too heavy to move
It buries itself completely deep under the sand
It grips the rock using thin threads called byssus
It releases a sticky slime that glues it to the coral
explanation: A young giant clam grips onto rock or reef using thin threads called byssus so it is not swept away by waves while it grows.
fact_tl: Ang batang taklobo ay kumakapit sa bato o bahura gamit ang manipis na mga sinulid na tinatawag na byssus para hindi ito maanod ng alon habang lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang batan-ong taklobo mokapyot sa bato o bahura pinaagi sa nipis nga mga hilo nga gitawag byssus aron dili kini maanod sa balod samtang nagtubo.

q: Who was the first woman President of the Philippines?
options: Gloria Macapagal Arroyo
Imelda Marcos
Corazon "Cory" Aquino
Miriam Defensor Santiago
explanation: Corazon "Cory" Aquino became the first woman President of the Philippines in 1986.
fact_tl: Si Corazon "Cory" Aquino ang unang babaeng Pangulo ng Pilipinas, noong 1986.
fact_bis: Si Corazon "Cory" Aquino ang unang babaye nga Presidente sa Pilipinas, niadtong 1986.

q: What body part helps the tarsier leap from tree to tree at night?
options: Its very long front arms that grip branches like hooks
Its wide flat tail that it uses like a rudder for balance
Its long hind legs that give it powerful jumping ability
Its sticky fingers and toes that stick to tree trunks
explanation: The tarsier has long hind legs that it uses to leap from one tree to another at night.
fact_tl: Ang tarsier ay may mahahabang binti na ginagamit nito para lumukso mula sa isang puno patungo sa iba sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang tarsier adunay tag-as nga bitiis nga gamiton niini aron molukso gikan sa usa ka kahoy ngadto sa lain sa gabii.

q: Who first broke the sound barrier, and in what year did it happen?
options: Neil Armstrong broke it in 1969 during a test flight in Nevada
Chuck Yeager broke it in 1947 by flying faster than sound
Amelia Earhart broke it in 1932 during her solo Atlantic crossing
Yuri Gagarin broke it in 1961 on his way to outer space
explanation: Chuck Yeager became the first person to fly faster than the speed of sound in 1947, breaking the sound barrier.
fact_tl: Unang nalampasan ang sound barrier noong 1947, nang lumipad si Chuck Yeager nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog.
fact_bis: Ang sound barrier unang nalapasan niadtong 1947, sa dihang milupad si Chuck Yeager nga mas paspas pa sa tingog.

q: How do some polychaete (bristle) worms on a reef get their food?
options: They chase small fish and catch them with strong jaws
They dig into coral and eat the coral polyps inside
They build protective tubes and extend feathery arms to filter food from the water
They attach to sharks and feed off leftover scraps from the shark's meals
explanation: Some polychaete species build protective tubes and extend feathery arms called radioles to filter food from the water.
fact_tl: Ang mga polychaete (bristle worm) ay isa sa pinaka-maraming grupo ng mga hayop sa reef at sediment ng dagat — ang ilang species ay gumagawa ng protective tube at nagbubukas ng mga feathery arms (radiole) para salain ang pagkain mula sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga polychaete (bristle worm) usa sa pinaka-daghan nga grupo sa mga hayop sa reef sediment ug lapak sa dagat — ang pipila ka species nagbuhat og protective tube ug nagpalapad og balahibo nga mga bukton (radioles) sa pag-filter sa pagkain gikan sa tubig.

q: How many main seasons does the Philippines have, and what are they called?
options: Four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter
Three seasons: hot, cool, and rainy
Two seasons: the wet season and the dry season
Two seasons: the cold season and the hot season
explanation: The Philippines has two main seasons: the wet season with much rain (June to November) and the dry season with little rain (December to May).
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may dalawang pangunahing panahon: ang tag-ulan (maraming ulan) at ang tag-tuyot (konti o walang ulan); ang tag-ulan ay karaniwang mula Hunyo hanggang Nobyembre at ang tag-tuyot mula Disyembre hanggang Mayo.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay duha ka nag-unang panahon: ang tag-ulan (daghang ulan) ug ang tag-hulaw (gamay o walay ulan); ang tag-ulan kasagaran Hunyo hangtod Nobyembre ug ang tag-hulaw Disyembre hangtod Mayo.

q: What does the color of volcanic ash tell us?
options: It tells us exactly how far the eruption will spread
It gives a hint about what minerals the ash is made of
It shows how long the volcano has been erupting
It tells us whether the lava beneath is liquid or solid
explanation: The color of volcanic ash hints at its mineral content — lighter ash has more light-colored minerals, while darker ash has more iron and heavy minerals.
fact_tl: Bakit iba-iba ang kulay ng abo? Ang kulay ay nagbibigay ng pahiwatig kung ano ang laman nito. Ang mas maputla o abuhing abo ay kadalasang may mas maraming mababaw na mineral, samantalang ang mas maitim na abo ay may mas maraming bakal at mabigat na mineral. Pero anuman ang kulay, pareho itong matalas at hindi dapat langhapin.
fact_bis: Ngano lainlain ang kolor sa abo? Ang kolor naghatag og timailhan kung unsa ang sulod niini. Ang mas luspad o abohon nga abo kasagaran daghag luspad nga mineral, samtang ang mas itom nga abo daghag puthaw ug bug-at nga mineral. Apan bisag unsa ang kolor, pareho ni hait ug dili angay suyopon.

q: If ice melts completely inside a sealed container, what happens to the total mass?
options: The mass decreases because some water evaporates
The mass increases because liquid water is heavier than ice
The mass stays exactly the same because no particles are lost or gained
The mass doubles because both ice and water now exist together
explanation: When ice melts in a sealed container, the number of particles stays the same — only their arrangement changes — so the mass remains the same.
fact_tl: Hindi nawawala ang matter kapag nagbabago ang state nito — kung tutunawin ang yelo sa saradong lalagyan, pareho pa rin ang mass ng tubig at ng dating yelo, dahil pareho ang dami ng particle, naiba lang ang ayos.
fact_bis: Dili mawala ang matter kung mausab ang state niini — kung tunawon ang yelo sa sirado nga sudlanan, parehas ra ang mass sa tubig ug sa kanhi yelo, kay parehas ang gidaghanon sa particle, ang han-ay lang ang nausab.

q: Why is the tandikan (Palawan peacock-pheasant) important to Palawan?
options: It is trained by locals to help fishermen find large schools of fish
It is farmed in large numbers to be sold as a popular food source
It attracts many tourists who want to see Palawan's forests and wildlife
It is used as the official mascot for all Philippine national sports events
explanation: The tandikan is a source of pride for Palawan and is one reason many tourists visit to see the province's forests and wildlife.
fact_tl: Ipinagmamalaki ng Palawan ang tandikan, at ang ibong ito ay isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit maraming turista ang gustong makita ang mga gubat at hayop ng probinsiya.
fact_bis: Garbo sa Palawan ang tandikan, ug kini nga langgam usa sa mga rason nganong daghang turista ang gustong makakita sa mga lasang ug mananap sa probinsya.

q: Why do water droplets in clouds eventually fall as rain?
options: The sun heats the cloud until it bursts open and releases the water
Cold wind pushes the cloud down until the water spills out
The droplets join together and grow until they are too heavy to float
Clouds absorb so much dust that the water is pushed out from below
explanation: Water droplets in clouds join and grow until they are too heavy to float, so they fall to the ground as rain.
fact_tl: Umuulan kapag ang mga patak ng tubig sa ulap ay nagsasama-sama at lumalaki, hanggang sa maging masyadong mabigat para lumutang — kaya bumabagsak sila bilang ulan.
fact_bis: Moulan kung ang mga tulo sa tubig sa panganod magtapok ug modako, hangtod nga mabug-at na kaayo aron molutaw — mao nga mahulog sila isip ulan.

q: Why is drinking milk especially important for growing children?
options: Milk is full of vitamin C that keeps the immune system strong
Milk is rich in calcium, which helps build strong bones and teeth
Milk contains iron that makes the blood carry more oxygen
Milk has plenty of fiber that helps the digestive system work
explanation: Milk is rich in calcium, a nutrient that helps build strong bones and teeth as children grow.
fact_tl: Ang gatas ay mayaman sa kalsyum, isang sustansyang tumutulong sa pagpapalakas ng ating mga buto at ngipin habang tayo ay lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang gatas dato sa kalsyum, usa ka sustansya nga magtabang sa paglig-on sa atong mga bukog ug ngipon samtang nagdako kita.

q: Where on a papaya plant do the fruits grow?
options: At the tips of long spreading branches far from the trunk
Underground, attached to the roots like sweet potatoes
Clustered near the top of the trunk, just below the leaves
Hanging from thin vines that trail down to the ground
explanation: Papaya fruits grow clustered near the top of the trunk, below the leaves — not on branches.
fact_tl: Ang mga bunga ng papaya ay tumutubo nang magkakapit sa itaas na bahagi ng katawan, sa ilalim ng mga dahon, hindi sa mga sanga.
fact_bis: Ang mga bunga sa kapayas motubo nga nagpundok sa ibabaw nga bahin sa lawas, ubos sa mga dahon, dili sa mga sanga.

q: Why did mammals grow larger and more numerous after the big dinosaurs disappeared?
options: Mammals developed wings after the dinosaurs left, allowing them to find more food
The temperature dropped so much that only warm-blooded mammals could survive
There was more space and food available once the large dinosaurs were gone
Mammals learned to breathe underwater, giving them access to new food sources
explanation: After the big dinosaurs were gone, mammals grew larger and more numerous because there was more space and food available for them.
fact_tl: Matapos mawala ang malalaking dinosaur, ang mga mamalya ay dumami at lumaki dahil mas marami nang espasyo at pagkain para sa kanila.
fact_bis: Human mawala ang dagkong mga dinosaur, ang mga mamalya midaghan ug midako kay mas daghan nay luna ug pagkaon para kanila.

q: What is the most effective way to stop rabies from spreading?
options: Keeping all pet dogs and cats indoors at all times
Vaccinating pet dogs and cats against rabies
Giving vitamin supplements to all animals in the neighborhood
Avoiding contact with all animals, both wild and domestic
explanation: Vaccinating pet dogs and cats is the most effective way to stop rabies from spreading to people and other animals.
fact_tl: Ang pagpapabakuna sa mga alagang aso at pusa ay pinakamabisang paraan para maiwasan ang pagkalat ng rabies.
fact_bis: Ang pagpabakuna sa binuhing iro ug iring mao ang labing epektibo nga paagi aron mapugngan ang pagkatap sa rabies.

q: Why do meteor showers happen at the same time each year?
options: The sun sends out extra bursts of energy on the same dates every year
The moon's gravity pulls space rocks toward Earth on a yearly schedule
Earth passes through a trail of dust left behind by a comet on the same orbit each year
Asteroids orbiting between Mars and Jupiter drift toward Earth every twelve months
explanation: A meteor shower repeats at the same time each year because Earth passes through a comet's dust trail at the same point in its orbit, and the particles burn up in the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang ulan ng bulalakaw (meteor shower) kapag dumadaan ang Earth sa isang landas ng alikabok na naiwan ng kometa, kaya nauulit ito sa parehong panahon taun-taon habang sumusunog ang mga butil sa himpapawid.
fact_bis: Ang ulan sa bulalakaw (meteor shower) mahitabo kon ang Earth moagi sa usa ka agianan sa abog nga gibilin sa kometa, mao nga mausab kini sa samang panahon matag tuig samtang nasunog ang mga tipik sa atmospera.

q: What did scientist Robert Whittaker propose in 1969 that changed how living things are classified?
options: He proposed that all living things should be sorted by size into three groups
He proposed a two-kingdom system replacing the earlier five kingdoms
He proposed a five-kingdom system so fungi, protists, and bacteria each had their own group
He proposed that viruses should be counted as the sixth kingdom of life
explanation: In 1969 Robert Whittaker proposed the five-kingdom system so that fungi, protists, and bacteria could each fit better in their own group, replacing the old two-kingdom system.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, dalawang kaharian lang ang itinuturo: halaman at hayop. Noong 1969, iminungkahi ng siyentistang si Robert Whittaker ang limang-kaharian na sistema para mas mahusay na mailagay ang fungi, protist, at bacteria sa sarili nilang grupo.
