fact_bis: Kaniadto duha ra ka gingharian ang gitudlo: tanom ug hayop. Niadtong 1969, gisugyot sa siyentista nga si Robert Whittaker ang lima ka gingharian nga sistema aron mas maayong mabutang ang fungi, protist, ug bacteria sa ilang kaugalingong grupo.

q: Which diseases are caused by bacteria?
options: Dengue fever and malaria
Tuberculosis and cholera
COVID-19 and influenza
Rabies and hepatitis B
explanation: Some bacteria cause diseases such as tuberculosis and cholera in people.
fact_tl: May mga bakteryang nagdudulot ng sakit tulad ng tuberkulosis at kolera.
fact_bis: Adunay bakterya nga maoy hinungdan sa sakit sama sa tuberkulosis ug kolera.

q: Why do scientists study meteorites that fall to Earth?
options: To find rare metals that can be used in smartphones and computers
To predict exactly when and where the next meteorite will land
To learn about the age and beginnings of the Solar System
To test whether life from other planets has arrived on Earth
explanation: Scientists study meteorites that have fallen to Earth to learn about the age and beginnings of the Solar System.
fact_tl: Pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko ang mga meteorite na nahulog sa Mundo upang matutunan ang tungkol sa edad at simula ng Solar System.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga siyentista ang mga meteorite nga nahulog sa Kalibutan aron makat-on bahin sa edad ug sinugdanan sa Solar System.

q: How does a pig use its snout to find food underground?
options: It uses its snout like a vacuum to suck worms out of the soil
Its strong snout works like a shovel and its sharp sense of smell helps it detect food underground
It uses its snout to listen for the sound of insects moving beneath the dirt
It sprays water from its snout to soften the ground and then digs with its hooves
explanation: A pig's strong snout works like a digging shovel, and its sharp sense of smell lets it find food underground even when it cannot see it.
fact_tl: Ang nguso ng baboy ay malakas at parang pala na panghukay. May matalas itong pang-amoy kaya nahahanap nila ang pagkain sa ilalim ng lupa kahit hindi nila ito nakikita.
fact_bis: Ang simod sa baboy kusgan ug morag pala nga pangkalot. Hait kini og panimaho mao nga makit-an nila ang pagkaon ilalom sa yuta bisan dili nila kini makita.

q: What is palay, and why is it important to Filipinos?
options: Palay is a type of fishing net used in rice paddies to catch freshwater fish
Palay is the plant that produces the grains we turn into rice and cook as food
Palay is a farming tool made of bamboo used to plant seeds in wet fields
Palay is a special fertilizer that makes rice plants grow taller and faster
explanation: Palay is the rice plant that produces the grains we turn into rice and cook as a staple food.
fact_tl: Ang palay ay halamang nagbibigay ng butil na ginagawang bigas at saka niluluto bilang kanin.
fact_bis: Ang humay maoy tanom nga naghatag sa lugas nga himuong bugas ug lutuon nga kan-on.

q: What makes a volleyball move and fly through the air when you hit it?
options: The weight of the ball pulls it forward on its own
The air inside the ball pushes outward and makes it float
The force from your hand transfers to the ball and makes it move
Gravity reaches up from the ground and launches the ball upward
explanation: When you hit a volleyball, the force from your hand is transferred to the ball, making it move and fly through the air.
fact_tl: Kapag tinira mo ang volleyball, ang pwersa ng iyong kamay ang nagpapagalaw at nagpapalipad nito sa hangin.
fact_bis: Kon imong tamparuson ang volleyball, ang kusog sa imong kamot maoy makapalihok ug makapalupad niini sa hangin.

q: How do Filipino farmers use PAGASA's seasonal forecasts?
options: To set the prices of crops at the local market each month
To decide when to plant, what crops to grow, and whether to store water for a possible drought
To choose the best times to buy new farming tools and equipment
To find out where to build new irrigation canals across their fields
explanation: Farmers use PAGASA's seasonal forecasts to decide when to plant, what crops to grow, and whether to store water in case of drought.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga magsasaka ang mga seasonal forecast ng PAGASA upang magpasya kung kailan magtanim, anong uri ng pananim ang itatanim, at kung kailangan bang mag-ipon ng tubig para sa posibleng tagtuyot.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga mag-uuma ang mga seasonal forecast sa PAGASA aron magdesisyon kung kanus-a mag-tanom, unsang klase sa pananim ang itanom, ug kung kinahanglan ba mag-imbak og tubig alang sa posibleng hulaw.

q: Why does the orange monarch butterfly taste bad to birds?
options: Its wings are coated with a bitter powder that it makes inside special glands
As a caterpillar it ate milkweed, a poisonous plant, and the poison stayed in its body
It feeds on bitter tree sap that soaks into its body over many years
Its bright orange color causes birds to feel dizzy when they look at it
explanation: The monarch butterfly tastes bad because as a caterpillar it ate the poisonous milkweed plant, and the poison remains in its body, making birds sick if they eat it.
fact_tl: Ang orange na monarch butterfly ay masama ang lasa dahil noong higad pa ito, kumakain ito ng halamang milkweed na may lason. Naiipon ang lason sa katawan nito. Kaya kapag kinain ito ng ibon, masuka ito at hindi na uulit!
fact_bis: Ang orange nga monarch butterfly baho og lami tungod kay sa bata pa kini nga ulod, mikaon kini sa hilo nga tanom nga milkweed. Ang hilo magpabilin sa lawas niini. Busa kon kan-on kini sa langgam, magsakit ang langgam ug dili na mosulay pag-usab!

q: Why is the bahay kubo raised off the ground on posts?
options: So that animals can sleep underneath it during cold weather
So that it stays dry during floods and cool air can flow beneath it
So that it can be moved easily from one place to another
So that the family can store their boats under the house near the river
explanation: The bahay kubo is raised on posts so it stays dry during floods and so cool air can flow underneath, showing the practical cleverness of Filipinos in a tropical climate.
fact_tl: Ang bahay kubo ay tradisyonal na tahanan ng mga Pilipino na gawa sa kawayan at pawid o nipa. Nakaangat ito sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng mga haligi para hindi mabasa kapag baha at para makapasok ang malamig na hangin sa ilalim. Simbolo ito ng pagiging matalino at praktikal ng mga Pilipino sa tropikal na klima.
fact_bis: Ang bahay kubo mao ang tradisyonal nga puluy-anan sa mga Pilipino, hinimo sa kawayan ug atup nga nipa. Gipataas kini gikan sa yuta pinaagi sa mga haligi aron dili mabasa kung baha ug aron makasulod ang bugnaw nga hangin sa ilawom. Simbolo kini sa pagkamaalamon ug pagkapraktikal sa mga Pilipino sa tropikal nga klima.

q: What happens to rainfall over the Philippines during La Nina?
options: The Philippines gets much less rain because warm ocean water moves away
Rainfall stays exactly the same as during normal years
Heavy rain increases over the Philippines because the Walker circulation gets stronger
Typhoons stop forming entirely because the Pacific Ocean cools down too much
explanation: During La Nina the Walker circulation strengthens, causing warm moist air to rise near Asia and form thick clouds and heavy rain over the Philippines.
fact_tl: Sa La Nina, lumalakas ang tinatawag na Walker circulation, isang malaking ikot ng hangin sa ibabaw ng Pasipiko. Sa bahaging malapit sa Asya, umaakyat ang mainit at basang hangin, bumubuo ng makapal na ulap at malakas na ulan sa Pilipinas at Indonesia.
fact_bis: Sa La Nina, mokusog ang gitawag nga Walker circulation, usa ka dako nga liko sa hangin ibabaw sa Pasipiko. Duol sa Asya, mosaka ang init ug basa nga hangin, naghimo og baga nga panganod ug kusog nga ulan sa Pilipinas ug Indonesia.

q: Where is the Kuiper Belt located in our solar system?
options: Between Mars and Jupiter, where most asteroids are found
Just inside Mercury's orbit, close to the sun
Beyond Neptune, filled with small icy bodies including Pluto
Around Earth's moon, made up of rocky debris from old impacts
explanation: The Kuiper Belt is a region beyond Neptune filled with small icy bodies; it is home to Pluto and other dwarf planets and is the source of most short-period comets.
fact_tl: Ang Kuiper Belt ay isang rehiyon ng solar system na lampas sa Neptune na puno ng maliliit na icy na katawan; ito ang tahanan ng Pluto at iba pang mga dwarf planet, at ito rin ang pinagmulan ng karamihan sa mga short-period comet.
fact_bis: Ang Kuiper Belt usa ka rehiyon sa solar system lapas sa Neptune nga puno sa gamay nga icy nga mga lawas; kini ang pinuy-anan sa Pluto ug ubang mga dwarf planet, ug kini usab ang gigikanan sa kadaghanan sa mga short-period comet.

q: What type of animal were dinosaurs?
options: They were giant fish that evolved to walk on land
They were mammals, like the ancestors of today's elephants
They were reptiles that lived on land in ancient times
They were birds that later lost the ability to fly
explanation: Dinosaurs were reptiles that lived on land in ancient times, millions of years before humans appeared.
fact_tl: Ang mga dinosaur ay mga reptilya na namuhay sa lupa noong sinaunang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga dinosaur mga reptilya nga nabuhi sa yuta niadtong karaang panahon.

q: What is homeostasis in the human body?
options: The process by which the body converts food into energy for muscles
The way the body keeps its internal conditions, like temperature and water, steady and balanced
The ability of the immune system to fight off diseases and infections
The growth of new cells to replace damaged or old ones throughout life
explanation: Homeostasis is the way the body keeps its internal conditions, like temperature and water levels, steady and balanced.
fact_tl: Ang homeostasis ay ang paraan ng katawan para panatilihing matatag at balanse ang mga kondisyon sa loob, gaya ng temperatura at tubig.
fact_bis: Ang homeostasis mao ang paagi sa lawas sa pagpabilin nga lig-on ug balanse ang mga kahimtang sa sulod, sama sa temperatura ug tubig.

q: How was ultraviolet light first discovered in 1801?
options: Scientists noticed it caused glass to glow green when shone through a prism
Astronomers detected it coming from the sun using an early telescope
Researchers found it darkened silver chloride just beyond the violet end of the spectrum
Chemists observed it making certain liquids boil at unusually low temperatures
explanation: Ultraviolet light was discovered in 1801 when scientists found that silver chloride darkened in the region just beyond the violet end of the visible spectrum.
fact_tl: Natuklas ang ultraviolet light noong 1801 gamit ang silver chloride na nag-itim lampas sa violet na dulo ng spectrum.
fact_bis: Ang ultraviolet light nadiskubre niadtong 1801 gamit ang silver chloride nga miitom unahan sa violet nga tumoy sa spectrum.

q: Why is wind the main force that shapes the land in deserts?
options: Desert winds are much faster than winds anywhere else on Earth
Deserts have few plants or water to hold the surface in place, so wind easily moves material
Sand in deserts is made of a special mineral that only wind can move
Extreme heat in deserts causes rocks to crack and crumble so wind can carry them away easily
explanation: In deserts, wind is the main shaping force because there are few plants or water to hold the surface in place, leaving loose material free to be moved by the wind.
fact_tl: Sa mga disyerto, ang hangin ang pangunahing puwersang humuhubog sa lupa dahil kakaunti ang halaman at tubig na magpipigil dito.
fact_bis: Sa mga disyerto, ang hangin mao ang nag-unang puwersa nga naghulma sa yuta kay gamay ra ang tanom ug tubig nga makapugong niini.

q: Why is the Cotabato Basin in Mindanao important to the Philippines?
options: It is the deepest ocean trench found within Philippine territory
It is the largest city in Mindanao and the center of technology industries
It is one of the largest lowland areas in the Philippines and an important farming area for rice, corn, and other crops
It is famous as the location of the country's tallest active volcano
explanation: The Cotabato Basin in central Mindanao is one of the largest lowland areas in the Philippines and an important farming area for rice, corn, and other crops.
fact_tl: Ang Cotabato Basin sa gitnang Mindanao ay isa sa mga pinakamalaking lupain sa Pilipinas at isang mahalagang lugar ng pagsasaka ng palay, mais, at iba pang mga pananim.
fact_bis: Ang Cotabato Basin sa sentral Mindanao usa sa mga pinakadakling ubos-bahin sa Pilipinas ug importante nga lugar sa pagsasaka sa humay, mais, ug uban pang mga pananom.

q: How does the dung of grazing animals help the grassland environment?
options: It forms a hard crust on the soil that stops water from washing the ground away
It attracts insects that pollinate the grasses so they grow more seeds
It returns nutrients to the soil, which helps the grass grow healthier
It produces gases that warm the air around the grass so it grows faster
explanation: The dung of grazing animals returns nutrients to the soil, which helps the grass grow healthier and supports the whole grassland ecosystem.
fact_tl: Ang dumi ng mga grazer ay nagbabalik ng sustansya sa lupa, na nakakatulong sa mas malusog na pagtubo ng damo.
fact_bis: Ang tae sa mga grazer mobalik og sustansya sa yuta, nga makatabang nga mas himsog ang pagtubo sa damo.

q: Why do iron objects in humid places rust faster than those in dry places?
options: Humid air is heavier, so it pushes harder on iron and wears away the surface
High humidity causes iron to expand and crack, which exposes fresh metal to the air
Rusting requires both oxygen and water, and humid air has more water, speeding up the reaction
Iron in humid air heats up faster, which makes all chemical reactions happen more quickly
explanation: Rusting happens when oxygen from air reacts with iron and water — so humid places, which have more water in the air, cause iron to rust faster.
fact_tl: Ang bakal ay naglalagawlaw kapag ang oxygen (mula sa hangin) ay gumagawa ng reaksyon kasama ang bakal at tubig. Ang prosesong ito ay nagbubunga ng iron oxide (kalawang). Kaya naman ang mga bagay na bakal na nasa halumigmiging lugar ay mas mabilis na naglalagawlaw.
fact_bis: Ang bakal naglalagawlaw sa pag-react sa oxygen gikan sa hangin uban sa bakal ug tubig. Kining proseso nagbuhat sa iron oxide (kalawang). Mao kana kung ngano ang mga bagay nga bakal sa halumigmiging lugar naglalagawlaw og mas paspas.

q: How many legs does every insect have?
options: Four legs
Six legs
Eight legs
Ten legs
explanation: All insects have exactly six legs — this is one of the key features that defines an insect.
fact_tl: Lahat ng insekto ay may anim (6) na paa.
fact_bis: Ang tanang insekto adunay unom (6) ka tiil.

q: What are the three main body parts of a true insect?
options: Head, wings, and thorax
Head, thorax, and abdomen
Thorax, abdomen, and tail
Head, abdomen, and antennae
explanation: All true insects have six legs and three main body parts: head, thorax, and abdomen.
fact_tl: Lahat ng tunay na insekto ay may anim (6) na paa at tatlong pangunahing bahagi ng katawan: ulo, dibdib (thorax), at tiyan (abdomen).
fact_bis: Tanang tinuod nga insekto adunay unom (6) ka tiil ug tulo ka nag-unang bahin sa lawas: ulo, dughan (thorax), ug tiyan (abdomen).

q: Which part of a flower makes pollen, and which part receives it so seeds can form?
options: The petal makes pollen; the sepal receives it
The pistil makes pollen; the stamen receives it
The stamen makes pollen; the pistil receives it
The nectary makes pollen; the style receives it
explanation: The stamen is the male part that makes pollen, and the pistil is the female part that receives pollen so seeds can form.
fact_tl: May lalaking bahagi (stamen) ang bulaklak na gumagawa ng pollen, at babaeng bahagi (pistil) na tumatanggap nito para mabuo ang buto.
fact_bis: Ang bulak adunay lalaki nga bahin (stamen) nga naghimo ug polen ug babaye nga bahin (pistil) nga modawat niini aron maporma ang liso.

q: How do some plants spread their seeds without using wind or animals?
options: The seeds fall straight down and roll along the ground on their own
The plant grows very tall so its seeds drop far from the parent plant
Dry seed pods suddenly burst open and fling the seeds away
The seeds are wrapped in fruit that the plant shakes off when ripe
explanation: Some plants have dry seed pods that suddenly burst open and fling their seeds away, spreading them without needing wind or animals.
fact_tl: May mga halaman na ang tuyong supot ng buto ay biglang pumuputok at nagtatalsik ng buto palayo. Sa ganitong paraan, hindi sila kailangan ng hangin o hayop para kumalat.
fact_bis: Ang ubang tanom adunay uga nga puyo sa liso nga kalit mobuto ug molagpot sa mga liso palayo. Niini nga paagi, dili sila magkinahanglan og hangin o mananap aron mokatag.

q: What is the main difference between complete metamorphosis and incomplete metamorphosis?
options: Complete metamorphosis has two stages; incomplete has four stages
Both have four stages, but in incomplete the larva looks very different from the adult
Complete metamorphosis has four stages including a pupa; incomplete has three stages with no pupal stage
Complete metamorphosis skips the egg stage; incomplete always begins with an egg
explanation: Complete metamorphosis has four stages (egg, larva, pupa, adult) while incomplete metamorphosis has only three stages (egg, nymph, adult) with no pupal stage.
fact_tl: Ang complete metamorphosis ay may apat na yugto: itlog, larva, pupa, at adult — habang ang incomplete metamorphosis ay may tatlong yugto lamang: itlog, nymph (katulad ng maliit na adult), at adult, nang walang pupa stage.
fact_bis: Ang complete metamorphosis adunay upat ka yugto: itlog, larva, pupa, ug adult — samtang ang incomplete metamorphosis adunay tulo lamang ka yugto: itlog, nymph (nagkapareho sa gamay nga adult), ug adult, walay pupal stage.

q: How did the Eurasian tree sparrow end up becoming one of the most common birds in the Philippines?
options: It evolved in the Philippines over millions of years from a local bird species
It was brought by Filipino sailors from China as a symbol of good luck
It came originally from Europe and Asia and spread to the Philippines, where it thrived
It was released into the wild by the government to control insect pests in rice fields
explanation: The Eurasian tree sparrow originally came from Europe and Asia and spread to the Philippines, where it became one of the most common birds.
fact_tl: Ang Eurasian tree sparrow ay nagmula sa Europa at Asya at kumalat sa Pilipinas, kung saan naging isa na ito sa pinakakaraniwang ibon.
fact_bis: Ang Eurasian tree sparrow naggikan sa Europa ug Asya ug mikatag sa Pilipinas, diin nahimo kining usa sa labing kasagarang langgam.

q: Why are soft drinks slightly acidic?
options: Sugar dissolves in water and produces a mild acid during the bottling process
The coloring agents added to soft drinks react with water to form weak acids
Carbon dioxide dissolves in water to form carbonic acid, making the drink slightly acidic
Cold temperatures inside the bottle cause water molecules to split and release acid
explanation: When carbon dioxide dissolves in water it forms a little carbonic acid, which makes soft drinks — and even natural rainwater — slightly acidic.
fact_tl: Kapag natunaw ang carbon dioxide sa tubig, bahagya itong nagiging carbonic acid, kaya ang mga softdrink at maging ang likas na ulan ay bahagyang maasim.
fact_bis: Kung ang carbon dioxide matunaw sa tubig nahimo kining gamay nga carbonic acid, mao nga ang mga softdrink ug bisan ang natural nga ulan gamay nga maaslom.

q: In which region of the Philippines is the province of Dinagat Islands located?
options: ARMM (Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao)
Region X (Northern Mindanao)
Caraga region (XIII), part of Mindanao
Region XI (Davao Region)
explanation: Dinagat Islands is a province located in the Caraga region (XIII), part of Mindanao, with San Jose as its capital.
fact_tl: Ang Dinagat Islands ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Caraga (XIII), na bahagi ng Mindanao. Ang kabisera nito ay San Jose.
fact_bis: Ang Dinagat Islands usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Caraga (XIII), nga bahin sa Mindanao. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang San Jose.

q: What is a kalesa, and where can it still be found in the Philippines?
options: A bamboo boat paddled by horse-drawn rope along rivers in Mindanao
A wooden sled pulled by a carabao used in rice fields during harvest season
A horse-drawn carriage still used in Vigan and Manila
A traditional horse race held every year in Bohol to celebrate a harvest festival
explanation: The kalesa is a horse-drawn carriage that is still used in Vigan and Manila as a traditional form of transport.
fact_tl: Ang kalesa ay isang karwaheng hinihila ng kabayo na ginagamit pa rin sa Vigan at Maynila.
fact_bis: Ang kalesa usa ka karwahe nga ginabira sa kabayo nga gigamit gihapon sa Vigan ug Manila.

q: Why is paper easy to fold and cut?
options: Because it is thin and has soft fibers
Because it is made of plastic and is waterproof
Because it is very thick and stiff
Because it is coated with a layer of wax
explanation: Paper folds and cuts easily because it is thin and its fibers are soft, which also makes it great for origami and different shapes.
fact_tl: Madaling tiklupin at gupitin ang papel dahil manipis ito at malambot ang mga hibla nito. Kaya magandang gawing origami at iba't ibang hugis ang papel.
fact_bis: Dali pilo-on ug putlon ang papel kay nipis kini ug humok ang mga hibla niini. Mao nga maayo himuong origami ug nagkalainlaing porma ang papel.

q: Which mineral was used to make the very first compasses?
options: Lodestone (magnetized magnetite)
Quartz crystal
Iron pyrite (fool's gold)
Granite
explanation: Lodestone, which is magnetized magnetite, was the first material people used to make compasses, long before modern science.
fact_tl: Ang magnetite ay isang iron ore na likas na may magnetikong katangian; ang lodestone (magnetized magnetite) ang unang ginamit ng mga tao para gumawa ng compass bago pa man ang modernong agham.
fact_bis: Ang magnetite usa ka iron ore nga sa kinaiyahan magnetiko; ang lodestone (magnetized magnetite) mao ang una nga gigamit sa mga tawo sa paghimo og kompas dugay na sa wala pa ang modernong siyensya.

q: Where are the ears of a cricket located?
options: On its front legs
On the sides of its head
On its antennae
On its back wings
explanation: Crickets (and katydids) hear with ears located on their front legs, not on their heads.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig at katydid ay nakaririnig sa pamamagitan ng mga taingang nasa kanilang mga harapang binti.
fact_bis: Ang kagang ug katydid makadungog pinaagi sa mga dalunggan nga naa sa ilang atubangang paa.

q: How many suckers does a leech have on its body?
options: Two — one at each end
One — only on the mouth end
Three — one in the middle and one at each tip
None — it grips with tiny claws instead
explanation: A leech has a sucker at each end of its body: the smaller end has the mouth for biting, and the larger end is used for gripping and movement.
fact_tl: May tagapagsipsip ang linta sa dalawang dulo ng katawan nito. Ang mas maliit na dulo ay may bibig na kumakagat, at ang mas malaki ang ginagamit nito para kumapit. Sa ganitong paraan ito gumagalaw at dumidikit nang mahigpit.
fact_bis: Ang alimatok adunay tagsuyop sa duha ka tumoy sa lawas niini. Ang gamay nga tumoy adunay baba nga mopaak, ug ang dako gamiton aron mokapyot. Ingon niini kini molihok ug motapot og hugot.

q: Why is steel often added to concrete in buildings?
options: Because concrete is weak when pulled or stretched, and steel is strong in pulling
Because concrete is weak when squeezed, and steel handles squeezing better
Because concrete cannot be shaped without a steel mold around it
Because steel makes concrete set and harden faster
explanation: Concrete is strong under squeezing (compression) but weak under pulling (tension), so it is paired with steel, which is strong in tension.
fact_tl: Napakatibay ng konkreto kapag idiniin (compression) ngunit mahina kapag hinatak (tension), kaya itinatambal ito sa bakal na malakas sa paghatak.
fact_bis: Lig-on kaayo ang konkreto kon ipiton (compression) apan luya kon biraon (tension), busa gipares kini sa puthaw nga kusog sa pagbira.

q: How do most caves form underground?
options: Water slowly dissolves soft limestone rock over thousands of years
Earthquakes crack the ground and create hollow spaces
Wind erodes tunnels through solid rock over centuries
Volcanic lava flows underground and leaves tunnels behind
explanation: Many caves form slowly as water dissolves soft limestone rock over thousands of years.
fact_tl: Maraming kuweba ay nabuo nang dahan-dahan habang tinutunaw ng tubig ang malambot na batong-apog sa loob ng libo-libong taon.
fact_bis: Daghang langob ang naporma og hinay-hinay samtang ang tubig nag-agnas sa humok nga bato-apog sulod sa liboan ka tuig.

q: How is mumps swelling different from allergy swelling?
options: Mumps swelling is caused by a virus and usually hurts, while allergy swelling comes from a body reaction and often itches
Mumps swelling comes from a body reaction and itches, while allergy swelling is caused by a virus and hurts
Both types of swelling are caused by viruses but affect different parts of the body
Both types of swelling are caused by allergic reactions but appear in different places
explanation: Mumps swelling comes from a virus and usually hurts, while allergy swelling comes from a body reaction and often itches — they are different things.
fact_tl: Ang pamamaga ng mumps ay dulot ng virus at madalas masakit, samtang ang pamamaga sa allergy ay galing sa reaksyon ng katawan at kadalasang makati. Magkaiba sila.
fact_bis: Ang paghubag sa mumps gikan sa virus ug kasagaran sakit, samtang ang paghubag sa allergy gikan sa reaksyon sa lawas ug kasagaran katol. Lahi sila.

q: What is the chemical formula for carbon dioxide?
options: CO2
CO
C2O
O2C
explanation: The chemical formula for carbon dioxide is CO2, meaning one carbon atom bonded to two oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Ang chemical formula ng carbon dioxide ay CO2.
fact_bis: Ang chemical formula sa carbon dioxide mao ang CO2.

q: How do mangrove roots help the fish living near the coast?
options: They trap mud and dirt so cleaner water flows out to the sea and reefs, helping fish breathe
They produce oxygen directly into the water like underwater plants do
They block saltwater from reaching the reef so fish can survive
They create shade that keeps the water cool enough for fish to thrive
explanation: Mangrove roots catch mud and dirt carried from the land, so cleaner water flows out to the sea and reefs, which helps fish breathe well.
fact_tl: Hinuhuli ng mga ugat ng bakawan ang putik at dumi na dala ng tubig mula sa lupa. Dahil dito, mas malinis ang tubig na napupunta sa dagat at bahura, na nakakatulong sa mga isda na huminga nang mabuti.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamot sa bakawan magdakop sa lapok ug hugaw nga dala sa tubig gikan sa yuta. Tungod niini, mas hinlo nga tubig ang moagas paingon sa dagat ug bahura, nga makatabang sa mga isda nga makaginhawa og maayo.

q: Why do elements in the same group (column) of the periodic table behave in similar ways?
options: They have the same number of valence electrons
They have the same total number of electrons
They were discovered around the same time in history
They all occur naturally as gases at room temperature
explanation: Elements in the same group have the same number of valence electrons, which gives them similar chemical properties — for example, all noble gases are almost completely unreactive.
fact_tl: Sa periodic table, ang mga elemento sa parehong grupo (column) ay may magkaparehong bilang ng valence electrons at nagpapakita ng magkaparehong katangian ng kemikal — halimbawa, ang lahat ng noble gases ay halos hindi nagre-react.
fact_bis: Sa periodic table, ang mga elemento sa mao rang grupo (kolum) adunay managsama nga bilang sa valence electron ug nagpakita og managsama nga chemical property; pananglitan, ang tanan nga noble gas halos dili gayud nagtubag.

q: What kind of plant does coffee grow on?
options: A shrub or small tree with shiny green leaves
A large palm tree with long drooping fronds
A climbing vine that wraps around other plants
A low ground-cover plant with tiny round leaves
explanation: Coffee grows on a shrub or small tree with shiny green leaves.
fact_tl: Ang kape ay tumutubo sa isang palumpong o maliit na puno na may berdeng makintab na mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang kape motubo sa usa ka palumpong o gamay nga kahoy nga adunay berde ug masinaw nga mga dahon.

q: Can an animal choose to develop a new adaptation when it needs one to survive?
options: No — adaptations arise through variation and selection across many generations, not by choice
Yes — animals can sense danger and grow new features within their lifetime
Yes — individual animals adapt quickly when food or weather changes
No — adaptations only happen when scientists breed animals in a laboratory
explanation: An animal cannot decide to adapt just because it needs to; adaptations arise through variation and selection across many generations.
fact_tl: Hindi maaaring magpasyang mag-adapt ang isang hayop dahil kailangan nito; lumilitaw ang adaptasyon sa pamamagitan ng baryasyon at seleksyon sa loob ng maraming henerasyon.
fact_bis: Dili makapili ang usa ka hayop nga mag-adapt tungod kay nagkinahanglan kini; ang adaptasyon motungha pinaagi sa baryasyon ug pagpili sa daghang henerasyon.

q: Which instrument is used to measure the amount of water vapor (humidity) in the air?
options: Hygrometer
Barometer
Thermometer
Anemometer
explanation: The instrument that measures humidity is called a hygrometer.
fact_tl: Ang instrumentong sumusukat sa halumigmig (humidity) ay tinatawag na hygrometer.
fact_bis: Ang instrumento nga mosukod sa kaumog (humidity) gitawag nga hygrometer.

q: How do worms breathe?
options: Through their moist skin
Through tiny gills on their sides
Through small holes called spiracles along their body
Through a lung at the front of their body
explanation: Worms breathe through their moist skin, so the worm bin must always stay a bit damp.
fact_tl: Humihinga ang bulate sa pamamagitan ng basang balat nito, kaya kailangang laging mamasa-masa ang worm bin.
fact_bis: Ang bulate moginhawa pinaagi sa basa niyang panit, mao nga kinahanglan kanunayng mamasa ang worm bin.

q: Why do beekeepers use smoke when collecting honey?
options: Smoke calms the bees so they sting less
Smoke makes the bees sleep so they can be moved safely
Smoke hides the beekeeper's scent so the bees cannot find them
Smoke kills the mites that live on the bees
explanation: Beekeepers use gentle smoke when they collect honey because the smoke calms the bees so they sting less.
fact_tl: Ang mga mag-aalaga ng pukyutan (beekeepers) ay gumagamit ng mahinang usok kapag kinukuha ang pulot. Pinapakalma ng usok ang mga pukyutan kaya nababawasan ang kanilang pananindak — at nagsusuot din sila ng makapal na damit pananggalang.
fact_bis: Ang mga tig-atiman sa putyokan (beekeepers) mogamit og hinay nga aso kon manguha sila og dugos. Ang aso makapakalma sa putyokan aron mokunhod ang ilang pagpaak — ug magsul-ob usab sila og baga nga proteksyon nga sinina.

q: How does a pangolin find its food even though it has very poor eyesight?
options: It uses its strong sense of smell
It uses its long tongue to feel movements in the ground
It listens for sounds with large ears
It uses heat sensors on its snout to detect prey
explanation: The pangolin has poor eyesight but a very strong sense of smell that it uses to find its food.
fact_tl: Ang balintong ay may mahinang paningin ngunit napakatalas ng pang-amoy nito na siya niyang ginagamit para makahanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang balintong adunay maluya nga panan-aw apan hait kaayo ang panimaho niini nga gamiton niini aron makakita ug pagkaon.

q: How long can a chameleon's tongue reach?
options: Farther than the full length of its own body
About halfway along its own body
Only a few centimeters beyond its mouth
Exactly as long as one of its legs
explanation: A chameleon's tongue is very long — it can reach out farther than the length of its own body, helping it catch insects quickly.
fact_tl: Ang dila ng chameleon ay napakahaba—kaya itong umabot sa layong mas mahaba pa kaysa sa sariling katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang dila sa chameleon taas kaayo—makaabot kini sa gilay-on nga mas taas pa kay sa iyang kaugalingong lawas.

q: Which element is the second most abundant in the universe?
options: Helium
Oxygen
Carbon
Nitrogen
explanation: The second most abundant element in the universe is helium, after hydrogen.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang pinakamaraming elemento sa uniberso ay helium (helyo).
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang labing daghan nga elemento sa uniberso mao ang helium (helyo).

q: What is the largest fish in the world?
options: The whale shark (butanding)
The great white shark
The giant manta ray
The blue marlin
explanation: The whale shark (butanding) is the largest fish in the world, and despite its enormous size it is a gentle animal with beautiful white spots on its back.
fact_tl: Ang butanding (whale shark) ay ang pinakamalaking isda sa mundo, ngunit isa itong mabait na hayop na may magagandang puting puntik sa likod.
fact_bis: Ang butanding (whale shark) mao ang pinakadako nga isda sa kalibotan, apan usa kini ka maaghop nga hayop nga adunay nindot nga puti nga puntik sa likod.

q: Why does turning food scraps and leaves into compost help the environment?
options: It reduces how much waste goes to the landfill and turns it into useful fertilizer
It kills harmful bacteria in the garbage before it enters the water supply
It produces energy that can be used to power homes and schools
It stops insects from breeding in rubbish heaps near neighborhoods
explanation: A big part of household garbage is food scraps and leaves that decomposers can break down; composting them sends far less waste to the landfill and creates useful fertilizer.
fact_tl: Bakit mahalaga ang composting sa kapaligiran? Malaking bahagi ng basura ng tahanan ay tira ng pagkain at dahon na puwedeng bulukin ng decomposers. Kapag ginawang compost ito sa halip na itapon, lubhang nababawasan ang basura sa tambakan at nagiging kapaki-pakinabang na pataba.
fact_bis: Ngano nga importante ang composting para sa kalikasan? Dako nga bahin sa basura sa balay kay salin sa pagkaon ug dahon nga madunot sa decomposers. Kung himuon kining compost imbes ilabay, mokunhod pag-ayo ang basura sa tambakanan ug mahimo kining mapuslanong abono.

q: Why do coral reefs grow upward and outward toward the water's surface?
options: Because the algae inside corals need sunlight to survive
Because ocean currents push them toward shallower water over time
Because the reef needs to stay warm and surface water is always warmest
Because predators live deeper, so growing upward keeps corals safer
explanation: The algae inside coral need sunlight, so the reef grows upward and outward toward the light — corals reaching the sun grow faster than those in shade.
fact_tl: Dahil kailangan ng algae sa loob ng coral ang sikat ng araw, tumutubo ang reef pataas at palabas papunta sa liwanag. Ang mga coral na nasa ilalim o nalililiman ay mabagal lumaki, habang ang nasa itaas na umaabot sa araw ang mas mabilis. Kaya nga ang hugis ng reef ay sinusunod ang daan ng liwanag sa tubig.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang lumot sulod sa coral nagkinahanglan og kahayag, ang reef motubo paitaas ug pagawas padulong sa kahayag. Ang mga coral nga ubos o anaa sa landong hinay motubo, samtang ang naabot sa adlaw mas paspas. Mao nga ang porma sa reef nagsunod kon asa maabot ang kahayag sa tubig.

q: What is 'desert pavement'?
options: A layer of tightly packed stones left after wind blows away all the fine dust
A layer of sand hardened by heat into a flat surface
A rock formation shaped by rivers that once flowed through the desert
A crust of salt left behind when desert lakes dry up
explanation: When wind blows away all the fine dust, a layer of tightly packed stones called desert pavement is left behind.
fact_tl: Kapag tinangay ng hangin ang lahat ng pinong alikabok, naiiwan ang isang patong ng siksik na bato na tinatawag na desert pavement.
fact_bis: Kung mapalid sa hangin ang tanang pino nga abog, mabilin ang usa ka tipun-og nga gimot nga bato nga gitawag ug desert pavement.

q: How do GPS stations around a volcano help scientists warn people about possible eruptions?
options: They measure tiny ground swelling caused by magma rising into the volcano
They measure the temperature of gases escaping from the volcano's crater
They track how ash clouds move so people can be evacuated in time
They detect the exact moment lava breaks through the surface
explanation: When magma enters a volcano's magma chamber, the ground swells (inflates) and GPS stations record this tiny movement — as little as a millimetre — as a warning signal.
fact_tl: Ang mga GPS station na nakalagay sa paligid ng isang bulkan ay maaaring masukat ang napaka-maliliit na paggalaw ng lupa (hanggang millimeter); kapag ang magma ay pumapasok sa magma chamber ng isang bulkan, ang lupa ay nagpapalaki (nagiging umbok) at ang GPS ay nagtatala nito bilang isang babala na ang bulkan ay maaaring magbago.
fact_bis: Ang mga GPS station nga gibutang sa palibot sa usa ka bulkan makasukat sa napaka-gagmay nga mga lihok sa yuta (hangtod millimeter nga katukma); kon ang magma mosulod sa magma chamber sa usa ka bulkan, ang yuta nagpataas (nag-inflate) ug ang GPS nagrekord niini ingon nga babala nga ang bulkan mahimong nagbabago.

q: What happens to colorful forest birds when the trees in their forest are cut down?
options: They disappear too, because they need the forest to survive
They move to nearby farms and fields and adapt quickly
They migrate to other forests far away and eventually return
They survive by nesting on the ground instead of in trees
explanation: Colorful forest birds need the forest, so when the trees are cut down, the birds disappear too.
fact_tl: Ang mga makukulay na ibong gubat ay nangangailangan ng kagubatan, kaya kapag naputol ang mga puno, nawawala rin sila.
fact_bis: Ang mga mabulukon nga langgam sa kalasangan nanginahanglan sa kagubatan, mao nga kung putlon ang mga kahoy, mawala usab sila.

q: Why does a block of ice float even though part of it is underwater?
options: The underwater part pushes aside enough water to keep it floating
Ice is completely hollow inside, which makes it lighter than water
Ice hardens at the bottom and only the softer top part sticks up
Frozen water becomes lighter than air, so it rises above the surface
explanation: Many things like ice or wood float but still have part of them underwater; the underwater part pushes aside enough water to keep the object floating.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng lumulutang ay nasa ibabaw lang. Maraming bagay tulad ng yelo o kahoy ay lumulutang pero may bahagi pa ring nakalubog sa tubig. Ang bahaging nakalubog ang siyang nagtutulak ng sapat na tubig para manatiling nakalutang.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga naglutaw anaa lang sa ibabaw. Daghang butang sama sa yelo o kahoy molutaw apan adunay bahin nga nilunod gihapon. Ang bahin nga nilunod mao ang motulak ug igong tubig aron magpabilin nga naglutaw.

q: Which power source is safest for children to use in a simple circuit?
options: Batteries, because they are portable and safe
Mains electricity (220V), because it provides the most power
Solar cells, because they never run out of energy
None of these — only teachers should power circuits
explanation: Batteries are the safest source of electricity for children because they are portable and low-voltage, unlike mains electricity (220V), which is more dangerous.
fact_tl: Ang mga circuit ay maaaring palakasin ng iba't ibang pinagkukunan ng kuryente — ang mga baterya ay portable at ligtas para sa mga bata, ang mga solar cell ay gumagamit ng liwanag, at ang mains electricity (220V) ay nagbibigay ng mas maraming kapangyarihan ngunit mas delikado.
fact_bis: Ang mga circuit mapalakasin sa lain-laing mga pinagkukunan — ang mga baterya portable ug luwas alang sa mga bata, ang mga solar cell naggamit sa suga, ug ang mains electricity (220V) naghatag ug mas dako nga kapangyarihan apan mas delikado.

q: What is the difference between the national animal and the national bird of the Philippines?
options: The carabao is the national animal, while the Philippine eagle is the national bird
The Philippine eagle is the national animal, while the carabao is the national bird
The carabao is both the national animal and the national bird
The tarsier is the national animal and the carabao is the national bird
explanation: The national animal and national bird are different: the carabao is the national animal, while the Philippine eagle is the national bird of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang pambansang hayop at pambansang ibon: ang kalabaw ang pambansang hayop, samantalang ang Philippine eagle (agila) naman ang pambansang ibon ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Lahi ang nasodnong hayop ug ang nasodnong langgam: ang kabaw mao ang nasodnong hayop, samtang ang Philippine eagle (agila) mao ang nasodnong langgam sa Pilipinas.

q: How do hidden ultraviolet patterns on flowers help bees?
options: They act like arrows pointing the bee to the nectar so it finds food faster
They warn bees away from flowers that have been visited already
They help bees recognize which flowers belong to the same plant species
They attract bees by mimicking the glow of the sun at midday
explanation: Many flowers have hidden lines and patterns visible only in ultraviolet light that act like arrows pointing the bee to the nectar, so bees find food faster.
fact_tl: Maraming bulaklak ang may mga tagong guhit at pattern na tanging makikita lang sa ultraviolet light. Ang mga ito ay parang 'arrow' na nagtuturo sa bubuyog kung saan ang nektar, kaya mas mabilis silang nakakahanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Daghang bulak ang adunay tinago nga linya ug pattern nga makita lang sa ultraviolet light. Sama kini sa pana nga nagtudlo sa putyokan kung asa ang nektar, busa mas paspas sila makakaplag og pagkaon.

q: Which parts of the narra tree are used as folk medicine in traditional Philippine practice?
options: The bark and sap
The roots and flowers
The seeds and young leaves
The fruit and thorns
explanation: In traditional practice, the bark and sap of narra are used as folk medicine.
fact_tl: Sa lumang paraan, ginagamit ang balat at dagta ng narra bilang halamang gamot.
fact_bis: Sa karaang paagi, ang panit ug dagta sa narra gamiton isip tambal.

q: What amazing thing becomes visible during a total solar eclipse?
options: The Sun's corona — its outer atmosphere — appears around the blocked Sun
Stars normally hidden by moonlight suddenly appear in the sky
The dark side of the Moon is lit up by reflected sunlight
Auroras (northern lights) appear over the entire planet
explanation: During a total solar eclipse, the Moon blocks the Sun's bright disk, making the Sun's corona — its outer atmosphere — visible, one of the most spectacular sights in nature.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng total solar eclipse, ang korona ng araw — ang panlabas na atmospera — ay nagiging visible sa paligid ng blokadong araw — ito ay isa sa pinaka-magagandang tanawin sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Panahon sa total solar eclipse, ang korona sa adlaw — ang iyang panlabas nga atmospera — mahimong makita sa palibot sa naputlan nga adlaw — usa sa pinakamaanyag nga tanan-awon sa kinaiyahan.

q: Why does oral rehydration solution (ORS) contain both sugar and salt instead of plain water?
options: A special doorway in the gut lets glucose and sodium enter together, which pulls water back into the body faster
Sugar gives energy while salt replaces minerals, and together they taste better so children drink more
Sugar thickens the liquid so it stays in the stomach longer and absorbs more slowly
Salt kills harmful bacteria while sugar provides fuel for the immune system to fight infection
explanation: There is a special 'doorway' in the gut that lets glucose (sugar) and sodium (salt) enter together; when they move in together, water is pulled back into the body faster — that is why ORS needs both, not just plain water.
fact_tl: Paano gumagana ang ORS? May espesyal na 'pinto' sa loob ng bituka na sabay na pumapasok ang glucose (asukal) at sodium (asin). Kapag magkasama sila, mas mabilis na sumususo ang tubig pabalik sa katawan. Kaya may konting asukal at asin ang ORS, hindi lang tubig.
fact_bis: Unsaon paglihok sa ORS? Aduna'y espesyal nga 'pultahan' sa sulod sa tinai nga dungan nga ginasudlan sa glucose (asukar) ug sodium (asin). Kon magkuyog sila, mas paspas mabira ang tubig balik sa lawas. Mao nga ang ORS adunay gamay nga asukar ug asin, dili lang tubig.

q: Is rabies a disease that can be prevented?
options: Yes — it is fully preventable through vaccination and responsible pet care
No — once a person is exposed to rabies there is no way to prevent it
Yes — washing a bite wound with soap prevents rabies on its own
No — vaccines only work for animals, not for people
explanation: Although rabies is dangerous, it is fully preventable through vaccination and responsible pet care.
fact_tl: Bagaman delikado ang rabies, ito ay 100% naiiwasan sa pamamagitan ng pagpapabakuna at responsableng pag-aalaga sa hayop.
fact_bis: Bisan delikado ang rabies, kini malikayan gayod pinaagi sa pagpabakuna ug responsable nga pag-atiman sa hayop.

q: What makes mortar different from concrete?
options: Mortar has no gravel, so it works as a paste that glues bricks together
Mortar has extra gravel, making it stronger and better for walls
Mortar uses lime instead of cement and is mixed with river water
Mortar is the same as concrete but used only indoors
explanation: Mortar is cement, sand, and water with no gravel, so it works as a paste that glues bricks or blocks together, unlike concrete which contains gravel.
fact_tl: Ang mortar (argamasa) ay semento, buhangin, at tubig lang—walang graba—kaya nagdidikit ito ng mga tisa o bloke.
fact_bis: Ang mortar semento, balas, ug tubig lang—walay graba—busa kini ang nagpapilit sa mga tisa o bloke.

q: What does the Morse code signal for SOS look like?
options: Three dots, three dashes, three dots (· · · — — — · · ·)
Three dashes, three dots, three dashes (— — — · · · — — —)
One long dash followed by three dots (— · · ·)
Three dots only, repeated three times (· · · · · · · · ·)
explanation: In Morse code, SOS is three dots, three dashes, and three dots (· · · — — — · · ·).
fact_tl: Ang SOS sa Morse code ay tatlong tuldok, tatlong gitling, tatlong tuldok (· · · — — — · · ·).
fact_bis: Sa Morse code, ang SOS kay tulo ka tuldok, tulo ka guhit, ug tulo ka tuldok (· · · — — — · · ·).

q: What is the job of guard cells in a leaf?
options: They open and close stomata to control carbon dioxide entry and water loss
They produce chlorophyll that gives the leaf its green color
They carry water and minerals up from the roots to the leaf
They protect the outer surface of the leaf from insect damage
explanation: Guard cells are special leaf cells that open and close stomata to control carbon dioxide entry and water loss from the plant.
fact_tl: Ang guard cells ay mga espesyal na selula sa dahon ng halaman na nagbubukas at nagsasara ng mga stoma upang kontrolin ang pagpasok ng carbon dioxide at paglabas ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang guard cells espesyal nga mga selula sa dahon sa tanom nga nagbukas ug nagsara sa mga stoma aron makontrol ang pagsulod sa carbon dioxide ug paggawas sa tubig.

q: Which court is at the top of the Judicial branch of the Philippines?
options: The Supreme Court
The Court of Appeals
The Sandiganbayan
The Regional Trial Court
explanation: The Supreme Court heads the Judicial branch of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Korte Suprema (Kataas-taasang Hukuman) ang namumuno sa sangay na Hudikatura.
fact_bis: Ang Korte Suprema (Kataas-taasang Hukmanan) mao ang nangulo sa sanga nga Hudikatura.

q: How do large flightless birds get around instead of flying?
options: They use strong legs to run and walk
They swim through water using paddle-shaped feet
They glide from high ground using their wide wings
They hop very long distances using a strong tail for balance
explanation: Instead of flying, big flightless birds use strong legs to run and walk.
fact_tl: Sa halip na lumipad, ang malalaking ibong ito ay gumagamit ng malalakas na binti para tumakbo at maglakad.
fact_bis: Imbis nga molupad, kining dagkong langgam naggamit ug kusgan nga mga tiil aron modagan ug molakaw.

q: Can a remora fish leave the shark it is attached to?
options: Yes — it can let go and swim on its own whenever it wants
No — once attached, a remora is permanently bonded to the shark
No — the shark's suction holds the remora in place
Yes — but only when the shark is asleep or resting
explanation: A remora can let go of the shark and swim on its own whenever it wants.
fact_tl: Kaya ng remora na kumalas mula sa pating at lumangoy mag-isa kapag gusto nito.
fact_bis: Ang remora makahimo sa pagbulag gikan sa iho ug molangoy nga mag-inusara kung gusto niini.

q: What causes a goiter — a swelling of the thyroid gland in the neck?
options: A lack of iodine in the diet
Eating too much salt of any kind
A viral infection that attacks the throat
Too much vitamin C over a long period
explanation: Goiter is a swelling of the thyroid gland, often caused by a lack of iodine, which is why iodized salt is recommended.
fact_tl: Ang goiter ay paglaki ng thyroid gland sa leeg na kadalasang dahil sa kakulangan ng yodo, kaya iminumungkahi ang paggamit ng asing may yodo.
fact_bis: Ang goiter mao ang paghubag sa thyroid gland sa liog, kasagaran tungod sa kakulang sa yodo, mao nga girekomendar ang asin nga adunay yodo.

q: What happens to a banana stem after its bunch of bananas is harvested?
options: The stem dies and a new sucker grows in its place to fruit again
The stem grows a second bunch of bananas the following season
The stem is cut and replanted to produce a new banana plant
The stem stays alive and flowers again after a short rest period
explanation: Each banana stem fruits only once; after the bunch is harvested, that stem dies and a sucker takes its place to fruit again.
fact_tl: Bawat tangkay ng saging ay namumunga ng isang beses lamang; pagkatapos anihin, namamatay ito at ang supang ang pumapalit para magbunga muli.
fact_bis: Ang matag punoan sa saging mamunga makausa lamang; human anihon ang buwig, mamatay ang punoan ug ang saha mopuli aron mamunga pag-usab.

q: Why is a hummingbird's ability to hover useful for finding food?
options: It lets the bird drink nectar even when there is no branch to land on
It lets the bird escape predators by staying perfectly still in mid-air
It helps the bird warm up its wings before a long migration flight
It allows the bird to see flowers from far away without moving its head
explanation: A hummingbird's ability to hover is an adaptation that lets it drink nectar even when there is no branch to land on.
fact_tl: Ang kakayahang lumutang ng hummingbird ay isang angkop na katangian na nagbibigay-daan upang uminom ito ng nektar kahit walang madapuang sanga.
fact_bis: Ang abilidad sa hummingbird sa paglutaw usa ka pagpahiangay nga nagtugot niini sa pag-inom og nektar bisan walay sanga nga kadapatan.

q: How do hormones travel from the glands that make them to the rest of the body?
options: They are released into the blood, which carries them all over the body
They travel along nerves to reach the organs they control
They are stored in the brain and released as electrical signals
They move through the lymph system to nearby tissues only
explanation: Glands release hormones into the blood, which carries them all over the body to tell different parts what to do — this is how the endocrine system sends its chemical messages.
fact_tl: Ang endocrine system ay gumagawa ng mga hormone—parang chemical na mensahe. Sa halip na magpadala ng mabilis na signal sa nerbiyos, ang mga glandula ay naglalabas ng hormone sa dugo, na siyang nagdadala nito sa buong katawan para sabihin sa bawat bahagi kung ano ang gagawin.
fact_bis: Ang endocrine system maghimo og mga hormone—murag chemical nga mensahe. Imbis nga magpadala og paspas nga signal sa nerbiyos, ang mga glandula magbuhi og hormone ngadto sa dugo, nga magdala niini sa tibuok lawas aron sultian ang lain-laing bahin kon unsay buhaton.

q: What happens to a plant cell when it is placed in very salty water?
options: Water leaves the cell and the cell membrane pulls away from the cell wall (plasmolysis)
Water rushes into the cell and the cell swells until it bursts
Salt enters the cell and replaces the water, keeping the cell firm
The cell wall dissolves, leaving only the membrane behind
explanation: Plasmolysis occurs when water leaves the cell by osmosis into the salty water around it, causing the cell membrane to pull away from the cell wall, which can permanently damage plant cells.
fact_tl: Ang plasmolysis ay nangyayari kapag ang halaman ay nakalagay sa sobrang asin na tubig — ang tubig ay lumalabas sa selula sa pamamagitan ng osmosis at ang cell membrane ay humihiwalay sa cell wall, na maaaring makapinsala ng permanente sa selula ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang plasmolysis mahitabo sa dihang ang usa ka tanom gibutang sa hilabihang maasin nga tubig — ang tubig mogawas sa selula pinaagi sa osmosis ug ang cell membrane molayo gikan sa cell wall, nga mahimong permanenteng makadaot sa mga selula sa tanom.

q: Why are metal objects not allowed near an MRI machine?
options: The MRI's magnet is so strong it can pull metal across the room fast and dangerously
Metal reflects the radio waves the MRI uses and creates a blurry image
Metal objects block the magnetic field and prevent the machine from working
The electricity in metal objects interferes with the computer reading the scan
explanation: Metal objects are not allowed near an MRI because its magnet is so strong it can pull metal across the room fast and dangerously.
fact_tl: Bawal magdala ng bakal na bagay malapit sa MRI dahil napakalakas ng magnet nito kaya kayang hilahin nang mabilis at mapanganib ang metal.
fact_bis: Gidili ang pagdala ug bakal nga butang duol sa MRI kay kusog kaayo ang magnet niini mao nga makabira kini ug metal nga paspas ug peligroso.

q: How does a contact lens help a person see clearly?
options: It sits on the cornea and adjusts where the image focuses on the retina
It sits on the eyelid and filters out light that would blur vision
It covers the pupil to make it larger and let in more light
It floats in the tear film and magnifies small objects near the eye
explanation: A contact lens is a clear lens worn directly on the cornea — it adjusts where the image focuses on the retina to correct vision.
fact_tl: Ang contact lens ay isang malinis na lens na isinusuot nang direkta sa cornea ng mata — tinutuos nito ang imahe sa retina para itama ang pangitain.
fact_bis: Ang contact lens usa ka klaro nga lente nga isuol direkta sa cornea sa mata — gipahimutang niini ang hulagway sa retina aron matuwad ang pangitain.

q: What causes coral bleaching?
options: Water that is too warm forces corals to push out their algae, turning them white
Pollution from ships coats the coral in chemicals that bleach its color
Storms break coral apart and the broken pieces turn white in sunlight
Too little sunlight stops the coral from making its colorful pigments
explanation: When the water gets too warm, coral pushes out its algae and turns white — this is called coral bleaching.
fact_tl: Kapag masyadong mainit ang tubig, pinalalabas ng coral ang algae nito at nagiging puti—tinatawag itong coral bleaching.
fact_bis: Kon init kaayo ang tubig, ilabay sa coral ang algae niini ug mahimong puti—gitawag kini og coral bleaching.

q: Which simple machine is a grindstone an example of?
options: A wheel and axle
A lever
An inclined plane
A pulley
explanation: A spinning grindstone is a wheel and axle — the round stone is the wheel and the bar through its center is the axle; turning it spins the stone to sharpen tools.
fact_tl: Ang umiikot na batong panghasa ay gumagamit ng wheel and axle. Ang bilog na bato ang gulong, at ang baras sa gitna nito ang ehe. Pinipihit ito ng tao para mabilis na umikot ang bato at matalas ang kutsilyo o gunting na ihinaharap dito.
fact_bis: Ang nagtuyok nga bato nga ig-baid naggamit ug wheel and axle. Ang lingin nga bato mao ang gulong, ug ang bara sa tunga niini mao ang ehe. Tuyokon kini sa tawo aron paspas nga motuyok ang bato ug motalinis ang kutsilyo o gunting nga ipaatubang niini.

q: In a mango, where does the new plant actually grow from?
options: From the soft kernel inside the hard shell
From the hard outer shell itself
From the sweet flesh surrounding the seed
From the skin of the mango fruit
explanation: The big hard thing we call the mango seed is really just a shell; the true seed is the soft kernel inside it, and that is where the new plant grows from.
fact_tl: Ang malaking matigas na bagay na tinatawag nating buto ay talagang isang balot lang. Ang tunay na binhi ay ang malambot na laman sa loob nito, at dito nanggagaling ang bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Ang dakong gahi nga butang nga atong gitawag og liso usa ra gyud ka panit. Ang tinuod nga liso mao ang humok nga unod sa sulod niini, ug didto magsugod ang bag-ong tanom.

q: Why does momentum have a direction?
options: Because it depends on velocity, which points in the direction of motion
Because heavier objects always push things forward, not backward
Because momentum is created by gravity, which always pulls downward
Because only moving objects have momentum and they always move in straight lines
explanation: Momentum has direction because it depends on velocity, and velocity always points in the direction of motion.
fact_tl: Ang momentum ay may direksyon dahil nakasalalay ito sa bilis, na may direksyon din ng galaw.
fact_bis: Ang momentum adunay direksyon kay nagsalig kini sa katulin, nga adunay direksyon usab sa paglihok.

q: When light hits a mirror at a slant, how does it bounce off?
options: It bounces off at the same angle it came in
It bounces straight back the way it came
It bends slightly as it reflects, changing direction
It spreads out in all directions like a flashlight
explanation: When light hits a mirror at a slant, it bounces away at the same angle — like a ball bouncing off a wall.
fact_tl: Kapag tumama ang liwanag sa salamin nang pahilig, tumatalbog ito palayo sa parehong anggulo, gaya ng bolang tumatama sa pader.
fact_bis: Kung ang kahayag motama sa salamin nga pahilig, mobalik kini sa samang anggulo, sama sa bola nga moigo sa pader.

q: Why can you shape wet sand into a sandcastle but dry sand just falls apart?
options: Water between the grains holds them together
Sand grains melt and fuse when wet
Wet sand is heavier and harder
Salt in seawater glues the grains
explanation: Water between sand grains holds them together, which is why wet sand can be shaped.
fact_tl: Ang basang buhangin ay nagkakadikit dahil sa tubig sa pagitan ng mga butil, kaya kaya itong hugisan.
fact_bis: Ang basa nga balas magdikit tungod sa tubig taliwala sa mga lugas, busa mahimo kining porma.

q: Besides helping you swallow food, what does saliva do to protect your teeth?
options: It washes away food bits, lowers acid, and carries minerals that strengthen tooth enamel
It bleaches the enamel so stains cannot stick to it
It hardens the gums so bacteria cannot enter
It produces heat that kills bacteria in the mouth
explanation: Saliva washes away food bits, lowers acid, and carries minerals that help strengthen tooth enamel.
fact_tl: Ang laway ay hindi lang basta tubig — naghuhugas ito ng tirang pagkain, nagpapababa ng asido, at may mineral na tumutulong magpatibay ng enamel ng ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang laway dili lang basta tubig — manghugas kini sa salin nga pagkaon, mokunhod sa aslom, ug adunay mineral nga motabang pagpalig-on sa enamel sa ngipon.

q: What is true about very small wasp species that many people do not know?
options: They can barely sting people and actually help by eating plant pests
They sting more painfully than large wasps because their venom is stronger
They only sting at night when they cannot be seen
They eat other wasps instead of helping plants
explanation: Some tiny wasp species can barely sting people at all and instead help by eating pests that harm plants.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba na lahat ng putakti ay mabangis at nananaksak ng tao. Pero ang ilang uri ay napakaliit at halos hindi kayang manaksak; sa halip, tumutulong pa sila sa pamamagitan ng pagkain ng mga peste sa halaman.
fact_bis: Naay mga tawo nga naghunahuna nga ang tanang putyukan bangis ug manukol sa tawo. Apan ang ubang matang gagmay kaayo ug halos dili makatukol; hinuon, makatabang pa sila pinaagi sa pagkaon sa mga peste nga modaot sa tanom.

q: You drop a tea bag into still water without stirring. What causes the color to slowly spread through the water?
options: Diffusion
Evaporation
Condensation
Osmosis
explanation: The color spreads through diffusion — tea particles move from an area of high concentration into the surrounding water even without stirring.
fact_tl: Kapag inilubog mo ang tea bag sa tubig, kumakalat ang kulay kahit hindi mo hinahalo dahil sa diffusion.
fact_bis: Kon ituslob nimo ang tea bag sa tubig, mokatag ang kolor bisan dili nimo kutawon tungod sa diffusion.

q: What makes a volcano 'active' rather than 'dormant' or 'extinct'?
options: It erupted recently or could erupt again soon
It is currently the tallest mountain in the country
It has a deep crater lake inside its cone
It sits on land rather than under the ocean
explanation: An active volcano like Taal or Mayon has erupted recently or may erupt again, unlike dormant (quiet but able to wake) or extinct (dead) volcanoes.
fact_tl: Inuuri ang mga bulkan sa tatlo: active, dormant, at extinct. Ang active na bulkan gaya ng Taal at Mayon ay sumabog kamakailan o maaaring sumabog muli. Ang dormant ay parang natutulog—matagal nang tahimik pero pwedeng magising. Ang extinct naman ay 'patay' na, malabong sumabog pa. Maraming active na bulkan ang Pilipinas dahil nasa Pacific Ring of Fire ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulkan gibahin sa tulo: active, dormant, ug extinct. Ang active nga bulkan sama sa Taal ug Mayon mibuto bag-ohay lang o mahimong mobuto pag-usab. Ang dormant sama nga natulog—dugay nang hilom apan mahimong momata. Ang extinct 'patay' na, lagmit dili na mobuto. Daghan ang active nga bulkan sa Pilipinas tungod kay anaa kini sa Pacific Ring of Fire.

q: When ice melts, what happens to the heat energy around it?
options: Heat is absorbed from the surroundings, making them cooler
Heat is released into the surroundings, making them warmer
No heat is gained or lost during melting
The ice creates its own heat to melt itself
explanation: Melting ice is endothermic — it absorbs heat from its surroundings, which is why things cool down when ice melts nearby.
fact_tl: Ang pagkatunaw ng yelo ay endothermic dahil sumisipsip ito ng init mula sa paligid.
fact_bis: Ang pagkatunaw sa yelo endothermic kay nagsuyop kini ug kainit gikan sa palibot.

q: What should you do to protect your body during very hot weather?
options: Rest and avoid heavy play or work so your body does not overheat
Drink very cold water and run fast to cool down quickly
Stay inside and eat salty snacks to replace lost sweat
Exercise harder so your body gets used to the heat
explanation: In very hot weather, resting and avoiding strenuous activity prevents the body from overheating.
fact_tl: Sa napakainit na panahon, mas mabuting magpahinga at iwasan ang mabibigat na laro o trabaho para hindi mainitan ang katawan.
fact_bis: Sa hilabihan ka init nga panahon, mas maayo nga magpahulay ug likayan ang bug-at nga dula o trabaho aron dili moinit ang lawas.

q: At what temperature does water freeze on the Celsius scale?
explanation: Water freezes at 0°C, which is the same as 32°F on the Fahrenheit scale.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ang temperatura sa Celsius (°C) o Fahrenheit (°F). Ang tubig ay nagyeyelo sa 0°C = 32°F at kumukulo sa 100°C = 212°F.
fact_bis: Gisukod ang temperatura sa Celsius (°C) o Fahrenheit (°F). Ang tubig mo-yelo sa 0°C = 32°F ug mobukal sa 100°C = 212°F.

q: Why is igneous rock like granite used in buildings and pillars?
options: Because it is very hard and strong
Because it is lightweight and easy to cut
Because it forms colorful patterns naturally
Because it floats on water and is easy to transport
explanation: Granite is a very hard igneous rock, which makes it ideal for use in buildings and pillars.
fact_tl: Dahil napakatigas ng batong igneous tulad ng granite, ginagamit ito sa mga gusali at haligi.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gahi kaayo ang batong igneous sama sa granite, gigamit kini sa mga gusali ug haligi.

q: What is special about the mudskipper fish found in mangroves?
options: It can crawl over mud and climb roots using its strong fins
It breathes underwater through gills like all other fish
It only eats leaves from mangrove trees
It can change color to hide among the mangrove roots
explanation: The mudskipper can crawl over mud and climb mangrove roots using its strong fins, living between water and land.
fact_tl: May isang kakaibang isda sa bakawan na tinatawag na mudskipper o tambasakan. Kaya nitong gumapang sa putik at umakyat sa mga ugat ng bakawan gamit ang malalakas nitong palikpik. Tumitira ito sa pagitan ng tubig at lupa.
fact_bis: Adunay talagsaong isda sa bakawan nga gitawag og mudskipper. Makahimo kini sa pagkamang sa lapok ug pagsaka sa gamot sa bakawan gamit ang kusog niyang mga palikpik. Magpuyo kini sa tunga sa tubig ug yuta.

q: Why do scientists place fungi in their own separate kingdom rather than grouping them with plants?
options: Because their way of living and getting food is completely different from plants and animals
Because fungi are too small to be seen without a microscope
Because fungi only grow underground and never produce seeds
Because fungi move around like animals do
explanation: Fungi are placed in their own kingdom because their way of living and getting food differs so much from both plants and animals.
fact_tl: Inilagay ng mga siyentipiko ang fungi sa sarili nilang kaharian ng buhay — hiwalay sa mga halaman at mga hayop — dahil ibang-iba ang paraan ng kanilang pamumuhay at pagkuha ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Gibutang sa mga siyentista ang fungi sa ilang kaugalingong gingharian sa kinabuhi — bulag sa mga tanom ug sa mga mananap — kay lahi kaayo ang ilang paagi sa pagpuyo ug pagkuha og pagkaon.

q: What kind of outer body covering do centipedes and millipedes have instead of bones?
options: A hard outer covering called an exoskeleton
A soft rubbery skin that stretches as they grow
Overlapping scales like those of a fish
A moist slippery layer of mucus
explanation: Centipedes and millipedes are arthropods with a hard outer covering (exoskeleton) instead of bones inside.
fact_tl: Ang alupihan at millipede ay parehong arthropod na may matigas na balat sa labas ng katawan sa halip na buto sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang alupihan ug millipede parehong arthropod nga adunay gahi nga panit sa gawas imbes nga bukog sa sulod.

q: How does being transparent help an animal like a jellyfish hide in the water?
options: Light passes through its body so it is nearly invisible in water
Its clear body reflects light to blind nearby predators
It absorbs the blue color of water and turns blue
It produces a clear slime that hides its outline
explanation: Transparent animals like jellyfish let light pass through them, making them nearly invisible in the water.
fact_tl: May ibang paraan ng pagtatago sa tubig: ang pagiging malinaw o naaaninag (transparent). Ang mga hayop tulad ng dikya (jellyfish) ay halos walang kulay, kaya dumadaan ang liwanag sa kanila at halos hindi sila makita sa tubig.
fact_bis: Adunay laing paagi sa pagtago sa tubig: ang pagka-tin-aw o naaninag (transparent). Ang mga hayop sama sa dikya (jellyfish) halos walay kolor, mao nga moagi ang kahayag kanila ug halos dili sila makita sa tubig.

q: Why is it important to cook food thoroughly before eating it?
options: Heat from cooking kills bacteria that cause disease
Cooking makes food weigh less so it is easier to digest
Raw food contains vitamins that cooking removes
Cooking adds moisture that prevents choking
explanation: Thoroughly cooked food is safer because heat kills the bacteria that cause disease.
fact_tl: Ang lutong-luto na pagkain ay mas ligtas dahil ang init ay pumapatay sa mga bakteryang nagdudulot ng sakit.
fact_bis: Ang hingpit nga linuto nga pagkaon mas luwas tungod kay ang kainit makapatay sa mga bakterya nga maghatag ug sakit.

q: Where is the thyroid gland located in the human body?
options: In the front of the neck, just below the Adam's apple
Behind the stomach near the lower back
Inside the chest between the two lungs
On top of each kidney in the abdomen
explanation: The thyroid is a small butterfly-shaped gland found in the front of the neck, just below the Adam's apple.
fact_tl: Ang thyroid ay isang maliit na glandula na hugis paru-paro at nasa harapan ng leeg mo, sa ibaba ng iyong Adam's apple. Maliit lang ito pero napakahalaga sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid usa ka gamay nga glandula nga porma og alibangbang nga naa sa atubangan sa imong liog, ubos sa imong Adam's apple. Gamay ra siya pero importante kaayo sa lawas.

q: How often do El Niño and La Niña events typically occur?
options: About every two to seven years
Exactly once every year without fail
Every ten to twenty years
Only once in a person's lifetime
explanation: El Niño and La Niña typically return every two to seven years and can last from several months to more than a year.
fact_tl: Ang El Niño at La Niña ay hindi nangyayari kada taon; karaniwang bumabalik ang mga ito tuwing mga dalawa hanggang pitong taon at maaaring tumagal ng ilang buwan hanggang higit isang taon.
fact_bis: Ang El Niño ug La Niña dili matag tuig mahitabo; kasagaran mobalik kini matag mga duha hangtod pito ka tuig ug mahimong molungtad og pipila ka bulan hangtod kapin sa usa ka tuig.

q: In which state of matter does diffusion happen fastest, and why?
options: In gases, because gas particles are farther apart and move faster
In liquids, because particles flow freely and mix easily
In solids, because particles are packed tightly together
In liquids, because water helps carry particles along
explanation: Diffusion is fastest in gases because gas particles are farther apart and move faster than particles in liquids or solids.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis ang diffusion sa gas kaysa sa likido dahil mas malaki ang pagitan at mas mabilis ang galaw ng mga particle sa gas.
fact_bis: Mas paspas ang diffusion sa gas kaysa sa likido tungod kay mas layo ug mas paspas molihok ang mga tipik sa gas.

q: You shake a ketchup bottle hard and then suddenly stop your hand. Why does the sauce keep moving downward?
options: Because of inertia — the sauce tends to keep moving in the direction it was going
Because gravity is stronger on the sauce than on the bottle
Because air pressure pushes the sauce down after the hand stops
Because the sauce is denser than the bottle and sinks faster
explanation: Inertia causes the ketchup to keep moving down even after the hand stops, because objects in motion tend to stay in motion.
fact_tl: Kapag iniiling ang bote ng ketchup at biglang ihinto ang kamay, patuloy na gumagalaw ang sarsa pababa dahil sa inersya.
fact_bis: Kung uyugon nimo ang botelya sa ketchup ug kalit nga ihunong ang imong kamot, ang sarsa magpadayon sa paglihok paubos tungod sa inertia.

q: What does a hygrometer measure at a weather station?
options: Humidity — the amount of water vapor in the air
Air pressure — how heavy the atmosphere is pressing down
Wind speed — how fast the air is moving
Temperature — how hot or cold the air feels
explanation: A hygrometer measures humidity, which is how much water vapor is in the air; high humidity makes the air feel hot and sticky.
fact_tl: Ang hygrometer ay sumusukat ng halumigmig—ibig sabihin, kung gaano karaming tubig na singaw ang nasa hangin. Kapag mataas ang halumigmig, maalinsangan at parang malagkit ang pakiramdam, gaya tuwing tag-init bago umulan.
fact_bis: Ang hygrometer magsukod sa kaumog—buot ipasabot, kung pila ka aso sa tubig ang anaa sa hangin. Kung taas ang kaumog, mainit ug morag pilit ang bati, sama sa ting-init nga mga adlaw sa dili pa mouulan.

q: What mainly determines how fast a sea wave travels?
options: The depth of the water and the shape of the seafloor
The height of the wave above the water surface
How strong the wind was when the wave formed
The size of the area of water the wave crosses
explanation: A wave's speed depends more on water depth and the seafloor than on the wave's height (amplitude), so bigger waves are not always faster.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, mas mabilis ang malalaking alon ng dagat hindi laging totoo iyan. Ang taas ng alon (amplitude) ay hiwalay sa bilis nito. Ang lalim ng tubig at ilalim ng dagat ang mas nagtatakda ng bilis, hindi ang laki.
fact_bis: Naghuna-huna ang uban nga mas paspas ang dagkong balud sa dagat dili kanunay tinuod na. Ang gihabugon sa balud (amplitude) lahi sa kapaspas niini. Ang giladmon sa tubig ug ang salog sa dagat mao ang mu-set sa kapaspas, dili ang gidak-on.

q: What formed inside the crater of Mount Pinatubo after it erupted?
options: A lake
A new smaller volcano
A deep cave system
A forest of new trees
explanation: After Mount Pinatubo's eruption, a lake formed inside its crater.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos pumutok, isang lawa ang nabuo sa loob ng bunganga ng Bundok Pinatubo.
fact_bis: Human kini mibuto, usa ka linaw ang naporma sa sulod sa bung-aw sa Bukid Pinatubo.

q: What are the three parts of a mango from outside to inside?
options: Skin on the outside, juicy flesh in the middle, and one seed at the center
Thick shell on the outside, dry pulp in the middle, and many small seeds
Smooth peel on the outside, fibrous strings in the middle, and no seed
Green outer layer, white flesh in the middle, and two large seeds
explanation: A mango has skin on the outside, juicy flesh inside, and one seed in the center.
fact_tl: Ang mangga ay may balat sa labas, makatas na laman sa loob, at isang buto sa gitna.
fact_bis: Ang mangga adunay panit sa gawas, duga-on nga unod sa sulod, ug usa ka liso sa tunga.

q: What marking can sometimes be seen on the lower neck of some carabaos?
options: Pale V-shaped stripes
Black horizontal bands
White spots arranged in a circle
Dark diagonal lines running downward
explanation: Some carabaos have pale V-shaped stripes on the lower neck, so their gray color is not always perfectly even.
fact_tl: Ilang kalabaw ay may maputlang guhit na hugis-V sa ibabang bahagi ng leeg, kaya hindi laging pantay-pantay ang kulay-abo nila.
fact_bis: Ang ubang kalabaw adunay luspad nga guhit nga porma og V sa ubos nga bahin sa liog, mao nga dili kanunay parehas ang ilang abuhon nga kolor.

q: A geologist tries to scratch quartz with a copper coin in the field. What will happen?
options: The coin cannot scratch quartz because quartz is harder
The coin easily scratches quartz because copper is the harder mineral
The coin and quartz are equally hard so neither scratches the other
The coin melts slightly when it touches the harder quartz
explanation: A copper coin has a Mohs hardness of about 3, while quartz is 7, so the coin cannot scratch quartz.
fact_tl: Sa field test ng mineral hardness: ang kuko ng tao (Mohs 2.5) ay nakakagasgas ng talc ngunit hindi ng orthoclase; ang baryang piso (Mohs 3) ay hindi makagasgas ng quartz (Mohs 7).
fact_bis: Sa field testing sa mineral: ang kuko (Mohs 2.5) makagasgas sa talc apan dili sa orthoclase; ang barya (Mohs 3) dili makagasgas sa quartz (Mohs 7).

q: How do mangrove trees deal with the salty water they grow in?
options: Some filter salt out at their roots, and others push extra salt out through leaf glands
They store all the salt in their fruit and then drop the fruit into the sea
They only absorb fresh rainwater and keep their roots above the saltwater
They die quickly in salt water and must be replanted every season
explanation: Some mangroves filter salt at their roots while others push extra salt out through special glands on their leaves.
fact_tl: Sinasala ng ilang mangrove ang asin sa kanilang mga ugat, at ang iba ay nagtatapon ng asin sa pamamagitan ng espesyal na glandula sa kanilang mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang ubang mangrove magsala sa asin diha sa ilang mga gamot, samtang ang uban magpagawas sa asin pinaagi sa pinasahi nga glandula sa ilang mga dahon.

q: What is rattan and what is it mainly used for?
options: A climbing forest palm whose long spiny stem is used to make furniture
A type of tropical flower whose petals are woven into baskets
A large tree whose hard wood is used to build houses
A water plant whose hollow stems are used as pipes
explanation: Rattan is a climbing forest palm with a spiny stem; its long stem is harvested and used to make furniture.
fact_tl: Ang rattan o uway ay isang gumagapang na palmang gubat na may matinik na tangkay; mahaba ang sanga nito at ginagamit sa paggawa ng muwebles.
fact_bis: Ang rattan o uway usa ka nagkatay nga palma sa lasang nga adunay tunokon nga tangkay; taas ang punoan niini ug gamiton sa paghimo og muwebles.

q: Why do hibernating animals use very little energy during winter?
options: Their heartbeat and breathing slow down a lot during hibernation
They stop growing completely and their cells go to sleep
They produce special chemicals that turn off their muscles
They eat so much before winter that energy use does not matter
explanation: During hibernation, an animal's heartbeat and breathing slow down greatly, so it uses very little energy.
fact_tl: Habang naghihibernate, bumabagal nang husto ang tibok ng puso at paghinga ng hayop para gumamit ito ng kaunting enerhiya.
fact_bis: Samtang naghibernate, mohinay pag-ayo ang pitik sa kasingkasing ug ang pagginhawa sa mananap aron magamit niini ang gamay nga kusog.

q: How does a cicada make its loud sound?
options: By rapidly flexing thin ribbed parts called tymbals on the sides of its abdomen
By rubbing its hind legs together the way a cricket does
By vibrating its wings against each other at very high speed
By forcing air through holes in its thorax to create a buzzing noise
explanation: A cicada makes sound by quickly flexing thin ribbed parts called tymbals located on the sides of its abdomen.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig ay gumagawa ng tunog sa pamamagitan ng mabilis na paggalaw ng manipis na bahagi ng katawan na tinatawag na tymbal sa gilid ng tiyan nito.
fact_bis: Ang kuliglig nagahimo ug tingog pinaagi sa paspas nga paglihok sa nipis nga bahin nga gitawag tymbal sa kilid sa iyang tiyan.

q: How does the cloud rat's bushy, long tail help it survive in the trees?
options: It helps the rat keep its balance while moving along branches at night
It wraps around branches so the rat can hang upside down to sleep
It stores fat the rat uses as energy when food is scarce
It acts as a signal to warn other cloud rats of predators
explanation: The cloud rat's bushy, long tail helps it maintain balance as it moves along tree branches at night.
fact_tl: Ang mabalahibo at mahabang buntot ng cloud rat ay tumutulong sa pagpapanatili ng balanse habang gumagalaw sa mga sanga ng puno sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang baga ug hataas nga ikog sa cloud rat nagtabang niini sa pagpabiler sa balanse samtang naglihok sa mga sanga sa kahoy sa gabii.

q: What do most tardigrades feed on?
