options: They pierce plant cells, algae, or tiny animals and suck out their fluids
They filter microscopic bacteria from the water around them
They absorb dissolved sugars directly through their skin
They eat dead leaves on the forest floor like earthworms
explanation: Most tardigrades feed by piercing plant cells, algae, or tiny animals and sucking out their fluids.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga tardigrade ay sumisipsip ng laman ng selula ng halaman, algae, o maliliit na hayop sa pamamagitan ng matulis nilang bunganga.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga tardigrade nagakaon pinaagi sa pagtusok sa mga selula sa tanom, algae, o gagmay nga mananap ug pagsuyop sa ilang sulod.

q: What is the scientific name for human beings?
options: Homo sapiens
Homo erectus
Pan sapiens
Homo habilis
explanation: The scientific name of humans is Homo sapiens, where Homo is the genus and sapiens is the species.
fact_tl: Ang siyentipikong pangalan ng tao ay Homo sapiens, kung saan ang Homo ang genus at sapiens ang species.
fact_bis: Ang siyentipiko nga ngalan sa tawo mao ang Homo sapiens, diin ang Homo mao ang genus ug ang sapiens mao ang species.

q: One important reason we feel hungry is that something in the blood has dropped. What is it?
options: The level of energy or sugar in the blood
The amount of water molecules in the blood
The number of red blood cells in the blood
The temperature of the blood flowing to the stomach
explanation: When the level of sugar or energy in the blood drops, the brain notices and sends a hunger signal so we eat more food.
fact_tl: Isa sa mga dahilan ng gutom ay kapag kumonti na ang enerhiya o asukal na dala ng dugo sa buong katawan. Napapansin ito ng utak, at naghuhudyat ito ng gutom para magdagdag tayo ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Usa sa hinungdan sa gutom mao kon mokunhod na ang kusog o asukal nga gidala sa dugo sa tibuok lawas. Mamatikdan kini sa utok, ug magsenyas kini og gutom aron makadugang ta og pagkaon.

q: How should iodized salt be stored to keep its iodine from being lost?
options: Kept dry and covered in a closed container
Mixed with water and stored in a bottle in the refrigerator
Left open in sunlight so the iodine stays fresh
Frozen in the freezer to preserve the iodine content
explanation: Iodized salt should be kept dry and covered so the iodine content is not lost.
fact_tl: Dapat itago ang asing iodized sa tuyo at nakatakip na lalagyan para hindi mawala ang iodine.
fact_bis: Ang asin nga iodized angay tipigan nga uga ug natabonan aron dili mawala ang iodine.

q: Why does sapin-sapin have separate colored layers instead of being mixed into one color?
options: Each colored batch is cooked and allowed to set before the next layer is added
Food coloring is poured in stripes after the whole cake is baked at once
The layers form naturally because each color sinks to a different depth
The different flavors push apart from each other when heated
explanation: Sapin-sapin is cooked in stages so each colored batch sets into a separate layer before the next one is added.
fact_tl: Ang sapin-sapin ay isang Pilipinong kakanin na gawa sa giling na malagkit na bigas at gata na niluluto ng paunti-unti upang ang bawat kulay ay magtumpok bilang magkakapatong na layer.
fact_bis: Ang sapin-sapin usa ka Pilipinhong kakanin nga hinimo sa giniling nga pilit nga bugas ug gata, giluto sa hinay-hinay aron ang matag kolor mopatong isip nagkapatong nga sapaw.

q: In PAGASA's color-coded rainfall warning system, which color signals the highest flood risk?
options: Red
Orange
Yellow
Green
explanation: PAGASA uses red to indicate the highest flood risk, orange for high danger, and yellow for moderate danger.
fact_tl: Naglabas ang PAGASA ng mga babala sa pag-ulan gamit ang mga kulay: dilaw (yellow) para sa katamtamang panganib, kahel (orange) para sa mataas na panganib, at pula (red) para sa pinakamataas na panganib ng pagbaha.
fact_bis: Nagpagawas ang PAGASA sa mga babala sa ulan gamit ang mga kolor: dilaw alang sa katamtaman nga peligro, orange alang sa taas nga peligro, ug pula alang sa pinakaataas nga peligro sa baha.

q: What is the name for the process where water carries minerals and clay down from the topsoil into the layer of soil below it?
options: Eluviation (also called leaching)
Erosion
Evaporation
Sedimentation
explanation: Eluviation (leaching) is when percolating water carries minerals and clay from the A horizon down into the B horizon, reducing topsoil nutrients especially in high-rainfall areas.
fact_tl: Ang eluviation ay ang proseso ng paglipat ng mga mineral at clay sa pamamagitan ng percolating na tubig mula sa A horizon pababa sa B horizon; ang epektong ito ay tinatawag ding 'leaching' at maaaring magpababa ng sustansya ng topsoil sa mataas na ulan na mga lugar tulad ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang eluviation mao ang proseso sa pagdala sa mga mineral ug clay pinaagi sa percolating nga tubig pababa gikan sa A horizon ngadto sa B horizon; kini nga epekto gitawag usab og leaching ug mahimong magpababa sa sustansya sa topsoil sa mga lugar nga taas ang ulan sama sa Pilipinas.

q: Why was the Great Wall of China built?
options: To protect China from invaders coming from the north
To mark the borders between China's farming provinces
To channel floodwaters away from the Yellow River valley
To serve as a trade road connecting eastern and western China
explanation: The Great Wall of China was built as a defense to protect China from invaders coming from the north.
fact_tl: Ang Great Wall of China ay itinayo bilang depensa upang protektahan ang Tsina mula sa mga mananakop mula sa hilaga.
fact_bis: Ang Great Wall of China gitukod isip depensa aron panalipdan ang China gikan sa mga manunulong gikan sa amihanan.

q: At approximately what temperature does lead melt?
explanation: Lead melts at a relatively low 327 degrees Celsius, much lower than many other metals.
fact_tl: Ang tingga (lead) ay natutunaw sa mababang 327 degrees Celsius (327°C).
fact_bis: Ang tingga (lead) matunaw sa ubos nga 327 degrees Celsius (327°C).

q: When you look at a star in a constellation at night, what are you really seeing?
options: Light that left the star many years ago and only just reached us
The star exactly as it looks right now at this very moment
Light bouncing off the star's surface in real time
Reflected sunlight just like we see from the Moon
explanation: Stars are so far away that their light takes many years to reach us, so starlight we see tonight left those stars long ago.
fact_tl: Napakalayo ng mga bituin kaya ang liwanag nilang nakikita natin ay maraming taon nang naglalakbay bago umabot sa atin. Kaya minsan ay tinitingnan natin ang lumang liwanag ng mga bituin sa konstelasyon.
fact_bis: Halayo kaayo ang mga bituon mao nga ang kahayag nila nga atong makita nagpanaw na og daghang tuig una kini moabot kanato. Busa usahay, ang daan nga kahayag sa mga bituon ang atong gitan-aw.

q: Before a snake swallows its prey, it flicks its tongue over it. What is the snake doing?
options: Checking the smell to figure out what the prey is and whether it is safe to eat
Tasting the prey to see if it is sweet or salty before deciding
Injecting venom into the prey before swallowing it
Marking the prey with a scent so other snakes stay away
explanation: A snake flicks its tongue over prey to detect its smell and figure out what it is and whether it is safe to eat.
fact_tl: Bago kainin ng ahas ang isang hayop, dinidila muna nito ito para malaman kung ano ba talaga ito at kung ligtas itong kainin. Parang pagsusuri muna sa amoy bago magdesisyon.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa kan-on sa ahas ang usa ka hayop, tilaan una niini kini aron mahibaw-an kung unsa gyud kini ug kung luwas ba kan-on. Morag pagsusi una sa baho sa dili pa modesisyon.

q: How is guava most commonly eaten?
options: Fresh as a nutritious fruit or snack
Boiled into a thick paste and spread on bread
Dried in the sun and stored like raisins
Ground into powder and mixed with water
explanation: Guava is often eaten fresh as a nutritious fruit or snack.
fact_tl: Madalas kaining sariwa ang bayabas bilang masustansyang prutas o meryenda.
fact_bis: Ang bayabas kasagarang kan-on nga presko isip masustansya nga prutas o meryenda.

q: In which layer of the Sun does nuclear fusion take place?
options: The core
The convective zone
The radiative zone
The photosphere
explanation: Nuclear fusion occurs in the Sun's core, the innermost layer where energy is produced.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay may ilang layer mula sa gitna papalabas: ang core (kung saan nagaganap ang nuclear fusion), ang radiative zone (kung saan ang enerhiya ay paalon paalon), ang convective zone (kung saan ang mainit na gas ay umaakyat), at ang mga panlabas na layer ng photosphere, chromosphere, at corona.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw adunay daghang mga layer gikan sa sentro paingon sa gawas: ang core (diin ang nuclear fusion mahitabo), ang radiative zone (diin ang enerhiya molihok paingon sa gawas isip radiation), ang convective zone (diin ang init nga gas mosakyat), ug ang mga panlabas nga layer sa photosphere, chromosphere, ug corona.

q: What protects an ant's body instead of bones?
options: A hard outer covering called an exoskeleton
A thick layer of tough skin like a rhinoceros
Overlapping scales that grow from its abdomen
A jelly-like substance that hardens when it dries
explanation: An ant has no bones; instead, its body is protected by a hard outer covering called an exoskeleton.
fact_tl: Ang langgam ay walang buto sa loob; sa halip, may matigas na balot ang katawan nito sa labas.
fact_bis: Ang hulmigas walay bukog sa sulod; hinuon ang lawas niini adunay gahi nga panangga sa gawas nga gitawag og exoskeleton.

q: In which part of the Philippines is most rubber grown?
options: Mindanao, such as in Zamboanga and Cotabato
Luzon, especially in the Cordillera mountain region
The Visayas islands, mainly in Cebu and Bohol
Metro Manila's urban farming districts
explanation: Much of the Philippines' rubber is grown in Mindanao, particularly in areas like Zamboanga and Cotabato.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, marami sa goma ay itinatanim sa Mindanao tulad sa Zamboanga at Cotabato.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghang goma ang gitanom sa Mindanao sama sa Zamboanga ug Cotabato.

q: Why is it dangerous for a person to drive or make important decisions after drinking alcohol?
options: Alcohol affects the brain, making it hard to think clearly or make good decisions
Alcohol makes the eyes blurry so the person cannot see traffic signs
Alcohol makes the hands shake so the person cannot hold a steering wheel
Alcohol causes stomach pain that distracts the person from focusing
explanation: Alcohol affects the brain, so a drunk person finds it hard to think clearly or make good decisions.
fact_tl: Ang alak ay nakakaapekto sa utak, kaya nahihirapan ang taong lasing na mag-isip nang malinaw o gumawa ng tamang desisyon.
fact_bis: Ang alak makaapekto sa utok, mao nga ang tawo nga hubog maglisod sa paghunahuna ug husto o sa paghimo ug maayong desisyon.

q: Why do tiny fish and crabs hide among mangrove roots when they are young?
options: The dense roots shelter them from predators and provide food until they grow up
The roots release a chemical that helps the fish grow faster
The shaded water under the roots is cooler and fish need cool water
The mud between the roots contains salt that young fish need to survive
explanation: Mangrove roots act like a nursery — young fish and crabs hide there from predators and find food until they are large enough to move to open water.
fact_tl: Ang siksik na ugat ng bakawan ay parang silid-aralan o nursery para sa mga maliliit na isda at alimango. Doon sila nagtatago mula sa malalaking mandaragit at may laging pagkain hanggang sa lumaki sila.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga mga gamot sa bakawan morag nursery para sa gagmay nga isda ug alimango. Didto sila motago gikan sa dagkong manunukob ug kanunay may pagkaon hangtod modako sila.

q: Who gave the name 'vitamin' and in what year?
options: Casimir Funk in 1912
Louis Pasteur in 1865
Albert Einstein in 1905
Marie Curie in 1898
explanation: Casimir Funk coined the name 'vitamin' in 1912.
fact_tl: Si Casimir Funk ang nagbigay ng pangalang 'vitamin' (bitamina) noong 1912.
fact_bis: Si Casimir Funk ang naghatag sa ngalang 'vitamin' (bitamina) niadtong 1912.

q: How many oceans does Earth have, and which one is the smallest?
options: Five oceans; the Arctic Ocean is the smallest
Four oceans; the Indian Ocean is the smallest
Six oceans; the Southern Ocean is the smallest
Three oceans; the Atlantic Ocean is the smallest
explanation: Earth has five oceans — Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic — and the Arctic is the smallest.
fact_tl: Ang 5 na karagatan ay ang Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, at Arctic.
fact_bis: Ang 5 ka kadagatan mao ang Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, ug Arctic.

q: What kind of path does a comet travel around the Sun?
options: A long, stretched oval (elliptical) path that takes it very close to the Sun and then far out into space
A perfectly circular path that keeps it at a steady distance from the Sun
A straight path that brings it toward the Sun and then carries it away forever
A short oval path that keeps it near the inner planets
explanation: Many comets have long, stretched elliptical orbits, swinging very close to the Sun and then far out into space.
fact_tl: Maraming kometa ang may mahaba at pahabang (elliptical) na ikot kaya minsan napakalapit sa Araw at minsan napakalayo sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Daghang kometa adunay taas ug pinahaba (elliptical) nga tuyok, busa usahay duol kaayo sa Adlaw ug usahay layo kaayo sa kawanangan.

q: What is the job of the compressor inside a refrigerator?
options: It pumps and squeezes the refrigerant to keep it circulating
It absorbs heat from inside the refrigerator and releases it outside
It cools the refrigerant by passing it through the freezer coils
It converts electrical energy into cold air that chills the food
explanation: The compressor is the pump that pushes and squeezes the refrigerant so it keeps circulating through the refrigerator system.
fact_tl: Ang compressor ang makinang nagbobomba at nagpipiga sa refrigerant para patuloy itong umikot.
fact_bis: Ang compressor mao ang makina nga nagbomba ug nagpiga sa refrigerant aron padayon kining moliyok.

q: If a sound has a higher frequency, what happens to its wavelength (when the speed stays the same)?
options: The wavelength gets shorter
The wavelength gets longer
The wavelength stays the same
The wavelength doubles in size
explanation: Because speed equals frequency multiplied by wavelength, a higher frequency means a shorter wavelength when the speed of sound stays the same.
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng tunog sa isang medium ay katumbas ng frequency na pinarami ng wavelength — kung mataas ang frequency, maikli ang wavelength at kabaliktaran.
fact_bis: Ang tulin sa tunog sa usa ka medium katumbas sa frequency nga gidaghan sa wavelength — mas taas nga frequency nagpasabot sa mas mubo nga wavelength ug bise bersa.

q: What does the body of a stingray look like?
options: Flat and wide, shaped like a big leaf
Round and lumpy, like a large ball
Long and narrow, like a snake
Tall and thin, like a sheet of paper
explanation: A stingray is a fish with a flat, wide body shaped like a big leaf.
fact_tl: Ang pagi ay isang isda na may patag at malapad na katawan na parang malaking dahon.
fact_bis: Ang pagi usa ka isda nga adunay patag ug lapad nga lawas nga sama sa dako nga dahon.

q: Which part of the nervous system automatically controls your heartbeat, breathing, and digestion without you thinking about it?
options: The autonomic nervous system
The somatic nervous system
The cerebral cortex
The skeletal nervous system
explanation: The autonomic nervous system controls automatic functions like heart rate, breathing, and digestion without conscious thought.
fact_tl: Ang autonomic nervous system ay ang bahagi ng nervous system na kontrolado ang mga awtomatikong pag-andar tulad ng tibok ng puso, paghinga, at digestion nang hindi natin sinasadya.
fact_bis: Ang autonomic nervous system nagkontrol sa mga awtomatikong pag-andar sama sa tibok sa puso, paghinga, ug digestyon nga wala'y pag-isip, ug adunay duha ka estado: fight-or-flight ug pahinga.

q: What kind of zone is Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park, where all fishing is banned?
options: A strict no-take zone enforced by park wardens and the Philippine Coast Guard
A seasonal fishing zone open to local fishers during summer months
A protected area where only sport fishing with permits is allowed
A marine sanctuary open to commercial fishing during non-breeding seasons
explanation: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park is a strict no-take zone where all commercial and sport fishing is banned, enforced by park wardens and the Philippine Coast Guard.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park ay isang mahigpit na no-take zone kung saan ipinagbabawal ang lahat ng komersyal at sportfishing — ang mga park warden at Philippine Coast Guard ay nagbabantay upang maipatupad ang mga regulasyon.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park usa ka mahigpit nga no-take zone diin ang tanan nga komersyal ug sport fishing gidili — ang mga park warden ug Philippine Coast Guard nagpatuman sa mga regulasyon.

q: Can concrete harden even when it is submerged underwater?
options: Yes, because water actually drives the hardening process of concrete
No, because water washes away the cement before it can set
No, because concrete needs air to dry out completely
Yes, but only if special waterproof chemicals are added first
explanation: Water drives the hardening of concrete, which is why it can set even underwater, such as in the foundations of bridges.
fact_tl: Dahil reaksyon sa tubig ang nagpapatigas dito, kaya tumigas ng konkreto kahit nasa ilalim ng tubig, gaya sa mga pundasyon ng tulay.
fact_bis: Tungod kay reaksyon sa tubig ang nagpagahi, ang konkreto mogahi bisan ilalom sa tubig, sama sa pundasyon sa mga tulay.

q: Roughly how fast does sound travel through air?
options: About 340 meters per second
About 3,000 meters per second
About 3,400 meters per second
About 34 meters per second
explanation: Sound travels through air at about 340 meters per second, which means it covers almost a third of a kilometer in one second.
fact_tl: Isang totoong halimbawa ang bilis ng tunog sa hangin mga 340 metro kada segundo. Ibig sabihin sa isang segundo, naglalakbay ang tunog ng halos isang katlo ng kilometro. Kaya parang mabagal ito kumpara sa liwanag.
fact_bis: Usa ka tinuod nga ehemplo mao ang kapaspas sa tingog sa hangin mga 340 metro kada segundo. Buot pasabot sa usa ka segundo, ang tingog mubiyahe ug halos un-tersiya sa kilometro. Busa morag hinay ni kumpara sa kahayag.

q: How is dengue fever spread in the Philippines?
options: Through mosquito bites
Through drinking contaminated water
Through touching an infected person's skin
Through eating undercooked fish or meat
explanation: In the Philippines, dengue is spread by mosquito bites and can become serious, especially if there is bruising or bleeding.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, isa sa mga sakit na may lagnat ang dengue, na galing sa kagat ng lamok. Mahalaga ang pahinga at maraming tubig, pero dapat ding bantayan ng matanda dahil pwedeng lumala ang dengue. Kapag may pasa o pagdurugo, agad pumunta sa health center.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, usa sa mga sakit nga naay hilanat ang dengue, nga gikan sa pinaak sa lamok. Importante ang pahulay ug daghang tubig, apan kinahanglan sab bantayan sa hamtong kay mahimong mosamot ang dengue. Kung naay pangit o pagdugo, dayon adto sa health center.

q: How can you tell a termite apart from an ant by looking at its body?
options: Termites are usually paler with a straight body, while ants are often darker with a narrow waist in the middle
Termites have six legs and ants have eight legs
Termites have wings always, while ants never have wings
Termites are much larger than ants and have bigger heads
explanation: Termites are usually paler in color with a straight body, while ants are often darker and have a narrow waist in the middle.
fact_tl: Kahit magkamukha sa unang tingin, ang anay ay HINDI langgam. Karaniwang mas maputi o mahinang kulay ang anay at tuwid ang katawan, samantalang ang langgam ay madalas mas maitim at may makitid na baywang sa gitna.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag managsama sa unang tan-aw, ang anay DILI hulmigas. Kasagaran mas maputi o luspad ang kolor sa anay ug tul-id ang lawas, samtang ang hulmigas kasagaran mas itom ug adunay sigpit nga 'hawak' sa tunga.

q: What do calamansi flowers look like before the fruit appears?
options: Small, fragrant white flowers
Large, bright yellow flowers
Tiny pink flowers with no smell
Purple bell-shaped flowers
explanation: Before it bears fruit, the calamansi tree blooms small, fragrant white flowers.
fact_tl: Bago mamunga, ang puno ng kalamansi ay namumulaklak ng maliliit at mababangong puting bulaklak.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mamunga, ang kahoy sa kalamansi mamulak og gagmay ug humot nga puti nga mga bulak.

q: At what time of day is your shadow the shortest, and why?
options: At noon, because the Sun is highest in the sky
At sunrise, because the Sun is just appearing on the horizon
At sunset, because the Sun's rays are at their strongest
At midnight, because the Earth is closest to the Sun
explanation: A shadow is shortest at noon because that is when the Sun is highest in the sky, making the shadow fall almost directly below you.
fact_tl: Nagbabago ang haba at direksyon ng anino sa buong araw dahil gumagalaw ang posisyon ng Araw sa langit, at pinakamaikli ang anino tuwing tanghali kapag pinakamataas ang Araw.
fact_bis: Mausab ang gitas-on ug direksyon sa anino sa tibuok adlaw tungod kay molihok ang posisyon sa Adlaw sa langit, ug pinakamubo ang anino sa udto kung pinakahabog ang Adlaw.

q: What is the second most abundant element found in Earth's crust?
options: Silicon
Iron
Aluminum
Carbon
explanation: The second most abundant element in Earth's crust is silicon.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang pinakamaraming elemento sa balat ng lupa ay silicon (silikon).
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang labing daghan nga elemento sa panit sa yuta mao ang silicon (silikon).

q: What is the name of the most well-known mangrove tree in the Philippines, recognized by its tall arching roots?
options: Bakauan (Rhizophora)
Bungalon
Pagatpat
Nipa
explanation: In the Philippines, the best-known mangrove is the true bakauan (Rhizophora), recognized by its tall arching roots.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang pinakakilalang bakawan ay ang tunay na 'bakauan' (Rhizophora) na may matataas na ugat na nakaarko. May iba pang uri tulad ng bungalon at pagatpat na tumutubo rin sa maalat na tubig sa iba't ibang bahagi ng baybayin.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang labing inila nga bakhaw mao ang tinuod nga 'bakauan' (Rhizophora) nga may tag-as nga gamot nga nag-arko. Adunay laing matang sama sa bungalon ug pagatpat nga motubo usab sa parat nga tubig sa nagkalainlaing bahin sa baybayon.

q: What type of energy is stored in a stretched rubber band of a slingshot?
options: Elastic potential energy
Kinetic energy
Chemical energy
Gravitational potential energy
explanation: A stretched or squeezed object like a slingshot's rubber band stores elastic potential energy, which is released when the rubber band is let go.
fact_tl: May elastikong potensyal na enerhiya ang isang bagay na nakaunat o nakapit, gaya ng goma ng tirador o nakapis na spring, at lumalabas ito kapag binitawan.
fact_bis: Adunay elastikong potential energy ang usa ka butang nga gibira o gipiit, sama sa goma sa tirador o usa ka napiit nga spring, ug mogawas kini kon buhian.

q: Why is glass transparent and does it have a regular crystal structure like most solids?
options: Glass is transparent because its atoms are arranged randomly, not in a regular crystal pattern
Glass is transparent because its atoms are arranged in a perfect crystal grid that lets light pass through
Glass has a regular crystal structure that bends light to make it see-through
Glass is transparent because it has no atoms on its surface to block light
explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid with randomly arranged atoms rather than a regular crystal pattern, which is why it is transparent and shatters easily.
fact_tl: Ang salamin ay hindi crystal — ang mga atom nito ay nakaayos nang random (amorphous) hindi sa isang regular na pattern, kaya ito ay transparent at madaling mag-spall.
fact_bis: Ang salamin usa ka amorphous solid: ang mga atom niini nakabutang sa random, dili sa regular nga pattern sa crystal, mao nga transparent kini ug dali mapukas.

q: What happens to a person who has hemophilia when they get a small cut?
options: Even a small cut can bleed for a long time because their blood lacks an ingredient needed to clot
The cut heals much faster than normal because their blood is thinner
The person feels no pain from cuts because their nerves are also affected
Their blood clots too quickly, blocking the wound before it can be cleaned
explanation: People with hemophilia lack one of the ingredients needed for blood to clot, so even a small cut can bleed for a long time.
fact_tl: May ilang tao na may kondisyong tinatawag na hemophilia kung saan kulang sila sa isang sangkap na kailangan para mamuo ang dugo. Kaya't kahit maliit na sugat ay matagal tumigil ang pagdurugo nila.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga adunay kondisyon nga gitawag og hemophilia diin kulang sila sa usa ka sangkap nga gikinahanglan aron mamuo ang dugo. Busa bisan gamay nga samad mahimong dugay mohunong ang ilang pagdugo.

q: Why does your body slide forward when a car stops suddenly?
options: Because of inertia, your body keeps moving forward even though the car has stopped
Because the car seat pushes you forward when the brakes are applied
Because gravity pulls you toward the front of the car during braking
Because friction between you and the seat launches you forward
explanation: When a car stops suddenly, inertia keeps your body moving forward, which is why a seatbelt is needed to hold you back.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang huminto ang sasakyan, nagpapatuloy sa pagsulong ang katawan dahil sa inersya, kaya kailangan ang seatbelt para pigilan ito.
fact_bis: Kung kalit nga mohunong ang sakyanan, magpadayon sa pag-abante ang imong lawas tungod sa inertia, busa kinahanglan ang seatbelt aron pugngan ka.

q: What keeps your hair and scalp from becoming too dry?
options: Tiny glands next to each hair follicle that produce natural oil to coat the hair and scalp
Sweat glands that release moisture onto the scalp throughout the day
Blood vessels near the scalp that supply extra water to the hair roots
Keratin proteins inside the hair shaft that hold in moisture
explanation: Tiny glands next to each hair follicle make natural oil that coats the hair and scalp to prevent drying out and helps make hair look shiny.
fact_tl: Sa tabi ng bawat follicle ng buhok ay may maliliit na glandula na gumagawa ng natural na langis. Ang langis na ito ay nagbabalot sa iyong buhok at anit para hindi ito masyadong matuyo at para maging makinang ang buhok.
fact_bis: Tapad sa matag follicle sa buhok adunay gagmay nga glandula nga naghimo og natural nga lana. Kini nga lana motabon sa imong buhok ug anit aron dili kini mauga kaayo, ug makatabang aron mosinaw ang imong buhok.

q: When you look at a distant star through a telescope, are you seeing what it looks like right now?
options: No, because the light took many years to travel to us, so we see how the star looked in the past
Yes, because telescopes use special lenses that show the star's current state
No, because telescopes only show computer images, not real-time starlight
Yes, because light travels instantly between stars and Earth
explanation: Light from distant stars takes many years to reach a telescope, so what we see is how the star looked in the past, not right now.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng malalayong bituin ay umaabot ng maraming taon bago tumama sa teleskopyo, kaya ang nakikita natin ay kung ano ang anyo ng bituin noong nakaraan, hindi ngayon.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag sa layo nga mga bituon mokabot og daghang tuig una kini makaabot sa teleskopyo, mao nga ang atong makita mao ang hitsura sa bituon kaniadto, dili karon.

q: Where is the Bohol Sea (also called the Mindanao Sea) located?
options: Between Bohol and northern Mindanao
Between Leyte and the island of Cebu
Between Palawan and the Sulu Archipelago
Between Luzon and the Visayas region
explanation: The Bohol Sea, also called the Mindanao Sea, lies between Bohol and northern Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Dagat Bohol (Bohol Sea), na tinatawag ding Dagat Mindanao, ay nasa pagitan ng Bohol at hilagang Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang Dagat Bohol (Bohol Sea), nga gitawag usab nga Dagat Mindanao, anaa tunga-tunga sa Bohol ug amihanang Mindanao.

q: How far away is the Andromeda Galaxy from our own galaxy?
options: About 2.5 million light-years away
About 2.5 thousand light-years away
About 250 million light-years away
About 25 billion light-years away
explanation: The Andromeda Galaxy is about 2.5 million light-years away from us.
fact_tl: Ang Andromeda Galaxy ay nasa layong humigit-kumulang 2.5 milyong taon-liwanag mula sa atin.
fact_bis: Ang Andromeda Galaxy mga 2.5 ka milyon nga tuig-kahayag ang gilay-on gikan kanato.

q: How does the tamaraw stay hidden from other animals in the forest?
options: It is a quiet animal that does not make much noise, which helps it stay hidden while alone
It changes the color of its skin to blend in with the trees around it
It digs underground burrows where it hides during the day
It releases a smell that drives away predators before they can spot it
explanation: The tamaraw is a quiet animal that does not make much noise, which helps it stay hidden while it is alone in the forest.
fact_tl: Ang tamaraw ay tahimik na hayop na hindi maingay, na tumutulong dito para manatiling tago habang ito ay nag-iisa sa gubat.
fact_bis: Ang tamaraw usa ka hilom nga hayop nga dili saba, nga makatabang niini nga magpabiling tago samtang nag-inusara kini sa lasang.

q: Why can rubber be stretched and then return to its original shape?
options: Because rubber is made of long, coiled molecule chains that uncoil when pulled and recoil when released
Because rubber contains water molecules that expand when pulled and contract again
Because rubber is made of flat layers of atoms that slide and then snap back into place
Because the air pockets inside rubber absorb the stretching force and push back
explanation: Rubber is made of long, coiled molecule chains that uncoil when pulled and recoil when released, giving rubber its stretchy property.
fact_tl: Ang goma ay gawa sa mahahaba at nakakulot na kadena ng molekula na umuunat kapag hinila at bumabalik kapag binitawan.
fact_bis: Ang goma hinimo sa tag-as ug kulot nga kadena sa molekula nga mounat kon birahon ug mobalik kon buhian.

q: How does the pitch of a bat's echolocation call change as the bat sends it out?
options: The pitch sweeps from high down to low very quickly, like a sliding sound
The pitch stays at one steady high tone so the bat can hear echoes clearly
The pitch starts low and rises to a high shriek to scare away insects
The pitch alternates between high and low tones in a repeating pattern
explanation: Many bats' calls sweep from a high pitch down to a low pitch in an instant, and this sliding pitch helps the bat capture clearer detail about objects in front of it.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ng maraming paniki ay hindi iisang tono lang—dumadausdos ito mula mataas papuntang mababang tono sa loob ng isang iglap, parang mabilis na 'chiieew.' Ang ganitong paggalaw ng tono ay tumutulong na mas malinaw nilang makuha ang detalye ng bagay sa harap nila.
fact_bis: Ang tingog sa daghang kabog dili usa ra ka tono—mosaka-naog kini gikan sa habog ngadto sa ubos nga tono sulod sa usa ka pisok, sama sa paspas nga 'chiieew.' Kini nga paglihok sa tono motabang sa kabog nga mas klaro nga makuha ang detalye sa butang sa iyang atubangan.

q: What can flowing water do because it has force?
options: It can push and turn things like a water wheel
It can generate sound waves that power machines
It can create magnetic fields that attract metal
It can produce light energy to brighten dark areas
explanation: Flowing water has force that can push things, like the way it can turn a water wheel.
fact_tl: Ang umaagos na tubig ay may lakas na kayang magtulak ng mga bagay, gaya ng pag-ikot nito sa isang gulong ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang nagdagan nga tubig adunay kusog nga makaduso og mga butang, sama sa pagpalibot niini og usa ka ligid sa tubig.

q: Why do you feel hungry or weak after shivering in the cold for a long time?
options: Because shivering uses energy from food to produce body heat, spending the body's fuel
Because shivering stops blood from reaching the stomach, causing hunger feelings
Because cold air enters the body and removes the nutrients stored in muscles
Because the immune system uses all available energy to fight the cold temperature
explanation: Shivering uses energy from the food you have eaten to make heat, so shivering for a long time drains the body's fuel and makes you hungry or weak.
fact_tl: Ang panginginig ay gumagamit ng enerhiya mula sa pagkaing kinain mo. Kaya kapag matagal kang nilalamig at nanginginig, mas mabilis kang magutom o manghina — ginagastos ng katawan ang 'gas' nito para gumawa ng init.
fact_bis: Ang pagkurog mogamit og enerhiya gikan sa pagkaon nga imong gikaon. Mao nga kon dugay kang gitugnaw ug nagkurog, mas paspas kang gutmon o maluya — gigasto sa lawas ang 'gasolina' niini aron maghimog kainit.

q: What is the Philippine Eagle's large, strong hooked beak used for?
options: Catching and eating small animals
Cracking open hard seeds and nuts
Digging burrows in the ground
Filtering small fish from river water
explanation: The Philippine Eagle has a large, strong hooked beak for catching and eating small animals.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Eagle ay may malaki at malakas na nakakawit na tuka para manghuli at kumain ng maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Eagle adunay dako ug kusgan nga baliko nga sungo aron makadakop ug makakaon og gagmay nga mga hayop.

q: At what temperature does water boil on the Fahrenheit scale?
options: 212 degrees Fahrenheit
100 degrees Fahrenheit
32 degrees Fahrenheit
180 degrees Fahrenheit
explanation: On the Fahrenheit scale, water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit, which is equal to 100 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Sa Fahrenheit scale, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F), katumbas ng 100°C.
fact_bis: Sa Fahrenheit scale, ang tubig magbukal sa 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F), katumbas sa 100°C.

q: Which mountain is the tallest when measured from its base on the ocean floor all the way to its peak?
options: Mauna Kea in Hawaii, at almost 10,000 meters
Mount Everest in the Himalayas, at about 8,849 meters
Mount Kilimanjaro in Africa, at about 5,895 meters
Mount Apo in the Philippines, at about 2,954 meters
explanation: Measured from its base on the ocean floor to its peak, Mauna Kea in Hawaii is the tallest mountain at almost 10,000 meters.
fact_tl: Kung susukatin mula sa base sa ilalim ng dagat hanggang tuktok, ang Mauna Kea sa Hawaii ang pinakamataas na bundok, na halos 10,000 metro.
fact_bis: Kung sukdon gikan sa base sa salog sa dagat hangtod sa tumoy, ang Mauna Kea sa Hawaii mao ang pinakahabog nga bukid, nga halos 10,000 ka metro.

q: What kind of underground rock structure allows petroleum to collect and not escape?
options: A dome-shaped rock (anticline) with an impermeable cap rock above it
A flat layer of porous rock that soaks up oil like a sponge
A deep vertical crack in the Earth that traps oil at the bottom
A bowl-shaped valley of rock surrounded by harder stone walls
explanation: Petroleum accumulates in underground traps, usually dome-shaped rock structures called anticlines with an impermeable cap rock above to prevent the oil from escaping.
fact_tl: Ang petroleum ay naipon sa mga 'traps' sa ilalim ng lupa: karaniwang anticline (dome shape na bato) na may hindi matagusan na cap rock sa ibabaw upang hindi makatakas ang langis; ang Malampaya natural gas field sa Palawan ay isa sa mga halimbawa nito sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang petroleum nagtipon sa underground nga 'traps': kasagaran mga anticline (hugis-dome nga bato) nga adunay dili matagusan nga cap rock sa ibabaw aron dili makalingkawas ang langis; ang Malampaya natural gas field sa Palawan mao ang usa ka halimbawa sa Pilipinas.

q: How does a generator produce electricity?
options: By turning a magnet near coils of wire, which changes the mechanical energy of a spinning turbine into electrical energy
By heating water into steam that flows directly through copper wires to produce current
By using chemical reactions between two metals to push electrons through a circuit
By storing energy from sunlight in magnetic coils that release it as electricity at night
explanation: A generator changes the mechanical energy of a spinning turbine into electrical energy by turning a magnet near coils of wire.
fact_tl: Ang generator ay nagbabago ng mechanical energy ng umiikot na turbine tungong electrical energy sa pamamagitan ng pagpapaikot ng magnet malapit sa mga kawad.
fact_bis: Ang generator magbalhin sa mechanical energy sa nagtuyok nga turbine ngadto sa electrical energy pinaagi sa pagtuyok sa magnet duol sa mga koil sa alambre.

q: What does the number of watts on an appliance tell you?
options: How much electricity the appliance uses at each moment
How long the appliance can run before needing to be replaced
How many volts of electricity the appliance needs to start up
How much heat the appliance produces per hour when running
explanation: The number of watts on an appliance shows how much electricity it uses at each moment, indicating its power consumption.
fact_tl: Ang bilang ng watts sa isang aparato ay nagpapakita kung gaano karaming kuryente ang ginagamit nito kada sandali.
fact_bis: Ang gidaghanon sa watts sa usa ka aparato magpakita kung pila ka koryente ang gigamit niini sa matag higayon.

q: How do the broad wings and light feathers of the Brahminy kite help this bird?
options: They help the bird fly and glide easily on air currents
They help the bird swim underwater when fishing near the surface
They make the bird heavier so it can dive faster toward prey
They keep the bird warm in cold mountain environments
explanation: The Brahminy kite's broad wings and light feathers help it fly and glide easily on the air.
fact_tl: Ang malalapad na pakpak at magaan na balahibo ng lawin ay tumutulong dito na lumipad at lumutang nang madali sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang lapad nga mga pako ug gaan nga balahibo sa lawin makatabang niini sa paglupad ug paglutaw dayon sa hangin.

q: What does the principle of uniformitarianism say about how the Earth has changed over time?
options: The same slow processes we see today, like erosion and sedimentation, have shaped the Earth over very long spans of time
The Earth was shaped mostly by sudden catastrophic events that no longer occur today
Different physical laws applied in the ancient past, making Earth change faster than it does now
The Earth's shape is determined mainly by forces from space, like meteor impacts and solar wind
explanation: In the principle of uniformitarianism, the same slow processes we see today such as erosion and sedimentation have shaped the Earth over very long spans of time.
fact_tl: Sa prinsipyong uniformitarianism na pinasikat ni Charles Lyell, ang parehong mabagal na prosesong nakikita ngayon (gaya ng erosion at sedimentation) ang nagbago sa Earth sa loob ng napakahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Sa prinsipyong uniformitarianism nga gipasikat ni Charles Lyell, ang mao ra nga hinay nga proseso nga atong makita karon (sama sa erosion ug sedimentation) ang nag-usab sa Yuta sulod sa taas kaayo nga panahon.

q: What is the main job of the spinal cord?
options: To connect the brain to the body by carrying messages along a thick bundle of nerves inside the backbone
To pump blood from the heart to the muscles of the arms and legs
To filter waste products from the blood before they reach the brain
To produce the hormones that control growth and body temperature
explanation: The spinal cord is a thick bundle of nerves inside the backbone that connects the brain to the body, and messages travel along it to and from the brain.
fact_tl: Ang spinal cord ay makapal na bigkis ng nerves sa loob ng gulugod na nag-uugnay sa utak at sa katawan. Dumadaan dito ang mga mensahe papunta at pabalik sa utak, kaya iniingatan ito ng buto ng gulugod.
fact_bis: Ang spinal cord usa ka baga nga bundle sa nerves sulod sa gulugod nga nagdugtong sa utok ngadto sa lawas. Moagi dinhi ang mga mensahe paingon ug pabalik sa utok, mao nga gipanalipdan kini sa mga bukog sa gulugod.

q: What happens to honey when it is placed in a liquid density column with water and oil?
options: Honey sinks to the bottom because it is a very dense liquid
Honey floats to the top because it is thick and sticky
Honey stays in the middle layer between water and oil
Honey mixes with water and disappears into the lower layer
explanation: Honey is a very dense liquid, so it sinks to the bottom of a density column.
fact_tl: Ang pulot ay napakabigat na likido kaya't lumulubog ito sa ilalim ng isang density column.
fact_bis: Ang dugos kay bug-at kaayo nga likido, busa mounlod kini sa ubos sa usa ka density column.

q: How can newborn babies be protected from deadly newborn tetanus?
options: By vaccinating their pregnant mothers against tetanus before the birth
By giving the newborn an antibiotic injection right after delivery
By keeping the delivery room completely sterile and germ-free
By washing the newborn immediately after birth with antiseptic soap
explanation: Vaccinating pregnant mothers against tetanus protects newborn babies from deadly newborn tetanus.
fact_tl: Ang pagbabakuna ng mga buntis laban sa tetano ay nagprotekta sa mga sanggol mula sa nakamamatay na tetano ng bagong panganak.
fact_bis: Ang pagbakuna sa mga mabdos batok sa titano nagpanalipod sa mga bag-ong natawo nga bata gikan sa makamatay nga titano sa bag-ong natawo.

q: How does soap actually destroy viruses and bacteria on your hands?
options: Soap breaks apart the outer fatty coat of many viruses and bacteria so they fall apart, then water rinses them away
Soap kills germs by making the skin too acidic for viruses and bacteria to survive
Soap coats the germs in a sticky film that prevents them from entering the body through cuts
Soap heats up slightly when mixed with water, and the warmth kills the germs on your skin
explanation: Soap breaks apart the outer fatty coat of many viruses and bacteria so they fall apart, and then water rinses the broken germs off your hands.
fact_tl: Hindi lang basta nagdidikit ang sabon sa germs — sinisira nito ang panlabas na balot na taba ng maraming virus at bakterya, kaya nadudurog ang mga ito. Pagkatapos, hinihila ng tubig ang basag na germs palayo sa kamay. Kaya kailangan kuskusin ang kamay nang mga 20 segundo para magbigay ng oras sa sabon.
fact_bis: Dili lang basta motapot ang sabon sa germs — gub-on niini ang gawas nga tabon nga tambok sa daghang virus ug bacteria, mao nga magkagubot kini. Unya banlasan sa tubig ang naguba nga germs gikan sa imong kamot. Mao nga kinahanglang kuskoson ang kamot og mga 20 ka segundo aron hatagan og panahon ang sabon.

q: Why does a polar bear's fur look white even though each individual hair is actually colorless and clear?
options: Because the colorless hairs scatter light, making the fur appear white
Because a clear hair reflects the white color of the snow below it
Because the skin underneath is white and shows through the clear hairs
Because the hairs are coated with a white pigment that washes off in water
explanation: Each hair of a polar bear's fur is colorless and clear, but the fur appears white because the hairs scatter light.
fact_tl: Mukhang puti ang polar bear at tumutugma sa niyebe, ngunit ang bawat hibla ng balahibo nito ay walang kulay at parang malinaw — nagmumukha lang itong puti dahil naikakalat ng buhok ang liwanag.
fact_bis: Mura og puti ang polar bear ug motakdo sa niyebe, apan ang matag lugas sa balhibo niini walay kolor ug morag klaro — mura lang kini og puti tungod kay ang buhok magsabwag sa kahayag.

q: Why must broken glass be handled very carefully?
options: Because breaking glass creates sharp edges that can cut you
Because broken glass pieces are much heavier than they look and can crush your fingers
Because glass pieces give off harmful fumes when they break apart
Because the inside of glass is rough and covered in tiny splinters
explanation: When glass breaks, it forms sharp edges that can cut you, so broken glass must be handled carefully.
fact_tl: Kapag nabasag ang bubog, nagkakaroon ito ng matatalas na gilid na maaaring makasugat, kaya dapat itong ingatan.
fact_bis: Kon mabuak ang bildo, magbaton kini og mahait nga ngilit nga makasamad, mao nga angay kining bantayan.

q: What is the tallest mountain in the world when measured above sea level?
options: Mount Everest, standing about 8,849 meters above sea level
Mount Kilimanjaro, standing about 5,895 meters above sea level
Mauna Kea, standing about 4,205 meters above sea level
Mount Apo, standing about 2,954 meters above sea level
explanation: The tallest mountain in the world is Mount Everest, standing about 8,849 meters above sea level.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamataas na bundok sa mundo ay ang Mount Everest, na may taas na mga 8,849 metro mula sa lebel ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang pinakataas nga bukid sa kalibotan mao ang Mount Everest, nga mga 8,849 ka metro ang gitas-on gikan sa lebel sa dagat.

q: What is the national fish of the Philippines?
options: The milkfish, called bangus
The tilapia, called tilapya
The grouper, called lapu-lapu
The tuna, called tambakol
explanation: The milkfish, called bangus, is regarded as the national fish of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang bangus ang itinuturing na pambansang isda ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang bangus mao ang giila nga nasodnong isda sa Pilipinas.

q: Why is pure gold usually mixed with other metals when used for jewelry?
options: Because pure gold is so soft you can bend it with your hands, and mixing it with other metals makes it harder
Because pure gold is too heavy and mixing it reduces the weight of the jewelry
Because pure gold is too shiny and mixing it gives the jewelry a more attractive color
Because pure gold dissolves in water and mixing it prevents jewelry from getting damaged
explanation: Pure gold is so soft it can be bent with your hands, so it is mixed with other metals to make it harder for use in jewelry.
fact_tl: Ang purong ginto ay napakalambot na pwede itong baluktutin ng kamay, kaya hinahaluan ito ng ibang metal para tumigas.
fact_bis: Ang lunsay nga bulawan humok kaayo nga mabaluktot nimo sa kamot, mao nga gisagolan kini ug ubang metal aron mugahi.

q: What role does the Oncomelania quadrasi snail play in the life cycle of the schistosomiasis parasite?
options: The parasite grows inside the snail before it can infect a person
The snail eats the parasite and prevents it from spreading to humans
The snail carries the parasite directly through its bite when it attacks people
The snail is the final host where the parasite lays its eggs permanently
explanation: The schistosomiasis parasite needs the small Oncomelania quadrasi snail to grow inside before it can infect a person.
fact_tl: Ang parasito ay nangangailangan ng napakaliit na suso na tinatawag na Oncomelania quadrasi upang lumaki bago ito makaapekto sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang parasito nagkinahanglan og gamay kaayo nga suso nga gitawag og Oncomelania quadrasi aron motubo una kini makahawa sa tawo.

q: On the pH scale, how do lemon juice and soapy water compare?
options: Lemon juice is very acidic (around pH 2) while soapy water is basic (around pH 9 or higher)
Lemon juice is basic (around pH 9) while soapy water is acidic (around pH 2)
Both lemon juice and soapy water are acidic, but lemon juice is more acidic
Both lemon juice and soapy water are neutral (pH 7), just on opposite sides
explanation: On the pH scale, lemon juice is very acidic at around pH 2, while soapy water is basic at around pH 9 or higher.
fact_tl: Sa pH scale, ang katas ng limon ay napakaasido (mga pH 2), habang ang tubig na may sabon ay base (mga pH 9 pataas).
fact_bis: Sa pH scale, ang duga sa limon kaayo asido (mga pH 2), samtang ang tubig nga may sabon base (mga pH 9 pataas).

q: What happens when you put iodine on a leaf that has been making food through photosynthesis?
options: The leaf turns blue-black because iodine reacts with the starch the leaf produced
The leaf turns bright green because iodine reacts with the chlorophyll inside it
The leaf turns red because iodine burns the sugar stored in the leaf cells
The leaf does not change color because photosynthesis breaks down iodine
explanation: When iodine is dropped on a leaf and it turns blue-black, it shows the leaf contains starch, which is proof that the leaf made food through photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Kapag tinapatan ng yodo ang isang dahon at ito ay naging asul-itim, ibig sabihin may almirol (starch) dito—isang patunay na gumawa ng pagkain ang dahon sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Kon tagayan og yodo ang usa ka dahon ug kini mahimong asul-itom, nagpasabot nga adunay almidor (starch) niini—usa ka pamatuod nga ang dahon naghimo og pagkaon pinaagi sa potosintesis.

q: In the Northern Hemisphere, which date has the shortest day and the longest night?
options: Around December 21, the December solstice
Around June 21, the June solstice
Around March 21, the spring equinox
Around September 21, the fall equinox
explanation: The December solstice (around December 21) gives the Northern Hemisphere its shortest day and longest night of the year.
fact_tl: Sa Northern Hemisphere, ang December solstice (mga Disyembre 21) ang may pinakamaikling araw at pinakamahabang gabi.
fact_bis: Sa Northern Hemisphere, ang December solstice (mga Disyembre 21) maoy adunay kinamub-ang adlaw ug kinatas-ang gabii.

q: What can chromatography tell you about a color, like the green in a marker?
options: Whether the color is a single pure pigment or a blend of several pigments
Whether the color will fade in sunlight or stay bright
How hot the color was when it was made
Whether the color dissolves in water or oil
explanation: Chromatography separates pigments to show if a color is one pure substance or a mixture of many pigments.
fact_tl: Ipinapakita ng chromatography kung ang isang kulay ay purong sangkap o halo ng maraming pigment.
fact_bis: Ipakita sa chromatography kung ang usa ka kolor lunsay nga sangkap o sagol sa daghang pigment.

q: How far is our solar system from the center of the Milky Way galaxy?
options: About 26,000 light-years from the center
About 1,000 light-years from the center
About 100,000 light-years from the center
About 500 light-years from the center
explanation: Our solar system sits in a spiral arm about 26,000 light-years from the center of the Milky Way.
fact_tl: Ang disk ng Milky Way ay humigit-kumulang 100,000 light-years ang lapad ngunit humigit-kumulang 1,000 light-years lamang ang kapal sa karamihan ng bahagi nito — ito ay katulad ng isang CD na malaking ang diameter ngunit napakamipis. Ang ating solar system ay matatagpuan sa isang spiral arm mga 26,000 light-years mula sa sentro.
fact_bis: Ang disk sa Milky Way mga 100,000 light-years ang gilapdon apan mga 1,000 light-years lamang ang nipis sa kadaghanan sa iyang mga lugar — sama sa usa ka labi ka nipis nga CD nga dako ang diameter. Ang atong solar system anaa sa usa ka spiral arm mga 26,000 light-years gikan sa sentro.

q: At what age can a Filipino citizen vote in elections?
options: 18 years old and above
21 years old and above
15 years old and above
16 years old and above
explanation: The voting age in the Philippines is 18 years old and above.
fact_tl: Ang edad para makaboto sa Pilipinas ay 18 taong gulang pataas.
fact_bis: Ang edad para makaboto sa Pilipinas kay 18 ka tuig pataas.

q: In a monohybrid cross, how many traits do scientists focus on at one time?
options: One single trait
Two different traits
Three traits at once
All the traits of the organism
explanation: A monohybrid cross studies how just one single trait is inherited, with the dominant trait masking the recessive one.
fact_tl: Sa monohybrid cross, pinag-aaralan kung paano namamana ang isang katangian, kung saan natatakpan ng dominanteng katangian ang recessive sa mga supling.
fact_bis: Sa monohybrid cross, gitun-an kung giunsa pagpanunod ang usa ka kinaiya, diin ang dominante nga kinaiya motabon sa recessive sa mga anak.

q: What happens to cement when you mix it with water?
options: It becomes a sticky paste that holds sand and gravel together
It turns into a hard solid instantly without any paste stage
It dissolves completely and disappears into the water
It floats on top of the water and does not mix
explanation: When mixed with water, cement becomes a sticky paste that coats and glues sand and gravel together.
fact_tl: Kapag hinaluan ng tubig, ang semento ay nagiging malagkit na pandikit na bumabalot at nagdurugtong sa buhangin at graba.
fact_bis: Kon sagolan ug tubig, ang semento mahimong pilit nga nagputos ug nagsumpay sa balas ug graba.

q: In a simple circuit with a battery and a light bulb, what energy changes happen?
options: Chemical energy in the battery becomes electrical energy, then light and heat in the bulb
Electrical energy from the wall becomes chemical energy stored in the bulb
Light energy enters the battery and turns into chemical energy
Heat from the bulb flows back into the battery to recharge it
explanation: In a circuit, the battery's chemical energy becomes electrical energy, which the bulb converts into light and heat.
fact_tl: Sa isang circuit, nagbabago ang anyo ng enerhiya: ang kemikal na enerhiya sa baterya ay nagiging elektrikal na enerhiya, at sa bombilya ito ay nagiging ilaw at init.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka circuit, mausab ang porma sa enerhiya: ang kemikal nga enerhiya sa baterya mahimong elektrikal nga enerhiya, ug sa bombilya kini mahimong kahayag ug kainit.

q: What is special about the shape of a solid object?
options: A solid keeps its own shape no matter what container it is placed in
A solid takes the shape of whichever container it is poured into
A solid expands to fill all the space around it
A solid has no definite shape and changes easily
explanation: A solid keeps its own shape whether placed in a big box or a small bag, unlike liquids or gases.
fact_tl: Ang isang solido ay pinapanatili ang sariling hugis kahit saan mo ito ilagay. Ang isang bato ay mananatiling hugis-bato kahit ilagay mo sa isang malaking kahon o maliit na bag.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka solido nagpabilin sa kaugalingong hugis bisan asa kini ibutang. Ang usa ka bato nagpabilin nga hugis-bato bisan ibutang sa dakong kahon o gamayng bag.

q: Why is it hard to lift a heavy rock off the ground?
options: Gravity pulls the rock downward strongly and your muscles must overcome that pull
The rock is stuck to the ground by a magnetic force from the earth
Air pressure pushes down on the rock and makes it heavier
Friction between the rock and the air holds the rock in place
explanation: Gravity pulls heavy objects downward, so you must use your muscles to overcome gravity's pull to lift them up.
fact_tl: Mahirap buhatin ang mabigat na bagay dahil malakas na hinihila ito ng gravity pababa. Kailangan mong gumamit ng lakas ng iyong katawan para talunin ang hila ng gravity at maitaas ang bagay.
fact_bis: Lisod alsahon ang bug-at nga butang kay kusog kini birahon sa gravity paubos. Kinahanglan nimong gamiton ang kusog sa imong lawas aron buntogon ang birahay sa gravity ug mapataas ang butang.

q: Where in the Philippines can you find the butanding, the world's largest fish?
options: In the waters of Donsol, Sorsogon
In the lakes of Mindanao
In the rivers near Manila Bay
In the coral reefs of Palawan only
explanation: The butanding (whale shark), the world's largest fish, is found in the waters of Donsol in Sorsogon and is a major eco-tourism attraction.
fact_tl: Ang butanding (whale shark) ay ang pinakamalaking isda sa mundo at matatagpuan sa tubig ng Donsol sa Sorsogon; ito ay isang malaking atraksyon para sa eco-tourism sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang butanding (whale shark) ang pinakadakling isda sa kalibutan ug makita sa mga tubig sa Donsol sa Sorsogon; usa kini ka dakong atraksyon sa eco-tourism sa Pilipinas.

q: Compared to a single carbon dioxide molecule, how does one methane molecule affect global warming?
options: One methane molecule traps much more heat than one carbon dioxide molecule
One methane molecule and one carbon dioxide molecule trap exactly the same heat
One carbon dioxide molecule traps far more heat than one methane molecule
Methane has no effect on heat trapping at all
explanation: Each methane molecule traps much more heat than a carbon dioxide molecule, though there is far less methane in the air.
fact_tl: Alin ang mas malakas, methane o carbon dioxide? Bawat molekula ng methane ay humuhuli ng mas maraming init kaysa carbon dioxide. Pero mas kaunti ang methane sa hangin at mas mabilis itong nawawala. Kaya pareho silang mahalagang bantayan sa pag-init ng mundo.
fact_bis: Hain ang mas kusog, methane o carbon dioxide? Matag molekula sa methane modakop og mas daghang init kaysa carbon dioxide. Apan mas gamay ang methane sa hangin ug mas paspas kini mawala. Busa silang duha importante bantayan sa pag-init sa kalibotan.

q: Two jeepneys travel toward each other, each at 40 km/h. What speed do they seem to pass each other at?
options: 80 km/h, because their speeds add together
40 km/h, because each jeepney only sees its own speed
20 km/h, because speeds are averaged when going opposite directions
0 km/h, because they cancel each other out
explanation: When two vehicles move toward each other, their relative speed is the sum of both speeds, so 40 + 40 = 80 km/h.
fact_tl: Kapag dalawang jeepney ang magkasalubong na pare-parehong 40 km/h ang bilis, mukhang napakabilis nilang naglalampasan dahil 80 km/h ang relative speed nila sa isa't isa. Pero kung magkasunod silang pare-pareho ang bilis, mukhang halos hindi gumagalaw ang isa kumpara sa isa.
fact_bis: Kung duha ka jeepney ang magtagbo nga parehong 40 km/h ang katulin, daw paspas kaayo sila molabay kay 80 km/h ang ilang relative speed sa usag usa. Apan kung magkuyog sila nga parehas ang katulin, daw halos walay lihok ang usa kumpara sa usa.

q: Why does the body need water to move sugar, salt, and minerals around?
options: Because these substances dissolve in water, letting the body carry them easily
Because water freezes around these substances and keeps them in one place
Because water makes these substances heavier so they sink to where they are needed
Because these substances are already liquid and do not need water to move
explanation: Sugar, salt, and minerals dissolve in water, so the body uses water to transport them wherever they are needed.
fact_tl: Maraming sustansya tulad ng asukal, asin, at minerals ang natutunaw sa tubig, kaya ito madaling madala sa loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Daghang sustansya sama sa asukal, asin, ug minerals ang matunaw sa tubig, mao nga sayon kining madala sulod sa lawas.

q: Why is kamagong wood so prized in the Philippines?
options: It is a dark, dense hardwood called Philippine ebony
It is the lightest wood in the Philippines, perfect for making boats
It grows the fastest of any Philippine tree, so it is easy to harvest
It is bright white and is used to make paper
explanation: Kamagong is valued for its dark, dense wood known as Philippine ebony, though overharvesting has made it endangered.
fact_tl: Ang kamagong (Diospyros philippinensis) ay isang mahalagang kahoy ng Pilipinas na kilala sa madilim, matibay na kahoy nito—kilala bilang Philippine ebony—ngunit ngayon ay itinuturing itong endangered dahil sa sobrang pagputol.
fact_bis: Ang kamagong (Diospyros philippinensis) usa ka mahal nga hardwood sa Pilipinas nga bantog sa ngitngit ug tigas nga kahoy nga gitawag og Philippine ebony; karon giisip kini nga endangered tungod sa sobrang pagputol.

q: Why is it important to drink plenty of water on a very hot day?
options: It helps the body stay cool and avoid heat stroke
It makes the body sweat less so you stay dry
It lowers your body temperature below normal to keep you safe
It thickens your blood so it moves more slowly and cools down
explanation: Drinking plenty of water when it is hot helps the body stay cool and prevents heat stroke.
fact_tl: Mahalagang uminom ng maraming tubig kapag mainit dahil tumutulong ito sa katawan na manatiling malamig at iwasan ang heat stroke.
fact_bis: Importante nga moinom og daghang tubig kung init kay nagtabang kini sa lawas nga magpabiling bugnaw ug malikayan ang heat stroke.

q: How is a broken bone different from a broken rock?
options: Bone is alive and can slowly heal and join back together, unlike rock
Rock is alive and can heal, but bone cannot repair itself
Both bone and rock can heal if you leave them alone long enough
Neither bone nor rock can ever repair itself after breaking
explanation: Because bone is living tissue, the body can slowly mend a broken bone back together, which is why a cast is used to keep it still during healing.
fact_tl: Iba ang buto sa bato — buhay ito, kaya kapag nabali, kaya nitong gumaling at magsanib muli. Karaniwang nilalagyan ng yeso (cast) para hindi gumalaw habang dahan-dahang ipinipili ng katawan ang baling buto sa loob ng ilang linggo.
fact_bis: Lahi ang bukog sa bato — buhi kini, busa kung mabali makaayo kini ug magtapot pag-usab. Kasagaran butangan og cast aron dili molihok samtang hinay-hinay nga ayohon sa lawas ang nabali nga bukog sulod sa pipila ka semana.

q: What is the study of how animals adapt to living in cities called?
options: Urban ecology
Marine biology
Wildlife conservation
Animal taxonomy
explanation: Urban ecology is the study of how animals adapt to city environments, with species like certain birds and rodents thriving while specialists struggle.
fact_tl: Ang urban ecology ay nag-aaral kung paano ang mga hayop ay nagiging angkop sa pamumuhay sa mga lungsod — ang ilang species tulad ng mga ibon at daga ay nag-angkop nang maayos sa mga lungsod, habang ang mga espesyalista ay naiiwan.
fact_bis: Ang urban ecology nagstudy kung giunsa ang mga mananap nag-angkop sa pagpuyo sa mga syudad — ang pipila ka species sama sa pipila ka mga langgam ug mga rodent maayo nga nag-angkop sa lungsod nga kinabuhi, samtang ang mga espesyalista nahabilin.

q: Why does water boil at a lower temperature on top of a high mountain than at sea level?
options: Because air pressure is lower on the mountain, so water boils more easily
Because the air on mountains is colder, which heats water faster
Because there is more oxygen on mountains, which lowers the boiling point
Because sunlight is stronger at high altitude and adds extra heat to the water
explanation: Lower air pressure on high mountains means water needs less heat to boil, so its boiling point drops.
fact_tl: Sa mataas na bundok, kumukulo ang tubig sa mas mababang temperatura dahil mas mababa ang presyon ng hangin.
fact_bis: Sa habog nga bukid, ang tubig magbukal sa mas ubos nga temperatura kay mas ubos ang presyon sa hangin.

q: What does an aneroid barometer use to measure air pressure?
options: A small metal box that squeezes or expands with air pressure
A column of mercury that rises or falls in a glass tube
A spinning fan that speeds up when pressure increases
A paper strip that changes color with air pressure
explanation: An aneroid barometer uses a small flexible metal box that squeezes or expands as air pressure changes, unlike mercury barometers that use a liquid column.
fact_tl: May barometrong gumagamit ng mercury na umaakyat o bumababa sa tubo, at may aneroid na gumagamit ng maliit na kahong metal na umuurong o lumalawak ayon sa presyon ng hangin.
fact_bis: Adunay barometro nga mogamit og mercury nga mosaka o mokunhod sa tubo, ug adunay aneroid nga mogamit og gamay nga kahon nga metal nga mokuyos o molapad sumala sa presyon sa hangin.

q: Why do shrimp farmers measure the water temperature in their ponds with a thermometer?
options: Because water temperature affects how strong or weak the shrimp become
Because thermometers also measure how much food the shrimp are eating
Because water temperature tells them how many shrimp are in the pond
Because shrimp change color when measured with a thermometer
explanation: Shrimp farmers use thermometers because water temperature can strengthen or weaken shrimp, so keeping it right is important for their health.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ng mga magsasaka ng hipon ang init ng tubig gamit ang termometro para masiguradong hindi masyadong mainit o malamig, dahil alam nilang ang init ng tubig ang nagpapalakas o nagpapahina sa hipon.
fact_bis: Ginasukod sa mga mag-uuma og hipon ang kainit sa tubig gamit ang thermometer aron masiguro nga dili init o bugnaw kaayo, kay nahibalo sila nga ang temperatura sa tubig makapakusog o makapaluya sa hipon.

q: How do some Filipinos use the tides to make salt?
options: They let saltwater flow into shallow beds at high tide, then let the sun dry it until only salt remains
They boil seawater in large pots during low tide until the water evaporates
They collect rainwater in pans and mix it with ocean sediment to get salt
They dig trenches near the shore and let the salt fall out of the water underground
explanation: At high tide, saltwater is let into shallow beds; the sun then evaporates the water, leaving salt behind.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas, gumagawa ng asin gamit ang taog. Tuwing high tide, pinapapasok ang tubig-alat sa mga babaw na palaisdaan o asinan. Pagkatapos, hinahayaang matuyo sa araw hanggang matira ang asin.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka lugar sa Pilipinas, naghimo og asin gamit ang taob. Matag high tide, gipasulod ang parat nga tubig sa mabaw nga mga asinan. Pagkahuman, gipasagdan nga momala sa adlaw hangtod nga ang asin na lang ang mabilin.

q: How does the skin help cool the body when it gets too hot?
options: Tiny sweat glands in the skin release sweat to cool the body
The skin absorbs heat from outside air to lower body temperature
Blood vessels in the skin freeze to pull heat out of the body
The skin produces a thick oil that insulates against outside heat
explanation: Tiny sweat glands in the skin release sweat, which cools the body as it evaporates.
fact_tl: May maliliit na glandula ng pawis sa balat na naglalabas ng pawis upang palamigin ang katawan kapag mainit.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga mga glandula sa singot sa panit nga mogawas og singot aron pabugnawon ang lawas kung init.

q: How can you catch a virus from a dirty surface?
options: By touching the surface and then touching your eyes, nose, or mouth
By standing near the surface without touching it
By eating food that was cooked near the surface
By breathing in air that bounced off the surface
explanation: A virus on a dirty surface can enter your body if you touch the surface and then touch your eyes, nose, or mouth.
fact_tl: Maaaring mahawa ng virus kapag nahawakan ang maruming bagay at saka hinawakan ang sariling mata, ilong, o bibig.
fact_bis: Mahimo kang matakdan ug bayrus kon mahikap ang hugaw nga butang ug unya mahikap ang imong mata, ilong, o baba.

q: What instrument do scientists use to measure earthquakes?
options: A seismograph
A barometer
A thermometer
A hygrometer
explanation: The seismograph is the instrument used to detect and measure earthquakes.
fact_tl: Ang kasangkapang sumusukat ng lindol ay tinatawag na seismograph.
fact_bis: Ang kagamitan nga nagasukod sa linog gitawag og seismograph.

q: In complete metamorphosis, why do the larva and the adult not compete for food?
options: Because they eat different foods at each stage of life
Because the larva is too small to find any food on its own
Because the adult stops eating entirely after metamorphosis
Because both the larva and adult eat the same food but at different times of day
explanation: In complete metamorphosis, the larva and adult eat different foods, so they do not compete with each other for the same resources.
fact_tl: Sa ganap na metamorphosis, ang larva at hingkod ay kumakain ng magkaibang pagkain, kaya hindi sila nag-aagawan ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Sa kompleto nga metamorphosis, ang larva ug ang hamtong magkalahi og kaonon, mao nga dili sila mag-indigay sa pagkaon.

q: What are the billions of connected cells in the human brain called?
options: Neurons
Platelets
Alveoli
Nephrons
explanation: The human brain has billions of neurons connected to one another, forming the network that controls thinking and body functions.
fact_tl: Ang utak ng tao ay may bilyon-bilyong neuron na magkakakonekta sa isa't isa.
fact_bis: Ang utok sa tawo adunay binilyon nga mga neuron nga magkadugtong sa usag-usa.

q: What does the Philippine crocodile eat?
options: Fish, birds, and other animals it can reach in the water
Fruits, leaves, and plants that grow near the river
Insects and small seeds found along the riverbank
Algae and water plants floating in the lake
explanation: The Philippine crocodile is a carnivore that eats fish, birds, and other animals it can catch in the water.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine crocodile ay isang carnivore na naninirahan sa mga ilog at lawa ng Pilipinas; kumakain ito ng isda, ibon, at iba pang hayop na naaabot nito sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine crocodile usa ka carnivore nga nagpuyo sa mga suba ug lanaw sa Pilipinas; mokaon kini og isda, langgam, ug uban pang hayop nga maabot niini sa tubig.

q: Are all stars in the night sky the same brightness and color?
options: No, stars differ in brightness and come in colors like reddish, white, and bluish
Yes, all stars are exactly the same white color and brightness
No, but they all look yellow because they are like our Sun
Yes, they all look the same but appear different because of the atmosphere
explanation: Stars are not all the same — they vary in brightness and come in different colors including reddish, white, and bluish.
fact_tl: Hindi pare-pareho ang mga bituin — may mga bituing mas maliwanag kaysa iba, at may iba't ibang kulay sila tulad ng mapula, maputi, at mabughaw.
fact_bis: Dili parehas ang mga bituon — adunay mga bituon nga mas masanag kaysa uban, ug lain-lain ang ilang kolor sama sa mapula, maputi, ug asul.

q: Why should you cover food when you are not eating it?
options: To protect it from flies, dust, and microbes floating in the air
To keep it warmer than the room temperature around it
To stop the food from changing color when light hits it
To make the food taste better by trapping flavors inside
explanation: Covering food protects it from flies, dust, and airborne microbes that could make it unsafe to eat.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatakip sa pagkain ay nagpoprotekta dito mula sa langaw, alikabok, at mikrobyong nasa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang pagtabon sa pagkaon nanalipod niini gikan sa langaw, abog, ug mikrobyo nga naglutaw sa hangin.

q: When is a comet most bright and active as it travels around the Sun?
options: At perihelion, its closest approach to the Sun, when ice evaporates and forms a large tail
At aphelion, its farthest point from the Sun, when it is coldest and most icy
Halfway between perihelion and aphelion, when it moves at a steady speed
At the exact moment it crosses Earth's orbit on its way inward
explanation: A comet is most active at perihelion — its closest approach to the Sun — when the heat rapidly evaporates its ice, creating the largest coma and longest tails.
fact_tl: Ang kometa ay pinakamasigla at pinakamagandang tingnan sa panahon ng perihelion — ang pinaka-malapit nitong pagdating sa Araw; sa puntong ito, ang init ng Araw ay nagpapabilis ng evaporation ng yelo na lumilikha ng pinakamalaking coma at pinakamahabang buntot.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka kometa pinaka-aktibo ug pinakamaanindot talan-awon sa perihelion — ang iyang pinaka-duol nga pagduol sa Adlaw; sa puntong ito ang init sa Adlaw paspas nga nagpahinabo sa evaporation sa yelo, nagmugna sa pinakadako nga coma ug pinaka-haba nga mga buntot.

q: Why is there almost nothing that eats the top predator in a food chain?
options: There is too little energy left at the top to support yet another level of predator
Top predators are too dangerous for any animal to ever try to hunt
Top predators live in places so remote that other animals never find them
Top predators reproduce so fast that no hunter could keep up with them
explanation: Energy is lost at each level of a food chain, so by the time you reach the top predator, there is too little energy left to support another feeding level.
fact_tl: Halos walang hayop na kumakain sa pinakamataas na mandaragit dahil napakakaunti na ng enerhiyang matitira para sa isa pang antas.
fact_bis: Halos walay hayop nga mokaon sa pinakataas nga manunukob kay diyutay na kaayo ang nahibiling enerhiya alang sa laing lebel.

q: Which phrase best describes the variety of landscapes found in the Philippines?
options: Low coastal plains and beaches alongside high mountains and forests
Mostly flat land with very few mountains or coastlines
Mostly desert and dry plains with a short coastline
Only rainforests and no coastal areas
explanation: Philippine geography is extremely diverse, ranging from low coastal plains and beaches to high mountains and forests.
fact_tl: Ang heograpiya ng Pilipinas ay napakaraming pagkakaiba-iba: mula sa mga mababang kapatagan at baybayin hanggang sa mga mataas na bundok at kagubatan—iba-iba ang tanawin sa bawat rehiyon.
fact_bis: Ang heograpiya sa Pilipinas labaw ka magkakalainlain: gikan sa ubos nga kapatagan ug baybayin hangtod sa taas nga bundok ug kagubatan—lain-laing tanawin ang matag rehiyon.

q: Where does gold rank on the Mohs hardness scale?
options: About 2.5, which makes it a soft and easy-to-shape metal
About 10, which makes it the hardest natural material
About 7, placing it in the middle of the hardness scale
About 5, about as hard as a steel knife blade
explanation: Gold is a soft metal, rated only about 2.5 on the Mohs scale, which is why it is easy to shape into jewelry and coins.
fact_tl: Ang ginto ay malambot na metal, na nasa mga 2.5 lamang sa Mohs scale, kaya madali itong mahubog.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan usa ka humok nga metal, mga 2.5 ra sa Mohs scale, busa sayon kini hulmahon.

q: Why do children who eat regular meals find it easier to learn at school?
options: The brain needs energy from food to focus and remember lessons
Eating makes children sleepy, which helps their memory work better at night
Food makes the eyes stronger so children can read the board more clearly
Chewing exercises the jaw muscles, which sends blood to the brain
explanation: The brain needs energy from regular meals to focus and learn, so children who eat well understand and remember lessons more easily.
fact_tl: Ang utak ay nangangailangan ng lakas mula sa regular na pagkain para makapag-focus at makatuto. Ang batang kumakain ng tama ay mas madaling makaintindi at makaalala ng aral.
fact_bis: Ang utok nanginahanglan og kusog gikan sa regular nga pagkaon aron makafocus ug makakat-on. Ang bata nga maayo mokaon mas sayon makasabot ug makahinumdom sa leksyon.

q: How does Earth's iron core protect life on the surface?
options: It creates a magnetic field that blocks dangerous particles from the Sun and space
It generates so much heat that harmful radiation burns up before reaching the surface
It pulls dangerous particles downward into the ocean where they cannot harm life
It produces a thick layer of gas that reflects all radiation back into space
explanation: Earth's iron core makes it act like a giant magnet, and the resulting magnetic field shields the surface from dangerous particles from the Sun and space.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay parang isang malaking magnet dahil sa bakal na core nito. Ang "magnetic field" na ito ay parang invisible na kalasag na humaharang sa mapanganib na particle na galing sa araw at espasyo, kaya protektado ang buhay sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang Earth murag dako nga magnet tungod sa puthaw nga core niini. Kini nga magnetic field murag dili-makita nga taming nga moali sa peligroso nga mga particle gikan sa adlaw ug kawanangan, mao nga panalipdan ang kinabuhi sa ibabaw.

q: What is an ore?
options: A rock or mineral that holds enough metal to be worth mining
Any rock that is found near a volcano
A type of soil that is rich in nutrients for plants
A fossil that contains traces of ancient metal tools
explanation: An ore is a rock or mineral containing enough useful metal that mining it is worthwhile.
fact_tl: Ang ore ay isang bato o mineral na naglalaman ng sapat na metal upang sulit itong minahin.
fact_bis: Ang ore usa ka bato o mineral nga adunay igong metal aron mapuslan kini nga minahon.

q: Why is spirulina used as a food supplement?
options: It is rich in protein and nutrients that are good for the body
It tastes sweet and can replace sugar in all recipes
It grows underground and absorbs minerals from the soil only
It produces vitamins only when mixed with dairy products
explanation: Spirulina is a type of cyanobacteria rich in protein and nutrients, which is why it is cultivated and used as a food supplement.
fact_tl: Ang spirulina ay isang uri ng cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) na mayaman sa protina at iba pang sustansya — ginagamit ito bilang food supplement at inilalaki rin sa mga pond para sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang spirulina usa ka klase sa cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) nga dato sa protina ug mga sustansya — gigamit kini ingon food supplement ug gilalaki usab sa mga pond para sa pagkain.

q: What is the main job of the spinal cord?
options: It is the main pathway for messages between the brain and the rest of the body
It produces blood cells that carry oxygen around the body
It stores extra energy that muscles use during exercise
It filters waste products out of the blood like a kidney
explanation: The spinal cord is a thick bundle of nerves inside the backbone that serves as the main highway for messages between the brain and the rest of the body.
fact_tl: Ang spinal cord ay makapal na hanay ng mga nerve sa loob ng gulugod. Ito ang pangunahing daanan ng mensahe sa pagitan ng utak at ng iba't ibang bahagi ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang spinal cord usa ka baga nga pundok sa mga nerve sulod sa gulod. Mao kini ang nag-unang agianan sa mensahe tali sa utok ug sa ubang bahin sa lawas.

q: What usually happens to hiccups even if you do not try any special remedy?
options: They go away on their own after a short time
They get worse and worse until a doctor treats them
They only stop after drinking a full glass of water
They last for days unless you hold your breath for one minute
explanation: Hiccups usually go away on their own, so popular cures like drinking water are not proven to be necessary.
fact_tl: May mga sinusubukan para patigilin ang sinok, gaya ng pag-inom ng tubig, pero karaniwan namang nawawala ito kahit walang ginagawa.
fact_bis: Adunay mga sulayan aron pahunongon ang sed-ok, sama sa pag-inom og tubig, apan kasagaran mawala ra kini bisag walay buhaton.

q: What unusual thing happens to a tunicate larva when it settles and transforms into an adult?
options: It reabsorbs its own brain-like structure and notochord during metamorphosis
It grows a new larger brain to help it find more food as an adult
It splits into two separate adult tunicates, each with its own brain
It keeps its larval brain unchanged and just grows a hard outer shell
