explanation: During metamorphosis, the tunicate larva attaches to a surface and then reabsorbs its own brain-like structure and notochord, a remarkable example of developmental change.
fact_tl: Ang tunicate (sea squirt) ay may kakaibang metamorphosis — ang larva nito ay may katulad ng utak at notochord, ngunit sa panahon ng metamorphosis, ang larva ay nagiging nakadikit at sinisipsip muli ang sarili nitong utak at notochord.
fact_bis: Ang tunicate (sea squirt) adunay talagsaon nga metamorphosis — ang iyang larva adunay istruktura nga katulad sa utok ug notochord, apan sa panahon sa metamorphosis ang larva nakadikit ug gi-absorb ang kaugalingon niyang utok-katulad ug notochord.

q: Which vegetable helps keep eyesight healthy according to Filipino health advice?
options: Malunggay (moringa) leaves
Kamote (sweet potato) skin
Talong (eggplant) seeds
Ampalaya (bitter melon) flowers
explanation: Eating leafy vegetables like malunggay helps maintain healthy eyesight, alongside protecting eyes from direct sunlight.
fact_tl: Dapat alagaan ang ating mga pandama. Ang sobrang lakas na tunog sa headphones ay maaaring makasira ng pandinig, at ang pagtitig sa araw ay nakakasama sa mata. Ang pagkain ng madahong gulay tulad ng malunggay ay tumutulong sa malusog na paningin.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan atimanon nato ang atong mga igbalati. Ang sobra ka kusog nga tingog gikan sa headphones makadaot sa pandungog, ug ang pagtutok sa adlaw makadaot sa mata. Ang pagkaon og dahonon nga utanon sama sa malunggay motabang sa himsog nga panan-aw.

q: What makes spirochete bacteria different from most other bacteria in the way they move?
options: They rotate their corkscrew-shaped body to drill through dense tissues
They use tiny leg-like structures to walk along surfaces
They release gas bubbles that propel them through liquid
They attach to other cells and let the current carry them
explanation: Spirochetes have a corkscrew shape and move by rotating their body, which lets them penetrate dense tissues that other bacteria cannot reach.
fact_tl: Ang mga spirochete ay isang espesyal na uri ng bacteria na may hugis na parang corkscrew — gumagalaw sila sa pamamagitan ng pag-ikot ng katawan at kaya nilang tumagos sa matigas na tissue na hindi kaya ng ibang bacteria.
fact_bis: Ang mga spirochete usa ka espesyal nga klase sa bakterya nga hugis corkscrew — naglihok sila pinaagi sa pag-ikot sa ilang lawas ug makasulod sila sa matipon nga tissue nga dili mahimo sa ubang bakterya.

q: What did Albert Einstein's theory of relativity show about time and space?
options: That time and space are connected and can change depending on how fast something moves
That time always moves at the same speed no matter what
That space is completely empty and does not affect the motion of objects
That fast-moving objects become lighter and eventually disappear
explanation: Einstein showed that time and space are connected and can change depending on how fast something moves — a key idea in his theory of relativity.
fact_tl: Si Albert Einstein ay isang siyentista na nagturo na ang oras at espasyo ay magkadugtong at maaaring magbago depende sa bilis ng paggalaw.
fact_bis: Si Albert Einstein usa ka siyentista nga nagtudlo nga ang oras ug espasyo nagdugtong ug mahimong mausab depende sa kakusog sa paglihok.

q: How does an earthworm breathe?
options: Through its skin, which must stay moist to absorb oxygen
Through tiny holes in its segments that act like nostrils
Through a small mouth that opens and closes to gulp air
Through gills located underneath its body
explanation: An earthworm breathes through its skin, so it must stay moist to absorb oxygen properly.
fact_tl: Ang bulate ay humihinga sa pamamagitan ng balat nito, kaya kailangang laging basabasa ito.
fact_bis: Ang bulate moginhawa pinaagi sa iyang panit, mao nga kinahanglan kanunay kining mamasa.

q: What is the endocrine system made up of?
options: Glands in different parts of the body that communicate using hormones
Muscles that control breathing and digestion together
Bones and cartilage that support the body's movement
Blood vessels that carry nutrients directly to organs
explanation: The endocrine system is a group of glands spread throughout the body that work together by releasing hormones.
fact_tl: Ang endocrine system ay binubuo ng mga glands sa iba't ibang bahagi ng katawan na nagtutulungan gamit ang hormone.
fact_bis: Ang endocrine system gilangkuban sa mga glandula sa lain-laing bahin sa lawas nga nagtinabangay pinaagi sa hormone.

q: Which ant in the colony typically lives the longest?
options: The queen ant, who can live for several years
The soldier ant, who lives longest because it is the strongest
The worker ant, who lives longest because it is the most active
All ants in the colony live exactly the same length of time
explanation: The queen ant lives the longest in the colony — often several years — while worker ants have much shorter lives.
fact_tl: Ang reyna ng langgam ang pinakamatagal mabuhay sa kolonya—maaaring umabot ng ilang taon—samantalang ang mga manggagawang langgam ay karaniwang mas maikli ang buhay.
fact_bis: Ang reyna sa hulmigas mao ang pinakadugay nga mabuhi sa kolonya—mahimong moabot og pipila ka tuig—samtang ang mga trabahanteng hulmigas kasagaran mas mubo ang kinabuhi.

q: What kind of weather does the amihan bring to the Philippines?
options: Cool, colder weather because it is a northeast monsoon wind blowing from November to February
Hot, humid weather because it blows in from the warm western ocean
Heavy rain and flooding because it carries moisture from the Pacific
Strong typhoon winds because it peaks during the typhoon season
explanation: The amihan is a cool northeast monsoon wind that blows from November to February, making Philippine weather colder during those months.
fact_tl: Ang amihan ay ang malamig na hanging humihihip mula hilagang-silangan tuwing Nobyembre hanggang Pebrero, kaya mas malamig ang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang amihan mao ang bugnaw nga hangin nga mohuyop gikan sa amihanang-sidlakan gikan Nobyembre hangtod Pebrero, mao nga mas bugnaw ang panahon.

q: What happens if a Rafflesia bud is picked or damaged before it opens?
options: It will never develop into a flower that can make seeds.
It will grow back from the same stem within a week.
It will still bloom but produce smaller seeds.
It releases a strong smell to attract pollinators instead.
explanation: A Rafflesia bud dies easily when damaged, so it can never become a flower and make seeds.
fact_tl: Hindi dapat pitasin o galawin ang buko ng Rafflesia dahil madali itong mamatay, at kapag nasira ang buko, hindi na ito magkakaroon ng bulaklak na magbubuto.
fact_bis: Dili nato angay kuhaon o hikapon ang buko sa Rafflesia kay dali kini mamatay, ug kung madaot ang buko dili na kini mahimong bulak nga makahimo og liso.

q: Which organ actually makes urine in your body?
options: The kidneys
The bladder
The liver
The stomach
explanation: The kidneys make urine while balancing the water in your body; the bladder only stores urine until you use the toilet.
fact_tl: Maraming akala na ang pantog ang gumagawa ng ihi, pero hindi. Ang bato ang gumagawa nito habang binabalanse ang tubig. Ang pantog ay imbakan lang ng ihi bago mo ilabas.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang pantog ang naghimo sa ihi, apan dili. Ang kidney ang naghimo niini samtang gibalanse ang tubig. Ang pantog mao ray bodega sa ihi una nimo ipangihi.

q: In Niels Bohr's 1913 atomic model, how do electrons move around the nucleus?
options: They orbit the nucleus like planets around the sun.
They are embedded in the nucleus like raisins in bread.
They form a cloud of random motion around the nucleus.
They move in straight lines back and forth through the nucleus.
explanation: Bohr proposed in 1913 that electrons orbit the nucleus like planets, which was the key feature of his model.
fact_tl: Si Niels Bohr ang gumawa ng atomic model noong 1913, kung saan umiikot ang mga electron sa nucleus tulad ng mga planeta.
fact_bis: Si Niels Bohr ang naghimo sa atomic model niadtong 1913, diin ang mga electron molibot sa nucleus sama sa mga planeta.

q: How does an LED produce light when electricity passes through it?
options: Electrons release light as they flow through a special material.
A metal wire heats up until it glows red-hot.
A gas inside a tube gets excited and fluoresces.
Chemical reactions between two liquids create a glow.
explanation: In an LED, electrons release light as they pass through a special material, which is why it glows without needing heat.
fact_tl: Ang LED ay maikli para sa 'light-emitting diode.' Kapag dumaan ang kuryente sa loob nito, ang maliliit na particle na tinatawag na electron ay naglalabas ng liwanag habang dumadaloy sila sa espesyal na materyal. Kaya nagliliwanag ang LED nang hindi gumagamit ng init.
fact_bis: Ang LED mubo para sa 'light-emitting diode.' Kung moagi ang kuryente sa sulod niini, ang gagmay nga partikulo nga gitawag og electron mohatag og kahayag samtang moagi sila sa pinasahi nga materyal. Mao na nga mosanag ang LED nga walay init.

q: Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder during a storm?
options: Light travels much faster than sound.
Thunder takes time to form after lightning appears.
Our ears are less sensitive than our eyes during rain.
Sound waves are blocked by raindrops before they reach us.
explanation: Light is the fastest thing in the universe, so lightning reaches our eyes before the sound of thunder reaches our ears.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa uniberso, kaya nauuna nating makita ang kidlat bago natin marinig ang kulog.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag mao ang pinakakusog nga butang sa uniberso, mao nga makita una nato ang kilat sa dili pa nato madungog ang dalogdog.

q: Why does soil crack during a drought when there is no rain?
options: The sun heats the wet ground, water evaporates into the air, and the soil keeps drying out.
Roots of plants push the soil apart as they search for water underground.
Wind blows the top layer of soil away, exposing the dry layer beneath.
The ground shrinks because it becomes heavier when it loses water.
explanation: Evaporation turns water in the soil into vapor that rises into the air, and without rain to replace it, the soil keeps drying until it cracks.
fact_tl: Ang dahilan kung bakit nawawala ang tubig sa lupa ay ang pagsingaw. Iniinit ng araw ang basang lupa, at ang tubig ay nagiging singaw na pumapaitaas sa hangin. Kapag walang ulan na pumapalit, patuloy itong natutuyo hanggang mabitak.
fact_bis: Ang hinungdan nganong mawala ang tubig sa yuta mao ang pag-alisngaw. Init-on sa adlaw ang basa nga yuta, ug ang tubig mahimong alisngaw nga mosaka sa hangin. Kon walay ulan nga mopuli, padayon kining mamala hangtod nga moliki.

q: Why does every person have a different voice?
options: Each person's larynx and vocal cords have a different size and shape.
Each person breathes at a different speed, changing the air pressure on the cords.
Different people have different numbers of vocal cords.
The amount of saliva a person produces changes how the cords vibrate.
explanation: Each person's voice is unique because the size and shape of their larynx and vocal cords are different from everyone else's.
fact_tl: Magkakaiba ang boses ng bawat tao dahil magkakaiba ang laki at hugis ng kanilang larynx at vocal cords.
fact_bis: Lahi-lahi ang boses sa matag tawo tungod kay lahi-lahi ang gidak-on ug porma sa ilang larynx ug vocal cords.

q: How does the Philippines compare to neighboring countries when it comes to animals found only there?
options: The Philippines has more endemic animals than many of its neighboring countries.
The Philippines has fewer endemic animals because it is a small country.
The Philippines and its neighbors have about the same number of unique animals.
The Philippines has many animals, but most of them are also found in other countries.
explanation: The Philippines has a very high number of endemic animals, meaning more species found only there than many neighboring countries.
fact_tl: Kung ihahambing sa ibang bansa, ang Pilipinas ay may napakataas na bilang ng endemikong hayop—ibig sabihin, mas marami tayong hayop na dito lang matatagpuan kumpara sa marami nating kalapit na bansa.
fact_bis: Kon itandi sa ubang nasod, ang Pilipinas adunay taas kaayo nga ihap sa endemic nga hayop—nagpasabot nga mas daghan tag hayop nga dinhi ra makit-an kaysa daghan sa atong silingang nasod.

q: What is the real purpose of school feeding programs, according to health and education experts?
options: They are an investment in the future because well-fed children can study better.
They are charity given only to families who refuse to work.
They are a reward for students who get high grades.
They are funded by foreign countries to embarrass the Philippines.
explanation: Feeding programs are an investment in the future because a healthy, well-fed child can concentrate and study better.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang feeding program ay para lang sa tamad na pamilya o pulos awa. Ang totoo, ito ay isang paraan para matulungan ang mga batang nahihirapan, dahil ang batang busog at malusog ay mas nakakapag-aral, kaya't ito ay pamumuhunan sa kinabukasan.
fact_bis: Sayop ang panabot nga ang feeding program para lang sa tapulan nga pamilya o puro kaluoy. Ang tinuod, kini usa ka paagi aron tabangan ang mga bata nga naglisod, kay ang bata nga busog ug himsog mas makatuon pag-ayo, mao nga kini usa ka pamuhunan sa kaugmaon.

q: What kind of teeth do grass-eating animals like cows and horses have at the back of their mouths?
options: Wide, flat teeth for grinding tough blades of grass
Long, pointed teeth for tearing meat
Small, sharp teeth for crushing seeds and nuts
Curved teeth for holding slippery fish
explanation: Grass-eating animals have wide, flat back teeth designed for grinding the tough, rough blades of grass.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na kumakain ng damo ay may malalapad na bagang para durugin ang matigas at magaspang na dahon ng damo.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap nga nagakaon ug damo adunay lapad nga mga bag-ang aron magaling sa gahi ug gaspang nga mga dahon sa damo.

q: Why do iron objects rust more easily in the Philippines than in very dry climates?
options: The Philippines is humid and rainy, which speeds up rusting.
Philippine air has more oxygen than air in other countries.
The Philippines is close to the equator, so iron gets hotter and rusts faster.
The salt in Philippine soil sticks to iron and causes it to melt.
explanation: In the humid, rainy Philippines, iron objects are exposed to more moisture, which makes them rust more easily.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas na mahalumigmig at maulan, mas madaling kumalawang ang mga bagay na bakal.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas nga umido ug ulanon, mas dali mokalawang ang mga butang nga puthaw.

q: When something burns, what two things does it give off?
options: Heat and light
Water and sound
Gas and weight
Color and pressure
explanation: When something burns, it releases both heat and light as products of the burning process.
fact_tl: Kapag may nasusunog, naglalabas ito ng init at liwanag.
fact_bis: Kung may masunog, kini magpagawas ug kainit ug kahayag.

q: What is one of the best ways to help prevent diarrhea?
options: Drinking clean or boiled water
Eating more salty foods
Wearing thick clothing every day
Sleeping with the windows closed
explanation: Drinking clean or boiled water helps prevent diarrhea by avoiding germs that contaminate unsafe water.
fact_tl: Ang pag-inom ng malinis o pinakuluang tubig ay nakatutulong na maiwasan ang pagtatae.
fact_bis: Ang pag-inom ug limpyo o gipabukal nga tubig makatabang sa paglikay sa kalibanga.

q: Why can talc never be made hard or sharp, no matter what you do to it?
options: A mineral's hardness is fixed by its structure, so talc always stays the softest mineral.
Talc is made mostly of water, which keeps it from hardening.
Talc is a type of plastic that was never meant to be hard.
Talc only feels soft; heating it makes it as hard as diamond.
explanation: A mineral's hardness is fixed by its structure, so talc permanently remains number 1 — the softest — on the Mohs scale.
fact_tl: Hindi mo magagawang matigas o matalim ang talc kahit anong gawin mo dito. Ang tigas ng isang mineral ay nakatakda na dahil sa istruktura nito, kaya laging numero 1 ang talc sa Mohs scale.
fact_bis: Dili nimo mahimong gahi o hait ang talc bisan unsa pa imong buhaton niini. Ang katig-a sa usa ka mineral natakda na tungod sa istruktura niini, mao nga ang talc kanunay nga numero 1 sa Mohs scale.

q: If someone has blood type AB, do they also have an Rh factor (positive or negative)?
options: Yes, they can be AB+ or AB-, because Rh is a separate antigen.
No, AB blood has no Rh factor at all.
Only AB+ exists; AB- is not a real blood type.
The Rh factor only applies to blood types A and B, not AB.
explanation: Even with blood type AB, there is still a separate Rh (D) antigen, so a person can be AB+ or AB-, making AB+ the true universal recipient.
fact_tl: Kahit type AB ka, may dagdag pang tanong: Rh-positive ka ba o Rh-negative? Ibang antigen iyan (Rh o D antigen). Kaya may AB+ at may AB-. Ang AB+ ang tunay na universal recipient para sa lahat.
fact_bis: Bisan type AB ka, naa pa'y dugang nga pangutana: Rh-positive ka ba o Rh-negative? Lahi kana nga antigen (ang Rh o D antigen). Mao nga naa'y AB+ ug AB-. Ang AB+ ang tinuod nga universal recipient para sa tanan.

q: Besides breathing in germs from a sneeze, how else can a cold spread from person to person?
options: By touching a virus on an object and then touching your eyes, nose, or mouth
By standing near someone who has a cold, even with no physical contact
By eating food that was prepared in the same kitchen as a sick person
By looking at someone who is sick while they are coughing
explanation: A cold can spread when you touch a virus left on an object and then touch your eyes, nose, or mouth, allowing the virus to enter your body.
fact_tl: Makakahawa rin ang sipon kapag nahawakan mo ang virus sa isang bagay at hinipo mo ang iyong mata, ilong, o bibig.
fact_bis: Makatakod usab ang sip-on kung magunitan nimo ang virus sa usa ka butang dayon hikapon nimo ang imong mata, ilong, o baba.

q: How many valence electrons do alkali metals like sodium and potassium have?
options: One
Two
Seven
Eight
explanation: Alkali metals are in Group 1 and have just one valence electron, which makes them very reactive.
fact_tl: Ang mga alkali metal gaya ng sodium at potassium ay nasa Group 1, napakareaktibo, at may isang valence electron lamang.
fact_bis: Ang mga alkali metal sama sa sodium ug potassium anaa sa Group 1, reaktibo kaayo, ug adunay usa lang ka valence electron.

q: Which chamber of the heart has the thickest wall and pumps blood to the entire body?
options: The left ventricle
The right ventricle
The left atrium
The right atrium
explanation: The left ventricle is the strongest chamber with the thickest wall because it must pump blood from the heart all the way to every part of the body.
fact_tl: Ang kaliwang ventricle ang pinakamalakas at may pinakamakapal na pader sa apat na silid. Ito kasi ang nagbobomba ng dugo papuntang buong katawan, mula ulo hanggang paa, kaya kailangan nito ng mas malakas na pwersa kaysa sa ibang silid.
fact_bis: Ang walang ventricle mao ang pinakakusgan ug adunay pinakabaga nga bungbong sa upat ka lawak. Tungod kay kini ang nagabomba sa dugo padulong sa tibuok lawas, gikan sa ulo hangtod sa tiil, busa nagkinahanglan kini og mas kusog nga puwersa kaysa ubang lawak.

q: What happens when you keep adding salt to water after it has dissolved as much as it can?
options: The extra salt settles to the bottom because the water is saturated.
The water starts to boil to make room for more salt.
The extra salt turns into a gas and floats away.
The water changes color to show that it is full of salt.
explanation: When water is saturated, it cannot dissolve any more salt, so the extra salt just settles at the bottom.
fact_tl: Hindi walang-hanggan ang kayang tunawin ng tubig. Kapag sobra na ang asin, hindi na ito matutunaw at lulubog lang sa ilalim — puno na ang tubig (saturated).
fact_bis: Dili walay kataposan ang matunaw sa tubig. Kon sobra na ang asin, dili na kini matunaw ug molunod lang sa ilawom — puno na ang tubig (saturated).

q: Who was the first person to observe Saturn through a telescope?
options: Galileo
Copernicus
Newton
Kepler
explanation: Galileo was the first to observe Saturn through a telescope in 1610, although he could not yet recognize what its rings were.
fact_tl: Si Galileo ang unang nakakita ng Saturno gamit ang teleskopyo noong 1610, kahit hindi pa niya nakilala ang singsing nito.
fact_bis: Si Galileo ang unang nakakita sa Saturno pinaagi sa teleskopyo niadtong 1610, bisan wala pa niya mailhi ang singsing niini.

q: Which statement best describes the giant cloud rat's size?
options: It is among the largest rodents in the world and can weigh nearly two kilograms.
It is about the same size as a common house mouse.
It is a medium-sized rodent weighing around 200 grams.
It is the largest land animal found only in the Philippines.
explanation: Giant cloud rats are among the world's largest rodents and can weigh nearly two kilograms.
fact_tl: Ang mga higanteng cloud rat ay kabilang sa pinakamalalaking daga sa mundo at maaaring umabot ng halos dalawang kilo ang bigat.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong cloud rat usa sa pinakadagkong ilaga sa kalibutan ug mahimong moabot ug halos duha ka kilo ang gibug-aton.

q: In which province is the Hinatuan Enchanted River located?
options: Surigao del Sur
Palawan
Batangas
Sorsogon
explanation: The Hinatuan Enchanted River is found in Surigao del Sur, Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Hinatuan Enchanted River ay matatagpuan sa Surigao del Sur sa Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang Hinatuan Enchanted River makita sa Surigao del Sur sa Mindanao.

q: What are the millions of tiny air sacs inside the lungs called, and what do they do?
options: Alveoli — they let oxygen enter the blood and carbon dioxide leave.
Bronchi — they carry air from the throat down into the lungs.
Capillaries — they pump blood through the lungs.
Ventricles — they push air in and out with each breath.
explanation: Alveoli are the tiny air sacs in the lungs where oxygen passes into the blood and carbon dioxide passes out.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng baga ay may milyon-milyong maliliit na supot ng hangin na tinatawag na alveoli, kung saan ang oksiheno ay pumapasok sa dugo at ang carbon dioxide ay lumalabas.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa baga adunay minilyon nga gagmayng supot sa hangin nga gitawag og alveoli, diin ang oksiheno mosulod sa dugo ug ang carbon dioxide mogawas.

q: Why did online learning and distance education become important in the Philippines?
options: So children can still learn when they cannot reach school due to a pandemic or disaster
So students can study faster and finish school in fewer years
So teachers can grade papers without meeting students in person
So schools can save money by closing their buildings
explanation: Online learning and distance education became important in the Philippines as a way of teaching when children cannot reach school due to a pandemic or disaster.
fact_tl: Naging mahalaga ang online learning at distance education sa Pilipinas bilang paraan ng pagtuturo kapag hindi makaabot ang mga bata sa paaralan dahil sa pandemya o sakuna.
fact_bis: Naging importante ang online learning ug distance education sa Pilipinas ingon paagi sa pagtudlo kon dili makaabut ang mga bata sa paaralan tungod sa pandemya o kalamidad.

q: What useful product can be pressed from the seeds found inside mature malunggay pods?
options: Oil used in cosmetics and some kinds of soap
A sweet syrup used as a medicine for coughs
A dye used to color clothes and fabrics
A starchy flour used in baking bread
explanation: Oil can be pressed from malunggay pod seeds and is used in products such as cosmetics and some kinds of soap.
fact_tl: Mula sa mga buto sa loob ng matandang malunggay pod, maaaring pigain ang langis. Ginagamit ang langis na ito sa ibang produkto tulad ng pampaganda at ilang uri ng sabon.
fact_bis: Gikan sa mga liso sulod sa tigulang nga malunggay pod, mahimong pug-on ang lana. Kini nga lana gigamit sa ubang produkto sama sa pangpaanyag ug pipila ka klase sa sabon.

q: What actually happens to carbon when it is stored in plants or soil — does it disappear?
options: No, carbon is never destroyed; it just moves from air to plants to soil and back in a cycle.
Yes, carbon breaks down and disappears when it is stored underground for a long time.
Carbon changes into oxygen when stored in plants, which is why forests produce clean air.
Stored carbon turns into water vapor and evaporates out of the soil.
explanation: Carbon is never destroyed; it simply moves from the air to plants to soil and back again in a continuous cycle.
fact_tl: Maling akala na nawawala ang karbon kapag naimbak. Hindi ito nawawala kailanman, lumilipat lang ito mula hangin, sa halaman, sa lupa, at pabalik—paikot-ikot.
fact_bis: Sayop ang hunahuna nga mawala ang karbon kon kini matipig. Wala kini mawala; mobalhin lang kini gikan sa hangin, sa tanom, sa yuta, ug mobalik—nagtuyok.

q: Why does a flashlight beam become visible when it shines through smoke or milky water?
options: Tiny particles scatter the light, making the beam's path visible — this is the Tyndall effect.
The smoke absorbs the light and re-emits it as a glow.
Warm air from the smoke bends the light so we can see its path.
Water droplets in smoke act like tiny mirrors that reflect the beam back.
explanation: Tiny particles in smoke or milky water scatter the light from a flashlight, making the beam's path visible in what is called the Tyndall effect.
fact_tl: Kapag dumaan ang sinag ng flashlight sa usok o gatas na may tubig, nagiging kita ang daan ng liwanag dahil ikinakalat ito ng maliliit na particle—tinatawag itong Tyndall effect.
fact_bis: Kon ang suga sa flashlight moagi sa aso o gatas nga tubig, makita ang agianan sa kahayag tungod kay gikatag kini sa gagmayng partikulo—gitawag kini og Tyndall effect.

q: Why is a small amount of old yogurt added to fresh milk when making new yogurt?
options: It acts as a starter by providing bacteria already ready to multiply.
It adds sweetness so the new yogurt tastes better.
It thickens the milk so it sets faster in the refrigerator.
It prevents the milk from boiling over during heating.
explanation: Old yogurt added to fresh milk acts as a starter culture, providing good bacteria that are already ready to multiply and ferment the new batch.
fact_tl: Para gumawa ng yogurt, nilalagyan ng kaunting lumang yogurt ang sariwang gatas bilang starter, upang magkaroon agad ng mabuting bakterya na dadami.
fact_bis: Aron makahimo og yogurt, gibutangan og gamay nga daang yogurt ang lab-as nga gatas isip starter, aron adunay maayong bakterya nga andam modaghan.

q: In which country did the Industrial Revolution begin in the late 1700s?
options: Britain (England)
France
Germany
The United States
explanation: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain (England) in the late 1700s, where new machines and factories changed how goods were made.
fact_tl: Ang Rebolusyong Industriyal ay nagsimula sa Britain (England) noong huling bahagi ng 1700s.
fact_bis: Ang Industrial Revolution nagsugod sa Britain (England) sa ulahing bahin sa 1700s.

q: How does the monitor lizard (bayawak) use its sharp claws?
options: To climb trees and dig in the ground
To catch fish in rivers and streams
To grip smooth rocks while crossing rivers
To scare away predators by making loud scratching sounds
explanation: The monitor lizard uses its sharp claws to climb trees and dig in the ground.
fact_tl: Ang bayawak ay may matatalim na kuko na ginagamit nito para umakyat sa mga puno at maghukay sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang bayawak adunay hait nga mga kuko nga gamiton niini aron mosaka sa mga kahoy ug mokalot sa yuta.

q: Which strong muscle in your mouth helps you taste food AND push it down into the esophagus?
options: The tongue
The palate
The jaw
The uvula
explanation: The tongue is a strong muscle that helps chew, taste food, and push swallowed food into the esophagus.
fact_tl: Ang dila ay isang kalamnan na tumutulong sa pagnguya, paglasa, at paglunok ng pagkain papunta sa esophagus.
fact_bis: Ang dila usa ka kusog nga kaunuran nga nagtabang sa pagngayngay, paglasa, ug pagtulod sa pagkaon ngadto sa esophagus.

q: What is the birthstone for September, and what color is it usually?
options: Sapphire, usually blue
Ruby, usually red
Emerald, usually green
Amethyst, usually purple
explanation: The birthstone for September is the sapphire, which is usually blue in color.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Setyembre ay ang sapphire (sapiro), na kadalasang asul ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Setyembre kay ang sapphire (sapiro), nga kasagaran asul og kolor.

q: Who experiences stress and difficult feelings?
options: Everyone — both children and adults feel stress at some point.
Only adults, because children do not have real responsibilities.
Only children, because they have not learned to manage their emotions yet.
Only people who are sick or have health problems.
explanation: Everyone, including both children and adults, experiences stress and hard feelings, so no one is alone in feeling that way.
fact_tl: Lahat ng tao — bata man o matanda — ay nakakaranas ng stress at mahihirap na damdamin, kaya hindi ka nag-iisa.
fact_bis: Ang tanang tawo — bata man o hamtong — makasinati og stress ug lisod nga pagbati, busa dili ka nag-inusara.

q: Why is the mangrove crab sometimes called 'nature's cleanup crew'?
options: It eats dead animals in the mud, helping to keep the mangrove clean.
It digs holes that drain muddy water from the swamp.
It removes harmful algae from mangrove roots with its claws.
It chases away large animals that damage the mangrove forest.
explanation: The mangrove crab eats dead animals in the mud, acting like nature's cleanup crew by helping to keep the mangrove clean.
fact_tl: Halos lahat kinakain ng alimango — maliliit na isda, kabibe, dahon, at maging patay na hayop sa putik. Dahil kumakain ito ng mga patay na bagay, nakakatulong ito maglinis sa bakawan, parang taga-linis ng kalikasan.
fact_bis: Halos tanan gikaon sa alimango — gagmayng isda, kinhason, dahon, ug bisan patay nga mananap sa lapok. Tungod kay mokaon kini og patay nga butang, makatabang kini sa paglimpyo sa bakhaw, sama sa tighinlo sa kinaiyahan.

q: Besides cleaning the blood, what other important job do the kidneys do?
options: They help control the body's blood pressure.
They produce digestive juices that break down food.
They store energy in the form of sugar for later use.
They filter air before it reaches the lungs.
explanation: Besides cleaning the blood, the kidneys also help control the body's blood pressure.
fact_tl: Bukod sa paglilinis ng dugo, tumutulong din ang mga bato na kontrolin ang presyon ng dugo sa katawan.
fact_bis: Gawas sa paglimpyo sa dugo, ang mga kidney motabang usab sa pagkontrol sa presyon sa dugo sa lawas.

q: How does a newborn bat stay safely with its mother while she hangs upside down?
options: The baby bat clings tightly to the mother's body so it does not fall.
The mother builds a small nest to hold the baby while she hangs.
The baby bat flies on its own within a day of being born.
The mother wraps the baby in her wings and sets it on a branch.
explanation: A baby bat clings tightly to its mother's body while she hangs upside down, gripping so firmly that it does not fall.
fact_tl: Kapag may anak, kumakapit ang munting paniki sa katawan ng ina habang ito ay nakabitin. Magkadikit silang nakatiwarik habang sumususo ang sanggol. Matibay ang kapit ng anak kaya hindi ito nahuhulog kahit nakabitin lang ang ina.
fact_bis: Kon adunay anak, mokapyot ang gamayng paniki sa lawas sa inahan samtang kini nagbitay. Magdungan silang baliktad samtang nagsuso ang gamay. Kusog ang kapyot sa anak mao nga dili kini mahulog bisan nagbitay ra ang inahan.

q: What happens when you put warm food directly into the refrigerator?
options: The fridge has to work harder to remove the extra heat from the warm food.
The warm food cools down in the same amount of time as cold food.
The warm food heats the fridge motor, which automatically speeds it up.
Nothing changes because the fridge always runs at the same speed.
explanation: Putting warm food in the fridge adds extra heat that the refrigerator must then move out, making it work harder.
fact_tl: Kapag nilagyan ng mainit na pagkain ang ref, mas marami itong init na kailangang ilipat palabas.
fact_bis: Kon butangan og mainit nga pagkaon ang ref, mas daghan ang kainit nga kinahanglan ipagawas niini.

q: Approximately how fast does light travel?
options: About 300,000 kilometers per second
About 3,000 kilometers per second
About 340 meters per second
About 30,000 kilometers per hour
explanation: The speed of light is about 300,000 kilometers per second (exactly 299,792 km/s).
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng liwanag ay humigit-kumulang 300,000 kilometro kada segundo (tumpak na 299,792 km/s).
fact_bis: Ang katulin sa kahayag mga 300,000 ka kilometro kada segundo (tukma nga 299,792 km/s).

q: What is intercropping, and what is one benefit of doing it?
options: Growing two types of crops in the same field at the same time to use land more efficiently
Rotating a single crop from one field to another each season to rest the soil
Planting crops only in shaded areas to reduce the need for irrigation
Harvesting two separate fields on the same day to save on labor costs
explanation: Intercropping means growing two types of crops simultaneously in the same field, which uses land more efficiently and can suppress weeds.
fact_tl: Ang intercropping ay ang pagtatanim ng dalawang uri ng pananim nang sabay sa iisang lugar—halimbawa, ang pagtatanim ng mongo sa pagitan ng mais—para mas epektibong magamit ang lupa at mabawasan ang damo.
fact_bis: Ang intercropping mao ang pagtanom sa duha ka klase sa pananim sa mao gihapon nga lugar—pananglitan, pagtanom og mongo tali sa mais—aron mas epektibong magamit ang yuta ug mabawasan ang sagbot.

q: Why is burning trash — especially plastic — harmful?
options: It releases poisonous smoke that is bad for the air and our health.
It creates ash that is useful as a natural fertilizer for plants.
It is the fastest and cleanest way to get rid of large amounts of garbage.
It only produces water vapor and carbon dioxide, which are harmless.
explanation: Burning trash, especially plastic, releases poisonous smoke that harms the air and people's health; it is better to sort, recycle, or compost waste.
fact_tl: Ang pagsunog ng basura, lalo na ang plastik, ay naglalabas ng nakakalasong usok na masama sa hangin at sa kalusugan natin. Mas mabuting ihiwalay at i-recycle o i-compost ito kaysa sunugin.
fact_bis: Ang pagsunog sa basura, ilabi na ang plastik, mogawas og makahilo nga aso nga daotan sa hangin ug sa atong panglawas. Mas maayo nga ilain ug i-recycle o i-compost kini kaysa sunogon.

q: What kind of air is needed for a thunderstorm to form?
options: Warm, moist air that rises quickly and builds tall storm clouds
Cold, dry air that sinks rapidly toward the ground
Still, humid air that sits close to the ground without moving
Hot, dry air that collides with cool ocean breezes
explanation: Thunderstorms form when warm, moist air rises quickly and builds tall storm clouds.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang thunderstorm kapag mabilis na umaakyat ang mainit at mahalumigmig na hangin at bumubuo ng matataas na ulap.
fact_bis: Ang unos matawo kung ang mainit ug umog nga hangin mosaka dayon ug maghimo og taas nga mga panganod.

q: What creates Earth's magnetic field and its North and South magnetic poles?
options: Moving liquid iron in Earth's outer core creates electric currents that make the magnetic field.
Huge underground magnets left over from when the Earth first formed.
The pull of the Moon on iron deposits near the Earth's surface.
Solar wind from the Sun pushes charged particles into the Earth's poles.
explanation: Moving liquid iron in Earth's outer core creates electric currents, and those currents produce the magnetic field that gives Earth its North and South magnetic poles.
fact_tl: Bakit may magnetic poles ang Earth? Sa loob ng Earth, sa bahaging tinatawag na outer core, may tinunaw (likido) na bakal na patuloy na gumagalaw dahil sa init. Ang gumagalaw na bakal na ito ay gumagawa ng electric currents, at ang mga ito ang lumilikha ng magnetic field ng buong planeta — kaya nga may North at South magnetic poles tayo. Para itong isang malaking magnet na nakatago sa kailaliman.
fact_bis: Ngano naa man magnetic poles ang Yuta? Sa sulod gyud sa Yuta, sa bahin nga gitawag og outer core, naa natunaw (likido) nga puthaw nga padayon nga naglihok tungod sa kainit. Kining naglihok nga puthaw naghimo og electric currents, ug kini ang naghimo sa magnetic field sa tibuok planeta — mao nga naa kitay North ug South magnetic poles. Murag dako nga magnet nga gitago sa kahiladman.

q: What is the purpose of the large underground part of the gabi plant?
options: It stores starch for the plant, and people also cook and eat this part.
It absorbs sunlight from underground to power the plant's growth.
It holds water during floods so the plant does not get washed away.
It produces seeds that are carried underground by ants.
explanation: The gabi corm stores starch (food) for the plant underground, and this same part is cooked and eaten by people.
fact_tl: Ang malaking bahagi ng gabi sa ilalim ng lupa ay nag-iimbak ng pagkain (almirol) para sa halaman, at ito rin ang niluluto at kinakain ng mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang dako nga bahin sa gabi sa ilalom sa yuta nagtipig og pagkaon (starch) para sa tanom, ug kini usab ang ginaluto ug ginakaon sa mga tawo.

q: When are two forces said to be balanced?
options: When they are equal in strength but push in opposite directions, canceling each other out
When they both push in the same direction with the same strength
When one force is twice as strong as the other force
When the forces act on different objects at the same time
explanation: Forces are balanced when they are equal in strength but opposite in direction, so they cancel each other out and no movement results.
fact_tl: Balanse ang mga pwersa kapag magkapareho ang lakas nila ngunit magkasalungat ang direksyon, kaya nagkakansela sila.
fact_bis: Balanse ang mga pwersa kung pareho sila og kusog apan magkaatbang og direksyon, busa magkanselar sila sa usag usa.

q: How does a sheep's thick wool help it survive in cold weather?
options: It keeps the sheep warm by trapping body heat.
It makes the sheep heavier so it can stand firm against strong winds.
It absorbs rainwater so the sheep does not get too thirsty.
It changes color to blend in with snow, hiding the sheep from predators.
explanation: A sheep's thick wool keeps it warm even in cold weather by holding in body heat.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na wool ay nagpapainit sa tupa kahit sa malamig na panahon.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga wool maghatag og kainit sa karnero bisan sa bugnaw nga panahon.

q: Why do you leave a faint moist print on a glass when you touch it?
options: Tiny sweat pores along each fingerprint ridge release sweat that leaves a print shaped like the ridges.
Oil from your blood seeps through the skin and sticks to smooth surfaces.
Dead skin cells fall off and stick to the glass in the shape of your fingerprint.
The heat from your finger melts a thin layer of glass that hardens into a print.
explanation: Along each fingerprint ridge are tiny pores that release sweat, and when you touch a glass, this moist sweat leaves a print shaped like your ridges.
fact_tl: Sa ibabaw ng bawat fingerprint ridge ay may maliliit na butas na naglalabas ng pawis. Dahil dito, kapag humawak ka ng baso o salamin, naiiwan ang basa-basang bakas ng iyong fingerprint na hugis ng iyong mga linya.
fact_bis: Sa ibabaw sa matag fingerprint ridge adunay gagmay nga lungag nga mogawas og singot. Tungod niini, kung mohikap ka og baso o salamin, mabilin ang basa-basa nga marka nga hugis sa imong mga linya.

q: What forms the base of the food web inside a dark cave?
options: Bat droppings called guano, which fungi and bacteria break down to feed other cave animals
Green algae that grow on the cave walls using light from cracks in the ceiling
Dead leaves that wash into the cave during heavy rain and decompose slowly
Small fish that swim into the cave from underground rivers
explanation: Inside caves, bat droppings called guano are broken down by fungi and bacteria, forming the base of the food web that feeds cave crickets and other cave-dwelling animals.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng mga yungib, ang mga dumi ng paniki (guano) ang pundasyon ng food web — ang mga fungi at bacteria ay nagpapatuklap nito at nagbibigay ng pagkain sa cave crickets at iba pang hayop na nakatira sa dilim.
fact_bis: Sulod sa mga lungib, ang tae sa mga kabog (guano) ang pundasyon sa food web — ang fungi ug bacteria nagpabulok niini ug nagpakaon sa mga cave cricket ug uban pang mananap nga nagpuyo sa ngitngit.

q: How does a jellyfish get rid of waste after eating?
options: Waste comes back out through the same opening it used to eat — jellyfish have only one opening.
It digests all its food completely, so it never produces any waste.
Waste exits through a separate opening at the bottom of its body.
The jellyfish absorbs waste back into its body and recycles it as energy.
explanation: A jellyfish has only one opening that serves as both its mouth and its exit for waste — food enters and waste leaves through the same hole.
fact_tl: Ang dikya ay may iisang butas lamang na nagsisilbing bibig — dito pumapasok ang pagkain at dito rin lumalabas ang dumi. Wala itong magkahiwalay na bibig at puwit.
fact_bis: Ang dikya may usa ra ka lungag nga maoy iyang baba — didto mosulod ang pagkaon ug didto usab mogawas ang hugaw. Wala kini'y bulag nga baba ug lubot.

q: Why is mamon (Filipino sponge cake) fluffy and soft?
options: Beaten eggs trap tiny air bubbles that expand in the oven's heat, making the cake rise.
Baking soda reacts with vinegar to produce gas bubbles that lift the batter.
Sugar melts in the oven and creates pockets of steam inside the cake.
Flour absorbs water during baking and swells up to make the cake light.
explanation: Mamon is fluffy because beaten eggs trap tiny air bubbles that expand when heated in the oven, causing the cake to rise.
fact_tl: Ang mamon ay malambot dahil ang binateng itlog ay nagkukulong ng maliliit na bula ng hangin na lumalaki sa init ng oven, kaya umaalsa ito.
fact_bis: Ang mamon humok kay ang gibatil nga itlog nagatipig ug gagmay nga bula sa hangin nga modako sa kainit sa oven, mao nga mosaka kini.

q: Why do farmers add fertilizer to their fields?
options: To make crops grow faster by adding nitrogen to the soil
To keep the soil moist during the dry season
To make the soil darker so it absorbs more sunlight
To stop weeds from competing with the crops
explanation: Fertilizer adds nitrogen to the soil, which is what makes crops grow faster.
fact_tl: Nagdadagdag ang mga magsasaka ng nitroheno sa lupa gamit ang pataba upang lumago nang mabilis ang mga pananim.
fact_bis: Ang mga mag-uuma nagdugang og nitrogen sa yuta gamit ang abono aron mas paspas motubo ang mga tanom.

q: Which gemstone is the birthstone for the month of October?
options: Ruby
Opal
Sapphire
Amethyst
explanation: The opal is the birthstone for October and is known for flashing many rainbow colors.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Oktubre ay ang opal, na nagpapakita ng maraming kulay na parang bahaghari.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Oktubre kay ang opal, nga nagpakita og daghang kolor sama sa balangaw.

q: Which is the largest gulf in the Philippines?
options: Davao Gulf
Manila Bay
Moro Gulf
Leyte Gulf
explanation: The Moro Gulf is the largest gulf in the Philippines, followed by the Davao Gulf.
fact_tl: Ang Moro Gulf ang pinakamalaking look (gulf) sa Pilipinas, sinusundan ng Davao Gulf.
fact_bis: Ang Moro Gulf mao ang pinakadako nga luok (gulf) sa Pilipinas, gisundan sa Davao Gulf.

q: Who patented the Sing-Along System, the machine that led to modern karaoke machines?
options: Roberto del Rosario
Jose Rizal
Diosdado Banatao
Eduardo San Juan
explanation: Roberto del Rosario, a Filipino inventor, patented the Sing-Along System, the karaoke-type machine he developed.
fact_tl: Si Roberto del Rosario, isang Pilipino, ang nag-patent ng Sing-Along System, ang uri ng karaoke machine na siya ang gumawa.
fact_bis: Si Roberto del Rosario, usa ka Pilipino, mao ang nag-patent sa Sing-Along System, ang matang sa karaoke machine nga iyang gihimo.

q: What role do the bacteria and fungi living in the soil play for plants?
options: They cycle nutrients, decompose organic matter, and protect plants from disease
They make the soil softer so roots can dig deeper into the ground
They produce sunlight for plants that grow in shady areas
They turn rainwater into sugar that the plant can absorb directly
explanation: The soil microbiome — thousands of bacteria and fungi species — cycles nutrients, decomposes organic matter, and protects plants from pathogens.
fact_tl: Ang soil microbiome—ang libu-libong uri ng bakterya at fungi sa lupa—ay mahalaga para sa kalusugan ng halaman; nagtutulungan sila sa pag-cycle ng mga sustansya, pag-decompose ng organikong bagay, at proteksyon ng halaman mula sa mga pathogen.
fact_bis: Ang soil microbiome—libu-libong klase sa bakterya ug fungi sa yuta—importante para sa kahimsog sa tanum; nagtabang sila sa pag-cycle sa sustansya, pagbulsak sa organiko nga bagay, ug pagprotekta sa tanum gikan sa mga pathogen.

q: Why does a gray carabao appear darker right after it gets wet from rain?
options: Its skin produces more dark pigment when cold water touches it
Water keeps light from bouncing off its skin, making it look darker
Its gray hairs turn black when they absorb water
Mud from the rain sticks to its skin and changes its color
explanation: Water keeps light from bouncing off the carabao's skin, which makes it look darker when wet.
fact_tl: Mas madilim ang itsura ng kulay-abong kalabaw kapag basa, dahil pinipigil ng tubig ang liwanag na tumalbog sa balat nito.
fact_bis: Mas itom og dagway ang abuhon nga kalabaw kon basa, tungod kay ang tubig magpugong sa kahayag nga mosumbalik gikan sa panit niini.

q: What kinds of animals does the Philippine eagle mainly hunt and eat?
options: Small insects and beetles found on the forest floor
Large tree animals such as flying lemurs and sometimes monkeys and birds
Fish caught from rivers and mountain streams
Fruits and large seeds from tall rainforest trees
explanation: The Philippine eagle eats large tree animals such as flying lemurs and sometimes even monkeys and birds.
fact_tl: Kumakain ang Philippine eagle ng malalaking hayop sa puno tulad ng kagwang o flying lemur, at minsan pa nga unggoy at mga ibon.
fact_bis: Mokaon ang Philippine eagle og dagkong hayop sa kahoy sama sa kagwang o flying lemur, ug usahay bisan unggoy ug mga langgam.

q: What event caused a tsunami that struck the coasts of Mindanao in 1976?
options: A powerful volcanic eruption under Moro Gulf
A strong earthquake in the Moro Gulf
A giant underwater landslide near Leyte
A super typhoon that hit the Moro Gulf coastline
explanation: In 1976, a strong earthquake in the Moro Gulf caused a tsunami that struck the coasts of Mindanao.
fact_tl: Noong 1976, isang malakas na lindol sa Moro Gulf ang nagdala ng tsunami na sumalanta sa baybayin ng Mindanao.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1976, usa ka kusog nga linog sa Moro Gulf ang nagdala ug tsunami nga miigo sa baybayon sa Mindanao.

q: Why do most wind turbines use exactly three blades instead of more?
options: Three blades spin smoothly and stay balanced, while more blades add weight and cost without catching much extra energy
Three blades are lighter than one or two, so they spin even in light winds
Factories can only produce three-bladed designs with current tools and materials
Three blades produce three times more electricity than a single-blade design
explanation: Three blades spin smoothly and stay balanced; adding more blades makes the turbine heavier and costlier without catching much more energy.
fact_tl: Karaniwang tatlong pako lang ang wind turbine dahil iyon na ang pinakamatatag at panatag na bilang na umiikot nang pantay-pantay; mas maraming pako ay mas mabigat at mas magastos nang hindi gaanong nadaragdag ang enerhiya.
fact_bis: Kasagaran tulo ra ka pako ang wind turbine kay kana na ang labing lig-on ug timbang nga gidaghanon nga motuyok nga patas; ang mas daghang pako mas bug-at ug mas mahal nga dili kaayo modugang sa enerhiya.

q: What are the two main jobs of the pelvis in your body?
options: It supports the upper body and protects the organs inside it
It connects the spine to the skull and protects the spinal cord
It pumps blood to the legs and stores extra calcium for the bones
It holds the shoulder blades in place and protects the lungs
explanation: The pelvis supports the upper body and protects the organs inside it.
fact_tl: Ang balakang (pelvis) ay sumusuporta sa itaas na bahagi ng katawan at nagpoprotekta sa mga organong nasa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang bat-ang (pelvis) nagsuporta sa ibabaw nga bahin sa lawas ug nagpanalipod sa mga organo sa sulod niini.

q: What color of light do you get when you combine red, green, and blue light together?
options: Yellow
Black
Purple
White
explanation: When red, green, and blue light are combined, they make white light.
fact_tl: Kapag pinagsama ang pula, berde, at asul na liwanag, nabubuo ang puting liwanag.
fact_bis: Kung isagol ang pula, berde, ug asul nga kahayag, mahimo kini nga puti nga kahayag.

q: How do many plants survive the dry season even after their stems and leaves wither?
options: They get water from dew that collects on pebbles near their roots
They stop growing completely and restart only when rainfall returns
They have stored food energy in their roots that lets them grow back when conditions improve
They shed their bark to reduce water loss until the rains come
explanation: Many plants store food in their roots, so even when the top withers in a dry season, the root holds saved energy that lets the plant grow back.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang nag-iimbak ng pagkain sa kanilang ugat. Kapag dumating ang tag-tuyot o malamig na panahon at nalalanta ang itaas, may nakaimbak na lakas ang ugat para muling tumubo ang halaman paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang magtipig og pagkaon sa ilang gamot. Kon moabot ang ting-init o bugnaw nga panahon ug malaya ang ibabaw, ang gamot adunay natipigang kusog aron motubo pag-usab ang tanom kon mouli ang maayong panahon.

q: Which seeds are carried the farthest by the wind?
options: Seeds that are large and round so they can roll on the ground
Seeds that are small and light so the wind can carry them farther
Seeds that have a hard coat to protect them during long journeys
Seeds that are sticky so they attach to passing animals
explanation: The smaller and lighter a seed is, the farther the wind can carry it before it lands on the ground.
fact_tl: Mas magaan at maliit ang binhi, mas malayo ito maaaring dalhin ng hangin bago bumagsak sa lupa.
fact_bis: Mas gamay ug mas gaan ang liso, mas layo kini madala sa hangin sa dili pa kini monaog sa yuta.

q: A fixed pulley is attached to the top of a flagpole. How much force do you need to pull the rope to lift a flag?
options: Half as much force, because the pulley shares the load equally
The same amount of force as the weight of the flag
Twice as much force, because the rope changes direction and adds friction
A quarter of the force, because the pulley multiplies your effort four times
explanation: A fixed pulley does not reduce the force you need; you still pull as hard as the load weighs.
fact_tl: Ang nakapirming kalo ay hindi nagbabawas ng pwersang kailangan; kasimbigat pa rin ng bagay ang dapat mong hilahin.
fact_bis: Ang pixo nga polea wala magbawas sa kusog nga gikinahanglan; bira-on pa gihapon nimo ang sama kabug-at sa karga.

q: What happens to an animal's body temperature during hibernation?
options: It rises sharply to help the animal burn stored fat quickly
It stays the same because the animal's fur insulates it
It drops greatly so the animal's body becomes nearly cold
It goes up and down in cycles throughout the hibernation period
explanation: In hibernation an animal's body temperature drops greatly, so its body becomes nearly cold.
fact_tl: Sa hibernation ay bumababa nang malaki ang temperatura ng katawan ng hayop, kaya halos malamig na ito.
fact_bis: Sa hibernation mokunhod pag-ayo ang temperatura sa lawas sa mananap, mao nga halos mibugnaw na kini.

q: How are the rows and columns of the periodic table named?
options: Rows are called groups and columns are called periods
Rows are called periods and columns are called groups
Rows are called series and columns are called families
Rows are called blocks and columns are called tiers
explanation: The periodic table is arranged in horizontal rows called periods and vertical columns called groups, with elements of similar properties near each other.
fact_tl: Ang periodic table ay nakaayos sa mga pahalang na hanay na tinatawag na periods at mga pababang haligi na tinatawag na groups. Magkakatabi ang mga elementong magkakatulad ang katangian.
fact_bis: Ang periodic table giplano sa pinahigda nga mga laray nga gitawag og periods ug pinahiluna nga mga kolum nga gitawag og groups. Ang mga elemento nga managsama og kinaiya magkatupad.

q: What happens to the atoms and molecules inside a material when it gets hotter?
options: They slow down and pack more tightly together
They stop moving and wait until the material cools down
They move faster
They break apart into smaller pieces that spread evenly
explanation: All atoms and molecules are always moving, and they move faster when the material is hotter.
fact_tl: Ang lahat ng atomo at molekula ay laging gumagalaw o nanginginig; mas mabilis silang gumalaw kapag mas mainit ang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang tanang atomo ug molekula kanunayng naglihok o nagkurog; mas paspas sila molihok kon mas init ang butang.

q: What does it mean when you start sweating a lot after having a fever?
options: It means the fever is getting worse and you need medicine right away
It means your body is cooling itself down because the fever is starting to drop
It means your body is running out of water and you must drink immediately
It means the sickness has spread and you need to go to the hospital
explanation: When a fever starts to drop, you often sweat a lot — that's a sign your body is cooling itself down because the hot part of the fight is over.
fact_tl: Kapag nagsisimula nang bumaba ang lagnat, madalas kang pinapawisan nang husto. Iyan ay senyales na pinapalamig na ng katawan ang sarili nito dahil tapos na ang init na bahagi ng laban. Palitan mo ang basang damit at magpahinga pa rin.
fact_bis: Kung magsugod na pagkunhod ang hilanat, kasagaran mosingot ka ug daghan. Kana usa ka senyales nga gipabugnaw na sa lawas ang kaugalingon kay human na ang init nga bahin sa pakig-away. Ilisi ang basa nga sanina ug padayon sa pagpahulay.

q: How do temperature changes during the day and night slowly break apart rocks?
options: Rain seeps into the rock and freezes at night, pushing the rock apart instantly
Rock expands when heated and shrinks when cooled; repeating this over and over weakens and cracks it
Wind carries tiny sand grains that scratch deep grooves into the surface of the rock
Sunlight changes the minerals in the rock into a softer material that crumbles easily
explanation: Rock expands when heated in the sun and shrinks when it cools at night; repeating this over and over weakens and cracks the rock.
fact_tl: Kapag uminit ang bato sa araw, lumalawak ito, at kapag lumamig sa gabi, umuurong ito. Ang paulit-ulit na ito ay nagpapahina at nagbabasag ng bato.
fact_bis: Kung moinit ang bato sa adlaw molapad kini, ug kung mobugnaw sa gabii mokunhod kini. Kining balik-balik makapahuyang ug makaguba sa bato.

q: What is the highest possible number on the earthquake magnitude scale?
options: There is no fixed highest number — the scale is open-ended
explanation: The earthquake magnitude scale has no fixed highest number; it is open-ended.
fact_tl: Ang magnitude scale ng lindol ay walang itinakdang pinakamataas na numero.
fact_bis: Ang magnitude scale sa linog walay gitakdang kinatas-ang numero; abli kini.

q: How does a nautilus grow compared to most sea animals?
options: It grows very rapidly, reaching adult size within just a few weeks
It grows in short bursts only during warmer months of the year
It grows slowly and takes many years to reach adulthood
It stops growing once its shell is fully formed in its first year
explanation: The nautilus lives a long life and grows slowly, taking many years to reach adulthood.
fact_tl: Mahaba ang buhay ng nautilus at mabagal itong lumaki, kaya tumatagal pa bago ito maging hustong-gulang.
fact_bis: Taas ang kinabuhi sa nautilus ug hinay kini motubo, mao nga dugay pa una kini mahimong hamtong.

q: Why does a solid keep its firm shape without needing a container?
options: Its particles repel each other and spread out evenly in all directions
Its tiny particles are packed very close together and can barely move
The particles form a rigid liquid layer on the outside that holds the shape
Heat energy locks the particles into position so they cannot shift at all
explanation: A solid keeps its firm shape because its tiny particles are packed very close together and can barely move.
fact_tl: Ang isang solid ay may matigas na hugis dahil ang napakaliit na mga piraso (particles) nito ay magkakadikit nang husto at halos hindi makagalaw. Kaya naman hindi nito basta-basta nababago ang hugis.
fact_bis: Ang solid adunay gahi nga porma kay ang gagmay kaayo nga mga tipik (particles) niini magkadikit pag-ayo ug halos dili makalihok. Mao nga dili dali mausab ang porma niini.

q: Why is secondhand smoke especially dangerous for babies and small children?
options: Their skin is thinner, so smoke chemicals pass directly into their blood more easily
They breathe faster than adults, so more smoke enters their bodies, and their lungs are still small
They cannot tell adults when they feel sick, so the problem goes unnoticed for longer
Their immune systems overreact to smoke and trigger dangerous allergic responses
explanation: Babies and children breathe faster than adults, so more smoke enters their bodies, and their lungs are still small and easily harmed.
fact_tl: Bakit mas delikado ang secondhand smoke sa sanggol at maliit na bata? Mas mabilis silang huminga kaysa adulto, kaya mas maraming usok ang pumapasok sa katawan nila. Maliit pa rin ang baga nila, kaya mas madali silang magkasakit sa baga at ubo.
fact_bis: Ngano mas delikado ang secondhand smoke sa masuso ug gagmay nga bata? Mas paspas sila moginhawa kaysa sa hamtong, mao nga mas daghang aso ang mosulod sa ilang lawas. Gamay pa sad ang ilang baga, mao nga mas dali sila magsakit sa baga ug ubo.

q: What happens to a barnacle's hard outer shell as the animal grows bigger?
options: The barnacle leaves its old shell and finds a larger empty shell nearby
The shell stays the same size and the barnacle squeezes itself to fit
The barnacle slowly adds to and enlarges the wall plates around it so it never runs out of room
The shell dissolves in seawater and is replaced by a brand-new shell each year
explanation: As the barnacle grows inside, it slowly adds to and enlarges the hard wall plates around it so it never runs out of room.
fact_tl: Habang lumalaki ang barnacle sa loob, dahan-dahan nitong dinadagdagan at pinapalaki ang matigas na platong pader sa palibot para hindi siya masikipan.
fact_bis: Samtang motubo ang barnacle sa sulod, hinay-hinay niini nga dugangan ug padak-on ang gahi nga paril nga plato sa palibot aron dili masikip.

q: What do aphids feed on in a plant?
options: The water stored inside leaf cells after morning dew collects
The sugary phloem sap, the fluid the plant uses to carry its food
The hard woody material in the stem that supports the plant upright
The pollen produced in the flowers at the top of the plant
explanation: Aphids feed on the sugary phloem sap, the fluid a plant uses to carry its sugar-made food.
fact_tl: Sinisipsip ng aphid ang matamis na katas (phloem), ang likidong dinadala ng halaman ang pagkaing gawa sa asukal.
fact_bis: Ang aphid nagasupsop sa matam-is nga duga (phloem) nga maoy gidala sa tanom sa pagkaong asukal.

q: How does a tsunami behave when it is still out in the deep ocean?
options: It forms a very tall wall of water that ships must avoid
It creates a whirlpool that sucks boats downward
It is only a low wave that ships can barely feel pass beneath them
It travels slowly, giving coastal towns many hours to prepare
explanation: Out in the deep ocean, a tsunami is only low, so ships can barely feel it pass.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng malalim na dagat, mababa lang ang tsunami kaya halos hindi ito mahalata ng mga barko.
fact_bis: Sa taliwala sa lawom nga dagat, ubos ra ang tsunami mao nga halos dili kini mabati sa mga barko.

q: How do the tears on the surface of your eyes help you see clearly?
options: Tears warm the eye so the lens can focus light more accurately
The thin film of tears makes a smooth surface on the front of the eye, allowing you to see clearly
Tears wash away bacteria that would otherwise cloud your vision permanently
Tears contain a special chemical that strengthens the muscles that move the eyeball
explanation: The thin film of tears makes a smooth surface on the front of the eye; when the eye is dry, your vision can get blurry.
fact_tl: Ang manipis na luha ay gumagawa ng makinis na patong sa harap ng mata. Dahil makinis ito, malinaw ang nakikita mo. Kapag tuyo ang mata, nagiging malabo ang paningin.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga luha maghimo og hapsay nga patong sa atubangan sa mata. Tungod kay hapsay kini, klaro ang imong makita. Kung uga ang mata, mahimong hanap ang panan-aw.

q: How does the cleaner wrasse fish help larger fish on a coral reef?
options: It leads larger fish to areas with more food so they do not compete
It removes parasites from larger fish, benefiting both species
It builds hiding spots in the coral where larger fish can rest safely
It chases away predators that would otherwise attack the larger fish
explanation: The cleaner wrasse removes parasites from larger fish, with both species benefiting from the arrangement — a mutualistic relationship.
fact_tl: Ang cleaner wrasse ay isang maliit na isda sa coral reef na nag-aalis ng mga parasito sa mas malalaking isda, at ang dalawang magkaibang species na ito ay parehong nakikinabang.
fact_bis: Ang cleaner wrasse usa ka gamay nga isda sa coral reef nga nagtangtang sa mga parasito sa mas dagkong isda, ug ang duha ka lain-laing species kapwa nakiginabaw sa kahusayan.

q: When you stir sugar into water and it disappears, what kind of change has taken place?
options: A chemical change, because the sugar is destroyed and cannot be recovered
A physical change, because it is still sugar and the water still tastes sweet
A biological change, because tiny organisms in the water broke down the sugar
A thermal change, because heat from your hand melted the sugar into a liquid
explanation: Sugar dissolving in water is a physical change because it is still sugar and the water still tastes sweet.
fact_tl: Ang pagkatunaw ng asukal sa tubig ay pisikal na pagbabago dahil asukal pa rin ito at matamis pa rin ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagkatunaw sa asukal sa tubig kay pisikal nga kabag-ohan kay asukal man gihapon kini ug matam-is gihapon ang tubig.

q: What happens in a tropical lake that develops thermal stratification?
options: Warm water sinks to the bottom and cold water rises to the top, making the whole lake equally fertile
The lake freezes in layers from the surface down, trapping fish in the warmer lower layer
Warm oxygenated water stays on top and cold low-oxygen water stays below, preventing nutrients from mixing
All the water in the lake heats up evenly, causing oxygen levels to rise throughout
explanation: Tropical lakes can develop thermal stratification — warm, oxygenated water on top and cold, low-oxygen water below — which prevents nutrients from mixing.
fact_tl: Ang mga tropical lake ay maaaring magkaroon ng thermal stratification — mainit at may oxygen na tubig sa ibabaw (epilimnion) at malamig at kakaunti ang oxygen sa ilalim (hypolimnion) — na pumipigil sa paghalo ng mga sustansya.
fact_bis: Ang mga tropical lake mahimong adunay thermal stratification — mainit, may oxygen nga tubig sa ibabaw (epilimnion) ug bugnaw, ubos-oxygen nga tubig sa ilawom (hypolimnion) — nga nagpugong sa pagsagol sa mga sustansya.

q: Why do warm-blooded animals need to eat more food than cold-blooded animals of the same size?
options: They have larger stomachs that can store more food at one time
They use food energy to make body heat, which cold-blooded animals do not need to do
They move faster and use up more energy chasing their prey every day
They have to feed their young, which cold-blooded animals rarely do
explanation: Warm-blooded animals need more food because they use its energy to make body heat.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng mga hayop na mainit ang dugo ng mas maraming pagkain dahil ginagamit nila ang enerhiya nito para gumawa ng init.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap nga mainiton ug dugo nagkinahanglan ug mas daghang pagkaon kay gamiton nila ang enerhiya niini sa paghimo ug init.

q: How many stages does incomplete metamorphosis have, and what are they?
options: Four stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult
Two stages: egg and adult only
Three stages: egg, nymph, and adult
Five stages: egg, nymph, larva, pupa, and adult
explanation: Incomplete metamorphosis has only three stages — egg, nymph, and adult — with no pupa stage.
fact_tl: Ang hindi ganap na metamorphosis ay may tatlong yugto lamang: itlog, nymph, at adult—walang pupa.
fact_bis: Ang dili kompleto nga metamorphosis adunay tulo ka yugto lamang: itlog, nymph, ug hamtong—walay pupa.

q: Why are solids and liquids very difficult to squeeze or compress?
options: Their particles are constantly moving too fast to be pushed together
Their particles are already close together, leaving little room to compress
They contain special bonds that create an invisible shield against pressure
They always push back with twice the force applied to them
explanation: Unlike a gas, solids and liquids are very hard to squeeze because their particles are already close together.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng gas, mahirap siksikin ang solido at likido dahil magkadikit na ang mga partikulo nito.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa gas, lisod pug-on ang solido ug likido kay duol na ang ilang mga partikulo.

q: How does vaccinating many children help people who are NOT vaccinated?
options: Vaccinated children produce antibodies that they share through touch with unvaccinated children
When many children are vaccinated, the disease has a harder time spreading, so others are protected too
Vaccines train doctors to treat the disease faster, helping all patients in the community
Vaccinated children become immune to all diseases, not just the one in the vaccine
explanation: When many children are vaccinated, the disease has a harder time spreading, so other people who were not vaccinated are protected too.
fact_tl: Kapag maraming bata ang nabakunahan, mas mahihirapang kumalat ang sakit, kaya naprotektahan din ang ibang tao.
fact_bis: Kung daghang bata ang nabakunahan, maglisod pagkaylap ang sakit, mao nga mapanalipdan usab ang ubang tawo.

q: Where in a plant does mitosis happen the fastest?
options: In the flower petals, where new cells must form every season
In the oldest leaves, where damaged cells are replaced quickly
At the tip of the plant's root, where growth is most active
In the bark of the stem, where the plant adds new layers each year
explanation: Mitosis happens faster in growing parts, like the tip of a plant's root.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis nangyayari ang mitosis sa mga bahaging lumalaki, gaya ng dulo ng ugat ng halaman.
fact_bis: Mas paspas mahitabo ang mitosis sa mga bahin nga nagtubo, sama sa tumoy sa gamot sa tanom.

q: What does a change in the frequency of an allele in a population over time tell scientists?
options: It shows that the population is growing too large and needs to be controlled
It shows that evolution is occurring in that population
It shows that the species is about to go extinct in that area
It shows that the animals are breeding with a different species nearby
explanation: Population genetics studies allele frequencies in a population — when the frequency of an allele changes over time, it is a sign that evolution is occurring.
fact_tl: Ang population genetics ay pag-aaral ng frequency ng mga allele sa isang populasyon — kapag ang frequency ng isang allele ay nagbabago sa paglipas ng panahon, ito ay isang palatandaan ng ebolusyon na nagaganap.
fact_bis: Ang population genetics pag-aaral sa frequency sa mga allele sa usa ka populasyon — sa dihang ang frequency sa usa ka allele nagbag-o sa paglabay sa panahon, kini usa ka timaan nga ang ebolusyon nagahinabo.

q: How does the carabao typically work in the fields?
options: In short fast bursts followed by long rest periods
Slowly but steadily and patiently
Only in the early morning when it is coolest
Very quickly so it can finish the work before noon
explanation: The carabao works slowly but steadily and patiently in the fields.
fact_tl: Mabagal pero matiyaga at masipag magtrabaho ang kalabaw sa bukid.
fact_bis: Hinay apan mapailubon ug kugihan motrabaho ang kalabaw sa uma.

q: What makes the carabao a ruminant?
options: It can survive for weeks without drinking water like a camel
It chews its food again after swallowing to digest it more fully
It eats both plants and small animals to get enough protein
It has a single large stomach that digests food very quickly
explanation: The carabao is a ruminant — a mammal that chews its food again after swallowing to digest it fully, just like cows and goats.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay 'ruminant,' isang uri ng mammal na ngumunguya muli ng pagkaing nasa tiyan na nito para lubos itong matunaw, tulad din ng baka at kambing.
fact_bis: Ang kalabaw usa ka 'ruminant,' usa ka matang sa mammal nga mousab ug usap sa pagkaon nga gilamoy na niini aron matunaw pag-ayo, sama sa baka ug kanding.

q: What causes the colorful lights in the sky called auroras?
options: Moonlight reflecting off thick ice sheets near the Earth's poles
Particles from the solar wind hitting the air high above Earth near the poles, making it glow
Lightning storms high in the atmosphere that are too far away to hear
Gases escaping from volcanoes that glow when they reach the upper atmosphere
explanation: Auroras are caused by the Sun — when particles from the solar wind hit the air high above Earth near the poles, that air glows and turns into colorful lights.
fact_tl: Ang magagandang kulay-kulay na ilaw sa langit na tinatawag na aurora (northern at southern lights) ay dulot ng Araw — kapag tumama ang mga particle mula sa solar wind sa hangin sa itaas ng Mundo malapit sa mga poste, nagliliwanag ang hanging iyon at nagiging makukulay na ilaw.
fact_bis: Ang nindot ug bulokon nga kahayag sa langit nga gitawag og aurora (northern ug southern lights) tungod sa Adlaw — kung ang mga particle gikan sa solar wind moigo sa hangin sa taas sa Kalibutan duol sa mga poste, modan-ag kana nga hangin ug mahimong bulokon nga kahayag.

q: How do a flamingo's feet help it move through its muddy habitat?
options: Its long curved claws grip slippery rocks so it does not fall into the water
Webbed skin between its toes helps it walk on soft mud without sinking
Its feet are very wide and flat, acting like snowshoes on the muddy surface
Air pockets between its toes keep it from sinking when it steps on soft ground
explanation: A flamingo has webbed skin between its toes that helps it walk on soft mud.
fact_tl: May lapat na balat sa pagitan ng mga daliri ng paa ng flamingo na tumutulong dito sa paglakad sa malambot na putik.
fact_bis: Adunay lapat nga panit tunga-tunga sa mga tudlo sa tiil sa flamingo nga makatabang niini sa paglakaw sa humok nga lapok.

q: Why do your eyes blink automatically when something comes near them?
options: Blinking cleans the surface of the eye and keeps it from drying out permanently
Blinking is a reflex that protects the eyes when something comes near or dust appears
Blinking sends a signal to the brain to prepare the eyes for danger ahead
Blinking lowers eye pressure whenever light suddenly becomes too bright
explanation: Your eyes blink automatically when something comes near or dust appears as a reflex to protect them.
fact_tl: Awtomatikong kumukurap ang iyong mga mata kapag may lumapit na bagay o alikabok, para maprotektahan sila.
fact_bis: Awtomatikong mopamilok ang imong mga mata kung adunay moduol nga butang o abog, aron maprotektahan sila.

q: Why do architects pay special attention to the shape and materials of concert halls?
options: To make the hall look beautiful so audiences feel excited before the music starts
The shape and materials control how long sound reverberates and whether it reaches all seats equally
To reduce outside noise by making thick walls that completely block street sounds
To ensure the lighting bounces evenly off the ceiling so musicians can read their music
explanation: Concert halls are designed with acoustics in mind — the shape, materials, and dimensions determine how long reverberation lasts and whether sound reaches all seats equally well.
fact_tl: Ang mga concert hall ay dinisenyo nang may pag-iisip sa acoustics — ang mga anyo, materyales, at sukat ng silid ay nagtatakda kung gaano katagal ang reverberation at kung pantay ang pamamahagi ng tunog sa lahat ng upuan.
fact_bis: Ang mga concert hall gidisenyohan nga adunay pag-isip sa acoustics — ang porma, mga materyal, ug sukatan nagtino kung hangtod kanus-a ang reverberation ug kung pantay ang pamamahagi sa tunog sa tanang lingkoranan.

q: How do healthy coral reefs help the people living near them?
options: They block ocean currents so fishing boats can safely leave the harbor every day
They attract tourists who snorkel and dive, bringing income and jobs to coastal communities
They cool the nearby ocean water so typhoons weaken before reaching the shore
They provide fresh water that coastal villages collect for drinking and cooking
explanation: Beautiful coral reefs draw tourists who want to snorkel and dive, bringing income and jobs to boat operators, guides, and lodge owners in coastal communities.
fact_tl: Ang magagandang coral reef ay nagdadala ng turista na gustong mag-snorkel at mag-diving para makita ang mga isda at coral. Nagbibigay ito ng kita at trabaho sa mga taga-baybayin tulad ng mga bangkero, gabay, at may-ari ng mga turuhan. Kaya ang pag-aalaga sa reef ay hindi lang para sa hayop, kundi para din sa kabuhayan ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang nindot nga coral reef magdani og turista nga gustong mo-snorkel ug mo-diving aron makita ang isda ug coral. Naghatag kini og kita ug trabaho sa mga taga-baybayon sama sa mga tigbugsay, giya, ug tag-iya sa puy-anan. Busa ang pag-amping sa reef dili lang alang sa mga mananap kondili alang usab sa panginabuhi sa mga tawo.

q: How is a concave lens different from a convex lens?
options: A concave lens is thick in the middle and makes things look bigger; a convex lens is thin in the middle and makes things look smaller
A concave lens is thin in the middle and makes things look smaller; a convex lens is thick in the middle and makes things look bigger
A concave lens bends light toward a point; a convex lens scatters light in all directions equally
A concave lens only works in water; a convex lens only works in air
explanation: A concave lens is thin in the middle and makes things look smaller, while a convex lens is thick in the middle and makes things look bigger — they are opposites in shape and effect.
fact_tl: Ang concave lens ay manipis sa gitna at pinapaliit ang bagay, samantalang ang convex lens ay makapal sa gitna at pinapalaki. Magkasalungat sila ng hugis at gawa.
fact_bis: Ang concave lens nipis sa tunga ug magpagamay sa butang, samtang ang convex lens baga sa tunga ug magpadako. Magkaatbang sila ug porma ug epekto.

q: Which Philippine provinces were hit hardest by the powerful storm surge of Typhoon Yolanda in 2013?
options: Batanes and Cagayan in northern Luzon
Palawan and Mindoro in the western Philippines
Leyte and Samar in the Eastern Visayas
Davao and South Cotabato in Mindanao
explanation: Typhoon Yolanda in 2013 caused widespread destruction in Leyte and Samar, including a powerful storm surge.
fact_tl: Ang Bagyong Yolanda noong 2013 ay isa sa pinakamalalakas na bagyo na natala sa kasaysayan at nagdulot ng malawak na pinsala sa Leyte at Samar, pati na rin ng malakas na storm surge.
fact_bis: Ang Bagyong Yolanda niadtong 2013 usa sa pinakakusog nga mga bagyo nga natala sa kasaysayan ug nagdala og lapad nga pagkaguba sa Leyte ug Samar, apil ang kusog nga storm surge.

q: Who is considered the world's first computer programmer?
options: Marie Curie
Grace Hopper
Ada Lovelace
Alan Turing
explanation: Ada Lovelace is considered the first computer programmer.
fact_tl: Si Ada Lovelace ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer.
fact_bis: Si Ada Lovelace giila nga unang computer programmer.

q: What can the tuko and house geckos found in Philippine homes do with their tails that is very unusual?
options: They can change the color of their tail to blend in with the wall
They can make their tail longer to grab food from a distance
They can shed their tail when threatened, and it grows back
They can vibrate their tail to make a sound that warns predators away
explanation: The tuko and house geckos can shed their tail when threatened, and it grows back.
fact_tl: Ang tuko at mga tiki sa bahay sa Pilipinas ay kayang putulin ang buntot kapag nasugatan, at tutubo itong muli.
fact_bis: Ang tuko ug ang mga tiki sa balay sa Pilipinas makahimo sa pagputol sa ilang ikog kung mabahad, ug motubo kini pag-usab.

q: How does a padyak move forward when you push the pedals?
options: Pushing the pedals creates heat energy that turns the rear wheel automatically
Pushing the pedals sends force through a chain to the wheel, moving it even when loaded with heavy sacks
Pushing the pedals pumps air into the tires, which push against the ground to move forward
Pushing the pedals turns a gear that stores energy in a spring, which then releases to spin the wheel
explanation: A padyak is powered by human strength — pushing the pedals sends force through a chain to the wheel, moving it even when loaded with heavy sacks.
fact_tl: Ang padyak ay pinatatakbo ng lakas ng tao—kapag tinatadyakan ang pedal, naililipat ng kadena ang puwersa sa gulong para gumalaw kahit may dalang mabibigat na sako.
fact_bis: Ang padyak gipalihok sa kusog sa tawo—kon tamakon ang pedal, ang kadena magbalhin sa puwersa ngadto sa ligid aron molihok bisan og bug-at ang gikarga nga mga sako.

q: What is the difference between an organism's genotype and its phenotype?
options: The genotype is what you can see, like eye color; the phenotype is the hidden set of genes inside
The genotype is the combination of alleles an organism carries; the phenotype is the trait you can actually observe, like eye color
The genotype controls body shape only; the phenotype controls behavior only
The genotype changes throughout life as cells divide; the phenotype stays fixed from birth
