explanation: The genotype is the combination of alleles an organism carries, while the phenotype is the trait you can actually observe — the genotype produces the phenotype.
fact_tl: Ang genotype ay ang kombinasyon ng mga allele na taglay ng isang organismo, habang ang phenotype ay ang katangiang nakikita o lumalabas, tulad ng kulay ng mata; ang genotype ang dahilan ng phenotype.
fact_bis: Ang genotype mao ang kombinasyon sa mga allele nga gibatonan sa usa ka organismo, samtang ang phenotype mao ang kinaiya nga makita o mamatikdan, sama sa kolor sa mata; ang genotype maoy hinungdan sa phenotype.

q: Which mold releases a chemical from its hyphae that kills harmful bacteria and led to the discovery of penicillin?
options: Penicillium mold
Aspergillus mold
Bread mold (Rhizopus)
Rust fungus
explanation: The Penicillium mold releases a bacteria-killing chemical from its hyphae, which became the antibiotic penicillin.
fact_tl: May mga fungi na nakakatulong sa tao: ang amag na Penicillium ay naglalabas ng kemikal mula sa hyphae nito na pumapatay sa nakakasakit na bacteria. Mula rito ginawa ang PENICILLIN, isang gamot (antibiotic) na nakapagligtas ng milyon-milyong buhay sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Adunay mga fungi nga makatabang sa tawo: ang agup-op nga Penicillium mubuga og kemikal gikan sa hyphae niini nga mupatay sa makadaot nga bacteria. Gikan niini gihimo ang PENICILLIN, usa ka tambal (antibiotic) nga nakaluwas og minilyon nga kinabuhi sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: Why is drinking sea water dangerous even though your body needs salt?
options: Sea water is too salty and makes you even thirstier instead of satisfying your thirst
Sea water contains no minerals that the body can use
Sea water has too many germs that cause stomach sickness
Sea water is too cold and slows down your digestion
explanation: Sea water is so salty that the body must work hard to remove the extra salt, making you feel thirstier rather than hydrated.
fact_tl: Kahit may asin ang katawan, hindi tama na uminom ng tubig-dagat para makakuha nito. Sobrang alat ng tubig-dagat kaya sa halip na mapawi ang uhaw, lalo ka pang mauuhaw. Kailangan pa ngang magtrabaho nang husto ang katawan para alisin ang labis na asin mula rito.
fact_bis: Bisan og nagkinahanglan ang lawas ug asin, dili husto nga moinom og tubig-dagat aron makakuha niini. Parat kaayo ang tubig-dagat mao nga imbes mawala ang imong kauhaw, mas mauhaw ka pa. Kinahanglan pa maghago pag-ayo ang lawas aron kuhaon ang sobra nga asin gikan niini.

q: What does a fertilized coral egg become before it settles down and grows into a new polyp?
options: A planula larva that swims freely
A spore that drifts on ocean currents
A tiny polyp that attaches immediately
A juvenile medusa that floats near the surface
explanation: A fertilized coral egg develops into a free-swimming planula larva, which later settles on a hard surface and grows into a new polyp.
fact_tl: Ang fertilized na itlog ng coral ay nagiging planula larva na lumalagoy sa tubig bago lumapag sa matigas na ibabaw at magsimulang lumaki bilang bagong polyp.
fact_bis: Ang fertilized nga itlog sa coral mahimong planula larva nga molangoy nga gawasnon sa wala pa molandong sa lig-on nga ibabaw ug modako isip bag-ong polyp.

q: What do some snails do during very hot, dry weather to keep from drying out?
options: They hide inside their shells and seal the opening with mucus
They burrow deep into wet soil and wait for rain
They absorb water through their shells from the humid air
They travel to shaded areas and group together to stay moist
explanation: In very hot, dry weather some snails seal themselves inside their shells with mucus to prevent drying out — a behavior called estivation.
fact_tl: Kapag napakainit at tuyot, nagtatago ang ilang suso sa loob ng kanilang shell at sinasarhan ito ng uhog para hindi sila matuyo.
fact_bis: Kon hilabihan ka init ug uga, motago ang pipila ka kuhol sulod sa ilang talukab ug selyohan kini og uhog aron dili sila mauga.

q: Besides extreme heat, which of the following can also cause coral bleaching?
options: Too much sunlight, pollution, and changes in the water's saltiness
Strong ocean currents, darkness, and fish overpopulation
Increased fish diversity, deep water pressure, and cold temperatures
Heavy rainfall, sand storms, and low oxygen levels
explanation: In addition to heat, coral bleaching can be triggered by too much sunlight, pollution, and changes in the water's saltiness.
fact_tl: Bukod sa init, ang sobrang sikat ng araw, polusyon, at pagbabago sa alat ng tubig ay maaari ring magdulot ng coral bleaching.
fact_bis: Gawas sa init, ang sobra nga silaw sa adlaw, polusyon, ug kausaban sa kaparat sa tubig mahimo usab nga hinungdan sa coral bleaching.

q: After the rice harvest, what is one useful thing that rice straw (dayami) can be made into?
options: Compost for fertilizer
Cotton thread for weaving cloth
Cooking oil for frying
Soap for washing dishes
explanation: Rice straw can be used as animal feed, garden mulch, compost for fertilizer, or for making baskets and other goods.
fact_tl: Ang dayami (rice straw) pagkatapos ng ani ay maaaring gamitin bilang pagkain ng hayop, mulch sa taniman, compost para sa pataba, o materyales sa paggawa ng basket at iba pang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang dayami (rice straw) human sa ani mahimong gamiton isip pagkaon sa hayop, mulch sa taniman, compost para sa abono, o materyales sa paghimo og basket ug uban pang butang.

q: How do penguins stay warm when temperatures are very cold?
options: They crowd together in a large group to share body heat
They grow an extra layer of feathers in winter
They dive into the warmer ocean water to escape the cold air
They dig burrows in ice to shelter from freezing winds
explanation: Many penguins huddle together in a group so their shared body heat keeps them warm during very cold weather.
fact_tl: Nagsisiksikan ang maraming penguin bilang isang grupo para magpainit kapag napakalamig.
fact_bis: Daghang pingwino magtapok ug magsiksikay isip usa ka grupo aron magpainit kung tugnaw kaayo.

q: Why do rocks in the Philippines weather more rapidly than rocks in cooler places?
options: The hot, humid climate speeds up chemical reactions and provides water needed for weathering
Strong earthquakes constantly crack and break rocks into smaller pieces
Volcanic ash covers rocks and dissolves them with acids over time
Heavy typhoon rains physically grind the rocks away faster
explanation: Chemical weathering is much faster in hot, humid climates like the Philippines because heat speeds up chemical reactions and water is needed for hydrolysis.
fact_tl: Ang chemical weathering ay nagaganap nang mas mabilis sa mainit at mahalumigmig na klima tulad ng Pilipinas dahil ang init ay nagpapabilis ng mga reaksyong kemikal at ang tubig ay kinakailangan para sa hydrolysis; dahil dito, ang mga bato sa Pilipinas ay mas mabilis na naubos kaysa sa mga bato sa mas malamig na lugar.
fact_bis: Ang chemical weathering mas paspas mahitabo sa mainit ug mabag-o nga klima sama sa Pilipinas tungod kay ang init nagpabilis sa mga chemical reaction ug ang tubig kinahanglan alang sa hydrolysis; tungod niini, ang mga bato sa Pilipinas mas paspas nawala kaysa mga bato sa mas bugnaw nga lugar.

q: Which of these correctly names the three ways heat can move from one place to another?
options: Conduction, convection, and radiation
Absorption, reflection, and refraction
Diffusion, osmosis, and filtration
Evaporation, condensation, and precipitation
explanation: Heat moves by conduction (direct contact), convection (moving liquid or air), and radiation (through rays, even through empty space).
fact_tl: May tatlong paraan kung paano lumilipat ang init: conduction (sa pamamagitan ng dikit na bagay), convection (sa pamamagitan ng gumagalaw na tubig o hangin), at radiation (sa pamamagitan ng sinag, kahit walang bagay sa pagitan).
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka paagi kung giunsa paglabay sa init: conduction (pinaagi sa dikit nga butang), convection (pinaagi sa naglihok nga tubig o hangin), ug radiation (pinaagi sa silaw, bisan walay butang sa tunga).

q: How do some butterflies find their way during long seasonal migrations?
options: They use the sun's position and Earth's magnetic field to navigate
They follow rivers and coastlines they have memorized from birth
They release scent trails that guide younger butterflies along the route
They travel only in groups and follow the oldest butterfly in the swarm
explanation: Some butterflies navigate during migration by using the position of the sun and even Earth's magnetic field, similar to how birds migrate.
fact_tl: Tulad ng mga ibon, ang ilang paru-paro ay lumalakbay nang mahabang distansya sa iba't ibang panahon ng taon; ginagamit nila ang posisyon ng araw at maging ang magnetic field ng Lupa para mag-navigate.
fact_bis: Sama sa mga langgam, ang pipila ka mariposa molakaw og taas nga distansya sa nagkalain-laing panahon sa tuig; naggamit sila sa posisyon sa adlaw ug bisan sa magnetic field sa Yuta para mamamala sa panahon sa migration.

q: Which two elements are the most abundant in the universe and make up the main ingredients of stars?
options: Hydrogen and helium
Oxygen and nitrogen
Carbon and silicon
Iron and nickel
explanation: Hydrogen and helium are the two most abundant elements in the universe and are the primary ingredients that make up stars.
fact_tl: Ang haydroheno at helium ang dalawang pinakamaraming elemento sa uniberso at siyang pangunahing sangkap ng mga bituin.
fact_bis: Ang hydrogen ug helium mao ang duha ka labing daghang elemento sa uniberso ug mao ang nag-unang sangkap sa mga bituon.

q: What is the job of the epiglottis when you swallow food?
options: It closes over the larynx so food does not go into the lungs
It pushes food from the mouth into the stomach quickly
It produces saliva to help break down food before swallowing
It prevents food from going back up into the throat after swallowing
explanation: When we swallow, the epiglottis flap closes over the larynx to keep food from going down into the lungs.
fact_tl: Kapag lumulunok tayo, isang takip na tinatawag na epiglottis ang nagsasara sa larynx para hindi mapunta ang pagkain sa baga.
fact_bis: Kon motulon ta, usa ka taklob nga gitawag og epiglottis ang motakob sa larynx aron dili masulod ang pagkaon sa baga.

q: What is the unit used to measure the frequency of a sound wave?
options: Hertz (Hz)
Decibel (dB)
Watt (W)
Newton (N)
explanation: The unit of frequency is the hertz (Hz), named after the scientist Heinrich Hertz.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng prekwensya ay hertz (Hz), na ipinangalan kay Heinrich Hertz.
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa prekwensya mao ang hertz (Hz), nga ginganlan sunod kang Heinrich Hertz.

q: Why might filtered water still be unsafe to drink?
options: Tiny germs can slip through the filter, so the water may still need to be boiled
Filtering removes all the healthy minerals your body needs from the water
The filter adds chemicals that can make the water harmful to drink
Filtered water absorbs air pollutants that cause illness when swallowed
explanation: A filter can make water look clear, but tiny germs can still pass through, so you usually need to also boil or treat the water to make it safe.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ligtas nang inumin ang tubig basta dumaan sa filter. Maaaring malinaw na ang tubig pero may mga mikrobyong napakaliit na nakakalusot pa rin. Kaya kailangan pa ring pakuluan o gamitan ng espesyal na panghalo para mapatay ang mga germ.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga luwas na imnon ang tubig basta niagi sa filter. Mahimong tin-aw na ang tubig pero naa gihapon gagmay kaayo nga mikrobyo nga makalusot. Mao nga kinahanglan pa gihapon pabukalan o tambalan aron mamatay ang mga germ.

q: How does the colugo protect itself from predators while resting between glides?
options: It clings to a tree trunk and stays still, using its bark-colored fur as camouflage
It rolls into a ball and hangs upside down from a branch so predators cannot reach it
It releases a strong smell that warns predators to stay away
It makes a loud noise to frighten nearby predators before they can attack
explanation: The colugo clings motionless to a tree, and its bark-like coloring hides it from predators while it rests between glides.
fact_tl: Sa pagitan ng mga glide, kumakapit ang colugo sa puno at nananatiling tahimik. Ang kulay nito na kahawig ng balat ng puno ay tumutulong para hindi ito makita ng mga mandaragit habang nagpapahinga.
fact_bis: Tali sa mga glide, mokupot ang colugo sa kahoy ug magpabilin nga hilom. Ang kolor niini nga morag panit sa kahoy makatabang aron dili kini makita sa mga manunukob samtang nagpahulay.

q: What makes the male Visayan warty pig look fierce and unusual?
options: Long coarse hair running from its head down its back
Sharp curved tusks that point upward and outward
Bright orange and black stripes along its sides
A large ruff of stiff fur around its neck like a lion
explanation: The male Visayan warty pig has long coarse hair running from its head down its back, giving it a fierce appearance.
fact_tl: Ang lalaking Visayan warty pig ay may mahabang buhok na tumatagos mula ulo hanggang likod, na nagbibigay sa kanya ng nakatatakot na hitsura.
fact_bis: Ang lalaking Visayan warty pig adunay hataas nga magaspang nga buhok nga moabot gikan sa ulo ngadto sa likod, naghatag niini og mapintas nga hitsura.

q: According to Darwin's theory of natural selection, which animals are most likely to survive and reproduce?
options: Animals that are better suited to their environment
Animals that are the largest and heaviest in their species
Animals that can run the fastest to escape predators
Animals that live in the most protected habitat with little competition
explanation: In Darwin's natural selection, animals that are better suited to their environment are more likely to survive and reproduce.
fact_tl: Sa natural na seleksyon ni Darwin, ang mga hayop na mas angkop sa kapaligiran ay mas malamang mabuhay at magkaanak.
fact_bis: Sa natural nga seleksyon ni Darwin, ang mga hayop nga mas angay sa palibot mas lagmit mabuhi ug manganak.

q: Why do you slide more easily on a smooth floor than on a rough one?
options: Smooth surfaces have less friction, so less force slows you down
Smooth surfaces are always slanted, making gravity pull you forward
Smooth surfaces have more friction that actually pushes you along
Rough surfaces are softer and absorb your energy when you move
explanation: Rough surfaces have more friction than smooth ones, which is why sliding on a smooth floor is much easier.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang friction sa magaspang na ibabaw kaysa sa makinis, kaya mas madaling dumulas sa makinis na sahig.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang friction sa gahi nga nawong kaysa sa hamis, mao nga sayon madalin-as sa hamis nga salog.

q: Why does a person with a fever tend to feel weak and need more food energy?
options: The body burns fuel faster than usual to produce the heat needed for a fever
The fever destroys the energy stored in muscles and bones directly
High body temperature prevents the stomach from digesting food properly
The immune system sends all available energy to the skin to cool the body down
explanation: Making the heat for a fever requires extra energy, so the body burns fuel faster than usual, which can leave a person feeling tired and weak.
fact_tl: Ang paggawa ng init para sa lagnat ay nangangailangan ng dagdag na enerhiya, kaya mas mabilis gumamit ng lakas ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang paghimo og init alang sa hilanat nagkinahanglan og dugang kusog, mao nga ang lawas mas paspas mogamit og kusog kaysa naandan.

q: The element sodium (Na) has an atomic number of 11. What does this tell you about a sodium atom?
options: It has 11 protons in its nucleus
It has 11 neutrons in its nucleus
It weighs 11 atomic mass units
It has 11 electrons in its outermost shell
explanation: The atomic number of sodium is 11, which means a sodium atom has 11 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng sodium (Na) ay 11, kaya may 11 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa sodium (Na) kay 11, mao nga naa kini 11 ka proton.

q: Why does cooked rice spoil quickly when left out at room temperature?
options: Warm, moist rice is a perfect place for bacteria to grow rapidly
The starch in rice breaks down on its own when exposed to air
The heat from cooking activates chemicals that make the rice turn sour
Steam trapped inside the rice turns into water that makes it rot
explanation: Cooked rice spoils fast because warm, moist rice is an ideal environment for bacteria to grow; refrigerating it slows this down.
fact_tl: Mabilis mapanis ang kaning iniwan sa labas dahil ang mainit at basang kanin ay paboritong tubuan ng bakterya, kaya mas matagal ito kapag inilagay sa ref.
fact_bis: Ang kan-on nga gibilin sa gawas paspas mapanis kay ang init ug basa nga kan-on paborito nga tuboan sa bakterya, mao nga mas dugay kini kung ibutang sa ref.

q: Which of the following is a free-floating water plant that is NOT anchored in mud?
options: Water hyacinth
Water lily
Lotus
Mangrove
explanation: Water hyacinth, duckweed, and water lettuce are free-floating plants whose roots hang loose in the water and drift wherever the wind pushes them.
fact_tl: May mga halamang-tubig na lumulutang nang malaya at hindi nakabaon sa putik, gaya ng water hyacinth (water lily na 'di tunay), duckweed, at kiapo. Nakalaylay lang sa tubig ang kanilang ugat at naaanod sila kung saan tinatangay ng hangin.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom sa tubig nga molutaw nga gawasnon ug dili nakatanom sa lapok, sama sa water hyacinth, duckweed, ug kiapo (water lettuce). Ang ilang gamot nagbitay lang sa tubig ug maanod sila bisan asa dad-on sa hangin.

q: Why can bananas and mangoes be picked early and still ripen properly later?
options: They produce a burst of ethylene gas that makes them ripen even after being picked
They store sugar in their seeds that slowly moves into the fruit after harvest
They absorb moisture from the air around them which triggers ripening
Their thick skin keeps moisture locked inside, finishing the ripening process
explanation: Bananas and mangoes are climacteric fruits that release a burst of ethylene gas to ripen even after being picked, so they can be harvested early.
fact_tl: Ang saging at mangga ay climacteric fruits—nagbubutas ng malaking dami ng ethylene gas habang hihinog ito kahit na napatid na mula sa puno; kaya maaari itong anihin bago pa ganap na hinog.
fact_bis: Ang saging ug mangga climacteric fruits—nagpagawas sila og dako nga burst sa ethylene gas habang nahinog bisan human na aniha; kaya mahimo silang aniha sa sayo ug pahimuon nga hinog sa ulahi.

q: Why are rice fields in the Philippines a concern for climate change?
options: Rice paddies produce methane, a potent greenhouse gas, as a normal part of the rice-growing process
Rice fields release large amounts of carbon dioxide when farmers burn the crop after harvest
The fertilizers used in rice farming release ozone-destroying chemicals into the atmosphere
Irrigation canals in rice fields trap heat from the sun and warm up nearby regions
explanation: Rice fields produce methane (CH4), a potent greenhouse gas, and since the Philippines has a large rice industry, this methane is a climate change concern.
fact_tl: Ang methane (CH4) ay isang potent na greenhouse gas. Ang mga palayan at baka ay nagpoprodyus ng methane bilang bahagi ng kanilang normal na proseso. Ang Pilipinas ay may malaking industriya ng palay kaya ang methane mula sa mga palayan ay isang isyu sa pagbabago ng klima.
fact_bis: Ang methane (CH4) usa ka potent nga greenhouse gas. Ang mga palayan ug baka nagbuhat sa methane isip bahin sa ilang normal nga mga proseso. Ang Pilipinas adunay dakong industriya sa palay busa ang methane gikan sa mga palayan usa ka pag-alala sa pagbabago sa klima.

q: Why do the lymph nodes in your neck sometimes swell when you are sick?
options: They are busy producing defenders to fight the germs making you ill
They are collecting extra blood from the heart to speed up healing
They are storing white blood cells until the fever brings them to the right temperature
They are swelling to block the spread of germs through your bloodstream
explanation: Lymph nodes swell when you are sick because they are actively making immune defenders to fight the germs causing your illness.
fact_tl: Kapag may sakit, minsan namamaga ang maliliit na kulani (lymph nodes) sa leeg o kilikili dahil masigla itong gumagawa ng panlaban sa germ.
fact_bis: Kon magsakit, usahay manghupong ang gagmay nga lymph nodes sa liog o ilok tungod kay busy kini sa paghimo og panalipod batok sa germ.

q: The katala (Philippine cockatoo) is known for what kind of social behavior?
options: It lives and travels in noisy flocks, flying and feeding together
It lives alone and calls loudly at night to keep other birds away
It chooses one partner for life and never travels in large groups
It gathers only during the breeding season and then splits into pairs
explanation: The katala is a social bird usually seen in noisy flocks flying and feeding together.
fact_tl: Ang katala ay mapagkaibigan at karaniwang nakikita sa maingay na mga grupo ng mga ibon na lumilipad at kumakain nang magkasama.
fact_bis: Ang katala mapagpanamkon ug kasagaran makita sa maingay nga mga grupo sa mga langgam nga nalupad ug nagkaon uban-uban.

q: What is the purpose of an eagle's curved, sharp beak?
options: To tear the meat of its prey into pieces
To crack open hard nuts and seeds for food
To scoop fish out of the water while flying
To dig into tree bark to find insects hiding inside
explanation: An eagle's hooked beak is used to tear the meat of its prey into pieces small enough to eat.
fact_tl: May baliko at matalim na tuka ang agila na ginagamit nito para punit-punitin ang laman ng kanyang biktima.
fact_bis: Ang agila adunay baliko ug hait nga sungo nga gamiton niini sa paggisi-gisi sa unod sa iyang tukbonon.

q: What kind of diet makes a civet an omnivore?
options: It eats both fruit and small animals like insects and worms
It eats only fruit found in the forest canopy
It feeds mainly on grass and leaves near streams
It hunts only small mammals and birds for all its food
explanation: The civet eats both fruit and small animals such as insects and worms, which makes it an omnivore — an animal that eats a mix of foods.
fact_tl: Hindi lang prutas ang kinakain ng musang. Kumakain din ito ng maliliit na hayop tulad ng insekto, bulate, at minsan maliliit na ibon. Dahil dito, tinatawag itong omnivore o kumakain ng halo-halong pagkain.
fact_bis: Dili lang prutas ang gikaon sa musang. Mokaon usab kini og gagmay nga mananap sama sa insekto, ulod, ug usahay gagmay nga langgam. Tungod niini, gitawag kini nga omnivore o mokaon og sagol nga pagkaon.

q: What advantage does geothermal energy have over solar and wind power?
options: It works day and night in any weather because underground heat is always available
It is the cheapest form of energy to build and requires no maintenance
It produces more electricity per hour than any other renewable energy source
It can be installed anywhere in the world without needing special equipment
explanation: Unlike solar or wind power, geothermal energy works day and night in any weather because the heat deep underground is always present.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng solar na nangangailangan ng araw o wind na nangangailangan ng hangin, ang geothermal ay gumagana araw-gabi at sa anumang panahon dahil ang init sa ilalim ng lupa ay palaging naroon.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa solar nga nagkinahanglan og adlaw o wind nga nagkinahanglan og hangin, ang geothermal molihok adlaw ug gabii sa bisan unsang panahon kay ang init sa ilalom sa yuta kanunay nga anaa.

q: What is it called when a chemical reaction gives off light but very little heat, like in a glow stick or a firefly?
options: Chemiluminescence
Phosphorescence
Combustion
Fluorescence
explanation: When a reaction's energy turns directly into light instead of heat, it is called chemiluminescence — seen in glow sticks and fireflies.
fact_tl: Kapag may reaksyong naglalabas ng liwanag nang hindi mainit, tanda iyon ng kemikal na pagbabago. Sa glow stick at sa alitaptap, ang enerhiyang inilalabas ng reaksyon ay nagiging liwanag agad sa halip na init — tinatawag itong chemiluminescence.
fact_bis: Kon adunay reaksiyon nga mopagawas og kahayag nga dili init, timailhan kana sa kemikal nga kausaban. Sa glow stick ug sa aning-aning, ang enerhiya nga gibuga sa reaksiyon mahimong kahayag dayon imbes init — gitawag kini og chemiluminescence.

q: What is one reason the warm air inside a typhoon's eye helps keep the typhoon strong?
options: The warmth in the eye is warmer than surrounding air, helping to sustain the storm's energy
The eye blocks cold ocean water from cooling the storm's center
Warm air in the eye spins faster and creates the strongest winds of the typhoon
The heat in the eye evaporates rainwater, which prevents the storm from losing moisture
explanation: The air inside a typhoon's eye is warmer than its surroundings, and this warmth helps maintain the typhoon's strength.
fact_tl: Ang hangin sa loob ng mata ay mas mainit kaysa paligid nito, at ito ang tumutulong na manatiling malakas ang bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang hangin sa sulod sa mata mas init kaysa palibot niini, ug kini nga kainit makatabang nga magpabiling kusog ang bagyo.

q: What remarkable ability do sea stars have when they lose an arm?
options: They can regrow the lost arm, and some species can even grow a whole new body from a single arm
They quickly replace the lost arm within a few hours using stored cells in their skin
They shed all their remaining arms and regrow a completely new set all at once
They cannot regrow lost arms but learn to survive and move with fewer limbs
explanation: Sea stars can regrow a lost arm, and some species can even grow an entire new body from just a single arm if enough of the central disc is attached.
fact_tl: Ang sea star ay kayang palakihin muli ang isang braso na natanggal — at ang ilang species ay kayang lumago ng bagong buong katawan mula sa isang braso lamang kung nanatili ang sapat na bahagi ng central disc.
fact_bis: Ang sea star makahimo og pagtubo muli sa usa ka nawala nga braso — ug ang pipila ka species makahimo og tibuok bag-ong lawas gikan sa usa ra ka braso, basta igo ang central disc nga nagpabilin nga nakadugtong.

q: What device is used to convert sunlight into electricity?
options: Solar panels
Wind turbines
Water wheels
Geothermal generators
explanation: Solar energy comes from the sun's light and can be turned into electricity using solar panels.
fact_tl: Ang solar energy ay enerhiyang galing sa sikat ng araw. Puwede itong gamitin para magpainit ng tubig o gawing kuryente sa pamamagitan ng mga solar panel.
fact_bis: Ang solar energy mao ang enerhiya nga gikan sa sanag sa adlaw. Magamit kini aron init-on ang tubig o himoon nga kuryente pinaagi sa mga solar panel.

q: How are the seeds of a pine tree different from those of a fruit-bearing tree?
options: Pine seeds are found inside cones, not enclosed in a fruit
Pine seeds are located inside a thick shell buried under the roots
Pine seeds float on water and are carried away to sprout elsewhere
Pine seeds grow directly on the surface of the leaves without any covering
explanation: Pine trees are gymnosperms, meaning their seeds are not enclosed in a fruit but are found inside cones.
fact_tl: Ang pino ay isang gymnosperm—ang mga buto nito ay hindi nakabalot sa isang prutas kundi matatagpuan sa loob ng mga kono (cones); ang Benguet pine ay ang pino na katutubong sa mga kabundukan ng Cordillera sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang pino usa ka gymnosperm—ang mga buto niini dili nakabalot sa prutas kondili makita sa sulod sa mga kono; ang Benguet pine mao ang pino nga katutubong sa mga kabukiran sa Cordillera sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do older, harder types of coal release more heat when burned than younger, softer coal?
options: Harder coal took longer to form, and longer formation time results in more energy stored in it
Harder coal contains more water, which produces extra steam heat when burned
Softer coal is mixed with other rocks and minerals that absorb heat instead of releasing it
Older coal is found deeper underground where it absorbed more heat from Earth's core
explanation: Coal that took longer to form and is harder releases more heat when burned than younger, softer kinds of coal.
fact_tl: Hindi pare-pareho ang karbon — ang karbon na mas matagal na nabuo at mas matigas ay naglalabas ng mas maraming init kapag sinunog kaysa sa mas bata at malambot na uri nito.
fact_bis: Dili managsama ang karbon — ang karbon nga mas dugay naporma ug mas gahi mobuga og mas daghang kainit kung sunugon kay sa mas bata ug humok nga klase niini.

q: What must happen to a hen's egg before it can develop into a chick?
options: It must be fertilized by a rooster
It must be kept warm by the hen for at least seven days
It must be laid in a nest made of grass and feathers
It must absorb sunlight through its shell for energy
explanation: An egg must be fertilized by a rooster before it can hatch into a chick.
fact_tl: Ang itlog ay kailangang fertilized ng tandang bago ito maging sisiw kapag napisa.
fact_bis: Ang itlog kinahanglang ma-fertilize sa sunoy una kini mahimong piso kon mapusa.

q: What is the purpose of an indicator in science?
options: It changes color to show whether a liquid is an acid or a base
It measures the exact temperature of a chemical reaction
It produces bubbles when mixed with a liquid to signal a chemical change
It is added to liquids to make them safe for drinking
explanation: An indicator is a substance that changes color to reveal whether a liquid is acidic or basic.
fact_tl: Ang indikador ay isang sangkap na nagbabago ng kulay upang ipakita kung asido o base ang isang likido.
fact_bis: Ang indikador usa ka sangkap nga nagbag-o ug kolor aron ipakita kung asido o base ang usa ka likido.

q: How does a drum produce sound when it is hit?
options: The stretched skin of the drum vibrates and creates sound waves
The hollow body of the drum traps air that resonates and makes sound
The wooden sticks striking each other create the sound, not the drum itself
The air inside the drum is compressed by the hit and pushes out as a loud burst of sound
explanation: A drum makes sound because its stretched skin vibrates when struck, and those vibrations travel through the air as sound waves.
fact_tl: Ang tambol ay gumagawa ng tunog dahil yumayanig ang nakaunat nitong balat kapag pinukpok ito.
fact_bis: Ang tambol mohimo ug tingog tungod kay mag-uyog ang gibira nga panit niini kon kini bunalan.

q: What role do decomposers play in the carbon cycle?
options: They break down dead plants and animals, returning carbon to the soil and air as carbon dioxide
They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and store it inside dead leaves and branches
They convert carbon in the soil into sugars that living plants can use as food
They release oxygen into the air after breaking down carbon stored in dead organisms
explanation: Decomposers like bacteria and fungi break down dead organisms, returning carbon to the soil and releasing carbon dioxide back into the air.
fact_tl: Kapag namatay ang mga halaman at hayop, binubulok sila ng mga decomposer gaya ng bakterya at fungi. Ibinabalik nito ang carbon sa lupa at hangin bilang carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Kung mamatay ang mga tanom ug hayop, gibulok sila sa mga decomposer sama sa bakterya ug fungi. Niini gibalik ang carbon sa yuta ug sa hangin isip carbon dioxide.

q: The San Roque Dam, one of the largest dams in the Philippines, was built on which river?
options: Agno River
Cagayan River
Pampanga River
Pasig River
explanation: The San Roque Dam was built on the Agno River in Pangasinan.
fact_tl: Ang San Roque Dam ay itinayo sa Ilog Agno sa Pangasinan.
fact_bis: Ang San Roque Dam gitukod sa Suba sa Agno sa Pangasinan.

q: What is the main difference between when butterflies and moths are most active?
options: Butterflies are active during the day, while moths are mostly active at night
Moths are active during the day, while butterflies fly mostly at night
Both butterflies and moths are active only at dawn and dusk
Butterflies and moths are both active during the day but in different habitats
explanation: Butterflies usually fly during the day while moths are mostly active at night.
fact_tl: Karaniwang lumilipad ang paru-paro kapag araw, samantalang ang gamu-gamo ay mas aktibo kapag gabi.
fact_bis: Ang alibangbang kasagaran molupad inig adlaw, samtang ang anunugba mas aktibo inig gabii.

q: What is the cosmic microwave background, and why is it important to scientists?
options: It is leftover warmth from the early universe and is strong evidence for the Big Bang
It is the light produced by the closest stars to Earth and shows how old they are
It is a layer of warm gas around Earth that protects us from deep space radiation
It is the heat released by black holes at the edge of the observable universe
explanation: The cosmic microwave background is faint heat radiation that fills the whole sky — leftover warmth from the young universe and strong evidence for the Big Bang.
fact_tl: May mahinang init na radyasyon (cosmic microwave background) na nakakalat sa buong langit, na siyang natitirang init mula sa batang uniberso—malakas na patunay ng Big Bang.
fact_bis: Adunay huyang nga radyasyon sa kainit (cosmic microwave background) nga naglukop sa tibuok langit, ug kini mao ang nahibilin nga kainit gikan sa batan-on nga uniberso—lig-on nga pamatuod sa Big Bang.

q: How does metamorphic rock form?
options: Existing rock is changed by intense heat and pressure deep inside the Earth
Layers of sediment are pressed together over millions of years into hard rock
Molten magma from a volcano cools and hardens into solid rock
Ocean minerals dissolve in water and then crystallize into rock on the seafloor
explanation: Metamorphic rock forms when existing rock is transformed by intense heat and pressure inside the Earth.
fact_tl: Ang metamorphic na bato ay nabubuo kapag nababago ang ibang bato dahil sa matinding init at presyon sa loob ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang metamorphic nga bato mabuo kung ang ubang bato mausab tungod sa kusog nga init ug presyur sulod sa Yuta.

q: Why do young shrimp molt (shed their shell) much more often than adult shrimp?
options: They are growing quickly while small, so they need to replace their shell more often
Their shells are softer when young and break more easily, needing frequent replacement
Young shrimp molt to change their color and blend in with different backgrounds
They shed their shell to release waste products that build up inside it
explanation: Young shrimp molt much more often than adults because they are growing rapidly and need to shed their old shell to accommodate their larger size.
fact_tl: Mas madalas magpalit ng balat ang batang hipon kaysa sa matanda, dahil mabilis itong lumalaki noong bata pa.
fact_bis: Mas kanunay mag-ilis sa panit ang batan-on nga hipon kaysa sa hamtong, kay paspas kini motubo samtang gamay pa.

q: What happens to a pufferfish's skin after it releases the water it used to inflate itself?
options: The elastic skin springs back to its normal size on its own, like rubber
The skin stays stretched out until the pufferfish slowly deflates over several hours
The fish must squeeze through a tight space to press its skin back into shape
The stretched skin is shed and replaced with a new, smaller layer of skin
explanation: A pufferfish's skin is elastic like rubber, so when it releases the water used to inflate itself, the skin springs back to its normal size on its own.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng butete ay nababanat na parang goma — kaya kapag inilabas na nito ang tubig, ang balat ay bumabalik (humuhupa) sa dati nitong laki nang mag-isa.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa butete maunat morag goma — maong kon ipagawas na niini ang tubig, ang panit mobalik sa naandan nga gidak-on nga kaugalingon ra.

q: What often happens to biodiversity in an ecosystem when a keystone species is lost?
options: Biodiversity drops because many other species disappear along with it
Biodiversity increases as other species quickly fill the empty role
Biodiversity stays the same because other species adapt to replace it
Biodiversity changes unpredictably — sometimes increasing and sometimes decreasing
explanation: When a keystone species is lost, biodiversity in the ecosystem often drops because many other species that depended on it also disappear.
fact_tl: Kadalasan, kapag nawala ang isang keystone species, bumababa ang biodiversity dahil maraming species ang nawawala kasunod nito.
fact_bis: Sagad, kung mawala ang usa ka keystone species, mokunhod ang biodiversity kay daghang ubang espesye ang mawala human niini.

q: Why can many insects see in almost all directions at once?
options: Their lenses are arranged in a curve, giving them a very wide field of view
They can rotate their heads almost 360 degrees to look in any direction
They have a pair of large eyes on top of their head and another pair on the sides
They have a mirror-like surface on their eyes that reflects images from behind them
explanation: Many insects can see in nearly all directions at once because their lenses are arranged in a curve, giving them a very wide field of view.
fact_tl: Dahil paikot ang ayos ng kanilang mga lente, maraming insekto ay halos nakakakita sa lahat ng direksyon nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nakakurba ang pagkahan-ay sa ilang mga lente, daghang insekto makakita sa halos tanang direksyon dungan.

q: A playground slide is an example of which simple machine?
options: An inclined plane
A lever
A pulley
A wedge
explanation: A playground slide is an inclined plane — gravity pulls children smoothly from the top to the bottom along the slope.
fact_tl: Ang slideboard sa laruan ng mga bata ay isang inclined plane: ginagamit ng gravity para pababain ang mga bata nang maayos mula sa itaas hanggang sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang slide sa parke sa mga bata usa ka inclined plane: gigamit sa gravity ang pagpababa sa mga bata nga maayos gikan sa ibabaw hangtod sa ubos sa slope.

q: What material do swiftlets use to build their nests that are collected to make a famous, expensive soup?
options: Hardened saliva
Dried feathers pressed together
Woven plant fibers cemented with mud
Spider silk mixed with grass
explanation: Swiftlets build their nests from their own hardened saliva, and these nests are collected and cooked into the famous and expensive 'bird's nest soup.'
fact_tl: Ang matigas na pugad ng laway ng swiftlet ay kinokolekta at niluluto bilang sikat na 'bird's nest soup', isang napakamahal na pagkain lalo na sa ibang bansa tulad ng Tsina.
fact_bis: Ang tig-a nga salag nga laway sa swiftlet ginakolekta ug ginaluto isip bantogan nga 'bird's nest soup,' usa ka mahal kaayo nga pagkaon ilabi na sa mga nasod sama sa China.

q: Why does concrete crack when you try to stretch or pull it apart?
options: Because concrete is weak under tension (pulling forces)
Because concrete is too brittle to handle any force at all
Because concrete expands when it gets wet and splits itself
Because concrete is only strong when it is freshly mixed
explanation: Concrete is very strong when pushed (compression) but weak when pulled apart (tension), so stretching forces cause it to crack.
fact_tl: Ang tigas na konkreto ay napakalakas kapag idinidiin pero mahina kapag hinihila, kaya naluluray ito sa banat.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga konkreto kusog kaayo kon ipiton apan huyang kon biraon, busa daling mabuak kini kon batakon.

q: What is the world's largest lake?
options: The Caspian Sea
Lake Superior
Lake Victoria
The Dead Sea
explanation: The Caspian Sea is actually the world's largest lake — it is so big that people call it a sea, but it is entirely surrounded by land.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking lawa sa mundo ay ang Caspian Sea, na napakalaki kaya tinawag itong dagat kahit ito ay isang lawa.
fact_bis: Ang labing dako nga linaw sa kalibotan mao ang Caspian Sea, nga dako kaayo mao nga gitawag kining dagat bisan tuod kini usa ka linaw.

q: Why does a shrimp need to shed its hard shell in order to grow bigger?
options: Because the hard shell cannot grow along with the shrimp's body
Because the old shell gets too heavy and slows it down
Because predators can smell the old shell and find the shrimp
Because the shell absorbs too much salt from the sea
explanation: A shrimp's hard shell cannot stretch or grow, so the shrimp must molt — shed the old shell — to allow its body to get bigger.
fact_tl: Hindi lumalaki ang matigas na balat ng hipon kasama ng katawan nito, kaya kailangan nitong iwanan ang lumang balat para makalaki.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga panit sa hipon dili motubo uban sa lawas niini, busa kinahanglan biyaan niini ang daan nga panit aron makadako.

q: If you tap a glass that has a lot of water in it, what kind of sound do you hear compared to a glass with only a little water?
options: A lower pitch
A higher pitch
The same pitch
No sound at all
explanation: More water in a glass makes a lower pitch when tapped because the extra water slows the vibrations down.
fact_tl: Sa mga baso na may iba't ibang dami ng tubig, ang mas maraming tubig ay gumagawa ng mas mababang tono kapag pinatunog mo ang baso.
fact_bis: Sa mga baso nga adunay lain-laing gidaghanon sa tubig, ang mas daghang tubig maghimo ug mas ubos nga tono kon imong tuktokon ang baso.

q: Many fish lay thousands of eggs and then swim away without caring for them. How do some young fish still manage to survive?
options: Because there are so many eggs that some hatch and live even without parent care
Because other fish in the ocean take care of the eggs instead
Because the eggs can protect themselves with a hard, armored shell
Because the young fish are born fully grown and do not need help
explanation: Many fish lay thousands of eggs and leave them unguarded; the sheer number of eggs means that some of the young survive even without any parent looking after them.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng isda ang nangingitlog ng libu-libong itlog at pagkatapos ay iniiwan ang mga ito; dahil napakarami, may ilang anak na nakakaligtas kahit walang nag-aalaga.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa isda ang mangitlog og liboan ka itlog ug dayon biyaan kini; tungod kay daghan kaayo, naay pipila ka nati nga maluwas bisan walay nag-atiman.

q: What happens to an insect that falls into the tube of a pitcher plant?
options: It is dissolved by a liquid at the bottom of the plant
It escapes through a hole in the side of the plant
It is pushed out by the plant closing its lid
It dries out and blows away in the wind
explanation: At the bottom of the pitcher plant is a digestive liquid that dissolves trapped insects so the plant can absorb their nutrients.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng pitcher plant ay may likido na tumutunaw sa nahuling insekto para makuha ang sustansya nito.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa pitcher plant adunay likido nga motunaw sa nadakpan nga insekto aron makuha ang sustansiya niini.

q: You cut a piece of paper into many small pieces. What happens to the total mass?
options: The total mass stays exactly the same
The total mass decreases because some paper is lost in cutting
The total mass increases because cutting adds energy
The total mass changes depending on how many pieces you make
explanation: Cutting paper is a physical change, and in physical changes no matter is lost — the total mass before and after remains the same.
fact_tl: Sa pisikal na pagbabago, hindi nawawala ang dami ng bagay; pareho lang ang kabuuang timbang bago at pagkatapos.
fact_bis: Sa pisikal nga kausaban, walay mawala nga butang; pareho lang ang kinatibuk-ang gibug-aton sa wala pa ug human.

q: How does your brain tell your arm muscles to move?
options: It sends a signal through nerves to the muscle, telling it to contract
It pumps extra blood to the muscle until the muscle moves on its own
It releases a hormone into the stomach that travels to the muscle
It sends a signal through bones that vibrate to the muscle
explanation: When we want to move, the brain sends an electrical signal through nerves to the muscle, instructing it to contract.
fact_tl: Kapag gusto nating kumilos, nagpapadala ang utak ng senyas sa pamamagitan ng mga nerbiyo papunta sa kalamnan upang ito ay umurong.
fact_bis: Kung gusto natong molihok, ang utok magpadala og senyas pinaagi sa mga nerbiyo paingon sa kaunlan aron kini mokuyos.

q: When a pangolin is scared, what does it do to protect itself?
options: It rolls into a tight ball so its hard scales cover its soft belly
It sprints away at high speed to escape the predator
It inflates its body to look bigger and scare the attacker
It buries itself underground very quickly
explanation: When frightened, the pangolin rolls into a ball so its tough scales shield its vulnerable soft belly from predators.
fact_tl: Kapag natatakot, gumugulong ang balintong na parang bola para protektahan ang malambot nitong tiyan ng matigas na kaliskis.
fact_bis: Kon mahadlok, ang balintong molingin nga morag bola aron mapanalipdan sa gahi nga himbis ang humok niini nga tiyan.

q: When a bat hits a baseball, the bat pushes the ball forward. When does the ball push back on the bat?
options: At the exact same moment the bat pushes the ball
A tiny moment after the bat pushes the ball
Only after the ball has left the bat
The ball never pushes back on the bat
explanation: According to Newton's third law, action and reaction always happen at the same instant — there is no delay between them.
fact_tl: Karaniwang tanong: alin ang nauuna, ang aksyon o ang reaksyon? Ang sagot: SABAY silang nangyayari! Walang antala o pagkahuli sa pagitan nila. Hindi muna tumutulak ang isang bagay bago tumulak pabalik ang isa — kapag may aksyon, kasabay na agad ang reaksyon. Magkapares silang laging magkasama.
fact_bis: Komon nga pangutana: hain ang mauna, ang aksyon o ang reaksyon? Ang tubag: DUNGAN sila mahitabo! Walay langan tali nila. Dili una motulod ang usa ka butang ayha motulod balik ang lain — kung adunay aksyon, dungan dayon ang reaksyon. Pares sila nga kanunay magkuyog.

q: What is compost made from?
options: Rotted plant and food scraps
Crushed rocks and sand mixed with water
Burnt ash from wood fires
Dried-up mud from riverbeds
explanation: Compost is dark, rich material made from rotted plant and food scraps that can be used to improve soil.
fact_tl: Ang compost ay maitim at mayamang lupa na nabuo mula sa mga nabulok na tira ng halaman at pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang compost maoy itom ug dato nga yuta nga gikan sa nadunot nga tinanom ug pagkaon.

q: On a cashew tree, which part is the true botanical fruit?
options: The hard shell that holds the nut at the end
The large red or yellow swollen part that people eat like a fruit
The green leaves at the top of the branch
The thick woody stem that holds the cashew apple
explanation: The cashew nut is enclosed in the true botanical fruit — a hard shell at the tip — while the large juicy part people eat is actually an enlarged pedicel, not the true fruit.
fact_tl: Ang kasoy ay may dalawang edible na bahagi: ang malaking pula o dilaw na cashew apple (ang pinalaking pedicel, hindi ang tunay na prutas) at ang bato—ang tunay na prutas—sa dulo na naglalaman ng cashew nut.
fact_bis: Ang kasoy adunay duha ka edible nga bahin: ang dako nga pula o dilaw nga cashew apple (usa ka pinalakian nga pedicel, dili ang tinuod nga prutas) ug ang bato sa dulo nga adunay cashew nut.

q: What pH value means a substance is perfectly neutral — neither an acid nor a base?
options: pH 7
pH 0
pH 14
pH 3
explanation: Pure water has a pH of 7, which is considered neutral on the pH scale.
fact_tl: Ang purong tubig ay may pH na 7, na neutral, hindi asido at hindi base.
fact_bis: Ang putling tubig adunay pH nga 7, nga neutral, dili asido ug dili base.

q: Why does a Filipino bangka boat stay upright and not tip over easily?
options: The outriggers (katig) on the sides balance it and stop it from tipping
The hollow body is filled with sand to lower the center of gravity
Fishermen always sit on the same side to keep it balanced
The boat is made from very heavy wood that resists tipping
explanation: A bangka floats because of its hollow body, and the outriggers (katig) extending from its sides help keep it stable so it does not tip over.
fact_tl: Ang bangkang Pilipino ay lumulutang dahil sa guwang na katawan nito, at ang mga katig ang tumutulong upang hindi ito tumagilid.
fact_bis: Ang Pinoy nga bangka magalutaw tungod sa bakante niini nga lawas, ug ang mga katig motabang aron dili kini matakilid.

q: When you touch a makahiya plant, what happens to its leaflets?
options: They fold one after another in a row, like a book slowly closing
They all snap shut at the exact same moment
They curl away from the stem and drop to the ground
They release a sticky liquid to trap the thing that touched them
explanation: A makahiya leaf's many tiny leaflets do not all close at once — they fold in sequence one after another when touched.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng makahiya ay gawa sa maraming maliliit na dahon na tinatawag na leaflets. Kapag nahipo, hindi sabay-sabay ang pagsasara, kundi paisa-isang nagsasara ang mga leaflets na parang nagsasarang aklat.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa makahiya hinimo sa daghang gagmay nga dahon nga gitawag og leaflets. Kon mahikap, dili kini tanan mosira dungan; hinuon ang mga leaflets mosira tagsa-tagsa, sama sa libro nga hinay nga mosira.

q: What does a tarsier eat?
options: Insects such as grasshoppers
Leaves and young tree shoots
Ripe fruits and berries
Small fish from streams
explanation: The tarsier is an insect-eater — it hunts insects like grasshoppers and leaps between branches to catch its prey.
fact_tl: Ang tarsier ay kumakain ng mga insekto tulad ng tipaklong, at marunong itong lumukso mula sa isang sanga papunta sa iba para manghuli.
fact_bis: Ang tarsier mokaon og mga insekto sama sa apan, ug makahibalo kining molukso gikan sa usa ka sanga ngadto sa lain aron mangdakop.

q: When does a desert plant usually bloom and make seeds?
options: Quickly after the rare rain arrives
Only during the coldest nights of the year
Slowly over many months of dry weather
After a very long dry spell with no rain at all
explanation: Some desert plants rapidly bloom and produce seeds right after rain arrives, taking advantage of the brief window of moisture.
fact_tl: Ilang halaman sa disyerto ay mabilis mamulaklak at maghasik ng buto kapag may bihirang ulan.
fact_bis: Pipila ka tanom sa desyerto dali mobulak ug mohimo ug liso kung muabot ang panagsa nga ulan.

q: Why does the sea sometimes glow blue at night when waves crash or you paddle through it?
options: Tiny plankton glow with light when the water is disturbed, a process called bioluminescence
Minerals in the seafloor reflect the moonlight upward
Salt crystals in seawater produce light when they rub together
Deep-sea fish swim near the surface and their lights show through
explanation: Some plankton produce light through bioluminescence and glow when the seawater around them is disturbed at night.
fact_tl: May ilang uri ng plankton na kumikinang o nagliliwanag sa dilim kapag gumagalaw ang tubig dagat sa gabi, isang penomenong tinatawag na bioluminescence.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka klase sa plankton nga modan-ag o mosidlak sa kangitngit kung matandog ang tubig dagat sa gabii, usa ka panghitabo nga gitawag og bioluminescence.

q: In the Philippines, how do prawns (sugpo) and shrimp (hipon) compare in size?
options: Prawns are usually larger than shrimp
Shrimp are usually larger than prawns
They are always exactly the same size
Prawns are smaller but heavier than shrimp
explanation: In the Philippines, a prawn (sugpo) is usually larger than a common shrimp (hipon), although both are crustaceans.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang sugpo ay karaniwang mas malaki kaysa karaniwang hipon, kahit pareho silang crustacean.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang sugpo kasagaran mas dako kaysa ordinaryong hipon, bisan parehong crustacean sila.

q: What happens when you keep adding sugar to a glass of water after it has reached its limit?
options: Extra sugar sinks to the bottom without dissolving
All the extra sugar dissolves even faster than before
The water turns into a solid because of too much sugar
The glass overflows because the sugar pushes the water out
explanation: There is a maximum amount of sugar that can dissolve in water; once that limit is reached, extra sugar simply stays undissolved at the bottom.
fact_tl: May hangganan kung gaano karaming asukal ang matutunaw sa isang basong tubig; kapag sobra na, hindi na ito matunaw.
fact_bis: Adunay kinutuban kon pila ka asukal ang matunaw sa usa ka baso nga tubig; kon sobra na, dili na kini matunaw.

q: What do newly hatched cicadas do right after they come out of their eggs?
options: They drop to the ground and dig underground
They fly immediately to find leaves to eat
They stay on the branch and wait for their wings to grow
They swim to the nearest pool of water
explanation: When cicada eggs hatch, the tiny nymphs drop to the ground and burrow underground, where they will live for years before emerging.
fact_tl: Kapag napisa ang itlog, ang maliit na kuliglig ay nahuhulog sa lupa at humuhukay papasok sa ilalim nito.
fact_bis: Kon mamugna ang itlog, ang gagmay nga kuliglig mahagba sa yuta ug mokalot padulong sa ilalom niini.

q: What is special about breathing compared to most other things your body does?
options: It happens automatically even while you are asleep without you thinking about it
You must concentrate on every breath or your lungs will stop working
It only works when you are awake and paying attention
Your heart controls each breath and reminds your lungs when to move
explanation: Breathing is automatic — your body keeps doing it on its own even while you are asleep, without you needing to think about it.
fact_tl: Humihinga ka nang hindi mo namamalayan, kahit na natutulog ka.
fact_bis: Moginhawa ka bisan dili nimo hunahunaon, bisan kon ikaw natulog.

q: What is the purpose of a mosquito net placed over a bed?
options: To keep mosquitoes from biting the person while they sleep
To keep the sleeper warm during cold nights
To block out light so the person can sleep better
To catch mosquitoes so they can be killed in the morning
explanation: A mosquito net is a mesh placed over a bed to prevent mosquitoes from reaching and biting a sleeping person.
fact_tl: Ang kulambo ay isang lambat na inilalagay sa ibabaw ng higaan upang hindi makakagat ang mga lamok habang natutulog.
fact_bis: Ang moskitero usa ka pukot nga ibutang ibabaw sa higdaanan aron dili makapaak ang mga lamok samtang natulog.

q: What type of element is gold (Au) on the periodic table?
options: A transition metal
A noble gas
An alkali metal
A nonmetal
explanation: Gold (Au) is a transition metal, and it is commonly used to make jewelry because of its beauty and resistance to tarnish.
fact_tl: Ang ginto o gold (Au) ay isang transition metal na ginagamit sa mga alahas.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan o gold (Au) usa ka transition metal nga gigamit sa paghimo og alahas.

q: Why do many flowers release a sweet scent?
options: To attract pollinators like bees and butterflies closer to the flower
To warn insects that the flower is poisonous
To absorb more sunlight for photosynthesis
To keep away other plants that might compete for space
explanation: Flowers release sweet scents to attract pollinators, which helps the plant get pollinated and produce seeds.
fact_tl: Maraming bulaklak ang naglalabas ng matamis na bango para akitin ang mga pollinator papalapit.
fact_bis: Daghang bulak ang nagpagawas ug tam-is nga kahumot aron danihon ang mga pollinator paduol.

q: How can you use a simple circuit with a light bulb to test whether a material carries electricity?
options: Connect the material in the circuit — if the bulb lights up, it is a conductor
Rub the material on the bulb — if it glows, electricity passed through
Hold the material near a magnet and see if the bulb flickers
Dip the material in water and check if the bulb changes color
explanation: In a simple circuit test, you place the material between the circuit connections — the bulb lights up only if the material is a conductor that lets electricity flow through.
fact_tl: Masusubok kung konduktor o insulador ang isang materyal sa pamamagitan ng simpleng circuit; umiilaw ang bombilya kapag konduktor.
fact_bis: Masulayan kung konduktor o insulador ang usa ka materyal pinaagi sa simpleng sirkito; mosiga ang bombilya kung konduktor.

q: What is traditional ecological knowledge (TEK)?
options: Indigenous people's deep understanding of nature built up over thousands of years
A government program that teaches farming methods in schools
A modern scientific database of endangered species worldwide
A set of laws that protect forests from being cut down
explanation: Traditional ecological knowledge (TEK) is the understanding of nature that indigenous communities have developed and maintained over thousands of years, which often helps conserve biodiversity and sustain livelihoods.
fact_tl: Ang traditional ecological knowledge (TEK) ay ang karunungan ng mga katutubong tao tungkol sa kalikasan na napanatili sa loob ng libu-libong taon — ang kaalamang ito ay kadalasang kapwa nagpapanatili ng biodiversity at nagbibigay ng kabuhayan sa mga komunidad.
fact_bis: Ang traditional ecological knowledge (TEK) mao ang pag-unawa sa mga indigenous nga tao bahin sa kalikasan nga gipanatili sulod sa libo-libo ka tuig — kining kahibalo kasagarang nagkonserba sa biodiversity ug nagsuporta sa mga kabuhayan.

q: What is the treeline, and what grows above it?
options: The highest altitude where trees can survive — above it only mosses and grasses can grow
The lowest point of a mountain where trees begin to thin out
The line where tropical trees stop and pine trees start
The edge of a forest next to a river or lake
explanation: The treeline is the highest elevation where trees can grow; above it, the cold and wind are too harsh for trees, so only small plants like mosses and grasses survive.
fact_tl: Ang treeline ay ang pinakamataas na altitude kung saan maaaring lumaki ang mga puno — sa ibabaw nito, ang kalamigan at hangin ay masyadong matindi para sa mga puno, at ang mga halaman tulad ng lumot at damo lamang ang maaaring lumaki.
fact_bis: Ang treeline mao ang pinakataas nga altitude diin ang mga kahoy makaabot — sa ibabaw niini, ang katugnaw ug hangin hilabihan ka grabeng para sa mga kahoy, ug ang mga tanom sama sa lumot ug balili lamang ang mabuhi.

q: In a Philippine rice field, what does the snake eat and why does that help farmers?
options: The snake eats rats that damage the rice, so it helps keep the rat population down
The snake eats insects that pollinate the rice, so it improves the harvest
The snake eats weeds around the rice plants, so it reduces competition
The snake eats frogs that eat the rats, so more rats are removed
explanation: In the rice-field food chain, snakes eat rats that feed on the rice crop, so snakes naturally reduce the rat population and help protect the harvest.
fact_tl: Sa bukid sa Pilipinas, may food chain na ganito: araw → palay → daga na kumakain ng palay → ahas na kumakain ng daga. Kaya nakakatulong ang ahas sa magsasaka dahil pinipigilan nito ang dami ng daga.
fact_bis: Sa uma sa Pilipinas, adunay food chain nga sama niini: adlaw → humay → ilaga nga mokaon og humay → bitin nga mokaon og ilaga. Mao nga makatabang ang bitin sa mag-uuma kay gipugngan niini ang gidaghanon sa ilaga.

q: Which animal holds the record as the longest-lived vertebrate on Earth?
options: The Greenland shark, which can reach about 400 years old
The giant tortoise, which can live about 200 years
The bowhead whale, which can live about 150 years
The koi fish, which can live about 100 years
explanation: The Greenland shark is the longest-lived vertebrate known to science, with some individuals reaching approximately 400 years of age.
fact_tl: Ang Greenland shark ang pinakamatagal mabuhay na vertebrate, na umaabot ng mga 400 taong gulang.
fact_bis: Ang Greenland shark mao ang labing dugay mabuhi nga vertebrate, nga makaabot og mga 400 ka tuig ang edad.

q: About how long can an elephant's trunk grow?
options: About 2 meters long
About 50 centimeters long
About 5 meters long
About 1 centimeter long
explanation: An elephant's trunk can be about 2 meters long, making it one of the most impressive and versatile body parts in the animal kingdom.
fact_tl: Ang nguso (ilong) ng elepante ay maaaring umabot ng halos 2 metro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang nguso (ilong) sa elepante mahimong moabot ug halos 2 metro ang gitas-on.

q: Why do Filipino farmers wrap carabao mangoes in paper bags while the fruit is still on the tree?
options: To protect the fruit from insects and pests
To speed up ripening by trapping heat inside the bag
To prevent the mangoes from falling off the tree in strong wind
To keep the mangoes from turning too sweet before harvest
explanation: Farmers bag carabao mangoes on the tree to protect the developing fruit from insects and pests before harvest.
fact_tl: Madalas nakikita na ang mga carabao mango ay binabalot ng papel habang nasa puno pa; ginagawa ito ng magsasaka para protektahan ang bunga mula sa insekto at peste.
fact_bis: Ang mga carabao mango sagad makita nga giputos og papel samtang anaa pa sa punoan; ginahimo kini sa mga mag-uuma aron mapanalipdan ang bunga gikan sa insekto ug peste.

q: What happens to the total resistance in a circuit when you add more branches in parallel?
options: The total resistance goes down because the current has more paths to flow
The total resistance goes up because there are more parts to slow the current
The total resistance stays the same no matter how many branches you add
The total resistance goes down only if all branches have identical resistors
explanation: Adding more branches in a parallel circuit gives electric current more paths to flow through, which lowers the overall total resistance.
fact_tl: Ang pagdaragdag ng mga sanga sa isang parallel circuit ay nagbibigay ng mas maraming landas para sa current, kaya bumababa ang kabuuang resistance.
fact_bis: Ang pagdugang ug mga sanga sa usa ka parallel circuit naghatag ug mas daghang agianan alang sa current, mao nga mokunhod ang kinatibuk-ang resistance.

q: What gas is released when we burn gasoline, coal, and oil for electricity and vehicles?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Hydrogen
explanation: Burning fossil fuels like gasoline, coal, and oil releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, which contributes to warming the planet.
fact_tl: Kapag sinusunog natin ang gasolina, uling, at langis para sa kuryente at sasakyan, naglalabas ito ng carbon dioxide na nagpapainit sa mundo.
fact_bis: Kon mosunog kita og gasolina, uling, ug lana para sa kuryente ug mga sakyanan, nagbuga kini og carbon dioxide nga nagpainit sa kalibutan.

q: How do male moths find female moths that are very far away?
options: They detect the female's pheromones using their feathery antennae from several kilometers away
They follow the trail of light that females produce to guide them
They listen for the high-pitched sounds females make at night
They watch for the females' bright wing patterns in moonlight
explanation: Female moths release sex pheromones that males can detect from several kilometers away using their large feathery antennae.
fact_tl: Ang babaeng moth ay naglalabas ng sex pheromone na kayang maramdaman ng lalaki sa distansya na hanggang ilang kilometro gamit ang kanyang feathery na antenyo.
fact_bis: Ang babaeng moth naglabas og sex pheromone nga mabation sa lalaki gikan sa distansya nga pipila ka kilometro gamit ang iyang bulabulahon nga antenyo.

q: How does rainwater slowly carve out limestone caves?
options: Rainwater picks up carbon dioxide to form carbonic acid, which dissolves the limestone over thousands of years
Rainwater freezes inside cracks and expands, breaking the rock apart piece by piece
Rainwater carries sand that grinds away the rock as it flows underground
Rainwater heats up underground and turns into steam that blasts out the cave space
explanation: Rainwater dissolves carbon dioxide to form carbonic acid, which then slowly dissolves calcite in limestone and carries it away, creating caves and karst landforms over thousands of years.
fact_tl: Ang tubig-ulan ay natutunaw ng carbon dioxide sa hangin upang lumikha ng carbonic acid (H2CO3); ang mahinang asidong ito ay naglulusaw ng calcite sa limestone, na nagdadala ng calcium bicarbonate sa solusyon at naglikha ng mga kuweba at karst landforms sa paglipas ng libo-libong taon.
fact_bis: Ang tubig-ulan natunaw ang carbon dioxide sa hangin aron makahimo og carbonic acid (H2CO3); kini nga mahuyang asido naglusaw sa calcite sa limestone, nagdala og calcium bicarbonate sa solusyon ug nagporma og mga kuweba ug karst landforms sulod sa libu-libong tuig.

q: Why are traditional bamboo bridges in the Cordillera mountains a good building material for bridges?
options: Bamboo is light, strong, and flexible enough to sway slightly without breaking
Bamboo is very heavy so it does not move in strong winds or floods
Bamboo grows very slowly so it lasts hundreds of years without being replaced
Bamboo becomes harder than steel when it is soaked in river water
explanation: Traditional bamboo bridges in the Cordillera are built from bamboo because it is light, strong, and flexible — it can sway a little under load without snapping.
fact_tl: Sa mga bundok ng Cordillera sa Pilipinas, ang mga tradisyonal na tulay na gawa sa kawayan ay magaan, matibay, at flexible na nagpapahintulot ng kaunting galaw nang hindi nasira.
fact_bis: Sa mga bukid sa Cordillera sa Pilipinas, ang mga tradisyonal na tulay nga gihimo sa kawayan magaan, lig-on, ug flexible aron ang gamay nga paggalaw dili maka-pahilig niini.

q: Why is it noon in the Philippines at the same moment it is night in America?
options: Because Earth rotates, different parts of the world face the Sun at different times
Because the Philippines is closer to the Sun and gets sunlight first
Because the Moon blocks the sunlight from America when it is noon in the Philippines
Because the Philippines and America are in different hemispheres that never have the same weather
explanation: Different parts of the world have different times because Earth is always rotating — when one side faces the Sun (noon), the opposite side is in darkness (night).
fact_tl: Magkakaiba ang oras sa iba't ibang bahagi ng mundo dahil umiikot ang Earth — kapag tanghali sa Pilipinas, gabi na sa Amerika at iba ang oras sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Lain-lain ang oras sa lain-laing bahin sa kalibutan kay molibot ang Earth — kung udto sa Pilipinas, gabii na sa Amerika ug lahi ang oras sa ubang nasod.

q: What unusual feature can be found at Saturn's north pole?
options: A six-sided (hexagonal) cloud pattern made by a jet stream
A giant red storm that has lasted for centuries
A ring of ice volcanoes that shoot water into space
A perfectly circular hole where no clouds exist
explanation: At Saturn's north pole there is an extraordinary hexagonal cloud pattern — a six-sided jet stream first discovered by Voyager 1 in 1981.
fact_tl: Sa hilagang polo ng Saturn ay isang napakakakaibang hexagonal na cloud pattern — isang beregonan na jet stream na may anim na tabi (halos 25,000 kilometro ang lapad ng bawat tabi) na natuklasan ng Voyager 1 noong 1981 at pagkatapos ay detalyadong naitala ng Cassini.
fact_bis: Sa amihanan nga poste sa Saturn adunay talahulagway nga hexagonal nga cloud pattern — usa ka six-sided nga jet stream (ang mga kilid hapit 25,000 kilometro ang gilapdon) una nga nadiskubre sa Voyager 1 niadtong 1981 ug pagkahuman gidetalye sa Cassini.

q: Why does lightning heat the air around it to extremely high temperatures?
options: A huge surge of electric current pushes through air, and air resists electricity so it heats up very fast
Lightning is a ball of burning gas that falls from the clouds and sets the air on fire
Lightning compresses the air so tightly that the pressure alone produces the heat
Lightning is reflected sunlight focused through ice crystals in storm clouds
explanation: Lightning is a massive surge of electric current through air; because air resists current, the energy turns into intense heat — just like a wire glowing hot when too much current flows through it.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay napakalaking daloy ng kuryente na dumadaan sa hangin. Hindi madaling dumaan ang kuryente sa hangin, kaya napakabilis nitong umiinit—parang kawad na namumula kapag dinaanan ng sobrang kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang kilat usa ka dako kaayo nga agos sa kuryente nga moagi sa hangin. Lisod moagi ang kuryente sa hangin, mao nga paspas kaayo kini moinit—sama sa alambre nga mamula kung sobra ang kuryente nga moagi.

q: Does Mars have any water, and if so, where is it found?
options: Yes, frozen water ice exists at both of its polar caps
No, Mars has no water in any form at all
Yes, liquid oceans cover about half of the planet
Yes, water vapor fills the Martian atmosphere like clouds on Earth
explanation: Mars does have water — it is frozen as ice at both of Mars's polar caps.
fact_tl: Oo, may tubig na yelo (water ice) sa magkabilang poste ng Mars.
fact_bis: Oo, adunay tubig nga yelo (water ice) sa duha ka poste sa Mars.

q: How does a cockroach nymph look compared to an adult cockroach?
options: It looks similar to the adult but is smaller and has no wings
It looks completely different, like a worm or caterpillar
It looks exactly the same as an adult, just a different color
It looks like a tiny egg with legs before it becomes an adult
explanation: The cockroach undergoes incomplete metamorphosis, so its nymph stage already resembles the adult — it is just smaller and lacks fully developed wings.
fact_tl: Ang ipis ay dumaraan sa di-buong metamorphosis, kaya ang nimpa nito ay kamukha na ng matanda pero mas maliit.
fact_bis: Ang uk-ok moagi sa dili kompletong metamorphosis, mao nga ang nympha niini susama na sa hamtong apan mas gamay.

q: When moss or lichen grows on the surface of tree bark, what effect does it usually have on the tree?
options: It usually does not harm the tree — it just uses the bark as a surface to live on
It slowly eats through the bark and kills the tree over time
It helps the tree grow faster by adding nutrients to the bark
It makes the bark softer so that insects can easily damage the tree
explanation: Moss or lichen that grows on tree bark typically does not harm the tree — they simply use the bark surface as a place to live, especially in damp environments.
fact_tl: Madalas may lumot o lichen na tumutubo sa ibabaw ng balat ng puno, lalo na sa mahalumigmig na lugar. Karaniwang hindi nito sinasaktan ang puno — gumagamit lang sila ng balat bilang tirahan.
fact_bis: Kasagaran adunay lumot o lichen nga motubo sa ibabaw sa panit sa kahoy, ilabi na sa umog nga dapit. Kasagaran dili kini makadaot sa kahoy — gigamit lang nila ang panit isip puy-anan.

q: Besides rolling into a ball, what other way can a pangolin defend itself from predators?
options: It sprays a foul-smelling secretion from glands near its rear
It bites with very sharp teeth and claws the attacker
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
It makes a very loud hissing sound to scare predators away
explanation: As an extra defense, a pangolin can spray a foul-smelling liquid from glands near its rear to drive away predators.
fact_tl: Bilang karagdagang depensa, ang pangolin ay kayang mag-spray ng masamang amoy mula sa mga glandula sa puwerta nito para takutin ang mga mandaragit.
fact_bis: Isip dugang nga depensa, ang pangolin makahimo sa pag-spray og daotan nga amoy gikan sa mga glandula duol sa iyang lubot aron matakutin ang mga manunukob.

q: What can a seed found inside a santol, atis, or guyabano do if it lands in the soil?
options: It can sprout and grow into a new tree
It dissolves in the rain and becomes part of the soil
It floats away on water and disappears
It sits in the soil for only one day before drying out
explanation: Seeds inside fruits like santol, atis, or guyabano can germinate in the soil and grow into new trees, continuing the plant's life cycle.
fact_tl: Ang buto sa loob ng santol, atis, o guyabano ay maaaring tumubo at maging bagong puno.
fact_bis: Ang liso sa sulod sa santol, atis, o guyabano mahimong moturok ug mahimong bag-ong kahoy.

q: What happens to the trachea (windpipe) as it enters the chest?
options: It branches into two tubes called bronchi — one going to each lung
It connects directly to the stomach to allow air and food to travel together
It splits into hundreds of tiny hairs that filter dust from the air
It widens into a single large air sac that fills both lungs at once
explanation: The trachea branches into two tubes called bronchi — one for each lung — which then spread out like tree branches inside the lungs.
fact_tl: Nagsasanga ang trachea sa dalawang tubo na tinatawag na bronchi — isa para sa bawat baga — na parang sanga ng punong-kahoy sa loob ng baga.
fact_bis: Ang trachea nagsanga ngadto sa duha ka tubo nga gitawag og bronchi — usa alang sa matag baga — nga mokatag sama sa sanga sa kahoy sulod sa baga.

q: How many other neurons can a single neuron be connected to through its synapses?
options: Thousands of other neurons
Only one other neuron
Exactly two other neurons
No more than ten other neurons
explanation: A single neuron can have thousands of synapses connecting it to many other neurons, like a tree with countless branches reaching in all directions.
fact_tl: Ang isang neuron ay hindi lang nakakabit sa isa. Maaari itong magkaroon ng libu-libong synapse papunta sa ibang mga neuron, parang isang punong may napakaraming sanga.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka neuron dili lang konektado sa usa. Mahimo kining adunay liboan ka synapse padulong sa daghan pang neuron, sama sa kahoy nga adunay daghan kaayong sanga.

q: In which country was nata de coco first developed and made popular?
options: The Philippines
Japan
Indonesia
Thailand
explanation: Nata de coco was first developed and made popular in the Philippines, and it later became especially popular in Japan in the 1990s as a Philippine export.
fact_tl: Ang nata de coco ay isang pagkaing una nang ginawa at pinasikat sa Pilipinas. Naging sikat ito sa ibang bansa lalo na sa Japan noong 1990s, kaya naging mahalagang produktong inilalako ng mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang nata de coco usa ka pagkaon nga unang gihimo ug gipasikat sa Pilipinas. Nahimo kining bantog sa ubang nasod ilabi na sa Japan niadtong 1990s, mao nga nahimo kining importante nga produkto nga ibaligya sa mga Pilipino.

q: What does nicotine in cigarettes do to your heartbeat?
options: It speeds up the heartbeat, forcing the heart to work faster than normal
It slows the heartbeat down to reduce the risk of heart disease
It stops the heartbeat temporarily until the nicotine wears off
It has no effect on the heart — it only affects the lungs
explanation: Nicotine enters the bloodstream and forces the heart to beat faster than normal, which tires the heart out over time.
fact_tl: Ang nikotina sa sigarilyo ay isang kemikal na nagpapabilis ng tibok ng puso. Kapag pumasok ito sa dugo, napipilitan ang puso na magtrabaho nang mas mabilis kaysa karaniwan, kaya napapagod ito.
fact_bis: Ang nikotina sa sigarilyo usa ka kemikal nga magpaspas sa pitik sa kasingkasing. Kung mosulod kini sa dugo, mapugos ang kasingkasing nga molihok nga mas paspas kaysa naandan, mao nga makapoy kini.

q: What happens to soil when farmers rotate different crops on the same land over time?
options: The soil becomes looser and gains more organic matter, improving its quality.
The soil becomes harder and drier because plants take out all the water.
The soil loses all its nutrients and needs chemical fertilizer to recover.
The soil stays exactly the same because plants do not affect soil structure.
explanation: Different plant roots loosen the soil in different ways, and leftover leaves and roots build up organic matter, making the soil's structure and quality improve over time.
fact_tl: Ang iba't ibang halaman ay may iba't ibang ugat na humuhukay at lumuluwag sa lupa sa magkaibang paraan. Kapag pinagsalit-salit, nagiging mas maluwag at mas madaling pasukin ng hangin at tubig ang lupa. Nadadagdagan din ang organic matter mula sa naiiwang dahon at ugat, kaya bumubuti ang istruktura at kalidad ng lupa sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang lainlaing tanom adunay lainlaing gamot nga mokalot ug moluag sa yuta sa managlahing paagi. Kon liwaton sila, mahimong mas luag ug mas sayon sudlan sa hangin ug tubig ang yuta. Modaghan usab ang organic matter gikan sa nahabilin nga dahon ug gamot, mao nga mouswag ang estraktura ug kalidad sa yuta sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: Why is it helpful that the kalaw bird has a loud, low-pitched call instead of a high, shrill one?
options: Lower sounds travel farther inside thick forests because high sounds are blocked more easily by leaves and branches.
Lower sounds are quieter and do not scare away insects that the kalaw eats.
High-pitched sounds travel farther in forests, so the kalaw avoids them to stay hidden.
Lower sounds can only be heard by other kalaws, keeping communication private.
explanation: Lower-pitched sounds travel farther inside thick forests than high, shrill sounds, which are more easily blocked by leaves and branches.
fact_tl: Ang tawag ng kalaw ay malakas at medyo mababa o malalim ang tono. Ito ay kapaki-pakinabang dahil ang mababang tunog ay mas malayong umaabot sa loob ng makapal na gubat kaysa sa matinis na tunog na madaling masala ng mga dahon at sanga.
fact_bis: Ang tawag sa kalaw kusog ug medyo ubos o lalom ang tono. Mapuslanon kini kay ang ubos nga tunog mas layo nga moabot sulod sa baga nga lasang kaysa hait nga tunog, nga sayon lang ma-sala sa mga dahon ug sanga.

q: Why is it important to tell the doctor exactly what you are feeling when you are sick?
options: Symptoms help the doctor figure out what illness you might have.
Doctors only need to look at you to know your illness without any information.
Symptoms are only useful to nurses, not to doctors.
Describing your symptoms is just a formality and does not affect the diagnosis.
explanation: Symptoms help a doctor figure out what illness you might have.
fact_tl: Ang mga sintomas ay tumutulong sa doktor na malaman kung anong sakit ang mayroon ka.
fact_bis: Ang mga sintomas makatabang sa doktor aron mahibaw-an kung unsang sakit ang naa nimo.

q: Which mountain is the highest in the Philippines, and where is it located?
options: Mount Apo in Mindanao, standing 2,954 meters tall.
Mount Mayon in Albay, standing 2,463 meters tall.
Mount Pulag in Benguet, standing 2,926 meters tall.
Mount Halcon in Mindoro, standing 2,586 meters tall.
explanation: Mount Apo in Mindanao is the highest mountain in the Philippines, standing 2,954 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Apo sa Mindanao ang pinakamataas na bundok sa Pilipinas, na may taas na 2,954 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Apo sa Mindanao mao ang pinakahabog nga bukid sa Pilipinas, nga adunay gitas-on nga 2,954 ka metro.

q: How does a roller bird catch its food?
options: It sits on a high perch and swoops down to grab insects or small animals.
It wades into shallow water and catches fish with its beak.
It chases prey by running fast on the ground.
It hovers in the air like a hummingbird and picks insects off leaves.
explanation: The roller sits on a high perch and swoops down to grab insects or small animals.
fact_tl: Ang roller ay nakaupo sa isang mataas na lugar at bumababa para sakmalin ang insekto o maliit na hayop.
