fact_bis: Ang roller motugdon sa habog nga dapit ug molupad paubos aron sakmiton ang insekto o gamayng hayop.

q: Why does your heart stop pounding so fast after you get a big scare and the danger is gone?
options: The body stops releasing adrenaline, so your heartbeat and breathing slowly return to normal.
Your brain sends a signal to your heart to beat faster so you can recover.
Adrenaline stays in your blood for hours and keeps your heart rate high.
Your muscles use up all the oxygen, forcing your heart to slow down immediately.
explanation: After the danger passes, the body stops releasing adrenaline, and your heartbeat and breathing slowly return to normal.

q: At what temperature does liquid water turn into ice?
options: 0°C (Celsius)
4°C (Celsius)
100°C (Celsius)
-10°C (Celsius)
explanation: Water freezes at 0°C (Celsius), the temperature at which it turns to ice.
fact_tl: Nagyeyelo ang tubig sa 0°C (Celsius), kung saan ito nagiging yelo.
fact_bis: Mogahi nga yelo ang tubig sa 0°C (Celsius), ang temperatura nga mahimo kining yelo.

q: What is a "water bear," and roughly how big is it?
options: A tiny eight-legged animal usually smaller than one millimeter.
A small six-legged insect that lives near ponds and lakes.
A microscopic plant that floats on the surface of water.
A type of water spider that can grow up to five centimeters long.
explanation: A tardigrade, also called a water bear, is a tiny eight-legged animal usually smaller than one millimeter.
fact_tl: Ang tardigrade o 'water bear' ay napakaliit na hayop na may walong paa, na kadalasang mas maliit pa sa isang milimetro.
fact_bis: Ang tardigrade o 'water bear' usa ka gamay kaayo nga mananap nga adunay walo ka tiil, kasagaran mas gamay pa sa usa ka milimetro.

q: Which list shows the electromagnetic spectrum in the correct order from the longest waves to the shortest?
options: Radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.
Gamma, X-ray, ultraviolet, visible light, infrared, microwave, radio.
Radio, infrared, microwave, visible light, X-ray, ultraviolet, gamma.
Visible light, radio, microwave, infrared, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.
explanation: The electromagnetic spectrum runs from the longest waves to the shortest in this order: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, and gamma.
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum, mula sa pinakamahabang alon hanggang pinakamaikli, ay nasa ganitong ayos: radio, microwave, infrared, nakikitang liwanag, ultraviolet, X-ray, at gamma.
fact_bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum, gikan sa kinatas-ang balod hangtod sa kinamub-an, naa niini nga han-ay: radio, microwave, infrared, makita nga kahayag, ultraviolet, X-ray, ug gamma.

q: After the kidneys clean the blood and make urine, where does the urine go before leaving the body?
options: It flows to the bladder, which stores it until we urinate.
It goes directly to the stomach to be broken down further.
It passes through the intestines and is mixed with solid waste.
It is carried back into the bloodstream to be filtered again.
explanation: From the kidneys, urine flows to the bladder, which stores it until we urinate.
fact_tl: Mula sa mga bato, ang ihi ay dumadaloy patungo sa pantog na nag-iimbak nito hanggang sa tayo ay umihi.
fact_bis: Gikan sa mga kidney, ang ihi modagayday paingon sa pantog nga nag-imbak niini hangtod kita mangihi.

q: What is a polyatomic ion?
options: A group of bonded atoms that together carry an electric charge.
A single atom that has lost or gained one electron.
A molecule that has no electric charge at all.
A type of metal that conducts electricity through a solution.
explanation: A polyatomic ion is a group of bonded atoms that together carry an electric charge, such as sulfate and ammonium.
fact_tl: Ang isang polyatomic ion ay isang pangkat ng mga atomong magkakabit na may kabuuang electric charge, gaya ng sulfate (SO₄²⁻) at ammonium (NH₄⁺).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka polyatomic ion mao ang usa ka grupo sa mga atomo nga nagbugkos nga adunay tibuok electric charge, sama sa sulfate (SO₄²⁻) ug ammonium (NH₄⁺).

q: When kapeng barako coffee is filtered, what happens to the coffee grounds?
options: They are trapped and left on top of the filter while the drink passes through.
They dissolve completely into the liquid so nothing is left behind.
They sink to the bottom of the cup along with the drink.
They are absorbed by the filter and become part of it permanently.
explanation: When kapeng barako is filtered, the clear drink passes through while the coffee grounds are trapped and left on top of the filter.
fact_tl: Kapag sinasala ang kapeng barako, dumadaan ang malinaw na inumin sa salaan habang naiiwan ang durog na butil ng kape sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Kon salaan ang kapeng barako, moagi ang tin-aw nga ilimnon sa salaan samtang mabilin ang giok nga lugas sa kape sa ibabaw.

q: How does the leptospirosis bacteria enter the human body?
options: Through cuts in the skin or through the eyes, nose, and mouth.
Only by swallowing contaminated food or water directly.
Through mosquito bites that inject the bacteria into the blood.
Through breathing in air near infected animals.
explanation: The leptospirosis bacteria enter the body through cuts in the skin or through the eyes, nose, and mouth.
fact_tl: Pumapasok ang bakterya sa katawan sa pamamagitan ng mga sugat sa balat o sa mata, ilong, at bibig.
fact_bis: Ang bakterya mosulod sa lawas pinaagi sa mga samad sa panit o pinaagi sa mata, ilong, ug baba.

q: Why is it important to trim your fingernails regularly?
options: So that dirt and germs do not collect underneath them.
So that your fingers grow longer and become stronger.
So that you can scratch more easily when you have an itch.
So that the nails become thicker and do not break easily.
explanation: We trim our fingernails with a clipper so that dirt and germs do not collect underneath them.
fact_tl: Pinuputol natin ang mga kuko gamit ang panggupit upang hindi makaipon ng dumi at mikrobyo sa ilalim ng mga ito.
fact_bis: Ginaputol nato ang atong mga kuko gamit ang kortador aron walay hugaw ug mikrobyo nga magtipon sa ilawom niini.

q: About how many days is a dog pregnant before giving birth?
options: About 63 days, or roughly nine weeks.
About 21 days, or roughly three weeks.
About 120 days, or roughly four months.
About 270 days, or roughly nine months.
explanation: A dog is pregnant for about 63 days, or roughly nine weeks, before giving birth.
fact_tl: Ang aso ay nagbubuntis nang halos 63 araw, o mga siyam na linggo, bago manganak.
fact_bis: Ang iro mabdos ug mga 63 ka adlaw, o mga siyam ka semana, una manganak.

q: Which statement about fish that can produce electric shocks is correct?
options: Only a few kinds of fish, like the electric eel and electric ray, can produce electric shocks.
All fish in the ocean can produce small electric shocks to defend themselves.
Only saltwater fish can produce electric shocks because of the salt in the water.
All fish can shock, but only when they feel threatened by a predator.
explanation: Most fish cannot shock at all; only a few kinds, like the electric eel and the electric ray, have a special electric organ.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng isda ay nakakakuryente. Karamihan ng isda sa dagat at ilog ay walang ganitong kakayahan. Iilang uri lang, gaya ng electric eel at electric ray, ang may espesyal na electric organ.
fact_bis: Dili tanang isda makakuryente. Kadaghanan sa isda sa dagat ug suba walay ingon niini nga abilidad. Pipila lang ka matang, sama sa electric eel ug electric ray, ang adunay espesyal nga electric organ.

q: How does the red chest patch of the male bleeding-heart dove compare to that of the female?
options: The male has a larger and more vivid red patch on the chest than the female.
The female has a larger and brighter red patch because she needs to attract a mate.
Both the male and female have exactly the same size and color of red patch.
Only the female has a red patch; the male's chest is plain white.
explanation: In most bleeding-heart dove species, the male has a larger and more vivid red patch on the chest than the female.
fact_tl: Sa karamihan ng uri ng bleeding-heart dove, ang lalaki ay may mas malaki at mas maliwanag na pulang marka sa dibdib kaysa babae.
fact_bis: Sa kadaghanan sa klase sa bleeding-heart dove, ang lalaki adunay mas dako ug mas hayag nga pula nga marka sa dughan kaysa babaye.

q: How does Earth behave in relation to magnetism?
options: The Earth acts like a giant magnet with its own magnetic field surrounding it.
The Earth is made of non-magnetic materials and has no magnetic field.
The Earth has a magnetic field only near the North Pole.
The Earth's magnetic field exists only in outer space, not near the surface.
explanation: The Earth acts like a giant magnet, with its own magnetic field surrounding it.
fact_tl: Ang Mundo ay parang isang malaking magnet na may sariling magnetic field na pumapalibot dito.
fact_bis: Ang Kalibotan sama sa usa ka dakong magnet, nga adunay kaugalingong magnetic field nga naglibot niini.

q: How many of Jupiter's moons did Galileo discover?
options: Four (4) moons.
Two (2) moons.
Seven (7) moons.
Twelve (12) moons.
explanation: Galileo discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang apat (4) na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter.
fact_bis: Nadiskubre ni Galileo ang upat (4) ka pinakadako nga bulan sa Jupiter.

q: What does power measure, and what unit is it expressed in?
options: How fast energy is used or produced, measured in watts.
The total amount of energy stored in an object, measured in joules.
The force applied to move an object, measured in newtons.
The distance an object travels per second, measured in meters.
explanation: Power is how fast energy is used or produced, measured in watts; the higher the wattage, the faster the work gets done.
fact_tl: Ang power ay kung gaano kabilis ginagamit o nililikha ang enerhiya, at sinusukat ito sa watt; mas mataas ang watt, mas mabilis ang paggawa ng trabaho.
fact_bis: Ang power mao kung unsa ka paspas gigamit o gimugna ang enerhiya, ug gisukod kini sa watt; mas taas ang watt, mas paspas mahuman ang trabaho.

q: Who invented the barometer, and in what year?
options: Evangelista Torricelli in 1643.
Galileo Galilei in 1610.
Isaac Newton in 1687.
Benjamin Franklin in 1752.
explanation: The barometer was invented by Evangelista Torricelli in 1643.
fact_tl: Ang barometer ay inimbento ni Evangelista Torricelli noong 1643.
fact_bis: Ang barometer gimugna ni Evangelista Torricelli niadtong 1643.

q: What is a carbon footprint?
options: The total amount of greenhouse gases a person releases through their habits such as electricity use and transportation.
The mark left on the ground by burning carbon-based fuels in factories.
The amount of carbon dioxide that cars produce per kilometer driven.
A measurement of how much carbon is stored inside plants and trees.
explanation: A carbon footprint is the total amount of greenhouse gases a person releases into the atmosphere through their habits such as electricity use and transportation.
fact_tl: Ang carbon footprint ay ang kabuuang halaga ng greenhouse gas na inilalagay ng isang tao sa atmospera sa pamamagitan ng kanilang mga gawi tulad ng paggamit ng kuryente at transportasyon.
fact_bis: Ang carbon footprint mao ang kabuuan sa gidaghanon sa greenhouse gas nga gibuhian sa usa ka tawo sa atmospera pinaagi sa ilang mga gawi sama sa paggamit sa kuryente ug transportasyon.

q: How does leptospirosis usually spread to people?
options: Through the urine of rats and other animals.
Through the bite of an infected mosquito.
By eating food that has been left out in the sun too long.
Through touching an infected person's skin directly.
explanation: Leptospirosis usually spreads through the urine of rats and other animals.
fact_tl: Karaniwang kumakalat ang leptospirosis sa pamamagitan ng ihi ng mga daga at iba pang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang leptospirosis kasagaran mokaylap pinaagi sa ihi sa mga ilaga ug uban pang mananap.

q: What kind of animal is a koala, and how does it carry its baby?
options: A marsupial that carries its baby in a pouch, just like a kangaroo.
A placental mammal that carries its baby inside the womb until fully grown.
A reptile that lays eggs and then guards them until they hatch.
A marsupial that carries its baby on its back using its tail.
explanation: The koala is a marsupial and has a pouch where it carries its baby, just like a kangaroo.
fact_tl: Ang koala ay marsupial din at may supot na dinadalhan ng kanyang anak gaya ng kangaroo.
fact_bis: Ang koala usa usab ka marsupial ug adunay supot diin gidala niini ang anak, sama sa kangguro.

q: If there is no air, which object hits the ground first when dropped from the same height — a heavy rock or a light feather?
options: They hit the ground at exactly the same time because gravity speeds both up equally.
The heavy rock hits first because gravity pulls harder on heavier objects.
The light feather hits first because it has less weight slowing it down.
It depends on the shape of the objects, not on gravity.
explanation: Without air to slow them, a heavy object and a light object fall and hit the ground at the same time because gravity speeds them up by the same amount.
fact_tl: Kung walang hangin na humahadlang, ang isang mabigat at magaang bagay ay magkasabay na bumabagsak dahil pinapabilis sila ng grabidad sa parehong dami.
fact_bis: Kon walay hangin nga makababag, ang bug-at ug gaan nga butang dungan nga mahulog kay gipaspas sila sa grabidad sa samang gidaghanon.

q: Both spiders and silkworms make silk, but how do they use it differently?
options: A spider uses its silk dragline for safety while a silkworm spins silk to build a cocoon.
A spider spins a cocoon with its silk while a silkworm uses silk to catch prey.
Both spiders and silkworms use their silk mainly to build cocoons.
A silkworm uses silk to make a safety line and a spider uses silk to make a cocoon.
explanation: Both spiders and silkworms make silk, but a spider uses its dragline for safety while a silkworm spins silk to build a cocoon.
fact_tl: Parehong gumagawa ng sutla ang gagamba at ang uod ng silkworm, pero ginagamit ng gagamba ang dragline para sa kaligtasan, samantalang ang uod ay para gumawa ng cocoon.
fact_bis: Parehong mohimo ug seda ang lawalawa ug ang ulod sa silkworm, apan ang lawalawa mogamit sa dragline alang sa kaluwasan, samtang ang ulod mohimo ug cocoon.

q: Why do schools in the Philippines regularly practice earthquake drills?
options: Because the Philippines is on the Ring of Fire, making earthquakes common, so people practice "duck, cover, and hold" to be ready.
Because the government requires all countries worldwide to hold earthquake drills every year.
Because the Philippines is far from any fault line, so drills are just a safety precaution.
Because earthquakes only happen in schools, which is why drills focus on classrooms.
explanation: Because the Philippines is on the Ring of Fire, earthquake drills are done regularly so that people are ready when the ground suddenly shakes.
fact_tl: Dahil nasa Ring of Fire ang Pilipinas, regular na isinasagawa ang earthquake drills sa mga paaralan at opisina. Sa pamamagitan ng pag-eensayo ng "duck, cover, and hold," nagiging handa ang mga tao kapag biglang yumanig ang lupa.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang Pilipinas naa sa Ring of Fire, kanunay ginahimo ang earthquake drills sa mga eskwelahan ug opisina. Pinaagi sa pagpraktis sa "duck, cover, and hold," maandam ang mga tao kon kalit motay-og ang yuta.

q: Why can the narra tree not be freely cut down in the Philippines?
options: Because too much logging has made it a protected tree that cannot be freely cut.
Because the narra wood is too soft to be useful for building anything.
Because the narra tree only grows in private gardens and not in public forests.
Because a new law requires all trees to be protected, not just the narra.
explanation: Because of too much logging, the narra is now protected and cannot be freely cut down.
fact_tl: Dahil sa labis na pagputol, pinoprotektahan na ang narra at bawal itong basta putulin.
fact_bis: Tungod sa sobrang pagputol, gipanalipdan na ang narra ug dili na basta putlon.

q: What is the main problem in a person who has type 2 diabetes?
options: The body still makes insulin but the cells stop responding to it well.
The body completely stops making insulin so blood sugar has no control at all.
The body makes too much insulin, causing blood sugar to drop dangerously low.
The kidneys destroy insulin before it can reach the cells that need it.
explanation: In type 2 diabetes, the body still makes insulin but the cells stop responding to it well.
fact_tl: Sa type 2 diabetes, gumagawa pa ng insulin ang katawan ngunit hindi na ito gumagana nang maayos sa mga selula.
fact_bis: Sa type 2 diabetes, naghimo pa ang lawas ug insulin apan dili na kini molihok ug maayo sa mga selula.

q: Which description correctly matches the three main types of clouds?
options: Cumulus look like cotton balls, stratus form flat layers, and cirrus are high and wispy.
Cumulus form flat gray layers, stratus are fluffy white puffs, and cirrus bring heavy rain.
Stratus look like cotton balls, cirrus form flat sheets, and cumulus are thin and high.
Cirrus are low and dark, stratus are puffy and white, and cumulus are thin feathery streaks.
explanation: Cumulus look like cotton balls, stratus form flat layers, and cirrus are high and wispy.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng ulap: ang cumulus ay parang bulak, ang stratus ay nakapatong na manipis, at ang cirrus ay matangkad at parang buhok.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing klase sa panganod: ang cumulus murag bulak, ang stratus nipis nga sapaw-sapaw, ug ang cirrus taas ug murag balhibo.

q: How does the mudskipper move when it is out of the water?
options: It uses its sturdy front fins like little arms or legs to push its body forward.
It flaps its tail back and forth to hop across the mud.
It inflates its belly to roll and bounce along the ground.
It uses its back fins as paddles to slide on the wet mud.
explanation: The mudskipper uses its sturdy front fins like little arms or legs to push its body forward.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mudskipper ng matibay nitong palikpik sa harap na parang maliliit na braso o paa para itulak ang katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang mudskipper mogamit sa iyang lig-on nga unahang palikpik nga morag gagmay nga bukton o tiil aron itulod ang iyang lawas.

q: How does igneous rock form?
options: When magma or lava cools and hardens.
When layers of sand and mud are pressed together over millions of years.
When existing rocks are squeezed and heated deep underground without melting.
When minerals dissolved in water slowly build up on the ocean floor.
explanation: Igneous rock forms when magma or lava cools and hardens.
fact_tl: Ang igneous na bato ay nabubuo kapag lumamig at tumigas ang magma o lava.
fact_bis: Ang igneous nga bato mabuo kung mobugnaw ug mogahi ang magma o lava.

q: Where in the Philippines can the balintong, or Philippine pangolin, be found?
options: Only in Palawan.
Only in Mindanao.
Only in Luzon.
Only in the Visayas.
explanation: The balintong, or Philippine pangolin, is an animal found only in Palawan in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang balintong o Philippine pangolin ay isang hayop na matatagpuan lamang sa Palawan sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang balintong o Philippine pangolin usa ka hayop nga makit-an lamang sa Palawan sa Pilipinas.

q: What is special about the coco de mer plant?
options: It produces the largest and heaviest seed in the world — one seed can weigh more than 15 kilograms.
It produces the most seeds of any plant — one tree can drop over a million seeds each year.
It has the widest leaves in the world, each big enough to shelter a family.
It grows the tallest trunk of any palm tree, reaching over 100 meters.
explanation: The coco de mer has the largest and heaviest seed in the whole world — a single seed can weigh more than 15 kilograms.
fact_tl: Ang coco de mer ay may pinakamalaki at pinakamabigat na buto sa buong mundo — ang isang buto nito ay maaaring umabot ng higit sa 15 kilo, mas mabigat pa sa isang batang sanggol.
fact_bis: Ang coco de mer adunay pinakadako ug pinakabug-at nga liso sa tibuok kalibotan — ang usa ka liso niini mahimong moabot og kapin sa 15 ka kilo, mas bug-at pa sa usa ka masuso.

q: Why might a shrimp move to deeper water when the surface of the sea or river gets too warm?
options: Because water is cooler in the deeper parts, giving the shrimp a cooler environment.
Because predators live near the surface and the shrimp wants to escape them.
Because food such as algae is always more plentiful in the deeper water.
Because shrimp need more oxygen, which is only found in deep water.
explanation: Water is cooler in the deeper parts of the sea or river, so a shrimp sometimes moves deeper when the surface water gets too warm.
fact_tl: Mas malamig ang tubig sa mas malalim na bahagi ng dagat o ilog, kaya minsan bumababa ang hipon sa mas malalim kapag masyadong mainit ang tubig sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Mas bugnaw ang tubig sa mas lawom nga bahin sa dagat o suba, busa usahay mokanaog ang hipon sa mas lawom kung init na kaayo ang tubig sa ibabaw.

q: Why do fishers release fish that are too small instead of keeping them?
options: Releasing small fish gives them a chance to grow up and breed.
Releasing small fish saves the fisher from getting fined for catching any fish at all.
Small fish taste bad, so fishers throw them back to avoid wasting cooking oil.
Small fish are too difficult to remove from the net, so it is easier to throw them back.
explanation: Releasing fish that are still too small gives them a chance to grow up and breed.
fact_tl: Ang pagpapakawala ng masyadong maliliit pang isda ay nagbibigay sa kanila ng pagkakataong lumaki at mag-anak.
fact_bis: Ang pagbuhi sa mga isda nga gamay pa kaayo naghatag kanila og kahigayonan nga modako ug makaanak.

q: What is remarkable about the strength of an ant compared to its size?
options: A single ant can lift objects many times heavier than its own body.
An ant can only lift objects that weigh the same as its own body.
Ants are actually very weak for their size, which is why they work in groups.
Ants can lift objects, but only ones that weigh less than half their own body weight.
explanation: Ants are very strong for their size — a single ant can lift objects many times heavier than its own body.
fact_tl: Napakalakas ng langgam para sa laki nito—kaya nitong magbuhat ng bagay na mas mabigat pa kaysa sa sarili nitong katawan nang maraming beses.
fact_bis: Ang hulmigas kusgan kaayo alang sa gidak-on niini—makahimo kini sa pagbuhat og butang nga mas bug-at pa kay sa kaugalingong lawas niini sa daghang pilo.

q: What do cold-blooded animals do in very cold weather?
options: They rest and barely move until the weather warms up again.
They shiver rapidly to generate body heat and stay active.
They migrate to warmer places just like many birds do.
They eat extra food to build up fat that keeps them warm.
explanation: In very cold places, some cold-blooded animals rest and barely move until the weather warms up again.
fact_tl: Sa mga lugar na napakalamig, ang ilang hayop na malamig ang dugo ay nagpapahinga at halos hindi gumagalaw hanggang uminit muli ang panahon.
fact_bis: Sa mga lugar nga sobra kabugnaw, ang ubang mananap nga bugnaw ug dugo magpahulay ug halos dili molihok hangtod nga moinit na usab ang panahon.

q: Why do farmers not need to replant a chili plant right away after harvesting the peppers?
options: A chili plant can keep producing peppers many times over several months.
Chili plants grow so fast that new seeds sprout on their own without replanting.
Once harvested, the chili plant grows an entirely new set of roots and starts over.
Chili plants can only grow in greenhouses, so farmers wait for the right conditions.
explanation: A chili plant can produce peppers many times over several months, so you do not need to replant right away.
fact_tl: Ang halaman ng siling haba ay maaaring mamunga nang maraming beses sa loob ng ilang buwan. Hindi mo kailangang magtanim ulit kaagad dahil patuloy itong nagbibigay ng sili.
fact_bis: Ang tanom sa siling haba makahatag og sili sa makadaghan sulod sa pipila ka bulan. Dili nimo kinahanglan magtanom dayon pag-usab kay padayon kining mohatag og sili.

q: Who is the unit of magnetic field strength called the "tesla" named after?
options: Nikola Tesla, the inventor who developed alternating current (AC) electricity.
Thomas Edison, who invented the direct current (DC) electrical system.
Michael Faraday, who discovered the principle of electromagnetic induction.
James Watt, who developed the steam engine and improved power measurement.
explanation: The tesla unit is named after Nikola Tesla, the inventor who developed alternating current (AC) electricity.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na tesla ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla, ang imbentor na nagpaunlad ng alternating current (AC) na kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang yunit nga tesla ginganlan kang Nikola Tesla, ang imbentor nga nagpalambo sa alternating current (AC) nga koryente.

q: Besides sweating and urinating, how else does the body lose water throughout the day?
options: By breathing out, because exhaled air carries water vapor.
By digesting food, because the stomach uses water to break food down.
By thinking hard, because the brain uses water to produce electrical signals.
By keeping the eyes open, because the eyeballs constantly release moisture into the air.
explanation: You also lose water every time you breathe out, because your breath carries water vapor — which is why a mirror fogs up when you breathe on it.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pawis at ihi, nawawalan ka rin ng tubig tuwing huminga ka, kasi may singaw na lumalabas ang hininga mo. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit nakakaulap ang salamin kapag hiningahan, at bakit kailangan natin tuloy-tuloy na uminom.
fact_bis: Gawas sa singot ug ihi, mawad-an ka usab ug tubig matag mogawas ang imong gininhawa, kay ang imong ginhawa nagdala ug singaw sa tubig. Mao nga moganga ang salamin kon ginhawaan, ug ngano kinahanglan ta padayong moinom.

q: Which animal group has the widest range of food choices — herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores?
options: Omnivores, because they eat both plants and meat.
Herbivores, because plants are found everywhere and are easy to find.
Carnivores, because they can eat any animal in the food chain.
All three groups have the same range of food choices.
explanation: An omnivore eats both plants and meat, giving it the widest range of food choices.
fact_tl: Ang herbivore ay halaman lang ang kinakain (gaya ng kalabaw), ang carnivore ay karne lang (gaya ng leon), at ang omnivore ay pareho (gaya ng tao). Ang omnivore lang ang may pinakamalawak na pagpipilian ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang herbivore tanom lang ang kan-on (sama sa kabaw), ang carnivore karne lang (sama sa leon), ug ang omnivore mokaon sa duha (sama sa tawo). Ang omnivore ra ang adunay pinakalapad nga kapilian sa pagkaon.

q: In the Philippines, which organization measures and reports the magnitude after every earthquake?
options: PHIVOLCS
PAGASA
NDRRMC
DENR
explanation: PHIVOLCS measures and reports the magnitude after every earthquake in the Philippines, so the numbers you hear in the news come from their measurements.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS ang sumusukat at nag-uulat ng magnitude pagkatapos ng bawat lindol. Kaya kapag may nababalitang lindol, ang numerong naririnig mo, gaya ng magnitude 5.4, ay galing sa pagsusukat ng PHIVOLCS.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS mao ang nagsukod ug nagreport sa magnitude human sa matag linog. Mao nga kung adunay balita nga linog, ang numero nga imong madungog, sama sa magnitude 5.4, gikan sa pagsukod sa PHIVOLCS.

q: Where do most metals used in everyday life originally come from?
options: From rocks called ore, which are dug from the ground and refined to get the pure metal.
From seawater, where dissolved metals are collected and filtered out.
From plant roots, which absorb metals from the soil and store them.
From the atmosphere, where metals drift down as tiny particles and are collected.
explanation: Most metals come from rocks called ore, which are dug from the ground and refined to get the pure metal.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng metal ay nakukuha mula sa mga batong tinatawag na ore, na hinuhukay sa lupa at pinipino para makuha ang purong metal.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa metal makuha gikan sa mga bato nga gitawag og ore, nga gikalot sa yuta ug gilunsay aron makuha ang lunsay nga metal.

q: How does a layer of snow protect the soil underneath from getting even colder?
options: Snow traps a lot of air, acting like a blanket that blocks extreme cold from reaching the soil.
Snow reflects all sunlight away from the ground, preventing heat from escaping.
Snow absorbs heat from the atmosphere and releases it slowly into the ground.
Snow is too thin to do anything; only ice can protect soil from freezing.
explanation: A layer of snow acts like a blanket because it traps a lot of air, blocking extreme cold and keeping the soil beneath from freezing even deeper.
fact_tl: Ang patong ng niyebe ay parang kumot sa lupa: dahil maraming hangin ang nakakulong sa loob nito, hinaharang nito ang sobrang lamig at pinipigilan ang lupa sa ilalim na mas lumamig pa.
fact_bis: Ang patong sa niyebe sama sa habol sa yuta: tungod kay daghang hangin ang nasakpan sa sulod niini, gibabagan niini ang grabe nga kabugnaw ug gipugngan ang yuta sa ilalom nga modugang pa og bugnaw.

q: Which animals hunt penguins when the penguins are swimming in the water?
options: Seals and orcas (killer whales).
Polar bears and wolves.
Giant squid and jellyfish.
Sharks and barracudas.
explanation: In the water, penguins can be hunted by seals and orcas, or killer whales.
fact_tl: Sa tubig, ang penguin ay maaaring habulin ng mga kaaway tulad ng seal at orca o killer whale.
fact_bis: Sa tubig, ang pingwino mahimong gukdon sa mga kaaway sama sa seal ug orca o killer whale.

q: What physical features can look different from one dog breed to another?
options: Their fur, ear shapes, and body sizes.
Only their eye color and nose shape.
Only the length of their tail.
Their number of legs and claws.
explanation: Different dog breeds have different fur, ear shapes, and body sizes.
fact_tl: Ang magkaibang lahi ng aso ay may magkakaibang balahibo, hugis ng tainga, at sukat ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang lainlaing kaliwat sa iro adunay lainlaing balhibo, porma sa dalunggan, ug gidak-on sa lawas.

q: What is the birthstone for the month of December, and what color is it?
options: Turquoise, which is a blue-green color.
Ruby, which is a deep red color.
Sapphire, which is a dark blue color.
Emerald, which is a bright green color.
explanation: The birthstone for December is the turquoise, which is a blue-green color.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Disyembre ay ang turquoise (turkesa), na asul-berde ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Disyembre kay ang turquoise (turkesa), nga asul-berde og kolor.

q: Why can a spider walk on its own dragline silk without getting stuck?
options: Dragline silk is dry and not sticky, unlike the sticky threads used to trap prey.
Dragline silk is coated with oil from the spider's legs that prevents sticking.
The spider's feet are too large to be caught by its own silk threads.
Dragline silk becomes sticky only when an insect touches it, not when the spider does.
explanation: Dragline silk is dry and not sticky, which is why the spider can walk on it — unlike the sticky web threads used to trap prey.
fact_tl: Hindi malagkit ang dragline silk, kaya nga kaya itong gamiting lakad-lakaran ng gagamba—iba ito sa malagkit na sapot na panghuli ng biktima.
fact_bis: Ang dragline silk uga ug dili pilit, mao nga malaktan kini sa lawalawa—lahi sa pilit nga lawa nga gigamit pangdakop ug biktima.

q: What does it mean when a scientist says an animal is 'critically endangered'?
options: The animal is very close to dying out forever and needs urgent help to survive.
The animal is common but lives only in a small area, so people must be careful near it.
The animal has just been discovered and scientists are still studying it.
The animal is dangerous to humans and has been moved to a protected zone.
explanation: 'Critically endangered' is the most dangerous level before an animal disappears forever, meaning very few are left and there is a high chance they will vanish without help.
fact_tl: Ang 'critically endangered' ay ang pinakamapanganib na antas bago tuluyang maglaho ang isang hayop. Ibig sabihin, kakaunti na lang silang natitira at malaki ang tsansa na mawala sila sa mundo kung walang tulong.
fact_bis: Ang 'critically endangered' mao ang pinakapeligrosong ang-ang sa dili pa hingpit nga mawala ang usa ka hayop. Buot pasabot, gamay na lang ang nahibilin ug dako ang kahigayonan nga mawala sila sa kalibutan kung walay tabang.

q: Who leads the judicial branch of the Philippine government?
options: The President of the Philippines
The Senate President
The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
The Secretary of Justice
explanation: The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court heads the judicial branch of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Punong Mahistrado (Chief Justice) ng Korte Suprema ang namumuno sa sangay na hudikatura.
fact_bis: Ang Punong Mahistrado (Chief Justice) sa Korte Suprema mao ang nangulo sa hudikatura.

q: What shape is the shell of a limpet?
options: Spiral and coiled, like a corkscrew
Flat and round, like a coin
Cone-shaped, like a tiny hat
Long and narrow, like a tube
explanation: A limpet is a kind of sea snail with a cone-shaped shell that looks like a tiny hat.
fact_tl: Ang limpet ay isang uri ng kuhol-dagat na may kabibeng hugis kono o parang munting sombrero.
fact_bis: Ang limpet usa ka klase sa kuhol-dagat nga adunay kabhang nga porma og kono o sama sa gamayng kalo.

q: Why is it important to bathe regularly with soap?
options: It removes dirt and germs that can cause illness in our body.
It keeps our hair shiny and helps us grow taller faster.
It makes our skin produce more vitamins from sunlight.
It stops mosquitoes from biting us during the day.
explanation: Bathing regularly with soap removes dirt and germs that can cause illness in our body.
fact_tl: Ang regular na paliligo gamit ang sabon ay nag-aalis ng dumi at mikrobyong maaaring magdulot ng sakit sa ating katawan.
fact_bis: Ang kanunay nga pagkaligo gamit ang sabon mokuha sa hugaw ug kagaw nga makahatag ug sakit sa atong lawas.

q: During a storm, why do we see lightning before we hear the thunder, even though both happen at the same time?
options: Thunder travels in a curve around clouds, so it takes longer to reach us.
Light travels much faster than sound, so the flash reaches our eyes first.
Lightning is created before thunder, so the flash starts earlier.
Sound needs water drops in the air to travel, which slows it down during rain.
explanation: Light is much faster than sound, so we see the lightning flash before we hear the thunder even though they happen at the same moment.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis nang husto ang liwanag kaysa tunog. Kaya kapag may kidlat, nakikita mo muna ang flash bago marinig ang kulog kahit sabay silang nangyari. Ito ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa sansinukob.
fact_bis: Mas paspas kaayo ang kahayag kaysa tingog. Mao nga kung adunay kilat, makita una nimo ang flash una madungog ang dalugdog bisan dungan ra sila nahitabo. Ang kahayag mao ang pinakapaspas nga butang sa kalibutan.

q: How is a static electricity spark different from the electricity that flows through a wire?
options: A static spark and wire electricity are the same; they just come from different sources.
Static electricity only forms during storms, while wire electricity works year-round.
A static spark builds up and jumps just for a moment, while wire electricity flows steadily through a path.
A static spark is much stronger than wire electricity and can power appliances.
explanation: Static electricity builds up and jumps for just a moment then stops, while the electricity from a battery or socket flows steadily as long as there is a path.
fact_tl: Iba ang static spark sa kuryenteng umaagos sa wire. Ang static ay nagtitipon at tumatalon nang sandali lang, tapos tumitigil. Ang kuryente naman sa baterya o saksakan ay tuloy-tuloy na umaagos hangga't may daanan. Kaya 'kuryente' pareho, pero magkaiba ang kilos.
fact_bis: Lahi ang static spark sa kuryente nga modagayday sa wire. Ang static magtigom ug molukso sa makadiyot lang, dayon mohunong. Ang kuryente gikan sa baterya o saksakan padayon nga modagayday basta naay agianan. Parehas nga 'kuryente', apan lahi ang kilos.

q: Why does the Philippines protect seahorses by law?
options: Seahorses are poisonous to fish, so protecting them prevents harm to fishermen.
Seahorses clean the ocean by eating pollution, so laws protect their habitat.
Seahorses are dried and sold as souvenirs or medicine, and the law keeps them from disappearing.
Seahorses can predict typhoons, so the government wants to study them.
explanation: In the Philippines, seahorses are protected by law because they are dried and sold as souvenirs or medicine, which threatens their survival in the sea.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar, pinapatuyo at ibinebenta ang seahorse bilang souvenir o panggamot, kaya sa Pilipinas ay protektado ito ng batas para hindi maubos sa dagat.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka dapit, ginapauga ug ginabaligya ang seahorse isip souvenir o tambal, busa sa Pilipinas gipanalipdan kini sa balaod aron dili mahurot sa dagat.

q: How have people created the many different breeds of dogs we see today?
options: By giving dogs special medicines that change how they look over many years
By choosing which dogs to breed together to pass on traits people want
By training dogs for many generations until the training becomes part of their body
By mixing dog DNA with other animals in a laboratory
explanation: By choosing which animals to breed, people have created new kinds with traits they want, like the many breeds of dogs.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng pagpili kung aling mga halaman o hayop ang pagpaparamihin, nakagawa ang tao ng mga bagong uri na may katangiang gusto nila, gaya ng iba't ibang lahi ng aso.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pagpili kung unsang mga tanom o hayop ang padaghanon, ang tawo nakahimo ug bag-ong matang nga adunay kinaiya nga ilang gusto, sama sa daghang lahi sa iro.

q: What is special about the spiral shape of a nautilus shell as it grows?
options: The shell changes to a completely different shape each time the animal gets bigger.
Each new section of the shell is a different color to attract a mate.
The curve keeps the same shape even as the chambers inside get bigger and bigger.
The shell grows in a straight line, then curves at the tip to close off each chamber.
explanation: As the nautilus grows, the spiral curve keeps the same shape even though the chambers get bigger and bigger, making it a beautiful pattern in nature.
fact_tl: Ang paikot na hugis ng shell ng nautilus ay isang magandang halimbawa ng pattern sa kalikasan. Habang lumalaki ito, pareho ang anyo ng kurba kahit lumalaki nang lumalaki ang silid.
fact_bis: Ang molikoliko nga porma sa kabibe sa nautilus usa ka nindot nga panig-ingnan sa pattern sa kinaiyahan. Samtang motubo kini, parehas gihapon ang porma sa kurba bisan magkadako ang mga lawak.

q: When was the main Taj Mahal mausoleum completed?
explanation: The main Taj Mahal mausoleum was completed in 1648, with the full complex finished by 1653.
fact_tl: Natapos ang pangunahing mausoleo ng Taj Mahal noong 1648, at ang buong kumpleto noong 1653.
fact_bis: Nahuman ang nag-unang mausoleo sa Taj Mahal niadtong 1648, ug ang tibuok niini niadtong 1653.

q: In what year was the double-helix structure of DNA discovered?
explanation: The double-helix structure of DNA was discovered in 1953.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang hugis double helix ng DNA noong taong 1953.
fact_bis: Ang double-helix nga porma sa DNA nadiskobrehan niadtong tuig 1953.

q: What does a dialysis machine do for a person whose kidneys are not working well?
options: It pumps extra blood into the body to replace what the kidneys lost.
It sends electrical signals to make the kidneys start working again.
It cleans the blood when the kidneys can no longer do that job.
It produces the hormones that healthy kidneys normally make.
explanation: When the kidneys no longer work well, a dialysis machine can help clean the blood in their place.
fact_tl: Kapag hindi na gumagana nang maayos ang mga bato, may makinang tinatawag na dialysis na tumutulong linisin ang dugo.
fact_bis: Kung dili na molihok og maayo ang mga kidney, adunay makina nga gitawag og dialysis nga motabang sa paglimpyo sa dugo.

q: How many flexible bands does the most common type of armadillo have across its armor?
options: Six
Twelve
Seven
Nine
explanation: The most common kind is the nine-banded armadillo, which has nine flexible bands across the middle of its armor.
fact_tl: Ang pinakakaraniwang uri ay ang nine-banded armadillo, na may siyam na nababaluktot na guhit sa gitna ng baluti nito.
fact_bis: Ang labing komon nga klase mao ang nine-banded armadillo, nga adunay siyam ka mahimo-himo nga guhit sa tunga sa iyang baluti.

q: About how long does a blue whale carry her baby before giving birth?
options: About 6 months
About 3 months
About 12 months
About 18 months
explanation: A blue whale is pregnant for about 12 months, similar in length to a human pregnancy.
fact_tl: Ang pagbubuntis ng blue whale ay umaabot ng mga 12 buwan.
fact_bis: Ang blue whale magmabdos sulod sa mga 12 ka bulan.

q: Why do hunting insects like dragonflies see better than many other insects?
options: They have a wider head that allows them to see in all directions at once.
They produce a special chemical that makes their lenses more transparent.
They have more individual lenses in their compound eyes than most other insects.
They can switch between day vision and night vision instantly.
explanation: Hunting insects like dragonflies have more lenses in their eyes, which gives them better vision than many other insects.
fact_tl: Ang mga insektong mangangaso tulad ng tutubi ay may mas maraming lente, kaya mas mahusay silang makakita kaysa sa ibang insekto.
fact_bis: Ang mga insekto nga mangangaso sama sa alindahaw adunay mas daghang lente, mao nga mas maayo silang makakita kaysa ubang insekto.

q: How do many birds keep their feathers strong and water-resistant?
options: They rub their feathers against tree bark to add a natural wax coating.
They take oil from a gland near their tail and spread it over feathers with their beak.
They sit in the sun for hours so the heat bakes a protective layer into the feathers.
They collect sap from plants and brush it through their feathers with their feet.
explanation: Many birds take oil from a gland near the tail and spread it over their feathers with their beak, keeping the feathers strong and water-resistant.
fact_tl: Sinasagap ng maraming ibon ang langis mula sa glandula malapit sa buntot at ipinapahid ito sa balahibo gamit ang tuka, kaya lalong matibay at hindi binabasa ng tubig ang balahibo.
fact_bis: Daghang langgam ang mokuha ug lana gikan sa glandula duol sa ikog ug ipahid kini sa ilang balhibo gamit ang sungo, mao nga molig-on ug dili mabasa ang balhibo.

q: How do cogon and talahib grasses spread their seeds to faraway places so quickly?
options: Their seeds are sweet and are eaten and dropped by birds across fields.
Their seeds hook onto animals' fur and are carried when the animals walk away.
Their seeds have tiny hairs that let the wind carry them to faraway places.
Their seeds float on water when it rains, spreading along ditches and streams.
explanation: The seeds of cogon and talahib have tiny hairs that let the wind carry them to faraway places, which is why they spread quickly across fields and empty lots.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ng cogon at talahib ay may maliliit na balahibo kaya madali itong tangayin ng hangin papunta sa malayong lugar. Dahil dito, mabilis silang dumami sa mga bukid at bakanteng lote.
fact_bis: Ang mga liso sa kugon ug talahib adunay gagmay nga balahibo mao nga sayon kini palidon sa hangin ngadto sa layong dapit. Tungod niini, paspas sila modaghan sa kaumahan ug bakanteng yuta.

q: How do fault-block mountains form?
options: Magma pushes up from below the ground and cools into a dome shape.
Two tectonic plates crash into each other and crumple the rock upward.
Huge blocks of rock are lifted up along a crack, or fault, in the ground.
Wind and water slowly remove soft rock and leave hard rock standing tall.
explanation: Fault-block mountains form when huge blocks of rock are lifted up along a crack, or fault, in the ground.
fact_tl: Ang fault-block mountains ay nabubuo kapag ang malalaking tipak ng bato ay naitataas sa tabi ng isang biyak o fault sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang fault-block mountains mabuo kung ang dagkong bloke sa bato maangat sa kilid sa usa ka liki o fault sa yuta.

q: Which body part of a snail builds and adds to its shell?
options: The foot, which secretes calcium while the snail moves
The mantle, which adds new shell material as the snail grows
The stomach, which absorbs minerals and passes them to the shell
The gills, which filter calcium from water and deposit it outside
explanation: A snail's shell is built by a body part called the mantle, which adds new shell material.
fact_tl: Ang bahay ng suso ay ginagawa ng isang bahagi ng katawan na tinatawag na mantle na nagdaragdag ng apog.
fact_bis: Ang kabhang sa suso gihimo sa usa ka bahin sa lawas nga gitawag mantle nga nagdugang ug bag-ong materyal.

q: Which statement about the human heart is true?
options: The heart rests for a few minutes each night while we are in deep sleep.
The heart works hard during the day but slows to nearly a stop at night.
The heart never stops beating, even while you sleep, throughout your whole life.
The heart stops briefly each time you sneeze or hold your breath.
explanation: The heart never stops beating even while you sleep, and it works your whole life without resting.
fact_tl: Ang puso ay hindi tumitigil sa pagtibok kahit natutulog ka, at gumagana ito sa buong buhay mo.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing dili moundang sa pagputok bisan natulog ka, ug naglihok kini sa tibuok nimong kinabuhi.

q: What was Jose Rizal's second novel called?
options: Noli Me Tangere
Sa Aking mga Kabata
El Filibusterismo
Mi Ultimo Adios
explanation: The second novel of Jose Rizal is El Filibusterismo.
fact_tl: Ang ikalawang nobela ni Jose Rizal ay ang El Filibusterismo.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang nobela ni Jose Rizal mao ang El Filibusterismo.

q: Why is copper commonly used to make electrical wire?
options: Copper is the hardest metal, so it does not bend or break when used in walls.
Copper is magnetic, which helps electricity flow through it faster than other metals.
Copper is ductile, meaning it can be pulled into very thin wire without snapping.
Copper is the lightest metal, making wires easy to hang and install in buildings.
explanation: Copper is ductile, meaning it can be pulled and stretched into very thin wire without snapping, which makes it easy to turn into wire.
fact_tl: Ang tanso ay 'nababanat' (ductile), ibig sabihin pwede itong hilahin at gawing napakanipis na kawad nang hindi nababali. Kaya madaling gawing wire ang tanso kaysa sa mga metal na malutong.
fact_bis: Ang tumbaga 'mabanat' (ductile), nga nagpasabot mahimo kining bira-on ug himoon nga nipis kaayo nga wire nga dili mabali. Busa sayon himoon nga wire ang tumbaga kaysa mga metal nga balasik.

q: Which best describes the patani (lima bean) plant?
options: A root vegetable whose orange tubers are dug from the ground and eaten
A climbing vegetable whose flat seeds grow inside long pods and are eaten as protein-rich food
A leafy plant eaten raw in salads and known for being very high in iron
A small tree whose hard brown seeds are ground into a powdery flour
explanation: The patani (lima bean) is a climbing vegetable whose flat seeds grow inside long pods and are eaten as a protein-rich food.
fact_tl: Ang patani ay isang gumagapang na halamang-gulay na may malalapad na buto sa loob ng mahahabang supot na kinakain bilang protina.
fact_bis: Ang patani usa ka nagakatay nga utanon nga adunay lapad nga mga liso sulod sa tag-as nga mga sopot nga ginakaon isip protina.

q: Who described the double helix shape of DNA in 1953, and whose X-ray photo helped prove it?
options: Louis Pasteur and Marie Curie — her radiation experiments confirmed the shape
Charles Darwin and Gregor Mendel — their plant experiments revealed the structure
James Watson and Francis Crick — with key X-ray evidence from Rosalind Franklin
Albert Einstein and Niels Bohr — their atomic theory led to the DNA model
explanation: In 1953, James Watson and Francis Crick described the double helix shape of DNA, and the X-ray photo taken by Rosalind Franklin was a big help in proving this shape.
fact_tl: Noong 1953, inilarawan nina James Watson at Francis Crick ang double helix na hugis ng DNA. Malaki ang naitulong ng X-ray na larawan ni Rosalind Franklin para mapatunayan ang hugis na ito.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1953, gihulagway ni James Watson ug Francis Crick ang double helix nga porma sa DNA. Dako ang natabang sa X-ray nga litrato ni Rosalind Franklin aron mapamatud-an kini nga porma.

q: Why do tall trees release their seeds from high branches?
options: The sun is stronger higher up, which gives the seeds more energy before they fall.
Falling from high up takes longer, so the wind has more time to carry seeds farther away.
Birds nest in high branches and help scatter seeds when they land on them.
Seeds need cold air found high up to start growing once they reach the ground.
explanation: Falling from high up, a seed takes longer to reach the ground, so the wind can carry it farther before it lands.
fact_tl: Maraming mataas na puno ang naglalabas ng buto mula sa itaas na sanga. Mula sa mataas na lugar, mas matagal bumagsak ang buto kaya mas malayo ito madadala ng hangin.
fact_bis: Daghang habog nga kahoy ang mobuhi sa liso gikan sa taas nga sanga. Gikan sa habog nga dapit, mas dugay mahulog ang liso mao nga mas layo kini madala sa hangin.

q: What is the difference between heat and temperature?
options: Heat and temperature mean exactly the same thing but are used in different subjects.
Heat tells us how cold something is, while temperature tells us how much energy it stored.
Heat is a form of energy, while temperature measures how hot something is.
Heat is measured with a thermometer, while temperature is felt only by touching.
explanation: Heat is a form of energy, while temperature measures how hot something is — they are related but different things.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang init at temperatura: ang init ay enerhiya, habang ang temperatura ang sukat kung gaano kainit ang bagay.
fact_bis: Lahi ang kainit ug temperatura: ang kainit usa ka enerhiya, samtang ang temperatura mao ang sukod kung unsa kainit ang butang.

q: Two people push a cart in the same direction. What happens to the cart compared to one person pushing alone?
options: The cart moves slower because two people create friction that cancels some force.
The cart moves at the same speed because the weight of people does not affect the cart.
The cart moves faster because the two forces add together for a bigger total push.
The cart stops sooner because having two pushers causes the wheels to lock.
explanation: When forces point in the same direction they add up, so two people pushing together give a bigger combined force that moves the cart faster than one person alone.
fact_tl: Kapag maraming force ang dumadapo, pinagsasama-sama ang mga ito para malaman ang kabuuang pagbabago. Kung magkadireksyon sila, nagdaragdag (mas malaking pagbabago); kung magkasalungat, nagbabawasan. Kaya dalawang taong sabay tumutulak sa kariton ay mas mabilis itong pinapagalaw kaysa isa lang.
fact_bis: Kung daghang force ang modapat dungan, gisagol kini aron mahibal-an ang kinatibuk-ang kausaban. Kung parehas og direksyon, magdugang (mas dako nga kausaban); kung magsumpaki, magkunhod. Mao nga duha ka tawo nga dungan moduso sa karomata mas paspas kini molihok kaysa usa ra.

q: Why is it a bad idea to scratch itchy skin very hard?
options: Scratching causes the skin to produce too much oil, which spreads the itch further.
Scratching removes the top skin layer, which traps more heat and makes swelling worse.
Scratching can open sores and let bacteria enter, making the infection worse.
Scratching sends nerve signals that slow blood flow and delay the body from healing.
explanation: Scratching itchy skin too much can open sores and let bacteria make the infection worse.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang pagkamot sa makating balat ay maaaring magbukas ng sugat at magbigay-daan sa bakterya na lumala ang impeksyon.
fact_bis: Ang sobra nga pagkalmot sa katol nga panit makaabli og samad ug makapasulod og bakterya nga molala ang impeksyon.

q: Which plastic item takes the longest time to break down in the environment?
options: A thin plastic bag, because it is the most common kind of plastic waste
A foam cup, because foam traps air and never fully breaks down
A thick plastic bottle or fishing line, which can take up to about 500 years
A plastic straw, because its small size means no animals can break it apart
explanation: Thicker and tougher plastics like a plastic bottle and fishing line take the longest to break down — up to about 500 years — because the thicker and tougher they are, the longer they last.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng plastik pareho ang tagal. Ang plastic bag ay matagal, pero ang makakapal na bagay tulad ng plastic bottle at fishing line ay mas matagal pang masira — umaabot ng halos 500 taon. Mas makapal at matibay, mas matagal.
fact_bis: Dili tanan plastik parehas ka dugay. Ang plastic bag dugay, apan ang baga nga mga butang sama sa plastic bottle ug fishing line mas dugay pa madunot — moabot og halos 500 ka tuig. Mas baga ug mas lig-on, mas dugay molungtad.

q: How do owls help farmers who grow crops?
options: Owls eat the insects that bite the farmers while they work in the fields.
Owls eat the rats that damage crops, protecting the farmers' harvest.
Owls chase away large birds that steal seeds before the plants can grow.
Owls dig up the soil with their talons, which helps aerate the farmland.
explanation: Owls help farmers because they eat the rats that damage crops, protecting the harvest.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang kuwago sa mga magsasaka dahil kinakain nito ang mga dagang sumisira sa pananim.
fact_bis: Ang bukaw makatabang sa mga mag-uuma kay kaonon niini ang mga ilaga nga modaot sa mga tanom.

q: What does a circuit breaker in a home do when too much electricity flows through the wires?
options: It stores the extra electricity in a battery for later use to prevent waste.
It slows the electricity down so appliances receive a steadier, safer current.
It automatically cuts off the electricity to prevent overheating that could start a fire.
It sends a signal to the electric company to lower the voltage coming into the house.
explanation: A circuit breaker automatically cuts off the flow of electricity when too much current flows, preventing overheating that could start a fire.
fact_tl: Ang circuit breaker sa bahay ay awtomatikong pumuputol ng daloy ng kuryente kapag sobra-sobra ito, upang maiwasan ang init na maaaring magdulot ng sunog.
fact_bis: Ang circuit breaker sa balay awtomatikong moputol sa agos sa kuryente kon sobra na kini, aron malikayan ang kainit nga makahatag og sunog.

q: How can tiny sea creatures called foraminifera eventually form rock?
options: They produce acid that dissolves sand on the seafloor and cements it into rock over time.
Their calcium carbonate shells sink and pile up on the seafloor, forming limestone over millions of years.
They build coral reefs by gluing sand grains together with a sticky secretion.
Their soft bodies decompose and release minerals that harden the seafloor into stone.
explanation: When foraminifera die, their calcium carbonate shells sink and accumulate on the seafloor, and over millions of years these shells can form limestone rock.
fact_tl: Ang mga foraminifera ay maliliit na single-celled na organismo na may calcium carbonate na shell; kapag namatay sila at lumubog, ang kanilang mga shell ay umupon sa sahig ng dagat at maaaring maging limestone sa pagtagal ng libu-libong taon.
fact_bis: Ang mga foraminifera gagmay nga single-celled nga organismo nga adunay calcium carbonate nga shell; sa dihang mamatay sila ug molubog, ang ilang mga shell nagtipon sa lapak sa dagat ug sa milyon ka tuig mahimong mabuhat og limestone nga bato.

q: What paddle position gives the strongest forward push when paddling a banca?
options: Holding the paddle at a wide angle so it scoops more water with each stroke
Holding the paddle nearly straight up-and-down as you pull it through the water
Holding the paddle flat along the surface so it does not disturb the water
Switching between angled and straight strokes to alternate the muscles used
explanation: For the strongest forward push, the paddle should be held nearly vertical as you pull it through the water; a flat angle wastes force by lifting water instead of driving the boat forward.
fact_tl: Para sa pinakamalakas na pasulong, dapat halos tuwid pababa (vertical) ang sagwan habang hinihila mo ito sa tubig. Kapag masyadong pahilig o pahalang ang sagwan, bahagi ng puwersa ay napupunta sa pagtaas ng tubig sa halip na sa pagtulak ng bangka pasulong.
fact_bis: Para sa pinakakusog nga pagpaunahan, ang bugsay angay nga halos tul-id paubos (vertical) samtang birahon nimo kini sa tubig. Kung sobra ka hilig o patag ang bugsay, bahin sa kusog moadto sa pagpataas sa tubig imbis sa pagduso sa sakayan paunahan.

q: What is actually happening when you see a spark of static electricity or a lightning bolt?
options: A new kind of energy is created when opposite charges collide in the air.
Heat builds up inside a cloud until it explodes outward as a flash of light.
Electrons suddenly jump through the air to a more balanced place, quickly transferring charge.
Magnetic fields from clouds pull positive particles down to the ground as a visible beam.
explanation: A spark or lightning bolt is a very fast kind of grounding — electrons suddenly jump across the air to a more balanced place, causing the flash and the crack.
fact_tl: Ang spark na nakikita mo (o ang malaking kidlat sa langit) ay isang napakabilis na uri ng grounding. Kapag napakaraming naipong charge, biglang tumatalon ang mga elektron sa hangin papunta sa mas balanseng lugar — iyon ang kislap at tunog. Mabilis na paglipat ng charge ito, hindi spesyal na enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang spark nga imong makita (o ang dako nga kilat sa langit) usa ka paspas kaayo nga matang sa grounding. Kung sobra na kadaghan ang natipon nga charge, kalit nga molukso ang mga elektron latas sa hangin paingon sa mas balanse nga lugar — kana ang kidlap ug tunog. Paspas nga pagbalhin sa charge kini, dili espesyal nga enerhiya.

q: Why do scientists group living things into similar kinds?
options: So they can give every organism a name in Latin that is easy to remember
So the huge variety of life is easier to study
So they can decide which animals need to be protected by law
So farmers know which plants and animals are safe to keep together
explanation: Scientists group living things into similar kinds so the huge variety of life is easier to study.
fact_tl: Inuuri ng mga siyentipiko ang mga buhay na bagay sa magkakahawig na grupo para mas madaling pag-aralan ang dami nilang uri.
fact_bis: Gigrupo sa mga siyentista ang mga buhing butang ngadto sa managsamang klase aron sayon ra tun-an ang ilang kadaghan nga matang.

q: How does a mother cow feed her newborn calf?
options: She chews grass and brings soft food back to the calf in her mouth.
She feeds the calf with milk from her body, because cattle are mammals.
She leads the calf to a water source where algae provide the calf's first food.
She teaches the calf to eat grass immediately, since calves are born with teeth.
explanation: Cattle are mammals, and a mother cow feeds her calf with milk.
fact_tl: Ang baka ay isang mamalya na nagpapasuso ng gatas sa kanyang anak na guya.
fact_bis: Ang baka usa ka mamalya nga nagpasuso og gatas sa iyang nati.

q: Why does a coffee bean come out whole after passing through a civet's digestive system?
options: The civet's stomach produces a special oil that coats the bean and protects it from acids.
The coffee bean has a hard outer shell that the civet's stomach cannot break down.
The civet swallows the bean too quickly for stomach acids to have any effect.
The bean's bitter taste signals the body to push it through without digesting it.
explanation: The coffee bean has a hard outer shell that the civet's stomach cannot break down, so it passes through the body whole and can still be used to make coffee.
fact_tl: Ang buto ng kape ay may matigas na balat na hindi kayang tunawin ng tiyan ng musang. Kaya kahit dumaan ito sa loob ng katawan, buo pa rin itong lumalabas at puwede pang gamitin para gumawa ng kape.
fact_bis: Ang liso sa kape adunay gahi nga panit nga dili matunaw sa tiyan sa musang. Mao nga bisan og moagi kini sa sulod sa lawas, mogawas gihapon kini nga buo ug magamit pa aron maghimo og kape.

q: How does the Philippines benefit from being located on the Ring of Fire?
options: Volcanic ash makes the soil very fertile, so the Philippines grows more rice than any country.
The Ring of Fire keeps ocean currents warm around the Philippines, helping fish to grow.
Underground volcanic heat is used in geothermal power plants to generate electricity.
Frequent small earthquakes break up rock, creating new islands that expand the land area.
explanation: The underground heat from the Ring of Fire is turned into electricity using geothermal power plants, making the Philippines one of the world's top users of geothermal energy.
fact_tl: May magandang dulot din ang Ring of Fire: ang init sa ilalim ng lupa ay ginagawang kuryente sa pamamagitan ng geothermal power plants. Isa ang Pilipinas sa mga nangungunang bansa sa paggamit ng geothermal energy galing sa init ng bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang Ring of Fire adunay maayong dala usab: ang kainit sa ilalom sa yuta gihimong kuryente pinaagi sa geothermal power plants. Ang Pilipinas usa sa nag-unang nasod sa kalibotan sa paggamit og geothermal energy gikan sa kainit sa bulkan.

q: What happens when light hits the boundary between a denser and a less dense material at an angle greater than the critical angle?
options: The light bends sharply and passes through to the less dense material at double the speed.
All the light reflects back inside the denser material instead of passing through.
The light splits into its rainbow colors and scatters in all directions.
The light is absorbed by the boundary and turned into heat energy.
explanation: When the angle is beyond the critical angle, all light reflects back inside the denser material — this is called total internal reflection.
fact_tl: Kapag ang liwanag ay pumunta mula sa mas siksik papunta sa mas baba ang density na materyal, mayroong isang critical angle — kapag nalampasan ito, ang buong liwanag ay nananatili sa loob at hindi na lumabas.
fact_bis: Kung ang suga mobalhin gikan sa mas siksik ngadto sa mas dili siksik nga materyal, adunay critical angle — kung malabaw na kini, ang tanang suga nagpabilin sa sulod — mao kini ang total internal reflection.

q: How many eggs does a Philippine eagle usually lay in its large nest?
options: Three eggs, so that at least one chick is likely to survive
Two eggs, one as a backup in case the first does not hatch
One egg, and the parents care for the single chick for a long time
Four to six eggs, matching the number laid by other large eagles
explanation: A Philippine eagle usually lays just one egg in its large nest high in a tall tree and cares for the single chick for a long time.
fact_tl: Karaniwang isang itlog lamang ang inilalagay ng Philippine eagle sa malaking pugad nito sa mataas na puno, at matagal nilang inaalagaan ang isang sisiw.
fact_bis: Kasagaran usa ra ka itlog ang gibutang sa Philippine eagle sa dako niini nga salag sa taas nga kahoy, ug dugay nilang atimanon ang usa ka piso.

q: Why can measles be especially dangerous for young children?
options: Measles causes an allergic reaction that permanently damages the skin of young children.
Measles spreads much faster in children than adults, infecting whole schools in hours.
Measles can become serious and lead to pneumonia in young children.
Measles causes high fever that damages the hearing of children under five.
explanation: Measles can become serious and lead to pneumonia, especially in young children.
fact_tl: Ang tigdas ay maaaring maging delikado at humantong sa pulmonya, lalo na sa maliliit na bata.
fact_bis: Ang tigdas mahimong delikado ug moresulta og pulmonya, ilabi na sa gagmay nga mga bata.

q: How can scientists study a tree's rings without cutting the tree down?
options: They take photographs of the bark and count patterns that match inner ring colors.
They use sound waves that travel through the trunk and reveal the ring spacing.
They take a thin pencil-like core of wood from the trunk using a special drill.
They wait for the tree to shed its bark each year and count the layers that fall off.
explanation: Scientists can take a thin pencil-like core of wood from the trunk with a special drill to study the rings without cutting the tree down.
fact_tl: Hindi kailangang putulin ang puno para makita ang singsing; ang mga siyentipiko ay kumukuha ng manipis na hibla ng kahoy gamit ang espesyal na barena.
fact_bis: Dili kinahanglan putlon ang kahoy aron makita ang mga singsing; ang mga siyentista mokuha og nipis nga lugas sa kahoy gamit ang espesyal nga barena.

q: How do Filipino farmers use worm farming (vermiculture) to help their crops?
options: They feed worms to chickens as a high-protein supplement to increase egg production.
They raise worms to eat pests in the soil that would otherwise damage the roots of rice.
They raise worms like the African nightcrawler to make vermicompost, used as organic fertilizer for rice and vegetables.
They use worms to break down pesticide residues in the soil before planting a new crop.
explanation: In the Philippines, many farmers raise worms like the African nightcrawler to make vermicompost, which they use as organic fertilizer for rice and vegetables.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, marami nang magsasaka ang nagpapalaki ng bulate gaya ng African nightcrawler para gumawa ng vermicompost. Ginagamit nila itong organic na abono sa palay at gulay, at ang sobra ay ibinebenta bilang dagdag-kabuhayan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghan nang mag-uuma ang nag-atiman og ulod sama sa African nightcrawler aron maghimo og vermicompost. Gigamit nila kini nga organic nga abono sa humay ug utan, ug ang sobra ibaligya isip dugang panginabuhi.

q: What is piña cloth traditionally used to make?
options: Ordinary school uniforms worn by students in public elementary schools
Woven baskets and bags sold at local markets during harvest festivals
The barong Tagalog and other formal Filipino clothing
Everyday casual shirts worn by fishermen along the Philippine coast
explanation: Piña cloth is used to make the barong Tagalog and other formal Filipino clothing.
fact_tl: Ang telang piña ay ginagamit sa paggawa ng barong Tagalog at iba pang pormal na damit ng mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang pinya nga panapton gigamit sa paghimo ug barong Tagalog ug uban pang pormal nga sinina sa mga Pilipino.

q: How does the sailfin lizard (ibid) escape from an enemy?
options: It puffs up its body to look too large to swallow and hisses loudly to scare the threat.
It changes its skin color to match rocks or leaves so the enemy cannot see it.
It leaps into the water and dives under, staying submerged for several minutes.
It runs on its hind legs at very high speed until it reaches a tree to climb.
explanation: When in danger, the sailfin lizard (ibid) can leap into the water and dive under, staying submerged for several minutes to hide from an enemy.
fact_tl: Kapag nahuli sa panganib, kaya ng ibid na tumalon sa tubig at sumisid sa ilalim, at puwede itong manatili sa ilalim ng tubig nang ilang minuto upang magtago sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Kon maabtan sa katalagman, ang ibid makahimo sa pag-ambak sa tubig ug mosalom sa ilawom, ug makapabilin kini ilawom sa tubig sulod sa pipila ka minuto aron motago gikan sa kaaway.

q: In a tin-can telephone, how does sound travel from one person to the other?
options: Sound waves travel through the air inside the string to the second can.
The metal cans convert sound into electrical signals that move along the string.
Sound travels as vibrations along the taut string connecting the two cans.
The string reflects sound waves back and forth between the two cans rapidly.
explanation: In a tin-can telephone, sound travels as vibrations along the taut string from one can to the other.
fact_tl: Sa telepono ng lata, ang tunog ay naglalakbay bilang panginginig sa banat na tali mula sa isang lata patungo sa kabila.
fact_bis: Sa telepono nga lata, ang tingog molakaw isip pag-uyog subay sa hugot nga tali gikan sa usa ka lata ngadto sa pikas.

q: Approximately how many Philippine eagles are estimated to remain in the wild?
options: About 50 to 100 individuals, mostly found in Luzon
About 800 to 1,100 individuals, mainly in Mindanao
About 3,000 to 5,000 individuals spread across all major islands
About 300 to 400 individuals, mostly in Palawan
explanation: Only an estimated 800 to 1,100 Philippine eagles remain in Philippine forests, mainly in Mindanao, making them critically endangered.
fact_tl: Ang agila ng Pilipinas, ang ating pambansang ibon, ay critically endangered — tanging 800 hanggang 1,100 na indibidwal na lamang ang natitira sa kagubatan ng Pilipinas, lalo na sa Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang agila sa Pilipinas, ang atong pambansang ibon, critically endangered — mga 800 hangtod 1,100 ka mga indibidwal na lamang ang nabilin sa mga kagubatan sa Pilipinas, labi na sa Mindanao.

q: Why do the Philippine islands form curved chains of volcanoes and mountains?
options: Strong ocean currents carved curved paths through the seafloor over millions of years.
The islands were once one large landmass that split apart and curved as it drifted.
The curved chains show where one tectonic plate is sliding under another (subduction).
Underwater volcanic eruptions always produce curved lava flows that harden into island arcs.
explanation: Philippine islands form volcanic arcs — curved chains of volcanoes and mountains — because they mark where one tectonic plate subducts beneath another.
fact_tl: Ang mga isla ng Pilipinas ay karaniwang nabuo sa anyo ng volcanic arcs—mga kurba na linya ng mga bulkan at bundok na nagpapakita ng mga lugar kung saan ang isang plaka ng tektono ay sumasalid sa ilalim ng isa pa.
fact_bis: Ang mga isla sa Pilipinas kasagaran nabuo sa anyo sa volcanic arcs—mga kurba nga kadena sa mga bulkan ug bundok nga nagpakita sa mga lugar diin ang usa ka tectonic plate mosubduct sa ilalim sa lain.

q: What part of a Campbell-Stokes sunshine recorder focuses sunlight onto the recording card?
options: A glass sphere
A curved mirror
A metal lens
A flat plastic plate
explanation: The Campbell-Stokes recorder uses a glass sphere to focus sunlight onto a card that records the hours of bright sunshine.
fact_tl: Ang sunshine recorder (Campbell-Stokes recorder) ay gumagamit ng isang bola ng salamin upang mag-focus ng liwanag ng araw sa isang card na nagtatala ng bilang ng oras ng sikat ng araw bawat araw.
fact_bis: Ang sunshine recorder (Campbell-Stokes recorder) naggamit sa usa ka bola nga salamin aron mag-focus sa liwanag sa adlaw sa usa ka card nga nag-rekord sa gidaghanon sa oras sa hayag nga sikat sa adlaw matag adlaw.

q: How does a shellfish's shell change as the animal gets older?
options: It grows bigger and gains lines showing its age
It stays the same size but gets harder
It shrinks and the animal moves to a bigger shell
It falls off and a completely new shell grows
explanation: A shell grows bigger as the animal grows and gains lines that show how old it is getting.
fact_tl: Lumalaki ang kabibe ng tahong habang lumalaki ang hayop, at may mga linyang nakikita rito tulad ng pagtanda nito.
fact_bis: Ang kabhang sa tahong modako samtang modako ang hayop, ug adunay mga linya nga nagpakita sa pagkatigulang niini.

q: What does a koala eat almost exclusively?
options: Eucalyptus leaves
Bamboo shoots
Acacia bark
Grass and berries
explanation: A koala eats almost only the leaves of the eucalyptus tree.
fact_tl: Halos dahon lamang ng eucalyptus ang kinakain ng koala.
fact_bis: Ang koala halos dahon lang sa eucalyptus ang ginakaon.

q: How fast can a tsunami travel in the deep ocean?
options: About 800 kilometers per hour
About 100 kilometers per hour
About 300 kilometers per hour
About 50 kilometers per hour
explanation: In the deep ocean, a tsunami can travel at almost 800 kilometers per hour, about as fast as a jet plane.
fact_tl: Sa malalim na karagatan, ang tsunami ay maaaring tumakbo nang halos 800 kilometro kada oras, kasimbilis ng isang jet plane.
fact_bis: Sa lawom nga kadagatan, ang tsunami makahimo og dagan nga halos 800 kilometro matag oras, sama kapaspas sa usa ka jet plane.

q: At what exact temperature does pure water freeze?
explanation: A pure substance like water melts and freezes at a sharp, precise temperature — exactly 0°C.
fact_tl: Ang isang purong sangkap ay natutunaw sa isang tukoy, matalas na temperatura — halimbawa, ang purong tubig ay nag-iice sa 0°C mismo. Ang mga halo ay natutunaw sa isang hanay ng temperatura.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka purong sangkap nagkatunaw sa tukoy, matalas nga temperatura — pananglitan, ang purong tubig nag-freeze sa 0°C gayud. Ang mga halo nagkatunaw sa hanay sa mga temperatura, dili sa usa ka punto.

q: What is the birthstone for the month of January?
options: Garnet
Amethyst
Diamond
Ruby
explanation: The birthstone for January is the garnet, which is usually deep red in color.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone (bato ng kapanganakan) para sa Enero ay ang garnet, na kadalasang pula ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone (bato sa kapanganakan) para sa Enero kay ang garnet, nga kasagaran pula og kolor.

q: What should you do after soaking fruit in a water-and-vinegar mixture?
options: Rinse it with clean water to remove the vinegar taste
Dry it immediately with a cloth to stop the vinegar working
Soak it in vinegar a second time for better results
Leave the vinegar on so it keeps killing germs
explanation: After soaking fruit in a vinegar-water mix you should rinse it with clean water to remove the vinegar taste and smell.
fact_tl: May naniniwalang mas malinis ang prutas kapag ibinabad sa tubig na may halong kaunting suka. Nakakatulong nga ito nang kaunti laban sa ilang mikrobyo, pero pagkatapos ay dapat pa ring banlawan sa malinis na tubig para matanggal ang lasa at amoy ng suka.
fact_bis: Adunay nagtuo nga mas limpyo ang prutas kung ibutang sa tubig nga sinagolan og gamayng suka. Makatabang gyud kini og gamay batok sa ubang mikrobyo, apan human niini kinahanglan gihapon banlawan sa limpyo nga tubig aron mawala ang lami ug baho sa suka.

q: What does finished compost look and smell like?
options: Dark, crumbly, and smells like fresh earth
Wet, slimy, and smells like rotting garbage
Light-colored, powdery, and odorless
Green and leafy, smelling like fresh-cut grass
explanation: Finished compost is dark, crumbly, and smells like fresh earth — signs that decomposition is complete.
fact_tl: Ang tapos nang compost ay maitim, durog-durog, at may amoy na parang sariwang lupa.
fact_bis: Ang humana nga compost itom, dugmok-dugmok, ug naay baho nga sama sa presko nga yuta.

q: Why does Uranus seem to roll around the Sun instead of spinning upright like most planets?
options: It is tipped over on its side
It spins much faster than other planets
Its gravity is too weak to hold it upright
It has no moons to keep it stable
explanation: Uranus is tipped over on its side, so it rolls around the Sun like a ball rather than spinning upright.
fact_tl: Ang Uranus ay nakatagilid nang husto, kaya tila gumugulong ito sa paligid ng Araw na parang bola sa halip na tumayong tuwid.
fact_bis: Ang Uranus nakahapay sa iyang kilid, mao nga morag nagligid kini libot sa Adlaw sama sa bola imbis nga magtindog og tul-id.

q: What happens in the body when someone is choking?
options: Food or an object blocks the airway so the person cannot breathe
The stomach is too full and the person feels sick
Blood cannot reach the brain so the person feels dizzy
The throat swells up from an allergic reaction
explanation: Choking happens when food or an object blocks the airway, so a person cannot breathe.
fact_tl: Ang pagkabilaukan ay nangyayari kapag may pagkain o bagay na humaharang sa daanan ng hangin, kaya hindi makahinga ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang pagkabilaukan mahitabo kung may pagkaon o butang nga nakababag sa agianan sa hangin, busa dili makaginhawa ang tawo.

q: Why was Palawan designated a UNESCO biosphere reserve?
options: Because it has an extraordinary number of animal and plant species found nowhere else on Earth
Because it has the largest coral reef in Southeast Asia
Because it is home to the most endangered species in Asia
Because it produces the most medicinal plants in the Philippines
explanation: Palawan was designated a UNESCO biosphere reserve because of its extraordinary number of animal and plant species found nowhere else on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang Palawan ay itinalaga ng UNESCO bilang isang biosphere reserve dahil sa napakaraming uri ng hayop at halaman na hindi makikita kahit saan pa sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Palawan gidesignahan sa UNESCO isip biosphere reserve tungod sa napakaorihinal nga gidaghanon sa mga mananap ug tanom nga wala makita bisan asa pa sa kalibutan.

q: In which direction does friction always act on a moving object?
options: Opposite to the direction of the object's motion
In the same direction as the object's motion
Perpendicular to the direction of the object's motion
Downward toward the ground
explanation: Friction is a force that always acts in the opposite direction to an object's motion.
fact_tl: Ang friction (friksyon) ay isang puwersang laging nakaharap sa kabaligtaran ng direksiyon ng paggalaw ng isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang friction (friksyon) usa ka kusog nga kanunay nag-atubang sa atbang nga direksiyon sa paglihok sa usa ka butang.

q: Why does frozen water (ice) take up more space than liquid water of the same mass?
options: When water freezes, its molecules lock into a more open pattern that takes up more space
When water freezes, the molecules shrink and move farther apart randomly
When water freezes, it gains extra molecules from the surrounding air
When water freezes, heat pushes the molecules outward so they spread apart
explanation: When water freezes, its molecules lock into a more open pattern, so the same mass takes up more space and density drops.
fact_tl: Kapag nagyeyelo ang tubig, ang mga molekula nito ay umaayos sa mas maluwag na hugis, kaya parehong timbang ngunit mas malaki ang espasyo, kaya mas magaan ang densidad.
fact_bis: Kon mogahi ang tubig nga yelo, ang mga molekula niini maglinya sa mas luag nga han-ay, mao nga pareho og gibug-aton apan mas dako og espasyo, busa mas gaan ang densidad.

q: What is one use of sonar in the ocean?
options: Finding schools of fish and sunken ships hidden underwater
Measuring the temperature of deep ocean currents
Sending radio messages between submarines
