explanation: In science, work is done when a force makes an object actually move some distance.
fact_tl: Sa agham, ang trabaho ay nangyayari kapag ang isang puwersa ay nagpagalaw ng isang bagay sa layong tinahak.
fact_bis: Sa siyensya, naa'y trabaho kung ang usa ka puwersa makapalihok sa usa ka butang sa gilay-on nga gilaktan.

q: What do we call the simplest pure substance that cannot be broken down into any other kind of matter — like gold or oxygen?
options: A mixture
A compound
An element
A molecule
explanation: An element is the simplest pure substance that cannot be broken into other kinds of matter, such as gold or oxygen.
fact_tl: Ang elemento ay ang pinakasimpleng purong sangkap na hindi na mahahati sa ibang uri ng bagay, gaya ng ginto o oksiheno.
fact_bis: Ang elemento mao ang pinakasimple nga purong sangkap nga dili na mabahin sa ubang klase sa butang, sama sa bulawan o oxygen.

q: During a severe sandstorm, what happens to visibility?
options: Visibility actually improves because fine dust filters harsh sunlight
Visibility drops so much that you can barely see your own hand
Visibility stays the same because sand stays close to the ground
Visibility drops slightly but you can still see about 50 meters ahead
explanation: During a sandstorm, so much sand and dust fills the air that visibility can drop until you can barely see your own hand.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng isang sandstorm, ang dami ng lumilipad na buhangin at alikabok ay maaaring magpalabo ng paningin hanggang sa halos hindi na makita ang kamay mo.
fact_bis: Sa taliwala sa usa ka sandstorm, daghan kaayong naglupad nga balas ug abog mao nga ang panan-aw mahimong hapit dili na makita ang imong kamot.

q: Manny Pacquiao is the only boxer in history to win world titles in how many different weight divisions?
options: Five
Six
Seven
Eight
explanation: Manny Pacquiao is the only boxer to win world titles in eight different weight divisions.
fact_tl: Si Manny Pacquiao ang tanging boksingero na nanalo ng world title sa walong magkaibang dibisyon ng timbang.
fact_bis: Si Manny Pacquiao ang bugtong nga boksingero nga nakadaog ug world title sa walo ka lain-laing dibisyon sa timbang.

q: Why does a crowbar with a long handle make it easier to lift heavy objects?
options: A longer handle means the crowbar is heavier and has more force
A longer handle lets you move faster, increasing the energy delivered
A longer lever arm means you are farther from the fulcrum and need less strength
A longer handle reduces the distance the object needs to be moved
explanation: A longer lever arm from the fulcrum to your hand means you need less strength to lift, which is why a crowbar has a long handle.
fact_tl: Mas madaling magbuhat kapag mas mahaba ang braso ng lever mula sa fulcrum hanggang sa kamay mo. Kaya may mahabang hawakan ang barreta — para mas malayo ka sa fulcrum at mas kaunti ang lakas na kailangan.
fact_bis: Mas sayon ang pag-alsa kung mas taas ang braso sa lever gikan sa fulcrum hangtod sa imong kamot. Mao nga ang barreta adunay taas nga kuptanan — aron mas layo ka sa fulcrum ug mas gamay ang kusog nga gikinahanglan.

q: Your inner ear sends signals when you hear something. Which part of your body actually turns those signals into the sounds you recognize?
options: The eardrum
The outer ear canal
The brain
The cochlea
explanation: The inner ear sends signals to the brain, and the brain is what turns them into the sounds we recognize.
fact_tl: Ang panloob na tainga ay nagpapadala ng mga senyales sa utak, at ang utak ang nagpapakahulugan sa mga ito bilang tunog.
fact_bis: Ang sulod nga dalunggan magpadala og mga senyales ngadto sa utok, ug ang utok maoy mohubad niini ingong tingog.

q: A parrotfish uses its hard beak to scrape algae off coral. What does it accidentally produce that ends up on beaches?
options: Colorful pieces of broken coral
White sand made from ground-up rock it poops out
A sticky mucus that hardens into sand
Salt crystals from the seawater it filters
explanation: As a parrotfish feeds, it grinds up bits of rock and poops them out as white sand — so part of a white beach actually came from parrotfish.
fact_tl: May isda sa bahura na tinatawag na parrotfish na may matigas na tukang parang sa loro. Ginagamit nila ito para mag-katkat ng lumot sa coral. Habang kumakain, naiipon nila ang durog na bato at inilalabas ito bilang puting buhangin, kaya may bahagi ang mga puting beach na galing talaga sa parrotfish.
fact_bis: Adunay isda sa bahura nga gitawag og parrotfish nga adunay gahi nga tuka sama sa loro. Gamiton nila kini aron mokiskis sa lumot gikan sa coral. Samtang mokaon, magaling sila og gagmay nga bato ug iluwa kini isip puti nga balas, mao nga ang ubang puti nga baybayon naggikan gyud sa parrotfish.

q: What is lymph, the clear fluid that moves through the body's lymphatic system?
options: A fluid produced directly by the kidneys to carry waste
Fluid that leaks out between the body's cells and is collected
A type of blood that has been filtered by the liver
A fluid made in the stomach to help digest food
explanation: Lymph is a clear fluid that comes from the fluid that leaks out between the body's cells.
fact_tl: Ang limpa ay malinaw na likido na galing sa likidong tumatagas sa pagitan ng mga selula ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang limpa usa ka tin-aw nga likido nga gikan sa likido nga nagtulo taliwala sa mga selula sa lawas.

q: What does the Philippine Eagle use its sharp, hooked beak for?
options: To dig nests in tree trunks
To crack open hard seeds and nuts
To tear apart the meat of its catch
To scoop fish from rivers
explanation: The eagle has a sharp, hooked beak that it uses to tear apart the meat of its prey.
fact_tl: May matalim at baluktot na tuka ang agila na ginagamit nito para punitin ang laman ng hinuli.
fact_bis: Ang agila adunay hait ug kurbado nga sungo nga gigamit aron gision ang unod sa iyang nadakpan.

q: Where in the Philippines can you find the famous Banaue Rice Terraces, the step-like rice fields carved into mountains?
options: In Mindanao, in the Bukidnon highlands
In the Visayas, on Bohol island
In Luzon, in the Cordillera mountains
In Palawan, along the coast
explanation: The Banaue Rice Terraces are found in Luzon, specifically in the Cordillera mountains.
fact_tl: Sa Luzon matatagpuan ang Banaue Rice Terraces, ang mga sikat na hagdan-hagdang palayan sa Cordillera.
fact_bis: Sa Luzon makit-an ang Banaue Rice Terraces, ang bantogang hagdan-hagdan nga humayan sa Cordillera.

q: The liver produces a digestive liquid called bile. Where is bile stored until the body needs it?
options: In the pancreas
In the small intestine
In the gallbladder
In the stomach
explanation: The bile made by the liver is stored in a small pouch called the gallbladder.
fact_tl: Ang apdong gawa ng atay ay iniimbak sa isang maliit na supot na tinatawag na apdo-supot o gallbladder.
fact_bis: Ang apdo nga gihimo sa atay gitipigan sa gamay nga supot nga gitawag og gallbladder o supot sa apdo.

q: After you eat, bacteria in your mouth make acid that can damage your teeth. How does toothpaste protect your teeth from this acid?
options: Toothpaste is acidic too and dissolves the bacteria directly
Toothpaste creates a hard coating over each tooth to block the acid
Toothpaste is slightly basic, so it neutralizes the mouth acid
Toothpaste makes your mouth too dry for bacteria to produce acid
explanation: Toothpaste is slightly basic, so it neutralizes the acid made by bacteria in your mouth, protecting teeth from decay.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos kumain, ang mga bakterya sa bibig ay gumagawa ng asido na sumisira sa ngipin. Ang toothpaste ay bahagyang base, kaya nito tinu-neutralize ang asidong ito at pinoprotektahan ang ngipin sa pagkabulok. Kaya mahalaga ang pagsisipilyo — hindi lang para malinis, kundi para mabalanse rin ang asido.
fact_bis: Human mokaon, ang mga bakterya sa baba maghimo og asido nga magdaot sa ngipon. Ang toothpaste gamay nga base, mao nga gi-neutralize niini kanang asido ug gipanalipdan ang ngipon gikan sa pagkadunot. Mao nga importante ang pagsipilyo — dili lang para limpyo, kondili para mabalanse usab ang asido.

q: What is it called when a plant bends and grows toward a light source to capture more sunlight?
options: Geotropism
Hydrotropism
Phototropism
Thigmotropism
explanation: Phototropism is the way a plant bends and grows toward a light source so it can capture more sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang phototropism ay ang paghilig at pagtubo ng halaman patungo sa pinanggagalingan ng liwanag upang makakuha ng mas maraming sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang phototropism mao ang pagpaingon ug pagtubo sa tanom paingon sa gigikanan sa kahayag aron makakuha ug mas daghang silaw sa adlaw.

q: Why can't you see wild prairie dogs in the Philippines?
options: Prairie dogs only live in very cold Arctic regions, not in tropical Asia
Prairie dogs live in the wide grasslands of North America, not the Philippines
Prairie dogs are now extinct everywhere in the wild
Prairie dogs used to live in the Philippines but were hunted away
explanation: Prairie dogs live in the wide grasslands of North America, so there are no wild prairie dogs in the Philippines — we can only see them in pictures, books, or videos.
fact_tl: Walang prairie dog sa kalikasan ng Pilipinas—nakatira sila sa malalawak na damuhan ng North America. Dito, makikita lang natin sila sa mga larawan, libro, o video.
fact_bis: Walay ihalas nga prairie dog sa Pilipinas—nagpuyo sila sa lapad nga kasagbutan sa North America. Dinhi, makita lang nato sila sa mga litrato, libro, o video.

q: A crab has a hard outer shell and legs with joints, making it an arthropod. Which other animals are relatives of the crab?
options: Fish and sharks
Worms and snails
Insects and spiders
Frogs and lizards
explanation: A crab is an arthropod — the same group that includes insects and spiders — because they all have hard outer shells and jointed legs.
fact_tl: Ang alimango ay isang arthropod, ibig sabihin may matigas itong balat sa labas at mga paang may biyas (joints); kaya kamag-anak ito ng mga insekto at gagamba.
fact_bis: Ang alimango usa ka arthropod, nagpasabot nga adunay kini gahi nga panit sa gawas ug mga tiil nga adunay lutahan; mao nga paryente kini sa mga insekto ug lawalawa.

q: Why does a baby tooth loosen and fall out as a child grows older?
options: The tooth gets too heavy and pulls itself out
The gums shrink and can no longer hold the tooth in place
The new permanent tooth growing underneath slowly dissolves the baby tooth's root
Eating hard food gradually breaks the root of the baby tooth
explanation: A baby tooth falls out because the new permanent tooth growing underneath slowly dissolves its root until it loosens and drops.
fact_tl: Hindi basta nahuhulog ang gatasong ngipin — ang bagong permanenteng ngipin sa ilalim ay dahan-dahang tinutunaw ang ugat ng gatasong ngipin hanggang lumuwag ito at malaglag.
fact_bis: Dili lang basta matangtang ang ngipon sa gatas — ang bag-ong permanente nga ngipon sa ilawom hinay-hinay nga motunaw sa gamot sa ngipon sa gatas hangtod nga moluag kini ug matangtang.

q: The word 'pangolin' comes from a Malay word that means what?
options: Scaly armor
One that rolls up
Silent hunter
Ant eater
explanation: Pangolin comes from the Malay word pengguling, meaning 'one that rolls up,' because the pangolin curls into a ball when threatened.
fact_tl: Ang salitang pangolin ay nagmula sa salitang Malay na pengguling na ang ibig sabihin ay isa na gumugulong, dahil tumitiklop ito na parang bola.
fact_bis: Ang pulong nga pangolin gikan sa Malay nga pulong nga pengguling nga nagkahulogan ug usa nga molingin, kay molingin man kini nga morag bola.

q: When a plant does not get enough water, its cells lose pressure and it wilts. What process moves water across the plant cell membrane?
options: Photosynthesis
Osmosis
Transpiration
Diffusion
explanation: Through osmosis, water crosses the plant cell membrane, and when water is scarce, plant cells lose pressure and the plant wilts.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng osmosis, ang tubig ay tumatawid sa lamad ng selula ng halaman at kapag kulang ang tubig, nalalanta ang halaman dahil nawawalan ng presyon ang mga selula.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa osmosis, ang tubig motabok sa cell membrane sa tanom, ug kung kulang ang tubig, malaya ang tanom tungod kay ang mga selula mawala og presyon.

q: When you stretch and pluck a thick rubber band, it vibrates slowly. What kind of sound does a slowly vibrating object make?
options: A high-pitched squeal
A loud cracking sound
A low hum
A sharp clicking noise
explanation: A thick rubber band vibrates slowly when plucked, and a slowly vibrating object produces a low hum.
fact_tl: Subukan mong banatin ang isang makapal na lastiko at kalbitin ito. Mabagal itong magva-vibrate at maririnig mo ang mababang 'hum'. Ang kapal nito ang dahilan kaya mabagal ang galaw at mababa ang tunog.
fact_bis: Sulayi pagbira ang baga nga lastiko ug kalbita kini. Hinay kini mag-vibrate ug madungog nimo ang mubo nga 'hum'. Ang kabaga niini mao ang hinungdan nga hinay kini molihok ug mubo ang tingog.

q: Before putting a bottle or can in the recycling bin, what should you do to it first?
options: Crush it completely flat so it takes less space in the bin
Paint or mark it so workers know it is recyclable
Rinse or wash it to remove leftover food or drink
Remove all labels and any plastic caps before recycling
explanation: Rinsing or washing a container removes leftover food or drink that could spoil other clean recyclables and prevent them from being reused.
fact_tl: Bago mo i-recycle ang isang bote o lata, mabuting banlawan o hugasan muna ito para matanggal ang tira-tirang pagkain o inumin. Kapag marumi ang lalagyan, puwedeng masira nito ang ibang malilinis na recyclable at hindi na ito magamit ulit. Hindi kailangang super linis, basta walang dumi o amoy.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa nimo i-recycle ang botelya o lata, maayo nga banlawan o hugasan kini una aron matangtang ang nahabilin nga pagkaon o ilimnon. Kon hugaw ang sudlanan, mahimong madaot niini ang ubang limpyo nga recyclables ug dili na kini magamit usab. Dili kinahanglan hinlo kaayo, basta walay buling o baho.

q: What country was the famous scientist Louis Pasteur from?
options: Germany
France
England
Italy
explanation: Louis Pasteur was a French scientist, meaning he came from France.
fact_tl: Si Louis Pasteur ay isang Pranses (taga-France) na siyentipiko.
fact_bis: Si Louis Pasteur usa ka Pranses (taga-France) nga siyentista.

q: What is one important reason why mangroves are planted along coastlines?
options: They provide wood for building houses near the sea
They block big waves and give fish a place to live
They prevent rain from falling directly on the shore
They remove salt from the ocean so people can drink the water
explanation: Planting mangroves along the coast blocks big waves and gives fish a place to live.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatanim ng bakawan sa baybayin ay humahadlang sa malalaking alon at nagbibigay ng tirahan sa mga isda.
fact_bis: Ang pagtanom og bakawan sa baybayon makasanta sa dagkong balod ug makahatag og puy-anan sa mga isda.

q: John Dalton, the scientist known for his work on atoms, was from which country?
options: Scotland
Wales
England
Ireland
explanation: John Dalton was an English scientist.
fact_tl: Si John Dalton ay isang Ingles (English) na siyentipiko.
fact_bis: Si John Dalton usa ka English (Ingles) nga siyentipiko.

q: Why can the calamansi tree bear fruit almost all year round in the Philippines?
options: Because Filipino farmers water it every single day
Because it is grown in greenhouses with special lights
Because the warm Philippine climate allows it to fruit year-round
Because it only needs to be planted once and never dies
explanation: The warm Philippine climate allows the calamansi tree to bear fruit almost all year round.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na klima ng Pilipinas, ang kalamansi ay maaaring mamunga halos buong taon.
fact_bis: Sa init nga klima sa Pilipinas, ang kahoy sa kalamansi makamunga halos tibuok tuig.

q: What do lanternfish do differently during the day compared to at night?
options: They glow brightly during the day to attract mates, then go dark at night
They swim at the surface during the day and sink deep at night
They hide in the deep ocean during the day and rise to the surface at night to feed
They sleep on the ocean floor during the day and hunt in the middle ocean at night
explanation: Lanternfish hide deep during the day and rise to the surface at night to feed.
fact_tl: Ang mga lanternfish (Myctophidae) ay marahil isa sa pinakamaraming vertebrate sa dagat; nagtatago sila sa malalim sa araw at umaangat sa ibabaw sa gabi upang kumain — ang kanilang mga photophore ay gumagawa ng mga kumukunap na liwanag na ginagamit para sa kominikasyon at kamuflahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga lanternfish (Myctophidae) tingali usa sa pinaka-daghan nga mga vertebrate sa dagat; nagtago sila sa kailalman sa adlaw ug mokyat sa ibabaw sa gabii aron mokaon — ang ilang mga photophore nagbuhat og mga kislap sa suga nga gigamit sa komunikasyon ug camouflage.

q: The word 'vaccine' comes from a Latin word meaning what animal?
options: Horse
Pig
Goat
Cow
explanation: The word 'vaccine' comes from the Latin word 'vacca,' meaning cow, because Jenner first used cowpox to protect people.
fact_tl: Ang salitang 'vaccine' ay galing sa Latin na 'vacca' na ang ibig sabihin ay baka, dahil sa cowpox na unang ginamit ni Jenner.
fact_bis: Ang pulong nga 'vaccine' naggikan sa Latin nga 'vacca,' nga nagpasabot baka, tungod sa cowpox nga unang gigamit ni Jenner.

q: How do animals help plants when they eat fruit?
options: They water the plant's roots when they drink nearby
They help scatter the plant's seeds to faraway places
They keep insects from eating the plant's leaves
They make the soil richer by digging around the plant
explanation: When animals eat fruit, they help scatter the seeds to faraway places.
fact_tl: Kapag kinakain ng hayop ang prutas, naikakalat nila ang mga buto sa malalayong lugar.
fact_bis: Kon kan-on sa mga hayop ang bunga, makatabang sila sa pagkatag sa mga liso ngadto sa layong mga dapit.

q: Why do people cook malunggay pods before eating them?
options: Cooking removes the poison that is inside the raw pods
Cooking makes their tough skin and pulp soft and brings out their flavor
Cooking turns malunggay pods from green to a brighter color so they look nicer
Cooking adds vitamins to malunggay that are not there when it is raw
explanation: Cooking malunggay pods makes their slightly tough skin and pulp soft and brings out their nice flavor.
fact_tl: Niluluto muna ang malunggay pod bago kainin para lumambot ang medyo matigas nitong balat at laman. Ang pagluluto rin ang nagpapalabas ng masarap na lasa nito sa ulam.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay pod lutoon usa kan-on aron mohumok ang medyo gahi nga panit ug unod niini. Ang pagluto usab maoy magpagawas sa lami nga lasa niini sa sud-an.

q: How does geothermal energy produce electricity?
options: It uses sunlight collected by underground panels to heat water
Heat from deep inside the Earth turns water into steam that spins turbines
It burns coal found beneath volcanoes to produce steam
It collects ocean heat from underwater pipes to run generators
explanation: Geothermal energy comes from heat deep inside the Earth that turns water into steam to spin turbines.
fact_tl: Ang geothermal energy ay galing sa init sa loob ng lupa na nagpapasingaw ng tubig para magpaikot ng turbine; ang Pilipinas ay isa sa pinakamalalaking gumagamit nito sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang geothermal energy gikan sa kainit sa sulod sa yuta nga magpaalisngaw og tubig aron magpatuyok sa turbine; ang Pilipinas usa sa pinakadako nga naggamit niini sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: A jellyfish uses its sting for two purposes. What are they?
options: To attract a mate and to communicate with other jellyfish
To camouflage itself and to dig into the seafloor
To catch food and to defend itself from enemies
To find its direction and to sense ocean temperature
explanation: A jellyfish uses its sting to catch the small fish it eats and to defend itself from enemies.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng dikya ang pagkagat (sting) nito sa dalawang paraan: para mahuli ang maliliit na isda na pagkain nito, at para ipagtanggol ang sarili sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa dikya ang iyang paak (sting) sa duha ka paagi: aron makadakop sa gagmayng isda nga iyang gikaon, ug aron panalipdan ang kaugalingon batok sa kaaway.

q: What do sea snakes typically eat in the coral reef?
options: Crabs, shrimp, and sea stars
Seaweed, algae, and coral polyps
Small fish, eels, and sometimes fish eggs
Jellyfish, sea turtles, and oysters
explanation: Sea snakes eat small fish, eels, and sometimes fish eggs that they find in the coral reef.
fact_tl: Ang mga ahas-dagat ay kumakain ng maliliit na isda, palos, at minsan ng itlog ng isda na nahahanap nila sa bahura.
fact_bis: Ang mga bitin sa dagat mokaon og gagmay nga isda, igat, ug usahay itlog sa isda nga ilang makit-an sa bahura.

q: What is one important way a bacterial cell is different from an animal cell?
options: A bacterial cell has no cell wall, while an animal cell has a thick cell wall
A bacterial cell has many nuclei, while an animal cell has only one nucleus
A bacterial cell has no nucleus, so its DNA floats freely inside
A bacterial cell uses flagella to digest food instead of a stomach
explanation: A bacterial cell has no nucleus, so its DNA simply floats inside, unlike animal cells which have a true nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang selula ng bakterya ay napaliligiran ng matibay na cell wall at karaniwang may parang-buntot na flagellum para makagalaw, ngunit wala itong nucleus kaya nakalutang lamang ang DNA nito sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang selula sa bakterya gilibutan sa lig-on nga cell wall ug sagad may murag-ikog nga flagellum aron makalihok, apan wala kini'y nucleus busa naglutaw lang ang DNA niini sa sulod.

q: Why does a reef shark's skin feel rough like sandpaper?
options: Because it rolls in sand on the ocean floor every morning
Because its skin is covered in tiny tooth-like scales
Because it has no slime layer like other fish do
Because its skin dries out quickly near the surface
explanation: A reef shark's skin is covered in tiny tooth-like scales, making it rough like sandpaper, which helps it swim faster and more quietly.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng reef shark ay magaspang na parang lija dahil natatakpan ito ng napakaliliit na tulis-tulis na kaliskis. Tumutulong ito para mas mabilis at tahimik silang lumangoy.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa reef shark magaspang sama sa lija kay natabonan kini sa gagmay kaayo nga ngipon-ngipon nga himbis. Kini makatabang aron mas paspas ug hilom silang molangoy.

q: Why does a high amount of sugar help jam and fruit preserves last a long time?
options: Sugar heats up the jam so that all bacteria are cooked away
Sugar adds a coating that seals out all oxygen from the jar
Sugar pulls water away from microorganisms through osmosis, stopping bacterial growth
Sugar makes the jam very acidic, which is what kills the bacteria
explanation: High sugar concentration inhibits bacterial growth by osmosis, reducing the water available for microorganisms.
fact_tl: Ang mataas na konsentrasyon ng asukal sa halaya at jam ay pumipigil ng paglaki ng bacteria sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng osmosis para mabawasan ang tubig na magagamit ng mga microorganism.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga konsentrasyon sa asukal sa jam ug halaya nagpugong sa pagtubo sa bacteria pinaagi sa osmosis, nagpababa sa tubig nga magamit sa mga microorganism.

q: Why do new variants of the same virus sometimes appear over time?
options: Viruses grow larger as they get older, becoming a new kind
Viruses combine with bacteria over time to form a new type
Viruses can change or mutate, producing new forms or variants
Viruses pick up new cells from different hosts and change shape
explanation: Viruses can change or mutate over time, which is why new forms or variants sometimes appear.
fact_tl: Ang virus ay maaaring magbago o mag-mutate sa paglipas ng panahon, kaya minsan ay lumilitaw ang mga bagong anyo o variant nito.
fact_bis: Ang virus mahimong mag-usab o mag-mutate sa paglabay sa panahon, mao nga usahay motungha ang bag-ong porma o variant niini.

q: Besides melting glaciers, what is another reason sea levels rise when the climate gets warmer?
options: Warmer air pushes ocean water toward the shore, piling it up
More rain falls into the ocean, adding extra water to it
Ocean water expands when it warms up, taking up more space
Stronger winds blow water from the poles toward coastal areas
explanation: When the ocean warms, the water expands through thermal expansion, contributing to sea level rise alongside melting ice.
fact_tl: Kapag uminit ang karagatan dahil sa pagbabago ng klima, ang tubig ng dagat ay nagpapalawak. Ang pagpapalawak na ito ng napakalaking dami ng tubig ng dagat ay nagdudulot ng pagtaas ng antas ng dagat, kasama ang pagkatunaw ng mga glacier at ice cap.
fact_bis: Sa pag-init sa karagatan tungod sa pagbabago sa klima, ang tubig sa dagat nagpapalawak. Kining thermal expansion sa napakalaking dami sa tubig sa dagat nagamot sa pagtaas sa antas sa dagat, uban ang pagkatunaw sa mga glacier ug ice cap.

q: Approximately how many elements are currently known to science?
options: About 50 elements
About 92 elements
About 118 elements
About 200 elements
explanation: There are about 118 known elements, most occurring in nature while a few are made only in laboratories.
fact_tl: May humigit-kumulang 118 na kilalang elemento, kung saan karamihan ay natural at ang ilan ay gawa-gawa lamang ng tao sa laboratoryo.
fact_bis: Adunay mga 118 ka nailhang elemento, ang kadaghanan natural samtang ang pipila binuhat lang sa tawo sa laboratoryo.

q: What is the key difference between fermentation and food spoilage, even though both involve microbes?
options: Fermentation only happens in meat, while spoilage only happens in vegetables
Fermentation uses heat to kill germs, while spoilage happens when food is left cold
In fermentation we control safe microbes whose acid or alcohol keeps harmful ones away, unlike spoilage
Fermentation needs sunlight to work, while spoilage only happens in the dark
explanation: In fermentation, we choose and control safe microbes whose acid or alcohol holds back harmful ones, unlike uncontrolled spoilage.
fact_tl: Ang fermentation at pagkasira ay parehong gawa ng mikrobyo, ngunit sa fermentation ay pinili at kinontrol ang ligtas na mikrobyo na gumagawa ng asido o alkohol na pumipigil naman sa nakakasamang mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang fermentation ug ang pagkadaot parehong gibuhat sa mikrobyo, apan sa fermentation gipili ug gikontrol nato ang luwas nga mikrobyo nga ang ilang asido o alkohol mopugong sa makadaot nga mikrobyo.

q: Why does a rubber tree produce latex?
options: To attract birds and insects that carry its pollen
To store extra food energy for the dry season
To seal wounds and help keep insects away
To cool its trunk during the hot tropical day
explanation: A tree makes latex as protection because it can seal wounds and help keep insects away.
fact_tl: Ginagawa ng puno ang latex bilang proteksyon, dahil tumatakip ito sa sugat at umiiwas sa mga insekto.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy mohimo og latex isip panalipod, kay makatabon kini sa samad ug makapahilayo sa mga insekto.

q: What two ingredients make a model volcano overflow with foam to look like it is erupting?
options: Salt and water
Flour and baking powder
Baking soda and vinegar
Soap and cooking oil
explanation: A toy volcano that overflows with foam uses baking soda and vinegar to mimic an eruption.
fact_tl: Ang laruang bulkan na umaapaw ng bula ay gumagamit ng baking soda at suka para magmukhang pumuputok.
fact_bis: Ang dula-dula nga bulkan nga mag-awas og bula naggamit og baking soda ug suka aron morag mobuto.

q: What is bioluminescence?
options: Light produced by reflection off a shiny animal surface
Light created when an animal absorbs sunlight and releases it at night
Light produced by a chemical reaction inside a living organism
Light made by electricity generated inside an animal's body
explanation: Bioluminescence is light produced by a chemical reaction inside living organisms, used by fireflies to communicate and by deep-sea creatures to attract prey.
fact_tl: Ang bioluminescence ay liwanag na nagmumula sa isang chemical reaction sa loob ng mga buhay na bagay — ang mga alitaptap ay gumagamit nito upang makipag-usap, habang ang ilang nilalang sa kailaliman ng dagat ay gumagamit nito bilang bitag sa mangdadakma.
fact_bis: Ang bioluminescence kahayag nga giproduser sa usa ka chemical reaction sulod sa mga buhay nga organismo; ang mga alitaptap naggamit niini aron makipag-communicate, samtang ang mga nilalang sa kailalom sa dagat naggamit niini aron madani ang biktima.

q: Why is saliva important for tasting food?
options: Saliva adds flavor to food that has no taste on its own
Saliva dissolves food so the tongue can detect its taste
Saliva cools food down so it does not burn the taste buds
Saliva sends signals from the mouth directly to the brain
explanation: Saliva is needed to dissolve food so the tongue can sense its taste.
fact_tl: Kailangan ang laway upang matunaw ang pagkain at maramdaman ng dila ang lasa nito.
fact_bis: Gikinahanglan ang laway aron matunaw ang pagkaon ug mabati sa dila ang lami niini.

q: What element is diamond made of?
options: Silicon
Calcium
Iron
Carbon
explanation: Diamond is made of pure carbon with its atoms packed in a very tight arrangement.
fact_tl: Ang diyamante ay gawa sa purong carbon na napaka-siksik ang pagkakaayos ng mga atomo.
fact_bis: Ang diyamante hinimo sa lunsay nga carbon nga hugot kaayo ang pagkahan-ay sa mga atomo.

q: What color is an elephant's skin?
options: Brown
Black
Gray
White
explanation: Elephants have thick, gray skin.
fact_tl: Ang elepante ay may makapal at kulay-abong balat.
fact_bis: Ang elepante adunay baga ug abuhon nga panit.

q: What special ability does a pig use to find food buried under the soil?
options: Very sharp eyesight that can see underground
A powerful sense of smell through its snout
Long front legs for digging into the ground
A sensitive tongue that can taste minerals in the soil
explanation: A pig has a very keen sense of smell, so it can find food buried under the soil.
fact_tl: May napakatalas na pang-amoy ang baboy, kaya nahahanap nito ang pagkaing nasa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang baboy adunay hait kaayong panimaho, mao nga makit-an niya ang pagkaon ilalom sa yuta.

q: How does washing hands with soap protect us from getting sick?
options: It makes our hands too slippery for flies to land on
It helps remove germs spread by flies and cockroaches
It adds a special chemical that kills viruses in the air
It keeps our skin warm so germs cannot survive on it
explanation: Washing hands with soap and keeping the house clean help protect us from germs spread by flies and cockroaches.
fact_tl: Paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at paglilinis ng bahay ay tumutulong para hindi tayo magkasakit mula sa langaw at ipis.
fact_bis: Ang paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon ug paglimpyo sa balay makatabang aron dili kita masakit gikan sa langaw ug ipis.

q: What is the job of tendons in your body?
options: They cushion the ends of bones so they do not scrape each other
They carry blood from the heart to the muscles during exercise
They connect muscles to bones so muscles can pull bones and create movement
They wrap around joints to keep bones from moving too far apart
explanation: Tendons are tough cords of tissue that connect muscles to bones, allowing muscles to pull bones and create movement.
fact_tl: Ang mga litid (tendons) ay matibay na mga lubid na tisyu na nagdudugtong ng kalamnan sa buto upang maaari tayong gumalaw.
fact_bis: Ang mga litid (tendons) mga tig-a nga lubid sa tisyu nga nagkonekta sa kaunuran sa buto, nagtugot sa mga kaunuran sa paghila sa mga buto aron makagalaw.

q: How does the Sun's heat reach Earth even though there is no air in space?
options: Heat flows through solid rock all the way from the Sun to Earth
Tiny heat particles float through space and land on Earth's surface
The Sun's heat travels as waves that can cross empty space through radiation
Earth's magnetic field pulls the Sun's heat across the vacuum of space
explanation: In radiation, heat travels as waves that can cross even empty space, which is how the Sun's heat reaches us across the vacuum.
fact_tl: Sa radiation, naililipat ang init sa pamamagitan ng mga alon na maaaring tumawid kahit sa walang laman na espasyo, kaya naaabot tayo ng init ng araw sa kabila ng kalawakan.
fact_bis: Sa radiation, ang init mobalhin pinaagi sa mga balud nga makatabok bisan sa walay sulod nga luna, mao nga makaabot kanato ang init sa adlaw bisan latas sa wanang.

q: What kind of environment does cacao grow best in?
options: Cold, dry highlands with lots of direct sunlight
Sandy coastal areas with sea breezes and full sun
Hot, humid places often under the shade of taller trees
Dry grasslands with occasional flooding during the rainy season
explanation: Cacao grows in hot, humid places and often under the shade of taller trees.
fact_tl: Ang kakaw ay tumutubo sa mainit at mahalumigmig na lugar at madalas sa ilalim ng lilim ng mas matataas na puno.
fact_bis: Ang kakaw motubo sa init ug umog nga dapit ug kasagaran ilalom sa landong sa mas tag-as nga mga kahoy.

q: A cork is floating in the ocean when a wave passes. What happens to the cork?
options: The cork moves forward in the same direction the wave is travelling
The cork sinks underwater and then pops back up after the wave passes
The cork only bobs up and down in place because waves carry energy, not the water itself
The cork spins around rapidly as the wave's energy pushes it in circles
explanation: A wave transfers energy without carrying the medium along, so a floating cork only bobs up and down in place as the wave passes.
fact_tl: Ang isang alon ay naglilipat ng enerhiya mula sa isang lugar patungo sa iba nang hindi dinadala ang mismong medium, kaya't ang lumulutang na korotso ay tumataas-bumababa lamang sa lugar nito habang dumadaan ang alon.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka balod magbalhin og enerhiya gikan sa usa ka dapit ngadto sa lain nga dili dalhon ang medium mismo, mao nga ang naglutaw nga tapon mokayab-kanaog lang sa iyang dapit samtang moagi ang balod.

q: What is the main job of the kidneys?
options: They pump blood throughout the body and control heart rate
They break down food into nutrients the body can use
They clean the blood by removing wastes and extra water, which become urine
They control breathing by sending signals to the lungs
explanation: The two kidneys act like filters that clean the blood, removing wastes and extra water, which become urine.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang bato ay parang salaan na naglilinis ng dugo: tinatanggal nito ang mga dumi at sobrang tubig, na nagiging ihi.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka kidni sama sa salaan nga naghinlo sa dugo: kuhaon niini ang mga hugaw ug sobra nga tubig, nga mahimong ihi.

q: Which Philippine government agency issues thunderstorm advisories so people can prepare in advance?
options: MMDA
PHIVOLCS
DOST
PAGASA
explanation: In the Philippines, PAGASA issues thunderstorm advisories so people can prepare ahead of time.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA ang nagbibigay ng babala tungkol sa thunderstorm para makapaghanda ang mga tao.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA maghatag og pasidaan bahin sa unos aron makaandam ang mga tawo.

q: Which joint in the body allows a basketball player to raise and swing their arm widely when shooting?
options: The knee joint, which bends and straightens the leg powerfully
The elbow joint, which locks the arm straight during a throw
The ball-and-socket joint in the shoulder, which rotates widely
The wrist joint, which twists the hand for direction control
explanation: The ball-and-socket joint in the shoulder lets you rotate and swing your arm widely, which is why it is used in shooting, spiking, or serving.
fact_tl: Kapag naglalaro ng basketball o volleyball ang mga Pinoy, ang ball-and-socket joint sa balikat ang nagbibigay-daan para makapag-shoot, makapag-spike, o makapag-serve. Dahil malawak ang ikot nito, kaya mong iangat at iwasiwas ang braso nang malakas.
fact_bis: Kon magdula ug basketball o volleyball ang mga Pinoy, ang ball-and-socket joint sa abaga maoy nagtugot nga makashoot, makaspike, o makaserve. Tungod kay lapad ang ikot niini, makaisa ug makawasiwas ka sa imong bukton nga kusog.

q: Why does static electricity build up on rubber and plastic but not on metal?
options: Metal is too heavy for static charges to stick to
Static charge flows away quickly through metal because metal is a conductor
Rubber and plastic attract opposite charges from the air around them
Metal gets too hot from the charges and burns them away immediately
explanation: Static charge gathers on insulators like rubber and plastic because the charge cannot move freely, while on metal the charge flows away quickly.
fact_tl: Madaling maipon ang static charge sa mga insulator tulad ng goma, plastik, at buhok dahil hindi madaling gumalaw ang charge dito. Sa metal naman (conductor), mabilis dumaloy palabas ang charge kaya hindi ito basta nananatili.
fact_bis: Sayon maipon ang static charge sa mga insulator sama sa goma, plastik, ug buhok kay dili dali makalihok ang charge didto. Sa metal (conductor), paspas moagos pagawas ang charge mao nga dili kini basta magpabilin.

q: What happens to the materials that make up rocks over millions of years in the rock cycle?
options: They slowly disappear as rocks get older and break down completely
They escape into the atmosphere as gas when rocks melt
They are reused over and over to make new rocks — nothing is lost
They sink to the center of the Earth and are permanently destroyed
explanation: In the rock cycle, matter is not lost — the same materials are reused over and over to make new rocks.
fact_tl: Sa siklo ng bato, hindi nawawala ang materya—ang parehong mga sangkap ay paulit-ulit na ginagamit upang bumuo ng bagong mga bato.
fact_bis: Sa siklo sa bato, dili mawala ang materya—ang samang mga materyales gigamit balik-balik aron magporma og bag-ong mga bato.

q: What unusual material does a mud dauber wasp use to build its nest?
options: Chewed-up leaves stuck together with saliva
Wax produced from glands on its body
Paper made from wood fibers it chews up
Mud shaped into small tubes stuck to walls or rocks
explanation: The mud dauber wasp builds its nest from mud, making little mud tubes stuck to walls or rocks.
fact_tl: May mga putakti na hindi papel ang pugad kundi putik — tulad ng mud dauber na bumubuo ng maliliit na tubong putik na idinidikit sa dingding o bato.
fact_bis: Adunay mga putakti nga dili papel ang salag kondili lapok — sama sa mud dauber nga naghimo og gagmay nga tubo nga lapok nga gipilit sa bongbong o bato.

q: How does a mussel get its food from the water?
options: It uses its sharp teeth to scrape algae off rocks
It catches small fish with tentacles around its shell
It sucks in water, takes out plankton, and releases the filtered water
It buries itself in sand and absorbs nutrients through its shell
explanation: A mussel is a filter feeder that sucks in water, takes out plankton, and helps clean the water in the process.
fact_tl: Ang tahong ay filter feeder na sumisipsip ng tubig, kumukuha ng plankton, at nakakatulong na linisin ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tahong usa ka filter feeder nga mosuyop sa tubig, mokuha sa plankton, ug makatabang sa paglimpyo sa tubig.

q: What is an almires (mortar) used for in cooking?
options: Mixing liquids like vinegar and soy sauce together smoothly
Heating spices over an open flame to bring out their flavor
Crushing garlic, pepper, or ginger into tiny pieces by pounding and grinding
Straining seeds and skins from fruit to make a smooth sauce
explanation: A mortar (almires) is a hard bowl used with a pestle to crush garlic, pepper, or ginger into tiny pieces by pounding and grinding.
fact_tl: Ang almires ay isang matibay na mangkok na ginagamit kasama ng halo upang durugin ang bawang, paminta, o luya sa pamamagitan ng pagpukpok at paggiling.
fact_bis: Ang almires usa ka gahi nga panaksan nga gamiton uban sa alho aron dugmokon ang ahos, paminta, o luy-a pinaagi sa pagbunal ug paggaling niini.

q: How do many orchids survive during dry periods?
options: They drop all their leaves so they lose no water through them
They grow very long roots that reach underground water sources
They have thick leaves or stems that store water to survive dry periods
They close their flowers tightly to seal in the moisture inside them
explanation: Many orchids have thick leaves or stems that store water to survive dry periods.
fact_tl: Maraming orkidya ay may makakapal na dahon o tangkay na nag-iimbak ng tubig para makatagal sa tuyong panahon.
fact_bis: Daghang orkid adunay baga nga mga dahon o lawas nga magtipig ug tubig aron makalahutay sa uga nga panahon.

q: Why did some scientists say Palawan formed differently from most other Philippine islands?
options: Palawan was formed by a giant underwater volcano that appeared just 10,000 years ago
Palawan is made entirely of coral that built up over thousands of years
Palawan is thought to have once been part of the Asian landmass and slowly drifted to its current location
Palawan rose from the sea because of strong earthquakes that pushed the seafloor upward
explanation: Palawan is thought to have once been part of the big landmass of Asia and slowly broke away and drifted to where it is now.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng isla ng Pilipinas ay galing sa bulkan. Ang Palawan, halimbawa, ay sinasabing dating bahagi ng malaking lupain ng Asya at unti-unting humiwalay at lumipat patungo sa kasalukuyang lugar nito. Kaya may mga hayop sa Palawan na mas kahawig ng nasa Borneo kaysa sa ibang isla ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Dili tanang isla sa Pilipinas naggikan sa bulkan. Ang Palawan, pananglitan, giingong kaniadto kabahin sa dakong yuta sa Asya ug hinay-hinay nga nibulag ug milihok ngadto sa karon niyang nahimutangan. Mao nga adunay mga hayop sa Palawan nga mas susama sa naa sa Borneo kaysa sa ubang isla sa Pilipinas.

q: What are some ways animals use their tails?
options: For breathing underwater, finding food in the dark, and making sounds
For balance when climbing or running, swatting flies, and showing feelings
For storing fat for winter, digging burrows, and attracting mates only
For swimming faster, protecting eggs, and changing color to hide
explanation: Many animals use their tails to help with balance when climbing or running, to swat away flies, and to show feelings like a happy dog wagging its tail.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop ang may buntot na may iba't ibang gamit. Tumutulong ito para mag-balanse kapag umaakyat o tumatakbo, panghagupit sa mga langaw, at minsan ginagamit pa para magpakita ng damdamin gaya ng tuwa ng aso.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap ang adunay ikog nga lain-lain og gamit. Motabang ni aron mobalanse kung mosaka o modagan, mopahid sa mga langaw, ug usahay gamiton pa aron ipakita ang gibati sama sa malipayong iro nga magkawos-kawos.

q: Approximately how long is the Puerto Princesa Underground River that can be travelled by boat inside the cave?
options: About 2 kilometers long
About 5 kilometers long
About 8 kilometers long
About 15 kilometers long
explanation: The Puerto Princesa Underground River is about 8 kilometers long and can be navigated by boat inside the cave.
fact_tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River ay may haba na humigit-kumulang 8 kilometro na maaaring lagusin ng bangka sa loob ng yungib; ito ang isa sa pinakamahabang nabigable na underground river sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River mga 8 kilometro ang gitas-on ug maabot sa bangka sulod sa yungib; usa kini sa pinakamahaba nga navigable underground river sa kalibutan.

q: Where does most of the magma that erupts from volcanoes come from?
options: The outer core, where iron and nickel melt at extreme heat
The crust, where the thinnest rock melts the most easily
The mantle, where rock partly melts when pressure drops or water is added
The asthenosphere pocket directly beneath the volcano's crater
explanation: Most of the magma that erupts from volcanoes comes from the mantle, where rock partly melts when pressure drops or water is added.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng magma na lumalabas sa mga bulkan ay nagmumula sa mantle, kung saan bahagyang natutunaw ang bato kapag bumababa ang presyon o pumapasok ang tubig.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa magma nga mosabwag sa mga bulkan naggikan sa mantle, diin ang bato bahin nga matunaw kon mokunhod ang presyon o makasulod ang tubig.

q: What is one important job that your skin does for your body?
options: It produces the oxygen your body needs to breathe
It keeps the body from drying out by stopping water from escaping
It filters waste from the blood and turns it into sweat to remove toxins
It senses hunger and tells the brain when it is time to eat
explanation: The skin keeps the body from drying out by stopping water from escaping.
fact_tl: Pinipigilan ng balat na matuyo ang katawan sa pamamagitan ng pag-iwas sa pagtagas ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang panit makapugong sa lawas nga mauga pinaagi sa pagpugong sa tubig nga mogawas.

q: How far away must you stand from a wall or cliff to hear a clear echo of your voice?
options: At least 5 meters away
At least 10 meters away
At least 17 meters away
At least 30 meters away
explanation: You need a distance of at least 17 meters from a wall or cliff to hear a clear echo.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng hindi bababa sa 17 metrong layo mula sa pader o bundok upang makarinig ng malinaw na alingawngaw (echo).
fact_bis: Kinahanglan og labing menos 17 metros nga gilay-on gikan sa bungbong o pangpang aron makadungog og klarong echo (alingawngaw).

q: Why can antibiotics kill bacteria but NOT viruses?
options: Antibiotics only work at high body temperature, and viruses prefer cool environments
Bacteria are too large to hide inside cells, while viruses are protected inside cells only
Bacteria are living cells that antibiotics can target, while viruses are much smaller and are not true living cells
Antibiotics are made from plants, and viruses have a plant-like coating that makes them immune
explanation: Bacteria are living cells that antibiotics can kill, while viruses are much smaller and are not true living cells, so antibiotics do not work on them.
fact_tl: Ang bakterya ay buhay na selula na kayang patayin ng antibiotiko, samantalang ang virus ay napakaliit at hindi tunay na buhay na selula.
fact_bis: Ang bakterya buhi nga selula nga mapatay sa antibyotiko, samtang ang virus gamay kaayo ug dili tinuod nga buhi nga selula.

q: Which vitamin deficiency causes night blindness, making it hard to see in the dark?
options: Vitamin C
Vitamin D
Vitamin B12
Vitamin A
explanation: A lack of Vitamin A causes night blindness, where a person has trouble seeing in the dark.
fact_tl: Ang kakulangan sa Vitamin A ay nagdudulot ng night blindness, kung saan hirap makakita sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang kakulang sa Vitamin A maoy hinungdan sa night blindness, diin lisod motan-aw sa kangitngit.

q: Why does a tightrope walker carry a long pole?
options: The pole is used to signal the audience when the walker is ready to start
The pole pushes against the rope to create extra grip for the walker's feet
The long pole lowers the center of gravity and slows how quickly they tip over, giving time to correct balance
The pole is held for decoration and also helps the walker measure the length of the rope
explanation: The long pole lowers the effective center of gravity and slows the rate at which the walker tips over, giving more time to correct balance.
fact_tl: Ang mahabang poste na hawak ng acrobat sa lubid ay nagpapababa at nagpapalawak ng effective na sentro ng grabidad — ginagawa itong mas mahirap na matumba at nagbibigay ng mas maraming oras para maayos ang balanse.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga patpat nga gihawakan sa tightrope walker nagpababa sa effective nga sentro sa grabidad ug nagpahina sa rate sa pagtumba, nagahatag og mas daghang oras sa pag-ayo sa balanse.

q: What is the whole body of a lichen called?
options: A mycelium
A thallus
A sporophyte
A rhizome
explanation: The whole body of a lichen is called a thallus, where the fungus and alga are held together.
fact_tl: Ang buong katawan ng lichen ay tinatawag na thallus, kung saan magkasamang nakapaloob ang fungus at alga.
fact_bis: Ang tibuok lawas sa lichen gitawag og thallus, diin ang fungus ug alga managhiusa nga nahimutang.

q: Why are there fewer animals at the top of the food chain compared to the bottom?
options: Less energy is passed on at each step up the food chain, so top predators cannot support large numbers
Top predators choose to live alone and avoid each other, so their population stays small
Apex predators eat so much food that they run out of prey and must stop reproducing
Humans hunt apex predators, which keeps their numbers low in nature
explanation: At each step up the food chain, less energy is transferred, so by the time energy reaches apex predators at the very top, only a small amount remains — not enough to support many individuals.
fact_tl: Bakit kakaunti lang ang apex predator? Sa bawat hakbang pataas sa food chain, kumakaunti ang enerhiyang naililipat mula sa pagkain. Dahil nasa pinakatuktok ang apex predator, kakaunti lang ang enerhiyang umaabot sa kanila, kaya hindi sila maaaring dumami nang sobra.
fact_bis: Nganong gamay ra man ang apex predator? Sa matag lakang pataas sa food chain, mokunhod ang enerhiya nga gibalhin gikan sa pagkaon. Tungod kay ang apex predator naa sa kinatumyan, gamay ra nga enerhiya ang moabot kanila, mao nga dili sila modaghan ug sobra.

q: Which type of Earth's crust is thinner but denser — the kind found under the land or the kind found under the sea?
options: The crust under the sea (oceanic crust) is thinner but denser
The crust under the land (continental crust) is thinner but denser
Both types are the same thickness but oceanic crust is denser
The crust under the sea is thicker and less dense than continental crust
explanation: Oceanic crust under the sea is only about 5–10 km thick but is denser than continental crust, which is thicker at about 30–50 km.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng crust: ang continental crust sa ilalim ng mga lupain na mas makapal (mga 30–50 km), at ang oceanic crust sa ilalim ng dagat na mas manipis (mga 5–10 km) pero mas mabigat.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka klase sa crust: ang continental crust ilalom sa kayutaan nga mas baga (mga 30–50 km), ug ang oceanic crust ilalom sa dagat nga mas nipis (mga 5–10 km) apan mas bug-at.

q: What do white herons hunt when they stand in Philippine rice paddies and canals?
options: Small fish, frogs, and insects
Grain, seeds, and young rice shoots
Crabs, shrimp, and aquatic snails
Earthworms, beetles, and fallen leaves
explanation: White herons stand in rice paddies and canals where they hunt small fish, frogs, and insects among the plants.
fact_tl: Madalas makita sa mga palayan at kanal sa Pilipinas ang puting tagak na nakatayo sa tubig. Dito ito nanghuhuli ng maliliit na isda, palaka, at insekto sa pagitan ng mga halaman.
fact_bis: Kasagarang makita sa mga humayan ug kanal sa Pilipinas ang puti nga tulabong nga nagbarog sa tubig. Dinhi kini manguha og gagmay nga isda, baki, ug insekto taliwala sa mga tanom.

q: Which statement best describes how long monotremes like the platypus have been on Earth?
options: They belong to one of the oldest branches of mammals and have existed for a very long time
They evolved recently and are among the newest types of mammals
They lived alongside dinosaurs but went extinct and were later rediscovered
They are actually reptiles that slowly evolved mammal-like features over centuries
explanation: Monotremes, including the platypus, belong to one of the oldest branches of mammals and have existed for a very long time on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang mga monotreme ay kabilang sa pinakaunang sangay ng mga mammal at matagal nang nabubuhay sa Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang mga monotreme sakop sa usa sa pinakakaraang sanga sa mga mammal ug dugay na kaayo nga nagpuyo sa Yuta.

q: Why does a ball fall down to the ground when you drop it?
options: Earth's gravity pulls the ball toward the ground
Air pressure pushes the ball downward
The ball is heavier than the air around it so it sinks
Magnetic force from the ground attracts the ball
explanation: Things fall because Earth's gravity pulls them toward the ground.
fact_tl: Nahuhulog ang mga bagay dahil hinihila sila ng grabidad ng Daigdig patungo sa lupa.
fact_bis: Mahulog ang mga butang tungod kay ang grabidad sa Yuta nagbira kanila padulong sa yuta.

q: What is the white part of the eye called, and what does it do?
options: The sclera — it is a tough outer coat that holds the eyeball's shape and protects the inside
The cornea — it is a clear window that lets light into the eye
The iris — it is a colored ring that controls how much light enters
The retina — it is a tough lining that senses light and sends signals to the brain
explanation: The white part of the eye is called the sclera, a tough outer coat that wraps around the eyeball, holds its shape, and protects the inside.
fact_tl: Ang puting bahagi ng mata, ang sclera, ay isang matigas na balat na bumabalot sa mata, nagpapanatili ng hugis nito at nagpoprotekta sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang puti nga bahin sa mata, ang sclera, usa ka gahi nga panit nga moputos sa mata, magpabilin sa porma niini, ug manalipod sa sulod.

q: Which Philippine government body is in charge of disaster preparedness, risk reduction, and response across the whole country?
options: NDRRMC (National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council)
PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration)
PHIVOLCS (Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology)
DENR (Department of Environment and Natural Resources)
explanation: The NDRRMC or National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council oversees disaster preparedness, risk reduction, and response throughout the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang NDRRMC o National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council ang nangangasiwa ng paghahanda, pagbabawas ng panganib, at pagtugon sa mga sakuna sa buong Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang NDRRMC o National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council nagdumala sa paghanda sa kalamidad, pagpababa sa peligro, ug pagtubag sa mga sakuna sa tibuok Pilipinas.

q: Why is steel harder and stronger than pure iron?
options: Carbon atoms wedge between the iron atoms and block the layers from sliding past each other
Steel is made by heating iron until its atoms lock together permanently in a rigid grid
Steel contains oxygen that bonds with iron to form a harder compound
The iron atoms in steel are larger and heavier, so they cannot move as easily
explanation: When carbon is added to iron, the tiny carbon atoms get wedged between the iron atoms and block them from sliding, making steel harder and stronger than pure iron.
fact_tl: Bakit mas matibay ang steel? Sa purong bakal, madaling magkadulasan ang mga patong-patong na atomo kaya madali itong mabaluktot. Pero kapag may halong carbon, ang maliliit na atomo ng carbon ay nakaipit sa pagitan ng mga atomo ng bakal at hinaharangan silang magkadulasan—kaya mas matigas at mas matibay ang steel.
fact_bis: Ngano mas lig-on man ang steel? Sa puro nga puthaw, dali ra magkadalin-as ang patong-patong nga mga atomo maong dali ra kini mabawog. Apan kung adunay sagol nga carbon, ang gagmay nga atomo sa carbon mapiit sa tunga sa mga atomo sa puthaw ug babagan sila sa pagdalin-as—maong mas gahi ug mas lig-on ang steel.

q: What is the job of the stem in a plant?
options: It carries water and nutrients from the roots up to the leaves and fruit
It absorbs sunlight and turns it into food for the plant
It soaks up water and minerals from the soil
It makes seeds that grow into new plants
explanation: The stem of a plant carries water and nutrients up from the roots to the leaves and fruit, working like a pipe that connects all the parts.
fact_tl: Ang tangkay o puno ng halaman ang nagdadala ng tubig at sustansya mula sa ugat papunta sa dahon at bunga. Para itong tubo na nag-uugnay sa lahat ng bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang punoan o tangkay sa tanom maoy nagdala sa tubig ug sustansya gikan sa gamot ngadto sa dahon ug bunga. Sama kini sa tubo nga nagdugtong sa tanang bahin.

q: What happens when baking soda is mixed with an acid?
options: It neutralizes the acid and brings the mixture closer to a pH of 7
It makes the acid stronger and lowers the pH further
It dissolves into the acid without changing the pH at all
It reacts to form a strong base with a pH above 12
explanation: Baking soda is a base that neutralizes an acid, bringing it closer to a neutral pH of 7.
fact_tl: Ang baking soda na isang base ay maaaring mag-neutralize ng asido at gawing mas malapit sa pH na 7.
fact_bis: Ang baking soda nga usa ka base makahimo sa pag-neutralize sa asido ug himuon kini nga mas duol sa pH nga 7.

q: How many planets in our solar system have ring systems?
options: Four — Saturn, Jupiter, Uranus, and Neptune
Two — Saturn and Jupiter only
Three — Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune
One — only Saturn has rings
explanation: Four planets have ring systems: Saturn (the most spectacular), Jupiter (faint dust rings), Uranus (thick dark rings), and Neptune (incomplete arcs) — all gas or ice giants.
fact_tl: Apat na planeta sa solar system ang may mga singsing: Saturn (ang pinakamaliwanag), Jupiter (faint dust rings), Uranus (makapal at madilim na mga singsing), at Neptune (incomplete arcs). Lahat ng apat ay gas o ice giants.
fact_bis: Upat ka planeta sa solar system adunay mga singsing: Saturn (ang pinaka-talahulagway), Jupiter (mahinay nga mga dust ring), Uranus (baga ug ngitngit nga mga singsing), ug Neptune (incomplete arc). Tanan upat gas o ice giants.

q: What simple action helps stop tuberculosis (TB) from spreading to other people?
options: Covering the mouth when coughing and wearing a mask
Washing your hands before every meal and after using the toilet
Drinking plenty of water and resting in bed
Eating vitamin C-rich fruits to strengthen your immune system
explanation: Covering the mouth when coughing and wearing a mask helps stop TB from spreading to others through the air.
fact_tl: Makakatulong na mapigil ang pagkalat ng TB kung tatakpan ng pasyente ang bibig kapag umuubo at magsusuot ng mask.
fact_bis: Makatabang sa pagpugong sa pagkaylap sa TB kung tabonan sa pasyente ang baba kung mangubo ug magsul-ob og maskara.

q: How does a parasitic plant like dodder get nutrients?
options: It attaches to another plant and sucks out its sap and nutrients, weakening the host
It grows in soil that is very rich in minerals and absorbs nutrients through long roots
It captures insects in its sticky leaves and digests them to get extra nutrients
It photosynthesizes faster than normal plants and stores extra food in its stems
explanation: Some parasitic plants attach to other plants and suck out their sap and nutrients, weakening the host plant.
fact_tl: May mga halamang parasito na dumidikit sa ibang halaman at sumisipsip ng katas at sustansiya nito, kaya nahihina ang halamang pinanghahawakan.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom nga parasito nga motapot sa ubang tanom ug mosuyop sa katas ug sustansya niini, mao nga maluya ang host nga tanom.

q: Why does light from distant galaxies look redder when it reaches us?
options: As space expands, the light waves get stretched out and shift toward the red end of the spectrum
Distant galaxies are very hot, and hot objects emit red light
The light loses energy traveling through space dust, changing its color to red
Gravity from black holes between us and the galaxy bends the light and makes it redder
explanation: As space expands, light from distant galaxies gets stretched and looks redder — this effect is called redshift.
fact_tl: Habang lumalawak ang espasyo, nauunat ang liwanag mula sa malalayong galaksi at nagiging mas pula—tinatawag itong redshift.
fact_bis: Samtang naglapad ang espasyo, ang kahayag gikan sa layo nga mga galaksi maunat ug magpula—gitawag kini nga redshift.

q: An object moves at 5 meters per second for 10 seconds. How far does it travel?
options: 50 meters
15 meters
2 meters
500 meters
explanation: Distance equals speed multiplied by time, so 5 m/s x 10 s = 50 meters.
fact_tl: Mula sa average speed, pwede mong hanapin ang ibang bahagi. Para sa layo, i-multiply ang bilis sa oras. Para sa oras, hatiin ang layo sa bilis. Halimbawa, sa 5 m/s sa loob ng 10 segundo, ang layo ay 50 metro.
fact_bis: Gikan sa average speed, makita nimo ang ubang bahin. Para sa gilay-on, i-multiply ang katulin sa oras. Para sa oras, bahina ang gilay-on sa katulin. Pananglitan, sa 5 m/s sulod sa 10 segundo, ang gilay-on kay 50 metros.

q: Why does the Moon affect Earth's tides more than the much larger Sun does?
options: The Moon is much closer to Earth, and for tides, nearness matters more than size
The Moon is denser than the Sun and therefore has stronger gravity despite its smaller size
The Moon orbits Earth while the Sun stays still, so the Moon's pull sweeps around and makes bigger tides
The Sun's gravity is mostly blocked by the planets between Earth and the Sun
explanation: The Moon affects tides more than the Sun because it is much closer to Earth, and for tides, nearness matters more than size.
fact_tl: Mas malakas ang epekto ng buwan sa tides kaysa Araw dahil mas malapit ang buwan sa Earth — sa tides, mas mahalaga ang lapit kaysa laki.
fact_bis: Mas kusog ang epekto sa bulan sa tides kaysa Adlaw tungod kay mas duol ang bulan sa Earth — sa tides, mas importante ang kaduol kaysa kadako.

q: About how fast do tectonic plates move each year?
options: A few centimeters — about as fast as a fingernail grows
A few meters — about as fast as a person walks in an hour
A few millimeters — far too slow to be measured by any instrument
A few kilometers — fast enough to be noticed in a single human lifetime
explanation: Tectonic plates move a few centimeters per year — about as fast as a fingernail grows — and scientists measure this using GPS satellites.
fact_tl: Ang mga tectonic plate ay gumagalaw nang ilang sentimetro bawat taon — halos kasingsabilis ng paglaki ng iyong kuko ng daliri — at sinusukat ito ng mga siyentipiko gamit ang GPS.
fact_bis: Ang mga tectonic plate molihok og pipila ka sentimetro matag tuig—hapit kapareha sa tulin sa pagtubo sa kuko—ug gisukat kini sa mga siyentipiko pinaagi sa GPS satellites.

q: Why are plains like Central Luzon and Cagayan Valley among the most fertile farming areas in the Philippines?
options: Rivers carried soil down from the mountains for thousands of years, depositing rich alluvial soil on the plains
The plains receive more rainfall than any other part of the Philippines, keeping the soil moist
Volcanic eruptions in the past covered these plains with nutrient-rich ash
The government planted thousands of trees on the plains to improve soil quality
explanation: Luzon plains became extremely fertile because of thousands of years of alluvial soil deposited by rivers flowing down from the mountains.
fact_tl: Ang mga kapatagan ng Luzon tulad ng Central Luzon at Cagayan Valley ay naging sobrang mayabong dahil sa libu-libong taon ng pag-iipon ng alluvial soil—lupa na dinala ng mga ilog mula sa mga bundok.
fact_bis: Ang mga kapatagan sa Luzon sama sa Central Luzon ug Cagayan Valley nahimong labaw ka mayabong tungod sa libu-libong taon sa pag-iipon sa alluvial soil—yuta nga gidala sa mga ilog gikan sa mga bundok.

q: What are the young seeds of the nipa palm like when eaten?
options: Soft and sweet, like a snack
Hard and crunchy, like a nut
Sour and chewy, like dried fruit
Bitter and tough, like raw bark
explanation: The young seeds of the nipa palm are soft and sweet and can be eaten as a sweet snack.
fact_tl: Ang murang buto ng nipa ay malambot at matamis, at maaaring kainin tulad ng kakanin.
fact_bis: Ang batan-ong liso sa nipa humok ug tam-is, ug mahimong kaonon sama sa usa ka tam-is nga meryenda.

q: Where does a developing baby grow inside its mother's body?
options: In the uterus (also called the womb)
In the ovary, where the egg first formed
In the placenta, which nourishes the baby directly
In the fallopian tube, connecting the ovary to the uterus
explanation: The new life grows inside the mother's uterus, also called the womb.
fact_tl: Ang bagong buhay ay lumalaki sa loob ng matris o sinapupunan ng ina.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong kinabuhi motubo sulod sa matris o sabakan sa inahan.

q: How does an oxbow lake form?
options: Floodwaters cut a new shorter channel across a river bend, leaving the old curved bend isolated as a lake
A river dries up and the remaining puddle in the middle slowly widens into a lake
Two rivers meet and the slower one is dammed by the faster one, forming a lake
The sea rises and traps a section of a river valley, creating a brackish lake
explanation: An oxbow lake forms when floodwaters cut a new shorter channel across a sharp river meander, and the old horseshoe-shaped bend becomes isolated as a lake.
fact_tl: Ang isang oxbow lake ay nabubuo kapag ang isang matinding kurbada (meander) ng ilog ay 'pinigilan' ng bagong mas maikling kanal na binukas ng baha; ang lumang kurbada ay nagiging isang horseshoe-shaped na lawa na nakahiwalay sa ilog.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka oxbow lake naporma kon ang usa ka matarik nga kurbada sa suba (meander) 'mapunggan' sa usa ka bag-ong mas mubo nga kanal nga giablihan sa tubig-baha; ang daan nga kurbada nahimong horseshoe-shaped nga lawa nga nahimulag gikan sa suba.

q: Besides wood, which of the following can also be used to make paper?
options: Bamboo, abaca, or old cloth
Plastic bottles, aluminum foil, or sand
Rubber, glass, or metal shavings
Coal, oil, or natural gas
explanation: Paper can be made from materials other than wood, including bamboo, abaca, or old cloth.
fact_tl: Bukod sa kahoy, ang papel ay puwede ring gawin mula sa kawayan, abaka, o lumang tela.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kahoy, ang papel mahimo usab nga buhaton gikan sa kawayan, abaka, o daan nga panapton.

q: How do bangus hatcheries in places like Dagupan use genetics knowledge to improve fish farming?
options: They select the fastest-growing and most disease-resistant bangus for breeding
They inject the fish with growth hormones to make them larger faster
They cross bangus with other fish species to create a hardier hybrid
They use radiation to randomly mutate genes and pick the strongest survivors
explanation: Philippine bangus hatcheries apply genetics knowledge by selecting the fastest-growing and most disease-resistant fish for breeding.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay gumagamit ng kaalaman sa genetics sa pagpapalaki ng bangus — ang mga hatchery sa Dagupan at iba pang lugar ay pinipili ang pinakamabilis na lumaki at lumalaban sa sakit na bangus para sa pagpaparami.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas naggamit sa kaalaman sa genetics sa pagpapalaki og bangus — ang mga hatchery sa Dagupan ug uban pang lugar mopili sa pinaka-dali nga motubo ug labing lumalaban sa sakit nga bangus alang sa pagpanamkon.

q: How do health workers keep vaccines cold when traveling to faraway villages?
options: They use insulated vaccine carriers with ice packs to keep vaccines cold during the trip
They mix the vaccines with a special chemical that preserves them at room temperature
They freeze the vaccines solid before the trip so they stay cold for days
They carry small portable refrigerators powered by a generator on the vehicle
explanation: Health workers use insulated vaccine carriers with ice packs to keep vaccines cold on the way to remote villages.
fact_tl: Para madala ang bakuna sa malalayong baryo, ginagamit ng mga health worker ang vaccine carrier na may ice pack para manatiling malamig ito sa biyahe.
fact_bis: Aron madala ang bakuna sa layong baryo, ang mga health worker mogamit ug vaccine carrier nga may ice pack aron magpabilin kining bugnaw sa biyahe.

q: Where in nature can you find Fibonacci number patterns?
options: In the number of flower petals and the spiral patterns in sunflowers and shells
In the number of legs on insects and the branching of lightning bolts
In the spots on butterfly wings and the stripes on zebras
In the depth of ocean trenches and the layers of rock in a cliff
explanation: Fibonacci numbers often appear in nature, such as the number of flower petals and the spiral patterns in sunflowers and shells.
fact_tl: Ang Fibonacci numbers ay madalas makita sa kalikasan, gaya ng bilang ng talulot ng bulaklak at ng spiral pattern sa sunflower at shells.
fact_bis: Ang Fibonacci numbers kasagarang makita sa kinaiyahan, sama sa gidaghanon sa talulot sa bulak ug sa spiral pattern sa mirasol ug kabibe.

q: What is the highest latitude value possible on Earth?
options: 90 degrees, found at the poles
180 degrees, found on the opposite side of the Earth
45 degrees, found at the midpoint between the equator and the poles
360 degrees, used to measure the full circle of the Earth
explanation: Latitude ranges from 0 degrees at the equator to a maximum of 90 degrees at the poles.
fact_tl: Ang latitud ay umaabot mula 0 degrees sa ekwador hanggang 90 degrees sa mga poste.
fact_bis: Ang latitude gikan 0 degrees sa ekwador hangtod 90 degrees sa mga poste.

q: What do Filipinos do with eels caught from rivers and bodies of water?
options: Cook and eat them as food
Dry them and use them as medicine
Keep them as pets in home aquariums
Sell them to zoos and marine parks
explanation: In the Philippines, eels are caught and cooked as food.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang igat o palos ay nahuhuli at niluluto bilang ulam.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang igat o palos gidakop ug giluto isip sud-an.

q: Why are healthy fats like omega-3 important for your body?
options: They are essential for brain development and building cell membranes
They give the body quick energy and replace sugars in a healthy diet
They help muscles grow bigger and stronger after exercise
They coat the stomach lining and protect it from digestive acids
explanation: Healthy fats like omega-3 (found in fish) are essential for brain development and cell membrane structure.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng taba ay masama; ang mga malusog na taba tulad ng omega-3 (mula sa isda) ay mahalaga para sa pag-unlad ng utak at mga pader ng selula.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga taba makadaot; ang maayong taba sama sa omega-3 (makita sa isda) importante alang sa pag-uswag sa utak ug istruktura sa cell membrane.

q: Why is the makahiya plant called by that name?
options: Because its leaves fold up when touched, as if it is shyly hiding
Because it only blooms at night when no one is looking
Because it grows in dark, hidden corners away from sunlight
Because its flowers are very small and hard to see
explanation: Makahiya means 'shy' because the plant seems to shyly hide its leaves by folding them up when touched.
fact_tl: Tinawag itong makahiya dahil parang nahihiya itong nagtatago ng mga dahon kapag hinipo.
fact_bis: Gitawag kining makahiya kay morag naulaw nga gitago ang iyang mga dahon kon hikapon.

q: Besides using strong electric shocks to attack prey, what else does the electric eel use its electricity for?
options: It sends out weak electric pulses to sense its surroundings, like radar, even in muddy water
It uses low-voltage shocks to communicate with other electric eels nearby
It produces a mild shock to keep smaller fish away from its eggs
It charges its own body to glow faintly so it can see in dark water
explanation: The electric eel sends out weak pulses to sense its surroundings — like radar — so it knows where rocks, plants, or prey are even in muddy water.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng kuryente ng electric eel ay pampatay. Gumagawa rin ito ng mahihinang pulso para maramdaman ang paligid—parang radar—kaya kahit malabo ang tubig, alam nito kung saan ang bato, halaman, o biktima.
fact_bis: Dili tanan kuryente sa electric eel para mopatay. Naghimo usab kini og huyang nga pulso aron mabati ang palibot—murag radar—busa bisan lubog ang tubig, nahibaw-an niini asa ang bato, tanom, o biktima.

q: What makes the fireworm dangerous to touch?
options: It has white bristles that easily break off into the skin, causing painful irritation and swelling
It secretes a burning acid from its skin that dissolves the top layer of human skin
It bites with sharp jaws that inject a mild venom causing numbness
It releases ink like an octopus that causes a skin rash on contact
explanation: The fireworm has dangerous white bristles that easily detach and penetrate skin, causing painful irritation and swelling.
fact_tl: Ang fireworm (Hermodice carunculata) ay isang polychaete na may mapanganib na puting bristle na madaling nahihiwalay at tumatagos sa balat — nagdudulot ng masakit na pangangati at pagpapamaga kung hawakan; karaniwan itong matatagpuan sa mga Philippine reef.
fact_bis: Ang fireworm (Hermodice carunculata) usa ka polychaete nga adunay delikadong puting mga bristle nga dali mamugna ug mopusod sa panit — nagpahinabo og masakit nga pangangati ug pamaga kon hikapon; komon kini nga makita sa Philippine reef.

q: How can thick floating plastic in the ocean harm sea life beyond just tangling animals?
options: It blocks sunlight from reaching plankton, which need light to make oxygen and food for the whole ocean food web
It releases heat into the water, raising ocean temperatures and killing coral reefs directly
It attracts fish that eat it instead of real food, and those fish become too full to eat anything else
It sinks slowly and covers the seafloor, blocking nutrients from rising back up to the surface
explanation: Thick floating plastic blocks sunlight that plankton need, and since plankton make oxygen and food in the ocean, this affects the whole web of sea life.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na nakalutang na plastik ay maaaring humarang sa liwanag ng araw na kailangan ng maliliit na halaman sa dagat tulad ng plankton — at dahil ang mga ito ang gumagawa ng oxygen at pagkain sa dagat, nakakaapekto ito sa buong buhay-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga naglutaw nga plastik makababag sa kahayag sa adlaw nga gikinahanglan sa gagmay nga tanom sa dagat sama sa plankton — ug tungod kay kini ang naghimo og oksiheno ug pagkaon sa dagat, makaapekto kini sa tibuok kinabuhi sa dagat.

q: How does a door stop keep a door from closing?
options: Its tapered wedge shape and friction hold the door in place
It uses a spring inside to push against the door with force
It is attached to the door with a magnet that grips the floor
Its heavy weight alone is enough to block the door from swinging
explanation: A door stop is a wedge that uses its tapered shape and friction to keep a door from closing.
fact_tl: Ang pantigil ng pinto ay isang wedge na ginagamit ang pagkakaiba ng itsura nito at kiskisan para mapanatiling bukas ang pinto.
fact_bis: Ang pantigil sa pinto usa ka wedge nga naggamit sa iyang nagtapered nga porma ug kiskisan aron mapugngan ang pinto nga sirado.

q: What are the three types of blood vessels in the human body?
options: Arteries, veins, and capillaries
Arteries, nerves, and lymph vessels
Veins, tendons, and capillaries
Capillaries, bronchi, and arteries
explanation: Blood travels through three kinds of vessels: arteries, veins, and tiny capillaries.
fact_tl: Dumadaloy ang dugo sa tatlong uri ng daluyan: arterya, vena, at maliliit na capillary.
fact_bis: Ang dugo moagos sa tulo ka matang sa ugat: arterya, vena, ug gagmay nga capillary.

q: What is the main job of red blood cells?
options: To carry oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body
To fight germs and infections that enter the bloodstream
To carry nutrients from digested food to the body's cells
To produce hormones that control growth and body temperature
explanation: Red blood cells carry oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body.
fact_tl: Ang pulang selula ng dugo ay nagdadala ng oxygen mula sa baga papunta sa buong katawan.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga mga selula sa dugo magdala og oxygen gikan sa baga ngadto sa tibuok lawas.

q: What happens when two different metals touch each other in a moist environment?
options: The more reactive metal corrodes faster and sacrificially protects the less reactive one
Both metals corrode at the same rate because electricity flows equally between them
The less reactive metal corrodes first because moisture attacks it more easily
The metals stick together permanently through a process called galvanic bonding
explanation: Galvanic corrosion occurs when two different metals touch in a moist environment; the more reactive metal corrodes faster and sacrificially protects the less reactive one.
fact_tl: Ang galvanic corrosion ay nangyayari kapag ang dalawang magkaibang metal ay nakadikit sa isang moist na kapaligiran — ang mas aktibong metal (anode) ay mas mabilis na malulusot.
fact_bis: Ang galvanic corrosion mahitabo kon ang duha ka magkaibang metal nagadikit sa usa ka moist nga palibot; ang mas reaktibong metal (anode) mas paspas makorosyon ug sacrificially nagproteksyon sa dili kaayo reaktibo.

q: What illness can Entamoeba histolytica cause when it invades the intestinal wall?
options: Amoebic dysentery, with diarrhea that contains blood
Malaria, with fever, chills, and cycles of sweating
Dengue fever, with rash, joint pain, and low platelet count
Typhoid fever, with sustained high temperature and abdominal pain
explanation: Entamoeba histolytica is an amoeba that can invade the intestinal wall and cause amoebic dysentery, characterized by diarrhea with blood.
fact_tl: Ang Entamoeba histolytica ay isang amoeba na maaaring tumagos sa pader ng bituka at magdulot ng amoebic dysentery — isang impeksyon na nagdudulot ng pagtatae na may dugo.
fact_bis: Ang Entamoeba histolytica usa ka amoeba nga mahimong mosulod sa pader sa tinai ug magpahinabog amoebic dysentery — usa ka impeksyon nga adunay pagtatae nga may dugo.

q: Where is Ceres located, and why is it classified as a dwarf planet?
options: It is in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter, and it is round enough to be classed as a dwarf planet
It orbits beyond Neptune in the Kuiper Belt, where many icy dwarf planets are found
It is a large moon of Jupiter that broke free of Jupiter's gravity and now orbits the Sun
It sits between Earth and Mars and was reclassified from a planet to a dwarf planet in 2006
explanation: Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter, and because it is big enough to be round, it is also classified as a dwarf planet.
fact_tl: Ang Ceres ang pinakamalaking bagay sa asteroid belt sa pagitan ng Mars at Jupiter, at sapat ang laki nito para maging bilog kaya itinuturing din itong dwarf planet.
fact_bis: Ang Ceres maoy kinadak-ang butang sa asteroid belt sa tunga sa Mars ug Jupiter, ug igo ang gidak-on niini aron mahimong lingin mao nga giisip usab kini nga dwarf planet.

q: Why does a cut apple turn brown after a short time?
options: Oxygen in the air reacts with chemicals inside the fruit, causing oxidation that turns the flesh brown
Bacteria immediately land on the cut surface and release a brown-colored waste product
The apple loses water through the cut surface and the dried-out flesh turns brown
Enzymes stop working once the apple is cut, so the cells turn brown as they die
explanation: A cut apple turns brown because oxygen in the air reacts with chemicals inside the fruit — a kind of oxidation; squeezing lemon or calamansi juice on it slows the process.
