fact_bis: Dili lang umang ang naggamit sa walay sulod nga kabibi; adunay gagmay nga kugita ug isda nga magtago usab sulod niini.

q: Why must potters dry wet clay very slowly before baking it?
options: To add more water back into the clay so it stays soft
To prevent cracking, because clay shrinks as it dries
To make the clay change from red to gray color evenly
To let bacteria in the clay die before the pot is used for food
explanation: Clay shrinks as it dries, and drying it too fast causes cracks, so potters must control the drying carefully to avoid cracking.
fact_tl: Ang parehong pag-urong ng luwad na nagdudulot ng bitak ay ginagamit din ng mga gumagawa ng palayok. Hinuhubog nila ang basang luwad, hinahayaang matuyo nang dahan-dahan para hindi pumutok, tapos iniihaw para tumigas. Kaya kailangang kontrolin ang pagkatuyo.
fact_bis: Ang samang pagkunhod sa yutang kulonon nga maoy hinungdan sa liki gigamit usab sa mga maghihimo og kolon. Hulmahon nila ang basa nga clay, pasagdan nga mamala hinay-hinay aron dili moliki, dayon lutuon aron mogahi. Mao nga kinahanglan nilang kontrolon ang pagkamala.

q: What makes large coral reefs remarkable in terms of age?
options: They grow exactly one meter every year, so their age is easy to calculate
Some large reefs have lasted thousands of years, making them among the oldest living structures on Earth
Most reefs are only a few hundred years old because storms constantly destroy them
Coral reefs are older than any rock on Earth's surface
explanation: Some large reefs have lasted thousands of years, placing them among the oldest living structures on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang ilang malalaking bahura ay tumagal nang libu-libong taon, kaya't isa ito sa pinakamatatandang buhay na istraktura sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang ubang dagkong bahura milungtad na og liboan ka tuig, mao nga usa kini sa pinakatigulang nga buhi nga istraktura sa kalibutan.

q: In which direction does the North Equatorial Current flow across the Pacific Ocean?
options: From west to east toward North America
From north to south toward Australia
From east to west toward the Philippines
From south to north toward Japan
explanation: The North Equatorial Current flows from east to west across the Pacific Ocean toward the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang North Equatorial Current ay umaagos mula silangan pakanluran sa Karagatang Pasipiko patungo sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang North Equatorial Current nagaagos gikan sa sidlakan paingon sa kasadpan sa Dagat Pasipiko padulong sa Pilipinas.

q: What was Pangaea?
options: The name of the first ocean that ever formed on Earth
A giant single landmass that once contained all of Earth's continents
A massive volcano that shaped most of the world's mountain ranges
The large island where the first life on Earth appeared
explanation: About 300 million years ago, all of Earth's continents are believed to have been joined in one giant landmass called Pangaea, which slowly broke apart to form today's continents.
fact_tl: Mga 300 milyong taon na ang nakalipas, ang lahat ng kontinente ng Earth ay pinaniniwalaang nagsama-sama sa isang higanteng masa ng lupa na tinatawag na Pangaea, na unti-unting nahati at naglayo upang mabuo ang mga kontinente ngayon.
fact_bis: Mga 300 ka milyon ka tuig na ang milabay, ang tanang kontinente sa Earth gituohan nga naghiusa sa usa ka dako kaayo nga yuta nga gitawag og Pangaea, nga hinay-hinay nga nabuak ug nagbulag aron maporma ang mga kontinente karon.

q: What happens at equilibrium in a reversible chemical reaction?
options: The reaction completely stops and no more products are made
The forward and reverse rates become equal so concentrations stay constant
All the reactants turn into products and none are left
The temperature drops to zero so the reaction freezes
explanation: At equilibrium in a reversible reaction, the forward and reverse rates are equal, so the concentrations of all substances remain constant.
fact_tl: Ang ilang chemical reaction ay maaaring pumunta sa magkabila ng direksyon — tinatawag na reversible reactions. Sa equilibrium, ang bilis ng forward at reverse reaction ay magkapareho at hindi nababago ang konsentrasyon ng mga sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang uban ka chemical reaction mahimong molakaw sa duha ka direksyon — reversible reactions. Sa equilibrium, ang bilis sa forward ug reverse reaction managsama, mao nga ang mga konsentrasyon nagpabilin nga kanunay.

q: How is a pearl different from most other gems?
options: A pearl is mined from deep underground just like diamonds
A pearl is made by a living oyster or mollusk, not mined from rock
A pearl forms when seawater freezes around a grain of sand
A pearl is a type of mineral crystal found inside coral reefs
explanation: Unlike most gems that are mined from rock, a pearl is made by a living oyster or mollusk.
fact_tl: Ang perlas ay likha ng buhay na talaba o kabibe, hindi galing sa bato gaya ng ibang hiyas.
fact_bis: Ang perlas gihimo sa buhi nga talaba o mollusk, dili gikan sa bato sama sa ubang mutya.

q: Why do animals that store food choose dry, safe hiding spots?
options: Dry spots keep the food warm so it tastes better later
Stored food can rot or be stolen, so a dry, safe spot helps protect it
Other animals can smell wet spots, so dry spots hide the scent better
Dry spots allow the food to ripen faster so it is ready sooner
explanation: Stored food can rot or be stolen by other animals, so food-storing animals choose dry, safe hiding spots to protect their supply.
fact_tl: Ang itinagong pagkain ay maaaring mabulok o nakawin ng ibang hayop, kaya pumipili ng tuyong lugar ang mga nag-iimbak.
fact_bis: Ang gitago nga pagkaon mahimong mabulok o kawaton sa laing mananap, busa nagpili og uga ug luwas nga tagoanan ang nagatipig.

q: What is the job of nerves in your body?
options: To pump blood from the heart to every part of the body
To carry electric signals to and from the brain so we feel things and react quickly
To produce hormones that control how fast we grow
To filter waste products from the blood before they reach the organs
explanation: Nerves act like fast wires that carry electric signals to and from the brain, which is how we feel things and respond quickly.
fact_tl: Ang mga nerbiyos ay parang mabilis na kawad na nagdadala ng mga senyales na de-kuryente papunta at pabalik sa utak, kaya mabilis nating nararamdaman at natutugunan ang mga bagay.
fact_bis: Ang mga nerbiyos sama sa paspas nga alambre nga nagdala og elektrikong mga senyales padulong ug pabalik sa utok, mao nga dali natong mabati ug matubag ang mga butang.

q: What kind of water is found in mangrove areas?
options: Pure fresh water from underground springs
Purely salty water just like the open ocean
Brackish water, which is a mix of salty sea water and fresh river water
Acidic water caused by decaying mangrove leaves
explanation: Mangroves have brackish water — a mix of salty water from the sea and fresh water from rivers — which is why they support many different fish species.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa bakawan ay halo ng tubig-alat mula sa dagat at tubig-tabang mula sa ilog. Tinatawag itong tubig-tabsing. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit espesyal ang lugar at iba't ibang isda ang kayang tumira dito.
fact_bis: Ang tubig sa bakawan sagol nga parat nga tubig gikan sa dagat ug tab-ang nga tubig gikan sa suba. Gitawag kining tabsing nga tubig. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong espesyal ang dapit ug nagkalainlaing isda ang makapuyo didto.

q: What does your eye lens do when you look at something close up?
options: It flattens out to let in more light from nearby
It thickens to focus on the near object
It rotates slightly so both eyes aim at the same point
It shrinks in size to reduce the amount of light entering
explanation: The eye lens thickens when focusing on near objects and flattens for distant ones — this ability to change shape is called accommodation.
fact_tl: Ang lens ng mata ay nagbabago ng hugis upang matuunan ang mga bagay sa iba't ibang distansya — nangangitlin para sa malapit at nababawasan ang pagkaikmo para sa malayo — tinatawag itong accommodation.
fact_bis: Ang lente sa mata nagbag-o sa porma aron matutukan ang mga butang sa lain-laing gilay-on — mosamag alang sa duol ug momanipis alang sa layo — gitawag kini accommodation.

q: Why can young palm fronds be woven into shapes without breaking?
options: Because they are soaked in water first to make them soft
Because young palm leaves are long, thin, and flexible
Because palm leaves have a waxy coat that makes them slippery
Because palm fronds are hollow inside like a drinking straw
explanation: Young palm leaves can be woven because they are long, thin, and flexible, bending easily without breaking.
fact_tl: Maaaring lalahin ang palaspas dahil ang batang dahon ng palma ay mahaba, manipis, at malambot kaya madaling baluktutin nang hindi nababali.
fact_bis: Mahimong lalahon ang palaspas tungod kay ang batan-ong dahon sa palma taas, nipis, ug humok mao nga sayon ibawog nga dili mabali.

q: Why is a special kind of pineapple sometimes grown on farms?
options: To produce a sweeter fruit that is used for canned juice
Not for its fruit but for its good fibers
To grow very large fruits used as animal feed
To produce seeds that are used to make cooking oil
explanation: A special pineapple variety is cultivated not for its fruit but for the good fibers found in its leaves.
fact_tl: May natatanging uri ng pinya na itinatanim hindi para sa prutas kundi para sa mahuhusay na hibla nito.
fact_bis: Adunay espesyal nga klase sa pinya nga ginatanom dili para sa bunga kondili para sa maayo niini nga lanot.

q: What makes bacterial meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis especially dangerous?
options: It spreads only through contaminated drinking water and is easy to prevent
It can be fatal within hours if left untreated
It causes a lifelong rash but rarely leads to death
It only affects elderly people and not children
explanation: Neisseria meningitidis causes a very dangerous infection of the membranes around the brain that can be fatal within hours if untreated.
fact_tl: Ang bacterial meningitis ay maaaring dulot ng Neisseria meningitidis — isang napakadelikadong impeksyon ng mga lamad sa paligid ng utak na maaaring magdulot ng kamatayan sa loob ng ilang oras kung hindi ginagamot.
fact_bis: Ang bacterial meningitis mahimong gikagikan sa Neisseria meningitidis — usa ka grabeng delikadong impeksyon sa mga lamad sa palibot sa utak nga mahimong makapatay sulod sa pipila ka oras kung dili tambalon.

q: What are bioplastics made from?
options: Recycled ocean plastic cleaned and melted down
Plants such as corn
Petroleum mixed with natural rubber from trees
Sand and minerals baked at very high temperatures
explanation: Bioplastics are a type of plastic made from plants such as corn, rather than from petroleum.
fact_tl: May mga bagong plastik na gawa sa halaman gaya ng mais, at tinatawag itong bioplastic.
fact_bis: Adunay bag-ong plastik nga gihimo gikan sa tanom sama sa mais, ug gitawag kini nga bioplastic.

q: What does the unit 'volt' measure in electricity?
options: The amount of electric charge stored in a battery
The resistance that slows down electric current in a wire
How strongly an electric current is pushed, which is called voltage
The total amount of electrical energy used per second
explanation: The volt measures voltage, or electric potential — how strongly an electric current is pushed.
fact_tl: Ang volt ay sumusukat ng boltahe o elektrikong potensyal — kung gaano kalakas ang itinutulak ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang volt nagsukod sa boltahe o elektrikong potensyal — kung unsa kakusog ang pagtulod sa kuryente.

q: Where does a female mosquito lay her eggs?
options: In dry soil under shaded trees
Inside the bark of dead trees
In or near still water
On the leaves of flowering plants
explanation: A female mosquito lays her eggs in or near still water, which is why removing standing water helps control mosquitoes.
fact_tl: Ang inahing lamok ay nangingitlog sa o malapit sa tubig na hindi gumagalaw.
fact_bis: Ang inahan nga lamok mangitlog diha o duol sa tubig nga dili molihok.

q: What is a joint dislocation?
options: A fracture where a bone breaks completely in two pieces
When the ball of a ball-and-socket joint pops out of its socket
When two bones grind against each other because cartilage wears away
A bruise deep inside a joint caused by a hard impact
explanation: A dislocation happens when the ball pops out of the socket in a ball-and-socket joint, causing pain and requiring a doctor to put it back in place.
fact_tl: Kapag may malakas na bunggo o aksidente, minsan lumalabas ang bola sa socket—tinatawag itong dislocation o pagkalinsad. Masakit ito at kailangang ibalik ng doktor ang bola sa tamang lugar. Madalas itong nangyayari sa balikat dahil mababaw ang socket nito.
fact_bis: Kon adunay kusog nga pagbangga o aksidente, usahay mogula ang bola sa socket—gitawag kining dislocation o pagkalinsad. Sakit kini ug kinahanglan ibalik sa doktor ang bola sa hustong lugar. Kasagaran kini mahitabo sa abaga tungod kay mabaw ang socket niini.

q: What feature of the remora fish inspires engineers to build new grippers?
options: Its smooth streamlined body shape that reduces drag underwater
Its special adhesive disc that lets it cling to surfaces without any glue
Its ability to change color to match the surface it clings to
Its flexible spine that bends around curved surfaces perfectly
explanation: Engineers study the remora's disc to build robots and medical tools that can cling to wet or smooth surfaces without needing glue.
fact_tl: Pinag-aaralan ng mga inhinyero ang disc ng remora para gumawa ng bagong klaseng pandikit na walang glue. May mga robot at gamit-medikal na ginaya ang disenyo nito para makakapit sa basa o makinis na rabaw — halimbawa, robot na kumakapit sa ilalim ng barko o sa loob ng katawan ng tao. Likas na imbensyon na ginagaya ng tao!
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga inhinyero ang disc sa remora aron makahimo og bag-ong klase nga gripper nga walay glue. Adunay mga robot ug medical nga himan nga nagsundog sa disenyo niini aron mokupot sa basa o hamis nga nawong — pananglitan, robot nga motapot sa ilawom sa barko o himan nga gamiton sulod sa lawas. Natural nga imbensyon nga gisundog sa tawo!

q: What is unusual about the viperfish's fangs?
options: They are hollow and inject venom like a snake's fangs
They are so long they stick out past its jaws and cannot fit inside its mouth
They glow in the dark to attract prey in the deep ocean
They fall out and regrow every few months like shark teeth
explanation: The viperfish's fangs are so long they cannot fit inside its mouth and stick out past its jaws, helping it trap prey.
fact_tl: Ang viperfish ay may napakahahabang ngipin na parang pangil, na sobrang haba kaya hindi magkasya sa bibig nito at lumalabas pa palapit sa mga mata.
fact_bis: Ang viperfish adunay taas kaayo nga mga ngipin nga sama sa tango, taas kaayo maong dili mahaom sa baba niini ug mogawas pa duol sa mga mata.

q: Why is washing your hands with soap effective against the COVID-19 virus?
options: Soap heats up the skin enough to kill the virus on contact
Soap breaks apart the virus's outer fatty layer so it falls apart and washes away
Soap creates a slippery barrier that stops viruses from touching skin cells
Soap makes the skin too acidic for the virus to survive
explanation: The COVID-19 virus has a thin fatty outer coat, and soap breaks this coat apart so the virus falls apart and is washed away.
fact_tl: Ang virus ng COVID-19 ay nababalot ng manipis na layer na parang taba. Ang sabon ay sumisira sa balot na ito, kaya nawawasak ang virus at nahuhugasan palayo. Kaya napakabisa ng 20 segundong paghuhugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon, o paggamit ng alcohol, para hindi kumalat ang sakit.
fact_bis: Ang virus sa COVID-19 giputos sa nipis nga layer nga sama sa tambok. Ang sabon moguba niini nga putos, busa maguba ang virus ug mahugasan palayo. Mao nga epektibo kaayo ang 20 segundo nga paghugas sa kamot gamit ang sabon, o paggamit og alcohol, aron dili mokatap ang sakit.

q: How do doctors treat a very severe bone fracture?
options: They wrap the broken bone tightly in a plaster cast and rest it for six months
They may place metal plates or pins inside the body to hold the bone pieces together while they heal
They use a magnetic device outside the skin to pull the broken pieces back into place
They inject a special glue into the fracture to seal the two pieces together
explanation: For severe breaks, doctors may put metal plates or pins inside the body to hold the bone pieces together while they heal.
fact_tl: Sa malubhang bali, naglalagay ang doktor ng metal na plate o pin sa loob para mahawakang magkadikit ang buto.
fact_bis: Sa grabe nga bali, ang doktor mahimong mobutang og metal nga plate o pin sa sulod aron magkahiusa ang bukog.

q: What does the term 'living fossil' mean?
options: An animal that has turned to stone while still alive
A living animal or plant that still looks much like its very ancient ancestors
A fossil that scientists have brought back to life in a laboratory
An old fossil that was recently found still buried underground
explanation: A living fossil is a living animal or plant that still looks very much like its ancient ancestors from millions of years ago.
fact_tl: Ang living fossil ay isang uri ng nabubuhay na hayop o halaman na halos kapareho pa rin ng mga ninuno nito mula sa napakatandang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang living fossil usa ka buhi nga hayop o tanom nga halos pareho gihapon sa mga katigulangan niini gikan sa karaan kaayo nga panahon.

q: What do the fins of a lionfish look like?
options: They are small and clear, almost invisible in water
They are large and fan-like, similar to a lion's mane
They are shaped like paddles and used for digging in sand
They are long and ribbon-like, trailing behind the fish as it swims
explanation: The lionfish has large fan-like fins that resemble a lion's mane, which is how it got its name.
fact_tl: Ang lionfish ay may malalaki at parang pamaypay na palikpik na kahawig ng kiling ng leon.
fact_bis: Ang lionfish adunay dagko ug murag-pamaypay nga mga kapay nga susama sa buhok sa liyon.

q: Why is distilled water used in car batteries, irons, and laboratories?
options: Because it conducts electricity better than regular tap water
Because it is pure and has no minerals that could leave deposits
Because it boils at a higher temperature than ordinary water
Because it costs less to produce than purified bottled water
explanation: Distilled water is used in irons, car batteries, and laboratories because it is pure and contains no minerals that could leave deposits.
fact_tl: Ang distiladong tubig ay ginagamit sa mga plantsa, baterya ng sasakyan, at laboratoryo dahil malinis ito at walang minerales na maaaring mag-iwan ng tigkal.
fact_bis: Ang distiladong tubig gigamit sa mga plansa, baterya sa sakyanan, ug laboratoryo kay limpyo kini ug walay mineral nga makabilin ug tipun-og.

q: What is a common sign that someone has mumps?
options: A high fever with a spotted rash all over the body
The glands on both cheeks swell up
Painful blisters appear around the mouth and nose
The eyes turn red and become very sensitive to light
explanation: Mumps is a viral disease whose most recognizable sign is swelling of the glands on both cheeks.
fact_tl: Ang beke ay sakit na dulot ng virus na nagpapamaga sa mga glandula sa magkabilang pisngi.
fact_bis: Ang beke usa ka sakit gikan sa bayrus nga makapahubag sa mga glandula sa duha ka aping.

q: What does the atomic number of an element tell you?
options: How many neutrons are packed in the atom's nucleus
How many protons are in the atom's nucleus
The total mass of all the particles inside the atom
How many electrons are in the outermost shell of the atom
explanation: The atomic number tells you how many protons are in an atom's nucleus, and it is unique for every element.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ay nagsasabi kung ilang proton ang nasa nucleus ng isang atomo.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number nagsulti kung pila ka proton ang anaa sa nucleus sa usa ka atomo.

q: Why is it dangerous to eat a pufferfish?
options: Its meat is extremely tough and impossible to chew
A pufferfish has poison in its body
Its scales are sharp and can cut your throat
It carries parasites that are impossible to kill by cooking
explanation: A pufferfish has poison in its body, making it dangerous to eat.
fact_tl: Ang butete ay may lason sa katawan, kaya delikadong kainin ito.
fact_bis: Ang butete adunay hilo sa lawas niini, mao nga delikado kini kaonon.

q: What gas is released by plants while they make food through photosynthesis?
options: Carbon dioxide, which helps other plants grow
Nitrogen, which makes up most of the air we breathe
Oxygen, the gas that we breathe
Hydrogen, which floats up into the atmosphere
explanation: While making food through photosynthesis, a plant releases oxygen — the same gas that humans and animals breathe.
fact_tl: Habang gumagawa ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis, naglalabas ang halaman ng oksiheno na siyang hinihinga natin.
fact_bis: Samtang naghimo ug pagkaon pinaagi sa potosintesis, ang tanom nagabuga ug oksiheno nga maoy atong ginaginhawa.

q: How do bacteria help in making cheese?
options: They break down the fat in milk so it becomes lighter and easier to eat
They produce acid in the milk that makes it curdle and gives the cheese its flavor
They add color to the milk so different cheeses look different
They remove the water from the milk by absorbing it into their cells
explanation: Bacteria help make cheese by producing acid in the milk, which causes it to curdle and gives the cheese its characteristic flavor.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang bakterya sa paggawa ng keso sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng acid sa gatas, na nagpapamuo nito at nagbibigay ng lasa sa keso.
fact_bis: Ang bakterya motabang sa paghimo og keso pinaagi sa pagmugna og acid sa gatas, nga makapamugna niini ug makahatag og lami sa keso.

q: Why do liquid drops sometimes appear in a crocodile's eyes while it is eating?
options: The crocodile is sad because it does not want to eat the prey
The liquid keeps the crocodile's eyes wet and clean, not because of feelings
The eyes release water to wash off blood splashed during the hunt
Bright sunlight causes the crocodile's eyes to water automatically
explanation: Liquid appears in a crocodile's eyes to keep them wet and clean, not because of emotion — this is the origin of the phrase 'crocodile tears.'
fact_tl: May sabi-sabi na umiiyak daw ang buwaya kapag kumakain, pero hindi ito dahil malungkot. Lumalabas ang likido sa mata nito para mapanatiling basa at malinis ang mata, hindi dahil sa emosyon. Doon nagmula ang kasabihang 'luha ng buwaya'.
fact_bis: Naay panultihon nga mohilak kuno ang buaya kung mokaon, apan dili kini tungod kay subo. Mogawas ang likido sa mata niini aron mabasa ug malimpyo ang mata, dili tungod sa pagbati. Diha gikan ang panultihon nga 'luha sa buaya'.

q: What happens when you pour oil into water?
options: The oil sinks to the bottom because it is heavier than water
The oil and water blend together to form a single liquid
The oil floats on top because it is less dense than water
The oil dissolves completely and disappears into the water
explanation: Oil and water do not mix; oil floats on top because it is less dense (lighter) than water.
fact_tl: Hindi naghahalo ang langis at tubig; ang langis ay lumulutang sa ibabaw dahil mas magaan ito kaysa sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lana ug tubig dili magsagol; ang lana molutaw sa ibabaw kay mas gaan (gamay og density) kini kaysa tubig.

q: Where in a cell is your DNA stored?
options: In the mitochondria, which is the energy factory of the cell
In the cell membrane that surrounds the outside of the cell
In the nucleus of almost every cell in your body
In the ribosomes, which are tiny structures that build proteins
explanation: Your DNA is stored in the nucleus of almost every cell in your body, and nearly all cells carry one complete copy of the same DNA.
fact_tl: Ang DNA mo ay nakatago sa nucleus ng halos bawat selula sa katawan mo, at ang nakakagulat, halos lahat ng bilyon-bilyong selula mo ay may iisa at kumpletong kopya ng parehong DNA.
fact_bis: Ang imong DNA gitago sa nucleus sa halos matag selula sa imong lawas, ug katingad-an, halos tanan sa imong binilyon nga selula adunay usa ka kompleto nga kopya sa parehas nga DNA.

q: How would a pendulum swing on the Moon compared to on Earth?
options: It would swing faster because the Moon has no air resistance to slow it down
It would swing at the same speed because gravity does not affect pendulums
It would swing more slowly because the Moon's gravity is weaker
It would not swing at all because there is no air on the Moon to push it
explanation: Stronger gravity makes a pendulum swing faster, so on the Moon, where gravity is weaker, a pendulum would swing more slowly.
fact_tl: Mas malakas ang grabidad, mas mabilis umuugoy ang pendulum; sa Buwan na mahina ang grabidad, mas mabagal ito.
fact_bis: Mas kusog ang grabidad, mas paspas molabyog ang pendulum; sa Bulan nga huyang ang grabidad, mas hinay kini.

q: Why does the dugong's snout point downward?
options: To help it breathe air at the surface without lifting its whole head
So it can easily graze seagrass on the seafloor
To allow it to filter tiny shrimp from the water like a whale
To protect its eyes from sand stirred up on the seabed
explanation: The dugong's downward-pointing snout is shaped to let it easily graze seagrass from the seafloor.
fact_tl: Ang nguso ng dugong ay nakatungo pababa para madaling sabsabin ang damong-dagat sa ilalim ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang simod sa dugong nagtumong paubos aron sayon nga makasabsab og sagbot sa salog sa dagat.

q: What is bioleaching?
options: A process that uses sunlight to separate copper from seawater
Using bacteria to dissolve metals from low-grade ore for mining
A farming method where bacteria are used to enrich poor soil
A water treatment technique that removes heavy metals from rivers
explanation: Bioleaching uses bacteria such as Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans to dissolve metals from low-grade ore, and it is used in mining to extract copper and gold.
fact_tl: Ang bioleaching ay ang paggamit ng bacteria tulad ng Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans upang matunaw ang mga metal mula sa mababang grado na ore — ginagamit ito sa industriya ng pagmimina upang makuha ang tanso at ginto.
fact_bis: Ang bioleaching mao ang paggamit sa mga bakterya sama sa Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans aron matunaw ang mga metal gikan sa dili taas nga grado nga ore — gigamit kini sa industriya sa pagmimina aron makuha ang tanso ug bulawan.

q: Why can solid objects like books and boxes be stacked on top of each other?
options: Solids are always light enough so they don't crush whatever is below them
Solids keep their shape, so they balance and support each other when stacked
Solids produce a sticky force that holds them together when piled up
Solids melt slightly at the surface, gluing each layer to the one below
explanation: Solid objects keep their shape, which is why they can be stacked — unlike liquids, which need a container to keep their form.
fact_tl: Ang mga solidong bagay ay maaaring itinayo sa isa't isa dahil pinapanatili nila ang kanilang hugis. Maaari kang mag-ipon ng mga libro, mga bato, o mga kahon sa ibabaw ng isa't isa. Ang mga likido ay hindi maaaring itinayo nang walang lalagyan.
fact_bis: Ang mga solidong butang mahimong ipatong sa ibabaw sa usag-usa tungod kay nagpabilin sila sa ilang hugis. Makapagpatong ka og mga libro, bato, o kahon sa ibabaw sa usag-usa. Ang mga likido dili mapatong nga walay sudlanan.

q: What is the main use of Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan?
options: It is a major tourist destination that earns foreign currency for the Philippines
It supplies much of Mindanao's electricity through a hydroelectric plant
It is the main source of drinking water for the entire Mindanao region
It is used to irrigate rice fields across the Lanao del Norte province
explanation: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan supplies much of Mindanao's electricity through the Agus VI hydroelectric plant.
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan ang nagbibigay ng malaking bahagi ng kuryente sa Mindanao sa pamamagitan ng Agus VI hydroelectric plant.
fact_bis: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan naghatag og dakong bahin sa kuryente sa Mindanao pinaagi sa Agus VI hydroelectric plant.

q: Why is gold commonly used to make rings and necklaces?
options: Because it is the hardest metal, so jewelry made from it never bends
Because it is beautiful and does not tarnish or spoil over time
Because it is the most common metal found in the Earth's crust
Because it is magnetic, so it is easy to shape into thin wires
explanation: Gold is used for jewelry because it is beautiful and does not spoil or tarnish, keeping its appearance over time.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang ginto sa paggawa ng mga alahas tulad ng singsing at kuwintas dahil maganda at hindi ito nasisira.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan gigamit sa paghimo og alahas sama sa singsing ug kwintas tungod kay nindot ug dili madaot.

q: How are kakawate leaves sometimes used in farming or gardens?
options: They are boiled and fed to livestock to help them grow faster
They are used as a natural insect repellent because they contain substances that repel some pests
They are dried and burned to create smoke that kills soil bacteria
They are soaked in water to make a liquid fertilizer for vegetables
explanation: Kakawate leaves contain substances that repel some pests, so they are sometimes used as a natural insect repellent.
fact_tl: Ang mga dahon ng kakawate ay may mga sangkap na nakakapagtaboy sa ilang peste, kaya minsan ginagamit ito bilang likas na pamatay-insekto.
fact_bis: Ang mga dahon sa kakawate adunay sustansya nga makapahawa sa pipila ka peste, busa usahay gigamit kini nga natural nga pamatay-insekto.

q: Which of the following machines belongs to the lever family of simple machines?
options: Pulley
Wedge
Screw
Inclined plane
explanation: The lever family includes the lever, pulley, and wheel and axle, while the inclined-plane family includes the inclined plane, wedge, and screw.
fact_tl: Ang anim na simple machines ay nahahati sa dalawang pamilya: ang lever family (lever, pulley, wheel and axle) at ang inclined-plane family (inclined plane, wedge, screw).
fact_bis: Ang unom ka simple machines nabahin sa duha ka pamilya: ang lever family (lever, pulley, wheel and axle) ug ang inclined-plane family (inclined plane, wedge, screw).

q: Why are wild greens like pako useful to Filipino families?
options: They can be eaten for free and also sold to earn money.
They are used only as medicine and cannot be eaten.
They grow only in gardens and must be bought at markets.
They are too bitter to eat but useful as animal feed only.
explanation: Pako and other wild greens are free food and can also be sold to earn money.
fact_tl: Ang pako at ibang ligaw na gulay ay libreng pagkain at maaari ring ipagbili para kumita ng pera.
fact_bis: Ang pako ug uban pang ihalas nga utanon libre nga pagkaon ug mahimo usab ibaligya aron makakwarta.

q: What happens to light when it moves from air into water?
options: It bends because it passes from one material into another.
It stops completely because water blocks all light.
It speeds up and becomes brighter.
It splits into seven colors and disappears.
explanation: Refraction is the bending of light as it passes from one material into another, such as from air into water.
fact_tl: Ang refraction ay ang pagliko ng liwanag kapag ito ay dumadaan mula sa isang materyal patungo sa iba, tulad ng mula hangin patungong tubig.
fact_bis: Ang refraction mao ang pagliko sa kahayag samtang kini molabay gikan sa usa ka materyal ngadto sa lain, sama sa gikan sa hangin ngadto sa tubig.

q: Which ancient thinker first had the idea that everything is made of tiny, invisible particles called atoms?
options: Democritus
Aristotle
Archimedes
Pythagoras
explanation: The ancient Greek philosopher Democritus first had the idea that everything is made of tiny atoms.
fact_tl: Ang sinaunang pilosopong Griyego na si Democritus ang unang nag-isip na ang lahat ay gawa sa maliliit na atomo.
fact_bis: Ang karaang Griyego nga pilosopo nga si Democritus ang unang naghunahuna nga ang tanan gilangkuban sa gagmay nga mga atomo.

q: Where do clownfish and anemones live together, including in the seas of the Philippines?
options: In coral reefs
In freshwater rivers
In deep ocean trenches
In mangrove swamps
explanation: Clownfish and anemones are found in coral reefs, including in the seas of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang clownfish at anemone ay matatagpuan sa mga bahura ng korales, kabilang sa mga karagatan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang clownfish ug anemone makita sa mga bahura sa korales, lakip sa kadagatan sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the fastest thing in the entire universe?
options: Light
Sound
Electricity
Wind
explanation: Light is the fastest thing in the whole universe.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa buong uniberso.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag mao ang pinakapaspas nga butang sa tibuok uniberso.

q: Why is blood type AB called 'AB'?
options: Because it has both the A and B antigens on the blood cells.
Because it was discovered in the months of August and then September.
Because it is a mix of type A and type O blood.
Because it has neither A nor B antigens but a special AB antigen.
explanation: Type AB blood has both the A and B antigens, which is why it is called AB.
fact_tl: Ang dugong uri AB ay may A at B antigen kaya tinatawag itong AB.
fact_bis: Ang dugo nga klase AB adunay duha ka antigen nga A ug B, mao nga gitawag kining AB.

q: At what temperature does water boil under normal air pressure?
options: 100 degrees Celsius
50 degrees Celsius
150 degrees Celsius
75 degrees Celsius
explanation: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (100°C) at normal air pressure.
fact_tl: Ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 100 degrees Celsius (100°C) sa karaniwang presyon ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang tubig magbukal sa 100 degrees Celsius (100°C) sa naandan nga presyon sa hangin.

q: How many oxygen atoms are in one molecule of oxygen gas (O2)?
explanation: In O2, the 2 means 2 oxygen atoms joined together, so one molecule of oxygen gas has 2 oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Sa O2, ang O2 ay nangangahulugang 2 atomo ng oksiheno na magkadikit, kaya ang isang molekula ng oxygen gas ay may 2 oksiheno.
fact_bis: Sa O2, ang O2 nagpasabot ug 2 atomo sa oksiheno nga nagdikit, busa ang usa ka molekula sa oxygen gas adunay 2 oksiheno.

q: Which organ of the body helps you speak, understand language, and read words?
options: The brain
The tongue
The ears
The eyes
explanation: The brain helps us speak, understand language, and read words.
fact_tl: Tinutulungan tayo ng utak na magsalita, umunawa ng wika, at bumasa ng mga salita.
fact_bis: Ang utok nagtabang kanato sa pagsulti, pagsabot sa pinulongan, ug pagbasa sa mga pulong.

q: Why does a giant clam close its shell when a shadow passes over it?
options: Hundreds of tiny light-sensing spots on its mantle detect the shadow, which might signal danger.
It closes automatically every few minutes to pump water through its body.
It has eyes on its shell that see the shadow and send a signal to its muscles.
It reacts to the change in water pressure caused by something swimming overhead.
explanation: Along the edge of its colorful mantle, a giant clam has hundreds of tiny light-sensing spots that detect light and shadow, so it closes when a shadow that might be an enemy passes over.
fact_tl: Sa gilid ng makulay na laman ng taklobo ay may daan-daang maliliit na sensor na nakakaramdam ng liwanag at anino, kaya nagsasara ito kapag may dumaang anino na maaaring kaaway.
fact_bis: Sa kilid sa mabulukon nga unod sa taklobo adunay gatusan ka gagmay nga sensor nga makamatngon sa kahayag ug landong, busa mosira kini kung adunay molabay nga landong nga mahimong kaaway.

q: What happens to dried seaweed when it is soaked in water?
options: It swells and expands again.
It dissolves completely into the water.
It turns a different color and becomes slimy.
It stays the same size and shape.
explanation: Seaweed can be dried to store for a long time, and it swells again when soaked in water.
fact_tl: Maaaring patuyuin ang damong-dagat para maitago nang matagal, at lumalaki itong muli kapag ibinabad sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lumot sa dagat mahimong pauga aron tipigan og dugay, ug molukop kini balik kon ibutang sa tubig.

q: Why is bagasse from sugarcane considered a cleaner energy source than coal?
options: Because sugarcane grows back every year, making bagasse renewable, while coal runs out.
Because bagasse burns hotter than coal and produces more electricity per kilogram.
Because bagasse is mined from the ground just like coal but in smaller amounts.
Because sugarcane fields absorb all the smoke produced when bagasse is burned.
explanation: Compared to coal, which runs out and comes from the ground, bagasse is renewable because sugarcane grows again every year.
fact_tl: Kumpara sa uling na nauubos at galing sa lupa, ang bagasse ay nababawi dahil tumutubo ulit ang tubo kada taon. Kaya itinuturing itong mas malinis na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Kumpara sa uling nga mahurot ug gikan sa yuta, ang bagasse mabawi kay motubo balik ang tubo kada tuig. Mao nga giila kini nga mas limpyo nga tinubdan sa enerhiya.

q: Which of the following can be stored for several days without a refrigerator?
options: Kamote and cassava
Fresh fish and squid
Leafy vegetables like kangkong
Ripe mangoes and bananas
explanation: Root crops like kamote and cassava can be stored for several days even without a refrigerator.
fact_tl: Ang mga halamang-ugat tulad ng kamote at cassava ay maaaring itago nang ilang araw kahit walang ref.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nga ugat sama sa kamote ug cassava mahimong tipigan sa pipila ka adlaw bisan walay ref.

q: When do egrets grow their beautiful long feather plumes?
options: During the breeding season
When they are young chicks learning to fly
During the cold dry season to stay warm
After they finish molting their old feathers
explanation: Egrets grow beautiful long plumes during the breeding season.
fact_tl: Tumutubo sa egret ang magaganda at mahahabang balahibo kapag panahon na ng pagpaparami.
fact_bis: Ang egret motubo ug nindot ug tag-as nga mga balhibo kung panahon na sa pagpasanay.

q: What causes a volcanic eruption to happen?
options: Gas trapped in magma builds up pressure and suddenly escapes, driving the eruption.
The volcano fills with water underground until it overflows from the top.
Lava becomes so hot that it melts through the volcano's walls and bursts out.
Earthquakes crack the ground open and release the lava that was stored inside.
explanation: Gas trapped inside magma builds up pressure, and when it suddenly escapes it drives a volcanic eruption.
fact_tl: Ang nakulong na gas sa loob ng magma ay nagtatayo ng presyon, at kapag ito ay biglang lumabas, nagdudulot ito ng pagsabog ng bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang gas nga nakulong sulod sa magma magpataas sa presyon, ug kung kalit kining mogawas, mao kini ang hinungdan sa pagbuto sa bolkan.

q: How can you tell a heron apart from a stork while they are flying?
options: A heron folds its neck into an S shape, while a stork keeps its neck stretched straight out.
A heron spreads its wings wide, while a stork tucks its wings close to its body.
A heron flies fast in a straight line, while a stork glides in slow circles.
A heron flaps its wings constantly, while a stork barely moves its wings at all.
explanation: When flying, a heron folds its neck into an S, while a stork keeps its neck straight out.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang tagak at ang stork kahit pareho silang mahahabang paa at leeg. Kapag lumilipad, nakabaluktot na parang S ang leeg ng tagak, samantalang deretso ang leeg ng stork.
fact_bis: Lahi ang tulabong ug ang stork bisan og parehong taas og bitiis ug liog. Pag molupad, nakaliko nga morag S ang liog sa tulabong, samtang tul-id ang liog sa stork.

q: On a seismogram, what do taller and bigger marks on the paper indicate?
options: A higher magnitude or stronger earthquake
A deeper earthquake that started far underground
A longer earthquake that lasted many minutes
An earthquake that struck far away from the seismograph
explanation: The taller and bigger the marks on the paper, the higher the magnitude scientists assign to the earthquake.
fact_tl: Mula sa laki ng mga alon sa seismogram, kinakalkula ng mga siyentipiko ang magnitude o lakas ng lindol; mas mataas at mas malaki ang mga guhit sa papel, mas mataas ang magnitude na ibinibigay nila.
fact_bis: Gikan sa kadako sa mga balod sa seismogram, kuwentahon sa mga syentista ang magnitude o kakusog sa linog; mas taas ug mas dako ang mga marka sa papel, mas taas ang magnitude nga ihatag nila.

q: Why do your fingernails look pink even though the nail itself is nearly clear?
options: Because the blood in the skin underneath shines through the clear nail.
Because nails contain a pink pigment called melanin that colors them.
Because the air trapped under the nail reflects a pink color.
Because nails absorb sunlight and store it as a pinkish glow.
explanation: Nails are almost clear and look pink because of the blood in the skin beneath them.
fact_tl: Ang kuko ay halos malinaw, at mukhang kulay-rosas dahil sa dugo sa balat sa ilalim nito.
fact_bis: Ang kuko hapit klaro, ug morag rosas tan-awon tungod sa dugo sa panit ilalom niini.

q: Why do hornbills (kalaw) choose bright, ripe fruit to eat?
options: Because ripe fruit is sweet and easy to spot in the trees, so the hornbill knows it is ready to eat.
Because bright colors contain more vitamins that hornbills need to fly long distances.
Because hornbills only see the color red, so only brightly colored fruit is visible to them.
Because ripe fruit is harder and easier for a hornbill's large beak to crush open.
explanation: Ripe fruit is sweet and easy to spot in the trees, so the hornbill knows it is ready to eat.
fact_tl: Bakit hinog at makulay na prutas ang gusto ng kalaw? Dahil ang mga ito ay matamis at madaling makita sa mga puno, kaya alam ng kalaw na handa na itong kainin.
fact_bis: Ngano hinog ug kolorado nga prutas ang gusto sa kalaw? Tungod kay tam-is kini ug sayon makita sa mga kahoy, busa nahibalo ang kalaw nga andam na kini kaonon.

q: Which animal is known for producing one of the loudest sounds on Earth, reaching about 188 decibels?
options: The blue whale
The African elephant
The howler monkey
The sperm whale
explanation: The blue whale is one of the loudest animals, with a call reaching about 188 decibels.
fact_tl: Ang blue whale ang isa sa pinakamaingay na hayop, na may tawag na umaabot ng mga 188 desibel.
fact_bis: Ang blue whale usa sa labing saba nga hayop, nga ang tingog makaabot og mga 188 ka desibel.

q: An object with a density of 0.7 g/cm3 is placed in water. What will happen?
options: It will float because its density is less than 1 g/cm3.
It will sink because any object placed in water sinks.
It will dissolve because its density is lower than water.
It will float halfway and then slowly sink to the bottom.
explanation: Anything with a density less than 1 g/cm3 floats in water, while denser things sink.
fact_tl: Lumulutang sa tubig ang anumang bagay na mas mababa sa 1 g/cm³ ang densidad, at lumulubog kung mas mataas.
fact_bis: Molutaw sa tubig ang bisan unsa nga ubos sa 1 g/cm³ ang densidad, ug molugdang kon mas denso.

q: How do ants help spread certain seeds to new places?
options: They carry seeds back to their nest to eat the tasty part, then leave the seed behind where it can grow.
They fly with the seeds and drop them far away from the parent plant.
They chew open the seed coat so the sprout can push out more easily.
They store seeds in hollow trees and forget where they hid them.
explanation: Ants carry seeds back to their nest, eat the tasty part, and leave the seed behind to grow.
fact_tl: May mga butong may maliit na bahaging matamis o malangis na gusto ng langgam. Dinadala ng langgam ang buto pauwi sa pugad nila, kinakain ang masarap na bahagi, at naiiwan ang buto para tumubo.
fact_bis: Ang ubang liso adunay gamay nga tam-is o malanaon nga bahin nga ganahan sa hulmigas. Dad-on sa hulmigas ang liso ngadto sa ilang salag, kan-on ang lami nga bahin, ug ibilin ang liso aron motubo.

q: How do Philippine cave swiftlets find their way around dark caves?
options: They use echolocation — sending out sounds and listening for the echoes.
They have very large eyes that can see clearly in total darkness.
They follow underground streams of air that lead them through the cave passages.
They memorize the exact shape of the cave and use touch to navigate.
explanation: Philippine cave swiftlets use echolocation to navigate dark caves.
fact_tl: Ang mga swiftlet na Philippine cave birds ay gumagamit ng echolocation para mag-navigate sa madilim na yungib — ang mga salag ng ibon na ito ang siyang ginagamit para gumawa ng bird's nest soup.
fact_bis: Ang mga Philippine cave swiftlet naggamit sa echolocation sa paniksik sa maitom nga yungib — ang ilang mga salag mao ang gigamit sa paghimo sa bird's nest soup.

q: Who designed the QWERTY keyboard layout?
options: Christopher Latham Sholes, who also invented the typewriter
Alexander Graham Bell, who invented the telephone
Thomas Edison, who also invented the light bulb
Charles Babbage, who built the first mechanical computer
explanation: The QWERTY keyboard layout was designed by Christopher Latham Sholes, the same man who made the typewriter.
fact_tl: Ang QWERTY keyboard ay dinisenyo ni Christopher Latham Sholes, ang parehong taong gumawa ng makinilya.
fact_bis: Ang QWERTY keyboard gidisenyo ni Christopher Latham Sholes, ang sama nga tawo nga naghimo sa typewriter.

q: What is terminal velocity?
options: The speed at which a falling object stops accelerating because air resistance equals gravity.
The maximum speed a car can reach before its engine burns out.
The speed at which an object hits the ground after falling.
The speed at which gravity stops pulling an object downward.
explanation: Terminal velocity is reached when air resistance balances gravity, so the falling object stops speeding up.
fact_tl: Naaabot ang terminal velocity kapag pantay na ang lakas ng hangin (air resistance) at grabidad, kaya hindi na bumibilis ang nahuhulog na bagay.
fact_bis: Maabot ang terminal velocity kon mag-pareho na ang air resistance ug grabidad, mao nga dili na mopaspas ang nahulog nga butang.

q: According to Bohr's model of the atom, where do electrons travel?
options: In fixed paths or energy levels around the nucleus
Randomly throughout the entire atom with no fixed path
In a straight line from one side of the nucleus to the other
Stuck on the surface of the nucleus, barely moving
explanation: Bohr said electrons travel in fixed paths or energy levels around the nucleus.
fact_tl: Sinabi ni Bohr na ang mga electron ay gumagalaw sa mga tiyak na landas o antas ng enerhiya (energy levels) sa paligid ng nucleus.
fact_bis: Giingon ni Bohr nga ang mga electron molihok sa pihong mga agianan o lebel sa enerhiya (energy levels) palibot sa nucleus.

q: How does a lightning rod protect a building during a storm?
options: It safely carries a lightning strike's electricity down into the ground.
It sends a strong electric signal upward that repels lightning away.
It heats up so hot that it vaporizes the lightning before it can damage anything.
It attracts all nearby lightning and stores the electricity inside for later use.
explanation: A lightning rod is a metal pole on a roof that safely carries a lightning's electricity down to the ground.
fact_tl: Ang lightning rod ay isang patpat na metal sa bubong na ligtas na nagdadala ng kuryente ng kidlat papunta sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang lightning rod usa ka metal nga bara sa atop nga luwas nga magdala sa kuryente sa kilat paingon sa yuta.

q: How deep is the Mariana Trench?
options: So deep that Mount Everest would fit inside it and still be underwater.
Exactly the same depth as Mount Everest is tall — the two balance out perfectly.
About half as deep as Mount Everest is tall.
Deep enough to fit a 10-story building, but no deeper than that.
explanation: The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of the ocean — so deep that even Mount Everest would fit inside it and still be underwater.
fact_tl: Ang Mariana Trench ang pinakamalalim na bahagi ng dagat, at napakalalim nito na kahit ang Bundok Everest ay kasya rito at malulubog pa rin.
fact_bis: Ang Mariana Trench mao ang labing lawom nga bahin sa dagat, ug lawom kaayo kini nga bisan ang Bukid sa Everest mahaom sulod niini ug magpabilin pa gihapon nga naunlod.

q: What is wind chill?
options: The effect of wind that makes cold temperatures feel even colder than they really are.
A type of cold rain that feels like ice pellets hitting your skin.
The lowest temperature recorded by a weather station during a storm.
A cold wind that blows from the mountains toward the coast in winter.
explanation: Wind chill is the effect of wind that makes cold temperatures feel even colder; even at 15°C, strong wind can make it feel much colder.
fact_tl: Ang wind chill ay ang epekto ng hangin na nagpapamalakas ng pakiramdam ng lamig; kahit ang temperatura ay 15°C, ang malakas na hangin ay maaaring magparamdam ng mas malamig kaysa aktual.
fact_bis: Ang wind chill mao ang epekto sa hangin nga nagpagrabe sa pakiramdam sa kabugnaw; bisan sa temperatura nga 15°C, ang kusog nga hangin mahimong magpabugnaw og labaw pa kaysa aktwal.

q: Which element is the most abundant in the entire universe?
options: Hydrogen (H)
Helium (He)
Oxygen (O)
Carbon (C)
explanation: Hydrogen (H) is the most abundant element in the entire universe.
fact_tl: Ang hydrogen (H) ang pinakamaraming elemento sa buong sansinukob.
fact_bis: Ang hydrogen (H) maoy kinadaghanang elemento sa tibuok uniberso.

q: What feature helps sea snakes swim through the ocean?
options: A flat, paddle-like tail that pushes them through the water.
Flippers on their sides like a turtle's that row them forward.
Gills along their neck that also act like fins for steering.
A wide, flat belly that they wiggle back and forth to glide.
explanation: Sea snakes have a flat paddle-like tail that helps them swim.
fact_tl: Ang mga sea snake ay may flat na buntot na parang paddle na tumutulong sa paglangoy — sila ang mga nakakalason na reptile ng dagat at natutulog sila sa pamamagitan ng pagtahok ng hangin sa ibabaw ngunit maaaring manatili sa ilalim ng tubig ng ilang oras.
fact_bis: Ang mga sea snake adunay patag nga paddle-like nga buntot nga nagtabang kanila sa paglangoy — sila mga nakakalason nga marine reptile ug kinahanglan nilang mokyat aron makahinga apan mahimong magpabilin sa ilalim og mga oras.

q: Why does water travel upward through paper, soil, or cloth on its own?
options: These materials have tiny holes or spaces that act like tubes and pull water upward through capillary action.
These materials are magnetic and attract water molecules toward the top.
Gravity is weaker inside porous materials, so water naturally rises.
Water evaporates from the bottom and condenses higher up inside the material.
explanation: Capillary action happens in materials full of tiny holes or spaces that act as tubes for the water.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang capillary action sa mga materyales na may maliliit na butas o puwang, tulad ng papel, lupa, tela, at kahoy. Ang maliliit na puwang na ito ang nagsisilbing tubo para sa tubig.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang capillary action sa mga materyales nga puno sa gagmay nga mga lungag o luna, sama sa papel, yuta, panapton, ug kahoy. Kini nga gagmay nga mga luna ang mahimong tubo alang sa tubig.

q: How do prairie dog alarm calls differ from one another?
options: Each call is different depending on the type of predator — there is a special sound for a hawk, a coyote, or a human.
All alarm calls sound the same but are given more quickly when the danger is closer.
Prairie dogs only give one type of alarm call and then run underground immediately.
The calls differ by loudness — louder means a bigger predator, quieter means a smaller one.
explanation: Prairie dog alarm calls differ by enemy, so there is a special sound for a hawk, a coyote, or a human.
fact_tl: Iba-iba ang tawag ng babala ng prairie dog depende sa kaaway, kaya may natatanging tunog para sa lawin, coyote, o tao.
fact_bis: Ang pasidaan sa prairie dog magkalainlain depende sa kaaway, mao nga adunay espesyal nga tingog alang sa agila, coyote, o tawo.

q: What kind of animal is a sand dollar?
options: A flat sea urchin that lives buried in the sand on the seafloor.
A type of jellyfish that drifts along the ocean bottom.
A shellfish similar to a clam that filters water for food.
A small flat crab that burrows into sandy beaches.
explanation: A sand dollar is a kind of flat sea urchin that lives buried in the sand on the seafloor.
fact_tl: Ang sand dollar ay isang uri ng lapad na sea urchin na naninirahan sa buhangin sa ilalim ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang sand dollar usa ka matang sa lapad nga tuyom nga nagpuyo nga nalubong sa balas sa salog sa dagat.

q: How does the anglerfish benefit from the glowing bacteria living on its lure?
options: The bacteria make the light the fish needs to attract prey, while the fish gives the bacteria a safe home and nutrients.
The bacteria eat the dead skin off the fish to keep it clean, while the fish protects the bacteria from other predators.
The bacteria release chemicals that paralyze passing fish so the anglerfish can catch them easily.
The bacteria generate warmth for the anglerfish in the cold deep ocean, while the fish feeds the bacteria.
explanation: The fish gives the bacteria a safe home and nutrients, and in return the bacteria make the light the fish needs to hunt.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish at ang bakterya ay may simbiyosis — isang relasyon kung saan pareho silang nakikinabang. Binibigyan ng isda ang bakterya ng ligtas na tirahan at sustansya, at bilang kapalit, ginagawa ng bakterya ang ilaw na kailangan ng isda para manghuli.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish ug ang bakterya adunay simbiyosis — usa ka relasyon diin pareho silang makabenepisyo. Ang isda mohatag sa bakterya og luwas nga puy-anan ug sustansya, ug isip baylo ang bakterya maghimo sa kahayag nga gikinahanglan sa isda aron mangayam.

q: What helps keep the liver healthy and working well?
options: Eating healthy food and drinking clean water.
Taking vitamin C supplements every day.
Exercising for at least one hour every morning.
Sleeping at least ten hours each night.
explanation: Healthy food and clean water help keep the liver healthy and working well.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang malusog na pagkain at malinis na tubig upang manatiling malusog at gumagana nang maayos ang atay.
fact_bis: Ang himsog nga pagkaon ug limpyo nga tubig makatabang nga magpabiling himsog ug maayo ang paglihok sa atay.

q: Why does the body fight a germ much faster after you have been vaccinated against it?
options: The vaccine leaves behind memory cells that remember the germ so the body reacts quickly if it appears again.
The vaccine destroys all germs in the body so there is nothing left to fight.
The vaccine makes the immune system permanently active so it attacks everything immediately.
The vaccine puts a small amount of medicine in the blood that kills the germ on contact.
explanation: A vaccine leaves behind memory cells that remember the germ, so the body fights much faster if it meets that germ again.
fact_tl: Iniiwan ng bakuna ang mga 'memory cells' na naaalala ang mikrobyo, kaya mas mabilis lumaban ang katawan kapag muli itong nakasalubong.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna mabilin ug 'memory cells' nga mahinumdom sa mikrobyo, busa mas paspas mosukol ang lawas kung makasugat na usab niini.

q: What is the capital city of Portugal?
options: Lisbon
Porto
Braga
Faro
explanation: The capital of Portugal is Lisbon.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Portugal ay Lisbon (Lisboa).
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Portugal mao ang Lisbon (Lisboa).

q: Why do scientists today use the moment magnitude scale (Mw) instead of the original Richter scale for very large earthquakes?
options: Because the moment magnitude scale is more accurate for measuring very large earthquakes.
Because the Richter scale was destroyed in a big earthquake and cannot be used anymore.
Because the moment magnitude scale is simpler and easier for the public to understand.
Because the Richter scale only measures earthquakes that happen underwater.
explanation: For very large earthquakes, scientists today use the moment magnitude scale (Mw) instead of the original Richter scale because it is more accurate.
fact_tl: Para sa napakalalaking lindol, mas ginagamit ngayon ng mga siyentista ang moment magnitude (Mw) kaysa orihinal na Richter scale dahil mas tumpak ito.
fact_bis: Alang sa dagkong mga linog, ang mga siyentista karon naggamit sa moment magnitude (Mw) imbes sa orihinal nga Richter scale kay mas tukma kini.

q: Where does the carbon stored in your bones, muscles, and skin originally come from?
options: From the food you eat.
From the air you breathe in through your lungs.
From the water you drink every day.
From sunlight absorbed through your skin.
explanation: Your bones, muscles, and skin are built from carbon that came from the food you eat.
fact_tl: Pati ikaw ay imbakan ng karbon! Ang iyong mga buto, laman, at balat ay gawa sa karbon na galing sa pagkaing kinain mo.
fact_bis: Bisan ikaw usa ka tipiganan sa karbon! Ang imong mga bukog, unod, ug panit hinimo gikan sa karbon nga gikan sa pagkaon nga imong gikaon.

q: What is a meteorite?
options: A space rock that survives burning through the atmosphere and lands on Earth's surface.
A chunk of ice and dust that orbits the Sun and grows a bright tail near it.
A small piece that breaks off an asteroid and orbits Earth like a tiny moon.
A rock ejected from a volcano that is launched so high it reaches outer space.
explanation: A meteorite is a space rock that survives the burning and lands on Earth's ground.
fact_tl: Ang meteorite ay ang bato mula sa kalawakan na nakaligtas sa pagkasunog at bumagsak sa lupa ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang meteorite mao ang bato gikan sa kalawakan nga nakalahutay sa pagkasunog ug nahulog sa yuta sa Yuta.

q: Why is it harder to breathe at the top of a very high mountain like Mount Apo?
options: The air is thinner at high altitudes, so each breath brings in less oxygen.
The cold temperature freezes the oxygen molecules so they cannot enter the lungs.
Wind blows the oxygen away from the mountain peak before you can breathe it in.
Your lungs work harder in thin air, but they still take in the same amount of oxygen.
explanation: High up, the air is thinner and each breath brings in less oxygen.
fact_tl: Sa napakataas na lugar tulad ng tuktok ng Mount Apo, mas manipis ang hangin at mas kaunti ang oxygen na nakukuha sa bawat hinga.
fact_bis: Sa habog kaayo nga dapit sama sa tumoy sa Mount Apo, mas niwang ang hangin ug mas gamay ang oxygen nga makuha sa matag ginhawa.

q: What physical features help an anglerfish catch and eat its prey?
options: A large mouth and sharp teeth.
Long, thin tentacles that wrap around prey.
A hard beak like a parrot fish that crushes shells.
A venomous spine on its back that paralyzes prey.
explanation: The anglerfish has a large mouth and sharp teeth to catch and eat its prey.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish ay may malaking bibig at matatalas na ngipin para makahuli at makakain ng biktima.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish naa'y dako nga baba ug hait nga mga ngipon aron makadakop ug makaon sa biktima niini.

q: In what year was Stephenson's famous 'Rocket' locomotive built?
explanation: Stephenson's 'Rocket' locomotive was built in 1829.
fact_tl: Ang 'Rocket' na lokomotibo ni Stephenson ay ginawa noong 1829.
fact_bis: Ang 'Rocket' nga lokomotibo ni Stephenson gihimo niadtong 1829.

q: Why does the ocean sometimes glow blue at night when waves break?
options: Tiny organisms called dinoflagellates produce blue light through a chemical reaction whenever the water is disturbed.
Bioluminescent jellyfish release glowing chemicals into the water when they sense danger.
Minerals in the seawater absorb sunlight during the day and release it as blue light at night.
The reflection of moonlight on wave foam creates a glowing blue optical illusion.
explanation: Some dinoflagellates produce blue light whenever the water is disturbed at night, through a chemical reaction involving the enzyme luciferase.
fact_tl: Ang ilang mga dinoflagellate — isang uri ng phytoplankton — ay gumagawa ng asul na liwanag tuwing nagagalaw ang tubig sa gabi, dahil sa kemikal na reaksyon na kinasasangkutan ng luciferase enzyme.
fact_bis: Ang ubang mga dinoflagellate — usa ka klase sa phytoplankton — nagbuhat og asul nga suga sa matag higayon nga nagabalhin ang tubig sa gabii, pinaagi sa kemikal nga reaksyon nga naglambigit sa enzyme luciferase.

q: In which province is Taal Lake located?
options: Batangas
Laguna
Cavite
Quezon
explanation: Taal Lake is located in Batangas, on the island of Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang Taal Lake ay matatagpuan sa Batangas, sa isla ng Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Taal Lake nahimutang sa Batangas, sa isla sa Luzon.

q: How are banana plants usually grown and spread in the Philippines?
options: Using suckers — small offshoots that grow beside the main plant.
By planting seeds found inside ripe bananas.
By cutting a branch and placing it in water until roots grow.
By grafting a banana bud onto the root of another fruit tree.
explanation: Bananas are propagated using suckers — small offshoots that grow beside the main plant, not from seeds.
fact_tl: Ang saging ay pinaparami gamit ang mga supang (sucker) — maliliit na anak na tumutubo sa tabi ng pangunahing puno, hindi mula sa buto.
fact_bis: Ang saging gipadaghan gamit ang mga saha (sucker) — gagmay nga anak nga mutubo sa kilid sa nag-unang punoan, dili gikan sa liso.

q: What does Pascal's Principle state about pressure in an enclosed fluid?
options: Pressure applied to an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally to all parts of it.
Pressure in a fluid always pushes downward due to gravity and is stronger at the bottom.
Pressure applied at one point in a fluid doubles at every other point in the fluid.
Pressure in a sealed container decreases over time as the fluid absorbs it.
explanation: Pascal's Principle states that pressure applied to an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally to all parts of it.
fact_tl: Ang Prinsipyo ni Pascal, ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal, ay nagsasabing ang presyon na inilapat sa isang nakakulong na likido ay pantay na naipapasa sa lahat ng bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Ang Prinsipyo ni Pascal, ginganlan sunod kang Blaise Pascal, nag-ingon nga ang presyon nga gibutang sa usa ka sirado nga likido managsama nga ipasa sa tanan niini nga bahin.

q: What can happen to the seeds found inside a citrus fruit if you plant them in soil?
options: They can sprout and grow into a new citrus tree.
They shrink and disappear because citrus seeds cannot survive outside the fruit.
They only grow roots but never develop into a full tree above the ground.
They must be dried for one year before they are able to sprout.
explanation: Inside citrus fruit are seeds that can sprout and grow into a new tree when planted in soil.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng citrus ay may mga buto na maaaring tumubo at maging bagong puno kapag naitanim sa lupa.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa citrus naay mga liso nga mahimong motubo ug mahimong bag-ong kahoy kung itanom sa yuta.

q: Why does dew form tiny round beads on leaves in the morning?
options: Surface tension pulls the water together into round drops
The leaf wax makes water bounce into round shapes
Cold air freezes the water into tiny balls
Gravity squeezes falling raindrops into beads
explanation: Surface tension pulls water molecules together, which is why dew on leaves forms tiny round beads.
fact_tl: Tuwing umaga, ang hamog sa mga dahon ay nagiging maliliit na bilog na butil dahil hinihila ng surface tension ang tubig.
fact_bis: Sa buntag, ang yamog sa mga dahon mahimong gagmay nga lingin nga butil kay ang surface tension mobira sa tubig pagtapok.

q: Why can termites be harmful to houses?
options: They bite people who live inside the house
They eat wood, which can damage wooden structures
They build mud walls that block doorways
They produce a liquid that rusts metal beams
explanation: Termites eat wood, so they can damage houses and other wooden things.
fact_tl: Ang anay (termite) ay isang insektong namumuhay nang sama-sama sa malaking kolonya at kumakain ng kahoy, kaya nakakasira ito ng mga bahay at gamit na yari sa kahoy.
fact_bis: Ang anay (termite) usa ka insekto nga nagpuyo nga tingob sa dako nga kolonya ug nagkaon og kahoy, maong makadaot kini sa mga balay ug gamit nga hinimo sa kahoy.

q: What must happen to the air before dew or fog can form?
options: The air must heat up to the boiling point
The air must reach 100% oxygen levels
The air must cool to a temperature called the dew point
The air must mix with salt water from the ocean
explanation: Air must cool to the dew point temperature before dew or fog can form.
fact_tl: Kailangang lumamig ang hangin hanggang sa tinatawag na dew point bago mabuo ang hamog o ambon.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan mobugnaw ang hangin hangtod sa gitawag nga dew point una maporma ang yamog o gabon.

q: Which statement best describes how quickly different materials decompose?
options: All materials rot at the same speed when buried in soil
Soft leaves rot fast, but plastic takes very long or cannot break down at all
Plastic rots faster than leaves because it is made by people
Leaves take hundreds of years to rot just like metal cans
explanation: Soft leaves rot quickly, but plastic takes a very long time or cannot be broken down by decomposers at all.
fact_tl: Mabilis bulukin ang malambot na dahon, ngunit napakatagal o hindi man lang mabulok ng mga decomposer ang plastik.
fact_bis: Paspas malata ang humok nga dahon, apan dugay kaayo o dili gani mabungkag sa mga decomposer ang plastik.

q: Why is digestion slow in animals that eat mainly leaves?
options: Leaves have very little water so the stomach must work harder to absorb liquid
Microbes need time to break down the tough fiber in leaves
Leaf-eaters have very small stomachs that process food one bite at a time
Leaves contain poison that the body must remove slowly before digesting
explanation: Digestion is slow in leaf-eaters because microbes need time to break down the tough fiber in leaves.
fact_tl: Mabagal ang pagtunaw ng pagkain sa mga leaf-eater dahil kailangan ng oras ang mga mikrobyo para sirain ang matigas na hibla.
fact_bis: Mahinay ang pagtunaw sa pagkaon sa mga leaf-eater kay kinahanglan og panahon ang mga mikrobyo aron bungkagon ang gahi nga hibla.

q: Approximately how long ago did our Sun and Earth form?
options: About 13.8 billion years ago, at the same time as the Big Bang
About 4.6 billion years ago, long after the Big Bang
About 1 billion years ago, recently in cosmic time
About 4.6 million years ago, when the first dinosaurs appeared
explanation: Our Sun and Earth formed about 4.6 billion years ago, long after the Big Bang.
fact_tl: Ang ating Araw at Daigdig ay nabuo mga 4.6 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas—matagal-tagal na pagkatapos ng Big Bang.
fact_bis: Ang atong Adlaw ug Yuta naporma mga 4.6 ka bilyon ka tuig na ang milabay—dugay na human sa Big Bang.

q: What element makes up diamond, the hardest natural material?
options: Silicon
Nitrogen
Carbon
Quartz
explanation: Diamond is the hardest natural material and is made entirely of the element carbon.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamatigas na natural na materyal ay diamante (diamond), at ito ay gawa lamang sa elemento na carbon (karbon).
fact_bis: Ang labing gahi nga natural nga materyal mao ang diamante (diamond), ug hinimo lamang kini sa elemento nga carbon (karbon).

q: Which lake is the deepest in the Philippines?
options: Lake Taal
Lake Laguna de Bay
Lake Lanao
Lake Mainit
explanation: Lake Mainit is the deepest lake in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na lawa sa Pilipinas ay ang Lake Mainit.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga lanaw sa Pilipinas mao ang Lake Mainit.

q: What are the granules visible on the Sun's surface?
options: Craters formed by meteor impacts on the solar surface
Dark spots caused by strong magnetic fields cooling the surface
Convection cells where hot gas rises, spreads out, and sinks back down
Permanent mountain ranges made of solid solar rock
explanation: The Sun's granules are convection cells about 1,000 km across where hot gas rises, spreads out, and sinks back down at the edges.
fact_tl: Ang ibabaw ng Araw ay natatakpan ng mga granule — mga convection cell na humigit-kumulang 1,000 kilometro ang lapad kung saan ang mainit na gas ay umaakyat mula sa convective zone sa loob, pinalalawak, at bumabalik pababa sa mga gilid; ang bawat granule ay tumatagal ng humigit-kumulang 8 hanggang 20 minuto bago masira.
fact_bis: Ang nawong sa Adlaw natakpan sa mga granule — mga convection cell mga 1,000 kilometro ang gilapdon diin ang init nga gas mosaka gikan sa sulod nga convective zone, mokuyanap, ug mosalop sa mga kilid; ang matag granule nagpadayon og mga 8 hangtod 20 minuto sa wala pa madisrupt.

q: What is the internal structure of a crystal called?
options: A lattice — a regular, repeating pattern of atoms or molecules throughout the crystal
A matrix — a random jumble of atoms squeezed tightly together
A mesh — a flat sheet of molecules layered one on top of another
A nucleus — a central cluster of atoms surrounded by empty space
explanation: The regular, repeating pattern of atoms, ions, or molecules inside a crystal is called a lattice, which gives the crystal its shape and properties.
fact_tl: Ang istruktura ng isang kristal ay tinatawag na lattice — isang regular, paulit-ulit na pattern ng mga atom, ion, o molekula na sumasaklaw sa buong kristal. Ang pattern na ito ang nagbibigay sa kristal ng katangiang hugis at katangian.
fact_bis: Ang istruktura sa usa ka kristal gitawag nga lattice — usa ka regular, paulit-ulit nga pattern sa mga atom, ion, o molekula nga nagpatunhay sa tibuok kristal. Kining pattern naghatag sa kristal sa iyang kinaiya nga hugis ug mga katangian.

q: What are elements?
options: Mixtures of two or more substances combined together
Liquids that can be separated by boiling
The simplest substances that make up all the matter around us
Chemicals that only exist inside living things
explanation: Elements are the simplest substances that make up all the matter around us.
fact_tl: Ang mga elemento ang pinakasimpleng mga sangkap na bumubuo sa lahat ng bagay sa paligid natin.
fact_bis: Ang mga elemento mao ang pinakayano nga mga sangkap nga naglangkob sa tanang butang sa atong palibot.

q: Why can't plants use nitrogen gas directly from the air?
options: Plants already make their own nitrogen through photosynthesis
Nitrogen gas is poisonous to plant roots
Plants can only absorb nitrogen after special bacteria change it into a usable form
Nitrogen gas is too heavy to enter through the roots
explanation: Plants cannot use nitrogen gas straight from the air, so special bacteria change it into a form that roots can absorb.
fact_tl: Hindi magagamit ng mga halaman ang nitrogen gas mula mismo sa hangin, kaya may mga espesyal na bakterya na nagbabago nito sa anyong kayang sipsipin ng mga ugat.
fact_bis: Dili magamit sa mga tanom ang nitrogen gas direkta gikan sa hangin, mao nga adunay espesyal nga bakterya nga nag-usab niini ngadto sa porma nga masuyop sa mga gamot.

q: What kinds of energy does a burning candle produce?
options: Electrical energy and mechanical energy
Light and heat at the same time
Sound energy and kinetic energy
Magnetic energy and chemical energy
explanation: A burning candle converts chemical energy into both light and heat at the same time.
fact_tl: Ang kandila ay nagbibigay ng liwanag at init nang sabay-sabay kapag nasusunog — ito ay isang halimbawa ng isang bagay na nagko-convert ng chemical energy sa liwanag at init.
fact_bis: Ang nagsunog nga kandila nagahatag og suga ug init sa samang panahon — kini usa ka pananglitan sa chemical energy nga ginabag-o ngadto sa suga ug init.

q: What is the laboratory method called that finds exactly how much base is needed to neutralize an acid?
options: Filtration
Distillation
Chromatography
Titration
explanation: Titration is the lab method where a base is added drop by drop to an acid until an indicator shows the solution is neutral.
fact_tl: Sa lab, may paraan na tinatawag na titration para malaman nang eksakto kung gaano karaming base ang kailangan para ma-neutralize ang isang asido. Patak-patak na idinadagdag ang base habang minamasdan ang indicator. Sa sandaling magbago ang kulay, alam nilang tama na ang dami — neutral na.
fact_bis: Sa lab, naa'y paagi nga gitawag og titration aron mahibal-an gayud kung pila ka base ang gikinahanglan aron ma-neutralize ang asido. Idugang ang base tinuluan samtang gibantayan ang indicator. Sa higayon nga mobalhin ang kolor, mahibal-an nila nga sakto na ang gidaghanon — neutral na.

q: How do some mangroves get the air their roots need in muddy coastal soil?
options: Their roots grow very deep to reach air pockets underground
They have pointed roots that poke up out of the mud to breathe in air
Their leaves absorb oxygen and send it down to the roots
They float on the water surface so their roots stay above the mud
explanation: Some mangroves have pointed roots that poke up out of the mud to breathe in air.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bakawan ay may matutulis na ugat na umuusli sa putik para makahinga ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bakhaw adunay talinis nga mga gamot nga mogula sa lapok aron makaginhawa og hangin.

q: What instrument does PHIVOLCS use around volcanoes to detect signs of magma moving underground?
options: Telescope
Barometer
Seismograph
Thermometer
explanation: PHIVOLCS uses seismographs to detect small earthquakes and ground tremors that signal magma movement under active volcanoes.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS ng mga seismograph sa paligid ng aktibong bulkan para masukat ang mga maliliit na lindol at ground tremor na senyales ng paggalaw ng magma.
fact_bis: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS og mga seismograph sa palibot sa aktibong bulkan aron mahibal-an ang gagmay nga linog ug ground tremors nga timaan sa paglihok sa magma sa ilalom.

q: What happens to the water temperature when some salts dissolve in it?
options: The water always gets warmer because dissolving releases heat
The water temperature never changes when things dissolve in it
The water can get cooler because some salts absorb heat when they dissolve
The water freezes instantly because salts remove all heat energy
explanation: Some salts cool the water when they dissolve because the dissolving process absorbs heat, making it endothermic.
fact_tl: May ilang asin na kapag tinunaw sa tubig ay nagpapalamig nito dahil sumisipsip ito ng init (endothermic).
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka asin nga kung matunaw sa tubig magbugnaw niini kay nagsuyop kini ug kainit (endothermic).

q: What is the difference between heat and temperature?
options: Heat and temperature are two different names for the same thing
Heat measures how hot an object looks, while temperature measures how hot it feels
Heat is energy transferred between objects, while temperature measures the average motion energy of particles inside a substance
Temperature is the total energy inside an object, while heat is only on the surface
explanation: Heat is energy transferred from a hotter to a cooler object, while temperature is a measure of the average motion energy of particles inside a substance.
fact_tl: Ang init (heat) ay ang enerhiyang inililipat mula sa mainit patungong malamig na bagay, samtang ang temperatura ay sukat lamang ng average na enerhiya ng paggalaw ng mga maliliit na particle sa loob ng bagay.
fact_bis: Ang init (heat) mao ang enerhiya nga gibalhin gikan sa mas init ngadto sa mas bugnaw nga butang, samtang ang temperatura sukod lamang sa average nga enerhiya sa paglihok sa gagmay nga partikulo sulod sa usa ka butang.

q: What does the inside of a durian look like when you open it?
options: One big solid piece of fruit with no divisions, like a mango
It is hollow and empty inside with just a large seed in the center
It is divided into several compartments, each holding soft flesh and seeds
It has layers of thin sheets of fruit stacked on top of each other
explanation: Inside a durian there are several compartments, each holding a few pieces of soft flesh with seeds.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng durian ay may ilang silid o bahagi, parang mga kuwarto. Sa bawat bahagi ay may ilang piraso ng malambot na laman na may buto. Kapag binuksan mo, parang naghahati ito sa mga seksyon.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa durian adunay pipila ka silid o bahin, morag gagmay nga kwarto. Sa matag bahin adunay pipila ka piraso sa humok nga unod nga adunay liso. Kung ablihan nimo, mabahin kini sa maong mga seksyon.

q: What special sense do sharks use to find prey hidden under sand?
options: A powerful sense of taste that detects chemicals in the water
Gel-filled pores on their faces that detect weak electric fields from muscle movements
Tiny hairs along their sides that pick up sound vibrations from the prey
Extra-large eyes that see heat given off by hidden animals
explanation: Sharks have ampullae of Lorenzini — gel-filled pores on their faces — that detect weak electric fields produced by prey's muscle movements, even when the prey is hidden under sand.
fact_tl: Ang mga pulo ng pating ay may ampullae of Lorenzini — mga butas na puno ng gel sa kanilang mukha — na nakakaramdam ng mahinang electric fields na ginawa ng mga kalamnan ng biktima kahit nakatabing sa buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga pating adunay ampullae of Lorenzini — gel-puno nga mga poro sa ilang nawong — nga makakita sa mahinay nga electric fields nga gihimo sa paglihok sa kaunoran sa biktima bisan natago sa ilalim sa balas.

q: Why is blood considered a heterogeneous mixture?
options: Because blood is always one color and has the same thickness throughout
Because blood only contains one type of molecule dissolved evenly in water
Because under a microscope, red blood cells and plasma are visibly different parts
Because blood can be separated into gases when heated, showing it has different layers
explanation: Blood looks even to the eye but under a microscope contains distinct parts — red blood cells floating in plasma — making it a heterogeneous mixture.
fact_tl: Ang dugo natin ay parang pula at pantay sa mata, pero sa ilalim ng mikroskopyo, heterogeneous pala ito. Naglulutang ang maliliit na cells tulad ng red blood cells sa malabnaw na bahagi na tinatawag na plasma. Magkakaiba ang mga bahaging ito, kaya nga heterogeneous.
fact_bis: Ang atong dugo morag pula ug pantay sa mata, apan ilawom sa mikroskopyo, heterogeneous diay kini. Naglutaw ang gagmay nga mga cell sama sa red blood cells sa tubigon nga bahin nga gitawag og plasma. Lainlain kining mga bahin, mao nga heterogeneous.

q: Which city is famous for the Panagbenga flower festival where flowers like roses and sunflowers are displayed on floats?
options: Manila
Cebu
Davao
Baguio
explanation: Many flowers such as roses, sunflowers, and the everlasting flower grow well in cool Baguio, and are featured during the Panagbenga festival.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng bulaklak ang tumutubo nang maganda sa malamig na Baguio, tulad ng rosas, sunflower, at ang 'everlasting' na hindi madaling malanta. Madalas itong makita sa mga float at hardin tuwing Panagbenga.
