explanation: Certain American cicadas spend years underground and then all emerge together in massive groups every 13 or 17 years.
fact_tl: May ilang uri ng kuliglig sa Amerika na lumalabas mula sa lupa nang sabay-sabay tuwing 13 o 17 na taon.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka klase sa kuliglig sa Amerika nga mogula sa yuta nga dungan kada 13 o 17 ka tuig.

q: How do germs most easily spread from your hands to your body?
options: From dirty hands to the mouth, eyes, and food
From touching wet surfaces to breathing in steam
From walking barefoot on dirty floors to your feet
From sweating on dirty clothes that touch your skin
explanation: Germs on dirty hands easily transfer to the mouth, eyes, and food, which is why regular handwashing is so important.
fact_tl: Madaling kumalat ang mikrobyo mula sa maruming kamay patungo sa bibig, mata, at pagkain, kaya mahalaga ang paglilinis.
fact_bis: Ang mikrobyo dali rang mokaylap gikan sa hugaw nga kamot ngadto sa baba, mata, ug pagkaon, busa importante ang pagpakalimpyo.

q: What extreme temperatures can a tardigrade survive, at least for a short time?
options: Near -272°C in extreme cold and up to about 150°C in extreme heat
Between 0°C and 100°C like most small animals
From -10°C in mild cold to 50°C in desert heat
From -50°C in freezing cold to 80°C in very hot water
explanation: A tardigrade can survive near -272°C (almost absolute zero) and up to about 150°C, making it one of the most temperature-tolerant animals known.
fact_tl: Ang tardigrade ay nakakaligtas sa sobrang lamig na halos -272°C at sobrang init na umaabot sa mga 150°C, kahit saglit lang.
fact_bis: Ang tardigrade makasugakod sa hilabihang bugnaw nga halos -272°C ug hilabihang init nga moabot ug mga 150°C, bisan sa mubo lang nga panahon.

q: How does a tapeworm grow longer inside the intestine?
options: It keeps adding new segments to its body over time
It stretches its existing body like a rubber band
It splits in two and each half grows back to full size
It absorbs water from the intestine, swelling in length
explanation: A tapeworm's body is made of many flat segments, and it continuously adds new segments to grow longer inside the intestine.
fact_tl: Ang tapeworm ay parang mahabang laso na binubuo ng maraming maliliit na piraso o bahagi. May ulo itong may parang kawit na nakakapit sa loob ng bituka, at habang tumatagal ay nagdadagdag ito ng bagong piraso para humaba.
fact_bis: Ang tapeworm murag taas nga laso nga gilangkuban sa daghang gagmay nga piraso nga gisumpay. Naa kini ulo nga adunay gagmay nga kaw-it nga mokupot sa sulod sa tinai, ug magdugang kini og bag-ong piraso aron motaas.

q: How many sunrises do astronauts on the International Space Station see each day?
options: About 16 sunrises
About 2 sunrises
About 4 sunrises
About 24 sunrises
explanation: Because the ISS orbits Earth very quickly, astronauts on board see about 16 sunrises and sunsets every day.
fact_tl: Dahil napakabilis nitong umiikot, nakikita ng mga astronaut sa ISS ang humigit-kumulang 16 na pagsikat at paglubog ng araw kada araw.
fact_bis: Tungod kay paspas kaayo kini motuyok, ang mga astronaut sa ISS makakita og mga 16 ka pagsubang ug pagsalop sa adlaw matag adlaw.

q: Why does stirring make a substance dissolve faster?
options: It spreads the solute through the solvent faster
It breaks the solute into smaller pieces
It raises the temperature of the solvent
It removes air bubbles that slow dissolving
explanation: Stirring speeds up dissolving by spreading the solute throughout the solvent more quickly rather than letting it sit in one place.
fact_tl: Ang paghahalo o pagkalkal ay nagpapabilis ng pagkatunaw dahil mas mabilis kumalat ang solute sa solvent.
fact_bis: Ang pagkutaw makapadali sa pagkatunaw kay mas paspas nga magkatag ang solute sa solvent.

q: What is the chemical formula for carbon dioxide?
options: CO2
CO
C2O
O2C
explanation: Carbon dioxide is written as CO2, meaning one carbon atom bonded to two oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng carbon dioxide ay CO2: isang carbon at dalawang oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang pormula sa carbon dioxide mao ang CO2: usa ka carbon ug duha ka oksiheno.

q: What is the difference between an endemic species and a native species?
options: An endemic species is found only in one place, while a native species is naturally present but also found elsewhere
An endemic species was brought by humans, while a native species evolved there on its own
An endemic species is endangered, while a native species is not threatened
An endemic species lives only in water, while a native species can live on land or water
explanation: An endemic species exists only in a single specific location, whereas a native species is naturally found there but also occurs in other places.
fact_tl: Ang endemic species ay makikita lamang sa iisang lugar; ang native species ay likas na naroroon ngunit matatagpuan din sa ibang lugar; ang introduced species ay dinala ng tao mula sa ibang lugar at maaaring maging invasive.
fact_bis: Ang endemic species makita lamang sa usa ka lugar; ang native species natural nga anaa apan makita usab sa ubang lugar; ang introduced species gidala sa mga tawo gikan sa ubang lugar ug mahimong mahimong invasive.

q: According to Charles's law, what happens to the volume of a gas when its temperature increases (at constant pressure)?
options: The volume increases
The volume decreases
The volume stays the same
The volume first increases then quickly decreases
explanation: Charles's law states that at constant pressure, the volume of a gas increases as its temperature rises.
fact_tl: Ayon sa batas ni Charles, kapag pare-pareho ang presyon, lumalawak ang volume ng isang gas habang tumataas ang temperatura nito.
fact_bis: Sumala sa balaod ni Charles, kon parehas ang presyur, mosangkad ang volume sa usa ka gas samtang motaas ang temperatura niini.

q: What causes the 'diamond ring' effect seen just before a total solar eclipse?
options: The last ray of sunlight passing through a valley on the Moon's edge before the Sun is fully covered
Sunlight reflecting off the Moon's smooth surface as it moves in front of the Sun
Light from the corona of the Sun spreading around the edges of the Moon
The Moon's thin atmosphere bending the last rays of sunlight into a ring shape
explanation: Baily's beads are rays of sunlight passing through valleys on the Moon's edge; the very last remaining ray creates the 'diamond ring' effect just before totality.
fact_tl: Ang Baily's beads ay mga sinag ng araw na dumadaan sa mga lambak sa gilid ng Moon bago maabot ang totality ng solar eclipse; ang huling sinag na natitira ay lumilikha ng 'diamond ring' effect bago ganap na matakpan ang Araw.
fact_bis: Ang Baily's beads mga sinag sa adlaw nga moagi sa mga lambak sa kilid sa Moon dili pa maabot ang totality sa solar eclipse; ang katapusan nga nabilin nga sinag nagmugna sa 'diamond ring' effect sa dili pa ganap nga matakpan ang Adlaw.

q: In Philippine rainforests, where does the tarsier live compared to the Philippine eagle?
options: The tarsier lives in the understory while the Philippine eagle hunts from the canopy
The tarsier lives in the canopy while the Philippine eagle hunts at ground level
Both the tarsier and the Philippine eagle live in the same canopy layer
The tarsier lives on the forest floor while the Philippine eagle nests in the understory
explanation: In Philippine rainforests, the tarsier is found in the understory layer while the Philippine eagle hunts from the higher canopy layer.
fact_tl: Sa gubat ng Pilipinas, ang tarsier ay namumuhay sa understory habang ang Philippine eagle ay nangangaso mula sa canopy.
fact_bis: Sa lasang sa Pilipinas, ang tarsier nagpuyo sa understory samtang ang Philippine eagle nangayam gikan sa canopy.

q: How does distillation separate a liquid mixture into a purer substance?
options: The mixture is heated until the substance with the lower boiling point evaporates, then the vapor is cooled back into liquid
The mixture is filtered through a fine cloth that blocks one substance but lets the other pass
The mixture is frozen so one substance becomes solid and the other stays liquid
The mixture is stirred vigorously until the two substances naturally separate into layers
explanation: In distillation, heating causes the substance with the lower boiling point to evaporate first; cooling the vapor then produces a purer liquid.
fact_tl: Sa distilasyon, pinainit ang isang halo hanggang sumingaw ang sangkap na may mas mababang punto ng pagkulo, at pinalalamig muli ang singaw upang makuhang malinis na likido.
fact_bis: Sa distillation, init-an ang sagol hangtod moalisngaw ang sangkap nga ubos ang boiling point, dayon pabugnawon ang alisngaw aron mahimong mas limpyo nga likido.

q: What was the Big Bang actually, according to scientists?
options: The stretching of space itself everywhere at once
A massive explosion that happened inside existing space
A collision between two very large galaxies long ago
The moment the first stars exploded and lit up the universe
explanation: The Big Bang was not an ordinary explosion inside space but rather the expansion of space itself, happening everywhere at the same time.
fact_tl: Ang Big Bang ay hindi isang pagsabog sa loob ng espasyo, kundi paglawak mismo ng espasyo sa bawat bahagi nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Ang Big Bang dili usa ka pagbuto sulod sa espasyo, kondili ang paglapad mismo sa espasyo sa tanang dapit dungan.

q: What is the capital of Bulacan province in the Philippines?
options: Malolos
San Jose del Monte
Meycauayan
Calumpit
explanation: Bulacan is a province in the Central Luzon region (Region III), and its capital city is Malolos.
fact_tl: Ang Bulacan ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Central Luzon (III), na bahagi ng Luzon. Ang kabisera nito ay Malolos.
fact_bis: Ang Bulacan usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Central Luzon (III), nga bahin sa Luzon. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Malolos.

q: How do trees help reduce the gases that cause global warming?
options: They pull carbon dioxide out of the air and store the carbon in their trunks and branches
They produce oxygen that neutralizes the greenhouse gases in the atmosphere
They create shade that cools the ground and stops heat from building up
They absorb rainwater that would otherwise flood areas and release warm air
explanation: Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the air and store the carbon in their wood, helping to reduce the amount of this warming gas in the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Sumisipsip ang mga puno ng carbon dioxide mula sa hangin at itinatabi ang carbon sa kanilang katawan at sanga — kaya ang pagtatanim ng puno ay tumutulong bawasan ang gas na nagpapainit sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy mosuyop og carbon dioxide gikan sa hangin ug magtipig sa carbon sa ilang lawas ug sanga — busa ang pagtanom og kahoy makatabang sa pagpakunhod sa gas nga makapainit sa kalibotan.

q: How do tarsiers communicate with each other?
options: Using very high-pitched sounds that people can barely hear
By releasing a strong scent from glands near their tail
By tapping patterns on tree branches with their fingers
Using low rumbling sounds that travel through the ground
explanation: Tarsiers communicate using very high-pitched sounds that are at a frequency most humans can barely detect.
fact_tl: Nag-uusap ang mga tarsier gamit ang napakatinis na tunog na halos hindi marinig ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang mga tarsier magsinultihay gamit ang hilabihan ka tilian nga tunog nga halos dili madungog sa tawo.

q: What shape does a bird's wing have that helps it fly?
options: Curved on top and flatter on the bottom
Flat on both sides like a board
Curved on the bottom and flat on top
Equally curved on both the top and the bottom
explanation: A bird's wing is curved on top and flatter on the bottom, and this shape causes air moving over the wing to lift the bird upward.
fact_tl: Ang pakpak ng ibon ay may espesyal na hubog—curved sa itaas at patag sa ibaba—na tumutulong sa hanging umangat ito (lift) habang lumilipad.
fact_bis: Ang pako sa langgam adunay espesyal nga korte—kurbado sa ibabaw ug patag sa ilawom—nga motabang sa hangin nga moalsa niini samtang molupad.

q: How does carbon move from plants into animals?
options: When an animal eats a plant, carbon from the plant moves into the animal's body
When a plant releases oxygen, nearby animals absorb the carbon left behind
When an animal breathes near a plant, the plant passes carbon through the air
When rain washes carbon from plant leaves into the soil where animals drink
explanation: Carbon travels through the food chain when animals eat plants, transferring the carbon stored in plant matter into the animal's body.
fact_tl: Kapag kumakain ng halaman ang hayop, lumilipat ang karbon mula sa halaman patungo sa katawan ng hayop. Kaya dumadaloy ang karbon sa buong food chain.
fact_bis: Kon ang hayop mokaon ug tanom, ang karbon mobalhin gikan sa tanom ngadto sa lawas sa hayop. Mao kini ang paagi sa pag-agos sa karbon sa tibuok food chain.

q: What is Romblon province in the Philippines famous for producing?
options: High-quality marble used for sculptures and building floors
The largest gold deposits found in Southeast Asia
Rare volcanic rocks used in scientific research
The finest limestone caves in the entire country
explanation: Romblon province is famous for its high-quality marble, which is exported worldwide and used for sculptures, decorations, and building floors.
fact_tl: Ang probinsya ng Romblon sa Pilipinas ay kilala sa produksyon ng mataas na kalidad na marmol (marble); ang marmol ng Romblon ay eksportado sa buong mundo at ginagamit sa paggawa ng mga eskultura, palamuti, at sahig ng mga gusali.
fact_bis: Ang probinsya sa Romblon sa Pilipinas bantog sa paghimo sa taas nga kalidad nga marmol; ang marmol sa Romblon gi-eksport sa tibuok kalibutan ug gigamit sa mga eskultura, dekorasyon, ug sahig sa gusali.

q: In a science lab, a student needs to express how much solute is dissolved in a solution. What does molarity measure?
options: The number of moles of solute dissolved in one liter of solution
The total mass of solute in grams per 100 mL of solution
The number of molecules of solvent per kilogram of solute
The percentage of solute by volume in the solution
explanation: Molarity is defined as the number of moles of solute dissolved in one liter of solution and is the standard lab measure of concentration.
fact_tl: Ang molarity ay ang dami ng solute (sa moles) na nakasolve sa isang liter ng solusyon — ito ang karaniwang paraan ng pagsasalita ng konsentrasyon ng mga kemikal sa laboratoryo.
fact_bis: Ang molarity mao ang dami sa solute (sa moles) nga natunaw sa usa ka liter sa solusyon; kini ang naandan nga paagi sa pagpahayag sa konsentrasyon sa mga kemikal nga solusyon sa laboratory.

q: Two balls collide and bounce apart with almost no energy lost. What is this type of collision called?
options: Inelastic collision
Elastic collision
Destructive collision
Frictional collision
explanation: In an elastic collision, objects bounce apart and the total kinetic energy stays the same before and after the collision.
fact_tl: Sa isang elastikong banggaan, ang mga bagay ay tumatalbog nang halos walang nawawalang enerhiya ng galaw, kaya ang kabuuang kinetic energy ay nananatiling pareho bago at pagkatapos.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka elastik nga banggaan, ang mga butang molukso palayo nga halos walay nawala nga kusog sa paglihok, busa ang kinatibuk-ang kinetic energy magpabilin nga parehas antes ug human.

q: Which type of wall in a building carries the weight of the floors and roof above it?
options: Partition wall
Curtain wall
Load-bearing wall
Decorative wall
explanation: Load-bearing walls carry the weight of the floors and roof above and must not be removed without first supporting that weight another way.
fact_tl: Ang mga load-bearing na dingding ay nagdadala ng timbang ng mga sahig at bubong sa itaas nito — hindi dapat tanggalin ang mga ito nang hindi muna sinusuportahan ang timbang sa ibang paraan.
fact_bis: Ang mga load-bearing wall nagdala sa timbang sa mga sahig ug bubong sa ibabaw niini — dili kini kuhaon nang dili una masuportahan ang maong timbang sa laing paraan.

q: Some flying fish glide using only their large front fins, while others also have large pelvic fins. What are these two kinds called?
options: Two-finned and six-finned flying fish
Two-winged and four-winged flying fish
Single-gliders and double-gliders
Fast-fin and slow-fin flying fish
explanation: Some flying fish are 'two-winged' with only large front fins, while others are 'four-winged' with large pelvic fins too, giving them four wing-like fins.
fact_tl: May mga flying fish na 'two-winged' na malaki lang ang harap na palikpik, at may 'four-winged' na malaki rin ang palikpik sa pelvis kaya parang apat ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Naa'y flying fish nga 'two-winged' nga dagko ra ang atubangan nga kapay, ug naa'y 'four-winged' nga dagko sab ang kapay sa pelvis maong daw upat ang pako.

q: Some animals go into a very deep sleep during winter to save energy when food is hard to find. What is this called?
options: Migration
Camouflage
Hibernation
Molting
explanation: Hibernation is a deep, sleep-like state some animals enter during winter to save energy when food is scarce.
fact_tl: Ang hibernation ay isang mahimbing na tulog na ginagawa ng ilang hayop sa taglamig para makatipid ng lakas kapag kulang ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang hibernation usa ka lawom nga matulog nga ginabuhat sa pipila ka mananap sa tingtugnaw aron makatipig og kusog kon nihit ang pagkaon.

q: How do bees turn nectar into honey?
options: They mix nectar with pollen and heat it in the sun
They collect nectar, store it, and fan it with their wings to thicken it
They chew nectar until it hardens inside their stomachs
They filter nectar through special honeycombs without any fanning
explanation: Bees collect sweet nectar from flowers, store it, and fan it with their wings to thicken it into honey, which feeds the whole colony.
fact_tl: Kinukuha ng bubuyog ang matamis na nectar mula sa mga bulaklak, iniimbak ito, at pinapaypayan gamit ang kanilang pakpak para palaputin tungo sa pulot. Ito ang pagkain ng kolonya sa bahay-pukyutan.
fact_bis: Manguha ang mga buyog og tam-is nga nectar gikan sa mga bulak, tipigan kini, ug paypayan gamit ang ilang pako aron pabagaon ngadto sa dugos. Ang dugos maoy pagkaon sa tibuok kolonya sa balay-putyukan.

q: What gas is produced when baking soda and vinegar are mixed together?
options: Oxygen gas
Nitrogen gas
Carbon-dioxide gas
Hydrogen gas
explanation: When baking soda and vinegar are mixed, a chemical reaction takes place and the bubbles produced are carbon-dioxide gas.
fact_tl: Kapag pinaghalo ang baking soda at suka, bumubula ito nang malakas. Ang bula ay carbon dioxide na gas na nabubuo mula sa chemical reaction ng dalawa.
fact_bis: Kon isagol ang baking soda ug suka, mobula kini og kusog. Ang bula kay carbon-dioxide nga gas nga maporma gikan sa chemical reaction sa duha.

q: Why is a bruised or cut fruit more risky to eat than a fruit with perfect skin?
options: Bruised fruit loses all its vitamins immediately
Microbes can enter through damaged skin where washing can no longer reach them
The flesh of bruised fruit becomes toxic even before microbes arrive
Washing removes the outer skin and exposes the fruit to more bacteria
explanation: When fruit skin has a bruise, scrape, or hole, microbes can enter the flesh inside where surface washing can no longer reach them.
fact_tl: Kapag may pasa, gasgas, o butas ang balat ng prutas, mas madaling makapasok ang mikrobyo papunta sa laman sa loob. Doon ay hindi na sila maaabot ng paghuhugas sa ibabaw, kaya mas mainam putulin ang sirang bahagi o iwasan ang labis na sirang prutas.
fact_bis: Kung adunay pasa, gasgas, o lungag ang panit sa prutas, mas dali makasulod ang mikrobyo ngadto sa unod sa sulod. Didto dili na sila maabot sa paghugas sa ibabaw, mao nga mas maayo putlon ang nadaot nga bahin o likayan ang grabe nga nadunot nga prutas.

q: Sea otters are unusual because they use rocks as tools. What do they use the rocks for?
options: To build dens under water
To crack open clams and urchins while floating on their backs
To anchor themselves to the seafloor during strong currents
To scrape algae off coral reefs for food
explanation: Sea otters float on their backs with a clam or urchin on their chest and hit it with a rock to break the shell, making them one of the few non-primate tool users.
fact_tl: Ang sea otter ay gumagamit ng mga bato bilang kasangkapan — naglalangoy ito nang nakataob habang pinapalabas ang isang klam o urchin sa tiyan nito at pinukpok ng isang bato upang masira ang shell — isa sa ilang hindi-primate na hayop na gumagamit ng kasangkapan.
fact_bis: Ang sea otter naggamit og mga bato isip kasangkapan — naglangoy kini nga nagatukod sa iyang likod nga adunay clam o urchin sa iyang dughan ug gipukpok kini og bato aron masira ang shell — usa sa pipila ka mga hayop nga dili primate nga naggamit og kasangkapan.

q: What is the acceleration due to gravity on Earth's surface?
options: About 6.7 meters per second squared
About 9.8 meters per second squared
About 11.2 meters per second squared
About 3.7 meters per second squared
explanation: The acceleration due to Earth's gravity (g) is about 9.8 meters per second squared (9.8 m/s²).
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng pagbilis dahil sa grabidad ng Earth (g) ay humigit-kumulang 9.8 metro kada segundo kuwadrado (9.8 m/s²).
fact_bis: Ang kapaspas sa pagkahulog tungod sa grabidad sa Earth (g) mga 9.8 ka metro kada segundo kuwadrado (9.8 m/s²).

q: A siren sounds higher-pitched as an ambulance drives toward you and lower-pitched as it drives away. What effect explains this?
options: The echo effect
The resonance effect
The Doppler effect
The interference effect
explanation: The Doppler effect describes how the observed frequency of a wave changes due to relative motion: pitch is higher when source and observer approach and lower when they move apart.
fact_tl: Sa Doppler effect, nagbabago ang naoobserbahang frequency ng alon dahil sa relatibong galaw ng pinagmumulan at ng tagamasid: mas mataas ang pitch kapag papalapit at mas mababa kapag papalayo.
fact_bis: Sa Doppler effect, mausab ang nakit-an nga frequency sa balod tungod sa relatibo nga paglihok sa tinubdan ug sa tagpaniid: mas taas ang pitch kung magkaduol ug mas ubos kung magkalayo.

q: What is the first thing you should do to stop bleeding from a wound?
options: Rinse the wound with cold water and wait for it to stop
Apply a clean cloth and press firmly on the wound for several minutes
Tie a tight band around the whole arm to cut off blood flow
Put ice directly on the wound and elevate it immediately
explanation: To stop bleeding, you apply a clean cloth and press firmly on the wound for several minutes to allow blood clotting to begin.
fact_tl: Upang ihinto ang pagdurugo mula sa isang sugat, ang tamang paraan ay ang paglalagay ng malinis na tela at pagpindot nang mahigpit sa sugat habang ang sugat ay naghihintay ng medikal na tulong.
fact_bis: Aron mapahunong ang pagdugo gikan sa sugat, ipatong ang usa ka limpyo nga tela ug pinduton ug kusog ang sugat; padayon ang padayon nga presyon sulod sa pipila ka minuto aron magsugod ang blood clotting.

q: Taal Volcano is found inside a large lake on the island of Luzon. In which province is it located?
options: Laguna
Cavite
Batangas
Rizal
explanation: Taal Volcano is located in Batangas and is surrounded by Taal Lake, making it one of the most hazardous and well-known volcanoes in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Taal Volcano sa Batangas ay isa sa pinakamalalakas na mapanganib na bulkan sa Pilipinas at sikat din dahil nakapaligid ito ng Lawa ng Taal at may isla sa gitna nito.
fact_bis: Ang Taal Volcano sa Batangas usa sa pinaka-mapanganib nga mga bulkan sa Pilipinas ug sikat usab tungod nga napalibutan kini sa Lawa sa Taal nga adunay isla sa taliwala niini.

q: Why is it safe to experiment with batteries but NOT with electricity from a house outlet?
options: Batteries produce alternating current while outlets produce direct current
Battery electricity is weak, but house outlet electricity is very strong and dangerous
Outlets are safe as long as your hands are dry, but batteries are always risky
Batteries run out quickly making them safe, while outlets never run out
explanation: Battery electricity is weak and safe for experiments, but house outlet electricity is very strong and dangerous — never use it for experiments.
fact_tl: Ligtas mag-eksperimento gamit ang baterya dahil mahina ang kuryente nito. Pero ang kuryente sa saksakan ng bahay ay napakalakas at delikado — huwag itong gamitin sa eksperimento at iwasang hawakan ng basang kamay.
fact_bis: Luwas mag-eksperimento gamit ang baterya kay huyang ang kuryente niini. Apan ang kuryente gikan sa saksakan sa balay kay kusgan kaayo ug delikado — ayaw kini gamita sa eksperimento ug likayi ang paghikap niini gamit ang basa nga kamot.

q: Why does ice float on liquid water instead of sinking?
options: Ice is heavier than water so it pushes up to the surface
Water expands when it freezes, making ice less dense than liquid water
Ice contains trapped air bubbles that always make it float
Frozen water has a higher density than liquid water
explanation: Water expands slightly and gets lighter when it freezes, making ice less dense than liquid water, so it floats.
fact_tl: Ang yelo ay lumulutang sa tubig dahil bahagyang lumalaki at gumagaan ito kapag namuo, kaya mas mababa ang densidad nito.
fact_bis: Ang yelo magalutaw sa tubig kay ang tubig molapad og gamay ug mogaan kon mamuo, busa mas ubos ang densidad sa yelo.

q: A person infected with leptospirosis needs to see a doctor right away. What medicine is used to treat this disease?
options: Antiviral drugs
Antifungal cream
Antibiotics
Antihistamines
explanation: Leptospirosis is a bacterial disease treated with antibiotics, so seeing a doctor right away is very important.
fact_tl: Ginagamot ang leptospirosis sa pamamagitan ng antibiotiko, kaya mahalagang magpatingin agad sa doktor.
fact_bis: Ang leptospirosis tambalan pinaagi sa antibiotiko, busa importante nga magpatan-aw dayon sa doktor.

q: Like phytoplankton, algae can also produce oxygen through which process?
options: Respiration
Fermentation
Photosynthesis
Decomposition
explanation: Algae produce oxygen through photosynthesis, just like phytoplankton do.
fact_tl: Ang algae ay gumagawa rin ng oxygen sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, tulad ng ginagawa ng phytoplankton.
fact_bis: Ang algae naghimo usab og oksiheno pinaagi sa potosintesis, sama sa gibuhat sa phytoplankton.

q: How does a Rafflesia flower in the Philippines help local communities?
options: Its large petals are harvested and sold as medicine worldwide
It attracts tourists who want to see it, bringing income and a reason to protect the forest
It produces edible fruit that feeds people in surrounding villages
It releases a scent that repels pests from nearby farms
explanation: Rafflesia draws tourists in parts of the Philippines and nearby countries, bringing income to local communities and giving people a reason to protect the forest.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas at karatig-bansa, ang Rafflesia ay isang dahilan kung bakit dumadayo ang mga turista para makita ito. Nagbibigay ito ng kita sa mga komunidad at nagiging dahilan para ingatan ang gubat.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka lugar sa Pilipinas ug silingang nasud, ang Rafflesia maoy hinungdan nganong moadto ang mga turista aron makita kini. Naghatag kini og kita sa mga komunidad ug nahimong rason aron amping-an ang lasang.

q: Why can strong radiation such as gamma rays be dangerous to people?
options: Gamma rays cool body tissue rapidly and cause frostbite
Strong radiation can damage the body's cells, especially the DNA
Gamma rays replace oxygen in the air, causing suffocation
Strong radiation makes metals in the body attract magnets
explanation: Strong radiation, especially gamma rays with lots of exposure, can damage the body's cells and particularly the DNA, which is why protective gear is needed.
fact_tl: Bakit minsan delikado ang radiation? Ang malakas na radiation (lalo na ang gamma at maraming exposure) ay maaaring makasira sa mga cell ng katawan, lalo na sa DNA. Kaya naka-protective gear ang mga nagtatrabaho dito. Pero ang konting natural na radiation sa paligid ay ligtas — ang dami at tagal ng exposure ang mahalaga.
fact_bis: Ngano nga usahay delikado ang radiation? Ang kusgan nga radiation (ilabi na ang gamma ug daghan nga exposure) makadaot sa mga cell sa lawas, ilabi na sa DNA. Mao nga ang mga trabahante nagsul-ob og protective gear. Apan ang gamay nga natural nga radiation sa atong palibot luwas — ang gidaghanon ug gidugayon sa exposure ang importante.

q: Why is oil placed between gear teeth in a machine?
options: To cool the metal and prevent it from melting at high speed
To reduce friction and wear so gears last longer and the machine runs smoothly
To increase the speed of the gears by making them heavier
To prevent the gears from slipping by making them sticky
explanation: Oil placed between gear teeth reduces friction and wear so the gears last longer and the machine runs smoothly.
fact_tl: Ang langis na inilalagay sa pagitan ng mga ngipin ng gear ay nagbabawas ng kiskisan at pagkagasgas para manatiling maayos ang pagtakbo ng makina.
fact_bis: Ang langis nga gibutang sa taliwala sa mga ngipin sa gear nagpababa sa kiskisan ug paggasgas aron mas dugay mabuhi ang mga gear ug maayos ang pagdagan sa makina.

q: What mineral found in the black sand on some Philippine beaches can be attracted by a magnet?
options: Quartz
Calcite
Magnetite
Feldspar
explanation: The black sand on some Philippine beaches contains an iron mineral called magnetite that a magnet attracts.
fact_tl: Ang itim na buhangin sa ilang baybayin ng Pilipinas ay may bakal na tinatawag na magnetite na naaakit ng magneto.
fact_bis: Ang itom nga balas sa pipila ka baybayon sa Pilipinas adunay puthaw nga gitawag og magnetite nga madani sa magneto.

q: In the nitrogen cycle, which process returns nitrogen gas back into the air from nitrate in the soil?
options: Nitrification
Nitrogen fixation
Denitrification
Ammonification
explanation: In denitrification, certain bacteria convert nitrate back into nitrogen gas, returning it to the air.
fact_tl: Sa denitrification, ibinabalik ng ilang bakterya ang nitrate sa anyong nitroheno gas pabalik sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sa denitrification, gibalik sa ubang bakterya ang nitrate ngadto sa nitrogen gas balik sa hangin.

q: Who invented the stethoscope, and in what year?
options: William Harvey in 1628
Rene Laennec in 1816
Louis Pasteur in 1860
Florence Nightingale in 1854
explanation: Rene Laennec invented the stethoscope in 1816 to listen to the heartbeat.
fact_tl: Si Rene Laennec ang nag-imbento ng stethoscope (estetoskopyo) noong 1816 para makinig sa tibok ng puso.
fact_bis: Si Rene Laennec ang nag-imbento sa stethoscope (estetoskopyo) niadtong 1816 aron mamati sa pitik sa kasingkasing.

q: How can some mother pythons keep their eggs warm even though they are cold-blooded?
options: They coil around the eggs and rely on their body fat to release heat slowly
They rapidly twitch their muscles, almost like shivering, to generate heat
They bury the eggs in warm mud and return to check on them daily
They move the eggs to sunny spots throughout the day to absorb sunlight
explanation: Even though a python is cold-blooded, some mother pythons can warm their eggs by rapidly twitching their muscles, almost like shivering.
fact_tl: Kahit malamig ang dugo ng sawa, kaya ng ilang inang sawa na painitin ang kanilang itlog sa pamamagitan ng mabilis na pangangatal ng mga kalamnan, na parang nanginginig sa lamig.
fact_bis: Bisan bugnaw ug dugo ang sawa, ang ubang inahan nga sawa makapainit sa ilang mga itlog pinaagi sa paspas nga pagkurog sa kaunoran, nga morag nagkurog sa katugnaw.

q: Why do fingerprints show up on shiny stainless steel surfaces like a fridge door?
options: The steel reacts with skin chemicals and forms a permanent brown stain
Oil and sweat from our fingers stick to the smooth surface, leaving visible smudges
The steel is slightly rough and skin cells get trapped in tiny grooves
The cold temperature of the fridge causes moisture from fingers to freeze on contact
explanation: Fingerprints on stainless steel are simply oil and sweat from our fingers sticking to the smooth surface; they are not rust and wipe off easily with cloth and soap.
fact_tl: Napansin mo bang madalas may bakas ng daliri sa makintab na stainless steel tulad ng pinto ng ref? Hindi ito kalawang kundi dulot lang ng konting langis at pawis mula sa ating mga daliri na dumidikit sa makinis na ibabaw. Madali itong matanggal sa pamamagitan ng basahan at kaunting sabon.
fact_bis: Namatikdan ba nimo nga kanunay adunay marka sa tudlo sa sinaw nga stainless steel sama sa pultahan sa ref? Dili kana kalawang kondili gamay lang nga lana ug singot gikan sa atong mga tudlo nga motapot sa hamis nga ibabaw. Dali ra kini mapahid pinaagi sa trapo ug gamay nga sabon.

q: Why do wood and cork float on water?
options: Wood and cork are attracted upward by the surface of water
Their density is less than water's density because they have tiny air-filled spaces
They are waterproof materials that always push water away
Wood and cork are lighter than air, making any liquid unable to hold them down
explanation: Wood and cork float because their density is less than the 1 g/cm³ density of water; wood has many tiny air-filled spaces that lower its average density.
fact_tl: Ang kahoy at cork ay lumulutang sa tubig dahil ang densidad nila ay mas mababa kaysa 1 g/cm3 na densidad ng tubig. Ang kahoy ay may maraming maliliit na butas na puno ng hangin, na nagpapalaan ng densidad nito.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy ug cork mulutaw sa tubig tungod kay ang densidad nila ubos sa 1 g/cm3 nga densidad sa tubig. Ang kahoy adunay daghang gagmayng espasyo nga puno sa hangin, nga nagpaubos sa average density niini.

q: An armadillo has a hard armor-like shell on its body. What type of animal is it?
options: A reptile, because of its hard outer shell
A mammal, because it has some hair on its body
An amphibian, because it can live on land and near water
A fish, because its scales evolved into hard plates
explanation: Even with its hard armor, the armadillo is a mammal and has a little hair on its body, not a reptile.
fact_tl: Kahit may matigas itong baluti, ang armadillo ay mammal at hindi reptilya, at may kaunting buhok ito sa katawan.
fact_bis: Bisan adunay gahi nga baluti, ang armadillo usa ka mammal ug dili reptilya, ug aduna kini gamay nga balhibo sa lawas.

q: Mangroves grow along Philippine coasts where the water is salty. What makes their roots special?
options: Their roots grow downward very fast to reach fresh groundwater below the salt
Their roots can survive in salty seawater, unlike roots of most other plants
Their roots filter out salt and store it in their leaves, which fall off seasonally
Their roots float on the surface so salt water never touches them
explanation: Mangroves along Philippine coasts have special roots that can survive in salty seawater.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan (mangrove) sa baybayin ng Pilipinas ay may espesyal na ugat na nakakatagal sa maalat na tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang bakawan sa baybayon sa Pilipinas adunay espesyal nga gamot nga makaagwanta sa parat nga tubig-dagat.

q: Which inventor greatly improved the steam engine?
options: Thomas Edison
Nikola Tesla
James Watt
Benjamin Franklin
explanation: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine, which helped power the Industrial Revolution.
fact_tl: Pinaunlad ni James Watt ang steam engine (makinang pinapaandar ng singaw).
fact_bis: Gipalambo pag-ayo ni James Watt ang steam engine (makina nga gipalihok sa aso).

q: The Philippines has no large desert, yet it has sand dunes. Where are the La Paz Sand Dunes found?
options: Batanes
Ilocos Norte
Palawan
Sorsogon
explanation: Even though the Philippines has no large desert, it has sand dunes such as the La Paz Sand Dunes in Ilocos Norte, shaped by coastal wind.
fact_tl: Kahit walang malaking disyerto ang Pilipinas, may mga sand dune tayo gaya ng La Paz Sand Dunes sa Ilocos Norte na hinubog ng hangin sa tabing-dagat.
fact_bis: Bisan walay dako nga disyerto ang Pilipinas, naa tay sand dunes sama sa La Paz Sand Dunes sa Ilocos Norte nga gihulma sa hangin sa baybayon.

q: The Sargasso Sea is unique among all seas on Earth. What makes it different from other seas?
options: It is the only sea that lies entirely within a freshwater lake
It is the only sea with no land boundary — it is defined by four surrounding ocean currents
It is the only sea that has no fish living in it at all
It is the only sea that completely freezes over every winter
explanation: The Sargasso Sea in the Atlantic is the only sea with no land boundary — it is defined by four surrounding ocean currents and hosts vast floating sargassum seaweed.
fact_tl: Ang Sargasso Sea sa Atlantiko ay natatanging karagatan na walang land boundary — ito ay napapaligiran lamang ng apat na ocean current; ito ang kinabibilangan ng napakaraming floating sargassum seaweed at ang pinanggalingan ng American at European eels.
fact_bis: Ang Sargasso Sea sa Atlantiko ang bugtong dagat nga walay land boundary — gihulagway lamang kini sa upat ka naglibot nga ocean current; nagdala kini sa dako kaayong kantidad sa nagutay-utay nga sargassum seaweed ug mao ang breeding ground sa American ug European nga mga igat.

q: Mount Apo is the highest mountain in the Philippines. What kind of mountain is it?
options: A fold mountain formed by colliding tectonic plates
A large dormant stratovolcano on Mindanao
An active shield volcano on Luzon
A mountain formed by erosion on Visayas
explanation: Mount Apo is a large dormant volcano (a stratovolcano) located on Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Bundok Apo ay isang malaking tulog na bulkan (stratovolcano) sa Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang Bukid Apo usa ka dako nga natulog nga bulkan (stratovolcano) sa Mindanao.

q: A person with astigmatism sees blurry images. Which part of the eye causes this?
options: The retina becomes too thick and blocks incoming light
The eye's lens or cornea is uneven, so the image formed is not sharp
The pupil is too large and lets in too much light at once
The optic nerve sends scrambled signals to the brain
explanation: Astigmatism is like a warped camera lens — the eye's 'lens' is uneven, so the image it forms is not sharp.
fact_tl: Isipin ang mata na parang kamera. Kung baluktot o hindi pantay ang lente ng kamera, magiging malabo ang litrato. Ganoon din sa astigmatism — hindi pantay ang 'lente' ng mata kaya hindi malinaw ang larawang nabubuo.
fact_bis: Hunahunaa ang mata sama sa usa ka kamera. Kung ang lente sa kamera baliko o dili patag, mahimong hanap ang litrato. Ingon ana usab ang astigmatism — dili patag ang 'lente' sa mata maong dili klaro ang hulagway nga maporma.

q: When decomposers break down waste in places with no oxygen, like a swamp or landfill, what gas do they release?
options: Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen
Methane
explanation: When there is no oxygen, decomposers release methane, a flammable gas — which is why some rotting places smell and why biogas can be made from waste.
fact_tl: Kapag walang oxygen ang paligid — gaya sa ilalim ng latian o sa loob ng tambakan ng basura — iba ang inilalabas ng mga decomposers: methane, isang gas na nasusunog. Kaya may amoy ang ilang lugar na nabubulok, at kaya rin nakakagawa ng biogas mula sa basura.
fact_bis: Kon walay oxygen ang palibot — sama sa ilawom sa lamakan o sulod sa tinapok nga basura — lahi ang gigawas sa mga decomposers: methane, usa ka gas nga masunog. Mao nga adunay baho ang pipila ka nagkadunot nga dapit, ug mao usab nga makahimo og biogas gikan sa basura.

q: Which plants lose the most water through transpiration?
options: Plants with very thick, waxy leaves and few stomata
Plants with larger or more leaves
Plants that grow in cold, dry climates with very short stems
Plants that have deep roots reaching underground water sources
explanation: Plants with larger or more leaves lose more water through transpiration.
fact_tl: Ang mga halamang may malalaki at maraming dahon ay nawawalan ng mas maraming tubig sa transpirasyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nga adunay dagko o daghang dahon mawad-an og mas daghang tubig sa transpiration.

q: Why is the air near the floor usually cooler than the air near the ceiling of a room?
options: The floor absorbs all the heat from the air and keeps it cold
Cool air is denser and sinks to the bottom while warm air rises
The ceiling is closer to the sun so it absorbs more heat
Windows near the floor let in cold outside air continuously
explanation: Cool air sinks to the bottom because it is denser, while warm air rises — that is why your feet feel cold even when the top of the room is warm.
fact_tl: Mas malamig ang hangin malapit sa sahig kaysa sa itaas dahil bumababa at lumulubog ang malamig na hangin. Kaya minsan malamig ang paa mo kahit init sa taas ng kwarto.
fact_bis: Mas bugnaw ang hangin duol sa salog kaysa sa taas tungod kay mokunsad ug molunod ang bugnaw nga hangin sa ubos. Mao nga usahay bugnaw ang imong tiil bisan init sa taas sa kwarto.

q: What happens when sugar is heated above about 160 degrees Celsius?
options: It evaporates into water vapor without changing color or smell
It turns into brown caramel with a new flavor and smell in an irreversible chemical change
It melts into a clear liquid but can be returned to solid sugar by cooling
It crystallizes into larger sugar crystals with no change in color
explanation: Caramelization occurs when sugar is heated above about 160°C, changing it into brown caramel with a new flavor and smell — an irreversible chemical change.
fact_tl: Ang caramelization ay nangyayari kapag ang asukal ay pinainit nang higit sa 160°C, na nagbabago nito sa kayumanggi na caramel na may bagong lasa at amoy.
fact_bis: Ang caramelization mahitabo kon ang asukal i-init nga mas taas sa mga 160°C, nagbag-o niini ngadto sa kayumanggi nga caramel nga adunay bag-ong lasa ug bango — usa ka dili mabali nga chemical change.

q: How do dogs help protect a home?
options: They patrol the yard silently and attack any strangers on sight
They bark when a stranger or unusual noise appears
They store food in hidden places to attract small animals away from the house
They sleep in front of doors to block strangers from entering
explanation: Many dogs guard the home and bark when a stranger or unusual noise appears, alerting the people inside.
fact_tl: Maraming aso ang nagbabantay sa bahay at tumatahol kapag may estranghero o kakaibang ingay.
fact_bis: Daghang iro ang nagbantay sa balay ug mag-usig kung adunay estranyo o talagsaong saba.

q: Why does a sloth move so slowly?
options: Sloths are afraid of falling and move slowly to stay safe in the trees
Sloths have a very slow metabolism and get little energy from the leaves they eat
Sloths are heavy animals whose weight prevents them from moving quickly
Sloths sleep 23 hours a day and are always half asleep when they move
explanation: A sloth moves slowly because it has a very slow metabolism and gets little energy from the leaves it eats.
fact_tl: Mabagal kumilos ang sloth dahil mababa ang metabolismo nito at kakaunti ang lakas na nakukuha sa kinakaing dahon.
fact_bis: Hinay molihok ang sloth kay ubos ang metabolismo niini ug gamay ra ang kusog nga makuha sa dahon nga gikaon niini.

q: What does a seed need to sprout?
options: Sunlight, plenty of soil nutrients, and warm temperature
Water, enough warmth, and air — but not light until the first leaves appear
A lot of light, dry soil, and cool temperatures below 10 degrees Celsius
Salt water, heat, and fertilizer from the start
explanation: To sprout, a seed needs water, enough warmth, and air — it does not need light until the first leaves appear.
fact_tl: Para tumubo ang binhi, kailangan nito ng tubig, sapat na init, at hangin; hindi kailangan ng liwanag hanggang lumitaw ang dahon.
fact_bis: Aron moturok ang liso, gikinahanglan niini ang tubig, igong kainit, ug hangin, ug dili kini magkinahanglan og kahayag hangtod motungha ang unang dahon.

q: In the Philippines, coconut water is sometimes given to people sick with diarrhea. Why is it helpful?
options: It kills the bacteria causing diarrhea the same way antibiotics do
It helps put back the water and minerals the body lost during illness
It coats the stomach lining to prevent further fluid loss
It is very sweet, which gives sick people extra energy to recover
explanation: Coconut water is given to sick people in some parts of the Philippines because it helps replace the water and minerals the body lost.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas, binibigay ang tubig ng buko sa mga taong may sakit tulad ng pagtatae, dahil tumutulong itong magbalik ng tubig at sustansyang nawala sa katawan.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka lugar sa Pilipinas, ang tubig sa buko ihatag sa mga tawong masakiton sama sa kalibanga, kay motabang kini sa pagbalik sa tubig ug sustansya nga nawala sa lawas.

q: When you turn a screw, what kind of motion does the turning become?
options: A sideways sliding motion across the surface
A forward push into the material
An upward pulling force toward the hand
A back-and-forth vibrating motion inside the wood
explanation: When you turn a screw, its turning motion becomes a forward push into the material, which is how a screw fastens things together.
fact_tl: Kapag iniikot mo ang turnilyo, ang pag-ikot ay nagiging galaw na pasulong papasok sa materyal.
fact_bis: Kung tuyokon nimo ang tornilyo, ang pagtuyok mahimong galihok nga pasulod sa materyal.

q: Why do some lakes become salty over time?
options: Saltwater fish carry ocean salt into the lake through rivers
Lakes with no outlet become salty as water evaporates and leaves the salt behind
Salt from the lake bed slowly dissolves at the same rate water leaves
Rain carries salt from the atmosphere and deposits it in closed lakes
explanation: Lakes with no outlet become salty as water evaporates and leaves the salt behind.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng lawa ay tubig-tabang; ang ilang lawa na walang labasan ng tubig ay nagiging maalat habang sumisingaw ang tubig at naiiwan ang asin.
fact_bis: Dili tanang lanaw kay tubig-tab-ang; ang ubang lanaw nga walay gawasanan mahimong parat samtang nag-alisngaw ang tubig ug nabilin ang asin.

q: How fast does a falling object speed up due to Earth's gravity?
options: It speeds up by about 5.0 meters per second every second
It speeds up by about 9.8 meters per second every second
It speeds up by about 15.0 meters per second every second
It falls at a constant speed of 9.8 meters per second with no change
explanation: An object falling on Earth speeds up by about 9.8 meters per second every second (9.8 m/s²) due to gravity.
fact_tl: Ang isang bagay na nahuhulog sa Earth ay bumibilis nang halos 9.8 metro kada segundo bawat segundo (9.8 m/s²).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka butang nga nahulog sa Yuta mokusog og mga 9.8 ka metro kada segundo matag segundo (9.8 m/s²).

q: How do salt flats form?
options: Glaciers scrape salt out of the ground and deposit it in flat sheets
A saline lake evaporates completely, leaving a flat layer of salt behind
Rivers deposit salt as they slow down and spread across flat plains
Volcanic eruptions release salt-rich steam that settles on the ground
explanation: Salt flats form when a saline lake evaporates completely, leaving a flat layer of salt behind in areas where evaporation exceeds water inflow.
fact_tl: Ang mga salt flat ay nabubuo kapag ang isang saline lake ay sumingaw nang ganap, na nag-iiwan ng isang patag na patong ng asin — ito ay nangyayari kapag ang pagsingaw ay mas mabilis kaysa pagpasok ng ulan o ilog.
fact_bis: Ang mga salt flat nabubuo kon ang usa ka saline lake bug-os masungaw, nagbilin og patag nga layer sa asin; kini mahitabo sa mga lugar diin ang pagkasungaw mas paspas kaysa pagpasulod sa tubig gikan sa ulan o suba.

q: Which of the following is true about moss?
options: Moss produces colorful flowers but has no seeds
Moss is a simple plant with no flowers and no seeds
Moss grows seeds underground instead of on top like other plants
Moss is not a real plant but a type of fungus
explanation: Moss is a simple plant with no flowers and no seeds, but it is still a living plant.
fact_tl: Ang lumot ay isang simpleng halamang walang bulaklak at walang buto, ngunit isa pa rin itong buhay na halaman.
fact_bis: Ang lumot usa ka simpleng tanom nga walay bulak ug walay liso, apan tanom gihapon kini nga buhi.

q: Why do cloud rat populations grow very slowly?
options: Cloud rats only mate once in their lifetime, producing very few offspring total
A cloud rat usually has only one baby per year
Cloud rats abandon most of their young, so only a few survive each season
Cloud rats hibernate for ten months of the year and only reproduce during two months
explanation: A cloud rat usually has only one baby per year, so their numbers grow very slowly.
fact_tl: Karaniwang isang anak lamang ang ipinapanganak ng cloud rat bawat taon, kaya mabagal dumami ang kanilang bilang.
fact_bis: Ang cloud rat kasagaran usa ra ka anak ang mahimugso matag tuig, mao nga hinay kaayo modaghan ang ilang gidaghanon.

q: The pancreas performs two very different jobs in the body. What are they?
options: It filters blood and produces red blood cells
It makes enzymes for digestion and hormones for the blood
It stores bile and pumps it into the stomach during meals
It controls breathing rate and regulates body temperature
explanation: The pancreas has two jobs: it makes enzymes that help with digestion and hormones (like insulin) that regulate the blood.
fact_tl: May dalawang trabaho ang pancreas: gumagawa ito ng enzyme para sa panunaw at hormone para sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang pancreas adunay duha ka buluhaton: maghimo og enzyme para sa paghilis ug hormone para sa dugo.

q: Which list correctly shows the levels of biological classification from broadest to smallest?
options: Kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species
Phylum, kingdom, class, order, genus, family, species
Kingdom, class, phylum, order, family, genus, species
Kingdom, phylum, order, class, genus, family, species
explanation: Scientists classify living things starting from the broadest level (kingdom) down to the most specific (species): kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species.
fact_tl: Inuuri ng mga siyentipiko ang mga nilalang sa mga antas mula sa pinakamalawak hanggang pinakamaliit: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, at species.
fact_bis: Giklasipikar sa mga siyentista ang mga buhi nga binuhat sa mga ang-ang gikan sa pinakalapad ngadto sa pinakagamay: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, ug species.

q: Why is the number of Visayan warty pigs decreasing?
options: Because of hunting and the loss of its forest home
Because of disease spreading from farm pigs
Because food in its habitat has become scarce
Because it cannot reproduce well in captivity
explanation: The Visayan warty pig population is falling due to hunting and the destruction of the forests where it lives.
fact_tl: Bumababa ang bilang ng Visayan warty pig dahil sa pangangaso at pagkawala ng mga gubat na tirahan nito.
fact_bis: Mikunhod ang gidaghanon sa Visayan warty pig tungod sa pagpangayam ug pagkawala sa kalasangan nga iyang puy-anan.

q: Why does a fan make you feel cooler even though it does not lower the air temperature?
options: It blows air across your skin so your sweat evaporates faster, carrying heat away
It pushes cold air from outside the room toward you
It circulates cool air from near the floor up to your face
It removes moisture from the air so the room feels drier
explanation: A fan speeds up sweat evaporation on your skin, and as sweat evaporates it carries heat away from your body, making you feel cooler.
fact_tl: Hindi talaga pinapalamig ng bentilador ang hangin — pinaiihip lang nito ang hangin sa ating balat para mas mabilis sumingaw ang pawis. Kapag sumisingaw ang pawis, dinadala nito ang init palayo, kaya nararamdaman nating presko.
fact_bis: Ang bentilador dili gyud mopabugnaw sa hangin — gihuyop lang niini ang hangin sa atong panit aron mas paspas mosingaw ang singot. Samtang mosingaw ang singot, dad-on niini ang init palayo, maong mobati tag kabugnaw.

q: What unit is used to measure electric current?
options: Ampere (A)
Volt (V)
Ohm (Ω)
Watt (W)
explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes (A), a unit named after the scientist Andre-Marie Ampere.
fact_tl: Ang agos ng kuryente ay sinusukat sa ampere (A), na ipinangalan kay Andre-Marie Ampere.
fact_bis: Ang agos sa koryente gisukod sa ampere (A), nga ginganlan kang Andre-Marie Ampere.

q: An inkjet printer is an example of a compound machine. Which combination of parts makes it one?
options: Motors, gears, belts, and a moving carriage
Springs, levers, wheels, and pulleys
Gears, screws, wedges, and inclined planes
Motors, axles, ramps, and switches
explanation: An inkjet printer uses motors, gears, belts, and a moving carriage together to position the ink head precisely, making it a compound machine.
fact_tl: Ang inkjet printer ay isang compound machine: gumagamit ito ng mga motor, gear, belt, at carriage na naglalabas-masok para malagay ang tamang tinta sa papel.
fact_bis: Ang inkjet printer usa ka compound machine: naggamit kini og mga motor, gear, belt, ug naglihok nga carriage aron tumpakong iposisyon ang ink head sa ibabaw sa papel.

q: At the factory, what happens to a vaccine after the germ has been grown?
options: It is purified, measured into correct doses, and filled into clean vials
It is immediately frozen and shipped directly to hospitals
It is mixed with vitamins and bottled in large containers
It is dried into powder and packed into single-use capsules
explanation: After the germ is grown, the vaccine is purified, measured into correct doses, and filled into clean vials before being shipped to clinics.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos patubuin ang mikrobyo, nililinis ito, sinusukat nang tama, at inilalagay sa malilinis na bote sa pabrika bago ipadala sa mga klinika.
fact_bis: Human matubo ang mikrobyo, limpyohan kini, sukdon sa saktong dosis, ug isulod sa limpyo nga botelya sa pabrika sa dili pa ipadala sa mga klinika.

q: Which object in our solar system has the strongest gravity?
options: The Sun
Jupiter
Saturn
Earth
explanation: The Sun has the strongest gravity in the solar system — about 274 m/s², which is roughly 28 times stronger than Earth's gravity.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ang may pinakamalakas na grabidad sa solar system, halos 274 m/s² — mga 28 beses ng grabidad ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw mao ang adunay pinakakusgan nga grabidad sa solar system, mga 274 m/s² — mga 28 ka pilo sa grabidad sa Yuta.

q: What happens to sugar particles when sugar dissolves in water?
options: They break apart and spread out among the water particles
They sink to the bottom and stay in a clump
They turn into a gas and rise to the surface
They attach to the sides of the container
explanation: When sugar dissolves, its tiny particles break apart and spread out among the water particles.
fact_tl: Sa pagkatunaw, naghihiwa-hiwalay ang napakaliit na piraso ng asukal at kumakalat sa pagitan ng mga piraso ng tubig.
fact_bis: Sa pagkatunaw, ang gagmay nga mga tipik sa asukal magkalat ug mosulod taliwala sa mga tipik sa tubig.

q: How is a coral reef different from a plain rocky reef under the sea?
options: A coral reef is made by living animals that keep growing, while a rocky reef is just dead stone that cannot heal
A rocky reef has more colorful fish than a coral reef
A coral reef is always found in deeper water than a rocky reef
A rocky reef grows faster than a coral reef because it absorbs minerals
explanation: A coral reef is built by living animals whose skeletons keep growing, so it can heal and spread, unlike a plain rocky reef which is just dead stone.
fact_tl: May mga batuhan din sa ilalim ng dagat na pinupuntahan ng isda, pero iba ito sa coral reef. Ang batuhan ay patay na bato lang, samantalang ang coral reef ay gawa ng buhay na hayop na patuloy na lumalaki at gumagawa ng bagong balangkas. Kaya kayang gumaling at lumawak ng coral reef, hindi kayang gawin ng simpleng bato.
fact_bis: Adunay batuhon nga reef usab sa ilalom sa dagat diin magtapok ang mga isda, apan lahi kini sa coral reef. Ang batuhon usa lang ka patay nga bato, samtang ang coral reef hinimo sa buhing mananap nga padayong nagtubo ug naghimo og bag-ong balangkas. Mao nga ang coral reef makaayo ug makalapad, dili kini mahimo sa yano nga bato.

q: What is ozone made of?
options: Three oxygen atoms joined together
Two oxygen atoms and one nitrogen atom
One oxygen atom and two hydrogen atoms
Four oxygen atoms bonded in a ring
explanation: Ozone is a gas with the formula O3, meaning it is made of three oxygen atoms joined together.
fact_tl: Ang ozone ay isang gas na gawa sa tatlong atomo ng oksiheno na magkakabit (O3).
fact_bis: Ang ozone usa ka gas nga hinimo sa tulo ka atomo sa oksiheno nga gisumpay (O3).

q: What is the main job of urine in the body?
options: To carry liquid waste removed by the kidneys so the blood stays clean
To carry extra nutrients out of the body after a large meal
To cool the body down when it gets too hot
To deliver oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body
explanation: Urine is liquid waste that the kidneys filter from the blood to keep it clean.
fact_tl: Ang ihi ay likidong dumi na inaalis ng mga bato sa katawan upang maging malinis ang dugo.
fact_bis: Ang ihi usa ka likido nga hugaw nga gikuha sa mga kidney aron magpabilin nga limpyo ang dugo.

q: How do tiny water droplets inside a cloud become raindrops heavy enough to fall?
options: They collide and combine repeatedly until they grow large and heavy enough to fall
They absorb heat from the Sun until they expand and burst out of the cloud
They are pushed together by wind until they freeze and drop as ice
They attach to dust particles that pull them down to the ground
explanation: Tiny cloud droplets collide and combine (coalescence) to grow larger until they are heavy enough to fall as rain.
fact_tl: Ang mga maliliit na patak ng tubig sa loob ng ulap ay nagtatagpo (coalescence) at nagkasamasama upang lumaki; kapag sapat na ang bigat, babagsak na ito bilang ulan.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga mga tulo sa tubig sulod sa panganod nagtatag-iya ug nagsagol (coalescence) aron mopadako; sa dihang bug-at na kaayo, mahulog na kini isip ulan.

q: For what field of work was Angel Alcala named a National Scientist of the Philippines in 2014?
options: Marine biology
Volcanology
Agricultural science
Atmospheric physics
explanation: Angel Alcala was named a National Scientist of the Philippines in 2014 in recognition of his work in marine biology.
fact_tl: Ginawaran si Angel Alcala ng titulong National Scientist ng Pilipinas noong 2014 para sa kanyang gawa sa biyolohiya ng dagat.
fact_bis: Si Angel Alcala gihatagan sa titulong National Scientist sa Pilipinas niadtong 2014 alang sa iyang trabaho sa biyolohiya sa dagat.

q: Who invented the magnetic recording tape used to record sound?
options: Fritz Pfleumer of Germany in 1928
Thomas Edison of the United States in 1877
Guglielmo Marconi of Italy in 1901
Nikola Tesla of Serbia in 1910
explanation: Fritz Pfleumer of Germany invented the magnetic recording tape used to record sound in 1928.
fact_tl: Si Fritz Pfleumer ng Germany ang gumawa ng magnetic tape na ginagamit sa pag-record ng tunog noong 1928.
fact_bis: Si Fritz Pfleumer sa Germany mao ang naghimo sa magnetic tape nga gigamit sa pagrekord og tunog niadtong 1928.

q: When does BFAR announce that it is safe to eat shellfish again after a red tide warning?
options: Only after testing confirms the toxin has dropped to a safe level
As soon as the red color disappears from the water
After a fixed waiting period of one week
Once fishermen report that the shellfish look and smell normal again
explanation: BFAR keeps testing the water and shellfish after a red tide and only lifts the ban once the toxin level has dropped to a safe level.
fact_tl: Hindi basta-basta tinatanggal ang babala sa red tide: paulit-ulit munang sinusubok ng BFAR ang tubig at ang mga tahong, at saka lamang sasabihing ligtas nang kumain kapag bumaba na ang lason sa ligtas na antas.
fact_bis: Dili dayon kuhaon ang pasidaan sa red tide: balik-balik usang sulayan sa BFAR ang tubig ug ang mga tahong, ug saka lang ipahibalo nga luwas na kan-on kon mikunhod na ang hilo ngadto sa luwas nga ang-ang.

q: How does a firefly switch its light on and off?
options: By controlling the flow of air inside its body
By contracting and relaxing a special muscle near its tail
By opening and closing a reflective flap over its light organ
By mixing two chemicals together and then separating them
explanation: A firefly controls its blinking light by regulating the air flowing inside it, which controls the chemical reaction that produces light.
fact_tl: Nakokontrol ng alitaptap ang pagbukas at pagsara ng ilaw nito sa pamamagitan ng pagpapadaloy ng hangin sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang aninipot makapahunong ug makapasiga sa iyang kahayag pinaagi sa pagkontrol sa hangin nga moagos sa sulod.

q: Which Mars rover operated the longest, lasting nearly 15 years before a dust storm ended its mission?
options: Opportunity
Curiosity
Perseverance
Spirit
explanation: Opportunity, which landed on Mars in 2004, operated for nearly 15 years until a massive dust storm ended its mission in 2018.
fact_tl: Ang NASA ay nagpadala ng maraming rover sa Mars: Sojourner (1997), Spirit at Opportunity (2004), Curiosity (2012), at Perseverance (2021). Ang Opportunity ay ang pinakamatagal — ito ay nag-operate ng halos 15 taon bago winasak ng dust storm noong 2018.
fact_bis: Ang NASA nagpadala og daghang rover sa Mars: Sojourner (1997), Spirit ug Opportunity (pareho 2004), Curiosity (2012), ug Perseverance (2021). Ang Opportunity ang pinaka-matagal — nag-operate kini sulod sa hapit 15 ka tuig sa wala pa matapos ang iyang misyon sa dust storm niadtong 2018.

q: After which scientist is the watt, the unit of power, named?
options: James Watt
Isaac Newton
Michael Faraday
Andre-Marie Ampere
explanation: The watt (W), the unit used to measure power, is named after James Watt.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng kapangyarihan na watt (W) ay ipinangalan kay James Watt.
fact_bis: Ang watt (W), ang yunit sa gahum o power, ginganlan sunod kang James Watt.

q: Why is it dangerous to fly a kite near power lines?
options: If the string or kite touches the lines, electricity can flow through and hurt you
The kite can block electricity from reaching homes in the neighborhood
Power lines give off magnetic fields that can snap the kite string
The kite may cause a short circuit in the power line by flying too close
explanation: If a kite's string or the kite itself touches power lines, electricity can travel down the string and seriously hurt the person holding it.
fact_tl: Mapanganib magpalipad ng saranggola malapit sa linya ng kuryente dahil kung sumayad ang tali o saranggola, maaaring dumaloy ang kuryente at makapanakit.
fact_bis: Delikado ang pagpalupad og saranggola duol sa linya sa koryente tungod kay kon mosaghid ang pisi o saranggola, mahimong moagos ang kuryente ug makasakit.

q: Why is space completely silent even though explosions happen there?
options: There is no air in space, so sound vibrations have nothing to travel through
Space is too cold for sound waves to form
The gravity in space is too weak to carry sound waves
Sound waves in space move so slowly they disappear before reaching anyone
explanation: Sound travels as vibrations through air, so without air — as in the vacuum of space — sound cannot travel and we hear nothing.
fact_tl: Paano umaabot sa atin ang tunog? Yumayanig ang hangin kapag may kumikilos na bagay, at ang yanig na ito ay dumadaan sa hangin bilang alon hanggang sa umabot sa tainga natin. Kung walang hangin, hindi tayo makakarinig — kaya tahimik ang kalawakan.
fact_bis: Unsaon pag-abot sa tingog kanato? Mokurog ang hangin kung adunay molihok nga butang, ug kini nga pagkurog moagi sa hangin isip balud hangtod moabot sa atong dalunggan. Kung walay hangin, dili ta makadungog — mao nga hilom ang kawanangan.

q: Why do you often lose your appetite when you have a fever?
options: Your body is focused on fighting the illness rather than digesting food
Your stomach shrinks when your body temperature rises
Germs release chemicals that block your sense of taste
Your body stores all available energy as fat instead of using it for digestion
explanation: When you have a fever, your body focuses its energy on fighting the illness, so appetite for food decreases — this is a normal response.
fact_tl: Kapag may lagnat, madalas kang nawawalan ng gana kumain dahil naka-focus ang katawan sa paglaban sa sakit, hindi sa pagtunaw ng pagkain. Normal lang ito. Basta uminom ka ng maraming tubig at kumain ng magagaan na pagkain kapag may gana ka na.
fact_bis: Kung naay hilanat, kasagaran mawad-an ka ug gana mokaon kay naka-focus ang lawas sa pakig-away sa sakit, dili sa paghilis sa pagkaon. Normal ra kini. Basta moinom ka ug daghang tubig ug mokaon ug magaan nga pagkaon kung naa nay gana.

q: Why does a bruise change color from red-blue to green and yellow as it heals?
options: Your body is breaking down the leaked blood under the skin, and the changing color shows the different stages of cleanup
The skin absorbs oxygen from the air, which gradually changes the color of the bruise
New skin cells growing over the bruise produce different pigments as they multiply
Increased blood flow to the area brings yellow-colored healing fluids to the surface
explanation: A bruise is blood that leaked from broken vessels; as the body breaks down and cleans up that blood, the bruise goes from red-blue to green and then yellow before fading.
fact_tl: Ang pasa ay dugong tumagas mula sa mga sirang ugat sa ilalim ng balat. Habang nililinis ito ng katawan, nagbabago ang kulay mula pula-asul tungo sa berde at dilaw bago tuluyang mawala.
fact_bis: Ang pasa kay dugo nga mibuhagay gikan sa nangabuak nga ugat ilalom sa panit. Samtang gilimpyohan kini sa lawas, mausab ang kolor gikan pula-asul ngadto berde ug dilaw una mawala.

q: How does the Etruscan shrew help farmers, despite being very small?
options: It eats pest insects that can damage crops
It loosens the soil with its claws, helping plants grow
It scares away larger animals that eat crops
It pollinates flowers as it moves through fields
explanation: The Etruscan shrew is helpful to farmers because it feeds on pest insects that would otherwise damage crops.
fact_tl: Bagaman maliit, nakakatulong ang Etruscan shrew sa mga magsasaka dahil kumakain ito ng mga insektong peste na sumisira sa mga pananim.
fact_bis: Bisan gamay, ang Etruscan shrew makatabang sa mga mag-uuma kay mokaon kini sa mga insektong peste nga makadaot sa mga tanom.

q: What makes balut different from a regular hard-boiled duck egg?
options: Balut is incubated so a partly formed duck embryo develops inside before cooking
Balut is soaked in saltwater for several weeks before it is cooked
Balut uses a fertilized egg that is boiled immediately without any incubation
Balut is made by mixing a raw duck egg with vinegar to firm up the inside
explanation: Balut is a duck egg that is incubated for a period of time before cooking, allowing a partly formed embryo to develop inside, nourished by the yolk and white.
fact_tl: Ang balut ay itlog ng pato na pinapainit muna bago lutuin, kaya makikita ang nabubuong sisiw na lumaki sa loob sa tulong ng pula at puti ng itlog.
fact_bis: Ang balut usa ka itlog sa pato nga gipainit una sa dili pa lutoon, busa makita ang nagporma nga sisiw nga mitubo sa sulod pinaagi sa tabang sa pula ug puti sa itlog.

q: When saltwater is left in the sun and the water evaporates, what happens to the salt?
options: The salt is left behind as solid crystals because only water turns to vapor
The salt also evaporates and disappears along with the water
The salt floats to the surface and washes away
The salt turns into a gas but stays close to the ground
explanation: When saltwater evaporates, only the water molecules turn into vapor and escape; the salt cannot evaporate, so it is left behind as solid crystals.
fact_tl: Kapag sumisingaw ang tubig, ang tubig lang ang nagiging singaw at lumilipad; ang asin ay hindi sumisingaw kaya naiiwan ito bilang solidong kristal.
fact_bis: Kon mosingaw ang tubig, ang tubig ra ang mahimong alisngaw ug molupad; ang asin dili mosingaw busa mahibilin kini nga gahi nga kristal.

q: How does sweating help your body stay cool on a hot day?
options: When sweat evaporates from your skin, it carries heat away and lowers your body temperature
Sweat soaks up heat from the air around you before it dries
Sweat blocks your skin pores so your body produces less heat
Sweat increases blood flow to the skin so your heart can pump heat out
explanation: When sweat evaporates from the skin, it takes heat away from the body, which lowers body temperature and cools you down.
fact_tl: Nagpapawis ang katawan natin para lumamig — kapag sumingaw ang pawis sa balat, naaalis nito ang init kaya bumababa ang temperatura ng katawan.
fact_bis: Mosingot ang atong lawas aron mobugnaw — kung mosingaw ang singot sa panit, makuha niini ang kainit busa mokunhod ang temperatura sa lawas.

q: How often do El Niño and La Niña events occur?
options: At irregular intervals, usually every two to seven years — not every year
Exactly once every two years on a regular schedule
Every year, alternating between El Niño and La Niña
Every ten years, tied to the sunspot cycle
explanation: El Niño and La Niña do not follow a fixed schedule; they occur at irregular intervals of usually two to seven years, which makes them hard to predict.
fact_tl: Hindi taon-taon nangyayari ang El Niño at La Niña kundi paitaas-pababa sa di-regular na pagitan na karaniwang dalawa hanggang pitong taon, kaya mahirap itong hulaan nang maaga.
fact_bis: Ang El Niño ug La Niña dili matag tuig mahitabo kondili nagbalhinbalhin sa dili regular nga gilay-on nga kasagaran duha ngadto sa pito ka tuig, busa lisod kini matagna sa sayo pa.

q: Which whales sing full songs, the grown males or the calves (baby whales)?
options: Grown male whales sing full songs, while calves are still learning and make simpler sounds
Calves sing the most complex songs because they learn quickly after birth
Both calves and adult males sing identical songs from birth
Only female whales sing full songs to guide their calves
explanation: Usually it is the grown male whales that sing full songs; baby whales (calves) are still learning and produce only simpler sounds as they grow.
fact_tl: Karaniwang ang mga lalaking matandang balyena ang kumakanta ng buong kanta. Ang mga sanggol na balyena ay nag-aaral pa lang at gumagawa ng mas simpleng tunog habang lumalaki.
fact_bis: Kasagaran ang hamtong nga laki nga balyena ang mokanta ug tibuok kanta. Ang mga gamay nga balyena, gitawag ug calf, nagkat-on pa ug naghimo ug mas simpleng tingog samtang nagdako.

q: Why is talc the softest mineral?
options: Its structure is like thin sheets stacked on top of each other, held together very weakly, so they slide apart easily
Its crystals are very small and rounded, so they do not grip each other tightly
It contains a high amount of water trapped inside its structure, making it slippery
It forms only at very low temperatures, so its atoms never bond strongly
explanation: Talc's layers are held together by very weak forces, so the sheets slide apart easily — that is what makes it the softest mineral.
fact_tl: Malambot ang talc dahil ang istruktura nito ay parang manipis na mga sheet na patong-patong, at napakahina ng pagkakadikit ng mga sheet na ito. Kaya madali silang magdausdusan o magkahiwalay.
fact_bis: Humok ang talc tungod kay ang istruktura niini sama sa nipis nga mga panid nga gipatong-patong, ug huyang kaayo ang pagkadikit niini nga mga panid. Mao nga sayon ra sila magdausdos o magbulag.

q: What does the mass number of an atom tell you?
options: The total number of protons and neutrons in the atom's nucleus
The number of electrons orbiting the nucleus
The number of protons minus the number of neutrons
The total weight of the atom measured in grams
explanation: The mass number equals the total number of protons plus neutrons in an atom's nucleus — for example, carbon has 6 protons and 6 neutrons, giving a mass number of 12.
fact_tl: Ang mass number ay ang kabuuang bilang ng proton at neutron sa nucleus ng isang atom — halimbawa, ang carbon na may 6 na proton at 6 na neutron ay may mass number na 12.
fact_bis: Ang mass number mao ang kinatibuk-ang gidaghanon sa proton ug neutron sa nucleus sa usa ka atom — pananglitan, ang carbon nga may 6 ka proton ug 6 ka neutron may mass number nga 12.

q: Why is the worm used for making vermicompost not always the same as a fishing worm?
options: A composting worm is chosen because it eats rotting matter fast and lives near the surface, while not every worm is good at making fertilizer
Composting worms are larger and stronger, so they are too hard to put on a fishing hook
Fishing worms live underground and cannot survive near the surface where compost is made
Composting worms only eat plant material, while fishing worms eat both plants and soil
explanation: Composting worms are chosen for specific traits — eating rotting matter quickly and living near the surface — which not all worm species share.
fact_tl: Ang bulateng ginagamit sa vermicompost ay hindi palaging kapareho ng bulateng ginagamit na pain sa pamingwit. Ang composting worm ay pinipili dahil mabilis kumain ng bulok na bagay at nakatira malapit sa ibabaw — hindi lahat ng bulate ay magaling gumawa ng pataba.
fact_bis: Ang bulate nga gamiton sa vermicompost dili kanunay parehas sa bulate nga gamiton nga paon sa pamingwit. Ang composting worm gipili kay paspas mokaon sa dunot nga butang ug magpuyo duol sa ibabaw — dili tanang wati maayo mohimo og pataba.

q: What does the makopa (wax apple) fruit look, feel, and taste like?
options: It is bell-shaped with shiny skin and crisp, watery flesh that is refreshing to eat
It is round with rough brown skin and has a sweet, sticky, very thick flesh
It is oval with a fuzzy red skin and dense, starchy flesh that must be cooked
It is long and curved with a yellow peel and a soft, creamy inside
explanation: The makopa, also called the wax apple, is a bell-shaped fruit with shiny skin and crisp, watery flesh, making it refreshing on a hot day.
fact_tl: Ang makopa ay hugis-kampanang prutas na may makintab na balat at malutong, tubig na laman, kaya nakakawala ito ng uhaw kapag mainit.
fact_bis: Ang makopa o tambis usa ka prutas nga porma og kampana nga adunay sinaw nga panit ug malutong, tubigon nga unod, busa makapawala kini sa kauhaw kon init.

q: What do sea turtles (pawikan) eat?
options: Some eat seagrass while others eat jellyfish
All sea turtles eat only small fish and squid
Sea turtles eat only coral and sea sponges
All sea turtles eat the same food: crabs and shellfish
explanation: Sea turtles have different diets depending on the species — some eat seagrass while others eat jellyfish.
fact_tl: May pawikan na kumakain ng damong-dagat at may iba namang kumakain ng dikya.
fact_bis: Adunay pawikan nga mokaon og damong-dagat ug adunay uban nga mokaon og dikya.

q: Which insect is the only pollinator that can allow figs to form fruit?
options: The tiny fig wasp
The honeybee
The bumblebee
The flower beetle
explanation: While bees are better pollinators overall, the tiny fig wasp is the only pollinator that can pollinate certain fig plants, allowing fig fruit to form.
fact_tl: Bagaman mas magaling ang bubuyog sa polinasyon, may ilang putakti na tanging sila lang ang nakakapagpolinate ng ilang halaman — tulad ng maliit na fig wasp na siyang nagpapalago ng bunga ng igos.
fact_bis: Bisan og mas maayo ang bubuyog sa polinasyon, adunay pipila ka putakti nga sila ra ang makapolinate sa pipila ka tanom — sama sa gamay nga fig wasp nga maoy hinungdan nga mamunga ang igos.

q: Why can you feel the vibrations from a loud bass speaker in your chest and on your skin?
options: Low sounds move the air slowly and powerfully, so you can feel the vibrations not just hear them
Bass speakers send out a special type of ray that passes through your skin
Your bones amplify bass vibrations until they become strong enough to feel
The heat from a loud speaker spreads out and warms your chest
explanation: Low-frequency (bass) sounds make the air move slowly but powerfully, so the vibrations are strong enough to feel on your skin and in your chest.
fact_tl: Kapag nasa harap ka ng malakas na bass speaker, nararamdaman mo ang mabagal na pag-vibrate nito sa iyong dibdib at balat. Mas madaling maramdaman ang mababang tunog dahil mabagal at malakas ang galaw ng hangin.
fact_bis: Kon mag-atubang ka sa kusog nga bass speaker, mabati nimo ang hinay nga pag-vibrate niini sa imong dughan ug panit. Mas sayon bation ang mubo nga tingog kay hinay ug kusgan ang lihok sa hangin.

q: In the Philippines, how did introducing the golden apple snail and janitor fish from other places affect the local environment?
options: They harmed local plants and fish, showing that adding a foreign species can upset the balance just like removing one
They helped control overpopulation of native snails and kept rivers cleaner
They had no effect because local animals quickly adapted to living alongside them
They replaced extinct native species and restored the original balance of the ecosystem
explanation: The golden apple snail and janitor fish, both introduced to the Philippines from elsewhere, harmed native plants and fish — an example of how adding a foreign species can break the ecosystem balance.
fact_tl: Hindi lang pag-alis ang nakakasira ng balanse, pati pagdagdag ng dayuhang species. Halimbawa sa Pilipinas, ang golden apple snail (kuhol) at janitor fish na dinala mula iba't ibang lugar ay umubos sa mga lokal na halaman at isda. Kaya parehong delikado ang pagbawas at pagdagdag.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang pagkuha ang makaguba sa balanse, apil usab ang pagdugang og langyaw nga species. Pananglitan sa Pilipinas, ang golden apple snail (kuhol) ug janitor fish nga gidala gikan sa lain nga dapit miguba sa lokal nga tanom ug isda. Busa parehong delikado ang pagkuha ug pagdugang.

q: What does rosemary look like and how is it used?
options: It is a fragrant herb with thin, needle-like leaves used as a seasoning in cooking
It is a leafy green vegetable with wide, flat leaves eaten raw in salads
It is a flowering vine with broad leaves grown for its bright purple flowers
It is a root vegetable with a strong smell used mainly to make medicine
explanation: Rosemary is a fragrant herb with thin, needle-like leaves that is commonly used as a seasoning in cooking.
fact_tl: Ang rosemary ay isang mabangong halamang-gamot na may manipis at parang karayom na mga dahon, at ginagamit ito bilang pampalasa sa pagluluto.
fact_bis: Ang rosemary usa ka humot nga tanom-tambal nga adunay nipis ug sama-sa-dagom nga mga dahon, ug gamiton kini isip panakot sa pagluto.

q: What are the body's three lines of defense against germs, in order?
options: Barriers like skin and mucus; white blood cells that swallow germs; antibodies that target a specific germ
Antibodies; white blood cells; barriers like skin and mucus
White blood cells; antibodies; fever and inflammation
Skin and mucus; fever; white blood cells
