explanation: When a population exceeds its environment's carrying capacity, resources run short and numbers can fall sharply from starvation or disease.
fact_tl: Kapag lumagpas ang dami ng isang populasyon sa carrying capacity ng kapaligiran, nauubos ang mga pinagkukunan at maaaring biglang bumaba ang bilang nito dahil sa gutom o sakit.
fact_bis: Kung molabaw ang gidaghanon sa usa ka populasyon sa carrying capacity sa palibot, mahurot ang mga kahinguhaan ug mahimong kalit nga mokunhod ang ihap niini tungod sa kagutom o sakit.

q: What two main parts make up most viruses?
options: Genetic material wrapped in a protein coat called a capsid
A cell membrane and a nucleus filled with DNA
A hard shell and tiny flagella for swimming
A sugar wall and watery cytoplasm like a cell
explanation: A virus is usually made of genetic material — DNA or RNA — wrapped in a protein coat called a capsid.
fact_tl: Karaniwang binubuo ang virus ng genetic material (DNA o RNA) na nababalot ng isang patong na protina na tinatawag na capsid.
fact_bis: Ang virus kasagaran gilangkuban og genetic material (DNA o RNA) nga giputos sa usa ka sapaw nga protina nga gitawag og capsid.

q: What is the lime in traditional betel chewing often made from?
options: Burned and crushed shells or coral
Dried and powdered tree bark
Ground white clay from riverbeds
Salt crystals collected from the sea
explanation: The lime used in betel chewing is often made from burned and crushed shells or coral.
fact_tl: Ang apog sa nganga ay madalas gawa sa sinunog at dinurog na mga kabibe o korales.
fact_bis: Ang apog sa panginganga sagad hinimo gikan sa sinunog ug dinugmok nga kabibi o korales.

q: Where does ube grow, and what color is it?
options: It grows underground and is purple
It grows on vines and is orange
It hangs from tree branches and is yellow
It floats on water and is white
explanation: Ube is a purple root crop that grows underground and is used to make sweet treats like halaya.
fact_tl: Ang ube ay isang lilang halamang-ugat na tumutubo sa ilalim ng lupa at ginagawang matamis na kakanin tulad ng halaya.
fact_bis: Ang ubi usa ka lila nga halamang-gamot nga motubo ilalom sa yuta ug ginahimong tam-is nga kalan-on sama sa halaya.

q: Which type of heat transfer can ONLY happen in liquids and gases?
options: Convection
Conduction
Radiation
Insulation
explanation: Convection happens only in fluids — heat moves by the rising and falling of a liquid or gas, not in solids.
fact_tl: Tatlong paraan ang paglipat ng init: conduction (sa pamamagitan ng direktang pagdikit), convection (sa pamamagitan ng pagtaas at pagbaba ng fluid), at radiation (sa pamamagitan ng sinag tulad ng init ng araw). Ang convection ay sa fluid lamang nangyayari.
fact_bis: Tulo ka paagi ang pagbalhin sa init: conduction (pinaagi sa direktang pagdikit), convection (pinaagi sa pagsaka ug pagkunsad sa fluid), ug radiation (pinaagi sa silaw sama sa kainit sa adlaw). Ang convection mahitabo lang sa fluid.

q: What gas does a fire use up while it burns, and what happens when that gas runs out?
options: Oxygen — the flame goes out
Carbon dioxide — the flame spreads
Nitrogen — the flame turns blue
Hydrogen — the flame gets hotter
explanation: Burning is a chemical reaction that uses up oxygen; when the oxygen runs out, the flame goes out.
fact_tl: Ang pagkasunog (combustion) ay isang chemical reaction kung saan kumakain ng oxygen mula sa hangin ang gumaganang sunog. Kapag naubusan ng oxygen, namamatay ang apoy.
fact_bis: Ang pagkasunog (combustion) usa ka chemical reaction diin ang kalayo mokaon og oxygen gikan sa hangin. Kung mahurot ang oxygen, mapalong ang apoy.

q: Why was gold one of the first metals people ever used?
options: Because it can be found as nearly pure nuggets in the ground or rivers
Because it is the hardest metal and easy to shape with bare hands
Because it melts at room temperature so no furnace was needed
Because it is very common and found everywhere on Earth
explanation: Unlike most metals, gold is often found as nearly pure nuggets in nature, so ancient people could use it without refining.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng karamihang metal, ang ginto ay madalas matagpuang halos purong tipak sa lupa o sa ilog kaya ito ang unang metal na nakuha ng tao.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa kadaghanan sa metal, ang bulawan kasagarang makit-an nga halos lunsay nga tipak sa yuta o sa suba, mao nga usa kini sa unang metal nga gigamit sa tawo.

q: Where and when was Jose Rizal executed?
options: At Bagumbayan (Luneta) on December 30, 1896
At Fort Santiago on June 12, 1896
At Kawit, Cavite on August 23, 1898
At Balintawak on December 30, 1898
explanation: Jose Rizal was executed by firing squad on December 30, 1896 at Bagumbayan, which is now known as Luneta Park.
fact_tl: Binaril si Jose Rizal noong Disyembre 30, 1896 sa Bagumbayan (Luneta).
fact_bis: Si Jose Rizal gipusil niadtong Disyembre 30, 1896 sa Bagumbayan (Luneta).

q: What does the lens of the eye do to help us see things at different distances?
options: It changes shape to focus on near and far objects
It moves forward or backward inside the eye socket
It changes color to control how much light enters
It rotates to point in different directions
explanation: The lens changes shape so we can focus on both nearby and distant objects clearly.
fact_tl: Nagbabago ng hugis ang lente para makita nang malinaw ang mga bagay na malapit at malayo.
fact_bis: Ang lente nag-usab og porma aron makita nga tin-aw ang mga butang nga duol ug layo.

q: When a guitar string vibrates slowly, what kind of sound does it make?
options: A low sound
A high sound
A very loud sound
No sound at all
explanation: When a vibrating object — like a guitar string — moves slowly back and forth, the sound it produces is low in pitch.
fact_tl: Ang bahaging mabilis o mabagal gumalaw-galaw paroo't parito ang tinatawag na nagva-vibrate. Pwede itong kuwerdas ng gitara, balat ng tambol, o haba ng hangin sa loob ng plawta. Kapag mabagal ito kumilos, mababa ang tunog.
fact_bis: Ang bahin nga naglihok balik-balik mao ang nag-vibrate. Mahimo kini nga kuwerdas sa gitara, panit sa tambol, o ang hangin sulod sa plawta. Kung hinay kini molihok, mubo ang tingog.

q: Which vitamin found in malunggay leaves helps the body fight off sickness?
options: Vitamin C
Vitamin A
Vitamin D
Vitamin B12
explanation: Malunggay leaves are rich in vitamin C, which helps the body fight off sickness.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng malunggay ay mayaman sa bitamina C na tumutulong sa katawan na labanan ang sakit.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa kamunggay daghan ug bitamina C nga makatabang sa lawas sa pagbatok sa sakit.

q: Even though the Etruscan shrew is one of the tiniest animals, how do we know it is a true mammal?
options: It has fur, is warm-blooded, and feeds its babies with milk
It hatches from an egg and breathes through gills at birth
It has scales and hibernates through the cold season
It is cold-blooded and lives entirely underground
explanation: The Etruscan shrew is a true mammal because it has fur, is warm-blooded, and feeds its young with milk — key mammal traits.
fact_tl: Kahit napakaliit, isa pa ring tunay na mammal ang Etruscan shrew: may balahibo siya, mainit ang dugo, at nagpapasuso ng gatas sa mga anak.
fact_bis: Bisan gamay kaayo, ang Etruscan shrew usa gihapon ka tinuod nga mammal: adunay balhibo, init og dugo, ug nagpasuso ug gatas sa mga anak.

q: What insect is the only pollinator of fig trees?
options: The fig wasp
The honeybee
The bumblebee
The carpenter ant
explanation: Figs are pollinated exclusively by specialized fig wasps in a tight partnership where each fig species has its own dedicated wasp species.
fact_tl: Ang mga fig ay binibisita lamang ng espesyal na fig wasps para sa polinasyon—isang mahigpit na mutualism na kung saan ang bawat species ng fig ay may sariling species ng fig wasp.
fact_bis: Ang mga fig gi-pollinate lamang sa espesyal nga fig wasps—usa ka higpit nga mutualism diin ang matag species sa fig adunay kaugalingon nga espesyal nga species sa fig wasp.

q: Why does the sky look its clearest and bluest around noon?
options: Because sunlight travels a shorter path through the air at noon
Because the sun produces more blue light in the middle of the day
Because clouds disappear completely when the temperature is highest
Because Earth's atmosphere thins out at midday allowing more light through
explanation: Around noon the sun is nearly overhead, so its light travels a shorter path through the atmosphere, making the sky look its clearest and bluest.
fact_tl: Tuwing tanghali, mas maikli ang dinaanan ng liwanag sa hangin, kaya pinakamaaliwalas at pinakaasul ang langit.
fact_bis: Sa udto, mas mubo ang agianan sa kahayag sa hangin, mao nga labing tin-aw ug labing asul ang langit.

q: What are banana leaves sometimes used for in the Philippines?
options: To wrap food such as rice cakes
To make rope for tying boats
To build walls for houses
To filter drinking water
explanation: Banana leaves are very large and long, making them useful for wrapping food like rice cakes.
fact_tl: Napakalaki at mahaba ng mga dahon ng saging; madalas itong ginagamit na pambalot ng pagkain tulad ng suman.
fact_bis: Dako kaayo ug taas ang mga dahon sa saging; kanunay kining gamiton aron iputos sa pagkaon sama sa suman.

q: Why can the body fight off a germ much faster the second time it encounters the same germ?
options: Because the body remembers the germ and can make antibodies quickly
Because the germ becomes weaker each time it infects a person
Because white blood cells double in number after every infection
Because the body raises its temperature higher than the germ can survive
explanation: After fighting off a germ, the immune system keeps a memory of it so it can produce antibodies much faster when the same germ returns.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos malabanan ang isang germ, naaalala ito ng katawan, kaya mas mabilis itong nakakagawa ng antibody kapag bumalik ang parehong germ.
fact_bis: Human madaog ang usa ka germ, mahinumdoman kini sa lawas, mao nga mas paspas kini makahimo og antibody kung mobalik ang samang germ.

q: Which areas in the Philippines are known as major gold mining regions?
options: Compostela Valley, Masbate, and Benguet
Palawan, Leyte, and Batangas
Cebu, Bohol, and Zamboanga
Ilocos Norte, Pangasinan, and Cavite
explanation: The Philippines is rich in gold, with major mining areas in Compostela Valley in Mindanao, Masbate, and Benguet.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay mayaman sa ginto; ang mga pangunahing lugar ng pagmimina ng ginto ay kinabibilangan ng Compostela Valley sa Mindanao at Masbate at Benguet.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas dato sa ginto; dagkong lugar sa pagmina sa ginto naglangkob sa Compostela Valley sa Mindanao, Masbate, ug Benguet.

q: How does a male Draco lizard warn other males to stay out of his territory?
options: By using the color on his throat to challenge rivals
By making loud barking sounds from treetops
By spreading his gliding wings to look bigger
By biting the bark of the tree to leave a scent mark
explanation: A male Draco guards its tree territory and challenges other males by displaying the color on its throat.
fact_tl: Ang lalaking Draco ay nagbabantay ng kanyang teritoryo sa isang puno at hinahamon ang ibang lalaki gamit ang kulay sa lalamunan.
fact_bis: Ang laki nga Draco magbantay sa iyang teritoryo sa usa ka kahoy ug mohagit sa ubang laki gamit ang kolor sa iyang liog.

q: What happens when a tree's bark is wounded, unlike human skin that heals itself?
options: The old bark does not grow back — the tree grows new bark around the wound
The bark bleeds sap and then dries into exactly the same bark as before
The damaged bark falls off and is replaced by smooth, fresh bark within days
The wound stays open permanently because trees cannot repair any damage
explanation: Unlike human skin that heals, a tree's old bark does not regrow — instead the tree forms new bark around the wound.
fact_tl: Madalas akalain na ang balat ng puno ay parang balat natin na gumagaling. Pero kapag nasugatan ang puno, hindi tumutubo muli ang lumang balat — sa halip ay gumagawa ito ng bagong balat sa paligid ng sugat.
fact_bis: Kasagaran maghunahuna nga ang panit sa kahoy murag atong panit nga mamaayo. Apan kon masamdan ang kahoy, ang daan nga panit dili na motubo balik — hinuon maghimo ang kahoy og bag-ong panit palibot sa samad.

q: What are the small bumps on the roots of mung beans and sitaw called, and what lives inside them?
options: Root nodules, which house Rhizobium bacteria that fix nitrogen from the air
Seed pods, which store starch energy before the plant flowers
Tap root tips, which absorb water directly from the deepest soil layer
Tubers, which contain bacteria that help the plant absorb sunlight
explanation: The small bumps on legume roots are called root nodules and they house Rhizobium bacteria that fix nitrogen from the air for the plant.
fact_tl: Kung titingnan ang ugat ng monggo o sitaw, makikita ang mga maliliit na bukol (root nodules)—ang mga ito ang tahanan ng Rhizobium bacteria na nag-fi-fix ng nitrogen mula sa hangin para sa halaman.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon ang gamot sa mongo o sitaw, makita ang mga gagmay nga bukol nga gitawag og root nodules—kini ang pinuy-anan sa Rhizobium bacteria nga nag-fix sa nitrogen gikan sa hangin para sa tanum.

q: Why do baby fireflies (larvae) glow on the ground?
options: To warn predators that they do not taste good
To attract mates even before they are fully grown
To light up the soil so they can find food at night
To signal other larvae to gather together for warmth
explanation: Firefly larvae glow as a warning to predators that they are unpleasant to eat, just like adult fireflies.
fact_tl: Hindi lang malalaking alitaptap ang nagliliwanag. Pati ang mga uod nito (baby firefly) ay nagliliwanag din sa lupa. Ang liwanag nila ay parang babala sa mga kakain na hindi sila masarap.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang dagkong aninipot ang mosiga. Bisan ang ilang mga ulod (baby firefly) mosiga sab sa yuta. Ang ilang suga sama sa pasidaan sa mga manununaw nga dili sila lami.

q: Why is a fuel truck connected to the ground with a wire before pumping fuel?
options: To remove static electricity that could create a spark near fuel vapor
To keep the truck from rolling on the sloped fuel depot ground
To allow electricity from the depot to power the pump motor
To measure how much fuel is flowing through the hose accurately
explanation: Fuel trucks are grounded before pumping to remove static charge that could cause a spark — near fuel vapor, even a tiny spark can cause fire or explosion.
fact_tl: Sa mga gasolinahan, kinakabit muna sa lupa ang trak ng gasolina gamit ang isang kawad bago magbomba. Bakit? Para tanggalin ang anumang static charge na maaaring magbuga ng spark — sa singaw ng gasolina, kahit maliit na spark ay puwedeng magdulot ng sunog o pagsabog.
fact_bis: Sa mga gasolinahan, ikabit una sa yuta ang trak sa gasolina pinaagi sa usa ka kawad sa dili pa magbomba. Ngano? Aron makuha ang bisan unsa nga static charge nga makahimo og spark — duol sa alisngaw sa gasolina, bisan gamay nga spark makasugod og sunog o pagbuto.

q: What does a makahiya leaf look like?
options: Many tiny leaflets lined up like a feather
One big, round leaf with smooth edges
A single thick leaf shaped like a heart
Long, thin leaves that droop toward the ground
explanation: Each makahiya leaf is made of many tiny leaflets arranged along a stem, giving it a feather-like appearance.
fact_tl: Ang bawat dahon ng makahiya ay gawa sa maraming maliliit na dahon na nakahanay na parang balahibo.
fact_bis: Ang matag dahon sa makahiya gilangkoban sa daghang gagmay nga dahon nga nagpahirig nga morag balhibo.

q: Why do plants add oxygen to the atmosphere during the day?
options: They make more oxygen through photosynthesis than they use up in respiration
They stop breathing completely during daylight hours to save oxygen
They absorb carbon dioxide and release exactly the same amount of oxygen
They collect oxygen from the soil at night and release it during the day
explanation: During the day, plants produce more oxygen through photosynthesis than they consume in respiration, so the extra oxygen goes into the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Sa araw, gumagawa ang halaman ng higit pang oxygen sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis kaysa sa kanilang ginagamit sa respiration—kaya ang mga halaman ay nagdadagdag ng oxygen sa atmospera.
fact_bis: Sa adlaw, ang tanum nagmugna og mas daghang oxygen pinaagi sa photosynthesis kaysa sa ilang gigamit sa respiration; kining net oxygen output mao ang rason nga ang mga tanum nagdugang og oxygen sa atmospera.

q: How do cave-dwelling swiftlets find their way in total darkness?
options: By making clicking sounds and listening for the echoes
By using their keen eyesight even in very low light
By following airflow patterns inside the cave tunnels
By sensing the Earth's magnetic field like migratory birds
explanation: Cave swiftlets make clicking sounds and use the echoes to navigate in the dark.
fact_tl: Ang ilang balinsasayaw na naninirahan sa kweba ay gumagamit ng mga tunog na pumipitik para makalipad sa dilim.
fact_bis: Ang ubang balinsasayaw nga nagpuyo sa langob mugamit ug mga tingog nga klik aron makalupad sa kangitngit.

q: What usually causes a tsunami?
options: A strong earthquake under the sea that suddenly moves the ocean floor
A powerful underwater storm that pushes water toward the coast
A very high tide combined with strong winds during a typhoon
A meteor hitting the deep ocean and sending out shock waves
explanation: A tsunami is usually caused by a strong undersea earthquake that suddenly moves the ocean floor, creating huge waves that rush toward the coast.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nagmumula ang tsunami sa malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat na biglang nagpapagalaw ng sahig ng karagatan, na lumilikha ng napakalalaking alon patungo sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Kasagaran nga ang tsunami gikan sa kusog nga linog sa ilawom sa dagat nga kalit nga nagpalihok sa salog sa kadagatan, nga nagmugna ug dagko kaayo nga balod paingon sa baybayon.

q: Why should you never touch an electric device with wet hands?
options: Because electricity passes easily through water and can shock you
Because water will short-circuit the device and break it immediately
Because dry hands grip the device better and prevent it from slipping
Because moisture causes sparks that can burn your fingers
explanation: Electricity passes easily through water, so touching electric devices with wet hands is dangerous and can cause a shock.
fact_tl: Huwag hawakan ang mga gamit na de-kuryente kapag basa ang iyong kamay dahil madaling dumaloy ang kuryente sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ayaw hikapa ang mga gamit nga de-kuryente kung basa ang imong kamot kay sayon moagi ang kuryente sa tubig.

q: What is the most dangerous moment in a sloth's life, and why does it happen?
options: Climbing down from the tree to poop, because it is exposed to predators on the ground
Swimming across a river to find a new tree, because it cannot swim very fast
Sleeping during the day, because predators spot its still body in the canopy
Eating leaves at night, because it must move quickly and risks falling
explanation: A sloth stays safely in the trees but must climb down about once a week to poop, making it vulnerable to predators on the ground.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nasa itaas ng puno lang ang sloth, pero mga isang beses sa isang linggo, bumababa ito sa lupa para dumumi. Ito ang pinaka-mapanganib na sandali nito kaya mabilis itong bumabalik sa puno pagkatapos.
fact_bis: Kasagaran anaa lang sa taas sa kahoy ang sloth, apan mga kausa sa usa ka semana, manaog kini sa yuta aron malibang. Kini ang labing peligroso nga panahon niini mao nga paspas kini mobalik sa kahoy human niana.

q: Why is sandstone important as a source of drinking water?
options: Its many pore spaces between sand grains can hold water underground
Its surface is waterproof, so rainfall collects in pools on top of it
It dissolves slowly in water, releasing minerals people need to drink
Its hardness makes it easy to drill through to reach deeper water
explanation: Sandstone has many pore spaces between its sand grains that can be filled with water, making it an important aquifer for drinking water.
fact_tl: Ang sandstone ay isang sedimentary rock na may maraming puwang (pores) sa pagitan ng mga butil ng buhangin; ang mga puwang na ito ay maaaring mapuno ng tubig, na nagagawa itong isang mahalagang aquifer para sa inuming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang sandstone usa ka sedimentary rock nga adunay daghang mga guwang (pores) tali sa mga butil sa buhangin; kini nga mga guwang mahimong mapuno sa tubig, nga naghimo niini nga usa ka importante nga aquifer sa tubig-inom.

q: What is the role of the IPCC?
options: It is an international group of scientists that assesses knowledge about climate change for governments
It is a Philippine agency that tracks typhoons and issues weather warnings
It is a United Nations fund that pays for solar panels in poor countries
It is a laboratory that tests whether new fuels are safe for the environment
explanation: The IPCC is an international body of scientists that regularly assesses the latest scientific knowledge on climate change, and their reports help governments plan.
fact_tl: Ang IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change) ay isang internasyonal na katawan ng mga siyentipiko na regular na nag-aassess ng pinakabagong siyentipikong kaalaman tungkol sa climate change; ang kanilang mga ulat ay ginagamit ng mga pamahalaan sa pagpaplano.
fact_bis: Ang IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change) usa ka internasyonal nga katawan sa mga siyentipiko nga regular nga nag-assess sa pinakabag-o nga siyentipikong kaalaman bahin sa climate change; ang ilang mga ulat gigamit sa mga gobyerno alang sa pagpaplano.

q: Why can a fast-moving river carry away rocks and soil during a flood?
options: Because flowing water has kinetic energy that increases with speed
Because rivers contain strong chemicals that dissolve rocks over time
Because the weight of the water pushes rocks and soil straight downward
Because rivers spin in circles creating suction that pulls soil from the banks
explanation: Flowing river water has kinetic energy, and the faster the current, the more kinetic energy it carries and the more material it can move.
fact_tl: Ang umaagos na tubig sa ilog ay may kinetic energy. Kaya nga ang malakas na agos ay kayang magtangay ng mga bato, lupa, at kahit mga gamit kapag may baha. Mas mabilis ang agos, mas malaki ang kinetic energy at mas malaki ang kayang tangayin.
fact_bis: Ang nagaagos nga tubig sa suba naa'y kinetic energy. Mao nga ang kusog nga agos makahimo'g banlas sa mga bato, yuta, ug bisan mga gamit kung magbaha. Mas paspas ang agos, mas dako ang kinetic energy ug mas daghan ang madala.

q: How is the energy of a strong earthquake sometimes described to help people understand it?
options: By comparing it to the power of a huge amount of TNT explosive
By counting how many houses it could lift into the air at once
By measuring how many kilometers the ground actually moved sideways
By timing how long the shaking lasted in seconds at the epicenter
explanation: The energy released by a strong earthquake is sometimes compared to the equivalent power of a huge amount of TNT, far more than many large bombs combined.
fact_tl: Para maintindihan ang enerhiya ng lindol, minsang inihahalintulad ito sa lakas ng pampasabog. Ang isang malakas na lindol ay naglalabas ng enerhiyang katumbas ng napakaraming TNT, na mas malaki pa kaysa sa marami at malalaking bomba.
fact_bis: Aron masabtan ang enerhiya sa linog, usahay gitandi kini sa kusog sa pabuto. Ang usa ka kusog nga linog mobuga og enerhiya nga katumbas sa daghan kaayong TNT, mas dako pa kay sa daghan ug dagkong mga bomba.

q: When does PAGASA retire a typhoon name so it is never used again?
options: When a typhoon is very destructive and causes many deaths
When a typhoon changes direction and turns back out to sea
When a typhoon lasts for more than two weeks without weakening
When a typhoon is the first of the season to make landfall
explanation: PAGASA retires a typhoon name when the storm was very destructive and caused many deaths, as it did with the name Yolanda.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang bagyo ay napakalakas at marami ang namatay, inaalis ng PAGASA ang pangalan nito at hindi na muling gagamitin, tulad ng pangalang Yolanda.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka bagyo grabe kaayo ug daghan ang namatay, kuhaon sa PAGASA ang ngalan niini ug dili na gamiton pag-usab, sama sa ngalang Yolanda.

q: What do tectonic plates ride on top of?
options: The hot, soft part of the mantle beneath them
The solid inner core of the Earth
A layer of liquid water trapped deep underground
A cushion of compressed air between the crust and the mantle
explanation: Tectonic plates ride on top of the hot, soft portion of the mantle directly beneath them.
fact_tl: Ang mga tectonic plate ay parang lumulutang sa ibabaw ng mainit at malambot na bahagi ng manto sa ilalim nila.
fact_bis: Ang mga tectonic plate murag naglutaw sa ibabaw sa init ug humok nga bahin sa manto sa ilalom nila.

q: Why do meteor showers like the Perseids happen at nearly the same time every year?
options: Because Earth passes through the same comet dust trail at the same point in its orbit each year
Because asteroids from the asteroid belt break apart and fall to Earth on a fixed schedule
Because the moon's gravity pulls extra space dust toward Earth during the same phase each year
Because the sun's solar wind pushes dust particles into Earth's path on a yearly cycle
explanation: Meteor showers occur at the same time each year because Earth crosses the same trail of comet dust at the same point in its annual orbit.
fact_tl: Ang mga meteor shower ay nangyayari sa halos parehong panahon bawat taon dahil dumadaan ang Earth sa parehong landas ng alikabok ng kometa taun-taon. Kaya alam ng mga astronomo kung kailan aasahan ang mga sikat na shower tulad ng Perseids at Geminids.
fact_bis: Ang mga meteor shower mahitabo sa halos samang panahon kada tuig kay moagi ang Earth sa samang agianan sa abog sa kometa matag tuig. Mao nga nahibaloan sa mga astronomo kung kanus-a paabuton ang bantogang mga shower sama sa Perseids ug Geminids.

q: Why do yellow and orange colors appear in a dying leaf?
options: Because the green chlorophyll fades and reveals the yellow and orange pigments that were always there
Because the leaf produces new yellow and orange chemicals as it begins to die
Because cold temperatures cause the leaf cells to release orange dye stored in roots
Because sunlight bleaches the leaf and mixes red and yellow light on its surface
explanation: When chlorophyll fades in a dying leaf, the yellow and orange pigments that were hidden underneath finally become visible.
fact_tl: Kapag bumababa ang chlorophyll sa isang nalalantang dahon, lumilitaw ang dilaw at kahel na pigment na dati ay nakatago.
fact_bis: Kon mokunhod ang chlorophyll sa usa ka nagakalaya nga dahon, mogawas ang dalag ug kahel nga pigment nga kaniadto natago.

q: What are pigs in the Philippines commonly fed?
options: Rice bran, rice, and leftover vegetables
Corn kernels, dried fish, and coconut husks
Sugarcane stalks, banana peels, and dried leaves
Ground cassava, salt, and fresh seaweed
explanation: In the Philippines, pigs are often fed rice bran, rice, and leftover vegetables, making use of common food scraps.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas pinapakain ang baboy ng darak, kanin, at mga tira-tirang gulay.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kasagaran ginapakaon ang baboy ug darak, kan-on, ug salin nga utanon.

q: What is it called when rainwater slowly soaks down through the soil and becomes groundwater?
options: Infiltration
Condensation
Transpiration
Precipitation
explanation: When rainwater seeps downward through soil due to gravity until it reaches the spaces in rock and becomes groundwater, the process is called infiltration.
fact_tl: Kapag umuulan, hindi lahat ng tubig ay umaagos sa ilog. Ang iba ay dahan-dahang tumatagos pababa sa lupa dahil sa hila ng gravity, hanggang umabot sa mga butas ng bato at maging groundwater. Tinatawag itong infiltration.
fact_bis: Kung mag-ulan, dili tanan tubig modagayday sa suba. Ang uban hinay-hinay nga mosulod paubos sa yuta tungod sa gravity, hangtod moabot sa mga luna sa bato ug mahimong groundwater. Gitawag ni nga infiltration.

q: What do rice farmers do with seedlings after they grow in the seedbed?
options: They transplant them into the paddy field
They leave them in the seedbed until harvest
They dry them in the sun and store them as seeds
They float them on water until the roots are long enough to eat
explanation: Farmers first grow rice seedlings in a seedbed, then transplant them into the flooded paddy to finish growing.
fact_tl: Ang mga magsasaka ay nagtatanim muna ng punla sa punlaan, pagkatapos inililipat ang mga ito sa palayan.
fact_bis: Ang mga mag-uuma magtanom una og binhi-tanom sa punlaan, dayon ibalhin kini ngadto sa humayan.

q: Why does the inside of a banana turn brown after it is cut open?
options: The exposed flesh reacts with oxygen in the air in a chemical change called oxidation
The cut releases a liquid that dries and turns dark brown when it meets air
The cells stop making yellow color when they are broken and turn dark on their own
The warm air outside is absorbed by the banana and causes a color dye to leak out
explanation: When a banana is cut, the exposed flesh reacts with oxygen in the air and turns brown — a chemical change called oxidation.
fact_tl: Kapag hiniwa ang saging o mansanas, nakikipagsama ang loob nito sa oksiheno sa hangin at nagdudulot ito ng kulay-kayumanggi—isang pagbabagong-kemikal na tinatawag na oksihenasyon.
fact_bis: Kon mahiwa ang saging o mansanas, ang sulod niini makig-uban sa oksiheno sa hangin ug mahimong brown—usa ka kemikal nga kausaban nga gitawag og oksidasyon.

q: How does a tick get its food?
options: It clings to the skin of an animal and sucks its blood
It collects nectar from flowers using a long, thin mouthpart
It catches small insects with a sticky web it spins in the grass
It chews dead leaves and plant roots it finds on the forest floor
explanation: A tick is a tiny animal that clings to the skin of a dog or other animal and sucks its blood for nourishment.
fact_tl: Ang garapata ay isang maliit na hayop na kumakapit sa balat ng aso o ibang hayop at sumisipsip ng dugo nito.
fact_bis: Ang garapata usa ka gamay nga mananap nga mokapyot sa panit sa iro o ubang mananap ug mosuyop sa dugo niini.

q: How does an electroscope show that an object is electrically charged?
options: Two thin metal leaves inside it spread apart when charge is present
A small light bulb at the top lights up when charge is detected
A needle spins in circles on the metal base when charge is near
A liquid inside the glass tube changes color when static is present
explanation: An electroscope has two thin metal leaves that spread apart when an electric charge is present, detecting static electricity.
fact_tl: May kagamitan na tinatawag na electroscope na nagpapakita kung may charge ang isang bagay. Ito ay may metal na tuktok at dalawang manipis na dahon ng metal sa loob. Kapag may charge, naghihiwalay ang dalawang dahon. Simpleng pang-detect ito ng static.
fact_bis: Naay himan nga gitawag og electroscope nga nagpakita kung naay charge ang usa ka butang. Naa kini metal nga ibabaw ug duha ka nipis nga dahon sa metal sa sulod. Kung naay charge, magbulag ang duha ka dahon. Simple kini nga pang-detect sa static.

q: How do gliders and large birds like eagles stay up in the air without using engines?
options: By riding columns of rising warm air called thermals and using wing lift
By flapping their wings very fast to push air downward beneath them
By storing kinetic energy on the ground before leaping into the air
By catching cold air that sinks from clouds and gliding along underneath
explanation: Gliders and large soaring birds like eagles stay airborne by riding columns of rising warm air and using the lift from their wings.
fact_tl: Lumilipad ang glider at malalaking ibong gaya ng agila nang walang makina sa pamamagitan ng paglutang sa umaakyat na mainit na hangin. Ginagamit nila ang lift mula sa pakpak para manatili sa himpapawid.
fact_bis: Ang glider ug dagkong langgam sama sa agila molupad nga walay makina pinaagi sa pagsakay sa nagsaka nga init nga hangin. Gamiton nila ang lift gikan sa ilang mga pako aron magpabilin sa kahanginan.

q: Why can't filtering remove salt that is already dissolved in water?
options: Because dissolved salt particles are far too tiny for a filter to catch
Because salt dissolves into a gas that passes through the filter as a vapor
Because salt particles are actually heavier than the filter and fall through the bottom
Because filtering only works on colored substances and salt is transparent
explanation: Once salt is dissolved in water, its particles are far too tiny for a filter to catch, so filtering cannot remove dissolved salt.
fact_tl: Hindi maaalis ng pagsala ang asin na natunaw na sa tubig dahil ang mga butil nito ay napakaliit para mahuli ng salaan.
fact_bis: Ang pagsala dili makakuha sa asin nga natunaw na sa tubig kay ang mga tipik niini gamay ra kaayo para madakpan sa salaan.

q: Who was the first Filipino to reach the Emden Deep?
options: Deo Florence Onda in 2021
Ramon Magsaysay Jr. in 2015
Maria Ressa in 2019
Eduardo Quisumbing in 2010
explanation: Deo Florence Onda became the first Filipino to reach the Emden Deep in 2021.
fact_tl: Si Deo Florence Onda ang unang Pilipinong nakarating sa Emden Deep noong 2021.
fact_bis: Si Deo Florence Onda mao ang unang Pilipino nga nakaabot sa Emden Deep niadtong 2021.

q: What is the birthstone for August and what color is it?
options: Peridot, which is yellowish-green
Ruby, which is deep red
Sapphire, which is bright blue
Topaz, which is golden yellow
explanation: The birthstone for August is the peridot, a gemstone with a distinctive yellowish-green color.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Agosto ay ang peridot, na berde na may dilaw na tinta.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Agosto kay ang peridot, nga berde nga may pagkadalag og kolor.

q: When you mix salt and pepper together, what kind of change happens?
options: A physical change, because no new substance is formed
A chemical change, because the substances combine
A chemical change, because you cannot separate them again
A physical change, because heat is released
explanation: Mixing two substances is only a physical change because the original parts are still there and no new substance is formed.
fact_tl: Kapag naghahalo ka ng dalawang substansya, hindi ito chemical change dahil walang bagong substansyang nabubuo. Pisikal na pagbabago lang ito—nananatili pa rin ang dating mga sangkap, naghalo lang sila. Sa chemical change, may bagong bagay na lumilitaw na iba na sa simula.
fact_bis: Kung magsagol ka og duha ka substansya, dili kini kemikal nga kausaban kay walay bag-ong substansya nga maporma. Pisikal lang nga kausaban kini—ang orihinal nga mga sangkap naa pa, nagsagol lang sila. Sa kemikal nga kausaban, adunay bag-ong butang nga motungha nga lahi na sa sinugdanan.

q: Which set of steps correctly separates salt from a mixture of salt and sand?
options: Add water to dissolve the salt, filter out the sand, then evaporate the water
Heat the mixture directly until the sand melts away
Shake the mixture in air until the salt flies off
Pour the mixture through a magnet to attract the salt
explanation: Adding water dissolves the salt, filtering removes the sand, and evaporating the water leaves the salt behind.
fact_tl: Ang asin at buhangin ay pwedeng paghiwalayin: idagdag ang tubig para matunaw ang asin, salain ang buhangin, tapos pasingawin ang tubig para makuhang muli ang asin.
fact_bis: Ang asin nga sagol sa balas mahimong bulagon: dugangi og tubig aron matunaw ang asin, salaa ang balas, dayon paalisngawa ang tubig aron makuha balik ang asin.

q: Why is pig's blood, used in dinuguan, considered a good source of nutrition?
options: It is rich in iron that the body uses to carry oxygen
It is high in vitamin C that strengthens bones
It is packed with calcium that helps build muscles
It contains fiber that aids digestion
explanation: Pig's blood is rich in iron, and the body needs iron to carry oxygen in the blood.
fact_tl: Ang dinuguan ay niluluto mula sa dugo ng baboy, na mayaman sa bakal na ginagamit ng katawan para magdala ng oksiheno sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang dinuguan giluto gikan sa dugo sa baboy, nga dato sa puthaw nga gigamit sa lawas aron magdala og oksiheno sa dugo.

q: When sound travels from air into water, which property of the wave stays the same?
options: Frequency
Speed
Wavelength
Amplitude
explanation: When a wave moves from one medium to another, its frequency stays the same even though speed and wavelength change.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang alon ay dumaan mula sa isang medium papunta sa iba, tulad ng tunog na galing sa hangin papasok sa tubig, hindi nagbabago ang frequency nito. Ang nagbabago ay ang bilis at ang wavelength, pero ang dami ng alon kada segundo ay nananatiling pareho.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka balod molabay gikan sa usa ka medium ngadto sa lain, sama sa tingog gikan sa hangin paingon sa tubig, dili mausab ang frequency niini. Ang mausab mao ang katulin ug ang wavelength, apan ang gidaghanon sa balod matag segundo magpabilin nga pareho.

q: What kind of plants commonly cover the hills and mountainsides of the Philippines?
options: Tall cogon and talahib grasses
Dense mangrove trees
Thick bamboo forests
Low cactus shrubs
explanation: Many hills and mountainsides in the Philippines are covered with tall cogon and talahib grasses.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, maraming burol at kabundukan ay natatakpan ng matataas na damong cogon at talahib.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghang bungtod ug bakilid sa bukid ang natabunan sa tag-as nga kogon ug talahib nga mga damo.

q: Which pen names did Jose Rizal use when writing?
options: Laong Laan and Dimasalang
Bayani and Dakila
Maliksi and Lakan
Katipunero and Dakila
explanation: Jose Rizal used the pen names 'Laong Laan' and 'Dimasalang' when publishing his writings.
fact_tl: Gumamit si Jose Rizal ng sagisag-panulat na 'Laong Laan' at 'Dimasalang'.
fact_bis: Si Jose Rizal migamit sa mga ngalan-pluma nga 'Laong Laan' ug 'Dimasalang'.

q: How do a shrimp's eyes help it watch for danger?
options: They sit on short stalks, letting the shrimp see in many directions at once
They are very large, giving the shrimp perfect night vision
They face forward only, giving the shrimp sharp focus on one target
They are on the underside of the body to watch the sea floor
explanation: A shrimp's eyes are set on short stalks, allowing it to see in many directions at the same time.
fact_tl: Ang hipon ay may mga mata na nakausli sa maikling tangkay, kaya nakakakita ito sa iba't ibang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang hipon adunay mga mata nga nagtuy-od sa mubo nga tangkay, busa makakita kini sa nagkalainlaing direksyon.

q: How does a worker bee tell other bees where to find flowers with food?
options: It performs a waggle dance that shows the direction and distance to the flowers
It releases a scent trail leading straight to the flowers
It makes a loud buzzing sound that guides bees to the right direction
It leads a small group of bees directly to the flowers
explanation: A worker bee performs a waggle dance inside the hive to communicate the direction and distance to a food source.
fact_tl: Kapag nakakita ng pagkain ang isang worker bee, sumasayaw ito ng tinatawag na waggle dance sa loob ng pugad para ituro sa iba ang direksyon at layo ng mga bulaklak.
fact_bis: Kon makakita og pagkaon ang usa ka worker bee, mosayaw kini og gitawag nga waggle dance sulod sa pugad aron itudlo sa uban ang direksyon ug gilay-on sa mga bulak.

q: During evaporation, which water particles escape into the air first?
options: The fastest-moving particles at the surface
The slowest-moving particles at the bottom
The largest particles anywhere in the water
The particles closest to the center of the liquid
explanation: During evaporation, the fastest-moving tiny particles of water escape from the surface into the air.
fact_tl: Sa pagsingaw, ang pinakamabibilis na maliliit na particle ng tubig ang tumatakas mula sa ibabaw papunta sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sa pag-alisngaw, ang pinakapaspas nga gagmay nga partikulo sa tubig mao ang moikyas gikan sa ibabaw ngadto sa hangin.

q: What happens to coffee seeds right after they are taken from the fruit, before they are roasted?
options: They are dried in the sun
They are soaked in water overnight
They are ground into powder
They are boiled to remove the outer coating
explanation: After being removed from the fruit, coffee seeds are dried in the sun before roasting.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos alisin sa bunga, ang mga buto ng kape ay pinapatuyo sa araw bago iihawin.
fact_bis: Human kuhaa sa bunga, ang mga liso sa kape ibulad sa adlaw una sanlagon.

q: What can happen to a child who does not get enough iodine in their diet?
options: They may feel tired, feel cold, grow slowly, and find it hard to think clearly
They may develop rashes, itching, and swollen joints
They may lose their appetite and have stomach pain all the time
They may become hyperactive and find it impossible to sleep
explanation: Without enough iodine, the thyroid gland slows down, causing tiredness, feeling cold, slow growth, and difficulty thinking.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang sa iodine ang isang bata, bumabagal ang thyroid kaya maaaring laging pagod, giniginaw, mabagal lumaki, at mahirapang mag-isip nang malinaw.
fact_bis: Kung kulang sa iodine ang usa ka bata, mohinay ang thyroid mao nga mahimong kanunay kapoy, tugnaw, hinay motubo, ug maglisod og hunahuna og tin-aw.

q: Why must water travel all the way up to a plant's leaves?
options: The leaves use water together with sunlight to make food in photosynthesis
The leaves need water to stay green and prevent wilting only
The leaves release water through their roots after it travels up
The leaves store water to send it back down to the roots at night
explanation: Water must reach the leaves because the leaves use it along with sunlight to carry out photosynthesis and make food.
fact_tl: Kailangang umakyat ang tubig hanggang sa dahon dahil ginagamit ito ng dahon kasama ang liwanag ng araw para gumawa ng pagkain sa photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan mosaka ang tubig ngadto sa dahon kay gamiton kini sa dahon uban sa kahayag sa adlaw aron maghimo og pagkaon pinaagi sa photosynthesis.

q: Why is the tikling bird also called the buff-banded rail?
options: It has bands or stripes on the feathers of its underside
It builds its nest using thin strips of bamboo tied in a band
It runs along riverbanks in a zigzag band-like path
It has a bright orange band of feathers around its neck
explanation: The tikling is called the buff-banded rail because it has bands or stripes on the feathers of its underside.
fact_tl: May mga guhit o banda ang balahibo ng tikling sa ilalim ng katawan nito, kaya tinawag itong buff-banded rail.
fact_bis: Ang tikling adunay mga badlis o banda sa iyang balahibo sa ilawom sa lawas, mao nga gitawag kini nga buff-banded rail.

q: What do a bird's wing feathers do differently on the downstroke compared to the upstroke?
options: On the downstroke they overlap to block air; on the upstroke they open to let air pass through
On the downstroke they open to let air pass; on the upstroke they overlap to block air
On both strokes they stay fully closed to keep the bird streamlined
On both strokes they open fully so the bird can glide without effort
explanation: During the downstroke the feathers overlap to push against the air, and during the upstroke they open to let air pass through.
fact_tl: Kapag ibinababa ang pakpak, nagkakapatong ang mga balahibo para harangan ang hangin; kapag itinaas naman, bumubukas ang mga ito para makaraan ang hangin.
fact_bis: Sa pagpaubos sa pako, magsapaw ang mga balhibo aron babagan ang hangin; sa pagsaka, moabli sila aron moagi ang hangin.

q: Why is the chemical symbol for sodium 'Na' and not 'So'?
options: The symbol comes from the Latin word 'natrium'
The symbol was chosen by the scientist who first isolated it, whose initials were N.A.
Sodium was named after the Norse word 'natron' which starts with Na
The letters S and O were already taken by sulfur and oxygen
explanation: Sodium's symbol is Na because it comes from the Latin name for sodium, 'natrium'.
fact_tl: Ang sodium ay Na, hindi 'So', dahil galing ito sa salitang Latin na 'natrium'.
fact_bis: Ang sodium kay Na, dili 'So', kay gikan kini sa Latin nga pulong nga 'natrium'.

q: Inside which kind of rock do many amethysts grow?
options: Hollow rocks called geodes
Dense granite boulders
Layered sandstone slabs
Volcanic obsidian chunks
explanation: Many amethysts grow inside hollow rocks called geodes, where mineral-rich water allows crystals to slowly form on the walls.
fact_tl: Maraming amethyst ang tumutubo sa loob ng mga butas ng bato na tinatawag na geode. Dumadaloy ang tubig na may mineral sa loob ng butas, at dahan-dahang lumalaki ang mga kristal sa pader nito sa loob ng napakatagal na panahon.
fact_bis: Daghang amethyst ang motubo sulod sa mga lungag nga bato nga gitawag og geode. Ang tubig nga puno sa mineral mosulod sa lungag, ug hinay-hinay nga motubo ang mga kristal sa bungbong niini sulod sa taas kaayo nga panahon.

q: What happens if a cavity in a tooth is left untreated?
options: It grows larger and can cause bad pain when it reaches the inside of the tooth
It heals by itself as the tooth slowly fills the hole with new material
It stays the same size but makes the tooth look yellow
It spreads to nearby teeth immediately and causes gum swelling only
explanation: An untreated cavity grows larger over time and can cause bad pain once it reaches the inner part of the tooth.
fact_tl: Kapag hindi naagapan ang butas sa ngipin, lumalaki ito at maaaring magdulot ng matinding sakit hanggang abutin ang loob ng ngipin.
fact_bis: Kung dili matambalan ang buslot sa ngipon, modako kini ug makahatag ug grabe nga sakit hangtod maabot ang sulod sa ngipon.

q: About how long does it take for sea turtle eggs to hatch after they are buried under the sand?
options: About 60 days
About 14 days
About 120 days
About 30 days
explanation: Sea turtle eggs hatch after about 60 days buried under the sand.
fact_tl: Ang mga itlog ng pawikan ay napipisa pagkatapos ng halos 60 araw sa ilalim ng buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga itlog sa pawikan mapisa human sa mga 60 ka adlaw nga gilubong sa balas.

q: How can a large landslide into the sea cause a tsunami?
options: The sudden drop of material into the water creates large waves that travel outward
The landslide blocks the seabed and forces water to pile up into a giant wave
The heat from the falling rock warms the water and makes it expand rapidly
The landslide sends shockwaves through the ground that shake the ocean floor
explanation: When a large landslide drops into the sea, it displaces a huge amount of water, creating large waves that can become a tsunami.
fact_tl: Kapag may malaking pagguho ng lupa o bato na bumagsak sa dagat o lawa, parang malaking batong inihulog sa tubig, gumagawa ito ng malalaking alon na puwedeng maging tsunami.
fact_bis: Kung adunay dakong pagdahili sa yuta o bato nga mahulog sa dagat o linaw, sama sa dakong bato nga gilabay sa tubig, makahimo kini og dagkong balod nga mahimong tsunami.

q: Which parent carries seahorse eggs, and for how long?
options: The male carries the eggs in his pouch for a few weeks
The female carries the eggs attached to her belly for several months
Both parents take turns carrying the eggs in their mouths
The eggs are left to float freely in seaweed until they hatch
explanation: The male seahorse carries the eggs in his pouch for a few weeks before the babies are released.
fact_tl: Ilang linggo dinadala ng lalaking kabayong-dagat ang mga itlog sa supot nito bago ito maglabas ng mga anak.
fact_bis: Pipila ka semana dad-on sa laki nga kabayo sa dagat ang mga itlog sa iyang supot una pa mogawas ang mga anak.

q: On the Mohs hardness scale, which mineral is the softest and which is the hardest?
options: Talc is the softest (1) and diamond is the hardest (10)
Chalk is the softest (1) and quartz is the hardest (10)
Talc is the softest (1) and quartz is the hardest (10)
Sand is the softest (1) and diamond is the hardest (10)
explanation: On the Mohs scale, talc has a hardness of 1 (softest) and diamond has a hardness of 10 (hardest).
fact_tl: Sa Mohs scale, ang talc ang pinakamalambot (1) at ang diamante ang pinakamatigas (10).
fact_bis: Sa Mohs scale, ang talc mao ang pinakahumok (1) ug ang diamante mao ang pinakatig-a (10).

q: What do some kinds of mudskipper prefer to eat?
options: Small animals like shrimp, crabs, and insects
Algae and water plants growing on mud
Seeds and fallen fruits near the water's edge
Dead leaves and decaying wood in mangroves
explanation: Some kinds of mudskipper are mainly meat-eaters and prefer to eat small animals such as shrimp, crabs, and insects.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng mudskipper—ang ilan ay mahilig kumain ng maliliit na hayop tulad ng hipon, alimango, at insekto.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing matang sa mudskipper, ug ang uban gusto mokaon ug gagmay nga mananap sama sa pasayan, alimango, ug insekto.

q: A liquid with a pH of 7 is described as what?
options: Neutral, like pure water
Strongly acidic
Weakly basic
Extremely alkaline
explanation: On the pH scale, which runs from 0 to 14, a value of 7 is neutral, like pure water.
fact_tl: Ang pH scale ay sukatan mula 0 hanggang 14 na nagsasabi kung gaano kaasido o kabase ang isang likido, kung saan ang 7 ay neutral tulad ng purong tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pH scale usa ka sukdanan gikan sa 0 hangtod 14 nga magsulti kon unsa ka asido o ka base ang usa ka likido, diin ang 7 neutral sama sa lunsay nga tubig.

q: Why does a real thrown ball travel a shorter distance than a simple calculation would predict?
options: Air resistance pushes back on the ball and reduces its range
Gravity pulls harder on moving objects than on still ones
The ball loses mass as it travels through the air
Wind always blows against the direction of the throw
explanation: In real life, air resistance pushes back on a projectile, making its range shorter and its path not a perfect parabola.
fact_tl: Sa totoong buhay, pinipigil ng resistensya ng hangin ang projectile kaya mas maikli ang range nito at hindi perpektong parabola ang landas, lalo na para sa magagaang bagay.
fact_bis: Sa tinuod nga kinabuhi, ang resistensya sa hangin magpugong sa projectile mao nga mas mubo ang range niini ug dili hingpit nga parabola ang agianan, ilabi na para sa magaan nga mga butang.

q: In what way are humans considered apex predators, even without sharp teeth or claws?
options: No other animal regularly hunts humans, and humans use their brains and tools to hunt
Humans run faster than any other predator, which keeps them safe from attack
Humans have the strongest grip of any animal, making them impossible to overpower
Humans live in such large groups that no predator dares to attack them
explanation: Humans are considered apex predators because no animal regularly hunts us, and we use our intelligence and tools rather than physical weapons.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nagtatanong: 'Apex predator ba ang tao?' Sa isang paraan, oo—walang ibang hayop ang regular na nanghuhuli sa atin. Pero hindi natin ito nagagawa gamit ang matatalas na ngipin o kuko kundi sa pamamagitan ng utak at mga kagamitan na ating ginagawa.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang mangutana: 'Apex predator ba ang tawo?' Sa usa ka paagi, oo—walay laing hayop nga kanunay mangayam kanato. Apan dili nato kini mahimo pinaagi sa hait nga ngipon o kuko kondili pinaagi sa atong utok ug mga galamiton nga atong gihimo.

q: Why is the pawikan (sea turtle) protected by Philippine law?
options: It is endangered and needs protection to survive
It is a pest that destroys coral reefs if not controlled
It is a sacred animal used in traditional Filipino ceremonies
It produces a valuable substance that medicines are made from
explanation: The pawikan is protected by law in the Philippines because it is endangered.
fact_tl: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) ay isang malaking pagong-dagat na matatagpuan sa karagatan ng Pilipinas at ipinagbabawal na hulihin dahil malapit nang maubos.
fact_bis: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) usa ka dakong pawikan sa dagat nga makita sa kadagatan sa Pilipinas, ug gidili kining dakpon kay hapit na mahurot.

q: What is the long-term result of catching too many fish from the sea at once?
options: Fishers will have far fewer fish to catch in the future
The remaining fish will grow larger to replace those that were taken
Fish populations recover fully within just one or two months
The sea will stay just as full of fish because new ones migrate in
explanation: Overfishing reduces fish populations so much that fishers will find far fewer fish to catch in the future.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang panghuli ngayon, mas kaunti na lang ang isda na mahuhuli ng mga mangingisda sa hinaharap.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang pagpangisda karon, gamay na lang ang isda nga makuha sa mga mangingisda unya.

q: Why do some kids enjoy eating bitter ampalaya while others cannot stand it?
options: People differ in how sensitive they are to tastes
Ampalaya tastes different depending on how it is cooked, not who is eating it
Children who eat more vegetables automatically like bitter foods
The bitterness of ampalaya disappears as children grow older
explanation: People differ in how sensitive they are to tastes, so the same food can taste very bitter to one person and mild to another.
fact_tl: Iba-iba ang sensitibo ng mga tao sa lasa, kaya may ilang batang ayaw sa mapait na ampalaya na masarap naman sa iba.
fact_bis: Lahi-lahi ang pagkabati sa mga tawo sa lami, mao nga adunay mga bata nga dili ganahan sa pait nga paliya nga lami para sa uban.

q: How is a temperature colder than the freezing point of water written on a thermometer?
options: As a negative number, like minus 5 degrees Celsius
As zero degrees, because nothing can be colder than freezing
As a fraction, like one-half of zero degrees
As a Roman numeral to avoid confusion with normal readings
explanation: Temperatures colder than the freezing point are written as negative numbers, such as minus 5 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang temperaturang mas malamig pa sa freezing point ay isinusulat bilang negatibong numero, gaya ng minus 5 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Ang temperatura nga mas bugnaw pa sa freezing point gisulat isip negatibong numero, sama sa minus 5 ka degrees Celsius.

q: What is special about the Andromeda galaxy compared to other large galaxies?
options: It is the nearest large galaxy to the Milky Way and can be seen with the naked eye on a very dark night
It is the largest galaxy in the universe and contains trillions of stars
It is moving away from the Milky Way faster than any other galaxy
It is the only galaxy besides the Milky Way that contains known planets
explanation: Andromeda is the nearest large galaxy to the Milky Way and appears as a faint smudge visible to the naked eye on a very dark night.
fact_tl: Ang Andromeda ang pinakamalapit na malaking galaxy sa Milky Way, at sa napakadilim na langit ay nakikita ito ng mata bilang malabong batik kahit napakalayo nito.
fact_bis: Ang Andromeda mao ang labing duol nga dakong galaxy sa Milky Way, ug sa ngitngit kaayong langit makita kini sa mata isip hanap nga batik bisan layo kaayo kini.

q: What kind of diet does a lion have?
options: It eats only meat, making it a carnivore
It eats plants and meat, making it an omnivore
It eats only plants, making it a herbivore
It eats mostly fish, making it a piscivore
explanation: The lion is a carnivore that eats only meat, hunting animals like zebras, antelope, and wild buffalo.
fact_tl: Ang leon (lion) ay isang malaking mandaragit (predator) na pusa na kumakain lamang ng karne — karnivora ito. Nangangaso ito ng mga hayop tulad ng sebra, antelope, at ligaw na kalabaw.
fact_bis: Ang leon (lion) usa ka dakong manunukob nga iring nga mokaon lamang og karne — karnivora kini. Mangayam kini og mga hayop sama sa zebra, antelope, ug ihalas nga kalabaw.

q: What do insects use their antennae for?
options: To sense smell and touch in their environment
To see in the dark when their eyes cannot
To produce sounds to communicate with other insects
To balance themselves while walking or flying
explanation: Insects use their antennae to sense smell and touch, helping them detect food, danger, and their surroundings.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga insekto ang kanilang antenyo para maramdaman ang amoy at haplos sa paligid nila.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga insekto ang ilang antenyo aron makaamgo ug makamatikod sa ilang palibut.

q: What is the difference between the magnitude and the intensity of an earthquake?
options: Magnitude is one number for the whole earthquake's strength at the source, while intensity varies from place to place
Magnitude measures the shaking felt by people, while intensity measures the energy released underground
Magnitude changes from city to city, while intensity stays the same everywhere
Magnitude is measured after the earthquake, while intensity is predicted before it strikes
explanation: Magnitude is a single number describing an earthquake's strength at the source, while intensity changes depending on how far a place is from the epicenter.
fact_tl: Ang magnitude ay isang bilang lang para sa buong lindol (lakas sa pinagmulan), pero ang intensity ay nag-iiba depende sa lugar — mas malakas malapit sa epicenter.
fact_bis: Ang magnitude usa ra ka numero alang sa tibuok linog (kakusog sa tinubdan), apan ang intensity nagkalainlain matag lugar — mas kusog duol sa epicenter.

q: What does a solar panel need in order to produce electricity?
options: Light from the sun
Heat from warm temperatures
Both light and high heat together
Strong winds alongside sunlight
explanation: A solar panel needs light, not heat, to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Ang solar panel ay nangangailangan ng liwanag, hindi init, para gumawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang solar panel nagkinahanglan ug kahayag, dili kainit, aron makahimo ug koryente.

q: What happens to heat energy when liquid water freezes into ice?
options: Water releases heat into its surroundings as it freezes
Water absorbs a large amount of heat from its surroundings as it freezes
No heat energy moves at all during freezing
Water absorbs heat first, then releases it once fully frozen
explanation: When water freezes, it actually releases heat into its surroundings, even though the resulting ice feels cold.
fact_tl: Kapag nagyeyelo ang tubig, naglalabas ito ng kaunting init papunta sa paligid. Kaya't kahit nagiging malamig na ang yelo, may init pa rin itong ibinibigay habang nagbabago mula likido patungong solido.
fact_bis: Kung mag-yelo ang tubig, mogawas gamay nga kainit ngadto sa palibot. Bisan tugnaw ang yelo, naghatag pa kini ug kainit samtang mausab gikan sa likido ngadto sa solido.

q: Which taste do lemon juice and vinegar both have?
options: Sour
Bitter
Salty
Umami
explanation: Sour is one of the five basic tastes, and both lemon juice and vinegar are well-known examples of sour foods.
fact_tl: Ang maasim ay isa sa limang batayang lasa, gaya ng lasa ng kalamansi o suka.
fact_bis: Ang aslom usa sa lima ka sukaranang lami, sama sa lami sa kalamansi o suka.

q: How do twining vines climb up a pole or another plant?
options: By spiraling their whole stem around the support like a corkscrew
By hooking small thorns into the surface of the support
By releasing a sticky glue from their leaves to hold on
By sending out wide flat roots that wrap around the base
explanation: Twining vines climb by spiraling their entire stem around a pole or plant in a corkscrew pattern.
fact_tl: Ang ilang baging ay umaakyat sa pamamagitan ng pag-ikot ng buong tangkay nito paikot sa isang haligi o ibang halaman na parang espiral.
fact_bis: Ang ubang baging mosaka pinaagi sa paglikos sa tibuok tangkay niini palibot sa tukon o ubang tanom nga morag espiral.

q: What does a goat eat, and what type of animal does that make it?
options: Only plants, making it a herbivore
Only meat, making it a carnivore
Both plants and meat, making it an omnivore
Only grains and seeds, making it a granivore
explanation: A goat eats only plants such as grass, which makes it a herbivore.
fact_tl: Ang kambing ay alagang hayop na herbivore o pawang halaman ang kinakain, kaya madalas itong makitang nanginginain ng damo sa bakuran o parang.
fact_bis: Ang kanding usa ka alagang mananap nga herbivore o tanom lang ang gikaon, mao nga kanunay kini makita nga nagsibsib ug sagbot sa nataran o kapatagan.

q: After oxygen, which element is the second most abundant in Earth's crust?
options: Silicon
Iron
Aluminum
Carbon
explanation: The second most abundant element in Earth's crust is silicon, with oxygen being the most abundant.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang pinakamaraming element sa balat ng Daigdig ay silicon, sunod sa oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang labing daghang elemento sa balat sa Yuta mao ang silicon, sunod sa oxygen.

q: What kind of living organism is yeast, and how does it reproduce?
options: A single-celled fungus that reproduces by budding
A single-celled bacterium that reproduces by splitting in two
A tiny plant that reproduces by releasing spores into the air
A microscopic animal that reproduces by laying eggs
explanation: Yeast is a living single-celled fungus that multiplies by budding and produces gas and alcohol through fermentation.
fact_tl: Ang lebadura ay isang buhay na isang-selulang halamang-singaw (fungus) na dumarami sa pamamagitan ng pagsibol, at sa proseso ng fermentation ito ang gumagawa ng gas at alkohol mula sa asukal.
fact_bis: Ang lebadura usa ka buhi nga usa-ka-selula nga fungus nga nagdaghan pinaagi sa pagturok, ug pinaagi sa fermentation kini ang nagahimo ug gas ug alkohol gikan sa asukal.

q: Who built the first airplane?
options: The Wright brothers
Thomas Edison
Alexander Graham Bell
Nikola Tesla
explanation: The first airplane was built by the Wright brothers.
fact_tl: Ang unang eroplano ay ginawa ng magkapatid na Wright (Wright brothers).
fact_bis: Ang unang eroplano gihimo sa managsoon nga Wright (Wright brothers).

q: Why is it dangerous to let static electricity build up near gasoline?
options: A static spark can ignite the gasoline and cause a fire
Static electricity makes gasoline evaporate faster and spill over
Static charges attract gasoline vapors, causing the container to explode on its own
Static electricity freezes the fuel pump, making it impossible to control the flow
explanation: A static spark near gasoline can ignite it, which is why warnings tell people to avoid building up static electricity while pouring fuel.
fact_tl: Ang static spark ay maaaring delikado malapit sa gasolina o iba pang madaling magliyab na bagay, dahil kayang magpasiklab ito ng apoy. Kaya may mga babala na huwag mag-ipon ng static habang nagbubuhos ng gasolina.
fact_bis: Ang static spark mahimong delikado duol sa gasolina o uban pang dali masunog nga butang, kay makahimo kini sa pagdagkot og kalayo. Mao nga adunay mga pasidaan nga likayan ang pag-ipon og static samtang magbubo og gasolina.

q: How does a weaver ant colony begin?
options: One queen starts the colony by laying all the eggs
A group of workers leaves an old colony to build a new one together
Two queens fight until one wins the right to found the colony
Workers collect eggs from other nests to start a new colony
explanation: Every weaver ant colony begins with one queen who lays the eggs for all the other ants in the colony.
fact_tl: Ang bawat kolonya ng hantik ay nagsisimula sa isang reyna na nangingitlog ng lahat ng mga langgam.
fact_bis: Ang matag kolonya sa hantik magsugod sa usa ka rayna nga mangitlog sa tanang langgam.

q: How are fault-block mountains formed?
options: A large crack in the crust causes one block of rock to be lifted up while the block beside it drops down
Two tectonic plates slowly push against each other and fold the land upward
A series of volcanic eruptions builds up layers of lava that harden into high peaks
A river cuts deeply into flat land, leaving tall columns of rock standing on both sides
explanation: Fault-block mountains form when a fault splits the crust and one block is pushed upward while the adjacent block drops, creating steep, sharp sides.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng mountain range ay galing sa pagkukulot ng lupa. May iba na nabubuo kapag biniyak ng malaking bitak (fault) ang balat ng lupa, at ang isang malaking bloke ng bato ay napapataas habang ang katabi naman ay bumababa. Tinatawag itong fault-block mountains, at madalas na matulis at matarik ang gilid nito.
fact_bis: Dili tanang mountain range gikan sa nakuhal nga yuta. Adunay uban nga maporma kung biakon sa dakong liki (fault) ang panit sa yuta, ug ang usa ka dakong bloke sa bato mosaka samtang ang tupad niini monaog. Gitawag kini og fault-block mountains, ug kasagaran tarik ug talinis ang kilid niini.

q: Which scientist discovered the neutron?
options: James Chadwick
Ernest Rutherford
Niels Bohr
Marie Curie
explanation: James Chadwick discovered the neutron, the particle inside the nucleus that has no electric charge.
fact_tl: Si James Chadwick ang nakatuklas ng neutron, ang particle na walang charge.
fact_bis: Si James Chadwick ang nakadiskobre sa neutron, ang partikulo nga walay charge.

q: What does the reaction rate of a chemical reaction tell you?
options: How fast the reactants are used up or the products are formed over time
How much energy is released when the chemicals first touch each other
How many molecules are present in the reaction mixture at the start
How hot the mixture gets before the reaction is complete
explanation: The reaction rate describes how fast the reactants are consumed or the products are created over a period of time.
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng reaksyon (reaction rate) ay kung gaano kabilis nauubos ang mga reactant o nabubuo ang mga product sa isang yugto ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang tulin sa reaksiyon (reaction rate) mao kon unsa ka paspas mahurot ang mga reactant o maporma ang mga product sulod sa usa ka yugto sa panahon.

q: About how much blood does a 10-year-old child's body contain?
options: About 3 to 4 liters
About 1 to 2 liters
About 6 to 7 liters
About 8 to 10 liters
explanation: A 10-year-old child's body contains about 3 to 4 liters of blood that the heart continuously recirculates.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng isang bata na nasa edad 10 ay may halos 3 hanggang 4 na litro ng dugo na patuloy na nire-recirculate ng puso.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa usa ka bata nga 10 anyos adunay mga 3 hangtud 4 ka litro sa dugo nga kanunay nga gi-recirculate sa puso.

q: Why can we not see the bacteria living in our gut with our eyes alone?
options: They are too tiny to see without a microscope
They hide behind the lining of the stomach at all times
They are transparent so light passes straight through them
They only appear at night when the gut is resting
explanation: Gut bacteria are so tiny that a microscope is needed to see them.
fact_tl: Ang gut bacteria ay napakaliit kaya hindi natin ito nakikita nang walang mikroskopyo.
fact_bis: Ang gut bacteria gagmay kaayo mao nga dili nato kini makita kon walay mikroskopyo.

q: Which discovery caused astronomers to reclassify Pluto as a dwarf planet in 2006?
options: The discovery of the dwarf planet Eris, which is almost as big as Pluto
The discovery that Pluto has no moons to keep it in a true planetary orbit
The discovery that Pluto is made mostly of ice rather than rock
The discovery of a gap in the solar system where Pluto's orbit should not fit
explanation: The discovery of Eris, a dwarf planet nearly the same size as Pluto, led astronomers to reclassify Pluto in 2006.
fact_tl: Ang pagkatuklas sa dwarf planet na Eris, na halos kasinglaki ng Pluto, ang nag-udyok sa mga astronomo na muling uriin ang Pluto noong 2006.
fact_bis: Ang pagkadiskobre sa dwarf planet nga Eris, halos kasing kadak-on sa Pluto, maoy nag-aghat sa mga astronomo nga i-classify pag-usab ang Pluto niadtong 2006.

q: Which was the Philippines' first geothermal power plant, and where is it located?
options: Tiwi in Albay, which began operating in 1979
Makban in Laguna, which opened in 1980
Palinpinon in Negros Oriental, which opened in 1983
Mindanao in Lanao del Norte, which opened in 1977
explanation: The Philippines' first geothermal power plant was Tiwi in Albay, which began operating in 1979.
fact_tl: Ang unang geothermal power plant ng Pilipinas ay ang Tiwi sa Albay, na nagsimulang gumana noong 1979.
fact_bis: Ang unang geothermal power plant sa Pilipinas mao ang Tiwi sa Albay, nga nagsugod og dagan niadtong 1979.

q: Which plant can be grown by planting a cut piece of stem in the soil instead of a seed?
options: Cassava
Papaya
Mongo bean
Corn
explanation: Plants like cassava can be grown from stem cuttings because new roots sprout from the cut stem when placed in soil.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng halaman ay galing sa buto. Maraming halaman tulad ng kamoteng kahoy at kangkong ay maaaring itanim mula sa isang putol na tangkay — tutubo dito ang bagong ugat sa lupa at magiging bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga tanom gikan sa liso. Daghang tanom sama sa kamoteng kahoy ug kangkong mahimong itanom gikan sa usa ka putol nga punoan — motubo dinhi ang bag-ong gamot sa yuta ug mahimong bag-ong tanom.

q: When a teks card is slapped down and flies through the air, what force makes it flip and spin?
options: Gravity pulling it down
Air pushing against its flat surface
Magnetism from the ground
The player's hand shaking it
explanation: Air pushing against the surface of the lightweight cardboard creates resistance that makes the teks card flip and spin as it flies.
fact_tl: Kapag inihampas ang teks, ang sumasalpok na hangin sa ibabaw nito ang nagpapabaligtad at nagpapaikot ng kartong laro habang ito ay lumilipad.
fact_bis: Kon ihampak ang teks, ang hangin nga mosumpaki sa ibabaw niini maoy hinungdan nga mobaliskad ug moliyok ang gaan nga kartong laro samtang molupad.

q: Mycorrhizal fungi live in plant roots and help the plant absorb minerals. What does the plant give the fungi in return?
options: Sugars
Oxygen
Water
Carbon dioxide
explanation: In this mutualistic relationship, mycorrhizal fungi help plant roots absorb phosphorus and minerals, and in return the plant supplies sugars to the fungi.
fact_tl: Ang mycorrhizal fungi ay mga fungi na naninirahan sa ugat ng halaman at tumutulong sa pagsipsip ng phosphorus at iba pang mineral mula sa lupa—kapalit nito, ang halaman ay nagbibigay ng asukal sa fungi.
fact_bis: Ang mycorrhizal fungi mga fungi nga nagpuyo sa gamot sa tanum ug nakatubang sa pagsuyop sa phosphorus ug uban pang mineral gikan sa yuta; kapalit niini, ang tanum naghatag og asukal sa fungi—usa ka mutualistic nga relasyon.

q: For two gears to work together properly, what must be true about their teeth?
options: The teeth must be the same size and shape
The larger gear must have twice as many teeth
The teeth must point in opposite directions
One gear must have no teeth at all
explanation: Gear teeth must be the same size and shape so they can mesh together properly; mismatched teeth will slip instead of turning smoothly.
fact_tl: Para magkadikit nang maayos ang dalawang gear, kailangang magkapareho ang sukat at hugis ng kanilang mga ngipin. Kung hindi, hindi sila tutugma at madudulas.
fact_bis: Aron magkadukit ug maayo ang duha ka gear, kinahanglan parehas ang gidak-on ug porma sa ilang mga ngipin. Kung dili, dili sila mohaom ug modangin.

q: Why can light travel from the Sun all the way to Earth even though space has no air?
options: Because light is an electromagnetic wave that does not need a medium
Because air particles drift out of the atmosphere into space
Because gravity pulls light through empty space
Because light is carried by the solar wind
explanation: Light is an electromagnetic wave, so unlike sound it does not need any medium like air or water to travel — it can move through a perfect vacuum.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ay isang electromagnetic wave kaya nakakapaglakbay ito kahit sa vacuum (walang hangin) ng kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag usa ka electromagnetic wave mao nga makabiyahe kini bisan sa bakuom (walay hangin) sa kawanangan.

q: What do the letters WWW stand for in a website address?
options: World Wide Web
Wireless Wide Wave
World Wire Web
Wide World Wavelength
explanation: WWW stands for World Wide Web, the system of linked pages and resources accessed over the internet.
fact_tl: Ang WWW ay nangangahulugang World Wide Web.
fact_bis: Ang WWW nagpasabot og World Wide Web.

q: Which Philippine agency uses alert levels from 0 to 5 to show how close a volcano is to erupting?
options: PHIVOLCS
PAG-ASA
DENR
NDRRMC
explanation: PHIVOLCS uses alert levels from 0 to 5 to indicate how close a volcano is to erupting, with higher numbers meaning greater danger.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS ng mga antas ng alerto mula 0 hanggang 5 upang ipakita kung gaano kalapit pumutok ang isang bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS naggamit og mga lebel sa alerto gikan sa 0 hangtod 5 aron ipakita kung unsa kaduol mobuto ang usa ka bulkan.

q: How does a sponge digest its food if it has no mouth or stomach?
options: It digests food right inside its own cells
It absorbs nutrients through a special skin layer
It filters food through tiny teeth
It relies on bacteria living inside it to digest for it
explanation: Because sponges have no mouth or stomach, they digest food inside their own individual cells rather than in a central digestive organ.
fact_tl: Walang bibig o tiyan ang espongha, kaya tinutunaw nito ang pagkain sa loob mismo ng mga selula nito.
fact_bis: Ang espongha walay baba o tiyan, busa gihilis niini ang pagkaon sulod mismo sa mga selula niini.

q: Where do cloud rats shelter and raise their young?
options: In hollows inside ancient trees of old-growth forests
In burrows dug deep in rice fields
Under rocks near mountain streams
In nests built on top of bamboo groves
explanation: Cloud rats depend on old-growth forests, using hollows in ancient trees for shelter and for raising their young.
fact_tl: Ang mga cloud rat ay nangangailangan ng matandang kagubatan para mabuhay, dahil gumagamit sila ng mga butas ng mga matandang puno para matulog at manganak.
fact_bis: Ang mga cloud rat nanginahanglan sa tigulang nga kagubatan aron mabuhi, mogamit sa mga guwang sa mga tigulang nga kahoy alang sa pahingalay ug pag-atiman sa ilang mga anak.

q: What is one way that too many chemical pesticides harm food crops?
options: They kill bees that are needed to pollinate crops so less fruit is produced
They make soil too salty for roots to absorb water
They cause plants to grow too tall and fall over
They block sunlight from reaching the leaves
explanation: Too much chemical pesticide can harm bees, and without bees to pollinate crops, many plants struggle to produce fruit.
fact_tl: Mahalagang pangalagaan ang mga bubuyog dahil kapag bumaba ang bilang nila, mahihirapang mamunga ang maraming pananim—nakakasama sa kanila ang labis na kemikal o pestisidyo sa bukid.
fact_bis: Importante nga panalipdan ang mga putyukan kay kon mokunhod ang ilang gidaghanon, maglisod og pamunga ang daghang tanom—makadaot kanila ang sobra nga kemikal o pestisidyo sa uma.

q: What did Edward Jenner use to create the world's first vaccine against smallpox?
options: Cowpox
Chicken pox
Measles
Rabies
explanation: Edward Jenner discovered that infecting people with cowpox protected them against the much more dangerous smallpox disease.
fact_tl: Ginamit ni Edward Jenner ang cowpox (bulutong-baka) para makagawa ng bakuna laban sa smallpox.
fact_bis: Gigamit ni Edward Jenner ang cowpox (bulutong-baka) aron makahimo og bakuna batok sa smallpox.

q: Why does covering a flame with a fire blanket put out the fire?
options: It removes the oxygen the fire needs to keep burning
It cools the fuel below its melting point
It adds water vapor that soaks the fuel
It presses the flame flat until it dies
explanation: Combustion requires oxygen, so covering flames with a fire blanket cuts off the oxygen supply and the fire goes out.
fact_tl: Ang oxygen ay kailangan para magsunugan ang mga bagay. Kung aalisin ang oxygen mula sa isang sunog (hal., sa pamamagitan ng pagtakip sa apoy), ang sunog ay mamamatay. Ito ang prinsipyo ng fire blanket at ng ilang fire extinguisher.
fact_bis: Ang oxygen kinahanglan alang sa combustion (pagsusunog). Kon ang oxygen mawagtang gikan sa sunog — pananglitan pinaagi sa pagtabon sa apoy — ang sunog mamatay. Kini ang prinsipyo sa fire blanket ug sa pipila ka fire extinguisher.

q: Why does warm ocean water make typhoons stronger?
options: Warmer water causes more evaporation, providing more energy to the storm
Warm water pushes typhoons away from land
Warm water reduces air pressure so the storm moves faster
Warm water makes ocean waves taller so the wind is blocked
explanation: Warm Pacific water — typically above 26°C — fuels typhoons by increasing evaporation, which supplies more energy and intensifies the storm.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na tubig ng Karagatang Pasipiko — karaniwang higit sa 26°C — ay nagbibigay ng enerhiya sa mga bagyo sa pamamagitan ng evaporation — ang mas mainit ang tubig, mas malakas ang potensyal na bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang mainit nga tubig sa Karagatang Pasipiko — kasagaran labaw sa 26°C — nagasugnod sa mga bagyo pinaagi sa evaporation — ang mas mainit nga tubig sa dagat nagahatag og mas daghang enerhiya alang sa mas kusog nga mga bagyo.

q: In which layer of the atmosphere do most meteors burn up before reaching the ground?
options: Mesosphere
Stratosphere
Troposphere
Thermosphere
explanation: The mesosphere is the third layer of the atmosphere and the place where most meteors burn up, creating what we see as shooting stars.
fact_tl: Ang mesosphere ang ikatlong layer at ang pinakamalamig na bahagi ng atmosphere; dito nasusunog ang karamihan ng meteor o bulalakaw bago pa sila tumama sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mesosphere mao ang ikatlong layer ug ang kinabugnaw nga bahin sa atmosphere; dinhi masunog ang kadaghanan sa mga meteor o bulalakaw sa dili pa sila makaabot sa yuta.

q: How does a glass prism split white light into all the colors of the rainbow?
options: Each color bends by a different amount when passing through the glass
The glass reflects each color in a different direction off its flat surface
The colors were already separated inside the light and the prism just reveals them
The glass absorbs some colors and lets others pass through
explanation: A prism splits light into colors because each color refracts (bends) by a different amount inside the glass, spreading them apart.
fact_tl: Hinahati ng prisma ang liwanag dahil iba-iba ang antas ng pagbaluktot (refraction) ng bawat kulay sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Gibahin sa prisma ang kahayag tungod kay lahi-lahi ang gidaghanon sa pagbaluktot (refraction) sa matag kolor sulod niini.

q: What body parts does a tilapia use to move through the water?
options: Its fins and tail
Its gills and mouth
Its scales and skin
Its eyes and nostrils
explanation: Tilapia uses its fins and tail to swim and steer through water.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang tilapia ng mga palikpik at buntot upang lumangoy sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tilapia mogamit sa iyang mga kapay ug ikog aron molangoy sa tubig.

q: Which bird is regarded as one of the heaviest birds that can still fly?
options: Great bustard
Ostrich
Emperor penguin
Emu
