explanation: The great bustard is considered one of the heaviest birds capable of flight, unlike the ostrich or emu which cannot fly at all.
fact_tl: Ang great bustard ay itinuturing na isa sa pinakamabigat na ibong kayang lumipad.
fact_bis: Ang great bustard giila nga usa sa pinakabug-at nga langgam nga makahimo gihapon paglupad.

q: Why can an eagle spot a small animal from very high in the sky?
options: Because an eagle has extremely sharp eyesight
Because small animals make loud sounds the eagle hears
Because the eagle uses its sense of smell to track prey
Because the eagle flies low to the ground when hunting
explanation: An eagle's eyesight is extremely sharp, allowing it to see small prey from great heights while soaring.
fact_tl: Napakatalas ng paningin ng agila kaya kaya nitong makita ang isang maliit na hayop kahit nasa napakataas pa ito sa himpapawid.
fact_bis: Hilabihan ka hait ang panan-aw sa agila mao nga makita niini ang gamay nga hayop bisan taas pa kaayo kini sa kawanangan.

q: What is latik made from?
options: Simmered coconut milk that separates into brown crunchy curds
Fermented rice mixed with coconut sugar
Dried coconut strips fried in palm oil
Ground coconut flesh pressed into flat cakes
explanation: Latik is formed when coconut milk is simmered until the heat separates the oil from the solid coconut fat, leaving behind brown crunchy curds.
fact_tl: Ang latik ay ang kayumanggi at malutong na tira kapag pinakuluan ang gata; ang init ay naghihiwalay ng langis sa solidong taba ng niyog.
fact_bis: Ang latik mao ang kape ug tagiktik nga sobra kung lutoon ang gata; ang kainit nagbulag sa lana gikan sa gahi nga tambok sa lubi.

q: Why does genetic drift have a bigger effect on small populations than on large ones?
options: In small populations, random events can remove many genes at once, greatly changing gene frequencies
Small populations breed faster so genes change more quickly
Larger populations have weaker genes that change more easily
Genetic drift only affects animals that live in groups of ten or fewer
explanation: Genetic drift means random changes in allele frequency — in small populations a disaster can randomly wipe out much of the genetic diversity at once, making the effect very large.
fact_tl: Ang genetic drift ay nagpapakita na ang mga random na pagbabago sa frequency ng allele ay mas malaki ang epekto sa maliliit na populasyon — ang mga malagim na pangyayari tulad ng bagyo ay maaaring random na mabawasan ang genetic diversity ng isang maliit na populasyon.
fact_bis: Ang genetic drift nagpakita nga ang mga random nga pagbag-o sa frequency sa allele adunay mas dagko nga epekto sa gagmay nga mga populasyon — ang mga katalagman sama sa bagyo mahimong random nga mabawasan ang genetic diversity sa usa ka gamay nga populasyon.

q: Why is it better to wait a while after eating before doing hard exercise?
options: Because your stomach may hurt while it is still digesting your food
Because food makes your muscles temporarily weaker
Because exercising right after eating makes you grow taller too fast
Because your heart beats too slowly right after a meal
explanation: Doing hard exercise too soon after eating can cause stomach pain because the digestive system is still working on your food.
fact_tl: Mas mabuting maghintay ng kaunti pagkatapos kumain bago mag-ehersisyo. Kasi kung agad kang gagalaw, baka sumakit ang tiyan mo habang tinutunaw pa ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Mas maayong maghulat og gamay human mokaon una mag-ehersisyo og kusog. Kung molihok ka dayon, basin masakit ang imong tiyan samtang gitunaw pa ang pagkaon.

q: Why were even people who felt perfectly healthy asked to wear masks during the COVID-19 pandemic?
options: Because a person can carry and spread the COVID-19 virus even without feeling any symptoms
Because masks protect the eyes from dust particles that carry the virus
Because wearing masks prevents the body from absorbing the virus through the skin
Because healthy people's breath is warmer and spreads the virus farther
explanation: COVID-19 can be spread by people who carry the virus but feel no symptoms at all, which is why even apparently healthy people wore masks.
fact_tl: Isang nakakagulat na bagay tungkol sa COVID-19: minsan, ang isang tao ay may virus at nakakahawa pa sa iba kahit wala siyang nararamdamang sakit. Kaya kahit mukhang malusog ang isang tao, puwede pa rin siyang magpasa ng virus. Ito ang isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit nagsuot ng mask kahit ang mga hindi pa nagkakasakit.
fact_bis: Usa ka makapakurat nga butang bahin sa COVID-19: usahay, ang usa ka tawo nagdala sa virus ug makatakod sa uban bisan walay gibati nga sakit. Busa bisan morag himsog ang usa ka tawo, mahimo pa gihapon niyang ikapasa ang virus. Mao kini ang usa ka rason nganong nag-mask bisan ang mga wala pa magsakit.

q: What happens to wood to turn it into petrified wood?
options: Minerals slowly replace the wood until it becomes stone
The wood freezes solid inside a glacier for millions of years
Bacteria eat away the wood and leave behind a rock-shaped hole
Heat from a volcano bakes the wood into charcoal
explanation: Petrified wood forms when minerals slowly replace the original wood material, turning it completely to stone over a very long time.
fact_tl: Ang petrified wood ay isang fossil kung saan ang tunay na kahoy ay unti-unting pinalitan ng mineral hanggang sa maging bato ito.
fact_bis: Ang petrified wood usa ka fossil diin ang tinuod nga kahoy hinay-hinay nga gipulihan og mineral hangtod nga nahimo kining bato.

q: Where is Earth's magnetic North Pole located compared to the geographic North Pole?
options: Hundreds of kilometers away from the geographic North Pole
At exactly the same spot as the geographic North Pole
Directly below the geographic North Pole inside the crust
Somewhere in the Southern Hemisphere
explanation: The magnetic North Pole is hundreds of kilometers away from the true geographic North Pole, so the two poles are different points on Earth.
fact_tl: Karaniwang akala ng mga bata ay nasa eksaktong itaas at ibaba ng Earth (sa axis na iniikutan nito) ang magnetic poles. Pero hindi! Ang magnetic North pole ay nasa lugar na medyo malayo — daan-daang kilometro ang layo mula sa tunay na hilagang dulo ng Earth. Kaya ang magnetic poles at ang geographic poles ay dalawang magkaibang punto, hindi sila magkapatong.
fact_bis: Kasagarang hunahuna sa mga bata nga ang magnetic poles anaa gyud sa ibabaw ug ubos sa Yuta (sa axis nga gilibutan niini). Apan dili! Ang magnetic North pole anaa sa lugar nga medyo layo — gatusan ka kilometro ang gilay-on gikan sa tinuod nga amihanang tumoy sa Yuta. Mao nga ang magnetic poles ug ang geographic poles duha ka lahi nga punto, dili sila magtapaw.

q: What is a yawn?
options: A deep, slow breath that pulls a big gulp of air into the lungs
A fast, short breath that pushes air quickly out of the lungs
A movement of the jaw that helps clear fluid from the ears
A reflex that helps cool the brain down when it is overheated
explanation: A yawn is a deep, slow breath that draws a large amount of air into the lungs, and we often do it when tired or bored.
fact_tl: Ang paghikab ay isang malalim at mabagal na paghinga na nagpapapasok ng maraming hangin sa baga. Madalas tayong humihikab kapag pagod o inip, at kahit hindi pa sigurado ang mga siyentista kung bakit, alam nating nakakahawa ito.
fact_bis: Ang paghuwaw usa ka lawom ug hinay nga pagginhawa nga mosuyop og daghang hangin sa baga. Kasagaran kita mohuwaw kon gikapoy o gilaayan, ug bisan dili pa sigurado ang mga siyentista kon ngano, nahibalo kita nga makatakod kini.

q: Which layer of Earth is the thinnest?
options: The crust
The mantle
The outer core
The inner core
explanation: The crust is the thinnest of Earth's layers when compared to the thick mantle and the core beneath it.
fact_tl: Ang crust ang pinakamanipis na layer ng Mundo kumpara sa mantle at core.
fact_bis: Ang crust mao ang pinakanipis nga layer sa Kalibutan kumpara sa mantle ug core.

q: In what year did Emilio Aguinaldo die?
explanation: Emilio Aguinaldo, the first President of the Philippines, died on February 6, 1964.
fact_tl: Si Emilio Aguinaldo ay namatay noong Pebrero 6, 1964.
fact_bis: Si Emilio Aguinaldo namatay niadtong Pebrero 6, 1964.

q: What is Marie Curie most famous for in science?
options: Researching radioactivity and discovering the elements radium and polonium
Inventing the light bulb and the phonograph
Developing the theory of relativity and the equation E=mc²
Discovering penicillin and saving millions of lives
explanation: Marie Curie is celebrated for her groundbreaking research on radioactivity and for discovering two new elements — radium and polonium.
fact_tl: Tanyag si Marie Curie sa pag-aaral ng radyaktibidad (radioactivity) at sa pagtuklas ng mga elementong radium at polonium.
fact_bis: Bantog si Marie Curie sa iyang pagtuon sa radyaktibidad (radioactivity) ug sa pagdiskubre sa mga elemento nga radium ug polonium.

q: How does a phagocyte white blood cell destroy a germ?
options: It surrounds and swallows the germ, eating it until it is destroyed
It releases chemicals that burst the germ from a distance
It marks the germ so that antibodies can dissolve it later
It traps the germ in a sticky web until the germ runs out of energy
explanation: A phagocyte is a type of white blood cell that surrounds and engulfs germs, digesting them until they are completely destroyed.
fact_tl: May uri ng white blood cell na tinatawag na phagocyte na binabalot at nilalamon ang germ na parang nilululon ito hanggang masira.
fact_bis: Adunay matang sa white blood cell nga gitawag og phagocyte nga molibot ug molamoy sa germ, ginakaon kini hangtod malaglag.

q: How did lionfish end up in the Atlantic Ocean when they naturally live in the Indo-Pacific?
options: They escaped from aquariums and established themselves in the new ocean
Strong ocean currents carried them around the tip of Africa
They were deliberately released by fishermen to control other fish populations
Climate change warmed the Atlantic enough for them to swim through the Arctic
explanation: Lionfish became invasive in the Atlantic after escaping from aquariums; they have no natural predators there, so they multiply rapidly and eat many native fish.
fact_tl: Ang lionfish ay katutubong sa Indo-Pacific ngunit naging invasive sa Atlantic Ocean matapos makalabas mula sa mga aquarium, kung saan kumakain nito ng maraming uri ng katutubong isda nang walang natural na kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang lionfish katutubong sa Indo-Pacific apan nahimong invasive sa Atlantic Ocean human makagawas gikan sa mga aquarium, diin sila mangaon sa daghang katutubong isda nga walay natural nga kaaway.

q: What is one big difference between worker ants and worker bees?
options: Bees can fly and make honey, but worker ants do not fly or make honey
Ants work for a queen but bees work alone without a queen
Worker bees are male while worker ants are female
Ants live in colonies but bees always live alone
explanation: Worker ants and worker bees are both female and both serve a queen in a colony, but bees fly and produce honey while worker ants do neither.
fact_tl: Parang magkapatid na ideya ang worker ant at worker bee. Pareho silang babae, pareho silang nagtatrabaho para sa reyna, at pareho silang nakatira sa kolonya. Ang pinagkaiba, ang bubuyog ay lumilipad at gumagawa ng pulot.
fact_bis: Sama sa managsoon nga ideya ang worker ant ug worker bee. Parehong babaye sila, parehong nagtrabaho para sa reyna, ug parehong nagpuyo sa kolonya. Ang kalainan, ang putyukan molupad ug mohimo ug dugos.

q: What happens to the best, freshest yellowfin tuna caught in the Philippines?
options: It is exported to other countries to be made into sashimi
It is canned immediately and sold in local grocery stores
It is frozen and used in schools for free lunch programs
It is dried in the sun and sold as a local delicacy
explanation: The highest-quality, freshest yellowfin tuna from the Philippines is exported abroad to be used as sashimi.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamasarap at sariwang yellowfin tuna mula sa Pilipinas ay ipinapadala sa ibang bansa para gawing sashimi.
fact_bis: Ang labing lami ug presko nga yellowfin tuna gikan sa Pilipinas ipadala sa ubang nasod aron himoong sashimi.

q: Where is the DNA found inside a bacterium?
options: Floating freely inside the cell because bacteria have no nucleus
Locked inside a nucleus like in plant and animal cells
Stored in mitochondria scattered around the cell
Wrapped around the outer membrane of the cell
explanation: Bacteria have no nucleus, so their DNA is not enclosed in a membrane but floats freely inside the cell.
fact_tl: Ang bakterya ay walang nucleus, kaya ang DNA nito ay lutang sa loob ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang bakterya walay nucleus, busa ang DNA niini naglutaw sa sulod sa selula.

q: Why do astronauts float inside a space station?
options: Because they and the station are both falling around Earth together
Because there is no gravity at all in space
Because the engines push them away from Earth's gravity
Because the space station spins to create an upward push
explanation: Astronauts appear weightless because both they and the space station are falling around Earth together in orbit, so neither one falls faster than the other.
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang mga astronaut sa loob ng istasyon sa kalawakan dahil sila at ang istasyon ay magkasabay na nahuhulog sa paligid ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut molutaw sulod sa istasyon sa kawanangan tungod kay sila ug ang istasyon dungan nga nahulog libot sa Yuta.

q: What is a pneumatic system?
options: A system that uses compressed air to power tools and machines
A system that uses flowing water to move heavy objects
A system that uses electric coils to generate force
A system that uses magnets to drive rotating gears
explanation: A pneumatic system transmits force through compressed air and is used to power tools such as drills and air hammers.
fact_tl: Ang pneumatic system ay gumagamit ng naka-compress na hangin para patakbuhin ang mga kasangkapan at makina tulad ng mga drill, nagtutulak ng hangin para magbigay ng puwersa.
fact_bis: Ang pneumatic system naggamit sa compressed air aron ipadagan ang mga kasangkapan ug makina sama sa mga drill ug air hammer, nagbalhin sa puwersa pinaagi sa presurized nga hangin.

q: Why does the amount of ozone in the stratosphere stay at a fairly steady level naturally?
options: Because ozone is constantly being created from oxygen and broken apart by sunlight at roughly the same rate
Because ozone sinks down and is replaced by fresh ozone from space every day
Because sunlight only destroys ozone in the lower atmosphere and not in the stratosphere
Because the stratosphere is too cold for ozone to break down
explanation: In the stratosphere, ozone forms from oxygen at about the same rate that sunlight destroys it, so the two processes balance and keep ozone levels stable.
fact_tl: Sa stratosphere, palaging may ozone na nabubuo mula sa oxygen at sabay namang may nasisira dahil sa sinag ng araw. Dahil halos pantay ang dalawang ito, nananatiling sapat ang dami ng ozone para protektahan tayo.
fact_bis: Sa stratosphere, kanunay nga adunay ozone nga maporma gikan sa oxygen ug dungan usab nga adunay maguba tungod sa sidlak sa adlaw. Tungod kay halos patas ang duha, magpabilin nga igo ang gidaghanon sa ozone aron manalipod kanato.

q: Why is Reduce considered better than Recycle when dealing with trash?
options: Because if you avoid making the trash in the first place, no energy is needed to clean, melt, or remake it
Because recycling always creates more pollution than throwing things away
Because reduction programs cost more money than recycling programs
Because recycled materials can never be made into products as good as new ones
explanation: Reducing waste is the best choice because not creating trash at all means no energy is spent on collecting, sorting, melting, or remaking materials.
fact_tl: Mas mabuti ang Reduce kaysa Recycle dahil kung hindi mo na gagawa ng basura, wala nang kailangang linisin, tunawin, o gawing bago, na lahat ay nangangailangan ng enerhiya. Ang pag-iwas sa basura mula sa simula ang pinakamabisang paraan.
fact_bis: Mas maayo ang Reduce kaysa Recycle tungod kay kon dili ka maghimo ug basura, wala nay kinahanglan limpyohan, tunawon, o himuong bag-o, nga tanan nanginahanglan ug enerhiya. Ang paglikay sa basura gikan sa sinugdanan mao ang labing epektibo nga paagi.

q: Why is Mayon Volcano called the most active volcano in the Philippines?
options: Because it has erupted many times over the past centuries
Because it is the tallest volcano in the country
Because it is the only volcano in the Philippines that is still growing
Because it has the largest crater of any volcano in Asia
explanation: Mayon earns the title of most active Philippine volcano because of the many eruptions it has had throughout recorded history.
fact_tl: Ang Mayon ang pinakaaktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas dahil madalas itong pumutok sa nakaraang mga siglo.
fact_bis: Ang Mayon mao ang labing aktibo nga bulkan sa Pilipinas tungod kay kanunay kini nga miputok sa milabay nga mga siglo.

q: What is the job of the hard outer husk of a mango seed?
options: To protect the real seed kernel inside so it does not get crushed or dry out
To store food that the mango tree uses during the dry season
To help the seed float on water and travel to new places
To attract animals so they will carry the seed away
explanation: The hard outer husk of a mango seed acts like a protective box, keeping the inner seed kernel safe from being crushed or drying out before it can grow.
fact_tl: Ang buto ng mangga ay may matigas na balot na tinatawag na husk. Parang kahon ito na nagpoprotekta sa totoong binhi na nasa loob, para hindi ito masira o matuyo bago tumubo.
fact_bis: Ang liso sa mangga adunay gahi nga panit nga gitawag og husk. Murag gamay nga kahon kini nga nanalipod sa tinuod nga liso sa sulod aron dili kini madunot o mamala una pa kini moturok.

q: What would happen if there were no fungi or other decomposers in nature?
options: Dead things would pile up and nutrients could not return to the soil
Animals would have to eat plants much faster to prevent build-up
The soil would become too wet because nothing dries out the dead matter
Plants would grow faster because they would have less competition
explanation: Without decomposers like fungi, dead plants and animals would pile up and the nutrients locked inside them could never return to the soil for new life to use.
fact_tl: Kung walang fungi at iba pang tagabulok, magtatambak ang mga patay na bagay at hindi makakabalik ang sustansya sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Kon walay fungi ug ubang tagabulok, magtapok ang patay nga mga butang ug dili makabalik ang sustansya sa kalikasan.

q: When is the Cagayan River most likely to overflow and cause floods?
options: During the rainy and typhoon season
During the hot dry summer months
During the planting season in March and April
During the cool December to February months
explanation: The Cagayan River often overflows and causes floods during the rainy and typhoon season when heavy rains raise water levels.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Cagayan ay madalas umaapaw at nagdudulot ng baha tuwing tag-ulan at panahon ng bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Cagayan kanunay mag-awas ug magpahinabog baha panahon sa ting-ulan ug bagyo.

q: What does a calamansi fruit look like on the outside?
options: Small and round, usually green
Large and oval, usually orange
Long and thin, usually yellow
Bumpy and purple like a grape
explanation: The calamansi is a small, round citrus fruit that is usually green on the outside.
fact_tl: Ang kalamansi ay isang maliit at bilog na prutas na karaniwang berde sa labas.
fact_bis: Ang kalamansi usa ka gamay ug lingin nga prutas nga kasagaran berde sa gawas.

q: Why does rainwater slowly dissolve limestone rocks over time?
options: Because rainwater is slightly acidic and acid breaks down limestone
Because rainwater is very hot and melts the rock surface
Because rainwater carries sand that scrapes away the rock
Because rainwater freezes inside cracks and splits the rock apart
explanation: Rainwater is slightly acidic, so it reacts with and slowly dissolves certain rocks like limestone — this process is called chemical weathering.
fact_tl: Ang ulan ay bahagyang maasim, kaya unti-unti nitong tinutunaw ang ilang bato tulad ng limestone (apog). Ito ang chemical weathering.
fact_bis: Ang ulan gamay nga aslom, busa hinay-hinay niini matunaw ang pipila ka bato sama sa limestone. Kini ang chemical weathering.

q: What was Sputnik 1, launched in 1957?
options: The first artificial satellite to orbit Earth, built by the Soviet Union
The first crewed spacecraft to travel to the Moon
The first rocket to break through Earth's atmosphere
The first space telescope to photograph distant stars
explanation: Sputnik 1, launched by the Soviet Union on October 4, 1957, was a simple metal sphere that became the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.
fact_tl: Ang Sputnik 1 ng Soviet Union, na inilunsad noong Oktubre 4, 1957, ang unang artificial satellite na nag-orbit ng Earth; ito ay isang simpleng metal sphere na may diameter na 58 sentimetro na nagpapadala ng radio signal pabalik sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Sputnik 1 sa Soviet Union, gilunsad niadtong Oktubre 4, 1957, mao ang unang artificial satellite nga nag-orbit sa Yuta; kini usa ka simple nga metal sphere nga 58 sentimetros ang gilapdon nga nagpadala og radio signal pabalik sa Yuta.

q: What is the asthenosphere?
options: A hot, softer layer of the mantle on which tectonic plates slowly slide
The outermost solid rock layer that forms Earth's surface
The liquid iron layer at the center of Earth
A thin gas layer just below the crust that contains trapped heat
explanation: The asthenosphere is a hotter, softer part of the mantle just beneath the lithosphere, and it is the layer on which tectonic plates slowly move.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng lithosphere ay ang asthenosphere, isang mas mainit at malambot na bahagi ng mantle kung saan dahan-dahang umuusad ang mga plate na nasa ibabaw nito.
fact_bis: Ilalom sa lithosphere mao ang asthenosphere, usa ka mas init ug mas humok nga bahin sa mantle diin hinay nga naglihok ang mga plate nga anaa sa ibabaw niini.

q: What makes sourdough bread have its distinctive tangy flavor?
options: Lactic acid bacteria in the starter that produce acids during fermentation
Extra vinegar that is added to the dough before baking
A special type of salt harvested from the ocean floor
Wild yeast that releases a sour gas when the bread is baked
explanation: Sourdough's tangy flavor comes from lactic acid bacteria in the starter, which produce acids while the bread ferments.
fact_tl: Ang sourdough bread ay ginagawa gamit ang isang 'starter' na naglalaman ng wild yeast at lactic acid bacteria — ang yeast ay gumagawa ng CO2 para lumaki ang tinapay, habang ang bacteria ay gumagawa ng mga asim na nagbibigay ng kakaibang lasa.
fact_bis: Ang sourdough bread gihimo gamit ang usa ka 'starter' nga adunay wild yeast ug lactic acid bacteria — ang yeast nagbuhat og CO2 aron maakon ang tinapay samtang ang bacteria nagbuhat og mga asido nga naghatag sa kahalagahang lasa sa sourdough.

q: How many antennae does every insect have?
options: Two
Four
Six
Eight
explanation: All insects have exactly two antennae, which they use to feel and smell their surroundings.
fact_tl: Ang bawat insekto ay may dalawang (2) antena na ginagamit nila para makaramdam at makaamoy.
fact_bis: Ang matag insekto adunay duha (2) ka antena nga ilang gamiton aron makabati ug makasimhot.

q: What does Alert Level 5 mean in the PHIVOLCS volcano alert system?
options: The most dangerous level, indicating a major eruption is happening or imminent
A low-level warning that scientists are monitoring increased activity
A signal that the volcano has gone dormant and is no longer dangerous
A notice that ash fall has been detected in nearby towns
explanation: PHIVOLCS uses Alert Levels 0 to 5 for volcanoes, and Level 5 is the highest and most dangerous, indicating a major eruption.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS ng Alert Level 0 hanggang 5 para sa mga bulkan, kung saan ang 5 ang pinakadelikado.
fact_bis: Naggamit ang PHIVOLCS og Alert Level 0 hangtod 5 para sa mga bulkan, diin ang 5 ang labing delikado.

q: About how many elements exist, and what can be made from them?
options: About 118 elements, and they can combine to form millions of different substances
About 12 elements, and each one can only make one type of substance
About 500 elements, but only 10 of them are common on Earth
About 1,000 elements, and scientists have not yet discovered most of them
explanation: There are only about 118 elements, but by combining them in different ways, millions of different substances can be formed.
fact_tl: Bagaman mga 118 lamang ang elemento, milyon-milyong iba't ibang substansya sa mundo ang nabubuo sa pamamagitan ng pagsasama-sama ng mga elementong ito sa iba't ibang paraan.
fact_bis: Bisan og mga 118 ra ka elemento, minilyong lainlaing substansya sa kalibotan ang naporma pinaagi sa pagsagol niini nga mga elemento sa lainlaing paagi.

q: When you make hand shadows on a wall using one light bulb, what is the very dark center of the shadow called?
options: Penumbra
Umbra
Eclipse
Silhouette
explanation: The darkest, innermost part of a shadow is called the umbra, while the fuzzy outer edge is the penumbra.
fact_tl: Sa bahay tuwing gabi, gamit ang isang bombilya, pwede kang gumawa ng anino ng kamay sa dingding. Mapapansin mo ang madilim na umbra sa loob at ang malabong penumbra sa gilid.
fact_bis: Sa balay kada gabii, gamit ang usa ka bombilya, makahimo ka og landong sa kamot sa bongbong. Imong mamatikdan ang ngitngit nga umbra sa sulod ug ang hanap nga penumbra sa ngilit.

q: What is the trade-off when you use a lever to make lifting something easier?
options: You have to use a stronger material for the lever
You must push your end of the lever through a longer distance
The lever creates extra energy to help you
The object becomes lighter on the other end
explanation: A lever does not create extra energy — to lift something more easily, you must push your end through a longer distance, so there is always a trade-off.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang lever ay nagbibigay ng libreng lakas. Hindi ito gumagawa ng dagdag na enerhiya. Para mas magaan ang pagbuhat, kailangan mong itulak ang dulo sa mas malayong distansya. Kaya may kapalit ang ginhawa.
fact_bis: Sayop nga tuo nga ang lever mohatag ug libre nga kusog. Wala kini maghimo ug dugang nga enerhiya. Aron mas sayon ang pag-alsa, kinahanglan nimong iduot ang tumoy sa mas layo nga gilay-on. Mao nga adunay baylo ang kasayon.

q: Why are coral reefs sometimes called the 'rainforests of the sea'?
options: Because they are found in warm tropical water just like rainforests
Because they are green and look like underwater forests
Because a huge variety of sea life lives there, even though they cover only a small part of the ocean
Because they produce oxygen the way trees in a rainforest do
explanation: Coral reefs earn the nickname 'rainforests of the sea' because they host an enormous variety of fish and sea life despite covering only a small part of the ocean floor.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na 'rainforest ng dagat' ang coral reef dahil bagaman maliit lang na bahagi ng karagatan ang sakop nito, dito nakatira ang napakaraming uri ng isda at hayop-dagat.
fact_bis: Gitawag nga 'rainforest sa dagat' ang coral reef kay bisan gamay ra nga bahin sa kadagatan ang gisakpan niini, dinhi nagpuyo ang daghan kaayong matang sa isda ug kinabuhi sa dagat.

q: What is one important job that bacteria living in your gut do for your body?
options: They digest all your food so your stomach does not have to work
They train your immune system to tell harmful microbes from helpful ones
They produce vitamins that replace the need to eat vegetables
They keep your gut warm so digestion works faster
explanation: Gut bacteria help train the immune system to recognize and distinguish harmful microbes from harmless or helpful ones.
fact_tl: Tinutulungan ng gut bacteria ang ating immune system na matutong makilala ang masama sa mabuting mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang gut bacteria nagatabang sa atong immune system nga makakat-on mailhan ang daotan ug ang maayong mikrobyo.

q: How many chambers does the human heart have?
options: Two
Three
Four
Six
explanation: The human heart has four chambers that work together to pump blood throughout the body.
fact_tl: Ang puso ng tao ay may apat na (4) bahagi o silid.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing sa tawo adunay upat (4) ka lawak o bahin.

q: Are 'light' or menthol cigarettes safer to smoke than regular cigarettes?
options: Yes, they have fewer harmful chemicals so the health risk is lower
Yes, the menthol cools the smoke and protects your lungs
No, they still reduce your health and carry the same poisonous chemicals
No, but only because menthol cigarettes have more nicotine
explanation: 'Light' and menthol cigarettes are not safe — they still contain the same poisonous chemicals and harm your health just like regular cigarettes.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba na ligtas ang 'light' o menthol na sigarilyo, pero mali ito, nakakabawas pa rin sa kalusugan at may parehong nakakalasong kemikal ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga luwas ang 'light' o menthol nga sigarilyo, apan sayop kini, makakunhod gihapon sa panglawas ug parehas ra ang makahilo nga kemikal niini.

q: How do floodplains and wetlands beside Philippine rivers help communities during heavy rain?
options: They speed up the flow of river water so it reaches the sea faster
They act like natural sponges, absorbing extra water and reducing flood damage
They block rainwater from ever entering the river
They filter the water and make it safe to drink right away
explanation: Floodplains and wetlands beside rivers act like natural sponges, absorbing excess water and reducing flood damage to nearby communities.
fact_tl: Ang mga floodplain at wetland sa tabi ng mga ilog ng Pilipinas ay gumaganap na tulad ng natural na bato-tubo, sumisipsip ng dagdag na tubig at nagpapababa ng pinsala ng baha sa mga komunidad.
fact_bis: Ang mga floodplain ug wetland sa tabi sa mga ilog sa Pilipinas nagtrabaho sama sa natural nga espongha, nagsuyop sa sobrang tubig ug nagpakunhod sa kadaut sa baha sa mga komunidad.

q: What happens to the refrigerant gas on the outside of the fridge?
options: It turns into ice and freezes the air around the fridge
It turns back into liquid and releases the heat it carried
It stays as a gas and slowly cools the room
It is filtered out to remove bad smells from the kitchen
explanation: Outside the fridge, the refrigerant gas condenses back into liquid and releases the heat it collected from inside.
fact_tl: Sa labas ng ref, ang singaw na refrigerant ay nagiging likido muli at inilalabas ang init na dala nito.
fact_bis: Sa gawas sa ref, ang gas nga refrigerant mobalik pagkaliquid ug ipagawas ang kainit nga gidala niini.

q: Why is carbon monoxide in cigarette smoke dangerous to your body?
options: It makes the blood too thick to flow through the heart
It reduces the oxygen the blood should carry to the body
It burns the inside of the lungs directly
It causes the heart to beat too fast
explanation: Carbon monoxide in cigarette smoke reduces the amount of oxygen that blood can carry to the body.
fact_tl: Ang usok ng sigarilyo ay may carbon monoxide, isang gas na bumabawas sa oksiheno na dapat dalhin ng dugo sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang aso sa sigarilyo adunay carbon monoxide, usa ka gas nga makakunhod sa oksiheno nga angay dad-on sa dugo ngadto sa lawas.

q: How does the pitcher plant attract insects to its trap?
options: It shakes its leaves to startle insects into falling in
It glows in the dark to attract insects at night
It lures insects with sweet-smelling nectar around the rim of its cup
It grows near water where insects already gather
explanation: The pitcher plant lures insects by producing sweet-smelling nectar around the rim of its cup-shaped trap.
fact_tl: Nang-aakit ang pitcher plant ng insekto sa pamamagitan ng matamis at mabangong nektar sa labi ng tasa nito.
fact_bis: Ang pitcher plant modani ug insekto pinaagi sa tam-is ug humot nga nektar sa ngabil sa tasa niini.

q: Why is photosynthesis described as the doorway through which the sun's energy enters all living things?
options: Because sunlight warms the soil so all living things stay alive
Because plants use photosynthesis to make food that animals eat, passing the sun's energy up the food chain
Because photosynthesis produces the oxygen that every living thing breathes
Because the sun's rays travel directly into animals through their skin during photosynthesis
explanation: Plants use photosynthesis to convert sunlight into food; animals eat those plants, and other animals eat them — so nearly all energy in a food web starts with photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang photosynthesis ang pinto kung saan pumapasok ang enerhiya ng araw sa lahat ng nabubuhay. Ang mga halaman (producers) ang gumagawa ng pagkain, kinakain sila ng mga hayop, at sila naman ay kinakain ng iba. Kaya halos lahat ng enerhiya sa food web ay nagsisimula sa photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Ang photosynthesis mao ang pultahan diin mosulod ang enerhiya sa adlaw sa tanang buhi. Ang mga tanom (producers) maghimo sa pagkaon, kan-on sila sa mga hayop, ug kadtong mga hayop kan-on sa uban. Busa halos tanang enerhiya sa food web magsugod sa photosynthesis.

q: Why does a tadpole's gut become shorter when it turns into a frog?
options: The frog's body grows bigger so the gut takes up less space
The frog stops eating altogether during the change
The gut shrinks because the frog switches from eating plants to eating animals
The frog's digestive system is replaced by a completely new one
explanation: A tadpole has a long gut to digest plants, but when it becomes a frog and switches to eating animals, the gut becomes shorter to match its new meat-based diet.
fact_tl: Mahaba ang bituka ng tadpole para sa pagkaing-halaman, ngunit umiikli ito kapag naging palaka na dahil lumilipat ito sa pagkain ng hayop.
fact_bis: Taas ang tinai sa tadpole para sa pagtunaw og tanom, apan momubo kini kon mahimo na kining baki kay mobalhin kini sa pagkaon og mananap.

q: Why do scientists think there may have once been tiny living things on Mars?
options: Because Mars has the right amount of oxygen in its atmosphere today
Because Mars is the planet closest to Earth in the solar system
Because Mars once had water, which living things need to survive
Because spacecraft have found plant fossils on the Martian surface
explanation: Scientists think microbes may have once existed on Mars because evidence shows Mars once had liquid water, which living things need to survive.
fact_tl: Iniisip ng mga siyentipiko na maaaring nagkaroon ng napakaliliit na nilalang tulad ng mikrobyo sa Mars noong may tubig pa ito.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang mga siyentista nga tingali adunay gagmay kaayo nga binuhat sama sa mikrobyo sa Mars kaniadto sa dihay tubig pa kini.

q: A reef shark has no swim bladder. How does it keep from sinking?
options: It constantly swims upward with its powerful tail fins
It has hollow bones that are lighter than water
It has a large liver full of oil that is lighter than water, which helps it float
It swallows air at the surface to stay buoyant
explanation: Instead of a swim bladder, a reef shark has a large liver full of oil that is lighter than water, helping it stay afloat.
fact_tl: Walang swim bladder ang reef shark gaya ng karaniwang isda na tumutulong sa paglutang. Sa halip, may malaki itong atay na puno ng langis na mas magaan kaysa tubig, kaya hindi ito agad lumulubog.
fact_bis: Ang reef shark walay swim bladder sama sa ordinaryong isda nga makatabang molutaw. Hinuon, aduna kini dako nga atay nga puno sa lana nga mas gaan kaysa tubig, busa dili kini dali nga molunod.

q: When a seed starts to grow, which part comes out first?
options: The stem
The leaf
The flower bud
The root
explanation: The root is the first part to emerge from a germinating seed so it can absorb water and anchor the plant in the soil.
fact_tl: Kapag nagsisimula tumubo ang buto, ang ugat ang unang lumalabas para makahanap ng tubig sa lupa.
fact_bis: Kung magsugod og turok ang liso, ang gamot mao ang unang mogawas aron makakita og tubig sa yuta.

q: Which element in the periodic table is the lightest of all?
options: Helium
Oxygen
Hydrogen
Nitrogen
explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest element on the periodic table.
fact_tl: Ang hydrogen (haydroheno) ang pinakamagaan na elemento sa periodic table.
fact_bis: Ang hydrogen mao ang labing gaan nga elemento sa periodic table.

q: Newton's third law of motion says that for every action there is what?
options: A faster and stronger reaction in the same direction
An equal and opposite reaction
A delayed reaction that depends on the object's mass
A weaker reaction that fades over time
explanation: Newton's third law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction.
fact_tl: Ang ikatlong batas ni Newton ay nagsasabing sa bawat aksyon ay may katumbas at kabaligtarang reaksyon (action-reaction).
fact_bis: Ang ikatulong balaod ni Newton nag-ingon nga sa matag aksyon adunay managsama ug kaatbang nga reaksyon (action-reaction).

q: Which dam supplies about 90% of Metro Manila's tap water?
options: Pantabangan Dam in Nueva Ecija
Magat Dam in Isabela
Angat Dam in Bulacan
Caliraya Dam in Laguna
explanation: Angat Dam in Bulacan is the main source of about 90% of Metro Manila's tap water supply.
fact_tl: Ang Angat Dam sa Bulacan ang pinagmumulan ng halos 90% ng tubig-gripo ng Metro Manila.
fact_bis: Ang Angat Dam sa Bulacan mao ang gigikanan sa halos 90% sa tubig-gripo sa Metro Manila.

q: What is amber, and why is it important to scientists who study ancient life?
options: A type of dark rock that forms under volcanoes and sometimes traps bones
Hardened tree resin from ancient trees that can trap and preserve insects as fossils
A mineral crystal that forms underground and shows the age of rock layers
A sticky mud that hardens over time and records animal footprints
explanation: Amber is hardened ancient tree resin that sometimes traps insects, preserving them as fossils for scientists to study.
fact_tl: Ang amber ay tumigas na dagta ng sinaunang puno, at minsan may nakulong na mga insekto rito na naging fossil.
fact_bis: Ang amber mao ang gahi nga dagta sa karaang kahoy, ug usahay adunay nabilanggo nga mga insekto niini nga nahimong fossil.

q: Why do animals in the same area often compete with each other?
options: They compete to show which species is the most intelligent
Food and water in any place are limited, so animals must compete for them
They fight to decide which group will migrate first when the season changes
Animals compete only if they are the same species and need the same mate
explanation: Because food and water are limited in any habitat, animals that share the same place must compete for these resources.
fact_tl: Dahil limitado ang pagkain at tubig, ang mga hayop ay nag-aagawan o nagkukumpitensya sa parehong lugar.
fact_bis: Tungod kay limitado ang pagkaon ug tubig, ang mga hayop mag-indigay o magkompetensya niini sa samang lugar.

q: Why can't a sea turtle hide inside its shell the way a land turtle can?
options: Its shell is too thin and flexible to provide protection
Sea turtles lost their shells through millions of years of evolution
It has large flippers instead of feet, and cannot pull its head or flippers inside its shell
The salt water would damage its soft body if it retreated inside
explanation: Sea turtles have large flippers instead of retractable feet, so they are unable to pull their head or flippers inside their shell.
fact_tl: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) ay may malalaking kapay sa halip na paa at hindi nito kayang itago ang ulo o kapay sa loob ng kabibe.
fact_bis: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) adunay dagkong kapay imbes nga tiil ug dili kini makatago sa ulo o kapay sulod sa bao.

q: What does the spinal cord do that the brain does not do on its own?
options: It stores long-term memories so the brain can focus on thinking
It produces the hormones that control mood and growth
It acts as a message highway between the brain and body, and also handles some reflexes
It controls breathing and heartbeat without any help from the brain
explanation: The spinal cord carries messages up and down between the brain and body, and it also handles some reflexes independently.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang trabaho ng utak at spinal cord pero magkatuwang sila. Ang utak ang nag-iisip at nagdedesisyon; ang spinal cord naman ay parang highway na nagdadala ng mensahe pataas at pababa sa pagitan ng utak at ng katawan, at humahawak din ng ilang reflex.
fact_bis: Lahi ang trabaho sa utok ug sa spinal cord apan magkatambayayong sila. Ang utok maghunahuna ug magdesisyon; ang spinal cord sama sa highway nga magdala og mensahe pataas ug paubos tali sa utok ug sa lawas, ug magdumala usab og pipila ka reflex.

q: What color does phenolphthalein turn when it is placed in a base?
options: Yellow
Red
Blue
Pink
explanation: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acid and turns pink when placed in a base.
fact_tl: Ang iba't ibang acid-base indicator ay nagbabago sa iba't ibang kulay sa iba't ibang pH: ang phenolphthalein ay walang kulay sa acid at nagiging rosas sa base, habang ang methyl orange ay pula sa acid at dilaw sa base.
fact_bis: Ang lain-laing acid-base indicator nagbag-o sa lain-laing kulay sa lain-laing pH: ang phenolphthalein walay kolor sa acid ug nahimong rosas sa base, samtang ang methyl orange pula sa acid ug dalaw sa base.

q: What is the hardest natural substance found on Earth?
options: Quartz
Diamond
Granite
Steel
explanation: Diamond is the hardest natural substance on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang diamante (diamond) ang pinakamatigas na likas na sangkap sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang diamante (diamond) mao ang pinakagahi nga natural nga substansiya sa kalibotan.

q: Which equation correctly shows how to calculate power?
options: Power = Work × Time
Power = Force ÷ Distance
Power = Work ÷ Time
Power = Mass × Speed
explanation: Power is calculated by dividing the work done by the time it takes: P = W ÷ t.
fact_tl: Ang power (lakas) ay katumbas ng gawa hinati sa oras: Power = Work ÷ Time (P = W ÷ t).
fact_bis: Ang power (gahum) parehas sa trabaho nga bahinon sa oras: Power = Work ÷ Time (P = W ÷ t).

q: What happens to the trees as you climb higher up a mountain?
options: Trees grow taller because they need to reach more sunlight
Trees stay the same but their leaves change color due to less rainfall
Trees get smaller and shorter, and near the very top there may be no trees at all
Trees grow only on one side of the mountain where the wind blows
explanation: Because it gets colder at higher altitudes, trees become smaller and shorter as you climb, and near the very top the cold prevents trees from growing at all.
fact_tl: Dahil mas malamig sa taas, nagbabago ang mga halaman habang umaakyat ka sa bundok — mas maliit at mas mababa ang mga puno sa itaas, at sa pinakatuktok ay maaaring wala nang puno dahil sobrang lamig.
fact_bis: Tungod kay mas bugnaw sa taas, mausab ang mga tanom samtang mosaka ka sa bukid — mahimong gagmay ug mubo ang mga kahoy sa taas, ug sa tumoy mahimong wala nay kahoy kay bugnaw kaayo.

q: Why do vehicles like jeepneys have springs?
options: To make the vehicle roll faster on flat roads
To store electrical energy when the vehicle slows down
To soak up the jolt when the vehicle passes over bumps
To keep the wheels from spinning too fast
explanation: Vehicles have springs to absorb the jolt when they drive over bumps, giving passengers a smoother ride.
fact_tl: May mga spring ang mga sasakyan gaya ng jeepney upang sipsipin ang yanig kapag dumaan sa lubak.
fact_bis: Ang mga sakyanan sama sa jeepney adunay mga spring aron suhopon ang pag-alog kon moagi sa mga lubak.

q: Why does puto pao become soft and fluffy when it is steamed?
options: The steam washes away the heavy parts of the dough
The dough absorbs water from the steam and becomes heavier
Tiny gas bubbles inside the dough grow larger when heated, making it fluffy
The heat melts the sugar in the dough and creates air pockets
explanation: Puto pao becomes soft and fluffy because tiny gas bubbles trapped in the dough expand when heat is applied during steaming.
fact_tl: Ang puto pao ay malambot at maaliwalas dahil sa loob ng masa nito ay may maliliit na bula ng gas na lumalaki kapag pinasisingawan.
fact_bis: Ang puto pao humok ug habog kay adunay gagmay nga bula sa gas sulod sa minasa niini nga modako kon pasingawan.

q: How does a fruit dove help new trees grow in a forest?
options: It digs holes in the ground where tree seeds can fall and sprout
It waters young seedlings with water it carries in its crop
When it eats fruit, it spreads the seeds so new trees can grow
It chases away insects that would eat young tree shoots
explanation: When a fruit dove eats fruit, it disperses the seeds through its droppings, allowing new trees to grow in different spots.
fact_tl: Kapag kumakain ang fruit dove ng prutas, naikakalat nito ang mga buto kaya tumutubo ang bagong puno.
fact_bis: Kung mokaon ang fruit dove ug prutas, makatag niini ang mga liso aron motubo ang bag-ong kahoy.

q: Why do we see different star constellations in the sky at different times of the year?
options: Because the stars move around the Earth at different speeds each season
Because clouds block different parts of the sky in different seasons
Because the Earth orbits around the Sun, changing which part of the sky we face at night
Because the Moon reflects light onto different constellations each season
explanation: As the Earth orbits the Sun throughout the year, we face different regions of the night sky, so different constellations become visible each season.
fact_tl: Iba't ibang konstelasyon ang nakikita sa magkakaibang panahon ng taon dahil umiikot ang Earth sa paligid ng Araw.
fact_bis: Lahi-lahi nga konstelasyon ang makita sa managlahing panahon sa tuig tungod kay ang kalibutan naglibot sa Adlaw.

q: Why do places near the sea, like most of the Philippines, tend to have milder temperatures than places far inland?
options: Sea winds carry cold air from the polar regions to coastal areas
The sea blocks the sun's rays from reaching coastal land directly
Water needs a lot of energy to change temperature, so the sea heats up and cools down slowly, keeping nearby places mild
Coastal soil contains more minerals that absorb and release heat slowly
explanation: Water has a very high specific heat, meaning it heats and cools slowly, which helps keep coastal areas like most of the Philippines at milder temperatures.
fact_tl: Ang tubig ay may napakataas na specific heat — kailangan ng maraming enerhiya upang magbago ang temperatura nito. Kaya naman ang mga lugar malapit sa dagat (tulad ng karamihan sa Pilipinas) ay may mas malambot na temperatura kaysa sa mga lugar na malayo sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tubig adunay napaka-taas nga specific heat — kinahanglan og daghang enerhiya aron mabag-o ang iyang temperatura. Mao kana kung ngano ang mga lugar duol sa dagat (sama sa kadaghanan sa Pilipinas) adunay mas malumo nga mga temperatura kaysa sa mga lugar nga layo sa dagat.

q: How do mangrove forests help fight climate change?
options: They block storm winds so less carbon dioxide is produced by damaged buildings
They cool the ocean water around them, slowing down global warming
They absorb and store large amounts of carbon in their mud
They release oxygen into the water, which absorbs carbon from the air
explanation: Mangroves help fight climate change by absorbing and storing large amounts of carbon in their mud and roots.
fact_tl: Sinisipsip at iniimbak ng mga mangrove ang malaking halaga ng carbon sa kanilang putik, na nakatutulong laban sa pagbabago ng klima.
fact_bis: Ang mangrove magsuyop ug magtipig og daghang carbon sa ilang lapok, nga makatabang batok sa pagbag-o sa klima.

q: What do wave energy converters do with the motion of ocean waves?
options: They slow ocean waves down so ships can travel more safely
They transform wave motion into electricity as a renewable energy source
They use wave energy to desalinate seawater for drinking
They store wave energy in large batteries under the ocean floor
explanation: Wave energy converters transform the motion of ocean waves into electricity, making it a promising renewable energy source especially for island nations like the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang mga alon ng karagatan ay nagdadala ng napakalaking enerhiya — ang mga wave energy converter ay nagko-convert ng galaw ng mga alon sa kuryente, isang promising na renewable energy source para sa mga islang Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang mga alon sa karagatan nagdala og napakalaking enerhiya — ang mga wave energy converter nagpretend sa galaw sa mga alon ngadto sa kuryente, usa ka promising nga renewable energy source alang sa mga isla nga nasud sama sa Pilipinas.

q: What does it mean when we say trash is 'biodegradable'?
options: It can be melted down and turned into new plastic products
It can be burned safely without producing harmful smoke
It can rot or break down naturally in the environment
It can be recycled into paper or cardboard
explanation: Biodegradable trash can rot or break down naturally, which is why sorting it from non-biodegradable waste makes disposal easier.
fact_tl: Ang pag-uuri ng basura ay ang paghihiwalay nito sa nabubulok (biodegradable) at hindi nabubulok (non-biodegradable). Mas madaling maitapon o magamit muli ang basura kapag tama itong inuri.
fact_bis: Ang pag-uri sa basura mao ang paglain niini ngadto sa madunot (biodegradable) ug dili madunot (non-biodegradable). Mas sayon ilabay o magamit pag-usab ang basura kon husto kining giuri.

q: How do earthworms help plants grow better?
options: They eat harmful insects that would damage plant roots underground
They add nutrients directly to leaves by crawling up plant stems
Their tunnels in the soil make it easier for plant roots to grow down
They carry water from underground streams up to where roots can reach it
explanation: As earthworms move through the soil they create tunnels, which makes it easier for plant roots to grow deeper into the ground.
fact_tl: Ang mga lungga ng bulate ay nagbibigay-daan para mas madaling lumago ang ugat ng halaman papunta sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga lungag sa bulate makahatag og dalan aron mas sayon motubo ang gamot sa tanom paingon sa yuta.

q: How do leptospirosis germs enter a person's body?
options: By being breathed in through the nose when near infected rats
Through cuts or scrapes when wading in dirty floodwater
By drinking water that has not been boiled
Through mosquito bites in flooded areas
explanation: Leptospirosis germs enter the body through cuts or scrapes when a person wades through dirty floodwater contaminated with the bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang mikrobyo ng leptospirosis ay pumapasok sa katawan sa pamamagitan ng sugat o galos kapag lumusong sa marumi na baha.
fact_bis: Ang mikrobyo sa leptospirosis mosulod sa lawas pinaagi sa samad o gisi sa panit kung molusong sa hugaw nga baha.

q: How does leptospirosis mainly spread from infected animals to floodwater?
options: Infected animals shed skin cells into the water that carry the bacteria
The disease is carried by mosquitoes that bite infected rats
Leptospirosis spreads through the urine of infected animals, especially rats
The bacteria float in the air around infected animals and fall into water
explanation: Leptospirosis spreads through the urine of infected animals, especially rats, which contaminates floodwater and soil.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang leptospirosis sa pamamagitan ng ihi ng mga hayop na may sakit, lalo na ng daga.
fact_bis: Mokuyanap ang leptospirosis pinaagi sa ihi sa mga hayop nga may sakit, ilabi na sa ilaga.

q: Why do you see a lightning flash before you hear the thunder it makes?
options: Your eyes react faster than your ears, so you notice light first
Thunder is produced a few seconds after the lightning flash actually happens
Sound travels much more slowly than light, so the light reaches you first
Light and sound travel at the same speed, but lightning is brighter so it grabs attention first
explanation: Light travels far faster than sound, so the light from lightning reaches your eyes long before the sound of thunder reaches your ears.
fact_tl: Mas mabagal ang tunog kaysa liwanag, kaya nakikita muna ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog.
fact_bis: Ang tingog mas hinay kaysa kahayag, mao nga makita una ang kilat sa dili pa madungog ang dalogdog.

q: Which path does urine follow to leave your body?
options: Bladder → ureters → kidneys → urethra
Kidneys → urethra → bladder → ureters
Kidneys → ureters → bladder → urethra
Ureters → kidneys → urethra → bladder
explanation: Urine is made in the kidneys, flows down the ureters, collects in the bladder, and exits the body through the urethra.
fact_tl: Dumadaloy ang ihi mula sa bato pababa sa makitid na tubo na ureter, naiipon sa pantog, at lumalabas sa katawan sa tubong urethra.
fact_bis: Ang ihi modagayday gikan sa kidney paubos sa pig-ot nga mga tubo nga ureter, magtigom sa pantog, ug mogawas sa lawas pinaagi sa urethra.

q: Which group of animals usually gives live birth instead of laying eggs?
options: Birds
Reptiles
Amphibians
Mammals
explanation: Most mammals give live birth, while fish, amphibians, reptiles, and birds usually reproduce by laying eggs.
fact_tl: Ang isda, ampibya, reptilya, at ibon ay karaniwang nangingitlog, samantalang karamihan ng mamalya ay nanganganak.
fact_bis: Ang isda, amphibian, reptilya, ug langgam kasagaran mangitlog, samtang kadaghanan sa mga mammal manganak.

q: Who bought Nikola Tesla's AC motor patents to use for electric power?
options: Thomas Edison
Benjamin Franklin
George Westinghouse
Guglielmo Marconi
explanation: George Westinghouse purchased Tesla's AC motor patents and used them to develop alternating current electric power systems.
fact_tl: Binili ni George Westinghouse ang mga patent ng AC motor ni Tesla para gamitin sa kuryente.
fact_bis: Gipalit ni George Westinghouse ang mga patente sa AC motor ni Tesla aron gamiton sa kuryente.

q: What protects the brain inside your head?
options: A thick layer of muscle surrounding the brain
The hard skull that surrounds the brain
A cushion of blood vessels wrapped around the brain
A layer of fat between the brain and the scalp
explanation: The brain is protected by the hard skull that completely surrounds it, acting as a natural helmet.
fact_tl: Ang utak ay pinoprotektahan ng matigas na bungo na bumabalot dito.
fact_bis: Ang utok gipanalipdan sa gahi nga bagolbagol nga naglibot niini.

q: How do you know that a spider is NOT an insect?
options: Spiders have wings, but insects do not
Spiders have a hard outer shell, while insects have soft bodies
Spiders have eight legs, while insects have only six
Spiders live on land, while all insects live near water
explanation: A spider has eight legs, which means it is not an insect — insects always have exactly six legs.
fact_tl: Ang gagamba ay may walong paa, kaya hindi ito insekto na may anim na paa.
fact_bis: Ang lawalawa adunay walo ka tiil, mao nga dili kini insekto nga adunay unom.

q: How often does PAGASA release its seasonal climate outlook, and who uses this information?
options: Every month; mainly used by schools to plan outdoor activities
Every three months; used by farmers and others to plan for expected wetter or drier weather
Every six months; used mainly by shipping companies to plan sea routes
Every year; used by the government to set national holidays around good weather
explanation: PAGASA releases a seasonal climate outlook every three months, providing expected weather conditions to help farmers and other Filipinos plan ahead.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ay naglalabas ng seasonal climate outlook bawat tatlong buwan; ibinibigay nito ang inaasahang kalagayan ng panahon (mas maulan o mas tuyot) sa mga susunod na buwan upang matulungan ang mga magsasaka at iba pa.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA nagpagawas sa seasonal climate outlook matag tulo ka buwan; naghatag kini sa gilauman nga kondisyon sa panahon (mas ulanon o mas tuyot) sa mga sunod nga buwan aron matulungan ang mga mag-uuma ug uban pa.

q: Where is the tallest statue in the world located, and how tall is it?
options: In China, standing 153 meters tall
In the United States, standing 93 meters tall
In India, standing 182 meters tall
In Brazil, standing 200 meters tall
explanation: The Statue of Unity, located in India, is the tallest statue in the world at 182 meters.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamataas na estatwa sa mundo ay ang Statue of Unity sa India, na may taas na 182 metro.
fact_bis: Ang pinakataas nga estatwa sa kalibotan mao ang Statue of Unity sa India, nga 182 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: What happens to heat transfer between two objects once they reach the same temperature?
options: Heat transfer speeds up because both objects have the same energy
Heat transfer reverses so the warmer object becomes even hotter
Heat transfer stops completely — this is called thermal equilibrium
Heat transfer continues slowly until one object reaches freezing point
explanation: When two objects reach the same temperature, heat transfer stops — a state called thermal equilibrium.
fact_tl: Huminto ang paglipat ng init kapag magkasing-init na ang dalawang bagay — tinatawag itong thermal equilibrium. Halimbawa, ang yelo at ang juice ay umaabot sa parehong temperatura at hindi na nagbabago pagkatapos.
fact_bis: Mohunong ang paglabay sa init kung managsama na ang kainit sa duha ka butang — gitawag kini og thermal equilibrium. Pananglitan, ang yelo ug ang juice moabot sa usa ka temperatura ug dili na mausab human niana.

q: What material is a rhino's horn made of?
options: Ivory, the same material as elephant tusks
Bone, grown from the rhino's skull
Keratin, the same material as our nails and hair
Calcium, the same material as teeth
explanation: A rhino's horn is made of keratin, the same protein that makes up human nails and hair.
fact_tl: Ang sungay ng rhino ay gawa sa keratin, ang parehong sangkap ng ating kuko at buhok.
fact_bis: Ang sungay sa rhino hinimo gikan sa keratin, ang samang materyal sa atong kuko ug buhok.

q: Why does the water in your blood help keep your body temperature steady at around 37 degrees?
options: Water evaporates quickly from blood, cooling the body whenever it gets too warm
Water is transparent, so it does not absorb the sun's heat like other liquids
Water can absorb and carry heat without sudden temperature changes, keeping the body stable
Water is always colder than body temperature, so it constantly cools the blood
explanation: Most of our blood is water, which can absorb and transport heat without causing sudden temperature swings, helping maintain a steady body temperature of about 37 degrees.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng dugo natin ay tubig, kaya kayang sumipsip at magdala ng init nang hindi biglang nag-iinit o lumalamig ang katawan — ito ang tumutulong panatilihing humigit-kumulang 37 degrees ang temperatura natin.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa atong dugo kay tubig, mao nga makasuyop ug makadala kini og init nga dili kalit nga moinit o molamig ang lawas — kini ang motabang sa pagpabilin sa atong temperatura sa mga 37 degrees.

q: What happens to plastic litter left on the ground?
options: It stays for a long time and spoils the look of the surroundings
It dissolves into the soil after a few weeks of rain
It gets eaten by insects and breaks apart quickly
It turns into natural compost that helps plants grow
explanation: Plastic litter left on the ground stays for a very long time and makes the surroundings look bad.
fact_tl: Ang plastik na nakakalat sa lupa ay nananatili nang matagal at sumisira sa ganda ng paligid.
fact_bis: Ang plastik nga nagkalat sa yuta magpabilin og dugay ug makadaot sa kanindot sa palibot.

q: Why do trees in the Philippines always appear green, even though they shed their leaves?
options: They keep their leaves all year because the Philippines has no cold season
They replace their leaves a few at a time, so they are never bare
They grow new leaves faster than trees in other countries
Their leaves are thicker and do not fall off easily in the tropical heat
explanation: Philippine trees shed and replace leaves gradually, a few at a time, so they always look green.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno sa Pilipinas ay unti-unting nagpapalit ng dahon kaya laging may luntiang dahon ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga kahoy sa Pilipinas inanay nga magpuli og dahon, busa kanunay sila berde og dahon.

q: What do ladybug larvae eat before they become adult ladybugs?
options: Flower nectar and pollen from garden plants
Many aphids, the same prey adult ladybugs eat
Leaves and soft stems of young plants
Small moth eggs found on the undersides of leaves
explanation: Ladybug larvae eat many aphids before growing into full-grown adult ladybugs.
fact_tl: Ang mga uod (larva) ng ladybug ay kumakain din ng maraming aphids bago sila maging buong ladybug.
fact_bis: Ang mga ulod (larva) sa ladybug mokaon usab og daghang aphids sa dili pa sila mahimong hingkod nga ladybug.

q: Which blood types are most common among people in the Philippines?
options: Type A and Type AB
Type B and Type AB
Type O and Type A
Type O and Type B
explanation: In the Philippines, Type O and Type A are the most common blood types among people.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang dugong uri O at A ang pinakakaraniwan sa mga tao.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang dugong klase O ug A mao ang pinakakasagaran sa mga tawo.

q: What product can be made from the sap of a nipa palm's flowers?
options: Coconut milk
Vinegar
Palm sugar
Cooking oil
explanation: Nipa palm flower sap becomes vinegar when it is left to sour.
fact_tl: Ang katas ng bulaklak ng nipa ay maaaring gawing suka kapag ito ay pinabayaang umasim.
fact_bis: Ang duga sa bulak sa nipa mahimong himuong suka kung pasagdan kini nga moaslom.

q: How does the gumamela plant grow?
options: As a tall tree with a single thick trunk
As a climbing vine that wraps around other plants
As a bushy shrub with many branches and green leaves
As a low ground cover that spreads along the soil
explanation: The gumamela grows as a bushy shrub with many branches and green leaves.
fact_tl: Ang gumamela ay tumutubo bilang isang palumpong na may maraming sanga at berdeng dahon.
fact_bis: Ang gumamela motubo isip usa ka palumpong nga daghag sanga ug berde nga dahon.

q: Why does gliding use less energy than true flight?
options: Gliding animals are lighter, so they need less muscle power to stay in the air
The animal does not need to flap its wings, so it uses less energy
Gliding is done at night when the air is cooler and easier to move through
Gliding animals have longer wings that trap more air automatically
explanation: Gliding uses less energy than true flight because the animal does not need to flap wings.
fact_tl: Ang paglutang ay mas matipid sa enerhiya kaysa tunay na paglipad dahil hindi kailangang ikampay ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang pagdagan-dagan mas makatipig og kusog kaysa tinuod nga paglupad kay dili kinahanglan ikampay ang pako.

q: Why do frogs keep their skin moist and stay near water?
options: To hide from predators by blending in with the wet environment
To attract insects that land on the wet surface of their skin
To avoid getting too hot or too dry since they are cold-blooded
To absorb minerals from water that they need for their bones
explanation: Frogs are cold-blooded and stay near water with moist skin so they do not get too hot or dry.
fact_tl: Ang mga palaka, na malamig ang dugo, ay nananatili malapit sa tubig at basa upang hindi mainitan o matuyo nang husto.
fact_bis: Ang mga baki o palaka, nga bugnaw ug dugo, magpabilin duol sa tubig ug magpabasa sa ilang panit aron dili kaayo mainitan o mamala.

q: What is the monsoon trough (ITCZ) and what does it bring to the Philippines?
options: A high-pressure belt of dry air that prevents typhoons from forming
A warm ocean current that raises water temperature along the coasts
A low-pressure line where winds converge, bringing extremely heavy rain
A zone of strong upper-atmosphere winds that carry storms westward
explanation: The monsoon trough (ITCZ) is a low-pressure line where winds converge and brings extremely heavy rain to the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang monsoon trough (kilala rin bilang intertropical convergence zone o ITCZ) ay isang linya ng mababang presyon kung saan nagtatagpo ang mga hangin; nagdudulot ito ng napakamalakas na ulan sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang monsoon trough (kilala usab nga intertropical convergence zone o ITCZ) usa ka linya sa ubos nga presyon kung diin nagtagbo ang mga hangin; naghatag kini og labihan ka kusog nga ulan sa Pilipinas.

q: What did Marie Curie win her second Nobel Prize for in 1911?
options: Discovering radioactivity as a property of uranium
Inventing X-ray machines used in hospitals
Discovering the elements radium and polonium
Splitting the atom for the first time in a laboratory
explanation: Marie Curie won her 1911 Chemistry Nobel Prize for discovering the elements radium and polonium.
fact_tl: Nanalo si Marie Curie ng kanyang ikalawang Nobel Prize, sa Chemistry, noong 1911 para sa pagtuklas ng radium at polonium.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie nidaog sa iyang ikaduhang Nobel Prize, sa Chemistry, niadtong 1911 tungod sa pagdiskobre sa radium ug polonium.

q: What are stomata, and what do they do for a plant?
options: Tiny root hairs that absorb water and minerals from the soil
Waxy coatings on the leaf surface that stop water from escaping
Tiny pores on the underside of leaves where water vapor leaves and air enters
Clusters of cells inside the leaf that store extra sugar for the plant
explanation: Stomata are tiny pores on the underside of leaves through which water vapor exits and air enters the plant.
fact_tl: May napakaliliit na butas sa ilalim ng dahon na tinatawag na stomata; dito lumalabas ang singaw ng tubig at pumapasok ang hanging kailangan ng halaman.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay kaayong lungag sa ilawom sa dahon nga gitawag og stomata; dinhi mogawas ang alisngaw sa tubig ug mosulod ang hangin nga gikinahanglan sa tanom.

q: After the first wave of a tsunami reaches the shore, what should you do?
options: Return quickly to collect belongings before the water rises again
Wade into the receding water to check if it is safe
Stay away because bigger waves can still come after the first one
Signal for help from the shoreline so rescuers can find you
explanation: After the first tsunami wave, you must not return because bigger waves can still follow.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng unang alon, huwag agad bumalik sa baybayin dahil maaari pang dumating ang mas malalaking alon.
fact_bis: Human sa unang balod, ayaw dayon pagbalik sa baybayon kay mahimong moabot pa ang mas dagkong mga balod.

q: What happens to rubber when it gets very cold?
options: It melts slightly and sticks to surfaces it touches
It becomes softer and stretchier, like warm taffy
It stops stretching well and becomes stiff or brittle
It shrinks permanently and can never return to its original size
explanation: In very cold temperatures, rubber molecules slow down, so rubber stops stretching and becomes stiff or brittle.
fact_tl: Kapag napakalamig, hindi na masyadong nakakaunat ang goma at nagiging matigas o malutong ito. Bumabagal ang paggalaw ng mga molekula nito sa lamig kaya nahihirapan silang gumalaw pabalik. Kaya nga mas mabilis masira ang gulong sa sobrang lamig na lugar.
fact_bis: Kon bugnaw kaayo, dili na maayo moinat ang goma ug mahimo kining gahi o mahuyang. Ang mga molekula niini mohinay og lihok sa bugnaw, busa maglisod silang mobalik. Mao nga ang ligid nga goma mas paspas mabuak sa bugnaw kaayo nga lugar.

q: When you blow across the mouth of a bottle that has a lot of water in it, what kind of sound do you get?
options: A lower pitch, because the water makes the vibrations heavier
A higher pitch, because less air space is left inside to vibrate
No sound, because the water blocks the air from vibrating
The same pitch as an empty bottle, because air speed is the same
explanation: More water leaves less air to vibrate inside the bottle, so the sound produced is higher in pitch.
fact_tl: Kapag hinipan mo ang bibig ng botelya, ang dami ng tubig sa loob ang magbabago ng tono: mas maraming tubig, mas kaunting hangin ang nayayanig, kaya mas mataas ang tunog.
fact_bis: Kon huyopan nimo ang baba sa botelya, ang gidaghanon sa tubig sa sulod mag-usab sa tono: mas daghan ang tubig, mas gamay ang hangin nga magkurog, busa mas taas ang tingog.

q: Which planet in our solar system is so light for its size that it could float on water?
options: Jupiter
Uranus
Neptune
Saturn
explanation: Saturn is the least dense planet in the solar system and would float if placed in a large enough ocean.
fact_tl: Ang Saturn ang pinakamababa ang density at lulutang ito sa tubig kung may sapat na laki.
fact_bis: Ang Saturn mao ang pinakaubos ang density ug molutaw kini sa tubig kung dunay igo nga kadako.

q: According to Filipino farming tradition, when do farmers plant rice?
options: When the amihan winds begin blowing from the northeast
When the habagat rains arrive from the southwest
After the dry season ends and rivers begin to overflow
During the months when typhoon warnings are most frequent
explanation: Filipino farmers follow the monsoon seasons and plant rice when the habagat rains arrive.
fact_tl: Sinusunod ng mga magsasaka ang habagat at amihan: nagtatanim sila ng palay kapag dumating ang ulan ng habagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga mag-uuma mosunod sa habagat ug amihan: motanom sila og humay kung moabot ang ulan sa habagat.

q: What Philippine government agency was established in 1982 to study and monitor volcanoes and earthquakes?
options: PAGASA
NAMRIA
PHIVOLCS
DOST-ASTI
explanation: PHIVOLCS was established in 1982 as the Philippine agency for studying and monitoring volcanoes and earthquakes.
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS ay itinatag noong 1982 bilang ahensya ng gobyerno ng Pilipinas na nag-aaral at nagmamasid sa mga bulkan at lindol sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS gitukod niadtong 1982 ingon nga ahensya sa gobyerno sa Pilipinas nga nagatuon ug nagmonitor sa mga bulkan ug linog sa nasod.

q: Why do scientists and rangers count tamaraw at Mounts Iglit-Baco every year?
options: To collect tamaraw DNA for a breeding program in captivity
To decide how many tamaraw can be safely moved to other islands
To find out if the tamaraw population is increasing or decreasing
To tag each animal so tourists can identify them on guided tours
explanation: Annual counts tell scientists whether the tamaraw population is growing or shrinking, showing if protection efforts are working.
fact_tl: Bawat taon, ang mga siyentipiko at ranger ay bumibilang ng tamaraw sa Mounts Iglit-Baco para malaman kung dumarami o kumokonti sila. Ito ay tumutulong sa kanila na malaman kung gumagana ang pag-iingat.
fact_bis: Matag tuig, ang mga siyentista ug ranger mag-ihap sa tamaraw sa Mounts Iglit-Baco aron mahibal-an kung modaghan o mokunhod sila. Makatabang kini kanila nga masayran kung molihok ang ilang pag-amping.

q: What is the main purpose of the sharp spines on a cactus?
options: To collect dew so the cactus can drink water in the desert
To help the cactus climb over rocks and reach more sunlight
To protect the cactus from animals that want to eat the water stored inside
To spread seeds by catching on the fur of passing animals
explanation: A cactus's spines protect the water stored inside it from animals that might try to eat the cactus.
fact_tl: Ang tinik ng kaktus ay nagpoprotekta dito laban sa mga hayop na gustong kainin ang tubig na nakaimbak sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang tunok sa kaktus nanalipod niini batok sa mga hayop nga gustong mokaon sa tubig nga gitago sa sulod.

q: Which metal is the best conductor of electricity?
options: Copper
Gold
Iron
Silver
explanation: Silver is the best electrical conductor of all metals.
fact_tl: Ang pilak (silver) ang pinakamahusay na konduktor ng kuryente sa lahat ng metal.
fact_bis: Ang pilak (silver) mao ang labing maayo nga konduktor sa kuryente sa tanang metal.

q: What comes out of a volcano when it erupts?
options: Only hot steam and water vapor from underground rivers
Hot lava, ash, gas, and rocks from inside the earth
A mixture of mud, sand, and seawater pushed up from below
Mostly cold rocks and dust blown outward by underground pressure
explanation: When a volcano erupts, hot lava, ash, gas, and rocks come out from inside the earth.
fact_tl: Kapag pumutok ang bulkan, lumalabas ang mainit na lava, abo, gas, at mga bato mula sa loob ng lupa.
fact_bis: Kung moputok ang bulkan, mogawas ang init nga lava, abo, gas, ug mga bato gikan sa sulod sa yuta.

q: What does blood deliver to every cell in the body?
options: Only oxygen to power cell activity
Hormones and vitamins from the digestive system
Oxygen and nutrients, while collecting waste like carbon dioxide
Water and minerals absorbed from food in the stomach
explanation: Blood delivers oxygen and nutrients to every cell and collects waste products like carbon dioxide from them.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ang naghahatid ng oksiheno at sustansya sa bawat selula ng katawan at tumatanggap mula sa kanila ng mga dumi tulad ng carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Ang dugo maoy mohatod og oksiheno ug sustansiya ngadto sa matag selula sa lawas ug mokuha gikan kanila sa mga hugaw sama sa carbon dioxide.

q: Who was one of the first scientists to isolate the gas oxygen, and when?
options: Antoine Lavoisier in 1789
Carl Wilhelm Scheele in 1769
John Dalton in 1808
Joseph Priestley in 1774
explanation: Joseph Priestley was one of the first to isolate oxygen as a gas, in 1774.
fact_tl: Si Joseph Priestley ang isa sa unang nakahiwalay ng gas na oxygen noong 1774.
fact_bis: Si Joseph Priestley usa sa unang nakalain sa gas nga oxygen niadtong 1774.

q: How is the dangerous disease cholera spread?
options: Through bites from mosquitoes that carry the Vibrio cholerae bacteria
By touching the skin of a person who already has cholera
Through contaminated water carrying Vibrio cholerae bacteria
By eating undercooked pork or beef infected with the bacteria
explanation: Cholera is spread through contaminated water carrying Vibrio cholerae, causing severe diarrhea and dehydration.
fact_tl: Ang kolera ay isang mapanganib na sakit na dulot ng bakteryang Vibrio cholerae na kumakalat sa pamamagitan ng maruming tubig at nagdudulot ng matinding pagtatae at dehydration.
fact_bis: Ang kolera usa ka delikadong sakit nga gikagikan sa Vibrio cholerae nga bakterya nga mikaylap pinaagi sa hugaw nga tubig, nagpahinabog grabe nga pagtatae ug dehydration.

q: What do the sharp canine-like teeth of a snapper fish help it do?
options: Scrape algae from rocks on the sea floor
Crush the hard shells of crabs and clams
Grip the fish it catches as prey
Filter tiny plankton from the water
explanation: The snapper's sharp canine-like teeth are used to grip the fish it catches.
fact_tl: Ang maya-maya ay may matatalas na ngipin na parang pangil na ginagamit upang hawakan ang nahuling isda.
fact_bis: Ang maya-maya adunay hait nga mga ngipon nga sama sa pangil nga gigamit aron kuptan ang nadakpan nga isda.

q: How did European scientists react when they first saw a platypus?
options: They correctly placed it in a new class between reptiles and mammals
They thought it was a fake animal stitched together from different parts
They assumed it was a large species of river otter from Australia
They identified it immediately as a mammal because it had fur
explanation: Early European scientists thought the platypus was a fake animal stitched together from different animal parts.
fact_tl: Noong unang nakita ng mga Europeong siyentipiko ang platypus, akala nila ay pekeng hayop na pinagdikit-dikit lang.
fact_bis: Sa una nga nakita sa mga Europeohanon nga siyentista ang platypus, abi nila peke kini nga mananap nga gitahi-tahi lang.

q: How can stronger heat, floods, and droughts caused by climate change affect people's food supply?
options: They encourage farmers to grow more crops because of longer growing seasons
They shift all farming to coastal areas where water is more available
They can damage crops and lower the harvest of food
They cause insects to disappear, which reduces the need for pesticides
explanation: Stronger heat, floods, and droughts from climate change can damage crops and lower the harvest of food.
fact_tl: Ang mas matinding init, baha, at tagtuyot dulot ng climate change ay maaaring makasira ng mga pananim at magpababa ng ani ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mas grabe nga kainit, baha, ug huwaw tungod sa climate change makadaot sa mga tanom ug makapaubos sa ani sa pagkaon.

q: Why does a flying fish leap out of the water?
options: To catch insects flying low above the ocean surface
To cool itself down when the water gets too warm
To escape larger fish that want to eat it
To find a mate by displaying its fins in the sunlight
explanation: A flying fish leaps out of the water to escape larger fish that are chasing it.
fact_tl: Ang isdang lumilipad ay tumatalon at umaangat mula sa tubig para makatakas sa mga isdang gustong kumain dito.
fact_bis: Ang isdang naglupad molukso ug mosaka gikan sa tubig aron makaikyas sa dagkong isda nga gustong mokaon niini.

q: What must appear on a corn plant before a new ear full of kernels can form?
options: Large roots that spread outward to store extra nutrients
The tassel and silk, which are part of the corn plant's reproduction
Thick leaves that fold inward to protect the developing kernels
Red or orange husks that signal the plant is ready to pollinate
explanation: The tassel and silk appear on the corn plant before a new ear full of kernels forms that can be planted again.
fact_tl: Mula sa isang itinanim na butil, tumutubo ang halaman ng mais, lumalabas ang tassel at silk, at sa huli ay nabubuo ang bagong busal na puno ng butil na maaaring muling itanim.
fact_bis: Gikan sa usa ka gitanom nga lugas, motubo ang tanom nga mais, mogula ang tassel ug silk, ug sa kataposan mahimo ang bag-ong busal nga puno sa lugas nga mahimong itanom pag-usab.

q: How does a baby's ability to locate sounds change as it grows?
options: Babies can locate sounds perfectly from birth because hearing is fully formed
Babies lose some hearing ability as they grow due to louder environments
Babies gradually learn to use both ears together as their head gets bigger
Babies only learn to locate sounds after they start learning to speak
explanation: As a baby grows and its head gets bigger, the brain slowly learns to use the two ears together to locate sounds.
fact_tl: Hindi pa kaagad magaling ang isang bagong silang na sanggol sa pagtukoy ng direksyon ng tunog. Habang lumalaki sila at lumalaki ang ulo nila, unti-unting natututo ang utak na gamitin ang dalawang tainga. Kaya nakikita mong lumilingon na ang mas malaking sanggol kapag tinawag ng nanay nila.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong natawo nga bata dili pa kaayo hanas sa pagtino sa direksyon sa tingog. Samtang nagdako sila ug nagdako ang ilang ulo, hinay-hinay nga makat-on ang utok sa paggamit sa duha ka dalunggan. Mao nga makita nimo nga molingi na ang mas dako nga bata kung tawgon sa ilang inahan.

q: What does the discovery of matching plant and animal fossils on different continents prove?
options: That ancient animals could swim vast ocean distances to reach new lands
That the same species evolved independently on separate continents
That those continents were once connected to each other
That ocean currents carried fossil seeds between distant landmasses
