explanation: Matching fossils on now-separate continents are evidence that those continents were once joined together.
fact_tl: Magkatulad na fossil ng mga hayop at halaman ang natagpuan sa magkahiwalay na kontinente, nagpapatunay na dati silang magkadikit.
fact_bis: Managsama nga mga fosil sa mga hayop ug tanom nakit-an sa magkalahi na nga kontinente, nagpamatuod nga sila nagdikit kaniadto.

q: What are rocks made of?
options: Compressed layers of sand and clay only
Pure chemical compounds formed by cooling lava
One or more minerals packed together
Fossilized remains of ancient plants and animals
explanation: Rocks are made of one or more minerals packed together.
fact_tl: Ang mga bato ay binubuo ng isa o higit pang mineral na pinagsama-sama.
fact_bis: Ang mga bato gilangkuban sa usa o daghang mineral nga gitapok.

q: What does PAGASA measure to determine how strong a typhoon is and what signal to raise?
options: The amount of rainfall a typhoon drops in one hour
The size of the eye of the typhoon as seen from satellite
The wind speed of the typhoon
The storm surge height expected along the coast
explanation: PAGASA measures typhoon wind speed to judge how strong the storm is and decide which signal warning to raise.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, sinusukat ng PAGASA ang bilis ng hangin ng isang bagyo para malaman kung gaano ito kalakas. Habang mas mabilis ang hangin—gaya ng higit 100 kilometro kada oras—mas malakas ang bagyo at mas mataas ang itinataas na signal warning. Ginagamit ito para handa ang mga tao bago dumating ang bagyo.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, gisukod sa PAGASA ang katulin sa hangin sa usa ka bagyo aron mahibal-an kung unsa kini kakusog. Samtang mas paspas ang hangin—sama sa kapin 100 ka kilometro kada oras—mas kusog ang bagyo ug mas taas ang gipataas nga signal warning. Gigamit kini aron makaandam ang mga tawo ayha moabot ang bagyo.

q: How does a young tadpole move through water?
options: By kicking with its small back legs like a tiny frog
By flapping its front fins left and right
By wiggling its tail, because it does not have legs yet
By blowing bubbles that push it forward through the water
explanation: A young tadpole swims by wiggling its tail because it does not yet have legs.
fact_tl: Ang batang tadpole ay lumalangoy gamit ang buntot nito na pakislot-kislot, dahil wala pa itong mga binti.
fact_bis: Ang batan-ong tadpole molangoy pinaagi sa pagkiwa-kiwa sa ikog niini, kay wala pa kini mga tiil.

q: What must happen for an airplane to climb upward?
options: The thrust from the engines must be greater than the drag from air resistance
The lift force must be greater than the weight pulled down by gravity
The plane must reduce its speed so air flows faster over the wings
The weight of fuel must decrease enough to let the wings lift the plane
explanation: For a plane to climb, the lift must be greater than the weight that gravity pulls down.
fact_tl: Para umangat ang eroplano, kailangang mas malaki ang lift kaysa sa bigat na hinihila ito pababa ng grabidad.
fact_bis: Aron mosaka ang eroplano, kinahanglan mas dako ang lift kaysa sa gibug-aton nga gibira paubos sa grabidad.

q: Where are red blood cells made, and about how long do they live?
options: In the liver, living for about 30 days before being replaced
In the spleen, living for about 60 days before being replaced
In bone marrow, living for about 120 days before being replaced
In the kidneys, living for about 200 days before being replaced
explanation: Red blood cells are made in bone marrow through mitosis and live for about 120 days before being replaced.
fact_tl: Ang mga pulang selula ng dugo ay ginagawa sa utak ng buto sa pamamagitan ng mitosis at nabubuhay lamang ng humigit kumulang 120 araw bago palitan ng mga bagong selula.
fact_bis: Ang mga pulang selula sa dugo gihimo sa bone marrow pinaagi sa mitosis ug nagpuyo lamang og mga 120 ka adlaw sa wala pa palihon sa bag-ong mga selula.

q: How many colors are in the spectrum of light, or rainbow?
options: Five
Six
Eight
Seven
explanation: There are seven colors in the spectrum of light, which is what we see in a rainbow.
fact_tl: May pitong (7) kulay ang spectrum ng liwanag o bahaghari.
fact_bis: Adunay pito (7) ka kolor sa spectrum sa kahayag o balangaw.

q: Why do some animals store food like seeds instead of sleeping through hard seasons?
options: They store food to attract mates by showing they are good providers
They save seeds to replant them when the warm season returns
They have something to eat when food is scarce during hard seasons
They hide food to keep it safe from other animals in their group
explanation: Some animals store food so they have something to eat when food is scarce during hard seasons.
fact_tl: May mga hayop na hindi natutulog kundi nag-iimbak ng pagkain gaya ng mga buto, para may makain sila habang kulang ang pagkain sa mahirap na panahon.
fact_bis: Adunay mga mananap nga dili matulog apan magtigom og pagkaon sama sa mga liso, aron may makaon sila samtang nihit ang pagkaon sa lisod nga panahon.

q: Which of these fruits has only ONE seed inside?
options: Papaya
Watermelon
Mango
Pomelo
explanation: Mango has just one seed inside, while fruits like papaya and watermelon are full of many seeds.
fact_tl: May prutas na isa lang ang buto gaya ng mangga at abukado, at may prutas naman na puno ng buto gaya ng papaya at pakwan. Ang dami ng buto ay depende sa halaman, pero lahat sila ay may layuning magparami ng bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Adunay prutas nga usa ra ang liso sama sa mangga ug abokado, ug adunay prutas nga puno sa liso sama sa papaya ug pakwan. Ang gidaghanon sa liso nagdepende sa tanom, apan tanan sila adunay tumong nga makapadaghan og bag-ong tanom.

q: Which statement best describes the variety of trilobites that once lived in the sea?
options: There was only one type of trilobite, which lived for a short period
Trilobites came in thousands of different kinds, ranging from fingernail-sized to plate-sized
Trilobites were all very large, averaging the size of a dinner plate
Only about fifty kinds of trilobites have ever been found in the fossil record
explanation: Thousands of different kinds of trilobites existed, from as tiny as a fingernail to as big as a plate.
fact_tl: Mayroong libu-libong magkakaibang uri ng trilobite, mula sa kasinliit ng kuko hanggang sa kasinlaki ng plato, na nabuhay sa dagat sa loob ng milyon-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Adunay libolibo ka lainlaing matang sa trilobite, gikan sa kagamay sa kuko hangtod sa kadako sa plato, nga nabuhi sa dagat sulod sa gatosan ka milyon ka tuig.

q: What important communication achievement did Guglielmo Marconi accomplish in 1901?
options: He made the first telephone call between two different countries
He sent a radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean for the first time
He invented the telegraph machine used to send Morse code
He broadcast the first radio news program heard by the public
explanation: In 1901, Guglielmo Marconi successfully sent a radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean.
fact_tl: Noong 1901, matagumpay na naipadala ni Guglielmo Marconi ang isang radio signal patawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1901, malampuson nga gipadala ni Guglielmo Marconi ang usa ka radio signal tabok sa Kadagatang Atlantiko.

q: How many legs does a beetle have?
options: Eight legs, like a spider
Four legs, like a lizard
Six legs, like all insects
Ten legs, like a crab
explanation: A beetle is an insect and therefore has six legs and a body divided into three parts.
fact_tl: Ang salagubang ay isang insekto, kaya may anim itong paa at tatlong bahagi ang katawan tulad ng ibang kulisap.
fact_bis: Ang bakukang usa ka insekto, busa adunay unom kini ka tiil ug ang lawas tulo ka bahin sama sa ubang insekto.

q: How does a lightning rod protect a tall building during a storm?
options: It creates an electric shield around the building that repels lightning
It absorbs lightning and stores the energy for the building to use
It attracts lightning and carries the electricity safely down into the ground
It breaks lightning bolts into smaller sparks before they hit the roof
explanation: A lightning rod attracts lightning and carries the electricity safely down a wire into the ground, protecting the building.
fact_tl: Ang lightning rod ay matulis na metal na inilalagay sa tuktok ng matataas na gusali. Hinihikayat nito ang kidlat na tumama rito sa halip na sa bubong, pagkatapos ay dinadala ang kuryente paibaba sa isang kawad patungo sa lupa nang ligtas. Kaya hindi nasusunog o nasisira ang gusali.
fact_bis: Ang lightning rod usa ka talinis nga metal nga gibutang sa ibabaw sa tag-as nga building. Modani kini sa kilat nga motama niini imbes sa atop, dayon dad-on ang kuryente paubos sa usa ka alambre ngadto sa yuta nga luwas. Mao nga dili masunog o madaot ang building.

q: How do intestinal worms cause malnutrition in children?
options: They block the intestine so food cannot pass through and be digested
They produce toxins that destroy the child's appetite permanently
They take the nutrients that the child's body needs
They cause the child's stomach to swell so no more food can fit inside
explanation: Intestinal worms cause malnutrition by taking the nutrients that the child needs.
fact_tl: Ang maraming bulate sa bituka ay maaaring magdulot ng malnutrisyon dahil kinukuha nila ang sustansya ng bata.
fact_bis: Ang daghang bulate sa tinai makahatag ug malnutrisyon kay ilang kuhaon ang sustansya nga gikinahanglan sa bata.

q: How long does it take for a narra tree to grow fully and mature?
options: About one to two years, similar to most fast-growing tropical trees
About five to ten years, the same as most fruit trees
Several decades of growth before it is fully mature
Only a few months because the Philippine climate is very warm and wet
explanation: It takes several decades for a narra tree to grow fully and mature.
fact_tl: Ilang dekada ang kailangan bago tumanda at lumaki nang husto ang isang punong narra.
fact_bis: Pila ka dekada ang gikinahanglan una motigulang ug modako pag-ayo ang usa ka punoan sa narra.

q: Which two hormones work together to keep your blood sugar level balanced?
options: Insulin lowers it and glucagon raises it
Adrenaline lowers it and insulin raises it
Glucagon lowers it and cortisol raises it
Insulin lowers it and adrenaline raises it
explanation: The body uses insulin to lower blood sugar and glucagon to raise it, keeping the level balanced.
fact_tl: Pinapanatiling balanse ng katawan ang asukal sa dugo gamit ang insulin na nagbababa nito at glucagon na nagtataas nito.
fact_bis: Gipabilin sa lawas nga balanse ang asukal sa dugo pinaagi sa insulin nga nag-ubos niini ug glucagon nga nagpataas niini.

q: When you stir sugar into water and it seems to disappear, what actually happened to the sugar?
options: It broke into tiny pieces too small to see and spread evenly through the water
It turned into a different substance and became part of the water
It dissolved completely and no longer exists in the water
It sank to the bottom in pieces too small to see with the naked eye
explanation: Sugar does not disappear — it breaks into tiny invisible pieces that spread evenly through the water, making it taste sweet.
fact_tl: Kapag hinalo mo ang asukal sa tubig, parang nawawala ito pero hindi naman talaga. Naghihiwa-hiwalay lang ang asukal sa napakaliliit na piraso na hindi na natin makita, at kumakalat ito nang pantay sa buong tubig. Kaya naging matamis ang tubig kahit hindi mo na kita ang asukal.
fact_bis: Kung imong sagolon ang asukal sa tubig, morag mawala kini apan dili man gyud. Ang asukal mabahin lang sa gagmay kaayo nga piraso nga dili na nato makita, ug mokatag kini og parehas sa tibuok tubig. Mao nga nahimong tam-is ang tubig bisan dili na nimo makita ang asukal.

q: In what year did Valentina Tereshkova fly into space?
explanation: Valentina Tereshkova flew into space on June 16, 1963.
fact_tl: Si Valentina Tereshkova ay umakyat sa kalawakan noong Hunyo 16, 1963.
fact_bis: Si Valentina Tereshkova misaka sa kawanangan niadtong Hunyo 16, 1963.

q: Why does a tsunami wave that was low in the open ocean suddenly grow tall when it reaches the shore?
options: It slows down in the shallow water and the water piles up
It speeds up as it hits the ocean floor and pushes water upward
The wind near the shore adds energy to the wave and makes it taller
It absorbs water from the seafloor and increases in volume
explanation: When a tsunami reaches shallow water near shore, it slows down and the water piles up, making the wave grow tall.
fact_tl: Pagdating ng tsunami sa mababaw na bahagi malapit sa baybayin, bumabagal ito at naiipon ang tubig kaya biglang tumataas ang alon mula sa pagiging mababa.
fact_bis: Kon moabot ang tsunami sa mabaw nga bahin duol sa baybayon, mohinay kini ug magtapok ang tubig maong kalit nga modako ang balod gikan sa pagka-ubos niini.

q: Which protein hardens like glue to seal a wound when blood clots?
options: Fibrin
Hemoglobin
Plasma
Collagen
explanation: Fibrin hardens at the wound site — just like glue drying — to stick the wound together and seal it shut.
fact_tl: Maaari mong isipin ang pamumuo ng dugo bilang likas na pandikit ng katawan. Tulad ng kola na tumitigas kapag natuyo, ang fibrin ay tumitigas para idikit-dikit at isara ang sugat.
fact_bis: Mahimo nimong hunahunaon ang pagmuo sa dugo isip natural nga pandikit sa lawas. Sama sa kola nga motig-a kung mamala, ang fibrin motig-a aron idikit ug isira ang samad.

q: What kind of substance is air — is it a single pure substance or something else?
options: A mixture of many different gases
A single pure gas called oxygen
A compound made of oxygen and hydrogen
A single pure gas called nitrogen
explanation: Air is a mixture of many different gases, not a single substance.
fact_tl: Ang hangin ay isang halo (mixture) ng maraming iba't ibang gas, hindi iisang sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang hangin usa ka sagol (mixture) sa daghang lain-laing gas, dili usa lang ka substansya.

q: Why are feathers helpful to a bird?
options: They are light yet strong, helping it fly and keeping its body warm
They are heavy and waterproof, protecting the bird from rain
They are stiff and sharp, used as weapons against predators
They are colorful and dense, helping the bird attract mates
explanation: A bird's feathers are light yet strong, which helps it fly and keeps its body warm.
fact_tl: Ang mga balahibo ng ibon ay magaan ngunit malakas, kaya nakakatulong ito sa paglipad at pagpapainit ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga balhibo sa langgam gaan apan lig-on, busa makatabang kini sa paglupad ug sa pagpainit sa lawas.

q: Why does a Filipino family that smokes lose money that could be spent on food or schooling?
options: Because of the sin tax, cigarettes are very costly in the Philippines
Because doctors charge high fees when treating smokers in the Philippines
Because smokers cannot work as many hours, reducing the family income
Because the government fines families who smoke near children
explanation: In the Philippines the sin tax makes cigarettes costly, so money spent on cigarettes cannot go to food or schooling.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, mahal na ang sigarilyo dahil sa 'sin tax', kaya ang pamilyang naninigarilyo ay nababawasan ng perang sana ay pang-pagkain o pang-eskwela.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas mahal na ang sigarilyo tungod sa 'sin tax', busa ang pamilyang nagpanigarilyo makunhdan ug kwarta nga unta para sa pagkaon o eskwela.

q: What do all major Philippine power plants — coal, gas, hydro, and geothermal — have in common?
options: They all spin a magnet inside coils of wire using a turbine to generate electricity
They all burn fuel to produce heat that directly flows as electricity through wires
They all use solar panels to convert energy before sending it to the turbine
They all split water molecules to create a current that powers homes
explanation: All major Philippine power plants use the same principle — steam or water spins a turbine that rotates a magnet inside wire coils to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Lahat ng pangunahing power plant sa Pilipinas — maging coal, gas, hydro, o geothermal — ay gumagamit ng parehong prinsipyo: ang singaw o tubig ay nagpapalikot ng turbina na nagpapalikot ng magneto sa loob ng napakaraming coil, na gumagawa ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Tanan nga pangunahing power plant sa Pilipinas — maging coal, gas, hydro, o geothermal — naggamit sa mao rang prinsipyo: ang singaw o tubig nagpalikot sa turbina nga nagpalikot sa magneto sulod sa mga coil sa kawad, nagmugna ug kuryente.

q: In what year did the Battle of Mactan take place?
explanation: The Battle of Mactan took place in 1521.
fact_tl: Naganap ang Labanan sa Mactan noong 1521.
fact_bis: Ang Gubat sa Mactan nahitabo niadtong 1521.

q: Why can't a single termite survive on its own?
options: Each termite has only one job, so the colony must work together to survive
A lone termite is too large to find enough food in the forest by itself
Termites must stay in groups because they cannot breathe outside the mound
A single termite has no wings and cannot escape predators alone
explanation: A single termite cannot survive alone because each one has only one job — feeding, guarding, or laying eggs — and survival depends on the whole colony cooperating.
fact_tl: Hindi mabubuhay nang mag-isa ang isang anay. Ang bawat isa ay may tungkulin — pagkain, pagbabantay, o pangingitlog — at dahil sa pagtutulungan ng buong kolonya nila nakakayang mabuhay at lumago.
fact_bis: Dili mabuhi ang usa ka anay nga mag-inusara. Ang matag usa adunay tahas — pagpangaon, pagbantay, o pangitlog — ug pinaagi sa tinabangay sa tibuok kolonya sila makahimo nga mabuhi ug motubo.

q: What do we call the whole area of land that drains its water into a river system?
options: A watershed
A delta
A tributary
A floodplain
explanation: The whole area of land that drains its water into a river system is called a watershed.
fact_tl: Ang isang sistema ng ilog ay binubuo ng pangunahing ilog at mga sanga o sapa nitong nag-uugnay, at ang lahat ng lupang umaagos ng tubig papunta rito ay tinatawag na watershed.
fact_bis: Ang sistema sa suba gilangkoban sa pangunang suba ug sa tanang gagmayng sapa nga modagayday niini, ug ang tibuok yuta nga modagayday og tubig ngadto niini gitawag og watershed.

q: Who invented the Fahrenheit temperature scale?
options: Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit
Anders Celsius
Lord Kelvin
Isaac Newton
explanation: Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit created the Fahrenheit temperature scale.
fact_tl: Si Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit ang gumawa ng Fahrenheit temperature scale.
fact_bis: Si Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit mao ang naghimo sa Fahrenheit temperature scale.

q: What happens to limestone rock when water touches it over a long time?
options: It slowly dissolves
It becomes harder and denser
It turns into a different kind of rock immediately
It absorbs water and swells up
explanation: Limestone is a soft rock that slowly dissolves when water touches it.
fact_tl: Ang limestone ay isang malambot na bato na unti-unting natutunaw kapag nababasa ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang limestone usa ka humok nga bato nga hinay-hinayng matunaw kon mabasa sa tubig.

q: Before Typhoon Yolanda, which storm was the deadliest in Philippine history, killing over 5,000 people mostly in Ormoc?
options: Tropical Storm Uring (Thelma) in 1991
Typhoon Ruping (Mike) in 1990
Typhoon Nitang (Ike) in 1984
Tropical Storm Ondoy (Ketsana) in 2009
explanation: Before Yolanda, Tropical Storm Uring (Thelma) in 1991 was the deadliest Philippine typhoon, killing over 5,000 people mostly in Ormoc.
fact_tl: Bago dumating ang Yolanda, ang Bagyong Uring (Thelma) noong 1991 ang pinakamakamatay, na pumatay ng mahigit 5,000 katao, karamihan sa Ormoc.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa ang Yolanda, ang Bagyong Uring (Thelma) niadtong 1991 mao ang pinakamakamatay, mipatay ug kapin sa 5,000 ka tawo, kadaghanan sa Ormoc.

q: Which of the following is a correct example of a noble gas?
options: Neon
Oxygen
Chlorine
Nitrogen
explanation: Noble gases, including helium, neon, and argon, almost never react with other substances.
fact_tl: Ang noble gases ay mga gas na halos hindi nakikipag-react sa ibang sangkap; kasama dito ang helium, neon, at argon.
fact_bis: Ang noble gases mao ang mga gas nga halos dili mo-react sa ubang substansiya; apil niini ang helium, neon, ug argon.

q: Why is each giraffe's spot pattern special?
options: No two giraffes have exactly the same spot pattern, just like human fingerprints
All giraffes in the same herd share the same spot pattern to recognize each other
Spot patterns change as the giraffe grows older and gets bigger
A giraffe's spots slowly fade in color over time but the shape stays the same
explanation: No two giraffes have exactly the same spot pattern, just like human fingerprints.
fact_tl: Walang dalawang dyirap na magkapareho ang batik, gaya ng fingerprint ng tao.
fact_bis: Walay duha ka giraffe nga parehas gyud ang puntik, sama sa fingerprint sa tawo.

q: Why are balete and fig trees sometimes called the 'bread of the forest'?
options: They produce small fruit almost all year round, always giving birds and bats something to eat
Their bark contains a substance that gives energy to many forest animals when eaten
They grow so tall that other plants use their shade to survive the dry season
They store large amounts of water in their roots that forest animals drink
explanation: Balete and fig trees produce fruit almost all year round, so birds and bats always have something to eat in any season.
fact_tl: Ang mga punong balete at iba pang igos sa gubat ay namumunga halos buong taon, kaya tinatawag itong parang 'tinapay ng kagubatan'. Marami silang maliliit na bunga na laging may makakain ang mga ibon at paniki kahit tag-init o tag-ulan.
fact_bis: Ang balete ug ubang igos nga kahoy sa lasang mamunga halos tibuok tuig, mao nga gitawag kining murag 'tinapay sa kagubatan'. Daghan silang gagmay nga bunga nga kanunayng makaon sa mga langgam ug kabag bisan init o ting-ulan.

q: What is Diosdado Banatao known for in Silicon Valley?
options: He was one of the early pioneers of semiconductor chip design
He invented the first personal computer operating system
He designed the first fiber-optic internet cables
He founded the first Filipino technology company in the United States
explanation: Diosdado Banatao is a Filipino engineer from Cagayan who became one of the early pioneers of semiconductor chip design in Silicon Valley.
fact_tl: Si Diosdado Banatao ay isang Pilipinong inhinyero mula Cagayan na naging isa sa mga unang pioneer ng semiconductor chip design sa Silicon Valley.
fact_bis: Si Diosdado Banatao usa ka Pilipinong inhinyero gikan sa Cagayan nga naging usa sa mga unang pioneer sa semiconductor chip design sa Silicon Valley.

q: How does a cockroach escape danger so quickly?
options: It runs very fast on its six legs
It flies away with its two pairs of wings
It sprays a bad-smelling liquid to confuse enemies
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
explanation: A cockroach can run very fast on its six legs, which lets it quickly escape danger and makes it hard to catch.
fact_tl: Napakabilis tumakbo ng ipis sa anim nitong paa, kaya madali itong nakakaiwas sa panganib at mahirap hulihin.
fact_bis: Paspas kaayo modagan ang ipis sa unom niini ka tiil, maong dali kini makalikay sa kapeligrohan ug lisod dakpon.

q: What useful science instrument did Apollo astronauts leave on the Moon that is still used today?
options: A mirror used to measure the Moon's distance from Earth
A thermometer to track how cold the Moon gets at night
A camera to photograph the surface over many years
A seismometer to detect earthquakes on the Moon
explanation: The Apollo astronauts left a mirror on the Moon that is still used today to measure the Moon's exact distance from Earth.
fact_tl: Nag-iwan ang mga astronaut ng Apollo ng mga kagamitang pang-agham sa Buwan, kasama ang isang salamin na hanggang ngayon ay ginagamit para sukatin ang layo ng Buwan sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut sa Apollo nagbilin og mga galamiton sa siyensya sa Bulan, lakip ang usa ka salamin nga hangtod karon gigamit aron sukdon ang gilay-on sa Bulan gikan sa Earth.

q: Why does the Philippines experience so many landslides?
options: It is mountainous and hit by many strong typhoons, so steep land plus heavy rain causes slides
It has very loose sandy soil everywhere that washes away easily in any rain
It has no large forests left, so nothing holds the soil on slopes during storms
It sits on soft volcanic rock that cracks and slides during earthquakes only
explanation: The Philippines has many landslides because it is mountainous and hit by strong typhoons — steep land plus very heavy rain causes slides, especially in the Cordillera, Bicol, and Eastern Visayas.
fact_tl: Madalas magkaroon ng landslide sa Pilipinas dahil ito ay mabundok at madalas tamaan ng malalakas na bagyo. Ang pinagsamang matarik na lupa at sobrang ulan ay nagiging sanhi ng maraming pagguho, lalo na sa Cordillera, Bicol, at Eastern Visayas.
fact_bis: Kanunay magkaaduna og landslide sa Pilipinas tungod kay kini bukidnon ug kanunay igoon sa kusog nga bagyo. Ang tarik nga yuta dugang sa hilabihang ulan maoy hinungdan sa daghang pagguba, ilabina sa Cordillera, Bicol, ug Eastern Visayas.

q: Why do only female mosquitoes bite people?
options: They need blood to produce their eggs
They are larger than males and have stronger mouthparts
They bite to protect their territory from human disturbance
They need the warmth from blood to regulate their body temperature
explanation: Only female mosquitoes bite because they need blood to produce their eggs.
fact_tl: Tanging ang babaeng lamok ang kumakagat ng tao dahil kailangan nila ng dugo para makapangitlog.
fact_bis: Ang bayeng lamok lang ang mopaak sa tawo, tungod kay nanginahanglan sila ug dugo aron makahimo sa ilang mga itlog.

q: Through which valley and region does the Agusan River run?
options: The Agusan Valley in eastern Mindanao
The Cagayan Valley in northern Luzon
The Cotabato Basin in central Mindanao
The Pampanga Delta in central Luzon
explanation: The Agusan River runs through the Agusan Valley in eastern Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Agusan ay dumadaloy sa Lambak ng Agusan sa silangang bahagi ng Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Agusan modagayday sa Walog sa Agusan sa sidlakang bahin sa Mindanao.

q: Why are the Philippine crocodile's eyes positioned high on its head?
options: So it can watch rivers and marshes while most of its body stays underwater
So it can see in both directions at once while walking on land
So sunlight heats its eyes and keeps the crocodile warm in cold water
So it can see prey flying above the water and jump to catch it
explanation: Like other crocodiles, the Philippine crocodile's eyes sit high up so it can watch rivers and marshes while mostly submerged.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas ay may sariling uri ng buwaya na tinatawag na Philippine crocodile, na matatagpuan lang dito sa atin. Gaya ng ibang buwaya, ang mga mata nito ay nasa ibabaw para makaabang sa mga ilog at latian. Nanganganib na itong maubos, kaya pinoprotektahan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas naay kaugalingong matang sa buaya nga gitawag og Philippine crocodile, nga makita lamang dinhi sa atong nasud. Sama sa ubang buaya, ang mga mata niini naa sa ibabaw aron makabantay sa mga suba ug lamakan. Nameligro na kini nga mahurot, busa gipanalipdan.

q: What part of the eye has tiny muscles that change the size of the pupil?
options: The iris
The retina
The cornea
The lens
explanation: The iris has tiny muscles that change the size of the pupil to control how much light enters the eye.
fact_tl: May maliliit na kalamnan ang iris na nagbabago sa laki ng balintataw para kontrolin ang liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang iris adunay gagmay nga unod nga nagbag-o sa gidak-on sa kalimutaw aron pugngan ang kahayag.

q: Which statement about elements is true?
options: Most elements occur naturally, but some are made only by scientists in laboratories
All elements are found naturally on Earth and none can be made by humans
All elements were made by scientists and do not exist naturally in nature
Only metals occur naturally; all non-metals must be made in a laboratory
explanation: Most elements occur naturally, but some elements are made only by scientists in laboratories.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng elemento ay likas na matatagpuan sa kalikasan, ngunit ang ilan ay gawa lang ng mga siyentista sa laboratoryo.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga elemento makita sa kinaiyahan, apan ang uban gihimo lamang sa mga siyentista sa laboratoryo.

q: What stage does a mosquito larva change into before it becomes an adult?
options: A pupa
A nymph
A cocoon
A chrysalis
explanation: After growing in the water, the mosquito larva changes into a pupa before becoming an adult mosquito.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos lumaki sa tubig, nagbabago ang uod ng lamok at nagiging pupa bago ito maging matandang lamok.
fact_bis: Human motubo sa tubig, mausab ang uod sa lamok ug mahimong pupa sa dili pa kini mahimong hamtong nga lamok.

q: Why does a mudskipper leave the water and wander on the mud?
options: To look for food and to escape bigger fish, which is safe because it can breathe air
To dry out its skin in the sun, which keeps it healthy and free of parasites
To lay its eggs on land, where they are safe from underwater predators
To attract a mate by showing off its ability to move on land
explanation: A mudskipper leaves the water to find food and escape bigger fish, and because it can breathe air, wandering on the mud is safe for it.
fact_tl: Umaahon ang mudskipper sa lupa para maghanap ng pagkain at makaiwas sa mga isdang gustong kumain sa kanya. Dahil kaya nitong huminga sa hangin, ligtas siyang maglakad sa putik.
fact_bis: Mogawas ang mudskipper sa yuta aron mangita og pagkaon ug makalikay sa dagkong isda nga gustong mokaon niini. Tungod kay makaginhawa kini sa hangin, luwas kini nga molakaw sa lapok.

q: What is the correct symbol for the metric prefix 'mega'?
options: Capital M
Lowercase m
Capital G
Lowercase k
explanation: The symbol for the prefix 'mega' is a capital 'M'.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo para sa unlaping "mega" ay malaking "M".
fact_bis: Ang simbolo para sa prefix nga "mega" kay dako nga "M".

q: In a flame test, what color does copper produce, and roughly what wavelength range does that light fall in?
options: Green, around 500–560 nanometers
Blue, around 400–450 nanometers
Red, around 620–700 nanometers
Yellow, around 570–590 nanometers
explanation: Copper produces a green flame with light in the green band, around 500–560 nanometers.
fact_tl: Ang berdeng liwanag ng copper sa apoy ay nasa green na bahagi ng liwanag, mga 500-560 nanometro (nm).
fact_bis: Ang lunhaw nga kahayag sa copper naa sa green nga bahin, mga 500-560 nanometers (nm).

q: Where does the Oncomelania snail — which spreads schistosomiasis — prefer to live?
options: In wet soil at the edges of streams, canals, and rice-paddy dikes where land and water meet
Deep underwater in the middle of rivers where there is plenty of food
On dry land far from water, hiding under rocks and fallen leaves
Floating on the surface of still ponds in shaded forest areas
explanation: The Oncomelania snail lives in wet soil at the edges of streams, canals, and rice-paddy dikes where land and water meet.
fact_tl: Ang Oncomelania na suso ay nabubuhay sa basang lupa sa gilid ng mga sapa, kanal, at pilapil ng palayan kung saan nagsasalubong ang lupa at tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Oncomelania nga suso nagpuyo sa basa nga yuta sa kilid sa mga sapa, kanal, ug pilapil sa humayan diin magtagbo ang yuta ug tubig.

q: What is seafloor spreading?
options: New ocean crust forming in the middle of oceans and pushing the old crust away
Old ocean crust sinking under the continents at the edges of tectonic plates
The ocean floor cracking open to release hot lava that cools into islands
Tectonic plates grinding sideways against each other along the ocean floor
explanation: Seafloor spreading is when new crust keeps forming in the middle of oceans and pushes the old crust away.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng karagatan, ang bagong crust ay patuloy na nabubuo at itinutulak ang lumang crust palayo, na tinatawag na seafloor spreading.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa kadagatan, ang bag-ong crust padayon nga maumol ug motulod sa daan nga crust palayo, gitawag og seafloor spreading.

q: Which foods are good Filipino sources of vitamin A that help protect eyesight and fight illness?
options: Sweet potato, carrots, and malunggay
Rice, corn, and cassava
Bangus, tilapia, and shrimp
Coconut, papaya, and banana
explanation: Vitamin A from sweet potato, carrots, and malunggay helps with clear eyesight and builds defense against illness.
fact_tl: Ang bitamina A mula sa kamote, karot, at malunggay ay tumutulong sa malinaw na paningin at nagpapalakas ng resistensya laban sa sakit. Kapag kulang dito, mahihirapan ang bata na makakita sa dilim at madaling magkasakit.
fact_bis: Ang bitamina A gikan sa kamote, karot, ug malunggay motabang sa tin-aw nga panan-aw ug magpalig-on sa resistensya batok sa sakit. Kung kulang niini, maglisod ang bata sa pagkakita sa ngitngit ug daling magsakit.

q: Which statement about where milk comes from is correct?
options: Milk can come from carabaos, goats, and other mammals — not just cows
Only cows produce the right kind of milk that humans can safely drink
Milk comes only from cows and carabaos but not from any other animal
All female animals produce milk, including fish, birds, and reptiles
explanation: It is wrong to think milk comes only from cows — carabaos, goats, and other mammals also produce milk.
fact_tl: Maling akala na sa baka lang nanggagaling ang gatas. Ang gatas ay maaari ring magmula sa kalabaw, kambing, at iba pang mammal — hindi lang sa baka.
fact_bis: Sayop ang pagtuo nga gikan ra sa baka ang gatas. Ang gatas mahimo usab nga gikan sa kabaw, kanding, ug ubang mammal — dili lang sa baka.

q: What is the chemical formula of rust (iron oxide)?
options: Fe2O3
FeO
Fe3O4
FeCl2
explanation: The chemical formula of rust (iron oxide) is Fe2O3.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng kalawang (rust o iron oxide) ay Fe2O3.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa taya (rust o iron oxide) kay Fe2O3.

q: What happens to the electricity produced by a generator when the magnet spins faster?
options: A larger amount of electricity is produced
The same amount of electricity is produced but at higher voltage
A smaller amount of electricity is produced because friction increases
The electricity becomes weaker and the current drops
explanation: When the magnet spins faster inside a generator, it produces a larger amount of electricity.
fact_tl: Kapag mas mabilis umiikot ang magnet sa loob ng generator, mas malaki ang kuryenteng nalilikha nito.
fact_bis: Kon mas paspas moliko ang magnet sulod sa generator, mas dako ang kuryente nga mahimo niini.

q: What makes the leatherback sea turtle unusual compared to other sea turtles?
options: Instead of hard shell plates it has a rubbery leathery skin, and it can grow over 2 meters long
It is the only sea turtle that can breathe underwater using gills instead of lungs
It has a colorful spotted shell that it can retract its head and flippers into
It is the smallest sea turtle and eats only jellyfish in deep ocean waters
explanation: The leatherback sea turtle is the largest living turtle and has rubbery leathery skin instead of hard shell plates.
fact_tl: Ang leatherback sea turtle ang pinakamalaking buhay na pagong — maaari itong lumaki ng higit sa 2 metro at magimbak ng hanggang 900 kilo — at hindi ito may mahard na shell bali ay balat na parang katad.
fact_bis: Ang leatherback sea turtle ang pinakadako nga buhing bao — makaabot kini og kapin sa 2 metro ug motimbang og hangtod 900 kilo — ug imbes sa matig-a nga mga plaka sa kalansay adunay kini og gahi nga katad nga panit.

q: Whose portraits appeared on the older 1,000-peso banknote?
options: Jose Abad Santos, Vicente Lim, and Josefa Llanes Escoda
Jose Rizal, Andres Bonifacio, and Apolinario Mabini
Manuel Quezon, Sergio Osmeña, and Manuel Roxas
Emilio Aguinaldo, Marcelo del Pilar, and Graciano Lopez Jaena
explanation: The older 1,000-peso banknote featured Jose Abad Santos, Vicente Lim, and Josefa Llanes Escoda.
fact_tl: Ang lumang 1,000-piso na pera ay nagtatampok kina Jose Abad Santos, Vicente Lim, at Josefa Llanes Escoda.
fact_bis: Ang daang 1,000-piso nga kwarta nagpakita kang Jose Abad Santos, Vicente Lim, ug Josefa Llanes Escoda.

q: What happens to a porcupine's quills when an animal gets too close?
options: The quills come loose easily and stick into the attacker's skin
The quills stand up stiffly but stay attached to the porcupine's body
The porcupine shoots the quills through the air at the attacker
The quills curve inward and grip the attacker's skin like hooks
explanation: A porcupine's sharp quills come loose easily and stick into the skin of any animal that gets too close.
fact_tl: Ang matutulis na tinik ng porcupine ay madaling natatanggal at tumitirik sa balat ng hayop na lumapit dito.
fact_bis: Ang hait nga tunok sa porcupine sayon nga matangtang ug motusok sa panit sa hayop nga moduol niini.

q: How does oxygen cross a cell membrane without the cell using any energy?
options: By diffusion — it moves from an area of high concentration to an area of low concentration
By active transport — the cell pumps it through special channels using energy
By osmosis — water carries the oxygen molecules through the membrane
By filtration — pressure forces the oxygen through tiny pores in the membrane
explanation: Oxygen crosses the cell membrane through diffusion, moving from high to low concentration without the cell needing to use energy.
fact_tl: Ang diffusion ay ang galaw ng mga molekyul mula sa lugar na may mataas na konsentrasyon patungo sa lugar na may mababa — ang oxygen ay dumadaan sa cell membrane sa pamamagitan ng diffusion nang hindi na kailangan ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Ang diffusion ang kihap sa mga molekyul gikan sa lugar nga adunay taas nga konsentrasyon ngadto sa lugar nga adunay ubos — ang oxygen motabok sa cell membrane pinaagi sa diffusion nga walay paggamit og enerhiya ang selula.

q: What is the 'eye' of a typhoon like?
options: It is the calm, clear center of the typhoon with almost no rain or wind
It is the most dangerous part of the typhoon where wind speeds are highest
It is a ring of dark clouds that spins fastest at the edge of the storm
It is the outer edge of the typhoon where rain first begins to fall
explanation: The eye of the storm is the calm, clear center of a typhoon where there is almost no rain or wind.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng bagyo ang tahimik at malinaw na gitna ng isang bagyo kung saan halos walang ulan o hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa bagyo mao ang kalmado ug klaro nga sentro sa bagyo diin halos walay ulan o hangin.

q: How do forest animals help the durian tree survive?
options: They are attracted by its strong smell, eat its fruit, and help spread its seeds
They dig holes near its roots that let water reach the tree more easily
They protect the tree's spiky trunk from being eaten by insects
They carry pollen from flower to flower so the tree can produce fruit
explanation: The durian's strong smell attracts forest animals that eat its fruit and spread its seeds.
fact_tl: Ang durian ay tanyag na prutas na may ligaw na pinagmulan sa kagubatan ng Mindanao, lalo na sa Davao. May matinik itong balat at malakas na amoy, pero ang amoy na ito ay nakakaakit ng mga hayop sa gubat na tumutulong magkalat ng buto.
fact_bis: Ang durian usa ka bantog nga prutas nga ihalas ang gigikanan sa kalasangan sa Mindanao, ilabi na sa Davao. Adunay kini tunokon nga panit ug kusog nga baho, apan kini nga baho makadani sa mga hayop sa lasang nga motabang pagkatag sa liso.

q: What is the Zambales Ophiolite Complex in Luzon an example of?
options: Ancient ocean floor that was pushed onto land instead of sinking, and now contains nickel ore
A chain of underwater volcanoes that rose above sea level to form mountains
A deposit of coral reef limestone that was lifted by earthquakes over millions of years
A layer of granite rock that formed when magma cooled slowly deep underground
explanation: An ophiolite is ancient ocean floor pushed onto land; the Zambales Ophiolite Complex is an example that now contains nickel ore deposits.
fact_tl: Ang ophiolite ay isang piraso ng sinaunang ocean floor na itinulak sa ibabaw ng lupa sa halip na sumubduct; ang Zambales Ophiolite Complex sa Luzon ay isang halimbawa ng sinaunang ocean floor na ngayon ay nasa lupa at nagtataglay ng nickel ore deposits.
fact_bis: Ang ophiolite usa ka piraso sa karaan nga ilawom sa dagat nga giitsa sa ibabaw sa yuta imbes nga mosubduct; ang Zambales Ophiolite Complex sa Luzon usa ka pananglitan sa karaan nga ilawom sa dagat karon nasa yuta ug naglangkob og mga nickel ore deposit.

q: What do some kinds of mudskipper prefer to eat?
options: Algae and tiny plants that grow on the surface of the mud
Small crabs and insects they catch on the mudflat
Worms and small fish they dig out of the mud
Dead leaves and plant matter that washes onto the shore
explanation: Some kinds of mudskipper prefer to graze on algae and tiny plants that grow on the surface of the mud.
fact_tl: Ang ilang uri naman ng mudskipper ay mas mahilig kumain ng lumot at maliliit na halaman na tumutubo sa ibabaw ng putik.
fact_bis: Ang ubang matang sa mudskipper mas gusto mokaon ug lumot ug gagmay nga tanom nga motubo sa ibabaw sa lapok.

q: Which river carries the most water in the world?
options: The Amazon River in South America
The Nile River in Africa
The Yangtze River in Asia
The Mississippi River in North America
explanation: The river carrying the most water in the world is the Amazon River in South America.
fact_tl: Ang ilog na may pinakamaraming tubig na umaagos ay ang Ilog Amazon (Amazon River) sa South America.
fact_bis: Ang suba nga may pinakadaghang tubig nga nagaagos mao ang Suba sa Amazon (Amazon River) sa South America.

q: What does a snake do when it sheds its skin?
options: It leaves behind the old skin like a thin empty cover as new skin grows
It loses its skin completely and grows an entirely different type of skin
It sheds only the skin on its head to allow its jaw to grow bigger
It rubs its body against rocks to scrape off patches of old skin one at a time
explanation: A snake sheds its skin by replacing it, leaving behind the old skin like a thin empty cover.
fact_tl: Naghuhunos o nagpapalit ng balat ang ahas, kaya naiiwan nito ang lumang balat na parang manipis na sapin.
fact_bis: Ang bitin maghukas o magpuli sa panit niini, mao nga mabilin ang daan nga panit nga sama sa nipis nga sapot.

q: How do animals living near hydrothermal vents on the seafloor get energy?
options: From chemicals released by the vents instead of from sunlight
From sunlight that filters down from the surface through clear water
From eating bits of food that fall down from animals near the surface
From the extreme heat of the vent water, which they absorb through their skin
explanation: At hydrothermal vents, animals use energy from chemicals rather than from sunlight.
fact_tl: Sa mga 'hydrothermal vent,' kung saan lumalabas ang mainit na tubig mula sa ilalim ng dagat, may mga hayop na nabubuhay gamit ang enerhiya mula sa kemikal, hindi sa araw.
fact_bis: Sa mga 'hydrothermal vent,' diin mogawas ang init nga tubig gikan sa salog sa dagat, adunay mga mananap nga nabuhi pinaagi sa kusog gikan sa kemikal, dili sa adlaw.

q: Which of the following is found in a plant cell but NOT in an animal cell?
options: A cell membrane
A nucleus
A cell wall and chloroplasts
Cytoplasm
explanation: A plant cell has a stiff cell wall and chloroplasts that an animal cell does not have, which is why the two look different.
fact_tl: Ang selula ng halaman ay may matigas na cell wall at chloroplast na wala sa selula ng hayop, kaya magkaiba ang anyo ng dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang selula sa tanom may gahi nga cell wall ug chloroplast nga wala sa selula sa mananap, busa lahi ang panagway sa duha.

q: Some plants have fungi on their roots that help them absorb water and minerals. What does the plant give the fungi in return?
options: Oxygen that the plant produces during respiration
Sugar that the plant made through photosynthesis
Water that the plant absorbed from rain
Minerals that the plant pulled from the soil
explanation: In this mutualistic relationship, the fungi help the plant soak up water and minerals from the soil, and the plant gives the fungi sugar it made.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang may fungi sa ugat na tumutulong sumipsip ng tubig at mineral mula sa lupa; bilang kapalit, binibigyan ng halaman ang fungi ng asukal na ginawa nito.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang adunay fungi sa gamot nga motabang pagsuyop ug tubig ug mineral gikan sa yuta; baylo niini, hatagan sa tanom ang fungi ug asukal nga gihimo niini.

q: What is the name of the galaxy that our Sun and Earth belong to?
options: Andromeda
The Solar Way
The Milky Way
Orion
explanation: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way, which is a huge group of billions of stars including our Sun.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin (stars) ay napakalalaking bola ng nag-aapoy na gas na naglalabas ng sarili nilang liwanag at init — tulad ng ating Araw. Ang galaxy ay napakalaking grupo ng bilyon-bilyong bituin; ang ating galaxy ay tinatawag na Milky Way. Napakalayo ng mga bituin kaya tila maliit lang sila sa langit.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon (stars) dagko kaayong bola sa nagdilaab nga gas nga mobuga sa ilang kaugalingong kahayag ug kainit — sama sa atong Adlaw. Ang galaxy dako kaayong grupo sa bilyon-bilyon ka bituon; ang atong galaxy gitawag og Milky Way. Layo kaayo ang mga bituon mao nga morag gagmay lang sila sa langit.

q: Why does the carabao have wide, split hooves?
options: To grip tree bark when scratching its legs
To kick away predators more effectively
To stop it from sinking in muddy ground
To dig up roots and tubers for food
explanation: The carabao's wide, split (cloven) hooves spread its weight so it does not sink in muddy ground.
fact_tl: May malalapad at biak na kuko ang kalabaw para hindi ito lumubog sa maputik na lupa.
fact_bis: Ang kabaw adunay lapad ug bahin nga kuko aron dili kini malubong sa lapokon nga yuta.

q: In the water-pipe analogy for electricity, what does the flowing water represent?
options: The voltage pushing the electricity
The electrical current flowing through the wire
The resistance slowing the electricity down
The battery providing the energy
explanation: In this analogy, the wire is like the pipe and the current is like the water flowing inside — the more water flowing, the more current there is.
fact_tl: Madaling intindihin ang current kung iisipin mong parang tubig sa tubo. Ang wire ang tubo, at ang current ang tubig na dumadaloy sa loob. Mas malakas ang daloy, mas maraming current — gaya ng mas maraming tubig na dumadaan.
fact_bis: Sayon sabton ang current kung hunahunaon nimo nga sama sa tubig sa tubo. Ang wire mao ang tubo, ug ang current mao ang tubig nga moagos sa sulod. Mas kusog ang agos, mas daghan ang current — sama sa mas daghang tubig nga moagi.

q: About how long does one day last on the planet Neptune?
options: About 10 hours
About 16 hours
About 24 hours
About 36 hours
explanation: One day on Neptune, meaning one full rotation, lasts about 16 hours.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Neptune (isang pag-ikot nito) ay tumatagal ng halos 16 oras.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Neptune (usa ka pagtuyok niini) molungtad ug mga 16 ka oras.

q: How is a star different from the Moon and planets when it comes to light?
options: Stars reflect sunlight, while the Moon and planets make their own light.
Stars make their own light, while the Moon and planets only reflect the Sun's light.
Stars and planets both make their own light, but the Moon does not.
Stars borrow light from nearby planets, while the Moon makes its own.
explanation: Stars make their own light through nuclear reactions, unlike the Moon and planets that only reflect the Sun's light.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin ay gumagawa ng sariling liwanag, hindi tulad ng Buwan at mga planeta na nagpapakita lang ng liwanag ng Araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon naghimo sa ilang kaugalingong kahayag, dili sama sa Bulan ug mga planeta nga nagbanaag lang sa kahayag sa Adlaw.

q: What is the name for the route that migratory birds follow when they fly to the Philippines each winter?
options: A corridor
A flyway
A migration lane
A bird highway
explanation: Migratory birds travel along a route called a flyway to reach the Philippines each northern winter, stopping at wetlands like Candaba to rest and feed.
fact_tl: Tuwing taglamig sa hilaga, maraming ibong dayo ang lumilipad pababa sa Pilipinas sa daang tinatawag na flyway; ang mga latian tulad ng Candaba ay pahingahan at pakainan nila.
fact_bis: Matag tugnaw sa amihanan, daghang langyaw nga langgam molupad paubos sa Pilipinas agi sa dalan nga gitawag og flyway; ang mga latian sama sa Candaba mao ang ilang pahulayanan ug kan-anan.

q: Why do engineers study a bridge's natural frequency before it is built?
options: To find out how many vehicles can cross at the same time
To make sure the bridge's frequency will not match wind or traffic and cause dangerous swaying
To determine the best materials to use for the deck
To calculate how long the bridge will take to build
explanation: Engineers study a bridge's natural frequency to make sure it will not match the frequency of wind or traffic, which could cause the bridge to start swaying dangerously.
fact_tl: Inaaral ng mga inhinyero ang natural na prekwensiya ng tulay para tiyaking hindi ito tutugma sa hangin o trapiko at sumayaw nang delikado.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga inhinyero ang kinaiyanhon nga prekwensiya sa taytayan aron sigurohon nga dili kini motakdo sa hangin o trapiko ug mosayaw nga delikado.

q: How did many islands, including many in the Philippines, form?
options: Large pieces of the ocean floor were pushed sideways to create dry land.
Wind and rain wore away the surrounding seafloor, leaving high ground above water.
Undersea volcanoes erupted and their cooled lava piled up until it rose above the water.
Coral reefs grew so tall over millions of years that they became islands.
explanation: Many Philippine islands formed when undersea volcanoes erupted and their cooled lava accumulated over time until it rose above the water's surface.
fact_tl: Maraming pulo, gaya ng marami sa Pilipinas, ay nabuo nang sumabog ang mga bulkan sa ilalim ng dagat at unti-unting nagtumpok ang tumigas na lava hanggang umangat ito sa ibabaw ng tubig.
fact_bis: Daghang isla, sama sa daghan sa Pilipinas, naporma sa dihang mibuto ang mga bulkan ilalom sa dagat ug anam-anam nga nagtapok ang nagbugnaw nga lava hangtod miangat kini ibabaw sa tubig.

q: Why are many fermented foods kept submerged under brine (salty liquid)?
options: The salt adds nutrients and vitamins to the food.
Keeping food under liquid keeps it cold and slows all chemical reactions.
Without air, mold and spoilage microbes that need oxygen cannot grow.
The liquid draws moisture out of the food to make it last longer.
explanation: Mold and many spoilage microbes need oxygen to grow, so keeping fermented foods submerged under brine prevents air from reaching them and stops spoilage.
fact_tl: Maraming pagkaing fermented ay nakalubog sa tubig-asin para walang hangin na umabot dito; dahil kailangan ng amag at maraming nakasisirang mikrobyo ng oxygen, hindi sila tumutubo sa ilalim ng tubig.
fact_bis: Daghang fermented nga pagkaon ginalubog sa tubig-asin aron walay hangin nga makaabot; tungod kay ang agup-op ug daghang makadaot nga mikrobyo nanginahanglan og oxygen, dili sila motubo ilalom sa tubig.

q: What effect does ocean warming caused by climate change have on coral reefs?
options: It makes coral grow faster and produce more reef structure.
It causes coral bleaching to happen more often.
It causes ocean water to become less salty, harming fish.
It increases the amount of algae that coral needs for food.
explanation: Climate change is warming the oceans, which makes coral bleaching — a stress response where coral expels the algae it needs — happen more frequently.
fact_tl: Ang pagbabago ng klima ang nagpapainit sa karagatan, kaya mas madalas nang nangyayari ang coral bleaching.
fact_bis: Ang kausaban sa klima maoy nagpainit sa kadagatan, mao nga mas masubsob nang mahitabo ang coral bleaching.

q: Why do most leaves appear green to our eyes?
options: Leaves absorb green light and release the other colors.
Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light for photosynthesis and reflects green light back to our eyes.
Green light passes straight through the leaf, making it look green from behind.
Leaves produce a green pigment that has nothing to do with photosynthesis.
explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light most effectively for photosynthesis and reflects green light, which is why leaves appear green.
fact_tl: Ang chlorophyll ay pinaka-mahusay sa pag-absorb ng pula at asul na liwanag para sa photosynthesis—nire-reflect nito ang berde na liwanag, kaya berde ang kulay ng mga dahon sa ating mga mata.
fact_bis: Ang chlorophyll pinaka-epektibo sa pag-absorb sa pula ug asul nga kahayag para sa photosynthesis; ginareflect niya ang berde nga kahayag, mao kana ang rason nga berde ang mga dahon sa atong mga mata.

q: What is the medical name for the flat bone in the middle of your chest?
options: Clavicle
Scapula
Sternum
Patella
explanation: The bone in the middle of the chest is called the sternum, also known as the breastbone.
fact_tl: Ang buto sa gitna ng dibdib ay tinatawag na sternum o breastbone.
fact_bis: Ang bukog sa tunga sa dughan gitawag og sternum o breastbone.

q: After a tsunami's first wave, how long can the danger last?
options: A few minutes, after the first wave passes
Only until the water fully drains back
For hours, so it is not safe to return after the first wave
Until the next high tide arrives
explanation: A tsunami's danger can last for hours because more waves can follow, so it is not yet safe to return after the first wave.
fact_tl: Ang panganib ng tsunami ay maaaring tumagal nang ilang oras, kaya hindi pa ligtas bumalik pagkatapos ng unang alon.
fact_bis: Ang peligro sa tsunami mahimong molungtad ug pipila ka oras, mao nga dili pa luwas mobalik human sa unang balod.

q: What special ability do some parrots have that most other birds do not?
options: They can see in complete darkness.
They can mimic sounds and even words.
They can hold their breath underwater for several minutes.
They can detect Earth's magnetic field to navigate.
explanation: Parrots are clever birds, and some can mimic sounds and even words.
fact_tl: Ang mga loro ay matatalinong ibon at ang ilan ay kayang gumaya ng mga tunog at salita.
fact_bis: Ang mga loro maalamon nga mga langgam ug ang uban makahimo og sundog sa mga tingog ug pulong.

q: Why does your body fight off the same germ much faster the second time you are infected?
options: Your body makes the germ weaker each time it enters.
After the first infection, the body leaves behind memory cells that respond faster and stronger.
Your white blood cells multiply every time you catch a new sickness.
The germ loses its ability to cause disease after the first infection.
explanation: After fighting a germ, the body leaves behind memory cells so that if the same germ returns, the immune defense is faster and stronger.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos malabanan ang isang germ, nag-iiwan ang katawan ng mga 'memory cell' kaya kapag bumalik ang parehong germ, mas mabilis at mas malakas na ang depensa.
fact_bis: Human masukol ang usa ka germ, magbilin ang lawas og mga 'memory cell' aron kon mobalik ang samang germ, mas paspas ug mas kusgan na ang depensa.

q: What does a garbage patch in the ocean actually look like?
options: A solid floating island of trash you could walk on
A layer of large plastic bottles covering the whole ocean surface
A soup of millions of tiny plastic bits scattered across a huge area of water
A visible mountain of garbage sitting on the ocean floor
explanation: The garbage patch is not a solid island — it is more like a soup of millions of tiny plastic bits scattered across a huge area of water.
fact_tl: Hindi isang matibay na isla ng basura ang garbage patch na malalakaran mo — mas parang "sopas" ito ng milyon-milyong maliliit na plastik na nakakalat sa malawak na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang garbage patch dili usa ka gahi nga isla sa basura nga imong malakawan — mas sama kini sa "sabaw" sa minilyon nga gagmay nga plastik nga nagkatag sa lapad nga tubig.

q: What kind of food does the carabao eat?
options: Fish, insects, and small frogs from the paddy fields
Grass, leaves, and rice straw — it never eats meat
Roots, seeds, and the bark of trees
Rice grains, corn, and other harvested crops
explanation: The carabao is a herbivore that eats grass, leaves, and rice straw, and it never eats meat.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay isang herbivore na kumakain ng damo, dahon, at dayami. Ito ang katuwang ng magsasaka sa bukid at hindi kailanman kumakain ng karne.
fact_bis: Ang kabaw usa ka herbivore nga mokaon og sagbot, dahon, ug dagami. Kini ang katabang sa mag-uuma sa uma ug dili gyud mokaon og karne.

q: The kalaw (Philippine hornbill) makes two different loud sounds. Where does the 'whoosh' sound come from?
options: From its throat, just like its loud call
From its beak snapping open and closed rapidly
From its broad wings beating the air when flying
From the air escaping its large casque on top of its beak
explanation: The kalaw's whoosh sound comes from its broad wings beating the air during flight, while its other loud call comes from its throat.
fact_tl: Bukod sa malakas na tawag, may isa pang malakas na tunog ang kalaw: ang 'whoosh' ng mga pakpak nito kapag lumilipad, na parang hangin o tren. Pero magkaiba ang dalawa, ang tawag ay galing sa lalamunan, samantalang ang whoosh ay galing sa malalapad na pakpak na humahampas sa hangin.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kusog nga tawag, naa'y laing kusog nga tingog ang kalaw: ang 'whoosh' sa iyang pako kung molupad, sama sa hangin o tren. Apan lahi ang duha, ang tawag gikan sa tutonlan, samtang ang whoosh gikan sa lapad nga pako nga mokampay sa hangin.

q: When plastic is burned, why does it give off carbon dioxide?
options: Plastic contains water, which releases carbon dioxide when heated.
Plastic is made from oil, which is carbon-based, so burning it releases carbon dioxide.
Carbon dioxide is trapped inside plastic during manufacturing.
The nitrogen in plastic combines with oxygen in the air to form carbon dioxide.
explanation: Most plastic comes from oil, which is carbon-based, so when plastic is burned it releases carbon dioxide, which is why plastic waste affects the environment.
fact_tl: Pati ang plastik ay gawa sa carbon. Karamihan ng plastik ay galing sa langis (na carbon-based din), kaya kapag sinunog ito, naglalabas ng carbon dioxide. Ito ang isang dahilan kung bakit nakakaapekto ang basurang plastik sa kapaligiran.
fact_bis: Bisan ang plastik hinimo sa carbon. Kadaghanan sa plastik naggikan sa lana (nga carbon-based usab), mao nga kung sunogon kini, mobuga og carbon dioxide. Mao kini usa ka rason nganong ang basurang plastik makaapekto sa palibot.

q: Salt is dissolved in water. Which method can remove the salt from the water?
options: Filtering, because it catches all particles including dissolved salt
Distillation, because only the salt-free water vapor is collected and condensed
Filtering, but only if the filter paper has very tiny holes
Both filtering and distillation remove dissolved salt equally well
explanation: Filtering cannot remove dissolved salt, but distillation can because only the salt-free water vapor is collected, leaving the salt behind.
fact_tl: Hindi maaalis ng pagsala ang asing natunaw sa tubig, ngunit kaya ito ng distilasyon dahil ang singaw lamang ang naaalisan ng asin.
fact_bis: Ang pagsala dili makakuha sa asin nga natunaw sa tubig, apan ang distillation makahimo kay ang walay-asin nga alisngaw lamang ang matigom.

q: Why does light bend when it travels from air into water?
options: Water blocks part of the light beam, pushing the rest sideways.
Light changes color in water, and different colors travel in different directions.
Light slows down when it enters water, and this change in speed makes it bend.
Water molecules push light upward, causing it to appear to bend.
explanation: Light slows down when it enters water or glass, and this change in speed is what causes it to bend (refract).
fact_tl: Bumabagal ang liwanag kapag pumapasok ito sa tubig o salamin, at ang pagbabagong ito ng bilis ang dahilan kaya ito bumabaluktot.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag mohinay kon mosulod kini sa tubig o salamin, ug kini nga kausaban sa katulin maoy hinungdan nga moliko kini.

q: A school feeding program plans meals using the Go, Grow, and Glow system. Which food group provides energy (Go foods)?
options: Vegetables and fruits
Meat and beans
Rice and other energy foods
Milk and dairy products
explanation: In the Go, Grow, and Glow system, energy foods like rice are Go foods, body-building foods like meat or beans are Grow foods, and protective foods like vegetables and fruit are Glow foods.
fact_tl: Hindi basta-basta ang pagpili ng pagkain sa feeding program. Pinaplano ito gamit ang ideya ng Go, Grow, at Glow foods para balanse ang pagkain, ibig sabihin may pampalakas (kanin), pampalaki (karne o munggo), at pampaganda ng katawan (gulay at prutas) sa bawat handa.
fact_bis: Dili basta-basta ang pagpili og pagkaon sa feeding program. Giplano kini gamit ang ideya sa Go, Grow, ug Glow nga pagkaon aron balanse ang pagkaon, buot ipasabot adunay pangkusog (kan-on), pangpadako (karne o munggo), ug pangpanalipod sa lawas (utanon ug prutas) sa matag andam.

q: How does soap destroy many viruses and bacteria?
options: Soap makes the water so hot that it kills any germ it touches.
Soap breaks apart the fatty outer coat of many viruses and bacteria so water can wash them away.
Soap produces a chemical that poisons germs on contact.
Soap makes your skin too slippery for germs to hold on to.
explanation: Soap destroys germs by breaking apart the fatty outer coat of many viruses and bacteria, allowing water to wash them away.
fact_tl: Sumisira ang sabon sa mga mikrobyo dahil pinaghihiwa-hiwalay nito ang mantikang balot ng maraming virus at bakterya, kaya naaanod sila ng tubig.
fact_bis: Gun-ubon sa sabon ang mga mikrobyo kay buak-buakon niini ang tambok nga sapaw sa daghang virus ug bakterya, mao nga mabanlasan sila sa tubig.

q: How do butterflies help plants while visiting flowers?
options: They eat harmful insects that would otherwise destroy the flowers.
They carry pollen between flowers while sipping nectar.
They water the plants by collecting rain and releasing it near roots.
They dig small tunnels in the soil to help plant roots breathe.
explanation: While sipping nectar, butterflies carry pollen from flower to flower, which helps plants reproduce through pollination.
fact_tl: Habang sumisipsip ng nektar, nakakatulong ang paru-paro na ilipat ang polen sa pagitan ng mga bulaklak.
fact_bis: Samtang nagasuyop sa nektar, ang alibangbang nakatabang sa pagbalhin sa polen tali sa mga bulak.

q: Why do farmers measure the pH of their soil before planting?
options: To find out how many worms and insects live in the soil
To know which fertilizer or crop suits their land, since each plant needs the right soil pH
To measure how much water the soil can hold after rain
To check whether the soil has enough sand or clay mixed in
explanation: Each plant has a right soil pH to grow well, so farmers measure soil pH to decide which fertilizer or crop is suited to their land.
fact_tl: May tamang pH ng lupa ang bawat halaman para lumago nang mabuti. Sinusukat ng mga magsasaka ang pH ng lupa para malaman kung anong abono o tanim ang bagay sa kanilang taniman.
fact_bis: Ang matag tanom adunay saktong pH sa yuta aron motubo og maayo. Gisukod sa mga mag-uuma ang pH sa yuta aron mahibal-an kung unsang abono o tanom ang haom sa ilang uma.

q: Why do Philippine birdwing butterflies have bright, shiny colors on their wings?
options: The bright colors attract the sunlight they need for warmth.
The colors help them blend into colorful flowers while feeding.
Their bright colors warn birds that they taste bad.
The shiny wings reflect light to communicate with other birdwings.
explanation: The birdwing butterfly's bright colors serve as a warning to birds that they taste bad, which is a form of defense called warning coloration.
fact_tl: Sa kagubatan ng Pilipinas, may malalaking paru-paro na tinatawag na birdwing na may makinang na dilaw, berde, o itim na pakpak. Ang matingkad na kulay nila ay babala sa mga ibon na masama ang lasa nila. Pambihira at maganda silang makita sa ating bansa!
fact_bis: Sa kalasangan sa Pilipinas, adunay dagkong alibangbang nga gitawag og birdwing nga adunay masinaw nga dalag, berde, o itom nga pako. Ang ilang hayag nga kolor nagpasidaan sa mga langgam nga baho silag lami. Talagsaon ug nindot silang tan-awon sa atong nasod!

q: What are the four forces that act on an airplane in flight?
options: Speed, gravity, fuel, and air resistance
Lift, weight, thrust, and drag
Power, pull, push, and friction
Lift, gravity, engine force, and wind
explanation: Four forces act on a flying airplane: lift pushing up, weight pulling down, thrust pushing forward, and drag pulling back.
fact_tl: May apat na puwersang gumagana sa lumilipad na eroplano: lift (pataas), weight (pababa dahil sa bigat), thrust (pasulong) at drag (pabalik na hangin). Lilipad ito kapag sapat ang lift at thrust.
fact_bis: Adunay upat ka kusog nga molihok sa naglupad nga eroplano: lift (pataas), weight (pababa tungod sa gibug-aton), thrust (pasulong) ug drag (pabalik nga hangin). Molupad kini kung igo na ang lift ug thrust.

q: The Bakhawan Eco-Park in Kalibo, Aklan is famous for its mangroves. What are TWO benefits these mangroves provide?
options: They produce rice and provide drinking water for the community.
They store carbon and protect the coast from storms.
They attract tourists and produce timber for building.
They clean the air of city smoke and supply food for farm animals.
explanation: The Bakhawan Eco-Park mangroves store carbon, shelter fish and birds, and protect the coastline from storms.
fact_tl: Sa Kalibo, Aklan ay may sikat na Bakhawan Eco-Park kung saan libo-libong bakawan ang itinanim ng mga tao. Ang lugar na ito ay nag-iimbak ng carbon, nagtataguan ng mga isda at ibon, at nagpoprotekta sa baybayin mula sa bagyo.
fact_bis: Sa Kalibo, Aklan adunay bantog nga Bakhawan Eco-Park diin libolibo nga bakawan ang gitanom sa mga tawo. Kini nga dapit nagtipig ug carbon, nagsilong sa mga isda ug langgam, ug nagpanalipod sa baybayon gikan sa bagyo.

q: In which country is the ancient Maya city of Chichen Itza located?
options: Guatemala
Peru
Mexico
Brazil
explanation: Chichen Itza is located in the Yucatan peninsula in Mexico.
fact_tl: Ang Chichen Itza ay matatagpuan sa Yucatan sa bansang Mexico.
fact_bis: Ang Chichen Itza nahimutang sa Yucatan sa nasod nga Mexico.

q: What does a silkworm use to make its cocoon, and how long can that material be?
options: A web of protein threads up to 100 meters long
A continuous silk thread that can be up to one kilometer long
A sticky mixture of saliva and leaves up to 500 meters long
A woven net of fine hairs up to 200 meters long
explanation: The silkworm spins a cocoon around itself using a single continuous silk thread that can be up to one kilometer long.
fact_tl: Ang uod ng sutla (silkworm) ay nagtatayo ng cocoon sa palibot ng sarili nito gamit ang isang patuloy na hibla ng sutla na maaaring hanggang isang kilometro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang uod sa sutla nagbuhat og cocoon sa palibot sa iyang kaugalingon gamit ang usa ka tuluy-tuloyon nga hibla sa sutla nga mahimong hangtod usa ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Where is the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) located in the Philippines?
options: Quezon City, Metro Manila
Los Banos, Laguna
Cagayan de Oro, Misamis Oriental
Iloilo City, Iloilo
explanation: The IRRI is located in Los Banos, Laguna, where it discovers new rice varieties to help feed more people worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang IRRI o International Rice Research Institute na matatagpuan sa Los Banos, Laguna ay nagtutuklas ng mga bagong uri ng palay upang mapakain ang mas maraming tao sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang IRRI o International Rice Research Institute nga nahimutang sa Los Banos, Laguna nagatuklas og bag-ong mga klase sa palay aron makapakaon og mas daghang tawo sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: The kagwang, or Philippine flying lemur, is called a 'flying' mammal. What does it actually do?
options: It flaps large wings and flies short distances between trees.
It jumps so far that it looks like it is flying through the air.
It glides from tree to tree using a wide flap of skin along its body.
It climbs to high branches and drops down in a controlled dive.
explanation: The kagwang does not truly fly — it glides from tree to tree using the wide flap of skin along its body.
fact_tl: Ang kagwang o Philippine flying lemur ay isang mammal na hindi talaga lumilipad kundi nag-glide mula sa puno patungo sa puno gamit ang malapad na balat sa gilid ng katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang kagwang o Philippine flying lemur usa ka mammal nga dili tinuod nga molupad kondili mo-glide gikan sa kahoy ngadto sa laing kahoy pinaagi sa lapad nga panit sa kilid sa lawas niini.

q: What does an electromagnet need to work that a regular permanent magnet does not?
options: A special iron core wrapped in copper
A battery or other source of electricity
A very cold temperature to keep the magnetism stable
A spinning motion to generate its magnetic field
explanation: Unlike a permanent magnet, an electromagnet needs a battery or other source of electricity to create and maintain its magnetic force.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng elektromagnet ng baterya o ibang pinagkukunan ng kuryente para gumana ito.
fact_bis: Ang elektromagnet nagkinahanglan ug baterya o ubang tinubdan sa kuryente aron molihok kini.

q: Which of the following is an effective way to help protect coral reefs?
options: Removing coral from the reef so it can grow somewhere safer
Filling the sea with more salt to make corals stronger
Keeping the sea clean and supporting marine protected areas
Increasing the water temperature slightly to speed up coral growth
explanation: We can help coral reefs by keeping the sea clean, avoiding pollution, and supporting marine protected areas.
fact_tl: Matutulungan natin ang coral reef sa pamamagitan ng paglilinis ng dagat, pag-iwas sa polusyon, at pagsuporta sa mga marine protected area.
fact_bis: Matabangan nato ang coral reef pinaagi sa paglimpyo sa dagat, paglikay sa polusyon, ug pagsuporta sa mga marine protected area.

q: In which direction does a gas inside a container push (exert pressure)?
options: Only downward, because gas is affected by gravity
Only outward through the nearest opening
Equally in all directions — upward, downward, and sideways
Only upward, because gas is lighter than the container walls
explanation: A gas inside a container exerts equal pressure in all directions — upward, downward, and sideways — which is why a balloon expands equally all around.
fact_tl: Ang isang gas sa loob ng isang lalagyan ay nagbibigay ng pantay na presyon sa lahat ng direksyon — pataas, pababa, at sa magkabilang gilid. Kaya naman ang isang balloon ay pumapalakas sa lahat ng direksyon nang pare-pareho.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka gas sulod sa usa ka sudlanan naghatag og pantay nga presyon sa tanan nga direksyon — pataas, pababa, ug sa duha ka kilid. Mao kana kung ngano ang usa ka balloon nagpapalawak nga pantay sa tanan nga direksyon.

q: Most people think all anglerfish live in the very deep ocean. What is true?
options: All anglerfish only live at depths below 1,000 meters.
Anglerfish cannot survive at any depth less than 500 meters.
Some kinds of anglerfish live near the floor of shallower seas.
Anglerfish live only in tropical shallow coral reefs.
explanation: Not all anglerfish live in the deep ocean — some kinds live near the floor of shallower seas.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng anglerfish ay nasa kalaliman; may ilang uri na nakatira malapit sa sahig ng mababaw na dagat.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga anglerfish naa sa kahiladman; aduna'y ubang matang nga nagpuyo duol sa salog sa mabaw nga dagat.

q: A mosquito lays its eggs in still water. What stages does it go through before becoming a flying adult?
options: Egg → pupa → larva → adult
Egg → larva (wrigglers) → pupa → adult mosquito
Egg → nymph → cocoon → adult
Egg → adult → larva → pupa
explanation: A mosquito's life cycle goes from eggs laid in still water to larvae (wrigglers) then pupae before becoming adult flying mosquitoes, so removing standing water stops them from multiplying.
fact_tl: Ang lamok ay nangingitlog sa nakatigil na tubig, at ang itlog ay nagiging kiti-kiti at pupa bago lumipad bilang lamok, kaya mahalagang alisin ang nakaipong tubig para hindi ito dumami.
fact_bis: Ang lamok mangitlog sa nagtigi nga tubig, ug ang itlog mahimong kiti-kiti ug pupa una pa kini molupad isip lamok, busa importante nga kuhaon ang natipon nga tubig aron dili kini modaghan.

q: How do scientists use the firefly's glowing chemical (luciferin) in medicine?
options: They mix it into medicines to make pills easier to swallow in the dark.
Because it glows near living cells or infections, they use it to detect disease in samples.
They apply it to wounds because it kills bacteria with its light.
They use it to power tiny medical devices inside the human body.
explanation: Scientists use luciferin in the lab because it glows in the presence of living cells or infection, allowing them to detect disease in samples.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang kemikal ng alitaptap (luciferin) sa laboratoryo para sa medisina. Dahil kumikinang ito, magagamit nila ito para makita kung may buhay na cell o impeksyon sa isang sample. Kaya tumutulong ang malamig na ilaw sa pag-aaral ng sakit.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga siyentista ang kemikal sa aninipot (luciferin) sa laboratoryo para sa medisina. Tungod kay mosiga kini, magamit nila aron makita kon adunay buhing cell o impeksyon sa usa ka sample. Busa ang bugnaw nga kahayag motabang sa pagtuon sa sakit.

q: In what year did the Human Genome Project begin?
explanation: The Human Genome Project, which aimed to map all human genes, began in the year 1990.
fact_tl: Nagsimula ang Human Genome Project noong taong 1990.
fact_bis: Ang Human Genome Project nagsugod niadtong tuig 1990.

q: Extremophile bacteria are unusual because they live in places where most living things cannot survive. Which environment is an example of where they live?
options: Inside freshwater ponds with lots of sunlight
In thick forest soil with plenty of nutrients
In extremely hot, acidic, or salty places like volcanic vents and hot springs
On the surfaces of living plant leaves in mild climates
explanation: Extremophile bacteria thrive in extremely hot, acidic, or salty environments such as volcanic vents, hot springs, and the deep ocean floor.
fact_tl: Ang mga extremophile na bakterya ay nabubuhay sa mga lugar na labis na mainit, maasim, o maalat — tulad ng mga bulkan, hot spring, at kailaliman ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga extremophile nga bakterya nabuhi sa mga lugar nga hilabihan ka init, asido, o maasin — sama sa mga volcanic vent, hot spring, ug sa ilawom sa dagat.

q: A gold panner swirls soil in a batya (shallow pan) of water to find gold. Why does the gold sink to the bottom?
options: Gold is magnetic so it is pulled downward by the Earth's magnetic field.
Gold is much heavier than most rock because it has a very high specific gravity.
Gold dissolves in water and then settles again when the water is still.
Gold's smooth surface makes it slide through water faster, so it sinks.
explanation: Gold has a specific gravity of about 19 — much heavier than most rock — so when panned in water it sinks to the bottom while lighter material washes away.
fact_tl: Ang specific gravity ay nagpapakita kung gaano kabigat ang mineral kumpara sa katumbas na dami ng tubig; ang ginto (specific gravity ~19) ay mas mabigat kaysa karamihan ng bato, kaya ito ay lulubog sa ilalim ng batya kapag pandukokin.
fact_bis: Ang specific gravity nagpakita kung unsa kabug-at ang mineral kumpara sa katumbas nga tubig; ang bulawan (specific gravity ~19) mas bug-at kaysa kadaghanan sa bato, mao nga kini mosalod sa ilalim kon gi-pan sa batya.

q: How does breastfeeding help protect a baby from pneumonia?
options: Breast milk is warm, which prevents bacteria from entering the baby's lungs.
Breast milk gives the baby protective substances that help fight off pneumonia.
Breastfeeding keeps the baby's mouth covered so germs cannot enter.
Breast milk thickens the baby's airway lining so viruses cannot get through.
explanation: Breastfeeding gives a baby protection — through antibodies and other immune factors in breast milk — that helps fight off pneumonia.
fact_tl: Ang pagpapasuso ng gatas ng ina ay nagbibigay sa sanggol ng proteksiyon na tumutulong labanan ang pulmonya.
fact_bis: Ang pagpasuso sa gatas sa inahan naghatag sa masuso og panalipod nga makatabang batok sa pulmonya.

q: Candaba Marsh in Pampanga is known for which visiting animals?
options: Large sea turtles that lay eggs on its banks every dry season
Thousands of migratory birds that arrive during the cold months
Whale sharks that swim upriver into the marsh each year
Groups of freshwater dolphins that rest there in winter
explanation: Candaba Marsh in Pampanga is home to thousands of migratory birds that arrive during the cold months, making it an important wetland stopover.
fact_tl: Ang Candaba Marsh sa Pampanga ay tahanan ng libu-libong migratory na ibon na dumarating tuwing malamig na buwan.
fact_bis: Ang Candaba Marsh sa Pampanga maoy gipuy-an sa liboan ka langyaw nga langgam nga moabot sa bugnaw nga mga bulan.

q: Why is it hard for the sea turtle (pawikan) population to recover after many turtles die?
options: Sea turtles lay very few eggs and hide them too deep for any to hatch.
Sea turtles take so long to grow up that the ones that die are hard to replace.
Sea turtles only breed once in their entire lives, so losses are permanent.
Sea turtles migrate so far that young ones cannot find mates when adults are gone.
explanation: Because sea turtles take so long to grow up, the ones that die are very hard to replace, making population recovery slow.
fact_tl: Dahil napakatagal bago tumanda ang pawikan, mahirap mapalitan ang mga namamatay na anak, kaya mas matagal bago dumami ulit ang kanilang bilang.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dugay kaayo mahamtong ang pawikan, lisod mapulihan ang mga anak nga mamatay, busa mas dugay una modaghan pag-usab ang ilang gidaghanon.

q: Why do warm, tropical places like the Philippines experience more lightning-caused nitrogen fixation than cold countries?
options: Tropical soils have more nitrogen gas trapped underground that lightning can release.
The hot, wet tropical climate produces stronger thunderstorms with more frequent lightning.
Cold air holds more nitrogen, so less lightning is needed to fix it in warm places.
Philippine plants absorb more nitrogen from the air, so lightning fixes less in cold countries.
explanation: The hot and wet tropical climate of the Philippines produces strong, frequent thunderstorms with more lightning, which means lightning-driven nitrogen fixation happens more often there than in cold countries.
