fact_tl: Bakit mas maraming kidlat sa mga mainit na lugar tulad ng Pilipinas? Ang mainit at basang klima ng tropiko ay madalas magkaroon ng malalakas na bagyong may kidlat. Dahil dito, mas madalas ang kaunting nitrogen fixing mula sa kidlat sa mga lugar na ito kumpara sa malalamig na bansa. Bahagi ito ng buhay sa ating klima.
fact_bis: Ngano nga ang init nga mga lugar sama sa Pilipinas mas daghan og kilat? Ang init ug basa nga klima sa tropiko kanunay maghimo og kusog nga bagyo nga adunay kilat. Tungod niini, ang gamay nga nitrogen fixing gikan sa kilat mas kanunay mahitabo niini nga mga lugar kaysa bugnaw nga mga nasud. Bahin kini sa kinabuhi sa atong klima.

q: The African elephant is the heaviest land animal. About how much can it weigh?
options: About 1 ton
About 3 tons
About 6 tons
About 10 tons
explanation: The African elephant, the heaviest land animal, can weigh as much as about 6 tons.
fact_tl: Ang African elephant, ang pinakamabigat na hayop sa lupa, ay umaabot sa mga 6 na tonelada ang bigat.
fact_bis: Ang African elephant, ang pinakabug-at nga hayop sa yuta, moabot og mga 6 ka tonelada ang gibug-aton.

q: What is the main purpose of the Hubble Space Telescope?
options: To measure the temperature and weather patterns of distant planets
To orbit Earth and take clear pictures of stars and galaxies
To communicate with space stations and relay signals back to Earth
To look for asteroids that might crash into our planet
explanation: The Hubble Space Telescope orbits Earth to take clear pictures of stars and galaxies, free from the blurring effects of the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang Hubble Space Telescope ay isang teleskopyong umiikot sa Earth para kumuha ng malilinaw na larawan ng mga bituin at galaksiya.
fact_bis: Ang Hubble Space Telescope usa ka teleskopyo nga nagatuyok sa Earth aron mokuha og tin-aw nga mga hulagway sa mga bituon ug galaksiya.

q: Around 1609, Galileo used a telescope to look at the sky. What were TWO things he discovered?
options: He saw mountains on the Moon and the moons of Jupiter.
He saw rings around Saturn and the craters on Mars.
He saw comets near Earth and a new star being born.
He saw the Milky Way galaxy and the clouds of Venus.
explanation: Galileo was one of the first to use a telescope to study the sky, and he discovered mountains on the Moon and the moons of Jupiter.
fact_tl: Si Galileo ang isa sa mga unang gumamit ng teleskopyo para pag-aralan ang langit noong mga 1609, at nakita niya ang mga bundok sa buwan at ang mga buwan ng Jupiter.
fact_bis: Si Galileo usa sa mga unang migamit og teleskopyo aron tun-an ang langit niadtong mga 1609, ug nakita niya ang mga bukid sa bulan ug ang mga bulan sa Jupiter.

q: What do some slugs and snails eat that helps nature recycle?
options: Rotting leaves and dead plant matter
Living green leaves from healthy plants
Insects and small worms in the soil
Mud and minerals from the ground
explanation: Some slugs and snails help nature by eating rotting leaves and dead plant matter, making them important recyclers in an ecosystem.
fact_tl: Ang ilang slug at suso ay tumutulong sa kalikasan sa pamamagitan ng pagkain ng mga nabubulok na dahon.
fact_bis: Ang ubang slug ug suso motabang sa kinaiyahan pinaagi sa pagkaon sa nadunot nga mga dahon.

q: At what age did Paeng Nepomuceno become the youngest bowling world champion?
explanation: Paeng Nepomuceno became the youngest bowling world champion when he won at age 19 in 1976.
fact_tl: Si Paeng Nepomuceno ang pinakabatang world champion sa bowling, na nanalo noong 19 anyos siya noong 1976.
fact_bis: Si Paeng Nepomuceno ang pinakabata nga world champion sa bowling, nga nakadaog sa edad nga 19 niadtong 1976.

q: Why should you never catch a skink by its tail?
options: The skink will drop its tail as a defense, which hurts the animal
The tail is covered in sharp scales that will cut your hand
The tail releases a poison that can make you sick
The tail is too slippery to hold onto safely
explanation: As a defense, a skink will drop its tail right in your hand, which harms the animal, so it is better to just watch and not grab it.
fact_tl: Tanong ng marami: bakit hindi dapat hulihin ang skink sa buntot? Dahil bilang depensa, ihuhulog niya ang buntot mismo sa kamay mo, at masasaktan ang hayop. Mas mabuting tingnan na lang at huwag hawakan ang buntot.
fact_bis: Daghan ang nangutana: ngano dili angay kuptan ang skink sa ikog? Tungod kay isip depensa, iyang ihulog ang ikog mismo sa imong kamot, ug masakitan ang hayop. Mas maayo nga tan-awon lang ug dili kuptan ang ikog.

q: When nothing is pushing a pendulum, where does it come to rest?
options: At its lowest point, called the equilibrium position
At the highest point of its last swing
Exactly halfway between its two highest points
At the point where it was first released
explanation: When nothing pushes it, a pendulum rests at its lowest point, called the equilibrium or rest position.
fact_tl: Kapag walang humahatak dito, ang pendulum ay nakahinto sa pinakamababang punto, na tinatawag na resting position.
fact_bis: Kon walay nagduso niini, ang pendulum mopahulay sa pinakaubos nga punto, nga gitawag nga resting position.

q: Why does the giant squid have eyes almost as large as a dinner plate?
options: To catch the little light in the dark ocean and spot danger
To see color better than any other ocean animal
To detect the electrical fields of nearby fish
To see clearly both in deep and shallow water at the same time
explanation: The giant squid has enormous eyes to catch the little light in the deep dark ocean and spot approaching danger.
fact_tl: May napakalalaking mata ang giant squid, kasinlaki halos ng plato, para makahuli ng kaunting liwanag sa madilim na karagatan at makita ang mga papalapit na panganib.
fact_bis: Ang giant squid adunay dagko kaayo nga mga mata, halos sama kadako sa plato, aron makakuha sa gamay nga kahayag sa ngitngit nga dagat ug makita ang nagsingabot nga kapeligrohan.

q: What should a person with diabetes do if too much insulin causes their blood sugar to drop dangerously low?
options: Quickly eat something sweet to bring blood sugar back up
Take an extra dose of insulin to balance the levels
Drink a large amount of water immediately
Rest and wait for the sugar level to rise on its own
explanation: If blood sugar drops too low due to too much insulin or a missed meal, the person quickly eats something sweet to bring it back up.
fact_tl: Kung sobra ang insulin o nalaktawan ang pagkain, maaaring bumaba nang husto ang asukal sa dugo at makaramdam ng panghihina o pagkahilo; kaya kumakain agad ng matamis ang taong may diabetes para tumaas ito.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang insulin o nalaktawan ang pagkaon, mahimong moubos kaayo ang asukal sa dugo ug maghimo og kaluya o kalipong; mao nga mokaon dayon og tam-is ang tawo aron mosaka kini.

q: Why do many animals have a stripe running across their eyes as part of camouflage?
options: To mask the eye's round, dark shape so the animal is less visible
To make the eye appear larger and scare away predators
To protect the eye from sunlight and improve vision
To signal other members of the same species
explanation: Eyes are round and dark and stand out, so a stripe across the eye masks its shape — a clever part of an animal's camouflage.
fact_tl: Ang mata ay madalas na nagbibigay ng hayop dahil bilog at madilim ito, kaya madaling makita. Maraming hayop ang may guhit na dumadaan sa mata para itago ang hugis nito — isang maliit ngunit matalinong bahagi ng camouflage.
fact_bis: Ang mata kasagaran mobutyag sa hayop kay lingin ug ngitngit kini, mao nga dali makita. Daghang hayop adunay badlis nga moagi sa mata aron itago ang porma niini — gamay apan maalamon nga bahin sa camouflage.

q: How do some flying fish glide extra well through the air?
options: By using four wing-like fins
By using a large fan-shaped tail
By storing air inside their bodies
By leaping from wave to wave with two large fins
explanation: Some flying fish use four wing-like fins to glide even better through the air above the water.
fact_tl: May mga isdang lumilipad na gumagamit ng apat na palikpik na parang pakpak para mas mahusay na lumutang.
fact_bis: Adunay mga isdang naglupad nga mogamit ug upat ka palikpik nga sama sa pako aron mas maayo nga molutaw.

q: What does a dog's wet, cool nose help it do better?
options: Smell its surroundings
See in the dark
Hear distant sounds
Stay cool in hot weather
explanation: A dog's nose is often wet and cool, and this helps it smell its surroundings better.
fact_tl: Madalas basa at malamig ang ilong ng aso, at nakatutulong ito para mas mahusay nitong maamoy ang paligid.
fact_bis: Kanunay basa ug bugnaw ang ilong sa iro, ug makatabang kini aron mas maayo niini nga masimhot ang palibot.

q: Why do you still need to wash your hands even when they look clean?
options: Because thousands of invisible germs can still be on them
Because soap removes oils that trap new dirt later
Because water alone washes away all the visible bacteria
Because dry hands crack and let more germs inside
explanation: Even when hands look clean, thousands of germs too tiny to see are stuck on them, which is why washing is always needed.
fact_tl: Kahit mukhang malinis ang kamay, may libo-libong mikrobyong nakadikit dito na hindi natin nakikita dahil napakaliit ng mga ito. Kaya kailangan pa ring maghugas kahit walang nakikitang dumi.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag limpyo ang kamot, adunay liboan ka mikrobyo nga nakatapot niini nga dili nato makita kay gagmay kaayo sila. Mao nga kinahanglan gihapon manghugas bisan walay makitang hugaw.

q: How many main senses do humans have?
options: Five
Four
Six
Seven
explanation: Humans have five main senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.
fact_tl: Ang tao ay may limang (5) pangunahing pandama: paningin, pandinig, pang-amoy, panlasa, at pandama o pakiramdam (touch).
fact_bis: Ang tawo adunay lima (5) ka panguna nga igbalati: panan-aw, pamati, panimho, panlasa, ug paghikap (touch).

q: Why are older mountains more rounded and smooth compared to younger mountains?
options: Because they have been worn down by erosion over a long time
Because older mountains are made of softer rock than younger ones
Because they were formed underwater and shaped by ocean currents
Because volcanic activity gradually melts and smooths their peaks
explanation: Old mountains are more rounded and smooth because they have been eroded for a very long time, while young mountains are still sharp and steep.
fact_tl: Ang mga batang bundok ay matulis at matarik, habang ang matatandang bundok ay mas bilog at pantay na dahil matagal nang naaagnas.
fact_bis: Ang mga bata pa nga bukid talinis ug tarik, samtang ang tigulang nga bukid mas lingin ug hamis na kay dugay nang nakaykay.

q: Why do some Philippine trees like narra shed their leaves during the dry season?
options: To save water during the harsh dry weather
To protect the leaves from being eaten by dry-season insects
To allow more sunlight to reach the roots below
To stop producing food until the temperature cools down
explanation: A few Philippine trees like narra shed some leaves during the dry season to save water, then grow new ones when the rains return.
fact_tl: May ilang punong Pilipino tulad ng narra na nagbabawas ng dahon kapag matindi ang tag-init para makatipid ng tubig, at muling lumalago kapag umulan.
fact_bis: Pipila ka kahoy sa Pilipinas sama sa narra mawad-an og dahon kon grabe ang ting-init aron makatipig og tubig, dayon manubo pag-usab kon mobalik ang ulan.

q: What is one key difference between a seed and a spore?
options: Seeds contain stored food for the young plant, but spores do not
Spores are much larger and heavier than seeds
Seeds need very specific conditions to grow, while spores do not
Spores always grow into flowering plants, while seeds do not
explanation: Seeds contain an embryo and stored food for the young plant, while spores are simpler structures with no stored food and need ideal conditions to grow.
fact_tl: Ang buto ay naglalaman ng isang embryo at stored food para sa batang halaman, habang ang mga spore ay mas simpleng istruktura na walang stored food at kailangan ng magandang kondisyon para tumubo.
fact_bis: Ang buto naglangkob og embryo ug gitipig nga pagkaon alang sa batang tanom, samtang ang mga spore mas simple nga istruktura nga walay gitipig nga pagkaon ug nagkinahanglan og maayo nga kahimtang aron motubo.

q: According to the 2020 census, which language is spoken at home in the most Philippine households?
options: Tagalog
Cebuano
Ilocano
Hiligaynon
explanation: According to the 2020 census, Tagalog is the most widely spoken language at home in the Philippines, used in about 39.9 percent of households.
fact_tl: Ayon sa 2020 senso, Tagalog ang pinakaginagamit na wika sa tahanan sa Pilipinas, sa humigit-kumulang 39.9 porsyento ng mga sambahayan.
fact_bis: Sumala sa 2020 nga senso, ang Tagalog mao ang pinakadaghang gigamit nga pinulongan sa balay sa Pilipinas, sa mga 39.9 ka porsyento sa mga panimalay.

q: What is the purpose of a grounding wire in an electrical appliance?
options: To give electricity a safe path into the earth so we do not get shocked
To increase the speed at which electricity flows through the appliance
To store extra electricity for use when the power goes out
To prevent the appliance from using too much power at once
explanation: A grounding wire gives electricity a safe path into the earth so we do not get shocked if an appliance breaks.
fact_tl: Ang ground wire ay nagbibigay ng ligtas na daanan ng kuryente papunta sa lupa para hindi tayo makuryente kapag may sira ang gamit.
fact_bis: Ang ground wire naghatag ug luwas nga agianan sa elektrisidad padulong sa yuta aron dili ta makuryente kon maguba ang gamit.

q: How are grasslands most commonly used by people for raising animals?
options: As wide pastures where cattle, goats, and horses feed on grass
As hunting grounds to catch wild animals for food
As sheltered areas where animals are kept in barns all year
As training grounds for working animals like elephants and camels
explanation: Grasslands are used to raise cattle, goats, and horses, serving as wide pastures where the animals feed on grass.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang grassland para mag-alaga ng baka, kambing, at kabayo. Malawak na pastulan ito kung saan kumakain ang mga hayop ng damo.
fact_bis: Gigamit ang grassland aron mag-atiman ug baka, kanding, ug kabayo. Lapad nga sibsibanan kini diin mokaon ang mga hayop ug sagbot.

q: What is the birthstone for the month of February?
options: Amethyst
Garnet
Aquamarine
Ruby
explanation: The birthstone for February is the amethyst, a purple variety of quartz.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Pebrero ay ang amethyst, isang lilang uri ng quartz.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Pebrero kay ang amethyst, usa ka lila nga klase sa quartz.

q: How do fungi digest their food differently from how humans do?
options: They release enzymes to dissolve food outside their bodies, then soak up the nutrients
They swallow chunks of dead matter and digest it inside a stomach
They absorb sunlight and turn it into food through a chemical process
They filter tiny food particles from water flowing past their surface
explanation: Fungi release chemicals called enzymes that dissolve dead matter outside their bodies, then soak up the digested food.
fact_tl: Hindi nguya ang fungi tulad natin — naglalabas sila ng mga kemikal na tinatawag na enzymes na tumutunaw sa patay na bagay sa labas ng kanilang katawan. Pagkatapos ay sinisipsip nila ang natunaw na pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang fungi dili mausap sama kanato — mopagawas sila og mga kemikal nga gitawag og enzymes nga motunaw sa patay nga butang sa gawas sa ilang lawas. Unya suyopon nila ang natunaw nga pagkaon.

q: What does one watt of power equal?
options: One joule of energy per second
One kilogram of force per meter
One calorie of heat per minute
One volt multiplied by one ohm
explanation: One watt equals one joule of energy per second (1 W = 1 joule/second).
fact_tl: Ang isang watt ay katumbas ng isang joule ng enerhiya bawat segundo (1 W = 1 joule/segundo).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka watt katumbas sa usa ka joule nga enerhiya kada segundo (1 W = 1 joule/segundo).

q: Why is it important to cool cooked food quickly and put it in the fridge?
options: Lukewarm food left out grows microbes fast, and cooling it slows spoiling
Hot food put directly in the fridge will cook other food stored inside
Room temperature makes food taste better before it is chilled
Leaving food out kills germs through the drying effect of air
explanation: Cooked food left lukewarm grows microbes quickly, so cooling it fast and storing it in the fridge preserves it and prevents spoiling.
fact_tl: Ang lutong pagkain na iiwang mainit-init nang matagal sa labas ay mabilis dumami ang microbes. Mas matatagal ito kung palalamigin agad at itatago sa ref. Ito rin ay isang paraan ng pag-iingat para hindi mapanis.
fact_bis: Ang lutong pagkaon nga ibilin nga init-init og dugay sa gawas paspas modaghan og microbes. Mas molungtad kini kung palamigon dayon ug itipig sa ref. Kini usab usa ka paagi sa pagpreserba aron dili madaut.

q: Are the stars in a constellation actually close to each other in space?
options: No, they are at very different distances and only appear to form a shape from Earth
Yes, they orbit each other and stay grouped together permanently
No, they drift apart slowly but were once a tight cluster
Yes, they formed at the same time and remain at the same distance from Earth
explanation: Stars in a constellation only appear close together; they are really at very different distances in space and just happen to form a shape when seen from Earth.
fact_tl: Ang mga bituin sa isang konstelasyon ay tila magkakalapit, ngunit talagang nasa magkakaibang layo sila sa kalawakan — nagkataon lang na bumubuo sila ng hugis kapag tinitingnan mula sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon sa usa ka konstelasyon morag magkaduol, apan tinuod nga lain-lain ang ilang gilay-on sa kawanangan — natural lang nga naghimo silag porma kon tan-awon gikan sa Earth.

q: Why is hail very rare in the Philippines even though clouds can form ice high up?
options: The warm air below melts the ice before it reaches the ground
The Philippines does not get thunderstorms strong enough to form hail
Ocean breezes push ice storms away before they reach land
The humidity in the air prevents water droplets from freezing
explanation: Even when water freezes high inside tall clouds, it melts before reaching the ground because of the warm air below, making hail very rare in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Bihirang-bihira ang ulan ng yelo (hail) sa Pilipinas dahil kahit nagyeyelo ang tubig sa loob ng matataas na ulap, natutunaw na ito bago dumampi sa lupa gawa ng init sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Talagsa ra kaayo ang ulan sa yelo (hail) sa Pilipinas tungod kay bisan mo-yelo ang tubig sa sulod sa habog nga panganod, matunaw kini sa dili pa moabot sa yuta tungod sa init sa ubos.

q: Why is Baguio City called the 'Summer Capital of the Philippines'?
options: Because of its cool climate high in the mountains of Benguet
Because it holds the largest summer festivals in the country
Because it was the first city built during the American colonial summer season
Because its beaches are the coolest and calmest in the Philippines
explanation: Baguio is called the Summer Capital because of its cool mountain climate in Benguet, with an average temperature lower than Manila's.
fact_tl: Ang Baguio ay tinatawag na 'Summer Capital ng Pilipinas' dahil sa malamig na klima nito sa taas ng mga bundok ng Benguet, ang average na temperatura nito ay mas mababa kaysa sa Manila.
fact_bis: Ang Baguio gitawag nga 'Summer Capital sa Pilipinas' tungod sa bugnaw nga klima niini sa taas sa mga bukid sa Benguet; ang iyang abereyds nga temperatura mas ubos kaysa sa Manila.

q: Why do many Philippine schools set aside a specific time for group handwashing before meals?
options: To reduce infections and keep children from getting sick and missing class
To teach students the correct soap-and-water mixing technique
To follow a government rule that requires two handwashes per school day
To save water by washing all hands at one organized time
explanation: The goal of group handwashing before meals is to reduce the number of children who get sick from infections that clean hands can prevent, so fewer students miss class.
fact_tl: Sa maraming paaralan sa Pilipinas, may nakatakdang oras para sa sabay-sabay na paghuhugas ng kamay bago kumain. Layunin nito na mabawasan ang mga batang nagkakasakit at nagliliban sa klase dahil sa mga impeksyon na maiiwasan sa malinis na kamay.
fact_bis: Sa daghang eskwelahan sa Pilipinas, adunay gitakda nga oras alang sa dungan nga paghugas sa kamot sa dili pa mokaon. Tumong niini nga makunhuran ang mga bata nga magsakit ug dili makaeskwela tungod sa mga impeksyon nga mapugngan sa limpyo nga kamot.

q: What are the millions of tiny air sacs inside the lungs called, where oxygen passes into the blood?
options: Alveoli
Bronchioles
Capillaries
Cilia
explanation: Inside the lungs are millions of tiny air sacs called alveoli where oxygen passes into the blood.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng baga ay may milyon-milyong maliliit na supot ng hangin na tinatawag na alveoli kung saan pumapasok ang oksiheno sa dugo.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa baga adunay minilyon nga gagmay nga mga puyo sa hangin nga gitawag og alveoli diin ang oksiheno mosulod sa dugo.

q: About how many people lived in Quezon City according to the 2020 census?
options: About 2.96 million
About 1.5 million
About 4.2 million
About 800 thousand
explanation: Quezon City has about 2.96 million people based on the 2020 census, making it one of the most populous cities in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Lungsod ng Quezon ay may halos 2.96 milyong tao base sa senso noong 2020.
fact_bis: Ang Quezon City adunay mga 2.96 ka milyon nga tawo base sa senso sa 2020.

q: What kind of plant is bamboo, and what makes it record-breaking?
options: A type of grass, and the fastest growing plant in the world
A type of fern, and the tallest plant in the world
A type of tree, and the strongest plant material ever tested
A type of vine, and the widest-spreading plant in the world
explanation: Bamboo is a type of grass, not a tree, and is the fastest growing plant in the world — it can grow several inches in a single day.
fact_tl: Ang kawayan ay isang uri ng damo (hindi puno) na siyang pinaka-mabilis na lumalaking halaman sa mundo—maaari itong lumaki ng ilang pulgada sa isang araw; ginagamit ito sa konstruksyon at iba pang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang kawayan usa ka klase sa damo, dili kahoy, ug mao ang pinaka-paspas nga motubo nga tanum sa kalibutan—mahimong motubo og pipila ka pulgada sa usa ka adlaw; kini kaylap nga gigamit sa konstruksyon ug crafts sa Pilipinas.

q: Why does the Philippines face a risk of tsunamis?
options: Because it sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire where many earthquakes happen
Because it is surrounded by very deep ocean trenches that trap large waves
Because volcanic eruptions on the islands push water outward in all directions
Because tropical typhoons sometimes compress the sea surface and create giant waves
explanation: The Philippines sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, so it has many earthquakes and can be hit by tsunamis triggered by those earthquakes.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay nasa Pacific Ring of Fire kaya madalas itong may lindol at maaaring tamaan ng tsunami.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas anaa sa Pacific Ring of Fire mao nga kanunay kini'g linog ug mahimong maigo sa tsunami.

q: What do you call each individual banana on a bunch?
options: A finger
A hand
A cluster
A spur
explanation: Each individual banana is called a finger; a row of bananas is a hand; and the whole cluster is called a bunch.
fact_tl: Ang isang buong kumpol ng saging ay tinatawag na bunch; ang bawat grupong magkasamang saging sa isang hanay ay tinatawag na hand; at ang bawat indibidwal na saging ay tinatawag na finger.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka bug-os nga kumpol sa saging gitawag og bunch; ang matag grupo sa usa ka hanay gitawag og hand; ug ang matag indibidwal nga saging gitawag og finger.

q: About how many days is a pig pregnant before giving birth?
options: 114 days
90 days
150 days
60 days
explanation: A pig is pregnant for about 114 days, often remembered as three months, three weeks, and three days.
fact_tl: Ang baboy ay nagbubuntis nang halos 114 araw, o tatlong buwan, tatlong linggo, at tatlong araw.
fact_bis: Ang baboy mabdos ug mga 114 ka adlaw, o tulo ka bulan, tulo ka semana, ug tulo ka adlaw.

q: About how long is the small intestine, and how does it fit inside the body?
options: About six meters long, and coiled up to fit inside the belly
About two meters long, and folded once flat inside the abdomen
About ten meters long, and stacked in separate chambers
About one meter long, stretched tightly between the stomach and large intestine
explanation: The small intestine is very long — about six meters — and coiled up to fit inside the belly.
fact_tl: Ang maliit na bituka ay napakahaba, mga anim na metro, at nakapulupot para magkasya sa loob ng tiyan.
fact_bis: Ang gamay nga tinai taas kaayo, mga unom ka metro, ug pinurot-purot aron mohaum sulod sa tiyan.

q: Which organs can be damaged over time by uncontrolled high blood sugar?
options: The eyes, kidneys, nerves, and heart
The lungs, liver, spleen, and stomach
The skin, bones, muscles, and hair follicles
The brain, pancreas, appendix, and thyroid
explanation: If not controlled, high blood sugar can damage the eyes, kidneys, nerves, and heart over time.
fact_tl: Kung hindi nakokontrol, ang mataas na asukal sa dugo ay maaaring makasira sa mata, bato, ugat, at puso sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Kung dili makontrol, ang taas nga asukal sa dugo makadaot sa mata, kidney, ugat, ug kasingkasing sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: What is surprising about the holes that tamilok (shipworms) make in wood?
options: The entry hole on the outside is tiny, but inside the wood can be almost hollow from the tunnels
The holes glow at night because the shipworms are bioluminescent
The holes are always perfectly round because the shipworm rotates as it drills
The outside of the wood hardens around the hole, hiding the damage completely
explanation: The hole on the outside of the wood is tiny, but inside the wood can be almost hollow from all the tamilok tunnels, so the damage is much worse than it appears.
fact_tl: Maliit lang ang butas sa labas ng kahoy, pero sa loob ay maaaring guang na guang na ito dahil sa daming lungga ng tamilok.
fact_bis: Gamay ra ang lungag sa gawas sa kahoy, apan sa sulod mahimo na kining halos guang tungod sa daghang tunel sa tamilok.

q: How is a wheel and axle different from a pulley?
options: In a wheel and axle the wheel and axle spin together on the same center, while a pulley uses a rope through a groove to change the direction of a pull
In a wheel and axle only the wheel turns, while in a pulley both the wheel and axle spin together
A wheel and axle only works horizontally, while a pulley only works vertically
A pulley multiplies force more than a wheel and axle can
explanation: A wheel and axle has the wheel and axle joined and spinning together, while a pulley uses a rope running through a groove to change the direction of a pull.
fact_tl: Magkapareho na bilog ang wheel and axle at ang pulley, pero magkaiba. Sa wheel and axle, magkadikit at sabay umiikot ang gulong at ehe sa parehong sentro. Sa pulley, may lubid na dumadaan sa kanal ng gulong para baguhin ang direksyon ng hila.
fact_bis: Ang wheel and axle ug ang pulley parehong lingin, apan lahi. Sa wheel and axle, ang gulong ug ehe nagdikit ug nagtuyok dungan sa samang tunga. Sa pulley, naay pisi nga moagi sa kanal sa gulong aron usbon ang direksyon sa bira.

q: How is a monsoon similar to a daily sea breeze?
options: Both involve wind switching direction between land and sea, but a monsoon does it by season while a sea breeze does it every day
Both are caused only by the temperature of ocean water near the coast
Both produce rain only during the daytime hours when the sun heats the land
Both flow in one constant direction and never reverse
explanation: A sea breeze switches direction daily between sea and land, while a monsoon works the same way but is much larger and switches by season instead of by day.
fact_tl: Ang sea breeze (simoy ng dagat) ay parang munting monsoon na nangyayari araw-araw: araw umiihip mula dagat, gabi mula lupa. Ang monsoon ay katulad nito ngunit napakalaki at nagbabago tuwing season, hindi araw-araw.
fact_bis: Ang sea breeze sama sa gamay nga monsoon nga mahitabo matag adlaw: sa adlaw mohuyop gikan sa dagat, sa gabii gikan sa yuta. Ang monsoon parehas niini apan dako kaayo ug mag-usab matag panahon, dili matag adlaw.

q: What kind of light can bees see that humans cannot?
options: Ultraviolet light
Infrared light
X-ray radiation
Gamma radiation
explanation: Bees can see ultraviolet light, which allows them to notice patterns on flowers that are invisible to human eyes.
fact_tl: Ang mga bubuyog ay nakakakita ng ultraviolet, kaya nakikita nila ang mga marka sa bulaklak na hindi natin nakikita.
fact_bis: Ang mga putyukan makakita og ultraviolet, mao nga makita nila ang mga marka sa bulak nga dili nato makita.

q: Why is skin called the body's first barrier?
options: Because it keeps most germs from getting inside the body
Because it is the first organ to receive sunlight and warmth
Because it filters oxygen before it reaches the lungs
Because it produces chemicals that kill all bacteria on its surface
explanation: The skin is the body's first barrier because it keeps most germs from getting inside the body.
fact_tl: Ang balat ang unang harang ng katawan dahil pinipigilan nito ang karamihan ng germ na makapasok.
fact_bis: Ang panit mao ang unang babag sa lawas kay gipugngan niini ang kadaghanan sa mga kagaw nga mosulod.

q: Which planet has the biggest temperature swing between day and night?
options: Mercury
Venus
Mars
Moon
explanation: Mercury has the biggest temperature swing — very hot during the day and very cold at night — because it has almost no atmosphere to hold heat.
fact_tl: Ang Mercury ang may pinakamalaking pagbabago ng temperatura, sobrang init kung araw at sobrang lamig kung gabi.
fact_bis: Ang Mercury adunay pinakadako nga kabag-ohan sa temperatura, sobrang init kon adlaw ug sobrang bugnaw kon gabii.

q: What materials did ancient people use to make red, yellow, and black paintings on cave walls?
options: Pigments from earth (ochre) and charcoal
Crushed berries and animal blood mixed together
Colored clay mixed with tree sap and beeswax
Ground shells and plant ash mixed with water
explanation: Thousands of years ago, ancient people used pigments from earth (ochre) and charcoal to paint red, yellow, and black pictures on cave walls.
fact_tl: Libu-libong taon na ang nakalipas, gumamit ang sinaunang tao ng pigment mula sa lupa (ochre) at uling para gumuhit sa dingding ng kuweba ng kulay pula, dilaw, at itim.
fact_bis: Liboan ka tuig na ang milabay, naggamit ang karaang tawo og pigment gikan sa yuta (ochre) ug uling aron magdrowing og pula, dalag, ug itom nga hulagway sa bongbong sa langub.

q: Why does a carabao wallow in mud to cool down, unlike people?
options: Because it does not sweat much, so mud helps cool its body
Because its thick skin cannot release heat through the air
Because mud blocks the sun's rays better than shade or water
Because mud contains minerals that lower the carabao's body temperature
explanation: Unlike people, the carabao does not sweat much, so it wallows in mud to cool its body during hot weather.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng tao, ang kalabaw na mammal ay hindi gaanong pinagpapawisan, kaya lumululbog ito sa putik para palamigin ang katawan tuwing tag-init.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa tawo, ang kalabaw nga usa ka mammal dili kaayo mosingot, mao nga molublob kini sa lapok aron mobugnaw ang lawas niini panahon sa init.

q: In which region of the Philippines is the province of Agusan del Norte located?
options: Caraga region (Region XIII) in Mindanao
Davao Region (Region XI) in Mindanao
CALABARZON (Region IV-A) in Luzon
Eastern Visayas (Region VIII) in the Visayas
explanation: Agusan del Norte is a province in the Caraga region (Region XIII), which is part of Mindanao; its capital is Cabadbaran.
fact_tl: Ang Agusan del Norte ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Caraga (XIII), na bahagi ng Mindanao. Ang kabisera nito ay Cabadbaran.
fact_bis: Ang Agusan del Norte usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Caraga (XIII), nga bahin sa Mindanao. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Cabadbaran.

q: In which body of water are the famous Tubbataha Reefs located?
options: The Sulu Sea, near Palawan
The Philippine Sea, near Samar
The Visayan Sea, near Cebu
The Sibuyan Sea, near Romblon
explanation: The famous Tubbataha Reefs are found in the Sulu Sea, near Palawan, and are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
fact_tl: Ang sikat na Tubbataha Reefs ay matatagpuan sa Dagat Sulu (Sulu Sea), malapit sa Palawan.
fact_bis: Ang bantogan nga Tubbataha Reefs makit-an sa Dagat Sulu (Sulu Sea), duol sa Palawan.

q: How long does Earth take to spin once all the way around?
options: About 24 hours
About 12 hours
About 365 days
About 48 hours
explanation: Earth spins once in about 24 hours, which gives us the length of one day.
fact_tl: Umiikot ang Earth nang isang beses sa loob ng halos 24 oras, kaya iyan ang haba ng isang araw.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta motuyok kausa sulod sa mga 24 ka oras, mao kana ang gitas-on sa usa ka adlaw.

q: How do people in the Philippines travel from one island to another?
options: By boats, ships, or planes
By long bridges that connect every island
By underground tunnels built under the sea
By zip lines stretched between the nearest islands
explanation: Because the islands are separated by water, people need boats, ships, or planes to travel from one island to another.
fact_tl: Dahil hiwa-hiwalay ang mga pulo, kailangan ng mga tao ang bangka, barko, o eroplano upang makapunta sa ibang isla.
fact_bis: Tungod kay bulag-bulag ang mga isla, kinahanglan sa mga tawo ang bangka, barko, o eroplano aron makaadto sa laing isla.

q: In some parts of the Philippines, what do people do with certain barnacles?
options: Gather and cook them as seafood
Grind them into powder for use in medicine
Use their shells as decorations or jewelry
Keep them as pets in saltwater tanks
explanation: In some parts of the Philippines, certain barnacles are gathered and cooked as seafood.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas, may mga barnacle na kinakain at niluluto bilang ulam mula sa dagat.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka dapit sa Pilipinas, adunay mga barnacle nga ginakaon ug ginaluto isip pagkaon gikan sa dagat.

q: Why does the Agusan Valley flood so often during the rainy season?
options: Because it is flat and low-lying, so the river cannot carry all the rainwater and it spills onto the land
Because the river has no tributaries to share the extra water load
Because the valley is surrounded by mountains that block the water from draining to the sea
Because the soil in the valley soaks up so much water that it pushes excess back up to the surface
explanation: The Agusan Valley is flat and low-lying, so when there is too much water the river cannot carry it all and spills over onto nearby land, causing frequent flooding.
fact_tl: Ang Lambak ng Agusan ay patag at mababa, kaya kapag tag-ulan at sobra ang dami ng tubig, hindi kayang dalhin ng ilog ang lahat nang sabay-sabay at umaapaw ito sa mga kalapit na lupa—ito ang dahilan kung bakit madalas bumaha rito.
fact_bis: Ang Walog sa Agusan patag ug ubos, mao nga panahon sa ting-ulan kon sobra ang tubig, dili kaya sa suba nga dad-on ang tanan dungan ug molapaw kini sa kasikbit nga yuta—mao kini ang hinungdan nganong kanunay mobaha dinhi.

q: El Niño and La Niña affect the weather in which part of the world?
options: Only in Southeast Asia
Only in the Pacific Ocean region
The whole world, bringing drought to some countries and floods to others
Only in countries near the equator
explanation: El Niño and La Niña change weather around the whole world, bringing drought to some countries and floods to others.
fact_tl: Hindi lang Pilipinas ang naaapektuhan — ang El Niño at La Niña ay nakakaapekto sa panahon sa buong mundo, na nagdadala ng tagtuyot sa ilang bansa at baha naman sa iba.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang Pilipinas ang maapektuhan — ang El Niño ug La Niña makaapekto sa panahon sa tibuok kalibutan, nga magdala og hulaw sa ubang nasod ug baha sa uban.

q: How do invasive species harm native animals?
options: They teach native animals new skills
They eat native animals, steal their food and homes, or bring diseases
They help native animals find new sources of food
They make native animals grow stronger and adapt faster
explanation: Invasive species harm native animals by eating them, taking their food and homes, or bringing diseases, which can cause some native species to disappear.
fact_tl: Sinasaktan ng invasive species ang mga katutubong hayop sa pamamagitan ng pagkain sa kanila, pag-agaw ng kanilang pagkain at tirahan, o pagdadala ng sakit. Dahil dito, maaaring maglaho ang ilang katutubong species.
fact_bis: Ang invasive species makadaot sa lumad nga mga hayop pinaagi sa pagkaon nila, pag-ilog sa ilang pagkaon ug puy-anan, o pagdala og sakit. Tungod niini, mahimong mawala ang pipila ka lumad nga species.

q: Why does sweating help cool your body on a hot day?
options: Sweat makes your skin feel wet, which blocks the sun's rays
Sweat evaporates and removes heat from the skin
Sweat releases cold air that was stored inside the body
Sweat makes your blood flow faster, sending heat to your feet
explanation: When sweat evaporates from the skin, it takes heat away with it, which is the body's natural way of fighting heat.
fact_tl: Kapag pawisan tayo, ang singaw ng pawis ay kumukuha ng init mula sa ating balat at nagpapalamig ng ating katawan; ito ang natural na paraan ng katawan na lumaban sa init.
fact_bis: Sa dihang magpawis kita, ang singaw sa pawis nagkuha sa init gikan sa atong balat ug nagpabugnaw sa atong lawas; mao kini ang natural nga paagi sa lawas sa pagsukol sa init.

q: What does the true flower of a bougainvillea plant look like?
options: Large, bright pink, and flat like a plate
Small, white, and trumpet-shaped, with three growing together
Wide, purple, and round with thick petals
Tiny, red, and star-shaped growing alone on each stem
explanation: The true flower of bougainvillea is small, white, and trumpet-shaped, usually growing in groups of three surrounded by colorful bracts.
fact_tl: Ang totoong bulaklak ng bougainvillea ay maliit, puti, at hugis-trumpeta. Karaniwang tatlo ang magkakasamang tumutubo, na napapaligiran ng makukulay na bracts. Madalas hindi ito napapansin dahil mas kapansin-pansin ang makukulay na dahon!
fact_bis: Ang tinood nga bulak sa bougainvillea gamay, puti, ug porma'g trumpeta. Kasagaran tulo ang magkuyog og tubo, gilibutan sa kolorado nga bracts. Sagad dili kini mamatikdan tungod kay mas makadani ang kolorado nga mga dahon!

q: What causes the itch and pain when you touch a stinging plant?
options: The tiny hairs of the plant scratch the skin deeply
A chemical left in the skin makes it red or swollen
An allergic reaction to the plant's pollen
The plant's sap dries out and tightens the skin
explanation: The itch and pain from a stinging plant come from a chemical left in the skin, which causes redness and swelling.
fact_tl: Ang kati at sakit mula sa nakakapasong halaman ay dahil sa kemikal na naiwan sa balat, kaya ito namumula o namamaga.
fact_bis: Ang katol ug sakit gikan sa makapaso nga tanom tungod sa kemikal nga nabilin sa panit, maong mamula o manghubag.

q: What is the chemical formula for sodium hydroxide (caustic soda)?
options: NaCl
NaOH
Na2O
NaHCO3
explanation: The chemical formula of sodium hydroxide (lye or caustic soda) is NaOH.
fact_tl: Ang chemical formula ng sodium hydroxide (lye o caustic soda) ay NaOH.
fact_bis: Ang chemical formula sa sodium hydroxide (lye o caustic soda) kay NaOH.

q: What happens when you turn off a switch in an electric circuit?
options: The switch slows down the electricity so only a little flows
The switch breaks the path so no electricity can flow through the wire
The switch stores the electricity until the switch is turned on again
The switch redirects the electricity to a different wire
explanation: When a switch is turned off, it breaks the path so electricity can no longer flow through the wire.
fact_tl: Kapag pinatay ang switch, naputol ang daanan ng kuryente kaya hindi na ito dumadaloy sa kable.
fact_bis: Kon palungon ang switch, maputol ang agianan mao nga dili na moagi ang elektrisidad sa kable.

q: Why do large rockets drop off empty sections (stages) during flight?
options: To release fuel stored in each section to ignite the next engine
To make the rocket lighter so it can reach space faster
To keep the rocket balanced by removing equal weight from each side
To allow the sections to return safely to Earth for re-use
explanation: Each empty stage is dropped off after its fuel runs out so the rocket becomes lighter and can reach space faster.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking rocket ay may mga yugto (stages) na isa-isang inihihiwalay matapos maubos ang gasolina ng bawat isa, upang gumaan ang rocket at mas mabilis itong makaabot sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong rocket adunay mga bahin nga gitawag og stages, ug ang matag bahin ihulog human maubos ang gasolina niini aron mogaan ang rocket ug mas paspas makaabot sa kawanangan.

q: What causes coral bleaching?
options: Pollution from plastic makes corals change color
Too much sunlight bleaches the coral's surface like fabric
The water gets too warm, causing coral to push out its algae and turn white
Strong waves scrape away the colored layer of coral
explanation: When water gets too warm, coral pushes out its algae and turns white — this is coral bleaching and it can kill the coral.
fact_tl: Kapag sobrang init ng tubig, pinalalabas ng coral ang algae sa loob nito at nagiging puti—tinatawag itong coral bleaching at maaaring ikamatay ng coral.
fact_bis: Kon mainit kaayo ang tubig, ipagawas sa coral ang algae sulod niini ug mahimong puti—gitawag kini og coral bleaching ug makapatay sa coral.

q: Which statement about camouflage in animals is TRUE?
options: Camouflage only works if an animal is green to blend in with plants
Camouflage only involves color matching the background
Camouflage includes not just color but also shape, pattern, and texture
Camouflage is only useful for animals that live in forests
explanation: Camouflage is not just about being green — it also includes shape, pattern, and texture, as seen in sand-colored fish and leaf-like insects.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang camouflage ay tungkol lang sa pagiging berde para makihalo sa halaman. Hindi lang kulay — kasama rin ang hugis, pattern, at texture. Ang ilang isda sa dagat ay kulay-buhangin, at ang ilang insekto ay parang tuyong dahon.
fact_bis: Sayop ang paghunahuna nga ang camouflage bahin lang sa pagka-berde aron makig-sagol sa tanom. Dili lang kolor — apil sab ang porma, pattern, ug texture. Ang pipila ka isda sa dagat kolor-balas, ug ang pipila ka insekto sama sa uga nga dahon.

q: How can we tell that a fault line passes through an area even without digging?
options: The rocks on the surface are darker in color near a fault
Rivers, fences, or roads suddenly bend or shift at the same spot because the fault moved the land
Plants grow taller on one side of a fault due to different soil type
The temperature of the ground is always higher directly above a fault
explanation: The slow movement of the Philippine Fault shifts the land on each side, causing rivers, fences, or roads that used to be straight to suddenly bend or shift.
fact_tl: Paano natin nalalaman na may fault doon? Minsan nakikita natin ang mga ilog, bakod, o kalsada na biglang nababaling o naliko sa parehong lugar. Ito ay dahil dahan-dahang inilipat ng paggalaw ng Philippine Fault ang lupa sa magkabilang panig, kaya hindi na tuloy-tuloy ang dating diretsong linya.
fact_bis: Unsaon nato pagkahibalo nga naay fault didto? Usahay makita nato ang mga suba, koral, o dalan nga kalit nga moliko o mobalhin sa samang lugar. Kini tungod kay ang hinay nga paglihok sa Philippine Fault nagbalhin sa yuta sa duha ka bahin, mao nga ang kanhi tul-id nga linya dili na padayon.

q: How does oxygen get from the air in your lungs into your blood?
options: Tiny pumps in the lung walls push oxygen into the blood vessels
The lungs squeeze to force oxygen directly into the blood
Oxygen moves by diffusion from the air, where it is more concentrated, into the blood
The heart creates a vacuum that pulls oxygen out of the lungs
explanation: Oxygen passes into the blood by diffusion from the air in the lungs, where oxygen is more concentrated.
fact_tl: Sa ating mga baga, ang oksiheno ay pumapasok sa dugo sa pamamagitan ng diffusion mula sa hangin na mataas ang oksiheno.
fact_bis: Sa atong baga, ang oksiheno mosulod sa dugo pinaagi sa diffusion gikan sa hangin nga daghan ug oksiheno.

q: What is a turtle's shell actually made of?
options: A thick layer of hard skin grown on the outside of the body
A shell made of the same material as a snail's shell
Part of the turtle's skeleton, with ribs and backbone joined to it
A separate structure the turtle grows into, like a house
explanation: A turtle's shell is part of its skeleton — the ribs and backbone are joined to it, so a turtle can never leave its shell.
fact_tl: Ang talukab ng pagong ay hindi bahay na isinusuot nito — bahagi ito ng kanyang kalansay, dahil nagkakabit dito ang mga tadyang at gulugod, kaya hindi kayang lumabas ng pagong sa sarili nitong talukab.
fact_bis: Ang kabhang sa bao dili balay nga gisul-ob niini — kabahin kini sa iyang kalabera, kay ang mga gusok ug bukog-likod nasumpay niini, mao nga ang bao dili gayod makagawas sa kaugalingon niining kabhang.

q: What happens to the air when vehicles and factories burn fossil fuels?
options: They release oxygen into the air, making it fresher
They release carbon dioxide into the air
They release nitrogen gas, which causes rain clouds to form
They absorb carbon dioxide, cleaning the surrounding air
explanation: When vehicles and factories burn fossil fuels, they release carbon dioxide into the air.
fact_tl: Kapag sinusunog ng mga sasakyan at pabrika ang fossil fuel, naglalabas ito ng carbon dioxide sa hangin.
fact_bis: Kon ang mga sakyanan ug pabrika magsunog ug fossil fuel, magpagawas kini ug carbon dioxide sa hangin.

q: Some female fireflies copy the flash pattern of another species. Why do they do this?
options: To warn males of the same species about predators nearby
To attract a male of a different species so she can eat him
To confuse predators and escape in the darkness
To signal other females where to lay their eggs
explanation: A female firefly copies another species' flash pattern to lure a male of that species close, and then she eats him.
fact_tl: May isang uri ng babaeng alitaptap na nanggagaya ng flash pattern ng ibang species. Pinapakita niya ang pekeng senyales para lumapit ang lalaki ng ibang uri—tapos kakainin niya ito!
fact_bis: Adunay matang sa baye nga aninipot nga manggaya sa flash pattern sa ubang species. Ipakita niya ang peke nga senyas aron moduol ang lalaki sa laing matang—dayon iyang kaonon kini!

q: If you put red cabbage juice into a lemon juice solution, what color will it turn?
options: Blue or green
Yellow or orange
Red or pink
Purple or violet
explanation: Red cabbage juice turns red or pink in an acid, and lemon juice is an acid.
fact_tl: Ang katas ng pulang repolyo ay nagiging PULA o ROSAS sa isang asido.
fact_bis: Ang duga sa pula nga repolyo mahimong PULA o ROSAS sa usa ka asido.

q: Which is the second largest island in the Philippines?
options: Palawan
Samar
Mindanao
Negros
explanation: Mindanao is the second largest island in the Philippines, covering about 97,500 square kilometers, and is known as the agricultural center.
fact_tl: Ang Mindanao ay ang pangalawang pinakamalaking isla sa Pilipinas, sumasaklaw ng halos 97,500 square kilometro; ito ay kilala sa pagiging sentro ng agrikultura ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Mindanao mao ang ikaduha nga pinakadakling isla sa Pilipinas, nagsakop og mga 97,500 square kilometro; bantog kini isip sentro sa agrikultura sa nasud.

q: Which mineral has a Mohs hardness of 9 and includes gemstones like ruby and sapphire?
options: Quartz
Topaz
Corundum
Feldspar
explanation: The mineral with Mohs hardness 9 is corundum, which includes ruby and sapphire.
fact_tl: Ang mineral na may Mohs hardness na 9 ay corundum (kabilang dito ang ruby at sapphire).
fact_bis: Ang mineral nga adunay Mohs hardness nga 9 mao ang corundum (apil niini ang ruby ug sapphire).

q: Why does the Philippines have so many unique animal species found nowhere else?
options: The warm tropical climate makes animals grow and evolve faster than in cold countries
Many animals became isolated on separate islands and evolved into new, unique species over time
The Philippines has more land area than most countries, giving animals more room to develop
The Philippine seas prevent predators from crossing between islands, protecting more species
explanation: Because the Philippines is made of thousands of islands, many animals became isolated and evolved into unique species found only there.
fact_tl: Dahil ang Pilipinas ay binubuo ng libu-libong pulo, maraming hayop ang nahiwalay sa bawat isla at nag-evolve para maging bago at natatanging uri.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang Pilipinas gilangkuban og liboan ka isla, daghang hayop ang nalain sa matag pulo ug nag-evolve aron mahimong bag-o ug talagsaong matang.

q: What is the main job of a Mars rover?
options: To carry human astronauts safely to the surface of Mars
To drive across Mars taking pictures and studying rocks to learn about the planet
To bring back samples of Mars soil directly to Earth for study
To orbit Mars and map the entire planet from above
explanation: A Mars rover is a robotic vehicle that drives across the surface of Mars, taking pictures and studying rocks so we can learn what the planet is like.
fact_tl: Ang Mars rover ay isang robotikong sasakyan na gumagalaw sa ibabaw ng Mars, kumukuha ng larawan at sumusuri ng mga bato para malaman natin ang hitsura ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang Mars rover usa ka robot nga sakyanan nga nagsuroy sa ibabaw sa Mars, nagkuha og hulagway ug nagtuon sa mga bato aron mahibaw-an nato kon unsa ang dagway sa planeta.

q: What color is the body of a milkfish (bangus)?
options: Golden yellow
Shiny silver
Dark gray
Bright orange
explanation: Milkfish have a shiny silver-colored body.
fact_tl: Ang bangus ay may makintab na kulay-pilak na katawan.
fact_bis: Ang bangus adunay masilaw nga kolor-plata nga lawas.

q: How does the Philippines use underground hot water to produce electricity?
options: The hot water is pumped into homes to heat buildings and generate electricity from cooling
The steam from underground hot water spins machines in power plants
The hot water is used to melt metal, which powers electric generators
Underground hot water is cooled and used as fuel in turbines
explanation: The Philippines uses geothermal energy — steam from underground hot water spins machines in power plants to make electricity.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng Pilipinas ang init ng tubig sa ilalim ng lupa (geothermal) para gumawa ng kuryente — ang singaw nito ay nagpapaikot ng makina sa mga power plant.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa Pilipinas ang init sa tubig sa ilalom sa yuta (geothermal) aron makahimo og kuryente — ang alisngaw niini magpalihok sa mga makina sa power plant.

q: What is a 'silent mutation' in DNA?
options: A mutation that causes an animal to lose its voice over time
A mutation where a DNA letter changes but the protein stays the same, so nothing noticeable changes
A mutation that only shows up after many generations
A mutation that makes a cell grow slower and quieter
explanation: A silent mutation is when a DNA letter changes but the resulting protein turns out the same, so nothing noticeable changes in the organism.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng mutation ay may nakikitang epekto. May tinatawag na silent mutation kung saan nagbago ang isang letra ng DNA pero pareho pa rin ang naging protina, kaya walang pagbabagong mararamdaman. Para itong nag-typo ka pero pareho pa rin ang naintindihang salita ng kausap mo.
fact_bis: Dili tanan mutation adunay makita nga epekto. Adunay gitawag nga silent mutation diin mausab ang usa ka letra sa DNA apan pareho gihapon ang nahimong protina, mao nga walay mabati nga kausaban. Murag nag-typo ka apan pareho gihapon ang masabtan nga pulong sa magbabasa.

q: Why do egrets grow long, beautiful plumes on their backs during breeding season?
options: The plumes help them fly faster and catch more fish
They use the plumes to attract a mate
The plumes help keep them warm during colder months
The plumes make them look bigger to scare off predators
explanation: During breeding season, egrets grow long, beautiful plumes to attract a mate.
fact_tl: Tuwing panahon ng pagpaparami, ang mga bakaw ay nagkakaroon ng mahahaba at magagandang balahibo sa likod. Ginagamit nila ito para maakit ang kapareha nila.
fact_bis: Panahon sa pagpanganak, ang mga bakaw motubo ug taas ug nindot nga mga balhibo sa likod. Gigamit nila kini aron makadani ug kapikas.

q: How do the petals of the Rafflesia flower feel when touched?
options: Thin, soft, and silky like rose petals
Smooth and waxy like a leaf surface
Thick, firm, and rubbery to help the giant flower hold its shape
Dry and papery like dead leaves
explanation: Rafflesia petals are thick, firm, and rubbery, which helps such a giant flower hold its shape.
fact_tl: Hindi manipis at malambot ang talulot ng Rafflesia gaya ng ibang bulaklak — makapal, matigas, at parang goma ang pakiramdam nito, kaya kaya nitong tumayo kahit napakalaki ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang petal sa Rafflesia dili nipis ug humok sama sa ubang bulak — baga, gahi, ug murag goma ang pamati niini, mao nga kaya niini motindog bisan dako kaayo ang bulak.

q: Why does the Sun look redder when there is smoke or haze in the air?
options: Smoke adds a red tint to sunlight as it passes through
More particles in the air block and scatter the blue light, leaving more red light visible
The sun itself turns red when the temperature is high near the surface
Haze bends sunlight so only the red wavelengths curve toward our eyes
explanation: Smoke and haze particles block and scatter blue light, so the Sun appears redder.
fact_tl: Kapag may usok o hamog sa hangin, mas namumula ang araw dahil mas marami ang nakakahadlang at nagkakalat sa asul na liwanag.
fact_bis: Kung adunay aso o gabon sa hangin, mas mapula ang adlaw kay mas daghan ang nagbabag ug nagkatag sa bughaw nga kahayag.

q: Which fish is considered the national fish of the Philippines?
options: Tilapia
Maya-maya (red snapper)
Milkfish (bangus)
Tuna
explanation: The milkfish (bangus) is considered the national fish of the Philippines because it is so important to Filipino food and livelihood.
fact_tl: Ang bangus ay itinuturing na pambansang isda ng Pilipinas dahil napakahalaga nito sa pagkain at hanapbuhay ng mga Pilipino.
fact_bis: Ang bangus giila nga nasudnong isda sa Pilipinas tungod kay importante kaayo kini sa pagkaon ug panginabuhi sa mga Pilipino.

q: Why do citrus trees grow well in the Philippines?
options: The Philippines has rocky soil that citrus roots prefer
The Philippines gets a lot of rain, which citrus trees need more than sunshine
Citrus trees like a warm, sunny climate, which the Philippines has
The Philippines has cold winters that help citrus trees produce sweet fruit
explanation: Citrus trees prefer a warm, sunny climate, which is why they grow well in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Mahilig sa mainit at maaraw na klima ang mga citrus, kaya mabuti silang tumutubo sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ganahan ang mga citrus sa mainit ug maadlaw nga klima, mao nga maayo silang motubo sa Pilipinas.

q: Which of the following groups of Philippine animals are ALL vertebrates (animals with a backbone)?
options: Milkfish, maya bird, carabao, and frog
Earthworm, butterfly, crab, and milkfish
Ant, snail, frog, and carabao
Jellyfish, squid, maya bird, and dog
explanation: Milkfish, the maya bird, dogs, the carabao, and frogs are all vertebrates — animals that have a backbone.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa ating paligid ang vertebrate, gaya ng bangus, maya, aso, kalabaw, at palaka — lahat sila ay may gulugod.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sa atong palibot mga vertebrate, sama sa bangus, maya nga langgam, iro, kabaw, ug baki — silang tanan adunay gulugod.

q: What is the PNR, and when did its predecessor first start operating?
options: The Philippine National Railway, which began as the Manila Railroad in 1892
The Philippine Northern Route, a highway system started in 1902
The Philippine Network Railway, which was built by the Americans in 1945
The Philippine National Route, a public bus system established in 1880
explanation: The Philippine National Railways (PNR) is the country's national railway company, which began as the Manila Railroad in 1892.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine National Railways (PNR) ang pambansang kompanya ng tren sa Pilipinas, na nagsimula bilang Manila Railroad noong 1892.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine National Railways (PNR) mao ang nasudnong kompanya sa tren sa Pilipinas, nga nagsugod isip Manila Railroad niadtong 1892.

q: Besides wood, what else will termites eat?
options: Plastic containers because of the chemical smell
Paper and books because they also contain cellulose
Cotton cloth because it is made from plant fibers with sugar
Metal wires because termites need minerals for their shells
explanation: Termites also eat paper and books because, like wood, they contain cellulose.
fact_tl: Bukod sa kahoy, kinakain din ng anay ang papel at libro dahil mayroon din itong selulosa.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kahoy, ang anay mokaon usab ug papel ug libro tungod kay aduna usab kini selulosa.

q: What does it mean to say that iron is a 'catalyst' in certain chemical reactions?
options: Iron provides the energy needed to start and complete the reaction
Iron is broken down and used up as the reaction proceeds
Iron speeds up the reaction without being used up itself
Iron slows the reaction so it does not produce too much heat
explanation: A catalyst like iron speeds up reactions without being used up — it is still there when the reaction finishes.
fact_tl: Maraming transition metals ang katalista (catalyst) — nagpapabilis sila ng reaksyon nang hindi nauubos. Halimbawa, ginagamit ang iron para gumawa ng pataba (fertilizer) at platinum sa mga kotse para linisin ang usok.
fact_bis: Daghang transition metals ang catalyst, nagpadali sila sa reaksyon nga dili maubos. Pananglitan, ang iron makatabang paghimo og abono ug ang platinum gigamit sa sakyanan aron limpyohan ang aso.

q: At what temperature does water boil on the Celsius scale?
explanation: On the Celsius scale, water boils at 100°C.
fact_tl: Ang temperatura ay madalas sukatin sa degrees Celsius (°C); 100°C ang kumukulong tubig.
fact_bis: Ang temperatura kasagarang sukdon sa degrees Celsius (°C); ang tubig mobukal sa 100°C.

q: What does the bluestreak cleaner wrasse do for larger fish on a coral reef?
options: It guides large fish to areas with more food by swimming ahead of them
It eats parasites and dead skin from large fish that visit its cleaning station
It warns large fish of danger by changing its color pattern
It lays eggs inside the mouths of large fish for protection
explanation: The bluestreak cleaner wrasse waits at cleaning stations and eats parasites and dead skin from large fish that come to be cleaned.
fact_tl: Ang bluestreak cleaner wrasse ay isang maliit na isda na naghihintay sa mga itinalagang 'cleaning station' sa reef — kumakain ito ng parasito at patay na balat mula sa mga malaking isda na punta doon para malinis.
fact_bis: Ang bluestreak cleaner wrasse usa ka gagmay nga isda nga naghulat sa mga gihulagway nga 'cleaning station' sa reef — mokaon kini og mga parasito ug patay nga panit gikan sa dagkong isda nga moadto aron malimpyohan.

q: What did scientists like Louis Pasteur discover about what causes many diseases?
options: Diseases are caused by breathing cold night air near swamps
Many diseases are caused by tiny living microbes, not by bad air
Most diseases are passed from parents to children through blood
Diseases come from eating food that has lost its vitamins
explanation: Louis Pasteur and others discovered that many diseases are caused by tiny living microbes, not by bad air as people once believed.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ng mga siyentipiko tulad ni Louis Pasteur na ang maraming sakit ay dulot ng napakaliliit na mikrobyo, hindi ng masamang hangin.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan sa mga siyentista sama ni Louis Pasteur nga daghang sakit gipahinabo sa gagmay kaayong mikrobyo, dili sa baho nga hangin.

q: How was smallpox completely wiped out from the world?
options: Scientists found a cure medicine that killed the smallpox virus inside patients
A worldwide vaccination campaign led the WHO to declare smallpox eradicated in 1980
Smallpox disappeared naturally when warm weather killed the virus globally
Governments quarantined all sick people for 50 years until the disease faded away
explanation: Thanks to a worldwide vaccination campaign, the WHO declared in 1980 that smallpox had been completely wiped out.
fact_tl: Salamat sa pandaigdigang kampanya ng pagbabakuna, idineklara ng WHO noong 1980 na tuluyan nang nawala sa mundo ang bulutong (smallpox).
fact_bis: Tungod sa kalibotanong kampanya sa pagbakuna, gideklara sa WHO niadtong 1980 nga hingpit nang nawala sa kalibotan ang bulutong (smallpox).

q: Which of the following are ways germs can enter the human body?
options: Through your fingerprints and the bottoms of your feet
Through your nose, mouth, eyes, or an open cut
Through sweat glands when you exercise outdoors
Through your hair follicles and the skin on your back
explanation: Germs get into the body through the nose, mouth, eyes, or an open cut.
fact_tl: Ang mga germ ay nakakapasok sa katawan sa pamamagitan ng ilong, bibig, mata, o bukas na sugat.
fact_bis: Ang mga kagaw makasulod sa lawas pinaagi sa ilong, baba, mata, o abli nga samad.

q: What can happen to the gums of a long-time smoker?
options: The gums turn bright red from increased blood flow due to nicotine
The gums shrink and disappear over many years of smoking
The gums can darken to a brownish color due to years of smoking
The gums grow thicker and harder to protect the teeth from smoke
explanation: The gums of a long-time smoker can darken to a brownish color — called smoker's melanosis — caused by years of smoking.
fact_tl: Bukod sa ngipin, ang gilagid din ng matagal nang naninigarilyo ay puwedeng mangitim o magkulay-tsokolate. Tinatawag itong 'smoker's melanosis' at sanhi rin ng tagal ng paninigarilyo.
fact_bis: Gawas sa ngipon, ang gilagid usab sa dugay nang nanigarilyo mahimong mongitngit o mahimong kolor-tsokolate. Gitawag kini og 'smoker's melanosis' ug tungod usab sa katas-on sa panigarilyo.

q: Why does Earth's inner core stay solid even though it is extremely hot?
options: The inner core has no iron, so it cannot melt at any temperature
The inner core is solid because it has cooled down over billions of years
The enormous pressure from the layers above squeezes the metal so it cannot melt
The inner core stays solid because it is surrounded by cold ocean water deep underground
explanation: Even though the inner core is extremely hot, the enormous pressure from the layers above squeezes the metal so it stays solid and cannot melt.
fact_tl: Kahit sobrang init ng inner core, nananatili itong buo at matigas dahil sa napakalakas na presyon mula sa mga patong sa ibabaw nito. Pinipiga ng presyon ang metal kaya hindi ito natutunaw.
fact_bis: Bisan init kaayo ang inner core, nagpabilin kining buo ug gahi tungod sa kusog kaayo nga presyur gikan sa mga patong sa ibabaw niini. Gipuga sa presyur ang metal mao nga dili kini matunaw.

q: What is the job of the green leaves (husk) wrapped around a corn cob?
options: They store extra sugar that the corn kernels use to grow
They absorb sunlight to help the corn kernels develop color
They protect the kernels inside the corn cob
They produce the pollen needed for the corn to make seeds
explanation: The husk leaves wrapped around the corn cob protect the kernels inside.
fact_tl: Ang busal ng mais ay nababalot ng mga berdeng dahong tinatawag na husk o upak, na nagpoprotekta sa mga butil sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang busal sa mais giputos sa lunhaw nga mga dahon nga gitawag og upak o panit, nga nagapanalipod sa mga lugas sa sulod.

q: What unit is used to measure capacitance, and who is it named after?
options: The watt (W), named after James Watt
The ohm (Ω), named after Georg Ohm
The farad (F), named after Michael Faraday
The henry (H), named after Joseph Henry
explanation: Capacitance is measured in farads (F), named after Michael Faraday.
fact_tl: Ang kapasitansya (capacitance) ay sinusukat sa farad (F), na ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday.
fact_bis: Ang kapasitansya (capacitance) gisukod sa farad (F), nga ginganlan kang Michael Faraday.

q: What are the four stages an ant passes through before becoming an adult?
options: Egg, nymph, chrysalis, adult
Egg, larva, pupa, adult
Egg, caterpillar, cocoon, adult
Egg, grub, nymph, adult
explanation: An ant goes through four stages: egg, larva, pupa, then adult — a process called metamorphosis.
fact_tl: Ang langgam ay dumadaan sa apat na yugto bago maging adult: itlog, larva (uod), pupa, at saka adult—isang proseso na tinatawag na metamorphosis.
fact_bis: Ang hulmigas moagi sa upat ka yugto una mahimong hamtong: itlog, larva (ulod), pupa, ug dayon hamtong—usa ka proseso nga gitawag og metamorphosis.

q: In which direction does an object move when a force is applied to it?
options: Always toward the ground because of gravity
In the opposite direction of the push or pull
In the direction of the push or pull
In a circular path around the point where force is applied
explanation: Every force has a direction, and an object moves in the direction of the push or pull.
fact_tl: Bawat puwersa ay may direksyon; ang bagay ay gumagalaw papunta sa direksyon ng tulak o hila.
fact_bis: Ang matag puwersa adunay direksyon; ang butang molihok paingon sa direksyon sa tulod o bira.

q: How do floating plants like water hyacinth help clean polluted water?
options: They release chemicals that kill harmful bacteria in the water
Their leaves block sunlight so algae that cause pollution cannot grow
Their long roots soak up pollution and harmful substances from the water
They filter water by trapping dirt particles in their thick stems
explanation: Floating plants like water hyacinth help clean dirty water because their long roots soak up some of the pollution and harmful substances.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga tao ang ilang lumulutang na halaman tulad ng water hyacinth para linisin ang maruming tubig. Sinisipsip ng mahahabang ugat nito ang ilang dumi at lason sa tubig, kaya gumaganda nang kaunti ang kalidad ng tubig.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga tawo ang pipila ka naglutaw nga tanom sama sa water hyacinth aron limpyohan ang hugaw nga tubig. Ang ilang taas nga gamot mosuyop sa pipila ka hugaw ug makadaot nga sustansya, mao nga mahimong limpyo-limpyo gamay ang tubig.

q: What is a lens and what does it do?
options: A shiny flat surface that reflects light to form an image
A colored filter that blocks certain wavelengths of light
A clear piece of material shaped to bend the light that passes through it
A rough surface that scatters light in all directions
explanation: A lens is a clear piece of material shaped to bend the light that passes through it.
fact_tl: Ang lente ay isang malinaw na bagay na hinubog upang baluktutin ang liwanag na dumadaan dito.
fact_bis: Ang lente usa ka tin-aw nga butang nga gihulma aron likoon ang kahayag nga moagi niini.

q: Which statement best describes the electromagnetic spectrum?
options: It is made up of completely separate types of waves that do not mix with each other
All EM waves are the same kind of wave forming one continuous spectrum where named bands blend into each other
Radio waves and X-rays are totally different kinds of energy with nothing in common
The spectrum has sharp dividing lines between each type of wave, like colors in a rainbow
explanation: All EM waves are the same kind of wave and part of one continuous spectrum; names like infrared or ultraviolet are just bands that blend into each other.
fact_tl: Lahat ng EM wave ay iisang uri lamang ng alon at bahagi ng iisang tuloy-tuloy na spectrum; ang mga pangalan gaya ng infrared o ultraviolet ay mga bahagi lang na unti-unting nagsasanib, hindi magkakahiwalay na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang tanang EM wave usa lang ka klase sa balod ug bahin sa usa ka padayon nga spectrum; ang mga ngalan sama sa infrared o ultraviolet mga bahin lang nga hinay-hinayng nagsagol, dili managlahing butang.

q: How many protons does a neon atom have?
explanation: The atomic number of neon (Ne) is 10, meaning it has 10 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng neon (Ne) ay 10, kaya may 10 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa neon (Ne) kay 10, mao nga naa kini 10 ka proton.

q: What shape is a DNA molecule?
options: A straight ladder with flat rungs
A single spiral coil like a spring
A twisted ladder called a double helix
A round ball with strands coming out from the center
explanation: DNA has the shape of a twisted ladder called a double helix.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay hugis na parang pilipit na hagdan na tinatawag na 'double helix.'
fact_bis: Ang DNA porma sama sa linubid nga hagdanan nga gitawag ug 'double helix.'

q: In what kind of water does the mudskipper live in mangroves?
options: Only in fully salty ocean water far from shore
Only in fresh water from rivers and streams
In a mix of salty and fresh water found in mangroves
In warm water heated by underwater volcanic vents
explanation: The mudskipper can live in the mix of salty and fresh water found in mangrove habitats.
fact_tl: Kayang mabuhay ng mudskipper sa pinaghalong tubig-alat at tubig-tabang sa bakawan.
fact_bis: Ang mudskipper makahimo mabuhi sa sinagol nga parat ug tab-ang nga tubig sa bakhaw.

q: About how long is the total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China?
options: About 21,196 kilometers
About 5,000 kilometers
About 50,000 kilometers
About 10,000 kilometers
explanation: The total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China is about 21,196 kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang kabuuang haba ng lahat ng bahagi ng Great Wall of China ay humigit-kumulang 21,196 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang kinatibuk-ang gitas-on sa tanang bahin sa Great Wall of China mga 21,196 ka kilometro.

q: How does a pig communicate with other pigs?
options: By grunting and oinking
By chirping and whistling
By growling and howling
By hissing and squeaking
explanation: A pig grunts and oinks to communicate with other pigs.
fact_tl: Ang baboy ay umuungol para makipag-usap sa ibang baboy.
fact_bis: Ang baboy mo-ungol aron makigsulti sa ubang baboy.

q: Why does the Philippines experience monsoons?
options: Because it lies in the tropics near the equator where the Sun's heat is very strong
Because it is surrounded by very cold ocean currents
Because it has many tall mountains that block the wind
Because it is close to the North Pole where storms form
explanation: The Philippines experiences monsoons because it lies in the tropics near the equator where the Sun's heat is very strong.
fact_tl: Nararanasan ng Pilipinas ang monsoon dahil ito ay nasa tropiko malapit sa ekwador kung saan napakainit ng sinag ng araw.
fact_bis: Nasinati sa Pilipinas ang monsoon tungod kay nahimutang kini sa tropiko duol sa ekwador diin kusog kaayo ang init sa adlaw.

q: What is special about anadromous fish like salmon?
options: They are born in fresh water, live in the ocean, and return to the river of their birth to spawn
They are born in the ocean, live in fresh water, and return to the ocean to spawn
They live their whole lives in the ocean and never enter rivers
They are born in rivers and stay in rivers their entire lives
explanation: Anadromous fish like salmon are born in fresh water, live in the ocean, and return to the river of their birth to spawn and then die.
fact_tl: Ang ilang isda tulad ng salmon ay anadromous — ipinaglihi sila sa sariwang tubig, nabubuhay sa dagat, at bumabalik sa ilog ng kanilang kapanganakan para mangitlog at pagkatapos ay namamatay.
fact_bis: Ang uban nga mga isda sama sa salmon anadromous — ipinaganak sila sa tabo nga tubig, nagpuyo sa dagat, ug mobalik sa suba sa ilang pinanganak aron mag-spawn ug dayon mawala.

q: How many common blood types are there when ABO and Rh factors are combined?
options: Eight, such as A+, A-, O+, and O-
Four, such as A, B, AB, and O
Six, such as A+, A-, B+, B-, O+, and O-
Twelve, including many rare types
explanation: When ABO and Rh are combined, there are eight common blood types such as A+, A-, O+, and O-.
fact_tl: Kapag pinagsama ang ABO at Rh, may walong karaniwang uri ng dugo tulad ng A+, A-, O+, at O-.
fact_bis: Kung hiusahon ang ABO ug Rh, adunay walo ka komon nga klase sa dugo sama sa A+, A-, O+, ug O-.

q: Why can owls see well even when it is very dark at night?
options: Their eyes are very large, so they catch a lot of light
Their eyes glow in the dark and light up the area around them
They have many tiny eyes all around their head
They use their ears instead of their eyes to find objects at night
explanation: An owl's eyes are very large, so they catch a lot of light, letting the owl see even when it is very dark at night.
fact_tl: Napakalaki ng mga mata ng kuwago kaya marami itong nasasalong liwanag, at dahil dito ay nakakakita pa rin sila kahit napakadilim na sa gabi.
fact_bis: Dagko kaayo ang mata sa kuwago mao nga daghan kini ug masulod nga kahayag, busa makakita gihapon sila bisan ngitngit na kaayo sa gabii.

q: In the Philippines, which animal is the most common source of rabies in people?
options: Dogs
Bats
Cats
Monkeys
explanation: In the Philippines, dogs are the most common source of rabies in people.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga aso ang pinakakaraniwang pinagmumulan ng rabies sa mga tao.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga iro mao ang labing komon nga tinubdan sa rabies sa mga tawo.

q: In the lysogenic cycle, what does a virus do inside a host cell?
options: It hides its genetic material inside the host cell's DNA and stays dormant until triggered
It immediately destroys the host cell and releases thousands of new viruses
It turns the host cell into a virus factory that works nonstop
It wraps itself around the outside of the cell and waits for the cell to die
explanation: In the lysogenic cycle, a virus hides its genetic material inside the host cell's DNA and remains dormant until triggered to switch to the lytic cycle.
fact_tl: Sa lysogenic cycle, ang ilang virus ay nagtatago sa loob ng DNA ng host cell at nananatiling tulog — hanggang sa ma-activate sila at pumasok sa lytic cycle.
fact_bis: Sa lysogenic cycle, ang uban nga virus nagtago sa sulod sa DNA sa host cell ug nagpabilin nga tulog — hangtud ma-activate sila ug mobalhin sa lytic cycle.

q: What do warm ocean currents like the Gulf Stream do for faraway places?
options: They carry heat from the tropics, keeping the climate milder than expected
They bring cold water from the poles, making places cooler
They push storms away, making regions drier
They lower sea levels, exposing more land
explanation: Warm ocean currents like the Gulf Stream carry heat from the tropics to faraway places, keeping their climate milder than expected.
fact_tl: May mga mainit na agos-dagat tulad ng Gulf Stream na nagdadala ng init mula sa tropiko patungo sa malalayong lugar, kaya mas mainit ang klima roon.
fact_bis: Adunay init nga mga sulog sa dagat sama sa Gulf Stream nga nagdala og kainit gikan sa tropiko paingon sa layo nga mga dapit, mao nga mas init ang klima didto.

q: Why do prairie dogs build mounds of soil at the ends of their burrows?
options: The mounds help fresh air flow through the tunnels
The mounds hide the entrance from predators underground
The mounds are used as lookout towers to spot food
The mounds keep rainwater from flooding the tunnels
explanation: Prairie dogs build mounds of soil at the ends of their burrows that help fresh air flow through the tunnels.
fact_tl: May mga bunton ng lupa sa magkabilang dulo ng lungga ng prairie dog na tumutulong na umikot ang sariwang hangin sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang mga prairie dog naghimo og mga bunton sa yuta sa tumoy sa ilang lungib nga makatabang nga mosulod ang preskong hangin sa tunel.

q: What are two things that most mammals do that make them different from other animals?
options: Give birth to live young and feed them with milk
Lay eggs and feed their young with fish
Give birth to live young and feed them with insects
Lay eggs and keep them warm until they hatch
explanation: Most mammals give birth to live young and feed them with milk.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga mamalya ay nanganganak ng buhay na anak at pinapasuso ito ng gatas.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga mamalya nanganak ug buhi nga anak ug gipasuso kini ug gatas.

q: How do many migrating birds find their way even on cloudy nights when they cannot see the stars?
options: They sense Earth's magnetic field using a kind of inner compass
They follow the smell of the ocean from thousands of kilometers away
They use their very sharp eyesight to spot landmarks below
They fly in a straight line by counting their wingbeats
explanation: Many migrating birds have a kind of inner compass that senses Earth's magnetic field, so they can find their way even on cloudy nights.
fact_tl: Maraming lumilipat na ibon ang may parang panloob na kompas na nakakaramdam ng magnetikong larangan ng Mundo, kaya hindi sila naliligaw kahit gabi o maulap ang langit.
fact_bis: Daghang balhinon nga langgam adunay morag sulod nga kompas nga makabati sa magnetikong puwersa sa Kalibutan, mao nga dili sila mawala bisan gabii o dag-om ang langit.

q: Why do birds of prey sit near the top of the food chain?
options: They hunt other animals but few animals hunt them
They are the largest animals in any ecosystem
They eat only plants and are never hunted
They can fly faster than any predator that might chase them
explanation: Birds of prey sit near the top of the food chain because they hunt other animals but few animals hunt them.
fact_tl: Ang mga lawin ay nasa itaas ng kadena ng pagkain dahil sila ang humuhuli ng ibang hayop ngunit kakaunti lamang ang humuhuli sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga mananakmal anaa sa taas sa kadena sa pagkaon kay sila ang manukop og laing mananap apan diyutay ra ang manukop kanila.

q: What can happen when miners dig up an ore that holds more than one metal?
options: Several metals are obtained at the same time, like lead together with zinc or silver
Only the most valuable metal is taken; the rest is thrown away
The metals melt together and become impossible to separate
Only one metal can exist inside a single rock
explanation: Sometimes one ore holds more than one metal mixed together, and when such ore is mined, several metals are obtained at the same time.
fact_tl: Minsan ang isang ore ay may higit sa isang metal na magkahalo, gaya ng lead na may kasamang zinc o pilak. Kaya kapag minahin ang ganitong ore, maraming metal ang nakukuha nang sabay-sabay.
