fact_bis: Sagad gihunahuna nga pareho ang reflex ug instinct, apan dili. Ang reflex usa ka paspas ug yano nga lihok sa kaunoran; ang instinct mas komplikado nga batasan sama sa paghimo og salag sa langgam. Mas yano ug mas paspas ang reflex.

q: Why is steel rebar placed inside concrete when building structures in the Philippines?
options: Steel prevents water from seeping into the concrete over time
Concrete is strong against pulling but steel resists pressing, so together they balance
Concrete is strong against pressing but cracks when pulled; steel is strong against pulling, so together they make sturdy structures
Steel makes concrete dry faster during construction
explanation: Concrete resists pressing but cracks when pulled, while steel resists pulling, so combining them creates sturdy earthquake-resistant structures.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang steel bars o 'rebar' ay inilalagay sa loob ng konkreto kapag nagtatayo ng bahay, gusali, at tulay. Malakas ang konkreto kapag dinidiin pero madaling mabasag kapag binabatak. Ang steel naman ay malakas sa pagbatak, kaya pinagsama sila para gumawa ng matibay na gusaling kaya nang tumindig kahit may lindol.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang steel bars o 'rebar' gibutang sa sulod sa konkreto kung magtukod ug balay, building, ug taytayan. Lig-on ang konkreto kung iduot apan dali mabuak kung biraon. Ang steel, lig-on sa pagbira, mao nga gisagol sila aron makahimo ug lig-on nga building nga makatindog bisan adunay linog.

q: Why does the mouth turn deep red when someone chews betel nut?
options: The betel nut itself is red and releases a natural dye when chewed
A chemical reaction between the betel nut, leaf, and lime causes the red color
The saliva mixes with blood from the gums to create the red stain
Red food coloring is added to the lime paste used in betel chewing
explanation: The deep red color results from a chemical reaction when the betel nut, leaf, and lime mix together inside the mouth — no red dye is added.
fact_tl: Ang malalim na pulang kulay ay lumalabas kapag nagsama-sama ang betel nut, dahon, at apog sa loob ng bibig. Ito ay resulta ng isang reaksyon, hindi dahil may pulang tina.
fact_bis: Ang lalom nga pula nga kolor mogawas kon maghiusa ang betel nut, dahon, ug apog sa sulod sa baba. Resulta kini sa usa ka reaksyon, dili tungod sa pula nga tina.

q: Which Filipino scientist discovered the soil that led to the antibiotic erythromycin?
options: Dr. Fe del Mundo from Manila
Dr. Abelardo Aguilar from Iloilo
Dr. Eduardo Quisumbing from Leyte
Dr. Josefa Marcos from Cebu
explanation: Dr. Abelardo Aguilar, a Filipino doctor from Iloilo, found the soil that yielded the antibiotic erythromycin.
fact_tl: Si Dr. Abelardo Aguilar, isang Pilipinong doktor mula Iloilo, ang nakatuklas ng lupa na pinanggalingan ng antibiotic na erythromycin.
fact_bis: Si Dr. Abelardo Aguilar, usa ka Pilipinong doktor gikan sa Iloilo, mao ang nakakaplag sa yuta nga gigikanan sa antibiotic nga erythromycin.

q: Which type of muscle tissue is found ONLY in the heart?
options: Skeletal muscle
Smooth muscle
Voluntary muscle
Cardiac muscle
explanation: Cardiac muscle is found only in the heart; the three types of muscle tissue are skeletal, smooth, and cardiac.
fact_tl: Mayroong tatlong uri ng tissue ng kalamnan: ang skeletal muscle na ginagalaw natin nang boluntaryo, ang smooth muscle sa mga organo tulad ng tiyan, at ang cardiac muscle na nag-iisang uri sa puso.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka klase sa tissue sa kalamnan: ang skeletal muscle nga gipalihok nato boluntaryo, ang smooth muscle sa mga organo sama sa tiyan, ug ang cardiac muscle nga anaa lamang sa puso.

q: What body part helps a horse run fast?
options: Its long flexible tail that balances it
The hard hooves on its feet
Its large nostrils that take in more air
The thick mane that reduces wind resistance
explanation: A horse can run fast using the hard hooves on its feet.
fact_tl: Mabilis tumakbo ang kabayo gamit ang matitigas nitong kuko sa paa.
fact_bis: Ang kabayo kusog modagan pinaagi sa gahi nga kuko sa iyang mga tiil.

q: How do rodents keep their front teeth sharp without any outside help?
options: Their saliva contains acid that sharpens teeth over time
The enamel is harder on the front than the back, so gnawing itself keeps the teeth sharp like a chisel
They rub their teeth against hard bones every day to file them down
New sharp teeth grow every few months to replace worn-out ones
explanation: The enamel is harder on the front of the tooth than the back, so gnawing keeps rodent teeth sharp like a chisel.
fact_tl: Mas matigas ang enamel sa harap ng ngipin kaysa sa likod, kaya kapag ngumangata ito ay tumatalas na parang pait.
fact_bis: Mas gahi ang enamel sa atubangan sa ngipon kaysa likod, mao nga ang pagkitkit naghimo niini nga hait sama sa pait.

q: Who is recognized as the national hero of the Philippines?
options: General Emilio Aguinaldo
Andres Bonifacio
Dr. Jose Rizal
Apolinario Mabini
explanation: Dr. Jose Rizal is recognized as the national hero of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Si Dr. Jose Rizal ang kinikilalang pambansang bayani ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Si Dr. Jose Rizal ang giila nga nasodnong bayani sa Pilipinas.

q: Why are most leaves broad, flat, and thin?
options: A wide flat shape stores more water inside the leaf tissue
A bigger flat surface catches more sunlight for photosynthesis, and being thin lets light reach chlorophyll cells easily
A flat shape reduces wind resistance so the leaf does not fall off
Broad flat leaves release more oxygen through more pores on their surface
explanation: Most leaves are broad, flat, and thin so a bigger surface catches more sunlight for photosynthesis and light can easily reach the cells holding chlorophyll.
fact_tl: Lapad at patag ang karamihan ng dahon para sa isang dahilan: mas malaking surface ang sumasalo sa liwanag ng araw para sa photosynthesis. Nakaharap din ang mga ito sa araw at manipis para madaling makapasok ang liwanag sa mga selula na may chlorophyll.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga dahon lapad ug patag tungod sa usa ka rason: mas dako nga surface ang nagsalo og kahayag sa adlaw para sa photosynthesis. Nag-atubang usab kini sa adlaw ug nipis aron sayon nga makasulod ang kahayag sa mga selula nga adunay chlorophyll.

q: Who discovered the radioactive elements polonium and radium in 1898?
options: Albert Einstein and Niels Bohr
Ernest Rutherford and Frederick Soddy
Marie and Pierre Curie
Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch
explanation: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered two radioactive elements, polonium and radium, in 1898.
fact_tl: Sina Marie at Pierre Curie ang nakatuklas ng dalawang radyaktibong elemento, ang polonium at radium, noong 1898.
fact_bis: Si Marie ug Pierre Curie ang nakadiskobre sa duha ka radyaktibong elemento, ang polonium ug radium, niadtong 1898.

q: Where and when was paper first made?
options: In ancient Egypt around 3000 BC
In ancient China around the year 105 AD
In ancient Greece around 500 BC
In ancient Rome around 300 AD
explanation: Paper was made around the year 105 AD in ancient China.
fact_tl: Ang papel ay ginawa noong mga taong 105 AD sa sinaunang Tsina.
fact_bis: Ang papel gihimo mga tuig 105 AD sa karaang China.

q: How does the beach pandan stay upright against strong wind and waves at the shore?
options: Its wide spreading leaves act like an anchor in the sand
Strong stilt roots grow out of the trunk down into the sand to hold it steady
Its trunk bends with the wind without breaking so it never falls
It grows in groups so the plants hold each other up in the wind
explanation: The beach pandan has strong stilt roots that extend from the trunk into the sand, keeping it steady even in strong winds and waves.
fact_tl: Ang pandan-dagat ay may matitibay na ugat na parang tungkod na lumalabas sa puno pababa sa buhangin, kaya ito ay matatag kahit malakas ang hangin at alon sa tabing-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang pandan sa baybayon adunay lig-on nga gamot nga morag tungkod nga mogula sa punoan paingon sa balas, maong magpabilin kining lig-on bisan kusog ang hangin ug balod sa baybayon.

q: What does the sulfur gas released by volcanoes smell like?
options: Burnt wood or charcoal
Rotten eggs
Fresh sea air
Sweet flowers
explanation: Sulfur released by volcanoes smells like rotten eggs.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulkan ay naglalabas ng mga gas tulad ng singaw ng tubig at asupre, na may amoy na parang sirang itlog.
fact_bis: Ang mga bolkan magbuga ug mga gas sama sa alisngaw sa tubig ug asupre, ug ang asupre baho nga sama sa daot nga itlog.

q: What is one way a rooster looks different from a hen?
options: A rooster has brown feathers while a hen has white feathers
A rooster has a large red comb on its head
A rooster has a shorter tail than a hen
A rooster is much smaller and lighter than a hen
explanation: A rooster is a male chicken with a large red comb on its head, and it crows especially in the morning.
fact_tl: Ang tandang ay lalaking manok na tumitilaok, lalo na sa umaga, at may malaking pulang palong.
fact_bis: Ang sunoy mao ang laki nga manok nga motuktugaok, ilabi na sa buntag, ug adunay dako nga pula nga palong.

q: Taro, sweet potato, cassava, and ube all store starch underground. What is different about taro compared to sweet potato?
options: Taro stores starch in its leaves while sweet potato stores it in its stem
Taro is a corm (a type of stem) while sweet potato is a root
Taro is always sweeter than sweet potato when cooked
Taro produces fruit above ground while sweet potato does not
explanation: Taro is a corm (a type of underground stem), while sweet potato is a root, so the underground part we eat is different in each plant.
fact_tl: Ang gabi, kamote, cassava, at ube ay magkakatulad dahil lahat sila ay nag-iimbak ng almirol sa ilalim ng lupa, pero ang gabi ay corm (tangkay), ang kamote ay ugat, at ang ube at cassava ay iba pang uri ng imbakan — magkakaiba ang bahaging kinakain.
fact_bis: Ang gabi, kamote, cassava, ug ube managsama kay silang tanan magtipig og almidon sa ilawom sa yuta, apan ang gabi corm (punoan), ang kamote gamot, ug ang ube ug cassava lahi pa nga matang sa tipiganan — busa lahi ang bahin nga kan-on sa matag usa.

q: What two things does the enzyme rennet do when making cheese?
options: It kills bacteria in the milk and adds flavor to the final product
It makes the soured milk clot into solid curds and watery whey, which are then separated
It pasteurizes the milk and turns it into butter before curd forms
It adds salt to the milk and hardens the curds into a wheel of cheese
explanation: The enzyme rennet makes soured milk clot into solid curds and watery whey, which are separated to make cheese.
fact_tl: Sa paggawa ng keso, pinapaasim muna ng bakterya ang gatas, pagkatapos ay isang enzyme (rennet) ang nagpapamuo nito sa matigas na curds at malabnaw na whey na pinaghihiwalay.
fact_bis: Sa paghimo og keso, pasagdan una sa bakterya nga moaslom ang gatas, dayon usa ka enzyme (rennet) ang mopamuo niini ngadto sa gahi nga curds ug labnaw nga whey nga gibulag.

q: How does the Philippine flying lemur (colugo) move from tree to tree?
options: It flaps feathered wings to fly like a bird
It leaps very far using its powerful hind legs
It glides through the air using a skin flap stretched between its legs
It climbs quickly down one tree and up the next
explanation: The Philippine flying lemur does not truly fly but glides using a skin flap stretched between its legs.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine flying lemur o kagwang ay hindi talaga lumilipad kundi lumulutang sa hangin gamit ang balat na nakaunat sa pagitan ng mga paa nito.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine flying lemur o kagwang dili gyud molupad kondili maglutaw sa hangin pinaagi sa panit nga gibukhad tali sa iyang mga tiil.

q: Why is it important to keep food covered when flies are around?
options: Flies fan the food and make it dry out faster
Flies carry germs on their feet from filth and can leave bacteria on uncovered food
Flies lay eggs only inside open food containers
Flies make food taste bitter by landing on it
explanation: Flies land on filth and carry germs on their feet, so they can leave bacteria on uncovered food.
fact_tl: Ang mga langaw ay dumadapo sa dumi at basura, kaya nagdadala sila ng germs sa kanilang mga paa. Kapag tumapat sila sa bukas na pagkain, maaari silang mag-iwan ng bacteria, kaya dapat takpan ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga langaw motugpa sa hugaw ug basura, busa magdala sila og germs sa ilang mga tiil. Kung motugpa sila sa bukas nga pagkaon, makabilin sila og bacteria, busa angay tabonan ang pagkaon.

q: How does a sinkhole form in the ground?
options: An underground volcano pushes upward then collapses back down
Water dissolves the rock underneath, and the land on top suddenly collapses into the empty space
An earthquake cracks the surface and dirt falls into the crack
Underground animals dig tunnels until the ground above them caves in
explanation: A sinkhole forms when water dissolves the rock underneath and the land on top suddenly collapses downward into that empty space.
fact_tl: Ang sinkhole ay isang biglaang lungga sa lupa na nabubuo kapag ang bato sa ilalim ay matunaw na ng tubig at ang lupang nasa ibabaw ay biglang gumuho pababa.
fact_bis: Ang sinkhole usa ka kalit nga lungag sa yuta nga maporma kon ang bato sa ilawom natunaw na sa tubig ug ang yuta sa ibabaw kalit nga maguba paubos.

q: What do lichens do to a tree they grow on?
options: They slowly drain nutrients from the tree like a parasite
They harm the tree by blocking sunlight from reaching its bark
They only use the tree as a place to grow and do not harm it
They release acid that eats into the tree's bark over time
explanation: Lichens on tree bark do not harm the tree; they only use the tree as a surface to grow on.
fact_tl: Ang lichen na nasa balat ng puno ay hindi nananakit dito; ginagamit lang nito ang puno bilang lugar na tutubuan.
fact_bis: Ang lichen sa panit sa kahoy dili makadaot niini; gigamit lang nila ang kahoy isip dapit nga tubuan.

q: How do fallen mangrove leaves help larger fish in a mangrove forest?
options: Fish eat the fallen leaves directly as a source of food
The leaves rot and release nutrients that feed tiny animals, which then become food for larger fish
Fallen leaves block sunlight so the water stays cool enough for fish to thrive
The leaves sink and form a soft floor where fish lay their eggs safely
explanation: In a mangrove forest, fallen leaves rot and release nutrients that feed tiny animals, which in turn become food for larger fish in a connected nutrient cycle.
fact_tl: Sa kabakawanan, ang mga nalalaglag na dahon ng bakawan ay nabubulok at nagiging sustansyang pinagkukunan ng pagkain ng maliliit na hayop, na sinusunod naman ng mas malalaking isda.
fact_bis: Sa kabakhawan, ang nangahulog nga dahon sa bakhaw madunot ug mahimong sustansya nga pagkaon sa gagmay nga mananap, nga sundan usab sa mas dagko nga isda sa nasumpay nga siklo sa sustansya.

q: Which vitamin found in malunggay is good for healthy eyes?
options: Vitamin C
Vitamin B12
Vitamin A
Vitamin D
explanation: Malunggay has vitamin A, which is good for healthy eyes.
fact_tl: Ang malunggay ay may bitamina A na mabuti para sa malusog na mga mata.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay adunay bitamina A nga maayo alang sa himsog nga mga mata.

q: Which simple machine is an axe an example of?
options: A lever
A pulley
A wedge
A screw
explanation: An axe is an example of a wedge — a sharp object that splits or cuts things when pushed into them.
fact_tl: Ang palakol (axe) ay halimbawa ng wedge, isang matulis na bagay na naghahati o naghihiwa kapag itinutulak.
fact_bis: Ang atsa (axe) usa ka pananglitan sa wedge, usa ka hait nga butang nga mobahin o moputol kon iduso niini.

q: What two substances in cigarettes cause the yellowish-brown stains on teeth?
options: Carbon monoxide and ash
Nicotine and tar
Ammonia and formaldehyde
Smoke and water vapor
explanation: Nicotine and tar turn yellowish-brown when exposed to air, which is what stains the teeth of smokers.
fact_tl: Dalawang bahagi ng sigarilyo ang gumagawa ng mantsa: ang nikotina at ang alkitran. Kapag nahalo sa hangin, nagiging dilaw o kayumanggi sila, kaya namamantsahan ang ngipin.
fact_bis: Duha ka bahin sa sigarilyo ang nagahimo sa mantsa: ang nikotina ug ang tar. Kung mabutang sa hangin, mahimo silang dalag o brown, mao nga mamantsahan ang ngipon.

q: What shape are kangkong leaves?
options: Round and wide like a lily pad
Long and pointed like the tip of an arrow
Small and oval like a mango seed
Jagged and spiky like a saw blade
explanation: Kangkong leaves are long and pointed, shaped like the tip of an arrow.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng kangkong ay mahaba at matulis, tulad ng hugis ng dulo ng pana.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa kangkong taas ug talinis, sama sa porma sa tumoy sa pana.

q: What causes the makahiya plant to fold its leaves?
options: Touch, strong wind, heat, or shaking all trigger the leaves to fold
Rain and cold temperature cause the leaves to fold
The leaves fold only when it gets dark at night
The plant folds its leaves to absorb more sunlight
explanation: The makahiya folds when triggered by touch, strong wind, heat from a flame, or shaking — these signals cause water to leave the cells.
fact_tl: Ang makahiya ay tumitiklop kapag may humipo dito, ngunit maaari rin itong magtiklop kapag may malakas na hangin, init ng apoy, o nayanig. Ang paghipo ang senyas na nagpapasimula sa paglabas ng tubig sa mga selula.
fact_bis: Ang makahiya mutiklop kon adunay muhikap niini, apan mahimo usab kini mutiklop kon kusog ang hangin, init sa kalayo, o matay-og. Ang paghikap mao ang senyas nga magsugod sa paggawas sa tubig gikan sa mga selula.

q: How does concrete get its shape when used in buildings?
options: It is cut from large solid blocks into the desired shape
It is poured as a wet liquid mix into a mold and then hardens
It is mixed dry and pressed with machines into shape
It is melted at high temperature and cast like metal
explanation: Concrete is first poured as a wet mix into a mold, where it then hardens into that shape.
fact_tl: Ibinubuhos muna ang konkreto bilang malabnaw na halo sa isang hulmahan, at doon ito tumitigas ayon sa hugis nito.
fact_bis: Ang konkreto ibubo una isip malabnaw nga sagol ngadto sa hulmahan, ug didto kini mogahi sumala sa porma niini.

q: Galileo Galilei, the scientist who made an early thermoscope, was from which country?
options: Greece
France
Spain
Italy
explanation: Galileo Galilei was a scientist from Italy (Italian), and he created an early device called a thermoscope.
fact_tl: Si Galileo Galilei, na gumawa ng unang thermoscope, ay isang siyentipiko mula sa Italya (Italian).
fact_bis: Si Galileo Galilei, nga naghimo sa unang thermoscope, usa ka siyentista gikan sa Italya (Italian).

q: In which part of the Philippines has gold mining been historically important, especially in Benguet?
options: The Visayas region near Cebu
The Cordillera region in northern Luzon
The Zamboanga Peninsula in Mindanao
The Bicol region in southern Luzon
explanation: The Philippines has a long history of gold mining especially in Benguet, which is part of the Cordillera region.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may mahabang kasaysayan ng pagmimina ng ginto lalo na sa Cordillera region ng Benguet at sa Masbate; ang ginto ay nabubuo sa hydrothermal veins na malapit sa dating mga bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay dugay nga kasaysayan sa pagmina sa ginto labi na sa Cordillera region sa Benguet ug sa Masbate; ang ginto nagporma sa hydrothermal veins duol sa karaan nga mga bulkan.

q: What is one advantage a pH meter has over a color indicator?
options: A pH meter is cheaper and easier to use
A pH meter gives an exact pH number, not just a rough color reading
A pH meter works without any electricity or batteries
A pH meter shows a wider range of colors than an indicator
explanation: A pH meter uses electricity to give an exact pH number, while a color indicator gives only a rough answer through its color.
fact_tl: Ang indicator na pang-kulay ay nagbibigay lang ng tinatayang sagot sa pamamagitan ng kulay, habang ang pH meter ay gumagamit ng kuryente para magbigay ng eksaktong numerong pH. Mas mura at simple ang indicator, ngunit mas tumpak ang pH meter.
fact_bis: Ang indicator nga pangkolor maghatag lang og banabana nga tubag pinaagi sa kolor, samtang ang pH meter mogamit og kuryente aron mohatag og eksaktong numero sa pH. Mas barato ug simple ang indicator, apan mas sibo ang pH meter.

q: Why does a seatbelt protect you when a car stops suddenly in a crash?
options: It keeps your body completely still so you feel no movement at all
It inflates like a cushion to absorb the impact directly
It holds you so your momentum is reduced gradually instead of all at once
It signals the airbag to deploy before you move forward
explanation: When a car stops suddenly, your body still has momentum and wants to keep moving forward; the seatbelt holds you so your momentum is reduced gradually and you do not hit hard.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang huminto ang sasakyan sa aksidente, ang katawan mo ay may momentum at gustong magpatuloy sa pagsulong. Ang seatbelt ang humahawak sa iyo para dahan-dahang mabawasan ang momentum mo at hindi ka tumama nang malakas.
fact_bis: Kung kalit nga mohunong ang sakyanan sa aksidente, ang imong lawas adunay momentum ug gustong magpadayon sa pag-abante. Ang seatbelt mao ang nagkupot kanimo aron hinay-hinay nga makunhuran ang imong momentum ug dili ka makabangga og kusog.

q: How quickly do young rats reach the age when they can have babies of their own?
options: It takes about two years, similar to most small mammals
It takes about six months, which is fast for rodents
They can have babies of their own within just a few weeks
Young rats must wait until they are at least one year old
explanation: Young rats grow up quickly and can have babies of their own within just a few weeks.
fact_tl: Mabilis lumaki ang batang daga at sa loob lamang ng ilang linggo ay kaya na nitong manganak.
fact_bis: Paspas modako ang batan-ong ilaga ug sulod sa pipila ka semana makapanganak na sila.

q: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
options: So
Sd
Nm
Na
explanation: The chemical symbol for sodium is Na, which comes from the Latin word natrium.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng sodium (sodyum) ay Na, mula sa salitang Latin na natrium.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa sodium mao ang Na, gikan sa Latin nga pulong nga natrium.

q: How do many indigenous communities in the Philippines take care of their forests?
options: They sell timber licenses to local businesses to fund community projects
They rely entirely on the government's national park rangers
They use traditional management systems passed down through generations
They cut down old trees and replace them with faster-growing imported species
explanation: Many indigenous communities in the Philippines manage their forests through traditional management systems that protect the natural environment.
fact_tl: Pinamahalaan ng maraming katutubong komunidad sa Pilipinas ang kanilang kagubatan sa pamamagitan ng tradisyonal na sistema ng pamamahala na nagpoprotekta sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Daghang katutubo nga komunidad sa Pilipinas nagdumala sa ilang kagubatan pinaagi sa tradisyonal nga sistema sa pamamahala nga nagprotekta sa natural nga kapaligiran.

q: What do white blood cells called phagocytes do when they encounter germs?
options: They release chemicals that dissolve germs from a distance
They surround germs and trap them inside a membrane barrier
They swallow and digest germs as if eating them
They signal other organs to raise body temperature to kill germs
explanation: Phagocytes are white blood cells that swallow and digest germs as if eating them.
fact_tl: May mga puting selula na tinatawag na phagocyte na lumululon at nagtutunaw sa mga germ na parang kinakain ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Adunay puti nga mga selula nga gitawag og phagocyte nga molamoy ug motunaw sa mga kagaw nga daw gikaon kini.

q: Which mountain is the third highest in the Philippines, standing about 2,922 meters tall?
options: Mount Apo in Davao
Mount Halcon in Mindoro
Mount Mayon in Albay
Mount Pulag in Benguet
explanation: Mount Pulag in Benguet is the third highest mountain in the Philippines at about 2,922 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang pangatlong pinakamataas na bundok sa Pilipinas ay ang Mount Pulag sa Benguet, mga 2,922 metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang ikatulong pinakahataas nga bukid sa Pilipinas mao ang Mount Pulag sa Benguet, mga 2,922 ka metros ang kataas.

q: Why is Baguio's 'everlasting' flower often used to make souvenirs and decorations?
options: It glows in the dark, making it easy to see at night
It can be dried and stay pretty for a long time without wilting
It has a very strong fragrance that lasts for months
Its petals change color when dried, making each souvenir unique
explanation: The everlasting flower can be dried and stay pretty for a long time without wilting, which is why it is often made into souvenirs or decorations.
fact_tl: Ang 'everlasting' na bulaklak ng Baguio ay maaaring patuyuin at panatilihing maganda nang matagal nang hindi nalalanta. Kaya madalas itong ginagawang pasalubong, kuwintas, o panghias na pwedeng itago bilang alaala.
fact_bis: Ang 'everlasting' nga bulak sa Baguio mahimong pauga-on ug magpabiling nindot sa dugay nga panahon nga dili malaya. Mao nga kasagaran kini himuong pasalubong, kuwintas, o dekorasyon nga matipigan isip handumanan.

q: Why are rats and mice considered pests in homes?
options: They make very loud noises that disturb people at night
They eat only insects and can spread disease through bites
They damage food and household things by gnawing on them
They destroy electrical wires by scratching them with their claws
explanation: Rats and mice are pests because they damage food and household things by gnawing on them.
fact_tl: Ang daga at ilaga ay mga peste na sumisira ng pagkain at gamit sa bahay sa pamamagitan ng pagngatngat.
fact_bis: Ang ilaga ug ilagang gamay mga peste nga modaot sa pagkaon ug butang sa balay pinaagi sa pagkutkot.

q: Why do dama de noche flowers release their strong sweet scent at night?
options: They release scent at night to absorb dew for water
Their perfume keeps away insects that might damage the flowers
They open at night to attract the moths that pollinate them
Night air is cooler, which makes their scent smell stronger
explanation: Dama de noche flowers open and release a strong sweet scent at night specifically to attract the moths that pollinate them.
fact_tl: Ang dama de noche ay isang halaman na ang maliliit na puting bulaklak ay namumukadkad at naglalabas ng matapang na bango tuwing gabi upang akitin ang mga gamu-gamong nagpo-polinasyon.
fact_bis: Ang dama de noche usa ka tanom kansang gagmay nga puti nga mga bulak mamukhad ug mogawas og kusog nga humot panahon sa gabii aron makadani sa mga anunugba nga magpolinasyon niini.

q: What does it mean if a substance has a pH below 7?
options: It is neutral and will not react with anything
It is a base, and the lower the pH, the stronger the base
It is acidic, and the lower the pH, the stronger the acid
It is acidic only if the pH is below 3
explanation: Things with a pH below 7 are acidic, and the lower the pH, the stronger the acid.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagay na may pH na mas mababa sa 7 ay asido, at mas mababa ang pH, mas malakas ang asido.
fact_bis: Ang mga butang nga may pH nga ubos sa 7 mga asido, ug kon mas ubos ang pH, mas kusog ang asido.

q: What type of simple machine system do construction cranes use to lift heavy building materials to high floors?
options: A wedge system that splits materials to make them easier to carry
A compound pulley system that reduces the effort needed to hoist heavy loads
A large lever system that uses the ground as a fulcrum
A series of inclined planes that guide materials upward
explanation: Construction cranes use compound pulley systems to hoist heavy building materials to high floors.
fact_tl: Ang mga grua sa mga gusaling itinatatayo sa Pilipinas ay gumagamit ng sistema ng maraming pulley para maiangat ang mabibigat na materyales pataas.
fact_bis: Ang mga grua sa mga gusaling gitatayo sa Pilipinas naggamit sa sistema sa daghang pulley aron mapaakyat ang mabug-at nga materyales sa itaas.

q: What is the oldest single living tree in the world?
options: A giant sequoia named General Sherman in California, USA
A Great Basin bristlecone pine called 'Methuselah' in California, USA
An ancient olive tree on the island of Crete in Greece
A kauri tree called Tane Mahuta in New Zealand
explanation: The oldest single living tree is a Great Basin bristlecone pine called 'Methuselah,' located in California, USA.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamatandang iisang buhay na puno ay isang Great Basin bristlecone pine na tinatawag na "Methuselah," sa California, USA.
fact_bis: Ang pinakatigulang nga usa ka buhi nga kahoy mao ang Great Basin bristlecone pine nga gitawag ug "Methuselah," sa California, USA.

q: Who founded the Katipunan?
options: Jose Rizal
Emilio Aguinaldo
Antonio Luna
Andres Bonifacio
explanation: Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan.
fact_tl: Si Andres Bonifacio ang nagtatag ng Katipunan.
fact_bis: Si Andres Bonifacio mao ang nagtukod sa Katipunan.

q: Inside a plant stem, which tube carries water upward from the roots?
options: The phloem carries water upward from the roots
The xylem carries water upward from the roots
The stomata carry water upward through the stem
The cortex tubes carry water upward from the roots
explanation: Inside the stem, the xylem carries water upward from the roots, while the phloem carries food made in the leaves downward.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng tangkay ay may dalawang grupo ng maliliit na tubo. Ang tinatawag na xylem ang nagdadala ng tubig pataas mula sa ugat, at ang phloem naman ang nagdadala ng pagkaing gawa sa dahon pababa sa ibang bahagi ng halaman.
fact_bis: Sulod sa punoan sa tanom adunay duha ka grupo sa gagmay nga tubo. Ang xylem maoy nagdala sa tubig pataas gikan sa gamot, ug ang phloem maoy nagdala sa pagkaon gikan sa dahon ngadto sa ubang bahin sa tanom.

q: According to the first law of thermodynamics, what happens to energy?
options: Energy is slowly used up and disappears over time
New energy is created whenever fuel is burned in an engine
Energy can only be changed from one form to another; it cannot be created or destroyed
Energy is destroyed when it turns into heat through friction
explanation: Energy cannot be created or destroyed — it can only be changed from one form into another, which is the first law of thermodynamics.
fact_tl: Hindi maaaring likhain o sirain ang enerhiya — maaari lamang itong mabago mula sa isang anyo patungo sa iba, na siyang unang batas ng thermodynamics.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya dili mahimo o maguba — mahimo lang kini nga usbon gikan sa usa ka porma ngadto sa lain, nga mao ang unang balaod sa thermodynamics.

q: What is the value of absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature?
options: -100 Kelvin
-273 Kelvin
0 Kelvin
100 Kelvin
explanation: Absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature, is 0 Kelvin (0 K).
fact_tl: Ang absolute zero, ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura, ay 0 Kelvin (0 K).
fact_bis: Ang absolute zero, ang pinakaubos nga posible nga temperatura, mao ang 0 Kelvin (0 K).

q: Why do scientists say that the materials in our bodies originally came from stars?
options: Stars send out energy that plants absorb and convert into the atoms we eat
Meteorites from stars carried carbon and oxygen to Earth billions of years ago
Inside stars, fusion builds heavier elements like carbon and oxygen that spread through space
Stars capture hydrogen from space and change it into the water our bodies need
explanation: Inside stars, fusion builds heavier elements such as carbon and oxygen, so the very materials in our bodies came from stars.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pagliliwanag, ang mga bituin ay parang pabrika rin ng mga elemento. Sa loob nila, ang fusion ay gumagawa ng mas mabibigat na elemento tulad ng carbon at oxygen. Kaya may kasabihan na galing sa mga bituin ang mismong mga sangkap ng ating katawan.
fact_bis: Gawas sa paghatag og kahayag, ang mga bituon murag pabrika usab sa mga elemento. Sa sulod nila, ang fusion naghimo og mas bug-at nga mga elemento sama sa carbon ug oxygen. Mao nga adunay panultihon nga ang mismong mga sangkap sa atong lawas naggikan sa mga bituon.

q: Why are flowers pollinated by birds often red and nearly scentless?
options: Red pigment repels insects so only birds can access the nectar
Birds prefer the taste of red nectar, and scent keeps them away
Birds see colors well but have a weak sense of smell, so bright red works better than fragrance
Red flowers stay cooler in sunlight, which helps birds land on them safely
explanation: Flowers pollinated by birds are often red and have little scent because birds see colors well but have a weak sense of smell.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulaklak na pinupulot ng mga ibon ay kadalasang pula at walang gaanong bango dahil mahusay tumingin ang ibon ngunit hindi masyadong umaamoy.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulak nga gipolinate sa mga langgam kasagaran pula ug walay kaayo humot kay maayo motan-aw ang langgam apan luya ang ilang pang-amoy.

q: What are the two main forms in a jellyfish's life cycle?
options: The larva stage floating freely and the adult stage living on the seafloor
The egg stage in sand and the swimming juvenile stage
The polyp stage attached to rock and the swimming medusa stage
The spore stage in water and the bud stage on coral reefs
explanation: Jellyfish have two forms: the polyp stage attached to rock that reproduces asexually, and the swimming medusa stage that reproduces sexually.
fact_tl: Ang jellyfish ay may kakaibang life cycle na may dalawang anyo: ang polyp stage na nakadikit sa bato at nagpaparami nang asexual, at ang medusa stage na lumalangoy at nagpaparami nang sexual.
fact_bis: Ang jellyfish adunay talagsaon nga life cycle nga adunay duha ka porma: ang polyp stage nga nakadikit sa bato ug nagpanamkon nga asexual, ug ang swimming medusa stage nga nagpanamkon nga sexual.

q: What material is a cuttlebone made of, and why does it break easily?
options: It is made of cartilage like a shark's skeleton, which is flexible but weak
It is made of calcium, the same material as seashells, which makes it brittle
It is made of chitin like an insect shell, which is light but cracks under pressure
It is made of dried skin tissue that hardens when the cuttlefish ages
explanation: A cuttlebone is made of calcium, the same material as seashells, which is why it is brittle and breaks easily.
fact_tl: Kahit tinatawag itong 'cuttlebone,' hindi ito tunay na buto. Gawa ito sa kalsiyum na kapareho ng nasa kabibe at kabhang sa dagat, kaya brittle o madaling mabasag ito.
fact_bis: Bisan tawagon kini og 'cuttlebone,' dili kini tinuod nga bukog. Hinimo kini sa calcium, pareho sa materyal sa kabhang sa dagat, mao nga huyang kini ug daling mabuak.

q: What part of the ginger plant do we use as a spice?
options: The dried seeds found inside the ginger flower
The leaves that are ground into a spice powder
A thickened underground stem, not the true root
The bark peeled from the main above-ground stem
explanation: The ginger we use as a spice is not really a root but a thickened stem that grows underground, and new ginger plants can sprout from it.
fact_tl: Ang luya na ginagamit nating pampalasa ay hindi talaga ugat kundi isang tangkay na tumutubo sa ilalim ng lupa. Mula rito tumutubo ang mga bagong halaman ng luya.
fact_bis: Ang luya nga atong gamiton nga panakot dili tinuod nga gamot kondili usa ka punoan nga motubo ilalom sa yuta. Gikan niini motubo ang bag-ong mga tanom sa luya.

q: What happens to the leaves of the makahiya (sensitive plant) when you touch them?
options: They turn bright red and release a sticky juice
They quickly fold and close as if the plant were shy
They spring outward and become stiff to defend the plant
They drop off to the ground and then grow back later
explanation: The makahiya has tiny leaves that quickly fold and close when touched or shaken, as if the plant were shy.
fact_tl: Ang makahiya ay isang halamang ang maliliit na dahon ay agad nagsasara o nakatiklop kapag nahipo o nayanig, na parang ito ay nahihiya.
fact_bis: Ang makahiya o sensitive plant adunay gagmay nga dahon nga dali nga mosira o mopilo kon mahikapan o mauyog, nga morag naulaw.

q: What are very small young milkfish (bangus) called before they are moved to fishponds?
options: Fingerlings
Juveniles
Fry
Larvae
explanation: Very small young milkfish are called fry, which are raised before being moved to fishponds.
fact_tl: Ang napakaliit na batang bangus ay tinatawag na semilya o bangus fry na inaalagaan bago ilipat sa palaisdaan.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay kaayong batan-ong bangus gitawag nga fry o semilya nga gialimahan una ibalhin sa palaisdaan.

q: What causes tides, making the whole sea slowly rise and fall?
options: Strong winds blowing across the ocean surface for many hours
The rotation of the Earth spinning the water outward
The gravity of the Moon and Sun pulling on the sea
Underwater earthquakes pushing water upward and downward
explanation: Tides are the slow rise and fall of the whole sea caused by the gravity of the Moon and Sun, which is different from waves made by wind.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang tides at alon: ang alon ay gawa ng hangin sa ibabaw ng tubig, samtang ang tides ay mabagal na pagtaas-pagbaba ng buong dagat dulot ng gravity ng buwan at Araw.
fact_bis: Lahi ang tides sa balod: ang balod gibuhat sa hangin sa ibabaw sa tubig, samtang ang tides mao ang hinay nga pagsaka ug pagkanaog sa tibuok dagat tungod sa gravity sa bulan ug Adlaw.

q: What happens to a lichen when its surroundings become very dry?
options: It produces extra moisture from its cells to survive the dry period
It sheds its outer layer and rebuilds it when rain returns
It becomes dormant and then becomes active again when there is rain or dew
It moves to a shadier spot to avoid further water loss
explanation: When it is dry, a lichen becomes dormant, and it becomes active again when there is rain or dew.
fact_tl: Kapag tuyo ang panahon, ang lichen ay parang natutulog, at muling nagiging aktibo kapag may ulan o hamog.
fact_bis: Kon uga ang panahon, ang lichen morag natulog, ug mahimong aktibo pag-usab kon adunay ulan o yamog.

q: How does a convex lens make an object look bigger?
options: It spreads light outward so more light from the object reaches your eye
It is thicker in the middle and brings light together, magnifying the object
It reflects light off its surface, making the object appear larger
It absorbs surrounding light so only the object's light reaches your eye clearly
explanation: A convex lens is thicker in the middle and brings light together, which is why it can magnify how an object looks.
fact_tl: Ang convex na lens ay mas makapal sa gitna at tinitipon nito ang liwanag, kaya magagamit ito para palakihin ang tingin sa isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang convex nga lente mas baga sa tunga ug gitigom niini ang kahayag, mao nga magamit kini sa pagpadako sa panan-aw sa usa ka butang.

q: During which stage of a thunderstorm is the storm at its strongest, with heavy rain and lightning?
options: The cumulus stage, when the storm is just building up
The mature stage, when the storm is at full strength
The dissipating stage, when the storm is weakening
The anvil stage, when the storm cloud flattens at the top
explanation: The mature stage is the strongest stage of a thunderstorm, with rain and lightning, while the cumulus stage is the building phase and the dissipating stage is when it weakens.
fact_tl: Ang isang thunderstorm ay dumadaan sa tatlong yugto: cumulus stage (pagbuo), mature stage (pinakamalakas, may ulan at kidlat), at dissipating stage (paghina); ang bawat yugto ay tumatagal ng halos isang oras.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka thunderstorm moagi sa tulo ka yugto: ang cumulus stage (pagporma), mature stage (pinaka-kusog, adunay ulan ug kilat), ug dissipating stage (paghubas); ang matag yugto molungtad og mga usa ka oras.

q: What role do lymph nodes play in the human body?
options: They filter the blood and remove old red blood cells from circulation
They produce digestive enzymes that help break down food in the stomach
They are part of the immune system, the body's defense network against disease
They carry electrical signals between the brain and the muscles
explanation: Lymph nodes are part of the immune system, which is the body's defense network against disease.
fact_tl: Ang mga lymph node ay bahagi ng immune system, ang sistema ng katawan na nagtatanggol laban sa mga sakit.
fact_bis: Ang mga lymph node maoy bahin sa immune system, ang sistema sa lawas nga nanalipod batok sa mga sakit.

q: How does fluoride in toothpaste protect your teeth?
options: It whitens the enamel by removing surface stains from food and drinks
It kills all the bacteria in your mouth so no decay can start
It strengthens the tooth's enamel and helps prevent decay
It creates a wax coating that seals the enamel against acid
explanation: Fluoride in toothpaste strengthens the tooth's enamel and helps prevent decay.
fact_tl: Ang fluoride sa toothpaste ay nagpapalakas sa enamel ng ngipin at tumutulong na maiwasan ang pagkasira nito.
fact_bis: Ang fluoride sa toothpaste molig-on sa enamel sa ngipon ug motabang aron malikayan ang pagkaguba niini.

q: How hot is a lightning bolt compared to the surface of the sun?
options: Lightning is about the same temperature as the sun's surface
Lightning is cooler than the sun's surface but still very hot
Lightning is hotter than the surface of the sun
Lightning is much cooler than the sun but still hot enough to ignite fuel
explanation: Lightning is extremely hot — even hotter than the surface of the sun — which is why it can start fires.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay napakainit, mas mainit pa kaysa sa ibabaw ng araw, kaya kaya nitong magpaningas ng apoy.
fact_bis: Ang kilat init kaayo, mas init pa kaysa sa ibabaw sa adlaw, mao nga makahimo kini og kalayo.

q: What happens to most objects when they are heated?
options: They contract and become denser as the molecules pack together
They expand or get bigger because of the heat
They first expand and then shrink back to their original size
They change color as the extra heat energy is released
explanation: When something is heated, it expands or gets bigger because of the heat.
fact_tl: Kapag pinainit ang isang bagay, ito ay lumalawak o lumalaki dahil sa init.
fact_bis: Kung painiton ang usa ka butang, kini molapad o modako tungod sa kainit.

q: What makes an electromagnet different from a regular permanent magnet?
options: An electromagnet uses iron that has been permanently magnetized by a strong current
An electromagnet is made of copper coils and stays magnetic all the time
An electromagnet becomes magnetic only while electricity is flowing through its wire coil
An electromagnet works only when placed near another permanent magnet
explanation: An electromagnet is made of wire coiled around iron and becomes magnetic only while electricity is flowing through it.
fact_tl: Ang electromagnet ay isang magnet na gawa sa pinaikot na kawad sa paligid ng bakal, at ito ay nagiging magnetiko lamang habang may dumadaloy na kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang electromagnet usa ka magnet nga hinimo sa alambre nga giliyok palibot sa puthaw, ug mahimo lang kining magnetiko samtang may kuryente nga modagayday niini.

q: What instrument does PHIVOLCS use to measure earthquake strength?
options: A barometer that detects changes in air pressure during tremors
A seismograph that measures earthquake strength and locates its origin
A thermometer network that detects heat released during fault movement
A GPS array that tracks how far the ground shifts during a quake
explanation: PHIVOLCS uses seismographs to measure earthquake strength and locate the earthquake's origin so warnings can be issued faster.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS ng seismograph upang sukatin ang lakas ng lindol at tukuyin kung saan ito nanggaling upang mas mapabilis ang pagbibigay ng babala.
fact_bis: Naggamit ang PHIVOLCS og seismograph aron sukdon ang kusog sa lindol ug tukuyin kung diin kini gikan aron mas mapaspasan ang paghatag sa mga babala.

q: How do you test if leche flan is fully cooked?
options: You press the top lightly — if it springs back immediately, it is done
You shake the mold — if it does not jiggle at all, it is done
You poke it with a toothpick or knife — if it comes out clean, it is done
You check the color — if the top is deep brown, the inside is fully set
explanation: To check if leche flan is done, you poke it with a toothpick or knife — if it comes out clean and not sticky, it means the proteins have set and the custard is solid.
fact_tl: Para malaman kung luto na ang leche flan, tinutusok ito ng toothpick o kutsilyo — kung lumabas itong malinis at hindi madikit, hudyat na nagsiksik na ang protina at solid na ang custard.
fact_bis: Aron mahibal-an kon luto na ang leche flan, tusokon kini og toothpick o kutsilyo — kon mogawas nga limpyo ug dili pilit, timailhan nga ang protina nagahi na ug solid na ang custard.

q: What is lightning, in terms of electricity?
options: A steady flow of current from the sky to the ground along a conductive path
A giant static spark that jumps from a cloud to the ground or to another cloud
A beam of concentrated light energy released by charged water droplets
An electromagnetic wave produced when storm clouds rub against each other
explanation: Lightning is a giant static spark that jumps from a cloud to the ground or to another cloud.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay isang napakalaking static spark na lumulukso mula sa ulap papunta sa lupa o sa ibang ulap.
fact_bis: Ang kilat usa ka dako kaayong static spark nga molukso gikan sa panganod paingon sa yuta o sa laing panganod.

q: Why must most vaccines be kept between 2 degrees and 8 degrees Celsius at all times?
options: Cold temperatures activate the vaccine's ingredients so they work faster when injected
Vaccines must stay cold so they remain liquid and can be injected easily
Vaccines must stay within that temperature range to remain effective
Cold storage prevents the vaccine vials from breaking during transport
explanation: Most vaccines must be stored at 2-8 degrees Celsius to remain effective; the cold chain is the system that keeps vaccines at the correct temperature from manufacture to use.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan ng bakuna ay kailangang itago sa temperatura na 2-8°C upang mapanatili ang epekto nito — ang 'cold chain' ay ang sistema ng mga refrigerator at insulated bag na nagpapanatili ng tamang temperatura ng mga bakuna mula sa gawa hanggang sa gamit.
fact_bis: Ang karamihan sa bakuna kinahanglang ibutang sa temperatura nga 2-8°C aron mapreserba ang epekto niini — ang 'cold chain' mao ang sistema sa mga refrigerator ug insulated bag nga nagbanatili sa tamang temperatura sa mga bakuna gikan sa paghimo hangtud sa paggamit.

q: Why does an object look bigger when you look at it through a magnifying glass?
options: The glass blocks surrounding light, making the object stand out clearly
The curved glass reflects the object's image back to your eye from a wider angle
Light bends as it passes through the curved lens, making the object appear bigger
The glass slows down light so your eye has more time to detect details
explanation: A magnifying glass works because of refraction — light bends as it passes through the curved lens, making the object appear bigger and clearer.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang magnifying glass dahil sa refraction. Yumuyuko ang liwanag habang dumadaan sa kurbadong lente nito, kaya lumalaki at mas malinaw ang nakikita mong bagay kapag tinitingnan mo ito sa pamamagitan nito.
fact_bis: Mugana ang magnifying glass tungod sa refraction. Mubawog ang kahayag samtang muagi sa kurbado niini nga lente, maong mudako ug mas klaro ang butang nga imong tan-awon kung tan-awon nimo kini pinaagi niini.

q: Which constellation is the smallest of all 88 recognized constellations?
options: Orion
Canis Minor
Ursa Minor
Crux (the Southern Cross)
explanation: Crux, also known as the Southern Cross, is the smallest of all 88 constellations.
fact_tl: Ang Crux (Southern Cross) ang pinakamaliit sa lahat ng 88 konstelasyon.
fact_bis: Ang Crux (Southern Cross) mao ang pinakagamay sa tanang 88 ka konstelasyon.

q: About how often does Halley's Comet return close enough to Earth to be seen?
options: Every 10 years
Every 76 years
Every 25 years
Every 200 years
explanation: Halley's Comet follows a very long oval path around the Sun and returns near Earth about every 76 years.
fact_tl: Maraming kometa ay sumusunod sa napakahabang pabilog na landas sa paligid ng Araw, kaya nawawala sila ng matagal bago muling makita. Halimbawa, ang sikat na Halley's Comet ay bumabalik malapit sa Earth tuwing mga 76 na taon.
fact_bis: Daghang kometa nagasunod sa taas kaayo nga binilog nga agianan palibot sa Adlaw, mao nga mawala sila og dugay una makita pag-usab. Pananglitan, ang bantogang Halley's Comet mobalik duol sa Earth matag mga 76 ka tuig.

q: What is the special name for a group of owls?
options: A colony
A flock
A parliament
A murder
explanation: A group of owls is called a parliament.
fact_tl: Ang isang pangkat ng mga kuwago ay tinatawag na parliament.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka pundok sa mga ngiwngiw gitawag nga parliament.

q: Why can't we see most cells with just our eyes?
options: Cells are transparent, so they let all light pass through them
Most cells are too tiny to see without a microscope
Cells are hidden deep inside the body where light cannot reach
Cells move too quickly for our eyes to focus on them
explanation: Most cells are so tiny that we cannot see them with our eyes alone; we need a microscope.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mga selula ay napakaliit kaya hindi natin sila nakikita sa mata lang; kailangan natin ng mikroskopyo.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga selula gamay ra kaayo mao nga dili nato sila makita sa mata lang; kinahanglan natog mikroskopyo.

q: Why does the hornbill toss fruit into the air before swallowing it?
options: Tossing the fruit helps knock off insects hiding on the fruit's skin
Hornbills toss fruit up so they can catch it at the right angle to crush it with their beak
Hornbills have no teeth, so they toss fruit into the air and let it fall back into their mouth to swallow whole
Tossing the fruit breaks it open so the hornbill can reach the seeds inside
explanation: The hornbill tosses fruit up in the air and lets it fall back into its mouth to be swallowed whole because hornbills have no teeth.
fact_tl: Ang hornbill ay nagtatatapon ng prutas sa hangin at hinahayaan itong bagsak pabalik sa bunganga nito para malunok nang buo dahil wala itong ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang hornbill nagtapon sa prutas sa hangin ug gitugtan kini nga mahulog balik ngadto sa iyang baba aron malamoy nga buo tungod kay ang mga hornbill walay ngipin.

q: How does warmer air affect the speed of sound?
options: Warmer air slows sound down because the molecules spread apart
Sound travels at exactly the same speed no matter what the temperature is
In warmer air, faster-moving molecules pass the sound wave along more quickly, so sound is slightly faster
Warmer air makes sound louder but does not change how fast it travels
explanation: In warmer air, molecules move faster and pass the sound wave along more quickly, so on a hot day sound travels slightly faster.
fact_tl: Sa mas mainit na hangin, bahagyang mas mabilis lumalakbay ang tunog. Dahil mas mabilis gumagalaw ang mga molecule ng hangin kapag mainit, mas mabilis nilang naipapasa ang alon. Kaya sa tag-init, bahagyang mas mabilis ang tunog.
fact_bis: Sa mas init nga hangin, gamay nga mas paspas mubiyahe ang tingog. Tungod kay mas paspas mulihok ang mga molekula sa hangin kung init, mas paspas nila ipasa ang balud. Busa sa init nga adlaw, gamay nga mas paspas ang tingog.

q: Why are most electrical wires in homes made of copper instead of silver?
options: Copper carries electricity well and costs less than silver
Silver is too soft and breaks easily in walls
Copper is heavier so it stays in place better
Silver produces too much heat when electricity flows through it
explanation: Copper is chosen for wiring because it conducts electricity very well and is far more affordable than silver, even though silver is the better conductor.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mga kable ng kuryente sa bahay ay gawa sa tanso (copper) dahil napakahusay nitong magdala ng kuryente at hindi gaanong mahal kumpara sa pilak. Ang pilak (silver) ang pinakamagaling magdala ng kuryente, pero masyadong mahal para gawing kable. Kaya tanso ang madalas piliin: mabuti ang daloy ng kuryente at abot-kaya ang presyo.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga kable sa kuryente sa balay hinimo sa tumbaga (copper) kay maayo kaayo kini modala sa kuryente ug dili kaayo mahal kompara sa pilak. Ang pilak (silver) ang labing maayo modala sa kuryente, apan mahal kaayo aron gamiton nga kable. Mao nga tumbaga ang kasagaran gipili: maayo ang dagan sa kuryente ug barato ang presyo.

q: What kind of animals did Filipino scientist Angel Alcala discover as new species?
options: Frogs and lizards found only in the Philippines
Whales and dolphins found in the Pacific Ocean
Butterflies and beetles found in Palawan rainforests
Corals and sea horses found in Tubbataha Reef
explanation: Angel Alcala discovered many new species of frogs and lizards that are found only in the Philippines, showing the richness of the country's natural heritage.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Angel Alcala ang maraming bagong uri ng palaka at butiki na tanging makikita lamang sa Pilipinas, na nagpapakita ng kayamanan ng ating kalikasan.
fact_bis: Nakatuklas si Angel Alcala og daghang bag-ong klase sa palaka ug butiki nga makita lamang sa Pilipinas, nagpakita sa kahaman sa atong natural nga kalikasan.

q: According to current space exploration plans, what is the planned stepping-stone before humans travel to Mars?
options: Establishing a Moon base first
Orbiting Venus to test the spacecraft
Landing on an asteroid to gather fuel
Building a space hotel halfway between Earth and Mars
explanation: Plans by NASA, SpaceX, and other agencies call for setting up a Moon base as an intermediate stop before the longer journey to Mars in the 2030s.
fact_tl: Ang isa sa pangunahing layunin ng space exploration ngayon ay ipadala ang mga tao sa Mars sa loob ng mga 2030s; plano ng NASA, SpaceX, at ibang ahensya ang mga mission na unang magtatayo ng base sa Moon bilang intermediate stop bago ang mas matagal na paglalakbay sa Mars.
fact_bis: Usa sa panguna nga katuyoan sa space exploration karon mao ang pagpadala og mga tawo sa Mars sa mga 2030s; ang NASA, SpaceX, ug ubang mga ahensya nagplano og mga misyon nga una magpatukod og Moon base isip intermediate stop sa wala pa ang mas dugay nga biyahe ngadto sa Mars.

q: What makes the katala (Philippine cockatoo) look different from other cockatoos?
options: It has white feathers with red-orange feathers under its tail
It has a bright blue crest on top of its head
It has black wing tips and a yellow beak
It has green feathers with an orange chest
explanation: The katala is set apart from other cockatoos by its white feathers and the distinctive red-orange feathers found under its tail.
fact_tl: Ang katala ay may puting balahibo at pulang balahibo sa ilalim ng buntot, na nagpapakilala dito mula sa ibang mga cockatoo.
fact_bis: Ang katala adunay puting balahibo ug pula-kahel nga balahibo sa ilawom sa ikog, nga nagpahilahi niini gikan sa ubang mga cockatoo.

q: How do a sloth's long curved claws help it stay in a tree?
options: They work like hooks so the sloth can hang upside down without getting tired
They grip the bark so the sloth can run quickly up and down
They dig into wood so the sloth can sleep sitting upright
They lock around thin branches so the sloth can leap between trees
explanation: A sloth's long, curved claws work like hooks, letting its body simply dangle upside down from a branch without using any muscle effort.
fact_tl: Ang sloth ay may mahaba at nakakurbang kuko na parang kalawit. Salamat dito, madali itong nakabitin nang patiwarik sa sanga nang hindi napapagod, kasi parang naka-sabit lang ang katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang sloth adunay taas ug kurbado nga mga kuko nga sama sa kaw-it. Tungod niini, sayon ra kini magbitay nga balintong sa sanga nga dili kapoyon, kay morag nasab-it lang ang lawas niini.

q: Which ocean is found to the east of the Philippines?
options: The Pacific Ocean
The Indian Ocean
The Atlantic Ocean
The Arctic Ocean
explanation: The Pacific Ocean lies to the east of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Pacific Ocean ang karagatan sa silangan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Pacific Ocean mao ang kadagatan sa sidlakan sa Pilipinas.

q: Besides soap itself, what useful substance is also produced when soap is made?
options: Glycerin, which keeps skin moist and soft
Alcohol, which acts as a disinfectant
Wax, which hardens the soap bar
Ammonia, which boosts cleaning power
explanation: When soap is made through saponification, glycerin is produced as a byproduct, and it helps keep skin moist and soft.
fact_tl: Kapag gumagawa ng sabon, hindi lang sabon ang nabubuo, kundi pati glycerin din. Ang glycerin ay nakakatulong panatilihing basa at malambot ang balat, kaya minsan iniiwan ito sa sabon.
fact_bis: Kung maghimo og sabon, dili lang sabon ang mahimo kondili apil usab ang glycerin. Ang glycerin makatabang nga magpabilin nga umog ug humok ang panit, mao nga usahay ibilin kini sa sabon.

q: A metal ball and a wooden ball are exactly the same size. Which statement is true?
options: They can have different masses even though they are the same size
They must have the same mass because they are the same size
The wooden ball is heavier because wood holds more air inside
The metal ball is lighter because metal is made of smaller particles
explanation: Two objects of the same size can have different masses, as shown by a metal ball being much heavier than a wooden ball of equal size.
fact_tl: Dalawang bagay na magkasinlaki ay maaaring magkaiba ng masa, gaya ng bola ng metal at bola ng kahoy.
fact_bis: Duha ka butang nga managsama og gidak-on mahimong lahi og masa, sama sa bola nga metal ug bola nga kahoy.

q: What happens to rock when it heats up in the sun and then cools down at night, over and over again?
options: Its outer layers slowly flake off like peeling an onion
It becomes harder and harder each time it heats and cools
It absorbs water and eventually dissolves into soil
It glows briefly and releases stored heat as light
explanation: Repeated heating and cooling causes rock to expand and shrink until its outer layers flake off, a process called exfoliation weathering.
fact_tl: Kapag paulit-ulit na umiinit sa araw at lumalamig sa gabi ang bato, ito ay lumalaki at lumiliit hanggang matuklap ang mga panlabas na patong nito.
fact_bis: Kon balikbalik nga moinit sa adlaw ug mobugnaw sa gabii ang bato, kini mohabog ug mokunhod hangtod nga manuklap ang mga gawas nga patong niini.

q: What is the purpose of the keel bone in a bird's chest?
options: It is where the big flight muscles attach so the wings can flap
It stores extra fat the bird uses during long migrations
It protects the heart and lungs from being crushed when landing
It helps the bird balance when perching on a branch
explanation: The keel is a special chest bone where the large, strong flight muscles attach; these muscles flap the wings and allow the bird to fly.
fact_tl: May espesyal na buto sa dibdib ng ibon na tinatawag na 'keel'. Dito nakakabit ang malalaki at malalakas na kalamnan na nagpapakampay ng mga pakpak para makalipad ito.
fact_bis: Naay espesyal nga buto sa dughan sa langgam nga gitawag og 'keel'. Dinhi nakakabit ang dagko ug kusgan nga mga unod nga magpakapay sa mga pako aron makalupad kini.

q: In your mouth, what type of digestion does saliva do while your teeth grind food?
options: Chemical digestion, breaking food down with enzymes
Mechanical digestion, crushing food into smaller pieces
Physical digestion, warming food to body temperature
Electrical digestion, sending signals to the stomach
explanation: Saliva performs chemical digestion using enzymes while the teeth do mechanical digestion by grinding, and both work together in the mouth.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng panunaw na nagaganap sa bibig. Ang ngipin ay gumagawa ng mechanical digestion (pagdurog), samantalang ang laway ay gumagawa ng chemical digestion (paghati gamit ang enzyme). Magkasama silang gumagana.
fact_bis: Duha ka matang sa paghilis ang mahitabo sa baba. Ang ngipon maghimo og mechanical digestion (pagdugmok), samtang ang laway maghimo og chemical digestion (pagbungkag gamit ang enzyme). Mag-uban sila pagtrabaho.

q: How does a mudskipper breathe oxygen when it is out of the water?
options: Oxygen passes through its thin skin and mouth lining into its blood
It stores air inside special pouches attached to its gills
It breathes through tiny holes along the sides of its body
It absorbs oxygen through its fins when they touch wet mud
explanation: The mudskipper absorbs oxygen from the air through the thin skin and lining of its mouth directly into its blood.
fact_tl: Sumisipsip ang manipis na balat at lining ng bibig ng mudskipper ng oksiheno mula sa hangin papunta sa dugo nito.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga panit ug ang sulod sa baba sa mudskipper mosuyop ug oksiheno gikan sa hangin ngadto sa iyang dugo.

q: Why do you sweat much more when you run or play hard?
options: Your muscles make extra heat and your body releases sweat to stop you from overheating
Your body runs out of water so it pushes the extra water out through the skin
Running shakes up the water inside your body until it leaks out
Your skin gets stretched by moving fast so water escapes through the pores
explanation: Hard exercise makes muscles produce a lot more heat, so the body releases extra sweat to cool itself down and prevent overheating.
fact_tl: Kapag tumatakbo o naglalaro ka, mas maraming init ang ginagawa ng iyong mga kalamnan. Para hindi mainitan ang katawan, mas marami itong pawis na pinalalabas — kaya basang-basa ka kapag pagod sa laro.
fact_bis: Kon modagan o magdula ka, mas daghang init ang himuon sa imong mga kaunuran. Aron dili mainitan ang lawas, mas daghang singot ang ipagawas niini — mao nga basa kaayo ka human sa kapoy nga dula.

q: Why are viruses NOT included in the five kingdoms of life?
options: They are not cells and cannot reproduce on their own without a host cell
They are too small for scientists to classify into any group
They are found only inside the ocean and do not fit land categories
They belong to a secret sixth kingdom that has not been officially named
explanation: Viruses are excluded from the five kingdoms because they are not cells and cannot reproduce by themselves — they need a living host cell to make copies.
fact_tl: Hindi kasama ang virus sa limang kaharian dahil hindi ito itinuturing na ganap na buhay; hindi ito selula at hindi makakadami nang mag-isa kundi kailangan nito ng ibang nabubuhay na selula. Ang bacteria naman ay tunay na buhay at may sariling kingdom.
fact_bis: Ang virus dili apil sa lima ka gingharian kay wala kini isipa nga hingpit nga buhi; dili kini selula ug dili makapadaghan og kaugalingon nga wala ang ubang buhing selula. Ang bacteria, sa pikas bahin, tinuod nga buhi ug adunay kaugalingong kingdom.

q: Who actually completed the first trip all the way around the world?
options: Juan Sebastián Elcano, after Magellan died
Ferdinand Magellan, who led the entire voyage
Francis Drake, who sailed later on a second attempt
Vasco da Gama, who finished the route through Asia
explanation: Juan Sebastián Elcano completed the first circumnavigation of the world after Ferdinand Magellan died before the voyage was finished.
fact_tl: Si Juan Sebastián Elcano ang tumapos sa unang paglibot sa mundo matapos mamatay si Magellan.
fact_bis: Si Juan Sebastián Elcano ang nakahuman sa unang paglibot sa kalibotan human mamatay si Magellan.

q: What makes virgin coconut oil (VCO) different from regular coconut oil?
options: It is made from fresh coconut meat without high heat, so natural compounds like lauric acid are preserved
It is made from dried coconut flakes that are boiled until the oil floats to the top
It is filtered through charcoal to remove the coconut flavor before bottling
It is mixed with water and shaken until the oil and water separate by themselves
explanation: VCO is extracted from fresh coconut meat by cold pressing or fermentation without high temperatures, which keeps beneficial compounds like lauric acid intact.
fact_tl: Ang virgin coconut oil (VCO) ay ginagawa mula sa sariwang meat ng niyog sa pamamagitan ng cold pressing o fermentation—hindi ito pinainit nang mataas, kaya napapanatili ang mga natural na sangkap tulad ng lauric acid.
fact_bis: Ang virgin coconut oil (VCO) gihimo gikan sa sariwa nga meat sa niyog pinaagi sa cold pressing o fermentation—dili kini giinit sa taas nga temperatura kaya ang natural nga compound sama sa lauric acid napanatili.

q: How are bees and wasps related to each other?
options: Bees are close relatives of wasps and actually descended from ancient wasps that switched to eating flowers
Bees and wasps look alike but evolved from completely different insect groups
Wasps developed from bees after bees lost the ability to sting
Bees and wasps share a common ancestor with ants but not with each other
explanation: Bees are close relatives of wasps and descended from ancient wasps that gradually shifted from hunting to relying on flowers for food.
fact_tl: Magkamag-anak ang putakti at bubuyog — kapwa sila nasa grupo ng mga insektong may tibo, at ang mga bubuyog ay nagmula sa mga sinaunang putakti na unti-unting umasa sa bulaklak sa halip na sa pangangaso.
fact_bis: Magkadugo ang putakti ug bubuyog — silang duha sakop sa grupo sa mga insekto nga adunay tibo, ug ang bubuyog gikan sa karaang putakti nga anam-anam nga nagsalig sa bulak imbes mangayam.

q: Besides eating it fresh, how else is durian commonly used as a food in the Philippines?
options: It is made into candy, ice cream, and other sweet snacks
It is dried and ground into a spice for cooking rice
It is pressed into juice that is bottled and sold in stores
It is fermented into a sour sauce used in soups
explanation: Durian is eaten fresh but is also made into candy, ice cream, and other sweet snacks, and durian candy from Davao is a popular pasalubong.
fact_tl: Karaniwang kinakain ang durian nang sariwa pagkabukas ng balat, pero ginagawa rin itong candy, ice cream, at iba pang matatamis na meryenda. Sa Davao, sikat ang durian candy bilang pasalubong.
fact_bis: Kasagaran kaonon ang durian nga lab-as human ablihi ang panit, apan gihimo usab kini nga candy, ice cream, ug uban pang tam-is nga meryenda. Sa Davao, bantog ang durian candy isip pasalubong.

q: When you look at a star in the night sky, what are you actually seeing?
options: How the star looked in the past, because its light took many years to reach Earth
Exactly what the star looks like right now
A reflection of the star on dust floating in space
The star's shadow cast on the background of space
explanation: Stars are so far away that their light takes many years to travel to Earth, so we always see them as they appeared in the past.
fact_tl: Napakalayo ng mga bituin kaya ang kanilang liwanag ay umaabot ng maraming taon bago marating ang Earth, kaya nakikita natin sila kung paano sila noon.
fact_bis: Halayo kaayo ang mga bituon mao nga ang ilang kahayag mokuha ug daghang tuig usa makaabot sa Yuta, busa makita nato sila sama sa kaniadto.

q: What is estivation?
options: A deep rest some animals enter during very hot, dry weather to survive
A fast swim animals use to escape heat in tropical rivers
A seasonal migration animals make toward cooler mountain areas
A skin-shedding process that helps animals stay cool in summer
explanation: Estivation is like hibernation but happens during very hot, dry weather, allowing animals to survive harsh conditions by resting deeply.
fact_tl: Ang estivation ay parang hibernation pero ginagawa ito ng hayop sa sobrang init at tuyot na panahon para makaligtas.
fact_bis: Ang estivation susama sa hibernation apan buhaton kini sa mananap panahon sa hilabihang kainit ug kahulaw aron mabuhi.

q: Why are seismographs placed in quiet spots far from roads and buildings?
options: Nearby vibrations from trucks or footsteps could be mistaken for an earthquake
Electricity from buildings can damage the sensitive electronics inside
Seismographs only work underground where the soil is perfectly still
Road dust can clog the moving parts that detect shaking
explanation: Seismographs are sensitive enough that passing trucks or footsteps can cause vibrations that might be falsely recorded as earthquake signals.
fact_tl: Madalas inilalagay ang mga seismograph sa mga tahimik na lugar na malayo sa daan at gusali, dahil kahit ang dumadaang trak o yapak ng tao ay maaaring magdulot ng pagkilos na maipagkamali sa isang lindol.
fact_bis: Sagad ibutang ang mga seismograph sa hilom nga mga dapit nga layo sa dalan ug mga building, kay bisan ang naglabay nga trak o mga tunob sa tawo makahimo og paglihok nga masaypan nga linog.

q: Why is a banana considered a true botanical fruit?
options: It develops from the flower's ovary
It has seeds that you can plant in the ground
It grows on a tree and has a thick outer skin
It is sweet and soft like all other fruits
explanation: A banana is a true botanical fruit because it develops from the flower's ovary; commercial bananas are seedless because they are triploid varieties.
fact_tl: Ang saging ay isang tunay na botanical fruit dahil nagmula ito sa ovary ng bulaklak—kahit na walang makikitang buto sa mga komersyal na saging dahil sila ay triploid.
fact_bis: Ang saging usa ka tinuod nga botanical fruit tungod kay nagmugna kini gikan sa ovary sa bulaklak; ang komersyal nga saging walay buto tungod kay triploid kini.

q: In which month does the Leonid meteor shower happen every year?
options: November
August
January
April
explanation: The Leonid meteor shower occurs every November each year.
fact_tl: Ang Leonid meteor shower (ulan ng bulalakaw) ay nangyayari tuwing Nobyembre bawat taon.
fact_bis: Ang Leonid meteor shower (ulan sa bulalakaw) mahitabo matag Nobyembre kada tuig.

q: How does your body defend itself when harmful germs get inside?
options: White blood cells act like soldiers that find and kill the germs
Red blood cells surround the germs and carry them out through the skin
The liver filters germs out of the blood and destroys them with acid
Bones release a special fluid that freezes germs so they cannot move
explanation: White blood cells are the body's soldiers that find and destroy harmful germs, and a fever is often a sign that this defense is working.
fact_tl: May sariling depensa ang katawan natin laban sa germs. Ang mga white blood cells ay parang sundalo na naghahanap at pumapatay sa masamang germs. Minsan ang lagnat ay senyales na lumalaban ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang atong lawas adunay kaugalingong panalipod batok sa germs. Ang white blood cells sama sa mga sundalo nga mangita ug mopatay sa daotang germs. Usahay ang hilanat timaan nga nakig-away ang lawas.

q: What are the two main gases that make up the Sun?
options: Hydrogen and helium
Oxygen and nitrogen
Carbon dioxide and methane
Neon and argon
explanation: The Sun is a hot ball of gas made mostly of hydrogen and helium.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay binubuo ng mainit na gas, halos puro hydrogen at helium.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw gama sa init nga gas, kasagaran hydrogen ug helium.

q: How do sponges move water through their bodies?
options: Special collar cells with whip-like tails beat to push water through
They squeeze their body like a pump when a wave passes by
Tiny hairs on the outside of the sponge catch passing currents
They absorb water through their skin when the tide comes in
explanation: Sponges have special collar cells with whip-like flagella that beat continuously to pump water through the body.
fact_tl: May mga espesyal na selula ang espongha na may parang buntot na pumapaspas upang itulak ang tubig sa loob ng katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang espongha adunay espesyal nga mga selula nga may daw ikog nga mokapay-kapay aron iduso ang tubig sa lawas niini.

q: Which of the following best describes the rusting of iron?
options: A slow chemical change that releases a small amount of heat
A fast physical change that absorbs heat from the air
A slow physical change that makes iron lighter over time
A fast chemical change that produces a burst of light and heat
explanation: Rusting is a slow exothermic chemical change, meaning iron reacts with oxygen and water and slowly releases a small amount of heat.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalawang ng bakal ay isang mabagal na exothermic na pagbabago na naglalabas ng kaunting init.
fact_bis: Ang pagkalawang sa puthaw usa ka hinay nga exothermic nga kausaban nga nagpagawas ug gamay nga kainit.

q: What is the name of the Philippines' own satellite that helps monitor weather and disasters?
options: Diwata
Luntian
Bayani
Agila
explanation: The Philippines launched a satellite called Diwata to help monitor weather, the environment, and disasters in the country.
fact_tl: Naglunsad ang Pilipinas ng sariling satellite na tinatawag na Diwata upang makatulong sa pag-monitor ng panahon, kalikasan, at sakuna sa bansa.
fact_bis: Nagpagawas ang Pilipinas sa iyang kaugalingong satellite nga gitawag og Diwata aron matabangan ang pag-monitor sa panahon, kalikasan, ug mga kalamidad sa nasod.

q: How does a Komodo dragon get from one island to another?
options: It swims across the sea
It glides through the air using flaps of skin
It waits for the tide to expose a land bridge
It floats on logs carried by ocean currents
explanation: The Komodo dragon is able to swim and sometimes crosses the sea to reach other islands.
fact_tl: Ang Komodo dragon ay marunong lumangoy at minsan ay tumatawid sa dagat papunta sa ibang isla.
fact_bis: Ang Komodo dragon kahibalo molangoy ug usahay motabok sa dagat padulong sa lain nga isla.

q: What happens inside a rechargeable battery when you plug it in to charge?
options: Electricity pushes chemical energy back into the battery so it can be used again
New chemicals are poured into the battery through a tiny opening
The old chemicals inside are heated until they become active again
The battery resets its timer so it can count down from full charge again
explanation: Charging a rechargeable battery uses electricity to push chemical energy back inside it, allowing the battery to be used over and over again.
fact_tl: Ang rechargeable na baterya ay maaaring punuin muli: kapag kinakarga (charge) mo ito, ibinabalik ng kuryente ang chemical energy sa loob nito upang magamit muli, tulad sa cellphone.
fact_bis: Ang rechargeable nga baterya mahimong pun-on pag-usab: kon i-charge nimo kini, ang kuryente mobalik sa chemical energy sa sulod aron magamit balik-balik, sama sa cellphone.

q: How does soap help water clean dirty clothes?
options: It lowers water's surface tension so water can spread into cloth and reach the dirt
It makes water hotter so the heat melts the grease on the fabric
It adds tiny bubbles that physically push dirt out of the cloth fibers
It makes water heavier so it sinks into the fabric more easily
explanation: Soap lowers the surface tension of water, allowing it to spread into cloth and get between bits of dirt so they can be washed away.
fact_tl: Pinapababa ng sabon ang surface tension ng tubig kaya mas nakakapasok ito sa mga tela at pagitan ng dumi.
fact_bis: Ang sabon nagpaubos sa surface tension sa tubig aron makasulod kini sa panapton ug taliwala sa hugaw.

q: Why is the chemical symbol for iron 'Fe' and not 'Ir'?
options: The symbol comes from 'ferrum', the Latin word for iron
Scientists made a mistake early on and it was never corrected
'Ir' was already taken by a different element discovered first
Iron is called 'ferum' in the language of ancient Greece
explanation: Iron's symbol is Fe because it comes from 'ferrum', the Latin word for iron, not from the English word.
fact_tl: Ang bakal ay Fe, hindi 'Ir', dahil galing ito sa salitang Latin na 'ferrum'.
fact_bis: Ang puthaw kay Fe, dili 'Ir', kay gikan kini sa Latin nga pulong nga 'ferrum'.

q: If salt is dissolved in water, what happens when you try to remove it by pouring the water through a filter?
options: The salt passes right through the filter along with the water
The filter catches all the salt and only clean water comes out
The salt and water separate as soon as they reach the filter
The filter turns the salty water into steam leaving the salt behind
explanation: Dissolved salt particles are so tiny that they pass straight through a filter along with the water, unlike sand which gets caught by the filter.
fact_tl: Hindi mo maaalis ang natunaw na asin sa tubig sa pamamagitan ng salaan o tela. Napakaliit ng mga particle ng asin kaya dumadaan ito kasama ng tubig sa salaan. (Iba ito sa buhangin na nasasalo.)
fact_bis: Dili nimo makuha ang natunaw nga asin sa tubig pinaagi sa salaan o panapton. Gagmay kaayo ang mga particle sa asin maong moagi kini uban sa tubig sa salaan. (Lahi kini sa balas nga masakpan.)

q: What are the two main reasons the Philippine endemic deer are in danger of disappearing?
options: Deforestation and overhunting have greatly reduced their numbers
Volcanic eruptions and typhoons have destroyed their mountain homes
Disease outbreaks and competition from imported deer species
Pollution of rivers and loss of grasslands where they feed
explanation: Philippine endemic deer are threatened mainly by deforestation, which destroys their habitat, and overhunting, which directly kills them.
fact_tl: Ang mga endemikong usa ng Pilipinas ay nanganganib dahil sa pagkawala ng kagubatan at labis na pangangaso sa nakalipas na mga taon.
fact_bis: Ang mga endemikong usa sa Pilipinas nanganganib tungod sa pagkaguba sa kagubatan ug sobrang pagpangayam nga nagpamenos sa ilang gidaghanon.

q: Which desert is known as the driest place on Earth?
options: The Atacama Desert in Chile
The Sahara Desert in Africa
The Gobi Desert in Asia
The Arabian Desert in Saudi Arabia
explanation: The Atacama Desert in Chile is the driest place on Earth, with some parts that almost never receive any rain.
fact_tl: Ang Atacama Desert sa Chile ang pinakatuyong lugar sa mundo — may mga bahagi na halos hindi inuulan.
fact_bis: Ang Atacama Desert sa Chile mao ang pinakauga nga dapit sa kalibotan — adunay mga bahin nga hapit dili gyud ulanan.

q: In the traditional method of winnowing rice, what separates the light husks from the heavier grain?
options: Wind blows the husks away while the heavier grain stays in the tray
Water washes the husks off while the grain sinks to the bottom
Heat dries the husks so they crack and fall off the grain
A screen with small holes lets the grain through but catches the husks
explanation: Winnowing uses wind to blow the lighter husks away from the heavier grain, which stays behind in the tray.
fact_tl: Sa pagtatahip (winnowing), ginagamit ang hangin para ihiwalay ang magaan na ipa sa mabigat na bigas — tinatangay ng hangin ang ipa habang nananatili ang bigas sa bilao.
fact_bis: Sa pagtahop (winnowing), ang hangin gigamit aron bulagon ang gaan nga upa gikan sa bug-at nga bugas — gipalid sa hangin ang upa samtang magpabilin ang bugas sa nigo.

q: Why does the color of the sky keep changing throughout the day?
options: The angle that sunlight passes through the air keeps changing
The Sun gets hotter as the day goes on and changes its color
Clouds reflect different colors of the rainbow at different hours
