fact_bis: Ang paghimo og bag-ong papel o panapton gikan sa hilaw nga materyales naggamit og daghang tubig, apan kon na-recycle, mas gamay na lang ang tubig nga gikinahanglan — busa makatipig usab kini og tubig.

q: What do scientists call it when tiny air molecules spread light in different directions?
options: Light scattering
Light refraction
Light diffraction
Light absorption
explanation: Scientists call the spreading of light by tiny air molecules light scattering.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakalat ng liwanag sa maliliit na molekula ng hangin ay tinatawag ng mga siyentipiko na scattering.
fact_bis: Ang pagkatag sa kahayag pinaagi sa gagmay nga molekula sa hangin gitawag sa mga siyentista nga scattering.

q: Why do the edges of dried mud often curl upward?
options: The top surface dries faster than the bottom, so it shrinks more and pulls the edges up
The bottom layer absorbs groundwater, pushing the edges upward from below
Wind blows across the surface and lifts the edges as the mud becomes lighter
The clay minerals in mud naturally expand at the edges when water evaporates
explanation: The top surface dries faster than the bottom, so it shrinks more and pulls the edges upward.
fact_tl: Pansinin na ang mga gilid ng tuyong putik ay madalas na umaangat pataas na parang kurba. Nangyari ito dahil ang ibabaw ay mas mabilis matuyo kaysa sa ilalim, kaya mas mabilis itong lumiit at humila ang gilid pataas.
fact_bis: Matikdi nga ang mga kilid sa mala nga lapok kasagarang moalsa paibabaw nga morag kurba. Mahitabo kini kay ang ibabaw mas paspas mamala kaysa sa ilawom, mao nga mas paspas kini mokunhod ug mobira sa kilid paibabaw.

q: Where must humans get Vitamin C from?
options: From food, because the human body cannot make its own Vitamin C
From sunlight, just as the skin makes Vitamin D from sunlight
From the liver, which stores and releases Vitamin C as the body needs it
From the intestines, which produce Vitamin C during digestion
explanation: The human body cannot make its own Vitamin C, so it must be gotten from food.
fact_tl: Hindi kayang gawin ng katawan ng tao ang sariling Vitamin C, kaya kailangan itong makuha mula sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa tawo dili makahimo sa kaugalingong Vitamin C, busa kinahanglan kini makuha gikan sa pagkaon.

q: Where is the deepest hole ever drilled, and how deep does it go?
options: The Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia, about 12 km deep
The Mariana Trench Drilling Project in Japan, about 11 km deep
The South African Mponeng Mine in South Africa, about 12 km deep
The Iceland Deep Drilling Project in Iceland, about 10 km deep
explanation: The deepest hole ever drilled is the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia, about 12 km deep.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalalim na butas na nabarena ng tao ay ang Kola Superdeep Borehole sa Russia, mga 12 km ang lalim.
fact_bis: Ang pinakalawom nga lungag nga gibang-an sa tawo mao ang Kola Superdeep Borehole sa Russia, mga 12 km ang giladmon.

q: Why are plants called producers in a food chain?
options: Because they make their own food and are the start of almost every food chain
Because they produce oxygen that all other living things need to breathe
Because they reproduce faster than any other organism in the ecosystem
Because they break down dead matter and produce nutrients for the soil
explanation: Because plants make their own food, they are called producers and are the start of almost every food chain.
fact_tl: Dahil gumagawa sila ng sarili nilang pagkain, ang mga halaman ay tinatawag na producers at sila ang simula ng halos lahat ng food chain.
fact_bis: Tungod kay sila naghimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon, ang mga tanom gitawag nga producers ug sila ang sinugdanan sa halos tanang food chain.

q: How does floating ice help fish survive in a freezing lake?
options: Ice forms a lid on top while the water below stays liquid, so fish can survive underneath
Ice sinks to the bottom and insulates the ground, keeping deep water warmer
Fish swim under the ice sheet and use it as a shield against cold air above
Ice melts slowly and releases heat energy that warms the surrounding water
explanation: Because ice floats, it forms a lid on top of a lake while water below stays liquid — so fish and other life can survive even when it is freezing outside.
fact_tl: Dahil lumulutang ang yelo, bumubuo ito ng takip sa ibabaw ng lawa habang nananatiling likido ang tubig sa ilalim — kaya nabubuhay pa ang mga isda kahit malamig sa labas.
fact_bis: Tungod kay molutaw ang yelo, mahimo kining taklob sa ibabaw sa lanaw samtang ang tubig sa ubos magpabilin nga likido — mao nga mabuhi gihapon ang mga isda bisan bugnaw sa gawas.

q: How do bats hang upside down without getting tired?
options: Their body weight pulls on tendons that lock the claws closed, so no muscle effort is needed
Their claws grip the surface using sticky pads like those found on gecko feet
Their feet have suction cups that attach to surfaces and release when they fly away
Their strong leg muscles constantly squeeze shut to keep them from falling
explanation: A bat's weight pulls on tendons that lock its claws closed, so it does not fall even while asleep.
fact_tl: Ang paa ng paniki ay nakadisenyo para kumapit nang hindi napapagod. Ang bigat ng katawan nito ang humihila sa litid na nagsasara ng mga kuko, kaya hindi ito nahuhulog kahit natutulog.
fact_bis: Ang tiil sa kabog gidisenyo aron mokapyot nga walay kakapoy. Ang kabug-aton sa lawas niini ang mobira sa ugat (tendon) nga mosira sa mga kuko, mao nga dili kini mahulog bisan natulog.

q: Which statement about DNA and intelligence is correct?
options: Having more DNA does not make an organism smarter — some simple plants have more DNA than humans
Organisms with more DNA are always more intelligent and complex than those with less
Humans have the most DNA of any organism on Earth, which explains human intelligence
The number of DNA base pairs directly determines how smart an animal is
explanation: What matters is how genes are used, not how much DNA there is — some simple plants actually have far more DNA than humans.
fact_tl: Maling isipin na ang nilalang na may mas maraming DNA ay mas matalino o mas mataas na uri. May ilang simpleng halaman na mas marami pang DNA kaysa tao. Ang mahalaga ay kung paano ginagamit ang mga gene, hindi ang dami nito.
fact_bis: Sayop ang paghunahuna nga ang binuhat nga adunay mas daghang DNA mas maalamon o mas taas og matang. Adunay pipila ka simpleng tanom nga mas daghan pa og DNA kaysa tawo. Ang importante kay kung giunsa paggamit ang mga gene, dili ang gidaghanon niini.

q: What does the body do when it gets a wound?
options: The body repairs itself
The body needs medicine to heal any wound
The body replaces damaged tissue with scar tissue permanently
The body sends extra blood to wash out the wound but cannot repair it
explanation: The body repairs itself when there is a wound.
fact_tl: Ang katawan mismo ang nag-aayos ng sarili nito kapag may sugat.
fact_bis: Ang lawas mismo ang mo-ayo sa iyang kaugalingon kung adunay samad.

q: How do wetlands help prevent flooding?
options: They soak up extra water like big sponges, reducing the amount that floods nearby land
They block rivers with thick plants that slow down the flow of floodwater
They freeze floodwater quickly, turning it into ice before it can spread
They filter floodwater underground and release it slowly through deep springs
explanation: Like big sponges, wetlands soak up extra water and help reduce flooding.
fact_tl: Para silang malalaking espongha, sumisipsip ng sobrang tubig ang mga wetland kaya nababawasan ang pagbaha.
fact_bis: Sama sa dagkong espongha, ang mga wetland mosuyop sa sobra nga tubig busa makapakunhod kini sa pagbaha.

q: What is the purpose of a small plastic cover placed in an unused electrical outlet?
options: To stop young children from poking fingers or objects into the holes and getting hurt
To keep dust out of the outlet so it works better when something is plugged in
To save electricity by blocking the current from flowing when nothing is plugged in
To prevent water from dripping into the outlet during rainy or humid weather
explanation: Plastic outlet covers stop small children from poking fingers or objects into the holes, keeping them safe from electricity.
fact_tl: May maliliit na plastik na takip na isinasaksak sa hindi ginagamit na outlet. Pinipigilan nito ang maliliit na bata na maisuksok ang daliri o gamit sa butas, kaya ligtas sila sa kuryente.
fact_bis: Naay gagmay nga plastik nga tabon nga isaksak sa wala gamita nga outlet. Mapugngan niini ang gagmay nga bata sa pagsulod sa ilang tudlo o butang sa lungag, busa luwas sila sa koryente.

q: Which boils at a lower temperature — alcohol (ethanol) or water?
options: Alcohol (ethanol), because it boils at about 78°C while water boils at 100°C
Water, because it boils at 100°C while alcohol boils at about 120°C
They boil at the same temperature of 100°C because both are liquids
Water, because pure liquids always have lower boiling points than mixtures
explanation: Alcohol (ethanol) boils before water because its boiling point is only about 78°C, while water's is 100°C.
fact_tl: Ang alkohol (ethanol) ay kumukulo muna kaysa tubig dahil mababa lang ang boiling point nito na mga 78°C, samantalang ang tubig ay 100°C.
fact_bis: Ang alkohol (ethanol) mobukal una kaysa tubig kay ang boiling point niini mga 78°C lang, samtang ang tubig 100°C.

q: What do raw cacao seeds taste like before they are processed?
options: Very bitter — the good flavor only comes out after fermenting and roasting
Very sweet — they naturally taste like chocolate right off the tree
Tasteless — they have no flavor until sugar is added during chocolate-making
Sour — because cacao seeds contain the same acids found in citrus fruits
explanation: Even though cacao becomes sweet chocolate, the raw seeds taste very bitter — the good flavor only comes out after fermenting and roasting.
fact_tl: Kahit galing sa cacao na gagawing matamis na chocolate, ang hilaw na buto ay napakapait. Ang sarap nito ay lumalabas lang pagkatapos ng ferment at roast.
fact_bis: Bisan og ang cacao mahimong tam-is nga chocolate, ang hilaw nga liso pait kaayo. Ang lami niini mogawas lamang human sa ferment ug roast.

q: Why does food taste weaker when you have a cold and a stuffy nose?
options: Taste and smell work together, so blocking your nose also weakens the flavor you sense
A cold coats the tongue with mucus that prevents taste buds from detecting flavors
Fever caused by a cold raises body temperature, which destroys taste bud cells temporarily
Medicines you take for a cold block the taste nerves in your mouth
explanation: Taste and smell work together, so when you have a cold and a stuffy nose, food tastes weaker.
fact_tl: Ang panlasa at pang-amoy ay magkatuwang; kaya kapag may sipon at barado ang ilong, mas mahina ang nararamdaman nating lasa.
fact_bis: Ang panlasa ug ang panimaho nagtinabangay, mao nga kung sip-on ka ug barado ang ilong, mas luya ang lami nga imong mabati.

q: What keeps the planets orbiting around the Sun instead of flying off into space?
options: The Sun's very strong gravity pulls the planets and keeps them circling around it
The planets spin so fast that they create their own orbit path without any pulling force
Magnetic fields from the Sun attract the iron in the planets and hold them in place
The vacuum of space itself has no direction, so planets simply continue in circles
explanation: The Sun is so big and massive that its gravity is very strong, holding all the planets so they keep circling around it.
fact_tl: Dahil napakalaki at mabigat ng Araw, napakalakas ng grabidad nito. Ang lakas na ito ang humihila sa lahat ng planeta para manatiling umiikot sa paligid nito, kasama ang ating Mundo. Kung wala ito, lilipad ang mga planeta papalayo sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dako ug bug-at kaayo ang Adlaw, kusog kaayo ang grabidad niini. Kini nga birik maoy nagkupot sa tanang planeta, lakip ang atong Kalibutan, aron magpadayon sila sa paglibot niini. Kung wala kini, molupad ang mga planeta palayo sa kawanangan.

q: How does skin stay a strong protection even though it gets scratched every day?
options: Skin constantly makes new cells underneath that move up and replace old ones, renewing itself
Skin grows thicker in areas that get scratched most often, building up extra layers
Skin releases a liquid that fills in scratches and hardens into a protective coating
Dead skin cells pile up on the surface and act as a shield against further scratching
explanation: Skin keeps making new cells underneath that move up toward the surface, so it renews and repairs itself every day.
fact_tl: Patuloy na gumagawa ang balat ng mga bagong selula sa ilalim na umaakyat papunta sa ibabaw. Dahil dito, nababago at naaayos ang balat kahit araw-araw itong nagagasgas, kaya nananatili itong matibay na proteksyon.
fact_bis: Ang panit padayon nga maghimo ug bag-ong mga selula sa ilalom nga mosaka padulong sa ibabaw. Tungod niini, mabag-o ug maayo ang panit bisan adlaw-adlaw kining magasgas, mao nga magpabilin kining lig-on nga panalipod.

q: How many classes of lever are there, based on the positions of the fulcrum, load, and effort?
options: Three classes: first-class, second-class, and third-class
Two classes: simple and compound
Four classes: push, pull, lift, and balance
Five classes, one for each type of everyday tool
explanation: There are three classes of lever — first-class, second-class, and third-class — depending on the positions of the fulcrum, load, and effort.
fact_tl: May tatlong uri (class) ng lever, depende sa posisyon ng fulcrum, load, at lakas: first-class, second-class, at third-class.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka klase sa lever, depende sa posisyon sa fulcrum, load, ug kusog: first-class, second-class, ug third-class.

q: Roughly how many different species of ladybugs exist around the world?
options: More than five thousand
About one hundred
Around five hundred
Fewer than fifty
explanation: There are more than five thousand kinds of ladybugs found in different parts of the world.
fact_tl: Mahigit limang libong uri ng ladybug ang matatagpuan sa iba't ibang bahagi ng mundo.
fact_bis: Kapin sa lima ka libo ka matang sa ladybug ang makit-an sa nagkalain-laing bahin sa kalibutan.

q: What happens to the total mass of an object when you crush or tear it into pieces?
options: The total mass stays exactly the same — no mass is lost
The mass decreases because some tiny pieces fly off and are lost
The mass increases because crushing adds energy to the material
The mass decreases because tearing breaks the bonds that hold mass together
explanation: When we crush or tear an object, the total weight of all the pieces stays the same — no mass is lost.
fact_tl: Kapag dinurog o pinunit natin ang isang bagay, pareho pa rin ang kabuuang timbang ng lahat ng piraso — walang masang nawawala.
fact_bis: Kung dugmokon o gision nato ang usa ka butang, pareho gihapon ang kinatibuk-ang gibug-aton sa tanang piraso — walay masa nga mawala.

q: When your body is low on water, what does a hormone signal your kidneys to do?
options: Make less urine and save water, which is why urine becomes darker when you are dehydrated
Make more urine to flush out waste products that build up when you are dehydrated
Draw water from the blood and store it in the muscles for future use
Release stored water from the liver so the blood does not become too thick
explanation: When your body is low on water, a hormone tells your kidneys not to make much urine and to save water — that is why urine is darker when you are dehydrated.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang sa tubig ang katawan mo (halimbawa sa init o pag-uhaw), may hormone na nagsasabi sa bato na huwag masyadong mag-ihi at itipid ang tubig. Kaya naninilaw at konti ang ihi mo kapag dehydrated—trabaho ito ng endocrine system.
fact_bis: Kon kulang sa tubig ang imong lawas (pananglitan kon init o uhaw ka), adunay hormone nga magsulti sa imong kidney nga dili maghimo og daghang ihi ug magtipig og tubig. Mao nga mas itom ug gamay ang imong ihi kon dehydrated—trabaho kini sa endocrine system.

q: What is Olympus Mons, and where is it found?
options: The largest volcano in the solar system, located on Mars
The deepest crater in the solar system, located on the Moon
The tallest mountain made of ice, located on Jupiter's moon Europa
The largest dormant volcano on Earth, located in Hawaii
explanation: Mars is home to Olympus Mons, the largest volcano in the whole solar system.
fact_tl: Nasa Mars ang Olympus Mons, ang pinakamalaking bulkan sa buong solar system.
fact_bis: Anaa sa Mars ang Olympus Mons, ang pinakadako nga bulkan sa tibuok solar system.

q: What is the pH of pure water, and what does that tell us about it?
options: pH 7 — pure water is neutral, meaning it is neither acidic nor basic
pH 0 — pure water is strongly acidic because hydrogen atoms are in the formula
pH 14 — pure water is strongly basic because it can dissolve many substances
pH 5 — pure water is slightly acidic due to dissolved carbon dioxide
explanation: Pure water has a pH of 7, which means it is neutral — neither acidic nor basic.
fact_tl: Ang dalisay na tubig ay may pH na 7, na ibig sabihin neutral ito.
fact_bis: Ang lunsay nga tubig adunay pH nga 7, nga nagpasabot nga neutral kini.

q: When is it important to drink water during physical activity like sports or PE?
options: Before, during, and after playing, to avoid getting tired or dizzy too soon
Only after playing, because drinking during exercise can cause stomach cramps
Only before playing, because your body stores water to use throughout the activity
Drinking during exercise is not needed if the weather is cool and you do not feel thirsty
explanation: When you play or exercise your body works faster and gets hotter, so it helps to drink water before, during, and after to avoid getting tired or dizzy.
fact_tl: Kapag naglalaro ka o nag-eehersisyo, mas mabilis at mas mainit ang iyong katawan kaya kailangan mo ng dagdag na tubig. Mabuting uminom ng tubig bago, habang, at pagkatapos maglaro lalo na sa PE o sports. Ito ay tumutulong para hindi ka mapagod o mahilo agad.
fact_bis: Kung magdula ka o mag-ehersisyo, mas init ug mas paspas molihok ang imong lawas mao nga nanginahanglan ka og dugang tubig. Maayong moinom og tubig sa wala pa, samtang, ug human magdula ilabina sa PE o sports. Kini motabang aron dili ka kapuyon o malipong dayon.

q: Where did the carbon now found in your body originally come from?
options: From the air and from plants that you ate
From the soil that nutrients in your food were absorbed from
From the water you drank, which contains dissolved carbon particles
From the oxygen you breathe, which is converted into carbon inside your cells
explanation: The carbon in your body was once part of the air and of plants before you ate them.
fact_tl: Ang karbon sa iyong katawan ay dating bahagi ng hangin at mga halaman bago ka ito kainin.
fact_bis: Ang karbon sa imong lawas kaniadto bahin sa hangin ug sa mga tanom una pa nimo kini kan-a.

q: Why do Filipino farmers consider rats to be pests?
options: Rats damage rice in the fields, destroying the crops that farmers depend on
Rats dig holes in the soil that cause irrigation canals to leak and flood fields
Rats eat the fertilizer that farmers spread on the soil, making it less effective
Rats carry diseases that spread to the rice plants and make them grow more slowly
explanation: In the Philippines, rats damage rice in the fields, so farmers see them as pests.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, sinisira ng daga ang mga palay sa bukid kaya itinuturing itong peste ng mga magsasaka.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ginadaot sa ilaga ang humay sa basakan mao nga giila kini nga peste sa mga mag-uuma.

q: Which gas fizzes out of soft drinks and can turn limewater cloudy?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Hydrogen
explanation: Carbon dioxide is the gas that fizzes out of soft drinks and that we breathe out; it turns limewater cloudy when tested.
fact_tl: Ang carbon dioxide ang gas na lumalabas kapag bumubula ang softdrinks at kapag huminga tayo palabas; maaari itong subukan dahil pinalalabo nito ang limewater.
fact_bis: Ang carbon dioxide mao ang gas nga mobula gikan sa softdrinks ug atong gibuga kung moginhawa pagawas; matistingan kini kay gipalubog niini ang limewater.

q: Why does a double rainbow disappear so quickly?
options: It needs rain and sunshine at the same time, so it vanishes the moment the rain stops or a cloud covers the sun
The second rainbow is reflected off water on the ground and disappears when the ground dries
The colors of a double rainbow fade because sunlight bleaches them after a few minutes
The outer rainbow is made of much larger water droplets that evaporate faster than normal
explanation: A double rainbow fades fast because it needs both rain and sunshine at the same time — it disappears the moment the rain stops or a cloud covers the sun.
fact_tl: Mabilis mawala ang dobleng bahaghari dahil kailangan nito ng sabay na ulan at sikat ng araw. Kapag tumigil ang ulan o natakpan ng ulap ang araw, agad nawawala ang mga kulay.
fact_bis: Paspas mawala ang dobleng bahaghari kay kinahanglan niini ang dungan nga ulan ug sidlak sa adlaw. Inig-hunong sa ulan o inig-tabon sa panganod sa adlaw, dali ra mawala ang mga kolor.

q: When does a dominant trait show up in an organism?
options: Even when only one dominant allele is present — it masks the recessive allele
Only when both alleles are dominant, since one is not strong enough to show
Only when no recessive alleles are present at all in the organism's genes
Only in the first generation; recessive traits take over in later generations
explanation: A dominant trait appears even when only one dominant allele is present, masking the recessive allele.
fact_tl: Ang dominanteng katangian ang lumilitaw kahit na isang dominanteng alelo lang ang naroroon.
fact_bis: Ang dominante nga kinaiya magpakita bisan og usa ra ka dominante nga alelo ang naa.

q: What shape are salt grains when seen under a magnifying glass or microscope?
options: Tiny cubes, because sodium and chloride ions are arranged in a cubic pattern
Tiny spheres, because salt dissolves into round droplets before it dries
Long thin needles, because salt crystals always grow in one direction
Flat hexagons, like the shape of snowflakes or honeycomb cells
explanation: Salt grains are tiny cubes because sodium and chloride ions are arranged in a cubic pattern.
fact_tl: Kapag tinignan mo ang asin sa ilalim ng isang loupe o mikroskopyo, makikita mo na ang bawat butil ng asin ay isang maliit na kubo. Ito ay dahil ang mga ion ng sodium at chloride ay naka-ayos sa isang cubic na pattern.
fact_bis: Sa pagtingin sa mga butil sa asin ilalum sa usa ka magnifying glass o mikroskopyo, makita nimo nga ang matag butil usa ka gagmayng kubo. Kini tungod kay ang sodium ug chloride ions naka-ayos sa usa ka cubic nga pattern.

q: How does saliva help with digestion?
options: It wets the food and starts to break it down as we chew, beginning digestion in the mouth
It kills bacteria in the food so that nothing harmful reaches the stomach
It coats the food in a slippery layer so it slides down the throat without being digested
It signals the stomach to produce acid before the food even arrives
explanation: Saliva in our mouth begins digestion by wetting food and starting to break it down as we chew.
fact_tl: Ang laway sa ating bibig ang nagsisimula ng pagtunaw ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng pagbabad at paghahati nito habang ngumunguya tayo.
fact_bis: Ang laway sa atong baba mao ang magsugod sa paghilis sa pagkaon pinaagi sa pagbasa ug pagbungkag niini samtang mag-usap kita.

q: Which season is generally considered the best time for tourism in the Philippines?
options: Amihan (December to February), the dry season when beaches and outdoor activities are most enjoyable
Habagat (June to September), the rainy season when waterfalls and rivers are at their fullest
April to May, the hottest months when resorts offer the most discounts to visitors
October to November, because typhoon season has ended and prices are at their lowest
explanation: The amihan season (December to February) is generally considered the best time for tourism in the Philippines, as it is the dry season.
fact_tl: Ang panahon ng amihan (Disyembre hanggang Pebrero) ay karaniwang tinuturing na pinakamagandang panahon para sa turismo sa Pilipinas; ang mga beach at outdoor na aktibidad ay mas masaya sa tuyong panahon.
fact_bis: Ang panahon sa amihan (Disyembre hangtod Pebrero) kasagaran giisip isip pinakamaayo nga panahon alang sa turismo sa Pilipinas; ang mga beach ug outdoor nga mga aktibidad mas malipayon sa tuyot nga panahon.

q: In which group of the periodic table are the noble gases found?
options: Group 18 — and they almost never react with other elements
Group 1 — alongside the very reactive alkali metals
Group 17 — right next to the halogens, which they resemble
Group 8 — because they have eight electrons in their outer shell
explanation: The noble gases are in Group 18 of the periodic table, and they almost never react with other elements.
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas ay nasa Group 18 ng periodic table, at halos hindi sila nakikipagreaksyon sa ibang elemento.
fact_bis: Ang mga noble gas naa sa Group 18 sa periodic table, ug halos dili sila mo-react sa ubang elemento.

q: How do convection currents in Earth's mantle cause earthquakes and volcanoes?
options: Very hot rock slowly circulates in the mantle, and these currents push the tectonic plates that cause earthquakes and volcanic eruptions
Hot steam trapped under the crust builds up pressure until it bursts through as a volcano or earthquake
The spinning of Earth's core creates magnetic currents that push plates sideways
Radioactive decay in the mantle produces gases that expand and crack the crust above
explanation: Deep inside Earth, hot rock in the mantle slowly circulates by convection, and these currents push the tectonic plates that cause earthquakes and volcanoes.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng Mundo, ang sobrang init na bato sa mantle ay dahan-dahang umiikot sa pamamagitan ng convection, at ang mga agos na ito ang nagtutulak sa mga tectonic plate na nagdudulot ng lindol at bulkan sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Sa kahiladman sa Yuta, ang grabe ka init nga bato sa mantle hinay-hinay nga molibot pinaagi sa convection, ug kining mga agos magtukmod sa mga tectonic plate nga maoy hinungdan sa linog ug bolkan sa Pilipinas.

q: How can a magnifying glass burn a piece of paper using sunlight?
options: It gathers the sun's rays into one tiny, very hot point that can ignite the paper
It reflects the sun's rays back onto the paper, causing it to heat up slowly over time
It filters ultraviolet rays from the sun and concentrates them into harmful radiation
It splits sunlight into colors that, when recombined at one spot, produce extreme heat
explanation: A magnifying glass gathers the sun's rays into one tiny point so hot that it can burn paper.
fact_tl: Ang magnifying glass ay kayang magtipon ng sinag ng araw sa isang maliit na punto kung saan napakainit nito, kaya kayang sunugin ang papel.
fact_bis: Ang magnifying glass makahimo og pagtipon sa sidlak sa adlaw ngadto sa usa ka gamay nga punto nga init kaayo, mao nga makasunog kini og papel.

q: How does the mud lobster help the mangrove environment?
options: It builds tall soil mounds while burrowing, which loosens and refreshes the ground for other plants
It filters salt out of mangrove water, making the soil less salty for plants to grow
It eats dead leaves on the mud surface, speeding up decomposition in the mangrove
It creates tunnels that channel tidal water deeper into the mangrove forest
explanation: The mud lobster builds tall mounds of soil as it digs, loosening and refreshing the ground for other mangrove plants.
fact_tl: Ang mud lobster ay hayop sa putik ng kabakawanan na gumagawa ng mataas na bunton ng putik habang naghuhukay, na nagpapaluwag at nagpapasariwa ng lupa para sa ibang halaman.
fact_bis: Ang mud lobster usa ka mananap sa lapok sa bakhaw nga maghimo og tag-as nga bunton sa yuta samtang nagkalot, nga makapaluag ug makapabag-o sa yuta alang sa ubang tanom.

q: What is the value of absolute zero in degrees Fahrenheit?
explanation: In Fahrenheit, absolute zero is -459.67°F — the coldest temperature possible.
fact_tl: Sa Fahrenheit, ang absolute zero ay -459.67°F.
fact_bis: Sa Fahrenheit, ang absolute zero kay -459.67°F.

q: How much bamboo can a single giant panda eat in one day?
options: About 12 to 38 kilograms
About 1 to 3 kilograms
About 5 to 8 kilograms
About 50 to 60 kilograms
explanation: A single panda can eat about 12 to 38 kilograms of bamboo in one day.
fact_tl: Ang isang panda ay maaaring kumain ng halos 12 hanggang 38 kilo ng kawayan sa isang araw.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka panda makakaon ug mga 12 ngadto sa 38 ka kilo nga kawayan sa usa ka adlaw.

q: How long is a kangaroo's pregnancy before the baby is born?
options: Only about 35 days — then the tiny baby continues growing in the mother's pouch
About 9 months, the same as a human pregnancy
About 6 weeks for the mother to fully develop a baby before it hops independently
About 3 months, after which the baby is fully formed and does not need a pouch
explanation: A kangaroo is pregnant for only about 35 days, then the baby grows in its pouch.
fact_tl: Ang pagbubuntis ng kangaroo ay mga 35 araw lamang, pagkatapos ay tumutubo ang anak sa supot nito.
fact_bis: Ang kangaroo magmabdos lang sulod sa mga 35 ka adlaw, dayon motubo ang anak sa puyo niini.

q: What is the difference between venom and poison?
options: Venom is injected through a bite, while poison harms you when something is eaten — pythons have neither
Venom is a solid substance stored in fangs, while poison is a liquid found in skin glands
Venom affects only animals, while poison affects only humans who eat it
There is no real difference — venom and poison are two names for the same thing
explanation: Venom is injected through a bite while poison harms you when eaten — pythons have no venom and are not poisonous to eat.
fact_tl: Walang kamandag ang sawa, at hindi rin ito nakakalason kapag kinain—maaaring kainin pa nga ito sa ilang lugar—dahil ang kamandag (venom) ay iniiniksyon sa kagat, samantalang ang lason (poison) ay nakakasama kapag nakain.
fact_bis: Ang sawa walay hilo, ug dili sab kini makahilo kon kan-on—gani gikaon kini sa pipila ka lugar—kay ang venom giinject pinaagi sa pinaak samtang ang poison makadaot kon makaon.

q: What can cause a Philippine island to grow or shrink over a very long time?
options: Islands grow when new lava hardens or sand piles up, and shrink when waves wear away their edges
Islands grow when more rain falls each year, raising the sea level around them
Islands shrink only during strong typhoons, then quickly return to their original size
Islands grow by absorbing nutrients from the sea floor, which pushes their land higher
explanation: An island can grow when new lava hardens or sand piles up, and shrink when waves wear away its edges — these changes are very slow.
fact_tl: Hindi palaging pareho ang sukat ng isla sa paglipas ng napakahabang panahon. Maaaring lumaki ang isla kapag may bagong lava na tumigas o buhangin na naipon, at maaari namang umliit kapag inaagnas ng alon at tubig ang gilid nito. Napakabagal ng mga pagbabagong ito, kaya hindi natin agad napapansin sa loob ng isang buhay ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang isla dili kanunay parehas og gidak-on sa paglabay sa taas kaayong panahon. Ang isla makadako kung adunay bag-ong lava nga migahi o balas nga natipon, ug makagamay kung ang balod ug tubig magkutkot sa kilid niini. Hinay kaayo kini nga mga kausaban, busa kasagaran dili nato mamatikdan sulod sa usa ka kinabuhi sa tawo.

q: How do Filipino farmers use the carabao in rice farming?
options: They use it to pull a plow and break up the soil in rice fields
They use it to carry bags of harvested rice from the field to the road
They use it to water the rice plants by pulling a cart with a water tank
They use it to scare away birds that try to eat the rice seeds
explanation: Farmers use the carabao to pull a plow and break up the soil in rice fields.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga magsasaka ang kalabaw upang humila ng araro at bungkalin ang lupa sa palayan.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga mag-uuma ang kalabaw aron mobira sa daro ug magbungkal sa yuta sa umahan.

q: What is the key difference between a physical change and a chemical change?
options: In a physical change no new substance is formed, but in a chemical change a new substance with different properties is formed
In a physical change the material is permanently destroyed, but in a chemical change it can be reversed
In a physical change heat is always absorbed, but in a chemical change heat is always released
There is no real difference — both changes produce new substances with new properties
explanation: In a physical change like melting, no new substance is formed, but in a chemical change a new substance with different properties is formed.
fact_tl: Sa pisikal na pagbabago tulad ng pagkatunaw, hindi nabubuo ang bagong sangkap, ngunit sa kemikal na pagbabago ay nabubuo ang isang bagong sangkap na may ibang katangian.
fact_bis: Sa pisikal nga kausaban sama sa pagkatunaw, walay bag-ong substansiya nga maporma, apan sa kemikal nga kausaban adunay bag-ong substansiya nga lahi og kinaiya ang maporma.

q: What special feature helps the Philippine tarsier see at night?
options: Its huge eyes, which gather more light in the dark
Its very sensitive nose, which guides it toward prey in the dark
Its long fingers with sticky tips that feel vibrations in the dark
Its large ears that let it use sound to navigate like a bat
explanation: The Philippine tarsier, found in Bohol, has huge eyes that help it see at night.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine tarsier na matatagpuan sa Bohol ay may napakalaking mata na tumutulong sa kanyang makakita sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine tarsier nga makit-an sa Bohol adunay dagko kaayo nga mata nga makatabang niini makakita sa gabii.

q: What is diffusion?
options: The process by which two liquids or gases mix on their own without being shaken or stirred
The process where a liquid is heated until it turns into a gas and rises upward
The force that causes heavy liquids to sink below lighter ones when poured together
The separation of a mixture into its parts using a filter or membrane
explanation: Through diffusion, two liquids or gases can mix together on their own even when no one shakes or stirs them.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng diffusion, dalawang likido o gas ay maaaring maghalo nang kusa kahit walang nag-iwan o naghalo sa kanila.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa diffusion, ang duha ka likido o gas mahimong mosagol sa ilang kaugalingon bisan walay naguyog o nagkutaw kanila.

q: What happens to the nitrogen in plants and animals after they die and decay?
options: It returns to the soil, and some is sent back into the air by bacteria
It is permanently locked in the soil and can never be used again
It evaporates directly into the atmosphere as nitrogen gas without any help
It is washed into rivers and oceans where it becomes part of the water
explanation: When plants and animals die and decay, the nitrogen in their bodies returns to the soil, and other bacteria send some of it back into the air.
fact_tl: Kapag namamatay at nabubulok ang mga halaman at hayop, ang nitrogen sa kanilang katawan ay bumabalik sa lupa, at ang ibang bakterya ay nagpapabalik nito sa hangin.
fact_bis: Kung mamatay ug madunot ang mga tanom ug mananap, ang nitrogen sa ilang lawas mobalik sa yuta, ug ang ubang bakterya magpabalik sa pipila niini ngadto sa hangin.

q: Why can humans twist and bend their back?
options: Because the spine is made of many small bones with joints in between that allow movement
Because the spine is one long flexible bone that bends like a rubber tube
Because muscles attached to the spine stretch and contract to change its length
Because the spine floats in fluid inside the body, letting it move freely in any direction
explanation: The spine is made of many small bones with joints in between, which lets us twist and bend our back.
fact_tl: Ang gulugod ay binubuo ng maraming maliliit na buto na may mga kasukasuan sa pagitan, kaya kaya nating iliko at iyuko ang ating likod.
fact_bis: Ang gulugod gilangkuban sa daghang gagmayng bukog nga may mga lutahan sa taliwala, mao nga makaliko ug makayukbo kita sa atong likod.

q: How does the lens in your eye adjust to keep images in focus whether objects are near or far?
options: Tiny muscles change the lens's curve — thicker for close objects and thinner for far ones — so the image stays focused on the retina
The pupil opens wider for near objects and narrows for far ones, changing how much light enters
The cornea shifts forward for close objects and backward for far ones, changing the focal length
The retina moves closer to the lens for near objects and farther away for distant ones
explanation: Tiny muscles can change the eye lens's curve — making it thicker for close objects and thinner for far ones — so the image always stays focused on the retina.
fact_tl: Ang lente sa loob ng ating mata ay isang convex na lens na buhay! Hindi tulad ng salamin, kayang baguhin ng maliliit na kalamnan ang kurba nito — nagiging mas makapal kapag tumitingin sa malapit at mas manipis kapag malayo — para palaging pokus ang larawan sa retina.
fact_bis: Ang lente sa sulod sa atong mata usa ka buhi nga convex lens! Dili sama sa bildo, ang gagmay nga kaunoran makausab sa kurba niini — mahimong mas baga para sa duol nga butang ug mas nipis para sa layo — aron kanunay nga naka-focus ang hulagway sa retina.

q: You are standing near two lamps that are both turned on at the same time. How many shadows can your body make?
options: Only one shadow, because a person only has one body
More than one shadow, because each light source can make a separate shadow
No shadows, because two lights cancel each other out
Exactly three shadows, no matter how many lights there are
explanation: When there are several light sources, one object can have more than one shadow — each light source can cast its own shadow.
fact_tl: Kapag maraming pinagmumulan ng liwanag, maaaring magkaroon ng higit sa isang anino ang isang bagay.
fact_bis: Kon daghan ang gigikanan sa kahayag, ang usa ka butang mahimong adunay sobra sa usa ka landong.

q: Why does the sky sometimes look reddish or hazy instead of clear blue?
options: The Sun produces red light when it is very hot
Dust high in the air blocks and scatters sunlight, changing the sky's color
Water vapor in clouds absorbs all the blue light
The ozone layer turns sunlight red when there is a hole in it
explanation: Dust high in the air blocks and scatters sunlight, which can make the sky look reddish or hazy.
fact_tl: Ang alikabok na nasa himpapawid ay nakakahadlang at nagkakalat ng sinag ng araw, kaya kung minsan ay namumula o nanlalabo ang kulay ng langit.
fact_bis: Ang abog nga taas sa kahanginan magbabag ug magkatag sa sidlak sa adlaw, mao nga usahay mopula o mohanap ang kolor sa langit.

q: What do many scientists believe caused the extinction of the dinosaurs?
options: A massive volcanic eruption that released poisonous gas underground
A huge asteroid that hit Earth and changed the environment dramatically
A sudden ice age that froze the oceans overnight
A worldwide flood that covered all the land for thousands of years
explanation: Many scientists believe that a huge asteroid hit Earth and caused the dinosaurs to die out.
fact_tl: Maraming siyentista ang naniniwala na isang malaking asteroid ang tumama sa mundo at nagdulot ng pagkaubos ng mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Daghang siyentista ang nagtuo nga usa ka dako nga asteroid ang naigo sa kalibotan ug maoy hinungdan sa pagkahurot sa mga dinosaur.

q: Where do centipedes and millipedes usually lay their eggs?
options: In water, attached to underwater rocks and plants
In damp soil, where tiny young hatch and slowly grow bigger
Inside the bodies of other insects to protect them
High up in tree bark, away from ground predators
explanation: Centipedes and millipedes lay eggs usually in damp soil, and tiny young hatch from the eggs and slowly grow bigger.
fact_tl: Ang alupihan at millipede ay nangingitlog, kadalasan sa basang lupa, at mula sa mga itlog ay lumalabas ang maliliit na anak na unti-unting lumalaki.
fact_bis: Ang alupihan ug millipede mangitlog, kasagaran sa basa nga yuta, ug gikan sa mga itlog mogula ang gagmayng anak nga hinay-hinay nga modako.

q: A dye and a pigment both add color, but what is one key difference between them?
options: A dye is always brighter, while a pigment always fades faster in sunlight
A dye dissolves in liquid and bonds to fibers, while a pigment stays as tiny solid particles
A dye is made from plants, while a pigment is always made from rocks
A dye can only color cloth, while a pigment can only color metal
explanation: A dye dissolves in liquid and bonds to fiber molecules, while a pigment does not dissolve and consists of tiny solid particles suspended in a medium like paint.
fact_tl: Ang dye ay natutunaw sa tubig at nagtataglay ng kulay sa tela sa pamamagitan ng pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga fiber nito, habang ang pigment ay hindi natutunaw at nasa hugis ng maliliit na particle.
fact_bis: Ang dye natunaw sa likido ug nagbond sa mga fiber molecule aron magkulot og tela, samtang ang pigment dili matunaw ug naglangkob sa gagmay nga solidong particle nga naglutaw sa usa ka medium sama sa pintal.

q: Turtles and crabs have a hard shell for protection. How is this different from how humans are protected?
options: Humans have no protection because they have neither bones nor a shell
Humans have a thick layer of skin that acts like an outer shell, just like a turtle
Humans have bones on the inside of the body that give protection, while turtles and crabs have a hard shell on the outside
Humans and crabs both have outer shells, but humans shed theirs as they grow
explanation: We humans have bones inside that protect us, while animals like turtles, snails, or crabs have a hard shell on the outside — both give protection but in different places.
fact_tl: Tayong tao ay may buto sa loob na nagpoprotekta sa atin, pero ang ibang hayop tulad ng pagong, kuhol, o alimango ay may matigas na talukab sa labas. Parehong nagbibigay-proteksyon, pero iba ang kinalalagyan — sa loob o sa labas ng katawan.
fact_bis: Kita nga mga tawo adunay bukog sa sulod nga manalipod kanato, apan ang ubang mananap sama sa pawikan, kuhol, o alimango adunay gahi nga kabhang sa gawas. Parehong maghatag og panalipod, apan lahi ang nahimutangan — sa sulod o gawas sa lawas.

q: Which metal has the highest melting point, at about 3,422°C?
options: Iron
Gold
Tungsten
Platinum
explanation: Tungsten is the metal with the highest melting point, about 3,422°C.
fact_tl: Ang tungsten (tungsteno) ang metal na may pinakamataas na melting point, mga 3,422 °C.
fact_bis: Ang tungsten (tungsteno) mao ang metal nga adunay pinakataas nga melting point, mga 3,422 °C.

q: How does your brain form a memory when you learn something new?
options: The brain creates a tiny photograph stored in a special memory gland
The brain forms a new pathway or connection between neurons, which gets stronger when repeated
The brain stores memories in the blood as chemical codes that can be passed to children
Old brain cells are replaced with new ones that already contain the new information
explanation: A memory is like a new pathway built between neurons — when you repeat something, that connection grows stronger and you remember it more easily.
fact_tl: Ang isang alaala ay parang bagong daan na binubuo sa pagitan ng mga neuron — kapag inuulit mo ang isang bagay, lumalakas ang koneksyon at mas madali mo itong natatandaan.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka panumduman sama sa bag-ong dalan nga gitukod tunga sa mga neuron — kon balikbalikon nimo ang usa ka butang, molig-on ang koneksyon ug mas sayon nimo kining mahinumduman.

q: What field of science does Filipino physicist Caesar Saloma study?
options: Earthquake prediction and volcanic activity
The behavior of chemicals in water
Light and lasers for modern technology
The movement of the planets in our solar system
explanation: There are Filipino physicists like Caesar Saloma who study light and lasers for modern technology.
fact_tl: May mga Pilipinong pisisista tulad ni Caesar Saloma na nag-aaral ng liwanag at laser para sa mga makabagong teknolohiya.
fact_bis: Adunay mga Pilipinong pisisista sama ni Caesar Saloma nga nagtuon sa kahayag ug laser para sa modernong teknolohiya.

q: What unit is used to measure how loud a sound is?
options: Hertz (Hz)
Newton (N)
Watt (W)
Decibel (dB)
explanation: The decibel (dB) is the unit used to measure the loudness or intensity of sound.
fact_tl: Ang decibel (dB) ang yunit na ginagamit upang sukatin ang lakas o intensity ng tunog.
fact_bis: Ang decibel (dB) mao ang unit nga gigamit sa pagsukod sa kusog o intensity sa tunog.

q: Coffee, chocolate, and many fruits all have something in common — where do they originally come from?
options: They all grow directly from the roots of their plants underground
They all start as seeds that fall to the ground from ripe fruit
They all come from flowers that were pollinated
They all form from the leaves of the plant when it gets enough sunlight
explanation: Many foods on our table began as flowers — coffee, chocolate from cacao, and many fruits all come from flowers that were pollinated.
fact_tl: Maraming pagkain sa ating mesa ang nagsimula bilang bulaklak. Ang kape, tsokolate na galing sa kakaw, at maraming prutas ay galing lahat sa mga bulaklak na napollinate. Kaya napakahalaga ng mga bulaklak at bubuyog sa ating pang-araw-araw na pagkain.
fact_bis: Daghang pagkaon sa atong lamesa nagsugod isip bulak. Ang kape, tsokolate gikan sa kakaw, ug daghang prutas naggikan tanan sa mga bulak nga napollinate. Mao nga importante kaayo ang mga bulak ug buyog sa atong adlaw-adlaw nga pagkaon.

q: Which mammal can live the longest, reaching over 200 years of age?
options: Elephant
Bowhead whale
Giant tortoise
Blue whale
explanation: The bowhead whale is the longest-living mammal, able to reach over 200 years old.
fact_tl: Ang bowhead whale ang pinakamatagal mabuhay na mammal, na maaaring umabot nang mahigit 200 taon.
fact_bis: Ang bowhead whale mao ang pinakadugay mabuhi nga mammal, nga makaabot ug kapin 200 ka tuig.

q: How is a bacterium different from a virus?
options: A bacterium is smaller than a virus and needs a host cell to survive
A virus is alive and can eat on its own, while bacteria cannot function without a host
A bacterium is alive and can multiply on its own, while a virus can only multiply inside another cell
Both bacteria and viruses are exactly the same size and behave the same way
explanation: A bacterium is alive and can eat and multiply on its own, while a virus is even tinier and cannot multiply unless it gets inside another cell.
fact_tl: Madalas pinagkakamalan ang bacteria at virus, pero magkaiba sila. Ang bacteria ay buhay at kayang kumain at dumami nang mag-isa. Ang virus naman ay napakaliit pa, at hindi makakadami kung walang ibang cell na sasakyan. Mas malaki ang bacteria kaysa virus.
fact_bis: Kasagaran maglibog ang mga tawo sa bacteria ug virus, pero lahi sila. Ang bacteria buhi ug makakaon ug makadaghan mag-isa. Ang virus mas gamay pa, ug dili makadaghan kung walay laing cell nga sudlan. Mas dako ang bacteria kay sa virus.

q: Which of the following correctly names the three types of muscle in the human body?
options: Hard muscle, soft muscle, and liquid muscle
Outer muscle, inner muscle, and nerve muscle
Skeletal muscle, cardiac muscle, and smooth muscle
Fast muscle, slow muscle, and middle muscle
explanation: The body has three types of muscle: skeletal muscle for movement, cardiac muscle in the heart, and smooth muscle in organs like the intestines.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ay may tatlong uri ng kalamnan: skeletal (para sa paggalaw), cardiac (para sa puso), at smooth (para sa mga organo tulad ng bituka); ang dalawa ay gumagalaw nang hindi natin sinasadya.
fact_bis: Ang lawas adunay tulo ka klase sa kaunuran: skeletal alang sa galaw, cardiac alang sa puso, ug smooth alang sa mga organ sama sa bituka; ang katapusang duha nagtrabaho nga wala'y kontrol sa hunahuna.

q: Why is a loaded truck harder to push from rest than an empty bicycle?
options: Because trucks are built with brakes that resist being pushed by design
Because the truck has more mass and therefore more inertia, making it harder to start moving
Because bicycles are lighter, so air pressure helps them move more easily
Because the ground pushes back harder on trucks than on bicycles
explanation: An object with more mass has more inertia, so heavier objects are harder to start moving or to stop.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang inersya ng isang bagay kung mas malaki ang masa nito, kaya mas mahirap pakilusin o pahintuin ang mabibigat na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang butang nga mas dako og masa adunay mas dako nga inertia, mao nga ang mas bug-at nga mga butang lisod patukaron o pahunongon.

q: Which of the following will NOT help sugar dissolve faster in water?
options: Heating the water
Stirring the water
Grinding the sugar into a finer powder
Putting the cup in a dark room
explanation: A solid dissolves faster in a liquid when the liquid is heated, stirred, and when the solid is in smaller pieces — darkness has no effect on dissolving.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis matunaw (dissolve) ang isang solid sa likido kapag (1) iniinit ang likido, (2) hinahalo o kinakalog, at (3) pinino sa maliliit na piraso ang solid. Kaya mas mabilis matunaw ang asukal sa mainit na tubig na hinahalo.
fact_bis: Mas paspas matunaw (dissolve) ang solid sa likido kung (1) initan ang likido, (2) kutawon, ug (3) dugmokon sa gagmay nga piraso ang solid. Mao nga mas paspas matunaw ang asukal sa init nga tubig nga gikutaw.

q: A child weighs 60 kg on Earth. About how much would the same child weigh on the Moon?
options: About 60 kg, because weight never changes
About 10 kg, because the Moon's gravity is much weaker than Earth's
About 30 kg, because the Moon is half the size of Earth
About 120 kg, because there is no air on the Moon
explanation: On the Moon your weight drops to about 1/6 of what it is on Earth, so a 60-kg person would feel like only about 10 kg on the Moon.
fact_tl: Sa Buwan, ang weight mo ay bumababa sa halos 1/6 ng nasa Earth — kaya kung 60 kg ang bigat mo sa Earth, parang 10 kg lang ito sa Buwan.
fact_bis: Sa Bulan ang imong weight mokunhod sa mga 1/6 sa naa sa Earth — busa ang tawo nga 60 kg sa Earth morag 10 kg na lang sa Bulan.

q: At what age do Filipinos gain the right to vote in elections?
options: 16 years old
21 years old
18 years old
25 years old
explanation: Every Filipino aged 18 and above has the right to vote in elections to choose government officials.
fact_tl: Ang bawat Pilipinong may gulang na 18 pataas ay may karapatang bumoto sa mga eleksyon upang piliin ang mga opisyal ng pamahalaan.
fact_bis: Ang matag Pilipino nga 18 anyos pataas adunay katungod sa pagboto sa mga eleksyon aron pilion ang mga opisyal sa gobyerno.

q: How do parent herons feed their baby chicks in the nest?
options: They leave fish beside the chick in the nest and wait for it to eat alone
They teach the chick to fly first, then bring it to water to catch its own fish
They bring up food from their own throat and put it directly into the chick's mouth
They carry live prey in their talons and drop it into the nest for the chick
explanation: The parent heron brings up food from its own throat into the chick's mouth to feed its babies in the nest.
fact_tl: Ang mga sisiw ng tagak ay napipisa sa pugad at pinapakain ng kanilang mga magulang. Ibinabalik ng magulang ang pagkain mula sa lalamunan nito papunta sa bibig ng sisiw.
fact_bis: Ang mga piso sa tagak mapusa sa salag ug pakan-on sa ilang ginikanan. Iuli sa ginikanan ang pagkaon gikan sa tutunlan niini ngadto sa baba sa piso.

q: What happens to the boiling point of water when you add salt to it?
options: It drops below 100°C because salt makes water cold
It stays exactly at 100°C because salt has no effect on boiling
It rises slightly above 100°C because the salt raises the boiling point
It doubles to 200°C because the salt greatly increases the temperature needed
explanation: Adding salt to water slightly raises its boiling point above 100°C.
fact_tl: Ang pagdaragdag ng asin sa tubig ay bahagyang nagpapataas ng boiling point nito nang higit sa 100°C.
fact_bis: Ang pagdugang og asin sa tubig gamay nga magpataas sa boiling point niini labaw sa 100°C.

q: The Sun is made of gas, yet it stays perfectly round. What force keeps the Sun in a round shape?
options: The spin of the Sun flings material outward and flattens it into a perfect ball
The Sun's magnetic field pushes the gas equally in all directions from the outside
The Sun's own gravity pulls all its material evenly inward toward the center
Heat from nuclear reactions inside the Sun pushes outward equally in every direction
explanation: Even though the Sun is just gas, it stays round because its own gravity pulls all its material inward evenly toward the center.
fact_tl: Bagama't gas lang ang Araw, nananatili itong bilog dahil ang sarili nitong grabidad ay humihila ng lahat ng materyales nito papasok sa gitna nang pantay-pantay. Dahil napakabigat nito, sapat ang lakas para gawing perpektong bola. Kaya bilog ang Araw, hindi kuwadrado o hugis-itlog.
fact_bis: Bisan og gas lang ang Adlaw, nagpabilin kining lingin kay ang kaugalingong grabidad niini magbira sa tanang materyales niini paingon sa tunga nga patas. Tungod kay bug-at kaayo kini, igo ang birik aron mahimong hapit perpekto nga bula. Mao nga lingin ang Adlaw, dili kuwadrado o hugis-itlog.

q: How are wasps helpful to farmers and gardeners?
options: They pollinate all crops more efficiently than bees do
They eat weeds and prevent them from spreading across fields
They hunt and eat pests and caterpillars that would otherwise damage crops
They make honey that can be used to protect plants from disease
explanation: Wasps are important natural predators that help keep down the numbers of pests and caterpillars that could damage crops.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang putakti sa kalikasan dahil sila ay natural na predator — pinananatili nilang kontrolado ang dami ng mga peste at uod na maaaring sumira sa mga pananim.
fact_bis: Importante ang putakti sa kinaiyahan isip natural nga manunukob — gitabangan nila nga makontrol ang gidaghanon sa mga peste ug ulod nga makadaot sa mga tanom.

q: How high above the ground do auroras (the colorful lights in the sky near the poles) occur?
options: About 10 to 12 kilometers — the same height as a jet airplane flying
About 30 to 50 kilometers — just above the highest storm clouds
About 100 to 300 kilometers — much higher than any flying airplane
About 500 to 1,000 kilometers — almost at the distance of the Moon
explanation: Auroras happen very high up — about 100 to 300 kilometers above the ground — much higher than any flying airplane.
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang aurora nang napakataas — mga 100 hanggang 300 kilometro sa itaas ng lupa — kaya mas mataas pa ito kaysa sa lumilipad na eroplano.
fact_bis: Ang aurora mahitabo sa hilabihan ka taas — mga 100 ngadto sa 300 ka kilometro ibabaw sa yuta — mas taas pa kini kaysa sa naglupad nga eroplano.

q: How does a tick get its food?
options: It gathers nectar from flowers like a bee does
It hunts and eats small insects such as mosquitoes
It clings to the skin of an animal or person and sucks their blood
It eats dead leaves and fallen fruit on the forest floor
explanation: A tick is a parasite that sucks the blood of an animal or person after clinging to the skin.
fact_tl: Ang garapata ay isang parasito na sumisipsip ng dugo ng hayop o tao matapos kumapit sa balat.
fact_bis: Ang garapata usa ka parasito nga mosupsop sa dugo sa hayop o tawo human mokapyot sa panit.

q: In which ancient civilization was paper first invented?
options: Ancient Egypt
Ancient Greece
Ancient Rome
Ancient China
explanation: Paper was first made in ancient China.
fact_tl: Ang papel ay unang ginawa sa sinaunang Tsina (China).
fact_bis: Ang papel unang gihimo sa karaang China (Tsina).

q: Both momentum and kinetic energy depend on mass and speed. What makes momentum different from kinetic energy?
options: Momentum is always greater in value than kinetic energy for the same object
Momentum has a direction and measures quantity of motion, while kinetic energy measures the energy of a moving object
Kinetic energy can only be measured in moving fluids, while momentum applies to all objects
Momentum never changes in any situation, while kinetic energy always changes
explanation: Momentum has direction and measures the quantity of motion, while kinetic energy is the energy of a moving object — they are related but different quantities.
fact_tl: Ang momentum at kinetic energy ay parehong nakadepende sa masa at bilis, pero magkaiba sila. Ang momentum ay may direksyon at sinusukat ang dami ng galaw, habang ang kinetic energy ay ang lakas o enerhiya ng gumagalaw na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang momentum ug kinetic energy parehong nagdepende sa masa ug katulin, apan lahi sila. Ang momentum adunay direksyon ug nagsukod sa gidaghanon sa lihok, samtang ang kinetic energy mao ang kusog o enerhiya sa nagalihok nga butang.

q: What are chocolate and tablea made from?
options: Dried and ground coffee beans that are mixed with milk
Cacao beans that are dried, roasted, and ground
The sap of the sugar cane plant boiled until thick
Coconut milk that is fermented and then hardened
explanation: Chocolate and tablea are made from cacao beans that are dried, roasted, and ground.
fact_tl: Ang tsokolate at tablea ay gawa sa mga buto ng kakaw na pinatuyo, iniihaw, at giniling.
fact_bis: Ang tsokolate ug tablea hinimo gikan sa mga liso sa kakaw nga gipauga, gisanlag, ug giligis.

q: What happens to an object when it loses some of its electrons?
options: It becomes negatively charged because it now has fewer protons
It becomes positively charged because it has fewer electrons than protons
It becomes neutral because losing electrons balances the charge
It loses its mass and becomes lighter
explanation: An object that loses electrons becomes positively charged because it now has more protons than electrons.
fact_tl: Ang bagay na nakakuha ng dagdag na electron ay nagiging negatibo, at ang nawalan ng electron ay nagiging positibo.
fact_bis: Ang butang nga makadawat og dugang electron mahimong negatibo, ug ang mawad-an og electron mahimong positibo.

q: Why is antibiotic resistance a dangerous problem for people?
options: Resistant bacteria grow larger and can be seen without a microscope
Antibiotics become more expensive when resistance is common, so only rich people can afford them
Common infections that were once easy to cure become hard to treat and more dangerous
Resistance causes antibiotics to become poisonous to the people who take them
explanation: When resistance becomes widespread, common infections that were once easy to cure become hard to treat and more dangerous.
fact_tl: Kapag laganap na ang resistensya, nagiging mahirap gamutin at mas mapanganib ang mga karaniwang impeksyon na dating madaling lunasan.
fact_bis: Kung mokaylap na ang resistensya, mahimong lisod tambalan ug mas delikado ang mga komon nga impeksiyon nga kaniadto sayon ra ayohon.

q: What makes Philippine endemic plant species special?
options: They grow faster than plants in any other country due to the tropical climate
They are imported from other countries and grow better in Philippine soil
They are found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in the world
They can survive in both saltwater and freshwater unlike plants in other countries
explanation: The Philippines is home to thousands of endemic plant species — these plants are found only in the country and nowhere else.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay tahanan ng libu-libong uri ng halaman na endemiko; kasama rito ang iba't-ibang uri ng orkidya at iba pang natatanging halaman na makikita lamang sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas puy-anan sa libu-libong species sa halaman nga endemiko; naglakip kini sa iba-ibang klase sa orkidya ug uban pang natatanging mga halaman nga makita lamang sa nasud.

q: What mineral makes up a snail's hard shell?
options: Iron oxide
Silicon dioxide
Calcium carbonate
Magnesium sulfate
explanation: A snail's shell is made of a hard mineral called calcium carbonate.
fact_tl: Ang bahay ng suso ay gawa sa matigas na mineral na calcium carbonate o apog.
fact_bis: Ang kabhang sa suso hinimo gikan sa gahi nga mineral nga gitawag calcium carbonate o apog.

q: Why do things buried in a packed landfill rot very slowly, even after many years?
options: The soil in landfills is too acidic, which kills all the decomposing bacteria
Landfills are kept very cold underground, which slows down all chemical reactions
There is very little air inside a packed landfill, so decomposition happens extremely slowly
Rain water washes away the nutrients that decomposers need to break down trash
explanation: Inside a packed landfill there is little air, so even food and newspaper rot extremely slowly — sometimes an old newspaper can still be read after many years buried.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng siksik na tambakan ng basura, kulang ang hangin, kaya kahit ang pagkain at diyaryo ay napakabagal mabulok — minsan ay nababasa pa ang lumang diyaryo pagkalipas ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Sulod sa siksik nga tambakanan sa basura, kulang ang hangin, busa bisan ang pagkaon ug mantalaan hinay kaayo madunot — usahay mabasa pa ang daang mantalaan human sa daghang tuig nga gilubong.

q: Which type of wave in the electromagnetic spectrum has the longest wavelength?
options: X-rays
Ultraviolet waves
Gamma rays
Radio waves
explanation: Radio waves have the longest wavelength in the electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamahabang wavelength sa electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_bis: Ang radio waves mao ang adunay pinakataas nga wavelength sa electromagnetic spectrum.

q: What is remarkable about a tabon chick compared to most other baby birds?
options: It hatches with all its adult feathers already fully grown and colored
It can fly almost as soon as it hatches, allowing it to protect itself early
It stays in the nest for over a year before it learns to fly
Its parents carry it on their backs until it is strong enough to walk
explanation: A tabon chick can fly almost as soon as it hatches, so it can protect itself early.
fact_tl: Ang sisiw ng tabon ay kayang lumipad halos kaagad pagkatapos mapisa, kaya naman maaga nitong kayang protektahan ang sarili.
fact_bis: Ang piso sa tabon makahimo na sa paglupad halos diha-diha human mapusa, busa makapanalipod kini sa kaugalingon sa sayo.

q: What is gene therapy designed to do for patients with genetic diseases?
options: It removes the patient's entire DNA and replaces it with a healthy copy
It uses viral vectors to deliver a working gene to replace a faulty or missing one in the patient's cells
It trains the immune system to attack and destroy defective genes on its own
It uses electricity to repair damaged sections of DNA inside the nucleus
explanation: Gene therapy tries to treat genetic diseases by replacing a faulty or missing gene with a working version, using viral vectors to deliver the new gene to a patient's cells.
fact_tl: Ang gene therapy ay isang medikong pamamaraan na nagsisikap na ayusin ang mga genetic disease sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalitan ng sira o nawawalang gene ng isang tamang bersyon — ginagamit nito ang mga viral vectors para maihatid ang bagong gene sa mga selula ng pasyente.
fact_bis: Ang gene therapy usa ka medikal nga pamaagi nga nagsulay sa pagtambal sa mga genetic nga sakit pinaagi sa pagpuli sa sira o nawala nga gene sa usa ka nagtrabaho nga bersyon — naggamit kini og mga viral vector aron maihatod ang bag-ong gene sa mga selula sa pasyente.

q: How do most creatures living in the deep sea get their food?
options: They swim up to shallower water each night to hunt near the surface
They make their own food using chemicals from hot underwater vents
They feed on marine snow — tiny bits of dead material that drift slowly down from above
They absorb dissolved nutrients directly from the seawater around them
explanation: Most food in the deep sea comes from marine snow, bits of dead material that drift slowly down from above.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa pagkain sa malalim na dagat ay nagmumula sa tinatawag na marine snow, ang mga patay na bagay na unti-unting bumabagsak mula sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa pagkaon sa lawom nga dagat naggikan sa gitawag og marine snow, ang mga patay nga butang nga hinay-hinay nga mahulog gikan sa ibabaw.

q: Why do some hydras appear green in color?
options: They produce a green pigment in their skin cells to camouflage in pond plants
They eat only green algae, and the color seeps through their transparent body
Tiny algae live inside their bodies and give them a green color while also making food from sunlight
They change color based on the pH level of the water they live in
explanation: Some hydras are green because tiny algae live inside their bodies — the algae make food from sunlight, which the hydra also gets to share.
fact_tl: May uri ng hydra na berde ang kulay dahil may maliliit na lumot (algae) na nakatira sa loob ng katawan nito. Ang lumot ay gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw na nakikinabangan din ng hydra.
fact_bis: Adunay matang sa hydra nga berde ang kolor tungod kay adunay gagmay nga lumot (algae) nga nagpuyo sa sulod sa lawas niini. Ang lumot maghimo og pagkaon gikan sa adlaw nga makaambit usab ang hydra.

q: How does a firefly produce its flashing light?
options: It stores sunlight in special cells during the day and releases it at night
It rubs its wings together quickly, creating heat that glows orange-yellow
A chemical reaction inside its body called bioluminescence produces the light
It reflects moonlight off the surface of its shiny outer shell
explanation: A firefly's light comes from a chemical reaction inside its body called bioluminescence.
fact_tl: Ang ilaw ng alitaptap ay nanggagaling sa isang kemikal na reaksyon sa loob ng katawan nito na tinatawag na bioluminescence.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag sa aninipot naggikan sa usa ka kemikal nga reaksiyon sa sulod sa lawas niini nga gitawag og bioluminescence.

q: What is the complete full name of the Philippine national hero Jose Rizal?
options: Jose Antonio Rizal Bonifacio y Mercado
Jose Protasio Rizal Mercado y Alonso Realonda
Jose Maria Rizal Laong Laan y Luna
Jose Francisco Rizal Calamba y Alonso
explanation: The full name of Jose Rizal is Jose Protasio Rizal Mercado y Alonso Realonda.
fact_tl: Ang buong pangalan ni Jose Rizal ay Jose Protasio Rizal Mercado y Alonso Realonda.
fact_bis: Ang tibuok nga ngalan ni Jose Rizal mao ang Jose Protasio Rizal Mercado y Alonso Realonda.

q: How do scientists use fecal coliform bacteria to check water quality?
options: They count how many bacteria are swimming to measure how fast water flows
They check if the bacteria grow faster in warm or cold water to judge its temperature
High levels of fecal coliform bacteria in water show that the water is contaminated with feces
The bacteria change color when metals like lead are dissolved in the water
explanation: Scientists use certain bacteria as pollution indicators — high levels of fecal coliform bacteria in water show that the water is contaminated with feces.
fact_tl: Ang mga siyentipiko ay gumagamit ng ilang bacteria bilang mga indicator ng polusyon ng kalikasan — ang pagkakaroon ng maraming fecal coliform sa tubig, halimbawa, ay nagpapakita na ang tubig ay kontaminado ng dumi ng tao o hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentipiko mogamit sa pipila ka bakterya ingon mga indicator sa polusyon sa kalikasan — ang taas nga lebel sa fecal coliform bacteria sa tubig, pananglitan, nagpakita nga ang tubig kontaminado sa dumi.

q: Why are those tiny bumps that appear on your skin when you are cold called 'goosebumps' in English?
options: A scientist named Dr. Goose discovered them in the 1800s
They look like the shape of goose footprints left in soft mud
The skin with tiny bumps looks like the skin of a goose that has had its feathers removed
Geese are the only animals that also get these bumps when they feel cold
explanation: They are called 'goosebumps' because skin covered in these tiny bumps looks like the skin of a goose or chicken that has had its feathers plucked.
fact_tl: Tinawag itong 'goosebumps' sa Ingles dahil ang balat na may maliliit na bukol na ito ay kamukha ng balat ng gansa (goose) o manok na inalisan ng balahibo. Sa Tagalog tinatawag itong kilabot at sa Bisaya kibabot.
fact_bis: Gitawag kini nga 'goosebumps' sa Iningles tungod kay ang panit nga adunay gagmay nga bukol murag panit sa gansa (goose) o manok nga gilangkat ang balahibo. Sa Tagalog gitawag kini nga kilabot ug sa Binisaya kibabot.

q: Why do Philippine mines dig copper, nickel, and gold out of rock rather than making them in a factory?
options: Mining is cheaper than making these metals, even though factories could produce them
These metals glow underground, making them easy to spot with special equipment
They are elements that cannot be made from simpler substances — they can only be found and extracted
The Philippine government passed a law requiring all metals to come from local rock
explanation: Copper, nickel, and gold are elements that we cannot make or break down from simpler substances — we can only dig them from the rock where they naturally occur.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga minahan ng tanso, nikel, at ginto—lahat ito ay elemento. Hinahango ang mga ito mula sa bato dahil hindi natin sila magagawa o mahahati mula sa mas simpleng sangkap.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, adunay mga minahan sa tanso, nikel, ug bulawan—tanan kini elemento. Gikuha kini gikan sa bato kay dili nato kini mahimo o mabahin gikan sa mas yano nga substansiya.

q: At approximately what temperature does copper melt?
options: 328 degrees Celsius
660 degrees Celsius
1085 degrees Celsius
1538 degrees Celsius
explanation: Copper melts at about 1085 degrees Celsius (1085°C).
fact_tl: Ang tanso (copper) ay natutunaw sa mga 1085 degrees Celsius (1085°C).
fact_bis: Ang tumbaga (copper) matunaw sa mga 1085 degrees Celsius (1085°C).

q: What is diarrhea?
options: A stomach ache caused by eating too much food at one time
A fever that makes the body sweat a great deal
When a person passes loose or watery stool many times
When a person cannot pass stool for several days in a row
explanation: Diarrhea is when a person passes loose or watery stool many times.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatae ay kapag madalas na lumalabas ang malabnaw o matubig na dumi ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang kalibanga mao kung kanunay nga mogawas ang malabnaw o matubig nga tae sa tawo.

q: Why do grasslands have mostly grasses instead of tall trees?
options: The soil in grasslands is too rocky for tree roots to grow deep enough
Grasslands are too cold for trees to survive, but grasses are frost-resistant
Grasslands get enough rain for grasses but too little rain to support a forest
Animals in grasslands eat all the tree seeds before they can grow into seedlings
explanation: A grassland gets enough rain for grasses to grow but too little to support a forest, which is why grasses dominate instead of trees.
fact_tl: Ang grassland ay may sapat na ulan para tumubo ang damo pero kulang para sa kagubatan. Kaya damo ang nananaig, hindi mga puno.
fact_bis: Ang grassland adunay igong ulan para motubo ang sagbot apan kulang para sa kalasangan. Mao nga sagbot ang nagdaghan, dili mga kahoy.

q: You notice bubbles forming in a jar of fermenting vegetables. What do these bubbles actually mean?
options: The food is spoiled and should be thrown away immediately
The salt is dissolving and releasing gas trapped inside the vegetables
Helpful microbes are releasing carbon dioxide — a sign the fermentation is working properly
The jar was sealed too tightly, causing air bubbles to be forced into the liquid
explanation: In fermentation, bubbles are carbon dioxide released by helpful microbes — a sign the process is working properly, not that the food is spoiled.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakala na sira na ang pagkain kapag may bula, pero sa fermentation ang mga bula ay carbon dioxide na inilalabas ng mabubuting mikrobyo — tanda ito na gumagana nang maayos ang proseso.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga daot na ang pagkaon kung adunay bula, apan sa fermentation kadtong mga bula kay carbon dioxide nga gibuga sa mabuting mikrobyo — timaan nga maayo ang proseso.

q: How can you tell a butterfly from a moth just by looking at its antennae?
options: Butterfly antennae are long and straight, while moth antennae are short and flat
A butterfly's antennae have a small knob at the tip, while a moth's antennae are feathery or thread-like
Butterflies have four antennae, while moths only have two
Moth antennae are always brightly colored, while butterfly antennae are always black
explanation: A butterfly's antennae are thin with a little knob at the tip, while a moth's are feathery or thread-like.
fact_tl: Ang antena ng paru-paro ay manipis na may parang bilog na dulo, samantalang ang sa gamu-gamo ay parang balahibo o tuwid.
fact_bis: Ang antena sa alibangbang nipis nga adunay gamayng bola sa tumoy, samtang ang sa anunugba balhiboon o sama sa hilo.

q: Which pair of materials is correctly matched with its property?
options: Metal and glass are absorbent, cloth and sponge are waterproof
Cloth and sponge are absorbent, plastic and rubber are waterproof
Paper and wood are waterproof, plastic and rubber are absorbent
Sponge and rubber are absorbent, cloth and metal are waterproof
explanation: Materials like cloth, paper, and sponge soak up water (absorbent), while plastic and rubber keep water out (waterproof) so it just runs off the surface.
fact_tl: Ang ilang materyales gaya ng tela, papel, at espongha ay sumisipsip ng tubig (absorbent), samantalang ang plastik at goma ay hindi tinatablan ng tubig (waterproof) kaya pinapatakbo lang nila ito sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang ubang materyales sama sa panapton, papel, ug espongha mosuyop sa tubig (absorbent), samtang ang plastik ug goma dili matuhop sa tubig (waterproof) maong modagayday lang kini sa ibabaw.

q: What is 'island hopping' in the Philippines?
options: A traditional Filipino dance performed on floating bamboo rafts between islands
A sport where athletes jump across small islands using poles to cross the sea
A popular tourism activity where visitors travel by boat from one island to another to explore beaches and natural wonders
A fishing technique where fishermen move their boats from island to island to find the best fishing spots
explanation: 'Island hopping' is a popular tourism activity in the Philippines where visitors travel from one island to another by boat to explore different beaches and natural wonders.
fact_tl: Ang 'island hopping' ay isang sikat na aktibidad ng turismo sa Pilipinas kung saan naglalakbay ang mga bisita mula sa isang isla patungo sa isa pa sa pamamagitan ng bangka upang tuklasin ang iba't-ibang dalampasigan at likas na kababalaghan.
fact_bis: Ang 'island hopping' usa ka popular nga aktibidad sa turismo sa Pilipinas diin ang mga bisita nagbyahe gikan sa usa ka isla ngadto sa lain pinaagi sa bangka aron tuklasin ang lain-laing dalampasigan ug natural nga kababalaghan.

q: Why do dark, thick clouds usually mean rain is coming?
options: They are full of water droplets that block the sunlight
They are made of ice that melts when it falls
They are closer to the ground than white clouds
They form only over the ocean and bring sea water
explanation: Dark, thick clouds look dark because they are packed with so many water droplets that sunlight cannot pass through them, which means rain is near.
fact_tl: Kapag maitim at makapal ang ulap, malapit nang umulan — dahil punong-puno na ito ng maraming patak ng tubig na hahadlang sa liwanag ng araw.
fact_bis: Kon itom ug baga ang panganod, hapit na mo-ulan — kay puno na kini sa daghang tulo sa tubig nga mobabag sa kahayag sa adlaw.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the three ways mangroves handle salt?
options: Absorbing extra salt to use as energy
Filtering salt out at the roots
Excreting salt through glands on the leaves
Storing salt in old leaves that then drop off
explanation: Mangroves survive salt by filtering it at the roots, excreting it through leaf glands, or storing it in old leaves that fall — they do not absorb salt as an energy source.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing paraan ang bakawan para hindi mapatay ng asin: (1) sinasala ito sa ugat para hindi makapasok, (2) inilalabas ito sa dahon sa pamamagitan ng salt glands, at (3) itinatago ito sa lumang dahon na malalaglag.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka nag-unang paagi ang bakhaw aron dili mapatay sa asin: (1) salaon kini sa gamot aron dili makasulod, (2) ipagawas kini sa dahon pinaagi sa salt glands, ug (3) itipon kini sa daan nga dahon nga mahulog.

q: Who is Hooke's law named after?
options: Robert Hooke, an English scientist
Isaac Newton, an English scientist
Galileo Galilei, an Italian scientist
Charles Darwin, an English scientist
explanation: Hooke's law is named after Robert Hooke, the English scientist who described how springs stretch in proportion to the force applied.
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Hooke ay ipinangalan kay Robert Hooke, isang Ingles na siyentipiko.
fact_bis: Ang Balaod ni Hooke ginganlan kay Robert Hooke, usa ka Iningles nga siyentista.

q: What features help the cloud rat survive cold mountain temperatures?
options: Thick soft fur and a bushy tail
Thin smooth skin and a long bare tail
Hollow bones and wide flat feet
Dark scales and a short stubby tail
explanation: The cloud rat's thick, soft fur and bushy tail protect it from the cold of the mountains where it lives.
fact_tl: Ang cloud rat ay may makapal at malambot na balahibo at malagong buntot na tumutulong sa kanya laban sa lamig ng bundok.
fact_bis: Ang cloud rat adunay baga ug humok nga balhibo ug mabuhok nga ikog nga makatabang batok sa bugnaw sa kabukiran.

q: How does a jumping spider catch its food?
options: It leaps to catch its prey instead of using a web
It spins a sticky web and waits for insects to land
It uses venom sprayed from a distance
It digs underground tunnels to trap insects
explanation: Unlike most spiders, the jumping spider does not build a web; instead it leaps directly onto its prey to catch it.
fact_tl: Ang jumping spider ay hindi gumagawa ng sapot; tumatalon ito para hulihin ang biktima.
fact_bis: Ang jumping spider dili maghimo ug sapot; moambak kini aron dakpon ang biktima.

q: Why do a rodent's teeth never stop growing?
options: Their teeth have open roots that never close
Their saliva contains a special growth hormone
They eat minerals that rebuild lost tooth material
Their jaw bones push the teeth out continuously
explanation: A rodent's teeth have open roots that never close, which allows the teeth to keep producing new tooth material throughout the animal's life.
fact_tl: Ang ngipin ng daga ay may bukas na ugat na hindi nagsasara, kaya ito ay patuloy na nakalilikha ng bagong ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang ngipon sa ilaga adunay abli nga ugat nga dili gyud mosira, mao nga padayon kining maghimo og bag-ong ngipon.

q: What can happen if high blood pressure is left untreated for a long time?
options: It can damage the heart and arteries and lead to heart attack or stroke
It causes the lungs to fill with fluid and stop breathing
It makes the kidneys grow larger until they burst
