It only affects vision and has no effect on the heart
explanation: Untreated high blood pressure damages the heart and arteries over time and can lead to serious events like heart attack or stroke.
fact_tl: Kung hindi gagamutin, maaaring makapinsala ang altapresyon sa puso at mga arterya at magdulot ng atake sa puso o stroke.
fact_bis: Kon dili tambalan, ang altapresyon makadaot sa kasingkasing ug mga arterya ug mosangpot sa atake sa kasingkasing o stroke.

q: How dangerous is moving floodwater compared to still water?
options: Moving floodwater is so strong it can sweep away cars and people
Moving floodwater is less dangerous because it drains away quickly
Moving floodwater is only dangerous in deep rivers, not on roads
Moving floodwater is dangerous only to small animals, not to people
explanation: Moving floodwater carries tremendous force and can sweep away even heavy objects like cars and full-grown people.
fact_tl: Ang umaagos na tubig-baha ay napakalakas at kayang tangayin kahit mga sasakyan at tao.
fact_bis: Ang nagaagos nga tubig-baha kusgan kaayo ug makadala bisan og mga sakyanan ug mga tawo.

q: Over thousands of years, what does a river's flowing water do to the land?
options: Slowly carves through soil and rock to create valleys and canyons
Deposits only sand on flat plains and never cuts downward
Pushes mountains upward by pressing against the hillsides
Fills valleys with water until they become permanent lakes
explanation: A river's flowing water slowly erodes soil and rock over thousands of years, carving out deep valleys and canyons.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng libu-libong taon, ang umaagos na tubig ng ilog ay unti-unting umuukit ng lupa at bato, gumagawa ng malalalim na lambak at kanyon.
fact_bis: Sulod sa liboan ka tuig, ang nagdagayday nga tubig sa suba hinay-hinay nga nagkutkot sa yuta ug bato, naghimo og lawom nga walog ug kanyon.

q: Which type of metamorphosis do bees go through?
options: Complete metamorphosis — egg, larva, pupa, adult
Incomplete metamorphosis — egg, nymph, adult
Direct development — they hatch as tiny adult bees
Budding — a new bee grows on the side of an adult bee
explanation: Bees go through complete metamorphosis: eggs hatch into larvae, which then pupate in cells before emerging as adult bees.
fact_tl: Ang mga pukyutan ay dumadaan sa complete metamorphosis: ang reyna ay naglalaglag ng mga itlog sa honeycomb, ang mga itlog ay nagiging larva na pinakakain ng mga manggagawang pukyutan, nagko-cocoon bilang pupa, at lumabas bilang adult na pukyutan.
fact_bis: Ang mga pukyutan moagi sa complete metamorphosis: ang reyna nagbilin og mga itlog sa honeycomb, ang mga itlog nagiging larva nga gipakaon sa mga trabahador nga pukyutan, nagpupa sa ilang mga selula, ug mogawas isip hamtong nga mga pukyutan.

q: What happens to blood after the heart pumps it out to the body?
options: It travels in a loop, returning to the heart to be pumped again
It gets used up and replaced by new blood made in the lungs
It stays in the organs until the heart beats again
It drains out through the skin as sweat after it is used
explanation: Blood travels in a never-ending loop — pumped out to the body and then returned to the heart to be pumped again.
fact_tl: Hindi nauubos ang dugo na tinutulak ng puso. Umiikot ito: lumalabas patungo sa katawan, tapos bumabalik sa puso para muling itulak. Parang tuloy-tuloy na pabilog na biyahe.
fact_bis: Ang dugo nga giduso sa kasingkasing dili mahurot. Mosuroy kini sa usa ka liko: pagawas ngadto sa lawas, dayon mobalik sa kasingkasing aron iduso pag-usab. Sama sa walay kataposang biyahe.

q: Why does the Philippines have a unique mixture of animal species found nowhere else?
options: It sits at the boundary of Asian and Australian faunal realms
It has the hottest climate in Asia which drives fast evolution
It was never connected to any other land, so all species evolved alone
It receives the most rainfall in the world, supporting all types of life
explanation: The Philippines sits at the boundary between Asian and Australian faunal realms, giving it a unique blend of species from both regions.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isang natatanging lugar sa biogeography ng mundo — ito ay nasa hangganan ng mga reino ng Asian at Australian fauna, na nagbibigay ng kakaibang halo ng mga species na makikita lamang dito.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas nagsakop sa talagsaon nga biogeographic nga posisyon — anaa kini sa utlanan sa mga Asian ug Australian nga faunal realm, naghatag kaniya og talagsaon nga pagsagol sa mga species nga wala makita bisan asa.

q: Why do aquarium owners add a heater to tanks that hold pet shrimp?
options: Shrimp cannot warm themselves and need the water kept at the right temperature
Shrimp breathe less oxygen in warmer water so they live longer
Shrimp grow harder shells in heated water making them stronger
The heater produces light that shrimp need to see their food
explanation: Shrimp are cold-blooded and cannot regulate their own body temperature, so a heater keeps the water warm enough for them to survive.
fact_tl: Sa mga akwaryum na may alagang hipon, naglalagay ang mga tao ng pampainit (heater) para panatilihing tama ang init ng tubig, dahil hindi kayang painitin ng hipon ang sarili nito.
fact_bis: Sa mga aquarium nga adunay binuhing hipon, magbutang ang mga tawo og heater aron mapabilin ang husto nga kainit sa tubig, kay dili man makapainit ang hipon sa kaugalingon niini.

q: Why does a pendulum's swing slowly get smaller until it stops?
options: Air resistance and friction take away its energy over time
The pendulum gains weight as it swings, slowing it down
Gravity pulls it back harder with each swing
The string stretches longer each time, reducing the speed
explanation: A pendulum loses energy to air resistance and friction with each swing, which is why the arc gets smaller and it eventually comes to rest.
fact_tl: Unti-unting umiikli ang pag-ugoy ng pendulum dahil sa hangin at friction hanggang sa tuluyang huminto ito.
fact_bis: Anam-anam nga momubo ang pagtabyog sa pendulum tungod sa hangin ug friction hangtod nga mohunong na kini.

q: Where do hornbills get most of the water they need?
options: From the juicy fruit they eat every day
From rivers and streams where they drink regularly
From rain that collects in holes in tree trunks
From the dew they lick off leaves in the morning
explanation: Hornbills rarely drink from rivers; most of their water comes directly from the juicy fruit they eat each day.
fact_tl: Hindi madalas umiinom ng tubig ang kalaw mula sa ilog. Karamihan sa kailangan niyang tubig ay nakukuha niya mismo sa makatas na prutas na kinakain niya araw-araw.
fact_bis: Dili kanunay moinom og tubig ang kalaw gikan sa suba. Kadaghanan sa tubig nga gikinahanglan niini makuha gikan mismo sa tubig-on nga prutas nga ginakaon niini matag adlaw.

q: What does it mean that the Philippine eagle is critically endangered?
options: It is so few in number that hunting or harming one is forbidden
It is common throughout Asia but rare in the Philippines
It can only survive in captivity and no longer lives in the wild
It is endangered only during typhoon season
explanation: The Philippine eagle is critically endangered, meaning its population is very low and it is illegal to hunt or harm one.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine eagle ay kritikal na nanganganib (critically endangered), kaya bawal itong hulihin o saktan.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine eagle kritikal nga namiligro (critically endangered), busa gidili ang pagpangayam o pagsakit niini.

q: How many spots does the most common type of ladybug, the seven-spot ladybug, have on its back?
explanation: The seven-spot ladybug, the most common species, has exactly seven spots on its back.
fact_tl: Ang pinakakaraniwang uri ng ladybug ay may pitong (7) batik (tuldok) sa kanyang likod.
fact_bis: Ang labing komon nga ladybug, ang seven-spot ladybug, adunay pito (7) ka tuldok sa likod niini.

q: How does a tapeworm harm the person or animal it lives inside?
options: It lives in the intestine and steals nutrients from the food the host eats
It injects venom directly into the host's bloodstream
It destroys red blood cells in the lungs causing breathing problems
It wraps around the heart and slows down the heartbeat
explanation: A tapeworm lives in the intestine and steals nutrients from the digested food, weakening the host over time.
fact_tl: Ang tapeworm ay bulateng nabubuhay sa loob ng bituka ng hayop o tao at kumukuha ng sustansiya mula sa kinakain ng host, kaya nahihina ang host.
fact_bis: Ang tapeworm usa ka ulod nga nagpuyo sa sulod sa tinai sa hayop o tawo ug mokuha ug sustansya gikan sa gikaon sa host, mao nga maluya ang host.

q: What surprising ability do some hummingbirds have despite their tiny size?
options: They can fly very long distances without stopping, even crossing wide stretches of water
They can carry objects heavier than their own body weight in their beaks
They can hover perfectly still for several hours without any movement
They can survive underwater for several minutes by slowing their heartbeat
explanation: Even though hummingbirds are very small, some can fly surprisingly long distances non-stop, even crossing wide stretches of water during migration.
fact_tl: Kahit napakaliit nito, may ilang hummingbird na napakalakas — kaya nilang lumipad nang tuloy-tuloy sa napakalayong distansya, minsan pa nga ay tumatawid sa malalaking katubigan nang hindi humihinto.
fact_bis: Bisan gamay kaayo kini, ang ubang hummingbird kusgan kaayo — makahimo sila sa paglupad og layo kaayo nga walay hunong, usahay molabang pa sa lapad nga katubigan nga walay pahulay.

q: A fast truck and a fast bicycle are traveling at the same speed. Which has more kinetic energy?
options: The truck, because it has greater mass
The bicycle, because it is lighter and easier to accelerate
They have the same kinetic energy since they have the same speed
Neither has kinetic energy unless they are going uphill
explanation: Kinetic energy depends on both mass and speed, so a truck moving at the same speed as a bicycle has far more kinetic energy because its mass is much greater.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, pareho lang ang kinetic energy at bilis. Hindi pala! Dalawang bagay na may parehong bilis ay puwedeng magkaiba ang kinetic energy kung magkaiba ang bigat. Halimbawa, mabilis na trak ay may mas maraming kinetic energy kaysa sa mabilis na bisikleta.
fact_bis: Maghunahuna ang uban nga managsama lang ang kinetic energy ug katulin. Dili diay! Duha ka butang nga parehas ug katulin mahimong magkalahi ang kinetic energy kung lahi ang ilang gibug-aton. Pananglitan, ang paspas nga trak mas daghan ug kinetic energy kaysa paspas nga bisikleta.

q: When you accidentally touch something hot, why does your hand pull away before you even think about it?
options: The spinal cord handles the reflex directly without waiting for the brain
The skin sends a signal to the eyes which tell the hand to move
The brain processes the pain so fast it feels like there was no thinking
The heart pumps more blood to the hand making it move on its own
explanation: A reflex like pulling away from heat is controlled directly by the spinal cord, making it faster than a response that has to travel all the way to the brain.
fact_tl: Kapag nahawakan natin ang isang mainit na bagay, agad nating naiiwas ang kamay bago pa man tayo makaisip — ito ay reflex. Direkta itong dinadaan sa spinal cord para mas mabilis kaysa kung dadaan pa sa utak.
fact_bis: Kon makahikap ta og init nga butang, dali nato nga ibira ang atong kamot sa wala pa ta makahunahuna — reflex kini. Direkta kining moagi sa spinal cord aron mas paspas kay sa moagi pa sa utok.

q: How do geothermal plants keep their energy source renewable for a long time?
options: They return used fluid back into the ground through reinjection wells
They mix the fluid with seawater to create a larger reservoir
They release the steam into the atmosphere and let rain refill the ground
They drill new wells every year as the old ones dry up
explanation: Reinjecting used geothermal fluid back into the ground maintains reservoir pressure and extends the life of the geothermal field, keeping it renewable.
fact_tl: Para panatilihing renewable ang geothermal energy, ang mga puwersang tubig na ginagamit (spent geothermal fluid) ay inibabalik sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng mga reinjection wells; nakakatulong ito para mapanatili ang presyon ng reservoir at mapalawig ang buhay ng isang geothermal field.
fact_bis: Aron mapabilin ang geothermal energy nga renewable, ang nagamit na geothermal fluid gibalik sa yuta pinaagi sa mga reinjection wells; kini nagtabang sa pagpanatili sa presyon sa reservoir ug nagpalapas sa kinabuhi sa usa ka geothermal field.

q: If you feel a strong earthquake while near the coast, what should you do right away?
options: Move to high ground immediately without waiting for an official warning
Wait for a loud siren before doing anything
Go to the shore to check if the ocean looks different
Stay indoors and hide under a table until the shaking stops
explanation: A strong earthquake near the coast is a natural warning sign of a possible tsunami, so you should move to high ground right away without waiting for an official alert.
fact_tl: Kapag malakas na lindol ang naramdaman malapit sa dalampasigan, huwag nang maghintay ng babala at agad umakyat sa mataas na lugar.
fact_bis: Kon makabati ka og kusog nga linog duol sa baybayon, ayaw na paghulat sa pasidaan ug dayon saka sa habog nga dapit.

q: Why is the name 'red tide' considered misleading by scientists?
options: The water is not always red, and the real danger is the toxin the algae produce
Red tide only happens in cold oceans, not in tropical places like the Philippines
The water turns red because of iron from underwater volcanoes, not algae
Red tide is caused by jellyfish, not algae, so scientists changed the name
explanation: Scientists prefer the term 'harmful algal bloom' because the water isn't always red and the real danger comes from the toxin produced by the algae, not the color.
fact_tl: Kahit tinatawag itong red tide, hindi laging pula ang tubig — kaya tinatawag din itong harmful algal bloom dahil ang totoong panganib ay ang lason, hindi ang kulay.
fact_bis: Bisan kung gitawag kini nga red tide, dili kanunay pula ang tubig, mao nga gitawag usab kini nga harmful algal bloom kay ang tinuod nga kuyaw mao ang hilo, dili ang kolor.

q: Which organ of the body is the largest and is responsible for our sense of touch?
options: The skin
The brain
The tongue
The eyes
explanation: The skin is the body's largest organ and is what we use for the sense of touch.
fact_tl: Ang balat ang pinakamalaking organ ng katawan at ito ang ginagamit natin para sa pandamang hipo o pagdama.
fact_bis: Ang panit mao ang pinakadako nga organ sa lawas ug mao ni atong gamiton sa paghikap o pagbati.

q: How fast can a peregrine falcon fly when it dives to catch prey?
options: Up to 389 kilometers per hour
Up to 120 kilometers per hour
Up to 250 kilometers per hour
Up to 500 kilometers per hour
explanation: The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal on Earth in a dive, reaching speeds of up to 389 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang peregrine falcon ay umaabot ng hanggang 389 kilometro kada oras kapag sumusuong pababa.
fact_bis: Ang peregrine falcon makaabot ug hangtod 389 ka kilometro kada oras samtang nagsulbo paubos.

q: How are guava leaves used in traditional medicine?
options: As a wash to clean wounds and help prevent infection
Boiled into a tea that lowers fever within minutes
Placed on the forehead to relieve headaches
Ground into a powder eaten to improve eyesight
explanation: Guava leaves are believed to help prevent infection, so they are traditionally used as a wash to clean wounds.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng bayabas ay ginagamit sa tradisyunal na panggamot bilang panghugas o pampalinis ng sugat dahil naniniwalang nakakatulong itong maiwasan ang impeksyon.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa bayabas gigamit sa tradisyonal nga tambal isip panghugas o panglimpyo sa samad kay gituohan nga makatabang kini sa pagpugong sa impeksyon.

q: Besides trapping insects, what else can a spider's web do?
options: Collect morning dew droplets that the spider can drink
Produce a sound to warn the spider of approaching danger
Store extra food the spider wraps up for later
Reflect light to attract moths toward the web at night
explanation: Morning dew condenses into droplets on spider webs, which the spider can drink; this property also inspires engineers to design water-collecting surfaces.
fact_tl: Sa umaga, ang mga tulo ng hamog ay sumasakay sa tela ng gagamba—maaari ring inumin ng gagamba ang tubig na ito; nagbibigay inspirasyon din ito sa mga inhinyero para gumawa ng mga surface na nakakahuli ng tubig mula sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sa buntag, ang mga tulo sa hamog nagasuot sa tela sa gagamba—mahimong imnon sa gagamba ang tubig nga kini; nakapaghatag usab kini og inspirasyon sa mga inhinyero aron maghimo og mga surface nga makahukop og tubig gikan sa hangin.

q: Is it safe to eat a death cap mushroom if it has been cooked thoroughly?
options: No — the amatoxin survives cooking and can still cause liver failure and death
Yes — heat breaks down all mushroom toxins making them harmless
Yes — cooking for more than 30 minutes removes any dangerous chemicals
No — but only because cooking makes the smell stronger, which is toxic
explanation: The amatoxin in the death cap mushroom is not destroyed by heat, so cooking does not make it safe; it can still cause liver failure and death.
fact_tl: Ang amatoxin ng Amanita phalloides ay hindi masisira ng pagluluto — kahit lutuin ang kabute, ang lason ay mananatili at maaaring magdulot ng kabiguan ng atay at kamatayan sa loob ng ilang araw.
fact_bis: Ang amatoxin sa Amanita phalloides dili mapoo sa pagluto — bisan iluto ang kabute, ang lason nagpabilin ug mahimong magpahinabog kabiguan sa atay ug kamatayon sulod sa pipila ka adlaw.

q: What can the young aerial roots of the balete tree do before they reach the ground?
options: Absorb moisture directly from the air
Produce seeds that float down to the soil
Make food from sunlight like leaves do
Release a scent to attract pollinating insects
explanation: The young hanging roots of the balete can absorb moisture from the surrounding air even before they reach the ground.
fact_tl: Habang nakabitin pa sa hangin, ang mga batang ugat ng balete ay maaaring sumipsip ng halumigmig bago pa ito umabot sa lupa.
fact_bis: Samtang nagbitay pa sa hangin, ang mga batan-ong gamot sa balete makasuyop ug kaumog sa hangin sa wala pa kini makaabot sa yuta.

q: Which chemical creates the orange color in fireworks?
options: Calcium salts
Sodium salts
Magnesium salts
Copper salts
explanation: The orange color seen in fireworks is produced by burning calcium salts.
fact_tl: Ang KAHEL (orange) na kulay sa paputok (fireworks) ay galing sa CALCIUM na asin.
fact_bis: Ang KAHEL (orange) nga kolor sa paputok (fireworks) gikan sa CALCIUM nga asin.

q: What do scientists mainly do to understand the world around them?
options: Carefully observe, ask questions, and test ideas
Memorize facts from books and repeat them exactly
Build machines and let computers figure out the answers
Only measure things with rulers and weighing scales
explanation: Science is about carefully observing, asking questions, and testing ideas to understand how the world works.
fact_tl: Sa klase sa agham, natututo tayo sa pamamagitan ng maingat na pagmamasid, pagtatanong, at pagsubok upang maunawaan ang mundo sa paligid natin.
fact_bis: Sa klase sa siyensya, makakat-on kita pinaagi sa maampingong pagbantay, pagpangutana, ug pagsulay aron masabtan ang kalibotan sa atong palibot.

q: Which animal is one of the main grazers that eats seagrass in ocean meadows?
options: The green sea turtle
The great white shark
The blue-ringed octopus
The hammerhead shark
explanation: The green sea turtle is one of the main animals that grazes on seagrass meadows in the ocean.
fact_tl: Ang green sea turtle o berdeng pawikan ay isa sa mga pangunahing hayop na kumakain ng damong-dagat sa damuhan.
fact_bis: Ang green sea turtle o berde nga pawikan usa sa mga nag-unang mananap nga mokaon sa sagbot sa dagat sa damuhan.

q: How many ants can live together in a single ant colony?
options: Thousands to millions
Only a few hundred at most
Exactly 500 to 1,000
Fewer than 50 worker ants
explanation: A single ant colony can hold thousands to millions of ants living together like one large family.
fact_tl: Ang isang kolonya ng langgam ay maaaring magkaroon ng libu-libo hanggang milyon-milyong langgam na nakatira nang magkakasama na parang isang malaking pamilya.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka kolonya sa hulmigas mahimong adunay liboan hangtod minilyon ka hulmigas nga nagpuyo nga magkauban sama sa usa ka dakong pamilya.

q: What is vulcanization, and why is it used to make rubber for car tires?
options: Mixing rubber with sulfur and heating it so it becomes stronger and does not soften in the sun
Cooling rubber quickly in ice water so it becomes harder and more rigid
Adding plastic to raw rubber so it stretches without breaking
Treating rubber with acid so it bonds strongly to metal wheels
explanation: Vulcanization mixes raw rubber with sulfur and applies heat, making it much stronger and resistant to softening in the heat — ideal for tires.
fact_tl: Ang hilaw na goma ay malagkit at humihina sa init, pero kapag hinaluan ng asupre at pinainit (tinatawag na vulcanization), nagiging mas matibay at hindi na basta nalalambot sa araw — kaya ginagamit ito sa gulong.
fact_bis: Ang hilaw nga goma malagkit ug maluya sa init, apan kon sagolan og asupre ug initon (gitawag og vulcanization) mahimo kining mas lig-on ug dili na dali mahumok sa adlaw — mao nga gigamit kini sa gulong.

q: In the scientific classification system, which level is the MOST specific?
options: Species
Kingdom
Phylum
Class
explanation: Classification goes from broadest to most specific: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species — making species the most specific level.
fact_tl: Ang pag-uri ng buhay ay may pasunod-sunod na antas mula sa pinakamalaki hanggang pinakatiyak: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, at species.
fact_bis: Ang klasipikasyon sa buhay adunay sunod-sunod nga ang-ang gikan sa labing lapad ngadto sa labing pig-ot: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, ug species.

q: What formed the Paoay Sand Dunes in Ilocos Norte?
options: Winds from the South China Sea shaped them over time
Earthquakes pushed sand up from underground into large mounds
Lava from a nearby volcano cooled into sandy material
Ocean waves during a typhoon deposited all the sand at once
explanation: The Paoay Sand Dunes were formed by winds blowing from the South China Sea, making them among the largest sand dunes in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Paoay Sand Dunes sa Ilocos Norte ay mga bunton ng buhangin na inihubog ng hangin mula sa Dagat Tsina — isa sa pinakamalaking sand dunes sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Paoay Sand Dunes sa Ilocos Norte mga bunton sa buhangin nga hinubog sa hangin gikan sa South China Sea, usa sa pinakaduako nga sand dunes sa Pilipinas.

q: How many pairs of chromosomes does a normal human cell contain?
options: 23 pairs
46 pairs
12 pairs
30 pairs
explanation: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes in the nucleus of each cell, for a total of 46 chromosomes.
fact_tl: Ang tao ay may 23 pares ng kromosoma.
fact_bis: Ang tawo adunay 23 ka pares nga kromosoma.

q: Why are Philippine mountains not as tall as the Himalayas?
options: Philippine mountains formed mainly from volcanoes and uplift, not from a giant collision of continents
The Philippines has softer rock that erodes away before mountains can grow tall
Typhoons wear down Philippine mountains faster than they can grow
The Philippines is too close to the equator for tall mountains to form
explanation: Philippine mountains mostly come from volcanic activity and uplift, which do not build the extreme heights created by the collision of two large continental plates that formed the Himalayas.
fact_tl: Ang mga bundok ng Pilipinas ay kadalasang galing sa bulkan at pag-angat ng lupa, kaya hindi kasing taas ng Himalayas na bunga ng banggaan ng kontinente.
fact_bis: Ang mga bukid sa Pilipinas kasagaran gikan sa bulkan ug pag-angat sa yuta, mao nga dili sila kataas sa Himalayas nga gikan sa pagbangga sa kontinente.

q: What makes migmatite different from a regular metamorphic rock?
options: Parts of it begin to melt under extreme heat and pressure, forming bright veins of magma inside dark metamorphic rock
It is made entirely of lava that cooled very slowly deep underground
It forms only on the ocean floor where cold water stops full melting
It contains no minerals, only compressed layers of ancient plant material
explanation: Migmatite forms at the boundary between metamorphism and melting: extreme heat and pressure partially melt the rock, producing bright magma veins inside the darker metamorphic material.
fact_tl: Ang migmatite ay isang bato sa hangganan ng metamorphism at pagkatunaw; sa ilalim ng matinding init at presyon sa malalim na crust, ang ilang bahagi ng bato ay nagsimulang matunaw at lumikha ng maliwanag na mga ugat ng magma sa loob ng madilim na metamorphic rock.
fact_bis: Ang migmatite usa ka bato sa utlanan sa metamorphism ug pagtunaw; ilalom sa grabe nga init ug presyon sa lawom nga crust, ang pipila ka bahin sa bato nagsugod sa pagtunaw ug nagporma og hayag nga mga ugat sa magma sulod sa ngitngit nga metamorphic rock.

q: What is a ratoon in sugarcane farming?
options: New growth that sprouts from the leftover roots after the cane is harvested
A special tool used to cut the sugarcane stalks at harvest time
The first crop planted from seed before any harvesting takes place
A pest that attacks sugarcane roots causing the plant to regrow weaker
explanation: After sugarcane is cut, it regrows from the remaining roots — this regrowth is called a ratoon — allowing farmers to harvest the same plant several times before replanting.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos anihin, muling tumutubo ang tubo mula sa naiwang ugat, kaya maaaring umani nang ilang beses bago muling magtanim.
fact_bis: Human anihon, motubo pag-usab ang tubo gikan sa nahibilin nga gamot, mao nga mahimong anihon makadaghan sa dili pa magtanom usab.

q: Approximately how long ago did modern humans (Homo sapiens) first appear on Earth?
options: About 300,000 years ago
About 3 million years ago
About 65 million years ago
About 10,000 years ago
explanation: Modern humans, Homo sapiens, first appeared on Earth approximately 300,000 years ago.
fact_tl: Ang mga makabagong tao (Homo sapiens) ay lumitaw mga 300,000 taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang mga modernong tawo (Homo sapiens) mitungha mga 300,000 ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: Why can't you see the tiny living things in pond water with just your eyes?
options: They are micro-organisms too small to see without a microscope
They are transparent so they blend in with the water completely
They only come out at night when it is too dark to see
They move so fast that your eyes cannot focus on them
explanation: Pond water contains micro-organisms that are far too tiny to see with the naked eye; a microscope is needed to observe them.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa lawa o estanke ay puno ng napakaliliit na nabubuhay na bagay na tinatawag na mikroorganismo, na hindi nakikita ng mata kundi sa pamamagitan lamang ng mikroskopyo.
fact_bis: Ang tubig sa danaw o lim-aw kay puno sa gagmay kaayo nga mga buhi nga butang nga gitawag og mikroorganismo, nga dili makita sa mata kondili pinaagi lang sa mikroskopyo.

q: How long did the Wright brothers' very first powered airplane flight last?
options: Only 12 seconds
About 5 minutes
Nearly one hour
Exactly 30 seconds
explanation: The Wright brothers' historic first powered flight lasted only 12 seconds, but it proved that a heavier-than-air machine could fly.
fact_tl: Ang unang lipad ng Wright brothers ay tumagal lamang ng 12 segundo.
fact_bis: Ang unang paglupad sa managsoong Wright milungtad lang ug 12 ka segundo.

q: What do ripple marks preserved in sedimentary rock tell scientists about the past?
options: The sediment was once deposited in shallow water or on a beach and shows the direction of ancient currents
The rock was once part of a volcanic explosion that sent waves through molten lava
The area was once covered by a thick glacier that carved wave-like grooves
The rock formed deep underground where liquid minerals created the wave pattern
explanation: Ripple marks in sedimentary rock are wave patterns that show the rock was once sediment in shallow water or on a beach, and they even reveal the direction the ancient currents flowed.
fact_tl: Ang mga ripple marks ay maliit na alon na napreserba sa mga sedimentary rock; ito ay nagpapakita na ang sediment ay idineposito sa mababaw na tubig o sa isang beach noong araw at nagtuturo sa direksyon ng sinaunang agos.
fact_bis: Ang mga ripple marks gagmay nga mga alon nga napreserba sa mga sedimentary rock; kini nagpakita nga ang sediment kaniadto gitahid sa mabaw nga tubig o sa baybayon ug nagtimaan sa direksyon sa karaan nga mga agos.

q: How many eggs can a female tick lay after feeding on blood?
options: Thousands of eggs
Only 10 to 20 eggs
About 100 eggs
Exactly 500 eggs
explanation: After a female tick fills up on blood, she can lay thousands of eggs at one time.
fact_tl: Ang babaeng garapata ay maaaring mangitlog ng libo-libong itlog matapos mabusog sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang bayeng garapata makapangitlog ug liboliboan ka itlog human mabusog sa dugo.

q: Why is it wrong to think that big earthquakes along the Philippine Fault happen on a fixed schedule?
options: Earthquakes cannot be predicted on an exact schedule — they may come sooner or later than expected, so being always prepared matters
Earthquakes do follow a strict 100-year schedule but scientists have not published it yet
The Philippine Fault has already released all its energy and will not move again
Big earthquakes only happen at sea near the Philippine Fault, not on land
explanation: It is a misconception that Philippine Fault earthquakes arrive on a fixed schedule; they are unpredictable and may happen sooner or later than expected, making constant preparedness essential.
fact_tl: Maling akala na may tiyak na iskedyul ang malalakas na lindol sa Philippine Fault, na parang darating tuwing eksaktong taon. Sa totoo, hindi natin tiyak na mahuhulaan kung kailan eksakto ito gagalaw. Maaaring magkalat ng daan-daang taon o mas maaga, kaya laging mahalaga ang paghahanda.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga adunay piho nga iskedyul ang kusog nga linog sa Philippine Fault, nga morag moabot sa eksaktong tuig. Sa tinuod, dili nato matagna sa piho kon kanus-a kini molihok. Mahimong mokabat og gatosan ka tuig o mas sayo, mao nga importante kanunay ang pagpangandam.

q: How do fresh air and sunlight help fight tuberculosis (TB) inside a home?
options: They help reduce TB bacteria, so good ventilation is important
They make TB medicine work faster when taken near a window
They destroy the bacteria by raising the room temperature above 40°C
They prevent TB from spreading by keeping family members from talking indoors
explanation: Fresh air and sunlight help reduce the number of TB bacteria inside a home, which is why good ventilation is an important part of TB prevention.
fact_tl: Ang sariwang hangin at sikat ng araw ay nakakatulong na mabawasan ang bakterya ng TB sa loob ng bahay, kaya mahalaga ang maayos na bentilasyon.
fact_bis: Ang preskong hangin ug silaw sa adlaw makatabang sa pagkunhod sa bakterya sa TB sulod sa balay, mao nga importante ang maayong bentilasyon.

q: According to cell theory, where does every new cell come from?
options: A pre-existing cell.
A combination of proteins and water.
The nucleus breaking apart into two pieces.
Dead organic material in the environment.
explanation: Cell theory states that every cell comes from a pre-existing cell, not from non-living matter.
fact_tl: Ayon sa cell theory, lahat ng buhay na bagay ay binubuo ng isa o higit pang selula, at ang bawat selula ay nagmula sa dating selula.
fact_bis: Sumala sa cell theory, ang tanang buhi nga butang hinimo sa usa o daghan nga selula, ug ang matag selula naggikan sa naglungtad nang selula.

q: What does a rooster use the sharp spur on its leg for?
options: Fighting.
Digging for food in the soil.
Gripping branches when it roosts at night.
Attracting a mate during courtship.
explanation: A rooster has a sharp spur on each leg that it uses when it fights other roosters.
fact_tl: Ang tandang ay may matulis na tari sa bawat paa na ginagamit nito kapag lumalaban.
fact_bis: Ang sunoy adunay talinis nga tari sa matag tiil nga iyang gamiton kon makig-away.

q: If citizens have rights, what else do they have according to the idea of responsible citizenship?
options: Duties, like helping others and following laws, because rights and duties go together.
The freedom to ignore rules they personally disagree with.
Extra privileges that give them more power than non-citizens.
The right to demand services without contributing anything to their community.
explanation: Being a citizen means having both rights and duties — such as helping others and following laws — because receiving and giving go together.
fact_tl: Bilang mamamayan, may mga karapatan ka—pero may mga tungkulin ka rin, tulad ng pagtulong sa kapwa at pagsunod sa batas. Magkatuwang ang dalawa: hindi lang tumatanggap, nagbibigay din.
fact_bis: Isip lungsuranon, aduna kay mga katungod—apan aduna usab kay mga katungdanan, sama sa pagtabang sa isigkatawo ug pagsunod sa balaod. Magkuyog ang duha: dili ka lang modawat, mohatag usab ka.

q: What controls the changes an insect goes through during metamorphosis?
options: Hormones, which are body chemicals that signal when to change form.
The amount of sunlight the insect receives each day.
The temperature of the insect's environment.
The type of food the insect eats during its larva stage.
explanation: Metamorphosis is controlled by hormones — the body chemicals that signal when an insect should change form.
fact_tl: Ang metamorphosis ay kinokontrol ng mga hormone, na siyang mga kemikal sa katawan na nagsasabi kung kailan magbabago ang insekto.
fact_bis: Ang metamorphosis gikontrol sa mga hormone, ang mga kemikal sa lawas nga nagsulti kanus-a kinahanglan mag-usab og porma ang insekto.

q: How does seagrass help fight global warming?
options: It takes in and stores carbon in the mud.
It produces large amounts of oxygen that cool the ocean.
It reflects sunlight away from the ocean surface.
It filters warm water back into cold deep-sea currents.
explanation: Seagrass takes in carbon and stores it in the mud, reducing the amount of carbon in the atmosphere and helping fight global warming.
fact_tl: Kumukuha at nag-iipon ng karbon ang damong-dagat sa putik, na tumutulong labanan ang init ng mundo.
fact_bis: Ang sagbot sa dagat nagkuha ug nagtipig og karbon sa lapok, nga makatabang batok sa kainit sa kalibutan.

q: Why does a plant wilt when it loses too much water?
options: The vacuole empties, water pressure against the cell wall drops, and the plant loses its firmness.
The chloroplasts stop making food, so the plant runs out of energy to stay upright.
The cell membrane dissolves, causing the plant's stem to collapse.
The roots pull the plant downward when they dry out and shrink.
explanation: When the central vacuole loses water, the pressure it pushes against the cell wall drops, and without that pressure the plant wilts.
fact_tl: Kapag puno ng tubig ang central vacuole ng halaman, ang presyon nito laban sa cell wall ay nagpapanatiling matibay ang halaman — kapag mawala ang tubig, ang presyong ito ay bumababa at naglalanta ang halaman.
fact_bis: Sa dihang puno sa tubig ang central vacuole sa selula sa tanom, ang presyon niini batok sa cell wall nagpanatiling lig-on ang tanom — sa dihang nawala ang tubig, kining presyon moubos ug malaya ang tanom.

q: What can happen to a plant if you give it too much water?
options: Its roots can drown and rot.
Its leaves will grow too large and fall off.
It will grow too fast and become too tall.
It will stop flowering and making seeds.
explanation: Too much water can drown and rot the plant's roots, even though many people think more water is always better for plants.
fact_tl: May nag-aakalang mas maraming tubig ay mas mabuti, pero mali ito. Kapag sobra ang tubig, nalulunod at nabubulok ang ugat ng gulay — tamang dami lang ang kailangan.
fact_bis: Adunay naghunahuna nga mas daghang tubig mas maayo, apan sayop kana. Kon sobra ang tubig, malumos ug madunot ang gamot sa utanon — ang husto lang nga gidaghanon ang gikinahanglan.

q: Where was the wheel first invented, about 5,500 years ago?
options: Mesopotamia, in the area of modern Iraq.
Ancient Egypt, along the Nile River.
Ancient China, along the Yellow River.
Ancient India, in the Indus Valley.
explanation: The wheel was first used in Mesopotamia (modern Iraq) about 5,500 years ago to reduce friction in transportation.
fact_tl: Ang gulong ay isa sa mga pinakamahalagang imbensyon ng tao — ayon sa kasaysayan, ito ay unang ginamit sa Mesopotamia (ngayon ay Iraq) mga 5,500 taon na ang nakakaraan.
fact_bis: Ang gulong usa sa pinaka-importanteng mga imbensyon sa katawhan — kini unang gigamit sa Mesopotamia (modernong Iraq) mga 5,500 ka tuig na ang miagi aron mapababa ang kiskisan sa transportasyon.

q: In science, what unit is used to measure weight?
options: Newton.
Kilogram.
Gram.
Pound.
explanation: Because weight is a force, scientists measure it in newtons, not kilograms (which measure mass).
fact_tl: Dahil ang timbang ay isang puwersa, sinusukat ito ng mga siyentipiko sa yunit na tinatawag na newton.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang gibug-aton usa ka puwersa, ang mga siyentista magsukod niini sa yunit nga gitawag og newton.

q: What does a healthy watershed do for the communities below it?
options: It captures rainwater, provides clean water to rivers, and helps prevent flooding.
It creates strong winds that bring more rain to the lowlands.
It filters seawater into freshwater using tree roots.
It stores heat from the sun and keeps nearby towns warm.
explanation: A healthy watershed captures and stores rainwater in forests and hills, supplying clean water to rivers below and preventing flooding.
fact_tl: Ang watershed ay isang lugar ng kagubatan at bundok na kumukuha at nagtatago ng tubig ng ulan — ang malusog na watershed ay nagbibigay ng malinis na tubig sa mga ilog at nagpipigil ng baha sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang watershed usa ka lugar sa kagubatan ug mga bukid nga nagkuha ug nagimbak sa tubig sa ulan — ang usa ka maayo nga watershed naghatag sa limpyo nga tubig sa mga suba sa ilawom ug nagpugong sa baha.

q: In the deep sea where sunlight cannot reach, how do some bacteria make their food?
options: They use chemicals from the water instead of sunlight — a process called chemosynthesis.
They absorb nutrients that sink down from plants living at the surface.
They use heat from underwater volcanoes to perform a special kind of photosynthesis.
They feed on dead animals that fall to the ocean floor.
explanation: Deep-sea bacteria perform chemosynthesis, making food from chemicals rather than sunlight, unlike the photosynthesis plants use at the surface.
fact_tl: Sa ibabaw, gumagawa ang mga halaman ng pagkain mula sa liwanag ng araw, ngunit sa kailaliman ay may mga bakteryang gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa kemikal — ito ang tinatawag na chemosynthesis.
fact_bis: Sa ibabaw, ang mga tanom naghimo og pagkaon gikan sa silaw sa adlaw, apan sa kalaliman adunay mga bakterya nga naghimo og pagkaon gikan sa kemikal — kini gitawag og chemosynthesis.

q: What is the main reason the Northern and Southern Hemispheres have opposite seasons?
options: Earth's axis always points in the same direction, so each hemisphere tilts toward or away from the Sun at different times of year.
Earth moves closer to the Sun in summer and farther away in winter.
The clouds are thicker in one hemisphere, blocking more sunlight during winter.
Earth spins faster in summer, making days longer and warmer.
explanation: Earth's axis points in a constant direction throughout its orbit, causing each hemisphere to tilt toward or away from the Sun at different times — this is what creates opposite seasons, not changes in distance from the Sun.
fact_tl: Ang axis ng Earth ay nakatungo sa parehong direksyon habang ito ay umiikot sa paligid ng Araw — ang hilagang polo ay halos palaging nakatungo sa Polaris. Ito ang nagdudulot ng magkaibang season sa dalawang hemisphere — hindi pagbabago ng distansya ng Earth sa Araw.
fact_bis: Ang axis sa Yuta nagatudlo sa samang direksyon sa tibuok iyang orbit sa palibot sa Adlaw — ang amihanan nga poste hapit pirmi nagatudlo ngadto sa Polaris. Kining padayon nga tilt mao ang nagmugna og magkaatbang nga season sa duha ka hemisphere — dili pagbabag-o sa distansya sa Yuta gikan sa Adlaw.

q: Which of the following is found in a plant cell but NOT in an animal cell?
options: A cell wall and chloroplasts.
A nucleus and cell membrane.
Cytoplasm and genetic material.
A cell membrane and mitochondria.
explanation: Plant cells have a cell wall (a stiff outer layer) and chloroplasts for photosynthesis, structures that animal cells do not have.
fact_tl: Parehong may nucleus (sentro na nagkokontrol), cell membrane, at cytoplasm ang plant at animal cell. Pero ang plant cell ay may dagdag na cell wall (matigas na panlabas na balat) at chloroplasts (para sa photosynthesis) na wala sa animal cell.
fact_bis: Parehong adunay nucleus (sentro nga nagkontrol), cell membrane, ug cytoplasm ang plant ug animal cell. Apan ang plant cell adunay dugang nga cell wall (gahi nga panggawas nga panit) ug chloroplasts (alang sa photosynthesis) nga wala sa animal cell.

q: After which scientist is the unit of electrical resistance named?
options: Georg Ohm.
Isaac Newton.
Alessandro Volta.
Andre-Marie Ampere.
explanation: The unit 'ohm,' which measures electrical resistance, is named after the scientist Georg Ohm.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na 'ohm', na sukatan ng resistensya, ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm.
fact_bis: Ang unit nga 'ohm', ang sukod sa resistensya sa kuryente, ginganlan sunod kang Georg Ohm.

q: What is the difference between blood clotting and the immune system?
options: Clotting seals the wound shut, while the immune system fights germs that got inside.
Clotting fights germs, while the immune system repairs damaged tissue.
Clotting creates new blood cells, while the immune system removes old ones.
Clotting delivers oxygen, while the immune system produces platelets.
explanation: Blood clotting seals a wound to stop bleeding, while the immune system is a separate defense that fights germs that entered the body.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang pamumuo ng dugo at ang immune system, pero parehong nagpoprotekta sa katawan. Ang clotting ang nagsasara ng sugat, samantalang ang immune system naman ang lumalaban sa mikrobyong nakapasok.
fact_bis: Lahi ang pagmuo sa dugo ug ang immune system, apan parehas silang nanalipod sa lawas. Ang pagmuo mosira sa samad, samtang ang immune system makig-away sa mga mikrobyo nga nakasulod.

q: Why does a needle poke through skin more easily than pressing with your finger?
options: The needle's tiny tip concentrates force on a much smaller area, creating greater pressure.
The needle is heavier, so it pushes down with more force than a finger.
The needle is made of metal, which is naturally sharper than skin.
The needle moves faster, so it has more energy to break through the skin.
explanation: Pressure is force per area — a needle's very small tip means the same force is concentrated on a tiny area, producing much greater pressure than a wide fingertip.
fact_tl: Ang pressure ay ang force na nakatuon sa isang lugar (force kada area). Mas matalas na bagay = mas maliit na area = mas malakas na pressure, kaya tumutusok ang karayom. Ang malapad na area (tulad ng snowshoes o gulong) ay nagbabawas ng pressure.
fact_bis: Ang pressure mao ang force nga gipunting sa usa ka dapit (force kada area). Mas talinis nga butang = mas gamay nga area = mas kusog nga pressure, mao nga motusok ang dagom. Ang lapad nga area (sama sa snowshoes o ligid) mokunhod sa pressure.

q: What does an inverter do in a solar power system?
options: It converts DC electricity from solar panels into AC electricity that home appliances use.
It stores extra electricity in batteries for use at night.
It boosts the voltage so electricity travels farther through wires.
It measures how much electricity the solar panels are producing.
explanation: An inverter converts DC from solar panels or batteries into AC that home appliances use, making it an essential part of every solar power system.
fact_tl: Ang inverter ay nagco-convert ng DC mula sa mga solar panel o baterya patungong AC na ginagamit ng mga appliance sa bahay — ito ay isang mahalagang bahagi ng lahat ng solar power system.
fact_bis: Ang inverter nagconvert sa DC gikan sa mga solar panel o baterya ngadto sa AC nga gigamit sa mga appliance sa balay — kini usa ka importanteng parte sa tanan nga solar power system.

q: Why do stars appear to twinkle when we look at them from Earth?
options: Their light bends as it passes through the moving air of the atmosphere.
The stars themselves briefly brighten and dim as they burn fuel.
Our eyes blink rapidly, creating the illusion of flickering light.
Clouds pass in front of the stars, briefly blocking their light.
explanation: Stars twinkle because their light is bent by the constantly moving air in Earth's atmosphere, not because the stars themselves are changing.
fact_tl: Kumikislap ang mga bituin dahil ang kanilang liwanag ay yumuyuko habang dumadaan sa gumagalaw na hangin ng atmospera, hindi dahil nagbabago ang bituin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bituon mopangidlap kay ang ilang kahayag mobawog samtang moagi sa nagalihok nga hangin sa atmospera, dili kay nagbag-o ang bituon.

q: Why is it especially dangerous to disturb a wasp nest?
options: When one wasp stings, it releases a smell that signals other wasps to attack too.
Wasps build their nests from a poison that gets on your skin if you touch it.
A disturbed nest falls apart and releases thousands of wasp eggs that hatch immediately.
Wasps only sting when they are hungry, and a disturbed nest makes them hungry.
explanation: A wasp's sting releases a chemical alarm signal that calls other wasps to join the attack, so disturbing a nest can provoke many wasps at once.
fact_tl: Kapag nanaksak ang isang putakti, naglalabas ito ng espesyal na amoy na para bang hudyat na tumatawag sa iba pang putakti na lumaban din. Kaya delikadong galitin ang isang pugad: pwedeng dumami silang lumusob.
fact_bis: Kung manukol ang usa ka putyukan, mobuga kini ug espesyal nga baho nga murag senyales nga magtawag sa ubang putyukan nga mosulong sab. Mao nga delikado ang paghasi sa salag: daghan kanila ang mahimong moapil.

q: What role do bacteria play in wastewater treatment plants?
options: They break down organic waste and nutrients from sewage.
They filter out heavy metals and plastic particles from the water.
They add minerals back to the water to make it safe for drinking.
They produce ultraviolet light that kills harmful viruses in the sewage.
explanation: In wastewater treatment plants, bacteria do the main work of breaking down organic waste and nutrients from sewage, with aerobic bacteria using oxygen and anaerobic bacteria producing methane.
fact_tl: Sa mga water treatment plant, ang mga bacteria ang gumaganap ng pangunahing gawain ng pagtanggal ng organic na basura at nutrients mula sa sewage — ginagamit nila ang oxygen (aerobic bacteria) o gumagawa ng methane (anaerobic bacteria).
fact_bis: Sa mga water treatment plant, ang mga bakterya nagbuhat sa nag-unang trabaho sa pagbungkag sa organic nga basura ug mga sustansya gikan sa sewage — ang aerobic bacteria mogamit og oksiheno samtang ang anaerobic bacteria nagbuhat og methane.

q: How many pairs of antennae does a shrimp have compared to an insect?
options: A shrimp has two pairs; an insect has only one pair.
A shrimp has one pair; an insect has two pairs.
Both a shrimp and an insect have two pairs of antennae.
Both a shrimp and an insect have only one pair of antennae.
explanation: Unlike an insect, which has only one pair of antennae, a shrimp has two pairs, giving it more feeler-antennae than an insect.
fact_tl: Kakaiba sa insekto na may iisang pares lamang ng sungot, ang hipon ay may dalawang pares, kaya mas marami itong pandamang sungot kaysa sa insekto.
fact_bis: Lahi sa insekto nga adunay usa lang ka paris nga sungot, ang hipon adunay duha ka paris, busa mas daghan kini ug pangbati nga sungot kaysa insekto.

q: What happens to your heart rate when you run compared to when you walk?
options: Your heart beats faster when you run than when you walk.
Your heart beats at the same rate because the body adjusts to any activity.
Your heart beats slower when you run because your body becomes more efficient.
Your heart beats faster when you walk because walking takes longer to finish.
explanation: The harder the exercise, like running, the faster your heart beats compared to lighter activity like walking.
fact_tl: Kapag mas mahirap ang ehersisyo, gaya ng pagtakbo, mas mabilis pa tumibok ang iyong puso kaysa sa maglakad lang.
fact_bis: Kon mas lisod ang ehersisyo, sama sa pagdagan, mas paspas pa mopitik ang imong kasingkasing kaysa sa paglakaw lang.

q: Which statement about pufferfish is true?
options: There are many kinds of pufferfish around the world, with different sizes and colors.
There is only one species of pufferfish, found only in tropical oceans.
All pufferfish are exactly the same size but come in different colors.
Pufferfish are only found in the waters around the Philippines.
explanation: There are many kinds of pufferfish around the world, varying in size and color.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng butete sa buong mundo, na may iba't ibang laki at kulay.
fact_bis: Adunay daghang matang sa butete sa tibuok kalibutan, nga lainlain og gidak-on ug kolor.

q: Why are insects considered a key part of the food chain?
options: They are an important food source for many animals, including birds, frogs, lizards, and spiders.
They are the only animals that can break down dead leaves on the forest floor.
They produce oxygen through a process similar to photosynthesis in plants.
They are the top predators in most ecosystems, controlling all other animal populations.
explanation: Insects are eaten by many animals such as birds, frogs, lizards, and spiders, making them a key link in the food chain.
fact_tl: Ang mga insekto ay mahalagang pagkain ng maraming hayop tulad ng ibon, palaka, butiki, at gagamba, kaya bahagi sila ng food chain o kadena ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga insekto importante nga pagkaon sa daghang hayop sama sa langgam (bird), baki, tiki, ug lawalawa, mao nga bahin sila sa food chain o kadena sa pagkaon.

q: When can ducklings first swim?
options: Soon after they hatch from the egg.
Only after their adult feathers fully grow in, several weeks after hatching.
After their mother teaches them by pushing them into the water.
Once they are about three months old and strong enough.
explanation: Ducklings can swim soon after they hatch — they do not need to wait for adult feathers or learn from their mother.
fact_tl: Ang sisiw ng bibe ay kayang lumangoy kaagad pagkatapos mapisa mula sa itlog.
fact_bis: Ang piso sa bibe makahimo na molangoy dayon human mapusa gikan sa itlog.

q: Where in an electric animal's body is the electric shock produced?
options: In a special body part called an electric organ, packed with thousands of tiny stacked cells.
In the brain, which sends a powerful signal through the nerves to the skin.
In the tail, where special muscles contract rapidly to create electricity.
In the skin, which has a coating of electric chemicals that discharge on contact.
explanation: Electric animals have an electric organ packed with thousands of tiny cells stacked together like batteries, and that is where the shock is made.
fact_tl: May espesyal na bahagi ng katawan ang mga electric na hayop na tinatawag na electric organ. Dito ginagawa ang kuryente. Puno ito ng libu-libong maliliit na cell na nakasalansan na parang mga baterya sa loob ng flashlight.
fact_bis: Ang mga electric nga mananap adunay espesyal nga bahin sa lawas nga gitawag og electric organ diin gihimo ang kuryente. Puno kini sa liboan ka gagmayng cell nga gipatong-patong sama sa mga baterya sa sulod sa flashlight.

q: How is dengue spread in the Philippines?
options: Through the bite of the Aedes mosquito, which carries the dengue virus.
Through drinking water contaminated with the dengue virus.
By touching the skin of a person who already has dengue fever.
By eating food that has been exposed to the dengue virus.
explanation: In the Philippines, dengue is caused by a virus spread through the bite of the Aedes mosquito.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang dengue ay isang sakit na dulot ng virus na ikinakalat ng kagat ng lamok na Aedes.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang dengue usa ka sakit nga gipahinabo sa virus nga gikatap pinaagi sa paak sa lamok nga Aedes.

q: Which type of wave in the electromagnetic spectrum carries the LEAST energy?
options: Radio waves.
Visible light.
X-rays.
Ultraviolet rays.
explanation: Radio waves carry the lowest energy of all the waves in the electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamababang enerhiya sa electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_bis: Ang radio waves mao ang adunay pinakaubos nga enerhiya sa electromagnetic spectrum.

q: If your hands look clean, is it still necessary to wash them before eating?
options: Yes, because germs are too small to see and can still be on hands that look clean.
No, if there is no visible dirt there are no germs to worry about.
Only if you have been touching soil or animals, not just playing indoors.
Only if you feel sick; healthy children do not need to wash clean-looking hands.
explanation: Even hands that look clean can carry many germs that are invisible to the eye, so washing before eating is still important.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi mo nakikita ang dumi at parang malinis ang kamay mo, marami pa ring germ doon na hindi nakikita ng mata. Kaya kahit pagkatapos lang maglaro o humawak ng gamit, mahalaga pa ring maghugas bago kumain.
fact_bis: Bisan walay makita nga hugaw ug murag limpyo ang imong kamot, mahimong adunay daghang germ gihapon nga dili makita sa mata. Busa bisan human lang magdula o maghikap og butang, importante gihapon ang panghugas una mokaon.

q: What happens to a substance during a physical change?
options: Only its shape or form changes — it stays the same substance.
It turns into a completely new substance with different properties.
It loses some of its mass as energy is released.
Its color and smell change, showing that a new substance formed.
explanation: In a physical change, only the shape or form changes; the substance itself remains the same, unlike a chemical change.
fact_tl: Sa pisikal na pagbabago, nagbabago lang ang hugis o anyo ng bagay ngunit nananatili itong parehong sangkap.
fact_bis: Sa pisikal nga kausaban, ang porma lang sa butang ang mausab apan pareho gihapon kini nga substansiya.

q: How do the winds inside a typhoon move?
options: They spiral inward, turning as they move toward the eye at the center.
They blow outward from the eye, spreading in all directions.
They blow straight from one side to the other, like a wall of wind.
They rise straight up from the ocean surface into the clouds above.
explanation: A typhoon's winds spiral inward, turning as they move toward the eye at the center of the storm.
fact_tl: Ang mga hangin ng bagyo ay umiikot papasok patungo sa mata sa gitna nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga hangin sa bagyo naglikoliko padulong sa sulod, paingon sa mata nga anaa sa sentro niini.

q: What is 'candling' used for when checking chicken eggs?
options: Shining a light behind an egg to see whether a chick is growing inside.
Warming eggs with a candle flame to speed up hatching.
Checking the color of an egg's shell to tell how old it is.
Counting how many eggs a hen has laid in a single day.
explanation: Candling means shining a light behind an egg so people can see whether a chick is developing inside.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng pagsindi ng ilaw sa likod ng itlog, makikita kung may lumalaking sisiw sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pagsuga sa likod sa itlog, makita kung adunay nagatubo nga piso sa sulod niini.

q: Which stage is present in a butterfly's life cycle but NOT in a grasshopper's?
options: The pupal stage.
The egg stage.
The adult stage.
The nymph stage.
explanation: Grasshoppers go through incomplete metamorphosis with only egg, nymph, and adult stages — there is no pupal stage, unlike butterflies which have complete metamorphosis.
fact_tl: Ang tipaklong ay dumadaan sa incomplete metamorphosis na may tatlong yugto lamang: itlog, nymph (katulad ng maliit na adult ngunit walang pakpak), at adult — walang pupa stage tulad ng sa mariposa.
fact_bis: Ang mga tipaklong moagi sa incomplete metamorphosis nga adunay tulo lamang ka yugto: itlog, nymph (sama sa gamay nga adult apan walay pakpak), ug adult — wala'y pupal stage sama sa mga mariposa.

q: Which layer of the Philippine tropical rainforest is made up of the very tallest trees that rise above all others?
options: The emergent layer.
The canopy layer.
The understory layer.
The forest floor layer.
explanation: The emergent layer consists of the tallest trees that poke above the canopy, which serves as the main forest roof below them.
fact_tl: Ang tropical rainforest ng Pilipinas ay may iba't ibang patong: ang emergent layer (pinakamataas na puno), ang canopy (bubong ng kagubatan), ang understory, at ang forest floor.
fact_bis: Ang tropical rainforest sa Pilipinas adunay lain-laing patong: ang emergent layer (pinakataas nga mga kahoy), ang canopy (atop sa kagubatan), ang understory, ug ang forest floor.

q: How do TV and phone screens produce different colors?
options: Each pixel has three tiny sub-pixels in red, green, and blue, and adjusting their brightness creates any color.
Each pixel contains a small prism that splits white light into the color needed.
The screen is coated with different colored dyes that light up when electricity passes through.
A computer inside the screen mixes paint-like liquids to produce each color as needed.
explanation: TV and phone screens make colors by adjusting the brightness of red, green, and blue sub-pixels in each of their millions of tiny pixels.
fact_tl: Ang mga screen ng TV at cellphone ay gawa sa milyun-milyong maliit na pixel — ang bawat pixel ay may tatlong sub-pixel na pula, berde, at asul. Sa pamamagitan ng pag-adjust ng liwanag ng bawat sub-pixel, anumang kulay ay maaaring makuha.
fact_bis: Ang mga screen sa TV ug cellphone naghimo sa milyon-milyong gagmay nga pixel — ang matag pixel adunay tulo ka sub-pixel sa pula, berde, ug asul. Pinaagi sa pag-adjust sa hayag sa matag sub-pixel, bisan unsang kulay mahimo.

q: What causes water to be 'hard'?
options: Dissolved calcium and magnesium picked up as water flows over rocks.
Tiny pieces of sand and clay stirred up from the riverbed.
Salt left behind when seawater mixes into freshwater streams.
Bacteria that grow in standing water and release minerals.
explanation: Water hardness is caused by dissolved calcium and magnesium ions that water picks up as it flows over rocks; hard water causes soap scum and scale in pipes.
fact_tl: Ang hardness ng tubig ay sanhi ng dissolved na calcium at magnesium ions mula sa mga bato na tinunaw ng tubig — ang hard water ay nagdudulot ng soap scum at nagtatayo ng calcium scale sa loob ng mga tubo.
fact_bis: Ang katig-a sa tubig sanhi sa natunaw nga calcium ug magnesium ions nga nakuha samtang ang tubig moagos sa ibabaw sa mga bato; ang hard water nagdulot og soap scum ug calcium scale deposits sa mga tubo ug appliances.

q: What drives the 'great ocean conveyor belt' that moves water around all of Earth's oceans?
options: Differences in water temperature and saltiness (salinity).
The gravitational pull of the Moon causing global tides.
Strong winds blowing across the ocean surface in one direction.
The spinning of the Earth pushing water toward the poles.
explanation: Thermohaline circulation is driven by differences in water temperature and salinity, creating a global conveyor belt that distributes heat and nutrients around the world's oceans.
fact_tl: Ang thermohaline circulation — tinatawag na 'great ocean conveyor belt' — ay isang pandaigdigang sistema ng mga agos ng tubig na pinalakas ng pagkakaiba ng temperatura at alat ng tubig, na nagdadala ng init at sustansya sa buong karagatan at nakakaapekto sa klima ng mundo.
fact_bis: Ang thermohaline circulation — gitawag og 'great ocean conveyor belt' — usa ka global nga sistema sa mga agos sa tubig nga gipaandar sa mga kalainan sa temperatura ug alat sa tubig, nagpaabot og kainit ug mga sustansya sa tibuok mga dagat sa kalibutan ug nagapekto sa global nga klima.

q: Which vitamin helps keep your vision working well, especially at night?
options: Vitamin A, found in carrots, squash, and leafy greens.
Vitamin C, found in citrus fruits like oranges and lemons.
Vitamin D, made by the skin when exposed to sunlight.
Vitamin B12, found in meat, eggs, and dairy products.
explanation: The eyes need vitamin A, found in foods like carrots, squash, and leafy greens, to keep vision working well especially in low light.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng mata ang bitamina A, na makukuha sa mga pagkaing gaya ng karot, kalabasa, at madahong gulay, para gumana nang maayos ang paningin lalo na sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang mata nagkinahanglan og bitamina A, nga makuha sa mga pagkaon sama sa karot, kalabasa, ug dahonong utanon, aron molihok og maayo ang panan-aw ilabi na sa gabii.

q: How do deadly germs most commonly spread from person to person?
options: Through dirty hands, contaminated water, and food.
Through breathing the same air as a sick person in an open outdoor space.
Through touching the clothes or hair of a person who is ill.
Through insect bites from flies that land on healthy and sick people equally.
explanation: Deadly germs spread through dirty hands, contaminated water, and food, which is why cleanliness and handwashing matter so much.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang mga mikrobyong nakamamatay sa pamamagitan ng maruming kamay, kontaminadong tubig, at kainan, kaya mahalaga ang kalinisan.
fact_bis: Mokaylap ang makamatay nga mga mikrobyo pinaagi sa hugaw nga kamot, kontaminadong tubig, ug pagkaon, mao nga importante kaayo ang kalimpyo.

q: Why do pine trees in Baguio have thin, needle-shaped leaves instead of flat, wide leaves?
options: Their thin shape helps them save water in cold places.
Their sharp points protect the tree from animals that want to eat them.
Their thin shape lets more sunlight reach the lower branches.
Their needle shape helps them catch more rainfall than flat leaves would.
explanation: Pine needles are still leaves, but their thin shape reduces water loss, helping the tree survive in cold environments like Baguio.
fact_tl: Ang mga pino sa Baguio ay may manipis at matulis na dahon na parang karayom. Kahit hindi sila mukhang ordinaryong dahon, dahon pa rin sila! Ang manipis nilang hugis ay tumutulong sa kanila na makatipid ng tubig sa malamig na lugar.
fact_bis: Ang mga pino sa Baguio adunay nipis ug talinis nga dahon nga sama sa dagom. Bisan og dili sila morag ordinaryong dahon, dahon gihapon sila! Ang ilang nipis nga porma motabang nila sa pagtipig og tubig sa bugnaw nga lugar.

q: What is boiling?
options: Very fast evaporation that happens when water reaches 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
The process of water slowly turning into vapor over many hours at room temperature.
The change that happens when water cools down and turns into ice.
Water absorbing salt and other minerals as it is heated on a stove.
explanation: Boiling is very fast evaporation that occurs when water reaches 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
fact_tl: Ang pagkulo ay mabilis na pagsingaw na nangyayari kapag umabot ang tubig sa 100 degrees Celsius sa karaniwang antas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang pagbukal mao ang paspas nga pag-alisngaw nga mahitabo kung moabot ang tubig sa 100 degrees Celsius sa lebel sa dagat.

q: Why does the Sun look so much bigger than other stars in the sky?
options: Because the Sun is the closest star to Earth, not because it is the biggest.
Because the Sun is thousands of times bigger than any other star in the universe.
Because the Sun spins faster than other stars, making it appear larger.
Because the Sun's light is brighter, which makes it look bigger than it really is.
explanation: The Sun only seems huge because it is the closest star to us; in reality it is an average, ordinary star, and many stars are far bigger.
fact_tl: Madalas isipin na ang Araw ang pinakamalaking bituin, pero hindi pala! Marami pang bituin sa kalawakan na mas malaki pa nang libo-libong beses. Malaki lang ang Araw para sa atin dahil ito ang pinakamalapit. Sa katotohanan, isa lang itong karaniwang bituin.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga ang Adlaw mao ang kinadak-ang bitoon, apan dili diay! Daghan pa nga bitoon sa kawanangan nga mas dako og liboan ka pilo. Dako ra ang Adlaw alang kanato kay kini ang labing duol. Sa tinuod, ordinaryo ra kini nga bitoon.

q: Besides grass, what else can a carabao eat?
options: Banana leaves, stalks, and other soft, leafy plants.
Small fish and frogs found near rice paddies.
Fruit that has fallen from trees on the farm.
Grain and seeds stored in the farmhouse.
explanation: Besides grass, a carabao can eat banana leaves, stalks, and other soft, leafy plants found on the farm.
fact_tl: Bukod sa damo, kayang kainin ng kalabaw ang mga dahon at puno ng saging at iba pang malalambot na halaman sa bukid.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kumpay, kaya kaonon sa kalabaw ang mga dahon ug punoan sa saging ug uban pang humok nga mga tanom sa uma.

q: How can a person catch rabies from an infected animal?
options: The infected animal's saliva must get into a wound or bite — not just petting its fur.
By standing near the infected animal and breathing the same air.
By touching the animal's fur or skin, even without being bitten.
By drinking milk or touching the sweat of an infected animal.
explanation: You cannot catch rabies just by petting a healthy animal's fur; the saliva of an infected animal must enter a wound or bite for transmission to occur.
fact_tl: Hindi nakukuha ang rabies sa simpleng paghaplos sa balahibo ng malusog na hayop, o sa pagtabi rito. Kailangang makapasok ang laway ng hayop na may sakit sa sugat o kagat. Ang gatas o pawis ay hindi nagdadala ng virus.
fact_bis: Dili makuha ang rabies sa yano nga paghapuhap sa balhibo sa himsog nga hayop, o sa pagduol niini. Kinahanglan makasulod ang laway sa hayop nga may sakit sa samad o paak. Ang gatas o singot dili magdala sa bayrus.

q: How many protons does a gold (Au) atom have?
options: 47 protons
79 protons
118 protons
32 protons
explanation: Gold has an atomic number of 79, which means every gold atom contains exactly 79 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng gold (ginto, Au) ay 79, kaya may 79 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa gold (bulawan, Au) kay 79, mao nga naa kini 79 ka proton.

q: Why do we often feel cold and shiver at the very start of a fever, even though our body is already warm?
options: Our body loses all its heat very quickly at the start
Our body is trying to raise its temperature even higher, making us feel chilly
The thermometer is wrong and we are not really warm yet
Cold air from outside enters the body through our pores
explanation: At the beginning of a fever the body wants to reach an even higher temperature, so it makes us feel cold and shiver even though it is already warm.
fact_tl: Sa simula ng lagnat ay madalas tayong giginaw kahit mainit na ang katawan, dahil mas mataas pa ang gustong init ng katawan.
fact_bis: Sa sinugdanan sa hilanat kasagaran ginaw ta bisan init na ang lawas, tungod kay mas taas pa ang gusto nga init sa lawas.

q: Why is keeping their forest home quiet and free from disturbance one of the best ways to protect tamaraws?
options: Tamaraws are nocturnal and loud noises keep them awake during the day
Tamaraws are shy, solitary animals that are easily stressed by disturbance
Tamaraws have very poor eyesight and rely only on hearing to find food
Tamaraws are territorial and fight each other when they hear noise
explanation: Because the tamaraw is shy and solitary, disturbances in its forest home stress it greatly, so keeping that space quiet is a key protection measure.
fact_tl: Dahil mailap at nag-iisa ang tamaraw, ang isang paraan para protektahan ito ay panatilihing tahimik at hindi gulong-gulo ang gubat na tirahan nito.
fact_bis: Tungod kay mailap ug nag-inusara ang tamaraw, usa ka paagi sa pagpanalipod niini mao ang pagpabiling hilom ug dili sabaan ang lasang nga iyang puy-anan.

q: A city experiences a magnitude-7 earthquake but reports only minor damage. Which factor best explains why high magnitude does NOT always mean severe damage?
options: The Richter scale only measures how long the shaking lasts, not its strength
Damage also depends on depth, distance, and the type of ground and buildings
High-magnitude quakes always happen far out at sea where no one lives
Modern buildings automatically absorb all seismic energy above magnitude 6
explanation: The Richter number only tells an earthquake's strength; actual damage also depends on the earthquake's depth, distance from cities, and the kind of ground and buildings present.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang mataas na magnitude ay laging katumbas ng matinding pinsala. Ang Richter number ay nagsasabi lang ng lakas ng lindol, ngunit ang aktuwal na pinsala ay nakadepende rin sa lalim, layo, at uri ng lupa at gusali sa isang lugar.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga ang taas nga magnitude kanunay nagpasabot og grabe nga kadaot. Ang Richter number nagsulti lang sa kusog sa linog, apan ang tinuod nga kadaot nag-agad usab sa giladmon, gilay-on, ug matang sa yuta ug mga building sa usa ka dapit.

q: How does a lava tube cave form?
options: Lava dissolves the rock beneath it and leaves an empty space
The outer lava hardens while molten lava keeps flowing inside; when flow stops, an empty tube remains
Exploding gas bubbles inside lava create a long hollow channel
Rainwater washes lava away and carves a tube underground
explanation: A lava tube forms when the outer layer of lava cools and hardens first while hot lava continues flowing inside; once the flow stops, the empty tube remains as an underground cave.
fact_tl: Ang lava tube ay isang natural na tubo na nabubuo kapag ang panlabas na lava ay lumamig at tumigas habang ang molten lava ay patuloy na dumadaloy sa loob; kapag tumigil ang pagdaloy, ang tubo ay nananatili bilang isang underground na cave.
fact_bis: Ang lava tube usa ka natural nga tubo nga naporma kon ang panlabas nga layer sa lava nagbugnaw ug nagpatig-a samtang ang molten lava nagpadayon sa pag-agos sulod; kon mihunong ang pag-agos, ang tubo nagpabilin ingon nga underground nga kuweba.

q: What is the most direct way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases like dengue?
options: Wear heavy clothing even inside the house at all times
Remove standing water where mosquitoes lay their eggs
Spray the insides of all houses with salt water every week
Plant thorny bushes around homes to keep mosquitoes away
explanation: Mosquitoes lay their eggs in standing water, so removing those water sources stops them from breeding and spreading disease.
fact_tl: Para maiwasan ang mga sakit na dala ng lamok, dapat alisin ang nakatigil na tubig kung saan nangingitlog ang mga lamok.
fact_bis: Aron malikayan ang mga sakit nga gidala sa lamok, kinahanglan natong kuhaon ang nagtindog nga tubig diin mangitlog ang mga lamok.

q: Which surprising fact is true about a bird's skeleton?
options: A bird's bones are solid and dense so they can support heavy muscles for flying
A bird's whole skeleton can weigh less than all its feathers put together
A bird's bones are hollow but still make up more than half of its total body weight
Birds have more bones than most mammals because flying needs extra joints
explanation: Thanks to hollow and fused bones, a bird's entire skeleton is sometimes lighter than all its feathers combined.
fact_tl: Nakakagulat, ang buong kalansay ng ibon ay napakagaan—minsan mas magaan pa kaysa lahat ng balahibo nito! Ito ang malaking tulong ng mga guwang at pinagdugtong na buto.
fact_bis: Makapakurat, ang tibuok kalansay sa langgam grabe ka gaan—usahay mas gaan pa kaysa tanang balhibo niini! Tungod ni sa hawan ug gisumpay nga mga buto.

q: How far can a colugo travel in a single glide between trees?
options: About 10 meters in one glide
More than 100 meters in one glide
Around 50 meters if the wind helps
Up to 30 meters on a downhill slope
explanation: A colugo can glide more than 100 meters between trees in just one single glide.
fact_tl: Ang kagwang ay kayang gumliding nang higit sa 100 metro sa pagitan ng mga puno sa isang glide lamang.
fact_bis: Ang kagwang makahimo og glide nga sobra sa 100 ka metro tali sa mga kahoy sa usa lang ka glide.

q: What is the correct chemical symbol for the metal aluminum?
options: Au
Am
Al
An
explanation: The chemical symbol for aluminum is Al, taken from its name.
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng aluminum (aluminyo) ay Al.
fact_bis: Ang simbolong kemikal sa aluminum (aluminyo) kay Al.

q: How does water help protect your knees and elbows when you move?
options: Water makes bones harder so they do not chip when they touch each other
Water acts like a cushion between bones in the joints, letting them slide smoothly without pain
Water keeps muscles warm so joints stay flexible in cold weather
Water fills tiny holes in the bones and prevents them from cracking
explanation: Water between your joints acts like a lubricating cushion that lets the bones slide smoothly and protects them from painful friction.
fact_tl: May tubig din sa pagitan ng iyong mga buto sa kasukasuan na parang langis na nagpapadulas at nagpoprotekta sa kanila. Tumutulong ito para makagalaw ka nang maayos nang hindi masakit ang iyong mga tuhod o siko. Kaya't ang sapat na tubig ay mabuti rin para sa iyong paggalaw.
fact_bis: Adunay tubig usab sa tunga sa imong mga bukog sa lutahan, sama sa lana nga maghimo nila nga modalin-as ug manalipod kanila. Motabang kini aron makalihok ka og maayo nga dili masakit ang imong tuhod o siko. Busa ang igong tubig maayo usab alang sa imong paglihok.

q: In an ocean energy pyramid, which organisms form the very base and are most numerous?
options: Sharks, because they eat everything below them
Tiny plankton, because they are very many and make the food for all others
Large fish, because they store the most energy
Seaweed on the ocean floor, because it gets the most sunlight
explanation: In the ocean energy pyramid, tiny plankton form the base and are extremely numerous, while top predators like sharks are few.
fact_tl: Sa dagat, ang maliliit na plankton ang nasa ibaba ng pyramid at napakarami nila, habang ang mga pating sa tuktok ay kakaunti lang.
fact_bis: Sa dagat, ang gagmayng plankton maoy ubos sa pyramid ug daghan kaayo, samtang ang mga iho sa tumoy diyutay ra.

q: Approximately how big can a giant cloud rat get?
options: About 500 grams and 10 to 15 centimeters long
More than 2 kilograms and 30 to 50 centimeters long
Exactly 1 kilogram and about 20 centimeters long
Up to 5 kilograms and over 80 centimeters long
explanation: A giant cloud rat can weigh more than 2 kilograms and have a body length of 30 to 50 centimeters.
fact_tl: Ang giant cloud rat ay maaaring tumimbang ng mahigit 2 kilo at may katawang 30 hanggang 50 sentimetro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang giant cloud rat mahimong motimbang ug kapin sa 2 ka kilo ug ang lawas niini 30 ngadto sa 50 sentimetros ang gitas-on.

q: Why do we always see lightning before we hear thunder, even though both come from the same bolt?
options: Thunder is created a few seconds after lightning, so sound must travel the extra time
Light travels faster than sound, so the flash reaches our eyes before the sound reaches our ears
Our ears are less sensitive than our eyes so they react more slowly
Lightning produces light, but thunder comes from a separate cloud above it
explanation: Light travels much faster than sound, so the flash from the lightning channel reaches our eyes well before the thunder sound arrives at our ears.
fact_tl: Una nating nakikita ang maliwanag at mainit na kidlat bago natin marinig ang kulog. Iyon ay dahil mas mabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog—pero pareho silang nanggaling sa parehong sobrang init na daanan ng kidlat.
fact_bis: Una nato makita ang hayag ug init nga kilat sa dili pa nato madungog ang dalugdog. Kana tungod kay mas paspas ang kahayag kaysa tingog—apan parehong gikan sa samang init kaayo nga agianan sa kilat.

q: At the Pulilan Carabao Festival in Bulacan, what special thing do the carabaos do?
options: They race along the main street while riders guide them
They kneel down as a sign of thanks
They are bathed in the river as a blessing ceremony
They are decorated with flowers and paraded around the town plaza
explanation: At the Pulilan Carabao Festival in Bulacan, carabaos kneel as a sign of thanks, honoring these hardworking animals.
fact_tl: Pinararangalan ang kalabaw sa Pulilan Carabao Festival sa Bulacan kung saan nagluluhod ang mga kalabaw bilang pasasalamat.
fact_bis: Gipasidunggan ang kalabaw sa Pulilan Carabao Festival sa Bulacan diin moluhod ang mga kalabaw isip pasalamat.

q: What makes a mixture different from a chemical compound when it comes to the amounts of its parts?
options: A mixture always has a fixed and exact ratio of ingredients, just like a compound
A mixture has no fixed ratio, so you can add more or less of each ingredient
A mixture can only be made of two substances, while a compound can have many
A mixture separates on its own after a few minutes, but a compound never does
explanation: Unlike a compound, a mixture has no fixed ratio, which is why you can add a little or a lot of salt to your soup.
fact_tl: Walang tiyak na proporsyon ang isang mixture, kaya pwede kang maglagay ng kaunti o maraming asin sa iyong sabaw.
fact_bis: Ang mixture walay piho nga sukod, mao nga makabutang ka og gamay o daghang asin sa imong sabaw.

q: What does a tabon chick do right after it hatches from its egg inside a mound?
options: It waits inside the mound for its mother to dig it out and feed it
It digs its way out of the mound by itself and then lives on its own
It calls loudly so both parents can hear it and lead it to food
It rests inside the mound for several days before it is strong enough to leave
explanation: After hatching, a tabon chick digs itself out of the mound without any help from its parents and immediately lives independently.
fact_tl: Pagkapisa, ang sisiw ng tabon ay humuhukay palabas sa bunton at nabubuhay nang mag-isa nang walang tulong ng magulang.
fact_bis: Human mapusa, ang piso sa tabon nagakalot pagawas sa tambak ug nabuhi nga mag-inusara nga walay tabang sa ginikanan.

q: What is Apo Reef's ranking among the world's contiguous coral reefs?
options: It is the largest contiguous coral reef in the world
It is the second largest contiguous coral reef in the world, after the Great Barrier Reef
It is the third largest contiguous coral reef, after those in Australia and Indonesia
It is the largest coral reef in Asia but ranks fifth in the world
