explanation: Apo Reef is the second largest contiguous coral reef in the world, surpassed only by Australia's Great Barrier Reef.
fact_tl: Ang Apo Reef ang ikalawang pinakamalaking magkadugtong na bahura ng korales sa mundo, kasunod ng Great Barrier Reef.
fact_bis: Ang Apo Reef mao ang ikaduhang pinakadako nga magkadugtong nga bahura sa korales sa kalibotan, sunod sa Great Barrier Reef.

q: How do the mantis shrimp's eyes help it catch prey?
options: Its eyes glow in the dark so it can hunt at night without any light
Its excellent eyes help it aim its lightning-fast punch accurately at its prey
Its eyes can see through rocks and sand to spot hidden animals
Its eyes are so large they scare prey into freezing in place
explanation: The mantis shrimp's excellent eyes allow it to aim its extremely fast punch with great accuracy when attacking prey.
fact_tl: Ang mahusay na mga mata ng mantis shrimp ay tumutulong dito para tumpak na ipuntirya ang mabilis nitong suntok sa biktima.
fact_bis: Ang maayo nga mga mata sa mantis shrimp motabang niini sa tukma nga pagpuntirya sa paspas niini nga sumbag sa tukbonon.

q: Where is almost all of an atom's mass concentrated?
options: In the electrons, because they move very fast and carry kinetic energy
In the nucleus at the center, where the protons and neutrons are packed together
Evenly spread through the whole atom, including the empty space around it
In the outer electron shell, because it is the largest part of the atom
explanation: The nucleus is the dense center of the atom where protons and neutrons are found, and almost all of the atom's mass is located there.
fact_tl: Ang nucleus ay ang siksik at mabigat na gitna ng atomo kung saan magkasamang naroon ang mga proton at neutron; dito nakatago ang halos buong bigat ng atomo.
fact_bis: Ang nucleus mao ang siksik ug bug-at nga tunga sa atomo diin nagkahiusa ang mga proton ug neutron; dinhi nahimutang ang halos tibuok gibug-aton sa atomo.

q: What color flame does calcium (Ca) produce in a flame test?
options: Violet or purple
Orange or brick-red
Bright yellow
Lilac or pale pink
explanation: In a flame test, calcium produces an orange (brick-red) flame color that identifies it from other elements.
fact_tl: Sa flame test, ang calcium (Ca) ay nagbibigay ng KAHEL o orange (brick-red) na kulay sa apoy.
fact_bis: Sa flame test, ang calcium (Ca) mohatag ug KAHEL o orange (brick-red) nga kolor sa kalayo.

q: A volcanic eruption throws out rock pieces that are 30 mm across. What type of tephra are these fragments classified as?
options: Volcanic ash, because they come directly from the eruption
Lapilli, because their size is between 2 mm and 64 mm
Volcanic bombs, because they were spinning while flying through the air
Volcanic blocks, because they are larger than 2 mm
explanation: Tephra between 2 mm and 64 mm in size is classified as lapilli; at 30 mm, these fragments fit that category.
fact_tl: Ang tephra ay ang lahat ng mga fragment na inilabas ng isang pagsabog ng bulkan; inuri ito ayon sa sukat: ang volcanic ash ay mas maliit pa sa 2 mm, ang lapilli ay 2-64 mm, at ang mga volcanic bomb at block ay mas malaki pa sa 64 mm (at ang mga bomb ay nag-iikot habang nag-aalpas sa hangin).
fact_bis: Ang tephra mao ang tanan nga mga fragment nga gibuhian sa usa ka pagsabog sa bulkan; giiklasipikar kini sa gidak-on: ang volcanic ash ubos sa 2 mm, ang lapilli 2-64 mm, ug ang mga volcanic bomb ug block labaw sa 64 mm (ug ang mga bomb naglibot samtang naglupad sa hangin).

q: How many pairs of legs does a centipede have on each body segment?
options: Two pairs of legs on each segment
One pair of legs on each segment
Three pairs of legs spread across every two segments
No legs on the first segment, two pairs on all the rest
explanation: A centipede has one pair of legs on each of its body segments, giving it many legs in total.
fact_tl: Ang alupihan (centipede) ay may mahabang katawan na hati sa mga segment, at may isang pares ng paa sa bawat segment. Mabilis itong mangangaso at gumagamit ng kamandag para hulihin ang maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang alupihan (centipede) adunay taas nga lawas nga nabahin sa mga segment, ug adunay usa ka paris nga tiil sa matag segment. Paspas kini nga mangangaso ug mogamit og hilo aron dakpon ang gagmayng hayop.

q: According to Newton, why do planets orbit the Sun instead of falling straight into it?
options: Planets spin fast enough to create their own gravity that pushes against the Sun
Planets are moving sideways very fast, so the Sun's inward pull curves their path into an orbit
The Sun and planets have opposite magnetic poles that keep them at a fixed distance
Other planets' gravity balances the Sun's pull and keeps each planet in a straight line
explanation: Newton showed that the Sun's gravity pulls planets inward, but because they are also moving fast sideways, they keep curving around in an orbit rather than falling in.
fact_tl: Ipinaliwanag ni Newton na ang grabidad ng Araw ang patuloy na humihila sa mga planeta papalapit, ngunit dahil sila ay mabilis na gumagalaw sa gilid, umiikot sila sa Araw sa halip na bumagsak dito.
fact_bis: Gipasabot ni Newton nga ang grabidad sa Adlaw padayong mobira sa mga planeta paduol, apan tungod kay paspas silang molihok sa kilid, molibot sila sa Adlaw imbis nga matagak niini.

q: How does a plant root know which direction to grow downward?
options: Root hairs feel moisture in the soil and always grow toward wetter areas
Tiny grains in the root tip sink due to gravity and signal the root to grow downward
The root grows away from light, so it always points in the opposite direction of the stem
Roots follow minerals in the soil, and most minerals sink to the lowest layers
explanation: Tiny starch grains inside the root tip sink because of gravity, and this signal tells the root to grow downward.
fact_tl: Ang dulo ng ugat ang nakakaramdam kung saan ang baba; may maliliit na butil sa loob nito na lumulubog dahil sa grabidad at nagtuturo sa ugat na tumubo pababa.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa gamot maoy makabati kung asa ang ubos; adunay gagmay nga butil sulod niini nga molugdang tungod sa grabidad ug magtudlo sa gamot nga motubo paubos.

q: What causes acne to form on the skin?
options: Eating too much chocolate or oily food directly blocks the pores from outside
The skin's pores get clogged with oil and dead skin cells
Bacteria from touching your face travel through the blood into the skin
Too much sunlight causes the pores to swell up and become infected
explanation: Acne forms when the skin's pores become clogged with oil and dead skin cells, leading to spots and blemishes.
fact_tl: Nagkakatagihawat kapag ang mga pores sa balat ay nababarahan ng langis at patay na selula ng balat.
fact_bis: Ang tagihawat motungha kung ang mga poro sa panit mabara sa lana ug patay nga selula sa panit.

q: How do cleaner fish and larger fish help each other in a mutualistic relationship?
options: Cleaner fish hide inside large fish to protect themselves, and the large fish get camouflage
Cleaner fish eat parasites and dead skin off large fish, so cleaners get food and large fish stay healthy
Cleaner fish lead large fish to schools of prey in exchange for leftover scraps
Cleaner fish share their territory with large fish so both groups avoid predators
explanation: Cleaner fish eat the parasites and dead skin off larger fish, giving the cleaner fish food while keeping the bigger fish clean and healthy — a mutualistic relationship.
fact_tl: Ang cleaner fish ay naglilinis ng mga parasito at patay na balat ng mas malalaking isda, kaya kumakain ito habang nananatiling malinis at malusog ang malaking isda.
fact_bis: Ang cleaner fish manglimpyo sa mga parasito ug patay nga panit sa mas dagkong isda, busa makakaon kini samtang ang dakong isda magpabiling limpyo ug himsog.

q: In what year did Robert Hooke publish his law of elasticity?
explanation: Robert Hooke published his law of elasticity in 1678, expressing it in Latin as 'ut tensio, sic vis'.
fact_tl: Inilathala ni Robert Hooke ang kanyang batas ng elastisidad noong 1678, sa Latin na 'ut tensio, sic vis'.
fact_bis: Gimantala ni Robert Hooke ang iyang balaod sa elasticity niadtong 1678, sa Latin nga 'ut tensio, sic vis'.

q: Why is our galaxy called the Milky Way?
options: Ancient astronomers believed the galaxy was made of frozen milk floating in space
In the night sky it looks like a faint whitish band, like spilled milk, from the glow of countless distant stars
The galaxy was first mapped by a scientist whose last name meant 'milk' in Latin
Its stars are all white or pale yellow, and together they look like a white milky cloud
explanation: The Milky Way got its name from how it looks in the sky — a faint whitish band like spilled milk, created by the combined glow of countless faraway stars.
fact_tl: Ang pangalang Milky Way ay nagmula sa hitsura nito sa langit — isang malabo at maputing guhit na para bang natapong gatas, dahil iyon ang sabay-sabay na liwanag ng napakaraming malalayong bituin.
fact_bis: Ang ngalan nga Milky Way naggikan sa panagway niini sa langit — usa ka hanap ug maputi nga guhit nga morag nayabo nga gatas, kay kana ang dungan nga kahayag sa daghan kaayong layo nga bituon.

q: What is true about fruit doves found in the Philippines?
options: There is only one kind of fruit dove in the Philippines, but it comes in many sizes
There are several kinds of fruit doves in the Philippines, each with its own unique colors
Fruit doves in the Philippines all look identical and can only be told apart by their calls
Philippine fruit doves are all endangered because they have only one color that makes them easy to spot
explanation: The Philippines is home to several kinds of fruit doves, and each species has its own unique and colorful appearance.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng fruit dove sa Pilipinas, bawat isa ay may sariling kakaibang kulay.
fact_bis: Adunay lain-laing matang sa fruit dove sa Pilipinas, ang matag usa adunay kaugalingong talagsaong kolor.

q: Which part of the brain is responsible for balance and smooth movement?
options: The cerebrum, because it controls all body functions including movement
The cerebellum, because it handles balance and smooth movement
The brainstem, because it connects the brain to the muscles through the spine
The hippocampus, because it remembers how the body felt during past movements
explanation: The cerebellum is the part of the brain that controls balance and smooth movement, while the cerebrum handles thinking and the brainstem controls breathing and heartbeat.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing bahagi ang utak: ang cerebrum para sa pag-iisip at pakiramdam, ang cerebellum para sa balanse at maayos na paggalaw, at ang brainstem na kumokontrol sa paghinga at tibok ng puso.
fact_bis: Ang utok adunay tulo ka nag-unang bahin: ang cerebrum para sa paghunahuna ug pagbati, ang cerebellum para sa balanse ug hapsay nga paglihok, ug ang brainstem nga magkontrol sa pagginhawa ug pitik sa kasingkasing.

q: How long does one day on Neptune last?
options: About 10 hours, because Neptune spins very fast
About 16 hours, the time it takes Neptune to rotate once
About 24 hours, just like a day on Earth
About 165 Earth years, because Neptune is very far from the Sun
explanation: One day on Neptune lasts about 16 hours, which is the time it takes the planet to complete one full rotation.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Neptune ay tumatagal ng halos 16 oras, ang oras na kailangan para makaikot ito nang isang beses.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Neptune motagal ug mga 16 ka oras, ang panahon nga gikinahanglan aron makatuyok kini sa makausa.

q: On a coral reef, which organisms are the producers that make food from sunlight for all other animals?
options: Small fish, because they are the most numerous animals on the reef
Algae, because they use sunlight to make food that becomes the energy source for reef animals
Coral polyps, because they build the reef structure that shelters all living things
Sea turtles, because they eat jellyfish and keep the reef clean
explanation: On a coral reef, algae are the producers that make food from sunlight and become the energy source for all the other organisms.
fact_tl: Sa bahura, ang algae ang gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa araw, at ito ang pinagmumulan ng enerhiya para sa lahat ng iba pang hayop.
fact_bis: Sa bahura, ang algae maghimo og pagkaon gikan sa adlaw ug mahimong tinubdan sa kusog alang sa tanang ubang mananap.

q: Which statement about mold is TRUE?
options: All molds are harmful and must be removed from any food or surface
Some kinds of mold are actually used to make certain cheeses
Mold only grows on food that has been frozen and then thawed
Mold is a type of bacterium that releases acids to break down food
explanation: Not all molds are bad — some specific kinds of mold are deliberately used in the production of certain cheeses.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng amag ay masama; ang ilang uri ay ginagamit para gumawa ng ilang klase ng keso.
fact_bis: Dili tanan agup-op daotan; ang uban nga matang gigamit sa paghimo og pipila ka klase sa keso.

q: How are diamonds formed inside the Earth?
options: Diamonds form when two different minerals mix together near the Earth's surface over many years
Extreme heat and crushing pressure deep inside the Earth squeeze carbon together over millions of years
Diamonds form when meteorites hit the Earth and fuse rocky minerals with iron
Diamonds grow from crystals of salt that are buried and compressed by ocean sediment
explanation: Diamonds form deep inside the Earth where extreme heat and crushing pressure squeeze carbon together over millions of years.
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang diamante sa napakalalim na bahagi ng Earth kung saan sobrang init at sobrang bigat ng presyon ang dumidiin sa carbon sa loob ng milyon-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Nahimo ang diamante sa lawom kaayo nga bahin sa Yuta diin ang grabe nga kainit ug bug-at nga presyon mopuga sa carbon sulod sa minilyon ka tuig.

q: Who is credited with developing the alternating current (AC) electrical system?
options: Thomas Edison, who invented the light bulb and built the first power stations
Nikola Tesla, who developed the alternating current electrical system
Michael Faraday, who discovered that magnets could generate electricity
James Watt, who invented the steam engine and applied it to generate electricity
explanation: Nikola Tesla developed the alternating current (AC) electrical system that is still widely used to deliver electricity today.
fact_tl: Si Nikola Tesla ang nagpaunlad ng alternating current (AC) na sistema ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Si Nikola Tesla ang nagpalambo sa alternating current (AC) nga sistema sa kuryente.

q: Where does a moving object get its kinetic energy from?
options: It creates kinetic energy on its own as soon as it starts moving, with no external cause needed
A force pushes the object while it moves, transferring energy into it — this is called doing work
Kinetic energy is stored inside all objects and is only released when they start to move
Gravity always provides kinetic energy to any object that is not completely still
explanation: Kinetic energy comes from a force doing work on an object — when a force pushes it while it moves, energy is transferred into the object, building up as kinetic energy.
fact_tl: Saan galing ang kinetic energy ng isang bagay? Kapag may puwersa na tumutulak dito habang gumagalaw ito, ang puwersang iyon ay nagsasalin ng enerhiya sa bagay. Ito ang tinatawag na 'work'. Kaya mas malayong itulak, mas maraming kinetic energy ang naipupon.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang kinetic energy sa usa ka butang? Kung naa'y pwersa nga nagduso niini samtang naglihok kini, kana nga pwersa nagbalhin ug enerhiya sa butang. Gitawag ni nga 'work'. Mas layo ang duso, mas daghan ang kinetic energy nga matigom.

q: Which plant is a native Philippine tree known for its showy purple flowers and leaves brewed into medicinal tea?
options: Narra, which is the Philippine national tree and has yellow flowers
Banaba, a native tree with purple flowers whose leaves are used in herbal tea
Molave, a hardwood tree whose bark is used to treat coughs and fevers
Ipil-ipil, a fast-growing tree whose leaves are eaten as a vegetable
explanation: The banaba is a native Philippine tree with showy purple flowers, and its leaves have long been used to make a medicinal herbal tea.
fact_tl: Ang banaba ay isang katutubong punong Pilipino na may magagandang lilang bulaklak, at ang mga dahon nito ay matagal nang ginagamit na panghalo sa tsaa na panlunas.
fact_bis: Ang banaba usa ka lumad nga kahoy sa Pilipinas nga adunay nindot nga lila nga bulak, ug ang mga dahon niini dugay nang gigamit isip tsa nga tambal.

q: What is a chick, and what will it become as it grows?
options: A chick is a baby duck that hatched from an egg and will grow into a full-grown duck
A chick is a young chicken that hatched from an egg and will slowly grow into a full-grown chicken
A chick is a very small egg that will hatch into a bird after several weeks
A chick is a baby bird that never knew its mother and was raised by humans
explanation: A chick is a young chicken that hatched from an egg, and it will slowly grow into a full-grown chicken as part of its life cycle.
fact_tl: Ang sisiw ay ang batang manok na napisa mula sa itlog at unti-unting lalaki upang maging ganap na manok.
fact_bis: Ang piso mao ang bata nga manok nga napusa gikan sa itlog ug hinay-hinay nga modako aron mahimong hingkod nga manok.

q: In what year did Typhoon Yolanda (Haiyan) strike the Philippines?
explanation: Typhoon Yolanda struck the Philippines on November 8, 2013, making it one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded.
fact_tl: Tumama ang Bagyong Yolanda sa Pilipinas noong Nobyembre 8, 2013.
fact_bis: Ang Bagyong Yolanda miigo sa Pilipinas niadtong Nobyembre 8, 2013.

q: How does the thickness of a string affect the sound it makes when plucked?
options: A thicker string vibrates faster and makes a higher-pitched note
A thicker string vibrates more slowly and makes a lower-pitched note
A thicker string produces a louder sound but the same pitch as a thin string
String thickness has no effect on pitch; only string length changes the note
explanation: A thicker string vibrates more slowly than a thin one, which makes it produce a lower-pitched note.
fact_tl: Ang mas makapal na kuwerdas ay yumayanig nang mas mabagal at gumagawa ng mas mababang tono kaysa sa manipis na kuwerdas.
fact_bis: Ang mas baga nga kuwerdas mag-uyog nga mas hinay ug mohimo ug mas ubos nga tono kaysa nipis nga kuwerdas.

q: Even though you cannot see air, how do you know it can push things?
options: Air can only push things if it is cooled down first and becomes heavier
Moving air can push things like sailboats and scatter papers, and you can feel it when it blows on you
Air only pushes objects that are already moving; it cannot start a stationary object moving
You cannot feel air push things because it has no mass or weight at all
explanation: Even though air is invisible, you can feel it when it blows on you, and moving air can push a sailboat or send papers flying.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi nakikita ang gas, nararamdaman mo ang hangin kapag umiihip ito at maaari nitong itulak ang barko't layag o paspasin ang papel.
fact_bis: Bisan dili makita ang gas, mabati nimo ang hangin kung mohuyop kini, ug ang naglihok nga hangin makaduot sa layag o makapalupad sa papel.

q: In what type of environment does the nipa palm tree grow?
options: On dry rocky hillsides where very little rain falls
In saltwater areas like mangrove swamps
In freshwater ponds and rivers deep in the forest
In high mountain forests where temperatures are cool
explanation: The nipa palm is a kind of palm tree that grows in saltwater areas such as mangrove swamps.
fact_tl: Ang nipa o sasa ay isang uri ng palma na tumutubo sa mga lugar na may tubig-alat tulad ng bakawan.
fact_bis: Ang nipa o sasa usa ka matang sa palma nga motubo sa mga lugar nga adunay parat nga tubig sama sa bakawan.

q: Why do sloths sometimes bask in the sunshine?
options: They need sunlight to produce a special vitamin that keeps their fur green
Their body temperature is low, so they warm themselves in the sun to raise it
They are solar-powered and use sunlight to get the energy they need to move
Sunlight kills parasites in their fur, so they sunbathe to stay clean
explanation: A sloth has a low body temperature, so it sometimes warms itself in the sunshine to raise its body heat.
fact_tl: Mababa ang temperatura ng katawan ng sloth, kaya minsan ay nagpapainit ito sa sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ubos ang temperatura sa lawas sa sloth, mao nga usahay magpainit kini sa silaw sa adlaw.

q: What is the approximate pH of lemon juice, and what does that tell us about it?
options: pH of about 7, which means it is neutral like pure water
pH of about 2, which means it is acidic
pH of about 10, which means it is a mild base
pH of about 5, which means it is slightly alkaline
explanation: Lemon juice has a pH of about 2, which places it firmly in the acidic range.
fact_tl: Ang lemon ay asido (acidic), na may pH na mga 2.
fact_bis: Ang lemon asido (acidic), nga adunay pH nga mga 2.

q: How does a barnacle survive when the tide goes out and leaves it exposed to air?
options: It opens its lid wide to collect dew drops and moisture from the air
It shuts its hard lid tightly, trapping a little seawater inside to stay moist until the tide returns
It burrows into the rock beneath it and waits in a tiny wet hole
It releases a chemical that slows down its body so it needs almost no water
explanation: When a barnacle shuts its hard lid, it traps a small amount of seawater inside, keeping it moist and alive while it waits for the tide to come back.
fact_tl: Kapag isinara ng barnacle ang matigas nitong takip, may kaunting tubig-dagat itong naiipon sa loob para manatiling basa at buhay habang naghihintay na bumalik ang alon.
fact_bis: Kung sirad-an sa barnacle ang gahi niini nga taklob, adunay gamayng tubig-dagat nga matipon sa sulod aron magpabiling basa ug buhi samtang naghulat nga mubalik ang balod.

q: What is the civet's actual role in making civet coffee (kopi luwak)?
options: The civet's saliva, which mixes with the beans in its mouth, creates the special flavor
The civet only passes the coffee beans out in its droppings; people collect, clean, and roast them to make coffee
The civet grinds the beans with its teeth and the grinding process changes the flavor
The civet buries the beans underground for weeks, and the soil fermentation creates the taste
explanation: The civet simply passes the coffee beans in its droppings; people collect them, clean them thoroughly, and then roast them to make coffee — the civet itself does not magically create the flavor.
fact_tl: May nag-iisip na ang musang mismo ang gumagawa ng kape, pero hindi totoo iyon. Inilalabas lang nito ang buto sa dumi nito. Kinokolekta ito ng mga tao, nililinis nang husto, saka iniihaw para maging kape.
fact_bis: Adunay naghunahuna nga ang musang mismo ang naghimo sa kape, apan dili kana tinuod. Igawas lang niini ang liso sa tae niini. Kolektahon kini sa mga tawo, limpyohan pag-ayo, dayon sugbahon aron mahimong kape.

q: Which mosquitoes bite humans and suck blood, and what do the others eat?
options: Both male and female mosquitoes bite humans, but only females also drink plant nectar
Only the female mosquito bites and sucks blood; the male mosquito drinks plant nectar instead
Only young mosquitoes bite to get protein; adult mosquitoes of both sexes only drink nectar
Male mosquitoes bite at night while female mosquitoes bite during the day
explanation: Only the female mosquito bites and sucks blood for the protein she needs to produce eggs; the male mosquito feeds on plant nectar.
fact_tl: Tanging babaeng lamok lamang ang kumakagat at sumisipsip ng dugo; ang lalaking lamok ay umiinom ng katas ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang babaye lang nga lamok ang mopaak ug mosuyop og dugo; ang laki nga lamok moinom og duga sa tanom.

q: Where is the pilandok (Palawan mouse deer) found, and why does it need protection?
options: It lives throughout the Philippine islands and is threatened only by disease
It is found only on Palawan island and must be protected from hunting and habitat loss
It lives in Mindanao rainforests and is endangered because of competition from larger deer
It is native to Luzon and faces extinction mainly due to pollution of its river habitat
explanation: The pilandok is a small animal found only on Palawan island and must be protected from hunting and from the loss of its natural habitat.
fact_tl: Ang pilandok o Palawan mouse deer ay isang maliit na hayop na tanging makikita lamang sa isla ng Palawan at kailangang protektahan mula sa pangangaso at pagkawala ng tirahan.
fact_bis: Ang pilandok o Palawan mouse deer usa ka gamay nga hayop nga makita lamang sa isla sa Palawan ug kinahanglan mapanalipdan gikan sa pagpangayam ug pagkawala sa puy-anan.

q: Who suggested using agar to solidify bacterial cultures in the laboratory, getting the idea from a Japanese cooking ingredient?
options: Angelina Fanny Hesse
Louis Pasteur
Robert Koch
Joseph Lister
explanation: Angelina Fanny Hesse suggested agar as a solidifying agent after being inspired by kanten, a Japanese agar used in cooking.
fact_tl: Ang paggamit ng agar bilang isang solidifying agent para sa mga bacterial culture ay iminungkahi ni Angelina Fanny Hesse — nanon niya ito mula sa kanten (Japanese na agar) na ginagamit sa pagluluto, na nagbago ng microbiology forever.
fact_bis: Ang paggamit sa agar ingon solidifying agent para sa bacterial cultures gisugyot ni Angelina Fanny Hesse — nakuha niya kini gikan sa kanten (Japanese nga agar) nga gigamit sa pagluto, nga nagbag-o sa microbiology hangtud sa kahangturan.

q: How do many grasshoppers make their chirping sound?
options: By rubbing a hind leg against a wing
By vibrating their wings very fast
By blowing air through a hole in their belly
By clicking their mouthparts together
explanation: Many grasshoppers make sound by rubbing a hind leg against a wing, a process called stridulation.
fact_tl: Maraming tipaklong ang gumagawa ng tunog sa pamamagitan ng pagkikiskis ng hita laban sa pakpak.
fact_bis: Daghang apan o duron ang naghimog tingog pinaagi sa pagkiskis sa paa batok sa pako.

q: What keeps a developing baby protected inside its mother's womb?
options: A fluid that surrounds and cushions the baby
A hard shell that covers the womb
A layer of fat wrapped around the baby
Bones of the womb that lock into place
explanation: The baby floats in a fluid inside the womb that cushions and protects it from bumps and pressure.
fact_tl: Ang sanggol ay lumulutang sa isang likido sa loob ng sinapupunan na sumasalo at nagpoprotekta sa kanya.
fact_bis: Ang bata naglutaw sa usa ka likido sulod sa tagoangkan nga magsalo ug magpanalipod kaniya.

q: Which of the following best describes a sloth's daily activity?
options: It spends most of the day sleeping and resting
It hunts prey for most of the night
It swims in rivers for several hours each day
It migrates long distances each season
explanation: A sloth spends many hours of the day sleeping and resting, making it one of the least active mammals.
fact_tl: Maraming oras sa maghapon ang ginugugol ng sloth sa pagtulog at pagpapahinga.
fact_bis: Daghang oras sa adlaw ang gigamit sa sloth sa pagkatulog ug pagpahuway.

q: Which group of fruits all belong to the citrus family?
options: Calamansi, dalandan, pomelo, and lemon
Mango, papaya, guava, and pineapple
Banana, coconut, jackfruit, and durian
Apple, pear, peach, and plum
explanation: Calamansi, dalandan, pomelo, and lemon all belong to the citrus family because they have sour, fragrant-skinned fruit.
fact_tl: Ang calamansi, dalandan, suha, at lemon ay magkakapamilya na tinatawag na citrus dahil pare-pareho silang maaasim at mabango ang balat.
fact_bis: Ang kalamansi, dalandan, suha, ug lemon managsoon nga gitawag og citrus kay tanan sila maaslom ug humot ang panit.

q: Where is the asteroid belt located in our solar system?
options: Between Mars and Jupiter
Between Earth and Mars
Between Jupiter and Saturn
Between Venus and Earth
explanation: The asteroid belt is a wide ring of rocky leftovers located between Mars and Jupiter.
fact_tl: Sa pagitan ng Mars at Jupiter ay ang asteroid belt, isang malapad na singsing ng batuhing tira mula noong nabuo ang mga planeta.
fact_bis: Sa tunga-tunga sa Mars ug Jupiter mao ang asteroid belt, usa ka lapad nga singsing sa batoon nga salin sukad natukod ang mga planeta.

q: How do warm-blooded animals like horses and people cool their bodies down on a hot day?
options: By sweating through their skin
By breathing much faster to release heat
By pressing against cool ground or water
By stopping all movement until they feel cool
explanation: Some warm-blooded animals, like horses and people, sweat to cool their bodies down as the liquid evaporates from the skin.
fact_tl: Nagpapawis ang ilang hayop na mainit ang dugo, tulad ng kabayo at tao, upang lumamig ang kanilang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang ubang hayop nga init ug dugo, sama sa kabayo ug tawo, maningot aron mabugnaw ang ilang lawas.

q: Why can water flow and pour so easily?
options: Its particles are close together but can slide past each other freely
Its particles are far apart and move in all directions
Its particles are locked in place and cannot move at all
Its particles are stuck to each other and never separate
explanation: In a liquid, particles are still close together but can slide past each other freely, which is why water flows.
fact_tl: Sa isang likido tulad ng tubig, ang mga particle ay malapit pa rin sa isa't isa ngunit malaya silang gumagalaw at nagpapalipas-lipas — kaya ang tubig ay dumadaloy.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka likido sama sa tubig, ang mga particle duol pa gihapon sa usag-usa apan gawasnon silang mobalhin sa usag-usa — mao kana nga nagdaloy ang tubig.

q: What is the title of the leader who heads the Philippine Senate?
options: Senate President
Senate Speaker
Senate Chief
Senate Governor
explanation: The head of the Philippine Senate is called the Senate President.
fact_tl: Ang pinuno ng Senado ay tinatawag na Pangulo ng Senado (Senate President).
fact_bis: Ang puno sa Senado gitawag nga Presidente sa Senado (Senate President).

q: What effect does regular exercise have on your mood and energy?
options: It helps you feel happier and more energetic
It makes you feel calm and sleepy afterward
It lowers your energy so you rest better at night
It has no effect on how you feel emotionally
explanation: Exercise helps us feel happier and more energetic, improving both mood and physical well-being.
fact_tl: Ang ehersisyo ay nakakatulong para maging mas masaya at mas masigla ang ating pakiramdam.
fact_bis: Ang ehersisyo makatabang nga mas malipayon ug mas masiglahon ang atong pamati.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the metal lead?
options: Pb
Le
Ld
Pl
explanation: The chemical symbol for lead is Pb, which comes from the Latin word plumbum.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng tingga (lead) ay Pb, mula sa salitang Latin na plumbum.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa tingga (lead) mao ang Pb, gikan sa Latin nga pulong nga plumbum.

q: Why does the spot where a wasp stings you feel burning and swollen right after?
options: The venom is a mix of chemicals and proteins that cause pain and swelling
The wasp leaves a small thorn that presses on the skin
The wasp sprays hot liquid that burns the skin
The stinger pumps air into the skin causing it to puff up
explanation: A wasp's venom is a mix of different chemicals and proteins that cause pain, swelling, and a burning feeling at the sting site.
fact_tl: Ang kamandag ng putakti ay hindi lang isang sangkap. Ito ay halo ng iba't ibang kemikal at protina na nagpapasakit, nagpapamaga, at nagsasabi sa katawan mo na nasaksak ka. Kaya nga parang nag-aapoy ang pakiramdam pagkatapos masaksak.
fact_bis: Ang hilo sa putyukan dili lang usa ka butang. Sagol kini sa lain-laing kemikal ug protina nga maghatag ug kasakit, paghubag, ug magsulti sa imong lawas nga gipaakan ka. Mao nga mura'g nagdilaab ang bahin nga gitusok.

q: How is carabao milk usually collected?
options: By gently squeezing the udder by hand so the milk flows into a container
By letting the calf drink first and then collecting the leftovers in a tube
By connecting the carabao to a machine that pumps milk automatically
By cutting a small opening in the udder and catching the milk in a bowl
explanation: Carabao milk is collected by milking — gently squeezing the udder by hand so the milk flows into a container, often done in the morning.
fact_tl: Kinukuha ang gatas sa pamamagitan ng paggatas — dahan-dahang pinipisil ng kamay ang suso (udder) ng kalabaw, at tumutulo ang gatas sa lalagyan. Madalas itong ginagawa tuwing umaga.
fact_bis: Ginakuha ang gatas pinaagi sa paggatas — hinay-hinay nga pisilon sa kamot ang suso (udder) sa kabaw aron motulo ang gatas sa sudlanan. Kasagaran kini buhaton matag buntag.

q: Why is gold commonly used to make rings and necklaces?
options: Because it is a shiny, valuable metal
Because it is the hardest metal available
Because it is very light and easy to carry
Because it changes color in sunlight making jewelry look special
explanation: Gold is a shiny, valuable metal that is crafted into jewelry like rings and necklaces.
fact_tl: Ang gold o ginto ay isang makintab at mahalagang metal na ginagawang alahas tulad ng singsing.
fact_bis: Ang bulawan usa ka masinaw ug mahalon nga metal nga gihimong alahas sama sa singsing.

q: What makes the Philippines unusual in how it produces a large share of its electricity?
options: It is one of the world's leading producers of geothermal energy from Earth's heat
It runs most of its power plants using ocean wave energy
It generates most of its electricity from large solar farms
It relies mainly on nuclear power plants built near volcanoes
explanation: The Philippines is one of the world's leading countries in producing geothermal energy, with a large share of its electricity coming from Earth's heat.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang bansa sa mundo sa paggawa ng geothermal energy. Malaki ang bahagi ng kuryente sa bansa na nagmumula sa init ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa nag-unang mga nasod sa kalibotan sa paghimo og geothermal energy. Dako nga bahin sa kuryente sa nasod ang gikan sa kainit sa Earth.

q: What is the largest space station currently orbiting Earth?
options: The International Space Station (ISS)
The Mir Space Station
The Tiangong Space Station
The Skylab Space Station
explanation: The International Space Station (ISS) is the largest space station currently orbiting Earth.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking space station na umiikot sa Earth ngayon ay ang International Space Station (ISS).
fact_bis: Ang labing dako nga space station nga milibot sa Earth karon mao ang International Space Station (ISS).

q: Which group of people in the Philippines is at greatest risk of being struck by lightning?
options: Rice field farmers, fishermen at sea, and players on open fields
Miners working deep underground
Drivers on elevated highways during storms
Students in school buildings during heavy rain
explanation: Lightning is a common cause of death outdoors in the Philippines, with rice field farmers, sea fishermen, and players on open fields at greatest risk.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay isa sa mga karaniwang sanhi ng pagkamatay sa mga outdoors na lugar sa Pilipinas; ang mga magsasaka sa palayan, mangingisda sa dagat, at manlalaro sa open field ay nasa pinakamalaking panganib.
fact_bis: Ang kidlat usa sa labing sagad nga hinungdan sa kamatayon sa mga outdoor nga lugar sa Pilipinas; ang mga mag-uuma sa palayan, mga mananagat sa dagat, ug mga magdudula sa bukas nga lugar ang adunay pinakataas nga peligro.

q: Where can the Philippine macaque monkey be found beyond the Philippines?
options: In many countries across Southeast Asia
Only on the island of Mindanao
Across the continent of Africa
In forests throughout South America
explanation: The Philippine macaque is found not only in the Philippines but in many countries across Southeast Asia.
fact_tl: Matatagpuan ang unggoy na ito hindi lang sa Pilipinas kundi sa iba't ibang bansa sa Timog-Silangang Asya.
fact_bis: Kini nga unggoy makit-an dili lang sa Pilipinas kondili sa nagkalainlaing nasod sa Habagatan-Sidlakang Asya.

q: On which Philippine islands can the Philippine flying fox be found?
options: Mindanao and Bohol, among others
Luzon and Cebu only
Palawan and Batanes only
Leyte and Samar only
explanation: The Philippine flying fox is found in the forests of islands such as Mindanao and Bohol, with famous roosts also in places like Subic.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine flying fox ay matatagpuan lamang sa mga gubat ng Pilipinas, gaya ng mga isla ng Mindanao at Bohol. May mga sikat na roost na maaaring puntahan, tulad sa Subic, kung saan libu-libong paniki ang nakikita kapag dapithapon.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine flying fox makita lamang sa mga kagubatan sa Pilipinas, sama sa mga isla sa Mindanao ug Bohol. Adunay bantog nga mga roost nga mabisitahan, sama sa Subic, diin liboan ka kabog ang makita kon hapon na.

q: On a lever, what happens to the output force when the load arm is shorter than the effort arm?
options: The output force on the load becomes greater
The output force on the load becomes smaller
The output force stays exactly the same
The lever stops working because the arms are unequal
explanation: The shorter the load arm compared to the effort arm, the greater the output force applied to the load.
fact_tl: Kung mas maikli ang load arm kaysa sa effort arm, mas malaki ang resultang puwersa na nailalapat sa karga.
fact_bis: Kung mas mubo ang load arm kaysa sa effort arm, mas dako ang resultang puwersa nga nailalapat sa luwan.

q: Why does ice cream melt faster when you take it outside on a hot day?
options: Heat from the warm air gives the frozen particles enough energy to turn back into liquid
Cold air from inside the freezer leaves with the ice cream and makes it melt
The sugar in the ice cream breaks down in sunlight
The weight of the cone squeezes the ice cream until it drips
explanation: Ice cream melts because heat from the warm air gives its frozen particles enough energy to change back into liquid form.
fact_tl: Natutunaw ang sorbetes kapag ang init mula sa mainit na hangin ay nagbibigay sa nagyelong particle nito ng sapat na enerhiya para muling maging likido. Kaya mabilis itong natutunaw sa labas kapag mainit.
fact_bis: Matunaw ang sorbetes kon ang init gikan sa init nga hangin mohatag sa mga nagyelo niini nga partikulo og igong kusog aron mahimo na usab likido. Mao nga paspas kini matunaw sa gawas kon init.

q: How long is the sinarapan, one of the Philippines' tiniest fish?
options: About 10 to 13 millimeters
About 2 to 3 centimeters
About 5 to 7 centimeters
About 1 to 2 millimeters
explanation: The sinarapan is only about 10 to 13 millimeters long, making it one of the world's smallest fish.
fact_tl: Ang sinarapan ay mga 10 hanggang 13 milimetro lamang ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang sinarapan mga 10 hangtod 13 ka milimetro ra ang gitas-on.

q: What two steps are needed to make sukang puti (white cane vinegar) from sugarcane juice?
options: Yeast first makes alcohol, then bacteria convert the alcohol into acetic acid
Bacteria first make sugar, then yeast turns the sugar into vinegar directly
The juice is boiled to make acid, then cooled to become vinegar
Salt is added to make alcohol, then sunlight converts it to vinegar
explanation: Sukang puti is made through two-step fermentation: yeast first produces alcohol, then Acetobacter bacteria convert that alcohol into acetic acid vinegar.
fact_tl: Ang sukang puti ay ginagawa mula sa katas ng tubo sa pamamagitan ng dalawang hakbang na fermentation — una, ang yeast ay gumagawa ng alkohol, at pagkatapos, ang Acetobacter ay nag-convert ng alkohol sa suka.
fact_bis: Ang sukang puti gihimo gikan sa katas ng tubo pinaagi sa duha ka lakang nga fermentation — una, ang yeast nagbuhat og alkohol, ug dayon, ang Acetobacter nagbag-o sa alkohol ngadto sa suka.

q: Approximately how old is planet Earth?
options: About 4.6 billion years old
About 1 million years old
About 65 million years old
About 13.8 billion years old
explanation: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old, as determined by scientists studying rocks and meteorites.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay humigit-kumulang 4.6 bilyong taon na ang edad.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta mga 4.6 ka bilyon ka tuig na ang panuigon.

q: How does a honeybee tell other bees in the hive where to find flowers?
options: It performs a 'waggle dance' showing direction and distance to the food
It releases a special smell that leads others straight to the flowers
It makes a loud buzzing sound that grows quieter when far from the flowers
It brings back a petal and leaves a trail on the ground for others to follow
explanation: When a honeybee finds food, it does a 'waggle dance' inside the hive to communicate the direction and distance to the flowers.
fact_tl: Kapag nakakita ng pagkain, sumasayaw ang bubuyog sa loob ng bahay-pukyutan — ang 'waggle dance' — para sabihin sa iba kung saang direksyon at gaano kalayo ang mga bulaklak.
fact_bis: Kung makakita og pagkaon, mosayaw ang putyukan sulod sa balay-putyukan — ang 'waggle dance' — aron sultihan ang uban kung asang direksyon ug unsa kalayo ang mga bulak.

q: When is the best time to harvest malunggay pods for eating?
options: While they are still young, green, and snap easily
After they turn brown and the seeds are fully ripe
Once the pods have fallen from the tree on their own
When the pods are long and very thick
explanation: Malunggay pods are best harvested while still young, green, and snapping easily; old, hard pods are left to ripen for seeds instead.
fact_tl: Inaani ang malunggay pod para kainin kapag bata pa ito, luntian, at madaling baliin. Kapag tumanda na at tumigas, mas mainam na itong iwang mahinog para sa buto.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay pod anion para kan-on samtang batan-on pa, lunhaw, ug sayon balion. Kung motigulang na ug mogahi, mas maayo nga pasagdan kini nga mahinog para sa liso.

q: What makes a storm surge even more dangerous when it coincides with high tide?
options: The water rises even higher and coastal flooding becomes worse
The winds become stronger and push the surge further inland
The wave speed slows down so the flood lasts longer
The storm surge is redirected away from the coast
explanation: When a storm surge happens at the same time as high tide, the water rises even higher, making coastal flooding significantly worse.
fact_tl: Kapag nagkasabay ang storm surge at ang high tide, mas tumataas pa ang tubig at mas malala ang pagbaha sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Kon mahitabo ang storm surge dungan sa taob, mosaka pa gyud ang tubig ug mas grabe ang pagbaha sa baybayon.

q: What nutrients in jackfruit seeds give the body strength and energy?
options: Protein and starch
Vitamins A and C
Calcium and iron
Water and fiber
explanation: Jackfruit seeds contain protein and starch that give the body strength and energy.
fact_tl: Bukod sa lasa, ang buto ng langka ay may protina at starch na nagbibigay ng lakas at sustansya sa katawan.
fact_bis: Gawas sa lami, ang liso sa nangka adunay protina ug starch nga naghatag ug kusog ug sustansya sa lawas.

q: What does the liver produce that helps stop bleeding when you get a wound?
options: Proteins that help the blood clot
Red blood cells that plug the cut
White blood cells that seal the skin
Platelets that clean the wound
explanation: The liver makes proteins that help the blood clot when there is a wound, slowing or stopping the bleeding.
fact_tl: Gumagawa ang atay ng mga protina na tumutulong upang mamuo ang dugo kapag may sugat.
fact_bis: Ang atay naghimo ug mga protina nga makatabang nga mamuo ang dugo kung adunay samad.

q: Why do LED bulbs save money compared to old-style bulbs?
options: They last many years before needing replacement, so you buy fewer bulbs
They use so much energy that the electric bill drops to zero
They never burn out because they do not use any electricity
They can be recharged like a battery so you never throw them away
explanation: An LED bulb lasts many years before it needs replacing, much longer than an old bulb, so you buy new ones less often and save money.
fact_tl: Ang LED bulb ay tumatagal nang napakaraming taon bago kailangang palitan, mas matagal kaysa sa lumang bombilya. Kaya hindi mo kailangang madalas bumili ng bago, na nakakatipid din ng pera.
fact_bis: Ang LED bulb molungtad og daghang katuigan sa dili pa kini kinahanglan ilisan, mas dugay kaysa sa daang bombilya. Busa dili nimo kinahanglan magpalit og bag-o kanunay, nga makatipig usab og kwarta.

q: What happens to hot lava after it flows out of a volcano?
options: It cools down and hardens into new rock
It evaporates into the air and disappears
It sinks into the ground and turns into magma again
It dissolves in rainwater and washes into the sea
explanation: When a volcano erupts, hot lava flows out, cools down, and hardens into new rock.
fact_tl: Kapag pumutok ang bulkan, lumalabas ang mainit na lava na lumalamig at nagiging bagong bato.
fact_bis: Kung mobuto ang bulkan, mogawas ang init nga lava nga mobugnaw ug mahimong bag-ong bato.

q: What are the bubbles you see in water actually made of?
options: Pockets of gas trapped inside the liquid
Tiny drops of hot water that spin very fast
Clumps of dust that float up to the surface
Pieces of liquid that turned into a different color
explanation: The bubbles in water are little pockets of gas trapped inside the liquid; they rise to the top and pop into the air.
fact_tl: Ang mga bula sa tubig ay maliliit na gas na natanggong sa loob ng likido; pumapaibabaw sila at sumasabog sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bula sa tubig kay gamay nga gas nga nasipit sulod sa likido; mosaka sila sa ibabaw ug mobuto ngadto sa hangin.

q: What does a barnacle do when the tide goes out and its rock becomes dry?
options: It closes the lid of its shell so it does not dry out
It crawls into the water by moving its shell slowly
It releases slime to keep itself wet until the tide returns
It opens its shell wider to catch any moisture in the air
explanation: When the tide goes out and the rock is dry, the barnacle closes the lid of its shell so it does not dry out.
fact_tl: Kapag kati at lumalabas sa tubig ang bato, isinasara ng barnacle ang takip ng kanyang kabibe upang hindi matuyo.
fact_bis: Kon mohubas ang tubig ug mamala ang bato, isira sa barnacle ang taklob sa iyang kabhang aron dili kini mamala.

q: On which continent do ostriches naturally live?
options: Africa, in grasslands and dry open plains
Australia, in the outback desert
South America, in tropical rainforests
Asia, in cold mountain highlands
explanation: Ostriches live in Africa, in grasslands and dry open plains.
fact_tl: Ang mga ostrich ay nakatira sa Aprika, sa mga damuhan at tuyong kapatagan.
fact_bis: Ang mga ostrich nagpuyo sa Africa, sa kasagbotan ug mala nga kapatagan.

q: Why does the body use carbohydrates for energy before it uses fat?
options: Because carbohydrates burn faster and are easier for the body to use quickly
Because fat takes too long to digest and passes through without giving energy
Because the body cannot break down fat until all carbohydrates are gone from the blood
Because fat is stored only in bones and is hard for the body to reach
explanation: The body uses carbohydrates first because they burn faster; fat is like stored-away energy used only when carbohydrates run out.
fact_tl: Parehong nagbibigay ng enerhiya ang carbohydrates at taba, pero ang carbohydrates ang ginagamit muna ng katawan kasi mas mabilis itong masunog. Ang taba naman ay parang nakaimbak na enerhiya na ginagamit kapag wala nang carbohydrates.
fact_bis: Parehas nga maghatag og kusog ang carbohydrates ug tambok, apan ang carbohydrates ang gamiton una sa lawas kay mas paspas kini masunog. Ang tambok sama sa gitipigan nga kusog nga gamiton kung mahurot na ang carbohydrates.

q: How does a caldera form after a massive volcanic eruption?
options: The top of the volcano collapses into the now-empty magma chamber, creating a large circular depression
Hot lava piles up at the peak and slowly forms a wide bowl shape at the top
Rainwater erodes the crater over thousands of years into a wide hole
Earthquakes crack the volcano's sides and the pieces sink down to form a ring
explanation: A caldera forms when a volcano erupts violently and its top collapses into the now-empty magma chamber; Taal is an example that sits inside a water-filled caldera.
fact_tl: Ang caldera ay isang malaking bilog na depresyon na nabubuo kapag ang isang bulkan ay sumabog nang labis at bumagsak ang tuktok nito sa loob ng walang lamang magma chamber; ang Taal ay isang halimbawa ng bulkan na nabubuo sa loob ng isang caldera na may lawa.
fact_bis: Ang caldera usa ka dako nga lingin nga depresyon nga naporma kon ang usa ka bulkan mosabog og grabe ug ang tuktok niini mahulog ngadto sa karon walay sulod nga magma chamber; ang Taal usa ka pananglitan sa bulkan nga nabutang sulod sa usa ka caldera nga puno sa tubig sa lawa.

q: Why is the gumamela a good flower to study in science class in the Philippines?
options: It is common in gardens and has big, easy-to-see flower parts like stamens
It is only found in one region and is very rare to observe
It has tiny, hidden flowers that need a microscope to examine
It blooms only once a year making it special for study
explanation: Gumamela is commonly seen in gardens and hedges all over the Philippines, and its flower parts like stamens are big and clear to see.
fact_tl: Madalas makita ang gumamela sa mga hardin at bakod sa Pilipinas. Madali mong mapag-aralan ang stamen nito dahil malalaki at kitang-kita ang mga bahagi ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Kasagaran makita ang gumamela sa mga tanaman ug koral sa tibuok Pilipinas. Sayon nimo tun-an ang stamen niini kay dagko ug klaro makita ang mga bahin sa bulak.

q: What type of plant is sugarcane, despite having a tall and woody-looking stalk?
options: A grass, related to corn and bamboo
A tree, related to coconut and banana
A vine, related to sweet potato and yam
A shrub, related to coffee and tea
explanation: Sugarcane is a tall grass in the same plant family as corn and bamboo — it is not a tree, even though its stalk looks woody.
fact_tl: Ang tubo (sugarcane) ay isang matangkad na damo (grass), kapamilya ng mga damong tulad ng mais at kawayan — hindi ito puno, kahit na parang tangkay ng kahoy ang katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang tubo (sugarcane) usa ka taas nga sagbot (grass), kaparyentihan sa mga tanom sama sa mais ug kawayan — dili kini kahoy, bisan og morag punoan sa kahoy ang lawas niini.

q: How does wearing a mask help slow the spread of airborne lung diseases like tuberculosis?
options: It blocks tiny droplets that carry bacteria from spreading through the air
It filters all viruses and bacteria out of the air so nothing gets breathed in
It keeps the lungs warm so bacteria cannot survive inside them
It prevents the wearer from coughing, stopping bacteria from forming
explanation: Wearing a mask blocks the tiny droplets that carry bacteria, slowing the spread of lung diseases.
fact_tl: Ang pagsuot ng mask ay nakakahadlang sa maliliit na patak na may bakterya, kaya bumabagal ang pagkalat ng mga sakit sa baga.
fact_bis: Ang pagsul-ob og mask makababag sa gagmay nga tinulo nga nagdala og bakterya, mao nga mohinay ang pagkaylap sa sakit sa baga.

q: Besides bats and dolphins, which other animals use echoes to find their way?
options: Some whales and cave-nesting swiftlet birds
Crocodiles and large monitor lizards
Eagles and hawks while hunting in the dark
Sharks and stingrays navigating the ocean floor
explanation: Besides bats and dolphins, some whales and even cave-nesting swiftlet birds also use echoes (echolocation) to find their way.
fact_tl: Bukod sa paniki at lumba-lumba, ang ilang balyena at maging ang ibong balinsasayaw ay gumagamit din ng alingawngaw para makahanap ng daan.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kabog ug lumba-lumba, ang ubang balyena ug bisan ang langgam nga balinsasayaw mogamit usab og alingawngaw aron makakita og dalan.

q: Why is a grassland fire not entirely harmful to the grass?
options: The roots stay alive underground and the grass sprouts again, even fresher than before
The fire kills the old grass but new seeds blow in from nearby forests
The ash makes the soil too acidic for weeds, giving grass more space
The smoke scares away animals that would eat the new grass shoots
explanation: During grassland fires the roots stay alive underground, so the grass sprouts again after the fire, even fresher than before.
fact_tl: Madalas masunog ang grassland, pero hindi ito masama. Buhay pa ang ugat sa ilalim ng lupa, kaya muling sumisibol ang damo at mas sariwa pa.
fact_bis: Kanunay masunog ang grassland, apan dili kini daotan. Buhi pa ang gamot sa ilalom sa yuta, mao nga motubo usab ang sagbot, mas presko pa gani.

q: What is the caterpillar doing inside its chrysalis?
options: Its whole body is busy changing, so it does not eat or move
It is spinning silk threads to make a stronger protective case
It is resting and storing energy by eating its own skin
It is waiting for the right temperature before hatching
explanation: Inside the chrysalis the creature does not eat or move because its whole body is busy changing into a butterfly.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng chrysalis, hindi kumakain o gumagalaw ang nilalang dahil abala itong nagbabago ang buong katawan.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa chrysalis, dili mokaon o molihok ang binuhat tungod kay nag-usab ang tibuok lawas niini.

q: Why is sitting inside a closed metal car a relatively safe place during a lightning storm?
options: Electricity flows along the metal outside and down to the ground, protecting people inside
The rubber tires absorb all the lightning before it reaches the car body
The glass windows block the electric charge from entering the car
Metal attracts lightning away from the car toward nearby trees instead
explanation: The inside of a closed metal car is fairly safe from lightning because the electricity flows along the metal outside and down to the ground, not through the passengers.
fact_tl: Ang loob ng saradong kotseng metal ay medyo ligtas sa kidlat dahil dumadaloy ang kuryente sa labas ng metal patungo sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang sulod sa sirado nga metal nga awto medyo luwas sa kilat kay ang kuryente moagi sa gawas sa metal paingon sa yuta.

q: What is a key feature of the Pampanga River in Luzon?
options: It carries water from the Central Cordillera toward Manila Bay and often overflows during typhoons
It flows from Manila Bay toward the Pacific Ocean through the Sierra Madre
It begins in Mindanao and ends in a large lake in Central Luzon
It is found underground most of the year and only surfaces during heavy rain
explanation: The Pampanga River is an important river in Central Luzon that carries water from the Central Cordillera toward Manila Bay and often overflows during typhoon season.
fact_tl: Ang Pampanga River ay isa sa mahahalagang ilog sa Gitnang Luzon na dumadala ng tubig mula sa Central Cordillera patungong Manila Bay; madalas itong mag-apaw sa kapanahunan ng bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang Pampanga River usa ka importante nga ilog sa Central Luzon nga nagdala og tubig gikan sa Central Cordillera paingon sa Manila Bay; kanunay kini moawas sa panahon sa bagyo.

q: What happens to coral if the ocean water stays too hot for a long time?
options: The coral dies because it starves without its algae
The coral grows faster by using heat as extra energy
The coral changes color permanently but stays alive
The coral breaks apart into pieces but each piece regrows
explanation: If the water stays hot for a long time, the coral dies because it starves without the algae it depends on for food.
fact_tl: Kung matagal na nananatiling mainit ang tubig, namamatay ang coral dahil nagugutom ito nang wala ang algae.
fact_bis: Kung dugay nga magpabilin nga init ang tubig, mamatay ang coral tungod kay magutom kini nga wala ang algae.

q: What is the special name for a baby kangaroo?
options: A joey
A cub
A foal
A pup
explanation: A baby kangaroo is called a joey, a term used for the young of marsupials.
fact_tl: Ang anak ng kangaroo ay tinatawag na "joey."
fact_bis: Ang anak sa kangguro gitawag nga "joey."

q: What special feature helps a cactus survive in the desert?
options: A thick stem that stores water
Long roots that reach underground rivers
Waxy leaves that collect morning dew
Flowers that close at night to trap moisture
explanation: A cactus has a thick stem to store water, which is its key adaptation for surviving in the dry desert environment.
fact_tl: May mga halaman na may espesyal na adaptation sa kanilang kapaligiran: ang cactus ay may makapal na tangkay para mag-imbak ng tubig sa disyerto, at ang bakawan (mangrove) ay may ugat na kayang tumayo sa maalat na tubig sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom nga may espesyal nga adaptation sa ilang palibot: ang cactus adunay baga nga punoan aron magtipig og tubig sa disyerto, ug ang bakhaw (mangrove) adunay gamot nga makabarog sa parat nga tubig sa baybayon.

q: Which of the following is true about the animals that live in the forests of Mount Pulag?
options: Cloud rats found there are a kind of animal unique to the Philippines
Cloud rats are large rodents also found in forests across Southeast Asia
The birds on Mount Pulag are the same species seen throughout Asia
No mammals live on Mount Pulag because it is too cold and high
explanation: Mount Pulag's forests are home to large 'cloud rats' that are endemic — found only in the Philippines and nowhere else in the world.
fact_tl: Sa kagubatan ng Mount Pulag nakatira ang malalaking 'cloud rat' o ilagang ulap—malalambot at mabalahibo na hayop na sa Pilipinas lang matatagpuan. May mga ibon at iba pang hayop din na endemic, ibig sabihin wala kang makikitang ganito sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Sa kalasangan sa Mount Pulag nagpuyo ang dagkong 'cloud rat' o ilaga sa panganod—humok ug balhiboon nga mananap nga sa Pilipinas ra makit-an. Adunay mga langgam ug ubang mananap usab nga endemic, buot ipasabot wala ka'y makita nga sama niini sa ubang nasod.

q: What protects a beetle's soft body from being hurt?
options: A hard outer skeleton called an exoskeleton
A thick layer of fat just under its skin
A slimy coating that makes attackers slip
A set of stingers on its legs and back
explanation: A beetle has a hard outer skeleton (exoskeleton) that acts like armor, protecting the soft body inside.
fact_tl: Ang salagubang ay may matigas na panlabas na balangkas (exoskeleton) na parang baluti na nagpoprotekta sa malambot na katawan sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang bakukang adunay gahi nga panggawas nga kalansay (exoskeleton) nga sama sa baluti nga nagpanalipod sa humok nga lawas sa sulod.

q: Why is a tsunami so much more powerful than an ordinary ocean wave?
options: Its energy travels through the full depth of the water from seafloor to surface
It spins in circles underwater which builds up extra speed
It is caused by strong winds that push the water from behind
The water in a tsunami is saltier and therefore heavier than normal seawater
explanation: A tsunami carries its energy through the entire depth of the ocean — from the seafloor all the way to the surface — which makes it far more powerful than wind-driven waves.
fact_tl: Ang tsunami ay nagdadala ng enerhiya sa buong lalim ng tubig, mula sahig ng dagat hanggang ibabaw, kaya napakalakas nito.
fact_bis: Ang tsunami nagdala ug kusog sa tibuok kalawom sa tubig, gikan sa salog sa dagat hangtod sa ibabaw, mao nga grabe kini kakusog.

q: What is the job of the leaf spring found on a heavy truck?
options: To support heavy loads and absorb bumps from the road
To store fuel so the engine runs longer between fill-ups
To connect the engine to the wheels so the truck can move
To steer the front wheels when the driver turns the wheel
explanation: A leaf spring — layered flat steel strips — supports the truck's heavy loads and absorbs road shocks so the ride stays stable.
fact_tl: Ang leaf spring ng mabibigat na trak ay mga patag na bakal na iniayos sa magkasamang patong-patong — sinusuportahan nito ang mabibigat na kargo at sinisipsip ang mga bungga ng daan.
fact_bis: Ang leaf spring sa mabug-at nga trak naglangkob sa mga patag nga bakal nga ginsal-in; nagsuporta kini sa mabug-at nga kargo ug nagsipsip sa mga shock sa daan.

q: Who was the second person to walk on the Moon?
options: Buzz Aldrin
Neil Armstrong
Michael Collins
Yuri Gagarin
explanation: Buzz Aldrin was the second person to walk on the Moon, stepping out shortly after Neil Armstrong during the 1969 Apollo 11 mission.
fact_tl: Ang ikalawang taong tumapak sa buwan ay si Buzz Aldrin, kasama ni Neil Armstrong noong 1969.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang tawo nga mitamak sa bulan mao si Buzz Aldrin, kauban ni Neil Armstrong niadtong 1969.

q: Why does the Philippines stay warm all year and never have winter?
options: It is located near the equator where the Sun's heat is strongest
It is surrounded by warm ocean water that keeps the air cold
It is far from the poles so strong winds never reach it
It has many volcanoes that heat the land from below
explanation: The Philippines sits near the equator, the zone where the Sun's rays hit most directly and most strongly, keeping the country warm throughout the year with no winter.
fact_tl: Tropikal ang Pilipinas dahil nasa gitnang banda ito ng mundo, malapit sa ekwador kung saan pinakamatindi ang init ng araw — kaya mainit tayo buong taon at walang taglamig.
fact_bis: Tropikal ang Pilipinas kay naa kini sa tunga-tunga nga banda sa kalibutan, duol sa ekwador diin pinakakusog ang init sa adlaw — maong init kita tibuok tuig ug walay tingtugnaw.

q: What does an insect do when it has fully grown inside a plant gall?
options: It chews a hole and leaves the gall
It stays inside the gall for the rest of its life
It breaks open the whole leaf to escape
It waits for the gall to fall off the plant before coming out
explanation: When the insect inside a gall has grown up, it makes a hole in the gall and crawls out.
fact_tl: Kapag sapat na ang gulang ng insekto, gumagawa ito ng butas at lumalabas mula sa gall.
fact_bis: Kung hamtong na ang insekto, mohimo kini ug lungag ug mogawas gikan sa gall.

q: Why does the Moon look reddish during a total lunar eclipse?
options: Earth's atmosphere filters out most colors and bends red light onto the Moon
The Moon's surface heats up and glows red when Earth blocks the Sun
Red dust from Earth's deserts floats up and coats the Moon's surface
The Moon moves into a region of space where red starlight is stronger
explanation: During a lunar eclipse, sunlight passing through Earth's atmosphere has its other colors filtered out, and red light is bent onto the Moon, giving it a reddish glow.
fact_tl: Tuwing lunar eclipse, namumula ang buwan dahil ang ilang liwanag ng Araw ay dumadaan sa atmospera ng Earth, na sumasala sa ibang kulay at nagpapadaan ng pulang liwanag papunta sa buwan.
fact_bis: Sa lunar eclipse, mamula ang bulan kay ang ubang kahayag sa Adlaw moagi sa atmospera sa Earth, nga mosala sa ubang kolor ug mopaagi sa pula nga kahayag paingon sa bulan.

q: What is the capital city of Mexico?
options: Mexico City
Guadalajara
Monterrey
Cancún
explanation: The capital of Mexico is Mexico City, the largest and most important city in the country.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Mexico (Mehiko) ay Mexico City.
fact_bis: Ang kapital sa Mexico (Mehiko) mao ang Mexico City.

q: Which unit is the standard SI base unit used to measure length?
options: Meter (m)
Kilogram (kg)
Second (s)
Celsius (°C)
explanation: The meter (m) is the SI base unit of length, used worldwide in science and everyday measurement.
fact_tl: Ang metro (m) ang batayang yunit ng haba sa sistemang SI.
fact_bis: Ang metro (m) mao ang sukaranang yunit sa gitas-on sa sistemang SI.

q: A fish sanctuary protects more than just fish. Which other sea creatures does it also help?
options: Sea turtles, squid, starfish, shellfish, and coral
Only the fish that live near the surface of the water
Freshwater animals like tilapia and catfish
Land animals near the shore such as crabs and birds
explanation: A fish sanctuary protects the whole variety of sea life — including sea turtles, squid, starfish, shellfish, and coral — because all these living things are connected in the sea.
fact_tl: Hindi lang isda ang naililigtas ng fish sanctuary. Pinoprotektahan din nito ang IBA'T IBANG buhay sa dagat (biodiversity) — gaya ng pawikan, pusit, starfish, kabibe, at coral. Dahil magkakaugnay ang lahat ng ito sa dagat, kapag protektado ang buong sistema, mas malusog at matatag ang dagat para sa lahat.
fact_bis: Dili lang isda ang maluwas sa fish sanctuary. Giprotektahan usab niini ang TANANG matang sa kinabuhi sa dagat (biodiversity) — sama sa pawikan, nokus, starfish, kabibe, ug coral. Tungod kay nagkadugtong silang tanan sa dagat, kung protektado ang tibuok sistema, mas himsog ug lig-on ang dagat alang sa tanan.

q: What does a snail do when it is scared and wants to stay safe?
options: It pulls its body inside its shell to hide
It sprays a bad-smelling liquid at attackers
It buries itself under the mud very quickly
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
explanation: When a snail feels scared, it pulls its whole body inside the shell, using it as a shelter where birds and other predators cannot reach it.
fact_tl: Kapag natatakot ang kuhol, pumapasok ito sa loob ng shell para magtago. Doon ligtas ito sa ibon, manok, at iba pang gustong kumain dito. Parang kanlungan ang shell nito.
fact_bis: Kung mahadlok ang kuhol, mosulod kini sa kabhang aron motago. Didto luwas kini sa langgam, manok, ug uban pang mokaon niini. Sama sa silonganan ang iyang kabhang.

q: Which pair correctly matches a natural fiber with its source?
options: Cotton from a plant and wool from a sheep
Polyester from a plant and nylon from a sheep
Cotton from oil and wool from a cotton plant
Nylon from a sheep and cotton from oil
explanation: Cotton comes from a plant and wool comes from a sheep's coat — both are natural fibers, unlike polyester and nylon which are human-made from oil.
fact_tl: Ang ilang hibla ng tela ay galing sa kalikasan — ang cotton ay mula sa halaman, ang wool ay mula sa balahibo ng tupa — pero ang iba tulad ng polyester at nylon ay gawa ng tao mula sa langis, kaya parang plastik.
fact_bis: Ang ubang hibla sa panapton gikan sa kinaiyahan — ang cotton gikan sa tanom, ang wool gikan sa balhibo sa karnero — apan ang uban sama sa polyester ug nylon hinimo sa tawo gikan sa lana, mao nga sama sa plastik.

q: How do birds get the energy to fly very long distances during migration?
options: They eat a lot before leaving and burn stored body fat as fuel
They ride strong wind currents so they barely need to flap their wings
They sleep while gliding and only wake up to eat insects in the air
They drink large amounts of water to keep their muscles working
explanation: Before migrating, birds eat a great deal and store body fat, which they then burn as fuel to power their long non-stop flights.
fact_tl: Bago lumipat, kumakain nang marami ang mga ibon at nag-iipon ng taba na ginagamit nilang gasolina ng katawan para makalipad nang malayo nang halos walang tigil.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mobalhin, mokaon ug daghan ang mga langgam ug magtigom ug tambok nga ilang gamiton nga gasolina sa lawas aron makalupad ug layo nga halos walay hunong.

q: How do birds use their wings to fly through the air?
options: They flap their wings to push themselves up and forward
They spread their wings wide and wait for the wind to carry them
They spin their wings in circles like a helicopter blade
They beat their wings against the ground to jump very high
explanation: Birds flap their wings, which pushes air downward and backward and drives the bird upward and forward through the air.
fact_tl: Pinagpapagaspas ng mga ibon ang kanilang mga pakpak upang itulak ang sarili paitaas at pasulong sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ginakapay-kapay sa mga langgam ang ilang mga pako aron itukmod ang ilang kaugalingon paitaas ug pasulong sa hangin.

q: What shape does a buckminsterfullerene (C60) molecule look like?
options: A soccer ball
A flat sheet like graphite
A long hollow tube
A pyramid with four triangular sides
explanation: Buckminsterfullerene (C60) is made of 60 carbon atoms arranged in a pattern that looks like a soccer ball, making it one of the first nanomaterials discovered.
fact_tl: Ang buckminsterfullerene (C60) ay isang molecule na binubuo ng 60 carbon atom na nakaayos tulad ng pagsasalikop ng soccer ball — ito ay isa sa unang natuklasang nanomaterial at ginagamit sa pananaliksik sa mga bagong materyales.
fact_bis: Ang buckminsterfullerene (C60) usa ka molecule nga binubuo sa 60 carbon atom nga nakabutang sama sa soccer ball; usa kini sa unang natuklasang nanomaterial ug gigamit sa research sa materials science.

q: Which island is the second largest in the Philippines?
options: Mindanao
Luzon
Palawan
Leyte
explanation: Mindanao, located in the southern part of the Philippines, is the country's second largest island.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang pinakamalaking isla ng Pilipinas ay ang Mindanao, na nasa katimugang bahagi ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang pinakadako nga pulo sa Pilipinas mao ang Mindanao, nga naa sa habagatang bahin sa nasod.

q: What do we call the narrow body of water between two islands, like the San Bernardino Strait?
options: A strait
A gulf
A bay
A delta
explanation: The narrow strip of water separating two islands is called a strait; for example, the San Bernardino Strait is a passage ships use between Philippine islands.
fact_tl: Ang makitid na tubig sa pagitan ng dalawang pulo ay tinatawag na kipot o strait, tulad ng San Bernardino Strait. Dito dumadaan ang mga barko papunta sa ibang lugar.
fact_bis: Ang sigpit nga tubig taliwala sa duha ka isla gitawag og kipot o strait, sama sa San Bernardino Strait. Diri moagi ang mga barko padulong sa ubang lugar.

q: What did the New Horizons spacecraft discover on Pluto in 2015?
options: A large heart-shaped plain of nitrogen ice called Tombaugh Regio
A ring system similar to the rings around Saturn
A thick atmosphere of oxygen that could support simple life
A series of deep craters filled with liquid water
explanation: When New Horizons flew past Pluto in 2015, it revealed a large heart-shaped plain of nitrogen ice now named Tombaugh Regio, as well as Pluto's large moon Charon.
fact_tl: Ang New Horizons spacecraft ay lumipas malapit sa Pluto noong 2015 at natuklasan ang isang malaking puso-hugis na patag ng nitrogen ice na tinatawag na Tombaugh Regio, pati na rin ang malaking buwan nitong si Charon.
fact_bis: Ang New Horizons spacecraft milabay hapit sa Pluto niadtong 2015 ug nakapadayag og dako nga puso-hugis nga patag sa nitrogen ice nga ginganlan og Tombaugh Regio, ingon man ang iyang dako nga buwan nga si Charon.

q: Who created the Kelvin temperature scale?
options: William Thomson, known as Lord Kelvin
Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer
Gabriel Fahrenheit, a German physicist
Isaac Newton, who also studied gravity
explanation: The Kelvin temperature scale was created by William Thomson, who is better known by his title Lord Kelvin.
fact_tl: Si William Thomson, na kilala bilang Lord Kelvin, ang gumawa ng Kelvin temperature scale.
fact_bis: Si William Thomson, nga nailhan nga Lord Kelvin, mao ang naghimo sa Kelvin temperature scale.

q: Two machines do the same amount of work. Which one has greater power?
options: The one that finishes the work faster
The one that uses more fuel to do the job
The one that is heavier and larger
The one that moves at a slower, steadier speed
explanation: Power equals work divided by time, so when two machines do the same work, the faster one has greater power.
fact_tl: Ang power ay katumbas ng work na nagawa na hinati sa oras na ginugol, kaya kung dalawang makina ang gumagawa ng parehong work, mas malaki ang power ng mas mabilis na natatapos.
fact_bis: Ang power parehas sa work nga nabuhat bahinon sa oras nga gigamit, mao nga kung duha ka makina maghimo sa parehas nga work, mas dako ang power sa mas paspas nga mahuman.

q: Why do gasoline prices in the Philippines rise when world oil prices go up?
options: Because the Philippines buys almost all of its oil from other countries
Because the Philippines produces too much oil and has to sell the extra
Because local refineries raise prices to earn more profit on local oil
Because the government adds extra taxes whenever world prices increase
explanation: Almost all the oil used in the Philippines is imported, so when world oil prices rise, those higher costs are passed on to Filipino consumers at the pump.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ng langis na ginagamit sa Pilipinas ay binibili mula sa ibang bansa, kaya kapag tumaas ang presyo ng langis sa mundo, tumataas din ang presyo ng gasolina dito sa atin.
fact_bis: Halos tanang lana nga gigamit sa Pilipinas gipalit gikan sa laing nasod, busa kung mosaka ang presyo sa lana sa kalibutan, mosaka usab ang presyo sa gasolina dinhi kanato.

q: An object is sitting completely still on a table. Which property does it still have?
options: Inertia, because inertia depends only on mass
Momentum, because all objects have momentum at all times
Both inertia and momentum, since both depend on mass
Neither, because a still object has no force acting on it
explanation: Inertia depends only on mass and exists even when an object is at rest, unlike momentum which requires the object to be moving (mass × velocity).
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang inertia at momentum. Ang inertia ay depende sa masa lamang at meron kahit nakatigil ang bagay. Ang momentum naman ay masa beses bilis, kaya kailangan munang gumalaw ang bagay bago ito magkaroon ng momentum.
fact_bis: Lahi ang inertia ug momentum. Ang inertia nagsalig lamang sa masa ug naa bisan nagpahulay ang butang. Ang momentum mao ang masa pilo sa katulin, mao nga kinahanglan molihok una ang butang aron makabaton ug momentum.

q: Why does a crab shed (molt) its hard outer shell?
options: Because it needs to grow bigger and the old shell cannot expand
Because the old shell gets too dirty and heavy to carry around
Because it needs to find a mate and the shell hides its colors
Because the shell breaks apart after a certain number of years
explanation: A crab's exoskeleton cannot grow with its body, so the crab molts — sheds the old shell — to allow a larger new shell to form.
fact_tl: Ang alimango ay may matigas na balat sa labas na tinatawag na exoskeleton, at upang lumaki, kailangan nitong itapon ang lumang balat sa pamamagitan ng pagbabalat, kaya pansamantalang malambot ang bagong balat nito.
fact_bis: Ang alimango adunay gahi nga panit sa gawas nga gitawag exoskeleton, ug aron modako, kinahanglan kini molabay sa daan nga panit pinaagi sa pagpamanit, mao nga humok una ang bag-o niini nga panit sulod sa mubo nga panahon.

q: What does the Preamble of the 1987 Philippine Constitution say the Filipino people are doing when they establish the government?
options: Building a just and humane society and securing blessings of independence and democracy
Declaring war against all foreign nations that threaten the Philippines
Setting the exact rules for how elections must be held every six years
Listing all the rights that only government officials are allowed to have
explanation: The Preamble of the 1987 Constitution says the sovereign Filipino people ordain it to build a just and humane society and secure the blessings of independence and democracy under the rule of law.
fact_tl: Ang Panimula (Preamble) ng 1987 Saligang Batas: "Kami, ang nakapangyayaring sambayanang Pilipino, na humihingi ng tulong sa Makapangyarihang Diyos, upang bumuo ng isang makatarungan at makataong lipunan at magtatag ng isang Pamahalaan na kakatawan sa aming mga mithiin at adhikain, magtataguyod ng kabutihan sa bawat isa, mangangalaga at magpapaunlad ng aming kabuhayan, at magbibigay sa amin at sa aming mga magiging anak ng mga biyaya ng kalayaan at demokrasya sa ilalim ng pananaig ng batas at ng pamamahalang puno ng katotohanan, katarungan, kalayaan, pagmamahalan, pagkakapantay-pantay, at kapayapaan, ay naghahayag at nagpapatibay ng Saligang Batas na ito."
fact_bis: Ang Pasiuna (Preamble) sa 1987 nga Konstitusyon nag-ingon nga ang soberanong katawhang Pilipino, nga nangayog tabang sa Makagagahum nga Dios, magtukod og makatarunganon ug makitawhanon nga katilingban ug Gobyerno nga magtaguyod sa kaayohan sa tanan, ubos sa balaod ug sa kamatuoran, hustisya, kagawasan, gugma, pagkaparehas, ug kalinaw.

q: A doctor gives you an antibiotic. What does this medicine do inside your body?
options: It kills or stops the growth of harmful bacteria
It destroys viruses like the ones that cause colds and flu
It raises your body temperature to burn away the infection
It teaches your immune cells to remember the disease forever
explanation: An antibiotic kills or stops harmful bacteria from growing; it does not work against viruses, which is why it should only be taken when a doctor prescribes it.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotic ay gamot na pumapatay o pumipigil sa pagdami ng nakakasakit na bacteria. Dapat lang itong inumin kapag ipinareseta ng doktor at ubusin ang buong dosis, dahil hindi ito gumagana laban sa virus tulad ng sipon.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotic usa ka tambal nga mopatay o mopugong sa pagdaghan sa makapasakit nga bacteria. Kinahanglan kini imnon lamang kung gireseta sa doktor ug humanon ang tibuok dosis, kay dili kini mogana batok sa virus sama sa sip-on.

q: What unit do scientists use to measure radioactivity?
options: Becquerel (Bq)
Joule (J)
Watt (W)
Ampere (A)
explanation: Radioactivity is measured in becquerels (Bq), a unit named after scientist Henri Becquerel who discovered radioactivity.
fact_tl: Ang radyaktibidad ay sinusukat sa becquerel (Bq), na ipinangalan kay Henri Becquerel.
fact_bis: Ang radyaktibidad gisukod sa becquerel (Bq), nga ginganlan kang Henri Becquerel.

q: What is the purpose of using a mordant like alum (tawas) when dyeing fabric?
options: It helps the natural dye bond permanently to the fabric so the color does not wash out
It removes the old color from the fabric before adding the new dye
It makes the fabric softer and smoother so the dye soaks in more easily
It heats the dye to a higher temperature so it sticks to the fibers faster
explanation: A mordant like alum helps natural dyes bond permanently to fabric; without it, the color fades quickly when the fabric is washed.
fact_tl: Ang mordant tulad ng tawas ay isang kemikal na nagtutulong sa natural na dye na permanenteng kumapit sa tela; nang wala ito, maaaring mabilis na mawala ang kulay kapag hinugasan.
fact_bis: Ang mordant sama sa tawas usa ka kemikal nga nagtabang sa natural nga dye nga permanenteng modikit sa tela; kon wala kini, ang kolor mahimong dali mapupo sa paghugaw.

q: After a forest fire, what is the first type of plant likely to grow back?
options: Fast-growing plants like grasses and small shrubs
Tall mature trees that quickly re-sprout from their roots
Mosses and lichens that must break down bare rock first
Large ferns that need deep shade to germinate
explanation: Secondary succession begins with fast-growing plants appearing first in disturbed soil, and trees gradually return only later in the process.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang succession ay nagsisimula pagkatapos ng isang kaguluhan tulad ng sunog o baha sa isang lugar na may lupa pa rin, at ang mga mabilis na lumalagong halaman ay unang tumutubo bago unti-unting bumalik ang mga puno.
