Resting the eyes for several months
Eating more carrots every day
explanation: Blurry vision is not blindness and can usually be corrected with the right eyeglasses.
fact_tl: Ang malabong paningin ay hindi pagkabulag; kadalasan ay maaayos ito sa tamang salamin sa mata.
fact_bis: Ang hanap nga panan-aw dili pagkabuta; kasagaran maayo kini sa husto nga antipara.

q: Why is the city of Baguio cooler than cities near the sea in the Philippines?
options: Baguio is a highland area, and higher areas are cooler than lowland areas near the sea
Baguio is surrounded by large lakes that keep the air cold
Baguio is farther from the equator than other Philippine cities
Baguio has thick forests that block the sun from warming the city
explanation: In the Philippines, highland areas like Baguio are cooler while lowland areas near the sea are warmer.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, mas mainit ang panahon sa mga mababang lugar malapit sa dagat, habang mas malamig ang mga mataas na lugar tulad ng Baguio sa Benguet.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, mas mainit ang panahon sa mga ubos-bahin duol sa dagat, samtang mas mabugnaw ang mga taas-bahin sama sa Baguio sa Benguet.

q: At which point on a swing is kinetic energy the greatest?
options: At the lowest point of the swing
At the highest point on either side
When the swing is pushed from behind
When the swing first starts moving
explanation: On a swing or pendulum, kinetic energy is greatest at the lowest point where the swing moves fastest.
fact_tl: Sa umuugang duyan o palawit, pinakamalaki ang potensyal na enerhiya sa pinakamataas na punto at pinakamalaki ang kinetiko sa pinakamababa, at palit-palit ito habang umuugoy.
fact_bis: Sa nagaindayog nga duyan o palawit, labing dako ang potential energy sa pinakahabog nga punto ug ang kinetiko sa pinakaubos, ug nagbinayloay kini samtang nagaindayog.

q: Which combination of tests do scientists use to identify a mineral?
options: Hardness, streak, color, and luster
Weight, shape, smell, and temperature
Color, size, texture, and thickness
Density, magnetism, taste, and glow
explanation: To identify a mineral, scientists use hardness, streak, color, and luster together rather than just one test.
fact_tl: Upang makilala ang isang mineral, sabay-sabay na ginagamit ng siyentipiko ang tigas, streak, kulay, at luster.
fact_bis: Aron mailhan ang usa ka mineral, gigamit sa siyentista ang katig-a, streak, kolor, ug luster nga dungan.

q: Where does a fully grown forest store most of its carbon for a long time?
options: In the wood of the trees and in the soil
In the rainwater that falls on the leaves
In the air spaces between the branches
In the flowers and fruits of the trees
explanation: Fully grown forests store a lot of carbon in their wood and soil for a long time.
fact_tl: Ang mga gubat na lumaki nang husto ay nagtatago ng maraming carbon sa loob ng kanilang katawan at lupa sa mahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang hingpit nga natubo nga mga lasang nagtipig og daghang carbon sa ilang lawas ug yuta sulod sa taas nga panahon.

q: Why can multiple hornet stings be life-threatening?
options: The venom causes severe pain and can trigger a dangerous allergic reaction called anaphylaxis
Hornets inject a sleeping chemical that stops the heart after several stings
The stingers break off inside the skin and cause a deadly infection
Hornet saliva carries a virus that spreads through the bloodstream
explanation: Multiple hornet stings are dangerous because the venom causes severe pain and can trigger a life-threatening allergic reaction called anaphylaxis in sensitive people.
fact_tl: Ang maraming kagat ng hornet ay maaaring maging mapanganib—ang hilo ay nagdudulot ng matinding sakit at maaaring magbunsod ng alerdyik na reaksyon (anaphylaxis) sa ilang tao.
fact_bis: Ang daghang kagat sa hornet mahimong mapanganib—ang hilo nagdala sa grabe nga sakit ug mahimong magbunsod og mapandangon nga alerdyik nga reaksyon (anaphylaxis) sa pipila ka tawo.

q: Why can diamond scratch every other mineral?
options: Diamond is the hardest mineral, rating 10 on the Mohs scale
Diamond has the sharpest edges of any rock found in nature
Diamond contains iron which makes it strong enough to cut anything
Diamond expands when hot and can break through softer materials
explanation: Diamond can scratch every other mineral because it is the hardest at Mohs 10.
fact_tl: Kayang gasgasin ng diamante ang lahat ng ibang mineral dahil ito ang pinakamatigas (Mohs 10).
fact_bis: Makagasgas ang diamante sa tanang ubang mineral kay kini ang pinakagahi (Mohs 10).

q: Why does an ambulance siren sound higher as it comes toward you and lower as it drives away?
options: Sound waves bunch up when approaching and spread out when leaving, changing the pitch — this is the Doppler effect
The driver turns up the volume as the ambulance approaches and turns it down when passing
The siren spins faster when moving toward you and slows down when moving away
Your ears are more sensitive to high-pitched sounds when danger is coming closer
explanation: This is the Doppler effect: sound waves bunch up when a source approaches you and spread out when it moves away, changing the pitch you hear.
fact_tl: Ang sirena ng dumadaang ambulansya ay tunog na mas mataas habang papalapit ito at mas mababa kapag papalayo na. Ito ay dahil nagsisiksikan ang mga alon ng tunog kapag palapit at humihiwalay kapag palayo — ang tinatawag na Doppler effect.
fact_bis: Ang sirena sa naglabay nga ambulansya mas taas og tono samtang nagpaduol kini ug mas ubos kon nagpalayo na. Tungod kini kay magtapok ang mga balod sa tingog kon nagpaduol ug magkatag kon nagpalayo — ang gitawag nga Doppler effect.

q: How many legs does an insect have?
options: Six
Four
Eight
Ten
explanation: All insects have exactly six legs — that is one of the key features of being an insect.
fact_tl: Ang isang insekto ay may anim (6) na paa.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka insekto adunay unom (6) ka tiil.

q: Who was the sixteenth President of the Philippines?
options: Rodrigo Duterte
Benigno Aquino III
Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo
Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
explanation: Rodrigo Duterte was the sixteenth President of the Philippines, starting in 2016.
fact_tl: Si Rodrigo Duterte ang ikalabing-anim na Pangulo ng Pilipinas, nagsimula noong 2016.
fact_bis: Si Rodrigo Duterte ang ikanapulog-unom nga Presidente sa Pilipinas, nagsugod niadtong 2016.

q: What kinds of animals does the Philippine eagle hunt for food?
options: Monkeys, hornbills, snakes, and other small forest animals
Only fish from rivers and streams in the forest
Mainly insects, frogs, and small lizards on the forest floor
Seeds, fruits, and small birds that live in the treetops
explanation: The Philippine eagle hunts monkeys, hornbills, snakes, and other small forest animals.
fact_tl: Ang agilang Pilipino ay humuhuli ng mga unggoy, kalaw, ahas, at iba pang maliliit na hayop sa gubat.
fact_bis: Ang agila sa Pilipinas mangayam ug mga unggoy, kalaw, bitin, ug uban pang gagmay nga mananap sa lasang.

q: Why does red cabbage juice change color when mixed with vinegar or baking soda?
options: It is an ordinary chemical reaction between the cabbage pigment and an acid or base
The cabbage contains magic compounds that science cannot fully explain
The juice absorbs light differently at different temperatures in the liquid
Vinegar and baking soda destroy the red color and reveal a hidden color beneath
explanation: The color change is just an ordinary chemical reaction between the cabbage pigment and an acid or base — any plant with the same pigment would work.
fact_tl: Maling akala na may 'mahika' ang red cabbage. Ang totoo, ordinaryong reaksyong kemikal lamang ito sa pagitan ng pigment at ng asido o base, kaya kahit anong gulay na may parehong pigment ay puwedeng gumana.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga ang red cabbage adunay 'mahika.' Sa tinuod, ordinaryo lang kini nga reaksyong kemikal tali sa pigment ug sa asido o base, busa bisan unsang tanom nga adunay parehas nga pigment mahimo usab molihok.

q: What is the correct way to remove a tick from your skin?
options: Gently pull it straight out with tweezers
Burn it with a match until it lets go
Twist it in circles until it comes free
Cover it with petroleum jelly to suffocate it
explanation: To safely remove a tick, gently pull it straight out with tweezers so its head is not left behind in the skin.
fact_tl: Para ligtas na alisin ang garapata, dahan-dahan itong hinihila paalis gamit ang sipit upang hindi maiwan ang ulo nito.
fact_bis: Aron luwas nga makuha ang garapata, hinay-hinay kining birahon gamit ang sipit aron dili mabilin ang ulo niini.

q: What does a vaccine do inside the body?
options: It teaches the body to fight a disease without first getting sick
It kills all germs in the blood immediately after injection
It gives you a small amount of the disease so you feel sick briefly
It coats the lungs so germs cannot enter the body at all
explanation: A vaccine teaches the body to fight a disease without first getting sick, preparing the immune system in advance.
fact_tl: Ang bakuna ay nagtuturo sa katawan na labanan ang isang sakit nang hindi muna nagkakasakit.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna nagatudlo sa lawas sa pagsukol sa usa ka sakit nga dili una magsakit.

q: What causes an earthquake?
options: Large blocks of rock suddenly slip and move along a crack called a fault, making the ground shake
Hot magma pushes up from underground and causes the surface to vibrate
Strong ocean waves crash against the coast and send vibrations through the ground
The spinning of the Earth suddenly speeds up and makes the ground tremble
explanation: An earthquake happens when large blocks of rock suddenly slip and move on opposite sides of a fault, making the ground shake.
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon ng lindol kapag biglang nadudulas at gumagalaw ang malalaking bato sa magkabila ng isang bitak na tinatawag na fault, at ang biglang paggalaw na ito ang nagdudulot ng pagyanig ng lupa.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang linog kung kalit nga modulas ug molihok ang dagkong mga bato sa duha ka kilid sa usa ka liki nga gitawag og fault, ug kini nga kalit nga paglihok maoy hinungdan sa pag-uyog sa yuta.

q: What does the Brahminy kite commonly eat near water?
options: Fish, crabs, and dead animals it finds near water
Only live fish that it catches by diving underwater
Mainly water insects and frogs found along riverbanks
Seeds, water plants, and small shellfish from the seashore
explanation: The Brahminy kite often eats fish, crabs, and dead animals it finds near water, making it partly a scavenger.
fact_tl: Ang lawin ay madalas kumain ng isda, alimango, at patay na hayop na natagpuan malapit sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lawin kasagaran mokaon og isda, alimango, ug patay nga mananap nga makit-an duol sa tubig.

q: How long does a jackfruit take to become ripe after it starts growing?
options: Several months
Just a few days
About two weeks
Exactly one year
explanation: Jackfruit does not ripen quickly — it takes several months to grow big and become ripe.
fact_tl: Hindi agad nahihinog ang langka; tumatagal ito ng ilang buwan bago lumaki at maging hinog. Kaya kailangan ng pasensya bago ito makain.
fact_bis: Dili dayon mahinog ang nangka; mokabat kini og pipila ka bulan una modako ug mahinog. Mao nga kinahanglan og pasensya una makaon.

q: What are aftershocks?
options: Smaller earthquakes that follow the main earthquake and can last for days or weeks
The vibrations that happen underground just before a big earthquake strikes
Waves of water caused by an earthquake that hit coastal areas
The loud sounds the ground makes as cracks form during an earthquake
explanation: Aftershocks are smaller earthquakes that follow after the main strong earthquake and can continue for several days or weeks.
fact_tl: Ang aftershocks ay mga mas mahihinang lindol na sumusunod pagkatapos ng pangunahing malakas na lindol, at maaari itong tumagal ng ilang araw o linggo.
fact_bis: Ang aftershocks mao ang mas huyang nga mga linog nga mosunod human sa nag-unang kusog nga linog, ug mahimo kining molungtad ug pipila ka adlaw o semana.

q: How are seeds arranged inside a legume pod like a pea pod?
options: Lined up in a single row
Stacked on top of each other in layers
Scattered randomly throughout the pod
Grouped in pairs at each end of the pod
explanation: Inside a legume pod, the seeds are lined up in a single row, just like when you open a pea pod.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng pod, nakahanay sa isang linya ang mga buto, gaya ng makikita kapag binuksan ang isang gisantes.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa pod, naka-han-ay sa usa ka linya ang mga liso, sama sa makita kung ablihan ang gisantes.

q: What causes the 'hic' sound when you get the hiccups?
options: The vocal cords snap shut as air rushes in
The stomach bounces up and hits the lungs
Air bursts out of the throat in a sudden puff
The diaphragm vibrates like a guitar string
explanation: The 'hic' sound of a hiccup comes from the vocal cords snapping shut as air rushes in.
fact_tl: Ang tunog na 'hik' sa sinok ay dahil biglang nagsasara ang vocal cords habang pumapasok ang hangin.
fact_bis: Ang tingog nga 'hik' sa sed-ok tungod kay kalit nga mosira ang vocal cords samtang mosulod ang hangin.

q: Why is it so important to protect the tamaraw from extinction?
options: It exists nowhere else in the world, so if it disappears it is gone forever
There are only a few left but scientists can breed them in any zoo worldwide
It is endangered but a similar species in Borneo can replace it in the ecosystem
Its population is recovering quickly, but it still needs temporary protection
explanation: The tamaraw exists only in Mindoro, Philippines, so if it disappears there is no other place in the world where it can be found.
fact_tl: Mahalagang protektahan ang tamaraw dahil kapag nawala ito, mawawala ito magpakailanman — wala nang ibang lugar sa mundo kung saan ito matatagpuan. Bahagi rin ito ng malusog na kaparangan ng Mindoro at isang likas na yaman para sa susunod na henerasyon.
fact_bis: Importante nga panalipdan ang tamaraw kay kung mawala kini, mawala na kini hangtod sa hangtod — wala nay laing dapit sa kalibotan diin kini makita. Kabahin usab kini sa himsog nga kasagbotan sa Mindoro ug usa ka kinaiyanhong bahandi alang sa sunod nga kaliwatan.

q: What makes a matchstick burst into flame when you strike it?
options: The heat from friction ignites the chemicals on the matchstick head
Static electricity from your fingers sets off a tiny spark inside the match
The chemicals in the match react with water vapor in the air
The matchstick contains a small battery that releases energy when scratched
explanation: When a matchstick head is struck against a rough strip, the heat from friction ignites the chemicals and makes a flame.
fact_tl: Kapag ikiniskis ang ulo ng posporo sa magaspang na bahagi, ang init mula sa friction ay nagpapaningas ng kemikal at lumilikha ng apoy.
fact_bis: Kon kiskison ang ulo sa posporo sa gahi nga bahin, ang kainit gikan sa friction modilaab sa kemikal ug maghimo ug kalayo.

q: What is special about the firefly squid that appears in Japanese coastal waters in spring?
options: Thousands of photophores on its body create a spectacular glowing light display at night
It is the largest glowing creature in the ocean and can be seen from space
Its light is so bright it can temporarily blind fish that swim too close
It changes color rapidly to communicate with other squids over long distances
explanation: The firefly squid has thousands of photophores covering its body that create a spectacular luminous display when they gather in coastal Japanese waters in spring.
fact_tl: Ang firefly squid (Watasenia scintillans) ay may libu-libong photophore sa buong katawan — kapag sila ay nang-iipon sa mga coastal water ng Japan sa tagsibol, gumagawa sila ng kahanga-hangang maliwanag na display sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang firefly squid (Watasenia scintillans) adunay libu-libong photophore nga nagatakob sa iyang lawas — sa dihang nagtipon sila sa coastal waters sa Japan sa tingpamulak, nagbuhat sila og talagsaong hayag nga display sa gabii.

q: How many islands make up the Philippines according to the government's official count?
explanation: The Philippines is made up of 7,641 islands according to the government's official count.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay binubuo ng 7,641 na pulo ayon sa pagbilang ng pamahalaan.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas gilangkoban sa 7,641 ka isla sumala sa ihap sa gobyerno.

q: How many protons does a copper (Cu) atom have?
explanation: The atomic number of copper is 29, which means it has 29 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng copper (tanso, Cu) ay 29, kaya may 29 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa copper (tumbaga, Cu) kay 29, mao nga naa kini 29 ka proton.

q: What substance gives plant leaves their green color?
options: Chlorophyll
Melanin
Carotene
Cellulose
explanation: The green color of leaves comes from a substance called chlorophyll found in plant cells.
fact_tl: Ang berdeng kulay ng mga dahon ay nagmumula sa isang sangkap na tinatawag na klorophil.
fact_bis: Ang lunhaw nga kolor sa mga dahon naggikan sa usa ka sangkap nga gitawag og chlorophyll.

q: What is the cytoplasm inside a cell?
options: A jelly-like fluid that fills the cell where the cell's parts float
A hard wall that surrounds and protects the outside of the cell
A thread-like structure inside the nucleus that carries DNA
A membrane that controls what enters and leaves the cell
explanation: The cytoplasm is a jelly-like fluid that fills the cell, where the cell's parts float.
fact_tl: Ang sitoplasma ay parang jelly na likido na pumupuno sa loob ng selula kung saan lumulutang ang mga bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Ang sitoplasma usa ka morag jelly nga likido nga nagpuno sa sulod sa sélula diin naglutaw ang mga bahin niini.

q: Which type of wedge splits things more easily?
options: A long, thin wedge
A short, thick wedge
A square, flat wedge
A curved, blunt wedge
explanation: A long, thin wedge splits things more easily than a short, thick wedge because of its shape.
fact_tl: Ang manipis at mahabang wedge ay mas madaling pumunit kaysa sa makapal at maikling wedge.
fact_bis: Ang nipis ug taas nga wedge mas sayon mobiyak sa mga butang kaysa baga ug mubo nga wedge.

q: How do plants help protect sand dunes from being blown away?
options: Plant roots hold the sand in place so the wind cannot easily blow it away
Plants block the wind entirely by growing taller than the dune
Plant leaves produce oils that harden the sand and make it stick together
Plants absorb moisture that makes the sand too heavy for the wind to move
explanation: Plant roots hold the sand in place and keep a dune from being easily blown away by the wind.
fact_tl: Ang mga ugat ng halaman ay humahawak sa buhangin at pumipigil sa dune na madaling matangay ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamot sa tanom maghupot sa balas ug magpugong sa dune nga dili dali nga mapalid sa hangin.

q: On a lever, what is called the 'effort'?
options: The force you apply to move the lever
The weight of the object you want to lift
The point where the lever balances on its support
The distance between the load and the fulcrum
explanation: On a lever, the effort is the force you apply, and the lever helps by making your effort stronger to lift the load.
fact_tl: Sa isang lever, ang load ay ang bigat na gusto mong buhatin, at ang effort ay ang puwersang inilalagay mo. Ang lever ay tumutulong dahil pinapalakas nito ang iyong effort.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka lever, ang load mao ang bug-at nga gusto nimong isakwat, ug ang effort mao ang kusog nga imong gibutang. Ang lever motabang kay gipakusog niini ang imong effort.

q: What is a geode?
options: A rock with a hollow inside where crystals grew from mineral-rich water
A flat rock formed from layers of mud pressed together over time
A type of volcanic rock with many small holes made by gas bubbles
A smooth river stone with colorful stripes from different minerals
explanation: A geode is a rock with a hollow inside where crystals grew from mineral-rich water over a long time.
fact_tl: Ang geode ay isang bato na may guwang sa loob kung saan tumubo ang mga kristal mula sa tubig na may mineral.
fact_bis: Ang geode usa ka bato nga adunay guwang sa sulod diin mitubo ang mga kristal gikan sa tubig nga puno sa mineral.

q: At approximately what temperature does gold melt?
options: 1064 degrees Celsius
500 degrees Celsius
327 degrees Celsius
1500 degrees Celsius
explanation: Gold melts at about 1064 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang ginto (gold) ay natutunaw sa mga 1064 degrees Celsius (1064°C).
fact_bis: Ang bulawan (gold) matunaw sa mga 1064 degrees Celsius (1064°C).

q: Why does water in a pond look shallower than it really is?
options: Because light bends (refracts) as it leaves the water, making the apparent depth look less than the real depth
Because the water surface acts like a mirror and shows the sky instead of the bottom
Because clean water absorbs light so the bottom looks closer than it is
Because our eyes naturally add extra depth when we look at moving water
explanation: Because of refraction, the apparent depth we see is always less than the real depth of water in a pond or basin.
fact_tl: May pagkakaiba ang tunay na lalim ng tubig at ang lalim na nakikita ng mata natin. Dahil sa refraction, palaging mas mababaw ang tingin natin (apparent depth) kaysa sa totoong lalim (real depth) ng isang lawa o palanggana ng tubig.
fact_bis: Adunay kalainan tali sa tinuod nga giladmon sa tubig ug sa giladmon nga makita sa atong mata. Tungod sa refraction, kanunay nga mas mabaw ang atong panan-aw (apparent depth) kaysa sa tinuod nga giladmon (real depth) sa usa ka linaw o palanggana sa tubig.

q: Why does the tarsier turn its head almost 180 degrees to each side?
options: Because its eyes cannot move, so it must turn its whole head to look around
Because its neck muscles are so strong that turning its head is easier than moving its eyes
Because it has ears on the sides of its head that need to face the sound it hears
Because its oversized eyes work only when facing directly forward
explanation: The tarsier cannot move its eyes, so it can turn its head almost 180 degrees to each side to look around.
fact_tl: Hindi maigalaw ng tarsier ang kanyang mata, kaya kaya niyang iikot ang ulo halos 180 degrees sa bawat panig para makakita sa paligid.
fact_bis: Dili matuyok sa tarsier ang iyang mata, mao nga makalingi siya og ulo halos 180 degrees sa matag kilid aron makakita sa palibot.

q: In which hospital was ether anesthesia first demonstrated?
options: Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, USA
Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, USA
Royal London Hospital in London, UK
Charité Hospital in Berlin, Germany
explanation: Ether anesthesia was first demonstrated at Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, USA.
fact_tl: Unang ipinakita ang ether anesthesia sa Massachusetts General Hospital sa Boston, Amerika.
fact_bis: Ang ether anesthesia unang gipakita sa Massachusetts General Hospital sa Boston, Amerika.

q: What is the difference between two isotopes of the same element?
options: They have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons
They have different numbers of protons but the same number of electrons
They have the same atomic mass but are found in different places on Earth
They look different under a microscope but behave identically in reactions
explanation: Isotopes of the same element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons, like carbon-12 and carbon-14.
fact_tl: Ang mga isotopo ng parehong elemento ay may parehong bilang ng proton ngunit magkaibang bilang ng neutron, gaya ng carbon-12 at carbon-14.
fact_bis: Ang mga isotope sa samang elemento adunay parehong gidaghanon sa proton apan lahi ang gidaghanon sa neutron, sama sa carbon-12 ug carbon-14.

q: What happens to a fire when more oxygen is available?
options: It burns faster and hotter
It burns more slowly and produces less smoke
It changes color from red to blue
It goes out because oxygen smothers it
explanation: Fire burns faster and hotter when more oxygen is present.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis at mas mainit na nagliliyab ang apoy kapag mas maraming oxygen ang naroroon.
fact_bis: Mas paspas ug mas init ang pagsiga sa kalayo kung mas daghan ang oxygen nga anaa.

q: Why is it useful to have two eyes that see slightly different views?
options: It lets the brain judge how far away things are
It doubles the number of colors we can see
It helps us see better in the dark
It prevents eye infections from spreading
explanation: Having two eyes that see slightly different views lets the brain judge depth and distance, which is why you can catch a ball or tell how far away something is.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakaroon ng dalawang mata na bahagyang magkaiba ang nakikita ay nagbibigay-daan sa utak na husgahan ang lalim at distansya. Ito ang dahilan kaya kaya mong saluhin ang isang bola o malaman kung gaano kalayo ang isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang pagbaton og duha ka mata nga gamayng lahi ang makita maghatag og kahigayonan sa utok aron hukman ang giladmon ug gilay-on. Mao nga makasalo ka og bola o makahibalo kon unsa kalayo ang usa ka butang.

q: What do we call the hot melted rock that flows out of a volcano?
options: Lava
Magma
Granite
Pumice
explanation: The hot molten rock that flows out of a volcano is called lava; it is called magma only while it is still underground.
fact_tl: Ang tunaw na batong lumalabas sa bulkan ay tinatawag na lava (magma kapag nasa loob pa ng lupa).
fact_bis: Ang tunaw nga bato nga mogawas sa bulkan gitawag og lava (gitawag og magma samtang anaa pa sa ilawom sa yuta).

q: Besides inventing the videophone, what other fields did Filipino inventor Gregorio Zara work on?
options: Airplanes and solar energy
Submarines and wind energy
Rockets and nuclear energy
Ships and tidal energy
explanation: Gregorio Zara created inventions dealing with airplanes and solar (sun) energy, in addition to the videophone.
fact_tl: Bukod sa videophone, si Gregorio Zara ay gumawa rin ng mga imbensyon hinggil sa eroplano at enerhiya ng araw (solar).
fact_bis: Gawas sa videophone, si Gregorio Zara naghimo usab og mga imbensyon mahitungod sa eroplano ug enerhiya gikan sa adlaw (solar).

q: What happens to warm air compared to cool air?
options: It rises because it is lighter and less dense
It sinks because heat makes it heavier
It stays in place because it has more pressure
It moves sideways along the ground
explanation: Warm air is lighter and less dense, so it rises and leaves an area of lower pressure below.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na hangin ay mas magaan at hindi gaanong siksik, kaya umaakyat ito at iniiwan ang lugar na may mababang presyon sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang init nga hangin mas gaan ug dili kaayo baga, mao nga mosaka kini ug mobilin og dapit nga may ubos nga presyon sa ubos.

q: If you bring the same pendulum from Earth to the Moon, how does it swing?
options: More slowly, because the Moon has weaker gravity
Faster, because the Moon has stronger gravity
At the same speed, because the pendulum length does not change
More slowly, because the Moon has no atmosphere
explanation: Stronger gravity makes a pendulum swing faster; on the Moon where gravity is weaker, the same pendulum would swing more slowly.
fact_tl: Ang puwersa ng gravity ay nakaapekto rin sa period ng pendulum — ang isang pendulum sa mas malakas na gravity (tulad ng mas mababang antas) ay nangingisig nang mas mabilis kaysa sa mas mahina na gravity (tulad ng nasa buwan).
fact_bis: Ang mas lig-on nga gravity nagpahinabo sa pendulum nga maglingkod og mas paspas — ang pendulum sa mao gihapon nga gitas-on nagalingkod og mas paspas sa Yuta kaysa sa Buwan diin mas mahuyang ang gravity.

q: When does scabies cause the most itching?
options: Especially at night
Only in the morning
When the skin is wet
Only when touched
explanation: Scabies makes the skin very itchy, especially at night.
fact_tl: Nagdudulot ang galis ng matinding kati sa balat, lalo na kapag gabi.
fact_bis: Ang galis makapakatol pag-ayo sa panit, ilabi na sa gabii.

q: When can we see the Sun's corona with our eyes?
options: During a total solar eclipse, when the Moon covers the Sun
On very clear nights when the sky is dark
During a partial lunar eclipse
When using ordinary sunglasses on a sunny day
explanation: We normally cannot see the Sun's faint corona because the Sun is too bright, but during a total solar eclipse the Moon covers the Sun and the corona appears as a ring of light.
fact_tl: Karaniwang hindi natin nakikita ang malamlam na korona ng Araw dahil sobrang liwanag ng Araw mismo — pero tuwing kumpletong solar eclipse, kapag tinatakpan ng Buwan ang Araw, lumilitaw ang korona bilang magandang singsing ng liwanag sa paligid ng madilim na bilog.
fact_bis: Kasagaran dili nato makita ang hanap nga corona sa Adlaw tungod kay hayag kaayo ang Adlaw mismo — apan panahon sa total nga solar eclipse, kung ang Bulan motabon sa Adlaw, motungha ang corona isip nindot nga singsing sa kahayag palibot sa ngitngit nga lingin.

q: Which vitamins do the helpful bacteria in your gut help make?
options: Vitamin K and several B vitamins
Vitamin C and Vitamin D
Vitamin A and Vitamin E
Vitamin B12 and Vitamin C only
explanation: Gut bacteria synthesize important vitamins we cannot make on our own, including Vitamin K needed for blood clotting and several B vitamins.
fact_tl: Ang mga bacteria sa ating bituka ay gumagawa ng ilang mahahalagang bitamina na hindi natin kayang gumawa nang mag-isa — kabilang dito ang Vitamin K (para sa pagdurugo ng dugo) at ilang B vitamins.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakterya sa atong tinai nagbuhat og pipila ka importante nga bitamina nga dili nato mahimo sa kaugalingon — lakip niini ang Vitamin K (para sa pagdugo sa dugo) ug pipila ka B vitamins.

q: If you crush a green plant leaf and separate its colors using chromatography, what do you find?
options: Hidden yellow and orange colors alongside the green
Only pure green with no other colors
Only blue and purple pigments
Red and violet colors that were invisible before
explanation: When you separate the colors of a Philippine plant leaf by chromatography, you find hidden yellow and orange colors inside, not just green.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, puwede mong subukan ang chromatography gamit ang dahon ng halaman. Kapag dinurog mo ang dahon at hiniwalay ang kulay, makikita mong hindi lang berde ang nasa loob, may dilaw at orange din pala na nakatago.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, mahimo nimong sulayan ang chromatography gamit ang dahon sa tanom. Kung dugmokon nimo ang dahon ug bulagon ang kolor, makita nimo nga dili lang berde ang sulod naa diay tinago nga dalag ug orange.

q: What is the correct first step when treating a small cut?
options: Wash the wound with clean water
Apply toothpaste to stop the bleeding
Pour rubbing alcohol directly into the cut
Cover it immediately with a bandage without cleaning
explanation: For a small cut, you should first wash the wound with clean water, then press a clean cloth on it to stop the bleeding, and finally cover it with a clean bandage.
fact_tl: Para sa maliit na hiwa, hugasan ang sugat ng malinis na tubig, idiin ang malinis na tela para tumigil ang dugo, at takpan ito ng malinis na benda.
fact_bis: Para sa gamay nga samad, hugasi ang samad og limpyo nga tubig, ipiti og limpyo nga panapton aron mohunong ang dugo, dayon taboni kini og limpyo nga bendahe.

q: Where do most penguins in the world live?
options: In the southern half of the world, such as Antarctica
In the Arctic, near the North Pole
In the rainforests of Africa
In the deserts of Australia
explanation: Most penguins live in the southern half of the world, such as Antarctica.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga penguin ay nakatira sa katimugang bahagi ng mundo, gaya ng Antartika.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga pingwino nagpuyo sa habagatang bahin sa kalibotan, sama sa Antartika.

q: Which animal is known for having natural protection that allows it to fight venomous snakes?
options: The mongoose
The rabbit
The peacock
The iguana
explanation: The mongoose has natural protection that lets it fight venomous snakes without being badly affected.
fact_tl: May ilang hayop tulad ng mongoose na may natural na proteksyon kaya nakakalaban sila sa kamandag ng ahas nang hindi gaanong naaapektuhan.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka hayop sama sa mongoose nga adunay natural nga panalipod maong makasukol sila sa kamandag sa bitin nga dili kaayo maapektuhan.

q: What is the main difference between a flood and a landslide?
options: In a flood water overflows on flat land; in a landslide soil, mud, and rock slide downhill
A flood only happens near rivers; a landslide only happens near volcanoes
A flood is caused by earthquakes; a landslide is caused by rain
A landslide is faster than a flood and always more dangerous
explanation: In a flood, water overflows and rises on flat land; in a landslide, it is the soil, mud, and rock themselves that give way and slide downhill.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang landslide at baha. Sa baha, tubig ang umaapaw at tumataas sa patag na lugar; sa landslide naman, ang mismong lupa, putik, at bato ang gumuho at bumagsak pababa sa dalisdis.
fact_bis: Lahi ang landslide ug ang baha. Sa baha, tubig ang moawas ug mosaka sa patag nga dapit; sa landslide, ang mismong yuta, lapok, ug bato ang maguba ug mahulog paubos sa bakilid.

q: Why does sweat taste salty?
options: Because sweat contains a little salt from your body
Because sweat is made from the food you eat
Because skin produces salt to keep bacteria away
Because the sun adds minerals to sweat as it dries
explanation: When you sweat, your body loses not just water but also a little salt, which is why sweat tastes salty if it reaches your lips.
fact_tl: Kapag pinapawisan ka, hindi lang tubig ang lumalabas sa iyong katawan kundi pati kaunting asin. Kaya nga maalat ang lasa ng pawis kung tumama sa iyong labi. Iyan ang dahilan kung bakit kailangang uminom at kumain pagkatapos maglaro o mag-ehersisyo.
fact_bis: Kung magsingot ka, dili lang tubig ang mogawas sa imong lawas kondili apil ang gamay nga asin. Mao nga parat ang lami sa singot kung makaabot sa imong ngabil. Mao ni ang hinungdan nga kinahanglan ka moinom ug mokaon human magdula o mag-ehersisyo.

q: In what year was the Malolos Constitution, the first Philippine constitution, proclaimed?
explanation: The Malolos Constitution, the first Philippine constitution, was promulgated in 1899.
fact_tl: Ipinahayag ang Saligang Batas ng Malolos, ang unang konstitusyon ng Pilipinas, noong 1899.
fact_bis: Ang Konstitusyon sa Malolos, ang unang konstitusyon sa Pilipinas, gimantala niadtong 1899.

q: In which parts of the Philippines is ground corn commonly eaten as a daily substitute for rice?
options: Cebu and Mindanao
Metro Manila and Batangas
Ilocos Region and Pampanga
Palawan and Batanes
explanation: In some parts of the Philippines like Cebu and Mindanao, ground corn (corn grits) is eaten as a daily substitute for rice.
fact_tl: Sa ilang lugar sa Pilipinas tulad ng Cebu at Mindanao, ang giling na mais ('corn grits') ay kinakain bilang pamalit sa kanin araw-araw.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka dapit sa Pilipinas sama sa Cebu ug Mindanao, ang giling nga mais (corn grits) ginakaon isip puli sa kan-on matag adlaw.

q: What is the job of soldier ants in an ant colony?
options: To defend the nest from enemies using their big jaws
To find and bring back food for the queen
To lay eggs and grow the colony
To build new tunnels deeper underground
explanation: Some ant colonies have soldier ants with big jaws whose job is to defend the nest from enemies.
fact_tl: May mga sundalong langgam na malalaki ang panga na nagtatanggol sa kolonya laban sa kaaway.
fact_bis: Ang ubang kolonya adunay sundalo nga hulmigas nga dagko og apapangig nga manalipod sa salag batok sa kaaway.

q: Which of these is an example of a PHYSICAL change?
options: Melting ice into water
Burning wood into ash
Bread dough rising and baking
Iron rusting on a fence
explanation: In a physical change the form changes but no new substance forms, as when ice melts into water; burning creates new substances and is a chemical change.
fact_tl: Sa physical change, nagbabago ang anyo pero hindi nagiging bagong sangkap (hal. natutunaw na yelo). Sa chemical change o reaksyon, bumubuo ng bagong sangkap na kadalasang hindi na maibabalik (hal. pagsusunog).
fact_bis: Sa physical change, mag-usab ang porma apan walay bag-ong sustansya nga maporma (pananglitan, natunaw nga yelo). Sa chemical change o reaksyon, maporma og bag-ong sustansya nga kasagaran dili na mabalik (pananglitan, pagsunog).

q: What is ultrasound used for inside hospitals?
options: To make pictures of the inside of the body, such as a baby sonogram
To sterilize medical tools using high-frequency sound
To break up kidney stones using laser light
To measure blood pressure through the ears
explanation: Ultrasound is used in hospitals to make pictures of the inside of the body, such as a baby sonogram.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang ultrasound sa ospital para kumuha ng larawan sa loob ng katawan, gaya ng sonogram ng sanggol.
fact_bis: Ang ultrasound gigamit sa ospital aron mokuha og hulagway sa sulod sa lawas, sama sa sonogram sa bata.

q: Why do you blink automatically when something flies near your eye?
options: It is a reflex that protects the eye without you having to think about it
Your brain decides to blink after seeing the danger
Your eyelid muscles practice blinking as a habit
Blinking sends a warning signal to your hand to move away
explanation: Blinking when something comes near your eye is a reflex that protects the eye automatically.
fact_tl: Ang pagkurap ng mata kapag may papalapit na bagay ay isa ring reflex na nagpoprotekta sa mata.
fact_bis: Ang pagpilok sa mata kung adunay nagsingabot nga butang usa usab ka reflex nga manalipod sa mata.

q: What type of rock is slate, and what is it known for?
options: A metamorphic rock that splits easily into thin, flat sheets
A sedimentary rock that dissolves slowly in rainwater
An igneous rock formed when lava cools very slowly
A volcanic rock full of tiny air bubbles
explanation: Slate is a metamorphic rock that splits easily into thin, flat sheets, which is why it was once used for writing boards.
fact_tl: Ang slate ay isang metamorphic rock na madaling mahati sa manipis at patag na piraso, kaya dati itong ginagamit na pisara.
fact_bis: Ang slate usa ka metamorphic rock nga sayon mabahin sa nipis ug patag nga piraso, maong kaniadto gigamit kini nga pisara.

q: What organ makes blood for a baby while it is still inside the mother?
options: The liver
The kidneys
The spleen
The bone marrow
explanation: Before a baby is born, its liver is one of the organs that makes blood; after birth, the bone marrow takes over this job.
fact_tl: Bago pa ipanganak ang isang sanggol, habang nasa tiyan pa ng ina, ang atay niya ang isa sa gumagawa ng dugo. Pagkatapos ipanganak, ang buto-buto (bone marrow) na ang humahalili sa trabahong ito.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa matawo ang usa ka masuso, samtang naa pa sa sabakan sa inahan, ang iyang atay maoy usa sa naghimo ug dugo. Human matawo, ang utok sa bukog (bone marrow) na ang mopuli niini nga trabaho.

q: Why are the lights and appliances in a house wired in parallel circuits?
options: So each one can be switched on or off separately without affecting the others
So all lights turn on at the same time to save electricity
So that if one appliance breaks, all others stop too for safety
So the total voltage is shared equally among all appliances
explanation: Houses are wired in parallel circuits so that each light and appliance can be switched on or off separately without affecting the others.
fact_tl: Ang mga bahay ay nakakable sa parallel circuit upang ang bawat ilaw at kagamitan ay maaaring buksan o patayin nang hiwalay nang hindi naaapektuhan ang iba.
fact_bis: Ang mga balay gikable sa parallel circuit aron ang matag suga ug gamit mahimong sindihan o palongon nga bulag nga dili maapektuhan ang uban.

q: How does a chameleon avoid falling off a branch?
options: Its pincer-shaped feet and curling tail both grip the branch tightly
It uses sticky pads on its belly like a gecko
It wraps its whole body around the branch like a snake
Its claws dig deep grooves into the bark to stay in place
explanation: A chameleon's feet are shaped like pincers for gripping branches, and its tail can curl around a branch like an extra hand so it does not fall.
fact_tl: Ang mga paa ng chameleon ay hugis-sipit na perpekto sa pagkapit sa sanga. Ang kanilang buntot naman ay kayang pumulupot sa sanga gaya ng isang dagdag na kamay para hindi mahulog.
fact_bis: Ang mga tiil sa chameleon porma og sipit nga maayo kaayo sa pagkupot sa sanga. Ang iyang ikog kaya molikos sa sanga sama sa dugang nga kamot aron dili mahulog.

q: How does Pluto's surface gravity compare to the Moon's gravity?
options: It is even weaker than the Moon's gravity
It is about the same as the Moon's gravity
It is stronger than the Moon's but weaker than Earth's
It has no gravity at all because it is so far from the Sun
explanation: Pluto's surface gravity is only about 0.6 m/s², which is even weaker than the Moon's gravity.
fact_tl: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw ng Pluto ay halos 0.6 m/s² lamang, mas mababa pa sa grabidad ng Buwan.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw sa Pluto mga 0.6 m/s² ra, mas huyang pa kaysa sa grabidad sa Bulan.

q: What is a mutualism relationship on a coral reef?
options: A relationship where both species benefit, like clownfish living among anemones
A relationship where one species hunts and eats the other
A relationship where one species lives on another without helping or hurting it
A relationship where two species compete for the same food
explanation: Mutualism is a relationship where both species benefit; coral reefs are full of examples such as clownfish and anemone, and cleaner shrimp and large fish.
fact_tl: Ang coral reef ay puno ng mutualism — mga relasyon kung saan parehong nakikinabang ang dalawang species; ang mga halimbawa ay kinabibilangan ng: clownfish at anemone, cleaner shrimp at malaking isda, at goby fish at pistol shrimp.
fact_bis: Ang coral reef puno sa mutualism — mga relasyon diin ang duha ka species nakakuha og benepisyo; ang mga ehemplo naglakip sa: clownfish ug anemone, cleaner shrimp ug dako nga isda, ug goby fish ug pistol shrimp.

q: About how many decibels loud is a normal conversation between two people?
options: About 60 decibels
About 20 decibels
About 100 decibels
About 140 decibels
explanation: A normal conversation is about 60 decibels (dB) loud.
fact_tl: Ang lakas ng karaniwang usapan ay nasa mga 60 desibel (dB).
fact_bis: Ang ordinaryong panagsultihay anaa sa mga 60 desibel (dB) ka kusog.

q: What makes a group of living things count as one species?
options: Their members can breed with each other and have offspring that can also breed
They all look exactly the same and live in the same place
They share the same diet and have the same number of legs
They were discovered by the same scientist at the same time
explanation: A species is one kind of living thing whose members can breed with each other and have offspring that can also breed; all humans are one species.
fact_tl: Ang isang species ay isang uri ng buhay na nabubuhay na bagay na maaaring magparami kasama ang isa't isa at magkaroon ng anak na kaya ring magparami; halimbawa, lahat ng tao ay iisang species.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka species mao ang usa ka matang sa buhi nga butang nga makahimo og pagsanay tali sa usag usa ug makabaton og anak nga makasanay usab; pananglitan, ang tanang tawo usa ra ka species.

q: How does a sunbird help plants make seeds?
options: It carries pollen from flower to flower while drinking nectar
It digs holes in the soil where seeds can fall and grow
It eats insects that would otherwise destroy the flowers
It waters the flowers by splashing with its wings
explanation: While drinking nectar, the sunbird picks up pollen and carries it to other flowers, helping the plants make seeds.
fact_tl: Habang umiinom ng tamis na nektar sa bulaklak, ang sunbird ay nadidikitan ng polen at dinadala ito sa ibang bulaklak, kaya tumutulong itong magpabunga ng halaman.
fact_bis: Samtang naginom sa tam-is nga nektar sa bulak, ang sunbird mapilit og polen ug madala kini sa laing bulak, busa makatabang kini sa pagpamunga sa tanom.

q: Why do you sometimes feel a tickle on your lips when playing the kubing?
options: Because the vibrating tongue of the instrument passes its movement into your skin
Because saliva moves along the instrument when you breathe
Because the kubing produces heat that warms your lips
Because the sound waves bounce off your teeth back into your mouth
explanation: When you play a kubing, the real vibration of its tongue passes into your lips and skin, proving that sound comes from movement.
fact_tl: Kapag tumutugtog ka ng kubing, minsan ramdam mo ang munting kilig o ngalngal sa iyong labi o ngipin. Iyon ay ang totoong vibration ng dila na naipapasa sa balat mo. Patunay ito na ang tunog ay galing sa paggalaw — kung hindi gumagalaw ang dila, walang tunog at walang ramdam.
fact_bis: Kung magtugtog ka og kubing, usahay mabati nimo ang gamay nga ngalngal o gangha sa imong ngabil o ngipon. Mao kana ang tinuod nga vibration sa dila nga moagi sa imong panit. Kini nagpamatuod nga ang tunog gikan sa lihok — kung dili molihok ang dila, wala'y tunog ug wala'y mabati.

q: Roughly how many Earths could fit inside the Sun?
options: More than a million
About one thousand
About ten thousand
About one hundred
explanation: The Sun is so big that more than a million Earths could fit inside it, making it the largest object in our Solar System.
fact_tl: Napakalaki ng Araw kaya mahigit isang milyong Mundo ang kasya sa loob nito — ito ang pinakamalaking bagay sa ating Solar System, na may halos lahat ng timbang ng buong sistema.
fact_bis: Dako kaayo ang Adlaw mao nga kapin sa usa ka milyon ka Kalibutan ang mahimong masulod niini — kini ang pinakadako nga butang sa atong Solar System, nga adunay halos tanang gibug-aton sa tibuok sistema.

q: What is one thing mouthwash can do for your mouth, and what can it NOT replace?
options: It can kill bacteria and reduce bad breath, but it cannot replace brushing and flossing
It can replace brushing completely if used twice a day
It heals cavities by killing all bacteria on the teeth
It whitens teeth as effectively as a dentist treatment
explanation: Mouthwash can help kill bacteria in the mouth and reduce bad breath, but it is not a substitute for brushing and flossing.
fact_tl: Ang mouthwash ay maaaring makatulong sa pagpatay ng mga bacteria sa bibig at pagpapabilis ng masamang hininga, ngunit hindi ito kapalit ng pagsisipilyo at paggamit ng dental floss.
fact_bis: Ang mouthwash makatabang sa pagpatay sa bacteria sa baba ug pagpababa sa mabahong hangin, apan kini dili kapuli sa pag-brush ug paggamit sa dental floss.

q: What color flame does lithium produce in a flame test?
options: Red (crimson)
Yellow
Violet
Green
explanation: In a flame test, lithium (Li) gives a red (crimson) flame color.
fact_tl: Sa flame test, ang lithium (Li) ay nagbibigay ng PULA (red, crimson) na kulay sa apoy.
fact_bis: Sa flame test, ang lithium (Li) mohatag ug PULA (red, crimson) nga kolor sa kalayo.

q: How is a strong acid different from a weak acid?
options: A strong acid releases almost all of its H+ in water, while a weak acid releases only a small part
A strong acid is more colorful and smells worse than a weak acid
A strong acid is always found in nature, while a weak acid is always man-made
A strong acid turns blue litmus red, while a weak acid has no effect on litmus
explanation: A strong acid like muriatic acid releases almost all of its H+ in water, while a weak acid like vinegar releases only a small part of its H+.
fact_tl: Ang isang malakas na acid (tulad ng muriatic acid) ay halos buong naglalabas ng H+ sa tubig, habang ang isang mahinang acid (tulad ng suka) ay bahagya lamang naglalabas ng H+.
fact_bis: Ang kusganon nga acid (sama sa muriatic acid) hapit tanan nga H+ niini gipagawas sa tubig, samtang ang huyang nga acid (sama sa suka) gamay ra nga bahin sa H+ ang gipagawas.

q: How can you tell that a lanzones fruit is ripe just by looking at it?
options: It turns yellow when it is ripe
It turns dark green when it is ripe
It turns purple when it is ripe
It turns white when it is ripe
explanation: Lanzones turn yellow as a sign that they are ripe, just as rambutan turns red when it is ripe.
fact_tl: Nagiging dilaw ang lanzones at pula ang rambutan bilang tanda na hinog na ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang lanzones mahimong dalag ug ang rambutan mahimong pula isip timaan nga hinog na sila.

q: What is a baby sheep called?
options: A lamb
A calf
A kid
A foal
explanation: A baby sheep is called a lamb, and like many young mammals it drinks milk from its mother.
fact_tl: Ang anak ng tupa ay tinatawag na lamb o kordero at sumususo rin ito ng gatas.
fact_bis: Ang nati sa karnero gitawag og lamb o kordero, ug mosuso usab kini og gatas.

q: Which animal is the fastest in the world when it dives to catch prey?
options: The peregrine falcon, reaching over 300 km/h
The cheetah, reaching about 120 km/h
The sailfish, reaching about 110 km/h
The golden eagle, reaching about 200 km/h
explanation: The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal in the world; when it dives to catch prey, it can reach over 300 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang peregrine falcon (isang uri ng lawin) ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa buong mundo. Kapag sumisisid ito pababa para hulihin ang biktima, umaabot ito sa mahigit 300 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang peregrine falcon (usa ka matang sa banog) mao ang pinakapaspas nga hayop sa tibuok kalibutan. Kon mosalom kini paubos aron dakpon ang tukbonon, makaabot kini og kapin sa 300 ka kilometro kada oras.

q: In what year was the first color photograph made?
explanation: The first color photograph was made in 1861.
fact_tl: Ang unang makulay na larawan ay ginawa noong 1861.
fact_bis: Ang unang makulay nga litrato gihimo niadtong 1861.

q: What is the safest thing to do when there is lightning outside?
options: Go inside a sturdy building or house
Stand under a tall tree to stay dry
Lie flat on the ground in an open field
Hold a metal umbrella over your head
explanation: The safest thing to do during lightning is to go inside a sturdy building or house, because its walls and roof protect you.
fact_tl: Ang pinakaligtas na gawin kapag may kidlat ay pumasok sa loob ng isang matibay na gusali o bahay, dahil mapoprotektahan ka ng pader at bubong nito laban sa kidlat.
fact_bis: Ang labing luwas nga buhaton kung naay kilat mao ang pagsulod sa lig-on nga building o balay, kay ang dingding ug atop niini magpanalipod nimo batok sa kilat.

q: Which members of an ant colony are the most numerous?
options: Worker ants
Soldier ants
Queen ants
Male ants
explanation: In an ant colony, worker ants are the most numerous; there is only one queen but there can be thousands of workers, which is why workers are the ones we usually see.
fact_tl: Sa isang kolonya ng langgam, ang mga worker ant ang pinakamarami. Isa lang ang reyna, pero libo-libo ang mga worker. Kaya sila ang madalas nating nakikitang gumagala sa labas.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka kolonya sa langgam, ang mga worker ant ang labing daghan. Usa ra ang reyna, apan liboan ang mga worker. Mao nga sila ang kasagaran natong makita nga naglakaw sa gawas.

q: Why does a cool breeze blow from the sea toward the shore on a sunny day?
options: The land heats up faster than the sea, creating lower pressure over land that pulls in cool sea air
The sea is colder than the land, so it pushes cold air outward toward the shore
The sun heats the water and causes it to evaporate, pushing air onto the land
Wind always blows from water to land because water molecules are heavier than air
explanation: On a sunny day the land heats faster than the sea, making lower pressure over land, so a cool sea breeze blows from the sea toward the shore.
fact_tl: Sa tanghali, mas mabilis uminit ang lupa kaysa dagat kaya may mababang presyon sa lupa at umiihip ang malamig na simoy mula sa dagat papuntang baybayin.
fact_bis: Sa udto, mas paspas mainit ang yuta kay sa dagat busa ubos ang presyon sa yuta ug mohuros ang bugnaw nga hangin gikan sa dagat padulong sa baybayon.

q: What gives some hot spring water its bright yellow, orange, or blue color?
options: Minerals and tiny bacteria living in the very hot water
Algae that grow only in cold water and dye it as they die
Dissolved volcanic ash that changes color when heated
Sunlight reflecting differently off deep underground pools
explanation: Hot spring water is sometimes brightly colored because of minerals and tiny bacteria that live in the very hot water.
fact_tl: Minsan makulay ang tubig sa hot spring — dilaw, kahel, o asul — dahil sa mga mineral at maliliit na bakterya na nakatira sa napakainit na tubig.
fact_bis: Usahay mabulukon ang tubig sa hot spring — dalag, kahil, o asul — tungod sa mga mineral ug gagmay nga bakterya nga nagpuyo sa init kaayo nga tubig.

q: Why are there more young fish near shores with mangroves than near bare sandy shores?
options: Mangroves provide shelter and food that young fish need to survive
Sandy shores have stronger currents that wash young fish away
Mangrove roots release chemicals that attract fish from the open sea
Fish prefer dark water, and mangroves block sunlight from reaching the shore
explanation: Shores with mangroves have far more young fish because the mangroves provide shelter and food, showing the mangrove itself is the reason fish numbers are higher.
fact_tl: Kung ihahambing ang baybaying may bakawan sa baybaying buhangin lang at walang halaman, mas marami ang batang isda sa may bakawan. Ito ay dahil may taguan at pagkain doon. Pinatutunayan nito na ang bakawan mismo ang dahilan kung bakit dumarami ang isda.
fact_bis: Kung itandi ang baybayon nga naa'y bakawan sa baybayon nga balas lang ug walay tanom, mas daghan ang batan-ong isda sa naa'y bakawan. Tungod kini sa katagoan ug pagkaon didto. Nagpamatuod kini nga ang bakawan mismo ang hinungdan nga modaghan ang isda.

q: What is the hard outer shell of a shrimp called?
options: An exoskeleton
An endoskeleton
A carapace fin
A scale plate
explanation: A shrimp has a hard shell on the outside called an exoskeleton that protects its soft body.
fact_tl: Ang hipon ay may matigas na balat sa labas na tinatawag na exoskeleton na nagsisilbing panangga sa malambot nitong katawan.
fact_bis: Ang hipon adunay gahi nga panit sa gawas nga gitawag exoskeleton nga nagpanalipod sa humok niini nga lawas.

q: How does light help you see when it enters your eye?
options: Light enters through the pupil and an image forms at the back of the eye
Light is absorbed by the colored part of the eye and converted into signals
Light bounces off the lens and travels back out, creating a mirror image
Light is filtered by the eyelashes before reaching the retina
explanation: The eye is the organ we use for sight; light enters through the pupil and an image forms at the back of the eye so we can see.
fact_tl: Ang mata ang organ na ginagamit natin sa paningin; pumapasok ang liwanag sa balintataw at nabubuo ang larawan sa likod ng mata para makakita tayo.
fact_bis: Ang mata mao ang organ nga gamiton nato sa panan-aw; mosulod ang kahayag sa kalimutaw ug maporma ang hulagway sa likod sa mata aron makakita kita.

q: Which mountain range is the longest in the world, and where is it?
options: The Andes in South America, about 7,000 km long
The Himalayas in Asia, about 5,000 km long
The Rockies in North America, about 6,000 km long
The Alps in Europe, about 4,000 km long
explanation: The Andes in South America is the longest mountain range in the world, about 7,000 kilometers long.
fact_tl: Ang Andes sa South America ang pinakamahabang bulubundukin sa mundo, halos 7,000 kilometro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang Andes sa South America mao ang pinakahaba nga kabukiran sa kalibutan, mga 7,000 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: Why does the Philippines run mangrove replanting programs?
options: To protect coastlines from typhoons, support fisheries, and store carbon
To create new tourist beaches by clearing old mangrove areas
To grow wood for furniture and house construction
To provide nesting areas for deep-sea fish species
explanation: The Philippines has mangrove replanting programs to restore coastal ecosystems because mangroves protect coastlines from typhoons, support fisheries, and store significant amounts of carbon.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may mga programa ng pagtatanim ng bakawan para maibalik ang mga nasirang coastal ecosystem—ang mga bakawan ay nagpoprotekta sa dalampasigan laban sa bagyo at nagtatago ng carbon.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay mga programa sa pagtanom og bakawan aron mabawi ang mga nadaot nga coastal ecosystem; ang bakawan nagprotekta sa baybayon gikan sa bagyo, nagtabang sa pangisda, ug nagtago og dako nga carbon.

q: Which of the following is a weak acid found naturally in a living thing?
options: Citric acid in calamansi
Muriatic acid in cleaning products
Sulfuric acid in car batteries
Hydrochloric acid in volcanic gases
explanation: Many weak acids occur naturally in living things, such as citric acid in calamansi, acetic acid in vinegar, and lactic acid in souring milk.
fact_tl: Maraming mahinang acid ang likas na matatagpuan sa mga buhay na bagay, tulad ng citric acid sa kalamansi, acetic acid sa suka, at lactic acid sa naaasim na gatas.
fact_bis: Daghang huyang nga acid ang natural nga makita sa mga buhi nga butang, sama sa citric acid sa kalamansi, acetic acid sa suka, ug lactic acid sa naaslom nga gatas.

q: What do new queen ants do when they are ready to start their own colony?
options: They grow wings and fly away to find a new place to start a colony.
They dig deeper tunnels inside the old colony to lay their eggs.
They fight the old queen and take over the existing colony.
They stay underground and wait for worker ants to build them a new nest.
explanation: New queen ants have wings and use them to fly away from the old colony to start a brand-new one.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagong reyna ay may pakpak at lumilipad para magsimula ng bagong kolonya.
fact_bis: Ang mga bag-ong reyna adunay pako ug molupad aron magsugod og bag-ong kolonya.

q: How small are the parts inside computer chips and phone chips?
options: They are as small as a grain of sand.
They are only a few atoms wide.
They are about as thin as a human hair.
They are smaller than a water droplet but larger than atoms.
explanation: The chips inside phones and laptops are built from parts only a few atoms wide, which is why understanding atoms matters for modern technology.
fact_tl: Ang mga computer chip sa cellphone at laptop ay gawa ng mga bahaging napakaliit, halos sukat na ng ilang atomo. Kaya gumagana ang teknolohiyang ginagamit natin araw-araw sa Pilipinas dahil sa pag-unawa sa atomo.
fact_bis: Ang mga chip sa sulod sa cellphone ug laptop hinimo sa mga bahin nga gamay kaayo, halos pipila na lang ka atomo ang gilapdon. Mao nga molihok ang teknolohiya nga atong gamiton kada adlaw tungod sa pagsabot sa atomo.

q: What is the capital of the province of Tawi-Tawi?
options: Zamboanga City
Marawi
Bongao
Cotabato City
explanation: Tawi-Tawi is a province in the BARMM region of Mindanao, and its capital is Bongao.
fact_tl: Ang Tawi-Tawi ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), na bahagi ng Mindanao. Ang kabisera nito ay Bongao.
fact_bis: Ang Tawi-Tawi usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), nga bahin sa Mindanao. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Bongao.

q: During typhoons or floods in the Philippines, what happens to feeding programs?
options: Feeding programs are paused until schools reopen after the disaster.
Only hospitals run feeding programs for sick patients during a disaster.
Feeding programs are also run in evacuation centers so displaced families still have food to eat.
Government stores hand out raw ingredients so families can cook on their own.
explanation: During disasters like typhoons or floods, feeding programs extend to evacuation centers where community meals are cooked or ready food is distributed to families who lost their homes.
fact_tl: Bukod sa paaralan, may mga feeding program din na isinasagawa tuwing may sakuna gaya ng bagyo o baha. Sa mga evacuation center, naglulutong-bayan o nagbibigay ng handang pagkain para masiguro na may makakain ang mga pamilyang nawalan ng tahanan o pagkain.
fact_bis: Gawas sa eskwelahan, adunay mga feeding program usab nga gihimo kada adunay katalagman sama sa bagyo o baha. Sa mga evacuation center, nagaluto-bayan o naghatag og andam nga pagkaon aron masiguro nga adunay makaon ang mga pamilya nga nawad-an og puluy-anan o pagkaon.

q: How does a crab breathe?
options: It uses tiny air pockets trapped under its shell to breathe oxygen.
It absorbs oxygen directly through its hard outer shell.
It has gills tucked inside its shell that take in oxygen from water.
It breathes through small holes on the underside of its body.
explanation: A crab has gills inside its shell that absorb oxygen from water, and as long as the gills stay moist the crab can even breathe out of water for a while.
fact_tl: Paano huminga ang alimango? May mga hasang (gills) ito sa loob ng talukab na sumisipsip ng oxygen mula sa tubig. Basta basa ang hasang, kaya rin nitong huminga sa lupa sandali, kaya minsan nakikita mong nagbubula ang alimango.
fact_bis: Unsaon paghinga sa alimango? Naa kini mga hasang (gills) sulod sa talukab nga mosuyop og oxygen gikan sa tubig. Basta basa ang hasang, makaginhawa pa kini sa yuta sa makadiyot, mao nga usahay makita nimong mubuga og bula ang alimango.

q: Even though vaccines can use a weakened germ, a killed germ, or just a piece of a germ, what do they all have in common?
options: They all give the body a small dose of the disease so it can recover naturally.
They all teach the body to make antibodies to fight the germ.
They all use the same type of virus protein to trigger immunity.
They all work by replacing damaged white blood cells with healthy ones.
explanation: No matter which type of material they use, all vaccines teach the body to produce antibodies that protect against the real germ.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng bakuna: ang ilan ay gawa sa pinahinang germ, ang iba ay sa patay na germ, at ang iba ay sa isang piraso lamang ng germ, ngunit lahat ay nagtuturo sa katawan na gumawa ng antibodies.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing klase sa bakuna: ang uban gikan sa gipahuyang nga germ, ang uban gikan sa patay nga germ, ug ang uban gikan lang sa usa ka bahin sa germ, apan tanan kini motudlo sa lawas nga mohimo og antibodies.

q: Why would a jar full of sprouting seeds feel slightly warm inside?
options: Sprouting seeds absorb sunlight and convert it to heat energy stored in the jar.
Germinating seeds carry out respiration using oxygen, which gives off heat.
The seeds release stored water as steam, which warms the inside of the jar.
Fermentation by soil bacteria in the jar produces the warmth you feel.
explanation: Germinating seeds respire using oxygen and release heat as a result, making a jar of sprouting seeds feel warm.
fact_tl: Ang tumutubong buto ay humihinga gamit ang oxygen at naglalabas ng init, kaya kapag inilagay sa garapon ay nararamdaman ang bahagyang pag-init.
fact_bis: Ang nagtubo nga mga liso naginhawa gamit ang oxygen ug nagbuga ug kainit, busa ang garapon nga adunay nagtubo nga liso mobati nga init sa sulod.

q: What is the chemical formula of nitrogen gas, and why is it important to know about air?
options: N — a single nitrogen atom — and it makes up a small fraction of air.
N2 — two nitrogen atoms bonded together — and it is the most common gas in air.
N3 — three nitrogen atoms — and it is the second most common gas in air.
NO — one nitrogen and one oxygen atom — and it is the main gas in fresh air.
explanation: Nitrogen gas has the formula N2 (two nitrogen atoms) and is the most abundant gas in Earth's air.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng nitrogen gas ay N2, dalawang atomo ng naytroheno; ito ang pinakamarami sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa nitrogen gas kay N2, duha ka atomo sa naytroheno; mao kini ang labing daghan nga gas sa hangin.

q: What is the special ability called when deep-sea animals produce their own light?
options: Photosynthesis
Phosphorescence
Bioluminescence
Chemoluminescence
explanation: Many deep-sea animals can make their own light, and this ability is called bioluminescence.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa malalim na dagat ang gumagawa ng sariling ilaw, isang kakayahang tinatawag na bioluminescence.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sa lawom nga dagat ang naghimo sa ilang kaugalingong suga, usa ka katakos nga gitawag og bioluminescence.

q: What does a Punnett square tell a scientist about inherited traits?
options: It shows exactly which trait every offspring will have.
It shows only the chance (probability) of getting a trait, not a certainty.
It maps out all the genes on every chromosome of an organism.
It tells which parent will pass on the dominant trait to the child.
explanation: A Punnett square shows only the probability of inheriting a trait; it cannot say for certain what trait any individual offspring will have.
fact_tl: Ang Punnett square ay nagpapakita ng tsansa lamang, kaya hindi nito tiyak na masasabi kung anong katangian ang makukuha ng anak.
fact_bis: Ang Punnett square nagpakita lamang sa higayon, busa dili niini masulti og sigurado kon unsang kinaiya ang makuha sa anak.

q: How many chambers does the human heart have, and how are they arranged?
options: Two chambers — one atrium on top and one ventricle on the bottom.
Three chambers — two atria and one large ventricle.
Four chambers — two atria on top and two ventricles on the bottom.
Four chambers — two ventricles on top and two atria on the bottom.
explanation: The heart has four chambers: two atria on the upper part and two ventricles on the lower part.
fact_tl: Ang puso ay may apat na silid: dalawang atria sa itaas at dalawang ventricle sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang kasingkasing adunay upat ka lawak: duha ka atria sa ibabaw ug duha ka ventricle sa ubos.

q: Why is dissolving sugar in water considered a physical change rather than a chemical change?
options: Because the sugar turns into a completely different substance when it mixes with water.
Because the sugar molecules are destroyed and cannot be recovered.
Because the sugar can be recovered if the water is evaporated, meaning no new substance was made.
Because no energy is needed to dissolve the sugar in water.
explanation: Dissolving sugar in water is a physical change because the sugar is still sugar — evaporate the water and you get the sugar back.
fact_tl: Ang pagtunaw ng asukal sa tubig ay pisikal na pagbabago lamang; kung sisingawin ang tubig, babalik ang asukal.
fact_bis: Ang pagtunaw sa asukal sa tubig usa lamang ka pisikal nga pagbag-o; kon paalisngawon ang tubig, mobalik ang asukal.

q: Why is estivation more common than hibernation for animals in the Philippines?
options: Because the Philippines has very long winters that force animals to sleep through the cold.
Because the Philippines has no winter, so the harsh season is the hot dry season, which triggers estivation.
Because Philippine animals are too small to store enough fat for hibernation.
Because the warm ocean keeps Philippine temperatures too mild for any kind of dormancy.
explanation: The Philippines has no winter, so the difficult season is the hot dry season, making estivation (not hibernation) the relevant survival strategy here.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas na walang taglamig, mas posibleng makita ang estivation kaysa hibernation dahil ang mahirap na panahon dito ay ang mainit na tag-init.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas nga walay tingtugnaw, mas lagmit makita ang estivation kaysa hibernation kay ang lisod nga panahon dinhi mao ang init nga tig-init.

q: How does the rounded shape of a cactus help it survive in the desert?
options: It lets the cactus collect more rainwater by directing drops toward the roots.
It reduces the amount of heat the cactus takes in, so it loses less water.
It makes the cactus harder for animals to bite through and eat.
It spreads the cactus spines farther apart so sunlight can reach every part.
explanation: The rounded shape of many cacti absorbs less heat from the sun, which helps the plant retain more water in the dry desert.
fact_tl: Ang bilugang hugis ng maraming kaktus ay nakatutulong na makakuha ito ng mas kaunting init kaya mas kaunti ang tubig na nawawala.
fact_bis: Ang lingin nga porma sa daghang kaktus makakuha og gamay nga init, busa gamay ang tubig nga mawala.

q: What is one important use of ipil-ipil wood in the Philippines?
options: It is carved into furniture because it is the hardest wood in the country.
It is burned to make charcoal used for cooking and heating.
It is ground into flour to make traditional Filipino bread.
It is soaked in water to make a medicinal drink for fever.
explanation: Ipil-ipil wood is turned into charcoal that is widely used for cooking and heating.
fact_tl: Ang kahoy ng ipil-ipil ay ginagawang uling na ginagamit sa pagluluto at pagpapainit.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy sa ipil-ipil gihimong uling nga gigamit sa pagluto ug pagpainit.

q: After using electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen, what happens if you try to split the pure oxygen further?
options: The oxygen splits into two simpler oxygen forms called alpha and beta oxygen.
The oxygen breaks down into heat and light energy with enough electricity.
You cannot break pure oxygen down into any simpler substance because it is already an element.
The oxygen combines with water vapor in the air to form a new compound.
explanation: Elements like oxygen cannot be broken into simpler substances even by electrolysis because they are already the most basic form of matter.
fact_tl: Kahit gamitin ang kuryente sa electrolysis para hatiin ang tubig sa hydrogen at oxygen, hindi mo mahahati ang purong oxygen pa sa anumang mas simpleng sangkap.
fact_bis: Bisan gamiton ang kuryente sa electrolysis aron bahinon ang tubig ngadto sa hydrogen ug oxygen, dili nimo mabahin ang lunsay nga oxygen ngadto sa bisan unsa nga mas yano.

q: How is an insect-made gall on a plant different from a plant disease?
options: A gall always kills the plant, while a disease only makes it look sick.
A gall is a natural seed pod, while a disease destroys the plant's leaves.
A gall is caused by an insect and forms a swelling, but it is not the same as a plant disease even though both can cause swellings.
A gall only appears on fruit, while plant diseases affect only the stem and leaves.
explanation: An insect-made gall and a plant disease can both cause swellings on a plant, but they are different things — the gall is triggered by an insect, not by a pathogen.
fact_tl: Ang gall na gawa ng insekto ay iba sa sakit ng halaman, kahit pareho silang nagpapalaki ng bukol.
fact_bis: Ang gall nga gibuhat sa insekto lahi sa sakit sa tanom, bisan pa nga pareho silang makapatubo ug bukol.

q: When a red four o'clock flower (Mirabilis jalapa) is crossed with a white one, what color are the offspring flowers?
options: Red, because red is the dominant color.
White, because white is the recessive color that shows up when mixed.
Pink, because neither red nor white is fully dominant over the other.
Purple, because mixing red and white pigments always produces purple in plants.
explanation: The four o'clock flower shows incomplete dominance — crossing red with white produces pink offspring because neither color fully dominates the other.
fact_tl: Ang four o'clock flower (Mirabilis jalapa) ay nagpapakita ng incomplete dominance — kapag ang isang pulang bulaklak ay tinatawid sa isang puti, ang mga anak ay rosas ang kulay, hindi pula o puti.
fact_bis: Ang four o'clock flower (Mirabilis jalapa) nagpakita sa incomplete dominance — sa dihang ang usa ka pulang bulak gitabok sa usa ka puti, ang mga kaliwat adunay rosas nga kolor sa bulak, dili pula o puti.

q: Why do many dugongs gather in the waters around Palawan?
options: The warm deep water around Palawan shelters dugongs from sharks and other predators.
Palawan has many coral reefs where dugongs find small fish and shrimp to eat.
The water around Palawan is clear and shallow with plenty of healthy seagrass for dugongs to eat.
Dugongs migrate to Palawan each year because its beaches are quiet and undisturbed.
explanation: Dugongs gather around Palawan because the clear, shallow waters there are full of healthy seagrass, which is their main food.
fact_tl: Marami ang dugong sa Palawan dahil malinaw at mababaw doon ang tubig at marami ang malulusog na damong-dagat na pagkain nila.
fact_bis: Daghan ang dugong sa Palawan tungod kay tin-aw ug mabaw ang tubig didto ug daghan ang himsog nga sagbot sa dagat nga ilang kan-on.

q: What happens to a B cell in the immune system when it recognizes a matching antigen?
options: It immediately destroys the antigen by releasing digestive enzymes onto it.
It sends a signal to the brain to raise body temperature to kill the germ.
It activates and turns into a plasma cell that mass-produces antibodies.
It shrinks into a memory cell and waits for a second infection before acting.
explanation: When a B cell meets its matching antigen, it activates and differentiates into a plasma cell specialized to produce large numbers of antibodies.
fact_tl: Kapag nakilala ng isang B cell ang isang antigen, ito ay nag-activate at nagiging plasma cell — ang plasma cell ay isang uri ng B cell na nagmamanipula ng malaking halaga ng mga antibody.
fact_bis: Kung mailhan sa usa ka B cell ang usa ka antigen, nag-activate kini ug nahimong plasma cell — ang plasma cell usa ka B cell nga espesyalista sa paghimo og daghang mga antibody.

q: Why does a falling object keep moving faster and faster as it falls?
options: Because air pushes it downward and adds to its speed.
Because it loses weight as it falls, making it easier to speed up.
Because gravity keeps pulling on it continuously, adding speed every moment.
Because the ground creates a force that pulls the object down faster.
explanation: A falling object speeds up continuously because gravity keeps acting on it throughout the entire fall.
fact_tl: Habang bumabagsak ang isang bagay, patuloy itong bumibilis dahil sa tuloy-tuloy na paghila ng grabidad.
fact_bis: Samtang nahulog ang usa ka butang, padayon kining modali tungod sa nagpadayon nga pagbira sa grabidad.

q: What makes Kingdom Monera different from all other kingdoms of living things?
options: Members of Monera are the only living things that cannot reproduce on their own.
Members of Monera are bacteria that have no true nucleus inside their cells.
Members of Monera are multicellular organisms that live only in soil and water.
Members of Monera are the only kingdom whose members can survive without oxygen.
explanation: Kingdom Monera is made up of bacteria, which are unique because their cells have no true nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang kahariang Monera ay binubuo ng bakterya na napakaliit at walang tunay na nucleus sa loob ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang gingharian nga Monera gilangkob sa bakterya nga gagmay kaayo ug walay tinuod nga nucleus sa ilang selula.

q: Why do many metamorphic rocks have visible bands or stripes?
options: The stripes form when layers of sediment are pressed together over millions of years.
The bands appear when lava cools at different speeds inside a volcanic chamber.
The minerals line up in parallel layers under the strong pressure that creates metamorphic rocks.
The stripes are caused by different-colored chemicals seeping through cracks in the rock.
explanation: Metamorphic rocks show bands or stripes because intense pressure forces the minerals inside to line up in the same direction.
fact_tl: Maraming metamorphic na bato ang may makikitang guhit-guhit na banda dahil naghahanay ang mga mineral sa ilalim ng matinding presyon.
fact_bis: Daghang metamorphic nga bato ang adunay makita nga mga banda o guhit kay ang mga mineral maghan-ay ubos sa kusog nga presyon.

q: In what form does carbon exist in the air around us?
options: As pure carbon particles floating as dark dust.
As carbon monoxide (CO), a colorless gas.
As carbon dioxide (CO2), a colorless gas.
As carbonic acid droplets mixed into water vapor.
explanation: In the air, carbon is found as the gas carbon dioxide (CO2).
fact_tl: Sa hangin, ang karbon ay nasa anyo ng gas na carbon dioxide o CO2.
fact_bis: Sa hangin, ang karbon anaa sa porma sa gas nga gitawag carbon dioxide o CO2.

q: How does a mother spider protect her eggs?
options: She buries the eggs underground and guards the entrance of the burrow.
She attaches the eggs to leaf surfaces using a sticky liquid from her body.
She wraps the eggs in a protective silk sac she spins herself.
She keeps the eggs inside her body until they are ready to hatch.
explanation: A mother spider uses silk to spin a protective sac around her eggs to keep them safe.
fact_tl: Ginagamit din ng inahing gagamba ang sutla upang gumawa ng supot na pananggalang sa kanyang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Gamiton usab sa inahan nga lawalawa ang sutla aron maghimo ug supot nga panalipod sa iyang mga itlog.

q: What is one advantage that fossil fuels still have over renewable energy sources like solar and wind?
options: Fossil fuels produce more electricity per hour than all renewable sources combined.
Fossil fuels are cleaner and produce less waste than wind or solar energy.
Fossil fuels are easy to store and can be used any time, unlike solar or wind which depend on weather.
Fossil fuels are cheaper to build power plants for than renewable energy systems.
explanation: Even though fossil fuels run out and pollute the air, they have the advantage of being easy to store and available any time, unlike solar or wind energy which depend on sunlight or wind.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng fossil fuels na nauubos at nagdudumi sa hangin, ang renewable energy gaya ng solar at hangin ay hindi nauubos at mas malinis — ngunit ang fossil fuels ay madali pang itago at gamitin anumang oras.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa fossil fuels nga mahurot ug mohugaw sa hangin, ang renewable energy sama sa solar ug hangin dili mahurot ug mas hinlo — apan ang fossil fuels sayon pa tipigan ug gamiton bisan unsang orasa.

q: Why do dengue fever cases increase during the rainy season in the Philippines?
options: Rainwater lowers body temperature, making people more vulnerable to the dengue virus.
Mosquitoes die during dry weather but are reborn in large numbers during heavy rains.
More collected (standing) water is available for mosquitoes to lay their eggs in.
The rainy season drives people indoors where mosquitoes are more concentrated.
explanation: Dengue cases rise in the rainy season because rainwater collects in containers and puddles, giving mosquitoes more places to lay their eggs.
fact_tl: Dumadami ang kaso ng dengue tuwing tag-ulan dahil mas maraming naiipong tubig na pinangingitlugan ng lamok.
fact_bis: Modaghan ang kaso sa dengue panahon sa ting-ulan kay mas daghan ang natipong tubig nga pangitlogan sa lamok.

q: What is the scientific name of the yeast commonly used in making both bread and beer?
options: Lactobacillus acidophilus
Aspergillus niger
Saccharomyces cerevisiae
Penicillium roqueforti
explanation: The yeast used in bread and beer is usually the same species, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, which means 'sugar-eating fungus.'
