fact_tl: Ang lebadurang ginagamit sa tinapay at sa serbesa ay kadalasang iisang uri na may siyentipikong pangalang Saccharomyces cerevisiae, na nangangahulugang 'fungus na kumakain ng asukal.'
fact_bis: Ang lebadura nga gigamit sa pan ug sa serbesa kasagaran usa ra ka espisye nga ginganlan og Saccharomyces cerevisiae, nga nagpasabot og 'fungus nga mokaon og asukal.'

q: How does convection move heat through boiling water?
options: Heat travels in straight rays from the bottom of the pot to the top of the water.
Warm water sinks to the bottom and cool water rises to the top in a circular flow.
Heated water rises because it becomes lighter, and cooler water sinks, making heat circulate.
Tiny heat particles spread evenly in all directions through the still water.
explanation: In convection, heated water becomes lighter and rises while cooler water sinks, creating a circulation that spreads heat through the liquid.
fact_tl: Sa kombeksyon, umaakyat ang pinainit na tubig o hangin dahil ito ay mas magaan, at bumababa naman ang mas malamig, kaya umiikot ang init sa loob ng kumukulong tubig.
fact_bis: Sa konveksyon, ang gipainit nga tubig o hangin mosaka kay mas gaan kini, samtang ang mas bugnaw mounlod, mao nga ang init magtuyok sulod sa nagbukal nga tubig.

q: What is the main difference between nuclear fission and nuclear fusion?
options: Fission uses hydrogen atoms while fusion uses uranium atoms.
Fission happens only in the sun while fusion happens only in nuclear power plants.
Fission splits an atom apart while fusion joins atoms together — they are opposites.
Fission releases cold energy while fusion releases heat energy.
explanation: Fission splits an atom apart and fusion joins atoms together, making them opposite nuclear processes.
fact_tl: Ang fission ay paghahati ng atomo, habang ang fusion ay pagsasama ng mga atomo — magkasalungat sila.
fact_bis: Ang fission nagpikas sa atomo, samtang ang fusion naghiusa sa mga atomo — managlahi sila.

q: When and where did Hidilyn Diaz win her historic Olympic gold medal?
options: At the Rio de Janeiro Olympics in 2016.
At the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.
At the Paris Olympics in 2024.
At the Beijing Olympics in 2008.
explanation: Hidilyn Diaz won her Olympic gold medal at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, becoming the first Filipino Olympic gold medalist.
fact_tl: Nanalo si Hidilyn Diaz ng gintong medalya sa Tokyo Olympics noong 2021.
fact_bis: Nakadaog si Hidilyn Diaz ug bulawang medalya sa Tokyo Olympics niadtong 2021.

q: Where is Maria Cristina Falls located, and approximately how tall is it?
options: It is in Davao City and is about 150 meters tall.
It is in Iligan City and is about 98 meters tall.
It is in Cagayan de Oro and is about 75 meters tall.
It is in Zamboanga City and is about 120 meters tall.
explanation: Maria Cristina Falls is located in Iligan and stands at about 98 meters, making it one of the highest waterfalls in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan ay isa sa pinakamatataas na talon sa Pilipinas sa halos 98 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan, nga mga 98 metros, usa sa pinakataas nga busay sa Pilipinas.

q: Why is the chemical symbol for tungsten W instead of T or Tu?
options: W stands for 'Wolfram,' the older name for tungsten from which its symbol is taken.
W was chosen because tungsten was first discovered in Washington, USA.
W stands for 'Weighty Metal,' describing how dense tungsten is.
The symbol W was picked randomly when the periodic table was first organized.
explanation: The chemical symbol for tungsten is W because it comes from 'wolfram,' the historical name for this element.
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng tungsten ay W, mula sa pangalang 'wolfram'.
fact_bis: Ang simbolong kemikal sa tungsten kay W, gikan sa ngalan nga 'wolfram'.

q: How does an mRNA vaccine protect you from a virus without giving you the actual disease?
options: It injects a weakened form of the virus so your body can fight a mild version of the infection.
It adds protective antibodies directly into your bloodstream without involving your cells.
It instructs your cells to make a small viral protein so your immune system learns to recognize the virus.
It uses a piece of the virus's outer coat injected under the skin to trigger an allergic response.
explanation: mRNA vaccines give cells instructions to make a small harmless viral protein, training the immune system to recognize the real virus without causing infection.
fact_tl: Ang mRNA vaccines ay nagtuturo sa ating mga selula na gumawa ng maliit na bahagi ng virus (tulad ng spike protein) upang mapaunlak ng immune system ang virus nang hindi kailangang mahawa.
fact_bis: Ang mRNA vaccines nagatudlo sa atong mga selula aron makagama og gamay nga viral protein aron makat-on ang immune system sa pag-ila sa virus nga walay tinuod nga impeksyon.

q: What happened to the moa, the giant flightless bird of New Zealand?
options: It evolved into the modern kiwi bird, which is much smaller today.
It migrated to Australia when New Zealand's forests were cut down.
It is now extinct — it no longer exists anywhere in the world.
It survives in small numbers in protected forests in New Zealand.
explanation: The moa was a giant flightless bird that once lived in New Zealand but is now extinct.
fact_tl: Ang moa ay higanteng ibong hindi makalipad na dating naninirahan sa New Zealand ngunit naglaho na ngayon.
fact_bis: Ang moa usa ka higante nga langgam nga dili makalupad nga kaniadto nagpuyo sa New Zealand apan wala na karon.

q: What do insects, spiders, and crabs all have in common?
options: They are all insects because they all have six legs and an exoskeleton.
They are all mollusks because they have hard outer coverings protecting their soft bodies.
They are all arthropods — animals with a hard exoskeleton and jointed legs.
They are all crustaceans because they shed their outer shell as they grow.
explanation: Insects, spiders, and crabs are all arthropods, which means they share a hard outer shell (exoskeleton) and jointed legs.
fact_tl: Ang mga insekto, gagamba, at alimango ay lahat arthropods — mga hayop na may panlabas na balat (exoskeleton) at mga paa na may buko-buko.
fact_bis: Ang mga insekto, lawalawa, ug alimango tanan arthropods — mga hayop nga adunay gahi nga panggawas nga balat (exoskeleton) ug tiil nga adunay buko-buko.

q: What does the full name of the Katipunan mean in English?
options: The Brotherhood of the Sons of the Philippines United Against Spain.
The Highest and Most Respectable Society of the Sons of the People.
The Secret Association of Filipino Rebels Fighting for Freedom.
The Grand Council of Patriots for the Liberation of the Filipino Nation.
explanation: The Katipunan's full name translates to 'The Highest and Most Respectable Society of the Sons of the People.'
fact_tl: Ang buong pangalan ng Katipunan ay Kataastaasang Kagalanggalang na Katipunan ng mga Anak ng Bayan.
fact_bis: Ang tibuok ngalan sa Katipunan mao ang Kataas-taasan ug Halangdon nga Katilingban sa mga Anak sa Nasud.

q: What would you see if you sliced a large hailstone in half?
options: A solid block of clear ice with no internal structure.
Layers of ice like the rings of an onion, formed by multiple trips up and down inside the storm cloud.
A hollow center surrounded by a thin shell of ice.
Tiny air bubbles arranged in a spiral pattern from the center outward.
explanation: Cutting a hailstone in half reveals onion-like layers of ice — each layer represents one more cycle the hailstone made up and down inside the cold storm cloud.
fact_tl: Kung hahatiin mo ang isang malaking butil ng hail, makikita mo ang mga patong-patong na yelo na parang sibuyas — bawat patong ay isang pagtaas-pagbaba nito sa loob ng malamig na ulap bago tuluyang bumagsak.
fact_bis: Kon imong tunga-tungaon ang usa ka dako nga hail, makita nimo ang sapaw-sapaw nga yelo nga morag sibuyas — matag sapaw usa ka biyahe niini pasaka ug paubos sulod sa bugnaw nga panganod una kini nahulog.

q: What are El Nino and La Nina in relation to each other?
options: El Nino and La Nina are different names for the same weather event happening in different ocean basins.
El Nino is a rainy season and La Nina is a dry season that alternate every year in the Philippines.
El Nino and La Nina are two opposite phases of the ENSO cycle, where the Pacific Ocean surface water repeatedly warms and cools.
El Nino is caused by the sun and La Nina is caused by ocean currents pulling warm water away from the coast.
explanation: El Nino and La Nina are the two opposite phases of ENSO — one warms the central Pacific surface water and the other cools it.
fact_tl: Ang El Niño at La Niña ay dalawang magkasalungat na bahagi ng isang siklo na tinatawag na ENSO (El Niño–Southern Oscillation), kung saan paulit-ulit na nag-iinit at lumalamig ang ibabaw ng tubig sa gitnang at silangang Pacific Ocean.
fact_bis: Ang El Niño ug La Niña mao ang duha ka magkasumpaki nga bahin sa usa ka siklo nga gitawag ENSO (El Niño–Southern Oscillation), diin balik-balik nga moinit ug mobugnaw ang ibabaw nga tubig sa tunga ug sidlakang Pacific Ocean.

q: Why is a tsunami's run-up height on land always greater than its wave height out at sea?
options: Tsunamis speed up when they hit land, which increases the water level higher than the original wave.
The weight of sand on the seafloor pushes the wave up higher as it approaches the coast.
The shape of the coast amplifies the wave — especially funnel-shaped bays — so water climbs higher on land than the wave height at sea.
Tsunamis absorb extra water from rivers as they travel inland, making them taller on shore.
explanation: Tsunami run-up is always higher than wave height at sea because the coastal shape amplifies the wave, with funnel-shaped bays causing even more amplification.
fact_tl: Ang 'run-up' ng tsunami ay kung gaano kataas ang tubig na aakyat sa lupa pagkatapos marating ng alon ang baybayin; ito ay lagi na mas mataas kaysa sa taas ng alon sa dagat dahil ang bentoryan ng baybayin ay nagpapalaki nito; ang mabalikat na mga baybayin ay nagpapalaki ng run-up nang higit sa patag na mga baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang tsunami 'run-up' mao kung unsa kataas ang tubig nga moakyat sa yuta human maabot sa balod ang baybayon; kini kanunay mas taas kaysa taas sa balod sa dagat tungod kay ang hitsura sa baybayon nagpadako niini; ang hugis-pungko nga mga bay nagpadako sa run-up nga mas labaw kaysa bukas ug patag nga mga baybayon.

q: How did indigenous Filipinos traditionally know when to plant and harvest their crops?
options: They followed a written calendar passed down by Spanish missionaries during the colonial period.
They used the position of stars and phases of the moon to find the right time for planting and harvesting.
They relied on the color of the sky at sunrise to predict the best farming days of the year.
They counted the number of rainy days each season and planted after a fixed number of dry days.
explanation: Indigenous Filipinos used the positions of stars and the phases of the moon as a guide for determining the right times to plant and harvest crops.
fact_tl: Ginamit ng mga katutubong Pilipino ang posisyon ng mga bituin at pagbabago ng buwan upang malaman ang tamang oras ng pagtatanim at pag-aani.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa mga katutubo nga Pilipino ang posisyon sa mga bituin ug pagbag-o sa buwan aron mailhan ang tama nga oras sa pagtanim ug pag-ani sa mga pananim.

q: What material did Robert Hooke look at when he first saw and named 'cells'?
options: A thin slice of onion skin under a simple magnifying glass.
A piece of pond water containing tiny organisms.
A thin slice of cork from the bark of a cork-oak tree.
A sliver of wood from a freshly cut tree trunk.
explanation: Robert Hooke first saw and named 'cells' when he looked at a thin slice of cork, the bark of the cork-oak tree.
fact_tl: Nakita ni Robert Hooke ang mga unang "cell" sa isang manipis na hiwa ng cork (balat ng cork-oak na puno).
fact_bis: Nakita ni Robert Hooke ang unang mga "cell" sa nipis nga hiwa sa cork (ang panit sa kahoy nga cork-oak).

q: Which two kinds of bacteria are commonly used to turn milk into yogurt?
options: Salmonella and Escherichia
Lactobacillus and Streptococcus
Staphylococcus and Bacillus
Clostridium and Listeria
explanation: Lactobacillus and Streptococcus are the two bacteria commonly used in the process of fermenting milk into yogurt.
fact_tl: Dalawang uri ng bakterya, ang Lactobacillus at Streptococcus, ang karaniwang ginagamit upang gawing yogurt ang gatas.
fact_bis: Duha ka klase nga bakterya, ang Lactobacillus ug Streptococcus, ang kasagarang gamiton aron mahimong yogurt ang gatas.

q: Why is winter colder than summer?
options: Earth moves farther from the Sun during winter, so less sunlight reaches the surface.
During winter, the atmosphere is thicker and blocks more of the Sun's heat.
The part of Earth experiencing winter is tilted away from the Sun, so sunlight hits at a slant and the days are shorter.
Winter clouds reflect sunlight back into space, preventing the ground from warming up.
explanation: Winter is colder because that part of Earth is tilted away from the Sun, causing sunlight to hit at a slant over a shorter day.
fact_tl: Mas malamig sa taglamig dahil ang bahaging ito ng mundo ay nakahilig palayo sa Araw, kaya pahilig na tumatama ang sinag at mas maikli ang maaraw na oras.
fact_bis: Mas bugnaw sa tingtugnaw kay kanang bahina sa kalibutan nahilig palayo sa Adlaw, mao nga kiling ang pagtama sa silaw ug mas mubo ang oras nga adlaw.

q: When a ball is thrown through the air (ignoring air resistance), what happens to its horizontal speed during the flight?
options: It gradually slows down because gravity pulls it backward as well as downward.
It increases steadily because the ball gains energy as it moves forward.
It stays the same throughout the flight because no horizontal force acts on it.
It first increases as the ball moves away from the thrower, then decreases near the end.
explanation: Ignoring air resistance, a projectile's horizontal velocity stays constant because there is no horizontal force acting to change it.
fact_tl: Kung wala ang resistensya ng hangin, ang pahalang na bilis ng isang projectile ay nananatiling pareho sa buong paglipad dahil walang pahalang na puwersang nagpapabagal dito.
fact_bis: Kung wala ang resistensya sa hangin, ang pahalang nga katulin sa projectile magpabilin nga pareho sa tibuok paglupad kay walay pahalang nga puwersa nga magpahinay niini.

q: In science, what happens to energy when work is done on an object?
options: Energy is created inside the object to make it move.
Energy is destroyed as it turns into motion within the object.
Energy is transferred from one object to another when work is done.
Energy stays in the same place but changes from heat to movement.
explanation: When work is done, energy is transferred from one object to another — this is the scientific definition of work.
fact_tl: Kapag may nagagawang trabaho, may enerhiyang inililipat mula sa isang bagay patungo sa iba.
fact_bis: Kung naa'y trabaho nga nahimo, naa'y enerhiya nga gibalhin gikan sa usa ka butang ngadto sa lain.

q: Why are fossils sometimes found inside the limestone walls of caves?
options: Limestone formed from crushed shells and coral of ancient sea animals, so fossils got trapped inside it.
Fossils washed into the cave from rivers and stuck to the cave walls over time.
Volcanic ash buried sea animals and slowly turned into limestone inside caves.
Ancient people carved fossils into cave walls to decorate them.
explanation: Limestone is made from the crushed shells and coral of ancient sea animals, which is why fossils can be found preserved inside it.
fact_tl: Ang limestone na bumubuo ng maraming kweba ay galing sa mga durog na kabibe at coral ng mga hayop sa dagat noong sinaunang panahon, kaya minsan ay may fossil sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang limestone nga nagporma sa daghang langob naggikan sa nadugmok nga mga kabhang ug coral sa karaang mga mananap sa dagat, mao nga usahay adunay fossil sa sulod niini.

q: How is charcoal made from wood?
options: Wood is burned inside a covered mound with very little air so it turns into nearly pure carbon instead of burning away completely.
Wood is soaked in water for many weeks until it becomes dark and hard like charcoal.
Wood is ground into powder, pressed into blocks, and baked in a regular oven at high heat.
Wood is left underground for thousands of years until it slowly changes into charcoal on its own.
explanation: Charcoal is made by burning wood with very little air so it does not burn away completely but turns into nearly pure carbon fuel.
fact_tl: Ang uling ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng pagsunog ng kahoy sa loob ng tinabunang lupa na kakaunti ang hangin, kaya hindi ito tuluyang nasusunog kundi nagiging halos purong carbon na panggatong.
fact_bis: Ang uling ginahimo pinaagi sa pagsunog sa kahoy sulod sa tinabonan nga yuta nga gamay ra og hangin, mao nga dili kini masunog sa hingpit kondili mahimong halos lunsay nga carbon nga panggatong.

q: What happens to the pitch of a violin string when a player slides a finger closer to the body of the instrument?
options: The pitch rises because the vibrating part of the string gets shorter.
The pitch drops because the string gets tighter.
The pitch stays the same because the string length does not change.
The pitch rises because the string gets longer and vibrates more slowly.
explanation: Moving a finger closer to the violin body shortens the string, and a shorter string vibrates faster, which raises the pitch.
fact_tl: Sa violin, kapag idinudulas ng manunugtog ang kanyang daliri palapit sa katawan ng instrumento, pinaiikli niya ang kuwerdas. Kaya tumataas nang tumataas ang tunog habang umuusod ang daliri.
fact_bis: Sa violin, kung idulas sa magtutukar ang iyang tudlo paduol sa lawas sa instrumento, mamubo ang kuwerdas. Mao nga padayon nga mosaka ang tingog samtang molihok ang tudlo.

q: In a very dry area, what most limits how many animals can live there?
options: The amount of drinkable water available.
The number of trees that provide shade.
The size of the land area.
The temperature during the day.
explanation: In a dry place, the amount of drinkable water limits how many animals can survive there.
fact_tl: Sa tuyot na lugar, ang dami ng tubig na maiinom ang naglilimita kung gaano karaming hayop ang mabubuhay.
fact_bis: Sa uga nga lugar, ang gidaghanon sa tubig nga mainom maoy nagalimita kung pila ka hayop ang mabuhi didto.

q: During an endothermic reaction, what happens to the temperature reading on a thermometer?
options: The temperature drops because the reaction absorbs heat from the surroundings.
The temperature rises because the reaction releases heat to the surroundings.
The temperature stays the same because no heat is involved.
The temperature first rises and then slowly drops back to normal.
explanation: In an endothermic reaction, heat is absorbed from the surroundings, which causes the thermometer reading to drop.
fact_tl: Sa endothermic na reaksyon, bumababa ang basa ng termometro dahil sinisipsip ng reaksyon ang init.
fact_bis: Sa endothermic nga reaksyon, monaog ang basa sa termometro kay gisuyop sa reaksyon ang kainit.

q: Why can a bee or wasp sting be dangerous for some people?
options: Some people are allergic to bee or wasp stings, which can cause large swelling or a severe reaction.
Bee and wasp stings carry a deadly virus that spreads through the blood.
The stinger always breaks off inside the skin and causes a serious infection.
The venom from bees and wasps destroys red blood cells in everyone who is stung.
explanation: Some people are allergic to bee or wasp stings, which can cause large swelling or even a severe life-threatening reaction.
fact_tl: Ang ilang tao ay allergic sa kagat ng bubuyog o putakti, na maaaring magdulot ng malaking pamamaga o matinding reaksyon.
fact_bis: Ang ubang tawo allergic sa paak sa buyog o tamboboan, nga mahimong hinungdan sa dako nga paghubag o grabe nga reaksyon.

q: Why do Philippine schools hold earthquake drills?
options: So that children can practice what to do and where to go safely during an earthquake.
So that children can learn how earthquakes form underground.
To test whether the school building is strong enough to survive a big earthquake.
To teach children how to use fire extinguishers and first-aid kits.
explanation: Earthquake drills are held in Philippine schools so that children can practice what to do and where to go safely during an earthquake.
fact_tl: Nagsasagawa ng earthquake drill sa mga paaralan sa Pilipinas para masanay ang mga bata kung ano ang gagawin at saan pupunta nang ligtas kapag may lindol.
fact_bis: Naghimo og earthquake drill sa mga eskwelahan sa Pilipinas aron mabansay ang mga bata kung unsa ang buhaton ug asa moadto nga luwas kung adunay linog.

q: What is the main purpose of bevel gears in a machine?
options: To change the angle at which force is transmitted from one shaft to another.
To increase the speed of rotation without changing direction.
To reduce friction between two smooth metal surfaces.
To store energy and release it gradually over time.
explanation: Bevel gears have conical shapes that allow them to change the direction or angle of force transmission between shafts.
fact_tl: Ang bevel gears ay may kono-konong hugis at ginagamit para baguhin ang anggulo ng shaft ng pagsasalin ng puwersa, tulad ng sa sistema ng drivetrain ng sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang bevel gears adunay conical nga porma ug gigamit aron baguhin ang anggulo sa pagsalin sa puwersa, sama sa drivetrain sa sasakyan.

q: In a parasitic relationship between two organisms, what happens to the host?
options: The host is harmed because the parasite takes nourishment from it.
The host benefits because the parasite cleans away harmful bacteria.
Both the host and parasite benefit equally from the relationship.
The host is unaffected while the parasite slowly grows stronger.
explanation: In parasitism, the parasite benefits by taking nourishment from the host, but the host is harmed in the process.
fact_tl: Sa parasitismo, nakikinabang ang parasito sa pamamagitan ng pagkuha ng sustansiya mula sa host, ngunit napipinsala ang host.
fact_bis: Sa parasitismo, mananaog ang parasito pinaagi sa pagkuha ug sustansya gikan sa host, apan masakitan ang host.

q: What causes very heavy rain lasting many days when the ITCZ lies over the Philippines?
options: The ITCZ is a band of low pressure near the equator where winds from the north and south converge, bringing heavy rain.
The ITCZ is a cold wind from the Pacific Ocean that cools the air over the Philippines and causes rain.
The ITCZ pushes warm ocean water onto land, flooding coastal areas with seawater.
The ITCZ blocks sunlight, causing clouds to form and release rain all at once.
explanation: The ITCZ is a band of low pressure near the equator where converging winds cause heavy, prolonged rainfall when it sits over the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang ITCZ ay isang banda ng mababang presyon malapit sa ekwador kung saan nagsusugatan ang mga hangin mula sa hilaga at timog; kapag ito ay nasa ibabaw ng Pilipinas, nagdudulot ito ng napakamalakas na ulan sa maraming araw.
fact_bis: Ang ITCZ usa ka banda sa ubos nga presyon duol sa ekwador kung diin nagtagbo ang mga hangin gikan sa amihanan ug habagat; sa dihang kini atua sa ibabaw sa Pilipinas, nagdulot kini og napaka-kusog nga ulan nga molungtad og daghang mga adlaw.

q: When a jackfruit seed sprouts, what comes out first?
options: A root that grows down into the soil.
A green shoot that reaches up toward the sun.
Two tiny leaves that open wide right away.
A flower bud that blooms before the plant grows.
explanation: When a jackfruit seed sprouts, the root emerges first and grows into the soil, then a shoot pushes up toward the sun.
fact_tl: Kapag tumutubo ang buto ng langka, lumalabas muna ang ugat papuntang lupa, tapos sumusulpot ang usbong na aakyat papuntang araw.
fact_bis: Kung motubo ang liso sa nangka, mogawas una ang gamot padulong sa yuta, dayon mosulbong ang usbong nga mosaka padulong sa adlaw.

q: Where was Jose Rizal born?
options: Calamba, Laguna
Binan, Laguna
Manila, Metro Manila
Batangas, Batangas
explanation: Jose Rizal was born in Calamba, Laguna on June 19, 1861.
fact_tl: Ipinanganak si Jose Rizal sa Calamba, Laguna noong Hunyo 19, 1861.
fact_bis: Si Jose Rizal natawo sa Calamba, Laguna niadtong Hunyo 19, 1861.

q: A student cannot see the writing on the board clearly but can read a book held close. Which eye condition does this describe?
options: Myopia (nearsightedness), where the image focuses in front of the retina.
Hyperopia (farsightedness), where the image focuses behind the retina.
Astigmatism, where the lens of the eye is shaped unevenly.
Color blindness, where the eye cannot tell certain colors apart.
explanation: Myopia (nearsightedness) means the image focuses in front of the retina, making distant objects blurry while close ones are clear.
fact_tl: Ang myopia o maikling paningin ay nangyayari kapag ang imahe ay natutuon sa harap ng retina; ang hyperopia o malayo ang paningin ay nangyayari kapag ang imahe ay natutuon sa likod ng retina.
fact_bis: Ang myopia mahitabo kung ang hulagway nagtutok sa atubangan sa retina; ang hyperopia mahitabo kung nagtutok kini sa likod sa retina.

q: What kind of plant is cadena de amor, and why do bees visit it?
options: It is a climbing vine with pink flower clusters that bees visit for nectar.
It is a tall tree with yellow flowers that bees visit to collect pollen for honey.
It is a ground plant with red berries that bees eat as food.
It is a water plant with white flowers that bees use to build their hives.
explanation: Cadena de amor is a climbing vine with clusters of pink flowers that bees often visit for nectar.
fact_tl: Ang cadena de amor ay isang gumagapang na baging na may kumpol-kumpol na rosas na bulaklak na malimit dinarayo ng mga bubuyog para sa nektar.
fact_bis: Ang cadena de amor usa ka nagakatay nga baging nga adunay pungpong nga rosas nga bulak nga kanunay duawon sa mga buyog para sa nektar.

q: How does the body fight a germ more quickly the second time it appears?
options: The body remembers the germ from the first infection and can produce antibodies against it much faster.
The germ becomes weaker the second time because it has already been in the body once.
White blood cells grow larger after the first infection so they can trap germs more easily.
The skin thickens after the first infection to stop the same germ from entering again.
explanation: After fighting a germ, the body remembers it so that if the same germ returns, antibodies can be produced much faster to destroy it.
fact_tl: Kapag pumasok ang isang germ, gumagawa ang ilang white blood cells ng antibodies — maliliit na sandata na kumakapit sa germ para masugpo ito. Naaalala ng katawan ang germ na iyon, kaya kung babalik ito, mas mabilis itong malalabanan.
fact_bis: Kung mosulod ang usa ka germ, ang pipila ka white blood cells maghimo og antibodies — gagmayng hinagiban nga mokupot sa germ aron laglagon kini. Mahinumdom ang lawas niadtong germ, busa kung mobalik kini, mas paspas kining masukol.

q: What makes a shark's skeleton different from most other fish?
options: A shark's skeleton is made of cartilage, which is flexible, not hard bone.
A shark's skeleton is made of very thick bone that is harder than most fish bones.
A shark has no skeleton at all; its body is held together only by muscle.
A shark's skeleton is made of a mix of bone and shell, like a crab.
explanation: Unlike most fish, a shark's skeleton is made of cartilage — bendy and flexible — not hard bone.
fact_tl: Ang pating (shark) ay isang isda (fish), pero ang kalansay nito ay gawa sa cartilage — malambot na parang gristle, hindi tigas na buto. Napakatagal nang nabubuhay ng mga pating; mas matanda pa sila kaysa sa mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang iho (shark) usa ka isda, apan ang kalansay niini hinimo sa cartilage — humok nga morag gristle, dili gahi nga bukog. Dugay na kaayong nabuhi ang mga iho, mas karaan pa kay sa mga dinosaur.

q: Why does a shark never run out of teeth during its lifetime?
options: A shark keeps replacing its teeth throughout its entire life.
A shark's teeth are so hard that they never break or fall out.
A shark grows all of its teeth at once before it is born.
A shark only uses its teeth a few times a year, so they last a long time.
explanation: A shark continually replaces lost teeth throughout its life, ensuring it always has a full set.
fact_tl: Patuloy na pinapalitan ng pating ang kanyang mga ngipin sa buong buhay nito, kaya hindi ito kailanman nauubusan ng ngipin.
fact_bis: Padayon nga ginapulihan sa iho ang iyang mga ngipon sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi, mao nga dili gyud kini mahutdan ug ngipon.

q: What is the Darag, and where in the Philippines does it come from?
options: It is a native Philippine chicken from Western Visayas, known for its brownish feathers, hardiness, and tasty meat and eggs.
It is a native Philippine duck from Mindanao, known for its colorful plumage and ability to dive underwater.
It is a native Philippine goat from the Cordillera region, known for its strength and very rich milk.
It is a native Philippine turkey from Luzon, known for its large size and loud calls.
explanation: The Darag is a native Philippine chicken from Western Visayas with brownish feathers, known for being hardy and for its tasty meat and eggs.
fact_tl: Ang Darag ay isang katutubong manok ng Pilipinas mula sa Western Visayas na may kayumangging balahibo, kilala sa pagiging matibay at sa masarap nitong karne at itlog.
fact_bis: Ang Darag usa ka lumad nga manok sa Pilipinas gikan sa Kasadpang Bisayas nga adunay kayumanggi nga balhibo, ilado sa pagkalig-on ug sa lami niini nga karne ug itlog.

q: How do mangrove forests protect coastlines during storms?
options: Their dense trunks and roots slow waves, reduce storm surges, and prevent coastal erosion.
They release a chemical into the water that calms wave movement during storms.
They absorb rainwater underground, preventing floodwaters from reaching the shore.
They grow so tall that they block storm clouds from dropping rain on the coast.
explanation: Mangroves serve as natural barriers — their dense roots and trunks slow waves, reduce storm surges, and prevent coastal erosion.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakawan ay nagsisilbing natural na pader laban sa mga daluyong at bagyo — ang makapal na puno at ugat nila ay nagpapabagal ng mga alon, nagbabawas ng storm surge, at pumipigil sa pagguho ng baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakawan nagsilbing natural nga pader batok sa mga alon ug bagyo — ang ilang mabaga nga mga kahoy ug ugat nagpabagal sa mga alon, nagbawas sa storm surge, ug nagpugong sa pagguho sa baybayon.

q: During which months can people in the Philippines best see the constellation Orion in the night sky?
options: December to February, during the cool amihan season.
June to August, during the hot and rainy habagat season.
March to May, during the hot dry season before the rains.
September to November, just after the rainy season ends.
explanation: In the Philippines, Orion is best seen from December to February during the cool amihan months, when it sits high and bright in the night sky.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, pinakamaganda mong makikita ang Orion tuwing malamig na mga buwan mula Disyembre hanggang Pebrero, kung kailan umiihip ang amihan. Sa mga buwang ito, mataas at maliwanag ito sa langit sa gabi. Tuwing tag-init naman, di mo ito masyadong makikita sa gabi.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, pinakanindot nimong makita ang Orion panahon sa bugnaw nga mga bulan gikan Disyembre hangtod Pebrero, kon ang amihan mohuyop. Niini nga mga bulan taas ug hayag kini sa langit sa gabii. Panahon sa init nga ting-init, halos dili nimo kini makita sa gabii.

q: Why do house rats and mice gnaw on wires and wood?
options: They must keep their constantly growing teeth short by gnawing on hard materials.
They are searching for food hidden inside wires and wood.
They gnaw to mark their territory and warn other animals to stay away.
They gnaw to build nests from the shredded material they create.
explanation: House rats and mice gnaw on wires and wood because their teeth keep growing, and gnawing keeps the teeth short.
fact_tl: Ang mga daga sa bahay ay nangangagat ng kable at kahoy dahil kailangan nilang panatilihing maikli ang lumalaking ngipin.
fact_bis: Ang mga ilaga sa balay mokitkit og alambre ug kahoy kay kinahanglan nilang mubo ang ilang nagatubo nga ngipon.

q: What do prop roots do for plants like corn and mangroves?
options: They grow out from the stem and brace the plant so it stands firm.
They absorb extra sunlight to help the plant make more food.
They store large amounts of water for the plant during dry seasons.
They attract insects that help the plant spread its seeds.
explanation: Prop roots grow out of the stem and brace the plant, helping tall plants like corn and mangroves stand firm.
fact_tl: May mga halaman tulad ng mais at bakawan na may prop roots, mga ugat na lumalabas sa tangkay at sumusuporta sa halaman para tumayo nang matatag.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom sama sa mais ug bakawan nga adunay prop roots, mga gamot nga mogawas sa punoan ug mosuhay sa tanom aron motindog nga lig-on.

q: What is the difference between the Rafflesia and the titan arum when it comes to size records?
options: The Rafflesia has the largest single flower, while the titan arum is a tall cluster of many tiny flowers.
The titan arum has the largest single flower, while the Rafflesia is a tall cluster of many tiny flowers.
Both are individual flowers, but the Rafflesia smells worse than the titan arum.
Both are clusters of flowers, but the Rafflesia cluster is bigger than the titan arum cluster.
explanation: The Rafflesia holds the record for the largest single flower, while the titan arum is actually a tall cluster of many tiny flowers.
fact_tl: Ang Rafflesia ang may pinakamalaking iisang bulaklak, samantalang ang titan arum ay isang mataas na kumpol ng maliliit na bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang Rafflesia mao ang adunay pinakadako nga usa ka bulak, samtang ang titan arum usa ka taas nga pungpong sa gagmay nga mga bulak.

q: Why do workers use a long metal bar instead of a short one to move a large rock?
options: A longer lever lets you use less effort to lift or move a heavy object.
A longer lever moves faster, so you can push the rock out of the way more quickly.
A longer bar is heavier, so it adds extra weight to help push the rock.
A longer bar is made of stronger metal that will not bend under the weight.
explanation: A longer lever reduces the effort needed to move a heavy object, which is why a long bar is used to shift large rocks.
fact_tl: Mas mahabang lever ang gagamitin para mas kaunti ang effort na kailangan sa pagbuhat ng mabigat na bagay. Kaya gumagamit tayo ng mahabang baras (pingga) para igalaw ang malalaking bato.
fact_bis: Ang mas taas nga lever maghatag kanimo og mas gamay nga effort sa pag-alsa sa bug-at nga butang. Mao nga mogamit ta og taas nga pingga aron palihukon ang dagkong bato.

q: How do rice and corn, two important foods in the Philippines, begin to grow?
options: Farmers plant small seeds in the ground, and the plants grow from those seeds.
Farmers take cuttings from older plants and press them into the soil to grow.
The plants grow from underground bulbs that farmers dig up and replant each season.
The seeds are attached to a parent plant and fall onto the ground by themselves each year.
explanation: Rice and corn grow from small seeds that farmers plant, making them seed-grown crops.
fact_tl: Ang palay at mais na pangunahing pagkain sa Pilipinas ay tumutubo mula sa maliliit na buto na itinatanim ng magsasaka.
fact_bis: Ang humay ug mais, importante nga pagkaon sa Pilipinas, motubo gikan sa gagmay nga liso nga gitanom sa mga mag-uuma.

q: Why does a gecko's grip work in both hot and cold weather, unlike ordinary tape?
options: A gecko's grip comes from forces between molecules, not from glue that can dry out or melt with temperature changes.
A gecko produces a special oil that keeps its feet sticky no matter the temperature.
A gecko's toes have tiny claws that hook into any surface, so weather does not affect its hold.
A gecko's skin changes color to match the surface and creates a stronger grip in different temperatures.
explanation: A gecko's grip comes from molecular forces rather than glue, so it is not affected by heat, cold, or rain the way ordinary tape would be.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang dikit ng gecko kahit mainit o malamig ang panahon dahil ito ay galing sa pang-akit ng mga molekula at hindi sa anumang pandikit na natutuyo o natutunaw. Kaya hindi ito basta nasisira sa init at hindi naaapektuhan ng ulan o panahon tulad ng ordinaryong tape.
fact_bis: Ang pagdikit sa gecko molihok bisan init o bugnaw ang panahon kay kini gikan sa pagbira tali sa mga molekula, dili gikan sa pandikit nga momala o matunaw. Mao nga dili kini dali madaot sa init ug dili maapektuhan sa ulan o panahon sama sa ordinaryong tape.

q: What is unusual about the manta ray's brain compared to other fish?
options: The manta ray has one of the largest brains of any fish.
The manta ray has no brain at all and is controlled only by its nervous system.
The manta ray's brain is the smallest of any large sea animal.
The manta ray has two separate brain sections that work independently.
explanation: The manta ray stands out because it has one of the largest brains of any fish.
fact_tl: Ang manta ray ay may isa sa pinakamalalaking utak sa lahat ng isda.
fact_bis: Ang manta ray adunay usa sa pinakadako nga utok sa tanang isda.

q: Why does the Philippines have a warm climate throughout the whole year?
options: The Philippines lies between 5 and 21 degrees north of the equator, placing it in the tropical zone.
The Philippines is surrounded by warm ocean currents that keep temperatures high every month.
The Philippines has many active volcanoes that release heat and keep the land warm.
The Philippines has very few trees, so there is nothing to block the sun and cool the land.
explanation: The Philippines sits between 5 and 21 degrees north of the equator, which puts it in the tropical zone and gives it a warm climate all year.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay matatagpuan sa pagitan ng 5 at 21 degrees hilaga ng ekwador, kaya't ito ay nasa tropikong rehiyon at mainit ang klima sa buong taon.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas nahimutang tali sa 5 ug 21 degrees amihanan sa ekwador, nga nagbutang niini sa tropikal nga sona nga may mainit nga klima sa tibuok tuig.

q: What is a sinkhole?
options: A pit that forms when the ground collapses into a hollow space below it.
A deep crack in the earth caused by two tectonic plates moving apart.
A large hole dug by underground rivers that slowly empty out over many years.
A crater left behind after a meteorite hits the ground and explodes.
explanation: A sinkhole is a pit that forms when the surface ground collapses into a hollow space beneath it.
fact_tl: Ang sinkhole ay isang biglang lubak na nabubuo kapag gumuho ang lupa papunta sa hungkag na espasyo sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Ang sinkhole usa ka lungag nga maporma kon mahugno ang yuta paingon sa bakante nga luna sa ilawom.

q: What body covering does a chicken have that shows it is a bird?
options: Feathers covering its body and wings.
Smooth, wet skin like a frog.
Hard scales like a snake or lizard.
Thick fur like a dog or cat.
explanation: A chicken is a bird, and like all birds it has feathers and wings.
fact_tl: Ang manok ay isang ibon na may balahibo at pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang manok usa ka langgam nga adunay balahibo ug pako.

q: How can you tell that a cuttlefish is older just by looking at its cuttlebone?
options: An older cuttlefish has a bigger and thicker cuttlebone because it adds new layers as it grows.
An older cuttlefish has a cuttlebone with more holes in it because it gets worn down over time.
An older cuttlefish has a darker cuttlebone because it absorbs more minerals from the sea.
An older cuttlefish has a softer cuttlebone because older tissue breaks down with age.
explanation: As a cuttlefish grows, it adds new layers to its cuttlebone, so an older cuttlefish has a bigger, thicker cuttlebone than a young one.
fact_tl: Habang lumalaki ang cuttlefish, nagdaragdag ito ng mga bagong patong sa ilalim ng cuttlebone nito. Kaya mas malaki at mas makapal ang cuttlebone ng mas matandang cuttlefish kaysa sa bata pa.
fact_bis: Samtang motubo ang cuttlefish, magdugang kini og bag-ong mga sapaw sa ilawom sa cuttlebone niini. Mao nga ang mas tigulang nga cuttlefish naay mas dako ug mas baga nga cuttlebone kaysa sa bata pa.

q: Approximately how deep is the Manila Trench?
options: About 5,400 meters deep.
About 2,000 meters deep.
About 10,900 meters deep.
About 8,300 meters deep.
explanation: The Manila Trench reaches a depth of about 5,400 meters.
fact_tl: Ang Manila Trench ay umaabot sa lalim na halos 5,400 metro.
fact_bis: Ang Manila Trench moabot sa kalawom nga mga 5,400 ka metro.

q: Which animal holds the record for being the largest fish in the world?
options: The whale shark.
The blue whale.
The giant manta ray.
The oarfish.
explanation: The whale shark is the largest fish in the entire world.
fact_tl: Ang butanding o whale shark ang pinakamalaking isda sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang tuki o whale shark mao ang pinakadako nga isda sa tibuok kalibotan.

q: What is an astronaut?
options: A person trained to travel and work in space, wearing a special suit to stay alive away from Earth.
A scientist who studies stars and planets using a telescope from the ground.
A pilot who flies very high in Earth's atmosphere but does not go into space.
A person who builds and repairs the rockets that carry satellites into orbit.
explanation: An astronaut is a person trained to travel and work in space and must wear a special space suit to survive away from Earth.
fact_tl: Ang astronaut ay isang taong sinanay para maglakbay at magtrabaho sa kalawakan, na nakasuot ng espesyal na space suit para mabuhay sa labas ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang astronaut usa ka tawo nga gibansay aron mobiyahe ug magtrabaho sa kawanangan, nga nagsul-ob og espesyal nga space suit aron mabuhi sa gawas sa Earth.

q: When can the Sun's chromosphere be seen by people watching from Earth?
options: Only during a total solar eclipse, when it appears as a pinkish ring around the Sun.
During sunrise and sunset, when it glows orange above the horizon.
Every night, when the Sun is below the horizon and the chromosphere is still lit.
On any clear day through a regular telescope without a special filter.
explanation: The chromosphere is the layer above the photosphere and is only visible as a pinkish ring during a total solar eclipse.
fact_tl: Ang chromosphere ang layer ng Araw na nasa itaas ng photosphere; makikita lamang ito bilang pinkish na singsing sa panahon ng total solar eclipse.
fact_bis: Ang chromosphere mao ang layer sa Adlaw nga naa ibabaw sa photosphere; makita lamang kini isip pink nga singsing panahon sa total solar eclipse.

q: What does the temperature of an object tell us about its tiny particles?
options: The higher the temperature, the faster the particles inside the object are moving.
The higher the temperature, the more particles the object contains.
The higher the temperature, the larger and heavier each particle becomes.
The higher the temperature, the more tightly packed the particles are together.
explanation: Heat comes from the motion of tiny particles in matter; the faster they move, the hotter the object is.
fact_tl: Ang init ay isang anyo ng enerhiya na nagmumula sa paggalaw ng napakaliliit na bahagi ng materya; mas mabilis silang gumagalaw, mas mainit ang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang kainit usa ka porma sa enerhiya nga gikan sa paglihok sa gagmay kaayo nga bahin sa materya; mas paspas sila molihok, mas init ang butang.

q: What does Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment tell us about inherited traits?
options: Genes for different traits separate independently during sex cell formation, so traits like seed color and shape are inherited independently of each other.
Each offspring always inherits exactly half of every trait from each parent with no variation.
Stronger traits always push out weaker ones, so only the dominant trait is ever passed on.
Traits that appear together in one generation will always appear together in the next generation.
explanation: Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment states that genes for different traits separate independently during sex cell formation, meaning traits are inherited independently.
fact_tl: Ang Law of Independent Assortment ni Mendel ay nagsasabi na ang mga gene para sa iba't ibang katangian ay naghihiwalay nang malaya sa isa't isa sa panahon ng sex cell formation — kaya ang kulay at hugis ng buto ng gisantes ay independyente sa isa't isa.
fact_bis: Ang Law of Independent Assortment ni Mendel nag-ingon nga ang mga gene alang sa lain-laing katangian nagbulag nga independyente sa usag-usa sa panahon sa paghimo sa sex cells — busa ang kolor ug hugis sa buto sa sitaw gipanunod nga independyente sa usag-usa.

q: Why does heavy rain cause flooding in towns along Laguna de Bay?
options: The lake's water level rises and it drains slowly because it has only one outlet, the Pasig River.
The lake has no natural outlet, so any extra water spills directly onto the surrounding land.
The towns are built below sea level, so rainwater and lake water both flow in and cannot escape.
The lake floor is lined with hard rock that prevents water from soaking into the ground.
explanation: When heavy rain or a typhoon raises the lake level, water drains slowly because Laguna de Bay has only one outlet — the Pasig River — causing floods along the shore.
fact_tl: Tuwing malakas at matagal ang ulan o may bagyo, tumataas ang tubig ng Laguna de Bay at maaaring umapaw sa mga bayang nasa baybayin nito. Mabagal lumabas ang sobrang tubig dahil iisa lang ang labasan—ang Pasig River.
fact_bis: Kada kusog ug taas ang ulan o naay bagyo, mosaka ang tubig sa Laguna de Bay ug mahimong moawas sa mga lungsod sa baybayon niini. Hinay mogawas ang sobra nga tubig kay usa ra ang agianan—ang Pasig River.

q: Where does the dengue mosquito prefer to lay its eggs?
options: In clean, still water such as cans or flower pots.
In muddy, flowing river water near riverbanks.
In salty seawater in coastal areas.
In dirty drain water with a lot of waste matter in it.
explanation: The dengue mosquito lays its eggs in clean, still water, such as the water collected in cans or flower pots.
fact_tl: Ang lamok na may dengue ay nangingitlog sa malinis at nakatigil na tubig, tulad ng nasa lata o paso.
fact_bis: Ang lamok nga nagdala og dengue mangitlog sa hinlo ug natigom nga tubig, sama sa lata o paso.

q: How does PAGASA use radar and satellites when tracking a typhoon?
options: They watch the storm's eyewall to figure out where it will hit and give early warnings so people can prepare and evacuate.
They use radar to shoot signals into the eyewall to weaken the storm before it reaches land.
They track the satellites launched into the storm to measure rain inside the clouds.
They use radar to count how many lightning strikes the storm produces each hour.
explanation: PAGASA uses radar and satellites to track a typhoon's eyewall and predict where it will hit, giving warnings so people can prepare and evacuate.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng PAGASA ang radar at satellite para makita ang eyewall ng bagyo at alamin kung saan ito tatama. Sa pamamagitan ng pagsubaybay dito, nakapagbibigay sila ng babala para makapaghanda at makalikas ang mga tao bago pa dumating ang panganib.
fact_bis: Gigamit sa PAGASA ang radar ug satellite aron makita ang eyewall sa bagyo ug masayran kung asa kini moigo. Pinaagi sa pagbantay niini, makahatag sila og pasidaan aron makaandam ug makabakwit ang mga tao sa dili pa moabot ang katalagman.

q: How does a lightning rod protect a building during a lightning strike?
options: It carries the huge electric charge safely down into the ground through a thick wire so the building is not damaged.
It sends an electric signal into the clouds that breaks the lightning bolt apart before it reaches the roof.
It reflects the lightning bolt sideways so it hits the ground away from the building.
It stores the electric charge from the lightning inside a battery inside the building's foundation.
explanation: A lightning rod is connected to the ground by a thick wire, so when lightning strikes it, the electric charge is safely conducted into the ground instead of damaging the building.
fact_tl: Isang totoong gamit ng grounding ay ang lightning rod sa bubong ng mga gusali. Ito ay metal na nakakonekta sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng makapal na kawad. Kapag tumama ang kidlat, dinadala nito ang napakalakas na kuryente palusong sa lupa nang ligtas, kaya hindi nasusunog ang bahay.
fact_bis: Usa ka tinuod nga gamit sa grounding mao ang lightning rod sa atop sa mga building. Kini metal nga konektado sa yuta pinaagi sa baga nga kawad. Kung maigo sa kilat, dad-on niini ang kusog kaayo nga kuryente paubos sa yuta nga luwas, maong dili madaot ang balay.

q: Who invented the modern, working zipper?
options: Swedish-American engineer Gideon Sundback in 1913.
American inventor Thomas Edison in 1895.
Scottish engineer James Watt in 1870.
German physicist Max Planck in 1900.
explanation: The modern, practical zipper was invented by Swedish-American engineer Gideon Sundback in 1913.
fact_tl: Ang makabago at gumaganang ziper ay ginawa ng Swedish-American na si Gideon Sundback noong 1913.
fact_bis: Ang moderno ug molihok nga ziper gihimo sa Swedish-American nga si Gideon Sundback niadtong 1913.

q: Where is the Moro Gulf located?
options: On the western side of Mindanao, part of the Celebes Sea.
On the eastern coast of Mindanao, facing the Pacific Ocean.
Between the islands of Leyte and Samar in the Visayas.
North of Luzon, where it opens into the South China Sea.
explanation: The Moro Gulf is a large inlet on the western side of Mindanao, and it is part of the Celebes Sea.
fact_tl: Ang Golpo ng Moro (Moro Gulf) ay ang malaking look sa kanlurang Mindanao, bahagi ng Dagat Celebes.
fact_bis: Ang Gulpo sa Moro (Moro Gulf) usa ka dako nga luok sa kasadpang bahin sa Mindanao, bahin sa Dagat Celebes.

q: What happens when you pour cooking oil into a glass of water?
options: The oil floats on top of the water because it is less dense than water.
The oil sinks to the bottom because it is heavier than water.
The oil mixes completely with the water and disappears.
The oil turns the water cloudy and then sinks slowly to the bottom.
explanation: Cooking oil floats on top of water because oil is less dense than water, so it quickly rises to the surface.
fact_tl: Pwede mong subukan sa bahay: maglagay ng tubig sa isang baso, tapos magbuhos ng kaunting mantika. Makikita mong agad na umaakyat ang langis at lumulutang sa ibabaw ng tubig.
fact_bis: Mahimo nimo kining sulayan sa balay: butangi og tubig ang baso, dayon ibubo ang gamay nga mantika. Makita nimo dayon nga mosaka ang lana ug molutaw sa ibabaw sa tubig.

q: Why can a compass help Filipino fishermen find their direction on the water?
options: A compass needle follows Earth's magnetic field, pointing in a consistent direction.
A compass uses a small radio signal from shore to find which way is north.
A compass measures ocean currents and shows which way the water is flowing.
A compass detects changes in water temperature to show the direction of land.
explanation: A compass works because its needle aligns with Earth's magnetic field, reliably pointing in the same direction and helping sailors navigate.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas na maraming isla at dagat, ginagamit ng mga mangingisda at marino ang compass para malaman ang direksyon sa tubig. Tumatakbo ang compass dahil sumusunod ang karayom nito sa magnetic field ng Daigdig, kahit may compass na rin sa maraming cellphone.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas nga daghan ug isla ug dagat, ang mga mananagat ug marino mogamit ug compass aron mahibal-an ang direksyon sa tubig. Molihok ang compass tungod kay ang karayom niini mosunod sa magnetic field sa Kalibutan, ug daghang cellphone karon adunay usab niini.

q: What was the key difference between Edison's Kinetoscope and the Lumiere brothers' Cinematographe?
options: The Kinetoscope let only one viewer watch at a time, while the Cinematographe projected films on a big screen for many people at once.
The Kinetoscope used color film, while the Cinematographe used only black-and-white film.
The Kinetoscope showed moving images with sound, while the Cinematographe showed only silent pictures.
The Kinetoscope was a large theater machine, while the Cinematographe was a small personal viewer.
explanation: Edison's Kinetoscope was a single-viewer device, while the Lumiere Cinematographe projected films onto a big screen so many people could watch together.
fact_tl: Iisa lang ang nanonood sa Kinetoscope ni Edison, samantalang sa Cinematographe ng Lumiere ay marami ang sabay na nanonood sa malaking screen.
fact_bis: Sa Kinetoscope ni Edison usa ra ka tawo ang motan-aw, samtang sa Cinematographe sa Lumiere daghan ang dungan nga motan-aw sa dakong screen.

q: What kind of seasonal pattern is common in many grasslands and savannas?
options: A clear wet season and dry season, so the grass turns dry during part of the year.
A cold winter and warm summer, so the grass dies in winter and grows back in spring.
A rainy season that lasts most of the year with only a short dry spell.
A dry season and a hot season but no wet season since these areas rarely get rain.
explanation: Many grasslands and savannas have a clear wet season and dry season, causing the grass to turn dry during part of the year.
fact_tl: Maraming grassland at savanna ay may malinaw na tag-ulan at tagtuyot, kaya tuyo ang damo sa ilang buwan ng taon.
fact_bis: Daghang grassland ug savanna adunay klaro nga ting-uwan ug ting-init, mao nga mauga ang damo sa pipila ka bulan sa tuig.

q: Which correctly lists the stages in the life cycle of a rice plant from beginning to end?
options: Seed planted in water → seedling → tillering (many stems) → flowering → ripening grains → harvest.
Seedling → seed → flowering → tillering → ripening grains → harvest.
Seed → flowering → seedling → tillering → harvest → ripening grains.
Tillering → seed → seedling → flowering → harvest → ripening grains.
explanation: The rice plant grows from a planted seed to a seedling, then tillers, flowers, ripens its grains, and is finally harvested.
fact_tl: Ang palay ay dumadaan sa maraming yugto: mula sa butil na itinatanim, paglaki bilang seedling, pagpalaki ng maraming tangkay (tillering), pagbulaklak, at paghinog ng butil bago anihin.
fact_bis: Ang palay moagi sa daghang yugto: gikan sa butil nga gitanom sa tubig, punla, pagtubo sa daghang tangkay (tillering), pagpamulak, ug paghinog sa mga butil sa wala pa aniha-on.

q: How have engineers borrowed ideas from the human skeleton when designing safety equipment?
options: They copied the rib cage and skull concept to create helmets and roll cages that form a strong frame protecting what is inside.
They copied the way bones bend slightly to make car bumpers that flex and absorb crashes.
They copied the way bone marrow produces blood cells to design filters that clean fuel inside engines.
They copied the growth rings in bones to make tires that last longer with regular use.
explanation: Engineers created helmets and roll cages inspired by how the skull and rib cage form a strong protective frame around vital organs.
fact_tl: Kinukuhanan ng ideya ng mga inhinyero ang paraan ng pagprotekta ng ating buto. Ang matitibay na helmet at ang 'roll cage' na bumabalot sa loob ng kotse-karera ay parang ginayang gusok o bungo — matibay na balangkas sa labas na nag-iingat sa mahalagang nasa loob.
fact_bis: Ang mga inhinyero mokuha og ideya gikan sa paagi sa pagpanalipod sa atong bukog. Ang lig-on nga helmet ug ang 'roll cage' nga naglibot sa sulod sa race car sama sa gisundog nga gusok o bungo — lig-on nga bayanan sa gawas nga nanalipod sa importante sa sulod.

q: What is the difference between an asterism and a full constellation?
options: An asterism is only part of a larger constellation, while a full constellation is the complete official pattern recognized by astronomers.
An asterism is a constellation that can only be seen in the southern hemisphere.
A full constellation is made up of only three stars, while an asterism contains many more stars.
An asterism is a pattern of stars visible only at night, while a constellation can be seen during the day.
explanation: An asterism like the Big Dipper is only part of a larger constellation (Ursa Major), while a full constellation is the complete official star pattern.
fact_tl: Ang ilang sikat na hugis tulad ng Big Dipper ay tinatawag na asterism, ibig sabihin bahagi lamang ito ng mas malaking konstelasyon (Ursa Major). Hindi lahat ng kilalang pattern ay isang buong opisyal na konstelasyon.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka bantog nga porma sama sa Big Dipper gitawag og asterism, nga nagpasabot bahin lang kini sa mas dako nga konstelasyon (Ursa Major). Dili tanan ilado nga porma usa ka tibuok opisyal nga konstelasyon.

q: How many of Jupiter's moons did Galileo discover in 1610?
options: Two moons: Io and Europa
Three moons: Io, Europa, and Ganymede
Four moons: Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto
Five moons: Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto, and Titan
explanation: Galileo discovered exactly four of Jupiter's largest moons in 1610: Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto.
fact_tl: Noong 1610, natuklasan ni Galileo ang apat (4) na malalaking buwan ng Jupiter: Io, Europa, Ganymede, at Callisto.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1610, nadiskobrehan ni Galileo ang upat (4) ka dagkong bulan sa Jupiter: Io, Europa, Ganymede, ug Callisto.

q: Why does a carabao need to drink a lot of water every day, especially when it is hot?
options: To grow a thicker hide for protection from insects
To stay healthy and strong for work
To cool the mud it rolls in
To produce more milk for its calves
explanation: Like other large animals, a carabao needs plenty of water daily, especially in hot weather, to stay healthy and strong enough to work.
fact_tl: Tulad ng ibang malalaking hayop, kailangan ng kalabaw na uminom ng maraming tubig araw-araw lalo na kapag mainit, para manatiling malusog at malakas sa trabaho.
fact_bis: Sama sa ubang dagkong mananap, kinahanglan moinom ang kalabaw ug daghang tubig matag adlaw ilabi na kung init, aron magpabilin nga himsog ug kusgan sa trabaho.

q: What does a barometer measure to help forecast the weather?
options: The temperature of the air
The speed of the wind
The pressure, or weight, of the surrounding air
The amount of moisture in the air
explanation: A barometer measures air pressure; high pressure usually means good weather, while dropping pressure signals rain or a coming storm.
fact_tl: Ang barometer ay sumusukat ng presyon o bigat ng hangin sa paligid. Kapag mataas ang presyon, kadalasan maganda ang panahon; kapag bumababa ang presyon, malamang umulan o magbagyo. Kaya importante itong instrumento sa pagbabala.
fact_bis: Ang barometer magsukod sa presyon, o gibug-aton, sa palibot nga hangin. Kung taas ang presyon, sagad maayo ang panahon; kung mokunhod ang presyon, lagmit mouulan o mobagyo. Mao nga importante kini nga instrumento sa pagpasidaan.

q: Why do cold countries spread salt on icy roads?
options: Salt makes the road surface rougher so cars grip better
Salt reflects sunlight to warm the road
Salt melts the ice and makes it harder to refreeze
Salt absorbs water so the ice cannot form at all
explanation: Salt melts ice and makes it harder to refreeze, which is why cold countries spread it on icy roads.
fact_tl: Kapag binudburan ng asin ang yelo, mas mahirap itong magyelo at mas mabilis matunaw. Kaya sa malalamig na bansa, nilalagyan ng asin ang mga kalsadang puno ng yelo.
fact_bis: Kung sablihan og asin ang yelo, mas lisod kini mograyel ug mas paspas matunaw. Mao nga sa bugnaw nga mga nasud, sablihan og asin ang mga dalan nga puno og yelo.

q: How can you smell food cooking in another room even when you cannot see it?
options: Sound waves carry the smell through the walls
The smell travels through water in the air
Tiny particles drift off the food and spread through the air until they reach your nose
Heat from the cooking pushes the scent toward your nose
explanation: Tiny particles diffuse (spread) off the food and travel through the air until they reach the inside of your nose, letting you detect the smell.
fact_tl: Nakakaamoy tayo dahil may napakaliliit na particle na pumupulas mula sa bagay at kumakalat sa hangin (diffusion) hanggang umabot sa loob ng ating ilong. Kaya naaamoy mo ang ulam kahit nasa kabilang silid ka pa.
fact_bis: Makasimhot ta tungod kay adunay gagmayng partikulo nga mobuhi gikan sa butang ug mokatag sa hangin (diffusion) hangtod moabot sa sulod sa atong ilong. Mao nga masimhot nimo ang sud-an bisan lain ka og kwarto.

q: What makes the ipil-ipil tree easy to plant in many different places?
options: It needs a lot of water to grow quickly
Its seeds germinate only in rich, fertilized soil
It can grow even on poor or dry soil
It grows only near rivers and lakes
explanation: The ipil-ipil can grow even on poor or dry soil, making it easy to plant in many places.
fact_tl: Ang ipil-ipil ay kayang tumubo kahit sa mahirap o tigang na lupa, kaya madaling itanim sa maraming lugar.
fact_bis: Ang ipil-ipil makahimo motubo bisan sa luya o uga nga yuta, mao nga sayon itanom sa daghang dapit.

q: Who chose the @ symbol used in email addresses?
options: Bill Gates
Tim Berners-Lee
Ray Tomlinson
Steve Jobs
explanation: Ray Tomlinson chose the @ symbol for email addresses.
fact_tl: Si Ray Tomlinson ang pumili ng simbolong @ para sa mga email address.
fact_bis: Si Ray Tomlinson ang nagpili sa simbolo nga @ para sa mga email address.

q: How do bats find their way and catch food in complete darkness?
options: They use their large eyes to see in very dim light
They follow the smell of their prey
They make sounds and listen for the echoes
They sense heat given off by warm-bodied prey
explanation: Bats produce sounds and use the echoes that bounce back to navigate and locate food in the dark.
fact_tl: Ang paniki ay naglalabas ng tunog at nakikinig sa alingawngaw nito para makahanap ng daan at pagkain sa dilim.
fact_bis: Ang kabog mohimo og tingog ug maminaw sa alingawngaw niini aron makakita og dalan ug makadakop og pagkaon sa kangitngit.

q: Which moon did the Huygens lander touch down on?
options: Enceladus, Saturn's icy moon
Europa, Jupiter's ocean moon
Titan, Saturn's largest moon
Triton, Neptune's largest moon
explanation: The Huygens lander, carried by the Cassini spacecraft, successfully touched down on Titan, Saturn's largest moon.
fact_tl: Ang Huygens lander (kasama ng Cassini) ay lumapag sa Titan, ang pinakamalaking buwan ng Saturn.
fact_bis: Ang Huygens lander (dala sa Cassini) mitugpa sa Titan, ang pinakadako nga bulan sa Saturn.

q: Where do cacao seeds — used to make chocolate — come from?
options: From the roots of the cacao tree
From flowers that dry and harden on the branch
From seeds inside a large fruit called a cacao pod
From the sap that drips from cacao bark
explanation: Cacao comes from seeds found inside a large fruit called a cacao pod that grows on the cacao tree.
fact_tl: Ang kakaw ay nagmumula sa mga buto na nasa loob ng malaking bungang tinatawag na cacao pod.
fact_bis: Ang kakaw gikan sa mga liso nga naa sa sulod sa dako nga bunga nga gitawag og cacao pod.

q: Why does a straw look bent when you put it in a glass of water?
options: The water pushes the straw sideways and bends it
Your eyes adjust to see underwater objects at an angle
Light bends (refracts) as it passes from water into air
The straw actually does bend slightly from water pressure
explanation: The straw looks bent because light refracts — it bends — as it passes from the water into the air, making the submerged part appear shifted.
fact_tl: Mukhang baluktot ang straw sa baso ng tubig dahil ang liwanag ay lumiliko (refraction) kapag dumaan sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang straw murag baliko sa baso nga tubig tungod kay ang kahayag mobawog (refraction) kon moagi sa tubig.

q: When a ball falls to the ground, what does gravity do to it?
options: Gravity slows the ball by pushing against it
Gravity does no work because the ball is already moving
Gravity does work on the ball by pulling it downward
Gravity only acts on the ball when it first starts to fall
explanation: When something falls, gravity does work on it because it exerts a force that pulls the object downward in the direction of motion.
fact_tl: Kapag may bagay na nahuhulog, ang grabidad ay gumagawa ng trabaho rito dahil pinapagalaw nito pababa.
fact_bis: Kung naa'y butang nga nahulog, ang grabidad naghimo og trabaho niini kay gibira kini paubos.

q: In a plant stem growing toward light, where does more auxin gather, and what does that cause?
options: More auxin gathers on the lit side, making those cells grow longer
More auxin gathers on the shaded side, making those cells grow longer so the stem bends toward the light
Auxin is evenly spread, but light directly pulls the stem forward
More auxin gathers at the stem tip, pushing the whole stem upward
explanation: In phototropism, more auxin gathers on the shaded side, causing cells there to grow longer and bending the stem toward the light.
fact_tl: Sa phototropism, mas maraming auxin ang napupunta sa bahaging may anino, kaya tumutubo nang mas mahaba ang mga cell doon at yumuyuko ang tangkay papunta sa liwanag.
fact_bis: Sa phototropism, mas daghang auxin ang moadto sa kilid nga may landong, mao nga ang mga selula didto motubo nga mas taas ug ang punoan moyuko paingon sa kahayag.

q: In which parts of the Philippines are the country's major geothermal fields found?
options: Palawan, Cebu, Bohol, and Batangas
Metro Manila, Cavite, Laguna, and Rizal
Luzon, Leyte, Negros, and Mindanao
Ilocos Norte, Cagayan, Aurora, and Samar
explanation: The Philippines' geothermal fields are found in Luzon, Leyte, Negros, and Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang mga geothermal field ng Pilipinas ay nasa Luzon, Leyte, Negros, at Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang mga geothermal field sa Pilipinas makit-an sa Luzon, Leyte, Negros, ug Mindanao.

q: What was the nationality of James Chadwick, the scientist who discovered the neutron?
options: American
German
French
English
explanation: James Chadwick, who discovered the neutron, was an English scientist.
fact_tl: Si James Chadwick, ang nakatuklas ng neutron, ay isang Ingles (English) na siyentipiko.
fact_bis: Si James Chadwick, ang nakadiskobre sa neutron, usa ka English (Ingles) nga siyentipiko.

q: About how many eggs can a frog lay at one time?
options: Only one or two eggs per season
About a dozen eggs carefully hidden on land
Hundreds of eggs at once in the water
Exactly fifty eggs protected inside a nest
explanation: A frog can lay hundreds of eggs at once in the water.
fact_tl: Ang palaka ay maaaring mangitlog ng daan-daang itlog nang sabay-sabay sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang baki makahimo og pagpangitlog ug gatusan ka itlog dungan sa tubig.

q: What is a healthy person's normal body temperature on the Fahrenheit scale?
options: About 86.0 degrees Fahrenheit
About 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit
About 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit
About 72.0 degrees Fahrenheit
explanation: Normal body temperature is about 98.6°F on the Fahrenheit scale, which equals 37°C.
fact_tl: Sa Fahrenheit scale, ang normal na temperatura ng katawan ay mga 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit (98.6°F), katumbas ng 37°C.
fact_bis: Sa Fahrenheit scale, ang normal nga temperatura sa lawas mga 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit (98.6°F), katumbas sa 37°C.

q: Why is a total solar eclipse possible even though the Sun is much bigger than the Moon?
options: The Moon's shadow is larger than the Sun during an eclipse
The Moon speeds up in its orbit and temporarily covers the Sun
The Sun and Moon appear almost the same size from Earth
The Earth's atmosphere magnifies the Moon to match the Sun's size
explanation: A total solar eclipse is possible because the Sun and Moon appear almost the same size when viewed from Earth, even though the Sun is far larger.
fact_tl: Nagkakaganap ang total solar eclipse dahil halos magkasinglaki ang Araw at Buwan kapag tinitingnan mula sa Daigdig, kahit napakalaki ng Araw.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang total solar eclipse kay halos magkasinglaki ang Adlaw ug Bulan kon tan-awon gikan sa Kalibutan, bisan og dako kaayo ang Adlaw.

q: What would happen to your body's cells if there were no iron in the blood?
options: Cells would grow too fast and produce too much energy
Cells would store extra fat instead of using oxygen
Cells would be starved of oxygen and could not make enough energy
Cells would produce more red blood cells to compensate
explanation: Without iron, blood cannot carry oxygen well, so the body's cells would be starved of oxygen and could not produce enough energy.
fact_tl: Ano ang mangyayari kung biglang mawala ang iron? Hindi na makakapagdala ng oxygen ang dugo nang maayos, kaya magugutom sa oxygen ang mga selula ng katawan. Tulad ng apoy na namamatay kapag walang hangin, hindi makakagawa ng sapat na enerhiya ang mga selula natin.
fact_bis: Unsa may mahitabo kung kalit nga mawala ang iron? Dili na makadala og oxygen ang dugo og maayo, mao nga gutomon sa oxygen ang mga selula sa lawas. Sama sa kalayo nga mapalong kung walay hangin, dili makahimo og igong enerhiya ang atong mga selula.

q: Who sent the very first text message, and when did it happen?
options: Bill Gates sent it in January 1990
Martin Cooper sent it in April 1988
Neil Papworth sent it in December 1992
Tim Berners-Lee sent it in March 1994
explanation: Engineer Neil Papworth sent the first text message in December 1992.
fact_tl: Ang unang text message ay ipinadala ng inhinyerong si Neil Papworth noong Disyembre 1992.
fact_bis: Ang unang text message gipadala sa inhenyero nga si Neil Papworth niadtong Disyembre 1992.

q: Is vinegar an acid, a base, or neutral — and what is its approximate pH?
options: It is a base with a pH of about 9
It is neutral with a pH of about 7
It is a very strong acid with a pH of about 1
It is an acid with a pH of about 3
explanation: Vinegar is acidic with a pH of about 3.
fact_tl: Ang suka ay asido, na may pH na halos 3.
fact_bis: Ang suka kay asido, nga may pH nga mga 3.

q: Why do frogs usually stay in cool, damp places?
options: Their skin dries out toxins when wet
They need moisture in the air to hear properly
Their skin must stay wet to keep them alive
They prefer cool places because they hibernate in summer
explanation: A frog's skin must stay wet, so frogs stay in cool, damp places to prevent their skin from drying out.
fact_tl: Kailangang manatiling basa ang balat ng palaka, kaya madalas itong nasa malamig at basang lugar.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan magpabilin nga basa ang panit sa baki, mao nga kanunay ni sa bugnaw ug basa nga dapit.

q: What happens to a baby chick right after it hatches from its egg?
options: It is dry and already has its adult feathers
It is wet at first, then dries and becomes fluffy
It is covered in a hard shell that cracks away gradually
It is fully dry and can walk immediately without help
explanation: A newly hatched chick is wet at first, then dries out and becomes fluffy.
fact_tl: Ang bagong pisa na sisiw ay basa muna, pagkatapos ay natutuyo at nagiging malambot ang balahibo.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong pusa nga piso humog una, dayon mauga ug mahimong malumo ang balhibo.

q: How does the diving bell spider manage to live completely underwater?
options: It breathes through gills it grew on its abdomen
It comes to the surface every few minutes to breathe
It builds a silk dome and fills it with air carried from the surface
It absorbs dissolved oxygen directly from the water through its skin
explanation: The diving bell spider builds a silk dome underwater and fills it with air carried from the surface, allowing it to live entirely submerged.
fact_tl: Ang diving bell spider (Argyroneta aquatica) ay ang tanging gagamba na naninirahan nang ganap sa ilalim ng tubig—gumagawa ito ng dome mula sa sutla at pinupuno ng hangin na kinukuha nito mula sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Ang diving bell spider (Argyroneta aquatica) mao ra ang gagamba nga nagpuyo sa hingpit sa ilalim sa tubig—nagbuhat kini og silk dome ug gipuno sa hangin nga gibitbit gikan sa ibabaw.

q: What happens to an electromagnet when you increase the electric current flowing through it?
options: The electromagnet becomes weaker because the wire overheats
The electromagnet stays the same strength no matter how much current flows
The electromagnet becomes stronger
The electromagnet loses its magnetic field and must be recharged
explanation: The stronger the electric current flowing through an electromagnet, the stronger the electromagnet becomes.
fact_tl: Kapag mas malakas ang kuryenteng dumadaloy, mas lumalakas din ang elektromagnet.
fact_bis: Kung mas kusog ang kuryente nga nag-agos, mas mokusog usab ang elektromagnet.

q: How can the Sun hold planets in orbit even though they are millions of kilometers away and nothing is touching them?
options: The Sun sends out invisible rays that push planets along their paths
The Sun emits solar wind that pushes planets into circular orbits
Gravity is invisible and works without any contact, so it can pull planets across vast distances
Planets are connected to the Sun by a thin layer of gas that stretches across space
explanation: Gravity is invisible and acts without any physical contact, so the Sun can attract planets that are millions of kilometers away.
fact_tl: Ang grabidad ay hindi nakikita at gumagana kahit walang anumang dumidikit, kaya nahahawakan ng Araw ang mga planetang milyon-milyong kilometro ang layo.
fact_bis: Ang gibug-aton dili makita ug molihok bisan walay nagdikit, mao nga makupot sa Adlaw ang mga planeta nga minilyon ka kilometro ang gilay-on.

q: At approximately what temperature on the Kelvin scale does water boil?
options: At 100 Kelvin
At 212 Kelvin
At 273 Kelvin
At 373 Kelvin
explanation: Water boils at about 373 Kelvin, which corresponds to 100°C on the Celsius scale.
fact_tl: Sa Kelvin, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa mga 373 Kelvin (373 K).
fact_bis: Sa Kelvin, ang tubig mobukal sa mga 373 Kelvin (373 K).

q: Why was the betel nut easy to get in the Philippines long ago?
options: The areca palm was imported cheaply from India
It was cultivated in cold mountain regions across Luzon
The areca palm that produces betel nut grows in warm tropical places like the Philippines
Trade ships brought large amounts of betel nut from China
explanation: The areca palm that provides the betel nut grows in warm tropical places like the Philippines, making it easy to obtain locally.
fact_tl: Ang punong areca na pinagkukunan ng betel nut ay tumutubo sa mainit at tropikal na lugar tulad ng Pilipinas, kaya naging madaling makuha ang sangkap na ito noong unang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang areca palm nga gigikanan sa betel nut motubo sa init ug tropikal nga mga dapit sama sa Pilipinas, mao nga sayon makuha kining sangkapa kaniadto.

q: Why are soap bubbles always round?
options: Bubbles are round because the air inside spins and creates a circular shape
Bubbles are round because hot air always rises in a circular pattern
Surface tension pulls the soap film into the smallest shape, and a sphere holds the most air with the least surface area
Bubbles form a round shape because water molecules push outward equally in all directions
explanation: Surface tension pulls the thin soap film into the smallest possible shape — a sphere — which holds the most air using the least surface area.
fact_tl: Bilog ang bula dahil hinihila ng surface tension ang manipis na pelikula ng sabon papunta sa pinakamaliit na hugis. Ang bilog (sphere) ang nakakahawak ng pinakamaraming hangin gamit ang pinakaliit na ibabaw.
fact_bis: Lingin ang bula tungod kay ang surface tension nagbira sa nipis nga pelikula sa sabon ngadto sa kinagamyan nga porma. Ang lingin (sphere) maoy makasulod sa kinadaghanan nga hangin gamit ang kinagamyan nga gawas.

q: Which animal is the fastest in the world, and how fast can it travel?
options: The cheetah, reaching about 120 km/h in a sprint
The sailfish, swimming at about 110 km/h
The swift, flying at about 200 km/h in level flight
The peregrine falcon, reaching over 380 km/h in a dive
explanation: The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal in the world, reaching over 380 kilometers per hour when it dives.
fact_tl: Ang peregrine falcon ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa mundo, na umaabot ng mahigit 380 kilometro kada oras kapag sumusugod pababa.
fact_bis: Ang peregrine falcon mao ang pinakapaspas nga hayop sa kalibutan, nga moabot ug kapin 380 ka kilometro kada oras kung mosulong paubos.

q: What can happen to someone who is allergic to latex when they wear rubber gloves?
options: Their hands become numb and lose feeling
Their skin gets red or itchy
The gloves melt and cause chemical burns
Their hands swell from a buildup of fluid
explanation: Some people are allergic to latex, so their skin becomes red or itchy when they wear rubber gloves.
fact_tl: May mga taong allergic sa latex, kaya namamantal o nangangati ang kanilang balat kapag nagsuot ng guwantes na goma.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga allergic sa latex, mao nga mamula o mangatol ang ilang panit kon magsul-ob og guwantes nga goma.

q: What can you learn about an animal's diet just by looking at its teeth, beak, or claws?
options: You can tell how old the animal is from the wear on these parts
These parts show where the animal sleeps and lives
The shape of these body parts often matches what the animal eats
These parts reveal how far the animal can travel to find food
explanation: The shape of an animal's teeth, beak, or claws often matches what it eats, so we can tell an animal's diet from these body parts.
fact_tl: Ang hugis ng ngipin, tuka, o kuko ng isang hayop ay madalas na akma sa kung ano ang kinakain nito. Sa ganitong paraan, makikita natin ang kakanin ng hayop sa hugis ng katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang porma sa ngipon, tuka, o kuko sa usa ka hayop kasagaran nahiangay sa unsay gikaon niini. Sa ingon, matultolan nato ang gikaon sa hayop pinaagi sa porma sa mga bahin sa lawas niini.

q: What happens to your chest when you breathe out?
options: Your chest expands to make room for fresh air coming in
Your chest stays the same size while only your nose changes shape
Your chest gets smaller and the diaphragm moves back up, pushing air out
Your chest vibrates rapidly, which forces old air to leave
explanation: When you breathe out, your chest gets smaller and the diaphragm moves back up, pushing air out of the lungs.
fact_tl: Kapag huminga ka palabas, lumiliit ang dibdib at bumabalik pataas ang diaphragm, kaya lumalabas ang hangin mula sa baga.
fact_bis: Kung moginhawa ka pagawas, mogamay ang dughan ug mobalik pataas ang diaphragm, mao nga mogawas ang hangin gikan sa baga.

q: How can a very loud sound harm your ear?
options: Loud sound heats the ear canal, burning the delicate tissue inside
Loud sound pushes fluid into the middle ear, blocking hearing
Loud sound makes the eardrum vibrate very hard, which can cause harm
Loud sound freezes the tiny ear bones so they can no longer move
explanation: Loud sound makes the eardrum vibrate very hard, and this intense vibration is one way a loud sound can damage hearing.
fact_tl: Ang malakas na tunog ay nagpapaugang nang napakalakas sa 'eardrum' o lamad ng tainga, at ito ang isang dahilan ng pinsala.
