explanation: William Ramsay discovered most of the noble gases — neon, krypton, and xenon — in 1898.
fact_tl: Si William Ramsay ang tumuklas ng karamihan sa mga noble gas — neon, krypton, at xenon — noong 1898.
fact_bis: Si William Ramsay ang nakadiskobre sa kadaghanan sa mga noble gas — neon, krypton, ug xenon — niadtong 1898.

q: Why do bubbles appear in a soda drink when you open the bottle?
options: The pressure drops and CO2 gas that was dissolved in the water begins to escape
The water inside heats up quickly and turns into steam
Air rushes into the bottle and mixes with the liquid
The sugar inside reacts with the bottle cap to create gas
explanation: Carbonated soft drinks are made by dissolving CO2 under high pressure; when you open the bottle, the pressure drops and the CO2 begins to escape as bubbles.
fact_tl: Ang mga carbonated softdrinks ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng pagdissolve ng CO2 sa tubig sa ilalim ng mataas na presyon. Kapag binuka mo ang bote, bumababa ang presyon at ang CO2 ay nagsisimulang lumabas bilang mga bula.
fact_bis: Ang mga carbonated softdrink gihimo pinaagi sa pagtunaw sa CO2 sa tubig sa ilalum sa taas nga presyon. Sa pag-abli nimo sa bote, ang presyon mobagsak ug ang CO2 nagsugod sa paggawas isip mga bula.

q: What is a keystone species?
options: A plant or animal that has a very large effect on its whole ecosystem even if there are only a few of them
The most numerous animal in an ecosystem that controls the food supply
A species that can survive in any ecosystem no matter the conditions
An animal that sits at the very top of the food chain and has no natural predators
explanation: A keystone species is a plant or animal that has a very large effect on its whole ecosystem, even if there are only a few of them.
fact_tl: Ang keystone species ay isang hayop o halaman na may napakalaking epekto sa kabuuan ng ekosistema, kahit kakaunti lang ang bilang nito.
fact_bis: Ang keystone species usa ka hayop o tanom nga adunay dako kaayo nga epekto sa tibuok ekosistema, bisan gamay ra ang ihap niini.

q: In a blood typing test, how does a lab know someone has type AB blood?
options: Both the anti-A drop and the anti-B drop cause the blood to clump together
Only the anti-A drop clumps while the anti-B drop stays smooth
Only the anti-B drop clumps while the anti-A drop stays smooth
Neither drop clumps because AB blood has no antigens
explanation: If both drops — one mixed with anti-A and one mixed with anti-B — clump together, you are type AB, because you have both A and B antigens.
fact_tl: Paano malalaman na type AB ka? Sa lab, hahaluan ng anti-A ang isang patak ng dugo mo at anti-B ang isa pa. Kung PAREHONG nagkumpol-kumpol (clumping) ang dalawa, type AB ka, dahil may A at B antigen kang dalawa.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagkahibalo nga type AB ka? Sa lab, sagolan ug anti-A ang usa ka tulo sa imong dugo ug anti-B ang lain. Kung PAREHONG mobungkog (clumping) ang duha, type AB ka, kay aduna kay A ug B antigen.

q: Why is it important for seeds to spread away from the parent plant?
options: So they do not have to compete with the parent for water and light
So birds can find and eat them more easily in open spaces
So rain can wash them to where the soil is wetter
So the parent plant has more room to grow new flowers
explanation: If all the seeds grew right under the parent plant they would compete for water and light, so spreading out helps them survive.
fact_tl: Kung lahat ng binhi ay tumutubo sa ilalim ng magulang na halaman, mag-aagawan sila sa tubig at liwanag, kaya mas mabuti kung kumakalat sila.
fact_bis: Kon ang tanang liso motubo ubos sa ginikanang tanom, mag-indigay sila sa tubig ug kahayag, mao nga mas maayo kon mokatag sila.

q: What happens to your eardrum when a sound reaches your ear?
options: It vibrates and passes those vibrations through three tiny bones to the cochlea
It stretches wider so more sound waves can enter the ear canal
It produces electrical signals that travel directly to the brain
It absorbs the sound waves and converts them into heat
explanation: When sound arrives, the eardrum vibrates and these vibrations are passed by three tiny bones in the middle ear to the cochlea.
fact_tl: Kapag dumarating ang tunog, ang eardrum (tympanic membrane) ay nananaig, at ang mga vibrasyon ay ipinipigil ng tatlong maliliit na buto sa middle ear patungo sa cochlea.
fact_bis: Kung moabot ang tunog, ang eardrum (tympanic membrane) nagpayugyog; kini nga mga vibrasyon gipasa sa tulo ka gagmayng buto sa middle ear ngadto sa cochlea.

q: In the Go-Grow-Glow food groups, what do GROW foods help your body do?
options: Help your body grow bigger and build muscles
Give you energy to run and play
Keep you healthy and protect you from sickness
Help your body digest other foods faster
explanation: Foods are sorted into three groups — Go (energy), Grow (growing), and Glow (staying healthy) — and we need all three every day.
fact_tl: Ang mga pagkain ay maaaring hatiin sa tatlong grupo: Go (para sa lakas), Grow (para sa paglaki), at Glow (para sa kalusugan). Kailangan natin ang lahat ng tatlo araw-araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga pagkaon mahimong bahinon sa tulo ka grupo: Go (para sa kusog), Grow (para sa pagtubo), ug Glow (para sa kahimsog). Kinahanglan nato ang tanang tulo matag adlaw.

q: Why do we often see moths flying around lamps at night?
options: Moths are drawn to lights at night
Moths mistake lamps for the moon and try to land on them to rest
Moths use the heat from lamps to warm their wings before flying
Moths eat the insects that gather around lights
explanation: Moths are often drawn to lights at night, which is why we see them flying around lamps.
fact_tl: Ang mga gamu-gamo ay madalas na lumalapit sa ilaw kapag gabi, kaya nakikita natin sila sa paligid ng ilawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga anunugba kasagaran moduol sa suga inig gabii, mao nga makita nato sila nga naglupad libot sa suga.

q: How many ribs does a human body have in total?
options: 24 ribs arranged in 12 pairs
12 ribs arranged in 6 pairs
20 ribs arranged in 10 pairs
26 ribs arranged in 13 pairs
explanation: A person has 24 ribs, arranged in 12 pairs.
fact_tl: May 24 na tadyang ang tao, na nasa 12 pares.
fact_bis: Ang tawo adunay 24 ka gusok, nga gihan-ay sa 12 ka paris.

q: Why does the Moon's gravity create tides on both the near AND far side of Earth?
options: Gravity weakens with distance, so the Moon pulls the near side stronger and the far side weaker, creating a bulge on each side
The Moon's gravity is the same on all sides of Earth, so the water spreads out evenly
The Sun's gravity cancels the Moon's pull on the far side, pushing water away
Earth's rotation throws water outward on the far side, creating a second bulge
explanation: Gravity gets weaker with distance, so the Moon pulls the near side stronger and the far side weaker — this difference creates the tides on both sides.
fact_tl: Humihina ang gravity habang lumalayo, kaya hindi pantay ang hila ng buwan sa buong Earth — mas malakas sa panig na malapit dito at mas mahina sa malayo; ang pagkakaibang ito ang lumilikha ng tides.
fact_bis: Mohuyang ang gravity samtang molayo, mao nga dili patas ang bira sa bulan sa tibuok Earth — mas kusog sa kilid nga duol ug mas huyang sa layo; kining kalainan mao ang naghimo sa tides.

q: What is sambong (Blumea balsamifera) approved to treat by the Philippine Department of Health?
options: Kidney stones and high blood pressure
Fever and skin infections
Tooth pain and stomach ulcers
Asthma and chest colds
explanation: Sambong is approved by the Philippine DOH as a herbal treatment for kidney stones and high blood pressure; its leaves are brewed as tea.
fact_tl: Ang sambong (Blumea balsamifera) ay aprubado ng DOH bilang gamot para sa bato sa bato at mataas na presyon ng dugo—ang dahon nito ay ginagawang tsaa.
fact_bis: Ang sambong (Blumea balsamifera) gi-aprubahan sa DOH isip herbal nga gamot para sa bato sa bato ug taas nga presyon sa dugo; ang mga dahon niini gihimo nga tsaa.

q: In the classification system scientists use, which level groups the MOST different kinds of organisms together?
options: Kingdom
Family
Genus
Species
explanation: Organisms are arranged from the large kingdom down to the small species, so kingdom is the broadest level.
fact_tl: Inaayos ang mga organismo sa mga antas mula sa malaking kaharian hanggang sa maliit na espesye.
fact_bis: Ginahan-ay ang mga organismo sa mga ang-ang gikan sa dako nga gingharian paingon sa gamay nga espesye.

q: Why does sunlight scatter in all directions when it enters Earth's atmosphere?
options: Tiny air molecules like nitrogen and oxygen bounce the light around
Large water droplets in clouds reflect the light outward
The ozone layer splits sunlight into different beams
Dust from the ground pushes light away from the Sun
explanation: Tiny air molecules like nitrogen and oxygen are what scatter the Sun's light in all directions.
fact_tl: Ang mga napakaliit na molekula ng hangin, tulad ng nitrogen at oxygen, ang nagtatabog sa liwanag ng araw sa lahat ng direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay kaayo nga molekula sa hangin, sama sa nitrogen ug oxygen, mao ang nagkatag sa kahayag sa adlaw sa tanan nga direksyon.

q: What makes the liver unusual compared to most other organs in the body?
options: It can repair itself and regrow damaged parts when the harm is not too severe
It never stops producing red blood cells throughout your life
It can survive without any blood supply for several days
It is the only organ that does not need nutrients to work
explanation: The liver can repair itself and regrow its damaged parts when the harm is not too severe.
fact_tl: Ang atay ay kayang mag-ayos ng sarili at tumubong muli ang sirang bahagi nito kapag hindi masyadong malala.
fact_bis: Ang atay makaayo sa kaugalingon ug makatubo pag-usab sa nadaot nga bahin niini kung dili kaayo grabe.

q: What do barnacles eat to get their energy?
options: Plankton — tiny plants and animals drifting in the water
Small fish that swim close to the rocks where they live
Seaweed and algae that grow on the ocean floor
Dead animals that sink down from the surface
explanation: A barnacle eats plankton, the tiny plants and animals that drift in the water.
fact_tl: Plankton, ang napakaliit na halaman at hayop na lumulutang sa tubig, ang kinakain ng barnacle.
fact_bis: Ang barnacle mokaon ug plankton, ang gagmay kaayo nga tanom ug hayop nga naglutaw sa tubig.

q: Why does ice melt when you leave it outside on a warm day?
options: The warm surroundings add heat to the ice, causing it to melt
Cold air inside the ice escapes, making it turn to water
Gravity pulls the water molecules apart from the ice
Ice naturally changes to water over time without needing any heat
explanation: Melting needs heat, so ice melts when its surroundings are warm.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng init para matunaw ang yelo, kaya ito natutunaw kapag mainit ang paligid.
fact_bis: Nagkinahanglan ug kainit aron matunaw ang yelo, mao nga matunaw kini kung init ang palibot.

q: How does a microwave oven heat food?
options: Waves are absorbed by water in the food, making the water molecules move and produce heat
Electric coils inside the oven glow red-hot and radiate heat into the food
A gas flame underneath the tray transfers heat upward through the food
Magnets inside spin the food very fast so friction heats it up
explanation: A microwave oven uses wave energy absorbed by water in food, making it move and heat up.
fact_tl: Ang microwave oven ay gumagamit ng isang uri ng alon na ang enerhiya ay sinisipsip ng tubig sa loob ng pagkain, na nagpapagalaw at nagpapainit dito — isang pang-araw-araw na halimbawa ng paggamit ng wave energy.
fact_bis: Ang microwave oven mogamit og matang sa balod nga ang enerhiya niini suhopon sa tubig sulod sa pagkaon, nga maghimo niini nga molihok ug moinit — usa ka adlaw-adlaw nga panig-ingnan sa paggamit sa wave energy.

q: Which region in northern Luzon is known as the home of indigenous Igorot peoples with rice terraces and traditional clothing?
options: Cordillera Administrative Region
Ilocos Region
Cagayan Valley
MIMAROPA
explanation: The Cordillera Administrative Region in northern Luzon is home to indigenous Igorot peoples with rich culture, rice terraces, and traditional clothing.
fact_tl: Ang Cordillera Administrative Region sa hilagang Luzon ay tahanan ng mga katutubong Igorot na may mayamang kultura at sining, kabilang ang mga rice terrace at tradisyonal na pananamit.
fact_bis: Ang Cordillera Administrative Region sa amihanan nga Luzon puluy-anan sa mga katutubo nga Igorot nga adunay dakong kultura ug sining, apil na ang mga rice terrace ug tradisyonal nga sinina.

q: What does density tell you about a material?
options: How tightly packed it is — how much mass fits into each unit of space
How much the material weighs when placed on a scale
How fast the material melts when heated above room temperature
How brightly the material shines when light hits it
explanation: Density is how tightly packed a material is — its mass for each amount of space (volume) it takes up.
fact_tl: Ang density ay kung gaano kasiksik ang isang bagay — ang bigat (mass) nito sa bawat sukat ng espasyong inookupahan (volume).
fact_bis: Ang density mao ang pagkasiksik sa usa ka materyal — ang gibug-aton (mass) niini matag gidak-on sa luna (volume) nga giokupahan.

q: Where does the water in a pond come from?
options: Rain, streams, and water that flows from the surrounding land
Only from underground springs that push water up from below
Melting ice from distant mountains that flows downhill
Moisture that the pond plants release into the ground over time
explanation: A pond is filled with water from rain, streams, and water that flows from the land.
fact_tl: Ang lawa ay napupuno ng tubig mula sa ulan, sapa, at tubig na dumadaloy mula sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang lanaw mapuno ug tubig gikan sa ulan, sapa, ug tubig nga modagayday gikan sa yuta.

q: Why do fruits and honey taste sweet?
options: They contain natural sugar
They have a large amount of salt that tricks the tongue
They produce a chemical that activates the sour taste buds
They are coated with a thin layer of starch that tastes sweet
explanation: Fruits and honey contain natural sugar, which is why they taste sweet.
fact_tl: May likas na asukal din ang mga prutas at ang pulot-pukyutan, kaya matamis ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga prutas ug ang dugos sa putyukan adunay natural nga asukal, mao nga kini tam-is.

q: What program does the Department of Health use to treat tuberculosis (TB) in the Philippines?
options: Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course (DOTS)
Universal Health Vaccination Program (UHVP)
Community Antibiotic Relief System (CARS)
National Lung Support Initiative (NLSI)
explanation: The DOH treats TB through Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course, or DOTS.
fact_tl: Ang tuberkulosis o TB ay isang nakakahawang sakit ng baga na karaniwan sa Pilipinas; tinatambal ito ng DOH sa pamamagitan ng Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course o DOTS.
fact_bis: Ang tuberculosis o TB usa ka makakahawa nga sakit sa baga nga sagad sa Pilipinas; ginamatulan kini sa DOH pinaagi sa Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course o DOTS.

q: Why did the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in the USA collapse in 1940?
options: Wind caused resonant vibrations that grew large enough to tear the bridge apart
An earthquake cracked the bridge's main support columns at the base
Too many vehicles crossed the bridge at once, overloading it
A flood washed away the soil beneath the bridge's foundations
explanation: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed because wind caused resonant vibrations that grew large enough to tear it apart.
fact_tl: Ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge sa USA ay bumagsak noong 1940 dahil ang hangin ay nagdulot ng resonating vibration na nagpalaki nang malaki hanggang masira ang tulay.
fact_bis: Ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge sa USA nahulog sa 1940 tungod kay ang hangin naghimo og resonating vibrations nga nagdako hangtod nagpihak ang tulay.

q: When a gun fires a bullet forward, what happens to the gun itself?
options: It recoils (kicks) backward as a reaction to pushing the bullet forward
It moves forward along with the bullet because both are pushed by the same force
It stays completely still because the explosion pushes equally on all sides
It spins sideways because the bullet curves as it leaves the barrel
explanation: When a gun fires, it pushes the bullet forward, and as a reaction the gun recoils backward.
fact_tl: Kapag pinaputok ang baril, itinutulak nito ang bala pasulong, at bilang reaksyon, ang baril ay umaatras pabalik.
fact_bis: Kung mobuto ang pusil, giduso niini ang bala paabante, ug isip reaksyon, ang pusil moatras pabalik.

q: What is usually inside a vaccine that teaches your body to fight a disease?
options: Dead or weakened germs, or just a tiny part of a germ
Live, fully active germs at full strength so the body gets real practice
A chemical that destroys the disease germ already inside your blood
A vitamin that makes your white blood cells grow larger and stronger
explanation: Many vaccines are made from dead or weakened germs, or just a tiny part of a germ, so they cannot give you the disease.
fact_tl: Maraming bakuna ang gawa sa patay o pinahinang mikrobyo, o sa isang maliit na bahagi nito, kaya hindi ka nito mahahawa ng sakit.
fact_bis: Daghang bakuna hinimo gikan sa patay o gipahuyang nga mikrobyo, o gamay nga bahin lang niini, busa dili ka niini matakdan sa sakit.

q: Where do termites spend most of their time, and why?
options: Hidden inside wood or soil because they prefer dark places
On the leaves of plants because they need sunlight to find food
Near bright lights at night because they are attracted to the glow
On open ground during the day so they can dry out their wings
explanation: Termites prefer dark places, so they stay hidden inside wood or soil.
fact_tl: Mas gusto ng anay ang madidilim na lugar kaya nananatili silang nakatago sa loob ng kahoy o lupa.
fact_bis: Ang anay mas ganahan sa mangitngit nga dapit, mao nga magpabilin silang tago sa sulod sa kahoy o yuta.

q: What causes your stomach to growl when you are hungry?
options: Gas and fluids moving through the empty stomach and intestines as the muscles squeeze them along
Air that you swallowed getting pushed back up through the throat
Extra acid that your stomach makes spilling into the small intestine
Your heart beating faster when hungry, which vibrates the stomach walls
explanation: Your stomach growls when gas and fluids move through the empty stomach and intestines while the muscles squeeze them; it sounds louder when hungry because there is no food to muffle the noise.
fact_tl: Kumakalam ang tiyan kapag gumagalaw ang gas at likido sa loob ng walang lamang sikmura at bituka, at pinipiga sila ng mga kalamnan. Mas malakas ang tunog kapag gutom dahil walang pagkaing humahadlang sa ingay.
fact_bis: Magkagol ang tiyan kon ang gas ug likido molihok sulod sa walay sulod nga tiyan ug tinai samtang gipuga sila sa kaunoran. Mas kusog ang tingog kon gutom ka tungod kay walay pagkaon nga makapahupay sa saba.

q: How does PHIVOLCS warn Filipinos about dangerous volcanic activity?
options: It uses machines that sense earthquakes and measure gas, then issues an alert level
It flies aircraft over the volcano every day and drops water to cool the lava
It places large mirrors on hillsides to reflect heat away from nearby towns
It trains local teachers to look for lava flows and call the nearest city hall
explanation: PHIVOLCS watches active volcanoes using machines that sense earthquakes and measure gas, issuing an alert level so people know how dangerous the situation is.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS ang mga aktibong bulkan gamit ang mga makina na nakakaramdam ng lindol at sumusukat ng gas. Naglalabas sila ng alert level para malaman kung gaano kadelikado.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS nagbantay sa aktibo nga mga bulkan gamit ang makina nga makabati og linog ug makasukod og gas. Mag-isyu sila og alert level aron mahibal-an unsa ka delikado.

q: Why can cockroaches survive in many different places while the Philippine eagle cannot?
options: Cockroaches are generalists that eat varied food and adapt to many environments, while the Philippine eagle is a specialist needing specific habitat and food
Cockroaches are smaller so they need less food and can hide more easily than eagles
Cockroaches reproduce faster than eagles, so they never run out of members even if many die
Cockroaches breathe through their skin, which allows them to live underwater or on land
explanation: Generalist species like cockroaches survive in many environments and eat varied food, while specialists like the Philippine eagle need specific habitat and food.
fact_tl: Ang generalist species tulad ng ipis ay nabubuhay sa iba't ibang kapaligiran at kumakain ng iba't ibang pagkain, samantalang ang specialist tulad ng Philippine eagle ay nangangailangan ng espesipikong tirahan at pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang generalist species sama sa ipis mabuhi sa daghang palibot ug mokaon sa lain-laing pagkaon, samtang ang espesyalista sama sa Philippine eagle nanginahanglan og espesipikong puy-anan ug pagkaon.

q: How do scientists get time to warn people before a tsunami hits the coast?
options: Sensors detect the low, fast-moving wave while it is still far out in deep water
Satellites photograph the ocean floor moving just before the wave forms
Local fishermen radio in reports as soon as they feel unusual rocking on their boats
Seabirds fly inland hours before a tsunami, giving scientists a natural warning
explanation: Because a tsunami is low and fast in deep water, sensors can detect it while it is still far away, giving time to warn people before it hits the coast.
fact_tl: Dahil mababa at mabilis ang tsunami sa malalim na dagat, may pagkakataong matukoy ito ng mga sensor habang malayo pa, para makapagbigay ng babala bago ito tumama sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ubos ug paspas ang tsunami sa lawom nga dagat, matukib kini sa mga sensor samtang layo pa, aron makahatag og pahimangno una kini mohampak sa baybayon.

q: What is the chemical symbol for helium?
options: He
Hl
Hi
Hm
explanation: The chemical symbol for helium is He.
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng helium (helyum) ay He.
fact_bis: Ang simbolong kemikal sa helium (helyum) kay He.

q: What role do earthworms, fungi, and bacteria play in the soil?
options: They break down dead leaves and animals, returning nutrients so new plants can grow
They protect plant roots from being eaten by larger underground animals
They produce oxygen underground so plant roots can breathe during the night
They hold soil particles together so rainwater cannot wash the soil away
explanation: Decomposers like earthworms, fungi, and bacteria break down dead leaves and animals, returning nutrients to the soil so new plants can grow.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng lupa, ang mga tagapagpabulok tulad ng mga uod, fungi, at bakterya ay sumisira sa mga patay na dahon at hayop, na nagbabalik ng sustansya sa lupa para muling tumubo ang mga halaman.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa yuta, ang mga tigpadunot sama sa bulati, fungi, ug bakterya magdunot sa patay nga mga dahon ug mananap, nga magbalik sa sustansiya ngadto sa yuta aron makatubo pag-usab ang mga tanom.

q: How do mangrove forests help protect coastal communities?
options: Their dense roots and trunks block waves and protect land from rising seas
They release a chemical into the water that calms ocean currents near the shore
They attract large schools of fish that eat the bases of incoming waves
Their tall canopy deflects strong typhoon winds before they reach the land
explanation: Mangrove forests along the coast help block waves and protect land from rising seas.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakawan sa baybayin ay nakakatulong na pigilan ang alon at proteksyon laban sa pagtaas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga bakhaw sa baybayon makatabang sa pagpugong sa balod ug panalipod batok sa pagsaka sa dagat.

q: Do fish live inside mangrove forests for their entire lives?
options: No — young fish use mangroves as a nursery, then swim out to reefs or the open sea when they grow bigger
Yes — once a fish settles in a mangrove, it stays there and never leaves because food is plentiful
No — fish only enter mangroves during storms to shelter, and leave again within a day or two
Yes — mangroves provide everything fish need, so there is no reason for them to move away
explanation: Fish only stay in mangroves while young; once they grow bigger, they swim out to coral reefs or the open sea.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, tumatagal habambuhay ang mga isda sa bakawan. Ngunit ang totoo, doon lang sila nanunuluyan habang bata. Kapag malalaki na, lumalangoy sila palabas patungong bahura o malalim na dagat para mamuhay doon.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga ang isda magpabilin sa bakawan sa tibuok kinabuhi. Apan ang tinuod, magpuyo lang sila didto samtang bata pa. Kon modako na, molangoy sila pagawas paingon sa bahura o lawom nga dagat aron mamuyo didto.

q: How did William Herschel discover infrared light in 1800?
options: He noticed a thermometer warming up just beyond the red end of sunlight's colors
He saw a bright glow through a prism that appeared past the violet color of sunlight
He detected a humming sound when red light passed through a crystal lens
He measured that red light traveled slightly faster than the other colors of sunlight
explanation: William Herschel discovered infrared light in 1800 when he noticed a thermometer warming up just beyond the red color of sunlight.
fact_tl: Si William Herschel din ang nakatuklas ng infrared light noong 1800 nang mapansin niyang umiinit ang termometro lampas sa pulang kulay ng sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Si William Herschel usab ang nakadiskobre sa infrared light niadtong 1800 sa dihang namatikdan niya nga nag-init ang termometro lapas sa pula nga kolor sa silaw sa adlaw.

q: Where are herons (tagak) commonly seen in the Philippines?
options: In rice fields and near carabaos while looking for food
On rocky mountain cliffs where they build large nests
In city parks eating seeds that people scatter on the ground
In dense forest canopy far from farms and people
explanation: In the Philippines, herons are often seen in rice fields and near carabaos as they look for food.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas makita ang tagak sa palayan at sa tabi ng mga kalabaw na naghahanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kanunay makita ang tagak sa humayan ug duol sa mga kabaw samtang nangita ug pagkaon.

q: Why is it dangerous for a pregnant woman to smoke?
options: Smoking harms the baby growing in her womb
Smoke makes the mother cough, which can bruise her lungs but does not reach the baby
Only secondhand smoke is harmful during pregnancy; smoking yourself has no effect on the baby
Smoking slows the mother's digestion, making her absorb fewer vitamins but not harming the baby directly
explanation: Smoking during pregnancy harms the baby growing in the womb.
fact_tl: Ang paninigarilyo ng buntis ay nakakasama sa sanggol sa loob ng sinapupunan.
fact_bis: Ang pagpanigarilyo sa mabdos makadaot sa bata nga anaa pa sa tagoangkan.

q: If two fossils are found in rock layers, and one is deeper underground than the other, which is usually older?
options: The one in the deeper layer, because lower layers were formed first
The one in the shallower layer, because it was buried more recently by stronger forces
They are the same age, because rock layers form at the same time throughout the Earth
The deeper one is younger because pressure underground speeds up the aging process
explanation: Fossils in deeper rock layers are usually older than those above them, which helps us see the order in which living things appeared.
fact_tl: Sa karaniwan, ang mga fossil na nasa mas malalim na patong ng bato ay mas matanda kaysa sa nasa itaas, kaya nakikita natin ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng buhay.
fact_bis: Sa kasagaran, ang mga fossil sa mas lawom nga sapaw sa bato mas tigulang kaysa naa sa ibabaw, busa makita nato ang han-ay sa pagtungha sa mga buhi.

q: What happens when you pour cooking oil — like coconut oil or corn oil — into a glass of water?
options: The oil floats on top because all kitchen oils are lighter than water
The oil sinks to the bottom because oil is denser than water
The oil mixes completely with the water and disappears
Some oils sink and some float, depending on which type you use
explanation: Almost every kind of kitchen oil floats on water because all of them are lighter than water.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ng uri ng langis sa kusina—langis ng niyog, mantika ng baboy, o langis ng mais—ay lumulutang sa tubig. Ito ay dahil silang lahat ay mas magaan kaysa tubig.
fact_bis: Halos tanan nga matang sa lana sa kusina—lana sa lubi, tambok sa baboy, o lana sa mais—naglutaw sa tubig. Kini tungod kay tanan sila mas gaan kaysa tubig.

q: Is it true that you can only see the Moon at night?
options: No — the Moon can also be seen in the morning or afternoon because it is still in the sky, just fainter than the Sun
Yes — the Moon only rises after sunset and always sets before sunrise
No — the Moon is only visible during the day and completely disappears at night
Yes — gravity keeps the Moon on the opposite side of Earth from the Sun at all times
explanation: The Moon can often be seen in the morning or afternoon too, because it is still in the sky — it is just fainter than the Sun.
fact_tl: Maling akala na sa gabi lang lumalabas ang Buwan. Madalas mong makita ang Buwan kahit umaga o tanghali, kasi nasa langit pa rin ito—mahina lang ang liwanag nito kaysa Araw.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga sa gabii ra mogawas ang Bulan. Kanunay nimong makita ang Bulan bisan buntag o udto, kay anaa pa kini sa langit—maluya ra ang kahayag niini kaysa Adlaw.

q: Why do growing children need more calcium than older adults?
options: Because their bones are still getting taller and bigger quickly
Because children exercise more and sweat out calcium faster than adults
Because younger blood cannot carry as much calcium as adult blood
Because children's stomachs can only absorb calcium-rich foods, not other nutrients
explanation: Growing children need more calcium than older adults because their bones are still getting taller and bigger quickly.
fact_tl: Mas maraming kaltsyum ang kailangan ng mga batang lumalaki kaysa matatanda. Ito ay dahil mabilis pang tumatangkad at lumalaki ang inyong mga buto.
fact_bis: Mas daghan nga kalsyum ang gikinahanglan sa mga batang nagdako kaysa tigulang. Tungod kini kay paspas pa nga nagataas ug nagadako ang inyong mga bukog.

q: Which of the following groups lists real active volcanoes in the Philippines?
options: Mayon, Taal, and Pinatubo
Apo, Pulag, and Halcon
Banahaw, Kitanglad, and Malindang
Manunggal, Makiling, and Isarog
explanation: The Philippines has more than twenty active volcanoes, including Mayon, Taal, and Pinatubo.
fact_tl: May mahigit dalawampung aktibong bulkan ang Pilipinas, kasama ang Mayon, Taal, at Pinatubo.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay kapin baynte ka aktibong bulkan, lakip ang Mayon, Taal, ug Pinatubo.

q: How are bats different from birds even though both can fly?
options: Bats do not have hollow bones like birds do; they stay light through thin bones and a light body instead
Bats have hollow bones just like birds, but their wings are shaped differently so they fly slower
Bats cannot flap their wings like birds and instead only glide from tree to tree
Bats are actually a type of bird, so they share all the same physical features including hollow bones
explanation: Bats also fly, but they don't have the same hollow bones birds do — they stay light through thin bones and a light body.
fact_tl: Ang paniki ay lumilipad din pero hindi ito ibon at walang ganoong guwang na buto gaya ng ibon. Magaan ang paniki sa ibang paraan—maninipis na buto at gaang katawan—kaya kahit iba ang ibon at paniki, parehong kaya nilang lumipad.
fact_bis: Ang kabog molupad sad apan dili kini langgam ug walay sama nga hawan nga buto sa langgam. Ang kabog gaan sa laing paagi—nipis nga buto ug gaan nga lawas—busa bisan lahi ang langgam ug kabog, pareho silang makalupad.

q: Why is iodine especially important for pregnant mothers?
options: It helps the baby's brain develop properly
It keeps the mother's blood pressure low during delivery
It prevents the baby from developing an iron shortage after birth
It helps the mother's joints stay flexible during the later months of pregnancy
explanation: Iodine is important for pregnant mothers because it helps the baby's brain develop.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang iodine sa mga buntis dahil tumutulong ito sa pag-unlad ng utak ng sanggol.
fact_bis: Importante ang iodine sa mga mabdos kay makatabang kini sa pag-uswag sa utok sa bata.

q: On a seesaw, what name do we give to the middle bar that the whole seesaw pivots on?
options: Fulcrum
Load
Effort
Axle
explanation: The fulcrum is the fixed point around which a lever turns; on a seesaw, the bar in the middle that it rests on is the fulcrum.
fact_tl: Ang fulcrum ang tuldok na hindi gumagalaw kung saan umiikot ang isang lever. Halimbawa, sa seesaw, ang bakal sa gitna na pinagtutuntungan ang fulcrum. Dito umiikot ang buong palanca.
fact_bis: Ang fulcrum mao ang punto nga dili molihok diin nagatuyok ang lever. Sa seesaw, ang puthaw sa tunga nga gitungtungan mao ang fulcrum. Didto nagatuyok ang tibuok palanca.

q: Which part of the brain keeps your movements smooth and balanced?
options: Cerebellum
Cerebrum
Medulla
Hypothalamus
explanation: A part of the brain called the cerebellum helps keep your movements smooth and balanced.
fact_tl: May bahagi ng utak na tinatawag na cerebellum o maliit na utak na tumutulong panatilihing maayos at balanse ang iyong mga galaw.
fact_bis: Adunay bahin sa utok nga gitawag og cerebellum o gamay nga utok nga motabang aron magpabilin nga hapsay ug balanse ang imong mga lihok.

q: Why do eyeglasses help people see clearly?
options: The lenses bend (refract) light so it focuses correctly on the eye
The lenses make objects appear brighter so details are easier to spot
The lenses block harmful ultraviolet rays that would otherwise blur vision
The lenses vibrate at a frequency that relaxes the eye muscles
explanation: Lenses and eyeglasses work because of refraction — they bend light to focus it correctly in the eye.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang mga lens at salamin sa mata dahil sa refraction — binabaluktot nila ang liwanag para mag-focus nang tama sa mata at gawing malinaw ang nakikita natin.
fact_bis: Molihok ang mga lens ug salamin sa mata tungod sa refraction — gibawog nila ang kahayag aron mo-focus og husto sa mata ug himuong tin-aw ang atong makita.

q: Besides plastic trash, what else commonly clogs storm drains and causes flooding?
options: Dry leaves and twigs that fall from trees and collect in drains
Rainwater itself, because too much water cannot fit through the pipes
Sand from beaches that the wind blows into city streets
Insects that build nests inside the drain pipes during dry season
explanation: Dry leaves and twigs that fall from trees also collect in storm drains and block the flow of water, just like plastic.
fact_tl: Hindi lang plastik ang nagbabara ng kanal. Ang mga tuyong dahon at sanga na nahuhulog mula sa mga puno ay naiipon din sa imburnal at nakakabara ng daloy ng tubig.
fact_bis: Dili lang plastik ang makababag sa kanal. Ang uga nga mga dahon ug sanga nga mangahulog gikan sa mga kahoy matapok usab sa imburnal ug makababag sa dagayday sa tubig.

q: What is Dr. Angel Alcala known for in protecting the ocean?
options: Helping establish protected ocean areas like Apo Island to safeguard fish
Inventing a fish trap that catches only adult fish and releases the young
Writing the first law in the Philippines that banned ocean fishing entirely
Discovering a new species of whale shark in the waters near Palawan
explanation: Dr. Angel Alcala helped establish protected ocean areas such as Apo Island to safeguard the fish.
fact_tl: Tinulungan ni Dr. Angel Alcala na maitatag ang mga protektadong bahagi ng dagat tulad ng Apo Island para mapangalagaan ang mga isda.
fact_bis: Si Dr. Angel Alcala mitabang sa pagtukod sa mga protektadong bahin sa dagat sama sa Apo Island aron mapanalipdan ang mga isda.

q: What is the main job of the tiny ridges (fingerprints) on your fingertips?
options: They help you grip objects firmly so they do not slip from your hands
They sense temperature changes so your brain knows when something is hot or cold
They protect the bone inside your finger from hard bumps and pressure
They release moisture to keep the skin from cracking in dry weather
explanation: The skin ridges called fingerprints help us grip objects firmly so they do not slip from our hands.
fact_tl: Ang balat sa dulo ng ating mga daliri ay may maliliit na guhit o tinatawag na fingerprint. Tumutulong ito para mas mahawakan natin nang maigi ang mga bagay nang hindi nadudulas.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa tumoy sa atong mga tudlo adunay gagmay nga linya nga gitawag og fingerprint. Kini nagtabang aron mas maayo natong magunitan ang mga butang nga dili modahili.

q: Which part of a paddle actually pushes the water to move a boat forward?
options: The blade — the wide flat end that catches the water
The grip — the top end where the paddler's hand rests
The shaft — the long handle that connects the two ends
The joint — the metal ring that connects the blade to the shaft
explanation: The wide blade at the end of the paddle matters most because it pushes more water to move the boat.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing parte ang sagwan: ang blade (ang malapad na dulo na sumasalo sa tubig), ang shaft (ang mahabang tangkay na hawak), at ang grip (ang dulo sa itaas na hinahawakan ng kamay). Ang malapad na blade ang importante kasi mas maraming tubig ang naitutulak nito.
fact_bis: Ang bugsay naay tulo ka punoan nga bahin: ang blade (ang lapad nga tumoy nga modakop sa tubig), ang shaft (ang taas nga kuptanan), ug ang grip (ang ibabaw nga tumoy nga kuptan sa kamot). Ang lapad nga blade mao ang labing importante kay daghan ang tubig nga matulak niini.

q: Where is the Manila Trench located, and why is it significant?
options: West of Luzon in the South China Sea; it is a potential source of strong earthquakes and tsunamis for western Luzon
East of Mindanao in the Pacific Ocean; it is the deepest point in the Philippine Sea
Between Visayas and Mindanao; it is where two tectonic plates are slowly pulling apart
North of Batanes in the Luzon Strait; it causes the strongest typhoons entering the Philippines
explanation: The Manila Trench is a subduction zone west of Luzon in the South China Sea and is one of the potential sources of strong earthquakes and tsunamis affecting western Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang Manila Trench ay isang subduction zone sa kanluran ng Luzon sa South China Sea; ito ay isa sa mga potensyal na pinagmulan ng malakas na lindol at tsunami na maaaring makaapekto sa kanlurang Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Manila Trench usa ka subduction zone sa kasadpan sa Luzon sa South China Sea; usa kini sa potensyal nga pinagmulan sa kusog nga lindol ug tsunami nga mahimong makaapekto sa kasadpanong Luzon.

q: What keeps the billions of stars in a galaxy from flying apart in all directions?
options: Gravity pulls the stars together so they orbit around the galaxy's center
A large magnetic field produced by the galaxy's core locks the stars in place
Dark clouds of dust between stars act like glue holding them together
The rapid spinning of the galaxy creates a force that pushes stars inward
explanation: Gravity pulls and holds the billions of stars in a galaxy together so they orbit around its center instead of flying apart.
fact_tl: Ang grabidad ang humihila at nagpapanatili sa bilyon-bilyong bituin sa loob ng isang galaxy, kaya umiikot sila sa paligid ng sentro nito sa halip na lumipad palayo.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad maoy mobira ug mohiusa sa bilyon-bilyon ka bituon sulod sa usa ka galaxy, mao nga naglibot sila sa sentro niini imbis nga molupad palayo.

q: Which statement is TRUE about helping improve your country?
options: Every ordinary person can do something helpful in their own community, no matter how small
Only elected leaders have the power and resources needed to make a real difference
Helping the country is only meaningful if you are rich enough to donate large amounts of money
Students must wait until they graduate and have jobs before they can contribute to society
explanation: A common misconception is that helping is only for the rich or for leaders — every ordinary person can do something, however small, in their own community.
fact_tl: May maling akala na ang pagtulong sa bayan ay para lang sa mayayaman o sa mga lider. Hindi totoo iyon—bawat ordinaryong tao ay may magagawa, gaano man kaliit, sa sariling komunidad.
fact_bis: Adunay sayop nga pagtuo nga ang pagtabang sa nasud para lang sa adunahan o sa mga lider. Dili kana tinuod—matag ordinaryong tawo adunay mahimo, bisan gamay, sa kaugalingong komunidad.

q: How fast do all electromagnetic waves (like light, radio waves, and X-rays) travel in empty space?
options: About 300,000 kilometers per second
About 3,000 kilometers per second
About 300 kilometers per second
About 30,000,000 kilometers per second
explanation: All electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light, about 300,000 kilometers per second in a vacuum.
fact_tl: Lahat ng electromagnetic waves ay naglalakbay sa bilis ng liwanag, mga 300,000 kilometro kada segundo sa vacuum.
fact_bis: Tanang electromagnetic waves mobiyahe sa katulin sa kahayag, mga 300,000 kilometro kada segundo sa vacuum.

q: How do wasps help farmers protect their crops?
options: Wasps prey on caterpillars and other pest insects, naturally controlling their numbers
Wasps pollinate crop flowers better than bees because they visit more plants per day
Wasps dig holes in the soil that let water reach plant roots more easily
Wasps produce a chemical that repels larger animals from eating farm plants
explanation: Many wasps prey on caterpillars and other pest insects, helping farmers naturally by controlling caterpillar populations in crops.
fact_tl: Ang maraming putakti ay kumakain ng mga uod at iba pang insektong pestes—nagtutulungan sila sa mga magsasaka sa pamamagitan ng pagkontrol sa bilang ng mga uod sa halaman.
fact_bis: Daghang putakti nagkaon og mga uod ug uban pang pest nga insekto—nagtabang sila sa mga mag-uuma pinaagi sa natural nga pagkontrol sa bilang sa mga uod sa tanom.

q: Besides animals, who else has long eaten fruits that grow wild in forests?
options: Indigenous people and those living near forests, who pick ripe fruits as nutritious food and sometimes sell them
Only scientists studying the forest, who taste the fruits to check if they are safe for animals
Children in cities who hike into forests on weekends to gather snacks
Farmers who plant special trees inside forests so they can harvest fruit commercially
explanation: Besides animals, indigenous people and those living near forests have long eaten wild forest fruits as nutritious food and sometimes sold them at the market.
fact_tl: Bukod sa hayop, ang ilang prutas sa gubat ay matagal nang kinakain ng mga katutubo at taong nakatira malapit sa kagubatan. Pinipitas nila ang mga hinog na bunga bilang masustansyang pagkain at minsan ay ipinagbibili rin sa palengke.
fact_bis: Gawas sa hayop, ang ubang bunga sa lasang dugay nang gikaon sa mga lumad ug sa mga tawong nagpuyo duol sa kalasangan. Mamupo sila sa mga hinog nga bunga isip masustansyang pagkaon ug usahay ibaligya pa sa merkado.

q: According to PHIVOLCS, approximately how many active volcanoes does the Philippines have?
options: About 24
About 7
About 50
About 100
explanation: The Philippines has about 24 active volcanoes according to PHIVOLCS.
fact_tl: May humigit-kumulang 24 na aktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas ayon sa PHIVOLCS.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay mga 24 ka aktibo nga bulkan sumala sa PHIVOLCS.

q: What is PAGASA's main job for the Filipino public?
options: Watching the weather and warning people about typhoons
Managing the country's airports and flight schedules
Tracking fish populations in Philippine waters
Monitoring volcanic activity and issuing eruption alerts
explanation: PAGASA is the government agency that watches the weather and warns the public about typhoons.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ang ahensiya ng gobyerno na nagbabantay sa panahon at nagbababala tungkol sa mga bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA mao ang ahensiya sa gobyerno nga nagbantay sa panahon ug nagpasidaan bahin sa mga bagyo.

q: How do salmon find their way back to the exact river where they were born?
options: They follow the smell of the water back to their birth stream.
They follow ocean currents that lead back to fresh water.
They are guided by the position of the sun and stars.
They follow other older salmon who know the route.
explanation: Salmon are guided by the smell of the water to return to the exact stream where they were born to lay their eggs.
fact_tl: Ang salmon ay namumuhay sa dagat ngunit bumabalik pasalungat sa ilog kung saan ito ipinanganak para mangitlog — ginagabayan ito ng amoy ng tubig pabalik sa eksaktong sapa.
fact_bis: Ang salmon nagpuyo sa dagat apan mobalik pasulbong sa suba diin sila natawo aron mangitlog — gigiyahan sila sa baho sa tubig pabalik sa eksaktong sapa.

q: Which fruit is rambutan most closely related to?
options: Lychee
Durian
Mango
Papaya
explanation: Rambutan belongs to the same fruit family as lychee and longan.
fact_tl: Ang rambutan ay kabilang sa parehong pamilya ng prutas tulad ng lychee at longan.
fact_bis: Ang rambutan kauban sa samang banay sa prutas sama sa lychee ug longan.

q: What does Storm Signal No. 3 warn people about?
options: Strong, dangerous winds that may arrive within about 18 hours and can tear off roofs.
Very light rains that may cause minor flooding in low areas.
Moderate winds expected to arrive in about 36 hours.
A tropical depression that may bring heavy but slow-moving rain.
explanation: Signal No. 3 means strong, dangerous storm winds may arrive within about 18 hours and can tear off roofs and topple trees.
fact_tl: Ang Signal No. 3 ay nangangahulugang may malakas at delikadong hanging dala ng bagyo na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 18 oras at maaaring tumanggal ng bubong at magpabagsak ng puno.
fact_bis: Ang Signal No. 3 nagpasabot nga adunay kusog ug peligrosong hangin gikan sa bagyo nga moabot sulod sa mga 18 ka oras ug makatanggal sa atop ug makapukan sa mga kahoy.

q: Where in the Philippines is Tubbataha Reef located, and when can visitors access it?
options: In the middle of the Sulu Sea, accessible only from March to June.
Near Palawan's western shore, accessible all year round.
In the Visayan Sea, accessible from June to October.
Near Mindanao's coast, accessible only during the dry season.
explanation: Tubbataha Reef consists of two coral atolls in the middle of the Sulu Sea, more than 150 km from land, and is only accessible from March to June.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha Reef ay binubuo ng dalawang coral atoll na matatagpuan sa gitna ng Sulu Sea, higit na 150 kilometro mula sa pinakamalapit na lupa; ang lugar ay naa-access lamang sa mga buwang Marso hanggang Hunyo.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha Reef naglangkob sa duha ka coral atoll nga nahimutang sa kalibotonang Dagat Sulu, labaw sa 150 kilometro gikan sa pinakduol nga yuta; ang site ma-access lamang gikan Marso hangtod Hunyo.

q: What is the main job of epithelial tissue in your body?
options: It lines body surfaces like the skin and stomach to protect the body.
It carries electrical signals from the brain to muscles.
It produces hormones that control growth and energy.
It connects bones together at joints to allow movement.
explanation: Epithelial tissue lines body surfaces like the skin, inside of the stomach, and tubes to protect the body.
fact_tl: Ang epithelyal na tissue ay bumabatbat sa mga ibabaw ng katawan tulad ng balat, loob ng tiyan, at mga daluyan upang maprotektahan ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang epithelyal na tissue nagtabon sa mga ibabaw sa lawas sama sa panit, sulod sa tiyan, ug mga tubo aron mapanalipdan ang lawas.

q: What is the difference between temperature and heat?
options: Temperature measures the average energy of particles, while heat is the total energy transferred between objects.
Temperature is the total energy in a substance, while heat measures how hot or cold something feels.
Temperature and heat are the same thing, just measured in different units.
Temperature measures how fast energy moves, while heat measures how much energy is stored.
explanation: Temperature measures average particle kinetic energy, while heat is the total energy transferred from one object to another.
fact_tl: Ang temperatura at init ay magkaibang bagay — ang temperatura ay sukatan ng average na kinetic energy ng mga particle, habang ang init ay ang kabuuang enerhiyang inilipat mula sa isang bagay papunta sa isa pa.
fact_bis: Ang temperatura ug init managlahi nga mga bagay — ang temperatura nagsukod sa average nga kinetic energy sa mga particle, samtang ang init mao ang tibuok enerhiya nga gibalhin gikan sa usa ka butang ngadto sa usa.

q: Why do snails eat chalky materials in addition to plants?
options: To get calcium that keeps their shell strong and growing.
To sharpen their teeth so they can eat tougher plants.
To help them digest leaves more quickly.
To make their body slippery so they can move faster.
explanation: Snails get calcium from chalky things to keep their hard shell strong and growing.
fact_tl: Bukod sa halaman, kumukuha rin ang kuhol ng calcium mula sa mga maaapog na bagay para tumibay at lumaki ang matigas nitong bahay o shell.
fact_bis: Gawas sa tanom, mokuha pud ang kuhol og calcium gikan sa mga apog nga butang aron molig-on ug motubo ang gahi niyang kabhang.

q: How do engineers use ultrasound to check metal bridges for damage?
options: Sound echoes bounce off hidden cracks and reveal flaws inside the metal without damaging it.
Ultrasound heats the metal until cracks glow and become visible.
Ultrasound vibrations shake the bridge until cracks appear on the surface.
Engineers listen for unusual humming sounds that indicate weak spots.
explanation: Engineers use ultrasound to inspect metal structures for hidden cracks — the sound echoes reveal flaws or voids inside the metal without damaging it.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga inhinyero ang ultrasound para suriin ang mga metal na tulay at istruktura para sa mga buto na hindi nakikita — ang echo ng tunog ay nagpapakita kung mayroong mga bato o butas sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang mga inhinyero naggamit sa ultrasound sa pagsusi sa mga metal nga tulay ug istruktura alang sa mga nakatago nga bali — ang mga echo sa tunog nagpakita sa mga depekto o buho sa sulod sa metal.

q: What can a baby do before it is born?
options: Move and kick inside the womb, which the mother can sometimes feel.
Open its eyes and respond to bright light outside.
Breathe air through its lungs just like after birth.
Hear only its mother's voice but not other sounds.
explanation: Before being born, the baby can already move and kick, and the mother can sometimes feel it.
fact_tl: Bago pa ipanganak, kaya nang gumalaw at sumipa ng sanggol, at minsan nararamdaman ito ng ina.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa matawo, ang bata makahimo na og lihok ug sipa, ug usahay mabati kini sa inahan.

q: What helps your immune system fight illness and lets your body recover faster?
options: Getting enough rest and drinking plenty of water.
Eating large amounts of food so the body has extra energy.
Staying active and exercising even when you feel sick.
Taking a cold shower several times each day.
explanation: When sick, enough rest and drinking plenty of water help the immune system fight and let the body recover faster.
fact_tl: Kapag may sakit, ang sapat na pahinga at pag-inom ng maraming tubig ay tumutulong sa immune system na lumaban at mas mabilis na gumaling ang katawan.
fact_bis: Kon masakit, ang igong pahulay ug pag-inom og daghang tubig motabang sa immune system nga makig-away ug mas paspas nga mamaayo ang lawas.

q: What does a reef shark eat on the reef?
options: Fish and octopus.
Coral and sea plants.
Jellyfish and sea turtles.
Shrimp and crabs only.
explanation: A reef shark is a predator that eats fish and octopus on the reef.
fact_tl: Ang reef shark ay isang mandaragit na kumakain ng mga isda at pugita sa bahura.
fact_bis: Ang reef shark usa ka manunukob nga mokaon og mga isda ug kugita sa bahura.

q: Why do you feel a spark when touching metal but not when touching plastic?
options: Metal is a conductor so charge flows through it easily, while plastic is an insulator that stops charge from flowing.
Metal stores more static charge than plastic, so the spark is larger.
Plastic absorbs all charge without releasing it, so there is never any build-up.
Metal has a rougher surface that creates friction and produces sparks.
explanation: Metal is a conductor where charge passes easily, so you feel a spark; plastic is an insulator where charge cannot flow, so you rarely feel a spark from it.
fact_tl: Madali tumalon ang charge papunta sa metal kaya doon ka nakakaramdam ng spark. Sa plastik, goma, o kahoy, hindi madaling dumaloy ang charge, kaya bihira kang makaramdam ng spark sa mga ito. Ang metal ay 'conductor'—madaling daanan ng kuryente; ang plastik ay 'insulator'—mahirap daanan.
fact_bis: Dali molukso ang charge ngadto sa metal, mao nga didto ka mobati ug spark. Sa plastik, goma, o kahoy, dili dali modagayday ang charge, busa panagsa ra ka mobati ug spark gikan niini. Ang metal usa ka 'conductor'—dali agian sa kuryente; ang plastik usa ka 'insulator'—lisod agian.

q: When is the knifefish most active, and what effect does it have on Laguna Lake?
options: It hunts at night, and because it eats so much, native fish numbers drop quickly.
It hunts during the day, and it helps control algae growth in the lake.
It feeds at dawn and dusk, and its presence attracts more small fish.
It hunts at night but mostly eats plants, so fish populations stay stable.
explanation: The knifefish is more active at night when it hunts small fish and eggs, causing the number of native fish in Laguna Lake to drop quickly.
fact_tl: Ang knifefish ay mas aktibo sa gabi, kung kailan nito hinuhuli ang maliliit na isda at itlog. Dahil madalas itong kumain, mabilis na bumababa ang dami ng katutubong isda sa Lawa ng Laguna.
fact_bis: Ang knifefish mas aktibo sa gabii, kung kanus-a niini gipangita ang gagmay nga isda ug itlog. Tungod kay kanunay kining mokaon, paspas mokunhod ang gidaghanon sa lumad nga isda sa Lanaw sa Laguna.

q: What body part does a sea snail use to scrape algae from rocks?
options: A radula — a tongue-like organ with thousands of tiny teeth.
A beak similar to the one a parrotfish has.
A set of claws on its foot that grip and tear food.
A long sticky tongue like a frog's that catches food.
explanation: Sea snails have a radula — a tongue-like organ with thousands of tiny teeth — that they use to rasp algae from rock and coral surfaces.
fact_tl: Ang mga snail ng dagat ay may radula — isang tongue-like organ na may libo-libong maliit na ngipon — na ginagamit nila para kumain sa pamamagitan ng pagkaskas ng algae mula sa mga bato at coral surfaces.
fact_bis: Ang mga snail sa dagat adunay radula — usa ka tongue-like nga organo nga may libu-libong gagmay nga ngipon — nga ilang gigamit sa pagkaon pinaagi sa pag-kutkot sa algae gikan sa mga bato ug coral surfaces.

q: Why does the Rafflesia flower smell like rotting meat?
options: To attract flies that help pollinate it.
To keep animals from eating its petals.
To warn nearby plants that danger is close.
To trap insects inside so it can digest them.
explanation: The Rafflesia smells like rotting meat to attract flies, which help pollinate it.
fact_tl: Ang Rafflesia ay umaamoy ng bulok na karne para makaakit ng mga langaw na siyang tumutulong sa pollination nito.
fact_bis: Ang Rafflesia mobaho sama sa dunot nga karne aron makadani ug mga langaw nga motabang sa pagpamulak niini.

q: How many chromosomes does a typical human body cell have?
options: 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs.
23 chromosomes, one from each parent.
92 chromosomes in 46 matching pairs.
48 chromosomes, two from each parent.
explanation: Each typical human body cell has 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs, with one of each pair from each parent.
fact_tl: Karaniwang may 46 na chromosomes ang bawat karaniwang selula ng tao, nakaayos sa 23 na pares, kung saan ang isa sa bawat pares ay galing sa ina at ang isa naman ay galing sa ama.
fact_bis: Ang matag ordinaryong selula sa tao kasagaran adunay 46 ka chromosomes, gihan-ay sa 23 ka pares, diin ang usa sa matag pares gikan sa inahan ug ang usa gikan sa amahan.

q: How can some succulent plants be grown without seeds?
options: A single leaf placed on soil can sprout roots and grow into a new plant.
A small piece of bark can be planted directly in the ground.
Succulents only grow from seeds stored inside their thick stems.
Roots from one plant can be split and each piece grows a new plant.
explanation: Some plants like succulents can be grown from a single leaf — when laid on soil, roots and a new plant sprout from it.
fact_tl: May mga halaman gaya ng succulent na maaaring patubuin mula sa isang dahon lang — kapag inilapat sa lupa, tutubo dito ang ugat at bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom sama sa succulent nga mahimong patubuon gikan sa usa ka dahon lang — kung ipahimutang sa yuta, motubo gikan niini ang gamot ug bag-ong tanom.

q: In a Philippine ocean food chain, what do small fish eat?
options: Plankton
Tuna
Coral
Seaweed
explanation: In the Philippine sea food chain, the sun grows plankton, plankton is eaten by small fish, and small fish are eaten by big fish like tuna.
fact_tl: Sa dagat ng Pilipinas, may food chain na ganito: araw → plankton → maliliit na isda → malalaking isda tulad ng tuna. Lahat ng isdang ito ay nakasalalay sa araw na nagpapalaki ng plankton.
fact_bis: Sa dagat sa Pilipinas, adunay food chain nga sama niini: adlaw → plankton → gagmayng isda → dagkong isda sama sa tuna. Tanan kining mga isda nagsalig sa adlaw nga maoy nagpatubo sa plankton.

q: What happens to the carbon inside a tree after the wood is turned into furniture or paper?
options: The carbon stays stored inside the wood or paper product for as long as it is used.
The carbon is released into the air as soon as the tree is cut down.
The carbon turns into oxygen when the wood is shaped into furniture.
Most of the carbon drains into the soil when wood is dried and processed.
explanation: Even after wood becomes paper or furniture, the carbon stays inside it, so wooden things keep storing carbon for as long as we use them.
fact_tl: Kahit ginawa nang papel o muwebles ang kahoy, nananatili pa rin doon ang karbon. Kaya ang gamit na yari sa kahoy ay imbakan din ng karbon habang ginagamit.
fact_bis: Bisan human mahimong papel o muwebles ang kahoy, ang karbon magpabilin gihapon sulod niini. Mao nga ang mga butang nga hinimo sa kahoy magtipig usab ug karbon samtang gigamit nato.

q: If a liquid has a pH of 3, what does that tell you about it?
options: It is acidic because its pH is below 7.
It is basic because lower numbers mean stronger bases.
It is neutral like pure water.
It has no acid or base properties at all.
explanation: A low pH (below 7) is acidic, while a high pH (above 7) is basic.
fact_tl: Ang mababang pH (mas mababa sa 7) ay asido, habang ang mataas na pH (mas mataas sa 7) ay base.
fact_bis: Ang ubos nga pH (ubos sa 7) asido, samtang ang taas nga pH (taas sa 7) base.

q: What two main materials are mixed together to make steel?
options: Iron and a small amount of carbon.
Iron and a small amount of aluminum.
Copper and a small amount of iron.
Nickel and a small amount of iron.
explanation: Steel is made of iron mixed with a small amount of carbon.
fact_tl: Ang asero (steel) ay gawa sa bakal (iron) na hinaluan ng kaunting carbon.
fact_bis: Ang asero (steel) hinimo sa puthaw (iron) nga gisagolan og gamay nga carbon.

q: Why does a makahiya leaf fold up at night even when nobody touches it?
options: Darkness causes water to leave the cells, making the leaf fold just as if it were touched.
The leaf folds at night to trap insects for food while the plant sleeps.
Cold night air makes the leaf stiff and it curls naturally.
The leaf folds at night to save energy by stopping photosynthesis.
explanation: The makahiya leaf folds at night because darkness causes water to leave its cells — the same mechanism as touch, but triggered by dark instead.
fact_tl: Kahit walang humihipo, tumitiklop din ang dahon ng makahiya kapag gabi. Parang natutulog ito! Ito ay dahil din sa paglabas ng tubig sa selula, pero ang nagpapagalaw nito ay ang pagdilim, hindi ang paghipo.
fact_bis: Bisan walay muhikap, mutiklop usab ang dahon sa makahiya kon gabii. Morag matulog kini! Tungod usab kini sa paggawas sa tubig sa mga selula, apan ang hinungdan dinhi mao ang kangitngit, dili ang paghikap.

q: What can you do with jackfruit seeds?
options: Cook and eat them — they taste a bit like boiled cassava or banana.
Plant them immediately or they will lose the ability to sprout.
Use them only as animal feed because they are too hard for people.
Grind them into flour but never eat them whole.
explanation: Jackfruit seeds can be cooked and eaten, tasting a bit like boiled cassava or banana.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ng langka ay maaaring lutuin at kainin, halos kasinglasa ng nilagang kamoteng-kahoy o saba.
fact_bis: Ang mga liso sa nangka mahimong lutoon ug kaonon, lami nga morag linat-ang balanghoy o saging.

q: When water freezes into ice, what type of change has taken place?
options: A physical change, because the substance stays the same even though its state changed.
A chemical change, because the water turns into a completely new substance.
A biological change, because living things caused the temperature to drop.
No real change at all, because ice and water are just different names for the same thing.
explanation: Changes of state like freezing are physical changes because the substance stays the same.
fact_tl: Ang pagbabago ng estado—pagtunaw, pagkulo, pagsingaw, o pagyelo—ay pisikal na pagbabago dahil pareho pa ring sangkap ang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang pag-usab sa kahimtang—pagtunaw, pagbukal, pag-alisngaw, o pagyelo—kay pisikal nga kabag-ohan kay mao gihapon nga substansiya ang butang.

q: Why do some craftspeople use cuttlebone when making metal jewelry?
options: Its soft but slightly gritty texture makes it useful for polishing metal and as a mould for casting small silver pieces.
It contains chemicals that make silver turn a bright gold color.
It dissolves easily in water, creating a liquid that hardens metals.
It is the only natural material strong enough to scratch a diamond for gem-cutting.
explanation: Because cuttlebone is soft yet slightly gritty, craftspeople use it to polish metal and as a mould for casting small silver jewelry.
fact_tl: Dahil malambot pero magaspang ang cuttlebone, ginagamit ito ng ilang mga artisan bilang pampakinis ng metal. May gumagamit din nito bilang hulma sa paggawa ng maliliit na alahas na pilak.
fact_bis: Tungod kay humok apan medyo gahi-gahi ang cuttlebone, gigamit kini sa pipila ka artisan aron ipasinaw ang metal. Ang uban naggamit niini isip hulma sa paghimo og gagmay nga plata nga alahas.

q: Why are GFCI outlets required in bathrooms and kitchens?
options: They detect when current flows through a person's body and cut power in milliseconds to prevent electrocution.
They use less electricity than normal outlets to save energy near water.
They prevent water from entering the wiring by sealing the outlet holes.
They automatically turn off any device that is left on for more than one hour.
explanation: A GFCI outlet has a sensor that trips and cuts power in milliseconds when current takes an unexpected path such as through a person's body.
fact_tl: Ang GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlet ay may kasamang sensor na nagti-trip at nagpapatay ng kuryente sa loob ng milliseconds kapag may kuryente na dumadaan sa di-inaasahang daan tulad ng sa katawan ng tao — kailangan ito sa banyo at kusina.
fact_bis: Ang GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlet adunay sensor nga magtrip ug magpatay sa kuryente sa sulod sa milliseconds inig adunay kuryente nga moagi sa dili inaasahang agianan sama sa lawas sa tawo — gikinahanglan kini sa banyo ug kusina.

q: How do ocean trenches form?
options: Two tectonic plates collide and one sinks beneath the other.
A volcano erupts on the ocean floor and pushes rock outward.
Two plates pull apart and the gap between them becomes a trench.
Ocean currents erode the sea floor over millions of years.
explanation: Ocean trenches form where two tectonic plates collide and one plate sinks beneath the other.
fact_tl: Ang mga kanal sa karagatan ay nabubuo kung saan nagbabanggaan ang dalawang plato at ang isa ay lumulubog sa ilalim ng isa.
fact_bis: Ang mga kanal sa dagat naporma diin nagbangga ang duha ka plato ug ang usa molusbog ilalom sa pikas.

q: Why does a butterfly choose a specific plant's leaves when laying its eggs?
options: So the caterpillar that hatches will have the right food right away.
So the eggs are hidden from predators who cannot climb that plant.
So the eggs stay warm because those leaves absorb more sunlight.
So the eggs dry out less because those leaves hold more water.
explanation: A butterfly lays its eggs on the right plant's leaves so the hatching caterpillar has food right away.
fact_tl: Ang paru-paro ay nangingitlog sa ilalim ng dahon ng tamang halaman para may makain agad ang uod kapag napisa.
fact_bis: Ang alibangbang mangitlog sa ilawom sa dahon sa hustong tanom aron ang ulod nga mapusa adunay dayong pagkaon.

q: What is the name of the small stalk that connects a leaf to a branch?
options: Petiole
Blade
Midrib
Stipule
explanation: The small stalk that connects the leaf to the branch is called the petiole, while the wide flat part where food is made is called the blade.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang parte ang dahon. Ang lapad at patag na bahagi ang tinatawag na blade — dito nangyayari ang paggawa ng pagkain. Ang maliit na tangkay na nagkakabit sa dahon sa sanga ay tinatawag na petiole o tangkay.
fact_bis: Ang dahon adunay lainlaing bahin. Ang lapad ug patag nga bahin gitawag og blade, diin mahitabo ang paghimo og pagkaon. Ang gamay nga tangkay nga nagdugtong sa dahon ngadto sa sanga gitawag og petiole o tangkay.

q: Why does your nose run when you have a cold?
options: Your body makes extra mucus to wash the virus out of your nose.
Your blood vessels shrink from the cold, pushing fluid out through the nose.
The virus destroys nose cells, and the liquid inside them leaks out.
Sneezing breaks tiny blood vessels and the nose drips as a result.
explanation: Your nose runs during a cold because the body makes extra mucus to wash the virus out.
fact_tl: Tumutulo ang ilong kapag may sipon dahil gumagawa ang katawan ng maraming uhog para hugasan palabas ang virus.
fact_bis: Mag-agas ang ilong kung adunay sip-on kay maghimo ang lawas ug daghang sip-on aron hugasan pagawas ang virus.

q: What is true about neutrons inside an atom's nucleus?
options: They have no electrical charge and weigh about the same as a proton, adding to the atom's mass.
They have a positive charge and help hold the nucleus together.
They orbit the nucleus like electrons and carry a negative charge.
They are the lightest particle in the atom and contribute almost no mass.
explanation: A neutron is a neutral particle in the nucleus that weighs about the same as a proton, so it adds to the atom's mass.
fact_tl: Ang neutron ay isang partikulo sa nucleus na walang karga (neutral), at halos kasimbigat ito ng proton kaya nakadaragdag ito sa bigat ng atom.
fact_bis: Ang neutron usa ka partikulo sa nucleus nga walay karga (neutral), ug halos pareho ra og gibug-aton sa proton mao nga makadugang kini sa gibug-aton sa atom.

q: How do schistosomiasis parasite eggs get into water sources and spread the disease?
options: The eggs leave the body in stool and reach water when there are no proper toilets.
Infected people sneeze near rivers and the eggs travel through the air to water.
Mosquitoes carry the eggs from person to person through their bites.
The eggs are released from the gills of infected fish into the surrounding water.
explanation: The schistosomiasis parasite lays eggs inside a person, and these eggs leave the body in stool and can reach water when there are no proper toilets.
fact_tl: Ang parasito ay naglalagay ng mga itlog sa loob ng tao, at ang mga itlog na ito ay lumalabas kasama ng dumi at maaaring umabot sa tubig kung walang maayos na palikuran.
fact_bis: Ang parasito mangitlog sulod sa tawo, ug kini nga mga itlog mogawas uban sa tae ug makaabot sa tubig kung walay maayong kasilyas.

q: How tall is Mount Apo above sea level?
options: About 2,954 meters
About 1,200 meters
About 4,500 meters
About 800 meters
explanation: Mount Apo stands about 2,954 meters above sea level.
fact_tl: Ang Bundok Apo ay may taas na halos 2,954 metro sa ibabaw ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Bukid Apo mga 2,954 ka metro ang kahataas gikan sa dagat.

q: Why is the Philippines especially vulnerable to rising sea levels?
options: It is made up of thousands of islands, making it very exposed to rising seas.
It sits on a low, flat continent that floods easily during heavy rain.
Its cities are all built on river deltas that flood every year.
It has very little forest left to absorb extra rainwater and protect the coast.
explanation: The Philippines is made of thousands of islands, so it is very exposed to rising seas.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay binubuo ng libu-libong isla, kaya delikado ito sa pagtaas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas gilangkuban sa liboan ka isla, busa delikado kini sa pagsaka sa dagat.

q: How do scientists find out the actual age of a fossil?
options: By using isotopic (radioactive) dating, which measures radioactive elements in the fossil or surrounding rock.
By comparing the fossil's size to those of living animals with known lifespans.
By counting growth rings visible inside fossilized bones under a microscope.
By measuring how deeply the fossil is buried and calculating how long soil builds up.
explanation: Through isotopic (radioactive) dating, scientists determine the actual age of fossils and rocks in millions of years.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng isotopic (radioactive) dating, natutukoy ng mga siyentipiko ang aktwal na edad ng mga fosil at bato sa milyon-milyong taon, na nagpapatunay na sapat na ang panahong lumipas para maipon ang sunud-sunod na pagbabago sa buhay.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa isotopic (radioactive) dating, matino sa mga siyentista ang tinuod nga edad sa mga fosil ug bato sa milyon-milyon ka tuig, nga nagpamatuod nga igo na ang panahon nga milabay aron matigom ang sunud-sunod nga pagbag-o sa kinabuhi.

q: Why do some animals have eyes that glow in the dark?
options: They have a special layer behind the eye that reflects light back, helping them see better at night.
Their eyes produce their own light to help them find food in the dark.
Their pupils grow so large at night that they capture all available light and appear to glow.
They have extra blood vessels in the eyes that warm the eye and make it shine.
explanation: Many night animals have a layer behind the eye that reflects light back — this is why their eyes glow in the dark and they can see better at night.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop na gising sa gabi ay may malalaking mata at isang patong sa likod ng mata na sumasalamin ng liwanag pabalik — kaya kumikinang ang mata nila sa dilim at mas malinaw silang nakakakita sa gabi.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap nga gising sa gabii ang adunay dagkong mata ug usa ka sapaw sa likod sa mata nga mosumbalik sa kahayag — mao nga mosidlak ang ilang mga mata sa kangitngit ug mas klaro silang makakita sa gabii.

q: Why can you often see butterflies spreading their wings in the morning sun?
options: They are cold-blooded and need the sun's warmth to raise their body temperature enough to fly.
They are drying the dew off their wings so they do not get too heavy to fly.
They are signaling to other butterflies to gather for group feeding.
They are warming their eggs attached to the undersides of their wings.
explanation: Butterflies are cold-blooded and need warmth from the sun to raise their body temperature enough to fly, so they bask with open wings in the morning sun.
fact_tl: Ang mga paru-paro ay malamig ang dugo—kailangan nila ng init mula sa araw para maabot ang temperatura ng katawan na kinakailangan para makalipat; makikita sila sa umaga na nagpapainit ng pakpak sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga mariposa bugnaw ang dugo—kinahanglan nila ang init gikan sa adlaw para maabot ang temperatura sa lawas nga kinahanglan para makalupad; makita sila sa buntag nga nagpainit sa pakpak sa adlaw.

q: How does a coral colony grow bigger?
options: Each polyp buds new polyps off its side, creating more and more copies.
Coral larvae swim in from the open ocean and attach to an existing colony.
Broken pieces of coral drift away and each piece becomes a new colony.
A single polyp grows very large over time, taking up more space on the reef.
explanation: A polyp makes copies of itself by budding new polyps off its side, so the colony grows bigger.
fact_tl: Nagpaparami ang polyp sa pamamagitan ng pagsibol ng bagong polyp sa gilid nito, kaya lumalaki ang kolonya.
fact_bis: Ang polyp magpadaghan pinaagi sa pagturok og bag-ong polyp sa kilid niini, busa modako ang kolonya.

q: Why is a pyroclastic flow far more dangerous than ashfall?
options: A pyroclastic flow is a super-hot, fast-moving cloud of gas and ash that you cannot outrun, while ashfall is ash slowly drifting down from the sky.
Ashfall contains poisonous gases, while a pyroclastic flow is mostly harmless dust.
A pyroclastic flow falls straight down like rain, while ashfall spreads sideways and covers more area.
Ashfall destroys buildings instantly, while a pyroclastic flow only causes minor damage to rooftops.
explanation: A pyroclastic flow is a super-hot cloud of gas and ash that rushes down a volcano very fast and cannot be outrun, making it the most dangerous — unlike ashfall which drifts slowly from the sky.
fact_tl: Pareho ba ang ashfall at pyroclastic flow? Hindi. Ang ashfall ay abong dahan-dahang bumabagsak mula sa langit at pwede mong takasan. Ang pyroclastic flow naman ay napakainit na ulap ng gas at abo na bumababa sa gilid ng bulkan nang napakabilis — hindi ito matatakasan at pinakamapanganib sa lahat. Magkaiba sila kahit pareho silang may abo.
fact_bis: Pareho ba ang ashfall ug pyroclastic flow? Dili. Ang ashfall mao ang abo nga hinay-hinay nga nahulog gikan sa langit, ug malikayan nimo. Ang pyroclastic flow usa ka init kaayo nga panganod sa gas ug abo nga mokunsad sa kilid sa bulkan nga paspas kaayo — dili nimo kini malayasan ug mao ang labing delikado. Lahi sila bisan pareho silang naay abo.

q: At approximately what temperature does iron melt?
options: 1,538 degrees Celsius
538 degrees Celsius
938 degrees Celsius
2,538 degrees Celsius
explanation: Iron melts at about 1,538 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang bakal (iron) ay natutunaw sa mga 1538 degrees Celsius (1538°C).
fact_bis: Ang puthaw (iron) matunaw sa mga 1538 degrees Celsius (1538°C).

q: Which of the following correctly pairs a Philippine organism with its kingdom?
options: Narra tree belongs to the Plant kingdom.
A field mushroom belongs to the Animal kingdom.
Pond algae belong to the Fungi kingdom.
The carabao belongs to the Plant kingdom.
explanation: In the Philippines, narra and rice are plants, mushrooms are fungi, pond algae can be protists, and the carabao is an animal.
fact_tl: Madaling makita ang limang kaharian sa Pilipinas: ang kalabaw at bangus ay hayop, ang narra at palay ay halaman, ang kabute sa bukid ay fungi, ang lumot sa palaisdaan ay maaaring protist, at ang bacteria ay nasa lupa at sa fermented na pagkain gaya ng buro.
fact_bis: Sayon makita ang lima ka gingharian sa Pilipinas: ang kabaw ug bangus mga hayop, ang narra ug humay mga tanom, ang uhong sa uma fungi, ang lumot sa pundohanan mahimong protist, ug ang bacteria anaa sa yuta ug sa fermented nga pagkaon sama sa buro.

q: What has NASA's Parker Solar Probe helped scientists learn?
options: Why the Sun's corona is hotter than its surface.
How long it takes for sunlight to reach the Earth.
How many planets orbit inside Mercury's path.
Why solar eclipses happen more often near the equator.
explanation: NASA's Parker Solar Probe has entered the Sun's corona and helped scientists understand why the Sun's corona is hotter than its surface.
fact_tl: Ang Parker Solar Probe ng NASA, na inilunsad noong 2018, ay lumilipad nang mas malapit sa Araw kaysa sa kahit anong spacecraft sa kasaysayan at lumasok na sa corona ng Araw; ang pag-aaral nito ay nakatulong sa pag-unawa kung bakit ang corona ng Araw ay mas mainit kaysa sa surface nito.
fact_bis: Ang Parker Solar Probe sa NASA, gilunsad niadtong 2018, naglupad og mas duol sa Adlaw kaysa sa bisan unsang spacecraft sa kasaysayan ug misulod na sa corona sa Adlaw; ang iyang mga obserbasyon nakatulong sa mga syentipiko nga masabtan kung ngano ang corona sa Adlaw mas init kaysa sa iyang surface.

q: What does the equation PV = nRT describe?
options: The ideal gas law, combining pressure, volume, moles, and temperature of a gas.
The formula for calculating the density of any liquid at room temperature.
The speed at which gas particles escape from a container when heated.
The relationship between the mass of a gas and the force it exerts on a wall.
explanation: The ideal gas law PV = nRT combines pressure, volume, number of moles, and temperature of a gas.
fact_tl: Ang Batas ng Ideal na Gas ay ipinapahayag ng ekwasyong PV = nRT, na pinagsasama ang presyon, volume, dami ng mole, at temperatura.
fact_bis: Ang Balaod sa Ideal nga Gas gipahayag pinaagi sa ekwasyon nga PV = nRT, nga naghiusa sa presyon, volume, gidaghanon sa mole, ug temperatura.

q: What are nectar guides on flower petals, and what do they do?
options: They are lines or marks that act like arrows pointing pollinators toward the nectar.
They are sticky patches that trap insects so the flower can absorb nutrients from them.
They are bright spots that warn insects the flower is poisonous.
They are folds in the petal that hide the nectar to keep it only for certain insects.
explanation: Some petals have lines or marks called nectar guides that act like arrows pointing to where the nectar is.
fact_tl: May mga guhit o marka sa talulot na tinatawag na nectar guides na parang flecha na tumuturo sa kinaroroonan ng nektar.
fact_bis: Ang ubang petalo adunay mga linya o marka nga gitawag nga nectar guides nga morag pana nga nagtudlo asa ang nektar.

q: Why is the anglerfish's glowing lure blue-green rather than red or yellow?
options: Blue-green light travels farthest through deep water, so prey can see the lure from a greater distance.
Blue-green is the color that deep-sea prey animals are most afraid of.
The chemicals in the anglerfish's bacteria can only produce blue-green light.
Blue-green light is invisible to predators, keeping the anglerfish safe while it hunts.
explanation: The anglerfish's lure is blue-green because that is the color that travels farthest through deep water, making it visible to fish from some distance away.
fact_tl: Karaniwang asul-berde (blue-green) ang kulay ng ilaw ng anglerfish. Ito ang kulay na pinakamalayo na umaabot sa malalim na tubig, kaya kapaki-pakinabang ang kulay na ito — para makita ng mga isda kahit medyo malayo pa.
