fact_bis: Kasagaran asul-berde (blue-green) ang kolor sa kahayag sa anglerfish. Mao kini ang kolor nga molahos og labing layo sa lawom nga tubig, mao nga mapuslanon kini nga kolor — aron makita kini sa mga isda bisan medyo layo pa.

q: Why does a Venus flytrap usually need to be touched twice before it closes?
options: So it does not waste energy snapping shut on a raindrop or a speck of dust.
Because the first touch wakes it up and the second touch tells it which direction the insect is coming from.
Its hairs must build up enough pressure from two touches before the spring mechanism activates.
The first touch opens the trap wider, and the second touch triggers the actual closing.
explanation: The Venus flytrap's hairs usually must be touched twice before it closes so it is not wasted on a raindrop or speck of dust.
fact_tl: Karaniwang kailangang mahipo nang dalawang beses ang buhok ng Venus flytrap bago ito magsara, para hindi masayang sa patak ng ulan o alikabok.
fact_bis: Kasagaran kinahanglan mahikap kaduha ang balahibo sa Venus flytrap una kini mosira, aron dili mausik sa tulo sa ulan o abog.

q: Why is it more dangerous to handle electrical devices when your hands are wet?
options: Wet skin conducts electricity more easily than dry skin, increasing the risk of electric shock.
Wet skin blocks electricity better, but the shock feels stronger because water is cold.
Water on your hands causes short circuits in the device before any electricity reaches you.
Wet hands make you grip the device less firmly, so you are more likely to drop it on live wires.
explanation: Wet skin conducts electricity more easily than dry skin, so handling electricity is more dangerous when you are wet.
fact_tl: Mas madaling nagpapadaloy ng kuryente ang basang balat kaysa tuyong balat, kaya mas mapanganib humawak ng kuryente kapag basa.
fact_bis: Ang basa nga panit mas sayon nga magpaagi sa kuryente kaysa uga nga panit, mao nga mas peligro mokuptan og kuryente kung basa.

q: What do elements and compounds have in common that mixtures do not?
options: Both elements and compounds are pure substances made of only one kind of building block.
Both elements and compounds contain at least two different types of atoms.
Both elements and compounds can be separated by filtering or boiling.
Both elements and compounds change color when heated above 100 degrees Celsius.
explanation: Both elements and compounds are pure substances — an element is one kind of atom and a compound is one kind of substance built from a fixed set of atoms — while a mixture is made of different particles blended together.
fact_tl: Parehong purong sangkap ang element at compound, dahil bawat isa ay gawa sa iisang uri lang ng pinakamaliit na bahagi: ang element ay iisang uri ng atom, at ang compound ay iisang uri ng sangkap na buo sa nakatakdang dami ng atom. Ang mixture lamang ang gawa sa magkakaibang particle na pinaghalo.
fact_bis: Pareho nga putli nga sustansya ang element ug compound, kay ang matag usa hinimo sa usa ra ka klase nga pinakagamayng bahin: ang element usa ka klase nga atom, ug ang compound usa ka klase nga sustansya nga hinimo sa tino nga gidaghanon sa mga atom. Ang mixture lang ang hinimo sa nagkalainlaing particle nga gisagol.

q: A baby is chubby and eats lots of sweets. Does that mean the baby is definitely healthy?
options: No, because a baby fed mostly sweets may still lack vitamins and nutrients the brain needs
Yes, because a chubby body always means enough nutrition
Yes, because fat stores energy that the brain can use directly
No, because babies should never eat any sweet food at all
explanation: A chubby appearance does not guarantee health — a child full of sweets or junk food may look fat but still lack the vitamins and nutrients the brain needs.
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang matabang sanggol ay laging malusog. Ang mahalaga ay tamang sustansya, hindi basta laki o taba. Ang batang puno ng matamis o junk food ay maaaring mataba pero kulang pa rin sa bitamina at sustansyang kailangan ng utak.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahuna nga ang tambok nga masuso kanunay himsog. Ang importante mao ang husto nga sustansya, dili basta gidak-on o tambok. Ang bata nga puno sa tam-is o junk food mahimong tambok apan kulang gihapon sa bitamina ug sustansya nga gikinahanglan sa utok.

q: Why are apex predators important to an ecosystem?
options: They keep prey populations from growing too large so plants and food are not used up
They produce the most oxygen of any animal group in the ecosystem
They remove harmful gases from the air that would otherwise sicken plants
They compete with plants for sunlight and keep forests from becoming too dense
explanation: Apex predators keep the animals they eat from growing too many in number, which prevents plants and food from being used up and keeps the whole ecosystem healthy.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang apex predator dahil pinipigilan nilang dumami nang sobra ang mga hayop na kanilang kinakain. Kapag tama lang ang bilang ng mga ito, hindi nauubos ang halaman at iba pang pagkain, kaya nananatiling balanse ang kalikasan.
fact_bis: Importante ang apex predator kay pugngan nila nga modaghan ug sobra ang mga hayop nga ilang gikaon. Kon husto ra ang gidaghanon, dili maubos ang tanom ug uban pang pagkaon, mao nga magpabilin nga timbang ang kinaiyahan.

q: Which animal holds the record as the longest-lived vertebrate on Earth?
options: The Greenland shark, which can live 200 to 400 years
The giant tortoise, which can live up to 500 years
The bowhead whale, which can live up to 250 years
The ocean quahog clam, which can live over 300 years
explanation: The Greenland shark can live 200 to 400 years, making it the longest-lived vertebrate animal.
fact_tl: Ang Greenland shark ay maaaring mabuhay nang 200 hanggang 400 taon, ito ang pinakamatagal mabuhay na hayop na may gulugod (vertebrate).
fact_bis: Ang Greenland shark makabuhi og 200 ngadto sa 400 ka tuig, mao kini ang pinakadugay mabuhi nga hayop nga adunay bukog sa likod (vertebrate).

q: What is the main difference between contact metamorphism and regional metamorphism?
options: Contact metamorphism happens near hot magma in a small area, while regional metamorphism occurs over wide areas from tectonic plate collisions
Contact metamorphism requires water, while regional metamorphism requires only heat
Contact metamorphism only occurs underwater, while regional metamorphism only occurs on land
Contact metamorphism takes millions of years, while regional metamorphism happens quickly near volcanoes
explanation: Contact metamorphism happens near hot magma in a small area (heat only), while regional metamorphism occurs over wide areas when tectonic plates collide and build enormous pressure and heat over millions of years.
fact_tl: Ang contact metamorphism ay nangyayari malapit sa mainit na magma (init lamang, maliit na lugar), habang ang regional metamorphism ay nangyayari sa malawak na lugar kapag ang mga plato ay nagtatagpo at nag-iipon ng napakalaking presyon at init sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Ang contact metamorphism nahitabo duol sa mainit nga magma (init lamang, gamay nga lugar), samtang ang regional metamorphism mahitabo sa halapad nga lugar kon ang mga plato magbanggaan ug nagtipon og dako nga presyon ug init sulod sa milyun-milyon nga tuig.

q: A student says Rafflesia is a meat-eating plant that eats animals with its big smell. Is this correct?
options: No, Rafflesia is not a meat-eating plant — it only takes food from its vine and uses its smell to attract flies
Yes, Rafflesia uses its smell to trap and digest small animals
Yes, because Rafflesia is the largest flower and needs to eat animals to survive
No, but only because Rafflesia has no smell at all
explanation: Rafflesia is not a meat-eating plant; it only takes food from its vine, and its bad smell is just to attract flies for pollination.
fact_tl: Hindi totoong kumakain ng tao o hayop ang Rafflesia kahit malaki at mabaho ito. Hindi rin ito carnivorous na halaman; sa baging lamang ito kumukuha ng pagkain, at ang mabahong amoy ay para lang sa mga langaw.
fact_bis: Dili tinuod nga mokaon og tawo o hayop ang Rafflesia bisan og dako ug baho kini. Dili usab kini carnivorous nga tanom; sa baging lang kini mokuha og pagkaon, ug ang baho alang lang sa mga langaw.

q: Which continent is the largest in area, covering about 44 million square kilometers?
options: Asia
Africa
North America
Antarctica
explanation: Asia covers about 44 million square kilometers, making it the largest of all continents.
fact_tl: Ang Asia ay may sukat na humigit-kumulang 44 milyong square kilometro, ang pinakamalaki sa lahat ng kontinente.
fact_bis: Ang Asia adunay gilapdon nga mga 44 ka milyon nga square kilometro, ang pinakadako sa tanang kontinente.

q: What actually causes tuberculosis (TB)?
options: A bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis
Cold air and damp weather weakening the lungs
A virus that spreads through contaminated water
Tiredness and lack of sleep breaking down the immune system
explanation: Tuberculosis is caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis, not by cold or tiredness.
fact_tl: Ang tuberkulosis o TB ay isang sakit na dulot ng bakteryang Mycobacterium tuberculosis, hindi ng lamig o pagod.
fact_bis: Ang tuberkulosis o TB usa ka sakit nga gipahinabo sa bakterya nga Mycobacterium tuberculosis, dili sa tugnaw o kakapoy.

q: What sea treasure is the Philippines well known for producing from large oysters in the ocean?
options: South Sea pearls
Precious rubies
Black coral jewelry
Giant sea sponges
explanation: The Philippines is known for beautiful South Sea pearls, made by large oysters in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay kilala sa magagandang South Sea pearl, mga perlas na ginagawa ng malalaking talaba sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas ilado sa nindot nga South Sea pearls, mga perlas nga gihimo sa dagkong talaba sa dagat.

q: What does Philippine Typhoon Signal No. 2 tell us about the incoming storm?
options: Moderately strong storm winds may arrive within about 24 hours and can break tree branches
Very destructive storm winds are already in the area and buildings may be damaged
Light rain and gentle winds are expected and only outdoor activities should be cancelled
The storm has weakened and families can return to their homes safely
explanation: Signal No. 2 means moderately strong storm winds may arrive within about 24 hours and can break tree branches.
fact_tl: Ang Signal No. 2 ay nangangahulugang may katamtamang lakas na hanging dala ng bagyo na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 24 na oras at maaaring magpabali ng mga sanga ng puno.
fact_bis: Ang Signal No. 2 nagpasabot nga adunay kasarangang kakusog nga hangin gikan sa bagyo nga moabot sulod sa mga 24 ka oras ug makabali sa mga sanga sa kahoy.

q: What is sign language and who mainly uses it?
options: A way of communicating using hands and gestures, mainly for deaf people
A secret code that sailors use to signal ships far away
A system of written symbols used to teach reading to young children
A type of body exercise that helps people improve their hand strength
explanation: Sign language is a way of communicating using hands and gestures, mainly for deaf people.
fact_tl: Ang sign language ay paraan ng pakikipag-usap gamit ang mga kamay at galaw, kadalasan para sa mga bingi.
fact_bis: Ang sign language usa ka paagi sa pagpakigsulti gamit ang mga kamot ug lihok, ilabi na alang sa mga bungol.

q: Glyptodon was an extinct prehistoric animal about the size of a small car with a rounded shell. Which modern animal is its closest relative?
options: The armadillo
The tortoise
The pangolin
The rhinoceros
explanation: Glyptodon was a giant relative of the armadillo, about the size of a small car, that lived long ago.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon ay may higanteng kamag-anak ng armadillo na tinatawag na Glyptodon, na kasinlaki ng isang maliit na kotse at may pabilog na baluti.
fact_bis: Kaniadto adunay higante nga kabanay sa armadillo nga gitawag og Glyptodon, sama kadako sa gamay nga awto ug adunay lingin nga baluti.

q: When you exercise hard, where does your body send most of the blood and why?
options: To the muscles, because working muscles need more oxygen
To the skin, because the skin needs to cool the whole body down
To the brain, because the brain controls all the movements of exercise
To the stomach, because digestion speeds up to provide more energy
explanation: When you exercise, more blood is sent to the muscles than to the skin because the working muscles need more oxygen.
fact_tl: Hindi pantay ang dami ng dugong napupunta sa bawat bahagi ng katawan. Kapag nag-eehersisyo ka, mas maraming dugo ang ipinapadala sa kalamnan kaysa sa balat dahil mas kailangan ng oksiheno ng mga kalamnan.
fact_bis: Dili patas ang gidaghanon sa dugo nga moadto sa matag bahin sa lawas. Kung mag-ehersisyo ka, mas daghan nga dugo ang ipadala sa unod kaysa panit kay mas nagkinahanglan og oksiheno ang naglihok nga unod.

q: What kind of energy is stored in wood before it is burned?
options: Chemical energy
Electrical energy
Magnetic energy
Nuclear energy
explanation: Fuels like wood store chemical energy that turns into heat energy when they burn.
fact_tl: Ang gatong tulad ng kahoy ay may nakaimbak na kemikal na enerhiya na nagiging init kapag ito ay nasunog.
fact_bis: Ang sugnod sama sa kahoy adunay tinipigan nga kemikal nga enerhiya nga mahimong init kung kini masunog.

q: What makes a planet's location called the 'Goldilocks zone' so special for life?
options: It is the right distance from the star to keep liquid water on the planet's surface — not too hot and not too cold
It is the zone where the planet receives the most sunlight so plants can grow freely
It is an area near a star where the gravity is perfectly balanced for large animals
It is the region of space where no asteroids or comets can reach a planet
explanation: The Goldilocks zone is the range of distances from a star where a planet's temperature allows liquid water on its surface — Earth sits in this zone around our Sun.
fact_tl: Ang habitable zone (o Goldilocks zone) ng isang bituin ay ang rehiyon ng distansya kung saan ang temperatura ng isang planeta ay sapat para mapanatili ang liquid water sa ibabaw — hindi masyadong mainit at hindi masyadong malamig. Ang Earth ay nasa habitable zone ng aming Araw.
fact_bis: Ang habitable zone (o Goldilocks zone) sa usa ka bituin mao ang range sa mga distansya diin ang temperatura sa usa ka planeta angay para mapanatili ang liquid water sa iyang surface — dili kaayo init ug dili kaayo bugnaw. Ang Yuta anaa sa habitable zone sa atong Adlaw.

q: What is the job of the valves inside the lymph vessels?
options: They stop lymph from flowing backward so it moves in only one direction
They speed up the lymph flow when the body has an infection
They filter out bacteria and viruses directly inside the vessel walls
They connect lymph vessels to blood vessels so fluids can mix
explanation: Valves inside the lymph vessels stop lymph from flowing backward, so it moves in only one direction.
fact_tl: May mga balbula sa loob ng lymph vessels na pumipigil sa limpa na umagos pabalik, kaya iisa lang ang direksyon nito.
fact_bis: Adunay mga balbula sulod sa lymph vessels nga nagpugong sa limpa nga dili mobalik, mao nga usa ra ka direksyon ang agos niini.

q: When a storm surge warning is issued in a coastal area, what should residents do?
options: Evacuate immediately because a dangerous high sea wave caused by a strong typhoon may hit
Stay indoors and close the windows to keep storm winds out
Move to the beach to watch for the wave so they know when it arrives
Wait for the rain to stop before deciding whether to leave their homes
explanation: A storm surge is a dangerous high sea wave caused by a strong typhoon, and people in coastal areas must evacuate when a storm surge warning is issued.
fact_tl: Ang storm surge ay isang mapanganib na mataas na alon ng dagat na dulot ng malakas na bagyo; kailangang lumikas ang mga nakatira sa baybaying lugar kapag may babala ng storm surge.
fact_bis: Ang storm surge usa ka mapeligrong mataas nga alon sa dagat nga dulot sa kusog nga bagyo; kinahanglan molikas ang mga namuyo sa baybayon kon adunay babala sa storm surge.

q: How far from Mayon Volcano is the Permanent Danger Zone where no one is allowed to live?
options: 6 kilometers
2 kilometers
10 kilometers
15 kilometers
explanation: PHIVOLCS established a permanent 6-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone around Mayon Volcano because of the danger from eruptions and lahars.
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS ay nagtatag ng permanenteng 6-kilometro na Permanent Danger Zone sa paligid ng Mayon Volcano; ipinagbabawal ang pamumuhay sa loob ng zone na ito dahil sa panganib ng eruption at lahar.
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS nagtukod og permanenteng 6-kilometro nga Permanent Danger Zone sa palibot sa Mayon Volcano; gidili ang pamumuwang sulod sa zone nga kini tungod sa panganib sa eruption ug lahar.

q: How do oceans help reduce the amount of carbon dioxide in the air?
options: The ocean absorbs carbon dioxide, which dissolves into the water and is also used by plankton for photosynthesis
The ocean reflects carbon dioxide back into space using sunlight from the water surface
Ocean waves break apart carbon dioxide molecules into oxygen and carbon that sink to the seafloor
Fish breathe in carbon dioxide and convert it to oxygen the same way plants do
explanation: The ocean absorbs a large amount of carbon dioxide from the air — it dissolves into the water, and plankton also use it for photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang karagatan ay sumisipsip ng malaking bahagi ng carbon dioxide mula sa hangin. Natutunaw ito sa tubig, at ginagamit din ng plankton sa photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Ang dagat mosuyop og dakong kantidad sa carbon dioxide gikan sa hangin. Matunaw kini sa tubig, ug gamiton usab kini sa plankton sa photosynthesis.

q: If you stretched out all the DNA from just one human cell, about how long would it be?
options: About 2 meters
About 2 centimeters
About 2 millimeters
About 2 kilometers
explanation: If the DNA from one human cell were stretched out, it would be about two meters long, which is why it must be tightly coiled to fit inside the cell.
fact_tl: Kung uunatin ang DNA mula sa isang selula ng tao, aabot ito ng halos dalawang metro ang haba, kaya ito mahigpit na nakarolyo.
fact_bis: Kon unaton ang DNA gikan sa usa ka selula sa tawo, mokabat kini og mga duha ka metro ang gitas-on, mao nga hugot kining gilukot.

q: Why are mosses often the first plants to grow on bare rock?
options: Mosses can grow on bare rock and slowly break it down to help form thin soil where other plants can later grow
Mosses do not need sunlight and can survive deep underground before appearing on rock surfaces
Mosses produce a strong acid that instantly dissolves rock and creates thick soil in just a few days
Mosses spread their seeds by wind and always land on rocks before they can reach soil
explanation: Mosses are often the first plants to grow on bare rock because they slowly break the rock down and help form thin soil.
fact_tl: Ang lumot ay madalas na unang tumubo sa hubad na bato, at habang lumalaki ito, dahan-dahan nitong sinisira ang bato para makabuo ng manipis na lupa.
fact_bis: Ang lumot kasagaran maoy unang tanom nga motubo sa hubo nga bato, ug samtang nagtubo kini, hinay-hinay niining gub-on ang bato aron makahimo og nipis nga yuta.

q: Your friend says lightning only happens where it is already raining, so you are safe in a sunny spot nearby. Is your friend right?
options: No, lightning can strike far from the rain and is dangerous even where it is not yet raining
Yes, lightning only travels downward directly through falling rain
Yes, because lightning needs water droplets in the air right above you to form
No, but only because lightning strikes only during the night
explanation: Lightning can strike far from the rain, so it can be dangerous even where it is not yet raining.
fact_tl: Maaaring tumama ang kidlat kahit malayo pa sa ulan, kaya delikado kahit hindi pa umuulan sa kinatatayuan mo.
fact_bis: Ang kilat mahimong motama bisan layo pa sa ulan, mao nga delikado bisan wala pa mag-ulan sa imong nahimutangan.

q: How does tuberculosis (TB) spread from one person to another?
options: By breathing in air that contains the TB bacteria
By shaking hands with someone who has TB
By sharing plates or eating utensils with a TB patient
By touching the skin or clothing of a person who has TB
explanation: TB is not spread by shaking hands or sharing plates, but by breathing in air that has the TB bacteria.
fact_tl: Hindi naikakalat ang TB sa simpleng paghawak ng kamay o paggamit ng iisang plato, kundi sa paghinga ng hanging may bakterya.
fact_bis: Ang TB dili matakod pinaagi sa paghikap sa kamot o paggamit og usa ka plato, kondili pinaagi sa pagginhawa og hangin nga adunay bakterya.

q: Why does a carabao roll in mud or soak in water when the weather is hot?
options: Because it has very few sweat glands and uses mud and water to cool its body
Because mud makes its skin harder and protects it from insect bites
Because wallowing in water helps it find food buried in the ground
Because mud removes parasites from its skin that cause disease
explanation: A carabao has very few sweat glands, so it uses mud and water to cool its body during hot weather.
fact_tl: Iilan lang ang pawisang glandula ng kalabaw, kaya gumagamit ito ng putik at tubig para palamigin ang katawan sa mainit na panahon.
fact_bis: Gamay ra kaayo ang singot nga glandula sa kalabaw, mao nga mogamit kini ug lapok ug tubig aron pabugnawon ang lawas panahon sa init.

q: How does the bittern protect itself from predators while hiding in the reeds?
options: It stretches its neck upward like a stick so it blends in with the reeds around it
It changes the color of its feathers to match the color of the water below
It dives underwater and holds its breath until the predator passes
It makes a loud call to warn other birds and scare the predator away
explanation: The bittern lifts its neck like a stick so it blends in with the reeds, making it very hard to spot.
fact_tl: May kamag-anak ang tagak na tinatawag na bittern na ganoon din tumusok ng isda. Pero mas magaling itong magtago sa mga tambo dahil kayang itaas ang leeg na parang patpat para hindi makita.
fact_bis: Adunay paryente ang tulabong nga gitawag og bittern nga sama usab motuslok og isda. Apan mas hanas kini motago sa mga bugang, ipataas ang liog nga morag sungkod aron dili makita.

q: Why does dry ice keep things around it very cold?
options: Because sublimation absorbs heat from the surroundings as dry ice turns directly from solid to gas
Because dry ice melts into very cold liquid carbon dioxide that chills nearby objects
Because dry ice reflects heat waves away from anything it is placed near
Because dry ice releases cold gas that freezes the air molecules around it
explanation: Sublimation absorbs heat from the surroundings, which is why dry ice keeps nearby things very cold.
fact_tl: Ang sublimation ay sumisipsip ng init mula sa paligid, kaya nagpapalamig ang dry ice sa mga bagay sa malapit.
fact_bis: Ang sublimation magsuyop ug init gikan sa palibot, mao nga ang dry ice magpabugnaw sa mga butang nga duol.

q: Why can't astronauts in outer space hear explosions happening nearby?
options: Because sound needs air to travel, and there is no air in the vacuum of space
Because sound travels too slowly and fades out before reaching anyone in space
Because the cold temperature of space freezes sound waves and stops them
Because the gravity of nearby planets bends sound waves away from listeners
explanation: Sound cannot travel through space because there is no air (medium) to carry it.
fact_tl: Hindi makakalakbay ang tunog sa kalawakan dahil walang hangin doon na magdadala nito.
fact_bis: Ang tingog dili makalakaw sa kawanangan kay walay hangin didto nga modala niini.

q: What is one method the Philippine government uses to control the invasive knifefish in Laguna Lake?
options: Paying fishers to catch knifefish to reduce their numbers
Releasing predator fish that naturally eat knifefish into the lake
Building fences across the lake to stop knifefish from spreading
Draining parts of the lake temporarily to expose the fish to air
explanation: The government buys caught knifefish from fishers to keep the knifefish population from growing further in Laguna Lake.
fact_tl: Para mabawasan ang knifefish sa Lawa ng Laguna, may mga programa kung saan binibili ng pamahalaan ang mga nahuhuling knifefish mula sa mga mangingisda. Ginagawa ito para hindi pa lalo itong dumami.
fact_bis: Aron makunhoran ang knifefish sa Lanaw sa Laguna, adunay mga programa diin paliton sa gobyerno ang nadakpan nga knifefish gikan sa mga mananagat. Gibuhat kini aron dili na kini modaghan pa.

q: How can carabao milk help a farmer's family earn money?
options: By selling the milk or products like kesong puti made from it
By trading the milk for seeds to plant in the fields
By using the milk as fertilizer to make crops grow faster
By feeding the milk to chickens so they produce more eggs to sell
explanation: Carabao milk helps farmers' livelihood because they can sell the milk or products like kesong puti to earn money.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pag-aararo, nakakatulong ang gatas ng kalabaw sa kabuhayan ng mga magsasaka dahil naipagbibili nila ito o ang mga produktong tulad ng kesong puti para kumita ng pera.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagdaro, ang gatas sa kabaw makatabang sa panginabuhi sa mga mag-uuma kay mabaligya nila kini o ang mga produkto sama sa kesong puti aron makakwarta.

q: Although lichen looks like a plant growing on rocks and tree bark, why is it NOT classified as a plant?
options: Because a lichen is made of two different organisms living together, not a single plant
Because lichen cannot make its own food through photosynthesis the way plants do
Because lichen has no cell walls, which all true plants must have
Because lichen only grows in places where no plants are able to survive
explanation: A lichen is not a plant because it is made of two different organisms (typically a fungus and an alga) living together.
fact_tl: Kahit mukhang halaman, ang lichen ay hindi isang halaman dahil ito ay binubuo ng dalawang magkaibang organismo.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag tanom kini, ang lichen dili usa ka tanom kay gilangkoban kini sa duha ka lainlaing organismo.

q: Some kids think the ball in a ball-and-socket joint rattles around loosely. What really keeps it in place?
options: The ball fits snugly in the cup and ligaments and muscles hold it so it does not wobble
Layers of cartilage glue the ball permanently in place so it cannot move at all
The joint fluid fills the space and acts like cement to lock the ball in position
Bone spurs grow around the ball over time and lock it firmly into the socket
explanation: The ball fits snugly in the cup, and ligaments and muscles hold it so it does not wobble around loosely.
fact_tl: Maling akala ng iba na maluwag at umuugang-uga ang bola sa loob ng socket. Sa totoo, akmang-akma ang dikit ng bola sa mangkok, at hinahawakan ito ng ligaments at kalamnan para hindi gumalaw nang basta-basta.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo sa uban nga luag ug nagkagalaw ang bola sulod sa socket. Sa tinuoray, hapsay nga nahaum ang bola sa panaksan, ug gigunitan kini sa ligaments ug kaunoran aron dili basta-basta molihok.

q: What important job does the water in your blood do for your body?
options: It carries nutrients and oxygen to every part of your body
It keeps your body temperature exactly the same at all times
It destroys germs that enter the bloodstream before they can cause sickness
It makes your muscles stronger by delivering electricity to them
explanation: The water in your blood carries nutrients and oxygen to every part of your body.
fact_tl: Ang tubig sa iyong dugo ay nagdadala ng sustansya at oxygen sa lahat ng bahagi ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang tubig sa imong dugo nagdala og sustansya ug oxygen ngadto sa tanang bahin sa imong lawas.

q: Where in the human body are new blood cells produced?
options: Inside the bone marrow within our bones
Inside the liver, which filters and rebuilds blood
Inside the spleen, which stores and releases fresh blood cells
Inside the heart, where blood cells are pumped into existence
explanation: Blood cells are made in the bone marrow inside our bones.
fact_tl: Ang mga selula ng dugo ay ginagawa sa utak ng buto (bone marrow) sa loob ng ating mga buto.
fact_bis: Ang mga selula sa dugo gibuhat sa kinauyokan sa bukog (bone marrow) sulod sa atong mga bukog.

q: Which set of materials does a plant take in to make glucose and oxygen during photosynthesis?
options: Carbon dioxide and water, using light
Oxygen and sugar, using darkness
Nitrogen and carbon dioxide, using heat
Water and oxygen, using minerals from the soil
explanation: In photosynthesis, carbon dioxide and water use light to become glucose and oxygen.
fact_tl: Sa madaling salita: carbon dioxide + tubig, kasama ang liwanag, ay nagiging glucose + oxygen sa photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Sa yano nga pulong: carbon dioxide + tubig, gamit ang kahayag, mahimong glucose + oxygen sa photosynthesis.

q: What causes puddles to disappear on a sunny day?
options: The sun's heat gives water particles enough energy to escape into the air as invisible water vapor through evaporation
The water soaks straight down through the concrete or pavement into the ground
The wind blows the water molecules apart and scatters them as tiny invisible pieces
Animals and plants nearby drink up the water from puddles very quickly
explanation: Puddles dry up because the sun's heat gives water particles enough energy to escape into the air as invisible water vapor — this process is called evaporation.
fact_tl: Natutuyo ang mga lusak dahil binibigyan ng init ng araw ang mga particle ng tubig ng sapat na lakas para makatakas papuntang hangin bilang singaw ng tubig (water vapor) na hindi nakikita. Ito ang tinatawag na evaporation.
fact_bis: Mauga ang mga lapok tungod kay ang init sa adlaw mohatag sa mga partikulo sa tubig og igong kusog aron makaikyas ngadto sa hangin isip dili-makita nga alisngaw sa tubig (water vapor). Kini gitawag og evaporation.

q: Why do you feel dizzy after spinning around fast and then stopping?
options: The fluid in your ears keeps moving even after you stop, which confuses your sense of balance
Your eyes keep sending spinning images to your brain even after your body is still
The muscles in your legs are still contracting from spinning and push your body off balance
The blood rushes to your head during spinning and takes a while to flow back down
explanation: When we spin fast, the fluid in our ears keeps moving even after we stop, which makes us feel dizzy.
fact_tl: Kapag mabilis tayong umiikot, gumagalaw pa rin ang likido sa tainga kahit tumigil na tayo, kaya nahihilo tayo.
fact_bis: Kon kusog kitang motuyok, ang likido sa atong dalunggan magpadayon sa paglihok bisan mohunong na kita, mao nga molipong kita.

q: At what temperature does water freeze AND ice melt — and are those two temperatures different?
options: They are the same temperature: both happen at 0 degrees Celsius
Freezing happens at 0°C but melting happens at a slightly higher temperature of 4°C
Melting happens at 0°C but freezing requires a temperature of −10°C
They are different: freezing needs −5°C while melting starts at 0°C
explanation: The freezing point of water and the melting point of ice are the same temperature — both are 0 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang freezing point ng tubig at ang melting point ng yelo ay magkapareho — parehong 0 degrees Celsius.
fact_bis: Ang freezing point sa tubig ug ang melting point sa yelo managsama — parehong 0 ka degrees Celsius.

q: A baby receives the BCG vaccine. Does that mean the baby is protected from ever getting TB and will never need TB medicine?
options: No, BCG helps prevent severe TB but medicine is still needed to cure TB that is already present
Yes, BCG completely prevents all forms of TB so medicine will never be needed
No, BCG only protects for two years and then the child must get the vaccine again
Yes, but only if the child also takes vitamin supplements alongside the vaccine
explanation: The BCG vaccine helps prevent severe TB, but it is for prevention — medicine is still needed to cure TB that is already present.
fact_tl: Ang BCG na bakunang ibinibigay sa sanggol ay tumutulong maiwasan ang malalang TB, pero ito ay pang-iwas—gamot pa rin ang kailangan kung may TB na.
fact_bis: Ang BCG nga bakuna nga ihatag sa mga masuso makatabang nga malikayan ang grabeng TB, apan kini para sa paglikay—tambal gihapon ang gikinahanglan kung naa nay TB.

q: About how long did Charles Lindbergh's historic solo flight from New York to Paris take?
options: About 33 and a half hours
About 12 hours
About 48 hours
About 20 hours
explanation: Lindbergh's flight from New York to Paris took about 33 and a half hours.
fact_tl: Tumagal ng halos 33 at kalahating oras ang lipad ni Lindbergh mula New York hanggang Paris.
fact_bis: Ang paglupad ni Lindbergh gikan sa New York paingon sa Paris milungtad ug mga 33 ug tunga ka oras.

q: What is special about the way some Filipino farmers make mango trees produce fruit?
options: They use special methods to make the trees flower so they will bear fruit at the right time
They cut off the roots during dry season so the tree focuses all energy on making fruits
They bury animal bones under the tree to provide nutrients that trigger fruit production
They spray saltwater on the leaves each morning to force the tree into its flowering stage
explanation: In the Philippines, some farmers use special methods to make mango trees flower so they will bear fruit.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga magsasaka na nagpapamulaklak ng mangga gamit ang espesyal na pamamaraan upang makapagbunga ito.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, adunay mga mag-uuma nga magpamulak sa mangga pinaagi sa espesyal nga pamaagi aron kini mamunga.

q: What happens to the solubility of most solid substances when you heat the water they are dissolving in?
options: Solubility increases as temperature rises, so more solid can dissolve in hotter water
Solubility decreases as temperature rises because heat breaks apart the dissolved particles
Solubility stays the same regardless of temperature for most solid substances
Solubility increases only until 50°C and then drops sharply as water nears boiling
explanation: For most solids, solubility increases as temperature rises — a solubility curve graph shows this relationship, and cooling a hot saturated solution causes crystals to form.
fact_tl: Ang solubility curve ay isang grap na nagpapakita ng pagbabago ng solubility ng isang sangkap sa iba't ibang temperatura. Para sa karamihan ng solido, tumataas ang solubility habang tumataas ang temperatura. Kapag pinalamig ang isang hot saturated solution, lumalabas ang mga kristal.
fact_bis: Ang solubility curve usa ka grap nga nagpakita kung giunsa pagbabago ang solubility sa usa ka substansya sa lainlaing temperatura. Para sa kadaghanan sa mga solido, motaas ang solubility habang motaas ang temperatura. Sa pagpabugnaw sa usa ka mainit nga saturated solution, mogawas ang mga kristal.

q: The Philippines has many languages like Bisaya and Ilokano. In which language must the national anthem be sung?
options: In Filipino, so the whole country can be united in one song
In English, because it is the official language of the government
In whichever regional language the singer speaks best
In both Filipino and English together to include everyone
explanation: Even though the Philippines has many languages, the national anthem must be sung in Filipino so the whole country can be united in one song.
fact_tl: Kahit may iba't ibang wika sa Pilipinas tulad ng Bisaya at Ilokano, ang pambansang awit ay dapat awitin sa wikang Filipino. Ito ay para magkaisa ang buong bansa sa iisang awit.
fact_bis: Bisan daghan ang pinulongan sa Pilipinas sama sa Binisaya ug Ilokano, ang pambansang awit kinahanglan kantahon sa pinulongang Filipino. Kini aron magkahiusa ang tibuok nasud sa usa ka awit.

q: The Philippine Fault Zone is a very long fault crossing the Philippines. How do the two sides of this fault move?
options: They slide horizontally past each other in a left-lateral direction — the far side moves to the left when you look across the fault
They move toward each other and push one side downward under the other
They pull apart from each other, creating a gap that fills with magma
They move up and down vertically, which is why the Philippines has many high mountain ranges
explanation: The Philippine Fault Zone is a strike-slip fault where the two sides move horizontally in a left-lateral sense — standing on the fault and looking across, the far side moves to the left.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Fault Zone ay isang halos 1,200 kilometro ang haba na strike-slip fault na tumatawid sa Pilipinas mula Luzon hanggang Mindanao; ang mga magkabilang bahagi ay gumagalaw nang pahalang na left-lateral: kapag nakatayo ka sa fault at tumingin sa kabila, ang kabilang bahagi ay gumagalaw pakaliwa.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Fault Zone usa ka halos 1,200 kilometro ang gitas-on nga strike-slip fault nga nagkros sa Pilipinas gikan Luzon hangtod Mindanao; ang duha ka kilid nagalihok nga pahalang sa left-lateral nga kahimtang: ang pagtindog sa fault ug ang pagtimbaya sa pikas, ang layo nga kilid naglihok sa wala.

q: Hand warmers stay warm for hours without being plugged in. What type of chemical reaction makes this possible?
options: An exothermic reaction that gives off heat as iron reacts
An endothermic reaction that pulls heat in from the surroundings
A nuclear reaction that slowly releases energy stored in atoms
A combustion reaction where iron burns slowly in a sealed pouch
explanation: Hand warmers use an exothermic reaction of iron to give off heat.
fact_tl: Ang pampainit ng kamay ay gumagamit ng exothermic na reaksyon ng bakal upang magbigay ng init.
fact_bis: Ang pang-init sa kamot naggamit ug exothermic nga reaksyon sa puthaw aron makahatag ug kainit.

q: How many atoms are found in a single tiny grain of sand?
options: Billions of atoms
About ten atoms
A few thousand atoms
Exactly one million atoms
explanation: Atoms are so small that even a single tiny grain of sand has billions of atoms inside it, and we cannot see them one by one.
fact_tl: Napakaliit ng atom kaya kahit ang isang maliit na butil ng buhangin ay may bilyun-bilyong atom sa loob. Hindi natin sila nakikita nang isa-isa.
fact_bis: Gamay ra kaayo ang atom maong bisan ang usa ka gamay nga lugas sa balas adunay binilyon nga atom sa sulod. Dili nato sila makita nga tinagsa.

q: Why is rainwater considered 'soft' water?
options: Because it comes from evaporated water that has not yet passed through mineral-rich rocks
Because rainwater is filtered through clouds which remove all minerals from it
Because rain falls gently and does not pick up hard minerals from the ground
Because rainwater is boiled by lightning before falling, which removes all hardness
explanation: Rainwater is soft because it comes from evaporated water that has not yet passed through mineral-rich rocks.
fact_tl: Ang tubig-ulan ay malambot dahil galing ito sa singaw ng tubig na hindi pa nakakadaan sa mga bato na may mineral.
fact_bis: Ang tubig-ulan kay humok kay naggikan kini sa aso sa tubig nga wala pa makaagi sa mga bato nga puno og mineral.

q: Which group of Philippine islands connects Mindanao to Borneo and is known for its rich Muslim culture and marine resources?
options: The Sulu Archipelago, made up of the provinces of Sulu and Tawi-Tawi
The Visayas island group, made up of Cebu, Leyte, and Samar
The Calamian Islands, made up of Coron, Busuanga, and Culion
The Spratlys, a group of disputed islands in the West Philippine Sea
explanation: The Sulu Archipelago is a chain of islands connecting Mindanao to Borneo, consisting of the provinces of Sulu and Tawi-Tawi, known for its Muslim culture and marine resources.
fact_tl: Ang Sulu Archipelago ay isang hanay ng mga isla na nagkokonekta ng Mindanao sa Borneo; ito ay binubuo ng mga lalawigan ng Sulu at Tawi-Tawi at kilala sa mayamang kulturang Muslim at yamang-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Sulu Archipelago usa ka kadena sa mga isla nga nagkonektar sa Mindanao sa Borneo; naglangkob kini sa mga probinsya sa Sulu ug Tawi-Tawi ug bantog sa dato nga kultura sa Muslim ug kahinguhaan sa dagat.

q: What is special about the way a crab's eyes work?
options: Each stalked eye can move separately so one eye can look left while the other looks right at the same time
Both eyes always point in the same direction so the crab can focus clearly on one target
The eyes rotate in a full circle on the stalk so the crab can see in all directions at once
The eyes glow in the dark so the crab can hunt for food on the ocean floor at night
explanation: A crab's two stalked eyes can move separately from each other, so one eye may look one way while the other looks another way, allowing the crab to watch more places at the same time.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang matang nakatangkay ng alimango ay kayang gumalaw nang magkahiwalay. Maaaring tumingin ang isang mata sa kaliwa habang ang isa naman ay nakatingin sa kanan. Sa ganitong paraan, mas marami silang nababantayan nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka mata nga naa sa tangkay sa alimango makahimo og lihok nga managlain. Mahimong motan-aw ang usa ka mata sa wala samtang ang usa motan-aw sa tuo. Niini nga paagi, mas daghan silang mabantayan nga dungan.

q: How does heat from the Sun reach Earth even though there is empty space in between?
options: By radiation — heat travels as rays or waves and does not need any material or medium to pass through
By conduction — the Sun touches a long chain of particles that stretches all the way to Earth
By convection — hot gas flows outward from the Sun and carries heat across space to Earth
By reflection — the Moon reflects the Sun's heat and redirects it toward Earth's surface
explanation: In radiation, heat travels as rays (waves) and needs no material in between, so heat can travel even through the empty vacuum of space.
fact_tl: Sa radiation, naglalakbay ang init sa anyo ng sinag (waves) at hindi nangangailangan ng anumang bagay sa pagitan — kaya kayang dumaan ng init kahit sa walang-hangin na kalawakan.
fact_bis: Sa radiation, ang init molabay isip silaw (waves) ug wala manginahanglan og bisan unsang butang sa tunga — busa makaagi ang init bisan sa walay-hangin nga kawanangan.

q: Which mineral sits at the very top of the Mohs hardness scale with a score of 10?
options: Diamond
Quartz
Topaz
Corundum
explanation: The hardest mineral on the Mohs scale is diamond, with a hardness of 10.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamatigas na mineral sa Mohs scale ay diamond (diyamante), na may hardness na 10.
fact_bis: Ang labing gahi nga mineral sa Mohs scale mao ang diamond (diyamante), nga adunay hardness nga 10.

q: Which part of a bone is where blood is made?
options: The hard outer part made of calcium
The soft inside called bone marrow
The joints that connect two bones
The cartilage that cushions the ends
explanation: Bone marrow is the soft inside of a bone where blood cells are produced.
fact_tl: Ang buto ay may matigas na labas na pinapatibay ng kaltsyum, at malambot na loob na tinatawag na utak ng buto kung saan ginagawa ang dugo. Magkaiba ang trabaho ng bawat bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang bukog adunay gahi nga gawas nga gipalig-on sa kalsyum, ug humok nga sulod nga gitawag og utok sa bukog diin gihimo ang dugo. Lahi ang trabaho sa matag bahin.

q: What material is dragline silk made of?
options: Sugar, the same building block as plant sap
Protein, the same building block found in meat and eggs
Chitin, the same material as an insect's shell
Fat, the same material stored in a spider's abdomen
explanation: Dragline silk is made of protein, the same kind of building material found in meat and eggs, which gives it strength.
fact_tl: Ang dragline silk ay gawa sa protina, ang parehong uri ng sangkap na makikita sa laman at itlog na nagbibigay dito ng lakas.
fact_bis: Ang dragline silk hinimo gikan sa protina, ang samang matang sa sangkap nga makit-an sa karne ug itlog nga naghatag niini ug kusog.

q: How do ferns, mosses, and liverworts reproduce instead of using seeds?
options: They grow from cuttings of their stems
They release spores to make new plants
They spread by sending out underground runners
They drop berries that sprout new plants
explanation: Ferns, mosses, and liverworts are non-seed plants that reproduce by releasing spores instead of seeds.
fact_tl: Ang mga halaman na hindi nagbubunga ng buto ay tinatawag na non-seed plants—kasama dito ang mga pakis (ferns), lumot (mosses), at liverworts—lahat sila ay nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng spore.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanum nga dili nagmugna og buto gitawag og non-seed plants; naglakip kini sa pakis, lumot, ug liverworts—tanan sila nagpadaghan pinaagi sa spore kaysa buto.

q: Why do power lines sag lower on a very hot day?
options: The plastic coating melts and adds weight
The metal expands and becomes longer in the heat
The poles tilt outward under the heat
The electricity flowing through makes them heavier
explanation: On hot days, power lines expand and become longer, causing them to sag lower between the poles.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na tag-araw, lumalawak at lumalaylay ang mga kable ng kuryente; sa malamig, umuurong at humihigpit ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Sa init nga ting-init, molapad ug mosabit ang mga kable sa kuryente; sa bugnaw, mokunhod ug mohugot kini.

q: What happens to coral reefs when the ocean absorbs too much carbon dioxide?
options: They grow faster because CO₂ is a fertilizer
They become more acidic, harming the reefs
They become warmer but the reefs are unaffected
The CO₂ turns into oxygen, helping marine life
explanation: When seawater absorbs too much carbon dioxide, it becomes more acidic, which harms coral reefs and other sea life.
fact_tl: Bukod sa hangin, sumisipsip din ang dagat ng carbon dioxide. Pero kapag sobra na, nagiging mas maasim ang tubig-dagat at nasasaktan ang mga coral reef at iba pang lamang-dagat. Mahalaga ito sa Pilipinas dahil maraming nakadepende sa dagat.
fact_bis: Gawas sa hangin, ang dagat usab mosuyop ug carbon dioxide. Apan kung sobra na, mahimong mas aslom ang tubig-dagat ug madaot ang mga coral reef ug uban pang lamang-dagat. Importante kini sa Pilipinas kay daghan ang nagsalig sa dagat.

q: Which animals feed on seagrass meadows in Philippine coastal waters?
options: Dolphins and flying fish
Dugongs and sea turtles
Sharks and barracudas
Clownfish and jellyfish
explanation: Seagrasses serve as food for dugongs, sea turtles, and other marine animals in Philippine coastal waters.
fact_tl: Ang mga damong-dagat (seagrass) ay mga tunay na halaman na lumalago sa ilalim ng dagat—nagpapatola ito sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis at nagsisilbing pagkain ng dugong at iba pang hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga damong-dagat (seagrass) mga tinuod nga tanum nga motubo sa ilalim sa dagat; nagpapatola kini pinaagi sa photosynthesis ug nagsilbi ingong pagkaon sa dugong, pawikan, ug uban pang dagat nga hayop.

q: In a double replacement reaction, what do the two compounds do?
options: One compound breaks apart into its separate elements
Both compounds combine to form a single product
The two compounds exchange their parts to form two new compounds
One compound gains electrons from the other compound
explanation: In a double replacement reaction, two compounds exchange their ions to form two new compounds, often producing a precipitate.
fact_tl: Sa double replacement reaction, dalawang compound ang nagpapalitan ng kanilang mga bahagi (ions) upang bumuo ng dalawang bagong compound, na kadalasang nagbubuo ng latak.
fact_bis: Sa double replacement reaction, duha ka compound mag-ilisanay sa ilang mga bahin (ions) aron maporma ang duha ka bag-ong compound, kasagaran maghimo og latak.

q: Most plastic is made from which raw material?
options: Sand, which is melted and shaped into molds
Oil (petroleum), whose parts are linked into long molecule chains
Wood pulp, which is compressed and chemically treated
Limestone, which is heated and mixed with carbon
explanation: Most plastic is made from oil (petroleum), whose tiny parts are joined into very long chains of molecules that can be shaped into almost anything.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan ng plastik ay gawa mula sa langis (petrolyo), na ang maliliit na bahagi ay pinagdurugtong-durugtong para maging napakahabang kadena ng molekula na puwedeng hubugin sa anumang hugis.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa plastik hinimo gikan sa lana (petroleum), nga ang gagmay nga bahin niini ginadugtong-dugtong aron mahimong taas kaayo nga kadena sa molekula nga mahimong hulmahon ngadto sa bisan unsang porma.

q: Why do two mirrors facing each other create many repeated images of one object?
options: Each mirror adds its own color to the image, making more copies
Light bounces back and forth between them, repeating the image many times
The glass bends light into a curve that splits the image apart
Each mirror has a slightly different curve, creating different views
explanation: When two mirrors face each other, light bounces back and forth between them, so one object appears repeated many times in a long row.
fact_tl: Kapag dalawang salamin ang magkaharap, ang liwanag ay paulit-ulit na bumabalik sa pagitan nila, kaya nakikita mo ang isang bagay na inuulit nang maraming beses na pahaba — ito ang prinsipyo ng kaleidoscope.
fact_bis: Kung duha ka salamin ang mag-atubang, ang kahayag balikbalik nga mobalik tunga nila, maong makita nimo ang usa ka butang nga balikbalik og daghan nga pataas — mao kini ang prinsipyo sa kaleidoscope.

q: Why does a soldering iron have a metal tip when joining electronic parts?
options: Metal is hard enough to press the parts tightly together
Metal quickly carries heat to the small parts being joined
Metal is non-stick so solder does not cling to the tool
Metal glows brightly so the worker can see small parts
explanation: The metal tip of a soldering iron quickly carries heat to the tiny metal parts being joined, melting the solder so it bonds them together.
fact_tl: Sa paghihinang ng mga sirkito sa electronics, ginagamit ang panghinang na may metal na dulo. Mabilis na dinadala ng metal na dulo ang init papunta sa maliit na metal na bahaging pinagdurugtong, kaya natutunaw ang panghinang at nagdidikit ang mga ito. Kung hindi mahusay magdala ng init ang metal, hindi gagana ang ganitong pagkumpuni.
fact_bis: Sa paghinang sa mga sirkito sa electronics, gigamit ang panghinang nga adunay metal nga tumoy. Ang metal nga tumoy paspas modala sa kainit paingon sa gagmay nga metal nga bahin nga gisumpay, mao nga matunaw ang hinang ug magdikit kini. Kung dili maayo ang metal modala sa kainit, dili molihok kini nga matang sa pag-ayo.

q: What can happen to a tarsier when it is kept in captivity and disturbed by people?
options: It becomes aggressive and bites its handlers
It can die from extreme stress or depression
It grows much larger because it is overfed
It loses its ability to cling to branches
explanation: Tarsiers are easily stressed in captivity and can die from extreme stress or depression when disturbed by people.
fact_tl: Ang tarsier ay madaling ma-stress kapag nakakulong o ginagambala ng mga tao, at maaaring mamatay sa sobrang stress o depresyon.
fact_bis: Ang tarsier daling ma-stress kung nakulong o ginalagaw sa mga tawo, ug mahimong mamatay sa sobrang stress o depresyon.

q: Which three simple machines did Archimedes study?
options: The wheel and axle, the inclined plane, and the wedge
The lever, the pulley, and the screw
The gear, the spring, and the pendulum
The ramp, the wedge, and the wheel and axle
explanation: Archimedes studied three simple machines: the lever, the pulley, and the screw.
fact_tl: Tatlo ang simpleng makinang pinag-aralan ni Archimedes: ang lever, ang pulley, at ang screw.
fact_bis: Tulo ka simpleng makina ang gitun-an ni Archimedes: ang lever, ang pulley, ug ang screw.

q: How does hair conditioner smooth hair and reduce static electricity?
options: It coats hair with oil that physically glues the strands flat
Its positively charged compounds are attracted to negatively charged hair, smoothing it
It removes all electrical charge from hair by washing it away
It heats the hair slightly so the strands relax and lie flat
explanation: Hair conditioner contains positively charged compounds that are attracted to negatively charged hair, smoothing the surface and reducing static electricity.
fact_tl: Ang hair conditioner ay naglalaman ng mga positibong charged na kemikal (cationic compounds) na nakaakit sa negatibong charged na buhok, na nagpapalambot at nagpapahina ng static electricity.
fact_bis: Ang hair conditioner nagdala og positibong charged na mga kemikal (cationic compound) nga nadani sa negatibong charged nga buhok, nagpalambot sa nawong ug nagpababa sa static electricity.

q: What actually causes body odor when a person sweats?
options: The salt in sweat irritates the skin and causes a chemical reaction
Bacteria on the skin feed on the sweat and give off a smell
Sweat itself has a very strong smell that builds up over time
The heat from the body turns sweat into a smelly gas
explanation: Sweat itself is almost odorless — body odor comes from bacteria on the skin feeding on the sweat and giving off a smell.
fact_tl: Ang pawis mismo ay halos walang amoy — ang amoy ay galing sa bacteria sa balat na kumakain ng pawis sa mga bahaging tulad ng kilikili at nagiging mabaho ang dulot.
fact_bis: Ang singot mismo halos walay baho — ang baho gikan sa bacteria sa panit nga mokaon sa singot sa mga bahin sama sa kilikili ug mohatag og baho.

q: What does the shape of Laguna de Bay look like when seen on a map?
options: A perfect oval like a large lake
A stork footprint with three spreading arms of water
A long thin river stretched from north to south
A rectangle with one rounded end like a shoe
explanation: Laguna de Bay has a shape like the footprint of a stork, with three arms of water spreading out from a central body.
fact_tl: Ang Laguna de Bay ay may hugis na parang talampakan ng ibong tagak, na may tatlong sangang tubig na lumalabas mula sa gitna. Kaya kapag tiningnan mo ito sa mapa, parang may tatlong daliri na nakaunat.
fact_bis: Ang Laguna de Bay daw morag tikod sa langgam nga tagak ang porma, naay tulo ka sanga sa tubig nga nagagikan sa tunga. Mao nga kung tan-awon nimo sa mapa, morag tulo ka tudlo nga gibukhad.

q: How does a tube worm get its food?
options: It digs through sand to hunt small buried worms
It uses feathery crowns to filter food from the water
It waits for currents to push prey into its open tube
It extends sticky threads to catch passing plankton
explanation: A tube worm builds a hard tube as its home and uses feathery crowns to filter food from the water.
fact_tl: Ang tube worm ay gumagawa ng matigas na tubo bilang tahanan at gumagamit ng mabuhok na sukbit upang manala ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang tube worm magbuhat ug gahi nga tubo isip iyang puy-anan ug mogamit ug balhiboon nga korona aron mosala sa pagkaon.

q: According to Kepler, what shape is the orbit of each planet around the Sun?
options: A perfect circle, always the same distance from the Sun
An ellipse, like a stretched or flattened circle
A spiral that slowly moves the planet further from the Sun
A figure-eight path that crosses itself once each orbit
explanation: According to Kepler's first law, the orbits of planets are shaped like an ellipse, not a perfect circle.
fact_tl: Ayon kay Kepler, ang orbit ng mga planeta ay hugis-ellipse (parang pahabang bilog), hindi perpektong bilog.
fact_bis: Sumala kang Kepler, ang orbit sa mga planeta porma'g ellipse (sama sa gibira nga lingin), dili hingpit nga lingin.

q: When does the nautilus rise to shallow water to find food?
options: During the day, following the sunlight for warmth
At night, rising to shallower water while sinking deep during the day
At sunrise and sunset, making two feeding trips each day
Only during storms when deep-water prey moves upward
explanation: At night the nautilus rises to shallower water to feed, then sinks to deep water again during the day.
fact_tl: Tuwing gabi ay umaakyat ang nautilus sa mababaw na tubig para kumain, at lumulubog naman sa malalim kapag araw.
fact_bis: Panahon sa gabii moangat ang nautilus sa mabaw nga tubig aron mokaon, ug molubog sa lawom kon adlaw.

q: What does it usually mean when a dog wags its tail?
options: The dog is warning you to stay away
The dog is happy or excited to see you
The dog is feeling sick and needs help
The dog wants food and is begging
explanation: Dogs often wag their tails when they are happy or excited to see someone.
fact_tl: Madalas ikinakawag ng aso ang buntot nito kapag ito ay masaya o nasasabik na makita ka.
fact_bis: Kanunay iwag-iwagon sa iro ang ikog niini kung kini malipayon o naghinamhinam nga makita ka.

q: Why do white or light-colored roofs help keep homes cooler in the Philippines?
options: They are made of thicker material that blocks hot air from entering
They reflect more radiant heat from the sun than dark-colored roofs
They absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night
They allow rainwater to flow off faster, cooling the surface
explanation: White or light-colored roofs reflect more radiant heat from the sun than dark roofs, keeping homes cooler in the hot Philippine climate.
fact_tl: Ang mga puting o maliwanag na bubong ay nagpapabawi ng mas maraming radiant na init ng araw kaysa sa madilim na bubong — nakakatulong ito na mapanatiling malamig ang loob ng bahay sa mainit na klima ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang puti o maliwanag nga mga bubong nagapakita sa daghang radiant nga init sa adlaw kaysa sa maitom nga bubong — nagpabilin sa mga balay nga mas malamig sa mainit nga klima sa Pilipinas.

q: What magnitude on the Richter scale classifies an earthquake as a 'great earthquake'?
options: Magnitude 5 or higher
Magnitude 6 or higher
Magnitude 7 or higher
Magnitude 8 or higher
explanation: An earthquake of magnitude 8 or higher on the Richter scale is called a 'great earthquake' and is very destructive.
fact_tl: Ang lindol na may magnitude 8 o higit pa sa Richter scale ay tinatawag na 'great earthquake' at napakapinsala.
fact_bis: Ang linog nga adunay magnitude 8 o labaw pa sa Richter scale gitawag og 'great earthquake' ug makaguba kaayo.

q: Why does silver jewelry turn black over time?
options: Oxygen in the air slowly burns the silver surface
Silver reacts with hydrogen sulfide in the air, forming black silver sulfide
Moisture causes silver to rust just like iron does
The silver reacts with carbon dioxide to form a dark coating
explanation: Silver tarnishes because it reacts with hydrogen sulfide in the air, forming a thin black layer of silver sulfide on its surface.
fact_tl: Ang pilak ay nagbabago ng kulay (tarnishes) kapag ito ay napalantad sa hydrogen sulfide sa hangin, na bumubuo ng itim na silver sulfide sa ibabaw nito.
fact_bis: Ang pilak nagtarnish tungod kay nagtubag kini sa hydrogen sulfide sa hangin, nagbuo og manipis nga itim nga layer sa silver sulfide sa ibabaw niini.

q: What happens when you breathe more deeply?
options: Your heart beats slower to save energy
Your lungs take in more oxygen with each breath
Your blood pumps faster to remove carbon dioxide
Your diaphragm pushes extra air out of the lungs
explanation: Breathing more deeply lets your lungs take in more oxygen with each breath.
fact_tl: Mas malalim na paghinga ay nagpapasok ng mas maraming oxygen sa iyong mga baga.
fact_bis: Ang mas lawom nga pagginhawa makapasulod og mas daghang oxygen sa imong mga baga.

q: How is the way a whale shark filter-feeds different from the way a shellfish filter-feeds?
options: The whale shark uses teeth to catch food while the shellfish does not
The whale shark swims and pushes water through its mouth while the shellfish stays still and pulls water in
The whale shark only feeds near the surface while the shellfish only feeds on the seafloor
The whale shark catches fish while the shellfish only eats tiny plants
explanation: The whale shark swims and pushes water through its mouth as it travels, while the shellfish stays in one place and pulls water toward itself.
fact_tl: Parehong filter feeder ang kabibe at ang butanding, pero ang butanding ay lumalangoy at dinadaan ang tubig sa bibig habang naglalakbay, samantalang ang kabibe ay nakatigil sa isang lugar at hinihila ang tubig papunta sa sarili.
fact_bis: Parehong filter feeder ang kabibe ug ang butanding, apan ang butanding molangoy ug moagi sa tubig sa baba samtang nagpanaw, samtang ang kabibe magpabilin sa usa ka dapit ug mobira sa tubig padulong sa kaugalingon.

q: What is an aquifer?
options: A large river that flows through a mountain range
A layer of rock or sand underground that holds a lot of water
A type of cloud that stores water vapor high in the sky
A man-made reservoir built to collect rainwater
explanation: An aquifer is a layer of rock or sand underground that holds a lot of water, and is an important source of fresh water.
fact_tl: Ang aquifer ay isang layer ng bato o buhangin sa ilalim ng lupa na may laman na maraming tubig.
fact_bis: Ang aquifer usa ka sapaw sa bato o balas ilawom sa yuta nga gipuno sa daghang tubig.

q: Why can an electric eel's shock reach its prey before it even touches it?
options: The eel can aim its shock like a beam through the water
Electricity travels through water easily, spreading the shock outward
The eel releases a chemical that stuns prey at a distance
Sound waves from the shock travel faster in water than in air
explanation: Electricity travels through water more easily than through air, so an electric eel's shock can spread through the water and reach prey before it makes contact.
fact_tl: Mas madaling dumaan ang kuryente sa tubig kaysa sa hangin. Kaya kayang kumalat ang kuryente ng electric eel sa tubig sa paligid nito para tamaan ang biktima kahit hindi pa ito nahahawakan.
fact_bis: Mas sayon moagi ang kuryente sa tubig kaysa sa hangin. Mao nga ang kuryente sa electric eel makakatap sa tubig palibot niini ug makaabot sa biktima bisan wala pa kini mahikap.

q: What happens when two objects with the same kind of electric charge are placed near each other?
options: They attract each other strongly
They repel each other
They cancel out and become neutral
They create a spark between them
explanation: Like electric charges (both positive or both negative) repel each other, while opposite charges attract.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng elektrikal na karga: positibo at negatibo; ang magkaparehong karga ay nagtataboy, at ang magkasalungat ay umaakit.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka matang sa elektrikal nga charge, positibo ug negatibo; ang parehas nga charge magsalikway ug ang magkalahi magdani.

q: How does the long handle of a car jack help lift a heavy vehicle?
options: The long handle stores more energy like a spring when you grip it
Pushing it down applies a small force over a long distance to produce a large upward force
The handle spins to multiply speed and push the jack arm up faster
The long handle lets two people push at once to double the force
explanation: The long handle of a car jack acts as a lever — a small force over a long distance produces a large upward force on the short jack arm.
fact_tl: Ang mahabang hawakan ng jack ng kotse ay nagsisilbing lever — ang pagpitik nang pababa ay nagpapataas ng malaking puwersa sa maliit na piston na umangat ng kotse.
fact_bis: Ang taas nga hawakan sa jack sa kotse nagasilbi isip lever — ang pagpindot niini pababa nagbutang og gamay nga puwersa sa taas nga distansya, nagabuhat og dako nga pataas nga puwersa sa mubo nga jack arm.

q: What does 'due process' mean according to the Philippine Constitution?
options: The right to vote in any election without restrictions
Every Filipino's right to a proper legal process before being punished
The government's right to collect taxes from all citizens
The freedom to travel anywhere inside the Philippines
explanation: According to the Philippine Constitution, every Filipino has the right to a proper legal process before being punished — this is called due process.
fact_tl: Ayon sa Saligang Batas, ang bawat Pilipino ay may karapatang sumailalim sa tamang prosesong legal bago siya maparusahan — ito ang tinatawag na due process.
fact_bis: Sumala sa Saligang Batas, ang matag Pilipino adunay katungod sa hustong prosesong legal sa wala pa siya silotan — kini gitawag og due process.

q: What makes a mirror reflect your image instead of letting you see through the glass?
options: The glass is extra thick so no light passes through it
A thin coating of shiny metal on the back of the glass bounces light back
The glass is tinted dark so it acts like a screen
The surface of the glass is curved to focus light into an image
explanation: A mirror is clear glass with a thin coating of shiny metal (like silver or aluminum) on the back that bounces light back to form an image.
fact_tl: Ang salamin ay isang piraso ng malinis na bildo na may manipis na patong ng makintab na metal (tulad ng pilak o aluminum) sa likod — ang metal na ito ang nagbabalik ng liwanag para mabuo ang larawan.
fact_bis: Ang salamin usa ka piraso sa tin-aw nga bildo nga adunay nipis nga sapaw sa makintab nga metal (sama sa pilak o aluminum) sa luyo — kini nga metal mao ang mobalik sa kahayag aron maporma ang hulagway.

q: Why do many cold-blooded reptiles like geckos and monitor lizards thrive in the Philippines?
options: The Philippines has many forests that hide reptiles from predators
The Philippines is warm all year, which suits cold-blooded animals
Philippine rivers have clean water that reptiles need to survive
Philippine insects are larger, giving reptiles plenty of food
explanation: Because the Philippines is warm all year, many cold-blooded reptiles like geckos and monitor lizards thrive there.
fact_tl: Dahil mainit ang klima sa Pilipinas buong taon, marami ditong reptilya tulad ng tuko at bayawak na umuunlad.
fact_bis: Tungod kay init ang klima sa Pilipinas tibuok tuig, daghang reptilya sama sa tuko ug bayawak ang molambo dinhi.

q: What happens when you gently touch a makahiya leaf?
options: It grows a small thorn to protect itself from being touched again
It quickly folds up its leaves in response to the touch
It releases a strong smell to warn away the hand
It turns a darker green color within a few seconds
explanation: When you gently touch a makahiya leaf, it folds up quickly — you can observe this in a simple experiment.
fact_tl: Maaari mong subukang hipuin nang marahan ang dahon ng makahiya at obserbahan kung gaano kabilis itong magtiklop.
fact_bis: Mahimo nimong sulayan ug hinay nga hikapon ang dahon sa makahiya ug obserbahan kung unsa kapaspas kini magtiklop.

q: About how old is a Greenland shark before it can reproduce?
options: About 10 years old
About 50 years old
About 150 years old
About 300 years old
explanation: The Greenland shark cannot have young until it is about 150 years old, making it one of the slowest-maturing animals on Earth.
fact_tl: Hindi nakakapagkaanak ang Greenland shark hangga't hindi ito umaabot ng mga 150 taong gulang.
fact_bis: Ang Greenland shark dili makaanak hangtod nga moabot kini ug mga 150 ka tuig ang edad.

q: Why do nectar-drinking birds have long, thin beaks?
options: To crack open hard seed pods that contain sweet nectar
To reach deep inside flowers to sip the nectar inside
To dig into bark where sugary tree sap collects
To scoop water and nectar from flat open puddles
explanation: Birds that drink nectar have long, thin beaks so they can reach deep inside flowers to sip the nectar.
fact_tl: Ang mga ibong umiinom ng nektar ay may mahaba at manipis na tuka para makaabot sa loob ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam nga moinom og nektar adunay taas ug nipis nga sungo aron makaabot sa sulod sa bulak.

q: Why does food taste bland when you have a blocked nose?
options: A blocked nose causes the tongue to swell and lose sensitivity
Smell contributes much of what we experience as flavor, so a blocked nose reduces taste
The throat tightens when the nose is blocked, stopping flavor chemicals from reaching the tongue
Blocked sinuses send a signal to the brain that turns off taste buds temporarily
explanation: Taste and smell are closely connected; when the nose is blocked, food tastes bland because smell contributes much of what we experience as flavor.
fact_tl: Ang lasa at amoy ay magkakaugnay; kapag sipon tayo at hindi makalanghap, ang pagkain ay hindi masyadong malasahan dahil malaki ang kontribusyon ng amoy sa panlasa natin.
fact_bis: Ang lasa ug amoy suod kaayo nga magkaugnay; kung sipon ang ilong, ang pagkaon dili kaayo malasa tungod kay ang amoy nakatampo ug dako sa atong nasinati nga lasa.

q: Why is pyrite nicknamed 'fool's gold'?
options: It is worthless because it is softer than real gold and scratches easily
It looks like gold but is harder and has a greenish-black streak instead of a gold one
It was once used as fake coins by dishonest merchants in ancient times
It is found in the same mines as gold but cannot be melted down like gold
explanation: Pyrite is called 'fool's gold' because it looks like gold, but it is harder (hardness 6) and its streak is greenish-black, not gold-colored.
fact_tl: Ang pyrite ay tinatawag na 'fool's gold' dahil magkapareho ang hitsura nito ng ginto, ngunit mas matigas ito (hardness 6) at ang streak nito ay greenish-black, hindi ginto.
fact_bis: Ang pyrite gitawag og 'fool's gold' tungod kay sama kini og hitsura sa tinuod nga bulawan, apan mas gahi kini (hardness 6) ug ang streak niini greenish-black, dili bulawan.

q: Which gases are the main greenhouse gases in the atmosphere?
options: Oxygen, nitrogen, and argon
Carbon dioxide, water vapor, and methane
Ozone, helium, and carbon monoxide
Hydrogen, sulfur dioxide, and neon
explanation: The main greenhouse gases are carbon dioxide, water vapor, and methane in the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang pangunahing greenhouse gases ay carbon dioxide, water vapor, at methane na nasa atmospera.
fact_bis: Ang nag-unang greenhouse gases mao ang carbon dioxide, alisngaw sa tubig, ug methane sa atmospera.

q: How do sea stars move across the seafloor?
options: They use their stiff arms like legs, pushing off rocks to walk
Hundreds of tiny tube feet powered by water pressure inside their body move them
They use jet propulsion by squirting water out the back of their body
They roll by inflating and deflating their central disc like a balloon
explanation: Sea stars move using hundreds of tiny tube feet powered by water pressure within the animal's water vascular system.
fact_tl: Ang sea star (bitoon-dagat) ay gumagalaw gamit ang daan-daang maliliit na tube feet sa ilalim ng kanyang mga braso — ang bawat tube foot ay pinapatakbo ng presyon ng tubig sa loob ng water vascular system ng hayop.
fact_bis: Ang sea star (bitoon-dagat) naglihok gamit ang gatusan ka gagmay nga tube feet sa ubos sa iyang mga bukton — ang matag tube foot gipaandar sa presyon sa tubig sulod sa water vascular system sa hayop.

q: What effect does the amihan wind season have on highland places like Baguio?
options: It brings heavy rainfall and flooding to Baguio's hillsides
It makes highland areas even colder with temperatures dropping sharply
It causes hot dry spells in Baguio during the months it blows
It pushes thick fog away from Baguio, making it unusually clear and warm
explanation: During the amihan, highland places like Baguio get even colder, with temperatures dropping sharply.
fact_tl: Tuwing amihan, lalong lumalamig ang mga mataas na lugar tulad ng Baguio kung saan minsan bumababa nang husto ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Panahon sa amihan, mas mobugnaw ang taas nga mga dapit sama sa Baguio diin usahay mokunhod pag-ayo ang temperatura.

q: Which planet takes the longest time to complete one orbit around the Sun?
options: Saturn, because its rings slow it down
Jupiter, because it is the most massive planet
Uranus, because it orbits on its side
Neptune, because it is farthest from the Sun
explanation: Neptune has the longest year because it is farthest from the Sun — about 165 Earth years to complete one orbit.
fact_tl: Ang Neptune ang may pinakamahabang taon dahil ito ang pinakamalayo sa Araw, halos 165 taon ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Neptune adunay pinakatas-on nga tuig kay kini ang pinakalayo sa Adlaw, mga 165 ka tuig sa Yuta.

q: Where can you find out whether you should take a medicine with food or water?
options: Ask your classmates what worked for them
Check the medicine's label for directions on how to take it
Guess based on how the medicine smells
Take it both ways and see which feels better
explanation: The medicine's label states whether to take it with food or water, so reading the label is the correct step.
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng label kung iinom ba ang gamot kasama ng pagkain o tubig.
fact_bis: Ang label nagsulti kung uban ba sa pagkaon o tubig ang pag-inom sa tambal.

q: If a car's speed doubles, how does its kinetic energy change?
options: It doubles, because energy and speed increase at the same rate
It triples, because doubling speed adds one extra unit of energy
It stays the same, because mass does not change when speed increases
It becomes four times as large, because kinetic energy depends on the square of speed
explanation: Kinetic energy depends on the square of speed, so doubling the speed makes the kinetic energy four times as large.
fact_tl: Ang kinetic energy ng isang bagay ay nakadepende sa masa at sa parisukat (square) ng bilis nito, kaya kapag doble ang bilis, apat na beses ang kinetic energy — kaya delikado ang mabilis na sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang kinetic energy sa usa ka butang nagdepende sa masa ug sa kuwadrado sa katulin niini, mao nga kung doblehon ang katulin, upat ka pilo ang kinetic energy — mao nga delikado ang paspas nga sakyanan.

q: What gives a ruby its distinctive red color?
options: A trace of iron mixed into the crystal structure
A trace of chromium mixed into the corundum
A small amount of copper absorbed during formation
A layer of red mineral deposited on the surface
explanation: A ruby is red because of a trace of chromium mixed into the corundum mineral that makes up the gem.
fact_tl: Ang ruby ay pumupula dahil sa bahagyang halong chromium (kromyum) sa corundum.
fact_bis: Ang ruby pula tungod sa gamay nga chromium nga nasagol sa corundum.

q: What makes the Puerto Princesa Subterranean River in Palawan especially remarkable?
options: It is the deepest cave river in the world, measured in the 1990s
It has the longest navigable underground river in the world, flowing through a limestone cave into the sea
It is the only underground river in Asia that is entirely underground from start to finish
It was formed by a volcanic eruption that created a tunnel beneath the mountain
explanation: Puerto Princesa Subterranean River in Palawan has the longest navigable underground river in the world, flowing through a large limestone cave system directly into the sea.
fact_tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park sa Palawan ay may pinakamahabang navigable underground river sa mundo; ang ilog ay dumadaan sa loob ng isang malaking limestone cave system at diretso sa dagat; ito ay isang UNESCO World Heritage Site at isa sa New7Wonders of Nature.
fact_bis: Ang Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park sa Palawan adunay pinakataas nga navigable underground river sa kalibutan; ang suba nagdagayday pinaagi sa dako nga limestone cave system ug direkta ngadto sa dagat; kini usa ka UNESCO World Heritage Site ug usa sa New7Wonders of Nature.

q: Why do farmers and fishpond owners sometimes add lime to their soil or water?
options: Lime adds nutrients that help plants and fish grow bigger
Lime neutralizes excess acid in the soil or water to make it more fit for life
Lime acts as a pesticide that kills harmful insects and parasites
Lime makes the water clearer by settling floating mud particles
explanation: People add lime (a base) to overly acidic soil, lakes, or fishponds to neutralize the acid and make the water or soil more fit for life.
fact_tl: Naglalagay ang mga tao ng apog (isang base) sa labis na asidong lupa, lawa, o palaisdaan upang i-neutralize ang asido at gawing mas angkop sa buhay ang tubig o lupa.
fact_bis: Magbutang ang mga tawo og apog (usa ka base) sa sobra ka-asido nga yuta, lanaw, o pundohanan sa isda aron i-neutralize ang asido ug himuong mas angay sa kinabuhi ang tubig o yuta.

q: What part of the garlic plant is used to flavor food?
options: The leaves, which are dried and crushed into powder
The underground bulb, which is made of small cloves
The small white flowers, which have the strongest aroma
The roots, which are boiled to release their flavor
explanation: Garlic (bawang) is a plant whose underground bulb is made of small cloves used to flavor food because of its strong smell and taste.
fact_tl: Ang bawang ay isang halamang ang bahaging tumutubo sa ilalim ng lupa ay binubuo ng maliliit na pira na ginagamit na pampalasa dahil sa matapang nitong amoy at lasa.
fact_bis: Ang ahos usa ka tanom nga ang bahin niini sa ilawom sa yuta gilangkoban sa gagmay nga mga tipik nga gigamit nga panimpla tungod sa kusog niini nga baho ug lami.

q: How can you tell if a material is a conductor of electricity?
options: Rub it against wool and see if it makes a spark
Put it in a circuit — if the bulb lights up, electricity is flowing through it
Dip it in water and see if the water changes color
Hold it up to sunlight and check if it glows slightly
explanation: You can test whether something is a conductor by putting it in a circuit; if the bulb lights, current flows through it.
fact_tl: Maaari mong subukan kung conductor ang isang bagay sa pamamagitan ng paglalagay nito sa loob ng circuit; kung magliwanag ang bombilya, dumadaloy ang kuryente. Kahit prutas tulad ng kalamansi ay maaaring gumawa ng kaunting kuryente gamit ang dalawang magkaibang metal.
fact_bis: Mahimo nimong sulayan kung conductor ba ang usa ka butang pinaagi sa pagbutang niini sa sulod sa circuit; kung modan-ag ang bombilya, moagos ang kuryente. Bisan ang prutas sama sa kalamansi makahimo og gamay nga kuryente gamit ang duha ka lahi nga metal.

q: Approximately how wide is the Earth from one side to the other?
options: About 6,371 kilometers wide
About 12,742 kilometers wide
About 40,075 kilometers wide
About 1,274 kilometers wide
explanation: Earth is about 12,742 kilometers wide across — this measurement is called the diameter.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay humigit-kumulang 12,742 kilometro ang lapad mula sa magkabilang dulo (diameter).
fact_bis: Ang Yuta mga 12,742 ka kilometro ang gilapdon gikan sa magkilid nga tumoy (diameter).

q: Why do having two eyes instead of one allow us to see depth?
options: Two eyes collect twice as much light, making images sharper
The small gap between the eyes makes each eye view things from a slightly different angle
Two eyes share the work so each eye can focus on a different distance
One eye sees color while the other sees shape, and together they make a 3D image
explanation: Because there is a small gap between the two eyes, they view things from different angles, which lets us see depth.
fact_tl: Dahil may kaunting agwat sa pagitan ng dalawang mata, magkaiba ang anggulo ng pagtingin nila, kaya nakikita natin ang lalim.
fact_bis: Tungod kay adunay gamay nga gilay-on tunga-tunga sa duha ka mata, lahi ang ilang anggulo sa pagtan-aw, mao nga makita nato ang giladmon.

q: What does the hardness of a mineral tell us?
options: How hard it is to scratch the mineral
How heavy the mineral is
