Porcelain is thicker and heavier, making it more durable than earthenware.
Porcelain is made from red clay, giving it a darker and rougher surface.
Porcelain absorbs water more easily than regular earthenware does.
explanation: Porcelain is made from white kaolin clay and is finer, whiter, and slightly translucent compared to ordinary earthenware.
fact_tl: Ang porcelain ay isang mataas na kalidad na ceramic na gawa sa puting kaolin clay; ito ay mas pino, mas puti, at bahagyang transparent kaysa ordinaryong ceramic.
fact_bis: Ang porcelana usa ka taas nga kalidad nga ceramic gihimo gikan sa puting kaolin clay; mas pino, mas puti, ug bahagyang transparent kaysa ordinaryong ceramic nga gam-it.

q: What do disclosing tablets do when you chew them?
options: They color the plaque on your teeth red or pink so you can see where it is hiding.
They release fluoride that immediately dissolves the plaque on your teeth.
They numb your teeth and gums so the dentist can clean without pain.
They whiten your teeth by bleaching any stains on the enamel.
explanation: Disclosing tablets stain plaque red or pink so you can see exactly where it is hiding on your teeth.
fact_tl: May espesyal na tableta na nagbibigay-kulay sa plaque para makita kung saan ito nakatago. Pumupula o nagi-pink ang mga bahaging may plaque.
fact_bis: Adunay espesyal nga tableta nga mohatag og kolor sa plaque aron makita asa kini nagtago. Mopula o mag-pink ang mga bahin nga adunay plaque.

q: What is the main difference between an asteroid and a comet?
options: An asteroid is made of rock and metal, while a comet is made of ice, dust, and rock.
An asteroid has a glowing tail, while a comet is completely dark and invisible.
An asteroid orbits the Moon, while a comet orbits only distant stars.
An asteroid is bigger than any comet ever found in our solar system.
explanation: An asteroid is made of rock and metal, while a comet is made of ice, dust, and rock.
fact_tl: Ang asteroid ay gawa sa bato at metal, samantalang ang kometa ay gawa sa yelo, alikabok, at bato.
fact_bis: Ang asteroid hinimo sa bato ug metal, samtang ang kometa hinimo sa yelo, abog, ug bato.

q: What is sublimation in the water cycle?
options: The direct change from ice into water vapor without passing through liquid
The change from liquid water into water vapor by heating
The change from water vapor back into liquid water droplets
The change from liquid water into ice by freezing
explanation: Sublimation is the direct change from ice into water vapor without passing through the liquid state.
fact_tl: Ang sublimation ay ang direktang pagbabago ng yelo papaging singaw ng tubig nang hindi dumadaan sa liquid na estado.
fact_bis: Ang sublimation mao ang direktang pagbag-o gikan sa yelo ngadto sa water vapor nga wala moagi sa liquid nga estado.

q: Why does an earthquake have only one magnitude even though people feel it differently in different places?
options: Magnitude measures the total energy released at the source, which is a single value for the whole quake.
Each city chooses its own magnitude based on how strongly its buildings shook.
Magnitude is the average of all the different feelings reported from every place.
Scientists assign a different magnitude to each region depending on the damage found.
explanation: An earthquake has one magnitude because it measures the total energy released at the source; the feeling that varies from place to place is called intensity, not magnitude.
fact_tl: Kahit iba-iba ang ramdam ng tao sa magkakaibang lugar, iisa lang ang magnitude ng isang lindol dahil ito ay sukat ng kabuuang enerhiyang inilabas sa pinanggalingan. Ang ramdam na nag-iiba ay tinatawag na intensity, hindi magnitude.
fact_bis: Bisan og lahi-lahi ang bati sa mga tawo sa managlahing dapit, usa ra ka magnitude ang usa ka linog kay kini sukat sa kinatibuk-ang enerhiya nga gibuga sa gigikanan. Ang bati nga magkalahi matag dapit gitawag intensity, dili magnitude.

q: How did the electric eel inspire an important invention?
options: The stacking of its electricity-producing cells gave Alessandro Volta the idea to build the first battery.
Its ability to store electricity for months gave engineers the idea for rechargeable batteries.
Its shock inspired scientists to discover that electricity could travel through wires.
Its eel-shaped body gave inventors the idea for coiled electrical cables.
explanation: The way an electric eel's electrocytes stack up gave Alessandro Volta the idea to build the first battery.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, tinulungan ng electric eel ang mga siyentipiko na maunawaan ang kuryente. Ang pagkakasalansan ng electrocyte nito ay nagbigay ng ideya kay Alessandro Volta para gawin ang unang baterya.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, gitabangan sa electric eel ang mga siyentista nga makasabot sa kuryente. Ang pagkapundok sa electrocyte niini naghatag og ideya kang Alessandro Volta sa paghimo sa unang baterya.

q: What is the main reason Earth has seasons?
options: Earth's axis is tilted, so different parts get sunlight at changing angles as it orbits the Sun.
Earth moves closer to the Sun in summer and farther away in winter.
The Sun gets brighter and dimmer at different times of the year.
The Moon blocks some sunlight during certain months, making those months colder.
explanation: Seasons happen because Earth's axis is tilted, so different parts receive sunlight at changing angles and amounts throughout the year.
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon ng iba't ibang panahon dahil nakahilig ang ehe ng Daigdig, kaya't sa paglibot nito sa Araw ay nag-iiba ang dami at anggulo ng sikat ng araw sa bawat bahagi ng planeta.
fact_bis: Adunay nagkalainlaing panahon tungod kay nahilig ang axis sa Kalibutan, mao nga samtang molibot kini sa Adlaw, ang nagkalainlaing bahin makadawat og kahayag sa Adlaw sa nagkalainlaing anggulo ug gidaghanon.

q: How does the ear help us hear a sound?
options: Sound enters the outer ear and vibrates the eardrum so we can hear it.
Sound is collected by the inner ear and sent directly to the brain as light signals.
Sound passes through our skull bones and makes the ear canal vibrate.
Sound reaches the eardrum first and then travels backward to the outer ear.
explanation: The ear is the hearing organ; sound enters the outer part and vibrates the eardrum so we can hear.
fact_tl: Ang tainga ang organ na ginagamit natin sa pandinig; pumapasok ang tunog sa labas na bahagi at umuugong sa eardrum upang marinig natin ito.
fact_bis: Ang dalunggan mao ang organ nga gamiton nato sa pagpaminaw; mosulod ang tingog sa gawas nga bahin ug mokurog sa eardrum aron madungog nato kini.

q: What is special about how a leech gets its food?
options: It uses two suckers to attach to animals or people and sucks their blood.
It hunts small insects with sharp teeth hidden inside its mouth.
It absorbs nutrients from mud and decaying leaves through its skin.
It traps tiny water creatures in a sticky web it spins between rocks.
explanation: A leech is a worm with two suckers that feeds by sucking the blood of other animals or people, usually found in wet or muddy places.
fact_tl: Ang linta (leech) ay isang uri ng bulate na may dalawang panghigop (sucker) at sumisipsip ng dugo ng ibang hayop o tao. Karaniwan itong matatagpuan sa basa o maputik na lugar.
fact_bis: Ang alimatok (leech) usa ka matang sa bulate nga adunay duha ka panghigop (sucker) ug mosuyop sa dugo sa ubang hayop o tawo. Kasagaran makit-an kini sa basa o lapokon nga dapit.

q: Which method of heat transfer does NOT need any matter to carry heat from one place to another?
options: Radiation, which travels as electromagnetic waves through empty space
Conduction, which moves heat through touching solid particles
Convection, which carries heat by the movement of heated fluids
Evaporation, which removes heat as liquid turns into gas
explanation: Radiation travels as electromagnetic waves and needs no matter, unlike conduction and convection which require particles or fluid.
fact_tl: Ang init ay maaaring maglakbay sa tatlong paraan — sa pamamagitan ng conduction (pagsentuhan ng particles), convection (paggalaw ng mainit na fluids), at radiation (electromagnetic waves na hindi nangangailangan ng matter).
fact_bis: Ang init mahimong mobalhin sa tulo ka paagi — conduction pinaagi sa pagsimpatiya sa mga particle, convection pinaagi sa paglihok sa mainit nga mga fluid, ug radiation pinaagi sa electromagnetic waves nga dili kinahanglan og matter.

q: What is the thick inside of a jackfruit seed used for?
options: It is a food store that the baby plant uses while it is just starting to sprout.
It is a hard shell that protects the seed from insects and birds.
It produces chemicals that attract bees to pollinate nearby flowers.
It absorbs rainwater so the seed does not dry out in the soil.
explanation: The thick inside of a jackfruit seed stores food that the tiny baby plant uses while it is just starting to sprout.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na laman ng buto ng langka ay tindahan ng pagkain na ginagamit ng maliit na halaman habang sumisibol pa lang ito.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga sulod sa liso sa nangka maoy tipiganan sa pagkaon nga gamiton sa gamay nga tanom samtang nag-ugbos pa lang kini.

q: What happens to a moving billiard ball when it directly strikes another ball at rest?
options: It can stop while the struck ball rolls away, because it transfers its energy of motion.
Both balls fly off in the same direction at twice the original speed.
The moving ball speeds up, and the ball at rest stays still.
Both balls stop completely because they cancel out each other's motion.
explanation: When a moving billiard ball strikes another, it transfers its energy of motion so the first ball can stop while the struck ball rolls away.
fact_tl: Kapag tinamaan ng gumagalaw na bola ng bilyar ang isa pang bola, naipapasa nito ang lakas ng paggalaw kaya napapahinto ang una habang umaandar naman ang tinamaang bola.
fact_bis: Kon ang naglihok nga bola sa bilyar mobunggo sa laing bola, mabalhin niini ang kusog sa paglihok, busa mohunong ang una samtang moligid ang bola nga nabunggoan.

q: Why is it important that blood sugar stays at a balanced level?
options: Because blood sugar that is too high or too low is harmful to the body's health
Because high blood sugar gives the body extra energy to run and play
Because low blood sugar is harmless, only high blood sugar causes problems
Because blood sugar level only matters during illness and does not affect healthy people
explanation: Blood sugar must stay balanced — neither too high nor too low — so the body stays healthy.
fact_tl: Dapat manatiling balanse ang asukal sa dugo — hindi sobrang taas o sobrang baba — para manatiling malusog ang katawan.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan magpabiling balanse ang asukal sa dugo, dili sobra ka taas o sobra ka ubos, aron magpabiling himsog ang lawas.

q: What is the most common misconception about commensalism?
options: People wrongly think the host is also helped, when in truth it gains nothing and is just not harmed.
People wrongly think only one organism is involved, when in truth two organisms always compete.
People wrongly think the host is harmed, when in truth both organisms always benefit equally.
People wrongly think commensalism only happens in the ocean, not on land.
explanation: In commensalism, only one organism benefits — the host gains nothing and is simply not harmed, not helped as many people mistakenly believe.
fact_tl: Maling akala na sa commensalism ay natutulungan din ang 'host'. Sa totoo, isa lang ang nakikinabang—ang host ay hindi natutulungan, basta hindi rin nasasaktan.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga sa commensalism matabangan usab ang 'host'. Sa tinuod, usa lang ang makabenepisyo—ang host walay makuha, basta dili usab madaot.

q: Is the carabao, the Philippine national animal, a wild or a domestic animal?
options: It is a tame, domesticated animal that gently helps on the farm.
It is a wild animal that farmers sometimes catch and train when young.
It is half-wild, living in forests but coming to farms to graze.
It used to be wild but became extinct, so statues represent it as national animal.
explanation: The carabao that is our national animal is a tame, domesticated animal used to people and gently helps on the farm.
fact_tl: Hindi mailap na hayop ang kalabaw na pambansang hayop natin; ito ay alagang hayop na sanay sa tao at maamong tumutulong sa bukid.
fact_bis: Dili ihalas nga hayop ang kabaw nga atong nasodnong hayop; binuhi kini nga hayop nga anad sa tawo ug maamong motabang sa uma.

q: What can very loud sounds do to your hearing?
options: They can damage the hair cells in the ear and harm our hearing.
They temporarily sharpen hearing by exercising the eardrum muscles.
They cause the eardrum to thicken, which actually protects against future noise.
They are only harmful to older people; children's ears are not affected.
explanation: Very loud sounds can damage the hair cells in the ear and harm our hearing.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang lakas na tunog ay maaaring makasira sa hair cells sa tainga at makapinsala sa pandinig.
fact_bis: Ang sobra ka kusog nga tingog makadaot sa hair cells sa dalunggan ug makadaot sa atong pagdungog.

q: How can a very powerful volcanic eruption affect the temperature of the whole world?
options: Ash and sulfur gas rising very high can block some sunlight, causing parts of the world to cool for months or years.
The extreme heat released by the eruption raises global temperatures for several decades.
The lava flowing into the ocean warms the surrounding seas, which warms the air above them.
Eruptions release oxygen that traps heat near the surface, making the planet warmer overall.
explanation: In very strong eruptions, ash and sulfur gas rise extremely high and block sunlight, which cools parts of the world for months or years — as happened after the 1991 Pinatubo eruption.
fact_tl: Pwede bang makaapekto sa panahon ng buong mundo ang abo? Sa napakalakas na pagsabog, umaakyat nang napakataas ang abo at gas na sulfur at humahadlang ito sa sikat ng araw. Dahil dito, bahagyang lumalamig ang ilang bahagi ng mundo sa loob ng ilang buwan o taon. Nangyari ito pagkatapos ng pagsabog ng Pinatubo noong 1991.
fact_bis: Mahimo bang maapektohan sa abo ang panahon sa tibuok kalibotan? Sa kusog kaayo nga pagbuto, mosaka og taas kaayo ang abo ug sulfur nga gas ug mobabag kini sa silaw sa adlaw. Tungod niini, gamay nga mobugnaw ang ubang bahin sa kalibotan sulod sa pipila ka bulan o tuig. Nahitabo kini human sa pagbuto sa Pinatubo niadtong 1991.

q: What does fractional distillation NOT do to the molecules it separates?
options: It does not change the molecules themselves; it only sorts them apart.
It does not separate the molecules; it bonds them into new compounds.
It does not use heat; it relies entirely on pressure to divide the substances.
It does not work on liquids; it can only separate gases already in the air.
explanation: Fractional distillation is a physical separation — it sorts molecules apart without changing them.
fact_tl: Ang fractional distillation ay isang pisikal na paghihiwalay lamang—hindi nito binabago ang mga molekula, kundi pinagbubukod lang ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang fractional distillation usa lang ka pisikal nga pagbulag—wala niini usba ang mga molekula, gibulagbulag lang kini.

q: What are the huge bridge-like arches of hot gas that sometimes rise from the Sun's surface?
options: Prominences, shaped by the Sun's magnetic force
Sunspots, which are dark cool patches on the Sun's surface
Solar flares, which are sudden bright explosions of energy
Coronas, which are the faint glow seen around the Sun during an eclipse
explanation: Bridge-like arches of hot gas rising from the Sun's surface are called prominences, shaped by magnetic force, and some are taller than many Earths stacked together.
fact_tl: Minsan ang mainit na gas ng Araw ay umaarko paitaas mula sa ibabaw nito sa hugis-tulay na tinatawag na prominence, na hinuhubog ng magnetikong puwersa — ang ilan sa mga arkong ito ay mas mataas pa kaysa sa maraming Mundong nakapatong-patong.
fact_bis: Usahay ang init nga gas sa Adlaw moarko paibabaw gikan sa nawong niini sa porma nga sama sa taytayan nga gitawag og prominence, gihulma sa magnetikong puwersa — ang uban niini nga arko mas taas pa kaysa daghang Kalibutan nga gipatong-patong.

q: What is muscovado?
options: A brown sugar from sugarcane made the traditional way with little refining
A sweet syrup boiled from coconut sap and sold at local markets
A type of white refined sugar made from beets grown in mountain farms
A fermented sugarcane drink popular in Visayan festivals
explanation: Muscovado is a brown sugar from sugarcane made the traditional way with little refining.
fact_tl: Ang muscovado ay kayumangging asukal mula sa tubo na gawa sa tradisyonal na paraan, hindi gaanong pinuputi.
fact_bis: Ang muscovado usa ka kayumanggi nga asukal gikan sa tubo nga gihimo sa tradisyonal nga paagi, dili kaayo gilimpyohan.

q: Which of these is a sign that you might be dehydrated?
options: Feeling dizzy, getting a headache, and tiring quickly
Feeling very hungry and craving salty or sweet foods
Having very cold hands and feet and shivering a lot
Getting a rash on your skin and feeling itchy all over
explanation: When you do not have enough water, you can feel dizzy, get a headache, and tire quickly — these are signs of dehydration.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang ka sa tubig (dehydration), maaari kang mahilo, masakit ang ulo, at mapagod nang mabilis.
fact_bis: Kung kulang ka og tubig (dehydration), mahimo kang malipong, sakiton og ulo, ug kapoyon dayon.

q: Why are flies so hard to swat?
options: Their compound eyes detect faster movements than human eyes can see, making them react before we strike.
Their wings beat so fast that they blur in the air and our hand passes right through.
They can feel the air pressure of a swinging hand from several meters away.
Their six legs spring them into the air before the threat even gets close.
explanation: Insect compound eyes have a higher flicker rate than human eyes, so flies detect fast movements that appear blurred to us — that is why they are so hard to swat.
fact_tl: Ang compound eyes ng mga insekto ay may mas mataas na flicker rate kaysa sa mga mata ng tao—nakakakita sila ng mas mabilis na galaw na para sa tao ay tila blur; kaya mahirap mahuli ang mga langaw.
fact_bis: Ang compound eyes sa mga insekto adunay mas taas nga flicker rate kaysa sa mga mata sa tawo—nakamatikod sila sa mas paspas nga lihok nga para sa ato murag blurry; kini ang rason kung ngano lisod kaayo ang pagpikpik sa mga langaw.

q: What do many parrots, including the katala, do when they find a mate?
options: They form pairs and stay together for a long time.
They stay alone most of the year and only meet briefly to lay eggs.
They live in large flocks but change partners every breeding season.
They compete fiercely every year and the winner claims a new mate.
explanation: Many parrots, including the katala, form pairs and stay together for a long time.
fact_tl: Maraming loro, kasama ang katala, ay nagkakapares at nananatiling magkasama nang matagal na panahon.
fact_bis: Daghang loro, lakip ang katala, magtiayon ug magpabilin nga magkauban sa dugay nga panahon.

q: Why do you breathe faster when you run or play?
options: Your body needs more oxygen, so your breathing speeds up to supply it.
Your heart beats slower, so your lungs must work harder to pump blood.
Running shakes your lungs, making them release extra air automatically.
Your muscles produce oxygen during exercise, and breathing removes the extra.
explanation: When you run or play, you breathe faster because your body needs more oxygen.
fact_tl: Kapag tumatakbo o naglalaro ka, humihinga ka nang mas mabilis dahil kailangan ng katawan mo ng mas maraming oksiheno.
fact_bis: Kon ikaw modagan o magdula, moginhawa ka nga mas paspas kay ang imong lawas nagkinahanglan og mas daghang oksiheno.

q: What does an ocean trench actually look like?
options: A very long, narrow valley on the sea floor that has a bottom where animals can live
A round, bottomless hole that goes all the way through the Earth's crust
A wide flat plain on the ocean floor with no edges or walls
A circular pit caused by a meteorite crashing into the deep ocean
explanation: A trench is not a round bottomless hole — it is a very long, narrow valley on the sea floor, and it has a bottom where animals can live.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba ang trench ay parang bilog na butas na walang katapusan, pero hindi. Ito ay parang napakahaba at makitid na lambak sa ilalim ng dagat, na may sahig din na puwedeng tirhan ng mga hayop.
fact_bis: Maghunahuna ang uban nga ang trench sama sa lingin nga lungag nga walay kataposan, apan dili. Sama kini sa taas ug sigpit nga walog sa salog sa dagat, ug naa pa kini salog diin makapuyo ang mga hayop.

q: How can a thick layer of water hyacinth cause a fish kill?
options: When the plants die and rot, bacteria use up the oxygen in the water, and fish also need oxygen to survive.
The plants release poison into the water that is harmless to frogs but kills fish.
The thick mat of plants blocks the current, overheating the water until fish cook.
The roots of rotting water hyacinth release salt that makes the water too salty for fish.
explanation: When water hyacinth dies and rots, bacteria use up the dissolved oxygen breaking it down, causing the oxygen to drop sharply and many fish to die — a fish kill.
fact_tl: Kapag namatay at nabulok ang makapal na water hyacinth, ginagamit ng mga bakterya ang oxygen sa tubig para mabulok ito. Bumababa nang husto ang oxygen, at dahil kailangan din ng isda ang oxygen para huminga, puwede silang mamatay nang sabay-sabay—ito ang tinatawag na fish kill.
fact_bis: Kung mamatay ug madunot ang baga nga water hyacinth, gamiton sa bakterya ang oxygen sa tubig aron kini madunot. Mokunhod pag-ayo ang oxygen, ug tungod kay ang isda nagkinahanglan usab og oxygen aron makaginhawa, daghan ang mahimong mamatay dungan—gitawag kini nga fish kill.

q: If an organism has two different alleles for the same trait, such as one dominant and one recessive, what is it called?
options: Heterozygous
Homozygous dominant
Homozygous recessive
Codominant
explanation: When the two alleles for a trait are different (for example Bb), the organism is called heterozygous.
fact_tl: Kung magkapareho ang dalawang allele ng isang katangian (halimbawa BB o bb), ito ay tinatawag na homozygous; kung magkaiba naman ang dalawang allele (halimbawa Bb), ito ay heterozygous.
fact_bis: Kon managsama ang duha ka allele sa usa ka kinaiya (pananglitan BB o bb), gitawag kini nga homozygous; kon magkalahi ang duha ka allele (pananglitan Bb), kini heterozygous.

q: In what year did humans first fly freely in a hot air balloon?
explanation: Humans first flew freely in a hot air balloon in the year 1783.
fact_tl: Unang lumipad nang malaya ang mga tao sakay ng hot air balloon noong taong 1783.
fact_bis: Ang mga tao unang milupad nga gawasnon sakay sa hot air balloon niadtong tuig 1783.

q: What makes soft drinks fizzy?
options: Carbon dioxide gas that is dissolved in the drink and escapes as bubbles when you open the container
Tiny sugar crystals that dissolve quickly and produce gas as they break down
Air that is pumped into the can under high pressure before it is sealed
Water vapor trapped inside during the bottling process at the factory
explanation: Soft drinks have carbon dioxide gas dissolved in them, which escapes as bubbles when the container is opened.
fact_tl: Ang softdrink ay may natunaw na gas na carbon dioxide; lumalabas ito bilang bula kapag binuksan ang lalagyan.
fact_bis: Ang softdrink adunay natunaw nga gas nga carbon dioxide; mogawas kini isip bula kung ablihan ang sudlanan.

q: Why can canned food stay safe to eat for years?
options: It is heated strongly to kill germs, then the can is sealed so no new bacteria or air can get in.
It is packed with large amounts of salt and sugar that preserve the food naturally.
It is frozen inside the can, keeping bacteria from growing in the cold temperature.
It is treated with vinegar, which makes the environment too sour for bacteria to survive.
explanation: Canned food lasts for years because it is heated strongly to kill germs, then sealed so no new bacteria or air can enter.
fact_tl: Tumatagal ng maraming taon ang de-latang pagkain dahil iniinit ito nang husto para mapatay ang mikrobyo, tapos selyado ang lata para walang bago pang bakterya o hanging makakapasok.
fact_bis: Ang de lata nga pagkaon molungtad og daghang tuig kay kini gipainit pag-ayo aron patyon ang mikrobyo, dayon gisarado ang lata aron walay bag-ong bakterya o hangin nga makasulod.

q: What does it mean when oxygen exists as O₂?
options: Two atoms of the same element are bonded together to form one molecule.
One oxygen atom has gained an extra electron and become negatively charged.
Two different elements have combined to form a new compound molecule.
One oxygen molecule has split into two separate atoms floating freely.
explanation: O₂ is a diatomic molecule in which two atoms of the same element — oxygen — are covalently bonded together.
fact_tl: Ang ilang elemento gaya ng oxygen ay umiiral bilang diatomic molecule (O₂), kung saan dalawang atomo ng parehong elemento ang covalent na nagbi-bond.
fact_bis: Ang ubang elemento sama sa oxygen naglungtad isip diatomic molecule (O₂), diin duha ka atomo sa samang elemento ang covalent nga nagbugkos.

q: Where do seeds form in a flowering plant?
options: Inside the flower
On the surface of the stem
Inside the roots
On the edges of leaves
explanation: Many plants reproduce by making seeds that form inside their flowers.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng buto na nabubuo sa loob ng kanilang bulaklak.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang magpadaghan pinaagi sa mga liso nga maporma sulod sa ilang mga bulak.

q: Where do farmers find the coffee beans used to make civet coffee?
options: Clumped together in civet droppings on the ground or branches
Stored inside the civet's cheek pouches
Hidden under the roots of coffee trees
Floating in the water near riverbanks
explanation: Farmers search the ground and branches for civet droppings where the coffee beans are found clumped together.
fact_tl: Hinahanap ng mga magsasaka ang dumi ng musang sa lupa o sanga kung saan nakakumpol ang mga buto ng kape.
fact_bis: Ang mga mag-uuma mangita sa hugaw sa musang sa yuta o sanga diin makit-an ang mga buto sa kape nga nagtapok.

q: When you look at the night sky without a telescope, where are almost all the stars you can see?
options: Inside our own Milky Way galaxy
In many different galaxies spread across space
In the nearest galaxy, Andromeda
In a star cluster just outside the Milky Way
explanation: Almost every star we can see at night with just our eyes is a star inside our own Milky Way galaxy, not in another galaxy.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ng bituing nakikita natin sa gabi gamit ang mata lamang ay mga bituing nasa loob ng ating sariling Milky Way galaxy, hindi sa ibang galaxy.
fact_bis: Halos tanang bituon nga atong makita sa gabii gamit ang mata lamang mga bituon nga naa sulod sa atong kaugalingong Milky Way nga galaksiya, dili sa ubang galaksiya.

q: What does the Philippine Department of Health provide for free to protect children from measles?
options: Vaccines against measles
Daily vitamin supplements
Antibiotic medicine
Special masks and face shields
explanation: In the Philippines, the Department of Health provides free vaccines against measles, a disease that once often killed children.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ipinapalibre ng Department of Health ang bakuna laban sa tigdas (measles) na dating malimit ikamatay ng mga bata.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, libreng gihatag sa Department of Health ang bakuna batok sa tipdas (measles), usa ka sakit nga kanhi kanunay makamatay sa mga bata.

q: Why is it easier to float in seawater than in a freshwater pool?
options: Seawater is denser than fresh water because of the dissolved salt
Seawater is warmer and pushes the body up more
Seawater has less oxygen so the body weighs less
Seawater moves in waves that help keep you up
explanation: Salty seawater is denser than fresh water, so it is easier for a person to float in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang tubig-alat sa dagat ay mas siksik kaysa tubig-tabang, kaya mas madaling lumutang ang tao sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tubig-asin sa dagat mas dasok kay sa tab-ang nga tubig, mao nga mas sayon molutaw ang tawo sa dagat.

q: What can you do with jackfruit seeds?
options: Boil or roast them and eat them like cassava or potato
Use them only as animal feed because they are too tough to eat
Grind them into a spice for cooking
Plant them only — they are poisonous if eaten
explanation: Jackfruit seeds can be eaten; when boiled or roasted, they taste a bit like cassava or potato.
fact_tl: Hindi lang ang dilaw na laman ang kinakain sa langka—pwede ring kainin ang buto! Kapag niluto o ininit, parang kamoteng-kahoy o patatas ang lasa nito.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang dilaw nga unod ang ginakaon sa nangka—mahimo usab kaonon ang liso! Kung lutoon o sugbaon, sama og lami sa kamoteng-kahoy o patatas.

q: Which of the following correctly lists the five groups of animals that have a backbone?
options: Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals
Fish, insects, reptiles, birds, and mammals
Fish, amphibians, crustaceans, birds, and mammals
Fish, amphibians, reptiles, spiders, and mammals
explanation: Animals with a backbone are divided into five groups: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na may gulugod ay nahahati sa limang pangkat: isda, amphibian, reptilya, ibon, at mammal.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap nga adunay gulugod gibahin sa lima ka grupo: isda, amphibian, reptilya, langgam, ug mammal.

q: Why does an elevator have a heavy counterweight on the other side of the cables?
options: It balances the load so the motor does not have to work as hard
It keeps the elevator from swinging side to side in the shaft
It stores extra electricity to power the motor
It slows the elevator down so it stops safely at each floor
explanation: A heavy counterweight on the other end of the cables balances the load so the motor works less hard.
fact_tl: Ang elevator ay hinihila pataas at pababa ng mga matitibay na kable na nakabalot sa isang motor, at may mabigat na counterweight sa kabilang dulo na nagpapagaan sa trabaho ng motor.
fact_bis: Ang elevator ginabira pataas ug paubos sa lig-on nga mga kable nga giputos sa usa ka motor, ug adunay bug-at nga counterweight sa pikas tumoy nga mobalanse sa karga aron mas gaan ang trabaho sa motor.

q: What body shape helps the flying fish move easily through both water and air?
options: A smooth, torpedo-shaped body
A flat, disc-like body
A long, ribbon-like body
A round, ball-like body
explanation: The flying fish has a smooth, torpedo-shaped body that lets it move easily through water and air.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng isdang lumilipad ay makinis at hugis-torpedo para madaling makausad sa tubig at hangin.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa isdang naglupad hapsay ug porma-torpedo aron sayon kini molihok sa tubig ug hangin.

q: Why does the Sun have a weaker effect on tides than the Moon, even though the Sun is much bigger?
options: The Sun is so far away that its gravitational pull on the oceans is weaker than the Moon's
The Sun's gravity pulls sideways, not toward the ocean surface
The Sun moves too fast for its gravity to affect the oceans steadily
The Sun only affects tides near the equator, not everywhere
explanation: Although the Sun is much bigger, it is so far away that its effect on tides is weaker than the Moon's.
fact_tl: Humihila rin ang gravity ng Araw sa tubig ng dagat, pero dahil napakalayo nito, mas mahina ang epekto nito sa tides kaysa sa buwan kahit napakalaki ng Araw.
fact_bis: Ang gravity sa Adlaw mobira usab sa tubig sa dagat, apan tungod kay layo kaayo ang Adlaw, mas huyang ang epekto niini sa tides kaysa bulan bisan og dako kaayo ang Adlaw.

q: What does the stomach produce to help break down food?
options: A strong acid
A thick mucus layer
Digestive enzymes only found in the mouth
Bile to dissolve fats
explanation: Our stomach makes a strong acid to help break down food.
fact_tl: Ang ating tiyan ay gumagawa ng malakas na asido para tunawin ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang atong tiyan maghimo og kusog nga asido aron tunawon ang pagkaon.

q: Why won't crystals form inside a tightly covered container of water?
options: The water cannot evaporate, so no crystals can form
The lid blocks the cold air needed to freeze the crystals
The pressure inside prevents the molecules from joining
The covering makes the water stay liquid and too warm
explanation: If the container is tightly covered, the water cannot evaporate, so no crystals can form.
fact_tl: Kapag may takip ang lalagyan, hindi makakasingaw ang tubig kaya hindi rin mabubuo ang mga kristal.
fact_bis: Kon tabonan og hugot ang sudlanan, dili makaalisngaw ang tubig busa walay kristal nga maporma.

q: Which direction does the brightest part of a lightning bolt actually travel?
options: Upward from the ground to the cloud
Downward from the cloud to the ground
Sideways between two clouds
In both directions at exactly the same time
explanation: Although lightning looks like it falls from the cloud, its brightest part actually shoots upward from the ground to the cloud in less than a blink.
fact_tl: Kahit mukhang bumabagsak ang kidlat mula sa ulap, ang pinakamaliwanag na bahagi nito ay sumasabog pataas mula sa lupa patungong ulap sa loob ng kaunti pa sa isang kisapmata, kaya tila biglang sumiklab ang buong daanan.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag nahulog ang kilat gikan sa panganod, ang labing hayag nga bahin niini sa tinuod misaka gikan sa yuta padulong sa panganod sa wala pa molabaw sa usa ka pamilok, busa morag kalit nga misiga ang tibuok agianan.

q: What must you add to a solid to make it melt into a liquid?
options: Heat
Pressure
Water
Air
explanation: To melt a solid, you must add heat so it can change into a liquid.
fact_tl: Para matunaw ang isang solido, kailangan itong bigyan ng init para magbago ang anyo nito.
fact_bis: Aron matunaw ang gahi nga butang, kinahanglan dugangan kini og kainit aron mausab ang porma niini.

q: About how many baby rats can a mother rat give birth to in one litter?
options: Six to twelve pups
One to three pups
Twenty to thirty pups
Two to four pups
explanation: A mother rat can give birth to about six to twelve pups in a single litter.
fact_tl: Ang isang inang daga ay maaaring manganak ng mga anim hanggang labindalawang anak sa isang pagsilang.
fact_bis: Ang inahan nga ilaga makahimo og anom hangtod dose ka anak sa usa ka pagpanganak.

q: What is the role of the queen in a social wasp colony?
options: She lays the eggs while the worker wasps build the nest and hunt
She guards the entrance to the nest against predators
She feeds all the larvae and teaches them to hunt
She produces wax that the workers use to build the nest cells
explanation: In social wasps, one queen lays the eggs while many worker wasps build the nest and hunt.
fact_tl: Sa mga panlipunang putakti, may isang reynang nangingitlog at maraming manggagawang nagtatayo ng pugad.
fact_bis: Sa mga sosyal nga putakti, adunay usa ka rayna nga mangitlog ug daghang trabahante nga magtukod sa salag.

q: What are Saturn's rings mostly made of?
options: Ice and small rocks
Dust and hot gas
Solid iron and nickel
Liquid water and sand
explanation: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice and small rocks.
fact_tl: Ang mga singsing ng Saturn ay gawa halos lahat sa yelo at maliliit na bato.
fact_bis: Ang mga singsing sa Saturn hinimo halos tanan sa yelo ug gagmay nga mga bato.

q: What is the part of a tooth that you can see above the gums called?
options: The crown
The root
The enamel cap
The pulp
explanation: A tooth has a crown that you can see and a root hidden in the gums.
fact_tl: Ang ngipin ay may korona na nakikita sa labas at ugat na nakabaon sa gilagid.
fact_bis: Ang ngipon adunay korona nga makita ug gamot nga nakatago sa lagus.

q: Which ocean zone is completely dark because no sunlight reaches it?
options: The midnight zone, below 1,000 meters
The twilight zone, between 200 and 1,000 meters
The euphotic zone, in the top 200 meters
The abyssal zone, just below the surface
explanation: The midnight zone (1,000 m and deeper) is completely dark; the twilight zone has little light, and the euphotic zone has enough light for photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang karagatan ay nahahati sa mga zone batay sa dami ng sikat ng araw na makakarating: ang euphotic zone (0-200m) ay may sapat na liwanag para sa photosynthesis; ang twilight zone (200-1000m) ay kakaunti ang liwanag; at ang midnight zone (1000m+) ay ganap na madilim.
fact_bis: Ang dagat nahilis ngadto sa mga zone base sa gidaghanon sa kahayag sa adlaw nga makaabut: ang euphotic zone (0-200m) adunay igo nga kahayag alang sa photosynthesis; ang twilight zone (200-1000m) adunay gamay nga kahayag; ang midnight zone (1000m+) hingpit nga ngitngit.

q: Why does a curved airplane wing produce lift?
options: Air moves faster over the curved top, lowering the pressure there and pushing the wing upward
Air is trapped under the flat bottom and pushed down, pushing the wing up
The wing tilts forward and deflects air backward, lifting the plane
The wing is heavier on the bottom so gravity pulls it down less strongly
explanation: An airplane wing is curved so air flows faster over the top, making the pressure on top lower and creating lift that pushes the wing upward.
fact_tl: Ang pakpak ng eroplano ay hubog para mas mabilis dumaloy ang hangin sa itaas kaysa sa ilalim. Ginagawa nitong mas mababa ang presyon sa itaas, kaya may lift na nagtutulak sa pakpak pataas.
fact_bis: Ang pako sa eroplano kurbado aron mas paspas modagayday ang hangin sa ibabaw kaysa sa ilawom. Niini mas ubos ang diin sa ibabaw, busa adunay lift nga motukmod sa pako pataas.

q: What does the continued discovery of new cloud rat species in the Philippines show?
options: The Philippines has very rich biodiversity that scientists are still exploring
Cloud rats breed extremely fast and fill new forests
The Philippine forests are growing rapidly into new habitats
Cloud rats are invasive species that spread quickly into new areas
explanation: Scientists continue to discover new cloud rat species in the forests of Luzon and Mindanao, demonstrating the depth of Philippine biodiversity.
fact_tl: Patuloy na natutuklasan ng mga siyentipiko ang bagong uri ng cloud rat sa mga kagubatan ng Luzon at Mindanao, na nagpapakita ng lalim ng biodibersidad ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Padayon ang mga siyentipiko sa pagdiskubre og bag-ong klase sa cloud rat sa mga kagubatan sa Luzon ug Mindanao, nagpakita sa kalawom sa biodibersidad sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the purpose of the ground pin in a Philippine three-pin electrical plug?
options: It safely carries stray current to earth to protect the user
It returns the electric current back to the power grid
It carries the 220 volts of electricity from the grid to the appliance
It controls how much electricity flows into the appliance
explanation: The ground pin safely carries stray current to earth to protect users, while the live pin carries 220 volts and the neutral pin returns current.
fact_tl: Ang tatlong pin ng Philippine plug ay: (1) live — nagdadala ng 220 volts mula sa grid; (2) neutral — nagbabalik ng kuryente; at (3) ground — nagdadala ng stray na kuryente sa lupa para sa kaligtasan.
fact_bis: Ang tulo ka pin sa Philippine plug mao: (1) live — nagdala sa 220 bolts gikan sa grid; (2) neutral — nagbalik sa kuryente; ug (3) ground — luwas nagdala sa stray nga kuryente sa yuta aron protektahan ang mga tiggamit.

q: How do you find the volume of a rectangular box?
options: Multiply its length by its width by its height
Add its length, width, and height together
Multiply its length by its height only
Multiply two of its sides and then divide by two
explanation: The volume of a rectangular box is found by multiplying its length, width, and height.
fact_tl: Ang bolyum ng kahong parihaba ay makukuha sa pagpaparami ng haba, lapad, at taas nito.
fact_bis: Ang volume sa usa ka kahon makit-an pinaagi sa pagpadaghan sa gitas-on, gilapdon, ug gihabogon niini.

q: What does the fur of some cloud rats look like?
options: Thick and soft, cream or pale gray with black or brown markings
Short and rough, bright orange with white stripes
Smooth and thin, solid dark brown with no markings
Coarse and bristly, jet black with white spots
explanation: Some cloud rats have thick, soft fur that is cream or pale gray with black or brown markings.
fact_tl: Ang ilang cloud rat ay may makapal at malambot na balahibong kulay-krema o abuhin na may mga itim na marka.
fact_bis: Ang ubang cloud rat adunay baga ug humok nga balhibo nga kolor-krema o luspad nga abuhon nga adunay itom nga timaan.

q: Which natural gas in the atmosphere has the strongest greenhouse effect on Earth?
options: Water vapour
Carbon dioxide
Methane
Oxygen
explanation: Water vapour is the most powerful natural greenhouse gas, and its concentration increases as Earth warms, amplifying the greenhouse effect.
fact_tl: Ang singaw ng tubig ay ang pinaka-makapangyarihang natural na greenhouse gas; tumataas ang halaga nito sa atmospera kapag mainit, nagpapalakas ng greenhouse effect bilang isang feedback mechanism.
fact_bis: Ang singaw sa tubig mao ang pinaka-gamhanan nga natural nga greenhouse gas; ang iyang konsentrasyon sa atmospera mosaka sa dihang ang Yuta mainit, nagpalakas sa greenhouse effect isip usa ka feedback mechanism.

q: What can happen to hair when ringworm infects the scalp?
options: The hair falls out and leaves a round bald patch
The hair turns white and becomes very brittle
The hair grows much faster than normal
The hair sticks together and forms hard clumps
explanation: When ringworm grows on the scalp, the hair can fall out and leave a round bald patch.
fact_tl: Kapag tinubuan ng ringworm ang anit, maaaring malagas ang buhok at mag-iwan ito ng bilog na patse na walang buhok.
fact_bis: Kung motubo ang ringworm sa anit, ang buhok mahimong mangahulog ug mobilin og lingin nga patse nga walay buhok.

q: Which small sea animal is famous for having one of the most powerful punches of any animal for its size?
options: The mantis shrimp
The electric eel
The puffer fish
The pistol shrimp
explanation: The mantis shrimp has one of the most powerful punches of any animal for its size, able to crack shells.
fact_tl: Ang mantis shrimp ay may pinakamalakas na suntok sa hayop kumpara sa laki nito—kaya nitong basagin ang kabibe.
fact_bis: Ang mantis shrimp adunay usa sa pinakakusgan nga sumbag sa mga hayop sumala sa gidak-on niini—makabuak kini ug kabhang.

q: What hormone does the body release from the adrenal glands when a person is stressed?
options: Cortisol
Insulin
Adrenaline only, not cortisol
Melatonin
explanation: When stressed, the body releases a hormone called cortisol from the adrenal glands, speeding up the heart and providing energy to face the stressor.
fact_tl: Kapag nag-iistress, ang katawan ay naglalabas ng hormone na tinatawag na cortisol mula sa adrenal glands, na nagpapabilis ng tibok ng puso at nagbibigay ng energy upang harapin ang stressor.
fact_bis: Kung naga-stress, ang lawas nagpagawas ug hormone nga gitawag cortisol gikan sa adrenal glands, nagpadali sa tibok sa puso ug naghatag ug energy aron maatubang ang stressor.

q: Why do we sneeze?
options: To blow out dust or irritating things that get into the nose
To push extra air from the lungs when we breathe too fast
To clear the throat when mucus drips down from the nose
To signal to the brain that we need to breathe more deeply
explanation: We sneeze to blow out dust or irritating things that get into the nose.
fact_tl: Bumabahing tayo para itulak palabas ang alikabok o iritante na pumapasok sa ilong.
fact_bis: Mobahing ta aron itulod pagawas ang abog o makahasol nga butang nga mosulod sa ilong.

q: Why is the energy pyramid wide at the bottom and narrow at the top?
options: Less and less energy is available at each higher level of the food chain
More organisms live near the top, so they need less space in the diagram
Producers are the smallest organisms and take up the least room at the base
Energy increases as it passes from one level to the next
explanation: The energy pyramid is wide at the bottom and narrow at the top because less and less energy is available at each higher level.
fact_tl: Ang pyramid ng enerhiya ay malapad sa ibaba at makitid sa itaas dahil paunti nang paunti ang enerhiya habang paakyat sa bawat antas.
fact_bis: Ang pyramid sa enerhiya halapad sa ubos ug haligot sa taas kay mokunhod ang enerhiya samtang mosaka sa matag lebel.

q: What is the circular flow of air formed when hot air rises and cold air sinks called?
options: A convection current
A conduction wave
A radiation loop
A compression cycle
explanation: When hot air keeps rising and cold air keeps sinking, it forms a circular flow called a convection current that carries heat from the warm part to the cold part.
fact_tl: Kapag tuluy-tuloy na umaakyat ang mainit na hangin at bumababa ang malamig na hangin, nabubuo ang isang paikot na daloy na tinatawag na convection current. Dinadala nito ang init mula sa mainit na bahagi papunta sa malamig na bahagi.
fact_bis: Kung padayon nga mosaka ang init nga hangin ug mokunsad ang bugnaw nga hangin, mahimo ang usa ka paliyok nga agos nga gitawag og convection current. Gidala niini ang kainit gikan sa init nga bahin ngadto sa bugnaw nga bahin.

q: Why are oil and coal called nonrenewable energy sources?
options: They formed over millions of years and cannot be replaced quickly once used up
They can only be found in certain countries and cannot be shared
They release no energy when burned so they waste more than they provide
They are so deeply buried that they cannot be safely removed from the ground
explanation: Oil and coal are fossil fuels that formed over millions of years, so they run out and cannot be replaced quickly.
fact_tl: Ang langis at karbon ay fossil fuels na nabuo sa loob ng milyon-milyong taon kaya nauubos at hindi agad napapalitan.
fact_bis: Ang lana ug karbon mga fossil fuel nga naporma sulod sa milyon-milyon ka tuig, busa mahurot ug dili dali mapulihan.

q: What is the main purpose of the nectar produced by a flower's nectary?
options: To attract pollinators like bees and butterflies that carry pollen between flowers
To feed the growing seeds inside the flower's ovary
To protect the flower from insects that might eat the petals
To make the flower smell unpleasant so only certain animals come near
explanation: The nectary produces nectar to attract pollinators like bees and butterflies that will carry pollen from flower to flower.
fact_tl: Ang nectary ay isang espesyal na glandula sa loob ng bulaklak na gumagawa ng nectar—isang matamis na likido—para akitin ang mga pollinator tulad ng bubuyog at mariposa na makapagdala ng pollen.
fact_bis: Ang nectary usa ka espesyal nga glandula sa sulod sa bulaklak nga nagmugna og nectar—usa ka tam-is nga likido—aron madani ang mga pollinator sama sa putyukan ug mariposa nga magdala og pollen.

q: What type of fault is the Marikina Valley Fault System?
options: A right-lateral strike-slip fault
A reverse thrust fault
A normal extensional fault
A subduction zone fault
explanation: The Marikina Valley Fault System is a right-lateral strike-slip fault located in Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang Marikina Valley Fault System ay isang right-lateral strike-slip fault sa Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Marikina Valley Fault System usa ka right-lateral strike-slip fault sa Luzon.

q: Why do many Philippine farmers tie their goats to a stake or tree near grass?
options: So the goats can eat fresh grass without wandering off or damaging crops
So the goats stay cool under the shade of the tree
So the goats are easy to find and milk each morning
So the goats do not fight with one another in the open field
explanation: In many Philippine farms, goats are tied to a stake or tree near a grassy spot so they can eat fresh grass without wandering off or damaging crops.
fact_tl: Sa maraming bukirin sa Pilipinas, itinatali ang kambing sa isang patpat o puno sa tabi ng damuhan para makakain ito ng sariwang damo nang hindi naliligaw o nakakasira ng pananim.
fact_bis: Sa daghang uma sa Pilipinas, gihigot ang kanding sa usa ka kahoy o ugsok duol sa sagbutan aron makakaon kini og lab-as nga sagbot nga dili mahisalaag o makadaot sa mga tanom.

q: What are kaong, and how are they commonly used in Filipino desserts?
options: Soft, jelly-like seeds of the sugar palm boiled in syrup and used as a topping in halo-halo
Hard nuts from the coconut palm soaked in brine and served as a salty snack
Crunchy seeds of the nipa palm fried in oil and sprinkled on rice cakes
Dried fruits of the buri palm pressed into sweet discs and eaten plain
explanation: Kaong are the soft, jelly-like seeds of the sugar palm tree, boiled in syrup and used as a sweet topping in desserts like halo-halo.
fact_tl: Ang kaong ay malalambot at malilinaw na buto ng palmang tinatawag na sugar palm, na pinakukuluan sa arnibal at ginagawang pamatamis sa mga panghimagas tulad ng halo-halo.
fact_bis: Ang kaong mao ang humok ug mola nga liso sa palmang sugar palm, nga ginalat-an sa dugos ug ginagamit nga tam-is nga sangkap sa halo-halo.

q: How big is a blue whale's heart compared to everyday objects?
options: About the size of a small car
About the size of a basketball
About the size of a school desk
About the size of a refrigerator
explanation: The blue whale is so huge that its heart is about the size of a small car, and the whole animal can weigh over 150 metric tons.
fact_tl: Napakalaki ng blue whale na ang puso nito ay kasinglaki ng isang maliit na kotse, at kayang tumimbang ang buong hayop ng higit 150 toneladang metriko — kasimbigat ng mahigit 25 na elepante.
fact_bis: Hilabihan ka dako sa blue whale nga ang kasingkasing niini sama kadako sa usa ka gamay nga sakyanan, ug ang tibuok hayop makatimbang og kapin sa 150 ka metriko nga tonelada — kasimbug-at sa kapin sa 25 ka elepante.

q: How is composting connected to the nutrient cycle?
options: Dead plants break down into compost that becomes food for new plants
Composting destroys nutrients so they do not re-enter the soil
Compost only helps animals, not plants, because it adds protein to the soil
Composting creates new nutrients from sunlight and water in the soil
explanation: Composting is part of the nutrient cycle, where dead plants become food for new ones.
fact_tl: Ang pag-compost ay bahagi ng siklo ng sustansya, kung saan ang patay na halaman ay nagiging pagkain ng bago.
fact_bis: Ang pag-compost kabahin sa siklo sa sustansya, diin ang patay nga tanom mahimong pagkaon sa bag-o.

q: What actually causes schistosomiasis in a person?
options: A tiny flatworm parasite called a blood fluke that the snail carries
The snail itself biting the person and injecting venom
Drinking contaminated water that contains snail eggs
A bacteria that lives inside the snail's shell and spreads through touch
explanation: Schistosomiasis is caused by a tiny flatworm parasite called a blood fluke; the snail only carries it, and once inside a person, the worm lives in blood vessels near the intestines or bladder.
fact_tl: Ang schistosomiasis ay hindi galing sa suso mismo, kundi sa napakaliit na uod na tinatawag na blood fluke o Schistosoma. Ang suso ay tagadala lang nito. Kapag nakapasok ang uod sa katawan ng tao, doon ito nakatira sa loob ng mga ugat malapit sa bituka o pantog.
fact_bis: Ang schistosomiasis dili gikan mismo sa kuhol, kondili sa gamay kaayo nga ulod nga gitawag og blood fluke o Schistosoma. Ang kuhol tigdala lang niini. Kon makasulod ang ulod sa lawas sa tawo, magpuyo kini sulod sa mga ugat duol sa tinai o pantog.

q: Why does the Earth's mantle stay mostly solid even though it is extremely hot?
options: The huge pressure from the rock above raises the temperature needed to melt it
The mantle is made of a special type of iron that cannot melt at those temperatures
The heat escapes quickly through cracks so the rock never gets hot enough to melt
The mantle is cooled constantly by groundwater flowing through it
explanation: Even though the mantle is extremely hot, it stays mostly solid because the huge pressure from the rock above raises the temperature needed to melt the rock.
fact_tl: Kahit napakainit ng mantle, halos hindi ito natutunaw dahil sa sobrang presyon mula sa bigat ng bato sa ibabaw — ang presyon ay nagpapataas ng temperaturang kailangan para matunaw ang bato.
fact_bis: Bisan init kaayo ang mantle, halos dili kini matunaw tungod sa grabe nga presyon gikan sa kabug-at sa bato sa ibabaw — ang presyon nagpataas sa temperatura nga gikinahanglan aron matunaw ang bato.

q: Besides generating electricity, what other useful things can the lake behind a dam provide?
options: Water for drinking and farming, and flood control downstream
Habitats for ocean fish and coral reefs
A source of crude oil that can be refined nearby
Wind that powers turbines built along the dam's wall
explanation: Besides electricity, the lake behind a dam also stores water for drinking and farming and helps hold back floods downstream.
fact_tl: Bukod sa kuryente, ang lawa ng tubig sa likod ng dam ay nag-iimbak din ng tubig na maaaring inumin, gamitin sa patubig, at tumutulong na pigilan ang baha sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kuryente, ang linaw sa tubig sa luyo sa dam nagtipig usab og tubig nga mainom, magamit sa patubig, ug makatabang pagpugong sa baha sa ubos.

q: What makes a rainforest different from other habitats on land?
options: It has the greatest variety of plants and animals of any land habitat because it rains very often
It is the driest habitat on land, which forces animals to develop special survival skills
It is covered in snow for most of the year, protecting animals from predators
It only contains plants and no animal species because the rain washes food away
explanation: A rainforest is a thick forest where it rains very often, and it is the habitat of the greatest variety of plants and animals on land.
fact_tl: Ang rainforest ay napakasalimuot na gubat na umuulan nang madalas, at ito ang tirahan ng pinakamaraming uri ng halaman at hayop sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang rainforest usa ka baga kaayo nga lasang nga kanunayng ulanon, ug mao kini ang puluy-anan sa pinakadaghang matang sa tanom ug mananap sa yuta.

q: What is special about some of the fruit bat species found in the Philippines?
options: They are endemic, meaning they are found nowhere else in the world
They are the largest bats in Asia and can carry fruit weighing over a kilogram
They are the only bats in the world that can see in full color
They migrate every year from Australia to the Philippines to find food
explanation: The Philippines is home to many kinds of fruit bats, including some endemic species found nowhere else in the world.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng paniki ang matatagpuan sa Pilipinas, kasama ang ilang endemiko na hindi makikita sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Daghang klase sa kabog ang makaplagan sa Pilipinas, lakip ang pipila ka endemiko nga dili makita sa laing nasod.

q: When an orchid grows on a tree's branch to reach sunlight but does not take the tree's nutrients, what kind of relationship is this?
options: Commensalism
Mutualism
Parasitism
Predation
explanation: Some orchids grow on a tree's branch to reach sunlight without taking the tree's nutrients, making it commensalism — one organism benefits and the other is unaffected.
fact_tl: Ang ilang orkidya ay tumutubo sa sanga ng puno para maabot ang sikat ng araw, ngunit hindi nito kinukuha ang sustansiya ng puno — kaya komensalismo ito.
fact_bis: Ang ubang orkid motubo sa sanga sa kahoy aron maabot ang silaw sa adlaw, apan dili niini kuhaon ang sustansiya sa kahoy — busa komensalismo kini.

q: How does a sunbird drink nectar from a flower?
options: It uses its long, tube-like tongue to suck up the nectar
It pecks a hole in the flower base and laps the nectar with a flat tongue
It dips its beak into the flower and tips its head back to let the nectar drip in
It uses its feet to squeeze the flower petals until nectar drips out
explanation: The sunbird has a long, tube-like tongue that it uses to suck up nectar from inside a flower.
fact_tl: Ang sunbird ay may mahaba at parang tubong dila na ginagamit nito para sumipsip ng nektar mula sa loob ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang sunbird adunay taas ug morag tubo nga dila nga gamiton niini sa pagsuyop og nektar gikan sa sulod sa bulak.

q: What is the becquerel (Bq) used to measure, and who is it named after?
options: Radioactivity, named after Henri Becquerel
Electrical resistance, named after Henri Becquerel
Sound intensity, named after Henri Becquerel
Magnetic field strength, named after Henri Becquerel
explanation: The becquerel (Bq) is the unit of radioactivity and is named after Henri Becquerel.
fact_tl: Ang becquerel (Bq), ang yunit ng radyoaktibidad, ay ipinangalan kay Henri Becquerel.
fact_bis: Ang becquerel (Bq), ang yunit sa radyoaktibidad, ginganlan kay Henri Becquerel.

q: At what temperature does liquid nitrogen boil and turn into gas?
options: -196 degrees Celsius
0 degrees Celsius
-50 degrees Celsius
-273 degrees Celsius
explanation: Nitrogen boils at -196 degrees Celsius; liquid nitrogen is used to freeze things very cold.
fact_tl: Ang nitrogen ay kumukulo sa -196 degrees Celsius; ginagamit ang likidong nitrogen para magpalamig.
fact_bis: Ang nitrogen mubukal sa -196 degrees Celsius; ang likidong nitrogen gigamit sa pagpabugnaw.

q: What must a cell do before it divides by mitosis?
options: Copy all of its DNA
Split its nucleus into two halves
Absorb extra nutrients from nearby cells
Double the size of its cell membrane
explanation: Before a cell divides, it first copies all of its DNA so each new cell gets a complete set.
fact_tl: Bago maghati ang selula, kinokopya muna nito ang lahat ng DNA nito.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa mabahin ang selula, kopyahon una niini ang tanang DNA niini.

q: Why is a convex lens used in a magnifying glass?
options: It makes objects look larger
It bends light rays away from each other
It blocks harmful ultraviolet rays
It reflects light like a mirror
explanation: A convex lens magnifies objects, which is exactly why it is used in a magnifying glass.
fact_tl: Ang convex na lente ay nagpapalaki ng tingin sa bagay, kaya ito ginagamit sa magnifying glass.
fact_bis: Ang convex nga lente magpadako sa panan-aw sa butang, mao nga gigamit kini sa magnifying glass.

q: What does a baby coral larva do before it can start a new colony?
options: It swims until it finds a hard, clean surface to attach to
It sinks to the deepest part of the ocean and waits
It attaches to a fish and rides it to warmer water
It immediately splits into two polyps without moving
explanation: A coral larva swims and drifts until it finds a hard, clean surface, where it attaches and becomes the first polyp of a new colony.
fact_tl: Ang bagong coral ay nagsisimula bilang maliit na larva na lumalangoy at lumulutang sa tubig; kapag nakakita ito ng matigas at malinis na bato na madadikitan, dumidikit ito at nagiging unang polyp na pagsisimulan ng buong bagong kolonya.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong coral magsugod isip gamay nga larva nga molangoy ug molutaw sa tubig; kung makakita kini og gahi ug limpyo nga bato nga katapotan, motapot kini ug mahimong unang polyp nga magsugod sa tibuok bag-ong kolonya.

q: What happens to soil on a mountain slope when all the trees are cut down?
options: Soil erodes easily and flooding becomes more likely
The soil becomes richer because it gets more sunlight
New grass grows fast and holds the soil firmly
Rainwater soaks in more deeply and prevents floods
explanation: Tree roots hold soil in place, so when forests are removed, soil erodes and flooding and landslides become more likely on mountain slopes.
fact_tl: Kapag natanggal ang kagubatan, nawala ang mga ugat ng mga puno na nagtatago ng lupa; resulta nito ay ang pagkasaid ng lupa (erosion), pagbaha, at pagguho ng lupa lalo na sa mga bundok.
fact_bis: Kung makuha ang kagubatan, nawala ang mga gamot sa mga kahoy nga nagbitik sa yuta; ang resulta mao ang soil erosion, baha, ug landslide labi na sa mga kabukiran.

q: Which city is known as the 'City of Smiles' and is the center of the sugar trade in the Philippines?
options: Bacolod
Iloilo
Cebu
Dumaguete
explanation: Bacolod is the main city of Negros Occidental, the center of the sugar trade, and is called the 'City of Smiles.'
fact_tl: Ang Bacolod ang pangunahing lungsod ng Negros Occidental at sentro ng kalakalan ng asukal. Tinatawag pa nga itong 'City of Smiles.' Dito rin ginaganap ang sikat na MassKara Festival na nagpapakita ng masayang kultura ng mga taga-Negros.
fact_bis: Ang Bacolod mao ang nag-unang siyudad sa Negros Occidental ug sentro sa pamaligya og asukal. Gitawag pa gani kini nga 'City of Smiles.' Dinhi usab ginahimo ang ilado nga MassKara Festival nga nagpakita sa malipayong kultura sa mga taga-Negros.

q: Aside from roofing, what else are nipa leaves used for?
options: Walls and wrappers for traditional cigarettes
Medicine and cooking oil
Rope and clothing material
Baskets and fish traps
explanation: Nipa leaves are used not only for roofing but also for walls and as wrappers for traditional cigarettes.
fact_tl: Maliban sa atip, ang mga dahon ng nipa ay ginagamit din bilang dingding at pambalot ng katutubong sigarilyo.
fact_bis: Gawas sa atop, ang mga dahon sa nipa gigamit usab isip bungbong ug igbabalot sa lumad nga sigarilyo.

q: An orb-web spider builds its web in two layers. What is the purpose of the sticky spiral threads?
options: To catch flying insects
To anchor the web to branches
To let the spider walk without getting stuck
To signal danger to other spiders
explanation: Orb-web spiders add sticky spiral threads specifically to trap flying insects, while the non-sticky radial threads provide structure.
fact_tl: Ang orb-web spider ay gumagawa ng circular at spiral na tela—una itong nagtatayo ng mga radyal na sinulid para sa estruktura, pagkatapos ay nagdaragdag ng malagkit na espiral para mahuli ang mga insekto.
fact_bis: Ang orb-web spider nagbuhat og bilog ug spiral nga telang-gagamba—una nagpadayon og dili malagkit nga radyal nga sinulid para sa istruktura, dayon nagdugang og malagkit nga spiral para madakop ang mga insekto.

q: How do Filipino scientists use radiation to help farmers grow better rice?
options: They expose seeds to radiation to create mutations, then select plants with useful traits
They spray radiation on fields to kill weeds before planting
They use radiation to sterilize the soil so rice grows faster
They irradiate harvested grain to keep it fresh longer
explanation: In mutation breeding, scientists apply radiation to seeds to create new mutations and then select plants that are sturdier, ripen faster, or resist pests.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang mutation para makabuo ng mas magagandang uri ng palay. Sa pamamagitan ng maingat na paggamit ng radiation sa mga buto, nakakalikha sila ng mga bagong mutation, at pinipili nila ang mga halaman na mas matibay, mas mabilis mag-ani, o kayang labanan ang peste. Tinatawag itong mutation breeding at tumutulong ito sa ating mga magsasaka.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga siyentista mogamit sa mutation aron makahimo og mas maayong matang sa humay. Pinaagi sa maampingong paggamit og radiation sa mga liso, makahimo sila og bag-ong mutation, dayon pilion nila ang mga tanom nga mas lig-on, mas paspas mohinog, o makasukol sa peste. Gitawag kini nga mutation breeding ug makatabang sa atong mga mag-uuma.

q: How do your cells get the energy they need to work?
options: They combine oxygen with food to release energy
They absorb sunlight and convert it to energy
They break down carbon dioxide using heat from blood
They store energy from water and release it when needed
explanation: In cellular respiration, cells combine oxygen with food to release the energy they need to function.
fact_tl: Sa cellular respiration, pinagsasama ng selula ang oxygen at pagkain upang makakuha ng enerhiyang gagamitin nito.
fact_bis: Sa cellular respiration, ginahiusa sa selula ang oxygen ug pagkaon aron makakuha sa kusog nga gamiton niini.

q: What happens to light rays when they pass through a convex lens?
options: They are brought together to a single point
They spread outward in all directions
They bounce straight back to their source
They travel parallel and never meet
explanation: A convex lens is thicker in the middle and brings light rays together to converge at a single point.
fact_tl: Ang umbok (convex) na lente ay mas makapal sa gitna at pinagsasama-sama ang mga sinag ng ilaw sa isang punto.
fact_bis: Ang convex nga lente baga sa tunga ug nagtipon sa mga silaw sa kahayag ngadto sa usa ka punto.

q: What did Darwin realize after observing how people choose which animals reproduce?
options: Nature can also select traits through natural selection
Only domestic animals can develop new traits over time
Breeding always makes animals weaker over generations
Wild animals evolve only when humans help them
explanation: Darwin saw that if people can strengthen traits by choosing which animals reproduce (artificial selection), then nature can do the same through natural selection.
fact_tl: Sa selective breeding (artificial selection), ang tao ang pumipili kung aling hayop o halaman ang pagpaparamihin para mapalakas ang gustong katangian; napansin ni Darwin na kung magagawa ito ng tao, ang kalikasan din ay maaaring pumili — ito ang natural selection.
fact_bis: Sa selective breeding (artificial selection), ang tawo ang nagpili kon unsang hayop o tanom ang ipaparami aron palig-onon ang gusto nga kinaiya; namatikdan ni Darwin nga kon mabuhat kini sa tawo, ang kinaiyahan usab makapili — kini mao ang natural selection.

q: Where in the Philippines can lichens commonly be found growing?
options: Clinging to tree bark in forests and parks
Floating on the surface of rivers and lakes
Buried in the soil under thick leaf litter
Growing only on rocky mountaintops above the clouds
explanation: In the Philippines, lichens can be seen clinging to tree bark in forests and parks.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, makikita ang mga lichen na nakadikit sa balat ng mga puno sa mga gubat at parke.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, makita ang mga lichen nga nagpilit sa panit sa mga kahoy sa kalasangan ug parke.

q: When is the cloud rat most active?
options: At night
Early in the morning
During the middle of the day
At sunset only
explanation: The cloud rat is nocturnal — it is active at night and usually sleeps or hides during the day.
fact_tl: Ang cloud rat ay aktibo sa gabi at karaniwang natutulog o nagtatago sa araw.
fact_bis: Ang cloud rat aktibo sa gabii ug kasagaran matulog o motago sa adlaw.

q: What do the leaves of the abaca plant look like?
options: Large, long leaves similar to banana leaves
Small, round leaves like a water lily
Thin, needle-like leaves like a pine tree
Heart-shaped leaves with serrated edges
explanation: Abaca has large, long leaves that look like banana leaves.
fact_tl: Ang abaka ay may malalaki at mahahabang dahon na kahawig ng dahon ng saging.
fact_bis: Ang abaka adunay dagko ug taas nga mga dahon nga sama sa dahon sa saging.

q: Why is a pomelo heavier to hold than an orange or calamansi?
options: It is large and has a thick rind
It is filled with water like a coconut
Its seeds are made of dense bone-like material
It absorbs more minerals from the soil than other fruits
explanation: A pomelo is large and has a thick rind, making it heavy to hold compared to smaller fruits like oranges or calamansi.
fact_tl: Dahil malaki at makapal ang balat nito, ang suha ay mabigat hawakan kumpara sa ibang prutas tulad ng dalandan o kalamansi. Parang may bitbit kang bola.
fact_bis: Tungod kay dako ug baga ang panit niini, ang suha bug-at gunitan kompara sa ubang prutas sama sa kahel o kalamansi. Morag nagkupot ka og bola.

q: At what temperature does liquid nitrogen boil?
options: -196 degrees Celsius
0 degrees Celsius
-100 degrees Celsius
-273 degrees Celsius
explanation: Liquid nitrogen boils at an extremely cold -196 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang liquid nitrogen (likidong nitroheno) ay kumukulo sa napakalamig na -196 degrees Celsius (-196°C).
fact_bis: Ang liquid nitrogen (likidong nitroheno) mobukal sa hilabihan kabugnaw nga -196 degrees Celsius (-196°C).

q: How was the Agusan Valley formed over a very long time?
options: The constant flow of a river slowly carved and shaped the land
A massive earthquake split the earth open in one event
Volcanic eruptions deposited layers of rock that sank over time
Glaciers melted and washed soil away during an ice age
explanation: Over thousands of years, the constant flow of a river slowly dug into and shaped the land, gradually forming the Agusan Valley.
fact_tl: Sa napakahabang panahon, ang patuloy na pag-agos ng tubig ng ilog ay unti-unting humuhukay at humuhubog sa lupa. Ganito unti-unting nabuo ang Lambak ng Agusan—hindi ito naganap sa isang araw kundi sa loob ng libu-libong taon.
fact_bis: Sa taas kaayong panahon, ang padayong pagdagayday sa tubig sa suba hinay-hinay nga magkalot ug maghulma sa yuta. Ingon niini hinay-hinay nga naporma ang Walog sa Agusan—dili kini nahitabo sa usa ka adlaw kondili sulod sa liboan ka tuig.

q: What does a snail do when it is too hot and dry outside?
options: It seals the opening of its shell and rests until it is wet again
It buries itself in the ground and sheds its shell
It searches for shade and drinks dew from leaves
It moves quickly to find a river or pond to cool down
explanation: When conditions are too hot or dry, some snails seal the opening of their shell and rest until moisture returns.
fact_tl: Kapag masyadong mainit o tuyo, tinatakpan ng ilang kuhol ang bukana ng shell at nagpapahinga hanggang bumasa muli.
fact_bis: Kon init kaayo o mala, taklupan sa pipila ka kuhol ang baba sa kabhang ug mopahulay hangtod mabasa pag-usab.

q: How does a pyrometer measure the temperature of something like molten lava without touching it?
options: It reads the light emitted by the hot object
It measures how fast heat travels through the air around it
It uses sound waves that change speed with temperature
It detects changes in the magnetic field near the heat source
explanation: A pyrometer measures very high temperatures from the light emitted by hot objects, allowing safe measurement from a distance.
fact_tl: Ang pyrometer ay isang thermometer na sumusukat ng napakataas na temperatura mula sa liwanag na inilalabas ng mainit na bagay — ginagamit ito sa mga pabrika ng bakal at para sukatin ang temperatura ng magma.
fact_bis: Ang pyrometer usa ka thermometer nga nagsukod sa napataas nga temperatura gikan sa suga nga ginhawa sa mainit nga mga butang — gigamit sa mga pabrika sa bakal ug sa pagbanabana sa temperatura sa magma.

q: Why do some animals store food before winter?
options: Food is hard to find in cold seasons
They want to share it with other animals later
They store food because they grow tired of eating fresh food
Stored food tastes better after it gets cold
explanation: Animals store food because during cold winter seasons food becomes scarce and hard to find.
fact_tl: Nag-iimbak ng pagkain ang mga hayop dahil may mga panahong mahirap makahanap ng pagkain, gaya ng taglamig.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap nagatipig og pagkaon kay naa'y mga panahon nga lisod mangita og pagkaon, sama sa bugnaw nga tingtugnaw.

q: Why is the Visayan spotted deer endangered?
options: It has lost most of its forest habitat
It has been over-hunted for its spots
It cannot reproduce in the wild
It is outcompeted by larger imported deer species
explanation: The Visayan spotted deer is endangered because of forest loss, making it one of the rarest deer in the world.
fact_tl: Ang usang batik-batik ay isa sa pinakabihirang usa sa mundo at nanganganib mawala dahil sa pagkasira ng kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang Visayan spotted deer usa sa pinakatalagsa nga usa sa kalibutan ug nameligro tungod sa pagkaguba sa kalasangan.

q: What causes an earthquake according to the theory of plate tectonics?
options: Plates suddenly slip or push against each other, releasing stored energy
Hot magma pushes up through cracks in the ocean floor
Large underground rivers collapse and cause the ground to shake
Heavy rain soaks deep into the earth and loosens rock layers
explanation: When tectonic plates suddenly slip or push against each other, the stored energy is released as an earthquake.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang gumagalaw o nagdiin ang mga plaka, lumalabas ang naipong enerhiya bilang lindol.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga molihok o magdinuotay ang mga plate, ang natipon nga enerhiya mogawas isip linog.

q: Why do sea cucumbers need to be protected from over-harvesting?
options: So they do not run out and can keep cleaning the sea
Because they are poisonous and must not enter the food chain
Their shells are needed to build coral reefs
They eat harmful algae that would otherwise kill fish
explanation: Sea cucumbers are over-harvested and must be protected so they do not disappear and can continue cleaning the sea.
fact_tl: Dahil sobra ang panghuhuli ng balat, kailangan itong alagaan para hindi maubos at patuloy nitong malinis ang dagat.
fact_bis: Tungod kay sobra na ang pagpangdakop sa balatan, kinahanglan kining ampingan aron dili mahurot ug makapadayon sa paglimpyo sa dagat.

q: Why does the colugo need tall trees to survive?
options: It needs height to glide far before it has to land
It builds nests only at the very tops of tall trees
Tall trees produce the only fruit the colugo eats
It hangs upside down to sleep and needs the extra space
explanation: The colugo needs tall trees so it can start high enough to glide far before landing, making tall forests essential to its survival.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng colugo ng matataas na puno para makalutang nang maayos. Habang mas mataas ang sisimulan nito, mas malayo ang kaya nitong tawirin bago dumapo, kaya importanteng manatiling buo ang matataas na puno sa gubat.
fact_bis: Nagkinahanglan ang colugo ug taas nga mga kahoy aron makalupad-lupad ug maayo. Kon mas habog ang sugdanan niini, mas layo ang matabok niini sa dili pa modapo, busa importante nga magpabilin ang taas nga mga kahoy sa lasang.

q: Who invented the phonograph, the first machine that could record and play back sound?
options: Thomas Edison
Alexander Graham Bell
Nikola Tesla
Guglielmo Marconi
explanation: Thomas Edison invented the phonograph, the first machine capable of recording and playing back sound.
fact_tl: Si Thomas Edison ang nag-imbento ng phonograph, ang unang makina na nakapag-record at nakapagpatugtog ng tunog.
fact_bis: Si Thomas Edison ang nag-imbento sa phonograph, ang unang makina nga makarekord ug makapatugtog og tingog.

q: What makes landslides and soil erosion worse in Philippine mountain areas?
options: Deforestation combined with heavy rains and typhoons
Construction of new roads through flat lowland areas
Over-farming of rice paddies in valley floors
Rising sea levels pushing water into mountain rivers
explanation: Landslides and soil erosion are common in mountainous Philippine areas during heavy rains and typhoons, and deforestation makes this danger worse.
fact_tl: Ang mga guho (landslide) at pagguho ng lupa ay karaniwan sa mga bulubunduking lugar ng Pilipinas lalo na sa panahon ng malakas na ulan at bagyo; ang pagkasira ng kagubatan ay nagpapalala ng panganib na ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga guho (landslide) ug pagguho sa yuta komon sa mga bulubundok nga lugar sa Pilipinas labi na sa panahon sa kusog nga ulan ug bagyo; ang pagkaguba sa kagubatan nagpasamot niining peligro.

q: What is bagasse, and how is it made in a sugarcane factory?
options: The wet fiber left after rollers crush and squeeze the juice from cane
The dark brown syrup collected before sugar crystals form
A fine white powder that settles after the cane juice cools
The green leaves removed from the cane before it enters the mill
explanation: In the factory, heavy rollers crush sugarcane to squeeze out the juice, and the wet fiber left behind is called bagasse.
fact_tl: Sa pabrika, ipinapasa ang tubo sa mabibigat na rolyo o gilingan na dumudurog at pumipiga rito. Lumalabas ang katas, at ang naiiwang basang hibla ang tinatawag na bagasse.
fact_bis: Sa pabrika, giagi ang tubo sa bug-at nga mga rolyo o galingan nga modugmok ug mopuga niini. Mogawas ang duga, ug ang nahibiling basa nga lanot mao ang gitawag nga bagasse.

q: What is a galaxy?
options: A huge group of stars, gas, dust, and dark matter held together by gravity
A single very large star surrounded by many planets
A cloud of gas in space that slowly cools into a new planet
A cluster of moons orbiting the same planet
explanation: A galaxy is a huge group of stars, gas, dust, and dark matter held together by gravity.
fact_tl: Ang galaksiya ay napakalaking pangkat ng mga bituin, gas, alikabok, at dark matter na pinagsasama ng grabidad.
fact_bis: Ang galaksiya usa ka dako kaayo nga pundok sa mga bitoon, gas, abog, ug dark matter nga gihiusa sa grabidad.

q: What makes an area of land a wetland?
options: It stays wet or is covered by shallow water most of the time
It is flooded only once a year during the rainy season
Its soil is made entirely of sand that absorbs water quickly
It is land that dried out after a river changed its course
explanation: A wetland is land that stays wet or is covered by shallow water most of the time.
fact_tl: Ang wetland o latian ay lupa na palaging basa o natatakpan ng mababaw na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang wetland o lamakan usa ka yuta nga kanunay basa o gitabunan og mabaw nga tubig.

q: Why is an electron microscope needed to see a virus?
options: It uses electrons instead of light to image objects smaller than one micrometer
It has a lens 1,000 times thicker than a regular microscope
It cools the sample to make it large enough to see with light
It uses laser beams that can penetrate living cells without harming them
explanation: An electron microscope uses electrons instead of light, allowing it to image objects as small as viruses and large molecules.
fact_tl: Ang electron microscope ay gumagamit ng mga elektron imbes na liwanag upang makita ang mga bagay na mas maliit kaysa isang micrometer — ito ang ginagamit upang makita ang mga virus at malalaking macromolecule.
fact_bis: Ang electron microscope mogamit og mga elektron imbes nga kahayag aron makita ang mga butang mas gamay kaysa usa ka micrometer — mao kini ang gigamit aron makita ang mga virus ug dagkong macromolecule.

q: What is a constellation?
options: A group of stars that forms a pattern or shape in the sky
A single very bright star near the center of the galaxy
A cloud of gas that glows because a star is forming inside it
A planet that reflects enough sunlight to look like a star
explanation: A constellation is a group of stars that forms a recognizable pattern or shape when viewed in the sky.
fact_tl: Ang konstelasyon ay isang grupo ng mga bituin na bumubuo ng isang pattern o hugis kapag tinitingnan sa langit.
fact_bis: Ang konstelasyon usa ka pundok sa mga bituon nga nagahimo ug usa ka pattern o porma kung tan-awon sa langit.

q: Which of the following is TRUE about metals and magnets?
options: Some metals like iron are attracted to magnets, but not all metals are magnetic
All metals are attracted to magnets equally
No metal is naturally magnetic — only electromagnets can attract metal
A metal must be very shiny to be attracted to a magnet
