explanation: Some metals like iron are attracted to magnets, but not all metals are magnetic — for example, gold and copper are not.
fact_tl: Ang ilang metal tulad ng bakal ay nadadagit ng magnet, ngunit hindi lahat ng metal.
fact_bis: Ang ubang metal sama sa puthaw madani sa magnet, apan dili tanang metal magnetiko.

q: How can a dog learn commands and tricks?
options: Through consistent training by people
By watching videos of other dogs performing tricks
By living in a large pack with older dogs
By instinct alone — dogs are born knowing commands
explanation: Dogs are smart and can learn commands and tricks when they are trained well by people.
fact_tl: Matalino ang aso at kaya nitong matuto ng mga utos at trick kapag sinanay nang mabuti.
fact_bis: Ang iro maalamon ug makakat-on og mga mando ug trick kung maayong gibansay.

q: About how much of the air is made up of carbon dioxide?
options: About 0.04%
About 21%
About 4%
About 78%
explanation: Carbon dioxide is only a tiny trace gas in the air, making up about 0.04% of the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang carbon dioxide ay napakakaunti lang sa hangin, mga 0.04% lamang.
fact_bis: Ang carbon dioxide gamay ra kaayo sa hangin, mga 0.04% lamang.

q: How are apes like gorillas and chimpanzees different from monkeys?
options: Apes have no tail
Apes have shorter arms than monkeys
Apes can only live in cold climates
Apes have four legs while monkeys have two
explanation: Apes like gorillas and chimpanzees have no tail, which is a key difference from monkeys.
fact_tl: Ang mga ape tulad ng gorilya at chimpanzee ay walang buntot, kaya iba sila sa mga unggoy.
fact_bis: Ang mga ape sama sa gorilya ug chimpanzee walay ikog, mao nga lahi sila sa mga unggoy.

q: How does soap remove grease and dirt from your hands?
options: One end of the soap molecule clings to water and the other end clings to oil, so water rinses the dirt away
Soap dissolves dirt by making it evaporate into the air
Soap hardens the oil so it falls off your skin in flakes
The heat from rubbing your hands melts the grease and soap absorbs it
explanation: Soap molecules have one end that clings to water and another that clings to oil, lifting grease and dirt so water can rinse it away.
fact_tl: Ang sabon ay may mga molekula na ang isang dulo ay kumakapit sa tubig at ang kabilang dulo ay kumakapit sa langis. Kaya nahihila ng sabon ang mantika at dumi palayo sa balat o pinggan, at natatangay ng tubig kapag binanlawan.
fact_bis: Ang sabon adunay mga molekula nga ang usa ka tumoy mokupot sa tubig ug ang pikas tumoy mokupot sa lana. Maong makuha sa sabon ang mantika ug hugaw gikan sa panit o plato, ug mabanlasan kini sa tubig.

q: What is fog, and how is it related to clouds?
options: Fog is a cloud that forms right at ground level
Fog is steam that rises from warm ground into cold air
Fog is a layer of dust that blocks sunlight near the ground
Fog is frozen rain that hangs in the air before falling
explanation: Fog is really a cloud that forms right at the ground, so walking through fog feels like walking inside a cloud.
fact_tl: Ang ambon o fog ay isang ulap na bumababa hanggang sa lupa kaya parang nasa loob ka ng ulap.
fact_bis: Ang gabon usa ka panganod nga naporma sa yuta, mao nga morag naglakaw ka sulod sa panganod.

q: How many days are there in a regular (non-leap) year?
options: 365 days
360 days
364 days
366 days
explanation: There are 365 days in one regular year, and 366 days in a leap year.
fact_tl: May 365 araw sa isang taon (366 sa leap year).
fact_bis: Adunay 365 ka adlaw sa usa ka tuig (366 sa leap year).

q: What is the key difference between an electromagnet and a permanent magnet?
options: An electromagnet is only magnetic when electricity flows through it
An electromagnet is stronger than any permanent magnet
A permanent magnet can be switched on and off like an electromagnet
A permanent magnet only works with iron, while an electromagnet works with any metal
explanation: Unlike a permanent magnet that is always magnetic, an electromagnet is only magnetic when electricity flows through it.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng permanenteng magnet na laging magnetiko, ang elektromagnet ay magnetiko lamang kapag may kuryente.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa permanenteng magnet nga kanunayng magnetiko, ang elektromagnet magnetiko lang kung naay kuryente.

q: Which of the following is an example of NATURAL vegetative propagation?
options: A strawberry plant sending out runners to grow new plants
A farmer taking cuttings from a rose bush to plant elsewhere
A gardener grafting one type of mango onto a different rootstock
A scientist growing banana plants from tissue samples in a lab
explanation: Some vegetative propagation is natural, done by the plant itself — like runners or suckers — while grafting and cuttings are done by people.
fact_tl: May likas na vegetative propagation na ginagawa mismo ng halaman (gaya ng runner o supang), at may artificial na ginagawa ng tao gaya ng grafting at cutting.
fact_bis: Adunay natural nga vegetative propagation nga buhaton mismo sa tanom (sama sa runner o saha), ug adunay artificial nga buhaton sa tawo sama sa grafting ug cutting.

q: When you look at the inside (bowl) of a shiny spoon, how does your reflection appear?
options: Upside down
Right-side up but smaller
Right-side up and the same size
Upside down and very large
explanation: The inside of a shiny spoon acts like a concave curved mirror, making your face appear upside down.
fact_tl: Ang makintab na kutsara ay parang kurbang salamin: sa loob na bahagi (palukong), baliktad ang mukha mo; sa likod (palabas), tuwid pero mas maliit — subukan mong tingnan!
fact_bis: Ang makintab nga kutsara murag kurba nga salamin: sa sulod nga bahin (lukong), baliskad ang imong nawong; sa luyo (luson), tul-id apan mas gamay — sulayi pagtan-aw!

q: How do bees help us have fruits and vegetables to eat?
options: They carry pollen between flowers while collecting nectar, allowing fruits and vegetables to form
They eat harmful insects that would otherwise destroy crops
They dig tunnels in the soil that help plant roots get more water
They produce a wax that farmers spread on soil to keep it moist
explanation: While bees look for nectar, they carry pollen between flowers, which allows many fruits and vegetables to form — without bees, we would have much less food.
fact_tl: Habang naghahanap ng nektar, dinadala ng bubuyog ang pollen sa pagitan ng mga bulaklak, kaya nakakabunga ang maraming prutas at gulay — kung wala sila, mas kaunti ang pagkain natin.
fact_bis: Samtang nangita og nektar, ang putyukan magdala og pollen tali sa mga bulak, mao nga makabunga ang daghang prutas ug utanon — kung wala sila, mas gamay ta og pagkaon.

q: A frog goes through metamorphosis, changing from a tadpole to a four-legged adult. What does this make a frog?
options: An amphibian, not an insect
An insect, because insects are the only animals that metamorphose
A reptile, because it has a backbone
A mammal, because it breathes air as an adult
explanation: A frog undergoes metamorphosis, but it is an amphibian — not an insect — even though insects also go through metamorphosis.
fact_tl: Ang palaka ay dumaraan din sa metamorphosis mula ulo-ulo (tadpole) tungo sa hayop na may apat na paa, ngunit ito ay hindi insekto.
fact_bis: Ang baki moagi usab sa metamorphosis gikan sa ulo-ulo (tadpole) ngadto sa hayop nga upat ang tiil, apan ang baki dili insekto.

q: How does the bird's nest fern get nutrients while growing on a tree?
options: It catches falling leaves and twigs, which rot and provide nutrients
It sends long roots down into the soil far below the tree
It absorbs nutrients directly from the bark of the tree it clings to
It traps insects in pools of water that collect in its leaves
explanation: The bird's nest fern catches falling leaves and twigs; as these rot, they become nutrients for the fern.
fact_tl: Ang ilang epiphytic na pako, tulad ng bird's nest fern, ay humuhuli ng nalalaglag na dahon at sanga. Kapag nabubulok ang mga ito, nagiging sustansya para sa pako.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka epiphytic nga pako, sama sa bird's nest fern, mosalo sa nangahulog nga dahon ug sanga. Kung madunot kini, mahimo kining sustansya para sa pako.

q: Why can a duck see in almost all directions at the same time?
options: Its eyes are on the sides of its head
Its eyes can rotate completely inside its head
It has a wider field of vision than any other bird
It has extra eyelids that act as mirrors
explanation: A duck's eyes are positioned on the sides of its head, so it can see nearly all around itself without turning.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng bibe ay nasa gilid ng ulo kaya halos lahat ng paligid nito ay nakikita niya.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa bibe naa sa kilid sa ulo mao nga halos tanan nga palibot makita niini.

q: When white light passes through a prism, which color bends the most?
options: Violet
Red
Yellow
Green
explanation: When white light passes through a prism, different colours refract by different amounts — violet bends the most and red bends the least.
fact_tl: Sa pagdaan ng puting liwanag sa prisma, ang iba't ibang kulay ay nagbabaluktot ng iba't ibang halaga — ang violet ay pinaka-nabaluktot at ang pula ay pinaka-kaunting nabaluktot.
fact_bis: Kung ang puting suga moagi sa prisma, ang lain-laing kolor nagabalog og lain-laing sukod — ang violet pinaka-nabalog ug ang pula pinaka-diyutay ang pagbalog.

q: How are the particles arranged inside a grain of table salt (NaCl)?
options: In a repeating pattern called a crystal lattice
In separate NaCl molecules floating freely
In random clusters with no fixed pattern
In long chains of atoms linked end to end
explanation: In table salt, sodium and chloride ions are arranged in a repeating pattern called a crystal lattice, not in separate molecules.
fact_tl: Sa table salt (NaCl), ang mga sodium at chloride ion ay nakaayos sa paulit-ulit na pattern na tinatawag na crystal lattice, hindi sa hiwalay na mga molekula.
fact_bis: Sa table salt (NaCl), ang mga sodium ug chloride ion gihan-ay sa balikbalik nga pattern nga gitawag ug crystal lattice, dili sa bulag nga mga molekula.

q: Why should you avoid using a corded phone or showering during a thunderstorm?
options: Lightning can travel through metal pipes and electrical wires into your home
The sound of thunder can travel through the phone and damage your hearing
Water from the shower attracts lightning through the roof
Corded phones boost the electrical signal of lightning bolts nearby
explanation: Lightning can travel through pipes and wires, so using corded phones or showering during a thunderstorm puts you at risk even indoors.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng bahay, iwasan ang corded na telepono at ang paliligo dahil maaaring dumaan ang kidlat sa mga tubo at kable.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa balay, likayi ang corded nga telepono ug ang pagligo kay ang kilat mahimong moagi sa mga tubo ug alambre.

q: What is the chemical formula for carbon dioxide?
options: CO2
CO
C2O
O2C
explanation: The chemical formula for carbon dioxide is CO2, representing one carbon atom bonded to two oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Ang kemikal na pormula ng carbon dioxide ay CO2 — isang carbon at dalawang oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang chemical formula sa carbon dioxide mao ang CO2 — usa ka carbon ug duha ka oxygen.

q: Why do lizards and snakes survive well in hot, dry deserts?
options: Their thick scaly skin keeps water from escaping their bodies
They can drink salt water, which is found underground in deserts
They absorb all the water they need directly from sunlight
They hibernate for most of the year and avoid the heat completely
explanation: Reptiles like lizards and snakes thrive in deserts because their thick scaly skin prevents water loss in the hot, dry environment.
fact_tl: Mabuti ang buhay ng mga reptilya tulad ng butiki at ahas sa disyerto dahil ang makapal nilang balat ay pumipigil sa pagkawala ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga reptilya sama sa tiki ug bitin maayo mabuhi sa desyerto kay ang ilang baga nga panit makapugong sa pagkawala sa tubig.

q: Which scientist is the unit of pressure, the pascal (Pa), named after?
options: Isaac Newton
Blaise Pascal
Galileo Galilei
Albert Einstein
explanation: The pascal (Pa), the unit of pressure, is named after Blaise Pascal.
fact_tl: Ang pascal (Pa), ang yunit ng presyon, ay ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal.
fact_bis: Ang pascal (Pa), ang yunit sa presyon o diin, ginganlan kay Blaise Pascal.

q: Why can taking antibiotics sometimes cause diarrhea as a side effect?
options: Antibiotics make the stomach produce too much acid
Antibiotics can kill beneficial gut bacteria along with the harmful ones
Antibiotics cause the body to absorb too much water
Antibiotics slow down the movement of food through the intestines
explanation: Antibiotics kill not only harmful bacteria but can also kill beneficial gut bacteria, upsetting the microbiome balance and causing diarrhea.
fact_tl: Ang antibiotics ay hindi lamang pumapatay ng masasamang bacteria — maaari rin nilang pumatay ng mga mabuting bacteria sa bituka, na nagdudulot ng pagtatae at iba pang side effects habang ang microbiome ay nagpapanumbalik.
fact_bis: Ang antibiotics dili lang nagpamatay sa mga masasamang bakterya — mahimong makapatay usab sila sa mga maayong bakterya sa tinai, nagpahinabog pagtatae ug uban pang side effects samtang nagbawi ang microbiome.

q: In the metric system, the prefix "mega" stands for which number?
explanation: The prefix "mega" means 1,000,000 (one million).
fact_tl: Ang unlaping "mega" ay nangangahulugang 1,000,000 (isang milyon).
fact_bis: Ang prefix nga "mega" nagpasabot og 1,000,000 (usa ka milyon).

q: What do we call a very large region of land that has its own climate and characteristic plants and animals, like a desert or rainforest?
options: Ecosystem
Habitat
Biome
Community
explanation: A biome is a very large region with a particular climate and characteristic plants and animals, such as desert, rainforest, and tundra.
fact_tl: Ang biome ay isang napakalawak na rehiyon na may partikular na klima at uri ng halaman at hayop, tulad ng disyerto, rainforest, at tundra.
fact_bis: Ang biome mao ang lapad kaayong rehiyon nga adunay piho nga klima ug kinaiya nga mga tanom ug hayop, sama sa disyerto, rainforest, ug tundra.

q: About what fraction of all land species on Earth are found in tropical rainforests?
options: About one quarter
About one third
About half
About three quarters
explanation: Even though rainforests cover only a small area, about half of all land species on Earth are found in them.
fact_tl: Ang mga tropical rainforest ang tahanan ng pinakamaraming uri ng halaman at hayop sa buong kalupaan ng mundo, kahit maliit lang ang sakop nila — kalahati ng lahat ng species sa lupa ay matatagpuan dito.
fact_bis: Ang tropical rainforest mao ang puy-anan sa labing daghang matang sa tanom ug hayop sa tanang kayutaan sa kalibutan, bisan og gamay ra ang ilang gisakopan — mga katunga sa tanang species sa yuta makit-an dinhi.

q: Compared to its relatives the squid and octopus, how does the nautilus swim?
options: Faster, because it has a hard shell for protection
At the same speed, since they are equally related
More slowly, because it is not built for speed
Much faster, because it uses jet propulsion better
explanation: The nautilus is a slow swimmer compared to its fast relatives, the squid and octopus.
fact_tl: Mabagal lumangoy ang nautilus kumpara sa mabibilis nitong kamag-anak na pusit at pugita.
fact_bis: Hinay molangoy ang nautilus kompara sa paspas niini nga mga paryente nga nukos ug kugita.

q: How does an airbag protect a passenger during a car crash?
options: It absorbs all the kinetic energy so the passenger feels nothing
It makes the car stop faster so the impact is over sooner
It lengthens the time it takes for the body to stop, making the force gentler
It pushes the passenger away from the steering wheel before impact
explanation: An airbag lengthens the time it takes a body to stop in a crash, so the force on the passenger becomes gentler.
fact_tl: Ang airbag ay nagpapahaba sa oras ng paghinto ng katawan sa banggaan, kaya humihina ang puwersang tumatama sa pasahero.
fact_bis: Ang airbag nagpalugway sa oras nga mohunong ang lawas sa banggaan, mao nga mohuyang ang puwersa nga moigo sa pasahero.

q: What happens to land when plants are removed and heavy rain falls?
options: The rain adds nutrients and makes the soil richer
The rain compacts the soil and makes it harder to erode
The rain can wash away the fertile topsoil, making the land less rich
The rain fills the soil with water, helping future plant growth
explanation: When no plants hold the soil, heavy rain can wash away the fertile topsoil, causing the land to lose its richness.
fact_tl: Kapag walang halamang humahawak sa lupa, ang malakas na ulan ay maaaring umanod sa matabang topsoil, kaya nawawala ang taba nito.
fact_bis: Kung walay tanom nga mokupot sa yuta, ang kusog nga ulan makaanod sa tambok nga topsoil, mao nga mawad-an kini sa katambok.

q: Which fruits are peeled by hand before eating their soft flesh?
options: Mango and papaya
Lanzones and rambutan
Banana and pineapple
Guava and star apple
explanation: Lanzones and rambutan are peeled by hand before eating their soft flesh.
fact_tl: Ang lanzones at rambutan ay binabalatan gamit ang kamay bago kainin ang malambot na laman.
fact_bis: Ang lanzones ug rambutan panitan gamit ang kamot una kan-on ang humok nga unod.

q: What does each galaxy in the universe contain?
options: A single solar system with a few dozen planets
Millions of comets orbiting one central black hole
Many billions of stars
Thousands of planets with moons
explanation: The universe contains many billions of galaxies, and each galaxy itself contains many billions of stars.
fact_tl: Ang sansinukob ay naglalaman ng bilyon-bilyong galaxy, at ang bawat galaxy ay may bilyon-bilyon ding bituin.
fact_bis: Ang uniberso adunay bilyon-bilyon ka galaxy, ug ang matag galaxy adunay bilyon-bilyon usab ka bituon.

q: What determines which female bee larva grows up to become the queen?
options: Being the first egg laid by the current queen
Being the largest larva in the hive
Being fed special "royal jelly" instead of regular food
Being kept in the warmest cell in the honeycomb
explanation: Female bee larvae start out the same, but the one fed special 'royal jelly' grows up to become the queen.
fact_tl: Magkapareho ang mga babaeng uod ng bubuyog sa simula, pero ang isang pinakakain ng espesyal na 'royal jelly' ay lumalaki at nagiging reyna — ang pagkain ang nagpasiya kung sino ang magiging reyna.
fact_bis: Managsama ang mga babaye nga ulod sa putyukan sa sinugdan, apan ang usa nga pakan-on og espesyal nga 'royal jelly' modako ug mahimong reyna — ang pagkaon ang modesisyon kung kinsa ang mahimong reyna.

q: What happens to light when it passes through a concave lens?
options: It bends toward a single focal point, making objects look larger
It travels straight through without changing direction
It splits into the colors of the rainbow
It spreads apart, making objects look smaller
explanation: A concave lens is thinner in the middle and spreads light apart, so it makes an object look smaller.
fact_tl: Ang concave na lens ay mas manipis sa gitna at pinapakalat nito ang liwanag, kaya pinaliliit nito ang tingin sa bagay.
fact_bis: Ang concave nga lente mas nipis sa tunga ug gipakatag niini ang kahayag, mao nga gipagamay niini ang panan-aw sa butang.

q: What tool would you use to see micro-organisms living in a drop of pond water?
options: A magnifying glass
A telescope
A microscope
A periscope
explanation: A microscope magnifies tiny objects hundreds of times, which lets us see the micro-organisms in pond water.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang mikroskopyo para palakihin ang anyo ng maliliit na bagay nang daan-daang beses, kaya nakikita natin ang mga mikroorganismo sa tubig-lawa.
fact_bis: Gigamit ang mikroskopyo aron padakuon ang dagway sa gagmay nga mga butang og gatusan ka pilo, mao nga makita nato ang mga mikroorganismo sa tubig-danaw.

q: What creates the force that pushes blood through your blood vessels?
options: The lungs expanding and contracting with each breath
The muscles squeezing the arteries as you move
The heart squeezing and creating pressure with each beat
Gravity pulling blood down from the heart
explanation: Each time the heart squeezes, it creates pressure that pushes blood through the narrow vessels — this is what blood pressure measures.
fact_tl: Tuwing pumipi ang puso, lumilikha ito ng presyon na siyang nagtutulak sa dugo sa makikitid na ugat. Ito ang 'blood pressure' na sinusukat ng doktor.
fact_bis: Matag puga sa kasingkasing, magmugna kini ug presyon nga moduso sa dugo agi sa pig-ot nga mga ugat. Mao kini ang 'blood pressure' nga gisukod sa doktor.

q: Which river flows through Paris, the capital of France?
options: The Thames
The Rhine
The Loire
The Seine
explanation: The river that runs through Paris, capital of France, is the Seine.
fact_tl: Ang ilog na dumadaloy sa Paris, kabisera ng Pransya, ay ang Seine.
fact_bis: Ang suba nga moagi sa Paris, kapital sa Pransya, mao ang Seine.

q: How does sulfur dioxide from factories contribute to acid rain?
options: It blocks sunlight, causing clouds to become colder and more acidic
It reacts with oxygen in the air to form solid sulfur particles that fall as acid
It dissolves in rainwater to form sulfuric acid, which falls as acid rain
It rises into the upper atmosphere and breaks down water molecules
explanation: Sulfur dioxide released by factories dissolves in rainwater to form sulfuric acid, which is a major cause of acid rain.
fact_tl: Ang sulfur dioxide (SO2) na inilalabas ng mga pabrika at planta ng kuryente ay natutunaw sa ulan para gumawa ng sulfuric acid — ito ang pangunahing sanhi ng acid rain na nagbibigay ng pinsala sa mga halaman at gusali.
fact_bis: Ang sulfur dioxide (SO2) nga gipagawas sa mga pabrika ug power plant natunaw sa ulan aron makahimo og sulfuric acid; kini usa ka panguna nga sanhi sa acid rain nga nakapasakit sa mga kagubatan, lanaw, ug gusali.

q: What does the term "half-life" describe in science?
options: The total time it takes for a radioactive material to fully decay
The time it takes for half of a radioactive material to decay
The energy released when half a radioactive atom splits
The age of a fossil after half its carbon has been replaced by minerals
explanation: A half-life is the time it takes for half of a radioactive material to decay.
fact_tl: Ang half-life ay ang oras na kailangan para mabulok ang kalahati ng isang radyaktibong materyal.
fact_bis: Ang half-life mao ang panahon nga gikinahanglan aron mabulok ang katunga sa usa ka radyaktibong materyal.

q: How do most fossils form?
options: Organisms are frozen in ice and preserved for millions of years
Organisms are burned and their ash hardens into rock
Organisms are quickly buried by sediment that slowly hardens into rock
Organisms fall into deep ocean trenches where pressure preserves them
explanation: Fossils usually form when the remains of an organism are quickly buried by sediment, and over time the sediment hardens into rock that preserves its shape.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nabubuo ang fossil kapag ang labi ng organismo ay mabilis na natatabunan ng sediment, at sa paglipas ng panahon ay nagiging bato (sedimentary rock) na nagpapanatili ng hugis o bakas nito.
fact_bis: Ang fossil kasagarang maporma kung ang salin sa organismo paspas nga matabunan sa sediment, ug sa paglabay sa panahon mahimo kining bato nga magtipig sa porma o timaan niini.

q: In a rainbow, which color is on the outer top edge?
options: Violet
Yellow
Blue
Red
explanation: In a rainbow, red is on the outer top edge and violet is on the inner bottom edge.
fact_tl: Sa bahaghari, ang pula ang nasa pinakatuktok (labas) at ang lila ang nasa pinakailalim.
fact_bis: Sa bangaw, ang pula anaa sa kinatas-an (gawas) ug ang lila anaa sa kinaubsan (sulod).

q: What is Brigada Eskwela in the Philippines?
options: A yearly sports competition held between public schools before classes begin
A government program giving free school supplies to grade-school pupils
A yearly event where parents, teachers, and residents work together to clean and fix the school before classes open
A summer reading camp run by the Department of Education in every barangay
explanation: Brigada Eskwela is a yearly Philippine event where parents, teachers, and residents work together to clean and repair the school before classes open.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang Brigada Eskwela ang taunang gawain kung saan ang mga magulang, guro, at residente ay nagtutulungan para linisin at ayusin ang paaralan bago magbukas ng klase.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang Brigada Eskwela mao ang tinuig nga buluhaton diin ang mga ginikanan, magtutudlo, ug residente magtinabangay sa paglimpyo ug pag-ayo sa eskwelahan sa dili pa magbukas ang klase.

q: Which branch of the Philippine government interprets the laws and decides court cases?
options: The Executive branch
The Legislative branch
The Judicial branch
The Electoral branch
explanation: The Judicial branch (the courts) interprets the laws and decides cases in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang sangay na Hudikatura (ang mga hukuman) ang nagbibigay-kahulugan at humahatol sa mga batas.
fact_bis: Ang sanga nga Hudikatura (ang mga hukmanan) maoy naghubad ug naghukom sa mga balaod.

q: In what year did Mount Pinatubo erupt very powerfully?
explanation: Mount Pinatubo erupted very powerfully in the year 1991.
fact_tl: Sumabog nang napakalakas ang Bulkang Pinatubo noong taong 1991.
fact_bis: Mibuto nga kusog kaayo ang Bulkang Pinatubo niadtong tuig 1991.

q: How do Philippine scientists track the migration routes of sea turtles?
options: They paint numbers on the shells and report sightings from fishing boats
They release tagged turtles near nesting beaches and count how many return
They attach satellite tags to the turtles and follow their journeys electronically
They collect DNA samples and match turtles found in different oceans
explanation: Scientists in the Philippines attach satellite tags to sea turtles to track their migration routes across the Pacific.
fact_tl: Ang mga siyentipiko sa Pilipinas ay nag-attach ng mga satellite tag sa mga pawikan (sea turtle) upang masubaybayan ang kanilang mga ruta ng paglalakbay sa Pacific — ang datos mula sa mga ito ay nagpapakita ng napakalayong paglalakbay ng mga sea turtle sa pagitan ng mga feeding at nesting area.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentipiko sa Pilipinas nagdugtong og mga satellite tag sa mga pawikan aron masubay ang ilang mga ruta sa pag-migrate sa Pacific — ang datos gikan niini nagpakita sa mga pawikan nga nagbuhat og kataw-anan nga haba nga mga byahe tali sa mga feeding ug nesting area.

q: What effect does the dense canopy of a rainforest have on the layers below it?
options: It makes the lower layers hotter because the canopy traps heat
It makes the lower layers windier because it directs air downward
It makes the lower layers calmer, shadier, and more sheltered
It blocks all moisture so the forest floor stays completely dry
explanation: The dense canopy catches most of the rain and sun, so the layers below are calmer, shadier, and more sheltered.
fact_tl: Ang siksik na canopy ay nagsasalo ng karamihan ng ulan at araw, kaya mas tahimik, malilim, at protektado ang mga patong sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga canopy nagasalo sa kadaghanan sa ulan ug adlaw, busa mas malinaw, malandong, ug napanalipdan ang mga patong sa ubos.

q: Why is light kept limited inside tourist caves that have stalactites?
options: Bright light causes the cave to heat up and crack the rock formations
Too much light makes the cave unsafe for bats that live inside
Too much light encourages algae growth that stains the formations green
Bright light scares away the insects that live inside the cave
explanation: Too much light grows green algae that stains the cave formations, so light is kept limited in tourist caves.
fact_tl: Pinapanatiling madilim at maingat ang mga kwebang may stalactite dahil ang sobrang ilaw ay nagpapalago ng berdeng lumot na dumudumi sa mga pormasyon, kaya kontrolado lang ang ilaw sa mga turistang kweba.
fact_bis: Ang mga langob nga adunay stalactite ginapabilin nga ngitngit ug ginabantayan kay ang sobra nga kahayag mopatubo og berde nga lumot nga mohugaw sa mga pormasyon, mao nga kontrolado lang ang suga sa mga langob nga giadtoan sa turista.

q: What is the main job of a tree's bark?
options: To carry water and nutrients from the roots to the leaves
To make food for the tree through photosynthesis
To protect the inside of the tree from heat, insects, and injury
To absorb carbon dioxide directly from the air
explanation: The bark is like armor that protects the inside of the tree from heat, insects, and injury.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng puno ay parang baluti na nagpoprotekta sa loob nito mula sa init, insekto, at pinsala.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa kahoy sama sa taming nga nagapanalipod sa sulod niini gikan sa init, insekto, ug kadaot.

q: What is the simplest way to make an electromagnet at home?
options: Rub a nail with a magnet repeatedly until it becomes permanently magnetic
Wrap wire around a nail and connect the wire ends to a battery
Place a nail inside a coil of wire without any power source
Freeze a steel nail inside water to align its magnetic domains
explanation: You can make a simple electromagnet by wrapping wire around a nail and connecting it to a battery.
fact_tl: Makakagawa ka ng simpleng elektromagnet sa pamamagitan ng pag-ikot ng kawad sa isang pako at pagdurugtong nito sa baterya.
fact_bis: Makahimo ka ug yano nga elektromagnet pinaagi sa paglukot ug kawad palibot sa lansang ug pagsumpay niini sa baterya.

q: Which group of animals is the ONLY one that has feathers?
options: Bats
Insects
Fish
Birds
explanation: Birds are the only animals with feathers, and most of them can fly using wings.
fact_tl: Ang mga ibon ay tanging hayop na may balahibo, at karamihan sa kanila ay nakakalipad gamit ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang mga langgam mao ra ang mga hayop nga adunay balhibo, ug kadaghanan kanila makalupad gamit ang pako.

q: What is Gregorio Zara best known as in science?
options: A Filipino botanist who classified hundreds of Philippine plant species
A Filipino astronomer who discovered a comet near the Philippines
A Filipino physicist who created many inventions
A Filipino chemist who developed medicines from local plants
explanation: Gregorio Zara was a Filipino physicist who created many inventions, not just the videophone.
fact_tl: Si Gregorio Zara ay isang Pilipinong pisiko (physicist) na maraming imbensyon, hindi lamang ang videophone.
fact_bis: Si Gregorio Zara usa ka Pilipinong pisiko (physicist) nga adunay daghang imbensyon, dili lang ang videophone.

q: At approximately what temperature on the Kelvin scale does water freeze?
options: 0 K
explanation: In Kelvin, water freezes at about 273 Kelvin (273 K).
fact_tl: Sa Kelvin, ang tubig ay nagyeyelo sa mga 273 Kelvin (273 K).
fact_bis: Sa Kelvin, ang tubig mo-yelo sa mga 273 Kelvin (273 K).

q: In what year was the word "cell" first used to describe what scientists saw under a microscope?
explanation: The "cell" was first named in 1665, in Robert Hooke's book Micrographia.
fact_tl: Unang ipinangalan ang "cell" noong 1665, sa aklat ni Robert Hooke na Micrographia.
fact_bis: Ang "cell" unang gihinganlan niadtong 1665, sa libro ni Robert Hooke nga Micrographia.

q: What is one main reason many animals become endangered?
options: They are unable to reproduce fast enough in the wild
They are all hunted by the same predators
Their forests or homes are destroyed, so they lose shelter and food
They compete with too many other species for the same resources
explanation: When forests are cut down or animal homes are destroyed, animals lose their shelter and food, so many become endangered.
fact_tl: Kapag pinuputol ang mga kagubatan o sinisira ang mga tirahan ng hayop, nawawalan sila ng matitirhan at pagkain, kaya marami ang nagiging endangered.
fact_bis: Kung putlon ang mga kalasangan o gub-on ang puy-anan sa mga hayop, mawad-an sila og pasilonganan ug pagkaon, maong daghan ang mahimong endangered.

q: What keeps the ball from popping out of the socket in a ball-and-socket joint?
options: Cartilage that cushions and locks the bones in place
Tendons that pull the bones tightly together at all times
Tough bands called ligaments that connect the two bones and hold them in place
Fluid in the joint that creates enough pressure to keep the bones together
explanation: Tough ligaments connect the two bones in a ball-and-socket joint and hold them in place so the joint stays put even while moving freely.
fact_tl: Hindi basta-basta natatanggal ang bola sa socket dahil may matitibay na 'ligaments'—parang malalakas na tali na nakakabit sa magkabilang buto. Sila ang humahawak para manatiling nasa lugar ang kasukaso kahit malaya itong gumagalaw.
fact_bis: Dili sayon matangtang ang bola sa socket tungod sa lig-on nga 'ligaments'—sama sa kusgan nga higot nga nagsumpay sa duha ka bukog. Sila ang naggunit aron magpabilin sa lugar ang lutahan bisan gawasnon kini nga molihok.

q: Why must a scorpion shed its old shell in order to grow?
options: Shedding removes parasites and diseases from the old shell
The shell becomes too heavy as the scorpion ages
The hard exoskeleton cannot stretch, so the scorpion must shed it to get bigger
Scorpions shed their shell to reveal bright warning colors when they are adults
explanation: To grow, a scorpion must shed its old shell because the exoskeleton cannot stretch.
fact_tl: Para lumaki, kailangang magpalit ng lumang balat ang alakdan dahil hindi humahaba ang exoskeleton nito.
fact_bis: Aron modako, ang tanga kinahanglang mag-ilis sa daang panit kay ang exoskeleton dili makainat.

q: What causes a storm surge during a typhoon?
options: Heavy rainfall fills the ocean and causes it to overflow onto land
Underwater earthquakes triggered by the typhoon push waves ashore
The strong winds of the typhoon drag and push seawater toward the land, making it pile up
The low air pressure of the typhoon sucks water up from the ocean floor
explanation: The very strong winds of a typhoon drag and push seawater toward the land, making it pile up in a storm surge.
fact_tl: Ang napakalakas na hangin ng bagyo ang humahatak at nagtutulak sa tubig-dagat papunta sa lupa, kaya ito tumataas.
fact_bis: Ang kusog kaayo nga hangin sa bagyo maoy nagaduso sa tubig-dagat padulong sa yuta, mao nga magpundok kini.

q: How many giant planets are in the outer solar system?
options: Two — Jupiter and Saturn
Three — Jupiter, Saturn, and Uranus
Four — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune
Five — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto
explanation: There are four giant planets in the outer solar system: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
fact_tl: May apat (4) na higanteng planeta sa labas: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, at Neptune.
fact_bis: Adunay upat (4) ka higante nga planeta sa gawas: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, ug Neptune.

q: How does wind carrying sand change rocks over time?
options: The sand dissolves the rock surface by mixing with rainwater
The sand coats the rock and protects it from further weathering
The sand acts like sandpaper, slowly scraping and wearing down the rocks
The sand buries the rocks and stops them from eroding further
explanation: Wind carrying sand acts like sandpaper, slowly scraping and wearing down rocks close to the ground.
fact_tl: Ang hangin na may dalang buhangin ay parang sandpaper na unti-unting kumukuskos at nag-uukit sa mga bato malapit sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang hangin nga nagdala ug balas mahisama sa sandpaper nga hinay-hinay nga magkuskos ug magbanlas sa mga bato duol sa yuta.

q: What are Saturn's rings made of?
options: Swirling clouds of gas and frozen ammonia crystals
Billions of small pieces of ice and rock
Thick bands of dust held together by Saturn's magnetic field
Solid sheets of ice stretching outward from the planet
explanation: Saturn's rings are made of billions of small pieces of ice and rock, ranging from tiny grains to boulders as big as a house.
fact_tl: Ang mga singsing ng Saturn ay gawa sa bilyun-bilyong maliliit na piraso ng yelo at bato; ang mga ito ay mula sa sukat na katulad ng isang butil ng buhangin hanggang sa bato na kasing-laki ng bahay.
fact_bis: Ang mga singsing sa Saturn gihimo gikan sa bilyun-bilyon nga gamay nga piraso sa yelo ug bato; kini nagkalain-laing sukat gikan sa gamay nga butil sa balas ngadto sa bato nga kasing-dako sa balay.

q: What kind of electromagnetic radiation has the highest energy and is emitted by radioactive nuclei?
options: X-rays
Ultraviolet rays
Gamma rays
Microwaves
explanation: Gamma rays are the highest-energy electromagnetic radiation, emitted by radioactive nuclei and used in cancer treatment but dangerous in large doses.
fact_tl: Ang mga gamma rays ay ang pinaka-mataas na enerhiya na electromagnetic radiation — naglalabas sila mula sa radioactive na mga nucleus at ginagamit sa paggamot ng kanser (radiation therapy) ngunit mapanganib sa malalaking dosis.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamma ray mao ang pinakataas nga enerhiya nga electromagnetic radiation — gihawa gikan sa radioactive nga mga nucleus ug gigamit sa pagtambal sa kanser (radiation therapy) apan delikado sa dagko nga mga dosis.

q: What causes a volcano to erupt?
options: Rainwater seeps deep underground, turns to steam, and blasts out through cracks
Two tectonic plates slowly push the ground upward until it breaks open
Hot melted rock and gases build up pressure underground and burst out through an opening in the crust
An earthquake shakes the mountain so hard that the top cracks open
explanation: A volcano erupts when hot melted rock (magma) and gases deep underground build up pressure and burst out through an opening in the Earth's crust.
fact_tl: Sumasabog ang bulkan kapag ang mainit na tunaw na bato (magma) at mga gas sa ilalim ng lupa ay nag-iipon ng presyon at bumubuga palabas sa bunganga sa crust ng Earth.
fact_bis: Mobuto ang bulkan kung ang init nga natunaw nga bato (magma) ug mga gas sa ilalom sa yuta magtigom og presyur ug mobuga pagawas agi sa baba sa crust sa Earth.

q: Which bird lays the largest egg of any bird alive today?
options: The emu
The ostrich
The cassowary
The penguin
explanation: The ostrich egg is the largest egg of any bird living today — just one ostrich egg is about the size of 24 chicken eggs.
fact_tl: Ang itlog ng ostrich ang pinakamalaking itlog sa lahat ng ibon ngayon. Isang itlog lang nito ay kasinlaki ng mga 24 na itlog ng manok.
fact_bis: Ang itlog sa ostrich mao ang pinakadako nga itlog sa tanang langgam karon. Usa ra ka itlog niini sama kadako sa mga 24 ka itlog sa manok.

q: Where do most catfish live?
options: In shallow coral reefs near tropical islands
In deep ocean water far from shore
In freshwater such as rivers, lakes, and streams
In brackish water where rivers meet the sea
explanation: Most catfish live in freshwater such as rivers, lakes, and streams, not in the sea.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng hito ay nakatira sa tubig-tabang gaya ng mga ilog, lawa, at sapa, hindi sa dagat.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa hito nagpuyo sa tab-ang nga tubig sama sa mga suba, linaw, ug sapa, dili sa dagat.

q: Who typically manages many marine protected areas in the Philippines?
options: Scientists from national universities who patrol the seas regularly
The Philippine Navy and Coast Guard working together
Local communities and fishermen who watch over the areas
International conservation organizations based abroad
explanation: Many marine protected areas in the Philippines are managed by local communities and fishermen who watch over them.
fact_tl: Maraming marine protected area sa Pilipinas ay pinamamahalaan ng mga lokal na pamayanan at mangingisda na siyang nagbabantay dito.
fact_bis: Daghang marine protected area sa Pilipinas gidumala sa lokal nga komunidad ug mga mananagat nga maoy nagbantay niini.

q: When does the Philippine mango tree usually flower?
options: During the rainy season
During the cold months of December and January
During the dry season, before bearing fruit
After the first heavy rains of the year
explanation: The mango tree flowers in the dry season before bearing sweet fruit.
fact_tl: Ang mangga ay isang malaki at matagal mabuhay na puno-prutas sa Pilipinas; namumulaklak ito tuwing tag-init bago magbunga ng matatamis na prutas.
fact_bis: Ang mangga usa ka dako ug dugay mabuhi nga punoan-prutas sa Pilipinas; mamulak kini matag ting-init una mamunga og tam-is nga prutas.

q: Where does a female shrimp carry her eggs after laying them?
options: She buries them in the sand at the bottom of the sea
She attaches them to underwater plants or coral
She carries them inside a special pouch on her back
She carries them under her body until they hatch
explanation: A female shrimp lays many eggs and carries them under her body until they hatch.
fact_tl: Ang babaeng hipon ay nangingitlog ng maraming itlog at dinadala ito sa ilalim ng katawan hanggang mapisa.
fact_bis: Ang baye nga hipon mangitlog og daghang itlog ug magdala niini ilalom sa lawas hangtod mapusa.

q: Why do many deep-sea fish have huge mouths and stretchy stomachs?
options: To filter tiny plankton from large volumes of cold, dark water
To produce bioluminescent light to attract mates in the darkness
So they can swallow even large prey on the rare times food appears
To store oxygen so they can survive without swimming to the surface
explanation: Many deep-sea fish have huge mouths and stretchy stomachs so they can swallow even large prey on the rare occasions food appears.
fact_tl: Maraming isda sa kailaliman ang may malaking bibig at nababanat na tiyan upang makakain ng kahit malaking biktimang bihirang dumaan.
fact_bis: Daghang isda sa kailaloman adunay dako nga baba ug mainat nga tiyan aron makakaon bisan sa dako nga biktima sa panagsa nga higayon nga adunay pagkaon.

q: Who was the first person to pay for and travel into space as a tourist?
options: Yuri Gagarin in 1961
Neil Armstrong in 1969
Dennis Tito in 2001
Elon Musk in 2010
explanation: The first space tourist who paid to travel into space was Dennis Tito in 2001.
fact_tl: Ang unang space tourist na nagbayad para makapunta sa kalawakan ay si Dennis Tito noong 2001.
fact_bis: Ang unang space tourist nga nibayad aron makaadto sa kawanangan mao si Dennis Tito niadtong 2001.

q: Why do places near the equator, like the Philippines, stay warm all year with no winter?
options: They are closer to the Sun because the Earth bulges at the equator
The ocean currents around the equator always carry warm water
The sun's rays fall almost straight down all year long, so the land never loses much heat
The thick forests in tropical areas trap heat and prevent the land from cooling
explanation: Places in the tropics stay warm all year because they sit near the equator, where the sun's rays fall almost straight down the whole year, so there is no winter.
fact_tl: Ang mga lugar sa tropiko (kasama ang Pilipinas) ay mainit buong taon dahil malapit sila sa ekwador, kung saan halos tuwid na bumabagsak ang sikat ng araw sa buong taon — kaya walang taglamig doon.
fact_bis: Ang mga dapit sa tropiko (apil ang Pilipinas) init tibuok tuig kay duol sila sa ekwador, diin halos tul-id nga mahulog ang kahayag sa adlaw sa tibuok tuig — maong walay tingtugnaw didto.

q: Which geological epoch do we currently live in?
options: The Pleistocene epoch
The Pliocene epoch
The Holocene epoch
The Eocene epoch
explanation: We now live in the Holocene epoch, which began about 11,700 years ago after the last Ice Age.
fact_tl: Tayo ngayon ay nasa Holocene epoch, na nagsimula mga 11,700 taon na ang nakalipas pagkatapos ng huling Ice Age.
fact_bis: Naa ta karon sa Holocene epoch, nga nagsugod mga 11,700 ka tuig na ang milabay human sa kataposang Ice Age.

q: How does a Komodo dragon usually catch its prey after biting it once?
options: It bites once and then follows the prey, waiting for the venom to weaken it
It bites many times very quickly until the prey cannot move
It grabs the prey with its claws and holds on until it stops struggling
It chases the prey at high speed until the prey falls from exhaustion
explanation: The Komodo dragon bites prey once and then follows it, letting the venom weaken it until it is easy to catch.
fact_tl: Madalas ay kinakagat lang muna ng Komodo dragon ang biktima saka ito susundan habang naghihintay; sa tulong ng kamandag, manghihina ang biktima hanggang sa madaling mahuli ito.
fact_bis: Sagad kagaton lang una sa Komodo dragon ang biktima dayon sundan kini samtang naghulat; pinaagi sa hilo, maluya ang biktima hangtod sayon na kining madakpan.

q: How do hormones get from where they are made to the body parts they control?
options: They travel through the nervous system as electrical signals
They travel through the blood to reach the specific body parts they control
They move through the lymph nodes and then into organs
They are carried by white blood cells directly to muscles
explanation: Hormones travel through the blood to reach the specific body parts they control.
fact_tl: Ang mga hormone ay naglalakbay sa pamamagitan ng dugo papunta sa partikular na bahagi ng katawan na kanilang kinokontrol.
fact_bis: Ang mga hormone mobiyahe pinaagi sa dugo padulong sa piho nga bahin sa lawas nga ilang kontrolon.

q: What makes the seahorse unique compared to almost all other animals when it comes to having young?
options: The female carries and gives birth to the young while the male guards the nest
The male carries and gives birth to the young after the female lays eggs into his pouch
Both parents carry the eggs together in a shared pouch until they hatch
The young develop inside eggs attached to underwater plants by both parents
explanation: The seahorse is unique because the male carries and gives birth to the young — the female lays eggs into the male's pouch and he nurtures them.
fact_tl: Ang kabayo ng dagat ay natatangi sa mundo ng hayop dahil ang lalaki ang nagdadala at nagsisilang ng mga anak — ang babae ay naglalaglag ng mga itlog sa pouch ng lalaki at ang lalaki ang nagpapalaki nito hanggang sa maging handa na ang mga batang seahorse.
fact_bis: Ang kabayo sa dagat talagsaon sa kalibutan sa hayop tungod kay ang lalaki ang nagdala ug nagsilang sa mga anak — ang babae nagbilin og mga itlog sa bulsa sa lalaki ug ang lalaki nagpaalaga kanila hangtod ang mga batang seahorse andam na.

q: Why does a phone's touchscreen not work when you wear thick gloves?
options: Thick gloves are too heavy and press too many points on the screen at once
Thick gloves block the tiny electricity in your body from reaching the screen
Thick gloves scratch the screen surface making it unable to detect touches
Thick gloves are too cold and cause the screen to freeze up temporarily
explanation: A touchscreen senses the tiny electricity in our bodies, and thick gloves block that electricity from reaching the screen.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang touchscreen ng telepono dahil ang katawan natin ay may konting kuryente, at nararamdaman ng screen kung saan naabot ng daliri — kaya hindi ito gumagana kapag may suot kang makapal na guwantes.
fact_bis: Mogana ang touchscreen sa telepono tungod kay ang atong lawas adunay gamay nga kuryente, ug mabati sa screen kung asa midapat ang tudlo — mao nga dili kini mogana kung magsul-ob ka ug baga nga gwantes.

q: Why do underwater plants die when water hyacinth completely covers the water's surface?
options: Water hyacinth releases a poison into the water that kills other plants
Water hyacinth blocks sunlight so underwater plants cannot make food and oxygen
Water hyacinth uses all the water's nutrients leaving nothing for other plants
Water hyacinth creates waves that uproot other plants from the muddy bottom
explanation: Water hyacinth blocks sunlight from reaching underwater plants, so they cannot make food and oxygen and eventually die.
fact_tl: Kapag tinakpan ng water hyacinth ang ibabaw ng tubig, hindi makaabot ang sikat ng araw sa mga halamang nasa ilalim. Dahil dito, hindi makagawa ng pagkain at oxygen ang mga ito kaya namamatay sila.
fact_bis: Kung tabunan sa water hyacinth ang ibabaw sa tubig, dili makaabot ang kahayag sa adlaw sa mga tanom sa ilawom. Tungod niini, dili makahimo og pagkaon ug oxygen ang mga kini busa mamatay sila.

q: What does the word 'vertebrate' tell us about an animal?
options: That the animal has four legs and can walk on land
That the animal has a row of small bones forming a backbone in its back
That the animal has a skull that protects its brain
That the animal has a skeleton made entirely of cartilage
explanation: 'Vertebrate' comes from 'vertebra,' the name for each small bone in the backbone, so vertebrates are animals with this row of bones in their back.
fact_tl: Ang salitang 'vertebrate' ay galing sa 'vertebra,' ang tawag sa bawat maliit na buto na magkakabit-kabit para buuin ang gulugod; kaya ang vertebrate ay hayop na may ganitong hanay ng buto sa likod.
fact_bis: Ang pulong nga 'vertebrate' naggikan sa 'vertebra,' ang ngalan sa matag gamay nga bukog nga magkasumpay aron mahimo ang gulugod; busa ang vertebrate usa ka hayop nga adunay ingon niini nga laray sa bukog sa likod.

q: Why does a cool sea breeze blow toward the land during a hot day along the coast?
options: Cool air from the sea is heavier than warm air, so it naturally flows downhill toward land
When land heats up faster than the sea, warm air over land rises and cooler sea air moves in to replace it
The ocean currents push surface air toward the shore creating a constant breeze
Water evaporates from the sea and pulls surrounding air along with it toward land
explanation: Land heats up faster than the sea, causing warm air over land to rise; cooler air from the sea then moves in to replace it — this is convection.
fact_tl: Ang hanging-dagat (sea breeze) sa baybayin ng Pilipinas ay isang halimbawa ng convection: kapag mas mabilis uminit ang lupa kaysa dagat, umaakyat ang mainit na hangin sa lupa at pumapalit ang malamig na hangin mula sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang hangin gikan sa dagat (sea breeze) sa baybayon sa Pilipinas usa ka pananglitan sa convection: kung mas paspas moinit ang yuta kaysa dagat, mosaka ang init nga hangin sa yuta ug ang bugnaw nga hangin gikan sa dagat mopuli niini.

q: Where does much of the sand on beaches originally come from?
options: Sand is formed directly from ocean shells breaking apart on the shore
Inland rock is broken down and carried to the sea by rivers
Wind blows desert sand into the ocean where waves push it onto beaches
Volcanoes under the sea produce sand that washes up onto beaches
explanation: Much beach sand comes from inland rock that rivers carry down to the sea.
fact_tl: Maraming buhangin sa baybayin ay galing sa lupa na dinala ng mga ilog pababa sa dagat.
fact_bis: Daghang balas sa baybayon naggikan sa yuta nga gidala sa mga suba paubos sa dagat.

q: Why does the body shiver when it is very cold?
options: Shivering pumps extra blood to the skin to warm the outside of the body
Shivering generates heat to keep vital organs like the heart and brain warm enough to work
Shivering signals the brain to release hormones that make you feel warmer quickly
Shivering tightens the muscles around the lungs to help breathing in cold air
explanation: Shivering helps keep the inside of the body warm so vital organs like the heart and brain can work properly.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang nginig dahil tinutulungan nitong manatiling mainit ang loob ng katawan kung saan naroon ang mahahalagang organ tulad ng puso at utak. Kailangan ng mga organ na ito ng tamang init para gumana nang maayos.
fact_bis: Importante ang kurog kay motabang kini nga magpabiling init ang sulod sa lawas diin naa ang importanteng organ sama sa kasingkasing ug utok. Kini nga mga organ nagkinahanglan og hustong kainit aron molihok og maayo.

q: What did NASA's LCROSS mission discover when it crashed into a crater at the Moon's South Pole in 2009?
options: It found frozen carbon dioxide gas mixed into the polar soil
It detected water vapor in the dust thrown up by the impact
It confirmed that the crater floor was made of solid iron rock
It found evidence of ancient lava flows inside the shadowed crater
explanation: NASA's LCROSS crashed into a polar crater and detected water vapor in the dust, providing evidence of water ice in permanently shadowed craters at the Moon's poles.
fact_tl: Ang mga siyentipiko ay nakakita ng katibayan ng water ice sa loob ng mga permanently shadowed crater sa mga polo ng Moon; noong 2009, ang LCROSS mission ng NASA ay nagbangga sa isang polar crater at natuklasan ang water vapor sa alikabok na itinataas.
fact_bis: Ang mga syentipiko nakakita og ebidensya sa water ice sulod sa mga permanently shadowed na crater sa mga poste sa Moon; niadtong 2009 ang LCROSS mission sa NASA mibanggaa sa usa ka polar crater ug nakakaplag og water vapour sa abug nga gitaas.

q: Which moons are thought to hide oceans of liquid water beneath their icy surfaces?
options: Titan and Ganymede
Europa and Enceladus
Phobos and Deimos
Callisto and Oberon
explanation: Europa and Enceladus are thought to hide oceans of water under their ice, making them targets in the search for life.
fact_tl: Hindi lang Mars ang hinahanapan ng buhay; ang mga buwan na Europa at Enceladus ay pinaniniwalaang may karagatan ng tubig sa ilalim ng yelo.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang Mars ang ginapangitaan og kinabuhi; ang mga bulan nga Europa ug Enceladus gituohan nga adunay kadagatan sa tubig ilalom sa ilang yelo.

q: Why do crystals have flat, straight faces?
options: Crystals are cut and polished by people to give them their smooth flat surfaces
Their atoms are stacked in a neat, repeating pattern on the inside, creating flat faces
Water slowly wears away the rough parts of crystals leaving only flat surfaces
High pressure underground squeezes crystals until all their sides become flat
explanation: Crystals have flat, straight faces because their atoms are arranged in a neat, repeating pattern on the inside.
fact_tl: May patag at tuwid na mga mukha (faces) ang mga kristal dahil ang kanilang mga atomo ay nakaayos sa maayos at paulit-ulit na pattern sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang mga kristal adunay patag ug tul-id nga mga nawong tungod kay ang ilang mga atomo nakahan-ay sa hapsay ug balik-balik nga pattern sa sulod.

q: How do trees planted as windbreaks help farmers?
options: They attract rain clouds and increase rainfall over the farm
They protect crops from strong winds, reduce erosion, and help soil hold moisture
They shade the crops and keep the soil cool so plants grow faster
They absorb harmful gases from the soil before they can reach the crops
explanation: Trees planted as windbreaks protect crops from strong winds, reduce erosion, and help retain soil moisture.
fact_tl: Ang mga puno na itinatanim bilang windbreak ay nagpoprotekta ng mga tanaman mula sa matinding hangin; ito ay nagpapababa ng erosion at nagtutulong na mapanatili ang kahalumigmigan ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga puno nga itinanom isip windbreak nagpanalipod sa mga pananim gikan sa kusog nga hangin; nagpababa usab kini sa erosion ug nagtabang sa pagpatagan sa kahalumigmigan sa yuta.

q: How do germs most easily get inside your body after you touch something dirty?
options: Germs jump off dirty surfaces and float through the air into your nose
You touch your eyes, nose, or mouth after touching something with germs on it
Germs soak directly through your skin when you touch a dirty surface
Germs travel up your fingernails and enter through cuts in your skin
explanation: Germs spread when you touch something with germs on it and then touch your eyes, nose, or mouth, which is why washing hands matters.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang germs kapag hinawakan mo ang bagay na may germs, tapos hinawakan mo ang iyong mata, ilong, o bibig. Doon sila pumapasok sa katawan mo. Kaya mahalaga ang paghuhugas ng kamay.
fact_bis: Mokatag ang germs kung mohikap ka og butang nga adunay germs, dayon mohikap ka sa imong mata, ilong, o baba. Diha sila mosulod sa imong lawas. Mao nga importante ang paghugas sa kamot.

q: Why do sea turtles often swallow plastic bags floating in the ocean?
options: Sea turtles are attracted to the bright colors of plastic bags in the water
Floating plastic bags look like jellyfish, so turtles swallow them thinking they are food
Plastic bags release a smell similar to the fish that sea turtles normally eat
Sea turtles accidentally swallow plastic bags while swimming through garbage patches
explanation: A floating plastic bag looks like a jellyfish, so sea turtles swallow it mistakenly thinking it is food.
fact_tl: Ang plastik na supot ay kamukha ng dikya sa tubig, kaya nililamon ito ng mga pawikan na akala nila ay pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang naglutaw nga plastik nga supot mura og dikya sa tubig, busa lamunon kini sa mga pawikan kay abi nila pagkaon.

q: Why do noble gases like helium, neon, and argon almost never react with other elements?
options: They are kept at extremely low temperatures which prevents any chemical reactions
Their outer electron shell is already full, so they have no need to react
They are so light that they float away before they can come into contact with other atoms
They have no protons in their nucleus so other atoms are not attracted to them
explanation: Noble gases are in Group 18 and almost never react because their outer electron shell is already full.
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas gaya ng helium, neon, at argon ay nasa Group 18 at halos hindi nakikipagreaksyon dahil puno na ang kanilang panlabas na shell.
fact_bis: Ang mga noble gas sama sa helium, neon, ug argon anaa sa Group 18 ug halos dili moreaksiyon kay puno na ang ilang gawas nga shell.

q: What is one thing scientists do on the International Space Station (ISS) that is different from experiments on Earth?
options: They study how earthquakes form by recreating the pressure found deep underground
They grow plants in conditions that cannot be replicated the same way on Earth
They build new types of rockets using materials only found in space
They observe the Sun up close without Earth's atmosphere blocking the view
explanation: The ISS is used as a laboratory where experiments such as growing plants are conducted in ways that cannot be done the same way on Earth.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang ISS bilang laboratoryo kung saan ginagawa ang mga eksperimento, tulad ng pagpapatubo ng halaman, na hindi magagawa sa Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang ISS gigamit isip laboratoryo diin gihimo ang mga eksperimento, sama sa pagpatubo og tanom, nga dili mahimo sa samang paagi sa Kalibutan.

q: What is remarkable about Typhoon Tip, which occurred in 1979?
options: It was the deadliest typhoon ever recorded, killing more than a million people
It was the largest typhoon ever recorded, stretching about 2,220 km across
It was the fastest typhoon ever, with winds reaching over 400 km per hour
It was the only typhoon ever to make landfall in three countries at the same time
explanation: Typhoon Tip in 1979 was the largest typhoon ever recorded, measuring about 2,220 km across.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking bagyo na naitala ay si Bagyong Tip noong 1979, na umabot ng mga 2,220 km ang lapad.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga bagyo nga natala kay ang Bagyong Tip niadtong 1979, mga 2,220 km ang gilapdon.

q: What does the skin of a carabao look like?
options: It is brown and covered with thick, coarse hair all over the body
It is thick and gray with very little hair
It is black and shiny with a few white patches near the legs
It is pale pink and smooth like the skin of a pig
explanation: The carabao has thick gray skin with very little hair.
fact_tl: May makapal at kulay-abong balat ang kalabaw na may kakaunting buhok.
fact_bis: Ang kalabaw adunay baga ug abuhon nga panit nga gamay ra ug balhibo.

q: Who discovered X-rays in 1895, a technology now used to see bones inside the body?
options: Marie Curie
Wilhelm Roentgen
Louis Pasteur
Thomas Edison
explanation: Wilhelm Roentgen discovered X-rays in 1895, and they are now used to take pictures of bones inside the body.
fact_tl: Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang nakatuklas ng X-rays noong 1895, na ginagamit ngayon sa larawan ng buto sa loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang nakadiskobre sa X-rays niadtong 1895, nga gigamit karon sa pagkuha og hulagway sa bukog sulod sa lawas.

q: When are sampaguita flowers picked from the plant?
options: At midday when the sun has fully opened the blooms
Early in the morning while they are still fresh
Late at night after the dew has made them soft
In the afternoon after they have soaked up sunlight all day
explanation: Sampaguita flowers are picked early in the morning while they are still fresh, before being strung into garlands.
fact_tl: Bago tuhugin, tumutubo ang sampaguita bilang halaman na may maraming bulaklak. Pinipitas ang mga bulaklak nang maaga sa umaga habang sariwa pa.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa tuhogon, motubo ang sampaguita isip tanom nga daghan og bulak. Pupoon ang mga bulak sayo sa buntag samtang preska pa.

q: What changes about a constellation through the year, and what stays the same?
options: The shape of the constellation changes slowly each year but its position in the sky stays the same
The shape of the constellation stays exactly the same; only when and where we see it in the sky changes
Both the shape and the position of a constellation change completely with the seasons
The number of stars in a constellation increases each year but its shape never changes
explanation: The shape of a constellation never changes — its star pattern always looks the same; what changes is only when and where in the sky we can see it throughout the year.
fact_tl: Mahalagang malaman: hindi nagbabago ang mismong hugis ng isang konstelasyon — laging pareho ang ayos ng mga bituin nito. Ang nagbabago lang ay KUNG KAILAN at SAAN sa langit natin ito makikita sa buong taon. Kaya ang Orion ngayon ay may parehong hugis ng Orion noong sinaunang panahon.
fact_bis: Importante mahibaw-an: ang porma sa usa ka konstelasyon dili mausab — ang pattern sa iyang mga bituon parehas gihapon. Ang mausab lang mao KANUS-A ug ASA sa langit nato kini makita sulod sa tuig. Mao nga ang Orion karon parehas og porma sa Orion sa karaang panahon.

q: What is the main difference between hotspot volcanoes and most Philippine volcanoes?
options: Hotspot volcanoes erupt much more violently, while Philippine volcanoes release only steam
Hotspot volcanoes form above a fixed plume of hot mantle and create island chains; most Philippine volcanoes form at plate boundaries
Hotspot volcanoes are found only underwater, while Philippine volcanoes are always on land
Hotspot volcanoes produce only dark basalt rock, while Philippine volcanoes produce lighter rock
explanation: Hotspot volcanoes form above a fixed mantle plume and create island chains like Hawaii; most Philippine volcanoes form at plate boundaries, not hotspots.
fact_tl: Ang hotspot volcanoes ay nagmumula sa isang nakaayos na plume ng mainit na mantle at hindi sa plate boundaries; kapag ang plato ay gumagalaw sa ibabaw ng hotspot, ito ay lumilikha ng isang chain ng mga isla (tulad ng Hawaii); ang karamihan ng mga bulkan ng Pilipinas ay plate-boundary volcanoes, hindi hotspot.
fact_bis: Ang mga hotspot volcano gikan sa usa ka nakaayo nga plume sa mainit nga mantle ug dili gikan sa mga plate boundary; samtang ang plato naglihok sa ibabaw sa hotspot, kini nagporma og usa ka pana sa mga isla (sama sa Hawaii); kadaghanan sa mga bulkan sa Pilipinas mga plate-boundary volcanoes, dili hotspot.

q: What did Ignaz Semmelweis discover in the 1840s about preventing deaths in hospitals?
options: He discovered that sterilizing surgical tools with boiling water prevented most infections
Doctors washing their hands before delivering babies greatly reduced deaths from infection
Patients who wore clean clothing recovered from surgery far faster than others
Keeping hospital windows open allowed germs to escape and lowered infection rates
explanation: Semmelweis discovered that doctors washing their hands before delivering babies greatly reduced deaths from infection, years before germ theory was accepted.
fact_tl: Noong 1840s, natuklasan ni Ignaz Semmelweis na ang paghuhugas ng mga kamay ng mga doktor bago ang panganganak ay lubhang nagpababa ng mga namamatay sa impeksyon sa ospital — maraming taon bago pa pa-aminin ang germ theory.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1840s, nadiskobrehan ni Ignaz Semmelweis nga ang paghugas sa mga kamot sa mga doktor sa wala pa ang pag-alagad sa bata-bata nagpakunhod og grabe sa mga namatay gikan sa impeksyon sa ospital — daghang tuig sa wala pa mapasangkupon ang germ theory.

q: Why is a period in history called the 'Bronze Age'?
options: Bronze tools were the only items that survived long enough for historians to study that period
Bronze was one of the first alloys people made, so that era is named after this important discovery
Bronze weapons were so powerful they allowed one civilization to conquer most of the known world
Bronze was the only metal that could be found on every continent during that ancient time
explanation: Bronze was one of the first alloys people ever made, so the historical period when it was widely used is called the Bronze Age.
fact_tl: Ang bronse ay isa sa mga unang aleasyon na ginawa ng tao, kaya may panahon sa kasaysayan na tinatawag na Panahon ng Bronse.
fact_bis: Ang bronse usa sa unang mga aleasyon nga gihimo sa tawo, mao nga adunay panahon sa kasaysayan nga gitawag og Panahon sa Bronse.

q: How was the gorge at Pagsanjan Falls in Laguna formed?
options: An earthquake split the land apart and water later filled the gap creating the gorge
The flowing river slowly carved through the rock over a very long time
A volcano erupted and its lava cooled to form the steep cliff walls of the gorge
Strong typhoon floodwaters eroded the land rapidly during a single massive storm
explanation: The gorge at Pagsanjan Falls was slowly carved by the flowing river over a long period of time.
fact_tl: Ang Pagsanjan Falls sa Laguna ay isang tanyag na talon kung saan bumabagsak ang tubig sa pagitan ng matatarik na bangin na unti-unting inukit ng umaagos na ilog sa loob ng mahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang Pagsanjan Falls sa Laguna usa ka bantog nga busay diin nahulog ang tubig taliwala sa tarik nga mga pangpang sa gorge nga hinay-hinay nga giukit sa nagaagos nga suba sa dugay nga panahon.

q: What gives amethyst its purple color?
options: Copper mixed into the quartz reacts with oxygen underground to create purple tones
Tiny bits of iron in the quartz change color when affected by natural radiation in the ground
Manganese crystals grow between layers of quartz and produce the purple hue
The quartz slowly absorbs purple light from deep underground and stores it over millions of years
explanation: Amethyst's purple color comes from tiny bits of iron mixed into the quartz that change when affected by natural radiation in the ground.
fact_tl: Ang lila o purpleng kulay ng amethyst ay galing sa kaunting bakal (iron) na nahahalo sa quartz. Kapag tinatamaan ito ng natural na radiation sa loob ng lupa, nagbabago ang bakal at lumilitaw ang magandang kulay-ube.
fact_bis: Ang purple nga kolor sa amethyst gikan sa gamay nga puthaw (iron) nga nasagol sa quartz. Kung maigo kini sa natural nga radiation sa yuta, mabag-o ang puthaw ug motungha ang nindot nga purple nga kolor.

q: How are guava leaves traditionally used in the Philippines?
options: They are dried and eaten as a vegetable side dish with rice
They are used as a herbal or traditional folk medicine
They are burned to keep insects away from homes and farms
They are pressed and mixed with coconut oil to make cooking fat
explanation: In the Philippines, guava leaves are used as a herbal or traditional folk medicine.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ginagamit ang dahon ng bayabas bilang halamang gamot o tradisyonal na lunas.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang dahon sa bayabas gigamit isip tambal nga tanom o tradisyonal nga lunas.

q: Why is every adult sea turtle considered very precious?
options: Adult sea turtles are very old and carry important knowledge passed down through generations
So few sea turtles ever survive to adulthood that each grown turtle is rare and must be protected
Adult sea turtles are worth a lot of money because their shells can be used to make jewelry
Adult sea turtles lay thousands of eggs at once making them crucial for quick population recovery
explanation: Because so few sea turtles ever reach adulthood, each grown sea turtle is very precious and should never be harmed or caught.
fact_tl: Dahil napakakaunti ang nakakaabot sa pagiging matandang pawikan, napakahalaga ng bawat isa, kaya hindi dapat sila saktan o hulihin.
fact_bis: Tungod kay pipila ra kaayo ang makaabot sa pagkahamtong nga pawikan, bililhon kaayo ang matag usa, busa dili gyud sila angay samaran o dakpon.

q: When oceanic crust and continental crust collide, which one sinks? Why?
options: Continental crust sinks because it is thicker and therefore heavier than oceanic crust
Oceanic crust sinks because even though it is thinner, it is denser and heavier than continental crust
They both sink equally because the collision breaks both pieces apart at the same time
Oceanic crust sinks because it is thicker and creates more pressure pushing it downward
explanation: Oceanic crust is thinner but denser and heavier, so when it collides with lighter continental crust, the oceanic crust is the one that sinks.
fact_tl: Ang oceanic crust (sa ilalim ng dagat) ay mas manipis ngunit mas siksik at mabigat, habang ang continental crust (kung saan nakatayo ang mga lupain) ay mas makapal ngunit mas magaan — kaya kapag nagbanggaan, ang oceanic crust ang lumulubog.
fact_bis: Ang oceanic crust (ilawom sa dagat) mas nipis apan mas siksik ug bug-at, samtang ang continental crust (diin nahimutang ang mga yuta) mas baga apan mas gaan — busa kung magbangga, ang oceanic crust mao ang molunod.

q: Why is caramelizing sugar considered a chemical change rather than a physical change?
options: The sugar melts from solid to liquid, and melting is always classified as a chemical change
New substances with a different color and smell form, and it cannot turn back into plain sugar
The sugar gets much hotter than its normal temperature, which signals a chemical reaction
Caramelizing happens slowly over time, and any slow change in matter is a chemical change
explanation: Caramelizing is a chemical change because new substances with different color and smell form, and the process cannot be reversed back to plain sugar.
fact_tl: Ang pag-caramel ng asukal ay kemikal na pagbabago dahil nabubuo ang bagong sangkap na may ibang kulay at amoy, at hindi na ito mababalik sa dating asukal.
fact_bis: Ang pag-caramel sa asukal usa ka kemikal nga pagbag-o tungod kay matawo ang bag-ong sustansya nga lahi og kolor ug baho, ug dili na kini mobalik sa daan nga asukal.

q: Who discovered vulcanized rubber, and in what year?
options: Thomas Edison in 1879
Charles Goodyear in 1839
Henry Ford in 1901
James Watt in 1782
explanation: Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanized rubber in 1839.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Charles Goodyear ang vulcanized rubber noong 1839.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ni Charles Goodyear ang vulcanized rubber niadtong 1839.

q: What usually happens to the weather in the Philippines right after the very hot month of May?
options: The hottest weather continues into June, making June even hotter than May
The rainy habagat season begins in June after the intense heat of May
A cool dry season arrives in June bringing relief from the summer heat
Strong typhoons immediately arrive in June replacing the hot weather
explanation: The habagat usually begins after the intense hot season, so very hot May is followed by the rainy habagat in June.
fact_tl: Karaniwang sumisimula ang habagat pagkatapos ng matinding tag-init, kaya ang mainit na buwan ng Mayo ay sinusundan ng maulang habagat sa Hunyo.
fact_bis: Kasagaran magsugod ang habagat human sa hilabihang init nga panahon, mao nga ang init nga bulan sa Mayo sundan sa maulanong habagat sa Hunyo.

q: What is found at the center of the Milky Way galaxy, and how does our Sun relate to it?
options: A massive star cluster is at the center, and our Sun is one of those central stars
A supermassive black hole is at the center, and our Sun orbits around it along with all other stars
A giant nebula is at the center that produces all the new stars in our galaxy including our Sun
A dense cluster of neutron stars is at the center, and our Sun will eventually be pulled into it
explanation: At the center of the Milky Way there is a supermassive black hole, and all stars in our galaxy — including the Sun — orbit around this center.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng Milky Way ay may isang napakalaking black hole, at ang lahat ng bituin sa ating galaxy, kasama ang Araw, ay umiikot sa paligid ng sentrong ito.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa Milky Way adunay usa ka dako kaayong black hole, ug ang tanang bituon sa atong galaxy, lakip ang Adlaw, naglibot niini nga sentro.

q: Where is the jaw joint located, and what does it allow you to do?
options: It is at the chin and allows you to open your mouth very wide for swallowing
It is in front of the ear and lets the jaw move up, down, and sideways so you can chew and speak
It is at the back of the skull and controls how far forward your lower jaw can jut out
It is between the upper and lower teeth and absorbs the force when you bite down hard
explanation: The jaw has a joint in front of the ear that moves it up, down, and sideways, allowing us to chew and speak.
fact_tl: May kasukasuan ang panga sa harap ng tainga na nagpapagalaw nito pataas, pababa, at sa gilid para tayo makakain at makapagsalita.
fact_bis: Ang apapangig adunay lutahan sa atubangan sa dalunggan nga magpalihok niini paibabaw, paubos, ug sa kilid aron makakaon ug makasulti kita.

q: Besides controlling how many prey animals there are, how else do apex predators affect ecosystems?
options: They teach younger prey animals where to find food and shelter in the ecosystem
Their presence changes prey behavior so herbivores avoid overgrazing one spot, helping plants grow
They produce chemicals that attract smaller predators which keep the entire food web balanced
They dig burrows that smaller prey animals use, which increases the total biodiversity of the area
explanation: Apex predators change prey behaviour — the perceived presence of a predator stops herbivores from overgrazing any one spot, helping plants grow.
fact_tl: Ang apex predator ay nagkokontrol hindi lamang ng bilang ng kanilang prey kundi pati na rin ng gawi ng prey — ang haka-haka na presensya ng predator ay nagpipigil sa mga herbivore na kumain ng masyadong marami sa isang lugar, na tinutulungan ang mga halaman na lumago.
fact_bis: Ang apex predator nagkontrol dili lamang sa gidaghanon sa ilang prey kondili sa kinaiya usab sa prey — ang huna-hunaon nga presensya sa predator nagpugong sa mga herbivore sa sobrang pagkaon sa bisan unsang usa ka lugar, nagtabang sa mga tanom nga motubo.

q: Why can't we see water vapor even though it is in the air around us?
options: Water vapor sinks to the ground and hides under soil where our eyes cannot reach
Water vapor is an invisible gas, so our eyes cannot spot it floating in the air
Water vapor only appears at night when sunlight is not there to reflect off it
Water vapor moves too fast for human eyes to see as it swirls through the air
explanation: Water vapor is a gas that the eye cannot see, so we cannot spot it floating in the air.
fact_tl: Ang singaw ng tubig ay isang gas na hindi nakikita ng mata, kaya hindi natin ito makita sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang alisngaw sa tubig usa ka gas nga dili makita sa mata, busa dili nato kini makita sa hangin.

q: What does a snail do with its hard shell?
options: It leaves its shell behind when danger comes and grows a new one afterward
It carries the hard shell on its back wherever it goes
It buries its shell in the soil and only picks it up when sleeping
It shares its shell with other snails taking turns using it for protection
explanation: A snail has a hard shell on its back that it carries with it wherever it goes.
fact_tl: Ang kuhol ay may matigas na bahay-kuhol o shell sa likod na dala-dala nito kahit saan ito pumunta.
fact_bis: Ang kuhol o suso adunay gahi nga kabhang sa likod nga gidala-dala bisan asa kini moadto.

q: Why does grinding food with your molars help your body digest it?
options: Molars release digestive enzymes into the food as they crush it making it easier to absorb
When molars grind food into tiny pieces, the stomach can break it down more easily, so digestion starts in the mouth
Grinding creates heat in the food that begins to break down nutrients before they reach the stomach
Molars push food to the back of the throat faster so it reaches the stomach while still warm
explanation: When molars grind food into tiny pieces, the stomach can break it down more easily, so digestion actually starts in the mouth.
fact_tl: Kapag pinino ng bagang ang pagkain, mas madali itong matutunaw sa tiyan. Kaya ang panimula ng pagtunaw ng pagkain ay nagsisimula na pala sa bibig, hindi lang sa tiyan.
fact_bis: Kung pinuhon sa bag-ang ang pagkaon, mas sayon kining matunaw sa tiyan. Mao nga ang sinugdanan sa pagtunaw sa pagkaon magsugod diay sa baba, dili lang sa tiyan.

q: How does sweet fruit help a plant reproduce and spread to new places?
options: Sweet fruit protects seeds from insects by making the seed coat too hard to bite through
Animals and birds eat the sweet flesh and help spread the seeds to new places
Sweet fruit produces a strong scent that attracts wind to carry the seeds farther away
Sweet fruit stores water that the seeds use to germinate before rain arrives
explanation: The sweet flesh attracts animals and birds that eat the fruit and help spread the seeds to new places.
fact_tl: Ang matamis na laman ay nakakaakit ng mga hayop at ibon na tumutulong ikalat ang mga buto.
fact_bis: Ang tam-is nga unod modani sa mga mananap ug langgam nga motabang sa pagsabwag sa mga liso.

q: Why are pieces of old satellites orbiting Earth dangerous to spacecraft?
options: Old satellite parts release toxic gases that can damage a spacecraft's outer coating
Thousands of pieces of space junk orbit Earth at very high speed, making them dangerous to spacecraft
Old satellites give off strong radiation that can destroy a spacecraft's electronic systems
Broken satellite parts fall toward Earth and block the launch paths used by new spacecraft
explanation: Thousands of pieces of old satellites and other junk circle Earth at very high speed, making them dangerous to spacecraft.
fact_tl: Libu-libong piraso ng lumang satellite at iba pang basura ang umiikot sa Earth nang napakabilis, kaya delikado ang mga ito sa mga sasakyang pangkalawakan.
fact_bis: Liboan ka piraso sa daang satellite ug ubang basura ang naglibot sa Earth nga paspas kaayo, mao nga peligroso kini sa mga sakyanan sa kawanangan.

q: What does a blue flame on a gas stove tell you about how the gas is burning?
options: It means the gas pressure is too high and the flame is burning too hot to be safe
It is a sign of complete combustion with enough oxygen, producing almost no smoke and more heat
It shows that water vapor is mixing with the gas making the flame appear blue and cooler
It means the gas contains impurities that change the color of the flame from orange to blue
explanation: The blue flame of a gas stove indicates complete combustion — there is enough oxygen, so it produces almost no smoke and burns hotter.
fact_tl: Ang asul na apoy ng gas stove ay tanda ng complete combustion — sapat ang oxygen kaya halos walang usok at mas mainit ito.
