fact_bis: Ang asul nga apoy sa gas stove maoy timaan sa complete combustion — paigo ang oxygen mao nga halos walay aso ug mas init kini.

q: What causes the feeling of being full after eating a meal?
options: Special hormones are released by the brain telling you to stop eating before the stomach is full
We feel full when our stomach has been filled with food
Digestion slows down and sends a signal to the brain that no more nutrients are needed
The throat closes slightly when enough food passes through it preventing more food from going down
explanation: We feel full when our stomach has been filled with food.
fact_tl: Nakakaramdam tayo ng busog kapag napuno na ng pagkain ang ating tiyan.
fact_bis: Mobati kita ug kabusog kung napuno na sa pagkaon ang atong tiyan.

q: Why are bones, teeth, and shells the most common things found as fossils?
options: Soft parts like flesh fossilize first but dissolve later, leaving only the hard parts behind
Hard parts fossilize most often because soft parts like flesh and skin decay quickly and are rarely preserved
Only the hardest minerals on Earth can protect any body part long enough to become a fossil
Hard parts are larger so they are easier for scientists to find even after millions of years
explanation: Hard parts such as bones, teeth, and shells fossilize most often because soft parts like flesh and skin decay quickly and are rarely preserved.
fact_tl: Mas madalas ma-fossil ang matitigas na bahagi tulad ng buto, ngipin, at kabibe; ang malalambot na bahagi tulad ng laman at balat ay madaling mabulok kaya bihira itong mapreserba.
fact_bis: Mas kanunay ma-fossil ang gahi nga mga bahin sama sa bukog, ngipon, ug kabhang; ang humok nga mga bahin sama sa unod ug panit dali madunot busa panagsa ra matipigan.

q: What is a sundog, and what causes it to appear?
options: A sundog is a circular ring around the Sun caused by dust particles high in the atmosphere
A sundog is a bright spot of light beside the Sun that forms from ice crystals in clouds
A sundog is a second sun-like glow seen on the horizon just before or after sunrise or sunset
A sundog is a dark spot beside the Sun caused when thick clouds block part of the sunlight
explanation: A sundog is a bright spot of light beside the Sun, often with a little color, that forms from ice crystals in clouds.
fact_tl: Ang sundog ay maliwanag na batik ng liwanag sa tabi ng araw, madalas may kaunting kulay. Nabubuo rin ito mula sa mga kristal ng yelo sa ulap, tulad ng halo.
fact_bis: Ang sundog usa ka hayag nga patik sa kahayag sa kilid sa adlaw, sagad adunay gamay nga bulok. Maporma pod kini gikan sa mga kristal sa yelo sa panganod, sama sa halo.

q: How does the strength of gravity on the Moon compare to gravity on Earth?
options: The Moon's gravity is about half of Earth's gravity, so you would weigh half as much there
The Moon's gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's gravity, roughly 1.6 m/s²
The Moon has no gravity at all, which is why astronauts float when they are on the surface
The Moon's gravity is about three-quarters of Earth's gravity because the Moon is so close
explanation: Gravity on the Moon is about 1.6 m/s², which is roughly one-sixth of Earth's gravity.
fact_tl: Ang grabidad sa Buwan ay halos 1.6 m/s², na mga ikaanim (1/6) lang ng grabidad sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa Bulan mga 1.6 m/s², mga ikaunom (1/6) lang sa grabidad sa Yuta.

q: Which formula correctly shows how to calculate density?
options: Density = mass × volume
Density = mass ÷ volume
Density = volume ÷ mass
Density = mass + volume
explanation: Density is calculated using the formula density = mass ÷ volume (d = m/V).
fact_tl: Ang densidad ay kinukuwenta sa pormulang densidad = masa ÷ bolyum (d = m/V).
fact_bis: Ang density gikalkula gamit ang pormula nga density = masa ÷ volume (d = m/V).

q: Which test helps doctors find out if a person has tuberculosis (TB)?
options: Testing the patient's sputum (phlegm) or taking a chest X-ray
Checking the patient's blood sugar level
Measuring the patient's blood pressure
Looking at the color of the patient's skin
explanation: Doctors diagnose TB by testing the patient's sputum (phlegm) or by taking a chest X-ray.
fact_tl: Para malaman kung may TB, sinusuri ng mga doktor ang plema ng pasyente o kumukuha ng X-ray ng dibdib.
fact_bis: Aron mahibal-an kung adunay TB, ang mga doktor mosusi sa plema sa pasyente o mokuha og X-ray sa dughan.

q: What is the main job of vitamins in your body?
options: They help the body do its work, but they are not the energy source themselves
They are the main fuel the body burns for energy
They build muscles and bones directly
They replace the need to eat regular food
explanation: Vitamins help the body work — like a hammer helps a carpenter — but they are not the energy itself.
fact_tl: Isipin mo ang bitamina na parang martilyo: tumutulong ito sa trabaho pero hindi ito ang trabahador o ang materyales. Ganoon din ang bitamina—tumutulong ito sa katawan pero hindi ito ang enerhiyang ginagamit.
fact_bis: Hunahunaa ang bitamina sama sa martilyo: motabang kini sa trabaho apan dili kini ang trabahante o ang materyales. Mao sab ang bitamina; motabang kini sa lawas apan dili kini ang kusog nga gigamit.

q: How do mosses get water and nutrients since they have no true roots?
options: They soak up water and nutrients directly through their whole body
They send out thin underground roots to collect water
They get water only from rain landing on their leaves
They absorb water through a long central stem
explanation: Mosses have no true roots and instead absorb water and nutrients through their entire body.
fact_tl: Ang lumot ay walang tunay na ugat; sa halip, sumisipsip ito ng tubig at sustansya nang diretso sa pamamagitan ng buong katawan nito.
fact_bis: Ang lumot walay tinuod nga gamot; hinuon, mosuyop kini og tubig ug sustansya direkta pinaagi sa tibuok niyang lawas.

q: What useful fiber comes from the abaca plant, which is native to the Philippines?
options: Manila hemp
Cotton
Nylon
Jute
explanation: Abaca, a plant native to the Philippines, produces a strong fiber called Manila hemp.
fact_tl: Ang abaka ay isang halamang katutubo sa Pilipinas na pinagkukunan ng matibay na hibla na tinatawag na Manila hemp.
fact_bis: Ang abaka usa ka tanom nga lumad sa Pilipinas nga gigikanan sa kusgan nga hilo nga gitawag og Manila hemp.

q: Why is leche flan often cooked while sitting in a pan of hot water?
options: The water spreads the heat evenly so the custard does not scorch at the edges
The water makes the flan cook faster at higher temperature
The water adds moisture that the flan absorbs to stay sweet
The water keeps the mold from sticking to the pan
explanation: The water bath spreads heat evenly around the flan so the edges do not dry out or scorch too quickly.
fact_tl: Madalas iluto ang leche flan na nakapaloob sa lalagyan ng mainit na tubig (water bath); ang tubig ay nagpapantay ng init kaya hindi masyadong mabilis matuyo o masunog ang gilid ng custard.
fact_bis: Kasagaran lutoon ang leche flan nga nahimutang sa sudlanan nga adunay init nga tubig (water bath); ang tubig magpatag sa kainit maong dili kaayo paspas mauga o masunog ang kilid sa custard.

q: How many vertebrae does a baby have at birth, and roughly how many does an adult have?
options: 33 at birth, about 26 as an adult
26 at birth, about 33 as an adult
33 at birth, and still 33 as an adult
26 at birth, and still 26 as an adult
explanation: Babies are born with 33 vertebrae, but some fuse together so adults end up with about 26.
fact_tl: Ang sanggol ay ipinapanganak na may 33 na vertebrae, ngunit ang ilan ay nagsasanib kaya 26 na lamang ito sa nasa hustong gulang.
fact_bis: Ang masuso natawo nga adunay 33 ka vertebrae, apan ang uban magdugtong mao nga halos 26 na lang sa hamtong.

q: How does the curved shape of a bird's wing help it fly?
options: It pushes air downward, which creates a lifting force that holds the bird up
It traps air inside to make the bird lighter than air
It acts like a sail that catches the wind from the front
It creates a spinning motion that pulls the bird upward
explanation: A bird's curved wing pushes air downward, and the reaction force lifts the bird into the air.
fact_tl: Ang hubog na hugis ng pakpak ng ibon ay nagtutulak ng hangin pababa, at ito ay lumilikha ng lakas na nagtataas sa ibon sa himpapawid.
fact_bis: Ang kurbada nga porma sa pako sa langgam nagatukmod sa hangin paubos, nga naghatag og kusog nga nagpataas sa langgam sa kahanginan.

q: Which statement about a shark's eyesight is true?
options: Sharks have good eyesight and can see even in dim, dark parts of the sea
Sharks are nearly blind and rely only on their sense of smell
Sharks can only see clearly in bright, shallow water
Sharks have no eyes at all and sense prey through vibrations alone
explanation: Sharks have good eyesight and are able to see even in the dimly lit parts of the ocean.
fact_tl: Maganda ang paningin ng pating at nakakakita ito kahit sa madilim na bahagi ng dagat.
fact_bis: Maayo ang panan-aw sa pating ug makakita kini bisan sa mangitngit nga bahin sa dagat.

q: Why do recording studios often have soft walls?
options: Soft walls absorb sound and keep it from bouncing back into the room
Soft walls make the room warmer so singers perform better
Soft walls reflect sound more clearly than hard walls
Soft walls block outside noise by being very thick
explanation: Soft materials like cloth absorb sound instead of bouncing it back, which keeps sound trapped inside the studio.
fact_tl: Ang malalambot na bagay tulad ng unan, kurtina, at tela ay humihigop ng tunog sa halip na patalbugin ito. Kaya kapag tinakpan mo ng unan ang bibig mo at sumigaw, mahina lang ang lalabas. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit may malambot na pader ang ilang recording studio—para makulong ang tunog sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang humok nga mga butang sama sa unlan, kurtina, ug panapton mosuyop sa tingog imbis nga ibalik kini. Mao nga kung tabonan nimo og unlan ang imong baba ug mosinggit, hinay ra ang mogawas. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong ang ubang recording studio adunay humok nga bongbong, aron mapugngan ang tingog sa sulod.

q: Why does rabies cause an intense fear of water (hydrophobia)?
options: The virus causes painful spasms in the throat muscles, making swallowing water terrifying
The virus destroys the taste buds, making water taste unbearably bitter
The virus attacks the eyes, making all liquids appear blinding
The virus increases thirst so much that the patient panics near water
explanation: Rabies causes throat muscle spasms, making swallowing so painful that the infected person fears water.
fact_tl: Isa sa kakaibang sintomas ng rabies ay matinding takot sa tubig. Nangyayari ito dahil hinihigpit ng virus ang mga kalamnan sa lalamunan, kaya napakasakit at nakakatakot lumunok ng tubig.
fact_bis: Usa sa katingad-an nga sintomas sa rabies mao ang grabe nga kahadlok sa tubig. Nahitabo kini tungod kay ang bayrus maghigot sa mga unod sa tutunlan, mao nga sakit ug makahahadlok motulon og tubig.

q: What are the four stages of an ant's life cycle in the correct order?
options: Egg, larva, pupa, adult
Egg, pupa, larva, adult
Larva, egg, pupa, adult
Egg, nymph, pupa, adult
explanation: An ant passes through four stages: egg, larva, pupa, and then adult.
fact_tl: Ang langgam ay dumaraan sa apat na yugto: itlog, uod (larva), pupa, at saka ganap na langgam.
fact_bis: Ang hulmigas moagi sa upat ka hugna: itlog, ulod (larva), pupa, ug dayon hingkod nga hulmigas.

q: Where do some birds make their nests by digging?
options: In a tunnel or burrow in the ground or a riverbank
In a hollow high up in a tall tree
On a floating platform of sticks on water
In a cup-shaped nest woven into a bush
explanation: Some birds dig a burrow or tunnel in the ground or a riverbank to lay their eggs safely inside.
fact_tl: May mga ibon na humuhukay ng lungga o tunel sa lupa o sa pampang upang doon mangitlog.
fact_bis: Adunay mga langgam nga nagakalot ug langub o tunel sa yuta o sa pangpang aron didto mangitlog.

q: What is it called when a very strong earthquake causes the crack of a fault to reach the surface and split the ground open?
options: Ground rupture
Liquefaction
Aftershock
Subsidence
explanation: When the Philippine Fault breaks all the way to the surface during a powerful earthquake, it is called ground rupture.
fact_tl: Kapag napakalakas ng lindol, ang basag ng Philippine Fault ay maaaring umabot hanggang sa ibabaw ng lupa. Tinatawag itong 'ground rupture'. Makikita mo ang lupa na biglang nahati o naitaas sa isang panig, kung saan minsan napuputol pati ang mga kalsada. Ito ay isa pang panganib bukod sa pagyanig.
fact_bis: Kon kusog kaayo ang linog, ang liki sa Philippine Fault mahimong moabot hangtod sa ibabaw sa yuta. Gitawag kini nga 'ground rupture'. Makita nimo ang yuta nga kalit nga mabahin o mosaka sa usa ka bahin, diin usahay maputol pati ang mga dalan. Kini lain nga kuyaw gawas sa pag-uyog.

q: Why does a rooster crow, especially in the morning?
options: To let other chickens know where it is and claim its territory
To warn predators to stay away from the farmer
To call hens to come and eat food
To ask for sunlight so it can see better
explanation: A rooster crows to announce its location and to signal to others that the area belongs to it.
fact_tl: Ang tandang ay tumitilaok ng malakas, lalo na sa umaga, para ipaalam sa ibang manok kung nasaan ito at na ito ang nagmamay-ari ng lugar na iyon.
fact_bis: Ang sunoy motilaok og kusog, ilabi na sa buntag, aron ipahibalo sa ubang manok kon asa kini ug nga kini ang tag-iya niadtong dapita.

q: How does the narra tree spread its seeds?
options: The seed sits inside a winged pod that the wind carries away
The seed has a sticky coat that clings to animals passing by
The seed floats on water when it falls into a river
The seed is eaten by birds and dropped far from the tree
explanation: The narra's seed is enclosed in a round, winged pod that can be carried by the wind.
fact_tl: Ang buto ng narra ay nasa loob ng bilog at parang may pakpak na balat na dinadala ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang binhi sa narra naa sa sulod sa lingin ug daw naay pako nga sapaw nga madala sa hangin.

q: Which type of storm has a clear eye and eyewall?
options: Only strong, fast-spinning typhoons form a clear eye and eyewall
All tropical storms, even weak ones, always have a clear eye
A tropical depression always has the clearest eye of any storm
The eye only forms in storms that move slowly over the ocean
explanation: A clear eye and eyewall only appear when the storm is spinning strongly and fast enough; weak storms like tropical depressions usually do not have them.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bagyo ay may malinaw na mata at eyewall; lumalabas lang ang mga ito kapag sapat na ang lakas at bilis ng umiikot na bagyo. Ang mahihinang bagyo o tropical depression ay madalas walang malinaw na eyewall pa.
fact_bis: Dili tanan bagyo adunay tin-aw nga mata ug eyewall; motungha lamang kini kung kusog ug paspas na ang naglikoliko nga bagyo. Ang huyang nga mga bagyo o tropical depression kasagaran walay tin-aw nga eyewall pa.

q: How many legs does a worker ant have, and why?
options: Six legs, because ants are insects and all insects have six legs
Eight legs, because ants are related to spiders
Four legs, because they are small like most tiny animals
Six legs, but only the queen ant has three body parts
explanation: A worker ant has six legs because it is an insect, and all insects have six legs and three body parts.
fact_tl: Ang worker ant ay isang insekto, kaya may anim itong paa. Tatlong bahagi rin ang katawan nito: ang ulo, ang gitna (dibdib), at ang puwitan o tiyan. Ito ang katangian ng lahat ng insekto.
fact_bis: Ang worker ant usa ka insekto, mao nga adunay unom kini ka tiil. Tulo usab ka bahin ang lawas niini: ang ulo, ang tunga (dughan), ug ang lubot o tiyan. Mao kini ang kinaiya sa tanang insekto.

q: Why is it important to keep your fingernails trimmed and clean?
options: Dirt and germs that can cause sickness hide under long nails
Long nails make it harder for your fingers to grow properly
Nails grow faster when they are left long and unclipped
Trimming nails makes them harder so they protect your fingertips better
explanation: Dirt and germs that cause sickness can hide under long nails, so keeping them short and clean helps prevent illness.
fact_tl: Mahalagang panatilihing malinis at maikli ang iyong mga kuko. Sa ilalim ng mahabang kuko ay maaaring magtago ang dumi at mikrobyo na nagdudulot ng sakit. Kapag putol at malinis ang kuko, mas kaunti ang mikrobyong napupunta sa iyong bibig kapag kumakain ka.
fact_bis: Importante nga limpyo ug mubo ang imong mga kuko. Ilawom sa taas nga kuko, matago ang hugaw ug mikrobyo nga maoy hinungdan sa sakit. Kung putol ug limpyo ang imong kuko, mas gamay ang mikrobyo nga mosulod sa imong baba kung mokaon ka.

q: How do many crabs avoid being seen by predators?
options: Their shell color matches the sand or rocks around them, making them hard to spot
They move so fast that predators cannot follow them
They produce a cloud of ink to confuse attackers
They dig straight down into the sand the moment danger appears
explanation: Many crabs use camouflage — their shell color blends with the sand or rocks — so predators have difficulty spotting them.
fact_tl: Maraming alimango ang marunong magtago sa pamamagitan ng camouflage — ang kulay ng kanilang talukab ay katugma ng buhangin o bato kaya mahirap silang mapansin. May ilang uri pa na naglalagay ng damong-dagat o maliliit na nilalang sa likod nila para magmukhang bahagi ng paligid.
fact_bis: Daghang alimango ang kahibalo motago pinaagi sa camouflage — ang kolor sa ilang talukab mohaom sa balas o bato mao nga lisod silang makita. Adunay pipila ka matang nga motapot pa og lumot sa dagat o gagmay nga binuhat sa ilang likod aron morag bahin sa palibot.

q: What problem do many Philippine dams face because of erosion on surrounding hillsides?
options: Their reservoirs fill with sediment (silt), reducing how much water they can hold
Their concrete walls crack when too much sediment flows over them
Eroded soil blocks the dam's generators and stops electricity production
Sediment makes the water too salty for the communities downstream
explanation: Rapid erosion from surrounding hills sends sediment into dam reservoirs, a process called silting, which shrinks their capacity over time.
fact_tl: Ang karamihan ng mga dam ng Pilipinas ay nagdurusa ng mabilis na 'silting' — ang pagpuno ng mga reservoir ng sediment na nagmumula sa erosion ng mga kabundukan; ang mas mabilis ang pagkasira ng kabundukan, mas mabilis na nababawasan ang kapasidad ng dam; ang Ambuklao dam ay isa sa mga halimbawa na naging mas maliit ang kapasidad dahil sa erosion.
fact_bis: Daghang mga dam sa Pilipinas nagdurusa sa paspas nga 'silting' — ang ilang mga reservoir napuno og sediment nga gikan sa erosion sa naggalibot nga mga bakilid; ang mas paspas nga nagkaguba ang mga bakilid, mas paspas nga nagkunhod ang kapasidad sa dam; ang Ambuklao dam usa ka pananglitan nga nagkunhod ang kapasidad niini sa erosion.

q: If you tap two bottles — one nearly full of water and one almost empty — which makes the lower sound, and why?
options: The fuller bottle makes a lower sound because the heavier vibrating mass moves more slowly
The emptier bottle makes a lower sound because there is more air to vibrate
Both bottles make the same sound because the tapping force is the same
The fuller bottle makes a higher sound because water carries vibrations faster
explanation: The fuller bottle vibrates more slowly because its vibrating part is heavier, which produces a lower-pitched sound.
fact_tl: Kapag tinapik mo ang isang boteng maraming tubig, mas mababa ang tunog kaysa sa boteng kaunti ang tubig. Mas mabigat ang vibrating na bahagi kaya mas mabagal mag-vibrate at mas mababa ang nota.
fact_bis: Kon imong tapikon ang botelya nga daghag tubig, mas mubo ang tingog kay sa botelya nga gamay ra ug tubig. Mas bug-at ang nag-vibrate nga bahin busa mas hinay mag-vibrate ug mas mubo ang nota.

q: How are lymph nodes arranged in the human body?
options: There are hundreds of lymph nodes connected by lymph vessels throughout the whole body
There is just one large lymph node located in the center of the chest
Lymph nodes are only found in the neck and armpits
Lymph nodes work alone with no connecting tubes between them
explanation: The body has hundreds of lymph nodes linked together by lymph vessels, forming a body-wide network like a train route with many stations.
fact_tl: Hindi lang iisa ang lymph node sa katawan; daan-daan sila na nakakonekta sa pamamagitan ng maninipis na tubo na tinatawag na lymph vessels. Magkakadugtong silang lahat na parang ruta ng tren na may maraming istasyon.
fact_bis: Dili lang usa ang lymph node sa lawas; gatusan sila nga nagkadugtong pinaagi sa nipis nga mga tubo nga gitawag og lymph vessels. Nagkadugtong silang tanan murag ruta sa tren nga daghan og estasyon.

q: Why does your hair keep growing even after you cut it?
options: The root of the hair is still alive under the skin and keeps producing new hair
The cut end of the hair heals itself and stretches back out
Hair grows from the tip, so cutting it makes the tip grow faster
Oxygen in the air makes the cut ends of hair grow longer
explanation: Hair keeps growing after a haircut because its root, which is still alive beneath the skin, continues to produce new hair.
fact_tl: Kahit gupitan mo ang buhok, patuloy itong tumutubo dahil buhay pa ang ugat nito.
fact_bis: Bisan putlan nimo ang imong buhok, padayon kini nga motubo kay buhi pa ang gamot niini.

q: What is special about a seahorse's eyes?
options: Each eye can look in a different direction at the same time
Both eyes always point forward like human eyes
A seahorse has only one eye located on top of its head
Its eyes glow in the dark to help it see at night
explanation: A seahorse's two eyes move independently, so each eye can look in a different direction at the same time.
fact_tl: Ang dalawang mata ng kabayong-dagat ay makakatingin sa magkaibang direksyon nang sabay-sabay.
fact_bis: Ang duha ka mata sa kabayo sa dagat makatan-aw sa lahi-lahi nga direksyon nga dungan.

q: Compared with most coal power plants, how efficient are modern hydroelectric turbines at converting energy into electricity?
options: Hydro turbines are more efficient, converting over 90% of water energy into electricity
Hydro turbines are less efficient, converting only about 30% of water energy
Both hydro and coal plants convert energy at exactly the same efficiency
Hydro turbines waste most of their energy as heat, just like coal plants
explanation: Modern hydro turbines convert more than 90% of the water's energy into electricity, which is higher than most coal-burning plants.
fact_tl: Ang mga modernong hydro turbine ay napakahusay, na nakakapag-convert ng higit sa siyamnapung bahagdan ng enerhiya ng tubig patungong kuryente, mas mataas kaysa sa karamihang planta ng karbon.
fact_bis: Ang modernong hydro turbine episyente kaayo, nga makahimo og kapin sa kasiyaman porsyento sa kusog sa tubig ngadto sa kuryente, mas taas kay sa kadaghanang planta sa karbon.

q: Why does electricity flow more easily through salt water than through fresh water?
options: Dissolved salts in the water allow electricity to pass through more easily
Salt water is denser, so electrons travel faster in it
Fresh water contains oxygen that blocks the flow of electricity
Salt water is colder, and cold temperatures always help conduct electricity
explanation: The dissolved salts in salt water carry electric charge, making it a better conductor than fresh water.
fact_tl: Mas madaling dumaloy ang kuryente sa maalat na tubig kaysa sa tubig-tabang dahil sa mga asin na natunaw dito.
fact_bis: Mas sayon moagi ang kuryente sa parat nga tubig kay sa tubig-tab-ang tungod sa mga asin nga natunaw niini.

q: What are valence electrons, and why are they important?
options: They are electrons in an atom's outermost shell that determine how it bonds with other atoms
They are electrons locked in the atom's core that give it its mass
They are extra electrons that atoms eject when they become too hot
They are electrons shared equally by all atoms in a material at once
explanation: Valence electrons occupy an atom's outermost shell and control how that atom bonds with other atoms.
fact_tl: Ang valence electrons ay ang mga elektron sa pinakalabas na shell ng isang atomo, at sila ang nagpapasya kung paano makikipag-bond ang atomo sa ibang atomo.
fact_bis: Ang valence electrons mao ang mga elektron sa pinakagawas nga shell sa usa ka atomo, ug sila ang magtino kon unsaon pagbugkos sa atomo sa ubang atomo.

q: What does the betel leaf taste like?
options: Sharp and slightly spicy
Very sweet, like sugarcane
Bland and tasteless like plain lettuce
Sour and bitter like a lemon
explanation: The betel leaf has a sharp, slightly spicy taste.
fact_tl: Ang dahon ng buyo ay may matalim at bahagyang maanghang na lasa.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa buyo adunay hait ug gamay nga halang nga lami.

q: Why are convex (outward-curving) mirrors used in car side mirrors and store corners?
options: They show a wider area so you can see more at once, even though objects look smaller
They make objects look larger so drivers can judge distance more accurately
They reflect light straight ahead without bending it, giving a clear image
They are cheaper to make than flat mirrors, so stores prefer them
explanation: A convex mirror curves outward to show a wider view, making it useful anywhere you need to see a large area at once.
fact_tl: Ang salamin na kurba palabas (convex) ay nagpapakita ng mas malawak na lugar ngunit nagmumukhang mas maliit ang mga bagay — kaya ginagamit ito sa side mirror ng kotse at sa mga kanto ng tindahan para makakita nang mas marami.
fact_bis: Ang salamin nga nagkurba pagawas (convex) magpakita og mas lapad nga dapit apan magpagamay sa hitsura sa mga butang — mao nga gigamit kini sa side mirror sa awto ug sa mga eskina sa tindahan aron makakita og mas daghan.

q: In karst areas like Puerto Princesa in Palawan, where does most rainwater go after it falls?
options: It sinks quickly underground through cracks in limestone and flows through caves
It collects in large surface lakes because limestone is waterproof
It evaporates almost immediately because the rock surface is very hot
It runs into rivers that carry it straight out to sea within minutes
explanation: In karst limestone areas like Puerto Princesa, rainwater sinks underground through cracks and travels through cave systems.
fact_tl: Sa mga karst na lugar tulad ng Puerto Princesa sa Palawan, ang ulan ay mabilis na sumasaong sa ilalim ng lupa sa pamamagitan ng mga bitak sa apog at lumilipas sa mga yungib.
fact_bis: Sa mga karst nga dapit sama sa Puerto Princesa sa Palawan, ang tubig-ulan dali mosak-ob sa ilalim sa yuta pinaagi sa mga liki sa apog ug moagos sa mga langub.

q: Why do plant cells look boxy while animal cells are usually round or irregular?
options: Plant cells have a rigid cell wall that gives them a boxy shape; animal cells lack this wall
Plant cells are filled with more water, which pushes them into a box shape
Animal cells have a thick membrane that rounds them into a ball shape
Plant cells are older and lose their round shape over time
explanation: The cell wall in plant cells is rigid and forces a boxy shape, while animal cells have no cell wall and are usually round or irregular.
fact_tl: Ang selula ng hayop ay kadalasang bilog o hindi tiyak ang hugis, samantalang ang selula ng halaman ay parang kahon dahil sa dingding nito.
fact_bis: Ang sélula sa hayop kasagaran lingin o dili klaro ang porma, samtang ang sélula sa tanom morag kahon tungod sa pader niini.

q: Why can having one copy of the sickle cell allele actually be an advantage in some regions?
options: It gives partial protection against malaria, so that allele survives in the population through natural selection
It makes red blood cells larger, so they carry more oxygen in warm climates
It prevents all inherited diseases from being passed on to the next generation
It allows the person to recover from any infection twice as fast as normal
explanation: People with one sickle cell allele have partial protection from malaria, which is why natural selection keeps this otherwise harmful allele in the population.
fact_tl: Ang mga may isang kopya ng sickle cell allele (heterozygous) ay may bahagyang proteksyon laban sa malaria — ito ay isang halimbawa ng bakit ang isang nakakapinsalang allele ay maaaring manatili sa populasyon dahil sa natural selection.
fact_bis: Ang mga adunay usa ka kopya sa sickle cell allele (heterozygous) adunay bahagyang proteksyon batok sa malaria — kini usa ka halimbawa kung ngano ang usa ka makadaot nga allele mahimong magpabilin sa usa ka populasyon tungod sa natural selection.

q: When a cannon fires a ball forward, why does the cannon itself push backward?
options: The total momentum must stay balanced, so the cannon pushes back as the ball moves forward
The explosion releases heat that pushes equally on all sides, including backward
The cannon is heavier than the ball, so gravity pulls it in the opposite direction
Friction between the ball and the barrel forces the cannon to move the other way
explanation: When a cannon fires, the ball's forward momentum and the cannon's backward momentum must balance each other — this is conservation of momentum.
fact_tl: Kapag pumutok ang isang kanyon, ang bala ay lumilipad pasulong habang ang kanyon ay umuurong pabalik, dahil ang kabuuang momentum ay dapat manatiling pantay.
fact_bis: Kung mobuto ang usa ka kanyon, ang bala molupad pasulong samtang ang kanyon moatras balik, kay ang kinatibuk-ang momentum kinahanglan magpabilin nga balanse.

q: In which year was Pluto discovered?
explanation: Pluto was discovered in 1930.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Pluto noong taong 1930.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ang Pluto niadtong tuig 1930.

q: Why can it be hard to tell if a sound is coming from directly in front of you or directly behind you?
options: A sound from straight ahead and one from straight behind reach both ears at the same time and loudness, so the brain cannot easily tell them apart
The ears are blocked by hair and cannot hear sounds coming from behind at all
Low-pitched sounds always seem to come from in front while high-pitched ones come from behind
The brain automatically assumes all sounds come from in front to save thinking time
explanation: When a sound hits both ears at exactly the same time and loudness, the brain has no timing difference to use, making front and back sounds easy to confuse.
fact_tl: May tunog na nasa harapan mo at may tunog na nasa likod na pareho ang layo sa dalawang tainga. Kapag ganito, sabay silang dumarating at pareho ang lakas, kaya minsan nalilito ka kung galing ba sa harap o likod. Dito ka kailangang lumingon para masigurado.
fact_bis: Ang tingog nga anaa sa imong atubangan ug ang anaa sa luyo mahimong managsama ang gilay-on sa duha ka dalunggan. Kung mao kini, dungan sila moabot ug parehas ang kusog, mao nga usahay maglibog ka kung gikan ba sa atubangan o luyo hangtod nga molingi ka.

q: Which crops are known to grow well even in soil that is not very fertile?
options: Root crops like kamote (sweet potato) and cassava
Rice and corn, which need rich paddy soil
Mango and banana trees, which need deep fertile ground
Tomatoes and peppers, which only grow in well-fertilized garden beds
explanation: Root crops like kamote and cassava can grow even in poor, less fertile soil.
fact_tl: Ang mga halamang-ugat tulad ng kamote at cassava ay kayang tumubo kahit sa lupang hindi gaanong mataba.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nga ugat sama sa kamote ug cassava makatubo bisan sa yuta nga dili kaayo tambok.

q: What is one way people are helping to prevent the Visayan warty pig from dying out?
options: Breeding and caring for some of them in safe conservation centers
Releasing large numbers of pigs onto all islands at once
Hunting older pigs so younger ones have more food to eat
Moving them to zoos in other countries so they are no longer endangered in the Philippines
explanation: To prevent extinction, some Visayan warty pigs are bred and raised in dedicated conservation centers.
fact_tl: Para hindi tuluyang maubos, inaalagaan at pinaparami ang ilang Visayan warty pig sa mga ligtas na sentro ng konserbasyon.
fact_bis: Aron dili mapuo, ang ubang Visayan warty pig gibuhi ug gipadaghan sa luwas nga mga sentro sa konserbasyon.

q: How do newly hatched sea turtles find their way to the ocean?
options: They head toward the brightest part of the horizon, which is normally the reflective sea
They follow the smell of salt water using special sensors in their nose
They watch their mother return to the sea and then follow the same path
They are guided by the pull of the moon's gravity toward the water
explanation: Hatchling sea turtles instinctively crawl toward the brightest part of the horizon, which is usually the light reflected off the sea.
fact_tl: Ang mga batang pawikan na nanggaling sa pugad ay nagtutungo sa pinakamagniningning na bahagi ng abot-tanaw — karaniwang ang baguhin na dagat — upang makarating sa tubig; ang mga artipisyal na ilaw sa baybayon ay maaaring mag-confuse sa kanila at pangunahan sila palayo mula sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong nangalabas nga mga pawikan nagtungo sa pinaka-liwanag nga bahin sa abot-tan-aw — kasagaran ang nagpakita nga dagat — aron makaabut sa tubig; ang mga artipisyal nga suga sa baybayon mahimong malibog sila ug dad-on sila palayo gikan sa dagat.

q: Which Philippine waterfall is famous for producing electricity?
options: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan, which powers the Agus VI hydroelectric plant
Pagsanjan Falls in Laguna, which runs a large turbine for Metro Manila
Aliwangwang Falls in Benguet, which supplies power to Northern Luzon
Tinago Falls in Lanao del Norte, which powers a government water pump
explanation: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan City powers the Agus VI hydroelectric plant, making it the country's most famous electricity-generating waterfall.
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan ang talon na gumagawa ng kuryente, dahil pinapagana nito ang Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.
fact_bis: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan mao ang busay nga naghimo ug kuryente, kay gipalihok niini ang Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.

q: How does a movable pulley attached to a load make lifting easier?
options: It reduces the force you need to about half of the load's weight
It doubles the force you can apply so you can lift twice as much
It eliminates the need for any force because the pulley does all the work
It makes the rope longer so you have more time to pull the load up
explanation: A movable pulley attached to the load spreads the weight between two rope segments, cutting the required lifting force to about half.
fact_tl: Ang natitinag na kalo na nakakabit sa bagay ay maaaring magbawas ng pwersang kailangan halos sa kalahati.
fact_bis: Ang mabalhin nga polea nga gibutang sa karga makapakunhod sa gikinahanglan nga kusog ngadto sa mga katunga.

q: Which Philippine government department oversees both PHIVOLCS and PAGASA?
options: Department of Science and Technology (DOST)
Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
Department of National Defense (DND)
Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)
explanation: Both PHIVOLCS (volcanoes and earthquakes) and PAGASA (weather) operate under the Department of Science and Technology (DOST).
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS at PAGASA ay parehong nasa ilalim ng Department of Science and Technology (DOST).
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS ug PAGASA parehong sakop sa Department of Science and Technology (DOST).

q: How can an eel move from one body of water to another when there is no river connecting them?
options: It can wriggle across damp ground on land to reach the next body of water
It leaps into the air and glides like a flying fish to cross land
It waits for heavy rain to create a temporary stream it can swim through
It burrows underground and follows water-soaked soil until it reaches water
explanation: Over damp ground, an eel can wriggle across land to reach another body of water when needed.
fact_tl: Sa basang lupa, kayang gumapang ng igat patungo sa ibang tubig kapag kailangan.
fact_bis: Sa basa nga yuta, makahimo ang kasili sa pagkamang paingon sa lain nga tubig kung kinahanglanon.

q: Why do muscles usually work in pairs in the body?
options: Muscles can only pull, not push, so one muscle contracts to move a limb while its partner relaxes to move it back
Muscles can only push, not pull, so they need a partner to do the pulling
One muscle in each pair provides energy while the other muscle does the actual movement
Paired muscles make movements slower and more controlled, which protects bones from breaking
explanation: Because muscles can only pull (not push), they work in pairs: one contracts to bend a joint while the other relaxes to allow the opposite movement.
fact_tl: Ang mga kalamnan ay humihila lamang at hindi nagtutulak, kaya madalas silang nagtatrabaho nang magkapares: habang umuurong ang isa para iyuko ang braso, namamahinga ang kabila para iunat ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga kaunoran makabira lamang ug dili makatukmod, mao nga sagad sila magtrabaho nga magtinagduha: mokunot ang usa aron balukon ang bukton samtang mopahulay ang pikas aron itul-id kini.

q: What happens during the pupa stage of a mosquito's life?
options: The mosquito does not eat but rests and changes into an adult inside the pupa case
The pupa eats more food than any other stage to fuel its rapid growth
The pupa swims actively and bites animals to get the blood it needs
The pupa breaks open immediately and the adult mosquito jumps out after one day
explanation: During the pupa stage, the mosquito does not eat; it rests and undergoes the changes that transform it into an adult.
fact_tl: Sa yugtong pupa, hindi na kumakain ang lamok kundi nagpapahinga at nagbabago bago lumabas bilang matandang lamok.
fact_bis: Sa hugnang pupa, dili na mokaon ang lamok kondili mopahulay ug mag-usab sa dili pa kini mogula nga hamtong nga lamok.

q: What are the stages of a grasshopper's life cycle?
options: Egg, nymph, and adult grasshopper
Egg, larva, pupa, and adult grasshopper
Egg, pupa, and adult grasshopper
Larva, nymph, pupa, and adult grasshopper
explanation: A grasshopper undergoes incomplete metamorphosis with only three stages: egg, nymph, and adult.
fact_tl: Ang tipaklong ay dumaraan sa di-buong metamorphosis: itlog, nimpa, at matandang tipaklong.
fact_bis: Ang apan moagi sa dili kompletong metamorphosis: itlog, nympha, ug hamtong nga apan.

q: What happens to telomeres as cells keep dividing over time, and how does this relate to aging?
options: Telomeres get shorter with each division; when too short, the cell stops dividing and the tissue ages
Telomeres get longer with each division, eventually causing the cell to burst and die
Telomeres stay the same length but become less active, which slows the cell down
Telomeres have nothing to do with aging; it is only caused by damage from sunlight
explanation: Telomeres shorten with each cell division, and when they become too short the cell can no longer divide, contributing to tissue aging.
fact_tl: Ang pagtanda ay bahagyang sanhi ng pagikli ng mga telomere sa bawat cell division — kapag naging napakaikli na ang mga telomere, ang selula ay humihinto na sa pagdibide at nagdudulot ng pagkatanda ng tissue.
fact_bis: Ang pagtanda bahagyang tungod sa pagkubos sa gitas-on sa mga telomere sa matag cell division — sa dihang ang mga telomere mahimong mubo na kaayo, ang selula mohunong sa pagdibiside ug ang tissue magtanda.

q: Some snake venoms are called neurotoxins. What do neurotoxins attack?
options: The nerves
The blood and tissue
The skin and scales
The digestive organs
explanation: Neurotoxins in snake venom attack the nervous system, while other venoms destroy blood and tissue instead.
fact_tl: May mga kamandag ng ahas na umaatake sa nerbiyo (neurotoxin) at may iba namang sumisira sa dugo at laman.
fact_bis: Adunay kamandag sa bitin nga moataki sa nerbiyo (neurotoxin) ug aduna say uban nga moguba sa dugo ug unod.

q: Which group makes up most of the elements on the periodic table?
options: Metals, which are usually shiny and conduct electricity and heat well
Gases, because most elements are invisible at room temperature
Nonmetals, because they are more common in nature than metals
Liquids, because many elements melt easily at low temperatures
explanation: Most elements are metals, which are generally shiny and good conductors of both electricity and heat.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga elemento ay mga metal, na karaniwang makintab at mahusay magdaloy ng kuryente at init.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga elemento mga metal, nga kasagaran masinaw ug maayong magpaagi sa kuryente ug kainit.

q: How many protons does a sulfur (S) atom have?
explanation: Sulfur has an atomic number of 16, which means it has 16 protons in its nucleus.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng sulfur (S) ay 16, kaya may 16 proton ito.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number sa sulfur (S) kay 16, mao nga naa kini 16 ka proton.

q: Why can we see the Moon shining at night even though it is dark?
options: The Moon reflects sunlight toward Earth — it does not make its own light
The Moon produces its own light from a fire inside it, like a smaller Sun
The Moon glows because it is very hot from billions of years of spinning
The Moon collects sunlight during the day and releases it slowly at night
explanation: The Moon makes no light of its own; we see it because sunlight bounces off its surface and travels to our eyes.
fact_tl: Hindi gumagawa ng sariling ilaw ang buwan. Nagniningning ito dahil tinatamaan ito ng ilaw ng araw at tumatalbog ang ilaw na iyon papunta sa Earth. Kaya nakikita natin ang buwan kahit gabi.
fact_bis: Ang buwan walay kaugalingong kahayag. Mahayag kini tungod kay ang kahayag sa adlaw mutama niini ug mubalik kanang kahayag paingon sa Earth. Mao nga makita nato ang buwan bisan sa gabii.

q: Why do bigger and heavier trees need deeper roots?
options: To anchor themselves so they do not fall over easily
To collect more sunlight from underground
To store extra fruit and seeds below the soil
To push water up to the leaves faster
explanation: Bigger and heavier plants need stronger, deeper roots so they are firmly anchored in the ground and do not topple over.
fact_tl: Mas malaki at mas mabigat na halaman ay kailangang mas matibay at mas malalim na ugat. Kung hindi sapat ang ugat, madaling matutumba ang malaking puno.
fact_bis: Mas dako ug mas bug-at nga tanom nagkinahanglan og mas lig-on ug mas lawom nga gamot. Kung dili igo ang gamot, dali matumba ang dakong kahoy.

q: Where do whales travel to give birth to their young?
options: To warm parts of the ocean
To deep, cold ocean trenches
To freshwater rivers near the coast
To shallow coral reef areas
explanation: Whales migrate to warm parts of the ocean to give birth before returning to cold, food-rich waters.
fact_tl: Naglalakbay ang mga balyena sa mainit na bahagi ng dagat upang doon manganak bago bumalik sa malamig na tubig na maraming pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga balyena mobiyahe sa init nga bahin sa dagat aron didto manganak una mobalik sa bugnaw nga tubig nga daghag pagkaon.

q: How many Tropical Cyclone Wind Signals does PAGASA use to warn the public about typhoons?
explanation: PAGASA uses 5 Tropical Cyclone Wind Signals, ranging from Signal No. 1 (weakest) to Signal No. 5 (strongest).
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang PAGASA ng 5 Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal, mula Signal No. 1 (pinakamahina) hanggang Signal No. 5 (pinakamalakas).
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA naggamit ug 5 ka Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal, gikan sa Signal No. 1 (pinakahuyang) ngadto sa Signal No. 5 (pinakakusog).

q: How does a katydid hide from predators on a leafy tree?
options: Its body mimics the shape and color of leaves so it blends in
It stays motionless underground during the day
It produces a loud sound that startles predators
It releases a foul smell that drives predators away
explanation: Katydids are grasshopper relatives whose bodies mimic leaves so well they are nearly impossible to spot — a form of camouflage called crypsis.
fact_tl: Ang mga katydid ay kamag-anak ng tipaklong na may katawan na kamukhang dahon para magtago sa mga mandarambong—halos imposible silang makita sa isang punong dahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga katydid paryente sa tipaklong nga ang lawas nagkamuha og dahon aron magtago sa mga manunukob—hapit imposible ang pagkita kanila sa usa ka dahonon nga kahoy—usa ka porma sa crypsis.

q: How many queens does an ant colony usually have?
options: One
Three
Several dozen
None — workers take turns
explanation: An ant colony usually has one queen, and she is the one who lays all the eggs for the entire colony.
fact_tl: Karaniwang may isang (1) reyna ang isang kolonya ng langgam, at siya ang nangingitlog para sa buong kolonya.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka kolonya sa hulmigas kasagaran adunay usa (1) ka rayna, ug siya ang mangitlog para sa tibuok kolonya.

q: What is the thick outer covering of a woody stem called, and what does it protect the tree from?
options: Bark; it protects the tree from heat, insects, and disease
Pith; it protects the tree from wind and floods
Cambium; it protects the tree from lack of water
Epidermis; it protects the tree from too much sunlight
explanation: The thick outer covering of a woody stem is called bark, which protects the tree from heat, insects, and disease much like skin protects our body.
fact_tl: Ang makapal na balat sa labas ng matigas na tangkay ay tinatawag na bark. Ito ang nagsisilbing panangga ng puno laban sa init, insekto, at sakit, gaya ng balat na nagpoprotekta sa ating katawan.
fact_bis: Ang baga nga panit sa gawas sa gahi nga punoan gitawag og bark. Kini maoy nagpanalipod sa kahoy batok sa init, insekto, ug sakit, sama sa atong panit nga nagpanalipod sa atong lawas.

q: What is one important job that tears do for your eyes?
options: They wash out dirt and germs so the eye does not get sick
They help the eye see colors more clearly
They warm the eye when the air is cold
They make the eye grow bigger as you age
explanation: Tears wash dirt and germs out of the eye, keeping it clean and healthy.
fact_tl: Naghuhugas ang luha ng dumi at mikrobyo palabas ng mata para hindi ito magkasakit.
fact_bis: Mohugas ang luha sa hugaw ug mikrobyo paggawas sa mata aron dili kini masakit.

q: Why do DC motors need their carbon brushes replaced regularly?
options: The brushes wear out from rubbing against the commutator over time
The brushes absorb too much electricity and must be recharged
The brushes melt from the heat of the spinning magnets
The brushes expand and crack when the motor gets wet
explanation: A DC motor's carbon brushes wear out over time from constantly rubbing against the commutator, making replacement one of the main maintenance tasks.
fact_tl: Ang mga carbon brush ng isang DC motor ay nagkakasuot habang tumatagal dahil sa kanilang patuloy na pakikipag-ugnayan sa commutator — ang pagpapalit ng mga brush nang regular ay isa sa mga pangunahing maintenance ng DC motor.
fact_bis: Ang mga carbon brush sa usa ka DC motor nagkakaluya sa paglabay sa panahon tungod sa padayon nga pagrublag sa commutator — ang palaglay nga pagpalit sa mga brush usa sa panguna nga maintenance sa DC motor.

q: Why is the weather in the Philippines hot and humid all year round?
options: Because the Philippines is close to the equator
Because the Philippines is covered mostly by mountains
Because the Philippines has very few forests left
Because the Philippines is far from any ocean breeze
explanation: The Philippines has a tropical climate and is hot and humid throughout the year because it lies close to the equator.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may tropikong klima, ibig sabihin ay mainit at mahalumigmig ang panahon sa buong taon dahil malapit ito sa ekwador.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay tropikal nga klima, ang kahulogan niini mainit ug basa ang panahon sa tibuok tuig tungod kay duol kini sa ekwador.

q: What are the four main layers of the Earth, listed from the outside in?
options: Crust, mantle, outer core, inner core
Crust, lava, magma, inner core
Atmosphere, crust, mantle, outer core
Soil, bedrock, magma, inner core
explanation: The Earth has 4 main layers: the crust, the mantle, the outer core, and the inner core.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay may 4 na pangunahing layer: crust, mantle, outer core, at inner core.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta adunay 4 ka mga nag-unang layer: ang crust, mantle, outer core, ug inner core.

q: What is a comet made of that gives it the nickname 'dirty snowball'?
options: Ice, dust, and rock mixed together
Hot gases and glowing plasma
Solid iron and nickel metals
Clouds of hydrogen and helium
explanation: A comet is a ball of ice, dust, and rock orbiting the Sun — the mix of frozen ice and bits of rock earned it the nickname 'dirty snowball.'
fact_tl: Ang kometa (comet) ay isang malaking bola ng yelo, alikabok, at bato na umiikot sa Araw. Madalas itong tinatawag na 'maruming bola ng yelo' dahil halo-halo ang yelo at durog na bato sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang kometa (comet) usa ka dako nga bola sa yelo, abog, ug bato nga nagatuyok sa Adlaw. Sagad kini gitawag nga 'hugaw nga bola sa yelo' kay sagol ang yelo ug dugmok nga bato sa sulod niini.

q: Why are fireworks described as exothermic reactions?
options: Because they release heat, light, and sound into the surroundings
Because they absorb heat from the air to explode
Because they only change color without releasing energy
Because they convert light energy into chemical energy
explanation: Fireworks are exothermic because they release heat, light, and sound during the reaction.
fact_tl: Ang mga paputok sa Bagong Taon ay exothermic dahil naglalabas sila ng init, liwanag, at tunog.
fact_bis: Ang mga paputok sa Bag-ong Tuig exothermic kay nagpagawas sila ug kainit, kahayag, ug tingog.

q: What two forces does a bird create when it flaps its wings?
options: Lift, which holds it up, and thrust, which pushes it forward
Lift, which slows it down, and drag, which pushes it forward
Gravity, which holds it up, and thrust, which turns it left
Friction, which holds it up, and thrust, which lands it safely
explanation: A bird flaps its broad wings to make both lift (holding it up) and thrust (pushing it forward), aided by its light bones and feathers.
fact_tl: Pumapagaspas ang ibon gamit ang malalapad na pakpak para gumawa ng lift na nagtataas sa kanila at thrust na nagpapasulong. Ang magaan nilang buto at balahibo ay tumutulong para makalipad sila.
fact_bis: Ang langgam mokapay sa lapad niini nga mga pako aron mohimo og lift nga magsapnay niini ug thrust nga moduso pasulong. Ang gaan nga bukog ug balahibo niini makatabang aron makalupad kini.

q: Which of these everyday objects uses a magnet?
options: A refrigerator door
A glass window
A plastic ruler
A wooden spoon
explanation: Magnets are used in everyday things like refrigerator doors, speakers, and toys.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang mga magnet sa pang-araw-araw na bagay tulad ng pinto ng ref, speaker, at laruan.
fact_bis: Ang mga magnet gigamit sa adlaw-adlaw nga mga butang sama sa pultahan sa pridyider, speaker, ug dulaan.

q: How many consecutive terms may a Philippine senator serve?
options: Two consecutive terms
Three consecutive terms
One term only
Four consecutive terms
explanation: A Philippine senator may serve no more than two consecutive terms.
fact_tl: Ang isang senador ay maaaring maglingkod nang hindi hihigit sa dalawang (2) sunod-sunod na termino.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka senador mahimong moserbisyo og dili molabaw sa duha (2) ka sunod-sunod nga termino.

q: In what year was the Hubble Space Telescope launched into space?
explanation: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched into space in 1990.
fact_tl: Ang Hubble Space Telescope ay inilunsad sa kalawakan noong 1990.
fact_bis: Ang Hubble Space Telescope gilunsad sa kawanangan niadtong 1990.

q: How is the tamaraw's social behavior different from the carabao?
options: The tamaraw usually lives alone, while carabao stay together in herds
The tamaraw forms large herds, while carabao live alone
The tamaraw and carabao both live in herds of the same size
The tamaraw lives near people, while carabao avoid humans
explanation: Unlike carabao that stay in herds, the tamaraw usually lives alone and is very shy, avoiding people.
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng kalabaw na sama-sama sa grupo, ang tamaraw ay kadalasang nag-iisa at mailap. Umiiwas ito sa tao, kaya mahirap silang makita at mas mahirap silang bantayan.
fact_bis: Dili sama sa kalabaw nga nag-uban sa grupo, ang tamaraw kasagarang nag-inusara ug maulaw kaayo. Maglikay kini sa tawo, mao nga lisod silang makita ug mas lisod bantayan.

q: What was the spinning jenny invented to do?
options: Spin many threads at once for making cloth
Weave finished cloth into patterns automatically
Cut raw cotton into short fibers quickly
Dye thread using water-powered wheels
explanation: The spinning jenny was used to spin many threads at once, speeding up the production of cloth.
fact_tl: Ang spinning jenny ay ginamit para makahabi ng maraming sinulid nang sabay-sabay sa paggawa ng tela.
fact_bis: Ang spinning jenny gigamit aron makatuod ug daghang sinulid sa dungan alang sa paghimo ug panapton.

q: Why is melting ice considered a physical change and not a chemical change?
options: Because the water only changes form from solid to liquid but is still water
Because the water splits into hydrogen and oxygen gases
Because the cold ice turns into a completely new substance
Because the melting process releases a large amount of heat energy
explanation: Melting ice is a physical change because only the form changes (solid to liquid) — it is still water.
fact_tl: Ang pagkatunaw ng yelo ay pisikal na pagbabago dahil tubig pa rin ito, nag-iba lang ang anyo mula solido patungong likido.
fact_bis: Ang pagkatunaw sa yelo kay pisikal nga kabag-ohan kay tubig man gihapon kini, ang porma lang ang nausab gikan solido ngadto likido.

q: What is one advantage of ORS (oral rehydration solution) over IV fluids for mild diarrhea?
options: ORS can be taken by mouth at home and is cheap, making it safer for most mild cases
ORS works faster than IV fluids because it enters the bloodstream directly
ORS must be given at a hospital by a nurse to work correctly
ORS is only safe for adults, while IV is better for children
explanation: ORS is taken by mouth, is inexpensive, and can be used even at home, making it enough and safer for most mild diarrhea cases.
fact_tl: Ano ang pinagkaiba ng ORS sa IV (swero)? Ang ORS ay iniinom sa bibig, mura, at kayang gawin kahit sa bahay. Ang IV ay direktang ipinapasok sa ugat sa ospital, para sa malubhang kaso. Para sa karamihan ng banayad na pagtatae, sapat na at mas ligtas ang ORS.
fact_bis: Unsa ang kalainan sa ORS ug IV (swero)? Ang ORS giinom sa baba, barato, ug mahimo bisan sa balay. Ang IV direktang gisuksok sa ugat sa ospital, para sa grabe nga kaso. Para sa kadaghanan nga gaan nga kalibang, igo na ug mas luwas ang ORS.

q: How does a fever help the body fight an illness?
options: The extra heat slows down how fast some germs can multiply
The high temperature destroys all white blood cells quickly
The fever cools the blood so germs cannot travel through it
The body raises temperature to stop the heart from beating faster
explanation: A fever helps the body fight illness because the extra heat slows down how some germs multiply.
fact_tl: Ang lagnat ay paraan ng katawan para labanan ang sakit dahil ang init ay nagpapabagal sa pagdami ng ilang mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang hilanat usa ka paagi sa lawas sa pagpakig-away sa sakit kay ang init makapahinay sa pagdaghan sa pipila ka mikrobyo.

q: Which planet spins the fastest in our solar system?
options: Jupiter
Saturn
Earth
Mars
explanation: Jupiter is the fastest-spinning planet, completing one full rotation in only about 10 hours.
fact_tl: Ang Jupiter ang pinakamabilis umikot na planeta, isang ikot kada halos 10 oras lamang.
fact_bis: Ang Jupiter mao ang pinakapaspas motuyok nga planeta, usa ka tuyok kada mga 10 ka oras lamang.

q: If tectonic plates move only a few centimeters a year, why do earthquakes happen suddenly?
options: Pressure builds up slowly over time until it releases all at once as an earthquake
Plates speed up dramatically just before an earthquake strikes
Rain water lubricates the plates causing them to suddenly slip
Volcanic eruptions push the plates apart in one sharp movement
explanation: Although plates move very slowly (about as fast as fingernails grow), pressure builds up bit by bit until it suddenly releases as an earthquake.
fact_tl: Bakit biglaan ang lindol kung mabagal naman gumalaw ang mga plate? Gumagalaw lang ang mga plate nang ilang sentimetro bawat taon, kasimbagal ng paglaki ng kuko. Pero unti-unting naiipon ang presyon hanggang sa biglang bumitaw ito bilang lindol.
fact_bis: Nganong kalit ang linog kon hinay ra man molihok ang mga plate? Ang mga plate molihok lang og pipila ka sentimetro kada tuig, sama kahinay sa pagtubo sa kuko. Apan hinay-hinay nga magtigom ang presyon hangtod kalit kining mobuhi isip linog.

q: How can children help protect the ocean from illegal fishing?
options: By avoiding and reporting blast and cyanide fishing
By catching and releasing as many fish as possible themselves
By building their own fish cages in shallow reefs
By diving to plant new coral fragments every week
explanation: Children can help by avoiding and reporting illegal fishing practices such as blast fishing and cyanide fishing.
fact_tl: Makatutulong ang mga bata sa pag-iwas at pagsusumbong ng iligal na pangingisda tulad ng pangbobomba at cyanide.
fact_bis: Ang mga bata makatabang pinaagi sa paglikay ug pagreport sa iligal nga pagpangisda sama sa pagbomba ug cyanide.

q: Who gave hydrogen its name, and what does that name mean?
options: Antoine Lavoisier; it means 'water-former'
Isaac Newton; it means 'lightest element'
Dmitri Mendeleev; it means 'colorless gas'
Henry Cavendish; it means 'invisible fire'
explanation: Antoine Lavoisier named hydrogen, and the name means 'water-former.'
fact_tl: Si Antoine Lavoisier ang nagbigay ng pangalang "hydrogen," na ang ibig sabihin ay "gumagawa ng tubig."
fact_bis: Si Antoine Lavoisier ang naghatag sa ngalang "hydrogen," nga nagpasabot og "maghimo og tubig."

q: Why does a bayawak (monitor lizard) bask in sunlight before it becomes active?
options: Because it is cold-blooded and needs the sun's warmth to raise its body temperature
Because sunlight makes its skin produce the vitamins it needs to hunt
Because the bright light helps it spot insects hiding in the grass
Because basking in the sun signals other lizards to stay away
explanation: As a cold-blooded animal, the bayawak basks in sunlight to raise its body temperature before becoming active.
fact_tl: Bilang isang cold-blooded na hayop, ang bayawak ay nagpapainit sa sikat ng araw para mapanatili ang tamang temperatura ng katawan bago mag-aktibo.
fact_bis: Isip cold-blooded nga hayop, ang bayawak nagpainit sa sinagol sa adlaw aron mapataas ang temperatura sa lawas ayha mag-aktibo.

q: What kind of reaction is combustion, and what does it require besides fuel?
options: A chemical reaction that needs oxygen and gives off heat and light
A physical change that requires only heat to make things glow
A nuclear reaction that splits atoms to release energy
A biological process that living cells use to produce warmth
explanation: Combustion is a chemical reaction in which fuel combines with oxygen and releases heat and light.
fact_tl: Ang pagkasunog (combustion) ay isang reaksyong kemikal kung saan ang panggatong ay sumasanib sa oksiheno at naglalabas ng init at liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang pagkasunog (combustion) usa ka reaksiyong kemikal diin ang sugnod makighiusa sa oksiheno ug mohatag ug kainit ug kahayag.

q: What do members of a cooperative do to help each other?
options: They pool their money and resources together to buy what they couldn't afford alone
They compete against each other to get the lowest prices at the market
They elect a president who controls all the money for the group
They take turns borrowing the same set of tools one at a time
explanation: In a cooperative, members pool their savings and resources — for example, farmers combining money to buy seeds or equipment they couldn't afford alone.
fact_tl: Sa kooperatiba, sama-samang nag-iipon at nagtutulungan ang mga miyembro—halimbawa, mga magsasaka na nagsasama-sama ng pondo para makabili ng binhi o kagamitan na hindi nila kayang bilhin nang mag-isa.
fact_bis: Sa kooperatiba, ang mga miyembro magtipig ug magtinabangay—pananglitan, mga mag-uuma nga magtapok og pondo aron makapalit og binhi o kagamitan nga dili nila makaya og inusara.

q: In which region is the geographic center of the Philippines located?
options: The Visayas region
The National Capital Region (Metro Manila)
The Cordillera region in Northern Luzon
The Bangsamoro region in Mindanao
explanation: The geographic center of the Philippines is estimated to be in the Visayas region, near the middle of the archipelago.
fact_tl: Ang heograpikong sentro ng Pilipinas ay tinatantiyang nasa rehiyon ng Visayas, malapit sa gitna ng kapuluan na naghihiwalay sa mga grupo ng Luzon, Visayas, at Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang heograpikong sentro sa Pilipinas gibanabana nga anaa sa rehiyon sa Visayas, duol sa tunga sa kapuluanan nga nagseparar sa mga grupo sa isla sa Luzon, Visayas, ug Mindanao.

q: How do some bacteria move through their environment?
options: By spinning a tiny tail like a propeller to swim
By walking on hundreds of tiny legs
By releasing a gas that pushes them forward
By rolling along a slime trail they produce
explanation: Some bacteria move using a flagellum — a tiny tail that spins like a boat propeller — to swim toward food or away from danger.
fact_tl: May mga bacteria na kayang gumalaw gamit ang isang maliit na buntot na parang latigo. Iniikot nila ito na parang propeller ng bangka para makalangoy patungo sa pagkain o palayo sa panganib. Hindi lahat ng bacteria ay may ganito, pero malaking tulong ito sa mga may buntot.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bacteria nga makalihok gamit ang gamay nga ikog nga sama sa latigo. Gituyok nila kini sama sa propeller sa bangka aron molangoy paingon sa pagkaon o palayo sa kakuyaw. Dili tanang bacteria adunay ani, pero dako kini nga tabang alang sa mga adunay ikog.

q: Because a tarsier's enormous eyes cannot rotate in their sockets, what can a tarsier do instead?
options: Rotate its head 180 degrees in each direction to look around
Blink very rapidly to scan different directions
Move only its eyebrows to shift its field of view
Close one eye at a time to see in front and behind
explanation: The Philippine tarsier's eyes cannot rotate, so it compensates by rotating its head 180 degrees in each direction to look around.
fact_tl: Ang tarsier ng Pilipinas ay nag-evolve ng napakalaking mga mata na hindi nila ito mapaikot — kaya naman ang tarsier ay maaaring mag-ikot ng ulo nang 180 degrees sa bawat direksyon upang makita ang paligid nito.
fact_bis: Ang tarsier sa Pilipinas nag-evolve og napakalaking mga mata nga dili nila mapaikot sa socket — busa ang tarsier makapalihok og ulo og 180 degrees sa matag direksyon aron makita ang palibot.

q: What causes a solar eclipse to occur?
options: The Moon passes between the Earth and the Sun, blocking the Sun
The Earth passes between the Moon and the Sun, blocking the Sun
The Sun moves behind the Moon as the Sun orbits the Earth
Clouds cover the entire Sun during a thunderstorm
explanation: A solar eclipse happens when the Moon passes between the Earth and the Sun and blocks the Sun's light.
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon ng solar eclipse (eklipse ng Araw) kapag dumaan ang Buwan sa pagitan ng Earth at Araw at natatakpan nito ang Araw.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang solar eclipse (eklipse sa Adlaw) kung ang Bulan moagi sa tunga sa Yuta ug Adlaw ug motabon sa Adlaw.

q: In an electric car, what happens to some of the energy when the brakes are applied?
options: The motor acts as a generator and returns some energy back to the battery
The energy is converted to heat and released through the exhaust pipe
The battery stores the kinetic energy directly without any conversion
The brakes store the energy in a spring for the next acceleration
explanation: In electric cars, the motor can act as a generator during braking, returning some energy to the battery — called regenerative braking.
fact_tl: Sa mga electric car, ang motor ay maaaring magsilbing generator kapag nagpepreno, kaya nababawi ang ilang enerhiya pabalik sa baterya.
fact_bis: Sa mga electric car, ang motor mahimong mag-alagad isip generator kon mopreno, mao nga ang ubang enerhiya mabalik sa baterya.

q: Why does a pure metal conduct electricity better than an alloy (a metal mixed with other elements)?
options: In a pure metal the atoms are neatly arranged so electrons flow smoothly, while mixed-in atoms disrupt the flow
In a pure metal electricity travels more slowly, giving it time to build up more power
Alloys have extra free electrons that block the electrical current inside the metal
Pure metals are heavier, and heavier materials always carry more electricity
explanation: In a pure metal, neatly arranged atoms let electrons flow smoothly, but mixed-in atoms in an alloy disrupt the path, so electricity flows less easily.
fact_tl: Mas mahusay magdala ng kuryente ang purong metal kaysa sa metal na may halo. Sa purong metal, maayos ang pagkakaayos ng mga atomo kaya maayos ang daloy ng electron. Kapag may ibang uri ng atomo na nakahalo (gaya ng sa asero), nagulo ang daanan at bumabangga ang mga electron, kaya bahagyang humihina ang daloy ng kuryente.
fact_bis: Mas maayo modala sa kuryente ang lunsay nga metal kay sa metal nga gisagol ug uban. Sa lunsay nga metal, hapsay ang pagkahan-ay sa mga atomo, mao nga hapsay ang dagan sa electron. Kung adunay laing matang sa atomo nga gisagol (sama sa asero), magubot ang agianan ug mag-bangga ang mga electron, mao nga gamay nga mohuyang ang dagan sa kuryente.

q: What does Republic Act 11036, the Philippine Mental Health Act, establish?
options: The right to receive mental health services and protection against discrimination for people with mental illness
The requirement that all public school students take annual physical fitness tests
A national fund to build hospitals in every province of the Philippines
The creation of a government office that licenses all medical doctors
explanation: Republic Act 11036 (the Philippine Mental Health Act) establishes the right to receive mental health services and removes discrimination against people with mental illness.
fact_tl: Ang Batas Republika 11036 o Mental Health Act ng Pilipinas ay nagtatakda ng karapatang makatanggap ng serbisyo para sa kalusugan ng isip at nagtatanggal ng diskriminasyon sa mga may sakit sa isip.
fact_bis: Ang Republic Act 11036 o Mental Health Act sa Pilipinas nagtakda sa katungod sa pagkuha og serbisyo para sa kalusugan sa isip ug nagtanggal sa diskriminasyon batok sa mga adunay sakit sa isip.

q: Why is the water hyacinth considered harmful in places like the Pasig River in the Philippines?
options: It is a non-native invasive plant that disrupts the local environment
It produces a poison that kills all the native fish immediately
It grows thorns that injure people who swim in the river
It releases a dye that permanently turns the river water purple
explanation: The water hyacinth is not native to the Philippines and is treated as a harmful invasive plant in waterways like the Pasig River.
fact_tl: Hindi katutubo sa Pilipinas ang water hyacinth at itinuturing itong mapanirang dayuhang halaman, gaya sa Ilog Pasig.
fact_bis: Ang water hyacinth dili lumad sa Pilipinas ug giisip nga makadaot nga langyaw nga tanom, sama sa Suba sa Pasig.

q: Which continent is the coldest in the world?
options: Antarctica
Arctic
Asia
South America
explanation: Antarctica is the coldest continent in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Antarctica ang pinakamalamig na kontinente sa mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Antarctica mao ang pinakabugnaw nga kontinente sa kalibotan.

q: What unit is used to measure the frequency of sound?
options: Hertz (Hz)
Decibels (dB)
Watts (W)
Meters per second (m/s)
explanation: The frequency of sound is measured in Hertz (Hz), which counts the number of cycles per second.
fact_tl: Ang dalas (frequency) ng tunog ay sinusukat sa Hertz (Hz), na ang ibig sabihin ay bilang ng beses bawat segundo.
fact_bis: Ang frequency sa tingog gisukod sa Hertz (Hz), nga nagpasabot sa gidaghanon sa siklo kada segundo.

q: What should you avoid doing to prevent catching a skin disease from someone who is infected?
options: Sharing towels, combs, or clothes with that person
Eating the same food at the same table as that person
Standing too close to that person when talking
Using the same classroom chair as that person
explanation: To avoid catching skin diseases, you should not share towels, combs, or clothes with someone who has a skin infection.
fact_tl: Para hindi mahawa, huwag maghatian ng tuwalya, suklay, o damit kapag may kasama kang may sakit sa balat.
fact_bis: Aron dili matakdan, ayaw pag-ambit og tuwalya, sudlay, o sinina sa tawo nga adunay sakit sa panit.

q: What type of nutrient is the avocado especially rich in that makes it good for the body?
options: Healthy fats
Vitamin C
Dietary fiber
Iron and calcium
explanation: The avocado is a fruit with creamy green flesh and one large seed; it is rich in healthy fats that are good for the body.
fact_tl: Ang abukado ay isang prutas na may malambot at malinamnam na berdeng laman at isang malaking buto sa gitna, at mayaman ito sa malusog na taba na mabuti sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang abukado usa ka prutas nga may humok ug lami nga lunhaw nga unod ug usa ka dako nga liso sa tunga, ug dato kini sa himsog nga tambok nga maayo sa lawas.

q: Who is the only person to have won Nobel Prizes in two different sciences?
options: Marie Curie, who won in Physics and Chemistry
Albert Einstein, who won in Physics and Mathematics
Isaac Newton, who won in Physics and Biology
Louis Pasteur, who won in Chemistry and Medicine
explanation: Marie Curie is the only person to win a Nobel Prize in two different sciences: Physics in 1903 and Chemistry in 1911.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang tanging tao na nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa dalawang larangan ng agham: Physics (1903) at Chemistry (1911).
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie ra ang bugtong tawo nga nakadaog og Nobel Prize sa duha ka magkalahi nga siyensya: Physics (1903) ug Chemistry (1911).

q: What does it mean when milk is labeled 'pasteurized'?
options: It has been heated to kill harmful microbes so it is safer to drink
It has been frozen to remove all the water and concentrate the nutrients
It has been mixed with vitamins and minerals to make it more nutritious
It has been filtered through a fine screen to remove fat particles
explanation: Pasteurized milk has been heated to the right temperature to kill harmful microbes, making it safer to drink.
fact_tl: Ang "pasteurized" na gatas ay pinainit muna sa tamang temperatura para mamatay ang mapanganib na mikrobyo, kaya mas ligtas inumin.
fact_bis: Ang "pasteurized" nga gatas gipainit una sa hustong temperatura aron mamatay ang makadaot nga mikrobyo, mao nga mas luwas imnon.

q: Why are car tires made from rubber rather than hard metal?
options: Rubber grips the road to prevent sliding AND absorbs bumps for a smooth ride, while metal cannot do both
Rubber is much cheaper than metal so manufacturers always choose it for cost savings
Rubber is heavier than metal, giving the car more stability on the road
Rubber does not get damaged by rain, while metal would rust immediately
explanation: Car tires are made of rubber because they grip the road to prevent sliding and absorb bumps for a smooth ride — a hard metal wheel could not do both.
fact_tl: Goma ang gulong ng sasakyan dahil dalawa ang trabaho nito: kumakapit sa kalsada para hindi madulas, at sumisipsip ng yanig mula sa mga lubak para makinis ang biyahe. Hindi ito kayang gawin ng matigas na metal na gulong.
fact_bis: Goma ang ligid sa sakyanan tungod kay duha ang trabaho niini: mokapyot sa kalsada aron dili madakin-as ang awto, ug mosuyop sa yabag gikan sa mga lubak aron hamis ang biyahe. Dili ni mahimo sa gahi nga metal nga ligid.

q: Out of more than 7,000 islands in the Philippines, about how many have people actually living on them?
options: About 2,000
About 7,000
About 500
About 4,500
explanation: Only about 2,000 of the Philippine islands have people living on them.
fact_tl: Mga 2,000 lamang sa mga isla ng Pilipinas ang may mga taong nakatira.
fact_bis: Mga 2,000 lamang sa mga pulo sa Pilipinas ang gipuy-an sa mga tawo.

q: Why are fruit-eating bats considered keystone species in Philippine forests?
options: They spread the seeds that grow into new trees, helping forests survive
They hunt insects that would otherwise eat too many plants
They pollinate only one type of flower that no other animal can reach
They dig burrows that other forest animals use as shelter
explanation: In the Philippines, fruit-eating bats are keystone species because they spread seeds that grow new forests.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga paniki na kumakain ng prutas ay keystone species dahil ikinakalat nila ang mga buto na nagpapatubo ng bagong gubat.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga kabog nga mokaon og prutas mga keystone species kay ila ginapakatag ang mga liso nga motubo og bag-ong lasang.

q: What was the name of the spacecraft that carried the first human into space?
options: Vostok 1
Apollo 11
Sputnik 1
Mercury Freedom 7
explanation: Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space aboard a spacecraft called Vostok 1.
fact_tl: Si Yuri Gagarin ay nasa kalawakan sakay ng spacecraft na tinatawag na Vostok 1.
fact_bis: Si Yuri Gagarin miadto sa kawanangan sakay sa spacecraft nga gitawag og Vostok 1.

q: Why does only the female mosquito bite animals and humans for blood?
options: She needs the nutrients in blood to produce her eggs
She needs blood to build her wings before she can fly
She feeds on blood because she cannot digest plant nectar
She collects blood to store as food for her larvae after they hatch
explanation: The female mosquito needs blood to get the nutrients necessary to produce her eggs.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng babaeng lamok ang dugo upang magkaroon ng sustansya para gumawa ng kanyang mga itlog.
fact_bis: Ang babaye nga lamok nagkinahanglan og dugo aron makakuha og sustansya nga himuon niya og mga itlog.

q: Where does a sea turtle mother go to lay her eggs?
options: She returns to the shore and buries her eggs in the sand
She lays her eggs on floating seaweed mats in the open ocean
She digs a nest in soft coral reefs underwater
She deposits her eggs in deep-sea caves along the ocean floor
explanation: Sea turtle mothers return to shore to bury their eggs in the sand; many species are endangered in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) ay isang pagong na namumuhay sa dagat; bumabalik ang inahin sa baybayin para maglibing ng itlog sa buhangin, at marami sa kanila ay nanganganib nang maubos sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang pawikan (sea turtle) usa ka baw nga nagpuyo sa dagat; mobalik ang inahan sa baybayon aron ilubong ang itlog sa balas, ug daghan kanila ang namiligro nga mahurot sa Pilipinas.

q: Why are plankton so important to ocean life?
options: They form the base of the ocean food chain and are the food source for many fish
They produce all the oxygen found in the deep ocean waters
They clean ocean water by absorbing pollution from ships and factories
They control ocean currents by moving together in giant swarms
explanation: Plankton form the base of the ocean food chain because they are the primary food source for many fish.
fact_tl: Ang plankton ang pinakapundasyon ng food chain sa dagat dahil ito ang pinagmumulan ng pagkain ng maraming isda.
fact_bis: Ang plankton mao ang pundasyon sa food chain sa dagat tungod kay kini ang tinubdan sa pagkaon sa daghang isda.

q: Why is amethyst, which has a Mohs hardness of 7, commonly used in everyday jewelry?
options: Because it does not scratch easily, making it durable for daily wear
Because it is the rarest mineral on Earth, giving it high value
Because its hardness of 7 means it is flexible and will not crack
Because hard minerals can be melted and reshaped into any design
explanation: Amethyst has a hardness of 7 on the Mohs scale, meaning it does not scratch easily, which is why it is used in everyday jewelry.
fact_tl: Ang amethyst ay medyo matigas na bato, na may hardness na 7 sa Mohs scale. Ibig sabihin hindi ito basta-basta nagagasgas, kaya ginagamit ito sa alahas na pang-araw-araw.
fact_bis: Ang amethyst medyo gahi nga bato, nga adunay hardness nga 7 sa Mohs scale. Kini nagpasabot nga dili kini dali ra magasgas, mao nga gamiton kini sa adlaw-adlaw nga alahas.

q: What is the outer core of the Earth made of?
options: Liquid iron and nickel that flows around Earth's center
Solid iron and nickel packed tightly together
Melted rock called magma that erupts from volcanoes
Solid granite and basalt under great pressure
explanation: The outer core is a layer of liquid or molten metal, mostly iron and nickel, that flows around the center of the Earth.
fact_tl: Ang outer core ay isang sapaw ng likido o tunaw na metal, halos puro bakal at nikel, na umaagos sa paligid ng gitna ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang outer core usa ka sapaw sa likido o tunaw nga metal, kasagaran puthaw ug nikel, nga nagaagos palibot sa tunga sa Kalibutan.

q: Why does the Morpho butterfly look brilliant blue even though it has no blue pigment in its wings?
options: Light bounces off tiny microscopic structures on its wing scales, creating structural colour
Its wings contain a special blue chemical that reflects sunlight
It absorbs all other colours of light and releases blue light
Its wings are made of material that glows blue on its own
explanation: The brilliant blue of the Morpho butterfly is structural colour caused by light interference in microscopic structures on its wing scales, not by pigment.
fact_tl: Ang magandang asul na kulay ng ilang mariposa tulad ng Morpho ay hindi mula sa pigment — ito ay structural color na nagmumula sa interference ng liwanag sa mga microscopic na istruktura ng kanilang mga iskama.
fact_bis: Ang matahom nga asul nga kolor sa pipila ka mga alibangbang sama sa Morpho dili gikan sa pigment — kini structural color nga gikan sa interference sa suga sa microscopic nga mga istruktura sa ilang mga iskama.

q: Who developed the first vaccine against rabies?
options: Louis Pasteur
Edward Jenner
Alexander Fleming
Marie Curie
explanation: Louis Pasteur developed the first vaccine against rabies in 1885.
fact_tl: Si Louis Pasteur ang gumawa ng unang bakuna laban sa rabies (rabis) noong 1885.
fact_bis: Si Louis Pasteur ang naghimo sa unang bakuna batok sa rabies (rabis) niadtong 1885.

q: What happens when you mix all paint colours together?
options: You get a dark muddy colour close to black because most light is absorbed
You get white because all the colours combine into full light
You get a bright rainbow effect because each colour is still visible
You get grey because the colours cancel each other out evenly
explanation: Mixing all paint colours together absorbs more and more wavelengths of light, reflecting very little, which results in a dark muddy colour close to black.
