fact_tl: Sa paghalo ng lahat ng pintura, ang bawat kulay ay sumasipsip ng iba't ibang bahagi ng liwanag kaya napakakaunting liwanag ang nasasalamin — ang resulta ay isang madilim at maputik na kulay na malapit sa itim.
fact_bis: Ang paghalo sa tanang pintura nagsipsip sa daghang wavelength sa suga — gamay ra ang masalamin, ang resulta usa ka madulom ug malapot nga kolor nga duol sa itim.

q: What is the wavelength of a wave?
options: The distance from one crest to the next crest
The height from the bottom of a trough to the top of a crest
The number of waves that pass a point in one second
The speed at which the wave travels through a material
explanation: Wavelength is the distance from one crest of a wave to the next crest.
fact_tl: Ang wavelength (haba ng alon) ay ang distansya mula sa isang taluktok hanggang sa susunod na taluktok ng alon.
fact_bis: Ang wavelength (gitas-on sa balod) mao ang distansya gikan sa usa ka taluktok ngadto sa sunod nga taluktok sa balod.

q: How does fluoride in toothpaste help your teeth?
options: It strengthens enamel against decay
It removes the plaque and food stuck between teeth
It kills germs that cause bad breath
It whitens the surface of your teeth
explanation: The fluoride in toothpaste strengthens enamel against decay, while brushing removes plaque and food bits.
fact_tl: Ang pagsisipilyo ay nag-aalis ng plaque at tira-tirang pagkain, at ang fluoride sa toothpaste ay nagpapatibay ng enamel laban sa pagkabulok.
fact_bis: Ang pagsipilyo magtangtang sa plaque ug mga salin sa pagkaon, ug ang fluoride sa toothpaste mopalig-on sa enamel batok sa pagkagabok.

q: How can losing a lot of blood lead to anemia?
options: When a large amount of blood is lost, there are not enough red blood cells left to carry oxygen
Blood loss makes the heart beat too fast, so cells run out of energy
Too much blood loss causes the body to stop making new blood cells entirely
Losing blood removes the iron stored in bones, causing weakness
explanation: Losing a lot of blood, such as from a wound, can cause anemia because the body is left with too few red blood cells.
fact_tl: Ang labis na pagkawala ng dugo, gaya sa sugat o malakas na regla, ay maaaring magdulot ng anemia.
fact_bis: Ang sobra nga pagkawala sa dugo, sama sa samad o kusog nga regla, makahatag ug anemia.

q: Can a child with asthma still play sports and be physically active?
options: Yes, when the condition is well controlled with medicine
No, all physical activity is too dangerous for children with asthma
Only if they avoid all outdoor sports due to air quality
Only swimming is safe because water keeps the airways moist
explanation: Even a child with asthma can still play and do sports actively when the condition is well controlled with medicine.
fact_tl: Kahit may hika ang isang bata, maaari pa rin siyang maglaro at mag-sports nang aktibo kapag maayos na kinokontrol ang sakit gamit ang gamot.
fact_bis: Bisan ang bata nga may asma makahimo gihapon og dula ug sports nga aktibo kon maayong makontrol ang sakit pinaagi sa tambal.

q: What can a mother feel in her belly before a baby is born?
options: The baby moving and kicking
The baby breathing for the first time
The baby's heartbeat through the skin
The baby swallowing amniotic fluid
explanation: Before being born, the baby moves and kicks, and the mother can feel it in her belly.
fact_tl: Bago pa isilang, ang sanggol ay kumikilos at sumisipa, na nararamdaman ng ina sa kanyang tiyan.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa matawo, ang bata maglihok ug magsipa, ug mabati kini sa inahan sa iyang tiyan.

q: What is the main goal of IRRI and PhilRice when they develop new rice varieties?
options: To create rice that is more resistant to disease and gives higher yields
To make rice that grows faster so farmers can harvest three times a year
To develop rice that needs no water so it can grow in dry areas
To produce rice with a sweeter taste for Filipino consumers
explanation: IRRI in Los Baños, Laguna, and PhilRice work to develop new rice varieties that are more resistant to disease and give higher yields.
fact_tl: Ang International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) sa Los Banos, Laguna at ang PhilRice ay nagtatrabaho para makapag-develop ng mga bagong uri ng palay na mas matibay sa sakit at may mas mataas na ani.
fact_bis: Ang International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) sa Los Banos, Laguna ug ang PhilRice nagtrabaho aron makapagda og bag-ong klase sa palay nga mas makasugakod sa sakit ug adunay taas nga ani.

q: How does your body make vitamin D?
options: The skin turns a natural substance into vitamin D when sunlight hits it
The stomach produces vitamin D from the food you eat
The liver stores sunlight energy and converts it to vitamin D at night
Vitamin D is made by the kidneys when you drink enough water
explanation: The skin contains a natural substance that, when struck by the sun's UV rays, changes into vitamin D.
fact_tl: Paano nagagawa ang vitamin D? Sa balat mo may natural na sangkap na kapag tinamaan ng ultraviolet (UV) na sinag ng araw, nababago ito at nagiging vitamin D. Kaya parang ang balat mo ang 'pagawaan' ng bitamina kapag naliligo sa sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Giunsa paghimo ang vitamin D? Sa imong panit adunay natural nga sangkap nga kung maigo sa ultraviolet (UV) nga sidlak sa adlaw, mausab kini ug mahimong vitamin D. Mao nga ang imong panit murag gamay nga pabrika nga maghimo sa bitamina kung mainitan sa adlaw.

q: Is blood type AB just a mixture of type A blood and type B blood combined?
options: No, type AB is its own complete blood type where each cell carries both A and B antigens
Yes, AB blood is made by blending equal amounts of type A and type B blood
Yes, but the two blood types separate again over time inside the body
No, AB blood has neither A nor B antigens — it is a completely neutral type
explanation: Type AB is its own complete blood type; it is not two bloods mixed together — each cell naturally carries both A and B antigens.
fact_tl: Tanong na madalas: 'Halo ba ng type A at type B ang type AB?' Hindi! Ang type AB ay SARILING blood type na buo. Hindi ito pinaghalong dugo, kundi isang uri kung saan likas na may A at B antigen ang bawat selula.
fact_bis: Komon nga pangutana: 'Sagol ba sa type A ug type B ang type AB?' Dili! Ang type AB usa ka KAUGALINGON nga kompleto nga blood type. Dili kini duha ka dugo nga gisagol, kondili usa ka matang diin ang matag selula natural nga adunay A ug B antigen.

q: What are two common dangers that threaten dugongs in the wild?
options: Being hit by boats and getting caught in fishing nets
Overhunting for their ivory tusks and loss of coral reefs
Plastic pollution blocking their stomachs and oil spills burning their skin
Being eaten by large sharks and getting tangled in seaweed
explanation: Dugongs are in danger because they are sometimes hit by boats or caught in fishing nets.
fact_tl: Nanganganib ang dugong dahil minsan nasasagasaan ng bangka o nasasabit sa lambat ng mangingisda.
fact_bis: Ang dugong nameligro kay usahay maligsan sa bangka o masangit sa pukot sa mangingisda.

q: Why is it important to protect your ears while you are young?
options: Hearing loss makes it harder to listen to teachers and communicate with others
Young ears are softer and more likely to bleed from loud noises
Children cannot grow new ear bones if the old ones are damaged by sound
Early hearing damage makes it impossible to ever learn to read
explanation: Hearing loss makes it harder to listen to teachers and to talk with others, so protecting your ears while young is very important.
fact_tl: Ang pagkawala ng pandinig ay nagpapahirap sa pakikinig sa guro at pakikipag-usap, kaya't mahalaga itong protektahan habang bata pa.
fact_bis: Ang pagkawala sa pandungog maglisod sa pagpaminaw sa magtutudlo ug sa pagpakigsulti, busa importante kining panalipdan samtang bata pa.

q: Who was the first woman President of the Philippines?
options: Corazon Aquino
Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo
Imelda Marcos
Carmen Planas
explanation: Corazon Aquino was the first woman President of the Philippines.
fact_tl: Si Corazon Aquino ang unang babaeng Pangulo ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Si Corazon Aquino ang unang babayeng Presidente sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do scientists study the electric eel when designing new batteries?
options: They want to make soft water-and-gel batteries like the eel's body that could power devices inside the human body
They hope to copy the eel's electricity to power entire cities without burning fuel
They want to learn how the eel stores electricity so they can build longer-lasting car batteries
They study the eel so they can breed it in labs and use it as a direct power source
explanation: Scientists study the electric eel to make soft batteries from water and gel — like the eel's body — that could one day power devices inside the human body.
fact_tl: Hanggang ngayon, pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko ang electric eel. Gusto nilang gumawa ng malambot na baterya na gawa sa tubig at gel—gaya ng katawan ng eel—na maaaring magamit sa loob ng katawan ng tao balang araw.
fact_bis: Hangtod karon, gitun-an sa mga siyentista ang electric eel. Gusto nilang maghimo og humok nga baterya gikan sa tubig ug gel—sama sa lawas sa eel—nga mahimong magamit sulod sa lawas sa tawo sa umaabot.

q: How does a tapeworm harm the person it lives inside?
options: It lives in the intestine and takes nutrients that should have gone to the person
It burrows through the intestine walls and enters the bloodstream
It releases a poison that slowly destroys the person's digestive organs
It blocks the intestine so food cannot pass through at all
explanation: A tapeworm lives in a person's intestine and takes nutrients that should have gone to the person.
fact_tl: Ang tapeworm o bulate ay nakatira sa bituka ng tao at kinukuha ang sustansiyang dapat sana ay para sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang tapeworm o bitok nagpuyo sa tinai sa tawo ug ginakuha ang sustansiya nga alang unta sa tawo.

q: Why do many plants close their stomata at night?
options: To avoid losing too much water through transpiration
To stop oxygen from escaping while the plant is not photosynthesizing
To keep insects from entering the tiny pores while the plant rests
To raise the temperature inside the leaf and protect it from cold nights
explanation: Many plants close their stomata at night to avoid losing too much water.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang nagsasara ng stomata sa gabi para hindi masyadong mawalan ng tubig.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang magsira sa ilang stomata sa gabii aron dili mawad-an og sobrang tubig.

q: Where are the glands that make saliva located?
options: Near your cheeks and under the tongue
Inside the lining of your stomach and throat
Behind the tonsils at the back of the mouth
At the top and bottom of the esophagus
explanation: Saliva is made by glands found near your cheeks and under the tongue.
fact_tl: Ang laway ay ginagawa ng mga glandula na matatagpuan malapit sa iyong mga pisngi at sa ilalim ng dila.
fact_bis: Ang laway gihimo sa mga glandula nga makit-an duol sa imong mga aping ug ilalom sa dila.

q: What happens to an object when you push or pull it harder?
options: It moves faster or farther
It becomes heavier and harder to stop
It changes direction more slowly
It gets warmer from the extra energy
explanation: A stronger push or pull makes an object move faster or farther.
fact_tl: Mas malakas na puwersa ang nagpapagalaw nang mas mabilis o mas malayo sa isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang mas kusog nga puwersa makapalihok sa butang nga mas paspas o mas layo.

q: What is unusual about Taal Volcano's geography?
options: It has an island inside a lake, and inside that island there is another smaller lake
It is the only volcano in the Philippines that is completely surrounded by ocean water
It sits inside a crater so deep that it is below sea level
Its main crater is filled with solid lava instead of water
explanation: Taal has an island inside a lake, and there is an even smaller lake inside that island.
fact_tl: Ang Taal ay may isang isla sa loob ng lawa, at may maliit na lawa pa sa loob ng islang iyon.
fact_bis: Ang Taal adunay usa ka pulo sa sulod sa lanaw, ug adunay mas gamay pa nga lanaw sa sulod nianang pulo-a.

q: How can bagasse help reduce the cutting down of trees?
options: Bagasse fiber can be turned into paper, cardboard, and boards, so fewer trees need to be cut
Bagasse can be planted alongside trees to speed up forest regrowth
Bagasse is burned as fuel in sawmills, reducing the energy needed to cut logs
Bagasse extracts are sprayed on logs to make them easier to process without chemicals
explanation: Bagasse fiber can be turned into paper, cardboard, and boards, so fewer trees need to be cut down to make paper.
fact_tl: Ang hibla ng bagasse ay puwedeng gawing papel, karton, at mga board. Sa ganitong paraan, hindi na kailangang putulin ang maraming puno para gumawa ng papel.
fact_bis: Ang lanot sa bagasse mahimong himuong papel, karton, ug mga board. Niini nga paagi, dili na kinahanglang putlon ang daghang kahoy aron makahimo og papel.

q: What causes the sound when a ukulele string is plucked?
options: The string vibrates back and forth quickly and that vibration makes the sound
The hollow body of the ukulele traps air that escapes as sound when the string is touched
The string rubs against the air molecules and the friction creates a tone
The string stretches and contracts rapidly, pushing the bridge to make noise
explanation: When a ukulele string is plucked it vibrates back and forth quickly, and that vibration makes the sound we hear.
fact_tl: Kapag pinitik ang kwerdas ng ukulele, ito ay nanginginig nang mabilis at ang panginig na ito ang gumagawa ng tunog na ating naririnig.
fact_bis: Kon kurutan ang kwerdas sa ukulele, kini mauyog-uyog ug paspas, ug kanang pag-uyog mao ang naghimo sa tingog nga atong madungog.

q: Why is proper nutrition and care especially important in the first 1,000 days of a baby's life?
options: The brain grows and wires its connections very fast during this time, and most brain growth happens before age two
The digestive system is not yet formed during this period so the wrong food causes permanent damage
The body's immune system is completely off during the first 1,000 days, making illness far more deadly
The heart doubles in size during this window and needs extra nutrients to grow safely
explanation: In the first 1,000 days, the brain grows and wires up its connections very fast, and most brain growth happens before age two, so missing care during this time is very hard to make up later.
fact_tl: Bakit napakahalaga nito para sa utak? Sa unang 1,000 araw, napakabilis lumaki at magkonekta ang mga ugat ng utak. Karamihan ng paglaki ng utak ay nangyayari bago mag-dalawang taon, kaya kulang sa pagkain o pag-aaruga sa panahong ito ay mahirap nang habulin pa.
fact_bis: Ngano importante kaayo kini sa utok? Sa unang 1,000 ka adlaw, paspas kaayo motubo ug magkonektar ang mga ugat sa utok. Kadaghanan sa pagtubo sa utok mahitabo sa dili pa duha ka tuig, busa lisod nang habolan ang kakulang sa pagkaon o pag-atiman niini nga panahon.

q: How do monitor lizards help keep the ecosystem in balance?
options: They eat rats, pests, and dead animals, cleaning up the environment
They dig burrows that allow rainwater to soak into the soil more easily
They pollinate flowers while searching for insects to eat
They control fish populations by hunting in rivers and lakes
explanation: Monitor lizards are important to the ecosystem because they eat rats and pests and clean up dead animals, helping keep nature in balance.
fact_tl: Mahalaga ang bayawak sa ekosistema dahil kumakain sila ng mga daga at peste at naglilinis ng mga patay na hayop. Sa paggawa nito, tumutulong silang panatilihing balanse ang kalikasan.
fact_bis: Importante ang bayawan sa ekosistema kay mokaon silag ilaga ug peste ug maglimpyo sa mga patay nga mananap. Sa pagbuhat niini, makatabang sila sa pagtipig sa balanse sa kinaiyahan.

q: What does a sick snake do to help its body fight infection, since it cannot make a fever on its own?
options: It moves to a warmer spot to bask and heat itself up
It stops eating entirely until the infection goes away
It hides in cold damp soil to slow down the germs
It sheds its skin more frequently to remove infected tissue
explanation: Because a snake is cold-blooded and cannot make a fever inside its body, when it is sick it looks for a warmer spot to bask and heats itself up to help fight the germs.
fact_tl: Hindi kayang gumawa ng lagnat ang ahas tulad natin dahil cold-blooded siya. Kaya kapag may sakit siya, naghahanap siya ng mas mainit na lugar para magpaaraw—pinapainit niya ang sarili para tulungan ang katawan niyang labanan ang mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Dili makahimo og hilanat ang bitin sama nato kay cold-blooded siya. Busa kon masakit siya, mangita siya og mas init nga dapit aron magpa-adlaw—iyang painiton ang kaugalingon aron tabangan ang lawas nga makig-away sa mikrobyo.

q: Which end of a compass needle points toward the north?
options: The red or marked end
The plain silver or uncoloured end
Either end, depending on which hemisphere you are in
The end that is heaviest, because gravity pulls it northward
explanation: The end of the compass needle that points north is usually colored red or marked.
fact_tl: Karaniwang kulay pula o may marka ang dulong tumuturo sa hilaga sa karayom ng kompas.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa dagom sa compass nga nagtudlo sa amihanan kasagaran pula o adunay marka.

q: How often do tides cover and uncover a mudflat in a single day?
options: Twice a day — high tide covers it and low tide uncovers it
Once a day — the tide comes in at sunrise and goes out at sunset
Four times a day in a steady pattern every six hours
Only during stormy weather when strong winds push the sea inland
explanation: Twice a day, the high tide covers the mudflat and then the low tide uncovers it again.
fact_tl: Dalawang beses sa isang araw, tinatakpan ng taog ang mudflat at pagkatapos ay muling nalalantad kapag kati.
fact_bis: Kaduha sa usa ka adlaw, tabunan sa taob ang mudflat ug unya makita na usab kini kon mohubas.

q: Why do baby sea turtles survive better when a nesting beach is clean and dark?
options: They can reach the sea more easily without trash blocking their path, so more of them make it
Clean beaches have more crabs and birds that guide the hatchlings toward the water
Dark beaches keep the sand warm enough to hatch the eggs faster
Hatchlings have better eyesight at night on dark beaches so they avoid predators
explanation: When a beach is clean, dark, and free of trash, baby turtles can reach the sea more easily, so more of them survive.
fact_tl: Kapag malinis, madilim, at walang basura ang baybayin, mas madaling makarating sa dagat ang mga batang pawikan kaya mas marami sa kanila ang nakakaligtas.
fact_bis: Kung limpyo, ngitngit, ug walay basura ang baybayon, mas sayon makaabot sa dagat ang gagmayng pawikan busa mas daghan kanila ang maluwas.

q: What does it mean when goats and sheep are said to "chew the cud"?
options: They bring food back up from their stomach to chew it a second time
They grind grass slowly between their flat back teeth without swallowing
They store food in a special pouch in their cheek and chew it hours later
They eat the same patch of grass over and over in a circle
explanation: Goats and sheep bring food back up from their stomach to chew it again, which is called chewing the cud.
fact_tl: Ang kambing at tupa ay nginunguya muli ang kanilang pagkain mula sa tiyan upang lubusang matunaw ito.
fact_bis: Ang kanding ug karnero magpasibsib pag-usab sa ilang pagkaon gikan sa tiyan aron usapon kini balik.

q: Why does a new or unusual smell often mean a chemical reaction has happened?
options: A reaction can make a new gas, and those tiny gas particles travel to your nose and create a new odor
Smells come from heat being released, and all chemical reactions produce heat that carries the odor
A reaction always destroys the original substance completely, leaving only a vapour that you smell
The colour change in a reaction releases particles that happen to stimulate the nose
explanation: When a reaction makes a new gas — like in spoiled milk or burnt food — tiny gas particles reach your nose and you smell a new odor.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang may bagong amoy na lumitaw, malimit iyon ay tanda ng reaksyong kemikal. Ang amoy ay galing sa maliliit na gas na pumapasok sa ilong mo; kapag bumuo ang reaksyon ng bagong gas — gaya sa panis na gatas o sunog na pagkain — bagong amoy ang naaamoy mo.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga adunay bag-ong baho, kasagaran timailhan kana sa reaksiyong kemikal. Ang baho gikan sa gagmayng gas nga mosulod sa imong ilong; kon ang reaksiyon maghimo og bag-ong gas — sama sa panis nga gatas o sunog nga pagkaon — bag-ong baho ang imong masimhot.

q: What happens to a worker bee after it stings someone?
options: Its stinger is left behind and the bee dies afterward
It loses its stinger but grows a new one within a few days
It can sting again but becomes weaker each time it does
It flies back to the hive and the other bees remove the broken stinger
explanation: When a worker bee stings, its stinger is left behind and the bee dies afterward.
fact_tl: Kapag tumusok ang isang manggagawang bubuyog, naiiwan ang tibo nito at namamatay ito pagkatapos.
fact_bis: Kon motusok ang usa ka trabahanteng putyokan, mabilin ang tusok niini ug mamatay kini human niana.

q: What are the three main shapes that bacteria can have?
options: Round (cocci), rod-shaped (bacilli), and spiral (spirilla)
Flat (platelets), triangular (tricocci), and star-shaped (stellate)
Square (cuboid), oval (ovoid), and ring-shaped (annuli)
Cube-shaped (tetrad), needle-like (fusilli), and crescent-shaped (lunata)
explanation: Bacteria come in three main shapes: round (cocci), rod-shaped (bacilli), and spiral (spirilla).
fact_tl: Ang mga bakterya ay may tatlong pangunahing hugis: bilog (cocci), patpat (bacilli), at spiral (spirilla).
fact_bis: Ang mga bakterya adunay tulo ka nag-unang porma: bilog (cocci), pang-patpat (bacilli), ug spiral (spirilla).

q: Approximately how large is the Amazon rainforest?
options: About 5.5 million square kilometers
About 1.2 million square kilometers
About 10 million square kilometers
About 3 million square kilometers
explanation: The Amazon rainforest covers about 5.5 million square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang Amazon rainforest ay may sukat na halos 5.5 milyong kilometro kuwadrado.
fact_bis: Ang Amazon rainforest adunay gilapdon nga mga 5.5 ka milyong kilometro kwadrado.

q: In what order does urine travel from the kidney to leave the body?
options: Kidney → ureter → bladder → urethra
Kidney → urethra → bladder → ureter
Kidney → bladder → ureter → urethra
Kidney → ureter → urethra → bladder
explanation: Urine passes through the ureter from the kidney to the bladder, where it is stored until it is released through the urethra.
fact_tl: Ang ihi ay dumadaan sa ureter mula sa kidney patungo sa pantog, kung saan ito ay inimbak hanggang sa ito ay ilabas sa pamamagitan ng urethra.
fact_bis: Ang ihi moagi sa ureter gikan sa kidney ngadto sa pantog, diin kini gitipigan hangtud kini ipagawas pinaagi sa urethra.

q: What does a millipede eat when it feeds on a rotting leaf?
options: It eats the leaf itself and also the tiny fungi and bacteria growing on the leaf, which are often the most nourishing part
It eats only the soft inner parts of the leaf and leaves the tough outer skin
It eats only the leaf's veins because the soft parts are too wet to digest
It absorbs liquid nutrients from the leaf without biting or chewing any part of it
explanation: A millipede eats not just the leaf itself but also the tiny fungi and bacteria growing on the rotting leaf, which are often the most nourishing part of its meal.
fact_tl: Hindi lang dahon ang kinakain ng millipede. Kasama nito ang maliliit na amag at bacteria na tumutubo sa bulok na dahon, at madalas ito pa ang pinakamasustansyang bahagi ng pagkain nito.
fact_bis: Dili lang dahon ang gikaon sa millipede. Apil ang gagmay nga agup-op ug bacteria nga motubo sa malata nga dahon, ug kasagaran kini ang labing sustansyado nga bahin sa iyang pagkaon.

q: What is evaporation?
options: The slow change from a liquid to a gas at the surface only, like a puddle drying up
The fast change from a liquid to a gas throughout the whole liquid, like boiling water
The change from a gas back into a liquid when it cools down
The change from a solid directly into a gas without becoming a liquid first
explanation: Evaporation is the slow change from a liquid to a gas at the surface only, like a puddle drying up.
fact_tl: Ang pagsingaw (evaporation) ay ang dahan-dahang pagbabago ng likido tungo sa gas sa ibabaw lamang nito, gaya ng puddle na natutuyo.
fact_bis: Ang pag-alisngaw (evaporation) mao ang hinay nga pagbag-o gikan sa likido ngadto sa gas sa ibabaw lamang niini, sama sa lapok nga namala.

q: What does the chemical formula H2O tell us about a water molecule?
options: Each water molecule is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
Each water molecule is made of two oxygen atoms and one hydrogen atom
Water is made of hydrogen gas and oxygen gas mixed together in equal amounts
H2O means water has two types of hydrogen and no oxygen of its own
explanation: The chemical formula for water is H2O — two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
fact_tl: Ang kemikal na pormula ng tubig ay H2O — dalawang hydrogen at isang oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang chemical formula sa tubig mao ang H2O — duha ka hydrogen ug usa ka oxygen.

q: Why does a proton attract an electron inside an atom?
options: A proton is positive and an electron is negative, and opposite charges attract each other
Both particles carry the same charge, and like charges pull toward each other
A proton is heavier, so gravity pulls the lighter electron toward it
The electron spins so fast it creates a magnetic field that is pulled toward the still proton
explanation: A proton (positive) and an electron (negative) attract each other because opposite charges attract.
fact_tl: Ang proton (positibo) at electron (negatibo) ay naaakit sa isa't isa dahil ang magkasalungat na charge ay naaakit.
fact_bis: Ang proton (positibo) ug electron (negatibo) magdani sa usag usa tungod kay ang magkasumpaki nga charge magdani.

q: Why does a hot-air balloon rise into the sky?
options: The heated air inside the balloon is lighter than the cooler air outside, so it floats upward
The burning flame creates a gas that pushes against the ground like a rocket engine
Hot air is heavier and sinks through the cooler air, pushing the balloon up from below
The fabric of the balloon traps steam, which is lighter than air and lifts the balloon
explanation: A hot-air balloon rises because the heated air inside it is lighter than the cooler air outside, so it floats upward.
fact_tl: Pumapaitaas ang hot-air balloon dahil ang pinainit na hangin sa loob nito ay mas magaan kaysa sa malamig na hangin sa labas, kaya ito lumulutang pataas.
fact_bis: Mosaka ang hot-air balloon tungod kay ang gipainit nga hangin sa sulod niini mas gaan kay sa bugnaw nga hangin sa gawas, busa molutaw kini pataas.

q: What can a spider do with its dragline when it no longer needs it?
options: It can let go of or bite off the dragline so it is not stuck in one spot
It can reel the dragline back in by spinning it into a ball
It dissolves the dragline using a special liquid from its mouth
The dragline snaps on its own after a few minutes in sunlight
explanation: A spider can let go of or bite off its dragline when it no longer needs it, so it is not stuck tied to one spot.
fact_tl: Kaya ng gagamba na bitawan o putulin ang dragline nito kapag hindi na kailangan, kaya hindi ito laging nakatali sa isang lugar.
fact_bis: Makahimo ang lawalawa pagbuhi o pagputol sa dragline niini kon dili na kinahanglan, busa dili kini permi nahigot sa usa ka lugar.

q: How does dropping its tail help a lizard escape from a predator?
options: The dropped tail keeps wiggling to distract the predator while the lizard runs away
The tail releases a bad smell that makes the predator let go immediately
The tail breaks off and wraps around the predator's legs to slow it down
Dropping the tail makes the lizard lighter so it can run twice as fast
explanation: Many lizards can drop their tail when caught by an enemy — the fallen tail keeps wiggling to distract the predator while the lizard escapes.
fact_tl: Maraming butiki ang kayang i-drop ang buntot kapag nahuli ng kalaban — gumagalaw pa ang nahulog na buntot para guluhin ang kalaban habang tumatakas ang butiki, at unti-unti itong tumutubo ulit.
fact_bis: Daghang butiki ang makahulog sa ilang ikog kon madakpan sa kaaway — ang nahulog nga ikog magpadayon sa paglihok aron libgon ang manunukob samtang moikyas ang butiki, ug hinay-hinay kining motubo balik.

q: Besides attracting mates, what else can a firefly's glow do?
options: It can warn hungry animals that the firefly does not taste good
It can blind predators temporarily so the firefly can escape
It can heat up the firefly's body to make it too hot to eat
It signals other fireflies to swarm together for protection
explanation: A firefly's glow can warn hungry animals that it does not taste good.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng alitaptap ay maaaring babala sa mga maninila na ito ay hindi masarap kainin.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag sa aninipot mahimong pasidaan sa mananakmal nga kini dili lami kaonon.

q: What is an alloy?
options: A mixture of metals combined to make a stronger material, like steel made from iron and carbon
A single pure metal that has been melted and reshaped into a different form
A coating of one metal applied to the surface of another to prevent rust
A natural rock that contains two or more metals found together underground
explanation: An alloy is a mixture of metals, like steel made from iron and carbon, to make it stronger.
fact_tl: Ang alloy ay pinaghalong metal, gaya ng asero na halo ng bakal at carbon, para mas matibay.
fact_bis: Ang alloy maoy sinagol nga metal, sama sa asero nga sagol sa puthaw ug carbon, aron molig-on.

q: How are the different types of hepatitis identified?
options: They are named by letters, such as hepatitis A, B, and C
They are named by numbers based on how dangerous they are, like hepatitis 1 and 2
They are named after the scientists who first discovered each type
They are named by colours based on which organ they damage most
explanation: There are different kinds of hepatitis named by letters, such as hepatitis A, B, and C.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng hepatitis na pinangalanan ng mga letra, gaya ng hepatitis A, B, at C.
fact_bis: Adunay lain-laing matang sa hepatitis nga ginganlan ug mga letra, sama sa hepatitis A, B, ug C.

q: Why are river floodplains considered very good farmland even though they are risky?
options: Rivers deposit rich sediment on floodplains that makes the soil very fertile for growing crops
Floodplains stay moist all year so crops never need to be irrigated
The flat land of floodplains lets farmers use heavy machines more easily than on hillsides
Floodplain soil is packed so tightly that it holds crop roots very firmly during storms
explanation: River floodplains are very fertile farmland because of the rich sediment deposited by rivers, but they also carry a high risk of flooding.
fact_tl: Ang mga kapatagan sa tabi ng mga ilog (floodplains) ay napakamasaganang lupain para sa pagsasaka dahil sa maayos na lupa na dinala ng tubig-ilog; subalit mataas ang panganib ng pagbaha sa mga lugar na ito.
fact_bis: Ang mga kapatagan sa palibot sa mga suba (floodplains) napakamayamanon nga lupa alang sa pagsasaka tungod sa maayong sediment nga gidala sa tubig-suba; apan, ang mga lugar nga kini adunay taas nga peligro sa pagbaha.

q: How does mud actually cool a carabao down?
options: As the wet mud dries and evaporates on its skin, it carries heat away from the carabao's body
The mud is always colder than the air, so it directly cools the skin wherever it touches
The thick mud acts like a blanket that reflects sunlight so heat never reaches the skin
Mud contains water that soaks through the carabao's skin and cools the blood underneath
explanation: When the wet mud on a carabao's skin dries and evaporates, it carries heat away from the body, working like a substitute for the sweat the carabao cannot make much of.
fact_tl: Paano nagpapalamig ang putik sa kalabaw? Kapag natuyo ang basang putik sa balat, dahan-dahan itong sumisingaw, at habang sumisingaw ay inaalis nito ang init sa katawan ng kalabaw. Parang pamalit ito sa pawis na hindi gaanong nagagawa ng kalabaw.
fact_bis: Giunsa pagpabugnaw sa lapok ang kalabaw? Kon mauga ang basa nga lapok sa panit, hinay-hinay kini nga moalisngaw, ug samtang moalisngaw gikuha niini ang kainit gikan sa lawas sa kalabaw. Sama kini og puli sa singot nga dili kaayo mahimo sa kalabaw.

q: How does a gecko manage to grip a smooth wall without using any glue?
options: Its feet have microscopic structures that create tiny forces allowing it to stick without glue
It produces a thin layer of sticky liquid from its skin that works like natural glue
Its claws are sharp enough to scratch tiny grooves into the smooth surface to hold on
The pads on its feet create suction cups that attach to the wall like a rubber plunger
explanation: A gecko's feet use no glue; they are dry yet still grip a smooth wall thanks to microscopic structures on its toes.

q: How does a horseshoe crab find food?
options: It swims near the surface to catch fish
It walks along the seafloor and digs in the sand to find worms and shellfish
It uses its claws to grab food from rocks above the water
It filters tiny plants out of the water with its gills
explanation: Horseshoe crabs walk along the seafloor and dig in the sand to find small worms and shellfish to eat.
fact_tl: Naglalakad ang horseshoe crab sa ilalim ng dagat at humahalukay sa buhangin para humanap ng maliliit na uod at shellfish na kakainin.
fact_bis: Molakaw ang horseshoe crab sa ilawom sa dagat ug mokalot sa balas aron mangita og gagmay nga ulod ug shellfish nga kan-on.

q: What does the abbreviation DNA stand for?
options: Deoxyribonucleic acid
Diribonucleic amino acid
Deoxyribose nucleic amino acid
Dinucleotide acidic protein
explanation: DNA is short for deoxyribonucleic acid, which is the full name of the molecule that carries genetic information.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay maikling tawag para sa deoxyribonucleic acid, ang pangalan ng molekula na ito.
fact_bis: Ang DNA mubo nga tawag sa deoxyribonucleic acid, ang bug-os nga ngalan niini nga molekula.

q: When a fossil fuel like coal is burned, what happens that allows us to produce energy?
options: It absorbs heat from the air and stores it underground
It combines with oxygen and releases heat that can boil water or run an engine
It splits into smaller rocks that create electricity directly
It releases cold air that powers fans and turbines
explanation: Burning fossil fuel combines it with oxygen in the air, releasing heat that boils water or runs an engine to produce energy.
fact_tl: Kapag sinusunog ang fossil fuel, sumasanib ito sa oxygen sa hangin at naglalabas ng init — ang init na ito ang nagpapakulo ng tubig o nagpapaandar ng makina para makagawa tayo ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Kung sunugon ang fossil fuel, mosagol kini sa oxygen sa hangin ug mobuga og kainit — kini nga kainit maoy mopabukal sa tubig o mopadagan sa makina aron makahimo kitag enerhiya.

q: How does a hummingbird help plants make seeds?
options: It digs holes in the ground where seeds can fall and grow
It eats seeds and drops them in new places
It carries pollen from one flower to another while drinking nectar
It waters plants by splashing water from rivers with its wings
explanation: While drinking nectar, the hummingbird picks up pollen and carries it from one flower to another, helping plants make seeds.
fact_tl: Habang umiinom ng nektar, dinadala ng hummingbird ang pollen mula sa isang bulaklak patungo sa iba, kaya nakakatulong itong magpabunga ng mga halaman.
fact_bis: Samtang nag-inom og nektar, ang hummingbird magdala og polen gikan sa usa ka bulak ngadto sa lain, busa makatabang kini sa mga tanom nga mamunga.

q: Why does a radio station signal get weaker the farther you are from its tower?
options: The radio waves slow down as they travel through air and lose momentum
The radio waves collide with other waves and cancel each other out
The signal's energy spreads over a wider area the farther it travels
The tower reduces its power output when few listeners are nearby
explanation: As a radio wave travels farther, its energy spreads over a wider area, making the signal grow weaker.
fact_tl: Habang lumalayo ang radio wave mula sa pinanggalingan nito, kumakalat ang enerhiya nito sa mas malawak na lugar kaya humihina ang signal. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit nagiging maingay o nawawala ang estasyon ng radyo kapag malayo ka na sa tore.
fact_bis: Samtang molayo ang radio wave gikan sa gigikanan niini, mokatag ang enerhiya niini sa mas lapad nga dapit, busa moluya ang signal. Mao kini ngano nga ang estasyon sa radyo magbanha o mawala kon molayo ka na sa tore.

q: Which plant family do onion and garlic both belong to?
options: Cucurbit
Allium
Brassica
Legume
explanation: Onion and garlic are related plants in the same family called Allium.
fact_tl: Ang sibuyas at bawang ay magkamag-anak na halaman sa iisang pamilya na tinatawag na Allium.
fact_bis: Ang sibuyas ug ahos managsoon nga mga tanom sa usa ka pamilya nga gitawag og Allium.

q: The unit 'volt' used to measure electricity is named after which scientist?
options: Alessandro Volta, who made the first battery
James Watt, who improved the steam engine
André-Marie Ampère, who studied electric current
Michael Faraday, who discovered electromagnetic induction
explanation: The unit volt is named after Alessandro Volta, the scientist who made the first battery.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na volt ay ipinangalan kay Alessandro Volta, ang siyentistang gumawa ng unang baterya.
fact_bis: Ang yunit nga volt gipangalan kang Alessandro Volta, ang siyentista nga naghimo sa unang baterya.

q: What is a graduated cylinder used to measure in a science lab?
options: The temperature of a liquid
The mass of a solid object
The volume of a liquid
The pressure of a gas
explanation: A graduated cylinder is a marked container used to measure the volume of a liquid.
fact_tl: Ang graduated cylinder ay isang sisidlang may marka na ginagamit upang sukatin ang bolyum ng likido.
fact_bis: Ang graduated cylinder usa ka sudlanan nga adunay marka nga gigamit aron sukdon ang volume sa likido.

q: When a broken bone begins to heal, what forms to connect the two broken ends?
options: A hard crystal of calcium that fuses the bone instantly
A soft callus that grows like a bridge between the two broken ends
A fluid-filled sac that cushions the break while it fuses
A layer of skin cells that grows inward to seal the gap
explanation: As a broken bone heals, a soft callus forms like a bridge that connects the two broken ends.
fact_tl: Sa paghilom, bumubuo ng malambot na callus na parang tulay na nagdurugtong sa dalawang dulo ng baling buto.
fact_bis: Sa pag-ayo, mamuo ang humok nga callus nga sama sa taytayan nga magdugtong sa duha ka tumoy sa nabali nga bukog.

q: In which year was the structure of DNA first discovered?
explanation: The structure of DNA was discovered in the year 1953.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang hugis ng DNA noong taong 1953.
fact_bis: Ang porma sa DNA nadiskubre niadtong tuig 1953.

q: What class of lever is a bottle opener?
options: First-class lever, because the fulcrum is between the effort and load
Second-class lever, because the load is between the fulcrum and effort
Third-class lever, because the effort is between the fulcrum and load
Fourth-class lever, because it uses two fulcrums at once
explanation: A bottle opener is a second-class lever that uses a small effort to pop off the cap.
fact_tl: Ang pang-abre ng bote ay isang ikalawang-uring palanca na nag-aalsa ng tansan gamit ang kaunting puwersa lamang.
fact_bis: Ang pang-abre sa botelya usa ka ikaduhang-klase nga palanca nga moalsa sa takup gamit ang gamay lang nga kusog.

q: A student says only the thickness of a guitar string changes its pitch. What is wrong with that idea?
options: Thickness has no effect on pitch at all; only the tightness of the string matters
Both thickness and length affect pitch; a shorter string makes a higher pitch no matter how thick it is
Only length matters for pitch; thickness only changes the volume of the sound
Pitch never changes on a guitar because all strings are tuned the same
explanation: While thickness does affect pitch, length matters too — a shorter string always makes a higher pitch regardless of its thickness.
fact_tl: May mga batang nag-iisip na ang KAPAL lang ng kuwerdas ang nagbabago ng tunog. Totoo na nakakaapekto ang kapal, pero ang HABA rin ay napakahalaga: kahit gaano kakapal, mas maikli pa rin ang gumagawa ng mas mataas na tunog.
fact_bis: Naa'y mga bata nga nagtuo nga ang GIBAG-ON lang sa kuwerdas ang nag-usab sa tingog. Tinuod nga naka-apekto ang gibag-on, apan importante sad ang GITAS-ON: bisan unsa kabaga, mas mubo gihapon ang mohimo ug mas taas nga tingog.

q: Why are top predators like lions and eagles important in an ecosystem?
options: They produce food for smaller animals by eating plants
They help plants grow by spreading pollen as they move
They keep the numbers of other animals in the ecosystem in balance
They clean the water by filtering out harmful bacteria
explanation: Big predators sit at the top of the food chain and are important because they keep the numbers of other animals in the ecosystem in balance.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking mandaragit tulad ng leon, tigre, at agila ay nasa tuktok ng food chain (top predators). Mahalaga sila dahil pinapanatili nilang balanse ang bilang ng ibang hayop sa ekosistema.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong manunukob sama sa leon, tigre, ug agila naa sa tumoy sa food chain (top predators). Importante sila kay ilang gipabilin nga balanse ang gidaghanon sa ubang hayop sa ekosistema.

q: How can humans help slow down the rise of sea levels?
options: By building taller seawalls along every coastline in the world
By cutting pollution and using clean energy to slow how fast the sea rises
By draining parts of the ocean into underground storage tanks
By planting trees only in coastal areas to absorb extra seawater
explanation: Cutting pollution and using clean energy can slow down how fast the sea rises.
fact_tl: Ang pagbawas ng polusyon at paggamit ng malinis na enerhiya ay makakapagpabagal sa pagtaas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang pagkunhod sa polusyon ug paggamit ug limpyo nga enerhiya makapahinay sa pagsaka sa dagat.

q: What makes Honda Bay near Puerto Princesa, Palawan a popular destination?
options: It has the highest waterfall in the Philippines and dense rainforests
It is home to famous underground limestone caves open for tours
It has beautiful small islands and coral reefs ideal for island hopping and snorkeling
It is known for its active volcano and hot spring resorts
explanation: Honda Bay near Puerto Princesa is known for its beautiful small islands and coral reefs, perfect for island hopping and snorkeling.
fact_tl: Ang Honda Bay sa Puerto Princesa, Palawan ay kilala sa magagandang maliit na isla at coral reef na perpekto para sa island hopping at snorkeling.
fact_bis: Ang Honda Bay duol sa Puerto Princesa, Palawan bantog sa matahum nga gagmay nga isla ug coral reef, perpekto para sa island hopping ug snorkeling.

q: How is glass different from a crystal solid like salt?
options: Glass is a liquid at room temperature, while salt is a true solid
Glass melts at a lower temperature than all crystalline solids
Glass is an amorphous solid whose atoms are arranged irregularly, unlike the ordered pattern in a crystal
Glass is made entirely of one element, while crystals always contain two or more elements
explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid — its atoms are arranged irregularly, unlike the ordered structure of a crystal.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng solido ay may crystalline structure. Ang salamin ay isang amorphous solid — ang mga atom nito ay nakaayos nang di-regular, hindi tulad ng kristal. Ang salamin ay minsan tinatawag na 'supercooled liquid' dahil sa kasaysayan nito, bagaman ito ay talaga ngang isang amorphous solid.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga mga solido adunay crystalline structure. Ang salamin usa ka amorphous solid — ang mga atom niini naka-ayos nga di-regular, dili sama sa kristal. Ang salamin minsan gitawag nga 'supercooled liquid' sa kasaysayan, bisan kini usa ka tinuod nga solid.

q: What must happen on an eggplant or tomato plant before the vegetable forms?
options: The stem must grow thick and woody before fruit can appear
Leaves must fall off so the plant puts energy into its fruit
A flower must first grow on the plant, and from that flower the vegetable slowly forms
The plant must be watered with special fertilizer to trigger fruit growth
explanation: Before an eggplant, tomato, or okra appears, a flower first grows on the plant, and from that flower the vegetable slowly forms.
fact_tl: Bago lumabas ang talong, kamatis, o okra, may bulaklak munang tumutubo sa halaman. Mula sa bulaklak na ito unti-unting nabubuo ang gulay na kinakain natin.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa motungha ang talong, kamatis, o okra, adunay bulak nga motubo una sa tanom. Gikan niini nga bulak hinay-hinay nga maporma ang utanon nga atong gikaon.

q: What is an integrated circuit (IC) also commonly called, and what does it contain?
options: A power cell; it stores electricity made from millions of tiny batteries connected together
A microchip; it is a tiny piece of silicon containing millions of transistors and electronic components
A vacuum tube; it contains glass chambers that control the flow of electricity
A relay board; it holds hundreds of switches that turn electrical signals on or off
explanation: An integrated circuit (IC), also called a microchip, is a tiny piece of silicon containing millions of transistors and other electronic components that power modern devices.
fact_tl: Ang integrated circuit (IC) o microchip ay isang maliit na piraso ng silicon na naglalaman ng milyun-milyong transistors at iba pang electronic component — ang mga IC ay nagpapagana ng mga smartphone, computer, at halos lahat ng makabagong device.
fact_bis: Ang integrated circuit (IC) o microchip usa ka gagmay nga piraso sa silicon nga adunay sulod nga milyon-milyong transistor ug ubang electronic component — ang mga IC nagpagana sa mga smartphone, computer, ug halos tanan nga modernong device.

q: In what year did Filipino scientist Gregorio Zara patent his two-way videophone?
explanation: Gregorio Zara patented his two-way videophone in 1955.
fact_tl: Ipinatente ni Gregorio Zara ang kanyang two-way videophone noong 1955.
fact_bis: Gi-patente ni Gregorio Zara ang iyang two-way videophone niadtong 1955.

q: Of the five ships that set out on Magellan's voyage, how many made it back to Spain after sailing around the world?
options: Five — all ships returned safely after completing the journey
Three — most of the fleet survived the dangerous voyage
Two — Magellan's ship and one other made it back
One — only the Victoria completed the round-the-world voyage and returned
explanation: Only one ship, the Victoria, made it back to Spain after sailing around the world.
fact_tl: Isang barko lamang, ang Victoria, ang nakabalik sa Espanya matapos ang paglibot sa mundo.
fact_bis: Usa lang ka barko, ang Victoria, ang nakabalik sa Espanya human malibot ang kalibotan.

q: Marie Curie was remarkable because she won two Nobel Prizes. In which two fields did she win them?
options: Chemistry and Biology
Physics and Medicine
Physics and Chemistry
Mathematics and Chemistry
explanation: Marie Curie was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes — one in Physics and one in Chemistry.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang unang taong nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize — sa Physics at sa Chemistry.
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie mao ang unang tawo nga nakadaog ug duha ka Nobel Prize — sa Physics ug sa Chemistry.

q: Why do feathers help a bird fly?
options: They are heavy and give the bird enough weight to flap powerfully through the air
They trap warm air that lifts the bird off the ground like a balloon
They are very light but strong, so the bird is not weighed down while flying
They are waterproof and act like sails that catch the wind and push the bird upward
explanation: Feathers are very light but strong, which helps a bird fly without being weighed down.
fact_tl: Magaan ngunit matibay ang mga balahibo, kaya kaya ng ibon na lumipad nang hindi nabibigatan.
fact_bis: Ang mga balhibo gaan apan lig-on, busa makalupad ang langgam nga dili mabug-atan.

q: What is 'tower karst' and how does it form?
options: Underground caves that form when water drips through limestone and builds up stalactites
Tall, steep limestone hills that remain standing after the surrounding rock has dissolved away
Flat limestone plains created when ancient seabeds were pushed above the ocean surface
Networks of sinkholes that collapse and form large circular pits in the ground
explanation: Tower karst forms when tall, steep limestone hills remain standing after the surrounding rock dissolves away.
fact_tl: May uri ng karst na tinatawag na tower karst kung saan natitira ang matataas at matatarik na burol ng apog matapos matunaw ang nakapaligid dito, kagaya ng hugis ng ilang burol sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Adunay matang sa karst nga gitawag ug tower karst diin ang habog ug tarik nga bungtod sa anapog mabilin nga nagtindog human matunaw ang nakapalibot niini, sama sa porma sa pipila ka bungtod sa Pilipinas.

q: Why is it dangerous to take the wrong medicine without seeing a doctor?
options: Wrong medicines are always much more expensive than the right ones
The wrong medicine can hide your real illness so it gets worse before you notice
Taking any medicine is safe as long as you do not exceed the dose on the label
Wrong medicines only cause problems if you take them for more than one week
explanation: The wrong medicine can hide your real illness, making it worse before you even realize there is a serious problem.
fact_tl: Ang maling gamot ay maaaring magtago sa tunay na sakit kaya lumalala ito bago mo malaman.
fact_bis: Ang sayop nga tambal mahimong motabon sa tinuod nimong sakit, mao nga molala kini sa wala pa nimo mahibaw-i.

q: What is the area of Mindanao, the second largest island in the Philippines?
options: About 57,000 square kilometers
About 97,530 square kilometers
About 120,000 square kilometers
About 75,000 square kilometers
explanation: Mindanao, the second largest island of the Philippines, has an area of about 97,530 square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang Mindanao, ang ikalawang pinakamalaking isla ng Pilipinas, ay may sukat na halos 97,530 kilometro kuwadrado (97,530 km²).
fact_bis: Ang Mindanao, ang ikaduhang pinakadako nga isla sa Pilipinas, mga 97,530 ka kilometro kuwadrado ang gilapdon.

q: What happens if you keep blowing air into a balloon past its limit?
options: The balloon just keeps stretching without any limit because rubber is very flexible
The air pressure inside drops and the balloon slowly deflates on its own
The rubber reaches its stretching limit and can no longer hold, so the balloon pops
The balloon floats away because the extra air makes it very light
explanation: Rubber has a stretching limit; once you go past it, the rubber can no longer hold and the balloon pops.
fact_tl: May nag-iisip na puwede mong patuloy na hipan ang lobo nang walang katapusan. Pero ang goma ay may hangganan kung gaano ito kakaya umunat. Kapag lumampas ka sa hangganang iyon, hindi na kaya ng goma at pumuputok ang lobo.
fact_bis: Naay naghunahuna nga mahimo nimong padayon nga huypan ang lobo nga walay kataposan. Apan ang goma adunay limitasyon kung unsa kalayo kini makaunat. Kung molapas ka nianang limita, dili na makaya sa goma ug mobuto ang lobo.

q: What is an electrical conductor, and which of these is a good example?
options: A material that blocks electricity, such as rubber or plastic
A material that lets electricity flow through it, such as copper
A material that stores electricity, such as a battery or capacitor
A material that converts electricity into heat, such as sand or gravel
explanation: A conductor is a material that lets electricity flow through it, and metals like copper are good examples.
fact_tl: Ang konduktor ay materyal na nagpapadaloy ng kuryente, tulad ng mga metal gaya ng tanso (copper).
fact_bis: Ang konduktor kay materyal nga nagpaagi sa kuryente, sama sa mga metal nga sama sa tanso (copper).

q: How does leptospirosis usually spread to people?
options: It passes easily from one infected person to another through sneezing or touch
It spreads through mosquito bites in areas with still water
It usually comes from water or soil that carries the bacteria, not from person to person
It is caught by eating undercooked meat from infected animals
explanation: Leptospirosis rarely spreads directly from person to person; it usually comes from water or soil that carries the bacteria.
fact_tl: Bihirang kumalat ang leptospirosis mula tao patungo sa ibang tao; karaniwan itong nanggagaling sa tubig o lupang may bakterya.
fact_bis: Talagsa ra mokuyanap ang leptospirosis gikan sa usa ka tawo ngadto sa lain; kasagaran kini gikan sa tubig o yuta nga may bakterya.

q: Why is it dangerous to stand in an open field during a thunderstorm?
options: Open fields have wet grass that conducts electricity from the ground up into your feet
Being far from buildings means no shelter from rain, which carries electric charge
Lightning more easily strikes the tallest object in an area, and you could be the tallest thing in the field
Thunderstorms produce hailstones that fall faster in open areas without trees to slow them
explanation: Lightning more easily strikes the tallest object in an area because it is the closest path to the cloud, making it dangerous to be the tallest thing in an open field.
fact_tl: Mas madaling tumama ang kidlat sa pinakamataas na bagay sa paligid dahil mas malapit ito sa ulap, kaya delikadong ikaw ang pinakamataas sa isang bukid o bubong.
fact_bis: Mas sayon nga igoon sa kilat ang labing taas nga butang sa palibot kay mas duol kini sa panganod, busa delikado kung ikaw ang labing taas sa uma o atop.

q: In what year did the world's first jet aircraft, the Heinkel He 178, take its first flight?
explanation: The first jet aircraft, the Heinkel He 178, first flew in 1939.
fact_tl: Unang lumipad ang jet aircraft (ang Heinkel He 178) noong 1939.
fact_bis: Ang unang jet aircraft, ang Heinkel He 178, unang milupad niadtong 1939.

q: How do simple machines like a lever make work easier?
options: They increase the amount of work done so more energy is created from nothing
They change the size or direction of the force needed to do the work
They remove friction completely so objects move without any effort
They store energy in the daytime and release it at night when work is needed
explanation: Simple machines like a lever make work easier by changing the size or direction of the force needed.
fact_tl: Ang mga simpleng makina gaya ng palanca ay nagpapadali ng trabaho sa pamamagitan ng pagbabago ng laki o direksyon ng puwersa.
fact_bis: Ang yano nga mga makina sama sa lever nagpasayon sa trabaho pinaagi sa pag-usab sa kadako o direksyon sa kusog.

q: What gives ochre its red, yellow, or brown color?
options: Crystals of salt and sulfur mixed into the clay during ancient volcanic eruptions
Layers of compressed plant matter that darkened over millions of years
Iron oxide found in the soil or clay that makes up ochre
Tiny fossils of colored sea creatures embedded in the rock
explanation: Ochre is a natural soil or clay containing iron oxide, which gives it its red, yellow, or brown color.
fact_tl: Ang ochre ay likas na lupa o luad na may mineral na bakal (iron oxide), kaya ito ay kulay pula, dilaw, o kayumanggi at isa sa pinakamatandang pigment na ginamit ng tao.
fact_bis: Ang ochre usa ka natural nga yuta o lapok nga adunay mineral nga puthaw (iron oxide), maong pula, dalag, o kapehon kini ug usa sa pinakakaraang pigment nga gigamit sa tawo.

q: Who is the unit of electric charge, the coulomb, named after?
options: Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, a French scientist
Alessandro Volta, the inventor of the battery
James Clerk Maxwell, who unified electricity and magnetism
Hans Christian Ørsted, who discovered electromagnetism
explanation: The coulomb, the unit of electric charge, is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, a French scientist.
fact_tl: Ang coulomb, ang yunit ng elektrikong karga, ay ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, isang Pranses na siyentista.
fact_bis: Ang coulomb, ang yunit sa elektrikong karga, ginganlan kang Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, usa ka Pranses nga siyentista.

q: What happens to the red tide toxin as it moves up the food chain?
options: The toxin is gradually broken down by each animal that eats shellfish, making it harmless
The toxin only stays in plankton and does not pass into the animals that eat them
The toxin builds up in shellfish and can become even more concentrated in animals that eat many affected creatures
The toxin weakens at each level of the food chain because larger animals dilute it in their bodies
explanation: The toxin from plankton builds up in shellfish and can become even more concentrated in animals that eat many affected creatures.
fact_tl: Ang lason mula sa plankton ay naiipon sa kabibe, at maaari pang dumami sa katawan ng mga hayop na kumakain ng maraming apektadong nilalang.
fact_bis: Ang hilo gikan sa plankton matigom sa kabibe, ug mahimo pa nga modaghan sa lawas sa mga mananap nga mokaon og daghang apektadong binuhat.

q: In a candle flame, which part is the hottest?
options: The large yellow outer part that gives off the most light
The dark middle zone where there is not much oxygen
The small blue zone at the very bottom near the wick
The top tip of the flame where gases escape into the air
explanation: The blue zone at the very bottom of the candle flame, near the wick, is the hottest part.
fact_tl: Kapag tiningnan mong mabuti ang apoy ng kandila, may iba't ibang bahagi ito. Sa pinakaibaba, malapit sa mitsa, may bahaging asul na pinakamainit. Sa gitna ay may madilim na bahagi kung saan kulang pa ang oxygen. Ang malaki at dilaw na bahagi sa labas ang nagbibigay ng pinakamaraming liwanag.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon nimo pag-ayo ang kalayo sa kandila, naa kini lain-laing bahin. Sa pinakaubos, duol sa pabilo, naa ang asul nga bahin nga pinakainit. Sa tunga naa ang mangitngit nga bahin diin kulang pa ang oxygen. Ang dako ug dilaw nga bahin sa gawas mao ang naghatag og labing daghang kahayag.

q: Under PAGASA Typhoon Signal No. 2, what wind speeds are expected and what happens to classes?
options: Winds of 45–75 km/h are expected and only college classes may be suspended
Winds of 90–117 km/h are expected and classes in elementary and high school may be suspended
Winds of 120–150 km/h are expected and all classes in all levels are automatically cancelled
Winds of 60–90 km/h are expected and only outdoor activities are cancelled
explanation: Under PAGASA Signal No. 2, winds of 90–117 km/h are expected within 24 hours and classes in elementary and high school may be suspended.
fact_tl: Sa PAGASA Signal No. 2, ang mga hangin na 90–117 km/h ay inaasahang darating sa loob ng 24 oras; maaaring isauspensa ang mga klase sa elementarya at high school.
fact_bis: Sa PAGASA Signal No. 2, ang mga hangin nga 90–117 km/h gilauman sa sulod sa 24 ka oras; ang mga klase sa elementarya ug high school mahimong ihunong.

q: Why does Rafflesia usually not kill the vine it lives in very quickly?
options: Rafflesia produces a chemical that actually heals the vine while taking its nutrients
The vine grows faster than Rafflesia can absorb its nutrients, so there is always enough left
If Rafflesia killed the host too fast, it would also lose its own source of water and food
Rafflesia only lives in the vine for a few days, so the vine does not have time to be harmed
explanation: Rafflesia usually does not quickly kill the vine it lives in because if it did, it would also lose its own source of water and food.
fact_tl: Karaniwang hindi agad pinapatay ng Rafflesia ang baging na tinitirhan nito; pinapahina lang ito habang kumukuha ng tubig at pagkain. Kung mabilis nitong patayin ang host, mawawalan din ito ng pinagkukunan ng buhay.
fact_bis: Kasagaran dili dayon patyon sa Rafflesia ang baging nga gipuy-an niini; gipaluya lang kini samtang mokuha og tubig ug pagkaon. Kung paspas niini patyon ang host, mawad-an usab kini og tinubdan sa kinabuhi.

q: The Philippine Trench is very deep, but how old is it in geological terms?
options: Over 500 million years old, making it one of the oldest features on the ocean floor
About 8 to 9 million years old, which is quite young compared to Earth's age
About 50 million years old, formed during the same time as the Himalayas
About 200 million years old, formed when the supercontinent Pangaea broke apart
explanation: Even though the Philippine Trench is very deep, it is less than 8 to 9 million years old, which is very recent compared to Earth's billions of years.
fact_tl: Kahit napakalalim, ang Philippine Trench ay medyo bata pa sa larangan ng heolohiya, mas bata sa 8 hanggang 9 milyong taon. Sa Earth na bilyon-bilyong taong gulang na, ito ay bagong-bago pa lang.
fact_bis: Bisan lawom kaayo, ang Philippine Trench medyo bata pa sa heolohiya, ubos sa 8 hangtod 9 ka milyon ka tuig. Para sa Yuta nga binilyon na ka tuig, bag-o pa kaayo kini.

q: Why are areas where cold water rises up from the deep ocean often rich in marine life?
options: Cold water holds more oxygen bubbles that fish need to breathe near the surface
Cold deep water carries nutrients upward that support large numbers of sea creatures
Warm-water predators avoid cold upwelling zones, so prey fish gather there safely
Saltier cold water is denser and pushes plankton to the surface where sunlight helps them grow fast
explanation: Places where cold water wells up from the deep are often rich in marine life because of the nutrients the rising water brings.
fact_tl: Ang mga ocean current ay nagdadala ng mga nutrients at nagtatakda ng temperatura ng tubig — ang mga lugar kung saan ang malamig na tubig ay sumusulong mula sa kailaliman ay kadalasang mayaman sa buhay ng dagat dahil sa mga sustansya na dala nito.
fact_bis: Ang mga ocean current nagdala sa mga sustansya ug nagtakda sa temperatura sa tubig — ang mga lugar diin ang bugnaw nga tubig nagtaas gikan sa kailaliman kasagaran dato sa kinabuhi sa dagat tungod sa mga sustansya nga gidala sa tubig.

q: Why are there more fish along a coast with mangroves than along a bare coast?
options: Mangroves release chemicals into the water that attract fish from far away
Mangroves block ocean currents, creating calm pools where fish lay more eggs
Mangroves provide more food and more hiding spots for the fish
Mangroves cool the water, and fish thrive better in cooler coastal water
explanation: Coasts with mangroves have more fish because the mangroves provide more food and more hiding spots for the fish.
fact_tl: Kung ihahambing mo ang isang baybayin na may bakawan sa isang walang bakawan, mas marami ang isda kung saan may bakawan. Ito ay dahil mas maraming pagkain at lugar na matataguan ang mga isda doon.
fact_bis: Kon imong itandi ang baybayon nga adunay bakawan sa usa nga walay bakawan, mas daghan ang isda diin adunay bakawan. Tungod kini sa mas daghang pagkaon ug dapit nga katagoan sa mga isda didto.

q: How fast do all electromagnetic waves — from radio waves to gamma rays — travel through empty space?
options: They each travel at different speeds depending on their energy level
They all travel at the speed of sound, about 340 meters per second
They all travel at the speed of light, about 300,000 kilometers per second
They slow to half the speed of light once they travel farther than the Moon
explanation: All electromagnetic waves travel through a vacuum at the same speed — the speed of light, which is about 300,000 kilometers per second.
fact_tl: Lahat ng electromagnetic wave—mula radyo hanggang gamma—ay naglalakbay sa vacuum sa iisang bilis, ang bilis ng liwanag, na halos 300,000 kilometro kada segundo.
fact_bis: Ang tanang electromagnetic wave—gikan sa radyo hangtod sa gamma—mobiyahe sa vacuum sa managsamang katulin, ang katulin sa kahayag, nga mga 300,000 ka kilometro kada segundo.

q: Who is the unit of magnetic field strength, the tesla, named after?
options: Nikola Tesla, a Serbian-American scientist
Thomas Edison, who invented the light bulb
Heinrich Hertz, who proved electromagnetic waves exist
James Watt, who measured the power of steam engines
explanation: The tesla, the unit of magnetic field strength, is named after Nikola Tesla, a Serbian-American scientist.
fact_tl: Ang tesla, ang yunit ng lakas ng magnetikong larangan, ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla, isang siyentistang Serbian-American.
fact_bis: Ang tesla, ang yunit sa kakusog sa magnetikong natad, ginganlan kang Nikola Tesla, usa ka Serbian-American nga siyentista.

q: What does diorite look like, and how does it form?
options: A smooth, shiny black rock that forms when lava cools very quickly at Earth's surface
A red-brown rock rich in iron that forms in layers at the bottom of shallow seas
A black-and-white speckled rock that forms deep underground when magma cools slowly
A greenish rock that forms only where two ocean plates collide underwater
explanation: Diorite is an intermediate intrusive igneous rock with a distinctive black and white speckled look, formed deep underground as the equivalent of andesite lava.
fact_tl: Ang diorite ay isang intermediate intrusive igneous rock na may natatanging hitsura na puti at itim na mantsa; ito ay ang katumbas sa ilalim ng lupa ng andesite lava.
fact_bis: Ang diorite usa ka intermediate intrusive igneous rock nga adunay natatangi nga puti ug itom nga mantsa; kini mao ang deep underground equivalent sa andesite lava.

q: In natural selection, what actually changes over many generations?
options: Individual animals change their own bodies during their lifetime to survive better
The whole population changes gradually over many generations, not a single individual
Only the strongest individual in each group changes while the others stay the same
Genes jump between individuals in the same generation so the group improves quickly
explanation: It is the whole population, not an individual, that changes over many generations through natural selection.
fact_tl: Hindi ang indibidwal kundi ang buong populasyon ang nagbabago sa paglipas ng maraming henerasyon dahil sa natural na seleksyon.
fact_bis: Dili ang indibidwal kondili ang tibuok populasyon ang nag-usab sa daghang henerasyon tungod sa kinaiyanhong pagpili.

q: What can happen to household appliances during a thunderstorm when lightning strikes power lines?
options: Appliances go into a safe low-power mode automatically when electricity surges
Lightning cools the electricity in power lines, causing appliances to run too slowly
A surge of extra electricity can flow through the system and damage or ruin appliances
Power companies switch off all electricity before a storm to protect everyone's appliances
explanation: When lightning strikes power poles or lines, a surge of extra electricity can flow through the system and damage appliances — unplugging them during a storm helps protect them.
fact_tl: Kapag tumama ang kidlat sa mga poste o linya ng kuryente, sumasabog ang sobrang kuryente sa sistema kaya minsan nagkakaroon ng brownout o nasisira ang mga transformer. Kaya tuwing may malakas na kulog, madalas mawalan tayo ng kuryente. Mabuting hugutin ang plug ng mga appliance para hindi masira ng surge.
fact_bis: Kon motama ang kilat sa mga poste o linya sa kuryente, mobaha ang sobrang kuryente sa sistema, busa usahay magbrownout o madaot ang mga transformer. Mao nga kon kusog ang dalugdog, kanunay tang mawad-an ug kuryente. Maayong ibira ang plug sa mga appliance aron dili madaot sa surge.

q: Why was Pluto reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006?
options: Scientists discovered Pluto is made of ice and gas, not solid rock like real planets
Pluto is too far from the Sun to be counted as a proper planet in our solar system
Pluto has not cleared the other objects from around its orbit, so it no longer meets the planet definition
Pluto is smaller than Earth's Moon, and all objects smaller than the Moon are dwarf planets
explanation: Pluto is called a dwarf planet because it has not cleared the other objects around its orbit, which is one requirement for being a full planet.
fact_tl: Ang Pluto ay tinatawag na dwarf planet (maliit na planeta) dahil hindi nito nalinis ang ibang bagay sa paligid ng orbit nito, kaya noong 2006 ay hindi na ito kabilang sa walong planeta.
fact_bis: Ang Pluto gitawag nga dwarf planet tungod kay wala niini malimpyohi ang ubang butang palibot sa iyang orbit, mao nga sa 2006 wala na kini iapil sa walo ka planeta.

q: Where on a root does new growth happen to make the root longer?
options: At the base of the root near the stem, where nutrients from the plant arrive first
In the middle of the root, which stretches and expands as water is absorbed
At the tip of the root, just behind a protective root cap that shields it as it pushes through the soil
All along the root evenly, so every part of it grows a little longer each day
explanation: A root grows longer at its tip, where new cells form just behind the protective root cap as it pushes through the soil.
fact_tl: Humahaba ang ugat sa dulo nito, hindi sa gitna. Sa dulo ay may malambot na takip (root cap) na nagpoprotekta habang sumusulong ang ugat sa lupa, at sa likod nito gumagawa ng bagong cell para humaba.
fact_bis: Motaas ang gamot sa tumoy niini, dili sa tunga. Ang tumoy adunay humok nga takip (root cap) nga manalipod samtang mosulong ang gamot sa yuta, ug sa luyo niini maghimo og bag-ong cell aron motaas.

q: Which bird replaced the maya as the national bird of the Philippines in 1995?
options: Philippine eagle
Sarimanok
Kingfisher
Philippine duck
explanation: The Philippine eagle replaced the maya as the national bird of the Philippines in 1995.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ang maya ang itinuring na pambansang ibon ng Pilipinas, ngunit pinalitan ito ng agilang Pilipino noong 1995.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang maya mao ang giila nga nasyonal nga langgam sa Pilipinas, apan gipulihan kini sa agila sa Pilipinas niadtong 1995.

q: In 2005, which probe successfully landed on Titan, Saturn's largest moon?
options: Huygens probe
Voyager 1
Mars Pathfinder
Galileo probe
explanation: In January 2005, the ESA's Huygens probe (released from Cassini) landed on Titan — the most distant solar system landing ever made at the time.
fact_tl: Noong Enero 2005, ang Huygens probe ng ESA (na inilunsad ng Cassini spacecraft) ay bumaba sa ibabaw ng Titan, ang pinakamalaking buwan ng Saturn; ito ang pinaka-malalim na solar system landing na nagawa sa oras na iyon, at nagpadala ng mga larawan ng kakaibang landscape ng Titan.
fact_bis: Niadtong Enero 2005, ang Huygens probe sa ESA (gibuhat gikan sa Cassini spacecraft) nag-landing sa nawong sa Titan, ang pinakadako nga buwan sa Saturn; mao kini ang pinaka-layo nga solar system landing nga nahimo niadtong panahona, ug nagpadala og mga larawan sa kakaibang landscape sa Titan.

q: About how long can a blue whale grow?
options: 30 meters
15 meters
50 meters
8 meters
explanation: A blue whale can reach about 30 meters in length, making it the largest animal on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang blue whale ay umaabot ng halos 30 metro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang blue whale moabot ug mga 30 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: What material inside a solar cell is hit by sunlight to knock electrons loose and create electricity?
options: Silicon
Copper
Carbon
Aluminum
explanation: Inside a solar cell is a thin layer of silicon; when sunlight hits it, electrons are knocked loose and their movement creates electricity.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng solar cell ay may manipis na silikon; kapag tumama ang liwanag ng araw, naitutulak nito ang maliliit na elektron para gumalaw, at ang gumagalaw na elektron na iyon ang nagiging kuryente.
fact_bis: Sulod sa solar cell adunay nipis nga silikon; kon maigo sa kahayag sa adlaw, ibuy-od niini ang gagmay nga mga elektron aron molihok, ug kanang naglihok nga mga elektron mao ang koryente.

q: About how long does one day last on Saturn?
options: 10.7 hours
24 hours
16 hours
30 hours
explanation: One day on Saturn lasts about 10.7 hours, one of the shortest days among the planets.
fact_tl: Ang isang araw sa Saturn ay tumatagal ng halos 10.7 oras, isa rin sa pinakamaiikling araw sa mga planeta.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka adlaw sa Saturn motagal ug mga 10.7 ka oras, usa usab sa pinakamubo nga adlaw sa mga planeta.

q: In a room, where is the air usually warmest — near the ceiling or near the floor?
options: Near the ceiling
Near the floor
In the middle
It is the same everywhere
explanation: Because of convection, warm air rises to the ceiling while cool air sinks to the floor, making the air near the ceiling warmer.
fact_tl: Dahil sa convection, mas mainit ang hangin malapit sa kisame kaysa sa sahig, dahil umaakyat ang mainit na hangin at lumulubog ang malamig. Kaya mas mainit sa itaas na palapag ng bahay.
fact_bis: Tungod sa convection, mas init ang hangin duol sa kisame kaysa sa salog, kay mosaka ang init nga hangin ug monaog ang bugnaw. Mao nga mas init ang taas nga andana sa balay.

q: What is a pyroclastic flow?
options: A fast, scorching current of gas, ash, and rock that races down a volcano
A slow river of lava that cools as it flows downhill
A cloud of steam released when lava hits the ocean
A mudflow triggered by heavy rain on a volcano
explanation: A pyroclastic flow is a scorching, very fast current of gas, ash, and rock that races down a volcano and is one of the most dangerous parts of an eruption.
fact_tl: Ang pyroclastic flow ay napakainit at napakabilis na agos ng gas, abo, at bato na bumababa sa gilid ng bulkan kapag sumasabog, at ito ang isa sa pinakamapanganib na bahagi ng pagputok.
fact_bis: Ang pyroclastic flow usa ka init kaayo ug paspas kaayo nga agos sa gas, abo, ug bato nga modagan paubos sa kilid sa bulkan panahon sa pagbuto, ug usa kini sa labing delikado nga bahin sa pagbuto.

q: How does the bacterium Staphylococcus epidermidis help protect our skin?
options: It normally lives on skin and blocks harmful bacteria from entering
It produces a layer of oil that keeps skin moisturized
It kills viruses by releasing a chemical disinfectant
It repairs damaged skin cells after a cut
explanation: Staphylococcus epidermidis is part of the skin's microbiome and helps block harmful bacteria from entering the body.
fact_tl: Ang ating balat ay may sariling microbiome — mga bacteria tulad ng Staphylococcus epidermidis na karaniwang naninirahan sa ating balat at pumipigil sa mapanganib na bacteria na makapasok.
fact_bis: Ang atong balat adunay kaugalingong microbiome — mga bakterya sama sa Staphylococcus epidermidis nga kasagaran namuyo sa atong balat ug nagpugong sa mga mapanganib nga bakterya sa pagsulod.

q: What do ceramic objects have in common with glass when they are dropped?
options: Both can crack or break because they are brittle
Both bounce back without breaking
Both melt when they hit the ground
Both become stronger after being dropped
explanation: Like glass, ceramics are brittle and can crack or break when dropped.
fact_tl: Tulad ng salamin, ang seramika ay babasagin din at maaaring magkalamat o mabasag kapag nahulog.
fact_bis: Sama sa salamin, ang seramika babasagon usab ug mahimong moliki o mabuak kung mahulog.

q: Why can a single chlorine atom from CFC chemicals destroy thousands of ozone molecules?
options: Because the chlorine atom is used and then freed again and again, like a machine that never stops
Because chlorine atoms split into thousands of smaller pieces in the stratosphere
Because chlorine heats up the ozone layer, causing it to fall apart quickly
Because chlorine combines permanently with each ozone molecule to form a new gas
explanation: CFC chemicals release chlorine in the stratosphere, and a single chlorine atom destroys thousands of ozone molecules because it is used and freed repeatedly.
fact_tl: Ang mga kemikal na CFC ay naglalabas ng chlorine sa stratosphere. Isang atomo ng chlorine ang maaaring makasira ng libo-libong molekula ng ozone dahil ginagamit at muling napapalaya ito nang paulit-ulit, parang masamang makina na walang tigil.
fact_bis: Ang mga kemikal nga CFC mubuga og chlorine sa stratosphere. Usa ka atomo sa chlorine makaguba og liboan ka molekula sa ozone kay gamiton ug buhian kini balik-balik, sama sa daotang makina nga walay hunong.

q: What do images of Mars show about its ancient past?
options: Mars once had rivers and lakes, meaning liquid water used to flow there
Mars was once covered by thick forests before its atmosphere disappeared
Mars used to be a moon of Jupiter before it drifted to its current orbit
Mars once had oceans of liquid lava that carved the surface
explanation: Images show that Mars once had rivers and lakes long ago, meaning liquid water used to flow on its surface.
fact_tl: Napatunayan ng mga larawan na may mga ilog at lawa sa Mars noong unang panahon, kaya umaagos dati ang tubig doon.
fact_bis: Gipakita sa mga litrato nga ang Mars kaniadto adunay mga suba ug mga lanaw, mao nga nagdagayday kaniadto ang tubig didto.

q: Where deep inside the Earth do diamonds form?
options: In the mantle, about 150 kilometers down
In the outer crust, just below the surface
At the boundary between the crust and the core
At the very center of the Earth's inner core
explanation: Diamonds form deep in the Earth's mantle, about 150 kilometers down, where heat and pressure are extreme.
fact_tl: Ang mga diyamante ay nabubuo nang malalim sa mantle ng Earth, mga 150 kilometro pababa, kung saan napakatindi ng init at presyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga diyamante mabuo lawom sa mantle sa Yuta, mga 150 ka kilometro paubos, diin grabe kaayo ang init ug presyur.

q: Some mushroom species in Philippine tropical forests glow in the dark. What chemical do they use to produce this cold green light?
options: Luciferin
Chlorophyll
Bioluminol
Phosphorus
explanation: Bioluminescent mushrooms in Philippine forests use a chemical called luciferin to produce a cold green light in the dark.
fact_tl: May ilang uri ng kabute sa mga tropical na kagubatan ng Pilipinas na nagliliwanag sa dilim sa pamamagitan ng bioluminescence — ginagamit nila ang kemikal na luciferin upang makagawa ng malamig na berdeng liwanag.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka klase sa kabute sa mga tropical nga kagubatan sa Pilipinas nga nagsingaw og kahayag sa kangitngit pinaagi sa bioluminescence — gigamit nila ang kemikal nga luciferin aron makagama og bugnaw nga berdeng kahayag.

q: How does El Niño increase the risk of forest fires?
options: It causes drought that dries out forests and vegetation
It brings strong winds that can spread sparks quickly
It heats the air so much that wood ignites on its own
It stops rainfall entirely for several years at a time
explanation: The drought caused by El Niño dries out forests and vegetation, greatly increasing forest fire risk.
fact_tl: Ang tagtuyot na dulot ng El Nino ay nagpapatuyo ng mga kagubatan at damo, nagpapataas ng panganib ng sunog sa kagubatan; nangyari ito sa Palawan at iba pang lugar ng Pilipinas sa panahon ng malakas na El Nino.
