fact_bis: Ang hulaw nga gikan sa El Nino nagpauga sa mga kagubatan ug tanom, nagpataas sa peligro sa sunog sa kagubatan; kini nahitabo sa Palawan ug uban pang bahin sa Pilipinas sa panahon sa kusog nga El Nino.

q: What happens in your body that makes you feel hungry?
options: The sugar level in your blood drops, which signals your brain it is time to eat
Your stomach sends a direct electric signal to your muscles
Your liver releases a hunger hormone when it is completely empty
The smell of food triggers your heart to beat faster
explanation: When the glucose in your blood drops low, it signals your brain that it is time to eat.
fact_tl: Kapag bumababa ang asukal o glucose sa iyong dugo, nagpapadala ito ng senyales sa utak na oras na para kumain.
fact_bis: Kung moubos ang asukal o glucose sa imong dugo, magpadala kini og senyales sa utok nga panahon na sa pagkaon.

q: What is on the outside of a jackfruit that helps protect the soft flesh inside?
options: A thick, bumpy skin covered with small spikes
A hard, smooth shell like a coconut
A layer of waxy leaves wrapped tightly around it
A tough, leathery skin with deep ridges
explanation: Jackfruit has a thick, bumpy skin covered with small spikes that protects the soft flesh inside.
fact_tl: May makapal at malagkit-lagkit na balat ang langka na puno ng maliliit na tinik. Ang balat na ito ang nagpoprotekta sa malambot na laman sa loob.
fact_bis: Ang nangka adunay baga ug tunokon nga panit nga puno sa gagmay nga tunok. Kini nga panit nanalipod sa humok nga unod sa sulod.

q: What type of water forms where a river meets the sea?
options: Brackish water, which is slightly salty
Freshwater, because rivers dilute the salt
Saltwater, because the sea overpowers the river
Mineral water, due to rock deposits at the river mouth
explanation: Where a river meets the sea, fresh and salt water mix to form brackish water that is slightly salty.
fact_tl: Sa bukana ng ilog kung saan ito sumasalubong sa dagat, naghahalo ang tubig-tabang at maalat at tinatawag itong tubig-asim o brackish.
fact_bis: Sa baba sa suba diin kini mosugat sa dagat, ang tubig-tab-ang ug parat magsagol ug mahimong brackish nga gamay'g parat.

q: How does a bat figure out how far away an object is using echolocation?
options: It times how long the echo takes to come back
It counts how many echoes it hears in one second
It measures how loud the echo sounds when it returns
It checks the direction the echo comes from
explanation: A bat times how long the echo takes to return — a quick echo means the object is close, a slow echo means it is far.
fact_tl: Paano nalalaman ng paniki kung gaano kalayo ang isang bagay? Tinitiyempo nito kung gaano katagal bumalik ang alingawngaw. Kung mabilis bumalik ang tunog, malapit ang bagay. Kung matagal, malayo. Parang sumisigaw ka sa bundok at binibilang kung kailan bumalik ang echo.
fact_bis: Unsaon pagkahibalo sa kabog kung unsa kalayo ang usa ka butang? Iyang tantyahon kung unsa kadugay mibalik ang alingawngaw. Kung paspas mibalik ang tingog, duol ang butang. Kung dugay, layo. Sama sa pagsinggit sa bukid ug pag-ihap kung kanus-a mibalik ang echo.

q: How does the weather usually differ during the amihan season compared to the habagat season?
options: The amihan brings clearer, drier weather with brighter skies
The amihan brings heavy rain and strong winds every day
The amihan is hotter and more humid than the habagat
The amihan and habagat have exactly the same kind of weather
explanation: During the amihan, the weather is clearer and drier, so the sky is more often bright compared to the habagat season.
fact_tl: Tuwing amihan, mas malinaw at mas tuyo ang panahon, kaya mas madalas na aliwalas ang langit kumpara sa tag-habagat.
fact_bis: Panahon sa amihan, mas tin-aw ug mas mala ang panahon, mao nga mas kanunay nga aliwalas ang langit kumpara sa panahon sa habagat.

q: How does a microwave oven heat food?
options: It makes water molecules inside the food vibrate, and that vibration produces heat
It blows very hot air across the food from a heating element
It uses light rays that directly burn the surface of the food
It sends electric current through the food to heat it from the inside
explanation: A microwave oven uses microwave radiation that causes water molecules inside food to vibrate, and this vibration generates heat throughout the food.
fact_tl: Ang microwave oven ay gumagamit ng microwave radiation na may espesyal na frequency na nagdudulot ng vibration ng mga water molecules sa loob ng pagkain — ang vibration na ito ay nagbibigay ng init.
fact_bis: Ang microwave oven naggamit og microwave radiation sa usa ka frequency nga nagpalihok sa mga water molecule sa sulod sa pagkain — kining vibration nagabuhat og init sa tibuok pagkain.

q: What do snakes and turtles do during cold weather, and why?
options: They go through brumation and become very still because their body temperature follows the temperature around them
They hibernate deeply like bears and do not breathe for weeks
They migrate to warmer regions by traveling long distances
They burrow underground and raise their own body heat to stay warm
explanation: Reptiles like snakes and turtles go through brumation in cold weather — they become still and barely move because their body temperature follows the temperature around them.
fact_tl: Ang mga reptilya tulad ng ahas at pagong ay dumaraan sa brumation tuwing malamig na panahon — tumitigil sila at halos hindi gumagalaw dahil ang init ng katawan nila ay sumusunod sa init ng paligid.
fact_bis: Ang mga reptilya sama sa halas ug bao moagi sa brumation sa bugnaw nga panahon — mohunong sila ug halos dili molihok kay ang kainit sa ilang lawas mosunod sa kainit sa palibot.

q: What do glasses do for a person with astigmatism?
options: They bend light so it lands correctly on the retina, making vision clear while the glasses are worn
They slowly fix the shape of the eye so the person no longer needs glasses
They train the eye muscles to focus better over time
They block harmful light that would otherwise damage the curved eye
explanation: Glasses do not change the eye's shape, but while worn they make light land correctly on the retina so the person sees clearly.
fact_tl: Hindi tinatanggal ng salamin ang astigmatism — ang hugis ng mata ay nananatiling pareho. Pero kapag suot ang salamin, tumatama nang maayos ang liwanag sa retina kaya malinaw ang nakikita habang naka-salamin.
fact_bis: Ang antiyohos dili motangtang sa astigmatism — ang porma sa mata magpabilin nga pareho. Apan samtang nagsul-ob ka og antiyohos, ang kahayag motama og maayo sa retina maong klaro ang imong makita samtang nakasul-ob.

q: The colors of the rainbow that our eyes can see make up what part of the electromagnetic spectrum?
options: Only a small part of the full electromagnetic spectrum
The entire electromagnetic spectrum
The largest part of the electromagnetic spectrum
The half of the spectrum closest to radio waves
explanation: Visible light — the rainbow of colors our eyes detect — is only a small part of the full electromagnetic spectrum.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag na nakikita ng ating mga mata ay isang maliit na bahagi lamang ng electromagnetic spectrum, at ito ang nakikita natin bilang mga kulay ng bahaghari.
fact_bis: Ang kahayag nga makita sa atong mga mata gamay ra nga bahin sa electromagnetic spectrum, ug kini atong makita isip mga kolor sa balangaw.

q: What happens to old leaves on trees in the Philippines?
options: They fall off and are replaced by new leaves
They stay on the tree forever because the Philippines has no winter
They turn red and orange before dropping, just like in cold countries
They dry up and curl but never fully fall off
explanation: Even in the Philippines, old leaves fall off and are replaced by new leaves throughout the year.
fact_tl: Kahit sa Pilipinas, nalalagas ang lumang dahon at pinapalitan ng bagong dahon.
fact_bis: Bisan sa Pilipinas, mahulog ang daan nga dahon ug pulihan og bag-ong dahon.

q: Which source of iron does the body absorb more easily?
options: Iron from meat
Iron from vegetables and beans
Iron from fortified cereals
Iron from leafy plants like spinach
explanation: The body absorbs iron from meat (heme iron) more easily than iron from plants (non-heme iron).
fact_tl: Mas madaling nasisipsip ng katawan ang bakal mula sa karne kaysa sa bakal mula sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Mas dali masuyop sa lawas ang puthaw gikan sa karne kaysa puthaw gikan sa mga tanom.

q: Which of the following best describes Mount Apo?
options: A dormant volcano that has not erupted in recorded history but still has sulphur vents
An active volcano that erupts every few years with powerful ash clouds
An extinct volcano with no signs of volcanic activity whatsoever
A newly formed volcano that first appeared after a major earthquake
explanation: Mount Apo is a dormant volcano with no eruption in recorded history, though it still has vents that release sulphur.
fact_tl: Ang Bundok Apo ay isang bulkan na hindi na pumutok sa mga nakatalang panahon ngunit may mga butas pa rin na naglalabas ng asupre.
fact_bis: Ang Bukid Apo usa ka bulkan nga wala pa miputok sa natala nga kasaysayan apan aduna pa kini mga lungag nga nagpagawas og asupre.

q: Galileo Galilei is called the 'Father of Modern Science' and also the father of what specific field of astronomy?
options: Observational Astronomy
Theoretical Astronomy
Astrophysics
Planetary Geology
explanation: Galileo Galilei is called both the 'Father of Modern Science' and the 'Father of Observational Astronomy'.
fact_tl: Si Galileo Galilei ay tinaguriang 'Ama ng Makabagong Agham' at 'Ama ng Obserbasyonal na Astronomiya'.
fact_bis: Si Galileo Galilei gitawag nga 'Amahan sa Modernong Siyensya' ug 'Amahan sa Observational Astronomy'.

q: Why is the clean water of the Agusan Marsh important for families living nearby?
options: Fish live and multiply in clean water, providing both food and income for the people
Clean water allows families to grow rice directly in the marsh without irrigation
The marsh supplies drinking water to nearby cities through underground pipes
Clean water attracts tourists who pay to swim and kayak in the marsh
explanation: Many families around the Agusan Marsh make a living by fishing, and the clean water is important because fish live and multiply there, becoming both food and income.
fact_tl: Maraming pamilya sa palibot ng Agusan Marsh ang nabubuhay sa pangingisda. Mahalaga ang malinis na tubig ng marsh dahil dito tumitira at dumarami ang mga isda na nagiging pagkain at pinagkakakitaan ng mga tao.
fact_bis: Daghang pamilya sa palibot sa Agusan Marsh ang nagpanginabuhi pinaagi sa pagpangisda. Importante ang limpyo nga tubig sa marsh kay didto magpuyo ug modaghan ang mga isda nga mahimong pagkaon ug kita sa mga tao.

q: Why is there no sound in outer space?
options: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum — it needs matter to move through
Sound travels in outer space but is too weak to hear from Earth
The extreme cold of space freezes sound waves before they can spread
Sound waves are destroyed by cosmic radiation before reaching far distances
explanation: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum or empty space, which is why outer space is completely silent.
fact_tl: Ang tunog ay hindi makakadaan sa kawalan o vacuum, kaya walang naririnig na tunog sa kalawakan.
fact_bis: Ang tingog dili makaagi sa hawan o vacuum, mao nga walay madunggan nga tingog sa kawanangan.

q: Where does an adult mosquito first appear after leaving its pupa stage?
options: At the water surface, where it dries its wings before flying
On a leaf above the water, where it waits for its wings to harden
Inside a crack in mud near the water's edge
On the underside of a floating leaf in still water
explanation: The adult mosquito emerges from the pupa skin at the water surface and dries its wings there before flying away.
fact_tl: Ang ganap na lamok ay lumalabas mula sa balat ng pupa sa ibabaw ng tubig, pagkatapos ay tumutuyo ang pakpak bago lumipad.
fact_bis: Ang hingkod nga lamok mogula gikan sa panit sa pupa sa ibabaw sa tubig, dayon mauga ang pako una molupad.

q: In billiards, what happens to a rolling ball's motion when it strikes another ball?
options: It passes its motion to the struck ball, causing the struck ball to move off
Both balls stop completely at the moment they touch
The rolling ball speeds up while the struck ball stays still
Both balls roll in the same direction at the same speed after impact
explanation: In billiards, when a rolling ball strikes another it passes on its motion, so the struck ball moves off — an example of elastic collision.
fact_tl: Sa bilyar o karambola, kapag tinamaan ng gumugulong na bola ang ibang bola, naililipat nito ang lakas ng galaw kaya ang natamaang bola ang gumagalaw naman.
fact_bis: Sa bilyar o karambola, kung ang naglihok nga bola mobangga sa laing bola, mabalhin niini ang kusog sa paglihok mao nga ang nabanggaan nga bola maoy molihok.

q: How does exercise help you stand and sit up straight with good posture?
options: It strengthens the back and tummy muscles that support your spine
It makes your bones grow longer and thicker so your spine is stiffer
It trains your brain to automatically correct your position while you sleep
It stretches the cartilage between vertebrae so your spine becomes more flexible
explanation: Exercise strengthens the muscles in your back and tummy that support your spine, which helps you stand and sit straighter.
fact_tl: Ang ehersisyo ay nagpapalakas ng mga kalamnan sa likod at tiyan na sumusuporta sa iyong gulugod. Kaya mas tuwid at mas magandang tumindig ang katawan mo.
fact_bis: Ang ehersisyo magpalig-on sa mga unod sa likod ug tiyan nga nagsuporta sa imong bukog-likod. Mao nga mas tul-id ang imong barog ug lingkod.

q: In a commensalism relationship, what happens to both organisms involved?
options: One organism benefits while the other is neither helped nor harmed
Both organisms benefit equally from the relationship
One organism benefits while the other is clearly harmed
Both organisms are harmed by living together
explanation: In commensalism, one organism benefits while the other is neither helped nor harmed.
fact_tl: Sa komensalismo, isang organismo ang nakikinabang habang ang isa ay hindi tinutulungan o sinasaktan.
fact_bis: Sa komensalismo, usa ka organismo ang makabenepisyo samtang ang lain dili matabangan ni masakitan.

q: What is high tide?
options: When the seawater reaches its highest level at the shore
When the ocean floor becomes visible because water has pulled back
When strong winds push waves unusually high during a storm
When the tide changes direction twice in one day
explanation: High tide is when the seawater reaches its highest level at the shore.
fact_tl: Ang high tide (mataas na taog) ay kapag umabot sa pinakamataas na lebel ang tubig dagat sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang high tide (taas nga taob) mao kon ang tubig dagat moabot sa kinatas-ang lebel sa baybayon.

q: Why does red tide often follow heavy rain in some Philippine bays?
options: Floods wash fertilizer and waste from the land into the sea, feeding the plankton that cause red tide
Heavy rain cools the sea water so much that plankton multiply faster
Rainwater makes the sea less salty, which causes harmful algae to bloom
Strong winds from rainstorms stir up the seafloor and release trapped plankton
explanation: After heavy rain, floods wash fertilizer and waste from the land into the sea, giving plankton food and triggering red tide blooms.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng malakas na ulan, madalas sumunod ang red tide sa ilang look dahil tinatangay ng baha ang pataba at dumi mula sa lupa papunta sa dagat, na nagbibigay ng pagkain sa plankton.
fact_bis: Human sa kusog nga ulan, sagad mosunod ang red tide sa pipila ka look kay anuron sa baha ang abuno ug hugaw gikan sa yuta ngadto sa dagat, nga maghatag og pagkaon sa plankton.

q: What did Angel Alcala's research help show at Apo Island in Negros Oriental?
options: That fishing bans restore ocean resources, making it a model marine sanctuary
That dynamite fishing actually increases the number of fish in the long run
That coral reefs grow faster when tourists are allowed to swim over them
That mangrove forests protect fish populations better than fishing bans do
explanation: Apo Island became a model marine sanctuary with Angel Alcala's help, showing that fishing bans restore ocean resources.
fact_tl: Ang Apo Island sa Negros Oriental ay naging modelo ng marine sanctuary sa tulong ng pananaliksik ni Angel Alcala, na nagpakita na ang pagbabawal ng pangingisda ay nagpapalakas ng yamang dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Apo Island sa Negros Oriental naging modelo nga marine sanctuary pinaagi sa tabang sa panukiduki ni Angel Alcala, nagpakita nga ang pagdili sa pangisda nagpabuhag sa mga yamang dagat.

q: Why does an incandescent lightbulb glow?
options: Electricity heats the thin wire (filament) inside until it glows
Light from outside the bulb is collected and redirected by a mirror inside
A chemical reaction between two gases inside the bulb produces light
The glass of the bulb absorbs electricity and converts it directly into light
explanation: An incandescent bulb glows because electricity heats the thin wire called the filament until it glows with light.
fact_tl: Ang bombilya ay nagliliwanag dahil pinapainit ng kuryente ang manipis na kawad sa loob (filament) hanggang sa magbaga ito.
fact_bis: Ang bombilya nagsiga tungod kay ang kuryente nag-init sa nipis nga kawad sa sulod, ang filament, hangtod kini magbaga.

q: What is the birthstone for the month of July?
options: Ruby
Sapphire
Emerald
Amethyst
explanation: The birthstone for July is the ruby, which is a bright red gemstone.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Hulyo ay ang ruby (rubi), na matingkad na pula ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Hulyo kay ang ruby (rubi), nga hayag nga pula og kolor.

q: What makes distilled water different from other types of purified water?
options: Distilled water is cleaned through evaporation, while other purified water may just be filtered or treated another way
Distilled water still contains some minerals, while all other purified water is completely mineral-free
Distilled water is only safe to drink after adding minerals back in, unlike other purified water
Distilled water is the same as purified water — both terms mean exactly the same thing
explanation: Distilled water is purified by evaporation, while other purified water may be cleaned by filtering or other methods.
fact_tl: Ang distiladong tubig at purified water ay parehong nililinis, pero magkaiba ang paraan: ang distiladong tubig ay nilinis sa pamamagitan ng pagsingaw, habang ang purified water ay maaaring sinala lamang o dumaan sa ibang proseso.
fact_bis: Ang distiladong tubig ug purified water parehong gilimpyohan, apan lahi ang paagi: ang distiladong tubig gilimpyohan pinaagi sa pagsingaw, samtang ang purified water mahimong gisala lang o giagi sa laing proseso.

q: What happens when sunlight passes through the thick edge of a water-filled glass?
options: It splits into rainbow colors, just like a prism
It becomes brighter because the water concentrates it
It turns into a single beam of white light that shines straight ahead
It bounces back and creates a bright spot on the ceiling
explanation: When sunlight passes through the thick edge of a water-filled glass, it acts like a prism and splits the light into rainbow colors through refraction.
fact_tl: Kapag dumaan ang sikat ng araw sa makapal na gilid ng basong may tubig, parang prism itong naghahati ng liwanag sa mga kulay ng bahaghari.
fact_bis: Kung moagi ang silaw sa adlaw sa baga nga ngilit sa basong may tubig, molihok kini sama sa prism ug bahinon ang kahayag ngadto sa mga kolor sa balangaw.

q: How can santol fruit be enjoyed?
options: Eaten fresh or made into sweet preserves and candy
Only eaten when fully dried, as fresh santol is too sour to eat
Only used as a souring agent in cooking, never eaten on its own
Ground into powder and mixed with water to make a juice drink
explanation: Santol can be eaten fresh or made into sweet preserves and candy.
fact_tl: Ang santol ay maaaring kainin nang sariwa o gawing matamis na minatamis o kendi.
fact_bis: Ang santol mahimong kan-on nga lab-as o himoon nga tam-is nga minatamis o kendi.

q: How does the cuttlebone help a cuttlefish change color and hide from predators?
options: By keeping the cuttlefish floating level without swimming, freeing its energy to change color
By producing special pigment chemicals that the cuttlefish uses to shift its skin color
By acting as a shield that reflects light and confuses predators trying to spot it
By storing oxygen so the cuttlefish can stay still on the seafloor and camouflage itself
explanation: The cuttlebone keeps the cuttlefish floating level without constant swimming, so it can spend its energy on changing color and hiding from predators.
fact_tl: Dahil pinapanatili ng cuttlebone na lumutang nang patag ang cuttlefish nang hindi kailangang patuloy na lumangoy, mas madali nitong magagamit ang lakas niya para sa pagbabago ng kulay at pagtatago sa mga mandaragit.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang cuttlebone naghimo sa cuttlefish nga molutaw nga patag nga dili na kinahanglan kanunay nga molangoy, magamit niini ang kusog niini sa pag-usab og kolor ug pagtago gikan sa mga manunukob.

q: What role do certain anaerobic bacteria play in the sulfur cycle, and what sign tells you they are at work?
options: They release sulfur from dead organisms and produce hydrogen sulfide, which causes a rotten-egg smell
They absorb sulfur from the air and lock it into the soil so plants can use it
They break down sulfur dioxide in the atmosphere to keep the air clean
They produce sulfuric acid that dissolves minerals and releases sulfur into rivers
explanation: Anaerobic bacteria release sulfur from dead organisms in the sulfur cycle; the hydrogen sulfide they produce causes the characteristic rotten-egg smell.
fact_tl: Ang ilang bacteria ay gumaganap ng mahalagang papel sa sulfur cycle sa pamamagitan ng pagpapalaya ng sulfur mula sa mga patay na organismo — ang hydrogen sulfide na nililikha ng ilang bacteria ay nagbibigay ng amoy ng bulok na itlog.
fact_bis: Ang uban nga bakterya nagtrabaho og importante nga bahin sa sulfur cycle pinaagi sa pagpagawas sa sulfur gikan sa mga patay nga organismo — ang hydrogen sulfide nga naporma sa pipila ka anaerobic bacteria naghatag sa amoy sa bulok nga itlog.

q: What can a shark's skin do to a person even before the shark bites?
options: Its sharp denticles can scrape and scratch skin like sandpaper
Its slippery coating can cause a person to slip and fall in the water
Its electric sensors can give a mild shock when touched
Its rigid scales can inject a mild venom into the skin on contact
explanation: A shark's skin is covered with sharp denticles that act like sandpaper and can scrape a person's skin even before a bite — sometimes called 'shark burn.'
fact_tl: Oo, kaya kang gasgasan ng balat ng pating kahit hindi ka pa kinakagat! Kapag sumagi sa iyo ang katawan ng isang mabilis na pating, ang matatalim nitong denticle ay parang papel de liha na maaaring magpagasgas sa iyong balat — tinatawag itong 'shark burn'.
fact_bis: Oo, makagasgas kanimo ang panit sa iho bisan wala pa kini mopaak! Kon ang paspas nga iho mosagi kanimo, ang talinis niini nga denticle morag lija nga makagasgas sa imong panit — gitawag usahay kini og 'shark burn.'

q: On a stringed instrument, what happens to the pitch when a player presses a fret?
options: The vibrating length of the string shortens, so the pitch goes up
The vibrating length of the string lengthens, so the pitch goes down
The string vibrates faster because more tension is added at the bridge
The pitch stays the same but the sound becomes louder
explanation: Pressing a fret moves one end of the vibrating string, shortening it between the nut and bridge, which raises the pitch.
fact_tl: Ang bahagi ng kuwerdas na nag-vibrate ay nasa pagitan ng dalawang dulo: ang nut sa itaas at ang bridge sa baba. Kapag pinindot mo ang kuwerdas sa fret, lumilipat ang isang dulo at pumapaikli ang kuwerdas, kaya tumataas ang tunog.
fact_bis: Ang bahin sa kuwerdas nga mokurog naa sa tunga sa duha ka tumoy: ang nut sa ibabaw ug ang bridge sa ubos. Kung imong ipisil ang kuwerdas sa fret, mobalhin ang usa ka tumoy ug mamubo ang kuwerdas, mao nga mosaka ang tingog.

q: Where in a Philippine home are centipedes most commonly found, and when do they usually move around?
options: In damp corners like the bathroom, mostly at night
On sunny windowsills where they warm themselves during the day
Inside dry rice sacks stored in the kitchen
In the garden soil during the morning hours
explanation: In the Philippines, centipedes are often seen in damp corners of the house such as the bathroom, and they usually move around at night.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas makita ang alupihan sa mga mamasa-masang sulok ng bahay tulad ng banyo, at karaniwan itong gumagala sa gabi.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, kasagaran makita ang alupihan sa mga basa-basa nga suok sa balay sama sa kasilyas, ug kasagaran kini molihok sa gabii.

q: What color are carabaos usually?
options: Gray to black
Brown or white
Spotted black and white
Golden yellow
explanation: Carabaos are usually gray to black, unlike cows which are often brown, black, or white.
fact_tl: Ang baka ay madalas kayumanggi, itim, o puti, pero ang kalabaw ay karaniwang kulay-abo hanggang itim, kaya madali silang pagkaiba.
fact_bis: Ang baka kasagaran kape, itom, o puti, apan ang kalabaw kasagaran abuhon hangtod itom, mao nga sayon ra silang ilahon.

q: Why are plants considered producers in a food chain?
options: They can make their own food from sunlight
They eat other organisms to get energy
They break down dead plants and animals
They store energy underground in their roots
explanation: Plants and algae are producers because only they can make their own food from sunlight, placing them at the start of every food chain.
fact_tl: Ang mga prodyuser tulad ng halaman at algae ang nasa simula ng bawat food chain dahil sila lang ang gumagawa ng sariling pagkain mula sa liwanag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang mga producer sama sa tanom ug algae ang anaa sa sinugdanan sa matag food chain kay sila ra ang makahimo og kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw.

q: Why can a chameleon move each eye separately and independently?
options: Each eye is shaped like a tower covered by skin with only a small hole to see through
Its eyes are on opposite sides of its head like a flat disk
It has two separate brains, each controlling one eye
Its eyes are connected to different muscles than other lizards
explanation: A chameleon's eye is shaped like a small tower covered by skin with only a tiny hole to see through, which is what allows each eye to move independently.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng chameleon ay parang maliit na tore na natatakpan ng balat, may maliit lang na butas para sa paningin. Ito ang dahilan kaya kaya nilang igalaw ang bawat mata nang magkahiwalay.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa chameleon sama sa gamay nga tore nga gitabonan og panit, adunay gamay ra nga lungag aron makakita. Mao kini ang hinungdan nga makahimo silang ilihok ang matag mata nga magkalahi.

q: According to Newton's third law, when you push against a wall, what does the wall do?
options: Pushes back on you with the same strength in the opposite direction
Pushes back on you but with less force than you used
Stays still because it is much heavier than you
Absorbs your push and converts it to heat
explanation: Newton's third law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction, so the wall pushes back on you with the same strength but in the opposite direction.
fact_tl: Ayon sa ikatlong batas ni Newton: sa bawat aksyon, may katumbas na reaksyon na kasinglakas pero magkasalungat ng direksyon. Ibig sabihin, kapag ang isang bagay ay tumutulak sa pangalawa, ang pangalawa ay tumutulak pabalik nang pantay na lakas pero pabaligtad na direksyon.
fact_bis: Sumala sa ikatulong balaod ni Newton: sa matag aksyon, adunay katumbas nga reaksyon nga parehas ug kusog apan magkasumpaki ang direksyon. Buot ipasabot, kung ang usa ka butang motulod sa ikaduha, ang ikaduha motulod balik nga parehas ug kusog apan supak nga direksyon.

q: In a chemical reaction, what determines whether the reaction is exothermic (releases heat) or endothermic (absorbs heat)?
options: The difference between energy needed to break reactant bonds and energy released when product bonds form
Whether the chemicals are solid or liquid before reacting
How fast the reaction happens
The color change of the chemicals during the reaction
explanation: The difference between the energy needed to break reactant bonds and the energy released when new product bonds form determines if a reaction is exothermic or endothermic.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng enerhiya upang putulin ang mga bono ng reactant, at naglalabas ng enerhiya kapag nabubuo ang mga bagong bono ng product; ang pagkakaiba nito ang nagsasabi kung exothermic o endothermic ang reaksyon.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan og enerhiya aron bungkagon ang mga bond sa reactant, ug mogawas ang enerhiya kon maporma ang bag-ong mga bond sa product; ang kalainan niini maoy nagsulti kon exothermic o endothermic ang reaksiyon.

q: Which THREE things does a seed need to sprout?
options: Water, warmth, and air
Sunlight, soil, and fertilizer
Water, sunlight, and soil
Warmth, fertilizer, and water
explanation: A seed needs water, enough warmth, and air to germinate — if any of these is missing, the seed will not sprout.
fact_tl: Para magsibol ang isang buto, kailangan nito ng tubig, sapat na init, at hangin, at kapag kulang ang alinman sa mga ito ay hindi ito tutubo.
fact_bis: Aron moturok ang usa ka liso, kinahanglan niini ang tubig, igong kainit, ug hangin, ug kon kulang ang usa niini dili kini moturok.

q: What makes an obligate parasite different from other organisms?
options: It cannot survive without living inside a host organism
It only feeds on dead organisms instead of living ones
It can live on its own but prefers to live near a host
It harms plants but never harms animals
explanation: An obligate parasite like a tapeworm cannot survive without its host and may spend its entire life inside the host.
fact_tl: Ang isang obligate parasite ay hindi kayang mabuhay nang wala ang kanyang host — ang ilang parasito tulad ng tapeworm ay gugugol ng buong buhay nito sa loob ng host at hindi na kailangang lumabas.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka obligate parasite dili mabuhi nga wala ang iyang host — ang pipila ka mga parasito sama sa tapeworm mogugol sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi sulod sa host ug wala na kinahanglana nga mogawas.

q: Why is plastic commonly used to make bottles and toys?
options: It is lightweight and durable
It is heavy and easy to shape
It breaks down quickly in water
It is made from plants and is natural
explanation: Plastic is used for bottles and toys because it is lightweight and durable, making it practical for many everyday items.
fact_tl: Magaan at matibay ang plastik, kaya ginagamit ito sa bote, laruan, at maraming bagay.
fact_bis: Ang plastik magaan ug lig-on, busa gigamit kini sa botelya, dulaan, ug daghang butang.

q: Why do metal ships at sea corrode (rust) faster than metal objects on land?
options: Iron rusts faster when it touches saltwater
The wind at sea carries chemicals that dissolve metal
Ships are made of weaker metal than land vehicles
The pressure of the ocean squeezes water into the metal
explanation: Iron rusts faster when it touches saltwater, which is why ships at sea corrode more easily than objects on land.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis mangalawang ang bakal kapag nadikit sa tubig-alat, kaya madaling masira ang mga barko sa dagat.
fact_bis: Mas paspas motaya ang puthaw kung madetgan sa tubig-asgad, mao nga sayon madaot ang mga barko sa dagat.

q: What ability allows pythons to hunt in water, on land, AND in trees?
options: They are good swimmers and tree climbers
They can change skin color to match any surface
They can stop breathing for several hours
They can grow wings to glide between trees
explanation: Pythons are good swimmers and tree climbers, so they can hunt prey on land, in water, or in tree branches.
fact_tl: Magaling lumangoy at umakyat sa puno ang sawa, kaya kaya nitong manghuli sa lupa, sa tubig, o sa mga sanga.
fact_bis: Ang sawa maayong molangoy ug mosaka sa kahoy, mao nga makahimo kini sa pagpangayam sa yuta, sa tubig, o sa mga sanga.

q: Why does stainless steel resist rust even though it contains iron?
options: It is mixed with chromium, which forms a thin protective layer on the surface
It is coated with a thick layer of paint that seals out air
The iron in stainless steel has been treated to remove the part that rusts
It is mixed with plastic, which blocks water from reaching the iron
explanation: Stainless steel is a mix of iron and chromium; the chromium forms a thin protective layer that prevents rusting.
fact_tl: Ang stainless steel na gamit sa kaldero at kutsilyo ay halo ng iron at chromium — parehong transition metals. Ang chromium ang gumagawa ng manipis na proteksiyon kaya hindi ito madaling kalawangin.
fact_bis: Ang stainless steel nga gigamit sa kaldero ug kutsilyo kay sagol sa iron ug chromium, pareho nga transition metals. Ang chromium maghimo og nipis nga panalipod, mao nga dili dali motaya.

q: Which eating habit raises the risk of diabetes in the Philippines?
options: Frequently eating lots of rice, sweet drinks, and rice-cakes
Eating too much fish and green vegetables
Skipping meals and drinking only water
Eating mostly meat and eggs every day
explanation: In the Philippines, frequently eating lots of rice, sweet drinks, and rice-cakes raises the risk of diabetes, which is one of the most common diseases there.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang diabetes ay isa sa mga pinakakaraniwang sakit, at ang madalas na pagkain ng maraming kanin, matatamis na inumin, at kakanin ay nakadaragdag sa panganib—kaya mahalaga ang balanseng pagkain at ehersisyo.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang diabetes usa sa pinakakomon nga sakit, ug ang kanunay nga pagkaon og daghang kan-on, tam-is nga ilimnon, ug kakanin makadugang sa risgo—mao nga importante ang balanse nga pagkaon ug ehersisyo.

q: Which type of wave in the electromagnetic spectrum has the LOWEST frequency?
options: Radio waves
Infrared waves
Ultraviolet waves
X-rays
explanation: The electromagnetic spectrum ranges from radio waves with the lowest frequency up to gamma rays with the highest frequency.
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay nagsisimula sa mga radio waves na may pinakamababang frequency, pataas sa microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, at gamma rays na may pinakamataas na frequency.
fact_bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum nagsugod sa radio waves nga adunay pinakaubos nga frequency, pataas sa microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, hangtod gamma rays nga adunay pinakataas nga frequency.

q: How do farmers usually know that a durian fruit is ready to eat?
options: It falls from the tree on its own
Its skin turns from green to yellow
It gives off a very strong smell while still on the tree
It floats when placed in a bucket of water
explanation: Durian usually falls from the tree when it is ripe, which tells farmers that the fruit is ready to eat.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nahuhulog ang durian sa puno kapag hinog na ito, at madalas ito nangyayari sa gabi. Kaya nag-iingat ang mga magsasaka dahil mabigat at matinik ang bumabagsak na bunga. Mula sa pagkakahulog, malalaman nilang handa na ito.
fact_bis: Kasagaran mahulog ang durian gikan sa kahoy kung hinog na kini, ug kanunay kini mahitabo sa gabii. Mag-amping ang mga mag-uuma kay bug-at ug tunokon ang nahulog nga bunga. Gikan sa pagkahulog, mahibal-an nila nga andam na kini.

q: What health benefit is ampalaya (bitter melon) approved for by the Philippine DOH?
options: Helping lower blood sugar levels in people with diabetes
Strengthening bones and preventing fractures
Reducing fever and fighting bacterial infections
Improving eyesight and preventing cataracts
explanation: Ampalaya is DOH-approved to help lower blood sugar levels in people with diabetes, using both its leaves and fruit medicinally.
fact_tl: Ang ampalaya (Momordica charantia) ay aprubado ng DOH para sa tulong sa pagpapababa ng blood sugar sa mga taong may diabetes; ginagamit ang dahon at bunga nito.
fact_bis: Ang ampalaya (Momordica charantia) gi-aprubahan sa DOH aron makatabang sa pagpababa sa blood sugar sa mga tawo nga may diabetes; ang mga dahon ug prutas niini gigamit sa medisina.

q: What do we call foods like fruits and vegetables that give us vitamins and minerals for healthy skin and eyes?
options: Glow foods
Go foods
Grow foods
Power foods
explanation: Glow foods are vegetables and fruits that contain vitamins and minerals to keep skin, eyes, and the immune system healthy.
fact_tl: Ang mga Glow foods ay mga gulay at prutas na naglalaman ng mga bitamina at mineral na nagpapanatiling malusog ang ating balat, mata, at immune system.
fact_bis: Ang mga Glow foods mao ang mga gulay ug prutas nga naglangkob sa mga bitamina ug mineral aron mapadayon ang panit, mga mata, ug immune system nga maayo ang kahimsog.

q: The element polonium was named to honor which country?
options: Poland
France
Russia
Germany
explanation: Polonium was named after Poland, which was the home country of Marie Curie who discovered it.
fact_tl: Ang elementong polonium ay ipinangalan sa Poland, ang sariling bansa ni Marie Curie.
fact_bis: Ang elemento nga polonium ginganlan sunod sa Poland, ang nasud ni Marie Curie.

q: What is a sea anemone, even though it looks like a flower?
options: An animal
A plant
A type of coral reef rock
A fungus that lives underwater
explanation: The sea anemone is an animal, not a plant, even though it looks like a flower growing on the seafloor.
fact_tl: Ang sea anemone ay isang hayop, hindi halaman, kahit na mukha itong bulaklak sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang sea anemone usa ka mananap, dili tanom, bisan og morag bulak kini sa dagat.

q: How does a silkworm produce silk?
options: Silk comes out as a liquid from the silkworm's mouth and hardens in air
The silkworm collects tiny threads from leaves and weaves them together
Silk is produced in the silkworm's stomach and comes out through its skin
The silkworm scrapes plant fibers with its legs to make thin threads
explanation: Silk comes out as a liquid from the silkworm's mouth and hardens when it meets the air.
fact_tl: Ang silk ay lumalabas na likido sa bibig ng silkworm at tumitigas kapag nahanginan.
fact_bis: Ang seda mogawas nga likido gikan sa baba sa silkworm ug mogahi inig kasugat sa hangin.

q: What happens to the molecules of an object as it gets hotter?
options: They move faster
They slow down and get heavier
They escape from the object into the air
They stick together more tightly
explanation: The thermal energy of an object lies in the motion of its molecules — the hotter the object, the faster its particles move.
fact_tl: Ang thermal energy ng isang bagay ay nasa magulong paggalaw at pag-vibrate ng mga molekula nito, kaya kapag mas mainit ang isang bagay, mas mabilis ang paggalaw ng mga particle sa loob nito.
fact_bis: Ang thermal energy sa usa ka butang anaa sa magubot nga paglihok ug pagkurog sa mga molekula niini, mao nga kung mas init ang usa ka butang, mas paspas ang paglihok sa mga partikulo sulod niini.

q: Why might it be snowing on top of a tall mountain while it is raining in the valley below?
options: It is so cold at the mountaintop that raindrops freeze before reaching the ground
Clouds cannot carry snow down to the valley so it stays on the mountain
Mountains block rain from falling, so only snow can get through
The wind on mountains is too strong for liquid water to fall
explanation: High up on a mountain it is so cold that raindrops freeze before reaching the ground, causing snow on the peak even while rain falls in the lowlands.
fact_tl: Kapag umuulan sa kapatagan, maaaring niyebe na ang bumabagsak sa tuktok ng napakatataas na bundok — dahil sobrang lamig na doon kaya nagyeyelo ang patak ng ulan bago dumampi sa lupa.
fact_bis: Kon mag-ulan sa kapatagan, mahimong niyebe na ang nahulog sa tumoy sa taas kaayo nga bukid — kay bugnaw na kaayo didto mao nga moyelo ang tulo sa ulan una pa moabot sa yuta.

q: Which Philippine volcano is famous worldwide for its almost perfect cone shape?
options: Mayon Volcano in Albay
Pinatubo Volcano in Zambales
Taal Volcano in Batangas
Kanlaon Volcano in Negros
explanation: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous worldwide for its almost perfect cone shape.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay ay sikat sa buong mundo dahil sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay bantog sa tibuok kalibutan tungod sa hapit perpekto nga porma niini nga kono.

q: What is the main job of the ozone layer around Earth?
options: It reduces the harmful UV rays from the sun that reach us
It keeps the planet warm by trapping heat from the surface
It reflects sunlight back to space to cool the planet
It holds oxygen and nitrogen so we have air to breathe
explanation: Like sunscreen on skin, the ozone layer covers the entire planet to reduce the harmful UV radiation that reaches the surface.
fact_tl: Parang sunscreen ng buong Mundo ang ozone layer. Tulad ng sunblock na ipinapahid natin sa balat para hindi masunog sa araw, ang ozone ay tumatakip sa buong planeta para mabawasan ang masamang UV na dumarating sa atin.
fact_bis: Ang ozone layer murag sunscreen sa tibuok Kalibutan. Sama sa sunblock nga atong gipahid sa panit aron dili masunog sa adlaw, ang ozone nagtabon sa tibuok planeta aron makunhoran ang daotang UV nga moabot kanato.

q: A block of wood floats in water. What does this tell you about its density compared to water?
options: Its density is lower than water
Its density is higher than water
Its density is exactly equal to water
Its density depends on the size of the block
explanation: Objects with density lower than water float, so the floating wood block must have a density lower than water.
fact_tl: Ang density ay katumbas ng masa hinati sa volume (D = M/V) — ang mga bagay na may mas mababang density kaysa tubig ay lumulutang, habang ang mas mataas ay lumalubog.
fact_bis: Ang density katumbas sa masa nga hibahin sa volume (D = M/V); ang mga bagay nga adunay mas ubos nga density kaysa tubig naglutaw, samtang ang adunay mas taas mahulog.

q: Squeezing bicycle brakes stops the bike. What does this tell us about force?
options: Force can stop a moving object, not just start motion
Force only works when something is not moving
The brakes push the bike forward to slow it down
The bike stops because gravity pulls it to the ground
explanation: A force can also stop a moving thing — squeezing bicycle brakes applies a force that stops the bike, just as catching a ball stops it.
fact_tl: Ang force ay hindi lang nagpapagalaw — puwede rin itong magpatigil ng gumagalaw na bagay. Kapag sinalo mo ang lumilipad na bola, ang force ng iyong kamay ang nagpapahinto rito. Kaya rin tumitigil ang bisikleta kapag pinindot mo ang preno.
fact_bis: Ang force dili lang makapalihok — makapahunong usab kini sa naglihok nga butang. Kung imong sakpon ang naglupad nga bola, ang force sa imong kamot maoy mopahunong niini. Mao usab nga mohunong ang bisikleta kung imong pisliton ang preno.

q: What determines which element an atom belongs to?
options: The number of protons in its nucleus
The number of electrons orbiting the nucleus
The total weight of the atom
The number of neutrons in the nucleus
explanation: The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus, and it decides which element an atom is — every atom with 6 protons is carbon.
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ay ang bilang ng proton sa nucleus, at ito ang nagtatakda kung anong element ang atom — halimbawa, bawat atom na may 6 na proton ay carbon.
fact_bis: Ang atomic number mao ang gidaghanon sa proton sa nucleus, ug kini ang nagtino kung unsang element ang atom — pananglitan, ang matag atom nga may 6 ka proton kay carbon.

q: Some flowers have very long tube-shaped openings that only certain insects or birds with long tongues can reach. What does this show about flowers and their pollinators?
options: They have coevolved together, developing specialized matching features
Flowers evolved long tubes to prevent most animals from taking their nectar
Insects evolved long tongues to access food that plants were trying to hide
This is a coincidence, not a result of any relationship between them
explanation: Flowers and pollinators have coevolved with each other, so some flowers have long tubes suited only to insects or birds with long tongues, creating a specialized relationship.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulaklak at kanilang mga pollinator ay nag-coevolve sa isa't isa — ang ilang bulaklak ay may mahabang tubo na para lamang sa mga insekto o ibon na may mahabang dila, na nagdudulot ng espesyal na relasyon sa pagitan nila.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulak ug ang ilang mga pollinator nag-coevolve sa usag-usa — ang uban nga mga bulak adunay mahabang tubo nga angay lamang alang sa mga insekto o ibon nga adunay mahabang dila, nagbuhat og espesyal nga relasyon sa ilang duha.

q: Why is gliding through the air safer for a colugo than moving on the ground?
options: It climbs slowly and is clumsy on the ground, making it vulnerable there
Its legs are too long to walk normally on flat surfaces
Its sharp claws damage its feet when walking on the ground
Predators can only see it on the ground but not in the air
explanation: The colugo climbs slowly and is clumsy on the ground, so gliding through the air is a safer and more efficient way for it to travel.
fact_tl: Mabagal at parang clumsy ang kagwang kapag umaakyat o nasa lupa, kaya mas ligtas itong gumliding sa hangin.
fact_bis: Hinay ug daw tabang-tabang ang kagwang kung mokatkat o anaa sa yuta, mao nga mas luwas para niini ang pag-glide sa hangin.

q: How do female sea turtles find their way back to lay eggs near the beach where they were born?
options: They sense Earth's magnetic field like a map
They follow ocean currents that lead back to warm water
They remember the smell of the beach from when they hatched
They follow other turtles that already know the way
explanation: Sea turtles can sense Earth's magnetic field like a map, which allows a female to return and lay eggs near the beach where she was born.
fact_tl: Ang mga sea turtle (pawikan) ay nakakaramdam ng magnetic field ng Earth na para silang may mapa; dahil dito, kaya ng babaeng pawikan na bumalik para mangitlog malapit sa dalampasigan kung saan ito ipinanganak.
fact_bis: Ang mga pawikan makabati sa magnetic field sa Yuta nga morag adunay mapa; tungod niini, ang baye nga pawikan makabalik aron mangitlog duol sa baybayon diin siya natawo.

q: How does a centrifuge separate the different parts of blood in a laboratory?
options: It spins very fast, sending heavier parts to the bottom
It heats the blood until lighter parts evaporate
It uses a magnet to pull iron-containing blood cells apart
It filters blood through tiny holes of different sizes
explanation: A centrifuge spins very fast to separate parts of a mixture by sending the heavier parts to the bottom, such as separating the parts of blood.
fact_tl: Ang centrifuge ay isang makinang umiikot nang napakabilis upang ihiwalay ang mga bahagi ng halo, kung saan ang mas mabibigat na bahagi ay napupunta sa ilalim—gaya ng paghihiwalay sa mga bahagi ng dugo.
fact_bis: Ang centrifuge usa ka makina nga molibot og paspas kaayo aron ibulag ang mga bahin sa usa ka sagol, diin ang mas bug-at nga mga bahin moadto sa ilawom—sama sa pagbulag sa mga bahin sa dugo.

q: A boat travels faster going downstream than upstream on a river. Why?
options: Going downstream, the river's current speed adds to the boat's speed
Going upstream, the engine works harder and uses too much fuel
Water is deeper downstream so there is less resistance
The boat is lighter going downstream because it has used up fuel
explanation: Going downstream, the water's speed adds to the boat's speed, while going upstream the current subtracts from the boat's speed.
fact_tl: Kapag naglalayag ang bangka sa ilog, ang bilis nito sa pampang ay nagbabago depende sa agos. Pababa sa agos, dumaragdag ang bilis ng tubig sa bilis ng bangka kaya mas mabilis ito; pasalunga naman, nababawasan kaya mas mabagal. Kaya mas madaling sumalunong pababa kaysa pasalunga sa ilog.
fact_bis: Kung molawig ang bangka sa suba, ang katulin niini kumpara sa daplin magbag-o depende sa sulog. Padulong sa ubos, ang katulin sa tubig madugang sa katulin sa bangka busa mas paspas kini; padulong sa taas, makuhaan busa mas hinay ang bangka. Mao nga mas sayon ang paglawig padulong sa ubos kaysa padulong sa taas.

q: Why is a snake's tongue thin and easy to bend?
options: So it can reach for scents in tiny cracks, under rocks, or inside the ground where prey hides
So it can grab insects quickly before they fly away
So it can sting enemies as a form of defense
So it can absorb water through the tip when the snake is thirsty
explanation: A snake's tongue is thin and flexible so it can reach into tiny cracks, under rocks, and into the ground to detect scents of hidden prey.
fact_tl: Manipis at madaling makurba ang dila ng ahas, kaya kaya nitong abutin ang amoy sa maliliit na siwang, sa ilalim ng mga bato, o sa loob ng lupa kung saan maaaring nagtatago ang biktima.
fact_bis: Nipis ug sayon ikurba ang dila sa ahas, busa makaabot kini sa baho sa gagmayng liki, ilalom sa mga bato, o sulod sa yuta diin mahimong nagtago ang tukbonon.

q: Can you get diabetes by touching or being near someone who has it?
options: No, diabetes is not contagious
Yes, it can spread through touching someone's skin
Yes, it spreads through the air like a cold
Yes, but only by sharing food or drinks with them
explanation: Diabetes is not contagious, so it cannot spread to other people by touching or being near them.
fact_tl: Ang diabetes ay hindi nakakahawa, kaya hindi ito naililipat sa ibang tao sa pamamagitan ng paghawak o paglapit.
fact_bis: Ang diabetes dili makatakod, mao nga dili kini matakod sa ubang tawo pinaagi sa paghikap o pagduol.

q: How does a platypus defend itself when caught by a predator?
options: It uses a sharp venomous spur to hurt the attacker
It sprays a foul-smelling liquid like a skunk
It bites with sharp teeth filled with poison
It inflates its body to look bigger and scare predators away
explanation: A platypus can defend itself by using the sharp venomous spur on its hind leg to hurt an attacker when caught.
fact_tl: Nakakatulong ba ang kamandag laban sa mga mandaragit? Oo, kapag nahuli, kaya nitong saktan ang humuhuli rito gamit ang matulis na tibo bilang panlaban.
fact_bis: Makatabang ba ang hilo batok sa mga manunukob? Oo, kung madakpan, mahimong masakitan sa platypus ang nagdakop niini gamit ang hait nga tibo isip panalipod.

q: What do male horseshoe crabs use to hold onto a female during spawning?
options: Special legs shaped like hooks
Their tail spine
Their hard shell edges
Sticky material they produce
explanation: Male horseshoe crabs clasp onto the back of a female using special legs shaped like hooks so the pair can crawl up the beach together to spawn.
fact_tl: Mas maliit ang lalaking horseshoe crab kaysa sa babae. Kapag panahon na ng pangingitlog, kumakapit ang lalaki sa likod ng babae gamit ang mga espesyal na binti na may parang kawit, kaya magkadikit silang umaakyat sa dalampasigan.
fact_bis: Mas gamay ang laki nga horseshoe crab kaysa sa baye. Sa panahon sa pangitlog, mokupot ang laki sa likod sa baye gamit ang espesyal nga mga tiil nga morag kaw-it, busa magkuyog silang duha pagsaka sa baybayon.

q: When did the Perseverance rover land on Mars?
explanation: The Perseverance rover landed on Mars in 2021.
fact_tl: Dumaong ang Perseverance rover sa Mars noong 2021.
fact_bis: Ang Perseverance rover niabot sa Mars niadtong 2021.

q: What plant fiber is used to weave T'nalak cloth?
options: Abaca fiber
Cotton fiber
Bamboo fiber
Coconut husk fiber
explanation: T'nalak is woven by the T'boli people from the fiber of the abaca, a banana-like plant that gives strong natural fibers.
fact_tl: Ang t'nalak ay tela na hinahabi ng mga T'boli mula sa hibla ng abaka, isang halamang kamukha ng saging na pinagkukunan ng matibay na lanot.
fact_bis: Ang t'nalak usa ka panapton nga gihabol sa mga T'boli gikan sa lanot sa abaka, usa ka tanom nga morag saging nga gigikanan sa lig-on nga hibla.

q: The unit 'watt' used to measure electrical power is named after which person?
options: James Watt, a Scottish engineer
Isaac Newton, an English physicist
Michael Faraday, a British scientist
Andre-Marie Ampere, a French physicist
explanation: The watt is named after James Watt, a Scottish engineer who made major improvements to the steam engine.
fact_tl: Ang watt ay ipinangalan kay James Watt, isang Scottish na inhinyero.
fact_bis: Ang watt ginganlan kang James Watt, usa ka Scottish nga engineer.

q: What advantage does a giraffe's long neck give it when finding food?
options: It can reach leaves high in tall trees that other animals cannot reach
It can see predators coming from far away
It can drink water from deep wells that other animals cannot access
It helps the giraffe run faster by balancing its heavy body
explanation: A giraffe can reach leaves high in tall trees that other animals cannot reach, giving it access to food that other animals cannot get.
fact_tl: Kayang abutin ng giraffe ang mga dahon sa matataas na puno na hindi maabot ng ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Makaabot ang giraffe sa mga dahon sa taas nga mga kahoy nga dili maabot sa ubang hayop.

q: Why does a young Philippine eagle stay with its parents for more than a year?
options: Because it grows slowly and needs a long time to learn how to survive
Because the parents cannot find enough food for themselves without the chick
Because young eagles are afraid of flying until they are fully grown
Because the parents keep it close to teach it how to build nests
explanation: A young Philippine eagle grows slowly, so it needs to stay with its parents for more than a year.
fact_tl: Mabagal lumaki ang batang agila kaya nananatili itong kasama ng mga magulang sa loob ng mahigit isang taon.
fact_bis: Hinay motubo ang batan-ong agila mao nga magpabilin kini uban sa iyang ginikanan sulod sa kapin sa usa ka tuig.

q: About how many times does a person blink in one minute?
options: 15 to 20 times
3 to 5 times
50 to 60 times
1 to 2 times
explanation: A person blinks about 15 to 20 times every minute without even noticing it.
fact_tl: Kumukurap ang tao ng halos 15 hanggang 20 beses bawat minuto nang hindi namamalayan.
fact_bis: Mopilok ang tawo mga 15 ngadto sa 20 ka beses kada minuto nga dili pa gani mamatikdan.

q: Why can sunburn and heat stroke happen faster in the Philippines than in countries farther from the equator?
options: The Philippines is near the equator where sunlight is stronger
The Philippines has fewer clouds to block the sunlight
The Philippines is surrounded by water, which reflects sunlight upward
The Philippines is at higher altitude where the air is thinner
explanation: Because the Philippines is in the tropics near the equator, the sunlight is stronger, so sunburn and heat stroke can happen faster.
fact_tl: Dahil ang Pilipinas ay nasa tropiko malapit sa ekwador, mas matindi ang sinag ng araw kaya mas mabilis ang pagkasunog at heat stroke.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang Pilipinas anaa sa tropiko duol sa ekwador, mas kusog ang silaw sa adlaw mao nga mas paspas ang sunburn ug heat stroke.

q: Why is planting trees on mountains one of the best ways to prevent landslides?
options: Tree roots hold soil in place and slow the movement of water
Trees make the mountain heavier so the soil cannot slide
Shade from trees keeps the soil cold and frozen so it stays hard
Trees absorb all rainfall so the ground never gets wet
explanation: Tree roots hold soil in place and slow the movement of water, making reforestation one of the most effective ways to prevent landslides.
fact_tl: Ang pagtatanim ng mga puno (reforestation) sa mga bundok at dalisdis ay isa sa pinakaepektibong paraan upang maiwasan ang landslide; ang mga ugat ng puno ay nagtataglay ng lupa at nagpapababa ng bilis ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pagtanom sa mga puno (reforestation) sa mga bundok ug daplin usa sa labing epektibo nga paagi aron mapugngan ang landslide; ang mga ugat sa puno nagkupot sa yuta ug nagpahinay sa paglihok sa tubig.

q: Who built the first steam-powered vehicle, back in 1769?
options: Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot of France
James Watt of Scotland
George Stephenson of England
Benjamin Franklin of America
explanation: Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot of France built the first steam-powered vehicle in 1769.
fact_tl: Si Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot ng France ang gumawa ng unang sasakyang de-singaw (steam) noong 1769.
fact_bis: Si Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot sa France ang naghimo sa unang sakyanan nga gipalihok sa alisngaw (steam) niadtong 1769.

q: Where does the starch for sago (the chewy pearls in desserts) come from?
options: The pith inside the trunk of a sago palm tree
The seeds of a sago palm tree
The roots of a sago palm tree
The leaves of a sago palm tree
explanation: The sago palm's trunk pith is full of starch, and from it people make sago, the little chewy pearls eaten in desserts.
fact_tl: Ang sago palm ay isang puno ng palma na ang loob ng tangkay nito ay puno ng almirol o starch, at mula rito ginagawa ang sago na maliliit na bilog na kinakain sa mga panghimagas.
fact_bis: Ang sago palm usa ka palma nga ang sulod sa punoan niini puno og almidon o starch, ug gikan niini ginahimo ang sago nga gagmay nga lingin nga kan-on sa mga panam-is.

q: What happens when a convex lens focuses sunlight onto one tiny spot?
options: That spot gets very hot and can set paper on fire
The light breaks into a rainbow of colors
The spot becomes very bright but stays cool
The paper reflects all the light back to the sky
explanation: When a convex lens focuses sunlight onto a tiny spot, that spot gets very hot and can even set paper on fire.
fact_tl: Kapag pinagtuon ng umbok na lente ang sikat ng araw sa isang maliit na tuldok, lubhang umiinit ito at kayang magpaningas ng papel.
fact_bis: Kon i-focus sa convex nga lente ang silaw sa adlaw ngadto sa gamay nga tuldok, kini mainit kaayo ug makasunog pa gani og papel.

q: The unit 'farad,' used to measure electrical capacitance, is named after which scientist?
options: Michael Faraday
Benjamin Franklin
Alessandro Volta
Andre-Marie Ampere
explanation: The unit called the 'farad' is named after Michael Faraday, a pioneering scientist in electricity and magnetism.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na 'farad' ay ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday.
fact_bis: Ang unit nga 'farad' ginganlan sunod kang Michael Faraday.

q: How does water enter a sea sponge's body?
options: Through many tiny pores on its surface
Through one large opening at the top
Through its skin, which absorbs water slowly
Through root-like structures that pull water from the sea floor
explanation: Water enters a sponge's body through many tiny pores spread across its surface.
fact_tl: Pumapasok ang tubig sa katawan ng espongha sa pamamagitan ng napakaraming maliliit na butas sa balat nito.
fact_bis: Ang tubig mosulod sa lawas sa espongha pinaagi sa daghang gagmay nga mga lungag sa panit niini.

q: In Asian elephants, which elephants usually have large visible tusks?
options: Usually only the males
Both males and females equally
Only very old females
Only young elephants before they lose their baby tusks
explanation: In Asian elephants, usually only the males have large visible tusks, unlike African elephants where both sexes often have tusks.
fact_tl: Sa elepanteng Asyano, kadalasan ay ang mga lalaki lamang ang may malalaking nakikitang pangil.
fact_bis: Sa elepanteng Asyano, kasagaran ang mga laki lang ang adunay dagko ug makita nga tango.

q: What happens to your bladder as it fills with urine?
options: It stretches and grows bigger, like a balloon filling with water
It shrinks and gets harder to hold more liquid
It stays the same size but the walls get thinner
It moves higher in the body to make more room
explanation: The bladder stretches and grows bigger as it fills with urine, similar to how a balloon expands when filled with water.
fact_tl: Ang pantog ay umuunat at lumalaki habang nauupuan ng ihi, tulad ng lobong pinupuno ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pantog moluag ug modako samtang mapuno kini sa ihi, sama sa lobo nga gipuno og tubig.

q: What does your body's adaptive immunity do when a new germ enters your body?
options: It makes specific antibodies to fight that particular germ and creates memory cells for future protection.
It immediately raises your body temperature to burn the germs away.
It sends extra red blood cells to surround and trap the germs.
It releases stomach acid into the bloodstream to dissolve the germs.
explanation: Adaptive immunity produces specific antibodies against each pathogen and also creates memory cells so the body can fight faster if the same germ returns.
fact_tl: Ang adaptive immunity ay ang pangalawang linya ng depensa na gumagawa ng mga espesipikong antibody laban sa isang tiyak na microbe — mas mabagal ito ngunit mas tiyak at gumagawa ng memory cells para sa hinaharap.
fact_bis: Ang adaptive immunity mao ang ikaduhang linya sa depensa nga nagbuhat og mga espesipikong antibody batok sa usa ka piho nga pathogen — mas hinay kini apan tukma ug nagbuhat og memory cells para sa umaabot nga proteksyon.

q: Why are lenses made from glass or clear plastic instead of wood or metal?
options: Wood and metal are too heavy to hold in eyeglasses or cameras.
Clear materials like glass or plastic allow light to pass through them so the lens can bend it.
Glass and plastic are cheaper and easier to find than wood or metal.
Wood and metal cannot be polished into a smooth curved shape.
explanation: Lenses must be made of clear materials like glass or plastic so that light can pass through them and be focused or bent.
fact_tl: Ang mga lente ay yari sa malinaw na materyal gaya ng bubog o plastik para makadaan dito ang ilaw.
fact_bis: Ang mga lente hinimo gikan sa tin-aw nga materyal sama sa bildo o plastik aron makaagi niini ang kahayag.

q: In a split-type air conditioner, what does the outdoor unit do?
options: It filters dust from the outside air before pumping it inside.
It releases the heat that was removed from the room to the outside.
It measures the outside temperature and adjusts the cooling level.
It stores extra electricity to keep the room cool during a power outage.
explanation: A split-type air conditioner has an indoor unit that cools the room and an outdoor unit that releases the removed heat to the outside.
fact_tl: Ang split-type na aircon ay may dalawang bahagi: ang nasa loob na nagpapalamig at ang nasa labas na naglalabas ng init.
fact_bis: Ang split-type nga aircon adunay duha ka bahin: ang sulod nga magpabugnaw ug ang gawas nga mopagawas sa kainit.

q: Which animals use the floating leaf of a water lily as a resting or landing spot?
options: Crabs and shrimp rest on the leaves while birds nest underneath them.
Frogs rest on top and dragonflies and insects land on them, while fish hide underneath.
Turtles and ducks rest on the leaves while worms live in the soil below.
Butterflies and bees land on the leaves to collect nectar from the water.
explanation: The floating leaf of a water lily serves as a resting spot for frogs and a landing place for dragonflies and insects, while fish hide underneath it.
fact_tl: Ang lumulutang na dahon ng water lily ay nagsisilbing pahingahan ng mga palaka at tuluyan ng mga tutubi at insekto. Sa ilalim naman nito ay nagtatago ang mga isda at iba pang maliliit na hayop sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang naglutaw nga dahon sa water lily nagsilbing pahulayan sa mga baki ug tugpahanan sa mga tutubi ug insekto. Sa ilawom niini, magtago ang mga isda ug uban pang gagmay nga mananap sa tubig.

q: When you have a fever, why is it better to rest quietly instead of staring at your phone?
options: Phone screens give off heat that raises your temperature even more.
Looking at a phone uses too much electricity that your body needs to heal.
Staring at a phone still tires your brain and eyes, making it harder to sleep and recover.
The blue light from phones kills the white blood cells that fight your fever.
explanation: Rest means resting your brain and eyes too — staring at a phone while feverish still tires you and makes it harder to sleep, slowing recovery.
fact_tl: Ang pahinga ay hindi lang paghiga; kasama rito ang pagpapahinga ng utak at mata. Kapag matagal kang nakatutok sa cellphone habang may lagnat, napapagod ka pa rin at nahihirapan matulog. Mas mabuting magpahinga nang tahimik para makapagpalakas ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang pahulay dili lang paghigda; apil niini ang pagpahulay sa utok ug mata. Kung dugay ka magtutok sa cellphone samtang naay hilanat, makapuyon gihapon ka ug maglisod matulog. Mas maayo ang hilom nga pahulay aron makabaskog ang lawas.

q: How does a single fertilized cell become a baby with many billions of cells?
options: The one cell grows very large until it fills the whole body without dividing.
Stem cells are sent from the mother's blood to build different body parts.
The one cell divides into two, then four, then keeps dividing to build up the body.
The cell absorbs nutrients and splits into completely different kinds of cells all at once.
explanation: The single cell divides into two, then four, then many more, slowly building up the baby's body through repeated cell division.
fact_tl: Ang isang selula ay naghahati at nagiging dalawa, apat, at marami pa, kaya unti-unting nabubuo ang katawan ng sanggol.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka selula magbahin ngadto sa duha, dayon upat, dayon daghan pa, mao nga hinayhinay nga maporma ang lawas sa bata.

q: What is special about the feet of goats and sheep?
options: They have soft padded feet like a dog that help them walk quietly on rocks.
They have a single solid hoof like a horse that gives them speed on flat ground.
They have a hard hoof that is split into two parts, called a cloven hoof.
They have webbed feet that help them cross streams and muddy ground.
explanation: The feet of goats and sheep have a hard hoof that is split into two parts, which is why they are called cloven-hoofed animals.
fact_tl: Ang paa ng kambing at tupa ay may matigas na kukong nahahati sa dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang tiil sa kanding ug karnero adunay gahi nga kuko nga nabahin sa duha.

q: A ruby is red and a sapphire is blue — what do they have in common?
options: They are both forms of quartz, which is the most common mineral on Earth.
They are both made of the same mineral, corundum, and differ only in color.
They are both made of carbon atoms arranged in a crystal structure like diamond.
They are both rare silicate minerals that form only near volcanic rock.
explanation: Ruby and sapphire are the same mineral, corundum, and differ only in color — trace elements give each its distinctive shade.
fact_tl: Ang ruby at sapphire ay parehong mineral na corundum, magkaiba lang sa kulay.
fact_bis: Ang ruby ug sapphire parehas nga mineral nga corundum, magkalahi lang sa kolor.

q: Where is the Malampaya natural gas field located, and what is it used for?
options: It is an onshore gas field in Batangas that powers factories in the Visayas.
It is located offshore Palawan in the South China Sea and supplies electricity to Luzon.
It is an underwater oil field near Cebu that fuels ships crossing the Visayan Sea.
It is located near Leyte Gulf and provides gas for cooking to households in Mindanao.
explanation: Malampaya is a large natural gas field offshore Palawan in the South China Sea that supplies a significant portion of electricity to Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang Malampaya ay isang malaking natural gas field sa dagat ng Palawan sa South China Sea; ito ang nagbibigay ng malaking bahagi ng kuryente para sa Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Malampaya usa ka dakong natural gas field sa dagat sa Palawan sa South China Sea; naghatag kini og dakong bahin sa kuryente para sa Luzon.

q: Which is the longest river in the Philippines?
options: The Pasig River in Metro Manila, which flows through the heart of the capital.
The Agusan River in Mindanao, known for its wide flood plains and wildlife.
The Pampanga River in Central Luzon, which has the largest river delta.
The Cagayan River in northern Luzon, stretching about 505 kilometers.
explanation: The Cagayan River in northern Luzon is the longest river in the Philippines, stretching about 505 kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang Cagayan River sa hilagang Luzon ang pinakamahabang ilog sa Pilipinas, na may humigit-kumulang 505 kilometro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang Cagayan River sa amihanang Luzon mao ang pinakataas nga suba sa Pilipinas, mga 505 ka kilometro ang gitas-on.

q: How long does it usually take for large changes to happen in a species through natural selection?
options: A few generations — about 20 to 50 years is enough for major body changes to appear.
One lifetime — an animal that survives long enough will slowly transform into a new species.
Thousands or millions of years, because large changes through natural selection happen very slowly.
About 100 years, which is why scientists can observe new species forming in a single century.
explanation: Large changes through natural selection usually happen over thousands or millions of years, making evolution an extremely slow process.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking pagbabago sa pamamagitan ng natural na seleksyon ay karaniwang nangyayari sa loob ng libo-libo o milyon-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong kausaban pinaagi sa kinaiyanhong pagpili kasagaran mahitabo sa liboan o milyon ka tuig.

q: How do some white blood cells destroy germs inside your body?
options: They release a special fever that burns up any germs in the bloodstream.
They wrap the germ in a cocoon of mucus until it breaks apart.
They swallow and eat the germs to destroy them inside the body.
They send electrical signals to make the germs unable to move.
explanation: Some white blood cells swallow and eat germs to destroy them inside the body, acting like tiny cleaners in the bloodstream.
fact_tl: May mga puting selula ng dugo na parang lumululon at kumakain ng mga germ para wasakin ang mga ito sa loob ng katawan.
fact_bis: Adunay mga puti nga selula sa dugo nga molamoy ug mokaon sa mga germ aron laglagon kini sulod sa lawas.

q: When water vapor in cold air turns directly into frost on grass without first becoming liquid water, what is this change of state called?
options: Condensation, because water vapor is cooling down and sticking to a surface.
Sublimation, because the water goes from a gas straight past the liquid stage.
Freezing, because liquid water changes into ice when temperatures drop below zero.
Deposition, because a gas changes directly into a solid without first becoming a liquid.
explanation: Deposition is when a gas changes directly into a solid without becoming a liquid first — like water vapor turning into frost on cold grass.
fact_tl: Ang deposition ay ang pagbabago ng gas nang direkta papuntang solid nang hindi muna nagiging likido — gaya ng singaw ng tubig sa hangin na nagiging escarcha (frost) sa malamig na damo. Ito ang kabaligtaran ng sublimation.
fact_bis: Ang deposition mao ang pagbalhin sa gas direkta ngadto sa solid nga dili una mahimong likido — sama sa alisngaw sa tubig sa hangin nga mahimong escarcha (frost) sa bugnaw nga sagbot. Kabaliktaran kini sa sublimation.

q: The Earth and Moon both orbit around a shared point called the barycenter. Where is this point located?
options: Exactly at Earth's center, because Earth is so massive it does not move at all.
Halfway between the Earth and Moon, since both objects are pulled equally by gravity.
Inside the Earth, about 1,700 kilometers below the surface, because Earth is far more massive than the Moon.
Outside both the Earth and the Moon, in empty space between the two bodies.
explanation: Because Earth is 81 times more massive than the Moon, the barycenter is inside Earth — about 1,700 kilometers below the surface — not at its center.
fact_tl: Ang Earth at Moon ay parehong nag-o-orbit sa kanilang karaniwang center of mass, na tinatawag na barycenter; dahsa ang Earth ay 81 beses na mas masigla kaysa sa Moon, ang barycenter ay nasa loob ng Earth — humigit-kumulang 1,700 kilometro sa ilalim ng surface — ngunit ito ay nasa labas ng sentro ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Yuta ug Moon pareho naglibot sa ilang karaniwang centre of mass, ginganlan og barycenter; tungod kay ang Yuta 81 ka beses nga mas dagko kaysa sa Moon, ang barycenter anaa sulod sa Yuta — mga 1,700 kilometro sa ubos sa surface — apan dili kini sa sentro sa Yuta.

q: To remove germs properly, how long should you scrub your hands with soap before rinsing?
options: About 5 seconds — a quick rub with soap is enough to kill most germs.
About 20 seconds — scrubbing for this long with soap removes germs effectively.
About 1 minute — soap needs a full minute to break down germ cell walls.
About 3 seconds — just wetting your hands with soapy water is sufficient.
explanation: You should scrub your hands with soap for about 20 seconds before rinsing to remove germs well.
fact_tl: Para mabisang makaalis ng mikrobyo, dapat kuskusin ang kamay ng sabon nang mga 20 segundo bago banlawan ng tubig.
fact_bis: Aron epektibong matangtang ang mikrobyo, kinahanglan kuskoson ang kamot sa sabon ug mga 20 ka segundo una banlawan sa tubig.

q: Why is Pluto no longer classified as a main planet?
options: Pluto is too cold — planets must have a surface temperature above minus 200°C.
Pluto does not orbit the Sun; it orbits Neptune and is actually a moon.
Pluto is too small and has not cleared other objects out of its orbit around the Sun.
Pluto is made of ice and gas, so it does not qualify as a solid rocky or gas planet.
explanation: Pluto is called a dwarf planet because it is small and has not cleared other objects out of its orbit around the Sun, unlike the eight main planets.
fact_tl: Ang Pluto ngayon ay tinatawag na 'dwarf planet' (planetang duwende) dahil maliit ito at hindi pa nalilinis ang ibang bagay sa daanan nito sa paligid ng araw, hindi tulad ng walong pangunahing planeta. Kaya walo na lang ang opisyal na planeta.
fact_bis: Ang Pluto karon gitawag nga 'dwarf planet' tungod kay gamay kini ug wala pa nahawan ang ubang butang sa iyang agianan palibot sa adlaw, dili sama sa walo ka nag-unang planeta. Mao nga walo na lang ang opisyal nga planeta.

q: What does the liver do with extra sugar in your blood after you eat a big meal?
options: It sends the extra sugar to the kidneys, which filter it out through urine.
It immediately burns the extra sugar to produce heat and keep the body warm.
It stores the extra sugar as glycogen and releases it back into the blood when you need energy later.
It converts the extra sugar into vitamins and sends them to the muscles.
explanation: After eating, the liver stores extra blood sugar as glycogen, then releases it back into the blood when the body needs energy between meals.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang asukal sa dugo natin pagkatapos kumain, iniipon ng atay ang sobra bilang glycogen. Kapag gutom ka na o matagal nang hindi kumakain, ibinabalik ng atay ang asukal sa dugo para may enerhiya ka pa rin.
fact_bis: Human mokaon, ang sobra nga asukal sa atong dugo gitipigan sa atay isip glycogen. Kung gutom ka na o dugay na wala mokaon, ibalik sa atay ang asukal sa dugo aron naa pa kay kusog.

q: What is needed to make a resting object start moving?
options: Heat — warming up an object gives it enough energy to begin moving on its own.
Gravity — every resting object will eventually start moving because of gravity pulling it.
Time — if you wait long enough, a resting object will naturally begin to move.
A force — a push or pull is needed to start a resting object moving.
explanation: A force — a push or pull — is needed to start a resting object moving; without a force it stays still.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng puwersa para magsimulang gumalaw ang isang nakapwestong bagay.
fact_bis: Gikinahanglan ang puwersa aron molihok ang usa ka butang nga hunong.

q: Why does granite have large crystals while volcanic rock has tiny crystals?
options: Granite forms from sediment layers that press together slowly, while lava hardens instantly in water.
Granite is made mostly of quartz, which naturally grows large, while volcanic rock is made of iron.
Magma that cools slowly underground forms large crystals like granite, while fast-cooling lava on the surface makes tiny crystals.
Granite is heated twice underground, giving crystals time to grow twice as large as in lava.
explanation: Fast-cooling lava produces tiny crystals, while magma that cools slowly deep underground has time to form large crystals like those seen in granite.
fact_tl: Kung mabilis lumamig ang lava, maliliit ang kristal; kung mabagal sa ilalim ng lupa, malalaki ang kristal tulad sa granite.
fact_bis: Kon paspas mobugnaw ang lava, gagmay ang kristal; kon hinay nga mobugnaw ilalom sa yuta, dagko ang kristal sama sa granite.

q: Who was the Great Pyramid of Giza built for?
options: It was built as a temple for the sun god Ra by the priests of ancient Egypt.
It was built as a fortress to defend Egypt's northern border from invaders.
It was built as the tomb of Pharaoh Khufu (also known as Cheops) of Egypt.
It was built as a storehouse for grain by the people of the Nile Delta.
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built as the tomb of Pharaoh Khufu (Cheops) of ancient Egypt.
fact_tl: Ipinagawa ang Great Pyramid of Giza bilang libingan ni Paraon Khufu (Cheops) ng Ehipto.
fact_bis: Ang Great Pyramid of Giza gitukod isip lubnganan ni Paraon Khufu (Cheops) sa Ehipto.

q: Which type of foods are called 'grow foods' and why are they important for children?
options: Sweet foods like fruits and honey, because their natural sugar gives energy for growing muscles.
Starchy foods like rice and bread, because carbohydrates are the main fuel for building bones.
Green vegetables like kangkong and malunggay, because their vitamins help children grow taller.
Protein-rich foods like fish, meat, eggs, milk, and beans, because they build muscles and repair body tissues.
explanation: Grow foods are protein-rich foods such as fish, meat, eggs, milk, and beans that help build muscles and repair body tissues, especially important for growing children.
fact_tl: Ang mga Grow foods ay mga pagkain na mataas sa protina tulad ng isda, karne, itlog, gatas, at munggo; tumutulong ito sa pagpapalaki ng kalamnan at pag-aayos ng mga tisyu ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang mga Grow foods mga pagkaon nga dato sa protina sama sa isda, karne, itlog, gatas, ug balatong; nagtabang sa pagpatigom sa kaunuran ug pag-ayo sa mga tisyu sa lawas, ilabi na importante alang sa nagdakong mga bata.

q: Why is a chicken described as an omnivore?
options: Because it eats only insects and worms it finds in the soil, making it a predator.
Because it eats only seeds and leaves, so it only needs plants to survive.
Because it eats both plant foods like seeds and leaves and animals like worms and insects.
Because it can survive on water alone for long periods without eating solid food.
explanation: The chicken is an omnivore because it eats both plant materials like seeds and leaves and small animals like worms and insects.
fact_tl: Ang manok ay omnivore — tumutuktok ito ng butil, dahon, uod, at maliliit na insekto sa lupa. Kaya nakikita natin itong palaging nagtutuka sa lupa.
