fact_bis: Ang manok usa ka omnivore — motuktok kini og liso, dahon, ulod, ug gagmayng insekto sa yuta. Mao nga makita nato kini nga kanunayng nagtuka sa yuta.

q: What makes the makahiya plant fold its leaves so much faster than a sunflower turns toward the sun?
options: The makahiya has a special muscle-like stem that contracts faster than any other plant.
The makahiya folds fast because water quickly rushes out of its cells, while the sunflower turns slowly all day.
The makahiya grows in hotter climates where heat speeds up all plant movements.
The makahiya has fewer leaves so each one moves faster when the plant reacts to touch.
explanation: The makahiya folds very fast in just seconds because water rushes out of its cells, unlike the sunflower which turns slowly to face the sun throughout the day.
fact_tl: Maraming halaman ang gumagalaw, pero mabagal. Halimbawa, ang mirasol ay dahan-dahang humaharap sa araw buong araw. Ang makahiya naman ay napakabilis tumiklop sa loob lang ng ilang segundo dahil sa mabilisang paglabas ng tubig sa selula.
fact_bis: Daghang tanom ang muglihok, apan hinay. Pananglitan, ang mirasol hinay nga muatubang sa adlaw tibuok adlaw. Ang makahiya kusog kaayo mutiklop sulod ra sa pipila ka segundo tungod kay kalit nga mugawas ang tubig sa mga selula.

q: Which of these is a real challenge for sending humans to Mars?
options: Mars has too much oxygen in its atmosphere, which would be dangerous for astronauts to breathe.
The journey to Mars takes 6 to 9 months, during which astronauts face harmful cosmic radiation and must carry food and oxygen for years.
Mars has such strong gravity that astronauts' bones would break upon landing.
Radio signals from Earth reach Mars in under a second, so communication is easy but fuel is the only problem.
explanation: A human mission to Mars faces many challenges including a 6-to-9-month journey, exposure to harmful cosmic radiation, and the need to bring enough food and oxygen for years.
fact_tl: Ang isang human mission sa Mars ay maraming hamon: ang paglalakbay ay aabutin ng 6 hanggang 9 buwan, ang mga astronaut ay malantad sa nakakapinsalang cosmic radiation, kailangan silang magdala ng pagkain at oxygen para sa mga taon, at dapat silang mag-abang ng posibleng mental health issues sa haba ng misyon.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka human mission sa Mars adunay dagko nga mga hagit: ang biyahe mokabat og 6 hangtod 9 buwan, ang mga astronaut ma-expose sa makadaot nga cosmic radiation, kinahanglan magdala og pagkaon ug oxygen alang sa mga tuig, ug ang crew kinahanglan mag-atiman sa posibleng mental health issues sa haba sa misyon.

q: Which waterfall holds the record as the highest in the world?
options: Niagara Falls on the border of the USA and Canada, famous for its enormous width.
Victoria Falls in Africa, known for producing the largest curtain of falling water.
Angel Falls in Venezuela, which drops 979 meters making it the tallest waterfall on Earth.
Iguazu Falls in South America, which has the greatest total flow of any waterfall.
explanation: Angel Falls in Venezuela is the highest waterfall in the world, with a height of 979 meters.
fact_tl: Ang Angel Falls sa Venezuela ang pinakamataas na talon sa mundo, na may 979 metrong taas.
fact_bis: Ang Angel Falls sa Venezuela mao ang pinakahabog nga busay sa kalibotan, nga adunay 979 ka metro nga gitas-on.

q: How did early Filipinos use their own star groupings like the Balatik?
options: They used star groupings only for religious ceremonies and never for practical daily tasks.
They named every visible star individually and used the names to navigate across oceans.
They used star groupings as guides for seasons, helping farmers and fishermen plan their work.
They used the star groupings to track enemy ships and warn villages of incoming raids.
explanation: Long before modern telescopes, early Filipinos used star groupings like the Balatik as seasonal guides for farming and fishing.
fact_tl: Bago pa man dumating ang mga makabagong teleskopyo, may sariling pangkat ng bituin ang mga sinaunang Pilipino. Halimbawa, ang Balatik ay tinawag na ganoon mula sa isang pampanang gamit sa pangangaso. Ginagamit ito ng mga magsasaka at mangingisda bilang gabay sa panahon.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa ang modernong teleskopyo, ang karaang mga Pilipino adunay kaugalingong pundok sa mga bituon. Pananglitan, ang Balatik ginganlan gikan sa usa ka lit-ag sa pagpangayam. Gigamit kini sa mga mag-uuma ug mananagat isip giya sa mga panahon.

q: Why do worms slow down and stop eating when the weather is very cold or very hot?
options: Worms hibernate in winter by sealing their bodies with a protective mucus coat.
Worms cannot control their own body temperature, so it follows the surrounding temperature and affects how active they are.
Worms go underground to escape heat and cold and will not come up until temperatures are perfect.
Worms store body heat in summer and release it in winter so they always feel warm enough to move.
explanation: Worms cannot control their body heat — it follows the temperature around them — so they slow down and stop eating in extreme cold or heat, and are most active in mild warmth.
fact_tl: Hindi nakokontrol ng bulate ang init ng katawan nila tulad natin — sumusunod ito sa init ng paligid. Kapag napakalamig o napakainit, bumabagal sila at huminto sa pagkain; sa katamtamang init lang sila pinakaaktibo at masaya sa worm bin.
fact_bis: Dili makontrol sa ulod ang kainit sa ilang lawas sama nato — mosunod kini sa temperatura sa palibot. Kung bugnaw kaayo o init kaayo, mohinay sila ug moundang sa pagkaon; sa kasarangang kainit lang sila pinakaaktibo ug malipayon sa worm bin.

q: Why are a cat's whiskers so sensitive to the tiniest touch or movement?
options: Each whisker is hollow and filled with air, which amplifies even the smallest vibrations.
The whisker roots are surrounded by many nerves that detect even the tiniest movement or touch.
The tips of whiskers are coated in a special chemical that reacts to nearby objects.
Whiskers are longer than regular fur so they reach out and touch objects before the cat does.
explanation: The root of each whisker is surrounded by many nerves, so a cat can feel even the tiniest movement or touch through them.
fact_tl: Ang ugat ng bawat bigote ay napapalibutan ng maraming nerbiyo, kaya nararamdaman ng pusa kahit ang pinakamaliit na galaw o pagpindot.
fact_bis: Ang ugat sa matag bigote gilibutan sa daghang nerbiyos, busa mabati sa iring bisan ang pinakagamay nga lihok o paghikap.

q: If your hands look clean, does that mean they are free of germs?
options: Yes — germs always leave a visible mark, so clean-looking hands are always germ-free.
Yes — the natural oils on your skin kill germs within a few minutes of exposure.
No — even when your hands look clean, they can still carry germs you cannot see.
No — but only after eating food, because food always transfers visible and invisible germs.
explanation: Even when your hands look clean, they can still have germs you cannot see, which is why washing with soap is always important.
fact_tl: Kahit mukhang malinis ang kamay, maaari pa rin itong may mikrobyong hindi natin nakikita.
fact_bis: Bisan og morag limpyo ang kamot, mahimo gihapon nga adunay mikrobyo nga dili nato makita.

q: What is it like in the deepest parts of the ocean?
options: It is lit by bioluminescent algae that cover the ocean floor and glow continuously.
It is dimly lit because seawater is clear and sunlight slowly filters all the way down.
It is completely dark because no sunlight reaches those depths.
It is brightly lit near hydrothermal vents that release light along with heat.
explanation: No sunlight reaches the deepest parts of the ocean, so it stays completely dark there.
fact_tl: Walang sikat ng araw na umaabot sa pinakamalalim na bahagi ng karagatan, kaya patuloy itong madilim.
fact_bis: Walay sidlak sa adlaw nga moabot sa pinakalawom nga bahin sa dagat, mao nga kanunay kining ngitngit.

q: What does the cotton plant produce that people use to make cloth?
options: A sticky sap that hardens into strong threads when dried and spun.
Soft white fibers that grow in its seed pods and are used to make thread and cloth.
Long thin roots that are dried, bleached, and woven into fabric.
Broad flat leaves that are pressed together and layered to form sheets of cloth.
explanation: Cotton is a plant that produces soft white fibers in its seed pods, and these fibers are used to make thread and cloth.
fact_tl: Ang bulak ay isang halaman na nagbubunga ng malambot na puti na hibla na ginagawang sinulid at tela.
fact_bis: Ang gapas usa ka tanom nga mamunga ug humok nga puti nga lanot nga himoon nga sinulid ug panapton.

q: After swallowing a large animal, how long might a python need to fully digest its meal?
options: About 30 minutes — a python's powerful stomach acid digests prey very quickly.
A few hours — most snakes digest food within half a day by using muscular contractions.
Several days or even weeks — a python can take that long to fully digest a large meal.
About two days — snakes digest prey at the same speed as most large mammals.
explanation: After swallowing a large meal, a python may take several days or weeks to fully digest its food due to the size of the prey.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos lunukin ang malaking biktima, maaaring abutin ng ilang araw o linggo bago tuluyang matunaw ng sawa ang pagkain nito.
fact_bis: Human lunok sa dakong tukbonon, mahimong moabot ug pipila ka adlaw o semana ayha matunaw sa hingpit sa sawa ang iyang pagkaon.

q: What makes a substance a pure element rather than a mixture or compound?
options: An element must be a metal that conducts electricity and can be found in nature.
An element is any solid substance that cannot be dissolved in water.
An element is made of only one kind of atom that cannot be broken into simpler substances by ordinary means.
An element is any substance found in the periodic table that reacts easily with oxygen.
explanation: Each element is made of only one kind of atom that cannot be broken into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means.
fact_tl: Ang bawat elemento ay gawa sa iisang uri ng atomo na hindi mapaghihiwalay sa mga simpleng paraan.
fact_bis: Ang matag elemento gilangkoban sa usa ra ka klase sa atomo nga dili mabungkag ngadto sa mas yano nga mga sangkap.

q: Why does a magnet attract and hold paperclips?
options: Paperclips are coated with a thin layer of nickel, which is naturally magnetic.
Paperclips are made of iron, a material that magnets pull on.
The magnet and paperclip both have the same electric charge, which makes them attract each other.
Paperclips have tiny air pockets that create a vacuum that sucks them toward the magnet.
explanation: A magnet attracts and holds paperclips because they are made of iron, a material that magnets pull on.
fact_tl: Ang magnet ay humihila at kumakapit sa mga paperclip dahil ang mga ito ay gawa sa bakal, na isang materyal na nahihila ng magnet.
fact_bis: Ang magnet magbira ug mokapyot sa mga paperclip tungod kay hinimo kini sa puthaw, usa ka materyal nga birahon sa magnet.

q: How does lightning help add nutrients to the soil?
options: Lightning heats the soil so deeply that buried organic matter releases nitrogen into the ground.
Lightning breaks apart rocks containing nitrogen minerals so rain can wash them into the soil.
Lightning has enough energy to combine nitrogen and oxygen from the air, and rain carries the result down into the soil.
Lightning strikes trees which then decompose and release their stored nitrogen over many years.
explanation: Lightning has enough energy to combine nitrogen and oxygen, and rain carries the combined compounds down to the soil, adding nutrients naturally.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay may sapat na enerhiya para pagsamahin ang nitroheno at oksiheno, at dinadala ito sa lupa ng ulan.
fact_bis: Ang kilat adunay igong enerhiya aron iusa ang nitrogen ug oxygen, ug dad-on kini sa ulan paingon sa yuta.

q: What are garlic and onion commonly used for in Filipino cooking?
options: They are used as a main vegetable dish, cooked alone as the primary ingredient of the meal.
They are soaked in water to make a health drink that boosts the immune system.
They are used to add flavor to food in Filipino cooking.
They are ground into a powder and sprinkled on food as a natural food preservative.
explanation: Garlic and onion are often used in Filipino cooking to add flavor to many different dishes.
fact_tl: Madalas gamitin ang bawang at sibuyas sa pagluluto ng pagkaing Pilipino para magbigay ng sarap at lasa.
fact_bis: Ang ahos ug sibuyas kanunay gamiton sa pagluto sa pagkaong Pilipino aron mahatagan og lami ang pagkaon.

q: To see a rainbow, where must the sun be in relation to you?
options: The sun must be in front of you and above the rain clouds for the rainbow to form.
The sun must be directly overhead at noon so its light shines straight down into the rain.
The sun must be behind you while you face the rain or mist.
The sun must be low on the horizon and to your side as you look at the rain.
explanation: You can see a rainbow when the sun is behind you and you are facing the rain or mist, so sunlight shines into the water droplets toward your eyes.
fact_tl: Makikita mo ang bahaghari kapag nasa likod mo ang araw at nakaharap ka sa ulan o ambon.
fact_bis: Makita nimo ang bangaw kung ang adlaw naa sa imong luyo ug nag-atubang ka sa ulan o gabon.

q: How do the colugo's large eyes help it survive in the forest at night?
options: Its large eyes glow in the dark to scare away predators before it needs to glide to safety.
Its large eyes absorb extra heat at night to keep the colugo warm while gliding.
Its large eyes help it see well in the dark and judge how far the next tree is so it lands accurately when gliding.
Its large eyes can see ultraviolet light to detect insects hidden in leaves at night.
explanation: The colugo has large eyes that help it see well even at night, allowing it to judge how far the next tree is before it glides so it lands accurately.
fact_tl: May malalaking mata ang colugo na nakakatulong dito na makakita nang mabuti kahit gabi. Sa pamamagitan ng mga ito, natatantya nito ang layo ng susunod na puno bago maglutang para tumpak ang pagdapo nito.
fact_bis: Ang colugo adunay dagkong mata nga makatabang niini sa pagkakita ug maayo bisan gabii. Pinaagi niini, matantya niini ang gilay-on sa sunod nga kahoy sa dili pa molupad-lupad aron tukma ang pagdapo niini.

q: What property of zeolites makes them useful for softening hard water?
options: Zeolites are very hard minerals that physically crush calcium and magnesium as water flows through them.
Zeolites are porous minerals with tiny pores that allow ion exchange, so they can remove calcium and magnesium from hard water.
Zeolites are acidic minerals that dissolve calcium and magnesium into harmless gases.
Zeolites are magnetic minerals that attract calcium and magnesium ions and pull them out of water.
explanation: Zeolites are porous minerals with microscopically small pores that allow ion exchange, making them effective at removing calcium and magnesium from hard water.
fact_tl: Ang zeolite ay isang porous mineral na may maraming microscopicng pores na nagpapahintulot sa pagpalitan ng ion — ginagamit ito sa mga water softener para alisin ang calcium at magnesium mula sa hard water at sa mga detergent bilang kahalili ng phosphate.
fact_bis: Ang mga zeolite mga porous mineral nga adunay microscopically gagmay nga mga pores nga nagtugot sa ion exchange; gigamit kini sa mga water softener aron tangtangon ang calcium ug magnesium gikan sa hard water, ug sa mga detergent isip kasugtanan sa phosphate.

q: What group of animals do octopuses and cuttlefish belong to?
options: They are crustaceans, the same group as crabs and shrimp, because they have a hard outer covering.
They are echinoderms, related to sea stars and sea urchins, because they live on the ocean floor.
They are cephalopod mollusks — soft-bodied animals with no backbone.
They are cartilaginous fish, related to sharks and rays, because they have no true bones.
explanation: Octopuses and cuttlefish are cephalopods, a kind of soft-bodied mollusk with no backbone.
fact_tl: Ang pugita at cuttlefish ay mga cephalopod, isang uri ng mollusk na walang gulugod at malambot ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang pugita ug cuttlefish mga cephalopod, usa ka klase sa mollusk nga humok ug lawas ug walay bukog.

q: Why is nuclear energy considered non-renewable even though it does not burn fossil fuels?
options: Nuclear energy is non-renewable because the reactors break down after one use and cannot be rebuilt.
Nuclear energy is non-renewable because the radiation it produces permanently destroys the fuel.
Nuclear energy is non-renewable because uranium, the fuel used, is mined from the ground and can run out.
Nuclear energy is non-renewable because it requires coal to start the nuclear reaction inside the reactor.
explanation: Nuclear energy comes from splitting uranium atoms; even though it is not a fossil fuel, uranium is mined and can eventually run out, making it non-renewable.
fact_tl: Ang nuclear energy ay galing sa paghati ng mga atom ng uranium; hindi ito fossil fuel, pero non-renewable pa rin dahil ang uranium ay minahin at maaaring maubos.
fact_bis: Ang nuclear energy gikan sa pagbahin sa mga atom sa uranium; dili kini fossil fuel, apan non-renewable gihapon kay ang uranium gimina ug mahimong mahurot.

q: Why must only trained chefs prepare fugu (pufferfish) as a food dish?
options: Pufferfish must be cooked at an exact temperature that only trained chefs can maintain.
Trained chefs carefully remove the poisonous parts like the liver before serving, because eating them is deadly.
Pufferfish have very tough skin that only special knives owned by trained chefs can cut.
Pufferfish release a bad smell when cut, and only trained chefs know how to mask the odor.
explanation: Trained fugu chefs carefully cut away the poisonous parts like the liver before serving, because even a small mistake is very risky.
fact_tl: Ang mga sanay na kusinero ng fugu ay maingat na tinatanggal ang mga bahaging may lason gaya ng atay bago ito ihain, ngunit napakapanganib pa rin nito.
fact_bis: Ang gibansay nga mga kusinero sa fugu mag-amping sa pagkuha sa mga bahin nga adunay hilo sama sa atay una kini idalit, apan peligroso gihapon kaayo kini.

q: Inside an atom, how do protons and neutrons compare in mass to electrons?
options: Electrons are heavier than protons because they move faster and carry more energy.
All three particles — protons, neutrons, and electrons — have roughly the same mass.
Protons and neutrons are much heavier than electrons, which are extremely light.
Neutrons are the heaviest, protons are medium, and electrons are about half the mass of protons.
explanation: Protons and neutrons are much heavier than electrons, which are extremely light in comparison.
fact_tl: Ang proton at neutron ay mas mabigat kaysa electron, na napakagaan lamang.
fact_bis: Ang proton ug neutron mas bug-at kay sa electron, nga gaan kaayo.

q: What usually happens to weather in the Philippines during La Niña?
options: The Philippines experiences very dry conditions and drought because La Niña warms the Pacific Ocean.
There is less rain than usual because cooler Pacific waters produce fewer clouds.
The Philippines often gets more rain and flooding because La Niña cools Pacific seawater more than usual.
Typhoons become weaker during La Niña because cooler ocean water provides less energy.
explanation: La Niña is when Pacific seawater becomes cooler than usual, and because of this the Philippines often experiences more rain and flooding.
fact_tl: Sa simpleng salita, ang La Niña ay kapag mas lumamig kaysa karaniwan ang tubig-dagat sa Pacific, at kadalasang dahil dito ay mas marami ang ulan at baha sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Sa yano nga pulong, ang La Niña mao kon mas mobugnaw kaysa kasagaran ang tubig-dagat sa Pacific, ug tungod niini kasagarang mas daghan ang ulan ug baha sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the job of the right side of the heart?
options: To pump oxygen-rich blood from the lungs directly to all parts of the body.
To store extra blood when you exercise so the body has a reserve supply ready.
To send blood to the lungs so it can pick up oxygen before going to the body.
To filter waste products out of the blood before sending it to the kidneys.
explanation: The right side of the heart sends blood to the lungs, where it picks up oxygen before being delivered to the rest of the body.
fact_tl: Ang kanang bahagi ng puso ay may espesyal na trabaho: magpadala ng dugo sa baga. Doon, kinukuha ng dugo ang oxygen mula sa hangin na nilalanghap mo. Kaya bago ipamahagi ang dugo sa katawan, dumadaan muna ito sa kanang silid papuntang baga para mapuno ng oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang tuong bahin sa kasingkasing adunay espesyal nga trabaho: magpadala og dugo sa baga. Didto, ang dugo mokuha og oxygen gikan sa hangin nga imong giginhawa. Busa sa wala pa ipanghatag ang dugo sa lawas, moagi una kini sa tuong lawak padulong sa baga aron mapuno og oxygen.

q: During the night, in which direction does the breeze blow along a coastline?
options: From the sea toward the land, because the sea stays warm all night while the land cools down.
From the land out to the sea, because the sea is warmer at night and the cooler air from land moves toward it.
Straight upward from the water, because warm ocean air rises and does not move sideways at night.
There is no breeze at night because the temperature difference between land and sea disappears after sunset.
explanation: At night the water is warmer than the land, so air blows from the land out to sea, creating a land breeze — the opposite of the daytime sea breeze.
fact_tl: Ang kabaliktaran ng sea breeze ay ang land breeze. Sa araw, mas mainit ang lupa kaya humihihip ang hangin mula dagat (sea breeze). Sa gabi naman, mas mainit ang tubig kaya humihihip ang hangin mula lupa papuntang dagat (land breeze). Magkaibang direksyon sila depende sa oras.
fact_bis: Ang kaatbang sa sea breeze mao ang land breeze. Sa adlaw mas init ang yuta, mao nga mohuyop ang hangin gikan sa dagat (sea breeze). Sa gabii mas init ang tubig, mao nga mohuyop ang hangin gikan sa yuta padulong dagat (land breeze). Magkalahi ang ilang direksyon depende sa oras.

q: Why is stainless steel used in kitchens and hospitals instead of regular iron or steel?
options: Stainless steel is lighter than regular steel, making it easier to carry pots and surgical tools.
Stainless steel conducts heat better than regular steel so food cooks more evenly.
Stainless steel resists rust because it contains chromium that forms a protective layer on the surface.
Stainless steel is harder than regular steel so it cannot be scratched by knives or scalpels.
explanation: Stainless steel is an alloy of iron and chromium that forms a protective oxide layer preventing rust, which is why it is widely used in kitchens and hospitals.
fact_tl: Ang stainless steel ay isang alloy ng bakal at chromium na nagtatayo ng protektibong layer upang hindi kumakalawang — ito ang dahilan kung bakit ginagamit ito sa mga kusina at ospital.
fact_bis: Ang stainless steel usa ka alloy sa bakal ug chromium nga nagbuo og protektibong oxide layer, nagpugong sa kalawang; kini daghan gigamit sa mga kusina ug ospital tungod niini.

q: How does extra carbon dioxide (CO2) in the air harm ocean animals like corals and shellfish?
options: Extra CO2 warms the ocean so much that corals and shellfish overheat and die from the high temperature alone.
Extra CO2 reduces oxygen levels in the water, so corals and shellfish cannot breathe and suffocate.
CO2 absorbed by the ocean forms carbonic acid, lowering seawater pH and making it harder for corals and shellfish to build their shells.
Extra CO2 blocks sunlight from reaching the ocean floor, so corals and shellfish cannot see to find food.
explanation: When CO2 is absorbed by the ocean, it forms carbonic acid and lowers seawater pH, making it harder for corals and shellfish to build their shells and skeletons.
fact_tl: Kapag ang CO2 ay nasisipsip ng dagat, nagiging carbonic acid ito at nagpapababa ng pH ng tubig-dagat; ito ay nagpapahirap sa mga koral at kabibe na bumuo ng kanilang mga kaliskis at shell.
fact_bis: Sa dihang ang CO2 nasipsip sa dagat, mahimong carbonic acid kini ug nagpababa sa pH sa tubig-dagat; nagpahinay kini sa mga koral ug kabibe sa pagbuhat sa ilang mga kaliskis ug klam.

q: How do dung beetles help the environment?
options: They eat harmful insects in the soil that would otherwise damage plant roots and crops.
They collect animal dung and bury it in the soil, releasing nutrients into the ground and improving soil quality for plants.
They dig tunnels that allow rainwater to drain underground and prevent flooding in fields.
They carry pollen from one plant to another while searching for dung, pollinating flowers along the way.
explanation: Dung beetles collect animal dung and bury it in the soil, releasing nutrients into the ground and improving soil quality for plants.
fact_tl: Ang mga dung beetle ay kumukuha ng dumi ng mga hayop at inililibing ito sa lupa, na nagpapalabas ng mga sustansya sa lupa at nagpapabuti ng kalidad ng lupa para sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang mga dung beetle nagkolekta sa tae sa mga mananap ug gilubong kini sa yuta, nagpagawas sa mga sustansya ngadto sa yuta ug nagpabuti sa kalidad sa yuta alang sa mga tanom.

q: What is the chemical formula of rust, the reddish coating that forms on iron?
options: Fe2O3
FeCl2
FeS2
Fe3O4
explanation: Rust is mainly iron oxide with the formula Fe2O3.
fact_tl: Ang pangunahing kemikal sa kalawang ay iron oxide, na may pormula na Fe2O3.
fact_bis: Ang pangunang kemikal sa kalawang kay iron oxide, nga adunay pormula nga Fe2O3.

q: Who took the earliest surviving photograph, and in what decade was it taken?
options: Joseph Niepce in the 1820s
Louis Daguerre in the 1840s
Thomas Edison in the 1880s
Alexander Bell in the 1850s
explanation: The earliest surviving photograph was taken by Joseph Niepce in 1826, in the 1820s.
fact_tl: Ang pinakaunang natatanggal na litrato ay kinuha ni Joseph Niepce noong mga taong 1820, sa 1826.
fact_bis: Ang labing una nga nahabilin nga litrato gikuha ni Joseph Niepce niadtong mga tuig 1820, sa 1826.

q: Why does warm air rise while cool air sinks?
options: Warm air is lighter than cool air
Warm air contains more oxygen
Cool air is attracted to the ground by magnets
Warm air moves faster sideways
explanation: Warm air is lighter than cool air, so it rises while cool air sinks — which is why heat collects near the ceiling of a room.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na hangin ay mas magaan kaysa malamig na hangin, kaya umaakyat ito habang bumababa ang malamig na hangin. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit umiitaas ang init malapit sa kisame ng kuwarto at kung bakit lumulutang ang hot-air balloon.
fact_bis: Ang init nga hangin mas magaan kaysa bugnaw nga hangin, busa mosaka kini samtang ang bugnaw nga hangin mokunsad. Mao ni ang hinungdan nga ang kainit magtapok duol sa kisame sa kwarto ug nganong molutaw ang hot-air balloon.

q: Why might a tree in the Philippines have rings that are hard to see or count?
options: Because the tree grows fairly evenly all year in warm weather
Because Philippine trees do not have any rings at all
Because heavy rain washes the rings away each year
Because the trees grow too fast in summer to form rings
explanation: In places that stay warm all year like the Philippines, some trees have unclear rings because their growth is fairly even throughout the year.
fact_tl: Sa mga lugar na mainit buong taon tulad ng Pilipinas, ang ilang puno ay walang malinaw na singsing dahil halos pare-pareho ang paglaki nila buong taon.
fact_bis: Sa mga lugar nga init tibuok tuig sama sa Pilipinas, ang pipila ka kahoy walay klaro nga singsing kay hapit pareho ra ang ilang pagtubo sa tibuok tuig.

q: Which of the following are kinds of tuna commonly caught in the Philippines?
options: Yellowfin tuna and skipjack tuna
Bluefin tuna and swordfish
Albacore tuna and marlin
Bigeye tuna and sailfish
explanation: Several kinds of tuna are caught in the Philippines, such as yellowfin tuna and skipjack tuna.
fact_tl: Iba't ibang uri ng tuna ang nahuhuli sa Pilipinas, tulad ng yellowfin tuna at skipjack tuna.
fact_bis: Lain-laing matang sa tuna ang makuha sa Pilipinas, sama sa yellowfin tuna ug skipjack tuna.

q: Where does a person's blood type come from?
options: It is inherited from their parents
It is decided by the food they eat as babies
It changes as people grow older
It is determined by where a person is born
explanation: A person's blood type (A, B, O, or AB) is inherited from their parents through the combination of genes from the mother and father.
fact_tl: Ang uri ng dugo ng isang tao (tulad ng A, B, O, o AB) ay namana mula sa kanyang mga magulang. Ang kombinasyon ng mga gene mula sa ina at ama ang nagtatakda kung anong blood type ang makukuha ng anak.
fact_bis: Ang klase sa dugo sa usa ka tawo (sama sa A, B, O, o AB) napanunod gikan sa iyang mga ginikanan. Ang kombinasyon sa mga gene gikan sa inahan ug amahan maoy magtino kung unsa nga blood type ang makuha sa anak.

q: After a mantis shrimp punches its prey, what delivers a second blow?
options: The popping of a collapsing bubble
The shrimp's hard shell bouncing back
A second claw hitting instantly
A burst of water jet from the shrimp's tail
explanation: After the first punch, the collapsing bubble pops and delivers a second blow to the mantis shrimp's prey.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng unang suntok, ang pagputok ng bula ay nagbibigay pa ng ikalawang hampas sa biktima nito.
fact_bis: Human sa unang sumbag, ang pagbuto sa bula maghatag pa ug ikaduhang hampas sa tukbonon sa mantis shrimp.

q: What instrument is used to measure and record the strength of earthquakes?
options: Seismograph
Barometer
Thermometer
Anemometer
explanation: A seismograph is an instrument used to measure and record the strength of earthquakes.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang instrumentong seismograph upang sukatin at itala ang lakas ng mga lindol.
fact_bis: Ang seismograph usa ka instrumento nga gigamit aron sukdon ug irekord ang kakusog sa mga linog.

q: Where inside a cave do swiftlets choose to build their nests?
options: In the deepest parts where no sunlight reaches
Near the entrance to catch insects easily
On wet walls where moss grows
At the top of the cave ceiling close to the light
explanation: Swiftlets nest in the deepest parts of caves where no sunlight reaches, keeping them safer from predators.
fact_tl: Pumipili ang swiftlet na mamugad sa pinakamalalim na bahagi ng kweba kung saan walang liwanag ng araw na nakakapasok. Doon mas ligtas sila sa mga hayop na manghuhuli.
fact_bis: Ang swiftlet mopili nga mamugad sa pinakalawom nga bahin sa langob diin walay kahayag sa adlaw nga makasulod. Didto mas luwas sila gikan sa mga hayop nga manunukob.

q: How do gardeners create new gumamela flower colors?
options: By transferring pollen from one gumamela's stamen to another's pistil
By soaking the roots in colored water
By grafting two gumamela stems together
By cutting the petals and replanting them in new soil
explanation: Gardeners take pollen from one gumamela's stamen and place it on another's pistil to create new flower colors.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng mga hardinero ang pollen mula sa stamen ng isang gumamela para ipasok sa pistil ng iba, at sa ganoon nakagagawa sila ng bagong kulay ng bulaklak. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit napakaraming kulay ng gumamela ngayon.
fact_bis: Ang mga hardinero mokuha ug pollen gikan sa stamen sa usa ka gumamela ug ibutang kini sa pistil sa lain, ug niana makahimo silag bag-ong kolor sa bulak. Mao kini ang hinungdan nganong daghan kaayong kolor sa gumamela karon.

q: What special structure helps seeds travel through the air on wind currents?
options: Feathery or papery structures that act like parachutes
Hooks that cling to animals passing by
A thick hard shell that floats on water
Sticky gel that sticks to bird feet
explanation: Seeds dispersed by wind often have feathery or papery structures that act like parachutes, helping them drift on air currents.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto na nakakalat sa pamamagitan ng hangin ay madalas may mabalahibo o malatela na istraktura—tulad ng pampas na cotton—na tumutulong sa paglipad.
fact_bis: Ang mga buto nga nagkatag pinaagi sa hangin kasagaran adunay balahibo o papel nga istraktura—sama sa payong—nga makatabang sa paglupad niini.

q: What type of rock forms when lava cools and hardens?
options: Igneous rock
Sedimentary rock
Metamorphic rock
Limestone
explanation: When lava cools and hardens, it turns into solid rock called igneous rock.
fact_tl: Kapag lumamig at tumigas ang lava, ito ay nagiging matigas na bato (igneous rock).
fact_bis: Kon mobugnaw ug mogahi ang lava, mahimo kining gahi nga bato nga gitawag igneous rock.

q: What is the shiny inner layer of a nautilus shell called?
options: Nacre, or mother-of-pearl
Keratin
Enamel
Calcium carbonate coating
explanation: Inside the nautilus shell is a shiny layer called nacre, or mother-of-pearl, the same material that makes the inside of other shells and pearls shine.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng shell ng nautilus ay may makintab na patong na tinatawag na nacre o mother-of-pearl, kapareho ng nagbibigay-kinang sa loob ng ibang kabibe at sa perlas.
fact_bis: Sulod sa kabibe sa nautilus adunay makidlap nga patong nga gitawag og nacre o mother-of-pearl, parehas sa naghatag og kidlap sa sulod sa ubang kabibe ug sa perlas.

q: Approximately how large is the surface area of Lake Naujan?
options: About 81 square kilometers
About 8 square kilometers
About 810 square kilometers
About 18 square kilometers
explanation: Lake Naujan has a surface area of about 81 square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang Lake Naujan ay may lawak na humigit-kumulang 81 kilometro kuwadrado.
fact_bis: Ang Lake Naujan adunay gidak-on nga mga 81 ka kuwadradong kilometro.

q: What is each "eye" on a pineapple's skin made from?
options: A single flower that fused with the others
A seed pod that grew outward
A leaf bud that hardened
A cluster of juice sacs
explanation: A pineapple is made of many small flowers that fused together into one big fruit, and each eye on its skin comes from a single flower.
fact_tl: Ang isang pinya ay talagang gawa sa maraming maliliit na bulaklak na nagsanib-sanib sa isang malaking prutas. Ang bawat "mata" sa balat ng pinya ay galing sa isang bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka pinya tinuod nga hinimo sa daghang gagmay nga mga bulak nga naghiusa ngadto sa usa ka dako nga prutas. Ang matag "mata" sa panit sa pinya gikan sa usa ka bulak.

q: Aside from aphids, what other soft-bodied pests do ladybugs eat?
options: Mites and mealybugs
Caterpillars and beetles
Ants and flies
Grasshoppers and locusts
explanation: Besides aphids, ladybugs also eat other soft-bodied pests like mites and mealybugs.
fact_tl: Bukod sa aphids, kumakain din ang ladybug ng iba pang malalambot na peste gaya ng mites at mealybug.
fact_bis: Gawas sa aphids, ang ladybug mokaon usab og ubang humok nga peste sama sa mites ug mealybug.

q: What does the Latin word 'rodere,' the root of 'rodent,' mean?
options: To gnaw
To burrow
To scurry
To nest
explanation: The word 'rodent' comes from the Latin word 'rodere,' which means 'to gnaw.'
fact_tl: Ang salitang 'rodent' ay nagmula sa Latin na 'rodere' na ang ibig sabihin ay 'ngumata.'
fact_bis: Ang pulong 'rodent' naggikan sa Latin nga 'rodere,' nga ang buot ipasabot kay 'mokitkit.'

q: Which is the correct order of organization in a living body, from smallest to largest?
options: Cells → tissues → organs → organ systems → organism
Tissues → cells → organs → organism → organ systems
Organs → cells → tissues → organ systems → organism
Organism → organ systems → tissues → cells → organs
explanation: Living bodies are organized from cells, to tissues, to organs, to organ systems, up to the whole organism.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng mga buhay na bagay ay nakaayos sa antas: mula sa selula, patungong tissue, organ, organ system, hanggang sa buong organismo.
fact_bis: Ang lawas sa buhi nga mga butang gihan-ay sa lebel: gikan sa selula, ngadto sa tissue, organ, organ system, hangtod sa tibuok organismo.

q: What is the main difference between grounding and insulating in electricity?
options: Grounding lets electric charge escape to the ground; insulating keeps charge trapped in one place
Grounding blocks the flow of charge; insulating sends it to the ground
Grounding and insulating both stop the flow of electricity
Grounding only works in wet conditions; insulating only works in dry conditions
explanation: Grounding opens a path for charge to flow out to the ground, while insulating blocks the flow and keeps charge in one place — they are opposites.
fact_tl: Ano ang pagkakaiba ng grounding at insulating? Ang grounding ay nagbubukas ng daan para makadaloy palabas ang charge papunta sa lupa. Ang insulating naman ay humaharang sa daloy para manatili ang charge sa isang lugar. Magkasalungat sila: ang isa ay nagpapalabas, ang isa ay nagpapanatili.
fact_bis: Unsa ang kalainan sa grounding ug insulating? Ang grounding mo-abli og dalan aron moagas ang charge paingon sa yuta. Ang insulating mobabag sa pag-agas aron magpabilin ang charge sa usa ka lugar. Magkasukwahi sila: ang usa magpagawas, ang usa magpabilin.

q: How are dogs able to follow a person's trail even when they cannot see them?
options: They use their extremely sharp sense of smell to follow a scent trail on the ground
They use their sensitive hearing to detect footsteps from far away
They use their whiskers to feel vibrations left in the ground
They follow the heat trail a person's feet leave behind
explanation: Dogs have an extremely sharp sense of smell and can follow a scent trail left by a person or animal on the ground.
fact_tl: Ang aso ay may napakatalas na pang-amoy, kaya kaya nitong sundan ang bakas-amoy (scent trail) ng tao o hayop sa lupa para makahanap ng daan o makakita ng nawawala.
fact_bis: Ang iro adunay hilabihan ka talas nga panimaho, busa makasubay kini sa baho (scent trail) sa tawo o mananap sa yuta aron makakaplag sa dalan o makapangita sa nawala.

q: Why are old fish and crocodiles often the largest of their kind?
options: Because they keep growing as long as they live, unlike people
Because they eat more food as they get older
Because cold water makes their bodies expand over time
Because their bones fuse together and push them to grow bigger
explanation: Some animals like fish and crocodiles keep growing as long as they live, so the oldest one is often also the largest of its kind.
fact_tl: Bakit may ilang hayop na napakalaki kapag matanda na? Dahil ang ilang hayop tulad ng isda at buwaya ay patuloy na lumalaki habang nabubuhay—hindi sila tumitigil tulad ng tao. Kaya kadalasan, ang pinakamatanda ang pinakamalaki rin sa kanilang uri.
fact_bis: Ngano nga ang ubang hayop dako kaayo kung tigulang na? Tungod kay ang ubang hayop sama sa isda ug buaya magpadayon og tubo samtang buhi, dili sila mohunong sama sa tawo. Mao nga sagad, ang pinakatigulang mao usab ang pinakadako sa ilang matang.

q: Which part of the lungs does asthma mainly affect?
options: The tiny branching airways deep in the lungs called bronchioles
The large windpipe that leads air into the lungs
The air sacs at the very tips of the lung branches
The thick muscle wall surrounding the lungs
explanation: Asthma mainly affects the tiny branching airways deep inside the lungs called bronchioles.
fact_tl: Ang hika ay pangunahing nakakaapekto sa maliliit na sanga ng daluyan ng hangin sa loob ng baga na tinatawag na bronchioles.
fact_bis: Ang hubak nag-apekto labi na sa gagmay nga nagsanga nga agianan sa hangin sulod sa baga nga gitawag og bronchioles.

q: What instrument measures air pressure and is used to help predict the weather?
options: Barometer
Thermometer
Anemometer
Hygrometer
explanation: A barometer is an instrument that measures air pressure, and it is used to help predict the weather.
fact_tl: Ang barometro ay isang instrumento na sumusukat sa presyon ng hangin, at ginagamit ito sa pagtaya ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang barometro usa ka instrumento nga nagsukod sa presyon sa hangin, ug gigamit kini sa pagtag-an sa panahon.

q: How wide can the flower of Rafflesia arnoldii grow?
options: About one meter wide
About ten centimeters wide
About five meters wide
About half a meter wide
explanation: The flower of Rafflesia arnoldii can reach about one meter wide and weigh up to 10 kilograms.
fact_tl: Ang bulaklak ng Rafflesia arnoldii ay umaabot ng halos isang metro ang lapad at maaaring tumimbang ng hanggang 10 kilo.
fact_bis: Ang bulak sa Rafflesia arnoldii makaabot ug halos usa ka metro ang gilapdon ug makatimbang ug hangtod 10 ka kilo.

q: What type of acid is found naturally in the stomach, and what makes it useful?
options: Hydrochloric acid, which is very acidic and helps break down food and kill microbes
Sulfuric acid, which dissolves food quickly at a neutral pH
Citric acid, which is mild and safe for the stomach lining
Carbonic acid, which fizzes to mix food around the stomach
explanation: The stomach contains hydrochloric acid (pH around 1–2), which helps break down food and kill microbes.
fact_tl: Ang likas na asido sa sikmura ay hydrochloric acid na napakaasim (pH na halos 1–2), na tumutulong tunawin ang pagkain at pumatay ng mga mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Ang natural nga asido sa tiyan kay hydrochloric acid nga maaslom kaayo (pH mga 1–2), nga makatabang sa pagtunaw sa pagkaon ug pagpatay sa mga mikrobyo.

q: What is Diosdado Banatao known for in the history of computers?
options: Developing early chips that made personal computers faster and more affordable
Inventing the first computer keyboard used in the Philippines
Writing the first Filipino programming language for schools
Building the first internet server in Southeast Asia
explanation: Diosdado Banatao is known for developing early chips that made personal computers faster and more affordable.
fact_tl: Si Diosdado Banatao ay kilala sa paggawa ng mga maagang chip na nagpabilis at nagpamura sa mga personal na kompyuter.
fact_bis: Si Diosdado Banatao nailhan sa paghimo og sayo nga mga chip nga nagpaspas ug nagpabarato sa personal nga mga kompyuter.

q: What are Jupiter's rings made of, and which spacecraft discovered them?
options: Tiny dust particles from small inner moons, discovered by Voyager 1 in 1979
Large chunks of ice, discovered by the Hubble Space Telescope in 1990
Rocky asteroids, discovered by the Cassini spacecraft in 2004
Gas clouds from erupting volcanoes, discovered by Pioneer 10 in 1973
explanation: Jupiter's rings are very faint and made of tiny dust particles from its small inner moons; they were discovered by Voyager 1 in 1979.
fact_tl: Ang Jupiter ay mayroon ding mga singsing, ngunit ang mga ito ay napakalalim at binubuo ng maliit na alikabok na nagmumula sa mga maliit na buwan nito; natuklasan ang mga singsing ng Jupiter ng Voyager 1 spacecraft noong 1979.
fact_bis: Ang Jupiter aduna usay mga singsing, apan kini kaayo ka mahinay ug gihimo sa gamay nga mga abug-abug gikan sa iyang gamay nga mga panloob nga buwan; ang mga singsing sa Jupiter nadiskubre sa Voyager 1 spacecraft niadtong 1979.

q: Which Filipino scientist pioneered the use of geothermal energy in the Philippines?
options: Arturo Alcaraz
Gregorio Zara
Diosdado Banatao
Eduardo Quisumbing
explanation: Arturo Alcaraz was the Filipino scientist who pioneered the use of geothermal energy, helping make the Philippines one of the world's largest geothermal power users.
fact_tl: Si Arturo Alcaraz ang Pilipinong siyentipiko na nag-pioneer sa paggamit ng geothermal energy sa Pilipinas, na tumutulong na maging isa sa pinakamalaking gumagamit ng geothermal power sa mundo ang bansa.
fact_bis: Si Arturo Alcaraz mao ang Pilipinong siyentipiko nga nanguna sa paggamit sa geothermal energy sa Pilipinas, nakatulong nga mahimong usa sa pinakadako nga gumagamit sa geothermal power sa kalibutan ang nasod.

q: What is the density of pure water, often used as a comparison standard?
options: About one gram per cubic centimeter
About ten grams per cubic centimeter
About 0.1 grams per cubic centimeter
About five grams per cubic centimeter
explanation: Pure water has a density of about one gram per cubic centimeter, which is used as a comparison standard for other materials.
fact_tl: Ang densidad ng purong tubig ay halos isang gramo kada sentimetro kubiko, na ginagawang sukatan.
fact_bis: Ang densidad sa lunsay nga tubig kay mga usa ka gramo kada kubiko sentimetro, gigamit nga sukdanan.

q: About how far away is the Moon from Earth on average?
options: About 384,000 kilometers
About 38,400 kilometers
About 3,840,000 kilometers
About 384 kilometers
explanation: The average distance from Earth to the Moon is about 384,000 kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang layo ng Buwan sa Daigdig ay mga 384,000 kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang kasagarang gilay-on sa Bulan gikan sa Yuta maoy mga 384,000 ka kilometro.

q: In a compound like water, what is always true about the ratio of atoms?
options: The ratio is always fixed — water always has two hydrogen atoms for every one oxygen atom
The ratio changes depending on the temperature
The ratio depends on where the water comes from
The ratio can be adjusted by adding more of one element
explanation: In a compound, the ratio of each atom is always fixed; water always has two hydrogen atoms for every one oxygen atom, no matter where it comes from.
fact_tl: Sa isang kompuwesto, palaging tiyak ang dami ng bawat atomo; ang tubig ay laging dalawang hydrogen sa bawat isang oksiheno, kahit saan ito manggaling.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka kompuwesto, kanunayng piho ang gidaghanon sa matag atomo; ang tubig kanunayng duha ka hydrogen sa matag usa ka oksiheno, bisan asa kini gikan.

q: Why do cacti grow very slowly compared to most other plants?
options: They must save water and food in dry places
They have no leaves to catch sunlight for fast growth
Their roots are too shallow to absorb enough nutrients
They live in cold deserts where temperatures slow all growth
explanation: Cacti grow very slowly because they must save water and food in dry places.
fact_tl: Ang mga kaktus ay mabagal lumaki dahil nagtitipid sila ng tubig at pagkain sa tuyong lugar.
fact_bis: Ang mga kaktus hinay molaki kay nagtipig sila og tubig ug pagkaon sa uga nga lugar.

q: Why is a heavy box harder to drag across the floor than a light one?
options: A heavier object has greater friction with the ground
A heavier object has less air around it to slide on
A heavy box has more edges that dig into the floor
The weight of the box makes the floor stick to it magnetically
explanation: Friction between the ground and a heavier object is greater, which is why a heavy box is harder to drag.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang friction sa pagitan ng mabigat na bagay at lupa, kaya mas mahirap hilahin ang mabigat na kahon.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang friction tali sa yuta ug bug-at nga butang, mao nga lisod guyoron ang bug-at nga kahon.

q: In which layer of the atmosphere do auroras (northern lights) form?
options: The thermosphere
The stratosphere
The mesosphere
The troposphere
explanation: Auroras form in the thermosphere when particles from the Sun strike the air.
fact_tl: Sa thermosphere nabubuo ang aurora o hilagang ilaw kapag tumama ang mga particle ng araw sa hangin.
fact_bis: Sa thermosphere maporma ang aurora o amihanang kahayag kung ang mga partikulo gikan sa adlaw moigo sa hangin.

q: How do mangrove trees protect the coast and support sea life?
options: Their tangled roots block big waves and filter dirt from the water, sheltering young fish
They release chemicals that calm ocean waves during storms
Their thick canopy blocks sunlight and keeps the water cool for fish
They absorb saltwater to reduce flooding on land
explanation: Mangrove roots block big waves and storms and also filter dirt from the water, protecting the coast and sheltering young fish.
fact_tl: Ang masalimuot na ugat ng bakawan ay humahadlang sa malalaking alon at bagyo, at nasasala pa nito ang dumi sa tubig — kaya pinangangalagaan ang baybayin at pinupugaran ng mga isda.
fact_bis: Ang nagkagubot nga gamot sa bakhaw makababag sa dagkong balod ug bagyo ug makasala usab sa hugaw sa tubig — busa gipanalipdan niini ang baybayon ug gisilonganan sa mga gagmayng isda.

q: What body part does a fish use to swim and move through the water?
options: Its fins
Its scales
Its gills
Its tail bones
explanation: A fish uses its fins to swim and move through the water.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng isda ang mga palikpik nito para lumangoy at gumalaw sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang isda nagagamit sa iyang mga kapay aron makalangoy ug makalihok sa tubig.

q: What do fish, birds, and humans have in common that makes them all vertebrates?
options: They all have a backbone
They all breathe with lungs
They all have four limbs
They all have warm blood
explanation: Animals that have a backbone, such as fish, birds, and humans, are called vertebrates.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na may gulugod, gaya ng isda, ibon, at tao, ay tinatawag na vertebrates.
fact_bis: Ang mga mananap nga adunay gulugod, sama sa isda, langgam, ug tawo, gitawag og vertebrates.

q: Which Filipino physicist and inventor was proclaimed a National Scientist of the Philippines?
options: Gregorio Zara
Arturo Alcaraz
Diosdado Banatao
Julian Felipe
explanation: Gregorio Zara was a Filipino physicist and inventor proclaimed a National Scientist of the Philippines for his contributions to science.
fact_tl: Si Gregorio Zara ay isang Pilipinong pisiko at imbentor na itinanghal na Pambansang Siyentipiko ng Pilipinas dahil sa kanyang mga naiambag sa agham.
fact_bis: Si Gregorio Zara usa ka Pilipinong pisiko ug imbentor nga giproklama nga Pambansang Siyentipiko sa Pilipinas tungod sa iyang mga ambag sa siyensiya.

q: Where does a young dragonfly (nymph) live before it grows wings and flies?
options: Underwater
Inside a tree trunk
In an underground burrow
Inside a cocoon on a leaf
explanation: A dragonfly nymph lives underwater, and when it becomes an adult it flies in the air using wings.
fact_tl: Ang nymph ng tutubi ay nabubuhay sa ilalim ng tubig, at kapag hingkod na ito ay lumilipad sa hangin gamit ang pakpak.
fact_bis: Ang nymph sa tabanog magpuyo sa ilawom sa tubig, ug kon mahamtong na kini molupad sa hangin gamit ang mga pako.

q: How many official constellations are recognized by astronomers across the whole sky?
explanation: There are 88 official constellations recognized by astronomers across the whole sky.
fact_tl: May 88 opisyal na konstelasyon na kinikilala ng mga astronomo sa buong langit.
fact_bis: Adunay 88 ka opisyal nga konstelasyon nga giila sa mga astronomo sa tibuok langit.

q: How many oxygen atoms make up one molecule of ozone?
options: Three oxygen atoms (O3)
Two oxygen atoms (O2)
Four oxygen atoms (O4)
One oxygen atom (O1)
explanation: The chemical formula of ozone is O3, meaning it is made of three oxygen atoms.
fact_tl: Ang pormula ng kemikal ng ozone (ozono) ay O3, tatlong atomo ng oksiheno.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa ozone (ozono) kay O3, tulo ka atomo sa oksiheno.

q: Why are oil and coal called "fossil fuels"?
options: They come from the remains of plants and animals that lived millions of years ago
They are found in rocks that look like animal fossils
They release fossilized energy stored from the Big Bang
They are mined from the same layer of rock where dinosaur bones are found
explanation: Oil and coal are called fossil fuels because they come from the remains of plants and animals that lived millions of years ago.
fact_tl: Ang langis at uling ay tinatawag na fossil fuel dahil galing ito sa labi ng mga halaman at hayop na nabuhay milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang petrolyo ug karbon gitawag og fossil fuel kay naggikan kini sa labi sa mga tanom ug mananap nga nabuhi minilyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: How do cleaner shrimp and fish help each other in the ocean?
options: The shrimp eat parasites off the fish's skin, so both the shrimp and the fish benefit
The shrimp hide the fish from predators in exchange for food scraps
The fish carry the shrimp to new feeding areas in return for cleaning
The shrimp fan the fish with their antennae to help them breathe
explanation: Cleaner shrimp eat the parasites off a fish's skin, so both the shrimp and the fish benefit — a classic example of mutualism.
fact_tl: May uri ng hipon na naglilinis na kumakain ng mga parasito sa balat ng isda, kaya pareho silang nakikinabang.
fact_bis: Adunay matang sa hipon nga tiglimpyo nga mokaon sa mga parasito sa panit sa isda, busa silang duha makabenepisyo.

q: In a car's steering system, what does a rack and pinion do?
options: It converts the rotation of the steering wheel into straight side-to-side movement of the front wheels
It locks the steering wheel in place when the car is parked
It multiplies the engine force to make turning easier on steep hills
It converts the straight push of the brake pedal into a spinning motion
explanation: A rack and pinion system converts the rotation of the steering wheel into the straight side-to-side movement of the front wheels.
fact_tl: Ang rack at pinion ay ginagamit sa mga sistema ng pagtutusok ng sasakyan para baguhin ang pag-ikot ng manibela tungo sa tuwid na galaw ng mga gulong sa harap.
fact_bis: Ang rack ug pinion gigamit sa sistema sa pagtultol sa sasakyan aron baguhin ang pag-ikot sa manibela ngadto sa tuwid nga kilid-kilid nga paglihok sa mga gulong sa atubangan.

q: What do some parrotfish do before sleeping to protect themselves from predators?
options: They spin a transparent mucus cocoon around their body that hides their scent
They bury themselves in the sand so they are invisible
They change color to match their surroundings in the dark
They group together with other fish so predators cannot pick one target
explanation: Before sleeping, some parrotfish spin a transparent mucus cocoon around their body — like a sleeping bag that hides their scent from nighttime predators.
fact_tl: Bago matulog, ang ilang parrotfish ay nagtatayo ng transparenteng kapsula ng uhog sa paligid ng kanilang katawan — parang kumot na nagtatago ng kanilang amoy mula sa mga mandaragit sa gabi.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa matulog, ang pipila ka parrotfish nagtukod og transparent nga uhog nga kapsula sa palibot sa ilang lawas — morag higdaanan nga nagtago sa ilang amoy gikan sa mga mandaragit sa gabii.

q: Why do electric heaters, irons, and toasters warm up when plugged in?
options: When electric current passes through a material with resistance, some energy turns into heat
Electric current always flows faster in appliances, creating friction that heats the air
The metal in these appliances absorbs light and converts it to heat
These devices store heat from the outlet and release it slowly
explanation: When current passes through a material with resistance, some energy turns into heat — which is why heaters, irons, and toasters warm up.
fact_tl: Kapag dumaan ang current sa isang materyal na may resistance, bahagi ng enerhiya ay nagiging init, kaya umiinit ang mga heater, plantsa, at toaster.
fact_bis: Kung moagi ang current sa usa ka materyal nga adunay resistance, ang ubang enerhiya mahimong init, mao nga moinit ang mga heater, plantsa, ug toaster.

q: Which geological era is called the "Age of Dinosaurs"?
options: The Mesozoic Era
The Paleozoic Era
The Cenozoic Era
The Precambrian Era
explanation: The Mesozoic Era is called the "Age of Dinosaurs" because that is when dinosaurs lived.
fact_tl: Ang Mesozoic Era ang tinatawag na "Age of Dinosaurs" dahil ito ang panahong namuhay ang mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang Mesozoic Era gitawag nga "Age of Dinosaurs" tungod kay mao kini ang panahon nga nabuhi ang mga dinosaur.

q: In which region of the Philippines is the province of Apayao located?
options: Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR)
Ilocos Region
Cagayan Valley
Central Luzon
explanation: Apayao is a province in the Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR) in Luzon, with its capital in Kabugao.
fact_tl: Ang Apayao ay isang lalawigan (probinsya) ng Pilipinas sa rehiyon ng Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR), na bahagi ng Luzon. Ang kabisera nito ay Kabugao.
fact_bis: Ang Apayao usa ka probinsya (lalawigan) sa Pilipinas sa rehiyon sa Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR), nga bahin sa Luzon. Ang kaulohan niini mao ang Kabugao.

q: Where are stomata found on a leaf, and what gases pass through them?
options: On the underside of a leaf; carbon dioxide enters and oxygen leaves
On the top surface of a leaf; oxygen enters and carbon dioxide leaves
Inside the stem; water vapor enters and carbon dioxide leaves
Along the leaf edges; nitrogen enters and oxygen leaves
explanation: Stomata are tiny holes on the underside of a leaf through which carbon dioxide enters and oxygen exits during photosynthesis.
fact_tl: May maliliit na butas sa ilalim ng dahon na tinatawag na stomata; dito pumapasok ang carbon dioxide at lumalabas ang oxygen.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga mga lungag sa ilalom sa dahon nga gitawag og stomata; diri mosulod ang carbon dioxide ug mogawas ang oxygen.

q: Which type of radiation sits just beyond red light and has a longer wavelength than visible light?
options: Infrared
Ultraviolet
X-rays
Microwaves
explanation: Infrared is the band just beyond red light on the electromagnetic spectrum, with a longer wavelength than visible light.
fact_tl: Ang infrared ang banda na nasa labas ng pulang liwanag, na may mas mahabang wavelength kaysa visible light.
fact_bis: Ang infrared mao ang banda nga naa dapit sa pula nga kahayag, nga adunay mas taas nga wavelength kaysa visible light.

q: What is the capital city of Zamboanga del Sur?
options: Pagadian City
Zamboanga City
Dipolog City
Ozamiz City
explanation: The capital of Zamboanga del Sur is Pagadian City.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng Zamboanga del Sur ay ang Pagadian City.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa Zamboanga del Sur mao ang Pagadian City.

q: To find how many miles away lightning struck, you count 10 seconds between the flash and the thunder. How far away was the lightning?
options: 2 miles
5 miles
10 miles
50 miles
explanation: Divide the number of seconds between lightning and thunder by 5 to get the distance in miles — 10 divided by 5 equals 2 miles.
fact_tl: Para sa layo sa milya, hatiin sa 5 ang bilang ng segundo sa pagitan ng kidlat at kulog.
fact_bis: Para sa gilay-on sa milya, bahina sa 5 ang gidaghanon sa mga segundo tali sa kilat ug dalugdog.

q: How can new ginger plants grow even without seeds?
options: New plants sprout from the buds on a ginger rhizome
New plants grow from fallen ginger leaves placed in soil
Ginger releases spores that grow into new plants
Ginger roots split in half to produce two new plants
explanation: New plants grow from the buds on a ginger rhizome, so ginger can reproduce without seeds.
fact_tl: Mula sa mga usbong (buds) sa rhizome ng luya ay tumutubo ang bagong halaman, kaya pwede itong itanim kahit walang buto.
fact_bis: Gikan sa mga usbong sa rhizome sa luy-a motubo ang bag-ong tanom, mao nga matanom kini bisan walay liso.

q: How many elements are listed in the periodic table today?
explanation: There are 118 elements in the periodic table today.
fact_tl: May 118 na elemento sa periodic table sa kasalukuyan.
fact_bis: Adunay 118 ka elemento sa periodic table karon.

q: Which ocean is the largest in the world?
options: Pacific Ocean
Atlantic Ocean
Indian Ocean
Arctic Ocean
explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world, covering about 165 million square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking karagatan sa mundo ay ang Pacific Ocean (Karagatang Pasipiko), na sumasakop ng mga 165 milyong kilometro kuwadrado.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga kadagatan sa kalibotan mao ang Pacific Ocean, nga naglangkob ug mga 165 ka milyon ka kilometro kuwadrado.

q: In which mountain ranges does the Cagayan River begin?
options: The Caraballo and Sierra Madre mountains
The Cordillera Central and Mount Apo
The Zambales and Bukidnon mountain ranges
The Kitanglad Range and Mount Halcon
explanation: The Cagayan River rises in the Caraballo and Sierra Madre mountains.
fact_tl: Ang Ilog Cagayan ay nagmumula sa mga bundok ng Caraballo at Sierra Madre.
fact_bis: Ang Suba sa Cagayan nagsugod sa kabukiran sa Caraballo ug Sierra Madre.

q: Why does a tight lid on a thermos help keep a hot drink warm longer?
options: It stops hot steam and warm air from escaping
It reflects heat back into the liquid
It creates a vacuum that produces heat
It turns hot liquid into a solid to trap energy
explanation: A tight thermos lid stops hot steam and warm air from escaping, so the heat lasts longer inside.
fact_tl: Ang masikip na takip ng thermos ay pumipigil sa mainit na singaw na makatakas, kaya mas tumatagal ang init.
fact_bis: Ang hugot nga taklob sa thermos nagpugong sa init nga alisngaw nga makaikyas, busa mas dugay ang kainit.

q: Which blood vessel is the largest artery in the human body and connects directly to the heart's left ventricle?
options: The aorta
The pulmonary artery
The jugular vein
The femoral artery
explanation: The aorta is the body's largest artery, connecting directly to the left ventricle and carrying oxygenated blood to the rest of the body.
fact_tl: Ang aorta ay ang pinakamalaking arterya sa katawan; ito ay direktang nakakonekta sa kaliwang ventricle ng puso at nagdadala ng oxygenated na dugo sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang aorta mao ang pinakadakong arterya sa lawas, direktang nakakonekta sa kaliwang ventricle ug nagdala sa oxygenated nga dugo sa tibuok lawas.

q: How do a duck's webbed feet help it move through water?
options: They push water backward so the duck moves forward
They grip the water to pull the duck forward
They float like life preservers to keep the duck up
They splash water sideways to steer left and right
explanation: A duck's webbed feet work like paddles, pushing water backward so the duck moves forward.
fact_tl: Ang lambat na paa ng bibe ay parang sagwan na nagtutulak ng tubig pabalik para makausad ito sa unahan.
fact_bis: Ang lambat nga tiil sa bibe sama sa bugsay nga nagduot sa tubig paatras aron mopadayon ang bibe sa unahan.

q: How does an emu get around if it cannot fly?
options: It runs very fast using its long legs
It swims using its strong wings like flippers
It hops great distances using its tail for balance
It glides downhill using its large body as a sail
explanation: The emu cannot fly, but it runs very fast using its long legs.
fact_tl: Hindi makalipad ang emu, ngunit napakabilis nitong tumakbo gamit ang mahaba nitong mga binti.
fact_bis: Ang emu dili makalupad, apan paspas kaayo kini modagan gamit ang taas niini nga mga tiil.

q: Compared to the common house lizard, the tokay gecko is _____.
options: Bigger and longer
Smaller and thinner
About the same size
Shorter but wider
explanation: The tokay gecko is bigger and longer than the common little house lizard.
fact_tl: Ang tuko ay mas malaki at mas mahaba kaysa karaniwang butiki sa bahay.
fact_bis: Ang tuko mas dako ug mas taas kay sa ordinaryong gamayng tiki sa balay.

q: Why does okra help keep your digestion smooth?
options: It is rich in fiber, which helps food move easily in your tummy
It has a lot of Vitamin C that destroys harmful bacteria in the gut
It contains oil that lubricates the walls of the intestines
It is full of protein that strengthens the muscles of the stomach
explanation: Okra is rich in fiber, which helps food move and break down easily in the digestive system.
fact_tl: Ang okra ay mayaman sa hibla (fiber) na tumutulong sa madaling pagtunaw ng pagkain sa ating tiyan. Kaya nakakatulong ito para hindi tayo mahirapang dumumi.
fact_bis: Ang okra dato sa fiber nga makatabang sa sayon nga pagtunaw sa pagkaon sa atong tiyan. Mao nga makatabang kini aron dili kita maglisod sa pagkalibang.

q: What do rusting and burning have in common, and how are they different?
options: Both are types of oxidation, but rusting is very slow and has no flame
Both release flames, but rusting takes longer to complete
Both are chemical changes, but burning needs water while rusting needs air
Both produce the same product, but rusting is caused by sunlight
explanation: Rusting and burning are both kinds of oxidation, but rusting is very slow and produces no flame.
fact_tl: Ang pagkakalawang at pagkasunog ay parehong uri ng oksidasyon, pero ang kalawang ay napakabagal at walang apoy.
fact_bis: Ang pagkalawang ug pagkasunog parehong klase sa oksidasyon, apan ang kalawang hinay kaayo ug walay kalayo.

q: Why can clothes made of cotton or silk easily be dyed bright colors?
options: Natural fibers soak up dye like a sponge, absorbing the color deeply
Synthetic chemicals bond better with natural fabrics than artificial ones
The tight weave of cotton traps the dye permanently inside the cloth
Cotton and silk produce their own pigments when exposed to light
explanation: Natural fibers like cotton and silk soak up dye easily, allowing the cloth to take on many bright colors from plant or chemical dyes.
fact_tl: Madaling kulayan ang natural fibers dahil sumisipsip sila ng tina. Inilulubog ang tela sa kulay galing sa halaman o kemikal, at humihigop ang himaymay nito ng kulay. Kaya makukulay ang mga damit na gawa sa cotton o silk.
fact_bis: Sayon koloran ang natural fibers kay mosuyop sila ug tina. Ituslob ang panapton sa kolor gikan sa tanom o kemikal, ug mosuyop ang himaymay sa kolor. Mao nga mahimong daghang kolor ang sinina nga hinimo sa cotton o silk.

q: Who created the first vaccine against rabies, and in what year?
options: Louis Pasteur in 1885
Alexander Fleming in 1928
Edward Jenner in 1796
Marie Curie in 1903
explanation: Louis Pasteur created the first vaccine against rabies in 1885.
fact_tl: Si Louis Pasteur ang gumawa ng unang bakuna laban sa rabies noong 1885.
fact_bis: Si Louis Pasteur ang naghimo sa unang bakuna batok sa rabies niadtong 1885.

q: What happens during a partial solar eclipse?
options: The Moon covers only part of the Sun, making it look like a bite was taken out
The Moon completely blocks the Sun, turning day into temporary darkness
The Earth's shadow falls on the Moon, making it look reddish
The Sun appears larger than usual because the Moon is far away
explanation: In a partial solar eclipse, the Moon covers only part of the Sun, so it looks like a bite is taken out of the Sun.
fact_tl: Sa partial solar eclipse, bahagi lamang ng Araw ang natatakpan ng Buwan, kaya parang may kinagat sa gilid nito.
fact_bis: Sa partial solar eclipse, bahin lang sa Adlaw ang matabonan sa Bulan, mao nga morag adunay napaak sa kilid niini.

q: What is the main difference between a wet cough and a dry cough?
options: A wet cough brings up mucus, while a dry cough has no phlegm
A wet cough is caused by allergies, while a dry cough is caused by infection
A wet cough is dangerous, while a dry cough is always harmless
A wet cough is loud, while a dry cough is quiet and gentle
explanation: A wet cough brings up mucus, while a dry cough produces no phlegm.
fact_tl: May ubong may plema na naglalabas ng uhog at may tuyong ubo na walang lumalabas na plema.
fact_bis: Adunay ubo nga may plema nga mogawas ang uhog ug adunay uga nga ubo nga walay plema.

q: Why can cockroaches survive in so many different places?
options: They can eat almost anything, including food scraps, paper, glue, and soap
They have thick shells that protect them from heat, cold, and chemicals
They can go months without water by absorbing moisture from the air
They reproduce so fast that new generations replace any that die
explanation: A cockroach can live almost anywhere because it eats almost anything — leftover food, paper, glue, and even soap.
fact_tl: Nabubuhay ang ipis kahit saan dahil halos lahat ng bagay ay kinakain nito—mga tirang pagkain, papel, pandikit (glue), at kahit sabon.
fact_bis: Mabuhi ang ipis bisan asa tungod kay halos tanang butang gikaon niini—salin nga pagkaon, papel, pandikit (glue), ug bisan sabon.

q: What happens inside your body when you eat carbohydrates like rice and bread?
options: They break down into glucose, which raises blood sugar
They turn into fat and are stored directly in the liver
They combine with protein to build new muscle cells
They are converted into vitamins that the body uses for energy
explanation: Carbohydrates like rice and bread break down inside the body into glucose, which raises blood sugar.
fact_tl: Ang mga karbohidrato tulad ng kanin at tinapay ay nadudurog sa loob ng katawan at nagiging glucose na nagpapataas ng asukal sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang mga carbohydrates sama sa kan-on ug pan madugmok sulod sa lawas ug mahimong glucose nga magpataas sa asukal sa dugo.

q: What can cause a compass to give a wrong direction reading?
options: A magnet or iron object placed nearby
High temperature in the surrounding area
Strong sunlight shining directly on the compass
Humidity or moisture in the air around it
explanation: A compass can give a wrong reading if there is a magnet or iron object nearby, which disrupts its needle.
fact_tl: Maaaring magkamali ang kompas kung may magneto o bakal na malapit dito.
fact_bis: Ang compass mahimong masayop kung adunay magnet o puthaw nga duol niini.

q: Why is a little vinegar added when making nata de coco?
options: The acidity helps nata-making bacteria thrive while keeping harmful microbes away
The vinegar adds flavor and makes the nata firmer and thicker
Vinegar provides nutrients that the nata bacteria need to grow quickly
The acid preserves the coconut water and prevents it from rotting
explanation: The slight acidity from vinegar is preferred by nata-making bacteria but discourages harmful microbes, keeping the growing environment clean.
fact_tl: Dinadagdagan ng kaunting suka ang timpla para gawing bahagyang maasim ito. Ang asim na ito ay paborito ng bakteryang gumagawa ng nata pero ayaw ng ibang masamang mikrobyo, kaya nananatiling malinis at ligtas ang pinagtutubuan ng nata.
fact_bis: Dugangan ug gamay nga suka ang sagol aron mahimo kining medyo aslom. Kini nga kaaslom paborito sa bakterya nga naghimo sa nata apan dili gusto sa ubang daotang mikrobyo, mao nga magpabilin nga limpyo ug luwas ang gitubuan sa nata.

q: What type of body symmetry do adult sea stars, sea urchins, and sea cucumbers share?
options: Five-fold radial symmetry
Bilateral symmetry like humans
Two-fold symmetry like a butterfly
No symmetry — they are irregular in shape
explanation: All echinoderms have five-fold radial symmetry as adults, though their larvae are bilaterally symmetric.
fact_tl: Ang lahat ng echinoderm (sea star, sea urchin, sea cucumber) ay may limang-direksyong radial symmetry bilang adulto — ngunit ang kanilang larvae ay bilateral symmetric, katulad ng ating sarili.
fact_bis: Ang tanan nga echinoderm (sea star, sea urchin, sea cucumber) adunay limang direksyon nga radial symmetry isip mga hamtong — apan ang ilang mga larva bilateral symmetric, sama kanatong mga tawo.

q: What causes hot springs and geysers to form?
options: Underground water heated by hot rock near magma rises to the surface
Rainwater is trapped in deep caves and slowly boils from sunlight
Ocean water seeps underground and is compressed until it becomes hot
Volcanic ash mixes with groundwater to create a chemical heating reaction
explanation: Hot springs and geysers form where underground water is heated by hot rock near magma, causing it to rise or burst upward as steam and water.
fact_tl: Ang mainit na bukal at geyser ay lumalabas kapag ang tubig sa ilalim ng lupa ay napainit ng mainit na bato malapit sa magma, kaya umaakyat itong mainit o pumupulandit pataas bilang singaw at tubig.
fact_bis: Ang init nga tuburan ug geyser motungha kon ang tubig ilalom sa yuta mainit tungod sa init nga bato duol sa magma, mao nga mosaka kini nga init o mobuto pataas isip alisngaw ug tubig.

q: The marang is a fruit from Mindanao. Which fruits is it related to?
options: Jackfruit and breadfruit
Mango and guava
Papaya and pineapple
Durian and rambutan
explanation: The marang is a Mindanao fruit related to the jackfruit and breadfruit.
fact_tl: Ang marang ay isang prutas ng Mindanao na kamag-anak ng langka at rimas.
fact_bis: Ang marang usa ka prutas sa Mindanao nga paryente sa nangka ug rimas.

q: Why does the flying lemur (colugo) have a very long intestine?
options: To have enough time to fully digest tough leaves
To store large amounts of water during dry seasons
To absorb more fat from the insects it eats
To filter out toxins from the poisonous fruits it consumes
explanation: The flying lemur has a very long intestine so there is enough time to fully digest the tough leaves it eats.
fact_tl: May napakahabang bituka ang kagwang para magkaroon ng sapat na oras na tunawin nang husto ang matigas na dahon.
fact_bis: Ang kagwang adunay taas kaayo nga tinai aron adunay igong panahon sa hingpit nga pagtunaw sa gahi nga dahon.

q: When do the strongest tides (spring tides) occur?
options: At new moon and full moon when the Sun and Moon line up
At quarter moon when the Sun and Moon pull in different directions
During a solar eclipse when the Moon blocks the Sun
During equinoxes when the Earth is closest to the Sun
explanation: At new and full moon the Sun and Moon line up, creating the strongest spring tides; at quarter moon the tides are weaker neap tides.
fact_tl: Tuwing bagong buwan at kabilugan, magkahanay ang araw at buwan kaya pinakamalakas ang taog (spring tide); kapag nasa kalahati ang buwan, mas mahina ito (neap tide).
fact_bis: Sa bag-ong bulan ug takdol, naghan-ay ang adlaw ug bulan mao nga pinakakusog ang taob (spring tide); sa katunga nga bulan, mas huyang kini (neap tide).

q: Why is there only a fixed, limited number of natural elements?
options: Elements cannot be broken down or easily made, so nature has only a set number of them
Elements are created by stars but most are destroyed before reaching Earth
Scientists have decided to limit the number of elements to make chemistry easier
New elements form constantly but most are too unstable to be counted
explanation: Because elements cannot be broken down or easily made, there is only a fixed set of natural elements that form the foundation of all matter.
fact_tl: Dahil hindi mahahati o basta-basta nagagawa ang mga elemento, may tiyak lang na bilang ng natural na elemento. Sila ang limitadong pundasyon ng lahat ng bagay sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Tungod kay ang mga elemento dili mabahin o sayon nga himoon, adunay piho ra nga gidaghanon sa natural nga elemento. Sila ang limitado nga pundasyon sa tanan sa kinaiyahan.

q: A slow, very heavy truck is moving down a road. Which statement about its momentum is correct?
options: It can still have large momentum because mass matters just as much as speed
It has almost no momentum because it is moving slowly
Its momentum equals zero since it will stop soon
Only fast objects have momentum, so the truck has none
explanation: Mass is just as important as speed for momentum, so a slow but very heavy object can still have large momentum.
fact_tl: Maling akala ng iba na ang bilis lang ang mahalaga sa momentum. Sa totoo, ang masa ay kasing-halaga din, kaya ang mabagal pero napakabigat na bagay ay pwedeng magkaroon ng malaking momentum.
fact_bis: Sayop ang panghunahuna sa uban nga ang katulin lang ang importante sa momentum. Sa tinuod, ang masa parehas usab ka importante, mao nga ang hinay apan bug-at kaayo nga butang mahimo gihapong adunay dakong momentum.

q: How is a sea turtle different from a land tortoise when it comes to its shell?
options: A sea turtle cannot pull its head and legs into its shell the way a tortoise can
A sea turtle has a softer shell because it lives in the water
A sea turtle has no shell at all — its thick skin protects it instead
A sea turtle can only pull in its head, not its flippers
explanation: A sea turtle cannot pull its head and legs into its shell the way a land tortoise can; instead, its body is built for fast swimming with wide flippers.
fact_tl: Hindi kayang ipasok ng pawikan ang ulo at mga paa nito sa loob ng talukab gaya ng pagong sa lupa. Sa halip, ang katawan nito ay hinubog para sa mabilis na paglangoy gamit ang malalapad na palikpik.
fact_bis: Dili masulod sa pawikan ang iyang ulo ug tiil sa sulod sa talukab sama sa baw sa yuta. Hinuon, ang lawas niini gihimo alang sa paspas nga paglangoy gamit ang lapad nga mga palikpik.

q: What lies beneath the skin of a sea star or sea urchin and acts as its skeleton?
options: Tiny hard plates made of calcium
A flexible cartilage frame like sharks have
Layers of compacted muscle tissue
A network of tough collagen fibers
explanation: Beneath an echinoderm's skin are tiny hard calcium plates called ossicles that act as an internal skeleton.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng balat ng echinoderm ay may maliliit na matitigas na plaka na gawa sa apog na nagsisilbing panloob na kalansay.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa panit sa echinoderm adunay gagmay nga gahi nga mga plaka nga hinimo sa apog nga nagsilbing sulod nga kalansay.

q: How is yogurt made from milk?
options: Good bacteria sour and thicken the milk, turning it into yogurt
Milk is boiled until most of the water evaporates and it becomes thick
Special fungi break down the milk sugars and add the sour flavor
Milk is frozen, then slowly melted to change its texture and taste
explanation: Good bacteria are used to turn milk into yogurt by souring and thickening it — not all bacteria make us sick.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bacteria ay nakakasakit — may mga mabuting bacteria na ginagamit para gawing yogurt ang gatas sa pamamagitan ng pagpapaasim at pagpapakapal nito.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga bacteria makapasakit — adunay maayong bacteria nga gigamit aron himoong yogurt ang gatas pinaagi sa pagpaaslom ug pagpalagom niini.

q: What happens when an acid and a base are mixed in the right amounts?
options: They cancel each other out (neutralization) and form a salt and water
They explode and release a large amount of heat energy
They combine to form a stronger acid called a super-acid
The acid dissolves the base and the liquid becomes more acidic
explanation: When an acid and a base are mixed in the right amounts, they neutralize each other and form a salt and water.
fact_tl: Kapag pinaghalo ang isang acid at isang base sa tamang dami, kinakansela nila ang isa't isa (neutralization) at bumubuo ng asin at tubig — kaya hindi na ito masyadong acid o base.
fact_bis: Kon sagolon ang usa ka acid ug usa ka base sa saktong gidaghanon, magkanselahay sila (neutralization) ug maghimog asin ug tubig — busa dili na kini kaayo acid o base.

q: Why is stepping on a scorpionfish dangerous?
options: It stays hidden on the seafloor, and its spines stab the foot of anyone who steps on it
It leaps out of the water and bites ankles when disturbed
It releases a cloud of poison ink to blind attackers nearby
It camouflages in sand and then grabs the foot with its claws
explanation: Because the scorpionfish stays hidden on the seafloor, people often accidentally step on it and its venomous spines stab the foot.
fact_tl: Madalas matapakan ang scorpionfish dahil nakatago ito, at ang tinik nito ay tumutusok sa paa.
fact_bis: Tungod kay nagtago ang scorpionfish, kasagaran matumban kini ug ang tunok niini motusok sa tiil.

q: What formed inside the crater of Mount Pinatubo after it erupted?
options: A lake that tourists now visit
A lava dome that continues to glow at night
A deep cave filled with volcanic ash
A new smaller volcano that grew over time
explanation: After Pinatubo erupted, a lake formed inside its crater that tourists now visit.
