fact_tl: Pagkatapos pumutok ng Pinatubo, isang lawa ang nabuo sa bunganga nito na ngayon ay tinitignan ng mga turista.
fact_bis: Human miputok ang Pinatubo, usa ka lanaw ang naporma sa bunganga niini nga karon ginabisita sa mga turista.

q: Which activity is a good example of neighbors working together for the community?
options: A clean-up drive where people gather to pick up trash along a street or shoreline
A school science fair where only students compete for individual prizes
A government road project planned and paid for by the city alone
A family picnic held privately in a park on a holiday
explanation: A clean-up drive is a clear example of community cooperation — a small task that becomes a big help when many neighbors join together.
fact_tl: Isang malinaw na halimbawa ay ang clean-up drive: nagkikita-kita ang mga kapitbahay para mamulot ng basura sa kalsada o baybayin—isang maliit na gawain na malaking tulong kapag marami ang sumali.
fact_bis: Usa ka klaro nga pananglitan mao ang clean-up drive: magtapok ang mga silingan aron mamunit og basura sa dalan o baybayon—gamay nga buluhaton nga dako ang tabang kung daghan moapil.

q: What do you find inside a single jackfruit?
options: Many separate yellow pods that can be pulled apart
One large solid seed surrounded by sweet juice
A hollow space filled with a milky liquid
Hundreds of tiny seeds embedded in a dry pulp
explanation: A single jackfruit holds many little yellow pods inside that can be pulled apart.
fact_tl: Ang isang langka ay may napakaraming maliliit na dilaw na bahagi sa loob na pwedeng hatiin.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka nangka adunay daghang gagmay nga dalag nga bahin sa sulod nga mahimong bulagon.

q: What type of tree is the yakal, and where does it grow?
options: It is a dipterocarp, one of the tall trees that make up Philippine rainforests
It is a mangrove tree that grows along Philippine coastlines and riverbanks
It is a fruit tree cultivated in Philippine lowland farms
It is a bamboo species found in the highlands of the Philippines
explanation: The yakal is a dipterocarp, one of the tall trees that make up Philippine rainforests.
fact_tl: Ang yakal ay isa sa mga dipterocarp, ang malalaking punong bumubuo sa kagubatan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang yakal usa sa mga dipterocarp, ang tag-as nga mga punoan nga naghimo sa lasang sa Pilipinas.

q: What is the chemical symbol for hydrogen, and what is its atomic number?
options: Symbol H, atomic number 1
Symbol Hy, atomic number 2
Symbol H2, atomic number 1
Symbol He, atomic number 1
explanation: The symbol for hydrogen is H; it is the lightest element and has atomic number 1.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng haydroheno ay H, ito ang pinakamagaan na elemento at may atomic number na 1.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa hydrogen mao ang H; kini ang pinakagaan nga elemento ug adunay atomic number nga 1.

q: Why is it hard for prey to escape once caught by a moray eel?
options: Its teeth point inward and backward, making escape very difficult
Its jaws lock shut and cannot open again until the prey is swallowed
It wraps its long body around prey to squeeze it tightly
It injects venom that paralyzes the prey immediately
explanation: The sharp teeth of a moray eel point inward and backward, making it very hard for caught prey to escape.
fact_tl: Nakaturo papaloob at paatras ang matatalas na ngipin ng moray eel kaya napakahirap nang makatakas ng anumang nahuli nito.
fact_bis: Ang hait nga ngipon sa moray eel nagaturo paingon sa sulod ug paatras, mao nga lisod kaayo nga makaikyas ang bisan unsang madakpan niini.

q: How does a trumpet produce sound?
options: The player vibrates their lips against the mouthpiece, which sets the air column inside the tube vibrating
The player blows air across an opening, and the edge splits the air to create vibrations
The player presses valves that strike metal reeds, producing musical tones
The player's breath pushes a thin membrane that vibrates inside the bell
explanation: A trumpet makes sound when the player vibrates their lips against the mouthpiece, and those vibrating lips set the air column inside the tube vibrating.
fact_tl: Ang trumpeta ay gumagawa ng tunog kapag ang manlalaro ay nagvivibrate ang kanyang mga labi sa mouthpiece — ang vibrating lips ay nagdudulot ng vibration ng air column sa loob ng tubo.
fact_bis: Ang trompeta nagahimo og tunog kung ang nagtogtog nagpalihok sa iyang mga ngabil batok sa mouthpiece — ang nagalingkod nga mga ngabil nagpalihok sa air column sa sulod sa tubo.

q: Which river carries more water than any other river in the world?
options: The Amazon River
The Nile River
The Mississippi River
The Yangtze River
explanation: The Amazon River is the largest river in the world by the amount of water it carries.
fact_tl: Ang Amazon River ang pinakamalaking ilog sa mundo pagdating sa dami ng tubig na dinadala nito.
fact_bis: Ang Amazon River mao ang pinakadako nga suba sa kalibutan kon bahin sa gidaghanon sa tubig nga gidala niini.

q: About how much of the air is carbon dioxide, and why does it matter even in such a small amount?
options: About 0.04% (around 420 ppm), and it traps the sun's heat in our atmosphere
About 21%, and it is what humans breathe in to stay alive
About 4%, and it helps plants grow but is harmless in large amounts
About 78%, and it is the most abundant gas driving the greenhouse effect
explanation: Carbon dioxide makes up about 0.04% (around 420 ppm) of air, but even this tiny fraction plays a vital role in trapping heat through the greenhouse effect.
fact_tl: Ang carbon dioxide ay bumubuo ng halos 0.04 porsyento (tungkol sa 420 bahagi sa isang milyong) ng hangin. Kahit maliit ito, mahalaga ang papel nito sa pag-iipon ng init ng araw sa ating atmospera (greenhouse effect).
fact_bis: Ang carbon dioxide nagbuhat og mga 0.04 porsyento (mga 420 bahagi sa usa ka milyon) sa hangin. Bisan gagmay kini, adunay mahalaga siyang papel sa pag-ipon sa init sa adlaw sa atong atmospera (greenhouse effect).

q: How many legs does a scorpion have, and why?
options: Eight legs, because it is an arachnid like the spider
Six legs, because it is a type of insect
Ten legs, because it is related to crabs and shrimp
Four legs, because it uses its pincers instead of front legs
explanation: A scorpion has eight legs because it is an arachnid, the same group that includes spiders.
fact_tl: Ang alakdan (scorpion) ay may walong (8) paa, dahil ito ay arachnid tulad ng gagamba.
fact_bis: Ang tanga (scorpion) adunay walo (8) ka tiil, kay arachnid kini sama sa lawa-lawa.

q: What happens after your baby (milk) teeth fall out?
options: Permanent teeth grow in to last for the rest of your life
A second set of milk teeth grows in before the permanent teeth appear
The gums harden and become as strong as teeth without new ones growing
New teeth grow in every ten years to replace worn-out ones
explanation: After the milk teeth fall out, permanent teeth grow in to last for the rest of our lives.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos malaglag ang gatas na ngipin, tumutubo ang permanenteng ngipin na pamalit sa habambuhay.
fact_bis: Human matangtang ang gatas nga ngipon, motubo ang permanente nga ngipon nga magpabilin sa tibuok kinabuhi.

q: How does a pearl form inside an oyster?
options: An irritant enters the oyster and is coated with layers of nacre over time
The oyster grows a pearl from nutrients in the seawater as it ages
Sand crystals inside the oyster slowly fuse together into a round ball
The oyster secretes a hard shell around a bubble of trapped air
explanation: A pearl forms when an irritant enters an oyster and the oyster coats it with thin layers of nacre (mother-of-pearl) over time.
fact_tl: Ang perla ay nabubuo kapag ang isang patak ng irritant (tulad ng butil ng buhangin o parasito) ay nakapasok sa loob ng talaba — tumutugon ang talaba sa pamamagitan ng pag-bibilot nito ng mga manipis na layer ng nacre (mother-of-pearl) sa paligid ng irritant.
fact_bis: Ang perla naporma sa dihang ang usa ka irritant (sama sa usa ka butil sa balas o parasito) mosulod sa sulod sa usa ka talaba — ang talaba nagtubag pinaagi sa paglibot niini og nipis nga mga layer sa nacre (mother-of-pearl) sa palibot sa irritant.

q: What causes the aurora borealis (Northern Lights) and aurora australis (Southern Lights)?
options: Charged particles from the solar wind collide with gases in Earth's atmosphere near the magnetic poles
Sunlight is reflected off ice crystals in the upper atmosphere near the poles
The Earth's magnetic field bends sunlight into colorful bands near the poles
Lightning storms in the upper atmosphere release colored light near polar regions
explanation: Auroras occur when charged particles from the solar wind collide with gases in Earth's atmosphere near Earth's magnetic poles.
fact_tl: Ang aurora borealis (Northern Lights) at aurora australis (Southern Lights) ay mga makukulay na ilaw sa kalangitan malapit sa magnetic poles ng Earth; ito ay nangyayari kapag ang mga charged particles mula sa solar wind ay nakikipagtunggali sa mga gas sa atmosphere ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang aurora borealis (Northern Lights) ug aurora australis (Southern Lights) mga makulorab nga suga sa kalangitan duol sa magnetic poles sa Yuta; mahitabo kini sa dihang ang mga charged particles gikan sa solar wind makabanggaan sa mga gas sa atmosphere sa Yuta.

q: What is PHIVOLCS and what does it do?
options: A Philippine government agency that monitors volcanoes and earthquakes and warns people
A Philippine weather bureau that tracks typhoons and issues storm warnings
A government department that maps Philippine mountains and forests
A research center that studies ocean currents around the Philippines
explanation: PHIVOLCS is the Philippine government agency that watches volcanoes and earthquakes and warns people of danger.
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS ang ahensya ng gobyerno ng Pilipinas na nagbabantay sa mga bulkan at lindol at nagbibigay ng babala sa mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang PHIVOLCS mao ang ahensya sa gobyerno sa Pilipinas nga nagbantay sa mga bulkan ug linog ug naghatag og pasidaan sa mga tawo.

q: Which statement about asthma is true?
options: Asthma has no cure yet, but it can be controlled with medicine and by avoiding triggers.
Asthma is fully cured by taking medicine for one month.
Asthma disappears on its own when a child turns 12 years old.
Asthma is caused by eating too much sugar and goes away with a strict diet.
explanation: Asthma has no cure yet, but with the right medicine and by avoiding triggers, a child with asthma can live a normal life.
fact_tl: Wala pang lunas sa hika, ngunit sa tamang gamot at pag-iwas sa mga sanhi, maaaring makontrol ito upang makapamuhay nang normal ang isang bata.
fact_bis: Wala pay tambal nga makaayo sa hubak, apan pinaagi sa hustong tambal ug paglikay sa mga hinungdan, makontrol kini aron makapuyo og normal ang bata.

q: How do orchids get water and nutrients when they are not planted in soil?
options: Their aerial roots hang in the air and absorb water and nutrients from rain and humidity.
Their leaves soak up water directly through tiny holes on their surface.
They store rainwater inside their thick stems and use it slowly.
Their flowers collect droplets of water and send it down to the plant.
explanation: Orchids have aerial roots that extend into the air and absorb water and nutrients from rain and humidity, not just from soil.
fact_tl: Ang mga orkid ay may aerial roots na lumalabas sa hangin at nakakasipsip ng tubig at sustansya mula sa ulan at halumigmig ng hangin, hindi lamang mula sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga orkid adunay aerial roots nga molanog sa hangin ug nagsuyop sa tubig ug sustansya gikan sa ulan ug humidity, dili lamang gikan sa yuta.

q: Who discovered oxygen as a gas, and in what year?
options: Joseph Priestley discovered oxygen as a gas in 1774.
Antoine Lavoisier discovered oxygen as a gas in 1803.
John Dalton discovered oxygen as a gas in 1808.
Henry Cavendish discovered oxygen as a gas in 1766.
explanation: Joseph Priestley discovered oxygen as a gas in 1774.
fact_tl: Si Joseph Priestley ang nakatuklas ng oxygen bilang gas noong 1774.
fact_bis: Si Joseph Priestley maoy nakadiskobre sa oxygen isip gas niadtong 1774.

q: What type of simple machine is a crowbar, and what is it used for?
options: A crowbar is a lever used to pry open tight lids or pull out stuck nails.
A crowbar is a wedge used to split heavy logs into smaller pieces.
A crowbar is a pulley used to lift heavy objects off the ground.
A crowbar is a screw used to hold pieces of wood tightly together.
explanation: A crowbar is a lever used to pry open tight lids or pull out nails that are stuck.
fact_tl: Ang bareta o crowbar ay isang palanca na ginagamit upang mabuksan ang mga matibay na takip o maalis ang nakabaong pako.
fact_bis: Ang bareta o crowbar usa ka palanca nga gigamit aron ungkaton ang gahi nga takup o ibira ang nakaugat nga lansang.

q: What can a remora do while it is attached to a shark?
options: It can release its disc a little and shuffle to a different part of the shark's body, then grip again.
It stays locked permanently in the same spot and cannot move until the shark dies.
It detaches completely and swims alongside the shark before reattaching.
It burrows under the shark's scales and travels inside the shark's body.
explanation: A remora can release its suction disc slightly, move to a better position on the shark's body, then grip again — almost like slowly walking on its host.
fact_tl: Hindi basta nakapirme sa isang lugar ang remora. Kaya nitong i-release nang konti ang disc, umusod sa ibang parte ng pating, tapos kumapit ulit — parang naglalakad nang dahan-dahan sa katawan ng host. Ginagawa nito ito para humanap ng mas magandang pusisyon o para makakuha ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang remora dili lang nakapirme sa usa ka lugar. Mahimo niining buhian og gamay ang disc, mobalhin sa laing bahin sa iho, dayon mokupot pag-usab — morag hinay nga naglakaw sa lawas sa host niini. Buhaton kini niini aron makakita og mas maayong posisyon o aron makaabot sa pagkaon.

q: What process creates Earth's magnetic field?
options: Hot liquid iron flowing and swirling in the outer core generates the magnetic field through the geodynamo.
The spinning of solid rock in the inner core rubs against the mantle to create a magnetic field.
Volcanic eruptions release magnetic minerals that rise up and create Earth's magnetic field.
Sunlight striking the outer atmosphere creates electric currents that form Earth's magnetic field.
explanation: The constant flowing and swirling of hot, liquid iron in the outer core generates Earth's magnetic field through a process called the geodynamo.
fact_tl: Ang patuloy na pag-agos at pag-ikot ng mainit, likidong bakal sa outer core ay gumagawa ng magnetikong larangan ng Daigdig sa paraang tinatawag na geodynamo.
fact_bis: Ang padayon nga pag-agos ug pagtuyok sa init, likido nga puthaw sa outer core maoy naghimo sa magnetikong natad sa Kalibutan pinaagi sa proseso nga gitawag nga geodynamo.

q: Why should you drink more water on hot days or when you exercise?
options: Because you sweat more, so your body loses more water that needs to be replaced.
Because cold drinks cool your blood down to a safe temperature during exercise.
Because drinking water gives you more energy to keep playing without getting tired.
Because water helps your muscles grow bigger and stronger when you are active.
explanation: On hot days or when exercising, you need to drink more water because you sweat out more.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na panahon o kapag naglalaro at nag-eehersisyo, mas maraming tubig ang kailangang inumin dahil mas marami kang ipinapawis.
fact_bis: Sa init nga panahon o kung nagdula ug nag-ehersisyo, mas daghang tubig ang kinahanglan imnon kay mas daghan kang singot.

q: What do scientists believe is found deep at the center of Jupiter?
options: A small rocky or metal core, surrounded by huge layers of gas.
Pure gas all the way to the very center with no solid part at all.
A large ocean of liquid water beneath the gas layers.
A ball of ice and dust similar to a comet's core.
explanation: Even though Jupiter is a gas giant, scientists believe it has a small rocky or metal core deep in its center, wrapped in huge layers of gas.
fact_tl: Kahit gas giant ang Jupiter, naniniwala ang mga siyentista na may maliit na batuhin o metal na ubod (core) sa gitna nito, na nababalot ng napakaraming gas. Kaya hindi ito puro gas hanggang sentro.
fact_bis: Bisan og gas giant ang Jupiter, nagtuo ang mga siyentista nga adunay gamay nga batoon o metal nga ubod sa kinahiladman niini, naputos sa daghang gas. Mao nga dili kini puro gas hangtod sa tunga.

q: How many bones are in the fingers of one hand, and what are they called?
options: 14 bones called phalanges.
10 bones called metacarpals.
20 bones called carpals.
12 bones called phalanges.
explanation: The fingers of one hand have 14 bones called phalanges.
fact_tl: Ang mga daliri ng isang kamay ay may 14 na buto na tinatawag na phalanges.
fact_bis: Ang mga tudlo sa usa ka kamot adunay 14 ka bukog nga gitawag og phalanges.

q: Which animal is considered the deadliest in the world, and why?
options: The mosquito, because it spreads many deadly diseases to people.
The great white shark, because it attacks and kills more people than any other animal.
The box jellyfish, because its venom is the most powerful of any animal.
The hippopotamus, because it is the most aggressive large land animal.
explanation: Mosquitoes are considered the deadliest animal in the world because of the many diseases they spread to people.
fact_tl: Itinuturing ang lamok na pinakamapanganib na hayop sa mundo dahil sa daming sakit na dala nito sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang lamok giila nga pinakadelikado nga hayop sa kalibotan tungod sa daghang sakit nga gidala niini sa tawo.

q: What is the name of J.J. Thomson's model of the atom?
options: The plum pudding model.
The planetary model.
The nuclear shell model.
The billiard ball model.
explanation: J.J. Thomson's atomic model is called the "plum pudding model."
fact_tl: Ang atomic model ni J.J. Thomson ay tinawag na "plum pudding model."
fact_bis: Ang atomic model ni J.J. Thomson gitawag og "plum pudding model."

q: What does the fine hair on your skin help your body do?
options: It helps keep in a little of the body's warmth.
It protects your skin from being cut by sharp objects.
It senses rain or water on the skin to warn you of cold.
It stops insects from biting directly through to the skin.
explanation: The fine hair on our skin helps keep in a little of the body's warmth.
fact_tl: Ang manipis na balahibo sa ating balat ay tumutulong na panatilihin ang kaunting init ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga balhibo sa atong panit makatabang sa pagtipig ug gamay nga init sa lawas.

q: Why do cuttlebones wash up on beaches even though cuttlefish live underwater?
options: When a cuttlefish dies, the soft body rots away but the gas-filled cuttlebone floats to the shore.
Cuttlefish leave their bones on the beach on purpose when looking for food.
The cuttlebone is made of a material that is pushed to shore by the current while the fish is still alive.
Predators eat the soft body of the cuttlefish and spit the bone onto the beach.
explanation: When a cuttlefish dies, its soft body rots away but the cuttlebone, being full of gas and very light, floats and washes up on the beach.
fact_tl: Kapag namatay ang cuttlefish, nabubulok ang malambot na katawan nito pero naiiwan ang cuttlebone. Dahil puno ito ng gas at magaan, lumulutang ito at madalas maitulak sa baybayin, kaya madalas itong makita doon.
fact_bis: Kung mamatay ang cuttlefish, madunot ang humok niyang lawas apan magpabilin ang cuttlebone. Tungod kay puno kini sa gas ug gaan, molutaw kini ug kasagaran maanod sa baybayon, mao nga sagad kini makit-an didto.

q: What does the small number inside the triangle symbol on a plastic container tell you?
options: It tells what kind of plastic it is, so you know how to recycle it correctly.
It tells how many times the container has already been recycled before.
It tells the temperature at which the plastic was made in the factory.
It tells how many years the plastic will last before it breaks down.
explanation: The small number inside the triangle symbol on plastic containers tells what kind of plastic it is, so people know how to recycle it correctly.
fact_tl: Ang maliit na numero sa loob ng tatsulok na simbolo sa ilalim ng mga lalagyang plastik ay nagsasabi kung anong uri ng plastik ito, para malaman ng mga tao kung paano ito tama na i-recycle.
fact_bis: Ang gamay nga numero sulod sa triyanggulo nga simbolo sa ilawom sa mga sudlanan nga plastik nagsulti kon unsa nga matang sa plastik kini, aron mahibal-an sa mga tawo kon unsaon kini pag-recycle sa husto.

q: What happens to the colors in ink when water climbs up paper in chromatography?
options: The different colors that make up one pigment separate from each other.
All the colors combine to form a single new color at the top of the paper.
The ink dissolves completely so no color is seen on the paper.
The water washes all the color off the paper, leaving it white.
explanation: In chromatography, water climbs up the paper carrying the ink, causing the different colors that make up one pigment to separate from each other.
fact_tl: Sa chromatography, umaakyat ang tubig sa papel at dinadala ang tinta, kaya naghihiwalay ang magkakaibang kulay na bumubuo ng isang pigment.
fact_bis: Sa chromatography, mosaka ang tubig sa papel ug magdala sa tinta, busa magbulagbulag ang lain-laing kolor nga naglangkob sa usa ka pigment.

q: On the pH scale, what does a higher number mean?
options: A stronger base; a pH of 14 is a very strong base.
A stronger acid; a pH of 14 is a very strong acid.
A neutral substance; numbers above 7 are neither acid nor base.
A more corrosive liquid that can burn through metal.
explanation: On the pH scale, the higher the number, the stronger the base; a pH of 14 is a very strong base.
fact_tl: Sa pH scale, mas mataas ang numero, mas malakas ang base; ang pH na 14 ay napakalakas na base.
fact_bis: Sa pH scale, mas taas ang numero, mas kusog ang base; ang pH nga 14 usa ka kusog kaayo nga base.

q: What kind of communities are most affected by schistosomiasis?
options: Poor rural communities that lack safe water and toilets.
Urban communities that have a large number of stray dogs.
Coastal fishing communities that eat too much raw fish.
Mountainous communities that breathe cold, thin air.
explanation: Schistosomiasis is one of the diseases that often strikes poor rural communities that lack safe water and toilets.
fact_tl: Ang schistosomiasis ay isa sa mga sakit na madalas tumama sa mga mahihirap na pamayanan sa kanayunan na walang ligtas na tubig at palikuran.
fact_bis: Ang schistosomiasis usa sa mga sakit nga kasagaran motakod sa kabus nga mga komunidad sa kabukiran nga walay luwas nga tubig ug kasilyas.

q: What happens when an acid and a base are mixed together?
options: They form a salt and water, and the mixture often warms up because the reaction releases heat.
They form a gas and the mixture gets very cold as energy is absorbed.
They cancel each other out completely with no new substances formed.
They separate into layers and slowly return to being acid and base again.
explanation: When an acid and a base are mixed, they form a salt and water in a reaction called neutralization, which is often exothermic so the mixture warms up.
fact_tl: Kapag pinaghalo ang isang acid at isang base, bumubuo sila ng asin at tubig — tinatawag itong neutralisasyon. Ang ganitong reaksyon ay madalas na exothermic, kaya uminit ang timpla.
fact_bis: Kon isagol ang usa ka acid ug usa ka base, maghimo silag asin ug tubig — kini gitawag og neutralization. Kini nga reaksyon kasagaran exothermic, busa moinit ang sagol.

q: In the Philippines, how does the size of a honeybee colony change through the year?
options: The colony can stay populous year-round because the tropical climate stays warm.
The colony shrinks in summer and grows very large during the rainy season.
The colony almost disappears in winter and must restart from a single queen.
The colony size stays exactly the same throughout all months of the year.
explanation: In tropical Philippines, a honeybee colony can stay populous year-round, unlike temperate climates where it shrinks in winter.
fact_tl: Sa mga temperadong lugar, ang isang malusog na honeybee colony ay maaaring may 50,000 manggagawa sa tag-init ngunit bumababa sa gabi-gabi; sa tropical na Pilipinas, maaaring manatiling mataas ang populasyon nang buong taon.
fact_bis: Sa temperate nga klima, ang himsog nga honeybee colony mahimong adunay 50,000 manggagawa sa tindig apan mokunhod sa tagtugnaw; sa tropical nga Pilipinas, ang kolonya mahimong magpabilin nga puno sa tibuok tuig.

q: Why does a heron need to adjust its aim when striking at a fish in water?
options: Because light bends as it enters water, making the fish appear to be in a slightly different spot than it really is.
Because the fish moves away from the shadow the heron casts on the water's surface.
Because the water reflects the heron's image and confuses it about the fish's location.
Because the current of the river pushes the fish sideways just before the beak arrives.
explanation: Light bends as it passes through water, so a fish looks like it is in a slightly different spot; a heron learns to adjust for this so its beak still hits.
fact_tl: Sa tubig, parang lumilipat ng pwesto ang isda dahil baluktot ang dinadaanan ng liwanag. Marunong itong i-adjust ng tagak kaya tumatama pa rin ang tuka kahit mukhang nasa ibang lugar ang isda.
fact_bis: Sa tubig, morag mobalhin og dapit ang isda kay nagliko ang agianan sa kahayag. Mahibawo ang tulabong mu-adjust niini mao nga mutama gihapon ang sungo bisan og morag lahi og dapit ang isda.

q: What two purposes do the sharp spines of a rattan plant serve?
options: They help the rattan climb and also defend it against animals that might eat it.
They attract insects for pollination and store water during dry weather.
They collect rainwater for the plant and anchor the roots more deeply in the soil.
They reflect sunlight to cool the plant and scare away birds that eat its seeds.
explanation: The sharp spines of rattan not only help it climb but also defend the plant against animals that might eat it.
fact_tl: Ang matutulis na tinik ng uway ay hindi lang pampaakyat kundi nagsisilbi ring depensa laban sa mga hayop na maaaring kumain sa halaman.
fact_bis: Ang hait nga tunok sa uway dili lang pangsaka kondili nagsilbi usab nga depensa batok sa mga mananap nga mahimong mokaon sa tanom.

q: Why are seagrass beds important underwater ecosystems?
options: They provide food and shelter for dugongs, sea turtles, and many small animals.
They produce most of the oxygen that fish need to breathe in the ocean.
They filter pollution from ocean water and make it clean for swimming.
They trap warm water near the surface to help coral reefs grow faster.
explanation: Seagrass beds form important underwater ecosystems that serve as food and shelter for dugongs, sea turtles, and many small animals.
fact_tl: Ang mga damong-dagat (seagrass) ay bumubuo ng mahahalagang ekosistema sa ilalaim ng karagatan na nagsisilbing pagkain at tirahan ng dugong, pawikan, at iba't ibang maliliit na hayop.
fact_bis: Ang mga seagrass nagporma sa mga importanteng ecosystem sa ilawom sa dagat nga nagsilbing pagkaon ug puy-anan sa dugong, pawikan, ug daghang gamay nga mga hayop.

q: How does being high up in the mountains affect the temperature at which water boils?
options: Water boils at a lower temperature because the air pressure is lower at high altitudes.
Water boils at a higher temperature because the air is colder and needs more heat.
Water boils at exactly 100°C everywhere because that is a fixed property of water.
Water takes longer to boil but still reaches 100°C if you wait long enough.
explanation: At high places like mountains, water boils at a lower temperature than 100°C because the air pressure is lower.
fact_tl: Sa mataas na lugar gaya ng bundok, kumukulo ang tubig sa mas mababa sa 100°C dahil mas mababa ang presyon ng hangin.
fact_bis: Sa hataas nga lugar sama sa bukid, mobukal ang tubig sa mas ubos sa 100°C tungod kay mas ubos ang presyur sa hangin.

q: What is the capital city of Rizal province?
options: Antipolo City
Cainta
Taytay
San Mateo
explanation: The capital of Rizal province is Antipolo City.
fact_tl: Ang kabisera ng lalawigan ng Rizal ay ang Antipolo City.
fact_bis: Ang ulohan sa lalawigan sa Rizal mao ang Antipolo City.

q: What is an atoll?
options: A ring-shaped reef circling a lagoon where an island once sank away.
A reef that grows right next to the shore of a coastline.
A reef separated from land by a lagoon that formed from volcanic eruption.
A flat reef that is completely underwater and cannot be seen from the surface.
explanation: An atoll is a ring-shaped reef circling a lagoon where an island once sank away — one of the three main shapes of coral reefs.
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing hugis ng coral reef. Ang fringing reef ay tumutubo malapit sa baybayin. Ang barrier reef ay malayo nang kaunti sa pampang at may lagoon sa pagitan. Ang atoll ay parang singsing na reef na pumapalibot sa isang lagoon kung saan dating may isla na lumubog na.
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka nag-unang porma sa coral reef. Ang fringing reef motubo duol sa baybayon. Ang barrier reef anaa sa unahan nga adunay lagoon tunga niini ug sa yuta. Ang atoll usa ka singsing nga porma sa reef nga naglibot sa lagoon diin kaniadto adunay isla nga nalunod na.

q: What is the difference between primary and secondary microplastics?
options: Primary microplastics are made tiny from the start, while secondary microplastics come from larger plastics breaking down over time.
Primary microplastics come from factories, while secondary microplastics are made by nature from plant material.
Primary microplastics are visible to the eye, while secondary microplastics are too small to see without a microscope.
Primary microplastics are harmful to animals, while secondary microplastics are safe because they are fully degraded.
explanation: Primary microplastics are made tiny from the start (like plastic pellets or microbeads), while secondary microplastics come from bigger plastics breaking down over time.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng microplastics: ang 'primary' na ginawa nang maliit mula simula (tulad ng plastic pellets o microbeads), at ang 'secondary' na galing sa malalaking plastik na nadurog sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka matang sa microplastics: ang 'primary' nga gihimo gayod nga gamay gikan sa sinugdan (sama sa plastic pellets o microbeads), ug ang 'secondary' nga gikan sa dagkong plastik nga nadugmok paglabay sa panahon.

q: How is alamang (shrimp paste) made?
options: Tiny shrimp are mixed with salt and allowed to ferment for days to weeks, which gives it its strong, savory flavor.
Tiny shrimp are dried in the sun for several days and then ground into a fine powder.
Tiny shrimp are boiled in vinegar and sugar until the liquid evaporates and a thick paste forms.
Tiny shrimp are smoked over coconut husks and then mashed into a paste with fish sauce.
explanation: Alamang is made by mixing tiny shrimp with salt and allowing them to ferment for days to weeks, which gives it its strong, savory flavor.
fact_tl: Ang alamang (bagoong hipon) ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng paghalo ng mga maliliit na hipon at asin at pagpapahintulot nito na ferment sa loob ng ilang araw hanggang linggo — ito ang nagbibigay ng malakas na lasa nito.
fact_bis: Ang alamang (bagoong hipon) gihimo pinaagi sa paghalo sa gagmay nga hipon ug asin ug pagpahimu-ok niini aron mapalala sulod sa mga adlaw hangtud semana — mao kini ang naghatag sa kusog nga lasa niini.

q: Why is a bear's winter sleep not considered true deep hibernation?
options: Because bears can still wake up fairly easily if needed, unlike animals in true deep hibernation.
Because bears sleep outside in the snow rather than inside a den or cave.
Because bears eat all winter long and only rest between meals.
Because bears only sleep for a few days at a time, not for the whole winter season.
explanation: Bears sleep for long periods in winter, but it is not true deep hibernation because they can still wake up fairly easily if needed.
fact_tl: Ang oso ay natutulog nang matagal sa taglamig, pero hindi ganap na hibernation ito dahil madali pa rin silang magising kung kailangan.
fact_bis: Ang oso matulog og dugay panahon sa tingtugnaw, apan dili kini hingpit nga hibernation kay dali ra gihapon sila mahigmata kon kinahanglan.

q: Which vitamins are water-soluble, meaning they dissolve in water?
options: Vitamin C and the B vitamins.
Vitamins A and D.
Vitamins E and K.
Vitamins A, D, E, and K.
explanation: Vitamin C and the B vitamins are water-soluble, meaning they dissolve in water.
fact_tl: Ang Vitamin C at ang mga Vitamin B ay water-soluble, ibig sabihin natutunaw ang mga ito sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Vitamin C ug ang mga Vitamin B water-soluble, buot ipasabot matunaw kini sa tubig.

q: Why do malunggay pods have a long shape with three ridged sides?
options: Many seeds are lined up in a row inside, and the shape gives each seed enough room to grow.
The three ridges make the pod stronger so it does not break when the wind blows.
The ridged sides help the pod collect rainwater to keep the seeds moist.
The long shape makes it easier for animals to carry the pods far away to spread the seeds.
explanation: Malunggay pods are long with three ridged sides because many seeds are lined up in a row inside, giving each seed enough room to grow.
fact_tl: Mahaba at may tatlong gilid ang malunggay pod dahil nakahanay sa loob nito ang maraming buto. Ang hugis na ito ang nagbibigay ng sapat na espasyo para lumaki ang bawat binhi.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay pod taas ug adunay tulo ka kilid kay daghan nga liso ang nakapila sa sulod niini. Kini nga porma maghatag ug igong luna para motubo ang matag binhi.

q: What happens to an ordinary alkaline battery when it runs out of power?
options: It cannot be recharged and must be thrown away.
It can be recharged by placing it in a standard phone charger for one hour.
It can be revived by warming it up in a bowl of warm water.
It slowly recharges on its own after being left to rest overnight.
explanation: Ordinary single-use batteries, like alkaline ones, cannot be recharged once they run out.
fact_tl: Ang mga ordinaryong baterya na ginagamit minsan lamang (gaya ng alkaline) ay hindi na maaaring kargahan muli kapag naubos.
fact_bis: Ang ordinaryong baterya nga gamiton kausa ra, sama sa alkaline, dili na mabalik-kargahan kon mahurot.

q: How do epiphytes help small animals living high up in the trees?
options: They provide shelter and hold water between their leaves where small frogs and insects can live.
They drop large fruits that small animals collect and eat on the forest floor.
They block strong winds so that bird nests built nearby are not blown down.
They produce sweet nectar that attracts insects to pollinate nearby trees.
explanation: Epiphytes provide shelter and water for small animals up in the tree; some frogs and insects live in the water that collects between their leaves.
fact_tl: Ang mga epiphyte ay nagbibigay ng tirahan at tubig sa maliliit na hayop sa puno. Ang ilang palaka at insekto ay namumuhay sa naiipong tubig sa pagitan ng kanilang mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang mga epiphyte naghatag og puy-anan ug tubig sa gagmay nga mananap sa kahoy. Ang pipila ka baki ug insekto nagpuyo sa tubig nga natipon taliwala sa ilang mga dahon.

q: What role do supernovae play in forming new stars and planets?
options: When a large star explodes as a supernova, it scatters heavy elements into space, and new stars and planets can later form from those clouds.
Supernovae pull nearby dust and gas inward with huge gravity to instantly create new stars.
Supernovae create powerful radiation that breaks hydrogen into the building blocks of new planets.
Supernovae leave behind black holes, and the material pulled into the black holes eventually forms new stars.
explanation: When some large stars explode as supernovae, they scatter the heavy elements they made into space, and from these clouds new stars and planets can later form.
fact_tl: Kapag sumabog ang ilang malalaking bituin bilang supernova, ikinakalat nila sa kalawakan ang mga mabibigat na elementong ginawa nila, at mula sa mga ulap na ito ay maaaring mabuo ang bagong mga bituin at planeta.
fact_bis: Kon mobuto ang pipila ka dagkong bituon isip supernova, ikatag nila sa kawanangan ang mga bug-at nga elemento nga ilang gibuhat, ug gikan niini nga mga panganod mahimong maporma ang bag-ong mga bituon ug planeta.

q: What are the white, fluffy flowers at the top of the talahib plant used for?
options: They carry seeds that are blown away by the wind to spread to new places.
They attract butterflies that pollinate nearby flowers in the field.
They absorb sunlight to help the plant make more food by photosynthesis.
They collect dew drops that drip down to water the plant's roots.
explanation: Talahib has white, soft, feathery flowers at the top, and this fluffy white part carries the seeds that are blown away by the wind.
fact_tl: Ang talahib ay may mahabang tangkay na may puti at malambot na bulaklak sa dulo na parang balahibo. Itong puting bahagi ang nagdadala ng mga buto na tinatangay ng hangin.
fact_bis: Ang talahib adunay taas nga punoan nga may puti ug humok nga bulak sa tumoy nga murag balahibo. Kining puti nga bahin maoy nagdala sa mga liso nga ginapalid sa hangin.

q: Where do farmers in the Philippines raise milkfish (bangus)?
options: In large fishponds.
In small tanks inside a barn.
In river cages attached to floating bamboo.
In the open ocean in nets anchored to the sea floor.
explanation: Milkfish are raised by farmers in large fishponds.
fact_tl: Ang bangus ay inaalagaan ng mga magsasaka sa malalaking palaisdaan.
fact_bis: Ang bangus gialimahan sa mga mag-uuma diha sa dagkong palaisdaan.

q: What does PHIVOLCS do to help keep people safe from the Philippine Fault?
options: It uses machines to sense ground movement, maps where the fault passes, and provides information for earthquake drills and safe building.
It builds concrete walls along the fault to stop the ground from moving during earthquakes.
It sends warnings to schools by text message only after an earthquake has already struck.
It removes all buildings near the fault and turns the area into a national park.
explanation: Scientists at PHIVOLCS monitor the Philippine Fault using machines that sense ground movement, make maps, and provide information for earthquake drills and safe building construction.
fact_tl: Binabantayan ng mga siyentipiko sa PHIVOLCS ang Philippine Fault gamit ang mga makina na nakakaramdam ng paggalaw ng lupa. Pinag-aaralan nila kung saan ito dumadaan para makagawa ng mga mapa at makapagbigay ng babala. Ginagamit ang impormasyong ito para sa earthquake drill at ligtas na pagtatayo ng mga gusali.
fact_bis: Gibantayan sa mga siyentista sa PHIVOLCS ang Philippine Fault gamit ang mga makina nga makabati sa paglihok sa yuta. Gitun-an nila kon asa kini moagi aron makahimo og mapa ug makahatag og pasidaan. Gigamit kini nga impormasyon para sa earthquake drill ug luwas nga pagtukod og mga building.

q: What does it mean when a species becomes extinct?
options: All members of that kind of animal or plant die out so that none are left on Earth ever again.
The species moves to a different part of the world where people cannot find it easily.
The species becomes so rare that only a few individuals are left in protected areas.
The species changes slowly into a different kind of animal over thousands of years.
explanation: Extinction happens when all members of a kind of animal or plant die out, so that none are left on Earth ever again.
fact_tl: Ang pagkalipol ay nangyayari kapag namatay ang lahat ng miyembro ng isang uri ng hayop o halaman, kaya wala na itong matitira sa mundo magpakailanman.
fact_bis: Ang pagkapuo mahitabo kung mamatay ang tanang sakop sa usa ka matang sa mananap o tanom, mao nga wala nay mahabilin niini sa kalibotan hangtod sa kahangtoran.

q: Why is Venus the hottest planet in the solar system even though Mercury is closer to the Sun?
options: Because Venus has a very thick CO2 atmosphere that traps heat, causing an extreme greenhouse effect with surface temperatures around 465°C.
Because Venus spins very slowly, so the same side faces the Sun for a very long time and heats up more.
Because Venus has active volcanoes that constantly release heat and make the surface extremely hot.
Because Venus has no night side — the planet is always fully lit by the Sun from every angle.
explanation: Venus is the hottest planet because of the extreme greenhouse effect of its thick CO2 atmosphere, making surface temperatures reach about 465°C — hotter than Mercury.
fact_tl: Ang Venus ang pinaka-mainit na planeta sa solar system dahil sa matinding greenhouse effect ng makapal nitong CO2 atmosphere; ang temperatura sa surface nito ay humigit-kumulang 465°C — mas mainit pa kaysa sa Mercury kahit na malayo ito sa Araw.
fact_bis: Ang Venus mao ang pinaka-init nga planeta sa solar system tungod sa grabeng greenhouse effect sa iyang baga nga CO2 atmosphere; ang temperatura sa surface niini mga 465°C — mas init pa kaysa Mercury bisan layo kini sa Adlaw.

q: On a stage, what happens when red, green, and blue spotlights all overlap in the same area?
options: They can make white light and many other colors.
They combine to make a very bright yellow light.
They cancel each other out and the stage goes dark.
They each stay separate and the three colors never really mix.
explanation: On a stage, when red, green, and blue spotlights overlap, they can make white and many other colors.
fact_tl: Sa entablado, kapag nagtagpo ang mga kulay na ilaw na pula, berde, at asul, nakakabuo sila ng puti at iba pang kulay.
fact_bis: Sa entablado, kon magtapok ang pula, berde, ug asul nga mga suga, makahimo sila ug puti ug daghang lain nga kolor.

q: When do a bird's bones become fully hollow?
options: Gradually, as the bird grows and learns to fly — the insides of some bones slowly become more hollow over time.
Before the bird hatches, so the bones are already completely hollow inside the egg.
All at once when the bird takes its first flight and air is forced into the bones.
Only in adult birds that have been flying for more than two years.
explanation: A newly hatched chick's bones aren't fully hollow yet; as the bird grows and learns to fly, the insides of some bones gradually become more hollow.
fact_tl: Hindi pa ganap na guwang ang buto ng sisiw kapag bagong pisa. Habang lumalaki at natututong lumipad ang ibon, unti-unting nahuhubog at gumuwang ang loob ng ilang buto nito.
fact_bis: Dili pa hingpit nga hawan ang buto sa piso kung bag-o pa mapusa. Samtang nagdako ug nagkat-on molupad ang langgam, anam-anam nga maporma ug mahawan ang sulod sa ubang buto niini.

q: How does a vampire squid defend itself from predators instead of using ink?
options: It shoots out a glowing sticky cloud to confuse the predator.
It releases a cloud of black ink that blinds the predator temporarily.
It flashes its large eyes to startle and frighten the predator away.
It inflates its body to look much bigger and harder to swallow.
explanation: The vampire squid shoots out a glowing sticky cloud to confuse a predator instead of ink.
fact_tl: Ang vampire squid ay nagpapalabas ng nagliliwanag na malagkit na ulap para lituhin ang mandaragit sa halip na tinta.
fact_bis: Ang vampire squid mobuga og nagdan-ag nga pikit nga panganod aron libugon ang manunukob imbis tinta.

q: What is the job of cotyledons in a seed?
options: They store food to nourish the seedling until it can make its own food by photosynthesis.
They protect the seed from being eaten by insects before it germinates.
They absorb water from the soil to start the process of germination.
They produce the first flowers so the plant can begin making new seeds right away.
explanation: Cotyledons are the seed leaves that store food to nourish the seedling until it can make its own food by photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Ang cotyledon ay ang seed leaf ng buto na may nakaimbak na pagkain para sa bagong sibling na halaman—kapag naubos na ang pagkain, gumagawa na ang halaman ng sarili nitong pagkain sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis.
fact_bis: Ang cotyledon mao ang seed leaf nga adunay nakatagong pagkaon aron mapaabot ang seedling hangtod makagama na kini sa kaugalingon pinaagi sa photosynthesis.

q: What causes day and night on Earth?
options: Earth spinning on its axis once every 24 hours, so different parts face the Sun at different times.
Earth moving around the Sun once a year, so the Sun lights different sides each season.
The Moon blocking sunlight from reaching part of Earth as it orbits around us.
Clouds covering the Sun during the day and moving away at night to reveal darkness.
explanation: Earth spins on its axis — an imaginary line through the north and south poles — and one full spin takes about 24 hours, which causes day and night.
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay umiikot (rotation) sa sarili nitong axis — isang imahinaryong linya na dumadaan sa hilaga at timog na poste. Isang buong ikot ang tumatagal ng halos 24 oras, at ito ang dahilan ng araw at gabi.
fact_bis: Ang Earth molibot (rotation) sa kaugalingong axis niini — usa ka imahinaryong linya nga moagi sa amihanan ug habagatan nga poste. Usa ka tibuok tuyok molungtad og halos 24 ka oras, ug kini ang hinungdan sa adlaw ug gabii.

q: What happens to the brightness of bulbs in a series circuit when more bulbs are added?
options: Each bulb gets dimmer because the bulbs share the battery's voltage.
Each bulb stays the same brightness because the battery gives each one its full voltage.
The new bulbs are brighter and the old bulbs go out because current flows to the newest bulb first.
All the bulbs get equally brighter because more bulbs produce more total light energy.
explanation: In a series circuit the bulbs share the battery's voltage, so adding more bulbs makes each one receive less voltage and glow dimmer.
fact_tl: Sa isang series circuit, pinaghahati ng mga bumbilya o resistor ang boltahe ng baterya, kaya kapag dumami sila ay mas lumalabo ang bawat ilaw.
fact_bis: Sa usa ka series circuit, bahinon sa mga bombilya o resistor ang boltahe sa baterya, mao nga kung modaghan sila mas mongitngit ang matag suga.

q: Besides rats, which other animals can carry the bacteria that causes leptospirosis?
options: Dogs, cattle, and pigs can also carry the leptospirosis bacteria in their urine.
Cats, chickens, and fish can also spread leptospirosis through their blood.
Mosquitoes, cockroaches, and flies can carry and spread leptospirosis bacteria.
Birds, lizards, and frogs can carry leptospirosis through their saliva.
explanation: Rats are not the only carriers of leptospirosis; the bacteria can also be in the urine of dogs, cattle, and pigs.
fact_tl: Hindi lang daga ang nagdadala ng bakterya ng leptospirosis; maaari rin itong nasa ihi ng aso, baka, at baboy.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang ilaga ang nagdala sa bakterya sa leptospirosis; mahimo usab kini anaa sa ihi sa iro, baka, ug baboy.

q: Why has gold been used to make jewelry and coins since ancient times?
options: Because it is beautiful and does not decay or rust.
Because it is the hardest metal and cannot be scratched or bent.
Because it is the most common metal found in rivers and mines.
Because it melts at a very low temperature and is easy to shape into any form.
explanation: Since ancient times, gold has been used to make jewelry and coins because it is beautiful and does not decay.
fact_tl: Mula noong unang panahon, ginagamit na ang ginto sa paggawa ng alahas, singsing, at barya dahil ito ay maganda at hindi nasisira.
fact_bis: Sukad pa sa karaang panahon, gigamit na ang bulawan sa paghimo ug alahas, singsing, ug sinsilyo kay nindot kini ug dili madunot.

q: What makes something a pure substance?
options: It is made of only one kind of matter, so every part of it is the same.
It has been cleaned and filtered to remove all bacteria and dirt.
It is a liquid that has no color, no smell, and no taste.
It has been approved as safe for people to eat or drink.
explanation: A pure substance is made of only one kind of matter, so every part of it is the same.
fact_tl: Ang purong sangkap ay gawa sa isa lamang na uri ng bagay, kaya pare-pareho ang lahat ng bahagi nito.
fact_bis: Ang purong sangkap hinimo gikan sa usa ra ka klase nga butang, mao nga managsama ang tanan niini nga bahin.

q: What does Ohm's Law state?
options: Voltage equals current multiplied by resistance (V = IR).
Current equals voltage multiplied by resistance (I = VR).
Resistance equals voltage multiplied by current (R = VI).
Voltage equals current divided by resistance (V = I ÷ R).
explanation: Ohm's Law, named after Georg Ohm, states that V = IR — voltage equals current multiplied by resistance.
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Ohm, ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm, ay V = IR — ang boltahe ay katumbas ng kuryente (current) na minultiplika sa resistensya.
fact_bis: Ang Balaod ni Ohm, ginganlan sunod kang Georg Ohm, mao ang V = IR — ang voltage managsama sa current nga gipilo-pilo sa resistensya.

q: Why is getting enough protein especially important during the first 1,000 days of a child's life?
options: Because during this period of very fast growth, protein is what the body uses to build flesh, muscles, and organs.
Because protein prevents a child from catching diseases like colds and flu during the first years of life.
Because protein gives babies energy to stay awake and alert during the day.
Because protein helps the brain memorize things faster during the early learning years.
explanation: Protein from fish, eggs, chicken, and mung beans is like bricks the body uses to build flesh, muscles, and organs — and during the 1,000 days of very fast growth, enough protein is badly needed.
fact_tl: Ang protina mula sa isda, itlog, manok, at munggo ay parang mga ladrilyo na ginagamit ng katawan para magpalaki ng laman, kalamnan, at organo. Sa 1,000 araw na napakabilis ng paglaki, kailangang-kailangan ng sapat na protina.
fact_bis: Ang protina gikan sa isda, itlog, manok, ug monggos sama sa mga tisa nga gamiton sa lawas aron motubo ang unod, kaunoran, ug organo. Sa 1,000 ka adlaw nga paspas kaayo ang pagtubo, gikinahanglan kaayo ang igong protina.

q: What two extra ingredients are mixed with sand to make ordinary glass melt more easily?
options: Soda and lime
Salt and vinegar
Ash and sulfur
Iron and copper
explanation: Ordinary glass is made by mixing sand with soda and lime so it melts at a lower temperature.
fact_tl: Sa paggawa ng karaniwang salamin, hinahaluan ang buhangin ng soda at apog para mas madali itong matunaw.
fact_bis: Sa paghimo og ordinaryong salamin, ang balas gisagolan og soda ug apog aron mas sayon kining matunaw.

q: Which animal makes the longest migration of any animal on Earth?
options: Arctic tern
Monarch butterfly
Humpback whale
Bar-tailed godwit
explanation: The arctic tern flies from the Arctic to Antarctica and back each year — many thousands of kilometers — giving it the longest migration of any animal.
fact_tl: Ang arctic tern ang gumagawa ng pinakamahabang paglalakbay sa lahat ng hayop. Bawat taon, lumilipad ito mula sa Arctic patungong Antarctica at pabalik — libo-libong kilometro ang layo.
fact_bis: Ang arctic tern naghimo sa pinakataas nga panaw sa tanang hayop. Matag tuig, molupad kini gikan sa Arctic padulong sa Antarctica ug mobalik — liboan ka kilometro ang gilay-on.

q: Which Filipino hero wrote the novel El Filibusterismo?
options: Jose Rizal
Andres Bonifacio
Emilio Aguinaldo
Marcelo H. del Pilar
explanation: Jose Rizal wrote the novel El Filibusterismo.
fact_tl: Si Jose Rizal ang sumulat ng nobelang El Filibusterismo.
fact_bis: Si Jose Rizal ang nagsulat sa nobela nga El Filibusterismo.

q: What should you do after using the bathroom to remove germs from your hands?
options: Wash hands with soap and water
Rinse hands with water only
Wipe hands on a dry towel
Apply hand sanitizer spray on clothes
explanation: After using the bathroom, washing your hands with soap and water removes germs that could make you or others sick.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos umihi, dapat maghugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at tubig para maalis ang mga mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Human mangihi, kinahanglan manghugas og kamot gamit ang sabon ug tubig aron makuha ang mga mikrobyo.

q: What happens to lava after it flows out of a volcano and cools down?
options: It hardens into new rock
It dissolves into the soil
It turns into steam
It sinks back underground
explanation: Lava is melted rock that slowly cools and hardens into new rock as it flows away from the volcano or crack in the ground.
fact_tl: Ang lava ay natunaw na bato na lumalabas mula sa bulkan o sa bitak sa lupa, at habang umaagos ito ay unti-unting lumalamig at tumitigas na bago.
fact_bis: Ang lava maoy natunaw nga bato nga mogawas gikan sa bulkan o sa liki sa yuta, ug samtang nag-agos kini hinay-hinay nga mobugnaw ug mogahi nga bag-ong bato.

q: How many main senses do humans have?
explanation: Humans have 5 main senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.
fact_tl: May 5 (lima) na pangunahing pandama ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang tawo adunay 5 (lima) ka nag-unang igbalati.

q: Why does the body burp?
options: To push out extra air that got into the stomach
To release acid that built up in the stomach
To signal that the stomach is empty
To remove water swallowed too fast
explanation: We burp when extra air — swallowed while eating, drinking, or having soda — builds up in the stomach and the body pushes it back up and out.
fact_tl: Dumidighay tayo kapag may sobrang hangin sa loob ng tiyan — madalas itong galing sa hanging nalulunok natin habang kumakain, umiinom, o uminom ng soda; pinapalabas ito ng katawan pataas sa bibig.
fact_bis: Modighay ta kon adunay sobra nga hangin sa sulod sa tiyan — sagad kini gikan sa hangin nga atong nalamoy samtang nagkaon, nag-inom, o nag-inom og soda; gitulod kini sa lawas pataas ug mogawas sa baba.

q: Where did the farm pigs we raise today originally come from?
options: Wild pigs that people tamed thousands of years ago
Small deer that slowly changed over time
Forest hogs from Africa brought by traders
Domesticated animals bred from horses
explanation: Farm pigs came from wild pigs that people began taming thousands of years ago so they would have a steady source of food.
fact_tl: Ang mga baboy na inaalagaan sa bukid ay nagmula sa mga ligaw na baboy noong unang panahon. Sinimulang alagaan ng mga tao ang ligaw na baboy libo-libong taon na ang nakalipas para magkaroon ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga baboy nga giatiman sa uma naggikan sa mga ihalas nga baboy kaniadto. Gisugdan sa mga tao pag-atiman ang ihalas nga baboy liboan ka tuig na ang milabay aron makabaton sila og pagkaon.

q: Why does frost form more easily on clear, calm nights than on cloudy nights?
options: Heat escapes quickly into the sky, making surfaces very cold
Cold air blows in from the ocean and freezes the ground
Rain turns to ice when there are no clouds to block it
The moon's light cools the air near the ground
explanation: On clear, calm nights the ground's heat escapes quickly up to the sky, chilling surfaces enough for frost to form before morning.
fact_tl: Mas madaling magka-frost tuwing malinaw at walang hanging gabi, dahil ang init ng lupa ay mabilis na kumakawala paitaas sa langit, kaya napakalamig ng ibabaw bago mag-umaga.
fact_bis: Mas sayon magka-frost sa tin-aw ug walay hangin nga gabii, tungod kay ang kainit sa yuta paspas nga mobulhot pataas sa langit, mao nga bugnaw kaayo ang ibabaw una mosidlak ang adlaw.

q: How does massage help muscles recover after exercise?
options: It increases blood flow and helps remove lactic acid
It stretches the muscle fibers so they grow longer
It cools the muscles by reducing body temperature
It prevents the muscles from contracting again
explanation: Massage helps muscles recover after exercise by increasing blood flow and helping remove lactic acid that builds up during activity.
fact_tl: Ang masahe ay tumutulong sa pagbawi ng mga kalamnan pagkatapos ng ehersisyo sa pamamagitan ng pagpapabilis ng daloy ng dugo at pagtulong sa pagsipat ng lactic acid.
fact_bis: Ang masahe nagtabang sa pagbawi sa mga kaunuran pagkahuman sa ehersisyo pinaagi sa pagpadali sa agos sa dugo ug pagtabang sa pagtangtang sa lactic acid nga nag-ipon sa panahon sa aktibidad.

q: Which body system do the kidneys belong to?
options: Excretory system
Digestive system
Respiratory system
Circulatory system
explanation: The kidneys are part of the excretory system, the body system responsible for getting rid of wastes.
fact_tl: Ang mga bato ay bahagi ng excretory system, ang sistema ng katawan na nag-aalis ng mga dumi.
fact_bis: Ang mga kidney bahin sa excretory system, ang sistema sa lawas nga nagtangtang sa mga hugaw.

q: What signals tell an animal that it is time to hibernate?
options: Cooling weather, shorter days, and less available food
Rising temperatures and heavy rainfall
Longer days and more available sunlight
Strong winds and dry conditions
explanation: Cooling weather, shorter days, and less available food are the signals that tell animals it is time to hibernate.
fact_tl: Ang papalamig na panahon, papaikling araw, at kakaunting pagkain ang nagbibigay-hudyat sa hayop na panahon na para mag-hibernate.
fact_bis: Ang nagkabugnaw nga panahon, nagkamubo nga adlaw, ug nihit nga pagkaon maoy senyas sa mananap nga panahon na aron mag-hibernate.

q: What does it mean when we say an animal is extinct?
options: Every animal of that kind has died and none are left alive
The animal moved to a different part of the world
The animal changed so much it looks different now
The animal went into a very long deep sleep
explanation: Extinction means every animal of one kind has died and none are left alive — just like what happened to the non-bird dinosaurs.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang uri ng hayop ay tuluyang namatay at wala nang natitira, sinasabing ito ay naglaho o extinct na.
fact_bis: Kung ang tanang hayop sa usa ka matang mamatay ug wala nay buhi, atong isulti nga kana nga matang nahurot o extinct na, sama sa mga dinosaur.

q: Why can all land snails lay eggs?
options: Because each snail has both male and female parts in one body
Because snails switch between male and female each season
Because female snails are much more common than males
Because snails reproduce without needing another snail
explanation: Many land snails are hermaphrodites — they have both male and female parts in one body, so all of them can lay eggs.
fact_tl: Maraming lupang suso ay may bahaging lalaki at babae sa iisang katawan, kaya silang lahat ay nangingitlog.
fact_bis: Daghang yutang suso adunay bahin nga lalaki ug babaye sa usa ka lawas, busa silang tanan makaitlog.

q: Which type of wave in the electromagnetic spectrum has the longest wavelength?
options: Radio waves
Gamma rays
X-rays
Ultraviolet rays
explanation: In the electromagnetic spectrum, radio waves have the longest wavelength while gamma rays have the shortest.
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay may iba't ibang alon na nakaayos ayon sa wavelength: pinakamahaba ang radio wave at pinakamaikli ang gamma ray, at ang nakikitang liwanag ay maliit na bahagi lamang nito.
fact_bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum adunay lainlaing balod nga gihan-ay sumala sa wavelength: ang radio wave ang pinakataas ug ang gamma ray ang pinakamubo, ug ang makita nga kahayag gamay ra nga bahin niini.

q: What shape do salt grains look like when viewed under a magnifying glass?
options: Tiny cubes
Thin flat discs
Long pointed needles
Rough uneven lumps
explanation: Salt grains are shaped like tiny cubes because the parts of salt line up in a neat, repeating pattern.
fact_tl: Kapag tiningnan mo ang asin sa magnifying glass, makikita mong ang bawat butil ay hugis-kubo (parang maliit na kahon). Ganito kaayos ang ayos ng mga bahagi ng asin.
fact_bis: Kung tan-awon nimo ang asin sa magnifying glass, ang matag butil porma'g gamay nga kubo (gamay nga kahon). Tungod kini kay ang mga bahin sa asin nahan-ay og hapsay nga porma.

q: Where does the carpenter bee make its nest?
options: Inside wood
Underground in the soil
Inside hollow plant stems
Inside a wax honeycomb
explanation: The carpenter bee is a large, often black bee that nests in wood and also helps pollinate flowers.
fact_tl: Ang carpenter bee ay isang malaki at madalas itim na bubuyog na gumagawa ng pugad sa kahoy at tumutulong sa pagpopolinasyon ng mga bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang carpenter bee usa ka dako ug sagad itom nga bubuyog nga magsalag sa kahoy ug motabang sa pagpabunga sa mga bulak.

q: How does the sundew plant (Drosera) catch and digest insects?
options: Sticky mucilage on leaf hairs traps insects, then enzymes digest them
The leaves snap shut around the insect like a trap
The roots release poison that kills insects that touch the soil
Flowers produce a scent that stuns and suffocates insects
explanation: Sundew leaves have sticky mucilage at the tips of hairs that trap insects; the plant then secretes enzymes to digest them and obtain nitrogen.
fact_tl: Ang sundew (Drosera) ay may mga dahon na may malagkit na katete (mucilage) sa dulo ng mga buhok—nahuhuli dito ang mga insekto; pagkatapos ay nagtatago ng enzyme ang halaman para tunawin ang insekto para makakuha ng nitrogen.
fact_bis: Ang sundew (Drosera) adunay mga dahon nga may malagkit nga mucilage sa dulo sa mga buhok—nahuhuli ang mga insekto; pagkahuman, nagtago ang tanum og enzyme aron tunawin ang insekto para makakuha og nitrogen.

q: How does a shark get oxygen from the water?
options: Through gills that take oxygen out of the seawater
Through tiny pores all over its skin
By surfacing to breathe air like dolphins
By swallowing water and absorbing oxygen in the stomach
explanation: A shark breathes through gills that extract oxygen directly from the seawater flowing over them.
fact_tl: Ang pating ay humihinga sa pamamagitan ng mga hasang na kumukuha ng oxygen mula sa tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang iho manginhawa pinaagi sa mga hasang nga mokuha og oxygen gikan sa tubig-dagat.

q: Why can a maglev train travel so fast?
options: Like magnetic poles push it above the track so there is almost no friction
Powerful engines push the train faster than wheels allow
The track is built on a downward slope the whole way
It uses jet engines similar to airplanes
explanation: A maglev train floats above its track because like magnetic poles repel each other, nearly eliminating friction and allowing very high speeds.
fact_tl: Ang maglev na tren ay lumulutang sa ibabaw ng riles dahil ang magkatulad na poste ng magnet ay nagtutulakan, kaya halos walang friction at napakabilis nito.
fact_bis: Ang maglev nga tren maglutaw ibabaw sa riles tungod kay ang managsamang poste sa magnet magtinulakanay, mao nga halos walay friction ug paspas kaayo kini.

q: What is special about the ostrich's eyes compared to its brain?
options: Its eyes are bigger than its brain
Its brain is twice as large as each eye
Its eyes face backward for a wide view
Its eyes can see in total darkness
explanation: The ostrich has very large eyes — even bigger than its brain — which help it see far away.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng ostrich ay napakalaki, mas malaki pa kaysa sa utak nito, kaya malayo ang nakikita nito.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa ostrich dako kaayo, mas dako pa kay sa utok niini, mao nga makakita kini ug layo.

q: How can an octopus taste what it is touching?
options: It has taste receptors in its suckers
It releases a chemical into the water and smells the result
It uses sensors on the tips of its arms separate from the suckers
It tastes through two special tentacles longer than the others
explanation: An octopus can taste with its suckers, so it knows the flavor of whatever it touches.
fact_tl: Nakakatikim ang mga supsop ng pugita, kaya nalalaman nito ang lasa ng bagay na hinahawakan nito.
fact_bis: Makatilaw ang mga tisi sa kugita, mao nga mahibaw-an niini ang lami sa bisan unsang butang nga gihikap niini.

q: What is the Earth's mantle mostly made of?
options: Solid rock that flows very slowly over a long time
Liquid molten rock like a sea of magma
A mix of liquid water and dissolved minerals
Gas trapped under very high pressure
explanation: The Earth's mantle is almost entirely solid; it only flows extremely slowly over very long times, more like thick clay than liquid rock.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakalang tunaw na bato ang mantle, pero halos buo at matigas ito; umuusad lang ito nang sobrang bagal sa napakahabang panahon, parang malapot na clay, hindi tulad ng tubig.
fact_bis: Daghan ang naghunahuna nga tunaw nga bato ang mantle, apan halos tibuok kini ug gahi; mohinay-hinay lang kini og agos sulod sa taas kaayo nga panahon, morag baga nga clay, dili sama sa tubig.

q: How does a barnacle attach itself to a rock?
options: It glues a wide flat base plate at its bottom to the rock
It uses tiny hooks on its legs to grip the surface
It secretes a sticky slime all over its body to cling on
It drills a small hole and anchors itself inside the rock
explanation: A barnacle attaches using a wide, flat base plate at its bottom that is cemented directly onto the rock.
fact_tl: Dumidikit ang barnacle gamit ang isang lapad na pundasyong parang plato sa ilalim nito na siyang nakadikit sa bato.
fact_bis: Ang barnacle mopilit gamit ang usa ka lapad ug patag nga base nga murag plato sa iyang ubos nga maoy nadikit sa bato.

q: What is the difference between self-pollination and cross-pollination?
options: In self-pollination pollen stays on the same flower; in cross-pollination it comes from a different plant
In self-pollination insects carry pollen; in cross-pollination wind does
In self-pollination pollen moves to the roots; in cross-pollination to the leaves
In self-pollination only one seed forms; in cross-pollination many seeds form
explanation: Self-pollination is when pollen reaches the pistil of the same flower, while cross-pollination is when pollen comes from a different plant.
fact_tl: Sa self-pollination, napupunta ang pollen sa pistil ng parehong bulaklak; sa cross-pollination, galing ito sa ibang halaman.
fact_bis: Sa self-pollination, ang pollen moabot sa pistil sa samang buwak, samtang sa cross-pollination kini gikan sa laing tanom.

q: What is a compound?
options: Two or more elements chemically joined together
A pure substance made of only one kind of atom
A mixture of substances that are not chemically joined
A liquid element that dissolves easily in water
explanation: A compound is made of two or more elements chemically joined, like sodium and chlorine joining to form salt.
fact_tl: Ang compound ay gawa sa dalawa o higit pang elemento na kemikal na pinagsama, gaya ng sodium at chlorine na bumubuo ng asin.
fact_bis: Ang compound hinimo gikan sa duha o sobra pa ka elemento nga gihiusa pinaagi sa chemical, sama sa sodium ug chlorine nga naghimo og asin.

q: Which part of the body helps you keep your balance besides helping you hear?
options: The inner ear
The outer ear
The nose
The eyes
explanation: Besides hearing, the inner ear helps us keep our balance so we don't fall over.
fact_tl: Bukod sa pakikinig, ang panloob na tainga ang tumutulong sa atin para hindi matumba at manatiling balanse.
fact_bis: Gawas sa pagpaminaw, ang sulod nga dalunggan motabang kanato sa pagbalanse aron dili kita matumba.

q: What causes a person to get head lice?
options: Close contact that lets lice move from one head to another
Having dirty or unwashed hair
Playing outdoors in soil or grass
Sharing food with someone who has lice
explanation: Getting head lice is not caused by being dirty — even clean hair can have lice because lice spread through close contact, not dirt.
fact_tl: Hindi dahil sa pagiging marumi nagkaka-kuto; kahit malinis ang buhok ay maaaring tamaan.
fact_bis: Ang pagka-kuto dili tungod sa pagkahugaw; bisan ang limpyo nga buhok mahimong adunay kuto.

q: What does the brain do with the signals it receives from the senses?
options: It tells you what you are seeing, hearing, or feeling
It stores the signals in the stomach for later use
It sends the signals back out through the skin
It converts the signals into energy for the muscles
explanation: The senses detect the world and send signals through nerves to the brain, which is what tells you what you are seeing, hearing, or feeling.
fact_tl: Ang mga pandama — mata, tainga, balat, ilong, at dila — ay nakakaramdam ng paligid at nagpapadala ng signal sa utak sa pamamagitan ng mga nerve. Ang utak ang nagsasabi kung ano ang nakikita, naririnig, o nadarama mo.
fact_bis: Ang mga igbalati — mata, dalunggan, panit, ilong, ug dila — makabati sa palibot ug magpadala og signal sa utok pinaagi sa mga nerve. Ang utok mao ang mosulti kanimo kon unsa ang imong nakita, nadungog, o nabati.

q: What is hidden under a ladybug's colorful hard wing covers?
options: Thin wings it uses to fly
A second pair of hard wings
Long antennae folded up
A sticky pad for gripping leaves
explanation: A ladybug has hard wing covers that hide the thin wings it uses to fly underneath.
fact_tl: May matigas na takip ang pakpak ng ladybug na nagtatago sa manipis na pakpak na ginagamit nito sa paglipad.
fact_bis: Ang ladybug adunay gahi nga tabon sa pako nga nagtago sa nipis nga pako nga gamiton niini sa paglupad.

q: Which fruit is known as the largest fruit that grows on a tree?
options: Jackfruit
Watermelon
Coconut
Pumpkin
explanation: The jackfruit is the largest fruit that grows on a tree — one can weigh as much as a child.
fact_tl: Ang langka ang pinakamalaking prutas na tumutubo sa puno. Pwede itong tumimbang ng kasing-bigat ng isang bata, kaya napakalaki niya kumpara sa ibang prutas!
fact_bis: Ang nangka mao ang pinakadako nga prutas nga motubo sa kahoy. Mahimo kini motimbang sama kabug-at sa usa ka bata, busa dako kaayo kini kompara sa ubang prutas!

q: Why are the eastern coasts of the Philippines generally wetter than the western areas?
options: They face the Pacific Ocean and receive more rainfall
They are at higher elevations where clouds gather
They have more rivers flowing from the mountains
They are closer to the equator where it rains more
explanation: Eastern coasts of the Philippines face the Pacific Ocean and are generally wetter, while western areas are drier for some months of the year.
fact_tl: Ang dami ng ulan sa Pilipinas ay lubos na nagkakaiba sa bawat rehiyon: ang mga silangang baybayin ay karaniwang mas maulan dahil nakaharap sa Pacific, habang ang mga kanlurang bahagi ay mas matuyot sa ilang buwan.
fact_bis: Ang gidaghanon sa ulan sa Pilipinas nagkailaila pag-ayo matag rehiyon: ang mga sidlakang baybayin kasagaran mas ulanon tungod kay nag-atubang sa Pasipiko, samtang ang mga kanluranong lugar mas uga sa pipila ka buwan.

q: Why does La Nina increase the risk of diseases like dengue and leptospirosis in the Philippines?
options: It brings more rain and floods that breed mosquitoes and spread dirty water
It causes drought that forces people to drink unsafe water
It raises temperatures so bacteria multiply faster in food
It weakens typhoons so people go out more and get exposed
explanation: La Nina brings more rain and floods, raising the risk of dengue from mosquitoes and leptospirosis from dirty floodwater.
fact_tl: Dahil mas maraming ulan at baha tuwing La Niña, tumataas ang panganib ng mga sakit gaya ng dengue mula sa lamok at leptospirosis mula sa maruming tubig-baha.
fact_bis: Tungod kay mas daghan ang ulan ug baha sa panahon sa La Niña, motaas ang peligro sa mga sakit sama sa dengue gikan sa lamok ug leptospirosis gikan sa hugaw nga tubig-baha.

q: Why do moving objects seem to slow down and stop on their own?
options: Friction is a hidden force that opposes motion and slows things down
Moving objects naturally run out of energy and stop
Gravity pulls objects sideways and reduces their speed
Air pressure increases as the object moves and pushes back
explanation: Moving things seem to stop on their own because of friction — a hidden force that opposes motion — not because motion naturally stops by itself.
fact_tl: Ang dahilan kung bakit mukhang humihinto mag-isa ang mga gumagalaw na bagay ay ang friction — isang nakatagong puwersang lumalaban sa galaw — at hindi dahil natural na humihinto ang galaw.
fact_bis: Ang rason nganong morag mohunong nga mag-isa ang naglihok nga mga butang mao ang friction — usa ka tinago nga kusog nga mosupak sa lihok — dili tungod kay natural nga mohunong ang lihok.

q: How does the tagak (heron) use its sharp beak to get food?
options: It stabs or snatches small fish, frogs, and insects in the water
It scoops large amounts of water to filter out tiny fish
It cracks open snail shells to eat the soft insides
It digs into mud to pull out worms and grubs
explanation: The tagak has a sharp, spear-like beak that it uses to stab or snatch small fish, frogs, and insects in the water.
fact_tl: May matulis at parang sibat na tuka ang tagak. Ginagamit niya ito para tusukin o sunggaban ang maliliit na isda, palaka, at insekto sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tagak adunay talinis ug murag bangkaw nga sungo. Gigamit niya kini sa pagtuhog o pagsakmit sa gagmay nga isda, baki, ug insekto sa tubig.

q: In which direction do typhoons spin in the northern hemisphere, and why?
options: Counterclockwise, because of the Coriolis effect from Earth's rotation
Clockwise, because warm air rises in a spiral pattern
Counterclockwise, because ocean currents push wind to the left
Clockwise, because the Philippines is near the equator
explanation: Typhoons in the northern hemisphere spin counterclockwise because of the Coriolis effect caused by Earth's rotation.
fact_tl: Ang mga bagyo sa hilagang hemispero (tulad ng Pilipinas) ay umiikot nang kontra sa orasan (counterclockwise) dahil sa Coriolis effect na dulot ng pag-ikot ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang mga bagyo sa hilagang hemispero (sama sa mga nakaapekto sa Pilipinas) nagikot og counterclockwise tungod sa Coriolis effect nga gikan sa pag-ikot sa Yuta.

q: About how old is Methuselah, the oldest known tree?
options: More than 4,800 years old
About 2,000 years old
About 1,000 years old
More than 10,000 years old
explanation: Methuselah, the oldest known tree, is more than 4,800 years old.
fact_tl: Ang Methuselah, ang pinakamatandang puno, ay mahigit na 4,800 taong gulang.
fact_bis: Ang Methuselah, ang pinakatigulang nga kahoy, kapin na sa 4,800 ka tuig ang panuigon.

q: What happens to sugarcane juice when it is boiled for a long time in a large kawa?
options: The water evaporates and the liquid thickens into sugar like muscovado
The juice ferments and turns into a sour liquid
The juice cools and crystallizes into a clear solid
The sugar burns away and only brown water is left
explanation: When sugarcane juice is boiled in a kawa for a long time, the water evaporates and the liquid thickens into sugar such as muscovado.
fact_tl: Sa malaking kawa, pinakukulo ang katas ng tubo nang matagal para sumingaw ang tubig at lumapot ito hanggang maging asukal na tulad ng muscovado.
fact_bis: Sa dako nga kawa, ginpabukal ang duga sa tubo ug dugay aron mosingaw ang tubig ug molapot kini ngadto sa asukal sama sa muscovado.

q: What helpful job do the bacteria living inside our intestines do?
options: They help break down food our body cannot and make some vitamins for us
They destroy harmful chemicals in our food before we absorb them
They keep the intestines clean by eating dead cells
They produce extra stomach acid to speed up digestion
explanation: Helpful bacteria in our intestines break down food our own body cannot digest and even make some vitamins for us.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng ating bituka ay nakatira ang milyon-milyong mabubuting bacteria. Tinutulungan nila tayong masira ang pagkain na hindi kaya ng sarili nating katawan, at ginagawa pa nila ang ilang bitamina para sa atin. Kaya kaibigan natin ang ilang bacteria!
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa atong tinai nagpuyo ang minilyon nga maayong bacteria. Gitabangan nila kita sa pagdugmok sa pagkaon nga dili kaya sa atong lawas, ug naghimo pa sila og pipila ka bitamina para kanato. Busa higala nato ang pipila ka bacteria!

q: Who discovered Boyle's law about the relationship between gas pressure and volume?
options: Robert Boyle, an Irish scientist, in 1662
Isaac Newton, an English scientist, in 1687
Antoine Lavoisier, a French scientist, in 1789
Galileo Galilei, an Italian scientist, in 1610
explanation: Boyle's law was discovered by the Irish scientist Robert Boyle in 1662.
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Boyle ay tinuklas ng Irish na siyentipikong si Robert Boyle noong 1662.
fact_bis: Ang Balaod ni Boyle gitukib sa Irish nga siyentista nga si Robert Boyle niadtong 1662.

q: How is granite formed?
options: From magma that cooled slowly underground
From layers of sand and mud pressed together over time
From shells and bones of sea animals compressed into rock
From lava that cooled quickly on the surface of the Earth
explanation: Granite is an igneous rock that forms when magma cools slowly underground, allowing large crystals to develop.
fact_tl: Ang granite (granito) ay isang igneous na bato na nabuo mula sa magma na dahan-dahang lumamig sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang granite (granito) usa ka igneous nga bato nga gikan sa magma nga hinay-hinay nga mibugnaw sa ilalom sa yuta.

q: What are 'soda straw' stalactites and why do they eventually thicken?
options: They are thin hollow tubes; when the central hole clogs the tube thickens into a regular stalactite
They are wide flat stalactites that look like straws from the side
They form only in caves near soda water springs underground
They are stalactites that grow sideways because of strong cave winds
explanation: Soda straw stalactites are the youngest, thinnest stalactites — hollow tubes that thicken into regular stalactites when the central hole clogs.
fact_tl: Ang pinakabatang stalactite ay tinatawag na 'soda straw' dahil parang manipis na tubong may butas sa gitna — dumadaloy ang tubig sa loob at tumutulo sa dulo, at kapag nabarahan ang butas, lumalapad ito at nagiging tunay na stalactite.
fact_bis: Ang pinakabata nga stalactite gitawag og 'soda straw' kay sama kini sa nipis nga tubo nga adunay buho sa tunga — moagi ang tubig sa sulod ug motulo sa tumoy, ug kon masap-ong ang buho, modako kini ngadto sa tinuod nga stalactite.

q: What does a mother platypus do with her eggs after laying them?
options: She keeps them warm inside a burrow until they hatch
She buries them in wet riverbank mud and leaves them
She carries them in a pouch on her belly like a kangaroo
She places them in a nest of grass floating on the water
explanation: The mother platypus lays one to three eggs inside a burrow and keeps them warm until they hatch.
fact_tl: Ang inahing platypus ay nangingitlog ng isa hanggang tatlong itlog sa loob ng lungga at iniinitan ang mga ito hanggang mapisa.
fact_bis: Ang inahan nga platypus mangitlog ug usa ngadto sa tulo ka itlog sulod sa lungib ug giinitan kini hangtod mapusa.

q: Why is it important to get checked right away if a cough lasts more than two weeks?
options: A cough that long can be TB, and TB is easier to cure when found early
A long cough means you have asthma which needs medicine immediately
Coughs lasting two weeks spread to the lungs and cannot be treated
Only coughs lasting two weeks are contagious to others
explanation: TB is easier to cure when it is found early, so checking right away if a cough lasts more than two weeks is very important.
