fact_tl: Mas madaling gamutin ang TB kapag maagang natuklasan, kaya mahalagang magpatingin agad kapag may ubong tumagal nang mahigit dalawang linggo.
fact_bis: Mas sayon tambalan ang TB kung sayo kini makit-an, mao nga importante nga magpatan-aw dayon kung ang ubo molungtad ug sobra duha ka semana.

q: Besides making electricity, what else can geothermal heat be used for?
options: Warming water, drying crops, or heating buildings
Powering car engines in cold climates
Treating soil to make farms more fertile
Cooling buildings in hot tropical places
explanation: Geothermal heat can be used directly to warm water, dry crops, or heat buildings in cold places, not only to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Bukod sa paggawa ng kuryente, magagamit din nang tuwiran ang init ng geothermal para magpainit ng tubig, magpatuyo ng pananim, o magpainit ng mga gusali sa malamig na lugar.
fact_bis: Gawas sa paghimo og kuryente, ang init sa geothermal magamit usab direkta aron mopainit og tubig, mopauga og pananom, o mopainit og mga building sa bugnaw nga dapit.

q: How did the invention of the light bulb change people's daily lives?
options: People could work, study, and play safely even after dark
People no longer needed to cook food on open fires
People could travel faster at night using bright roads
People stopped using wood for fuel because of the new light
explanation: The light bulb changed life because people could now work, study, and play even after dark, and it was safer than candles or gas lamps.
fact_tl: Binago ng bombilya ang buhay dahil nakapagtrabaho, nakapag-aral, at nakapaglaro na ang mga tao kahit gabi, at mas ligtas ito kaysa sa apoy ng kandila o gas-lamp.
fact_bis: Giusab sa bombilya ang kinabuhi kay nakatrabaho, nakatuon, ug nakaduwa na ang mga tawo bisan gabii, ug mas luwas kini kaysa sa kalayo sa kandila o gas-lamp.

q: About how long can a coconut palm tree live and keep producing fruit?
options: More than 60 years
About 20 years
About 10 years
Up to 40 years
explanation: A coconut palm can live and bear fruit for more than 60 years, and can grow nearly 30 meters tall.
fact_tl: Ang puno ng niyog ay maaaring umabot ng halos 30 metro ang taas, kasingtaas ng isang gusaling 9 na palapag, at maaaring mabuhay at mamunga ng higit sa 60 taon.
fact_bis: Ang puno sa lubi makaabot og halos 30 metros ang gitas-on, sama katas sa usa ka 9 ka andana nga building, ug mabuhi ug mamunga sulod sa kapin sa 60 ka tuig.

q: How does Neptune's surface gravity compare to Earth's?
options: Neptune's gravity is about 11 m/s², slightly stronger than Earth's 9.8 m/s².
Neptune's gravity is much weaker than Earth's because it is so far from the Sun.
Neptune's gravity is exactly the same as Earth's since both are large planets.
Neptune's gravity is about half of Earth's because it is made mostly of gas.
explanation: Neptune's surface gravity is about 11 m/s², which is slightly stronger than Earth's 9.8 m/s².
fact_tl: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw ng Neptune ay halos 11 m/s², bahagyang mas malakas kaysa sa 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa ibabaw sa Neptune mga 11 m/s², gamay nga mas kusog kaysa sa 9.8 m/s² sa Yuta.

q: What is the dark writing part of a pencil actually made of?
options: Metal lead mixed with iron filings
Graphite mixed with clay
Charcoal mixed with wax
Carbon powder mixed with rubber
explanation: Pencil 'lead' is not metal lead at all — it is graphite mixed with clay.
fact_tl: Ang 'lead' ng lapis ay hindi tingga kundi graphite na hinaluan ng luwad (clay).
fact_bis: Ang 'lead' sa lapis dili tingga kondili graphite nga gisagolan og clay.

q: Why do many swallows travel very long distances when the seasons change?
options: They fly away to find warmer water to swim in.
They migrate to find more insects to eat.
They move to build bigger nests in new places.
They leave to avoid meeting other types of birds.
explanation: Many swallows migrate very long distances when the seasons change to find more insects.

q: Why is the pilandok an endangered animal in the Philippines?
options: It is endangered because of hunting and loss of its forest home.
It is endangered because it cannot find enough water during dry seasons.
It is endangered because it gets sick from diseases spread by other animals.
It is endangered because it produces very few babies each year.
explanation: The pilandok is endangered because of hunting and loss of its home, so it is now protected.
fact_tl: Ang pilandok ay nanganganib mawala dahil sa pangangaso at pagkawala ng tirahan nito kaya ito ay protektado.
fact_bis: Ang pilandok nameligro nga mawala tungod sa pagpangayam ug pagkawala sa iyang puy-anan mao nga gipanalipdan kini.

q: About how much higher could you jump on the Moon compared to on Earth?
options: About two times higher
About ten times higher
About six times higher
About three times higher
explanation: Because of the Moon's weak gravity, you could jump about six times higher than on Earth.
fact_tl: Sa mahinang grabidad ng Buwan, kaya mong tumalon halos anim na beses (6x) na mas mataas kaysa sa Daigdig.
fact_bis: Tungod sa huyang nga grabidad sa Bulan, makaambak ka mga unom ka pilo (6x) nga mas taas kaysa sa Yuta.

q: How does the osprey catch its food from the water?
options: It waits on a rock and snatches fish as they swim past.
It dives toward the water and grabs fish using its talons.
It uses its beak to scoop fish from just below the surface.
It chases fish through shallow water by running along the shore.
explanation: The osprey dives toward the water and snatches fish using its talons.
fact_tl: May mga ibong mandaragit tulad ng osprey na sumisisid sa tubig at sinusunggaban ang isda gamit ang kanilang mga kuko.
fact_bis: Adunay mga langgam nga manunukob sama sa osprey nga mosalom sa tubig ug modakop og isda gamit ang ilang mga kuko.

q: Why does a helium balloon float up into the air?
options: Helium is hotter than the surrounding air, so it pushes upward.
Helium is lighter in color than air, which makes it rise.
Helium is less dense than the surrounding air, so it floats up.
Helium has more air pressure inside, which pushes it upward.
explanation: A helium balloon rises because helium is less dense than the surrounding air, just like floating works in water.
fact_tl: Pumapaitaas ang lobong puno ng helium dahil mas mababa ang densidad ng helium kaysa hangin sa paligid, gaya ng pag-angat ng bagay sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang lobo nga puno og helium mosaka kay ang helium mas ubos og densidad kay sa hangin sa palibot, sama sa paglutaw sa tubig.

q: Why are malnourished children more likely to get pneumonia?
options: Because malnutrition makes the lungs grow smaller and easier to infect.
Because their body defenses against disease are weak due to poor nutrition.
Because malnourished children spend more time outdoors in cold weather.
Because lack of food causes the lungs to fill with fluid on their own.
explanation: Children who are malnourished are more likely to get pneumonia because their defenses against disease are weak.
fact_tl: Mas tinatamaan ng pulmonya ang mga batang malnourished dahil mahina ang kanilang depensa laban sa sakit.
fact_bis: Ang mga bata nga kulang sa sustansiya mas dali takdan sa pulmonya kay huyang ang ilang panalipod batok sa sakit.

q: Why is shark finning so harmful to ocean ecosystems?
options: It causes sharks to swim to deeper water where they eat all the small fish.
It cuts off shark fins and wastes the body, causing huge drops in shark populations and disrupting coral reefs.
It forces sharks to migrate away from the Philippines and upset currents.
It prevents sharks from reproducing because they lose their sense of direction.
explanation: Shark finning cuts off fins and discards the body, causing huge drops in shark populations and disrupting coral reef ecosystems that depend on them.
fact_tl: Ang shark finning — ang pagputol ng mga palikpik ng pating at pagtapon ng katawan pabalik sa dagat — ay nagdudulot ng malaking pagbaba ng populasyon ng pating at nagpapagulo ng mga ekosistema ng coral reef na umaasa sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang shark finning — ang pagputol sa mga palikpik sa pating ug pagtapon sa lawas balik sa dagat — naghinungdan og dakong pagkunhod sa populasyon sa pating ug nagpagulo sa mga coral reef ecosystem nga nagsalig kanila.

q: Why do cold-blooded animals need less food than warm-blooded ones?
options: They have smaller stomachs so they cannot eat large amounts.
They eat food that has more calories, so they need fewer meals.
They do not spend energy making their own body heat.
They sleep most of the day and only eat once a week.
explanation: Cold-blooded animals need less food because they do not spend energy making their own heat.
fact_tl: Ang mga hayop na malamig ang dugo ay nangangailangan ng mas kaunting pagkain dahil hindi sila gumagastos ng enerhiya para gumawa ng init.
fact_bis: Ang mga hayop nga bugnaw ug dugo nanginahanglan ug gamay nga pagkaon kay wala sila mogasto ug enerhiya sa paghimo ug kainit.

q: What makes the bird of paradise plant unusual compared to most garden flowers?
options: Its flowers are shaped like colorful butterflies with large spotted wings.
Its orange and blue flowers look like the head of a flying bird.
Its giant white flowers bloom only at night and smell very sweet.
Its flowers change color from pink to yellow as they open.
explanation: The bird of paradise is a garden plant whose orange and blue flowers look like the head of a flying bird.
fact_tl: Ang bird of paradise ay isang halamang pang-hardin na may kahel at asul na bulaklak na kahawig ng ulo ng lumilipad na ibon.
fact_bis: Ang bird of paradise usa ka tanom sa hardin nga ang kahel ug asul nga bulak morag ulo sa naglupad nga langgam.

q: How do mild burns and serious burns differ in what they do to the skin?
options: Mild burns cause blisters right away, while serious burns only redden the skin.
Mild burns only redden the skin, while serious burns cause blisters or deeper damage.
Mild burns are painful but heal overnight, while serious burns are painless.
Mild burns leave permanent scars, while serious burns heal without any mark.
explanation: Some burns only redden the skin, while serious burns cause blisters or deeper damage.
fact_tl: May paso na bahagyang namumula lang at may malalang paso na may lintos o malalim na pinsala.
fact_bis: Adunay paso nga mapula lang ang panit, ug adunay grabe nga paso nga adunay lubo o lawom nga kadaot.

q: What does one joule (1 J) of energy represent?
options: The energy used when a force of 1 newton moves something 1 meter.
The energy released when 1 kilogram of water is heated by 1 degree.
The energy produced when 1 watt of electricity flows for 1 hour.
The energy stored in 1 gram of fuel when it is completely burned.
explanation: One joule is the energy used when a force of 1 newton moves something 1 meter.
fact_tl: Ang isang joule (1 J) ay ang enerhiyang ginagamit kapag may 1 newton na puwersa na gumalaw ng 1 metro.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka joule (1 J) mao ang enerhiya nga gigamit kon ang 1 newton nga kusog magpalihok ug 1 metro.

q: Which of the following best describes the atmosphere?
options: A thick layer of water vapor found only at the top of high mountains.
The thick layer of air surrounding Earth that holds oxygen, regulates temperature, and is divided into layers.
A thin shell of oxygen gas floating just above the clouds where planes fly.
The region of space beyond Earth where the Sun's gravity is strongest.
explanation: The atmosphere is the thick layer of air surrounding Earth that holds oxygen, regulates temperature, protects from harmful rays, and is divided into layers.
fact_tl: Ang atmosphere ay ang makapal na hangin na nakapaligid sa Earth. Naglalaman ito ng oxygen na hinihinga natin, pinipigilan ang sobrang init at lamig, at nagpoprotekta sa atin mula sa nakakasamang sinag ng araw. Nahahati ito sa mga layer.
fact_bis: Ang atmosphere mao ang baga nga hangin nga naglibot sa Earth. Naglangkob kini og oxygen nga atong giginhawa, mopugong sa sobra nga kainit ug kabugnaw, ug manalipod kanato gikan sa makadaot nga silaw sa adlaw. Nabahin kini sa mga layer.

q: How does 'grounding' get rid of static electricity on an object?
options: Grounding sprays water on the object to wash the static charge away.
Grounding lets the static charge flow through metal into the earth, making the object neutral.
Grounding heats the object so the static charge evaporates into the air.
Grounding surrounds the object with rubber so the charge cannot escape.
explanation: Grounding lets the extra static charge flow away into the earth, usually through metal, so the object becomes balanced or neutral again.
fact_tl: Maaaring alisin ang static charge sa pamamagitan ng 'grounding' — paghayaan na dumaloy ang charge papunta sa lupa, kadalasan sa pamamagitan ng metal. Kaya nawawala ang sobrang charge at nagiging balanse o neutral muli ang bagay.
fact_bis: Mahimong tangtangon ang static charge pinaagi sa 'grounding' — pagpasagad nga moagos ang charge ngadto sa yuta, kasagaran pinaagi sa metal. Mawala niini ang sobra nga charge mao nga mahimong balanse o neutral pag-usab ang butang.

q: What do sebaceous glands in the skin produce, and what can happen when they get blocked?
options: They produce sweat to cool the body, and when blocked they cause dry skin.
They produce sebum oil that keeps skin moist, and when blocked can cause pimples.
They produce keratin to harden the skin, and when blocked they cause rashes.
They produce melanin to add color to the skin, and when blocked cause white spots.
explanation: Sebaceous glands produce oil called sebum that keeps skin moist and flexible; when blocked, the oil can cause pimples (acne).
fact_tl: Ang mga sebaceous glands sa dermis ay gumagawa ng mantika (sebum) na nagpapanatiling basa at malambot ang balat; kapag ang mga ito ay nagsara, maaaring mabuo ang mga pimple.
fact_bis: Ang mga sebaceous gland sa dermis nagpatubas ug mantika nga gitawag sebum nga nagpadayon sa panit nga basa ug humok; kung ang mga gland mabasol ang mantika mahimong hinungdan sa mga pimple.

q: How many groups (vertical columns) are in the periodic table?
explanation: There are 18 groups (vertical columns) in the periodic table.
fact_tl: May 18 group (patayong hanay) sa periodic table.
fact_bis: Adunay 18 ka group (patindog nga linya) sa periodic table.

q: Where do most detergents get their cleaning chemicals from?
options: From animal fat boiled with wood ash
From plant oils extracted from coconut trees
From petroleum (a fossil fuel)
From mineral salts dissolved in sea water
explanation: Most detergents are man-made from chemicals that come from petroleum, not from animal fat.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng detergent ay gawa ng tao mula sa mga kemikal na galing sa petrolyo, hindi sa taba ng hayop.
fact_bis: Ang kadaghanan sa detergent hinimo sa tao gikan sa mga kemikal nga gikan sa petrolyo, dili gikan sa tambok sa hayop.

q: What is a gemstone?
options: A common rock melted and shaped into beads for decoration.
A type of fossil bone that has hardened into a shiny mineral over millions of years.
A rare, beautiful mineral that is cut and polished to make jewelry.
A chunk of metal found in riverbeds and polished until it looks like glass.
explanation: A gemstone is a rare, beautiful mineral that is cut and polished to make jewelry, such as diamond and ruby.
fact_tl: Ang gemstone o hiyas ay isang bihira at magandang mineral na pinuputol at pinakikintab para gawing alahas, tulad ng diamond at ruby.
fact_bis: Ang gemstone usa ka talagsaon ug nindot nga mineral nga giputol ug gipasinaw aron himoong alahas, sama sa diamond ug ruby.

q: Why would a Filipino child almost never encounter a venomous platypus?
options: Because platypuses only come out at night and are too shy to be seen.
Because the platypus lives only in Australia and is not kept as a pet in the Philippines.
Because platypuses are extinct and exist only in zoos outside Asia.
Because platypuses lose their venom in warm tropical climates.
explanation: The platypus lives only in Australia and is not kept as a pet in the Philippines, so Filipino children almost never encounter one.
fact_tl: Makakasalubong ba ng batang Pilipino ang platypus na may kamandag? Halos imposible, dahil ang platypus ay nasa Australia lang at hindi inaalagang hayop dito sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Mahimo bang masugatan sa batang Pilipino ang platypus nga adunay hilo? Halos imposible, kay ang platypus naa ra sa Australia ug dili binuhi nga mananap dinhi sa Pilipinas.

q: Why are coral reefs sometimes called the 'rainforests of the sea'?
options: Because they grow very tall like trees and block sunlight just like a forest.
Because so many different kinds of life live there, just like in rainforests.
Because they produce oxygen that tropical rainforest animals need to breathe.
Because they are found only in the same countries that have tropical rainforests.
explanation: Coral reefs are called the 'rainforests of the sea' because so many different kinds of life live there.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na 'gubat ng dagat' ang coral reef dahil napakaraming iba't ibang uri ng buhay ang nakatira rito.
fact_bis: Gitawag nga 'lasang sa dagat' ang bahura tungod kay daghan kaayong nagkalainlaing matang sa kinabuhi ang nagpuyo niini.

q: What gives sapin-sapin its colorful separate layers?
options: Different types of fruit are pressed and dried between sheets of rice flour.
Ground glutinous rice batter is split into different colors and stacked in layers.
Each layer uses a different type of sugar that turns a different color when cooked.
Food coloring is painted on a single white rice cake after it is cooked.
explanation: Sapin-sapin is made from ground glutinous rice batter split into different colors and stacked, creating separate colorful layers.
fact_tl: Ang sapin-sapin ay kakaning gawa sa galapong (giniling na malagkit na bigas) na hinati sa iba't ibang kulay at pinatong-patong, kaya nakikita mo ang magkakahiwalay na makukulay na layer.
fact_bis: Ang sapin-sapin usa ka kakanin nga hinimo sa giniling nga pilit nga bugas nga gibahin sa lainlaing kolor ug gipatong-patong, mao nga makita nimo ang nagkalain-laing kolor nga layer.

q: What do some lichens use instead of or together with an alga to make food from sunlight?
options: Moss spores that shelter inside the lichen's body
Cyanobacteria, which also make food using sunlight
Tiny animal cells that convert sunlight into nutrients
Root-like threads that pull nutrients from rocks underground
explanation: Some lichens use cyanobacteria instead of or along with an alga, and these also make food using sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang ibang lichen ay gumagamit ng cyanobacteria sa halip o kasama ng alga, at ito rin ang gumagawa ng pagkain gamit ang sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang ubang lichen mogamit og cyanobacteria imbis o kuyog sa alga, ug kini sila usab maghimo og pagkaon gamit ang adlaw.

q: How do ocean waves cause coastal cliffs to collapse?
options: Waves spray saltwater onto the top of the cliff, dissolving the rock until it crumbles.
Waves carry away all the sand at the cliff's base in one big storm, causing it to fall.
Waves constantly pound the base of the cliff, carving it away until the upper part collapses.
Waves push against the cliff's face with wind pressure strong enough to topple it.
explanation: Waves constantly pound the base of a cliff, slowly carving out the bottom; when the upper part is no longer supported, it collapses into the sea.
fact_tl: Sa tabing-dagat, ang patuloy na paghampas ng alon ay unti-unting naghuhukay sa ilalim ng bangin. Kapag wala nang sumusuporta sa itaas na bahagi, gumuguho ito at nahuhulog sa dagat.
fact_bis: Sa baybayon, ang padayon nga pagbunal sa balod hinay-hinay nga mokutkot sa ilalom sa pangpang. Kung wala nay magsuporta sa ibabaw nga bahin, maguba kini ug mahulog sa dagat.

q: What effect do sugary drinks like soft drinks have on blood sugar?
options: They raise blood sugar very slowly because the sugar is mixed with water.
They lower blood sugar because the liquid dilutes glucose in the bloodstream.
They raise blood sugar very quickly.
They have no effect on blood sugar because the sugar is already dissolved.
explanation: Sugary drinks like soft drinks raise blood sugar very quickly.
fact_tl: Ang matatamis na inumin tulad ng softdrinks ay mabilis na nagpapataas ng asukal sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang tam-is nga mga ilimnon sama sa softdrinks paspas nga magpataas sa asukal sa dugo.

q: What kind of substance is calcium, and where does it originally come from in nature?
options: A type of vitamin produced by plants during photosynthesis.
A liquid nutrient found naturally in all fresh water sources.
A mineral found in nature in rocks and soil that ends up in our food.
A gas that living things absorb from the air during breathing.
explanation: Calcium is a mineral found in rocks and soil; plants and animals take it in, and it ends up in the food we eat.
fact_tl: Ano ba talaga ang calcium? Isa itong mineral, ibig sabihin isang sangkap na matatagpuan sa kalikasan tulad ng sa mga bato at lupa. Kinukuha ito ng mga halaman at hayop, at sa huli ay napupunta sa pagkain na kinakain natin.
fact_bis: Unsa gyud ang calcium? Usa kini ka mineral, buot pasabot usa ka sangkap nga makit-an sa kinaiyahan sama sa mga bato ug yuta. Kuhaon kini sa mga tanom ug mananap, ug sa kataposan moadto sa pagkaon nga atong gikaon.

q: How is the water cycle in the Philippines different from colder countries?
options: In the Philippines, water vapor becomes ice before turning to rain, just like cold countries.
In the Philippines, water vapor becomes rain and skips the snow step that happens in cold places.
In the Philippines, water never evaporates because it is too hot for clouds to form.
In the Philippines, the water cycle runs backward — rain rises and returns to the clouds first.
explanation: In the Philippines, water vapor becomes rain in the water cycle — it skips the snow step that happens in cold places.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang singaw ng tubig ay nagiging ulan agad sa siklo ng tubig — hindi ito dumadaan sa yugto ng niyebe gaya sa malamig na lugar, kaya ulan ang laging bumabalik sa lupa.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang alisngaw sa tubig mahimong ulan dayon sa siklo sa tubig — wala kini moagi sa yugto sa niyebe nga mahitabo sa bugnaw nga dapit, mao nga ulan ang kanunayng mobalik sa yuta.

q: What is the civet (musang) known for in the Philippines, besides being a night-active mammal?
options: Producing honey that is harvested from forest beehives it tends at night.
Being used to make civet coffee (kape alamid) from beans it has eaten.
Carrying young on its back like a kangaroo while it forages at night.
Spinning a silk-like fiber from its fur used to make traditional cloth.
explanation: The civet is a night-active mammal that eats fruit and insects, and in the Philippines it is known for civet coffee (kape alamid).
fact_tl: Ang musang o civet ay isang mamalyang aktibo sa gabi na kumakain ng prutas at insekto, at sa Pilipinas ay kilala dahil sa kapeng alamid.
fact_bis: Ang musang o civet usa ka mananap nga aktibo sa gabii nga mokaon ug prutas ug insekto, ug sa Pilipinas ilado kini tungod sa kape nga alamid.

q: Some deep-sea animals glow on their underside — what is one reason for this?
options: To warm up their body in the cold deep ocean water.
To warn predators that they taste bad and should be avoided.
To hide by matching the faint light from above so they are hard to spot from below.
To attract small fish by looking like a light source from every direction.
explanation: Some animals glow on their underside to hide — they are hard to spot as a shadow when seen from below.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng nagliliwanag na hayop ay gumagamit nito para manghuli. Ang anglerfish ay nagliliwanag para mang-akit, pero ang ibang hayop ay nagliliwanag sa ilalim ng katawan nila para magtago — para mahirap silang makitang anino kapag tinitingala mula sa ibaba.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga nagsiga nga hayop naggamit niini aron mangayam. Ang anglerfish nagsiga aron modani, apan ang ubang hayop nagsiga sa ilawom sa ilang lawas aron motago — aron lisod sila makita isip anino kung tan-awon gikan sa ubos.

q: When a child has a fever, why should you use light clothing instead of thick blankets?
options: Thick blankets carry germs that can make the fever worse.
Thick blankets press on the body and raise blood pressure dangerously.
Thick blankets trap heat in the body and prevent the extra heat from escaping.
Thick blankets absorb all the body's water and cause dehydration faster.
explanation: Too many blankets trap heat in the body; light clothing is better so the extra heat can escape.
fact_tl: May akala na dapat balutin ng makapal na kumot ang batang may lagnat para pawisan. Pero kapag sobrang init, hindi makawala ang init ng katawan. Mas mabuti ang magaan na damit para makalabas ang sobrang init.
fact_bis: Naay naghunahuna nga ang batang hilanaton angay putoson og baga nga habol aron singoton. Apan kung sobra ka init, dili makagawas ang kainit sa lawas. Mas maayo ang magaan nga sinina aron makagawas ang sobra nga kainit.

q: What do the different colors on a geologic map represent?
options: Different types or ages of rock found under the land surface.
Different depths of water below the soil in underground rivers.
Different danger zones for earthquakes based on distance from volcanoes.
Different elevations of the land, like a normal topographic map.
explanation: On a geologic map, each color represents a type or age of rock that underlies the land; in the Philippines, these maps are made by the Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).
fact_tl: Ang geologic map ay isang espesyal na mapa na gumagamit ng iba't ibang kulay at simbolo para ipakita kung anong uri ng bato ang nasa lupa; ang bawat kulay ay kumakatawan sa isang uri o edad ng bato; ang mga mapa na ito ay ginagawa ng Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB) ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang geologic map usa ka espesyal nga mapa nga naggamit og lain-laing kolor ug simbolo sa pagpakita kung unsa nga klase sa bato ang naa sa ilalim sa yuta; ang matag kolor nagrepresenta sa usa ka klase o edad sa bato; kining mga mapa gihimo sa Pilipinas sa Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).

q: Why does pouring hot water on a stuck metal lid help to open a jar?
options: Hot water rusts the metal slightly, breaking the seal around the lid.
The steam from hot water pushes against the lid and pops it open.
The metal lid expands when heated, making it looser and easier to turn.
Hot water softens the glass jar so the lid can be pushed off more easily.
explanation: A stuck metal lid opens more easily after hot water is poured on it because the metal expands and loosens.
fact_tl: Madaling mabuksan ang masikip na metal na takip kapag binuhusan ng mainit na tubig dahil lumalaki ang metal at lumuluwag ito.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga metal nga takip sayon na nga abrihan kon buboan ug init nga tubig kay molapad ang metal ug moluag.

q: What happens to a wasp's paper nest after one year?
options: Worker wasps seal the old nest to keep it safe for use the next season.
The nest is abandoned when the cold season comes, and a queen builds a brand-new one next season.
The nest is carried to a warmer place by the swarm when they migrate.
The nest hardens over winter and becomes stronger for the next colony to move in.
explanation: Many wasps' paper nests are used for only one year — abandoned when the cold season comes — and a queen builds a brand-new nest the next season.
fact_tl: Ang papel na pugad ng maraming putakti ay ginagamit nang isang taon lang — iniiwan ito sa taglamig at gumagawa ng bagong pugad ang reyna sa susunod na panahon.
fact_bis: Ang papel nga salag sa daghang putakti gamiton lang sulod sa usa ka tuig — biyaan kini panahon sa tugnaw, ug ang reyna magtukod og bag-ong salag sa sunod nga panahon.

q: Why does a pufferfish puff up its body?
options: To store extra air so it can breathe on land for short periods.
To scare away predators by making itself look much bigger.
To help it float to the surface and warm up in the sunlight.
To squeeze into tight spaces in coral reefs to find food.
explanation: The pufferfish puffs up to look much bigger and scare away animals that want to eat it.
fact_tl: Namamaga ang butete para magmukhang mas malaki at takutin ang mga isdang gustong kumain dito.
fact_bis: Mohubag ang butete aron magpakita nga mas dako ug hadlokon ang mga isda nga gustong mokaon niini.

q: How do extra greenhouse gases affect Earth's climate?
options: They cool the planet by blocking more of the Sun's energy before it reaches the surface.
They create an imbalance between heat received and heat released, causing the planet to warm.
They have no effect because the planet always releases exactly as much heat as it receives.
They absorb all incoming sunlight, making nights cooler and days hotter than normal.
explanation: Additional greenhouse gases create an imbalance between heat received from the Sun and heat radiated back into space, which warms the planet.
fact_tl: Ang klima ng Mundo ay nagdedepende sa balanse ng init na natatanggap mula sa araw at init na ibinubuga pabalik sa kalawakan; ang mga karagdagang greenhouse gas ay nagdudulot ng imbalance na nagpapainit ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang klima sa Yuta nagdepende sa balanse tali sa init nga natanggap gikan sa adlaw ug init nga gi-radiate balik sa kalawakan; ang mga karagdagang greenhouse gas nagmugna og imbalance nga nagpainit sa planeta.

q: How many centavos (sentimo) are equal to one Philippine peso?
explanation: One peso is equal to 100 centavos (sentimo).
fact_tl: Ang isang piso ay katumbas ng 100 sentimo (centavo).
fact_bis: Ang usa ka piso katumbas sa 100 ka sentimo (centavo).

q: What is one way to show that air has weight?
options: Blowing air through a straw makes the straw bend, proving air pushes things.
A balloon filled with air is a little heavier than an empty balloon.
A fan moves when you turn it on because air pressure pushes its blades.
Warm air rises above cold air, showing that air can move up and down.
explanation: A balloon filled with air is a little heavier than an empty one, proving that air is real matter with mass.
fact_tl: Kahit hindi natin ito nakikita, may timbang ang hangin. Kapag pinuno mo ng hangin ang isang lobo, ito ay bahagyang bumibigat kaysa sa walang hangin — patunay na ang gas ay tunay na bagay na may mass.
fact_bis: Bisan dili nato kini makita, ang hangin adunay timbang. Kung pun-on nimo og hangin ang lobo, mahimo kining gamay nga mas bug-at kaysa walay sulod — pamatuod nga ang gas tinuod nga butang nga adunay mass.

q: Why is it wrong to say every animal with forward-facing eyes is a predator?
options: Because predators actually have eyes on the sides to watch for danger while they hunt.
Because humans and monkeys have forward eyes but are not predators — they need depth vision to leap and grab things.
Because forward eyes only help animals see in the dark, not to hunt prey.
Because most predators use smell rather than sight, so eye position does not matter.
explanation: Humans and monkeys also have forward eyes but are not predators — they need depth vision to leap between branches and grab things.
fact_tl: Maling akala na lahat ng may matang nakaharap ay mandaragit. Ang tao at unggoy ay may harapang mata rin, pero hindi mandaragit — kailangan nila ang lalim ng tingin para tumalon sa sanga at humawak ng bagay.
fact_bis: Sayop nga pagtuo nga ang tanang may mata nga nag-atubang sa unahan maoy mandaragit. Ang tawo ug unggoy adunay nag-atubang usab nga mata, apan dili sila mandaragit — gikinahanglan nila ang giladmon sa panan-aw aron molukso sa sanga ug mokupot og butang.

q: What causes a tsunami, unlike an ordinary ocean wave?
options: Very strong surface winds pushing huge amounts of water toward the shore.
A strong earthquake or eruption under the sea that raises a giant wave.
The Moon's gravity pulling more water than usual toward one side of the ocean.
A sudden drop in water temperature that makes the sea surface rise all at once.
explanation: A tsunami is caused by a strong earthquake or eruption under the sea, which raises a giant wave that crashes onto the shore.
fact_tl: Ang tsunami ay hindi karaniwang alon na gawa ng hangin — ito ay dulot ng malakas na lindol o pagsabog sa ilalim ng dagat, na nagtataas ng higanteng alon na humahampas sa baybayin.
fact_bis: Ang tsunami dili ordinaryong balod nga gibuhat sa hangin — gipahinabo kini sa kusog nga linog o pagbuto ilalom sa dagat, nga mopataas og dakong balod nga mohampak sa baybayon.

q: What does freezing food do to microbes inside it?
options: Freezing kills all microbes instantly so food stays safe forever in a freezer.
Freezing almost stops microbes from growing but does not kill all of them.
Freezing has no effect on microbes because they can survive any temperature.
Freezing causes microbes to multiply faster so food must be eaten within hours of thawing.
explanation: In a freezer the cold almost stops microbes from growing, but they are not all killed.
fact_tl: Sa freezer, halos huminto ang pagdami ng mikrobyo dahil sobrang lamig, pero hindi sila lubusang namamatay.
fact_bis: Sa freezer, hapit mohunong ang pagdaghan sa mikrobyo tungod sa hilabihang kabugnaw, apan dili sila tanan mamatay.

q: Why do many fish sanctuaries also protect coral reefs?
options: Because coral reefs produce the oxygen that fish need to breathe underwater.
Because reefs are the home of fish, and healthy coral gives fish a place to live and find food.
Because coral reefs mark the boundary of a sanctuary so boats know where to stop.
Because coral absorbs fish waste and keeps the water clean enough for fish to survive.
explanation: Many fish sanctuaries protect coral reefs because reefs are the home of fish; inside a sanctuary, reef-damaging fishing is banned so coral stays healthy and more fish have a place to live.
fact_tl: Maraming fish sanctuary ang nagpoprotekta din ng coral reef (bahura) dahil ito ang tahanan ng mga isda. Sa loob ng sanctuary, bawal ang pangingisda na sumisira sa coral, tulad ng paggamit ng dinamita o lason. Kapag malusog ang coral, mas maraming isda ang may matitirhan at pagkukunan ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Daghang fish sanctuary nagaprotekta usab sa coral reef (bahura) kay kini ang puy-anan sa mga isda. Sa sulod sa sanctuary, bawal ang pangisda nga makadaot sa coral, sama sa paggamit og dinamita o hilo. Kung himsog ang coral, mas daghang isda ang adunay puy-anan ug makakuha og pagkaon.

q: What important thing did Alan Turing help accomplish during World War II?
options: He helped break the secret Enigma code used by enemy forces.
He invented the first radar system to detect enemy aircraft.
He designed the first nuclear submarine used in naval warfare.
He created a powerful cannon that helped end the war in Europe.
explanation: Alan Turing helped break the secret Enigma code during World War II.
fact_tl: Si Alan Turing ay tumulong bumasag ng sikretong Enigma code noong World War II.
fact_bis: Si Alan Turing mitabang sa pagbungkag sa sekretong Enigma code panahon sa World War II.

q: Which two elements did Marie Curie discover?
options: Uranium and thorium
Polonium and radium
Plutonium and carbon
Radon and iodine
explanation: Marie Curie discovered two new elements called polonium and radium, and she was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Marie Curie ang dalawang bagong elemento na polonium at radium, at siya ang unang babaeng nanalo ng Nobel Prize.
fact_bis: Nadiskobrehan ni Marie Curie ang duha ka bag-ong elemento nga polonium ug radium, ug siya ang unang babaye nga nidaog og Nobel Prize.

q: Why are fast-growing trees like ipil-ipil and gmelina planted first during reforestation?
options: Because they produce fruit that attracts birds to spread seeds of other trees quickly.
Because they quickly cover and shade bare ground after it has been stripped of trees.
Because their roots go deepest and immediately prevent floods after deforestation.
Because they are the only trees that can survive in soil that has been fully cleared.
explanation: Fast-growing trees like ipil-ipil and gmelina are planted first in reforestation to quickly cover and shade bare ground.
fact_tl: Mabilis tumubong puno tulad ng ipil-ipil at gmelina ang madalas itanim muna sa reforestation upang mabilis matakpan at malilim ang hubad na lupa.
fact_bis: Paspas motubo nga mga kahoy sama sa ipil-ipil ug gmelina ang sagad itanom una sa reforestation aron paspas matabonan ug malandongan ang hubo nga yuta.

q: What happens to rainfall patterns worldwide when the Walker Circulation weakens during El Niño?
options: The Walker Circulation strengthens trade winds that push rain to all continents equally.
Warm water shifts east, altering rainfall patterns worldwide as the circulation weakens.
All tropical rainfall stops completely until the Walker Circulation restarts.
Rainfall increases everywhere because the weakened circulation traps more moisture in clouds.
explanation: When the Walker Circulation weakens during El Niño, warm water shifts east and alters rainfall patterns worldwide.
fact_tl: Ang Walker Circulation ay isang east-west loop ng atmospheric circulation sa Pacific; kapag humina ito (El Nino), ang mainit na tubig ay gumagalaw patungo sa silangan at nagbabago ng pattern ng ulan sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang Walker Circulation usa ka east-west loop sa atmospheric circulation sa Pacific; sa dihang mohuyang kini (El Nino), ang mainit nga tubig nagpombalhin sa sidlakan ug nagbag-o sa mga pattern sa ulan sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: How many atoms make up one water molecule (H₂O)?
options: 1 hydrogen atom and 2 oxygen atoms
2 hydrogen atoms and 2 oxygen atoms
3 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom
2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom
explanation: One water molecule (H₂O) has 2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom, for a total of 3 atoms.
fact_tl: Ang isang molekula ng tubig (H2O) ay may 2 atomo ng hydrogen at 1 atomo ng oxygen.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka molekula sa tubig (H2O) adunay 2 ka atomo sa hydrogen ug 1 ka atomo sa oxygen.

q: How do seismographs help protect people from tsunamis?
options: They measure wave height in the ocean so boats know when to return to shore.
They detect earthquakes under the sea so coastal people can be warned to move to higher ground.
They track cloud formations that appear just before a tsunami reaches the shore.
They measure water temperature changes that happen minutes before a tsunami hits.
explanation: When seismographs detect a strong earthquake under the sea, people on the coast can quickly be warned to move to higher ground.
fact_tl: Isang mahalagang gamit ng seismograph ay ang pagbibigay ng maagang babala sa tsunami: kapag nakaramdam ito ng malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat, agad maipapaalam sa mga tao sa baybayin na umakyat sa mataas na lugar.
fact_bis: Usa ka importante nga gamit sa seismograph mao ang paghatag og sayo nga pasidaan sa tsunami: kung makamatngon kini og kusog nga linog ilalom sa dagat, dali nga mapahibalo ang mga tawo sa baybayon nga motungas sa habog nga dapit.

q: What is fiberglass made of, and why is it useful for making boats and helmets?
options: It is made of steel threads coated in rubber, making it heavy and waterproof.
It is made of glass fibers in plastic resin, making it light, strong, and corrosion-resistant.
It is made of compressed sand and clay, making it fireproof and very cheap.
It is made of carbon strands in aluminum, making it flexible and heat-resistant.
explanation: Fiberglass is a composite of glass fibers embedded in plastic resin; it is light, strong, and corrosion-resistant, so it is used for boats, helmets, and car body parts.
fact_tl: Ang fiberglass ay isang composite material na gawa sa mga thread ng salamin na naka-embed sa plastic resin — ito ay magaan, matibay, at lumalaban sa kumakalawang, kaya ginagamit sa mga bangka at helmet.
fact_bis: Ang fiberglass usa ka composite material nga gihimo sa mga thread sa salamin nga naka-embed sa plastic resin; magaan, lig-on, ug dili madaling korosyon, mao nga gigamit sa mga bangka, helmet, ug mga bahagi sa katawan sa sasakyan.

q: What is wrong about thinking that the gaps between Mohs hardness numbers are all equal?
options: The Mohs scale actually has 20 numbers, not 10, so each gap is smaller than people think.
Diamond (10) is far, far harder than number 9 — the gap is not just one small step.
Talc (1) is actually harder than diamond when wet, so the scale reverses at the bottom.
Numbers 5 through 7 represent exactly the same hardness, making those gaps meaningless.
explanation: It is a mistake to think the Mohs gaps are equal — diamond (10) is far, far harder than number 9, not just one small step apart.
fact_tl: Mali ang akalang pantay-pantay ang agwat ng mga numero sa Mohs scale. Ang diamante (10) ay napakalayo ng tigas kumpara sa numero 9, hindi lang isang hakbang ang pagitan.
fact_bis: Sayop ang paghunahuna nga managsama ang gilay-on sa mga numero sa Mohs scale. Ang diamante (10) layo kaayo ka gahi kumpara sa numero 9, dili lang usa ka gamayng lakang ang gilay-on.

q: What is the SI unit used to measure pressure?
options: Newton (N)
Joule (J)
Pascal (Pa)
Watt (W)
explanation: The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa), named after Blaise Pascal.
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng presyon (pressure) ay pascal (Pa), na ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal.
fact_bis: Ang SI unit sa presyon (pressure) kay pascal (Pa), nga ginganlan kang Blaise Pascal.

q: Which of the following correctly describes how twins can form?
options: One zygote splits in two, or two egg cells are fertilized at the same time
Two zygotes merge together into one, then split again later
One egg cell is fertilized twice by two different sperm cells
One zygote divides many times and then breaks apart into two embryos
explanation: Twins form either when one zygote splits (identical twins) or when two separate egg cells are each fertilized at the same time (fraternal twins).
fact_tl: Nabubuo ang kambal kapag naghati ang isang zygote, o kapag dalawang egg ang na-fertilize nang sabay.
fact_bis: Ang kaluha maporma kung ang usa ka zygote mabahin, o kung duha ka egg cell ang ma-fertilize sa samang higayon.

q: Starting from the outermost layer and going inward, what is the correct order of Earth's four main layers?
options: Crust, mantle, outer core, inner core
Mantle, crust, inner core, outer core
Crust, outer core, mantle, inner core
Inner core, outer core, mantle, crust
explanation: From the outside in, Earth's four main layers are the crust, the mantle, the outer core, and the inner core.
fact_tl: Ang Daigdig ay nahahati sa apat na pangunahing sapaw mula labas papasok: ang crust (balat), ang mantle (manta), ang outer core, at ang inner core.
fact_bis: Ang Kalibutan nabahin sa upat ka nag-unang sapaw gikan sa gawas paingon sa sulod: ang crust (panit), ang mantle, ang outer core, ug ang inner core.

q: How does this monkey help the forest grow?
options: It spreads the seeds of the fruits it eats
It digs holes in the ground for rain to collect
It carries pollen between flowers on its fur
It pulls up old tree roots to make room for new plants
explanation: The macaque monkey helps the forest by eating fruits and spreading the seeds through the places it travels.
fact_tl: Nakakatulong ang unggoy na ito sa kagubatan dahil ikinakalat nito ang mga binhi ng prutas na kinakain niya.
fact_bis: Kini nga unggoy nakatabang sa kalasangan kay gisabwag niini ang mga liso sa prutas nga gikaon niini.

q: Which layer of soil is made mostly of decomposing leaves, twigs, and other decaying material?
options: The O horizon
The A horizon
The B horizon
The C horizon
explanation: The O horizon is the topmost soil layer, composed of decomposing and decayed organic matter like leaves and twigs, making it very rich in carbon and nutrients for plants.
fact_tl: Ang O horizon ay ang pinakamataas na layer ng lupa na binubuo ng mga nabulok at nabulok na dahon, sanga, at iba pang organikong bagay; ito ay napakayaman sa carbon at nagbibigay ng sustansya sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Ang O horizon mao ang pinaka-itaas nga layer sa yuta nga gihimo sa nagkadunot ug nadunot na mga dahon, sanga, ug ubang organikong butang; kini grabe ka dato sa carbon ug naghatag og sustansya sa mga halaman.

q: How many legs does a spider have?
options: Eight
Six
Ten
Twelve
explanation: A spider has eight legs, which is one of the features that makes spiders different from insects, which only have six.
fact_tl: Ang gagamba ay may walong (8) paa.
fact_bis: Ang lawalawa adunay walo (8) ka tiil.

q: Where does a hydra live?
options: In clean freshwater like ponds and streams
In the salty deep ocean near volcanic vents
In moist soil under rotting logs
In the thin film of water on leaves in rainforests
explanation: A hydra is a tiny freshwater animal only a few millimeters long that lives in clean ponds and streams, often clinging to underwater plants or rocks.
fact_tl: Ang hydra ay napakaliit na hayop (ilang milimetro lang) na nakatira sa malinis na tubig-tabang gaya ng lawa at ilog. Madalas itong nakadikit sa halaman o bato sa ilalim ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang hydra usa ka gamay kaayo nga hayop (pipila ra ka milimetro) nga nagpuyo sa limpyo nga tab-ang nga tubig sama sa danaw ug sapa. Kasagaran kini nakadikit sa tanom o bato sa ilalom sa tubig.

q: What body feature allows the banded sea krait to stay underwater for a long time without coming up for air?
options: An elongated lung that extends nearly the full length of its body
A set of gills on the sides of its neck that filter oxygen from seawater
A special pouch behind its heart that stores compressed air
Scales along its belly that absorb dissolved oxygen from water
explanation: Banded sea kraits have elongated lungs that run almost the entire length of their body, allowing them to hold enough air for prolonged dives.
fact_tl: Ang mga sea snake tulad ng banded sea krait ay may napahaba pang baga na umaabot hanggang sa dulo ng kanilang katawan, na nagbibigay sa kanila ng kakayahang sumisid nang matagal nang walang hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga sea snake sama sa banded sea krait adunay taas nga baga nga moabot hapit sa tibuok lawas, nagtugot kanila sa dugay nga pagsisid nga dili moitaas aron makakuha og hangin.

q: Why is it important to wash your hands right after touching long green chili?
options: Because capsaicin on your fingers can sting and hurt your eyes if you touch them
Because the green color will stain your skin if it dries
Because chili juice attracts insects that can bite your hands
Because the seeds inside chili are poisonous if swallowed
explanation: Capsaicin, the substance that makes chili hot, can be transferred from your fingers to your eyes, causing painful stinging.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos humawak ng siling haba, maghugas ka agad ng kamay. Kung mahawakan mo ang mata mo nang may capsaicin pa sa daliri, mahahapdi at masasaktan ito.
fact_bis: Human maghikap sa siling haba, panghunaw dayon sa imong kamot. Kung mahikap nimo ang imong mata samtang naa pay capsaicin sa imong tudlo, mohapdi ug masakitan kini.

q: What should an earthquake go-bag contain to keep you safe for the first three days after a big earthquake?
options: Water, food, a flashlight with batteries, a first aid kit, important documents, and cash
A tent, sleeping bags, cooking equipment, and a portable radio
Extra clothing, running shoes, a map, and a whistle
Candles, matches, a bucket, and a blanket
explanation: An earthquake go-bag should have enough water and food for 3 days, a flashlight with extra batteries, a first aid kit, important documents, and cash in an easily accessible place.
fact_tl: Ang isang 'go-bag' para sa lindol ay dapat naglalaman ng sapat na tubig at pagkain para sa 3 araw, isang flashlight na may karagdagang baterya, isang first aid kit, mahalagang dokumento, at pera; dapat itong nakahanda sa madaling makuhang lugar sa bahay.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka 'go-bag' para sa lindol kinahanglan naglangkob sa igo nga tubig ug pagkaon para sa 3 ka adlaw, usa ka flashlight nga adunay dugang nga baterya, usa ka first aid kit, importante nga mga dokumento, ug kwarta; kinahanglan kini ibutang sa sayon makuha nga lugar sa balay.

q: What does the coulomb measure?
options: Electric charge on an object
The strength of a magnetic field
The flow of electric current over time
The voltage between two points
explanation: The coulomb is the unit that measures electric charge — how much charge is on an object.
fact_tl: Ang coulomb ay sumusukat ng elektrikong karga — kung gaano karaming karga ang nasa isang bagay.
fact_bis: Ang coulomb nagsukod sa elektrikong karga — kung pila ka karga ang anaa sa usa ka butang.

q: What does the Philippine cockatoo, called katala, look like?
options: It is a white parrot with a white crest on its head
It is a green parrot with a bright red beak and blue wings
It is a gray bird with a colorful fan-shaped tail
It is a black-and-white bird with a hooked orange bill
explanation: The katala, or Philippine cockatoo, is a white parrot with a white crest on its head.
fact_tl: Ang katala ay isang puting loro na may puting palong sa ulo nito.
fact_bis: Ang katala usa ka puti nga loro nga adunay puti nga tukto sa iyang ulo.

q: How many planets can you see with just your eyes, without using a telescope?
options: Five
Three
Seven
Two
explanation: Five planets — Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn — can be seen with the naked eye without any telescope.
fact_tl: Limang (5) planeta ang makikita ng mata nang walang teleskopyo: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, at Saturn.
fact_bis: Lima (5) ka planeta ang makita sa mata nga walay teleskopyo: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, ug Saturn.

q: After hydrogen, which element is the second most common in the universe?
options: Helium
Oxygen
Carbon
Nitrogen
explanation: Helium is the second most abundant element in the universe, after hydrogen.
fact_tl: Ang pangalawang pinakamaraming element sa uniberso ay helium, sunod sa hydrogen.
fact_bis: Ang ikaduhang labing daghang elemento sa uniberso mao ang helium, sunod sa hydrogen.

q: Where does the word 'vulcanization' get its name?
options: From Vulcan, the Roman god of fire
From the Vulcan volcano in Italy where the process was discovered
From the scientist Julius Vulcan who invented the treatment
From the Latin word 'vulcanus' meaning to harden
explanation: The process of hardening rubber with heat is called vulcanization because it was named after Vulcan, the Roman god of fire.
fact_tl: Tinawag na 'vulcanization' ang pagpapatibay ng goma dahil sa init, mula sa pangalan ni Vulcan, ang diyos ng apoy ng mga Romano.
fact_bis: Ang pagpalig-on sa goma pinaagi sa init gitawag 'vulcanization', ginganlan kang Vulcan, ang diyos sa kalayo sa mga Romano.

q: When you accidentally touch a hot pan, your hand pulls away before you even think about it. What is this called?
options: A reflex
A habit
A voluntary action
A conscious decision
explanation: Pulling your hand away from a hot pan automatically — before you consciously decide — is a reflex, which protects the body without requiring thought.
fact_tl: Kapag nahawakan mo ang mainit na kawali, agad na umuurong ang kamay mo bago mo pa naiisip na mainit ito. Iyan ang reflex — pinoprotektahan ka nito nang hindi mo na kailangang magdesisyon.
fact_bis: Kon imong mahikap ang init nga kalaha, dihadiha moiwas ang imong kamot sa wala pa nimo mahunahuna nga init kini. Mao na ang reflex — manalipod kini kanimo nga dili na kinahanglan ka mohukom.

q: In which province is Mount Dulang-dulang, part of the Kitanglad mountain range, located?
options: Bukidnon
Davao del Sur
Lanao del Norte
Cotabato
explanation: Mount Dulang-dulang is part of the Kitanglad mountain range found in Bukidnon, Mindanao, surrounded by thick forests.
fact_tl: Ang Bundok Dulang-dulang ay bahagi ng kabundukan ng Kitanglad sa Bukidnon na puno ng makakapal na gubat.
fact_bis: Ang Bukid Dulang-dulang kabahin sa kabukiran sa Kitanglad sa Bukidnon nga puno sa baga nga lasang.

q: What is the largest island in the Philippines?
options: Luzon
Mindanao
Palawan
Visayas
explanation: Luzon is the largest island in the Philippines and is where Manila, the capital city, is located.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking isla sa Pilipinas ay ang Luzon, kung saan matatagpuan ang Maynila.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga pulo sa Pilipinas mao ang Luzon, diin nahimutang ang Manila.

q: What did the Perseverance rover do on Mars that no spacecraft had done before?
options: It made oxygen by pulling it out of the carbon dioxide in Mars's air
It drilled into the surface and found liquid water underground
It grew a small plant inside a sealed container on Mars
It launched a small rocket from the Martian surface back into orbit
explanation: Perseverance was the first to produce oxygen on Mars, extracting it from the carbon dioxide in Mars's atmosphere — a step that could help future astronauts breathe.
fact_tl: Ang Perseverance rover ang unang nakagawa ng oxygen sa Mars—kinuha nito ang oxygen mula sa carbon dioxide sa hangin ng Mars, na maaaring makatulong sa mga astronaut na huminga balang araw.
fact_bis: Ang Perseverance rover mao ang una nga nakahimo ug oxygen sa Mars—gikuha niini ang oxygen gikan sa carbon dioxide sa hangin sa Mars, nga mahimong makatabang sa mga astronaut nga makaginhawa sa umaabot.

q: What makes an electromagnet different from an ordinary permanent magnet?
options: An electromagnet can be switched on and off by controlling the electric current
An electromagnet is always stronger than a permanent magnet at all times
An electromagnet does not use any metal parts to create its pull
An electromagnet only attracts non-metal objects while permanent magnets attract metal
explanation: An electromagnet gets its magnetism from electricity, so turning the current on or off controls whether it attracts or not — unlike a permanent magnet which is always magnetic.
fact_tl: Sa electromagnet, gawa sa kuryente ang lakas nito kaya kontrolado—buksan mo ang kuryente, lalakas ang poste; patayin mo, mawawala ang hila. Iba ito sa karaniwang magnet na laging may lakas.
fact_bis: Sa electromagnet, ang kusog gikan sa kuryente mao nga kontrolado: ablihi ang kuryente ug mokusog ang polo, palonga ug mawala ang pagbira. Lahi kini sa ordinaryong magnet nga kanunay adunay kusog.

q: Why did ancient people give names to groups of stars in the sky?
options: They made up stories and myths about animals and heroes they saw in those star patterns
They used the star names to measure exactly how far away each star was
They named the stars after planets to keep track of which planets had moons
They gave star groups names so sailors could navigate without getting lost during the day
explanation: Long ago, people created stories and myths connecting star patterns to animals and heroes, which is how constellations got their names.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, gumawa ang mga tao ng mga kwento at alamat tungkol sa mga hayop at bayani na nakikita nila sa mga konstelasyon.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang mga tawo naghimo og mga sugilanon ug alamat bahin sa mga mananap ug bayani nga ilang nakita sa mga konstelasyon.

q: Why are reptiles and amphibians placed in the same large group as fish, birds, and mammals?
options: They all have a backbone
They all breathe through lungs their whole lives
They all lay eggs with hard shells
They all have scales covering their skin
explanation: Reptiles and amphibians both have a backbone, placing them in the vertebrate group alongside fish, birds, and mammals.
fact_tl: Ang mga reptilya at amphibian ay parehong may gulugod (backbone), kaya kabilang sila sa mga hayop na tinatawag na vertebrate, tulad din ng mga isda, ibon, at mammal.
fact_bis: Ang mga reptilya ug amphibian parehong adunay gulugod (backbone), busa sakop sila sa grupo sa mga mananap nga gitawag og vertebrate, sama sa isda, langgam, ug mammal.

q: Where is the Sulu Sea located within the Philippines?
options: In the southwestern Philippines, between Palawan and the Sulu islands
In the eastern Philippines, between Samar and the Pacific Ocean
In the northern Philippines, between Luzon and Taiwan
In the central Philippines, between Cebu and Bohol
explanation: The Sulu Sea lies in the southwestern Philippines, situated between Palawan and the Sulu island chain.
fact_tl: Ang Sulu Sea ay ang dagat sa timog-kanluran ng Pilipinas, nasa pagitan ng Palawan at ng mga isla ng Sulu.
fact_bis: Ang Sulu Sea mao ang dagat sa habagatang-kasadpan sa Pilipinas, taliwala sa Palawan ug sa mga isla sa Sulu.

q: Which joint in the human body is the largest and carries our weight when we stand or walk?
options: The knee
The hip
The shoulder
The ankle
explanation: The knee is the largest joint in the human body and bears our body weight whenever we stand or walk.
fact_tl: Ang tuhod ang pinakamalaking kasukasuan sa katawan ng tao at dinadala nito ang bigat tuwing tayo ay tumatayo o lumalakad.
fact_bis: Ang tuhod mao ang pinakadako nga lutahan sa lawas sa tawo ug nagdala kini sa atong gibug-aton kon mobarog o molakaw kita.

q: In anglerfish, which one has the glowing lure on its head?
options: Only the female
Only the male
Both the male and the female
Neither; the glow comes from bacteria on their scales
explanation: Only the female anglerfish has the glowing lure in front of her head; the much smaller male has no light organ at all.
fact_tl: Sa anglerfish, ang babae lamang ang may kumikinang na pain sa harap ng ulo; ang lalaki ay maliit, walang ilaw, at gumugugol ng buhay sa paghahanap ng babae.
fact_bis: Sa anglerfish, ang baye ra ang adunay nagdan-ag nga pain sa atubangan sa ulo; ang laki gamay, walay suga, ug mogahin sa kinabuhi sa pagpangita og baye.

q: Why does a tin can crumple when it is full of steam and then suddenly cooled with cold water?
options: The steam condenses and air pressure outside crushes the can
The cold water freezes inside the can and expands, breaking the walls
The metal becomes brittle when cooled quickly and cracks under its own weight
The water vapor turns into liquid and pulls the walls outward
explanation: When steam inside the can condenses into water, the pressure inside drops sharply, and the greater outside air pressure crushes the weakened can.
fact_tl: Kapag pinainitan ang isang lata ng tubig at pagkatapos ay biglang isinubmersyon sa malamig na tubig, ang lata ay babagtok. Ang singaw sa loob ay nag-condense at ang mataas na presyon ng hangin sa labas ay puwersahin ang lata.
fact_bis: Sa pag-imersyon sa usa ka lata nga adunay singaw sulod sa bugnaw nga tubig, ang lata madurog. Ang singaw sulod nagcondense, ug ang mas taas nga presyon sa hangin sa gawas nagdurog sa lata.

q: Who was the first human to travel into space, and when did it happen?
options: Yuri Gagarin in 1961
Neil Armstrong in 1969
Alan Shepard in 1961
Valentina Tereshkova in 1963
explanation: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space on 12 April 1961, orbiting Earth once in about 108 minutes aboard Vostok 1.
fact_tl: Ang Soviet cosmonaut na si Yuri Gagarin ang naging unang tao sa kalawakan noong Abril 12, 1961; ang kanyang Vostok 1 spacecraft ay nag-orbit ng Earth nang isang beses sa loob ng humigit-kumulang 108 minuto.
fact_bis: Ang Soviet cosmonaut nga si Yuri Gagarin nahimong unang tawo sa kalawakan niadtong Abril 12, 1961; ang iyang Vostok 1 spacecraft nag-orbit sa Yuta kausa sulod sa mga 108 minuto.

q: Who is known as the Father of Observational Astronomy?
options: Galileo Galilei
Isaac Newton
Nicolaus Copernicus
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Galileo Galilei earned the title Father of Observational Astronomy for his pioneering work using the telescope to study the heavens.
fact_tl: Si Galileo Galilei ang tinaguriang Ama ng Obserbasyonal na Astronomiya (Father of Observational Astronomy).
fact_bis: Si Galileo Galilei ang gitawag nga Amahan sa Obserbasyonal nga Astronomiya (Father of Observational Astronomy).

q: Where does the anglerfish usually live?
options: In the very deep, dark parts of the ocean
In shallow coral reefs near tropical beaches
In freshwater rivers and lakes in tropical forests
In cool surface waters near the polar ice caps
explanation: The anglerfish lives in the deep, dark parts of the ocean where sunlight cannot reach.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish ay isang isda na karaniwang naninirahan sa napakalalim at madilim na bahagi ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish usa ka isda nga kasagaran nagpuyo sa lawom kaayo ug ngitngit nga bahin sa dagat.

q: What sometimes happens when meteorites reach Earth?
options: Some are seen falling by people and have even struck roofs or the ground near homes
All meteorites burn up completely before they reach the ground
Meteorites always land in the ocean because it covers most of Earth
People can only find meteorites using special metal detectors, never by watching them fall
explanation: Once in a while, people actually witness a meteorite fall, and some have even struck rooftops or landed near homes.
fact_tl: Paminsan-minsan, may mga taong nakakakita ng meteorite na bumabagsak, at ilan dito ay tumatama pa sa bubong o lupa malapit sa bahay.
fact_bis: Usahay, adunay mga tawo nga makakita og meteorite nga nahulog, ug pipila niini nakaigo pa sa atop o yuta duol sa balay.

q: Which statement is NOT one of the three parts of cell theory?
options: Cells need oxygen to survive and will die without it
All living things are made of cells
The cell is the basic unit of life
All new cells come from existing cells
explanation: Cell theory states that (1) all living things are made of cells, (2) the cell is the basic unit of life, and (3) all new cells come from existing cells — it does not say cells need oxygen to survive.
fact_tl: Ang cell theory ay may tatlong bahagi: (1) lahat ng buhay na bagay ay gawa sa selula, (2) ang selula ay pinakamaliit na yunit ng buhay, at (3) ang bagong selula ay nagmumula sa kasalukuyang selula.
fact_bis: Ang cell theory adunay tulo ka bahin: (1) ang tanan nga buhing butang hinimo sa mga selula, (2) ang selula ang pinakagamay nga yunit sa kinabuhi, ug (3) ang tanang bag-ong selula gikan sa naglungtad nang selula.

q: Besides measuring the strength of shaking, what else does a seismograph record that helps scientists find where an earthquake started?
options: The exact time the shaking arrived at each station
The direction the ground moved during shaking
The temperature of the ground at the moment of the quake
The depth of the soil at the recording site
explanation: A seismograph records the exact time shaking arrives; by comparing times from different stations, scientists can pinpoint the earthquake's starting location.
fact_tl: Bukod sa lakas, naitatala rin ng seismograph ang eksaktong oras nang dumating ang pagyanig; kapag pinagsama-sama ang oras mula sa iba't ibang istasyon, mahahanap ng mga siyentista kung saan nagsimula ang lindol.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kakusog, marekord usab sa seismograph ang eksaktong oras nga miabot ang pag-uyog; kung hiusahon ang oras gikan sa lainlaing estasyon, makit-an sa mga syentista kung asa nagsugod ang linog.

q: What caused the COVID-19 illness that spread all over the world?
options: A virus
A bacterium
A fungus
A parasite
explanation: COVID-19 was caused by a virus that spread worldwide, which is why people wore masks and washed their hands frequently to prevent infection.
fact_tl: Ang COVID-19 ay dulot ng isang virus na kumalat sa buong mundo, kaya tayo nagsuot ng mask at madalas naghugas ng kamay.
fact_bis: Ang COVID-19 gipahinabo sa usa ka bayrus nga mikaylap sa tibuok kalibutan, mao nga nagsul-ob ta ug mask ug kanunay nanghugas sa kamot.

q: Where in the Philippines is the waling-waling orchid naturally found?
options: Only on the island of Mindanao
Only on the island of Luzon
Throughout all the major islands of the Philippines
Only on the island of Palawan
explanation: The waling-waling (Vanda sanderiana) is endemic to Mindanao, meaning it is found naturally only on that island.
fact_tl: Ang waling-waling (Vanda sanderiana) ay matatagpuan lamang o endemiko sa isla ng Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang waling-waling (Vanda sanderiana) makit-an lamang o endemiko sa isla sa Mindanao.

q: What role do helpful bacteria on our skin play?
options: They help block harmful germs from entering the body
They produce vitamins that are absorbed directly through the skin
They keep the skin moist by releasing natural oils
They remove dead skin cells so new ones can grow faster
explanation: Helpful bacteria living on our skin act as a barrier that blocks harmful germs, protecting us from infection.
fact_tl: May mabubuting bakterya sa ating balat na tumutulong harangan ang nakakasamang mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Adunay maayong bakterya sa atong panit nga motabang pagbabag sa makadaot nga mikrobyo.

q: What is special about absolute zero (0 K) on the Kelvin scale?
options: It is the lowest possible temperature, where particle motion nearly stops completely
It is the temperature at which water freezes under normal conditions
It is the point where all gases turn into liquids at the same time
It equals 0 degrees Celsius on the Celsius scale
explanation: Absolute zero (0 K = -273.15 degrees C) is the lowest possible temperature on the Kelvin scale, at which particle motion nearly comes to a complete stop.
fact_tl: Ang Kelvin scale ay nagsisimula sa absolute zero (0 K = −273.15°C) — ang pinakamababang temperatura na posible, kung saan ang mga particle ay halos ganap na nanahimik.
fact_bis: Ang Kelvin scale nagsugod sa absolute zero (0 K = −273.15°C) — ang pinakaubos nga posibleng temperatura diin halos hingpit mopahunong ang lihok sa mga particle.

q: How do tiny coral polyps build a large coral reef?
options: Millions of polyps live together in a colony, and their combined limestone skeletons build the reef
Each polyp grows very fast and can reach the size of a basketball in one year
Polyps collect sand and shells from the ocean floor and cement them together
A single large polyp secretes a thick wall around itself that grows into a reef over decades
explanation: A single coral polyp is smaller than a coin, but thousands or millions of them live together in a colony, and their combined limestone skeletons form the reef structure.
fact_tl: Ang isang coral polyp ay karaniwang mas maliit pa sa isang piso — ngunit isang coral colony ay maaaring binubuo ng libu-libong o maging milyun-milyong polyp na nagtutulungan, habang ang mga buo nitong limestone skeleton ay bumubuo ng reef.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka coral polyp kasagaran mas gamay pa kaysa usa ka barya — apan ang usa ka coral colony mahimong naglakip sa libu-libo o bisan milyon ka polyp nga nagtinabangay, kansang kombinadong limestone skeleton nagbuhat sa reef.

q: Why does an elephant flap its large ears?
options: To cool its body when it is hot
To warn other elephants of danger nearby
To fan dust onto its back to keep insects away
To make loud sounds that carry over long distances
explanation: An elephant flaps its large ears to cool its body on hot days, because the ears release body heat.
fact_tl: Pinapaypay ng elepante ang malalaki nitong tainga para palamigin ang katawan kapag mainit.
fact_bis: Gikapay-kapay sa elepante ang iyang dagko nga dalunggan aron pabugnawon ang lawas kon init.

q: What conditions does the anglerfish live in at the bottom of the deep ocean?
options: Cold water with very high pressure
Warm water with very low pressure
Cool water with average pressure
Hot water near underwater volcanic vents
explanation: The anglerfish lives in the cold, high-pressure environment of the deep ocean.
fact_tl: Ang anglerfish ay nabubuhay sa malamig na tubig na may napakalaking presyon sa kalaliman ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang anglerfish nagpuyo sa bugnaw nga tubig nga adunay grabe ka kusog nga presyon sa kahiladman sa dagat.

q: Which statement about ferns and mosses is correct?
options: They are among the oldest plants on land, appearing millions of years before flowering plants
They were the first plants to produce flowers and fruits on Earth
They only appeared on land after flowering plants had already evolved
They are newer kinds of plants that evolved long after trees and grasses
explanation: Ferns and mosses are among the oldest land plants, growing on Earth millions of years before flowering plants ever appeared.
fact_tl: Ang pako at lumot ay kabilang sa pinakamatatandang uri ng halaman sa lupa, at tumutubo na sila milyon-milyong taon bago pa dumating ang mga halamang may bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang pako ug lumot kabahin sa pinakakaraan nga matang sa tanom sa yuta, nga nagtubo na milyon-milyon ka tuig sa wala pa motungha ang mga tanom nga adunay bulak.

q: Why does a doctor choose a specific antibiotic instead of just giving any antibiotic?
options: Different antibiotics target different bacteria, so the right one must match the infection
All antibiotics work on all bacteria equally, but some have fewer side effects
The doctor picks based on the patient's age and weight, not the type of bacteria
Antibiotics are all the same; the doctor just chooses the cheapest one available
explanation: There are different kinds of antibiotics and each targets particular bacteria, so a doctor must choose the one that works against the specific bacteria causing the infection.
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng antibiotic, at pinipili ng doktor ang tamang isa para sa partikular na bakteryang sanhi ng impeksyon.
fact_bis: Adunay lainlaing klase sa antibiotic, ug ang doktor mopili sa saktong usa alang sa piho nga bakterya nga hinungdan sa impeksyon.

q: What protects the tiny plant inside a seed while the seed is traveling to a new place?
options: A thick, hard outer coat that keeps it safe even if it gets wet, dry, or passes through an animal's stomach
A soft, spongy layer filled with water that cushions the seed during travel
A waxy shell that seals completely so no air or water can ever get inside
A sticky outer surface that glues the seed to a protective covering of soil
explanation: Many seeds have a thick, hard outer coat that protects the embryo inside from drying out, getting waterlogged, or being digested when an animal eats the fruit.
fact_tl: Maraming buto ang may makapal at matigas na balat. Pinoprotektahan nito ang munting halaman sa loob habang naglalakbay—kahit matuyo, mabasa, o dumaan pa sa tiyan ng hayop, ligtas pa rin ito.
fact_bis: Daghang liso adunay baga ug gahi nga panit. Manalipod kini sa gamay nga tanom sa sulod samtang nagbiyahe—bisan mauga, mabasa, o moagi sa tiyan sa mananap, luwas gihapon kini.

q: How does a tilapia breathe?
options: Using gills that take oxygen from the water
Using small lungs that let it breathe air at the surface
Through its skin, which absorbs oxygen directly from the water
Through its mouth, which filters oxygen out of the water
explanation: Like other fish, tilapia breathe using gills that extract dissolved oxygen from the water.
fact_tl: Humihinga ang tilapia gamit ang mga hasang na kumukuha ng oksiheno mula sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang tilapia naginhawa pinaagi sa hasang nga mokuha og oksiheno gikan sa tubig.

q: According to PAGASA, at what wind speed does a storm officially become a typhoon?
options: When winds reach 118 to 184 km/h
When winds reach 60 to 88 km/h
When winds reach 89 to 117 km/h
When winds reach 185 km/h or more
explanation: In PAGASA's classification, a storm is considered a typhoon when its sustained winds are between 118 and 184 km/h.
fact_tl: Sa pag-uuri ng PAGASA, ang isang bagyo ay tinatawag na typhoon kapag ang hangin nito ay 118 hanggang 184 km/h.
fact_bis: Sa klasipikasyon sa PAGASA, ang bagyo gitawag nga typhoon kon ang hangin niini 118 hangtod 184 km/h.

q: Why is the dugong in danger of disappearing?
options: It swims slowly, making it easy for people to catch
Its meat and fat taste very bitter, so people leave it alone
It only lives in one small area of the world
It reproduces very quickly, so hunters can easily find large groups
explanation: Because dugongs swim slowly, they are easy for people to catch, which is one of the main reasons these animals are endangered.
fact_tl: Dahil mabagal lumangoy ang dugong, madali itong mahuli ng mga tao, kaya isa ito sa dahilan kung bakit nanganganib na maubos ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Tungod kay hinay molangoy ang dugong, sayon kini dakpon sa mga tawo, mao nga usa kini sa hinungdan nganong nameligro nga mahurot.

q: Why does the liquid inside a thermometer rise when it gets warmer?
options: The liquid expands when heated and takes up more space, pushing it up the tube
The liquid becomes lighter when warm, so it floats upward naturally
Warm air pushes down on the liquid from the top and forces it up
The tube gets narrower when warm, squeezing the liquid upward
explanation: In a liquid thermometer, the liquid expands when heated and rises up the tube, showing a higher temperature reading.
fact_tl: Sa termometrong likido, lumalaki at umaakyat ang likido kapag mainit, at umuurong at bumababa kapag malamig — kaya naipapakita nito ang temperatura.
fact_bis: Sa termometro nga likido, ang likido molapad ug mosaka kon init, ug mokuyos ug mokunsad kon bugnaw — mao kini ang paagi nga mapakita niini ang temperatura.

q: How do the stilt-like roots of mangrove trees help them survive by the sea?
options: They grip the soft muddy ground tightly so the tree does not topple in waves and wind
They act like snorkels, pulling oxygen out of the air for the roots buried in mud
They filter salt out of seawater before it reaches the tree's leaves
They store large amounts of fresh water that the tree uses during low tide
explanation: Mangroves have stilt-like roots that spread into the soft mud and grip tightly, keeping the tree stable even when hit by strong waves and wind.
fact_tl: Maraming bakawan ay may mga ugat na parang tukod na nakabukaka pababa sa putik. Ang mga ugat na ito ay humahawak nang mahigpit sa malambot na lupa para hindi matumba ang puno kahit hampasin ng alon at hangin.
fact_bis: Daghang bakawan adunay mga gamot nga morag tukod nga nagbukhad paubos sa lapok. Kini nga mga gamot mokupot pag-ayo sa humok nga yuta aron dili matumba ang kahoy bisan bunalan sa balod ug hangin.

q: What type of joint do the small bones of the wrist and ankle have, and what does it allow?
options: Gliding joints that slide past each other for small movements
Ball-and-socket joints that allow swinging in all directions
Hinge joints that allow bending in one direction only
Pivot joints that allow one bone to spin around another
explanation: The small bones in the wrist and ankle have gliding joints, where the bone surfaces slide past each other, allowing small, precise movements.
fact_tl: Ang mga maliliit na buto sa pulso at bukung-bukong ay may mga kasukasuang dumudulas (gliding) na dumudausdos sa isa't isa para sa maliliit na galaw.
fact_bis: Ang gagmayng bukog sa pulso ug buol-buol adunay mga lutahang modangdang (gliding) nga magdausdos sa usag usa alang sa gagmayng lihok.

q: Why can an element NOT be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means?
options: It is made of only one kind of atom, and there is no simpler chemical piece behind the atom
Its atoms are too small for any chemical reaction to reach them
The atoms of an element are locked together too strongly for any chemical to break
Elements have no electrons, so no chemical reaction can start
explanation: An element cannot be split chemically because it consists of only one kind of atom, and there is nothing simpler that chemistry can reduce it to.
fact_tl: Hindi mahahati ng kemikal ang elemento dahil binubuo ito ng iisang uri lang ng atom. Walang mas simpleng kemikal na piraso sa likod ng atom.
fact_bis: Dili mabahin sa kemika ang elemento kay hinimo kini sa usa ra ka matang sa atomo. Walay mas yano nga kemikal nga bahin luyo sa atomo.

q: What is the correct unit for measuring weight?
options: Newtons (N)
Kilograms (kg)
Grams (g)
Joules (J)
explanation: Weight is a force and is measured in Newtons (N); kilograms measure mass, not weight, and a 1 kg mass has a weight of about 9.8 N on Earth's surface.
fact_tl: Ang weight ay isang pwersa at sinusukat ito sa Newton (N), hindi sa kilogram. Ang isang kilogram na mass ay may weight na halos 9.8 Newton sa ibabaw ng Mundo. Ang kilogram ay sinusukat ang mass, hindi ang weight.
fact_bis: Ang weight usa ka pwersa ug gisuktan sa Newton (N), dili sa kilogram. Ang usa ka kilogram nga mass adunay weight nga mga 9.8 Newton sa ibabaw sa Yuta. Ang kilogram nagsukat sa mass, dili sa weight.

q: What happens to red litmus paper when you dip it into a base solution?
options: It turns blue
It turns green
It stays red
It turns purple
explanation: In a base, red litmus paper turns blue — blue is the sign of a base.
fact_tl: Sa base, ang pulang litmus paper ay nagiging asul — kulay asul ang tanda ng base.
fact_bis: Sa base, ang pula nga litmus paper mahimong asul — asul ang timaan sa base.

q: How does a squid move through the water?
options: It squeezes its body to shoot water out and rocket forward
It uses its tentacles like paddles to row itself along
It inflates a gas bladder to rise and sink, then drifts
It beats a pair of flat tail fins like a fish does
explanation: Squids move by jet propulsion — squeezing the mantle to force water out through a siphon, pushing the animal in the opposite direction.
fact_tl: Ang pusit ay gumagalaw sa pamamagitan ng jet propulsion — pinisil nito ang mantle (ang pangunahing katawan) upang mapuwersang palabas ang tubig sa pamamagitan ng makitid na siphon, na nagpapadala ng hayop patungo sa kabaligtaran.
fact_bis: Ang pusit naglihok pinaagi sa jet propulsion — nipirit ang mantle (ang pangunahing lawas) aron mapuwersa ang tubig palabas pinaagi sa pig-ot nga siphon, nagpadali sa hayop ngadto sa kaatbang nga direksyon.

q: How does the leptospirosis bacterium get inside your body?
options: Through cuts in the skin or through the eyes, nose, and mouth
Only by drinking dirty water that you swallow
Only by breathing dust from dried animal droppings
Only through mosquito bites that carry the bacteria
explanation: The bacteria enter the body through cuts in the skin or through the eyes, nose, and mouth.
fact_tl: Pumapasok ang bakterya sa katawan sa pamamagitan ng mga sugat sa balat o sa mata, ilong, at bibig.
fact_bis: Mosulod ang bakterya sa lawas pinaagi sa mga samad sa panit o pinaagi sa mata, ilong, ug baba.

q: A jeepney travels 60 kilometers in 2 hours, stopping in traffic and speeding up on open roads. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
options: 30 km/h
60 km/h
120 km/h
15 km/h
explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time: 60 km ÷ 2 h = 30 km/h, even though the jeepney was not always going that speed.
fact_tl: Kung ang jeep ay umabot ng 60 kilometro papuntang bayan sa loob ng 2 oras, ang average speed nito ay 30 km/h, kahit pa minsan ay tumigil ito sa trapiko o bumilis sa maluwag na kalsada.
fact_bis: Kung ang jeep makaabot og 60 kilometros padulong sa lungsod sulod sa 2 oras, ang average speed niini kay 30 km/h, bisan pa man nga usahay mihunong kini sa trapik ug mipaspas sa luwag nga dalan.

q: On which island and province is Mount Pinatubo found?
options: Zambales, Luzon
Albay, Luzon
Bukidnon, Mindanao
Negros Occidental, Visayas
explanation: Mount Pinatubo is located in Zambales on the island of Luzon.
fact_tl: Ang Bulkang Pinatubo ay matatagpuan sa Zambales sa isla ng Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkan Pinatubo makita sa Zambales sa isla sa Luzon.

q: Into how many main parts is an insect's body divided?
options: Three parts: head, thorax, and abdomen
Four parts: head, neck, thorax, and abdomen
Two parts: head and body
Five parts: head, thorax, abdomen, wings, and legs
explanation: An insect's body is divided into three parts: the head, thorax, and abdomen.
fact_tl: Ang katawan ng insekto ay nahahati sa tatlong bahagi: ulo, dibdib, at tiyan.
