fact_bis: Ang lawas sa insekto gibahinbahin sa tulo ka bahin: ulo, dughan, ug tiyan.

q: What tool does a scientist use to measure how much rain has fallen?
options: A rain gauge
A barometer
A thermometer
An anemometer
explanation: A rain gauge is a container with a scale that tells the amount of rainwater in millimeters.
fact_tl: Ang rain gauge ay kasangkapan na sumusukat kung gaano karaming ulan ang bumagsak; ito ay isang lalagyan na may panukat na nagsasabi ng dami ng tubig-ulan sa milimetro.
fact_bis: Ang rain gauge usa ka galamiton nga mosukod kon unsa ka daghan ang ulan nga nahulog; usa kini ka sudlanan nga adunay sukdanan nga magsulti sa gidaghanon sa tubig-ulan sa milimetro.

q: In science, why is a malunggay pod considered a fruit even though we cook it as a vegetable?
options: Because it is the seed-bearing part of the plant
Because it grows underground like a root vegetable
Because it tastes sweet like a mango or banana
Because it comes from a flower but has no seeds inside
explanation: In science, a malunggay pod is a fruit because it is the seed-bearing part of the plant, even though cooks treat it as a vegetable.
fact_tl: Sa agham, ang malunggay pod ay isang bunga dahil ito ang bahaging may buto ng halaman. Pero sa pagluluto, itinuturing natin itong gulay dahil ito ay niluluto sa ulam, hindi kinakaing matamis na prutas.
fact_bis: Sa siyensya, ang malunggay pod usa ka bunga kay kini ang bahin sa tanom nga adunay liso. Apan sa pagluto, giila nato kini nga utanon, kay lutoon kini sa sud-an, dili kan-on isip tam-is nga prutas.

q: In which direction does gravity pull objects near Earth?
options: Toward the center of the Earth
Away from the center of the Earth
Sideways along the Earth's surface
Toward the nearest body of water
explanation: Gravity pulls all objects toward the center of the Earth.
fact_tl: Hinihila ng grabidad ang lahat ng bagay patungo sa gitna ng Lupa.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad nagbira sa tanang butang paingon sa tunga sa Yuta.

q: What kind of waves does a radio use to send sound and messages without wires?
options: Radio waves
Sound waves
Light waves
Microwaves
explanation: The radio uses radio waves — invisible waves that travel through the air — to send sound and messages without wires.
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang radio ng radio waves — mga nakatagong alon na naglalakbay sa hangin — para magpadala ng tunog at mensahe nang walang kable.
fact_bis: Ang radio mogamit og radio waves — dili makita nga mga balod nga moagi sa hangin — aron magpadala og tingog ug mensahe nga walay kable.

q: How do large seabird colonies help both islands and the nearby ocean?
options: Their droppings fertilize the land and deliver nutrients to coastal waters
They eat all the fish, leaving nutrients in the water as waste
They dig burrows that channel fresh water from land to the sea
They build nests that trap rainwater and create island freshwater pools
explanation: Large seabird colonies transfer nutrients from the ocean to land through their guano, fertilising islands and delivering nutrients to coastal ocean waters.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking colony ng mga ibon sa dagat ay nagpapadala ng nutrients mula sa karagatan patungo sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng kanilang guano — ito ay nagpapataba ng isla at nagpapababa ng nutrients sa karagatan malapit sa baybayon.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong mga colony sa mga langgam sa dagat nagbalhin sa mga sustansya gikan sa dagat ngadto sa yuta pinaagi sa ilang guano — kini nagpataba sa mga pulo ug naghatod sa mga sustansya ngadto sa tubig sa baybayon.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the element oxygen on the periodic table?
options: O
Ox
Og
Oy
explanation: The element symbol for oxygen on the periodic table is O.
fact_tl: Ang simbolo ng elementong oxygen sa periodic table ay O.
fact_bis: Ang simbolo sa elemento nga oxygen sa periodic table mao ang O.

q: Which lake is the main water source for the Agus hydroelectric complex in Mindanao?
options: Lake Lanao
Lake Sebu
Laguna de Bay
Lake Buhi
explanation: The Agus hydroelectric complex draws its water from Lake Lanao, which flows down the Agus River in Mindanao.
fact_tl: Ang Agus hydroelectric complex ay nagmumula sa tubig ng Lake Lanao na dumadaloy sa Ilog Agus papuntang Mindanao.
fact_bis: Ang Agus hydroelectric complex nagkuha sa tubig gikan sa Lake Lanao nga nagdagayday sa Suba sa Agus sa Mindanao.

q: Who took the world's first surviving photograph, around 1826?
options: Joseph Nicephore Niepce
Louis Daguerre
Thomas Edison
George Eastman
explanation: The Frenchman Joseph Nicephore Niepce took the first surviving photograph, 'View from the Window at Le Gras,' around 1826.
fact_tl: Ang Pranses na si Joseph Nicephore Niepce ang kumuha ng pinakaunang litrato na 'View from the Window at Le Gras' noong mga 1826.
fact_bis: Ang Pranses nga si Joseph Nicephore Niepce mao ang nikuha sa pinakaunang litrato nga 'View from the Window at Le Gras' niadtong mga 1826.

q: What substance builds up in your muscles when they run out of oxygen during hard exercise, causing soreness?
options: Lactic acid
Carbon dioxide
Lactic sugar
Uric acid
explanation: When muscles lack oxygen during exercise, they produce lactic acid, which causes the soreness you feel.
fact_tl: Kapag kulang sa oxygen ang iyong kalamnan habang nag-eehersisyo, gumagawa ito ng lactic acid na nagdudulot ng pananakit.
fact_bis: Kung kulang sa oksiheno ang imong kaunoran samtang nag-ehersisyo, maghimo kini og lactic acid nga maoy hinungdan sa kasakit.

q: In the ocean food chain, which animals eat tuna?
options: Sharks and large fish
Sea turtles and jellyfish
Plankton and krill
Dolphins and sea otters
explanation: In the ocean food chain, tuna are eaten by bigger animals such as sharks and large fish.
fact_tl: Sa hanay ng pagkain sa dagat, ang tuna ay kinakain naman ng mas malalaking hayop gaya ng pating at malalaking isda.
fact_bis: Sa kadena sa pagkaon sa dagat, ang tuna kaonon usab sa mas dagkong mananap sama sa iho ug dagkong isda.

q: Which animal is the fastest on land, able to reach about 100 to 110 km/h in short bursts?
options: The cheetah
The lion
The greyhound dog
The pronghorn antelope
explanation: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, reaching about 100 to 110 kilometers per hour in short bursts before it tires.
fact_tl: Ang cheetah ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa lupa. Kaya nitong tumakbo nang halos 100 hanggang 110 kilometro kada oras, pero sa maikling pagitan lang dahil mabilis itong mapagod.
fact_bis: Ang cheetah mao ang pinakapaspas nga hayop sa yuta. Makahimo kini sa pagdagan og mga 100 ngadto sa 110 ka kilometro kada oras, apan sa mubo nga panahon lang kay paspas kini makapuyan.

q: When a doctor hears a 'lub-dub' sound through a stethoscope, what causes that sound inside the heart?
options: The valves closing as the chambers beat
The blood rushing past the aorta walls
The muscles of the heart wall squeezing tight
The pericardium rubbing on the ribs
explanation: The 'lub-dub' sound comes from the valves closing as the chambers beat, which tells the doctor whether blood is flowing properly.
fact_tl: Kapag pinupuntahan mo ang doktor, ginagamit niya ang stetoskop para makinig sa iyong puso. Ang naririnig niyang 'lub-dub' ay galing sa pagsara ng mga balbula habang ang mga silid ay tumitibok. Sa tunog na ito, malalaman ng doktor kung maayos ang daloy ng dugo sa apat na silid.
fact_bis: Kung mobisita ka sa doktor, mogamit siya og stethoscope aron maminaw sa imong kasingkasing. Ang 'lub-dub' nga iyang madungog gikan sa pagsira sa mga balbula samtang nagapitik ang mga lawak. Gikan niini nga tingog, mahibal-an sa doktor kung maayo ba ang dagayday sa dugo sa upat ka lawak.

q: Why do plants need nitrogen from the soil?
options: To make green leaves and grow healthy
To produce flowers and attract pollinators
To store water in their stems and roots
To make the fruit sweet and full of sugar
explanation: Plants need nitrogen to make green leaves and to grow healthy.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng mga halaman ang nitrogen upang gumawa ng luntiang dahon at lumago nang malusog.
fact_bis: Ang mga tanom nagkinahanglan og nitrogen aron makahimo og lunhaw nga dahon ug motubo nga himsog.

q: What is the main ingredient that taho is made from?
options: Ground soybeans
Coconut milk
Sweet corn flour
Ground rice
explanation: Taho is a soft food made from ground soybeans that are boiled, strained, and set into a tender curd, then served with syrup and sago.
fact_tl: Ang taho ay isang malambot na pagkain na gawa sa giniling na soybeans na pinakuluan, sinala, at pinaltik para mamuo bilang malambot na kurd na sinasamahan ng arnibal at sago.
fact_bis: Ang taho usa ka humok nga pagkaon nga hinimo gikan sa giniling nga soybeans nga gipabukal, gisala, ug gipagahi-gahi aron mahimong humok nga curd, dayon dugangan ug arnibal ug sago.

q: How does the parrotfish help create white sand on tropical beaches?
options: It bites and grinds coral with its beak-like teeth, and its droppings become white sand
It crushes small shells with its strong jaws and spits them onto the shore
It scrapes limestone rocks on the seafloor and fans the powder toward the beach
It swallows sea glass and passes white grains in its waste
explanation: The parrotfish uses its parrot-like beak to bite coral, and its droppings turn into white sand.
fact_tl: Ang mulmol o parrotfish ay isang makulay na isda na may ngiping parang tuka ng loro na ginagamit nito sa pagkagat ng korales, at ang dumi nito ay nagiging puting buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang molmol o parrotfish usa ka kolor-kolor nga isda nga adunay ngipon nga morag sungo sa loro nga gigamit sa pagkagat sa korales, ug ang hugaw niini mahimong puti nga balas.

q: What was Maya-1, released into orbit in 2018?
options: The first CubeSat built by Filipinos
The first Filipino weather satellite
The first Filipino astronaut's mission capsule
The first Philippine communications satellite
explanation: Maya-1 was the first CubeSat (a small box-shaped satellite) built by Filipinos, released into orbit in 2018.
fact_tl: Ang Maya-1 ang unang CubeSat (maliit na kahong satelayt) na ginawa ng mga Pilipino, inilabas sa orbit noong 2018.
fact_bis: Ang Maya-1 mao ang unang CubeSat (gamay nga kahon nga satelayt) nga gibuhat sa mga Pilipino, gibuhian sa orbita niadtong 2018.

q: Why do ferns and mosses need water to reproduce?
options: Their swimming cells must travel through a film of water to reach and fertilize each other
They can only release spores when rain washes them off the leaf
Their seeds must soak in water before they can split open and germinate
They absorb nutrients through roots that only grow in standing water
explanation: Ferns and mosses need water to reproduce because their swimming cells must travel through a thin film of water to meet.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng pako at lumot ng tubig para makapagparami, dahil ang kanilang lumalangoy na selula ay kailangang dumaan sa manipis na patak ng tubig para magtagpo.
fact_bis: Nagkinahanglan ang pako ug lumot og tubig aron makapadaghan, kay ang ilang molangoy nga selula kinahanglan moagi sa nipis nga tulo sa tubig aron magtagbo.

q: How is sapin-sapin made to have its colorful stacked layers?
options: Each layer of a different color is cooked one at a time before the next is added
All the layers are poured in together and then baked so colors separate on their own
The layers are dyed after cooking and then pressed together while still hot
A single white dough is rolled out, cut into strips, and stacked with food coloring between them
explanation: Sapin-sapin is made of stacked layers of different colors, and each layer is cooked one at a time before the next is added.
fact_tl: Ang sapin-sapin ay gawa sa magkakapatong na manipis na patong na iba-iba ang kulay, at bawat patong ay niluluto nang isa-isa bago ilagay ang susunod.
fact_bis: Ang sapin-sapin gama sa nipis nga sapaw-sapaw nga lainlain og kolor, ug ang matag sapaw lutoon usa-usa una idugang ang sunod.

q: Besides swollen cheeks, what other symptoms does mumps cause?
options: Fever and pain when chewing food
Rash and itchy red spots on the chest
Nausea and severe stomach cramps
Runny nose and watery eyes only
explanation: Besides swollen cheeks, mumps can cause fever and pain when chewing food.
fact_tl: Bukod sa namamagang pisngi, ang beke ay maaaring magdulot ng lagnat at sakit kapag ngumunguya ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Gawas sa hubag nga aping, ang beke mahimong maghatag og hilanat ug kasakit kung mag-usap og pagkaon.

q: Why does adding too much water to a concrete mix make the finished concrete weaker?
options: Extra water leaves tiny pores in the concrete when it hardens
Extra water washes out the cement powder before it can set
Extra water makes the concrete harden too fast and crack
Extra water reacts with gravel to form air bubbles that dissolve later
explanation: Too much water in the mix leaves tiny pores when it hardens, which makes the concrete weaker.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang tubig sa halo ay nag-iiwan ng maliliit na butas kapag tumigas na, kaya humihina ang konkreto.
fact_bis: Ang sobra nga tubig sa sagol magbilin ug gagmay nga mga lungag kon mogahi na, busa mahuyang ang konkreto.

q: Why do divers carry a tank of air on their backs when swimming underwater?
options: Because there is no air underwater and they need oxygen to breathe
Because the water pressure is too high for their lungs to expand on their own
Because cold water temperatures slow breathing and the tank warms the air
Because underwater light is too dim for the diver to see without the tank's lamp
explanation: Divers carry a tank of air because there is no air underwater, and they need the oxygen from the tank to breathe while under the sea.
fact_tl: Hindi tayo makakahinga sa ilalim ng tubig dahil walang hangin doon na pwede nating langhapin. Kaya ang mga maninisid (scuba diver) ay may dalang tangke ng hangin sa likod. Mula rito, nakakakuha sila ng oxygen para makahinga habang nasa ilalim ng dagat.
fact_bis: Dili kita makaginhawa ilawom sa tubig kay wala didtoy hangin nga atong masuyop. Mao nga ang mga maninisid (scuba diver) nagdala og tangke sa hangin sa ilang likod. Gikan niini, makakuha sila og oxygen aron makaginhawa samtang naa sila ilawom sa dagat.

q: Which everyday habit helps conserve the country's resources at home?
options: Turning off lights when no one uses them and closing the faucet while brushing teeth
Buying more bottled water so the water pipes are never used
Running the air conditioner all night so the compressor stays efficient
Leaving chargers plugged in so devices are always ready to use
explanation: When every household turns off unused lights and closes faucets while brushing, the whole nation saves resources together.
fact_tl: Bawat tahanan ay makakatulong sa bansa sa pagtitipid: patayin ang ilaw kapag walang gumagamit at isara ang gripo habang nagsisipilyo. Kapag ginawa ito ng lahat, nakakatipid ang buong bayan ng yaman.
fact_bis: Matag panimalay makatabang sa nasud pinaagi sa pagtipig: palonga ang suga kung walay naggamit ug sirad-i ang gripo samtang nagsipilyo. Kung buhaton kini sa tanan, makatipig og bahandi ang tibuok nasud.

q: Why are plant-eating animals more numerous than meat-eating animals in an ecosystem?
options: Because they are closer to the source of energy
Because they reproduce faster and lay more eggs
Because they are smaller and need less space to survive
Because carnivores eat each other and their numbers drop quickly
explanation: Plant-eating animals are more numerous than animal-eating animals because they are closer to the source of energy.
fact_tl: Mas marami ang mga hayop na kumakain ng halaman kaysa sa mga kumakain ng ibang hayop dahil mas malapit sila sa pinagmulan ng enerhiya.
fact_bis: Mas daghan ang mga hayop nga mokaon og tanom kay sa mokaon og laing hayop kay mas duol sila sa tinubdan sa enerhiya.

q: When are most bats active, and when do they sleep?
options: They sleep during the day and come out at night to find food
They sleep at night and hunt during the early morning hours
They are active all day and rest only briefly at midday
They hunt during the day and migrate at night to new roosting sites
explanation: Most bats are nocturnal — they sleep during the day and come out at night to find food, which is why you often see them at dusk.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga paniki ay nocturnal — natutulog sila sa araw at lumalabas sa gabi para maghanap ng pagkain. Ito ang dahilan kaya madalas mo silang makita sa takipsilim.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga kabog kay nocturnal — matulog sila sa adlaw ug mogawas sa gabii aron mangita og pagkaon. Mao kini ang hinungdan nga sagad nimo sila makita sa kilumkilom.

q: Why is gold considered a nonrenewable resource?
options: It can run out and is not quickly replaced by nature
It dissolves in seawater and becomes too rare to mine
It is found only on other planets and must be brought to Earth
It breaks down into other chemicals over hundreds of years
explanation: Minerals like gold can run out and are not quickly replaced, so we must use them wisely.
fact_tl: Ang mga mineral tulad ng ginto ay nauubos at hindi agad nahahalinhan, kaya mahalagang gamitin ito nang matalino.
fact_bis: Ang mga mineral sama sa bulawan mahurot ug dili dali mapulihan, mao nga kinahanglan gamiton kini nga maalamon.

q: What type of muscle squeezes and pushes food along inside your stomach and intestines without you controlling it?
options: Smooth muscle
Skeletal muscle
Cardiac muscle
Voluntary muscle
explanation: Smooth muscles inside the stomach and intestines squeeze to push food along without us noticing.
fact_tl: May makinis na kalamnan sa loob ng tiyan at bituka na humihila para itulak ang pagkain, kahit hindi natin namamalayan.
fact_bis: Adunay hamis nga kaunuran sulod sa tiyan ug tinai nga mopuga aron iduso ang pagkaon bisan dili nato mamatikdan.

q: What force keeps Earth's atmosphere from drifting off into space?
options: Earth's gravity pulling air downward
The magnetic field trapping gas molecules
The Sun's light pressure pushing air back toward Earth
Ocean currents cycling warm air back to the surface
explanation: Earth's gravity pulls air downward, which keeps the atmosphere held around the planet.
fact_tl: Hinihila ng grabidad ng Earth ang hangin pababa, kaya nananatili ang atmospera sa palibot ng planeta.
fact_bis: Ang grabidad sa Earth mobira sa hangin paubos, mao nga magpabilin ang atmospera palibot sa planeta.

q: What is the magma chamber of a volcano?
options: A large pool of magma stored deep underneath the volcano
The opening at the top of the volcano where lava comes out
The slope of hardened lava on the outside of the volcano
The cloud of ash and gas released during an eruption
explanation: The magma chamber is the large pool of magma stored deep underneath a volcano.
fact_tl: Ang magma chamber ay ang malaking imbakan ng magma sa ilalim ng bulkan.
fact_bis: Ang magma chamber mao ang dako nga tipiganan sa magma sa ilalom sa bulkan.

q: In the Philippines, what is the main food that gives children the energy to play and study after a meal?
options: Rice
Corn
Bread
Camote
explanation: In the Philippines, rice is the main food that answers hunger and gives children the energy to play and study.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, kanin ang pangunahing pagkain na sumasagot sa gutom at nagbibigay ng enerhiya sa mga bata. Kapag kumain ka ng kanin at ulam, nawawala ang gutom at may lakas ka nang maglaro at mag-aral.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang kan-on mao ang nag-unang pagkaon nga motubag sa gutom ug maghatag og kusog sa mga bata. Kon mokaon ka og kan-on ug sud-an, mawala ang gutom ug naa kay kusog sa pagdula ug pagtuon.

q: How did sailors in the Philippines use the amihan wind long ago?
options: To push their sailboats across the sea
To dry their fish catch faster on shore
To cool their homes during the hot months
To predict when the rainy season would begin
explanation: Long ago, sailors used the amihan wind to push their sailboats across the sea.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ginagamit ng mga mandaragat ang amihan upang itulak ang kanilang mga bangka na may layag pataas ng dagat.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, gigamit sa mga mananagat ang hangin sa amihan aron itukmod ang ilang mga sakayang adunay layag tabok sa dagat.

q: How does water breaking rocks apart through freezing work?
options: Water seeps into a crack, freezes and expands, pushing the sides apart and slowly breaking the rock
Water dissolves minerals in the rock, making it soft enough to crumble on its own
Water heats up inside the crack and creates steam pressure that splits the rock
Water washes soil away from under the rock until it falls and shatters on the ground
explanation: When water seeps into a crack and freezes, it expands and pushes the sides apart, slowly breaking rocks down over time.
fact_tl: Kapag pumasok ang tubig sa bitak ng bato at nagyelo, lumalaki ito at itinutulak palayo ang mga gilid — paulit-ulit nitong sinisira at binabasag ang bato sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Kung mosulod ang tubig sa liki sa bato ug mo-yelo, modako kini ug moduso sa mga kilid palayo — sa paglabay sa panahon, hinay-hinay niining gubaon ug buakon ang bato.

q: Who discovered the atomic nucleus in 1911?
options: Ernest Rutherford
Niels Bohr
J.J. Thomson
Marie Curie
explanation: Ernest Rutherford discovered the atomic nucleus in 1911 through his famous gold-foil experiment.
fact_tl: Si Ernest Rutherford ang tumuklas ng nucleus o ubod ng atom noong 1911.
fact_bis: Si Ernest Rutherford maoy nakadiskubre sa nucleus o kinauyokan sa atom niadtong 1911.

q: What happens when something touches the palm of a newborn baby?
options: The baby automatically grips it tightly as a reflex
The baby pulls its hand away as a pain response
The baby relaxes its fingers completely and opens its hand
The baby cries loudly but does not move its fingers
explanation: A newborn baby has a grasp reflex that makes it grip tightly when something touches its palm.
fact_tl: Ang bagong silang na sanggol ay may reflex na kusang humahawak nang mahigpit kapag may humipo sa kanyang palad.
fact_bis: Ang bag-ong natawo nga masuso adunay reflex nga kalit mokapot og hugot kung adunay mohikap sa iyang palad.

q: What did Galileo support about the movement of Earth and other planets?
options: That Earth and other planets move around the Sun
That the Sun moves around the Earth and the Moon
That all planets are fixed in place while the Sun spins
That Earth moves around the Moon, and the Moon around the Sun
explanation: Galileo supported the idea that the Earth and other planets move around the Sun, not the Sun around the Earth.
fact_tl: Sinuportahan ni Galileo ang ideya na ang Mundo at iba pang planeta ay umiikot sa Araw, hindi ang Araw sa Mundo.
fact_bis: Gisuportahan ni Galileo ang ideya nga ang Kalibotan ug ubang planeta nagtuyok sa Adlaw, dili ang Adlaw sa Kalibotan.

q: Why is the loss of forests the biggest danger to the flying lemur?
options: Without closely spaced trees it cannot glide and cannot move well on the ground
Without tall trees the flying lemur cannot build its nest high enough to be safe
Without forest shade its eyes are damaged by direct sunlight, so it cannot hunt at night
Without trees its diet of insects disappears because most insects live only in forest soil
explanation: When the closely spaced trees disappear from logging and land clearing, the flying lemur has nowhere to glide to because it cannot move well on the ground.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking panganib sa kagwang ay ang pagkawala ng mga gubat dahil sa pagputol ng mga puno at pagkalbo ng kagubatan. Kapag nawala ang mga magkakalapit na puno, wala na siyang mapaglilipatan dahil hindi siya mahusay sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga peligro sa kagwang mao ang pagkawala sa kalasangan tungod sa pagputol sa mga kahoy ug paghawan sa kalasangan. Kung mawala ang nagkaduol nga mga kahoy, wala na siyay kalipatan kay dili siya maayo molihok sa yuta.

q: Which of the following is a useful role that bacteria play in our lives?
options: Helping make yogurt and buro, and breaking down dead matter so nutrients return to soil
Producing all of the oxygen we breathe through photosynthesis in the soil
Forming the protective layer of the skin that keeps harmful viruses out
Converting sunlight into sugar for plants that grow in dark environments
explanation: Not all bacteria cause sickness; many are useful — they help make yogurt and buro, break down dead matter, and help digest food in our stomachs.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bacteria ay nakakasakit; marami sa mga ito ay kapaki-pakinabang. Tinutulungan tayo ng bacteria na gumawa ng yogurt at buro, sinisira nila ang patay na bagay para bumalik sa lupa ang sustansya, at marami pa sa loob ng ating tiyan ang tumutulong sa pagtunaw ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga bacteria makapasakit; daghan kanila mapuslanon. Ang bacteria motabang kanato sa paghimo og yogurt ug buro, ilang gun-obon ang patay nga butang aron mobalik sa yuta ang sustansya, ug daghan sa atong tiyan ang motabang sa paghilis sa pagkaon.

q: What happens to clay when you add water to it?
options: It becomes soft and easy to shape
It hardens quickly and cracks when touched
It dissolves completely and turns into muddy water
It becomes rough and grainy like sand
explanation: Clay is a fine, sticky soil that becomes soft and easy to shape when you wet it with water.
fact_tl: Ang luwad (clay) ay isang uri ng lupang napakapino at malagkit na nagiging malambot at madaling hubugin kapag binasa ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang yutang-kolonon (clay) usa ka matang sa yuta nga pino kaayo ug pilit nga mahimong humok ug sayon hulmahon kon basaon og tubig.

q: Which part of the body does COVID-19 mainly attack, making it hard for a sick person to breathe?
options: The lungs
The kidneys
The liver
The stomach
explanation: COVID-19 is a respiratory disease that often attacks the lungs, causing trouble breathing.
fact_tl: Ang COVID-19 ay isang sakit sa paghinga, kaya kadalasan nitong inaatake ang baga at maaaring mahirapan sa paghinga ang maysakit.
fact_bis: Ang COVID-19 usa ka sakit sa pagginhawa, mao nga kasagaran niini giatake ang baga ug mahimong maglisod sa pagginhawa ang masakiton.

q: Who is known as the father of genetics?
options: Gregor Mendel
Charles Darwin
Louis Pasteur
Robert Hooke
explanation: Gregor Mendel is called the father of genetics for his pioneering work on how traits are inherited.
fact_tl: Si Gregor Mendel ang tinaguriang ama ng genetika.
fact_bis: Si Gregor Mendel ang gitawag nga amahan sa genetics.

q: On a medicine label, what is the 'active ingredient'?
options: The real substance that treats the illness
The flavoring added to make the medicine taste better
The amount of liquid in each dose of the medicine
The name of the company that manufactured the medicine
explanation: The active ingredient on the label is the real substance that treats the illness.
fact_tl: Ang active ingredient sa label ang tunay na sangkap na gumagamot sa sakit.
fact_bis: Ang active ingredient sa label mao ang tinuod nga sangkap nga nagtambal sa sakit.

q: How do the clownfish's droppings help the sea anemone it lives with?
options: They act like fertilizer, giving the anemone nutrients so it can grow healthy
They attract small fish that the anemone can catch for food
They coat the anemone's tentacles with a layer that keeps parasites away
They drive away rival clownfish that might harm the anemone's eggs
explanation: The clownfish's droppings and leftover food act like fertilizer, giving the anemone nutrients so it can grow healthy.
fact_tl: Hindi lang proteksyon ang ibinibigay ng clownfish sa anemone. Ang tae at tira-tirang pagkain nito ay parang pataba na nagbibigay ng sustansya sa anemone para lumusog ito. Kaya magkatulong silang dalawa para mabuhay nang mabuti.
fact_bis: Dili lang panalipod ang ihatag sa clownfish sa anemone. Ang iyang ihi-tae ug salin nga pagkaon mahimong sama sa abono nga maghatag og sustansya sa anemone aron molambo kini. Mao nga tinuod gyud silang nagtinabangay.

q: Why is the light made by a firefly called 'cold light'?
options: Because fireflies live in cold climates where temperatures are low
Because almost all of the energy used makes light, with very little heat lost
Because the firefly's body cools down when it produces light
Because cold temperatures help fireflies glow more brightly
explanation: The firefly's light reaction is nearly 100% efficient, turning almost all energy into light with very little heat released, which is why it is called cold light.
fact_tl: Ang reaksyon ng liwanag ng alitaptap ay gumagamit ng ATP (ang energy currency ng selula) at halos 100% efficient—halos lahat ng enerhiya ay nagiging liwanag, napakakaunting init ang naglalabas, kaya ito ay 'cold light'.
fact_bis: Ang reaksyon sa kahayag sa alitaptap naggamit og ATP (ang energy currency sa selula) ug hapit 100% efficient—hapit tanan nga enerhiya nahimong kahayag nga gamay kaayo nga init ang nalabyan, mao nga gitawag kini og 'cold light'.

q: In a circuit diagram, which direction does conventional current flow?
options: From negative to positive, the same direction electrons move
From positive to negative, which is opposite to how electrons actually move
From negative to positive, opposite to how electrons actually move
In both directions at the same time, depending on the voltage
explanation: Conventional current is defined as flowing from positive to negative, but electrons actually move from negative to positive, so the two directions are opposite.
fact_tl: Sa kasaysayan, ang conventional current ay itinakda na umaagos mula positibo patungong negatibo — ngunit sa katunayan, ang mga negatibong elektron ay gumagalaw mula negatibo patungong positibo. Ginagamit pa rin ang conventional direction sa mga diagram ng circuit.
fact_bis: Sa kasaysayan, ang conventional current gitakda nga nagagos gikan sa positibo paingon sa negatibo — apan sa tinuod, ang negatibong mga elektron nagbalhin gikan sa negatibo paingon sa positibo. Ang conventional direction gigamit pa gihapon sa mga circuit diagram.

q: Under which conditions do decomposers break down dead matter most quickly?
options: Cold and dry conditions, which slow bacterial activity
Hot and dry conditions, which speed up all chemical reactions
Warm and moist conditions, which help decomposers work faster
Dark and frozen conditions, which preserve the material longer
explanation: Decomposers work faster when it is warm and moist, which is why things rot quickly in hot, humid weather.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis magtrabaho ang mga decomposer kapag mainit at basa-basa ang paligid, kaya mabilis mabulok ang bagay sa tag-init.
fact_bis: Mas paspas motrabaho ang mga decomposer kung mainit ug mamasa-masa ang palibot, busa paspas malata ang butang sa init nga panahon.

q: In what year did Alfred Nobel patent dynamite?
explanation: Alfred Nobel patented dynamite in the year 1867.
fact_tl: Pinatentehan ni Alfred Nobel ang dynamite noong taong 1867.
fact_bis: Gi-patente ni Alfred Nobel ang dynamite niadtong tuig 1867.

q: What do many Filipino rice farmers plant after harvesting rice to help keep the soil rich?
options: Tobacco or sugarcane, which need less water than rice
Mung beans or corn, especially during the dry season
Another crop of rice to make use of the same water channels
Coconut trees, which restore nutrients over many years
explanation: In the Philippines, many rice farmers plant mung beans or corn after rice in a practice called rice-based crop rotation, which keeps soil rich and provides extra income.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, maraming magsasaka ng palay ang nagtatanim ng munggo o mais pagkatapos ng anihan ng bigas, lalo na sa tuyong panahon (dry season). Tinatawag itong rice-based crop rotation. Tumutulong ito para mapanatiling masustansya ang lupa at magkaroon ng dagdag na kita ang pamilya.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghang mag-uuma sa humay ang nagtanom og munggo o mais human sa ani sa bugas, ilabi na sa ting-init (dry season). Gitawag kini og rice-based crop rotation. Makatabang kini aron magpabilin nga dato ang yuta ug aron makadugang og kita ang pamilya.

q: What is special about the Crocidura shrews found in the Philippines?
options: They are all found on one single island and share the same habitat
Many different Crocidura shrew species are endemic, each found on different islands
They were introduced from other countries and spread across all the islands
Only one species of Crocidura shrew exists in the entire Philippines
explanation: The genus Crocidura has many endemic shrew species in the Philippines, with each species found on different islands of the country.
fact_tl: Ang genus na Crocidura ay mayroong maraming endemikong uri ng shrew sa Pilipinas, bawat isa ay matatagpuan sa iba't ibang pulo ng bansa.
fact_bis: Ang genus nga Crocidura adunay daghang endemikong klase sa shrew sa Pilipinas, ang matag usa makita sa lain-laing pulo sa nasud.

q: What group do pond micro-organisms like paramecium, amoeba, and euglena belong to?
options: Fungi, because they feed on decaying matter in pond water
Bacteria, because they are very tiny single-celled organisms
Protists, which are neither plants nor animals
Algae, because they can make food using sunlight
explanation: Paramecium, amoeba, and euglena all belong to a group called protists, which are neither plants nor animals.
fact_tl: Maraming mikroorganismo sa lawa—tulad ng paramecium, amoeba, at euglena—ay kabilang sa grupong tinatawag na protista, na hindi halaman o hayop.
fact_bis: Daghang mikroorganismo sa danaw—sama sa paramecium, amoeba, ug euglena—kay sakop sa grupo nga gitawag og protista, nga dili tanom o hayop.

q: Why did many 'living fossils' change very little over millions of years?
options: They evolved faster than other species, then stopped changing suddenly
They reproduced so slowly that mutations rarely appeared in the population
They were already well suited to stable habitats that changed very little
They were protected from predators, so natural selection had no pressure to act
explanation: Many living fossils changed very little because they were already well suited to stable habitats that also changed little, removing the pressure to evolve.
fact_tl: Maraming living fossil ang halos hindi nagbago dahil matagal nang angkop sila sa kanilang matatag na tirahan na bahagya ring nagbago.
fact_bis: Daghang living fossil ang halos wala mabag-o tungod kay haom na sila sa ilang lig-on nga puy-anan nga gamay ra usab nag-usab.

q: Which bone is the longest in the human body?
options: The tibia, which is the shin bone in your lower leg
The femur, which is the thigh bone
The humerus, which is the upper arm bone
The spine, which runs down your back
explanation: The longest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamahabang buto sa katawan ay ang femur, ang buto sa hita.
fact_bis: Ang pinakataas nga bukog sa lawas mao ang femur, ang bukog sa paa o hita.

q: How does smoking fish like tinapa help preserve it?
options: The heat from smoking cooks all bacteria instantly and seals the fish dry
Chemical compounds in the smoke, like phenols, slow the growth of bacteria
The salt rubbed on before smoking is the main reason bacteria cannot grow
Removing all the water during smoking makes it impossible for bacteria to survive
explanation: Smoking fish uses chemical compounds from smoke, including phenols, to slow bacterial growth and preserve the fish.
fact_tl: Ang paninigarilyo ng isda tulad ng tinapa ay gumagamit ng kemikal na nagsusulot mula sa usok, kabilang ang mga phenol, na nagpapanatili ng isda sa pamamagitan ng pagpigil ng paglaki ng bacteria.
fact_bis: Ang panisigarilyo sa isda sama sa tinapa naggamit og mga kemikal nga nagkuha gikan sa aso, lakip ang mga phenol, aron mapreserba ang isda pinaagi sa pagpugngan sa pagtubo sa bacteria.

q: How do farmer cooperatives help Filipino farmers?
options: They let individual farmers compete against each other for the best prices
They bring farmers together so they can store more produce and get better prices
They provide free land to farmers who cannot afford to buy their own fields
They replace small family farms with large government-owned plantations
explanation: Farmer cooperatives in the Philippines bring many farmers together so they can store more produce and negotiate better prices for their harvest.
fact_tl: Ang mga kooperatiba ng mga magsasaka sa Pilipinas ay nagtitipon ng maraming magsasaka upang makapagtago ng higit na produkto at makakuha ng mas magandang presyo sa kanilang ani.
fact_bis: Ang mga kooperatiba sa mga mag-uuma sa Pilipinas nagtipun sa daghang mga mag-uuma aron makapag-imbak og mas daghang produkto ug makakuha og mas maayo nga presyo sa ilang ani.

q: What percentage of sunlight does the Moon's surface actually reflect?
options: About 50%, which is why the full Moon lights up the night sky so well
About 75%, because the Moon's rocky surface acts like a giant mirror
About 12%, similar to worn asphalt, and it looks bright only by contrast
About 30%, the same as Earth's average reflectivity
explanation: The Moon's average albedo is only about 12%, similar to worn asphalt; it appears bright only by contrast with the dark sky and because our eyes adapt to the low light.
fact_tl: Ang Moon ay hindi masyadong mapabilog (reflective) — ang average albedo nito ay humigit-kumulang 12%, katulad ng tinadtad na aspalto sa karaan; ang Moon ay tila maliwanag dahsa ito ay napaka-liwanag na ipinaghambing sa madilim na kalangitan at napalapot sa ating mga mata.
fact_bis: Ang Moon dili kaayo reflective — ang iyang average albedo mga 12%, susama sa lumang aspalto; ang Moon morag hayag lamang tungod sa kontraste sa ngitngit nga langit ug tungod kay ang atong mga mata nag-adapt sa ubos nga antas sa suga.

q: When is soap and water better than hand sanitizer for cleaning your hands?
options: When you need to kill viruses, because sanitizer only works on bacteria
When your hands are warm, because heat stops sanitizer from working
When your hands are covered in dirt or grease, because sanitizer does not work well then
When you are in a hurry, because soap and water takes less time than sanitizer
explanation: Hand sanitizer does not work well on hands covered in dirt or grease, so soap and water is the better choice in those situations.
fact_tl: Ang sanitizer ay hindi gaanong mabisa sa kamay na may putik o langis, kaya mas mainam pa ring maghugas ng sabon at tubig.
fact_bis: Ang sanitizer dili kaayo epektibo sa kamot nga adunay lapok o lana, busa mas maayo gihapon ang paghugas og sabon ug tubig.

q: Which region of the Philippines is known for its major pineapple plantations?
options: The Ilocos Region in northern Luzon, which has the ideal sandy soil
The Bicol Region, where the volcanic soil makes pineapples extra sweet
Bukidnon and other parts of Mindanao, where large pineapple farms are found
The Visayas islands, which have the longest dry season for growing pineapples
explanation: Major pineapple plantations in the Philippines are found in Bukidnon and other parts of Mindanao, and the country is one of the world's largest pineapple exporters.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga pinakamalaking tagapagluwas ng pinya sa mundo; ang malalaking plantasyon ay nasa Bukidnon at iba pang lugar sa Mindanao, at ang pinya ay exported bilang prutas at juice.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa pinakadakong nagpaluwas og pinya sa kalibutan; ang mga dakong plantasyon anaa sa Bukidnon ug ubang lugar sa Mindanao, ug ang pinya gipaluwas isip sariwa nga prutas ug juice.

q: What is one key difference between how a bird's wing and an airplane's wing work?
options: A bird's wing is flat while an airplane's wing is curved, so only the plane makes lift
A bird flaps its wings to pull itself forward, while an airplane's fixed wings use an engine to push forward
An airplane's wings flap slowly while a bird's wings stay rigid during flight
A bird glides using warm air currents, while a plane relies entirely on its wing shape for lift
explanation: Both a bird's wing and an airplane's wing create lift due to their shape, but a bird flaps its wings to move forward while an airplane's wings stay fixed and an engine provides the forward push.
fact_tl: Pareho ang pakpak ng ibon at eroplano sa paggawa ng lift dahil sa hugis nila. Pero may malaking pagkakaiba: pumapagaspas ang pakpak ng ibon para mahila ang sarili nito pasulong, samantalang naka-fixed ang pakpak ng eroplano at makina o turbina ang nagtutulak dito pasulong.
fact_bis: Parehas ang pako sa langgam ug eroplano sa paghimo og lift tungod sa ilang porma. Apan adunay dakong kalainan: mokampay ang pako sa langgam aron birahon ang kaugalingon pasulong, samtang fixed ang pako sa eroplano ug makina ang motulod niini pasulong.

q: Who is the Celsius temperature scale named after?
options: Gabriel Fahrenheit, the German scientist who invented thermometers
Lord Kelvin, the British physicist who studied heat and energy
Anders Celsius, the scientist who created the scale
Isaac Newton, who proposed using body temperature as a reference point
explanation: The Celsius scale is named after Anders Celsius, the scientist who created it.
fact_tl: Ang Celsius scale ay ipinangalan kay Anders Celsius, ang siyentipikong gumawa nito.
fact_bis: Ang Celsius scale ginganlan sunod kang Anders Celsius, ang siyentista nga naghimo niini.

q: How does a spider catch its food?
options: It runs after insects on the ground and catches them with its front legs
It makes a web to trap insects like flies that fly into it
It waits inside flower petals and bites insects that come to drink nectar
It sprays sticky liquid from its mouth to glue insects to leaves
explanation: A spider is a predator that makes a web to trap insects like flies, then feeds on them.
fact_tl: Ang gagamba ay isang mananakop na gumagawa ng sapot para mahuli ang mga insektong gaya ng langaw.
fact_bis: Ang lawalawa usa ka manghuhuli nga maghimo ug lawa-lawa aron madakpan ang mga insekto sama sa langaw.

q: What wavelength of light does sodium produce in a flame test?
options: About 450 nanometers, which appears as a bright blue color
About 520 nanometers, which appears as a bright green color
About 589 nanometers, which appears as a yellow color
About 700 nanometers, which appears as a deep red color
explanation: Sodium produces a yellow flame with a wavelength of about 589 nanometers, known as the sodium D-line.
fact_tl: Ang dilaw na liwanag ng sodium ay nasa wavelength na humigit-kumulang 589 nanometro (nm), tinatawag na sodium D-line.
fact_bis: Ang dalag nga kahayag sa sodium naa sa wavelength nga mga 589 nanometers (nm), gitawag nga sodium D-line.

q: Why is insect blood usually yellow or clear instead of red?
options: Insects are too small to produce red blood cells, so their blood stays colorless
Insects do not have hemoglobin; their tracheal system delivers oxygen directly to tissues
Insect blood turns red only when they are injured, otherwise it stays yellow
Insects absorb oxygen through their skin, so their blood carries nutrients only
explanation: Insect blood, called hemolymph, is usually yellow or clear because insects lack hemoglobin; instead, their tracheal system delivers oxygen directly to body tissues.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ng insekto ay tinatawag na hemolymph—ito ay karaniwang dilaw o malinaw, hindi pula, dahil ang mga insekto ay hindi gumagamit ng hemoglobin para magdala ng oxygen; ginagawa ng kanilang tracheal system ang trabahong ito.
fact_bis: Ang dugo sa insekto gitawag og hemolymph—kasagaran dilaw o klaro, dili pula, tungod kay ang mga insekto dili naggamit og hemoglobin para magdala og oxygen; ang ilang tracheal system nagdistribute sa oxygen diretso sa mga tissue.

q: What kind of teeth do cows and horses use to grind tough grass?
options: Sharp canine teeth that cut through tough grass stalks
Flat incisors at the front of the mouth that slice grass into small pieces
Large molar teeth at the back of the mouth that grind grass over and over
Hollow teeth that break grass down using special chemicals inside
explanation: Cows and horses have large molar teeth that grind tough grass repeatedly, making it easier to digest.
fact_tl: Ang baka at kabayo ay may malalaking bagang na ngipin na gumigiling ng matigas na damo nang paulit-ulit.
fact_bis: Ang baka ug kabayo adunay dagko nga bagang nga ngipon nga sige og galing sa gahi nga sagbot.

q: In a jeepney, if one headlight stops working, what happens to the horn and signal lights?
options: They all stop working because all parts share a single circuit connected to the battery
They also dim because the battery has to share power among fewer working parts
They still work because each part sits on its own separate circuit
The signal lights stop but the horn continues since it uses a different battery
explanation: In a jeepney, each part like the headlights, horn, and signal lights sits on its own circuit, so if one light fails, the others continue to work.
fact_tl: Sa dyip o tricycle, may baterya na nagpapadaloy ng current papunta sa headlight, busina, at signal light. Bawat parteng iyon ay nasa sariling circuit, kaya kahit patay ang isang ilaw, gumagana pa rin ang iba.
fact_bis: Sa dyip o tricycle, adunay baterya nga nagpaagos sa current paingon sa headlight, busina, ug signal light. Ang matag bahin naa sa kaugalingong circuit, mao nga bisan palong ang usa ka suga, molihok gihapon ang uban.

q: Which color of visible light has the longest wavelength?
options: Violet, which is at the far end of the visible spectrum
Blue, which travels farthest through the atmosphere
Green, which is in the middle of the visible spectrum
Red, which is at the other end of the spectrum from violet
explanation: Among the visible colors, red has the longest wavelength, while violet has the shortest.
fact_tl: Sa mga kulay na nakikita, ang pula (red) ang may pinakamahabang wavelength.
fact_bis: Sa mga kolor nga makita, ang pula (red) maoy naay pinakataas nga wavelength.

q: Why should you not eat only go foods like rice or bread at a meal?
options: Go foods spoil quickly and become unsafe to eat when not mixed with other foods
Go foods have too much sugar on their own and become unhealthy without protein
They should be paired with grow foods like meat and glow foods like vegetables for a complete and balanced meal
Go foods can only be digested properly when eaten alongside dairy products
explanation: Go foods should be paired with grow foods like meat and glow foods like vegetables and fruits so the meal is complete and balanced.
fact_tl: Hindi tama na go food lang ang kainin. Dapat may kasama itong grow food gaya ng karne at glow food gaya ng gulay at prutas para kumpleto at balanse ang pagkain mo.
fact_bis: Dili maayo nga go food lang ang kan-on. Kinahanglan kauban niini ang grow food sama sa karne ug glow food sama sa utan ug prutas aron kompleto ug balanse ang imong pagkaon.

q: How is heat transferred by convection in boiling water?
options: Heat travels directly from the hot pot through the water without moving the water itself
Infrared rays from the flame pass through the water and heat it evenly throughout
The warmer, lighter water rises while the cooler water sinks, carrying heat as the fluid moves
Heat jumps instantly to all parts of the water at the same moment when it reaches boiling point
explanation: In convection, heat is carried as warm fluid moves — the hotter, lighter water rises while the cooler part sinks, as seen in boiling water.
fact_tl: Sa convection, naililipat ang init kapag umaagos ang mainit na likido o gas — ang mas mainit at magaan na bahagi ay pumapaitaas habang ang mas malamig ay bumababa, gaya ng nangyayari sa kumukulong tubig.
fact_bis: Sa convection, ang init mabalhin samtang ang init nga likido o gas moagos — ang mas init ug magaan nga bahin mosaka samtang ang mas bugnaw manaog, sama sa mahitabo sa nagbukal nga tubig.

q: What can happen if you regularly listen to very loud music through earphones?
options: Your eardrums become stronger and you can hear higher frequencies over time
The loud sound can damage the tiny sensors inside your ear, causing hearing loss
Loud music only harms your hearing if you listen without breaks for many hours
Your ear produces more wax to block the sound, which eventually causes temporary deafness
explanation: Very loud sound can damage the tiny sensors inside the ear, so it is wise not to turn earphones up too high.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang lakas na tunog ay maaaring makasira sa maliliit na sensor sa loob ng tainga, kaya mabuting hindi palakasin nang husto ang earphone at takpan ang tainga kapag napakaingay.
fact_bis: Ang sobra ka kusog nga tingog makadaot sa gagmay nga sensor sa sulod sa dalunggan, busa maayo nga dili palabihan ug kusog ang earphone ug tabonan ang dalunggan kon sobra ka saba.

q: Why do scientists study how tardigrades survive without water?
options: To understand how animals can grow without food and apply it to human fasting medicine
To develop robots that can survive in space without any protection from radiation
To learn how cells and proteins stay safe when dry, hoping to store medicines or vaccines without refrigeration
To find out how tardigrades repair DNA damage so the same method can regrow human organs
explanation: Scientists study tardigrades to learn how they keep cells and proteins safe when dry, with the hope of storing medicines or vaccines longer without constant refrigeration.
fact_tl: Bakit pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko ang tardigrade? Gusto nilang matutunan kung paano nito naitatago ang mga selula at protina nang ligtas habang tuyo. Sana ay magamit ito para mas matagal na maitago ang mga gamot o bakuna nang hindi kailangang palagiang malamig, lalo na sa mga lugar na walang refrigerator.
fact_bis: Ngano gitun-an sa mga siyentista ang tardigrade? Gusto nilang masayran kon unsaon niini pagtipig sa mga selula ug protina nga luwas samtang uga. Ang paglaom mao nga magamit kini aron mas dugay matipigan ang mga tambal o bakuna nga dili kanunay nagkinahanglan ug bugnaw, ilabi na sa mga dapit nga walay refrigerator.

q: Why do most trees in the Philippines not have leaves that change color in autumn?
options: Filipino trees have thicker leaves that block the chemicals that cause color change
The Philippines does not have autumn; it only has dry and wet seasons
Autumn color change only happens to trees that grow near snow, which the Philippines lacks
Filipino trees do change color, but they do it at night when no one can see it
explanation: There is no autumn in the Philippines because it is a tropical country with only dry and wet seasons, so most leaves do not change color.
fact_tl: Walang taglagas sa Pilipinas; dalawa lang ang panahon natin, ang tag-init at tag-ulan, kaya hindi nagpapalit ng kulay ang karamihan ng dahon.
fact_bis: Walay tinglagas sa Pilipinas; duha ra ka panahon ang atoa, ang ting-init ug ting-ulan, mao nga ang kadaghanan sa dahon dili mag-ilis og kolor.

q: What three things must come together for iron to rust?
options: Iron, carbon dioxide, and sunlight
Iron, salt, and high temperature
Iron, oxygen, and water
Iron, acid rain, and wind
explanation: When iron, oxygen, and water come together, rust slowly forms as oxygen 'eats' the iron, which is why iron is painted or oiled to block oxygen.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa apoy at paghinga kailangan ang oxygen — kapag pinagsama ang bakal, oxygen, at tubig, dahan-dahang nabubuo ang kalawang (rust). Parang isang mabagal na 'pagkain' ng oxygen sa bakal. Kaya pinipintahan o pinapahiran ng langis ang bakal para harangan ang oxygen at maiwasan ang pagkalawang.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang kalayo ug pagginhawa ang nagkinahanglan og oxygen — kung magtapok ang puthaw, oxygen, ug tubig, hinay-hinay nga maporma ang taya (rust). Sama kini sa hinay nga 'pagkaon' sa oxygen sa puthaw. Mao nga pintalan o lanahan ang puthaw, aron babagan ang oxygen ug malikayan ang pagkataya.

q: What does a tortoise's shell look like?
options: Flat and wide, like a round plate lying on the ground
Pointed and narrow, like an upside-down cone
High and dome-shaped, like an upside-down bowl
Soft and flexible, like a leather bag filled with air
explanation: A tortoise usually has a high, dome-shaped shell, like an upside-down bowl.
fact_tl: Karaniwang mataas at hubog (dome) ang kabibe ng tortoise, na parang nakatungtong na malaking kopa.
fact_bis: Ang tortoise kasagaran adunay taas ug hubog (dome) nga bao, sama sa gibalintong nga dako nga panaksan.

q: What weather effect does El Nino usually bring to the Philippines?
options: Heavier-than-normal rainfall that leads to widespread flooding across the islands
Cooler temperatures and more typhoons hitting the eastern coast
Less rainfall, longer dry spells, and a higher risk of water shortages and crop damage
Stronger monsoon winds that bring unusually cold weather to mountain areas
explanation: In the Philippines, El Nino usually brings less rainfall, longer dry spells, and higher risk of water shortages and crop damage.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang El Niño ay kadalasang nagdadala ng mas kaunting ulan, mas mahabang tagtuyot, at mas mataas na panganib ng kakulangan sa tubig at pagkasira ng ani.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang El Niño kasagaran nagadala og gamay nga ulan, mas taas nga huwaw, ug mas dako nga peligro sa kakulang sa tubig ug kadaot sa ani.

q: What happens to atoms as you move down the rows (periods) of the periodic table?
options: Atoms get smaller because the stronger nucleus pulls electrons closer together
Atoms gain more protons but lose electrons, making them electrically charged
Atoms gain a new electron shell with each row, making them larger
Atoms become lighter because outer electrons are held loosely and can be lost
explanation: Each row (period) going down the periodic table adds a new electron shell to the atoms, so atoms get larger as you move down.
fact_tl: Bawat pababang hanay (period) sa periodic table ay nagdaragdag ng isang bagong balat ng elektron sa mga atomo, kaya lumalaki ang mga atomo habang bumababa ka sa talahanayan.
fact_bis: Ang matag laray (period) paubos sa periodic table magdugang og bag-ong sapaw sa electron sa mga atomo, mao nga modako ang mga atomo samtang manaog ka sa talaan.

q: How does camouflage help a moth's species survive from one generation to the next?
options: It helps the moth find food more easily by blending in with flowers it feeds on
It makes the moth look like a more dangerous insect, scaring away larger predators
When birds cannot see the moth, it lives longer and has more chances to lay eggs
It keeps the moth warm at night by hiding it from cold winds in the dark
explanation: When birds cannot see camouflaged moths, the moths live longer and have more chances to lay eggs, helping their kind continue from one generation to the next.
fact_tl: Bakit importante ang camouflage sa gamu-gamo? Kapag hindi sila nakikita ng ibon, mas matagal silang nabubuhay. Kapag mas matagal silang nabubuhay, may pagkakataon silang mangitlog at magkaroon ng mga anak. Kaya ang pagtatago ay tumutulong sa kanila na magpatuloy ang kanilang lahi.
fact_bis: Ngano importante ang camouflage sa gamu-gamo? Kung dili sila makita sa langgam, mas dugay sila mabuhi. Kung mas dugay sila mabuhi, naa silay higayon nga mangitlog ug makabaton og anak. Mao nga ang pagtago motabang aron magpadayon ang ilang kaliwat.

q: Why are bass instruments like the double bass and tuba built so large?
options: Large instruments are easier to hold and play for musicians with bigger hands
Their large size makes them louder so the sound can fill a concert hall
Their long, thick parts vibrate slowly, producing the very low notes that give music its foundation
They need more air space inside so the sound can echo and become richer
explanation: Bass instruments are built large on purpose because their long, thick parts vibrate slowly, allowing them to produce the very low notes that give music its foundation.
fact_tl: Ang mga bass na instrumento tulad ng double bass at tuba ay ginawang malalaki sa layunin. Ang mahaba at makapal na bahagi nito ay mabagal mag-vibrate, kaya nakakagawa sila ng napakababang nota na nagbibigay ng pundasyon sa musika.
fact_bis: Ang mga bass nga instrumento sama sa double bass ug tuba gihimo nga dagko sa tuyo. Ang taas ug baga nga bahin niini hinay mag-vibrate, busa makahimo silag ubos kaayo nga nota nga maghatag ug pundasyon sa musika.

q: What everyday challenge might a color blind person face?
options: Difficulty hearing differences between high and low pitched sounds
Trouble reading small text in dim lighting conditions
Finding it hard to read traffic lights or tell if a fruit is ripe by its color
Being unable to recognize faces of people they have met before
explanation: A color blind person may find it hard to read traffic lights or tell if a fruit is ripe by its color, since these rely on seeing color differences.
fact_tl: Maaaring mahirapan ang color blind na taong matukoy ang ilaw trapiko o kung hinog na ang isang prutas dahil sa kulay.
fact_bis: Ang tawo nga color blind mahimong maglisod pag-ila sa ilaw sa trapiko o kung hinog na ba ang prutas pinaagi sa kolor niini.

q: How did limestone form long ago?
options: It formed when molten lava from volcanoes cooled slowly deep underground
Sand grains were squeezed together for millions of years by the weight of rock above
It formed from the shells and coral of ancient sea creatures that piled up and hardened
Minerals dissolved in rainwater collected in caves and slowly built up into solid rock
explanation: Limestone formed long ago from the shells and coral of sea creatures that accumulated and hardened over time.
fact_tl: Ang limestone ay nabuo mula sa mga kabibe at coral ng mga hayop-dagat noong unang panahon.
fact_bis: Ang limestone naporma kaniadto gikan sa mga kabhang ug coral sa mga mananap sa dagat.

q: What is the unit used to measure electrical resistance?
options: The volt, with the symbol V
The ampere, with the symbol A
The watt, with the symbol W
The ohm, with the symbol Omega
explanation: The unit of electrical resistance is the ohm, represented by the symbol Omega.
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng resistance ay ang ohm, na may simbolong Ω (omega).
fact_bis: Ang yunit sa resistance kay ang ohm, nga may simbolo nga Ω (omega).

q: What does a vaccine do in your body?
options: It kills all bacteria in the body immediately after injection to prevent infection
It adds extra white blood cells to help fight any kind of infection at any time
It trains the immune system to recognize and fight a specific germ before you get sick
It builds a protective coating around your organs so germs cannot enter your body
explanation: A vaccine trains the body's immune system to recognize and fight a specific germ before you ever become sick from it.
fact_tl: Ang bakuna ay nagtuturo sa immune system ng katawan na kilalanin at labanan ang isang partikular na mikrobyo bago ka pa magkasakit.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna nagatudlo sa immune system sa lawas nga mailhan ug awayon ang usa ka piho nga mikrobyo sa dili pa ka magsakit.

q: Which Philippine island is known for coal mining?
options: Palawan, which is known for its underground rivers and mineral deposits
Leyte, where geothermal energy and coal deposits are found side by side
Semirara Island, which is known for coal mining in the Philippines
Dinagat Island, where large coal reserves were discovered in the 1990s
explanation: In the Philippines, Semirara Island is known for coal mining, where coal is dug out from near the surface or through tunnels underground.
fact_tl: Para makuha ang uling, hinuhukay ito mula sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng mining. May mga uling na malapit lang sa ibabaw, pero ang iba ay nasa ilalim ng lupa kaya kailangang gumawa ng malalalim na lagusan. Sa Pilipinas, ang Semirara Island ay kilala sa coal mining.
fact_bis: Aron makuha ang uling, kaloton kini gikan sa yuta pinaagi sa mining. Ang ubang uling duol ra sa ibabaw, apan ang uban lawom sa ilalom sa yuta nga nanginahanglan og lungag. Sa Pilipinas, ang Semirara Island ilado sa coal mining.

q: Why is the mitochondria called the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
options: Because it controls everything the cell does, like a power switch turning functions on and off
Because it stores extra food that the cell can use later when energy runs low
Because it produces energy from food that the cell uses to do its work
Because it generates heat that keeps the cell at the right temperature to function
explanation: The mitochondria is called the powerhouse of the cell because it produces energy from food that the cell uses to carry out all its activities.
fact_tl: Ang mitochondria ay tinatawag na 'powerhouse ng selula' dahil ito ay gumagawa ng enerhiya mula sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mitocondria gitawag nga 'powerhouse sa selula' tungod kay kini nagahimo og enerhiya gikan sa pagkaon.

q: Which rover brought the Ingenuity helicopter to Mars in 2021?
options: Curiosity, which was already exploring Mars when Ingenuity arrived
Spirit, which was NASA's longest-running Mars rover at the time
Opportunity, which carried Ingenuity as part of its extended mission
Perseverance, which carried the small Ingenuity helicopter to Mars
explanation: The Perseverance rover carried the small Ingenuity helicopter to Mars in 2021, where Ingenuity made the first powered flight on another planet.
fact_tl: Ang Perseverance rover ang nagdala sa maliit na helicopter na Ingenuity papuntang Mars noong 2021.
fact_bis: Ang Perseverance rover mao ang nagdala sa gamay nga helikopter nga Ingenuity padulong sa Mars niadtong 2021.

q: Which insect is considered the strongest for its size?
options: The rhinoceros beetle, which can carry large pieces of bark in the forest
The leafcutter ant, which carries leaves many times heavier than its body
The dung beetle, which can pull objects more than 1,000 times its own weight
The hercules beetle, which lifts other beetles during territory fights
explanation: The dung beetle is considered the strongest insect for its size, capable of pulling objects more than 1,000 times its own weight.
fact_tl: Ang dung beetle ang itinuturing na pinakamalakas na insekto kung itutumbas sa laki nito. Kaya nitong hilahin ang bagay na mahigit 1,000 beses ang bigat kaysa sa sarili nito.
fact_bis: Ang dung beetle giila nga pinakakusgan nga insekto kon itandi sa kadako niini. Makahimo kini sa pagguyod og mga butang nga kapin sa 1,000 ka pilo ang gibug-aton kaysa sa kaugalingon niini.

q: Why do barnacles attach themselves to whales instead of staying on rocks?
options: Whale skin is softer than rock, making it easier for barnacles to hold on tightly
Barnacles use the whale's body heat to survive in cold ocean waters
As the whale swims, fresh water full of food keeps flowing past the barnacle, bringing a constant food supply
Whales carry barnacles to warm shallow waters where barnacles can reproduce
explanation: As the whale swims, fresh water full of food keeps flowing past the barnacle, giving it a constant supply of food, like sitting in front of a buffet.
fact_tl: Bakit gusto ng barnacle na sumakay sa whale na gumagalaw? Dahil habang lumalangoy ang whale, dumadaloy ang sariwang tubig na may pagkain papunta sa barnacle. Para itong nakaupo sa harap ng buffet na palaging may bagong dating na pagkain!
fact_bis: Ngano gusto sa barnacle nga musakay sa balyena nga naglihok? Tungod kay samtang naglangoy ang balyena, ang lab-as nga tubig nga puno sa pagkaon kanunay nga muagi sa barnacle. Murag naglingkod kini atubangan sa buffet diin kanunay nga muabot ang bag-ong pagkaon!

q: Which of these is a sign that a chemical reaction has taken place?
options: A substance moves from one container to another without changing its properties
The size and shape of a solid object change when it is cut or broken
A color change, release of gas, or a temperature change occurs in the materials
A liquid is poured and takes the shape of a new container without any other change
explanation: Signs that a chemical reaction has occurred include a color change, release of gas or bubbles, formation of a precipitate, and a temperature change such as heating up or cooling down.
fact_tl: Ang ilang palatandaan na may naganap na reaksyong kemikal ay pagbabago ng kulay, paglabas ng gas o bula, pagbuo ng latak (precipitate), at pagbabago ng temperatura tulad ng pag-init o paglamig.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka timailhan nga adunay nahitabo nga reaksiyong kemikal mao ang pag-usab sa kolor, paggawas sa gas o bula, pagporma sa latak (precipitate), ug pag-usab sa temperatura sama sa pag-init o pagbugnaw.

q: What is the difference between a wind gust and sustained wind?
options: Sustained wind blows only during the day while a wind gust happens only at night
A wind gust is the average wind speed measured over ten minutes; sustained wind is the peak speed
Sustained wind is the average wind speed over 10 minutes; a wind gust is the peak speed over a short period
Wind gusts and sustained winds are the same thing measured by different instruments
explanation: Sustained wind is the average wind speed over 10 minutes, while a wind gust is the peak wind speed over a short period and can be much higher than the sustained wind.
fact_tl: Ang sustained wind ay ang average na bilis ng hangin sa loob ng 10 minuto; ang wind gust naman ay ang pinakamataas na bilis ng hangin sa maikling panahon na maaaring mas mataas kaysa sustained wind.
fact_bis: Ang sustained wind mao ang average nga bilis sa hangin sulod sa 10 minuto; ang wind gust mao ang pinakataas nga bilis sa hangin sulod sa mubo nga panahon nga mahimong mas taas kaysa sustained wind.

q: What is a Mars rover and what does it do?
options: A robotic spacecraft that orbits Mars and takes photos from high above the surface
A wheeled robot driven across the surface of Mars to take pictures and study its rocks and soil
A remote-controlled submarine sent to explore underground lakes beneath the Martian surface
A satellite that measures Mars's magnetic field and sends data back to Earth
explanation: A rover is a wheeled robot driven across the surface of Mars to take pictures and study its rocks and soil.
fact_tl: Ang rover ay isang robot na may mga gulong na pinapagala sa ibabaw ng Mars para kumuha ng larawan at suriin ang mga bato at lupa.
fact_bis: Ang rover usa ka robot nga adunay mga ligid nga gipasuroy sa ibabaw sa Mars aron magkuha og hulagway ug magtuon sa mga bato ug yuta niini.

q: What happens to the Agusan Marsh's flood protection ability when it is damaged by pollution or illegal fishing?
options: The marsh becomes deeper and absorbs even more floodwater than before
It becomes saltier, which actually improves its ability to filter polluted water
Animals lose their home and the marsh's protection against floods becomes weaker
The marsh drains faster into the river, reducing the risk of local flooding
explanation: When the Agusan Marsh is damaged by threats like pollution and cutting trees, animals lose their home and its protection against floods becomes weaker.
fact_tl: May mga banta sa Agusan Marsh tulad ng polusyon, basura, sobrang pangingisda, at pagputol ng mga puno sa paligid. Kapag nasira ang marsh, mawawalan ng tirahan ang mga hayop at hihina ang proteksyon nito laban sa baha.
fact_bis: Ang Agusan Marsh nag-atubang sa mga hulga sama sa polusyon, basura, sobra nga pagpangisda, ug pagputol sa mga kahoy sa palibot. Kon madaot ang marsh, mawad-an og puy-anan ang mga hayop ug mohuyang ang panalipod niini batok sa baha.

q: How does seaweed help small fish and sea animals?
options: It produces oxygen only at the surface where fish cannot reach it
It filters salt out of seawater so small fish have fresh water to drink
It provides shelter and hiding places for small fish and sea animals
It gives off light at night so small sea animals can find food in the dark
explanation: Seaweed provides shelter and hiding places for small fish and sea animals, making it an important part of the ocean habitat.
fact_tl: Ang damong-dagat ay nagbibigay ng tirahan at taguan sa maliliit na isda at hayop sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang lumot sa dagat naghatag ug puy-anan ug tagoanan sa gagmay nga isda ug mananap sa dagat.

q: What makes a solid different from a liquid when it comes to shape and volume?
options: A solid takes the shape of any container you put it in, but always keeps the same volume
A solid can flow slowly and change shape over time, but its volume stays the same
A solid has both a fixed shape and a fixed volume that do not change
A solid keeps its shape but its volume changes depending on the temperature
explanation: A solid has both a fixed shape and a fixed size (volume) that do not change, unlike liquids and gases which change shape to fit their container.
fact_tl: Ang solido ay may tiyak na hugis at tiyak na laki (volume) na parehong hindi nagbabago.
fact_bis: Ang solido naa piho nga porma ug piho nga gidak-on (volume) nga parehong dili mausab.

q: What are the two siphons in shellfish like clams used for?
options: One siphon sprays ink to confuse predators; the other is used to push the shellfish along the seafloor
One pulls in fresh water with food, and the other pushes out filtered water along with waste
Both siphons pull in water from opposite sides so the shellfish can catch food from two directions
One siphon breathes in oxygen and the other releases carbon dioxide, like the shellfish's lungs
explanation: Many shellfish have two siphons: one pulls in fresh water with food, and the other pushes out the filtered water along with waste.
fact_tl: Maraming kabibe ang may dalawang parang tubo na tinatawag na siphon: sa isa pumapasok ang sariwang tubig na may pagkain, at sa kabila lumalabas ang nasalang tubig na kasama na ang dumi.
fact_bis: Daghang kabibe adunay duha ka murag tubo nga gitawag og siphon: ang usa mosuyop og presko nga tubig nga may pagkaon, ug ang lain mopagawas sa nasala nga tubig uban sa hugaw.

q: What is the main difference between the greenhouse effect and the ozone hole?
options: The greenhouse effect happens only over the poles while the ozone hole affects the whole planet equally
They are the same environmental problem, just described from different scientific perspectives
The greenhouse effect is about gases trapping heat, while the ozone layer blocks harmful ultraviolet rays
The ozone hole causes global warming while the greenhouse effect causes more skin cancer from UV rays
explanation: The greenhouse effect is about heat being trapped by gases, while the ozone layer blocks harmful ultraviolet rays — they are two different environmental issues.
fact_tl: Iba ang greenhouse effect sa butas ng ozone: ang greenhouse effect ay tungkol sa init, samantalang ang ozone layer ay humaharang sa nakakasamang ultraviolet rays.
fact_bis: Lahi ang greenhouse effect sa buslot sa ozone: ang greenhouse effect bahin sa kainit, samtang ang ozone layer mag-ali sa makadaot nga ultraviolet rays.

q: What is the name of the largest single tree in the world by volume?
options: General Sherman
General Grant
Hyperion
Methuselah
explanation: The largest single tree in the world by volume is a giant sequoia called General Sherman.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking puno sa mundo ayon sa dami ng kahoy ay ang giant sequoia na tinatawag na General Sherman.
fact_bis: Ang labing dako nga kahoy sa kalibotan base sa gidaghanon sa kahoy kay ang giant sequoia nga ginganlag General Sherman.

q: Why do we need to eat foods like fish and seaweed to get iodine?
options: The body cannot make iodine on its own
The body makes too little iodine after age 10
Iodine is destroyed by cooking unless eaten raw from the sea
Iodine only works when combined with seafood protein
explanation: The body cannot produce iodine on its own, so we must get it from foods like fish, shrimp, and seaweed.
fact_tl: Hindi gawa ng katawan ang iodine, kaya kailangan natin itong makuha sa pagkain gaya ng isda, hipon, damong-dagat, at iba pang seafood mula sa dagat.
fact_bis: Dili makahimo ang lawas og iodine, mao nga kinahanglan nato makuha kini gikan sa pagkaon sama sa isda, pasayan, lapu-lapu sa dagat, ug uban pang seafood.

q: Why do some scissors have a spring attached to them?
options: To push the blades open again so your hand gets less tired
To make the blades sharper as you cut
To keep the blades from crossing too far and breaking
To increase the force when you squeeze them shut
explanation: The spring in some scissors pushes them back open after each squeeze, reducing hand fatigue during many cuts.
fact_tl: May ilang gunting na may spring o resilyo na nagbubukas sa kanila pagkatapos mong pisilin. Palanca pa rin sila, pero tinutulungan ka ng spring para hindi ka mapagod sa maraming gupit.
fact_bis: Adunay pipila ka gunting nga adunay spring o resilyo nga moabli kanila human nimo pislita. Palanca gihapon sila, apan ang spring motabang kanimo aron dili ka kapoyon sa daghang putol.

q: Which cells must have a mutation for it to be passed on to an animal's offspring?
options: Egg and sperm cells (sex cells)
Skin and muscle cells
Blood and nerve cells
Bone and liver cells
explanation: Only mutations in the sex cells (egg and sperm) can be passed to offspring; mutations in other body cells are not inherited.
fact_tl: Tanging ang mga mutasyon sa mga sex cell (itlog at sperm) ang naipapasa sa anak; ang mutasyon sa ibang selula ay hindi minamana.
fact_bis: Ang mutasyon lamang sa mga sex cell (itlog ug sperm) ang mapasa sa anak; ang mutasyon sa ubang selula sa lawas dili mapanunod.

q: How does a frogfish catch its prey on the reef?
options: It disguises itself as a sponge or coral and uses a spine on its head to lure fish close
It chases fish in short bursts using its powerful tail fin
It hides in sand and ambushes passing fish from below
It works with cleaner shrimp to herd small fish into a corner
explanation: The frogfish looks like a sponge or coral and has a specialized spine that lures curious fish, then engulfs them in under a millisecond.
fact_tl: Ang frogfish ay isang reef fish na nagkakamukhang espongha o coral at may espesyal na tinik sa ulo na kumukuha ng mangagap na isda — biglang lumululon ito sa biktima sa loob ng isang millisecond.
fact_bis: Ang frogfish usa ka reef fish nga nagkamukhang espongha o coral ug adunay espesyal nga tinik sa ulo nga nagdani sa zosiosong isda — gilunon kini sa biktima sulod sa usa ka millisecond.

q: What unusual effect did the 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo have on the whole planet?
options: It temporarily cooled the planet's temperature
It caused a worldwide increase in rainfall for one year
It created a new island in the South China Sea
It triggered a series of earthquakes across Southeast Asia
explanation: The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo in Zambales was so powerful that it temporarily cooled the whole planet's temperature.
fact_tl: Noong 1991, sumabog nang malakas ang Bulkang Pinatubo sa Zambales at nagpalamig pansamantala sa temperatura ng buong mundo.
fact_bis: Niadtong 1991, kusog nga mibuto ang Bulkang Pinatubo sa Zambales ug temporaryong nakapabugnaw sa temperatura sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: What do we call a baby who is born earlier than nine months?
options: Premature
Underweight
Newborn
Postnatal
explanation: A baby born earlier than nine months is called premature and is often small and still weak.
fact_tl: Ang sanggol na isinisilang nang mas maaga sa siyam na buwan ay tinatawag na premature at madalas na maliit at mahina pa.
fact_bis: Ang bata nga matawo nga mas sayo sa siyam ka bulan gitawag premature ug kasagaran gamay ug huyang pa.

q: What role do mosquito larvae play in a water ecosystem?
options: They eat tiny algae and waste, and are eaten by fish, frogs, and dragonfly larvae
They produce oxygen that keeps the water clean for larger animals
They break down dead leaves on the pond floor into mud
They filter out harmful bacteria so fish can survive in polluted water
explanation: Mosquito larvae eat tiny algae and waste and are in turn eaten by fish, frogs, and dragonfly larvae, making them part of the food web.
fact_tl: Kahit nakakayamot ang lamok, may papel ang larva nito sa kalikasan: pagkain ito ng mga isda, palaka, at larva ng tutubi sa tubig. Bahagi ito ng food web — kumakain ng maliliit na lumot at dumi, at ito naman ay kinakain ng mas malalaking hayop.
fact_bis: Bisan tuod makalagot ang lamok, ang larva niini adunay papel sa kinaiyahan: pagkaon kini sa mga isda, baki, ug larva sa tutubi sa tubig. Kabahin kini sa food web — mokaon kini ug gagmayng lumot ug hugaw, ug kan-on usab kini sa mas dagkong hayop.

q: What happens to glucose (sugar) when it passes through a healthy kidney's filter?
options: The kidney returns it to the blood so it is not lost in urine
The kidney breaks it down into water and carbon dioxide
The kidney stores it temporarily in the bladder
The kidney converts it into a different nutrient before sending it to the liver
explanation: A healthy kidney returns glucose to the blood after filtering, which is why a healthy person's urine has almost no sugar.
fact_tl: Halimbawa ng kapaki-pakinabang na sangkap ay ang glucose o asukal na ginagamit ng katawan para sa enerhiya. Kahit lumusot ito sa pansala, ibinabalik ito ng malusog na bato sa dugo. Kaya sa ihi ng malusog na tao, halos walang asukal.
fact_bis: Usa ka pananglitan sa mapuslanong sangkap mao ang glucose o asukal nga gamiton sa lawas para sa kusog. Bisan moagi kini sa pansala, ibalik kini sa himsog nga kidney ngadto sa dugo. Mao nga sa ihi sa himsog nga tawo, halos walay asukal.

q: What happens to a block of ice when it warms up?
options: It melts into liquid water
It turns into water vapor and disappears
It becomes heavier and sinks
It hardens further and becomes crystal
explanation: Ice is the solid form of water and melts into liquid water when it absorbs heat.
fact_tl: Ang bloke ng yelo ay natutunaw at nagiging tubig kapag uminit, dahil ang yelo ay solidong anyo ng tubig na lumalambot sa init.
fact_bis: Ang block sa yelo matunaw ug mahimong tubig kon moinit, kay ang yelo mao ang gahi nga porma sa tubig nga molalâ sa kainit.

q: Why are many cloud rats in danger today?
options: Too much hunting and loss of their forest homes
Diseases spread by domestic animals
Competition from rats introduced by humans
Drought that dried up the mountain streams they depend on
explanation: Many cloud rats are threatened by overhunting and the destruction of the forests where they live.
fact_tl: Maraming cloud rat ang nanganganib dahil sa labis na pangangaso at pagkawala ng kanilang tirahan.
fact_bis: Daghang cloud rat ang namiligro tungod sa sobrang pagpangayam ug pagkawala sa ilang puy-anan sa kalasangan.

q: Which animal holds the record as the largest mammal on Earth?
options: Blue whale
Sperm whale
Elephant
Giant squid
explanation: The blue whale is the largest animal and mammal, reaching up to about 30 meters long.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking hayop at mammal ay ang blue whale (asul na balyena), na umaabot ng hanggang mga 30 metro ang haba.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga mananap ug mammal mao ang blue whale (asul nga balyena), nga moabot ug mga 30 ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: Why is nitrogen important to every living cell?
options: It is a key part of proteins and DNA, the molecules that build and run cells
It powers the energy reactions that keep cells alive
It carries oxygen through the cell membrane into the nucleus
It forms the outer wall of cells to protect them from damage
explanation: Nitrogen is a key part of proteins and DNA — the molecules that build and run living cells.
fact_tl: Ang nitrogen ay mahalagang bahagi ng protina at DNA, ang mga molekulang bumubuo at nagpapatakbo sa mga selula.
fact_bis: Ang nitroheno usa ka importanteng bahin sa protina ug DNA, ang mga molekula nga naghimo ug nagpadagan sa mga buhing selula.

q: What produces the sound when you pluck a guitar string?
