options: The vibrating string makes the sound
Air being pushed through a hole in the guitar body
The wood of the guitar amplifying your finger movement
The string rubbing against the guitar neck
explanation: In a guitar or violin, a vibrating string makes the sound when it is plucked or bowed.
fact_tl: Sa gitara at biyolin, gumagawa ng tunog ang nayayanig na kuwerdas kapag pinitik o hinihila; mas maikli o mas hinigpit ang kuwerdas, mas mataas ang tono.
fact_bis: Sa gitara ug biyolin, ang nagkurog nga kuwerdas mao ang mohimo sa tingog kon kuhiton o hapyoron; mas mubo o mas hugot ang kuwerdas, mas taas ang tono.

q: Who built the first practical helicopter?
options: Igor Sikorsky
Orville Wright
Howard Hughes
Leonardo da Vinci
explanation: Igor Sikorsky built the first practical helicopter, called the VS-300.
fact_tl: Si Igor Sikorsky ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na helicopter, ang VS-300.
fact_bis: Si Igor Sikorsky mao ang naghimo sa unang praktikal nga helicopter, ang VS-300.

q: What was the name of George Stephenson's famous early locomotive?
options: The Rocket
The Pioneer
The Thunderer
The Iron Horse
explanation: George Stephenson's famous locomotive was called the Rocket.
fact_tl: Ang sikat na lokomotibo ni George Stephenson ay tinawag na "Rocket."
fact_bis: Ang bantog nga lokomotibo ni George Stephenson gitawag nga "Rocket."

q: What Filipino food is malunggay leaves commonly added to for extra nutrition?
options: Tinola and rice porridge
Adobo and fried rice
Sinigang and pancit
Kare-kare and longganisa
explanation: Malunggay leaves are often added to soups like tinola and rice porridge to add nutrition.
fact_tl: Madalas idagdag ang dahon ng malunggay sa mga sabaw tulad ng tinola at lugaw upang madagdagan ang sustansya.
fact_bis: Ang dahon sa kamunggay kanunay idugang sa mga sabaw sama sa tinola ug lugaw aron madugangan ang sustansya.

q: What does the stomach turn food into before passing it to the intestine?
options: A thick soupy mush called chyme
A dry powder that is easier to absorb
Small solid pieces broken by stomach muscles
A watery liquid with vitamins removed
explanation: The stomach churns food with acid into a thick soupy mush before it moves on to the intestine.
fact_tl: Pinaghahalo ng tiyan ang pagkain at asido hanggang maging malapot na sabaw bago ito ipasa sa bituka.
fact_bis: Kutawon sa tiyan ang pagkaon ug asido hangtod mahimong baga nga sabaw una kini ipasa sa tinai.

q: How is distilled water different from mineral water?
options: Distilled water has no minerals at all, while mineral water contains minerals like calcium and magnesium
Distilled water is saltier because sea salt concentrates during boiling
Distilled water has added vitamins, while mineral water is completely pure
Distilled water is safer to drink because it contains natural minerals from rocks
explanation: Distilled water has no minerals at all, while mineral water contains natural or added minerals like calcium and magnesium.
fact_tl: Hindi pareho ang distiladong tubig at mineral water: ang distiladong tubig ay walang anumang mineral, samantalang ang mineral water ay may sadyang idinagdag o likas na mineral tulad ng calcium at magnesium.
fact_bis: Dili pareho ang distiladong tubig ug mineral water: ang distiladong tubig walay bisan unsang mineral, samtang ang mineral water adunay natural o gidugang nga mineral sama sa calcium ug magnesium.

q: Why are flaps on an airplane's wings lowered during takeoff and landing?
options: To increase lift even when the plane is moving slowly
To reduce drag so the plane can speed up faster on the runway
To steer the plane left or right during the approach
To cool the engines by directing air over them
explanation: Flaps are lowered during takeoff and landing to increase lift even when the plane is moving at low speed.
fact_tl: Sa pag-takeoff at pag-landing, ibinababa ang mga flaps sa pakpak para mapalaki ang lift kahit mabagal pa ang eroplano.
fact_bis: Sa pag-takeoff ug pag-landing, ginapaubos ang mga flaps sa pako aron modako ang lift bisan hinay pa ang eroplano.

q: Where does a cleaner shrimp usually set up its cleaning station on the reef?
options: Near an anemone or a crack in the reef rock
Buried in the sand at the base of coral heads
In open water away from the reef to attract more fish
On top of large boulders where fish can easily spot it
explanation: The cleaner shrimp often sets up its station near an anemone or a crack in the reef rock.
fact_tl: Madalas nagtatayo ng estasyon ang cleaner shrimp malapit sa anemone o siwang ng bato sa bahura.
fact_bis: Ang cleaner shrimp kanunay magpahimutang sa estasyon niini duol sa anemona o siwang sa bato sa bahura.

q: What makes budding different from other types of grafting?
options: Only a single small bud is attached to another plant instead of a whole stem
The bud is taken from the roots rather than the branches
Both plants must be from completely different species for budding to work
The bud is wrapped in wax and left to grow without attaching to anything
explanation: Budding is a type of grafting where just a single small bud is attached to another plant, and it is often used on citrus like calamansi.
fact_tl: Ang budding ay uri ng grafting kung saan isang maliit na buko (usbong) lang ang ikinakabit sa ibang halaman — kadalasang ginagamit sa citrus gaya ng kalamansi.
fact_bis: Ang budding usa ka matang sa grafting diin usa ra ka gamay nga buko (turok) ang isumpay sa laing tanom — kasagarang gamiton sa citrus sama sa kalamansi.

q: About how much steady power can a person produce through physical effort?
options: About 100 watts
About 1,000 watts
About 10 watts
About 500 watts
explanation: A person can produce only about 100 watts of power steadily, which is why heavy tasks tire us quickly.
fact_tl: Ang isang tao ay nakakagawa lamang ng tinatayang isang daang watt na lakas nang tuloy-tuloy, kaya mabilis tayong mapagod sa mabigat na gawain.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka tawo makahimo lamang og mga usa ka gatos ka watt nga power nga padayon, mao nga paspas tang kapuyon sa bug-at nga buluhaton.

q: About how long does one year last on Jupiter compared to Earth?
options: About 12 Earth years
About 365 Earth days
About 2 Earth years
About 84 Earth years
explanation: Jupiter is so far from the Sun that one full trip around it takes about 12 Earth years.
fact_tl: Napakalayo ng Jupiter sa Araw kaya ang isang taon dito — isang buong ikot sa paligid ng Araw — ay tumatagal ng mga 12 taon sa Earth. Kaya kung 12 taong gulang ka, isang taon ka pa lang sa Jupiter!
fact_bis: Halayo kaayo ang Jupiter sa Adlaw mao nga ang usa ka tuig didto — usa ka tibuok libot sa Adlaw — molungtad og mga 12 ka tuig sa Earth. Mao nga kung 12 anyos ka, usa pa lang ka ka tuig sa Jupiter!

q: What is the leading cause of lung cancer?
options: Smoking
Air pollution from vehicles
Breathing in dust from construction sites
Drinking polluted water
explanation: Smoking is the leading cause of lung cancer.
fact_tl: Ang paninigarilyo ay pangunahing sanhi ng kanser sa baga.
fact_bis: Ang pagpanigarilyo mao ang nag-unang hinungdan sa kanser sa baga.

q: What is a 'trophic cascade'?
options: When removing a top predator causes changes that ripple all the way down to plants
When a flood washes away the top layer of soil and exposes deeper rock
When a disease spreads from one level of the food web to all other levels
When too much sunlight causes plants to overgrow and push out animals
explanation: A trophic cascade is when removing a top predator causes plant-eaters to multiply and wipe out plants — like dominoes falling from the top down.
fact_tl: Ang 'trophic cascade' ay kapag ang pagbabago sa itaas na antas (tulad ng pag-alis ng top predator) ay bumababa hanggang sa pinakamababang antas. Halimbawa: nawala ang predator → dumami ang halamanan-kainin → naubos ang mga halaman. Parang sunod-sunod na domino mula taas pababa.
fact_bis: Ang 'trophic cascade' kay kon ang kausaban sa taas nga ang-ang (sama sa pagkuha sa top predator) molugsong hangtod sa pinakaubos nga ang-ang. Pananglitan: nawala ang predator → midaghan ang mokaon og tanom → naubos ang mga tanom. Sama sa domino nga matumba gikan sa taas paubos.

q: Why do you get goosebumps when you feel cold?
options: The tiny hairs on your skin stand up to help keep your body warm
Your skin tightens to stop heat from escaping through pores
Blood rushes away from the skin making it bump up
Your muscles under the skin shiver and push the skin outward
explanation: When you feel cold or scared, tiny hairs on your skin stand up creating goosebumps, which is your skin trying to keep your body warm.
fact_tl: Kapag nilalamig o natatakot ka, parang tumitindig ang maliliit na balahibo sa balat at nagkakaroon ng kilabot. Ito ay reaksyon ng balat para subukang panatilihin ang init ng katawan.
fact_bis: Kung tugnawon o mahadlok ka, motindog ang gagmay nga balhibo sa imong panit ug magkilabot. Kini reaksyon sa panit aron sulayan nga magpabilin ang init sa lawas.

q: What are the three primary colors of light?
options: Red, green, and blue
Red, yellow, and blue
Cyan, magenta, and yellow
Orange, green, and violet
explanation: The three primary colors of light are red, green, and blue (RGB).
fact_tl: May tatlong (3) pangunahing kulay ng ilaw: pula, berde, at asul (RGB).
fact_bis: Adunay tulo (3) ka nag-unang kolor sa kahayag: pula, berde, ug asul (RGB).

q: What happens to much of the tuna caught in the Philippines?
options: It is made into canned food and sold to other countries
It is dried and sold in local markets as a cheap protein source
It is kept frozen and used only in local restaurants
It is ground into fishmeal to feed farmed shrimp
explanation: Much of the tuna caught in the Philippines is made into canned food and exported to other countries.
fact_tl: Maraming tuna sa Pilipinas ang ginagawang de-latang pagkain at ipinapadala sa ibang bansa.
fact_bis: Daghan sa tuna sa Pilipinas ang himoon nga de-lata nga pagkaon ug ibaligya sa ubang nasod.

q: Why is stainless steel more popular than cast iron for everyday cooking pans?
options: Stainless steel resists rust and is easier to care for, while cast iron rusts if it gets wet
Stainless steel heats up faster because it is thinner and lighter than cast iron
Stainless steel costs less to produce, making it affordable for most families
Stainless steel is non-stick by nature, while cast iron sticks to food
explanation: Stainless steel resists rust and is easier to maintain, while cast iron must be kept oiled to prevent rusting.
fact_tl: Madalas ikumpara ang stainless steel na kawali sa cast iron na kawali. Ang cast iron ay madaling kalawangin kapag nabasa at hindi naalagaan, kaya kailangan itong patuluyan ng langis. Ang stainless steel naman ay hindi gaanong kinakalawang at mas madaling alagaan, kaya popular ito sa karamihang tahanan.
fact_bis: Ang stainless steel nga kawali kanunay itandi sa cast iron nga kawali. Ang cast iron dali ra mokalawang kung mabasa ug dili atimanon, busa kinahanglan kini kanunay nga butangan og lana. Ang stainless steel hinuon dili kaayo mokalawang ug mas sayon atimanon, mao nga popular kini sa kadaghanang panimalay.

q: What can cause a brownout or blackout?
options: A damaged power line or low electricity supply, such as during a strong typhoon
Using too many light bulbs at the same time in one room
A thunderstorm charging the wires with too much electricity
Power plants switching from coal to solar energy during the day
explanation: A brownout or blackout happens when a power line is damaged or electricity supply runs low, such as during a strong typhoon.
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon ng brownout o blackout kapag may sira sa linya o kulang ang suplay ng kuryente, gaya kapag may malakas na bagyo.
fact_bis: Mahitabo ang brownout o blackout kung naay nadaot nga linya o kulang ang suplay sa kuryente, sama kon naay kusog nga bagyo.

q: What gas do we release when we breathe out?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Water vapor only
explanation: When we breathe out, we release carbon dioxide, a gas that contains carbon.
fact_tl: Kapag huminga tayo palabas, naglalabas tayo ng carbon dioxide, isang gas na may carbon.
fact_bis: Kon moginhawa kita pagawas, magbuga kita og carbon dioxide, usa ka gas nga adunay karbon.

q: What can a scientist learn from the shape of a dinosaur's teeth?
options: Whether the dinosaur ate meat or plants
How fast the dinosaur could run
How long the dinosaur lived
Whether the dinosaur lived alone or in groups
explanation: Sharp teeth indicate a meat-eater while flat teeth are for grinding plants, so tooth shape tells us what a dinosaur ate.
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng hugis ng ngipin kung ano ang kinakain ng dinosaur: matatalim na ngipin para sa karne at malalapad para sa pagdurog ng halaman.
fact_bis: Ang porma sa ngipon sa dinosaur nagpakita kon unsa ang gikaon niini: hait nga ngipon para sa karne ug patag para sa pagdugmok ug tanom.

q: Have scientists found any life on Mars so far?
options: No, but they keep searching for even tiny signs of it
Yes, tiny bacteria were found in the soil by the Curiosity rover
No, and scientists have stopped looking because Mars is too cold
Yes, ancient fossils of small plants were found near the polar ice caps
explanation: So far, no life has been found on Mars, but scientists continue searching for any signs of it.
fact_tl: Hanggang ngayon, wala pang natagpuang buhay sa Mars, ngunit patuloy na naghahanap ang mga siyentipiko ng kahit maliliit na bakas nito.
fact_bis: Hangtod karon, wala pay nakit-an nga kinabuhi sa Mars, apan padayon nga nangita ang mga siyentista bisan sa gagmay nga timailhan niini.

q: Why is it especially important for cooks and food vendors to wash their hands often?
options: Germs on their hands can quickly spread to many customers through the food they prepare
Cooking heat does not kill all germs unless hands are washed first
Food spoils faster when handled with unwashed hands due to skin oils
Health inspectors require it by law in all food stalls
explanation: People who handle food can spread germs to many customers at once, so frequent handwashing is critical to prevent illness.
fact_tl: Ang mga taong humahawak ng pagkain — tulad ng kusinero, tindera ng street food, at nagbebenta sa karinderya — ay dapat maghugas nang madalas dahil maraming tao ang kakain ng kanilang inihanda. Kung may germ sa kanilang kamay, mabilis itong kumalat sa maraming customer.
fact_bis: Ang mga tawong naghikap og pagkaon — sama sa kusinero, tindera sa street food, ug namaligya sa karinderya — kinahanglang manghugas kanunay kay daghang tawo ang mokaon sa ilang giandam. Kung naay germ sa ilang kamot, dali kini mokatap ngadto sa daghang kustomer.

q: What number does the prefix 'giga' stand for?
options: 1,000,000,000 (one billion)
1,000,000 (one million)
1,000 (one thousand)
explanation: The prefix giga means 1,000,000,000 — one billion.
fact_tl: Ang unlaping "giga" ay nangangahulugang 1,000,000,000 (isang bilyon).
fact_bis: Ang prefix nga "giga" nagpasabot og 1,000,000,000 (usa ka bilyon).

q: Besides the Moon, what else affects ocean tides?
options: The Sun's gravity also pulls on ocean water
Earth's rotation creates centrifugal force that pushes water outward
Strong winds push water toward coastlines and raise tides
The weight of deep-sea creatures moving in large groups shifts the water
explanation: The Sun also affects tides with its gravity, though its pull is weaker than the Moon's.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay nakakaapekto rin sa taog gamit ang grabidad nito, ngunit mas mahina ito kaysa sa hila ng Buwan.
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw makaapekto usab sa taob pinaagi sa grabidad niini, apan mas huyang kini kaysa pagbira sa Bulan.

q: What actually causes Earth's seasons?
options: Earth's axis is tilted, so sunlight strikes different parts at different angles during the year
Earth moves closer to and farther from the Sun at different times of year
The Moon's gravity pulls Earth's atmosphere, making some months warmer
Earth spins faster in summer, generating more heat
explanation: Seasons are caused by Earth's tilted axis, not its distance from the Sun — the tilt changes the angle at which sunlight strikes each part of Earth.
fact_tl: Hindi nagkakaroon ng panahon (seasons) dahil sa layo ng Earth sa Araw — nagkakaroon ng panahon dahil nakatagilid ang ehe ng Earth, kaya iba't iba ang anggulo ng pagtama ng sinag sa iba't ibang bahagi sa loob ng taon.
fact_bis: Ang panahon (seasons) dili tungod sa kalayo sa Earth gikan sa Adlaw — naa kini tungod kay nahilig ang ehe sa Earth, mao nga lain-lain ang anggulo sa pagtama sa silaw sa lain-laing bahin sulod sa tuig.

q: What is a Punnett square used for?
options: To show the possible traits offspring may inherit from two parents
To measure how quickly a cell divides during growth
To map where genes are located on a specific chromosome
To count how many chromosomes an organism has
explanation: A Punnett square is a chart used to predict the possible traits of offspring based on the genes inherited from two parents.
fact_tl: Ang Punnett square ay isang tsart na ginagamit upang ipakita ang mga posibleng katangian ng anak base sa mga gene na minana nito mula sa dalawang magulang.
fact_bis: Ang Punnett square usa ka tsart nga gigamit aron ipakita ang mga posibleng kinaiya sa anak base sa mga gen nga napanunod gikan sa duha ka ginikanan.

q: Why can your body fix your balance almost instantly when you start to fall?
options: Signals travel very fast from the ear to the brain through nerves
Your muscles sense gravity directly and react without needing the brain
Blood pressure in your feet rises quickly to push you back upright
The bones in your legs automatically lock to stop you from falling
explanation: Signals travel very fast from the ear to the brain through nerves, allowing your body to correct balance almost instantly.
fact_tl: Napakabilis dumaloy ng mga senyas mula sa tainga papunta sa utak sa pamamagitan ng mga nerbiyos, kaya halos kaagad nitong naaayos ang balanse.
fact_bis: Paspas kaayo modagan ang mga senyas gikan sa dalunggan ngadto sa utok pinaagi sa mga nerbiyos, mao nga halos diha-diha kini makaayo sa balanse.

q: How do new banana plants grow naturally beside a parent plant?
options: New plants called suckers sprout up beside the parent plant
Seeds fall from the banana fruit and grow in the soil nearby
The parent plant sends out long roots that become new plants
The trunk of the parent splits and each half becomes a new tree
explanation: New banana plants that grow up beside the parent plant are called suckers.
fact_tl: May bagong saging na tumutubo sa tabi ng magulang na halaman, tinatawag itong suwi.
fact_bis: Adunay bag-ong saging nga motubo sa kilid sa ginikanang tanom, kini gitawag og saha.

q: What does a porcupine do to warn an enemy before fighting?
options: It raises its quills and rattles them as a warning
It sprays a foul-smelling liquid at the attacker
It makes a loud hissing sound and stamps its feet
It curls into a tight ball so only quills are exposed
explanation: Before fighting, a porcupine raises its quills and rattles them to warn an enemy to stay away.
fact_tl: Bago lumaban, itinitindig ng porcupine ang kanyang mga tinik at nagpapakalansing para bigyan ng babala ang kalaban.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa makig-away, ipatindog sa porcupine ang iyang tunok ug ipakalansing kini aron pasidan-an ang kaaway.

q: What does a pelican use its large throat pouch for?
options: To scoop up fish from the water
To store water for drinking during long flights
To attract a mate by puffing it up with air
To keep its eggs warm while it floats on the sea
explanation: A pelican has a large skin pouch under its bill that it uses to scoop up fish from the water.
fact_tl: Ang pelikano ay may malaking supot na balat sa ilalim ng tuka na ginagamit nito para sumalok ng isda mula sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang pelikano adunay dako nga supot nga panit ilalom sa tuka nga gamiton niini sa pagsalok ug isda gikan sa tubig.

q: How do many fish control how deep they float in the water?
options: They use a gas-filled swim bladder inside their body
They swallow water to become heavier and sink, then spit it out to rise
They angle their fins downward to push themselves deeper
They change the density of their scales to adjust their weight
explanation: Many fish have a gas-filled swim bladder that lets them stay floating at the depth they want without constantly swimming.
fact_tl: Maraming isda ang may lobo ng gas sa loob ng katawan na tinatawag na swim bladder upang makapanatili silang lumulutang sa nais nilang lalim.
fact_bis: Daghang isda adunay lobo nga puno og gas sulod sa lawas nga gitawag og swim bladder aron makapabilin sila nga naglutaw sa giladmon nga gusto nila.

q: Why is the nucleus sometimes called the 'brain' of the cell?
options: It stores DNA and controls what the cell does
It produces energy that powers all the cell's activities
It protects the cell from viruses and harmful chemicals
It carries food and oxygen to every part of the cell
explanation: The nucleus stores DNA and controls what the cell does, making it like the brain of the cell.
fact_tl: Ang nucleus ay katulad ng utak ng selula dahil ito ang nagtatago ng DNA at nagkokontrol sa lahat ng gagawin ng selula.
fact_bis: Ang nucleus sama sa utok sa selula tungod kay kini nagtipig sa DNA ug nagkontrol sa tanan nga gibuhat sa selula.

q: Why did the passenger pigeon become extinct in 1914?
options: Too much hunting by people wiped out the entire species
A widespread disease killed all the remaining birds
Loss of forest habitat left them nowhere to nest
Competition from invasive species drove them out of their range
explanation: The passenger pigeon, once numbering in the billions, became extinct in 1914 due to overhunting by people.
fact_tl: Ang passenger pigeon ay dating bilyon-bilyon ang dami sa Amerika, ngunit naging extinct noong 1914 dahil sa sobrang pangangaso ng mga tao.
fact_bis: Ang passenger pigeon kanhi bilyon-bilyon ang gidaghanon sa Amerika, apan nahimong lipol niadtong 1914 tungod sa sobrang pagpangayam sa mga tawo.

q: How does the water in natural hot springs like those in Laguna get heated?
options: Heat travels up through rock from magma and hot rock below the ground
The sun's rays penetrate deep into the earth and warm underground water
Chemical reactions between minerals dissolved in the water produce heat
Pressure from the weight of rock above squeezes the water until it warms up
explanation: Natural hot springs are heated by conduction — heat slowly travels upward through rock from magma and hot rock deep beneath the surface.
fact_tl: Ang mga mainit na bukal sa Pilipinas tulad ng mga nasa Laguna ay pinainit ng conduction mula sa magma at mainit na bato sa ilalim ng lupa — ang init ay unti-unting lumalakbay pataas sa pamamagitan ng bato papunta sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga natural nga mainit na bukal sa Pilipinas, sama sa mga naa sa Laguna, nainit pinaagi sa conduction gikan sa magma ug mainit nga bato sa ilalim sa yuta — ang init hinay-hinay mobalhin pataas pinaagi sa bato ngadto sa tubig.

q: What is the name of the natural pigment that gives human skin, hair, and eyes their color?
options: Melanin
Keratin
Collagen
Hemoglobin
explanation: Melanin is the natural pigment responsible for the color of skin, hair, and eyes, and it also helps protect the skin from harmful UV radiation.
fact_tl: Ang melanin ay ang natural na pigment na nagbibigay ng kulay sa balat, buhok, at mata ng mga tao — ito rin ang nagpoprotekta sa balat mula sa mapanganib na ultraviolet radiation ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang melanin mao ang natural nga pigment nga naghatag sa kolor sa balat, buhok, ug mga mata sa mga tawo; nagproteksyon usab kini sa balat gikan sa mapanganib nga ultraviolet radiation gikan sa adlaw.

q: What special feature do the piglets of the Philippine warty pig have that helps them hide in the forest?
options: Stripes on their body for camouflage
Rough warty skin that matches tree bark
Dark grey fur that blends with shadows
Spots that look like patches of sunlight
explanation: Philippine warty pig piglets are born with stripes that act as camouflage, helping them blend into the forest environment.
fact_tl: Ang baboy-ramo o Philippine warty pig ay isang ligaw na baboy na endemiko sa Pilipinas, at ang mga biik nito ay may guhit-guhit na balat na nagsisilbing kamuflahe sa gubat.
fact_bis: Ang baboy-ihalas o Philippine warty pig usa ka ihalas nga baboy nga makita lamang sa Pilipinas, ug ang mga biik niini adunay badlis-badlis nga panit nga nagsilbing tagoanan sa kalasangan.

q: How is a dust storm different from a sandstorm?
options: A dust storm carries fine particles that rise much higher into the air than a sandstorm
A dust storm only happens in deserts while sandstorms can happen anywhere
A dust storm is caused by wind but a sandstorm is caused by heat
A dust storm moves faster across the ground than a sandstorm
explanation: A sandstorm carries heavier sand grains close to the ground, while a dust storm lifts fine dust particles much higher into the air.
fact_tl: Ang sandstorm ay nagdadala ng mabigat na butil ng buhangin na malapit sa lupa, habang ang dust storm ay nagdadala ng pinong alikabok na umaakyat nang mas mataas sa himpapawid.
fact_bis: Ang sandstorm nagdala ug mas bug-at nga lugas sa balas duol sa yuta, samtang ang dust storm nagdala ug pino nga abog nga mosaka pa kataas sa kahanginan.

q: Why do termite soldiers have large heads and strong mandibles (jaws)?
options: To defend the colony from predators such as ants
To chew through wood faster and gather food for the colony
To dig tunnels deeper underground where the queen lives
To carry food back to the nest more efficiently
explanation: Termite soldiers have large heads and strong mandibles specifically to defend the colony against predators like ants.
fact_tl: Ang mga sundalo sa anay ay may malaking ulo at matitigas na mandibles para ipagtanggol ang koloni mula sa mga mandarambong tulad ng mga langgam.
fact_bis: Ang mga sundalo sa anay adunay dakong ulo ug lig-ong mandibles para panalipdan ang kolonya gikan sa mga manunukob sama sa mga langgam.

q: What are the two main kinds of grasslands found on Earth?
options: Warm ones near the equator with wet and dry seasons, and cooler ones with four seasons
Dry ones in deserts and wet ones near rivers and lakes
Tropical ones with tall grass and polar ones with short grass
Forest grasslands with scattered trees and open grasslands with no trees
explanation: There are two main kinds of grasslands: warm ones near the equator that have wet and dry seasons, and cooler ones farther from the equator that experience four seasons.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng grassland: ang mainit na malapit sa ekwador na may tag-ulan at tag-tuyot, at ang mas malamig na may apat na panahon.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka matang sa grassland: ang init nga duol sa ekwador nga adunay ting-ulan ug ting-init, ug ang mas bugnaw nga adunay upat ka panahon.

q: Which of the following is one of the four Baroque churches of the Philippines recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
options: Paoay Church in Ilocos Norte
San Agustin Church in Cebu City
Quiapo Church in Manila
Barasoain Church in Bulacan
explanation: The four Baroque churches — in Paoay, Miagao, Santa Maria, and Intramuros — are UNESCO World Heritage Sites that show the influence of Spanish colonialism in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang apat na Baroque church ng Pilipinas — sa Paoay, Miagao, Santa Maria, at Intramuros — ay mga UNESCO World Heritage Site na nagpapakita ng impluwensya ng kolonyalismong Espanyol.
fact_bis: Ang upat ka Baroque church sa Pilipinas — sa Paoay, Miagao, Santa Maria, ug Intramuros — mga UNESCO World Heritage Site nga nagpakita sa impluwensya sa Espanyol nga kolonismo.

q: What remarkable trick can some male cuttlefish perform with their colors?
options: Show different colors on each side of their body at the same time to court a mate and warn off a rival
Flash bright white light to blind predators and escape in the darkness
Change their entire body color instantly to match any background they rest on
Produce glowing colors at night to attract females in deep dark water
explanation: Some male cuttlefish can display different colors on each side of their body simultaneously — using one side to court a mate and the other to warn off a rival.
fact_tl: Ang ilang lalaking cuttlefish ay nagpapakita ng magkaibang kulay sa magkabilang gilid ng katawan para manligaw at takutin ang karibal nang sabay.
fact_bis: Ang ubang laki nga cuttlefish magpakita og lainlaing kolor sa matag kilid sa lawas aron mangulitawo ug mohadlok sa karibal dungan.

q: Which part of a plant takes in water from the soil?
options: The roots
The leaves
The stem
The flowers
explanation: Roots soak up water from the soil, which is how a plant drinks.
fact_tl: Sumisipsip ang ugat ng tubig mula sa lupa, na parang umiinom ang halaman gamit ang mga ugat nito.
fact_bis: Ang gamot mosuyop og tubig gikan sa yuta, mao nga ang tanom moinom pinaagi sa iyang mga gamot.

q: On many Philippine farms, what happens to rice husks and banana peels instead of burning them?
options: They are left for decomposers to rot into compost that enriches the soil
They are dried and used as packaging material for market goods
They are fed to farm animals as a cheap and nutritious food source
They are soaked in water and used to water crops during dry months
explanation: Rice husks, straw, and banana peels are gathered and left for decomposers to break them down into compost — a natural fertilizer that enriches the soil for the next crop.
fact_tl: Sa maraming sakahan sa Pilipinas, ang ipa ng palay, dayami, at balat ng saging ay tinitipon at hinahayaang bulukin ng decomposers para gawing compost. Sa halip na sunugin, ginagawa itong likas na pataba na nagpapataba sa lupa para sa susunod na tanim.
fact_bis: Sa daghang uma sa Pilipinas, ang upa sa humay, dagami, ug panit sa saging gitigom ug gipasagdan nga dunoton sa decomposers aron mahimong compost. Imbes nga sunogon, gihimo kining natural nga abono nga magpatambok sa yuta para sa sunod nga tanom.

q: What is the correct order of stages in a butterfly's life cycle?
options: Egg → caterpillar → pupa → butterfly
Egg → pupa → caterpillar → butterfly
Caterpillar → egg → pupa → butterfly
Egg → butterfly → pupa → caterpillar
explanation: A butterfly undergoes complete metamorphosis in four stages: egg, caterpillar (larva), pupa, then adult butterfly.
fact_tl: Bawat buhay na bagay ay dumadaan sa life cycle: ipinanganak o tumutubo, lumalaki, nagpaparami, at namamatay. May mga hayop na dumadaan sa metamorphosis — halimbawa, ang paru-paro: itlog → higad (caterpillar) → kokon (pupa) → paru-paro; at ang palaka: itlog → ulo-ulo (tadpole) → palaka.
fact_bis: Ang matag buhi nga butang moagi sa life cycle: matawo o moturok, motubo, mosanay, ug mamatay. Adunay mga hayop nga moagi sa metamorphosis — pananglitan, ang alibangbang: itlog → tangkong (caterpillar) → pupa → alibangbang; ug ang baki: itlog → ulo-ulo (tadpole) → baki.

q: What is the chemical symbol for the element sulfur?
options: S
Su
Sf
Si
explanation: The chemical symbol for sulfur is S.
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng sulfur (asupre) ay S.
fact_bis: Ang simbolong kemikal sa sulfur (asupre) kay S.

q: What makes the Philippines special in terms of mammals?
options: It is one of the world's top hotspots for mammals found nowhere else on Earth
It has more mammal species than any other country in Southeast Asia
It is the only country where all mammal species are protected by law
It has the largest mammal species in Asia living in its rainforests
explanation: The Philippines is one of the world's top hotspots for endemic mammals, with hundreds of mammal species found nowhere else on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang lugar sa buong mundo para sa endemic na mamipero, na may daan-daang uri ng mamipero na makikita lamang dito.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa pinakataas nga mga lugar sa tibuok kalibutan alang sa endemic nga mamipero, adunay gatusan ka klase sa mamipero nga makita lamang dinhi sa Yuta.

q: If you stand on one side of the Philippine Fault and look across to the other side, in which direction does the other side appear to move?
options: To your left
To your right
Straight toward you
Straight away from you
explanation: The Philippine Fault is a left-lateral fault, meaning the opposite side appears to slide toward your left when you face it.
fact_tl: Kung tatayo ka sa isang panig ng Philippine Fault at titingnan ang kabilang panig, mapapansin mong gumagalaw ito patungong kaliwa mo. Tinatawag itong 'left-lateral' na fault. Ito ang karaniwang direksyon ng paggalaw nito sa loob ng milyon-milyong taon.
fact_bis: Kon motindog ka sa usa ka bahin sa Philippine Fault ug motan-aw sa pikas bahin, makita nimo nga molihok kini padulong sa imong wala. Gitawag kini nga 'left-lateral' nga fault. Mao kini ang naandang direksyon sa paglihok niini sulod sa minilyon ka tuig.

q: How do scientists officially name a species using the two-word naming system?
options: Genus name first, then species name — for example, Homo sapiens for humans
Species name first, then genus name — for example, sapiens Homo for humans
Common name first, then a number code — for example, Human 001
The country of discovery first, then the scientist's name who found it
explanation: In the two-word naming system, scientists write the genus first and the species second, as in Homo sapiens for humans.
fact_tl: Binibigyan ng mga siyentipiko ang bawat species ng pangalan na may dalawang salita: ang genus muna, tapos ang species. Halimbawa, ang tao ay Homo sapiens.
fact_bis: Ang mga siyentipiko naghatag sa matag species og ngalan nga duha ka pulong: ang genus una, dayon ang species. Pananglitan, ang tawo kay Homo sapiens.

q: Why has Palawan been repeatedly recognized by travel magazines as one of the world's most beautiful islands?
options: Because of its extraordinary natural environment
Because it has the most modern resorts in Southeast Asia
Because it is the largest island in the Philippines
Because it has the longest white-sand beach in the world
explanation: Palawan has repeatedly earned top rankings as one of the world's most beautiful islands due to its extraordinary nature.
fact_tl: Si Palawan ay paulit-ulit na kinikilala ng mga travel magazine at survey bilang isa sa pinakamagandang isla sa buong mundo dahil sa napakayamang kalikasan nito.
fact_bis: Ang Palawan kanunay nga giila sa mga travel magazine ug survey isip usa sa labing matahum nga isla sa tibuok kalibutan tungod sa iyang labaw ka dato nga kalikasan.

q: What does a bridge deck do with the weight of vehicles and people crossing it?
options: It spreads the weight to beams and girders below, which carry it to the piers and supports
It absorbs the weight through the road surface so nothing reaches the structure below
It channels all the weight directly down through the center support pillar
It converts the downward weight into sideways tension along the bridge cables
explanation: The bridge deck distributes the weight of vehicles and people to the beams and girders beneath it, which then transfer the load to the piers and abutments.
fact_tl: Ang daan ng tulay (bridge deck) ay nagpamamahagi ng timbang ng mga sasakyan at tao sa mga beam at girder sa ibaba nito, na naghahatid ng karga sa mga haligi ng tulay.
fact_bis: Ang dalan sa tulay nagpamamahagi sa timbang sa mga sasakyan ug tawo ngadto sa mga beam ug girder sa ubos niini, nga nagbalhin sa karga ngadto sa mga pier ug abutment.

q: What unit is used to measure force?
options: Newton (N)
Joule (J)
Watt (W)
Pascal (Pa)
explanation: The newton (N) is the standard unit used to measure force.
fact_tl: Ang newton (N) ang yunit na sumusukat sa puwersa o force.
fact_bis: Ang newton (N) mao ang unit nga nagsukod sa puwersa o force.

q: Under Republic Act 10931, what benefit do Filipino students attending state universities have?
options: Free tuition and fees
Free dormitory and meals on campus
A monthly allowance paid by the government
Free textbooks and school supplies every semester
explanation: Republic Act 10931 gives Filipino students in state universities and colleges the right to free tuition and fees.
fact_tl: Ayon sa Batas Republika 10931, ang mga Pilipinong estudyante na pumapasok sa mga state university at college ay may karapatang makakuha ng libreng matrikula at bayad-eskwela.
fact_bis: Sumala sa Republic Act 10931, ang mga Pilipinong estudyante nga mosulod sa mga state university ug college adunay katungod sa pagkuha og libreng matrikula ug bayad sa paaralan.

q: Some people think nata (like nata de coco) is mold because it grows on liquid. What is nata actually made of?
options: Cellulose produced by bacteria — it is safe to eat when made properly
A type of harmless white mold that forms on the surface of coconut water
A fungus similar to mushrooms that grows in sugary liquid
A layer of crystallized sugar that floats on top of the liquid
explanation: Nata is not mold — it is a layer of cellulose made by helpful bacteria, and it is clean and safe to eat when produced properly.
fact_tl: Minsan iniisip na ang nata ay parang amag dahil tumutubo ito sa ibabaw ng likido. Pero hindi ito amag kundi cellulose na gawa ng bakterya, at ito ay malinis at ligtas kainin kapag wastong nagawa.
fact_bis: Usahay maghunahuna nga ang nata sama sa agup-op kay motubo kini sa ibabaw sa likido. Apan dili kini agup-op kondili cellulose nga gihimo sa bakterya, ug limpyo ug luwas kan-on kung husto ang pagkahimo.

q: How does a wind turbine generate electricity?
options: Wind spins large blades that drive a generator, converting kinetic energy into electrical energy
Wind pushes air through tubes that heat water to make steam, which spins a turbine
Wind charges large batteries stored in the base of the tower directly
Wind creates sound waves that a microphone converts into electrical signals
explanation: A wind turbine uses wind to spin large blades; the spinning drives a generator that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy.
fact_tl: Ang wind turbine ay gumagawa ng kuryente sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng hangin upang iikot ang malalaking blade; ang pag-ikot ay nagpapatakbo ng generator na nagpapalit ng kinetic energy sa electrical energy.
fact_bis: Ang wind turbine naghimo og kuryente pinaagi sa paggamit sa hangin aron iikot ang dagkong mga blade; ang pag-ikot nagpapatakbo sa generator nga nagkabig sa kinetic energy ngadto sa electrical energy.

q: You filter some water and it looks perfectly clear. Is it safe to drink right away?
options: Not necessarily — dangerous germs and chemicals can be invisible even in clear water
Yes — if water looks clear after filtering, it is always safe to drink
Yes — filtering removes all bacteria and makes the water completely safe
Not yet — you need to add salt to the water to kill any remaining germs
explanation: Clear water can still contain dangerous germs and chemicals too small for the eye to see, so looking clear does not mean the water is safe to drink.
fact_tl: Maling isipin na malinis na agad ang tubig basta malinaw na ito. Maraming mapanganib na mikrobyo at kemikal ang hindi nakikita ng mata. Kaya kahit malinaw na ang tubig pagkatapos i-filter, hindi pa rin natin masasabi agad na ligtas na itong inumin.
fact_bis: Sayop nga hunahunaon nga limpyo na dayon ang tubig basta tin-aw na kini. Daghang delikado nga mikrobyo ug kemikal ang dili makita sa mata. Mao nga bisan tin-aw na ang tubig human i-filter, dili gihapon nato masulti dayon nga luwas na kini imnon.

q: After washing your hands, why is it important to dry them with a clean towel?
options: Germs spread more easily from wet hands, so drying prevents picking up microbes again
Drying removes the soap that would otherwise irritate your skin over time
Wet hands feel cold and cause muscle cramps when you grip things
Drying seals the skin to block germs from entering through open pores
explanation: Germs stick to and spread from wet hands more easily than dry ones, so drying your hands after washing helps prevent recontamination.
fact_tl: Mas madaling dumikit at kumalat ang germ sa basang kamay kaysa sa tuyo. Kaya pagkatapos maghugas, mahalagang patuyuin ang kamay sa malinis na tuwalya o tissue para hindi agad mapuno muli ng mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Mas dali nga mopilit ug mokatap ang germ sa basa nga kamot kaysa sa uga. Busa human manghugas, importante nga pauga-on ang kamot gamit ang limpyo nga tuwalya o tissue aron dili dayon mapuno usab og mikrobyo.

q: During an asthma attack, which THREE things happen to the airways at the same time?
options: The muscles tighten around the airways, the linings swell, and thick mucus builds up
The lungs shrink, the throat closes, and breathing becomes shallow
The heart beats faster, the airways cool down, and the voice becomes hoarse
The nose blocks up, the windpipe twists, and the chest fills with fluid
explanation: During an asthma attack, the muscles around the airways tighten, the linings swell, and thick mucus builds up — all three make it hard to breathe.
fact_tl: Sa isang atake ng hika, tatlong bagay ang nangyayari sa daluyan ng hangin: humihigpit ang kalamnan sa paligid nito, namamaga ang loob, at nagkakaroon ng makapal na uhog.
fact_bis: Sa pag-atake sa hubak, tulo ka butang ang mahitabo sa agianan sa hangin: mosikip ang kaunuran sa palibot, manghupong ang sulod, ug motapok ang baga nga sip-on.

q: Why does fermentation keep food safe even without a refrigerator?
options: The acid or alcohol produced by helpful microbes makes it hard for harmful bacteria to survive
The heat released during fermentation kills all germs inside the food
Fermentation dries out the food completely so bacteria cannot live in it
Helpful microbes release oxygen that harmful bacteria cannot breathe
explanation: Fermentation preserves food because the acid or alcohol made by helpful microbes creates an environment where harmful spoilage bacteria cannot survive.
fact_tl: Pinananatiling ligtas ng fermentation ang pagkain kahit walang ref dahil ang asido o alkohol na ginagawa ng mabubuting mikrobyo ay nagpapahirap mabuhay sa mga nakakasamang bakterya na nagpapasira nito.
fact_bis: Ang fermentation maghupot sa pagkaon nga luwas bisan walay pridyider tungod kay ang asido o alkohol nga gihimo sa maayong mikrobyo maglisod sa makadaot, makapadaot nga bakterya nga mabuhi.

q: What is the main advantage of using a block and tackle system with multiple pulleys?
options: It greatly reduces the force needed to lift very heavy loads
It increases the speed at which the heavy load can be lifted
It allows the load to be moved sideways as well as upward
It lets one person lift a load to unlimited heights without stopping
explanation: A block and tackle uses multiple pulleys together to greatly reduce the force needed to lift very heavy loads.
fact_tl: Ang block and tackle ay gumagamit ng maraming pulley para bawasan nang malaki ang puwersa na kailangan para iangat ang napakabigat na bagay.
fact_bis: Ang block and tackle naggamit sa daghang pulley aron dako nga mabawasan ang paningkamot nga kinahanglan aron ibangon ang hilabihan ka bug-at nga butang.

q: Which part of an atom is responsible for joining atoms together to form substances?
options: The outer electrons
The protons in the nucleus
The neutrons in the nucleus
The inner electrons closest to the nucleus
explanation: The outer electrons of atoms are what join atoms together to form chemical bonds and create new substances.
fact_tl: Ang mga electron sa labas ng atomo ang gumagana kapag nagkakabit-kabit ang mga atomo upang bumuo ng bagay.
fact_bis: Ang mga electron sa gawas sa atomo maoy nagdugtong sa mga atomo aron makabuo og mga substansiya.

q: Why do people sometimes turn the pot of a plant sitting near a window?
options: So the plant grows evenly on all sides instead of leaning only toward the light
To prevent the roots from growing into one side and tipping the pot over
To stop the soil from drying out faster on the side facing the sun
To change which leaves get water first when the plant is being watered
explanation: A plant near a window leans toward the light, so turning the pot ensures all sides receive equal light and the plant grows evenly.
fact_tl: Ang halamang nasa tabi ng bintana ay nakasandal patungo sa liwanag; kaya minsan ay pihit-pihitin ang paso para pantay itong tumubo.
fact_bis: Ang tanom sa kilid sa bintana mosandig paingon sa kahayag; mao nga usahay tuyokon ang kolon aron patas kining motubo sa tanang kilid.

q: Which set of habits does a person need EVERY DAY to keep their body healthy?
options: Enough sleep, regular exercise, nutritious food, plenty of water, and good cleanliness
Taking vitamins, drinking juice, and getting at least two hours of sunshine daily
Eating three large meals, drinking soda with meals, and resting after each meal
Exercising in the morning only and eating once a day to keep the body light
explanation: To keep our bodies healthy, we need enough sleep, regular exercise, nutritious food, plenty of water, and good cleanliness every day.
fact_tl: Para manatiling malusog ang katawan, kailangan natin ng sapat na tulog, regular na ehersisyo, masustansyang pagkain, maraming tubig, at malinis na katawan araw-araw.
fact_bis: Aron magpabiling himsog ang lawas, kinahanglan nato ang igong katulog, kanunay nga ehersisyo, masustansya nga pagkaon, daghang tubig, ug hinlo nga lawas matag adlaw.

q: Why can't we see the shape of bacteria with just our eyes?
options: Bacteria are too tiny to see without a microscope, and are often stained with dye to show their shapes
Bacteria are transparent and disappear when light shines on them
Bacteria move too fast for our eyes to focus on their shape
Bacteria only appear in groups and individual shapes cannot be separated
explanation: Bacteria are so tiny that their shapes are invisible to the naked eye — a microscope is needed, and dye staining is often used to make their shapes visible.
fact_tl: Hindi natin makikita ang hugis ng bakterya gamit lang ang mata dahil napakaliit nila. Kailangan ng mikroskopyo at kadalasan kinukulayan muna sila (staining) para lumitaw ang kanilang hugis.
fact_bis: Dili nato makita ang porma sa bakterya pinaagi lang sa mata kay gagmay kaayo sila. Kinahanglan og mikroskopyo, ug sagad koloran una sila (staining) aron mopakita ang ilang porma.

q: What color are the sun and three stars on the Philippine flag?
options: Golden-yellow
Silver-white
Bright orange
Deep red
explanation: The sun and the three stars on the Philippine flag are golden-yellow, symbolizing freedom and unity.
fact_tl: Ang araw at ang tatlong bituin ay kulay ginto o dilaw, simbolo ng kalayaan at pagkakaisa.
fact_bis: Ang adlaw ug ang tulo ka bituon kolor bulawan o dalag, simbolo sa kagawasan ug panaghiusa.

q: Which Philippine government agency watches for earthquakes and issues tsunami warnings?
options: PHIVOLCS
PAGASA
NDRRMC
PhilSA
explanation: In the Philippines, PHIVOLCS monitors earthquakes and issues warnings when a tsunami may threaten coastal areas.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS ang nagbabantay sa mga lindol at naglalabas ng babala kapag may panganib na tsunami.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS maoy nagbantay sa mga linog ug nagpagawas ug pasidaan kon adunay peligro sa tsunami.

q: How do air sacs connected to hollow bones help a bird breathe while flying?
options: Air can flow even inside the bones, helping the bird breathe more efficiently
The hollow bones store extra oxygen the bird can use when air is thin at high altitudes
The air sacs pump air into the wings to keep them stiff during flight
Hollow bones reduce weight so the bird's lungs do not have to work as hard
explanation: Some of a bird's hollow bones connect to air sacs, allowing air to flow even inside the bones and helping the bird breathe better during flight.
fact_tl: Ang ilang buto ng ibon ay konektado sa kanilang mga 'air sac' o lalagyan ng hangin. Kaya pati sa loob ng buto, may daanan ng hangin na tumutulong sa kanila huminga nang mas mabuti habang lumilipad.
fact_bis: Ang ubang buto sa langgam konektado sa ilang 'air sac' o sudlanan sa hangin. Mao nga bisan sulod sa buto naay agianan sa hangin nga makatabang sa ila paghinga samtang naglupad.

q: How can we help animals that migrate long distances?
options: By protecting the wetlands and forests where they rest along the way
By building fences along their routes to guide them safely to their destination
By feeding them in parks so they do not have to travel as far to find food
By tagging every individual animal so scientists can track and guard each one
explanation: We help migrating animals by protecting the wetlands and forests that serve as resting places along their long journeys.
fact_tl: Tinutulungan natin ang mga lumilipat na hayop kapag pinangangalagaan natin ang mga latian at gubat na kanilang pinagpapahingahan.
fact_bis: Atong gitabangan ang mga mananap nga nagbalhin kon atong panalipdan ang mga lamakan ug kalasangan diin sila mopahulay.

q: What skin condition is akapulko (Cassia alata) officially approved to treat in the Philippines?
options: Ringworm and other fungal skin infections
Burns and open wounds
Insect bites and allergic rashes
Bacterial infections and skin sores
explanation: Akapulko is DOH-approved for treating ringworm and other fungal skin infections; its leaves are made into a paste and applied to the affected area.
fact_tl: Ang akapulko (Cassia alata) ay DOH-approved para sa paggamot ng buni at iba pang fungal na sakit sa balat—ang dahon nito ay ginagawang paste at inilalapat sa apektadong bahagi.
fact_bis: Ang akapulko (Cassia alata) DOH-approved para sa pagtambal sa buni ug uban pang fungal nga sakit sa balat—ang mga dahon gihimo nga paste ug gibutang sa apektadong bahin.

q: Why do soldiers wear uniforms with green and brown patterns?
options: To blend into grass and trees the same way forest animals use camouflage to hide
To show their rank and the country they belong to on the battlefield
To reflect sunlight and keep their body temperature cool in warm climates
To look scary and intimidate the enemy when they charge into battle
explanation: Soldiers' camouflage uniforms copy nature — the green and brown patterns help them blend into grass and trees, just like forest animals do.
fact_tl: Ginaya ng tao ang camouflage ng hayop. Ang uniporme ng mga sundalo ay may berde at kayumangging pattern para makihalo sa damo at puno, tulad ng ginagawa ng mga hayop sa gubat — para hindi sila madaling makita ng kalaban.
fact_bis: Gisundog sa tawo ang camouflage sa hayop. Ang uniporme sa mga sundalo adunay berde ug brown nga pattern aron makig-sagol sa sagbot ug kahoy, sama sa gibuhat sa mga hayop sa lasang — aron dili sila dali makita sa kaaway.

q: When someone is choking on food, why should you NOT give them water to swallow?
options: Water can block the airway even more and make the choking worse
Water is too cold and causes the throat muscles to cramp up tightly
Water dissolves the food and turns it into a paste that sticks to the throat
Water makes the person cough harder and the food can go into the lungs
explanation: Giving water to a choking person is dangerous because it can block the airway even more instead of clearing it.
fact_tl: Kapag may nabibilaukan, huwag siyang painumin ng tubig upang itulak ang pagkain dahil maaari pa itong lalong magbara sa daanan ng hangin.
fact_bis: Kung adunay nabilaukan, ayaw siya paimna ug tubig aron ituklod ang pagkaon kay mahimo kining mosamot ang pagbabag sa agianan sa hangin.

q: What is an asthma action plan that a doctor gives to a child with asthma?
options: A plan that tells which medicine to take every day to prevent asthma attacks
A list of foods the child must never eat so asthma attacks do not happen
A set of exercises the child should do every morning to strengthen the lungs
A schedule of hospital check-ups the child must attend each month
explanation: Many children with asthma have a doctor-provided plan that specifies which medicine to take daily to prevent attacks.
fact_tl: Maraming batang may hika ang may plano mula sa doktor na nagsasabi kung anong gamot ang iinumin araw-araw upang maiwasan ang atake.
fact_bis: Daghang bata nga adunay hubak ang adunay plano gikan sa doktor nga nag-ingon kung unsang tambal ang inomon kada adlaw aron malikayan ang pag-atake.

q: Why can't anyone count all the stars in the sky?
options: There are too many stars, and many are too far or too faint to see
Stars move around too quickly for scientists to keep track of them
Stars only appear for a short time before they disappear forever
Scientists have not yet built a telescope powerful enough to see each one
explanation: There are so many stars in the sky that no one can count them all, and many more are too far away or too faint for us to see.
fact_tl: May napakaraming bituin sa langit na hindi natin kayang bilangin, at marami pang hindi natin nakikita dahil sobrang layo o sobrang labo nila.
fact_bis: Adunay daghan kaayong bituon sa langit nga dili nato maihap, ug mas daghan pa ang dili nato makita kay layo ra kaayo o huyang ra kaayo sila.

q: How does a cobra inject venom into its prey?
options: Through sharp fangs that pierce the skin
By spitting venom from a distance through a special sac
By squeezing the prey tightly until venom enters through the skin
By biting down and holding on while venom seeps through the gums
explanation: Cobras and other venomous snakes inject venom into prey through sharp hollow fangs.
fact_tl: Ang ilang ahas gaya ng cobra ay may kamandag na ipinapasok nito sa biktima sa pamamagitan ng matutulis na pangil.
fact_bis: Ang ubang bitin sama sa cobra adunay hilo nga ipasulod nila sa biktima pinaagi sa hait nga mga tango.

q: How does the digital compass in many smartphones know which direction is north?
options: It detects Earth's magnetic field
It uses the GPS satellite signal to calculate direction
It measures the position of the sun to find north and south
It tracks the phone's movement over time to figure out direction
explanation: Many smartphones contain a digital compass that uses Earth's magnetic field to determine direction for maps and navigation.
fact_tl: Maraming selpon ngayon ay may digital na kompas na gumagamit ng magnetic field ng Daigdig para sa mga mapa.
fact_bis: Daghang selpon karon adunay digital nga compass nga naggamit sa magnetic field sa Kalibutan para sa mga mapa.

q: How does staying completely still and then jumping suddenly help a frog survive?
options: The sudden jump surprises a predator or prey, making it harder to catch or escape from the frog
The stillness makes the frog's body temperature drop so it can jump faster when needed
Staying still uses less energy so the frog can jump farther when it finally moves
The sudden movement confuses the frog's enemies by making them think it is two animals
explanation: A frog waits quietly and still, then jumps suddenly — the surprise makes it harder for predators to catch the frog or for prey to escape from it.
fact_tl: Madalas, tahimik lang at hindi gumagalaw ang palaka habang nakaabang. Pagkatapos, biglang-bigla itong lumulukso. Nakakatulong ito para magulat ang kaaway o ang biktima nito, kaya mas mahirap silang mahuli o makatakas.
fact_bis: Kasagaran, hilom lang ug dili molihok ang baki samtang naghulat. Unya, kalit kaayo kini nga molukso. Makatabang kini aron makalitan ang kaaway o ang iyang biktima, mao nga mas lisod sila madakpan o makaikyas.

q: Why is wave energy considered a clean, renewable energy source?
options: Wind constantly makes new waves and wave energy produces no smoke or pollution unlike burning oil or coal
Ocean waves store energy from the sun so they never run out and need no fuel
Wave energy plants are built underwater where no pollution can escape into the air
Waves are powered by the moon's gravity which is a natural force that never stops
explanation: Wave energy is renewable because wind keeps generating waves on the sea, and unlike burning fossil fuels, it produces no smoke or pollution.
fact_tl: Ang wave energy ay itinuturing na renewable dahil patuloy na gumagawa ng alon ang hangin sa dagat, at hindi ito naglalabas ng usok o polusyon tulad ng pagsunog ng langis o karbon.
fact_bis: Ang wave energy giisip nga renewable kay ang hangin padayon nga mohimo og balod sa dagat, ug wala kini moboga og aso o polusyon sama sa pagsunog og lana o karbon.

q: What unusual defense does a sea cucumber use when it is attacked?
options: It expels its internal organs from its rear to distract the predator, then escapes and regrows them later
It releases a thick cloud of ink to blind the predator and then hides in a nearby rock crevice
It puffs up its body with water to become too large for the predator to swallow
It detaches one of its arms which wiggles to distract the predator while the rest escapes
explanation: When attacked, a sea cucumber expels its internal organs to distract the predator, escapes, and later regrows a new set of organs.
fact_tl: Kapag nag-atake ang isang mandaragit, ang sea cucumber ay maaaring ilabas ang kanyang mga internal organs mula sa puwit nito — ang taktikang ito ay nagpapagulo sa mandaragit habang ang sea cucumber ay tumakas, at pagkatapos ay palalakin nito ang bagong set ng mga organo.
fact_bis: Sa dihang giaway, ang sea cucumber mahimong mogawas sa iyang mga internal organ gikan sa iyang luyo — kining taktika nagpabilin sa mandaragit samtang ang sea cucumber nakalingkawas, ug pagkahuman nagpatubo kini og bag-ong hugpong sa mga organo.

q: What two large bodies of water does the Pasig River connect?
options: Laguna de Bay and Manila Bay
Manila Bay and Subic Bay
Laguna de Bay and Laguna Lake
Taal Lake and Manila Bay
explanation: The Pasig River flows from Laguna de Bay — the largest lake in the Philippines — through Metro Manila and into Manila Bay.
fact_tl: Ang Pasig River ay umaagos mula sa Laguna de Bay, ang pinakamalaking lawa sa Pilipinas, patungo sa Manila Bay, dumadaan sa gitna ng Kalakhang Maynila.
fact_bis: Ang Pasig River modagayday gikan sa Laguna de Bay, ang pinakadakong lanaw sa Pilipinas, paingon sa Manila Bay, nga moagi sa tunga sa Metro Manila.

q: What is the main difference between ocean tides and ocean currents?
options: Tides are the rising and falling of water caused by the moon's gravity, while currents are a continuous flow of water in one direction caused by wind and heat differences
Tides flow horizontally across the ocean while currents move water up and down from the deep
Tides happen only near coastlines while currents only move water in the open ocean far from land
Tides are caused by the sun's heat making water expand and shrink while currents are caused by the moon
explanation: A tide is the rising and falling of water caused by the moon's gravitational pull, while a current is a continuous directional flow caused by wind and differences in water temperature.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang taog at agos. Ang taog ay pagtaas at pagbaba ng tubig na dulot ng hila ng buwan. Ang agos naman ay tuloy-tuloy na pagdaloy ng tubig sa isang direksyon, na karaniwang dulot ng hangin at pagkakaiba ng init.
fact_bis: Lahi ang taob ug sulog. Ang taob kay pagsaka ug pagkanaog sa tubig tungod sa guyod sa bulan. Ang sulog kay padayon nga pag-agos sa tubig sa usa ka direksyon, kasagaran tungod sa hangin ug kalainan sa kainit.

q: Why is abaca fiber also called 'Manila hemp'?
options: Because abaca fiber used to be shipped to other countries from the port of Manila
Because abaca was first discovered by Spanish traders in the city of Manila
Because the finest quality abaca plants only grow in the soil around Manila
Because Manila craftsmen invented the process of weaving abaca into rope and cloth
explanation: Abaca fiber earned the name Manila hemp because it was historically exported to other countries through the port of Manila.
fact_tl: Tinawag itong Manila hemp dahil ang hiblang abaka ay dating ipinapadala sa ibang bansa mula sa daungan ng Maynila.
fact_bis: Gitawag kini og Manila hemp tungod kay ang hilo sa abaka kaniadto gipadala sa ubang nasod gikan sa pantalan sa Manila.

q: What is the safest thing to do to prevent getting a deep wound with tetanus bacteria when going outside?
options: Wear slippers or shoes outdoors
Always walk on grass instead of dirt
Wash your feet before going outside
Stay near a water source while walking
explanation: Wearing slippers or shoes outdoors protects your feet from stepping on nails or sharp objects that could cause deep wounds where tetanus bacteria can enter.
fact_tl: Halimbawa, kung nakayapak kang naglalakad sa labas at natapakan mo ang nakatusok na pako, malalim ang sugat na pwedeng pasukan ng bakteryang tetanus. Kaya mas mabuting magsuot ng tsinelas o sapatos sa labas.
fact_bis: Pananglitan, kung magtiniil ka og lakaw sa gawas ug matumban nimo ang nagtuhog nga lansang, makakuha ka og lawom nga samad nga masudlan sa bakterya sa tetanus. Mao nga mas maayo nga magsul-ob og tsinelas o sapatos sa gawas.

q: On the Beaufort wind scale, what does Force 0 look like?
options: Smoke rises straight up because there is no wind
Leaves rustle gently in a slight breeze
Small waves form on calm water
Tree branches sway back and forth
explanation: Beaufort Force 0 means calm with no wind at all, and a tell-tale sign is that smoke rises perfectly straight up.
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort Force 0 ay nangangahulugang kalmado o walang hangin — ang usok ay tuwid na umaakyat.
fact_bis: Ang Beaufort Force 0 nagpasabot nga kalma o walay hangin — ang aso tul-id nga mosaka.

q: What do the thousands of fossil layers found in sedimentary rock tell scientists?
options: Life on Earth has changed over a very long time
All living things appeared at the same time
Sedimentary rock forms only in water
Fossils are only found near volcanoes
explanation: The many layers of sedimentary rock containing fossils provide evidence for the very long history of changing life forms on Earth.
fact_tl: Ang libu-libong patong ng sedimentaryong bato na may lamang mga fosil ay nagbibigay ng patunay sa napakahabang kasaysayan ng nagbabagong anyo ng buhay sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang liboan ka sapaw sa sedimentaryong bato nga adunay sulod nga mga fosil naghatag og pamatuod sa taas kaayo nga kasaysayan sa nag-usab nga klase sa buhi sa Yuta.

q: What is the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR)?
options: A defined region monitored by PAGASA for typhoons
The exclusive economic zone where Filipino fishermen can fish
The area covered by the Philippine Air Force
The territory declared during the Spanish colonial period
explanation: The PAR is a defined region monitored by PAGASA that covers a large portion of the Philippine Sea and surrounding waters where typhoons are tracked.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ay isang tinukoy na rehiyon na sinusubaybayan ng PAGASA para sa mga bagyo; sumasaklaw ito sa malaking bahagi ng Karagatang Pilipino at mga karagatang nakapalibot sa bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) usa ka tinukoy nga rehiyon nga gimonitor sa PAGASA alang sa mga bagyo; nagsakop kini sa dakong bahin sa Dagat Pilipino ug naglibot nga mga tubig sa nasud.

q: When ice melts into water and then the water freezes back into ice, what type of change is this?
options: A physical change that can be reversed
A chemical change that makes a new substance
An irreversible change that cannot be undone
A biological change caused by living things
explanation: Melting and freezing are physical changes — no new substance is made and the change can be reversed, as water can freeze back into ice.
fact_tl: Ang pagbabago ng state ay isang physical change — mababalik ito at walang bagong sangkap na nabubuo: kapag natunaw ang yelo, tubig pa rin ito, at kapag pinalamig muli, magyeyelo itong muli.
fact_bis: Ang pagbalhin sa state usa ka physical change — mabalik kini ug walay bag-ong sustansya nga maporma: kung matunaw ang yelo, tubig gihapon kini, ug kung bugnawon usab, mo-yelo na usab.

q: What is one astronomical unit (AU)?
options: The distance from Earth to the Sun, about 150 million kilometers
The distance from Earth to the Moon, about 384,000 kilometers
The distance light travels in one year
The diameter of the entire solar system
explanation: One astronomical unit (AU) is defined as the distance from Earth to the Sun, which is approximately 150 million kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang isang astronomical unit (AU) ay ang layo ng Lupa sa Araw, mga 150 milyong kilometro.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka astronomical unit (AU) mao ang gilay-on sa Yuta gikan sa Adlaw, mga 150 ka milyon ka kilometro.

q: How do plant roots help protect the land from erosion?
options: They hold the soil tightly in place so it cannot wash or blow away
They absorb all rainfall so floodwater cannot move the soil
They produce chemicals that harden the soil into rock
They create a thick layer of leaves on top of the ground
explanation: Plant roots hold soil firmly in place, which is why trees and plants help stop soil from being washed or blown away.
fact_tl: Ang mga ugat ng halaman ay humahawak sa lupa nang mahigpit, kaya nakakatulong ang mga puno na pigilan ang pagguho ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang gamot sa tanom mokupot pag-ayo sa yuta, mao nga ang mga kahoy makatabang sa pagpugong sa banlas sa yuta.

q: What is the difference between genuine high-quality kape alamid and lower-quality versions?
options: Genuine kape alamid comes from wild civets, not from civets kept in cages
Genuine kape alamid uses beans picked by hand, not by machine
Genuine kape alamid is grown only on mountain farms, not lowland areas
Genuine kape alamid is roasted longer to remove the animal smell
explanation: Genuine high-quality civet coffee comes from wild civets, while some kape alamid raises animal welfare concerns because the civets are kept in small cages.
fact_tl: Ang ilang kape alamid ay gawa mula sa mga musang na nakakulong sa maliliit na hawla, na nagdudulot ng alalahanin sa kagalingan ng hayop; ang tunay na mabuting kape alamid ay mula sa mga musang na malaya sa kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka kape alamid gihimo gikan sa mga musang nga nakulong sa gagmayng hawla, nagduhat og mga pag-alalahanin sa kaayohan sa hayop; ang tinuod nga maayong kape alamid gikan sa mga musang sa kalikasan.

q: After light enters your eye, what carries the electrical signals from your retina to your brain?
options: The optic nerve
The cornea
The iris
The pupil
explanation: Retinal cells convert light into electrical signals, and the optic nerve carries those signals to the visual cortex of the brain where images are processed.
fact_tl: Ang mga retinal cells ay nagko-convert ng liwanag sa mga elektrikal na signal na ipinapadala ng optic nerve sa visual cortex ng utak, kung saan ang mga larawan ay pinoproseso.
fact_bis: Ang mga retinal cell nagconvert sa kahayag ngadto sa mga electrical signal nga gipadala sa optic nerve ngadto sa visual cortex sa utak, diin ang mga imahe gi-proseso.

q: Why does the sun feel so strong in the Philippines even though the ozone layer blocks dangerous UV rays?
options: The Philippines is near the equator so sunlight hits more directly and strongly all year
The Philippines has a thinner ozone layer than other countries
Typhoons push more sunlight toward the Philippines
The Philippines has fewer clouds to block the sun's rays
explanation: Even with ozone blocking dangerous UV, the Philippines stays near the equator so sunlight hits more directly and the UV index stays high all year.
fact_tl: Bakit grabe ang init ng araw sa Pilipinas kahit may ozone? Malapit ang Pilipinas sa ekwador kaya mas tuwid at malakas ang sikat ng araw dito buong taon. Hinaharang pa rin ng ozone ang delikadong UV, pero dahil sa lokasyon natin, mataas pa rin ang UV index kaya kailangan pa rin mag-ingat sa araw.
fact_bis: Nganong kusog kaayo ang init sa adlaw sa Pilipinas bisan adunay ozone? Duol ang Pilipinas sa ekwador mao nga mas tul-id ug kusog ang sidlak sa adlaw dinhi tibuok tuig. Gibabagan gihapon sa ozone ang peligrosong UV, apan tungod sa atong lokasyon, taas gihapon ang UV index mao nga kinahanglan gihapon mag-amping sa adlaw.

q: In which two Philippine places can tourists watch whale sharks?
options: Donsol in Sorsogon and Oslob in Cebu
Batangas City and Puerto Princesa in Palawan
Subic Bay in Zambales and Davao in Mindanao
Boracay in Aklan and Pagudpud in Ilocos Norte
explanation: Whale sharks can be seen in Donsol, Sorsogon and in Oslob, Cebu, where tourists travel specifically to watch them.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, makikita ang mga butanding sa Donsol, Sorsogon at sa Oslob, Cebu, kung saan dumadayo ang mga turista para makita sila.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, makita ang mga tuki sa Donsol, Sorsogon ug sa Oslob, Cebu, diin moadto ang mga turista aron makita sila.

q: How does PAGASA measure the strength of a typhoon?
options: By measuring wind speed in kilometers per hour
By measuring how much rain falls in millimeters per day
By counting how many lightning bolts strike the ground
By tracking how wide the storm clouds spread in kilometers
explanation: PAGASA measures a typhoon's wind speed in kilometers per hour — the higher the speed, the stronger and more destructive the storm.
fact_tl: Sinusukat ng PAGASA ang bilis ng hangin ng isang bagyo sa kilometro kada oras; mas mataas ang bilis, mas malakas at mapanira ang bagyo.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA nagsukod sa katulin sa hangin sa usa ka bagyo sa kilometro kada oras; mas taas ang katulin, mas kusog ug mas makaguba ang bagyo.

q: What does the liver do with ammonia, a toxic waste product in the body?
options: It changes ammonia into urea, which leaves the body in urine
It stores ammonia in the gallbladder until the body needs it
It sends ammonia to the lungs to be breathed out
It breaks ammonia down into water and releases it as sweat
explanation: The liver converts ammonia, which is toxic, into urea — a safer waste product that the kidneys then remove from the body through urine.
fact_tl: Binabago ng atay ang ammonia, isang nakakalasong basura, tungo sa urea na inilalabas ng katawan sa pamamagitan ng ihi.
fact_bis: Ang atay nag-usab sa ammonia, usa ka makahilo nga hugaw, ngadto sa urea nga gipagawas sa lawas pinaagi sa ihi.

q: What causes a storm surge during a typhoon?
options: Low pressure and wind push seawater toward the shore, raising sea level
Heavy rainfall fills rivers until they overflow into the sea
Strong winds pull water up from the ocean floor
Thunder and lightning heat the water and make it expand
explanation: A storm surge is caused by a typhoon's low pressure and wind pushing seawater toward the shore, raising sea level — this caused massive devastation in Tacloban during Typhoon Haiyan.
fact_tl: Ang storm surge ay ang pag-akyat ng antas ng dagat dulot ng mababang presyon ng bagyo at ang pagtutulak ng hangin sa tubig-dagat patungo sa dalampasigan; ito ang nagdulot ng malaking sakuna sa Tacloban noong Yolanda.
fact_bis: Ang storm surge mao ang pagsaka sa lebel sa dagat tungod sa ubos nga presyon sa bagyo ug pagtulod sa hangin sa tubig-dagat padulong sa baybayin; kini ang naghatag og dako nga kalamidad sa Tacloban sa panahon ni Yolanda.

q: Why do some mango seeds never grow into plants?
options: Some seeds are spoiled, dried out, or do not get enough water and sunlight
All mango seeds always grow if you plant them deep enough
Only seeds from big mangoes can grow into healthy trees
Mango seeds need to be boiled first before they can sprout
explanation: Not every mango seed grows — some are spoiled, dried out, or lack enough water and sunlight, which is a normal part of nature.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng buto ng mangga ay tumutubo. Ang ilan ay sira na, tuyot, o walang sapat na tubig at araw, kaya hindi sila nagiging halaman. Normal lang ito sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga liso sa mangga moturok. Ang uban nadaot na, namala, o walay igong tubig ug adlaw, busa dili sila mahimong tanom. Normal ra kini sa kinaiyahan.

q: What is the difference between hunger and thirst?
options: Hunger signals a need for food, while thirst signals a need for water
Hunger signals a need for water, while thirst signals a need for food
Both hunger and thirst signal the body's need for more sleep
Hunger and thirst are the same feeling caused by low energy
explanation: Hunger and thirst are different body signals — hunger tells you that you need food, while thirst tells you that you need water.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang gutom at uhaw: ang gutom ay senyales na kailangan ng pagkain, samantalang ang uhaw ay senyales na kailangan ng tubig.
fact_bis: Lahi ang kagutom ug kauhaw: ang kagutom senyales nga nagkinahanglan ug pagkaon, samtang ang kauhaw senyales nga nagkinahanglan ug tubig.

q: How can you tell a heron apart from a stork when they are flying?
options: A heron folds its neck into an S-shape, while a stork stretches its neck out straight
A heron stretches its neck out straight, while a stork folds its neck in an S-shape
A heron flaps its wings faster, while a stork glides without flapping
A heron flies only at night, while a stork flies only during the day
explanation: When flying, a heron folds its neck back into an S-shape, while a stork flies with its neck stretched out straight — the key difference between these two birds.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakalang pareho lang ang tagak at ang stork, pero magkaiba sila. Kapag lumilipad ang tagak, ibinabaluktot nito ang leeg pabalik sa hugis-S, samantalang inuunat ng stork ang leeg nito.
fact_bis: Daghan ang nagtuo nga pareho ra ang tagak ug ang stork, apan lahi sila. Kung molupad ang tagak, ipilo niini ang liog balik sa porma nga S, samtang itul-id sa stork ang iyang liog.

q: What is a scorpion's tail made of?
options: Small joined segments that end in a sharp stinger
One solid curved bone covered in hard shell
A flexible muscle with a hollow tube inside
A series of tiny hairs packed tightly together
explanation: A scorpion's tail is made of small joined segments, and these segments end in the sharp stinger used for defense and catching prey.
fact_tl: Ang buntot ng alakdan ay gawa sa magkakabit na maliliit na bahagi at nagtatapos sa matulis na tibo.
fact_bis: Ang ikog sa tanga-tanga gibuhat sa gagmayng nagdugtong nga mga bahin nga matapos sa talinis nga tibo.

q: In the ideal gas law equation PV = nRT, what does the letter n represent?
options: The number of moles of gas
The normal temperature of the gas
The net pressure on the container
The number of molecules per liter
explanation: In the ideal gas law PV = nRT, n stands for the number of moles of gas present in the container.
fact_tl: Sa ekwasyong PV = nRT, ang n ay tumutukoy sa dami ng mole (number of moles) ng gas.
fact_bis: Sa ekwasyon nga PV = nRT, ang n nagtumong sa gidaghanon sa mole (number of moles) sa gas.

q: Why does a thin ice skate blade grip ice better than a wide ski?
options: The thin blade concentrates force into a smaller area, creating higher pressure
The thin blade is lighter, so the skater moves faster on the ice
The thin blade is made of harder metal that does not bend
The thin blade creates less friction so the skater can glide more easily
explanation: The thin blade of an ice skate creates high pressure on a small area that bites into the ice, while a wide ski spreads the force and gives low pressure so it floats on snow.
fact_tl: Ang manipis na talim ng ice skate ay nagbibigay ng mataas na presyon na pumuputok sa ibabaw ng yelo, samantalang ang malapad na ski ay nagbibigay ng mababang presyon para hindi lumubog sa niyebe.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga sulab sa ice skate naghatag og taas nga presyur nga moduot sa yelo, samtang ang lapad nga ski naghatag og ubos nga presyur aron dili molubong sa niyebe.

q: How does nitrogen from the air become useful for plants?
options: Soil bacteria change nitrogen from the air into a form plants can absorb
Plants breathe in nitrogen gas directly through tiny holes in their leaves
Rain dissolves nitrogen from clouds and delivers it to plant roots
Sunlight breaks down nitrogen in the air and plants capture the pieces
explanation: In the nitrogen cycle, soil bacteria convert nitrogen from the air into forms that plants can use, and the nitrogen returns to the air when dead things decay.
fact_tl: Sa nitrogen cycle, ang nitroheno mula sa hangin ay binabago ng bakterya sa lupa upang magamit ng mga halaman, at bumabalik ito sa hangin kapag nabubulok ang mga namatay na nilalang.
fact_bis: Sa nitrogen cycle, ang nitroheno gikan sa hangin usbon sa bakterya sa yuta ngadto sa porma nga magamit sa mga tanom, ug mobalik kini sa hangin kon madunot ang mga patay nga binuhat.

q: How high above Earth does the Hubble Space Telescope orbit?
options: About 540 kilometers above Earth
About 36,000 kilometers above Earth
About 384,000 kilometers above Earth
About 150 million kilometers above Earth
explanation: The Hubble Space Telescope orbits at a height of about 540 kilometers above Earth, well above the atmosphere that would blur its images.
fact_tl: Umiikot ang Hubble Space Telescope sa taas na halos 540 kilometro mula sa ibabaw ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Hubble Space Telescope nagatuyok sa gitas-on nga mga 540 kilometro ibabaw sa Earth.

q: In what year did Mendeleev create his periodic table of elements?
explanation: Mendeleev created his periodic table in 1869, organizing the elements by their properties in a way that predicted elements not yet discovered.
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Mendeleev ang kanyang periodic table noong taong 1869.
fact_bis: Gihimo ni Mendeleev ang iyang periodic table sa tuig 1869.

q: What information does velocity give you that speed does NOT?
options: The direction of movement as well as how fast
The exact distance traveled along the path
The total time taken to complete a journey
The amount of force needed to keep moving
explanation: Speed tells only how fast something moves, but velocity tells both how fast and in which direction — direction is the key extra piece of information.
fact_tl: Ang bilis (speed) ay nagsasabi lang kung gaano kabilis gumagalaw ang isang bagay, habang ang velocity ay nagsasabi rin ng direksyon ng paggalaw.
fact_bis: Ang speed mosulti lang kon unsa ka paspas molihok ang usa ka butang, samtang ang velocity mosulti usab sa direksyon sa paglihok.

q: Why do electricians clean iron connectors before joining them?
options: Rust on the surface blocks electricity from flowing
Iron is too soft and bends unless the surface is polished
Rust makes the connector too heavy to attach properly
Cleaning removes sharp edges that could cut the wire insulation
explanation: Rust on the surface of iron blocks electricity from flowing, so connectors must be cleaned to ensure good electrical contact.
fact_tl: Ang kalawang sa ibabaw ng bakal ay humahadlang sa daloy ng kuryente, kaya nililinis ang konektor bago kumabit.
fact_bis: Ang taya sa ibabaw sa puthaw nagababag sa pag-agos sa kuryente, mao nga limpyohan ang konektor sa dili pa idugtong.

q: A runner jogs all the way around a 400-meter track and ends up back where she started. What is her displacement?
options: Zero, because she is back at her starting point
400 meters, equal to the distance of one lap
800 meters, because she ran the full track distance
It depends on how fast she was running
explanation: Displacement is zero because the runner returned to her exact starting point — even though she traveled 400 meters of distance, her displacement is the straight-line difference between start and end positions.
fact_tl: Kung ang isang bagay ay bumalik sa eksaktong pinanggalingan nito, ang displacement nito ay zero kahit malaki ang kabuuang distansyang nilakbay.
fact_bis: Kung ang usa ka butang mobalik sa eksakto niyang gigikanan, ang displacement niini zero bisan dako ang kinatibuk-ang gilay-on nga gilaktan.
