q: Why are small gaps left between sections of railway track?
options: Hot weather makes metal expand, and the gaps allow this so tracks do not buckle
Cold weather shrinks the metal and gaps prevent the tracks from breaking apart
The gaps reduce friction so trains can move faster along the track
Workers need gaps so they can easily replace broken track sections
explanation: Railway tracks have small gaps between sections so that when metal expands in hot weather, it has room to grow without buckling or bending out of shape.
fact_tl: Ang mga bakal na riles ay may maliliit na puwang sa pagitan ng mga piraso — kapag mainit ang panahon, ang metal ay lumalawak at pumapalaki ang mga puwang na ito para hindi matektek ang riles.
fact_bis: Ang mga riles sa tren adunay gagmayng puwang tali sa mga piraso — sa mainit nga panahon ang metal mopalawak, ug ang mga puwang nagahatag og lugar alang sa kining pagpalawak aron dili mabali ang mga riles.

q: Why do we always see the same side of the Moon from Earth?
options: The Moon is tidally locked — it spins once on its axis in the same time it takes to orbit Earth once
The Moon does not rotate at all, so the same face always points toward Earth
Earth's gravity is so strong that it stops the Moon from turning
The far side of the Moon is always in shadow and cannot be seen
explanation: We always see the same face of the Moon because of tidal locking — the Moon spins once on its axis in exactly the same time it takes to complete one orbit around Earth.
fact_tl: Palagi nating nakikita ang iisang mukha ng Buwan dahil sa tidal locking — kasabay ng isang pag-ikot nito sa Earth ang isang pag-ikot sa sarili nitong axis.
fact_bis: Kanunay natong makita ang usa ra ka nawong sa Bulan tungod sa tidal locking — usa ka tuyok niini sa kaugalingong axis dungan sa usa ka libot palibot sa Yuta.

q: What makes the Philippines special when it comes to frog species?
options: Nearly half of all Philippine frog species are found nowhere else in the world
The Philippines has more frog species than any other country in Asia
Philippine frogs are the largest frogs found in Southeast Asia
All Philippine frogs can live both in saltwater and freshwater
explanation: The Philippines is rich in endemic frog species, with nearly half of all Philippine frog species found nowhere else in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay mayaman sa endemikong mga palaka, at halos kalahati ng mga uri ng palaka dito ay makikita lamang sa ating bansa.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas dato sa endemikong mga palaka, ug hapit sa katunga sa tanan nga klase sa palaka dinhi makita lamang sa atong nasud.

q: Which of the following is a group of noble gases?
options: Helium, neon, and argon
Oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon dioxide
Hydrogen, fluorine, and chlorine
Iron, copper, and gold
explanation: Noble gases include helium, neon, and argon — these gases rarely react with other substances, which is what makes them 'noble.'
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas ay kabilang ang helium, neon, at argon — mga gas na bihirang makipagreaksyon.
fact_bis: Ang noble gases naglakip sa helium, neon, ug argon — mga gas nga panagsa ra mo-react.

q: What happens between atoms when an ionic bond forms, as in table salt?
options: One atom gives up electrons to another, making them attract each other with opposite charges
Two atoms share electrons equally so both become more stable
One atom pulls electrons away from another and then repels it
The atoms fuse together and create a completely new element
explanation: In an ionic bond, one atom gives up one or more electrons to another atom, so the atoms gain opposite electric charges and attract each other — just as in sodium chloride (table salt).
fact_tl: Sa ionic bond, ibinibigay ng isang atom ang isa o higit pang elektron sa kabilang atom, kaya nagiging magkasalungat ang kanilang kuryenteng singil at naaakit sila sa isa't isa—gaya sa asin na sodium chloride.
fact_bis: Sa ionic bond, ang usa ka atomo mohatag og usa o daghang elektron sa laing atomo, mao nga magkaatbang ang ilang kuryente nga singil ug magkadani sila—sama sa asin nga sodium chloride.

q: Who invented the modern three-point seatbelt in 1959?
options: Nils Bohlin, a Volvo engineer
Henry Ford, the founder of Ford Motor Company
Karl Benz, who built the first gasoline-powered car
George Westinghouse, who invented the railway air brake
explanation: Nils Bohlin, an engineer at Volvo, invented the modern three-point seatbelt in 1959 — a design now used in nearly every car in the world.
fact_tl: Si Nils Bohlin, isang inhinyero ng Volvo, ang gumawa ng modernong three-point na seatbelt noong 1959.
fact_bis: Si Nils Bohlin, usa ka inhenyero sa Volvo, ang naghimo sa modernong three-point nga seatbelt niadtong 1959.

q: Why does carbon build up slowly in peat bogs over thousands of years?
options: Waterlogged soil lacks oxygen, so dead plants decay very slowly and carbon accumulates
Peat bogs are too cold for any organisms to survive and break down plant matter
The thick layer of moss covers dead plants so sunlight cannot reach them
Peat bogs have acidic water that turns dead plants directly into carbon
explanation: Waterlogged peat bog soil lacks oxygen, so decay is very slow — this allows organic matter and its stored carbon to accumulate over thousands of years.
fact_tl: Ang peat ay isang makapal na layer ng bahagyang nabulok na organikong bagay na nabubuo sa mga lugar na laging basa (bogs); dahil sa kakulangan ng oxygen sa tubig-tubig na lupa, ang pagkabulok ay mabagal, kaya naiipon ang carbon sa loob ng libo-libong taon.
fact_bis: Ang peat usa ka baga nga layer sa bahagyang nadunot nga organikong butang nga nagtipon sa mga lugar nga pirme basa (bogs); tungod kay kulang og oxygen ang tubig-tubig nga yuta, hinay ang pagkadunot, mao nga nagtipon ang carbon sulod sa libu-libong tuig.

q: How do scientists organize all living things into the largest groups?
options: They group them into kingdoms based on shared traits, such as animals, plants, fungi, and microbes
They rank them by size from the smallest microbe to the largest animal
They sort them by where they live — water, land, or air
They classify them by how they reproduce — eggs, seeds, or spores only
explanation: Scientists sort all living things into large groups called kingdoms — such as animals, plants, fungi, and microbes — based on their shared traits.
fact_tl: Inuuri ng mga siyentipiko ang lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay sa malalaking grupong tinatawag na kaharian—tulad ng hayop, halaman, fungi, at mga mikrobyo—batay sa kanilang pagkakatulad.
fact_bis: Gibahin sa mga siyentista ang tanang buhing butang ngadto sa dagkong grupo nga gitawag og gingharian—sama sa mananap, tanom, uhong, ug mga mikrobyo—base sa ilang managsama nga kinaiya.

q: Which mineral has a Mohs hardness of 4?
options: Fluorite
Quartz
Talc
Diamond
explanation: Fluorite is the mineral that ranks at 4 on the Mohs hardness scale, sitting between calcite (3) and apatite (5).
fact_tl: Ang mineral na may Mohs hardness na 4 ay fluorite.
fact_bis: Ang mineral nga adunay Mohs hardness nga 4 mao ang fluorite.

q: How long does a reticulated python usually grow?
options: About 6 meters, with the longest reaching nearly 7 meters
About 2 meters, similar in length to a large crocodile
About 10 meters, making it as long as a school bus
About 4 meters, roughly the height of a two-story building
explanation: The reticulated python usually grows to about 6 meters long, with the longest individuals reaching nearly 7 meters, making it one of the world's longest snakes.
fact_tl: Ang reticulated python ay karaniwang umaabot sa mga 6 na metro ang haba, at ang pinakamahaba ay halos 7 metro.
fact_bis: Ang reticulated python kasagaran motaas-on og mga 6 ka metro, ug ang pinakataas-on hapit 7 ka metro.

q: What is the key difference between carbon monoxide (CO) and carbon dioxide (CO2)?
options: CO has one oxygen atom and is poisonous; CO2 has two oxygen atoms and is used by plants
CO has two oxygen atoms and is poisonous; CO2 has one oxygen atom and is harmless
CO and CO2 are the same gas — the names are just different spellings
CO is produced by plants during photosynthesis; CO2 is only produced by animals
explanation: Carbon monoxide (CO) has just one oxygen atom and is poisonous to humans, while carbon dioxide (CO2) has two oxygen atoms and is the gas we breathe out and that plants use for photosynthesis.
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang carbon monoxide (CO) at carbon dioxide (CO2). Ang CO ay may isang atom lang ng oxygen at lason ito; ang CO2 ay may dalawang oxygen at ito ang inilalabas natin kapag huminga at ginagamit ng halaman. Iisang letra ang pinagkaiba pero ibang-iba ang epekto sa katawan.
fact_bis: Lahi ang carbon monoxide (CO) ug carbon dioxide (CO2). Ang CO adunay usa lang ka atom sa oxygen ug hilo kini; ang CO2 adunay duha ka oxygen ug mao ang atong ginabuga kung moginhawa ug gamiton sa tanom. Usa ra ka letra ang kalainan apan lahi kaayo ang epekto sa lawas.

q: How do hermit crabs help keep the shore clean?
options: They eat scraps and dead animals, cleaning up waste from the shoreline
They carry shells that collect garbage from the beach
They dig holes in the sand that drain away dirty water
They chase away other animals that make a mess on the shore
explanation: Hermit crabs eat scraps and dead animals, which helps keep the shore clean and returns nutrients to the environment.
fact_tl: Kumakain ang hermit crab ng tira-tirang pagkain at patay na hayop, kaya nakatutulong itong maglinis ng baybayin.
fact_bis: Mokaon ang umang ug salin nga pagkaon ug patay nga mga hayop, mao nga makatabang kini paglimpyo sa baybayon.

q: What metal is used in almost all electrical wiring in Philippine homes, jeepneys, and tricycles?
options: Copper
Aluminum
Iron
Silver
explanation: Almost all electricity flowing from Meralco or local co-ops to Philippine homes, and even the wiring in jeepneys and tricycles, travels through copper wire.
fact_tl: Dito sa Pilipinas, halos lahat ng kuryenteng dumadaan mula sa Meralco o kooperatiba patungo sa ating mga bahay at maging sa wiring ng jeepney at tricycle ay dumadaloy sa tansong wire.
fact_bis: Dinhi sa Pilipinas, halos tanang kuryente nga moagi gikan sa Meralco o kooperatiba paingon sa atong mga balay, ug bisan ang wiring sa jeepney ug tricycle, moagi sa tumbaga nga wire.

q: How does a Komodo dragon track prey that is kilometers away?
options: It flicks its forked tongue to catch scent particles from the air
It uses its large ears to hear the prey moving on the ground
It spots its prey from a high rock using its excellent eyesight
It follows footprints left in the soil using special sensors in its feet
explanation: The Komodo dragon uses its forked tongue to smell — the tongue catches scent particles from the air, allowing it to track prey even kilometers away.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng Komodo dragon ang sangang dila nito para makaamoy — sinasalo ng dila ang mga particle ng amoy sa hangin, kaya kaya nitong matunton ang biktima kahit ilang kilometro ang layo.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa Komodo dragon ang sanga niini nga dila aron makapanimaho — kuhaon sa dila ang mga partikulo sa baho gikan sa hangin, mao nga makasubay kini sa biktima bisan pila ka kilometro ang gilay-on.

q: How can farmers tell that coffee cherries are ripe and ready to pick?
options: The cherries turn red or purple when ripe
The cherries fall off the branch on their own when ripe
The cherries shrink to half their size when ripe
The cherries develop a strong smell that can be noticed from far away
explanation: Coffee cherries turn red or purple when they are ripe and ready to pick — this color change is the key sign farmers look for.
fact_tl: Ang bunga ng kape ay nagiging pula o lila kapag hinog na at handa nang pitasin.
fact_bis: Ang bunga sa kape mahimong pula o purple kung hinog na ug andam nang pupuon.

q: How do narra tree roots help protect the land?
options: Deep roots hold the soil so it does not easily erode or wash away
Roots release chemicals that harden the soil around them
Roots collect rainwater and store it underground to prevent floods
Roots push rocks closer together to form a natural wall against erosion
explanation: The narra's deep roots hold the soil firmly in place, preventing erosion and protecting the land from being washed away.
fact_tl: Ang malalalim na ugat ng narra ay humahawak sa lupa para hindi madaling maguho o maanod.
fact_bis: Ang lawom nga gamot sa narra naggunit sa yuta aron dili dali nga maguba o mabanlas.

q: How is energy transported through the Sun's convective zone?
options: By hot plasma rising and cool plasma falling, moving energy upward
By light rays passing straight through the gas at the speed of light
By electrical currents flowing through the charged gas
By sound waves bouncing back and forth inside the Sun
explanation: The Sun's convective zone transports energy by the movement of rising and falling plasma — hot plasma rises and cool plasma sinks, carrying energy outward from the interior.
fact_tl: Ang convective zone ng Araw ay ang pinaka-labas na layer ng interior nito; dito, ang enerhiya ay nailipat ng rising at falling na plasma sa halip na radiation. Ang hangganan sa pagitan ng radiative at convective zone ay tinatawag na tachocline at mahalaga ito para sa pagbuo ng magnetic field ng Araw.
fact_bis: Ang convective zone sa Adlaw mao ang pinaka-gawas nga layer sa iyang interior; dinhi ang enerhiya gi-transfer sa nagsaka ug nagsalop nga plasma kaysa sa radiation. Ang utlanan tali sa radiative ug convective zone ginganlan og tachocline ug importante kini alang sa pagmugna sa magnetic field sa Adlaw.

q: Why do some mountains near the equator have snow on top all year, even though the land below is very hot?
options: They are so tall that the temperature stays freezing at the summit all year
The snow is protected from the sun by thick clouds that never move away
The cold ocean wind blows only toward the mountaintops and brings ice
Trees on the mountains release a gas that keeps the peaks cold
explanation: Even near the equator, very tall mountains like Mount Kilimanjaro stay freezing at their peaks all year because temperature drops as altitude increases.
fact_tl: May mga bundok malapit sa ekwador na laging may niyebe o yelo sa tuktok — kahit mainit ang paligid, sobrang taas ng mga ito kaya laging malamig doon sa itaas, gaya ng Bundok Kilimanjaro sa Africa.
fact_bis: Adunay mga bukid duol sa ekwador nga kanunay adunay niyebe o yelo sa tumoy — bisan init ang palibot, sobra ka habog kini maong kanunay bugnaw didto sa taas, sama sa Bukid Kilimanjaro sa Africa.

q: What is true about the horns of goats and sheep?
options: Their horns stay for their whole life and never fall off
Their horns fall off every year and grow back longer
Their horns are made of hair pressed together, like fingernails
Their horns only grow on male goats and never on females
explanation: The horns of goats and sheep are permanent — they do not fall off and stay with the animal for its entire life.
fact_tl: Ang sungay ng kambing at tupa ay hindi nalalaglag at nananatili habang sila ay nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Ang sungay sa kanding ug karnero dili matangtang ug magpabilin samtang sila buhi.

q: What can be found at the base of a santan (ixora) flower that butterflies love?
options: Sweet nectar
Sticky pollen
A tiny seed
Bitter sap
explanation: The sweet base of each santan bloom holds nectar that butterflies — and even curious children — love to sip.
fact_tl: Ang santan ay isang palumpong na namumulaklak ng maliliit na bulaklak na nakapumpon-pumpon, at ang matatamis na dulo ng bulaklak nito ay sinisipsip ng mga paru-paro at bata para sa nektar.
fact_bis: Ang santan usa ka palumpong nga namulak og gagmay nga mga bulak nga nagpundok, ug ang tam-is nga tumoy sa matag bulak gisupsop sa mga alibangbang ug mga bata alang sa nektar.

q: About how long is a carabao (water buffalo) pregnant before giving birth?
options: About 10 months
About 3 months
About 6 months
About 18 months
explanation: A carabao is pregnant for about 10 months before giving birth, which is similar in length to a human pregnancy.
fact_tl: Ang kalabaw ay nagbubuntis nang halos 10 buwan bago manganak.
fact_bis: Ang kabaw mabdos ug mga 10 ka bulan una manganak.

q: Ball lightning is sometimes seen during thunderstorms. What do scientists say about it?
options: Scientists still do not fully understand how ball lightning forms.
Scientists have proven that ball lightning is caused by static electricity buildup.
Scientists say ball lightning is just a reflection of regular lightning on clouds.
Scientists have confirmed ball lightning is created by burning gases from the ground.
explanation: Ball lightning is so rare and unusual that scientists still do not fully understand how it forms.
fact_tl: Ang ball lightning ay isang bihirang lumulutang na bolang liwanag na minsang nakikita tuwing may bagyo — napakabihira nito kaya hindi pa lubos na nauunawaan ng mga siyentipiko kung paano ito nabubuo.
fact_bis: Ang ball lightning usa ka talagsaon nga naglutaw nga bola sa kahayag nga usahay makita panahon sa bagyo — talagsaon kaayo kini mao nga wala pa hingpit nga masabti sa mga siyentipiko kung giunsa kini pagporma.

q: A carabao pulls an empty cart and then a cart loaded with sacks of rice. Which cart needs MORE force to speed up?
options: The loaded cart, because bigger mass needs more force to accelerate.
The empty cart, because it is lighter and harder to control.
Both carts need the same force since the carabao is equally strong.
The loaded cart, because friction with the ground disappears when weight increases.
explanation: According to F = ma, a larger mass requires a larger force to produce the same acceleration.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng kalabaw ng mas malaking puwersa para pabilisin ang punong kariton kaysa sa walang laman, dahil mas malaki ang masa kaya mas maliit ang aselerasyon sa parehong puwersa (F = ma).
fact_bis: Kinahanglan sa kabaw og mas dako nga kusog aron paspason ang puno nga kariton kaysa walay sulod, kay ang mas dako nga masa mohatag og mas gamay nga aselerasyon sa samang kusog (F = ma).

q: Why does molave wood last a very long time?
options: It resists termites and rotting.
It contains a sticky sap that hardens into plastic over time.
Its grain is too dense for any saw to cut through.
It absorbs water and becomes stronger when wet.
explanation: Molave wood lasts a long time because it naturally resists termites and rotting.
fact_tl: Matagal bago masira ang kahoy ng molave dahil hindi ito madaling kainin ng anay o mabulok.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy sa molave dugay madaot kay dili dali kan-on sa anay o madunot.

q: Why can a tadpole NOT jump like an adult frog?
options: A tadpole has no legs yet, so it can only swim using its tail.
A tadpole is too heavy and sinks before it can push off.
A tadpole's muscles are too weak even though it already has legs.
A tadpole cannot jump because it breathes through gills instead of lungs.
explanation: A tadpole has no legs yet; it swims with its tail and only begins jumping after it grows legs.
fact_tl: Ang batang palaka o tadpole ay hindi pa marunong lumukso dahil wala pa itong binti. Lumalangoy muna ito sa tubig gamit ang buntot. Kapag lumaki na at tumubo ang binti, saka pa lang ito makakalukso.
fact_bis: Ang batan-ong baki o tadpole dili pa makahibalo molukso kay wala pa kini bitiis. Molangoy una kini sa tubig gamit ang ikog. Inig dako na ug motubo ang bitiis, saka pa kini makalukso.

q: What body part helps a frog jump far?
options: Strong, long back legs.
A wide, flat tail that pushes against the ground.
Sticky front feet that spring off surfaces.
A puffed-up belly that acts like a spring.
explanation: A frog has strong, long back legs that let it jump far.
fact_tl: May malalakas at mahahabang likurang binti ang palaka kaya ito ay malayong makalukso.
fact_bis: Ang baki naay kusgan ug taas nga likod nga mga tiil maong makaambak ni og layo.

q: Why does steam always rise upward instead of sinking down?
options: Hot steam is lighter than the cooler air around it, so it floats up.
Steam is pushed up by the pressure of boiling water below it.
Steam is heavier than air, so gravity pulls it up toward the sky.
Steam rises because water molecules repel each other strongly when hot.
explanation: Hot steam is lighter (less dense) than the cooler surrounding air, so it floats upward just like a hot-air balloon.
fact_tl: Bakit palaging pataas ang singaw? Ang mainit na singaw ay mas magaan kaysa sa malamig na hangin sa paligid nito. Dahil magaan ito, umaangat ito pataas — parang lobo na puno ng mainit na hangin. Kaya laging pataas ang galaw ng singaw.
fact_bis: Ngano kanunay nga mosaka ang singaw? Ang init nga singaw mas gaan kaysa bugnaw nga hangin sa palibot niini. Tungod kay gaan kini, mosaka kini paibabaw — sama sa balloon nga puno sa init nga hangin. Mao nga kanunay mosaka ang singaw.

q: What do healthy lungs do, and what harmful thing can block this work?
options: Healthy lungs clean the air and take in oxygen, but cigarette smoke blocks this work.
Healthy lungs produce oxygen from carbon dioxide, but pollution speeds this up.
Healthy lungs filter blood and remove carbon dioxide, but cold weather slows this down.
Healthy lungs warm the air before it reaches the heart, but dust particles stop them.
explanation: Healthy lungs clean the air and take in oxygen, and cigarette smoke blocks this important function.
fact_tl: Ang malusog na baga ay naglilinis ng hangin at kumukuha ng oksiheno, ngunit nahahadlangan ito ng usok ng sigarilyo.
fact_bis: Ang himsog nga baga maglimpyo sa hangin ug mokuha og oksiheno, apan ang aso sa sigarilyo makababag niini.

q: How does the bullfrog use its strong back legs?
options: To leap far in order to catch insects or escape danger.
To dig burrows underground where it hides from predators.
To paddle quickly through fast-moving rivers.
To climb tall reeds and reach food high above the water.
explanation: The bullfrog has strong back legs that let it leap far to catch insects or escape from danger.
fact_tl: Ang bullfrog ay isang malaking palaka na may malalakas na hulihang binti na nagbibigay-daan dito na lumukso nang malayo para makahuli ng insekto o makatakas.
fact_bis: Ang bullfrog usa ka dako nga baki nga adunay kusgan nga likod nga bitiis nga makapalukso niini og layo aron makadakop og insekto o makaikyas.

q: Why does a grassland look flat and wide open compared to a forest?
options: The grass is low and there are very few trees, so you can see far across it.
Strong winds blow away any tall plants, leaving only bare soil visible.
Grassland soil is too hard for any plant taller than knee height to grow.
Frequent fires keep trees small, but dense shrubs fill the space between grasses.
explanation: A grassland looks flat and open because the grass is low and there are few trees, allowing you to see very far across it.
fact_tl: Mukhang patag at malawak ang grassland dahil mababa lang ang damo at kakaunti ang puno. Kaya malayo ang naaabot ng tingin mo.
fact_bis: Morag patag ug lapad ang grassland tungod kay mubo ra ang sagbot ug gamay ang kahoy. Mao nga layo kaayo ang imong makita.

q: Iuk-iuk is a dish made of grilled blood. Why does the blood change from liquid to solid when grilled?
options: Heat makes the proteins in the blood coagulate, turning it solid.
Grilling removes all the water from the blood, leaving only minerals behind.
The iron in blood melts and re-hardens into a solid form when cooled.
Salt added before grilling causes a chemical bond that locks the liquid in place.
explanation: Heat causes the proteins in the blood to coagulate, which changes it from a liquid to a solid.
fact_tl: Ang inihaw na dugo gaya ng iuk-iuk ay tumitigas mula sa likido dahil ang init ay nagpapamuo (coagulate) sa mga protina sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang sinugba nga dugo sama sa iuk-iuk mogahi gikan sa likido tungod kay ang init maoy hinungdan nga mamuo ang mga protina sa dugo.

q: What are the three main parts of an atom?
options: Proton, neutron, and electron.
Nucleus, orbit, and shell.
Proton, photon, and neutron.
Electron, ion, and molecule.
explanation: The three main parts of an atom are the proton, neutron, and electron.
fact_tl: Ang tatlong pangunahing bahagi ng atom ay ang proton, neutron, at electron.
fact_bis: Ang tulo ka panguna nga bahin sa atomo mao ang proton, neutron, ug electron.

q: What is the natural frequency of an object?
options: The number of vibrations per second it makes when it is tapped.
The loudest sound it can produce before it breaks.
The speed at which sound travels through the object.
The lowest pitch sound it absorbs from its surroundings.
explanation: Every object has its own natural frequency — the number of vibrations per second it makes when tapped.
fact_tl: Bawat bagay ay may sariling natural na prekwensiya, ang bilang ng pag-uga nito kada segundo kapag tinapik.
fact_bis: Matag butang adunay kaugalingong kinaiyanhon nga prekwensiya, ang gidaghanon sa pag-uyog niini matag segundo kung tapikon.

q: Why might the makahiya plant fold its leaves when touched?
options: Folding may startle animals or insects that want to eat its leaves, protecting the plant.
Folding helps the plant collect more rainwater in its closed leaves.
Folding lets the plant move toward sunlight more quickly.
Folding reduces the leaf surface to cool the plant down on hot days.
explanation: The makahiya's folding may be a defense to startle animals or insects that want to eat its leaves.
fact_tl: Maaaring pananggalang ang pagtiklop ng makahiya upang takutin ang mga hayop o insektong nais kumain ng dahon nito.
fact_bis: Ang pagtiklop sa makahiya mahimong panalipod aron hadlukon ang mga mananap o insekto nga gustong mokaon sa dahon niini.

q: What happens when kakawate leaves fall and decompose on the ground?
options: They become a natural fertilizer that adds nutrients to the soil.
They release a chemical that prevents weeds from growing nearby.
They harden into a layer that protects tree roots from drying out.
They attract earthworms that loosen the soil but remove nutrients.
explanation: When kakawate leaves fall and decompose, they become a natural fertilizer that adds nutrients to the soil.
fact_tl: Kapag nahuhulog at nabubulok ang mga dahon ng kakawate, nagiging likas na pataba ang mga ito na nagdaragdag ng sustansya sa lupa.
fact_bis: Kon mahulog ug madunot ang mga dahon sa kakawate, mahimo kining natural nga abono nga makadugang og sustansya sa yuta.

q: What color are live shrimp, and how does their color change after cooking?
options: Live shrimp are gray or clear, but they turn red or orange when cooked.
Live shrimp are bright red, but they turn white or gray when cooked.
Live shrimp are blue, but they turn pink when placed in salt water.
Live shrimp are yellow, but they turn green when exposed to heat.
explanation: Live shrimp are usually gray or clear, but they turn red or orange when they are cooked.
fact_tl: Ang buhay na hipon ay madalas kulay-abo o malinaw, ngunit namumula o nag-oorange kapag ito ay niluluto.
fact_bis: Ang buhi nga hipon kasagaran abuhon o tin-aw, apan mamula o moorange kini kon lutoon na.

q: Where does an eel (igat) spend most of its life before returning to the sea?
options: In a river, where it may stay for many years before going back to the sea to spawn.
In a mangrove swamp, where it feeds on crabs until it is ready to lay eggs.
In the open ocean, only entering rivers to find cooler water during summer.
In coral reefs, moving to rivers only during the rainy season to breed.
explanation: An eel may spend many years in the river before it returns to the sea to spawn.
fact_tl: Maaaring tumagal nang maraming taon ang igat sa ilog bago ito magbalik sa dagat para mangitlog.
fact_bis: Mahimong mogugol ug daghang tuig ang kasili sa suba ayha kini mobalik sa dagat aron mangitlog.

q: What does the word 'weather' describe?
options: What the air is like in a place right now, such as hot, rainy, cloudy, or windy.
The average temperature of a place recorded over many years.
The path that storms follow across the ocean each year.
The amount of sunlight a place receives during a whole season.
explanation: Weather is what the air is like in a place right now — for example, hot, rainy, cloudy, or windy.
fact_tl: Ang panahon ay kung ano ang lagay ng himpapawid sa isang lugar ngayon, gaya ng pagiging mainit, maulan, maulap, o mahangin.
fact_bis: Ang panahon mao ang kahimtang sa hangin sa usa ka lugar karon, sama sa init, ulanon, panganuron, o hanginon.

q: How are green or brown glass bottles made?
options: A small amount of metal or mineral like iron is added to the melted glass to give it color.
The glass is dipped in colored paint before it cools so the color sticks to the surface.
Different thicknesses of glass naturally produce different colors when light passes through.
The bottles are filled with colored water during manufacturing, which stains the glass.
explanation: Adding a little metal or mineral (such as iron) to soda-lime glass while it melts gives the glass its green or brown color.
fact_tl: Bakit may mga bote na berde o kayumanggi? Pwedeng dagdagan ang soda-lime glass ng kaunting metal o mineral habang tinutunaw para magkakulay ito. Halimbawa, ang bakal ay nagbibigay ng berde o kayumanggi sa bote.
fact_bis: Ngano naa'y botelya nga berde o kapehon? Mahimong dugangan ang soda-lime glass og gamay nga metal o mineral samtang gitunaw aron makulayan. Pananglitan, ang puthaw naghatag og berde o kapehon sa botelya.

q: Why do Filipinos rarely see water in all three states (liquid, vapor, ice) at the same time outdoors?
options: The Philippines is usually warm, so ice only forms in a freezer, not outdoors.
The Philippines has no rivers, so liquid water is rarely seen outside cities.
The humidity is too low for water vapor to form naturally in the open air.
Strong ocean winds quickly turn any liquid water into steam before ice can form.
explanation: In the warm Philippines, water outdoors is usually only liquid or vapor; ice (the solid form) needs a freezer.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas bihira nating makita ang tubig sa tatlong anyo nito sa labas — likido at singaw lang ang karaniwan, dahil para makita ang yelo (solid) ay kailangan natin ng freezer.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas talagsa ra nato makita ang tubig sa tulo ka porma niini sa gawas — likido ug alisngaw ra ang naandan, kay aron makita ang yelo (solid) kinahanglan nato og freezer.

q: Why is rice usually grown in flooded fields called paddies?
options: The rice plant likes very wet soil, so flooded fields give it the water it needs.
Flooding keeps the field free of all insects that would otherwise eat the seeds.
The water in paddies acts as a fertilizer that helps rice grow taller and faster.
Flooding hardens the soil so the heavy rice stalks do not fall over when ripe.
explanation: Rice is grown in flooded paddies because the plant likes very wet soil.
fact_tl: Karaniwang itinatanim ang palay sa palayan na binabahaan ng tubig kaya mahilig ito sa basang lupa.
fact_bis: Ang humay kasagarang gitanom sa humayan nga gibahaan ug tubig kay gusto kini sa basa kaayo nga yuta.

q: What is one purpose of the sharp spikes on a durian fruit?
options: They help keep some animals from eating the fruit before it is ripe.
They help the fruit break open on its own when it is ready to be eaten.
They anchor the heavy fruit firmly to the branch so it will not fall.
They store extra water that the fruit uses during dry weather.
explanation: The durian's spikes help keep some animals from eating the fruit easily while it is still unripe.
fact_tl: Ang mga tinik ng durian ay tumutulong na hindi ito basta-basta makain ng ilang hayop habang hilaw pa.
fact_bis: Ang mga tunok sa durian makatabang nga dili dali makaon sa pipila ka hayop samtang hilaw pa kini.

q: What do the small transformers on utility poles in Philippine neighborhoods do?
options: They step down voltage from 13,000 volts on the distribution line to 220 volts for homes.
They store electrical energy during the day and release it to homes at night.
They boost the voltage from 220 volts to 13,000 volts so power travels farther.
They convert alternating current (AC) from the grid into direct current (DC) for appliances.
explanation: The transformers on utility poles step down voltage from 13,000 volts on the distribution line to 220 volts that homes can safely use.
fact_tl: Ang mga maliit na transformer na nakikita sa mga haligi ng kuryente sa mga kapitbahayan ng Pilipinas ay nagpapababa ng boltahe — nagco-convert sila ng 13,000 volts mula sa distribution line patungong 220 volts para sa mga bahay.
fact_bis: Ang mga gagmay nga transformer nga makita sa mga haligi sa kuryente sa mga kapitbahayan sa Pilipinas nagpapababa sa boltahe — nagconvert sila sa 13,000 bolts gikan sa distribution line ngadto sa 220 bolts alang sa mga balay.

q: Why do we usually see only the top arch of a rainbow and not a full circle?
options: The ground blocks the lower half of the rainbow, so we only see the arch above the horizon.
Our eyes can only detect the wavelengths of light that form the upper half of the arc.
The lower half of a rainbow is made of infrared light that is invisible to humans.
Rainbows only form above the clouds, so the part below the clouds disappears.
explanation: A rainbow is actually a full circle, but the ground blocks the lower half, so we only see the top arch from the ground.
fact_tl: Ang bahaghari ay talagang isang buong bilog, ngunit nakikita lang natin ang ibabaw na arko nito dahil hinaharang ng lupa ang ibabang kalahati — mula sa eroplano, minsan kitang-kita ang buong singsing na bahaghari.
fact_bis: Ang balangaw sa tinuod usa ka tibuok lingin, apan kasagaran makita lang nato ang ibabaw nga arko niini kay ang yuta nagsanta sa ubos nga katunga — gikan sa eroplano, usahay makita ang tibuok singsing nga balangaw.

q: Besides harming nature, how do invasive species affect the lives of people?
options: They damage crops and fisheries, causing farmers and fishers to lose money.
They attract tourists, which raises the cost of living for local communities.
They compete with native animals but do not affect farms or fishing areas.
They make rivers flood more often, forcing families to move to higher ground.
explanation: Invasive species harm livelihoods by damaging crops and fisheries, causing farmers and fishers to lose money.
fact_tl: Ang invasive species ay hindi lang nakakasira ng kalikasan, kundi pati ng kabuhayan. Sinisira nila ang ani at pangisdaan, kaya nawawalan ng pera ang mga magsasaka at mangingisda.
fact_bis: Ang invasive species dili lang makadaot sa kinaiyahan, kondili usab sa panginabuhi. Modaot sila sa abot ug panagat, busa mawad-an og kwarta ang mga mag-uuma ug mananagat.

q: Compared to bees, what is the human eye better at?
options: Forming sharp, detailed images and seeing the color red that bees can barely see.
Detecting ultraviolet light that helps humans find flowers in low-light conditions.
Seeing in complete darkness by using a reflective layer behind the retina.
Spotting movement at very long distances the way eagles and hawks can.
explanation: The human eye forms sharper, more detailed images than a bee's eye and can see the color red, which bees barely detect.
fact_tl: Ang mata ng tao ay mas mahusay sa paggawa ng malinaw, detalyadong larawan at nakakakita ng pulang kulay na hindi gaanong nakikita ng bubuyog.
fact_bis: Ang mata sa tao mas maayo sa paghimo ug klaro, detalyado nga hulagway ug makakita sa pula nga halos dili makita sa putyukan.

q: Which units are commonly used to measure speed?
options: Kilometers per hour (km/h) or meters per second (m/s).
Kilograms per minute (kg/min) or grams per second (g/s).
Newton-meters per hour (N·m/h) or joules per second (J/s).
Liters per hour (L/h) or milliliters per minute (mL/min).
explanation: Speed is commonly measured in kilometers per hour (km/h) or meters per second (m/s).
fact_tl: Ang bilis ay madalas isulat sa kilometro kada oras (km/h) o metro kada segundo (m/s).
fact_bis: Ang katulin sagad isulat sa kilometro kada oras (km/h) o metro kada segundo (m/s).

q: How widespread is stunting among young children in the Philippines?
options: About one in four children under five years old is stunted, making it a major health problem.
Almost all children under five are stunted due to a lack of clean drinking water.
Stunting affects fewer than one in twenty children because school lunch programs are common.
Stunting only affects children in rural areas; city children are rarely at risk.
explanation: In the Philippines, about one in four children under five years old is stunted, making it a major national health problem.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, halos isa sa bawat apat na batang wala pang limang taong gulang ang may stunting, kaya isa itong malaking suliranin sa kalusugan.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, mga usa sa matag upat ka bata nga wala pa moabot og lima ka tuig ang adunay stunting, mao nga dako kini nga problema sa panglawas.

q: Why is iodine added to table salt in the Philippines?
options: Iodized salt helps the body and brain grow properly; without enough iodine a person can develop goiter and thinking problems.
Iodized salt makes food stay fresh longer because iodine kills harmful bacteria.
Iodized salt improves the flavor of food and reduces the need for other seasonings.
Iodized salt supplies extra calcium that strengthens bones and prevents rickets.
explanation: Iodine added to salt helps the body and brain grow properly; a lack of it can cause goiter and problems with thinking.
fact_tl: Ang yodo na idinadagdag sa asin (iodized salt) ay tumutulong sa tamang paglaki ng katawan at utak; ang kakulangan dito ay maaaring magdulot ng goiter at problema sa pag-iisip.
fact_bis: Ang yodo nga gidugang sa asin (iodized salt) motabang sa hustong pagtubo sa lawas ug utok; ang kakulang niini mahimong hinungdan sa goiter ug problema sa panghunahuna.

q: What can an owl do with its head that most birds cannot do as well?
options: It can turn its head far around to see what is behind it.
It can spin its head completely upside down to look at the ground below.
It can flatten its head sideways to fit into narrow tree hollows.
It can tuck its head under its wing while still flying at night.
explanation: An owl can turn its head very far around, allowing it to see what is behind it.
fact_tl: Maaaring iikot ng kuwago ang ulo nito nang malayo upang makita ang nasa likod niya.
fact_bis: Ang bukaw makahimo sa pagtuyok sa iyang ulo og layo aron makakita sa luyo niya.

q: How is an epiphyte different from a climbing vine?
options: A vine is rooted in the ground and climbs upward, while an epiphyte grows entirely on the tree with no roots in the soil.
A vine has no leaves and gets all its food from the tree it wraps around, while an epiphyte makes its own food.
An epiphyte kills the tree it grows on, while a vine only borrows the tree for support without harming it.
A vine and an epiphyte are the same thing — both have roots in the ground and grow up tree trunks.
explanation: A vine is rooted in the ground and creeps upward, while an epiphyte grows entirely on the tree with no roots in the soil.
fact_tl: Iba ang epiphyte sa baging na umaakyat sa puno. Ang baging ay nakaugat sa lupa at gumagapang pataas, samantalang ang epiphyte ay tumutubo nang buo sa puno na walang ugat sa lupa.
fact_bis: Lahi ang epiphyte sa balagon nga mosaka sa kahoy. Ang balagon nakagamot sa yuta ug mokatay paitaas, samtang ang epiphyte motubo nga tibuok sa kahoy nga walay gamot sa yuta.

q: How does rattan benefit many Filipino families living near forests?
options: Harvesting rattan and making furniture from it is an important source of income for those families.
Rattan roots purify groundwater, giving forest communities a safe supply of drinking water.
Families burn dried rattan as fuel, reducing their need to buy firewood or gas.
Rattan bark is used to make clothing that forest communities sell at local markets.
explanation: Harvesting rattan and making furniture from it is an important livelihood for many families who live near Philippine forests.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang pag-aani at paggawa ng muwebles mula sa uway ay mahalagang hanapbuhay para sa maraming pamilyang naninirahan malapit sa gubat.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang pag-ani ug paghimo og muwebles gikan sa uway usa ka importanteng panginabuhi alang sa daghang pamilya nga nagpuyo duol sa lasang.

q: What is Siquijor island in the Visayas known for?
options: Its mysterious reputation, traditional folk healing, beautiful beaches, and clear waters.
Its large active volcano and frequent earthquakes that attract scientists.
Being the largest island in the Visayas and the main hub for inter-island shipping.
Its centuries-old Spanish fort and the biggest coral reef in the Philippines.
explanation: Siquijor is a small Visayas island known for its mysterious reputation, traditional folk healing, beautiful beaches, and clear waters.
fact_tl: Ang Siquijor ay isang maliit na isla sa Visayas na kilala sa misteryosong reputasyon nito at tradisyonal na folk healing; ito ay may magagandang dalampasigan at malinaw na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang Siquijor usa ka gamay nga isla sa Visayas nga bantog sa iyang misteriyosong reputasyon ug tradisyonal nga folk healing; adunay usab matahum nga dalampasigan ug klaro nga tubig.

q: What is the correct order and relationship of foreshocks, the mainshock, and aftershocks?
options: Foreshocks come before the mainshock; aftershocks come after and are usually weaker, gradually dying down over time.
Foreshocks are the strongest quakes; the mainshock comes after and is always weaker.
Aftershocks always happen before the mainshock and are used to predict when the mainshock will occur.
Foreshocks, mainshock, and aftershocks all happen at the same time in different locations.
explanation: Foreshocks are smaller quakes before the mainshock; aftershocks come after and are usually lower in magnitude, gradually weakening over time.
fact_tl: Ang mainshock ay ang pangunahing lindol; ang mga foreshock ay mas maliliit na lindol bago ang mainshock (hindi palagi), at ang mga aftershock ay mga lindol pagkatapos; ang mga aftershock ay karaniwang mas mababa ang magnitude kaysa sa mainshock at unti-unting humina sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang mainshock mao ang panguna nga lindol; ang mga foreshock gagmay nga mga lindol sa wala pa ang mainshock (dili kanunay present), ug ang mga aftershock moabot human; ang mga aftershock kasagaran ubos og magnitude kaysa mainshock ug hinay-hinay mohinay sa paglabay sa oras.

q: What is the administrative capital of South Africa?
options: Pretoria
Cape Town
Johannesburg
Durban
explanation: The administrative capital of South Africa is Pretoria.
fact_tl: Ang administratibong kabisera ng South Africa ay Pretoria.
fact_bis: Ang administratibo nga kapital sa South Africa mao ang Pretoria.

q: Why do city workers clean canals and storm drains especially before the rainy season?
options: They remove mud and trash so water can flow well and floods can be avoided.
They add chemicals to the canals to kill bacteria before rainwater mixes in.
They widen the canals so fishing boats can use them during the wet months.
They line the canals with concrete to stop them from shifting during heavy rains.
explanation: City workers clean canals and storm drains before the rainy season to remove built-up mud and trash so water flows freely and floods are avoided.
fact_tl: May mga manggagawa sa lungsod na naglilinis ng kanal at imburnal lalo na bago dumating ang tag-ulan. Inaalis nila ang naipong putik at basura para makadaloy ulit nang maayos ang tubig at maiwasan ang baha.
fact_bis: Naay mga trabahante sa siyudad nga manglimpyo sa kanal ug imburnal ilabi na sa dili pa moabot ang tingulan. Ilang kuhaon ang natapok nga lapok ug basura aron makadagayday na usab ug maayo ang tubig ug malikayan ang baha.

q: Why must a dugong eat for many hours each day?
options: Seagrass gives only a little energy, so the dugong must eat for a long time to get enough food.
Dugongs digest food very slowly, so they need to keep eating to maintain body temperature.
Seagrass is available only during high tide, so dugongs must eat as much as possible in that short window.
Dugongs share their feeding ground with many other animals, so they must eat quickly and repeatedly.
explanation: Because seagrass provides only a little energy, the slow dugong must eat for many hours each day to get enough food.
fact_tl: Dahil kakaunti lang ang enerhiyang nakukuha sa damong-dagat, kailangan ng mabagal na dugong na kumain nang maraming oras bawat araw para mabusog.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gamay ra ang enerhiya gikan sa sagbot, ang hinay nga dugong kinahanglan mokaon og daghang oras matag adlaw aron mabusog.

q: How does OTEC (Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion) generate electricity?
options: It uses the temperature difference between warm surface ocean water and cold deep water to generate electricity.
It uses the up-and-down movement of ocean waves to spin underwater turbines.
It burns seaweed harvested from the ocean floor as a renewable fuel source.
It converts the salinity difference between river water and ocean water into electrical energy.
explanation: OTEC uses the temperature difference between warm surface water and cold deep ocean water to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Ang OTEC (Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion) ay gumagamit ng pagkakaiba ng temperatura sa pagitan ng mainit na tubig sa ibabaw ng dagat at malamig na tubig sa kalaliman para makagawa ng kuryente — ang mga tropical na karagatan ng Pilipinas ay may malaking potensyal para rito.
fact_bis: Ang OTEC (Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion) naggamit sa pagkalahi sa temperatura sa taliwala sa mainit nga tubig sa nawong sa dagat ug malamig nga tubig sa kalaliman aron makahimo ug kuryente — ang tropical nga dagat sa Pilipinas adunay dako nga potensyal alang niining teknolohiya.

q: Why does a bruise change color from red to blue, green, and then yellow over several days?
options: The body slowly breaks down and cleans up the blood that leaked under the skin, causing the color to change.
Skin pigment shifts in response to sunlight exposure, darkening and then fading after an injury.
The bruise fills with different fluids over time — first water, then lymph, then fat.
Bacteria under the skin digest the damaged tissue, producing different colored byproducts.
explanation: A bruise changes color because the body slowly breaks down and cleans up the blood that leaked under the skin.
fact_tl: Nagbabago ng kulay ang pasa — mula pula tungong asul, berde, at dilaw — dahil dahan-dahang sinisira at nililinis ng katawan ang dugong tumagas sa ilalim ng balat.
fact_bis: Mausab ang kolor sa pasa — gikan pula ngadto asul, lunhaw, ug dalag — kay hinay-hinay nga gibungkag ug gilimpyohan sa lawas ang dugo nga nibuhagay sa ilawom sa panit.

q: What happens if you stroke a steel needle in one direction with a magnet many times?
options: The needle itself becomes a magnet and can be used to make a simple compass.
The needle becomes so hot from friction that it melts the magnet's surface.
The needle loses all its iron atoms and becomes non-magnetic permanently.
The needle becomes attracted to plastic but repels metal objects afterward.
explanation: Stroking a steel needle in one direction with a magnet causes the needle to become a magnet, which can then be used to make a simple compass.
fact_tl: Kung kuskusin mo nang paisa-isang direksyon ang isang karayom gamit ang magnet, magiging magnet din ang karayom at puwedeng gawing compass.
fact_bis: Kon hilodon nimo sa usa ka direksyon ang usa ka dagom gamit ang magnet, mahimong magnet usab ang dagom ug pwede himuong compass.

q: Which animal is the ONLY mammal that can truly fly using wings?
options: The bat.
The flying squirrel.
The sugar glider.
The colugo (flying lemur).
explanation: The bat is the only mammal capable of true, powered flight using its wings.
fact_tl: Ang paniki ang tanging mammal na talagang nakakalipad gamit ang mga pakpak nito.
fact_bis: Ang kabog mao ra ang mammal nga makalupad gyud pinaagi sa iyang mga pako.

q: Why does a color change indicate that a new substance may have formed during a reaction?
options: A new substance has atoms arranged differently, so it reflects a different color than the original substance.
Color change happens because the reaction releases heat that permanently stains the material.
The original substance absorbs new atoms from the air, adding color molecules to the mixture.
Color change means the substance has dissolved; dissolved substances always look different in color.
explanation: When a new substance forms, its atoms are arranged differently, causing it to absorb and reflect light differently — producing a new color.
fact_tl: Bakit tanda ng reaksyon ang pagbabago ng kulay? Ang kulay ay nagmumula sa kung paano sumisipsip at sumasalamin ng liwanag ang isang sangkap. Kapag nabuo ang bagong sangkap, iba na ang ayos ng mga atomo nito, kaya iba na rin ang kulay na ipinapakita.
fact_bis: Ngano timailhan man sa reaksiyon ang pagbag-o sa kolor? Ang kolor naggikan sa kon unsaon pagsuyop ug pagbanaag sa kahayag sa usa ka substansiya. Kon maporma ang bag-ong substansiya, lahi na ang han-ay sa mga atomo niini, busa lahi na ang kolor nga ipakita.

q: Is mixing sand and water a physical change or a chemical change? Why?
options: It is a physical change because the sand and water can still be separated again.
It is a chemical change because water dissolves the sand and creates a new substance.
It is a chemical change because the mixture looks and feels different from either material alone.
It is a physical change only if you stir slowly; stirring fast makes it a chemical change.
explanation: Mixing sand and water is a physical change because the materials can still be separated and no new substance is formed.
fact_tl: Ang basta paghahalo ng mga bagay gaya ng buhangin at tubig ay kadalasang pisikal na pagbabago dahil maaari pa itong paghiwalayin muli.
fact_bis: Ang basta pagsagol sa mga butang sama sa balas ug tubig kasagaran pisikal nga kabag-ohan kay mahimo pa kining ibulag pag-usab.

q: Where does the energy released during radioactive decay come from?
options: A tiny bit of mass in the nucleus turns into energy, as described by Einstein's E=mc².
Radioactive atoms collect heat from the surrounding rock and release it all at once.
Electrons fall to lower energy levels and release the extra energy as radiation.
Chemical bonds inside the nucleus break apart and release the stored bond energy.
explanation: When a nucleus decays, a tiny bit of mass converts into energy, just as Einstein's E=mc² explains.
fact_tl: Saan nanggagaling ang lakas ng radioactive decay? Kapag nagde-decay ang nucleus, kakaunting mass (bigat) ang nagiging enerhiya. Ipinaliwanag ito ni Einstein sa kanyang sikat na E=mc², na nagsasabing kahit kaunting mass ay maaaring maging napakalaking enerhiya.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang gahum sa radioactive decay? Kung mo-decay ang nucleus, gamay nga mass (gibug-aton) mahimong enerhiya. Gipasabot kini ni Einstein sa iyang bantog nga E=mc², nga nag-ingon nga bisan gamay nga mass mahimong dako kaayo nga enerhiya.

q: What part of the corn plant is each kernel of binatog (boiled white corn)?
options: A seed that could sprout into a new corn plant.
A flower bud that the plant uses to attract pollinators.
A root tip that stores starch for the plant during dry season.
A leaf node that contains the corn plant's growing cells.
explanation: Each corn kernel is a seed; binatog is made of boiled white corn kernels topped with grated coconut.
fact_tl: Ang binatog ay nilagang butil ng puting mais na sinabawan ng gadgad na niyog, at ang bawat butil ay isang binhi na pwedeng tumubo at maging bagong halaman ng mais.
fact_bis: Ang binatog mao ang linat-an nga lugas sa puti nga mais nga sangkapan ug kinudkod nga lubi, ug ang matag lugas usa ka binhi nga mahimong motubo og bag-ong tanom sa mais.

q: What is the diaphragm's job in breathing?
options: It moves down to pull air into the lungs and up to push air out.
It filters bacteria from the air before it reaches the lungs.
It pumps blood to the lungs so oxygen can enter the bloodstream.
It produces mucus that coats the airways and traps dust particles.
explanation: The diaphragm is a large muscle below the lungs that moves down to pull air in and up to push air out.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng baga ay may malaking kalamnang tinatawag na diaphragm na bumababa para makapasok ang hangin sa baga at tumataas para mailabas ito.
fact_bis: Ubos sa baga adunay dakong kaunoran nga gitawag og diaphragm nga mokanaog aron mosulod ang hangin sa baga ug mosaka aron ipagawas kini.

q: How do wetlands help clean water?
options: Their plants and mud trap dirt before the water flows out.
They use sunlight to break down pollutants through a process like photosynthesis.
They evaporate dirty water into clouds, leaving the contaminants behind on the ground.
They release special acids that dissolve heavy metals dissolved in the water.
explanation: Wetlands clean water because their plants and mud trap dirt before the water flows out.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang mga wetland na linisin ang tubig dahil hinahalang ng mga halaman at putik ang dumi bago dumaloy ang tubig palabas.
fact_bis: Ang mga wetland makatabang sa paglimpyo sa tubig kay ang ilang mga tanom ug lapok mosalâ sa hugaw una mogawas ang tubig.

q: Why does your eye suddenly produce a lot of tears when dust gets in it?
options: Extra tears wash the dirt out of the eye, cleaning it like a quick splash of water.
More tears make the eye muscles stronger so they can push the dust out.
Tears signal the brain to close the eyelid permanently until the dust is gone.
The tears contain a chemical that dissolves the dust so it disappears on its own.
explanation: When dust or an eyelash enters the eye, extra tears are produced to wash the dirt out, working like a quick splash of water.
fact_tl: Kapag may alikabok o pilikmata na pumasok sa mata mo, bigla itong gumagawa ng maraming luha para tanggalin ang dumi. Parang malakas na pagbuhos ng tubig na naglilinis.
fact_bis: Kung adunay abog o pilok nga mosulod sa imong mata, kalit kini nga maghimo og daghang luha aron tangtangon ang hugaw. Murag kusog nga bunok sa tubig nga naglimpyo.

q: How does drinking enough water help your kidneys?
options: It helps the kidneys stay healthy and keep the blood clean.
It fills the kidneys with fluid so they can grow larger and filter faster.
It cools the kidneys down so they do not overheat during physical activity.
It supplies the kidneys with minerals they need to make digestive juices.
explanation: Drinking enough water helps the kidneys stay healthy and keep the blood clean.
fact_tl: Ang pag-inom ng sapat na tubig ay tumutulong sa mga bato na manatiling malusog at malinis ang dugo.
fact_bis: Ang pag-inom og igong tubig makatabang sa mga bato nga magpabiling himsog ug limpyo ang dugo.

q: How does water in soil move upward even when the surface looks dry?
options: Water rises through the tiny spaces between soil grains by capillary action, keeping the surface moist.
Gravity reverses near the soil surface, pulling water upward instead of downward.
Plant roots pump water up to the surface through the soil around them.
Heat from the sun boils water deep underground, and the steam rises to moisten the surface.
explanation: In soil, water rises from wetter parts upward through tiny spaces between soil grains by capillary action, keeping the surface moist.
fact_tl: Sa lupa, umaakyat ang tubig mula sa mas basang bahagi paitaas sa maliliit na puwang sa pagitan ng mga butil ng lupa. Kaya nananatiling basa ang ibabaw ng lupa kahit malalim ang tubig.
fact_bis: Sa yuta, mosaka ang tubig gikan sa mas basa nga bahin paibabaw pinaagi sa gagmay nga mga lungag sa taliwala sa mga lugas sa yuta. Mao nga magpabilin nga umog ang ibabaw bisan og lawom ang tubig.

q: Which gland produces growth hormone, and what does it help children do?
options: The pituitary gland produces growth hormone, which helps children grow taller by building up bones and muscles.
The thyroid gland produces growth hormone, which controls how fast the heart beats during exercise.
The adrenal gland produces growth hormone, which helps children react quickly to danger.
The pancreas produces growth hormone, which regulates blood sugar so children have steady energy.
explanation: The pituitary gland produces growth hormone, which helps children grow taller by building up their bones and muscles.
fact_tl: Ang growth hormone na galing sa pituitary gland ang tumutulong sa mga bata na lumaki at tumangkad sa pamamagitan ng paglago ng buto at kalamnan.
fact_bis: Ang growth hormone gikan sa pituitary gland maoy motabang sa mga bata nga motubo ug motaas pinaagi sa pagpalig-on sa bukog ug kaunoran.

q: At what soil pH range do most crops grow best?
options: pH 6 to 7
pH 3 to 4
pH 8 to 9
pH 1 to 2
explanation: Most crops grow best at a soil pH of 6 to 7; soil that is too acidic or too alkaline blocks the plant's ability to absorb minerals.
fact_tl: Ang pH ng lupa ay nakakaapekto kung anong sustansya ang maaaring masipsip ng halaman—ang karamihang pananim ay lumago nang pinakamabuti sa pH na 6 hanggang 7; ang masyadong acidic o alkaline na lupa ay nagpipigil sa pagsipsip ng mineral.
fact_bis: Ang pH sa yuta nakaapekto sa kung anong sustansya ang masuyop sa tanum; ang kadaghanan sa mga pananim motubo sa pinakamabuting pH 6 hangtod 7; ang sobrang acidic o alkaline nga yuta nagpugong sa pagsuyop sa mineral.

q: How many legs does an ant have?
options: Six legs
Four legs
Eight legs
Ten legs
explanation: An ant is an insect and, like all insects, it has six legs and three body parts: the head, thorax, and abdomen.
fact_tl: Ang langgam ay isang insekto: may anim na paa at tatlong bahagi ng katawan—ang ulo, dibdib (thorax), at tiyan (abdomen).
fact_bis: Ang hulmigas usa ka insekto: aduna kini unom ka tiil ug tulo ka bahin sa lawas—ang ulo, dughan (thorax), ug tiyan (abdomen).

q: Why can a carabao work on the farm for many years?
options: Because it has a long life
Because it eats very little food
Because it sleeps most of the day
Because it is very small and light
explanation: A carabao can work on the farm for many years because it naturally has a long lifespan.
fact_tl: Kaya ng kalabaw na magtrabaho sa bukid sa loob ng maraming taon dahil matagal itong nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Ang kabaw makahimo pagtrabaho sa uma sa daghang tuig kay dugay kini mabuhi.

q: What can happen when too many devices are plugged into one extension cord?
options: It can overheat and possibly start a fire
The devices all stop working permanently
The electricity in the house runs out
The extension cord melts into a liquid
explanation: Too many devices plugged into one extension cord cause too much current to flow, making it overheat and possibly start a fire.
fact_tl: Kapag sobra ang nakasaksak sa isang extension cord, dumadaloy ang labis na kuryente kaya ito uminit at maaaring magdulot ng sunog.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ang nakasaksak sa usa ka extension cord, sobra ang kuryente nga moagi maong moinit kini ug mahimong hinungdan sa sunog.

q: What are tears mainly made of?
options: Water and a little oil
Salt water and sugar
Pure salt with no water
Water and small proteins only
explanation: Tears are made of water and a little oil; the oil helps the eye stay wet longer.
fact_tl: Ang luha ay gawa sa tubig at kaunting langis na tumutulong para hindi mabilis matuyo ang mata.
fact_bis: Ang luha gama sa tubig ug gamay nga lana nga motabang aron dili dali momala ang mata.

q: How does a colugo use its limbs to glide from tree to tree?
options: It spreads all four limbs to stretch the skin between them so air pushes against it
It flaps its front two legs rapidly like wings
It tucks all limbs in tightly to cut through the air faster
It pushes off with its back legs and holds its front legs forward
explanation: By spreading all four limbs at the same time, the colugo stretches the skin between them, creating a larger surface that catches air and lets it glide slowly to the next tree.
fact_tl: Para makalipad-lipad, ibinubuka ng colugo ang apat nitong paa nang sabay-sabay. Lumalawak ang balat sa pagitan ng mga ito kaya mas maraming hangin ang humahawak sa kanya, at dahil dito ay dahan-dahan siyang bumababa habang patawid sa kabilang puno.
fact_bis: Aron molupad-lupad, ibukhad sa colugo ang upat niini ka tiil nga dungan. Molapad ang panit sa tunga niini busa mas daghan nga hangin ang mosagang kaniya, ug tungod niini hinay-hinay siyang monaog samtang motabok sa pikas kahoy.

q: In which type of germination do the cotyledons stay below the soil?
options: Hypogeal germination
Epigeal germination
Aerial germination
Lateral germination
explanation: In hypogeal germination (like corn), the cotyledons remain below the soil; in epigeal germination (like mung bean), they emerge above ground.
fact_tl: Sa epigeal germination, lumalabas ang cotyledon sa ibabaw ng lupa (tulad ng mungo); sa hypogeal germination, nananatili ang cotyledon sa ilalim ng lupa (tulad ng mais).
fact_bis: Sa epigeal germination, mogawas ang cotyledon sa ibabaw sa yuta (sama sa mongo); sa hypogeal germination, nagpabilin ang cotyledon sa ilalim sa yuta (sama sa mais).

q: What are the long white lines left behind by aircraft in the sky?
options: Contrails formed when hot engine exhaust cools and condenses
Clouds of fuel that was not burned
Smoke from the plane's engines catching fire
Trails of water sprayed to cool the engines
explanation: Contrails are white cloud lines made by aircraft; they form when hot engine exhaust cools and condenses in the cold air at high altitude.
fact_tl: Ang contrails ay puting linya ng ulap na ginagawa ng mga eroplano; nastong ang mainit na singaw ng engine ay lumamig at nagkakondensasyon sa malamig na hangin sa mataas na lugar.
fact_bis: Ang contrails puting linya sa panganod nga gihimo sa mga eroplano; naporma sa dihang ang init nga singaw sa engine mobugnaw ug magkondensasyon sa malamig nga hangin sa taas.

q: What causes coral bleaching?
options: The water gets too warm and the algae inside the coral leave
Strong ocean currents wash the coral's color away
Divers accidentally scrub the color off the coral
The coral produces too much calcium and turns white
explanation: When the water gets too warm, the tiny algae living inside the coral—which give it color and food—leave, turning the coral white in a process called coral bleaching.
fact_tl: Ang koral ay may maliliit na lumot (algae) na nakatira sa loob nito na gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw; ito rin ang nagbibigay ng kulay sa koral. Kapag sobrang init ng tubig, umaalis ang lumot at namumuti ang koral (coral bleaching).
fact_bis: Ang coral adunay gagmayng lumot (algae) nga nagpuyo sulod niini nga maghimo og pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw ug naghatag sa kolor sa coral. Kung mainit na kaayo ang tubig, mobiya ang lumot ug mamuti ang coral (coral bleaching).

q: Why does a tsunami wave stay low at the surface when it is in deep water?
options: Its energy spreads through the entire water column from surface to seafloor
The wave slows down and loses all its energy in deep water
Deep water absorbs the wave and turns it into heat
The wave splits into many tiny ripples in the deep ocean
explanation: In deep water, a tsunami's energy spreads through the entire column of water from surface to seafloor, keeping the surface wave low.
fact_tl: Sa malalim na dagat, kumakalat ang enerhiya ng tsunami sa buong taas ng tubig mula ibabaw hanggang ilalim, kaya hindi ito nagtataas nang husto sa ibabaw.
fact_bis: Sa lawom nga dagat, mikatag ang enerhiya sa tsunami sa tibuok kalalom sa tubig gikan sa ibabaw paingon sa ilawom, busa gamay ra ang gibukol niini sa ibabaw.

q: Why must the flu vaccine be updated every year?
options: Because the influenza virus changes rapidly into new strains
Because the human body destroys the old vaccine in exactly one year
Because the vaccine expires and becomes poisonous after twelve months
Because flu only attacks people who were not vaccinated the previous year
explanation: The influenza virus changes rapidly through antigenic shift, producing new strains each year that the previous vaccine cannot fully protect against.
fact_tl: Ang influenza virus ay mabilis na nagbabago (antigenic shift) — ito ang dahilan kung bakit ang bakuna laban sa trangkaso ay kailangang i-update taon-taon upang maprotektahan tayo sa mga bagong strain.
fact_bis: Ang influenza virus paspas nga nagbag-o pinaagi sa antigenic shift — mao kini ang hinungdan kung ngano ang bakuna batok trangkaso kinahanglang i-update matag tuig aron maprotektahan kita sa mga bag-ong strain.

q: Why do children look similar to their parents?
options: They inherit half their genes from the mother and half from the father
They copy their parents' habits while growing up
The food the parents ate shapes how the child looks
Children always look exactly like whichever parent is taller
explanation: Children resemble their parents because they inherit half of their genes from the mother and half from the father.
fact_tl: Kamukha ng mga anak ang kanilang magulang dahil minana nila ang kalahati ng kanilang mga gene mula sa ina at kalahati mula sa ama.
fact_bis: Nahisama ang mga anak sa ilang ginikanan kay napanunod nila ang katunga sa ilang mga gene gikan sa inahan ug katunga gikan sa amahan.

q: After dropping its tail to escape danger, what does a skink sometimes do with the dropped tail?
options: It comes back and eats it to recover the lost fat and energy
It leaves it behind forever and never returns
It buries it so enemies cannot find it
It gives it to its young as food
explanation: After the danger is gone, a skink sometimes returns to eat its own dropped tail to recover the fat and energy stored in it.
fact_tl: Minsan, pagkawala ng panganib, babalik ang skink at kakainin ang sarili niyang nahulog na buntot! Hindi ito kakaiba para sa kanila; ginagawa nila ito para mabawi ang taba at enerhiyang nawala. Sayang kasi ang naipong pagkain doon.
fact_bis: Usahay, human mawala ang katalagman, mobalik ang skink ug kaonon ang iyang kaugalingong nahulog nga ikog! Normal ra kini para nila; gibuhat nila kini aron mabawi ang tambok ug enerhiyang nawala. Sayang man ang natipig nga pagkaon didto.

q: How can children help protect the ocean from plastic pollution?
options: By using reusable bags and bottles and avoiding single-use plastic
By pouring used water back into the sea every week
By only swimming in the ocean and not on rivers
By buying more bottled water to keep beaches clean
explanation: Children can help protect the ocean by using reusable bags and bottles and avoiding single-use plastic that may end up in the sea.
fact_tl: Ang mga bata ay makakatulong sa pangangalaga ng karagatan sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng reusable na bag at bote at pag-iwas sa single-use na plastik na maaaring mapunta sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga bata makatabang sa panalipod sa dagat pinaagi sa paggamit sa reusable nga mga bag ug bote ug pag-iwas sa single-use nga plastik nga mahimong makaadto sa dagat.

q: In Filipino folklore, which creature is often believed to live in a balete tree?
options: The kapre
The tikbalang
The aswang
The manananggal
explanation: In Filipino folklore, the balete tree is often believed to be the home of spirits like the kapre.
fact_tl: Sa kuwentong-bayan ng Pilipinas, madalas pinaniniwalaang tirahan ng mga engkanto o kapre ang puno ng balete.
fact_bis: Sa sugilanon sa Pilipinas, ang kahoy nga balete kasagarang gituohan nga puy-anan sa mga engkanto o kapre.

q: Why do balloons filled with helium float up into the air?
options: Because helium is lighter than air
Because helium is very hot and rises like smoke
Because the balloon's rubber pushes it upward
Because helium contains tiny particles that push against gravity
explanation: Helium is lighter than air, so balloons filled with it float upward.
fact_tl: Ang helium ay mas magaan kaysa hangin, kaya lumulutang ang mga lobong puno nito.
fact_bis: Ang helium mas gaan kaysa hangin, mao nga molutaw ang mga balloon nga puno niini.

q: Which of the following is a main cause of diarrhea in Filipino children?
options: Drinking contaminated water
Eating too many fruits and vegetables
Getting too much sunlight during the day
Playing outdoors without wearing shoes
explanation: In the Philippines, the main causes of diarrhea in children include contaminated water, dirty food, and germs like rotavirus and E. coli.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga pangunahing sanhi ng pagtatae sa mga bata ay kontaminadong tubig, maruming pagkain, at mga virus tulad ng rotavirus at bacteria tulad ng E. coli.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga panguna nga hinungdan sa pagtatae sa mga bata naglakip sa kontaminadong tubig, hugaw nga pagkaon, ug mga mikrobyo sama sa rotavirus ug E. coli; ang paglikay naglakip sa limpyo nga tubig ug maayong hygiene.

q: What happens to time near the very strong gravity of a black hole, according to Einstein's ideas?
options: Time appears to run slower near a black hole than far away from it
Time runs faster near a black hole than anywhere else
Time stops completely the moment you reach a black hole
Time runs at exactly the same speed everywhere in space
explanation: According to Einstein's ideas, the very strong gravity near a black hole makes time appear to run slower compared with time far away.
fact_tl: Ayon sa mga ideya ni Einstein, malapit sa napakalakas na grabidad ng black hole, ang oras ay tila bumabagal kung ikukumpara sa oras na malayo dito, kaya magkaiba ang takbo ng orasan sa magkaibang lugar.
fact_bis: Sumala sa mga ideya ni Einstein, duol sa kusog kaayong grabidad sa black hole, ang oras morag mohinay kon itandi sa oras nga layo niini, mao nga lahi ang dagan sa relo sa lainlaing dapit.

q: How do most coal and gas power plants generate electricity?
options: They burn fuel to boil water into steam that spins a turbine
They use giant fans to blow air over spinning magnets
They collect heat from the sun and convert it directly to electricity
They pump water uphill and let it fall to turn generators
explanation: Many power plants burn coal or gas to boil water into steam, and that steam spins a turbine to generate electricity.
fact_tl: Maraming power plant ang nagsusunog ng uling o gas para pakuluan ang tubig at gumawa ng singaw na umiikot sa turbina.
fact_bis: Daghang power plant ang nagsunog og uling o gas aron pabukalon ang tubig ngadto sa alisngaw nga magtuyok sa turbina.

q: Why has the number of tabon birds gone down in some places?
options: People often collect their eggs from the mounds
The birds cannot survive warm beach temperatures
Larger birds steal the chicks from the nests
The tabon only lays one egg in its entire life
explanation: People often collect tabon eggs from the mounds, which has lowered the bird's numbers in some places.
fact_tl: Madalas kolektahin ng mga tao ang mga itlog ng tabon mula sa bunton, kaya bumababa ang bilang nito sa ilang lugar.
fact_bis: Kanunay kuhaon sa mga tao ang mga itlog sa tabon gikan sa tambak, busa miubos ang ihap niini sa ubang dapit.

q: What does the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons do in the Philippines?
options: It establishes rights for persons with disabilities in education, employment, and public services
It sets a minimum daily wage that all employers must pay disabled workers only
It requires all public buildings to be built by persons with disabilities
It creates a special police force to protect disabled persons in cities
explanation: The Magna Carta for Disabled Persons is a Philippine law that establishes rights for persons with disabilities in education, employment, and public services.
fact_tl: Ang Magna Carta for Disabled Persons ay isang batas ng Pilipinas na nagtatakda ng mga karapatan ng mga may kapansanan sa edukasyon, trabaho, at pampublikong serbisyo.
fact_bis: Ang Magna Carta for Disabled Persons usa ka batas sa Pilipinas nga nagtakda sa mga katungod sa mga adunay kapansanan sa edukasyon, trabaho, ug pampublikong serbisyo.

q: What does it mean when an animal is called endemic to the Philippines?
options: It is found only in the Philippines and nowhere else on Earth
It is an endangered animal that was once common worldwide
It is a species that migrated to the Philippines from other countries
It is a newly discovered animal that has not yet been named
explanation: Endemic means the species is found only in the Philippines and nowhere else on Earth.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop at halaman sa Pilipinas ang "endemic," ibig sabihin matatagpuan lamang sila rito at wala saanmang lugar sa mundo.
fact_bis: Daghang hayop ug tanom sa Pilipinas ang "endemic," buot ipasabot makit-an lamang sila dinhi ug wala sa bisan asang dapit sa kalibutan.

q: How many wings do most adult insects have in total?
options: Four wings (two pairs)
Two wings (one pair)
Six wings (three pairs)
Eight wings (four pairs)
explanation: Most adult insects have two pairs of wings, which means four wings in total.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng adultong insekto ay may dalawang pares ng pakpak, ibig sabihin apat (4) na pakpak lahat.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa hamtong nga insekto adunay duha ka pares sa pako, nga nagpasabot og upat (4) ka pako tanan.

q: What allows some sloths to turn their heads almost all the way around?
options: They have extra neck bones
Their neck muscles are extremely strong
Their backbone is much longer than other animals
Their head is attached loosely with no bones at all
explanation: Some sloths have extra neck bones, which lets them turn their heads almost all the way around without moving the rest of their body.
fact_tl: May mga dagdag na buto sa leeg ang ilang sloth, kaya kaya nilang ilingon ang ulo nang halos pabalikod nang hindi gumagalaw ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang ubang sloth adunay dugang nga bukog sa liog, mao nga makalingi sila sa ulo halos paatbang nga dili molihok ang lawas.

q: Where does the malaria parasite (Plasmodium) complete an important part of its life cycle?
options: Inside the Anopheles mosquito
Inside the red blood cells of a river fish
In stagnant water where mosquito eggs hatch
On the surface of the human skin
explanation: The Plasmodium parasite completes an important part of its life cycle inside the Anopheles mosquito, and sporozoites are injected into humans when the mosquito bites.
fact_tl: Ang Plasmodium na sanhi ng malaria ay dumadaan sa mahalagang bahagi ng buhay nito sa loob ng katawan ng Anopheles lamok—ang mga sporozoites ay inililipat sa tao sa oras ng kagat.
fact_bis: Ang Plasmodium nga sanhi sa malaria nagkompleto sa importanteng bahin sa iyang kinabuhi sa sulod sa Anopheles lamok—ang mga sporozoite giitsa ngadto sa tawo sa oras sa kagat.

q: Why can't you smell or taste a single atom by itself?
options: Because a single atom is far too tiny — you need billions of atoms together to smell or feel anything
Because atoms are always moving too fast to notice
Because atoms only exist inside solid objects, not in the air
Because your nose and tongue can only detect things that are colorful
explanation: A single atom is so tiny that it cannot be held, smelled, or tasted alone; what you smell or feel is caused by billions of atoms working together.
fact_tl: Dahil napakaliit ng atomo, hindi mo ito kayang hawakan, amuyin, o lasahin nang isa-isa. Ang naaamoy o nararamdaman mo ay dahil sa bilyun-bilyong atomo na magkakasama.
fact_bis: Tungod kay gamay kaayo ang atomo, dili nimo kini magunitan, mapanimahoan, o matilawan nga usa ra. Ang imong mapanimahoan o mabati tungod sa binilyon ka atomo nga nagkahiusa.

q: During a storm surge, which areas near the sea flood first?
options: Low-lying areas near the sea
High coastal cliffs and rocky shores
Areas that are more than 10 kilometers inland
Hillside communities near river sources
explanation: Low-lying areas near the sea are the first to flood during a storm surge because the surge pushes water onto the lowest land first.
fact_tl: Ang mga mababang lugar na malapit sa dagat ang unang binabaha tuwing may storm surge.
fact_bis: Ang mga ubos nga dapit nga duol sa dagat mao ang unang mabahaan kon adunay storm surge.

q: Who is Bernoulli's principle named after?
options: Daniel Bernoulli, a Swiss mathematician and physicist
Isaac Newton, a British physicist
Albert Einstein, a German-born physicist
Galileo Galilei, an Italian scientist
explanation: Bernoulli's principle is named after Daniel Bernoulli, a Swiss mathematician and physicist.
fact_tl: Ang Prinsipyo ni Bernoulli ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Bernoulli, isang Suwisong matematiko at pisiko.
fact_bis: Ang Prinsipyo ni Bernoulli ginganlan kay Daniel Bernoulli, usa ka Suwiso nga matematiko ug pisiko.

q: Which scientist gave the gas oxygen its name?
options: Antoine Lavoisier
Joseph Priestley
Isaac Newton
Marie Curie
explanation: Antoine Lavoisier named the gas oxygen, even though it was also discovered by Joseph Priestley.
fact_tl: Si Antoine Lavoisier ang nagbigay ng pangalang oxygen (oksiheno) sa gas na natuklasan din ni Joseph Priestley.
fact_bis: Si Antoine Lavoisier mao ang naghatag sa ngalang oxygen (oksiheno) sa gas nga nadiskobrehan usab ni Joseph Priestley.

q: Why do a cat's eyes glow in the dark?
options: A mirror-like layer at the back of the eye bounces light back out
The cat produces its own light inside its eyes at night
Special colored pigment in the iris glows when it is dark
The pupil opens so wide that it looks like it is glowing
explanation: A cat's eye has a mirror-like layer called the tapetum at the back that bounces light back, which is why its eyes glow in the dark.
fact_tl: May parang salamin sa likod ng mata ng pusa na nag-aaninag ng liwanag pabalik, kaya kumikinang ang mga mata nito sa dilim.
fact_bis: Adunay sama sa salamin sa luyo sa mata sa iring nga mobalik sa kahayag, mao nga mosiga ang mata niini sa kangitngit.

q: What actually happens when you water a bougainvillea plant too much?
options: It grows more leaves but produces fewer colorful bracts
It produces twice as many colorful flowers as usual
Its roots rot and the plant dies within one week
It grows taller but the stem becomes very thin
explanation: Too much water makes a bougainvillea grow more leaves but fewer colorful bracts; it needs some heat and dryness to bloom a lot.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba, mas marami kang madidiligan, mas marami ang bulaklak. Mali ito sa bougainvillea! Kapag sobra ang tubig, mas maraming dahon pero kaunti ang makukulay na bracts. Kailangan nito ng kaunting init at tuyo para mamulaklak nang marami.
fact_bis: Ang uban naghunahuna nga mas daghan nimo bisbisan, mas daghan ang bulak. Sayop kini sa bougainvillea! Kung sobra ang tubig, mas daghan og dahon apan gamay ra ang kolorado nga bracts. Kinahanglan niini og gamay nga init ug pagkauga aron mamukad og daghan.

q: What tiny material are the fibers in paper made of?
options: Cellulose from wood and plants
Plastic threads from recycled bottles
Sand and clay pressed into thin sheets
Metal particles mixed with water
explanation: Paper is made of tiny cellulose fibers that come from wood and plants.
fact_tl: Ang papel ay binubuo ng maliliit na hibla ng selulosa na galing sa kahoy at halaman.
fact_bis: Ang papel hinimo gikan sa gagmay nga mga hibla sa selulosa nga gikan sa kahoy ug tanom.

q: Why is a crab NOT classified as a fish even though it lives in water?
options: A crab has no inner bones and its hard shell is on the outside, while a fish has a backbone and fins
A crab breathes air but a fish breathes only water
A crab has four legs while a fish has two fins used like legs
A crab lays eggs on land but a fish always lays eggs in water
