Beyond the frost line, the Sun's gravity is weaker so planets drift farther apart and collect more space dust without colliding.
Beyond the frost line, there is no wind from the Sun to blow material away, so planets can hold onto more gas.
Beyond the frost line, there is more iron and rock available because the inner planets used up all the lighter materials.
explanation: The frost line is where temperatures are cold enough for volatile compounds to stay as solid ice; this extra solid material allowed planets beyond it to grow much larger and become gas giants.
fact_tl: Ang frost line (o ice line) ng solar system ay ang distansya mula sa Araw kung saan ang temperatura ay malamig na sapat para mananatiling solidong yelo ang mga volatile compounds tulad ng tubig, ammonia, at methane; sa labas ng frost line, ang mga dagdag na solid material ang nagpapahintulot ng paglaki ng mas malalaking planeta na naging mga gas giant.
fact_bis: Ang frost line (o ice line) sa solar system mao ang distansya gikan sa Adlaw nga lapas niini ang mga temperatura bugnaw na igo para ang mga volatile compound sama sa tubig, ammonia, ug methane magpabilin isip solid nga yelo; lapas sa kining linya, ang dugang solid material nagpahinungod sa mga planeta nga motubo og mas dako, nahimong mga gas giant.

q: What is deposition in science?
options: When a gas changes directly into a solid without becoming a liquid first, like frost forming.
When a liquid changes directly into a gas without becoming a solid first, like boiling.
When a solid changes directly into a gas without becoming a liquid first, like dry ice.
When a gas changes into a liquid first and then slowly becomes a solid.
explanation: Deposition is the change from a gas directly into a solid without becoming a liquid first, like frost forming.
fact_tl: Ang deposition ay ang pagbabago ng gas nang direkta tungo sa solido nang hindi muna nagiging likido, gaya ng pagbuo ng frost.
fact_bis: Ang deposition mao ang pagbag-o gikan sa gas diretso ngadto sa solido nga dili una mahimong likido, sama sa pagporma sa frost.

q: Why is cassava dangerous to eat raw?
options: It contains a compound that turns into hydrogen cyanide when the plant cells are broken, but thorough cooking removes this toxin.
Its skin is covered in tiny crystals that cause painful rashes and stomach cramps when touched or eaten.
Raw cassava has very high levels of sugar that ferment quickly in the stomach and cause food poisoning.
Its starch absorbs water in the stomach so quickly that it can block the digestive system.
explanation: Cassava contains linamarin that converts to hydrogen cyanide when cells are broken, but thorough cooking removes this toxic compound.
fact_tl: Ang kamoteng kahoy ay naglalaman ng linamarin—isang compound na nagiging hydrogen cyanide kapag nasira ang selula—na nagsisilbing panlaban sa mga hayop; ang maayos na pagluluto ay nagtatanggal ng nakakalason na ito.
fact_bis: Ang kamoteng kahoy adunay linamarin—usa ka compound nga nahimong hydrogen cyanide kung masira ang selula—nagsilbi ingong depensa batok sa mga hayop; ang maayos nga pagluto nagkuha niining nakakalason.

q: How does the temperature of the weather affect how crickets chirp?
options: Crickets chirp faster when the weather is warmer.
Crickets chirp louder when the weather is warmer.
Crickets chirp only at night no matter what the temperature is.
Crickets stop chirping completely when the weather gets too warm.
explanation: Crickets chirp faster when the weather is warmer.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis humuni ang kuliglig kapag mas mainit ang panahon.
fact_bis: Mas paspas mohuni ang kuliglig kon mas init ang panahon.

q: What is the main staple food of Filipinos?
options: Cooked rice, eaten at almost every meal.
Bread, baked fresh every morning in most Filipino homes.
Corn, grown in almost every region of the country.
Noodles, served as a main dish at breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
explanation: Rice is the main staple food of Filipinos, usually eaten as cooked rice at almost every meal.
fact_tl: Ang bigas ang pangunahing pagkain ng mga Pilipino, at madalas itong kinakain bilang kanin sa tuwing kakain.
fact_bis: Ang bugas mao ang nag-unang pagkaon sa mga Pilipino, ug kasagaran kaonon isip kan-on sa matag pagkaon.

q: Which layer of the skin holds blood vessels, nerves, and sweat glands?
options: The dermis — the layer beneath the outer skin (epidermis).
The epidermis — the outermost layer of the skin you can see.
The subcutaneous layer — the deepest layer made mostly of fat.
The cuticle — the thin edge of skin around your fingernails.
explanation: The dermis is the layer beneath the epidermis that holds blood vessels, nerves, and sweat glands.
fact_tl: Ang dermis ang patong sa ilalim ng epidermis na naglalaman ng mga ugat ng dugo, nerbiyo, at glandula ng pawis.
fact_bis: Ang dermis mao ang sapaw sa ilawom sa epidermis nga naglangkob sa mga ugat sa dugo, nerbiyo, ug glandula sa singot.

q: What role do decomposers play in the nutrient cycle of nature?
options: They break dead plants and animals back down into nutrients that return to the soil for new plants to use.
They convert sunlight into food energy that other living things can eat.
They carry nutrients from the roots of plants up to the leaves and flowers.
They protect the soil from rain so nutrients are not washed away into rivers.
explanation: Decomposers break dead organisms back down into the soil, completing the continuous recycling loop in nature.
fact_tl: May tuloy-tuloy na siklo sa kalikasan: kumukuha ang halaman ng sustansya sa lupa, kinakain sila ng hayop, namamatay sila, at nilalansag sila ng mga decomposers pabalik sa lupa. Pagkatapos ay nagsisimula muli ang siklo.
fact_bis: Adunay padayon nga siklo sa kinaiyahan: mokuha ang tanom og sustansya sa yuta, kan-on sila sa hayop, mamatay sila, ug gub-on sila sa mga decomposers balik sa yuta. Unya magsugod na usab ang siklo.

q: How have sloths inspired scientists to build better robots?
options: Scientists study how sloths grip and save energy to design slow but energy-efficient robots that can climb in hard-to-reach places.
Scientists copy how sloths hang upside down to build robots that work on ceilings in factories.
Scientists study the sloth's thick fur to make robots that can survive in very cold environments.
Scientists copy the sloth's sharp claws to design robots that can grip slippery surfaces underwater.
explanation: Scientists study how sloths grip and save energy to design slow but energy-efficient robots that can climb in hard-to-reach places.
fact_tl: Pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko kung paano nakakapit at nakakatipid ng enerhiya ang sloth. Mula dito, gumagawa sila ng mga robot na mabagal pero matipid sa kuryente, gaya ng mga umaakyat sa mga lugar na mahirap puntahan.
fact_bis: Gitun-an sa mga siyentista kung giunsa pagkapyot ug pagtipig ug enerhiya sa sloth. Gikan niini, naghimo silag mga robot nga hinay apan tipid sa kuryente, sama sa mga mosaka sa mga lugar nga lisod adtoan.

q: What is the main difference between hard coral and soft coral?
options: Hard coral polyps build a stone skeleton that forms the reef, while soft coral polyps build no hard skeleton and sway in the current.
Hard coral lives only in shallow warm water, while soft coral lives only in cold deep water.
Hard coral is brightly colored to attract fish, while soft coral is clear and nearly invisible.
Hard coral grows very quickly, while soft coral grows so slowly it never changes size.
explanation: Hard coral polyps build a hard stone skeleton that forms the reef, while soft coral polyps make no hard skeleton and sway like a plant in the current.
fact_tl: May dalawang uri ng coral: ang 'hard coral' na ang mga polyp ay gumagawa ng matigas na bato at siyang nagtatayo ng bahura, at ang 'soft coral' na ang mga polyp ay walang matigas na kalansay kaya umuugoy ito na parang halaman sa agos ng tubig.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka matang sa coral: ang 'hard coral' kansang mga polyp maghimo og gahi nga bato ug maoy magtukod sa bahura, ug ang 'soft coral' kansang mga polyp walay gahi nga kalansay busa nagatabyog kini sama sa tanom diha sa sulog sa tubig.

q: What makes Triton unusual compared to other large moons?
options: Triton is the only large moon that orbits its planet backwards (retrograde).
Triton is the only large moon that has a thick atmosphere like Earth.
Triton is the only large moon that is perfectly round like a sphere.
Triton is the only large moon that is made entirely of solid ice with no rock inside.
explanation: Triton is the only large moon that orbits its planet backwards (retrograde).
fact_tl: Ang Triton ang tanging malaking buwan na umiikot nang pabaligtad (paatras) sa paligid ng planeta nito.
fact_bis: Ang Triton mao lang ang dakong bulan nga mulibot nga pabalik (retrograde) sa palibot sa iyang planeta.

q: Why is it important to drink enough water every day?
options: Your body needs water to make saliva, sweat, and other fluids.
Water helps your bones grow longer and stronger.
Drinking water makes your heart beat faster during exercise.
Water is needed to produce red blood cells.
explanation: Your body uses the water you drink to produce fluids like saliva and sweat.
fact_tl: Kailangan mong uminom ng sapat na tubig upang makagawa ang katawan ng laway, pawis, at iba pang likido.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan ka moinom og igo nga tubig aron makahimo ang imong lawas og laway, singot, ug uban pang likido.

q: How does a cricket make its chirping sound at night?
options: By tapping its legs on the ground rapidly.
By vibrating a special membrane on its abdomen.
By rubbing its wings together.
By clicking its mouthparts together.
explanation: Crickets are nocturnal insects that produce their chirping sound by rubbing their wings together.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig ay isang nokturnal na insekto na lumilikha ng huni sa gabi sa pamamagitan ng pagkiskis ng mga pakpak nito.
fact_bis: Ang kagiw usa ka nokturnal nga insekto nga mohimo og huni sa gabii pinaagi sa pagkiskis sa iyang mga pako.

q: When farmers harvest rice, which part of the plant do they cut?
options: The entire plant including the roots.
Only the upper stalk that holds the grains.
The leaves and stems near the ground.
Just the roots, leaving the grains to dry on the stalk.
explanation: Farmers cut only the upper stalk holding the grains, leaving the stubble (lower stalk and roots) in the ground.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba ay binubunot pati ugat ang palay tuwing ani, pero ang totoo, pinuputol lang ang itaas na bahagi ng tangkay na may mga butil at iniiwan ang pinagputulan.
fact_bis: Naghunahuna ang uban nga ibton ang humay apil ang gamot kon mag-ani, apan ang tinuod, putlon lang ang ibabaw nga bahin sa uhay nga adunay lugas ug ibilin ang tuod.

q: What do we see when there is absolutely no light anywhere?
options: White, because our eyes adjust and see brightness.
Gray, because our pupils open fully.
Black, because black is the absence of light.
Dark blue, because the sky color remains.
explanation: When there is no light at all, we see black — black is simply the absence of light.

q: Why do factories add a base to acidic wastewater before releasing it into a river?
options: To make the water smell better and attract fish.
To neutralize the acid so it is safe for the environment.
To increase the water temperature for aquatic life.
To remove the color so the water looks cleaner.
explanation: Adding a base neutralizes the acid in factory wastewater, making it safe before it enters rivers.
fact_tl: Maraming pabrika ang gumagamit ng asido sa kanilang proseso, at hindi pwedeng basta itapon ang asidong tubig sa ilog dahil makakapatay ito ng isda. Kaya bago ipakawala, nilalagyan nila ito ng base para i-neutralize ang asido at gawing ligtas para sa kapaligiran. Ginagamit ng industriya ang neutralization para protektahan ang ilog.
fact_bis: Daghan nga pabrika ang mogamit og asido sa ilang proseso, ug dili pwede nga basta ilabay ang asido nga tubig sa suba kay makapatay kini og isda. Busa una buhian, butangan nila kini og base aron i-neutralize ang asido ug himuong luwas para sa kalikopan. Gigamit sa industriya ang neutralization aron panalipdan ang mga suba.

q: How does the ocean help keep Earth's climate steady?
options: It reflects sunlight back into space to cool the planet.
It stores a large amount of heat and releases it slowly.
It produces clouds that block the sun during summer.
It absorbs greenhouse gases and converts them to water.
explanation: The ocean stores enormous amounts of heat and releases it slowly, which helps keep Earth's climate steady.
fact_tl: Ang karagatan ay nag-iimbak ng napakalaking dami ng init at dahan-dahan itong inilalabas, kaya pinapanatili nitong matatag ang klima ng Mundo.
fact_bis: Ang kadagatan naghupot og hilabihan kadako nga kainit ug hinay-hinay kining gibuhian, mao nga gipalig-on niini ang klima sa Kalibutan.

q: What happens to modeling clay when you squash it with your hand?
options: It becomes heavier because you added energy.
Its shape changes because a force was applied to it.
It gets harder because the particles are pushed closer.
It turns into a different material because of the pressure.
explanation: A force can change the shape of an object, just like squashing modeling clay changes its shape.
fact_tl: Ang puwersa ay maaari ring magbago ng hugis ng isang bagay, gaya ng pagpisil sa laruang luwad.
fact_bis: Ang puwersa makausab usab sa porma sa usa ka butang, sama sa pagpislit sa clay.

q: What can cause unusually cold weather in the Philippines during the amihan season?
options: A tropical cyclone forming in the Pacific Ocean.
Very cold air blowing in from northern China.
An increase in rainfall from the southwest monsoon.
The Earth moving farther from the Sun during winter.
explanation: In some years, very cold air from northern China reaches the Philippines during amihan, causing a cold snap.
fact_tl: Sa ilang taon, ang napakalalamig na hangin mula sa hilagang Tsina ay maaaring makarating sa Pilipinas sa panahon ng amihan at nagdudulot ng hindi karaniwan na malamig na panahon (cold snap).
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka tuig, ang lapig-init nga hangin gikan sa amihanang Tsina mahimong moabut sa Pilipinas sa panahon sa amihan, nagdala og dili kasagaran nga mabugnaw nga panahon (cold snap).

q: Why is the larva of a lacewing sometimes called the 'aphid lion'?
options: Because it has a mane-like covering on its head like a lion.
Because it is the largest insect larva in the garden.
Because it eats aphids so eagerly and in large numbers.
Because it makes a roaring sound to scare other insects.
explanation: The lacewing larva earned the nickname 'aphid lion' because it eats aphids so eagerly.
fact_tl: Ang larva ng lacewing ay matakaw na kumakain ng aphids kaya tinatawag itong 'aphid lion.'
fact_bis: Ang ulod sa lacewing maibog nga mokaon og aphids mao nga gitawag kining 'aphid lion.'

q: How does a future ant queen get the sperm she needs to lay eggs for the rest of her life?
options: She receives sperm from worker ants inside the colony every season.
She mates with male ants in the air during a nuptial flight and stores all the sperm.
She lays unfertilized eggs that hatch on their own without sperm.
She collects sperm from flowers just like bees collect pollen.
explanation: Before becoming queen, a young winged ant mates with males during a nuptial flight and stores all the sperm she needs for life.
fact_tl: Bago maging reyna, lumilipad ang isang batang langgam na may pakpak para makipagtalik sa mga lalaking langgam sa hangin. Pagkatapos nito, iniipon niya ang lahat ng natanggap na sperm at gagamitin niya ito habambuhay para mangitlog.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa siya mahimong reyna, ang batan-ong hulmigas nga adunay pako molupad ug makigminyo sa mga lalaki nga hulmigas sa hangin. Tipigan niya ang tanang sperm ug gamiton kini sa tibuok niyang kinabuhi aron mangitlog.

q: Which specific cells in the pancreas actually produce insulin?
options: Alpha cells scattered throughout the pancreas tissue.
Beta cells found inside tiny clusters called the islets of Langerhans.
Duct cells lining the pancreatic tubes.
Acinar cells that fill most of the pancreas.
explanation: Beta cells, located inside tiny clusters called the islets of Langerhans, are the cells that actually make insulin.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng pancreas ang gumagawa ng insulin. May maliliit na grupo ng mga selula na tinatawag na 'islets of Langerhans', at ang 'beta cells' doon ang talagang gumagawa ng insulin.
fact_bis: Dili tanang bahin sa pancreas ang naghimo og insulin. Adunay gagmay nga pundok sa mga selula nga gitawag og 'islets of Langerhans', ug ang 'beta cells' didto ang naghimo gyud sa insulin.

q: What happens when you drop vinegar (an acid) on a piece of limestone?
options: The limestone slowly dissolves without any visible reaction.
The limestone turns a different color due to a chemical change.
The limestone fizzes and releases a gas.
The limestone hardens because the acid fills its pores.
explanation: Limestone fizzes when acid is dropped on it because it contains calcium carbonate, which releases gas in the reaction.
fact_tl: Bumubula ang limestone kapag nilagyan ng asido tulad ng suka, dahil naglalabas ito ng gas mula sa calcium carbonate.
fact_bis: Mobula ang limestone kung butangan og asido sama sa suka, kay mogawas ang gas gikan sa calcium carbonate.

q: What does the areca palm (the tree that gives the betel nut) look like?
options: It is a short, bushy tree with wide spreading branches.
It is tall with a slender trunk, like a thin coconut tree.
It is a low-growing palm with large fan-shaped leaves.
It has a thick, rough trunk covered in large spines.
explanation: The areca palm is tall with a slender trunk, resembling a thin coconut tree.
fact_tl: Ang areca palm na pinanggagalingan ng bunga ay matangkad at manipis ang puno, na parang payat na niyog.
fact_bis: Ang areca palm nga gigikanan sa bunga taas ug nipis ang punoan, sama sa nipis nga lubi.

q: Even though durian has a spiky shell, what type of food is it really?
options: A vegetable, because it grows on the ground level.
A nut, because of its hard outer covering.
A fruit, because it has flesh, seeds, and comes from a flower.
A grain, because it grows in large clusters on the tree.
explanation: Durian is a fruit — it is sweet, has flesh and seeds inside, and grows from the tree's flower, just like other fruits.
fact_tl: Dahil sa matinik nitong balat, may nag-aakalang gulay o ibang uri ng pagkain ang durian, pero ito ay tunay na prutas. Ito ay matamis, may laman at buto sa loob, at galing sa bulaklak ng puno, tulad ng ibang prutas.
fact_bis: Tungod sa tunokon niini nga panit, naa'y naghunahuna nga utanon o laing matang sa pagkaon ang durian, apan prutas gyud kini. Tam-is kini, adunay unod ug liso sa sulod, ug gikan sa bulak sa kahoy, sama sa ubang prutas.

q: How does a dugong eat seagrass if it does not have sharp teeth?
options: It uses a long tongue to wrap around and pull seagrass.
It uses thick, strong lips to grip and pull up the seagrass.
It sucks in water and filters out seagrass with gill rakers.
It swallows seagrass whole without chewing by opening its jaws wide.
explanation: A dugong uses its thick, strong lips to grip and pull up seagrass from the seafloor.
fact_tl: Hindi gumagamit ng matatalim na ngipin ang dugong para kumain; ginagamit nito ang makakapal at malalakas na labi upang sabnutin at hilahin ang damong-dagat.
fact_bis: Wala mogamit og hait nga ngipon ang dugong aron mokaon; gigamit niini ang baga ug kusgang mga ngabil aron kuptan ug bira-on ang sagbot sa dagat.

q: How can a snake swallow prey that is bigger than its own head?
options: It chews its food into small pieces using rows of teeth.
Its jaws can stretch and open very wide to fit large prey.
It dissolves its prey with strong acids before swallowing.
It removes the bones of its prey before swallowing the soft parts.
explanation: A snake's jaws can stretch and open very wide, allowing it to swallow prey bigger than its own head.
fact_tl: Nababanat at naibubuka nang napakalapad ang panga ng ahas, kaya kaya nitong lamunin ang biktimang mas malaki pa sa ulo nito.
fact_bis: Ang apapangig sa bitin makabanat ug makabuka og lapad kaayo, mao nga matulon niini ang biktima nga mas dako pa sa iyang ulo.

q: Under which Philippine president was the 1987 Constitution adopted?
options: Ferdinand Marcos
Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo
Corazon Aquino
Fidel Ramos
explanation: The 1987 Constitution was adopted under President Corazon Aquino.
fact_tl: Pinagtibay ang 1987 Saligang Batas sa panahon ni Pangulong Corazon Aquino.
fact_bis: Ang 1987 nga Konstitusyon gisagop sa panahon ni Presidente Corazon Aquino.

q: What kind of energy does a hand-crank generator convert muscle power into?
options: Chemical energy stored in a battery inside the device.
Heat energy released by friction in the spinning parts.
Electrical energy that can light an LED.
Sound energy produced by the spinning coil.
explanation: A hand-crank generator converts mechanical (muscle) energy into electrical energy by rotating a magnet inside a coil of wire.
fact_tl: Ang hand-crank generator ay gumagamit ng lakas ng kamay para paikutin ang magneto sa loob ng coil ng kawad — ito ay nagco-convert ng mechanical na enerhiya mula sa muscle patungong kuryente na maaaring magpaliwanag ng LED.
fact_bis: Ang hand-crank generator naggamit sa lakas sa kamay aron palikuton ang magneto sulod sa coil sa kawad — nagconvert kini sa mechanical nga enerhiya gikan sa mga kalamnan ngadto sa kuryente nga makapaliwanag sa LED.

q: Why might your tongue tingle or feel sore after eating pineapple?
options: Because pineapple is very acidic and burns the tongue's surface.
Because pineapple contains bromelain, an enzyme that breaks down protein.
Because the rough texture of pineapple scratches the tongue.
Because pineapple releases a mild toxin that irritates taste buds.
explanation: Pineapple contains bromelain, an enzyme that breaks down protein, which is why your tongue may tingle when eating it.
fact_tl: Ang pinya ay may bromelain, isang ensima na sumisira sa protina, kaya minsan nangangati ang dila kapag kumakain nito.
fact_bis: Ang pinya adunay bromelain, usa ka enzyme nga nagbungkag sa protina, mao nga usahay mokatol ang dila kung mokaon niini.

q: Why does a stick placed partly in water look bent even though it is straight?
options: Water magnifies the lower part of the stick, making it appear shifted.
Light refracts (changes direction) as it passes from water into air.
The water pressure bends the light rays in a curved path.
The reflection off the water surface creates a mirror image below.
explanation: A stick partly in water looks bent because light refracts, or changes direction, as it passes from water into air.
fact_tl: Ang patpat na nakababad sa tubig ay parang baluktot tingnan dahil yumuyuko o nababaluktot ang liwanag pagdaan mula sa tubig papunta sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang sungkod nga gibutang sa tubig morag baliko tan-awon tungod kay ang kahayag mobawog o mausab og direksyon samtang moagi gikan sa tubig paingon sa hangin.

q: According to collision theory, when does a chemical reaction actually happen between particles?
options: When particles are in the same container regardless of how they move.
When particles are heated to any temperature above room temperature.
When particles collide with enough energy and the correct orientation.
When particles are mixed with water to help them bond together.
explanation: Collision theory states that a reaction occurs when particles collide with enough energy and in the correct orientation.
fact_tl: Ayon sa collision theory, nangyayari ang reaksyon kapag ang mga partikulo ay nagbabanggaan nang may sapat na enerhiya at tamang oryentasyon.
fact_bis: Sumala sa collision theory, mahitabo ang reaksiyon kon ang mga partikulo magbinangga nga adunay igong enerhiya ug husto nga oryentasyon.

q: In remote Philippine provinces with no grid electricity, why are batteries paired with solar panels?
options: Batteries boost the solar panels' output during cloudy weather.
Batteries store solar energy during the day so it can be used at night.
Batteries protect the solar panels from overheating in the sun.
Batteries convert the direct current from solar panels into alternating current.
explanation: In off-grid areas, batteries store the solar energy collected during the day so homes can use it at night.
fact_tl: Sa mga probinsyang malalayo sa kuryente sa Pilipinas, ang mga solar panel ay ginagamit kasama ng mga baterya — ang baterya ay nag-iimbak ng solar na enerhiya sa araw para magamit sa gabi.
fact_bis: Sa mga malayong probinsya sa Pilipinas nga wala'y kuryente sa grid, ang mga solar panel gigamit uban sa mga baterya — ang baterya nagatipig sa solar nga enerhiya sa adlaw aron magamit sa gabii.

q: Where did the carbon stored in coal, oil, and natural gas originally come from?
options: Carbon was always underground and was never part of the atmosphere.
It came from ancient plants and animals buried millions of years ago.
It formed from minerals in the ocean floor reacting with seawater.
It came from meteorites that struck Earth billions of years ago.
explanation: Fossil fuels formed from ancient plants and animals buried millions of years ago; they hold carbon that was once in the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang fossil fuels gaya ng uling, langis, at natural gas ay nabuo mula sa mga sinaunang halaman at hayop na nalibing milyong taon na ang nakalipas. Naka-imbak sa kanila ang carbon na dating galing sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang fossil fuels sama sa uling, lana, ug natural gas naporma gikan sa karaang mga tanom ug hayop nga gilubong milyon ka tuig na ang milabay. Anaa kanila ang carbon nga kanhi gikan sa hangin.

q: What is the modern scale scientists use to measure earthquake magnitude, and why is it better than the older Richter scale?
options: The Mercalli scale, because it measures shaking felt by people more accurately.
The Moment Magnitude scale (Mw), because it is more accurate for large earthquakes.
The Seismic Intensity scale, because it uses GPS data from satellites.
The Richter scale was improved and renamed the Decibel scale for earthquakes.
explanation: The Moment Magnitude scale (Mw) replaced the Richter scale and is more accurate, especially for large earthquakes.
fact_tl: Ang modernong sukatan ng magnitude ng lindol ay ang moment magnitude scale (Mw), na pumalit sa lumang Richter scale; ito ay kinakalkula mula sa sukat ng fault area, dami ng paggalaw (slip), at lakas ng bato; ito ay mas tumpak para sa malalaking lindol.
fact_bis: Ang modernong sukatan sa magnitude sa lindol mao ang moment magnitude scale (Mw), nga nagpuli sa mas daan nga Richter scale; kini kinakalkula gikan sa gidak-on sa fault area, dami sa slip, ug gahi sa bato; kini mas tumpak alang sa dagkong mga lindol.

q: What can a crab do if a predator grabs it by the claw?
options: It pinches the predator until it lets go.
It squirts ink to confuse the predator and then runs.
It lets the claw drop off so it can escape, and later grows a new one.
It plays dead until the predator loses interest.
explanation: A crab can drop its own claw to escape a predator, and the claw slowly grows back after the next molt.
fact_tl: Kapag nahuli ang sipit ng alimango ng kaaway, kaya nitong basta bitawan o iwanan ang sipit na iyon para makatakas! Hindi ito nasasaktan nang husto, at sa susunod na pagpapalit ng balat, unti-unting tumutubo ang bagong sipit.
fact_bis: Kung madakpan sa kaaway ang sipit sa alimango, mahimong basta buhian o biyaan sa alimango kana nga sipit aron makaikyas! Dili kini grabe masakitan, ug sa sunod nga pag-ilis sa panit, hinay-hinay nga motubo ang bag-ong sipit.

q: Why do deserts get very cold at night even though they are extremely hot during the day?
options: Desert sand releases its heat instantly when the sun sets.
The dry desert air cannot hold the heat it gained during the day.
Strong winds blow all the warm air away from the desert at sunset.
The desert surface reflects heat back into space very efficiently.
explanation: Deserts lose heat quickly at night because the dry air cannot hold the heat that built up during the day.
fact_tl: Lumalamig ang disyerto sa gabi dahil ang tuyong hangin ay hindi nakakapagtago ng init na nakuha nito sa araw.
fact_bis: Mubugnaw ang desyerto sa gabii kay ang uga nga hangin dili makahupot sa init nga nakuha niini panahon sa adlaw.

q: How much more energy is released when an earthquake's magnitude increases by one whole number?
options: About 2 times more energy.
About 10 times more energy.
About 32 times more energy.
About 100 times more energy.
explanation: Each whole-number step up in earthquake magnitude releases about 32 times more energy.
fact_tl: Ang bawat dagdag na isang numero sa magnitude ay naglalabas ng humigit-kumulang 32 beses na mas maraming enerhiya mula sa lindol.
fact_bis: Ang matag dugang nga usa ka numero sa magnitude nagpagawas ug mga 32 ka pilo nga mas daghang enerhiya gikan sa linog.

q: Which nutrient gives the most energy per gram — more than double that of carbohydrates or protein?
options: Vitamins
Carbohydrates
Protein
Fats
explanation: Fats give the most energy per gram, more than double the energy provided by carbohydrates or protein.
fact_tl: Ang taba ang nagbibigay ng pinakamaraming enerhiya kada gramo, mahigit doble ng karbohaydrat o protina.
fact_bis: Ang tambok maoy naghatag sa pinakadaghang kusog kada gramo, kapin sa doble sa karbohaydrat o protina.

q: In which direction do big storms like typhoons spin in the Philippines (Northern Hemisphere)?
options: Clockwise, because of the rotation of Earth.
Counterclockwise, because of the Coriolis effect.
In a straight line, because typhoons travel with the trade winds.
They spin randomly depending on where the storm forms.
explanation: In the Northern Hemisphere, including the Philippines, big storms spin counterclockwise due to the Coriolis effect.
fact_tl: Sa hilagang hemispero, gaya ng Pilipinas, umiikot ang malalakas na bagyo nang pakaliwa o counterclockwise dahil sa Coriolis effect.
fact_bis: Sa amihanang hemispero, sama sa Pilipinas, ang dagkong bagyo motuyok pakaliwa o counterclockwise tungod sa Coriolis effect.

q: What is the deepest part of the sea near the Philippines, reaching about 10,540 meters?
options: The Mariana Trench
The Mindanao Sea Basin
The Philippine Trench at the Galathea Depth
The Sulu Sea Trench
explanation: The Philippine Trench is the deepest part of the sea near the Philippines, reaching about 10,540 meters at the Galathea Depth.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench ang pinakamalalim na bahagi ng dagat malapit sa Pilipinas, na umaabot sa halos 10,540 metro ang lalim sa Galathea Depth.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench mao ang labing lawom nga bahin sa dagat duol sa Pilipinas, nga moabot mga 10,540 ka metro ang giladmon sa Galathea Depth.

q: According to Pinggang Pinoy, how should you divide a healthy meal plate?
options: Half protein, a quarter rice, a quarter vegetables.
Half rice or bread, a quarter vegetables, and a quarter protein.
One-third each of rice, vegetables, and protein.
All protein with a small side of rice and no vegetables.
explanation: Pinggang Pinoy shows the ideal plate with half filled by rice or bread, a quarter by vegetables, and a quarter by protein.
fact_tl: Ang Pinggang Pinoy ay ang gabay ng FNRI sa tamang pagkain para sa mga Pilipino; ipinapakita nito na dapat na kalahati ng plato ay bigas/tinapay, isang kapat ay gulay, at isang kapat ay protina.
fact_bis: Ang Pinggang Pinoy mao ang FNRI nga gabay sa maayong pagkaon alang sa mga Pilipino; nagpakita kini sa tamang platito nga pagkaon nga ang katunga puno sa kanon o tinapay, ang usa ka pang-upat ug gulay, ug usa ka pang-upat ug protina.

q: Why might a room sometimes feel colder than the temperature you set on the air conditioner?
options: The thermostat sensor is broken and reads the wrong temperature.
After the compressor turns off, leftover cold in the unit keeps blowing and slightly overshoots the target.
Cold outside air leaks in through the wall around the air conditioner unit.
The set temperature only controls the fan speed, not the actual cooling.
explanation: Even after the compressor turns off, leftover cold air in the unit keeps blowing, causing the room to slightly overshoot the target temperature.
fact_tl: Tanong ng marami: bakit minsan mas malamig pa sa itinakdang 24°C ang naramdaman? Kadalasan, kahit pumatay na ang compressor, may natitira pang lamig sa makina na patuloy na umiihip kaya bahagyang lumalampas sa target. Pansamantala lang ito at babalik din sa tamang init.
fact_bis: Daghan ang mangutana: ngano usahay mas bugnaw pa kaysa sa gi-set nga 24°C ang gibati? Kasagaran, bisan napalong na ang compressor, naa pay nahabilin nga bugnaw sa makina nga padayon nga mobuga, mao nga gamay nga molapas sa target. Temporaryo ra kini ug mobalik sa husto nga init.

q: What do gold and iron have in common that makes them special in chemistry?
options: They are both mixtures of two or more metals combined together.
They are both pure elements, made of only one type of atom.
They are both compounds found in the same type of ore.
They both dissolve easily in water to form useful solutions.
explanation: Gold and iron are both pure elements, meaning they are each made of only one type of atom.
fact_tl: Ang mga pamilyar na bagay gaya ng ginto at bakal ay talagang mga purong elemento.
fact_bis: Ang mga pamilyar nga butang sama sa bulawan ug puthaw mga lunsay gyud nga mga elemento.

q: Why can a virus only be seen with an electron microscope and not an ordinary microscope?
options: Viruses are transparent and cannot absorb the dyes used in ordinary microscopes.
Viruses are even smaller than bacteria, making them too tiny for an ordinary microscope.
Viruses move too fast under an ordinary microscope to be focused on.
Viruses only appear at night when exposed to ultraviolet light.
explanation: A virus is extremely tiny — even smaller than a bacterium — so it can only be seen with an electron microscope.
fact_tl: Ang virus ay napakaliit, mas maliit pa kaysa bakterya, kaya hindi ito makikita sa karaniwang mikroskopyo kundi sa electron microscope lamang.
fact_bis: Ang virus gamay kaayo, mas gamay pa kaysa bakterya, mao nga makita lang kini gamit ang electron microscope, dili sa ordinaryong mikroskopyo.

q: In which direction does energy flow along a food chain?
options: In both directions — plants absorb energy from animals when they die.
Energy cycles around in a loop among all the organisms.
Only one direction — from plants to the animals that eat them.
From the top predator down to the plants at the bottom.
explanation: Energy flows in only one direction along a food chain, moving from plants to the animals that eat them.
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya ay dumadaloy sa isang direksyon lamang sa kadena ng pagkain, mula halaman patungo sa mga hayop na kumakain sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya nagaagos sa usa lang ka direksyon sa kadena sa pagkaon, gikan sa tanom paingon sa mga hayop nga mokaon kanila.

q: Why should golden apple snails (kuhol) always be cooked well before eating?
options: Because their shells are toxic and may contaminate the meat if not boiled long enough.
Because they can carry tiny parasites that are only killed by thorough cooking.
Because raw snails taste very bitter due to chemicals they store in their bodies.
Because their soft flesh hardens and becomes safe to eat only when fully cooked.
explanation: The golden apple snail can carry tiny parasites, so it must be cooked thoroughly before eating.
fact_tl: Maaaring may dalang maliliit na parasito ang golden kuhol, kaya dapat itong lutuing mabuti bago kainin.
fact_bis: Mahimong may dala nga gagmay nga parasito ang golden kuhol, mao nga kinahanglan kini lutoon og maayo una kan-on.

q: What special ability do some trained pigeons have?
options: They can mimic human speech just like parrots.
They can find their way back home even from far away.
They can fly faster than any other bird in the city.
They can change the color of their feathers to blend in with buildings.
explanation: Some trained pigeons have the remarkable ability to find their way back home even when released far away.
fact_tl: Ang kalapati ay isang ibong palagiang nakikita sa mga lungsod, at ang ilang sanay na kalapati ay kayang makahanap ng daan pabalik sa kanilang tahanan kahit malayo.
fact_bis: Ang salampati usa ka langgam nga kanunay makita sa mga siyudad, ug ang pipila ka bansay nga salampati makahimo og pangita sa dalan pabalik sa ilang puluy-anan bisan layo.

q: A scientist sees a red layer of rock in a cliff. What does the red color most likely tell her about that layer?
options: The layer has a lot of carbon from old plant material.
The layer is made mostly of limestone formed in ancient seas.
The layer likely contains rusted iron minerals.
The layer was formed very recently from volcanic ash.
explanation: A red rock layer often indicates the presence of rusted iron minerals inside it.
fact_tl: Bakit magkakaiba ang kulay ng mga patong ng bato? Ang kulay ay nagmumula sa mga mineral na nasa loob nito. Ang pulang patong ay kadalasang may bakal na kinalawang, ang itim ay madalas may carbon mula sa lumang halaman, at ang puti ay kadalasang batong-apog. Kaya ang bawat kulay ay nagbibigay ng palatandaan kung ano ang laman ng patong.
fact_bis: Ngano nga lain-lain ang kolor sa mga patong sa bato? Ang kolor gikan sa mga mineral nga naa sulod niini. Ang pula nga patong kasagaran adunay puthaw nga gikalawang, ang itom kasagaran adunay carbon gikan sa karaang tanom, ug ang puti kasagaran limestone. Busa ang matag kolor naghatag og timailhan kung unsa ang sulod sa patong.

q: How do fossils help scientists understand evolution?
options: Fossils preserve the DNA of ancient creatures so scientists can clone them.
Comparing fossils from different time periods shows how living things changed over time.
Fossils reveal the exact temperature and climate of prehistoric periods.
Fossils show which animals were alive at the same time and competed for food.
explanation: By comparing fossils from different time periods, scientists can see how kinds of living things changed over very long stretches of time.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng fossil mula sa iba't ibang panahon, nakikita ng mga siyentista kung paano nagbago ang mga uri ng buhay sa napakahabang panahon.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pagtandi sa fossil gikan sa lain-laing panahon, makita sa mga siyentista kon giunsa pagkausab sa mga matang sa kinabuhi sa taas nga panahon.

q: What can happen to a very massive star (more than about 20 times the Sun's mass) after it explodes as a supernova?
options: It shrinks into a neutron star about the size of a city.
It becomes a white dwarf and slowly cools over billions of years.
It collapses into a black hole with gravity so strong even light cannot escape.
It breaks apart completely and its material drifts away as a nebula.
explanation: Very massive stars can collapse into a black hole after a supernova; a black hole's gravity is so strong that not even light can escape.
fact_tl: Ang napakalalaking mga bituin (higit sa 20 beses na mass ng Araw) ay maaaring maging black hole pagkatapos ng supernova; ang black hole ay may grabidad na napakalakas na kahit ang ilaw ay hindi makatakas dito, at ang hangganan nito ay tinatawag na event horizon.
fact_bis: Ang kaayo ka dagko nga mga bituin (labaw sa mga 20 ka beses sa mass sa Adlaw) mahimong mahulog ngadto sa black hole pagkahuman sa supernova; ang black hole adunay gravity nga kaayo ka kusog nga bisan ang suga dili makalikyas niini, ug ang iyang utlanan ginganlan og event horizon.

q: When you push against a wall, what does Newton's third law say the wall does?
options: The wall absorbs the force and converts it into heat.
The wall pushes back on you with an equal and opposite force.
The wall does nothing because it is not moving.
The wall transmits your force through its structure to the ground.
explanation: Forces always come in pairs — when you push on the wall, it pushes back on you with the same force in the opposite direction.
fact_tl: Ang mga puwersa ay laging dumarating nang pares: kapag may isang bagay na nagtutulak sa iba, ang ibang bagay ay nagtutulak din pabalik.
fact_bis: Ang mga kusog kanunay nga magpares: kung adunay usa ka butang nga moduso sa lain, ang laing butang moduso usab pabalik.

q: What is the scientific term for a warm-blooded animal?
options: Ectotherm
Heterotherm
Endotherm
Poikilotherm
explanation: In science, a warm-blooded animal is called an endotherm, while a cold-blooded animal is called an ectotherm.
fact_tl: Sa agham, tinatawag na endotherm ang hayop na mainit ang dugo at ectotherm ang malamig ang dugo.
fact_bis: Sa siyensiya, ang hayop nga init ug dugo gitawag nga endotherm ug ang bugnaw ug dugo gitawag nga ectotherm.

q: How does a carabao mainly deal with heat, and what are its big horns actually used for?
options: The horns help it cool down by fanning air, while it drinks extra water to stay hydrated.
It cools down by wallowing in mud and water, and uses its horns for defense.
The horns release excess body heat like radiators, and mud is used only for skin protection.
It sweats through its horns to cool down, and wallowing is just for fun.
explanation: A carabao cools itself by wallowing in mud and water; its big horns are used for defense, not for cooling.
fact_tl: Hindi nakakatulong ang malalaking sungay ng kalabaw para palamigin ito; pananggalang o pandepensa ang gamit nito. Ang paglublob sa putik at tubig pa rin ang pangunahing paraan ng kalabaw para harapin ang init.
fact_bis: Ang dagkong sungay sa kalabaw dili makatabang sa pagpabugnaw niini; gigamit kini alang sa depensa. Ang paglunang sa lapok ug tubig gihapon ang nag-unang paagi sa kalabaw aron atubangon ang kainit.

q: Where is the West Valley Fault located?
options: It runs along the coast of Leyte and Samar islands.
It passes through the Bicol region near Mayon Volcano.
It runs near and through Metro Manila.
It is found under Laguna de Bay far from any major city.
explanation: The West Valley Fault is an active fault that runs near and through Metro Manila.
fact_tl: Ang West Valley Fault ay isang aktibong fault na dumadaan malapit at sa loob ng Metro Manila.
fact_bis: Ang West Valley Fault usa ka aktibo nga fault nga moagi duol ug sulod sa Metro Manila.

q: What is a neuron, and what is its role in the body?
options: A neuron is a type of white blood cell that fights infection in the nervous system.
A neuron is a nerve cell that is the basic unit of the nervous system.
A neuron is a muscle fiber that connects the brain to the muscles.
A neuron is a protective cell that forms a sheath around the brain.
explanation: A neuron is a nerve cell and the basic unit of the nervous system.
fact_tl: Ang neuron ay ang selula ng nerbiyos na siyang pangunahing yunit ng sistemang nerbiyos.
fact_bis: Ang neuron mao ang selula sa nerbiyos nga maoy sukaranang yunit sa sistema sa nerbiyos.

q: On the Celsius scale, at what temperature does water boil?
explanation: On the Celsius scale, water freezes at 0°C and boils at 100°C.
fact_tl: Sa Celsius scale, nagyeyelo ang tubig sa 0°C at kumukulo ito sa 100°C.
fact_bis: Sa Celsius scale, ang tubig moyelo sa 0°C ug mobukal sa 100°C.

q: You stir sugar into water until you cannot see it anymore. What happened to the sugar's mass?
options: The mass was lost because the sugar broke down into water molecules.
The mass stays in the water — dissolved sugar is not destroyed.
The mass decreased because some sugar evaporated with the water vapor.
The mass doubled because the sugar absorbed water as it dissolved.
explanation: Even after sugar dissolves and disappears from view, its amount and weight stay in the water — it is not destroyed.
fact_tl: Kahit natunaw na ang asukal, hindi ito nawawala — nananatili ang dami at bigat nito sa tubig.
fact_bis: Bisan pag natunaw na ang asukal, wala kini mawala — ang gidaghanon ug gibug-aton niini nagpabilin sa tubig.

q: Why must a virus use a living cell to survive and reproduce?
options: Because viruses need the warmth inside cells to stay active.
Because viruses have no parts for eating, growing, or making their own energy.
Because viruses are too large to survive on their own outside a cell.
Because viruses need the liquid inside cells to prevent drying out.
explanation: A virus has no structures for eating, growing, or making its own energy, so it must invade another living cell to reproduce.
fact_tl: Walang mga bahagi ang virus para kumain, lumaki, o makagawa ng sariling enerhiya, kaya kailangan nito ang selula ng iba.
fact_bis: Ang bayrus walay mga bahin aron mokaon, motubo, o makahimo sa kaugalingong kusog, mao nga kinahanglan niini ang selula sa lain.

q: What determines whether ocean tides are very strong (spring tides) or weak (neap tides)?
options: The season of the year and how warm the ocean water is.
The combined gravity of both the Moon and Sun, depending on how they line up.
The speed of the Earth's rotation, which changes slightly each month.
The depth of the ocean floor, which either amplifies or reduces the tidal force.
explanation: The tides are caused by the combined gravity of the Moon and Sun — when they line up the tides are strong (spring) and when they are at right angles they are weak (neap).
fact_tl: Ang tides na nararamdaman natin ay pinagsamang epekto ng gravity ng buwan at ng Araw — kung paano sila magkahanay ang nagtatakda kung magiging malakas (spring) o mahina (neap) ang tides.
fact_bis: Ang tides nga atong makita mao ang gidugtong nga epekto sa gravity sa bulan ug sa Adlaw — kung giunsa sila pagsa-ad ang magbuot kung kusog (spring) o huyang (neap) ang tides.

q: How did early scientists learn about atoms even though they could not see them?
options: By looking at atoms under powerful microscopes
By doing experiments and watching how materials behave
By reading ancient books written by Greek philosophers
By measuring the weight of different gases on a scale
explanation: Early scientists proved atoms are real by doing experiments and observing how materials behave, not by seeing atoms directly.
fact_tl: Hindi nakita ng mga unang siyentipiko ang atomo, pero nalaman nila ang tungkol dito sa pamamagitan ng mga eksperimento at pagmamasid kung paano kumikilos ang mga bagay. Sa ebidensya, napatunayan nilang totoo ang atomo.
fact_bis: Wala makita sa unang mga siyentipiko ang atomo, apan nahibaloan nila kini pinaagi sa mga eksperimento ug pagtan-aw kung giunsa pagkilos sa mga butang. Pinaagi sa ebidensya, napamatud-an nila nga tinuod ang atomo.

q: Which gland in the neck controls how fast your body uses energy and makes heat?
options: The pancreas
The thyroid gland
The adrenal gland
The pituitary gland
explanation: The thyroid gland, found in the neck, controls metabolism — how fast the body uses energy and produces heat.
fact_tl: Ang thyroid gland sa leeg ang nagkokontrol ng metabolism—kung gaano kabilis gumamit ng enerhiya at gumawa ng init ang katawan.
fact_bis: Ang thyroid gland sa liog maoy nagdumala sa metabolism—kung unsa ka paspas mogamit og enerhiya ug mohimo og kainit ang lawas.

q: Why is a volcanic ash layer useful for telling the age of rock layers around it?
options: Because ash is always black, making it easy to spot between other layers
Because ash falls all at once, making it the same age everywhere it lands
Because ash contains crystals that glow under ultraviolet light
Because ash layers are always the thickest layer in a rock sequence
explanation: Because volcanic ash falls all at once over a wide area, every part of that ash layer is the same age, making it an excellent time marker in rock sequences.
fact_tl: Kapag pumutok ang isang bulkan, kumakalat ang abo nito sa malawak na lugar at nagiging isang manipis na patong. Dahil sabay-sabay itong bumagsak, magkasing-edad ang patong ng abo kahit saan ito mapunta. Kaya nagiging mahusay na marka ito ng panahon. Halimbawa, ang pagputok ng Bulkang Pinatubo noong 1991 ay nag-iwan ng patong ng abo sa malaking bahagi ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Kung mobuto ang usa ka bulkan, mokatag ang abo niini sa lapad nga dapit ug mahimong nipis nga patong. Tungod kay dungan kining nahulog, parehas og edad ang patong sa abo bisan asa kini moabot. Busa mahimo kining maayong timailhan sa panahon. Pananglitan, ang pagbuto sa Bulkang Pinatubo niadtong 1991 nagbilin og patong sa abo sa dakong bahin sa Pilipinas.

q: What do we call people who raise bees in special boxes in order to harvest honey?
options: Farmers
Zookeepers
Beekeepers
Gardeners
explanation: People called beekeepers raise bees in special boxes so they can harvest the honey the bees produce.
fact_tl: May mga taong nag-aalaga ng bubuyog sa mga espesyal na kahon upang makaani ng pulot.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tawo nga gitawag og beekeeper nga mag-atiman og putyukan sa espesyal nga mga kahon aron makaani og dugos.

q: What causes the pale band of light we sometimes see stretching across a dark night sky?
options: Reflected sunlight bouncing off the Moon's surface
Clouds lit up by city lights below them
The glow of millions of stars in the Milky Way
A trail of dust left behind by passing comets
explanation: The pale band across the night sky is the combined glow of millions of stars that make up the Milky Way galaxy.
fact_tl: Ang maputlang guhit na nakikita sa madilim na kalangitan sa gabi ay ang liwanag ng milyon-milyong bituin sa Milky Way.
fact_bis: Ang luspad nga guhit sa kahayag nga makita sa ngitngit nga langit sa gabii mao ang silaw sa minilyon ka bitoon sa Milky Way.

q: What does the gut-brain axis describe in the human body?
options: The path food takes from the mouth down to the stomach
The way the brain sends signals to the muscles during exercise
The communication between the gut and the brain, where gut bacteria can affect mood
The network of blood vessels that carry nutrients from the intestines to the brain
explanation: The gut-brain axis is the communication link between the gut and brain; gut bacteria can influence mood and mental health by producing chemicals like serotonin.
fact_tl: Ang gut-brain axis ay ang komunikasyon sa pagitan ng bituka at utak — ang mga bacteria sa bituka ay kayang mag-impluwensya sa ating mood at mental health sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng mga kemikal tulad ng serotonin.
fact_bis: Ang gut-brain axis mao ang komunikasyon tali sa tinai ug utak — ang mga bakterya sa tinai makaimpluwensya sa atong mood ug mental health pinaagi sa paghimo og mga kemikal sama sa serotonin.

q: What happens to fish and other reef creatures when corals die from bleaching?
options: They move closer to the shore to find food
They change color to blend in with the bleached coral
They scatter or disappear because their habitat is gone
They switch to eating dead coral as a new food source
explanation: When corals die from bleaching, the reef habitat is lost and the fish and other creatures that depend on it scatter or disappear.
fact_tl: Kapag namatay ang mga coral dahil sa pamumuti o bleaching, nawawala ang tirahan at nagkakalat ang mga isda at iba pang nilalang ng reef.
fact_bis: Kung mamatay ang mga coral tungod sa pagputi o bleaching, mawala ang puy-anan ug magkatibulaag o mawala ang mga isda ug ubang mananap sa bahura.

q: How is handwashing different from a vaccine when it comes to protecting you from sickness?
options: Handwashing only works against viruses, while vaccines only work against bacteria
A vaccine gives you vitamins, while handwashing removes dirt from your skin
A vaccine protects against one specific disease, while handwashing blocks many kinds of germs before they enter your body
Handwashing must be done with special soap, while vaccines can be taken at home
explanation: A vaccine trains the body to fight one specific germ, while handwashing stops many different kinds of germs before they can get inside — both methods work together.
fact_tl: Ang bakuna ay nagtuturo sa katawan na labanan ang isang tiyak na sakit, samantalang ang paghuhugas ng kamay ay humaharang sa maraming uri ng germ bago pa sila makapasok. Magkaiba sila ng paraan pero pareho silang mura at mabisang proteksyon na magkasamang ginagamit.
fact_bis: Ang bakuna magtudlo sa lawas nga makig-away sa usa ka piho nga sakit, samtang ang paghugas sa kamot magbabag sa daghang matang sa germ una pa kini makasulod. Lahi sila og paagi apan parehas silang barato ug epektibo nga proteksyon nga gigamit nato nga dungan.

q: Why is an old incandescent light bulb considered wasteful with electricity?
options: Because it flickers too much and uses extra power to stabilize
Because it burns out quickly and must be replaced often
Because it turns more energy into heat than into light
Because it needs a much higher voltage than modern bulbs
explanation: An incandescent bulb wastes electricity because it converts more energy into heat than into useful light.
fact_tl: Ang lumang bombilya ay nag-aaksaya ng kuryente dahil mas marami itong ginagawang init kaysa liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang daang bombilya mag-usik og koryente kay mas daghan ang gihimo niini nga init kaysa kahayag.

q: What is the purpose of the thick, sponge-like outer layer called velamen on orchid roots?
options: It anchors the orchid tightly to tree bark so it does not fall
It produces food for the orchid when sunlight is not available
It quickly soaks up water from rain before the water dries away
It protects the roots from insects that might chew through them
explanation: The velamen on epiphytic orchid roots acts like a sponge, quickly absorbing rain water before it evaporates.
fact_tl: Ang mga ugat ng epiphytic na orkidya ay may makapal na balat na parang espongha na tinatawag na velamen. Mabilis nitong sinisipsip ang tubig mula sa ulan bago ito tumuyo.
fact_bis: Ang gamot sa epiphytic nga orkidya adunay baga, morag-espongha nga panit nga gitawag og velamen. Paspas niining suyopon ang tubig gikan sa ulan sa dili pa kini mauga.

q: What is narra wood mainly used for in the Philippines?
options: Making paper and cardboard for books
Producing charcoal for cooking fires
Making beautiful furniture and flooring
Building fishing boats along the coast
explanation: Narra wood is prized for making beautiful furniture and flooring because of its quality and appearance.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang kahoy ng narra sa paggawa ng magagandang muwebles at sahig.
fact_bis: Ang kahoy sa narra gamiton sa paghimo og nindot nga muwebles ug salog.

q: What makes the Puerto Princesa Underground River special among underground rivers?
options: It is the deepest underground river ever discovered in Asia
It is the only underground river where tourists can kayak alone without a guide
It is one of the longest navigable underground rivers that flows directly into the sea
It glows in the dark because of bioluminescent organisms living inside it
explanation: The Puerto Princesa Underground River is one of the longest navigable underground rivers in the world and it flows directly into the sea.
fact_tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River ay isa sa pinakamahabang nabibiyaheng ilog sa ilalim ng lupa na dumadaloy nang tuwiran patungo sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River usa sa labing taas nga masakyang suba sa ilalom sa yuta nga modiretso ngadto sa dagat.

q: How far can a flying fish travel by linking several glides together?
options: About 10 meters total
More than 100 meters total
Exactly 50 meters every time
Up to 500 meters in calm weather
explanation: Flying fish can cover more than 100 meters by linking several glides together, even though a single glide is usually about 50 meters.
fact_tl: Ang isang glide ng flying fish ay karaniwang umaabot ng mga 50 metro, ngunit kaya nilang lumipad nang higit sa 100 metro kung pinagsasama-sama ang ilang glide.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka glide sa flying fish kasagaran moabot og mga 50 metros, apan makahimo sila molupad og kapin sa 100 metros kung magsumpay-sumpay sila og daghang glide.

q: Which of the following foods is a good source of Vitamin A that helps keep eyes healthy?
options: White rice and bread
Beans and peanuts
Sweet potato, carrots, and squash
Fish sauce and soy sauce
explanation: Vitamin A found in sweet potato, carrots, squash, and leafy vegetables helps keep eyes healthy and fights infection.
fact_tl: Ang bitamina A mula sa kamote, karot, kalabasa, at madahong gulay ay tumutulong sa malusog na mata at panlaban sa sakit. Sa Pilipinas, nagbibigay ng patak ng bitamina A sa mga bata para maiwasan ang night blindness at iba pang sakit.
fact_bis: Ang bitamina A gikan sa kamote, karot, kalabasa, ug dahonon nga utanon makatabang sa himsog nga mata ug pakigbatok sa sakit. Sa Pilipinas, ginahatagan og tulo sa bitamina A ang mga bata aron malikayan ang night blindness ug uban pang sakit.

q: What does a mosquito pupa do when a sudden shadow or ripple disturbs the water?
options: It floats up quickly to the surface to get air
It releases a chemical to warn other pupae nearby
It dives downward to hide from possible danger
It spins a protective silk cover around itself
explanation: The mosquito pupa is easily startled and dives downward when a sudden shadow, light, or ripple hits the water, to hide from danger.
fact_tl: Ang pupa ng lamok ay madaling magulat. Kapag may biglang anino o liwanag o yanig ng tubig, sumisisid ito pababa bilang pagtatago sa posibleng panganib.
fact_bis: Ang pupa sa lamok dali makuratan. Kung adunay kalit nga anino, kahayag, o pag-uyog sa tubig, mosalom kini paubos aron motago gikan sa posibleng kuyaw.

q: What does the male sailfin lizard do during mating season to attract a female?
options: It digs a deep burrow and calls loudly from inside
It changes its skin color to bright red and orange
It displays its brightly colored crest to attract a female
It brings the female pieces of food as a gift
explanation: During mating season, the male sailfin lizard shows off its brightly colored crest to attract a female.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng pag-aasawa, ang lalaking sailfin lizard ay nagpapakita ng matingkad na kulay ng tuklang nito para makaakit ng babae.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa pagpaanakon, ang lalaking sailfin lizard nagpakita sa iyang matingkad nga kolor sa tuktok aron madani ang babaye.

q: Why do scientists classify the tomato as a fruit rather than a vegetable?
options: Because it grows above the ground instead of underground
Because it is red and sweet when it is ripe
Because it has seeds inside and grows from a flower
Because it contains a large amount of Vitamin C
explanation: In science, a tomato is a fruit because it contains seeds and develops from a flower.
fact_tl: Sa agham, ang kamatis ay isang bunga dahil ito ay may mga buto sa loob at galing sa bulaklak.
fact_bis: Sa siyensiya, ang kamatis usa ka bunga kay kini adunay mga liso sa sulod ug naggikan sa bulak.

q: Near what kind of environment does the macaque monkey typically prefer to live?
options: High mountain peaks and cold rocky slopes
Open grasslands and dry desert areas
Rivers, mangroves, and forests
Sandy beaches and coral reefs
explanation: Macaque monkeys prefer to live near rivers, mangroves, and forests.
fact_tl: Mahilig manirahan ang unggoy na ito malapit sa mga ilog, bakawan, at kagubatan.
fact_bis: Kini nga unggoy ganahan mopuyo duol sa mga suba, bakawan, ug kalasangan.

q: Why do engineers paint the steel used in Philippine bridges and buildings?
options: To make them look more colorful and attractive to visitors
To absorb extra heat from the sun and keep the steel cool
To prevent the steel from rusting in the humid climate
To make the surface smoother so rainwater slides off faster
explanation: Because the Philippines has a humid climate, engineers paint steel structures to protect them from rusting and to keep them strong for many years.
fact_tl: Maraming tulay at gusali sa Pilipinas ay gawa sa bakal o steel. Dahil mahalumigmig ang ating klima, pinipinturahan ng mga inhinyero ang bakal na ito para hindi ito kalawangin at manatiling matibay sa loob ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Daghang taytayan ug bilding sa Pilipinas hinimo sa steel. Tungod kay umog ang atong klima, pintalan sa mga inhenyero kini nga steel aron dili motaya ug magpabiling lig-on sulod sa daghang tuig.

q: How is glass shaped into bottles or drinking glasses during manufacturing?
options: It is mixed with sand and poured into molds while still in powder form
It is cut and polished by machines after it cools into a flat sheet
It is blown or pressed into a mold while it is soft and melted, then cooled to harden
It is stretched into thin sheets by rollers and then folded into shape
explanation: Melted glass is soft like honey and can be blown or pressed into a mold while hot, then cooled to harden into the desired shape.
fact_tl: Kapag tunaw na ang salamin, malambot ito parang pulot at pwedeng hubugin sa kahit anong hugis. Hinihipan o hinuhulma ito sa molde habang mainit pa, tapos hinahayaang lumamig at tumigas sa hugis ng bote o baso.
fact_bis: Kung natunaw na ang salamin, humok kini sama sa dugos ug mahimong hulmahon sa bisan unsa nga porma. Gihuyop o gipugos kini sa molde samtang init pa, dayon pasagdan nga mabugnaw ug magahi sa porma sa botelya o baso.

q: What type of light can bees see that humans cannot, which helps them find flowers?
options: Infrared light
Radio waves
Ultraviolet light
X-ray light
explanation: Bees can see ultraviolet light, which is invisible to humans, and this ability helps them locate flowers.
fact_tl: Ang mga bubuyog ay nakakakita ng ultraviolet na liwanag na hindi natin nakikita, na tumutulong sa kanilang makahanap ng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mga putyukan makakita ug ultraviolet nga kahayag nga dili nato makita, nga makatabang nila sa pagpangita ug bulak.

q: What always comes first at the beginning of a food chain?
options: Animals that hunt and eat other animals
Decomposers that break down dead organisms
Producers like plants that make their own food from sunlight
Consumers that get energy by eating plants
explanation: A food chain always starts with producers, usually plants, which make their own food using energy from sunlight.
fact_tl: Ang food chain ay laging nagsisimula sa mga producer, karaniwang mga halaman, na gumagawa ng sariling pagkain mula sa liwanag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang food chain kanunay magsugod sa mga producer, kasagaran mga tanom, nga naghimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw.

q: How does the height of an object above the ground affect its gravitational potential energy?
options: The higher the object, the less gravitational potential energy it has
Gravitational potential energy stays the same no matter how high the object is
The higher the object is above the ground, the more gravitational potential energy it has
Gravitational potential energy only matters when an object is moving, not when it is still
explanation: An object has more gravitational potential energy the higher it is above the ground.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang gravitational potential energy ng isang bagay kapag mas mataas ito mula sa lupa.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang gravitational potential energy sa usa ka butang kon mas taas kini gikan sa yuta.

q: How do marine protected areas in the Philippines help dugongs survive?
options: They provide special feeding programs that deliver fish to dugongs every day
They train local fishermen to catch fish without hurting dugongs
They ban fishing in certain sea areas so dugongs can eat and live safely and seagrass can thrive
They build underwater fences to keep predators away from dugong habitats
explanation: Marine protected areas ban fishing in certain zones, allowing dugongs to eat seagrass safely and letting the seagrass recover and thrive.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga lugar sa dagat na ginagawang protektado kung saan bawal mangisda, upang ligtas na makakain at mamuhay ang dugong at lumusog ang damong-dagat.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, adunay mga bahin sa dagat nga gihimong protektado diin gidili ang pagpangisda, aron luwas nga makakaon ug mabuhi ang dugong ug molambo ang sagbot sa dagat.

q: What type of star is our Sun classified as?
options: A red giant
A white dwarf
A yellow dwarf
A blue supergiant
explanation: The Sun is classified as a yellow dwarf star.
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay isang bituing tinatawag na dilaw na unano (yellow dwarf).
fact_bis: Ang Adlaw usa ka bituin nga gitawag og dilaw nga unano (yellow dwarf).

q: Why does the human body need food every day?
options: Only to make the stomach feel full and stop the feeling of hunger
To add weight and size to the body as it grows taller
To get energy and nutrients needed to move, grow, and repair the body
To produce saliva and digestive juices that break down water
explanation: We eat food to get the energy and nutrients the body needs to move, grow, and repair itself — food is the body's fuel.
fact_tl: Kumakain tayo para makakuha ng enerhiya at sustansya (nutrients) na kailangan ng katawan para gumalaw, lumaki, at ayusin ang sarili. Ang pagkain ang parang 'gasolina' ng katawan.
fact_bis: Mokaon ta aron makakuha og enerhiya ug sustansya (nutrients) nga gikinahanglan sa lawas aron molihok, motubo, ug ayohon ang kaugalingon. Ang pagkaon sama sa 'gasolina' sa lawas.

q: What are the tiny holes on the underside of a leaf called, through which carbon dioxide enters for photosynthesis?
options: Chloroplasts
Veins
Stomata
Pores of the bark
explanation: Carbon dioxide needed for photosynthesis enters the leaf through tiny holes called stomata, which also let oxygen escape and control water loss.
fact_tl: Ang carbon dioxide na kailangan ng photosynthesis ay pumapasok sa pamamagitan ng maliliit na butas sa dahon na tinatawag na stomata, kadalasan nasa ilalim ng dahon. Sa parehong mga butas na ito lumalabas ang oxygen na ginawa. Bumubukas at sumasara ito para kontrolin ang tubig.
fact_bis: Ang carbon dioxide nga gikinahanglan sa photosynthesis mosulod pinaagi sa gagmay nga mga lungag sa dahon nga gitawag og stomata, kasagaran sa ilawom. Pinaagi niini nga mga lungag mogawas ang oxygen nga nahimo. Mobuka ug mosira kini aron kontrolon ang pagkawala sa tubig.

q: Which yearly festival in Davao celebrates a good harvest and proudly features durian fruit?
options: Sinulog Festival
Pahiyas Festival
Ati-Atihan Festival
Kadayawan Festival
explanation: Kadayawan is a yearly festival in Davao that celebrates a good harvest, with durian being one of the fruits proudly displayed alongside other crops.
fact_tl: Sa Davao, kung saan maraming durian, may taunang pista na tinatawag na Kadayawan na nagdiriwang ng masaganang ani. Isa ang durian sa mga prutas na ipinagmamalaki sa pistang ito kasama ang ibang bunga ng lupa.
fact_bis: Sa Davao, diin daghan ang durian, adunay tinuig nga pista nga gitawag og Kadayawan nga nagsaulog sa maayong ani. Usa sa mga prutas nga gipasigarbo sa maong pista ang durian uban sa ubang abot sa yuta.

q: What determines whether a sound has a high pitch or a low pitch?
options: How loud the sound is
How far away from you the sound is made
How fast or slow the sound vibrates — faster makes higher pitch
How big or small the object making the sound is
explanation: A sound's pitch depends on vibration speed: faster vibrations produce a higher pitch and slower vibrations produce a lower pitch.
fact_tl: Ang taas ng tono (pitch) ay nakadepende sa dalas ng pag-yanig: mas mabilis ang pag-yanig, mas mataas ang tono; mas mabagal, mas mababa ang tono.
fact_bis: Ang kataas sa tono (pitch) nagdepende sa kapaspas sa pagkurog: mas paspas ang pagkurog, mas taas ang tono; mas hinay, mas ubos ang tono.

q: What happens to a vaccine if it is not kept cold from the factory to the health center?
options: It becomes more powerful and can protect against more diseases
It changes color but still works the same way
It can spoil and may no longer teach the body to fight the germ
It freezes solid and must be warmed up slowly before use
explanation: If a vaccine gets warm, it can spoil and lose its ability to teach the body to fight the germ it was made for.
fact_tl: Maraming bakuna ang kailangang panatilihing malamig mula gawaan hanggang sa health center. Kapag uminit ang bakuna, pwede itong masira at hindi na maituro nang maayos sa katawan ang laban sa germ.
fact_bis: Daghang bakuna ang kinahanglan ipabilin nga bugnaw gikan sa pabrika hangtod sa health center. Kung mainit ang bakuna, mahimo kining madaot ug dili na matudlo og maayo sa lawas ang pagpakig-away sa germ.

q: Why is it important to drink water every day?
options: Because water helps food taste better when we eat
Because water gives us all the vitamins we need to grow
Because our body needs water every day to stay healthy and avoid getting thirsty
Because drinking water makes our bones and teeth stronger
explanation: We need to drink water every day to stay healthy and to keep the body from becoming dehydrated and thirsty.
fact_tl: Kailangan nating uminom ng tubig araw-araw para manatiling malusog at hindi mauhaw ang katawan.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan kitang moinom ug tubig adlaw-adlaw aron magpabiling himsog ug dili mauhaw ang lawas.

q: How do fish breathe while they are in the sea?
options: They come up to the surface to breathe air through their mouth
They absorb oxygen through their skin like frogs do
They use their gills to take in oxygen from the seawater
They store air bubbles in their stomach before diving deep
explanation: Fish breathe by using their gills, which take in oxygen dissolved in seawater.
fact_tl: Ang mga isdang ibinababa sa pantalan ay humihinga sa tubig sa pamamagitan ng kanilang hasang, na kumukuha ng oksiheno mula sa tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga isda nga ginakanaog sa pantalan moginhawa sa tubig pinaagi sa ilang hasang, nga mokuha ug oksiheno gikan sa tubig-dagat.

q: Why does distillation work to separate the different parts of crude oil?
options: Because the different parts of oil have different colors that can be sorted by filters
Because oil and water do not mix, so the parts float at different levels
Because each part of the oil boils at a different temperature, so they separate as vapor rises
Because heating oil makes it crystallize into solid layers that can be scraped apart
explanation: Distillation separates oil into fractions because each part boils at a different temperature, causing lighter parts to rise as vapor while heavier parts stay lower.
fact_tl: Gumagana ang paghihiwalay dahil ang bawat bahagi ng langis ay may sariling boiling point: ang mga gumagaang sumingaw ay umaakyat, habang ang mahihirap sumingaw ay nananatili sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Molihok ang pagbulag tungod kay ang matag bahin sa lana adunay kaugalingong boiling point: ang sayon mosingaw mosaka, samtang ang lisod mobukal magpabilin sa ubos.

q: What danger can happen if you plug too many devices into one electrical outlet?
options: The devices will charge too slowly and may not turn on
The outlet will produce a loud buzzing noise and stop working
The outlet can overheat and cause a fire
The electricity bill will automatically double each month
explanation: Plugging too many devices into one outlet can cause it to overheat and start a fire.
fact_tl: Huwag magsaksak ng sobrang daming gamit sa isang saksakan dahil maaari itong uminit at magdulot ng sunog.
fact_bis: Ayaw isaksak ang sobra ka daghang gamit sa usa ka saksakan kay mahimo kini nga moinit ug makahimo og sunog.

q: In the relationship between ants and aphids, what do the aphids give to the ants in return for protection?
options: Eggs that the ants hatch and raise as their own
Small pieces of leaves that the ants use to build tunnels
A sweet liquid called honeydew
Wax that the ants use to seal their underground chambers
explanation: Ants guard and protect aphids, and in return the aphids produce a sweet liquid called honeydew for the ants.
fact_tl: Binabantayan at pinoprotektahan ng mga langgam ang mga aphid, at bilang kapalit, binibigyan sila ng aphid ng matamis na likidong tinatawag na honeydew.
fact_bis: Ang mga hulmigas magbantay ug manalipod sa mga aphid, ug isip baylo, hatagan sila sa aphid og tam-is nga duga nga gitawag og honeydew.

q: Which element do atomic clocks commonly use to measure time with extreme accuracy?
options: Gold
Iron
Mercury
Cesium
explanation: Atomic clocks commonly use atoms of the element cesium to measure time very accurately.
fact_tl: Karaniwang gumagamit ang atomic clock ng atomo ng cesium upang sukatin ang oras nang napakatumpak.
fact_bis: Ang atomic clock kasagarang naggamit og atomo sa elemento nga cesium aron sukdon ang oras nga tukma kaayo.

q: What happens to the carbon stored inside trees when forests are cut down or burned?
options: It soaks into the soil and becomes part of the underground water supply
It is locked away permanently in the wood even after the tree is cut
It is released into the air as carbon dioxide
It is absorbed by nearby oceans and turned into coral
explanation: When forests are cut or burned, the carbon they stored is released into the atmosphere as carbon dioxide.
fact_tl: Kapag pinuputol o sinusunog ang mga gubat, ang naimbak na karbon ay napupunta sa hangin bilang carbon dioxide.
fact_bis: Kon putlon o sunogon ang mga kalasangan, ang natipig nga karbon mogawas sa hangin isip carbon dioxide.

q: Which type of kitchen waste should NOT be added to a compost bin with worms?
options: Fruit peels and vegetable scraps
Leftover cooked rice
Meat, oil, or salty and spicy food
Wet paper and fallen leaves
explanation: Compost worms eat fruit peels, vegetables, rice, leaves, and wet paper, but meat, oil, and salty or spicy food harm them and should be avoided.
fact_tl: Ang mga compost worm ay kumakain ng nabubulok na tira sa kusina tulad ng balat ng prutas, gulay, tirang kanin, dahon, at basang papel. Iniiwasan ang karne, mantika, at maaalat o maaanghang na pagkain dahil nakakasama ito sa kanila.
fact_bis: Ang compost worms mokaon og nadunot nga tira sa kusina sama sa panit sa prutas, utan, sobrang kan-on, dahon, ug basa nga papel. Likayan ang karne, lana, ug parat o halang nga pagkaon kay makadaot kini kanila.

q: What does a volcano blast into the sky when it erupts?
options: A stream of liquid lava that flows directly upward before falling back
A mixture of seawater and steam that cools quickly into rain
A towering column of hot ash, gas, and rock that can reach several kilometers high
A beam of light caused by electricity building up inside the volcano
explanation: When a volcano erupts, it can blast a towering column of hot ash, gas, and rock several kilometers up into the sky.
fact_tl: Kapag pumutok ang isang bulkan, maaari itong magpaitaas ng matarik na haligi ng mainit na abo, gas, at bato pataas sa himpapawid nang ilang kilometro.
fact_bis: Kon mobuto ang usa ka bulkan, mahimo kining mobuga og taas nga haligi sa init nga abo, gas, ug bato paingon sa kawanangan og pipila ka kilometro.

q: Why is it important to rinse your dropper or cup before testing each new sample with an acid-base indicator?
options: Because the indicator color fades quickly and rinsing refreshes it
Because different samples need different amounts of indicator drops
Because leftover acid or base from the previous test can give a wrong color reading
Because rinsing makes the indicator change color faster in the next sample
explanation: Even a tiny leftover amount of acid or base from a previous test can affect the indicator color result, so tools should be rinsed to keep the test fair.
fact_tl: Kapag gumagamit ka ng indicator, dapat malinis ang gamit mo at huwag paghaluin ang mga sample, dahil kahit kaunting natirang acid o base ay maaaring magbigay ng maling kulay. Banlawan mo ang dropper o baso bago ang susunod na subok.
fact_bis: Kon mogamit ka og indicator, kinahanglan limpyo ang imong gamit ug ayaw isagol ang mga sample, kay bisan gamay nga nahibilin nga acid o base makahatag og sayop nga kolor. Hugasi ang dropper o baso una sa sunod nga subok.

q: Which geothermal field in the Philippines produces electricity from steam and powers much of the Visayas region?
options: Makban Geothermal Field in Laguna
Bacman Geothermal Field in Sorsogon
Mindanao Geothermal Field in Bukidnon
Tongonan Geothermal Field in Leyte
explanation: The Tongonan Geothermal Field in Leyte is one of the largest geothermal power sources in the Philippines and its steam supplies electricity to much of the Visayas region.
fact_tl: Ang Tongonan Geothermal Field sa Leyte ay isa sa pinakamalaking geothermal na pinagkukunan ng kuryente sa Pilipinas — ang singaw nito ay nagbibigay ng daan-daang megawatt na kuryente na sapat para sa malaking bahagi ng Visayas.
fact_bis: Ang Tongonan Geothermal Field sa Leyte usa sa pinakadako nga geothermal nga tinubdan sa kuryente sa Pilipinas — ang singaw niini naghatag sa gatusan nga megawatt nga kuryente nga nagpagana sa kadaghanan sa Visayas.

q: What is Maria Orosa known for in Philippine history?
options: Being the first Filipino woman to fly an airplane across the Pacific Ocean
Writing the first Tagalog-language science textbooks used in public schools
Inventing new food preservation methods and creating products from local ingredients
Discovering a new species of Philippine orchid and naming it after Rizal
explanation: Maria Orosa was a Filipino food technologist who invented new food preservation methods and created products based on local Philippine ingredients.
fact_tl: Si Maria Orosa ay isang Pilipinong food technologist na naimbento ng bagong paraan ng pag-iingat ng pagkain at gumawa ng mga produktong batay sa lokal na sangkap.
fact_bis: Si Maria Orosa usa ka Pilipinong food technologist nga nag-imbento og bag-ong paagi sa pagpreserba sa pagkain ug naghimo og mga produkto base sa lokal nga mga sangkap.

q: What does the brain do while you are sleeping at night?
options: It shuts down completely so it can save energy for the next day
It speeds up all its activities to prepare the body for waking up
It organizes memories from the day while the nervous system rests
It sends repair signals only to injured muscles and ignores memories
explanation: During sleep, the brain organizes memories from the day and the nervous system gets to rest, which is why enough sleep is needed for the brain to work well.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng utak ng sapat na tulog para gumana nang maayos. Habang natutulog ka, inaayos ng utak ang mga alaala mula sa araw at nakakapagpahinga ang nervous system.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan sa utok ang igong tulog aron molihok og maayo. Samtang natulog ka, ang utok mag-ayos sa mga handumanan gikan sa adlaw ug ang nervous system makapahulay.

q: Who patented an early three-position traffic signal with a warning signal in 1923?
options: Thomas Edison
Henry Ford
Garrett Morgan
Nikola Tesla
explanation: Garrett Morgan patented an early three-position traffic signal that included a warning signal in 1923.
fact_tl: Si Garrett Morgan ang nag-patent ng isang maagang traffic signal na may babalang hudyat noong 1923.
fact_bis: Si Garrett Morgan ang nag-patent sa usa ka sayong traffic signal nga adunay pasidaan nga senyas niadtong 1923.

q: Besides your fingertips, where else on your body can friction ridges be found?
options: On the back of your hands and the back of your neck
Only on the tips of your toes, nowhere else
On your palms, the soles of your feet, and your toes
On your elbows and kneecaps where skin bends the most
explanation: Friction ridges are also found on the palms, the soles of the feet, and the toes — which is why hospitals take a newborn's footprint for identification.
fact_tl: Hindi lang sa dulo ng daliri may friction ridges. Nasa palad mo rin, sa talampakan, at sa mga daliri ng paa. Kaya nga sa ospital, ang footprint ng bagong silang na sanggol ang kadalasang kinukuha.
