fact_bis: Dili lang sa tumoy sa tudlo adunay friction ridges. Anaa sab kini sa imong palad, sa lapalapa sa tiil, ug sa mga tudlo sa tiil. Mao nga sa ospital, ang footprint sa bag-ong natawo nga bata ang kasagaran ginakuha.

q: Why are there very few snakes or lizards living in extremely cold places?
options: Because snow covers all the food that snakes and lizards eat
Because cold-blooded animals cannot grow scales in freezing temperatures
Because cold-blooded animals have a hard time surviving in extremely cold environments
Because snakes and lizards are afraid of ice and avoid it instinctively
explanation: Cold-blooded animals have a hard time living in extremely cold places because they cannot regulate their own body heat, so snakes and lizards are rarely found in icy lands.
fact_tl: Mahirap mabuhay ang mga hayop na malamig ang dugo sa sobrang lamig na lugar, kaya kakaunti ang ahas o butiki sa mga lupaing yelo.
fact_bis: Lisod mabuhi ang mga hayop nga bugnaw ug dugo sa sobra ka bugnaw nga dapit, mao nga gamay ra ang bitin o tiki sa yelo nga kayutaan.

q: Where does a flamingo keep its leg when it is resting on one foot?
options: It stretches the leg out behind its tail to help it balance
It dangles the leg straight down in the water below it
It tucks the leg up under its body or against its belly to keep it warm
It wraps the leg around a branch so it does not fall while sleeping
explanation: The flamingo tucks its other leg under its body or against its belly, where it is sheltered from cold air and kept warm against its feathers.
fact_tl: Yung kabilang paa na hindi nakatapak ay itinatago ng flamingo sa ilalim ng katawan o tabi ng tiyan nito. Doon ito nakakanlong sa lamig ng hangin at protektado ng mainit na balahibo.
fact_bis: Ang pikas nga tiil nga wala matungtong gitago sa flamingo ilawom sa lawas o sa kilid sa tiyan niini. Didto kini gisalipdan sa bugnaw nga hangin ug gipainit sa balhibo.

q: Because many centipedes have poor eyesight, what do they use to sense smell and movement around them?
options: Their many legs, which vibrate and detect ground movement
Their hard shell, which picks up changes in air pressure
Their long antennae, which sense smell and movement nearby
Their bright colors, which reflect light like tiny mirrors
explanation: Many centipedes have poor eyesight and rely on their long antennae to detect smells and movements in their surroundings.
fact_tl: Marami sa mga alupihan ay malabo ang paningin, kaya gumagamit sila ng mahabang sungot (antennae) para maramdaman ang amoy at galaw sa paligid nila.
fact_bis: Daghang alupihan ang huyang og panan-aw, busa mogamit sila sa taas nga sungot (antennae) aron mabati ang baho ug lihok sa ilang palibot.

q: What two things help strengthen the immune system so it can fight illness better?
options: Regular exercise and drinking energy drinks
Avoiding sunlight and staying indoors
Enough sleep and nutritious food
Taking vitamins every hour and resting for the whole day
explanation: Getting enough sleep and eating nutritious food both strengthen the immune system, helping the body fight off illness more effectively.
fact_tl: Ang sapat na tulog at masustansyang pagkain ay nagpapalakas sa immune system kaya mas magaling itong lumaban sa sakit.
fact_bis: Ang igong katulog ug masustansyang pagkaon nagpalig-on sa immune system aron mas maayo kining makig-away sa sakit.

q: How should jackfruit seeds be prepared before eating them?
options: They can be eaten raw straight from the fruit with no preparation needed
They must be soaked in water overnight and then eaten cold
They need to be boiled or cooked first to be safe and tasty
They should be dried in the sun for a week before grinding into flour
explanation: Jackfruit seeds should not be eaten raw; they need to be boiled or cooked first to be safe and tasty.
fact_tl: Hindi dapat kainin ng hilaw ang buto ng langka; kailangan munang pakuluan o lutuin para maging ligtas at malasa.
fact_bis: Dili angay kan-on nga hilaw ang liso sa nangka; kinahanglan una nga pabukalon o lutoon aron luwas ug lami.

q: What chemical do Filipino farmers spray on mango trees to make them flower outside of their normal season?
options: Potassium nitrate (KNO3)
Calcium phosphate
Nitrogen gas
Urea fertilizer
explanation: Farmers in the Philippines use potassium nitrate (KNO3) to force mango trees to flower off-season, a practice called flower induction.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ginagamit ng mga magsasaka ang potassium nitrate (KNO3) upang pilitin ang mga puno ng mangga na mamukadkad kahit hindi pa season—tinatawag itong flower induction o off-season farming.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, gigamit sa mga mag-uuma ang potassium nitrate (KNO3) aron pilitan ang mga kahoy sa mangga nga mamukadkad bisan dili pa season—gitawag kini og flower induction.

q: Which unit is used to measure energy or work in science?
options: Watt
Joule
Newton
Pascal
explanation: The joule is the unit that measures energy or work, such as the energy needed to push an object.
fact_tl: Ang joule ay sumusukat ng enerhiya o trabaho — halimbawa, ang enerhiyang kailangan para magtulak ng bagay.
fact_bis: Ang joule nagsukod sa enerhiya o trabaho — pananglitan, ang enerhiya nga gikinahanglan aron itulod ang usa ka butang.

q: Who invented the first dynamo (electric generator) in 1831?
options: Thomas Edison
Nikola Tesla
Michael Faraday
James Watt
explanation: Michael Faraday invented the first dynamo in 1831, making it possible to generate electricity from motion.
fact_tl: Si Michael Faraday ang gumawa ng unang dynamo (generator) noong 1831.
fact_bis: Si Michael Faraday mao ang naghimo sa unang dynamo (generator) niadtong 1831.

q: A fish that is dark on top and pale on its belly is using a type of camouflage. What is this called?
options: Mimicry
Countershading
Warning coloration
Disruptive coloration
explanation: Countershading is when a fish is dark on top and pale below, making it hard to see from above or below.
fact_tl: Ang countershading ay isang uri ng camouflage kung saan ang itaas ng katawan ng isda ay madilim at ang ibaba ay maliwanag, na nagpapahirap sa mga predator at biktima na makita ito mula sa alinmang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang countershading usa ka matang sa camouflage diin ang itaas sa isda ngitngit ug ang ilawom hayag, nagpadali nga lisdan makita gikan sa ibabaw o sa ilawom.

q: When a comet is near the Sun, which direction does its tail always point?
options: Toward the Sun
Sideways, at a right angle to the Sun
Away from the Sun
Backward along the comet's path
explanation: A comet's tail always points away from the Sun because the solar wind pushes the material outward.
fact_tl: Tumutubo ang buntot ng kometa kapag malapit ito sa Araw, at ang buntot ay laging nakaturo palayo sa Araw.
fact_bis: Ang ikog sa kometa motubo kung duol na kini sa Adlaw, ug ang ikog kanunay nagaturo palayo sa Adlaw.

q: When iodine crystals are gently heated, they change directly from a solid into a gas. What is this process called?
options: Evaporation
Melting
Sublimation
Condensation
explanation: Iodine crystals undergo sublimation when heated, turning directly into a vivid purple gas without first becoming a liquid.
fact_tl: Kapag ang iodine crystal ay bahagyang uminit, ito ay nagsa-sublimation at nagiging isang maliwanag na purpleng gas. Kapag pinalamig muli ang gas, nagde-deposition ito at direktang nagiging solid muli. Ito ay isang madaling makikitang halimbawa ng sublimation at deposition.
fact_bis: Sa bahagyang pag-init sa iodine crystal, kini nagsailalim sa sublimation ug mahimong maliwanag nga purpleng gas. Sa pagpabugnaw pag-usab sa gas, kini nagsailalim sa deposition ug direkta nga nahimong solid pag-usab. Kini usa ka sayon nga makita nga pananglitan sa sublimation ug deposition.

q: At about what pH does the indicator phenolphthalein begin to turn pink?
options: pH 4.0
pH 7.0
pH 8.3
explanation: Phenolphthalein begins to turn pink at about pH 8.3, showing that a solution is basic.
fact_tl: Ang phenolphthalein ay nagsisimulang maging rosas sa pH na mga 8.3 pataas.
fact_bis: Ang phenolphthalein magsugod og pula-rosas sa pH nga mga 8.3 pataas.

q: Kamote (sweet potato) is a root crop. Where does its edible part grow?
options: On its leaves
On branches above the ground
Underground
Inside a pod on the stem
explanation: Kamote is a root crop whose edible part grows underground, below the soil surface.
fact_tl: Ang kamote ay isang halamang-ugat na ang kinakain nating bahagi ay tumutubo sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang kamote usa ka tanom nga ugat nga ang atong gikaon nga bahin motubo sa ilalom sa yuta.

q: Which crop is one of the important cash crops of the Philippines, giving a living to many farmers?
options: Wheat
Sugarcane
Barley
Soybeans
explanation: Sugarcane is one of the Philippines' important cash crops, supporting many farming families.
fact_tl: Ang tubo ay isa sa mahahalagang pananim na pang-kalakal sa Pilipinas na nagbibigay ng hanapbuhay sa maraming magsasaka.
fact_bis: Ang tubo usa sa importanteng pananom nga pangnegosyo sa Pilipinas nga naghatag og kabuhian sa daghang mag-uuma.

q: What is the very first thing that forms around a broken bone to start the healing process?
options: New bone cells
Cartilage
A blood clot
Calcium deposits
explanation: Right after a bone breaks, a blood clot forms around the break to begin the healing process.
fact_tl: Kapag nabali ang buto, unang bumubuo ng namuong dugo sa paligid ng bali para simulan ang paghilom.
fact_bis: Pagkahuman mabali ang bukog, mamuo ang dugo palibot sa bali aron magsugod ang pag-ayo.

q: How do forests release large amounts of water into the air?
options: By absorbing rain and then releasing it as streams
Through transpiration from their leaves
By creating clouds through photosynthesis
By releasing oxygen that carries water molecules
explanation: Forests release huge amounts of water into the air through transpiration, the process where plants release water vapor through their leaves.
fact_tl: Ang mga gubat ay naglalabas ng napakaraming tubig sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng transpirasyon.
fact_bis: Ang mga lasang magpagawas og daghan kaayong tubig ngadto sa hangin pinaagi sa transpiration.

q: Which layer of the Earth is the thickest?
options: The crust
The inner core
The outer core
The mantle
explanation: The mantle is the thickest layer of the Earth, located between the crust and the core.
fact_tl: Ang mantle ang pinakamakapal na sapin ng Mundo, nasa pagitan ng crust at core.
fact_bis: Ang mantle mao ang labing baga nga sapin sa Kalibutan, taliwala sa crust ug core.

q: What happens to the eardrum when sound waves reach it?
options: It absorbs the sound and converts it to heat
It vibrates, like the skin of a drum
It reflects the sound back out of the ear
It stretches and changes shape permanently
explanation: The eardrum is a thin membrane that vibrates when sound waves hit it, which is how we begin to hear sounds.
fact_tl: Ang eardrum ay isang manipis na lamad sa loob ng tainga na nangingisig kapag tinamaang ng mga sound waves — katulad ng balat ng tambol.
fact_bis: Ang eardrum usa ka manipis nga lamad sa sulod sa tainga nga nalingkod kung tinahasan sa mga sound wave — sama sa panit sa tambol.

q: On the Richter scale, if an earthquake is magnitude 6 instead of magnitude 5, how much stronger is the shaking?
options: Twice as strong
Five times as strong
Ten times as strong
One hundred times as strong
explanation: Each whole number increase on the Richter scale means the ground shaking is ten times bigger, so magnitude 6 shakes ten times more than magnitude 5.
fact_tl: Sa Richter scale, ang bawat dagdag na isang numero ay nangangahulugang sampung beses na mas malaki ang yanig ng lupa, kaya malaki ang pagkakaiba ng magnitude 5 at magnitude 6.
fact_bis: Sa Richter scale, ang matag dugang nga usa ka numero nagpasabot nga napulo ka pilo nga mas dako ang pag-uyog sa yuta, busa ang magnitude 6 mas kusog kaayo kay sa magnitude 5.

q: Which fruit is known as the largest fruit in the world that grows on a tree?
options: Watermelon
Pumpkin
Jackfruit
Coconut
explanation: The jackfruit is the largest fruit in the world that grows on a tree.
fact_tl: Ang langka ang pinakamalaking prutas na tumutubo sa puno sa buong mundo.
fact_bis: Ang nangka mao ang pinakadako nga prutas nga motubo sa kahoy sa tibuok kalibutan.

q: Why are many kinds of vultures now endangered?
options: Overhunting for their feathers and meat
Diseases spread by other birds
Poisons and the loss of their habitat
Competition from larger eagles
explanation: Many vultures are endangered because of poisons (like from poisoned carcasses) and the loss of their natural habitat.
fact_tl: Maraming uri ng buwitre ang nanganganib nang maubos dahil sa lason at pagkasira ng kanilang tirahan.
fact_bis: Daghang matang sa buwitre ang nameligro nga mahurot tungod sa hilo ug pagkawala sa ilang puy-anan.

q: What colors are lotus flowers usually?
options: Yellow and orange
Blue and purple
Pink or white
Red and black
explanation: The lotus flower is large and usually pink or white, rising above the water on a tall stem.
fact_tl: Ang bulaklak ng lotus ay malaki at karaniwang rosas o puti, at tumataas ito sa ibabaw ng tubig na nakapatong sa mahabang tangkay.
fact_bis: Ang bulak sa lotus dako ug kasagaran rosas o puti, ug motungha kini sa ibabaw sa tubig nga naa sa taas nga tangkay.

q: What chemical process is used to make soap by mixing fat or oil with a strong base called lye?
options: Fermentation
Saponification
Distillation
Oxidation
explanation: Soap is made through saponification, a chemical process in which fat or oil reacts with a strong base called lye.
fact_tl: Ang sabon ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng paghahalo ng taba o langis sa isang malakas na base na tinatawag na lihiya, sa prosesong kemikal na saponification.
fact_bis: Ang sabon gihimo pinaagi sa pagsagol sa tambok o lana ngadto sa kusog nga base nga gitawag og lihiya, sa kemikal nga proseso nga saponification.

q: Why have giant clams become rare in many places?
options: They were killed by rising ocean temperatures
They were collected too much in the past for their meat and shells
They were outcompeted by other shellfish species
They were lost due to oil spills in the ocean
explanation: Giant clams became rare because they were over-collected for their meat and shells, so they are now protected.
fact_tl: Naging bihira na ang taklobo sa maraming lugar dahil sobra-sobra ang panghuhuli rito noon para sa laman at para sa kabibe nito, kaya ngayon ay protektado na ito.
fact_bis: Ang taklobo nahimong talagsaon na sa daghang dapit kay sa miagi sobra ra kaayo ang pagpangdakop niini alang sa unod ug sa kabhang niini, busa karon gipanalipdan na kini.

q: Which plant's small leaves are often added to the Filipino soup called tinola?
options: Kangkong
Pechay
Malunggay (moringa)
Camote tops
explanation: Malunggay (moringa) leaves are commonly added to Filipino soups like tinola.
fact_tl: Ang malunggay ay isang halamang ang maliliit na dahon ay madalas ilagay sa mga sabaw gaya ng tinola sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang malunggay (kamunggay) usa ka tanom nga ang gagmay nga mga dahon kanunay ibutang sa mga sabaw sama sa tinola sa Pilipinas.

q: How long does it take for a protected coral reef to begin showing signs of recovery?
options: About 1 month
About 1 year
About 5 to 10 years
About 100 years
explanation: When a coral reef is protected from fishing and disturbance, it can begin recovering within 5-10 years, though full recovery may take decades.
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang coral reef ay naprotektahan mula sa pangingisda at iba pang disturbanso, maaari itong magsimulang mabawi sa loob ng 5–10 taon — ngunit ang kumpletong pagbawi ng complex na reef ecosystem ay maaaring tumagal ng dekada o higit pa.
fact_bis: Sa dihang ang usa ka coral reef naprotektahan gikan sa pangisda ug uban pang disturbanso, mahimong magsugod kining moayo sulod sa 5–10 ka tuig — apan ang kompleto nga pagkaayo sa usa ka komplikadong reef ecosystem mahimong molungtad og mga dekada o labaw pa.

q: What is the SI base unit of time?
options: Minute
Millisecond
Hour
Second
explanation: The SI base unit of time is the second, represented by the symbol s.
fact_tl: Ang batayang yunit ng panahon (time) sa SI ay segundo (second), na ang simbolo ay s.
fact_bis: Ang sukaranang yunit sa panahon (time) sa SI mao ang segundo (second), nga ang simbolo kay s.

q: What extreme condition can tardigrades survive that even the deepest ocean cannot match?
options: Temperatures above 200 degrees C
Enormous pressures greater than those in the deepest part of the ocean
Radiation levels that melt metal
Complete lack of gravity
explanation: Tardigrades can survive enormous pressure, even greater than the pressure found in the deepest part of the ocean.
fact_tl: Kaya ng tardigrade na makaligtas sa napakalaking presyon, mas mataas pa kaysa presyon sa pinakamalalim na bahagi ng dagat.
fact_bis: Ang tardigrade makalahutay sa hilabihang presyur, mas dako pa kaysa presyur sa pinakalawom nga bahin sa dagat.

q: What happens to a child who does not get enough nutrients from food over a long time?
options: They grow taller and stronger than average
They may have stunted growth, weakness, and get sick easily
They develop stronger immune systems
They sleep more but remain healthy
explanation: Malnutrition from a diet lacking enough nutrients can cause stunted growth, weakness, and a weakened immune system.
fact_tl: Ang malnutrisyon ay nangyayari kapag kulang sa sustansya ang kinakain ng isang tao, na maaaring magdulot ng pagiging bansot, panghihina, at madaling pagkakasakit.
fact_bis: Ang malnutrisyon mahitabo kon kulang sa sustansya ang gikaon sa usa ka tawo, nga mahimong hinungdan og pagka-bansot, kaluya, ug sayon nga pagsakit.

q: A child touches a kalaw bird and notices it leaves no red color on their hand. Why?
options: The kalaw was washed recently so the paint came off earlier
The red color is natural to the bird's skin and bill, not paint
Only some kalaw birds have permanent color
The color is only visible in sunlight
explanation: The kalaw's red color is not paint — it is the natural color of its skin and bill, so it stays with the bird its whole life and cannot rub off.
fact_tl: Ang mapulang kulay ng kalaw ay hindi pintura na maaaring matanggal o makuskos. Ito ay likas na kulay ng kaniyang balat at tuka, kaya nananatili ito habang siya ay buhay.
fact_bis: Ang pula nga kolor sa kalaw dili pintura nga mahimong matanggal o makuskos. Kini natural nga kolor sa iyang panit ug sungo, mao nga magpabilin kini samtang buhi siya.

q: How do brittle stars move across the ocean floor, and how is this different from sea stars?
options: Brittle stars use their suction-cup tube feet like sea stars do
Brittle stars crawl slowly on the tips of stiff, spike-like arms
Brittle stars use snake-like arm movements and move rapidly, unlike the slower sea star
Brittle stars float using water currents while sea stars crawl
explanation: Brittle stars move quickly using rapid, snake-like arm movements, which is very different from the slow tube-foot movement of sea stars.
fact_tl: Ang brittle star (Ophiuroidea) ay iba sa sea star dahil ang kanyang mga braso ay manipis at mabilis na gumagalaw — ginagamit nito ang mga braso na may galaw na parang ahas para kumilos nang mabilis sa reef floor.
fact_bis: Ang brittle star (Ophiuroidea) lahi sa sea star tungod kay ang iyang mga bukton nipis ug paspas magalaw — naggamit kini og snake-like nga paglihok sa bukton aron molihok nga paspas sa lapak sa reef.

q: How is a cicada different from a locust?
options: Cicadas are much larger insects than locusts
Cicadas make noise while locusts are completely silent
Cicadas do not eat leaves or destroy crops the way locusts do
Cicadas live underground their whole lives while locusts live above ground
explanation: A cicada is not a locust — it does not eat leaves or destroy crops the way locusts do.
fact_tl: Ang kuliglig ay hindi balang; hindi ito kumakain ng dahon at hindi nakasisira ng pananim tulad ng balang.
fact_bis: Ang kuliglig dili dulon; dili kini mokaon ug dahon o moguba sa pananom sama sa dulon.

q: Which continent is the largest in the world?
options: Africa
Europe
North America
Asia
explanation: Asia is the largest continent in the world, covering about 44 million square kilometers.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking kontinente sa mundo ay ang Asia, na may sukat na mga 44 milyong kilometro kuwadrado.
fact_bis: Ang pinakadako nga kontinente sa kalibotan mao ang Asia, nga naglangkob ug mga 44 ka milyon ka kilometro kuwadrado.

q: If a red-flowered plant and a white-flowered plant are crossed, and the offspring have pink flowers, what type of inheritance is this?
options: Complete dominance
Co-dominance
Incomplete dominance
Recessive inheritance
explanation: In incomplete dominance, neither gene fully dominates, so the offspring shows a blended trait like pink flowers from red and white parents.
fact_tl: Sa incomplete dominance, walang gene na ganap na nananaig, kaya ang supling ay nagkakaroon ng pinaghalong katangian—gaya ng pink na bulaklak mula sa pula at puti.
fact_bis: Sa incomplete dominance, walay gene nga hingpit nga modaog, mao nga ang anak magpakita ug sinagol nga kinaiya—sama sa pink nga bulak gikan sa pula ug puti nga ginikanan.

q: After an earthquake, what danger should you check for that could cause a fire?
options: Loose tiles falling from roofs
The smell of leaking gas or broken electrical wires
Cracks in the road outside your house
Broken water pipes flooding the street
explanation: After an earthquake, you should check for leaking gas or broken electrical wires because these can start a fire.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng lindol, tingnan kung may amoy ng tumatagas na gas o nasirang kable ng kuryente, dahil maaari itong magdulot ng sunog.
fact_bis: Human sa linog, susiha kung adunay baho sa nagtulo nga gas o nadaot nga kable sa kuryente, kay mahimo kining hinungdan sa kalayo.

q: How long can the leaves (fronds) of the nipa palm grow?
options: About 50 centimeters
About 1 meter
About 3 meters
More than 5 meters
explanation: The leaves of the nipa palm are very long and can reach more than five meters in height.
fact_tl: Ang mga dahon ng nipa ay napakahaba at maaaring umabot nang mahigit sa limang metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang mga dahon sa nipa taas kaayo ug mahimong moabot ug kapin sa lima ka metro ang gitas-on.

q: How does a chrysalis attach itself to a branch or leaf?
options: It uses sticky liquid from its wings
It wraps itself with a cocoon of threads
It hangs upside down held by a small silk pad
It buries itself into the bark of the branch
explanation: Many chrysalises hang upside down from a branch or leaf by a small silk pad that anchors them in place.
fact_tl: Maraming chrysalis ang nakabitin nang patiwarik sa sanga o dahon sa pamamagitan ng maliit na unan ng seda.
fact_bis: Daghang chrysalis ang nagbitay nga balitaktak gikan sa sanga o dahon pinaagi sa gamay nga unlan nga seda.

q: What does the abbreviation DNA stand for?
options: Deoxyribonucleic acid
Dinitrogen amino acid
Deoxyribose nitrogenic atom
Double nucleic acid
explanation: DNA stands for deoxyribonucleic acid, the molecule that carries genetic information in living things.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay nangangahulugang deoxyribonucleic acid.
fact_bis: Ang DNA nagpasabot og deoxyribonucleic acid.

q: How are the tiny seeds of the rafflesia plant most likely spread to new locations?
options: They float on water to nearby rivers
They are blown by the wind to new vines
Animals like rats or deer carry them to other vines
Birds eat and then drop them in new forests
explanation: Rafflesia seeds are thought to be spread by animals like rats or deer that pick them up and carry them to other vines where a new plant can grow.
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ng Rafflesia ay napakaliit, at pinaniniwalaang naikakalat ng mga hayop tulad ng daga o usa na dumidikit sa mga ito at dinadala sa ibang baging kung saan maaaring tumubo ang bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Ang mga binhi sa Rafflesia gagmay kaayo, ug gituohan nga ginakatag kini sa mga hayop sama sa ilaga o usa nga modikit niini ug modala sa ubang liana diin makatubo ang bag-ong tanom.

q: Besides trees, which other plants can be used to make paper?
options: Corn and wheat
Bamboo and abaca
Rice and coconut
Banana and pineapple
explanation: Besides trees, paper can also be made from other plants like bamboo and abaca.
fact_tl: Bukod sa puno, ang papel ay maaari ring gawin mula sa ibang halaman tulad ng kawayan at abaka.
fact_bis: Gawas sa kahoy, ang papel mahimo usab buhaton gikan sa ubang tanom sama sa kawayan ug abaka.

q: Across the electromagnetic spectrum, what happens to frequency as wavelength gets shorter?
options: Frequency also gets shorter
Frequency stays the same regardless of wavelength
Frequency gets higher
Frequency becomes unpredictable
explanation: Across the electromagnetic spectrum, a shorter wavelength means a higher frequency — they are inversely related.
fact_tl: Sa buong spectrum, kapag mas maikli ang wavelength ay mas mataas ang frequency — magkabaligtad sila.
fact_bis: Sa tibuok spectrum, kung mas mubo ang wavelength mas taas ang frequency — baligtad sila.

q: Why does a planet orbit the Sun instead of falling straight into it?
options: The planet is repelled by the Sun's magnetic field
The planet moves sideways fast enough that it keeps missing the Sun while falling toward it
The planet is too far away for the Sun's gravity to pull it in
The planet pushes against the Sun's gravity using its own gravity
explanation: A planet is always falling toward the Sun, but it also moves sideways so fast that it keeps missing, resulting in an orbit.
fact_tl: Ang planeta ay parang patuloy na nahuhulog patungo sa Araw, ngunit gumagalaw din ito patagilid kaya laging "sumasala" at umiikot sa halip.
fact_bis: Ang planeta kanunay nga nahulog padulong sa Adlaw, apan naglihok usab kini sa kilid, mao nga kanunay kining "masipyat" ug magtuyok hinuon.

q: What is the chemical formula for table salt?
options: KCl
HCl
NaCl
MgO
explanation: The chemical formula of table salt is NaCl, which stands for sodium chloride.
fact_tl: Ang kemikal na pormula ng asin sa mesa (table salt) ay NaCl — sodium chloride.
fact_bis: Ang kemikal nga pormula sa asin sa lamesa (table salt) kay NaCl — sodium chloride.

q: Who developed the theory of relativity and the famous equation E=mc squared?
options: Isaac Newton
Nikola Tesla
Albert Einstein
Stephen Hawking
explanation: Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity and the famous equation E=mc squared, which relates energy and mass.
fact_tl: Si Albert Einstein ang gumawa ng teorya ng relativity at ng tanyag na ekwasyon na E=mc².
fact_bis: Si Albert Einstein mao ang naghimo sa teorya sa relativity ug sa bantog nga ekwasyon nga E=mc².

q: What do we call a physical change that can happen over and over again, like water turning to vapor and then back to water droplets as rain?
options: An irreversible chemical change
A reversible physical change
A permanent state change
A one-way transformation
explanation: Evaporation and condensation are reversible physical changes that repeat over and over in the water cycle, like in rain.
fact_tl: Ang pagsingaw at pagbalik nito bilang patak ng tubig ay pisikal na pagbabago na paulit-ulit na nagaganap, gaya sa pag-ulan.
fact_bis: Ang pagsingaw ug pagbalik niini isip tulo sa tubig kay pisikal nga kausaban nga balik-balik nga mahitabo, sama sa ulan.

q: Why do some plants produce poison in their leaves?
options: To attract insects for pollination
To help them absorb more sunlight
So that animals that eat them will get sick and avoid the plant
To store extra energy they produce from photosynthesis
explanation: Some plants make poison in their leaves as a defense so that any animal that eats them will get sick, discouraging further eating.
fact_tl: May mga halaman na gumagawa ng lason sa kanilang mga dahon para magkasakit ang kakain sa kanila.
fact_bis: Adunay mga tanom nga naghimog hilo sa ilang mga dahon aron magsakit ang mokaon kanila.

q: What happens to a fire if its supply of oxygen is completely cut off?
options: It burns more intensely
It changes color but keeps burning
It goes out
It burns more slowly but does not stop
explanation: Fire needs oxygen to burn, so a flame goes out when the oxygen supply is cut off.
fact_tl: Kailangan ng oxygen para magliyab ang apoy, kaya ang sunog ay namamatay kapag wala nito.
fact_bis: Ang kalayo nagkinahanglan og oxihena aron modilaab, mao nga mapalong kini kon walay oxihena.

q: Long ago, what did people make from certain oak galls?
options: A sweet syrup for cooking
A medicine for fever
Dark black ink for writing
A dye for coloring fabric red
explanation: Long ago, people used certain oak galls to make dark black ink for writing.
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ginagamit ang ilang oak gall para gumawa ng matingkad na itim na tinta para sa pagsulat.
fact_bis: Kaniadto, ang pipila ka oak gall gigamit aron maghimo ug itom nga tinta alang sa pagsulat.

q: How does a compass help sailors when there are no landmarks in sight?
options: It measures the distance to the nearest shore
It shows the depth of the water below the ship
It tells sailors the right direction to travel
It predicts the weather for the next day
explanation: A compass helps sailors and travelers know the right direction to travel even when there are no landmarks visible.
fact_tl: Tumutulong ang kompas sa mga marino at mananalakbay na malaman ang tamang direksiyon kahit walang landmark.
fact_bis: Ang compass nagtabang sa mga marinero ug magpapanaw nga mahibaw-an ang husto nga direksiyon bisan walay timailhan.

q: What does a DART buoy detect to warn people about tsunamis?
options: Changes in water temperature near the ocean floor
Changes in pressure on the ocean floor when a tsunami passes
Changes in wind speed above the ocean surface
Changes in the color of seawater caused by earthquakes
explanation: DART buoys are underwater pressure sensors that detect the pressure change caused by a passing tsunami and send a warning by satellite.
fact_tl: Ang DART (Deep-ocean Assessment and Reporting of Tsunamis) buoys ay mga underwater pressure sensors na nakadikit sa ocean floor; kapag ang isang tsunami ay dumaan, ang sensor ay nakita ang pagbabago ng presyon at nagpadala ng mensahe sa satellite para alertuhin ang mga sentro ng babala.
fact_bis: Ang DART (Deep-ocean Assessment and Reporting of Tsunamis) buoys mga underwater pressure sensors nga gikabit sa ilawom sa dagat; kon ang usa ka tsunami moagi, ang sensor naka-detect sa pagbag-o sa presyon ug nagpadala og mensahe pinaagi sa satellite ngadto sa mga sentro sa babala.

q: How do fish get the oxygen they need to survive?
options: They breathe air through a small hole on top of their head
They use gills to take in oxygen dissolved in the water
They store air bubbles inside their body for breathing
They absorb oxygen through their skin from the air
explanation: Fish use gills to extract oxygen that is dissolved in the water — they do not breathe air the way humans do.
fact_tl: Ang isda ay gumagamit ng oxygen na natunaw sa tubig, na sinasalo ng kanilang hasang — hindi sila humihinga ng oxygen mula sa hangin tulad natin.
fact_bis: Ang isda mogamit og oxygen nga natunaw sa tubig, nga sakpon sa ilang hasang — dili sila moginhawa og oxygen gikan sa hangin sama kanato.

q: Which metal is the best conductor of electricity and heat?
options: Gold
Copper
Iron
Silver
explanation: Silver is the best metal at conducting both electricity and heat of all the metals.
fact_tl: Ang pilak ang pinakamahusay na metal sa paghahatid ng kuryente at init kaysa sa lahat ng metal.
fact_bis: Ang plata mao ang labing maayo nga metal sa paghatod sa koryente ug init kay sa tanang metal.

q: What does the tip of the gumamela's pistil look like, and what is its job?
options: It is a single smooth tip that releases pollen into the air
It splits into five tiny knobs where pollen sticks to
It has one large sticky pad at the top to catch insects
It splits into three thin spikes that produce nectar
explanation: The tip of the gumamela's pistil splits into five tiny knobs, and this is where pollen sticks during pollination.
fact_tl: Ang dulo ng pistil ng gumamela ay nahahati sa lima na parang maliliit na bola, dito dumidikit ang pollen.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa pistil sa gumamela nabahin sa lima ka gagmay nga bola diin nagpilit ang pollen.

q: Which insect's larvae spin the silk used to make fabric?
options: The luna moth, whose caterpillars feed on oak leaves
The domestic silkworm (Bombyx mori), whose larvae feed on mulberry leaves
The monarch butterfly, whose caterpillars feed on milkweed
The atlas moth, whose caterpillars feed on cinnamon leaves
explanation: The domestic silkworm, Bombyx mori, is a moth species whose larvae feed on mulberry leaves and spin the silk used in making fabric.
fact_tl: Ang domestic silkworm (Bombyx mori) ay isang uri ng moth na ang mga larva ay kumakain ng dahon ng mulberry at gumagawa ng sutla para gamitin sa tela.
fact_bis: Ang domestic silkworm (Bombyx mori) usa ka klase sa moth nga ang mga larva nagkaon sa dahon sa mulberry ug nagpiko og sutla nga gamiton sa paghimo og tela.

q: What is the difference between simple and complex carbohydrates?
options: Simple carbs have fiber while complex carbs turn into energy quickly
Simple carbs turn into energy quickly while complex carbs digest slowly and contain fiber
Both types digest at the same speed but complex carbs have more calories
Simple carbs are found in vegetables and complex carbs are only in sweets
explanation: Simple carbohydrates provide quick energy, while complex carbohydrates digest slowly and contain fiber.
fact_tl: May simpleng karbohaydrat na mabilis maging enerhiya, at kompleks na karbohaydrat na unti-unting natutunaw at may hibla.
fact_bis: Adunay simpleng karbohaydrat nga paspas mahimong kusog, ug kompleks nga karbohaydrat nga hinay matunaw ug adunay hibla.

q: How is coconut sugar made?
options: By crushing dried coconut meat and mixing it with water
By boiling the sweet sap from the coconut flower until it thickens
By fermenting coconut water with special bacteria
By squeezing the liquid from fresh coconut leaves
explanation: The sweet sap from the coconut flower is boiled down until it thickens into coconut sugar, a natural sweetener.
fact_tl: Ang matamis na katas mula sa bulaklak ng niyog ay maaaring pakuluan hanggang lumapot at maging asukal ng niyog, isang likas na pampatamis.
fact_bis: Ang tam-is nga duga gikan sa bulak sa lubi mahimong pabukalan hangtod molapot ug mahimong asukal sa lubi, usa ka natural nga pangtam-is.

q: What does a pufferfish actually swallow underwater to puff up its body?
options: Air, which it gulps from the surface before diving
Water, which it gulps in large amounts to inflate
Gas produced by special cells inside its stomach
Sand and small rocks to weigh itself down
explanation: Many people think a pufferfish fills with air, but underwater it actually gulps water, not air, to puff up.
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakala na hangin ang ipinapasok ng butete para mamaga, pero sa ilalim ng dagat, TUBIG ang sinisipsip nito — hindi hangin.
fact_bis: Daghan ang nagtuo nga hangin ang gisulod sa butete aron mohubag, apan sa ilalom sa dagat, TUBIG ang gisuyop niini — dili hangin.

q: How does the pipefish hide from predators in its seagrass habitat?
options: It changes color rapidly to match the color of sand and rocks
It buries itself under the sand and stays still until danger passes
It swims vertically like a seahorse and blends with coral branches
It has an elongated straight body that mimics the shape of seagrass leaves
explanation: The pipefish hides by mimicking the shape of leaves with its elongated, straight body while living horizontally among seagrass.
fact_tl: Ang pipefish ay kamag-anak ng seahorse (parehong nasa pamilya Syngnathidae) ngunit mas matulis ang katawan nito; namumuhay ito sa halos patayong posisyon sa gitna ng seagrass at nagtago sa pamamagitan ng pagtulad ng hugis ng mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang pipefish paryenti sa seahorse (pareho sa pamilya Syngnathidae) apan adunay mas tuwid nga taas nga lawas; nagpuyo kini halos patindog taliwala sa seagrass ug nagtago pinaagi sa pagtulad sa porma sa mga dahon.

q: What is piña-seda cloth made of?
options: Pineapple fiber blended with silk to make the cloth stronger
Pineapple fiber blended with cotton to make it softer
Banana fiber blended with silk from the Bombyx mori moth
Abaca fiber blended with pineapple fiber for extra strength
explanation: Piña-seda is made by blending pineapple fiber with silk, which makes the cloth stronger.
fact_tl: Minsan ang hibla ng pinya ay hinahalo sa seda upang gawing mas matibay ang tela, na tinatawag na piña-seda.
fact_bis: Usahay ang lanot sa pinya isagol sa seda aron mahimong mas lig-on ang panapton, gitawag nga piña-seda.

q: What is magnetic declination?
options: The strength of Earth's magnetic field at a given location
The difference between magnetic north and true geographic north
The angle at which a compass needle tilts toward the ground
The speed at which Earth's magnetic poles move each year
explanation: Magnetic declination is the difference between magnetic north (where a compass points) and true geographic north (Earth's rotation axis), which varies by location.
fact_tl: Ang magnetic north (kung saan nakatungo ang compass needle) at ang tunay na geographic north (ang rotation axis ng Earth) ay hindi eksaktong parehong lugar; ang pagkakaiba sa pagitan ng dalawa ay tinatawag na magnetic declination, na nagbabago ayon sa lokasyon at kailangan itong isaalang-alang para sa tumpak na navigation.
fact_bis: Ang magnetic north (diin nagatudlo ang compass needle) ug ang tunay nga geographic north (ang rotation axis sa Yuta) dili eksaktong samang lugar; ang kalainan tali sa duha ginganlan og magnetic declination, nga nagbabago sumala sa lokasyon ug kinahanglan isipon alang sa tukma nga navigation.

q: What do scientists believe about crocodiles and color vision?
options: Crocodiles can only see in black and white, day or night
Crocodiles can only see colors at night using their special eyes
Crocodiles can see colors during the day, which helps them recognize animals and surroundings
Crocodiles are completely blind and rely only on smell to hunt
explanation: Scientists believe crocodiles can see colors during the day, which helps them recognize animals and their surroundings when it is bright.
fact_tl: Naniniwala ang mga siyentipiko na nakakakita ng kulay ang buwaya kapag araw, hindi lang itim at puti. Tumutulong ito para makilala ang mga hayop at kapaligiran nito kapag maliwanag.
fact_bis: Nagtuo ang mga siyentista nga makakita og kolor ang buaya kung adlaw, dili lang itom ug puti. Makatabang kini aron mailhan ang mga hayop ug ang ilang palibot kung hayag.

q: Why is April and May so hot in the Philippines?
options: The Philippines moves closer to the Sun during these months
The Sun's rays hit the Philippines more directly near the equator during the dry season
Typhoons block cool ocean winds, making the air much warmer than usual
The ozone layer becomes thinner over the Philippines in summer
explanation: Near the equator, the Sun's rays hit the Philippines more directly during the dry season, making April and May especially hot.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, lalo nating nararamdaman ang lakas ng higanteng Araw tuwing tag-init dahil mas tuwid na tumatama ang sikat nito sa atin malapit sa ekwador. Kaya't napakainit kapag Abril at Mayo. Mabuting magdala ng payong o magsuot ng sunscreen kapag tirik na ang Araw.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, mas mabati nato ang gahum sa higante nga Adlaw panahon sa ting-init kay mas tul-id ang silaw niini kanato duol sa ekwador. Mao nga init kaayo sa Abril ug Mayo. Maayo nga magdala og payong o magsul-ob og sunscreen kung taas na ang Adlaw.

q: Where does the baya weaver bird typically build its nest?
options: In dry desert areas, weaving its nest from dried grass and feathers
Near rice fields and water, using long blades of grass
In mountain forests, attaching its nest to tall pine trees
On rocky cliffs by the sea, using seaweed and mud
explanation: The baya weaver is a weaverbird of Asia that often nests near rice fields and water using long blades of grass.
fact_tl: Ang baya weaver ay isang ibong manghahabi sa Asya na madalas namumugad malapit sa palayan at tubig gamit ang mahahabang talahib.
fact_bis: Ang baya weaver usa ka manghahabi nga langgam sa Asya nga kasagaran nagsalag duol sa kaumahan ug tubig gamit ang taas nga sagbot.

q: What do the microbes that make yogurt and bagoong have in common with other living things?
options: They are chemicals that break down food without eating or multiplying
They feed on parts of the food and multiply just like other living things do
They produce heat that cooks the food from the inside
They are dead organisms that leave behind flavors in the food
explanation: The microbes that make yogurt and bagoong are living organisms that feed on parts of the food and multiply like other living things.
fact_tl: Ang mga mikrobyong gumagawa ng yogurt at bagoong ay buhay na organismo na kumakain ng sangkap ng pagkain at dumarami tulad ng ibang nabubuhay.
fact_bis: Ang mga mikrobyo nga naghimo og yogurt ug bagoong buhi nga organismo nga mokaon sa bahin sa pagkaon ug modaghan sama sa ubang buhing butang.

q: Why are big tornadoes rare in the Philippines compared to the United States?
options: The Philippines has too many mountains that stop wind from spinning into a tornado
Big tornadoes form in wide plains where large cold and warm air masses collide, which happens more in America
The Philippine ocean waters are too warm for tornado clouds to form overhead
Typhoons in the Philippines release all the energy that would otherwise make tornadoes
explanation: Big tornadoes happen more often in the wide plains of America where large cold and warm air masses collide; the Philippines does not have the same conditions.
fact_tl: Bihira ang malalaking tornado sa Pilipinas; mas madalas itong nangyayari sa malalawak na kapatagan ng Amerika kung saan nagbabanggaan ang malamig at mainit na malalaking masa ng hangin.
fact_bis: Talagsaon ang dagkong tornado sa Pilipinas; mas kanunay kini mahitabo sa lapad nga kapatagan sa Amerika diin magbangga ang dagkong bugnaw ug init nga masa sa hangin.

q: What is bioremediation?
options: Using heat and chemicals to burn toxic waste from oil spills in the ocean
Using bacteria or microorganisms to break down toxic chemicals in the environment
Filtering polluted water through layers of sand and charcoal to remove chemicals
Pumping oxygen into polluted soil to speed up the natural breakdown of dirt
explanation: Bioremediation uses bacteria or other microorganisms to break down toxic chemicals; certain bacteria can digest hydrocarbons from oil spills in the ocean.
fact_tl: Ang bioremediation ay ang paggamit ng mga bacteria o iba pang microorganism upang sirain ang mga nakalalason na kemikal sa kalikasan — ang ilang bacteria ay kayang kumain ng mga hydrocarbon sa langis na natumba sa dagat.
fact_bis: Ang bioremediation mao ang paggamit sa mga bakterya o uban pang microorganism aron bungkagon ang mga makalalason nga kemikal sa kalikasan — ang pipila ka bakterya makahimo sa pag-digest sa mga hydrocarbon gikan sa oil spill sa dagat.

q: About how much blood does an adult body contain?
options: About one to two liters
About three to four liters
About five to six liters
About ten to twelve liters
explanation: An adult body holds about five to six liters of blood.
fact_tl: Ang isang malaking tao ay may humigit-kumulang lima hanggang anim na litro ng dugo sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hamtong nga tawo adunay mga lima ngadto sa unom ka litro nga dugo sa lawas.

q: Why was liquid mercury once used in thermometers?
options: Because it is transparent and lets light through so you can read the number easily
Because it expands evenly when warmed and rises in a thin tube to show temperature
Because it is safe to touch and does not evaporate when the thermometer breaks
Because it changes color at different temperatures, making the reading clear
explanation: Liquid mercury was used in thermometers because it expands evenly when warmed, allowing it to climb up a thin tube so we can read the temperature.
fact_tl: Ginamit dati ang likidong mercury sa mga thermometro dahil pantay-pantay itong lumalaki kapag uminit. Habang tumataas ang init, umaakyat ang mercury sa manipis na tubo, kaya nababasa natin ang temperatura—isang gamit ng likidong metal.
fact_bis: Gigamit kaniadto ang likidong mercury sa mga termometro kay patas kini nga molapad kung moinit. Samtang motaas ang kainit, mosaka ang mercury sa nipis nga tubo, mao nga mabasa nato ang temperatura, usa ka gamit sa likidong metal.

q: How are the coffee beans for kape alamid obtained?
options: They are picked from trees growing in the rainforest before they ripen
They are collected from civet droppings, then cleaned and washed
They are fermented underwater in bamboo tubes for several weeks
They are dried inside coconut shells to give them a special flavor
explanation: Kape alamid is made from coffee beans collected from civet droppings, which are then cleaned and washed.
fact_tl: Ang kape alamid ay gawa sa mga buto ng kapeng kinuha mula sa dumi ng musang, pagkatapos ay nililinis at hinuhugasan.
fact_bis: Ang kape alamid hinimo gikan sa mga buto sa kape nga gikuha sa hugaw sa musang, dayon limpyohan ug hugasan.

q: Why can you smell perfume from across a room even though you did not move toward it?
options: Heat from your body attracts the scent and pulls it toward you through the air
Scent molecules spread through the air on their own by a process called diffusion
The fan in the room blows the perfume molecules in your direction
Perfume evaporates so fast that it fills the entire room in under one second
explanation: Scent molecules spread through the air by diffusion, which is why you can smell perfume across a room without moving toward it.
fact_tl: Kapag nagbukas ka ng pabango sa isang sulok ng kwarto, naaamoy mo ito sa kabilang dulo dahil kumakalat ang mga molekula ng amoy sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng diffusion.
fact_bis: Kon mag-abli ka og pahumot sa usa ka eskina sa kwarto, masimhutan nimo kini sa pikas tumoy tungod kay mikatag ang mga molekula sa humot sa hangin pinaagi sa diffusion.

q: Why is aluminum used in making airplane parts, cans, and foil?
options: Because it is the hardest metal and resists being scratched or damaged
Because it is lightweight, making it useful for products where low weight matters
Because it is the cheapest metal to mine and process from the ground
Because it never rusts or reacts with any chemicals, even strong acids
explanation: Aluminum is lightweight, which is why it is used in cans, aluminum foil, pots, window frames, and airplane parts.
fact_tl: Ang aluminum (aluminyo) ay magaan kaya ginagamit sa mga lata, aluminum foil, kawali, bintana, at bahagi ng eroplano.
fact_bis: Ang aluminum (aluminyo) magaan maong gigamit sa mga lata, aluminum foil, kaldero, bintana, ug mga parte sa eroplano.

q: What is the birthstone for November, and what color is it usually?
options: Ruby, which is usually deep red in color
Sapphire, which is usually bright blue in color
Topaz, which is often yellow or golden in color
Opal, which shows many colors at once
explanation: The birthstone for November is the topaz, which is often yellow or golden in color.
fact_tl: Ang birthstone para sa Nobyembre ay ang topaz (topasyo), na kadalasang dilaw o ginto ang kulay.
fact_bis: Ang birthstone para sa Nobyembre kay ang topaz (topasyo), nga kasagaran dilaw o bulawan og kolor.

q: In what year was Charon, the moon of Pluto, discovered?
explanation: Charon, the moon of Pluto, was discovered in the year 1978.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Charon, buwan ng Pluto, noong taong 1978.
fact_bis: Nadiskobre ang Charon, bulan sa Pluto, sa tuig 1978.

q: What is the main role of the brain in the human body?
options: It pumps blood to all organs and keeps the heart beating steadily
It filters waste from the blood and sends it out of the body as urine
It is the body's control center — it thinks, commands movement, and stores memories
It produces hormones that control how fast the body grows
explanation: The brain is the body's control center; it thinks, commands movement, and stores memories.
fact_tl: Ang utak ang sentro ng kontrol ng katawan; ito ang nag-iisip, nag-uutos sa kilos, at nag-iimbak ng mga alaala.
fact_bis: Ang utok mao ang sentro sa pagdumala sa lawas; kini ang naghunahuna, nagsugo sa lihok, ug nagtipig sa mga panumduman.

q: Why does a ball bounce back up after you drop it on the floor?
options: Gravity pulls the ball upward again once it touches the ground
Air pressure under the ball pushes it back up from below
The ball's shape changes when it hits, then it springs back and pushes against the floor, sending it upward
The ball stores heat from the fall and releases it as upward movement
explanation: When a force squeezes a springy object, its shape changes and then it springs back, pushing against whatever pressed it — that is why a ball bounces.
fact_tl: Kapag may force na dumidiin sa isang bagay tulad ng spring o goma, nagbabago muna ang hugis nito — pero pagkatapos, bumabalik ito sa dati at tinutulak pabalik ang nagdiin dito. Kaya tumatalbog ang bola at bumabalik ang trampolin: ang nabagong hugis ang nagbibigay ng panibagong force.
fact_bis: Kung adunay force nga moipit sa usa ka butang sama sa spring o goma, mausab una ang porma niini — apan unya, mobalik kini sa karaan ug moduso balik sa nagpiit niini. Mao nga motalbog ang bola ug mobalik ang trampolin: ang nausab nga porma maoy mohatag og bag-ong force.

q: What happens when a guitar string is plucked at its natural frequency?
options: The string vibrates slower and slower until it stops making sound
The string's waves cancel each other out, producing silence
The waves add up and the string vibrates with greater amplitude due to resonance
The string breaks because the frequency is too strong for it to handle
explanation: Resonance happens when something is pushed at its natural frequency, so the waves add up and grow in amplitude, as in a guitar string.
fact_tl: Ang resonance ay nangyayari kapag ang isang bagay ay tinutulak sa natural na frequency nito, kaya't ang mga alon ay nagdadagdag at lumalaki ang amplitude, tulad sa kuwerdas ng gitara o hangin sa loob ng plawta.
fact_bis: Ang resonance mahitabo kung ang usa ka butang itulod sa natural niini nga frequency, mao nga ang mga balod magdugang ug modako ang amplitude, sama sa kwerdas sa gitara o sa hangin sulod sa plawta.

q: Why do Palawan and Borneo share many of the same animal species?
options: Scientists moved animals between the two islands for conservation programs
Palawan was once connected to Borneo by a land bridge when sea levels were lower
Birds carried seeds and small animals between the two islands over thousands of years
Palawan and Borneo have the same type of forest, so the same animals evolved there
explanation: Palawan was once connected to Borneo by land exposed when the sea was low, which is why their animals are so alike.
fact_tl: Konektado dati ang Palawan sa Borneo sa pamamagitan ng lupang nalantad noong mababa ang dagat, kaya magkahawig ang kanilang mga hayop.
fact_bis: Ang Palawan kaniadto nakonektar sa Borneo pinaagi sa yuta nga nadayag dihang ubos ang dagat, mao nga managsama ang ilang mga mananap.

q: What are the four life stages of a butterfly in order?
options: Larva, egg, pupa, adult butterfly
Egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, adult butterfly
Caterpillar, cocoon, pupa, adult butterfly
Egg, pupa, caterpillar, adult butterfly
explanation: A butterfly goes through four life stages in order: egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, and adult butterfly.
fact_tl: Ang paru-paro ay dumaraan sa apat na yugto ng buhay: itlog, uod, supot (chrysalis), at paru-paro.
fact_bis: Ang alibangbang moagi sa upat ka hugna sa kinabuhi: itlog, ulod, supot (chrysalis), ug alibangbang.

q: How many spring tides and neap tides occur in a single month?
options: One spring tide and one neap tide
Three spring tides and three neap tides
Four spring tides and one neap tide
Two spring tides and two neap tides
explanation: Each month has two spring tides and two neap tides.
fact_tl: Bawat buwan ay may dalawang spring tide at dalawang neap tide.
fact_bis: Matag bulan adunay duha ka spring tide ug duha ka neap tide.

q: Why are there more micro-organisms in some parts of a pond than others?
options: Micro-organisms are evenly spread throughout all parts of a pond
Micro-organisms gather in the deepest parts where it is coldest and darkest
There are more micro-organisms where there is enough light, warmth, and food
Micro-organisms only live near the surface where they can breathe air
explanation: Micro-organisms in ponds are more numerous in parts with enough light, warmth, and food, so their numbers are not equal in every drop of water.
fact_tl: Mas marami ang mikroorganismo sa bahagi ng lawa na may sapat na liwanag, init, at pagkain, kaya hindi pantay ang dami nila sa bawat patak ng tubig.
fact_bis: Mas daghan ang mikroorganismo sa bahin sa danaw nga adunay igong kahayag, kainit, ug pagkaon, mao nga dili patas ang ilang gidaghanon sa matag tulo sa tubig.

q: What is the main difference between evaporation and boiling?
options: Evaporation needs a heat source while boiling can happen at any temperature
Evaporation happens only in salty water while boiling happens in fresh water
Evaporation happens at the water's surface at any temperature, while boiling happens throughout the liquid only at 100°C
Evaporation turns water into ice while boiling turns water into steam
explanation: Evaporation happens at the surface of water at any temperature, while boiling happens throughout the liquid and only at 100°C at sea level.
fact_tl: Ang pagsingaw ay nangyayari sa ibabaw ng tubig sa anumang temperatura. Ang pagkulo ay nangyayari sa buong likido at sa isang tiyak na temperatura lamang (100 Celsius para sa tubig sa kaantasan ng dagat).
fact_bis: Ang pagsingaw mahitabo sa ibabaw sa tubig sa bisan unsang temperatura. Ang pagkulo mahitabo sa tibuok likido ug sa usa lamang ka tiyak nga temperatura (100 C para sa tubig sa sea level).

q: How do termites help the forest ecosystem?
options: They pollinate forest flowers and spread seeds to help new trees grow
They eat leaves from trees, letting more sunlight reach the forest floor
They break down dead trees and branches, returning nutrients to the soil
They control the population of other insects by hunting and eating them
explanation: In the forest, termites act as decomposers by breaking down dead trees and branches, returning nutrients to the soil for new plants to grow.
fact_tl: Sa kagubatan, hindi laging masama ang anay. Tumutulong sila bilang decomposer na bumubulok ng mga patay na puno at sanga. Sa ganitong paraan, nababalik sa lupa ang sustansya para sa bagong halaman.
fact_bis: Sa lasang, dili kanunay daotan ang anay. Motabang sila isip decomposer nga modunot sa patay nga kahoy ug sanga. Pinaagi niini, mobalik sa yuta ang sustansya alang sa bag-ong tanom.

q: What makes the tears that keep your eyes moist?
options: Your eyelids squeeze tiny drops of water out of your eye each time you blink
Small parts above your eye called lacrimal glands make your tears
Blood vessels in the eye release water slowly to keep the surface wet
A layer of oil under your eyelid melts and spreads over the eye as tears
explanation: Small parts above your eye called lacrimal glands make your tears, always producing a little bit so your eye never dries out.
fact_tl: May maliliit na bahagi sa itaas ng iyong mata na tinatawag na lacrimal glands. Dito ginagawa ang luha! Lagi silang gumagawa ng kaunting luha para hindi matuyo ang iyong mata.
fact_bis: Adunay gagmay nga mga bahin sa ibabaw sa imong mata nga gitawag og lacrimal glands. Dinhi gibuhat ang luha! Kanunay silang naghimo og gamay nga luha aron dili mauga ang imong mata.

q: What is special about Tubbataha Reef in the Philippines?
options: It is the longest coral reef in Southeast Asia and is used for fishing all year round
It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Philippines' most protected marine sanctuaries
It is the only reef in the world where sharks and dolphins live together in large groups
It is an artificial reef built by the government to replace reefs destroyed by typhoons
explanation: Tubbataha Reef in the Sulu Sea is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Philippines' most protected marine sanctuaries.
fact_tl: Ang Tubbataha Reef sa Sulu Sea ay isang UNESCO World Heritage Site at isa sa pinakaprotektadong marine sanctuary sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Tubbataha Reef sa Sulu Sea usa ka UNESCO World Heritage Site ug usa sa pinaka-protektadong marine sanctuary sa Pilipinas.

q: In what year was the neutron discovered?
explanation: The neutron was discovered in the year 1932.
fact_tl: Natuklas ang neutron noong taong 1932.
fact_bis: Ang neutron nadiskubre niadtong tuig 1932.

q: If an elephant and a mouse run at the same speed, which one is harder to stop and why?
options: The mouse, because small animals can change direction faster than large ones
The elephant, because it has much more mass, giving it much greater momentum
They are equally hard to stop because they are moving at the same speed
The elephant, because its large feet create more friction with the ground
explanation: The elephant has much more momentum because it is so heavy — even at the same speed, greater mass means greater momentum and makes it much harder to stop.
fact_tl: Kung ang elepante at daga ay tumakbo sa parehong bilis, mas malaki ang momentum ng elepante dahil sobrang bigat nito. Kaya't mas mahirap pigilan ang tumatakbong elepante kaysa sa daga.
fact_bis: Kung ang elepante ug ilaga modagan sa parehas nga katulin, mas dako ang momentum sa elepante tungod kay bug-at kaayo kini. Mao nga mas lisod pugngan ang nagdagan nga elepante kaysa ilaga.

q: Where is the Samar Sea located?
options: East of Samar Island, between Samar and the Pacific Ocean
South of Mindanao, near the Celebes Sea and Tawi-Tawi
North of Luzon, between Batanes and the Babuyan Islands
West of Samar Island, near Masbate and the San Bernardino Strait
explanation: The Samar Sea lies west of Samar Island, near Masbate and the San Bernardino Strait.
fact_tl: Ang Dagat Samar (Samar Sea) ay nasa kanluran ng isla ng Samar, malapit sa Masbate at sa Kipot ng San Bernardino.
fact_bis: Ang Dagat Samar (Samar Sea) anaa sa kasadpan sa isla sa Samar, duol sa Masbate ug sa Kipot sa San Bernardino.

q: What kind of shell do most reptile eggs have, and where are they laid?
options: A hard shell like a bird's egg, laid underwater in rivers and lakes
A leathery shell, laid on land
A soft, gel-like shell, laid in moist soil underground
A thick, rubbery shell, laid inside the mother's pouch
explanation: Most reptiles lay eggs on land, and their eggs have a leathery shell.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng reptilya ay nangingitlog sa lupa, at ang kanilang mga itlog ay may makunat na balat.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga reptilya mangitlog sa yuta, ug ang ilang mga itlog adunay makunat nga panit.

q: Why does a rock fall faster than a feather when dropped from the same height?
options: Because the rock is heavier, gravity pulls it down with a stronger force
Because the feather has less gravity pulling on it than the rock does
Because air resistance slows down the feather more than it slows the rock
Because feathers spin in the air, which makes them move sideways instead of down
explanation: Without air, both objects would fall at the same time; the rock falls faster than a feather because air resistance slows the feather much more, not because of the difference in weight alone.
fact_tl: Maraming bata ang nag-aakalang ang mas mabigat na bagay ay laging mas mabilis bumagsak. Ang totoo, kung walang hangin na humahadlang, ang isang malaking bato at maliit na bato ay sabay na bumabagsak. Ang dahilan kung bakit mas mabilis bumagsak ang bato kaysa balahibo ay dahil sa hangin, hindi sa bigat.
fact_bis: Daghang bata ang naghunahuna nga ang mas bug-at nga butang kanunay mas paspas mahulog. Ang tinuod, kung walay hangin nga makababag, ang dako nga bato ug gamay nga bato dungan nga mahulog. Ang rason nganong mas paspas mahulog ang bato kaysa balhibo kay tungod sa hangin, dili sa kabug-at.

q: How are germs different from the cells in your own body?
options: Germs are a type of body cell that has mutated and turned harmful
Germs are not alive — they are toxic chemicals released by other organisms
Germs are separate living things that are foreign to our body, not part of it
Germs are our own cells that grow too fast and need to be removed
explanation: Germs are separate living things, not part of our body — they are different from our own cells, so the body recognizes them as foreign and fights them.
fact_tl: Ang germs ay ibang nabubuhay na bagay, hindi bahagi ng katawan natin. Iba sila sa cells nating sariling atin. Kaya kapag pumasok sila, kinikilala sila ng katawan bilang banyaga at nilalabanan.
fact_bis: Ang germs kay lahi nga buhi nga mga butang, dili bahin sa atong lawas. Lahi sila sa atong kaugalingong cells. Mao nga kung mosulod sila, mailhan sila sa lawas isip langyaw ug awayon.

q: How were many of the Philippine islands formed?
options: They broke off from the Asian continent when a giant earthquake split the land
They were formed from volcanoes and from the movement of tectonic plates under the sea
They were built up over millions of years entirely from coral reefs growing above the water
They were once part of Australia and drifted northward to their current position
explanation: Many Philippine islands were formed from volcanoes and from the movement of huge tectonic plates under the sea, which is why there are many volcanoes and earthquakes here.
fact_tl: Maraming pulo sa Pilipinas ay nabuo mula sa mga bulkan at sa paggalaw ng malalaking bahagi ng lupa sa ilalim ng dagat na tinatawag na tectonic plates. Kaya nga maraming bulkan at lindol dito.
fact_bis: Daghang isla sa Pilipinas naporma gikan sa mga bolkan ug sa paglihok sa dagkong mga bahin sa yuta ilawom sa dagat nga gitawag og tectonic plates. Mao nga daghan og bolkan ug linog diri.

q: In biology, what is a host?
options: An animal that helps a smaller animal find food and shelter by being its partner
The organism that a parasite lives on or in and gets its food or shelter from
A plant that attracts insects so they will carry its pollen to another flower
The largest animal in a group that leads and protects the others
explanation: A host is the organism that a parasite lives on or in and gets its food or shelter from.
fact_tl: Ang host ay ang organismong tinitirhan ng parasito at pinagkukunan nito ng pagkain o tirahan.
fact_bis: Ang host mao ang organismo nga gipuy-an sa parasito ug gikuhaan niini og pagkaon o puy-anan.

q: Why does a young insect living inside a plant gall feed on the gall's inner tissue?
options: The inner gall tissue is hard and helps the insect sharpen its mouthparts
The inner tissue contains poison that protects the insect from predators
The inside of a gall often has a special, nutritious tissue that the young insect eats
The inner gall tissue stays moist and gives the insect all the water it needs
explanation: The inside of a gall often has a special, nutritious tissue that the young insect eats.
fact_tl: Ang loob ng gall ay madalas may espesyal at masustansyang tisyu na siyang kinakain ng batang insekto.
fact_bis: Ang sulod sa gall sagad adunay espesyal ug masustansyang tisyu nga ginakaon sa batan-ong insekto.

q: Why do makahiya leaves fold shut when you touch them?
options: The leaves tighten up because special muscles in the stem contract quickly
The leaves fold because water quickly leaves tiny cells at the base of the leaf, making it go limp
The plant produces a chemical that causes the leaves to curl to protect itself
Electricity from your touch travels through the leaf and causes it to close
explanation: The leaves fold because water quickly leaves tiny cells at the base of the leaf, making it go limp and causing the leaf to fold.
fact_tl: Nagtitiklop ang dahon dahil mabilis na lumalabas ang tubig sa maliliit na bahagi sa pundo ng dahon, kaya ito lumalambot.
fact_bis: Magtiklop ang dahon kay kusog nga mogawas ang tubig gikan sa gagmay nga bahin sa punoan sa dahon, mao nga molambot kini.

q: Where in our solar system is the asteroid belt located?
options: Between Earth and Mars, making space travel to Mars very dangerous
Between Jupiter and Saturn, surrounding the outer solar system
Between Mars and Jupiter — a wide ring of rocky asteroids
Between Venus and Earth, just inside our planet's orbit
explanation: The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter — a wide ring of rocky asteroids.
fact_tl: Ang asteroid belt ay nasa pagitan ng Mars at Jupiter — isang malapad na singsing ng mga batong asteroid.
fact_bis: Ang asteroid belt anaa sa tunga-tunga sa Mars ug Jupiter — usa ka lapad nga singsing sa batoon nga asteroid.

q: On a guitar, what happens to the pitch of a string when you make it shorter?
options: The pitch becomes lower because the string vibrates more slowly
The pitch stays the same — only how hard you pluck changes the pitch
The pitch becomes higher because a shorter string vibrates faster
The pitch becomes lower because a shorter string has less tension
explanation: On a guitar, a shorter string vibrates faster and makes a higher sound.
fact_tl: Sa gitara, ang mas maikling kwerdas ay mas mabilis umuga at gumagawa ng mas mataas na tunog.
fact_bis: Sa gitara, ang mas mubo nga kwerdas mas paspas mouyog ug mohimo og mas taas nga tunog.

q: What is Michael Faraday famous for discovering?
options: How to split the atom and release nuclear energy in 1938
That electricity flows through metal wires faster when they are kept cold
Electromagnetic induction in 1831 — how to make electricity using a magnet
The connection between gravity and electrical charge in the year 1820
explanation: Michael Faraday is famous for discovering electromagnetic induction in 1831 — how to make electricity using a magnet.
fact_tl: Tanyag si Michael Faraday sa pagtuklas ng electromagnetic induction noong 1831 — kung paano gumawa ng kuryente gamit ang magnet.
fact_bis: Bantog si Michael Faraday sa pagdiskubre sa electromagnetic induction niadtong 1831 — kon unsaon paghimo ug koryente gamit ang magnet.

q: Why are mangrove roots important for young fish and shellfish?
options: Mangrove roots release nutrients into the water that help small fish grow faster
Mangrove roots warm the water, allowing fish eggs to hatch more quickly
The complex root structure provides shelter from predators while juvenile fish and shellfish grow
Mangrove roots trap sunlight under the water, growing algae that small fish eat
explanation: Mangrove prop roots serve as nurseries — the complex root structure provides shelter from predators while juvenile fish and shellfish grow.
fact_tl: Ang mga prop roots ng bakawan ay gumaganap bilang nursery para sa maraming species ng isda at isdang-dagat — ang masalimuot na istraktura ng ugat ay nagbibigay ng pagtatago mula sa mga mandaragit habang ang mga batang isda ay tumatanda.
fact_bis: Ang mga prop roots sa bakawan nagsilbing nursery para sa daghang species sa isda ug krustaseo — ang komplikadong istruktura sa ugat naghatag og tagoan gikan sa mga mandaragit samtang nagdako ang mga bata nga isda.

q: How does the hard shell of the golden apple snail protect it?
options: The shell is poisonous, so predators get sick when they try to eat the snail
The shell is brightly colored to warn predators that the snail tastes bad
When a predator threatens it, the snail pulls its soft body inside the shell for protection
The shell is spiky and hurts any animal that tries to grab or bite the snail
explanation: When a hungry bird or animal threatens the golden apple snail, it pulls its soft body inside the hard shell to protect itself.
fact_tl: Ang matigas na kabibe ng golden apple snail ay parang baluti nito. Kapag may kumakaing ibon o hayop na nanganganib sa kanya, pinapasok nito ang malambot na katawan sa loob ng kabibe para protektahan ang sarili. Ang kabibe rin ang nagsisilbing tahanan na dala-dala nito kahit saan ito pumunta.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga kabhang sa golden apple snail sama sa taming niini. Kung adunay gigutom nga langgam o mananap nga maghulga niini, isulod niini ang humok nga lawas sa sulod sa kabhang aron mapanalipdan ang kaugalingon. Ang kabhang mao usab ang balay nga dala-dala niini bisan asa kini moadto.

q: Which blood circuit carries blood from the heart to the lungs to pick up oxygen?
options: The pulmonary circuit
The systemic circuit
The lymphatic circuit
The coronary circuit
explanation: The pulmonary circuit carries blood from the heart to the lungs to pick up oxygen, while the systemic circuit delivers that oxygen-rich blood to the rest of the body.
fact_tl: Sa katawan ng tao, ang pulmonary circuit ay nagdadala ng dugo mula sa puso papuntang baga upang kumuha ng oxygen, habang ang systemic circuit naman ang nagdadala ng dugong puno ng oxygen sa buong katawan.
fact_bis: Sa lawas sa tawo, ang pulmonary circuit magdala sa dugo gikan sa kasingkasing paingon sa baga aron mokuha og oxygen, samtang ang systemic circuit magdala sa dugo nga puno og oxygen ngadto sa tibuok lawas.

q: How do earthworms help plants grow?
options: Their droppings make the soil rich and their tunnels let in air and water
They eat insects that harm roots and produce fertilizer from their saliva
They break up rocks underground and release minerals into the soil
They pull dead leaves to the surface so sunlight can break them down
explanation: An earthworm eats soil and rotting leaves, and its droppings enrich the soil; the tunnels it digs also let air and water reach plant roots.
fact_tl: Ang bulate sa lupa (earthworm) ay kumakain ng lupa at bulok na dahon, at ang inilalabas nito ay nagpapataba sa lupa para sa mga halaman. Ang mga butas na ginagawa nito ang nagpapasok ng hangin at tubig sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang bulate sa yuta (earthworm) mokaon og yuta ug dunot nga dahon, ug ang iyang tae makapatambok sa yuta para sa mga tanom. Ang mga lungag nga iyang kalotan magpasulod og hangin ug tubig sa yuta.

q: How many arms and tentacles does a squid have in total?
options: Ten — eight arms plus two longer tentacles
Eight — all the same length and used for grabbing
Twelve — ten arms plus two tentacles
Six — four arms and two tentacles
explanation: A squid has eight arms plus two longer tentacles it uses to grab food, making ten limbs in total.
fact_tl: Ang pusit ay may walong braso at dalawa pang mas mahabang tentacle na ginagamit panghuli ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang pusit adunay walo ka bukton ug duha pa ka mas taas nga tentakulo nga gamiton sa pagkuha og pagkaon.

q: Why does a remote control stop working when the battery goes "dead"?
options: The battery's stored chemical energy runs out, so there is no longer a push to keep current flowing
The electrons inside the battery get completely used up and disappear
The wires inside the remote corrode and break the circuit
The battery gets too cold and the electrons slow down to a stop
explanation: The electrons are not used up — what runs out is the stored chemical energy in the battery that pushes the current; once that's gone, the flow stops.
fact_tl: Bakit tumitigil ang laruan o remote kapag 'patay' na ang baterya? Hindi naman nauubos ang electron, kundi ang nakaimbak na enerhiyang kemikal sa baterya na siyang tumutulak sa current. Kapag ubos na ito, wala nang push, kaya humihinto ang daloy.
fact_bis: Ngano mohunong ang dulaan o remote kung 'patay' na ang baterya? Dili man mahurot ang electron, kondili ang natipig nga chemical energy sa baterya nga nagduso sa current. Kung mahurot na kini, wala nay pagduso, maong mohunong ang agos.

q: What is the fastest thing in the whole universe?
options: Light
Sound
A gamma-ray burst
A comet
explanation: Nothing travels faster than light; it is the fastest thing in the entire universe.
fact_tl: Walang bagay na mas mabilis kaysa sa liwanag; ito ang pinakamabilis sa buong uniberso.
fact_bis: Walay butang nga mas paspas pa sa kahayag; kini ang kinapaspasan sa tibuok uniberso.

q: In beetles, what have the first pair of wings turned into?
options: Hard protective covers called elytra
Thin transparent flight wings
Sense organs that detect air movement
Color patches used to warn predators
explanation: In beetles, the first pair of wings has hardened into protective wing covers called elytra, while most other insects use two pairs of wings for flight.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga insekto ay may dalawang pares ng pakpak; sa mga salagubang, ang unang pares ay naging matitigas na pangprotektang takip na tinatawag na elytra.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga insekto adunay duha ka pares nga pakpak; sa salagubang, ang unang pares nahimong gahi nga pamalapdos nga gitawag elytra.

q: Which fault caused the devastating magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Luzon on July 16, 1990?
options: The Philippine Fault
The Marikina Valley Fault
The Cotabato Trench
The Manila Trench
explanation: On July 16, 1990, the Philippine Fault caused a magnitude 7.8 earthquake that devastated Luzon.
fact_tl: Noong Hulyo 16, 1990, ang Philippine Fault ay nagdulot ng lindol na magnitude 7.8 na sumalanta sa Luzon.
fact_bis: Niadtong Hulyo 16, 1990, ang Philippine Fault maoy hinungdan sa linog nga magnitude 7.8 nga milaglag sa Luzon.

q: Why does gold have the chemical symbol Au instead of Go?
options: Because Au comes from gold's old Latin name
Because Au was chosen randomly by the first chemist to study gold
Because Au stands for the German word for gold
Because Au is an abbreviation of the French word for gold
explanation: Some symbols like Au, Fe, and Na do not match the English name because they come from the elements' old Latin names.
fact_tl: Ang ilang simbolo gaya ng Au, Fe, at Na ay hindi tugma sa English dahil galing ito sa lumang pangalang Latin ng mga elemento.
fact_bis: Ang ubang simbolo sama sa Au, Fe, ug Na wala mohaom sa English kay gikan kini sa karaang Latin nga ngalan sa mga elemento.

q: What is a neutron star?
options: The extremely dense leftover core of a large exploded star, so dense that a spoonful can weigh billions of tons
A star that has no nuclear reactions and shines only by reflecting light from nearby stars
A star that spins so fast it throws off layers of gas to become a nebula
A very small star that is younger and hotter than our Sun
explanation: A neutron star is the extremely dense leftover core of a large exploded star, where a single spoonful of its material can weigh several billion tons.
fact_tl: Ang neutron star ay ang napakasikip na natitirang ulo ng isang sumabog na malaking bituin, kung saan isang kutsaritang sangkap nito ay maaaring tumimbang nang ilang bilyong tonelada.
fact_bis: Ang neutron star mao ang grabe kadasok nga nabiling kinauyokan sa usa ka dakong bituon nga mibuto, diin ang usa ka kutsarita sa material niini mahimong motimbang og pila ka bilyon ka tonelada.

q: What was Gregor Mendel's occupation when he carried out his famous plant studies?
options: A monk who grew plants in a monastery garden
A university professor who ran a genetics laboratory
A farmer who bred crops for food production
A doctor who studied plant medicines in a hospital
explanation: Gregor Mendel was a monk who grew and studied plants in the monastery garden, where he discovered the basic rules of heredity.
fact_tl: Si Gregor Mendel ay isang monghe (monk) na nagtanim at nag-aral ng halaman sa hardin ng monasteryo.
fact_bis: Si Gregor Mendel usa ka monghe (monk) nga nagtanom ug nagtuon og mga tanom sa hardin sa monasteryo.

q: What can the second part of a scientific species name sometimes do?
options: Honor a person or place, such as naming a species after the person who discovered it
Describe only the animal's color or shape
Always name the country where the animal was first seen
Show how dangerous the animal is to humans
explanation: Sometimes the second part of a scientific name honors a person or place, like 'jefferyi' in the Philippine eagle's name, which was named after Jeffery Whitehead.
fact_tl: Minsan, ang ikalawang bahagi ng pangalang siyentipiko ay ipinangangalan sa isang tao o lugar bilang parangal, gaya ng 'jefferyi' sa Philippine eagle na pinangalan kay Jeffery Whitehead.
fact_bis: Usahay, ang ikaduhang bahin sa ngalang siyentipiko gipasidunggan sa usa ka tawo o dapit, sama sa 'jefferyi' sa ngalan sa agila sa Pilipinas, nga ginganlan kang Jeffery Whitehead.

q: How is a typhoon different from the amihan and habagat?
options: A typhoon is a spinning storm, while the amihan and habagat are steady seasonal winds
A typhoon brings only heavy rain, while amihan and habagat bring strong spinning winds
All three are the same kind of storm but with different local names
A typhoon affects only the sea, while amihan and habagat affect only the land
explanation: A typhoon is a spinning storm, while the habagat (southwest wind) and amihan (north wind) are steady winds that arrive in different seasons of the year.
fact_tl: Iba ang bagyo sa habagat at amihan: ang bagyo ay umiikot na unos, samantalang ang habagat (timog-kanlurang hangin) at amihan (hilagang hangin) ay tuloy-tuloy na ihip ng hanging dumarating sa magkaibang panahon ng taon.
fact_bis: Lahi ang bagyo sa habagat ug amihan: ang bagyo usa ka nagtuyok nga unos, samtang ang habagat (hangin gikan sa habagatan-kasadpan) ug amihan (hangin gikan sa amihanan) mao ang padayon nga huros sa hangin nga moabot sa lainlaing panahon sa tuig.

q: Why does a barnacle shut its shell plates when the tide goes out?
options: So it will not dry out while it is exposed to air
So it can trap small fish inside and eat them later
So it can sleep safely until the next high tide
So predators cannot smell it when it is out of the water
explanation: When the tide goes out, a barnacle shuts its shell plates so it will not dry out while exposed to air.
fact_tl: Kapag kati at natutuyo, isinasara ng barnacle ang takip ng kabibi nito upang hindi matuyot.
fact_bis: Kon mohubas ug mamala, ang barnacle mosira sa iyang kabhang aron dili momala.

q: What happens to a rice plant during tillering?
options: It produces multiple new stems from its base, which can lead to more grain
It grows its first roots deeper into the ground to find water
Its leaves fall off so energy goes only to the main stem
It produces flowers at the tip of each existing stem
explanation: During tillering, a single rice plant produces multiple new stems (tillers) from its base; more tillers generally mean more panicles and a higher yield.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng tillering, nagbubunga ng mga bagong tangkay (tiller) ang isang halaman ng palay mula sa ugat nito; mas maraming tiller ay nangangahulugang mas maraming uhay at mas mataas na ani.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa tillering, nagmugna ang usa ka tanum sa palay og daghang bag-ong tangkay (tiller) gikan sa gamot; mas daghang tiller kasagaran nagkahulogan og mas daghang uhay ug ani.

q: How do sea turtles move their front flippers when swimming?
options: Like wings — they flap them up and down the way birds fly through air
Like oars — they push them backward through the water in a rowing motion
Like paddles — they spin them in circles to propel forward
Like fins — they wave them side to side the way fish do
explanation: Sea turtles use their large front flippers like wings — they fly through the water in the same way birds fly through the air.
