fact_tl: Ang mga pawikan ay gumagamit ng kanilang malalaking front flipper na parang pakpak — lumipad sila sa ilalim ng tubig sa parehong paraan ng mga ibon na lumilipad sa hangin.
fact_bis: Ang mga pawikan naggamit sa ilang dakong mga front flipper nga parang pakpak — naglutaw sila sa ilalim sa tubig sa mao rang paagi sa mga langgam nga naglupad sa hangin.

q: Why is the dung beetle famous for its strength?
options: Some species can pull hundreds of times their own body weight
It can carry a ball of dung ten times larger than itself through the air
It can push a rock ten times its size using only its head
It can lift another insect that is one hundred times heavier off the ground
explanation: The dung beetle is one of the strongest insects for its size — some species can pull weights hundreds of times their own body weight.
fact_tl: Ang dung beetle ay isa sa pinakamalakas na insekto kung ihahambing sa laki nito — may mga species na nakakahila ng bigat na daan-daang beses ng sariling timbang.
fact_bis: Ang dung beetle usa sa pinakakusgan nga insekto kumpara sa gidak-on niini — adunay mga matang nga makaguyod og bug-at nga gatusan ka pilo sa ilang kaugalingong gibug-aton.

q: What is resonance?
options: When small pushes timed correctly cause something to swing or vibrate with greater and greater movement
When a heavy object pushes a lighter one so hard that it flies far away
When friction between two surfaces disappears completely at high speed
When a wave bounces off a wall and returns to its starting point
explanation: Like pushing a swing, when each small push is timed right, the swinging slowly grows bigger — that is resonance.
fact_tl: Tulad ng pagduyan, kapag tama ang timing ng bawat maliit na tulak, unti-unting lumalaki ang indayog—iyon ang resonansya.
fact_bis: Sama sa pagtulod sa duyan, kung sakto ang timing sa matag gamay nga tukmod, anam-anam nga modako ang indayog—mao kana ang resonansya.

q: What is special about how elephants are born?
options: Elephants are pregnant for a very long time and their babies are already big at birth
Elephants give birth underwater to protect the newborn from predators
Elephant babies are born very tiny and grow to full size inside a pouch
Elephants lay large eggs that hatch after about two years
explanation: An elephant is pregnant for a very long time, and its baby is already big when it is born.
fact_tl: Napakatagal bago manganak ang elepante, at malaki na agad ang anak nito pagsilang.
fact_bis: Ang elepante dugay kaayo nga mabdos, ug dako na dayon ang iyang anak inig-anak.

q: What is inside many vaccines that helps protect us from disease?
options: Killed or weakened germs that can no longer cause illness but teach the body to defend itself
Live, active germs in small doses that give us a very mild version of the disease
Special chemicals that destroy germs before they even enter the body
Antibodies made from the blood of people who already survived the disease
explanation: Many vaccines are made from killed or weakened germs that can no longer cause disease but still teach the body to defend itself.
fact_tl: Maraming bakuna ay gawa sa patay o pinahinang mikrobyo na hindi na maaaring magdulot ng sakit ngunit sapat pa para turuan ang katawan.
fact_bis: Daghang bakuna gihimo gikan sa patay o gipahuyang nga mikrobyo nga dili na makahatag ug sakit apan paigo pa aron tudloan ang lawas.

q: Besides bees, which other insects can see ultraviolet light?
options: Butterflies and many other insects that help with pollination
Only beetles, because their eyes are the most complex among insects
Ants and termites, because they live in dark underground tunnels
Mosquitoes, because they use UV light to find warm-blooded animals
explanation: Many insects like butterflies have the same ability as bees to see ultraviolet, so they too can see hidden flower patterns — this is common among insects that help with pollination.
fact_tl: Hindi lang bubuyog ang nakakakita ng ultraviolet. Maraming insekto tulad ng paru-paro ang may parehong kakayahan, kaya nakakakita rin sila ng mga tagong pattern sa bulaklak. Karaniwan ito sa mga insektong tumutulong sa pollination.
fact_bis: Dili lang ang putyokan ang makakita og ultraviolet. Daghang insekto sama sa alibangbang ang adunay parehas nga abilidad, busa makakita sad sila og tinago nga pattern sa bulak. Kasagaran kini sa mga insekto nga motabang sa polinasyon.

q: Which animal is the fastest on land?
options: The cheetah
The lion
The horse
The ostrich
explanation: The cheetah is the fastest land animal when running.
fact_tl: Ang cheetah ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa lupa kapag tumatakbo.
fact_bis: Ang cheetah mao ang pinakatulin nga mananap sa yuta kon modagan.

q: How do Filipino farmers use pheromone traps to control pest insects?
options: The traps contain artificial sex pheromones that lure and catch male pest insects
The traps release a poison gas that kills any insect that flies near a crop
The traps use ultraviolet light to attract and electrocute insects at night
The traps spray water with pheromones to drive insects away from fields
explanation: In the Philippines, farmers use pheromone traps containing artificial sex pheromones to catch male pest insects and monitor or reduce their populations.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ginagamit ng mga magsasaka ang pheromone traps—mga patibong na gumagamit ng artipisyal na sex pheromone—para mahuli ang mga lalaking salagubang at lamok ng pananim at mabawasan ang kanilang populasyon.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang mga mag-uuma naggamit og pheromone traps—mga patibong nga naggamit og artipisyal nga sex pheromone—para makuha ang mga lalaking pest nga insekto ug mamonitor o mabawasan ang ilang populasyon.

q: Why is a reflex hard to stop or control?
options: Because it happens fast and on its own before we can even decide to act
Because the brain sends an extra-strong signal to the muscles to move
Because the spinal cord physically blocks any signal from reaching the brain
Because reflexes are controlled by a part of the brain we cannot think with
explanation: A reflex is hard to stop because it happens fast and on its own before we can even decide.
fact_tl: Mahirap pigilan ang isang reflex dahil nangyayari ito nang mabilis at kusang-loob bago pa tayo makapagpasya.
fact_bis: Lisod pugngan ang usa ka reflex kay mahitabo kini paspas ug kusganon una pa kita makadesisyon.

q: What would happen to Earth if there were no greenhouse gases at all?
options: Earth would freeze to about -18°C on average, colder than a freezer
Earth would stay the same temperature because the Sun alone keeps us warm
Earth would become hotter because nothing would block solar radiation
Earth would lose its atmosphere and become like the Moon
explanation: Without the natural greenhouse effect, Earth would be freezing — about -18°C on average — because greenhouse gases trap heat that keeps our world comfortable for life.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng greenhouse gas ay masama! Kung wala ang natural na greenhouse effect, ang Earth ay magiging napakalamig — mga -18°C ang average, na mas malamig kaysa freezer. Ang tamang dami ng greenhouse gas ang nagpapanatiling komportable at angkop sa buhay ang ating mundo.
fact_bis: Dili tanan greenhouse gas daotan! Kon wala ang natural nga greenhouse effect, ang Earth mahimong tugnaw kaayo — mga -18°C ang aberids, mas bugnaw pa sa freezer. Ang husto nga gidaghanon sa greenhouse gas maoy maghupot sa atong kalibotan nga komportable ug angay sa kinabuhi.

q: What type of energy is stored in food, fuel, and batteries?
options: Chemical potential energy
Gravitational potential energy
Kinetic energy
Nuclear energy
explanation: Food, fuel, and batteries hold stored chemical potential energy that turns into motion or heat when it is used or burned.
fact_tl: Ang pagkain, gasolina, at baterya ay may nakaimbak na kemikal na potensyal na enerhiya na nagiging galaw o init kapag ginamit o sinunog.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon, gasolina, ug baterya adunay natipig nga kemikal nga potential energy nga mahimong paglihok o kainit kon gamiton o sunogon.

q: How many times can light travel around the entire Earth in just one second?
options: About 7 times
About 70 times
About 700 times
About 1 time
explanation: At its speed, light can circle the entire Earth about 7 times in just one second.
fact_tl: Sa bilis nito, kayang umikot ng liwanag sa buong Earth nang halos 7 beses sa isang segundo lamang.
fact_bis: Sa iyang kakusog, ang kahayag makalibot sa tibuok Yuta mga 7 ka pilo sulod ra sa usa ka segundo.

q: In which part of the ocean can sea plants that need sunlight live?
options: Only in the top few hundred meters where sunlight can reach
In every layer, because water carries sunlight all the way to the bottom
Only near volcanic vents deep in the ocean where heat replaces light
In the middle layer where pressure keeps the water still and clear
explanation: Sunlight reaches only the top part of the ocean (the first few hundred meters), so almost all sea plants that need light live there.
fact_tl: Umaabot lamang ang sikat ng araw sa pinakaibabaw na bahagi ng dagat (mga unang daan-daang metro), kaya doon nakatira ang halos lahat ng halaman-dagat na kailangan ng liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang silaw sa adlaw moabot lamang sa kinaibabwang bahin sa dagat (ang unang pipila ka gatos ka metro), mao nga didto nagpuyo halos tanang tanom-dagat nga nagkinahanglan og kahayag.

q: How long can a cockroach survive with very little food and water?
options: For weeks
For only a few hours
For about a day
For a whole year
explanation: A cockroach can survive for weeks on only a little food and water, so it can stay alive even in places with almost nothing to eat.
fact_tl: Kayang mabuhay ng ipis nang ilang linggo kahit kakaunti lamang ang pagkain at tubig na nakukuha nito, kaya nakakapanatili ito kahit sa mga lugar na halos walang pagkain.
fact_bis: Mabuhi ang ipis sulod sa pipila ka semana bisan gamay lang ang pagkaon ug tubig nga makuha niini, maong makapabilin kini bisan sa mga dapit nga halos walay pagkaon.

q: Why is saltwater an example of a homogeneous mixture?
options: Because the salt is fully dissolved so every part of the water looks and tastes the same
Because you can still see individual salt crystals floating throughout the water
Because salt and water have different densities and always separate over time
Because the mixture is clear, meaning no chemical change has taken place
explanation: A solution like saltwater is homogeneous because one substance is fully dissolved in another, making every part of the mixture uniform.
fact_tl: Ang solution ay isang espesyal na uri ng homogeneous na halo kung saan tuluyang natunaw ang isang sangkap sa iba. Halimbawa nito ang tubig na may asukal o asin. Lahat ng solution ay homogeneous, pero hindi lahat ng homogeneous na halo ay tinatawag na solution — pero magandang simulang halimbawa ito.
fact_bis: Ang solution usa ka espesyal nga matang sa homogeneous nga sagol diin hingpit nga natunaw ang usa ka sangkap sa lain. Pananglitan ang tubig nga may asukar o asin. Tanang solution homogeneous, ug sila ang pinakaklaro nga pananglitan kung unsaon paghimo ang pantay nga sagol.

q: Which gas makes up the largest portion of the air we breathe?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Water vapor
explanation: The most abundant gas in air is nitrogen, making up about 78% of the atmosphere.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming gas sa hangin ay nitrogen.
fact_bis: Ang labing daghang gas sa hangin mao ang nitrogen.

q: Why can we see sunlight in outer space but cannot hear any sounds there?
options: Light can travel through empty space but sound needs a medium like air or water to move
Sound travels faster than light in a vacuum so it left the Sun before light did
Both light and sound need air, but space has a special gas that only carries light
Outer space is too cold for sound waves to form, but heat keeps light moving
explanation: Sound energy must pass through a medium like air or water, but light energy can travel even through empty space — which is why outer space is silent yet sunlight still reaches us.
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya ng tunog ay kailangang dumaan sa isang medium gaya ng hangin o tubig, pero ang enerhiya ng liwanag ay kayang maglakbay kahit sa walang-hangin na espasyo — kaya't tahimik ang outer space pero umaabot pa rin ang sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang enerhiya sa tingog kinahanglan moagi sa medium sama sa hangin o tubig, apan ang enerhiya sa kahayag makabiyahe bisan sa walay hangin nga kawanangan — mao nga hilom ang outer space apan moabot gihapon ang sidlak sa adlaw.

q: What part of a fungus is the mushroom we see above ground?
options: Just the fruiting body — most of the fungus lives as hidden threads underground
The whole organism — fungi have no parts below the soil
The root system — the underground part absorbs nutrients and the cap stores them
The reproductive organ only found in fungi that have died
explanation: The mushroom we see is just like the fruit of a fungus — most of it lives hidden underground as a web of threads we cannot see.
fact_tl: Ang nakikita nating kabute ay tulad lamang ng bunga ng isang fungus — ang pinakamalaking bahagi ay nasa ilalim ng lupa bilang isang lambat ng mga sinulid na hindi natin nakikita.
fact_bis: Ang uhong nga atong makita sama lang sa bunga sa usa ka fungus — ang kinadak-ang bahin niini natago sa ilawom sa yuta isip usa ka lambat sa mga lanot nga dili nato makita.

q: Why is the colugo considered one of the finest gliding mammals?
options: It can travel a long distance from tree to tree while barely losing height
It can glide upward by catching rising warm air like a bird
Its wings are feathered, making it more efficient than any other gliding mammal
It glides at speeds faster than any other mammal can run
explanation: The colugo can cross a long way from one tree to another while barely losing height, which is why it is called one of the finest gliders among mammals.
fact_tl: Sa lahat ng hayop na lumulutang sa hangin, ang colugo ang isa sa pinakamagaling. Kaya nitong tumawid nang napakalayo mula sa isang puno patungo sa iba nang halos hindi nawawala ang taas, kaya tinaguriang isa sa pinakahusay na glider sa mga mamal.
fact_bis: Sa tanang mga hayop nga molupad-lupad sa hangin, ang colugo usa sa labing maayo. Makahimo kini sa pagtabok ug layo gikan sa usa ka kahoy ngadto sa lain nga halos dili mawad-an sa kahabog, busa gitawag kini nga usa sa labing maayo nga glider sa mga mammal.

q: What type of rock is marble, and how does it form?
options: A metamorphic rock formed from limestone changed by heat and pressure
A sedimentary rock formed from layers of sea shells compressed over time
An igneous rock formed when molten lava cools slowly underground
A volcanic rock formed from ash and cinders deposited around a volcano
explanation: Marble is a metamorphic rock formed from limestone that has been changed by heat and pressure deep in the Earth.
fact_tl: Ang marble (marmol) ay isang metamorphic na bato na nagmula sa limestone na nabago ng init at presyon.
fact_bis: Ang marble (marmol) usa ka metamorphic nga bato nga gikan sa limestone nga nausab tungod sa init ug presyur.

q: How does a raptor's color vision compare to a human's?
options: Raptors see colors more clearly than humans, which helps them track prey
Raptors see only in black and white, relying on movement instead of color
Raptors see fewer colors than humans but can detect heat like a thermal camera
Raptors see the same range of colors as humans but process images faster
explanation: Raptors see colors more clearly than humans, which helps them track down their prey.
fact_tl: Nakikita ng mga ibong mandaragit ang mga kulay nang mas malinaw kaysa sa tao, na tumutulong sa kanila na matunton ang biktima.
fact_bis: Makita sa mga langgam nga manunukob ang mga kolor nga mas klaro kay sa tawo, nga makatabang nila sa pagsubay sa tukbonon.

q: Which type of fault forms when two blocks of rock slide sideways past each other?
options: A strike-slip fault
A normal fault
A reverse fault
A thrust fault
explanation: There are three main fault types: normal (pulling apart), reverse (pushing together), and strike-slip (sliding sideways past each other).
fact_tl: May tatlong pangunahing uri ng fault ayon sa galaw nito: normal fault (humihila palayo), reverse fault (nagtutulakan), at strike-slip fault (nagkakadaplis nang pahalang).
fact_bis: Adunay tulo ka panguna nga klase sa fault sumala sa lihok niini: normal fault (nagbira palayo), reverse fault (nagtuloray), ug strike-slip fault (nagdaplis nga pakilid).

q: Why do scientists find fossils of bones and teeth much more often than fossils of skin or muscles?
options: Hard parts like bones and teeth survive long enough to fossilize, while soft flesh usually rots away too fast
Bones are made of minerals that form crystals, making them automatically turn into rock
Soft parts leave stains on rock that are too faint for scientists to notice
Ancient animals simply did not have soft body parts like those living animals have today
explanation: Hard parts like bones, teeth, and shells fossilize most often, while soft flesh usually rots away too fast to be preserved.
fact_tl: Mas madalas mag-fossil ang matitigas na bahagi gaya ng buto, ngipon, at kabibe, samantalang ang malambot na laman ay mabilis mabulok.
fact_bis: Ang gahi nga mga bahin sama sa bukog, ngipon, ug kinhason kanunay mahimong fossil, samtang ang humok nga unod paspas madunot.

q: Which place in the Philippines is called the "Whale Shark Capital" because butanding gather there?
options: Donsol in Sorsogon
Tubbataha Reef in Palawan
Apo Island in Negros Oriental
Puerto Princesa in Palawan
explanation: Donsol in Sorsogon is called the "Whale Shark Capital," where butanding gather from November to June.
fact_tl: Ang Donsol sa Sorsogon ay tinaguriang "Whale Shark Capital," kung saan nagtitipon ang mga butanding tuwing Nobyembre hanggang Hunyo.
fact_bis: Ang Donsol sa Sorsogon gitawag nga "Whale Shark Capital," diin magtigom ang mga butanding gikan Nobyembre hangtod Hunyo.

q: How do honeybees tell other bees where to find food?
options: They perform a special 'waggle dance' inside the hive that shows the direction and distance to food
They release a scent trail from the food source all the way back to the hive
They make a buzzing sound at a specific pitch that guides other bees to the location
They touch antennae with guard bees who then fly directly to the food
explanation: Honeybees use the sun as a compass and tell other bees the direction and distance to food through a special 'waggle dance' inside the hive.
fact_tl: Ang bubuyog (honeybee) ay gumagamit ng araw bilang kompas at sinasabi sa kapwa bubuyog ang direksyon at layo ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng isang espesyal na 'waggle dance' sa loob ng pugad.
fact_bis: Ang putyukan (honeybee) mogamit sa adlaw isip kompas ug mosulti sa ubang putyukan sa direksyon ug gilay-on sa pagkaon pinaagi sa espesyal nga 'waggle dance' sulod sa salag.

q: Who discovered the ABO blood types in 1901?
options: Karl Landsteiner
Louis Pasteur
Gregor Mendel
Alexander Fleming
explanation: Karl Landsteiner discovered the blood types (ABO) in 1901.
fact_tl: Si Karl Landsteiner ang nakatuklas ng mga uri ng dugo (ABO) noong 1901.
fact_bis: Si Karl Landsteiner ang nakadiskobre sa mga klase sa dugo (ABO) niadtong 1901.

q: How is the golden apple snail different from the Philippines' native rice snail?
options: The golden apple snail is bigger, multiplies faster, and lays pink eggs above water, making it a worse pest
The native snail is bigger but the golden apple snail lays more eggs underwater
Both snails are equally harmful to rice, but only the golden apple snail is eaten by people
The golden apple snail is smaller but more harmful because it eats rice roots underground
explanation: The golden apple snail is bigger than the native snail, multiplies faster, and lays pink eggs above the water; the native snail lays soft eggs underwater and does not damage rice nearly as badly.
fact_tl: May katutubong kuhol sa Pilipinas na matagal nang kinakain at hindi peste. Mas malaki ang golden apple snail kaysa rito, mas mabilis dumami, at nangingitlog ng kulay pink na itlog sa ibabaw ng tubig. Ang katutubong kuhol ay nangingitlog ng malalambot na itlog sa ilalim ng tubig at hindi sumisira sa palay nang ganoon kalala.
fact_bis: Aduna kuhol nga lumad sa Pilipinas nga dugay nang gikaon ug dili peste. Mas dako ang golden apple snail kay niini, mas paspas modaghan, ug mangitlog og pink nga itlog ibabaw sa tubig. Ang lumad nga kuhol mangitlog og humok nga itlog ilalom sa tubig ug dili kaayo makadaot sa humay.

q: Why does your body shiver when you are cold?
options: Shivering is an automatic reflex that makes muscles shake to generate heat and warm the body
Shivering is your body trying to signal other people that you need warm clothing
Shivering pumps blood faster to push warm blood from your core to your skin
Shivering tightens your skin so cold air cannot pass through and cool the blood
explanation: When you are cold, your body shivers automatically — this shaking is a reflex that helps warm the body.
fact_tl: Kapag nilalamig ka, awtomatikong nanginginig ang katawan—ang pangangatal na ito ay reflex na tumutulong magpainit sa katawan.
fact_bis: Kon tugnawon ka, awtomatik nga mokurog ang lawas—kini nga pagngiki usa ka reflex nga motabang painiton ang lawas.

q: Why does compost break down faster when materials are cut into small pieces?
options: Microbes can eat smaller pieces more easily, speeding up decomposition
Smaller pieces hold more water, which makes the compost hotter and faster
Air cannot reach large pieces so they stay dry and rot from the inside out
Smaller pieces attract more worms that carry the material deeper into the pile
explanation: Compost breaks down faster when the pieces are small because microbes can eat them more easily.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis nabubulok ang compost kapag maliliit ang piraso dahil mas madaling kainin ng mga mikrobyo.
fact_bis: Mas paspas madunot ang compost kung gagmay ang piraso kay mas sayon kaonon sa mga mikrobyo.

q: If a Philippine outlet provides 220 V and an appliance has 110 ohms of resistance, what is the current flowing through it?
options: 2 amperes
110 amperes
220 amperes
0.5 amperes
explanation: Ohm's law states V = I x R; dividing 220 V by 110 ohms gives a current of 2 amperes.
fact_tl: Ang batas ni Ohm (V = I × R) ay nagpapaliwanag ng relasyon ng boltahe, kuryente, at resistensya. Halimbawa: sa Philippine outlet na 220V, kapag ang resistensya ng isang appliance ay 110 ohm, ang kuryente ay 2 ampere.
fact_bis: Ang batas ni Ohm (V = I × R) nagpaliwanag sa relasyon sa boltahe, kuryente, ug resistensya. Pananglitan: sa Philippine outlet nga 220V, inig ang appliance adunay 110 ohm nga resistensya, ang kuryente 2 ampere.

q: How does temperature affect a stick insect's activity?
options: It moves and eats more actively when warm, and slows down when cold, because it is cold-blooded
It is more active when cold because the cool air makes its muscles stronger
Temperature does not affect it because its thick body keeps it warm like a mammal
It moves faster at night when temperatures drop and stays still during the day
explanation: A stick insect is cold-blooded, so it depends on the warmth around it to move — when cold it moves slowly, when warm it moves and eats more actively.
fact_tl: Malamig ang dugo ng stick insect, kaya nakadepende ito sa init ng paligid para gumalaw. Kapag malamig, mas mabagal ito; kapag mainit-init, mas masigla itong gumagalaw at kumakain.
fact_bis: Ang stick insect bugnaw og dugo, mao nga nagsalig kini sa kainit sa palibot aron molihok. Kon bugnaw, mas hinay kini; kon init, mas kusog kini molihok ug mokaon.

q: What kind of diet helps keep the heart healthy?
options: Eating plenty of fruits and vegetables and cutting back on fatty, salty foods
Eating a high-protein diet with mostly meat and avoiding all plant foods
Drinking extra water while keeping the same diet of any foods you enjoy
Eating three large meals a day and avoiding snacks between them
explanation: Eating plenty of fruits and vegetables and cutting back on fatty, salty foods helps keep the heart healthy.
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng maraming prutas at gulay at pagbawas ng matataba at maaalat na pagkain ay tumutulong panatilihing malusog ang puso.
fact_bis: Ang pagkaon ug daghang prutas ug utanon ug pagkunhod sa tambok ug parat nga pagkaon makatabang nga himsog ang kasingkasing.

q: Why can soap remove oil from your hands even though oil and water normally do not mix?
options: Each soap molecule has one end that loves water and another end that loves oil, so it can connect the two
Soap is a strong acid that breaks oil into tiny droplets that are small enough to dissolve in water
Soap heats the water slightly, which gives water the energy needed to break apart oil
Soap changes oil into a gas that evaporates off the skin when you rinse with water
explanation: Each soap molecule has a head that loves water and a tail that loves oil, so it can stand between water and oil — which normally refuse to mix — and carry the oil away.
fact_tl: Ang bawat molekula ng sabon ay parang maliit na butete: may ulo na gustong-gusto ng tubig at mahabang buntot na ayaw ng tubig pero gustong-gusto ng langis. Dahil sa dalawang magkaibang dulong ito, nakakapamagitan ang sabon sa tubig at langis na karaniwang hindi naghahalo.
fact_bis: Ang matag molekula sa sabon murag gamayng butete: adunay ulo nga ganahan kaayo sa tubig ug taas nga ikog nga dili ganahan sa tubig apan ganahan sa lana. Tungod niining duha ka magkalahi nga tumoy, ang sabon makatunga sa tubig ug lana nga sagad dili magsagol.

q: What do "bone-eating worms" feed on when a dead whale sinks to the deep sea floor?
options: They draw food directly from the whale's bones
They feed on the bacteria that coat the whale's skin
They eat tiny plankton that drift down from the surface
They consume the soft muscle tissue before it fully decomposes
explanation: When a dead whale sinks to the deep sea floor, tiny bone-eating worms arrive to settle on its skeleton and draw food from the bones themselves.
fact_tl: Kapag may patay na balyenang lumubog sa kailaliman, dumarating ang maliliit na 'bone-eating worm' na tumitira sa kalansay nito at kumukuha ng pagkain mula sa mismong mga buto.
fact_bis: Kon adunay patay nga balyena nga molunod sa kalaliman, moabot ang gagmay nga 'bone-eating worm' nga mopuyo sa kalansay niini ug mokuha og pagkaon gikan mismo sa mga bukog.

q: What do a barnacle's shell plates do when the barnacle is covered by water?
options: They open so the barnacle's legs can reach out to feed
They seal shut to trap food inside
They dissolve so the barnacle can swim away
They harden into a single solid shell
explanation: When covered by water, a barnacle's shell plates open so its legs can reach out and grab food from the water.
fact_tl: Ang barnacle ay nakatago sa loob ng matigas na kabibing gawa sa mga plato. Kapag may tubig, bumubukas ang mga ito para ilabas ang binti; kapag tuyo o may panganib, sumasara para hindi matuyot.
fact_bis: Ang barnacle nagtago sulod sa gahi nga kabhang nga hinimo sa mga plato. Kon natabunan og tubig, mag-abli kini aron mogawas ang tiil; kon mala o adunay kuyaw, mosira aron dili momala.

q: When most people in a community are vaccinated, who benefits even if they are NOT vaccinated?
options: Everyone in the community, because the disease struggles to spread
Only the vaccinated people, since the unvaccinated are left unprotected
Only newborn babies, because vaccines pass through breast milk
No one else benefits — each person must get their own vaccine
explanation: When most people are vaccinated, a disease struggles to spread, so even unvaccinated community members are protected by herd immunity.
fact_tl: Kapag marami sa isang komunidad ang nabakunahan, hirap nang kumalat ang sakit, kaya naprotektahan pati ang mga hindi pa nababakunahan.
fact_bis: Kon kadaghanan sa usa ka komunidad nabakunahan, maglisod nang mokaylap ang sakit, mao nga mapanalipdan bisan ang mga wala pa mabakunahi.

q: Why is dynamite fishing banned in the Philippines?
options: It kills many fish at once and destroys the sea
It makes the fish too expensive to sell at the market
It scares fish away so nets catch fewer fish
It pollutes the water with chemicals from the boat engine
explanation: Dynamite fishing is banned because it kills many fish at once and destroys the sea environment.
fact_tl: Bawal ang dynamite fishing o pangbobomba dahil pinapatay nito ang maraming isda nang sabay-sabay at sinisira ang dagat.
fact_bis: Bawal ang dynamite fishing o pagbomba kay daghan kaayo nga isda ang mamatay dungan ug madaot ang dagat.

q: Which of the following is a major national park found in Mindanao, Philippines?
options: Mount Apo National Park
Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park
Tubbataha Reef Natural Park
Hundred Islands National Park
explanation: Mount Apo National Park is located in Mindanao and is one of the largest national parks in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang ilan sa mga pinakamalaking pambansang parke ng Pilipinas ay kinabibilangan ng Mount Apo National Park sa Mindanao, Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park sa Palawan, at Tubbataha Reef Natural Park sa Sulu Sea.
fact_bis: Ang pipila sa pinakadakling pambansang parke sa Pilipinas naglakip sa Mount Apo National Park sa Mindanao, Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park sa Palawan, ug Tubbataha Reef Natural Park sa Dagat Sulu.

q: What is 'stunting' in children?
options: Being too short for their age due to long-term lack of food
Being very thin because they skipped meals for a few days
Growing too fast because of too much protein in their diet
Having weak muscles from lack of exercise
explanation: Stunting is when a child is too short for their age because of long-term lack of food, and it is a sign of lasting problems in nutrition and brain growth.
fact_tl: Ang stunting ay ang pagiging masyadong maikli ang bata para sa kanyang edad dahil sa matagalang kakulangan sa pagkain. Iba ito sa basta payat—ang payat ay maaaring mabilis tumaba ulit, pero ang stunting ay tanda ng matagal nang problema sa nutrisyon at utak.
fact_bis: Ang stunting mao ang pagka-mubo sa bata alang sa iyang edad tungod sa dugay nga kakulang sa pagkaon. Lahi kini sa basta niwang—ang niwang mahimong dali motambok pag-usab, apan ang stunting timaan sa dugay nang problema sa nutrisyon ug pagtubo sa utok.

q: Besides providing water for irrigation and power, what flood-related purpose do Philippine dams like Angat and Magat serve?
options: They control flooding to protect communities downstream
They collect rainwater only during typhoon season
They pump floodwater directly into the ocean
They store seawater to keep coastlines safe
explanation: Philippine dams such as Angat, Magat, and Pantabangan serve as flood controls that protect downstream communities.
fact_tl: Ang mga dam sa Pilipinas tulad ng Angat, Magat, at Pantabangan ay nagsisilbing panlabas ng baha, nagpoprotekta ng mga lugar sa ibaba habang nagbibigay ng tubig para sa patubig at kuryente.
fact_bis: Ang mga dam sa Pilipinas sama sa Angat, Magat, ug Pantabangan nagsilbi isip kontrol sa baha, nagpanalipod sa mga komunidad sa ubos samtang naghatag og tubig alang sa patubig ug kuryente.

q: What was severely damaged by the 2006 Guimaras oil spill?
options: Coral reefs, fisherfolk, and communities in Guimaras
Rice fields and freshwater rivers across Luzon
Mangrove forests near Manila Bay
Mountain forests and highland communities in Negros
explanation: The 2006 Guimaras oil spill was one of the worst marine disasters in the Philippines and severely damaged coral reefs, fisherfolk, and nearby communities.
fact_tl: Ang Guimaras oil spill noong 2006 ay isa sa pinakamalaking kalamidad sa kapaligiran ng dagat sa Pilipinas; ang pagbuhos ng langis ay nagdulot ng malubhang pinsala sa mga coral reef, mangingisda, at komunidad sa Guimaras.
fact_bis: Ang Guimaras oil spill niadtong 2006 usa sa pinaka-grabe nga kalamidad sa kapaligiran sa dagat sa Pilipinas; ang pagbubo sa lana grabe nga nagdaot sa mga coral reef, mangingisda, ug komunidad sa Guimaras.

q: Which metal is the most abundant in Earth's crust?
options: Aluminum
Iron
Copper
Gold
explanation: Aluminum (aluminium) is the most abundant metal found in Earth's crust.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming metal sa balat ng lupa ay aluminum (aluminyo).
fact_bis: Ang labing daghan nga metal sa panit sa yuta mao ang aluminum (aluminyo).

q: What are the helpful bacteria found in yogurt and other fermented foods called?
options: Probiotics
Antibiotics
Pathogens
Enzymes
explanation: Yogurt and fermented foods contain helpful bacteria called probiotics that support a healthy gut and digestion.
fact_tl: Ang yogurt at iba pang fermented na pagkain ay may mabubuting bakterya na tinatawag na probiotics, na makakatulong sa malusog na tiyan at panunaw.
fact_bis: Ang yogurt ug ubang fermented nga pagkaon adunay maayong bakterya nga gitawag og probiotics, nga makatabang sa himsog nga tiyan ug paghilis.

q: Which type of organism is considered among the very first living things to appear on Earth?
options: Bacteria
Fungi
Fish
Insects
explanation: Bacteria are among the very first living things that appeared on Earth billions of years ago.
fact_tl: Ang bakterya ay kabilang sa pinakaunang nabubuhay na lumitaw sa Daigdig bilyon-bilyong taon na ang nakalipas.
fact_bis: Ang bakterya kauban sa pinakauna nga buhing butang nga mitungha sa Kalibotan bilyon-bilyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

q: What is a well used for?
options: To reach water hidden underground by digging a deep hole
To collect rainwater falling from the sky into a tank
To store clean water pumped in from a river
To channel river water into farms for irrigation
explanation: A well is a deep hole dug into the ground to reach the water hidden below the surface.
fact_tl: Ang balon ay malalim na butas sa lupa na hinuhukay upang maabot ang tubig sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Ang atabay usa ka lawom nga lungag nga gikalot sa yuta aron maabot ang tubig ilawom.

q: What happens to erosion when trees are cut down and soil is left bare?
options: Erosion happens faster and floods and landslides become more common
Erosion slows down because rain can soak into the ground more easily
Nothing changes because erosion depends only on how hard it rains
The soil becomes richer and holds water better
explanation: When trees are cut and the soil is left bare, erosion happens faster and floods and landslides become more common.
fact_tl: Kapag pinuputol ang mga puno at naiwang hubad ang lupa, mas mabilis ang erosion at mas madalas ang pagbaha at landslide.
fact_bis: Kon putlon ang mga kahoy ug mabilin nga hubo ang yuta, mas paspas ang erosion ug mas masubsob ang baha ug landslide.

q: What does CHED (Commission on Higher Education) do in the Philippines?
options: It manages and sets standards for universities and colleges
It oversees elementary schools and high schools across the country
It provides scholarships only to science and engineering students
It regulates the salaries of all government teachers
explanation: CHED manages and sets standards for universities and colleges in the Philippines to ensure quality higher education.
fact_tl: Ang CHED o Commission on Higher Education ang namamahala at nagtatakda ng pamantayan para sa mga unibersidad at kolehiyo sa Pilipinas upang matiyak ang kalidad ng mas mataas na edukasyon.
fact_bis: Ang CHED o Commission on Higher Education nagdumala ug nagtakda og mga pamantayan para sa mga unibersidad ug kolehiyo sa Pilipinas aron matiyak ang kalidad sa mas taas nga edukasyon.

q: Where was gunpowder first invented?
options: Ancient China
Ancient Egypt
Ancient Greece
Ancient India
explanation: Gunpowder was first made in ancient China.
fact_tl: Ang pulbura (gunpowder) ay unang ginawa sa sinaunang Tsina.
fact_bis: Ang pulbura (gunpowder) unang gihimo sa karaang China.

q: What causes lightning to jump from a storm cloud to another cloud or to the ground?
options: Too much electric charge builds up in the cloud and leaps out
The cloud becomes too heavy with raindrops and falls apart
Hot air inside the cloud pushes electricity downward
Water droplets freeze and release stored heat as a spark
explanation: Lightning happens when electric charge builds up inside thick storm clouds and, when there is too much, it leaps out as a giant static spark.
fact_tl: Ang kidlat ay parang isang napakalaking spark ng static electricity. Sa loob ng makakapal na ulap ng bagyo, nag-iipon ng charge, at kapag sobra na ito, lumalabas bilang kidlat papunta sa ibang ulap o sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang kilat sama sa usa ka dako kaayo nga spark sa static electricity. Sulod sa baga nga mga panganod sa bagyo, maipon ang charge, ug kung sobra na kini, mogawas kini ingon nga kilat ngadto sa laing panganod o sa yuta.

q: How many days did the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution last?
options: Four days
Two days
Seven days
One week and three days
explanation: The 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution lasted four days, from February 22 to 25.
fact_tl: Tumagal ng apat (4) na araw ang 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution, mula Pebrero 22 hanggang 25.
fact_bis: Ang 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution milungtad ug upat (4) ka adlaw, gikan Pebrero 22 hangtod 25.

q: Why are bricks a good choice for building walls that hold up a heavy structure?
options: Bricks are very strong when pressed or loaded from above
Bricks are flexible so they bend without breaking under heavy weight
Bricks are lightweight so they don't add extra load to the building
Bricks stick together with water alone without needing cement
explanation: Bricks are strong when pressed or loaded from above, making them well-suited for stacking into walls that carry the weight of a building.
fact_tl: Matibay ang tisa kapag idiniin o pinapatungan ng bigat, kaya mainam itong isalansan upang buuin ang mga pader na nagdadala ng timbang ng gusali.
fact_bis: Lig-on ang tisa kon ipiton o patongan og bug-at gikan sa ibabaw, busa maayo kining tapok-tapokon aron mahimong bongbong nga magdala sa gibug-aton sa building.

q: Why can your body fight off a familiar germ much faster the second time it infects you?
options: Special memory cells remember the germ so the defense responds quickly
The germ weakens on its own each time it returns to the body
White blood cells multiply faster at night while you sleep
Vitamins from food destroy the germ before it can spread
explanation: After fighting a germ, special memory cells remember it, so if that same germ returns the body's defense is much faster.
fact_tl: Pagkatapos labanan ang isang germ, may mga 'memory cell' na naaalala ito kaya mas mabilis ang depensa kapag bumalik ang parehong germ.
fact_bis: Human makig-away sa usa ka kagaw, adunay 'memory cells' nga makahinumdom niini, busa mas paspas ang depensa kon mobalik ang samang kagaw.

q: How does a hydraulic system move force from one place to another?
options: It uses liquid to transmit force — pushing liquid at one end delivers force at the other end
It uses stretched rubber tubes that spring back to push heavy objects
It uses compressed air blown through metal pipes to drive machines
It uses spinning gears connected by a chain to multiply force
explanation: A hydraulic system uses liquid to transmit force — compressing the liquid at one end delivers that force at the other end.
fact_tl: Ang hydraulic system ay gumagamit ng likido para dalhin ang puwersa mula sa isang lugar patungo sa isa pa — kapag pinipisil ang likido sa isang dulo, ang puwersa ay nilalabas sa kabilang dulo.
fact_bis: Ang hydraulic system naggamit sa likido aron mabalhin ang puwersa gikan sa usa ka lugar ngadto sa laing lugar — ang pagpisil sa likido sa usa ka dulo naghatag sa puwersa sa pikas dulo.

q: Why do most trees in the Philippines stay green all year long?
options: Because it is always warm and there is no autumn
Because they are watered by farmers every day
Because their leaves are too thick to fall off
Because the Philippines gets very little rain
explanation: Most trees in the Philippines stay green all year because it is always warm and there is no autumn season there.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng puno sa Pilipinas ay luntian buong taon dahil laging mainit at walang taglagas dito.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa kahoy sa Pilipinas berde tibuok tuig kay kanunay init ug walay autumn dinhi.

q: What is formed when atoms of two or more different elements combine together?
options: A compound with new properties
A mixture that can be separated by hand
A pure element with a new name
An atom that is heavier than both originals
explanation: When atoms of two or more elements combine, they form a compound with new properties — for example, water (H₂O) is made of hydrogen and oxygen but behaves differently from those two gases.
fact_tl: Kapag nagsama ang atoms ng dalawa o higit pang element, nakabubuo sila ng compound na may bagong properties — halimbawa, ang tubig (H₂O) ay gawa sa hydrogen at oxygen pero iba ito sa dalawang gas na iyon. Ang molecule ay grupo ng atoms na magkakabit.
fact_bis: Kung magsagol ang atoms sa duha o sobra pa nga element, makaporma silag compound nga adunay bag-ong properties — pananglitan, ang tubig (H₂O) hinimo sa hydrogen ug oxygen apan lahi kini niadtong duha ka gas. Ang molecule usa ka grupo sa atoms nga nagkadikit.

q: Where does copper come from before it is made into wire or other products?
options: It is dug out of the ground as ore — rocks that contain copper
It is collected from the bottom of the ocean by special ships
It is made by melting together iron and tin in a furnace
It is found floating in rivers as pure shiny nuggets
explanation: Copper is dug out of the ground as ore — rocks that contain copper — and then cleaned and melted into pure copper.
fact_tl: Saan nanggagaling ang tanso? Hinuhukay ito mula sa lupa bilang 'ore'—mga bato na may halong tanso. Pagkatapos ay linilinis at tinutunaw ito para maging purong tanso na magagawang wire. May mga minahan ng tanso sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang tumbaga? Gikalot kini gikan sa yuta isip 'ore'—mga bato nga adunay sulod nga tumbaga. Dayon limpyohan ug tunawon kini aron mahimong putli nga tumbaga nga himoong wire. Adunay mga minahan sa tumbaga sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do many birds fly very long distances when the seasons change?
options: To find food and a warmer home in a different place
To escape predators that only hunt in the winter months
To lay their eggs in a place with less rainfall
To follow the direction of ocean currents toward the equator
explanation: Many birds migrate — flying very long distances when the seasons change — to find food and a warmer home.
fact_tl: Maraming ibon ang lumilipad nang napakalayo tuwing nagbabago ang panahon para makahanap ng pagkain at mainit-init na tirahan.
fact_bis: Daghang langgam ang molupad og layo kaayo matag mausab ang panahon aron makakita og pagkaon ug mas init nga puy-anan.

q: How can a phone stargazing app tell you which constellations will be visible in your sky tonight?
options: It uses Earth's exact position in its orbit to predict which stars will face us
It connects to a satellite that takes photos of the sky each night
It asks users around the world to report what they see and shares the results
It uses the moon's brightness to calculate which stars are blocked
explanation: Stargazing apps work because the computer knows Earth's exact position in its orbit and can predict which stars will be facing us that night.
fact_tl: May mga app sa telepono na nagpapakita kung anong mga konstelasyon ang lalabas sa langit ngayong gabi sa iyong lugar. Gumagana ito dahil alam ng computer ang eksaktong posisyon ng Earth sa orbit nito, kaya nahuhulaan kung aling mga bituin ang haharap sa atin — kapaki-pakinabang ito sa pag-aaral ng langit.
fact_bis: Adunay mga app sa telepono nga magpakita kung unsang mga konstelasyon ang motungha sa imong langit karong gabii. Molihok kini tungod kay nahibalo ang computer sa eksaktong posisyon sa Earth sa iyang orbit, mao nga matagna kung asang mga bituon ang moatubang nato — mapuslanon kini sa pagkat-on sa langit.

q: Which metal has the highest melting point of all metals?
options: Tungsten, at about 3422°C
Iron, at about 1538°C
Copper, at about 1085°C
Gold, at about 1064°C
explanation: Tungsten has the highest melting point of any metal, at about 3422 degrees Celsius.
fact_tl: Ang tungsten ang metal na may pinakamataas na melting point, mga 3422 degrees Celsius (3422°C).
fact_bis: Ang tungsten mao ang metal nga may labing taas nga melting point, mga 3422 degrees Celsius (3422°C).

q: What does the 'EXP' date on a medicine label tell you?
options: The date after which the medicine may lose its power or become unsafe
The date the medicine was first manufactured at the factory
The date the pharmacist opened the bottle and counted the tablets
The date the medicine was approved by the government
explanation: The EXP or expiration date on a medicine label tells you that after that date the medicine may lose its power or even become unsafe to use.
fact_tl: Sa label may petsa na may markang 'EXP' o expiration date. Pagkatapos ng petsang iyon, maaaring mawala ang bisa ng gamot o maging mapanganib na. Kaya bago uminom, tinitingnan kung hindi pa expired.
fact_bis: Sa label naa'y petsa nga gimarkahan og 'EXP' o expiration date. Human niana nga petsa, mahimong mawala ang bisa sa tambal o mahimong delikado. Busa una moinom, susihon kung dili pa expired.

q: How does mixing with escaped farm pigs threaten native wild pigs in the Philippines?
options: When wild and farm pigs breed together, the pure native pig bloodline slowly disappears
Farm pigs carry diseases that kill wild pigs before they can breed
Farm pigs take over the food supply so wild pigs starve
Wild pigs adopt farm-pig behaviors and forget how to survive in the forest
explanation: When wild and farm pigs breed together, the pure native pig bloodline of the Philippines slowly disappears due to hybridization.
fact_tl: Isang banta sa baboy-ramo ay ang paghahalo nila sa mga alagang baboy na nakakawala. Kapag nagsalo-salo ang ligaw at alaga, unti-unting nawawala ang purong lahi ng native na baboy ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Usa ka hulga sa baboy ihalas mao ang ilang pagsagol sa mga binuhing baboy nga nakaikyas. Kung magsagol ang ihalas ug binuhi, hinay-hinay nga mawala ang lunsay nga kaliwat sa lumad nga baboy sa Pilipinas.

q: In some animals, young ones know the migration route even without parents. How do they know it?
options: The route is inherited — they are born already knowing the path
They sense the route by smelling traces left by older animals
They watch the sun and figure out a new route on their own
They follow river currents that lead to the migration destination
explanation: In some animals the migration route is inherited, so a young one knows it even when alone, without needing to learn it from parents.
fact_tl: Sa ilang hayop, namana ang ruta ng paglalakbay kaya alam na agad ng bata kahit nag-iisa; sa iba naman, natututo ang bata sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa mga magulang at pag-alala sa daan.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka mananap, napanunod ang ruta sa panaw busa nahibal-an na sa bata bisan mag-inusara; sa uban, makakat-on ang bata pinaagi sa pagsunod sa ginikanan ug paghinumdom sa dalan.

q: What is the larva of a housefly called?
options: A maggot
A grub
A nymph
A caterpillar
explanation: A housefly's larva is called a maggot and is often found in rotting food or garbage.
fact_tl: Ang larva ng langaw ay tinatawag na uod (maggot) at madalas matatagpuan sa nabubulok na pagkain o basura.
fact_bis: Ang larva sa langaw gitawag og ulod (maggot) ug sagad makit-an sa nadunot nga pagkaon o basura.

q: What happens when a shark loses one of its front teeth?
options: A new tooth from the row behind it quickly moves forward to replace it
The shark must wait until the next season for a new tooth to grow
The gum heals over and the shark feeds with fewer teeth
A smaller tooth grows in the same spot after several weeks
explanation: A shark has several rows of teeth, and when a front tooth falls out a new one quickly moves forward from the row behind to take its place.
fact_tl: May mga hanay ng ngipin ang pating sa loob ng bibig, at kapag nawala ang nasa harap, may bagong ngipin agad na umuusog pasulong para pumalit.
fact_bis: Adunay daghang laray sa ngipon ang iho sulod sa baba, ug kon mawala ang nauna, naay bag-ong ngipon nga dali ra nga mosulong sa unahan aron mopuli.

q: How often does La Niña occur?
options: Every few years, with two to seven years between events
Every single year, usually during the rainy season
Twice a year, once during summer and once during winter
Every ten years, always following a major El Niño
explanation: La Niña does not happen every year — it usually comes every few years, with two to seven years between events.
fact_tl: Hindi nangyayari ang La Nina bawat taon. Karaniwang dumarating ito tuwing ilang taon, minsan dalawa hanggang pito ang agwat. Sa ibang taon, neutral lang ang Pasipiko, ibig sabihin walang El Nino o La Nina.
fact_bis: Dili mahitabo ang La Nina matag tuig. Kasagaran moabot kini matag pipila ka tuig, usahay duha hangtod pito ka tuig ang gilay-on. Sa ubang tuig neutral lang ang Pasipiko, buot ipasabot walay El Nino ug walay La Nina.

q: During floods and typhoons in the Philippines, why does handwashing with soap become especially important?
options: Dirty water and crowded evacuation centers make diseases spread faster
Floodwater contains chemicals that cause skin rashes if hands are not washed
Handwashing removes mud that blocks blood flow to the fingers
Soap kills mosquitoes that breed in floodwater around evacuation areas
explanation: During floods and typhoons, dirty water and crowded evacuation centers raise the risk of illness, and washing hands with clean water and soap is one of the most effective ways to stop disease from spreading.
fact_tl: Tuwing may baha at bagyo sa Pilipinas, madalas dumami ang sakit dahil sa maruming tubig at siksikan sa evacuation center. Ang paghuhugas ng kamay sa malinis na tubig at sabon ay isa sa pinakamabisang paraan para hindi kumalat ang sakit sa ganitong panahon.
fact_bis: Panahon sa baha ug bagyo sa Pilipinas, kanunay modaghan ang sakit tungod sa hugaw nga tubig ug sikit-sikit nga evacuation center. Ang paghugas sa kamot gamit ang limpyo nga tubig ug sabon usa sa labing epektibo nga paagi aron mapugngan ang pagkatap sa sakit niini nga panahon.

q: What is the main job of the lymphatic system?
options: To collect extra fluid from the body's tissues and return it to the blood
To produce red blood cells that carry oxygen around the body
To filter waste from the blood and send it to the kidneys
To carry digested food from the intestines to the muscles
explanation: The lymphatic system is the body's drainage system — it collects extra fluid from the tissues and returns it to the blood.
fact_tl: Ang sistemang limpatiko ay ang sistema ng pagsasaayos ng katawan na nangangalap ng sobrang likido mula sa mga tisyu at ibinabalik ito sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang sistema sa limpa mao ang sistema sa pag-drain sa lawas nga nagatigom sa sobra nga likido gikan sa mga tisyu ug ibalik kini sa dugo.

q: How can elephants walk quietly even though they are very heavy?
options: They have soft pads under their feet that cushion their steps
Their wide flat feet spread their weight evenly so the ground doesn't vibrate
They tiptoe by lifting their heels and walking only on their toes
They walk slowly enough that their steps don't make a sound
explanation: Elephants have soft pads under their feet that absorb the impact of their steps, allowing them to walk quietly despite their great weight.
fact_tl: May malambot na unan sa ilalim ng paa ng elepante kaya tahimik itong makalakad kahit napakabigat.
fact_bis: Adunay humok nga unan sa ilalom sa tiil sa elepante busa hilom kini makalakaw bisan bug-at kaayo.

q: What gives human skin its color and also helps protect us from the sun's harmful rays?
options: A substance called melanin
A layer of oil produced by sweat glands
Dead skin cells that pile up on the surface
Tiny blood vessels that show through the skin
explanation: Skin color comes from melanin — the more melanin a person has, the darker the skin, and melanin also helps block the sun's harmful rays.
fact_tl: Ang kulay ng balat ay galing sa isang likas na sangkap na tinatawag na melanin. Mas marami ang melanin, mas maitim ang balat, at ito rin ang tumutulong na harangin ang masakit na sinag ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang kolor sa panit gikan sa usa ka butang nga gitawag og melanin. Kung daghan ang melanin, mas itom ang panit, ug kini usab ang nagatabang sa pagsumpo sa makadaot nga sidlak sa adlaw.

q: Why might your heart pound and your hands turn cold right before a race or a hard exam?
options: Adrenaline is released to get your body ready for action
Your blood pressure drops because you are nervous and breathing fast
Your muscles tighten and squeeze blood away from your heart
Your brain sends pain signals to warn you about physical effort
explanation: That pounding heart and cold hands just before a race or exam is adrenaline getting your body ready for action.
fact_tl: Halimbawa, bago ka tumakbo sa palaro sa P.E. o bago ang isang mahirap na pagsusulit, baka maramdaman mong kumakabog ang puso mo at nanlalamig ang kamay. Iyon ay adrenaline na naghahanda sa iyo.
fact_bis: Pananglitan, sa dili pa ka modagan sa dula sa P.E. o sa dili pa ang lisod nga eksaminasyon, basin mobati ka nga mokusog ang pitik sa imong kasingkasing ug mobugnaw ang imong kamot. Kana ang adrenaline nga nag-andam kanimo.

q: Which gas is used to make balloons float and is also an example of a noble gas?
options: Helium (He)
Nitrogen (N₂)
Carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Oxygen (O₂)
explanation: Helium (He) is one example of a noble gas, and it is the gas used in floating balloons.
fact_tl: Isang halimbawa ng noble gas ay helium (He), ang gas na ginagamit sa lumulutang na lobo.
fact_bis: Usa ka ehemplo sa noble gas mao ang helium (He), ang gas nga gigamit sa naglutaw nga balloon.

q: What group of animals are colugos most closely related to, according to scientists?
options: Primates like monkeys and humans
Bats, because they also glide through the air
Squirrels and other tree-climbing rodents
Flying lemurs of Africa
explanation: Scientists have found that colugos are among the closest living relatives of primates like monkeys and humans.
fact_tl: Sa pag-aaral ng mga siyentipiko, ang kagwang ay isa sa pinakamalapit na kamag-anak ng mga primate tulad ng unggoy at tao.
fact_bis: Nahibal-an sa mga siyentista nga ang kagwang usa sa pinakaduol nga mga paryente sa mga primate sama sa unggoy ug tawo.

q: Which gas makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere, making it the most abundant?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Argon
explanation: The most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere is nitrogen, making up about 78% of the air we breathe.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming gas sa hangin (atmosphere) ng Earth ay nitrogen (nitroheno), mga 78%.
fact_bis: Ang labing daghan nga gas sa hangin (atmospera) sa Yuta mao ang nitrogen (nitroheno), mga 78%.

q: What does the inside flesh of a rambutan look and taste like?
options: White, juicy, and sweet, wrapping around the seed
Yellow and sour, with many small seeds throughout
Red and firm, with a dry powdery center
Orange and fibrous, like a smaller version of a mango
explanation: Inside the rambutan is a white, juicy, sweet flesh that wraps around the seed.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng rambutan ay may puti, makatas, at matamis na laman na nakapalibot sa buto.
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa rambutan naay puti, tubigon, ug tam-is nga unod nga nagpalibot sa liso.

q: Besides cattle, what is another major source of methane gas that is especially relevant for the Philippines?
options: Flooded rice paddies, where bacteria produce methane under the water
Burning coal in power plants during the dry season
Ocean waves that release trapped gas from the seafloor
Volcanic eruptions that release gases from deep inside the Earth
explanation: Bacteria in flooded rice paddies produce methane, making rice fields a major source of this greenhouse gas — especially relevant for the Philippines, which has many rice fields.
fact_tl: Saan galing ang methane? Marami nito ang nanggagaling sa mga lugar na binabahaan ng tubig tulad ng palayan, kung saan ang bakterya sa ilalim ng tubig ay bumubuo ng methane. Galing din ito sa mga hayop tulad ng baka — habang nagdidigest sila, naglalabas sila ng methane. Mahalaga ito sa Pilipinas dahil maraming palayan tayo.
fact_bis: Asa gikan ang methane? Daghan niini gikan sa mga dapit nga gibahaan og tubig sama sa palayan, diin ang bakterya ilawom sa tubig mohimo og methane. Gikan usab kini sa mga hayop sama sa baka — samtang motunaw sila sa pagkaon, mopagawas sila og methane. Importante kini sa Pilipinas tungod kay daghan tag palayan.

q: What makes the mantis shrimp famous among sea animals?
options: Its extremely fast and powerful strike, strong enough to crack hard shells
Its ability to change color to match coral reefs perfectly
Its large transparent body that lets predators see through it
Its habit of building a sand castle around itself for protection
explanation: The mantis shrimp is famous for its extremely fast and powerful strike, strong enough to crack the hard shells of its prey.
fact_tl: Ang mantis shrimp o tatampal ay maliit na hayop sa dagat na bantog sa napakabilis at napakalakas nitong suntok na kayang basagin ang kabibe ng kanyang biktima.
fact_bis: Ang mantis shrimp o tatampal usa ka gamay nga mananap sa dagat nga bantog sa kusog ug paspas kaayo nga suntok niini nga makabuak sa gahi nga kabhang sa iyang biktima.

q: How are powerful electromagnets used in metal junkyards?
options: They are attached to cranes to lift and move heavy scrap iron
They are buried underground to detect buried metal pipes
They are placed around the junkyard fence to keep metal from rusting
They are used to sort non-magnetic metals like aluminum from iron
explanation: Powerful electromagnets are used on cranes to lift and move heavy scrap iron in metal junkyards.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ang malalakas na elektromagnet sa mga kreyn para magbuhat at maglipat ng mabibigat na bakal sa basurahan ng metal.
fact_bis: Ginagamit ang kusgang elektromagnet sa mga grua aron mobayaw ug mobalhin sa bug-at nga puthaw sa basurahan sa metal.

q: What does the word 'photovoltaic' describe when it comes to solar panels?
options: Light being turned directly into electricity
Electricity being stored in a battery for later use
Heat from the sun warming water in a pipe
Mirrors reflecting sunlight onto a single point to create steam
explanation: Solar panels are called photovoltaic because they turn sunlight directly into electricity — 'photo' means light and 'voltaic' means electricity.
fact_tl: Ang solar panel ay gawa sa maraming maliliit na cell na ginagawang kuryente ang liwanag ng araw nang direkta. Tinatawag itong photovoltaic, na ang ibig sabihin ay 'liwanag na nagiging kuryente.'
fact_bis: Ang solar panel hinimo gikan sa daghang gagmay nga cell nga maghimo sa sanag sa adlaw nga kuryente direkta. Gitawag kini nga photovoltaic, nga nagpasabot 'kahayag nga mahimong kuryente.'

q: Who discovered the first antibiotic, penicillin, and what was it made from?
options: Alexander Fleming discovered it in 1928 from a mold that kills bacteria
Louis Pasteur discovered it in 1860 from cow's milk fermentation
Marie Curie discovered it in 1910 from a radioactive mineral extract
Edward Jenner discovered it in 1796 from a cowpox infected patient
explanation: The first antibiotic, penicillin, was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928 from a mold that was found to kill bacteria.
fact_tl: Ang unang antibiotic na penicillin ay natuklasan ni Alexander Fleming noong 1928 mula sa isang amag na pumapatay ng bakterya.
fact_bis: Ang unang antibiotic nga penicillin nadiskobrehan ni Alexander Fleming niadtong 1928 gikan sa usa ka agup-up nga mopatay og bakterya.

q: Which of the following best describes Laguna de Bay?
options: A shallow lake with an average depth of only a few meters
A very deep lake, comparable to the deepest lakes in the world
A saltwater bay that connects directly to the Pacific Ocean
A man-made reservoir built to supply water to Metro Manila
explanation: Laguna de Bay is a shallow lake, with an average depth of only a few meters.
fact_tl: Ang Laguna de Bay ay isang mababaw na lawa, na may karaniwang lalim na mga ilang metro lamang.
fact_bis: Ang Laguna de Bay usa ka mabaw nga linaw, nga adunay kasagarang giladmon nga pipila lang ka metro.

q: Besides generating electricity, how else can Earth's underground heat be used?
options: Hot underground water can be piped directly to warm buildings, greenhouses, or baths
It can be collected in tanks and burned like fuel in a power plant
It can be released into rivers to keep them from freezing in winter
It can be used to create powerful magnets deep inside mines
explanation: Earth's underground heat is not always converted to electricity — in some places hot underground water is used directly to warm buildings, greenhouses, or baths.
fact_tl: Hindi laging kuryente ang gawa sa init ng lupa; sa ibang lugar ay direktang ginagamit ang mainit na tubig sa ilalim para painitin ang mga gusali, greenhouse, o paliguan nang hindi muna ginagawang kuryente.
fact_bis: Dili kanunay koryente ang himoon gikan sa init sa yuta; sa ubang dapit ang init nga tubig sa ilalom direktang gigamit aron painiton ang mga building, greenhouse, o paliguanan nga dili una himoong koryente.

q: What does the term 'carrying capacity' mean in ecology?
options: The largest number of one kind of animal that a place can support for a long time
The total weight of all the animals living in one habitat added together
The distance an animal can travel before needing to find food and water
The number of different species that share the same food source
explanation: Carrying capacity is the largest number of one kind of animal that a place can support for a long time without the habitat breaking down.
fact_tl: Ang carrying capacity ay ang pinakamaraming bilang ng isang uri ng hayop na kayang buhayin nang tuloy-tuloy ng isang lugar.
fact_bis: Ang carrying capacity mao ang pinakadaghang gidaghanon sa usa ka klase sa hayop nga makaya nga buhion sa usa ka lugar sa dugay nga panahon.

q: How similar is the DNA of any two people from different countries?
options: More than 99 percent the same — only a tiny part differs
About 50 percent the same, since we share half our genes with anyone
About 75 percent the same, depending on how closely they are related
Completely different, because each person's DNA is totally unique
explanation: The DNA of any two people, regardless of country or background, is more than 99 percent identical — only the very small remaining part accounts for visible differences like hair or skin color.
fact_tl: Ang DNA ng dalawang tao kahit saang bansa galing ay halos eksaktong pareho—mahigit 99 porsiyento. Ang napakaliit na natitirang bahagi ang gumagawa ng pagkakaiba sa hitsura tulad ng kulay ng buhok o balat.
fact_bis: Ang DNA sa bisan kinsang duha ka tawo, bisan asa sila gikan, halos eksaktong pareho—kapin 99 porsiyento. Ang gamay kaayo nga nahabilin nga bahin maoy nagahimo sa kalainan sa panagway sama sa kolor sa buhok o panit.

q: About how tall is Angel Falls, the world's highest waterfall?
options: About 979 meters tall
About 450 meters tall
About 1,500 meters tall
About 250 meters tall
explanation: Angel Falls is about 979 meters tall, making it the highest waterfall in the world.
fact_tl: Ang Angel Falls ay mga 979 metro ang taas.
fact_bis: Ang Angel Falls mga 979 ka metro ang katas-on.

q: Why do water hyacinth mats cause fish in a pond to die?
options: The mat blocks sunlight and lowers the oxygen in the water
The plant releases poison directly into the water
The plant eats the fish's food supply from above the surface
The mat makes the water too warm for the fish to survive
explanation: When water hyacinth covers the surface, oxygen in the water below drops and the fish can die from lack of oxygen.
fact_tl: Dahil natatakpan ang tubig, bumababa ang oxygen at maaaring mamatay ang mga isda sa ilalim.
fact_bis: Tungod kay natabonan ang tubig, mokunhod ang oksiheno ug mahimong mangamatay ang mga isda sa ilawom.

q: How can you tell if a medicine sold in the Philippines is real and safe?
options: It has an FDA registration number on the label
It has a colorful seal from the manufacturer
It was purchased inside a large mall
It has an expiry date printed on the box
explanation: In the Philippines, real medicine has an FDA registration number on the label because the FDA checks whether medicines are safe.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang tunay na gamot ay may FDA registration number sa label. Ang FDA (Food and Drug Administration) ang ahensya ng gobyerno na nagsusuri kung ligtas ang gamot. Kapag walang ganitong marka, baka peke ang gamot.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang tinuod nga tambal naa'y FDA registration number sa label. Ang FDA (Food and Drug Administration) mao ang ahensya sa gobyerno nga nagasusi kung luwas ang tambal. Kung wala kini nga marka, basin peke ang tambal.

q: Why is civet coffee one of the most expensive coffees in the world?
options: It is rare and hard to gather
It grows only at the top of mountains
It must be imported from other countries
It takes ten years for the coffee plant to bear fruit
explanation: Civet coffee is one of the most expensive coffees because it is rare and hard to gather.
fact_tl: Ang kapeng alamid ay isa sa pinakamahal na kape sa mundo dahil bihira at mahirap kalapin ito.
fact_bis: Ang kape sa alamid usa sa labing mahal nga kape sa kalibotan tungod kay panagsa ug lisod tigumon.

q: How does a squid move quickly through the water?
options: It squirts water out of its body to push itself forward
It beats large fins on the sides of its body
It uses its long tentacles like oars to row
It floats on ocean currents to travel fast
explanation: A squid swims fast by squirting water out of its body, pushing itself like a jet.
fact_tl: Ang pusit ay lumalangoy nang mabilis sa pamamagitan ng pagbuga ng tubig palabas, parang jet.
fact_bis: Ang pusit kusog molangoy pinaagi sa pagbuga sa tubig pagawas, nga motulak kaniya sama sa jet.

q: After the kidneys filter the blood, what happens to useful substances like sugar?
options: They are returned to the blood
They are sent to the bladder as urine
They are stored in the liver for later use
They are broken down and expelled as waste
explanation: The kidneys return useful things like sugar and nutrients back to the blood instead of throwing them away.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng sinasala ay inaalis; ibinabalik ng bato sa dugo ang mga kapaki-pakinabang gaya ng asukal at sustansya.
fact_bis: Dili tanan nga gisala ilabay; ang kidney mobalik sa dugo sa mga mapuslanon sama sa asukal ug sustansya.

q: What are seeds doing when they stay in the soil for a long time without sprouting?
options: Waiting for enough water and warmth before sprouting
Collecting nutrients from the soil to grow roots first
Releasing chemicals to make the soil better
Dying slowly before a new seed replaces them
explanation: Many seeds can 'sleep' or stay dormant in the soil until there is enough water and warmth, sometimes waiting for many years before they sprout.
fact_tl: Maraming buto ang maaaring 'matulog' nang matagal — naghihintay sila sa lupa hanggang sa dumating ang sapat na tubig at init bago sila tumubo, minsan pagkalipas ng maraming taon.
fact_bis: Daghang liso ang mahimong 'matulog' og dugay — maghulat sila sa yuta hangtod nga moabot ang igong tubig ug kainit una sila motubo, usahay human sa daghang tuig.

q: Why does a decline in bee populations threaten our food supply?
options: Many fruits and vegetables need bee pollination to produce fruit
Bees make honey which farmers sell to buy seeds
Bees loosen the soil so that plant roots can grow deeper
Bees carry water from rivers to dry farmland
explanation: Many fruits and vegetables need bee pollination to produce fruit, so when bee populations decline, food security is threatened.
fact_tl: Ang pagbaba ng populasyon ng mga bubuyog dahil sa pesticide, pagkawala ng tirahan, at sakit ay nagbabanta sa pollination ng mga pananim—maraming prutas at gulay ang nangangailangan ng bubuyog para mamunga.
fact_bis: Ang pagbaba sa populasyon sa mga putyukan tungod sa pesticide, pagkawala sa tirahan, ug sakit nagbanta sa pollination sa mga pananim; daghang prutas ug utanon nagkinahanglan sa pollination sa putyukan aron mamunga.

q: Which Philippine government agency under DOST oversaw the development of the Diwata satellites?
options: ASTI (Advanced Science Technology Institute)
PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration)
PHIVOLCS (Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology)
NAMRIA (National Mapping and Resource Information Authority)
explanation: ASTI, the Advanced Science Technology Institute under DOST, oversaw the development of satellites like Diwata and other advanced technology projects for the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang ASTI o Advanced Science Technology Institute ng DOST ang nagpangasiwa sa pagbuo ng mga satellite tulad ng Diwata at iba pang makabagong proyekto ng teknolohiya para sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang ASTI o Advanced Science Technology Institute sa ilawom sa DOST nagdumala sa pagpalambo sa mga satellite sama sa Diwata ug uban pang advanced nga proyekto sa teknolohiya para sa Pilipinas.

q: What happens if a person receives the wrong blood type during a transfusion?
options: The red blood cells clump together, which is dangerous
The body simply breaks the extra blood down harmlessly
The heart beats faster to push the new blood out
The immune system stores the wrong blood in the liver
explanation: If given the wrong blood type, the red blood cells clump together, which is very dangerous to the body.
fact_tl: Kapag binigyan ng maling uri ng dugo, ang mga pulang selula ay nagdidikit at namumuo, na delikado.
fact_bis: Kung mahatagan og sayop nga klase sa dugo, ang mga pula nga selula magtipun-tipon ug magpundok, nga delikado.

q: A car slows down before stopping. Is the car accelerating?
options: Yes, because slowing down is a change in speed
No, because acceleration only means speeding up
No, because the car is still moving in the same direction
Yes, but only if the driver presses the gas pedal
explanation: Acceleration means any change in speed or direction, so slowing down counts as acceleration too.
fact_tl: Ang aselerasyon ay ang pagbabago sa bilis o direksyon ng isang bagay, kaya nangyayari ito kapag bumibilis, bumabagal, o lumiliko ang isang sasakyan.
fact_bis: Ang aselerasyon mao ang pagbag-o sa katulin o direksyon sa usa ka butang, busa mahitabo kini kon mopaspas, mohinay, o moliko ang usa ka sakyanan.

q: What causes a coral to turn white during bleaching?
options: The coral pushes out the algae living inside it
Pollution paints the coral's surface white
The coral skeleton is exposed after strong waves break it
Cold water freezes the coral's outer layer
explanation: Coral bleaching happens when a coral pushes out the algae inside it, which makes it turn white.
fact_tl: Ang coral bleaching ay nangyayari kapag itinaboy ng coral ang algae sa loob nito, kaya ito namumuti.
fact_bis: Ang coral bleaching mahitabo kung iabog sa coral ang algae sulod niini, mao nga kini moputi.

q: Why do scientists keep discovering new kinds of animals in the deep ocean?
options: Most of the deep ocean is still unexplored
The deep ocean animals reproduce faster than scientists can count them
Deep ocean water is too dark to keep any records
Scientists only started exploring the ocean last year
explanation: Most of the deep ocean is still unexplored, so scientists regularly discover new kinds of animals there.
fact_tl: Karamihan sa malalim na karagatan ay hindi pa nagagalugad, kaya patuloy pa ang pagtuklas ng mga bagong uri ng hayop doon.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa lawom nga dagat wala pa masuhid, mao nga padayon pa ang pagdiskobre sa bag-ong matang sa mananap didto.

q: Why do new variants of the COVID-19 virus appear over time?
options: The virus changes as it multiplies, creating new types
Doctors mix old viruses together in laboratories
People trade the virus between countries intentionally
The virus grows stronger when the weather is cold
explanation: The COVID-19 virus changes as it multiplies, so new types or variants of it appear over time.
fact_tl: Ang virus ng COVID-19 ay nagbabago habang dumadami, kaya lumalabas ang mga bagong uri o variant nito sa paglipas ng panahon.
fact_bis: Ang virus sa COVID-19 nagbag-o samtang nagdaghan, mao nga mogawas ang bag-ong klase o variant niini sa paglabay sa panahon.

q: How many senators make up the Philippine Senate?
options: 24 senators
12 senators
36 senators
48 senators
explanation: There are 24 senators in the Philippine Senate.
fact_tl: May 24 senador sa Senado ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Adunay 24 ka senador sa Senado sa Pilipinas.

q: Which instrument do scientists use to detect tiny earthquakes when monitoring a volcano?
options: A seismometer
A barometer
A thermometer
A hygrometer
explanation: Scientists measure tiny earthquakes near a volcano with a seismometer, which is one of the signs that magma may be getting close.
fact_tl: Binabantayan ng mga siyentista ang bulkan gamit ang mga instrumento. Sinusukat nila ang munting lindol gamit ang seismometer, ang gas na lumalabas, at ang pagbukol o pamamaga ng lupa — mga senyales na maaaring papalapit na ang magma.
fact_bis: Gibantayan sa mga siyentista ang bulkan gamit ang mga instrumento. Gisukod nila ang gagmay nga linog pinaagi sa seismometer, ang gas nga mogawas, ug ang pagbukol o paghubag sa yuta — mga timailhan nga tingali nagkaduol na ang magma.

q: What kind of light does the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) use to observe the universe?
options: Infrared light
Visible light
Ultraviolet light
Radio waves
explanation: The James Webb Space Telescope observes the universe in infrared light, which lets it see objects too distant or cool for Hubble to detect.
fact_tl: Ang James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) ay nagmamasid ng universe sa infrared light mula sa Lagrange point L2, humigit-kumulang 1.5 milyong kilometro mula sa Earth; maaari itong makita ang mga bagay na masyadong malalayo o malamig para makita ng Hubble, kasama ang mga unang galaxy ng universe.
fact_bis: Ang James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) nagobserba sa universe sa infrared light gikan sa L2 Lagrange point, mga 1.5 milyong kilometro gikan sa Yuta; makita niini ang mga butang nga layo kaayo o bugnaw para makit-an sa Hubble, lakip ang pinakasayo nga mga galaxy.

q: How do aphids harm crops in addition to sucking their sap?
options: They spread viruses that make crops sick as they move from plant to plant
They lay eggs inside the fruit, making it rot faster
They block sunlight by building waxy covers over leaves
They attract larger insects that eat the crop's roots
explanation: As aphids feed from plant to plant, they can spread viruses that make crops sick.
fact_tl: Habang sumususo sa iba't ibang halaman, naililipat ng aphid ang mga virus na nagpapasakit sa pananim.
fact_bis: Samtang nagasupsop gikan sa lainlaing tanom, ang aphid makabalhin sa mga virus nga makasakit sa pananom.

q: About how fast does the Voyager 1 space probe travel through space?
options: About 61,000 kilometers per hour
About 1,000 kilometers per hour
About 300,000 kilometers per hour
About 10,000 kilometers per hour
explanation: The Voyager 1 space probe travels through space at about 61,000 kilometers per hour.
fact_tl: Ang Voyager 1 na space probe ay naglalakbay sa kalawakan sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 61,000 kilometro kada oras.
fact_bis: Ang Voyager 1 nga space probe mobiyahe sa kawanangan sa tulin nga mga 61,000 ka kilometro kada oras.

q: Why can a camel survive many days without drinking water?
options: Its body saves water very well
It stores liquid water in its two humps
It absorbs water directly from the desert sand
It only needs water once a month because it sweats very little
explanation: A camel can live many days without drinking because its body is very good at saving water.
fact_tl: Kayang mabuhay ng kamelyo nang maraming araw na walang inumin dahil mahusay itong mag-ipon ng tubig sa katawan.
fact_bis: Ang kamelyo makabuhi ug daghang adlaw nga walay imnonon kay maayo kini mutipig ug tubig sa lawas.

q: Which muscle below your lungs moves to help you breathe?
options: The diaphragm
The abdominal muscle
The intercostal muscle
The pectoral muscle
explanation: Below the lungs is a muscle called the diaphragm that moves to help you breathe.
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng iyong baga ay may kalamnang tinatawag na diaphragm na gumagalaw upang tulungan kang huminga.
fact_bis: Sa ilawom sa imong baga adunay kaunoran nga gitawag og diaphragm nga molihok aron motabang nimo sa pagginhawa.

q: About how many weeks are there in one year?
options: About 52 weeks
About 36 weeks
About 48 weeks
About 60 weeks
explanation: There are about 52 weeks in one year.
fact_tl: May humigit-kumulang 52 linggo sa isang taon.
fact_bis: Adunay mga 52 ka semana sa usa ka tuig.

q: What does an element's period number in the periodic table tell you about its atoms?
options: How many electron shells, or energy levels, its atoms have
How many protons are in the nucleus of its atoms
How many neutrons the atoms of that element have
The total number of electrons in one atom of the element
explanation: An element's period number tells how many electron shells, or energy levels, its atoms have.
fact_tl: Ang numero ng period ng isang elemento ay nagsasabi kung ilang electron shell o energy level mayroon ang atomo nito.
fact_bis: Ang numero sa period sa usa ka elemento nagsulti kung pila ka electron shell o energy level ang anaa sa atomo niini.

q: Why is it better for the environment to recycle paper than to make new paper from wood?
options: Recycling paper uses significantly less energy and helps preserve trees
Recycled paper produces stronger sheets than wood paper
Making new paper from wood releases dangerous gases into homes
Paper recycled in the Philippines costs more so fewer trees are cut
explanation: Recycling paper uses significantly less energy than making new paper from wood and helps preserve trees in forests.
fact_tl: Ang pag-recycle ng papel ay gumagamit ng mas kaunting enerhiya kaysa paggawa ng bagong papel mula sa kahoy at nakatutulong sa pagpreserba ng mga puno sa kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang pag-recycle sa papel naggamit og mas gamay nga enerhiya kaysa paghimo og bag-ong papel gikan sa kahoy ug nagtabang sa pagpreserba sa mga puno sa kagubatan.

q: Why can't plants simply use the nitrogen in the air around them?
options: Plants cannot use nitrogen gas directly; it must first be changed into another form
Plants only absorb nitrogen through their leaves when it rains
Nitrogen in the air is mixed with oxygen, which blocks the plant's roots
Plants need nitrogen only for flowering, not for everyday growth
explanation: Plants cannot use nitrogen gas from the air directly; it must first be changed into another form that plants can absorb.
fact_tl: Hindi direktang magagamit ng mga halaman ang nitroheno gas sa hangin; kailangan muna itong baguhin sa ibang anyo.
fact_bis: Dili direkta magamit sa mga tanom ang nitrogen gas sa hangin; kinahanglan una kini usbon ngadto sa laing porma.

q: Why does a mother bird sit on her eggs after laying them?
options: Her body heat keeps the eggs warm so the chick can grow inside
