fact_bis: Ang siklo sa kinabuhi sa pako adunay duha ka yugto: ang dako nga madahon nga tanom nga maghimo og spora, ug usa ka gamay kaayo ug pataganang tanom nga motubo gikan sa spora sa dili pa mobalik sa dako nga tanom.

q: What makes the sound of a kubing louder when you flick its tongue harder?
options: A harder flick makes the sound travel faster, which makes it seem louder
A harder flick changes the pitch of the sound, which the ear hears as louder
A harder flick makes the tongue swing back and forth more (greater amplitude), producing a louder sound
A harder flick causes the metal to heat up slightly, releasing more sound energy
explanation: Flicking the kubing tongue harder makes it swing with greater amplitude, which produces a louder sound — loudness depends on how much energy you put in.
fact_tl: Kung mas malakas mong pinitik ang dila ng kubing, mas malaki ang paggalaw nito pabalik-balik (amplitude), kaya mas malakas ang tunog. Kapag marahan lang ang pitik mo, maliit lang ang galaw at mahina ang tunog. Ang lakas ng tunog ay nakadepende sa dami ng enerhiyang ibinigay mo.
fact_bis: Kung mas kusog nimong kutoyon ang dila sa kubing, mas dako ang lihok niini balik-balik (amplitude), busa mas kusog ang tunog. Kung hinay ra ang imong kutoy, gamay ra ang lihok ug hinay ang tunog. Ang kakusog sa tunog nagdepende sa gidaghanon sa enerhiya nga imong gihatag.

q: What is talc, the softest mineral, commonly ground into?
options: Talcum powder
Baking soda
Fine sand
Chalk dust
explanation: Talc is the softest mineral and is ground into talcum powder.
fact_tl: Ang talc, ang pinakamalambot na mineral, ay ginagawang talcum powder o pulbos.
fact_bis: Ang talc, ang pinakahumok nga mineral, ginagaling aron mahimong talcum powder o pulbos.

q: Why does a rolling ball eventually stop on its own?
options: Gravity pulls the ball straight down into the ground
Friction acts as an unbalanced force pushing against the ball's motion
The air around the ball pushes it forward and slows it
The ball runs out of the energy it was made of
explanation: Friction is an unbalanced force that pushes against the rolling ball until it stops.
fact_tl: Sa totoong buhay, humihinto ang gumugulong na bola dahil ang friction ay isang di-balanseng pwersang pumipigil dito.
fact_bis: Sa tinuod nga kinabuhi, mohunong ang nagligid nga bola tungod kay ang friction usa ka dili balanse nga pwersa nga mosumpo niini.

q: How long are cats and dogs usually pregnant?
options: About one month, or four weeks
About two months, or nine weeks
About three months, or thirteen weeks
About six months, or twenty-six weeks
explanation: Both cats and dogs are pregnant for about two months, or nine weeks.
fact_tl: Parehong nagbubuntis ang pusa at aso nang halos dalawang buwan o siyam na linggo.
fact_bis: Parehas nga mabdos ang iring ug iro ug mga duha ka bulan o siyam ka semana.

q: How can a shrimp regrow a leg it has lost?
options: It grows the leg back instantly after losing it
It grows the leg back a little more each time it molts
It absorbs a spare leg from another shrimp nearby
It cannot regrow lost legs and stays injured permanently
explanation: A shrimp can slowly grow back a lost leg each time it molts.
fact_tl: Kung mawalan ng paa ang hipon, maaari itong tumubo ulit nang paunti-unti tuwing magpapalit ito ng balat.
fact_bis: Kon mawad-an og tiil ang hipon, makatubo kini balik anam-anam matag higayon nga mag-ilis kini sa panit.

q: Which three coastal habitats are connected and share many of the same animals?
options: Mangroves, sandy beaches, and open ocean
Seagrass meadows, mangroves, and coral reefs
Coral reefs, kelp forests, and deep-sea vents
Salt marshes, tidal flats, and rocky shores
explanation: Seagrass meadows, mangroves, and coral reefs are connected coastal habitats that share many of the same animals.
fact_tl: Ang damuhan ng damong-dagat, bakawan, at bahura ay magkakaugnay na tirahan sa baybayin na nagbabahaginan ng parehong mga hayop.
fact_bis: Ang damuhan sa sagbot sa dagat, bakawan, ug bahura mga magkalambigit nga puy-anan sa baybayon nga nagbahin sa samang mga mananap.

q: Why are diamonds used to make rings and necklaces?
options: They are very soft, so they can be shaped into any design
They sparkle and are extremely tough, so they last a very long time
They are the lightest mineral, making jewelry easy to wear
They glow in the dark, making them easy to find if lost
explanation: Diamonds are used in jewelry because they sparkle beautifully and are very tough, so they last a very long time.
fact_tl: Ginagawang alahas tulad ng singsing at kwintas ang diamante dahil kumikinang ito at napakatibay, kaya tumatagal ito nang napakatagal.
fact_bis: Ginahimong alahas sama sa singsing ug kwintas ang diamante kay mosidlak kini ug lig-on kaayo, mao nga mudugay kini og taas nga panahon.

q: Which statement about the Philippine crocodile is true?
options: It is a large saltwater crocodile found all across Southeast Asia
It is a small freshwater crocodile found only in the Philippines and is one of the most endangered in the world
It is a medium-sized crocodile that lives in the sea around Philippine islands
It is a common crocodile that is not protected because there are many of them
explanation: The Philippine crocodile (Crocodylus mindorensis) is a small freshwater crocodile found only in the Philippines and is one of the most endangered crocodiles in the world.
fact_tl: Ang buwayang Pilipino (Crocodylus mindorensis) ay isang maliit na buwaya sa tabang na tubig na matatagpuan lamang sa Pilipinas; ito ay isa sa pinakananganganib na buwaya sa mundo at mahigpit na pinoprotektahan.
fact_bis: Ang buwaya nga Pilipino (Crocodylus mindorensis) usa ka gamay nga buwaya sa tab-ang nga tubig nga makita lamang sa Pilipinas; usa kini sa labing namiligro nga buwaya sa kalibutan ug higpit nga gipanalipdan.

q: How many people have walked on the Moon so far?
options: Six
Eight
Twelve
Twenty
explanation: So far, twelve people have walked on the Moon, all of them American astronauts.
fact_tl: Hanggang ngayon, labindalawang (12) tao na ang tumapak sa buwan, lahat sila ay Amerikanong astronaut.
fact_bis: Hangtod karon, napulog duha (12) ka tawo na ang mitamak sa bulan, tanan sila Amerikanong astronaut.

q: What does HIV do to the human body's immune system?
options: It strengthens T cells so the body fights disease more easily
It attacks T cells, which slowly weakens the body's defense against other diseases
It only affects red blood cells and leaves the immune system untouched
It blocks the lungs so oxygen cannot reach the immune cells
explanation: HIV attacks the T cells of the immune system, so the body's defense against other diseases slowly weakens.
fact_tl: Ang HIV ay isang virus na umaatake sa mismong mga T cell ng immune system, kaya unti-unting humihina ang depensa ng katawan laban sa ibang sakit.
fact_bis: Ang HIV usa ka virus nga moataki sa mismong mga T cell sa immune system, busa hinay-hinay nga mohuyang ang depensa sa lawas batok sa ubang sakit.

q: Which metal is responsible for the bright white or silver color in fireworks?
options: Iron
Copper
Magnesium
Potassium
explanation: The bright white or silver color in fireworks comes from burning magnesium or aluminum.
fact_tl: Ang maliwanag na PUTI o silver na kulay sa paputok ay galing sa nasusunog na MAGNESIUM o aluminum.
fact_bis: Ang hayag nga PUTI o silver nga kolor sa paputok gikan sa nagdilaab nga MAGNESIUM o aluminum.

q: What do pawikan conservation programmes in places like Batangas do to protect sea turtles?
options: They keep sea turtles in large tanks so predators cannot reach them
They monitor turtle eggs on beaches and release newly hatched turtles into the sea
They catch adult turtles and bring them to aquariums for safety
They spray the beach with chemicals to keep egg-eating animals away
explanation: Pawikan conservation programmes monitor turtle eggs and release newly hatched turtles into the sea on beaches like those in Batangas.
fact_tl: Sa ilang dalampasigan ng Pilipinas tulad ng Batangas, isinasagawa ang mga programang pawikan conservation kung saan ang mga itlog ng pawikan ay binabantayan at ang mga bagong pisang turtle ay inilalabas sa karagatan.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka baybayon sa Pilipinas sama sa mga baybayon sa Batangas, gipatuman ang mga programa sa konserbasyon sa pawikan diin ang mga itlog sa pawikan gibantayan ug ang mga bag-o lang pisang mga turtle gipalabas sa dagat.

q: Who was the first person to travel into space?
options: Neil Armstrong
Buzz Aldrin
Yuri Gagarin
Alan Shepard
explanation: Yuri Gagarin was the first person to travel into space in 1961, orbiting Earth once inside his spacecraft.
fact_tl: Si Yuri Gagarin ang unang taong nakapunta sa kalawakan noong 1961 nang isang beses niyang naikot ang Earth sa loob ng kanyang spacecraft.
fact_bis: Si Yuri Gagarin mao ang unang tawo nga nakaabot sa kawanangan niadtong 1961 sa dihang kausa niyang gilibot ang Earth sulod sa iyang spacecraft.

q: A wheelbarrow makes carrying heavy loads easier by combining which two simple machines?
options: A pulley and an inclined plane
A wedge and a screw
A wheel and a lever
A gear and an axle
explanation: A wheelbarrow combines a wheel and a lever to make carrying and lifting heavy loads easier.
fact_tl: Ang kariton ay isang simpleng makina na pinagsasama ang gulong at lever upang mas madaling buhatin at iangat ang mabigat na karga tulad ng semento.
fact_bis: Ang kariton usa ka simpleng makina nga naghiusa sa ligid ug lever aron mas sayon nga madala ug maalsa ang bug-at nga lulan sama sa semento.

q: What can happen if a crab pinches you with its claw?
options: Its claw is weak, so it only tickles and does not hurt
Its claw is very strong and can hurt you
Its claw leaves behind a liquid that makes your skin itch
Its claw is soft and bends without causing any harm
explanation: A crab's claw is very strong and can hurt if it pinches you.
fact_tl: Napakalakas ng sipit ng alimango at maaari itong makapanakit kapag naipit ka.
fact_bis: Kusgan kaayo ang sipit sa alimango ug makasakit kini kung maipit ka.

q: Where is Aliwagwag Falls, the country's tallest waterfall, located?
options: Pagsanjan, Laguna
Tinago, Lanao del Norte
Cateel, Davao Oriental
Iligan, Lanao del Norte
explanation: Aliwagwag Falls, the country's tallest waterfall, is located in Cateel, Davao Oriental.
fact_tl: Ang Aliwagwag Falls, ang pinakamataas na talon ng bansa, ay matatagpuan sa Cateel, Davao Oriental.
fact_bis: Ang Aliwagwag Falls, ang pinakataas nga busay sa nasod, makit-an sa Cateel, Davao Oriental.

q: How does a volcanic mountain form over time?
options: A single huge eruption blasts up a mountain in one event
Layer upon layer of lava and ash slowly build up over many eruptions
Earthquakes push underground rock upward to form a cone shape
Wind and rain pile up loose ash into a cone-shaped hill
explanation: Over many eruptions, layer upon layer of lava and ash slowly build up a volcanic mountain.
fact_tl: Sa paglipas ng maraming pagsabog, ang patong-patong na lava at abo ay unti-unting nagtatayo ng isang bundok na bulkan.
fact_bis: Sa paglabay sa daghang pagbuto, ang patong-patong nga lava ug abo hinay-hinay nga magtukod ug usa ka bukid nga bolkan.

q: How are the roots of the water hyacinth different from most land plants?
options: They grow along the surface of the water like floating mats
They dangle in the water and do not anchor into the ground
They dig deep into the mud to hold the plant tightly in place
They have no roots at all because the plant floats freely
explanation: The roots of the water hyacinth dangle in the water and do not anchor to the ground.
fact_tl: Ang mga ugat ng water hyacinth ay nakalawit sa tubig at hindi nakakapit sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamot sa water hyacinth nagbitay sa tubig ug wala mokupot sa yuta.

q: How does seagrass spread across the seafloor?
options: It releases seeds that float on the water and settle in new spots
It sends out underground stems called rhizomes that creep beneath the sand
It grows tall and falls over, and the fallen part becomes a new plant
Waves break off pieces of the grass that drift and attach elsewhere
explanation: Seagrass spreads by underground stems called rhizomes that creep beneath the sand.
fact_tl: Kumakalat ang damong-dagat sa pamamagitan ng mga tangkay na tinatawag na rhizome na gumagapang sa ilalim ng buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang sagbot sa dagat mokatag pinaagi sa mga tangkay nga gitawag og rhizome nga nagakamang ilalom sa balas.

q: Why does a pendulum clock need to be wound up?
options: Winding changes the length of the pendulum so it keeps better time
Winding adds a small amount of energy to each swing so the pendulum does not stop
Winding releases oil that keeps the pendulum moving without friction
Winding sets the clock hands to the correct time automatically
explanation: A pendulum clock must be wound to add a little energy to each swing so the pendulum does not stop.
fact_tl: Ang orasang may pendulum ay kailangang binubuwelo o may bumababang bigat na nagdadagdag ng kaunting enerhiya sa bawat ugoy, para hindi ito huminto.
fact_bis: Ang relo nga may pendulum kinahanglang i-wind, o may hinay nga nahulog nga gibug-aton, nga magdugang og gamay nga kusog sa matag labyog aron dili kini mohunong.

q: Why does the Agusan River often look brown or muddy, especially after heavy rain?
options: Factories nearby dump brown dye into the river during storms
Flowing river water picks up tiny bits of soil, sand, and mud called sediment along the way
The riverbed is made of dark rock that colours the water when it moves fast
Brown algae blooms in the river every time it rains heavily
explanation: Flowing river water carries sediment — tiny bits of soil, sand, and mud — which makes the Agusan River look brown or muddy after heavy rain.
fact_tl: Ang umaagos na tubig ng ilog ay may dalang maliliit na piraso ng lupa, buhangin, at putik na tinatawag na sediment. Kaya kadalasang kulay-kape o maputik ang tubig ng Agusan lalo na kapag malakas ang ulan—dala-dala nito ang lupang nakuha sa daan.
fact_bis: Ang nagadagayday nga tubig sa suba nagdala og gagmayng tipik sa yuta, balas, ug lapok nga gitawag og sediment. Mao nga kasagaran kape o lapokon ang tubig sa Agusan ilabi na human sa kusog nga ulan—gidala niini ang yuta nga nakuha sa dalan.

q: Which group of things is made up of ONLY living things?
options: Rocks, rivers, and mountains
Plants, animals, and fungi
Wind, sunlight, and air
Fire, clouds, and rainwater
explanation: Living things like plants, animals, and fungi grow, take in food or energy, breathe, respond to their surroundings, and reproduce — unlike nonliving things such as rocks and water.
fact_tl: Ang mga buhay na bagay (living things) ay lumalaki, kumakain o kumukuha ng enerhiya, humihinga, tumutugon sa paligid, at nakakapagpaparami (reproduce). Ang mga di-buhay na bagay tulad ng bato at tubig ay hindi ginagawa ang mga ito.
fact_bis: Ang buhi nga mga butang (living things) motubo, mokaon o mokuha og enerhiya, moginhawa, motubag sa palibot, ug makahimo og bag-o nga sama nila (reproduce). Ang dili-buhi nga mga butang sama sa bato ug tubig wala maghimo niini.

q: Who first used the word 'radioactivity'?
options: Albert Einstein
Ernest Rutherford
Marie Curie
Niels Bohr
explanation: Marie Curie coined the word 'radioactivity'.
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ang lumikha ng salitang 'radioactivity' (radyoaktibidad).
fact_bis: Si Marie Curie ang naghimo sa pulong nga 'radioactivity' (radyoaktibidad).

q: In which province is Lingayen Gulf, an important fishing area, located?
options: Batangas and Quezon
Ilocos Norte and Ilocos Sur
Pangasinan and La Union
Pampanga and Zambales
explanation: Lingayen Gulf is located on the western coast of Luzon in Pangasinan and La Union provinces and is important for fishing.
fact_tl: Ang Golpo ng Lingayen ay isang malaking look sa kanlurang Luzon sa mga lalawigan ng Pangasinan at La Union; ito ay mahalaga sa pangingisda.
fact_bis: Ang Golpo sa Lingayen usa ka dakong golpo sa kasadpanong Luzon sa mga probinsya sa Pangasinan ug La Union; importante kini para sa pangisda.

q: What can happen if a copper wire is too thin for the electricity passing through it?
options: The wire becomes a better conductor and more electricity flows safely
The wire heats up too much and can start a fire
The wire turns green and stops conducting electricity altogether
The wire stretches and makes the circuit longer but stays safe
explanation: If a copper wire is too thin for the electricity passing through it, it heats up too much and can start a fire, which is why the right wire size must be used in homes.
fact_tl: Kung masyadong manipis ang tansong wire para sa lakas ng kuryenteng dumadaan dito, uuminit ito nang sobra at puwedeng maging sanhi ng sunog. Kaya tamang sukat ng wire ang dapat gamitin sa bahay.
fact_bis: Kung sobra ka nipis ang tumbaga nga wire para sa kakusog sa kuryente nga moagi niini, mainit kini pag-ayo ug mahimong hinungdan sa sunog. Mao nga ang husto nga gidak-on sa wire kinahanglan gamiton sa balay.

q: What is the West Valley Fault, and why is it a concern for Metro Manila?
options: It is an inactive fault that has not moved in thousands of years and poses little risk
It is an active fault crossing Metro Manila that could produce a magnitude greater than 7.2 earthquake
It is a crack in the ocean floor near Manila Bay that causes tsunamis
It is a minor fault only found in Marikina City that affects only local roads
explanation: The West Valley Fault is an active fault crossing Metro Manila; PHIVOLCS warns it could produce a magnitude greater than 7.2 earthquake when it ruptures.
fact_tl: Ang West Valley Fault (tinatawag ding Marikina Valley Fault) ay isang aktibong fault na tumatawid sa Metro Manila at mga kalapit na lalawigan; ang PHIVOLCS ay nagbababala na ito ay maaaring lumikha ng lindol na may magnitude na higit 7.2 kapag bumagsak, na maaaring magdulot ng malawak na pinsala sa Metro Manila.
fact_bis: Ang West Valley Fault (gitawag usab og Marikina Valley Fault) usa ka aktibong fault nga nagkros sa Metro Manila ug mga kalapit nga lalawigan; gibabala sa PHIVOLCS nga kini makahimo og lindol nga labaw sa magnitude 7.2 kon mobali, mahimong magdulot og halapad nga kadaot sa Metro Manila.

q: Why is it very hard to squeeze a solid into a smaller space?
options: Solids are made of liquid particles that flow around when pressed
Solid particles are already packed very close together with almost no gaps
Solids have lots of empty space inside that traps air and resists squeezing
Squeezing a solid changes it into a liquid, which then takes less space
explanation: Solid particles are already packed very close together with almost no gaps, so it is very hard to squeeze a solid into a smaller volume.
fact_tl: Akala ng iba ay pwedeng basta i-squeeze ng maliit ang isang solid. Pero dahil magkadikit na ang mga particle nito at halos walang puwang, napakahirap nitong gawing mas maliit. Kaya nananatili ang dami ng espasyong inuubos nito (fixed volume).
fact_bis: Ang uban naghunahuna nga puwede lang nimo ipiit og gamay ang usa ka solid. Apan kay nagkadikit na ang mga tipik niini ug halos walay luna, lisod kaayo kini himuong gamay. Mao nga magpabilin ang gidaghanon sa luna nga gikuha niini (fixed volume).

q: What is a pulley?
options: A flat ramp that makes sliding heavy objects up easier
A wheel with a groove where a rope runs, used to raise or lower things
A bar that pivots on a point to lift heavy loads
A wedge-shaped tool used to split or cut materials apart
explanation: A pulley is a wheel with a groove around its edge where a rope runs, and it is used to raise or lower things.
fact_tl: Ang pulley ay isang gulong na may kanal sa gilid kung saan dumadaan ang lubid. Ginagamit ito para magbuhat o magbaba ng mga bagay.
fact_bis: Ang pulley usa ka gulong nga adunay kanal sa kilid diin moagi ang pisi. Gigamit kini aron isaka o ibaba ang mga butang.

q: How is a reflex different from a voluntary movement like walking?
options: A reflex is slower because your brain carefully plans it each time
A reflex happens without you thinking about it, while walking is a decision you make
A reflex only happens in your arms, while voluntary movements involve your legs
A reflex uses more muscles than a voluntary movement does
explanation: In a reflex your body moves without you thinking about it or allowing it, unlike a voluntary movement such as walking, which you decide to do.
fact_tl: May pagkakaiba ang reflex at kusang-loob na galaw. Kapag naglalakad ka, ikaw ang nagpapasya. Pero sa reflex, gumagalaw ang katawan mo nang hindi mo pinag-iisipan o pinapayagan.
fact_bis: Naay kalainan ang reflex ug ang kusganong lihok. Kung molakaw ka, ikaw ang modesisyon. Apan sa reflex, molihok ang imong lawas nga wala nimo gihunahuna o gitugotan.

q: When a lever reduces the force you need to lift something, what happens to the distance the effort end must move?
options: The effort end moves a shorter distance than the load
The effort end moves the same distance as the load
The effort end must move a greater distance than the load
The effort end does not move at all — only the load moves
explanation: When a lever reduces the effort force needed, the effort end must move a greater distance than the load moves.
fact_tl: Kapag ginagamit ang lever para bawasan ang puwersa, dapat ilipat nang mas malayo ang dulo ng effort kaysa sa gumagalaw na karga.
fact_bis: Kung gigamit ang lever aron mabawasan ang gikinahanglang paningkamot, ang katapusan sa effort kinahanglan mobalhin og mas layo kaysa sa nabalhinan nga luwan.

q: Which type of food keeps your skin healthy and helps protect you from getting sick?
options: Go foods like rice and bread
Grow foods like fish and eggs
Glow foods like mango and kangkong
Fast foods like chips and soda
explanation: Glow foods are fruits and vegetables such as kangkong, mango, banana, and tomato that keep skin healthy and protect us from getting sick.
fact_tl: Ang Glow foods ay mga gulay at prutas na nagpapaganda ng balat at nagpapalakas sa atin laban sa sakit. Halimbawa nito ang kangkong, mangga, saging, at kamatis.
fact_bis: Ang Glow foods mao ang mga utanon ug prutas nga maghimong himsog sa atong panit ug manalipod kanato batok sa sakit. Mga pananglitan niini ang kangkong, mangga, saging, ug kamatis.

q: What does the sailfin lizard mostly eat?
options: Fish and small water animals
Leaves, fruits, and flowers, with insects eaten only sometimes
Insects and worms almost exclusively
Other small lizards and frogs
explanation: The sailfin lizard is primarily herbivorous, eating leaves, fruits, and flowers, though it occasionally eats insects.
fact_tl: Ang sailfin lizard ay pangunahing kumakain ng mga halaman, tulad ng mga dahon, bunga, at bulaklak, bagaman minsan din kumakain ng insekto.
fact_bis: Ang sailfin lizard panguna nga mokaon og mga tanom, sama sa mga dahon, prutas, ug bulak, bisan pa usahay mokaon usab og insekto.

q: What is special about the Philippine fanged frog compared to most frogs?
options: It can survive in both fresh and salt water without any problem
Males have small fangs used in fighting, and the species is found only in Philippine mountain streams
It is the largest frog in Asia and can jump over two meters high
It has no legs and moves by slithering like a snake through the water
explanation: Philippine fanged frogs are endemic to Philippine mountain streams and males have small fangs used in fighting.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine fanged frog (Limnonectes spp.) ay isang endemikong palaka na makikita sa mga batis ng kabundukan ng Pilipinas; ang lalaki ay may maliliit na pangil para sa pakikipaglaban.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine fanged frogs (Limnonectes spp.) mga endemikong palaka sa mga batis sa kabungtoran sa Pilipinas; ang lalaki adunay gagmayng pangil alang sa away.

q: Why is it colder at the top of a mountain than at the ground below?
options: The Sun's rays are weaker at high altitudes because the atmosphere blocks them more
The ground is warmed by the Sun first and then warms the air above it, so being farther from the ground means the air is colder
Strong winds at the top blow away all the warm air before it can stay
Mountains are always covered in ice, which keeps the air permanently cold
explanation: The Sun heats the ground first, and the warm ground then heats the air above it; being high up means being farther from that warm ground, so it is colder.
fact_tl: Ang araw ang nagpapainit sa lupa, at ang mainit na lupa ang nagpapainit sa hangin sa ibabaw nito. Kaya mas malayo ka sa mainit na lupa kapag nasa taas, kaya mas malamig.
fact_bis: Ang adlaw maoy mopainit sa yuta una, ug ang init nga yuta maoy mopainit sa hangin sa ibabaw niini. Busa kon taas ka, layo ka sa init nga yuta, mao nga mas bugnaw.

q: What does your brain do with the two slightly different pictures it receives from your two eyes?
options: It ignores one picture and only uses the sharper one
It combines both pictures into one image that has depth
It flips both pictures upside down and stores them separately
It uses each picture for a different task — one for color, one for shape
explanation: The brain combines the two slightly different pictures from the eyes into one image that has depth.
fact_tl: Pinagsasama ng utak ang dalawang magkaibang larawan mula sa mga mata para gumawa ng isang larawang may lalim.
fact_bis: Gihiusa sa utok ang duha ka magkalahi nga hulagway gikan sa mga mata aron mahimo ang usa ka hulagway nga adunay giladmon.

q: Who discovered the two moons of Mars, Phobos and Deimos?
options: Galileo Galilei
Giovanni Cassini
Asaph Hall
Edwin Hubble
explanation: Asaph Hall discovered the two moons of Mars, Phobos and Deimos.
fact_tl: Si Asaph Hall ang nakatuklas ng dalawang buwan ng Mars, ang Phobos at Deimos.
fact_bis: Si Asaph Hall ang nakadiskobre sa duha ka bulan sa Mars, ang Phobos ug Deimos.

q: About what fraction of all sea species live on coral reefs, even though reefs cover only a small part of the ocean?
options: About one tenth
About one quarter
About one half
Almost all of them
explanation: Even though reefs cover only a small part of the ocean, about a quarter of all sea species live on them.
fact_tl: Kahit maliit lamang ang sakop nito sa dagat, may tahanan sa coral reef ang halos ikaapat ng lahat ng uri ng buhay-dagat.
fact_bis: Bisan gamay ra ang gisakpan niini sa dagat, mga ikaupat sa tanang matang sa kinabuhi sa dagat nagpuyo sa bahura.

q: Why do rooms with stone or glass walls feel louder and more echoey?
options: Hard, smooth surfaces like stone and concrete reflect sound well
Soft surfaces in stone rooms trap extra sound and release it slowly
Stone and glass produce their own sounds that mix with other noises
Cool temperatures in stone rooms make sound travel faster and louder
explanation: Hard smooth surfaces like stone and concrete reflect sound well, making rooms with such walls louder and more echoey.
fact_tl: Ang matigas at makinis na mga ibabaw tulad ng bato at concrete ay nagpapabuti ng pagtalikod ng tunog — kaya naman mas maingay ang mga kwartong may bato o salamin na dingding.
fact_bis: Ang gahi ug makinis nga mga ibabaw sama sa bato ug konkreto nagpakita sa tunog nga maayo — mao nang mas ingayong ang mga kwarto nga adunay bato o salamin nga dingding.

q: What color does red cabbage juice turn when you add it to vinegar?
options: Blue or green, because vinegar is a base
Reddish, because vinegar is an acid
Yellow, because vinegar is a neutral liquid
Black, because vinegar reacts strongly with the cabbage
explanation: Red cabbage juice turns reddish in vinegar because vinegar is an acid.
fact_tl: Subukan mong lagyan ng red cabbage juice ang suka, magiging mapula-pula ito dahil asido ang suka. Lagyan naman ng baking soda na nakatunaw sa tubig at magiging asul o berde dahil base ito.
fact_bis: Sulayi pagbutang og red cabbage juice sa suka ug mahimong pula-pula kini kay asido ang suka. Butangi sab og baking soda nga gitunaw sa tubig ug mahimong asul o berde kay base man kini.

q: Why do winged termites usually swarm right after rain?
options: Rain washes away their old nest, forcing them to fly out immediately
The damp, humid air and soft wet ground make it the safest time to start a new colony
They need to drink rainwater before they can fly long distances
Lightning during storms frightens them out of their tunnels
explanation: Winged termites swarm right after rain because the damp humid air and soft wet ground make it safer to start a new colony.
fact_tl: Karaniwang lumalabas ang mga may-pakpak na anay (gamu-gamo) tuwing katatapos lang umulan, kapag basa at mahalumigmig ang hangin. Mas madaling humukay sa malambot na lupa at hindi sila madaling matuyo, kaya 'yun ang pinakaligtas na panahon para magsimula ng bagong kolonya.
fact_bis: Kasagaran mogawas ang mga anay nga adunay pako human gyud sa ulan, kung basa ug humid ang hangin. Sayon kalotan ang humok nga yuta ug dili sila dali mauga, mao nga kana ang labing luwas nga panahon sa pagsugod og bag-ong kolonya.

q: Who discovered Pluto in 1930, and who suggested its name?
options: Edwin Hubble discovered it, and a NASA committee chose its name
Clyde Tombaugh discovered it, and an 11-year-old English girl named Venetia Burney suggested the name
Percival Lowell discovered it, and his wife chose the name after a pet dog
Asaph Hall discovered it, and Clyde Tombaugh suggested the name
explanation: Pluto was discovered on 18 February 1930 by Clyde Tombaugh, and 11-year-old Venetia Burney suggested its name after the Roman god of the underworld.
fact_tl: Ang Pluto ay natuklasan noong Pebrero 18, 1930 ng 24-taong-gulang na astronomero na si Clyde Tombaugh sa Lowell Observatory sa Arizona; ito ay pinangalanan sa mungkahi ng isang 11-taong-gulang na Ingles na batang babae na si Venetia Burney na nagmungkahi ng pangalang Roman god of the underworld.
fact_bis: Ang Pluto nadiskubre niadtong Pebrero 18, 1930 sa 24-anyos nga astronomer nga si Clyde Tombaugh sa Lowell Observatory sa Arizona; gipahinganlan kini sa mungkahi sa 11-anyos nga Ingles nga bata nga si Venetia Burney, nga nagmungkahi sa ngalan sa Roman god sa underworld.

q: What happens to a rubber band if it is stretched too far?
options: It becomes stronger and can stretch even more the next time
It can no longer spring back and may snap
It slowly shrinks back to a size smaller than before it was stretched
It hardens and becomes stiff like plastic
explanation: If rubber is stretched too far, it can no longer spring back and may snap.
fact_tl: Kung sobra-sobra ang paghila sa goma, hindi na ito makakabalik at maaaring malagot.
fact_bis: Kon birahon og sobra ang goma, dili na kini makabalik ug mahimong mabugto.

q: Why does a gecko leave no sticky mark on a wall after it climbs off?
options: Geckos coat their feet in a special oil that evaporates instantly when they leave
Their grip comes from tiny hairs, not a liquid adhesive, so there is no glue or sticky residue left behind
Geckos wipe their feet clean with their tail each time they take a step
The wall's surface absorbs the gecko's natural glue before it can stick
explanation: A gecko's grip comes from tiny hairs on its feet, not any liquid adhesive, so it leaves behind no glue or sticky mark when it leaves the wall.
fact_tl: Kapag umaalis ang gecko sa pader, wala itong iniiwang anumang pandikit o mantsa. Iba ito sa tape o kola na nag-iiwan ng malagkit na bakas, dahil ang dikit ng gecko ay galing sa buhok at hindi sa anumang likidong pandikit.
fact_bis: Kon mobiya ang gecko sa bungbong, wala kini mabilin nga pandikit o mantsa. Lahi kini sa tape o kola nga magbilin og pilit nga timaan, kay ang pagdikit sa gecko gikan sa balahibo ug dili sa bisan unsang likido nga pandikit.

q: What causes a mirage that makes a hot road look like it has water in the distance?
options: Water vapor from the hot road rises and acts like a real mirror above the surface
Light bends as it passes through hot and cool layers of air above the road, creating a false image
The heat makes the road surface itself reflect like glass because it melts slightly
Strong sunlight bounces off dust particles and scatters in a way that looks like water
explanation: A mirage on a hot road happens because light bends as it passes through hot and cool layers of air, creating a false water-like image.
fact_tl: Kung minsan sa sobrang init ng kalsada, mukhang may tubig o salamin sa malayong bahagi nito kahit tuyo naman. Tinatawag itong mirage, at nangyayari dahil yumuyuko ang liwanag habang dumadaan sa mainit at malamig na layer ng hangin sa ibabaw ng daan.
fact_bis: Usahay sa hilabihang init sa dalan, morag adunay tubig o salamin sa layo nga bahin niini bisan og uga. Gitawag kini og mirage, ug mahitabo tungod kay mubawog ang kahayag samtang muagi sa init ug bugnaw nga layer sa hangin ibabaw sa dalan.

q: What number is talc on the Mohs hardness scale?
explanation: Talc is number 1 on the Mohs hardness scale, making it the softest mineral.
fact_tl: Ang talc ay numero 1 sa Mohs hardness scale.
fact_bis: Ang talc mao ang numero 1 sa Mohs hardness scale.

q: What is the temperature like inside a cave throughout the year?
options: It is very hot because heat from underground rock warms the air
It stays cool and barely changes all year long
It changes dramatically with the seasons just like the weather outside
It is freezing cold in all caves because sunlight never reaches them
explanation: Inside a cave it stays dark and cool, with a temperature that barely changes all year.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng kuweba ay madilim at malamig, at halos hindi nagbabago ang temperatura buong taon.
fact_bis: Sulod sa langob ngitngit ug bugnaw, ug halos dili mabag-o ang temperatura sa tibuok tuig.

q: How does water temperature affect how much salt or sugar can be dissolved in it?
options: Cold water dissolves more because the particles are packed closer together
Both cold and hot water dissolve the same amount of any solid
Hot water can dissolve much more salt or sugar than cold water can
Only salt dissolves better in hot water; sugar dissolves better in cold water
explanation: Hot water can dissolve much more salt or sugar than cold water can.
fact_tl: Mas maraming asin o asukal ang kayang tunawin ng mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig na tubig.
fact_bis: Ang init nga tubig makahimo og tunaw og mas daghang asin o asukal kaysa sa bugnaw nga tubig.

q: What is peristalsis?
options: The process of teeth grinding food into smaller pieces in the mouth
The wave-like squeezing of muscles in the esophagus and intestines that pushes food forward
The chemical breakdown of food by stomach acid into nutrients
The absorption of water by the large intestine at the end of digestion
explanation: Peristalsis is the wave-like squeezing of muscles in the esophagus and intestines that pushes food forward.
fact_tl: Ang peristalsis ay ang pagkurot-kurot ng mga kalamnan ng esophagus at bituka na nagdadala ng pagkain patungo sa tamang direksyon.
fact_bis: Ang peristalsis mao ang alon-alon nga pagkupos sa mga kaunuran sa esophagus ug bituka nga nagtulod sa pagkaon sa usa ka direksyon.

q: How do most fruit bats find food, unlike insect-eating bats?
options: They use echolocation just like insect-eating bats do
They rely on their large eyes and strong sense of smell, not echolocation
They follow the sound of other fruit bats eating to find food
They search only during the day when light helps them spot ripe fruit
explanation: Most fruit bats rely on their large eyes and strong sense of smell, not echolocation, to find fruit.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng fruit bat ay umaasa sa malalaki nilang mata at matalas na pang-amoy, hindi sa echolocation, para makahanap ng prutas.
fact_bis: Kasagaran sa fruit bat nagsalig sa ilang dagkong mata ug humot nga panimho, dili sa echolocation, aron makakita ug prutas.

q: Which food group gives our bodies energy?
options: Grow foods
Glow foods
Go foods
Guard foods
explanation: Go foods give energy, Grow foods build the body, and Glow foods protect against sickness.
fact_tl: Ang mga pagkain ay nahahati sa tatlong grupo: Go foods na nagbibigay enerhiya, Grow foods na bumubuo ng katawan, at Glow foods na nagpoprotekta laban sa sakit.
fact_bis: Ang mga pagkaon gibahin sa tulo: Go foods nga naghatag ug kusog, Grow foods nga nagtukod sa lawas, ug Glow foods nga manalipod batok sa sakit.

q: For how many days is a duck egg usually incubated before it becomes balut?
options: About 5 to 7 days
About 10 to 12 days
About 16 to 18 days
About 25 to 28 days
explanation: A duck egg is usually incubated for about 16 to 18 days to become balut.
fact_tl: Karaniwang pinaiinit ang itlog para gawing balut sa loob ng halos 16 hanggang 18 na araw.
fact_bis: Ang itlog kasagarang gipainit sulod sa mga 16 ngadto sa 18 ka adlaw aron mahimong balut.

q: Why does the bark of a tree crack and form deep grooves as the tree gets older?
options: The outer bark is dead and cannot stretch, so it cracks as the tree grows wider underneath
The bark dries out from too much sunlight and splits apart
Insects chew through the outer bark, causing the cracks and grooves
The inner bark pushes outward because it is absorbing too much water
explanation: The outer bark is dead tissue that cannot stretch, so as the tree keeps growing wider underneath, the bark is pushed apart and cracks into deep grooves.
fact_tl: Patay na at hindi na lumalaki ang panlabas na balat, pero patuloy na lumalapad ang puno sa loob. Kaya nabibiyak at nagkakaroon ng mga uka-uka ang balat habang umaabot ito sa hangganan.
fact_bis: Patay na ang gawas nga panit ug dili na motubo, apan padayon nga molapad ang kahoy sa sulod. Busa mabuak ug maghimog lawom nga mga gilason ang panit samtang gibira kini palayo.

q: Which factor has the BIGGEST effect on the kinetic energy of a moving object?
options: The speed of the object
The mass of the object
The color of the object
The temperature of the object
explanation: Although both mass and speed increase kinetic energy, speed has the biggest effect of all on kinetic energy.
fact_tl: Mas malaki ang kinetikong enerhiya ng isang bagay kapag mas mabigat ito o mas mabilis kumilos; ang bilis ang may pinakamalaking epekto dito.
fact_bis: Mas dako ang kinetiko nga enerhiya sa usa ka butang kon mas bug-at kini o mas paspas molihok, ug ang katulin ang labing dako og epekto.

q: Where in the Philippines are the major deposits of nickel found?
options: Palawan and Surigao del Norte
Cebu and Batangas
Benguet and Davao del Sur
Leyte and Zambales
explanation: The Philippines is one of the world's leading nickel producers, with major deposits found in Palawan and Surigao del Norte.
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang tagagawa ng nikel sa mundo; ang mga pangunahing deposito ay matatagpuan sa Palawan at Surigao del Norte.
fact_bis: Ang Pilipinas usa sa nanguna nga nagprodyus sa nikel sa kalibutan; dagkong deposito makita sa Palawan ug Surigao del Norte.

q: How do sea snakes stay underwater longer compared to land snakes?
options: They can absorb some oxygen through their skin
They have two sets of lungs that store more air
They slow their heartbeat to zero when diving
They pump water through gills on their sides
explanation: A sea snake can absorb some oxygen through its skin, which helps it stay underwater longer than a land snake could.
fact_tl: Ang ahas-dagat ay makakasipsip ng kaunting oksiheno sa pamamagitan ng balat nito, kaya tumatagal sila sa ilalim ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang halas sa dagat makasuyop og gamayng oksiheno pinaagi sa panit niini, maong dugay kini makapuyo ilalom sa tubig.

q: Which of the following is an example of a physical change?
options: Dissolving sugar in water
Burning wood in a campfire
Rusting of an iron nail
Cooking an egg in a pan
explanation: Dissolving sugar is a physical change because it alters the sugar's state but does not make a new substance — the sugar can still be recovered.
fact_tl: Ang pisikal na pagbabago ay nagbabago ng hugis, sukat, o estado ng isang sangkap ngunit hindi gumagawa ng bagong sangkap. Ang pagputol ng papel, pagtunaw ng asukal, at pag-yelo ng tubig ay mga pisikal na pagbabago.
fact_bis: Ang pisikal nga pagbabago nagbago sa hugis, gidak-on, o estado sa usa ka substansya apan dili nagbuhat og bag-ong substansya. Ang pagputol sa papel, pagtunaw sa asukal, ug pag-yelo sa tubig mga pisikal nga pagbabago.

q: What is the normal resting heart rate for an adult?
options: 60 to 100 beats per minute
30 to 50 beats per minute
110 to 140 beats per minute
150 to 200 beats per minute
explanation: A normal resting heart rate for an adult is about 60 to 100 beats per minute.
fact_tl: Ang normal na tibok ng puso ng may-edad sa pamamahinga ay mga 60 hanggang 100 beses kada minuto.
fact_bis: Ang normal nga pitik sa kasingkasing sa hamtong sa pagpahulay kay mga 60 ngadto sa 100 ka pitik kada minuto.

q: What is Portland cement made from?
options: Burned mixed rock that is ground into a very fine powder
Sand and seawater mixed and dried at high heat
Crushed seashells melted together with iron filings
Clay and wood ash baked in a kiln
explanation: Portland cement, the most common type of cement, is made by grinding burned mixed rock into a very fine powder.
fact_tl: Ang pinakakaraniwang uri ng semento ay tinatawag na Portland cement, na gawa sa pinaghalong sinunog na bato na giniling na pinong-pino.
fact_bis: Ang labing komon nga matang sa semento gitawag nga Portland cement, hinimo pinaagi sa paggaling sa sinunog nga sagol nga bato ngadto sa pino kaayo nga pulbos.

q: Why does water often look shallower than it really is?
options: Refraction bends the light coming from the bottom, making the bottom appear closer
Reflection of the sky makes the surface look like a solid floor
The water absorbs some light, hiding the true depth from your eyes
Ripples on the surface scatter the light and fool your vision
explanation: Refraction bends light coming from the bottom of the water upward, so the bottom appears closer to the surface than it actually is.
fact_tl: Mukhang mas mababaw ang tubig kaysa sa tunay nitong lalim dahil binabaluktot ng refraction ang liwanag na galing sa ilalim, kaya mag-ingat sa paglublob sa hindi pamilyar na tubig.
fact_bis: Sagad morag mas mabaw ang tubig kaysa sa tinuod niini nga giladmon tungod kay gibawog sa refraction ang kahayag nga gikan sa ilawom, mao nga pag-amping sa paglusong sa dili pamilyar nga tubig.

q: How long can a giant clam live?
options: More than 100 years
About 10 to 20 years
Around 50 years at most
Only 5 to 8 years
explanation: Giant clams can live a very long time, reaching more than 100 years old.
fact_tl: Ang taklobo ay maaaring mabuhay nang napakatagal, na umaabot sa mahigit 100 taon.
fact_bis: Ang taklobo makabuhi ug dugay kaayo, nga moabot ug kapin sa 100 ka tuig.

q: Approximately how far does light travel in one hour?
options: About 1.08 billion kilometers
About 300,000 kilometers
About 150 million kilometers
About 9.5 trillion kilometers
explanation: In one hour, light travels about 1.08 billion kilometers, making it the fastest thing in the universe.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng isang oras, ang liwanag ay nakakalakbay ng mga 1.08 bilyong kilometro.
fact_bis: Sulod sa usa ka oras, ang kahayag mobiyahe og mga 1.08 ka bilyon ka kilometro.

q: What happens to the eyewall of a typhoon when it moves over land or cool water?
options: It weakens and slowly falls apart because it loses its fuel of heat and moisture
It strengthens as the storm picks up dust and soil particles from the land
It stays just as strong because the eyewall is protected inside the storm
It splits into two smaller eyewalls that cause more damage separately
explanation: The eyewall relies on warm ocean water for heat and moisture as fuel; moving over land or cool water cuts off that fuel, so the eyewall weakens and falls apart.
fact_tl: Ang eyewall ay nabubuhay sa init at singaw ng mainit na dagat, na parang gasolina nito. Kapag tumama ang bagyo sa lupa o sa malamig na tubig, nawawalan ito ng gasolina, kaya humihina at unti-unting nawawasak ang eyewall.
fact_bis: Ang eyewall mabuhi sa init ug alisngaw sa init nga dagat, nga sama sa gasolina niini. Kung mohasmag ang bagyo sa yuta o sa bugnaw nga tubig, mawad-an kini sa gasolina, mao nga mohuyang ug hinay-hinay nga maguba ang eyewall.

q: What does the ground wire in an appliance do to keep people safe?
options: It carries stray current safely into the ground instead of through a person
It increases the voltage so the appliance runs more efficiently
It stores extra electricity inside the appliance for later use
It stops current from flowing into the appliance when not in use
explanation: The ground wire connects metal parts of an appliance to the earth, so any stray current flows safely into the ground instead of through a person.
fact_tl: Ang grounding ay nag-uugnay ng metal na bahagi ng isang aparato sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng ground wire, kaya ang ligaw na current ay dumadaloy nang ligtas papunta sa lupa sa halip na sa tao.
fact_bis: Ang grounding nagdugtong sa metal nga bahin sa usa ka galamiton ngadto sa yuta pinaagi sa ground wire, mao nga ang nahisalaag nga current moagas nga luwas ngadto sa yuta imbes sa tawo.

q: On what date did the powerful Luzon earthquake occur?
options: August 3, 1990
November 12, 1990
March 25, 1990
explanation: The powerful Luzon earthquake happened on July 16, 1990.
fact_tl: Naganap ang malakas na lindol sa Luzon noong Hulyo 16, 1990.
fact_bis: Ang kusog nga linog sa Luzon nahitabo niadtong Hulyo 16, 1990.

q: How does a chameleon catch an insect?
options: It shoots its tongue out incredibly fast to catch the insect in the blink of an eye
It waits motionless and then leaps onto the insect with its front claws
It uses its sticky skin to trap insects that walk too close
It blows a puff of air to knock the insect down, then walks over to eat it
explanation: A chameleon shoots its tongue out incredibly fast — in the blink of an eye, the insect is caught.
fact_tl: Napakabilis ipalabas ng chameleon ang dila nito—isang kisap-mata lang at nahuli na ang insekto.
fact_bis: Paspas kaayo ipagawas sa chameleon ang dila niini—usa ka pamilok lang ug nadakpan na ang insekto.

q: What shows that crows are very intelligent animals?
options: They can use objects as tools to get food
They can fly faster than any other bird species
They are the only birds that can recognize their own reflection
They build the most complex nests of any bird in the world
explanation: Crows are very intelligent and can use objects as tools to get food, which is a sign of high intelligence in animals.
fact_tl: Ang mga uwak ay napakatalino at may kakayahang gumamit ng mga bagay para makakuha ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Ang mga uwak maalamon kaayo ug makahimo sa paggamit og mga butang isip galamiton aron makakuha og pagkaon.

q: How old is the water you drink today?
options: It is the same water that has been cycling on Earth since the time of the dinosaurs
It is newly made each year from underground chemical reactions
It forms fresh each rainy season from air and hydrogen gas
It is only about 100 years old, cleaned and reused since modern times
explanation: The water we drink today is the same water that has been cycling on Earth since the time of the dinosaurs, continuously reused through the water cycle.
fact_tl: Ang tubig na umiinom natin ngayon ay parehong tubig na umiikot na sa Daigdig mula pa noong panahon ng mga dinosaur.
fact_bis: Ang tubig nga atong giinom karon mao gihapong tubig nga nagtuyok sa Yuta sukad pa sa panahon sa mga dinosaur.

q: How can the jet stream affect a typhoon?
options: It can steer the typhoon, accelerate its movement, or change its track
It generates the typhoon by spinning warm air rapidly at low altitudes
It weakens typhoons by pushing cold polar air into the storm's center
It creates the eye of the typhoon by pulling air upward from the ocean
explanation: The jet stream is a fast high-altitude wind that can steer typhoons and change their tracks when it is strong.
fact_tl: Ang jet stream ay mabilis na hangin sa mataas na troposfera na maaaring mag-steer ng mga bagyo; kapag malakas ang jet stream, maaaring mapabilis nito ang paggalaw ng bagyo o baguhin ang landas nito.
fact_bis: Ang jet stream usa ka paspas nga hangin sa taas nga troposfera nga mahimong mag-steer sa mga bagyo; kung kusog, mahimong pabilisonan niini ang paglihok sa bagyo o baguhin ang iyang track.

q: Who is the unit of capacitance called the farad named after?
options: Michael Faraday, the British scientist who studied electricity and magnetism
Benjamin Franklin, who flew a kite in a thunderstorm to study lightning
Alessandro Volta, who invented the first electric battery
Andre-Marie Ampere, who studied the force between electric currents
explanation: The farad is named after Michael Faraday, the British scientist famous for his work on electricity and magnetism.
fact_tl: Ang yunit na farad ay ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday, ang Britanong siyentistang nag-aral ng kuryente at magnetismo.
fact_bis: Ang yunit nga farad ginganlan kang Michael Faraday, ang Britaniko nga siyentista nga nagtuon sa koryente ug magnetismo.

q: What do fossil whale bones found in Philippine sedimentary rocks tell scientists?
options: Parts of the Philippines were once under the sea
The Philippines was once connected to Antarctica by land
Ancient whales once lived in freshwater lakes across the islands
Whales evolved from land animals that lived on the Philippine islands
explanation: Fossils of ancient whales in Philippine sedimentary rocks confirm that parts of the archipelago were once covered by the sea.
fact_tl: Ang mga fosil ng sinaunang balyena at iba pang mga hayop ng karagatan ay natuklasan sa mga sedimentary rock ng Pilipinas, na nagpapatunay na ang mga bahagi ng kapuluan ay dating nasa ilalim ng dagat; ito ay nagbibigay ng mahalagang impormasyon tungkol sa kasaysayan ng karagatan ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang mga fossil sa karaan nga mga balyena ug ubang mga hayop sa karagatan nakit-an sa mga sedimentary rock sa Pilipinas, nagpakita nga ang mga bahin sa kapuluan kaniadto naa sa ilawom sa dagat; kini naghatag og importante nga impormasyon bahin sa kasaysayan sa mga dagat sa Pilipinas.

q: In the chemical formula H2O, what does the letter H stand for?
options: Hydrogen
Helium
Heat
Hydroxide
explanation: In H2O, the H stands for hydrogen and the O stands for oxygen — the two elements that make up water.
fact_tl: Sa H2O, ang H ay para sa hydrogen at ang O ay para sa oxygen.
fact_bis: Sa H2O, ang H para sa hydrogen ug ang O para sa oxygen.

q: Which of the following is NOT a place where carbon is stored on Earth?
options: Inside the moon's rocky core
In the ocean
In living things like plants and animals
In fossil fuels like coal and oil
explanation: Carbon is stored in the air, ocean, soil, living things, and rocks or fossil fuels — these are called carbon reservoirs; the moon's core is not one of them.
fact_tl: Naka-imbak ang carbon sa maraming lugar: sa hangin (bilang carbon dioxide), sa karagatan, sa lupa, sa mga buhay na bagay, at sa mga bato at fossil fuels gaya ng uling at langis. Ang mga ito ay tinatawag na carbon reservoirs o imbakan.
fact_bis: Ang carbon natipig sa daghang dapit: sa hangin (isip carbon dioxide), sa dagat, sa yuta, sa mga buhing butang, ug sa mga bato ug fossil fuels sama sa uling ug lana. Gitawag kini nga carbon reservoirs o imbakan.

q: What is the main advantage of using an LED bulb instead of an old incandescent bulb?
options: An LED bulb gives the same brightness but uses much less electricity
An LED bulb is brighter but also uses much more electricity
An LED bulb only works in very cold temperatures unlike incandescent bulbs
An LED bulb lasts exactly the same time but costs slightly less to buy
explanation: An LED bulb gives the same brightness as an incandescent bulb but uses much less electricity, saving energy.
fact_tl: Ang LED na bombilya ay nagbibigay ng parehong liwanag pero gumagamit ng mas kaunting kuryente kaysa lumang bombilya.
fact_bis: Ang LED nga bombilya magahatag og samang kahayag apan mogamit og mas gamay nga koryente kaysa daang bombilya.

q: Why does a balloon rubbed on wool stick to a wall?
options: The static charge on the balloon is attracted to the opposite charge it induces in the wall
The rubber in the balloon becomes magnetic after rubbing and clings to metal in the wall
The friction heats the balloon surface and it melts slightly, sticking like glue
The wool fibers transfer moisture to the balloon, making its surface sticky
explanation: When a balloon is rubbed on wool, it gains a static charge that is attracted to the opposite charge induced in the wall, holding the balloon in place.
fact_tl: Kapag kinuskos ang lobo sa tela at inilagay sa dingding, ito ay nakakabit nang ilang sandali — ang static na karga sa lobo ay naaakit sa kabaligtarang karga sa dingding, na nagpapanatili ng lobo sa lugar.
fact_bis: Inig kuskos sa lobo sa tela ug ibutang sa dingding, kini nakakabit ug pipila ka sandali — ang static nga karga sa lobo makuha sa kaatbang nga karga nga na-induce sa dingding, nagpabilin sa lobo sa lugar.

q: How does using solar and wind power help the environment?
options: It releases fewer greenhouse gases than burning fossil fuels
It removes existing greenhouse gases directly from the atmosphere
It produces extra oxygen that neutralizes carbon dioxide in the air
It cools the surrounding air immediately around solar panels and wind turbines
explanation: Using clean energy like solar and wind power releases fewer greenhouse gases, reducing the impact on Earth's climate.
fact_tl: Ang paggamit ng malinis na enerhiya tulad ng solar at hangin ay nakakabawas ng greenhouse gas na nailalabas.
fact_bis: Ang paggamit og limpyo nga enerhiya sama sa solar ug hangin makunhod ang greenhouse gas nga gibuga.

q: Why do amethysts vary in shade from pale lavender to deep blackish-purple?
options: The shade depends on how much iron and radiation the crystal received
The shade is determined by how quickly the crystal cooled after forming
Darker amethysts grew deeper underground where there is more pressure
The color changes over time as the crystal reacts with water in the soil
explanation: The shade of an amethyst depends on how much iron and radiation it received — more exposure produces deeper, darker purple.
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng amethyst ay pare-pareho ng kulay. May maputlang lila na halos kulay-lavender, at may napakadilim na halos kulay-ubeng-itim. Nakadepende ito sa dami ng iron at radiation na natanggap nito.
fact_bis: Dili tanan amethyst parehas og kolor. Adunay luspad nga purple nga halos lavender, ug adunay lawom kaayo nga halos itom-purple. Nagdepende kini sa kadaghan sa puthaw ug radiation nga nadawat niini.

q: Which scientist predicted the return of the famous comet now named after him?
options: Edmond Halley
Isaac Newton
Galileo Galilei
Johannes Kepler
explanation: Edmond Halley predicted that a comet would return, and it is now called Halley's Comet in his honor.
fact_tl: Si Edmond Halley ang nanghula na babalik ang isang kometa, at ito ngayon ay tinatawag na Halley's Comet bilang parangal sa kanya.
fact_bis: Si Edmond Halley mao ang nanagna nga mobalik ang usa ka kometa, ug kini karon gitawag og Halley's Comet agig pagpasidungog kaniya.

q: What is true about momentum and kinetic energy?
options: They both depend on mass and speed but are different quantities calculated in different ways
They are exactly the same thing and always have the same value for any object
Momentum depends on speed alone while kinetic energy depends only on mass
They are opposites — when one increases, the other always decreases
explanation: Momentum and kinetic energy both depend on mass and speed, but they are different quantities calculated in different ways.
fact_tl: Ang momentum at kinetic energy ay parehong nakadepende sa masa at bilis, ngunit magkaibang dami sila at iba ang paraan ng pagkalkula.
fact_bis: Ang momentum ug kinetic energy parehong nagsalig sa masa ug tulin, apan lahi sila nga gidaghanon ug lahi ang paagi sa pagkwenta.

q: Why must only specially licensed chefs prepare pufferfish (fugu) in Japan?
options: Pufferfish is dangerously toxic and must be prepared with special training to be safe to eat
Pufferfish is a protected species and harvesting it requires a government license
The fish is extremely rare and valuable, so only certified experts are trusted to handle it
Japanese law requires any seafood costing over a certain price to be handled by a licensed chef
explanation: In Japan, only specially trained, licensed chefs are allowed to prepare fugu (pufferfish) because the fish is dangerously toxic and incorrect preparation can be deadly.
fact_tl: Sa Japan, ang butete ay tinatawag na fugu, at tanging mga espesyal na sanay at may lisensyang kusinero lang ang pwedeng maghanda nito.
fact_bis: Sa Japan, ang butete gitawag og fugu, ug ang mga espesyal nga gibansay ug lisensyado nga kusinero lang ang gitugotan sa pag-andam niini.

q: Why do elements in the same group of the periodic table behave in similar ways?
options: They have the same number of outer electrons, which controls how they react
They have the same total number of electrons in all their shells combined
They were all discovered in the same country and have similar atomic weights
They have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons
explanation: Elements in the same group behave alike because they have the same number of outer electrons, and it is those outer electrons that control how an element reacts.
fact_tl: Ang mga elemento sa iisang group ay magkakatulad ang katangian dahil pare-pareho ang bilang ng kanilang panlabas na elektron, na nagtatakda kung paano sila mag-react.
fact_bis: Ang mga elemento sa samang group managsama og kinaiya kay parehas ang gidaghanon sa ilang gawas nga electron, nga maoy nagtino kon unsaon nila pag-react.

q: What traditional Philippine cloths are woven from abaca fiber?
options: Sinamay and t'nalak
Barong and piña
Jusi and cotton gauze
Hablon and raw silk
explanation: Abaca fiber is woven into traditional Philippine cloth such as sinamay and t'nalak.
fact_tl: Ang hibla ng abaka ay hinahabi sa tradisyonal na tela ng Pilipinas tulad ng sinamay at t'nalak.
fact_bis: Ang lanot sa abaka ginahabi nga tradisyonal nga panapton sa Pilipinas sama sa sinamay ug t'nalak.

q: What is true about the substances listed in the periodic table?
options: They are pure elements that cannot be broken down further and are the building blocks of all compounds
They are all compounds made of two or more simpler substances combined together
They are only the metals and gases found naturally on Earth's surface
They are the mixtures of elements that make up the most common minerals
explanation: Every element in the periodic table cannot be broken down further and serves as a building block from which all compounds in the world are made.
fact_tl: Lahat ng elementong hindi mahahati pa ay nakalista sa periodic table. Sila ang mga building block na pinagmumulan ng lahat ng compound sa mundo.
fact_bis: Tanan nga elemento nga dili na mabahin pa nalista sa periodic table. Sila ang mga tukod-bahin diin gihimo ang tanan nga kompound sa kalibutan.

q: Which of the following materials is an insulator of electricity?
options: Rubber
Copper
Iron
Saltwater
explanation: An insulator is a material that does not let electricity flow through it, and rubber is a common example of an insulator.
fact_tl: Ang insulator ay materyal na hindi nagpapadaloy ng kuryente, tulad ng goma (rubber) at plastik.
fact_bis: Ang insulator kay materyal nga dili magpaagi sa kuryente, sama sa goma (rubber) ug plastik.

q: Why does a pet snail retract into its shell when you grab it suddenly?
options: It feels scared, so it hides as a natural defense
It is preparing to sleep and needs to be in a dark enclosed space
It is hungry and retreats until food is placed nearby
It is shedding its outer skin and must stay hidden until finished
explanation: A snail retracts into its shell when grabbed suddenly because it feels scared — handling it gently helps it stay relaxed.
fact_tl: Kung may alagang kuhol, makikita mong umuurong ito kapag bigla mong hinawakan—senyales na natatakot ito. Para hindi ito laging magtago, dahan-dahan mo itong hawakan at basa-basain ang kamay mo.
fact_bis: Kon naa kay alagang kuhol, makita nimo nga muurong kini kon kalit nimong kuptan—timailhan nga nahadlok kini. Aron dili kini kanunay magtago, hinay-hinaya pagkupot ug basaa gamay ang imong kamot.

q: What is it called when you jump and blink automatically at a sudden loud sound?
options: The startle reflex
The balance reflex
The withdrawal reflex
The blinking reflex
explanation: When there is a sudden loud sound and you jump and blink automatically, this automatic reaction is called the startle reflex.
fact_tl: Kapag may biglang malakas na tunog, awtomatikong napapakibot at napapakurap ka—ito ang startle reflex.
fact_bis: Kon adunay kalit nga kusog nga tingog, awtomatik kang makulba ug mopisok—mao kini ang startle reflex.

q: Which pests can be reduced by spraying plants with mild soapy water?
options: Soft pests like aphids and mealybugs
Hard-shelled pests like beetles
Underground pests like grubs and root worms
Flying pests like moths and large butterflies
explanation: Soft pests like aphids and mealybugs can be reduced by spraying them with mild soapy water, making it an easy and safe pest control method.
fact_tl: Maaaring bawasan ang malalambot na aphid at mealybug sa pamamagitan ng pagwiwisik ng banayad na tubig na may sabon.
fact_bis: Ang humok nga aphid ug mealybug mapamenos pinaagi sa pagwisik ug hinay nga tubig nga may sabon.

q: In which book did Isaac Newton publish his three laws of motion?
options: Principia (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica)
Opticks
De Revolutionibus
Mathematical Elements of Natural Philosophy
explanation: Isaac Newton published his three laws of motion in the book known as Principia (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica) in 1687.
fact_tl: Inilathala ni Isaac Newton ang kanyang tatlong batas ng galaw sa aklat na "Principia" (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica) noong 1687.
fact_bis: Gipatik ni Isaac Newton ang iyang tulo ka balaod sa paglihok sa libro nga "Principia" (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica) niadtong 1687.

q: What is one big difference between the pupa of a butterfly and the pupa of a mosquito?
options: A butterfly's pupa hangs still and does not move, but a mosquito's pupa lives in water and can still swim
A butterfly's pupa lives in water while a mosquito's pupa hangs from a leaf and stays still
Both pupae are identical in behavior — neither one moves until it becomes an adult
A mosquito's pupa is protected by a hard shell, while a butterfly's pupa has only a thin skin
explanation: A butterfly's pupa (chrysalis) hangs still and does not move, but a mosquito's pupa lives in water and can still swim — a key difference between them.
fact_tl: Ang pupa ng paru-paro (chrysalis) ay nakabitin at hindi gumagalaw. Pero ang pupa ng lamok ay nasa tubig at nakakalangoy pa—ito ang isang malaking pagkakaiba nila.
fact_bis: Ang pupa sa alibangbang (chrysalis) nagbitay ug dili molihok. Apan ang pupa sa lamok anaa sa tubig ug makalangoy pa—kini usa ka dako nilang kalainan.

q: Where in the blood are antibodies carried?
options: In the plasma, the liquid part of blood
In the red blood cells that carry oxygen
In the platelets that help blood clot
In the white blood cells themselves as solid particles
explanation: The antibodies that fight the wrong blood type are carried in the plasma, the liquid part of blood.
fact_tl: Ang mga antibody na lumalaban sa maling dugo ay nasa plasma, ang likidong bahagi ng dugo.
fact_bis: Ang mga antibody nga makig-away sa sayop nga dugo anaa sa plasma, ang likido nga bahin sa dugo.

q: What do roots do for a plant?
options: They absorb water and nutrients from the soil so the plant can live
They capture sunlight and turn it into food for the plant
They release oxygen into the air during the night
They transport seeds to new locations so the plant can spread
explanation: Roots absorb water and nutrients from the soil so the plant can live and grow.
fact_tl: Ang ugat ay sumisipsip ng tubig at sustansya mula sa lupa para mabuhay ang halaman.
fact_bis: Ang gamot nagasuyop ug tubig ug sustansya gikan sa yuta aron mabuhi ang tanom.

q: What is special about the walking catfish?
options: It can breathe air and sometimes crosses wet land to move to a new pool of water
It walks along the ocean floor using four muscular leg-like fins
It can survive out of water for up to one month by storing water in a special organ
It breathes through its skin and buries itself in mud to wait out the dry season
explanation: The walking catfish can breathe air and sometimes crosses wet land to move from one pool of water to another, which is very unusual for a fish.
fact_tl: Ang walking catfish o hito ay nakakahinga ng hangin at minsang tumatawid sa basang lupa para lumipat sa bagong tubig.
fact_bis: Ang walking catfish o hito makaginhawa ug hangin ug usahay motabok sa basa nga yuta aron mobalhin sa bag-ong tubig.

q: Why are many cave animals pale or almost colorless?
options: They do not need pigment to hide in the dark, so color is not useful to them
They bleach over time because cave water contains chemicals that remove color
They are born with normal color but turn pale because of cold cave temperatures
Their bodies use all available energy for food-finding, leaving none for making pigment
explanation: Many cave animals are pale or almost colorless because living in darkness means they do not need pigment for camouflage or any other purpose.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa kuweba ay maputla o halos walang kulay dahil hindi nila kailangan ng pangkulay para magtago sa dilim.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sa langob ang luspad o halos walay kolor kay dili sila magkinahanglan og pigment aron magtago sa ngitngit.

q: Who invented the World Wide Web?
options: Tim Berners-Lee
Bill Gates
Steve Jobs
Alan Turing
explanation: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web (WWW), making it possible for people around the world to share information through the internet.
fact_tl: Si Tim Berners-Lee ang umimbento ng World Wide Web (WWW).
fact_bis: Si Tim Berners-Lee ang nag-imbento sa World Wide Web (WWW).

q: How do salmon find the river where they were born after spending years in the ocean?
options: They use their sense of smell to locate their birth river
They follow the path of the sun and stars to navigate back to shore
They follow electric signals in Earth's magnetic field all the way upstream
They return to the same river by following the other salmon in their group
explanation: Salmon use their sense of smell to find the river of their birth after years in the ocean, returning to spawn and lay eggs.
fact_tl: Ang mga salmon ay gumagamit ng kanilang pang-amoy upang mahanap ang ilog ng kanilang kapanganakan pagkatapos ng maraming taon sa karagatan — matapos mag-spawn at mag-iwan ng mga itlog, karamihan sa mga Pacific salmon ay namamatay.
fact_bis: Ang mga salmon naggamit sa ilang pang-amoy aron makit-an ang suba sa ilang kapanganakan human sa daghang tuig sa kadagatan — human mag-spawn ug magbilin og mga itlog, ang kadaghanan sa Pacific salmon nangamatay.

q: Which pigment gives carrots and ripe bananas their orange and yellow colors?
options: Carotenoids
Chlorophyll
Anthocyanins
Melanin
explanation: Carotenoids are pigments that give orange and yellow colors to plants like carrots and ripe bananas, and they remain visible in leaves when chlorophyll breaks down in autumn.
fact_tl: Ang mga carotenoid ay mga pigment na nagbibigay ng orange at dilaw na kulay sa mga halaman tulad ng karot at mature na saging — ang mga ito ay nananatili sa dahon kapag nawala ang chlorophyll sa taglamig.
fact_bis: Ang mga carotenoid mga pigment nga naghatag og orange ug dalag nga kolor sa mga tanom sama sa karot ug hinog nga saging; nagpabilin kini nga makita sa mga dahon kon ang chlorophyll mabungkag sa tagtugnaw.

q: Which instrument is used to measure how much rain has fallen?
options: A rain gauge
A barometer
A thermometer
An anemometer
explanation: The instrument that measures rainfall is called a rain gauge.
fact_tl: Ang instrumentong sumusukat sa dami ng ulan ay tinatawag na rain gauge.
fact_bis: Ang instrumento nga mosukod sa gidaghanon sa ulan gitawag nga rain gauge.

q: How do some mangrove trees cope with growing in salty water?
options: Some exclude salt at their roots through ultrafiltration, while others secrete excess salt through glands on their leaves
They convert salt water into fresh water inside their trunks before sending it to the leaves
They only grow above the tidal zone where their roots never actually touch salty water
They produce a special acid from their roots that neutralizes the salt in the surrounding soil
explanation: Mangroves cope with salt water in two ways: some species exclude salt at the roots through ultrafiltration, while others secrete excess salt through specialized glands on their leaves.
fact_tl: Ang bakawan ay nakakatulong sa tubig-alat sa pamamagitan ng dalawang paraan: ang ibang uri ay pinipigilan ang asin sa kanilang mga ugat (ultrafiltration), habang ang iba naman ay pinipili ang asin palabas sa kanilang mga dahon.
fact_bis: Ang bakawan makaya ang tubig-asin sa duha ka paagi: ang ubang klase nagpugong sa asin sa ilang mga ugat pinaagi sa ultrafiltration, samtang ang uban nagsekreta og sobrang asin pinaagi sa espesyal nga glandula sa ilang mga dahon.

q: What are the three parts of a lever?
options: The fulcrum, the load, and the effort
The axle, the wheel, and the handle
The wedge, the ramp, and the pulley
The spring, the pivot, and the force
explanation: A lever has three parts: the fulcrum (pivot point), the load (the weight being moved), and the effort (the force applied).
fact_tl: Ang palanca (lever) ay may tatlong bahagi: ang fulcrum (tukod o pivot), ang load (bigat na bubuhatin), at ang effort (puwersang ibinibigay).
fact_bis: Ang palanca (lever) adunay tulo ka bahin: ang fulcrum (tukod o pivot), ang load (gibug-aton nga ialsa), ug ang effort (kusog nga gigamit).

q: What kind of water conditions do corals need to grow?
options: Warm, shallow, and clear water where sunlight can reach
Cold, deep, and dark water with plenty of dissolved minerals
Slightly acidic, murky water rich in organic matter
Fast-moving, oxygen-rich water near river mouths and estuaries
explanation: Corals grow in warm, shallow, clear water where sunlight can reach, which is why coral reefs are found in tropical, sunny areas.
fact_tl: Lumalago ang koral sa mainit, mababaw, at malinaw na tubig kung saan umaabot ang sikat ng araw.
fact_bis: Ang koral motubo sa mainit, mabaw, ug tin-aw nga tubig diin makaabot ang kahayag sa adlaw.

q: How can a horse sleep while standing up without falling over?
options: Its legs can lock and not buckle while it sleeps
It sleeps with one eye open and its brain stays half-awake
Special sticky pads on its hooves grip the ground while it rests
It leans against a wall or fence to stay balanced during sleep
explanation: A horse can sleep while standing up because its legs have a locking mechanism that keeps them from buckling under the horse's weight.
fact_tl: Kayang matulog ng kabayo nang nakatayo dahil hindi nababaluktot ang mga binti nito kahit pagod.
fact_bis: Ang kabayo makahimo sa pagkatulog nga nagtindog tungod kay ang iyang mga paa makaharang ug dili matumba bisan pagod.

q: Why does the bottom of old building walls sometimes become damp?
options: Water climbs from the ground up into the bricks through capillary action
Rain seeps sideways through cracks at ground level during storms
Underground pipes leak and spray moisture onto the inner wall surface
The wall absorbs moisture from the air when humidity rises above a certain level
explanation: In old buildings, water sometimes climbs from the ground up into walls or bricks by capillary action, causing what is called rising damp.
fact_tl: Sa mga lumang gusali, minsan umaakyat ang tubig mula sa lupa papunta sa pader o ladrilyo dahil sa capillary action, kaya nagiging basa ang ibaba ng dingding.
fact_bis: Sa daan nga mga building, usahay mosaka ang tubig gikan sa yuta paingon sa bongbong o tisa tungod sa capillary action, mao nga maumog ang ubos nga bahin sa bongbong.

q: What causes convection currents — the rising and sinking of fluids?
options: Differences in density, where lighter parts float up and heavier parts sink down
Differences in temperature directly pushing hot fluid upward with heat energy
Differences in color, where darker fluids sink and lighter-colored fluids rise
Differences in pressure only, where high pressure always pushes fluid upward
explanation: Convection is driven by density differences — lighter (less dense) fluid rises while heavier (denser) fluid sinks, just like wood floating up through water.
fact_tl: Ang nagpapagalaw sa convection ay ang kaibahan sa density: ang mas magaan (less dense) na bahagi ay lumulutang pataas at ang mas mabigat (denser) na bahagi ay lumulubog pababa, gaya ng kahoy na lumulutang sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang nagpalihok sa convection mao ang kalainan sa density: ang mas magaan (less dense) nga bahin molutaw paibabaw ug ang mas bug-at (denser) nga bahin molunod paubos, sama sa kahoy nga molutaw sa tubig.

q: Which pair of processes are opposites of each other, where one turns solid directly into gas and the other turns gas directly into solid?
options: Sublimation and deposition
Evaporation and condensation
Melting and freezing
Boiling and precipitation
explanation: Sublimation turns a solid directly into gas (like dry ice), while deposition turns gas directly into solid (like frost) — neither passes through the liquid state.
fact_tl: Ang sublimation at deposition ay magkasalungat na proseso. Sa sublimation, ang solid ay direktang nagiging gas (tulad ng dry ice o moth balls). Sa deposition, ang gas ay direktang nagiging solid (tulad ng frost). Wala sa dalawang prosesong ito ang dumadaan sa likidong estado.
fact_bis: Ang sublimation ug deposition magkasukwahi nga mga proseso. Sa sublimation, ang solid direkta nga mahimong gas (sama sa dry ice o moth ball). Sa deposition, ang gas direkta nga mahimong solid (sama sa frost). Wala sa duha ka proseso ang nagdaan sa likidong estado.

q: Why are leeches, ticks, and mosquitoes called parasites?
options: They live by sucking the blood of other creatures
They eat dead leaves and decaying plants on the forest floor
They steal food that other animals have already caught
They compete with other animals for the same nesting spots
explanation: Leeches, ticks, and mosquitoes are parasites because they live by sucking the blood of other creatures.
fact_tl: Ang linta, garapata, at lamok ay tinatawag na parasito dahil nabubuhay sila sa pagsipsip ng dugo ng ibang nilalang.
fact_bis: Ang linta, garapata, ug namok gitawag nga parasito tungod kay nabuhi sila pinaagi sa pagsuyop sa dugo sa ubang binuhat.

q: During meiosis, chromosomes can swap sections with each other. What is the main result of this chromosome swapping?
options: New combinations of genes and more genetic variation
Fewer chromosomes in the offspring than in the parent
Exact copies of the parent's genes in every offspring
Faster cell division with less energy used
explanation: When chromosomes swap sections during meiosis, they create new gene combinations, which leads to greater genetic variation in offspring.
fact_tl: Sa meiosis, ang mga chromosome ay minsang nagpapalitan ng bahagi, kaya nabubuo ang mga bagong kombinasyon ng genes at mas maraming pagkakaiba-iba.
fact_bis: Atol sa meiosis, ang mga kromosoma usahay magbinayloay ug mga bahin, nga maghimo ug bag-ong kombinasyon sa mga gene ug mas daghang pagkalainlain.

q: How does a person most commonly get infected with tapeworms?
options: By eating undercooked pork or beef that carries tapeworm larvae
By drinking water that has not been boiled or filtered
By touching infected soil with bare hands while gardening
By breathing in tapeworm eggs that float in the air
explanation: Tapeworms are caught by eating undercooked pork or beef that carries tiny tapeworm larvae — thorough cooking kills them.
fact_tl: May bulati na tinatawag na tapeworm o tenya na nakukuha kapag kumain ka ng hindi lutong karne ng baboy o baka. May maliliit na bulati o larva na nakatago sa karne na hindi namamatay kung hilaw pa ito, kaya mahalagang lutong-luto ang karne bago kainin.
fact_bis: Naay bulati nga gitawag og tapeworm nga makuha kung mokaon ka og dili hinog nga karne sa baboy o baka. Naay gagmay nga larva sa karne nga dili mamatay kung hilaw pa, mao nga kinahanglan lutong-luto ang karne usa kan-a.

q: Which pair of colors are complementary colors — opposite each other on the color wheel?
options: Red and green
Red and orange
Blue and purple
Yellow and green
explanation: Complementary colors are opposite each other on the color wheel, such as red and green, or blue and orange.
fact_tl: Ang complementary colors ay ang mga kulay na magkatapat sa color wheel — halimbawa, ang pula at berde, at ang asul at orange — kapag pinagsama ang liwanag ng complementary colors, gumagawa ng puting liwanag.
fact_bis: Ang complementary colors nakaatubang sa usag-usa sa color wheel — sama sa pula ug berde, o asul ug orange — ang paghiusa sa complementary nga mga suga nagabuhat og puting suga.

q: Why is water called the 'universal solvent'?
options: Because so many different substances dissolve in it, due to its polar molecules
Because it can dissolve every single substance on Earth without exception
Because it is the only liquid found naturally on Earth's surface
Because it dissolves things faster than any other liquid when heated
explanation: Water is called the universal solvent because its polar molecules — with positive and negative ends — attract and dissolve many different substances.
fact_tl: Ang tubig ay tinatawag na 'universal solvent' dahil maraming iba't ibang sangkap ang natutunaw dito. Ito ay dahil ang mga molekula ng tubig ay polar — nayroon silang bahagi na positibo at negatibong bayad na nagkakaakit sa iba pang polar na molekula at mga ion.
fact_bis: Ang tubig gitawag nga 'universal solvent' tungod kay daghan nga lainlaing substansya ang matutunaw niini. Kini tungod kay ang mga molekula sa tubig polar — adunay positibo ug negatibong mga dulo nga nagakuha sa ubang polar nga mga molekula ug mga ion.

q: Which of the following is true about the ostrich?
options: It cannot fly but can run very fast on the ground
It can fly short distances but prefers to walk
It can fly but only uses its wings to escape predators
It cannot fly and is also one of the slowest birds on land
explanation: The ostrich cannot fly, but it makes up for this by being able to run very fast on the ground.
fact_tl: Ang ostrich ay hindi nakakalipad, pero mabilis itong tumakbo sa lupa.
fact_bis: Ang ostrich dili makalupad, apan makadagan kini ug paspas sa yuta.

q: As a metal gets hotter and hotter, what happens to the color of light it gives off?
options: It changes from red, to orange, to yellow, and finally to white hot
It changes from white, to yellow, to orange, and finally to red
It stays the same color but gets much brighter as temperature rises
It changes from blue to green before turning red at very high temperatures
explanation: As a metal's temperature rises, the color of light it emits progresses from red to orange to yellow to white hot.
fact_tl: Habang tumataas ang temperatura ng isang metal, nagbabago ang kulay ng liwanag nito — nagsisimula sa pula (mga 700°C), nagiging orange, dilaw, at sa wakas puti (higit sa 1,400°C).
