fact_bis: Habang motubo ang temperatura sa usa ka metal, nagbag-o ang kolor sa suga nga iyang ginhawa — nagsugod sa pula (mga 700°C), dayon orange, dalag, ug sa katapusan puti (labaw sa mga 1,400°C).

q: What does a stick insect do when it is suddenly startled or frightened?
options: It drops to the ground and goes stiff, pretending to be dead or a dry twig
It flies away quickly using its wings to escape from danger
It sprays a bad-smelling liquid to keep predators far away
It changes color to blend in with the background and hides
explanation: When startled, a stick insect drops to the ground and goes stiff, looking dead or like a dry twig — many enemies avoid eating something that appears already dead.
fact_tl: Kapag biglang nagulat, may stick insect na nahuhulog sa lupa at naninigas na parang patay. Iniiwasan ng maraming kaaway ang kumain ng mukhang patay na o tuyong sanga.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga makulbaan, ang stick insect mahulog sa yuta ug magtighot nga morag patay na. Daghang kaaway ang dili mokaon sa morag patay na o uga nga sanga.

q: How strong is a single ant compared to its own body weight?
options: It can lift things many times heavier than its own body
It can only lift objects about the same weight as itself
It can lift objects up to twice its own body weight
It is actually one of the weakest insects for its size
explanation: A single ant can lift things many times heavier than its own body — comparable to a person carrying a car.
fact_tl: Kayang buhatin ng isang langgam ang bagay na maraming beses na mas mabigat kaysa sa sarili nitong timbang — gaya ng tao na may bitbit na kotse.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka subay makahimo sa pagbuhat og butang nga pila ka pilo nga mas bug-at kaysa sa kaugalingon niini nga gibug-aton — sama sa tawo nga magpas-an og awto.

q: How are natural dyes traditionally obtained from tree bark and roots?
options: The bark or roots are boiled in water to draw out the color for dyeing cloth
The bark is ground into powder and mixed with oil to make paint
The roots are pressed to squeeze out juice that is used to dye cloth
The bark is soaked in cold water for many days until the color comes out
explanation: Tree bark and roots, which often hold brown or red color, are boiled to draw out a dye used for coloring cloth.
fact_tl: Ang balat ng puno (bark) at mga ugat ay madalas naglalaman ng kulay na kayumanggi o pula; pinakukuluan ito para makuha ang tina na pangkulay ng tela.
fact_bis: Ang panit sa kahoy (bark) ug mga gamot kasagaran adunay kapehon o pula nga kolor; lat-an kini aron makuha ang tina nga pangkolor sa panapton.

q: Which months are usually the hottest in the Philippines?
options: March, April, and May
June, July, and August
December, January, and February
September, October, and November
explanation: The hottest months in the Philippines are usually March, April, and May.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamainit na buwan sa Pilipinas ay karaniwang Marso, Abril, at Mayo.
fact_bis: Ang pinakainit nga mga bulan sa Pilipinas kasagaran Marso, Abril, ug Mayo.

q: What causes the dark patches you can see inside the bright band of the Milky Way?
options: Clouds of dust and gas that block the light of stars behind them
Empty areas of space where no stars have formed yet
Very cold stars that are too dim to see with the naked eye
Gaps between the spiral arms of our galaxy
explanation: The dark patches in the Milky Way's bright band are clouds of dust and gas that block the light of the stars behind them.
fact_tl: Ang madidilim na bahagi sa loob ng makinang na guhit ng Milky Way ay mga ulap ng alikabok at gas na humaharang sa liwanag ng mga bituin sa likod nila.
fact_bis: Ang ngitngit nga mga bahin sulod sa masanag nga guhit sa Milky Way mga panganod sa abog ug gas nga nagbabag sa kahayag sa mga bituon sa ilang luyo.

q: What would happen to life on Earth if the ozone layer suddenly disappeared?
options: Too much UV radiation would reach the ground, causing sunburn, skin problems, and damage to plants and sea animals
Earth's temperature would immediately drop because the ozone layer traps heat like a blanket
All rain would stop because the ozone layer helps form clouds in the sky
The atmosphere would slowly leak into space because ozone holds the air in place
explanation: Without the ozone layer, far too much UV radiation would reach Earth, causing more sunburn, skin and eye problems in people, and damaging plants and tiny sea animals.
fact_tl: Kung biglang mawawala ang ozone layer, masyadong maraming UV ang aabot sa lupa. Magdudulot ito ng mas maraming sunburn at sakit sa balat at mata sa tao, at masisira rin ang maraming halaman at maliliit na hayop sa dagat.
fact_bis: Kon kalit nga mawala ang ozone layer, sobra ka daghang UV ang muabot sa yuta. Maghatag kini og mas daghang sunburn ug sakit sa panit ug mata sa tawo, ug makadaot pud sa daghang tanom ug gagmayng mananap sa dagat.

q: Where do cloud rats make their nests?
options: Inside hollows of old trees
In underground burrows they dig themselves
In the tall grasses and shrubs on the forest floor
In nests built from twigs high up in the tree canopy
explanation: Cloud rats make their nests inside the hollows of old trees.
fact_tl: Ang cloud rat ay gumagawa ng pugad sa loob ng mga guwang o lungib ng matatandang puno.
fact_bis: Ang cloud rat nagahimo ug salag sulod sa mga guang o lungag sa daang mga kahoy.

q: Compared to a 60-watt incandescent bulb, about how much electricity does an LED bulb use to produce the same amount of light?
options: About 9 to 10 watts — saving around 85% of the electricity
About 40 watts — saving only about 33% of the electricity
About 30 watts — saving about half of the electricity
About 55 watts — barely any difference in energy use
explanation: A 9-10 watt LED gives the same light as a 60-watt incandescent bulb, saving about 85% of the electricity.
fact_tl: Ang isang LED bulb na 9-10 watts ay nagbibigay ng parehong liwanag ng 60-watt na incandescent bulb — kaya ang LED ay nagtatipid ng halos 85% na kuryente at tumatagal nang 10-15 taon, kumpara sa 1 taon para sa incandescent.
fact_bis: Ang 9-10 watt nga LED bulb naghatag ug pareho rang suga sa 60-watt nga incandescent bulb — busa ang LED nakatipid ug mga 85% sa kuryente ug nagdugay ug 10-15 tuig, kumpara sa mga 1 tuig alang sa incandescent.

q: Why is air pressure highest near the ground and lower higher up?
options: Because air is denser and heavier near the ground, so more air weight presses down
Because sunlight heats the ground and pushes air molecules down toward Earth
Because the Earth's magnetic field pulls air tightly against the surface
Because wind always blows downward near the ground, compressing air
explanation: Air is denser and heavier near the ground, so pressure is highest there and weakens as you go higher up.
fact_tl: Mas siksik at mabigat ang hangin malapit sa lupa, kaya naroon ang pinakamataas na presyon, at humihina ito habang pataas.
fact_bis: Mas baga ug bug-at ang hangin duol sa yuta, mao nga pinakahabog ang presyon didto, ug mohuyang kini samtang pataas.

q: What happens to the color of seawater when phytoplankton multiply all at once in a large bloom?
options: The seawater turns green and the bloom can be seen from satellites
The seawater turns bright red and becomes poisonous to fish
The seawater becomes clear and much more transparent than usual
The seawater turns brown because the phytoplankton die quickly
explanation: When phytoplankton multiply all at once, they can turn the seawater green, and the bloom is large enough to be visible from satellites.
fact_tl: Kapag dumami nang sabay-sabay ang phytoplankton, nagiging berde o kulay ang tubig ng dagat at nakikita ito mula sa satellite.
fact_bis: Kung mosaka ang gidaghanon sa phytoplankton, mahimong lunhaw ang tubig sa dagat ug makita kini gikan sa satellite.

q: If a device has a higher watt rating, what does that mean for your electricity bill?
options: It uses more energy each second, so it adds up your electricity use more quickly
It uses the same total energy but takes longer to finish its job
It uses less energy overall because it works more efficiently
It only costs more if you use it for less than one hour at a time
explanation: A device with a higher watt rating uses more energy each second, so it builds up electricity use more quickly.
fact_tl: Ang isang aparatong may mas mataas na watt rating ay kumukonsumo ng mas maraming enerhiya kada segundo, kaya mas mabilis tumaas ang kuryenteng gagamitin nito.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka galamiton nga adunay mas taas nga watt rating mogamit ug mas daghang enerhiya kada segundo, mao nga mas paspas nga modaghan ang konsumo niini sa kuryente.

q: Besides medicine from a doctor, what two simple things help the body recover from pneumonia?
options: Getting enough rest and drinking plenty of fluids
Exercising hard every day and eating only fruits
Staying awake as long as possible and going outside in the sun
Eating very salty food and drinking as little water as possible
explanation: Enough rest and drinking plenty of fluids help the body recover from pneumonia.
fact_tl: Ang sapat na pahinga at pag-inom ng maraming tubig ay tumutulong sa katawan na gumaling mula sa pulmonya.
fact_bis: Ang igong pahuway ug pag-inom og daghang tubig makatabang sa lawas nga maulian gikan sa pulmonya.

q: What advantage does a vaccine have over actually catching a disease to build immunity?
options: A vaccine teaches your body to fight the disease without the risk of getting seriously ill
A vaccine works faster than catching the disease because it uses stronger medicine
A vaccine gives permanent immunity while catching the disease only protects you for a short time
A vaccine costs less than treating the disease and works only for children
explanation: A vaccine gives the body the same lesson as catching the disease but without the risk of getting seriously ill.
fact_tl: Pwede ring matuto ang katawan kapag nagkasakit ka nang totoo—pero delikado iyon. Ang bakuna ang nagbibigay ng parehong 'aral' na walang panganib na magkasakit ka nang malubha.
fact_bis: Makakat-on usab ang imong lawas kung magsakit ka gyud—apan delikado kana. Ang bakuna naghatag sa samang leksyon nga walay peligro nga magsakit ka og grabe.

q: When you throw a ball, what type of energy do you give it?
options: Kinetic energy — the energy of motion
Potential energy — stored energy due to its height
Chemical energy — energy stored inside the ball's material
Thermal energy — heat energy from your hands
explanation: When you throw a ball, you do work that gives it kinetic energy — the energy of motion.
fact_tl: Kapag inihahagis mo ang bola, gumagawa ka ng trabaho na nagbibigay rito ng kinetic energy o enerhiya ng paggalaw.
fact_bis: Kung imong ilabay ang bola, naghimo ka og trabaho nga naghatag niini og kinetic energy o enerhiya sa paglihok.

q: What are the two main kinds of elephants found in the world?
options: The African elephant and the Asian elephant
The forest elephant and the plains elephant
The Indian elephant and the Chinese elephant
The savanna elephant and the jungle elephant
explanation: There are two main kinds of elephants: the African elephant and the Asian elephant.
fact_tl: May dalawang pangunahing uri ng elepante: ang elepanteng Aprikano at ang elepanteng Asyano.
fact_bis: Adunay duha ka nag-unang matang sa elepante: ang elepanteng Aprikano ug ang elepanteng Asyano.

q: Plant chemical defenses protect them against which types of threats?
options: Both large animals and tiny insects
Only large animals like deer and elephants
Only bacteria and fungi in the soil
Only harmful weather like frost and drought
explanation: Plant chemical defenses fight off not only large animals but also tiny insects.
fact_tl: Hindi lang malalaking hayop, kundi maliliit na insekto rin ang pinipigilan ng kemikal na depensa ng halaman.
fact_bis: Dili lang dagkong hayop, kondili gagmayng insekto usab ang mapugngan sa kemikal nga depensa sa tanom.

q: What is the correct order of steps for making sugar from sugarcane?
options: Press the stalks to get juice, then boil and clarify the juice, then cool it until sugar crystals form
Dry the stalks first, then grind them into powder, then add water and boil
Boil the whole stalks in water first, then press them to squeeze out the juice
Freeze the stalks to break them down, then heat the mixture until sugar appears
explanation: Making sugar from sugarcane involves pressing the stalks to extract juice, boiling and clarifying the juice, and cooling it until sugar crystals form.
fact_tl: Ang proseso ng paggawa ng asukal mula sa tubo ay: pinipiga ang tangkay para makuha ang juice; pagkatapos ang juice ay pinakuluan, nilinis, at pininalamig hanggang mag-crystallize ang asukal.
fact_bis: Ang proseso sa paghimo og asukal gikan sa tubo: pinislit ang tangkay aron makuha ang juice; ang juice gipakulob, gilimpyo, ug gipabugnaw hangtod motubog ang mga crystal sa asukal.

q: The cleaner wrasse fish cleans parasites off larger fish. What type of relationship is this called?
options: Mutualism, because both the cleaner fish and the big fish benefit
Parasitism, because the cleaner fish feeds off the bigger fish
Commensalism, because only the small cleaner wrasse benefits
Predation, because the big fish is harmed by the cleaner fish
explanation: The relationship between the cleaner wrasse and big fish is called mutualism because both sides benefit — the cleaner fish gets food and the big fish gets cleaned.
fact_tl: Ang ugnayan ng cleaner wrasse at malalaking isda ay tinatawag na mutwalismo, dahil parehong nakikinabang ang dalawa.
fact_bis: Ang relasyon sa cleaner wrasse ug dagkong isda gitawag nga mutwalismo, kay pareho silang nakabenepisyo.

q: Where in nature is evidence of Earth's past magnetic pole reversals recorded?
options: In magnetic stripes in seafloor basalt rocks on either side of mid-ocean ridges
In tree rings from ancient forests that survived each magnetic reversal
In ice cores from glaciers that preserve magnetic particles in each layer
In amber fossils that show how compasses would have pointed in the past
explanation: Earth's magnetic pole reversals are recorded in seafloor basalt rocks as magnetic stripes on either side of mid-ocean ridges; the last full reversal was about 780,000 years ago.
fact_tl: Ang mga magnetic poles ng Earth ay paulit-ulit na nagbabago ng posisyon sa buong kasaysayan ng mundo; ang huling full reversal ay nangyari humigit-kumulang 780,000 taon na ang nakalipas. Ang mga reversal na ito ay narekord sa mga basalt rocks ng seabed na nagpapakita ng magnetic stripes sa magkabilang panig ng mid-ocean ridges.
fact_bis: Ang mga magnetic pole sa Yuta paulit-ulit nga nagbabago sa posisyon sa tibuok kasaysayan sa heolohiya; ang katapusan nga full reversal nahitabo mga 780,000 ka tuig na ang milabay. Kining mga reversal narekord sa mga basalt rock sa seabed nga nagpakita sa magnetic stripe sa matag kilid sa mga mid-ocean ridge.

q: What is something special about the tiny leaves of the acacia (rain tree)?
options: They fold up at night or when it rains
They glow faintly in the dark to attract insects
They change from green to red every evening
They fall off every time the wind blows strongly
explanation: The acacia (rain tree) has tiny leaves that fold up at night or when it rains.
fact_tl: Ang akasya ay isang malaking puno na may malawak na sanga na nagbibigay ng malamig na lilim, at ang maliliit nitong dahon ay nagsasara kapag gabi o umuulan.
fact_bis: Ang akasya usa ka dako nga kahoy nga may halapad nga sanga nga naghatag og bugnaw nga landong, ug ang gagmay niini nga dahon mosira kon gabii o mag-ulan.

q: What is a contact lens and what is it used for?
options: A thin lens placed directly on the front of the eye to correct blurry vision
A small glass screen worn over the eye to protect it from dust
A lens clipped onto eyeglasses to magnify objects at a distance
A surgical implant placed inside the eye to permanently fix vision
explanation: A contact lens is a thin lens placed directly on the front of the eye to correct blurry vision.
fact_tl: Ang contact lens ay manipis na lenteng inilalagay nang direkta sa harap ng mata para itama ang malabong paningin.
fact_bis: Ang contact lens usa ka nipis nga lente nga ibutang direkta sa atubangan sa mata aron tul-iron ang hanap nga panan-aw.

q: What is the job of the vacuole inside a cell?
options: It stores water, food, and other substances the cell needs
It produces energy for the cell by breaking down sugar
It controls what goes in and out of the cell
It builds proteins that the cell uses for growth and repair
explanation: The vacuole is a storage sac inside the cell that holds water, food, and other substances.
fact_tl: Ang bakuwol ay parang lalagyan sa loob ng selula na nag-iimbak ng tubig, pagkain, at iba pang sangkap.
fact_bis: Ang bakuwol usa ka morag sudlanan sa sulod sa sélula nga nagtipig ug tubig, pagkaon, ug uban pang sangkap.

q: What is an organ in the human body?
options: A group of different tissues working together to perform a specific job
A single type of cell that grows very large to do an important task
A collection of bones and muscles that protect vital body parts
A system of tubes that carry blood and nutrients throughout the body
explanation: An organ is a group of different tissues working together to perform a specific job, like the heart pumping blood.
fact_tl: Ang organo ay isang grupo ng iba't ibang uri ng tissue na nagtatrabaho nang magkasama para gampanan ang isang espesyal na gawain, tulad ng puso na nagpapump ng dugo.
fact_bis: Ang organo usa ka grupo sa lain-laing klase sa tissue nga nagtrabaho sa tingob aron makompleto ang usa ka espesyal nga trabaho, sama sa puso nga nagpampa sa dugo.

q: How is using a fingerprint to identify a person different from using DNA?
options: A fingerprint is fast and easy to lift from a touched object, while DNA needs a laboratory to analyze
A fingerprint is more accurate than DNA because no two fingers are the same
DNA can be lifted from surfaces just like a fingerprint but costs more to check
Fingerprints change as you grow older while DNA stays the same throughout life
explanation: A fingerprint is fast and easy to lift from a touched object, while DNA is inside your cells and needs a laboratory to analyze.
fact_tl: Parehong ginagamit ang fingerprint at DNA para malaman kung sino ka, pero magkaiba sila. Mabilis at madaling kunin ang fingerprint mula sa hawak na bagay, samantalang ang DNA ay nasa loob ng iyong mga selula at kailangan ng laboratoryo para suriin.
fact_bis: Parehas gigamit ang fingerprint ug DNA aron mahibal-an kung kinsa ka, apan lahi sila. Paspas ug sayon kuhaon ang fingerprint gikan sa nahikapan nga butang, samtang ang DNA anaa sa sulod sa imong mga selula ug nagkinahanglan og laboratoryo aron susihon.

q: What type of magnet is used on cranes at scrap yards to lift heavy wrecked cars?
options: A very strong electromagnet attached to the end of the crane
A large permanent magnet that never loses its pulling power
A series of small bar magnets arranged in a circle
A magnet made from compressed iron filings and plastic
explanation: At scrap yards, big cranes use a very strong electromagnet that can lift whole wrecked cars and scrap metal.
fact_tl: Sa mga junk shop o tambakan ng bakal, may malalaking kran na may napakalakas na electromagnet sa dulo. Kaya nitong buhatin ang mga sirang kotse at bakal dahil sobrang lakas ng hila sa poste nito.
fact_bis: Sa mga junk shop o tapok sa puthaw, adunay dagkong crane nga adunay kusgan kaayo nga electromagnet sa tumoy. Makahimo kini pag-alsa sa mga guba nga sakyanan ug puthaw tungod kay kusog kaayo ang pagbira sa nawong niini.

q: What happens to a plant gall after the insect that made it leaves?
options: The dry empty gall often stays on the plant for a while
The gall immediately falls off the plant when the insect leaves
The plant quickly absorbs the gall back into its stem
The gall breaks open and releases seeds like a fruit
explanation: After the insect leaves, the dry empty gall often stays on the plant for a while.
fact_tl: Pagkaalis ng insekto, madalas nananatili sa halaman ang tuyong gall na wala nang laman.
fact_bis: Human mobiya ang insekto, sagad magpabilin sa tanom ang uga ug walay sulod nga gall sa pipila ka panahon.

q: Why should old batteries, cellphones, and gadgets NOT be thrown in ordinary trash?
options: They contain toxic chemicals and metals that must be recycled properly
They take up too much space and make trash bags too heavy to carry
They attract rats and insects that can spread disease in landfills
They block drainage systems and cause flooding in neighborhoods
explanation: E-waste like old batteries, cellphones, and gadgets contains toxic chemicals and metals that must be recycled properly — not mixed with ordinary trash.
fact_tl: Ang e-waste tulad ng lumang baterya, selpon, at gadget ay hindi basta-basta dapat itapon kasama ng karaniwang basura, dahil may nakakalasong kemikal at metal ito na kailangang i-recycle nang maayos.
fact_bis: Ang e-waste sama sa daan nga baterya, selpon, ug gadget dili angay basta ilabay uban sa ordinaryong basura, kay adunay makahilo nga kemikal ug metal nga kinahanglan i-recycle og maayo.

q: Should a wild macaque monkey be kept as a pet at home?
options: No, it is a wild animal that belongs in the forest, not a pet
Yes, macaques are friendly and easy to train as household pets
Yes, if raised from birth they become safe and calm companions
No, but only because they are too large to keep inside a house
explanation: The macaque is a wild animal that should stay in the forest — it is not meant to be kept as a pet.
fact_tl: Ang unggoy na ito ay mailap na hayop na dapat manatili sa kagubatan, hindi alagang-hayop.
fact_bis: Kini nga unggoy usa ka ihalas nga mananap nga angay magpabilin sa lasang, dili binuhing hayop.

q: A ball of clay sinks in water, but if you mold the same clay into a bowl shape, what happens?
options: It floats, even though it is made of the same amount of clay
It still sinks, because the amount of clay is the same
It sinks more slowly but always sinks eventually
It floats only if you add more clay to make the walls thicker
explanation: Molding clay into a hollow bowl shape allows it to float even though the amount of clay is the same, because shape affects whether an object floats or sinks.
fact_tl: Lumulubog ang bolang luwad pero kung gagawin itong hugis-mangkok, lumulutang na ito kahit pareho ang dami.
fact_bis: Ang bola nga luwad molubog, apan kung porma-mangkok kini, molutaw na bisan parehas ra ang gidaghanon.

q: You see a lightning flash and then hear thunder 6 seconds later. About how far away is the lightning?
options: About 2 kilometers away
About 6 kilometers away
About 1 kilometer away
About 10 kilometers away
explanation: Every 3 seconds between a lightning flash and thunder means the lightning is about 1 kilometer away, so 6 seconds equals about 2 kilometers.
fact_tl: Dahil mas mabagal ang tunog, bawat 3 segundo sa pagitan ng kidlat at kulog ay katumbas ng halos 1 kilometrong layo ng kidlat.
fact_bis: Tungod kay mas hinay ang tingog, matag 3 ka segundo tali sa kilat ug dalogdog nagpasabot nga mga 1 kilometro ang gilay-on sa kilat.

q: How is chromatography different from evaporation as a method of separating things?
options: Chromatography needs no heat — the liquid climbs and carries colors apart on its own
Chromatography uses very high heat to separate mixtures, while evaporation uses no heat
Chromatography can only separate liquids, while evaporation can separate solids too
Chromatography is much slower than evaporation and less accurate
explanation: Unlike evaporation which needs heat to drive off water, chromatography needs no heat — the liquid simply climbs and carries colors apart.
fact_tl: Kaiba sa pagsingaw: kapag pinakuluan mo ang tubig-alat, sumisingaw ang tubig at naiiwan ang asin. Pero hindi kailangan ng init sa chromatography umaakyat lang ang likido at dinadala nito ang mga kulay para maghiwalay.
fact_bis: Lahi sa pagsingaw: kung pabukalon nimo ang tubig-asin, mosingaw ang tubig ug mabilin ang asin. Apan dili kinahanglan og init ang chromatography mosaka lang ang likido ug dad-on niini ang mga kolor aron mabulag.

q: No matter how a seed is planted, which direction do the roots always grow?
options: Downward into the soil, because they follow the pull of gravity
Toward the nearest light source, following the sun
In whichever direction has the most water nearby
Outward in all directions equally from the seed
explanation: Roots always grow downward into the soil no matter how a seed is planted, because they follow the pull of gravity.
fact_tl: Tumutubo ang ugat pababa patungo sa lupa, kahit saang paraan mo itanim ang buto, dahil sinusunod nito ang hila ng grabidad.
fact_bis: Ang gamot motubo paubos paingon sa yuta bisan unsaon pagtanom sa liso, kay gisunod niini ang bira sa grabidad.

q: Why does a mantis shrimp shed its hard shell, and what happens right after?
options: It sheds its shell to grow, and it is weak and vulnerable until the new shell hardens
It sheds its shell because it gets too heavy, and it grows a lighter one immediately
It sheds its shell to attract a mate, and the new shell is brightly colored
It sheds its shell when sick, and the new shell is softer and more flexible
explanation: Like other crustaceans, the mantis shrimp sheds its hard shell to grow, and it is weak and vulnerable until the new shell hardens.
fact_tl: Tulad ng ibang crustacean, ang mantis shrimp ay nagpapalit ng kanyang matigas na balat para lumaki, at mahina ito sandali habang bago pa ang balat.
fact_bis: Sama sa ubang crustacean, ang mantis shrimp mag-ilis sa gahi niini nga panit aron motubo, ug luya kini sa makadiyot samtang bag-o pa ang panit.

q: Even without added sugar, how can yeast still find food in bread dough?
options: Flour contains starch that slowly breaks down into sugar the yeast can eat
Yeast does not actually need sugar and feeds on the gluten in flour instead
Water mixed with flour releases minerals that give yeast enough energy
Yeast feeds on oxygen trapped in the dough rather than on sugar
explanation: Even without added sugar, yeast can feed in bread because flour contains starch that slowly breaks down into sugar the yeast can eat.
fact_tl: Kahit walang dagdag na asukal, may pagkain pa rin ang yeast sa tinapay. Ang harina ay may starch (almirol) na unti-unting nahahati at nagiging asukal na pwedeng kainin ng yeast.
fact_bis: Bisan walay dugang nga asukal, makakaon gihapon ang yeast sa pan. Ang harina adunay starch (almirol) nga hinay-hinay nga mabahin ngadto sa asukal nga makaon sa yeast.

q: If you push with the same force on a small area versus a large area, what happens to the pressure?
options: Pressure is higher when the force is on a smaller area
Pressure is the same regardless of how big or small the area is
Pressure is lower on a smaller area because less material is being pushed
Pressure only changes if you also change how hard you push
explanation: When the same force is concentrated on a smaller area, the pressure becomes higher and presses much harder into things.
fact_tl: Kapag ang parehong puwersa ay nakatuon sa mas maliit na lugar, mas tumataas ang presyon, kaya mas malalim itong tumutusok o pumipindot.
fact_bis: Kung ang parehas nga puwersa mapunting sa mas gamay nga bahin, mosaka ang presyur, mao nga mas lawom kini moduot o motusok sa mga butang.

q: What does impulse equal, and what does it change in an object?
options: Impulse equals force multiplied by time, and it changes the momentum of the object
Impulse equals force divided by time, and it changes the speed of the object
Impulse equals mass multiplied by acceleration, and it changes the object's direction
Impulse equals force multiplied by distance, and it changes the energy of the object
explanation: Impulse equals force multiplied by time — the longer a force is applied, the greater the change in the object's momentum.
fact_tl: Ang impulse ay ang puwersa pinarami sa oras — binabago nito ang momentum ng isang bagay; mas matagal inilalapat ang puwersa, mas malaki ang pagbabago ng momentum.
fact_bis: Ang impulse katumbas sa puwersa nga gipadaghan sa oras — nagbago kini sa momentum sa usa ka butang; ang mas taas nga panahon sa paggamit sa puwersa, mas dako ang pagbag-o sa momentum.

q: Why do the proton and electron stay together in an atom?
options: The positive proton and negative electron attract each other because opposite charges attract
The proton and electron spin in opposite directions, creating a force that holds them together
Gravity pulls the lighter electron toward the heavier proton at the center
A strong nuclear force directly binds the electron to the proton in the nucleus
explanation: The positive proton and negative electron attract each other because opposite charges attract, which keeps them together in the atom.
fact_tl: Ang positibong proton at negatibong electron ay naaakit sa isa't isa, kaya nananatiling magkasama sa atomo.
fact_bis: Ang positibo nga proton ug negatibo nga electron magdinanihay sa usag usa, mao nga magpabilin silang magkauban sa atomo.

q: Why is a closed car with a metal roof considered a safe shelter during a lightning storm?
options: Because the electricity flows along the outside of the metal body, not through the people inside
Because the rubber tires act as insulators that block lightning from reaching the car
Because the metal roof is too thick for lightning to melt through and reach the passengers
Because metal attracts lightning away from the surrounding area protecting people nearby
explanation: A closed car with a metal roof is safe during lightning because the electricity flows along the outside of the metal body, not through the passengers inside.
fact_tl: Ang sarado at metal ang bubong na kotse ay ligtas na masisilungan dahil dumadaloy ang kuryente sa labas nito.
fact_bis: Ang sirado nga sakyanan nga metal ang atop luwas nga kasilungan kay ang kuryente moagi sa gawas niini.

q: Why are geese sometimes kept to guard homes and farms?
options: They honk loudly when a stranger comes near, alerting the owners
They can run very fast to chase away intruders from the property
They peck hard enough to seriously injure any person who enters
They have very sharp eyesight and can spot danger from far away in the dark
explanation: Geese honk loudly when a stranger comes near, which is why they are sometimes kept as guards.
fact_tl: Ang gansa ay sumisigaw ng malakas kapag may estranghero, kaya minsan ginagamit itong pambantay.
fact_bis: Ang gansa kusog nga motingog kon adunay estranghero, mao nga usahay gigamit kini nga bantay.

q: Which of the following correctly describes a monocot plant?
options: It has one cotyledon and parallel leaf veins — examples are rice, banana, and corn
It has two cotyledons and net-like leaf veins — examples are mung bean and mango
It has one cotyledon and net-like leaf veins — examples are camote and cassava
It has two cotyledons and parallel leaf veins — examples are corn and coconut
explanation: Monocots like rice, banana, and corn have one cotyledon and parallel leaf veins, while dicots like mung bean and mango have two cotyledons and net venation.
fact_tl: Ang monocot (tulad ng palay, saging, at mais) ay may isang cotyledon at parallel na ugat ng dahon; ang dicot (tulad ng monggo, mangga, at kamote) ay may dalawang cotyledon at net venation.
fact_bis: Ang monocot (sama sa palay, saging, ug mais) adunay usa ka cotyledon ug parallel nga ugat sa dahon; ang dicot (sama sa mongo, mangga, ug kamote) adunay duha ka cotyledon ug net venation.

q: Which months does the habagat (southwest monsoon wind) bring heavy rains to the Philippines?
options: June to October
November to March
March to May
December to February
explanation: The habagat is the southwest monsoon that blows from June to October, bringing heavy rains to the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang habagat ay ang hanging humihihip mula timog-kanluran tuwing Hunyo hanggang Oktubre at nagdadala ng malakas na ulan sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang habagat mao ang hangin nga mohuyop gikan sa habagatang-kasadpan gikan Hunyo hangtod Oktubre ug nagdala ug kusog nga ulan sa Pilipinas.

q: Where can you find many lichens clinging in the Philippines?
options: Moist forests on trees and rocks
Dry sandy beaches on driftwood
Mountain peaks on bare ice
Freshwater rivers on submerged logs
explanation: In the moist forests of the Philippines, many lichens can be found clinging to trees and rocks.
fact_tl: Sa mamasa-masang gubat ng Pilipinas, makikita ang maraming lichen na kumakapit sa mga puno at bato.
fact_bis: Sa mamasa nga kalasangan sa Pilipinas, makita ang daghang lichen nga nagkapyot sa mga kahoy ug bato.

q: What shape do quartz crystals commonly form?
options: Six-sided prism with a pointed end
Eight-sided cube with flat faces
Round ball with smooth surface
Flat sheet with ragged edges
explanation: Quartz commonly forms crystals with six sides and a pointed end.
fact_tl: Ang quartz ay karaniwang bumubuo ng kristal na may anim na gilid at matulis na dulo.
fact_bis: Ang quartz kasagaran maghimog kristal nga adunay unom ka kilid ug tinubok nga tumoy.

q: In the game langit-lupa, what makes you move faster and farther when you run?
options: Pushing harder against the ground with your feet
Swinging your arms more slowly
Leaning backward while running
Holding your breath as you sprint
explanation: In langit-lupa you move faster and farther when your feet push harder against the ground.
fact_tl: Sa larong langit-lupa, mabilis kang tumatakbo at umaakyat sa mataas na lugar; mas malayo ang naaabot mo kapag mas malakas mong itinutulak ang paa sa lupa.
fact_bis: Sa dula nga langit-lupa, modagan ka ug mosaka sa habog nga luwas nga dapit; mas paspas ug mas layo ang imong maabot kung kusgan nimo itulod ang tiil batok sa yuta.

q: When does a species usually go extinct?
options: When its environment changes quickly and individuals lack traits to survive
When it has too many offspring competing for the same food
When a stronger species decides to protect its territory
When the species moves to a new area and thrives there
explanation: A species usually goes extinct when its environment changes quickly and its individuals lack the traits needed to survive in the new conditions.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nauubos (nagiging extinct) ang isang species kapag mabilis na nagbago ang kapaligiran nito — tulad ng pagbabago ng klima o pagkawala ng pagkain — at ang mga indibidwal nito ay walang mga katangiang kailangan para mabuhay sa bagong kalagayan.
fact_bis: Kasagarang mapuo (mahimong extinct) ang usa ka species kung dali nga mausab ang palibot niini — sama sa pagbag-o sa klima o pagkawala sa pagkaon — ug ang mga indibidwal niini walay kinaiya nga gikinahanglan aron mabuhi sa bag-ong kahimtang.

q: Why do many sea snakes live around coral reefs?
options: To hunt for fish hiding in the coral
To lay their eggs safely on the reef surface
To filter tiny plankton from the current
To hide from sharks in the open ocean
explanation: Many sea snakes live around coral reefs where they hunt for fish hiding in the coral.
fact_tl: Maraming ahas-dagat ang naninirahan sa mga bahura ng korales kung saan sila nanghuhuli ng isda.
fact_bis: Daghang halas sa dagat nagpuyo libot sa mga bahura sa coral diin sila mangita og isda.

q: What gives bones a little flexibility so they do not snap easily?
options: Collagen, a protein full of carbon
Calcium that fills the hollow spaces
Iron minerals in the bone marrow
Water trapped between bone layers
explanation: Bones contain collagen — a protein full of carbon — that gives bone strength and a little flexibility so it does not snap easily.
fact_tl: Kahit ang matitigas mong buto ay may carbon. Bukod sa kalsiyum na nagpapatibay nito, may bahaging tinatawag na collagen — isang protina na puno ng carbon — na nagbibigay sa buto ng lakas at kaunting lambot para hindi madaling mabali.
fact_bis: Bisan ang gahi nimong bukog adunay carbon. Gawas sa calcium nga naghimo niini nga lig-on, adunay bahin nga gitawag og collagen — usa ka protina nga puno sa carbon — nga naghatag sa bukog og kusog ug gamayng kahumok aron dili dali mabali.

q: Why does a fishing net have small holes in it?
options: So water can pass through but fish cannot escape
So the net is colorful and easy to spot
So the net sinks to the bottom quickly
So fish are attracted to the pattern
explanation: A fishing net has small holes so water can pass through and keep the net light, while the holes are small enough that fish cannot escape.
fact_tl: Ang lambat ay may maliliit na butas para makalusot ang tubig at maging magaan itong hilahin, pero sapat na liit para hindi makatakas ang mga isda.
fact_bis: Ang pukot adunay gagmay nga mga lungag aron makaagi ang tubig ug magaan kining birahon, apan gamay ra kaayo nga dili makaikyas ang mga isda.

q: What do squid and cuttlefish use to bite their food?
options: A hard, parrot-like beak in the middle of their arms
Rows of tiny teeth lining their tentacles
A flat plate inside their mantle cavity
Sharp claws on the tips of their arms
explanation: In the middle of their arms, squid and cuttlefish have a hard, parrot-like beak they use to bite their food.
fact_tl: Sa gitna ng mga braso ng pusit at kibet ay may matigas na tuka na parang tuka ng loro na ginagamit nila sa pagkagat ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Sa tunga sa mga braso sa nokus ug kibot adunay gahi nga sungo nga sama sa sungo sa loro nga gamiton nila sa pagpaak sa pagkaon.

q: What happens to a person who does not get enough iron from food?
options: They get anemia and feel weak
They develop strong bones but poor eyesight
They gain too much weight quickly
They have trouble digesting proteins
explanation: Without enough iron, the blood cannot carry enough oxygen, and a person gets anemia and feels weak.
fact_tl: Ang iron mula sa pagkaing tulad ng malunggay, karne, at atay ay tumutulong sa dugo na magdala ng oxygen; kapag kulang dito, nagkaka-anemia at nanghihina ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang iron gikan sa pagkaon sama sa malunggay, karne, ug atay motabang sa dugo nga magdala og oxygen; kon kulang niini, magka-anemia ug magluya ang tawo.

q: What happens in an autoimmune disease?
options: The immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own cells
The immune system becomes too weak to fight any germs
Bacteria produce chemicals that destroy white blood cells
Viruses permanently switch off the immune system
explanation: An autoimmune disease occurs when the immune system cannot distinguish its own body cells and attacks them.
fact_tl: Ang autoimmune disease ay nangyayari kapag ang immune system ay hindi makilala ang sariling mga cell ng katawan at umaatake sa mga ito — ang mga halimbawa ay type 1 diabetes, lupus, at rheumatoid arthritis.
fact_bis: Ang autoimmune disease mahitabo kung ang immune system dili makilala ang kaugalingong mga cell sa lawas ug moatake kanila — ang mga pananglitan lakip ang type 1 diabetes, lupus, ug rheumatoid arthritis.

q: Why have most species that ever lived on Earth gone extinct?
options: Their environment changed and they lacked traits to survive and reproduce
They were all hunted to extinction by early humans
They chose to move underground and stopped reproducing
They evolved too quickly and outcompeted themselves
explanation: Extinction happens when the environment changes and the individuals of a species lack the traits needed to survive and reproduce there.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng mga species na nabuhay na sa Earth ay lipol na; nangyayari ang pagkalipol kapag nagbago ang kapaligiran at ang mga indibidwal ng species na iyon ay walang mga katangiang kailangan para mabuhay at magparami doon.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa mga species nga nabuhi na sa Yuta napuo na; mahitabo ang pagkapuo kon mabag-o ang palibot ug ang mga indibidwal sa maong species walay mga kinaiya nga gikinahanglan aron mabuhi ug manganak didto.

q: Why is the Philippines considered one of the most special places on Earth for living things?
options: It has an enormous variety of animals and plants, like the tarsier and thousands of plant species
It is the only country where photosynthesis can happen
It has the largest rainforest on any island in the world
It is the closest country to the planet Mars
explanation: The Philippines is one of the places with the most kinds of animals and plants in the world, showing how rich life on Earth is.
fact_tl: Ang Earth lang ang planetang puno ng iba't ibang buhay, at ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga lugar na may pinakamaraming uri ng hayop at halaman sa mundo — tulad ng tarsier, iba't ibang isda sa karagatan, at libo-libong uri ng halaman. Ipinapakita nito kung gaano kasagana ang buhay sa Earth.
fact_bis: Ang Earth ra ang planeta nga puno sa nagkalainlaing kinabuhi, ug ang Pilipinas usa sa mga dapit nga adunay pinakadaghang klase sa hayop ug tanom sa kalibutan — sama sa tarsier, daghang isda sa kadagatan, ug liboan ka klase sa tanom. Gipakita niini kung unsa ka adunahan ang kinabuhi sa Earth.

q: What is one benefit of separating your trash as required by Philippine law?
options: It reduces the amount of trash going to landfills and lowers pollution
It makes the trash smell better inside the home
It causes more garbage trucks to visit each day
It keeps all plastic in one pile so it burns faster
explanation: Separating waste reduces the amount of trash going to landfills, lowers pollution, and helps the environment.
fact_tl: Ang paghihiwalay ng basura ayon sa batas ay nagpapababa ng dami ng basurang napupunta sa mga tambak, nagpapababa ng polusyon, at nagtutulong sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Ang pagbulag sa basura sumala sa batas nagpababa sa dami sa basura nga moadto sa mga landfill, nagpababa sa polusyon, ug nakatulong sa kalikasan.

q: How can warming oceans affect shrimp?
options: They can weaken shrimp or push them to move to cooler places
They make shrimp grow larger and reproduce faster
They cause shrimp to change color but stay in the same spot
They help shrimp build stronger shells
explanation: Because shrimp are cold-blooded and follow the water's warmth, steadily warming seas can weaken them or push them to move to cooler places.
fact_tl: Dahil malamig ang dugo ng hipon at sumasabay ito sa tubig, ang patuloy na pag-init ng dagat ay maaaring magpahina sa kanila o magtulak sa kanilang lumipat sa mas malamig na lugar.
fact_bis: Tungod kay bugnaw og dugo ang hipon ug mosunod kini sa kainit sa tubig, ang nagpadayong pag-init sa dagat mahimong makapaluya kanila o motukmod kanila sa pagbalhin sa mas bugnaw nga dapit.

q: Why is the long-spined sea urchin (Diadema) dangerous on Philippine reefs?
options: Its thin spines break off in skin easily and cause pain and infection
It sprays a poisonous ink cloud at swimmers nearby
It bites with sharp teeth hidden under its shell
It produces electric shocks when touched underwater
explanation: The long-spined sea urchin has very long thin spines that easily break off in skin and cause pain and infection.
fact_tl: Ang long-spined sea urchin (Diadema) ay may napakahabang manipis na tinik na madaling masira kapag pumasok sa balat at nagiging sanhi ng sakit at impeksyon — isa ito sa pinakakaraniwang panganib sa mga reef ng Pilipinas para sa mga barefoot na manlalangoy.
fact_bis: Ang long-spined sea urchin (Diadema) adunay taas kaayo nga nipis nga mga tinik nga dali mabali sa panit ug nagpahinabo og sakit ug impeksyon — usa kini sa pinaka-komon nga peligro sa Philippine reefs para sa mga naglangoy nga walay sapin.

q: What is a key physical difference between monkeys and apes like gorillas?
options: Monkeys usually have a tail, while apes have no tail
Monkeys have no ears, while apes have large round ears
Monkeys have four eyes, while apes have two eyes
Monkeys are always smaller than apes in every species
explanation: Monkeys usually have a tail, while apes such as gorillas and orangutans have no tail.
fact_tl: Karaniwang may buntot ang unggoy (monkey), habang ang mga ape gaya ng gorilya at orangutan ay walang buntot.
fact_bis: Ang unggoy (monkey) kasagaran adunay ikog, samtang ang mga ape sama sa gorilya ug orangutan walay ikog.

q: What does blood carry to every cell in the body?
options: Oxygen and nutrients
Carbon dioxide and waste only
Electrical signals from the brain
Heat to warm cold organs
explanation: Blood flows through the whole body to carry oxygen and nutrients to every cell.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ay dumadaloy sa buong katawan upang magdala ng oksiheno at sustansya sa bawat selula.
fact_bis: Ang dugo nagaagas sa tibuok lawas aron magdala og oksiheno ug sustansya sa matag selula.

q: How do bees make honey?
options: They suck nectar from flowers, store it in a special stomach, and process it until it thickens
They collect water from rivers and mix it with pollen on the ground
They chew up leaves and let them ferment inside the hive
They gather morning dew from grass and dry it in the sun
explanation: Bees suck sweet nectar from flowers, store it in a special stomach, and process it over and over until it thickens into honey.
fact_tl: Sinisipsip ng bubuyog ang matamis na nektar ng bulaklak, iniimbak ito sa espesyal na tiyan, at paulit-ulit na pinoproseso hanggang maging makapal na pulot.
fact_bis: Ang putyukan mosuyop sa tam-is nga nektar sa bulak, itipig kini sa espesyal nga tiyan, ug balik-balikon kini hangtod mahimong baga nga dugos.

q: What device is used to measure blood sugar levels with a small drop of blood?
options: A glucometer
A thermometer
A stethoscope
A barometer
explanation: Blood sugar levels can be measured using a small drop of blood and a device called a glucometer.
fact_tl: Ang antas ng asukal sa dugo ay masusukat gamit ang isang maliit na patak ng dugo at isang device na tinatawag na glucometer.
fact_bis: Ang lebel sa asukal sa dugo masukod pinaagi sa gamay nga tulo sa dugo ug usa ka aparato nga gitawag glucometer.

q: What is kaingin farming and what problem does it cause?
options: Burning forest to create cropland, which causes deforestation
Planting many crops in rows to prevent soil erosion
Digging deep canals to irrigate dry farmland
Using chemical fertilizers that contaminate groundwater
explanation: Kaingin (slash and burn farming) burns forest to create cropland, causing deforestation and damaging ecosystems.
fact_tl: Ang kaingin (slash and burn farming) ay isang paraan ng pagsasaka kung saan sinusunog ang kagubatan para gawing palayan o taniman; ito ay nagdudulot ng deforestation at pinsala sa kalikasan.
fact_bis: Ang kaingin (slash and burn farming) usa ka pamaagi sa pagsasaka diin gisunog ang kalasangan aron gawing uma; nagdulot kini og deforestation ug pinsala sa ekosistema, ug kini giregulate sa balaod sa Pilipinas.

q: Why do astronauts float inside the International Space Station?
options: The station and astronauts are constantly falling around Earth as they orbit
There is absolutely no gravity in space at that altitude
The station's engines push air out and remove all weight
The walls are made of a material that cancels gravity
explanation: Astronauts float because the station and they are constantly 'falling' around the Earth as they orbit, not because gravity is gone.
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang mga astronaut dahil ang istasyon at sila ay patuloy na 'nahuhulog' sa paligid ng Mundo habang umiikot, hindi dahil walang grabidad.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut naglutaw tungod kay ang himpilan ug sila padayon nga 'nahulog' libot sa Kalibutan samtang nagtuyok, dili tungod kay wala nay grabidad.

q: Where in the world can jellyfish be found?
options: In every ocean, from shallow water to the deep sea
Only in warm tropical seas near the equator
Only in the Pacific and Indian Oceans
Only in shallow water along beaches
explanation: Jellyfish live in every ocean in the world, from shallow water to the deep sea.
fact_tl: May dikya sa lahat ng karagatan ng mundo, mula sa mababaw na tubig hanggang sa malalim na dagat.
fact_bis: Naa'y dikya sa tanang dagat sa kalibotan, gikan sa mabaw nga tubig hangtod sa lawom nga dagat.

q: What do baby sailfin lizards do right after hatching from their eggs?
options: Feed and climb on their own without any help from parents
Wait in the nest for their mother to bring them food
Stay together in a group until their scales harden
Call loudly so their father can find and protect them
explanation: Baby sailfin lizards can already feed and climb on their own right after hatching, as their parents do not care for them.
fact_tl: Pagkapisa ng mga itlog, ang sanggol na sailfin lizard ay agad nang nakakakain at nakakaakyat mag-isa. Hindi sila inaalagaan ng magulang, kaya sa simula pa lang ay marunong na silang magtago at maghanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Pagkapusa sa mga itlog, ang gagmay nga sailfin lizard makakaon na ug makasaka dayon nga mag-inusara. Wala sila atimana sa ginikanan, mao nga sukad sa sinugdan kahibalo na sila motago ug mangita og pagkaon.

q: Why do only a few baby seahorses survive even though hundreds are born?
options: They are so tiny that other animals eat most of them before they grow up
The father does not release them all at the same time
The ocean current sweeps most of them far away from food
They cannot breathe properly until their fins fully develop
explanation: Even though a seahorse has hundreds of babies, only a few survive because they are so tiny and are often eaten by other animals before they grow up.
fact_tl: Kahit daan-daan ang anak ng seahorse, kakaunti lang ang nakakaligtas dahil napakaliit nila at madalas silang kainin ng ibang hayop bago pa lumaki.
fact_bis: Bisan og gatusan ang anak sa seahorse, pipila ra ang maluwas kay gagmay kaayo sila ug kasagarang kan-on sa ubang hayop sa dili pa sila modako.

q: What causes the midnight sun near Earth's poles, where the Sun does not set for days?
options: Earth's strong tilt at the poles during certain times of year
The poles are much closer to the Sun than the equator
The ice at the poles reflects sunlight to keep it bright
A gap in Earth's atmosphere lets extra sunlight in
explanation: Near Earth's poles, the midnight sun is caused by Earth's strong tilt at those places, which keeps the Sun above the horizon for days.
fact_tl: Malapit sa mga polo ng Earth, may panahong hindi lumulubog ang Araw nang ilang araw (midnight sun) at panahong hindi ito sumisikat — dulot ito ng matinding pagkatagilid ng Earth sa mga lugar na iyon.
fact_bis: Duol sa mga polo sa Earth, adunay panahon nga dili mosalop ang Adlaw sulod sa pipila ka adlaw (midnight sun) ug panahon nga dili kini mosubang — tungod sa kusog nga paghilig sa Earth niadtong mga dapita.

q: How far did the ash reach when Taal Volcano erupted in January 2020?
options: As far as Manila
Only as far as the nearest town of Lemery
Only within Taal Lake itself
As far as Cebu City
explanation: Taal Volcano erupted in January 2020 and sent up thick ash that reached as far as Manila.
fact_tl: Pumutok ang Bulkang Taal noong Enero 2020 at nagpalabas ng makapal na abo na umabot hanggang Maynila.
fact_bis: Ang Bulkang Taal miputok niadtong Enero 2020 ug nagpagawas og baga nga abo nga miabot hangtod sa Manila.

q: How does the body cool itself down when a fever is breaking?
options: The brain lowers its target temperature and you begin to sweat, which cools the skin
The heart pumps faster to push cold blood to the surface
You shiver intensely to shake off excess heat
Extra urine production removes the heat from the body
explanation: When the fever is ready to come down, the brain lowers its target temperature and sweat evaporating from the skin cools the body back toward normal.
fact_tl: Kapag handa nang bumaba ang lagnat, ibinababa ng utak ang temperaturang gusto nito, at nagsisimula kang pawisan. Ang pawis na sumisingaw sa balat ang nagpapalamig sa katawan pabalik sa normal.
fact_bis: Kung andam na nga mokunhod ang hilanat, gipaubos sa utak ang temperatura nga gusto niini, ug magsugod ka og singot. Ang singot nga moalisngaw gikan sa panit maoy magpabugnaw sa lawas balik sa naandan.

q: What is blood's main job as it moves through your body?
options: Carry oxygen and nutrients to every part of the body
Break down food in the stomach
Send electrical signals to the muscles
Filter waste from the air we breathe
explanation: Blood is a fluid that carries oxygen and nutrients to every part of the body.
fact_tl: Ang dugo ay isang likido na nagdadala ng oksiheno at sustansya sa lahat ng bahagi ng katawan.
fact_bis: Ang dugo usa ka likido nga magdala og oksiheno ug sustansya sa tanan nga bahin sa lawas.

q: What is the milligram used to measure?
options: Very tiny amounts, like the dose in medicine
The weight of large stones and boulders
The length of short pieces of string
The volume of water in a swimming pool
explanation: The milligram is used to weigh very tiny amounts, like the dose in medicine.
fact_tl: Ang miligramo ay sukat para sa napakagagaang bagay tulad ng dami ng sangkap sa gamot.
fact_bis: Ang miligramo gigamit aron sukoron ang gagmay kaayo nga gibug-aton, sama sa sulod sa tambal.

q: What is potential energy?
options: Energy stored in an object because of its position or condition
Energy released when an object is moving fast
Energy produced by burning fuel in an engine
Energy that travels as waves through the air
explanation: Potential energy is energy stored in an object because of its position or condition.
fact_tl: Ang potential energy ay enerhiyang nakaimbak sa isang bagay dahil sa posisyon o kalagayan nito.
fact_bis: Ang potential energy mao ang enerhiya nga gitipigan sa usa ka butang tungod sa posisyon o kahimtang niini.

q: Why does your forehead feel hot when you have a fever?
options: The blood flowing through your body is warmer, and the forehead skin lets that heat be felt
Your brain is working harder and releasing heat through the skull
You are sweating more on your forehead than anywhere else
Your nose is blocked, so all the body's heat escapes through your forehead
explanation: During a fever, the blood flowing through your body is warmer, and the skin on your forehead makes that heat easy to feel.
fact_tl: Kapag may lagnat ka, mainit ang noo mo kapag hinawakan. Ito ay dahil mas mainit ang dugo na dumadaloy sa katawan mo, at madaling maramdaman ang init sa balat ng noo.
fact_bis: Kung hilanaton ka, init ang imong agtang kung hikapon. Tungod kini kay mas init ang dugo nga nagaagos sa imong lawas, ug sayon mabati ang kainit sa panit sa agtang.

q: What is the purpose of a ladybug's bright red and black colors?
options: To warn other animals that it tastes bad and should not be eaten
To help it blend into red flowers so predators cannot see it
To attract a mate during the breeding season
To reflect sunlight and keep its body cool
explanation: The ladybug's bright red and black colors warn other animals that it tastes bad and should not be eaten.
fact_tl: Ang maliwanag na pula at itim na kulay ng ladybug ay babala sa mga hayop na ito ay masamang lasa at hindi dapat kainin.
fact_bis: Ang masiga nga pula ug itom nga kolor sa ladybug usa ka pasidaan sa ubang hayop nga pait kini ug dili angay kan-on.

q: What happens because a shrew has a very high metabolism?
options: It burns energy from food very quickly
It can survive for weeks without eating anything
It moves very slowly to save energy
It sleeps for most of the day to conserve heat
explanation: A shrew has a very high metabolism, so it burns energy from food very quickly.
fact_tl: Napakabilis ng metabolismo ng shrew, kaya napakadali nitong nasusunog ang enerhiya mula sa pagkain.
fact_bis: Paspas kaayo ang metabolismo sa shrew, mao nga dali ra niini masunog ang enerhiya gikan sa pagkaon.

q: How does a heron catch its fish?
options: It stands perfectly still and quiet for a long time, then suddenly strikes when a fish comes close
It dives from high in the air to scoop a fish from below
It wades quickly through water and chases fish in groups
It lures fish to the surface by dropping feathers on the water
explanation: A heron stands perfectly still and quiet for a long time, waiting for a fish to come close before it suddenly strikes.
fact_tl: Hindi basta-basta tumutusok ang tagak. Nakatayo muna ito nang tahimik at hindi gumagalaw nang matagal, naghihintay na lumapit ang isda bago ito biglang tumira.
fact_bis: Dili dayon motuslok ang tulabong. Mobarog una kini nga hilom ug dili molihok og dugay, maghulat nga moduol ang isda una kini kalit nga motira.

q: When do stomata normally open on a plant leaf, and why?
options: During the day, to let in CO2 for photosynthesis
At night, to absorb moonlight for energy
Only during rain, to collect extra water
At sunrise and sunset only, to avoid heat damage
explanation: Stomata normally open during the day to let in CO2 for photosynthesis and close at night to reduce water loss.
fact_tl: Sa karaniwan, nagbubukas ang stomata sa araw para pumasok ang CO2 para sa photosynthesis, at nagsasara sa gabi upang mabawasan ang pagkawala ng tubig.
fact_bis: Sa kasagaran, nagbukas ang stomata sa adlaw aron mosulod ang CO2 para sa photosynthesis ug nagsira sa gabii aron dili mawala ang tubig.

q: What makes glass an especially good material to recycle?
options: It can be recycled over and over without losing its quality
It melts at a very low temperature so it is easy to process
It breaks into harmless powder when ground up in landfills
It is so rare that every piece must be reused
explanation: Glass can be recycled over and over without losing its quality, so the material is not wasted.
fact_tl: Ang salamin ay maaaring i-recycle nang paulit-ulit nang hindi nababawasan ang kalidad nito, kaya hindi nasasayang ang materyales.
fact_bis: Ang salamin mahimong i-recycle og balikbalik nga dili mokunhod ang kalidad niini, mao nga dili mausik ang materyales.

q: How does a puffed-up pufferfish defend itself if it can barely swim?
options: It relies on its large size and spines to scare off enemies instead of fleeing
It shoots poisonous darts from its belly
It releases a cloud of ink to hide and then escapes
It bites attackers with very sharp teeth
explanation: Once puffed up, a pufferfish can barely move or swim well, so it relies on its big size and spines to scare off enemies instead of fleeing.
fact_tl: Kapag namaga na ang butete, halos hindi na ito makagalaw o makalangoy nang maayos — kaya umaasa ito na takutin ng laki at tinik nito ang kalaban sa halip na tumakbo.
fact_bis: Kon nahubag na ang butete, halos dili na kini makalihok o makalangoy og maayo — maong nagsalig kini sa dako nga lawas ug tunok aron hadlokon ang kaaway imbes molayas.

q: What does the flying lemur (colugo) mostly eat?
options: Leaves of trees
Small insects and grubs
Fish from forest streams
Fruit and flower nectar
explanation: The flying lemur, also called a colugo, is a plant-eater and most of its food is the leaves of trees.
fact_tl: Ang kagwang o flying lemur ay halaman ang kinakain, kaya karamihan ng pagkain nito ay mga dahon ng puno.
fact_bis: Ang kagwang o flying lemur tanom ang gikaon, mao nga kadaghanan sa pagkaon niini mao ang mga dahon sa kahoy.

q: What happens to the traits in incomplete dominance?
options: The two traits blend together, for example red and white flowers producing pink offspring
The stronger trait completely hides the weaker trait
Both traits appear side by side in separate patches
Only one parent's trait is passed on to the offspring
explanation: In incomplete dominance, the two traits blend, such as a red flower and a white one giving pink offspring.
fact_tl: Sa di-ganap na dominansya, magkahalo ang dalawang katangian, gaya ng pulang bulaklak at puti na nagiging rosas.
fact_bis: Sa dili-hingpit nga dominansya, magsagol ang duha ka kinaiya, sama sa pula nga bulak ug puti nga mahimong rosas.

q: How many centimeters are in one meter?
explanation: There are 100 centimeters in one meter.
fact_tl: May 100 sentimetro sa isang metro.
fact_bis: Adunay 100 ka sentimetro sa usa ka metro.

q: What creates the small ripples you see on the surface of sand dunes?
options: Wind pushing sand grains up and down in a pattern
Water flowing under the sand and lifting it
Animals walking across the dune surface
The sand expanding and contracting with temperature changes
explanation: The small ripples seen on the surface of sand are made by wind pushing grains up and down in a pattern.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na alon o gilis na nakikita sa ibabaw ng buhangin ay gawa ng hangin na nagtutulak sa mga butil pataas at pababa.
fact_bis: Ang gagmay nga balud o kunot nga makita sa ibabaw sa balas hinimo sa hangin nga nagduso sa mga lugas paibabaw ug paubos.

q: How do small nectar-feeding birds move from flower to flower?
options: They beat their wings very fast and dart quickly between flowers
They walk slowly along branches searching for open blossoms
They glide silently on air currents between feeding spots
They hop along the ground and jump up to low flowers
explanation: Small nectar-feeding birds beat their wings very fast and dart quickly from flower to flower.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na ibong kumakain ng nektar ay napakabilis pumagaspas ng pakpak at maliksing lumipat sa bawat bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang gagmayng langgam nga mokaon og nektar paspas kaayo mokapakapa sa ilang pako ug abtik nga mobalhin sa matag bulak.

q: What role do wetlands in the Philippines play for migratory birds?
options: They serve as resting stops for birds flying in from faraway countries
They are breeding grounds where migratory birds lay their eggs permanently
They provide freshwater for birds that can only live in the tropics
They act as training grounds where young birds learn to migrate
explanation: Wetlands in the Philippines are resting stops for migratory birds that fly in from faraway countries.
fact_tl: Ang mga latian sa Pilipinas ay pahingahan ng mga ibong dayo na lumilipad mula sa malayong bansa.
fact_bis: Ang mga lamakan sa Pilipinas mga pahulayanan sa mga langyaw nga langgam nga molupad gikan sa layong nasud.

q: Why do nerves in the skin let us feel pain?
options: To warn us of danger
To help us hear sounds better
To control our balance when walking
To send messages to our stomach for digestion
explanation: Nerves in the skin let us feel pain to warn us of danger.
fact_tl: Ang mga nerbiyos sa balat ang nagpaparamdam ng sakit upang bigyang-babala tayo sa panganib.
fact_bis: Ang mga nerbiyos sa panit nagpabati sa kasakit aron pasidan-an kita sa katalagman.

q: What is ice?
options: The solid form of water that has become hard because of the cold
Water with air bubbles trapped inside it
A type of rock that melts in warm weather
Salt water that has been frozen in the sea
explanation: Ice is the solid form of water — water that has become hard because of the cold.
fact_tl: Ang yelo ay tubig sa solidong anyo nito — tubig na naging matigas dahil sa lamig.
fact_bis: Ang yelo mao ang solidong porma sa tubig — tubig nga nahimong gahi tungod sa kabugnaw.

q: Why is adequate sleep important for learning?
options: During sleep, the brain organizes and stores memories from the day
During sleep, the eyes practice reading so the brain improves
Sleep removes all chemicals from the brain so it starts fresh
Sleep makes the muscles stronger so you can sit and study longer
explanation: During sleep, the brain works to organize and store memories from the day, which is why adequate sleep is important for effective learning.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng tulog, ang utak ay nagtatrabaho para ayusin at itago ang mga alaala ng araw; ito ang dahilan kaya mahalagang matulog nang sapat para matuto nang mabuti.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa pagtulog, ang utak nagtrabaho sa pag-organisar ug pagtipig sa mga memorya sa adlaw; mao kini ang hinungdan nga ang igo nga pagtulog importante alang sa epektibong pagkat-on.

q: Why are people in the Philippines sometimes confused about which bird is the true maya?
options: Because many different small birds are all called maya
Because the maya changes color in different seasons
Because the maya looks exactly like a small bat
Because the name maya belongs to a fish, not a bird
explanation: In the Philippines, many small birds are called maya, which is why people are sometimes confused about which is the true maya.
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, maraming maliliit na ibon ang tinatawag na maya, kaya minsan nalilito ang mga tao kung alin ang totoong maya.
fact_bis: Sa Pilipinas, daghang gagmayng langgam ang gitawag og maya, mao nga usahay malibog ang mga tao kon hain ang tinuod nga maya.

q: About how many lightning flashes happen around the world every second?
options: About 100
About 10
About 1,000
About 1
explanation: Around the world, about 100 lightning flashes happen every second.
fact_tl: Sa buong Mundo, may humigit-kumulang 100 kidlat na kumikislap kada segundo.
fact_bis: Sa tibuok Kalibutan, adunay mga 100 ka kilat nga mokidlap matag segundo.

q: Why do your eyes stay wet even when you have not blinked for a few seconds?
options: Tears refill constantly from a pump inside the eye
A thin oily layer on top of the tear stops the water from evaporating quickly
Tears are too cold to evaporate in normal air
The eyelid seals the eye shut between blinks
explanation: The thin oily layer on top of a tear acts like a lid that slows evaporation, keeping your eye moist between blinks.
fact_tl: Ang manipis na langis sa labas ng luha ay parang takip na pumipigil sa tubig na sumingaw agad. Kaya nananatiling basa ang mata mo kahit hindi ka palaging kumukurap.
fact_bis: Ang nipis nga lana sa gawas sa luha sama sa taklob nga makapugong sa tubig nga dali mosingaw. Mao nga magpabilin nga basa ang imong mata bisan dili ka kanunay mopilok.

q: What happens to the movement of tiny particles as a substance gets closer and closer to absolute zero (−273.15°C)?
options: Particles spin faster because they release stored energy
Particles nearly stop moving, but absolute zero can never fully be reached
Particles change from solid to liquid as motion slows
Particles stay at the same speed regardless of temperature
explanation: At absolute zero nearly all random particle motion would theoretically stop, but this temperature can never actually be reached.
fact_tl: Ang absolute zero (0 Kelvin, −273.15°C) ay ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura — sa teorya, ang lahat ng random na galaw ng mga particle ay halos huminto, ngunit hindi ito kailanman ganap na naaabot.
fact_bis: Ang absolute zero (0 Kelvin, −273.15°C) ang pinakaubos nga posibleng temperatura — sa teorya halos tanan nga random nga lihok sa mga particle mohunong, apan dili kini kailanman hingpit nga maabot.

q: What does the tarsier mainly eat?
options: Fruits and seeds found in trees
Live insects, and sometimes small frogs or birds
Leaves and young shoots at night
Nectar from tropical flowers
explanation: The tarsier is a carnivore that mainly eats live insects and occasionally small frogs and birds at night.
fact_tl: Ang tarsier ay karnibore na pangunahing kumakain ng buhay na insekto, at minsan ay palaka at maliliit na ibon sa gabi.
fact_bis: Ang tarsier usa ka karnibore nga panguna mokaon og buhing insekto, ug usahay palaka ug gagmayng langgam sa gabii.

q: Why can many cave-dwelling animals survive without eating for very long periods?
options: They store large amounts of fat just before entering the cave
Food is scarce in caves, so they have adapted to survive on very little food
They absorb nutrients directly from the moist cave walls
They hibernate continuously, so they never actually need food
explanation: Because food is scarce inside caves, many cave animals have adapted to survive on very little food.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa kuweba ay marunong mabuhay sa kaunting pagkain lamang dahil bihira ang makakain sa loob ng kuweba.
fact_bis: Daghang mananap sa langob makahimo nga mabuhi sa gamay ra nga pagkaon kay panagsa ra ang makaon sulod sa langob.

q: The Etruscan shrew is one of the smallest mammals on Earth. What makes its need for food unusual?
options: It eats only once a week to save energy
It can die if it goes without food for just a few hours
It stores food in its cheeks like a hamster
It only eats during daylight and fasts at night
explanation: The Etruscan shrew cannot survive being hungry for long — if it does not eat within just a few hours, it can die.
fact_tl: Hindi kayang magtiis ng gutom ang Etruscan shrew. Kung hindi siya makakain sa loob lang ng ilang oras, maaari na siyang mamatay!
fact_bis: Dili makaagwanta sa kagutom ang Etruscan shrew. Kung dili siya makakaon sulod lang sa pipila ka oras, mahimo siyang mamatay!

q: What is stored inside a legume seed that helps a new plant survive right after it sprouts?
options: Water absorbed from the soil during the growing season
Food that the new plant will use when it sprouts
Minerals collected from the parent plant's roots
Oxygen trapped during the seed's formation
explanation: Each legume seed stores food that the new plant will use as energy when it first sprouts and before it can make its own food.
fact_tl: Bawat buto ng legume ay may nakaimbak na pagkain na gagamitin ng bagong halaman pagsibol nito.
fact_bis: Matag liso sa legume adunay tinagoan nga pagkaon nga gamiton sa bag-ong tanom kung moturok kini.

q: Which statement correctly describes the electrical charge of a neutron found in an atom's nucleus?
options: It has a positive charge equal to that of a proton
It has a negative charge that balances the proton
It has no charge — it is neutral
It switches between positive and negative depending on temperature
explanation: The neutron has no electrical charge — it is neutral, unlike protons (positive) and electrons (negative).
fact_tl: Ang neutron ay walang charge — neutral ito.
fact_bis: Ang neutron walay charge — neutral kini.

q: How do hospital ultrasound machines let doctors see a baby inside the mother's womb?
options: They use X-rays that pass through soft tissue and reflect off bone
They bounce sound waves off the inside of the body and use the echoes to make a picture
They shine a bright light through the skin so a camera can record the image
They inject a liquid that glows under special hospital lighting
explanation: Ultrasound machines bounce high-frequency sound waves off the inside of the body and use the returning echoes to build an image.
fact_tl: Sa ospital, gumagamit ng tunog na ultratunog na tumatalbog sa loob ng katawan para makagawa ng larawan, gaya ng pagtingin sa sanggol bago ipanganak.
fact_bis: Sa ospital, mogamit og ultrasound nga tingog nga mosalpok sa sulod sa lawas aron makahimo og hulagway, sama sa pagtan-aw sa bata sa wala pa matawo.

q: How do ants help plants grow when they dig their underground nests?
options: They carry water from streams directly to plant roots
They mix air into the soil while digging, which helps plants grow
They produce a liquid that acts like fertilizer for roots
They eat harmful worms that compete with plant roots
explanation: By digging their nests, ants mix air into the soil, which improves conditions for plant growth.
fact_tl: Sa paghuhukay ng kanilang pugad, naipapasok ng mga langgam ang hangin sa lupa at nakakatulong ito sa mga halaman.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa pagkalot sa ilang salag, ang mga hulmigas magsagol og hangin sa yuta nga makatabang sa mga tanom.

q: Which element makes up the greatest part of Earth's core?
options: Nickel
Silicon
Iron
Magnesium
explanation: Iron is the main element that makes up Earth's core, which is why Earth has a strong magnetic field.
fact_tl: Ang iron (bakal) ang pangunahing elemento na bumubuo sa ubod (core) ng Earth.
fact_bis: Ang iron (puthaw) mao ang nag-unang elemento nga naglangkob sa core sa Yuta.

q: Besides producing electricity, what is one environmental problem that large hydropower dams can cause?
options: They release large amounts of carbon dioxide directly into the air
They can block fish migration and displace communities living in areas to be flooded
They use up all the river water, leaving nothing downstream
They create noise pollution that permanently damages nearby forests
explanation: Large hydropower dams can block fish migration, change water temperature downstream, and displace communities when an area is flooded.
fact_tl: Ang malalaking dam para sa hydropower ay may mga epekto sa kalikasan — maaaring mapigilan ang paglalakbay ng mga isda, mabago ang temperatura ng tubig sa downstream, at maaaring maalis ang mga komunidad na nakatira sa lugar na lalubog sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang malalaking hydropower dam mahimong adunay epekto sa kalikasan — mahimong pugngan ang paglihok sa isda, mabag-o ang temperatura sa tubig sa downstream, ug maalis ang mga komunidad nga nagpuyo sa lugar nga malunod.

q: How is the budding method of plant propagation different from grafting?
options: Budding uses roots while grafting uses only leaves
Budding uses only a single bud instead of a whole shoot
Budding works only for trees while grafting works for any plant
Budding requires two parent plants while grafting uses only one
explanation: Budding is like grafting but uses only a single bud instead of a whole shoot, and is commonly used for kalamansi and roses.
fact_tl: Ang budding ay isang paraan ng vegetative propagation na katulad ng grafting pero gumagamit lamang ng isang bud sa halip ng isang sanga—ginagamit ito para sa kalamansi at rosas.
fact_bis: Ang budding usa ka paagi sa vegetative propagation nga susama sa grafting apan usa lamang ka bud ang gigamit kaysa bug-os nga sanga; kini komon para sa kalamansi ug rosas.

q: Two teams in a tug-of-war pull with exactly equal force in opposite directions. What happens to the rope?
options: The rope slowly moves toward the stronger side
The rope does not move because the forces are balanced
The rope breaks in the middle due to the combined force
The rope moves in a circle because both forces push it sideways
explanation: When two forces are equal and opposite they are balanced, so the object (the rope) does not move.
fact_tl: Kapag pantay at magkasalungat ang dalawang puwersa, balanse sila at hindi gumagalaw ang bagay.
fact_bis: Kon patas ug magkatugbang ang duha ka puwersa, balanse sila ug ang butang dili molihok.

q: Why are most of the world's great deserts, like the Sahara, located about 30 degrees away from the equator?
options: Winds carry all the rain away from those latitudes toward the poles
Hot air that rose over the equator sinks back down already dried out, so rain is rare
The land at 30 degrees is too flat for clouds to form over it
Ocean currents cool the air at 30 degrees so it cannot hold any moisture
explanation: At about 30 degrees latitude, hot air that rose over the equator sinks back down already dried out, making rainfall rare and creating desert conditions.
fact_tl: Maraming malalaking disyerto (tulad ng Sahara) ay nasa parehong distansya mula sa ekwador — mga 30 digri — dahil doon bumababa ang dating mainit na hangin mula sa ekwador na natuyo na, kaya bihira ang ulan.
fact_bis: Daghang dagkong disyerto (sama sa Sahara) naa sa managsama nga gilay-on gikan sa ekwador — mga 30 ka degree — kay didto mokunsad ang init nga hangin nga misaka sa ekwador nga namala na, maong talagsa ra ang ulan.

q: Why do most people not need to use the bathroom many times during the night while sleeping?
options: The body stops making any waste products during sleep
The kidneys produce less urine at night so sleep is not interrupted
The bladder becomes twice as large at night to hold more urine
Sleeping reduces blood flow so less fluid reaches the kidneys
explanation: At night, the kidneys make less urine so the body can rest without needing to wake up for the bathroom.
fact_tl: Bakit hindi ka madalas umihi kapag tulog? Sa gabi, mas kaunti ang ihi na ginagawa ng bato para hindi ka magising. Inaayos nito ang tubig nang hindi mo namamalayan.
fact_bis: Ngano nga dili ka kanunay mangihi kung natulog? Sa gabii, gamay ra ang ihi nga himuon sa kidney aron dili ka mamata. Gi-ayos niini ang tubig nga wala nimo mabantayi.

q: On the pH scale, which number means a substance is perfectly neutral — not an acid and not a base?
explanation: A pH of 7 is neutral, meaning the substance is neither acidic nor basic.
fact_tl: Ang pH 7 ay neutral, hindi asido ni base.
fact_bis: Ang pH 7 neutral, dili asido o base.

q: What is special about Vulcan Point inside Taal Lake in the Philippines?
options: It is the highest point in the Visayas region
It is a tiny island inside a lake that is itself inside a larger island
It is the only freshwater volcano in Asia
It is a coral reef that formed inside an ancient volcanic crater
explanation: Vulcan Point is famous for being an island within a lake within an island — a rare natural formation found inside Taal Lake on Luzon.
fact_tl: Sa loob ng Taal Lake ay may maliit na pulo na tinatawag na Vulcan Point, isa sa pinakatanyag na 'isla sa loob ng lawa sa loob ng isla.'
fact_bis: Sa sulod sa Taal Lake adunay gamay nga pulo nga gitawag og Vulcan Point, usa ka bantog nga 'isla sulod sa lanaw sulod sa isla.'

q: What does an eel look like, and where can it be found?
options: It is a round, flat fish with wings that lives only in the deep ocean
It is a long, snake-shaped fish with slippery skin found in rivers, streams, and the sea
It is a small, colorful fish with hard scales that lives only in coral reefs
It is a wide, flat fish that buries itself in riverbeds and has no fins
explanation: The eel is a long, snake-shaped fish with slippery skin that can live in rivers, streams, and the sea.
fact_tl: Ang igat ay isang mahabang isdang parang ahas ang hugis na may madulas na balat, at nakatira ito sa mga ilog, sapa, at dagat.
fact_bis: Ang igat usa ka taas nga isda nga morag bitin og porma nga adunay danlog nga panit, ug nagpuyo kini sa mga suba, sapa, ug dagat.

q: The maya is a small bird common in Philippine gardens. What do its short, rounded wings help it do?
options: Soar high above mountains for long distances without flapping
Make quick flaps and fast turns in small spaces like gardens and fields
Float silently over water to catch fish near the surface
Glide long distances between islands without stopping
explanation: The maya's short, rounded wings are suited for quick flapping and fast turns in small, tight spaces like gardens and fields.
fact_tl: Ang maya, isang karaniwang ibon sa Pilipinas, ay may maiikli at bilog na pakpak. Ang hugis na ito ay bagay sa mabilis na pagpagaspas at mabilis na pagliko sa maliliit na lugar tulad ng mga halamanan at bukid. Iba ito sa mahahabang pakpak ng agila na pang-mataas na paglipad.
fact_bis: Ang maya, usa ka kasagarang langgam sa Pilipinas, adunay mubo ug lingin nga pako. Kini nga porma maayo sa paspas nga pagkampay ug paspas nga pagliko sa gagmayng dapit sama sa tanaman ug uma. Lahi kini sa taas nga pako sa agila nga alang sa hataas nga paglupad.

q: Which chemical element is responsible for producing the RED color in fireworks?
options: Copper
Barium
Strontium
Magnesium
explanation: The red color in fireworks comes from strontium salts, which glow bright red when they burn.
fact_tl: Ang PULANG (red) kulay sa paputok (fireworks) ay galing sa STRONTIUM na asin.
fact_bis: Ang PULA nga kolor sa paputok (fireworks) gikan sa STRONTIUM nga asin.

q: What causes the greenhouse effect that keeps Earth warm?
options: The Sun sends more heat to Earth in summer, warming the whole planet
Certain gases in the atmosphere trap heat from the Sun, keeping Earth warm
Oceans store heat during the day and release it at night to warm the air
Clouds reflect sunlight back toward Earth, raising the temperature below them
explanation: The greenhouse effect happens when certain atmospheric gases trap heat from the Sun, keeping Earth's surface warm.
fact_tl: Ang greenhouse effect ay nangyayari kapag ang ilang gas sa atmospera ay humuhuli ng init mula sa araw, kaya nananatiling mainit ang Mundo.
