explanation: Saliva begins breaking down starch, but food spends little time in the mouth, so starch digestion is completed in the small intestine.
fact_tl: Sinisimulan lang ng laway ang panunaw ng starch — hindi ito tinatapos. Maikli lang ang oras ng pagkain sa bibig, kaya kaunti pa lang ang nahahati. Sa maliit na bituka pa natatapos ang panunaw ng starch.
fact_bis: Ang laway magsugod lang sa paghilis sa starch — dili kini mahuman niini. Mubo ra ang panahon sa pagkaon sa baba, mao nga gamay ra ang mabungkag. Sa gamay nga bituka pa mahuman ang paghilis sa starch.

q: Why must the heart never stop pumping?
options: Because blood delivers oxygen and nutrients to every part of the body, and without it cells would starve
Because the heart creates the electricity that powers the brain and nerves
Because stopping the heart causes blood to cool down and freeze in the veins
Because the heart filters waste from the blood, and stopping would poison the body
explanation: The heart must keep pumping so that blood continuously delivers oxygen and nutrients to all cells of the body.
fact_tl: Bakit kailangang tuloy-tuloy ang pump ng puso? Dahil ang dugo ang naghahatid ng oxygen at sustansya sa bawat bahagi ng katawan. Kapag tumigil ito, hindi makakakain ang mga selula.
fact_bis: Ngano kinahanglan magpadayon ang pagbomba sa kasingkasing? Kay ang dugo maoy naghatod ug oxygen ug sustansya sa matag bahin sa lawas. Kung mohunong kini, walay makaon ang mga selula.

q: What does a Venus flytrap do when a small insect touches its leaves?
options: It snaps its leaves shut to catch and eat the insect
It opens its leaves wider to show the insect the way out
It releases a sweet juice to dissolve the insect without closing
It drops its leaves to the ground and waits for rain
explanation: The Venus flytrap suddenly snaps its leaves shut to catch and eat small insects.
fact_tl: Ang Venus flytrap ay isang halaman na biglang isinasara ang dahon nito para hulihin at kainin ang maliliit na insekto.
fact_bis: Ang Venus flytrap usa ka tanom nga kalit nga mosira sa iyang dahon aron dakpon ug kan-on ang gagmayng insekto.

q: Why does it take more than one monarch butterfly to complete the whole round-trip migration?
options: One monarch butterfly cannot survive long enough to finish the entire journey, so its descendants continue the trip back
Monarch butterflies are too heavy to fly long distances without stopping for a very long time
Only female monarchs migrate one way while males migrate the other way
Monarchs travel in relay teams that take turns flying different sections of the route
explanation: A single monarch cannot finish the whole migration, so its descendants continue the trip back.
fact_tl: Hindi kayang tapusin ng isang monarch ang buong paglipat, kaya ang mga apo nito ang nagpapatuloy ng biyahe pabalik.
fact_bis: Usa ka monarch dili makahuman sa tibuok pagbalhin, busa ang mga kaliwat niini ang mopadayon sa biyahe pabalik.

q: How did sailors find their direction at sea before GPS was invented?
options: They used the positions of stars in the sky as a guide
They followed ocean currents that always flowed toward land
They used the color of the water to tell how deep they were
They counted the waves to estimate how far they had traveled
explanation: Because certain stars stay in fixed places in the sky, sailors used them as a guide for traveling at night long before GPS existed.
fact_tl: Bago pa man ang GPS, ginagamit ng mga mandaragat ang mga bituin para malaman ang kanilang direksyon sa dagat. Dahil pare-pareho ang lugar ng ilang bituin sa kalangitan, nagsisilbi silang gabay sa paglalakbay sa gabi.
fact_bis: Sa wala pa ang GPS, ang mga mananagat naggamit sa mga bituon aron mahibal-an ang ilang direksyon sa dagat. Tungod kay ang pipila ka mga bituon nagpabilin sa samang dapit sa langit, nahimo silang giya sa pagbiyahe sa gabii.

q: What raw material is gasoline made from?
options: Oil (petroleum/crude oil) dug from underground
Coal crushed and treated with high heat
Natural gas captured from underground caves
Seawater processed through special filters
explanation: Gasoline is made from petroleum (crude oil), a fossil fuel extracted from underground.
fact_tl: Ang gasolina ay gawa mula sa langis (petrolyo/crude oil), isang fossil fuel na hinuhukay mula sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_bis: Ang gasolina hinimo gikan sa lana (petrolyo/crude oil), usa ka fossil fuel nga gikalot gikan sa ilawom sa yuta.

q: Why do scientists say that rising greenhouse gases may make Philippine typhoons stronger?
options: Warmer seas provide more energy to fuel bigger storms, so a country like the Philippines gets hit by stronger typhoons and floods
More carbon dioxide in the air makes the wind blow faster over land, pushing typhoons inland sooner
Greenhouse gases block sunlight, which cools the upper atmosphere and speeds up typhoon rotation
Warmer air holds less moisture, so typhoons release rain more suddenly when they reach the Philippines
explanation: As greenhouse gases warm the world, seawater warms too, and that extra heat fuels stronger storms and worse flooding for the typhoon-prone Philippines.
fact_tl: Habang umiinit ang mundo dahil sa greenhouse gas, mas umiinit din ang tubig-dagat na siyang nagpapalakas ng mga bagyo. Dahil madalas tamaan ng bagyo ang Pilipinas, ramdam natin ang epekto nito sa mas malalakas na bagyo at baha.
fact_bis: Samtang nag-init ang kalibotan tungod sa greenhouse gas, nag-init usab ang tubig-dagat nga maoy nagpakusog sa mga bagyo. Tungod kay sagad maigo sa bagyo ang Pilipinas, mabati nato ang epekto niini sa mas kusog nga bagyo ug baha.

q: In which environment do mosquito eggs hatch and the larva and pupa stages take place?
options: In standing water
Inside soil underground
Inside a cocoon on tree bark
Inside rotting fruit on the ground
explanation: Mosquitoes undergo complete metamorphosis and the first three stages — egg, wriggler (larva), and pupa — all happen in water.
fact_tl: Ang lamok ay dumadaan din sa kumpletong metamorphosis — at nangyayari ang unang tatlong yugto sa tubig! Itlog → kiti-kiti (larva na lumalangoy) → pupa → lumilipad na lamok. Kaya mahalagang alisin ang nakaipong tubig sa bahay para maiwasan ang dengue.
fact_bis: Ang lamok moagi usab sa kompleto nga metamorphosis — ug ang unang tulo ka yugto mahitabo sa tubig! Itlog → kiti-kiti (larva nga molangoy) → pupa → naglupad nga lamok. Mao nga importante nga kuhaon ang natipon nga tubig sa balay aron malikayan ang dengue.

q: What two things does a cuttlefish use its rapid skin color changes for?
options: To hide from predators and to signal other cuttlefish
To attract sunlight and to keep its body warm
To warn sharks and to find food in the dark water
To mark territory on rocks and to scare away crabs
explanation: A cuttlefish can change its skin color and pattern in seconds, using this ability both to hide and to signal others.
fact_tl: Ang cuttlefish (kamag-anak ng pusit) ay kayang baguhin ang kulay at padron ng balat nito sa loob lang ng ilang segundo, at ginagamit niya ito para magtago at makipag-usap sa iba.
fact_bis: Ang cuttlefish (paryente sa nokus) makausab sa kolor ug padron sa panit niini sulod lang sa pipila ka segundo, ug gigamit niya kini aron motago ug makigsenyas sa uban.

q: What is urine mostly made of?
options: Water mixed with tiny waste substances removed from the blood
Pure waste chemicals with almost no water in them
Undigested food particles that passed through the intestines
Old blood cells that the kidneys crush and flush out
explanation: Urine is mostly water mixed with small amounts of waste that the body removed from the blood.
fact_tl: Ang ihi ay halos puro tubig na may halong mga dumi na inalis ng katawan mula sa dugo.
fact_bis: Ang ihi halos pulos tubig nga gisagolan sa gagmay nga hugaw nga gikuha sa lawas gikan sa dugo.

q: If you draw a graph of voltage (up-down) against current (left-right) for a conductor that follows Ohm's Law, what shape does the graph make?
options: A straight line that passes through the origin (zero point)
A curved line that rises steeply and then levels off
A zigzag line that goes up and down as current increases
A flat horizontal line showing that voltage never changes
explanation: For an ohmic conductor, the voltage-current graph is a straight line through the origin, and the slope of that line equals the resistance.
fact_tl: Para sa isang ohmic conductor (conductor na sumusunod sa Ohm's Law), ang graph ng boltahe laban sa kuryente ay isang tuwid na guhit na dumadaan sa simula — ang slope ng guhit ay katumbas ng resistensya ng conductor.
fact_bis: Alang sa usa ka ohmic conductor (usa nga nagsunod sa Ohm's Law), ang graph sa boltahe batok sa kuryente usa ka tuwid nga guhit nga moagi sa simula — ang slope sa guhit katumbas sa resistensya sa conductor.

q: What do scientists place in a chemical equation to make sure the number of each kind of atom is the same on both sides?
options: Coefficients (numbers in front of each formula)
Subscripts added inside each chemical formula
Arrows pointing from one atom to another
Brackets placed around each molecule
explanation: A chemical equation is balanced by placing coefficients so that the number of each atom is equal on the reactant side and the product side.
fact_tl: Binabalanse ang isang ekwasyong kemikal sa pamamagitan ng paglalagay ng mga coefficient upang maging magkapareho ang bilang ng bawat atomo sa panig ng reactant at sa panig ng product.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka ekwasyong kemikal gibalanse pinaagi sa pagbutang og mga coefficient aron managsama ang gidaghanon sa matag atomo sa kilid sa reactant ug sa kilid sa product.

q: How do grasses in a grassland survive a long dry season without rain?
options: They have very deep roots that reach water underground
They store water inside thick waxy leaves on the surface
They shed all their leaves and become dormant above ground only
They grow in tight clumps and share water through touching roots
explanation: Grasses in grasslands have very deep roots that reach water deep underground, letting them survive long dry spells.
fact_tl: May malalalim na ugat ang mga damo sa grassland. Nakukuha nila ang tubig sa ilalim ng lupa kaya nakakaligtas sila kahit matagal na walang ulan.
fact_bis: Ang mga sagbot sa grassland adunay lawom kaayo nga gamot. Makakuha sila ug tubig sa ilalom sa yuta, mao nga mabuhi sila bisan dugay nga walay ulan.

q: What instrument does a weather scientist use to measure how fast the wind is blowing?
options: An anemometer
A barometer
A hygrometer
A thermometer
explanation: Wind speed is measured using an instrument called an anemometer.
fact_tl: Ang bilis ng hangin ay sinusukat gamit ang instrumento na tinatawag na anemometer.
fact_bis: Ang kusog sa hangin gisukod gamit ang instrumento nga gitawag og anemometer.

q: Which group of nutrients is called 'macronutrients' because the body needs them in large amounts?
options: Protein, carbohydrates, and fats
Vitamins A, C, and D
Iron, calcium, and zinc
Fiber, water, and antioxidants
explanation: Protein, carbohydrates, and fats are called macronutrients because the body needs them in large amounts.
fact_tl: Tinatawag na macronutrients ang protina, karbohaydrat, at taba dahil kailangan ng katawan ang mga ito sa malaking dami.
fact_bis: Ang protina, karbohaydrat, ug tambok gitawag nga macronutrients tungod kay gikinahanglan kini sa lawas sa daghang gidaghanon.

q: When is the pilandok most active?
options: At night
In the early morning before sunrise
During the hottest part of the afternoon
Right after heavy rain during the day
explanation: The pilandok is more active at night and hides in thick plants during the day.
fact_tl: Ang pilandok ay mas aktibo kapag gabi at nagtatago sa makakapal na halaman kapag araw.
fact_bis: Ang pilandok mas aktibo kon gabii ug magtago sa baga nga mga tanom kon adlaw.

q: In a kulintang set of gongs from Mindanao, which gong produces the lowest pitch?
options: The largest gong, because it vibrates more slowly
The smallest gong, because it is struck the hardest
The middle-sized gong, because it has the most even shape
The oldest gong, because its metal has become thicker over time
explanation: In a kulintang, larger gongs give a lower pitch because they vibrate more slowly.
fact_tl: Ang kulintang ay isang grupo ng maliliit na gong na nagmumula sa Mindanao — ang mas malaking gong ay nagbibigay ng mas mababang pitch dahil nangingisig ito nang mas mabagal.
fact_bis: Ang kulintang usa ka grupo sa gagmayng gong gikan sa Mindanao — ang mas dakong gong nagahatag og mas ubos nga pitch tungod kay nagalingkod kini nga mas hinay.

q: Which set of actions can help lower the amount of carbon dioxide in the air?
options: Planting trees, using solar energy, and saving electricity and fuel
Burning more wood for cooking, and covering landfills with soil
Using more air conditioning so factories produce less heat
Recycling plastic bottles and printing newspapers on recycled paper
explanation: People can lower carbon dioxide in the air by planting trees, using clean energy like solar power, and saving electricity and fuel.
fact_tl: Maaaring mabawasan ng tao ang carbon dioxide sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng pagtatanim ng puno, paggamit ng malinis na enerhiya gaya ng solar, at pagtitipid ng kuryente at gasolina.
fact_bis: Mahimong makunhuran sa tawo ang carbon dioxide sa hangin pinaagi sa pagtanom og kahoy, paggamit og limpyo nga enerhiya sama sa solar, ug pagtipig og kuryente ug gasolina.

q: Which Philippine government agency gives local names to typhoons that enter the country?
options: PAGASA
PHIVOLCS
NAMRIA
DOST-SEI
explanation: PAGASA is the agency that gives the local names to typhoons in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang PAGASA ang ahensiya na nagbibigay ng lokal na pangalan sa mga bagyo sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang PAGASA mao ang ahensiya nga naghatag ug lokal nga ngalan sa mga bagyo sa Pilipinas.

q: Where would you most likely find a centipede hiding?
options: Under a rock or fallen leaves where it is dark and damp
On top of a sunny rock where it can warm itself
High in a tree among dry branches and bark
Floating on the surface of a still pond
explanation: Centipedes live in dark, damp places like under rocks or fallen leaves.
fact_tl: Ang alupihan ay nakatira sa madilim at basang lugar tulad ng ilalim ng bato o tuyong dahon.
fact_bis: Ang alupihan nagpuyo sa ngitngit ug basa nga mga dapit sama sa ilawom sa bato o nangahulog nga dahon.

q: What causes a person to become color blind?
options: One type of cone cell in the retina is missing or does not work properly
The rods in the eye stop sending signals to the brain at night
The lens of the eye bends colored light too much and mixes colors up
The optic nerve is too short to carry all color signals to the brain
explanation: A normal retina has three types of cones for red, green, and blue; when one kind is missing or works poorly, a person becomes color blind.
fact_tl: Ang normal na retina ay may tatlong uri ng cones para sa pula, berde, at asul; kapag kulang o hindi gumagana nang maayos ang isa, nagkakaroon ng color blindness ang tao.
fact_bis: Ang normal nga retina adunay tulo ka matang sa cones alang sa pula, berde, ug asul; kung kulang o dili maayong molihok ang usa, mahimong color blind ang tawo.

q: Who invented the first hot air balloon?
options: The Montgolfier brothers, Joseph and Etienne
The Wright brothers, Orville and Wilbur
Leonardo da Vinci, who drew flying machines in his notebooks
Isaac Newton, who used a balloon to demonstrate his laws of motion
explanation: The Montgolfier brothers (Joseph and Etienne) invented the first hot air balloon.
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Montgolfier (Joseph at Étienne) ang umimbento ng unang hot air balloon.
fact_bis: Ang magsoon nga Montgolfier (Joseph ug Étienne) ang nag-imbento sa unang hot air balloon.

q: In what year was the very first Nobel Prize awarded?
explanation: The first Nobel Prize was awarded in the year 1901.
fact_tl: Unang iginawad ang Nobel Prize noong taong 1901.
fact_bis: Ang unang Nobel Prize gihatag niadtong tuig 1901.

q: Why does stirring salt water make the salt dissolve faster?
options: Stirring spreads the salt out and brings fresh water close to the salt grains
Stirring raises the temperature of the water so the salt melts more quickly
Stirring breaks the salt crystals into smaller pieces before they dissolve
Stirring adds tiny air bubbles that push the salt to the bottom faster
explanation: Stirring helps spread the salt out and brings fresh water close to the salt grains, making it dissolve faster.
fact_tl: Kapag hinahalo o kinukutaw mo ang tubig, mas mabilis matunaw ang asin. Tinutulungan ng paghalo na maikalat ang asin at madala ang sariwang tubig palapit sa mga butil nito.
fact_bis: Kon kutawon o haluon nimo ang tubig, mas paspas matunaw ang asin. Ang pagkutaw motabang sa pagkatag sa asin ug magdala og presko nga tubig duol sa mga lugas niini.

q: How did the invention of radio change the way people received news?
options: News, storm warnings, and music could reach millions of homes at the same time without internet or TV
Written newspapers could be printed and delivered faster to faraway villages
People could talk back to the radio station and share their own stories
Ships at sea could send letters home using radio-powered postal codes
explanation: Radio changed the news because broadcasts could reach millions of homes all at the same time, even without internet or television.
fact_tl: Binago ng radyo ang pagbabalita dahil sabay-sabay nang nakakarating ang balita, babala sa bagyo, at musika sa milyon-milyong tahanan kahit walang internet o telebisyon.
fact_bis: Giusab sa radyo ang pagbalita kay dungan nga makaabot ang balita, pasidaan sa bagyo, ug musika sa minilyon ka panimalay bisan walay internet o telebisyon.

q: In some indigenous communities, why was the kubing traditionally played very close to another person?
options: Because its sound is very soft and can only be heard up close, making it useful for private messages or courtship
Because the vibration of the kubing can only be felt, not heard, unless two people hold it at the same time
Because the kubing needs the warmth of two people's breath to produce any musical sound
Because playing it quietly close-up was a sign of respect that the listener had to acknowledge
explanation: The kubing's soft sound can only be heard up close, so it was used for courtship or quiet messages — like a secret conversation between two people.
fact_tl: Sa ilang katutubong komunidad, ginagamit ang kubing para sa panliligaw o para magpadala ng tahimik na mensahe. Dahil mahina lang ang tunog, malapitan lang ito naririnig — kaya parang lihim na usapan sa pagitan ng dalawang tao. Ito ay magandang halimbawa ng paggamit ng physics ng tunog sa tunay na buhay.
fact_bis: Sa pipila ka lumad nga komunidad, ang kubing gigamit alang sa pangulitawo o aron magpadala og hilom nga mensahe. Tungod kay hinay ra ang tunog, madungog lang kini sa duol — sama sa tinago nga panag-istorya sa duha ka tawo. Nindot kini nga panig-ingnan sa paggamit sa physics sa tunog sa tinuod nga kinabuhi.

q: What happens to some vitamins in vegetables if you cook them for too long?
options: Vitamins like vitamin C can be destroyed, so light cooking keeps more nutrients in the food
The vitamins become stronger and more concentrated, so the food becomes healthier
The vitamins turn into minerals, which are even better for the body
The vitamins move from the vegetable into the cooking water and then evaporate as steam
explanation: Overcooking vegetables can destroy vitamins like vitamin C, so light cooking is better for keeping nutrients.
fact_tl: Ang sobrang pagluluto ng gulay ay maaaring mag-alis ng ilang bitamina gaya ng bitamina C, kaya mas mainam ang bahagyang luto lang.
fact_bis: Ang sobra nga pagluto sa utanon mahimong mokuha sa ubang bitamina sama sa bitamina C, busa mas maayo ang gaan lang nga pagluto.

q: How long do astronauts typically live on the International Space Station before a new crew replaces them?
options: Several months
About one week
About two years
Just a few days
explanation: Astronauts usually live on the ISS for several months before a new crew arrives by rocket to replace them.
fact_tl: Karaniwang nakatira ang mga astronaut sa ISS nang ilang buwan bago sila palitan ng bagong grupo na sumasakay sa rocket.
fact_bis: Ang mga astronaut kasagaran magpuyo sa ISS sulod sa pipila ka bulan sa dili pa moabot ang bag-ong grupo pinaagi sa rocket aron mopuli kanila.

q: What is the role of the hard, dark wood at the very center of a tree trunk?
options: It gives the whole tree strength and support, even though it is dead wood
It carries water and minerals from the roots up to the leaves
It stores sugar made by the leaves for the tree to use in dry season
It produces new growth rings every year as the tree gets older
explanation: The old, hard heartwood in the center of a tree is dead but gives the whole tree its strength and support.
fact_tl: Ang luma at matigas na kahoy sa gitna ng puno ay patay na pero ito ang nagbibigay ng lakas at suporta sa buong puno.
fact_bis: Ang daan ug gahi nga kahoy sa sentro sa puno patay na apan kini ang naghatag ug kusog ug suporta sa tibuok kahoy.

q: Why can termites hollow out a piece of wood so quickly?
options: Thousands of termites from one colony eat together at the same time, led by a queen
A single large termite uses very strong jaws that can cut wood faster than a saw
Termites inject a liquid that softens the wood before they bite through it
Termites work in non-stop shifts where one group rests while the other chews
explanation: A whole colony of thousands of termites led by a queen eat together, which is why they can hollow out wood so quickly.
fact_tl: Ang isang piraso ng hungkag na kahoy ay hindi gawa ng iisang anay. Libo-libong anay mula sa isang kolonya na pinamumunuan ng reyna ang sabay-sabay na kumakain, kaya napakabilis nilang ubusin ang loob.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka piraso sa hawan nga kahoy dili buhat sa usa lang ka anay. Liboan ka anay gikan sa usa ka kolonya nga gipangulohan sa reyna ang dungan nga mokaon, mao nga paspas nilang maubos ang sulod.

q: What do diving beetle larvae (called water tigers) eat in ponds and streams?
options: Tadpoles and small fish
Fallen leaves and algae on rocks
Tiny water plants floating near the surface
Dead insects that fall into the water
explanation: Diving beetle larvae, called water tigers, are fierce predators that hunt tadpoles and small fish in ponds and streams.
fact_tl: Ang larva ng diving beetle (tinatawag na water tiger) ay isang malupit na mandarambong na kumakain ng mga tadpole at maliliit na isda sa lawa at ilog.
fact_bis: Ang larva sa diving beetle (gitawag og water tiger) usa ka malupitong manunukob nga nagdakop sa mga tadpole ug gamay nga isda sa mga lawa ug sapa.

q: How does acid rain form?
options: Gases from factory and vehicle smoke mix with rainwater and make it slightly acidic
Rain passes through the ozone layer in the upper atmosphere that makes it sour
Seawater spray mixes with clouds and adds salt that reacts with water to form acid
Warm air from cities heats raindrops and causes a chemical change that creates acid
explanation: When certain gases from factory and vehicle smoke mix with rain, it becomes acid rain — slightly sour rain that can damage trees, lakes, and stone.
fact_tl: Kapag humalo sa ulan ang ilang gas mula sa usok ng pabrika at sasakyan, nagiging "acid rain" ito — bahagyang maasim na ulan na makakasira ng mga puno, lawa, at maging mga bato at rebulto.
fact_bis: Kon ang pipila ka gas gikan sa aso sa pabrika ug sakyanan masagol sa ulan, mahimo kining "acid rain" — gamay nga aslom nga ulan nga makadaot sa mga kahoy, lanaw, ug bisan sa mga bato ug estatwa.

q: Who wrote the famous 1665 book Micrographia, filled with detailed drawings of objects seen under a microscope?
options: Robert Hooke
Anton van Leeuwenhoek
Galileo Galilei
Isaac Newton
explanation: Robert Hooke wrote Micrographia (1665), which contained detailed drawings of things seen under a microscope.
fact_tl: Si Robert Hooke ang sumulat ng aklat na Micrographia (1665), na may mga detalyadong guhit ng mga bagay na nakita sa mikroskopyo.
fact_bis: Si Robert Hooke mao ang nagsulat sa libro nga Micrographia (1665), nga puno sa detalyadong mga drowing sa mga butang nga nakita sa mikroskopyo.

q: How many bones does an adult human body have?
explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.
fact_tl: Ang isang matanda (adult) ay may 206 na buto.
fact_bis: Ang usa ka hamtong nga tawo adunay 206 ka bukog.

q: When you look through a concave lens, how does the image appear compared to the real object?
options: Smaller and right-side up (never flipped upside down)
Larger and right-side up, like a magnifying glass
Upside down and the same size as the object
Upside down and much larger than the real object
explanation: Looking through a concave lens, the image is always smaller and right-side up — it never flips upside down.
fact_tl: Sa pamamagitan ng concave lens, ang nakikita mong larawan ay laging mas maliit at nakatayo nang tama. Hindi ito nagbabaligtad gaya ng ibang lente.
fact_bis: Pinaagi sa concave lens, ang imahe nga imong makita kanunay mas gamay ug tul-id. Dili kini mobaliktad sama sa ubang lente.

q: Why does sound travel faster through a solid than through air?
options: Particles in a solid are packed closely together and pass vibrations easily from one to the next
Solids are heavier, so the vibrations have more force to push them through quickly
Sound waves in solids get longer and longer, which makes them travel farther and faster
Solids reflect sound back and forth inside them, which adds up to a faster overall speed
explanation: Sound is faster in solids because their particles are packed closely together and pass vibrations easily.
fact_tl: Mas mabilis ang tunog sa solido dahil magkakadikit ang mga maliliit na bahagi nito at madaling maipasa ang yanig.
fact_bis: Mas paspas ang tingog sa gahi tungod kay nagkaduol ang gagmay nga bahin niini ug sayon ipasa ang pag-uyog.

q: How does the tabon bird keep its buried eggs at the right temperature?
options: It adds or removes sand from the mound to control the heat inside
It sits on top of the mound and spreads its feathers to block the sun
It digs a water channel around the mound to cool it down when too hot
It calls other tabon birds who fan the mound with their wings
explanation: The tabon adds or removes sand from the mound to control the heat and keep conditions just right for the eggs.
fact_tl: Nagdaragdag o nag-aalis ng buhangin ang tabon sa bunton para kontrolin ang init at mapanatili itong tama para sa itlog.
fact_bis: Ang tabon magdugang o magkuha og balas gikan sa tambak aron makontrol ang kainit ug mapadayon kini nga husto alang sa itlog.

q: How does garlic's strong smell help the plant survive?
options: It keeps away some pests and animals that might eat the plant
It attracts pollinators that carry pollen from flower to flower
It signals to nearby garlic plants that rain is coming soon
It makes the soil around the plant more acidic so weeds cannot grow
explanation: Garlic's strong smell helps protect the plant from some pests and animals that might eat it.
fact_tl: Ang malakas na amoy ng bawang ay tumutulong sa halaman na makaiwas sa ilang peste at hayop na kakain dito.
fact_bis: Ang kusog nga baho sa ahos makatabang panalipod sa tanom batok sa pipila ka peste ug mananap nga mokaon niini.

q: What is the tallest waterfall in the world, and in which country is it found?
options: Angel Falls in Venezuela
Niagara Falls in Canada
Victoria Falls in Zimbabwe
Iguazu Falls in Argentina
explanation: The tallest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls, located in Venezuela.
fact_tl: Ang pinakamataas na talon sa mundo ay ang Angel Falls sa Venezuela.
fact_bis: Ang labing taas nga busay sa kalibutan mao ang Angel Falls sa Venezuela.

q: How does a pig search for food in the soil?
options: It uses its tough snout to dig in the ground
It scratches the soil with its front hooves until food appears
It sniffs and licks the surface of the soil without digging
It uses its tail to push the soil aside and expose buried food
explanation: A pig uses its tough snout to dig in the soil and search for food.
fact_tl: Ginagamit ng baboy ang matigas nitong nguso para humukay sa lupa at maghanap ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Gamiton sa baboy ang gahi niyang ilong sa paghukay sa yuta aron mangita og pagkaon.

q: What sign can appear inside the mouth BEFORE the skin rash of measles shows up?
options: Tiny white spots on the inside of the mouth
A red swollen tongue that feels very sore
Dark brown patches on the gums and lips
Blisters on the roof of the mouth filled with clear fluid
explanation: Before the skin rash appears, measles often leaves tiny white spots inside the mouth.
fact_tl: Bago lumabas ang pantal sa balat, ang tigdas ay madalas mag-iwan ng maliliit na puting batik sa loob ng bibig.
fact_bis: Sa dili pa motungha ang pantal sa panit, ang tipdas kasagaran magbilin og gagmay nga puti nga batik sa sulod sa baba.

q: An object will float in water if its density is ___.
options: Less than 1 g/mL
Greater than 1 g/mL
Exactly equal to 1 g/mL
Greater than 10 g/mL
explanation: An object floats in water if its density is less than 1 g/mL, and sinks if its density is greater than 1 g/mL.
fact_tl: Lumulutang sa tubig ang bagay na mas mababa ang densidad sa 1 g/mL, at lumulubog kung mas mataas.
fact_bis: Molutaw sa tubig ang butang nga mas ubos ang density sa 1 g/mL, ug molunod kon mas taas.

q: What gas do animals and plants release into the air during cellular respiration?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen
Nitrogen
Water vapor
explanation: When animals and plants carry out cellular respiration, they break down sugar for energy and release carbon dioxide back into the air.
fact_tl: Kapag huminga ang mga hayop at halaman (cellular respiration), sinusunog nila ang sugar para sa enerhiya at ibinubuga ang carbon dioxide pabalik sa hangin.
fact_bis: Kung moginhawa ang mga hayop ug tanom (cellular respiration), ilang gisunog ang sugar alang sa enerhiya ug gibuga ang carbon dioxide balik sa hangin.

q: Who was the first person to fly faster than the speed of sound, breaking the sound barrier?
options: Chuck Yeager
Charles Lindbergh
Amelia Earhart
Neil Armstrong
explanation: Chuck Yeager was the first person to break the sound barrier, flying faster than the speed of sound.
fact_tl: Si Chuck Yeager ang unang taong sumira sa sound barrier, lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog.
fact_bis: Si Chuck Yeager ang unang tawo nga nakabuak sa sound barrier, milupad nga mas tulin pa sa tingog.

q: In a saltwater solution, what is the salt called and what is the water called?
options: The salt is the solute and the water is the solvent
The salt is the solvent and the water is the solute
Both the salt and water are called solvents
Both the salt and water are called solutes
explanation: In a solution, the dissolved substance is the solute (salt) and the substance that does the dissolving is the solvent (water).
fact_tl: Ang solusyon ay isang mixture kung saan ang natutunaw na sangkap (solute) ay nahahalo nang buo sa pumapatunaw (solvent), gaya ng asin sa tubig.
fact_bis: Ang solution usa ka mixture diin ang natunaw nga sangkap (solute) hingpit nga nagsagol sa tigtunaw (solvent), sama sa asin sa tubig.

q: Which layer of the Earth is the thickest?
options: The mantle
The crust
The inner core
The outer core
explanation: The mantle is the thickest layer of Earth, found between the crust and the core.
fact_tl: Ang mantle ang pinakamakapal na layer ng Mundo, na nasa pagitan ng crust at core.
fact_bis: Ang mantle mao ang pinakabaga nga layer sa Kalibutan, nga anaa sa tunga sa crust ug core.

q: Why should raw meat be kept separate from cooked food in the kitchen?
options: So that bacteria from the raw meat do not spread to the cooked food
So that the heat from the cooked food does not re-cook the raw meat
So that the juices of the raw meat do not change the flavor of the other food
So that insects are not attracted to both kinds of food at the same time
explanation: Keeping raw meat separate from cooked food prevents bacteria from spreading.
fact_tl: Dapat ihiwalay ang hilaw na karne sa lutong pagkain para hindi kumalat ang bakterya.
fact_bis: Kinahanglan bulagon ang hilaw nga karne gikan sa luto nga pagkaon aron dili mokatap ang bakterya.

q: Why do some Philippine beaches near Mayon Volcano in Albay have black sand?
options: The sand is made of tiny pieces of dark volcanic rock like basalt that were broken down by waves
The sand is colored black by oil and tar that flow out from underground cracks near the volcano
The black color comes from the charred remains of plants that burned during past eruptions
Dark seaweed grew on white sand for thousands of years, staining it permanently black
explanation: Black sand on some Philippine beaches is made of tiny pieces of basalt and other dark volcanic rocks broken down by waves.
fact_tl: Ang ilang mga dalampasigan ng Pilipinas (tulad ng mga malapit sa Mayon sa Albay) ay may itim na buhangin na nagmumula sa maliit na piraso ng basalt at iba pang madilim na volcanic rocks na nasira ng alon; ang kumplikadong mga mineral ng volcanic rock ay nagbibigay ng natatanging itim na kulay sa buhangin.
fact_bis: Ang pipila ka mga baybayon sa Pilipinas (sama sa mga duol sa Mayon sa Albay) adunay itom nga buhangin nga gihimo sa gagmay nga mga piraso sa basalt ug ubang ngitngit nga volcanic rocks nga gibali sa mga balod; ang ngitngit nga mga mineral sa volcanic rock naghatag sa buhangin sa natatangi niining itom nga kolor.

q: Why do farmers often plant ipil-ipil trees near their homes?
options: Because it grows very fast and can be used as firewood
Because its roots prevent all types of insects from entering the soil
Because it produces large fruit that can feed a whole family
Because its wide leaves provide the most shade of any tree in the Philippines
explanation: The ipil-ipil is a fast-growing tree that is often planted to be used as firewood.
fact_tl: Ang ipil-ipil ay isang mabilis tumubong puno na madalas itanim para gawing panggatong o gatong.
fact_bis: Ang ipil-ipil usa ka paspas motubo nga kahoy nga sagad itanom aron himuong sugnod o panggatong.

q: When firewood burns in a clay stove (kalan), what new things are produced?
options: Ash, smoke, and heat
Water, steam, and light only
Charcoal, oil, and cold air
Dust, gas, and ice crystals
explanation: In a clay stove, firewood burns and changes into ash, smoke, and heat that is used for cooking.
fact_tl: Sa kalan na luwad, ang panggatong na kahoy ay nasusunog at nagiging abo, usok, at init na ginagamit sa pagluluto.
fact_bis: Sa kalan nga luwad, ang sugnod nga kahoy masunog ug mahimong abo, aso, ug kainit nga gamiton sa pagluto.

q: How many legs does a tardigrade have, and what feature at the end of most legs helps it hold on to surfaces?
options: Eight stubby legs, most ending in tiny claws that grip moss or sand
Six jointed legs with sticky pads that cling to smooth surfaces
Four short legs and four long legs used for swimming and gripping
Ten legs, five on each side, each tipped with a small suction cup
explanation: A tardigrade has eight stubby legs, and most end in tiny claws that let it grip moss or grains of sand.
fact_tl: May walong maiikling paa ang tardigrade, at karamihan ay may maliliit na kuko sa dulo para makakapit sa lumot o butil ng buhangin. Mabagal silang gumapang, kaya nga tinawag silang 'water bear' o oso sa tubig dahil parang oso kung kumilos.
fact_bis: Ang tardigrade adunay walo ka mubo nga tiil, ug kasagaran adunay gagmay nga kuko sa tumoy aron makakapyot sa lumot o lugas sa balas. Hinay kini mokamang, mao nga gitawag kini ug 'water bear' o oso sa tubig kay murag oso kon molihok.

q: Which nutrient found in fish like galunggong, sardines, and tuna is especially important for brain development in children?
options: Omega-3 fatty acids (DHA and EPA)
Vitamin C and iron
Calcium and phosphorus
Omega-6 fatty acids and fiber
explanation: Filipino fish like galunggong, sardines, and tuna are rich in omega-3 fatty acids (DHA and EPA) that support brain development and memory in children.
fact_tl: Ang mga Pilipinong isda tulad ng galunggong, sardinas, at tuna ay mayaman sa omega-3 fatty acids (DHA at EPA) na mahalaga para sa pag-unlad ng utak at memorya ng mga bata.
fact_bis: Ang mga isda sa Pilipino sama sa galunggong, sardinas, ug tuna dato sa omega-3 fatty acids (DHA ug EPA) nga importante alang sa pag-uswag sa utak ug memorya sa mga bata.

q: How does a drum make sound when you hit it?
options: Its stretched skin vibrates and pushes the air to create sound
Air trapped inside the drum bounces out through the rim
The hard shell of the drum shakes the ground beneath it
The drumstick releases a stored sound when it strikes
explanation: When a drum is struck, its stretched skin vibrates rapidly and pushes the air, creating the sound we hear.
fact_tl: Kapag pinukpok ang tambol, nayayanig ang nakaunat nitong balat pataas-pababa nang napakabilis, at ang yanig na ito ang nagtutulak sa hangin para lumikha ng tunog.
fact_bis: Kon bunalan ang tambol, ang gibutang nga panit niini magkurog pataas-paubos ug paspas kaayo, ug kining pagkurog mao ang motuklod sa hangin aron makahimo ug tingog.

q: How does regular exercise help keep blood sugar levels lower?
options: Muscles use up blood sugar during movement even with little insulin
Exercise causes the pancreas to release more insulin immediately
Physical activity destroys sugar in the bloodstream directly
Moving speeds up digestion so less sugar enters the blood
explanation: When you move or exercise, your muscles use up blood sugar even with little insulin, which helps keep blood sugar low.
fact_tl: Kapag gumagalaw o nag-eehersisyo, ginagamit ng mga kalamnan ang asukal sa dugo kahit kaunti lang ang insulin, kaya ang regular na paglalaro at paggalaw ay nakakatulong na panatilihing mababa ang asukal.
fact_bis: Kung molihok o mag-ehersisyo, gamiton sa mga kaunoran ang asukal sa dugo bisan gamay ra ang insulin, mao nga ang regular nga pagdula ug paglihok makatabang nga magpabilin ubos ang asukal.

q: Why is nitrogen gas (N2) very hard to break apart?
options: It has a triple bond where three pairs of electrons are shared between atoms
It is an extremely heavy molecule that requires a lot of force
Its atoms are sealed inside a tough shell of protons
It only exists as a solid and does not react with anything
explanation: Nitrogen gas has a triple bond in which three pairs of electrons are shared, making it very strong and hard to break.
fact_tl: Ang nitrogen gas (N₂) ay may triple bond kung saan tatlong pares ng elektron ang pinaghahatian, kaya napakatibay at mahirap putulin nito.
fact_bis: Ang nitrogen gas (N₂) adunay triple bond diin tulo ka pares sa elektron ang gibahin, mao nga lig-on kaayo ug lisod bugtoon.

q: Why does a person's hair turn white or gray as they grow old?
options: Melanin decreases so the hair loses its color
Hair strands fill with air bubbles making them look lighter
The scalp stops making oils that keep hair dark
Old hair grows backward from the follicle with less pigment
explanation: As a person grows old, melanin decreases, so the hair turns white or gray.
fact_tl: Kapag tumatanda ang tao, nababawasan ang melanin kaya nagiging puti o kulay-abo ang buhok.
fact_bis: Kung magkatigulang ang tawo, mokunhod ang melanin mao nga ang buhok mahimong puti o abuhon.

q: According to PHIVOLCS, approximately how many active volcanoes does the Philippines have?
explanation: According to PHIVOLCS, there are about 24 active volcanoes in the Philippines, including Mayon, Taal, and Pinatubo.
fact_tl: Ayon sa PHIVOLCS, may humigit-kumulang dalawampu't apat (24) na aktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas, kabilang ang Mayon, Taal, at Pinatubo.
fact_bis: Sumala sa PHIVOLCS, adunay mga baynte-kuwatro (24) ka aktibo nga bulkan sa Pilipinas, lakip ang Mayon, Taal, ug Pinatubo.

q: Why do many rainforest animals have colors or shapes that match leaves and branches?
options: To hide from predators or to sneak up on their prey without being seen
To absorb more sunlight and stay warm in the dense forest
To warn other animals that they are poisonous
To attract mates by blending into colorful flowers
explanation: Many rainforest animals use camouflage — colors or shapes matching leaves or branches — so predators or prey cannot easily see them.
fact_tl: Maraming hayop sa rainforest ang gumagamit ng camouflage — pagkukubli sa pamamagitan ng kulay o hugis na katulad ng dahon o sanga — para hindi sila makita ng mga mandaragit o ng kanilang biktima.
fact_bis: Daghang hayop sa rainforest mogamit og camouflage — pagtago pinaagi sa kolor o porma nga sama sa dahon o sanga — aron dili sila makita sa mga manunukob o sa ilang biktima.

q: At what temperature are the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales equal to the same number?
options: -40 degrees
0 degrees
100 degrees
32 degrees
explanation: At -40 degrees, Celsius and Fahrenheit are equal: -40 degrees C is the same as -40 degrees F.
fact_tl: Sa -40 degrees, magkapareho ang Celsius at Fahrenheit: ang -40°C ay katumbas ng -40°F.
fact_bis: Sa -40 degrees, managsama ang Celsius ug Fahrenheit: ang -40°C parehas sa -40°F.

q: How heavy can the flower of Rafflesia arnoldii get?
options: Up to 10 kilograms
Up to 1 kilogram
Up to 50 kilograms
Up to 100 grams
explanation: The flower of Rafflesia arnoldii can weigh up to 10 kilograms, making it one of the heaviest flowers in the world.
fact_tl: Ang bulaklak ng Rafflesia arnoldii ay maaaring tumimbang nang hanggang 10 kilo.
fact_bis: Ang bulak sa Rafflesia arnoldii makatimbang og hangtod 10 ka kilo.

q: Why are rats often found near garbage and food storage areas?
options: Because rats eat almost anything, so they go wherever food scraps are
Because rats need warm shelter that garbage piles provide
Because rats are afraid of open spaces and hide in trash
Because rats only eat rotting plant material found in garbage
explanation: Rats eat almost anything, so they are often found in garbage and food storage areas where many types of food are available.
fact_tl: Halos lahat ay kinakain ng daga, kaya madalas silang nasa mga basura at imbakan ng pagkain.
fact_bis: Halos tanan kan-on sa ilaga, mao nga kasagaran sila makita sa basura ug tipiganan sa pagkaon.

q: How can catfish survive in shallow or muddy water during the dry season when oxygen is low?
options: It can breathe air, so it does not rely only on oxygen in the water
It goes into a deep sleep and needs no oxygen at all
It grows extra gills to filter oxygen from mud
It migrates underground where water stays cool and deep
explanation: Because the catfish can breathe air, it can survive in shallow or muddy water even during the dry season.
fact_tl: Dahil marunong itong huminga ng hangin, ang hito ay nakakaligtas sa mababaw o maputik na tubig kahit panahon ng tagtuyot.
fact_bis: Tungod kay makahimo kini og ginhawa sa hangin, ang hito mabuhi sa mabaw o lapok nga tubig bisan sa panahon sa ting-init.

q: How many flood warning levels does PAGASA use to guide people about evacuation?
options: Three levels: yellow, orange, and red
Two levels: green and red
Four levels: green, yellow, orange, and red
Five levels numbered 1 through 5
explanation: PAGASA issues three flood warning levels — yellow, orange, and red — to guide people and officials on where and when evacuation is needed.
fact_tl: Nagbibigay ang PAGASA ng tatlong antas ng babala sa baha — dilaw, kahel, at pula — upang gabayan ang mga tao at opisyal kung saan at kailan kailangan ang paglikas.
fact_bis: Naghatag ang PAGASA og tulo ka antas sa babala sa baha — dalag, kahel, ug pula — aron giyahan ang mga tawo ug opisyal kung diin ug kanus-a kinahanglan ang paglikas.

q: Why do farmers give vaccines to their pigs?
options: So the pigs do not get sick
To make the pigs grow bigger and faster
To improve the taste and quality of pork
To calm the pigs and make them easier to handle
explanation: Farmers give pigs vaccines and care so the animals do not get sick.
fact_tl: Binibigyan ng bakuna at ginagamot ang baboy upang hindi ito magkasakit sa pinapalaki ng mga magsasaka.
fact_bis: Ginahatagan ug bakuna ug ginaatiman sa mga mag-uuma ang baboy aron dili kini magsakit.

q: What does evolution mean in science?
options: The slow change of species over many generations, with living things descending from earlier different-looking species
The sudden transformation of one species into a completely new one within a single lifetime
The way individual animals change their bodies to survive in their environment
The process of crossbreeding two species to create a new hybrid species
explanation: Evolution is the slow change of species over very many generations; today's living things descended from earlier species that looked somewhat different.
fact_tl: Ang evolution ay ang mabagal na pagbabago ng mga species sa napakaraming henerasyon; ang ibig sabihin nito, ang mga buhay na bagay ngayon ay nanggaling sa mga naunang species na medyo iba ang anyo.
fact_bis: Ang evolution mao ang hinay nga pag-usab sa mga species sa daghan kaayong kaliwatan; ang buot ipasabot, ang mga buhi nga butang karon naggikan sa naunang mga species nga medyo lahi ang panagway.

q: How do small echolocating bats help Philippine farmers each night?
options: They catch thousands of pest insects and mosquitoes that damage crops or spread disease
They pollinate crop flowers by flying from plant to plant at night
They scare away larger animals like rats and birds that eat the harvest
They dig burrows that aerate the soil and help crops grow better
explanation: Each night, echolocating bats catch thousands of pest insects and mosquitoes that damage crops or spread disease, helping Philippine farms for free.
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na paniking gumagamit ng echolocation ay kaibigan ng magsasaka! Tuwing gabi, gamit ang tunog, nakahuhuli sila ng libu-libong insektong peste at lamok na sumisira sa pananim o nagdadala ng sakit. Sa ganitong paraan, natutulungan ng paniki ang mga taniman sa Pilipinas nang libre.
fact_bis: Ang gagmayng kabog nga mogamit og echolocation higala sa mag-uuma! Matag gabii, gamit ang tingog, makadakop silag liboan ka langaw nga peste ug namok nga modaot sa tanom o magdala og sakit. Niini nga paagi, ang kabog motabang sa mga uma sa Pilipinas nga walay bayad.

q: What is the normal resting pulse rate for an adult?
options: 60 to 100 beats per minute
30 to 50 beats per minute
120 to 160 beats per minute
100 to 140 beats per minute
explanation: A normal resting pulse for an adult is 60 to 100 beats per minute (bpm).
fact_tl: Ang normal na resting pulse ng isang nasa hustong gulang ay 60 hanggang 100 tibok kada minuto (bpm).
fact_bis: Ang normal nga resting pulse sa hamtong kay 60 hangtod 100 ka pitik kada minuto (bpm).

q: What harmful gas do geothermal plants release, and what does it smell like?
options: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S), which smells like rotten eggs
Carbon monoxide (CO), which has no smell at all
Sulfur dioxide (SO2), which smells like burning matches
Methane (CH4), which smells like natural gas
explanation: Although geothermal energy is cleaner than fossil fuels, geothermal plants release small amounts of hydrogen sulfide (H2S), a gas with a rotten egg smell, which modern plants capture and neutralize.
fact_tl: Kahit malinis ang geothermal energy kumpara sa fossil fuels, ang mga geothermal plant ay naglalabas ng maliit na halaga ng hydrogen sulfide (H2S) — isang gas na may amoy ng nabubulok na itlog; ang mga modernong geothermal plant ay may mga sistema para mahuli at matuyo ang mga emissions na ito.
fact_bis: Bisan malinis ang geothermal energy kumpara sa fossil fuels, ang mga geothermal plant nagpagawas og gamay nga kantidad sa hydrogen sulfide (H2S) — usa ka gas nga adunay amoy sa nabubulok nga itlog; ang modernong mga geothermal plant adunay mga sistema sa pagdakop ug pag-neutralize sa kining mga emission.

q: Who discovered the process of making strong, heat-treated vulcanized rubber?
options: Charles Goodyear
Thomas Edison
Louis Pasteur
Alexander Fleming
explanation: Strong, heat-treated rubber (vulcanized rubber) was discovered by Charles Goodyear.
fact_tl: Ang matibay na goma (vulcanized rubber) ay natuklasan ni Charles Goodyear.
fact_bis: Ang lig-on nga goma (vulcanized rubber) nadiskobre ni Charles Goodyear.

q: About how long is a mouse pregnant before giving birth?
options: About 20 days
About 3 months
About 9 months
About 60 days
explanation: A mouse is pregnant for only about 20 days, one of the shortest pregnancies of any mammal.
fact_tl: Ang daga ay nagbubuntis nang halos 20 araw lamang, isa sa pinakamaikling pagbubuntis.
fact_bis: Ang ilaga mabdos ug mga 20 ka adlaw lang, usa sa pinakamubo nga pagmabdos.

q: Why does rubbing soap create a thick foam or lather?
options: Soap molecules surround tiny pockets of air inside thin films of water, forming bubbles
Soap contains tiny air capsules that pop open when squeezed by friction
Hot water vapor is trapped between soap layers when hands are rubbed together
Soap reacts with skin oils to release a foaming gas
explanation: Soap bubbles form when its molecules surround tiny pockets of air inside thin films of water, which is why rubbing soap creates a thick foam or lather.
fact_tl: Ang bula ng sabon ay nabubuo kapag binabalot ng mga molekula nito ang maliliit na bag ng hangin sa loob ng manipis na balat ng tubig. Kaya kapag kinusot mo ang sabon, lumalabas ang makapal na bula o lather.
fact_bis: Ang bula sa sabon mahimo kung putson sa mga molekula niini ang gagmay nga bag sa hangin sulod sa nipis nga panit sa tubig. Mao nga kung kuso-kusoon nimo ang sabon, mogawas ang baga nga bula o lather.

q: Where are the male flowers on a corn plant, and what do they release?
options: At the top in the tassel; they release pollen
At the base in the roots; they release seeds
Along the stalk in the husks; they release sap
On the leaves as tiny buds; they release spores
explanation: Corn has imperfect flowers — the tassel at the top contains male flowers that release pollen, while the silk near the ear contains female flowers.
fact_tl: Ang mais ay may imperfect flowers—ang tassel sa tuktok ay mga lalaking bulaklak na naggugulong ng pollen, habang ang silk sa baba ay mga babaeng bulaklak.
fact_bis: Ang mais adunay imperfect flowers—ang tassel sa ibabaw adunay lalaki nga bulaklak nga nagpagawas og pollen, samtang ang silk mao ang babaye nga bulaklak.

q: What happens when you take extra water-soluble vitamins beyond what your body needs?
options: They are flushed out in urine and give you no extra energy or strength
They are stored in your muscles and make you stronger over time
They build up in your blood and slowly improve your immune system
They convert into extra calories that give you more energy
explanation: Extra water-soluble vitamins are simply flushed out by the body in urine; you do not become stronger or more energetic from taking extra vitamins.
fact_tl: Kung uminom ka ng sobrang bitamina, hindi ka magiging mas malakas o mas masigla. Ang sobrang bitamina na natutunaw sa tubig ay basta na lang inilalabas ng katawan sa ihi. Wala kang dagdag na enerhiya doon.
fact_bis: Kung mag-inom ka og sobra nga bitamina, dili ka mahimong mas kusgan o mas baskog. Ang sobra nga bitamina nga matunaw sa tubig basta lang ipagawas sa lawas pinaagi sa ihi. Wala kay dugang nga kusog gikan niini.

q: Who are most at risk during extreme heat events in the Philippines?
options: Students, outdoor workers, and the elderly
Only young children under age 5
Only people who already have heart disease
Athletes and people who exercise regularly
explanation: During extreme heat events, PAGASA issues health advisories because students, outdoor workers, and the elderly are most at risk from heat exhaustion and heatstroke.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng matinding init (heat wave) sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA ay naglalabas ng health advisories; ang mga estudyante, manggagawa sa labas, at matatanda ay pinaka-nanganganib sa heat exhaustion at heatstroke.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa grabe nga init (heat wave) sa Pilipinas, ang PAGASA nagpagawas sa mga health advisory; ang mga estudyante, trabahante sa gawas, ug mga tigulang ang labing naa sa peligro sa heat exhaustion ug heatstroke.

q: What makes an animal an apex predator?
options: It sits at the very top of the food chain with no other animal hunting it
It is the largest animal in its ecosystem
It eats both plants and animals so nothing can out-compete it
It lives alone and defends the largest territory
explanation: An apex predator sits at the very top of the food chain with no other animal hunting it, like the Philippine Eagle in our forests.
fact_tl: Ang apex predator ay ang nasa pinakatuktok ng food chain na walang ibang hayop na kumakain dito, tulad ng Philippine Eagle sa ating kagubatan.
fact_bis: Ang apex predator anaa sa kinatas-ang bahin sa food chain nga walay laing mananap nga mokaon niini, sama sa Philippine Eagle sa atong kalasangan.

q: What do scientists believe about the deep waters around the Philippines?
options: Many undiscovered species live there because the deep Philippine Sea has not been fully studied
All species in Philippine waters have already been discovered and named
The deep Philippine Sea is too cold for any large animals to survive
Only bacteria and microscopic life can exist in the deep Philippine Sea
explanation: The deep parts of the Philippine Sea are not yet fully studied; scientists believe many undiscovered species live in the deep waters around the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang malalim na bahagi ng Karagatang Pilipino ay hindi pa ganap na pinag-aralan; naniniwala ang mga siyentipiko na may maraming hindi pa natutuklasang uri ng hayop sa malalim na dagat ng Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang malalum nga bahin sa Dagat Pilipino wala pa hingpit nga gipag-aralan; nagtuo ang mga siyentipiko nga adunay daghang wala pa nadiskobrehan nga species sa malalum nga tubig sa palibot sa Pilipinas.

q: What happens to the temperature of boiling water if you add even more heat?
options: It stays at 100 degrees Celsius while water is still boiling
It rises quickly above 100 degrees Celsius
It drops slightly because added heat makes bubbles that cool the water
It fluctuates between 95 and 110 degrees Celsius
explanation: While water is boiling, it stays at 100 degrees Celsius even if more heat is added.
fact_tl: Habang kumukulo ang tubig, nananatili ito sa 100 degrees Celsius kahit dagdagan pa ang init.
fact_bis: Samtang nagbukal ang tubig, kini magpabilin sa 100 ka degrees Celsius bisan dugangan pa ang init.

q: What can happen when too many children in a community are not vaccinated against measles?
options: Measles can come back and spread again, even where it had become rare
Measles mutates into a harmless form when fewer people carry it
Children develop natural immunity to measles without needing the vaccine
Only the unvaccinated children get sick; vaccinated children are always safe
explanation: When many children are not vaccinated, measles can come back and spread again even where it had become rare, showing why continued vaccination is important.
fact_tl: Kapag maraming bata ang hindi nabakunahan, maaaring bumalik at kumalat muli ang tigdas, kahit bihira na ito dati. Ipinapakita nito na mahalagang tuloy-tuloy ang pagpapabakuna para hindi muling lumaganap ang sakit.
fact_bis: Kung daghang bata ang dili mabakunahan, mahimong mobalik ug mokatap pag-usab ang tigdas, bisan diin kini nahimong talagsaon na. Gipakita niini nga importante nga padayonon ang pagpabakuna aron dili na usab mokatap ang sakit.

q: Which human activities damage coral reefs?
options: Pollution, harmful fishing practices, and warming seawater
Building lighthouses and shipping ports near coastlines
Scuba diving for scientific research and photography
Planting mangrove trees along the shoreline
explanation: Reefs are damaged by pollution, harmful fishing, and warming seawater caused by human activities.
fact_tl: Nasisira ang mga bahura dahil sa polusyon, maling pangingisda, at pag-init ng tubig-dagat.
fact_bis: Ang mga bahura naguba tungod sa polusyon, sayop nga pangisda, ug pag-init sa tubig-dagat.

q: What happens to plants when drought causes the soil to lose too much moisture?
options: Plants wilt because there is not enough water and may die if rain does not come
Plants grow deeper roots to find water and survive without damage
Plants shed their flowers but keep their leaves and stay healthy
Plants absorb moisture from the air through their leaves instead
explanation: During drought, soil loses moisture; plants wilt when there is not enough water and may die if rain does not come.
fact_tl: Sa panahon ng tagtuyot, ang lupa ay nababawasan ng kahalumigmigan; ang mga halaman ay nalalanta kapag hindi sapat ang tubig sa lupa at maaaring mamatay kung patuloy na walang ulan.
fact_bis: Sa panahon sa hulaw, ang yuta mawad-an sa kahalumigmigan; ang mga tanom nalalanta sa dihang kulang ang tubig sa yuta ug mahimong mamatay kung walay ulan.

q: Why does a swimmer move forward when they push the water backward with their hands and feet?
options: The water pushes them forward in return, following Newton's third law
Their body becomes lighter in water so any push moves them forward
Water resistance is weak enough that the swimmer's weight carries them forward
The swimmer's lungs fill with air that lifts them toward the other end
explanation: A swimmer moves forward because they push the water backward, and the water pushes them forward in return — this is Newton's third law of motion.
fact_tl: Lumulutang at sumusulong ang manlalangoy dahil itinutulak niya ang tubig pabalik gamit ang kamay at paa, kaya itinutulak naman siya ng tubig pasulong (ikatlong batas ni Newton).
fact_bis: Mosulong ang molangoy tungod kay iduso niya ang tubig paatras gamit ang kamot ug tiil, mao nga ang tubig moduso kaniya pasulong (ikatulong balaod ni Newton).

q: Why do tuna travel across vast stretches of open ocean?
options: To find food and to spawn in suitable waters
To escape warm water by swimming toward the poles
To follow whale migration routes for protection
To shed their scales and grow new ones in deep water
explanation: Tuna migrate across vast stretches of open ocean to find food and to spawn.
fact_tl: Ang tuna ay naglalakbay nang napakalayo sa kalawakan ng dagat upang maghanap ng pagkain at mangitlog.
fact_bis: Ang tuna mopanaw og layo kaayo sa hawan nga dagat aron mangita og pagkaon ug mangitlog.

q: Why do the kidneys produce less urine during hot weather when we sweat more?
options: To keep the body from losing too much water, since water is already leaving through sweat
To redirect extra water to the sweat glands so they can produce more sweat
Because heat damages the kidneys and slows down their filtering work
Because we drink less water in hot weather so there is less to filter
explanation: In hot weather we sweat more, so the kidneys make less urine to keep the body from losing too much water.
fact_tl: Sa mainit na panahon, mas marami tayong pinagpapawisan kaya mas konti ang ihi para hindi mawalan ng tubig ang katawan.
fact_bis: Sa init nga panahon, mas mosingot ta maong mas gamay ang ihi aron dili mahutdan og tubig ang lawas.

q: On a roller coaster, what happens to energy as the car goes down from a high point?
options: Gravitational potential energy converts to kinetic energy, making the car go very fast at the bottom
Kinetic energy converts to heat energy, which slows the car down
The car gains new energy from the tracks as it descends
Potential energy is destroyed and the car moves on gravity alone
explanation: A roller coaster demonstrates energy conservation: descending from a high point converts gravitational potential energy to kinetic energy, producing high speed at the bottom.
fact_tl: Ang roller coaster ay nagpapakita ng conservation of energy: ang pagbaba mula sa mataas na bahagi ay nagpapalit ng gravitational potential energy tungo sa kinetic energy — nagdudulot ng mataas na bilis.
fact_bis: Ang roller coaster nagpakita sa conservation of energy: ang pagpababa gikan sa taas nga punto nagabalhin sa gravitational potential energy ngadto sa kinetic energy — nagabuhat og taas nga bilis sa ubos.

q: How can dried malunggay seeds help make muddy water cleaner?
options: They contain a natural substance that makes dirt clump together and sink
They release a chemical that kills all bacteria in the water
Their oil floats on top and traps mud particles like a filter
They absorb water into the seed and leave the mud behind
explanation: Dried malunggay seeds contain a natural substance that helps dirt in muddy water clump together and sink, making them useful for helping clean drinking water.
fact_tl: Ang tuyong buto mula sa malunggay pod ay may natural na sangkap na tumutulong magkapit ang mga dumi sa maputik na tubig para lumubog ang mga ito. Ginagamit ito sa ibang lugar bilang pantulong panlinis ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang uga nga liso gikan sa malunggay pod adunay natural nga sustansya nga motabang sa hugaw sa lapok nga tubig nga magtapok ug molugdang. Sa pipila ka dapit gigamit kini aron motabang limpyohan ang tubig.

q: What does your pupil do when you walk into a dark room?
options: It dilates (gets bigger) to let in more light
It contracts (gets smaller) to sharpen your vision
It stays the same size because the eye adjusts on its own
It turns a lighter color to reflect available light
explanation: The iris controls pupil size; the pupil dilates (gets bigger) in darkness to let in more light so you can see better.
fact_tl: Ang iris ay nagkokontrol sa laki ng pupil ng mata; lumalaki ang pupil (dilates) sa madilim para pumasok ang mas maraming liwanag, at lumiliit (contracts) sa maliwanag.
fact_bis: Ang iris nagkontrol sa gidak-on sa pupil; ang pupil nagdako (dilates) sa ngitngit aron masulod ang daghang kahayag, ug naghinay (contracts) sa hayag nga kahayag.

q: Is the far side of the Moon always dark?
options: No — the far side receives sunlight too; it is just the side that always faces away from Earth
Yes — the far side is permanently shadowed because the Sun cannot reach it
No — it is bright only during a full moon when Earth reflects light onto it
Yes — it is dark because Earth blocks all sunlight from reaching that side
explanation: The far side of the Moon is not always dark; it receives sunlight too. The correct term is 'far side' — the side that always faces away from Earth, not 'dark side'.
fact_tl: Ang far side ng Moon ay hindi palaging madilim; natatatanggap din ito ng sikat ng araw. Ang tamang salita ay 'far side' — ang panig na palaging nakatalikod sa Earth — hindi 'dark side'.
fact_bis: Ang far side sa Moon dili pirmi ngitngit; nakadawat usab kini og silaw sa adlaw. Ang husto nga termino mao ang 'far side' — ang bahin nga pirmi nakaatubang palayo sa Yuta — dili 'dark side'.

q: If an object keeps the same speed and direction, what is its acceleration?
options: Zero, because the forces acting on it are balanced
Negative, because staying still means decelerating
Equal to its speed, because acceleration and speed are the same thing
Positive, because maintaining speed requires a constant push
explanation: When an object keeps the same speed and direction, it has zero acceleration, which means the forces acting on it are balanced.
fact_tl: Kapag pare-pareho ang tulin at direksyon ng isang bagay, walang aselerasyon ito, at nangangahulugang balanse o magkapantay ang mga puwersang umiiral dito.
fact_bis: Kung parehas ra ang katulin ug direksyon sa usa ka butang, wala kini aselerasyon, nga nagpasabot nga balanse o managsama ang mga kusog nga naglihok niini.

q: What is the difference between the Tokyo Skytree and the Burj Khalifa?
options: The Tokyo Skytree is the tallest tower, while the Burj Khalifa is the tallest building
The Burj Khalifa is the tallest tower, while the Tokyo Skytree is the tallest building
Both are skyscrapers, with the Skytree in Dubai and the Burj Khalifa in Tokyo
They are both towers in Japan, with the Skytree being newer and taller
explanation: The Tokyo Skytree is the world's tallest tower, while the Burj Khalifa is the world's tallest building — these are two different records.
fact_tl: Ang Tokyo Skytree ang pinakamataas na tore (tower), ngunit ang Burj Khalifa ang pinakamataas na gusali (building).
fact_bis: Ang Tokyo Skytree mao ang pinakataas nga tore (tower), apan ang Burj Khalifa mao ang pinakataas nga building.

q: What freedom does the Philippine Constitution guarantee every Filipino when it comes to speaking their opinions?
options: The freedom to speak, write, and express opinions without fear of arrest
The freedom to hold any government position regardless of qualifications
The freedom to enter any building or property to gather information
The freedom to broadcast news on any channel without a license
explanation: The Philippine Constitution guarantees every Filipino the freedom to speak, write, and express opinions without fear of arrest.
fact_tl: Tinitiyak ng Saligang Batas ng Pilipinas ang kalayaan ng bawat Pilipino na magsalita, sumulat, at magpahayag ng kanilang mga opinyon nang walang pangamba sa pag-aresto.
fact_bis: Ginagarantiyahan sa Saligang Batas sa Pilipinas ang katungod sa matag Pilipino nga mosulti, magsulat, ug magpahayag sa ilang mga opinyon nga walay kahadlok sa dakop.

q: Why is a hot spring a clue that geothermal energy might be available nearby?
options: It shows that Earth's heat is close to the surface in that area
It means underground rivers are carrying water from distant volcanoes
It indicates that radioactive rocks are heating the water from below
It proves that the water table is very deep and full of minerals
explanation: When there is a hot spring, it is a clue that the Earth's heat is near the surface, and such places are often good for geothermal energy.
fact_tl: Kapag may mainit na bukal o hot spring, palatandaan ito na malapit lang sa ibabaw ang init ng lupa. Sa mga lugar na ganito ay malimit makakita ng geothermal energy.
fact_bis: Kung adunay init nga tubod o hot spring, timaan kini nga duol ra sa ibabaw ang init sa yuta. Kining mga lugara kasagaran maayo para sa geothermal energy.

q: What material makes your nose and ears soft and bendable?
options: Cartilage, which is softer and more bendable than bone
Tendons, which are tough but can be stretched in any direction
Fatty tissue, which cushions the nose and ears against impact
Compact bone, which is lighter and more flexible at the edges
explanation: The tips of our nose and ears are made of cartilage, which is softer and more bendable than bone.
fact_tl: Ang dulo ng ating ilong at tainga ay gawa sa kartilago, na mas malambot at madaling baluktutin kaysa buto.
fact_bis: Ang tumoy sa atong ilong ug dalunggan hinimo sa kartilago, nga mas humok ug sayon baliko kaysa bukog.

q: Why is the light produced by deep-sea animals called 'cold light'?
options: Because it gives off almost no heat, unlike fire or light bulbs
Because it only glows in very cold water near the ocean floor
Because the animals that produce it live in freezing temperatures
Because the light appears blue, which looks like a cold color
explanation: The light made by sea animals is called 'cold light' because it gives off almost no heat.
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng mga hayop sa dagat ay tinatawag na 'malamig na liwanag' dahil halos walang init na nalilikha kasabay nito.
fact_bis: Ang suga sa mga mananap sa dagat gitawag og 'bugnaw nga suga' tungod kay halos walay init nga mogawas uban niini.

q: What kind of energy does a battery convert into electrical energy?
options: Chemical energy from reactions inside the battery
Mechanical energy from the vibration of metal plates
Thermal energy stored as heat inside the battery cells
Light energy absorbed through the battery casing
explanation: A battery is a galvanic cell that converts chemical energy from reactions inside into electrical energy; when discharged, the chemical reactants have been used up.
fact_tl: Ang baterya ay isang galvanic cell na nagko-convert ng chemical energy mula sa mga chemical reaction sa loob nito patungo sa electrical energy — kapag na-discharge na ang baterya, naubos na ang mga sangkap sa reaksyon.
fact_bis: Ang baterya usa ka galvanic cell nga nagconvert sa chemical energy gikan sa mga reaksyon sa sulod niini ngadto sa electrical energy; kon maubos na ang baterya, ang mga chemical reactant sa sulod naubos na.

q: Which scientist discovered human blood types around the year 1900?
options: Karl Landsteiner
Louis Pasteur
Marie Curie
Alexander Fleming
explanation: The blood types were discovered around 1900 by the scientist Karl Landsteiner.
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang mga uri ng dugo noong 1900 ng siyentistang si Karl Landsteiner.
fact_bis: Ang mga klase sa dugo nadiskobrehan niadtong 1900 sa siyentista nga si Karl Landsteiner.

q: Who discovered the element radium in 1898?
options: Marie and Pierre Curie
Albert Einstein and Niels Bohr
Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla
Robert Boyle and John Dalton
explanation: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered the element radium in 1898.
fact_tl: Sina Marie at Pierre Curie ang tumuklas ng elementong radium noong 1898.
fact_bis: Sila si Marie ug Pierre Curie ang nakadiskobre sa elementong radium niadtong 1898.

q: What is most of the saliva in your mouth made of, and what does it help you do?
options: Mostly water; it helps you chew and swallow your food
Mostly stomach acid; it starts digesting food before you swallow
Mostly mucus; it coats your teeth to prevent cavities
Mostly sugar; it softens food so your teeth can break it apart
explanation: Most of the saliva in your mouth is water; it helps you chew and swallow your food.
fact_tl: Karamihan ng laway sa iyong bibig ay tubig; tinutulungan ka nito na nguyain at lunukin ang pagkain.
fact_bis: Kadaghanan sa laway sa imong baba kay tubig; motabang kini nimo sa pag-usap ug pagtulon sa pagkaon.

q: In which part of the Philippines is rubber an especially important crop?
options: Mindanao, including Zamboanga and Cotabato
Luzon, especially in the Cordillera highlands
The Visayas, particularly Cebu and Bohol
Metro Manila and surrounding lowland provinces
explanation: Rubber is an important crop in the Philippines, especially in Mindanao such as Zamboanga and Cotabato.
fact_tl: Ang goma ay isang importanteng pananim sa Pilipinas, lalo na sa Mindanao tulad ng Zamboanga at Cotabato.
fact_bis: Ang goma usa ka importante nga tanom sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa Mindanao sama sa Zamboanga ug Cotabato.

q: In what year was the stethoscope invented?
explanation: The stethoscope was invented in the year 1816.
fact_tl: Inimbento ang stethoscope noong taong 1816.
fact_bis: Ang stethoscope giimbento niadtong tuig 1816.

q: What happens to the size of a vibration during resonance when you keep adding pushes at the right time?
options: The vibration keeps growing bigger as energy builds up from each push
The vibration stays the same size because energy is used up as fast as it is added
The vibration shrinks because the object becomes tired from so much movement
The vibration changes direction with each push, canceling out the motion
explanation: In resonance, energy from each push builds up, so the size of the vibration keeps growing.
fact_tl: Sa resonansya, ang enerhiya mula sa bawat tulak ay naiipon, kaya lumalaki nang lumalaki ang lakas ng pag-uga.
fact_bis: Sa resonansya, ang kusog gikan sa matag tukmod magtigom, mao nga magpadayon sa pagdako ang kalakas sa pag-uyog.

q: What does the special protein inside a tardigrade do to help it survive radiation?
options: It acts like a shield that reduces damage to the tardigrade's DNA
It produces extra energy to repair cells damaged by radiation
It reflects radiation away from the tardigrade's body surface
It breaks down harmful radiation into safe chemicals
explanation: The tardigrade has a special protein that wraps around its DNA and acts like a shield, reducing damage caused by radiation.
fact_tl: Bahagi ng sikreto ng tardigrade ay isang espesyal na protina na bumabalot sa kanilang DNA (ang 'blueprint' ng katawan). Para itong proteksyon na bumabawas sa pinsala mula sa radiation. Kaya kahit medyo malakas na radiation, mas kaunti ang nasisira sa loob nila kumpara sa ibang hayop.
fact_bis: Kabahin sa sekreto sa tardigrade usa ka espesyal nga protina nga moputos sa ilang DNA (ang 'blueprint' sa lawas). Murag taming kini nga mokunhod sa kadaot gikan sa radiation. Mao nga bisan sa medyo kusog nga radiation, gamay ra ang madaot sulod nila kumpara sa ubang mananap.

q: What vitamin is found in long green chili that helps keep the body healthy and fights sickness?
options: Vitamin A
Vitamin B
Vitamin C
Vitamin D
explanation: Long green chili contains vitamin C, which strengthens the body's defenses against sickness.
fact_tl: Ang siling haba ay may bitamina C na tumutulong para maging malusog ang katawan at lumakas ang resistensya. Kaya bukod sa lasa, may pakinabang din ito sa kalusugan.
fact_bis: Ang siling haba adunay bitamina C nga makatabang aron mahimsog ang lawas ug molig-on ang depensa batok sa sakit. Busa gawas sa lami, maayo usab kini sa panglawas.

q: Why does a balloon shrink when you put it in a cold place like a fridge?
options: The rubber of the balloon gets stiff and pulls inward when cold
The cold makes the air particles crowd closer together, taking up less space
The air inside the balloon leaks out slowly through tiny holes when cold
The air particles inside lose their weight and push less on the balloon walls
explanation: Cold temperatures cause air particles to crowd closer together, so they take up less space and the balloon shrinks.
fact_tl: Kapag inilagay mo ang lobo sa malamig na lugar gaya ng ref, lumiliit ito. Dahil sa lamig, nagsisiksikan ang mga particle ng hangin kaya bumababa ang puwang na kailangan nila. Kapag muling uminit, lumalaki itong muli.
fact_bis: Kung ibutang nimo ang lobo sa bugnaw nga lugar sama sa ref, mokunhod kini. Tungod sa katugnaw, magsiksik ang mga partikulo sa hangin busa mokunhod ang ilang gikinahanglan nga luna. Kung mainit na usab, modako kini pag-usab.

q: What is special about the roots of orchid plants?
options: They glow green in sunlight because they contain chlorophyll
They have a spongy whitish covering that quickly absorbs and holds water
They grow straight down into the soil to reach underground water
They produce sticky sap that traps insects to feed the plant
explanation: Orchid roots have a spongy whitish covering that quickly absorbs and holds water.
fact_tl: Ang mga ugat ng orkidya ay may espongha-tulad na puting balat na sumisipsip at nag-iimbak ng tubig.
fact_bis: Ang mga gamot sa orkid adunay espongha nga maputi nga balat nga paspas mosuyop ug motipig ug tubig.

q: About how fast does Earth travel as it orbits the Sun?
options: About 3 kilometers every second
About 30 kilometers every second
About 300 kilometers every second
About 0.3 kilometers every second
explanation: Earth travels about 30 kilometers every second as it orbits the Sun, though we do not feel this motion at all.
fact_tl: Habang umiikot ang Earth sa Araw, naglalakbay ito nang napakabilis — mga 30 kilometro kada segundo — pero hindi natin nararamdaman ang paggalaw na ito.
fact_bis: Samtang molibot ang Earth sa Adlaw, mobiyahe kini nga paspas kaayo — mga 30 ka kilometro matag segundo — apan dili gyud nato mabati kining paglihok.

q: What fraction of the world's active volcanoes are found within the Ring of Fire?
options: About one-quarter
About one-half
About three-quarters
Almost all of them (nearly 100%)
explanation: About three-quarters of the world's active volcanoes are found within the Ring of Fire.
fact_tl: Mga tatlong-kapat ng mga aktibong bulkan sa mundo ay matatagpuan sa loob ng Ring of Fire.
fact_bis: Mga tulo ka bahin sa upat sa mga aktibo nga bulkan sa kalibutan makita sulod sa Ring of Fire.

q: Which mountain is the highest in the Philippines?
options: Mount Mayon in Albay
Mount Pulag in Benguet
Mount Apo in Mindanao
Mount Pinatubo in Zambales
explanation: Mount Apo in Mindanao is the highest mountain in the Philippines.
fact_tl: Ang Mount Apo sa Mindanao ang pinakamataas na bundok sa Pilipinas.
fact_bis: Ang Mount Apo sa Mindanao mao ang labing taas nga bukid sa Pilipinas.

q: In what year did the first spacewalk in history take place?
explanation: The first spacewalk took place on March 18, 1965.
fact_tl: Ang unang spacewalk ay ginawa noong Marso 18, 1965.
fact_bis: Ang unang spacewalk gihimo niadtong Marso 18, 1965.

q: After mixing oral rehydration salts (ORS) in water, how long can you safely keep and use the solution?
options: Up to one week if kept in a cool, dark place
Up to three days if stored in a clean, closed container
About one day (around 24 hours), then throw it out
Until it starts to smell or look cloudy
explanation: Mixed ORS should be used within about 24 hours because germs can grow in it after that, making it unsafe to drink.
fact_tl: Pwede bang gamitin ang naihalong ORS kahit kinabukasan? Hindi. Kapag naihalo na, dapat itong gamitin sa loob ng isang araw lang (mga 24 oras). Pagkatapos noon, pwede nang magkaroon ng bakterya, kaya dapat itapon at gumawa ng bago. Laging sariwa ang ligtas.
fact_bis: Mahimo ba gamiton ang nasagol nga ORS bisan ugma? Dili. Kon nasagol na, kinahanglan kini gamiton sulod sa usa ka adlaw lang (mga 24 oras). Human niana, mahimong motubo ang bakterya niini, busa ilabay kini ug paghimo og bag-o. Ang preska kanunay mas luwas.

q: What is the name for the curved chain of volcanoes stretching from Batanes in the north to Bicol in the south of Luzon?
options: A volcanic rift
A volcanic arc
A volcanic island
A volcanic ridge
explanation: The volcanoes along Luzon from Batanes to Bicol form a volcanic arc — a curved chain created by the subduction of tectonic plates.
fact_tl: Ang mga bulkan ng Luzon mula sa Batanes sa hilaga hanggang Bicol sa timog ay bumubuo ng isang volcanic arc—isang kurba na linya ng mga bulkan na nabuo dahil sa pagsalid ng tektono plaka sa ilalim ng Luzon.
fact_bis: Ang mga bulkan sa Luzon gikan sa Batanes sa amihanan hangtod Bicol sa habagatan nagbuo og volcanic arc—usa ka kurba nga kadena sa mga bulkan nga gihimo sa subduction sa mga tectonic plate sa ilalim sa Luzon.

q: The Philippine Trench is one of the deepest ocean points on Earth. What kinds of animals live there?
options: Animals that are identical to those found in shallow coral reefs
Animals specially adapted to survive extreme water pressure
Animals that rely on sunlight filtering down from the surface
Animals that migrate up to shallow water every night to feed
explanation: The Philippine Trench reaches over 10,000 meters deep and harbors animals specially adapted to survive the extreme pressure found there.
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Trench (kilala rin bilang Galathea Depth o East Mindanao Trench) ay isa sa mga pinakamalalim na karagatan sa mundo — umabot ng higit sa 10,000 metro ang lalim — at nagtatago ng mga espesyal na hayop na naka-angkop sa sobrang presyon.
fact_bis: Ang Philippine Trench (nailhan usab nga Galathea Depth o East Mindanao Trench) usa sa pinakamalalum nga mga punto sa dagat sa Yuta — nagaabot og labaw sa 10,000 metro ang lalim — ug nagdala sa mga hayop nga espesyal nga naka-angkop sa sobrang presyon.

q: Why are trilobite fossils so commonly found?
options: Trilobites lived in very large groups, so many died together in one place
Trilobites had a hard armor-like shell that easily turned to stone after they died
Trilobites were buried very quickly by undersea earthquakes that preserved them
Trilobites had soft, waxy bodies that resisted decay for millions of years
